Female/F_Armsaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_2025.description: A single fin-like blade running along the outer left forearm, tapering to a point at the wrist, with several curved frilly spikes along its edge and a tall curled tip near the elbow. Fantasy, aquatic creature styling.
Female/F_Armsaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_2025.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the fin; colour 3 on the frilled spikes and edge tips, blending into colour 1 toward the middle.

Female/F_Armsaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_2025.description: A single organic fin-like blade running along the outside of the right forearm, with a smooth tapered base and several curved, frilled spurs branching off toward the elbow. It suggests aquatic creature styling.
Female/F_Armsaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_2025.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the fin; colour 3 on the spur tips and upper edges, blending into colour 1.

Female/F_Back_Alien_01.description: A narrow spinal ridge of layered, curved blade-like fins running down the centre of the upper back, each fin ending in a sharp spike. A jagged central strip pokes out past the shoulders. Alien, organic-armor look.
Female/F_Back_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central ridge strip and fin edges; colour 1 on the curved fin panels; colour 2 on the inner fin shadows and undersides; colour 3 on the spike tips.
Female/F_Back_Alien_01.differs: The female ridge is a little shorter and sits slightly narrower along the spine, with more widely spaced spikes.

Female/F_Back_Alien_02.description: A pair of segmented mechanical arms that sprout from the upper back and arch up and over the shoulders, each ending in a large finned claw with a curved talon. Alien, insectoid cyborg look.
Female/F_Back_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented arm sections; colour 2 on the joint bands between segments; colour 1 on the claw heads; colour 3 on the curved talons.

Female/F_Back_Amazon_Blade_01.description: A straight sheathed sword carried diagonally across the back, hilt rising above the right shoulder. It has a wrapped grip, round pommel, winged guard and a long tapering blade in a ridged scabbard.
Female/F_Back_Amazon_Blade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pommel and metal fittings; colour 3 on the grip wrap; colour 1 on the winged guard and scabbard mouth; colour 2 on the scabbard and blade.

Female/F_Back_Animal_Snake_01.description: A narrow spinal ridge of overlapping, pointed scale plates running down the centre of the back from between the shoulder blades to the lower back, tapering at the ends. It suggests a snake or reptile.
Female/F_Back_Animal_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth central strip along the spine; colour 3 on the overlapping scale plates.

Female/F_Back_Astronaut_01.description: A boxy two-tier astronaut life-support backpack of padded, quilted cloth, with a smaller upper block on a larger lower block, a thin antenna on top, and a contrasting harness plate with straps facing the body. Reads as retro space gear.
Female/F_Back_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded casing; colour 1 on the horizontal bands, back vents and harness straps; colour 2 on the harness plate, antenna and back hatch; colour 3 on the small lights and strap ends.

Female/F_Back_Backpack_Cat_01.description: A cute plush cat backpack clinging to the upper back: rounded stuffed body with pointed ears, big round eyes, dangling tail and small bat-like wings spread out at the shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Backpack_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cat body and wing bones; colour 1 on the wing membranes and neck bow; colour 2 on the inner ears; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Back_Backpack_Halloween_01.description: A soft cloth trick-or-treat sack worn as a backpack, tapering to the bottom, printed with crescent moons, stars and swirls. Its contrasting rim overflows with candy canes, a round bomb-like sweet and wrapped treats. Cute holiday styling.
Female/F_Back_Backpack_Halloween_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sack body; colour 3 on the crescents, stars and candy stripes; colour 1 on the swirls, the band below the rim and some sweets; colour 2 on the rim, the bottom patch and the candy sticks.

Female/F_Back_Bat_Saw_01.description: A baseball bat with a circular saw blade fixed to its head, slung diagonally across the back with the saw resting above the shoulder and the handle ending near the hip. Improvised, mechanical street-weapon look.
Female/F_Back_Bat_Saw_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the saw blade and the bat handle; colour 3 on the bat barrel and the end knob; colour 2 on the grip bands and the saw's inner ring.

Female/F_Back_Blacktalonrocketpack_01.description: A mechanical backpack with a wide armored plate across the upper back and two articulated arms rising over the shoulders, each holding a boxy rocket pod with vented panels. Wraps slightly over the shoulders with small flat tabs at the front.
Female/F_Back_Blacktalonrocketpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and pod casings; colour 1 on the pod end panels and back plate inserts; colour 2 on the joints, arm mounts and edge trim; colour 3 has no clear use.
Female/F_Back_Blacktalonrocketpack_01.differs: The rocket pods sit slightly higher and closer together on the female version.

Female/F_Back_Bow_01.description: A large puffy bow worn across the upper back, with two rounded loops meeting at a central knot and two long tails hanging down the spine to the thighs. Cute, decorative and slightly mechanical in style.
Female/F_Back_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot, loop edging and the tails' outer strips; colour 1 on the outer faces of the loops and the tail centres; colour 2 on the loop tips and tail panels; colour 3 on the loop undersides.

Female/F_Back_Cannon_01.description: A backpack-mounted pair of heavy cannons: a rounded armored plate sits between the shoulder blades and two tall segmented barrels rise past the shoulders, angled forward, linked by looped ribbed cables.
Female/F_Back_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the backplate and barrel housings; colour 1 on the barrel bodies, vent panel and cable bands; colour 3 on the muzzle discs and the joint connectors.

Female/F_Back_Cannonarm_01.description: A pair of large mechanical cannons mounted on the upper back, each with a streamlined casing, a rounded intake at the base and a long multi-barrel muzzle rising above the shoulders. Sci-fi heavy-weapon style.
Female/F_Back_Cannonarm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casings; colour 1 on the barrel shrouds and edge panels; colour 2 on the intakes and inner mechanisms; colour 3 on small accent lights near the muzzles.
Female/F_Back_Cannonarm_01.differs: The two cannons sit closer together and more upright on the back, and are angled slightly less outward than on the male.

Female/F_Back_Child_Backpack_Cat_01.description: A pair of small stylised wings sitting on the upper back, one at each shoulder blade. Each has a slim curved bone-like spar with jagged, feather-like tips that sweep outward, giving a cute, fantastical look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Backpack_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing spars; colour 1 on the jagged feather-like tips.

Female/F_Back_Child_Backpack_Halloween_0.description: A small cluster of holiday sweets worn at the upper back near the neck: candy canes, a striped wrapped candy, a round bomb-like sweet, a mitten-like contrasting lump and a striped stick poking out in several directions.
Female/F_Back_Child_Backpack_Halloween_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the candy cane and candy stripes and the wrapper; colour 3 on the stripes of the canes and the round candy; colour 1 on the lump and wrapper twists; colour 2 on the round sweet and the stick.
Female/F_Back_Child_Backpack_Halloween_0.differs: The female version is bunched slightly higher and more tightly around the neck, with the round contrasting sweet more visible from the front.

Female/F_Back_Child_Cannon_01.description: A pair of chunky mechanical cannons mounted over the shoulders on the back, angled forward with the muzzles above the shoulders. Each has an octagonal barrel, segmented armored casing and a narrow tapering rear connector. Sci-fi heavy weapon backpack.
Female/F_Back_Child_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer barrel casing and housing plates; colour 0 on the inner segments and rim highlights; colour 3 on the muzzle caps; colour 2 on the small joints and connectors.
Female/F_Back_Child_Cannon_01.differs: The two cannons sit staggered, one higher and further forward than the other, and are angled outward away from the head.

Female/F_Back_Child_Cryo_01.description: Two separate curved, glossy flat panels stacked on the upper and lower back with a gap between them, each slightly wrapped around the torso like a shield plate. Suggests a minimalist sci-fi back unit.
Female/F_Back_Child_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both back panels; the glossy default material shows little of the other colour slots.

Female/F_Back_Child_Cryo_02.description: A scatter of small faceted crystal or ice chunks clustered down the upper and mid back along the spine, thinning out toward the lower back. Sits directly on the body like frozen growths, with a cryogenic feel.
Female/F_Back_Child_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crystal chunks; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Back_Child_Cryo_03.description: A pair of woven shoulder straps that loop over each shoulder and under the arms like a harness, each fastened with a chunky mechanical buckle clip. Loose ends hang open, giving a sparse sci-fi utility look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Cryo_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the woven straps; colour 1 on the buckle housings; colour 2 on the buckle clasp edges and fittings.
Female/F_Back_Child_Cryo_03.differs: The straps are fuller and connected across the back, with the loops curving under the bust rather than sitting apart.

Female/F_Back_Child_Feathers_01.description: Four long, blade-like feathered limbs radiating from the upper back, two per side, sweeping outward and down past the hips with jagged serrated tips. A mechanical, winged look suited to sci-fi or monstrous designs.
Female/F_Back_Child_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather shafts and inner vanes; colour 3 on the serrated outer tips; colour 0 on the light streaks near the middle of each feather.
Female/F_Back_Child_Feathers_01.differs: The female version's feathers sit slightly higher and spread wider with a more pronounced downward curl at the tips.

Female/F_Back_Child_Feathers_02.description: A pair of long, whip-like feathered tendrils sprouting from the lower back, sweeping outward and down past the hips. Each has a serrated feather fringe along a thin spine and ends in a large eye-marked plume. Fantasy or monstrous look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Feathers_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather vanes near the base; colour 2 on the thin spine; colour 0 on the serrated fringe edges; colour 3 on the eye-marked end plumes.

Female/F_Back_Child_Feathers_03.description: Six long, curved peacock-style feathers fanning out from the upper back in two tiers, with thin stems, eye-spot tips on the upper pair and broad swept blades on the lower pair. Fantasy, decorative back accessory.
Female/F_Back_Child_Feathers_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long feather stems and barbs; colour 3 on the broad feather blades and eye-spot surrounds; colour 0 on the fringe edges; colour 2 on the eye-spot centres and vane shafts.
Female/F_Back_Child_Feathers_03.differs: The female feathers fan out wider and lower, with the upper pair rising nearly straight up and the tips curving less forward.

Female/F_Back_Child_Future_01.description: A pair of small mechanical ring thrusters floating at the lower back and hips, each a thick octagonal hoop with a glowing inner ring and a short angular nozzle bracket. Suggests compact futuristic wings.
Female/F_Back_Child_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer hoops; colour 3 on the inner rings; colour 1 on the nozzle brackets.
Female/F_Back_Child_Future_01.differs: The female rings sit higher, around waist and rib level, and hang farther out to the sides.

Female/F_Back_Child_Ghost_Hunter_01.description: A pair of padded backpack-style shoulder straps that arch over each shoulder, with a piped edge and a small end tab, then trail down as thin webbing straps across the chest and back. Sits as a light harness.
Female/F_Back_Child_Ghost_Hunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the padded strap tops; colour 0 on the piping edges and underside of the straps; colour 3 on the small end tabs; colour 2 on the thin trailing webbing.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_01.description: A pair of slender helicopter rotor blades floating in a line above the head, each blade tapering from a small central hub with a ringed joint, giving a playful mechanical look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_01.colourAreas: The blades appear entirely in one glossy shade, so the colour scheme seems to be ignored by the default material.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_01.differs: The female blades show as a single uniform glossy shade, while the male blades have contrasting colour bands and tips.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_02.description: A pair of separate jet-pack pods floating out to each side of the back, each a domed rounded engine with a winglike panel, small vertical thrusters and pointed tips. A mechanical, sci-fi superhero flight rig.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the engine domes, wing panels and thrusters; colour 1 on the panel insets, dome caps and piping; colour 3 on the vents on the domes; colour 2 on small joints.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_B.description: A plain placeholder cube with flat faces and sharp edges, shown floating near the body. No jetpack or helicopter details are visible, so it reads as an unfinished or stand-in model.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_B.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cube; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_B.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges, floating near the body. It does not show any jetpack or rotor detail, so its real form is unclear.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_B.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_C.description: Only a plain featureless cube placeholder shows in place of the helicopter jetpack; no rotor, engine or straps are visible, and it floats near the body without clearly attaching to the back.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_C.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cube's faces; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_G.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges, floating near the back with no visible jetpack or rotor detail. Little can be told about its intended style.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_G.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cube; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_G.description: A plain, featureless cube placeholder floating in the zoomed views, with no visible jetpack or helicopter detail and no attachment to the body. Nothing shows on the full-body views, so little can be said about its real form.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_G.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cube faces; the shading looks uniform, with no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_O.description: A plain placeholder-like cube with flat faces and sharp edges, floating in the zoomed views; it does not show as an attached jetpack or helicopter shape and is not visible on the full body.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_O.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cube; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_P.description: A plain cube-shaped block with flat faces and sharp edges, shown floating with no visible straps or jetpack detail. It is not visible on the full-body views, so its placement on the back is unclear.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_P.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cube; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_P.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges, floating near the body. It shows no jetpack or helicopter detail, so its actual form is unclear.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_P.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_R.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges. It floats near the body and no jetpack or rotor detail is visible, so it does not read as a helicopter pack.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_R.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_W.description: A plain cube-shaped block with flat faces and sharp edges, seemingly a placeholder for a jetpack. It is not visible on the body in the full views, so nothing more can be said about its placement.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_W.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Y.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges. It floats near the body without visibly attaching to it, and no jetpack or helicopter details can be seen.
Female/F_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Y.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; the faces show only shading differences, and no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Back_Child_Jetengine_01.description: A pair of thin curved harness straps that arch over each shoulder, run down the front of the chest and the back, and end in small tips near the ribs. The straps look like the mounting for a jet pack.
Female/F_Back_Child_Jetengine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the small connector tips at the strap ends.

Female/F_Back_Child_Jetengine_02.description: A pair of boxy jet engine pods mounted at the shoulder blades, each with a vented rear grille, bolted corners and a downward exhaust nozzle, with long segmented swept-out wings extending sideways from each pod.
Female/F_Back_Child_Jetengine_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pod casings and wings; colour 1 on the exhaust nozzles and the intake tops; colour 3 on the rear vent grilles; colour 2 on the bolts.

Female/F_Back_Child_Kaiju_01.description: A single-sided cluster of jagged, overlapping spikes sweeping outward from a smooth tapered panel that runs down one side of the upper back and chest. Monstrous, kaiju-like dorsal ridge with a spiky, aggressive silhouette.
Female/F_Back_Child_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the smooth panel and the outer spikes; colour 2 on the darker inner spike layers.
Female/F_Back_Child_Kaiju_01.differs: The female panel is narrower and sits slightly further toward the side, and the spikes fan out in a longer sweep.

Female/F_Back_Child_Kaiju_02.description: A small monstrous growth on the lower back: a smooth rounded ridge that wraps toward the flank, with clusters of jagged spikes and layered shards trailing out behind. Suggests a kaiju or alien organic look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer spikes and the smooth rounded ridge; colour 2 on the inner recesses between the spikes.
Female/F_Back_Child_Kaiju_02.differs: The female spikes fan out and trail further to the side, with a slightly smaller smooth ridge at the front.

Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_01.description: A small stuffed shisa lion-dog charm hanging by a twisted cord beside the shoulder, floating off the body. It has a plush rounded body, upright ears, a circular eye rosette, a starburst mane motif and dangling tassels; suggests festive east-asian lantern styling.
Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plush body; colour 0 on the mane starbursts, cord and toe studs; colour 3 on the eye rosettes and tassels; colour 2 on the ears and underside.

Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_02.description: A small paper lantern hanging on a twisted wire loop with a hook, floating off to the side of the back. Ribbed octagonal cylinder body with flat caps top and bottom and a splashed ink-brush pattern on one face.
Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the lantern body; colour 1 on the top and bottom caps; colour 2 on the ink-brush pattern; colour 0 on the wire loop and hook.

Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_03.description: A ribbed accordion-style paper lantern hanging from a looped hanger cord, floating beside the body at shoulder height. Its stacked pleats form a cylinder with flat caps, and a calligraphy-like glyph marks one side.
Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the pleated lantern body and caps; colour 1 on the hanging loop; colour 3 on the glyph marking.

Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_04.description: A small round paper-style lantern charm hanging from a looped cord, with a capped top collar, a scalloped contrasting band across the upper dome, a small base fitting and a long tassel. It floats beside the hip as a back accessory.
Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the lantern body; colour 2 on the scalloped upper band; colour 0 on the top and bottom caps; colour 1 on the loop cord and tassel.

Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_05.description: A small hanging pagoda-style lantern with a flared, upturned roof, a square windowed body of paned glowing panels, and a base with clasps. It dangles from a looped cord and ring, floating beside the hip like a charm.
Female/F_Back_Child_Lantern_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the roof, frame and base; colour 3 on the window panes; colour 2 on the base clasps and cord; colour 0 on the metal ring and bottom pin.

Female/F_Back_Child_Mane_Spikey_01.description: A small, mane-like tuft of layered, jagged spikes worn on the lower back at the waist, with a solid faceted cap at the top and pointed strands that fade in tone toward the tips.
Female/F_Back_Child_Mane_Spikey_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted cap and the upper spikes; colour 0 on the central strands and spike tips; colour 2 on the darker shading between the strands.

Female/F_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_01.description: Four mechanical spider legs sprout from the upper back, two rising above the shoulders and two sweeping down past the hips. Each is a jointed, segmented limb ending in a flat, curved blade tip; a sci-fi villain look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light inner limb segments; colour 2 on the darker outer limb segments; colour 1 on the blade tips.

Female/F_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_02.description: Four jointed mechanical spider legs sprouting from the upper back, two arching up over the shoulders and two sweeping down past the hips, each with slim segmented limbs and curved blade tips.
Female/F_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_02.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and metallic and mostly ignores the colour scheme, so the whole piece shows as one bright reflective finish; no separate colour slots are distinguishable.
Female/F_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_02.differs: The female legs are contrasting and glossy, with the finish ignoring the scheme and no contrasting segments. They are also longer and thinner, with a wider blade sweep.

Female/F_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_01.description: A pair of tall mechanical weapon pods worn on the back, each a boxy housing with a round drum and a long, thin, ringed barrel rising well above the head; held by a strap band at the shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings and drums; colour 1 on the barrels, frames and joints; colour 2 on the strap bands and barrel rings; colour 3 on the barrel tip lights.
Female/F_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_01.differs: The female pods sit closer together and lean inward slightly on the narrower back.

Female/F_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_02.description: A pair of boxy mechanical cylinder canisters that float out to either side of the torso, each with a capped top, a side nozzle and a vented panel. Sci-fi gadget pods suggesting a tactical payload pack.
Female/F_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the caps on top; colour 2 on the vent slots and nozzle; colour 3 on the small marks on the front panel.
Female/F_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_02.differs: The female canisters sit a little further from the body and are angled, and have a small extra panel with marks on the front.

Female/F_Back_Child_Renegade_01.description: A small mechanical hose or cable worn on one shoulder: a short nozzle on a jointed connector with a long flexible tube that loops down across the upper chest and back, ending in a tip. Sci-fi accessory.
Female/F_Back_Child_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nozzle and tube tips; colour 1 on the connector joint; colour 3 on the flexible tube.
Female/F_Back_Child_Renegade_01.differs: The tube hangs lower and the loop is wider, reaching further down the chest, and the connector sits higher on the shoulder.

Female/F_Back_Child_Renegade_02.description: A single flexible hose or cable that arcs from a funnel-shaped metal nozzle at the shoulder, around the upper chest and under the arm, ending in a small pointed tip. A banded collar joins the nozzle to the hose.
Female/F_Back_Child_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nozzle and the tip; colour 1 on the band ring where the nozzle meets the hose; colour 3 on the hose.
Female/F_Back_Child_Renegade_02.differs: The hose is shorter and curves in a tighter, rounder loop over the chest. It has a smoother, less angular bend.

Female/F_Back_Child_Seacreature_03.description: A pair of spiky, layered fin-like wings mounted on the upper back, with jagged ribbed blades that sweep outward and upward from the spine. Suggests an aquatic or alien creature look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Seacreature_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ribbed fin surfaces; colour 1 on the edging and bands along the fins; colour 3 on the accent stripes; colour 2 on the darkest blade tips and underside.

Female/F_Back_Child_Skateboard_01.description: Two small skateboard truck assemblies with paired wheels, one perched at the base of the neck and one at the lower back. They read as a split, playful street-style back accessory.
Female/F_Back_Child_Skateboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the truck axles and mounting plates; colour 2 on the wheels.

Female/F_Back_Child_Skateboard_02.description: A flat atom-symbol decal on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring. It lies flush against the body with no thickness, like a printed emblem on a suit.
Female/F_Back_Child_Skateboard_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outlines of the orbits and nucleus; colour 0 on the fill inside the orbit lines.

Female/F_Back_Child_Snowball_01.description: A pair of segmented, curved metal pipes rising from the upper back and arching forward over the shoulders, each ending in a round fan-like nozzle with a central hub, like mechanical snowball launchers.
Female/F_Back_Child_Snowball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pipe segments and nozzle rims; colour 1 on the nozzle faces; colour 2 on the ring around each hub; colour 3 on the central hub.
Female/F_Back_Child_Snowball_01.differs: The female pipes arch higher and further forward, with one nozzle facing forward and the other facing sideways, and both stand more upright than the male pair.

Female/F_Back_Child_Snowball_02.description: Two floating clusters of snow-capped, icicle-fringed chunks hovering on either side of the head at ear height, each a lumpy snow mound above jagged dripping ice shards. Wintry fantasy look, not attached to the body.
Female/F_Back_Child_Snowball_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snow mounds and ice shards; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Back_Child_Snowball_03.description: A pair of woven webbing harness straps that loop over each shoulder and cross under the arms, each with a small mechanical buckle housing at the shoulder and loose strap ends. Minimal, playful gear look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Snowball_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbing straps; colour 1 on the buckle housings and their panels; colour 2 on the buckle edges and fittings.

Female/F_Back_Child_Space_01.description: Three small glossy spherical nodes stacked in a vertical line down the spine, from the base of the neck to the mid-back. They read as mechanical studs or ports and suit a futuristic look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Space_01.colourAreas: The glossy metallic spheres appear to ignore the colour scheme, so no slot shows clearly on them.

Female/F_Back_Child_Speakers_01.description: A backpack of two tall speaker cabinets rising above the shoulders, each with paired woofer rings and strapped mid-height, mounted on a wide boombox-style base unit with twin speakers and a central handle block.
Female/F_Back_Child_Speakers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cabinet shells, straps and base casing; colour 1 on the speaker grille panels; colour 2 on the central handle block and woofer rims; colour 3 on the small studs and ring accents.

Female/F_Back_Child_Teleos_01.description: A floating glowing ring-shaped energy orb hovering at the centre of the upper back, orbited by four small translucent egg-shaped shards scattered around the shoulders and ribs. Not attached to the body; suggests a sci-fi power source.
Female/F_Back_Child_Teleos_01.colourAreas: The glowing ring and shards ignore the colour scheme and show as self-lit energy; no colour slots visibly apply.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_01.description: A back-mounted armored tail of three stacked, segmented plates that curls up from the mid-back and over one shoulder, with scratch marks and blotchy panels. Sleek, scorpion-like, monstrous look with small pointed edges.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 2 on the blotches and inner edges; colour 3 on the small flecks; colour 1 is barely visible.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_01.differs: The female version curls over the shoulder with a narrower, more slender arc and the top segment sits further to the side.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_02.description: A pair of mechanical arm-like spikes mounted at the base of the neck, each with a cuffed socket that bends outward and sweeps up past head height into a thin pointed tip, like robotic insect pincers.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main arm segments; colour 1 on the socket cuffs; colour 2 on the joint bands and elbow sections.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_02.differs: The female arms rise from lower on the shoulders, the tips curve slightly further outward, and the two arms sit at more uneven heights.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_03.description: A small V-shaped armor plate that hangs over the upper chest, held by two chunky linked chains that rise over the shoulders toward the neck. It has claw-scratch marks and segmented panels, in a feral mechanical style.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface and scratched area; colour 2 on the segmented panels; colour 3 on the small studs or dots on the panels; colour 1 on the chain links.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A back-mounted fan of six long, tapering cylindrical pods with contrasting tips, splayed upward and outward from the upper back and rising past the shoulders like mechanical spines. Suggests a sci-fi or cyberpunk backpack.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pod bodies; colour 2 on the pod tips and darker inner sections; colour 0 and colour 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Cybergrid_01.differs: The female version has its pods more tightly clustered and angled sideways, giving a narrower spread than the male's wider, more upright fan.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Demon_Huge_01.description: A pair of large bat-like demon wings sprouting from the upper back, each with a bony arm and long fingered spars that stretch a scalloped membrane outward and slightly upward in a wide spread.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Demon_Huge_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 0 on the bony spars and edge ridges.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Hunchback_Hair.description: A strip of coarse, striped fur running down the spine from the neck to the lower back, with jagged spiky tufts along the ridge and a ragged tapering edge. Suits a werewolf or beast look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Hunchback_Hair.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur edges and lower fur; colour 1 on the central ridge and spiky tufts; colour 2 on the stripe markings; colour 3 on a few accent stripes.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.description: Four long segmented mechanical tentacle arms sprout from a central mount on the upper back. Two arch up over the shoulders and two sweep down and outward, each ending in a three-pronged claw with a collar-like joint.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm segments; colour 2 on the joint bands and claw prongs; colour 1 on the claw wrist collars; colour 3 on the thin stripe running along each arm.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_02.description: A pair of segmented mechanical tentacle arms rising from the upper back, arching up and over the head and forward. Each ends in a boxy wrist joint with a spread of pointed claws, in a villainous sci-fi style.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented arm plates; colour 3 on the thin cable lines along the arms; colour 1 on the wrist housings; colour 2 on the claws and base mounts.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_03.description: A pair of long segmented mechanical tentacle arms rising from the upper back, arcing out past the shoulders and sweeping forward and down to end in three-pronged claw hands beside the hips. Suggests a supervillain harness.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light segments along the arms; colour 2 on the underside of the arms; colour 3 on the thin stripe along each arm; colour 1 on the claw wrist housings; claw prongs stay near black.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_03.differs: The female arms hang lower and more symmetrically, ending in claws beside the hips, while the male arms sit differently with one claw raised.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_0.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem worn on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a hexagonal core with a small central ring. It lies flush against the body like a printed badge.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and core; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_0.description: A flat atom-symbol emblem printed on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central ring. It lies flush against the body like a decal and suits a sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_0.description: A flat atom-style emblem on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central ring, with a thin raised outline. It sits flush on the shoulder blades, suggesting a science-themed superhero look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit bands and central ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging.

Female/F_Back_Child_Tubes_01.description: A pair of curved, segmented mechanical tubes that rise from behind the shoulders and arc forward over them, ending in open, ragged tips at the back. Banded ridges mark each segment, giving a cyborg or mechanical-limb look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tubes_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tube bodies; colour 3 on the thin bands between segments.
Female/F_Back_Child_Tubes_01.differs: The female tubes are shorter and hook more sharply forward and down over the shoulders. One tube is nearly straight and the other is more strongly curved.

Female/F_Back_Child_Vigilante_01.description: A bundle of three long arrows slung diagonally across the back, with feathered fletching poking up past the shoulder and barbed, multi-pronged heads hanging near the lower back. A vigilante archer look.
Female/F_Back_Child_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fletching feathers; colour 0 on the arrow shafts; colour 2 on the barbed arrowheads.

Female/F_Back_Child_Wings_Patriot_01.description: A pair of large feathered wings rising from the upper back, swept up and out then curving down to long pointed tips below the hips, with layered rows of feathers and a bordered leading edge.
Female/F_Back_Child_Wings_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper feather row; colour 1 on the middle feather row; colour 2 on the long lower flight feathers; colour 3 on the leading edge trim.
Female/F_Back_Child_Wings_Patriot_01.differs: The female wings are held slightly more upright and closer together, with the tips angled more inward and less spread than the male version.

Female/F_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_01.description: A pair of mechanical thruster wings worn on the upper back: two long, angled armoured pods with slim fin-like blades and small vented tips fanning outward and down past the shoulders, in a sleek sci-fi superhero style.
Female/F_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main pod shells and blades; colour 0 on the inner panels and plating; colour 3 on the small fins and vent accents; colour 2 on the thruster nozzles and recesses.

Female/F_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_02.description: A pair of mechanical thruster wings mounted at the shoulder blades, each made of several long tapering pods angled backward and down, with segmented armored casings, nozzle tips and contrasting intake housings at the front.
Female/F_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main pod casings; colour 0 on the banding and edge stripes; colour 3 on the nozzle tips and side fins; colour 2 on the intake housings and inner recesses.
Female/F_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_02.differs: The female wings sit lower and spread further apart, with the two pods on each side forming a narrower, tighter cluster.

Female/F_Back_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A small mechanical backpack plate sitting between the shoulder blades, with angular armored panels and two jointed robotic arms that curve over the shoulders and reach down onto the upper chest with clawed tips.
Female/F_Back_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jointed arms and inner plates; colour 1 on the arm trim and side stripes; colour 2 on the main back plates; colour 3 on small accents at the arm tips and the joint panel.
Female/F_Back_Clockwork_Armor_01.differs: The female arms curve tighter around the chest and hang lower over the bust, with a larger back plate.

Female/F_Back_Cosmic_01.description: A pair of tall, thin angular back panels that rise behind the shoulders like mechanical wings. Each is a segmented, zigzagging plate with layered stripes, angled inward toward the spine and sitting off the upper back.
Female/F_Back_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate edges and framing; colour 1 on the long stripe panels; colour 2 on the zigzag inset segments; colour 3 on the small accent blocks near the lower tips.

Female/F_Back_Cosmos_01.description: A large floating metal ring standing upright behind the head and shoulders, with four sharp diamond-shaped spikes set around it at the top, both sides and the bottom. Suggests a halo-like mechanical sci-fi backpiece.
Female/F_Back_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring's inner highlights; colour 2 on the ring body; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 3 on the diamond inlays in the spikes.

Female/F_Back_Crusher_Blade_01.description: A large mechanical broadsword carried diagonally across the back, with a chunky blocky hilt of stacked metal segments, a hollow open-frame blade with rungs and a pointed tip, hanging down past the hip.
Female/F_Back_Crusher_Blade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hilt blocks and blade rungs; colour 1 on the hilt centre accents; colour 2 on the grip and pommel; colour 3 on the blade frame.
Female/F_Back_Crusher_Blade_01.differs: The female sword hangs steeper, nearly vertical down the back, while the male one lies at a shallower diagonal angle.

Female/F_Back_Cryo_01.description: A mechanical cryo backpack: a tall clear glass cylinder with a capped, camera-like top, a bulky lower base of rocket-shaped pods and vents, looping hoses, and shoulder straps. Sits high on the back in a sci-fi style.
Female/F_Back_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cap and lower pods; colour 0 on the shoulder straps and the top housing trim; colour 2 on the base vents and panels; colour 3 on the hoses. The cylinder is clear glass and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Back_Crystal_01.description: A cluster of faceted, elongated crystal shards fanned out across the upper back and poking past the shoulder toward the front, in varied sizes. Glossy and angular, it suggests a fantasy or mystic look.
Female/F_Back_Crystal_01.colourAreas: The glossy crystal material largely ignores the colour scheme; no clear slot is visible on any of the shards.
Female/F_Back_Crystal_01.differs: The female cluster has more shards that spread out across the middle of the back and sit further from the shoulder, while the shards reaching around the front are smaller.

Female/F_Back_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A tapering, leaf-shaped back piece running from between the shoulder blades down the spine, with a smooth inner face and an outer surface of rippled, flame-like ridges that flare into pointed tips at the side.
Female/F_Back_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth inner panel and the ridged body of the piece; colour 1 on the flared ridge tips and the lower texture on the outer surface.

Female/F_Back_Element_Fire_01.description: A cluster of jagged, flame-shaped tongues that sits on the upper back and pokes through to the chest front, like fire bursting out of the torso. Glossy, ragged edges give it a fantastical elemental look.
Female/F_Back_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; the flame tongues show a glossy finish with faint colour 1 highlights, and the chest-side burst shows a bright glossy sheen.

Female/F_Back_Engine_01.description: A single mechanical wing mounted on the upper back: an angular engine housing with circular turbine details and a hexagonal port, sweeping out into rows of long, flat metallic feather blades. Suggests a sci-fi jet or angel wing.
Female/F_Back_Engine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather blades and the hexagonal port rim; colour 1 on the engine housing panels; colour 2 on the underside and inner housing sections.
Female/F_Back_Engine_01.differs: The female wing is a single wing angled out to one side of the back, whereas the male sheet shows it sweeping to the other side.

Female/F_Back_Extra_Cannon_01.description: Two thin segmented cable loops hang from small angular mounting blocks on the upper back and shoulders, curving down and around the sides to the chest. Suggests the wiring for back-mounted mechanical cannons.
Female/F_Back_Extra_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 alternate on the ribbed segments of each cable; colour 2 on the small mounting blocks at the shoulders.

Female/F_Back_Extra_Vigilante_01.description: A slung mechanical recurve bow worn diagonally across the back, with swept, blade-like limbs, a jointed segmented grip with chunky clamp bands, and a thin taut string running between the limb tips.
Female/F_Back_Extra_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved bow limbs; colour 0 on the jointed grip segments; colour 3 on the clamp bands and the string; colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Back_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A mechanical back rig with two large angular wing-like panels that sweep up and outward behind the shoulders, with vented slats and contrasting edge blocks, mounted on a harness with a caged central module and a lower belt-like base.
Female/F_Back_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wing panels and harness body; colour 2 on the panel edge blocks, lower plates and belt base; colour 3 on the caged central module; colour 0 on small inner details of the module.

Female/F_Back_Feathers_01.description: A back-mounted fan of long, curling feather plumes radiating outward from the spine like a peacock-tail array, some tipped with eye-spot markings; the plumes arc up, out and down past the hips, giving a dramatic, exotic silhouette.
Female/F_Back_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner feather shafts and barbs; colour 3 on the outer feather vanes and eye-spot tips; colour 0 on the feather edges and quills; colour 2 on the eye centres.

Female/F_Back_Flagpole_01.description: A tall flagpole carried diagonally across the back, with a rounded metal finial at the top, a spear-like tip at the bottom, a bound grip section and a small cloth flag hanging near the top.
Female/F_Back_Flagpole_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the pole shaft; colour 1 on the binding wraps and straps across the back; colour 0 on the flag cloth; the finial and tip use a metallic default material.
Female/F_Back_Flagpole_01.differs: The female pole leans toward the right shoulder and stands steeper, with the flag hanging to the wearer's left of the pole; the male version slants more sharply the other way.

Female/F_Back_Flagpole_02.description: A long flagpole carried diagonally across the back, with a rounded metal finial at the top and a spear-like tip at the bottom. A small cloth flag hangs from the top on the left, with thin cords wrapped around the shaft.
Female/F_Back_Flagpole_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the pole shaft; colour 1 on the wrapped cords and grip section; colour 0 on the flag cloth; colour 2 on the finial and lower tip.
Female/F_Back_Flagpole_02.differs: The female pole is the left-hand version: it slants from the right shoulder down to the left hip, and the flag hangs on the left, hanging lower and narrower than the male flag.

Female/F_Back_Future_01.description: A mechanical back rig of four long, curved blade-like wings, two large and two small, each with a ringed circular joint. It is mounted on a harness plate across the shoulders and upper back, with a chest strap, and has a sci-fi look.
Female/F_Back_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade surfaces and harness plate; colour 1 on the inner blade edges and fins; colour 2 on the blade undersides and harness straps; colour 3 on the ring centres and the back emblem.

Female/F_Back_Fx_Windup_Key.description: No windup key is visible on this sheet. The zoomed views show only the mannequin's face and ear, and the piece-alone view is empty, so its shape and placement on the back can't be described.
Female/F_Back_Fx_Windup_Key.colourAreas: No visible features take any colour slot on this sheet.

Female/F_Back_Gamer_01.description: A rounded casual backpack with a padded main body, zipped pockets, angry-eye shaped patches on the back flap, a buckled front clip, and shoulder straps joined by a chest strap. Sits high on the back.
Female/F_Back_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back face and side panels; colour 1 on the straps, base and front panel; colour 2 on the zips and eye patches; colour 3 on the buckle and small clasps.

Female/F_Back_Ghost_Hunter_01.description: A boxy mechanical backpack unit with dials, a control panel and vertical cylindrical canisters down both sides, plus cables looping from the top. Padded shoulder straps hold it high across the upper back, in a sci-fi paranormal-gadget style.
Female/F_Back_Ghost_Hunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main box housing; colour 1 on the canisters, top connectors and shoulder straps; colour 2 on the cables, top frame and dial knobs; colour 3 on small accents on the straps and canisters.

Female/F_Back_Golf_01.description: A cylindrical golf bag worn diagonally across the back, with a padded rounded cap at the top, several zippered pockets along the side and lower end, and cross straps holding it in place. Casual, sporty carry piece.
Female/F_Back_Golf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bag body; colour 1 on the cap, pockets, straps and base trim; colour 3 on small stitched accents at the strap joins.

Female/F_Back_Guitar_Acoustic_01.description: An acoustic guitar slung diagonally across the back, its neck rising past the shoulder and its body resting at the lower back. Held by small angled brackets at the shoulder and hip; a casual, musician look.
Female/F_Back_Guitar_Acoustic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the guitar body and neck back; colour 1 on the fretboard, sound-hole surround and pickguard; colour 2 on the sound hole and tuning pegs; colour 3 on the strap brackets.

Female/F_Back_Guitar_Electric_01.description: An electric guitar slung diagonally across the back on a strap, body resting at the lower back and the neck with headstock rising past the opposite shoulder. Solid-body rock instrument with a pickguard, knobs and strap tabs.
Female/F_Back_Guitar_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the guitar body and headstock; colour 1 on the pickguard panel; colour 3 on the neck and strap; colour 2 on the knobs, tuning pegs and bridge details.

Female/F_Back_Guitar_Heavy_01.description: A heavy-metal electric guitar slung diagonally across the back, with a winged, blade-edged body, a skull emblem on the face, a small skull on the back and a long neck ending in a tuning-peg headstock, held by a thin strap.
Female/F_Back_Guitar_Heavy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade-like body wings and headstock; colour 2 on the neck and body centre; colour 3 on the skull emblem; colour 0 on the strap, small skull and blade tips.

Female/F_Back_Guitar_Heavy_02.description: A bladed electric guitar slung across the back on a thin strap, with a jagged, winged body full of cutouts and blade-like points, and a long neck rising past the shoulder to a spiked headstock. A metal-band fantasy weapon.
Female/F_Back_Guitar_Heavy_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer body wings and headstock spikes; colour 1 on the neck front and inner body swirls; colour 0 on the central body panel; colour 2 on the strap and fretboard.

Female/F_Back_Guitar_Heavy_03.description: A heavy-metal electric guitar slung diagonally across the back on a thin strap, with a dragon-like spiky body of swept talon wings and a long neck ending in a bat-wing headstock.
Female/F_Back_Guitar_Heavy_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the guitar body, neck and headstock; colour 2 on the fretboard and strap; colour 3 on the strings and pickup area; colour 0 on small metal fittings.

Female/F_Back_Halo_01.description: A small floating halo worn behind the head: a flat faceted disc ringed by a thick curved lower band, two jagged flame-like fins at the sides and a contrasting pointed crest on top. Sci-fi, superhero look.
Female/F_Back_Halo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central disc; colour 1 on the thick lower band; colour 3 on the two side fins; colour 2 on the top crest.
Female/F_Back_Halo_01.differs: The female halo is smaller and sits tighter behind the head and shoulders.

Female/F_Back_Halo_02.description: A large upright halo disc worn behind the head and shoulders: a flat central disc ringed by a segmented lower arc, two jagged flame-like fins at the sides and a small pointed crest on top.
Female/F_Back_Halo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central disc and thin inner rim; colour 1 on the lower segmented arc; colour 3 on the two side flame fins; colour 2 on the top crest.
Female/F_Back_Halo_02.differs: The female halo is larger and sits higher, framing the whole head, with a wider lower arc.

Female/F_Back_Helicopter_01.description: A wide mechanical backpack jetpack with two domed rotor housings topped by thin propeller blades, blocky central boxes and broad side wing panels tipped with pointed thruster pods. It sits across the upper back and spreads well past the shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Helicopter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings, wing panels and thruster pods; colour 1 on the panel insets and trim bands; colour 3 on the small vent details on the domes; colour 2 on the joints and undersides.

Female/F_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_01.description: A set of four long, jointed mechanical spider legs mounted at the upper back, crossing in an X behind the body. Each segmented limb ends in a sharp pointed claw, giving a menacing sci-fi look.
Female/F_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main leg segments and hub; colour 0 on the joint plates; colour 1 on the small panels near the joints; colour 3 on the accent tips of the claws.
Female/F_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_01.differs: The female legs have dark, glossy segments with small contrasting accents, and the limbs curl further out and sweep lower at the tips.

Female/F_Back_Hybrid_01.description: A pair of curved, horn-like spikes rising from the upper back over the shoulder blades, each segmented with knobby joints and tapering to a sharp point, giving a monstrous, organic hybrid look.
Female/F_Back_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main spike segments and joint blocks; colour 3 on the banded joints and ridges between segments.

Female/F_Back_Ice_01.description: A cluster of jagged crystalline ice shards mounted on the upper back: one tall spiky spire rising past the shoulder beside a rounded faceted lump with small chips around it. Faceted and angular, it suits fantasy or elemental looks.
Female/F_Back_Ice_01.colourAreas: Glossy crystal that mostly ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 shows faintly as a tint on some facets.

Female/F_Back_Jetengine_01.description: A mechanical jetpack with two large boxy engine pods on the upper back, each with a vented panel and a nozzle below, joined by a central harness with chest straps and long swept-back wings extending to each side.
Female/F_Back_Jetengine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the engine housings and wings; colour 1 on the harness, straps, central mount and nozzles; colour 3 on the vent grilles.

Female/F_Back_Jetwings_01.description: A compact mechanical jetpack worn on the upper back: a central plated housing flanked by two round turbine fans, with a lower ribbed exhaust plate and several long thin fins swept out from the shoulders and sides.
Female/F_Back_Jetwings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the turbine casings and lower plate; colour 1 on the central housing and the swept fins; colour 3 on the inner core panel; colour 2 on small underside details.

Female/F_Back_Kaiju_01.description: A narrow strip of jagged, spiky fins running down the centre of the back from the neck to the lower back, with a smooth rounded lobe wrapping around to the front at the shoulder and waist. Monstrous, armoured look.
Female/F_Back_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer spikes and the smooth front lobes; colour 2 on the inner gaps between spikes.

Female/F_Back_Kaiju_02.description: A pair of large bat-like wings sprouting from the upper back, with a membrane stretched between many curved ribs that end in sharp pointed tips along a scalloped edge. They sweep outward and slightly forward.
Female/F_Back_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wing membrane; colour 3 on the ribs and the root where the wings join the back; colour 0 on the sharp claw tips.
Female/F_Back_Kaiju_02.differs: The female wings are angled slightly forward and are less widely spread than the male pair.

Female/F_Back_Lantern_01.description: A long striped carrying pole slung diagonally across the back, with a small hanging animal-shaped lantern dangling from a thin chain at one end. It suggests a festive, East Asian-style accessory.
Female/F_Back_Lantern_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating pole segments; colour 1 on the other pole segments and the lantern body; colour 3 on the lantern tassels and mouth details; colour 2 on the lantern's details.
Female/F_Back_Lantern_01.differs: The female version has a small animal-shaped lantern hanging from the pole on a chain; the male version is only the bare pole.

Female/F_Back_Lantern_02.description: A long straight staff carried diagonally across the back, with capped ends. A thin chain hangs from it holding a small lantern shaped like a fanged, horned beast with a tassel below. Suggests an east-asian festival look.
Female/F_Back_Lantern_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the staff shaft and the lantern body; colour 0 on the staff end caps; colour 2 on the lantern ears and horns; colour 3 on the lantern tassel and mouth details.
Female/F_Back_Lantern_02.differs: The female version has a hanging beast-shaped lantern on a chain from the staff; the male version is just the bare staff.

Female/F_Back_Lantern_03.description: A long carrying staff slung diagonally across the back, with capped ends, and a small lion-dance style lantern head hanging from a thin chain at one end. Suggests an East Asian festival look.
Female/F_Back_Lantern_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the staff shaft; colour 1 on the end caps and the lantern body; colour 3 on the lantern's mane fringe and mouth details; colour 2 on small lantern details.
Female/F_Back_Lantern_03.differs: The female version has a small lion-head lantern hanging from a chain on the staff; the male version is only the bare staff.

Female/F_Back_Lantern_04.description: A long straight carrying staff slung diagonally across the back, with capped ends and a small lantern shaped like a fanciful beast hanging from a thin chain near one end. Suggests festive east-asian style.
Female/F_Back_Lantern_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the staff shaft and the lantern body; colour 0 on the staff end caps; colour 2 on the lantern's details; colour 3 on the lantern's tassels and small accents.
Female/F_Back_Lantern_04.differs: The female version includes a hanging animal-shaped lantern on a chain, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Back_Legendary_Hammer_01.description: A large fantasy war hammer carried upright on the back, its handle wrapped in cord with loose ends. The head is a square block with a round ornate emblem; the wide, flared, ornately engraved blade sits low on the back.
Female/F_Back_Legendary_Hammer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hammer head, the blade rim and the end blocks; colour 1 on the handle wrapping and cord ends; colour 2 on the engraved ornament; colour 3 on the recessed panels of the blade and the head emblem.

Female/F_Back_Light_01.description: A floating winged back piece: a broad U-shaped frame sweeping up into pointed wing tips, with rows of layered feather blades along each side and a slim spiked arc rising behind the head like a halo.
Female/F_Back_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer frame and small flame spikes; colour 2 on the feather blades; colour 1 on the halo arc and its central spike; colour 0 on the feather edge highlights.
Female/F_Back_Light_01.differs: The female wings tilt more steeply upward and sit narrower, with a deeper V at the centre than the male version's wider, flatter spread.

Female/F_Back_Lockbox_65_01.description: A back-mounted halo: a thin rigid arch rises behind the head and shoulders, ringed by clusters of swirling stylised flame shapes with spiral centres. Suggests an East Asian mystic or elemental spirit look.
Female/F_Back_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the arch band; colour 1 on the flame bodies; colour 3 on the spiral centres and inner flame accents.

Female/F_Back_Machete_02.description: A large broad-bladed machete carried diagonally across the back, handle rising past the shoulder beside the head and blade tip reaching the opposite hip. The grip is wrapped in cord and ends in a flat pommel cap.
Female/F_Back_Machete_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the wrapped grip; colour 2 on the pommel and guard; the blade is bare metal and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Back_Mallet_01.description: A large mallet carried diagonally across the back, with a long slim handle ending in a pointed tip and a big cylindrical head with frayed edges, held by a knotted cord strap across the shoulder blade.
Female/F_Back_Mallet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mallet head barrel; colour 0 on the handle; colour 2 on the head end caps and frayed edges; colour 3 on the cord strap and handle rings and tip.

Female/F_Back_Mane_Spikey_01.description: A dense mane of long, sharp, overlapping spikes spread across the upper back and shoulders, drooping in layers down the back and curling slightly over the shoulder toward the front. Feathery, feral, punk-superhero look.
Female/F_Back_Mane_Spikey_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the base and upper spike layers; colour 0 on the spike middles and tips near the bottom; colour 2 on the darker spike tips and shading.

Female/F_Back_Martial_Power_02.description: A large single-edged sword worn diagonally across the back, with a wide straight blade, a curved fang-shaped pommel rising above the shoulder, a wrapped grip and small ring guards at the hilt.
Female/F_Back_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the curved fang pommel and hilt guard; colour 3 on the grip wrapping; colour 2 on the small guard rings.

Female/F_Back_Martial_Power_Alt_01.description: A long curved jagged-edged sword worn diagonally across the back, hilt up over the shoulder. It has a hooked grip with wrapped bands, a spiked crossguard and a tapering serrated blade running to the opposite hip.
Female/F_Back_Martial_Power_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade and crossguard; colour 1 on the hooked hilt and pommel; colour 2 on the grip wraps.

Female/F_Back_Mecha_Spider_01.description: A back-mounted set of four long articulated mechanical arms radiating in an X from the shoulder blades, each jointed and segmented, ending in flat curved blade tips. Evokes a villainous cybernetic harness.
Female/F_Back_Mecha_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main limb segments; colour 2 on the darker limb sections and joints; colour 1 on the blade tips; the glossy metal finish partly ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Back_Mecha_Spider_01.differs: The female arms are slimmer and lack the small contrasting joint studs that the male version has at the hub and elbows.

Female/F_Back_Mecha_Spider_02.description: A backpack harness of crossed straps holding four long, thin jointed mechanical spider legs that arc out past the shoulders and hips and end in curved blade tips. Sleek, sci-fi villain style.
Female/F_Back_Mecha_Spider_02.colourAreas: The legs appear glossy and largely ignore the colour scheme; colour 2 on the crossed harness straps; colour 1 on the small joint and mount details.
Female/F_Back_Mecha_Spider_02.differs: The female legs are slimmer and glossy, with no colour panels along the segments, and they splay out more widely.

Female/F_Back_Monster_Arm_01.description: A monstrous shoulder-and-arm piece with muscular, sinewy oversized arms ending in large clawed hands with long talons, jagged spikes rising from the shoulders, and a ragged cropped collar across the upper chest and back.
Female/F_Back_Monster_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; colour 1 on the veins along the arms; colour 2 on the shoulder spikes; colour 3 on the fleshy arm and shoulder body.

Female/F_Back_Monster_Arm_02.description: A large monstrous extra arm rising from the upper back over the shoulder, with bulging muscle, spiky ridges along the top, a tapered forearm and a clawed hand with long curved talons hanging down.
Female/F_Back_Monster_Arm_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the muscled flesh of the arm; colour 1 on the veins; colour 0 on the claws; colour 2 on the spike tips.

Female/F_Back_Monster_Arm_03.description: A large monstrous extra arm attached at the upper back and reaching over the shoulder, with muscular fibrous flesh, spiky ridges along the top, veins and long curved claws at the hand.
Female/F_Back_Monster_Arm_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fleshy arm and muscle; colour 1 on the veins; colour 2 on the spikes at the shoulder and elbow; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Back_Null_01.description: A placeholder effects piece for a back slot: only a small plain cube is visible, floating near the body. It shows no wings or other construction detail, so the actual flight effect is not visible.
Female/F_Back_Null_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cube faces; no other coloured features are visible.

Female/F_Back_Porcupine_01.description: A dense cluster of long, sharp quills radiating from one shoulder blade, sweeping down the upper back and over the shoulder edge. Reads as a single-sided spiny mantle with a menacing, monstrous look.
Female/F_Back_Porcupine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quill bases and shafts; colour 1 on the quill mid-sections and small base shards; colour 2 on the quill tips.

Female/F_Back_Power_01.description: A segmented spine-like back plate: a winged, notched cap at the upper back, then a column of overlapping chevron plates tapering to a point down the spine, ending near the mid-back.
Female/F_Back_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cap and top plates; colour 2 on the middle plates; colour 3 on the lowest plates; colour 0 on the plate edges and underside.

Female/F_Back_Power_Blade_01.description: An oversized single-edged buster sword carried diagonally across the back, with a broad curved blade, a notch near the hilt, a round engraved emblem at the base, and a long wrapped handle rising past the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Power_Blade_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade body and engraved panel lines; colour 2 on the guard block at the blade base; colour 3 on the wrapped handle; colour 0 barely visible.

Female/F_Back_Scarab_01.description: A mechanical back rig: a small central spine plate between the shoulder blades with four jointed, segmented limbs. Two arch up past the head ending in curved claw tips; two curl around the waist to the front with hooked claw tips.
Female/F_Back_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central spine plate; colour 1 on the jointed limb segments; colour 3 on the claw tips; colour 2 on the joint gaps.
Female/F_Back_Scarab_01.differs: The female limbs are shorter and sit closer together, with the upper claws rising less high and the waist-wrapping limbs curling tighter.

Female/F_Back_Scarab_02.description: A set of four large, pointed butterfly-style wings, two upper and two lower, splaying out from a small round mechanical hub between the shoulder blades. Sharp jagged tips give an angular, insectile fantasy look.
Female/F_Back_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the wing membranes and hub; colour 0 on the wing edge trim; colour 1 on a few edge panels seen from the side.
Female/F_Back_Scarab_02.differs: The female wings are plainer, with smooth solid membranes and no visible cell veining or contrasting gem on the hub.

Female/F_Back_Seacreature_01.description: A back-mounted cluster of long, curved, feather-like fins or tendrils fanning out and downward from the upper back, with pointed tips, chevron-patterned edges and a few tall spikes rising past the shoulders and head.
Female/F_Back_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feather blades; colour 1 on the edges and tip highlights; colour 3 on the chevron markings; colour 2 on the base joint where the blades meet.
Female/F_Back_Seacreature_01.differs: The female version fans wider and fuller, with more blades spreading out to the sides and a longer sweep down the back.

Female/F_Back_Seacreature_03.description: A pair of jagged, fin-like back pieces: layered spiky blades fan out from the spine across the upper back, with long pointed spines rising past the shoulders and shorter barbs along the lower edges. Suggests a sea creature or alien look.
Female/F_Back_Seacreature_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade edges and spine tips; colour 1 and colour 3 on the striped, wavy patterning across the fin panels; colour 2 on the darker recesses between the blades.

Female/F_Back_Skateboard_01.description: A full-size skateboard carried diagonally across the upper back, tilted from one shoulder toward the opposite hip, with two axle trucks and four wheels facing outward and an atom-style emblem on the deck underside.
Female/F_Back_Skateboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the deck face; colour 0 on the atom emblem and the plain top surface; colour 3 on the trucks; colour 2 on the wheels.

Female/F_Back_Sled_01.description: A wooden toboggan-style sled carried upright on the back: a curved-rail frame with crossbars, and a bed of vertical slats. It stands from above the head to the hips, like a winter-themed novelty accessory.
Female/F_Back_Sled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vertical slats; colour 1 on the curved runner frame and crossbars.

Female/F_Back_Snowball_01.description: A mechanical backpack with a boxy angular housing on the back and two thick curved hoses arching over the shoulders to forward-facing round nozzles, capped with snow and icicles; held by crossing shoulder straps.
Female/F_Back_Snowball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoses, casing and straps; colour 1 on the nozzle rims and strap clips; colour 3 on the nozzle centres; colour 2 on small details of the casing.
Female/F_Back_Snowball_01.differs: The female pack looks less fully framed: the housing is a smaller, frosted box with no visible contrasting front plate or dangling contrasting cords.

Female/F_Back_Space_01.description: Three glossy spherical orbs stacked down the spine from the neck to the mid-back, each ringed by a thin band with small knobs at the sides. A futuristic, mechanical back accessory.
Female/F_Back_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spheres; colour 2 on the encircling bands; colour 1 on the small side knobs. The glossy spheres largely ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Back_Speakers_01.description: A backpack of two tall boxy speaker cabinets standing side by side above a wider low speaker box, strapped to the upper back with contrasting shoulder straps and a padded contrasting back panel. Playful, mechanical gadget look.
Female/F_Back_Speakers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cabinet casings, straps and cross bands; colour 1 on the speaker faces; colour 2 on the padded back panel and the display and cone rings; colour 3 on the small rivets and cone markings.

Female/F_Back_Spooky_01.description: A small spine-mounted ornament: four chunky, faceted angular segments stacked in a tapering column down the centre of the upper back, like a low-poly vertebral ridge or crystal spine.
Female/F_Back_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top two segments; colour 1 on a small accent at the third segment; colour 2 on the bottom segment.
Female/F_Back_Spooky_01.differs: The female version is coloured with fewer distinct colours, with colour 3 absent and the lower segments mostly colour 0 and 2.

Female/F_Back_Squirtgun_01.description: A toy-like oversized water gun carried diagonally across the back: a blocky handle and pump housing, a large rounded tank, a ringed barrel with a long thin nozzle, and an angular fin-shaped panel at the side.
Female/F_Back_Squirtgun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blocky housing and barrel shafts; colour 1 on the tank and nozzle collars; colour 2 on the tank bands and end caps; colour 3 on the barrel bands and the angular side panel.

Female/F_Back_Steampunk_Metal_01.description: A steampunk back piece: a tapered, pointed plate down the upper back with curved rib-like bands and toothed edge blocks, plus two large cog wheels floating at the shoulders. Sits on the shoulder blades and spine.
Female/F_Back_Steampunk_Metal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main back plate; colour 3 on the curved bands across the plate; colour 0 on the toothed edge blocks and the outer cog teeth; colour 2 on the cog hubs and centres.

Female/F_Back_Steelarachnid_01.description: A set of six long, curved, blade-like spider legs that sprout from the upper back in mirrored pairs, sweeping up beside the head and out across the shoulders. Sharp faceted tips give a menacing mechanical look.
Female/F_Back_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the blade-like legs; no other slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Back_Steelcommando_01.description: A rigid, boxy backpack-style armour plate worn across the upper back, with a top carrying bar, a central shield-shaped emblem panel, and two long angular side pieces that taper downward into pointed tips.
Female/F_Back_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer side plates and frame; colour 1 on the main back panel and shield face; colour 3 on the inset accent lines and lower panels; colour 2 on the top carrying bar.

Female/F_Back_Steelcommando_02.description: A small shield-shaped plate worn on the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a pointed top crest, tapering point below, raised bevelled rim and a chevron-shaped raised inlay. Retro mechanical superhero styling.
Female/F_Back_Steelcommando_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate body and rim; colour 3 on the raised chevron line inlay; colour 0 on the top crest highlights.

Female/F_Back_Swordpack_01.description: A back-mounted bundle of many swords and knives fanned out in a starburst behind the shoulders: long straight blades, a serrated sawback blade, short daggers and spiked scabbards, with wrapped grips and guards.
Female/F_Back_Swordpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long blades, scabbards and spiked sheaths; colour 0 on the broad and sawback blades; colour 2 on the dagger grips and short sheaths; colour 3 on the grip wraps, guards and pommels.

Female/F_Back_Teleos_01.description: A mechanical back piece of four large angular blade-like wing panels radiating in an X from a central glowing hub between the shoulder blades, each panel with a rounded inset gem-like disc on the front and a thin trim line.
Female/F_Back_Teleos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel surfaces and rims; colour 1 on the thin trim lines and ring outlines on the back faces; colour 3 on the round inset discs; colour 2 on the darker panel undersides.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Airtank_01.description: A single scuba-style air cylinder worn on the upper back, held by two wide buckled bands and a thin strap over the shoulder, with a valve and regulator knob on top and a rubber base cap; a flat backing pad sits behind it.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Airtank_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cylinder body; colour 1 on the bands, straps and backing pad; colour 2 on the valve fitting; colour 3 on the valve knob and base cap.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Angel_Big_01.description: A pair of large feathered angel wings rising from the upper back, with long swept-up tips, layered rows of feathers and a webbed, vein-like pattern at the base. Fantasy style, sitting close behind the shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Angel_Big_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper feather blades; colour 3 on the feather bases and vein pattern; colour 2 on the feather edges and tips; colour 0 on the light lattice lines.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Angel_Big_01.differs: The female wings sit closer together and lean more upright, with the tips angled slightly further back.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Angel_Small_01.description: A pair of small stylised wings worn high on the upper back: each has a shield-shaped panel at the base and layered, webbed feather blades sweeping outward and curling up into a hooked tip.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Angel_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather edges and outer rims; colour 1 on the webbed feather surfaces; colour 3 on the shield panels and curled tips; colour 2 on the panel borders.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_01.description: A single narrow membrane fin mounted along one side of the upper back, with curved spiny ribs fanning outward and a mottled webbed panel between them. Organic, aquatic and monstrous in feel.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved spine ribs; colour 0 and colour 2 on the webbed membrane panels; colour 3 on the speckled spots.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_01.differs: The female version has only a single fin on one side of the back, rather than a pair.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_02.description: A single large fin-like membrane on one side of the upper back, stretched between long curved spines that splay outward and downward. It has a mottled, blotchy surface and suggests an aquatic or monstrous creature look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spines and edge ribs; colour 0 on the membrane; colour 2 on the shaded membrane areas near the spines; colour 3 on the blotches.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_02.differs: The female version has only one fin, on one side of the back, while the male version has a pair of fins, one on each shoulder.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Finduo_01.description: A pair of fin-like fans sprouting from the upper back and shoulder blades, each with spined ribs and webbed membranes that sweep outward and upward, framing the neck. Aquatic, creature-inspired styling.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Finduo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spines and edge ribs; colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 3 on the speckled markings at the base; colour 2 on the shaded membrane areas.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Finduo_02.description: Two large fin-like wings sprouting from the upper back and shoulder blades, each a fan of spiny ribs with thin webbed membrane between them, spotted along the lower edge; aquatic, monstrous fantasy styling.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Finduo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiny ribs and edges of the fins; colour 0 on the webbed membrane panels; colour 3 on the spots along the membrane; colour 2 on the shaded inner membrane areas.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fintrio_01.description: A back piece of three webbed fin fans that sit across the upper back and shoulder blades, each with curved spiny ribs and a membrane between them. Sharp tips flare outward and downward, giving an aquatic, monstrous look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fintrio_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin membranes; colour 1 on the curved spine ribs and edges; colour 2 on the shadowed inner membrane folds; colour 3 on the speckled spots on the membranes.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fintrio_02.description: A large fan of three stacked fin clusters rising from the upper back and shoulder blades, each with long curved spines joined by webbed membrane. Spines splay outward past the shoulders, giving an aquatic, monstrous look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fintrio_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved spines and edging; colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 2 on the shaded bands between spines; colour 3 on the spotted markings on the membrane.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A rounded, shell-like back piece of overlapping segmented plates that rises into a cowl-like dome behind the head and tapers down the back to a point at the lower back, with a mottled cell pattern across the surface.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate rims and shell edges; colour 2 on the pebble-like cell patches; colour 3 on the small accents along the plate edges; colour 1 as faint tint in the shell.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Armadillo_01.differs: The female shell is slimmer and longer, with more curved, arching upper plates hugging behind the head and fewer, more sharply pointed lower segments.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A pair of small mechanical turbine ducts worn on the upper back. Each is an arched, angular housing that rises over the shoulder top, with a vented intake at the front and a slim panel hanging down the back.
