Female/F_Back_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arched housings; colour 1 on the hanging panels; colour 3 on the front intake vents.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Artdeco_01.description: A retro twin-tank jetpack: two rounded rocket canisters with pointed tips and flared nozzle bases sit side by side across the upper back, flanked by swept, stepped wing fins that angle outward past the shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Artdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nozzle bases, tips and wing edges; colour 1 on the canister bodies and wing panels; colour 3 on the inner recesses between the canisters and wings.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Backpack_01.description: A bulky rounded-box combat backpack worn high on the back, with a padded flap top, main compartment, horizontal cinch straps, small snap pockets on the sides and a lower pouch. Suggests a tactical, military field pack.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Backpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main compartment face and side pockets; colour 1 on the outer shell, flap and frame edging; colour 2 on the straps; colour 3 on the strap fittings, snaps and stitched tabs.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Backpack_Military_01.description: A boxy military backpack worn high on the back, with a rounded top flap, rows of small buttoned pockets on the outside, side pouches, and horizontal straps with buckles across the top and bottom.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Backpack_Military_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pack body and pockets; colour 1 on the top flap, edge piping and pocket panels; colour 2 on the horizontal straps; colour 3 on the strap clasps and pocket buttons.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Backpack_Tech_01.description: A compact, rounded-trapezoid tech backpack sitting high on the upper back, with two boxy shoulder-top pods, bolt-like hex nuts across the top, recessed side panels and a central vent strip; mechanical sci-fi look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Backpack_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and top pods; colour 1 on the inset panels, hex nuts and pod windows; colour 3 on the small vent strip and edge accents; colour 2 on the thin seams and underside slits.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Banners_01.description: A pair of banner poles worn crossed in a V on the back, each with a pointed tip and a rectangular cloth banner bearing a dragon motif, splayed outward above the shoulders in an east-asian warrior style.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Banners_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banner cloth; colour 1 on the dragon designs; colour 2 on the poles and banner edges; colour 3 on the spear tips.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Blackfang_01.description: A bulky organic-mechanical backpack shell with a ribbed, segmented carapace and a toothed maw rim, plus two tall curved horn-like prongs rising past the head from shoulder-mounted collars. Sits across the back.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Blackfang_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell plates and horns; colour 1 on the lower rim and collar joints; colour 2 on the plate patches and horn segments; colour 3 on the rib stripes.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Blackfang_01.differs: The female shell sits flatter against the back and its toothed maw opens more toward the front, while the male shell is deeper with a more visible coiled ribbed spiral.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A small mechanical cylinder mounted vertically on the upper back, like a compact thruster or canister. It has a wide capped top with a recessed round port, a long contrasting barrel and a flared base collar.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cap; colour 2 on the long barrel; colour 1 on the flared base collar; colour 3 on the recessed port in the top.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Bulwark_01.description: A back-mounted armor spine of segmented, hexagonal plates running from between the shoulder blades down the spine, ending in two clawlike prongs. Each plate has a raised metal rim and some carry round sockets; sci-fi, mechanical look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Bulwark_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate insets; colour 0 on the raised rims and edging; colour 3 on the round socket centres; colour 2 on the socket rings and underside edges.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A mechanical backpack shaped like a fan: a broad panel over the shoulder blades, a fan of tapered cylindrical spikes rising past the shoulders, and side canisters. Thin bands wrap the waist. Sci-fi jetpack look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fan panel and spikes; colour 0 on the metal back plate and housings; colour 3 on the canister stripes; colour 2 on the waist bands and trim.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Cyberkatana_01.description: A sheathed cyber-katana worn diagonally across the back, hilt up over one shoulder. It has a ring-shaped pommel, a wrapped grip, a small guard and a long straight scabbard with segmented panels and a wide blade tip.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Cyberkatana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring pommel, guard and scabbard tip; colour 1 on the grip wraps and scabbard bands; colour 2 on the central scabbard panels; colour 3 on the small accent patches near the guard and scabbard.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.description: A segmented mechanical spine running down the centre of the back, made of stacked blocky vertebrae with jointed mounts that carry curved, tapering blade-like spikes swept outward and back, larger at mid-back and shrinking toward the lower spine.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vertebra blocks; colour 1 on the joint mounts and sockets at the base of each spike; colour 2 on the curved blade spikes; colour 3 on the thin seams and rivets between segments.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Demon_Big_01.description: A pair of large bat-like demon wings on a central spade-shaped back mount, with long curved arm bones rising above the head and scalloped, ribbed membranes that hang down to about knee level.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Demon_Big_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central mount and wing arm bones; colour 0 on the upper membrane; colour 3 on the lower membrane ribs and fill; colour 2 on the membrane edges.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Demon_Big_01.differs: The female wings hang a little narrower and more upright, with a smaller mount on the back.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Demon_Huge_01.description: A pair of large bat-like demon wings sprouting from the upper back, each with a bony curved arm and finger spars supporting a scalloped membrane. Swept up and outward in a wide spread, with a gothic fantasy look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Demon_Huge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony arm and finger spars; colour 1 on the wing membranes.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Demon_Small_01.description: A pair of small bat-like demon wings joined at a central spine between the shoulder blades, with scalloped membranes, ribbed struts and long curling claw-tipped points; the wings spread outward and sit high on the back.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Demon_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central spine and wing ribs; colour 3 on the membrane panels; colour 2 on the curling wing tips and edges.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Demon_Small_01.differs: The female wings angle more upright and sit slightly higher and closer to the neck than the male ones.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Electric_01.description: A backpack of two stacked Tesla coils, each a chunky cylindrical housing with a ribbed accordion section ending in a contrasting octagonal tip. They angle outward from the upper and mid back, with the housings poking out past the sides.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coil casings; colour 1 on the end caps and casing bands; colour 3 on the ribbed sections; colour 2 on the octagonal tips.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Electric_01.differs: The female coils sit slightly lower and lean out at a shallower angle, with the upper coil closer to the neck.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Electric_02.description: A backpack of four Tesla coils, each a short cylindrical body with a ribbed coil section and a capped emitter tip. They angle outward from the upper back, two high and two low, with the rear caps poking past the shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Electric_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar bands of each coil; colour 1 on the cylinder bodies and end caps; colour 3 on the ribbed coil sections and thin lines; colour 2 on the emitter tips.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Electric_02.differs: The female coils sit closer together and higher on the back, angled more steeply upward and outward.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Envirosuit_01.description: A bulky mechanical backpack: a broad ribbed plate hugs the back, with two curved arms arching up past the shoulders to boxy end caps. Flexible ribbed hoses loop down from the lower edges, and the back face carries a control panel.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Envirosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and ribbed front; colour 1 on the panel plating, arm sections and hose clips; colour 2 on the hoses; colour 3 on the arm end lights and small indicator lights.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Envirosuit_02.description: A mechanical back unit: a rounded central pack on the shoulder blades with four segmented thruster pods that splay outward like arms, linked to the pack by thick flexible hoses. Sci-fi jetpack style.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Envirosuit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central pack and the pod casings; colour 1 on the pod panels and pack vents; colour 2 on the hoses and cables; colour 3 on the small markings and lights on the pod tips.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A pair of art deco mechanical wings mounted on a small shield-shaped back plate. Long curved spars sweep up and outward, with segmented feather-like panels fanned between them and a trimmed lower edge, giving a sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back plate and the curved wing spars; colour 3 on the segmented wing panels; colour 1 on the lower edge trim of the wings and the centre gem; colour 2 on the thin panel dividing lines.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_02.description: A retro-futuristic jet-fin backpack: a tall central spine with a rounded intake and a turbine vent rising above the shoulders, flanked by swept angular wings that jut out to each side. Worn on the upper back.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central spine, wings and intake housing; colour 1 on the V-shaped trim and edge stripes; colour 2 on the underside panels of the wings; colour 3 on the turbine housing.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_02.differs: The wings are slimmer and sit slightly lower, angled more sharply outward and downward.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Gadroonjetpack_01.description: A retro twin-tank jetpack: two rounded, bullet-shaped cylinders joined by a flat bridge plate, each with a thin spike on top and a ringed base nozzle. Sits across the upper back between the shoulder blades.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Gadroonjetpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tank bodies and bridge plate; colour 1 on the base rings; colour 2 on the top spikes.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Gadroonjetpack_01.differs: The female tanks sit slightly higher and closer together on the back, with the pair set at a small offset in depth.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A single oval faceted gemstone worn flat on the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a domed, cut-glass crown of angular facets facing outward and a flatter underside against the body.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The glossy gem appears to ignore the colour scheme; the default material shows its own shading, so no slot clearly applies.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted rhombus-shaped gemstone with a flat back and angular bevelled facets, mounted between the shoulder blades on the upper back like a jewel embedded in the suit.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The glossy gem appears to ignore the colour scheme; no colour slots are clearly visible on it.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small square-cut gemstone with bevelled edges and a flat table, mounted on the upper back between the shoulder blades. It rises as a shallow faceted block, suggesting a mechanical or jewelled emblem.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; it shows a reflective finish with faint sheen across all facets.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A single faceted pentagonal gemstone, glossy with bevelled edges, mounted flat on the upper back between the shoulder blades like an embedded crystal emblem. It suggests a sci-fi or mystic look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; only faint tints of colour 1 show on its bevelled facets.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn as a small emblem on the upper back between the shoulder blades. It is a rounded, glossy, cut-crystal form with angular facets, standing slightly proud of the body.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The gem appears to ignore the colour scheme, showing a glossy crystal finish; no distinct colour slots are visible on it.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A small teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone worn flat on the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a pointed top, a domed faceted face and a shallow hollow underside. It suggests a mechanical or fantasy jewel.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The whole gem uses a glossy, glass-like default material that mostly ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint shows on the upper facets, likely colour 1.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Gemstone_06.differs: The female gem is slightly broader and shallower, with a more rounded lower outline.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Harajuku_Bearpack_01.description: A cute plush teddy bear backpack worn between the shoulder blades: a boxy head with round swirled ears, X-stitched eyes, a snout and dangling limbs with small claws, carried by thin ribbed straps that loop over the shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Harajuku_Bearpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bear body, head and straps; colour 1 on the ears, snout, belly patch and paw patches; colour 3 on the eyes and nose; colour 2 on the claws and head seam.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Hunchback_Armor_Huma.description: A mechanical back piece: a curved, ribbed crescent shell wraps from the upper back around the ribs to the front of the torso, with a segmented carapace on the back and two long curved spiky arms rising above the shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Hunchback_Armor_Huma.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crescent band and ribbed inner shell; colour 1 on the back carapace, the arms and the end panels; colour 2 on the joints and patches; colour 3 is not clearly visible.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Hunchback_Hair_02.description: A strip of furry, striped hair running down the spine from the nape to the lower back, with a jagged spiky crest at the top and ragged tapering edges. It sits on the back like a werewolf mane.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Hunchback_Hair_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur edges and lighter fur; colour 1 on the central strip of the mane; colour 2 on the tiger-like stripes; colour 3 on small accent streaks within the central strip.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_01.description: A compact backpack-style jetpack with a rounded padded pack, a raised collar-like nozzle at the neck and a rounded panel on the back. Two swept, angular delta wings with edge trim extend sideways from the shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main pack body; colour 0 on the back panel, top edging and small side block; colour 2 on the wings and neck nozzle; colour 3 on the wing edge trim.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_01.differs: The wings on the female version sit lower and angle slightly more sharply back than the male version.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Candy_Cane_0.description: A festive jetpack with a rounded, plated backpack body and two tall candy-cane thrusters rising above the shoulders on either side, joined by looping cables and small round nozzles at the base; worn on the upper back.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Candy_Cane_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower pack body and side pods; colour 1 on the upper pack shell and piping; colour 3 on the candy-cane stripes and the round vent centre; colour 2 on the cables and the stripe twist.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Modern_01.description: A compact backpack jetpack with a rounded shell and a central eye-like emblem. Two horn-shaped arms sweep up past the shoulders to large turbine housings with fan intakes and small nose cones, with exhaust spikes below and small nozzles at the hips.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Modern_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower pack shell, arms and turbine housings; colour 1 on the upper pack panel, piping lines and fan blades; colour 2 on the nozzles, vents and nose cones; colour 3 on the central emblem.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Modern_01.differs: The female pack's lower shell is a paler, more rounded shape with a contrasting upper panel, and the turbine arms are more angular and horn-like.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Retroscifi_0.description: A retro rocket-style jetpack: a single bullet-shaped metal canister with a rounded nose, thin trim lines, small side thruster pods with vents, and a funnel nozzle with ring coils below. Curved fins sweep out behind it.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Retroscifi_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main canister body; colour 1 on the nozzle funnel; colour 3 on the trim lines, vertical stripes and the nozzle rings and bulb; colour 2 on the curved fins and vent slats.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Retroscifi_0.differs: The fins curve out further behind the pack and sit higher on the female version, while the male version has them folded closer to the sides of the canister.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A large upright wooden barrel worn on the back, bound with thin hoops and held by padded shoulder harness straps that cross the chest and join a ring-shaped waist strap. A festive, fantasy-mechanical carrier.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel hoops and waist ring; colour 1 on the barrel staves and harness edging; colour 2 on the shoulder straps and barrel patches; colour 3 on the shoulder caps.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.description: A back-mounted mechanical harness with four long segmented tentacle arms ending in clawed pincers. Two arms arc up over the shoulders and two sweep down and out past the hips. A small shield-shaped plate sits at the chest.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate and arm segments; colour 1 on the claw joints and sleeves; colour 2 on the back harness and claw tips; colour 3 on the thin stripes along the arms.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.differs: The female arms are arranged more asymmetrically: the upper pair is spread wider and the lower pair reaches lower and further out to the sides.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.description: A pair of mechanical dragonfly wings: four long, narrow, angular panels with thin metal edging, fanning out from a small glossy mechanical pod mounted between the shoulder blades. Sci-fi, insectoid look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.colourAreas: The glossy metal pod ignores the scheme; colour 1 on small accents at the pod; the wing panels take a translucent tint from colour 1 with metal rims following the default material.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.differs: The female wings are narrower and sit flatter, with the lower pair sweeping more sideways and the upper pair angled slightly forward.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Mechaniste_01.description: A back-mounted pair of mechanical arms: boxy panelled upper segments hang from the back, with jointed contrasting cylinder forearms that reach up over the shoulders and end in clawed, spiked tips. A small shoulder-plate box sits at the front of each shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Mechaniste_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy panel casings; colour 1 on the stripes and inset panels; colour 2 on the cylindrical joints and forearms; colour 3 on the joint caps and claw tips.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Mechaniste_01.differs: The arms rise straight up beside the head, and the front shoulder box is smaller and more rounded.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Military_Backpack_01.description: A large hiking-style military backpack with a padded main pack, side pockets, a lower pouch, a rolled bedroll on top, a water bottle at the hip and a long strap hanging down the back. It sits on the upper back and suggests field gear.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Military_Backpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pack body, pockets and bottle; colour 1 on the bedroll and thin piping lines; colour 3 on the straps and cinch bands; colour 2 on the buckles and the hanging strap.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_02.description: A compact mechanical jetpack worn on the upper back: a shield-shaped shell with small shoulder caps, thruster nozzles at the shoulders and a top cap, and a ribbed vented panel with a power-symbol mark on the back.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and shoulder caps; colour 1 on the top cap and thruster nozzles; colour 3 on the vent slats and power symbol; colour 2 on the inner recesses.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_02.differs: The female version's shoulder caps are smaller and sit closer to the body, with a narrower shell.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_03.description: A compact jetpack worn high on the back: a rounded, capsule-shaped main housing with a notched top, a circular turbine vent at the rear, banded lower rim with small nozzles, and a pair of swept blade-like wings at the sides.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and wings; colour 1 on the edge trim and stripes along the wings and lower bands; colour 2 on the base and nozzles; colour 3 on the turbine vent.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Nighthawk_2025_01.description: A mechanical backpack with a boxy central frame, two long slender antenna-like barrels rising above the shoulders, and cylindrical thruster pods hanging at each side. Glowing-looking side panels and a lattice frame suggest a sci-fi gadget rig.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Nighthawk_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy housings and pods; colour 1 on the long barrels, frame struts and central spine; colour 2 on the barrel tips and joints; colour 3 on the small inset panels and back window.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A small V-shaped back plate of two angular flared wings that taper to a point down the spine, with a hollow diamond opening in the centre and a raised edge trim. It sits on the upper back like a sleek mechanical fin.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 2 on the raised outer edge trim.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Phantom_01.differs: The female version is a wider, flatter plate with a hollow diamond opening and an edged rim, whereas the male version is two separate thick curved blades.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Psihypnotist_01.description: A mechanical back rig with a hexagonal hub between the shoulder blades and four long articulated arms splaying outward, two up and two down, each ending in a curved blade-like fin. Sci-fi psychic gadget.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Psihypnotist_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arms, blades and hub; the frosted, crackled surface appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Quiver_Box_01.description: A boxy rectangular quiver worn diagonally across the upper back, running from the shoulder down toward the opposite hip, with contrasting bands near top and bottom, a small angled flap on the side, and a bundle of fletched arrows sticking out of the top.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Quiver_Box_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver box and flap; colour 3 on the bands around the box; colour 1 on the arrow shafts; colour 2 on the arrow fletching.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Quiver_Large_01.description: A large boxy back quiver worn across the upper back, packed with a fan of fletched arrows rising above the shoulders. It has banded panels, a small front clasp plate and stacked ridges along the bottom edge.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Quiver_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver rim, front plate and bottom ridges; colour 1 on the upper and lower body panels and arrow shafts; colour 2 on the middle band and arrow fletching; colour 3 on the small clasp accents.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Quiver_Round_01.description: A tapered round quiver worn diagonally across the back, with its tip low near the hip and a full bundle of fletched arrows sticking out at the shoulder. Stitched seams wrap the body, and a small open tube juts from the side.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Quiver_Round_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver body; colour 3 on the stitched seams; colour 1 on the arrow shafts; colour 2 on the arrow fletching.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpachk_Orb.description: A large rounded orb worn on the upper back, gripped by curling tapered tendril claws with banded stripes at the sides and a pointed tail-like tendril hanging down the spine. Veined surface gives an alien, organic look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpachk_Orb.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the orb; colour 3 on the veins and stripes of the tendrils; colour 0 on the tendril bands and the small block below the orb; colour 1 on secondary tendril accents.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpackdualc.description: A mechanical back harness: a V-shaped plated yoke over the shoulders and upper back carries two articulated arms with wrapped joints, each ending in a large curved blade-like claw that rises above the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpackdualc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the yoke and the claw blades; colour 1 on the thin accent stripes and claw markings; colour 2 on the wrapped arm joints; colour 3 on the small dots and details.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpackdualc.differs: The claws sit upright and angled outward, rising above the shoulders like fins, while the male claws sweep forward and curve more.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularr_Crest_01.description: A back piece of stacked, overlapping angular plates forming a swept crest that rises to a point between the shoulder blades, with layered fins fanning outward and a solid wedge base. Reads as insectoid, chitinous armour.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularr_Crest_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper edges of the plates; colour 0 on the highlight bands between plates; colour 2 on the lower plate faces and base wedge.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularr_Crest_01.differs: The female crest is narrower and sits slightly higher, with a more upright, pointed peak.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularrlongpack_01.description: A pair of alien organic back attachments at the upper back: rounded bulbs set in contrasting fin-like shells, each with a long banded tendril sweeping outward and back over the shoulders. Bio-mechanical, partial coverage.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularrlongpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shells and bands of the tendrils; colour 3 on the bulbs and tendril stripes; colour 1 on the small spikes under the shells; colour 2 on the bulb centres.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Qularrlongpack_01.differs: The female tendrils sweep out more sideways and are longer, with one pointing further back than the other.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Reactor_03.description: A mechanical back-mounted articulated arm: a compact jointed base on the upper back, a long segmented boom rising past the shoulder, and a bent forearm ending in a large open, helmet-like reactor housing above the head.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Reactor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the reactor shell, joint caps and boom segments; colour 1 on the base housing, forearm and joint blocks; colour 3 on the stripes along the boom and shell top; colour 2 on the inner opening and the rear boom.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Reactor_03.differs: The base sits slightly lower on the back and the arm rises at a steeper angle than on the male version.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Robot_Jet_Pack_01.description: A compact mechanical jet pack on the upper back: a curved collar-like shell over the shoulders holds two rounded thruster pods, with long narrow swept fins trailing down past the hips. Sci-fi, robotic superhero styling.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Robot_Jet_Pack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved shell over the shoulders; colour 2 on the thruster pods; colour 3 on the small glowing accents on the pods; colour 1 on the long trailing fins.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Robot_Jet_Pack_01.differs: The female version has a shorter shell on the back, and its thruster pods sit closer together and the fins trail more narrowly.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.description: A back piece of stacked, cracked rock slabs across the upper back and behind the neck, with clusters of large pointed crystals jutting outward. A thin ragged rock ring wraps around the torso front.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between the rocks; colour 1 on the crystal spikes.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Rocket_01.description: A chunky rocket-shaped jetpack worn on the upper back: a rounded nosecone above a banded barrel with three swept fins at the base, a cord strapped around the middle, and a flared panel wrapping over the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Rocket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nosecone tip, fins and shoulder panel; colour 1 on the barrel and part of the nosecone; colour 2 on the band; colour 3 on the side panel patch.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Rocket_01.differs: The female shoulder panel is a flatter flap draped over one shoulder, and a contrasting side panel is visible on the barrel.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Rocket_02.description: A large rocket-shaped backpack with a rounded nose cone, banded body and three swept fins at the base, strapped on by a belt-like cord at the waist and a small front wrap over the chest. Playful retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Rocket_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose cone, fins and lower body; colour 1 on the main body sections; colour 2 on the wide band around the middle; colour 3 on the side panel patch.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Rocket_02.differs: The female version's front wrap sits higher and closer across the chest, and the contrasting patch sits on the side rather than the back.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Rope_01.description: A large twisted rope ring standing upright behind the head like a halo, gathered at the bottom by a chunky knot with two tassel-like ends resting between the shoulder blades. Three teardrop charms float inside the ring. Ritual, shrine-like style.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Rope_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the twisted rope ring; colour 0 on the knot and its tassel ends; colours 1, 2 and 3 on the three hanging teardrop charms.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Shaman_Sovereign_01.description: A back rig of crossed, banded poles fanning up and out from the spine, topped by a skull and a contrasting carved head, with shrunken heads dangling from cords at the lower ends. Tribal voodoo style.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Shaman_Sovereign_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the poles; colour 3 on the top skull and the small wrapped bindings; colour 0 on the carved heads and shrunken heads; colour 2 on the cords and hair.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A single curved shark-fin blade rising from the upper back beside the spine, with a swept tip pointing outward and a tapered lower point. Thin and smooth, it suggests a mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin, which is the only visible part of the piece.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_01.differs: The fin sits off-centre on the upper back and is smaller with a shorter sweep than the male one.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_02.description: A single large curved fin rising from one shoulder blade, swept back into a sharp point with a notched, ragged trailing edge and a second spike tapering down the back. Smooth membrane-like surface; suits sci-fi or monstrous looks.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_02.differs: The fin sits on the female's left shoulder blade and extends out to the side, and it is slightly smaller and more slender than the male one.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_01.description: A large heater-style shield worn across the back, slightly curved with a pointed bottom. The outer face has a broad bordered rim and a central atom emblem; the inner face has two vertical straps and a small hook.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield's inner face and outer rim edge; colour 1 on the broad border band on the outer face and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the inner border lines and the buckle; colour 3 on the two straps.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_02.description: A heater-style shield carried on the back, with a curved face, a raised rim and a scalloped top edge. An atom emblem sits on the outer face and two strap loops show on the inner side.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one half of the outer face; colour 1 on the other half of the outer face; colour 2 on the rim and the inner face; colour 3 on the inner straps; the atom emblem is a lighter tint of the face colours.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_02.differs: The female shield is narrower and tapers to a longer point, and it sits a little higher and tilted on the back.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_03.description: A heater-style shield worn flat on the back, with a slim raised rim, a quartered face bearing an atom emblem, and two strap loops on the inner side. Reads as a heroic, knightly accessory with a sci-fi twist.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the face; colour 1 on the other two quarters; colour 2 on the rim and inner back; colour 3 on the straps; the atom emblem is a subtle tone on the face.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Lion_01.description: A large round shield worn on the upper back, with a raised lion-head relief in the centre, a ring of zigzag patterning around a rim, and a plain dished inner face with a small hooked grip. Suggests a heroic, medieval style.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and outer rim; colour 1 on the lion head and the ring band around it; colour 2 on the lion's mane and the recessed background; colour 3 on the lion's eyes.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Malvan_01.description: A large oval shield worn flat on the back, with a notched waist on each side, a raised rim and two vertical slots. The outer face has a radiating sunburst around a diamond glyph, ringed by alien lettering.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Shield_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face; colour 1 on the outer rim and lettering band; colour 2 on the central diamond glyph and sunburst slots; colour 3 on the lettering.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_0.description: A small pair of stylised feathered wings forming a V on the upper back, with thick smooth swept blades rising past the shoulders and a ruffled underside edge; a compact, sleek superhero back accessory.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth upper wing blades and the joined base; colour 1 on the ruffled feather undersides.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_0.differs: The female wings are mostly one smooth solid shape with only a ruffled contrasting-edged underside, lacking the banded feather stripes and split feather tips of the male version.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_0.description: A small mechanical mantle of two swept-up wing shapes joined in a V at the upper back, rising behind the shoulders and neck. Each wing has a smooth rigid spine and a row of feather-like blades on its inner side.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth outer wing spines; colour 1 on the feather-like blades.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A grid of twelve small conical metal spikes across the upper and mid back, in four rows of three. The top spikes angle outward and the lower ones point slightly downward. The look is punk and mechanical.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Spikes_01.differs: The spikes sit lower and are spread evenly down the back, while the male top row rises up onto the shoulders.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Spikes_Huge_01.description: Clusters of large curved horn-like spikes sprouting from the upper and mid back in two symmetrical groups, each spike rising from a ring-shaped base collar and tapering to a point; the largest sweep outward and up.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Spikes_Huge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 3 on the ring collars at the spike bases.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Spikes_Huge_01.differs: The female spikes sit in more evenly spaced, tidy rows on the back, with ring bases that look more open and circular.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Steampunk_01.description: A steampunk mechanical backpack: a central boxy housing with a vented panel, tall capped exhaust stacks on top, ribbed hoses curving out at the shoulders, and square side tanks with porthole-like emblems and vent grilles, sitting across the upper and mid back.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and tank panels; colour 1 on the trim, stack bands and edge borders; colour 2 on the ribbed hoses; colour 3 on the vent slats and small emblem details.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Steampunk_03.description: A rigid steampunk back plate shaped like a shield, with a high flared collar behind the head and riveted side panels. contrasting mechanical canisters, a boxy motor and ribbed hoses are mounted across the back.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Steampunk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate shell and collar edge; colour 2 on the inner collar and panel borders; colour 1 on the canisters, motor and nozzles; colour 3 on the rivets; colour 2 on the hoses.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Steampunk_04.description: A steampunk backpack device: a round geared plate with a ringed dial sits on the upper back, with a horizontal cylindrical tank strapped below, a tall vertical antenna rod and two angled cylinder prongs on top, and a hanging handle loop.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Steampunk_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate, housing and tank straps; colour 1 on the tank; colour 3 on the central dial, the angled prongs and the rod stripes; colour 2 on the rod, prong caps and handle.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Steampunk_Jetpack_01.description: A steampunk jetpack: a rounded, egg-shaped rocket body with rivets and arrow motifs, flanked by small side thrusters and flexible hoses, with fin-like tail flares below. A cloth flap drapes over the shoulders and chest.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Steampunk_Jetpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body, flap and fins; colour 1 on the top cap, arrow motifs, riveted plates and flap edging; colour 2 on the hoses and joints; colour 3 on the marks on the flap and back panel.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A compact, rounded rocket-pack worn high on the back, with a smooth shell, a broad plated dome over twin thruster nozzles on the back face and a flat panel facing the body. Sleek superhero-tech styling.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 0 on the flat inner panel and the upper rim; colour 3 on the domed plate and the thruster nozzles; colour 2 on the bands and gaps between plates.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_01.differs: The female pack is a plain smooth shell without the swept-back fin blades that stick out from the male pack's sides.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_02.description: A compact twin-booster jetpack: two ribbed cylindrical rocket canisters with nozzle tips sit either side of a central angular plate and a small third tank, held by wide straps across the upper back and shoulders.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed booster bodies; colour 2 on the central plate, straps and bands; colour 0 on the nozzle tips, side panels and centre tank; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Stickbones_01.description: A mechanical back rig of four long spindly bone-like arms fanning out from a central mount between the shoulder blades, each ending in a cluster of round knobs or a ringed loop, joined by thin cords.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Stickbones_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long arm shafts and ring loops; colour 2 on the banded segments and connecting cords; colour 3 on the knob clusters and small wrapped tendrils.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Stickbones_01.differs: The female arms fan out more steeply, with a tighter, more upright spread, and the rings sit at different heights than on the male.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Sword_01.description: A large sheathed sword carried diagonally across the back, hilt over the right shoulder and tip near the left hip. It has a segmented scabbard with ridged bands, a small crossguard and a wrapped grip.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard; colour 1 on the crossguard and the pommel cap; colour 2 on the grip.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Swordsdual_01.description: A pair of sheathed short swords worn crossed in a V on the upper back, hilts rising above the shoulders and tapered scabbards pointing down toward the spine, with banded scabbard ridges and flared crossguards.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Swordsdual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbards; colour 1 on the crossguards and pommel caps; colour 2 on the grip wraps.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Tools_01.description: A gadgeteer harness with a chest-and-back plate strapped over the torso, carrying several jointed mechanical arms: a satellite dish on a stalk, a pincer claw, a forked prong on a curved cable, and thick cylindrical tool pods.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Tools_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the harness plates and tool casings; colour 1 on the dish, jointed arm segments and plate panels; colour 2 on the cables, pods and joints; colour 3 on the claw, prongs and small lights.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Tools_01.differs: The female arms splay outward at a slightly different angle and the harness sits a bit higher and narrower on the torso.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Tools_02.description: A mechanical backpack with a panelled body, a jointed arm reaching up over the shoulder ending in a clawed tool with pointed prongs, and a flexible jointed stalk carrying a round satellite dish beside the head.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Tools_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pack body panels; colour 1 on the satellite dish, stalk joints and pack accent panels; colour 2 on the arm segments and clamps; colour 3 on the tool prongs and small lights.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Tools_02.differs: The arm's upper segment rises higher above the shoulder and the dish sits to the left; the tool arm looks longer and more upright than the male version.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Tools_03.description: A mechanical gadgeteer backpack with a rounded plated pack on the back, a long drill-tipped tool arm and a wrench-clawed arm on jointed segments, plus a tall curling cable rising over the head to a pronged claw.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Tools_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pack shell and arm casings; colour 1 on the pack panels, coils and stripes; colour 2 on the cables and drill housing; colour 3 on the claw tips, wrench jaws and small lights.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Tools_03.differs: The drill arm points out to the wearer's left and stays level with the shoulder, and the pack is slimmer and sits higher on the back.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Urban_Anime_Messenge.description: A cross-body sling messenger bag: a wide strap runs diagonally over one shoulder and chest, with a rounded, angular-panelled satchel resting on the lower back and a small flap with a tab on top.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Urban_Anime_Messenge.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide strap and upper bag body; colour 1 on the lower bag and strap sections; colour 2 on the strap edging and side panel; colour 3 on the flap tab.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Vine_01.description: A monstrous organic back piece: a swirl-patterned carapace across the shoulder blades, ringed with sharp thorn-like spikes, with two long serpentine necks rising over the shoulders, each ending in a toothed, open-jawed head.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main carapace, necks and heads; colour 0 on the swirl patterns and inner mouth details; colour 3 on the thorn spikes and tips.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Vine_01.differs: The female version has its heads angled further forward over the shoulders, and its carapace sits slightly narrower and more compact on the upper back.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Wires_01.description: A cluster of flexible cable-like tentacles growing from the upper back, looping over the shoulders toward the front. Each ends in a clamp-like sleeve with a metal tip, giving a mechanical, cybernetic look.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cables; colour 1 on the sleeves and clamps at the cable ends; colour 0 on the small metal tips.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Wires_01.differs: The female wires are looser and more curled around the upper back, with the cable ends dangling lower over the chest.

Female/F_Back_Tight_Wires_02.description: A set of mechanical spinal implants running down the upper back: three short cylindrical plugs with capped ends alternate with two hexagonal sockets, and small curved shells show through at the front of the torso.
Female/F_Back_Tight_Wires_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cylinder bodies; colour 3 on the cylinder end caps and hexagon centres; colour 2 on the hexagonal sockets and curved shells.

Female/F_Back_Tubes_01.description: A mechanical backpack of boxy plated housings with round vented ports and a central slatted vent panel, worn across the upper back. Two thick ribbed tubes curl over the shoulders toward the chest.
Female/F_Back_Tubes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plated housings; colour 1 on the small bolts and port rings; colour 2 on the tubes and port centres; colour 3 on the tube bands and vent slats.
Female/F_Back_Tubes_01.differs: The female version's shoulder tubes curl slightly shorter and sit closer to the neck.

Female/F_Back_Turtleshell_01.description: A large oval turtle shell worn on the back: a domed outer carapace of hexagonal scutes, a scalloped rim of rounded plates, and a hollow, smooth inner face. It covers the back from shoulders to hips.
Female/F_Back_Turtleshell_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the carapace scutes and their highlights; colour 1 on the centre patches of the scutes and the outer edge; colour 3 on the inner face and the rim plates seen from the front; colour 2 on the seams between scutes.

Female/F_Back_Vigilante_01.description: A back-mounted recurve bow with swept, angular limbs and a thin taut string, strapped diagonally alongside a segmented cylindrical quiver of arrows with crossed straps and clamps. A mechanical archer's rig for a vigilante look.
Female/F_Back_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver body and bow riser; colour 1 on the bow limbs and arrow fletching; colour 2 on the quiver bands and clamps; colour 3 on the crossed straps and the bowstring.

Female/F_Back_Viperrocketpack_01.description: A mechanical backpack with a wide angular main plate, two shoulder-mounted rocket pods on jointed arms rising above the shoulders, and two long thruster canisters hanging at the sides. Sits across the upper back; sci-fi military look.
Female/F_Back_Viperrocketpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate, pod casings and canister bodies; colour 1 on the pod windows, canister panels and central thruster inserts; colour 2 on the joints, arms and lower thruster housings; colour 3 on the thin stripes near the canister tops.

Female/F_Back_Warlordrocketpack_01.description: A bulky mechanical backpack: twin rounded armoured pods across the upper back, a jointed arm on the left carrying a boxy monitor-like turret, and a thin antenna with a small sensor on the right. Sci-fi military gear.
Female/F_Back_Warlordrocketpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pod shells and turret casing; colour 1 on the pod panels, turret screen and sensor; colour 2 on the joints, arm and pod undersides; colour 3 on the small sensor lights.

Female/F_Back_Warrior_02.description: A small angular back plate shaped like a shield or arrowhead, sitting on the upper back between the shoulder blades and tapering to a point down the spine; a striped inner panel is framed by flared side edges.
Female/F_Back_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and the striped edges at the sides; colour 0 and colour 1 alternate in the stripes of the central back panel; colour 2 in the stripes at the flared side edges.
Female/F_Back_Warrior_02.differs: The female plate is flatter and sits closer to the back, with sharper facets and less depth than the male version.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_0.description: A large double-bladed battle axe carried diagonally across the back: a long segmented, ribbed haft topped with a rounded pommel, and a wide butterfly-shaped head with ridged panels, a central round gem and a downward spike.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the haft and the ridged blade faces; colour 1 on the blade edges and outer rims; colour 3 on the central gem and inner accents; colour 2 in the recesses.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_0.differs: The female axe is slung lower and more upright, with the head sitting near the hips and the haft running close to the spine.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_0.description: A large alien battle axe carried diagonally across the back: a long ribbed handle with a ringed pommel and a looping chain, ending in a broad fan-shaped blade with panel lines, a central round gem and pointed spikes.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle, chain and blade body; colour 1 on the blade edge fins and spikes; colour 3 on the central gem and blade inlay lines; colour 2 on the handle shaft joints.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Sword.description: A large sword worn diagonally across the back, with a segmented ridged hilt above the shoulder, a wide angular guard plate with a round gem, a long grooved blade and a spiky, leaf-like organic tip near the thigh.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Sword.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hilt, guard plate and blade body; colour 1 on the hanging loop and the organic tip section; colour 3 on the gem and the blade groove line.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Sword.description: A large sci-fi sword carried diagonally across the back, with a broad slab blade, a ribbed mechanical grip, an angular clawed guard with a round central gem and a curved cable-like loop rising over the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Sword.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hilt, guard and curved loop; colour 1 on the blade; colour 3 on the guard gem and the thin blade line; colour 2 on the grip segments.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Angon_01.description: A long, thin javelin-like spear (angon) carried diagonally across the back, with a contrasting shaft, a small contrasting band near the middle and a slender metal barbed point extending down past the legs.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Angon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaft; colour 1 on the small band at the middle of the shaft; colour 0 on the metal spearhead and shaft tip.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Animestylesword_03.description: An oversized broad-bladed sword carried diagonally across the back, with a wide flat blade, contrasting edge trim, a wrapped grip poking up past the shoulder, and a spiky claw-like guard resting near the neck.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Animestylesword_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade face; colour 3 on the blade edge trim; colour 1 on the wrapped grip; colour 2 on the spiky guard and pommel.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Axe_Wood_01.description: A large twisted axe carried diagonally across the back: a long handle of gnarled, intertwined vine-like branches with a forked tip above the shoulder, and a double-bladed feathered-looking head resting at the lower back.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Axe_Wood_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the twisted handle and branches; the axe blades ignore the scheme and show a glossy metal finish.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Balloon_01.description: A twisted-balloon sword worn diagonally across the back: a long smooth cylindrical blade, a looped crossguard of balloon lobes, a short grip and a small round pommel knob poking up behind the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Balloon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the grip; colour 2 on the crossguard loops; colour 3 on the pommel. The glossy balloon finish mutes the scheme.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Baseball_Bat_02.description: A full-length baseball bat carried diagonally across the back, handle end low at the hip and barrel tip rising past the shoulder. It has a tapered body with a separate grip section and a capped end.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Baseball_Bat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel tip, handle and end cap; colour 1 on the upper and lower bands of the shaft; colour 2 on the main body of the shaft; colour 3 on the small accent marks.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Baseball_Bat_02.differs: The female bat sits more upright and is angled less steeply across the back.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Bat_Bent_01.description: A bent, dented baseball bat slung diagonally across the back, handle up over one shoulder and the fat barrel hanging low at the opposite hip. A wrapped grip and a crumpled kink mid-shaft give it a battered street-brawler look.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Bat_Bent_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrapped handle grip; colour 0 on the upper shaft and the knob end; colour 1 on the barrel end.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Bat_Bent_01.differs: The bat sits slightly higher and more upright on the back, with the barrel ending at the waist.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Battery_01.description: A large sci-fi plasma rifle slung diagonally across the back, from the shoulder down to the opposite hip. It has a sleek casing, fin-like blades near the muzzle, a round sensor lens, ribbed coil segments and angular vent panels.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Battery_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rifle casing; colour 1 on the fins, ribbed coils and barrel bands; colour 3 on the diamond vent panels and the round lens; colour 2 on the darker underside and grip.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Bayonet_01.description: A long bolt-action rifle with a scope and a bayonet fixed to the muzzle, slung diagonally across the back from the upper shoulder down to the hip. It suggests a military or pulp look.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Bayonet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rifle stock and barrel body; colour 1 on the buttplate, scope, sling loop and fittings; colour 2 on the small barrel bands; colour 3 on the bayonet blade.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Bayonet_01.differs: The rifle sits more steeply, running close to vertical along the back, with the muzzle ending near the hip.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Blasterassaultrifle.description: A sci-fi blaster assault rifle carried horizontally across the upper back, with a bulky receiver, pistol grip, top-mounted scope rail, short muzzle and angular stock, held by a triangular bracket plate.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Blasterassaultrifle.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rifle body and top rail; colour 1 on the grip, bracket plate and trim pieces; colour 2 on the stock and barrel; colour 3 on the small vent details.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Blasterassaultrifle.differs: The female rifle is angled slightly upward with the stock on the right and sits a little higher across the shoulders.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Bone_01.description: An oversized bone modelled as a femur, carried diagonally across the back with the rounded head rising past one shoulder and the knuckled end hanging near the opposite hip. No straps are visible.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Bone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shaft; colour 1 on the lower knuckled end; colour 2 on the upper head of the bone.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_01.description: A broadsword carried diagonally across the back, hilt over one shoulder and point reaching the opposite hip. It has a straight crossguard, a long grip with a round pommel, and a wide blade etched with rune-like markings.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hilt, crossguard and pommel; colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the etched runes along the blade.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_02.description: Three broadswords appear stuck through the upper back and shoulder, with blades poking out the front of the torso. contrasting crossguards and grips, engraved blades with rune-like markings; a grim, medieval fantasy look.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hilts, crossguards and pommels; colour 0 on the blades; colour 3 on the etched markings along the blades.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_02.differs: The female version has the swords clustered on the left of the back, with one blade angled steeply down across the spine.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Broom_01.description: A witch-style broomstick slung diagonally across the back, with a long gnarled handle that curls into a hook above the shoulder and a bushy fibrous bristle head hanging at hip level, bound by banded wraps.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Broom_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle; colour 0 on the bristles; colour 2 on the binding band; colour 3 on the thin ring accent above the binding.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Chainsaw_01.description: A large mechanical chainsaw sword worn diagonally across the back: a boxy engine housing with vents and a rear handle, a curved loop grip at the top, and a long toothed blade running down past the hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Chainsaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the engine housing, loop grip and blade guard; colour 1 on the blade's central band; colour 2 on the rear handle and blade edge; colour 3 on the round buttons and small indicator lights.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Combat_01.description: A double-bladed battle axe carried diagonally on the back, its handle rising past the shoulder to a spiked, winged finial, with a mechanical hub and two swept crescent blades hanging low at the hip. Ornate fantasy styling.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Combat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the axe head hub and the finial; colour 1 on the crescent blade edges; colour 3 on the shaft and the ring at its centre.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Cosmic_Slayer_01.description: An oversized slab-bladed greatsword carried diagonally across the back, with a wide flat blade tapering to an angular tip, a wedge-shaped guard, a long wrapped grip and a small round pommel.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Cosmic_Slayer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the wedge guard; colour 1 on the wrapped grip; colour 3 on the pommel.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Crowbar_01.description: A slender metal crowbar carried diagonally across the back, with a flat pry end angled out above one shoulder and a curved, split claw hook at the lower end near the opposite hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Crowbar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crowbar; the metal finish appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Doubleheadedaxe_01.description: A double-headed battle axe carried diagonally on the back: two broad curved blades with contrasting cutting edges flank a boxy mechanical head with knobs, on a long ringed shaft with a gripped end, held by a contrasting strap.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Doubleheadedaxe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade faces and axe head; colour 3 on the blade edges; colour 1 on the shaft; colour 2 on the knobs, grip bands and strap.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Draco_01.description: A long polearm carried diagonally across the back, with a contrasting shaft, a barbed spearhead at the top and a winged, spiked blade cluster with a long tapered spike near the lower end. Ornate dragon-themed fantasy weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaft; colour 1 on the spearhead and blade wings; colour 0 on the blade edges and lower spike.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Draco_02.description: A long spear carried diagonally across the back, with a slim shaft, a small pointed tip at the top and a wide multi-pronged trident-like head with feathery spiked fins near the hip. Suggests a fantasy dragon-themed weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaft; colour 1 on the prongs and blade blades of the lower head; colour 0 on the spiked fins and tip; colour 3 on the small central gem.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Falchion_01.description: A single-edged falchion with a broad, curved blade, wrapped grip, flat crossguard and round pommel, slung diagonally across the back with the hilt above the shoulder and the tip near the opposite hip. Medieval fantasy weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Falchion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the blade's edge trim; colour 1 on the wrapped grip and small binding cords; colour 2 on the crossguard and pommel.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Fantasy_01.description: A fantasy broadsword carried diagonally across the back, hilt above the right shoulder and point near the opposite hip. It has a wrapped grip, a winged guard with a small gem, and a tapering blade with a contrasting edge line.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the grip wrap and the small cords near the guard; colour 2 on the guard and pommel; colour 3 on the grip rings, the gem and the blade edge lines.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Frigid_01.description: A long slender sword worn diagonally across the back, with a narrow tapering blade, a small winged crossguard with spiky accents, and a large curling hooked crescent guard rising above the shoulder. Fantasy styling.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the crossguard and spiky accents; colour 2 on the curved crescent guard; colour 3 on a small gem at the hilt.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Frigid_01.differs: The female sword sits more upright and is carried higher, with the tip reaching about knee level, while the male blade runs at a slightly different angle across the back.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Frigid_Rifle_01.description: A sci-fi rifle slung diagonally across the back, with a bulky angular stock, a cylindrical canister on top and a forked, claw-like muzzle of prongs hanging down near the hip. Segmented mechanical construction.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Frigid_Rifle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rifle body and muzzle prongs; colour 1 on the stock, grip and underside panels; colour 3 on the canister; colour 2 on small vents and details.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Frosty_01.description: A chunky sci-fi rifle slung diagonally across the back, with the long tapered stock rising past the shoulder and the bulky angular body, tank-like cylinder and ribbed grip hanging low near the hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Frosty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stock tip and the metal frame edges; colour 1 on the stock, casing and side fins; colour 3 on the cylinder and the inset stripe; colour 2 on the grips, vents and cable loops.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Frosty_01.differs: The rifle sits higher and more upright on the back, with the stock reaching up beside the head.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gamer_01.description: A sci-fi blaster slung diagonally across the back, with a forked, fin-like upper housing rising past the shoulder, a long barrel running toward the opposite hip, a pistol grip and a hanging magazine.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forked upper housing; colour 1 on the barrel body; colour 2 on the grip and magazine; colour 3 on the small vent markings and ribbed accents.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gear_01.description: A large mechanical sword worn across the back: a gear-shaped hub with a glowing core sits at the shoulders, with a hilt rising above the head and a long multi-pronged blade angling down past the hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade; colour 2 on the gear housing and hilt top; colour 0 on the hilt shaft and gear teeth; colour 3 on the centre of the gear.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gear_01.differs: The female sword hangs almost vertically down the centre of the back, while the male version is angled diagonally across it.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gladiator_01.description: A large double-headed war hammer carried across the lower back: a long ribbed handle with a flared pommel rises past the shoulder, ending in two chunky, bevelled blocks with recessed line panels. Bulky gladiator style.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hammer head blocks; colour 1 on the handle ribbing and the small plates on the head corners; colour 2 on the handle shaft and pommel; colour 3 on the recessed line inlays.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gladiator_02.description: A large two-handed axe carried diagonally across the back, with a long twisted-grip haft, a curved crescent blade on one side and a blocky hammer head on the other, joined by an ornate winged central mount.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade, hammer block and haft cap; colour 2 on the twisted haft; colour 1 on the inner panels of the central mount; colour 3 on the collar rings and mount trim.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gladius_01.description: A short Roman-style gladius sheathed diagonally across the back, hilt rising over the shoulder: a broad leaf-shaped blade with edged border, a wrapped grip, a flat guard and a knobbed pommel, held by thin cords.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Gladius_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade face; colour 3 on the blade edges; colour 1 on the wrapped grip, pommel cap and thin cords; colour 2 on the guard and pommel.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Glaive_01.description: A slim glaive carried diagonally across the back: a long thin pole topped with a broad leaf-shaped blade, slanting from the lower hip up past the shoulder. It reads as a polearm weapon with a fantasy, medieval feel.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Glaive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the pole shaft; colour 1 on a thin band along the pole.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Glaive_01.differs: The female glaive is a little thinner and the lower end of the pole sits higher, ending near the thigh with less contrasting banding showing on the shaft.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Grenade_Launcher_01.description: A chunky revolver-style grenade launcher slung diagonally across the back, with a rotating drum of striped chambers, a boxy angular receiver on top, a short cylindrical barrel pointing down, and a fabric strap tab at the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Grenade_Launcher_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the receiver, drum casing and barrel; colour 1 on the shoulder strap tab; colour 3 and colour 2 on alternating stripes of the drum chambers.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Hacker_01.description: An oversized cleaver-style sword carried diagonally across the back, with a wide flat slab blade that has a squared, notched tip and a long wrapped handle rising above the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Hacker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the small guard band at the base of the handle.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Halberd_01.description: A long halberd carried diagonally across the back, with a slim pole, a wrapped grip section, a small round pommel at the top, and a crescent axe blade with a side hook and long spear point at the lower end.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Halberd_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the pole shaft; colour 2 on the wrapped grip section; colour 0 on the axe blade, pommel and hook; colour 1 on the spear point.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Halberd_01.differs: The male version renders as a thin contrasting outline rather than solid coloured parts, with the same overall halberd shape.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_01.description: A heraldic mace carried diagonally across the back: a long banded shaft topped with a pointed spearhead, ending in a flared, bell-shaped head with studded spikes and a ringed base. Suggests a ceremonial medieval fantasy weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spearhead, the flanged collar and the base rim and spikes; colour 1 on the bell-shaped mace head; colour 3 on the shaft sections; colour 2 on the shaft joints and fittings.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_02.description: A long heraldic spear carried diagonally across the back, with a barbed leaf-shaped head at the top, a segmented shaft with banded rings and a smaller pointed butt spike at the bottom. Fantasy medieval look.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spearhead and butt spike; colour 3 on the collar rings and bands; colour 0 on the upper shaft section; colour 2 on the lower shaft grips.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_02.differs: The spear sits more steeply and upright, with its head over the left shoulder and its butt ending near the hip.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Hooksword_01.description: An oversized slab-bladed greatsword carried diagonally across the back, with a wide flat blade, a small guard block at the top, and a long wrapped handle ending in a pommel cap that rises past the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Hooksword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the guard block at the base of the handle; colour 2 on the handle grip; colour 3 on the pommel cap.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Ice_01.description: A large jagged ice-crystal sword worn on the back: a clustered burst of sharp icicle spikes sits at the shoulder blades, a tapering faceted blade runs down the spine, and a slim hilt with a spiked pommel rises above the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Ice_01.colourAreas: Glossy crystalline material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on the spike cluster and hilt accents, with the rest of the blade and hilt taking the glossy finish.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Ice_01.differs: The sword hangs straight down the middle of the back, with the blade running down the spine.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Industrial_01.description: A large industrial sword worn diagonally across the back, hilt above the shoulder with a wrapped grip and hooked pommel. The blade is a broad, segmented, leaf-shaped mechanical piece with a jagged guard and a pointed tip near the hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Industrial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade and guard; colour 2 on the wrapped grip; colour 3 on the collar ring below the pommel. The blade shows a metallic finish that mostly ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Ionic_01.description: A long sci-fi energy rifle carried diagonally across the back, from above the shoulder down to the hip. It has a boxy angular body, a short side grip near the top, vented panels and a thin muzzle rod.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Ionic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rifle body and casing; colour 1 on the clamp bands and end block; colour 3 on the small round indicator dots and vent strips; colour 2 on the recessed slots.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Ji_01.description: A long ji polearm carried diagonally across the back: a straight shaft topped with a crossbar-braced head, a central spike and two curved crescent blades. It rises past the shoulder and reaches down toward the opposite hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Ji_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade head and crescents; colour 1 on the long shaft.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Ji_01.differs: The female polearm sits steeper and more upright, with the head beside the head and the butt near the lower back; the male one lies at a shallower diagonal.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Katana_01.description: A katana in a straight scabbard carried diagonally across the back, hilt above the right shoulder and tip near the left hip. It has a wrapped handle, a small round guard and a knotted cord tied at the chest.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Katana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard; colour 2 on the handle wrap base, guard and scabbard ends; colour 3 on the handle wrap diamonds; colour 1 on the knotted cord.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Katana_Cyberninja_0.description: A sheathed katana slung diagonally across the back, with a gently curved scabbard, a tech-detailed hilt and pommel poking up past the shoulder, and a contrasting strap with small cords holding it at the chest.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Katana_Cyberninja_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scabbard; colour 0 on the hilt and its mechanical detailing; colour 2 on the strap and cords.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lance_01.description: A long conical lance sheathed in a tapering cloth-covered case slung diagonally across the back, with a crown-like metal collar at the top, small ornamental emblems, a pointed metal tip and a wrapped grip and blade shaft rising over the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lance_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal crown collar, tip and hilt; colour 1 on the tapering case; colour 3 on the small ornaments on the case; colour 2 on the grip wrapping.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lance_Elegant_01.description: A long ornate lance carried diagonally across the back, with a spiral-striped shaft, a flared cup-shaped guard near the top and a pointed tip at the lower end. Suggests a festive, fantasy ceremonial weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lance_Elegant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the spiral stripes of the shaft; colour 3 on the small accents by the guard; colour 2 on the guard cup and the end tips.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lance_Elegant_01.differs: The female lance has a spiral candy-striped shaft along its whole length, while the male version is mostly a plain contrasting shaft.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lead_Pipe_01.description: A long straight metal pipe carried diagonally across the back, from over one shoulder down to the opposite hip, with two contrasting bands near the bottom and a bent elbow-joint fitting at the end. Improvised, industrial weapon look.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lead_Pipe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pipe shaft; colour 2 on the bands near the lower end; colour 1 on the elbow fitting.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lockbox_65_01.description: A long staff carried diagonally across the back, extending above the shoulder and down past the hip. It has a slim shaft with segmented metal collars, ring fittings and a rounded knob at the top, in a mechanical style.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal collars, rings and end caps; colour 1 on the shaft; colour 3 on the round gem-like knobs and studs; colour 2 on the small recessed joints.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lockbox_65_02.description: A long mechanical weapon carried diagonally across the back: a thin antenna-like shaft at the top, a segmented pole with ring fittings, and a heavy spiked, claw-tipped barrel at the lower end.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring fittings and the upper barrel sections; colour 1 on the barrel body and shaft sections; colour 2 on the shaft and barrel bands; colour 3 on small accents near the top.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Mad_Scientist_03.description: A compact sci-fi submachine-gun slung diagonally across the back, with a long ribbed barrel, top-mounted plunger, pistol grip and a curved, clawed shoulder stock. Angular mechanical housings suggest a mad-scientist gadget.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Mad_Scientist_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main receiver and barrel housing; colour 1 on the stock, grip and side panels; colour 3 on small accents near the trigger; colour 2 on small fittings.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Microphone_Stand_01.description: A vintage-style microphone stand worn diagonally across the back, with a rounded mic head at the shoulder, a slim telescoping pole with a collar joint, and a flared round base near the opposite hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Microphone_Stand_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the microphone head; colour 3 on the mic grille details; colour 0 on the pole, collar and base; colour 2 on the small joint band.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Missilelauncher_01.description: A bazooka-style rocket launcher carried diagonally across the back, with its muzzle above the shoulder and a flared rear end near the opposite hip. It has a side grip, a sight block and a mounting bracket at the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Missilelauncher_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main tube body and the shoulder bracket; colour 0 on the muzzle, sight and grip housings; colour 2 on the rear flare; colour 3 on the thin bands around the tube.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Morningstar_01.description: A spiked morning star carried diagonally across the back, with the handle up by the shoulder and the studded ball hanging near the lower back. The wrapped grip has a guard, and a thin cord loops over the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Morningstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrapped grip, guard and cord; colour 2 on the shaft and pommel; colour 0 on the spiked ball; colour 3 on the spikes.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Morningstar_01.differs: The ball hangs low near the lower back, hip height and centred, and the weapon sits more upright.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Odragon_01.description: A large sheathed sword carried diagonally across the back, its hilt rising past the shoulder. It has a ringed pommel, a wrapped grip, a dragon-shaped guard and a long tapering scabbard with engraved patterning.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Odragon_01.colourAreas: The piece renders as glowing on this sheet, so the colour scheme does not visibly apply; colour slots cannot be told apart on the pommel, grip, dragon guard or scabbard.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Odragon_01.differs: This version renders as a contrasting glowing contrasting with no visible colour separation, whereas the male version shows distinct colour panels.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Okatana_01.description: A sheathed katana (scabbard only) slung diagonally across the back, slightly curved, with end caps at both ends and a small band near the top. The tip points down toward the opposite hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Okatana_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scabbard; colour 2 on the end caps and the small band.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Pitchfork_01.description: A long-handled pitchfork carried diagonally across the back, with a slender straight shaft and a four-tine head hanging low near the hip. Simple rustic farm-tool weapon with a thin metal collar joining head and shaft.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Pitchfork_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft; colour 2 on the collar and shaft tip; colour 1 on the tines.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Plunger_01.description: A toilet plunger carried diagonally across the back: a long thin straight handle rising past the shoulder, with a rounded rubber cup resting at the lower back by the hip. A comic novelty prop.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Plunger_01.colourAreas: The default material renders as glossy translucent glass-like and ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slots are clearly visible on the handle or cup.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Plunger_01.differs: The female plunger is glossy and see-through, ignoring the colour scheme, whereas the male version shows solid colours.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Punk_01.description: A keytar-style keyboard worn slung diagonally across the back: a long narrow neck rising past the shoulder and a broad paddle-shaped body at the hip, with a keyboard, a row of small lights and a thin sling strap at the chest.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing and body; colour 1 on the keys; colour 3 on the row of small lights along the neck; colour 2 on the keys and the neck end.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Rake_01.description: A garden rake carried diagonally across the back: a long slim pole rising past one shoulder, with a short collar at the bottom joining a thin head of fine tines that hangs near the hip.
