Female/F_Back_Weapon_Rake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long pole; colour 1 on the collar and the rake head bar; colour 2 on the fine tines.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Rake_01.differs: The female rake is a solid-looking pole with a small collar and finer tines, and it hangs lower with the head at the hip, while the male version is a thin outlined frame.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Recurvebow_01.description: A recurve bow slung diagonally across the back, with long curved limbs, a wrapped central grip and a thin taut string. It runs from above the shoulder down toward the opposite hip, suggesting an archer or hunter look.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Recurvebow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer limb surfaces; colour 1 on the grip section; colour 3 on the accent panels near the grip; colour 2 on the string and limb tips.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Renegade_01.description: A large sci-fi rifle slung diagonally across the back, with a bulky receiver, a side-mounted ribbed magazine, a rear grip and stock, and a muzzle that points down toward the hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body panels and stock; colour 1 on the frame, outer housing and magazine casing; colour 3 on the top rail and accent strips; colour 2 on the muzzle tip and joints.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Rifle_02.description: A modern assault rifle carried diagonally across the back, muzzle up over the shoulder and stock down by the opposite hip, with a carrying handle, ribbed handguard, magazine and thin sling straps.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Rifle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the receiver, magazine and stock body; colour 1 on the handguard, stock end and sling straps; colour 3 on small accent rings on the handguard; colour 2 on the barrel and sights.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Scythe_Heavy_01.description: A heavy mechanical scythe carried across the back: a long, kinked pole runs diagonally from the hip up past the shoulder to a jagged mechanical head with a huge curved blade sweeping forward beside the head.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Scythe_Heavy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade and head housing; colour 1 on the pole and the small knob at the top; colour 3 on the joint where the blade meets the pole; colour 2 on the grip end.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shield_Heraldry_01.description: A large kite-shaped heraldic shield carried on the back, with a thick rim, a pointed lower tip, a small grip handle on the inner face and a raised fleur-de-lis crest on a recessed panel on the outer face.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shield_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and outer plate; colour 2 on the rim and handle; colour 1 on the recessed back panel; colour 3 on the fleur-de-lis crest.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_02.description: A sawn-off double-barrelled shotgun carried diagonally across the back, with a curved pistol grip at the upper shoulder, exposed hammers and side-by-side barrels pointing down toward the opposite hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_02.colourAreas: The sheet renders this piece as a glowing outline, so the colour scheme is hard to read; the grip would take one slot and the barrels another, but the exact slot split can't be seen.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_02.differs: The female version is drawn as a translucent contrasting ghost-like outline rather than solid parts, though the shape is the same.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_04.description: A chunky sci-fi shotgun slung diagonally across the back, with the stock at the upper shoulder and the barrel angled down toward the opposite hip. It has a pump section, panel details and small contrasting fins.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the body, stock and pump housing; colour 0 on the barrel tip and the metal muzzle sections; colour 2 on the small fins and recessed panels; colour 3 on the small markings.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_Bloodmoon_2.description: A sawn-off double-barrel shotgun worn slung diagonally across the back, with a curved pistol-style grip pointing up over the shoulder, twin barrels angled down toward the opposite hip, and a strap band around the middle.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_Bloodmoon_2.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the grip tip and barrels; colour 1 on the stock body and forend; colour 2 on the fittings near the hammer and lower barrel joint; colour 3 on the band around the middle and the small ring.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shovel_01.description: A full-size digging shovel carried diagonally across the back, with a D-shaped grip handle at the shoulder, a long straight shaft and a broad flat blade hanging near the hip. Practical, rugged work-tool look.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shovel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the blade; colour 1 on the lower part of the blade; colour 3 on the handle grip and shaft; colour 2 on the D-shaped handle frame and socket.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shovel_01.differs: The female shovel has a bright metallic blade with a clearly split two-tone finish, and the contrasting handle shows up more strongly than on the male version.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shovel_02.description: A full-size shovel carried diagonally across the back, with a long slim shaft, a thick padded grip at the top and a broad pointed spade blade hanging near the hip. Rugged utilitarian weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Shovel_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the lower edge of the blade; colour 2 on the shaft; colour 3 on the grip.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sickle_02.description: A long-handled sickle carried diagonally across the back, with a segmented shaft and a single long curved blade sweeping out at hip level. The blade is glassy and translucent, suggesting an energy or crystal weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sickle_02.colourAreas: The whole piece renders as a glossy, translucent white, so the default material ignores the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sickle_02.differs: The female version is a translucent, glassy contrasting with no visible colour on the handle, while the male version has a solid handle and an opaque metal blade.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Skeletal_01.description: A long staff carried diagonally across the back, topped with a horned skull with glowing eyes. Below it sit a wrapped grip and a tapering shaft lined with thorn-like spines, ending in a sharp point near the calves.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Skeletal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and horns; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the grip section below the skull; colour 1 on the spiked shaft and spines.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Skeletal_01.differs: The female staff sits at a steeper angle, with its head close to the neck and a shaft that hangs more vertically down the back.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sledgehammer_01.description: A large sledgehammer carried diagonally across the back, with a long straight round handle rising past the shoulder and a chunky faceted head resting low near the hip. Rugged, practical melee weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sledgehammer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle; colour 1 on the hammer head.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sniperrifle_03.description: A long sniper rifle slung diagonally along the back, with a long slender barrel rising above the shoulder, a side-mounted scope, a bulky angular stock with a thumbhole grip, and small side brackets.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sniperrifle_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel shaft and body plating; colour 1 on the scope, muzzle tip and side brackets; colour 2 on the stock and grip; colour 3 on the small accents and scope lens rim.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Spear_Aztec_01.description: A long spear slung diagonally across the back, with a metal-capped butt, a wrapped shaft with banded fittings, and a broad leaf-shaped blade with a ridged, jagged edge hanging near the hip. Suggests an ancient Mesoamerican-inspired weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Spear_Aztec_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal caps, collars and banded fittings; colour 1 on the shaft; colour 3 on the spearhead blade; colour 2 on the blade edges and darker details.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Splintered_01.description: A large sword worn diagonally across the back, with a wrapped grip, a heavy crossguard and a broad blade made of layered splintered shards that fan down to the thigh. Reads as a savage, jagged fantasy weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Splintered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the splintered blade shards; colour 1 on the inner shards and accents between them; colour 2 on the crossguard and pommel; colour 3 on the grip wrapping.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Splintered_01.differs: The blade hangs down the centre of the back and is angled to run along the spine, with the hilt rising over the left shoulder.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Staff_Skull_01.description: A long thin cane or staff carried diagonally across the back, topped with a small skull head and ending in a small capped tip at the lower end. Suggests a gothic, occult gentleman's cane.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Staff_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull; colour 0 on the shaft; colour 2 on the lower end cap and the collar under the skull.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Steelcommando_01.description: A retro rifle-style weapon slung diagonally across the back, with a flat blocky stock at the upper shoulder, boxy receiver parts along the body and a slim barrel pointing down toward the opposite hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: The piece renders as a glossy, glassy sheen that mostly ignores the colour scheme, so the slots have little visible effect.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Streetlamp_01.description: A long street lamp post carried diagonally across the back, with a slim straight pole, a bent neck at the top and an elongated rounded lamp head angled out to one side. Suggests an improvised urban weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Streetlamp_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pole and neck joint; colour 1 on the lamp head; colour 2 on the underside of the lamp head.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sulitsa_01.description: A long slender spear worn slung diagonally across the back: a thin straight shaft with a small leaf-shaped point at the lower end and a plain tip at the top. Suggests a medieval or tribal weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sulitsa_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaft; colour 0 on the small metal spearhead.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Aztec_01.description: A macuahuitl-style broadsword carried diagonally across the back: a long slab blade with a central groove and a row of jagged teeth along each edge, an angular guard, and a short handle ending in a ring pommel.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Aztec_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade body and guard; colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 3 on the edge teeth and tip cap; colour 2 on the central groove.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Aztec_02.description: A spiked mace carried diagonally across the back: a wrapped handle with a flared contrasting pommel rises over the shoulder, and a tapering segmented head of stacked rings with pyramid studs ends in a pointed tip near the hip.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Aztec_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stacked head segments; colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the pommel and the bands between segments; colour 3 on the spikes and the tip.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Kunai_01.description: A single oversized kunai carried diagonally across the back: a long leaf-shaped flat blade tapering to a point, a thin wrapped handle, and a round ring pommel poking up past the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Kunai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the wrapped handle; colour 1 on the ring pommel.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Stick_01.description: A long, rough wooden branch worn slung diagonally across the back, from the right shoulder down toward the left hip, with a few short stubby twig offshoots and cut ends. Suggests a rustic staff or improvised weapon.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Stick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole branch; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Stick_03.description: A long, slightly curved wooden walking stick with small knots and stubs of cut branches along its length, worn slung diagonally across the back from the shoulder to the opposite hip. Rustic, simple and unadorned.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Sword_Stick_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole stick; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Tateklys_01.description: A long-hafted scythe-like polearm carried diagonally across the back, with a broad curved blade at the top, small fin-like blades below it, banded grip wraps and a pointed spearhead tip at the lower end.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Tateklys_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade body; colour 1 on the blade edge and the fin-like blades and spike tip; colour 2 on the shaft; colour 3 on the bands around the shaft.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Therakiel_01.description: An oversized sword worn diagonally across the back: a broad, jagged blade with notched edges and studded inlays, a spiked round guard, a wrapped grip and a curved, spiked pommel rising above the shoulder.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Therakiel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade plates; colour 1 on the guard and pommel; colour 2 on the wrapped grip; colour 3 on the spikes, blade inlay lines and studs.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Therakiel_01.differs: The blade hangs more vertically down the centre of the back, with the tip ending near the hip.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Bow_01.description: A recurve bow slung diagonally across the back, with swept, blade-like curved limbs, a padded grip, wrapped bands along the limbs and a thin taut string. It suggests a fantasy ranger or sci-fi archer.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bow limbs; colour 1 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the grip; colour 3 on the string.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Staff_01.description: A slender staff carried diagonally across the back, with a curled, hooked head that wraps around a faceted gem, a twisted shaft bound with thin cord wraps, and a pointed tip near the legs. Ornate fantasy styling.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Staff_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the staff shaft and curled head; colour 3 on the gem; colour 2 on the cord wraps.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_01.description: A long straight sword worn diagonally across the back, its handle rising above the shoulder. It has a slim tapered blade, a wrapped grip with a rounded pommel, and an ornate curved crossguard with small decorative details.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade; colour 2 on the grip; colour 3 on the crossguard accents; colour 0 on the pommel and small guard details.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_02.description: A long straight greatsword carried diagonally across the back, hilt up over the shoulder and blade tapering to a point near the thigh. It has an ornate crossguard with winged flourishes and a long wrapped grip. The default material shows as glossy, glassy white.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_02.colourAreas: The default material ignores the colour scheme and renders the whole sword as a glossy, glass-like white; no colour slots are visibly applied.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_02.differs: The female sword renders as a glossy translucent glass-like material with no visible colour slots, while the male version shows distinct coloured grip, fuller and blade panels.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Trident_Arvad_01.description: A long trident carried diagonally across the back, with a slender straight shaft, a rounded end cap at the bottom, and a curved multi-pronged metal head with hooked outer barbs. Suits an aquatic fantasy look.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Trident_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaft; colour 2 on the end cap; the trident head is glossy metal and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Trooper_01.description: A huge slab-like sci-fi sword carried diagonally across the back, with a long contrasting grip and pommel poking above the shoulder, jagged angular guard plates down the spine side, and a toothed serrated edge along the blade.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the jagged armour plates and pommel; colour 0 on the flat blade face; colour 2 on the grip; colour 3 on the round studs on the upper plates; colour 0 on the serrated teeth along the edge.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Trooper_02.description: A long curved katana slung diagonally across the back, with the hilt rising above the shoulder and an angular winged guard. The scabbard tapers down past the hip, with jagged accent markings on the handle.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Trooper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade and scabbard; colour 3 on the handle wrap and jagged markings; colour 2 on the guard and pommel; colour 1 on small accents along the scabbard.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Vacuum_01.description: An upright vacuum cleaner slung diagonally across the back: a tapered fabric bag on a long thin handle with a curved grip, and a wide flat cleaner head hanging at the hip. Comic household-gadget style.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Vacuum_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cleaner head casing; colour 1 on the fabric bag; colour 2 on the underside of the head and the handle shaft; colour 3 on the handle grip and the head's front strip.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Vigilante_01.description: A large recurve bow carried diagonally across the back, rising above the head and ending near the hip. It has swept, blade-like limbs, a jointed mechanical grip with clamp-like sections, and a thin taut string.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved limbs; colour 0 on the jointed central riser; colour 3 on the grip clamps and the bowstring.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Vladic_01.description: A large broadsword worn diagonally across the back, hilt up over the shoulder. It has a wide blade with notched cut-outs along one edge, a winged bat-like crossguard around a round gem, and a long grip ending in a small spiked pommel.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Vladic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the grip; colour 2 on the crossguard wings and pommel; colour 3 on the round gem.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Warhammer_02.description: A long-handled double-headed warhammer carried diagonally across the back, head resting above the shoulder. Octagonal faceted striking plates flank a rounded waisted core, and a ringed, wrapped haft has a small angular guard.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Warhammer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hammer head core; colour 3 on the striking faces and haft rings; colour 1 on the handle and the angular guard; colour 2 on the small fittings and handle end cap.

Female/F_Back_Weapon_Westernrifle_01.description: A lever-action western rifle slung diagonally across the back, with the wooden stock rising past the shoulder and the barrel pointing down toward the opposite hip. A short strap with small bands holds it in place.
Female/F_Back_Weapon_Westernrifle_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the stock and forestock; colour 2 on the receiver and lever; colour 0 on the barrel; colour 3 on the strap bands and stock butt trim.

Female/F_Back_Werewolf_01.description: A narrow strip of shaggy fur-like mane running down the centre of the upper back from the neck to the mid-back, with jagged tufts and pointed locks swept out to one side.
Female/F_Back_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base of the mane; colour 1 on the jagged tips and outer locks, blending into colour 0.

Female/F_Back_Wings_Anniversary16_2025_0.description: A set of long, tapering tentacles that spring from a central hub on the upper back. Several arch out and over the shoulders, while shorter ones hang down behind the body. Alien, mechanical-organic look.
Female/F_Back_Wings_Anniversary16_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the tentacle length and the hub; colour 1 on the inner strips and patterned stripes along the tentacles; colour 3 is barely visible.
Female/F_Back_Wings_Anniversary16_2025_0.differs: The female tentacles are mostly one colour with narrow accent stripes, and their arches are more open and evenly spread.

Female/F_Back_Wings_Patriot_01.description: A pair of large feathered angel wings rising from the upper back, arching above the shoulders and sweeping down past the knees in long layered feather tiers with pointed tips. Heroic, patriotic-superhero styling.
Female/F_Back_Wings_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper leading-edge feathers; colour 1 on the middle feather band; colour 2 on the long lower flight feathers.

Female/F_Back_Wings_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of rigid, static mechanical wings mounted at the shoulder blades, each a fan of overlapping tapered feather-like blades with contrasting edging and a curved upper plate, swept outward and slightly down.
Female/F_Back_Wings_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved upper plates; colour 3 on the feather blades; colour 2 on the blade edging; colour 1 on the thin line trim along the plates.
Female/F_Back_Wings_Starhawk_01.differs: The female wings sit spread flatter and more level, and look slightly smaller, with the two wings angled less sharply from each other.

Female/F_Back_Wings_Thruster_01.description: A pair of mechanical thruster wings mounted on the upper back: two long, tapering pod-like housings, each with swept fin blades along the outer edge and a short bracket arm attaching to the shoulder area. Sci-fi superhero jet-pack styling.
Female/F_Back_Wings_Thruster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing frames and mounting brackets; colour 1 on the large panels and fin blades; colour 3 on the small accent fins and vents; colour 2 on the nozzle tips.

Female/F_Belt_Ammo_Bandolier_01.description: A wide belt with a front buckle and punched holes, ringed by a row of upright bullet cartridges that hang around the whole circumference. It sits low on the waist and suggests a military or tactical look.
Female/F_Belt_Ammo_Bandolier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the edge piping and inner lining; colour 1 on the cartridge bands and tops; colour 2 on the buckle and bullet tips.

Female/F_Belt_Aquatic_01.description: A low-slung, ornate fantasy belt band that dips into a V at the front, with a layered pointed gem-set buckle, swirling scrollwork flourishes, and a small V-shaped point at the back. Sits on the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band and rim; colour 1 on the inner stripe and the layered buckle plates; colour 2 on the scrollwork and top edge piping; colour 3 on the central gem.

Female/F_Belt_Aquatic_02.description: A low-slung, wide belt band with a raised rim and jagged lightning-like fins sweeping down to a central diamond-shaped gem buckle at the front. The back is a plain, smooth band.
Female/F_Belt_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the jagged front fins; colour 2 on the inside lining; colour 1 on the outer band and the gem's outer setting; colour 3 on the gem's centre.

Female/F_Belt_Armored_01.description: A chunky armoured V-shaped belt guard worn low on the hips, with a thick angled rim, a padded contrasting interior and a contrasting front panel below the rim. Sci-fi plating that dips to a point at front and back.
Female/F_Belt_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised V-shaped rim; colour 1 on the front panel below the rim; colour 2 on the padded interior and outer edging.
Female/F_Belt_Armored_01.differs: The female version sits slightly lower and its front is more open, showing the inner padding from the front, while the male front is more closed.

Female/F_Belt_Bounty_01.description: A wide, slightly crumpled cloth-like band belt sitting low on the hips, with a chunky blocky H-shaped buckle at the front centre and a small matching piece visible at the back edge.
Female/F_Belt_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 3 on the H-shaped buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Chainlock_01.description: A heavy chain wrapped in several loose, overlapping loops around the midsection, crossing over itself at front and back. Chunky rectangular links give it a rough, industrial, restraint-like look.
Female/F_Belt_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; the metal reads as glossy and largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Cryo_01.description: A pair of curved, segmented ribbed tubes that arc out from each hip like hooked tusks or hoses, floating at the waist without a band. Mechanical and creature-like, an unusual sci-fi belt accessory.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole ribbed tube on both sides; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Lion_01.description: A pentagonal belt plaque with a sculpted lion head set in a studded, bevelled frame, with two square open loops at the sides. It sits low at the front of the hips, suiting fantasy or mechanical looks.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head; colour 1 on the frame and the plain back plate; colour 2 on the side loops; colour 3 on the lion's eyes.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small shield-shaped belt buckle plate with a thick rounded rim, a notched lower edge and a zigzag emblem in the centre, flanked by stepped angular fin-like wings on both sides. Sits at the front of the waist.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rim and the back plate; colour 0 on the inner face; colour 3 on the zigzag emblem; colour 1 on the stepped side wings.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Lockbox_67_01.description: A small ornate belt ornament shaped like a butterfly, with cut-out openwork wings, scrolled curls underneath and a fleur-de-lis shaped backing plate. It sits centred at the front of the waist.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the openwork wings and scrolls; colour 1 on the central backing plate and lower fleur-de-lis; colour 2 on the darker rim and recesses behind the wings.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A small circular belt buckle plate: a thick segmented ring around a domed round centre, with two small studs and inset panels, worn at the front of the waist. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower and left segments of the outer ring; colour 1 on the upper ring band; colour 3 on the domed centre; colour 2 on the inset panels and studs.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Modern_Sapphire_02.description: A small hanging strap accessory worn at the hip: a narrow band with a fork of two hooked clips at the top, a buckle block in the middle and a ring-tipped tab with a rivet at the bottom.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Modern_Sapphire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band and lower tab; colour 1 on the top clips, the middle buckle block and the bottom ring; colour 3 on the rivet.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A tiny flat decal-like atom symbol with orbiting ellipses and small arc marks, sitting on the lower abdomen and again on the lower back. It adds a subtle mystic-tech emblem without any real bulk.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the atom symbol and its surrounding arc marks.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Ornament_01.description: A round belt ornament: a carved guardian-lion face with fangs and swirl details in a thick rim, topped by a crest of flame-like curled fins. It sits at the navel as a centred buckle medallion with a flat back, in an east-asian fantasy style.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Ornament_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the carved lion face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the outer rim and the flat back; colour 1 on the flame-like crest.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A small rounded-rectangular armor plate worn at the front of the groin like a codpiece, with a slightly dented surface, four curved spikes jutting out of recessed sockets, and two short stubs on its top edge.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate; colour 3 on the four spikes; colour 1 on the two stubs along the top edge.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A low-slung studded belt made of segmented panels covered in pyramid studs, with contrasting edging, small contrasting buckle tabs and a looped chain-like clasp at the front and back. It sits around the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the studded panels; colour 0 on the belt edging and inner band; colour 1 on the chain clasp loops; colour 2 on the buckle tabs.

Female/F_Belt_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.description: A pair of loose chain loops draped along one hip and thigh, hanging from large ring clasps at the front and back of the hip. Wallet-chain style accessory with a punk, street look.
Female/F_Belt_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring clasps; colour 3 on the chain links, with colour 0 on the link highlights.

Female/F_Belt_Chimera_01.description: A low-slung V-shaped waistband with contrasting piping, dipping to a point at the front and back, with a narrow tapering tail of jagged, spiky strands hanging from the front centre down the thighs.
Female/F_Belt_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main band panel; colour 0 on the piping edges and the upper part of the hanging tail; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the tail strands.

Female/F_Belt_Corrupted_01.description: A sculpted armored waist guard with swirled, winged front plates and a raised rear fin, from which a pointed loincloth-like panel hangs at the front and back, with contrasting ragged side flaps. Sits low on the hips, with a fantasy-monstrous look.
Female/F_Belt_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swirled waist plates and rim; colour 1 on the pointed front and back panels; colour 3 on the centre back panel and a sliver at the side; colour 2 on the outlines, rear fin and side flaps.
Female/F_Belt_Corrupted_01.differs: The female version has longer, more angular front plate points and a deeper, longer pointed front panel, with the ragged contrasting side flaps hanging lower.

Female/F_Belt_Cosmos_01.description: A low-slung, glossy metal hip belt forming a deep V at front and back, with curved horn-like prongs rising from each side and a smooth inner panel. Sits around the hips as a sleek sci-fi accessory.
Female/F_Belt_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: The default glossy metal largely ignores the scheme; colour 0 and colour 1 show faintly on the inner panel and outer band; no other slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Belt_Crimson_01.description: A rigid, armored hip-guard belt with a pointed front plate, a central gem, two horizontal bands, and small ear-like points at the top. A quilted, pointed panel hangs at the back with a contrasting flap at the side.
Female/F_Belt_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 2 on the bands, edging, and side flap; colour 3 on the gem; colour 1 on the quilted rear panel.
Female/F_Belt_Crimson_01.differs: The female version has a shorter, more curved side flap and a rear panel that sits slightly lower.

Female/F_Belt_Cryo_01.description: A belt made of several stacked, rope-like tube bands wrapped around the waist, with a rounded front buckle plate, contrasting side clamps, small canisters at the back, and two looping hoses arching up from the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tube bands and looping hoses; colour 1 on the front buckle plate; colour 2 on the side clamps; colour 0 on the canisters and small connectors.

Female/F_Belt_Cyberwire_01.description: A low-slung belt with pouch-like side panels and a ragged, tattered skirt hanging from it in long jagged tapered strips with contrasting edging, reaching to about the knees or below at front and back.
Female/F_Belt_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt strips; colour 1 on the belt band and pouches; colour 2 on the buckle details and strip edges; colour 3 on the outlines along the strip edges.
Female/F_Belt_Cyberwire_01.differs: The female belt has a more worn, textured band with a small round buckle at the front hip, and no row of contrasting studs across the front.

Female/F_Belt_Draco_01.description: A wide, corset-like armoured belt with jagged, bat-wing style points at the hips, a pointed front plate hanging to the crotch, a swooping horned centre emblem and a matching pointed panel at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and back hanging plates; colour 1 on the centre emblem and back centre panel; colour 3 on the raised outline around the front emblem; colour 2 on the outer hip wings and lower edge points.

Female/F_Belt_Element_Fire_01.description: Two separate clusters of jagged, flame-shaped tongues hovering at the sides of the ribs and waist, with curling pointed tips. Glossy, sculpted surfaces give a fiery, elemental accent rather than a garment.
Female/F_Belt_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; slight sheen highlights only, no clear slot assignment visible.
Female/F_Belt_Element_Fire_01.differs: The female version renders as glossy contrasting sculpted flames, whereas the male version appears as translucent glowing flames.

Female/F_Belt_Element_Water_01.description: A diagonal sash-like belt piece of glossy, swooping metallic fins that sweeps from the upper hip down across the front to a hanging pointed tip, with small round beads near the lower end; a stylised elemental water look.
Female/F_Belt_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: Default material is glossy and largely ignores the scheme; the fins show a reflective sheen, with a faint hint of colour 3 in the inner folds and colour 1 on the shading of the outer surface.
Female/F_Belt_Element_Water_01.differs: The female version is a solid glossy metallic form, while the male version is a translucent, glowing wispy shape.

Female/F_Belt_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A chunky mechanical hip belt of faceted angular plates with a raised rim, round screw-like caps on the sides, and a separate tapered panel at the front that hangs into a brief-like lower piece. Sits low on the hips with a sci-fi robotic look.
Female/F_Belt_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main belt plates and side caps; colour 3 on the front tapered panel; colour 1 on the inner rim and the lower brief-like section.

Female/F_Belt_Firebird_01.description: A low-slung, layered band belt with a bevelled outer rim and a stacked underside, dipping into a V at the front. A contrasting buckle panel sits at the front, and a pointed shield-shaped plate hangs at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim of the band; colour 1 on the lower layered edge; colour 2 on the front buckle panel; colour 3 on the pointed plate at the back and the small plate at the front.
Female/F_Belt_Firebird_01.differs: The female belt sits lower on the hips and dips into a deep V at the front, while the male belt stays level around the waist.

Female/F_Belt_Frigid_01.description: A long insect-wing-like skirt hanging from a slim belt with a central gem clasp and small winged tips. The veined, translucent-looking panel has a ragged, pointed hem and reaches to the shins.
Female/F_Belt_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the upper wing panels; colour 1 on the feathered tips at the belt and the lower hem of the skirt; colour 2 on the veins and the clasp; colour 3 on the clasp gem.
Female/F_Belt_Frigid_01.differs: The female version has a solid belt clasp with a contrasting gem and small winged tips, while the male version has a thin, spiky, outlined belt of contrasting wisps.

Female/F_Belt_Gamer_01.description: A wide, plain band belt sitting at the hips, with a rounded upper rim over a lower band. A stepped, piped seam between them holds small contrasting rectangular vent slots. Sporty, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Belt_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper rim band; colour 0 on the lower band and inner lining; colour 3 on the piping along the stepped seam; colour 2 on the small slots.

Female/F_Belt_Gladiator_01.description: A wide, low-slung sculpted belt with a padded, layered band that dips to a curved point at the front and back, a large rounded centre buckle plate with side clasps, and a thin accent line running along the band.
Female/F_Belt_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded belt band; colour 1 on the front buckle plate and the rear band panel; colour 2 on the side clasps; colour 3 on the thin accent stripe.
Female/F_Belt_Gladiator_01.differs: The female belt sits lower on the hips and curves down more steeply into a rounded point at the front.

Female/F_Belt_Heroic_01.description: A superhero belt made of two flat angular bands that cross over each other in an X around the hips, with a small shield-shaped buckle at the front centre. It sits low on the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossing bands; colour 1 on the shield rim; colour 2 on the shield's backing; colour 3 on the shield's inner emblem.

Female/F_Belt_Heroic_02.description: A wide, segmented superhero belt worn low on the hips, dipping slightly at the front. It has a central rectangular buckle plate with a chevron emblem, flanking contrasting side clasps, and a thin contrasting stripe along the band.
Female/F_Belt_Heroic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and buckle plate; colour 1 on the chevron emblem; colour 3 on the thin stripe along the band; colour 2 on the edging, inner lining and side clasps.
Female/F_Belt_Heroic_02.differs: The female belt sits lower and tilts down at the front, with a slimmer band and a smaller buckle plate.

Female/F_Belt_Heroic_03.description: A wide, sleek superhero belt band sitting at the waist, with a stepped, notched front edge and a thin rim along top and bottom. The angular panel design gives a clean, plain look.
Female/F_Belt_Heroic_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main band; colour 0 on the top and bottom rim edging and the front notch trim; colour 2 on the thin inner edge lines.

Female/F_Belt_Inflatable_Ring_01.description: A glossy inflatable swim ring worn around the waist, shaped like a giraffe: a raised neck and head with small knobbed horns at the front, a short tail nub at the back, and a spotted upper tube over a contrasting lower rim.
Female/F_Belt_Inflatable_Ring_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main body of the tube, head and neck; colour 1 on the spots and the eye; colour 3 on the underside rim and the mouth line; colour 0 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Belt_Inflatable_Ring_02.description: A glossy inflatable pool ring shaped like a unicorn, worn around the waist like a belt. A rounded horse head with a spiral horn and mane rises at the front, with a tail flare at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Inflatable_Ring_02.colourAreas: Default glossy material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows on the mane and tail; the rest of the ring and head take a metallic sheen with darker patches on the ring.

Female/F_Belt_Inmate_01.description: A wide, softly layered cloth waistband sitting low on the hips, with horizontal ridged folds, two vertical straps at the front sides and a raised rectangular buckle plate at the centre. Plain, utilitarian prison-style look.
Female/F_Belt_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the vertical side straps, buckle frame and small back tab; colour 3 on the central buckle inset.

Female/F_Belt_Inmate_02.description: A wide, slightly flared belt band that sits low on the waist, with a square raised buckle plate at the centre front and two upright vertical straps at the sides. The surface has a brushed, fur-like texture.
Female/F_Belt_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 1 on the central buckle plate and the small tab at the back; colour 3 on the two vertical side straps.

Female/F_Belt_Large_Cairngorn_01.description: A wide, angular belt with a large oval medallion at the front, ringed with a circular glyph pattern, a central disc and small studs. Ribbed side panels and swirling scroll motifs wrap to the back; it sits at the waist.
Female/F_Belt_Large_Cairngorn_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt band and medallion rim; colour 0 on the ribbed panels, scroll patterns and medallion face; colour 2 on the central disc and glyph lines; colour 3 on the small studs around the disc.

Female/F_Belt_Lion_01.description: A wide, layered waist belt with a padded cuff-like band, puffy rounded hip pods at each side and a lion-head plaque at the front. A long, narrow tattered cloth panel hangs from the front centre.
Female/F_Belt_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the puffy hip pods, lion plaque and hanging panel; colour 1 on the upper band, plaque frame and the fading hem of the panel; colour 2 on the front band insert; colour 3 on the back band panel.
Female/F_Belt_Lion_01.differs: The female hanging panel is longer and narrower, falling well down the thigh, and the hip pods sit lower and more rounded.

Female/F_Belt_Lockbox_65_01.description: A wide, corset-like waist wrap that crosses over at the front in overlapping flaps, with contrasting piping along the edges and swirling cloud motifs. It sits snugly at the midriff, with a flat back and a flared lower hem.
Female/F_Belt_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the wrap; colour 0 on the piping, the crossing flap edges and the inner top facing; the swirl motifs also take colour 0.
Female/F_Belt_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The female version is cinched into a narrower hourglass waist with a more sharply dipped front crossover.

Female/F_Belt_Lockbox_65_02.description: A wide, folded-over cloth sash belt sitting at the waist and hips, with a turned-down upper cuff, pointed panels at front and back, and a central pointed emblem plate with a layered contrasting centre. Martial-arts style.
Female/F_Belt_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main sash body; colour 0 on the edge trim and the central pointed plate; colour 2 on the inner cuff lining and the centre insert.
Female/F_Belt_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The female version has slightly longer front and back points that hang lower over the hips.

Female/F_Belt_Lockbox_66_01.description: A belt with angular, swept-out hip plates and a long single tabard-like panel hanging from the front centre to mid-thigh, with a jagged zigzag pattern and a notched, pointed hem. Fantasy-mechanical look.
Female/F_Belt_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel body and the hip plates; colour 2 on the outlines and edging; colour 3 on the zigzag markings; colour 1 on the clasps and the hem bands.
Female/F_Belt_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The female version hangs the long panel off-centre toward one side of the hip, with the hip plates swept mainly to that side.

Female/F_Belt_Low_Sapphire_01.description: A slim, low-slung belt band sitting on the hips, dotted with small diamond studs and closed by a square frame buckle at the front. A thin trim edge runs along the top.
Female/F_Belt_Low_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and top edge; colour 1 on the buckle frame; colour 3 on the diamond studs and buckle studs.

Female/F_Belt_Low_Segmented_Drka_01.description: A slim, low-slung segmented band that dips at the front and rides on the hips, with a small rectangular buckle plate at the centre front and a thin strand hanging at the back. Mechanical, minimal styling.
Female/F_Belt_Low_Segmented_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the front buckle plate and the small strand at the back.

Female/F_Belt_Mecha_01.description: A chunky, angular armoured hip guard forming a V-shaped band low across the hips and lower belly, with a thick raised outer rim and a hollow inner lining; suggests mecha or sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Belt_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick outer rim; colour 1 on the inner lining and the back section.
Female/F_Belt_Mecha_01.differs: The female belt dips into a deeper V at the front and sits lower on the hips, with a more sharply pointed centre.

Female/F_Belt_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A wide, low-slung superhero belt band with contrasting edge piping, dipping to a V at the front where a heart-shaped shield plate sits between two round knobs; small pointed flaps hang below at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 2 on the edge piping and rim; colour 1 on the central heart-shaped plate and back flaps; colour 3 on the round knobs at the sides of the buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A slim layered belt with a raised central gem-like plate and small round studs at the front, plus a long narrow cloth loincloth panel hanging from the front to about the knees. Sci-fi warrior styling.
Female/F_Belt_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the loincloth panel and belt rim; colour 1 on the belt bands; colour 3 on the central plate; colour 2 on the round studs.
Female/F_Belt_Modern_Ironclad_01.differs: The female belt sits slightly narrower and its cloth panel hangs a little longer and thinner, hanging clear of the front of the hips rather than from under the belt.

Female/F_Belt_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A low-slung modern belt with a wide flat band and a plastic side-release buckle at the front, plus layered curved flaps hanging in short tiers over the hips, open at front and back centre.
Female/F_Belt_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 1 on the layered hip flaps; colour 2 on the buckle.
Female/F_Belt_Modern_Kinetik_01.differs: The female version sits lower on the hips, with the flaps flaring slightly outward and the back flaps split more widely at the centre.

Female/F_Belt_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A slim sci-fi utility belt with a wide banded strap, a large round buckle housing with a domed centre at the front hip, a angular clasp block beside it, and a hanging strap ending in a clip ring.
Female/F_Belt_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 1 on the buckle housing, clasp block, strap fittings and hanging strap clip; colour 2 on the inner band groove; colour 3 on the domed buckle centre and small indicator marks.
Female/F_Belt_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The hanging strap sits at the back hip and hangs lower behind, while the round buckle sits to the front right.

Female/F_Belt_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A slim sci-fi belt band with a row of round disc pods along one side and large round atom-emblem discs at the front and the back, sitting low on the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the large round discs; colour 2 on the small disc pods; colour 3 on the atom symbols.

Female/F_Belt_Nightmare_Goth_01.description: A slim, low-slung belt with a padded rectangular plate at the hip, a spiked square buckle, and a long studded strap hanging down the front to a pointed tip. Gothic and slightly mechanical in feel.
Female/F_Belt_Nightmare_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and hip plate; colour 2 on the hanging strap, its studs and the buckle; colour 1 on the small straps holding the buckle.
Female/F_Belt_Nightmare_Goth_01.differs: The female belt appears darker and glossier, with the hanging strap in a contrasting colour, and the buckle has small spikes.

Female/F_Belt_Ornament_01.description: An east-asian styled armored wrap-skirt belt with a snarling guardian lion face buckle at the front, a spiky mane crest above it, layered side and back plates, an ornate embossed back panel and a ragged fur-like hem.
Female/F_Belt_Ornament_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body panels and mane crest; colour 0 on the lion face and scale plates; colour 3 on the waist band; colour 2 on the ragged hem and inner lining.
Female/F_Belt_Ornament_01.differs: The female version has a more open front with the lion face sitting over a gap, and the hem is more tattered; the male version has a fuller front with a contrasting fur interior.

Female/F_Belt_Patriot_01.description: A wide, flat superhero belt sitting low on the hips, with a raised rectangular buckle at the front and a plain smooth band running around the back. It appears glossy and translucent, like glass.
Female/F_Belt_Patriot_01.colourAreas: The default material ignores the colour scheme, so no slot is clearly visible on the belt; it renders as glossy, glass-like throughout.
Female/F_Belt_Patriot_01.differs: The female version renders as a glossy translucent material with no visible colour panels, buckle detail or studs on the back, unlike the male version's separate trim and buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Pumpkin_01.description: A belt of layered, curved armor plates: swept hip guards on each side with pointed upper fins, and a segmented, spiny centre plate that hangs down over the groin and rear. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Female/F_Belt_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the layered hip plates; colour 1 on the pointed upper fins; colour 2 on the segmented centre front and back plates.

Female/F_Belt_Punk_01.description: A slim casual belt sitting low on the hips, with a large rectangular open buckle at the front, a small tab keeper, and a row of round dots studded evenly along the strap. It looks slightly tilted and thin.
Female/F_Belt_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the round dots; colour 2 on the buckle frame; colour 1 on the small keeper tab.
Female/F_Belt_Punk_01.differs: On the female version the strap sits lower and tilts, and the back of the belt looks darker and flatter, whereas the male belt is a level, even band.

Female/F_Belt_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A chunky armoured belt with a thick layered band, a large angular front buckle plate with a recessed chevron and rivet-like bolts, and a short hanging plate with contrasting spikes that drops over the groin. A matching plain plate hangs at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the hanging plates; colour 1 on the buckle plate; colour 3 on the spikes and the chevron inlay; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Belt_Renegade_Basic_01.description: A wide, flat belt band sitting low on the hips, with a recessed side panel of pyramid studs, upright clip-like brackets at intervals, and rows of round rivets and eyelets across the front and back plates.
Female/F_Belt_Renegade_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and rim; colour 1 on the recessed side panels and upright brackets; colour 3 on the pyramid studs; colour 2 on the rivet and eyelet holes.

Female/F_Belt_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A low-slung studded belt of segmented panels with pyramid studs and a thin band round the back, with looped ring clasps on one hip and three swagged chains hanging down the thigh. Punk, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Belt_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the studded panels and chains; colour 0 on the belt edging and the band round the back; colour 1 on the ring clasps and loops; colour 2 on the buckle blocks.

Female/F_Belt_Renegade_Chains_02.description: A double-band studded belt: an upper strap with a large square buckle and a lower, tilted band of pyramid studs, joined by ring clasps with several draped chains hanging down one hip. Punk, sci-fi look worn low on the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Renegade_Chains_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt straps and edging; colour 1 on the buckle and ring clasps; colour 3 on the studded panels and chains; colour 2 on the small strap keepers.

Female/F_Belt_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A slim strap belt worn low on the hips, wrapped around the waist with a loose tail crossing diagonally over the front and hanging past the crotch. Diamond-shaped studs run along its length, giving a retro punk look.
Female/F_Belt_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the diamond studs; colour 2 on the edge outline.

Female/F_Belt_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A wide, angular metal-look belt band that sits low at the waist. It has a flared upper rim, a deep outer band, and an open gap at the front with two squared flaps. Retro, mechanical style.
Female/F_Belt_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and top faces of the band; colour 1 on the lower outer band and front flaps; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Belt_Retrosteelhead_02.description: A wide, angular band belt worn at the waist, with a flared upper rim and a front opening. Two slanted flat plates bracket the gap, giving a retro mechanical, armoured look.
Female/F_Belt_Retrosteelhead_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and inner surface of the band; colour 1 on the lower outer band and the front plates. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Belt_Ring_01.description: A small belt ornament: a thick faceted ring hangs from a square block with a raised oval boss on its face. It sits at the front of the waist or hips as a mechanical, industrial accent.
Female/F_Belt_Ring_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole piece, both the ring and the block; other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Belt_Satchel_01.description: A plain, thin flat belt band sitting low on the hips, with a small buckle and a short fastening tab with two rivets at the front right. A simple, utilitarian accessory with no pouches visible.
Female/F_Belt_Satchel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 3 on the buckle frame and the strap end panel; colour 1 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Belt_Ski_01.description: A slim padded belt sitting at the waist, with a round octagonal ring buckle at the front and several small rectangular tabs spaced evenly around the band. Suggests a sporty, superhero utility look.
Female/F_Belt_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the rectangular tabs; colour 3 on the ring buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Starhawk_01.description: A low-slung angular armored belt with a V-dipping front and back, pointed hip wings holding raised curved panels, a faceted gem-like shard at the front centre and a small pointed tail spike at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt frame and edge trim; colour 3 on the hip panels, front shard and back diamond stud.
Female/F_Belt_Starhawk_01.differs: The female belt's front dips into a deeper V with a larger central shard and taller pointed hip wings.

Female/F_Belt_Starhawk_02.description: A low-slung angular hip belt with a V-shaped front plate, pointed downward wings and a raised chevron at the back. Faceted, armour-like sections sit on the hips, giving a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Belt_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back chevron and the inner rim; colour 1 on the front V plate and hip sections; colour 2 on the hip-side spikes; colour 3 on the small side panel by the hip.

Female/F_Belt_Subligar_Tight_Subligarbro.description: A brief, high-cut subligar or loincloth-style brief with a thick banded waistband scalloped along its lower edge, studded with round bosses. It has a central panel with small rivets and side panels of swirling, tendril-like relief patterns.
Female/F_Belt_Subligar_Tight_Subligarbro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim, central front and back panel; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 2 on the round studs and rivets; colour 3 on the swirling tendril patterns of the side panels.

Female/F_Belt_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A slim, rigid metal band belt with faceted edges that dips into a shallow V at the front, where a small rectangular plate sits at the centre; rests low on the waist in a retro superhero style.
Female/F_Belt_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 2 on the front plate and the inner lining. The glossy metal finish partly ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Belt_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.differs: The female belt dips into a V shape at the front and its rectangular plate sits at the front centre, while the male belt is a level ring.

Female/F_Belt_Swing_01.description: A slim padded belt that hangs loosely and tilts low across the hips, with a raised stitched edge, a small seam tab at the side and a round ornate buckle plate at the front centre.
Female/F_Belt_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the buckle plate; colour 3 on the inner rosette markings of the buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Swing_02.description: A slim, padded belt band sitting low on the hips, dotted with small round studs, with a large round dial-like buckle at the front that has a gauge face and small bolts. Retro sci-fi style.
Female/F_Belt_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the studs and the buckle rim; colour 3 on the gauge face; colour 2 on the gauge interior details.
Female/F_Belt_Swing_02.differs: The female belt sits lower and slants down at the front over the hips, while the male belt sits level at the waist.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A wide utility belt sitting on the hips, with angular segmented front plates around a bat-wing-shaped buckle, a smooth band across the back, and chunky boxy pouches at each side. Superhero vigilante styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and front plates; colour 1 on the buckle wings and the corner accents of the band; colour 2 on the side pouches; colour 3 on the small stripes near the pouches.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The female version sits lower and tilts down toward the front, with the pouches set slightly further round to the sides.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Pockets_01.description: A utility belt with a thin cord band carrying many small square pouches, canister-like cylinders on the hips, and small hooked clips or handles. The pieces are spaced all the way around, sitting at the waist in a tactical, 90s comic style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Pockets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin belt band and the lower parts of the cylinders; colour 1 on most pouches and the cylinder tops; colour 2 on the darker pouches and clips; colour 3 on the central front pouch and small buttons.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Pockets_01.differs: The female version has a contrasting pouch in the front centre, with the cylinders sitting at the hips and a contrasting pouch beside it, and the back pouches are spaced differently.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Round_01.description: A wide, segmented utility belt with a large oval central buckle, panelled plating with etched lines, small flap pouches and clusters of cylindrical capsules on both sides. It sits at the waist, with a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Round_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt plating; colour 1 on the pouches, capsule cylinders and buckle rim; colour 3 on the central buckle gem and capsule tips; colour 2 on the recessed panel lines and gaps.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Round_01.differs: The female belt has fewer capsule clusters along the sides and back, with a smaller pouch layout.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Round_02.description: A low-slung utility belt with a wide segmented band, a large oval central buckle, and small flap pouches with clusters of cylindrical capsules along the sides and back. Sits on the hips with a slight downward dip in front; suggests a superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_90s_Round_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band and panelling; colour 1 on the pouches, buckle rim and capsule holders; colour 3 on the central oval buckle and the capsule tips; colour 2 on the recessed grooves and vents.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A wide cloth sash wrapped twice around the waist in overlapping, crumpled folds, tied in a bulky knot at the front with two short hanging tails. Casual martial-arts style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole sash, knot and tails.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Defender.description: A brief armored hip piece shaped like briefs: a rigid metallic rim with notched corners, a segmented plate over the front and back of the hips, and chevron-striped panels on the hip sides. Sits low on the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Defender.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and glossy metallic plates; colour 1 on the brief-like lower fabric section; colour 3 on the chevron-striped hip panels; colour 2 on the front and back centre plates.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Defender.differs: The female version has the striped side panels wrapped further around the hips, visible from the front and side, with a higher, more open rim at the back.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcra.description: A wide, soft sash-style belt wrapped around the waist with a knotted bundle at the front, and a single long tapered strip hanging down the front of the hip and thigh, with contrasting edge piping.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sash band and knot; colour 1 on the hanging strip's inner face; colour 3 on the edge piping.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcra.differs: The female knot sits at the front-right with a single tail hanging off-centre down the thigh, while the male has two tails hanging from a central knot.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Arcane_Belt_01.description: A low-slung ornate belt band with swirling scrollwork pattern, a large rounded gem-like orb at the centre front flanked by curved horn-like prongs, and small round studs hanging at the hips. Arcane, mystic style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Arcane_Belt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the orb's frame; colour 3 on the scrollwork and the hanging round studs; colour 1 on the central orb; colour 2 on the curved prongs and the inner rim.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Archer_01.description: A wide, low-slung belt with a rectangular front buckle and a large hip pouch hanging from one side on a strap. The pouch has a folded flap and a contrasting edge strip. A bulbous padded lump sits at the opposite front hip.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band, buckle and pouch base; colour 1 on the pouch flap and panels; colour 2 on the pouch edge strip; colour 3 on the small top tab of the pouch.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Archer_01.differs: The female belt adds a bulbous padded lump on the opposite front hip and sits lower and tilted on the hips.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Archlich_01.description: A low-slung spiked belt of segmented bony plates with an inner banded strip, a pointed shield-like codpiece at the front with a contrasting heart-shaped opening, and a small pointed flap at the back. Monstrous, armoured look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Archlich_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and front shield; colour 1 on the inner band strip; colour 2 on the spikes and the front opening; colour 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Archlich_01.differs: The female front shield is a bit smaller and sits lower, and the back flap is a slimmer, contrasting pointed panel hanging behind.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Armorninja.description: A wide cloth sash wrapped around the hips and knotted at the front left, with two long tails hanging down the thigh nearly to the knee. Diagonal colour blocks give it a martial-arts feel.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot and parts of the sash and tails; colour 1 on diagonal bands of the sash and tails; colour 2 on the front sash panel and tail stripes; colour 3 on the diagonal stripe at the back of the sash.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Armorpattern_01.description: A low-slung, brief-style hip piece made of segmented armor-like panels with V-shaped inset panels at front and back, edged in thick outlines. It sits on the hips and covers the groin and buttocks only.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Armorpattern_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hip panels and outer plates; colour 1 on the V-shaped inset panels at front and back; colour 2 on the edging and outline trim.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Armorrivets_01.description: A wide, chunky band belt sitting at the waist, with a flat top edge, a scalloped lower edge on a separate panel, and large round rivet studs spaced around the circumference. Armoured, mechanical look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Armorrivets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and scalloped lower edge; colour 1 on the main band panel; colour 2 on the rivet studs.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A brief armored hip piece like tight briefs: segmented plated panels wrap the hips and rear, with a raised front plate, a small tab at the waist, and angular fin-like blades jutting from each hip.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate and panel edges; colour 3 on the main hip and rear plating; colour 1 on the waist tab and the central and side stripes; colour 2 on the hip blades.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A wide, low-slung band belt with thick rolled edges and a separate central strip, sitting on the hips. A spiky angular emblem plate with a contrasting rim hangs at the front, with a small point at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rolled upper and lower edges; colour 1 on the central band; colour 3 on the front emblem; colour 2 on the emblem rim and inner lining.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_01.differs: The female belt has only a tiny point showing at the back, while the emblem sits higher and reads more as a single front plate.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A low-slung, angular segmented belt band worn on the hips, split into separate front and back wedge-shaped panels with a raised rim and a contrasting inner lining, leaving gaps at the centre front and back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer faces of the panels; colour 1 on the inner lining and part of the back panels; colour 0 on the rim edging.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_01.description: A shaggy fur loincloth worn low on the hips: a short brief-shaped band of layered, jagged-edged tufts that covers the hips and backside, with a small open gap at the sides. Suggests barbarian or beastly tribal styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the fur tips and lower fringe; colour 2 in the shaded underlayer at the crotch.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_02.description: A wide tribal belt with a padded cushion-like top band ringed by contrasting skulls all around the waist, a hoop ornament at the front centre and short hanging spike tassels below. Striped banding wraps the sides and back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the padded upper band, hoop and straps; colour 2 on the skulls; colour 3 on the striped bands and hanging spikes; colour 0 barely visible.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_03.description: A tribal hip belt with a wide striped band, a ring of skulls around the waist, a hoop ornament with dangling tassels at the front, and a shaggy fur skirt fringe hanging to the upper thighs.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt band, hoop and fur tips; colour 3 on the stripes, tassels and web lines; colour 0 on the fur; colour 2 on the skulls.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_03.differs: The female version's fur skirt is shorter and sits closer to the hips, with a small loose strap flap at the side.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_Norse_01.description: A broad belt ringed by a shaggy fur fringe with jagged, pointed tufts above and below. A wide strap carries a large curled buckle at the front and round studs all the way round, sitting at the hips in a barbarian style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_Norse_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the buckle and studs; colour 0 on the fur; colour 1 on the fur tips and shading.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Belt_Sideways_01.description: A padded, ribbed tech belt worn tilted low across the hips, with a centre buckle panel, two round gadget discs at one hip and two boxy pouches at the other side. Utilitarian sci-fi look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Belt_Sideways_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded belt band; colour 1 on the buckle panel and the outer shells of the round discs; colour 2 on the pouches; colour 3 on the disc centres.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Belt_Sideways_01.differs: The female belt has two pouches at the side, while the male version carries three pouches.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Beltsash_01.description: A wide, plain band belt sitting low on the hips, with a rectangular contrasting panel at one hip from which hang a few ragged, tattered strands. A simple sash-style waist piece.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Beltsash_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the hip panel; colour 2 on the hanging tattered strands.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Beltsash_01.differs: The panel and hanging strands sit at the wearer's left hip, off to the side and slightly toward the front.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A low-slung hip belt with a thick segmented band and a contrasting rim, centred on a front bird emblem with spread layered wings and a pointed tail-like plate that hangs down over the groin. Superhero, avian style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 1 on the layered wing feathers; colour 2 on the rim, the bird body and the pointed lower plate; colour 3 on the small eye detail of the bird.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A curved plated groin guard hanging from the lower abdomen: a broad angular front plate with a contrasting band across the top, tapering to a separate pointed panel between the legs. Sci-fi armour look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 2 on the band across the top; colour 1 on the lower pointed panel.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A low-slung armoured hip guard forming a V-shaped plate that dips to a front codpiece with four round perforations, with flared side wings, small horn-like spikes at the hips and a matching V-shaped back panel.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and spikes; colour 1 on the diagonal side panels at the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_02.differs: The female version has a more open, asymmetric front, with the left hip wing sitting separated and lower than the right.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A slim, low-slung band belt worn around the hips, with a faceted polygonal outline, a raised contrasting rim along the top and bottom edges, and a row of rounded studs or gems spaced evenly around the outside.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the raised rim edging; colour 3 on the round studs.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A wide, corset-like waist band with jagged tufted fur edging along the top and bottom, a thin trim line beside each fur edge, and a strap with rectangular buckle plates and diamond studs wrapped around the midsection.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the fur edging at top and bottom; colour 2 on the thin trim lines; colour 3 on the strap, buckle plates and diamond studs.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Buckle_01.description: A wide, plain flat belt band worn around the hips, with a large square frame buckle at the centre front. Simple, angular faceted construction that suits casual and superhero looks.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Buckle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the square buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Buckle_02.description: A wide, plain belt band sitting low on the hips, with a large oval buckle at the front carrying a raised star-like relief. Western-style, slightly angular faceted band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Buckle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the oval buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Buckle_Holsterboth_0.description: A western gunslinger belt with a wide band, large rectangular buckle and rows of cartridge loops across the front. Two crossed drop straps hang low over the hips, also lined with cartridges, in a holster-rig style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Buckle_Holsterboth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and hanging straps; colour 2 on the buckle frame and cartridge tips; colour 1 on the cartridge bodies; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Buckleandwrap_01.description: A slim eyelet-studded belt riding low on the hips, with a large square buckle at the front, a tapered strap end hanging down beside it, and a second strap wrapping loosely around the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Buckleandwrap_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt straps and hanging tail; colour 3 on the buckle and eyelet rings; colour 0 on the small strap keepers at the sides.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Buckleandwrap_01.differs: The female belt sits lower and tilts, with the wrap strap crossing diagonally over the front and back, whereas the male version sits level.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_01.description: A wide, flat belt worn low on the hips, with a large square frame buckle at the front and rows of small cartridge-like bullets lined along both sides. The back is a plain smooth band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and bullet casings; colour 2 on the buckle frame and bullet caps.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_01.differs: The female belt dips lower at the front and sits tilted along the hips, while the back band is a bit taller.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_02.description: A wide, low-slung belt band sitting on the hips, dipping at the front, with a large oval raised buckle at the centre and rows of small bullet-like cartridges along both sides. Military, tactical look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the oval buckle and the cartridge caps; colour 1 on the cartridge bodies.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bulwark_01.description: A partial armored waist guard of angular plates: a chevron-shaped centre piece with a V-shaped inset and tall flared side fins with round studs, wrapping around the waist as a segmented belt.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bulwark_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared side plates and outer shell; colour 1 on the V-shaped inset under the chevron; colour 2 on the chevron centre plate; colour 3 on the round studs.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bulwark_01.differs: The female version sits at the natural waist with shorter, more compact plates.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bustierskirt_01.description: A very short, layered ruffled mini skirt sitting low on the hips, with two stacked tiers of puffy gathered fabric, thin contrasting edge trim on each tier, and a contrasting inner waistband. Cute, casual look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Bustierskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled skirt tiers; colour 1 on the edge trim of each tier; colour 2 on the inner waistband lining.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Celestial_01.description: A slim band belt sitting low on the hips, with a large round buckle at the front set in a ring, flanked by swept feathered wings and crossed by a vertical anchor-like bar. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Celestial_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the band and buckle disc; colour 0 on the ring around the buckle; colour 1 on the wings; colour 2 on the vertical bar.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Chains_01.description: A loose belt of chunky metal chain links wrapped in several overlapping loops around the hips, crossing over itself at front and back and resting low on the waist. Rugged, industrial look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; the gaps between links show the body underneath.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Chains_01.differs: The female chains sit lower and tilt on the hips, with the loops tangled more loosely at the front.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Chains_Skull_01.description: A loose belt of heavy chain looped several times around the hips, with small spikes poking out and a large skull buckle at the front centre. Gothic, monstrous accessory worn low at the waist.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Chains_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chain links and spikes; colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the skull's eye glow.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Chains_Skull_02.description: A belt of heavy chunky chain links looped several times around the waist and crossing at the back, with a large skull buckle at the front centre and small spikes along the chain.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Chains_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chain links and spikes; colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the skull's eye glow; colour 2 on the gaps between links.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A wide, angular mechanical belt band sitting at the waist, with faceted panels, contrasting swooping side panels and a small clasp mechanism with tiny levers and wires at the front centre. Sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and clasp levers; colour 1 on the swooping side and front panels; colour 2 on the inner lining and small clasp parts; colour 3 on the small wire details at the clasp.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cobralords_Belt_01.description: A wide, flat hip belt band that dips lower at the front, with a large skull buckle at the centre ringed by short curved spikes. It sits low on the hips, with a punk, monstrous look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cobralords_Belt_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt band; colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the eye sockets; colour 3 on the spikes.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cobralords_Belt_01.differs: The female belt tilts lower at the front and sits lower on the hips, with a slightly deeper dip below the waist.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Combat_01.description: A slim utility belt worn low at the hips, ringed with boxy pouches and small angular modules, with a rectangular buckle plate at the front and a thin strap band running around the waist. Suggests a tech or tactical look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Combat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the larger pouch bodies; colour 1 on the front buckle plate and the pouch lids and tabs; colour 2 on the thin inner strap lines and small slots.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Combatstraps_01.description: A utility harness of thin crossing straps looping around the hips and upper thighs, with a belt band carrying square pouches and cylindrical canisters with contrasting clips and hooks. Sits low on the hips; tactical, mechanical look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Combatstraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and belt band; colour 1 on the square pouches; colour 3 on the cylindrical canisters; colour 2 on the clips, hooks and small plates.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Construction_01.description: A wide, low-slung tool belt with a curved front plate, layered pouches around the hips, a large rear pocket with a flap, and a long hammer hanging from a loop at the side.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Construction_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band, front plate and hammer handle; colour 1 on the pouches; colour 3 on the pouch flaps and straps; colour 2 on the rear pocket and hammer head.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A wide, chunky segmented belt band with an angular, faceted oval outline and layered rims. It sits low on the waist like a sci-fi buckle ring with contrasting panels on the top face.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and rims; colour 1 on the side wedge panels and the top face; colour 3 on the top-face corner panels; colour 2 on the lower rim and inserts.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_01.differs: The female belt has a darker, less colourful top face and a heavier contrasting lower rim, while the male has bold contrasting and contrasting panels across the top.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_02.description: A chunky sci-fi belt band sitting low on the hips, with three hexagonal framed panels across the front and sides, layered rims above and below, and a slightly wider back section.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rims and hexagon frames; colour 1 on the hexagon inserts and band panels; colour 2 on the lower edge and inner band; colour 3 on small accent panels.
