Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_02.differs: The female belt has a raised, banded back and sits lower on the hips, with the hexagon panels spread wider around the front.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_03.description: A slim segmented belt of linked hexagonal plates joined by thin bars, with a larger hexagonal buckle plate at the centre front. It sits low on the hips and gives a sci-fi, mechanical look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the linking bars and outer hexagon plates; colour 1 on the plate edges and underlayer panels; colour 2 on the front buckle plate.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_03.differs: The hexagon plates are darker and more metallic in tone on this body, and the front buckle plate looks more raised.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_04.description: A wide, chunky hip belt with a smooth armoured upper band, two thin rings around the lower edge, and a hexagonal gem-like buckle at the front with angular struts sweeping outward. Sits low on the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_04.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper band and buckle struts; colour 1 on the central buckle gem and patches on the lower section; colour 0 on the lower panels; colour 3 on the rings and inner edge.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_04.differs: The female version is contrasting across the upper band and buckle, and the front struts sweep down into pointed tails.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cummerbund_01.description: A wide, softly gathered cummerbund-style sash worn low around the hips, with horizontal wavy folds all the way round. It is a short band with no hanging tails, suiting casual, martial or fantasy looks.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cummerbund_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole gathered sash band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cummerbund_01.differs: The female version is only the plain gathered band, without the long hanging cloth tail that the male version has at the hip.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A harness-style hip belt with a wide waistband and crossed leg straps that loop around the upper thighs, edged with contrasting trim and studded with small rectangular blocks; a large faceted gem-like buckle sits at the front centre.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and straps; colour 1 on the small rectangular blocks along the straps; colour 2 on the edge trim and the top of the band; colour 3 on the front buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cybermind_01.description: A slim, flat band belt worn at the waist with a small oval buckle at the centre front and two large rounded disc pods projecting from the hips, one on each side. Tech-styled with thin circuit-like lines.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Cybermind_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt band; colour 0 on the discs and centre buckle; colour 1 on the central lens of each side disc and the thin circuit lines.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Deity_01.description: A partial waist band made of sharp, swept-back blade-like fins that curve around the midsection, with gaps at the front and back. Angular and monstrous, worn snug at the waist over tights.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the blade fins and band segments.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Deity_01.differs: The female version has no front armoured plate, only the spiked fins with an open gap at the front.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Deity_02.description: A narrow waist belt of curved, blade-like metal fins flaring out at the hips and back, with a raised front plate of three stacked ridged bands around a contrasting centre window. Sits on the waist with a sci-fi, monstrous look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved blade fins; colour 1 on the plate backing and the rear panel; colour 3 on the stacked front bands; colour 2 on the centre window.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Deity_02.differs: The female version adds a solid front plate with stacked ridged bands and a rear panel, while the male version is only separate blade fins.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: Short, low-slung hip shorts with a V-shaped front waistband, a chevron-seamed front panel and high-cut leg openings. Contrasting piping edges the waist and legs, and a vertical strap runs down the back centre.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shorts fabric; colour 0 on the top edge of the waistband; colour 2 on the piping and back strap; colour 3 on the small stitched marks along the piping.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A wide, curved cloth-like belt band sitting low on the hips, with vertical stripe seams, a thin contrasting edge trim and a raised skull-and-crossbones emblem at the centre front; the band dips lower toward the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the skull emblem; colour 3 on the skull's eyes; stripe seams pick up a light tint.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.differs: The female belt sits lower on the hips and is a shallower curved band that dips at the back, while the male one is a taller, straighter band around the waist.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: Brief-style armoured hip piece of segmented plates forming a low-cut, high-leg silhouette with a raised banded waist rim and angular side plates. Sits on the hips and rear like armoured underwear; suits sci-fi or superhero looks.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edge and the lower side plates; colour 1 on the front waist band; colour 3 on the side accent plates; colour 2 on the front and rear centre panels.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_02.description: A brief, brief-shaped armored hip piece with a thick banded waistband and segmented angular plates across the front and a smooth rounded back panel; open at the sides, it sits low on the hips in a sci-fi style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and back panel; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 3 on the trim strip at the top back edge of the band; colour 2 on the edge outlines and inner lining.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_02.differs: The female version has a smoother, rounded back panel with less plate detail and no stitched rivet lines on the front.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_03.description: A hip-hugging brief-style armored belt with layered plate segments over the groin and rear, a contrasting upper band, boxy side pouches and a row of small cylindrical canisters across the front. Tactical sci-fi utility look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and brief body; colour 1 on the upper waistband; colour 2 on the side pouches; colour 3 on the canisters and the thin piping along the top edge.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_03.differs: The female version has canisters spread across the front and a slightly higher, more cut-away leg line.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Discstring_01.description: A loose, low-slung belt of round octagonal discs strung on a thin cord around the hips, with a larger domed disc at the front hip bearing a triple spiral emblem. Tribal, ornate metallic look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Discstring_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc faces; colour 2 on the disc rims and backs; colour 1 on the spiral emblem on the large front disc; colour 3 on the connecting cord.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Eclipse_01.description: A low-slung segmented belt of armored, bone-like plates ringed with sharp contrasting spikes, with a pointed shield-shaped buckle at the front and a V-shaped contrasting panel beneath. Monstrous, draconian style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Eclipse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented plates and buckle; colour 1 on the V-shaped panel under the buckle; colour 2 on the spikes and the buckle marking.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Eclipse_01.differs: The female belt has an extra small spiked ornament above the front buckle, and its buckle sits lower and points down over the hips.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Egyptian_01.description: A thin, low-slung ring-shaped belt with faceted, slightly irregular edges, dipping to a V at the front where a chunky faceted gem is set. It rests on the hips like an ancient-style ornamental girdle.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Egyptian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metallic-looking band, which shows and weathered; colour 1 on the outer facets of the gem; colour 3 on the gem's centre.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Egyptian_Scarab_01.description: A slim low-slung belt band with a winged scarab beetle emblem at the front: outstretched feathered wings with layered stripes flank a rounded beetle body with raised front legs, hanging over the hips and lower abdomen.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Egyptian_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the scarab body, legs and wing feathers; colour 2 on the wing stripe band; colour 3 on the wing accent feathers.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Energyhero_01.description: A slim, form-fitting belt worn low on the hips, with a band of ridged horizontal stripes between contrasting borders and a round faceted buckle disc set off-centre to one side of the front.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Energyhero_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the band edges and borders; colour 3 on the ridged stripes; colour 1 on the buckle rim; colour 0 on the buckle centre disc.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A low-slung art deco belt: a thin band circles the hips and dips into a V-shaped front plate with angular armored panels and a pointed centre buckle. It sits below the waist over the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt band and the V-shaped front panel; colour 0 on the angular side plates and centre buckle; colour 2 on the thin inset lines.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Exartdeco_01.differs: The female belt dips lower into a deeper, sharper V at the front, with a thinner band that sags at the sides.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Extraterrestial_01.description: A wide, ribbed sash-style belt sitting on the hips, with a hexagonal metal buckle plate bearing an emblem at the front and angular chevron-marked armor plates jutting from each hip. Alien, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Extraterrestial_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed sash band; colour 0 on the hexagonal buckle frame and hip plate edges; colour 1 on the emblem field and the chevron panels of the hip plates.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Extraterrestial_01.differs: The female belt sits lower and the sash is wider and layered at the front and back, while the male band is a thinner, single ring.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Flower_01.description: A slim belt of twisting vine stems wound loosely around the waist, studded with small pointed leaves and a round layered flower at the front centre. Reads as a natural, woodland-fairy accent.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some vine strands and leaf tips; colour 1 on most of the leaves and twining stems; colour 2 on the darker vine strands and flower centre; colour 3 on the flower's inner petals.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Formal_01.description: A slim, low-slung belt band sitting on the hips, with a small square buckle block at the front and several evenly spaced cross straps around the band. The edges have thin contrasting trim.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Formal_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main band; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 0 on the cross straps; colour 2 on the buckle block.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_01.description: A wide, slightly angled superhero belt with a raised letter F emblem at the front, rows of round striped spherical studs at each side, and a cylindrical canister holstered on the right hip by a strap bracket.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and canister body; colour 1 on the F emblem; colour 2 on the round spheres; colour 3 on the canister caps, bracket and belt edging.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_01.differs: The female belt sits slightly lower and tilts at the hips, with the canister hanging a little further forward on the hip.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.description: A wide, angular superhero belt sitting at the waist, with a raised upper rim, a contrasting front band carrying a large letter F buckle, and small cylindrical pouches or canisters at the front and sides. Plain rear band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower band, canisters and F buckle; colour 1 on the upper rim panels; colour 2 on the front band behind the buckle; colour 3 on the small stripe accents on the rim.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.differs: The female belt is tilted and sits lower at the front, with the canisters clustered closer to the centre buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Geishabow_01.description: A large geisha-style obi bow worn at the lower back of the waist, with a puffy two-lobed bow, a central knot and two long flat ribbon tails hanging down the back of the thighs.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Geishabow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central knot and the main length of the tails; colour 1 on the front-facing bow lobes' outer faces and the curved panels on the tails; colour 2 on the bow's underside edges and the bands across the tails.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Geishabow_Tail.description: A large rear bow sitting at the small of the back, with a central knot and two puffy loops, and two long flat ribbon tails hanging down over the buttocks to mid-thigh. Geisha-style sash accessory.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Geishabow_Tail.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot and the ribbon tails; colour 1 on the bow loops and the side panels of the tails; colour 2 on the bow loop undersides and the bands across the tails.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.description: A slim, low-slung band belt that dips at the front and back and sits on the hips. It has a light central stripe with contrasting edging, a contrasting clasp buckle and two small loop tabs.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central stripe; colour 1 on the edging and inner band; colour 2 on the buckle; colour 3 on the small loop tabs.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The female belt tilts and dips in a wavy line over the hips, and the buckle sits at the centre front with the loop tabs close beside it.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_01.description: A short, loose martial-arts gi skirt wrapping the hips like a wide sash, with soft wrinkled cloth, small side slits and a flared hem ending at upper thigh. Suggests casual dojo or sporty wear.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt exterior; the inner waist lining shows a darker shade, likely colour 2.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_01.differs: The female skirt sits lower on the hips and curves into a longer, rounded front hem with a fuller drape; the male is a flatter, shorter band.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_02.description: A short martial arts gi skirt of loosely creased cloth that hangs from the hips to the upper thigh, with a wide knotted sash at the waist and two long tails hanging down the front.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt cloth; colour 3 on the sash, knot and hanging tails.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_02.differs: The female version has a longer, fuller skirt that hangs to the upper thigh with a side slit, and the sash knot sits at the centre front.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A bulky armoured midsection wrap: rounded plates with a domed front centre, panelled sides with recessed screens, and three spikes down the back and each side. Sits around the waist and stomach with a notched top edge.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates and back stripe; colour 1 on the raised rims and edging; colour 2 on the front dome and recessed panels; colour 3 on the spikes and small scratch marks.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The female version has a lower, scooped notch at the top front, leaving the plates cut away above the navel.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A slim superhero belt of several stacked ridged bands that dip low at the front and wrap around the hips, with a large round disc buckle centred at the front and a thin raised rim along the top edge.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the layered belt bands and upper rim; colour 1 on the centre of the round buckle; colour 2 on the buckle's outer ring.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Golden_Age_02.description: A low-slung superhero belt made of several stacked thin ridged bands that ring the hips, with a large star-shaped buckle on a round backing at the front centre. Sits at the hip line with a retro Golden Age feel.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Golden_Age_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stacked belt bands; colour 1 on the star buckle; colour 2 on the round backing behind the star.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Goth_01.description: A wide, plain band belt with stitched edges that sits low on the hips, fastened at the front by an octagonal skull buckle ringed with small round studs. Gothic look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the skull; colour 2 on the octagonal buckle plate; colour 3 on the round studs and eye sockets.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Goth_02.description: A strappy hip harness of thin flat bands crossing in X shapes at the front and back, joined by small metal rings and tiny end tabs, slung low around the hips. Goth or punk styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 2 on the metal rings; colour 3 on the small tabs where the straps join.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Harajuku_Basic_01.description: A slim casual belt worn low and tilted around the hips, with a round ring buckle at the front, a short keeper loop, and a row of small studs along its length, edged in contrasting trim.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Harajuku_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt strap and keeper; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the studs; colour 2 on the ring buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Harness_01.description: A hip harness of narrow flat straps forming an open cage around the hips and groin, with a horizontal waist band carrying a rectangular front buckle. Straps cross at the sides and rear, leaving wide gaps.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Harness_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and band; colour 2 on the buckle frame.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Harness_01.differs: The female harness has a rectangular buckle at the centre of the waist band, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A hip-slung belt with a thin banded waistband and a centre emblem, two pointed side flaps with round vent discs, and a long narrow front tab with a wavy chevron pattern hanging to mid-thigh. Ancient-tech loincloth look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side flaps and waistband; colour 1 on the emblem and the wavy stripes of the front tab; colour 2 on the thin band at the waist and the vent discs.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The female version's side flaps are smaller and sit closer to the hips, with only the front tab visible at the centre.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A segmented armored hip belt with a large round glossy eye-like orb at the front centre, layered overlapping plates fanning around the hips, a pointed lower front tassette, and looping fabric sashes draped at the sides.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate edges, orb surround and lower rim; colour 1 on the inset banded plates; colour 2 on the orb and rear underside; colour 3 on the draped sashes.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Hipan_01.differs: The female version has a longer, pointed front plate and back panel hanging lower over the thighs, with the plates sitting slightly higher on the hips.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A low-slung sci-fi belt made of overlapping angular armored segments forming a wide band around the hips, with a raised notched edge and thin contrasting trim lines along the seams.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt segments; colour 1 on the thin trim lines along the panel edges.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Holsterleft_01.description: A double gunslinger belt with two overlapping bands crossing at a slant around the hips, each with a large square buckle at the front, rows of small cartridge loops at the sides, and a short hanging tab at the hip.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Holsterleft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt bands and tab; colour 2 on the buckles and the cartridge loops.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Holsterleft_01.differs: The female belt has a shorter hip tab that hangs less far down the thigh.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Holsterright_01.description: A western-style double belt: a flat waist band with a large square buckle, plus a second band slung diagonally low over the right hip with its own buckle, a hanging tab and a row of small cartridge loops.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Holsterright_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt bands and tab; colour 2 on the buckle frames and cartridge casings; colour 1 on the cartridge tips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Holsterright_01.differs: The female version has only one visible cartridge row with fewer loops and a larger, more angled buckle on the upper band.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Hunter_01.description: A wide, rounded hip band with a rough, hide-like texture and a raised rim, studded with curved horn spikes that jut out at the front, sides and back. A primitive, beastly waist piece worn low on the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Hunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim edge; colour 1 on the main band; colour 3 on the horn bases and gem-like bosses; colour 2 on the horn tips.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Insignia_01.description: A slim flat strap belt that dips low at the front and sits on the hips, with a large round disc buckle carrying an atom emblem. The disc stands proud of the strap at the front and also shows at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the rim and back of the disc; colour 1 on the emblem background; colour 0 on the atom symbol.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Insignia_01.differs: The female belt is a thinner strap that slopes down into a low V at the front, while the male belt is a wider band that sits level around the waist.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ironclad_Anniversary.description: A wide, tube-like waist wrap with a contrasting front panel and a long narrow tassel-like flap hanging down the front of the hips, ending in a zigzag diamond-patterned hem. Ancient, ceremonial look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ironclad_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waist band and the hanging flap; colour 1 on the front panel and the flap's hem edge; colour 2 on the diamond hem pattern and the panel's lower edge; colour 3 on the thin vertical lines on the flap.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A loose ring of chunky chain links draped around the hips, with several round two-tone spheres dangling at intervals like weights. Sits low on the waist as a menacing, monster-themed accessory.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links and one half of each sphere; colour 1 on the other half of some spheres; colour 2 on the other half of some spheres; colour 3 on small accents on a few spheres.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Largeloose_01.description: A wide, slightly angled band belt worn low on the hips, with a large round buckle at the front ringed by a thick rim and several small rectangular clasp blocks spaced along the band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Largeloose_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the rectangular clasp blocks; colour 2 on the buckle rim; colour 3 on the buckle centre disc.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Largeloose_02.description: A wide, plain belt band sitting low on the hips, with a large squared buckle at the front framing a round centre disc. The band is slightly angular and tilts down toward the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Largeloose_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the buckle frame; colour 3 on the round centre disc of the buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Light_01.description: A winged belt ornament: a hexagonal central medallion with a small gem sits over a pointed kite-shaped plate, flanked by two feathered wings that sweep upward across the hips, worn low at the waist.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing feathers and the panels of the plate; colour 0 on the edge piping and outlines; colour 3 on the medallion and the plate edging; colour 1 on the central gem.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.description: An ornate filigree belt of thorny, leaf-like scrollwork wrapping the waist, with a large butterfly-shaped cut-out plate at the front centre and curling swirl ornaments at the sides. Gothic and fantasy in feel.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the butterfly plate at the front; colour 1 on the curling swirls and the central leaf ornament; colour 2 on the thorny filigree band and leaf spikes.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The butterfly plate sits at the front centre with the leaf flourish below it, and the tall leaf spray is on the right side of the belt.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.description: A short, wide superhero waist belt band that tapers to points at the sides, with pointed fang-like spikes along the lower front edge, a contrasting inner lining at the front and a hexagonal panel at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower front edge and the fang spikes; colour 1 on the side and back sections of the band; colour 3 on the back panel and side edge; colour 2 on the inner front lining.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.differs: The female belt has a less pronounced hexagonal back panel, which is angled more like a wedge shape, and the contrasting trim at the side edge is more visible.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Loinclothmedicinebag.description: A thin hip belt with a single rectangular flapped pouch hanging at the wearer's right hip. The pouch has stitched edging and a printed tribal motif on the flap and body. Suggests a tribal, hide-craft look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Loinclothmedicinebag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and pouch body; colour 1 on the belt edge stripe; colour 3 and colour 1 on the stitched pouch edging; colour 2 on the printed motifs.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A wide, soft cloth sash belt worn low on the hips, with gathered horizontal wrinkles and a front edge that dips into a shallow V below the navel. Simple, casual and slightly theatrical.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole sash; the hidden underside is and takes no other visible slot.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Madjester_01.differs: The female sash dips lower in a V at the front and sits at a slight angle, with more visible draping folds.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Madjester_02.description: A low-slung studded belt with a pointed tail end and small buckle, worn at the hips, topped by several floating curled strips with pointed tips and studs that spiral loosely above it around the waist.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the floating curled strips; colour 1 on the belt band; colour 3 on the studs and buckle.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Madjester_02.differs: The female belt has a single contrasting band with no contrasting inner lining visible, and the floating strips sit higher and more spread out.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A twisted-rope belt wrapped around the waist, tied at the back in a large looped bow with a contrasting knot. Two thick braided cords hang down the back, each ending in a spherical weight and a tassel.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the twisted rope belt and bow loops; colour 2 on the central knot; colour 1 on the hanging cords and tassels; colour 3 on the spherical weights.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Martial_Power_01.differs: The female belt sits on the waist with a larger, wider bow whose loops spread out like wings, and the cords hang a little shorter.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Martialarts_02.description: A wide cloth sash wrapped around the waist and tied in a knot at the front, with two long tails hanging down the front of the hips. A simple martial arts belt with a soft, slightly puckered fold.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Martialarts_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole sash, knot and hanging tails; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Martialarts_Rope_01.description: A thick twisted rope belt wrapped twice around the waist and knotted at the front, with two rope ends hanging down the front and two shorter tails hanging at the back. Suggests martial-arts or casual wear.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Martialarts_Rope_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole rope; the twisted strands show shading only, and no other slots are visible.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Martialarts_Rope_01.differs: The front knot's rope ends hang longer, and the back tails reach lower on the hips.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Mechaniste_01.description: A brief, brief-style hip piece with angular faceted panels, a quilted raised front plate, padded ribbed pads at the back hips and open leg holes. Sits low on the hips with a sci-fi mechanical look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Mechaniste_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the briefs; colour 1 on the quilted front plate and the small back tab; colour 2 on the padded side and back pads.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Mechassn_01.description: A low-slung, brief-style armored hip piece with a segmented plated front that tapers to a point, a smooth rounded rear, and crossing diagonal straps over each hip. Mechanical, sleek look with an open, hollow side.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating front and back; colour 1 on the side panels beneath the straps; colour 3 on the crossing hip straps and edge panels; colour 2 on the inner lining and plate seams.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Mechassn_01.differs: The female version has a higher, flared front plate with a contrasting inner rim, while the male front plate is deeper with two stacked segments.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Monster_01.description: A ring of separate curved bone-like blades and small winged fins studded around the hips, each mounted on a small base plate. Sparse and spiky, they sit at the waistline with no band joining them.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blades and fin shapes; colour 1 on the fin membranes and some blade edges; colour 3 on the small base plates.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Monster_01.differs: The female version has fewer blades, spaced more widely around the hips and set slightly lower.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Necromancer_01.description: A slim double-strap belt with a wide band at the waist and a second thinner strap looping diagonally down to the hip, carrying a small padded satchel pouch on the side of the hip.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Necromancer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and looping strap; colour 1 on the satchel pouch.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.description: A thick, loosely gathered cloth sash wrapped around the waist, with a katana thrust through it diagonally: hilt with wrapped grip and round guard at the front-left, scabbard trailing down behind the opposite hip.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped sash; colour 1 on the scabbard and hilt; colour 3 on the hilt wrap diamonds; colour 2 on the sword guard and fittings.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.differs: The female sash sits higher on the waist and the sword slants more steeply, with the scabbard tip trailing lower at the front.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ornamental_01.description: A wide, segmented band belt worn at the waist, with a square front buckle bearing a knot-like emblem and angular glyph-like markings along the band, edged with a thin contrasting trim. Ornate east-asian styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ornamental_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the emblem face; colour 1 on the edge trim and the buckle frame; colour 2 on the buckle backing; colour 3 on the glyph markings.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ornamental_01.differs: The female belt sits lower and dips at the hips, with the front buckle placed slightly higher than the band and flared side panels, while the male band is level all the way round.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Padding.description: A slim, padded belt band that wraps once around the hips, made of faceted segments with small round dots and a slight dip at the front. It sits low on the waist and has a tactical, armored look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front and back segments and the round dots; colour 1 on the side segments; colour 2 on the darker patches near the sides; colour 3 on small accent patches at the sides.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_01.description: A wide, softly draped cloth sash wrapped around the hips in gathered folds, tied in a knot at the front-left hip with a single long tail hanging down the thigh. Suggests an eastern or fantasy wrap.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped sash and knot; colour 1 on the hanging tail; colour 3 on the trim band at the tail's end.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_01.differs: The knot sits at the side of the hip and the tail hangs from the hip down the outer thigh, away from the centre.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_02.description: A low-slung ancient-style belt with a padded, gathered waistband, a row of contrasting round beads along its lower edge and a central round gem. A narrow front loincloth panel with braided edging hangs to mid-thigh, and draped side panels sit over the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and front loincloth; colour 1 on the draped side panels and the centre gem; colour 2 on the beads; colour 3 on the band piping and the braided panel edging.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_02.differs: The female version has a row of round beads along the waistband and a longer, narrower front panel, with no contrasting band across the belt.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_03.description: A low-slung, gathered cloth hip wrap with a central round medallion, a row of contrasting round beads along the upper edge, and a narrow hanging panel with braided-looking edging falling down the front of the thigh.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered wrap and hanging panel; colour 3 on the stripe of piping along the wrap; colour 1 and colour 3 on the braided panel edging; colour 2 on the beads and medallion setting; colour 1 on the medallion gem.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_03.differs: The female version has a row of contrasting round beads along the top edge and contrasting loops draped across the back, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_04.description: A low-slung, puffy gathered belt band worn around the hips, with a contrasting stripe running along its length, a row of round studded discs along the edge, and a central oval gem clasp at the front.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered band; colour 3 on the stripe along the band; colour 2 on the round discs and the clasp housing; colour 1 on the central gem.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_04.differs: The female version adds a row of round contrasting discs along the edge of the band, and its front dips lower with a raised back.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_05.description: A low-slung hip belt with a wide, puffy gathered band, a row of round studs along a thin cord, and a central oval gem. Draped fabric panels hang at each hip, leaving the front and back open. Ornate, Persian-inspired look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Persian_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered waistband; colour 1 on the draped hip panels and the centre gem; colour 2 on the round studs; colour 3 on the thin cord trim.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A slim, low-slung belt band with a wide centre stripe between contrasting edge piping, closed at the front by a round, faceted medallion buckle with a domed centre. Sits on the hips; a fancy, pirate-flavoured accent.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the edge piping; colour 1 on the wide centre stripe; colour 2 on the buckle housing; colour 3 on the domed centre of the buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Pockets_01.description: A slim utility belt with a square front buckle and padded flap pouches spaced around the front and sides, each with a small button-like clasp. It sits low on the hips and suits tactical or superhero looks.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Pockets_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt strap; colour 1 on the buckle; colour 0 on the pouches; colour 3 on the pouch clasps.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Pockets_01.differs: The female belt has pouches clustered toward the front and sides, with the buckle sitting off-centre to one side of the front and a bare strap across the back.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Pockets_02.description: A slim ribbed belt worn at the hips, ringed with a row of small flap-covered pouches with recessed pocket fronts and a rectangular clasp at the centre front. Utilitarian, tactical look; the belt dips slightly at the front.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Pockets_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch flaps and outer pouch bodies; colour 1 on the banded belt strap, the clasp and the recessed pocket fronts.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Power_Cells_01.description: A slim belt band worn at the waist, ringed with upright cylindrical canisters with domed caps and ribbed bands, plus a square buckle box at the front with a round button. Suggests a sci-fi utility or power-cell rig.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Power_Cells_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the canister caps and the buckle face; colour 2 on the canister bodies and the buckle housing; colour 3 on the canister stripes and the round button.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Powersuit_01.description: A slim segmented hip belt of angular plates with a small shield-shaped panel at the front and a tapering pointed panel at the back, forming a minimal thong-like covering. Sci-fi powersuit styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Powersuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the lower centre of the front and back panels; colour 1 on the upper sides of the front and back panels.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A short, hip-slung armoured loincloth of stacked, chevron-shaped segmented plates that wrap around the hips, with a pointed V-shaped front panel and a rolled upper edge; open at the sides. Suggests alien or mechanical armour.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panel and the underside; colour 1 on the rolled upper rim and the banded plate ridges; colour 2 on the shaded plate creases.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Rave_01.description: A low-slung multi-strand belt of rectangular segmented blocks threaded on thin cords, with a small rectangular buckle at the front centre and extra looping strands draping down the wearer's left hip.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rectangular blocks; colour 0 on the cords and spacers between blocks; colour 1 on the front buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Rave_04.description: A wide, low-slung band belt sitting on the hips, with a flat solid top and two rows of round raised studs around the outside edge. Rave or club styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Rave_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the upper row of studs; colour 3 on the lower row of studs.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ravenswood_01.description: A pair of angular hip guards: rigid, faceted plates that hang from the hips down the outer thighs, with small rivets and slightly flared upper edges. A mechanical, armoured look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plates; colour 1 on the thin edge lines and seams along the panel borders.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A broken, open hip band made of two curved segments, one at each side of the hips. Each segment has a thick raised outer plate over a thin inner strip. It sits low on the hips and suggests a sci-fi utility look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick outer plates; colour 1 on the plate edges and the thin inner strips.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Rings_01.description: A low-slung, slim band belt sitting on the hips, made of layered strap bands with a raised rim on top. Heavy metal rings hang from small tabs around the front, sides and back, giving a utilitarian, fetish-punk look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Rings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper rim and outer band; colour 0 on the middle strap band; colour 2 on the inner band lines; colour 3 on the rings and their tabs.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Robotman_01.description: A slim, low-slung tech belt with a segmented band of striped panels and contrasting edging, carrying a bulky rounded holster pouch on the wearer's right hip. Suggests a sci-fi sidearm rig.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Robotman_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster pouch; colour 0 on the belt band panels; colour 3 on the stripes along the band; colour 2 on the belt edging and detail marks.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Rocker_01.description: Two thin belts slung crosswise and slanting low around the hips, each closed with a square buckle at the front and lined with a row of evenly spaced dots. Casual rocker-style accessory.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt bands; colour 3 on the dots along the bands; colour 2 on the buckles.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ruler_01.description: A wide, chunky championship-style belt worn at the waist, made of stacked horizontal bands with a large raised rectangular front plate embossed with a fist emblem. Faceted, slightly angular band edges give a sporty superhero look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Ruler_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main band and top; colour 2 on the thin stripes between bands; colour 0 on the front plate; colour 1 on the fist emblem.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Samurai__Large01.description: A samurai-style low-slung belt with a pointed front apron and stacked, layered lamellar plates hanging over each hip. Swirling embossed patterns and bordered edges suggest East Asian armour, worn as a partial hip guard.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Samurai__Large01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front apron and the belt band; colour 3 on the swirl patterns on the plates and apron; colour 0 on the plate borders; colour 1 on the plate backing and the rear side panel.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Samuraiplate_01.description: A low-slung samurai-style armour belt: a layered band of rounded contrasting cords with segmented, trimmed plates hanging as short hip guards at the sides, plus a small inner panel behind them. Sits on the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Samuraiplate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour plates; colour 1 on the trim lines and the inner panel; colour 2 on the cord belt band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Samuraiplate_01.differs: The plates on this version sit as two side hip guards that are angled slightly forward, with a visible gap at the front and back.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Santa_01.description: A wide, plain band belt with a smooth, slightly tapered shape sitting at the waist, closed at the front by a round buckle with a detailed emblem. The top edge shows a contrasting inner panel.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the buckle face and parts of the top edge; colour 2 on the flat panel along the top edge; colour 3 on small marks on the buckle.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Santa_01.differs: The female belt has a contrasting panel across the top edge and small accents on the buckle, while the male belt's top is a solid single-colour surface.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_01.description: A wide tribal waist band made of layered cloth wraps, with thick horizontal straps across the middle and rims stitched with cross-lacing at top and bottom. It sits at the waist and is open through the centre.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrapped band; colour 2 on the horizontal straps and rims; colour 1 on the stitching and lacing.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_01.differs: The female band is open at the top, so the ring shows the hollow centre, whereas the male version has a closed top panel.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_02.description: A wide, tapered tribal belt band worn low on the hips, built from stacked light bands separated by contrasting straps, with contrasting stitching along the edges and two round medal discs on the front.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide bands; colour 2 on the straps and edge binding; colour 1 on the stitching and the medal rims; colour 3 on the medal designs.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_02.differs: The female belt is open and dips lower in a tapered shape on the hips, with a hollow top, while the male belt has a closed patterned top.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_03.description: A wide tribal belt built from stacked horizontal bands with stitched lacing marks and a rim of small ties, worn around the waist and hips. A serrated blade-like knife hangs at one hip.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide bands; colour 2 on the bands and the top and bottom rims; colour 1 on the stitching, rim ties and the knife.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_03.differs: The female belt is a narrower, flatter band, and its knife hangs closer to the body and hangs shorter.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_04.description: A wide, layered tribal waist wrap of stacked banded coils with stitched edging, two round medallions on the front, and a serrated knife hanging at the left hip. Sits low on the waist.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the bands between them; colour 1 on the stitching, medallions and knife; colour 3 on the medallion markings.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_04.differs: The female knife is shorter and hangs close against the hip, while the belt sits lower and slimmer.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Secret_02.description: A wide, padded casual belt sitting at the hips, with a rolled inner edge, a large square front buckle with a hooked prong, and two short cross-straps on each side of the band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band; colour 1 on the inner lining and edge piping; colour 2 on the small strap dividers; colour 3 on the buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Secret_04.description: A slim, plain belt band that sits low on the hips, tilted slightly downward at the front, with a small rectangular open buckle at the centre front. Simple casual styling with a faceted edge.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 3 on the buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Shackle_01.description: A wide, rigid faceted band worn around the waist like a shackle cuff, with a square contrasting plate at the front and curved handle-like loops spaced around its outer surface. Mechanical, restraint-inspired look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Shackle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the curved loops; colour 2 on the front plate.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Shaman_Sovereign_01.description: A wide cloth sash wrapped around the hips with striped bands, carrying a shrunken severed head with long hair hanging at one hip and two small voodoo dolls dangling at the other. Macabre tribal style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Shaman_Sovereign_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sash; colour 2 on the sash stripes, doll limbs and hair; colour 1 on the shrunken head and doll bodies; colour 3 on the doll chests and head markings.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A wide band belt at the hips with a small knotted front tab and two round studs at the back, hung with layered, jagged fin-shaped panels that flare over the hips and upper thighs like a short skirt.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and tab; colour 2 on the upper layer of panels; colour 1 on the lower jagged fin panels; colour 3 on the accent strips on the panel tips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Sharkfin_01.differs: The female belt has a knotted, wrapped tab at the front and sits slightly lower with a softer, wider band.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Skull_01.description: A low-slung band belt worn at the hips, with a large skull buckle at the front bearing small side spikes and a hanging octagonal flap below. A matching ring-shaped flap hangs at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt band; colour 0 on the skull and its side spikes; colour 2 on the stripes across the skull; colour 3 on the eyes and the hanging octagonal flaps.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Skull_01_1.description: A slim low-slung waistband with a large front skull buckle that has small side spikes and a hanging octagonal drop below it. A matching octagonal ring hangs at the back. Gothic, monstrous styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Skull_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waistband; colour 0 on the skull and its spikes; colour 3 on the skull eyes and the hanging octagonal pieces front and back; colour 2 on the grooves and lines of the skull.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Skull_Belt_01.description: A slim, plain band belt sitting low on the hips, with a large sculpted skull buckle at the front centre. A second skull-shaped lump also shows at the back. Dips slightly at the front; gothic, monstrous styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Skull_Belt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets and teeth lines; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Skulls_01.description: A slim tribal waist belt made of a thin strap, with a row of skulls across the front and tied drawstring pouches hanging at the hips. Sits low on the waist with a fetish-like shaman look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Skulls_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skulls; colour 2 on the pouches; colour 3 on the thin belt strap and the pouch ties.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Skulls_01.differs: The female belt is only a thin cord-like strap, with no wide band around the waist.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Snake_01.description: A low-slung, briefs-like belt with a scaled band around the hips, a V-shaped front dipping into a pointed plated pouch of stacked ridged segments, and a contrasting rim along the top edge. Suggests serpent-themed armor.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled hip band; colour 1 on the segmented plates of the front and back pouch; colour 2 on the top rim and edge trim.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The female version has a shallower, narrower pouch that sits lower and looks more like a thong at the back.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A wide, slightly faceted band belt sitting low on the hips, with a raised rim top and bottom, stepped racing-stripe piping along the front and a triangular buckle emblem at the centre front.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the rim edges; colour 3 on the stripe piping and the triangle's inner centre; colour 1 on the triangular frame.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A sci-fi armoured belt: a wide segmented band with a pointed front plate, a knot-like centre bow, and upswept curved fins at the hips. A contrasting inner panel runs around the waist, edged with a raised rim.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edging, the hip fins and the bow's centre; colour 1 on the pointed front plate, the bow wings and the outer plates; colour 2 on the band panel; colour 3 on the thin accent stripes.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The female belt has a longer pointed front plate that hangs lower over the hips, with a rounder knot at the centre.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A sci-fi utility belt made of two stacked bands: a wide upper cummerbund-like band and a lower hip band with small slots. Boxy pouches and a round contrasting buckle sit at the front, with a small cylinder at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bands and pouches; colour 1 on the upper band's panels and pouch caps; colour 2 on the back strip, front buckle and cylinder ends; colour 3 on the small clips and brackets.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_02.description: A wide, sci-fi utility belt with a segmented band of small slots, a large round contrasting buckle at the front, and small pouches and cylindrical canisters spaced around the hips. Sits low on the waist.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band and pouches; colour 2 on the round front buckle and the inner belt lining; colour 1 on the side pouch caps and canister ends; colour 3 on small accent tabs at the sides.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_01.description: Two pairs of curved, tapering horn-like spikes that jut outward and upward from the hips, one pair on each side, with a rimmed base at each root. A monstrous, decorative belt accessory.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the rimmed bases.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Spikesandskulls_01.description: A wide, tribal waist belt with a striped band, a ring at the front, and a row of skulls around the hips. Curved tusk-like horns with pointed tips flare out from the sides and a few sit at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Spikesandskulls_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main belt band and front ring; colour 3 on the stripes in the band; colour 2 on the skulls; colour 0 on the horns.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Spikesandskulls_01.differs: The female belt sits slightly higher and curves closer to the hips, with the horns swept more outward and upward at the sides.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Steampunk_Cowboy_01.description: A padded belt band sits at the waist with a large square buckle and a keeper loop. A second strap runs diagonally down over one hip and thigh, forming a loose gunslinger-style drop loop. Both straps have eyelet holes.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Steampunk_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and diagonal strap; colour 1 on the keeper loops; colour 2 on the buckle; colour 3 on the eyelets.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Steampunk_Cowboy_02.description: A wide, padded belt sitting low on the hips with a large square buckle at the front, a keeper strap beside it, and round eyelets along the band. Western-flavoured with a mechanical steampunk feel.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Steampunk_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the keeper strap; colour 2 on the buckle; colour 3 on the eyelets.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_.description: A low-slung metal belt whose front is shaped like a spread-winged hawk with angular feather tips, and a slim banded strip circling the hips. Small feather-like spikes hang down at the back. Suggests a sleek, mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hawk and the belt band; colour 2 on the stripe along the band; colour 1 on the lower band edge; the thin top rim also takes colour 0.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Stlcommando_01.description: A small downward-pointing triangular plate that hangs over the groin and lower hips like a tapered tasset, with three chevron grooves across its face. It suggests a mechanical or armoured commando look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Stlcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 2 on the chevron grooves across the front.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Straight_01.description: A slim, plain flat band belt that sits low on the hips, dipping in a gentle curve at the front and running straight around the back. It has no visible buckle or details, giving a simple superhero look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Straight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole belt band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Straight_01.differs: The female belt is a plain band with no round studs, whereas the male version has two round discs at the front and two at the back.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Straight_Thick_01.description: A wide, plain low-slung belt band with faceted, angular edges, sitting on the hips. Two oval discs sit side by side at the front and two more at the back, giving a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Straight_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the oval discs at the front and back.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Straight_Thick_03.description: A thick utility belt worn at the hips, with a row of flapped pockets spaced around the front and sides, a square buckle plate at the centre, and a plain wide band across the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Straight_Thick_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pocket flaps and belt band; colour 1 on the square centre plate; colour 2 on the belt strap between the pockets; colour 3 on the small emblem marks on the pocket flaps.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A slim, low-slung belt band made of a faceted ring with a raised rim and a broad centre stripe, crossed by several vertical strap plates and a larger square buckle plate at the front. Sits on the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide centre stripe; colour 1 on the upper and lower rim edges; colour 3 on the buckle plate and the vertical straps.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Subligar_Ancientarmo.description: A brief armoured loincloth-style hip piece: a ribbed band circles the waist, with a curved front plate, chunky rounded hip guards and two separate rear flaps, all carved with spiral patterns in an ancient style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Subligar_Ancientarmo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and hip guards; colour 1 on the carved spiral lines; colour 2 on the worn edges and shading; colour 3 on the ribbed waist band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Subligar_Ancientarmo.differs: The female version has a narrower front plate, bulkier separate hip guards, and two split rear flaps instead of one joined back panel.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Subligarbasic_01.description: A plain, close-fitting brief-style bottom with a high-cut leg opening and a low front dip. It sits on the hips as a simple smooth underlayer, suited to a superhero or athletic look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Subligarbasic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole brief; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Takofanes_01.description: A low-slung segmented belt band studded with contrasting spikes, with a pointed armored front plate and a long tapering codpiece-like front and back flap. Beast-like, mechanical armor styling sits at the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Takofanes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt segments and the front and back plates; colour 1 on the inner strip and the edges of the flaps; colour 2 on the spikes and the plate recess.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Tattered_01.description: A tattered belt skirt: a rolled waistband over a short ragged front, with a long panel hanging behind and at the sides to the ankles. The hem is torn into jagged strips and the cloth fades toward the bottom.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rolled waistband and the lower part of the skirt; colour 0 on the upper skirt and the ragged upper edge.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Tattered_01.differs: The female version is cut higher and shorter at the front hip, so the long panel sits mostly at the back and sides.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Tattered_02.description: A long tattered skirt-like belt panel hanging from a banded waistband with a diamond emblem at the front. Ragged jagged hem falls to the shins, with a large bat-wing shaped cutout patch on front and back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Tattered_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper skirt and waistband edging; colour 1 on the waistband stripe and the lower fade of the skirt; colour 2 on the bat-wing patches and waistband band; colour 3 on the emblem and the patch outlines.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Tattered_02.differs: The female skirt is open and flared with a longer, more pointed hem that reaches lower, while the male version is cut shorter.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_01.description: A thin flat band belt worn low on the hips, with a small crumpled front plate bristling with sharp contrasting fang-like spikes of varied height. Monstrous, armoured accent piece.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the front plate; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_02.description: A short segmented plate skirt of layered horizontal bands with rivets and edged trim, open at the front. A clawed, toothy monstrous buckle with contrasting spikes sits at the centre of the waist.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armour plates; colour 1 on the edge trim and piping; colour 3 on the central buckle; colour 2 on the spikes.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_02.differs: The female skirt has a shorter, more tapered front opening with the side plates swept back, while the male has a wider gap showing more of the crotch.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Triple_01.description: Three stacked, separate wide straps wrapped around the waist like a corset, each with a front buckle, a keeper loop and a row of hexagonal studs; the bands are slightly angular and worn snug over the midriff.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Triple_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the keeper loops; colour 2 on the buckle frames; colour 3 on the studs.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.description: A thick, padded ring-shaped belt worn low on the hips, with a rounded bulbous buckle at the front and small strap loops beside it. Its patchwork panels give it a casual anime-inspired street look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light belt segments; colour 1 on the front buckle, strap loops and some panels; colour 2 on the panels; colour 3 on small accent patches near the back and side.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.differs: The female belt is thicker and puffier, sits lower on the hips, and has a bulkier knotted front with a sagging rounded buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Utility_01.description: A utility belt with a wide strap, a large round buckle with a central lens-like dome and side plates, and boxy pouches with metal-edged flaps at the hips and back. Sits at the waist in a tactical superhero style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Utility_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt strap and pouch bodies; colour 0 on the buckle housing and pouch edge plates; colour 3 on the buckle side panels and small lights; colour 2 on the central dome.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_V_01.description: A thin, low-slung band that sits on the hips and dips into a shallow V at the front, with a small triangular patch at the point. The band is flat and plain, and it curves around the back at a slight angle.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_V_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the small triangular patch at the front point of the V.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vibroman_01.description: A low-slung belt made of chunky rectangular plates spaced around the hips, joined by a thin band, with a larger square buckle plate at the centre front. Suggests a mechanical, armoured utility look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vibroman_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the segmented side and back plates; colour 1 on the central buckle plate; colour 0 on the thin connecting band and inner edging.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Victory_01.description: A belt of thin, ribbon-like bands forming V-shaped swooping loops around the hips, dipping to a point at the front and back, with open gaps between the strips. Sleek, angular superhero styling.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the bands and the central V; colour 1 on the long outer strips; colour 3 on one front strip end; colour 2 on the strip tips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Victory_01.differs: The female version has a multicolour pattern with blue, contrasting and contrasting accents across the bands, and the loops are more open and sit lower at the hips.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: A slim band-style belt sitting low on the hips, with a broad striped outer face edged by thin contrasting rims top and bottom. Simple, patriotic superhero look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide band face; colour 3 on the vertical stripes; colour 1 on the rims and inner lining.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_02.description: A double-banded belt with a tilted second band that droops diagonally below the main waist band, both with contrasting strap slots, and a boxy central buckle. Sits at the waist and hips in a superhero vigilante style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of both bands; colour 1 on the edging and inner lining; colour 2 on the small strap bars; colour 3 on the front buckle.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_02.differs: The lower band tilts more steeply on the female version, dipping lower across the front of the hips.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A slim segmented waist band with a central pointed, rounded armored buckle plate bearing a small round eye-like stud, plus a large angular fin-shaped guard flaring out over each hip. Suggests an alien or mechanical creature-armor look.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the centre buckle plate and hip fins; colour 3 on the thin lines and piping along the band and fins; colour 2 on the inner lining of the band.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vine_01.description: A low-slung hip band of twisting organic vines with swirling carved patterns, curling thorn-like hooks along the top edge and a pointed front panel that drops into a fringe of clawed tendrils at the crotch.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine band and swirl bands; colour 0 on the central front panel and swirl highlights; colour 3 on the curled thorn tips and dangling tendril points.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Viper_01.description: A tactical utility belt of layered banded strips worn low on the hips, with a large drop-leg gun holster on one hip, a sheathed knife on the other, and small pouches spaced across the front and back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded belt strips; colour 1 on the holster, pouches and knife sheath; colour 3 on the knife handle and small pouch details.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Viperlogo_01.description: A slim low-slung belt band that dips into a V at the front, with a snake-head buckle plate hanging over the groin, showing fangs and eye slits. Reads as a sleek, villainous serpent-themed accessory.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snake-head buckle plate; colour 1 on the fangs and eye markings; colour 2 on the belt band.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Viperlogo_01.differs: The female belt is a thin band that sits low on the hips and dips in a V, with a thin strap over the front, while the male one is a wide straight band at the waist.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wedding_Ribbedv_01.description: A low-slung, briefs-style waistband that dips into a deep V at the front and sits high on the hips at the back, with parallel ribbed stripes following the V and a thin trailing edge at the rear.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wedding_Ribbedv_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ribbed band; colour 1 on the stripes and top rim; colour 2 on the thin rear edge.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wedding_Ribbedv_01.differs: The female belt dips lower into a deeper V at the front, sits lower on the hips, and has a thin strip trailing down the back.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A low-slung, brief-shaped belt with a V-shaped front panel, a band of interlocking key-pattern scrollwork around the hips, a circular emblem at the centre and thin strings trailing at the back.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel and band; colour 2 on the scrollwork, outline and emblem lines; colour 1 and colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wizards_02.description: A low-slung wide belt with a V-shaped front dip, swirling engraved patterning and a central oval gem. A flat pouch hangs at one hip, and a round flask and two tube vials hang at the other hip. Fantasy wizard style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wizards_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and pouch; colour 2 on the swirl patterns and edge trim; colour 3 on the central gem and the lower halves of the vials; colour 1 on the upper halves of the flasks, vial tops and stoppers.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wizards_02.differs: The female belt has its vials hung together at one side with the round flask nearest the front, and a shallower V dip in the front.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wrappedtight_01.description: A wide, soft cloth wrap band sitting low on the hips, with slightly rumpled folds, a dipped front edge and small loose corners at the top. It is patterned with leaf motifs and a central glyph, in a casual East Asian style.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wrappedtight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base cloth of the band; colour 1 on the leaf pattern; colour 2 on the central glyph mark.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wrappedtight_01.differs: The female wrap dips lower at the front and is shaped to sit lower on the hips.

Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wrestling_01.description: A wide championship belt with a broad strap and a large ornate front plate showing two clenched fists and a lettered banner, plus hexagonal medallion plates around the sides and back. Sits on the waist and hips.
Female/F_Belt_Tight_Wrestling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide strap; the front plate, fists and medallions use a metallic default material that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Belt_Toy_01.description: A wide, segmented belt sitting at the waist, made of alternating flat panels with raised loops at intervals and a squared front buckle plate carrying a heart-shaped inset and small round studs. Toy-like, playful styling.
Female/F_Belt_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heart inset and some of the belt panels; colour 1 on the loops and straps around the belt; colour 2 on the buckle plate and the remaining belt segments; colour 3 on the small round studs on the buckle.

Female/F_Belt_Traveler_01.description: A casual double-layered belt worn low and tilted on the hips: a wide strap with a buckle lies over a second strap knotted through a ring, with a long tail hanging down the front.
Female/F_Belt_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knotted outer strap and its hanging tail; colour 1 on the underlying buckled belt; colour 3 on the buckle and ring; colour 2 on the edge outlines.

Female/F_Belt_Trooper_01.description: A wide, chunky band belt with stacked ridged tiers and a faceted, angular shield-shaped buckle at the front, with a small tab peeking out at the back. Sits at the waist in a sentai-hero style.
Female/F_Belt_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the front buckle and the small rear tab; colour 2 on the recess inside the buckle.
Female/F_Belt_Trooper_01.differs: The buckle is slightly smaller and the belt band sits a little higher and narrower at the waist.

Female/F_Belt_Trumpknight_01.description: A low-slung belt made of chunky angular blocks linked around the hips, with a larger rectangular plate at the front and smaller angular pods at the sides and back. It has a mechanical, armoured look.
Female/F_Belt_Trumpknight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular blocks and side pods; colour 1 on the base band and the frame around the plates; colour 3 on the rectangular front and back plates and small side accents; colour 2 on the recesses and shadowed inserts.
Female/F_Belt_Trumpknight_01.differs: The female belt is built from chunky angular armour blocks with contrasting plates and has no playing-card suit symbols, unlike the male's slim band of suit tiles.

Female/F_Belt_Warrior_01.description: A tribal warrior belt: a wide, padded waistband wrapped in criss-crossing zigzag bands, with a stacked diamond ornament at the front and a long narrow tassel-like panel hanging between the legs, patterned with chevrons and ending in a ribbed pointed tip.
Female/F_Belt_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband base and the panel backing; colour 1 on the zigzag wraps and the ribbed tip; colour 3 on the diamond ornament and the chevron panel; colour 2 on the diamond centres and the panel edging.

Female/F_Belt_Warrior_02.description: A wide, padded belt with a textured, scaly-looking band and a contrasting inner lining. A narrow striped strip hangs from the front and ends in a three-pronged metal tip; a matching tip trails at the back. Sits at the hips.
Female/F_Belt_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly belt band; colour 2 on the edging and inner lining; colour 1 on the striped front strip; colour 0 on the three-pronged metal tips.

Female/F_Bike_Rocket_01.description: A sci-fi hover-bike attachment: a long, tapering nose fuselage with a sleek central stripe, wide rocket pods with vented grilles on both sides, and small landing struts underneath. It sits under and around the rider as a vehicle.
Female/F_Bike_Rocket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hull panels; colour 1 on the central stripe and trim; colour 2 on the pod housings and underside; colour 3 on the vented grilles of the rocket pods.

Female/F_Bike_Rocket_02.description: A long sci-fi hover-bike body with a pointed nose, a raised rear housing of vented rocket exhausts, and twin angled side pods on swept struts; the rider sits on top and the whole vehicle extends well in front of and behind the body.
Female/F_Bike_Rocket_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hull panels and pods; colour 2 on the engine housings, struts and undercarriage; colour 1 on the stripe and marking panels; colour 3 on the rear vent grilles.

Female/F_Broom_01.description: A witch-style broom held at hip height: a long thin straight handle ending in a fanned bundle of bristles, bound at the neck by a narrow band. It sits horizontally beside the body, suggesting a fantasy or folk look.
Female/F_Broom_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle; colour 3 on the binding band at the bristle neck; colour 0 on the lighter bristle tips; colour 2 on the darker upper bristles.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Aggressive_01.description: A pair of thin, angular eyebrows that slant sharply downward toward the nose, giving a fierce scowling expression. They sit flat on the brow ridge above the eyes, with a slight upward flick at the outer ends.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Aggressive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both eyebrows; the other colour slots are not visibly used.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Basic_01_A.description: A pair of thin, slightly arched eyebrows in a flat, tapered shape that sits just above the eyes and sweeps outward, with a natural, understated look suited to any style.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A pair of sculpted, wing-like brow ridges that sweep up and outward above the eyes, each with several layered feather-like or fin-like spikes. A fantasy dragon or beast look worn on the brow line.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner brow ridges and most of each swept shape; colour 1 on the outer tips of the spikes.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A pair of swept-back, finned brow crests that curve up and outward from above each eye, with layered feather-like ridges along the outer edge. They sit along the brow line and suggest a dragon-like beast look.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower, inner part of each crest; colour 1 on the upper ridged tips and outer fin edges.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Ice_01.description: A pair of jagged ice-crystal brow ornaments, one over each eye, with branching antler-like shards that sweep upward and outward to tall points at the temples. Sits on the brow line as a frosty fantasy adornment.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Ice_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crystal shards; the rest of the surface shows a frosty, mottled crystal texture that appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Ice_02.description: A pair of decorative brow pieces made of three swept, claw-like slashes each, curving from above the eyes and flicking upward and outward at the temples. They sit on the brow line and suggest icy or clawed, creature-like styling.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Ice_02.colourAreas: The default glossy, mottled metallic material ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slot visibly applies to the brow slashes.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Ice_03.description: A pair of jagged, crystalline ice-shard eyebrows: clusters of sharp spikes sweeping up and outward from the brow line, with long thin tips flaring toward the temples. Suggests a frosty, monstrous or elemental face.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Ice_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shards; the mottled surface texture on the front faces largely ignores the colour scheme, and no other slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_01.description: A pair of thick, heavy brow ridges that dip to a V at the centre and sweep outward, with jagged, tufted points along the top edges. Sits on the brow line for a bestial, monstrous look.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the brows; colour 0 on the lighter tufted tips and upper edges.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_Long.description: A brow piece of layered, jagged shards that forms a V across the forehead and sweeps up and outward over each eye like fur tufts. Sits on the brow ridge with a beastly, monstrous look.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_Long.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the shards; colour 0 on the central V and the highlighted shard edges; colour 2 on the under-layers between shards.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_Medium_01.description: A pair of bestial brow ridges made of layered, jagged tufts that sweep outward and upward from a low central dip above the eyes, giving a fierce, feral look.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_Medium_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the brow tufts; colour 0 on the highlighted inner ridge and tips near the centre.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Solid_01.description: A chunky, lumpy stone-like brow ridge that wraps across the forehead over the eyes and around to the temples, with a row of sharp crystal shards jutting upward from the top. Cracked, veined surface suggests a monstrous look.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Solid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rocky brow surface; colour 3 on the crack veins; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Solid_Malvan_01.description: A pair of sharp, swept-back blade-like brow ridges with a smaller secondary spike above each, sitting over the eyes and extending outward past the temples. Alien, monstrous styling with faceted, angular panels.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Solid_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade surfaces; colour 1 on the upper faceted panels and tips; colour 2 on the underside and facets; colour 3 on the inner patches visible from behind.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Solid_Malvan_01.differs: The female version has hard-edged faceted panels in a mixed colour pattern, while the male version has smooth gradient-shaded blades.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Spikeyswept_01.description: A pair of eyebrow pieces made of sharp, swept-back spikes that fan out and upward over each eye, forming jagged blade-like brows. They suggest a monstrous or mechanical fantasy look.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Spikeyswept_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the spikes; colour 0 on a few lighter spike tips and edges; colour 2 on the underside edge along the brow line.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Spikeyswept_01.differs: The female brows are coloured mostly with colour 1 and only pick out colour 0 on a few tips, whereas the male version is coloured entirely with colour 0.

Female/F_Brow_Face_Werewolf_Long_01.description: A pair of long, swept-back brow pieces made of layered, jagged fur-like tufts that rise over each eye and flare outward toward the temples, giving a feral werewolf look.
