Female/F_Brow_Face_Werewolf_Long_01.colourAreas: The default material appears glowing and translucent and mostly ignores the scheme; the whole piece shows a single fiery tone across the tufts.
Female/F_Brow_Face_Werewolf_Long_01.differs: The female version shows a translucent, glowing look that ignores the colour scheme, while the male version shows a solid two-tone colour gradient.

Female/F_Brow_Tight_Animatronic_01.description: A pair of angular mechanical brow plates forming a V shape, each a slim faceted bar sweeping up and outward from a small central hinge joint at the brow line. Suggests robotic or animatronic styling.
Female/F_Brow_Tight_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central hinge joint; colour 1 on the two long brow bars.

Female/F_Brow_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A rigid angular brow band with a zigzag W-shaped profile, dipping to a point over the nose bridge and rising toward the temples. Two stepped ridges run along its length, giving a heroic, masked look.
Female/F_Brow_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the lower ridge and edge trim.

Female/F_Brow_Tight_Robotexo_01.description: A pair of thick, angular brow plates that replace the eyebrows, each a flat slab with a kinked bend that angles down toward the nose. They give a stern, mechanical look to the face.
Female/F_Brow_Tight_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both brow plates; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01.description: A plain hanging cape of simulated cloth that drapes from the shoulders down the back to about the calves, flaring wider toward a slightly uneven hem with soft folds. It has no visible clasp or trim.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01.differs: The female cape ends around the calves and hangs narrower and straighter, while the male cape is wider and flares more.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Art_Deco.description: A knee-length hanging cape with a small contrasting collar piece at the neck, a V-shaped central panel and swept, pointed lower corners. Thin ribbed lines fan out across the panels in an art deco, feather-like pattern.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Art_Deco.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar piece at the neck; colour 2 on the main upper cape panels; colour 1 on the central V panel and the lower swept corners; colour 3 on the thin rib lines.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Art_Deco.differs: The female cape hangs narrower and more closely to the back, with a longer, more pointed drape to the lower corners.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Destroyer_Pla.description: A cape made of many long, narrow hanging strands that fan out from a small collar at the shoulders and taper into sharp pointed tips around thigh to knee length. It drapes loosely down the back and sides, giving a mystic, gothic look.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Destroyer_Pla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small collar piece at the neck; colour 1 on the upper and middle lengths of the strands; colour 2 and colour 3 on the pointed lower tips and edges of the strands.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Flames.description: A hanging cloth cape that falls from the shoulders to about the knees, with a small draped collar and horizontal bands divided by flame-shaped edges, ending in a jagged, tattered hem. Superhero style.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Flames.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar area at the neck; colour 1 on the upper band; colour 2 on the middle flame band; colour 3 on the lower flame band at the hem.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Flaps.description: A back-mounted cape split into two hanging halves, built from stacked rows of pointed feather-like flaps that fan out toward the hem. It falls from the shoulders to about the knees, with a jagged zigzag lower edge.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Flaps.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper row of flaps at the shoulders; colour 2 on the middle row of flaps; colour 3 on the lower row of flaps and jagged hem; colour 0 on the thin edging at the neckline and centre seam.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Hanging_Tatte.description: A knee-length hanging cape draped from the shoulders down the back, wrapping slightly around one side. It falls in soft folds and ends in a ragged, tattered hem with torn strips.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Hanging_Tatte.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape body; colour 1 fades in over the lower cape and the torn hem.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Insect.description: A back-hung cape shaped like a pair of insect wings: two long, tapering panels with a vein-cell pattern, joined by a small collar-like patch at the neck and hanging to about knee level with pointed tips.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Insect.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck patch at the top; colour 1 on the wing panels; colour 2 on the lower wing panels and edges; colour 3 on the vein lines.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Insect.differs: The female wings hang narrower and closer together, leaving a slim gap down the centre of the back.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Lightning.description: A long hanging cape that drapes from the shoulders down past the knees, with a soft rounded top and a hem cut into jagged, lightning-bolt spikes edged in contrasting trim. It hangs straight down the back.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Lightning.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape body, fading toward colour 2 on the lower cape; colour 1 on the jagged edge trim along the sides and spiked hem.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Plated.description: A shoulder-mounted cape that hangs down the back to about the knees, with a small collar-like yoke at the neck and a solid upper section. The lower half splits into long, pointed feather-like slats, giving a jagged, winged hem.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_01_Plated.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small yoke at the neck; colour 1 on the upper cape body; colour 2 on the lower slatted feather section and the vertical slits.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Ascendant_01.description: A hanging cloth cape with a soft draped hood-like collar at the neck, falling straight down the back to about the knees. Layered angular chevron panels decorate it, and the hem has a jagged, pointed edge with contrasting trim.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body and collar; colour 1 on the border trim along the edges and hem; colour 2 on the chevron panels; colour 3 on the inner chevron panels.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01.description: A plain, simple cloth cape hanging from the upper back and shoulders, with soft gathered folds at the neckline and a wide, slightly flared drape that falls to about the calves, ending in an uneven hem.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole outer cape; the inner lining shows a slightly different shade from the same slot.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01.differs: The female cape is narrower and flared, with a slightly longer, more uneven hem; the male cape hangs as a broader, squarer drape.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01_Tattere.description: A cape of draped cloth hanging from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with soft folds and a ragged, torn lower hem. It gives a tattered, weathered superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01_Tattere.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape; colour 1 on the lower cape, fading in as a gradient toward the torn hem.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Art_Deco_0.description: A knee-length cape hanging from a small pointed collar at the upper back, with broad outer panels, a central spine panel and radiating seam lines, ending in a split, pointed fishtail hem.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Art_Deco_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small collar piece at the neck; colour 2 on the broad outer panels; colour 1 on the central spine panel and lower fishtail; colour 3 on the radiating seam lines.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Art_Deco_0.differs: The female cape is narrower and hangs closer to the body, with a more pronounced pointed fishtail at the hem.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Ascendant_.description: A knee-length cloth cape hanging from the shoulders, with a draped, gathered neckline and a jagged, zigzag hem. Contrasting edge trim and a stacked chevron-arrow motif run down the back. Suits a superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape cloth; colour 1 on the edge trim along the sides and hem; colour 2 on the upper and lower chevron shapes; colour 3 on the middle chevron.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Destroyer_.description: A cape made of long thin hanging strands that fan out from a small collar-like panel across the upper back, each strand ending in a sharp pointed blade tip; hangs to about the thigh or knee.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Destroyer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper back panel; colour 1 on the strands; colour 3 on the pointed tips and edge highlights; colour 2 on the darkened lower ends.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Feather_01.description: A back-mounted cape of layered feather-like strips hanging from the shoulders to about the thighs, gathered in soft folds at the top and ending in ragged, pointed feather tips with contrasting markings.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body and feather strips; colour 1 on the lower feather tips; colour 3 on the middle feather markings; colour 2 on the side feather markings.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flag_01.description: A plain, full-length cloth cape that hangs from the upper back in soft draped folds, widening slightly toward a slightly uneven hem near the ankles. A simple superhero cape with no visible trim.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape, outside and inner lining.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flames_01.description: A knee-length cloth cape hanging from the upper back, with a gathered draped top and horizontal bands of flame-shaped swirls. The hem ends in ragged, pointed flame tongues. Classic superhero styling.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flames_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered top section; colour 1 on the upper band; colour 2 on the middle band and flame shapes; colour 3 on the lower band.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flaps_01.description: A cape of two split flaps hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, with layered feather-like tiers ending in jagged, pointed hems. A small collar band sits at the neck.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flaps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck collar band; colour 1 on the upper tier of feathers; colour 2 on the middle tier; colour 3 on the lower tier and jagged tips.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Insect_01.description: A cape made of two long, translucent insect-wing panels that hang from a small collar at the neck to about the knees, tapering to pointed tips. A network of veins crosses each wing, and the two wings part down the centre of the back.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small collar at the neck; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 3 on the vein network; colour 2 on the wing edges and lower tips.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Insect_01.differs: The female wings hang narrower and closer to the body, and the collar is smaller.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Lightning_.description: A back-worn cloth cape hanging from the shoulder blades to about the knees, with a gathered draped top and a lower edge cut into long jagged lightning-bolt spikes; contrasting edging lines the outer points. Sits close behind the body.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Lightning_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered upper drape, fading toward colour 2 on the lower centre of the cape; colour 1 on the jagged outer edge panels.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Mini_01.description: A short cloth mini-cape hanging from the upper back with gathered draping folds at the top. It flares slightly and ends at the hips, giving a light superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Mini_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; the cloth is one uniform surface with no separate trim.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Mini_01.differs: The female cape sits lower on the back and hangs more narrowly, reaching about hip level, while the male cape starts higher across the shoulders.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Modern_Des.description: A simple hanging cape of soft draped cloth, attached across the upper back and falling straight down to about knee level with a slightly uneven, pointed hem. Plain, flowing superhero style.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Modern_Des.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape; colour 1 on the lower part of the cape, blending in a gradient toward the hem.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Modern_Des.differs: The female cape hangs narrower and hugs the back more closely, with a longer, more tapered drop.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Plated_01.description: A short back cape hanging from the upper back to about the knees, with a shaped collar panel, a broad main section slit with vertical gaps, and a lower band cut into long jagged tapering strips. Superhero style.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Plated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar panel at the neck; colour 1 on the main upper section of the cape; colour 2 on the lower band and the hanging strips.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Plated_01.differs: The female cape is narrower and hangs slightly shorter, with a smaller collar panel.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Poncho_01.description: A short back-mounted cape in the shape of a poncho panel: a flat, vertically striped cloth shield that hangs from the shoulders and tapers to a point around the upper thigh, with thin contrasting edge trim.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth; colour 1 and colour 2 on the thin vertical stripes; colour 3 on the edge trim.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Poncho_01.differs: The female cape hangs longer and narrower, tapering to a point lower down the thigh, with a closer, slimmer cut.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Retro_Dest.description: A plain, simple cloth cape hanging from the upper back to about knee level, with a straight top edge, gentle folds and a slightly ragged hem. It falls loosely behind the body in a classic superhero style.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Retro_Dest.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape, blending into colour 1 toward the hem; the fabric shows a smooth gradient between the two.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Scalloped_.description: A cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the calves, with soft draped folds at the neckline and a jagged, scalloped hem of pointed tips. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Scalloped_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders; colour 1 on the lower cape and scalloped points, blending from colour 0 above.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Scalloped_.differs: The female cape is a little narrower at the shoulders and hangs slightly longer and more tapered than the male one.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Torn_01.description: A torn cloth cape hanging from the upper back and shoulders in soft draped folds, reaching to about the knees, with a ragged, holed and shredded lower edge. Suggests a tattered, battle-worn look.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Torn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders, fading into colour 1 toward the ragged lower hem.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Cape_01.description: A plain, calf-length cape hanging straight from the shoulders, with soft cloth folds and a flared, slightly pointed hem. It drapes down the back and is gathered smoothly at the neck and shoulders, in a classic superhero style.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Cape_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Feather_01.description: A hanging cape of layered feather shapes that drapes from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with a ragged, pointed feathered hem and small arrow-like feather markings in rows.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape and feather bodies; colour 3 on the upper row of feather tips; colour 2 on the middle row of feather tips; colour 1 on the lowest feather tips.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_01.description: A small cloth banner-like cape that floats detached beside and above one shoulder, as if hung from an unseen pole. It is a tapered, pointed panel of loose folds with a ragged lower edge.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; no other slots visible.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_01.differs: The female panel hangs as a narrow, tall pennant with a single pointed top, while the male version has a wider flared side that juts out to one side.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_02.description: A single triangular cloth cape panel floating out from one shoulder like a flag on a pole, peaked at the top and tapering to a point below, with soft settled folds and a differently shaded inner face.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the cloth; colour 1 on the inner face of the cloth.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_02.differs: The panel is narrower and hangs more steeply, with a sharper fold ridge at the top.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Mini_01.description: A short mini-cape hanging from the shoulders down the back, a single smooth cloth panel that widens toward a flared hem around hip level, with soft folds and no visible fastenings.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Modern_Destroyer.description: A long cloth cape that hangs loosely from the shoulders down the back to about the calves, draped over one side of the front, with soft folds and a ragged, uneven hem. Suggests a modern supervillain look.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Modern_Destroyer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and shoulders; colour 1 blends in toward the lower hem as a gradient.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Pleated_01.description: A feathered wing-style cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with layered rows of long pointed feathers, a V-shaped notch at the top and ragged, fringed tips. Sits close to the back with a superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Pleated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper shoulder feathers; colour 2 on the middle feather rows; colour 1 on the long outer wing feathers; colour 0 on the lower fringed feathers.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Poncho_01.description: A short hanging cape shaped like a poncho panel, draped from the shoulders down the back and tapering to a point at hip level, with vertical stripes of cloth and a thin contrasting edge.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 1 and colour 2 on the vertical stripes; colour 3 on the outer edge trim.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Retro_Destroyer_.description: A plain, smooth cloth cape hanging straight from the shoulders down the back to about knee height, with a slightly flared, uneven hem and soft folds. It suggests a classic retro superhero or villain look.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Retro_Destroyer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders, blending into colour 1 toward the hem.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Scalloped_01.description: A long cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, with a small gathered collar at the neck and a hem cut into pointed scallops. It falls in soft folds.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Scalloped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the neck and shoulders, blending into colour 1 toward the scalloped lower hem.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Scalloped_01.differs: This cape hangs a little narrower and straighter, with a slightly shorter, less broad hem than the male version.

Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Torn_01.description: A tattered cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with a small gathered neckline and a ragged hem full of torn holes and frayed points. It gives a ruined, wind-worn look.
Female/F_Cape_Chestwear_Torn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders, fading into colour 1 across the lower torn portion and ragged edges.

Female/F_Cape_Geishabow_01.description: Two long, narrow flat cloth panels hanging side by side from the hips down the front of the thighs, like the trailing ends of a bow sash. Each has a curved contrasting inset and a wide cross band near the middle.
Female/F_Cape_Geishabow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel surfaces; colour 1 on the curved inset shapes along the panel edges; colour 2 on the wide cross bands across the middle of each panel.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01.description: A plain simulated-cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, with soft draped folds gathered at the top and a slightly flared, uneven hem. Suits jackets and superhero looks.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; the inner lining shows a slightly different shade of the same slot.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Art_Deco.description: A long back cape that hangs from the shoulders to about the knees, with a small collar-like yoke at the top. Layered panels end in pointed, swallowtail-like hems and fine radiating seams give it an art deco look.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Art_Deco.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the yoke at the neck and shoulders; colour 2 on the outer side panels; colour 1 on the central and lower panels; colour 3 on the thin radiating seam lines.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Destroyer_Player.description: A cape of long, narrow cloth strands hanging from a small triangular yoke at the lower back and waist. The strands taper to sharp pointed tips and fall to about knee level, giving a spiky, flowing, mystic look.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Destroyer_Player.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the triangular yoke at the top; colour 1 on the upper lengths of the strands; colour 2 on the pointed tips; colour 3 on the thin edge lines of the strands.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Flames.description: A back-mounted cloth cape that hangs from the shoulders to about the knees, with layered bands of flame-shaped tongues and a jagged, tattered hem. It drapes in soft folds behind the body, suiting a superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Flames.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top gathered band at the shoulders; colour 1 on the second band; colour 2 on the third band and the flame edging; colour 3 on the bottom band at the hem.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Flaps.description: A pair of long jagged-edged cape flaps hanging from the lower back of a jacket, split down the centre with a small collar-like fold at the top; stacked tiers of zigzag points give a tattered, bat-wing look that reaches below the knees.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Flaps.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small top fold at the waist; colour 1 on the upper tier of the flaps; colour 2 on the middle tier; colour 3 on the lower tier and hem points.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Insect.description: A back-mounted cape made of two long, narrow wing-like panels with pointed tips, split down the middle and joined by a small triangular collar patch at the neck. Veined, insect-wing pattern; reaches about knee to mid-calf.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Insect.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck patch; colour 1 on the wing panel surfaces; colour 2 on the darkened wing tips and edges; colour 3 on the vein network.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Lightning.description: A short cape worn low on the back from the upper back down to the knees, with gathered draping folds at the top and a jagged, lightning-bolt zigzag hem edged by a contrasting trim layer.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Lightning.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape body, fading toward colour 2 on the lower cape; colour 1 on the jagged edge trim along the sides and hem.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Plated.description: A back-mounted cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with a V-shaped upper panel, vertical seam lines, and a lower section cut into long tapering strips that end in ragged points. Superhero style.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Plated.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and neck yoke at the top; colour 1 on the main upper cape panel; colour 2 on the lower band and hanging strips.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Tattered.description: A plain, tapering cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with a ragged, tattered hem of jagged strips. Soft folds give a loose, flowing drape suited to a rugged superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_01_Tattered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape, fading into colour 1 toward the tattered lower hem.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Ascendant_01.description: A broad cloth cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with draped folds at the neckline, a jagged zigzag hem, and layered spear-shaped emblem panels down the centre back.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape cloth; colour 1 on the edge border and jagged hem trim; colour 2 on the central and outer spear-shaped panels; colour 3 on the inner spear-shaped panels.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Feather_01.description: A short cape hanging from the shoulders, gathered into soft drapes at the top and ending in a ragged hem of long pointed feather shapes, with feather-tip markings in rows down the lower half.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth; colour 3 on the upper feather tips; colour 2 on the middle feather tips; colour 1 on the lowest feather tips.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Flag_01.description: A plain, wide cloth cape hanging straight from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with soft gathered drapes at the top and a loose, slightly flared hem. Suits a superhero jacket look.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Flag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; a faint tint of colour 1 on the inner surface.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Mini_01.description: A short cloth mini-cape hanging from the upper back with soft gathered folds at the top edge, flaring slightly to a hip-length hem that is longer at the sides; a plain superhero back piece.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Mini_01.differs: The female cape hangs narrower and a little shorter, with a hem that slants up toward the front.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Mini_Modern_Destroy.description: A short cloth half-cape that hangs from the lower back to about hip or upper-thigh level. It is a flared, softly draped panel with vertical folds and a wide hem, and it sits low behind the waist.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Mini_Modern_Destroy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the cape; colour 1 fades in toward the lower hem. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Poncho_01.description: A short cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back, ending in a pointed V hem around hip level. Vertical stripe panels run down its length, giving a simple poncho-like drape for jackets.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body; colour 1 and colour 2 on the vertical stripes running down the cape; colour 3 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A plain, simple cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about ankle length, with a slightly flared, gently rippled hem and a smooth gradient of two tones. Suits a classic retro superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders; colour 1 on the lower cape and hem, blending as a gradient between them.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Scalloped_01.description: A long cloth cape hanging from the shoulders with a draped, cowl-like fold at the neckline and a jagged, scalloped hem reaching about the calves. Flowing superhero styling worn over a jacket.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Scalloped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and draped neckline; colour 1 on the lower cape and scalloped points, blending gradually from colour 0.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Scalloped_01.differs: The female cape hangs a little longer and narrower, with a more gathered neckline drape sitting lower on the back.

Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Torn_01.description: A tattered cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with draped folds at the neckline and a ragged hem full of torn holes. Suits worn jackets and a post-battle look.
Female/F_Cape_Jacket_Torn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and shoulder drapes; colour 1 on the lower torn portion and ragged hem, fading in from the top.

Female/F_Cape_Moth_01.description: A pair of long, narrow insect-style wings hanging separately from the upper back to about the knees, with veined translucent membranes, rounded tips and darker banded ends. Fantastical and organic look, worn like a split cape.
Female/F_Cape_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wing membranes; colour 1 on the rounded wing tips and fine veins; colour 2 on the bands at the tips; colour 3 on the upper wing roots.

Female/F_Cape_Redstone_01.description: A single narrow rectangular cloth panel hanging straight down the back from the lower back to below the hips, with soft draped folds and rounded corners, like a scarf tail worn at the back.
Female/F_Cape_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel.
Female/F_Cape_Redstone_01.differs: The female panel hangs centred and flat down the lower back and hips, while the male panel is offset to one side and starts at the shoulder.

Female/F_Cape_Redstone_02.description: A long, narrow strip of draped cloth hanging straight down the back from the waist area, with soft vertical folds, reaching to about the ankles. It sits centred behind the legs like a long scarf tail.
Female/F_Cape_Redstone_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole draped cloth strip.
Female/F_Cape_Redstone_02.differs: The female version hangs centred down the back and front of the hips, while the male version is a wider piece hung from one shoulder down one side.

Female/F_Cape_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down to about the shins, with a slightly flared hem. A large teardrop-shaped panel runs down the back with a jagged band across its upper part and a narrow vertical strip below. Ancient-Egyptian sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Cape_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body; colour 1 on the large teardrop panel; colour 2 on the jagged band across the panel; colour 3 on the narrow vertical strip.
Female/F_Cape_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The female cape is narrower and hangs straighter, with a less flared hem, and reaches slightly lower on the legs.

Female/F_Cape_Tied_Rope_01.description: Three vertical strings of teardrop-shaped beads floating in a row above the head, each a chain of four or three stacked drops shrinking toward the ends. Ornamental and ritual in feel, not attached to the body.
Female/F_Cape_Tied_Rope_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top drop of the centre string; colour 1 on the upper drops of each string; colour 2 on the middle drops; colour 3 on the lowest drops.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01.description: A plain cloth cape hanging from gathered draped folds across the upper back, falling in a slightly flared, tapering shape to about ankle length behind the legs. Simple superhero style.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Anniversary.description: A long, plain cloth cape hanging straight from the shoulders to about the knees, with a large oval emblem on the back, a pentagon-shaped banner panel across the middle and a narrow vertical strip below. Superhero style with soft draping folds.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth and small round spots at the edges; colour 1 on the large oval; colour 2 on the pentagon panel; colour 3 on the vertical strip.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Art_Deco.description: A long, narrow cape hanging from the shoulders to about the calves, with a draped collar at the neck, a central chevron-patterned panel and a split, pointed feather-like hem. Art deco superhero styling.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Art_Deco.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped collar; colour 2 on the main cape body; colour 1 on the central panel and the lower hem sections; colour 3 on the thin radiating lines.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Destroyer_Player.description: A cape made of long, narrow hanging strands that end in sharp pointed tips, attached by a small triangular panel at the lower back. It hangs to about knee level and gives a mystic, claw-like silhouette.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Destroyer_Player.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small upper panel at the back; colour 1 on the long strands; colour 2 on the darkened pointed tips; colour 3 on the thin edge lines of the tips.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Flames.description: A cloth cape hanging from the upper back to about the knees, with a draped gathered top and layered flame-shaped bands that end in a jagged, tattered flame-like hem. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Flames.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped top section; colour 1 on the upper band with flame edges; colour 2 on the middle flame band; colour 3 on the lower flame band and hem.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Flaps.description: A tight-fitting back cape made of long vertical flaps in three stacked tiers with jagged, feather-like points along each tier edge. It hangs from a small collar-like top at the upper back down to about the knees, split down the centre.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Flaps.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top collar piece; colour 1 on the upper tier of flaps; colour 2 on the middle tier; colour 3 on the lower tier and its jagged tips.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Insect.description: A close-hanging cape shaped like two long insect wings, joined at a small collar panel at the upper back and splitting into two tapering, pointed panels that reach to about knee level. Both panels carry a network of vein-like ridges.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Insect.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper collar panel; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 2 on the darker lower wing areas and edges; colour 3 on the vein pattern.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Lightning.description: A tight-fitting cape hanging from the upper back to about the knees, with draped folds at the top and a jagged lightning-bolt hem edged in contrasting trim. It falls straight behind the body with a sleek profile.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Lightning.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper draped part of the cape, fading toward colour 2 lower down; colour 1 on the jagged edge trim along the sides and hem.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Plated.description: A tight-hanging back cape with a draped upper collar panel, vertical plated bands down the body and a chevron-shaped lower section split into long ragged strips. It hangs from the shoulders to about the knees, in a superhero style.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Plated.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped upper collar panel; colour 1 on the main cape body; colour 2 on the vertical plate bands and the split lower strips.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Tattered.description: A plain cloth cape that hangs straight from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, with a raggedly torn, tattered lower hem and a soft draped fall. Suggests a heroic or post-apocalyptic look.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Tattered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape; colour 1 on the tattered lower hem, blending in as a gradient.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Torn.description: A torn, tattered cloth cape hanging from the shoulders with draped folds at the top, falling to about knee length with ragged holes and a shredded, jagged hem. Suits a battered superhero or post-apocalyptic look.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Torn.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and draped folds; colour 1 on the lower cape, fading in toward the ragged hem.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Webbed.description: A tight, spiderweb-patterned cape of thin cobweb strands with arched, scalloped ribs, hanging from the upper back to about the knees or calves and open in the gaps, with a ragged, pointed lower edge.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Webbed.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the web strands; the rest of the piece is see-through and takes no colour.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_01_Webbed.differs: The female cape hangs from a narrower shoulder line and is worn tighter to the back and hips, ending slightly shorter.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A short, flat cape hanging from the shoulders over the upper back to about hip level, made of layered cloth panels with a large central panel, side panels and contrasting trim edges. Retro superhero styling.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the large central back panel; colour 1 on the upper and lower side panels; colour 0 on the edge trim and shoulder folds.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The female cape is shorter and narrower, ending around hip level, and lacks the emblem cut-out seen on the male's back.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A tight, narrow cloth cape hanging straight down the back from the shoulders to about the knees, with a draped gathered top, a zigzag pointed hem and layered arrowhead-shaped panels down the centre.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape cloth; colour 1 on the edge trim and zigzag hem; colour 2 on the central arrowhead panels; colour 3 on the inner arrowhead panels.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Bow_01.description: A pair of narrow, tapering cloth tails hanging side by side from the lower back to about mid-thigh, each with a wide contrasting band across the middle and a small oval fastener near the tip. Suggests a sleek superhero cape accessory.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tail panels and oval tips; colour 1 on the curved side panels; colour 2 on the wide middle bands.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A plain, smooth cloth cape hanging straight from the upper back in one wide panel that tapers slightly and flares at the hem, ending around the calves. Simple superhero styling with no visible trim or fastenings.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Feather_01.description: A short cloth cape with draped folds at the shoulders and a hem cut into long feather-like tapering points, hanging from the upper back to about thigh level. Feather tips carry contrasting markings, giving a tribal, winged look.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth and feather bodies; colour 3 on the upper row of feather tip markings; colour 2 on the middle row of feather tips; colour 1 on the lowest feather tips.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Flag_01.description: A wide, plain cloth cape hanging straight down the back from the upper shoulders, with draped folds gathered across the top and a flared hem that reaches just above the ankles. Simple, classic superhero styling.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Flag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.description: A short, tight cloth cape hanging from the shoulder blades to about the waist, with a ruffled, gathered upper edge and a broad horizontal band across the lower half. Wraps slightly around the sides of the torso.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered upper edge and the sides; colour 1 on the upper centre panel; colour 2 on the wide lower band.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_01.description: A plain, simple cape that hangs from the shoulders down the back to about the calves, with soft draped folds at the neckline and a slightly flared hem. It gives a classic wrestler or superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the cape; colour 1 on the inner lining, seen at the edges.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_01_Tattered.description: A narrow cloth cape hanging straight down the back from the shoulders to about the knees, with soft vertical folds and a ragged, torn lower edge. Suits a luchador or wrestler look.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_01_Tattered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape; the cloth gradually blends to colour 1 toward the tattered hem.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_Ascendant_01.description: A knee-to-calf length cloth cape hanging from the shoulders, with draped folds at the neckline, a jagged pointed hem and a bold arrowhead-style pattern of stacked pointed panels down the back, in a luchador-inspired superhero style.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body; colour 1 on the edge trim and jagged hem border; colour 2 on the central and outer arrow-shaped panels; colour 3 on the inner arrow-shaped panels.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_Feather_01.description: A short draped cape hanging from the upper back to about the knees, with gathered folds at the top and a ragged lower edge of layered feather-like tips in staggered rows. Tribal, luchador-style.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape cloth and feather bodies; colour 3 on the upper feather tip markings; colour 2 on the middle-lower feather tips; colour 1 on the bottom feather tips.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_Flag_01.description: A plain cloth cape that hangs straight down the back from the shoulders to about the calves, with soft gathered folds at the top and a slightly uneven hem. Simple, flowing, and suited to a wrestler or superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_Flag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape, with a small patch of colour 1 or 2 visible only on the back surface near the hem.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_Poncho_01.description: A short, flat cloth back cape in the style of a luchador poncho, hanging from the shoulders down the back to a pointed hem at hip level. It has vertical stripes and a thin edge trim.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Lucador_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body; colour 1 and colour 2 on the vertical stripes; colour 3 on the thin edge trim.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Mini_01.description: A short cloth mini-cape hanging from the upper back, with gathered folds across the top and a flared, slightly uneven hem ending around the hips. It hangs loose behind the arms in a simple superhero style.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Mini_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the cape; colour 1 on the inner lining seen from behind.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Mini_01.differs: The female cape is narrower and hangs straighter, with a more pointed, uneven hem at one side.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A plain, simple cloth cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, draping in soft folds with a slightly ragged, pointed hem. It falls straight down the back, with the neckline dipping low between the shoulder blades.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape; colour 1 on the lower cape, blending in as a gradient toward the hem.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A tight, back-mounted cape hanging from the shoulder blades to about the knees, with a short contrasting upper section, a central tie-like strip, and tiered, jagged, pointed panels layered down to a ragged hem.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long layered lower panels; colour 2 on the upper shoulder section and the central strip.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Poncho_01.description: A short, tight cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back, tapering to a pointed tip at the hips. Vertical stripes give it a pinstriped, panelled look with a slim, close-hanging silhouette.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body; colour 1 and colour 2 on the vertical stripes; colour 3 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A plain, simple cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the calves, with a softly flaring hem and gentle cloth folds. It has a retro superhero look and no visible fastenings.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape, blending smoothly into colour 1 at the lower hem.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Scalloped_01.description: A cloth cape hanging from the upper back with gathered drapery folds at the shoulders. It falls straight to about knee length and ends in a jagged, scalloped hem. Suits a superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Scalloped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and shoulder drape; colour 1 on the lower cape and scalloped points, blending in a gradient.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_01.description: A short, single cloth panel cape that hangs from the shoulder down one side of the back to about hip or upper-thigh level, tapering to a narrow top with soft rippled folds and a slightly flared hem.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_01.differs: The female cape is narrower and tapers to a sharper point at the top, ending around the upper thigh.

Female/F_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_Forked_01.description: A short cloth half-cape hanging from one shoulder down the side of the body to about mid-thigh, with a forked, pointed hem and soft draped folds. It sits over the back and flank, giving a superhero look.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_Forked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_Forked_01.differs: The female cape is narrower and hangs lower down the thigh, with a more sharply pointed fork at the hem.

Female/F_Cape_Winter_Ice_01.description: A pair of long, narrow crystalline shards forming a split cape that hangs from the shoulders to about the knees, its lower edges breaking into jagged, clawlike icicle spikes with glossy faceted surfaces.
Female/F_Cape_Winter_Ice_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy metallic edge highlights; colour 1 on the faceted inner surface visible from behind; colour 2 on the main body of the shards. The glossy material largely ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Cape_Winter_Ice_02.description: A split, back-mounted cape made of two long panels of jagged, faceted ice-like shards that hang from the shoulders and end in sharp, claw-like spikes around knee to calf length. It suits a fantasy or elemental look.
Female/F_Cape_Winter_Ice_02.colourAreas: Mostly glossy, reflective material that largely ignores the scheme; faint colour 1 sheen on some shard facets, the rest reads as near-black.
Female/F_Cape_Winter_Ice_02.differs: The female cape ends around calf length with a slightly narrower spread, while the male one is a little wider at the hem.

Female/F_Cape_Winter_Ice_03.description: A cape split into two long jagged panels hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, each ending in shard-like crystalline spikes with faceted, glossy plates; it gives a harsh, icy fantasy look.
Female/F_Cape_Winter_Ice_03.colourAreas: Glossy faceted surface largely ignores the scheme; colour 2 on the main panel bodies; colour 1 shows as a sheen on the inner edges and some shards; colour 0 on a few of the shard highlights.
Female/F_Cape_Winter_Ice_03.differs: The female cape hangs slightly shorter and narrower, with a wider gap between the two panels, and shows more separated spikes at the hem.

Female/F_Capebelt_Backskirt_Frigid_01.description: A long, wing-like skirt hanging from the waist, with a web of contrasting vein-like lines over translucent panels and a ragged, pointed hem that drops to the shins. The fabric fades toward the hem. Fantasy or monstrous styling.
Female/F_Capebelt_Backskirt_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper panels; colour 1 on the lower hem panels, where the fade appears; colour 2 on the vein lines and torn edging.

Female/F_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_01.description: A tattered cloth back-skirt hanging from the waist to about the shins, with a ragged jagged hem, a large bat-wing emblem with edging on the back, and a gradient from the top down to the hem. Sits behind the legs.
Female/F_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper skirt; colour 1 on the lower gradient toward the hem; colour 2 on the bat emblem; colour 3 on the stitched edging around the emblem.
Female/F_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_01.differs: The female skirt is wider and flares out more at the hem, hanging fuller around the hips.

Female/F_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_02.description: A long back skirt panel hanging from the waist over the rear and hips, with a plain upper section and a ragged, torn hem of jagged strips reaching about the calves. Suggests a tattered, post-apocalyptic or fantasy look.
Female/F_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the panel; colour 1 on the ragged lower hem, blending down from the top.
Female/F_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_02.differs: The female panel is slightly shorter and narrower, and it is open at the front so it reads as a rear skirt only.

Female/F_Capebelt_Cyberwire_01.description: A cloth skirt-like belt panel hanging from the hips to about mid-thigh or knee, cut into long jagged spear-shaped tatters with contrasting edge trim. It wraps front and back and drapes loosely, suggesting a cyberpunk or monstrous look.
Female/F_Capebelt_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels of the front and upper skirt; colour 1 on the underside and back panel tint; colour 3 on the trim along the jagged edges; colour 2 on the thin outer edge lines.

Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Anniversary.description: A short front apron-style loincloth panel hanging from the waist to mid-thigh, with vertical piping lines and a contrasting deep hem decorated with diamond cut-outs; cloth hangs flat at the front only.
Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel; colour 3 on the vertical piping lines and thin edge line; colour 1 on the bottom hem band; colour 2 on the diamond shapes in the hem.
Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Anniversary.differs: The female panel is narrower and slightly shorter than the male panel, and it hangs straighter with a tapered top.

Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Anniversary.description: A single narrow tapered cloth panel hanging from the hip down the outer thigh, with a pointed lower tip and contrasting edge trim. It is layered, with a lighter upper part fading into a separate inner panel, and reads as a retro witchy skirt flap.
Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper outer panel; colour 1 on the lower inner panel; colour 3 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Chimera_01.description: A narrow hanging cloth panel worn low at the front of the hips, ending in several long jagged spikes that reach past mid-thigh. It is a loose, tattered tabard-like flap with a monstrous, beastly look.
Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the panel; colour 1 on the lower spiked tips, blending down from colour 0.
Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Chimera_01.differs: The female panel is narrower and hangs slightly shorter, with fewer, sharper points at the hem.

Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Lion_01.description: A short front loincloth panel of pleated, draped cloth hanging from the waist to mid-thigh, with a ragged, pointed lower hem. It sits centred on the front of the hips as a partial skirt flap.
Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the cloth; colour 1 fades in toward the lower hem as a gradient.
Female/F_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Lion_01.differs: The female version is narrower with deeper, more crumpled folds and a more slanted hem.

Female/F_Capebelt_Geishabow_Tail.description: Two long, narrow cloth streamers hanging side by side from the lower back, like the loose ends of a large bow. Each has a central band and a rounded tip, and they fall to about mid-thigh.
Female/F_Capebelt_Geishabow_Tail.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each streamer; colour 1 on the curved side panels; colour 2 on the cross band across each streamer.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Astronaut_01.description: A short flexible hose hanging in a U-curve from the left side of the waist, with a wrinkled fabric sleeve and a chunky segmented connector and rounded nozzle cap at each end. Suggests an astronaut life-support line.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wrinkled hose sleeve, fading into colour 1 on the lower sleeve; colour 2 on the connector collars; colour 3 on the rounded end caps.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Birdpeople_01.description: A small oval shield-like plaque worn on the left hip, with a thick rim and a flat face bearing a raised winged bird emblem with swept feathers. Hangs at the hip as a superhero belt accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plaque face; colour 2 on the thick outer rim and back; colour 3 on the raised winged bird emblem.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_01.description: A small boxy satchel-style pouch hanging at the left hip, with a folded-over front flap, a gem-like teardrop stud on the flap, contrasting edge trim and a short loop strap at the top.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and top loop; colour 3 on the teardrop stud.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_02.description: A small boxy pouch worn on the left hip, with a fold-over front flap, a rounded gem-like stud closure, contrasting binding around the edges and a loop on the back for a belt. Practical frontier-utility style.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge binding and back loop; colour 3 on the stud closure.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_03.description: A pair of small cylindrical canisters or charge packs worn side by side at the left hip. Each has a flared, ridged cap at both ends and a banded central section, giving a sci-fi gunslinger look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ridged end caps; colour 2 on the central bands. Colours 0 and 1 are not visible.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_03.differs: The female version has no contrasting strip on the back edge of the canisters; both cylinders are plain contrasting and black.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_04.description: A row of small cartridge-like canisters hanging side by side from the left hip, each with flared ends and a central band. They sit on the hip and wrap slightly toward the back, suggesting a sci-fi western ammunition bandolier.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the canister caps and bodies; colour 2 on the central bands.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Bounty_04.differs: The female version has five canisters spread slightly more loosely around the hip, while the male has them bunched more tightly.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A narrow rectangular cloth tabard panel hanging from the left hip to about mid-thigh, printed with a jagged tribal glyph pattern and a crown-like motif at the top, with a gear-shaped edging along the curved hem.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panel; colour 2 on the outlined glyph border and crown motif; colour 3 on the inner zigzag lines and diamond; colour 1 on the gear-like hem trim.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Child_Modern_Witchcr.description: A long, narrow hanging panel worn at the left hip, falling to mid-thigh. It has a stiff, layered look with a central stripe, angular outlined side panels and a pointed lattice motif at the hem, suggesting a sci-fi or fantasy tabard.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Child_Modern_Witchcr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges and side borders; colour 1 on the main central panel; colour 2 on the top cap and inner outlines; colour 3 on the lattice motif at the hem.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_01.description: A pair of side-by-side ammunition magazines worn on the left hip: ribbed upper casings with a slotted lower section, each topped with a pointed bullet tip. Reads as a compact tactical belt accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed upper casings; colour 0 on the slotted lower sections; colour 2 on the bullet tips.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_02.description: A boxy utility pouch worn at the left hip, with a flap lid edged in contrasting trim, a wide strap band around the middle and a chunky clip buckle. Ribbed side panels give it a practical tactical look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the straps and bands; colour 3 on the buckle clip; colour 2 on the edge trim around the flap.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_02.differs: The female pouch has a closed flap with a contrasting-edged trim around its opening, while the male pouch has an open mouth showing a contrasting interior.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_03.description: A small rectangular belt pouch with a tall flap edged in contrasting trim, closed by a strap and buckle at the front. It sits on the left hip and suits tactical or military costumes.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the flap edging; colour 1 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle frame.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_04.description: A small padded rectangular utility pouch worn at the left hip, with a flap and open top showing an item inside, a wide strap band across the front and a chunky buckle at the side.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the strap bands; colour 3 on the buckle; colour 2 on the item inside the opening.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_04.differs: The female pouch has an open top showing an item inside and lacks the contrasting outlined trim of the male one; its buckle sits at the side rather than the front.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Corrupted_01.description: A small hip-mounted cape panel with bat-wing scalloped, jagged edges, hanging at the left hip. Layered folds with a bordered trim, an inner lining and a small crystal-like spike suggest a gothic, monstrous look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner face of the upper panel; colour 2 on the outer shell, edge trim and fold; colour 1 on the lower scalloped wing layer; colour 3 on the small spike.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Gladiator_01.description: A belt accessory of three large octagonal metal rings joined by small chain links, each ring holding a hanging rounded plaque with pyramid studs. It dangles at the hip in a gladiator style.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and chain links; colour 1 on the plaque faces; colour 2 on the plaque borders, pyramid studs and connectors.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Gladiator_02.description: A short chain of chunky octagonal links alternating large and small, draped in a shallow curve across the front of the hips as a decorative belt accessory. Rough, industrial and gladiator-like in style.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the chain links; the metal ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Grenade_01.description: A small pineapple-style hand grenade hanging at the left hip, with a deeply segmented rounded body, a narrow neck, and a curved safety lever running down one side from a fuse cap. Suits military and tactical looks.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Grenade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented grenade body; colour 1 on the fuse cap and safety lever; colour 2 on the neck between body and cap.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Handcuffs_01.description: A pair of metal handcuffs hanging from a short flat belt strap on the left hip. The cuffs are two stacked rings with a small linked chain at the bottom; a police and tactical accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Handcuffs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rings and bodies; colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 on the hanging strap; colour 3 on the small round stud on the strap.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lion_01.description: A pentagonal belt-buckle plate with a sculpted lion head in relief, framed by a segmented raised border, with a square loop on each side for attaching a cape or belt. Sits at the front of the waist.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head; colour 1 on the pentagonal frame and back plate; colour 2 on the side loops; colour 3 on the lion's eyes.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_01.description: A wide sash belt wrapped around the waist and tied in a knot at the left hip, with a long single tail hanging to the upper thigh and ending in an ornate pointed filigree pendant set with a gem.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the sash and hanging tail; colour 0 on the metal pendant and the sash's inner lining; colour 3 on the gem in the pendant.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_02.description: A slim, plain belt band that wraps once around the waist at a slight tilt, with a contrasting inner edge and trim along both borders, and a small angular metal buckle at the front.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main belt band; colour 0 on the edge trim, inner lining and buckle.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_03.description: A small hanging belt charm: a spiky, winged metal crest with a central gem, a decorative knotted cord and bead, and a dangling faceted orb in a claw-like cage. It hangs at the left hip.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and cage metalwork; colour 3 on the crest gem, bead and orb; colour 1 on the knotted cord and link; colour 2 on the darker crest edges.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_66_02.description: A small angular armour plate hanging at the front of the hips like a short tapered tabard, with a chunky faceted cap at the top, layered side panels and recessed slot details. Flat and open at the back.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted top cap; colour 1 on the main front plate; colour 2 on the side panels and recessed slot details.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A round belt medallion worn at the left hip: a thick ringed frame with segmented outer plates, small round studs and contrasting inset panels around a domed centre boss. It sits flat against the body like a mechanical buckle.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper ring of the frame; colour 0 on the lower segmented plates and the back; colour 2 on the inset panels and small studs; colour 3 on the domed centre.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Modern_Sapphire_02.description: A hanging belt strap accessory on the left hip: a flat strap with a forked pair of hooks at the top, a chunky buckle clip in the middle, and a lower tab with a rivet and a D-ring at the end.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Modern_Sapphire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and tab; colour 1 on the hooks, buckle clip and D-ring; colour 3 on the rivet.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_01.description: A pair of padded rectangular pouches sitting on the left hip: a larger front pouch with a flap, a small contrasting stud and a star-like swirl motif, and a second slimmer pouch behind it with a pointed strap tab.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 1 on the swirl motif on the front flap and the pointed tab on the rear pouch; colour 2 on the small stud.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_02.description: A small belt accessory on the left hip: a soft flap pouch with a strap-and-clasp closure, beside a cluster of three upright cylindrical canisters with banded caps and pointed bottoms. Suggests a tactical or gothic utility look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and the bands around the canisters; colour 1 on the pouch's strap closure; colour 3 on the canister bodies and caps.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_02.differs: The canisters stand a little apart from the pouch, with the pouch set further back on the hip.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Ornament_01.description: A round belt ornament showing a sculpted snarling guardian-lion face in relief, set in a thick rim with flame-like fins curling up from the top edge. It sits at the front of the waist, with a flat plain back.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Ornament_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the rim and the back plate; colour 1 on the flame-like fins.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A small rectangular armor plate with clipped corners and a dented, hammered surface, studded with four large cone spikes pushing out through holes. It hangs at the front of the hip from the belt, with a flat smooth back.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate; colour 3 on the four spikes.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A pair of draped chain loops hanging from two ring attachments at the left hip, swagging in curves from front to back across the hip and thigh. Gives a punk, rebellious belt-chain look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the metal ring attachments; colour 3 on the chain links, with colour 0 showing on some link highlights.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Skull_01.description: A belt-buckle ornament: a chunky skull with a single pointed horn on its brow, set in a curved winged plate with upswept pointed edges and small cutouts. It sits at the front of the hips.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the winged backing plate; colour 3 on the horn.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Tubes_01.description: A belt accessory on the left hip: a small curved plate mounted at the waist with a segmented flexible tube that bends up and outward, banded with joints and ending in a blunt capped tip. Sci-fi mechanical styling.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Tubes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mounting plate; colour 3 on the tube sections; colour 2 on the tube joints and bends; colour 0 on the tube end cap and the collar near the plate.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Satchel_01.description: A padded rectangular satchel worn at the left hip, with a top carry handle, zippered end pockets and broad hook-and-loop straps across the sides. It has a soft, tactical utility look with a camouflage-like pattern.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Satchel_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the satchel; colour 0 on the mottled patches, handle and pocket edges; colour 2 on the wide straps and side panels; colour 3 on the zipper pulls and stitched accents.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Satchel_02.description: A boxy tactical satchel worn at the left hip, with a top carry handle, a webbing panel and vertical straps on the front, and a smaller side pouch with a zipper. Padded, utilitarian and military in style.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Satchel_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the satchel; colour 0 on the camouflage patches, handle and trim edges; colour 2 on the webbing panel and straps; colour 3 on the zipper and buckle tabs.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Satchel_Alt_02.description: A boxy tactical satchel worn at the left hip, with a top carry handle, a front webbing panel, vertical straps with buckles, stitched seams and a smaller side pouch. Patterned fabric body suggests military utility gear.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Satchel_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle, base panel and camouflage patches; colour 1 on the main fabric body; colour 2 on the webbing straps and front panel; colour 3 on the stitching and strap buckle tabs.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Scissors_01.description: A small pair of scissors hanging point-down at the left hip, with two rounded loop handles over slim tapering metal blades joined by a central pivot screw. A quirky, practical belt accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Scissors_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two handle loops; the blades and pivot are unaffected by the scheme and show as bare metal.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Swing_01.description: A hip-mounted gear pack: a padded, ribbed rectangular pouch with a circular cross emblem on its face, held to a rounded backing plate by two bands, plus a small separate gadget pouch with a gear badge beside it.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and ribbed padding; colour 2 on the backing plate and the two bands; colour 1 on the cross emblem and the gear badge.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Swing_01.differs: The female version's backing plate is a taller, flatter panel that hangs closer to the hip, with the small gadget pouch sitting higher on the front.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Swing_02.description: A small boxy pouch hung at the left hip from two thin straps over the belt line. It has a flap front with a raised looping outline and a small stud, and a ribbed end panel.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flap and body of the pouch; colour 1 on the raised outline, edge framing and stud; colour 3 on the ribbed end panel; colour 2 on the straps.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tattered_01.description: A small belt ornament: a faceted jack-o'-lantern skull face with glaring eyes and a jagged grin sits at the front of the waist, flanked by two pointed, bat-wing-like tattered cape flaps sweeping out to the hips and around the back.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted skull face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the pointed wing flaps; colour 2 on the small backing plate behind.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Anniversary_De.description: A slim curved belt plate worn low at the hips, with a short connector at each end holding a round domed disc. The pieces give a retro mechanical, supervillain look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Anniversary_De.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central belt plate; colour 3 on the connectors and disc rims and backs; colour 1 on the domed disc faces.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A small spellbook hanging at the left hip from a thin buckled strap that rises to the belt line. It has a rounded-rectangle cover with a circular sigil on the back, rune-like markings, and cords tied around the spine.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and the book cover; colour 1 on the sigil and rune markings; colour 2 on the spine and page block; colour 3 on the cord ties and strap stitching.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Arcane_02.description: A hardbound spellbook hanging at the left hip from two upright buckled straps, with a circular arcane sigil and patterned border on the cover, metal corner guards, and a strapped spine. Suggests a fantasy mage's belt accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the book cover and spine edges; colour 3 on the page block and the inner border pattern; colour 0 on the corner guards, latches and sigil lines; colour 2 on the straps and spine bands.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Arcane_03.description: A small rolled scroll with swirling patterned paper and contrasting end caps, hanging at the left hip from looped cord that ties up at the belt line. It dangles beside the hip like a mage's belt accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Arcane_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scroll paper; colour 1 on the swirl pattern; colour 2 on the end rods and caps; colour 3 on the hanging cord.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A rigid, dagger-shaped hanging panel with a pointed tip and a stepped, angular top, held at the left hip by a horned crescent bracket with outward-curving spikes. Framed by raised outlines, it suggests a fantasy or monstrous style.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horned crescent bracket; colour 1 on the main panel surface; colour 2 on the raised outlines and ribs of the panel.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A horned animal skull worn as a belt ornament at the front of the hips, with a tapering snout pointing down and two thick curved horns sweeping out to each side. Bone-like, monstrous and tribal.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the eye sockets; colour 3 on the horn bases; colour 2 on the horns.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_01.description: A pair of heavy chain loops hanging from the left hip, each anchored by a small skull ornament at the belt line, with the chains draping down the thigh in a long tail. Gothic accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 0 on the skulls; colour 3 on the skull eyes.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_02.description: A small sculpted skull ornament worn at the left hip on the belt, with hollow glowing eye sockets, a cracked cranium and a flat plain backing plate. A gothic, macabre belt charm.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull bone; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 1 on the flat back plate.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_03.description: A small skull-shaped belt buckle with a faceted, low-poly skull, hollow glowing-looking eye sockets and a flat backing plate. It sits at the centre of the waist as a gothic accent.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 1 on the flat backing plate.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Martial_Power_.description: A small oni demon mask worn as a hip ornament on the left side of the belt: a sculpted skull-like face with two curved horns, narrow glaring eyes, fang-like spikes and a flat backing plate against the body.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Martial_Power_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face and backing plate; colour 1 on the horns and the small spikes beside the face; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A small angular belt ornament: a hollow, downward-pointing triangular frame with a bevelled front edge, worn flat at the front of the hips as a buckle-like emblem. Sleek, mechanical and superhero in feel.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the frame; colour 2 on the back and outer edges. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_0.description: A small rectangular satchel pouch with a folded flap hanging at the left hip, held by a narrow strap that runs up to a rectangular buckle loop at the belt line, with a ring fastener on the strap.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the thin trim under the flap; colour 2 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle loop and ring fastener.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_0.description: A small flat rectangular pouch with a rounded folded flap, hanging at the left hip. A vertical strap with a ring buckle runs down the front, with a contrasting band under the flap and a pointed strap tail.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the band beneath the flap; colour 2 on the vertical strap; colour 3 on the ring buckle.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Quiver_01.description: A slim cylindrical quiver hung at the left hip, angled backward, holding a bundle of fletched arrows at the top. A thin strap loops up to a small buckle tab at the belt line.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver body ends and arrow shafts; colour 1 on the quiver sides and arrow fletching; colour 3 on the square patch on the quiver; colour 2 on the strap and belt tab.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A small pair of stacked boxy pouches worn on the left hip, each with a flap lid edged in contrasting trim and fastened by a round stud. Compact, tactical utility look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 2 on the edge trim around the flaps; colour 3 on the round studs.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_02.description: A small pair of stacked rectangular box pouches worn at the left hip, each with a flap and a round stud fastener. The chunky, boxy shape suggests a utility or tactical belt accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 2 on the edge trim and frames around the flaps; colour 3 on the round studs.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_03.description: A small pair of boxy stacked pouches on the left hip, each a two-tier block with a contrasting-edged flap and a round stud fastener. Small blocks sit near the front and back of the hip, giving a tactical utility look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the flap edges and trim; colour 3 on the round fasteners.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: A pair of small boxy utility pouches with flap lids, each closed by a round stud and a contrasting tongue panel, worn side by side on the left hip. Padded, rounded edges give a practical superhero look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 1 on the tongue panel of each flap; colour 3 on the round stud closures.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_01.differs: The two pouches sit close together at the hip with one turned behind the other, and the front-facing pouch sits slightly further forward than on the male version.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_02.description: A small rectangular utility pouch worn at the left hip, with a deep body and a fold-over flap across the top. Boxy and slightly tapered, it sits flat against the thigh side in a practical vigilante style.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body; colour 1 on the top flap and the side and back panel.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_03.description: A pair of small rectangular ammo-style pouches with flap lids, sitting side by side on the left hip. Boxy fabric bodies with contrasting flaps give a tactical, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 1 on the top flaps.

Female/F_Capebelt_L_Viper_01.description: A chunky snake-head plate worn at the front of the belt line, a shield-like triangle with angular brow ridges, cut-out eyes and a fanged open-mouth recess, with a plain flat back.
Female/F_Capebelt_L_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head plate and rim; colour 1 on the recessed mouth and eye insets.

Female/F_Capebelt_Lockbox_66_01.description: A single narrow hanging cloth panel worn at the front of the hips, ending mid-thigh with a notched, slightly pointed hem. Bold jagged glyph-like markings and a crown motif run down its length, with a curled band along the bottom edge.
Female/F_Capebelt_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel; colour 2 on the outlines and crown-shaped top motif; colour 3 on the zigzag inner markings and diamond; colour 1 on the band along the hem.
Female/F_Capebelt_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The female panel is slimmer and hangs a little more loosely, with a slightly more twisted drape when seen from the side.

Female/F_Capebelt_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A single narrow panel of soft draped cloth hanging from the waist down the front of the thighs to about knee level, with a rounded hem and gentle folds; a loincloth-style tabard with a little gathering at the back.
Female/F_Capebelt_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Astronaut_01.description: A curved flexible hose in a U shape, with a wrinkled fabric sleeve and a rigid collar at each end capped by a rounded nozzle. It hangs at the right hip and suggests an astronaut's life-support tube.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fabric of the hose; colour 1 on the lower fabric of the hose; colour 2 on the collars; colour 3 on the end nozzles.
