Female/F_Capebelt_R_Birdpeople_01.description: A shield-shaped oval plaque worn at the right hip, with a thick raised rim, a flat face and a winged bird emblem raised at its centre. The outer side is a plain smooth dome.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plaque face; colour 2 on the rim and the domed outer back; colour 3 on the raised bird emblem.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Bounty_01.description: A small rectangular utility pouch worn on the right hip, with a fold-over flap fastened by a round stud, a loop at the top for a belt, and edging around the border. Suits a sci-fi western look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edging and belt loop; colour 3 on the round stud.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Bounty_02.description: A small rectangular utility pouch worn at the right hip, with a fold-over flap, a rounded gem-like stud at its centre and contrasting binding along the edges. It has a loop at the top for a belt.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge binding and top loop; colour 3 on the gem stud; colour 1 on the inner side panel.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Bounty_03.description: A pair of short, chunky cylindrical canisters hanging side by side at the right hip, each with a pinched, ribbed top and bottom and a smooth central band. They suggest cartridges or explosive charges for a space-western look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Bounty_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed top and bottom sections of each canister; colour 2 on the central band.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Bounty_04.description: A row of small cylindrical cartridge or shell-like canisters with flared ends and a central band, hung side by side along the right hip and lower back. Suggests a bandolier-style ammo belt accessory for a sci-fi western look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Bounty_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the canister bodies and flared end caps; colour 2 on the central bands.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A narrow rectangular cloth panel hanging from the right hip to mid-thigh, with a jagged tribal glyph design down its length, a crest-like notched top and a knotted band gathered at the hem.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 2 on the outlines of the glyph design; colour 3 on the zigzag inner markings and central diamond; colour 1 on the knotted band at the bottom.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Child_Modern_Witchcr.description: A narrow rectangular cloth panel hanging from the right hip down the outer thigh to about the knee, with a tapered pointed hem, a central stripe with angular outlined panels and a lattice-patterned point at the bottom.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Child_Modern_Witchcr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central stripe and upper panel; colour 0 on the outer angular border panels and hem edges; colour 2 on the top edge and the thin line details; colour 3 on the lattice point at the hem.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_01.description: A pair of boxy ammunition magazines sitting side by side on the right hip, each with a ribbed lower section and a small pointed round poking out of the top. Tactical, military look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper magazine bodies; colour 0 on the ribbed lower sections; colour 2 on the bullet tips at the top.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_02.description: A small boxy utility pouch worn at the right hip, with a flap lid edged in a thick rounded border, a wide strap wrapped around it and a clip buckle at the centre. Slim and tall in shape, with ribbed metallic sides.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the wrapping straps; colour 2 on the flap edging and border; colour 3 on the buckle.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_02.differs: The female pouch is a closed, upright box with a contrasting-edged flap and ribbed sides, while the male one is a softer cloth pouch with an open top showing a canister inside.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_03.description: A small rectangular utility pouch with a padded flap that folds over the front, edged in contrasting trim and closed by a strap with a square buckle. It hangs at the right hip from the belt.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the flap edging; colour 1 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_04.description: A small boxy utility pouch worn at the right hip. It has a flap that is open at the front, a strap band wrapped around the middle with a chunky buckle on the side, and a ribbed rear panel. Tactical look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the strap band and top stripe; colour 2 on the inner cavity; colour 3 on the buckle.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_04.differs: This version has an open, cutaway front showing a contrasting inner cavity and no contrasting outline edging, while the male one has a closed flap with contrasting edging.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Corrupted_01.description: A small hip-mounted shield-shaped panel with a raised rim, a central ridge holding a pointed gem, and a jagged bat-wing-like cloth flap behind it. Sits on the right hip as a partial belt accessory with a gothic monstrous look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inset panels either side of the ridge; colour 2 on the rim, central ridge and the rear ragged flap; colour 1 on the lower scalloped fabric edge; colour 3 on the gem.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Gladiator_01.description: A belt accessory of three octagonal metal rings joined by small chain links, each ring holding a hanging rounded plate with a bordered edge and diamond studs. Hangs at the hip in a fantasy gladiator style.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and chain links; colour 1 on the hanging plate faces; colour 2 on the plate borders, connectors and studs.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Gladiator_02.description: A short chain of five octagonal metal links, alternating large and small, hanging across the lower back at hip level. It works as a rugged, decorative belt accessory in a gladiator or punk style.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the links; the metal material appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Grenade_01.description: A small hand grenade worn on the right hip: an oval body of chunky segmented pineapple-style blocks, a tapered neck, a flat fuse cap and a long curved safety lever running down one side.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Grenade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented grenade body; colour 2 on the tapered neck; colour 1 on the fuse cap and safety lever.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Handcuffs_01.description: A pair of metal handcuffs hanging from a short strap loop with a small round stud, clipped at the right hip; two chunky cuff rings are joined by a short chain. Suggests police or street gear.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Handcuffs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rings and plates; colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 on the hanging strap; colour 3 on the stud.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lion_01.description: A small pentagonal belt plaque worn at the lower back, with a sculpted lion's head relief framed by a segmented border and two square loops at the sides for attaching to a belt. Suggests a beastly, armored look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head; colour 1 on the segmented border and back plate; colour 3 on the lion's eyes; colour 2 on the side loops.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_01.description: A wide martial-arts sash wrapped around the waist and knotted at the front, with one long tail hanging down the thigh and ending in an ornate pointed metal charm set with a gem.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the sash and its tail; colour 0 on the metal charm and the inner lining of the sash; colour 3 on the gem.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The knot sits at the front-right of the waist and the tail hangs from it down the front of the thigh, whereas the male version has the knot at the back.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_02.description: A slim, flat belt band that sits at the waist and tilts slightly around the hips, with a contrasting edge trim and a small anchor-shaped metal buckle at the front. Simple martial-arts styling.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main belt band; colour 0 on the edge trim, inner lining and buckle.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_03.description: A dangling hip charm: an ornate spiked metal crest with a central gem, hanging on a decorative knot and a short bead to a large round gem cradled in a claw-like metal cage. Hangs at the right hip.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and cage metalwork; colour 1 on the knot cord and chain; colour 3 on the gems and bead; colour 2 in the crest's recesses.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_66_02.description: A small angular armored hip plate hanging at the right side of the belt: a wedge-shaped capped top above a faceted, slightly tapering panel with a shallow notched lower edge. Sits over the hip and buttock.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cap and the outer face of the plate; colour 1 on the inner, rear-facing panel and edge.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A small round mechanical belt medallion: a thick segmented ring with a domed glowing-style centre boss, small side studs and a notched lower plate. It sits on the right hip as a sci-fi buckle accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer ring; colour 0 on the segmented rim plates and back face; colour 3 on the domed centre; colour 2 on the small studs and lower recess.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Modern_Sapphire_02.description: A narrow hanging strap accessory for the right hip: twin hook prongs at the top clip over the waist, then a strap with a buckle block, a short lower tab with a rivet and a small D-ring at the end.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Modern_Sapphire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and lower tab; colour 1 on the hooks, buckle block and D-ring; colour 3 on the rivet.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Nightmare_Goth_01.description: A pair of boxy, padded pouches on the right hip, one larger in front and one smaller behind, each with a flap closure, a swirling diamond-shaped line motif, a small stud and a narrow tab.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Nightmare_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 1 on the diamond line motif and the narrow tabs; colour 2 on the small central stud.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Nightmare_Goth_02.description: A belt accessory for the right hip: a flat flap-closed pouch with a strap fastening, beside a cluster of three short pointed cylindrical canisters bound with banded rings. It sits at the hip and suggests a grim, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Nightmare_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and the bands around the canisters; colour 1 on the pouch's central fastening strap; colour 3 on the canister bodies.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Ornament_01.description: A round ornamental medallion worn at the small of the back: a carved guardian-lion face with fangs and glaring eyes, set in a thick rim topped by a crest of flame-like spiked fronds. Its flat plain back faces the body.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Ornament_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the carved lion face; colour 1 on the crest of fronds; colour 2 on the rim and the flat backing; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A small rounded-rectangular armor plate with clipped corners, worn on the lower back at the hip. Four large conical spikes jut from recessed sockets on its outer face, giving a brutal, monstrous sci-fi look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate; colour 3 on the four spikes.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Armor_01.differs: The female plate is slightly smaller and more tilted, with a thicker beveled rim.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A pair of draped chain strands hanging in loose swags from large ring clips at the right hip, curving around from the front of the hip toward the back. Edgy punk or space-outlaw belt accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chain links; colour 1 on the ring clips at the hip; colour 0 on small highlights within the links.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Skull_01.description: A small belt ornament: a skull with a tall contrasting-tipped central spike sits on a curved, horned plate with swept-up side points and two cut-out holes, worn at the lower back near the hip.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and the domed cap; colour 1 on the horned backing plate; colour 3 on the central spike.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Tubes_01.description: A small mechanical belt accessory: a curved plate sits at the right hip, with a segmented flexible tube rising from it, bending at a joint and ending in a small hexagonal cap. Suits sci-fi or cyberpunk outfits.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Tubes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hip plate; colour 3 on the tube segments; colour 2 on the tube joints; colour 0 on the tube end cap and the collar where the tube meets the plate.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Satchel_01.description: A small padded duffel-style satchel hanging at the right hip, with a top carry handle, zippered end pockets and contrasting webbing straps with loops across the sides. Camouflage-patterned, tactical utility look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Satchel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the camouflage-patterned padded body and handle; colour 2 on the webbing straps; colour 3 on the zipper lines.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Satchel_02.description: A padded, boxy duffel-style satchel worn at the right hip, with a top carry handle, vertical webbing straps with buckles, a zippered front pocket and a wide back panel of horizontal loops. Tactical, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Satchel_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the camouflage body of the satchel; colour 0 on the lighter camouflage patches, top handle and back panel; colour 2 on the webbing straps and loops; colour 3 on the zipper stitching.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Satchel_Alt_02.description: A small padded duffel-style satchel worn at the right hip: a boxy rounded pouch with a top carry handle, vertical straps, zip-line seams, a side pocket and a hook-and-loop panel on the back. Casual tactical look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Satchel_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the camouflage patches, handle and underside; colour 1 on the main camouflage body; colour 2 on the straps and back panel; colour 3 on the zipper seams and stitching.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Scissors_01.description: A small pair of scissors hanging point-down at the right hip: two rounded loop handles above a pair of narrow, tapering metal blades joined by a pivot screw. A quirky, practical belt accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Scissors_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the loop handles; the blades and pivot are unaffected metal that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Swing_01.description: A hip-mounted equipment pack on the right side: a padded rectangular pouch with a circular crosshair emblem and two straps, on a flat backing plate that hangs down the thigh, plus a small separate flap pouch beside it.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded pouch bodies and the small flap pouch; colour 2 on the straps and edging of the backing plate; colour 1 on the circular emblem and the small round badge.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Swing_02.description: A small boxy hip pouch or case hanging at the right hip from two thin straps that rise to the belt line. It has a framed lid with looping decorative scrollwork, a small stud clasp and a ribbed end panel.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box body and lid; colour 1 on the frame, scrollwork and clasp stud; colour 3 on the ribbed end panel; colour 2 on the straps.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tattered_01.description: A small back-of-waist ornament: a grinning angular skull mask with glaring eyes sits at the centre, flanked by two sharp bat-wing-like tattered points that sweep up and out. Sits low on the lower back, with a monstrous Halloween feel.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the mouth and teeth recesses; colour 1 on the wing-shaped cloth points.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Anniversary_De.description: A slim curved belt plate worn low at the back of the waist, with a small round domed disc on a short stub at each end. It gives a retro mechanical, sci-fi villain look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Anniversary_De.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the central plate's outer face; colour 0 on the plate's inner face; colour 3 on the disc rims and connector stubs; colour 1 on the domed disc centres.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A small square spellbook hanging at the right hip from two studded straps that rise to the waist. It has a thick spine, a contrasting binding band and a circular arcane sigil with runic marks on the cover.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the book cover and straps; colour 1 on the circular sigil and runes; colour 2 on the spine and binding band; colour 3 on the small strap fittings and edge stitching.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Arcane_02.description: A small hardbound spellbook hung at the right hip on two upright straps with buckles. It has a decorative cover with a circular arcane sigil and patterned border, page edges on one side, and small clasps with strap bands.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the book cover and spine; colour 3 on the page block and cover border pattern; colour 0 on the sigil linework, corner caps and clasp fittings; colour 2 on the straps and strap bands.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Arcane_03.description: A small rolled scroll hanging at the right hip from a looped cord tied in a knot, with contrasting end rods and swirling patterned paper. It dangles at thigh height as a belt accessory with a mystic, fantasy feel.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Arcane_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scroll paper; colour 1 on the swirl pattern; colour 2 on the end rods; colour 3 on the hanging cord and knot.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A narrow, dagger-shaped hanging panel with a bordered, cracked-looking face, worn at the lower back below the waist. A curved horn-like crescent with upswept tips sits across the top. Monstrous, mechanical fantasy look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved horn crescent at the top; colour 1 on the main panel face; colour 2 on the panel border and edging.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A horned animal skull worn at the belt line, with a textured bone-like face tapering to a point and two thick curled horns sweeping outward, each with a contrasting band at its base. Sits low on the hips as a monstrous belt ornament.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 2 on the horns; colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases; colour 1 on the eye sockets.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Goth_01.description: A pair of heavy chain loops hanging from the right hip, each anchored by a small skull ornament at the belt and draping down the thigh to about knee level. Gothic, punk-style belt accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 0 on the skulls; colour 3 on the skull eyes; colour 2 on the small belt mount tabs.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Goth_02.description: A small sculpted skull ornament worn at the right hip on the belt, with hollow glowing-looking eye sockets and a toothed jaw; its flat backing plate faces the body. A gothic, macabre accessory.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 1 on the flat backing plate.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Martial_Power_.description: A small oni demon mask worn as a hip ornament on the right side: a sculpted angular face with two long curved horns, narrow glaring eyes, small fangs, and a flat backing plate that sits against the hip.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Martial_Power_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face and backing; colour 1 on the horns and fangs; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A small flat triangular frame ornament with a hollow centre and bevelled edges, worn at the lower back of the belt line as a tiny emblem-like accent. Sleek and minimal, suited to superhero looks.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole frame, seen as a front face; the back face shows a glossy metallic sheen that ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Phantom_01.differs: The female frame is smaller and sits more slanted, with a slightly narrower triangle than the male one.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_0.description: A small rounded satchel-style pouch with a folded flap, hanging at the right hip from a narrow strap that loops through a square ring hanger at the top; a circular ring buckle sits on the strap.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the trim under the flap; colour 2 on the hanging strap; colour 3 on the square hanger and the round buckle ring.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_0.description: A small boxy pouch with a folded-over flap, worn on the right hip. A narrow strap with a large octagonal ring runs down the outer face of the flap. Suggests a pirate-style belt satchel.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the small trim strip under the flap edge; colour 2 on the strap; colour 3 on the ring.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Quiver_01.description: A slim cylindrical arrow quiver hanging at the right hip, tilted slightly, with a banded body, open top holding fletched arrows, and a thin strap loop on a small mount at the belt line. Practical archer look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver base and arrow shafts; colour 1 on the main quiver body and fletching; colour 3 on the band around the middle; colour 2 on the strap and belt mount.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A pair of small boxy pouches stacked vertically on the right hip, each with a flat lid framed by a raised border and a round stud clasp at the front. Sits at the belt line, with a utilitarian look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the raised borders around the lids; colour 3 on the round clasp studs.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_02.description: A small belt pouch made of two stacked rectangular boxes with contrasting edging, each closed by a flap with a round stud. It sits on the right hip at the lower back, with a boxy, tactical look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box tops and sides; colour 1 on the flap panels; colour 2 on the edging and trim; colour 3 on the round studs.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_03.description: A small pair of stacked boxy pouches with drawer-like fronts and small round studs, mounted on the right hip at belt level. Compact, angular and mechanical in feel, with contrasting edge trim.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the edge trim and borders; colour 3 on the round studs.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: A pair of small boxy utility pouches stacked at the right hip, each with a buttoned flap and a contrasting tongue strip down the front. Padded, squared cloth construction suggests a practical vigilante look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 1 on the flap tongue strips; colour 3 on the button studs.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_02.description: A small rectangular belt pouch worn at the right hip, with a deep folded-over flap covering the top and a soft, slightly creased body below. Simple, practical vigilante styling.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top flap and the back panel; colour 0 on the pouch body and front face.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_03.description: A pair of small boxy pouches sitting side by side on the right hip, each with a folded-over top flap and a tapered body. Simple, practical utility styling for a vigilante or tactical look.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 1 on the top flaps.

Female/F_Capebelt_R_Viper_01.description: A small, thick, shield-shaped plate worn at the lower back near the hip, with a snake-head face on its outer side: angry eye slits, a flared hood and fanged mouth cut into the surface.
Female/F_Capebelt_R_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate body and rim; colour 1 on the recessed fang and eye inlays.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A single narrow cloth panel hanging from the hip on one side, like a loose tabard or sash. It falls to about knee level with soft draped folds and a slightly rounded, tapered hem.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hanging cloth panel; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_01.description: A single oval faceted gemstone worn as a small belt accessory at the lower back, with a flat underside and a cut-crystal crown of angular facets on the outer face.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the gem body; colour 1 on the large central facet and some edge facets. The glossy gem material largely ignores the other slots.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_02.description: A small faceted diamond-shaped gemstone with a flat rhomboid outline and bevelled facets, worn at the lower back at the belt line as a decorative accent.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the gem body; the glossy facets show a slight sheen and appear to largely ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_03.description: A small square faceted gemstone with bevelled edges and a flat raised centre, mounted on the lower back at the belt line as a belt accessory. Glossy, jewel-like and angular.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: Glossy gem material largely ignores the scheme; the bevelled frame stays while the flat back face takes a hint of colour 1.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone with a flat back and bevelled edges, worn as a belt ornament at the lower back. It has a glossy cut-crystal look and suits fantasy or sci-fi outfits.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 shows on the bevelled facets and the back face of the gem; the rest of the glossy gem does not visibly take the scheme colours.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_05.description: A small faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn flat against the lower back at the belt line, with a rough contrasting front face and a smooth cut-crystal back. It reads as a decorative jewel accent.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme and shows its own material; no clear colour slot is visible.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_06.description: A small teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone with a flat front and a pointed top, worn on the lower back at the belt line as a single decorative accent. The back is cut with an inset teardrop facet.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front and outer body of the gem; colour 1 on the inset facet on the back. The glossy gem surface shows little of the other slots.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.description: A small oval faceted gemstone worn at the front of the belt line, with a flat table on top ringed by angular cut facets and a shallow domed back. Reads as a decorative jewel or clasp.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.colourAreas: The glossy gem appears to ignore the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible on it.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.description: A single faceted rhombus-shaped gemstone with a bevelled front face, set at the front of the belt line just below the navel as a small decorative belt jewel. Suggests a fantasy or mystic accent.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.colourAreas: The gem looks glossy and and seems to ignore the colour scheme, so no slot is clearly visible on it.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.description: A small square faceted gem set on the front of the belt line at the hip: a flat-backed block with bevelled edges and a smooth inset face, worn as a belt buckle-style ornament.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows a single glassy finish, with no visible use of colour slots 0-3.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone worn at the front of the belt line, slightly off-centre. It has a flat pentagon face, bevelled edges and a short faceted body, giving a glossy jewel-like accent.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.colourAreas: Glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; a slight tint from colour 1 shows on one bevelled facet edge.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.differs: The female gem has a flatter, more shallow face with a visible inset pentagon on the front facet.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.description: A faceted gemstone cut into a heart shape, worn as a small belt ornament at the front of the hips. It has angular flat facets on the front and a glossy, jewel-like finish.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.colourAreas: The glossy gem material ignores the colour scheme and shows its own finish; a hint of colour 1 shows in the notch at the top of the heart.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.differs: The female heart has a large flat contrasting-faced facet on the front, giving it a more clearly cut look.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.description: A small faceted teardrop gemstone worn at the front of the belt line, pointed end up, with a glossy faceted surface and an inset textured oval panel on the face. Reads as a decorative belt jewel.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.colourAreas: Glossy gem body appears to ignore the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on the upper facet edge; the inset oval panel takes colour 2.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_0.differs: The female version has a textured oval panel inset in the face of the gem, while the male gem is a plain faceted surface.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A small round disc badge worn at the hip, with a raised rim and a recessed ring in the centre. The flat back sits against the body, giving a sci-fi, tech-emblem look.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face of the disc; colour 1 on the outer edge and the inner recessed ring.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Holoforce_02.description: A small flat circular disc worn on the lower back at the belt line, with a bevelled rim and a recessed concentric ring on its outer face. Reads as a glowing tech emblem or energy emitter.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Holoforce_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat inner face and bevelled front edge; colour 1 on the outer rim edge and the recessed ring detail.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Holoforce_02.differs: The female disc sits tilted at an angle on the lower back, while the male disc lies flatter against the back.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_01.description: A short rectangular cloth loincloth panel hanging from the hip down the front of one thigh, with soft draped folds and a border of zigzag stitched trim; ends around mid-thigh, in an ancient or tribal style.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 1 on the border edging; colour 3 on the zigzag stitching along the border.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_01.differs: The female panel sits off-centre over one thigh rather than hanging at the centre front.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_02.description: A single narrow tapering cloth panel hanging from the hip down the front of one thigh to about the knee, with a patterned band of contrasting trim along its hem. A simple loincloth-style belt drape.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cloth panel; colour 3 on the patterned hem band.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Rear_Quiver_01.description: A cylindrical quiver worn horizontally across the lower back, held by two woven bands, with a stitched rim and a bundle of fletched arrows sticking out of one end. Suggests a rugged archer or ranger look.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Rear_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver body; colour 1 on the woven bands and stitched edging; colour 3 on the arrow shafts; colour 2 on the arrow fletching.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Rear_Quiver_01.differs: The female quiver is a plain contrasting tube with woven bands, while the male version has a two-tone wrap with a contrasting stripe and separate strap bands.

Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_.description: A wide, angular sci-fi utility belt with faceted edges and small slot details, carrying a round front buckle and several boxy pouches and canisters around the hips. Sits low at the waist.
Female/F_Capebelt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band and pouches; colour 2 on the round buckle and the top panel; colour 1 on the side pouches and canister ends; colour 3 on the small tabs at the edges.

Female/F_Capebelt_Warrior_01.description: A single narrow cloth panel hanging from the hip at the front-side of the thigh, tapering to a rounded point, with chevron-ribbed sinewy upper detail, a contrasting edging and a pleated lower section; monstrous warrior style.
Female/F_Capebelt_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top flap and the highlights between the chevron ribs; colour 3 on the chevron-ribbed upper section; colour 2 on the edging; colour 1 on the pleated lower section.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Amazon_01.description: A short pteruges-style skirt of hanging rectangular tabs with pointed tips, worn around the hips and upper thighs. Each tab has embroidered vertical lines and scroll motifs, giving a greco-roman warrior look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tab fabric; colour 3 on the vertical lines and scroll patterns; colour 1 on the tab edging and the flower-like tips.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Amazon_02.description: A pair of short hanging cloth panels at the hips, one in front and one behind, each printed with a scrolling swirl motif at the top, a chevron band and curling flame-like scrolls along the hem. Reaches to about mid-thigh.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 1 on the scrolled top motif; colour 2 on the chevron bands; colour 3 on the curling hem scrolls.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Amazon_02.differs: The female panels are split more widely and hang farther apart at the sides, with the hem sitting slightly higher.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Detective_0.description: A coat skirt piece hanging from the hips to about the ankles: a wide A-line cloth panel open at the front, edged with contrasting trim strips and small buttons, with a plain back. Suggests a detective's long coat tails.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Detective_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 2 on the front edge strips; colour 3 on the small buttons.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoun.description: A knee-length coat-skirt hanging from the hips, with a pointed waist panel, wide flared back and side panels, and open slits with horizontal strap bands at the sides. Sci-fi scoundrel styling with an open front.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoun.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top waist panel; colour 1 on the main skirt panels; colour 0 on the side flaps and strap bands; colour 3 on the inner banding seen through the front opening.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoun.differs: The female version is a longer, flared skirt-like coat with side flaps and an open front, while the male version is a short, fitted thigh-length hip wrap.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoun.description: A cloth coat-skirt worn from the hips to about the shin. It has a split front and back, long side panels that flare outward, and stacked ragged contrasting bands with small studs on each leg. It suggests a sci-fi scoundrel look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main coat body; colour 1 on the long side panels; colour 2 on the ragged stacked bands; colour 3 on the small studs and lights.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoun.differs: The female version has longer, more dramatic side panels that sweep to the ankle and a lower hem, while the male version stops nearer the shin.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Victorian_0.description: Short cloth coat tails hanging as a small flared panel over the buttocks and hips, with a contrasting hem edge and split sides. It sits low at the back, suggesting a Victorian jacket skirt.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Victorian_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main outer surface of the tails; colour 1 on the hem edge and side trim; colour 0 on the front side flap; colour 2 on the small inner shadowed edge.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Coat_Victorian_0.differs: The female version is a short, curved flap sitting over the buttocks with a contrasting colour pattern, while the male version hangs as a longer wrapped skirt panel with a mostly light pattern.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Cowboy_Duster_01.description: Long duster coat tails hanging from the lower back to about the ankles, split up the middle into two flowing cloth panels; only thin edges show at the front sides. Western-style, worn over the legs.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Cowboy_Duster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth tails, with a slight lighter edge along the outer sides.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Cowboy_Duster_01.differs: The female tails are narrower and taper toward the hem, with only thin slivers visible from the front.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.description: A hip-wrapped cloth skirt-like layer with an asymmetric, angled hem and a V-shaped slit at front and back. Contrasting trim outlines the edges. It sits at the hips and hangs to mid-thigh, suggesting a gothic look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body; colour 2 on the edge trim along the hem and slits.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.differs: The female version wraps as a single front panel with an angled front slit, while the male version has a separate flap on one side of the hip.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Madjester.description: A cloth tailcoat-style panel hanging from the waist at the back only, splitting into two long pointed tails that reach the lower thighs to knees; nothing covers the front. Suggests a jester or theatrical look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Madjester.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; the inner lining may show a lighter tone from colour 1.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Madjester.differs: The female version hangs only at the back with a narrow split and leaves the front bare, while the male version wraps around the hips and covers the front as well.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare.description: A short flared skirt-like jacket layer that hangs from the waist to mid-thigh, with a split open front and a hem of pointed zigzag tips. Long vertical stripes and diamond motifs give it an ornate gothic look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panels; colour 1 on the vertical stripes and hem outlines; colour 2 on the points and diamond centres at the hem.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare.differs: The female version is split open at the front with a narrower gap, and the panels sweep back and hang more evenly around the hips.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare.description: A flared, knee-length cloth skirt-like layer hanging from the hips, open at the front with a split, with long vertical stripes and a scalloped hem decorated with diamond and fleur-de-lis motifs. Gothic, ornate styling.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 1 on the vertical stripes and scalloped hem edging; colour 2 on the fleur-de-lis and diamond hem ornaments.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Modern_Witchcraf.description: A narrow, straight-hanging panel that drops from the waist to mid-thigh at the centre front and back, with a pointed lattice motif at the hem, layered inset stripes and a squared top. Sleek, techy superhero styling.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Modern_Witchcraf.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central strip and back panel; colour 0 on the outer border bands and hem edges; colour 2 on the top cap and inner stripes; colour 3 on the lattice motif at the hem.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Starowl_01.description: A waist-mounted skirt-like layer of overlapping pointed feather-shaped petals with chevron banding, hanging from the waist to about the knees around the hips and back. Flowing, fantasy-mechanical styling.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad petal surfaces; colour 2 on the chevron bands and petal tips; colour 3 on the thin edge piping.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Steampunk_01.description: A short hip-wrapped cloth skirt panel with an open front and uneven, angled hem, hanging from the waist to the upper thigh. contrasting strap bands with small fittings cross the front and back for a mechanical steampunk look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panel; colour 2 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the strap edging and inner accents; colour 3 on the small buckles and fittings.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Steampunk_01.differs: The female version hangs slightly lower and flares more at the front and side hems.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tails_Wide_01.description: A wide, flared coat-tail panel hanging from the waist to about the shin, open at the front and draping around the hips and back, with a contrasting trim along the hem and edges. Simulated cloth.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tails_Wide_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 1 on the trim along the hem and side edges.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tails_Wide_01.differs: The female tails hang as a wider, more even skirt-like flare that stays closer to the legs, and the front edges sit apart with less curl.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_01.description: A long cloth trench coat tail hanging from the waist to the calves or ankles, split open at the front and back into two wide panels with a thin contrasting edge trim, giving a loose, flowing skirt-like silhouette.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 1 on the inner lining seen from behind; colour 2 on the thin edge trim.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_Torn_.description: A torn coat-tail skirt panel hanging from the waist to about mid-calf, flaring outward with patchwork sections joined by stitched seams and a ragged, holey hem. Suggests a tattered trenchcoat skirt.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_Torn_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper panel and the back panel; colour 1 on the large angled patch; colour 2 on the lower patch; colour 3 on the stitching along the seams.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01.description: A short cloth tail-skirt panel hanging from the waist to mid-thigh, split at the centre with a curved contrasting arch panel and a straight-edged band across the hem. Suggests a formal tuxedo-tail look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel and edges; colour 1 on the arched inner panel; colour 2 on the band across the lower hem.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01.differs: The female version is much shorter, ending at mid-thigh with a contrasting arch and hem band, while the male version is a long plain tail reaching the calves.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01_Glit.description: A split tail panel of cloth hanging from the waist to about mid-shin, with a central slit front and back that forms two long flaps. It flares slightly toward the hem and gives a formal tailcoat look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01_Glit.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole panel with a speckled glitter texture; other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Roundpo.description: A single rounded, pointed cloth tail panel that hangs from the hips, like a tuxedo tailcoat skirt. It drapes over the rear and thighs, tapers to a rounded point below the crotch, and shows soft simulated folds.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Roundpo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole panel; the underside shows a slightly different tint from the same slot. No other slots are visible.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Roundpo.description: A single long coat-tail panel with a rounded, pointed lower end, hanging from the lower back down past the knees. It drapes over the hips and thighs like a tailcoat skirt, with a glittery speckled finish suited to formal or showy outfits.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Roundpo.colourAreas: The whole panel uses a speckled glitter texture that mostly ignores the colour scheme; no distinct slot areas are visible.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_0.description: A short tuxedo-style tail panel hanging from the hips over the thighs, with a centre split and flared, rounded hem. Plain smooth cloth that sits mostly at the back and sides, a formal jacket tail.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail panel; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_0.description: A short cloth tail panel hanging from the lower back over the hips and upper thighs, split by a centre slit into two flared flaps with rounded hems. Suggests a formal tailcoat skirt or jacket tails.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole panel with a speckled glitter texture; the other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_R.description: A short rounded tailcoat flap hanging from the waist over the hips and upper thighs, with soft cloth folds and a rounded point at the bottom. It reads as a formal jacket tail worn alone.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_R.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the tail; colour 1 on the inner lining seen from behind.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_R.description: A short, rounded coattail panel hanging from the lower back over the hips and rear, ending in a soft rounded point. It is a single flat cloth flap with a speckled glitter texture, giving a formal tuxedo-tail look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_R.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail panel, with a speckled glitter texture that shows tiny flecks of other slots; no other distinct features.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_S.description: A short swallowtail coat-tail panel hanging from the lower back at the hips, split into two pointed tails that reach the upper thighs. Soft cloth with a formal tuxedo look.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail panel; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_S.description: A short pair of swallowtail coat tails hanging from the lower back at the hips, split into two pointed panels with a glittery speckled finish. It is a partial formal accessory that ends at the upper thigh.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_S.colourAreas: The glitter-textured cloth appears to take colour 0 across the tails, with faint speckles of colour 3; colours 1 and 2 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallow.description: A pair of formal swallowtail coat tails hanging from the hips: two long, narrow pointed panels of soft cloth that split at the centre back and drape down the thighs, with no upper garment attached.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallow.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail panels; no other slots visible.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallow.differs: The female tails start lower on the hips and hang shorter and narrower, with a shallower split at the back.

Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallow.description: A pair of swallowtail coat tails hanging from the lower back over the hips and thighs, each tapering to a long point with a split between them. The glittery cloth suggests a formal tuxedo style.
Female/F_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallow.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glittery tail cloth with speckled flecks of colour 3; colours 1 and 2 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Birdpeople_.description: A narrow loincloth-style cloth panel hanging from the hips down the front of the thighs to about knee level, tapering to a point at the hem, with gathered pleats at the top waist edge.
Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Birdpeople_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Birdpeople_.differs: The female panel is narrower and tapers more sharply to a pointed hem, with deeper pleats at the top.

Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Egyptian_01.description: A narrow Egyptian-style loincloth panel of cloth hanging from the hip front to mid-thigh, tapering slightly and flaring to an angular pointed hem. It sits off-centre on one side of the hips.
Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Egyptian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cloth panel, fading toward colour 2 at the lower hem; colours 0 and 3 not visible.
Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Egyptian_01.differs: The female panel hangs off-centre on one hip and is narrower and more slanted, rather than centred at the front.

Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Knight_02.description: A narrow front-only loincloth panel hanging from the hips to about mid-thigh, with a rounded lower end and a tribal, spiky lightning-like pattern down the middle. Nothing covers the sides or back.
Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panel; colour 1 on the spiky pattern down the centre.

Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Nephilim_01.description: A small rectangular front loincloth panel hanging from the hips over the groin and upper thighs, with a ragged, torn lower edge, vertical fold lines and a contrasting border. Nothing covers the back.
Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Nephilim_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main cloth panel; colour 1 on the border edging around the panel.

Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Roinesh_01.description: A single narrow panel of simulated cloth hanging from the hips down the front of one thigh to about the knee, with soft folds at the top and a rounded hem. A tribal or monstrous loincloth style.
Female/F_Capehips_Frontskirt_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole loincloth panel; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Anniversary_I.description: A short, plain cloth hip skirt panel that hangs from the hips to the upper thigh, with a slightly curved hem, soft folds at the waist and a thin contrasting edge trim. It forms a simple wrap-like half skirt.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Anniversary_I.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 3 on the trim along the hem and side edge.

Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Brutal_02.description: A pair of jagged hip tassets of tattered, claw-like strips hanging from each hip, with a broad central panel flanked by narrower pointed tongues that taper to sharp tips. Reaches about mid-thigh, giving a beastly, monstrous look.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad central strip of each side; colour 2 on the top edge and upper fringes; colour 3 on the outer pointed strips; colour 1 on the tips of the central strips.

Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Draped_01.description: A short draped cloth panel hanging from the hips at the back, with soft vertical folds and a flared, uneven hem that ends around the knees. It reads as a loose half-skirt or tail cape.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Draped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; the underside picks up a slight tint of colour 1.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Draped_01.differs: The female version hangs a bit narrower and shorter, and its folds are more vertical and tightly gathered.

Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Firebird_01.description: A set of separate pointed, feather-like hip panels hanging in a loose ring around the upper thighs, each a narrow tapering blade with a flared tip, a central oval inset and edging. Fantasy firebird style.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each panel; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the oval inset at the centre of each panel.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Firebird_01.differs: The female version hangs as a slightly more spread set of shorter blades, with fewer panels at the sides and more at the front and back.

Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Lockbox_66_01.description: A calf-length wrap skirt with a plain waistband and a split front, covered in a repeating diamond zigzag pattern. The hem is bound in contrasting trim and falls to uneven points at the sides. It looks tribal and ancient.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and the pattern background; colour 1 on the diamond motifs; colour 3 on the zigzag lines; colour 2 on the hem binding.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The front opening is a narrower slit that shows more of the legs, and the waistband sits lower and is less pronounced.

Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Wide_01.description: A wide, flared cloth hip cape that hangs from the hips to about the knees, mostly behind and to the sides, with soft vertical ripples down the centre and a pointed upper edge at each hip.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Wide_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape, with a subtle darker shading at the pointed hip tips; no other slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Wizards_01.description: A pair of long tapering coat tails hanging from the back of the hips, split down the centre with a gap between them. Smooth cloth panels reach to about the knees, suggesting formal wizard or tuxedo tailcoat styling.
Female/F_Capehips_Hipscape_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both tails; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Capehips_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A hip-mounted cloth cape or half-skirt hanging at the front and back of the hips to about knee level, with a central patterned panel, contrasting side panels and a curved, uneven hem. It gives a mystic, robed look.
Female/F_Capehips_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer side panels and the cloth body; colour 1 on the central panel with vertical stripes; colour 3 on the woven diamond motif at the hem; colour 2 on the edging lines and trim.
Female/F_Capehips_Modern_Witchcraft_01.differs: The female version hangs longer, reaching to about knee level, with a longer, more sharply pointed hem.

Female/F_Capehips_Skirt_Long_Fantasy_01.description: A long, narrow triangular skirt panel that starts as a point at the hips and widens to a ragged, calf-length hem, hanging straight down over the legs with a crinkled, draped look. Suggests a fantasy loincloth or tabard.
Female/F_Capehips_Skirt_Long_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole panel; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Capehips_Warrior_02.description: A single hanging cloth panel worn at one hip, falling to roughly mid-thigh with a slightly tapered hem. It has a central vertical stripe with repeating diamond motifs between geometric triangle-patterned borders, suggesting a tribal warrior style.
Female/F_Capehips_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel base and the ground of the centre stripe; colour 2 on the triangle-pattern borders; colour 1 on the vertical stripes either side of the centre; colour 3 on the diamond motifs.

Female/F_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_A.description: A short military-style hip skirt: a gathered hip band with three strapped, ball-buttoned bars down the front and side, and a lined interior. A longer asymmetric panel hangs behind, falling to the knee with trim edging.
Female/F_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_A.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt panels; colour 1 on the front straps; colour 2 on the round buttons; colour 3 on the trim edging and the inner lining.
Female/F_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_A.differs: The female version has a shorter front hip band that flares out, and a longer rear panel that sits lower, with a slightly slanted hem.

Female/F_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_D.description: A draped hip wrap with a gathered cowl-like fold around the hips and a long panel of soft cloth falling over the back and front centre to about calf length, with rippled folds and a pointed hem.
Female/F_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_D.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole draped cloth; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_D.differs: The female version hangs longer, to about calf or ankle length, with a narrow front panel and a more open split at the sides.

Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_90s_Foxbat.description: A short waist-length superhero mantle hanging from a small neck collar over the back, with a large rounded central panel, contrasting side edges and a contrasting underlayer, ending at the lower back in a shallow scalloped hem.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_90s_Foxbat.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the large central back panel; colour 1 on the collar and the underlayer around the panel; colour 0 on the side edges.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_90s_Foxbat.differs: The female mantle has a small thin neck collar and hangs narrower and lower down the back, while the male has a thick padded collar and broad shoulder coverage.

Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Arcane_01.description: A pair of sweeping, bat-wing-like mantle fins that curve up around the neck and shoulders, with pointed tips and a thin contrasting edge. No cape hangs from them; they float as a partial collar-like shoulder accent.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner wing panels; colour 1 on the thin edge trim around each fin.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Arcane_01.differs: The female version has only the two upturned shoulder fins and no hanging cape; the male version adds a long draped cape below them.

Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Basic_01.description: A long cloth cape with a small draped collar gathered at the neck and shoulders, falling in soft folds down the back to about ankle level. A simple, plain superhero style cape.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape and collar; the cloth takes the scheme with no separate trim visible.

Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Brooch_01.description: A long, draped cloth cape with a small gathered mantle collar at the shoulders, fastened at the neck by a pair of small round brooches; it hangs loosely in soft folds to about calf or ankle length behind the body.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Brooch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and mantle cloth; colour 1 on the round brooch stones at the neck.

Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_01.description: A draped cloth mantle with a rolled cowl collar that wraps the neck and shoulders, falling in soft folds as a wide cape down the back to roughly the calves. Suggests a classical, heroic look.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle including the collar and drape; a small patch of colour 2 shows inside the neck opening.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_01.differs: The female mantle drapes longer, reaching about the calves, and hangs in a narrower shape that falls from the shoulders.

Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_02.description: A draped cloth mantle with a soft cowl-like collar around the neck and shoulders, fastened by a small round brooch at one side, falling in loose folds to about the calves behind the body.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mantle cloth and collar; colour 1 on the brooch.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_02.differs: The female mantle hangs narrower and is cut longer at the back, reaching lower down the legs, with a slimmer drape at the front.

Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Tech_01.description: A pair of curved mechanical shoulder mantles arching from the back of the neck over each shoulder, with ridged vent ends at the front and a stepped edge; no cape hangs from them.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of both mantles; colour 1 on the edge trim along the top; colour 3 on the inner underside panels; colour 2 on the vent grilles.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Tech_01.differs: The female version has only the two shoulder mantles, with no cape hanging behind.

Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Viper_01.description: A long, flowing cloth cape hanging from a gathered, draped collar-like mantle at the neck and shoulders, with small clasp-like pieces at each shoulder. It falls in soft folds to about the ankles and flares out toward the hem.
Female/F_Capemantle_Chestwear_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and the gathered neck mantle; colour 1 on the shoulder clasps.

Female/F_Capemantle_Extra_Retro_Destroye.description: Two small octagonal disc badges floating at the front of each shoulder, each a shallow dish with a raised rim and a shiny domed centre; a retro sci-fi mantle accent with no cape or fabric attached.
Female/F_Capemantle_Extra_Retro_Destroye.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the octagonal rims and backs of the discs; the domed centres are glossy metal and ignore the colour scheme.
Female/F_Capemantle_Extra_Retro_Destroye.differs: The female discs sit slightly higher and tilt more towards the sides of the shoulders.

Female/F_Capemantle_Extra_Tight_Wizards_.description: A pair of shoulder harnesses made of flat double straps that arch over each shoulder from a round metal disc at the front and hang down the upper back. Light, open and partial, with a mechanical superhero feel.
Female/F_Capemantle_Extra_Tight_Wizards_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the strap faces; colour 1 on the strap edging; colour 0 on the round discs.
Female/F_Capemantle_Extra_Tight_Wizards_.differs: The female straps are more upright and closer together over the shoulders, with shorter drops down the back.

Female/F_Capemantle_Fantasy_02.description: A feathered mantle with a short fur-like collar at the neck and a long plain cloak hanging down the back, with many long peacock-style feather plumes radiating outward and upward like spider legs, each tipped with an eye marking.
Female/F_Capemantle_Fantasy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloak, collar fluff and feather edging; colour 1 on the inner feather plumes; colour 3 on the outer feather blades and eye markings; colour 2 on the feather eye centres and quills.

Female/F_Capemantle_Jacket_01.description: A plain cloth mantle-cape hanging from a small padded collar at the shoulders, falling in soft draped folds to about the calves; it sits behind the body and hangs loose and straight.
Female/F_Capemantle_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body; colour 1 on the inner lining and collar edge.

Female/F_Capemantle_Jacket_Brooch_01.description: A knee-length draped cloth mantle that hangs from the shoulders down the back, with soft folds at the top and a rolled collar band. Small round brooches fasten it at each shoulder, giving a heroic, formal look.
Female/F_Capemantle_Jacket_Brooch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloak and collar band; colour 1 on the brooch rims; colour 2 on the brooch centres.

Female/F_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_01.description: A draped cloth mantle with a wide rolled cowl collar around the neck and shoulders and a long cape that falls in soft folds to about the knees, hanging mostly behind the body and drawn across the front of the torso.
Female/F_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle, collar and cape; a small opening at the front of the collar takes no clear slot.
Female/F_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_01.differs: The female mantle's front drape is a narrower panel of gathered folds hanging down the chest, while the cape behind is a little longer.

Female/F_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_02.description: A long cloth mantle cape draped over the shoulders with a wide rolled collar and a round brooch at one shoulder; the fabric hangs in soft folds down the back and ends around the ankles.
Female/F_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and collar cloth; colour 1 on the brooch.

Female/F_Capemantle_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A long, flowing hooded mantle draped over one shoulder and hanging in soft folds down the back to about the ankles, with a bunched cowl collar at the neck. Suggests a modern superhero cloak.
Female/F_Capemantle_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl collar and the upper cloak; colour 1 on the lower hem, fading in as a gradient.
Female/F_Capemantle_Modern_Destroyer_01.differs: The female version fades to a contrasting colour towards the hem, while the male version is a single colour throughout.

Female/F_Capemantle_Moth_01.description: A back mantle of two long, translucent insect-like wings hanging from a sculpted, horn-eared shoulder crest at the upper back. The veined wings drop to about the knees and end in banded tips, giving a moth-like fantasy look.
Female/F_Capemantle_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper crest and the fade at the wing tops; colour 0 on the main wing membranes; colour 1 on the wing tips and vein lines; colour 2 on the tip banding and the crest's inner details.
Female/F_Capemantle_Moth_01.differs: The wings hang a little shorter and closer to the body, ending around mid-thigh to knee; the male wings hang lower and are broader.

Female/F_Capemantle_Redstone_01.description: A loosely wrapped cloth scarf gathered in soft folds around the neck and shoulders, with a long flat tail hanging down the back to about hip level. Casual, draped look.
Female/F_Capemantle_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main scarf cloth and hanging tail; colour 1 on the stripes along the wrapped folds.
Female/F_Capemantle_Redstone_01.differs: The female version has a long flat tail hanging down the back to hip level, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Capemantle_Super_Retro_Destroye.description: A long superhero cape with a big draped hood-like mantle collar around the neck and shoulders, falling in a smooth, flowing sheet to about the shins, with a slightly ragged hem.
Female/F_Capemantle_Super_Retro_Destroye.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and the outer mantle collar; colour 1 on the lower cape fade and the inner collar lining.
Female/F_Capemantle_Super_Retro_Destroye.differs: The female cape is smooth with a gradient fade into the second colour at the hem, while the male has heavy folds and stays mostly one colour.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tattered_01.description: A long cloth mantle with a thick draped cowl collar around the neck and shoulders, and a loose cape falling to the calves with a ragged hem. A small fastening clasp sits at the upper chest.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl and upper cape; colour 1 on the lower cape hem as a gradient; colour 3 and colour 2 on the small clasp details at the chest.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tattered_01.differs: The female mantle fades from the light colour into a second colour toward the hem, while the male version is a single colour throughout.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_01.description: A long cloth cape hanging from a small collar at the neck, with soft draped folds across the upper back and a loose, tapering hem that falls to about the calves. It reads as a simple, classic superhero cape.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape body; colour 2 and colour 0 on the small striped collar tabs at the neck.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_01_1.description: A long back cape hanging from a small mantle at the neck and shoulders, reaching to about the calves. A large oval emblem sits on the back with a chevron-shaped band across it and a vertical bar below.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape body and shoulder mantle; colour 1 on the large oval; colour 2 on the chevron band; colour 3 on the vertical bar.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A knee-length cloth mantle hanging from the shoulders, with a draped cowl fold at the neck, small mechanical clasp discs at the collar, and a zigzag jagged hem. A bold arrowhead-shaped panel pattern runs down the back.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body; colour 1 on the edge trim along the sides and hem; colour 2 on the central arrowhead shapes; colour 3 on the inner arrowhead panels; clasp discs at the collar are mixed and metallic.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Brooch_01.description: A short draped cloth mantle that sits over the shoulders and upper back like a cowl, with soft folds and a striped inner lining at the throat, pinned at the front by two round brooch discs.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Brooch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped cloth; colour 2 on the striped inner lining and brooch centres; colour 1 on the brooch rims.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Brooch_01.differs: The female version is only a short shoulder mantle ending at the upper back, with no long cape hanging down the body.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cloak_02.description: A short, draped cloth mantle that sits over the shoulders and upper chest with a wide open neck, soft gathered folds, a contrasting patterned hem band, and a tulip-shaped clasp at the centre of the chest.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cloak_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the mantle; colour 1 on the hem band and the inner side of the clasp; colour 3 on the clasp petals; colour 2 on the hem pattern details.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cloak_02.differs: The female version is only a short shoulder mantle with no long cape hanging down the back.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A long, plain cape that hangs from a small shoulder mantle at the neck and falls in a smooth, slightly flared sheet to about the ankles, with a shaped collar piece at the top. Superhero style.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape body and mantle collar; colour 2 on the small inner panels at the neck.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_01.description: A short draped collar mantle that sits over the shoulders and upper back, with soft folds at the back and a striped inner lining showing at the front of the neck. Ends at the shoulder blades, with no cape below.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer cloth of the mantle; colour 2 on the striped inner lining at the front of the neck.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_01.differs: The female version is only a short shoulder collar with no long cape hanging from it.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_Foxbat_Cl.description: A short back mantle with a high standing cowl collar around the neck and a cropped rectangular panel hanging over the upper back, with a wide contrasting band along the bottom edge. Superhero style.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_Foxbat_Cl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared edges of the back panel and the cowl lining; colour 1 on the cowl and the upper back panel; colour 2 on the wide lower band and the collar edge; colour 3 on the strip down the front of the cowl.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_Foxbat_Cl.differs: The female mantle stays close to the neck and back, with no drape over the shoulders, while the male one extends over the shoulders with a strap across the front.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Fantasy_01.description: A back mantle of long, curling feather-like plumes fanning out from the shoulders like spider legs, each ending in an eye-spotted tip, with a fluffy feathered collar at the neck.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar tufts and feather edging; colour 1 on the inner plume blades; colour 3 on the outer plumes and eye-spot tips; colour 2 on the darker feather shading and eye centres.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Fantasy_01.differs: The female version has only the fanned plumes and collar, with no long cloth cape hanging down the back.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Ice_01.description: A cape-like mantle of jagged, shard-like crystal plates: a spiky starburst collar at the neck and shoulders, with two long split panels down the back that end in ragged, icicle-like points around knee to calf length.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Ice_01.colourAreas: Glossy, mostly ignores the scheme; the shards show a metallic sheen, with colour 1 faintly visible in the recessed back panels.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Luchador_01.description: A long draped mantle cape that hangs from the shoulders to about the shins, with a sculpted cup-like bust section and cut-out openings at the chest. Soft folds fall down the front and back, giving a dramatic wrestler-hero look.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Luchador_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle and cape; small trim details at the shoulder edge take colour 2.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Luchador_01.differs: The female version has a sculpted bust section with round cut-out openings at the chest, where the male version has a plain shoulder wrap.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A superhero mantle cape with a small soft collar at the neck, a contrasting bird-shaped yoke across the shoulders and upper back, and a long layered cape of jagged, pointed tails hanging to about the knees.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and the lower cape tails; colour 2 on the shoulder yoke and its bird shape; colour 1 on the cape's inner edge trim.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Nighthawk_01.differs: The female version's cape hangs slightly narrower and the yoke sits smaller across the shoulders, with the tails shorter at the sides.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Pleated_01.description: A feathered mantle of layered wing-like plumes draping from a wide raised collar over the shoulders down the back to hip length, with jagged pleated tips and long outer feathers sweeping outward.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Pleated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower feathers and collar highlights; colour 1 on the long outer feathers and collar stripe; colour 2 on the middle feather layer and collar edge; colour 3 on the upper shoulder feathers.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Pleated_01.differs: The female mantle hangs narrower and closer to the back, with a more upright, pointed collar and less outward flare.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Poncho_01.description: A poncho-style mantle: a thick draped cowl of cloth wraps the neck and shoulders, with a long, wide panel of soft folds hanging front and back to about the calves. Flowing, loose and layered.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl and the main draped panel; colour 1 and colour 2 on thin stripe accents across the cowl.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Poncho_01.differs: The female version hangs as a wide, plain, draped panel that reaches the lower calves and is not striped, whereas the male one is a shorter pointed panel with stripes.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Retro_Destroye.description: A long cape with a broad draped mantle collar over the shoulders, fastened by a small round clasp on each shoulder. It hangs straight to about the calves with a slightly ragged hem, in a retro comic-villain style.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Retro_Destroye.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mantle collar and upper cape; colour 1 on the lower cape, fading in as a gradient toward the hem; colour 1 on the shoulder clasps.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Retro_Destroye.differs: The female cape fades from one colour to another in a gradient toward the hem, while the male version is a single even colour.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Sidecaper_01.description: A short one-sided cape hanging from a small mantle at one shoulder, falling in a narrow tapered drape of soft folds down the side of the body to about hip or thigh level.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Sidecaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape and shoulder mantle.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Sidecaper_01.differs: The female cape is narrower and hangs slightly further to the side, with no contrasting lining visible at the shoulder.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_.description: A long, narrow cape hanging from a small shoulder collar and pauldron cap, falling straight down the back to about the ankles with a slightly ragged hem and a large oval panel with a central stripe.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape body and hem; colour 1 on the large oval panel and collar edge; colour 2 on the horizontal band across the middle and the shoulder caps; colour 3 on the central stripe.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_.differs: The female cape is narrower and hangs straighter, with a less flared, less tattered hem.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_01.description: A long draped cloth mantle with a rounded cowl-like collar around the neck. It hangs loosely from the shoulders in soft folds to about the calves and is open at the front, giving a classical heroic look.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle and collar; a small emblem patch at the front of the neck takes colour 2.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_02.description: A Spartan-style draped mantle: a soft cloth cape gathered over the shoulders with a small round brooch fastening at one shoulder, hanging in loose folds down the back to about calf length.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth of the mantle; colour 1 on the brooch.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_02.differs: The female mantle hangs a little shorter and narrower, ending near the calves.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_Star_0.description: A long draped cloth cape with a wide rolled mantle collar across the shoulders, fastened at one shoulder by a small star brooch; soft folds fall to about the knees over the back and chest front.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_Star_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and mantle cloth; colour 2 on the star brooch.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Viper_01.description: A long cloth cape hanging from small shoulder clasps, with a draped cowl-like fold at the neck and soft rippled folds down the back. It falls to about knee length and ends in a hem that flares slightly.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth; colour 1 on the shoulder clasps or pads; colour 2 on the small trim beneath the shoulder pads.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Webbed_01.description: A cobweb-patterned mantle of thin strands forming arched web rows, hanging from a small spiky collar-like shoulder piece down to about the thighs at the back. Open lattice, tattered and lightweight, with a spidery look.
