Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Webbed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the web strands and shoulder collar; colour 2 on the darker inner spikes of the collar; colour 1 and colour 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Webbed_01.differs: The female web hangs narrower and shorter, gathered toward the back rather than draping wide from the shoulders.

Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A long draped cloth mantle hanging from the shoulders to about the calves, with a soft cowl-like collar and two pairs of banded straps over each shoulder fastened with round clasps at the front.
Female/F_Capemantle_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth mantle and cowl; colour 3 on the shoulder straps; colour 2 on the round clasps.

Female/F_Capespadl_Destroyer_01.description: A single-shoulder cloth cape hanging from the left shoulder: a long, narrow tapered sheet that rises to a point above the shoulder and falls in soft folds to about ankle level behind the body.
Female/F_Capespadl_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; the inner face shows a slightly different shade, but no separate slot is visible.
Female/F_Capespadl_Destroyer_01.differs: The female cape is narrower and hangs straighter and closer to the body, with a sharper point at the shoulder.

Female/F_Capespadl_Destroyer_02.description: A single-shoulder cape of long, narrow parallel strands that fan out from the left shoulder and hang down past the knees behind the body, tapering to points. Suggests a mystic, wing-like fantasy look.
Female/F_Capespadl_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 3 on the thin edge lines; colour 2 on the tips near the shoulder.
Female/F_Capespadl_Destroyer_02.differs: The female strands are packed closer together into a narrower, slimmer fan.

Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: A set of three long, thin ribbon streamers that arch up over the left shoulder from a small anchor and trail down and outward behind the body, tapering to pointed tips. A light, flowing superhero accent.
Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the anchor loop and the upper ribbon lengths; colour 1 on the lower ribbon lengths and tips as a gradient.
Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.differs: The female ribbons hang more steeply down the back and are shorter, while the male streamers sweep wider and further out to the side.

Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A single long strip of simulated cloth that hangs from the left shoulder down past the hip, narrowing to a pointed tip near the knee. It drapes loosely at the side like a sash-cape.
Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth strip; colour 2 on the darker top edge at the shoulder.
Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The female strip hangs narrower and straighter, close to the body's side, and reaches lower toward the knee.

Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_01.description: A single plain panel of soft cloth that hangs from the left shoulder down the side and back of the body, tapering slightly toward a straight hem at about hip level. Simple superhero-style half cape with gentle vertical folds.
Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_01.differs: The female cape is narrower and hangs slightly further back from the shoulder, so it sits more behind the hip than beside the arm.

Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_02.description: A single short cloth cape panel hanging from the left shoulder, a narrow tapered rectangle with soft vertical folds. It drapes down the side of the body to about the hip, with a plain, unadorned edge.
Female/F_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel on the outer face; the inner face appears tinted by colour 1.

Female/F_Capespadr_Destroyer_01.description: A single-shoulder cloth cape that hangs from the right shoulder as one long draped sheet with soft folds, reaching to about the ankles and swept slightly behind the body. It has a pointed top and a superhero look.
Female/F_Capespadr_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Capespadr_Destroyer_01.differs: The female cape hangs more straight down and close behind the body, while the male one is wider and flares out to the side.

Female/F_Capespadr_Destroyer_02.description: A shoulder-mounted fan of long, narrow cloth strands hanging from the right shoulder down past the knees behind the body, each tapering to a point, with a slight sweeping curve. Suggests a shadowy mystic cape.
Female/F_Capespadr_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strand faces; colour 1 on the strand edges; colour 2 at the tops where the strands gather at the shoulder.
Female/F_Capespadr_Destroyer_02.differs: The female strands hang in a narrower, more closely packed fan that stays nearer the body and falls a little shorter.

Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: A set of three long, narrow ribbon streamers arching over the right shoulder from front to back, tapering to pointed tips that trail down behind the back. Sleek, flowing superhero accent.
Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper arch of the ribbons; colour 1 on the lower tapering tails, blending from the top down.

Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A single narrow strip of cloth cape hanging from the right shoulder, falling straight down the side of the body to about the calf, with a slightly pointed lower end. Simple and streamlined, worn as a one-sided drape.
Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth strip.
Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The female strip is a little narrower and hangs slightly further toward the front of the body with a more pointed tip.

Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_01.description: A single plain cloth cape panel hanging from the right shoulder, tapering slightly and ending in a rounded hem around hip level. It drapes in soft folds down the side and back, giving a light superhero look.
Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel.

Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_02.description: A single narrow panel of simulated cloth that hangs from the right shoulder down the back and side to about mid-thigh, with soft folds and a rounded lower hem. A simple superhero half-cape.
Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel.

Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_03.description: A single sash-like cloth shoulder cape that drapes from the right shoulder diagonally across the torso to the opposite hip, hanging in soft folds and tapering to a point at the lower end.
Female/F_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the cloth; colour 1 on the inner face visible from behind.

Female/F_Capewristl_Chains_01.description: A single thin chain of interlocking rectangular links that hangs freely from the left wrist down alongside the thigh. It is simulated cloth-like and reads as a dangling accessory with a punk or street edge.
Female/F_Capewristl_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all the chain links; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Capewristl_Wraps_01.description: A single long, narrow strip of cloth that hangs loose from the left wrist down past the hip, with a slight twist and a tapered, rounded end. It reads as the trailing end of a wrist wrap.
Female/F_Capewristl_Wraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth strip.

Female/F_Capewristr_Chains_01.description: A single loose chain of chunky rectangular links hanging straight down from the right hand or wrist, reaching roughly to mid-thigh. It is thin when seen edge-on and hangs freely like a dangling accessory.
Female/F_Capewristr_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole chain; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Capewristr_Wraps_01.description: A single long strip of cloth hanging from the right wrist down along the outer thigh, twisting slightly and widening to a rounded, tapered end. It reads as a loose trailing wrist wrap.
Female/F_Capewristr_Wraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth strip, which is the only visible feature; the inner face looks slightly shaded but takes the same slot.
Female/F_Capewristr_Wraps_01.differs: The strip is somewhat shorter and ends in a broader rounded tip, stopping around mid-thigh.

Female/F_Cheslayer_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A partial, sleeveless superhero chest layer: a pointed breastplate with upswept winged shoulder flares, a V-shaped lower edge, and a thin flared band around the ribs, with a wider swept-back panel across the upper back.
Female/F_Cheslayer_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central chest plate, back panel and rib band; colour 1 on the shoulder flares and surrounding edges; colour 3 on the inset panels across the upper chest and shoulders.
Female/F_Cheslayer_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The female version has contrasting inset panels on the shoulders, while the male one uses a near-contrasting tip on each shoulder and has a larger, open rim ring around the lower back.

Female/F_Cheslayer_Tight_Wolf_01.description: A cropped, sleeveless armored chest piece with a contrasting shaped cuirass, contrasting inset panel on the chest, contrasting-edged trim, a pointed lower hem, and tall curved horn-like spikes rising from the shoulders. Fantasy wolf-inspired style.
Female/F_Cheslayer_Tight_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main cuirass plates and the tall shoulder horns; colour 0 on the chest inset panel and inner shoulder fins; colour 3 on the edge trim and piping; colour 1 on the swirl decorations and lower hem detailing.

Female/F_Chest_Animal_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting snake-themed top with overlapping ribbed scale plates across the chest and abdomen, layered ridged scales along the shoulders and upper arms, and sleeves that fade into scaly textured forearms. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and abdomen scale plates and underarm panels; colour 1 on the torso, collar and upper sleeves; colour 2 on the slits between the chest plates; colour 3 on the forearm scales, blended into colour 1 above.

Female/F_Chest_Animal_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting animal-fur top with a tufted fur patch over the chest, feathery fur streaks along the shoulders and arms, a large pointed fur mane across the upper back, and jagged fur cuffs on the forearms; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulders, upper arms and lower torso fur; colour 1 on the torso and streaks down the arms; colour 2 on the chest fur tuft and the cuff tips; colour 3 on the forearm cuffs and the upper back mane.
Female/F_Chest_Animal_02.differs: The female top has a shaggy, contrasting fur tuft covering the chest, while the male version leaves the chest smooth and bare-looking.

Female/F_Chest_Animal_Jacket_01.description: A short-sleeved, waist-length animal-themed jacket top with overlapping scale-like ribbed plates across the chest and abdomen, a small stand-up collar, a corset-style waist band, and textured, muscle-like forearm sleeves.
Female/F_Chest_Animal_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and abdomen scale plates; colour 1 on the collar and waist band; colour 2 on the stripes between the plates; the forearm sleeves show a skin-like texture that ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Chest_Animal_Jacket_01.differs: The female version has a wider corset-like waist band that wraps fully around the back, and the back panel is a plain cloth-like shape.

Female/F_Chest_Animal_Jacket_02.description: A cropped animal-fur jacket: a big shaggy fur mass covers the chest and shoulders, with a short fitted torso and collar, plus separate feathered forearm sleeves that fade into tufted tips. Wild, coyote-inspired.
Female/F_Chest_Animal_Jacket_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the torso, collar and fur mass; colour 0 on the waist band and fur streaks on the forearms; colour 2 on the darker fur tips of the sleeves; colour 3 on the lower forearm sleeves.
Female/F_Chest_Animal_Jacket_02.differs: The female version adds a large, shaggy fur mass over the chest and shoulders, and a cinched waist band, which the male lacks.

Female/F_Chest_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A waist-length jacket with a fitted, zipped front panel and wide bell sleeves that flare at the wrist. The cuffs carry a triangle-patterned band, and the back has a V-shaped panel. East-Asian inspired.
Female/F_Chest_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and body sides; colour 2 on the centre front and back panel; colour 0 on the piping and collar area; colour 3 on the triangle pattern at the cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The female piece is a cropped jacket with long flared bell sleeves and a contrasting zipped panel, whereas the male piece is a sleeveless knee-length qipao dress.

Female/F_Chest_Astronaut_01.description: A long-sleeved, hip-length astronaut jacket with a padded hood-like collar, a bulky chest harness with a boxy front plate and shoulder straps, side pouches with round buttons and a hose, and contrasting cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and hood collar; colour 1 on the side and back panels and pouches; colour 2 on the harness straps and cuffs; colour 3 on the round buttons and indicator lights.

Female/F_Chest_Astronaut_02.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length astronaut jacket with a high rolled neck, contrasting side panels, and a bulky chest harness with front and back plates, small round connectors and looping hoses. contrasting cuffs end each sleeve.
Female/F_Chest_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the side and back panels and hose cases; colour 2 on the harness plates and cuffs; colour 3 on the round connectors.

Female/F_Chest_Blouse_Victorian_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved fitted blouse with a small standing collar, a contrasting panel down the front of the chest, and separate cuffs at the wrists. It ends above the waist, with a shoulder yoke and upper back in a contrasting fabric.
Female/F_Chest_Blouse_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the blouse and the sleeve fronts; colour 3 on the front chest panel; colour 2 on the shoulder yoke, upper back and back of the sleeves; colour 0 on the collar and the cuffs.

Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_01.description: A compact sci-fi life-support chest box strapped over the upper chest, with a V-shaped notch, two round indicator lights at the top corners and thick cables looping down and around the sides to the back.
Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box casing and V panel; colour 2 on the lower bumpers and base; colour 3 on the round indicator lights; colour 1 on the cables.

Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_02.description: A pair of flexible, wrapped tubular arms or cables hanging at the waist sides, each curving in a U with contrasting collar fittings and small capped tips at both ends. Suggests a sci-fi astronaut or utility harness.
Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wrapped sections of the tubes; colour 1 on the lower wrapped sections; colour 2 on the collar fittings; colour 3 on the capped tips.
Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_02.differs: The female tubes hang slightly higher and sit closer to the hips, with a tighter curve.

Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_03.description: A boxy life-support chest module with a chunky segmented housing, a V-shaped recessed panel and two round knobs on top, sitting on the upper chest. Flexible hoses loop from the underside around the ribs toward the back.
Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing; colour 2 on the V panel and lower corner blocks; colour 3 on the round knobs; colour 1 on the hoses.

Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_04.description: A pair of flexible, wrinkled hose-like cables that arc from the sides of the torso, each U-shaped with rigid cuffs and capped nozzle ends. They hang as a backpack-style life-support accessory at the ribs.
Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hose fabric; colour 1 on the lower hose fabric, fading in from the upper part; colour 2 on the cuffs; colour 3 on the nozzle tips.
Female/F_Chest_Child_Astronaut_04.differs: The female hoses hang lower on the ribs and curve into a deeper U shape with a more pronounced loop.

Female/F_Chest_Child_Ski_01.description: A soft hood worn down around the neck and upper back, with a lined inner face, a contrasting bound edge and short zip-pull tabs at the front. Only the hood is present, giving a casual jacket or ski-wear look.
Female/F_Chest_Child_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer hood; colour 1 on the binding around the hood opening; colour 3 on the zip-pull tabs; the lining appears to take colour 0.

Female/F_Chest_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A tiny flat, curved patch of material at the lower waist and hip line, wider at the front and narrowing to a thin edge around the back. Barely visible, it reads as a minimal belt-like plate.
Female/F_Chest_Child_Tight_None_01.differs: The female patch is wider and dips into a curved, scooped shape at the front; the male version is a thinner flat oval band.

Female/F_Chest_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting sci-fi western top with a glossy breastplate-like chest, banded waist corset with contrasting straps and a side clasp, smooth upper sleeves, and segmented armoured forearm bands. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate; colour 1 on the neck lining, piping, back panel and trim lines; colour 3 on the upper sleeves; colour 2 on the waist bands and forearm segments.

Female/F_Chest_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight scaled top ending at the waist, with a sculpted plate over the chest and upper torso, a notched contrasting centre throat panel, and a lower belly panel with jagged edges.
Female/F_Chest_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sleeves, shoulders and back; colour 1 on the sculpted chest plate; colour 0 on the throat and lower belly panels; colour 2 on the small underarm side panels.
Female/F_Chest_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.differs: The female chest plate is smoother and more rounded, with no muscle-like ridges, and the scale texture is less pronounced.

Female/F_Chest_Dryad_01.description: A sleeveless organic chest piece of smooth, ridged plates with a raised collar and pointed shoulders, wrapped at the waist by twisting vine-like tendrils. Segmented mechanical arm sleeves with banded cuffs sit below the shoulders.
Female/F_Chest_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates and cuff rings; colour 1 on the arm segments and small inset panels; colour 2 on the vine tendrils at the waist; colour 3 on the thin vein lines.
Female/F_Chest_Dryad_01.differs: The female version has no contrasting glowing patch on the chest and has more angular, flared shoulder points.

Female/F_Chest_Dryad_02.description: A long-sleeved organic fantasy top of root-like layered swirls with a high draped collar rising around the neck, thick vine bands wrapped diagonally across the torso, a tusk-like curved spike at the hip, and segmented ringed cuffs on the arms.
Female/F_Chest_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, swirled surface ridges and cuff rings; colour 1 on the sleeves and body panels between the ridges; colour 2 on the wrapping vine bands across the torso; colour 3 on thin veining lines.

Female/F_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_01.description: A sleeveless organic-mechanical chest piece: a smooth, veined shell with pointed shoulder flares and a high neck, wrapped at the waist in tangled vine-like bands, with segmented robotic arms and ringed cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and the cuff rings; colour 1 on the arm segments and small chest panels; colour 2 on the vine-like tendrils at the waist; colour 3 on the thin vein lines.
Female/F_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_01.differs: The female version shows no contrasting glowing chest panel, and its chest shell is smoother and less bulky.

Female/F_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_02.description: A long-sleeved organic-mechanical top with a swirling, root-like raised collar and shoulder mass, jointed robotic forearms with ring bands, and thick vine-like straps wrapped diagonally around the torso, ending with a curved thorn at the hip.
Female/F_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, shoulder swirls, forearm rings and thorn; colour 1 on the torso and sleeve panels; colour 2 on the wrapped vine bands; colour 3 on thin vein-like markings.

Female/F_Chest_Endo_01.description: A sci-fi exoskeleton-style top: a rounded armored chest and shoulder shell with a central tubed spine unit, studded joint nodes, segmented mechanical arms with banded cuffs, and a flat rim at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest shell, waist rim and arm bands; colour 1 on the arm segments and joint nodes; colour 2 on the central spine unit and back pack; colour 3 on the looping cables.

Female/F_Chest_Endo_02.description: A robotic exoskeleton top: a segmented armored chest shell with a central spine column and contrasting side pods, jointed arms with ball joints and ringed cuffs, exposed hoses looping across the torso, and a flared rim at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Endo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest shell, cuff rings and waist rim; colour 1 on the arm segments and ball joints; colour 2 on the spine column, side pods and back plate; colour 3 on the looping hoses.

Female/F_Chest_Extra_Endo_01.description: A mechanical collar-like ring that sits around the base of the neck and over the top of the shoulders. It has a raised glossy rim, layered banded plates and exposed inner machinery at the front. Suggests a sci-fi android look.
Female/F_Chest_Extra_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim edge and the top inner rim; colour 2 on the banded outer plates; colour 1 on the inner mechanical parts; colour 3 on small details.

Female/F_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_01.description: A skin-tight, sleek shoulder-and-arm piece: a cropped shrug-like cover over the shoulders and upper arms with thin strap-like trim lines, plus separate forearm sleeves with a gap at the elbow. Suggests a synthetic android look.
Female/F_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cover, upper arms and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the thin strap trim lines over the shoulders.
Female/F_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_01.differs: The female version has thin strap-like trim lines running over the shoulders and a narrower, higher cover, while the male version is a broader shoulder cap with a notch across the upper chest.

Female/F_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_02.description: A pair of robotic arm armour pieces: cupped shoulder plates, segmented mechanical joints at the elbows, angular forearm guards with fine detailing, and separate cuff bands at the wrists. Sleek android look worn over the upper and lower arms.
Female/F_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder caps, forearm guards and wrist bands; colour 0 on the inner shoulder cups and upper-arm sleeve sections; colour 2 on the elbow joint mechanics; colour 3 on the small forearm markings.

Female/F_Chest_Extra_Shirt_Fantasy_01.description: A pair of puffed, gathered shoulder caps in the style of fantasy puff sleeves, with vertical ruched folds. They sit over the tops of the upper arms and leave the torso and lower arms bare.
Female/F_Chest_Extra_Shirt_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the puffed shoulder caps; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Chest_Extra_Ski_01.description: A flat atom-style emblem of looping orbital ellipses around a small central ring, printed on the upper back of a tight suit. It lies flush against the fabric with a thin outline, and suits sporty or superhero looks.
Female/F_Chest_Extra_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fill of the orbital loops; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the emblem.

Female/F_Chest_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A sleeveless, angular robotic vest of faceted armor plates with a paneled front, a central recessed core with a bordered frame, small vents at the sides and a smooth plain back; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the back, shoulders and side plates; colour 1 on the front panels; colour 3 on the frame around the central core and the lower front strip; colour 0 on small light details.

Female/F_Chest_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight top ending at the waist, with a glossy V-shaped panel across the chest and shoulders, a sculpted ribbed abdomen panel, and small spots scattered down the outer arms.
Female/F_Chest_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 2 on the chest V-panel and abdomen panel; colour 3 on the spots along the arms.
Female/F_Chest_Foxbatcon_2025_01.differs: The female version has a wide chest band and a fully sculpted ribbed abdomen panel, while the male version has a thin shoulder stripe and a notched abdomen panel.

Female/F_Chest_Holohexarmor_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved, form-fitting glossy top that ends above the navel. It has a separate chest panel, contrasting shoulders and back yoke, and forearm cuffs. It suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Holohexarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the front chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back yoke and the back of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearm cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Holohexarmor_01.differs: The female chest panel is rounded and shaped to the bust, with a slightly scooped edge, while the male panel is a flat, boxy square.

Female/F_Chest_Jacket_Harajuku_Formal_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting collared blouse-style top with a button-up front placket and a pointed hem at the waist. It has a small standing collar and trim along the edges, giving a neat formal look.
Female/F_Chest_Jacket_Harajuku_Formal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blouse body; colour 1 on the button placket strip, collar edge and hem trim.

Female/F_Chest_Jacket_Retroscifi_Jumpsui.description: A retro sci-fi jumpsuit jacket top with a sculpted, cup-shaped bodice, a pointed high neck panel, two horizontal strap bands down the front and a banded hem at the waist. Forearm sleeves are separate, mismatched pieces with banded cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Jacket_Retroscifi_Jumpsui.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bodice and the left forearm sleeve; colour 3 on the neck panel, front straps, hem band and cuff edges; colour 1 on the upper sleeve band; colour 2 on the other forearm sleeve.
Female/F_Chest_Jacket_Retroscifi_Jumpsui.differs: The female version has a sculpted bust and a lower, open back that leaves the upper back bare.

Female/F_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_01.description: A robotic scrap-built chest and arms piece: a plate on the torso with a round slatted cage frame and small panel on the chest, a strapped frame across the back, and segmented mechanical arms with ringed joints and shoulder caps.
Female/F_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, waist band and arm ring segments; colour 1 on the cage frame, back frame and coiled arm segments; colour 2 on the small chest panel and inner back sections; colour 3 on the shoulder caps.

Female/F_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_02.description: A junkyard-robot chest and arm rig: a boxy plate over the torso with a round slatted cage on the front, a small square panel, a back frame of straps and mechanical segmented arms with ribbed joints and banded cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, cuff bands and lower waist band; colour 1 on the cage, ribbed arm segments and back frame; colour 2 on the square panel and inner back sections; colour 3 on the shoulder caps.
Female/F_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_02.differs: The female version has open, exposed shoulders with small contrasting caps and a slimmer chest plate, with no bulky shoulder pads.

Female/F_Chest_Lockbox_65_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting kung fu style vest with a stand-up mandarin collar, frog-knot toggle fastenings down the centre front, and a curved, flared hem with contrasting angular panels at the hips.
Female/F_Chest_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main vest body with a glossy finish; colour 0 on the collar, frog-knot fastenings and hem panels.

Female/F_Chest_Lockbox_65_02.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting glossy vest with a raised stand collar and decorative frog-style fastening loops down the centre front. It ends at the hips in a flared, curved hem with separate angular panels.
Female/F_Chest_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main vest body; colour 0 on the collar, the fastening loops and the lower hem panels.
Female/F_Chest_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The female vest has no chest plate; the front shows only the frog-style fastenings down the centre.

Female/F_Chest_Moth_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with large rounded shoulder and chest plates, chevron-like layered ribbing down the torso to a pointed hem at the waist, swooping accent markings, oval elbow panels and small wrist bands.
Female/F_Chest_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso, back and sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder and chest plates; colour 2 on the elbow panels, neck opening and wrist bands; colour 3 on the swooping accent markings and the waist band.

Female/F_Chest_Nightmare_Core_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting top of jagged, bone-like armor plates with a spiked high collar and pointed shoulder spurs. A cross-shaped chest emblem sits on a shield-like panel, and ragged plates run down the arms; it ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Nightmare_Core_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and sleeves; colour 1 on the chest and back panel; colour 3 on the central cross emblem and shoulder undersides; colour 2 on the gaps between the arm plates.

Female/F_Chest_Patriot_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a short standing collar and a separate lower band shaped like a corset with contrasting panels and thin seam lines; ends at the waist, with a small emblem dot on each upper arm.
Female/F_Chest_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper torso, collar and sleeves; colour 1 on the corset band; colour 2 on the centre and side panels of the band; colour 3 on the small arm dots and the thin lines on the band.
Female/F_Chest_Patriot_01.differs: The female top has a cinched, corset-like waist band with a pointed centre panel, and the arm marks sit lower and are smaller.

Female/F_Chest_Patriot_Jacket_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped jacket bodice with a high folded collar and layered chest panels, over a separate corset-style waist band with a centre panel and thin vertical straps. Loose gathered forearm sleeves sit apart from the body.
Female/F_Chest_Patriot_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest, collar and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the corset waist band; colour 2 on the centre panel and vertical straps; colour 3 on the small stitched accents.
Female/F_Chest_Patriot_Jacket_01.differs: The female version has a fitted corset waist that sits in and shows a shaped bust, with loose gathered forearm sleeves, while the male version has a straighter band and flatter chest panels.

Female/F_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_.description: A sleeveless armoured chest plate over a fitted corset-like midsection, paired with segmented robotic arms with ringed cuffs and exposed mechanical joints. Sits on the torso to the waist, with a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate and the arm rings; colour 1 on the corset and the arm segments; colour 2 on the central corset panel and joints; colour 3 on the shoulder trim and thin corset accents.
Female/F_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_.differs: The female version has a cinched corset waist and a rounded, contoured chest plate, with less visible shoulder trim.

Female/F_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_.description: A sleeveless robotic-exosuit top: a padded, segmented chest plate over a corset-style waist band, paired with mechanical arms of ribbed segments and ring joints. Ends at the waist, in a sleek sci-fi superhero style.
Female/F_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate and the arm rings; colour 1 on the waist band and the ribbed arm segments; colour 2 on the waist panel and the inserts; colour 3 on the small accents at the shoulders and waist.
Female/F_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_.differs: The female version has a cinched, corset-like waist band under a rounded, bust-shaped chest plate.

Female/F_Chest_Ribcage_Skeleton_02.description: An exposed mechanical skeleton torso: a bare ribcage and spine over the chest, with segmented, piston-like robotic arms, ringed cuffs and rounded shoulder caps. It ends at a narrow waist band, for a robotic sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chest_Ribcage_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribs, spine and cuff rings; colour 1 on the segmented arm casings and shoulder caps; colour 3 on the shoulder undersides and the spine core; colour 2 on the waist band and neck edge.
Female/F_Chest_Ribcage_Skeleton_02.differs: The female ribcage is narrower with the neck opening lower and no raised contrasting collar, and the shoulder pads are smaller.

Female/F_Chest_Ribcage_Skeleton_03.description: An exposed skeleton torso and arms piece: a rib cage and spine over the bare chest, bulky segmented mechanical arms with ringed joints and cuffs, and a thin waistband at the hem. Reads as cyborg or skeletal.
Female/F_Chest_Ribcage_Skeleton_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribs, spine and ring cuffs; colour 1 on the arm segments and inner chest panels; colour 3 on the shoulder caps and spine details; colour 2 on the waistband and neck trim.

Female/F_Chest_Robosleek_01.description: A sleeveless robotic armored top with sculpted chest plates, a segmented ribbed midsection and an ornate winged back plate. Armored forearm and upper-arm guards with wrist bands sit over bare skin sleeves; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Robosleek_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates, waist band and inner arm guard trim; colour 1 on the framing plates, back plate, arm guards and wrist bands; colour 2 on the inner midsection and joints; colour 3 on the small gems and lights.
Female/F_Chest_Robosleek_01.differs: The female version has a more open scooped neckline and a narrower, cinched armored waist section with a bare-skin midriff gap.

Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved robotic exo top with a glossy moulded chest plate, segmented ribbed arm tubes with ring joints at the forearms, shoulder caps, and a banded midriff section ending at the lower ribs.
Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest plate, back plate, midriff band and arm segments; colour 0 on the underlayer panels and arm rings; colour 3 on the shoulder caps; colour 2 on the inner gaps and joints.

Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_01_Phara.description: A cropped, form-fitting top with a large contrasting chest panel and a contrasting upper back yoke, paired with a segmented mechanical exoskeleton arm on one side with ringed joints and cables. Ends above the midriff.
Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_01_Phara.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main top and arm segments; colour 3 on the chest panel and shoulder pad accents; colour 2 on the upper back yoke and collar edge; colour 0 on the arm rings and joints.

Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_02.description: A robotic exo-suit top with a moulded chest plate, exposed tube and cable bundle at the midriff, and segmented mechanical sleeves with ringed joints at the elbows and wrists; ends at the ribs with a rim, with straps over the shoulders.
Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest plate, back plate and sleeve segments; colour 0 on the ring joints, chest flashes and spine strips; colour 2 on the underbust panels and waist rim; colour 3 on the shoulder straps and some cables.

Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_02_Phara.description: A cropped, sleeveless, form-fitting top ending above the navel, with a contrasting chest panel and a contrasting upper back. One arm is a segmented robotic sleeve with tubes and metal rings; the other arm is bare.
Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_02_Phara.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top body and the mechanical arm segments; colour 3 on the chest panel and shoulder accents; colour 2 on the upper back and collar area; colour 0 on the shoulder cap and the arm rings.

Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_03.description: A cropped, long-sleeved robotic exo-suit top with a moulded chest plate, exposed wire bundles at the midriff, a banded waist ring, and segmented mechanical arms with ring joints at the elbows and wrists.
Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest and back plates and the arm segments; colour 0 on the ring joints and chest stripes; colour 2 on the chest cups, waist band and back seam; colour 3 on the wires and shoulder accents.

Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_Alien_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length robotic exo-torso with a sculpted chest plate, a contrasting central spine panel and contrasting side stripes, paired with segmented mechanical arms that have ribbed joints and ring-like cuffs at the forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso base and the cuff rings; colour 1 on the chest plates and the ribbed arm segments; colour 3 on the shoulder and side stripes; colour 2 on the central spine panel and the chest underside.
Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_Alien_01.differs: The female torso is a fitted corset-like top with a sculpted bust and an exposed neckline, while the male version has a boxier vest with a padded shoulder yoke.

Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_Alien_02.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting robotic chest piece ending at the waist, with molded sculpted chest plates, a central vertical panel and segmented mechanical arm pieces with ring joints and exposed cabling. Suggests an alien exosuit.
Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso body, back panel and ring joints; colour 1 on the chest plates and segmented arm sections; colour 3 on the upper chest and side panels; colour 2 on the centre stripe and under-chest panels.

Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_Aquatic_.description: A fitted mesh-textured top with a scale-pattern weave, ending at the waist, with a thin harness plate across the chest and shoulders and segmented mechanical sleeves with ringed cuffs and cable detailing. Cybernetic, aquatic feel.

Female/F_Chest_Robotexo_Armboth_Warrior_.description: A cropped, sleeveless quilted chest piece with a round neckline and contrasting hem edge, paired with segmented robotic exoskeleton arms with ribbed upper sections and banded joint rings at the elbows and wrists. Sits above the midriff.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryr.differs: The female top has a narrower, corset-like waist with a pointed V panel between the breasts and more curved piping around the chest.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryy.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with chevron-shaped stripe panels down the chest and belly, shoulder caps, and banded stripes on the forearms. Ends at the waist with a contrasting hem band.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top and sleeves; colour 1 on the chevron stripes, collar edge, waist hem and sleeve bands; colour 2 on the shoulder panels; colour 3 on the forearm panels.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_01_Pharaoh.description: A form-fitting, long-sleeved cropped top that ends above the navel, with a plain scooped neckline, a separate panel over the chest and a contrasting panel across the upper back and outer arms. Tight-fitting casual superhero styling.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_01_Pharaoh.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the top and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the front chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back and outer arm panels; colour 0 on the forearms.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_90s_01.description: A tight, long-sleeved 90s-style top that ends at the waist. It has a central chest and shoulder panel, ribbed muscle-like side panels, a separate lower waist band, and mismatched sleeves. It sits close to the body with a round neckline.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_90s_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, shoulder and back panels; colour 0 on one sleeve and the ribbed side panels; colour 2 on the other sleeve and the lower waist band; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Alien_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top with sculpted, muscle-like panels: a raised chest plate, swooping side stripes, segmented back panels and a central contrasting spine wedge. It ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, torso sides and back centre panel; colour 1 on the chest plate and sleeves; colour 3 on the shoulder and rib stripes; colour 2 on the centre stomach and lower back wedges.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Alien_Hybrid.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped tight top ending above the navel, with a distinct rectangular chest panel, a high rounded neckline, and separate panels on the back, upper arms and forearms. A sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Alien_Hybrid.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the top and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the back of the shoulders, neck edge and rear of the arms; colour 0 on the forearms.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting scale-textured top with a crew neck, a contrasting harness-like panel across the shoulders and chest, a banded waist ending above the hips, and wrapped accent bands at the cuffs and waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scale-patterned body and sleeves; colour 2 on the shoulder and chest harness panel; colour 3 on the waist bands and cuff accents; colour 0 as the highlight in the scale pattern.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting scaled-mesh top with a separate smooth panel over the upper chest and shoulders and a matching corset-like waist band, edged with contrasting piping and banded cuffs; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scale-patterned sleeves, bust and back; colour 3 on the smooth upper chest panel and waist band; colour 2 on the piping, seams and cuff bands; colour 0 in the light scale pattern highlights.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tights top with a cropped contrasting-panel bodice, a contrasting central chest panel, separate cuffs and a short flared hem over the hips; the back and upper sleeves are a separate panel.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower hem and the forearm cuffs; colour 1 on the chest and upper body; colour 3 on the central chest panel; colour 2 on the collar, back yoke and upper sleeves.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_01.differs: The female version has a plain rounded chest panel with no neckline split, and a shorter cropped bodice with a flared hem.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped jacket top with a high neckline, a contrasting chest panel, angular shoulder plates and a short flared skirt-like hem reaching the hips. Sleeves have separate forearm sections. Archer-inspired, sporty superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower hem and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the upper chest, shoulders and back yoke; colour 3 on the centre chest panel; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder plates and back sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_03.description: A cropped, long-sleeved form-fitting tight shirt ending above the waist, with a contrasting centre chest panel, separate back and upper-sleeve panels, and cuffs at the forearms. Simple sporty superhero styling.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, front body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the centre chest panel; colour 2 on the collar, back yoke and rear sleeves; colour 0 on the forearm cuffs.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_04.description: A cropped, long-sleeved fitted shirt meant to sit under jackets: a chest panel, a small high collar, angular shoulder flaps and forearm cuffs. It ends above the waist, with a separate back yoke and contrasting sleeves.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main torso and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the front chest panel; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder flaps, back yoke and sleeves at the back; colour 0 on the forearm cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Archer_04.differs: The female version is cropped shorter above the waist with a rounded chest panel, while the male version reaches the waist and has a long centre stripe.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with a rounded neckline, curved piping lines down the chest and ribs, a V-shaped chevron across the upper back, and swooping striped bands on the forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, shoulders and upper back; colour 0 on the side panels, lower back and forearm bands; colour 2 on the upper sleeves; colour 3 on the piping, neckline trim and forearm stripes.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top ending at the waist, with a yoked shoulder panel and rounded collar, banded upper sleeves, curved line details on the chest and back, and contrasting piping.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and forearms; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke, upper sleeves and cuffs; colour 2 on the striped bands and chest and back line details; colour 3 on the collar and piping.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_02.differs: The female version has curved, swooping line details on the chest, while the male version has a straighter, angular bracket pattern.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Bird_People.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped top with an overlapping feather-scale yoke across the shoulders and upper chest, a glossy metallic bra-like cup piece with straps, and a contrasting hem band at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Bird_People.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feathered shoulder yoke and the hem band; colour 3 on the sleeves and midriff; colour 0 on the metallic bra cups and straps (glossy metal, largely ignores the scheme).
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Bird_People.differs: The female version adds a glossy metallic bra-style cup piece with straps over the chest, and a bare feathered yoke with a scooped neckline, where the male has a continuous feathered collar.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Bird_People_Jacket.description: A fitted, long-sleeved jacket ending at the waist, with a feather-textured upper chest panel, glossy rounded bust cups, a banded waist hem and separate sleeves. The upper back is contrasting and plain. Suggests a bird-themed superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Bird_People_Jacket.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bust cups and the upper back; colour 1 on the feathered chest panel, collar and hem band; colour 3 on the midriff section and sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Blaster_01.description: A mechanical chest emitter: a large round cannon disc with a recessed central lens and segmented rim, a notched outer edge, a shoulder yoke over the collar area and a partial band around the lower ribs.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Blaster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder yoke, ring segments and lower band; colour 1 on the disc face and notched outer shell; colour 3 on the trim edges of the yoke and band; colour 2 on the central lens.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Blaster_01.differs: The female disc is smaller and sits centred higher on the chest, with a thinner, more open lower band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting top with a shaggy, fur-like torso texture that ragged-edges over the shoulders, and fine scaled sleeves running down to the wrists. Ends at the waist; creature-hybrid look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furry torso and shoulders; colour 3 on the scaled sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Classic_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with ornate swirling scrollwork panels over the chest, shoulders and upper back, a banded lower edge, and thin angular trim accents at the wrists.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sleeves, collar and lower torso; colour 0 on the shoulder and chest panels; colour 1 on the swirling scroll motifs and waist band; colour 2 on the curling outline trim and wrist accents.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Classic_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tights top with abstract zebra-like swirling stripes across the chest, shoulders and upper back, a plain band at the waist and neck, and striped panels at the wrists. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Classic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sleeves, neckline and waist band; colour 0 on the chest and back panels; colour 2 on the stripes over the shoulders and chest; colour 1 on the wrist stripes and the chest swirls.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Classic_03.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved superhero top ending at the waist, with branching web-like vein patterns across the chest, shoulders and back, a separate band at the waist, and contrasting forearm panels with pointed flame-like edges.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Classic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and upper arms; colour 2 on the web-like vein patterns; colour 3 on the waist band and forearm panels; colour 1 on the thin curved accent lines at the forearm edges and cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Classic_03.differs: The female web pattern is more compact on the chest, with a central starburst and fewer lines running across the upper arms and shoulders.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Classic_04.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped tights top with swooping outlined bands over the shoulders and chest, a belt-like band at the waist, striped cuffs, and a separate midriff panel below the chest. It ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Classic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulders and upper torso; colour 3 on the forearms, upper-arm panels and midriff panel; colour 2 on the outline bands and waist band; colour 1 on the chest and back stripes and the cuff stripes.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Clockwork_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight cropped top that ends above the navel, with a large rectangular chest panel, a separate upper-back and rear-sleeve panel, and forearm sections in a different tone. A simple superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Clockwork_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back and the back of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearms.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Color_Patch_01.description: A plain, skin-tight long-sleeved top ending at the waist, split into large angular colour-block patches across the chest, torso and arms, giving a harlequin-like superhero look with no other details.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Color_Patch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the patch over one forearm and the upper chest wedge; colour 1 on the centre chest and lower waist wedges; colour 2 on the other forearm, one side of the chest and the waist band; colour 3 on the shoulder and upper arm and the lower torso wedge.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tights top ending above the navel, with a broad multi-band sash running diagonally from one shoulder across the chest to the opposite ribs, and matching banded stripes around each forearm.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 3 and colour 1 on the outer bands of the diagonal sash and forearm stripes; colour 2 on the central band between them.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.differs: The female top is cropped higher and leaves the midriff bare below the chest, with the sash sweeping under the bust.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Corrupted_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero top with a glossy upper section over the chest and shoulders, a jagged scalloped lower edge, and a contrasting laced-look waist panel with contrasting side panels; ends at the waist. Bare skin arms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest and shoulder section; colour 1 on the centre waist panel; colour 2 on the side waist panels; colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending under the chest, with a raised open collar ring, shoulder plates, a split front chest panel, a banded hem and separate forearm sections.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and one side of the chest and back; colour 3 on the front chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back and back of the arms; colour 0 on the collar, shoulder plates, hem band and forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cosmic_01.differs: The female version has a rounded, contoured chest panel with a curved hem and a larger open collar ring, and the front hem dips into a small notch.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cosmos_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a V-shaped chest panel, ribbed swooping shoulder caps, a banded ribbed waist section and V-shaped back lines; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest and upper back panel; colour 3 on the ribbed shoulder caps and the back V lines; colour 2 on the sides, sleeves and lower torso; colour 0 on the waist bands and some sleeve highlights.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cosmos_02.description: A long-sleeved, glossy form-fitting superhero top with a V-shaped neckline, chevron-patterned corset-like front panel, and twin swooping stripes running over the shoulders and down the arms; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy chest and upper sleeves; colour 2 on the chevron front panel, back and forearms; colour 1 on the collar and waist side panels; colour 3 on the stripes down the arms.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cryo_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with glossy shoulder caps, a lightning-notched chest panel, a corset-style banded waist section and angular contrasting panels down the arms; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar area, forearm panels and outlines; colour 1 on the chest and sleeve panels; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and centre torso; colour 3 on the corset waist band.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cryo_01.differs: The female top has a corset-like banded waist and a lightning-shaped notch across the chest.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting sci-fi top with raised armor-like panels over the chest, shoulders and arms, a segmented waist band, a low collar, and a paneled back with a central spine motif; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised chest, shoulder and arm panels; colour 0 on the upper chest, sides and base fabric; colour 2 on the collar, forearms, waist band and back panels; colour 3 on the small dots.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cyberpunk jacket ending at the waist, with a high standing collar, a segmented plated chest panel, rounded shoulder caps, and armoured strips down the sleeves. A raised panel sits on the upper back.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and midriff plating; colour 1 on the jacket body, collar and sleeves; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and panel seams; colour 3 on the small sleeve and back markings.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The female version has a smooth, large contrasting chest plate with a cropped, closed collar, while the male has ribbed side panels and a bulkier, armoured arm design with a lower open collar.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting sci-fi bodysuit top with sculpted chest plates, segmented panels along the ribs and spine, small stud lights at the shoulders, and contrasting upper-arm bands; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main suit body and sleeves; colour 0 on the chest plates, upper-arm bands and lower torso panel; colour 2 on the side and back segmented panels and collar; colour 3 on the small shoulder studs.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Defender_Update_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero crop top ending above the navel, with a large rectangular chest panel, separate forearm sections, and a contrasting upper back and shoulder yoke. Smooth tights-like finish.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the top and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back and shoulder yoke and rear of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearms and a narrow band at the waist.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Deity_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with thin linear seam lines tracing the chest, ribs and back, a swooping contrasting band across the shoulders, and separate bands at the wrists.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 3 on the shoulder bands; colour 2 on the thin seam lines; colour 1 on the wrist cuffs.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Draco_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with rounded shoulder and chest panels, a V neckline, a separate waist panel with a banded hem, and bracer-like forearm sections; it ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder, chest and back panels and the forearm inserts; colour 3 on the waist panel, chest centre and forearm sections; colour 0 on the upper sleeves; colour 2 on the outlines, piping and hem bands.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Dragonbodylockbox_6.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting bodysuit top ending at the waist, with sculpted rounded chest panels, a notched V-shaped centre panel, and a plain solid back and sleeves. Suggests a superhero or dragon-themed look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Dragonbodylockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sleeves, shoulders and back; colour 1 on the sculpted chest panels; colour 0 on the centre chest notch and lower midriff panel; colour 2 on the small underarm side panels at the back.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a glossy corset-like armored bodice over the torso and bust, flame-like swooping points on the upper arms, a round neckline with contrasting trim, ending at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulders, upper arms and body of the top; colour 1 on the neckline trim, flame points and forearm sleeves; colour 3 on the outer bodice panels; colour 2 on the glossy centre bodice plates.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Firebird_01.differs: The female bodice is a shaped corset with separate bust cups and a cinched waist, while the male version has a flat sculpted muscle-chest plate.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Fish_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight top ending at the waist, printed with lionfish-like swooping stripe patterns, branching vein-like lines radiating from the collar, and ringed bands on the forearms; fitted to the torso and arms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Fish_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light stripe panels and lower torso; colour 1 on the broad swooping stripes and sleeves; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and ringed arm bands; colour 3 on the branching lines and neck and cuff edging.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Formal_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting dress shirt with a pointed collar, a concealed centre button placket, a yoke seam across the back and buttoned cuffs; it ends at the waist with a slightly gathered hem.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Formal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shirt including collar, placket and cuffs; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Foxtech_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with a bat-wing emblem across the chest, shaped panels over the shoulders and ribs, a diamond mark on the back, and armoured forearm guards.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Foxtech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest centre, back and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the shoulder caps and ribs; colour 1 on the inner sleeves, side panels and piping; colour 2 on the bat emblem, back diamond and forearm guards.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Foxtech_01.differs: The female top has a bat emblem that sits over the bust, with a narrower, corseted waist panel and a smaller contrasting side panel.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Gamer_01.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved gamer top ending at the midriff, with circuit-board line patterns across the chest and back, a round trim-edged neckline and hem, and honeycomb-textured lower sleeves.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top; colour 1 on the circuit-line patterns; colour 3 on the neckline and waist hem trim; colour 2 on the honeycomb forearm sleeves.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Gamer_01.differs: The female circuit pattern forms swooping tiger-stripe-like bands across the chest, whereas the male version has a geometric triangular circuit design.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tights top with a wide scoop neckline, raised outlines forming a chevron pattern across the chest and back, ribbed upper sleeves and segmented plated forearm guards; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and shoulders; colour 1 on the ribbed upper sleeves and the waist hem; colour 2 on the outline piping and the segmented forearm sections.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Glow_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tight ending at the waist, with a textured base, bold panelled shapes across the chest, back and arms, thin contrasting piping, and glossy inset patches on the chest and forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured base, lower hem and cuffs; colour 1 on the large chest, shoulder and back panels and sleeve bands; colour 3 on the piping outlines; colour 2 on the glossy inset patches.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Glow_01.differs: The female version has two glossy patches on the chest, one over each side of the bust, where the male has a single round patch at the centre of the chest.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting jacket-style top with a deep plunging V neckline edged by wide lapels, and a thin seam down the centre front. It ends at the waist, giving a retro superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body and sleeves of the top; colour 1 on the lapels and the centre front seam; colour 2 on the inner back collar edge.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Gravitar_01.description: A revealing bandeau-style top with sculpted cups and a pointed corset-like centre panel, worn with beaded chains that loop around the neck and drape across the chest to the waist. Bare midriff, arms and back; edgy, punk-glam look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Gravitar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cups and centre panel; colour 2 on the beaded chains and small waist clasp; the arms and midriff show the bare skin of the body and take no colour slot.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Harnessherculean_01.description: A partial mechanical harness of two separate padded pieces: a wide bib-like collar plate over the upper chest and shoulders, and a curved band wrapping the ribs under the bust with a small square buckle at the front.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Harnessherculean_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar plate and the rib band; colour 3 on the inner edges and rim trim of both pieces; colour 1 and colour 2 are not visible.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Harnessherculean_01.differs: The female collar plate is smaller and sits lower and narrower on the chest, and the rib band sits under the bust, where the male band crosses the chest.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped superhero top that ends above the waist, with a large rectangular chest panel, a high rounded neckline, and separate lower sleeve sections. The back has a broad panel across the shoulders.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the collar, back shoulder panel and rear of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearms.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a quilted hexagon-textured chest and arms, thin piping lines over the shoulders and under the bust, a small contrasting collar insert and a corset-like waist band ending at the ribs.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted chest and sleeves; colour 3 on the piping lines; colour 2 on the collar insert and waist band; colour 1 on the lower edge trim of the waist band.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Hoses_01.differs: The female top has a quilted hexagon texture with piping only over the shoulders and under the bust, and a separate corset-like waist band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01.description: A plain, close-fitting jacket base: a smooth sleeveless torso shell with a slightly ragged raised neckline, ending at the midriff, plus separate fitted forearm sleeves that leave the upper arms bare. Suits layered jacket designs.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole torso and forearm sleeves; a faint shading band at the hem, with no other visible colour slots.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01_Legendary.description: A form-fitting, long-sleeved superhero jacket in a sentai style, with a high contrasting collar, sculpted contrasting panels over the chest and a V-shaped centre insert. It ends at the waist, with a bare midriff and banded, cuffed forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01_Legendary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the midriff panel, the upper back and the upper arms; colour 1 on the chest and shoulder panels, the back waist band and the forearm sections; colour 3 on the chest centre insert and the forearm patches; colour 2 on the collar and the cuffs.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01_Legendary.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting sentai-style top with a V-shaped collar panel, a chevron-shaped panel between the chest and waist, and a fitted waist band. Separate forearm sleeves with angular diamond panels and bands sit below bare upper arms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01_Legendary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest and upper body; colour 3 on the V-collar, the chest chevron and the diamond panels on the sleeves; colour 1 on the waist band and the forearm sleeves; colour 2 on the dividing stripe at the waist and the bands on the sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01_Legendary.description: A form-fitting sentai-style superhero jacket top with a bold sleeveless-looking chest panel, a V-shaped neckline, a corseted waist band with contrasting trim, and long fitted sleeves with angled panels; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01_Legendary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso, sleeves and back; colour 3 on the chest panel and forearm panels; colour 1 on the neckline, waist and cuff trim; colour 2 on the waist side panels.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01_Legendary.description: A form-fitting superhero sentai top with a V-shaped collar, sculpted rounded bust panels and a chevron-patterned midriff, ending at the waist. Separate banded forearm sleeves with contrasting stripes leave the upper arms bare.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_01_Legendary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bust panels, midriff centre and sleeve bases; colour 1 on the collar, chevron bands, waist trim and sleeve stripes; colour 2 on the inner collar panel and sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on the forearm panels.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso base; colour 3 on the star pattern; colour 1 on the collar and sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_04.description: A form-fitting superhero jacket top with a short, sleeveless-looking torso ending at the waist, a corset-like banded hem, a central vertical stripe with a star emblem at the chest, and separate detached forearm sleeves with star accents.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the stripe borders, hem band and star accents; colour 2 on the central stripe and hem lines; colour 3 on the small centre detail at the chest.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_05.description: A form-fitting, long-sleeved superhero top with a small rounded collar and a diagonal glossy panel sweeping across the chest and waist. Separate sleeves stop short of the wrists, and the hem ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top, collar and sleeves; colour 1 on the glossy diagonal chest and waist panel; the edge lines around the panel follow colour 2.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_06.description: A sleeveless-looking, form-fitting superhero torso piece ending at the waist, with a high rounded neckline and separate long forearm sleeves. Star-patterned stripe panels run down the sides of the ribs and along the outer arms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and inner sleeve surfaces; colour 3 on the side stripe panels of the ribs and arms; colour 1 on the stars within those stripes.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_07.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved superhero top with a jagged zigzag neckline collar, a star-patterned torso ending at the waist, and fitted forearm sleeves with matching jagged edges. The upper back looks open.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso base and upper sleeve edges; colour 3 on the star pattern; colour 1 on the jagged collar and forearm sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_08.description: A form-fitting, sleeveless tight top that ends at the waist, with a high rounded neckline and a plain torso. Separate forearm sleeves are printed with a scattered star pattern, giving a casual superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_08.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the torso; colour 0 on the forearm sleeves as the base; colour 3 on the star patterns on the sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_09.description: A form-fitting, long-sleeved jacket top with a star-patterned centre panel down the front, a small standing collar, and fitted side panels and sleeves; the back is mostly open above a narrow waist band. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_09.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the side panels, sleeves and lower back band; colour 0 on the star-patterned centre panel and collar; colour 3 on the stars; colour 2 on the seam edging along the centre panel.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_10.description: A tight, long-sleeved, waist-length superhero top with a split design: one half is smooth and plain, the other half carries a star-burst pattern with a wavy dividing edge. It has a round neckline and sits close to the body.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Stars_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plain half of the torso and its sleeve; colour 0 on the patterned half of the torso and sleeve; colour 3 on the star motifs.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Swan_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting corset-style top with a deep V neckline, swooping glossy panels down the centre and bust, and a cinched laced-looking waist band. Short cap shoulders; ends at the waist, suggesting a sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bust curves, cap shoulders, back panel and lower centre stripe; colour 2 on the glossy centre chest panel; colour 1 on the V collar edge and the waist band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Tactical_01.description: A form-fitting tactical jacket base with long sleeves, a pointed shoulder yoke around the neck, a slim midriff-length torso ending above the waist, and contrasting wristbands. Thin accent stripes run down the chest and arms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and sleeves; colour 1 on the neck yoke, waist band and inner sleeve panels; colour 3 on the thin stripes and dashes; colour 2 on the wrist bands.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Traveler_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting torso layer with a scooped neckline that ends at the waist, with a gradient band at the hem, plus separate forearm sleeves that stop at the elbow. Meant to sit under jackets.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso body; colour 1 on the lower hem band, blending up into the torso; colour 3 on the forearm sleeves; colour 2 on the thin neckline and hem edging.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Urban_Anime_.description: A cropped, form-fitting tube-style jacket top with a large open keyhole exposing the chest, a trimmed hem above the midriff, a small back collar, and separate fitted sleeve segments on the forearms with banded upper edges. Anime-inspired street look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Urban_Anime_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back panel, midriff band and lower forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the chest cups, hem trim and upper sleeve bands; colour 2 on the back collar and the rear of the forearm sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valdia_01.description: A fitted, waist-length superhero jacket top with a sculpted, armour-like chest, a V-shaped collar, a triangular emblem panel down the centre and segmented forearm guards on the sleeves. The back is mostly open, with a band across the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valdia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and torso shell; colour 1 on the collar, back waist band and forearm sleeves; colour 2 on the outlines, edging and seams; colour 3 on the triangular chest emblem.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valelectric_.description: A form-fitting, sleeveless superhero jacket top with a deep V neckline, a layered chevron panel down the chest, swooping trim lines over the ribs, and separate fitted forearm sleeves; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valelectric_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest V panel, back and collar; colour 1 on the bust, midsection panel and forearm sleeves; colour 2 on the swooping trim lines and neckline edge; colour 3 on the shoulder and sleeve accents.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valerian_01.description: A tight, form-fitting cropped jacket that ends at the waist, with a short upright collar and separate forearm sleeves. Swooping horn-like markings, a circular motif and a triangle decorate the torso, and thin vein-like lines run over the torso and sleeves.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, collar and sleeves; colour 3 on the swooping chest markings, circle and triangle; colour 1 on the thin vein-like lines; colour 2 on the centre of the circular motif.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valflare_01.description: A form-fitting superhero top with a glossy centre chest panel, swooping flame-like panels over the shoulders and ribs, and a corset-style waist band with pointed panels. Sleeves are fitted forearm sleeves with striped panels; the back is largely open.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valflare_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy chest panel and forearm panels; colour 0 on the shoulder swooshes and pointed waist panels; colour 3 on the side rib panels and sleeve stripes; colour 1 on the waist band and sleeve trim.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valhex_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a rounded bust, a corset-style waist panel with a V-shaped centre detail, curving piping lines across the shoulders and down the sleeves, and a small collar; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valhex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 1 on the collar and the small cuff-side patches at the upper arms; colour 2 on the piping lines and waist band; colour 3 on the V-shaped waist panel.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valstar_01.description: A form-fitting superhero jacket top with sculpted bust panels, a pointed V-shaped collar, a corseted waist with layered plates, and separate segmented forearm sleeves. It ends at the waist and leaves the upper arms bare.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bust panels, waist base and sleeve edges; colour 3 on the collar, chest and waist plates and the forearm panels; colour 1 on the side panels under the arms; colour 2 on the trim outlining the panels.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valvee_01.description: A form-fitting superhero jacket with sculpted armour-like chest plates bearing a V-shaped emblem, a corset-style banded waist, and long sleeves with angular cuff and elbow panels; the back is mostly open, and it ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Valvee_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates and sleeves; colour 1 on the waist band and sleeve panels; colour 2 on the piping and trim lines; colour 3 on the chest V emblem and small accents.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Vigilante_01.description: A form-fitting superhero top with a pointed collar, a corset-style waist panel with a V-shaped chest emblem, and short shoulder caps over long tight sleeves that stop at the wrists. It ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, upper chest, back and sleeves; colour 1 on the bust panels, shoulder caps, waist side panels and cuffs; colour 2 on the centre corset panel; colour 3 on the V-shaped chest emblem.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Warrior_01.description: A cropped, form-fitting quilted top with a diamond-stitched pattern, a thin round neckline and a contrasting hem band, paired with separate quilted forearm sleeves with banded cuffs. Leaves the midriff and upper arms bare.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jacket_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted top and sleeves; colour 1 on the hem band and sleeve cuffs; colour 2 on the neckline edge.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jeweled_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a textured, jewel-studded surface, smooth shoulder caps, a teardrop panel down the centre front and back, and striped forearms; it ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jeweled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured body and sleeve stripes; colour 1 on the piping and edge borders; colour 3 on the shoulder caps, centre teardrop panels and forearm stripes.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Jeweled_01.differs: The female top has a high rounded neckline with a centre-front zip line and a single long teardrop panel, while the male version has a scoop neck and a cluster of petal-shaped panels across the chest.
