Female/F_Chest_Tight_Kaiju_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with sculpted ribbed plates across the chest and shoulders, a separate side and neck panel, contrasting forearm panels, and a spine-like ridged motif down the back.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest plates, shoulder caps, back spine motif and lower forearms; colour 3 on the neck and side panels and the back waist panel; colour 0 on the upper arms, upper back and waist hem; colour 2 on the inner forearm panels.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Kaiju_01.differs: The female chest plates are sculpted into ribbed, bust-shaped segments, while the male version shows smooth muscle definition.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Kigatilik_01.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved crew-neck top ending at the waist, printed with tiger-like horizontal stripes on the arms, ribs and back, with fuzzy streaked markings and a spine-and-rib pattern across the back.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Kigatilik_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the top and the chest; colour 2 on the stripes; colour 0 on the fuzzy streaks and markings; colour 1 on the small patches on the torso.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A long-sleeved, cropped, form-fitting top with a short bolero-like hem above the midriff, contrasting lower sleeves, a small bow at the collar and a large shaggy fur tuft covering the chest. Suits a festive, monstrous look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the torso and upper front of the sleeves; colour 2 on the back, shoulders and back of the arms; colour 0 on the lower sleeves and midriff band; colour 3 on the bow; the chest fur mixes colour 1 and colour 2.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The female version has a shaggy fur tuft over the chest and a small bow at the collar, in place of the plain chest panel.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Leathersuit.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting leathersuit top with a V-shaped chest panel, contrasting side panels at the ribs and waist, and panelled sleeves. It ends at the waist and suggests a sleek tactical or superhero look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Leathersuit.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main torso and outer sleeves; colour 2 on the chest panel and the back of the upper arms; colour 0 on the inner sleeves, shoulder tops and centre back panel; colour 3 on the waist side panels.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.description: A form-fitting sci-fi top with short cap sleeves, sculpted contrasting armor-like panels curving over the chest, shoulders and upper back, and a separate corset-style band at the midriff. It ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 2 on the sculpted chest, shoulder and back panels; colour 1 on the waist band.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The female top has cap sleeves and chest panels that curve around the bust, with a cinched corset-like waist band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a V-neck collar, angled shoulder straps, a corset-like segmented waist band and banded upper arms with piped edging; the back has an open panel and it ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves, shoulders and chest; colour 0 on the back panel and belly; colour 2 on the bust panels, corset band and shoulder straps; colour 3 on the piping and arm bands.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.differs: The female version has contrasting cup-like panels over the bust and a light panel on the belly below the corset, while the male version has a light panel across the upper chest.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length fitted jacket with a high stand collar, a ruffle-edged shoulder yoke with buttons, puffed sleeves gathered into banded cuffs with frilled edges, and seam lines down the front. A small winged emblem sits on the back.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and cuff frills; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke and the back emblem; colour 2 on the ruffle edging, seam piping, waist band and cuff bands; colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight patchwork top made of irregular angular patches joined by contrasting cross-stitched seams, in a jester style. It covers the torso and arms and ends at the waist with a plain hem.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body patches; colour 0 on the light patches; colour 3 on the accent patches; colour 2 on the stitching.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Magicalgirl_01.description: A strapless, corset-style bustier with a sweetheart neckline and swooping folded cups. Jagged contrasting panels sit at the sides, with a zigzag-edged peplum flaring at the waist. Cute magical-girl look worn over the torso.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Magicalgirl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neckline cups and the jagged peplum edge; colour 1 on the main bodice and the waist band; colour 2 on the side panels and lower back panel; colour 3 on the zigzag accents at the waist.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Magicalgirl_Bow_01.description: A strapless, corset-style bustier with a ruffled, jagged-edged bust, a wide banded midriff and a small ornament with hanging tails at the centre front, plus a separate low triangular brief panel below. Cute magical-girl styling.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Magicalgirl_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled bust cups and the lower brief panel; colour 1 on the side and lower corset panels and the brief edges; colour 2 on the wide central corset band; colour 0 on the centre ornament.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top with a plunging V-neck and a bustier-like centre panel outlined in contrasting piping, a separate band at the waist, and striped panels down the back of the arms; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulders, neckline and sleeves; colour 3 on the chest and back panel; colour 1 on the waist band and the stripes along the arms; colour 2 on the outline piping.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.differs: The female top has a sculpted bustier-style chest panel with a scooped neckline, while the male panel is a flatter V-shaped chest plate.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with jagged lightning-bolt stripes across the chest and upper back, a fitted centre panel, angular wedge panels on the forearms, and a ribbed panel at the lower back.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, back and inner sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulders, upper arms and waist panel; colour 3 on the lightning stripes; colour 2 on the forearm wedges and lower-back ribbing.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with segmented armor-like panels over the chest, ribs and shoulders, a ribbed spine and back plating, and banded sleeves; ends at the waist with a contrasting hem.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, rib and shoulder plates; colour 1 on the collar, side panels, sleeve bands and hem; colour 2 on the central chest and abdomen inserts and the lower forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Nighthawk_01.differs: The female top has separately shaped, ribbed cups over the bust and a more cinched waist, and a smaller central chest insert.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Partial_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting sleek torso top ending at the waist, with mechanical segmented arm sleeves: ribbed bulbous upper arms, ringed cuffs at elbow and wrist, and exposed cable-like inner joints. Suggests a cyborg look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and the metal rings at the elbows and wrists; colour 1 on the ribbed arm segments; colour 3 on the small trim at the shoulder edges; colour 2 on the inner joints and cables.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Partial_01.differs: The female torso is a plain smooth top, with no armor-like shoulder plates.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Partial_02.description: A sleeveless bra-style top with a bare midriff and mechanical cyborg arms: segmented ribbed upper arms, exposed cable-like joints and ringed metal bands at the forearms. Fitted to the torso with small shoulder plates.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bra top, arm rings and forearm bands; colour 1 on the ribbed arm segments and trim edging; colour 3 on the shoulder plate accents; colour 2 on the inner joint cables.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Partial_02.differs: The female version is only a short bra-style top leaving the midriff bare, whereas the male version covers the whole torso to the waist.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Patternseta_Bolt_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top split diagonally into two halves, with branching lightning-bolt crack lines across the chest and back. It ends at the waist and leaves the neck bare.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Patternseta_Bolt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one half of the top, including one sleeve and shoulder; colour 1 on the other half, including the other sleeve and the lower torso; colour 2 on the branching bolt lines.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Patternseta_Fire_01.description: A skin-tight superhero top that covers the torso and arms, with flame-shaped edges licking down from the shoulders and upper back across the chest and arms. It has short sleeves over long fitted lower-arm sleeves, and ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Patternseta_Fire_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulder and upper-chest flame area; colour 0 on the lower torso and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the flame edge highlights; colour 2 on the flame tips at the sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top with a deep V-neck, a central panel running down the front, a separate waist panel and contrasting trim, and cuff sections on the forearms. It ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulders, chest and upper sleeves; colour 1 on the V-shaped trim and back yoke; colour 3 on the centre front panel and forearm cuffs; colour 2 on the side and lower back waist panels.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Phantom_01.differs: The female top has a narrow contrasting centre stripe over a fully covered chest, while the male shows a wide bare-looking torso panel.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Phantom_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top ending at the waist, with a wide layered scalloped collar panel over the shoulders, chevron stripes on the ribs and back, and banded stripes on the forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Phantom_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and sleeves; colour 2 on the shoulder collar panel; colour 1 on the wavy collar trim line; colour 3 on the rib chevrons and forearm bands.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Phantom_02.differs: The female version has a scalloped collar with wavy trim and striped forearm bands, with chevron stripes on the ribs, whereas the male version uses large colour-blocked panels.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Phantom_03.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top with a V-shaped yoke across the shoulders and upper chest, jagged spiked edges below it, a contrasting waist band, and separate forearm sections with pointed tops. It ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Phantom_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and upper sleeves; colour 2 on the shoulder yoke; colour 3 on the V stripe and forearm sections; colour 1 on the waist band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Pulp_Formalrolled_0.description: A fitted button-up pinstriped shirt with a small folded collar and sleeves rolled to three-quarter length with turned-back cuffs. It ends at the waist with a slightly flared hem, giving a smart office look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Pulp_Formalrolled_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and the base of the shirt; colour 1 on the vertical pinstripes; forearms and hands are the mannequin's bare skin, not part of the piece.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Pumpkin_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight top with a painted-on bone-like pattern: a bold main section over the chest, shoulders and arms, contrasting forearms, and an ornate ribcage and spine motif around the midriff. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chest, shoulders and upper arms; colour 0 on the forearms and bone-like midriff panels; colour 1 on the swirling rib and spine markings; colour 2 on the waistband details.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Pumpkin_01.differs: The female version has an intricate ribcage and spine pattern in swirling markings on the torso, while the male version uses plain blocks of colour.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Punk_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight top that ends at the waist, with a high round neckline, contrasting shoulder caps and flame-shaped panels at the lower ribs. The arms are bare skin.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso; colour 1 on the flame panels at the waist; colour 2 on the shoulder caps. The arms show skin and are not part of the colour scheme.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Radical_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight top with a scooped neckline and bare skin-toned arms and shoulders. Contrasting side panels run down the ribs, and the hem ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Radical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso; colour 1 on one side panel; colour 2 on the other side panel; skin-toned arms and neckline are not tinted by the scheme.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Rave_01.description: A sleeveless fishnet mesh tank with thin trimmed straps and hem, worn over a patterned bikini-style bra top that shows through; sits at the waist, with bare skin arms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fishnet mesh; colour 1 on the bra top; colour 2 on the edge trim along the neckline, straps and hem. Arms are skin and not recoloured.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Rave_01.differs: The female version has a separate patterned bra top layered under the mesh, which covers the chest with a distinct cup shape.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Rave_Jacket_01.description: A fitted fishnet mesh top with a patterned bra-style bust overlay, thin trim along the neckline and hem, and solid short sleeves across the upper back and shoulders; ends at the waist for a club or rave look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Rave_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the short sleeves and upper back panel; colour 1 on the bust cups and mesh pattern; colour 2 on the trim along the neckline, armholes and hem.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Ravenswood.description: A form-fitting, cropped superhero jacket-top with glossy short puffed sleeves, a shoulder and collar yoke, and a central chest cutout showing the midriff. Plain long tight sleeves run to the wrists, with contrasting-edged panel seams.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Ravenswood.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long sleeves, lower hem and the chest and abdomen fill; colour 1 on the collar, shoulder yoke and back chevron panel; colour 2 on the glossy short sleeves and chest panels; colour 3 on the seam piping.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with sculpted armor-like plates over the chest, shoulders and forearms, a central contrasting panel, contrasting-lined seams down the arms and a banded waist ending at the midriff.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulder and forearm plates; colour 1 on the fabric of the sleeves, shoulders and back; colour 2 on the central chest panel, back spine panel and cuff bands; colour 3 on the seam piping and waist band.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The female version has separately sculpted rounded chest cups and a narrower, corset-like waist band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting retro superhero top with a glossy chest-and-arm plate, a separate yoke over the shoulders and neck, a waist band with a notched centre panel, and contrasting bands at the elbows and wrists.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, sleeves and lower waist panel; colour 1 on the yoke and waist band; colour 3 on the elbow bands; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and wrist cuffs.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight retro superhero top with a round neckline edged in thin trim, two contrasting bands on each upper arm, contrasting forearm sleeves, and a V-notched waistband ending at the midriff.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and upper arms; colour 1 on the forearm sleeves and the waistband; colour 2 on the bands around the upper arms; colour 3 on the neckline and waist edge trim.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.differs: The female top has a waistband with a pronounced V-notch at the front and sits a little higher on the midriff.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting retro sci-fi jumpsuit top ending at the waist, with a V-shaped yoked collar panel over the shoulders, two small strap tabs down the centre front, contrasting waist band, and banded upper arm and wrist cuffs. One sleeve is a separate panel.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and one sleeve; colour 3 on the yoke, waist band, strap tabs and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the upper-arm band; colour 2 on the other sleeve.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top that ends above the navel, with a large rectangular chest panel, contrasting shoulder-to-back panels and separate forearm sections. Smooth, glossy and retro in feel.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main torso and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the back of the shoulders, upper arms and midriff; colour 0 on the forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.differs: The female top ends higher, with a contrasting midriff band at the waist, and has light forearm sections; the male version has a light band at the hem.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tight top with a high neck, a V-shaped centre chest panel, swooping side panels, contrasting shoulder and arm stripes, and a smooth back panel; it ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main torso and sleeves; colour 2 on the front chest panel and lower back arm panels; colour 0 on the shoulder and forearm stripes and the upper back panel; colour 3 on the waist side accents.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting sporty superhero top with a round contrasting neck band, shoulder caps, ribbed textured panels across the upper chest, forearms and waist band, and contrasting cuffs. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso, upper chest and small arm bands; colour 1 on the shoulder caps; colour 2 on the ribbed chest, waist and forearm panels; colour 3 on the neck band, shoulder piping and cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_01.differs: The female top has swooping curved ribbed panels across the chest and a cinched, curved waist band, where the male has angular chevron panels.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tight top ending at the waist, with a contrasting yoke across the shoulders and upper chest, rounded shoulder caps, a lower chest panel, and banded forearm sections with thin trim rings at the wrists.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke and lower chest panel; colour 2 on the forearm bands; colour 3 on the trim edging of the shoulders, collar and cuffs.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Scaled_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top with a large chest panel, horizontal banded plates down the midriff, curved piping over the shoulders, and contrasting bands on the upper arm and wrist. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Scaled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest panel, midriff bands and forearms; colour 1 on the shoulders, sides and back; colour 3 on the piping and hem trim; colour 2 on the arm bands.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Scarab_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top with a scarab-inspired design: curved crescent chest plates, segmented armour-like abdomen panels, a shaped back panel, and contrasting cuffs. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar area, upper chest, side flashes and lower back; colour 1 on the abdomen, back panel and sleeve panels; colour 3 on the crescent chest marks; colour 2 on the side ribs, inner arm panels and cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Scarab_01.differs: The female version has separate rounded chest cups with crescent marks and a cinched, corset-like waist, while the male has flatter crescents across the pecs.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Scarab_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a V-shaped neckline, scarab-like piping across the chest and midriff, segmented armour-style panels on the forearms and upper arms, and a large shield-shaped back panel; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the top and sleeves; colour 0 on the collar, side ribs, arm bands and back surround; colour 3 on the chest and midriff piping; colour 2 on the back panel and arm patches.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped tight top ending above the navel, with a large rectangular chest panel, a separate back yoke and upper-sleeve panel, and contrasting lower forearm sections. Sci-fi soldier style.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main torso and upper front sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the collar, back yoke and rear of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearms and midriff band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_01.description: A loose, baggy long-sleeved crew-neck sweater ending at the hips, with ribbed cuffs and hem and a small pocket at the side. Its colour is split into diagonal and vertical panels, giving a casual, sporty look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower body and cuffs; colour 1 on the large diagonal panel of the chest, sleeves and back; colour 2 on the neck-side and back panel; colour 3 on the bands across the upper arms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_01.differs: The female sweater uses a diagonal multi-panel colour split with stripes on the upper arms, with a small side pocket instead of a large front pouch pocket.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_03.description: A casual knit sweater-vest layered over a collared shirt with short sleeves. The vest has a deep V neckline, contrasting trim at the armholes and ribbed hem, and ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the shirt collar and short sleeves; colour 2 on the trim at the armholes, V neckline and hem.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_03.differs: The female version has slightly shorter, tighter-fitting sleeves and a shallower V neckline that shows less of the collar.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A sleeveless, lumpy padded torso shaped like a snowball, ending at the waist, with mechanical segmented arms of ribbed coils, jointed cables and cuff rings from shoulder to wrist. Comic robotic-snowman look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the puffy torso and the arm cuff rings; colour 1 on the ribbed arm segments; colour 3 on the shoulder trim; colour 2 on the arm joints and cables.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The shoulder trim shows as narrow contrasting-slot straps over the shoulders, and the torso is shorter and curvier with a defined bust.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Space_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting futuristic bodysuit top with glossy sculpted chest panels, curved piping lines across the chest and back, a segmented waist band and patterned forearm panels; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy chest, back and shoulder panels; colour 2 on the sleeves and waist band; colour 1 on the piping lines; colour 3 on the forearm panels and lower back accents.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Space_01.differs: The chest panel has a smooth, sculpted bust shape with a plain centre, and there is no diamond emblem on the chest.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved, form-fitting jacket top with a large rectangular opening that leaves the chest bare, a short collar, and separate panels on the upper back and sleeves. It ends above the navel with a contrasting hem band.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front body and upper arms; colour 2 on the upper back, collar and outer sleeve panels; colour 0 on the forearms and hem band. The chest opening shows bare skin, not a colour slot.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Spinal_01.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved superhero top ending at the waist, with a painted-on spinal pattern of vertebra-like dots and rib markings down the back, bold stripes along the shoulders and arms, and a segmented panel across the midriff.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Spinal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top and sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder and side stripes and some rib markings; colour 2 on the dashes and shaded panels along the arms and torso; colour 3 on the spine dots and stripes along the arms and shoulders.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Spinal_01.differs: The female top has a rounded, fitted bust and a narrower midriff panel with a corset-like taper, with no chest circle markings.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Spooky_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight top ending at the waist, with a feathery textured chest panel, fine ribbed lines across the torso, and scattered spot markings down the arms and shoulders. A monstrous, organic look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves; colour 1 on the feather-like chest and waist panel; colour 2 on the spot markings; colour 3 on the small accents in the centre of the chest panel.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Spooky_01.differs: The female version has sparser, smaller spots on the arms and back, and the chest panel is shaped around the bust with a cinched waist.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Starhawk_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with a scale-textured mesh over the shoulders, upper chest and forearms, bold outlined panels on the torso and arms, and a shield-shaped centre panel with a ring at the midriff.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scale-textured mesh areas; colour 1 on the main torso and upper-arm panels; colour 2 on the outlines and cuffs; colour 3 on the small round gems at the shoulders.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Starhawk_01.differs: The female top has a shield-shaped panel with a ring at the waist and a plunging scale-mesh neckline, where the male has a pointed chevron panel.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Starowl_01.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved crew-neck top ending at the ribs, printed with star shapes joined by thin constellation lines across the chest, back and arms, with contrasting trim at the neckline and cuffs.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top; colour 3 on the stars; colour 2 on the constellation lines and the neckline and cuff trim; colour 1 not visible.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top with a scattering of star motifs across the chest, back and sleeves. It has a round neckline and ends at the waist, hugging the torso and arms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric of the top; colour 1 on the stars across the chest and front torso; colour 3 on the stars on the sleeves; colour 2 on the stars across the back.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_02.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved superhero top ending at the waist, with a round neckline and star emblems: one on each breast, one on the midriff, one on the upper back, and small stars on the shoulders and elbows.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tight top; colour 1 on the stars; colour 2 on the outlines around the stars.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_02.differs: The female version places one star on each breast and one on the midriff, so the front stars sit lower and further apart than on the male version.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_03.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top with a shrug-like sleeve and shoulder section and a star-patterned torso panel. It has a high neckline at the front and ends at the waist with a thin plain hem.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and shoulder yoke; colour 0 on the torso base and hem; colour 3 on the stars.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_04.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with a vertical stripe down the centre of the chest and back topped by a star, and thin star-tipped stripes running down each arm, plus a contrasting waist band.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top and sleeves; colour 1 on the stripe borders, arm stripes and waist band; colour 2 on the centre stripe and band edge; colour 3 on the small star centres.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_05.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with a glossy diagonal panel that sweeps from one breast across the midriff and around to a jagged patch on the lower back.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 1 on the glossy diagonal panel across the chest, waist and lower back.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_05.differs: The diagonal glossy panel is a long sweeping band that wraps one breast and crosses the waist, while the male panel is a shorter, blockier patch.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_06.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved superhero top ending at the waist, with a bare round neckline. Contrasting striped side panels run from the shoulders down the outer arms and along the ribs, printed with stars.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and inner sleeves; colour 3 on the side panels along the arms and ribs; colour 1 on the stars; colour 2 on the thin outline edging the panels.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_07.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top ending at the waist, with a jagged zigzag border between a plain shoulder-and-sleeve section and a torso patterned with scattered star and sparkle shapes.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and inner-arm base; colour 1 on the shoulders, collar and outer sleeves; colour 3 on the star and sparkle motifs; colour 2 on the thin outline along the zigzag edge.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_07.differs: The zigzag border is larger and the torso stars cover the whole front and back, but the female version keeps more of the contrasting on the outer arms, so the stars sit mainly on the torso and inner arms.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_08.description: A close-fitting superhero top with short sleeves and a round neckline, ending at the waist. Long tight sleeves below the short cuffs carry a scattered star pattern, with a narrow banded strip at each upper arm.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_08.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the torso and short sleeve caps; colour 0 on the lower sleeves as the base of the star pattern; colour 3 on the stars; colour 2 on the narrow bands at the upper arms.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_09.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a wide central panel printed with a starburst pattern, running from the neckline down the front and back. Side sections and sleeves are plain, and the hem ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_09.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and side sections; colour 0 on the star panel background; colour 3 on the star bursts; colour 2 on the thin edging between the panel and sides.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_10.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top split down the middle: one half is plain, the other half carries a star pattern, divided by a jagged zigzag edge. Ends at the waist with a round neckline.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Stars_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plain half of the top and its sleeve; colour 0 on the star-patterned half; colour 3 on the stars; colour 2 on the edging along the zigzag split.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Swan_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero top with a deep V neckline, swan-wing shaped glossy panels sweeping over the bust and down to a corset-like waist, ending at the waist; the arms are left bare.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the neckline, shoulder straps and lower waist band; colour 2 on the glossy central and back panels; colour 0 on the swooping bust panels and centre waist stripe.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Swan_01.differs: The female top has rounded bust panels in a contrasting shade and a more cinched, corset-like waist.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Sweater_01.description: A long-sleeved knitted sweater with vertical cable-knit ribbing in bold stripes, a small folded turtleneck collar, and ribbed cuffs and hem. It fits close to the body and ends at the waist, in a casual style.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Sweater_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knit body; colour 1 on the wide cable stripes; colour 3 on the thin centre lines in the stripes; colour 2 on the collar, cuffs and hem band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Tactical_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tactical top ending at the waist, with a V-shaped yoke across the shoulders, panels on the upper arms and ribs, short vertical accent lines on the chest and forearms, and contrasting wrist bands.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke, upper-arm panels and rib panels; colour 3 on the short accent lines; colour 2 on the wrist bands.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Traveler_01.description: A plain, skin-tight long-sleeved top with a round neckline that ends at the waist. It has a fading gradient band at the hem and separate glossy sleeves, giving a casual, athletic look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso body of the top; colour 1 on the gradient hem band at the waist; colour 3 on the sleeves.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Underchest_01.description: A skin-toned base layer for jackets: bare shoulders, exposed forearms and midriff, with a small gathered bra-like bandeau top with thin straps and contrasting edge trim across the chest. Casual, revealing underlayer.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Underchest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bandeau cups and straps; colour 1 on the edge trim of the bandeau; the skin areas of the arms and torso do not use the colour scheme.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Underchest_01.differs: The female version adds a gathered bra-like top over the chest, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Underjacket_02.description: A formal, form-fitting collared shirt-style underjacket with a centre button placket, a cropped waist-length body and separate long sleeves with cuff bands. The back shows a crumpled, shadowed panel. Sits on the torso and forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Underjacket_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shirt body, collar and sleeves; thin cuff lines and placket seams also take colour 0. Colours 1, 2 and 3 are not clearly visible.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Underjacket_02.differs: The female version has a full back panel with gathered folds and a cropped hem, while the male back is missing, leaving only the collar.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved, tight-fitting top that ends above the navel. It has a large open keyhole panel exposing the chest, a separate upper-back and shoulder panel, and contrasting forearm sections. It suggests an urban anime or street look.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main torso and upper sleeves; colour 2 on the upper back, shoulder and outer arm panels; colour 0 on the lower forearms; the chest opening shows bare skin and takes no colour.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Urban_Anime_Tubetop.description: A strapless, form-fitting tube top wrapping the chest and back as a short band, with a separate skin-toned panel across the centre of the bust; strapless casual urban style ending above the midriff.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Urban_Anime_Tubetop.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tube top fabric at the sides, back and lower band; the centre bust panel shows a skin tone that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valdia_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with a V-neck, a large centre chest panel, a pointed chevron emblem below the bust and layered segmented pads over the shoulders and forearms, with a matching chevron across the upper back.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valdia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, back and side panels; colour 1 on the sleeves and shoulder sections; colour 2 on the shoulder pad bands, cuffs and waist edging; colour 3 on the chevron emblems.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valelectric_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with rounded shoulder caps, a V-shaped chest panel, a central swooping emblem-like panel, angular lightning-style forearm accents and thin vein-like lines on the ribs.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valelectric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest V and the upper arms; colour 1 on the central chest and waist panel and the forearms; colour 3 on the shoulder caps and the fine rib lines; colour 2 on the outlines, piping and waist band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valerian_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with a large horned crescent and inverted-triangle emblem on the chest and back, plus thin branching vein-like cracks running down the arms and torso.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top; colour 3 on the chest and back emblem; colour 1 on the thin vein-like crack lines on the arms and torso.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valerian_01.differs: The emblem on the female top is split into a crescent, a round centre and a triangle, whereas the male version has a more connected shield-like emblem.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valflare_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a glossy chest panel, swooping flame-like panels over the shoulders and ribs, a pointed shape at the waist, and armoured-looking forearm panels; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valflare_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy chest, back and forearm panels; colour 3 on the shoulder and rib panels; colour 0 on the collar swirls, waist flares and upper arm panels; colour 1 on the side panels, sleeve sections and piping.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valhex_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with raised outlined seams forming shoulder plates, arm panels and a corset-like waist with a V-shaped centre motif; a contrasting neck and inner-sleeve panel; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valhex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and sleeves; colour 1 on the collar and inner sleeve panels; colour 2 on the raised outline seams and waist band; colour 3 on the corset V motif.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valhex_01.differs: The female top has a cinched corset-style waist with a flared lower edge, whereas the male version is straighter with a plain waist band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valstar_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with swooping angular panels over the chest and shoulders, a pointed V-shaped centre, banded midriff panels, and segmented armor-like forearm panels outlined in contrasting piping.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest, shoulder and sleeve fabric; colour 3 on the chest, midriff and forearm panels; colour 1 on the side torso and inner upper-arm panels; colour 2 on the outline piping and accent swooshes.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valvee_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a V-shaped emblem across the chest, sculpted armor-like ribbing over the torso, shoulder and arm panels, and a segmented plated back; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Valvee_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and sleeves; colour 1 on the waist band, shoulder and arm panels and back diamond; colour 2 on the trim lines and joint accents; colour 3 on the V emblem and rib slits.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with a V-shaped chevron panel down the chest and back, swooping panels over the shoulders and ribs, and a small V emblem at the centre of the chest.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, upper chest, forearms and lower sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder caps, upper-arm stripes and side panels; colour 2 on the central chest and back panel; colour 3 on the V emblem.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Vigilante_01.differs: The female top has a lower, more open neckline and a narrower corset-like waist with a contrasting centre panel that reaches higher between the bust.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Warrior_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped top with a quilted diamond-stitch texture, a round neckline with a thin edge band, and contrasting trim at the hem and cuffs; it ends above the navel and leaves the midriff bare.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted body and sleeves; colour 1 on the hem and cuff trim; colour 2 on the neckline band.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length fitted top with a wide V-neck, a broad patterned band across the shoulders and chest, and flared bell cuffs with matching geometric trim. Its fantasy robe look suits a wizard or mystic.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves of the top; colour 2 on the patterned band and cuff trim; colour 1 and colour 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting zombie-themed top ending at the waist, with a tight base layer splattered with rot-like stains and patches of exposed skin, and one arm showing bare decayed flesh with a small wound patch.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top fabric; colour 2 on the stains and blotches; colour 3 on the exposed skin patches and one bare arm; colour 1 barely visible.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01.differs: The female version is a full covering top with a stained fabric layer over the torso, and only one arm is bare skin.

Female/F_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01_Skin.description: A skin-textured bare torso and arms with a strappy bralette-style top and streaky bruise-like patches and small oval panels along both arms; ends above the navel, leaving the midriff bare.
Female/F_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01_Skin.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the bralette top and its back straps; colour 1 on the streaky patches along the arms and shoulders; colour 0 on the highlights and small oval panels on the arms; skin areas ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Chest_Toxicsteel_01.description: A sleeveless robotic armour bodysuit with a sculpted chest plate, cut-away waist and high-cut hip, plus segmented mechanical arms with ribbed joints and ring bands. A vented back plate sits over a light lower back panel.
Female/F_Chest_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chest, torso and back plates; colour 1 on the ribbed arm segments and joints; colour 0 on the underlying side panels, arm rings and lower back panel; colour 2 on the vents and gaps.
Female/F_Chest_Toxicsteel_01.differs: The female version has a cut-away waist with a narrower midsection and a rounded, curved chest plate.

Female/F_Chest_Toxicsteel_02.description: A sleeveless sci-fi armoured torso piece with a glossy sculpted chest plate tapering to a high-cut bodysuit waist, a segmented back plate with vents, and mechanical tubed arms with ringed cuffs at the forearms.
Female/F_Chest_Toxicsteel_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main chest and back plates; colour 0 on the underlying side panels, rear hip plate and cuff rings; colour 1 on the ribbed arm tubes and accent lines; colour 2 on the inner gaps and seams.
Female/F_Chest_Toxicsteel_02.differs: The female version has slim bare-looking shoulders with contrasting tubed arms, whereas the male has bulky armoured shoulder pauldrons and a raised collar plate.

Female/F_Chest_Vest_Victorian_01.description: A Victorian-style outfit with a long-sleeved high-collared shirt under a fitted double-breasted waistcoat. The vest has wide contrasting lapels, two rows of buttons, small tab details at the waist and a back belt strap. It ends at the waist with a frilled hem.
Female/F_Chest_Vest_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt, collar and frilled hem; colour 1 on the vest body; colour 3 on the lapels, collar edge, waist tabs and back strap; colour 2 on the buttons.

Female/F_Chestaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025.description: A partial chest and shoulder piece of layered, petal-like curved plates: rounded shoulder caps join a bandeau-style band around the bust and upper back, meeting at a pointed centre. Organic, wing-like sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main petal plates; colour 3 on the ridged stripes and edge lines running along each plate.
Female/F_Chestaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025.differs: The female version has a smaller, more open bust band with slimmer shoulder caps that leave more of the chest bare.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Alien_01.description: A sculpted alien armband that wraps the upper left arm: an open, angular band with a raised contrasting plate on the outer side, layered edge plating and a short pointed spike jutting toward the back.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edge rim; colour 1 on the main band; colour 2 on the raised plate; colour 3 on the spike.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Amazon_01.description: A curved metal upper-arm guard wrapping the outside of the left arm, with a zigzag pointed lower edge, a raised central ridge, decorative scrollwork bands and small studs, framed by contrasting edge trim. Greco-roman warrior style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the engraved scroll patterns; colour 3 on the small stud gems.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Amazon_02.description: A short wrapped cuff worn around the left upper arm: an octagonal band that flares at both ends and pinches at the middle, with contrasting rims and a thin braided cord ringing the centre.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrap body; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 2 on the braided cord around the middle.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Anniversary_M.description: A chunky angular metal shoulder-cap for the left upper arm, open at the inner side, with a ribbed flexible tube curving up along its front edge. Suggests retro robot or sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Anniversary_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 2 on the ribbed tube. The glossy metal shows little of the other slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Armorninja.description: A chunky angular armor band wrapped around the left upper arm, made of faceted overlapping plates with a textured front panel and a raised rear plate. Ninja-style tactical armor that sits above the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the textured front panel; colour 1 on the large rear and lower plates; colour 3 on the upper rear wedge; colour 0 on the outer side plate and edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Bowtie_01.description: A small armband worn around the upper left arm, with a wide cloth band and a bow tied at the side with a round central knot, short ribbon tails and pointed loops. It suggests a cute magical-girl style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band's edges and the round knot rim; colour 1 on the main band and bow loops; colour 2 on the inner panels and knot centre; colour 3 on small ribbon tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, angular block-shaped band worn around the upper left arm, like a small cardboard carton with a flat top rim and straight faceted sides. It gives a blocky, quirky look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and the back panel; colour 1 on the upper front and side panels; colour 2 on the lower front and side panels; colour 3 on the angled stripe panel on the front.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chainlock_01.description: A loose coil of chunky metal chain links wrapped several times around the upper left arm and fastened with a small padlock on the inner side. Gives a rugged, punk or prisoner-style look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 1 on a small trim at the padlock; colour 3 on the keyhole.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chainlock_02.description: A loose tangle of chunky chain links wrapped several times around the upper left arm, fastened by a small boxy padlock on the outer side. Gives a gritty, restrained look suited to punk or street styles.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chainlock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 3 on the padlock keyhole marking; colour 1 on a small detail beside the lock.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chains_01.description: A single thin chain of small interlocking links hanging straight down from the upper chest past the hip, ending in a ring and a small key-like pendant. It dangles loosely against the body's left side.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper links near the shoulder; colour 0 on the lower links; colour 3 on the end pendant; colour 2 on the ring clasp.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chainlo.description: A small padlock-shaped ornament with a chamfered rounded body, a thick looped shackle and a recessed keyhole, worn on the side of the left upper body at the chest and arm. Suggests a punk or street look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chainlo.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the lock body and shackle; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on the thin edge strip along one side.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chainlo.description: A small chunky padlock with a faceted, chamfered body, a recessed keyhole on the face and a thick angular shackle on one side. It hangs from the chest and side as a gritty, punk-style accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chainlo.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the lock body and shackle; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on the thin edge strip along the side of the body.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chains_.description: A single long chain of oval links hanging straight down from the chest past the hip, ending in a small hook-and-charm pendant. It dangles loosely and swings freely, like a punk or gothic accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chains_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper links of the chain; colour 0 on the lower links; colour 2 and colour 3 on the end pendant.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Punk_01.description: A cloth armband wrapped around the upper left arm, gathered into a small knot with two long pointed bow-like tails sticking out sideways. A casual punk bandana-style accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped band and knot; colour 1 on one tail; colour 2 on the other tail.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Punk_01.differs: The female version has a full wrapped band that encircles the arm, while the male version shows only the small knot and tails.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Renegad.description: A small sci-fi cannon module on the upper left arm: a boxy casing with a perforated vent face and a hex-nut muzzle ring, trailing a thick flexible cable that loops around the arm and ends in a small ribbed connector.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Renegad.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing and cable end connector; colour 1 on the hex muzzle ring; colour 3 on the cable; colour 2 on the muzzle opening.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Renegad.description: A pair of flexible tubes that snake down the left upper arm in zigzag curves, each starting at a small capped mount near the shoulder and ending in a ribbed, vented cylindrical nozzle near the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Renegad.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the end caps and ribbed nozzles; colour 3 on the main tube lengths; colour 1 on the banded sections of the tubes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Scarab_.description: A flat, thin emblem of three interlocking elliptical loops around a small central ring, like an atom symbol, lying flush on the outer left upper arm. Reads as a decorative badge-like arm mark.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Scarab_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main loops and central ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the loops.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Crimson_01.description: A twin-strand twisted rope band worn snugly around the upper left arm, with two parallel braided cords forming a slim loop. A simple casual accessory, suited to sporty or pirate looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and inner half of the rope; colour 1 on the back and outer half of the rope.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Cyberwire_01.description: A sculpted band worn around the left upper arm: a tapered, faceted plate that points downward, edged with rims and crossed by a wide central strap with a small round stud. Suggests a sci-fi superhero armband.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main faceted plate; colour 0 on the edge rims and strap borders; colour 2 on the central strap band; colour 3 on the round stud and its mount.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Deity_01.description: A banded upper-arm cuff made of stacked padded rings, topped by a large angular curved plate that wraps over the outside of the left upper arm like a shoulder guard. Superhero armour styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large curved outer plate; colour 1 on the stacked padded bands; colour 3 on the top rim band and inner lining; colour 2 on the bottom band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Draco_01.description: A short armored band worn around the upper left arm, with a raised, flared upper edge that sweeps up on one side, layered stepped trim and a faceted diamond gem set in the front panel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised upper band and flared cap; colour 0 on the main lower panel; colour 2 on the edge trim layers; colour 3 on the diamond gem.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Draco_01.differs: The female band sits lower on the arm and is more rounded with a shallower flare, while the male one rises to a taller pointed peak.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Dragonbody_Lo.description: A flame-like fin attached along the outside of the left forearm: a smooth flat edge against the arm sweeps out into layered, swept-back ridged spikes that taper to a point near the wrist. Suggests a dragon or monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Dragonbody_Lo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth base and inner surface; colour 1 on the outer tips of the ridged spikes, fading in from colour 0.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Dragonbody_Lo.differs: The female fin is narrower and lies flatter against the forearm, with shorter spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Drill_01.description: A chunky sci-fi armband worn on the upper left arm: a rounded octagonal cuff with ribbed bands at top and bottom and a plated centre section with contrasting inset panels, a small triangular emblem and thin accent lines.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central armor plating; colour 1 on the ribbed top and bottom bands; colour 2 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the emblem and accent lines.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Element_Fire_.description: A ragged band of swirling flame-like tongues wrapped around the upper left arm, with curled, pointed wisps flaring outward. Glossy and rippled, it reads as an elemental fire armband.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Element_Fire_.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; the whole band is a reflective sheen with only faint tints from colour slots 1 and 2.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Element_Fire_.description: A ragged, flame-like wrap for the upper left arm: swooping, glossy licks of jagged flame-shaped panels curl around the upper arm and hang in tattered points, with a gap at the front.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Element_Fire_.colourAreas: The default glossy material largely ignores the scheme; the whole piece shows one uniform glossy finish, with only faint hints of colour 1 in the reflections.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Gearbreak_01.description: A bucket-shaped mechanical shoulder cup worn on the left upper arm, with a tall curved shield plate rising on the outer side, a banded ring with inset panels near the base, and a small side pod.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Gearbreak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cup body and shield plate; colour 1 on the band frame and the pod strap; colour 3 on the inset band panels; colour 2 on the shield edge trim and the small pod.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Gladiator_01.description: A short armband band worn around the upper left arm, with a wide main panel, darker rims at top and bottom, and a pair of padded straps fastened by a small buckle. Reads as a combat or military badge band.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band panel; colour 2 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the padded straps; colour 1 on the buckle.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Heraldry_01.description: A plain, smooth band worn around the upper left arm: a short faceted tube with a slightly flared, tapering profile and a clean edge, sitting just below the shoulder like a simple armband.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Kaiju_01.description: A rounded shoulder and upper-arm guard for the left arm: a segmented plate with stepped horizontal ridges wraps the outer arm, with a separate bulging, slightly dimpled shell panel over the front and back of the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented outer plate and its ridges; colour 3 on the bulging outer shell panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Madjester_01.description: Two thin faceted bands stacked at a slight tilt around the left upper arm, forming a simple double armband with a flat, angular profile. Reads as a plain cloth or leather cuff accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both bands; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_01.description: A small boxy mecha armband block on the upper left arm: a chunky faceted plate with a notched top, small slit accents on the front, and two short cylindrical pegs hanging below. Suggests robotic sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main block; colour 1 on the two cylindrical pegs underneath; colour 3 on the small slit accents.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_02.description: A chunky octagonal armband worn on the left upper arm: a faceted lower band with a small contrasting vent slot, topped by a stepped cap with two small slash marks. Mecha-style, sci-fi.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower faceted band; colour 1 on the top cap and ring; colour 3 on the small slash marks; colour 2 on the vent slot.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_02.differs: The female version is a taller, narrower cylinder-like band sitting on the mid upper arm, while the male one is a shorter, wider block.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mechanon.description: A angular mechanical armband worn on the left upper arm: a split shell of stepped plates with an open gap, a jutting side fin and a small notched panel, giving a robotic sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 1 on the curved upper panels and edge bands; colour 3 on small inset accents; colour 2 on the jutting side fin.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Modern_Ironcl.description: A simple armband worn around the left upper arm: a wide faceted band with a thin raised rim at top and bottom, snug and plain, suggesting a modern, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Modern_Ironcl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide central band; colour 2 on the raised rims at top and bottom.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Moth_01.description: A left upper-arm cover that wraps the bicep from shoulder to just above the elbow, with a tapered shoulder point, a feathery fluffy tuft on the outer side, inset side panels and a gathered cuff edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main sleeve body and cuff; colour 0 on the fluffy tuft; colour 1 on the inset panels on the front and back of the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Moth_01.differs: The female version is a longer, narrower sleeve that runs down the arm, with a tapered shoulder point and the tuft sitting along the upper outer arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mutated_01.description: A pair of curved bone-like horns or spikes jutting out and backward from the left upper arm and shoulder, a larger one above a smaller one, each with a faceted base tapering to a sharp point.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and body of each spike; colour 1 on the tapering tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Padding.description: A padded upper-arm band made of two curved armor shells with a gap at the inner side. The rear shell is larger and puffy, the front shell is narrower, and each has a contrasting panel and a small strip on the front edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and lower edges of the shells; colour 1 on the main shell surfaces; colour 2 on the angled inset panels; colour 3 on the small strip on the front shell.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pirate_Fancy_.description: A billowing pirate-style puffed sleeve sleeve band worn on the left upper arm: a gathered, ruffled cloth tube cinched by a buckled strap, with a second flared frill below tied with a small bow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pirate_Fancy_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered cloth and frill; colour 1 on the strap and the lower tie; colour 3 on the buckle and the round button; colour 2 on the frill hem edging.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Power_01.description: A rigid armband worn high on the upper arm, with a flat teardrop-shaped cap on top that angles up to a point, a tapered band below, and thin raised rims at the top and bottom edges.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cap and the rims; colour 1 on the main band panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pumpkin_01.description: A left upper-arm guard of layered, ridged armor plates that curve around the outer arm, ending in a hooked tip, with a separate row of jagged, blade-like fins on the inner side. Gothic fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the jagged fins; colour 2 on the hooked tip at the lower edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pumpkin_01.differs: The female version sits lower on the arm with the spiked fins standing clearly apart from the plate, while the male version has a larger plate that reaches up over the shoulder.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Punk_01.description: A cloth bandana tied around the upper left arm as an armband, with a folded-over striped inner band and a knot at the outer side that leaves two pointed, leaf-like tails sticking out. Punk, casual look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band; colour 1 on one knot tail and on stripes of the inner band; colour 2 on the other knot tail and on stripes of the inner band; colour 3 on stripes of the inner band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.description: A short band of cloth strips wrapped in a loose spiral around the upper left arm, with gaps between the loops and ragged edges. It suggests a casual rave or street armband.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.colourAreas: The strips blend through the colour slots along the arm: colour 0 at the top edge, colour 1 across the upper wraps, colour 2 across the middle wraps, colour 3 at the bottom loops.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.differs: The female version fades through all four colour slots, ending in colour 2 and colour 3 at the lower loops.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.description: A left-arm wrap of crisscrossing fabric straps that spiral from the upper arm down to the forearm, leaving gaps that show the body beneath. Loose, frayed bands give it a rave or street look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps at the top of the upper arm; colour 1 on the upper and mid-arm straps; colour 2 on the straps around the elbow; colour 3 on the forearm straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Reactor_01.description: A chunky sci-fi upper-arm cuff made of two joined armor halves with a notched top edge and small round stud, plus a curved cable running down to a small ribbed plate on the forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one half of the cuff, the lower rim and the small forearm plate; colour 1 on the other half of the cuff; colour 3 on the cable and the small stud.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Armo.description: A sci-fi armor band for the upper left arm: a cup-shaped shoulder-arm plate with an inner lining, and two bent tubular cables that loop out and down to ribbed gauntlet-like end caps. Sits on the upper arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and the ribbed end caps; colour 1 on the inner lining and cable bands; colour 3 on the cable tubes.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Armo.differs: The female plate is smaller and sits lower, with the cables looping wider and further away from it.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Cann.description: A small sci-fi cannon module mounted on the outer upper left arm: a boxy casing with a perforated vent face and a hex-nut muzzle ring, trailing a thin looping cable that wraps around the arm and ends in a small connector.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Cann.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing and the cable end connector; colour 1 on the hex muzzle ring; colour 3 on the cable; colour 2 on the muzzle opening.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Tube.description: A pair of thin flexible tubes that snake in zigzag curves down the left upper arm from the shoulder, each starting at a small rigid cap and ending in a ribbed cylindrical connector. Sci-fi cybernetic accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Tube.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main tube lengths; colour 1 on the banded sections of the tubes; colour 0 on the end caps and ribbed connectors.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Tube.description: Two flexible tubes that snake down the outside of the left upper arm in S-curves, each starting at a short capped collar near the shoulder and ending in a ribbed, vented cylindrical nozzle near the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Tube.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the end caps and ribbed nozzles; colour 3 on the main tube lengths; colour 1 on the banded tube sections.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retro_Warlord.description: A chunky armored cuff worn around the upper left arm: a faceted plate rises over the outer side, with a lower band and a curved tubular handle-like bar swinging out from the front. Suggests retro sci-fi warlord armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retro_Warlord.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large upper plate and the handle bar; colour 1 on the main cuff body and the handle tip; colour 3 on the lower band; colour 2 on the small nozzle underneath.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retro_Warlord.description: A segmented ammunition chain draped from the chest over the shoulder and down the back of the left arm, ending in a boxy metal clasp near the upper arm. Pointed tips line its edge, for a retro warlord look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retro_Warlord.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain segments; colour 1 on the pointed tips along the edges; colour 2 on the box clasp.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retrosteelhea.description: A curved metal pauldron-like arm guard that wraps the outer left upper arm, with a raised ridged centre plate, pointed flared lower edges and a contrasting rolled band along the bottom. Retro superhero armour style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retrosteelhea.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and ridged plates; colour 1 on the lower rolled band and edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Roman_01.description: A Roman-style segmented upper-arm guard: a curved shell of stacked overlapping plates with rivet studs, held to the outer left upper arm by two contrasting straps that wrap around the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Roman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate segments, fading into colour 1 across the middle of the shell; colour 3 on the rivets; colour 2 on the straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Roman_02.description: A segmented Roman-style upper-arm guard: a curved shell of stacked overlapping metal bands with small rivets along the edges, wrapping the outer left upper arm from shoulder to mid-arm without any straps.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Roman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded plates; colour 1 on the shaded outer curve of the shell; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Sandstorm_01.description: A left upper-arm guard: a curved armored shell with raised ribbed pads on the outer face, a contrasting lower cuff band, and a contrasting flared panel that extends down toward the elbow. Sits around the upper arm; sporty sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long lower panel and inner lining; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 1 on the lower cuff band; colour 3 on the ribbed pads.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Sandstorm_02.description: A chunky angular armband worn around the left upper arm, with a faceted plated shell that steps down into a notch, a small rectangular inset panel on the outer face, and a contrasting inner lining.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band shell; colour 3 on the small inset panel; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge shadows.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_01.description: A curved armband plate worn on the outer upper left arm, with a stepped, angular lower edge and a thick contrasting border. Its face carries an atom-like orbital emblem. Superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate face; colour 2 on the border and back shell; colour 1 on the atom emblem lines.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_01.differs: The female plate is longer and narrower, with a more stepped, angular lower edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_02.description: A short armored cuff worn on the upper left arm: a tapered shell with a raised, bordered panel on the outer face and a separate side section, open at the top. Suggests superhero or sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised front panel; colour 1 on the side and rear shell; colour 2 on the border rim and edging.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Spikysuit_01.description: A small, lumpy organic growth clamped to the upper left arm: a rounded bony mass with several blunt knuckle-like protrusions and mottled patches, suggesting a monstrous, alien shoulder guard.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bony mass; colour 1 on the mottled patches and streaks across its surface.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Starhawk_01.description: A glossy translucent upper-arm band: a wide angular cuff with a pointed fin-like spike on the outer side and a second thinner ring below it, worn around the left upper arm in a superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: The default material is glassy and ignores the colour scheme, so no slot colours are visible on the cuff, spike or lower ring.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Starhawk_01.differs: The female version renders as clear glass that ignores the colour scheme, while the male version shows separate colours on the cuff, spike and lower ring.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Steelarachnid.description: A chunky segmented armor band worn around the upper left arm: stacked angular plates on the front, a smooth plate across the back and top, and a small side flap with two round holes. Suggests sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Steelarachnid.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back plate, top surface and side flap; colour 1 on the stacked front plates; colour 2 on the gaps between plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Steelcommando.description: A tapered armored band worn around the upper left arm, with a flared rim, a contrasting angled panel on the outer side and a small hanging tab with a faceted crystal-like block at the back. Retro military-superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Steelcommando.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main band and rim; colour 1 on the angled side panel; colour 3 on the faceted hanging block; colour 0 on the thin edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Super_Destroy.description: A chunky faceted armband worn on the left upper arm: a short, slightly tapered cuff with angular flat planes and a smooth top rim, giving a retro superhero armored look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Super_Destroy.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top rim and upper faces of the band; colour 2 on the lower body of the cuff. Colour 0 and colour 3 are not visible.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Super_Destroy.differs: The female band is a closed, even cuff, while the male one has a notch cut into the back of the cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Symbiote_01.description: A single curved horn-like spike sprouting from the left shoulder, sweeping outward and upward to a sharp point, with a flat angular base seated against the shoulder. Suggests a monstrous symbiote look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and lower part of the spike; colour 1 on the upper curve and tip, blending in a gradient.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Tactical_01.description: A short angular armored band worn around the upper left arm: a curved open-backed plate with a raised, separate panel across the outer face. It reads as a tactical arm guard.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and its rim; colour 1 on the raised panel across the front.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Tactical_01.differs: The raised panel is a smaller block on the outer face and does not wrap around the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Traveler_01.description: A wide fabric armband worn around the upper left arm, with a folded, layered band, a row of small eyelets, a square buckle with a snap stud, and a short loose strap tail.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and strap tail; colour 1 on the small strap tab under the buckle; colour 2 on the buckle and its stud; colour 3 on the eyelet rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Wraps_01.description: A short band of diagonally wound, overlapping fabric wraps around the left upper arm, with a plain cuff at the top and bottom. Casual, street-style bandage look with a slightly crinkled finish.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Arm_Wraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and bottom cuffs and some of the diagonal wraps; colour 1 on the wide wrap strips; colour 2 on the wraps in the gaps between strips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Armor_Patterned_0.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapered, angular shell, a flared pointed lip at the elbow end and a stepped cuff at the wrist. A large inset panel is framed by heavy outlines. Suits superhero and sci-fi armour looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Armor_Patterned_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and cuff; colour 1 on the large inset panel; colour 2 on the outlines and edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Anniversar.description: A tapered, smooth metal bracer for the left forearm, open along one side with a notched, stepped cut-out and a raised flared rim at the elbow end. Simple retro-superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Anniversar.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bracer body, with the shading fading darker toward the wrist end; the default metal material gives a glossy gradient. Colours 0, 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Anniversar.description: A robotic forearm bracer: a tapered metal shell with a snake-head cap at the elbow end, a ribbed flexible tube running down its front, and a wide cuff band at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Anniversar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal shell and snake-head; colour 1 on the wrist cuff and the inner shell lining; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the ribbed tube.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Aquatic_01.description: A short, tapering forearm bracer with a contrasting rim and angular panelled plates, topped by two swept-back fin-like spikes along the outer edge. Sits on the left forearm just above the wrist, in an aquatic fantasy style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower plate and the spikes; colour 1 on the upper angular panels; colour 2 on the rim and the seam lines.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Aquatic_01.differs: The spikes sit further toward the back edge and lean more sharply, with the contrasting panel wrapping more around the outer side.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Aquatic_02.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapered cuff, a large front plate with a zigzag edge and contrasting trim, a flared pointed end over the wrist, and curved fin-like spikes rising along the outer edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body and the spikes; colour 1 on the large front plate; colour 3 on the flared wrist end; colour 2 on the edge trim and the top cap.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Aquatic_02.differs: The female version has larger, longer curved spikes along the outer edge, and a smaller front plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Arcane_01.description: A left forearm bracer of layered plate: a flared, pointed upper cuff with angular segments, a textured scale-like lower section over the wrist, contrasting trim lines and small gem inserts, ending in a plate over the back of the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and textured wrist section; colour 3 on the trim lines and bands; colour 1 on the small gems and spikes; colour 2 on the inner panels and edges.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Arcane_01.differs: The female bracer has a more sharply flared upper cuff with small spikes beside the gems, and a more angular hand plate.
