Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Arcane_02.description: A chunky, tapered bracer worn on the left forearm, built from stacked banded plates with zigzag-patterned insets, small rectangular gem panels and a raised stepped cuff at the elbow end. Suggests tribal or arcane armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate frame and bands; colour 2 on the zigzag-patterned insets; colour 3 on the rectangular gem panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Armored_01.description: A tapered armored bracer worn on the left forearm, with a raised outer plate, a bordered rim at the elbow end and a raised panel on the outer face. A small separate wrist guard with a trim tip sits at the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plate and wrist guard; colour 1 on the raised panel; colour 2 on the rim and border edges; colour 3 on the small accents above the panel and at the wrist tip.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Armorninja.description: A left forearm bracer of segmented armor plates with a raised pointed fin at the elbow end, a contrasting central seam panel, and curved blade-like spikes flaring from the wrist edge. Ninja-inspired and sleek.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plates and fin; colour 0 on the spikes, wrist rim and lower plates; colour 2 on the central seam panel and inner lining; colour 3 on a small strip on the back of the forearm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Arvad_01.description: An open, lattice-like forearm bracer of thin swooping scrollwork bands with curled hooked tips, framing a small curled scroll ornament. Sits on the left forearm above the wrist, with an ornate, fantasy feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer swooping frame bands; colour 2 on the inner curled hook scrollwork; colour 1 on the central scroll ornament.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Ascendant_.description: A left forearm bracer with a raised, angular hexagonal front plate bordered by a bevelled rim and set with an atom emblem, backed by a contrasting cuff that wraps the wrist. Sits on the outer forearm above the hand; superhero sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the front plate face; colour 2 on the inner cuff backing.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Ascendant_.description: A short tapered bracer that wraps the left forearm from wrist to below the elbow, with a raised curved panel on the outer face, a small cap-shaped plate at the top edge, and thin rims at both ends. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims at both ends; colour 1 on the main outer panel; colour 3 on the small plate at the top of the panel; colour 2 on the body of the bracer and the inner side.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Bounty_01.description: A chunky, angular forearm bracer worn on the left arm, made of a boxy outer shell with a recessed panel, a raised centre plate with two vertical slots, and small stepped clasps along the edge. Sci-fi frontier style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer shell; colour 0 on the edge plating and lower cuff; colour 2 on the raised centre housing and clasps; colour 3 on the slot inserts.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Bowtie_01.description: A small wrist bracer worn on the left wrist: a layered, angular cuff with faceted panels, topped by a large oval bow-knot medallion with short pointed ribbon tails hanging off one side. Cute magical-girl styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the oval medallion and the cuff's outer rim; colour 1 on the main cuff panels and ribbon tails; colour 2 on the inner cuff panels; colour 3 on the tips of the ribbon tails and small accent panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brass_01.description: A chunky set of brass knuckles: a flat angular metal bar with four hexagonal finger holes and a notched, ridged top edge, held in the left fist across the fingers. Gritty street-fighter weapon look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brass_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole knuckle piece; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brutal_01.description: A left forearm bracer of layered armor plates running from elbow to wrist, with a crown of jagged spiky blades flaring from the top edge, small side spikes, and a wrinkled cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer plates and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the spiky crest at the top; colour 2 on the side spikes and the thin band under the crest; colour 3 on the small accent tab at the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brutal_02.description: A left forearm bracer wrapped in overlapping cloth bindings, with a rigid edged plate along the outer side, a ruff of jagged crystalline spikes at the elbow end, and curved horn-like claws and spiky tufts along the length. Tribal, brutal look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth wraps and plate face; colour 1 on the elbow spike ruff and the wrist-end fringe; colour 2 on the plate edging and trim; colour 3 on the curved horns and spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brutal_Fur.description: A left forearm bracer of stacked, wrapped bands around a segmented sleeve, with a row of curved horn-like spikes along the outer edge and a tuft of fur-like spiky fringe at the elbow end, plus a small plate cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brutal_Fur.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented sleeve panels and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the wrapping bands; colour 3 on the curved spikes; colour 1 on the spiky fur tuft at the top.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brutal_Sku.description: A chunky bone-like bracer on the left forearm: a faceted, angular shell with a jagged lower edge and a few curved horn spikes rising from the top. Suggests a brutal, monstrous tribal look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brutal_Sku.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell; colour 1 on the curved horn spikes.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Brutal_Sku.differs: The female bracer has two or three spikes at the top and a more jagged, pointed lower edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Buzzsaw_01.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades floating around the left forearm, each with a central hub ring and a ring of small rivets; the blades are angled at different tilts for an aggressive, industrial look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Buzzsaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade faces and hub rings; colour 1 on the blade edges; colour 3 on the rivet dots; colour 2 on the inner hub bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Buzzsaw_02.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades mounted at different angles on the outer left forearm, each with a raised inner disc and a star-shaped hub. Aggressive, mechanical, hanging off the arm like spinning trophies.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Buzzsaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toothed blade rims; colour 1 on the inner discs; colour 3 on the star-shaped hubs; colour 2 in the small centre holes.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Buzzsaw_02.differs: The female blades are arranged with the largest blade higher on the forearm and a smaller one angled edge-on in front of it, unlike the male's more evenly spread cluster.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Buzzsaw_03.description: A cluster of three circular saw blades with toothed edges and open centre holes, floating loosely beside the left forearm at different tilts. Each has a hub ring with small rivet studs; an industrial, mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Buzzsaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toothed blade discs and inner hub rings; colour 1 on the ring band around each hub; colour 3 on the small rivet dots.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Buzzsaw_03.differs: The blades sit closer together in a tighter overlapping stack, with one blade edge-on beside the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cannonarm_.description: A large sci-fi cannon worn over the left forearm: a bulky angular armored housing with a contrasting vent at the elbow, a wrist cuff, and a long multi-barrel muzzle extending well past the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cannonarm_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armored casing; colour 1 on the cuff, side panels and barrel sections; colour 2 on the vent and small mechanical details; colour 3 on small indicator details.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cannonarm_.description: A large sci-fi arm cannon worn on the left forearm: a streamlined angular casing with a contrasting canopy-like vent at the top, side fins, a small knob, and a cluster of long barrels extending past the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cannonarm_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and barrel housing; colour 1 on the edge stripes and the barrel tips; colour 2 on the vent panel; colour 3 on small indicator details.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Cann.description: A sci-fi arm-mounted laser cannon that sits beside the left forearm: a wedge-shaped armored housing with a contrasting vent panel tapers into a cluster of long slim barrels that extend past the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Cann.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and side plates; colour 1 on the edge stripe, barrel sleeves and barrel tips; colour 2 on the panel at the rear; colour 3 on small details between the barrels.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Coat.description: A left-forearm accessory of several narrow cloth strips that hang loosely from the wrist area, each dotted with small studs and ending in a pointed diamond-shaped tip. It has a punk, rocker look and dangles freely beside the hip.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Coat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strips; colour 3 on the diamond tips and the small stud dots.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Coat.differs: The female strips hang loose and separate beside the hip, with fewer diamond tips visible at the ends.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Cryo.description: A curved, segmented flexible hose or tube in a C-shape, hanging beside the left forearm, made of ribbed rings and ending in a small hex-nut cap. Suggests a cryogenic coolant line.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Cryo.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed hose segments; colour 2 on the hex end cap.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A rotary gatling-style bracer: a cluster of long parallel barrels bundled around the forearm by two thick ringed bands, with the muzzles poking out below the wrist and a ragged, open rear end.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrels; colour 0 on the two bands; colour 3 on the muzzle tips at the lower end.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky cylindrical sci-fi bracer worn around the left forearm, with a rounded top cap, a contrasting inset panel holding a rectangular screen, and three curved recessed vents down the side.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and top cap; colour 2 on the inset panel and base trim; colour 1 on the screen; colour 3 on the side vents.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky D-shaped bracer worn on the left forearm: a flat-backed block with a rounded front, a rim of segmented ammunition-like cylinders wrapped around the curved face, and a recessed rounded top plate. Suggests a sci-fi gatling gadget.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer casing, rim and top plate; colour 1 on the row of cylinders; colour 2 on the thin band between casing and cylinders.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky cylindrical gun-barrel canister strapped along the left forearm, with a capped top, banded metal rim, recessed side panels, a small side nozzle and a thin cable trailing down to a connector near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main canister body and nozzle; colour 1 on the top cap, end rings, inset side panel and cable connector; colour 2 on the recessed panel; colour 3 on the cable.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A left-forearm bracer shaped like a gatling gun barrel cluster: a bundle of long cylindrical tubes held by two chunky ring bands with notched rims, with the barrel tips pointing down past the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrel tubes; colour 0 on the two ring bands; colour 3 on the barrel tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky cylindrical bracer worn on the left forearm near the wrist, with a segmented metal casing, a recessed screen panel on the inner side, and three glowing slotted vents along the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing and top cap; colour 2 on the screen surround; colour 1 on the screen panel; colour 3 on the vent slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A short, boxy bracer worn on the left forearm: a D-shaped housing with a flat panel cap and angled edges, wrapped on the outer side by a band of vertical cylindrical barrel-like segments between thin contrasting bands.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, flat cap and rim; colour 1 on the vertical barrel segments; colour 2 on the thin bands between housing and barrels.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A compact cylindrical gatling-style canister worn on the left forearm, with a capped top end, a small side nozzle, an inset contrasting window panel and a dangling cable ending in a small connector. Sci-fi gadget look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body and nozzle; colour 1 on the end caps and the inset trim; colour 2 on the window panel and connector; colour 3 on the cable.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Nigh.description: A large mechanical arm-mounted launcher worn on the left forearm: a round disc-shaped housing with a central lens, a boxy segmented casing and an angular frame on top, and a long ribbed barrel extending well below the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc housing and boxy casing; colour 1 on the top frame, barrel and ribbed sections; colour 3 on small accents on the disc and casing; colour 2 on the barrel tip and clamp bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Rene.description: A boxy sci-fi arm cannon mounted along the outside of the left forearm, with a block-like rear housing, a ribbed barrel section, vent slots and twin muzzle nubs near the wrist, plus a mounting clamp with bolts.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Rene.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cannon housing and barrel; colour 1 on the mounting clamp and muzzle tips; colour 3 on the small indicator slits; colour 2 on the vents and recesses.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Rene.description: Two thin, curving cable-like tubes with segmented collar bands, each ending in a bent, blocky connector tip. They hang loosely from the left forearm, giving a sci-fi cyborg or space-renegade look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Rene.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the long curved tubes; colour 0 on the bent connector sleeves at the ends; colour 2 on the small band rings and the end tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Rene.description: A cluster of five or six separate cone-shaped spikes of varying size, fanned out in an arc and floating beside the left upper arm near the elbow. They have no band or base, which suggests an aggressive, renegade look.

A pair of curved flexible tubes on the left forearm, each starting at a chunky angular cap near the elbow and bending down to a ribbed nozzle end near the wrist. A sci-fi cyborg-style forearm attachment.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Rene.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the angular caps; colour 0 on the ribbed rings and nozzle ends; colour 3 on most of the tube lengths; colour 1 on the bent tube segments.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A boxy retro-styled forearm cannon strapped along the left forearm: a long tapered metal barrel housing with a capped top block and a second smaller module at the back carrying a small readout panel. Extends past the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main barrel housing; colour 1 on the capped top block; colour 2 on the rear module and underside; colour 3 on the small readout lights.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A slender cylindrical cannon barrel with rows of round perforations along its length and a ringed band near one end, hovering beside the left forearm at the fist. Retro-styled, metallic and mechanical.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel tube and end cap; colour 1 on the ringed band near the end; colour 2 on the perforation recesses.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A retro sci-fi arm shield: a rounded rectangular metal plate with a raised contrasting-lined cross emblem, two ribbed side bars, and curved fins at top and bottom. It hangs off the left forearm on small mounting studs.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate face and fins; colour 1 on the ribbed side bars and mounting blocks; colour 3 on the inlaid emblem lines; colour 2 on the back of the plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A scattered set of small detached cylindrical pegs and rods, floating in a loose arc beside the left hip and forearm rather than attached to the body. They look like mechanical shield fittings in a retro sci-fi style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rod bodies; colour 2 on the darker caps and bolts; colour 1 on the tips and rings of some rods.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A scatter of small detached metal pegs and pins arranged in a loose ring beside the left hip, floating off the body. They look like rivet or bolt parts for a retro shield, not a wearable garment.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pin shafts; colour 1 on the pin tips; colour 2 on the small round studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Scar.description: A pair of curved pincer-like prongs forming a U-shaped bracer at the left wrist: two tapering blades with pointed tips rise from a small cuff base, evoking scarab mandibles or claws.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Scar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff base at the wrist; colour 1 on the lower blade shafts; colour 3 on the pointed tips.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Scar.differs: The female prongs sit closer together and lean more to one side, giving a narrower, more staggered pincer than the male's evenly spread pair.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Scar.description: A small curved bracer worn on the left forearm: a tapered segmented sleeve section sweeps up into a long backward-curving horn-like blade, with a hooked half-loop band curling around the wrist. Insectoid, armored look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Scar.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the curved horn blade; colour 2 on the tapered forearm segment; colour 0 on the hooked wrist band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Spik.description: A ring of separate pyramid-shaped spikes floating loosely around the left wrist, with no band joining them. They read as a spiked cuff or restraint and suit a punk or gothic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Spik.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spike faces; colour 2 on the spike bases and undersides.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Swin.description: A small sci-fi device strapped to the outside of the left forearm: a cylindrical body with a contrasting-lit glass slot, a pointed conical tip, banded rings, a ribbed flared base and a short cylindrical side peg.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Swin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body, tip and ribbed base; colour 2 on the rings; colour 3 on the glowing slot; colour 1 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Child_Swin.differs: The side peg is a round cylinder, whereas the male version has a flat rectangular block.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Chimera_01.description: A tapered forearm bracer covered in overlapping feather-like scales, with a jagged spiky upper rim and a ragged frayed lower edge. Sits around the left forearm from elbow toward wrist, in a monstrous beast style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiky upper rim and top scales; colour 1 on the middle scales; colour 2 on the ragged lower tips; colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Coat_Flair.description: A set of three narrow, curling cloth streamers hanging from the left forearm, each tipped with a pointed diamond-shaped charm and dotted with small studs. They swing loosely at the hip, giving a punk rocker flair.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Coat_Flair.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the streamers; colour 3 on the diamond tips and stud dots; colour 2 on the darker underside of the streamers.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Coat_Flair.differs: The female streamers hang loose and long past the hip, away from the arm, rather than wrapping around the forearm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cryo_01.description: A rigid sci-fi forearm bracer of angular armor plates with a raised contrasting panel, a round contrasting valve housing on the outer side, and a looping ribbed hose that curls down the arm. Sits on the left forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the raised panel; colour 3 on the ribbed hose and the small stripe on the panel; colour 2 on the valve housing and connectors.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cybercat_0.description: A hand-mounted set of long, slender curved blades that extend forward past the fingers, attached at the wrist and knuckles by small angular housings, thin rods and short contrasting studs. Suggests a cybernetic feline weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cybercat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long claw blades; colour 1 on the angular wrist housings and small tips; colour 3 on the thin rods and linkages; colour 2 on the knuckle studs and mounting blocks.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cybercat_0.description: A set of long, slender curved blade claws projecting forward from the left hand, with three or four tapering angular blades fanning out from a small angular base at the knuckles. Suggests a feline cyborg or sci-fi weapon look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cybercat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blades and knuckle base; the shaded undersides and tips show darker from lighting only, no other colour slots clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cyberwire_.description: A tapered forearm bracer worn on the left forearm: a flared, open upper rim, segmented armored plates along the outer edge, a smooth inset panel, small round studs and a slim banded cuff at the wrist. Sleek sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Cyberwire_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor plates and flared rim; colour 2 on the inset central panel; colour 1 on the thin cuff band and rim accent; colour 3 on the small round studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Deity_01.description: A short, plain angular forearm bracer that tapers toward the wrist, with a faceted, wedge-shaped top edge and a contrasting triangular panel at the upper opening. It sits on the left forearm as simple armour.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 2 on the triangular panel at the upper opening.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Deity_02.description: A short faceted bracer worn on the left forearm: a tapered cuff with angular edges that dips to a point over the back of the wrist, banded by stacked stripes of contrasting trim around the middle.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff shell; colour 2 on the wide band; colour 1 on the narrower band beneath it; colour 3 on the thin piping lines around the bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Draco_01.description: A left forearm bracer of tapered armored plates with a contrasting angular rim and recessed panels. A curved, blade-like fin with jagged spikes sweeps up from the outer edge, giving a dragon-inspired fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bracer panels; colour 2 on the rim and outer shell; colour 3 on the curved fin and the spikes at the wrist; colour 0 barely visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Drill_01.description: A short, tapered forearm bracer with an octagonal open cuff at the elbow end and a banded rim at the wrist. contrasting fin-like plates sit along the sides, with a seam line down the centre. Suggests a sci-fi gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the upper cuff and the wrist band; colour 2 on the side fin plates; colour 3 on the small markings near the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Dryad_01.description: A chunky left forearm bracer built from layered, leaf-like overlapping plates that flare outward toward the wrist, with a textured feathery panel on the outer face and a separate contrasting inner layer. Nature-themed fantasy styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leaf plates and edges; colour 1 on the textured outer panel; colour 2 on the inner layered plates; colour 3 on thin edge piping.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Dryad_Alt_.description: A left forearm bracer of layered, feather-like leaf plates that taper toward the wrist, with a contrasting inner lining and a flared open cuff at the elbow. Rugged, nature-guardian look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Dryad_Alt_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and lower feather tips; colour 1 on the upper leaf-textured panel; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge plates; colour 3 on the thin veins and the inner cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Eagle_Drka.description: A left forearm bracer made of layered, overlapping feathers that sweep down toward the wrist in a pointed tip, with a scalloped cuff at the elbow end and two narrow bands holding it on the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Eagle_Drka.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scalloped upper feather cuff; colour 1 on the long lower feathers; colour 2 on the two strap bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Element_Fi.description: A left forearm bracer made of swirling, glossy flame shapes: layered curling tongues wrap around the forearm above the wrist, with one tall flame tip curling up toward the elbow. Elemental fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Element_Fi.colourAreas: The glossy default material mostly ignores the scheme; it shows a metallic sheen across all the flames, with faint hints of colour 1 in the highlights.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Element_Fi.description: A bracer made of clustered, swirling flame tongues that wrap the left forearm and wrist, with curling tips flicking outward and a tall flame rising toward the elbow. Glossy, sculpted and elemental in feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Element_Fi.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the scheme, so the whole flame cluster shows one uniform shiny finish; no separate colour slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Element_Wa.description: A left forearm bracer shaped like frozen water splashes: glossy swirling wave forms with curling tendrils rising above the elbow and dripping, claw-like strands trailing over the wrist and back of the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Element_Wa.colourAreas: The whole piece uses a glossy default material that ignores the colour scheme; no separate slot areas are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Element_Wa.description: A left forearm bracer of glossy, liquid-like sculpted forms: swirling curled tendrils and finger-like drips rise along the arm and hang in dripping strands at the wrist. Fantasy elemental water styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Element_Wa.colourAreas: Glossy default material; the whole bracer appears to ignore the colour scheme, with only faint sheen highlights.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Falcon_01.description: A left forearm bracer of segmented plates that taper toward the wrist, with a domed elbow cap, a decorative filigree panel holding a faceted gem, edging lines and a flared, pointed cuff fin at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates and filigree panel; colour 2 on the elbow cap, outer shell and wrist flare; colour 1 on the edging lines and small studs; colour 3 on the gem.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Firebird_0.description: A faceted, angular bracer worn on the left forearm: a swept outer shell with a forked, pointed upper edge over a contrasting inner plate, with a contrasting rounded opening at the wrist end. Fantasy-armor styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Firebird_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept outer shell; colour 1 on the forked outer plate; colour 2 on the opening at the wrist end.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Flame_01.description: A left forearm bracer made of swept, flame-like shards: jagged pointed tongues rise along the outer edge and a smooth curved shell wraps the forearm from elbow to wrist, giving a fiery, spiky superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Flame_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall flame spikes and the outer shell edges; colour 1 on the main shell panels; colour 2 on the front underside panel; colour 3 on small flame accents between the spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Flame_Shor.description: A short left bracer made of jagged, flame-like spikes that flare outward around the forearm near the wrist. A contrasting central panel is edged with swept tongues, giving a spiky superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Flame_Shor.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main front panel; colour 1 on the back panel and the edge tongues; colour 0 on the large flame spikes; colour 3 on the small inner accents.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Fluff_01.description: A thick, shaggy fur cuff that wraps fully around the left forearm just above the wrist. Its tufted, bristly fibres stick out at the edges, giving a wintry, feral look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Fluff_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the tufted fur tips and shading strands; colour 2 in the deep underlayer.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gamer_01.description: A novelty gamer bracer: a flat rectangular game-controller slab with a cross pad and round buttons sits on the forearm, joined by a thin looping cable to a chunky wrist cuff over the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the controller body; colour 3 on the cross pad and buttons; colour 1 on the cable; colour 2 on the wrist cuff, with colour 3 on its stripe.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gatling_01.description: A chunky arm-mounted gatling gun worn over the left forearm: a cluster of long rotating barrels points down past the hand, with a rounded drum housing, ammo canister and bracket plates near the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings, drum caps and bracket plates; colour 1 on the barrels and canister bands; colour 3 on the vent slots and barrel tips; colour 2 on small joints.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gatling_Al.description: A bulky forearm-mounted gatling cannon: a rounded drum housing with vent slots and a side canister at the elbow end, tapering into a cluster of long barrels with ringed clamps, plus a thin cable. Sits over the lower arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gatling_Al.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, canister and barrel clamps; colour 1 on the barrels and the drum band; colour 3 on the vent slots and cable; colour 2 on small inserts.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gearbreak_.description: A chunky armoured bracer for the left forearm: a tapered cuff with a thick rimmed top edge, an upper band, a segmented lower plate with a raised ridge, and a hexagonal gem-like stud near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gearbreak_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower plates and ridge; colour 1 on the upper band; colour 2 on the top rim and bottom edge; colour 3 on the small studs and the hexagonal wrist stud.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gladiator_.description: A tapered forearm bracer of layered armored plates: a flared, rounded cuff at the elbow end, a long front panel with a curved swooping inset, a contrasting lower band, and a pointed guard over the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gladiator_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer plate edges, elbow cuff and wrist guard; colour 0 on the upper front panel; colour 3 on the curved inset marking; colour 1 on the lower front band.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gladiator_.differs: The female wrist guard extends into a longer, sharper point beyond the hand side.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gladiator_.description: A left forearm bracer in a gladiator style: a tapered shell with a large pointed outer plate, a curved rounded cap at the elbow end and a flared cuff at the wrist, all edged with thin contrasting trim.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gladiator_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large pointed outer plate; colour 3 on the main body of the bracer; colour 0 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the edge trim and elbow cap.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gladiator_.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapering, pointed-cuff shell: a segmented plated cap at the elbow end, layered panels along the outer edge and short strap-like ridges near the wrist. Superhero gladiator styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Gladiator_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the segmented plates and straps; colour 0 on the long central panel; colour 1 on the lower edge panel and pointed cuff; colour 3 on the inner strip beside the central panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Goth_01.description: A gothic left forearm bracer made of separate octagonal bands: a wide stack of ridged rings at the top, a thin spiralling wire loop, then a studded band and a slim base ring near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged upper rings and the wire loop; colour 1 on the studded band and the inner top surface; colour 3 on the studs; colour 2 on the thin base ring.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Goth_02.description: A gothic left wrist bracer: a wide faceted band studded with small round bumps, with a thin angular hoop rising above it and a slim ring below, worn around the lower forearm near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main band; colour 3 on the studs; colour 0 on the upper hoop; colour 2 on the lower ring.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Heraldry_0.description: A heater-style heraldic shield strapped to the left forearm: a pointed hexagonal plate with a raised rim, a central ornate crest emblem, and a small grip and strap mount on the back. Medieval knightly style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Heraldry_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shield field and back face; colour 1 on the inner painted panel; colour 3 on the central crest emblem; colour 2 on the rim, strap and grip.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Ice_01.description: A cluster of jagged crystalline ice shards growing along the outer left forearm from elbow to wrist, with the largest spikes pointing upward at the elbow and smaller shards tapering toward the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Ice_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the shard bodies; colour 1 on the faceted highlights of some shards. The glossy crystal finish largely ignores the other slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Ice_02.description: A cluster of jagged ice crystal shards attached to the outer left forearm: one large faceted spike on top with smaller angular crystals bunched below and trailing toward the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Ice_02.colourAreas: The glossy crystal ignores most of the colour scheme; it appears in glassy facets with a slight tint from colour 1 on some faces.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Inmate_02.description: A chunky armored bracer covering the left forearm, built from stacked angular plates with strapped-on side panels and a flared cuff at the wrist. A short chain dangles from the bottom edge. Suggests a prison-inmate, gritty tactical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main armor plates and cuff; colour 0 on the upper plate edges; colour 3 and colour 1 on the straps and small inset panels; the chain takes a metal look.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Insect_01.description: A sleek armoured left forearm bracer with a flared, winged cuff at the elbow end, a recessed glossy panel along one side, a ribbed curved plate and a small pointed gem-like spike. Insect-like sci-fi style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and flared cuff; colour 1 on the ribbed curved plate; colour 2 on the recessed panel; colour 3 on the pointed spike.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Insect_01.differs: The recessed panel is narrower and mostly sits on the outer side of the forearm, and the cuff flare is slimmer.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Kaiju_01.description: A monstrous armored forearm bracer with a segmented ribbed plate along one side, a flared fin-like plate at the elbow end, and a contrasting panel studded with curved contrasting spikes and small horns down the outer edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed segmented plate and elbow fin; colour 3 on the spiked outer panel and edge; colour 2 on the spikes.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Kaiju_01.differs: The female bracer has a slightly taller elbow fin and the ribbed plate wraps a bit further around the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Krampus_02.description: A heavy chain wound in many loose, overlapping loops around the left forearm just above the wrist, forming a chunky tangled bracer of thick rectangular links. Suggests a gothic, monstrous or holiday-horror look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Krampus_02.colourAreas: The chain uses a glossy metal default material that ignores the colour scheme; no visible slot colours.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Lockbox_65.description: An ornate, bulky left forearm bracer of layered metal plates with swooping curved thorn-like spikes and blade points along the edges and a long pointed tip over the wrist; worn on the forearm, fantasy martial style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curled spikes and edge trim; colour 1 on the inset plates and panels; colour 2 on the outer shell and undersides; colour 3 on the small gem-like accents.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Lockbox_65.description: A long left forearm bracer of layered contrasting plates with engraved swirl detailing and a flared cuff at the wrist, topped by a spiky snarling beast-head at the elbow with jagged spines. East-asian fantasy warrior look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main bracer plates and cuff; colour 0 on the engraved swirl band and edge trim; colour 1 on the beast head and its spines; colour 3 on the beast's eye.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Lockbox_66.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a smooth main shell, angular armored side plates and a hexagonal socket with a small round gem, plus a narrow trim ring at the wrist. Sci-fi, tactical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Lockbox_66.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the angular armor plates and bands; colour 1 on the wrist ring; colour 3 on the round gem in the socket.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Lockbox_66.description: A left forearm bracer of angular plates with a central round gem-like socket, swept wing-like fins at the top and a long tapering plate down the forearm, held by two contrasting cuff bands at the wrist and elbow. Fantasy-armour styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Lockbox_66.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plates and fins; colour 0 on the raised edge trim and the socket ring; colour 3 on the central round gem; colour 2 on the cuff bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Madjester_.description: A short cylindrical cuff worn at the left wrist, patterned with bold swirling scrollwork, with a layered ruffled flounce flaring out below the hand end. A playful jester or theatrical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Madjester_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the swirl scrollwork; colour 1 on the ruffle; colour 3 on the thin edge trim of the ruffle.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Madjester_.description: Two slim, faceted band cuffs stacked on the left forearm, each closed with a strap and buckle-like keeper and ending in a pointed tail tip. A simple, jester-like accessory that sits just above the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Madjester_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bands and pointed strap tips; colour 3 on the strap keepers.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Malvan_01.description: A left forearm bracer built from stacked ring bands around a runic-etched cylinder, with a tall flared plate at the elbow end and a back-mounted shield plate with a bladed fin, secured by contrasting bolts.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring bands, elbow flare and back plate; colour 1 on the cylinder between the rings; colour 3 on the rune markings and the back emblem; colour 2 on the bolts.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mecha_01.description: A chunky angular left bracer worn on the forearm: a light rectangular plate with a raised bracket lip and a recessed rounded slot, backed by a tall faceted side guard capped with a contrasting block. Mecha, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plate and lip; colour 1 on the faceted side guard; colour 2 on the block at the top of the guard and the underside; colour 3 on the slot inset.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mecha_03.description: A mechanical left wrist bracer with a banded cuff and a forked, angular clamp housing, from which a long flat blade-like slab extends down past the hand. Suggests a sci-fi mecha weapon gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mecha_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forked clamp housing and the edge strip of the blade; colour 1 on the blade body and cuff bands; colour 3 on the vent-like stripes and thin accent lines; colour 2 on the underside of the cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mechanon.description: A sci-fi forearm bracer made of layered, angular plates: long flat blades stacked along the outside of the wrist with a swept spiky fin at the cuff end, sitting over the left forearm just above the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long flat blade plates; colour 1 on the main bracer body and cuff panels; colour 2 on the swept fin edges and underside plates; colour 3 on the small accent inserts.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Modern_Des.description: A left forearm bracer of segmented armored plates with a raised panel on the front and a bulky cylindrical cuff near the elbow, narrowing toward the wrist with an angular flared edge over the back of the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Modern_Des.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plates; colour 1 on the elbow cylinder; colour 3 on the inset front panel; colour 2 on the outline trim and edging.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Modern_Iro.description: A left forearm bracer of armored plates: a flared, angular cuff at the elbow end, a smooth main shell with a flame-shaped inset, a segmented ribbed side panel, and a small pointed guard over the back of the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Modern_Iro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and wrist guard; colour 2 on the flared cuff and wrist band; colour 1 on the ribbed side panel; colour 3 on the flame inset.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Monster_Fu.description: A shaggy fur cuff wrapping the left wrist and the back of the hand, made of jagged, pointed tufts that spike upward at the wrist and hang in longer locks over the knuckles. Suggests a monstrous, beastly look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Monster_Fu.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts, shading darker toward the tips; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Moth_01.description: A short, tapered forearm bracer of soft folded cloth that flares open at the elbow end, with a contrasting inner lining and a row of small sharp claw-like spikes along the outer edge near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper bracer body, fading toward colour 3 at the wrist end; colour 3 on the inner lining; colour 2 on the small spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mutated_01.description: A single fleshy tentacle-like growth on the left forearm: a thick, lumpy tube that curves down past the hand and ends in a tight spiral curl, with a small patch on one side.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tentacle body; colour 1 on the small patch near the middle; colour 2 on a tiny spot beside it.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mutated_02.description: A single fleshy, tentacle-like appendage that curves in an S-shape from the upper arm down past the hand, ending in a curled tip, with small nodules along its length. Organic and monstrous.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tentacle body; colour 1 on the small bumps; colour 2 on the small spots.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Mutated_02.differs: The female tentacle hangs slightly longer and its contrasting-slot nodules are smaller and less clustered than on the male.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Odragon_01.description: A small dragon-head bracer worn at the left wrist: a smooth snouted head with a small eye and a tusk-like claw, crowned by a fan of long swept-back spiky fins or mane blades.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dragon head and snout; colour 1 on the large fin blades; colour 2 on the edging of the fins and the tusk; colour 3 on the eye.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Padding.description: Tactical forearm guard made of separate hard plates: two curved shells wrapping the outer and inner forearm, with a small detached pad floating above near the elbow. Segmented, angular and military in feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates and elbow pad; colour 1 on the large curved panels; colour 2 on the horizontal bands; colour 3 on the small inset panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Patriot_01.description: A left forearm bracer shaped as a curved guard plate with contrasting edge piping and a tapered wrist end, held on by two contrasting straps. Sits over the outer forearm, suggesting a clean superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate; colour 1 on the edge piping and the inner lining; colour 2 on the two straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Phantom_03.description: A smooth, open-sided forearm bracer with a swooping cut-out edge, curving from a wide angular cuff near the elbow down to a narrower wrist end. It sits on the left forearm as a simple sleek armored guard.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Phantom_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer bracer shell; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Pony_01.description: A wrist bracer made of a dense tuft of long, pointed, overlapping locks like a pony's mane, layered in tiers and flaring outward and backward from the left forearm. Playful, fantasy styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Pony_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and outer locks; colour 1 on the middle tier of locks; colour 2 on the lower, longest trailing locks.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Pumpkin_01.description: A left forearm bracer built like a ribcage: curved rib bands wrap around a central spine, with angular plated shells along the outer edge, a flared cuff at the wrist and tall curved horn spikes at the elbow end.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer armour shells and wrist cuff; colour 0 on the rib bands; colour 2 on the spine core between the ribs; colour 3 on the horn spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Punk_01.description: A short, wide cuff bracer worn on the left forearm, with a smooth band studded with rows of conical spikes and small faceted nubs around its outside. A punk, aggressive look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff band, fading toward colour 0 at the lower edge; colour 2 on the spikes and studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Punk_02.description: A chunky left forearm bracer: a knit ribbed cuff sits at the top, with a bulky metal cup below and a raised, rounded armor plate along the outer side. Punk-styled, worn just above the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Punk_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed knit cuff; colour 3 on the raised outer plate; colour 0 on the metal cup and its rim; colour 2 on the trim band and underside.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Punk_03.description: A short cylindrical sweatband worn on the left wrist, made of vertical padded stripes between thin rounded rims at top and bottom. Sporty, retro punk styling that sits snugly around the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Punk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and bottom rims; colour 1 on alternating vertical stripes; colour 2 on alternating vertical stripes; colour 3 on alternating vertical stripes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Rave_Brace.description: A chunky wrist bracelet with a zigzag, jagged upper and lower edge, made of angular banded segments with small triangular inset cut-outs. It sits snugly around the left wrist with a punk, rave-style look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Rave_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band and lower jagged edge; colour 2 on the upper band and inner lining; colour 1 on the triangular inset accents on the upper band; colour 3 on the triangular inset accents on the lower band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Rave_Brace.description: A chunky octagonal cuff bracelet worn on the left wrist, with raised rims top and bottom around a wide central band, studded with several long cone spikes and small pyramid studs. Punk rave styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Rave_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and bottom rims and inner lining; colour 1 on the central band; colour 2 on the spikes and studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Rave_Fur_0.description: A feathered wrist cuff: a short solid band at the wrist with layered rows of shaggy feathers flaring down over the back of the hand in three tiers. Party or rave styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Rave_Fur_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the wrist band; colour 2 on the upper feather layer; colour 1 on the middle feather layer; colour 0 on the lower feather layer.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Rave_Wire_.description: A left forearm bracer made of open diamond-lattice mesh, with a thick padded cuff at the elbow end and a rounded mesh flap extending over the back of the hand, edged with contrasting trim. Rave or street style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Rave_Wire_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top cuff and the trim around the hand flap; colour 0 fading into colour 1 on the upper and lower mesh strands; colour 2 on the mesh at the hand flap and the cuff interior.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Reactor_01.description: A chunky angular forearm bracer worn on the left arm: a layered armored shell with a large curved outer plate, a small mechanical housing on top and a long pointed fin sweeping forward. Suggests a sci-fi reactor gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner housing and armor plates; colour 2 on the large outer shell and the pointed fin; colour 1 on the inner lining visible behind the shell.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Reactor_02.description: A left forearm bracer of angular armor plating with a pointed flared edge at the elbow and wrist, an open lattice window showing a contrasting inner panel, and a cuff band at each end. Sci-fi reactor styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor plates; colour 1 on the cuff bands and rim; colour 2 on the inner lattice panel; colour 3 on the small studs.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Reactor_02.differs: The female bracer has a longer, sharper point at the wrist and a slimmer shape; the male one has a broader outer plate with a shorter wrist point.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Renegade_C.description: A bulky sci-fi forearm bracer with a boxy cannon barrel mounted along the outer side, segmented armor plates, a curved cup at the elbow end, and a looping external cable. Sits over the left forearm from elbow to wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Renegade_C.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and cannon barrel; colour 1 on the elbow cup, wrist rings and inner panels; colour 2 on the recessed panels; colour 3 on the cable and small indicator dots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Renegade_C.description: A chunky sci-fi arm cannon strapped along the left forearm: a boxy rear housing, a ridged barrel block running toward the wrist, vent slots along the side, twin muzzle tips, and a looping power cable.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Renegade_C.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing and barrel casing; colour 1 on the mounting bracket and muzzle tips; colour 3 on the looping cable; colour 2 on the vent slots and underside.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Renegade_S.description: A chunky forearm bracer with a rounded upper cuff topped by a contrasting spiked band and a row of sharp spikes, a smooth tapered lower guard, and curved hoses running to small canisters on the sides.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Renegade_S.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cuff and the bottom rim; colour 0 on the lower forearm guard and canister caps; colour 2 on the spike base band and hose joints; colour 3 on the spikes and hoses.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Renegade_S.differs: The spike band on the female version sits higher and is chunkier, with fewer visible spikes, and the cuff is shaped more like a raised flared collar.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Retro_Warl.description: A bulky arm-mounted rotary cannon on the left forearm: a rounded armoured casing beside a ribbed ammo drum, a multi-barrel gatling muzzle pointing down past the hand, and a coiled flexible feed hose rising to the chest.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Retro_Warl.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed drum and casing shell; colour 0 on the barrel cluster and hose; colour 2 on the casing top and drum bands; colour 3 on the panel of the casing.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Retrosteel.description: A retro sci-fi left forearm bracer with a cylindrical cuff that carries an oval, spiked shield plate with curved blade fins and twin side barrels. The plate is turned edge-on, so it reads as a narrow blaster-like profile from the front.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Retrosteel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield plate face and blade fins; colour 1 on the cuff, side barrels and spike tips; colour 3 on the inlaid line pattern; colour 2 on the plate edge and underside.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Retrosteel.differs: The shield plate is turned edge-on so it sticks out sideways like a gun, where the male plate faces outward flat on the forearm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Retrosteel.description: A retro-styled forearm-mounted cannon: a boxy gun body strapped to the left forearm with two cuff bands, a perforated barrel running past the wrist, and a small panel with a display on the back.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Retrosteel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel and light edge highlights; colour 1 on the cuff bands and top cap; colour 2 on the gun body and panels; colour 3 on the small indicator lights on the back.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Retrosteel.description: A large oval retro-styled shield worn on the left forearm, with a bevelled metal face, a central emblem with raised channel lines, two banded side cylinders, small swept fins top and bottom, and a ring of short spikes around the rim.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Retrosteel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and fins; colour 3 on the raised channel lines and central emblem; colour 1 on the side cylinders and spike tips; colour 2 on the rim and back.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Roman_01.description: A segmented Roman-style left forearm bracer made of stacked overlapping armor plates studded with rivets, open along the inner side and held closed by several thin straps with loops. Sits on the forearm from elbow to wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Roman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate segments; colour 1 as a gradient tint at the upper and edge areas of the plates; colour 3 on the rivets; colour 2 on the straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Roman_02.description: A left forearm bracer of stacked, overlapping segmented plates with a raised ridge down the outer side and small round rivets along each plate. It tapers toward the wrist and has no straps, in a Roman legionary style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Roman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented plates; colour 1 on the upper edge and the ridge shading; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Sandstorm_.description: A fingerless glove with a ruched, scrunched cuff extending up the forearm and a rectangular raised plate with an inset block on the outer side of the hand. Sporty, sci-fi fighter look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Sandstorm_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the scrunched cuff; colour 2 on the plate frame; colour 3 on the inset block.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Sandstorm_.description: A small faceted armor plate worn on the outer left forearm, a tapered angular shield shape held by a thick contrasting band that wraps around the arm. Suggests a rugged, sci-fi or fantasy bracer.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Sandstorm_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate; colour 2 on the encircling band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Sandstorm_.description: A fingerless fist wrap glove with a cuffed wrist, paired with a separate angular plate bracer strapped high on the forearm; a small plate sits at the glove wrist and a ribbed knuckle guard covers the outer hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Sandstorm_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm plate and wrist plate; colour 1 on the glove cloth; colour 2 on the straps; colour 3 on the ribbed knuckle guard.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarab_01.description: A forearm bracer with a smooth rounded main shell, a separate cuff at the wrist and a dome-shaped panel on the outer side. Curved contrasting fins run along the sides and end in long swept-back horn spikes. Superhero, insect-inspired look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and lower rim; colour 1 on the side fins; colour 3 on the horn spikes; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and top dome panel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarab_01.differs: The female version has two horn spikes, but the rear one is shorter and the pair is less symmetric than on the male.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarab_02.description: A left forearm bracer of smooth armored plates with a raised outer shell, an elbow-side cap with a round window panel, a trim-edged cuff at the wrist and a tall curved horn sweeping up from the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate and the round elbow panel; colour 1 on the side shell; colour 2 on the edging, elbow cap and cuff; colour 3 on the curved horn.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarab_Alt.description: A pair of curved, pincer-like scarab claws rising from a small curved base at the left wrist. Each tapers into a sharp hooked tip that points up along the forearm. Suggests an insectoid, fantasy gauntlet accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarab_Alt.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved base cuff; colour 1 on the long claw shafts; colour 3 on the pointed claw tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarab_Alt.description: A small forearm bracer shaped like a scarab claw: a tapering segmented base with a long curved horn rising past the wrist, and a hooked curved band wrapping around the lower forearm. Sits on the left forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarab_Alt.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved hooked band at the wrist; colour 2 on the segmented base; colour 3 on the long curved horn.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarletshi.description: A pair of stacked wide wrist straps on the left forearm, each closed with a square frame buckle and a keeper loop, with the strap tails lying flat. A casual, street-style bracer.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Scarletshi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the keeper loops; colour 2 on the buckle frames.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Seacreatur.description: A cluster of long, curved fin-like blades fanning out from the outside of the left forearm near the wrist, each with a raised edge and chevron markings. Suggests an aquatic, creature-themed gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Seacreatur.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade surfaces; colour 1 on the blade edges and outlines; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the inner faces and tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Shield_Her.description: A heater-style heraldic shield with a notched, pointed lower edge and a thick raised rim, strapped to the left forearm and hanging at the side. It has a decorative winged emblem on the face and two grip slots behind.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Shield_Her.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shield field; colour 1 on the inset central panel; colour 3 on the central emblem; colour 2 on the rim and back.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Shield_Her.differs: The shield hangs further back from the arm and sits more edge-on to the front, but its shape is the same.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Sleeve_01.description: A loose, flared sleeve section for the left forearm: a short banded cuff at the upper end, wrinkled cloth widening toward the wrist, and a separate hem band at the open end. Casual, flowing style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Sleeve_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sleeve cloth; colour 1 on the upper band; colour 2 on the bottom hem band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Socrates_0.description: A superhero forearm bracer with a raised, looping rim that arcs up from the wrist, a central segmented panel with ribbed vent slats, and a flared cuff at the forearm's upper end. Sits on the left forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Socrates_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer rim and wrist band; colour 1 on the side panels and lower cuff; colour 0 on the central stripe, vent slats and upper cuff; colour 2 on the small cap at the top of the panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Spiked_01.description: A chunky wrist restraint with two padded rounded rings joined by a narrow central band, a rigid angular clasp plate on one side, small studs on the upper ring and pyramid spikes around the lower ring.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the padded rings; colour 2 on the central band; colour 0 on the angular clasp plate; colour 3 on the studs and spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Spooky_01.description: A jagged, shard-like bracer of stacked crystalline spikes running down the outer left forearm, with tall pointed fins near the elbow tapering to smaller splintered points toward the wrist. Icy, fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper spikes and shards near the elbow; colour 1 on the lower shards toward the wrist, blending gradually from colour 0.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Spy_01.description: A short ruffled wrist frill worn on the left wrist: a gathered, flared skirt-like cuff that drapes over the back of the hand, finished with three stacked bands of contrasting trim along the hem. Frilly, dressy spy-style look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ruffle fabric and the inner lining; colour 1 on the middle trim band; colour 2 on the inner trim band; colour 3 on the outer hem edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Starhawk_0.description: A superhero forearm bracer: a tapering armored plate runs from a rounded, angular cap at the elbow down to a flared cuff at the wrist, with a small faceted gem-like fin on top of the cap.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Starhawk_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long forearm plate; colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the elbow cap and its rim; colour 3 on the pointed crest.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Starowl_01.description: A bulky, feathery cuff that wraps the left forearm below the elbow, with layered pointed feather tufts fanning out around the arm and a rounded, speckled mass. Suggests an owl or griffon-like fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feather mass; colour 1 on the small speckles scattered across the feathers; darker shading patches show in the surface texture.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Steelcomma.description: A short, tapered armoured bracer worn on the left forearm near the wrist, with a large smooth plate, a raised rim, an angular side guard and a ridged vent section at the top edge. Retro military-hero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Steelcomma.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main forearm plate; colour 2 on the side guard and inner panel; colour 0 on the rim edging; colour 3 on the ridged vent fins.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Super_Dest.description: A short forearm bracer made of stacked metal bands capped by chunky faceted rims at both ends, with a row of five sharp conical spikes along the outer edge. Retro superhero villain styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Super_Dest.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 0 on the middle stacked bands (glossy metallic look); colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 in the shadowed band gaps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Swan_01.description: A left forearm bracer that flares from a trimmed upper opening to a wide cuff, with a zigzag seam, an angular diamond inset and a round port near the wrist. A ragged feathery fringe hangs over the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body and fringe; colour 1 on the rim, zigzag seam, cuff band and fringe tips; colour 3 on the diamond inset; colour 2 on the round port.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Swing_01.description: A chunky tapered bracer worn on the left forearm, with a rimmed flared cuff, riveted armour panels, vent holes and strap bands, plus a small side-mounted spiked electrode cylinder with a glowing tube and ribbed base.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armour panels, straps and electrode casing; colour 1 on the bracer body and rim piping; colour 2 on the top rim and electrode collar; colour 3 on the tube inside the electrode.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Swing_02.description: A loose, slouchy forearm bracer on the left arm: a wide cuffed upper section with a snap tab and a small pocket-like panel, gathered over a ribbed, fitted lower section that ends at the wrist with edging.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper slouchy sleeve and cuff; colour 1 on the ribbed lower section; colour 2 on the edging and panel outlines; colour 3 on the round jewel-like lights.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Syringe_01.description: A chunky left forearm bracer with a flared top edge and angled armour panels. Syringe barrels stick out from the outer side, and tubes run along the front to a row of needle tips hanging past the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Syringe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour shell, syringe barrels and needle housings; colour 1 on the inset front panel; colour 3 on the raised front panel and tubes; colour 2 on the top rim and base band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Tateklys_0.description: A sci-fi forearm bracer with a flared, angled outer shell rising to a pointed fin at the elbow, an inset panel etched with circuit-like grooves, and a flared cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Tateklys_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and wrist band; colour 1 on the inner lining, inset panel and cuff flare; colour 2 on the elbow fin edge; colour 3 on the etched circuit lines.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Thruster_0.description: A large, elongated thruster pod worn on the left forearm, hanging beside the body. It has a tapered, segmented shell with ribbed panels and swept fin-like blades along both edges, giving a sci-fi jet look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Thruster_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and rim panels; colour 1 on the ribbed shell sections and blades; colour 3 on the fin blades and side vents; colour 2 on the small inserts and nose tip.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Tight_Anni.description: A short tapered superhero bracer worn on the left forearm, with a flared, scooped cuff that rises at the outer elbow side and a smooth lower sleeve carrying three recessed horizontal slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Tight_Anni.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the flared upper cuff; colour 0 on the front of the lower sleeve; colour 2 on the slot panels and the back of the sleeve; colour 3 on the thin outlines around the slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Traveler_0.description: A short forearm bracer with a folded-over cuff at the top and a flared soft wrist edge, with a smooth rigid panel down the outer face and a row of small lacing bars along its edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Traveler_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and main bracer body; colour 1 on the long outer panel; colour 2 on the panel outline and lacing bars.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Victory_01.description: A tapered armored bracer worn on the left forearm, with a rounded cuff at the elbow end, layered angular panels, a central strip down the front and a pair of pointed fins flaring off the upper edge. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angled side panels and the upper fins; colour 1 on the rim bands at both ends and the upper cuff; colour 2 on the central front strip.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Vigilante_.description: A left forearm bracer: a curved guard with a glossy central plate framed by a raised angular rim, held by two short cuffed bands at the wrist and near the elbow. Suggests a vigilante or street-hero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Vigilante_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy central plate; colour 3 on the raised outer rim and shell; colour 1 on the band cuffs; colour 0 on the band edges.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Vigilante_.differs: The female bracer has a slanted upper edge and a slimmer, more tapered plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Vigilante_.description: A left forearm bracer made of two stacked angular armour plates joined by a narrow connecting band, with layered strap bands around the arm above and below. Sits on the forearm toward the wrist, in a tactical vigilante style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Vigilante_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the armour plates; colour 3 on the connecting band between the plates; colour 1 and colour 0 on the layered strap bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Warrior_01.description: A left forearm bracer made of stacked, padded ribbed segments that taper toward the wrist, with a raised pointed shield-shaped plate on the outer face and a separate ribbed cuff band at the wrist over a contrasting under-sleeve.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed padded segments and cuff; colour 0 on the quilted front plate; colour 1 on the round inset on the plate; colour 2 on the wrist under-sleeve.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Warrior_02.description: A left forearm bracer made of a tall ribbed upper cuff, a angular armored plate with contrasting trim in the middle, and a ribbed wrist cuff below. It wraps the forearm but is open along one side.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surfaces, the inner lining and the cuff base; colour 2 on the upper ribbed bands; colour 1 on the lower wrist ribbed bands; colour 3 on the trim around the central plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Weapon_Cla.description: A left-hand bracer weapon: a wrist cuff with a strap and a ribbed hand plate with round studs, ending in a contrasting hinge mount that holds two long, curved, blade-like tiger claws pointing down past the fingers.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Weapon_Cla.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 0 on the ribbed hand plate; colour 2 on the hinge mount and underside housing; colour 3 on the claw blades and the round studs and slots on the plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Weapon_Tro.description: A spiky armored forearm bracer with a pointed, segmented shell along the outer forearm and a long tapering blade extending past the hand, flanked by two swept fin-like blades. Fantasy sci-fi warrior look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Weapon_Tro.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the central shell panels; colour 2 on the spiky edge armor and the trim around the shell; colour 1 on the two side fin blades; colour 0 on the central blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Wildfur_01.description: A left forearm bracer of overlapping pointed fur tufts stacked in rows, forming a shaggy tapered sleeve from elbow to wrist with jagged tips along both edges. Suggests a wild, feral look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Wildfur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur tufts; colour 1 on the inner tuft highlights; colour 2 on the tuft tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Wires_01.description: A left forearm bracer of layered armor plates: a broad flat slab on the upper forearm, a segmented panel beneath it, and a flared, pointed cuff at the wrist. Small round studs decorate the plates. Superhero-tactical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer forearm plate and flared wrist cuff; colour 2 on the broad upper slab; colour 1 on the segmented inner panel; colour 3 on the studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracers_Cosmos_01.description: A angular metal bracer worn on the left forearm: a tall pointed plate flaring from the elbow side down to the wrist, with a separate smaller cuff plate at the wrist and bevelled edges. Sci-fi armoured look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracers_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bevelled edge trim; colour 2 on the main plate surfaces; colour 3 on the thin inner line at the wrist cuff; colour 1 on the inner panel accents. The glossy metal mostly ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracers_Cosmos_02.description: A left forearm bracer of glossy sculpted plates: a pointed, swept-up outer edge, an inset heart-shaped panel with a small round gem, and a jagged blade-like flare reaching toward the wrist. Fantasy-armor style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracers_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and edges (glossy metal, partly ignoring the scheme); colour 1 on the heart-shaped inset panel; colour 3 on the round gem; colour 2 on the underside and wrist flare.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracers_Splendor_.description: A left forearm bracer in a superhero style: a tapered cuff with a large pointed fin-like flare at the elbow end, layered panels, a sharp spiked inlay down the front and a flared band at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracers_Splendor_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the elbow flare and wrist band; colour 0 on the main forearm panel; colour 3 on the spiked inlay; colour 2 on the thin band between the flare and the main panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracerspikes_01.description: A cluster of short conical spikes studded around the left forearm, in staggered rows with a few rounded stud bases between them. Sits just above the wrist as a punky bracer accent with no band.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Bracerspikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes and studs; the spikes look light in the default material and take no other colour slot.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Arm_Gearbre.description: A curved, shield-like plate that stands off the left shoulder, with a thick rimmed edge, a hexagonal stud on the face and a small boxy canister attached at the side. Reads as a sci-fi tactical shoulder guard.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Arm_Gearbre.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved plate; colour 2 on the rim and the canister; colour 1 on the hexagonal stud and the canister band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Arm_Retro_W.description: A bent tubular metal handle-like bar with angled ends and a slight S-curve, floating just off the outer left upper arm like a bracket or grab-bar. Suggests a retro, industrial warrior accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Arm_Retro_W.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the tube (glossy metal look); colour 1 on the lower end section of the bar.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Arm_Retro_W.differs: The female bar is a narrower, more slanted curve with the upper end angled more sharply, while the male bar is a squarer, more boxy loop.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Anni.description: A small faceted metal shell worn on the left side of the chest near the shoulder, with a hollow back and one inset round port on its outer face. Retro robot-styled, chunky and angular.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Anni.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal shell; colour 3 on the inset round ports. The glossy metal finish largely ignores the other slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Anni.differs: The female version shows one visible round port on the outer face, while the male version has two ports.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Aqua.description: A pair of curved, angular fin-like spikes jutting out sideways from the outer forearm, one above the other and swept toward the hand. Faceted blades give an aquatic, predatory look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Aqua.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both spike blades; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Aqua.description: A pair of curved, faceted fin-like blades jutting from the outer side of the left forearm, one above the other and sweeping back toward the elbow. Suggests aquatic or monstrous spiked bracers.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Aqua.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blades; the pieces show no other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Armo.description: A small angular armored bracer plate on the outer left wrist and forearm edge, a slightly curved tapered slab with a beveled edge and a short separate curved band beneath it. Suits superhero or sci-fi armor looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the small curved band below the plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Asce.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a small central ring, sitting on the outer forearm above the wrist like a decal. Suggests a superhero or sci-fi insignia.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Asce.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; colour 1 on the thin edge outline of the rings.
