Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Brut.description: A chunky, angular bone-like bracer worn on the left forearm: overlapping jagged plates form a shell, with a cluster of swept-back spikes on top and a single curved horn pointing down toward the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Brut.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plates; colour 1 on the cluster of upright spikes; colour 2 on the downward horn.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Drac.description: A single curved, blade-like fin attached to the outer forearm: a swept spike with a hooked notch near the top and jagged serrations tapering down toward the wrist. Dragon-like and aggressive.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Drac.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole fin blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Game.description: A game-controller-shaped slab strapped to the outer forearm, with a raised cross pad and rows of round buttons on its face. A thin curling cable trails from its lower end and loops around the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Game.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the controller body; colour 3 on the cross pad and buttons; colour 1 on the trailing cable.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Goth.description: A stack of bracers worn at the left wrist: a wide faceted band studded with round bumps, a thin ring underneath, and a tilted thin angular hoop rising above it. Gothic, punk styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Goth.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wide studded band; colour 3 on the studs; colour 0 on the upper hoop; colour 2 on the lower ring.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Hamm.description: A chunky left-forearm bracer made of a flared, boxy cuff at the wrist with two separate rounded rectangular blocks stacked up the forearm above it. Bulky, armor-like and stylised.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Hamm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large wrist cuff; colour 1 on the two stacked forearm blocks.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Kram.description: A heavy chain wound in several tangled loops around the left forearm just above the wrist, forming a chunky bracelet-like bracer. Rough, gritty style suggesting punk, gothic or monstrous costumes.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Kram.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all the chain links; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mech.description: A flat, elongated blade-shaped plate hanging beside the left hand, with a slanted pointed tip and a bordered frame holding three inset panels. It has a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mech.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame and edges; colour 3 on the two large inset panels; colour 2 on the small middle panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mech.description: A long, slim rectangular blade-like blaster block hanging beside the hip, detached from the forearm. It has a flat plate with recessed inset strips and a boxy casing, giving a mechanical sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mech.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer casing and end cap; colour 0 on the thin edge plate and top tip; colour 3 on the recessed strips; colour 2 on the flat inner side panel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mech.differs: The female piece is a little thicker and shorter, and sits slightly further from the body.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mode.description: A small angular bracer on the left wrist: a thick band around the cuff with a tapering, pointed plate that extends down over the back of the hand. Sleek, plated, modern armoured look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mode.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrist band; colour 0 on the tapered plate over the hand.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Moth.description: Three separate curved, tapering spikes in a row along the outer left forearm, each pointing down toward the wrist like moth-inspired thorns or claws. Sharp, angular and monstrous accents.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Moth.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all three spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retr.description: A chunky forearm-mounted rotary minigun: a ribbed cylindrical housing with a banded collar, a side mounting bracket, and a cluster of long parallel barrels with ring clamps extending past the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed housing; colour 2 on the collar band, top cap and bracket; colour 0 on the barrels and barrel rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retr.description: A detached, snaking segmented cable of stacked ribbed metal rings with small spikes along its edge, ending in a boxy block at the upper arm and curving across the chest and shoulder. Industrial, post-apocalyptic warlord look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed ring segments; colour 1 on the spiky edge tips and ring edges; colour 2 on the boxy end block and inner rings.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retr.differs: The female version curves up across the chest and is shorter and narrower, while the male version arcs out over the shoulder.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Sand.description: A small left forearm bracer: a faceted, shield-like angular plate standing off the outer arm, mounted on a chunky segmented band that wraps the arm. Sits on the upper forearm near the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Sand.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular plate; colour 2 on the band around the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Shie.description: A heater-style heraldic shield strapped to the left forearm, with a pointed lower edge, notched sides and a thick raised rim. A swooping crest sits at the centre and two grip slots show on the back.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shield face and upper wings; colour 1 on the inner field panels; colour 3 on the central crest; colour 2 on the rim and back.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Shie.differs: The female shield sits tilted further back against the hip and looks slightly smaller, with the point directed downward.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Swan.description: A feathery cuff that wraps around the left wrist and hand, made of overlapping jagged, pointed plumes that fall around the fist, with a flat closed top. Soft, fluffy and decorative, with a fantasy or elegant feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Swan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plumes, fading toward colour 1 at the feather tips; colour 1 on the flat top cap.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syri.description: A cyberpunk wrist rig: a small cylindrical hub at the wrist feeds bundled cables to four syringe needles that hang past the hand like claws, with extra cabled canisters floating off the forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syri.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hub, canister caps and needle housings; colour 1 on the needle tips and small connector bands; colour 2 on the canister bodies and needle barrels; colour 3 on the cables.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syri.differs: The canisters and hub are arranged slightly differently around the forearm, with the two canisters sitting closer together.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syri.description: A wrist-mounted syringe rig: a cylindrical metal cuff on the back of the wrist feeds bundled tubes to four long needle injectors over the hand, while two more tubes run up the forearm to capped canisters.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syri.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, canister caps and injector barrels; colour 3 on the tubes; colour 1 on the needle tips and connector fittings; colour 2 on the injector bands.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syri.differs: The female version has its tubes and canisters swept slightly further up the forearm, but the layout is otherwise the same.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Vict.description: A small angular band worn on the left upper arm, with a V-shaped front and two swept-up pointed fins. A contrasting stripe runs along the edge above a contrasting underside. Suits a superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Vict.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper swept fins; colour 1 on the stripe along the band; colour 2 on the lower edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Weap.description: A pair of long, narrow blade claws that extend downward from the left fist, slightly overlapping and tapering to sharp points with a small notch on the edge. Reads as a fantasy or superhero hand weapon.

A single long, narrow blade projecting downward from the left wrist past the hand, flanked by curved fin-like blades on either side. Angular and sharp, it suggests a sentai-style hero gauntlet weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Weap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central blade; colour 1 on the curved side blades; colour 2 on the blade edge shading.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Wire.description: A small curved armor plate worn on the outside of the left wrist, a half-shell with a pointed, swept-back edge and a thin raised rim, fastened by two round rivet-like studs.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Wire.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 1 on the rim edge; colour 3 on the two studs; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracers_Cos.description: A small angular shield-shaped bracer plate worn on the outer side of the left wrist, with a notched, pointed top edge, a raised central ridge and a bordered rim. It reads as a compact superhero armor guard.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracers_Cos.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and edge; colour 3 on the inset border line; colour 2 on the central raised plate and the side face.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A pair of long curved blade spikes projecting downward from the left fist, swept and jagged like claws, with a sharp outer edge and a contrasting inner panel. Fantasy-monstrous weapon-like bracer.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade spikes and ridges; colour 1 on the broad blade face panels; colour 2 on the inner recess of the blades.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.differs: The female version has two blades spaced more widely apart and pointing further down, in a slightly looser arrangement.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A long curved energy blade that projects from the left forearm past the hand, thin and tapering to a sharp point, with a fractured crackling surface and a broad base near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: The whole blade glows and ignores the colour scheme, so no slot visibly applies.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A long, curved energy blade projecting from the left forearm and sweeping down past the thigh to a sharp point. It is thin and crescent-shaped, with a cracked, crystalline surface pattern suggesting a psionic weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: The whole blade appears to ignore the colour scheme, showing a glowing surface with veined cracks; no visible slot colours.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, hovering as a thin plate beside the left wrist, facing outward. It suggests a science or energy superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the rings; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating as a thin plate just beside the left forearm near the wrist. Sci-fi superhero decoration with no straps or bracer body.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rings of the emblem; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating beside the left wrist like a badge. It is a thin, planar decal-like piece with an outlined edge, suggesting a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring faces; colour 1 on the outer edge outline of the rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A thin, flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating beside the left wrist like a small shield. It is edge-on from the front and reads as a decorative superhero badge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings of the emblem; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A flat, paper-thin atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central disc, floating just off the outer side of the left wrist. It is nearly edge-on from the front and back.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and central disc; colour 1 on the outlines and edges of the rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A set of three long, slender curved blades that extend from the left fist down past the knee, fanned slightly apart like Wolverine-style claws. Sleek pointed metal, worn as a hand attachment.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three blades; the base where the blades meet the fist has no other visible colour slot.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Retro.description: A thin, translucent glass bracer panel curving partway around the outer left forearm just above the wrist. It is a narrow, slightly tapered shell with a glossy edge, suggesting a retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Retro.colourAreas: The glass panel ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slots are visible on it.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Clockwork_Armor_0.description: An angular, faceted bracer worn on the outer left forearm: a tapered plated shell with a stepped side panel and a flared upper tip, ending in a small open port at the wrist. Sci-fi armour styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Clockwork_Armor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper tip and side edge; colour 1 on the stepped side panel and trim; colour 2 on the large textured outer shell; colour 3 on the small inner detail at the wrist opening.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A rugged left forearm bracer made of a curved, worn plate with a thick raised rim and round rivets, plus a smaller overlapping plate at the wrist end. It suggests a gritty western-cyber gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main worn plate face; colour 2 on the raised rim and edging; colour 3 on the lower wrist plate; colour 1 on the rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Cybermind_02.description: A cybernetic left forearm bracer shaped like a smooth tapered cup, with a long ribbed flexible cable that arcs up along the upper arm to a small connector at the shoulder. Suggests sci-fi cyborg styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Cybermind_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell and the connector tip; colour 2 on the ribbed cable; a small lit spot on the bracer side ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Cybermind_02.differs: The female bracer is a plain single-tone shell with a contrasting cable, while the male version has contrasting and contrasting panels and a lighter cable.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Feathers_01.description: A single folded wing of layered feathers attached at the left shoulder and sweeping down along the outside of the arm, tapering to a point below the hip, with long pointed tips at the trailing edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper covert feathers near the shoulder; colour 1 on the main mid-wing feathers; colour 2 on the barred markings across the feathers; colour 3 on the long feather tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.description: A single curved blade claw held in the left fist, with a thin handle rod that ends in a small cap, a chunky angular guard, and a long tapered blade pointing downward past the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade body; colour 2 on the blade's underside edge and the handle cap; colour 1 on the guard; colour 3 on the handle rod.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.differs: The blade points straight down along the leg and curves back slightly, whereas the male blade sweeps forward and outward from the fist.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.description: A single long curved cyber blade held in the left fist: a flat tapering metal blade with a swept, pointed tip, mounted on thin angular linkage rods and small block fittings at the grip. It juts sideways from the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the thin linkage rods; colour 2 on the small block fittings; colour 1 on the small fins at the grip.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.differs: The female blade points sideways, almost horizontal, out from the fist, while the male blade angles upward along the forearm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.description: A single curved blade claw held in the left fist: a long, flat, tapering metal blade sweeping to a fine point, mounted on a small grip bracket with thin strut arms. Suggests a cyberpunk, sci-fi weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the grip bracket block and the strut tip caps; colour 3 on the thin strut arms; colour 1 on the small fin at the base of the grip.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.differs: The blade lies nearly horizontal, pointing sideways and slightly back from the fist, instead of angling upward along the forearm as on the male.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_04.description: A single curved cyber blade held in the left fist: a long, flat, tapering claw that sweeps to a fine point, with thin strut-like rods and small tabs at the grip. A sleek, sci-fi hand weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the thin grip struts; colour 2 on the small block tabs at the handle; colour 1 on the small fin at the knuckle.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_04.differs: The blade angles forward and out along the wrist line, with the grip struts lying close to the hand, whereas the male blade rises upward and back from the fist on struts that hang below the hand.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_05.description: A single slim curved blade held in the left fist, a flat tapering metal edge with a pointed tip projecting forward from the hand. Small hilt pieces at the grip; the blade points horizontally, giving a cyber-weapon look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the small hilt block at the grip. The thin and marker lines near the hilt look like helper guides rather than part of the piece.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_05.differs: The blade sits pointing horizontally forward from the fist, rather than angled upward across the hand.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.description: A single angular blade-like shard held in the left fist, a faceted wedge that tapers to a sharp point and projects downward from the hand. Suggests a cybernetic or sci-fi claw weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted base of the shard; colour 2 on the tapering blade faces. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.description: A single slim, curved blade-like claw held in the left fist, projecting sideways from the hand and sweeping to a sharp tip. Angular faceted metal shard with a flat broad base, suggesting a cyborg weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; the default metal shows little variation from the other slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.differs: The blade points sideways out of the fist, roughly level with the ground, instead of angling up along the forearm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.description: A single curved metal blade claw projecting from the left fist, a flat tapering shard that sweeps forward and down to a fine point. It reads as a retractable cybernetic weapon in a sci-fi style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; colour 2 on the underside edge. The default metal mostly ignores the other colour slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.differs: The female blade extends forward and points down past the hand, while the male blade angles upward from the fist.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.description: A single long, narrow blade-like claw held in the left fist, widening at the grip end and curving into a thin pointed tip that extends well past the knuckles. Suggests a cybernetic or sci-fi weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; the faceted edges show shading but no other colour slot is visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.description: A single slender blade-like claw held in the left fist, a tapered angular shard with a flat wedge base that curves to a sharp point; it projects sideways from the hand with a sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; the default material shows little variation from the other slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_0.differs: The female claw points sideways and slightly back from the fist, rather than angling upward from the hand.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_01.description: A small cybernetic claw blade for the left hand: a thin rod runs from a hexagonal base on the back of the hand to a flat, barbed arrowhead-shaped blade that hangs over the knuckles.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hexagonal base; colour 3 on the thin rod; colour 1 on the barbed blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_02.description: A small cyber-claw hand accessory: a flat plate sits on the side of the fist, with a thin bent rod rising to a small capped tip and a flat blade-like barb poking out near the fingers.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plate and rod tip cap; colour 3 on the bent rod; colour 1 on the small barb near the fingers.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_02.differs: The female barb is a short thin blade that sits close to the fingers, and the rod ends in a short bend rather than reaching out to it.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_03.description: A minimal cyber claw accessory for the left hand: a thin bent rod with a small capped tip rising above the fist, a flat rectangular plate beside the knuckles, and a small pointed blade near the fingers.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bent rod; colour 2 on the rod's cap and the flat plate; colour 1 on the pointed blade.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_03.differs: The pointed blade sits apart from the rod's end, near the fingers, rather than joined to it, and the flat plate is set further from the rod's bend.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_04.description: A small cyber claw accessory on the left fist: a thin bent rod with a hexagonal cap at one end, a flat curved plate at the knuckle bend and a separate small blade-like spike. Sci-fi cyberpunk look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bent rod; colour 2 on the end cap and the knuckle plate; colour 1 on the small spike blade.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_04.differs: The blade spike sits detached, near the front of the fist away from the end of the rod, rather than at the rod's tip.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_05.description: A tiny cyber claw accessory on the left hand: a thin bent wire rod with a small blocky cap at one end, a flat plate at the elbow of the bend and a small arrow-shaped blade tip at the other end, lying along the fist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_05.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bent wire rod; colour 2 on the end cap and the flat plate; colour 1 on the arrow-shaped blade tip.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Insect_01.description: A long, curved insect-style blade mounted on the left forearm by a short contrasting peg. It sweeps up past the elbow and down past the wrist, with a row of small serrated spikes along its inner edge. Suits monstrous or alien looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower blade body; colour 1 on the upper blade tip, blending in from the base; colour 3 on the serration spikes; colour 2 on the mounting peg.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Insect_02.description: A long curved insect-like blade mounted on a short cylindrical cuff at the left wrist, sweeping down past the hand in a tapering point, with a row of small serrated spikes along its inner edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Insect_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper blade; colour 1 on the lower tip of the blade, blending in from the top; colour 3 on the serrated spikes; colour 2 on the wrist mount.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.description: A simple chunky band ring with a faceted, roughly hexagonal outline and a wide hollow centre, worn around a finger of the left hand. Plain and low-poly with no stones or engraving.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring band; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.description: A chunky hexagonal band ring worn on a finger of the left hand, with a hollow six-sided opening and flat faceted sides. Reads as a simple, nut-like metal ring.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the default metal shows a glossy sheen and ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.description: A small chunky ring with a hexagonal, nut-like profile and a hexagonal hole through the middle, worn around a finger of the left hand. Plain and heavy, with a metallic industrial look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the glossy metal shading ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.description: A small chunky hexagonal band ring worn on a finger of the left hand, with a thick faceted profile and a hexagonal hole through the middle, like a nut. Simple, plain jewellery.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metallic default material shows little variation from the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.description: A small chunky ring with a hexagonal, faceted band and a hexagonal hole, worn around a finger of the left hand. Simple, low-poly and blocky in shape.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring band; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Butterf.description: A slim faceted band ring worn on a finger of the left hand, with a small butterfly ornament attached at the front. The butterfly has veined wings with a contrasting outline. Delicate, cute and fantasy in style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Butterf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 3 on the butterfly wing panels; colour 1 on the wing outlines; colour 2 on the butterfly body.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Butterf.description: A slim, faceted band ring worn on a left-hand finger, topped with a small butterfly whose four flat wings splay out sideways, each with a raised rim and vein pattern. A dainty, decorative fantasy accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Butterf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band and the outer wing rims; colour 1 on the wing edging; colour 3 on the wing inner panels; colour 2 on the small body at the centre.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Butterf.description: A slim band ring worn on a left-hand finger, topped with a small butterfly whose two pairs of wings spread out flat, each wing edged with a contrasting border and a veined inner panel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Butterf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 1 on the wing edges and borders; colour 3 on the veined inner wing panels; colour 2 on the small butterfly body.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Martial.description: A segmented upper-arm guard of horizontal layered plates in a contrasting frame, curved around the left upper arm and held by two cloth straps, with small looped cord knots on top. Martial, east-asian style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Martial.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates; colour 2 on the frame and plate dividers; colour 1 on the cloth straps; colour 3 on the looped knots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Martial.description: A curved armband of stacked horizontal slats inside a rigid rim, wrapping the outer side of the upper left arm. Small looped cords stick up from the top edge. Martial, armored look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Martial.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the slat panels; colour 2 on the rim and the dividing bands; colour 3 on the looped cords at the top.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Toy_01.description: A snug armband worn on the upper left arm, with a shield-shaped front plate framed by a raised rim and embossed with a heart symbol. A wraparound strap overlaps at the side, giving a playful, retro-toy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate face; colour 1 on the rim edging and strap edging; colour 2 on the raised heart emblem; colour 3 on the wrap strap band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armarmor_01.description: A short armored band worn around the left upper arm: a rounded-hex cuff with a raised rim at both ends, large padded oval plates front and back, and a segmented ridged strip along the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the band; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 2 on the large padded plates; colour 3 on the segmented side strip.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armband_01.description: A wide cloth band wrapped snugly around the upper left arm, knotted at the back with two short pointed tails hanging down. Soft creased folds give it a casual bandana-like look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armband_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band and knot tails; the folds show shading only.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armband_Med.description: A tight, faceted armband worn high on the left upper arm, with a contrasting strap panel holding three upright cylindrical vials with contrasting caps. Suggests a medic or tactical utility look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armband_Med.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the strap panel and the bands around the vials; colour 3 on the vial bodies; colour 2 on the vial caps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandchai.description: A chunky, faceted armband worn on the upper left arm: a wide band with a bevelled rim and a flat oval top face, with small knob-like bolts and loop rings on the sides for hanging chains.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandchai.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bevelled upper rim; colour 1 on the lower band; colour 3 on the flat top face; colour 2 on the side knobs and loop rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandtied.description: A narrow cloth armband wrapped around the upper left arm and tied in a knot at the back, with two short pointed tails hanging down. Casual, simple, cloth bandana-style accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandtied.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band, knot and tails; the piece shows no other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandwing.description: A slim armband worn on the left upper arm, with an open overlapping strap and a single pointed wing-like fin rising from the outer side. Sharp, angular demonic accent in a fantasy style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandwing.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and wing surface; colour 1 on the edging and rim of the band and wing.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandwing.description: A band worn around the left upper arm with a single swept-back blade-like wing fin projecting outward from its side. The fin curves upward to a sharp point and has grooved lines along its length.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandwing.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armband; colour 3 on the wing fin; colour 2 on the grooves and edge lines of the fin.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armor_Extra.description: A left forearm bracer of chunky segmented plates with carved angular glyph patterns and a small raised rounded fin near the elbow end, plus a separate floating band higher on the upper forearm. Weathered, ancient-relic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armor_Extra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces and band; colour 1 on the glyph line inlays and the inner fin; colour 2 on the weathered patches and edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armorbasic_.description: A tapered sci-fi forearm bracer with a faceted open cuff, recessed slot vents on the outer face, thin trim lines, and stacked contrasting ridged bands near the wrist. Sits over the left forearm as sleek armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armorbasic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell and rim; colour 1 on the inner lining, vent slots and thin trim lines; colour 3 on the rear slot inserts; colour 2 on the ridged bands near the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_.description: A tapered armored bracer for the left forearm, built from angular faceted plates with a cut-out opening near the elbow, pointed fin-like spikes at the top and small vent lights near the wrist. Sci-fi tactical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the pointed spikes and the rim at the wrist; colour 3 on the small light marks near the wrist; colour 2 on the shadowed inner surfaces.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armpouch_01.description: A chunky angular armband worn around the upper left arm, with a thick faceted band and a raised rectangular pouch plate on the outer side carrying two vertical inset slots. Sits snug on the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armpouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and pouch plate frame; colour 1 on the inset slots and on patches of the band's inner and lower edges.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armpouch_01.differs: The female band is a thicker, deeper cuff with a bowl-like opening, while the male version is a thin flat strap.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armtrumpkni.description: A small armoured elbow band with a large oval disc mounted on its outer side. The disc has a raised rim and a broad central stripe, giving a knightly, superhero look on the left elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armtrumpkni.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the disc rim; colour 1 on the disc face; colour 2 on the central stripe of the disc; colour 3 on the small square marking on the disc.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armtrumpkni.differs: The female disc has a plain central stripe and a small marking, while the male disc has a radiating star-like pattern and a band with pointed flared edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bicepknife_.description: A combat knife strapped to the upper left arm by a thin, faceted band. The blade points downward along the outside of the arm, with a crossguard and a short handle above. Suggests a tactical, military look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bicepknife_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm band; colour 1 on a small inner strip of the band; colour 2 on the handle and crossguard; colour 3 on the blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Birdpeople_.description: A small faceted band worn around the left upper arm, with a raised angular plate on the outer face that flares slightly outward. It reads as a compact, armor-like cuff with a simple rounded-polygon outline.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Birdpeople_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole band and its raised plate; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bolts_01.description: A pair of small oversized hex bolts with round heads and short shanks, floating against the upper left arm; one has a curved backing plate. A quirky industrial decoration for tech or sci-fi looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bolts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bolt heads, shanks and backing plates; colour 1 and colour 3 on thin rings at the base of the bolt heads.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bolts_01.differs: The female bolts have small contrasting rings under the heads and a wrapped backing plate, while the male ones are plain.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Alie.description: A tight alien-style left forearm bracer with a curved outer shell, banded ridges along the forearm and a row of small hooked spikes with a larger curved horn near the elbow. Worn on the forearm from elbow to wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Alie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the curved outer shell panel; colour 2 on the diagonal bands; colour 3 on the spikes and horn.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Amaz.description: A tight forearm bracer with a glossy tapered sleeve, layered swept bands wrapping the upper half, rimmed edges, and a tall pointed fin rising at the elbow end with an inset angular pattern. Fantasy warrior look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Amaz.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the layered upper bands and the rim edges; colour 0 on the glossy lower forearm plate; colour 2 on the inner lining and fin; colour 3 on the fin edge and its angular pattern.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Ange.description: A plain tapered forearm bracer worn on the left arm, a smooth sleeve-like cuff with faceted octagonal trim bands at the elbow end and the wrist end. Clean, simple superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Ange.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the trim bands at both ends.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Ange.description: A short tapered forearm bracer with an octagonal cuff at each end and a chunky angular fin-like plate along the outer edge, giving a faceted, angelic armored look on the left forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Ange.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the rim bands at the top and bottom; colour 3 on the angular outer plate.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Ange.differs: The female plate is a smaller, stepped shape with a notch, while the male plate is a taller cross-like shape.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Ange.description: A short tapered bracer covering the left forearm, with contrasting trim rings at the elbow and wrist ends and a long curved, pointed blade sweeping up from the outer edge past the elbow. Angelic sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Ange.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer body; colour 1 on the trim rings at both ends; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Ange.description: A short tapered forearm bracer with an angular armored plate on the outer side and a long curved scythe-like blade sweeping backward from it. Rimmed cuffs at both ends give it a fantasy angelic-warrior look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Ange.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer sleeve; colour 1 on the cuff rims; colour 3 on the angular outer plate; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Anni.description: A smooth, snug cloth bracer covering the forearm from below the elbow to the knuckles, with a fingerless hand section and a rigid rounded plate on the outer edge of the hand fitted with three round studs.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Anni.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm sleeve and hand cover; colour 1 on the side hand plate; colour 2 on the studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Arca.description: A tight, flared bracer worn on the left forearm, with pointed angular flaps at the elbow end and a slanted cuff edge at the wrist. Swirling scrollwork runs across the surface, with raised oval and hexagonal studs on the outer side. Suggests a mystic, arcane look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Arca.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 3 on the swirling scroll patterns; colour 1 on the oval and hexagonal gem studs; colour 2 on the pointed elbow flaps and trim edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Arch.description: A left-arm archer bracer: a separate band around the upper arm, plus a forearm guard with a side panel held by two wide rings near the elbow and two stacked rings at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Arch.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bands and rings; colour 1 on the forearm guard panel; colour 2 on the inserts inside the guard and band; colour 3 on the thin edge strip.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Band.description: A left forearm bandage wrap: overlapping diagonal strips of cloth spiral around the lower forearm just above the wrist, with visible gaps between windings and small stitch marks across the strips. Suits fighters, street and casual looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Band.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some of the wrapping strips; colour 1 on alternating strips; colour 3 on the other alternating strips; colour 2 on the stitch marks.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blas.description: A chunky angular bracer worn on the left forearm, with a faceted outer shell that tapers toward the wrist, a raised pointed ridge at the elbow end and an open hollow underside. Light stripes give it a sci-fi blaster look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blas.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer shell; colour 3 on the inner lining and underside; colour 0 on the stripes and the small inset panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blas.description: A chunky angular blaster bracer worn on the left forearm: a faceted shell with a raised peak at the back, short barrel muzzles at the wrist end, and a hollow inner cradle. Suggests a sci-fi superhero weapon gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blas.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 3 on the inner lining and rear edge; colour 0 on the stripes and small inset panels.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blas.differs: The female version has visible barrel muzzles protruding at the wrist end, while the male one has a more closed, flatter lower edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blas.description: A rigid armored bracer worn on the left forearm: angular segmented plates wrap the arm with an open channel along the front, a pointed fin rising at the elbow end, and small vent-like marks near both ends.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the elbow fin and small inset panels; colour 3 on the small marks near the edges; colour 2 on the inner edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blas.description: A bulky sci-fi blaster bracer on the left forearm: an angular armored casing with a vented panel and small round lights, a cylindrical canister at the side, a barrel nozzle by the wrist, hazard striping and a looped cable handle.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armored casing and canister bands; colour 1 on the canister, barrel nozzle and looped cable; colour 2 on the vent grille; colour 3 on the small round lights and the hazard stripe accents.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Bloc.description: A chunky sci-fi bracer on the left forearm: a rounded armored shell with a notched lower edge, a cuff band at the top, and octagonal sockets with round lens-like studs near the elbow and wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Bloc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and wrist flare; colour 1 on the upper cuff band; colour 2 on the octagonal socket housings; colour 3 on the round centre lenses.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Bloc.description: A chunky sci-fi left forearm bracer with a wide, flared armored shell that tapers to a snug cuff at the wrist. Angular panels frame recessed contrasting inserts with glowing-style oval details; open at the elbow end.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Bloc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor shell; colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the recessed inner panels; colour 3 on the oval insert details.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.description: A left forearm bracer made of two stitched cuff bands joined by a central strip, with a pair of long, flat blades projecting past the wrist along the back of the hand. Rivet heads and visible stitching give it a rugged, street-fighter look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff bands; colour 1 on the central strip between the cuffs; colour 2 on the claw blades and rivets; colour 3 on the stitching.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.description: A left forearm bracer made of stitched panels with a flared rim at the elbow end and a hinged cuff at the wrist. Two long, thin blade claws extend past the hand, giving a sharp, feral look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell and cuff; colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the stitching; colour 2 on the rivet; the claw blades look like plain metal that ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.differs: The female claws are long, thin, sword-like blades that extend well beyond the hand, and the bracer is narrower.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.description: A serpentine dragon coiled in loops around the left forearm, with a spined ridge along its body and a horned head at the wrist. Long curved blade claws extend past the hand, and a fantasy weapon look overall.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the dragon body and head; colour 2 on the spines along the coils; colour 0 on the claw blades; colour 3 on the inner blade streaks.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.differs: The female version shows a single dragon head with a cluster of claws, whereas the male version has two dragon heads each with its own claw.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.description: A left forearm bracer shaped like a organic thorned claw: a long panel with curling vine-like loops at the wrist, rows of small spikes along the edge, and a serrated blade extending past the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curling frame, loops and serrated blade; colour 3 on the central panel; colour 0 on the small thorn spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Coil.description: A slim helical coil that winds around the left forearm in about three and a half loops, with tapered pointed ends at top and bottom. It reads as a simple wire spring bracer.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Cuff.description: A frilly lace cuff worn around the left wrist: a flared, scalloped ring of openwork lace in layered tiers that fans outward from the wrist like a small ruffled collar.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Cuff.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main lace body and scalloped edges; colour 2 on the underside and inner layer of the lace shadowing; the lace cutouts show the body beneath.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Cybe.description: A left forearm bracer made of two separate angular plates, a larger front plate with a raised rim and three curved horn spikes along its outer edge, and a smaller rear plate. Worn on the forearm below the elbow with a rugged cyber-western look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Cybe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 2 on the rims and edges; colour 3 on the three spikes; colour 1 on small rivet accents on the rear plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Drag.description: A serpentine dragon coiled in a spiral around the forearm, its tail tapering to a point at the elbow end and a horned, spiny head resting at the wrist. Scale-like belly ridges with tooth-like markings suggest a fantasy or east-asian style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Drag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dragon's body and head; colour 1 on the back ridge, horns and fins; colour 3 on the tooth-like belly markings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Drag.description: A serpentine dragon coiled in a spiral around the left forearm, with a tapering tail tip near the elbow and a horned, finned head resting at the wrist. Toothlike markings run along the belly of the coil.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Drag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer body of the coil and the head; colour 1 on the inner ridged back of the coils, the fins and the horns; colour 3 on the tooth-like belly markings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Dray.description: A tight plated bracer wrapping the left forearm, with riveted angular plates and a sculpted snarling monster face on the outer side, its open mouth holding a bulbous gem and ringed with contrasting claw-like fangs.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Dray.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and face; colour 1 on the edge trim and panel lines; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth gem; colour 2 on the fangs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feat.description: A slim forearm bracer on the left arm with an ornate engraved band, sprouting a swept-back fan of layered feathers that trail past the elbow. The feathers lie flat and streamlined along the arm. Fantasy or superhero winged look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feat.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bracer band and its engraved trim; colour 2 on the inner layer of feathers; colour 3 on the outer long feathers.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feat.differs: The female feathers sweep back flat along the arm and stay low, while the male's stand up and away from the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feat.description: A wrist bracer with a round cuff and a fan of long, pointed feather blades sweeping back along the forearm. Layered feather panels with small light details give a sci-fi winged gauntlet look on the left arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feat.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff ring; colour 0 on the central feather panels; colour 2 on the outer feather blades; colour 3 on the small indicator marks and cuff detail.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feat.differs: The feather fan lies close and flat along the outside of the forearm, pointing back, where the male version splays wider and further from the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feat.description: A tight left forearm bracer with a curved shell plate, three wrapping straps with tabs across the forearm, and a crest of long pointed feather blades fanning out from the elbow end. Fantasy or tribal armour styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather blades and straps; colour 1 on the shell panel, feather tips and strap tabs; colour 2 on the inner edge of the shell; colour 3 on small accents on the straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Fin_.description: A slim left forearm bracer made of stacked, overlapping curved plates, each ending in a long swept-back fin spike. The plates hug the outer forearm and give it a sharp, predatory, aquatic-monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Fin_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled plate surfaces; colour 3 on the spotted speckle markings across the plates; colour 1 on the fin edges and rims; colour 2 in the shaded plate gradients.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Fin_.description: A slim bracer of three curved, blade-like fins stacked along the outer forearm, each swept back to a sharp point, with a thin edging around each fin. Creature-inspired and armour-like.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Fin_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin surfaces; colour 1 on the edging around each fin; colour 3 on the speckled markings; colour 2 on the shading at the fin bases.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadr.description: A curved, open-sided bracer plate that wraps the outer half of the left forearm from wrist to below the elbow. Its glossy, semi-transparent surface has etched circuit-board line patterns, giving a sci-fi tech look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; the etched circuit lines pick up a coppery metallic sheen that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadr.description: A tall, tapering teardrop-shaped shield blade that hangs beside the left forearm, pointed at the top and rounded at the wrist end. It has a hollow, glassy shell with a thin edge rim and a sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell body; colour 1 on the inner surface; the glossy translucent material largely ignores the rest of the scheme.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadr.differs: The female shield is a narrower, slimmer blade that sits slightly further from the wrist, with a smaller base.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gold.description: A short, flared forearm bracer that tapers toward the wrist, built from vertical alternating panels with a thick rim at the top and a narrow band at the wrist. A classic superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gold.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light vertical panels; colour 1 on the alternating vertical panels; colour 2 on the top rim, bottom band and panel seams.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gold.description: A small round shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm by a short cuff band, with a raised star on its face over concentric rings. Patriotic golden-age superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gold.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield's outer rim; colour 3 on the inner ring; colour 1 on the star; colour 2 on the forearm cuff and shield back.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gold.description: A small round shield worn on the outside of the left forearm, fixed by a short cuff band at the wrist. It has a thick rim and a printed atom emblem on its face, in a retro superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gold.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shield face; colour 0 on the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and back of the shield; colour 3 on the wrist cuff.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gold.differs: The shield is angled and sits lower toward the wrist, further along the forearm, with a larger cuff band than the male version.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Hamm.description: A chunky armored forearm bracer with stacked padded segments and small round vents, ending in a fist guard with a large blocky hammer head jutting out from the knuckles. Worn on the left forearm and hand, with a heroic, heavy-hitter look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Hamm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hammer head, the bracer end cap and the inner band; colour 1 on the padded cuff segments and knuckle guard; colour 2 on the small vent holes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Hamm.description: A chunky left bracer built from two stacked octagonal rings with small round vents, padded cushion blocks on the outer side, and a large boxy hammer-like cuff that extends over the back of the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Hamm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and the large boxy cuff; colour 1 on the padded cushion blocks; colour 2 on the small round vent holes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Holo.description: A floating holographic field of jagged, angular hexagonal shards hovering along the left forearm, with a larger spiky cluster near the elbow and a smaller burst by the wrist. It does not touch the arm and suggests a sci-fi energy effect.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Holo.colourAreas: Colour slots do not visibly apply; the whole field shows as a single glowing energy effect that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Mart.description: A snug tubular bracer covering the left forearm, wrapped with crossing bands in a zigzag pattern over a smooth cloth sleeve, with thin contrasting trim rings at the wrist and upper edge. A martial-arts style look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Mart.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 2 on the crossing straps; colour 1 on the trim rings at the top and wrist edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Mart.description: A tight leather-look forearm bracer with a padded rolled cuff at the top and a pointed, angled lower edge toward the wrist; angular T-shaped and chevron panels run down the outer face. Martial-arts, superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Mart.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim trim; colour 2 on the angular T-shaped and chevron overlay panels; colour 3 on the wedge inset beneath the T.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Mech.description: A tapered armored forearm bracer with a flared rolled cuff at the elbow end, a raised back fin, ribbed stepped plates along the front and a perforated inset panel on the back. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Mech.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 3 on the ribbed slashes and thin outline piping; colour 1 on the perforated back panel and side inset; colour 2 on the inner opening and fin.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A tight left forearm bracer with a segmented, panelled plate body, a flared open cuff that swoops up at the elbow end, a rounded round boss on the side and a thin flanged rim at the wrist. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared cuff and wrist rim; colour 2 on the main panelled body; colour 1 on the piping between panels and cuff; colour 3 on the round boss and the small strip near the top.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A chunky, rounded forearm bracer with a flared cuff, an octagonal disc with concentric rings on the outer side, a ribbed segmented panel and contrasting side insets. Sits on the left forearm above the wrist; superhero sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and cuff rims; colour 1 on the side insets; colour 2 on the ribbed panel; colour 3 on the centre of the disc.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A set of three long, thin blade claws that project from the back of the left fist and run down past the hand, like retractable slashers. Flat, angular and pointed, with a mean, feral look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main blade faces; colour 0 on the blade edges; colour 2 on the reverse sides of the blades.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.differs: The three blades are packed close together in a tight, nearly parallel bundle, whereas the male set is spread further apart.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A small left bracer with a rounded rectangular armor plate on the outer forearm, embossed with stacked chevron ridges, held by two wide straps with small tabs that wrap around the forearm near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate frame and chevron ridges; colour 1 on the recessed panels between the ridges; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the strap tabs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A spiky armored bracer for the left forearm and hand, with a flared, jagged cuff plate and two long curved blades sweeping down past the fist. Suggests a contrasting fantasy or villain look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff plates and blade edges; colour 3 on the striped inset panels; colour 1 on the outer blade edges; colour 2 on the inner recesses and blade undersides.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.differs: The female version has two long blades that curve down together, while the male version looks like it has three blade tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Part.description: A thin, ring-shaped bracelet of chunky faceted beads strung in a loop, worn snugly around the left wrist. It gives a casual, playful party-band look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Part.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some of the beads along one section; colour 1 on another run of beads; colour 2 on a further run of beads; colour 3 on the remaining run of beads.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psii.description: A short cuff bracer worn at the left wrist with a large curved, blade-like fin sweeping up and back along the forearm. The fin is thin and translucent with a cracked, web-like energy texture and a few small slits.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psii.colourAreas: The default material appears to ignore the colour scheme, showing a glowing crackled energy texture over the cuff and fin; no clear split between colour slots is visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psis.description: A short cuff worn on the left forearm just above the wrist, with a long tapering blade-like shard sweeping down past the hand. The surface has a cracked, crystalline texture, giving a psionic energy-blade look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psis.colourAreas: The whole piece shows a crackled energy texture that mostly ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 appears on the cuff and blade with faint veining from the other slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psis.description: A left forearm bracer band carrying a long, thin curved blade that sweeps down past the thigh. The blade is crystalline with a cracked, faceted look, suggesting a psionic sci-fi weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psis.colourAreas: The whole piece shows as a glassy, near-crystal, so the colour scheme has little visible effect; colour 0 is the most likely tint on the bracer and blade.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psis.differs: The blade looks thinner and more sharply tapered, with a stronger curve, and appears mostly edge-on from the front.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Quag.description: A tight forearm bracer made of dense interwoven vines or roots that wrap around the left forearm, with loose thin tendrils sticking out at the top and bottom edges. Gives an overgrown, swampy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Quag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick central tangles and highlights; colour 1 on the outer thin tendrils and many of the surrounding strands; colour 2 on the shaded inner strands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Quag.description: A left forearm bracer made of tangled, wiry vines or roots wrapped densely around the forearm, with loose stray tendrils sticking out at both ends. Wild, organic look that sits between elbow and wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Quag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner wrapped strands; colour 1 on the outer tendrils and loose ends; colour 2 on the shadowed strands deep in the tangle.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Robo.description: A bulky, tapered mecha bracer worn on the left forearm: a rounded armored shell with a central sensor eye, slashed vent grooves, a tall spike near the elbow and angled fin blades flaring off the sides.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Robo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spike; colour 1 on the side fins; colour 3 on the vent slashes and circuit lines; colour 2 on the sensor eye and recesses.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Rock.description: A chunky left bracer of cracked, stacked rock slabs wrapped around the forearm, with two tall faceted crystal shards jutting up and outward from the back of the wrist. Fantasy elemental look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Rock.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the glowing crack lines and gaps between the rocks; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Rock.description: A chunky left forearm bracer built from cracked, stacked rock slabs, with two pointed crystal shards jutting up and outward from the back of the forearm. Reads as a fantasy stone gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Rock.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the glowing crack lines and inner gaps between the rocks; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roin.description: A angular armored bracer on the left forearm with a large smooth front plate, a long blade-like spike sweeping up toward the elbow, and a ridged back section with jagged flared edges at the wrist end.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front plate and spike; colour 1 on the ridged inner panels at the top; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and jagged rear plates; colour 3 on small accents between the jagged plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roin.description: A left wrist bracer with a large curved blade-like claw that sweeps down past the fist. A contrasting angular cuff with a pointed fin sits on top, over a bladed plate with cut-out slashes and a thin banded joint.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw blade and plate; colour 2 on the upper cuff and outer shell; colour 3 on the pointed fin and small accents; colour 1 on the banded joint at the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roin.description: A tight armoured bracer on the left forearm with a smooth plated outer shell that sweeps up into a long blade-like spike toward the elbow, with ribbed inner segments and jagged fins near the wrist edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer plate; colour 1 on the ribbed inner segments; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and jagged fins; colour 3 on the small accents inside the fins.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sacr.description: A short, snug octagonal cuff worn around the left wrist, with faceted sides and a slightly raised rim at the top edge. Plain and simple, it suits many superhero or fantasy looks.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shar.description: A small, thin shark-fin blade fixed to the outer side of the left forearm, sweeping back from a pointed tip with a notched, curved trailing edge. Reads as a sleek superhero or aquatic accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the piece shows a single flat tone with no separate slots visible.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shar.differs: The female fin is thinner and narrower, seen edge-on from the front as a slim blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shar.description: A single swept-back fin blade attached to the outside of the left forearm near the wrist: a thin, angular shard with a notched top edge that tapers to a long point toward the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the default material shows a single flat tone with no visible trim or second colour.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shar.differs: The female fin is thinner and lies more flat against the outer forearm, so it looks narrower from the front.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shar.description: A snug left forearm bracer with a swept-back fin-like spike rising from the elbow end and a smaller pointed flare at the wrist. Segmented panels and a wide contrasting band give it a sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin spike, back panels and wrist flare; colour 1 on the main bracer body and lower cuff; colour 2 on the wide band around the middle; colour 3 on small accents near the fin base.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A curved, rounded-triangle shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm with two short bands. It has a raised rim, a broad contrasting border and an atom emblem on the face, and it extends from elbow to past the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and outer rim; colour 1 on the broad border band; colour 2 on the thin inner outline and atom emblem lines; colour 3 on the two forearm straps.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.differs: The female shield is narrower and sits closer along the forearm, so it looks smaller and more slender than the male version.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A curved, kite-shaped shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm with two loop straps. The face is split into two halves and carries an atom emblem, with a thick rim around the edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper half of the shield face; colour 0 on the lower half and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and back; colour 3 on the two forearm straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm with two short straps. It has a raised rim and a quartered face with an atom emblem, in a superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the face; colour 1 on the other two quarters and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and back; colour 3 on the two forearm straps.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.differs: The female shield sits further forward on the forearm, so its face is angled toward the front. It is a little narrower than the male version.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A large kite-shaped shield strapped to the left forearm with two straps, hanging along the outside of the arm and reaching below the hand. It has a raised border, a recessed face with an atom emblem, and a plain back.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and outer rim; colour 1 on the wide border band and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the thin inner edge line and the back; colour 3 on the two forearm straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm by two loop straps. The face is divided into quarters with an atom emblem at the centre, and a thick rim edges the shield. Medieval form with a sci-fi twist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the face; colour 1 on the other two quarters and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and the back; colour 3 on the forearm straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A round shield mounted on a short bracer band around the left forearm, with a raised lion-head relief at the centre, a ridged rim with triangular tread pattern and a concentric inner ring. Heroic, fantasy or medieval look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer band and outer rim; colour 1 on the lion face and the inner ring band; colour 2 on the recessed shield face behind the lion and the back plate; colour 3 on the lion's eyes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A round forearm shield worn on the left wrist: a thick rim carved with runic lettering surrounds a radial-spoked face with a central diamond emblem, mounted by a short block cuff on the forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim and the cuff block; colour 3 on the runic lettering; colour 0 on the shield face; colour 2 on the diamond emblem and the backing plate.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shie.differs: The female shield is smaller and sits further along the outside of the forearm, with a narrower cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Skul.description: A tight left forearm bracer with a cloth sleeve band and a spiky skull-like plate on the outer side, with small eye studs, a large round gem-like centre, curved tusk spikes and a tall horn pointing up the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Skul.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cloth sleeve band; colour 0 on the skull plate and spikes; colour 2 on the stripes and curved lower blades; colour 3 on the round centre and the eye dots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Snak.description: A tight forearm bracer with a scaled, snake-skin panel on the outer face, segmented banded plates along the sides, and two long curved talon-like fangs sweeping past the wrist over the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Snak.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled panel and top rim; colour 1 on the segmented side plates and edging; colour 2 on the curved fangs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spar.description: A tapered greave-style forearm bracer with a curved shell open along the inner side, crossed lacing straps over the opening, and a contrasting edge trim. Sits over the left forearm in a classical Greek warrior style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the crossed lacing straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spar.description: A tapered left forearm bracer with an open front laced by crossing straps, a Greek-key border along the edge and cuff, and a sculpted lion-face guard at the elbow. Ancient Greek warrior style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer panel; colour 1 on the outer edge trim and the lion-face elbow guard; colour 3 on the Greek-key pattern and the lion's eyes; colour 2 on the crossing straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spik.description: Two curved, tapering horn-like spikes, one long and one short, sticking out from the outer side of the left forearm. They sweep upward and back in a loose meandering line, giving a spiky, monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spik.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spikes' upper lengths and tips; colour 0 on the wider base of the larger spike.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spik.description: Two curved, tapering horn-like spikes of different sizes jutting outward from the left forearm, each with a flared base cup. They sit one above the other along the outer arm as small accent bracer spikes.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spik.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips as a gradient; colour 3 on the flared base rims.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spik.description: Three curved, tapering horn-like spikes staggered down the outer left forearm, each sweeping backward and upward from a short ringed base. Suggests a monstrous, claw-like bracer accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spik.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each spike; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Stee.description: A wing-like blade fan attached along the outside of the left forearm: a row of long, curved, tapering feather blades stacked on a contrasting base strip, sweeping back and down past the hand. Suggests a bird-of-prey superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Stee.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long feather blades; colour 0 on the inner strips between the blades; colour 2 on the base strip along the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Stee.differs: The female version has narrower, more tightly packed blades that lie closer to the arm and look slimmer, while the male blades are more widely spaced.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Stee.description: A tapered forearm bracer with overlapping scale-like feather plates, a pointed flared cuff at the elbow end, and a strap loop over the hand from which three long curved talon blades sweep down past the fist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Stee.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled feather plates; colour 1 on the pointed cuff and edge trim; colour 2 on the hand loop; colour 3 on the talon blades.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symb.description: A short, tight forearm bracer with a smooth curved shell that wraps the left forearm, with two swept-back blade-like spikes rising from the outer edge. Sleek symbiote-style armour with an angular, aggressive look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symb.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 on the two spikes and their base panels; colour 0 on the inner lining and rim edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symb.description: A bulky angular left bracer of faceted plates over the forearm, with a raised frame arch, a ribbed nozzle canister on top and a cylindrical tank on the outer side; a chemical-weapon look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted armor plates and frame; colour 1 on the side trim strips; colour 2 on the inner housing; colour 3 on the canister and tank caps.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symb.differs: Its plates sit a little further along the forearm, with a longer trailing blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tesl.description: Open bracer of three stacked thin rings floating around the left forearm, joined by fine struts, with jagged lightning-bolt blades rising from the sides and a small round bead at the wrist end. Electric, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tesl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; colour 1 on the lightning-bolt blades; colour 3 on the round bead; colour 2 on the thin connecting struts.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tesl.description: Three loose, floating thin rings stacked along the left forearm above the wrist, each wider than the arm and joined to it by fine spoke-like wires. A sci-fi, energy-coil look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tesl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; colour 2 on the thin spokes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Toy_.description: A short tapered forearm bracer that widens toward the elbow, with a faceted rim, thin banded trim at both edges and a raised heart emblem on the outer face. Playful, cute superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Toy_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the top cap and edge trim; colour 2 on the thin bands and the heart outline.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Troo.description: A thick, cylindrical armored bracer worn on the left forearm, made of riveted, weathered plates with a spiked rim at the top and a contrasting band at the bottom edge. It has a rugged, scavenged military look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Troo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main riveted plate body; colour 1 on the spiked upper rim and the lower band; colour 2 on the rivet holes.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vine.description: A loose, open tangle of thin twisting vines wrapped around the left forearm near the wrist, with small leaves sprouting from the stems. A delicate, organic nature-themed bracer that leaves the sleeve visible through the gaps.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vine.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vine stems; colour 1 on parts of the stems and some leaves; colour 2 on a few shaded leaves.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vine.description: A tangled bracer of thin twisting vines wrapped loosely around the left forearm just above the wrist, studded with small sharp thorns. An open, wiry cage that suggests a wild, gothic or fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vine.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vine stems; colour 1 on the thorn tips and small accents.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vipe.description: A sci-fi armored bracer on the left forearm: two open cuff-like plates linked by a slim spine, with angular fins and long clawlike blades pointing down over the wrist. Reads as a viper-themed gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vipe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and blades; colour 1 on the inner connecting panel; colour 2 on the recessed panels and blade tips; colour 3 on the small accent slits.
