Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Wolf.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapered plated cuff, a flared trimmed upper edge, wrapped cord bands near the wrist, small faceted gems, and three long curved blades extending past the knuckles. Claw-fighter style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Wolf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plating and the blades; colour 2 on the wrist wraps and the underside of the cuff; colour 3 on the trim along the upper edge; colour 1 on the small gems.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Wrap.description: A snug cloth bracer of diagonal wrapped bands around the left forearm, with layered strips winding at alternating angles. A long narrow cloth streamer hangs from the wrist down toward the knee.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Wrap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapping strips and the hanging streamer; colour 1 on some wrap bands; colour 3 on other wrap bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchain.description: Heavy chunky chain links wrapped in loose crisscrossing loops around the left forearm and wrist, with a looped chain hanging over the back of the hand. Gives a bound, prisoner-like street or punk look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchain.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links, with slight mottling; the gaps between links are the see-through openings.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchain.description: Heavy chain links wound loosely around the left forearm and wrist in overlapping loops, with a few links dangling near the hand. It reads as a shackled, cursed look with a rough, gritty feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchain.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links across the whole piece; the gaps between links are the mannequin showing through, not a colour slot.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchain.description: Heavy chain wrapped in loose crisscrossing loops around the left forearm and wrist, with a few links draped over the back of the hand. A tangled, rough scourge-like bracer with a street or punk look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchain.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links, with a mottled metallic texture; the gaps between links show the body beneath.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerexart.description: A tight, segmented forearm bracer with stacked angular plates and thin etched lines, capped by contrasting bands at both ends and a tall curved fin blade rising along the outer edge. Retro-futuristic art deco style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerexart.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and the tall fin; colour 1 on the end bands and edge trim; colour 2 on the etched lines.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersaniu.description: A short tapered bracer worn on the left forearm just above the wrist, with a flared upper opening, a smooth main shell, a separate inset vertical panel and a plain band at the lower edge. Suggests ancient Egyptian armour.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersaniu.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell of the bracer; colour 0 on the lower band and the rim highlights; colour 2 on the upper rim edge; colour 3 on the inset vertical panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersasqu.description: A left forearm bracer with a smooth, tapered padded shell held by three cross straps, a studded panel edged with stitched trim, and jagged spiky fur tufts flaring out at both the elbow and wrist ends.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersasqu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell; colour 1 on the fur tufts at both ends; colour 2 on the cross straps and panel perforations; colour 3 on the stitched edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersasqu.description: A left forearm bracer: a tapered cuff banded with several straps, edged top and bottom with jagged fur-like spikes, and fitted with curled, ornately swirled blade-like fins along one side. Tribal, fantasy styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersasqu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the spiky fur tufts at the top and wrist edges; colour 2 on the horizontal straps; colour 3 on the curled fins and the strap piping.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerspike.description: A left forearm bracer made of a narrow plate on the outer forearm, with three long curved blade-like spikes sweeping back along the wrist and two flat octagonal discs on the inner side. It suggests a claw-like superhero gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerspike.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the three curved spikes and the backing panel; colour 3 on the two octagonal discs; colour 2 on the plate edge outline.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerstrap.description: A short, snug octagonal bracer worn around the left forearm near the wrist, with stacked horizontal ridges and two buckled straps wrapped across the outer side with small square slots. Casual, practical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerstrap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer body and strap slots; colour 1 on the two straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Buttoncuff_.description: A wide, faceted shirt-cuff bracer that wraps the left wrist as a short octagonal band, with a single round button on the outer back. Plain, tailored and understated in look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Buttoncuff_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cuff band; colour 0 on the button.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cardboard_0.description: A left forearm bracer shaped like a small carton: a tapered angular box with a hinged flap and open spout at the top, worn on the lower forearm. Quirky, comic-style and plain in construction.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cardboard_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the carton; colour 2 on the large angled panel and the flap; colour 0 on the rim, spout and inner edges; colour 3 on the small patch at the back.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Brace.description: A pair of long, flat blade claws projecting from the left wrist and pointing down past the hand, set side by side. Each is a narrow tapered blade with a notch near the tip, giving a feral, close-combat look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blades; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Claw_.description: A long, narrow chainsaw blade attached at the left forearm, hanging down past the hand. It has a toothed edge of small contrasting spikes, slotted recessed panels along its length, and a few claw-like points at the tip.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the blade body and housing; colour 2 on the teeth, tip claws and slot recesses.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Claw_.description: A set of four long, slender curved blades that extend from the knuckles of the left fist, sweeping downward and back like retractable claws. Worn on the hand as a weapon-style accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all four claw blades; the shading toward the base and back looks darker but no other slot is visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Claw_.description: A pair of slender feathers joined at a point, fanning out in a V shape and lying flat against the outer hip beside the hand. A small, decorative fantasy accent with fine textured barbs.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both feathers; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Claw_.description: A long curved blade with a serrated, thorn-like spiked spine, mounted at the forearm and sweeping down past the hip in a scythe-like arc. It has a layered edge and a short flat mounting stub, in a sci-fi, claw-like style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main spiked blade body; colour 1 on the inner edge layer and underside strip; the mounting stub is also colour 2.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Chains.description: A bulky bracer with a boxy motor housing strapped on the left forearm, carrying a long narrow chainsaw blade that extends past the hand and ends in small claw-like tips. Toothed edge; brutal, industrial look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Chains.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the housing and blade body; colour 1 on the inset panels and side accents of the housing; colour 2 on the toothed chain edge, joints and claw tips; colour 0 barely visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Dual_0.description: A pair of long, curved jagged blades projecting downward from a segmented plated wrist guard at the left fist. The two blades are slender and barbed, with notched edges, giving a predatory claw-weapon look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Dual_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented wrist plates; colour 2 on the mounting bands; colour 1 on the blades.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Dual_0.differs: The blades on the female version are more widely spread and slightly slimmer, with a clearer gap between them.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Fur_01.description: A left hand piece with a wide cuff at the wrist, a shaggy feathered or furred mitt covering the back of the hand, and a set of long, curved blades that sweep down past the knuckles. Feral, predatory style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff; colour 3 on the cuff buckle and studs; colour 2 on the shaggy fur covering; colour 1 on the claw blades.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Skull_.description: A tribal wrist bracer shaped like a small skull-faced mask sitting on the outer forearm above the hand, lashed on with contrasting cord wraps, with a trio of long curved claws hanging down and a spray of feathers trailing behind.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Skull_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skull-shaped bracer body; colour 2 on the cord wraps; colour 1 on the thin threads among the cords; colour 0 on the claws and feathers.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Spike_.description: A short forearm bracer bound with criss-crossed cord lacing over a padded band, with a rim at the wrist end and a long curved bone-like claw spike that sweeps down past the hand along the outer forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Spike_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the claw spike and the small lacing posts; colour 3 on the rim edges at both ends of the band; colour 2 on the padded band beneath the cords; colour 0 on the cord lacing.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Tech_0.description: A chunky mechanical bracer worn on the left forearm just above the wrist, with a ribbed side housing and small panel details. A long curved serrated blade sweeps back and downward from it, edged with jagged teeth.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Tech_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bracer housing and its panel details; colour 2 on the serrated blade teeth; colour 1 on the inner spine of the blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Combat_01_B.description: A left forearm bracer made of a curved rigid plate held by three cross straps, with two octagonal bands that wrap the arm near the elbow end and the wrist end. Sits on the outer forearm with a tactical combat look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Combat_01_B.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved armor plate; colour 2 on the three cross straps; colour 0 on the two octagonal arm bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A snug angular armband worn on the left upper arm: a faceted, slightly tapered cylinder with thin raised bands at the top and bottom edges and an inner lining showing at the rim. Sleek, sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim edge; colour 2 on the main band and the top and bottom bands; colour 1 on the inner lining at the rim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cosmic_02.description: A short, faceted bracer worn at the left forearm near the wrist: a slightly tapering octagonal cuff with raised bands at the top and bottom edges and a contrasting inner lip. Sleek, sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main cuff body and edge bands; colour 0 on the inner lip at the rim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_0.description: Two separate angular armor plates on the left arm, one over the upper arm and one on the forearm, each a glossy faceted shell with a small rivet and a contrasting lower panel. A sleek cyberpunk bracer set.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper edges and outer shell of the plates; colour 1 on the lower inset panels; colour 2 on the glossy faces; colour 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_0.differs: The upper-arm plate is a taller, narrower shell sitting higher on the arm, with less of the contrasting panel showing.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyborgarmor.description: A short faceted band of armor plating that wraps around the left upper arm, with a lighter raised rim at the top edge and hex bolt heads studding the surface. Suggests cyborg or sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyborgarmor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 0 on the rim and bolt heads. The other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Deco_01.description: A small angular armored cuff worn on the upper forearm just below the elbow, with a pointed shield-like front plate and a long swept-back blade spike with stepped serrated ridges extending up the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Deco_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer plates, spike and ridges; colour 3 on the inset panels and inner recesses of the cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbo.description: A short tapered forearm bracer of horizontally banded segments with a thin vertical strip along one side, a wide faceted rim at the elbow end with two contrasting spikes jutting outward, and a narrow lip at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim, wrist lip and side strip; colour 1 on the banded segments; colour 2 on the spikes and band lines.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbo.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a faceted octagonal rim at the elbow end, a ribbed segmented body of stacked bands, a thin vertical seam strip, a narrow cuff at the wrist, and two contrasting spikes projecting from the rim.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, wrist cuff and vertical strip; colour 1 on the segmented ribbed body; colour 2 on the spikes and rim stud.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbo.description: A short tapered bracer worn on the left forearm: an angular octagonal flared cuff with contrasting spikes on both sides, over a segmented banded body with a vertical seam strip and a thin trim edge at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, the seam strip and the wrist edge; colour 1 on the banded segments; colour 2 on the spikes and the small stud.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Egyptian_Ar.description: A short, wide octagonal armband worn snugly around the upper left arm, with a bright rim at the top, a contrasting band beneath it and horizontally banded striping below. Suggests an ancient Egyptian look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Egyptian_Ar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and the stripes; colour 1 on the band just under the rim; colour 3 on the striped bands; colour 2 on the thin inner edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Elbowpad_01.description: A snug elbow band made of stacked ridged layers with a raised, rounded pad at the back of the elbow, studded with rows of small round dimples. Sits on the left arm at the elbow, with a sporty, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Elbowpad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded back pad; colour 1 on the outer band panel and its thin edge trim; colour 2 on the ridged layers between; colour 3 on the small dimples in the pad.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Electric_01.description: A sci-fi forearm bracer: a curved plate with thin outlined seams and a perforated inner side, carrying three coiled electrode coils with hex-nut caps on the outer face, plus a flexible cable looping down the edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the perforated inner lining; colour 3 on the outline seams and the coil windings; colour 2 on the hex nuts, coil caps and cable.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_F_Variabler.description: A chunky angular armband worn on the upper left arm: a faceted box-like block wrapping the arm with a notched gap along the underside, giving a robotic, plated look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_F_Variabler.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole armband; the default material shows no other visible colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_F_Variabler.description: A chunky angular robotic bracer worn on the left forearm: a boxy faceted housing on the outer side with a small vent slot, set on a blocky open-topped cuff that wraps the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_F_Variabler.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff sections at the top and bottom of the bracer; colour 2 on the boxy outer housing and the band between the cuff sections.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_01.description: A small membranous fin attached to the left upper arm: three swept-back spines with webbed panels between them, ending in long curved points. It has a spotted surface and reads as an aquatic or monstrous accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbed membrane panels; colour 3 on the spots across the membrane; colour 1 on the spines and edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_02.description: A large fin-like arm accessory on the outer left upper arm: three overlapping curved membrane panels with speckled surfaces, edged by sharp swept-back spines. It sits flat against the arm and suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 3 on the speckled spots; colour 1 on the spine edges and rims of the panels; colour 2 in the shading at the panel bases.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_02.differs: The fin is thinner and sits flatter against the arm, with less spread when seen from behind.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Flower_01.description: A left bracer of overlapping pointed petal-like leaves that flare up and away from the forearm, bound by thin wrapping bands, with a small rose blossom on the outer wrist. Fantasy, nature-themed.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapping bands, rose and leaf tips; colour 1 on the outer leaf panels; colour 2 on the central leaf blades; colour 3 on small accents at the leaf bases.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A small oval faceted gemstone with a domed, cut-crystal top and angular facets, worn on the outside of the left wrist as a bracer accent. Its glossy surface suggests a jewel-like ornament.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The whole gem shows one glossy tone that seems to ignore the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A small faceted rhombus-shaped gemstone that sits flat against the outer side of the left wrist. It has a glassy, angular cut with a pointed top and bottom, and works as a jewel-like bracer accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lighter upper facets; colour 1 faintly on the edge facets; the main faces stay glossy and mostly ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small square-cut gemstone block with bevelled, faceted edges, mounted on the outer side of the left wrist or hand as a bracer accent. It has a glossy, angular look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted face of the gem; the glossy sides and body ignore the colour scheme and stay dark.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone with a flat face and bevelled edges, mounted flush on the outer side of the left wrist or hand as a bracer ornament. It has a glossy, cut-crystal look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Glossy gem material appears to ignore most of the scheme; the bevelled facets show a faint tint from colour 1, with no other separate areas.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A small faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn flat against the outside of the left wrist or forearm, with a flat cut top face and angular bevelled edges. A decorative jewel accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows on the upper facets.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A small teardrop-shaped faceted gem with a flat back, worn on the outer side of the left hand or wrist. It sits close to the body as a slim, pointed crystal ornament.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The gem shows a glossy material that largely ignores the colour scheme; only a faint hint of colour 1 appears on the facets.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Greave_01.description: A smooth, tapered forearm bracer of angular plate that flares open at the elbow end and narrows to the wrist. Faceted, sleek panels wrap the outer arm, with small contrasting trim accents at both ends.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Greave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 3 on the small trim accents at the top and bottom edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Harajuku_Wr.description: A tapered cloth forearm wrap made of alternating bands that spiral around the arm, widening slightly toward the elbow with a thick rolled edge at the top. Casual street-style bracer worn on the left forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Harajuku_Wr.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrapped bands and the rolled rim; colour 1 on the alternating bands and the inner lining.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A segmented armored bracer worn on the left forearm, with a ridged plate shell that flares to a pointed edge toward the wrist. Wavy recessed channels run along the top, and a row of square loop fittings lines the outer edge. Dragon-like fantasy styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor plates and ridges; colour 1 on the wavy inset channels; colour 2 on the underside body of the bracer; colour 3 on the square loop fittings along the edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_0.description: A sci-fi armband worn on the upper left arm: a ring-shaped band with a separate curved plate floating above it, joined by a thin strut. The whole piece has a crackling energy texture.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_0.colourAreas: The whole piece is an energy effect that ignores the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_0.differs: The female version renders entirely as a glowing energy effect with no colour slots, while the male version has solid panels in several colours.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hornsmonste.description: A cluster of small curved bone spikes and thorn-like horns studded along the outside of the left forearm, each set on a small angular base plate, with one longer spike pointing up toward the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hornsmonste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes and horns; colour 3 on the small base plates under each spike.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hornsmonste.description: A small cluster of three curved bone-like spikes on the left forearm, each rising from a small angular base plate. They sit at staggered heights along the outer arm for a monstrous, savage look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hornsmonste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the small base plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Knight_02.description: A curved plate shoulder guard for the left upper arm, made of layered overlapping plates with raised ridges, rounded studs and three conical spikes along the outer edge. It suggests medieval knight armour.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and spikes; colour 3 on the main plate surfaces and lower edge; colour 1 on the studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A left wrist bracer made of a plain cuff band ringed with round studs or bells, topped by a thick tangle of loosely wrapped chunky chain links that rise up the forearm. Gritty, festive-monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 1 on the round balls around the cuff; colour 2 on the chain links.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Krampus_Att.description: A wrist cuff wrapped in many loops of heavy chain, with a row of round studs or balls along the lower edge of the band. It sits on one forearm just above the hand, giving a rugged, punkish look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Krampus_Att.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links and the cuff band; colour 1 on the round balls along the lower edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lockbox_66_.description: A pair of separate angular armbands worn on the left upper arm: an upper band with a zigzag edge and a raised inset panel, and a plainer lower band with a stepped notch. Suggests a sleek superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lockbox_66_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band's outer rim; colour 1 on the raised inset panel; colour 2 on the lower band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Luchadordol.description: A short cloth bracer cuff worn on the left forearm near the wrist, with a wide contrasting upper band and a raised three-dimensional dollar sign emblem on the outer side. Playful luchador-wrestler styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Luchadordol.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff and the dollar sign's raised edges; colour 1 on the upper band and the bottom edge trim; colour 3 on the dollar sign's studded face.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Luchadorhaw.description: A short wrist bracer shaped as a cuff with a rolled rim, with a large feathered wing fin sweeping up along the outer forearm. Small contrasting feather marks decorate the cuff; a luchador-style superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Luchadorhaw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and the wing feathers; colour 1 on the rim, the wing edging and the lower wing point; colour 2 on the small feather marks.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lycan_02.description: A fitted forearm sleeve of shaggy, layered fur tufts running from elbow to wrist on the left arm, with jagged contrasting edging and rows of sharp spiky points along the outer side. Feral, wolf-like look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lycan_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 3 on the spiky tufts; colour 0 on the jagged edge fringe along the inner side.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lycanbracer.description: A furry, tufted bracer wrapping the left forearm, with jagged layered fur clumps and a row of sharp curved claw-like spikes along the outer edge. Feral, beastly look suited to werewolf or savage styles.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lycanbracer.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 3 on the spikes and inner fur streaks; colour 0 on the ragged fur tips along the edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Martialarts.description: A short octagonal forearm bracer with contrasting bands at both rims and a plain central cuff, extended by a narrow plate over the back of the hand studded with three small round bumps. Martial-arts style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Martialarts.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff and hand plate; colour 1 on the top and bottom bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Mechassassi.description: A mechanical forearm shield worn on the left forearm: a narrow tube-like housing that carries angular, layered plates. Pointed wing-like panels fan out from the sides, with accent caps at the ends. Sci-fi assassin styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Mechassassi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and housing; colour 1 on the inset panels and edge trim; colour 3 on the end caps and thin accent lines; colour 2 on the recessed mechanism and gaps.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Nighthawk_0.description: A left forearm bracer with a padded panel, contrasting angular rim at the elbow end and a ribbed side section. A clawed hand piece with three long curved talons extends over the back of the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Nighthawk_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer panel; colour 1 on the ribbed side section and centre stripe; colour 2 on the rim, hand mount and claws; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ninjabracer.description: A left forearm bracer with a large angular plate along the outer forearm that extends over the back of the hand, over a padded, segmented wrap held by thin cords. Ninja-style armor with a contrasting octagonal cuff at the elbow end.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ninjabracer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer plate; colour 1 on the padded wrap; colour 2 on the cuff rims and wrist strap; colour 0 on the thin cords.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ninjabracer.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapered plate on the outer face that points down toward the hand, edged with a raised rim. A ribbed wrist cuff with a contrasting cap sits at the wrist. Gladiator-style armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ninjabracer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate and its raised rim; colour 1 on the ribbed wrist cuff; colour 2 on the cuff caps and end rings; colour 0 on the thin cuff bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Norse_Fur_0.description: A short fur bracer wrapping the left forearm, with shaggy jagged fur cuffs at both ends and a fur-covered middle crossed by criss-crossing straps. Suggests Norse or barbarian styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Norse_Fur_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur; colour 2 on the criss-crossing straps; colour 1 as a faint tint in the fur shading.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Persian_01.description: A left upper-arm accessory: a stiff banded cuff with diagonal wrapping trim, ringed by a row of round disc ornaments, from which a gathered, puffy billowing sleeve hangs down over the upper forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered puffy sleeve; colour 2 on the banded cuff; colour 3 on the cuff top and the thin diagonal trim lines; colour 1 on the ring of disc ornaments.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Persian_Bra.description: A short, slightly tapered octagonal bracer worn on the left forearm, with swirling scrollwork patterns across its surface, contrasting edge trim at both ends and a rounded gem set on the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Persian_Bra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body and the top rim; colour 2 on the swirling scrollwork; colour 3 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the gem.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Plugs_Cover.description: A cluster of four small hexagonal metal plug sockets with stepped cylindrical bodies, studded onto the outer side of the left upper arm like implant ports. Suggests a covert military cybernetic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Plugs_Cover.colourAreas: All four plugs appear in a single metallic finish that mostly ignores the colour scheme; colour slots show little visible effect.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Post_Apoc_B.description: A short, angular post-apocalyptic forearm bracer: a faceted main plate wraps the forearm, with a raised contrasting patch panel along one side, two thin straps with square buckles, and small screw-like rivets.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Post_Apoc_B.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate; colour 1 on the raised side patch panel; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the buckles and rivet heads.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Power_01.description: A rigid forearm bracer with a swept-up pointed fin at the elbow end, a rimmed edge, a raised rectangular plate on the outer face and a small round knob with a jewel-like centre at the side. Sits on the left forearm; superhero-style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bracer shell; colour 0 on the rim and edging; colour 2 on the raised rectangular plate; colour 3 on the round central gem.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Power_02.description: A rigid armored bracer worn on the left forearm: a curved shell with a raised angular plate along the outer edge, thin metal rim, small inset studs and a pointed flared panel at the wrist end.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edging and the raised outer plate; colour 1 on the main curved shell; colour 3 on the pointed wrist panel and small stud gems; colour 2 on the side plate insert and underside.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Powersuit_0.description: A chunky cybernetic elbow cuff on the left arm: a segmented, hourglass-shaped housing with a round vented port at the outer end, a raised fin and a contrasting strap band across the top, and small recessed panels at the back.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Powersuit_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and end port rim; colour 1 on the strap band, fin and small back panels, and the centre of the port.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Qularr_Armo.description: A short segmented armor band around the upper left arm, with a smooth plain front and stacked overlapping lamellar plates across the back. Faceted, angular edges suggest ancient Greek-style armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Qularr_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the rim edges and the plate borders; colour 2 on the seams between plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_.description: A chunky cylindrical armguard cuff on the left upper arm, with a rigid mottled metal shell above a ribbed, layered band of stripes at the lower edge. Retro sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large upper shell; colour 1 on the ribbed lower band; colour 3 on the thin stripes within the band.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_.description: A short tapered forearm bracer with a glossy, semi-transparent outer shell and a raised panel framed by contrasting end bands, worn on the left forearm just above the wrist. Retro sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the raised inner panel; colour 2 on the end bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_.description: A chunky faceted forearm bracer worn on the left arm, with a strap band around the middle and a boxy keypad device with a small screen and buttons mounted on the outer side. Retro sci-fi gadget style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer cylinder; colour 1 on the strap band; colour 2 on the device casing and keypad; colour 3 on the screen and some keypad buttons.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ringsbicep_.description: A tight band worn around the upper left arm, made of stacked strap layers with a thin contrasting stripe between them. Two chunky octagonal rings hang from small mounting plates on the outer side, giving a street or punk look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ringsbicep_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper and lower strap bands; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 0 on the thin stripe; colour 3 on the rings and their mounting plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ringswrist_.description: A snug forearm bracer made of criss-crossing wrap straps between two solid end bands, with three small ring fasteners running down the outer edge. Sits on the left forearm; a street and punk look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ringswrist_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom end bands; colour 0 on the underlying wrap layer; colour 2 on the diagonal crossing straps; colour 3 on the ring fasteners.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A small angular metal plate with a round port sits on the upper left arm. Two segmented ribbed cables loop out from it and end in short cylindrical connectors. A cybernetic, mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular plate; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 1 on the cylindrical connector tips; colour 3 on the small port light.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A cybernetic implant for the left upper arm: an angular plated clamp housing with a small lens, from which several thick ribbed cables loop and dangle down the arm, ending in small connector caps.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular housing plates; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 1 on the connector caps and small collars.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_02.differs: The female version has fewer connector caps on the cables and a smaller housing than the male version.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Robotsamura.description: A tapered, angular forearm bracer on the left arm, sitting from wrist toward the elbow, with panelled plates and three long flat blade-like fins projecting along its outer edge. It suggests robotic samurai armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Robotsamura.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bracer shell; colour 2 on the lower and side panels; colour 3 on the small top panel near the elbow; colour 0 on the three long blade fins and the top rim.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rock_01.description: A left forearm bracer of cracked, faceted rock plates that sweeps down past the wrist into long tapering claw spikes, with jagged points at the elbow end. Fitted over the forearm with a monstrous, stony look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock plates; colour 2 on the crack lines between plates; no other slots clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rock_02.description: A chunky rock bracer worn on the left forearm just above the wrist: stacked cracked stone slabs form a rugged cuff, with tall jagged shards jutting up toward the elbow. Suggests an earthen, golem-like look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs and shards; colour 2 on the crack lines between the stones.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rolledsleev.description: A wide, rolled cloth armband worn around the left upper arm, with soft wrinkled folds and a slightly ragged edge. It gives a casual, makeshift wrapped look.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ruffle_01.description: A small ring of layered lace ruffles worn around the upper left arm, flaring outward in scalloped, perforated tiers with a darker inner lining. Delicate, frilly and decorative, suggesting a formal or gothic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ruffle_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lace ruffle layers; colour 2 on the inner lining visible at the top and underside.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ruler_01.description: A short, slightly tapered armored cuff worn around the left forearm near the wrist, with raised rims at both edges lined with small studs and rounded oval studs set into the faceted band.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ruler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band and rims; colour 1 on the small studs along both edges; colour 2 on the oval stud on one side; colour 3 on the round stud on the other side.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A chunky octagonal armband worn on the upper left arm, with a curved, horn-like fin sweeping outward from its side. The fin is a glossy plate with a ring motif and swirling inlaid line patterns.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band body; colour 1 on the band's top and bottom edges; colour 2 on the curved fin plate; colour 3 on the glowing line patterns and ring on the fin.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sacred_01.differs: The fin on the female version curves back and hangs lower, sitting close against the outside of the arm rather than rising up.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Samurai_Lar.description: A samurai-style left forearm bracer of angular, jagged plates with a raised curved fin flaring off the outer edge. Swirling engraved patterns fill the panels, and a bordered rim outlines each plate.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Samurai_Lar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and edge plates; colour 1 on the thin inner border line; colour 2 on the panel faces; colour 3 on the swirl patterns.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_0.description: A short furry bracer for the left forearm: a shaggy cuff of jagged, pointed fur tufts that flares at the elbow end and tapers to ragged strands over the wrist. Suggests a wild, beastly look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tips near the elbow end; colour 1 on the main body of the fur, fading towards the wrist strands.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_0.description: A small tuft of jagged, shard-like fur locks attached to the forearm, with pointed tips streaming down toward the wrist. It reads as a wild, feral accent on one arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur tufts; colour 1 on the lower fur points, fading toward darker tips.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_0.differs: This version is worn on the right forearm, with the tufts sitting slightly further up the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatchlo.description: A shaggy fur bracer wrapping the left forearm, built from jagged, layered tufts that flare into spiky points at the elbow end and taper into ragged strands over the wrist. Suggests a wild, beastly look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatchlo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur near the elbow, fading into colour 1 on the lower tufts toward the wrist; colour 2 in the shadowed undersides.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Shacklewris.description: A chunky metal wrist cuff with a slightly tapered, faceted shape, two bolted block clamps on one side and two looped handle-like rings on the sides, worn on the left wrist like a restraint shackle.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Shacklewris.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the looped side rings and the slot-shaped inset; colour 2 on the bolted clamp blocks.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Shacklewris.differs: The female cuff has a raised slot-shaped inset on the front face of the cuff, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_St.description: A band of overlapping angular plates wrapped around the upper left arm, with jagged fin-like points rising at the top and stacked, layered segments below; a sharp, armoured superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_St.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plates; colour 2 on the inner fin panels; colour 0 on the lower overlapping edge plates; colour 3 on the small top panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spike_Bars_.description: A wrapped forearm bracer of stacked banded segments, with four contrasting spear-tipped spikes jutting sideways from a curved blade-like plate along the outer edge. Sits on the left forearm above the wrist; punk, aggressive style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spike_Bars_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer wrap bands; colour 0 on the bands between them; colour 2 on the spikes; colour 3 on the curved plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spike_Bars_.description: A forearm bracer of stacked rings around the wrist, with four slender arrow-tipped rods projecting outward to a large curved blade fin that sweeps down past the hand. Aggressive, spiky superhero or sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spike_Bars_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large curved fin; colour 1 on the ring discs of the bracer; colour 0 on the bands between the rings; colour 2 on the spike rods and their tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spikeelbow_.description: A pair of curved, tapering horn-like spikes that sweep upward from the left upper arm near the elbow, one longer and one shorter, each sitting in a small ring-shaped base. Suggests a monstrous or fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spikeelbow_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the ring bases.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spikysuit_0.description: A short, bumpy bone-like bracer wrapped around the left forearm near the wrist, with knobbly ridges and three long curved horns sweeping backward and upward from its outer side. A monstrous, spiky look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spikysuit_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the mottled spots and bands across it; colour 2 on the curved horns.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Straps_01.description: Three thin, separate bands stacked and slightly tilted around the upper left arm, like slim armbands or straps. A minimal accessory with an edgy, street look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all three bands; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapsasqua.description: A left forearm bracer of shaggy, jagged fur tufts poking out at both the elbow and wrist ends, wrapped around the middle by a smooth cuff bound with several thin straps. Tribal, beastlike look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapsasqua.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts at both ends; colour 0 on the central cuff; colour 2 on the thin straps wrapped around it.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapsbicep.description: A tight band worn around the left upper arm, made of two broad outer straps with a narrower inner strip and a thin layered stripe between them. Angular faceted edges give it a simple, sporty superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapsbicep.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two broad outer straps; colour 2 on the central stripe; colour 0 on the thin strips beside the central stripe.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Tribalbrace.description: A short, snug wrist bracer of soft wrinkled cloth with thin edge bands at both ends, ringed by long tapering tooth-like spikes on segmented bases that stick out from the outer side of the forearm. Tribal in style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Tribalbrace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer body and the bands of the spike bases; colour 1 on the top and bottom edge trim; colour 3 on the spike tips; colour 2 on the lower spike bases.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Tribalfeath.description: A wrapped cloth band gathered in thick horizontal folds around the upper left arm, fastened with a round medallion at the top from which a fan of three long pointed feathers sticks upward. Tribal in style.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Tribalfeath.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped cloth band; colour 1 on the medallion and the small dash markings on the wrap; colour 3 on the medallion's centre mark; colour 2 on the feathers.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Brace.description: A pair of thin, smooth stacked bangles worn snugly around the left wrist, each a slightly faceted band with a tapered profile. A simple, casual urban accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower bangle; colour 1 on the upper bangle.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Diamo.description: A wide, snug wrist cuff with a smooth central band edged top and bottom by rows of small square gem-like studs in contrasting trim, closed at the outer side by two small buckled straps.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Diamo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and the buckle straps; colour 1 on the edge trim framing the gem rows; colour 3 on the square gems; colour 2 on the buckle prongs.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Studd.description: A short, snug cuff bracer worn on the left forearm just above the wrist, with a slightly tapered shape, thin contrasting edge bands at both ends and rounded raised studs dotted around the outside.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Studd.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the round studs; colour 2 on the edge bands at top and bottom.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A small armor band wrapped around the upper left arm: a curved shell with a raised rim and a notched top edge, framing inset panels front and back. Reads as a compact sci-fi or superhero arm guard.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the inset panels; colour 2 on the thin seam lines across the panels.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Viperps_01.differs: The female plate is a narrower, more tapered band that sits neatly on the arm, with a shallower notch at the top.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wedding_Cor.description: A small wrist corsage: a snug band around the left wrist topped with a cluster of two layered, angular blossoms with contrasting centres and a few pointed leaves. Formal, wedding-style accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wedding_Cor.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrist band and leaves; colour 0 on the flower petals; colour 2 on the flower centres; colour 3 on the pink-tinged petal bases.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_.description: A small bat-wing fin attached along the outside of the left forearm: two long curved spiny ribs joined by a thin membrane that flares out toward the elbow and tapers to a point at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the wing ribs and edges; colour 1 on the membrane between the ribs; colour 0 as light streaks on the membrane.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_.differs: The female wing sits closer to the arm and its membrane is narrower and less flared, so the ribs look thinner and more blade-like.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_.description: A single large bat-wing attached at the left wrist that sweeps up past the shoulder and head. Long curved bony spars carry a thin membrane between them, with a jagged lower edge. Suits monstrous, gothic or fantasy looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 3 on the bony spars, mixed across the wing frame; colour 1 on the thin membrane between the spars.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_.differs: The female wing is slimmer and hangs closer to the arm, with a narrower membrane that shows less from the front.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wristband_0.description: A plain, short tapered wristband forming an open cuff around the left forearm just above the wrist, slightly wider at the top. Smooth, simple, with no fastenings, suited to casual or superhero looks.

A short tight wristband worn on the left forearm just above the wrist: a slightly tapered, faceted cuff with a wide contrasting band at the top and a thin contrasting edge at the bottom. Sporty, wrestling-inspired look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wristband_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the wristband; colour 1 on the wide top band and the thin bottom edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Urban_Anime_Armwa.description: A short left forearm sleeve warmer with a thick octagonal cuff at the elbow end and a small trim band at the wrist. Panelled construction with a contrasting side strip gives a sporty, anime-street look.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Urban_Anime_Armwa.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the elbow cuff, wrist band and back panel; colour 1 on the main front sleeve panel; colour 2 on the side strip; colour 3 on the small patch on the front.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Vine_01.description: A chunky forearm bracer with swirling carved scroll patterns, from which several curling, tendril-like vines with sharp tips sprout upward and outward. It sits over the lower forearm near the wrist, with an organic fantasy feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swirling relief patterns; colour 1 on the main bracer body and the vine tendrils; colour 3 on the sharp thorn tips of the vines.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Watch_01.description: A chunky octagonal wristwatch band worn on the left wrist, with a wide central strap, thin rims at both edges and a small raised rectangular digital display block on the top of the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Watch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims at both edges of the band; colour 3 on the main strap; colour 1 on the raised display housing; colour 2 on the display screen and the thin edging.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Wing_Tight_Batwin.description: A thin membrane wing hanging from the left arm to the torso side, with a ragged, scalloped bat-like trailing edge and pointed tips. It drapes loosely between the upper arm and the hip.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Wing_Tight_Batwin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing membrane; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_L_Wing_Tight_Steelh.description: A tight, folded feathered wing hanging from the left arm and side of the torso, made of overlapping layered feathers that taper to a ragged, pointed fringe near the hip. Fantasy or superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_L_Wing_Tight_Steelh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather surfaces, with the underside showing a darker shade of the scheme; the other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Alien_01.description: A short open-backed armor band wrapped around the right upper arm, made of angular faceted plates with a recessed inner panel, a stepped lower rim and a single pointed spike jutting forward. Alien sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plates; colour 0 on the outer rim edges and lower lip; colour 2 on the recessed inner panel; colour 3 on the spike.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Amazon_01.description: A curved metal guard wrapped around the outside of the right upper arm, with a pointed, notched lower edge, a raised central ridge, scrolled engraved patterns and small round studs. It suggests warrior-style armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the outer edge trim and central ridge; colour 2 on the engraved scroll patterns; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Amazon_02.description: A short, wide cuff-like band worn around the right upper arm. It has an octagonal, slightly waisted profile, contrasting trim along both edges and a thin twisted cord band across the middle. Suggests an ancient, warrior look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band body; colour 1 on the top and bottom edge trim; colour 2 on the central cord band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Anniversary_M.description: A glossy metallic armor cuff for the right upper arm: an angular, faceted plate wraps the outer arm, with a ribbed, cable-like tube curving down the front edge. Retro robotic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Anniversary_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plate, catching light; ribbed tube and darker plate surfaces show a glossy metal finish that largely ignores the colour scheme; colours 1, 2 and 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Armorninja.description: A short, rounded armored band wrapped around the right upper arm, made of faceted angular panels with a raised, notched top edge. It reads as a ninja-style bracer worn on the bicep.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light side panels; colour 1 on the main back and lower panels; colour 2 on the large front panel; colour 3 on the top wedge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Bowtie_01.description: A cute upper-arm band with a large bow on the outer side: a round centre knot with several pointed, layered loops and tails fanning out. It sits snugly around the right upper arm, in a magical-girl style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the knot's rim; colour 1 on the bow loops and part of the band; colour 2 on the knot centre and inner bow panels; colour 3 on the small pointed tails.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, rigid block-shaped band worn around the right upper arm, with flat angular faces, a slightly raised rim and an open recessed top. It has a plain panelled look suggesting a cardboard-box or crate style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back panel and the top rim; colour 1 on the side and top panels; colour 2 on the lower front and inner recess; colour 3 on the angled stripe on the outer side.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chainlock_01.description: A heavy chain wrapped in several loose coils around the right upper arm, fastened with a small octagonal padlock that has a keyhole. Chunky rectangular links give it a rugged, street or punk look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on a small clasp beside the padlock.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chainlock_02.description: A tangled loop of heavy chunky chain links wrapped around the upper right arm, with a small padlock hanging at the outer side. Gritty, rugged street or punk accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chainlock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on a small tag by the lock.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chains_01.description: A single long chain of interlocking links hanging straight down from the upper chest past the hip, ending in a small hook-like pendant. Thin and simple, it hangs loose against the body as an edgy accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper links near the top; colour 0 on the lower links; colour 3 on the hook pendant at the end.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chainlo.description: A small chunky padlock charm with a faceted, chamfered body, a recessed keyhole on the front and a squared shackle loop on one side. It hangs on the right upper arm or chest side as a gritty accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chainlo.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the lock body and shackle; colour 1 on the thin edge strip along one side; colour 3 on the keyhole.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chainlo.description: A small chunky padlock charm with a faceted angular body, a thick octagonal shackle loop on one side and a recessed keyhole on its face; it hangs from the chest and upper arm as a quirky accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chainlo.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the lock body and shackle; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on the thin edge band of the lock body.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chains_.description: A single thin chain of small links hanging straight down from the chest at the right side to about mid-thigh, ending in a small hook-and-clasp weight. Simulated cloth lets it hang loosely against the body.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chains_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper links near the chest; colour 0 on the lower links; colour 2 and colour 3 on the hook and clasp at the bottom.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Punk_01.description: A cloth armband tied around the upper right arm, with a crumpled wrapped band and a knot from which two long pointed bunny-ear-like tails stick out. A casual punk accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped band and knot; colour 1 on one of the loose ear tails; colour 2 on the other ear tail.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Punk_01.differs: The female version has a full, wide wrapped band around the arm, while the male version shows only a small knot with no visible band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegad.description: A small sci-fi blaster cannon strapped to the outer upper arm: a boxy perforated body with a round, bolted-looking muzzle ring at the top, and a long flexible cable that loops around the arm to a small nozzle connector.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegad.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cannon body and the cable end connector; colour 1 on the muzzle ring; colour 2 on the muzzle opening; colour 3 on the cable.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegad.differs: The cable loops lower and wraps further toward the front of the arm. On the male version it sweeps out in a wider arc across the chest side.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegad.description: Two flexible, winding tubes that run down the outer upper right arm from hex-capped shoulder mounts, each ending in a ribbed cylindrical canister near the elbow. A sci-fi cyborg-style arm accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegad.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hex caps, ribbed end canisters and cuffs; colour 3 on the main tube lengths; colour 1 on the bands around the tube bends.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Scarab_.description: A flat, atom-like emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a small central ring, applied to the outer side of the right upper arm like a decal. Suggests a scientific or superhero insignia.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Scarab_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the edging and outlines of the rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Crimson_01.description: A twisted rope armband worn around the upper right arm, made of two stacked braided strands that wrap in a loose band. Simple, casual accessory with a rope-cord look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the braided rope strands; colour 1 on a section of the rope at the back of the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Cyberwire_01.description: A tapered armored arm guard worn on the upper right arm: a curved shell that narrows to a point, banded by a contrasting strip between two raised rims, with small round studs at the sides. Sci-fi superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the raised rims and edge trim; colour 2 on the central band; colour 3 on the round studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Deity_01.description: A short armband worn on the upper right arm: a smooth curved outer plate that flares up into a pointed wing on one side, over a padded inner band of stacked, quilted segments with a lined rim.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer curved plate; colour 3 on the inner rim lining; colour 1 on the stacked padded bands; colour 2 on the bottom edge band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Draco_01.description: A short armored band worn on the upper right arm, with a layered, faceted plate that rises into a raised, angular crest on the outer side, and a diamond-shaped gem set in a plain panel with a rim.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band panel; colour 1 on the raised layered plate; colour 2 on the edge trim and rim; colour 3 on the diamond gem.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Draco_01.differs: The female version's crest is smaller and lower, sitting closer to the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Dragonbody_Lo.description: A sculpted, flame-like fin of jagged swept-back spikes running along the outer right upper arm and forearm, with a smooth flat sheet along its inner edge. It looks fantasy or monstrous, like a dragon's crest.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Dragonbody_Lo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth inner sheet and the upper tips of the spikes; colour 1 on the lower rear spikes, which blend gradually into colour 0.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Drill_01.description: A short, chunky armored band worn around the right upper arm: an open octagonal cylinder with ribbed end bands, a plated centre with contrasting inset windows and a small chevron emblem. Sci-fi tech look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plating; colour 1 on the ribbed top and bottom bands; colour 2 on the inset windows; colour 3 on the chevron emblem and small stripe.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Element_Fire_.description: A ragged, flame-like wrap of glossy swirling shards that curls around the upper right arm, with pointed tongues licking up and down; a fantasy elemental arm accessory that leaves the arm open between the two clusters.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Element_Fire_.colourAreas: Mostly glossy metallic material that largely ignores the scheme; faint colour 1 sheen in the folds.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Element_Fire_.description: A flame-shaped wrap for the right upper arm: a glossy, open-backed band of swirling, wavy tongues with pointed tips, wrapping round the arm and flaring outward at the edges. Suggests a fiery superhero or elemental look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Element_Fire_.colourAreas: The material is glossy and mostly ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on some of the flame swirls and colour 3 on a thin inner edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Gearbreak_01.description: A mechanical shoulder pauldron shaped like an open cylinder, with a tall curved shield plate rising on the outer side, a segmented band of small panels around the base, and a boxy pod with clips on the outside.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Gearbreak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and inner cylinder; colour 1 on the band frame, clips and pod straps; colour 3 on the small band panels; colour 2 on the shield edge and the boxy pod.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Gladiator_01.description: A chunky armband worn on the upper right arm: a wide octagonal cuff with contrasting top and bottom rims, a contrasting middle band, and a layered strap with a square buckle wrapped around it. Sporty, gladiator-style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the middle band of the cuff; colour 2 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the layered strap; colour 1 on the buckle.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Heraldry_01.description: A plain, smooth band worn around the right upper arm: a short faceted cylinder that tapers slightly, with a thin lighter edge along the rim. It suggests simple armour or a heraldic armband.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; the rim edge catches a lighter tone from the same slot.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Kaiju_01.description: A right upper-arm guard of segmented armor: a large curved outer plate with small dents covers the outside of the arm, joined to stacked banded plates and a pointed shoulder cap. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large outer plate; colour 1 on the shoulder cap and the banded inner plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Madjester_01.description: A pair of thin, faceted angular bands worn on the right upper arm, one tilted across the other at an angle. Slim, plain and minimal, they suggest a simple armband or belt-strap accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both bands; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mecha_01.description: A chunky angular armour block worn on the right upper arm, with a notched double-ridge top, small slit accents on the face and two round bolt-like knobs hanging below. Suggests a mecha or sci-fi power-armour look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour block; colour 1 on the two round knobs underneath; colour 3 on the small slit accents.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mecha_02.description: A chunky faceted arm band worn around the right upper arm: a tall octagonal cuff with a flared capped top band, small slot vents on the top, and a contrasting recess at the lower front edge. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lower cuff body; colour 1 on the capped top and rim band; colour 3 on the small vent marks; colour 2 on the lower recess and underside.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mechanon.description: A small angular armour piece wrapped around the right upper arm: several separate flat plates with stepped edges and open gaps, forming a segmented mechanical brace. Suggests a sci-fi or robotic superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer plates and edges; colour 1 on the curved panels and inner plating; colour 2 on the rear stepped plate and the front upright plate; colour 3 on the small inset patches at the back.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Modern_Ironcl.description: A simple armband worn around the upper right arm: a wide, slightly faceted band with thick contrasting rims at top and bottom. It gives a plain, modern superhero or tactical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Modern_Ironcl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the top and bottom rims.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Moth_01.description: A fitted cloth sleeve-like wrap around the right upper arm, with a gathered panel at the shoulder, a large separate panel on the outer arm and a jagged, crumpled cuff above the elbow. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main sleeve body and cuff; colour 0 on the gathered shoulder panel; colour 1 on the large side panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mutated_01.description: Two curved, tapering horn-like spikes that jut outward from the side of the right upper arm and shoulder, one above the other. Each has a blunt faceted base and a sharp swept tip, giving a mutated, monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bases and main bodies of the spikes; colour 1 on the pointed tips, fading in from the base.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Padding.description: A tactical armor pad for the right upper arm, made of two separate curved plates, one on the front and one on the back, that leave the sides open. Angular panel edges give it a military look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate rims and edges; colour 1 on the main plate surfaces; colour 2 on the diagonal stripe panels; colour 3 on the raised bar across the front plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Pirate_Fancy_.description: A billowing cloth upper-arm puff sleeve with a ruffled, gathered top rim, cinched by a strap with a small buckle and round button, then a flared ruffled cuff tied below with a bow. Pirate-fancy style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Pirate_Fancy_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered cloth sleeve and ruffle; colour 1 on the upper strap and lower tie; colour 3 on the round button; colour 2 on the buckle and ruffle edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Power_01.description: A short armband worn high on the right upper arm: a band with a flat teardrop-shaped plate on top that tapers to a point toward the shoulder, edged with thin raised rims. Sleek, angular superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top plate and its rim; colour 1 on the band body; colour 0 on the thin trim rings at the lower edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Pumpkin_01.description: A right upper-arm guard: a rounded, layered shoulder-cap plate with ridged bands, a contrasting inner lining at the lower edge, and a fan of jagged, blade-like fins sweeping back from the outer arm. Fantasy armor styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the layered plate shell; colour 1 on the jagged fins and thin edge trim; colour 2 on the lining at the lower opening.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Punk_01.description: A cloth armband wrapped around the right upper arm, with a striped outer band over a gathered plain underlayer and a knotted tie with two pointed tails sticking out at the back. Punk, street-style accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered underlayer; colours 1, 2 and 3 on the striped outer band; colour 1 on one knot tail; colour 2 on the other knot tail.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.description: A short wrap of overlapping cloth straps spiralling around the right upper arm, with gaps between the bands and a loose ragged lower edge; gives a casual rave or street look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.colourAreas: The straps fade across colours 0, 1, 2 and 3 from the top of the wrap to the bottom: colour 0 at the top edge, colour 1 on the middle bands, colour 2 below, colour 3 at the lower edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.differs: The female version has a gradient running through all four colours (colour 3 at the lower edge), while the male version is mostly colour 1 with a thin colour 2 lower band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.description: A right-arm sleeve made of overlapping torn cloth strips wrapped around the arm from shoulder to wrist, with gaps showing the arm beneath. The bands fade between sections for a ragged rave or street look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top strips near the shoulder; colour 1 on the upper arm strips; colour 2 on the middle elbow strips; colour 3 on the forearm strips.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Reactor_01.description: A rigid cylindrical armband worn around the right upper arm, with a notched raised back panel and a rivet detail. A flexible cable hangs from it to a small ribbed plate on the forearm, giving a sci-fi gadget look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band and the small ribbed plate; colour 1 on the raised notched panel; colour 3 on the cable and the rivet.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Armo.description: A sci-fi arm accessory for the upper right arm: an open cup-shaped armor shell with a perforated side plate, ringed by two curved flexible tubes that end in segmented metal tips and hang down the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell, side plate and tube end caps; colour 1 on the inner shell lining and bands on the tubes; colour 3 on the tubes.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Armo.differs: The female shell is smaller and shallower, so the tubes look longer and more exposed around it.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Cann.description: A small sci-fi cannon unit mounted on the upper outer arm: a boxy perforated housing with a round barrel ring at the front, and a long looping hose trailing down and around the arm to a small nozzle end.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Cann.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the perforated housing and hose nozzle; colour 1 on the barrel ring; colour 3 on the hose; colour 2 on the barrel opening.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Tube.description: Two flexible, kinked tubes that wind down the right upper arm from a hexagonal shoulder mount, each ending in a segmented ribbed cuff. A sci-fi cable accessory that sits over the shoulder and arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Tube.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hex mount and the ribbed end cuffs; colour 3 on the tube lengths; colour 1 on the bands partway along each tube.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Tube.description: Two flexible tubes that run down the right upper arm in wavy curves, each starting at a hexagonal cap near the shoulder and ending in a ridged cylindrical nozzle. A sci-fi arm accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Tube.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the end caps and ridged nozzles; colour 3 on the tube lengths; colour 1 on the banded tube segments.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord.description: A chunky angular armor cuff wrapped around the right upper arm, with a raised faceted plate at the top, banded lower section and a bent metal pipe handle curving down the outside. Retro sci-fi warlord look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top shield plate and the pipe; colour 0 on the mid plating; colour 1 on the side panels and the pipe tip; colour 3 on the lower band.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord.differs: The top plate is a closed solid shape rather than an open rim with a hollow, and it sits flatter against the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord.description: A bandolier-style ammunition chain: a boxy cuff clasp on the upper right arm with a belt of angular cartridges rising over the shoulder toward the chest, tips pointing outward in a ridged, segmented line.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cuff clasp and the back of the belt; colour 0 on the cartridge casings; colour 1 on the tips and edges of the cartridges.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord.differs: The female belt ends higher on the chest, with a small square end tab, while the male belt curves back toward the upper arm and ends in a rounded tip.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retrosteelhea.description: A curved armor shell on the right upper arm, open on the inner side, with a pointed lower front edge, a raised rim and a contrasting band along the bottom. Retro superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retrosteelhea.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edges and outer shell; colour 2 on the inner shell surface; colour 1 on the lower band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_01.description: A segmented Roman-style plate guard for the right upper arm: stacked curved plates with small rivets, held on by two thin straps that wrap around the arm. Sits over the upper arm from shoulder to just above the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the plate edges and a gradient along the outer plates; colour 3 on the rivets; colour 2 on the straps.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_01.differs: The female guard has two straps, while the male version has three.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_02.description: A segmented Roman-style guard for the right upper arm: a curved shell of stacked overlapping plates with rivet heads along the edges, open on the inner side and with no straps. It sits over the upper arm from shoulder to just above the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and edges; colour 1 on the plates' central curved area as a gradient; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Sandstorm_01.description: A right upper-arm guard: a rounded, open-backed shell with raised ribbed panels on the outside, a flared trim cup at the elbow with a vented pad, and a plain cloth sleeve panel hanging down the forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging sleeve panel and inner lining; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 1 on the elbow cup trim; colour 3 on the ribbed panels and elbow vent pad.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Sandstorm_02.description: A chunky angular armband worn around the upper right arm, with a faceted outer shell, a contrasting inner lining, a stepped lower edge and a small rectangular inset panel on the outer side. Suggests a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band shell; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 3 on the small inset panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Scarab_01.description: A curved shield-like arm plate worn on the outer right upper arm, with a raised rim around a flat panel bearing an atom-style orbital emblem. Superhero styling, open at the inner side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel face; colour 2 on the raised rim and back shell; colour 1 on the atom emblem lines.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Scarab_02.description: A rigid, angular shield-like guard worn on the right upper arm: a tall faceted plate with a raised contrasting rim, a large flat outer panel and a separate side panel, ending in a pointed lower edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer panel; colour 1 on the side panel; colour 2 on the rim, edging and top cap.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Spikysuit_01.description: A small lumpy, bone-like growth on the outer upper right arm, made of a rounded mass with several thick pointed knuckle-like spurs jutting forward and outward. It suggests a monstrous, organic bone armour.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bone surface; colour 1 on the mottled patches spread across the growth.
