Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of angular band rings worn around the right upper arm: a wide faceted upper band and a thinner lower hoop, joined at the outer side by a pointed, gem-like faceted spike fin.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band; colour 1 on the lower hoop; colour 3 on the upper faceted spike facet; colour 2 on the lower spike blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Steelarachnid.description: A chunky segmented armor band worn around the upper right arm, made of stacked angular plates with a smooth cuff at the top edge and two small round holes on the side. Suggests sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Steelarachnid.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim, back plates and side edge; colour 1 on the stacked front plates; colour 2 in the gaps between plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Steelcommando.description: A short armored cuff band worn around the right upper arm, flaring open at the top with a raised rim, a side panel with stitched detailing, and a small crystal-like tab hanging down the back.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Steelcommando.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main cuff body; colour 0 on the top rim and lower edge; colour 1 on the side panel; colour 3 on the hanging tab.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Super_Destroy.description: A chunky, faceted band that wraps around the right upper arm, flaring slightly toward the elbow, with a flat top face and a raised bevelled rim. Its blocky, retro-armoured look suits a classic villain or superhero.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Super_Destroy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top face; colour 1 on the bevelled rim and highlights; colour 2 on the main body of the band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Symbiote_01.description: A single curved horn-like spike that juts out sideways from the right shoulder and sweeps upward to a sharp point. It has a flat-cut base and a blade-like taper, suggesting an organic, symbiote-style look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the spike; colour 1 on the upper tip, blending gradually from the base.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Symbiote_01.differs: The female spike is tilted more upright and stands off the shoulder near the neck, and it looks slightly narrower.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Tactical_01.description: A small open-backed armor band worn on the right upper arm: a curved plate with a raised, chunky rectangular panel on the outer face and a stepped bevelled edge. Suits tactical or military looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main curved plate and its rim; colour 1 on the raised panel and the band across it.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Traveler_01.description: A wide, softly rumpled armband worn around the upper right arm, with a row of eyelets along its edge and a strap that passes through a square buckle. The loose strap end and small tab give it a casual traveller look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and strap; colour 2 on the buckle and the small end tab; colour 1 on the strap keeper loops beside the buckle; colour 3 on the eyelet rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Wraps_01.description: A short band of overlapping cloth wraps coiled diagonally around the right upper arm, with layered strips in alternating tones and a flat open top edge. Gives a casual, street or sporty look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Arm_Wraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim, bottom edge and some wrap strips; colour 1 on the broad wrap bands; colour 2 on the shadowed strips between the wraps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Armor_Patterned_0.description: A right forearm bracer of angular armor plates with a flared, open top and a tapered wrist end. A large inset panel runs along the outer face, and contrasting outlines edge each plate. Suits superhero or sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Armor_Patterned_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and flared cuff; colour 1 on the long inset panel; colour 2 on the outlines and edging.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Anniversar.description: A tapered, cuff-style bracer worn on the right forearm, wider at the elbow end and narrowing to the wrist. The upper rim has a blocky notched cutout and an open side, giving a retro superhero-villain look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Anniversar.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper part of the bracer, fading to darker shading toward the wrist edge; the other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Anniversar.description: A chunky retro-robot bracer covering the right forearm: a domed metal shell with a hollow, concave back, a ribbed flexible tube running along the front to a small angular head with two lights at the elbow, and a separate cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Anniversar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal shell and ribbed tube; colour 1 on the wrist cuff and the inner hollow of the shell; colour 3 on the small lights in the head.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Aquatic_01.description: A short right-forearm bracer with a tapered cuff and a raised, diamond-shaped outer plate framed by thick edging. Two curved fin-like spikes sweep up from the outer edge. Sits at the forearm; aquatic fantasy style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and the spikes; colour 1 on the raised outer plate panels; colour 2 on the edge framing and rim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Aquatic_02.description: A right forearm bracer of angular armored plates with a stepped edge, two curved fin-like spines along the outer side, and a flared, tapered cuff at the wrist. It suggests aquatic superhero armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm shell and the spines; colour 1 on the side panel; colour 3 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Arcane_01.description: A right-forearm bracer of layered plate: a flared, pointed upper cuff, a segmented mid section with contrasting chevron bands, and a textured lower wrap over the wrist. Small gem studs sit on the plates, giving a fantasy mage look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the textured wrist wrap; colour 2 on the cuff edges and the underside; colour 3 on the chevron bands and the gem surrounds; colour 1 on the gems and small spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Arcane_02.description: A chunky right forearm bracer made of stacked, layered bands with recessed zigzag-patterned panels and small rectangular inset gems, topped by a raised angular flap at the elbow side. Ornate, tribal-arcane styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer bracer bands and plates; colour 2 on the recessed zigzag panels; colour 3 on the rectangular inset gems.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Armored_01.description: A rigid armoured forearm bracer with a wedge-shaped guard, a thick bordered edge and a raised angular panel on the outer face. A small separate cuff plate sits at the wrist. Suggests a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main guard and wrist cuff plate; colour 1 on the raised panel; colour 2 on the bordered edge and lower band; colour 3 on the small accents above the panel and at the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Armorninja.description: An angular armoured bracer worn on the right forearm, with layered plates, a raised pointed edge at the elbow end and several curved blade-like spikes sweeping back past the wrist. Ninja-inspired and sleek.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate edges, rims and spikes; colour 1 on the main forearm panel; colour 2 on the side strip and upper cuff band; colour 3 on the small underside panel near the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Arvad_01.description: An open, ornamental forearm bracer made of swooping, curled scroll-like bands that stand off the arm, framing a small S-shaped scroll panel. Sits on the right forearm above the wrist with a fantasy, elven feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer swooping frame bands; colour 1 on the S-shaped scroll panel; colour 2 on the hooked curling scrolls.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Ascendant_.description: A short right forearm bracer with a rigid, pointed-hex shield plate on the outer forearm, bordered by a raised rim and embossed with an atom symbol, attached to a flared cuff sleeve around the wrist. Superhero sci-fi style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim, atom emblem and inner cuff lip; colour 1 on the recessed face of the plate; colour 2 on the cuff sleeve.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Ascendant_.description: A short tapered forearm bracer that widens toward the elbow, with rimmed edges at both ends, a panel on the outer face with a curved cap at the top, and a separate panel wrapping the back. Clean, sleek superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims at both ends; colour 1 on the main outer panel; colour 2 on the back and lower band; colour 3 on the curved top cap.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Bounty_01.description: A chunky right forearm bracer with a faceted, angular shell, a recessed rectangular panel on the outer side, and a segmented front plate with two inset vertical slots and small stepped tabs. Suggests a sci-fi frontier bounty-hunter look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large outer shell and its recessed panel; colour 0 on the edge band and the lower cuff plate; colour 2 on the front plate and stepped tabs; colour 3 on the inset vertical slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Bowtie_01.description: A small wrist cuff with a folded, faceted band and a rosette-like round medallion on the outer side, with ribbon tails and a bow of pointed loops trailing down. Cute magical-girl styling worn at the right wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, medallion and some ribbon tails; colour 1 on the bow loops and band panels; colour 2 on the inner lining and bow folds; colour 3 on the ribbon tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brass_01.description: A single set of brass knuckles: a chunky angular metal bar with four connected finger holes and a raised, notched top edge, held in the fist across the fingers. Gritty street-fighter style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brass_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole knuckle duster; the glossy metal largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brutal_01.description: A right forearm bracer of layered, segmented armor plates with a gathered cuff at the wrist, a fan of tall jagged spikes flaring from the elbow end, and small curved thorns on the outer side and wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and cuff; colour 1 on the fan of spikes at the elbow; colour 2 on the side thorns; colour 3 on the wrist point.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brutal_02.description: A right forearm bracer of layered cloth wraps bound over a plated guard, with a ruff of jagged spiky fringe at the elbow end, curved horn-like spikes and small thorns along the wraps. Tribal, brutal barbarian look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth wraps; colour 1 on the spiky ruff at the top and the frilled cuff at the wrist; colour 2 on the plate edging and guard panel; colour 3 on the curved horn spikes and thorns.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brutal_Fur.description: A forearm bracer built from wide wrapped bands with a spiky fur-like tuft flaring out at the elbow end and a row of curved horn spikes along the outer edge; a small plate sits at the wrist. Brutal, savage style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brutal_Fur.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist plate and the bands; colour 2 on the wrapping straps; colour 3 on the curved spikes and the underlying base; colour 1 on the spiky tuft at the top.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brutal_Sku.description: A short bone-like bracer wrapping the right forearm, made of a rough angular plated shell with a jagged lower edge, an open flared back and a row of curved spikes rising along the outer edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Brutal_Sku.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell; colour 1 on the spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Buzzsaw_01.description: A cluster of three small notched circular saw blades with raised hub rings and studded dots, floating in a stacked group beside the right forearm and elbow, giving an industrial, mechanical weapon-like look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Buzzsaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade faces; colour 1 on the blade edges; colour 2 on the hub rings; colour 3 on the dots around each blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Buzzsaw_02.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades floating around the right forearm at different angles, each with a raised hub and star-shaped centre. Worn as a bladed bracer; an aggressive, industrial look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Buzzsaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade rims and teeth; colour 1 on the blade faces; colour 3 on the star-shaped hubs; colour 2 on the underside of the lowest blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Buzzsaw_03.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades mounted at the outer forearm, angled outward at different tilts, each with a central hole, a raised inner ring and studded rivets; an aggressive, industrial look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Buzzsaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade discs and inner hub rings; colour 1 on the recessed inner band of each blade; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cannonarm_.description: A large sci-fi arm cannon worn on the right forearm: a streamlined angular shell with a contrasting vent-like scoop, a bracer block at the wrist, and a triple-barrel muzzle extending well past the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cannonarm_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and barrel casings; colour 1 on the wrist bracer, shell edge stripes and barrel tips; colour 2 on the scoop and small recesses; colour 3 on small accent details near the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cannonarm_.description: An oversized sci-fi arm cannon worn over the right forearm: a bulky angular armored housing tapers into three long parallel barrels past the hand, with a contrasting vent panel and small round nodes on the side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cannonarm_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and barrel supports; colour 1 on the top ridge, side stripe and barrel tips; colour 2 on the vent panel and inner mechanism.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Cann.description: A large sci-fi cannon arm worn over the right forearm: a tapered armored housing with a contrasting vent panel, a piped edge and side modules, ending in three long parallel barrels that reach past the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Cann.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armored housing and barrel supports; colour 1 on the edge piping and barrel tips; colour 2 on the vent panel and inner mechanisms.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Coat.description: A right-hand bracer of three long curved blade-like flaps that sweep down and outward from the forearm, each ending in pointed hanging diamond-shaped tassels. Studded with small dots, it gives a punk, rocker flair.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Coat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved flaps and main strip; colour 3 on the dotted studs and the pointed hanging tips; colour 2 on the underside of the flaps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Cryo.description: A curved, segmented tube shaped like a hook or crescent, made of stacked ribbed rings with a contrasting hex-nut cap at one end. It hangs beside the right forearm as a small sci-fi accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Cryo.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed segmented tube; colour 2 on the hex-shaped end caps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A right-forearm gatling-style bracer: a cluster of parallel barrels wrapped by two chunky rings, one mid-forearm and one notched ring near the wrist end, with barrel muzzles poking out below the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrels; colour 0 on the two rings; colour 3 on the barrel tips at the muzzle end.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky cylindrical bracer worn on the right forearm near the wrist, with an octagonal armored shell, a recessed contrasting panel holding a rectangular screen on the outer face, and three contrasting vent slots along the side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and top cap; colour 1 on the rectangular screen; colour 2 on the recessed panel and bottom rim; colour 3 on the side vent slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky half-round bracer worn on the right forearm: a flat-backed, D-shaped housing with a rim and a front band of ribbed, cartridge-like cylinders, suggesting a wrist-mounted gatling or ammo belt.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer housing and rim; colour 1 on the ribbed cylinders; colour 2 on the strip above and below the cylinders.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky cylindrical canister worn on the right forearm, with a capped top, ringed ends and inset side panels. A small peg and a bent hose with a connector run down toward the hand. Suggests a compact sci-fi gadget.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body and the small peg; colour 1 on the end caps, rings, connector and one inset panel; colour 2 on the other inset panel; colour 3 on the hose.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A right-forearm gatling-style bracer: a cluster of long parallel barrels held by two chunky studded rings, with short barrel tips poking out below the wrist end. Bulky, mechanical, sci-fi weapon look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two clamp rings; colour 1 on the barrels; colour 3 on the barrel muzzle tips at the lower end.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky cylindrical sci-fi bracer worn around the right forearm, with a flat circular cap, segmented panel edges, a recessed inset panel on the inner face and three curved vent slots on the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and cap; colour 2 on the recessed panel surround and base rim; colour 1 on the inset plate; colour 3 on the three curved slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky half-round bracer block worn on the right forearm near the wrist: a flat-sided casing with a rounded back, a recessed dished top, and a band of ribbed cylindrical cartridges wrapped around its curved face.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer casing and top plate; colour 1 on the ribbed cylinders; colour 2 on the dividing bands between the cylinders and casing.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.description: A chunky cylindrical gun-drum module worn on the right forearm, with a capped top, ringed ends, a recessed side panel and a short barrel stub. A cable trails down from it to a small connector near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Gatl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cylinder body and barrel stub; colour 1 on the top cap, end rings and inner panel accent; colour 2 on the recessed side panel; colour 3 on the cable.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Nigh.description: A large mechanical gadget mounted along the outside of the right forearm: a boxy housing with a round dial and lens, an angular frame on top, and a long ribbed rod that extends well below the hand, held by a strap.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing plates and dial; colour 1 on the frame, rod and side panels; colour 2 on the strap, lens and rod tip; colour 3 on small accents on the dial and rod.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Rene.description: A chunky sci-fi arm cannon strapped along the outside of the right forearm: a boxy, segmented casing with raised ridges, vent slots and a rear housing, plus twin short muzzle barrels at the wrist end.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Rene.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and ridges; colour 1 on the mounting bracket and the muzzle barrels; colour 3 on the thin indicator strips; colour 2 on the vent slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Rene.description: A pair of thin, curving cable-like tubes with short blocky end fittings that hang beside the right forearm, S-shaped with banded joints. A small sci-fi cannon feed that dangles off the arm without wrapping it.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Rene.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tubes; colour 0 on the end fittings and ribbed sleeves; colour 2 on the small joint bands and the tip caps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Rene.description: A cluster of separate sharp cone-shaped spikes of varying sizes, floating in a row beside the right elbow and pointing outward and backward. A menacing, alien-looking spiked accent with no band or base.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Rene.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all of the spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Rene.description: A pair of curved, cable-like tubes attached to the outer right forearm. Each bends in an S-shape, with a ribbed collar, a flared cuff at one end and a chunky spike-like tip at the other. Sci-fi renegade style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Rene.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff ends and ribbed rings; colour 3 on the main tube lengths; colour 1 on the bent joint sections; colour 2 on the blunt tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A boxy retro forearm cannon worn on the right forearm: a tapered, open-channel barrel housing with a capped cuff at the elbow end and a second shorter module with a small control panel along the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff cap at the top; colour 0 on the front of the tapered barrel housing; colour 2 on the back housing and side module; colour 3 on the small indicator lights on the module.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A slim cylindrical cannon barrel floating beside the right hand, running parallel to the forearm. It is perforated with rows of round vent holes and has a banded section near the lower end, suggesting a retro sci-fi weapon part.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel tube and rim; colour 2 on the vent holes and the back of the tube; colour 1 on the band near the lower end.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A retro-styled stadium-shaped shield with a raised rim and a central C emblem, flanked by ribbed side bars and pointed fins at top and bottom. It floats vertically beside the right forearm with a bracket on the back.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and rim; colour 3 on the inlaid emblem lines; colour 1 on the ribbed side bars and back brackets; colour 2 on the shield underside and edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A scatter of small metal pegs and bolt-like studs arranged in a loose ring that floats beside the right arm, detached from the body. They look like mounting parts for a retro shield, in a sci-fi style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main peg shafts; colour 1 on the peg tips and some end caps; colour 2 on the darker bolt heads and bases.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.description: A scatter of small detached metal pegs, bolts and short cylindrical studs arranged in a loose ring floating beside the right arm, with no band or cuff joining them. They read as loose parts of a retro-tech shield.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bolt shafts and cylinder bodies; colour 1 on the tips of some pegs; colour 2 on the darker caps and heads.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Retr.differs: The female parts form a looser, wider ring that sits further out from the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Scar.description: A right-wrist bracer made of two curved, tapering spines that rise from a small cuff band at the wrist and end in sharp, hooked tips, giving a scarab-claw look along the outer forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Scar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff band; colour 1 on the curved spine shafts; colour 3 on the sharp spine tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Scar.description: A right forearm bracer made of a partial curved band that wraps the wrist, with a contrasting tapering stalk rising along the outer forearm and ending in a long, sharp, curved blade-like horn. Suggests a scarab or insect claw.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Scar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved wrist band; colour 2 on the tapering stalk; colour 3 on the curved horn blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Spik.description: A ring of separate floating pyramid spikes of varied sizes circling the right wrist, with no band joining them. Reads as a punk, edgy set of spiked restraints.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Spik.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spike faces; colour 2 on the shaded spike sides and bases.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Spik.differs: The female version has slightly larger, more scattered spikes with a few tiny shards, while the male version has a tidier ring of spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Swin.description: A small handheld electric device worn at the right wrist: a tapered cylindrical body with a glowing vertical tube, ringed collar, ribbed flared base, pointed metal tip and a short side handle peg.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Swin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, tip, ribbed base and side handle; colour 2 on the collar rings; colour 3 on the inner tube glow strip.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Child_Swin.differs: The female side handle is a rounded cylindrical peg.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Chimera_01.description: A right forearm bracer made of layered, overlapping feather-like or fur tufts that taper into jagged points at the wrist edge, with a spiky, crown-like rim at the elbow end. It gives a wild, beastly look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and top tufts; colour 1 on the middle tufts; colour 2 on the jagged tips at the wrist end. The colours blend as a gradient down the piece.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Coat_Flair.description: A right-forearm flair made of three curved, pointed straps stacked along the outer forearm, each studded with small dots and ending in hanging diamond-shaped tassels; a rock-and-roll, punk accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Coat_Flair.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 3 on the diamond tassels and the small stud dots; colour 1 on the thin edge trim.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Coat_Flair.differs: The female version has three stacked straps that hang closer together, while the male version has only two strap groups spaced further apart.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cryo_01.description: A rigid sci-fi bracer worn on the right forearm: a tapered armored shell with a flared upper edge, a separate contrasting panel with a stripe on the outer face, and a round dial housing with a looping ribbed hose.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the outer panel; colour 3 on the stripe, the ribbed hose and the dial centre; colour 2 on the dial housings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cybercat_0.description: A right-hand claw gauntlet of four long, curved blade-like talons that extend past the fingers from a small hand-back frame, with cables running to knuckle studs and a wrist anchor. Cybernetic, feline-inspired weapon style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cybercat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long claw blades; colour 1 on the wrist and hand-frame tips; colour 3 on the cables and struts; colour 2 on the knuckle studs and joints.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cybercat_0.description: A set of long, slender curved blade claws that extend forward from the right hand, with three or four tapering talons of differing lengths fanning out from a small angular base at the knuckles. Suggests a feline cyber-weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cybercat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main claw blades; colour 2 on the small angular base pieces at the knuckles. Slots 1 and 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cyberwire_.description: A tapered forearm bracer of segmented armor plates that runs from just below the elbow to the wrist. It has a flared open top, a contrasting side panel, small stud lights and a thin trim band at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Cyberwire_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared outer plates and top rim; colour 2 on the main sleeve panel; colour 1 on the wrist trim and the upper edge accent; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Deity_01.description: A short angular forearm bracer with a faceted, slightly tapered shell. A contrasting wedge-shaped panel cut into the upper edge gives it a sharp, angular top. Sits on the right forearm above the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 2 on the wedge-shaped panel at the upper edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Deity_02.description: A short flared forearm bracer with a pointed lower edge that tapers toward the wrist and a wide open cuff at the top. Bands of contrasting stripes wrap around the middle. Suggests a mystic, fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 2 on the wide central band; colour 1 on the broad band below it; colour 3 on the thin piping lines beside the bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Draco_01.description: A forearm bracer of layered armor plates with a rounded, flared cuff at the elbow end, a raised central panel and pointed edges at the wrist. A swooping, curved spiked fin sweeps off the outer edge, giving a dragon-like fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plates and raised panel; colour 2 on the rim, cuff edging and underside; colour 3 on the curved spiked fin and wrist spikes; colour 0 is not visible.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Draco_01.differs: The female cuff at the elbow end is contrasting and plain, with no contrasting flared inner flap.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Drill_01.description: A short, tapered armoured bracer worn on the right forearm, with a broad rim at each end, a thin seam down the centre and small angular plates at the sides. It has a compact sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 2 on the angular side plates; colour 3 on the small marks near the lower edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Dryad_01.description: A right forearm bracer built from overlapping layered plates that taper toward the wrist, with a rough, mossy-textured panel along the outer side and smooth panels on the inner side. Suggests a nature-guardian fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and edges; colour 1 on the rough outer panel; colour 2 on the inner smooth panels; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Dryad_Alt_.description: A chunky right forearm bracer of layered, bark-like plates that flare slightly toward the wrist, with a mossy, rough-textured outer panel and contrasting segmented inner plates. Suggests a nature-guardian fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Dryad_Alt_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plates; colour 1 on the rough outer panel; colour 2 on the inner segmented plates; colour 3 on thin accent lines.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Eagle_Drka.description: A right forearm bracer of layered, overlapping feather plates that sweep down into pointed tips toward the hand, with a scalloped feathered cuff at the elbow end and two thin bands holding it on.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Eagle_Drka.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scalloped upper cuff feathers; colour 1 on the long lower feathers; colour 2 on the two retaining bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Element_Fi.description: A right-forearm bracer made of swirling, layered flame shapes with pointed licking tongues, rising from the wrist up the forearm and flaring outward. It looks like a glossy sculpted fire wrap with an elemental fantasy feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Element_Fi.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; only faint tints of colour 1 and colour 3 show in the flame folds, with colour 0 and colour 2 barely visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Element_Fi.description: A right-forearm bracer shaped as a cluster of swirling flame tongues, with curled wisps and jagged points, wrapping around the forearm above the wrist. Glossy and sculptural, it suits elemental fantasy looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Element_Fi.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; the whole flame cluster shows a reflective sheen with only faint tinting from the slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Element_Wa.description: A right forearm bracer sculpted as glossy liquid swirls: curling wave-like tendrils rise above the elbow and drip in fluid points toward the wrist. It has a smooth, flowing organic surface and an elemental water style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Element_Wa.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; the whole bracer shows a single reflective finish, with only faint hints of colour slots in the sheen.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Element_Wa.description: A glossy, liquid-like right forearm bracer of flowing curled tendrils and swirling ridges, with tapering drips at the wrist and a few curling spurs rising past the elbow. Worn over the forearm as an elemental water-themed piece.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Element_Wa.colourAreas: The glossy default material ignores the colour scheme; the whole bracer shows one uniform shiny finish and no slot is visibly applied.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Falcon_01.description: A right forearm bracer of segmented plates with a domed, rounded shoulder-like cap at the elbow, small studs along its rim, and a sharp flared fin at the wrist. A gem sits in an ornate filigree panel on the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates; colour 2 on the elbow cap and wrist fin; colour 1 on the filigree and edge piping and the studs; colour 3 on the gem.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Firebird_0.description: An angular bracer worn on the right forearm: a faceted outer shell with a forked, pronged upper edge over a swept-back flared cuff panel, with a contrasting hollow at the wrist opening. Suggests a fiery, superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Firebird_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forked outer shell; colour 0 on the swept cuff panel; colour 2 on the inner hollow at the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Flame_01.description: A right forearm bracer shaped like licking flames: a tapered sleeve of layered, jagged tongues with long curved spikes sweeping up toward the elbow and smaller barbs along the edges, leaving the hand bare.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Flame_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer flame tongues and spikes; colour 1 on the main flame layers; colour 2 on the inner underside panel; colour 3 on small flame accents near the elbow.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Fluff_01.description: A short, thick fur cuff that wraps around the right wrist as a shaggy ring with spiky, ragged tufts along both edges. It sits just above the hand and suggests a wintry, barbarian or animal-themed look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Fluff_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the tufted tips and streaks through the fur; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gamer_01.description: A novelty gamer bracer: a flat rectangular game-controller slab with a cross pad and round buttons sits on the forearm, joined by a curling cable to a chunky wrist cuff with a thin accent stripe at the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the controller body and the inner cuff plate; colour 3 on the cross pad, buttons and cuff stripe; colour 1 on the cable; colour 2 on the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gatling_01.description: A large mechanical gatling-gun bracer strapped over the right forearm: a cluster of long barrels ending in a ringed muzzle, with a drum magazine, canister and cabling on the upper arm. Bulky sci-fi weapon look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings, rings and drum casing; colour 1 on the barrels and drum ribs; colour 3 on the vent-like slots and barrel tips; colour 2 on the cables and mechanism gaps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gatling_Al.description: A bulky forearm-mounted gatling gun bracer: a rotary barrel cluster with a ringed muzzle extends past the hand, behind a cylindrical housing with slotted vents, a side ammo canister and a capped top drum.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gatling_Al.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, canister, caps and muzzle ring; colour 1 on the barrels and housing bands; colour 3 on the vent slots and muzzle tips; colour 2 on the small sockets and panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gearbreak_.description: A chunky right forearm bracer with a flared, contrasting-rimmed cuff, a paneled upper band, an angular lower plate with a raised ridge, and hexagonal gem-like studs. It has a sturdy, sci-fi armored look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gearbreak_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower armor plate; colour 1 on the upper band; colour 2 on the rim and bottom edge; colour 3 on the hexagonal studs and small dots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gladiator_.description: A right forearm bracer of segmented armor: a flared, angular guard at the elbow end, a central panel with curved swoosh markings, a separate side panel, and a bulky cuff over the wrist and back of the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gladiator_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm panel; colour 3 on the curved markings; colour 1 on the lower side panel; colour 2 on the elbow guard, edging and wrist cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gladiator_.description: A gladiator-style right forearm bracer: a tall pointed outer plate flares up the side of the arm, over a curved main shell with a raised rounded guard near the elbow and a stepped flared cuff at the wrist, all edged in contrasting trim.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gladiator_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large pointed side plate; colour 3 on the main forearm shell; colour 0 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the edge trim and the raised elbow guard.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gladiator_.description: A right forearm bracer in gladiator style: a tapering armored shell with a raised flared cap at the elbow end, stacked ridged fins along the outer edge, and a pointed tip toward the wrist, with a small strap loop.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Gladiator_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate; colour 1 on the lower side panels and pointed tip; colour 2 on the elbow cap, ridged fins and strap; colour 3 on the inner accent stripe.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Goth_01.description: A set of separate octagonal bands stacked along the right forearm: a wide ribbed upper cuff, a thin wire hoop, a studded band and a thin bottom ring. Gothic, light and partial, worn near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed upper cuff and the thin hoop; colour 1 on the studded band and the top face of the upper cuff; colour 3 on the studs; colour 2 on the bottom ring.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Goth_02.description: A stack of thin faceted wrist bands on the right forearm: a wide studded central cuff with a slim raised hoop above it and a thin flat ring below, giving a gothic layered bracer look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper thin hoop; colour 1 on the wide central cuff; colour 3 on the studs around the cuff; colour 2 on the lower thin ring.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Heraldry_0.description: A heater-style shield mounted on the right forearm: an elongated pointed plate with a notched top edge, a raised rim, a kite-shaped inset panel and an ornate curled crest. Grips and a strap fit on the inner face.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Heraldry_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and outer field; colour 1 on the inset kite panel; colour 3 on the ornate crest and strap; colour 2 on the rim and back plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Ice_01.description: A cluster of jagged crystalline ice shards jutting outward along the right forearm from elbow to wrist, with larger spikes near the elbow. It gives a fantasy, elemental look without covering the whole arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Ice_01.colourAreas: Glossy, faceted crystal that mostly ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows on some facets, and the rest reads as reflective near-black.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Ice_02.description: A cluster of jagged crystalline ice shards attached to the outer right forearm: one large faceted spike rises at the top, with smaller angular shards clustered and tapering toward the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Ice_02.colourAreas: The glossy crystal ignores the colour scheme, so the shards show a reflective finish; no visible colour slot is applied.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Inmate_02.description: A chunky armored bracer for the right forearm, built from stacked segmented plates with strapped bands and a flared cuff at the wrist. A thin chain hangs from the wrist, giving a prison-inmate restraint look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and cuff; colour 2 on the back straps and underlying bands; colour 3 on the small accent panels between the plates; the chain takes the metal finish.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Insect_01.description: A right forearm bracer in an insect-carapace style: a smooth tapered shell with a raised, flared rim at the elbow end, a glossy inset panel on the outer side, a rounded raised plate on the inner side and a small curved spike.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the raised rounded plate; colour 2 on the glossy inset panel; colour 3 on the curved spike.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Kaiju_01.description: A right forearm bracer of armored, segmented plates on one side with a flared elbow cup, and a contrasting panel down the other side studded with curved contrasting horn-like spikes. Monstrous, kaiju-inspired armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented plates and elbow flare; colour 3 on the side panel and cuff edge; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Krampus_02.description: A heavy metal chain wound in several loose coils around the right forearm just above the wrist, forming a chunky, tangled bracer of chunky links. It suggests a gothic, holiday-monster or punk look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Krampus_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole chain; the metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Lockbox_65.description: A large ornate right forearm bracer with a pointed upturned cuff, swirling curved thorn-like blades and flame-like flourishes along its outer edge, and a small face-like ornament near the wrist. Fantasy martial style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sweeping metal flourishes and edge trim; colour 1 on the main bracer plate panels; colour 2 on the inner lining and the blade tips; colour 3 on the small gem accents.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Lockbox_65.description: A right forearm bracer with a snarling dragon-head guard at the elbow, spiky mane and horns, and a tapered armored shell with swirling scroll trim and a flared wrist cuff. East-asian martial arts style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the dragon head, mane and inner lining; colour 3 on the dragon's eyes; colour 0 on the swirling trim, edges and spikes; colour 2 on the main forearm plates and cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Lockbox_66.description: A chunky sci-fi forearm bracer: a tapered, open-topped cylindrical sleeve with angular armored plates at the elbow end, hex-bolted contrasting lens studs, and banded straps. A slim cuff sits at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Lockbox_66.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tubular sleeve; colour 2 on the angular armor plates, straps and bands; colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 3 on the hex lens studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Lockbox_66.description: A right forearm bracer made of angular armor plates: a long tapered plate with a round central gem, swept wing-like flanges, a curved raised fin along the outer edge, and two contrasting straps that hold it around the forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Lockbox_66.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plate and flanges; colour 0 on the raised fin and the rim around the gem; colour 3 on the round gem; colour 2 on the straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Madjester_.description: A short, faceted cuff worn on the right wrist, with swirling scrollwork patterns around its band and a wide, ruffled flounce flaring out below over the back of the hand. A playful, theatrical jester look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Madjester_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the swirling scroll patterns; colour 1 on the ruffled flounce; colour 3 on the thin edge of the ruffle.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Madjester_.description: Two separate faceted bands worn stacked on the right forearm, each a belt-like loop with a pointed overlapping tip and a small strap keeper across it. A simple, theatrical jester-style cuff pair.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Madjester_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both bands and their pointed tips; colour 3 on the small keeper straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Malvan_01.description: A forearm bracer built from stacked metal rings with a patterned inner band showing rune-like marks, plus a raised armored plate and a blade-like fin along the outer back of the arm, held by contrasting knobs.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and rear plate; colour 1 on the banded inner sleeve; colour 3 on the rune marks and plate emblem; colour 2 on the knobs and blade fin.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mecha_01.description: A chunky angular mecha bracer worn on the right forearm near the wrist: a boxy cuffed housing with a recessed vertical capsule window and a tall slab-like side plate with a separate top cap.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff housing; colour 1 on the tall side plate; colour 2 on the plate's top cap and lower cuff edges; colour 3 on the capsule window.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mecha_03.description: A mecha-style right bracer: a ring at the wrist with a forked, clamp-like housing, and a long flat blade-like slab extending down past the hand along the outer thigh. Angular and mechanical, with small vent-like slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mecha_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fork housing and the edge of the blade; colour 1 on the long blade slab and wrist ring; colour 3 on the slot markings near the wrist; colour 2 on the wrist band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mechanon.description: A sci-fi forearm bracer made of angular overlapping armor plates and tall upright blades that flare outward at the wrist, with a small latch detail. It sits on the right forearm just above the hand, with a robotic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall upright blades and edge plates; colour 1 on the main flared outer shell; colour 2 on the darker inset panels; colour 3 on the small accent strip and latch detail.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Modern_Des.description: A right forearm bracer of angular plates with contrasting outlined edges, a recessed rectangular panel on the outer face, a small rounded pouch-like block on the inner side, and a stepped cuff flaring over the back of the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Modern_Des.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plates; colour 1 on the rounded block on the inner side; colour 3 on the recessed panel; colour 2 on the edge outlines and cuff bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Modern_Iro.description: A rigid forearm bracer with a flared, angular cuff at the elbow end, a smooth plated outer shell with a flame-like emblem, a ribbed segmented side strip, and a small pointed guard over the wrist and hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Modern_Iro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and wrist guard; colour 1 on the ribbed side strip; colour 2 on the flared cuff and wrist band; colour 3 on the flame emblem.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Monster_Fu.description: A shaggy fur cuff wrapping the right wrist, with jagged, pointed tufts that stand up at the wrist and hang down over the back of the hand. Suggests a monstrous, beastly look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Monster_Fu.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts, with darker shading toward the tips; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Moth_01.description: A flared, cuff-like forearm bracer with soft folded cloth-like walls, an open wedge-shaped top that shows a contrasting lining, and a row of small contrasting claw-like spikes along the rear edge near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer bracer body; colour 3 on the inner lining and the lower gradient edge; colour 2 on the small spikes and the wrist edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mutated_01.description: A single fleshy, tentacle-like appendage that hangs beside the right hand, curving in an S shape and ending in a tight curled tip. Its lumpy, organic surface suggests a mutated growth.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole tentacle body; colour 1 on a small patch near the lower curl; colour 2 on a tiny spot.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mutated_02.description: A single thick, fleshy tentacle that hangs alongside the right forearm in a lazy S-curve and ends in a curled hook-like tip below the hand. It has a lumpy organic surface with small clustered nodules, giving a mutated, alien look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tentacle body; colour 1 on the small nodule cluster near the upper section; colour 2 on the small growths lower down.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Odragon_01.description: A small wrist ornament shaped like a stylised dragon head with a pointed snout, a round eye and a sweeping crest of long, sharp spiky fins fanning up and back along the forearm. It sits at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dragon head and snout; colour 1 on the spiky crest fins; colour 2 on the edges and claw tips; colour 3 on the eye.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Padding.description: Segmented tactical bracer for the right forearm: a rounded shield-like pad floats near the elbow above two curved armor shells, a wider outer one and a narrower inner one, with contrasting panels along the forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the elbow pad and upper edges of the shells; colour 1 on the lower outer shell; colour 2 on the inset panels and lower end; colour 3 on the inner shell's raised panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Patriot_01.description: A right forearm bracer shaped as an open half-shell that wraps the outer forearm from elbow to wrist, with a piped edge and two contrasting straps that loop around the arm. Suggests a clean superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 1 on the edge piping and the inner lining; colour 2 on the two straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Phantom_03.description: A right forearm bracer shaped like a short angular guard: a faceted rim rings the forearm, and the outer face sweeps down into a curved cutaway that leaves the inner side open. Sits between elbow and wrist; suits a superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Phantom_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of the bracer; colour 2 on the inner lining and the rim edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Pony_01.description: A tuft of layered, pointed feather-like locks that wraps around the right wrist and hand, with short upright spikes on top and longer tapering strands sweeping down and back. A whimsical, mane-like fantasy cuff.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Pony_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper spiky locks; colour 1 on the middle row of locks; colour 2 on the long lower trailing locks.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Pumpkin_01.description: A skeletal forearm bracer with rib-like curved bones wrapping around the arm, a contrasting spine strip along the inner side, curved claw spikes at the elbow and armored plates at the wrist and outer forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rib bones; colour 1 on the armor plates at the wrist and outer forearm; colour 2 on the spine strip; colour 3 on the claw spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Punk_01.description: A short, chunky cuff worn on the right forearm, with a smooth tapered band studded with rows of cone spikes and small faceted studs around its circumference. A punk, aggressive look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff band, fading toward colour 0 at the lower edge; colour 2 on the spikes and studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Punk_02.description: A short right bracer at the wrist: a metal cuff with a raised, bevelled hexagonal plate on the outer side and a ribbed knit cuff rising above it. Rugged punk styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Punk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal cuff and plate edging; colour 1 on the ribbed upper cuff; colour 3 on the raised outer plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Punk_03.description: A short, padded sweatband-style wrist bracer that flares slightly toward the top, built from vertical quilted stripes between thick rounded rims at the wrist edges. Sporty, punk-flavoured casual wear.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Punk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and bottom rims; colour 1 and colour 3 on alternating vertical stripes; colour 2 on the stripes between them.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Rave_Brace.description: A chunky angular wrist cuff with a jagged, zigzag upper and lower edge, faceted panels and small triangular inlay accents; worn snugly on the right wrist in a rave-punk, sci-fi style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Rave_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower and front faceted panels; colour 2 on the upper and back shell; colour 1 on the small triangular inlays; colour 3 on the triangular accents.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Rave_Brace.description: A chunky octagonal wrist cuff with raised rims top and bottom and a wide central band, studded with contrasting pyramid spikes around the sides. Sits snugly on the right wrist in a rave-punk style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Rave_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and lower rims and the inner lining; colour 1 on the central band; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Rave_Fur_0.description: A right wrist bracer made of layered, ragged feathers or fur that flare outward and hang over the back of the hand, topped by a narrow band at the wrist. Wild, festival-like styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Rave_Fur_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the wrist band; colour 2 on the upper layer of feathers; colour 1 on the middle layer; colour 0 on the lower, longest layer.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Rave_Wire_.description: A open-weave mesh bracer covering the right forearm, with a thick rolled cuff at the elbow end and a trimmed mesh flap extending over the back of the hand. Rave-style netted look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Rave_Wire_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper mesh strands; colour 1 on the lower mesh strands, fading between them; colour 2 on the inner lining and lower flap mesh; colour 3 on the top cuff and the hand flap edging.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Reactor_01.description: A chunky sci-fi armoured bracer covering the right forearm, built from layered angular plates with a flared, pointed edge near the elbow and a contrasting segmented cuff at the wrist. Tiny lights sit on the edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the inset panels along the outer forearm and cuff; colour 2 on the recessed joints and wrist band; colour 3 on the small light accents.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Reactor_02.description: A right forearm bracer of angular plated armour with a pointed spike extending toward the wrist, an open contrasting inset panel showing a reactor-like mesh, and soft cuffs at both ends. Sci-fi and tactical in feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armour plates and spike; colour 1 on the cuffs at each end; colour 2 on the inset mesh panel; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Renegade_C.description: A sci-fi forearm bracer with a boxy cannon barrel mounted along its outer side, ridged panels, a contrasting inset window and a curved cable looping over the top. It sits on the right forearm above the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Renegade_C.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell and cannon housing; colour 1 on the cuff ends, rim panels and top cap; colour 2 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the cable and small studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Renegade_C.description: A boxy sci-fi arm cannon strapped along the right forearm, with a segmented barrel housing, a raised side block with mounting plates, twin muzzle nozzles at the wrist end and looping power cables.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Renegade_C.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cannon housing and barrel casing; colour 1 on the side mounting block, muzzle nozzles and top connector; colour 3 on the looping cables and small slot inserts; colour 2 on the vent slits.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Renegade_S.description: A sci-fi forearm bracer with a tapered plated sleeve, a bulky angular cuff at the elbow end crowned with a ring of long spikes, and curved cables running to small canister pods along the side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Renegade_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm shell and canister casings; colour 1 on the upper cuff plating and the wrist rim; colour 2 on the spiked band and cable end caps; colour 3 on the spikes and cables.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Retro_Warl.description: A bulky retro sci-fi gatling arm cannon worn on the right forearm: a rounded domed shell with a glass-like window sits beside a ribbed barrel housing with a multi-barrel muzzle pointing down, plus a flexible ribbed hose looping up toward the shoulder.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Retro_Warl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel bands and muzzle rings; colour 1 on the ribbed housing and the dome shell panels; colour 2 on the hose and barrel shafts; colour 3 on the patch of the dome.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Retrosteel.description: A forearm bracer carrying a large oval shield-like plate off the outer side, with a cylindrical cuff at the wrist, ribbed side rails, small spikes around the rim, curved fins at the ends and a central emblem.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Retrosteel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate face and cuff; colour 1 on the side rails, cuff band and spike tips; colour 3 on the central emblem and its linework; colour 2 on the plate's underside and edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Retrosteel.description: A bulky retro sci-fi arm cannon strapped to the right forearm: a boxy angular housing with two cuff bands, a long perforated barrel pointing down past the hand, and a small readout panel on the back.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Retrosteel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing plates; colour 1 on the cuff bands, top cap and barrel ring; colour 2 on the barrel, rear body and underside.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Retrosteel.description: A large oval metal shield worn on the right forearm, with a raised plate face, curved fin-like blades at top and bottom, ribbed side cylinders, and rows of small studs around the rim. Retro sci-fi style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Retrosteel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shield plate and fins; colour 1 on the side cylinders and rim pegs; colour 3 on the central emblem and the branching line inlays; colour 2 on the rear housing and edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Roman_01.description: A Roman-style segmented forearm guard made of stacked, overlapping plates studded with rivets, wrapped around the right forearm and held by contrasting straps at the upper and lower ends. Suggests gladiator or legionary armour.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Roman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the shaded upper edge of the plates; colour 2 on the straps; colour 3 on the rivets.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Roman_01.differs: This version has three straps, with two at the upper end and one lower, and they sit more loosely on the plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Roman_02.description: A forearm bracer of stacked, overlapping horizontal metal plates in a Roman guard style, studded with small rivets. It wraps the right forearm from wrist to below the elbow and has no straps.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Roman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the shaded plate edges along the outer side; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Sandstorm_.description: A fingerless glove with a short scrunched cuff at the wrist, covering the back of the hand and knuckles. A raised angular plate with an inset panel sits on the outer hand, giving a sporty, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Sandstorm_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the plate frame; colour 3 on the inset panel of the plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Sandstorm_.description: A right forearm bracer made of a single angular, faceted plate that flares outward from the outer forearm, held on by a thick band that wraps around the arm. Reads as sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Sandstorm_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer plate; colour 2 on the band around the forearm.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Sandstorm_.description: A right-hand combat glove with a fingerless fabric cuff and padded knuckle guard, plus a rigid angular plate on the forearm held by a strap and a small plate over the wrist. Sporty, tactical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Sandstorm_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm and wrist plates; colour 1 on the glove fabric; colour 2 on the straps; colour 3 on the ridged knuckle pad.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarab_01.description: A right forearm bracer of layered armored plates with a flared cuff, a raised rounded plate on the outer forearm, and two curved horn-like spikes rising from contrasting side fins near the elbow. Suggests a beetle-like superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm shell; colour 1 on the side fins and rails; colour 2 on the cuff and the raised back plate; colour 3 on the curved horn spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarab_02.description: A rigid forearm bracer with a smooth armored shell, contrasting edging and a flared cuff at the wrist. A tall curved horn-like spike sweeps up from the elbow end. Suggests a beetle-inspired superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and back oval panel; colour 1 on the inner curved plate; colour 2 on the edge trim, cuff and elbow cap; colour 3 on the curved spike.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarab_02.differs: The female version has a narrower elbow cap, so the spike stands out more.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarab_Alt.description: A right-wrist bracer made of two long curved insect-like pincer blades rising from a small cuffed base at the wrist, each tipped with a sharp pointed claw that sweeps up along the forearm. Suggests a scarab-themed fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarab_Alt.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff base; colour 1 on the curved blade shafts; colour 3 on the claw tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarab_Alt.description: A single curved scarab-style claw worn on the right forearm: a tapering horn-like blade sweeps upward from a slim segmented sheath, with a contrasting hooked band curling under to wrap the wrist. Fantasy, monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarab_Alt.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the curved blade; colour 2 on the segmented sheath section; colour 0 on the hooked wrist band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarletshi.description: A pair of stacked, angular wrist bracers on the right wrist, each a faceted band closed by a buckled strap with a square frame; the look is punk and street with a rugged feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Scarletshi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer bands; colour 1 on the strap ends and tabs; colour 2 on the buckle frames.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Seacreatur.description: A fan of five long, curved fin-like blades that sweep outward and down from the outside of the right forearm. Each blade is layered with chevron patterning and a contrasting edge, giving an aquatic, spiny look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Seacreatur.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad blade faces; colour 1 on the blade edges and outlines; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the darker blade tips and undersides.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Shield_Her.description: A heater-style shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm, with a notched top edge, pointed lower end and a raised rim. The outer face carries a central wedge panel and an ornate fleur-like crest; the inner face has two grip slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Shield_Her.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and bevelled upper edge; colour 1 on the central wedge panel; colour 3 on the crest emblem; colour 2 on the outer rim and back.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Sleeve_01.description: A loose, flared forearm sleeve for the right arm: a tube that widens toward the wrist with soft creased folds, a band at the upper edge and a contrasting hem at the cuff opening.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Sleeve_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sleeve body; colour 1 on the band at the upper edge; colour 2 on the hem at the cuff opening.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Socrates_0.description: A superhero forearm bracer with a tall curved fin-like rim rising along the outer edge, a central raised spine, vented ribbed side panels and a narrow band at the wrist. Sits on the right forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Socrates_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer rim, wrist band and central stripe; colour 0 on the main plate and vent ribs; colour 1 on the side panels; colour 2 on the opening at the top.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Spiked_01.description: A chunky wrist restraint on the right forearm: two thick padded rings joined by a contrasting central cylinder, with a rectangular plate on the outer edge. Pyramid spikes ring the lower band and rivet-like studs sit on the upper band.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two padded rings; colour 3 on the spikes and studs; colour 2 on the central cylinder; colour 0 on the angular side plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Spooky_01.description: A jagged, crystalline shard cluster attached to the outer right forearm: stacked spiky blades taper from a tall point near the elbow down to smaller splinters at the wrist, like frost or bone spurs.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shards; colour 1 on the lower shards, fading between the two along the length.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Spy_01.description: A ruffled, gathered cuff worn around the right wrist, flaring out over the back of the hand in a scalloped frill with layered stripes of contrasting trim along the hem. Frilly, formal spy-style look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ruffle fabric; colour 1 on the inner stripe near the hem; colour 2 on the middle stripe; colour 3 on the outer hem edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Starhawk_0.description: A right forearm bracer tapering from a flared, rounded elbow cup to the wrist, with a pointed crystal-like fin on top, a banded cuff at the wrist and an open slit along the inner side. Sleek superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Starhawk_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the wrist cuff band; colour 2 on the elbow cup and its rim and the inner slit; colour 3 on the pointed crest.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Starowl_01.description: A bulky, feathered bracer wrapped around the right forearm: a rounded mass of layered, pointed feather tufts that flare outward and sweep down in ragged tips, with small speckled dots across the surface. Suggests a griffon or owl wing.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather mass; colour 1 on the small speckle dots; colour 2 on the soft shaded patches between feathers.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Steelcomma.description: A short armored bracer sitting on the right forearm near the wrist, made of segmented angular plates with a raised faceted cuff at the elbow end and ribbed inner vents. It has a retro military-superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Steelcomma.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer plates; colour 2 on the rear and side panels and the angular cuff; colour 0 on the rim edging and cuff top; colour 3 on the ribbed inner section.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Super_Dest.description: A tapered forearm bracer built from stacked segmented metal bands, capped with a chunky faceted cuff at the top and a narrow rim at the wrist, with a row of small cone spikes down the outer edge. Retro superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Super_Dest.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cap and wrist rim; colour 0 on the front metal bands; colour 2 on the back bands; colour 3 on the spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Swan_01.description: A large tapering armored bracer covering the right forearm, flaring toward the wrist. It has a zigzag trim line, a faceted gem on the outer side, a round socket at the cuff and a jagged feathery fringe hanging over the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell and fringe; colour 1 on the top rim, zigzag trim, cuff band and fringe tips; colour 2 on the round sockets; colour 3 on the gem.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Swing_01.description: A short, flared right bracer with a rolled rim at the top, riveted side panels and a strapped band at the wrist, carrying a small pointed electrode cylinder with a glass tube and ribbed base mounted on the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer plates, straps and electrode casing; colour 1 on the recessed panel areas of the bracer; colour 2 on the rim and the electrode collars; colour 3 on the tube inside the electrode.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Swing_02.description: A long right forearm bracer with a loose, gathered upper sleeve ending in a rolled open cuff, and a fitted lower section with contrasting edging. Round glowing-style studs sit at the elbow and wrist; a small pocket flap and snap decorate the back.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the loose upper sleeve and cuff; colour 1 on the fitted lower section; colour 2 on the edging and frames around the studs; colour 3 on the round studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Syringe_01.description: A chunky right forearm bracer with angular armored shell panels, side-mounted syringe cylinders, cables running down to the hand, and four needle-like claws extending past the knuckles. A sci-fi medical-gadget look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Syringe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell plate, syringe barrels and fittings; colour 1 on the inner panel; colour 3 on the side panel and cables; colour 2 on the rim and cuff.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Syringe_01.differs: The female version has two syringe cylinders on the outer side, with the four cabled needle claws reaching over the hand.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Tateklys_0.description: A chunky forearm bracer that flares from a narrow wrist cuff to a wider upper arm, with smooth armored panels, an etched maze-like pattern on the outer face, a pointed flared fin on the wrist and a raised edge along the top.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Tateklys_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armored shell and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the flared wrist fin, the inner recess and the upper flared lip; colour 3 on the etched maze pattern; colour 2 on the raised edge strip.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Thruster_0.description: A large jet-thruster pod worn alongside the right forearm, hanging from the arm to the hand. It is elongated and tapered, with swept fin-like blades, segmented armoured panels and a flat plate against the body. Suggests a superhero or sci-fi style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Thruster_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame, trim bands and inner flat plate; colour 1 on the main armoured casing panels; colour 3 on the swept fins and vent blocks; colour 2 on the nose tip and slot recesses.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Tight_Anni.description: A tight, tapered forearm bracer worn on the right arm. It has a swept, scooped cuff that rises higher on the outer side, a smooth lower band, and three recessed horizontal slots with thin edge lines. Suggests a retro superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Tight_Anni.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper scooped cuff; colour 0 on the main lower bracer body; colour 2 on the recessed slot panels and lower back section; colour 3 on the thin lines edging the slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Traveler_0.description: A short cloth bracer for the right forearm with a rolled, cuffed top and a wrist flare. A rigid outer plate with contrasting edging runs along the side, with small lace-like straps or slots beside it. Casual traveller style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Traveler_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth sleeve and rolled cuff; colour 1 on the outer plate; colour 2 on the plate edging, straps and band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Victory_01.description: A tapered superhero bracer worn on the right forearm, with a flared cuff at the elbow end, swept-back pointed fins, angled layered panels along the length and a trimmed band at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angled outer panels and the pointed fins; colour 1 on the elbow cuff and wrist band trim; colour 2 on the inner panel and underlay.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Vigilante_.description: A rigid forearm bracer with a smooth curved plate and a raised, angled rim, held by two banded cuffs near the wrist and below the elbow. Open at the back, in a superhero vigilante style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Vigilante_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the raised rim and the open back shell; colour 2 on the main plate; colour 0 on the cuff bands; colour 1 on the cuff edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Vigilante_.description: A right forearm bracer of angular, segmented plates: a chunky upper cuff and a tapering lower guard joined by a narrow band, with two thin strap rings around the arm. Sits on the forearm with a tactical vigilante look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Vigilante_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plates; colour 3 on the joining band between the plates; colour 1 and colour 0 on the two strap rings (outer bands and inner stripe).

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Warrior_01.description: A right forearm bracer built from stacked, ribbed rounded bands with a flared cuff at the wrist, and an angular pointed plate on the outer side with embossed chevron texture and two round insets.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed bands, cuff and plate edge trim; colour 0 on the embossed outer plate; colour 1 on the round insets; colour 2 on the narrow wrist band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Warrior_02.description: A right forearm bracer with a tall ribbed upper section, an angular segmented plate band across the middle, and a flared ribbed cuff at the wrist. It has an open notch along the inner edge and a superhero-armor look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed upper section and the plate edges; colour 2 on the grooves between the ribs; colour 3 on the angular plate band; colour 1 on the ribbed cuff.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Warrior_02.differs: The female version shows the default colour scheme, with contrasting ribbing, plate band and cuff; the male version shows as a translucent glassy glow that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Weapon_Cla.description: A right-hand claw bracer: a padded cuff at the wrist over a glove-like hand plate with scratch-mark lines and round knuckle studs, with two long curved blade claws sweeping down past the fingers from a mechanical mount.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Weapon_Cla.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 0 on the hand plate and scratch lines; colour 2 on the mount, housing and hinge; colour 3 on the blade claws and knuckle studs.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Weapon_Cla.differs: The female claws are wider and more flared, with broader blades near the tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Weapon_Tro.description: A right forearm bracer with a pointed, segmented armored shell that carries a long blade-like spike extending past the fist, flanked by two curved fin-like blades. Angular, sharp-edged and sci-fi superhero in style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Weapon_Tro.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main bracer shell; colour 2 on the edge frame and spikes; colour 1 on the two curved side blades; colour 0 on the central long blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Wildfur_01.description: A right forearm bracer made of stacked, overlapping fur tufts that end in sharp curved points, with a smooth plain backing shell on the inner side. It wraps the forearm and gives a feral, wild look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Wildfur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth backing shell and the fur tuft bases; colour 1 on the mid-tuft fur streaks; colour 2 on the darkened tips of the tufts.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Wires_01.description: A right forearm bracer of layered armor plates: a large flat slate panel on the outer forearm, a segmented ribbed section beneath it, and a flared, pointed cuff guard over the wrist, studded with round rivets.
