Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the segmented inner forearm sections; colour 2 on the large slate panel; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracers_Cosmos_01.description: A right-forearm bracer of angular plate: a tall pointed shield-like guard along the outer forearm with a raised rim, ending in a small pentagonal cuff at the wrist. Suggests sleek sci-fi or superhero armour.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracers_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and raised rim; colour 2 on the inner and back panels and the recessed centre of the plate; colour 3 on the thin inset line around the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracers_Cosmos_02.description: A right forearm bracer of glossy plated metal that flares to a pointed peak at the elbow and tapers to a sharp point at the wrist, with a heart-shaped inset panel holding a round gem on the outer face.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracers_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the polished outer plating and edges; colour 1 on the heart-shaped inset panel; colour 3 on the gem; colour 2 on the lower and inner plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracers_Splendor_.description: A right forearm bracer in a superhero style, with a large swept-up fin-like plate at the elbow end, a segmented banded body, pointed claw-like accent spikes down the outer side, and a flared cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracers_Splendor_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the elbow fin plate and the wrist cuff; colour 3 on the pointed accent spikes; colour 0 on the main forearm band; colour 2 on the narrow band between the fin and the main band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracerspikes_01.description: A cluster of short conical spikes studded along the outer side of the right forearm, arranged in staggered rows with the points angled outward and back. A punk, aggressive accent with no band or strap.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Bracerspikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 1 on the shading of the spike bases and undersides.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Arm_Gearbre.description: A curved shield-like plate mounted on the right shoulder and upper arm, with a thick rim of contrasting trim and a boxy contrasting module on the outside. Small octagonal fittings sit at each side; a sci-fi tactical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Arm_Gearbre.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main curved plate; colour 2 on the rim and the boxy module; colour 1 on the octagonal fittings and the module clasp.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Arm_Retro_W.description: A bent tubular metal handle-like bar hanging off the outer right upper arm: a rounded C-shaped loop with squared-off open ends, one end short and angled downward. Suggests a retro, industrial sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Arm_Retro_W.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tube (glossy metal look); colour 1 on the lower end segment of the tube.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Arm_Retro_W.differs: The lower end is a short downward-angled stub that sits close to the tube's bend.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Anni.description: A small faceted metal pod attached to the side of the torso at the right arm, with a rounded angular shell, flat inner face and glowing round indents. It suggests a retro robot look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Anni.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted shell; colour 3 on the round lens indents; the flat inner back is and does not appear to take the scheme.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Aqua.description: A pair of curved, fin-like blades jutting outward from the outer right forearm, one above the other, each tapering to a sharp point. Faceted, aquatic-inspired forearm spikes.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Aqua.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blades; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Aqua.description: A pair of curved, fin-like blades jutting outward from the outer right forearm, one above the other, each tapering to a sharp point toward the wrist. Suggests aquatic or monstrous gauntlet spikes.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Aqua.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blades; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Armo.description: A small angular armor plate that sits on the outer side of the right fist, tapering toward the wrist, with a curved separate rim at the knuckle end. Suggests a blocky armored gauntlet guard.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the curved rim at the knuckle end.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Asce.description: A small flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central ring, sitting on the outer side of the right forearm like a raised badge.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Asce.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin edging around the rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Brut.description: A right forearm bracer of angular, bone-like plates with a jagged flared lower edge, three tall curved spikes rising from the outer edge and a contrasting hooked claw curving off the wrist end. Brutal, monstrous style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Brut.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plates; colour 1 on the three upright spikes and small inset spots; colour 2 on the hooked claw at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Brut.differs: The female version has three upright spikes on the bracer, while the male version shows only two large spikes plus a small third one.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Drac.description: A single curved, blade-like fin or spike attached to the outside of the right forearm, sweeping from a hooked tip near the elbow down to a jagged serrated point by the wrist. Draconic, fantasy styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Drac.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole blade spike; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Game.description: A retro game-controller slab worn on the outer forearm: a flat rectangular pad with a cross-shaped directional button, rows of round buttons, and a curling cable trailing down toward the wrist. Playful and cute.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Game.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the controller body; colour 3 on the cross pad and round buttons; colour 1 on the trailing cable; the back face is a flat neutral panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Goth.description: A small gothic wrist bracer made of a wide, faceted band studded with round knobs, stacked with a thin tilted hoop above and a thin flat ring below. It sits loosely around the right wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Goth.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wide band; colour 3 on the round studs; colour 0 on the upper tilted hoop; colour 2 on the lower ring.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Hamm.description: A chunky hammer-head shaped bracer held in the right fist: a wide blocky head with flared ends at the hand, and two separated padded rounded segments stacked up the forearm above it.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Hamm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large hammer head; colour 1 on the two padded forearm segments.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Kram.description: A heavy chain wound in several loose coils around the right forearm just above the wrist, forming a chunky bracer of overlapping links. Suggests a gritty, rebellious or monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Kram.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole chain; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Mech.description: A long, flat blade-like bracer worn on the right forearm, hanging past the fist and tapering to a point. A bordered frame holds three inset panels, giving it a mechanical, sci-fi shield-blade look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Mech.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame and border; colour 3 on the two long inset panels; colour 2 on the small middle panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Mech.description: A slim, straight rectangular blade-like bar hanging vertically beside the right hand, detached from the wrist. It has a flat outer face with two short inset stripes and a thin edge panel, in a mecha style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Mech.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer body of the bar; colour 0 on the thin edge strip; colour 3 on the two short inset stripes; colour 2 on the inner side panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Mode.description: A right-wrist bracer of angular plate: a thick band around the wrist with a contrasting cuff edge, and a tapered guard that extends down over the back of the hand. Modern armoured, faceted look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Mode.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrist band and cuff; colour 0 on the tapering hand guard and its edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Moth.description: A row of three curved, tapering thorn-like spikes running down the outer side of the right forearm toward the wrist, graduated in size. They look like barbs or claws sprouting from the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Moth.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all three spikes; the glossy default material ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Retr.description: A rotary minigun-style bracer worn on the right forearm: a chunky ribbed barrel housing at the elbow end, a contrasting collar, and a cluster of long parallel barrels with ring clamps extending past the hand. Retro sci-fi weapon look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed housing and top cap; colour 2 on the collar band and the side plate; colour 0 on the barrels and clamp rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Retr.description: A segmented, ribbed flexible tube-like arm attachment that starts at a boxy cuff on the upper right arm and arcs up and across the chest, with stacked spiky ridges along its length. Suggests a retro sci-fi cyborg look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Retr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy cuff and the metallic segment bodies; colour 1 on the ridge tips along the top of the segments; colour 2 on the underside of the cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Sand.description: A small angular bracer worn on the right forearm: a faceted, shield-like plate on the outer side of the arm, pointed at the wrist end, held by a thick band that wraps around the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Sand.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer plate; colour 2 on the wrap-around band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Shie.description: A heater-style heraldic shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm, with a notched top edge, a pointed lower end, a raised rim, a central diagonal panel and an ornate fleur-like crest. The back has two grip slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and upper field; colour 1 on the central diagonal panel; colour 3 on the ornate crest; colour 2 on the rim and back.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Swan.description: A feathery, ruffled cuff that wraps around the right fist and wrist, with a flat top opening and a jagged, pointed lower edge of layered plumage-like tufts. Suggests a swan-feather bracer with a fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Swan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather tufts, fading toward colour 1 at the tips and on the flat top surface.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syri.description: A mechanical forearm-and-hand rig: a cylindrical wrist housing feeds bundled tubes to needle-like syringe spikes over the knuckles, while looping hoses run up the arm to canisters and small nozzle fittings.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syri.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist housing, canisters and fittings; colour 1 on the needle tips and small tube connectors; colour 3 on the hoses; colour 2 on the syringe barrels.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syri.differs: The female version has three syringe needles over the knuckles, slightly fewer than the male.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syri.description: A cyberpunk forearm rig on the right wrist: a cylindrical manifold on the back of the hand feeds flexible tubes to four needle-tipped syringe claws over the knuckles, with two more tubes running up the forearm to capped canisters.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syri.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the manifold, canister caps and syringe housings; colour 3 on the tubes; colour 1 on the needles and small connector caps; colour 2 on the syringe bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Vict.description: A slim, V-shaped open bracer worn on the right upper forearm, with a swept-back winged fin at each end and layered stripes along the edge. Reads as a sleek, angular superhero armband.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Vict.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wing-like fins; colour 1 on the middle stripe band; colour 2 on the lower edge layer.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Weap.description: A pair of long, flat, tapering claw blades that project downward from the right fist, side by side, each curving to a sharp point with a notched edge. Suggests a feral, beast-like weapon.

A right-forearm bracer blade: a long, narrow central spike extending well past the wrist, flanked by two swept-back angular fins on either side. Sleek, sharp and sci-fi in style, worn along the outside of the forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Weap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central blade spike; colour 1 on the flanking fins; colour 2 on the underside edge of the blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Wire.description: A small curved armor plate that wraps the outer side of the right wrist like a short cuff, with pointed, swept corners, a thin rim and two round studs; the inside is hollow and open.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Wire.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 3 on the two studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracers_Cos.description: A small angular shield-shaped bracer plate worn on the outer right wrist and forearm, with a raised pentagonal centre, layered inset borders and a notched pointed top edge; the back is a plain flat panel.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracers_Cos.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised centre and outer rim; colour 3 on the inset border line; colour 2 on the flat underside and inner edging; colour 1 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A set of long curved blades that hang beside the right forearm and hand, like a bracer of swept, jagged fins. The blades taper to sharp points well below the fist, with serrated edges and a fantasy, monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner blade faces and ridges; colour 1 on the outer blade edges and fins; colour 2 on the darker inner recesses and serrations.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.differs: The female version shows three or so layered, more jagged blades with extra serrations along the back edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A long, thin blade-like shard of psionic energy attached beside the right forearm, flaring near the wrist and tapering to a sharp point well below the hand. Its surface shows veined, crackled patterns.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: The whole blade shows a glowing crackled energy surface that appears to ignore the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A long, thin psionic blade projecting from the right forearm and sweeping down past the knee: a narrow, tapering shard with a faceted, cracked surface and a wider base near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 across the whole blade; the glassy, glowing default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a small central ring, floating beside the right wrist and seen face-on only from the side. It reads as a thin outline badge with a sci-fi look.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A thin, flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating just outside the right forearm near the wrist like a shield badge. It is seen edge-on from front and back.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating beside the right forearm near the wrist and seen edge-on from the front. It suggests a science or energy theme.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Brace.description: A set of three long, slightly curved blade claws extending from the right fist past the knuckles, side by side like retractable talons, tapering to sharp points. A fantasy-superhero weapon look with no visible straps or bracer.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Retro.description: A thin, curved translucent glass-like panel on the outer forearm of the right arm, a small flat shard that sits just above the wrist. Sleek retro sci-fi accent.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Clockwork_Armor_0.description: A tapered angular armour bracer on the right forearm: a wedge-shaped outer shell with layered plates, a small flared cap near the elbow and an open muzzle-like end with a small inner detail at the wrist. Sci-fi gauntlet look.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Clockwork_Armor_0.differs: The female version has a small contrasting inner detail visible at the open wrist end, and a slightly more closed, tapered end.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Cybermind_01_1.description: A rounded, cup-shaped armored bracer on the right forearm with a thick ribbed flexible cable rising from its rim, running up the outside of the arm to a small metal connector near the shoulder.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Feathers_01.description: A single layered feathered wing hanging along the right side of the torso from the shoulder to below the hip, with rows of overlapping feathers that lengthen into long pointed tips at the lower end.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.description: A single curved blade claw gripped in the right fist, jutting out below the knuckles. A small angled hilt with a contrasting grip and a finned guard sits at the top of the hand. Suggests a cyber assassin look.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.differs: The blade on the female version extends further past the fist and its hilt sits higher on the hand.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.description: A single long, curved blade claw held in the right fist, sweeping forward past the knuckles to a thin point, anchored by thin rod-like struts and small block mounts at the wrist. Sleek cybernetic weapon look.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.differs: The blade points forward from the fist and is held more horizontally, whereas the male blade sweeps upward and back.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.description: A single long curved blade held in the right fist, a tapered, slightly bent claw that sweeps forward past the knuckles, with a small contrasting grip block and thin rod struts at the hand. Sci-fi weapon style.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.differs: The blade points forward and angles slightly outward from the fist, rather than sweeping up along the forearm as on the male.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_04.description: A single curved cyber blade held in the right fist: a long, flat, tapering metal claw that sweeps down past the hand to a hooked point, with a small hilt and thin rod-like struts at the grip.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_05.description: A single long, slender curved blade held in the right hand, tapering to a sharp point beyond the fist, with thin rod-like grip supports and small tabs bracing it against the palm. Cyber-weapon style.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cybershard_0.description: A single tapering blade-like shard held in the right fist, with a blocky faceted base at the knuckles and a long sharp point angling down past the hand. Suggests a cybernetic claw or knife.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cybershard_0.description: A single long, slender curved blade that projects from the right fist. It is a faceted, tapering metal shard with a flared base at the knuckles, and it sweeps forward to a sharp point. The look is cybernetic.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Gem_05.description: A chunky signet-style ring with a faceted, angular band and a wide, flat square-cut gem setting on top, worn on a finger of the right hand. Bold, jewel-like accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Gem_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band and the base of the setting; colour 1 on the raised rim around the gem; colour 3 on the underside of the gem; colour 2 on the gem mount.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.description: A small faceted band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with a chunky heart-shaped gem set on the front in a contrasting bezel, topped by a tiny loop or bail.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 3 on the heart gem; colour 2 on the bezel behind the heart; colour 1 on the small loop atop the heart.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.description: A slim faceted metal ring band worn on a finger of the right hand, topped with a small heart-shaped gem setting on a small base with tiny decorative accents at its side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band and setting rim; colour 3 on the heart gem; colour 1 on the small accent details beside the setting; colour 2 on the base under the gem.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.description: A small ring worn on a finger of the right hand: a faceted, slightly polygonal band topped with a small heart-shaped gem setting and a tiny contrasting accent tucked at its base.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 3 on the heart stone; colour 1 on the small accent beneath the setting; colour 2 on the small mount under the heart.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.description: A small faceted band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, topped with a chunky heart-shaped stone in a small setting with tiny leaf-like prongs at its base.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band and setting prongs; colour 3 on the heart stone; colour 1 on the small accent tabs beside the setting; colour 2 on the thin base under the stone.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.description: A small faceted band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, topped with a flat heart-shaped setting and a tiny accent tab beneath it. Simple, decorative jewellery with a slightly angular polygonal band.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Heart_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 3 on the heart setting; colour 1 on the small accent tab; colour 2 on the thin base plate under the heart.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.description: A chunky faceted ring band worn on a right-hand finger, with a small skull set on the front of the band. The skull has glowing eye sockets and a contrasting jaw, giving a gothic biker look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 1 on the skull and the band section behind it; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the jaw tip.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.description: A chunky faceted band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with a small skull set on the outer side. The skull has hollow eye sockets, a jaw and a glowing gem-like eye. Gothic, biker-style jewellery.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the skull and the lower part of the band; colour 3 on the eye glint; colour 2 on the skull's teeth and jaw.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.description: A chunky faceted band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with a small skull set on its front face; the skull has hollow eye sockets and a jagged toothed jaw.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 1 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the teeth.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.description: A chunky ring worn on the right hand, with a faceted band that flares into a small skull front with eye sockets and a toothed jaw. A gothic, biker-style hand accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band and skull crown; colour 1 on the lower skull face and jaw; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the teeth.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.description: A chunky band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with a small carved skull set on the outer face. The skull has contrasting eye sockets and a toothed jaw. Suggests a gothic or biker look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 1 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the teeth.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled in about two and a half loops around a finger of the right hand, with a tapered tail tip curling up and a small contrasting head hanging down.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the snake's head.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled in two loops around a finger of the right hand, with a tapering tail tip trailing out and a small blunt head at the other end.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the snake's head.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled two or three times around a finger of the right hand, with a tapering tail tip curling out and a small head at one end.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the snake's head.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled in two loops around a finger of the right hand, with a tapering tail end trailing loose and a tiny head at the other end.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the snake's head.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled in two loops around a finger of the right hand, with a tapering tail tip trailing out and a small contrasting head at one end.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the small head.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.description: A small faceted ring with a slim angular band and a pointed shield-shaped bezel holding a round cut stone, worn on a finger of the right hand as a simple fantasy jewel accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the shield-shaped bezel; colour 3 on the central stone.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.description: A small angular ring worn on a finger of the right hand: a slim faceted band that widens into a flat, triangular stone-like setting on the palm side, with a shallow inset on the face.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the outer facets of the setting; colour 3 on the inset centre of the setting.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.description: A chunky faceted ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with an angular band and a flat, wedge-shaped stone setting on top, giving a rough carved-stone signet look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the outer faces of the stone setting; colour 3 on the top of the stone.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.description: A chunky faceted ring band with angular, chiselled edges and a flat pointed stone setting that projects below the band, worn on a finger of the right hand. Suggests a carved, fantasy signet style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 1 on the outer faces of the stone setting; colour 3 on the inner face of the stone.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.description: A small faceted band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with a flared angular setting on one side holding a pointed stone with a contrasting centre. Chunky, fantasy jewellery styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the outer facets of the stone setting; colour 3 on the stone centre.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Holohexarmor_01.description: A bulky angular forearm bracer of layered armor plates that wraps the right forearm, with two upswept horn-like spikes at the elbow end, a pointed tab toward the wrist, small rivets and a round sensor port.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Holohexarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main armor plates; colour 2 on the spikes and inset vent panels; colour 3 on the small round sensor light.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Inmate_01.description: A wide padded cuff worn around the right wrist, with a single length of chain hanging from it down past the hip. Suggests a prisoner's shackle or restraint look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cuff; colour 2 on the hanging chain.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Lockbox_67_01.description: A tapered, closed sleeve-like arm piece hanging along the right side of the torso, starting angular at the shoulder and ending in a ruffled, gathered flare with a small pendant tassel dangling below.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole sleeve body and ruffled flare; colour 0 on the small hanging tassel.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A small angular shell-like shoulder-arm accessory of faceted plates that curves around the outside of the upper right arm, with a jagged fin-like point at the top and a tapering lower tip.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faceted plates, which take a glossy metallic finish; colour 1 on the inner lining edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_01.description: A single right shoulder accessory made of overlapping angular feather-like blades with veined patterning, sweeping down and outward from the top of the shoulder in sharp points. Suggests a raven-wing pauldron in a contrasting fantasy style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blade surfaces; colour 1 on the vein lines running along each feather blade.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_01.differs: The blades hang more downward along the upper arm, pointing toward the elbow.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_02.description: A right forearm bracer shaped like a tapering flared cuff with several tall pointed petal-like fins rising toward the elbow. A small round medallion sits on the outer wrist, with thin trim along the cuff edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main bracer body and petal points; colour 2 on the round medallion; colour 1 on the thin trim line at the cuff edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A chunky right forearm bracer in an ancient-Egyptian style: a slightly flared tube with a flat rim, banded panels and an angular guard plate that extends over the back of the hand toward the knuckles.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panels and the hand guard; colour 1 on the rim, the lower band and the guard's upper edge; colour 2 on the main forearm panel; colour 3 on a small accent at the rim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Spikes_01.description: A cluster of small conical spikes of varied sizes jutting outward from the right upper arm, arranged in a loose ring pattern with no base plate. Suggests a punk or monstrous arm accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Steelarachnid_01.description: A segmented metal bracer for the right forearm with angular armor plates and a pointed spike at the elbow. A long curved blade-like talon extends past the hand, giving a menacing spider-leg look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer plates; colour 1 on the thin chevron stripes across the forearm; colour 2 on the inner rim and cuff opening; colour 3 on the long curved blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Strapsfeathers_01.description: Two thin strap bands wrap around the right upper arm, with a fan of about eight long, narrow feather blades sprouting from the outer side and pointing up toward the shoulder. Tribal, decorative armband styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Strapsfeathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two straps; colour 1 on the main body of the feathers; colour 3 on the feather edges and inner shading.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Strapsfeathers_01.differs: The female version has a larger fan of about eight longer feathers, while the male version has only three.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.description: A chunky armband worn on the upper right arm: a segmented band with angular panels, a buttoned pouch on the outer side and a row of cylindrical ammo shells held in loops. Suggests a 90s tactical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the pouch and corner clips; colour 2 on the side blocks and trim; colour 3 on the shell tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_.description: A chunky faceted armband worn around the upper right arm, with an octagonal band shape, a raised contrasting stripe along the top edge and small round dimples on the outer surface. Suits a retro superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the top stripe edging and inner trim; colour 3 on the raised panel at the top; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Pouch_.description: A bandolier-style band circling the upper right arm, lined with rows of upright bullet cartridges pointing downward, with a small buttoned flap pouch on the outer side. Tactical, military look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Pouch_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the pouch; colour 1 on the cartridge casings; colour 3 on the piping and edge trim; colour 2 on the bullet tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Angel_Armba.description: A short, faceted armband worn around the upper right arm: an angular multi-sided band with a raised rim and layered horizontal stripes plus a thin cross line on the outer side. Suggests armored superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Angel_Armba.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 2 on the main band; colour 0 on the lower stripe and side panels; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arcane_Armb.description: A chunky faceted armband worn on the right upper arm: a broad octagonal band with contrasting rims at top and bottom, swirling tendril-like engraved patterns and rounded gem studs spaced around it. Arcane, fantasy styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arcane_Armb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the gem studs; colour 2 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the swirling engraved designs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Card_01.description: A gathered armband worn around the upper right arm, with ruffled frilly edges and a wide contrasting central band. Two playing cards tuck into the top edge and stick up like a magician's or gambler's accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Card_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled edges and inner lining; colour 1 on the wide central band; colour 3 on the playing cards; colour 2 on the card suit markings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Cyber_C.description: A small cylindrical canister strapped to the outside of the upper arm, with a bent pipe rising from the top and a curved nozzle with a flared cap hanging below. Reads as a cyber-western gadget.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Cyber_C.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the canister body; colour 0 on the pipe, nozzle and cap tips.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Martial.description: A segmented martial arm guard worn on the upper right arm: a curved shell of stacked horizontal plates with contrasting edging, open at the inner side, over wrapped cloth bands, with small knotted cords at the top.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Martial.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate segments; colour 2 on the plate edging and dividing bands; colour 1 on the wrapped cloth underneath; colour 3 on the knotted cords.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Martial.description: A curved, open-sided armour band wrapping the right upper arm, built from stacked horizontal overlapping plates with a raised contrasting edge frame and small looped cord ties at the top corners. Martial, samurai-style look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Martial.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 1 on the plate bands' lighter overlapping surfaces; colour 2 on the edge frame and plate divider lines; colour 3 on the looped cord ties.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Toy_01.description: A wide armband worn high on the right upper arm: a flat, angular badge plate with a raised heart outline on the outer side, framed by a bordered rim, joined to a soft band that wraps around the arm and overlaps at the inner side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat badge face; colour 1 on the rim around the badge; colour 2 on the raised heart outline; colour 3 on the wrapping band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armarmor_01.description: A short armored band worn around the right upper arm: a rimmed cuff with large rounded plates front and back, segmented ribbed panels along the sides, and a raised trim edge at top and bottom.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band body; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim trim; colour 2 on the large rounded plates; colour 3 on the segmented side panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armband_01.description: A folded cloth bandana tied around the upper right arm, with rumpled creases and a knot on the outer side whose two pointed tails hang down. A simple casual or street armband.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armband_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole armband cloth, including the knot and tails.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armband_Med.description: A slim armband worn high on the right upper arm, with three upright cylindrical vials held side by side in a strap-like panel on the outer face. Suggests a medic or chemist look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armband_Med.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the strap panel holding the vials; colour 3 on the vial bodies; colour 2 on the vial caps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandchai.description: A chunky, faceted band worn snugly around the upper right arm, with a flat disc-shaped cap on the outer face and small screw-head fittings with tiny loops at each side. Suggests a sci-fi restraint or gadget cuff.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandchai.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim of the band; colour 1 on the lower band body; colour 3 on the flat cap face and inner lining; colour 2 on the screw fittings and loops.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandtied.description: A thin cloth armband wrapped around the right upper arm and tied in a small knot on the outer side, with two short pointed tails hanging down. Simple, casual and slightly rough in style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandtied.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band, knot and tails; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandwing.description: A slim armband wrapped around the right upper arm, made of two open-ended strap sections, with a tall curved spike-like wing blade sweeping upward from the outer side. Angular, demonic fantasy accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandwing.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and wing surfaces; colour 1 on the edge trim and outlines of the band and wing.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandwing.description: A slim open-front armband wrapped around the upper right arm, with a single flat curved blade-like wing fin sweeping outward and up from its outer side. Worn as a small superhero-style arm accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandwing.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 2 on the band's edge trim and the fin's stripe lines; colour 3 on the wing fin.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armor_Extra.description: A right forearm bracer of weathered, chunky plate with carved spiral glyph lines, a flared cuff at the wrist end and a raised fin-like scoop at the elbow end, plus a separate open ring band higher on the upper arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armor_Extra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the carved glyph lines and inner scoop; colour 2 on the worn edges and chipped patches.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorbasic_.description: A tapered, angular forearm bracer with a faceted open cuff, recessed slots on the outer face, chevron-style vents near the wrist and thin trim lines. Sits over the right forearm in a sleek sci-fi armor style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorbasic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 1 on the inner lining and the small recessed slots on the front; colour 3 on the paired slots on the back and side; colour 2 on the wrist vents.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_.description: A right forearm bracer of angular armored plates, with a flared, open-fronted upper cuff, raised pointed fins at the elbow end and small indicator marks near the wrist. Tech-armor style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the pointed fins and small inset accents; colour 3 on the small indicator marks; colour 2 on the inner lining.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_.differs: The female bracer has a more open, cut-away front with a deeper hollow, while the male one is closed more fully around the forearm.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armpouch_01.description: A chunky faceted band worn around the upper right arm, with a small rectangular pouch plate on the outer side holding two raised vertical panels. Compact, utilitarian look suited to tactical or sci-fi outfits.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armpouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and pouch frame; colour 1 on the two raised panels and on the patches at the band's sides.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armpouch_01.differs: The female band is a thicker, deeper cuff with a solid faceted body, while the male version is a thin flat strap.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armtrumpkni.description: A small band wrapped around the right elbow with a round, slightly domed disc standing out from its outer side like a shield. The disc has a contrasting central stripe and a small rectangular accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armtrumpkni.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the elbow band and disc rim; colour 1 on the disc face; colour 2 on the central stripe across the disc; colour 3 on the small rectangular accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armtrumpkni.differs: The female disc has a plain face with a broad central stripe and a small rectangular accent, while the male disc has a six-spoke star pattern.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bicepknife_.description: A combat knife strapped to the right upper arm: a thin faceted band circles the bicep and holds a straight, tapering blade with a crossguard and handle, pointing downward along the outer arm. Tactical, street-ready look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bicepknife_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm band; colour 3 on the blade; colour 2 on the handle and crossguard.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Birdpeople_.description: A small chunky band worn around the right upper arm, with a faceted, rock-like outer shell that bulges to a low angular plate on the outside of the arm. Suggests a crude tribal or fantasy armband.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Birdpeople_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole band; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Birdpeople_.differs: The female version has a flatter, more clearly faceted top plate, while the male version has a smoother, more domed top.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bolts_01.description: A pair of small hex-headed bolts with round studded shafts, attached to the outer upper arm as tiny mechanical rivets. They read as an industrial, sci-fi detail rather than a garment.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bolts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hex heads and shafts; colour 1 and colour 3 on the thin rings where the bolt heads meet the shafts.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bolts_01.differs: The female version shows small contrasting and contrasting accent rings on the bolt heads, while the male version is a single uniform colour.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Alie.description: A tight right forearm bracer of segmented alien armor: a raised plated cuff at the elbow end with a curved horn and small spikes, banded stripes down the forearm, and a smooth rounded panel along the outer back of the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Alie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the stripe bands; colour 2 on the alternating stripe bands between them; colour 1 on the smooth outer back panel; colour 3 on the horn and spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Amaz.description: A tapered right forearm bracer with layered, overlapping angled plates that wrap the forearm, a raised pointed fin at the elbow end with a geometric pattern, and a pointed flared cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Amaz.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the layered outer plates and wrist trim; colour 0 on the inner lining and the metallic lower panel; colour 2 on the inner shell and the elbow fin; colour 3 on the fin edge and its geometric pattern.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Ange.description: A smooth, tapered forearm bracer that flares slightly toward the elbow, with a thick faceted rim at the upper edge and a thin trim at the wrist. Sits on the right forearm; clean, sleek superhero armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Ange.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the thick upper rim and the wrist trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Ange.description: A tapered tube bracer worn on the right forearm, with a banded rim at each end and a large angular, cross-shaped armor plate jutting from the outer side. Suggests a chunky angelic superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Ange.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer tube; colour 1 on the rim bands at both ends; colour 3 on the angular outer plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Ange.description: A short tapered forearm bracer with contrasting trim bands at both rims and a tall curved, swept-back blade fin rising from the outer edge of the forearm. Angelic, armored look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Ange.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer body; colour 1 on the rim bands at the wrist and elbow ends; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Ange.description: A right forearm bracer, a short tapered cuff with thin contrasting bands at both ends. A stepped angular plate on the outer side carries a long curved scythe-like blade that sweeps forward and down past the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Ange.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff; colour 1 on the rim bands at both ends; colour 3 on the stepped side plate; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Anni.description: A soft, loose-fitting cloth glove-bracer covering the forearm and back of the hand, with a folded top edge and a stiff separate cuff panel along the outer hand edge fastened with three round studs. Retro superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Anni.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm and hand sleeve; colour 1 on the side cuff panel; colour 2 on the studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Arca.description: A tight forearm bracer with a tapered, angular shell decorated with swirling scrollwork and two gem-like inset stones, flaring into a pointed fin-like spike at the back of the wrist. Worn on the right forearm in a mystic fantasy style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Arca.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 3 on the swirling scroll patterns; colour 1 on the gem-like inset stones; colour 2 on the pointed rear flare and edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Arch.description: A right-arm archer bracer made of three separate faceted rings: a loose band on the upper arm, plus a forearm guard with a tall panel down the outer side and a ring near the wrist. Sits over the sleeve.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Arch.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and outer edges; colour 1 on the forearm guard panel; colour 2 on the inner band and guard sections; colour 3 on a thin accent strip on the guard.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Band.description: A right forearm bracer of overlapping bandage strips wound in a spiral from wrist to below the elbow, with contrasting stitch-like marks across the wraps; a rough, improvised street or fighter look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Band.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some of the wrap strips; colour 1 on alternating wrap strips; colour 3 on other wrap strips; colour 2 on the stitch marks.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blas.description: A large, angular armored bracer that wraps the right forearm and flares over the wrist, built from faceted plates with a raised fin-like ridge at the elbow end and inset stripe panels. Suggests a superhero or sci-fi blaster gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blas.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer plates; colour 0 on the inset stripes and edge panels; colour 3 on the inner side and rear rim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blas.description: A chunky angular right-forearm bracer housing a cluster of blaster barrels at the wrist end, with faceted armored plates, a raised fin-like ridge on top and a striped side panel. Sci-fi superhero gauntlet worn over the forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blas.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main faceted armor shell; colour 0 on the stripes, the ridge inserts and the inner edge panel; colour 3 on the underside and back edge panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blas.description: A sci-fi armored bracer for the right forearm: a faceted, angular shell with a hollowed scalloped opening along the inner side, a raised pointed fin at the elbow end, and small vent-like slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the pointed fin and small accent tabs; colour 3 on the small slot marks; colour 2 on the inner recess.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blas.description: A bulky sci-fi blaster bracer covering the right forearm: a smooth angular shell with a vented panel, small indicator lights and a hazard-striped muzzle, plus a cylindrical tank with a curved carry handle along the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and tank bands; colour 1 on the tank, muzzle barrels, handle and vent housing; colour 3 on the small indicator lights; colour 2 on the hazard stripe details.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Bloc.description: A chunky right forearm bracer with angular plated shell that tapers toward the wrist, a rounded cap of contrasting material at the elbow end, and two octagonal round-lensed studs on the outer side. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Bloc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main angular shell; colour 1 on the rounded upper cap; colour 2 on the octagonal housings; colour 3 on the round lens centres.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Bloc.differs: The female bracer has a closed, slightly hollow-looking top cap, while the male cap shows a flat light insert on top.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Bloc.description: A chunky, flared forearm bracer worn on the right arm: a tapered armored shell that widens toward the elbow, with recessed contrasting panels holding small oval emblems and a narrow cuff band at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Bloc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 1 on the wrist cuff band; colour 2 on the recessed inner panels; colour 3 on the oval emblem details.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw.description: A chunky right forearm bracer made of two stitched, baseball-like cuffs joined by a central panel, with a rivet and long blade-like claws sweeping down past the wrist along the outer edge. Sporty street look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuffs and outer bracer shell; colour 1 on the central panel strips; colour 3 on the stitching; colour 2 on the claw blades and rivet.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw.description: A right forearm bracer made of two stitched, segmented cuffs joined by straps, with a pair of long, narrow blades attached at the wrist that extend well past the hand. Suits a fantasy or sci-fi fighter.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff bands and the blades; colour 1 on the vertical straps and panels between the cuffs; colour 3 on the stitching; colour 2 on the small pivot fittings.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw.differs: The female claw blades are longer, extending well past the hand, and are the same colour as the cuffs, whereas the male blades are shorter and near black.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw.description: A serpentine dragon coiled around the right forearm, its spined body spiralling from elbow to wrist, ending in a horned dragon head at the hand with a pair of long curved serrated blade claws extending past the fist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the dragon body and head; colour 2 on the spines and ridges along the coils; colour 0 on the blade claws; colour 3 on the flame-like markings along the blades.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw.description: A right forearm bracer shaped like a thorny organic claw: a curled, vine-like frame wraps a ridged central panel studded with contrasting thorns, and a long serrated blade extends past the wrist and hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curled frame, the serrated blade and the outer rim; colour 3 on the ridged central panel; colour 0 on the thorns.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Coil.description: A helical metal coil bracer wrapping about three and a half turns around the right forearm near the wrist, tapering to pointed ends at top and bottom. Simple, open spiral that suits sci-fi or tribal looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Coil.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole coil; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cuff.description: A ruffled lace cuff worn around the right wrist: layered, flared scalloped rings with openwork floral cutouts fan out from the wrist like a doily. Delicate, frilly and feminine in style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cuff.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main lace layers; colour 2 on the underside and shadowed inner layer of the ruffle.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cybe.description: A right forearm bracer of thick, slightly curved plates with raised edges and round rivets. A pointed lower plate in a contrasting shade overlaps the wrist. A western-flavoured, sci-fi armoured cuff.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cybe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer plate; colour 3 on the lower wrist plate; colour 1 on the rivets; colour 2 on the edge trim and inner shell.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cybe.description: A right forearm bracer made of two separate angular plates that wrap the arm, one carrying three long curved spikes on its outer face, with small rivets on the second plate. Rugged western cyber style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cybe.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plate bodies and edges; colour 3 on the three spikes; colour 1 on the small rivets or studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Drag.description: A serpentine eastern dragon coiled in a loose spiral around the right forearm, with a ridged back, a belly of segmented scale bands with tooth-like markings, and a spiny horned head resting near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Drag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belly scales and head; colour 1 on the ridged back and head fins; colour 3 on the tooth-like belly markings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Drag.description: A serpentine dragon coiled in a tight spiral around the right forearm, with a ridged back, a banded underbelly with small tooth-like markings, and a spiny, finned dragon head resting at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Drag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belly bands and the head; colour 1 on the ridged back, fins and head crests; colour 3 on the tooth-like markings along the belly.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Dray.description: A rigid armored bracer worn on the right forearm, with riveted plates edged in trim and a sculpted snarling monster face with fangs, curved claw-like tusks and a big open mouth on the outer side. Gothic and monstrous.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Dray.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and the face; colour 1 on the edge trim and plate borders; colour 3 on the eyes and the inside of the mouth; colour 2 on the tusks.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feat.description: A slim armored bracer worn on the right forearm, with a sweeping fan of layered feathers rising from its top edge and pointing back and up past the elbow. Winged, fantasy-flavoured arm accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feat.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the bracer plate and its edge details; colour 2 on the short inner feathers; colour 3 on the long outer feathers.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feat.description: A wrist-mounted wing gauntlet: a cuff at the wrist with a sleek plated forearm base, from which a fan of long, sharp blade-like feathers sweeps back past the elbow. Sci-fi, angular and armour-like.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feat.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 0 on the plated base; colour 2 on the feather blades; colour 3 on the small marks on the base.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feat.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a curved outer plate and a fan of pointed feather blades along its upper edge. Three wrap-around bands with small tabs hold it to the forearm, giving a tribal, fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather blades, bands and plate rim; colour 1 on the large oval panel and feather tips; colour 2 on the central stripe of the plate; colour 3 on the small tabs at the band ends.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Fin_.description: A small fin-shaped bracer attached to the outer side of the right forearm: a tapered mottled panel with three curved, backswept blade-like spines along its edge and a thin contrasting rim. Alien, organic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Fin_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled panel body; colour 3 on the spots on the panel; colour 1 on the spines and edge rim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Fin_.description: A small fin-shaped bracer attachment on the outer right forearm: a flared, tapering panel with three swept-back curved spikes and a mottled spotted surface, giving a monstrous, aquatic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Fin_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mottled fin panel; colour 3 on the spots; colour 1 on the spike fins and edge trim; colour 2 on the shaded creases.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gadr.description: A curved, open-backed shield plate that wraps the outside of the right forearm, with a smooth glossy surface etched with circuit-like line patterns. It reads as a sleek sci-fi gauntlet panel.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gadr.colourAreas: The glossy metallic material ignores the colour scheme; the plate and its etched circuit lines show the default sheen rather than any slot colour.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gadr.description: A large teardrop-shaped shield blade floating beside the right forearm, a smooth translucent shell that tapers to a sharp point above the elbow and ends in a blunt rounded base at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gadr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; the material looks glassy and largely ignores the colour scheme, with only a faint warm tint along the edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gold.description: A short tapered bracer worn on the right forearm, flaring wider at the elbow end. It is built from vertical panels separated by thin dividing lines, with thick rimmed bands at both ends. The look is classic superhero.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gold.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top and bottom rim bands and the panel dividing lines; colour 1 on the alternating vertical panels; colour 0 on the remaining vertical panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gold.description: A round patriotic-style shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm by a short cuff band. It has a rim, a raised central disc and a large protruding five-pointed star; the back is a plain smooth dish.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gold.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield rim and dish; colour 3 on the central disc; colour 1 on the star; colour 2 on the forearm cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gold.description: A small round buckler-style shield strapped to the right forearm by a short chunky cuff, with a domed face bearing an atom emblem and a thick rim. It sits off the outer forearm, a superhero golden-age look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gold.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shield face; colour 0 on the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and back of the shield; colour 3 on the forearm cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Hamm.description: A bulky armoured right glove and forearm bracer: segmented cuff bands with rounded padded blocks and small round vents, ending in a fingered gauntlet with a large angular slab hammer-head fixed at the fist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Hamm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm core, the hammer head and the wrist rim; colour 1 on the padded cuff blocks and the finger plates; colour 2 on the small round vents.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Hamm.description: A right-forearm bracer of two stacked octagonal metal rings with small round side ports, each backed by a padded cushion, ending in a large boxy hammer-like block that covers the fist and wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Hamm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and the hammer block; colour 1 on the padded cushions; colour 2 on the round ports and gaps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Holo.description: A floating cluster of jagged, hexagonal energy shards that trails along the outside of the right forearm, with a larger burst near the elbow and a smaller one by the wrist. It does not wrap the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Holo.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to cover the whole field of shards; the glowing material seems to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Mart.description: A tight, tubular forearm bracer worn on the right arm, with criss-crossing wrapped straps across the front and back and contrasting trim bands at both edges. Suggests a martial arts look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Mart.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 2 on the crossing straps; colour 1 on the trim bands at the rim and cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Mart.description: A tapered martial-arts bracer worn on the right forearm, flaring wider at the elbow end, with a padded rolled rim at both ends and a T-shaped angular plate inlay down the outer face.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Mart.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leather bracer body; colour 1 on the rolled rims at both ends; colour 2 on the angular T-shaped plates; colour 3 on the inset wedge within the T-plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Mech.description: A tapered armored bracer for the right forearm with a flared rolled rim at the elbow end, slotted vents down the front, thin channel lines, and a perforated raised panel with a boxy contrasting block at the back.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Mech.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell and rim; colour 3 on the front vent slots and thin channel lines; colour 1 on the perforated back panel; colour 2 on the boxy block and inner opening.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A tapered forearm bracer of segmented armored panels with a raised, open flared cup at the elbow end and a thin cuff ring at the wrist. Contrasting piping outlines the panels, with a round stud and a small tab on the sides.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared cup and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the main armor panels; colour 1 on the piping between panels; colour 3 on the round stud and the small side tab.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A chunky armoured bracer for the right forearm, flaring at the elbow end with a rounded cuff. Octagonal discs with concentric rings sit on each side, and a segmented ribbed panel runs down the outer edge. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and cuff edges; colour 1 on the inset panels beside the ribbing; colour 2 on the segmented ribbed strip; colour 3 on the disc centres.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A set of three long, narrow blade claws that extend past the knuckles of the right fist, mounted on a slim wrist bracer. Each blade is flat and tapers to a sharp point, in a superhero berserker style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade edges and bracer rims; colour 1 on the flat faces of the blades; colour 2 on the darker back and inner surfaces.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A small rectangular armor plate worn on the outer right forearm near the wrist, held by two contrasting straps with buckle tabs. The plate has a raised rim and chevron ridges, giving a compact sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate rim and chevron ridges; colour 1 on the recessed plate panels; colour 2 on the two straps and the back of the plate; colour 3 on the strap buckles.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.description: A right forearm bracer of angular, spiked armor plating with a flared, jagged cuff, inset chevron-patterned panels, and two long curved blades sweeping past the hand. Sits over the forearm with a dark, menacing feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the long blades and edge trim; colour 3 on the chevron inset panels; colour 2 on the recessed gaps and slots.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nigh.differs: The blades are shorter and hang more steeply from the bracer, while the plating is slightly smaller.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Part.description: A thin beaded bracelet worn loosely around the right wrist, made of a ring of chunky faceted, lumpy beads in four alternating segments; a casual, playful accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Part.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one bead segment; colour 1 on another bead segment; colour 2 on a third bead segment; colour 3 on the fourth bead segment.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psii.description: A short wrist bracer with a tall, curved blade-like fin sweeping up and back from the outer forearm, with two narrow slits in the fin and a veined, crackled surface. Suggests a psionic, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psii.colourAreas: The whole bracer shows mostly the default surface with a web-like vein pattern; the colour scheme has little visible effect, so colour 0 is the likeliest slot for the main body.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psis.description: A right forearm bracer with a short cuff around the forearm and a long, thin curved blade sweeping down past the hand, with veined, crackling energy texture across it. Suggests a psychic blade.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psis.colourAreas: The default material appears to be glowing and ignores the colour scheme; the whole cuff and blade show as one glowing surface.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psis.description: A slim bracer worn on the right forearm with a long, tapering blade-like crystalline shard extending down past the hip toward the knee. The surface shows fractured, veined facets, giving an energy-blade look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psis.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer cuff and blade; the crystalline material shows veining and appears to ignore the other slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Quag.description: A forearm bracer made of thick, tangled vine-like tendrils wrapped densely around the right forearm, with ragged loose ends sticking out at the edges. Organic, overgrown and swampy in style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Quag.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the outer tangled strands; colour 0 on the thick central wrapped strands; colour 2 on the shadowed inner strands on the back of the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Quag.description: A tangled bracer of interwoven vine-like tendrils and thin fibrous strands wrapped densely around the right forearm, with loose frayed ends sticking out. Wild, organic and overgrown in style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Quag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick wrapped inner strands; colour 1 on the loose outer tendrils and frayed tips; colour 2 on a few shadowed strands in the tangle.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Robo.description: A chunky sci-fi forearm bracer with a rounded, tapering shell and a small pointed spike at the top. Three raised slot vents and a round sensor sit on the front, and angled fin blades project from the sides. It sits over the right forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Robo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the fin blades; colour 3 on the slot vents and the circuit line details; colour 2 on the small sensor and rivet dots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Rock.description: A chunky right-forearm bracer built from stacked, cracked rock slabs with glowing seams between them, topped by two large faceted crystal shards pointing up and outward from the outer forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Rock.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the glowing seams and cracks between the slabs; colour 1 on the crystal shards; colour 2 on the crack outlines.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Rock.description: A chunky right forearm bracer built from stacked, cracked rock slabs with a jagged outer edge, topped by two pointed crystal shards that jut up and forward from the outside of the arm. Fantasy elemental look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Rock.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the glowing cracks and gaps between the rocks; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roin.description: An angular armoured bracer worn on the right forearm: a smooth plated front panel, a long curved blade-like spike sweeping back past the elbow, and a jagged flared cuff with ribbed inner segments near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate and spike; colour 1 on the ribbed inner segments; colour 2 on the cuff band and flared wrist fins; colour 3 on the accents inside the cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roin.description: A right-wrist bracer with a large swept-back angular plate over the forearm and a long curved blade-claw hanging down past the fist. Slotted openings in the blade and a small cord wrap at the wrist give it an alien, predatory look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw blade and wrist band; colour 2 on the upper swept plate and back shell; colour 3 on the angled inset panels; colour 1 on the cord wrap at the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roin.description: An armored right forearm bracer with a smooth plated outer shell, a long blade-like spike sweeping up past the elbow, and a jagged, winged cuff at the wrist with ribbed inner segments. Fantasy or sci-fi armor styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth outer shell and the spike; colour 1 on the ribbed inner segments near the elbow; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and the back plates; colour 3 on the accents inside the cuff points.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sacr.description: A short, plain octagonal bracer worn snugly around the right wrist. Faceted sides with a slightly raised ridge along the edges give it a simple, sturdy, faintly ancient look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sacr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole bracer; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shar.description: A single curved fin-shaped spike attached to the outer side of the right forearm. It sweeps from a pointed tip near the elbow to a broad, angled base by the wrist, in a monstrous aquatic style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the piece shows no other visible colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shar.description: A single large fin-shaped spike on the outer right forearm: a swept-back blade with a notched secondary barb near its base, sitting close to the arm and pointing back toward the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the piece appears to use a single colour slot.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shar.description: A tight, sleek bracer worn on the right forearm, with a swept-back pointed fin blade rising from the outer edge near the elbow, a banded mid section and a small flared cuff at the wrist. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin blade, edge trim and wrist flare; colour 1 on the main bracer shell; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 3 on the small inset patch at the top and the back panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm by two short straps, with a raised rim, a recessed face bearing an atom emblem, and a flat plain back. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim edge and the recessed face; colour 1 on the broad border band and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the inner rim line and the back of the shield; colour 3 on the two arm straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A curved heater-style shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm, with a rounded top edge, a tapering base, a thin rim and an atom emblem on the face. Two loop straps hold it to the arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper half of the shield face; colour 0 on the lower half of the face; colour 2 on the rim and the back; colour 3 on the straps; the atom emblem is a slightly different shade of the face colours.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A heater-style shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm by two loop straps. The pointed-bottom face is quartered and bears an atom emblem, with a thick rim and a plain flat back.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the face and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the other two quarters; colour 2 on the rim and back; colour 3 on the forearm straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped to the outer right forearm by two loop straps, hanging along the arm. Its face has a raised rim, an inset field and an atom emblem; the back is plain and flat.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edge and inset face; colour 1 on the raised border band and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the back and inner rim lines; colour 3 on the two arm straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped along the outside of the right forearm by two looped straps on its back. The face is quartered with an atom emblem at the centre and a raised rim; a plain back.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the shield face and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the other two quarters; colour 2 on the rim and the back; colour 3 on the arm straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A round shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm by a short wrist cuff, its face showing a sculpted lion head inside a raised rim with a textured zigzag border; the back is a plain flat dish.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, outer rim and border; colour 1 on the lion face and the inner ring band; colour 2 on the lion mane and the shield back.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.description: A round shield worn on the outer right forearm, held by a short wide cuff band. The rim has a notched edge, runic lettering in two arcs, a radiating spoke ring and a central angular diamond glyph.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shie.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff band and shield rim; colour 3 on the runic lettering; colour 0 on the face of the shield around the glyph; colour 2 on the central glyph and the back plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Skul.description: A snug cloth bracer on the right forearm with a spiked, skull-like armour shell over the outer face: toothy jaw, studded eye dots, a large round gem-like orb, a tall horn and curved claw spikes.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Skul.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell; colour 1 on the cloth bracer sleeve; colour 2 on the stripes and spike edges; colour 3 on the orb and eye dots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Snak.description: A snug forearm bracer covered in fine overlapping scales on one side, with segmented banded plates on the other and a trimmed rim at the top. Two long curved talon blades sweep past the wrist over the back of the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Snak.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled panel and top rim; colour 1 on the banded plates and edge trim; colour 2 on the claw blades.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spar.description: A tapered forearm bracer, a curved shell that wraps the outer forearm with an open front lined by criss-cross lacing and cross straps, finished with contrasting edge trim. Sits between elbow and wrist in a Greco-Roman warrior style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the lacing and cross straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spar.description: A Greek-style forearm bracer with an open front laced by crossed straps, a Greek-key border near the wrist, contrasting edge trim, and a sculpted lion-head boss at the elbow end on the outer side.
