Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the lion head and edge trim; colour 3 on the Greek-key pattern and lion eyes; colour 2 on the crossed straps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spik.description: A pair of curved, tapering spikes on the outer right forearm: one long swept-back horn-like spike and a shorter, thinner one below it, each attached directly to the arm without a band.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spik.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the large spike; colour 1 on the spike tips and the smaller spike.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spik.description: Two curved, tapering thorn-like spikes jutting backward from short open collars on the right forearm, one near the elbow and one nearer the wrist. They give a feral, aggressive accent to a bracer.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spik.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 3 on the collar bases where the spikes attach.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spik.description: Three curved, tapering horn-like spikes in a row along the outer right forearm, each sweeping backward to a sharp point from a small collar-like base. A menacing, monstrous bracer accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spik.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies, fading toward colour 1 at the tips; colour 3 on the base rims.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Stee.description: A row of long, curved blade-like feather fins attached along the outside of the right arm, sweeping back and down past the hip to sharp points. It reads as a winged arm blade, in a superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Stee.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer feather blades; colour 0 on the inner connecting spine and its underside; colour 2 on the narrow shadowed edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Stee.description: A right forearm bracer with a scale-textured feathered cuff, a pointed flared rim at the elbow end and a strap across the hand, ending in three long curved talon blades that sweep past the knuckles.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Stee.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled feather plating; colour 1 on the pointed rim, edge trim and talon bases; colour 2 on the wrist strap; colour 3 on the talon blades.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Symb.description: A right forearm bracer with a smooth curved shell that wraps the outer forearm, edged with a rim and topped by two sharp swept-back blade spikes on layered panels. Sits between elbow and wrist with an aggressive symbiote-like look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Symb.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim and inner edge; colour 2 on the spiked blade panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Symb.description: A chunky angular forearm bracer built from faceted plates that wrap the outside of the arm, with a raised open frame holding two cylindrical canisters and a curved side panel. Sci-fi, symbiote-tech look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Symb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plates and frame; colour 1 on the curved side panel; colour 2 on the inner backing; colour 3 on the canister caps and tops.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tesl.description: A right-forearm bracer made of three stacked open rings held apart by thin struts, with jagged lightning-bolt fins running along its length and a small round tip at one end. Sits loosely around the forearm above the wrist; sci-fi, electrical look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tesl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the three rings; colour 1 on the lightning-bolt fins; colour 3 on the round tip; colour 2 on the thin connecting struts.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tesl.description: Three thin floating rings stacked along the right forearm near the wrist, each held off the arm by fine contrasting spokes. They give a light energy-coil, tech-bracer look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tesl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; colour 2 on the thin spokes connecting them to the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Toy_.description: A short, snug bracer covering the right forearm from wrist to below the elbow, with a textured cloth-like body, banded trim rings at the upper edge and a raised heart-shaped outline on the outer side. Cute, casual toy-like styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Toy_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the top cap and the trim bands at the rims; colour 2 on the heart outline and the thin inner bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Troo.description: A thick, cylindrical armored bracer worn on the right forearm, with a riveted, segmented plate body, weathered mottled surface, and a raised rim of small spikes at the elbow end and a contrasting band at the wrist end.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Troo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate body; colour 1 on the spiked upper rim and lower band; colour 2 on the rivet holes and worn stains.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vine.description: A loose open tangle of thin twisting vine stems spiralling around the right forearm above the wrist, with small angular leaves scattered along the branches. Organic, fantasy nature-inspired bracer.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vine.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vine stems and most leaves; colour 2 on some darker stem sections and a few leaves; colour 1 on shaded leaves at the back.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vine.description: A tangle of thin thorny vines wrapped loosely in open loops around the right forearm near the wrist, with small sharp thorns jutting outward. A wild, organic, gothic-fantasy bracer.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vine.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vine stems; colour 1 on the thorns.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vipe.description: A right forearm bracer of angular armor plates with two rounded cup-like cuffs on the outer side, a central inset panel, and long pointed blades that sweep down over the back of the hand. Sci-fi superhero style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vipe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates, cuffs and blades; colour 1 on the inset panel between the cuffs; colour 2 on the recessed panels; colour 3 on the small accent stripes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Wolf.description: A right forearm bracer with a flared, angled cuff, a trimmed upper edge and contrasting wrap cords near the wrist, ending in a knuckle housing with three long curved blade claws that extend past the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Wolf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer plates and claw blades; colour 3 on the trim along the upper edge; colour 1 on the small diamond gems; colour 2 on the wrist wraps, back plate and knuckle housing.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Wrap.description: A right forearm bracer of cloth strips wrapped diagonally in overlapping bands from wrist toward the elbow, with a long tapering cloth tail hanging from the wrist down past the hip. Suggests a fighter's hand wrap.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Wrap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging tail and the wrap base; colour 1 and colour 3 on alternating wrapped bands; colour 2 on the frayed edges and stitch-like marks.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchain.description: A length of heavy chain wound in loose spiral loops around the right forearm and wrist, with a few looser coils near the elbow and a tight cluster at the fist. Gritty street or punk look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchain.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; the metal shows textured shading and no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchain.description: Heavy chunky chain links wound in loose spiralling loops around the right forearm and wrist, with tight coils at the wrist and looser wraps up toward the elbow. Gives a shackled, cursed look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchain.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; the darker gaps between links show the body beneath, not a colour slot.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchain.description: A heavy chain wrapped in loose spiralling coils around the right forearm and fist, with thick interlocking links and a trailing loop near the elbow. A rugged, punk or gladiator-style bracer.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchain.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 in the shadowed gaps between links.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerexart.description: A right forearm bracer of segmented curved plates with thin etched lines, capped by contrasting rims at wrist and elbow, and a tall swept-back fin blade along the outer edge. Retro-futuristic art deco superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerexart.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and the fin blade; colour 1 on the rims at both ends; colour 2 on the thin etched lines between plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersaniu.description: A short, tapered forearm bracer with an octagonal open shape, a large main panel, an inset rectangular plate on the outer side, and a separate band at the wrist. Egyptian-styled armor sitting on the right forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersaniu.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bracer panel; colour 0 on the lower wrist band; colour 3 on the inset side plate; colour 2 on the top rim edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersaniu.differs: The female bracer is a smooth panelled shape with an inset plate and a separate wrist band, unlike the male's striped cuff design.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersasqu.description: A right forearm bracer made of a padded, rolled panel with an open seam edge, wrapped by three horizontal straps and studded with small rivet holes. Jagged tufts of fur spike out from both the elbow and wrist ends.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersasqu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer panel; colour 1 on the fur tufts at both ends; colour 2 on the horizontal straps and rivet holes; colour 3 on the stitched edge trim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersasqu.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a studded, segmented casing crossed by several contrasting straps, ornate swirl-patterned fins along the outer edge, and jagged fur-like spikes flaring out at both the wrist and elbow ends.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersasqu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer casing; colour 1 on the spiky fur tufts at the cuff and wrist; colour 2 on the straps and edge piping; colour 3 on the swirl-patterned fins and spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerspike.description: A right forearm bracer made of a curved plate with a contrasting inner lining, three long swept-back blades along the outer edge, and two flat oval discs that stick out to the side. Worn on the forearm above the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerspike.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate; colour 1 on the inner lining and the three blades; colour 3 on the two side discs; colour 2 on the plate edging.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerstrap.description: A short, snug wrist bracer with a slightly faceted, softly ribbed cuff and two parallel straps with small square buckles wrapped around the outer side. Sits at the wrist of the right arm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerstrap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 0 on the buckle frames.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Buttoncuff_.description: A short, plain shirt-style cuff: a faceted band wrapped around the right wrist, with a single round button on the outer side. It reads as a simple tailored cuff for casual or formal looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Buttoncuff_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 0 on the button.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cardboard_0.description: A boxy forearm bracer shaped like an open carton, with angular faceted sides, an open top rim and a folded flap sticking up at the elbow end. It sits on the right forearm above the wrist, with a novelty look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cardboard_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the open rim, inner top and flap edges; colour 1 on the main body of the carton; colour 2 on the large angled front and side panel; colour 3 on the small angled patch on the side and back.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Brace.description: A pair of long, flat, blade-like claws mounted at the right wrist that extend well past the fist along the outside of the forearm and hand, with small nicks along the edges. Suggests a feral or brawler weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both claw blades; the small edge nicks show a lighter tone. No other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Claw_.description: A long, narrow chainsaw blade worn along the outer forearm and extending well past the hand, with a rounded tip, recessed slots down the centre, and a row of curved teeth along both edges. Brutal, monstrous weapon look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the blade body and housing; colour 2 on the teeth and the recessed slots.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Claw_.description: A set of four long, slender curved blades that project forward from the knuckles of the right fist, sweeping down and outward like retractable claws. Suggests a feral, superhero mutant look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all four claw blades; the darker edges are shading on the same blades.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Claw_.description: A pair of slender feathers joined at a point near the right wrist, splaying outward and back along the hip side in a V shape. A small decorative accent rather than a full bracer, with finely textured barbs.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both feathers; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Claw_.description: A long, curved blade attached at the forearm that sweeps down past the hand to a sharp point, with jagged spikes along its outer edge and a thin contrasting edge strip. Suggests a sci-fi or monstrous claw weapon.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blade body and spikes; colour 1 on the thin edge strip along the inner curve.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Chains.description: A forearm-mounted chainsaw: a bulky angular motor housing sits at the wrist and a long narrow guide bar extends past the fist, edged with a toothed chain and ending in small spikes.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Chains.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the motor housing, bar and chain casing; colour 1 on the housing inserts and grip; colour 2 on the collar band and chain teeth; colour 0 on small edge highlights.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Dual_0.description: A right-hand claw weapon: a layered plated cuff at the wrist with contrasting clamp bands, holding two long, curved, jagged-edged blades that sweep down past the knee beside the leg. Sharp, aggressive, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Dual_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented cuff plates; colour 2 on the clamp bands; colour 1 on both blades.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Fur_01.description: A right wrist bracer with a narrow cuff and a thick shaggy mass of feathery fur over the back of the hand, from which four long curved claw blades extend past the knuckles. Savage, animalistic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff; colour 3 on the cuff buckle and studs; colour 2 on the fur; colour 1 on the claw blades.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Skull_.description: A bulky, rounded wrist bracer of rough textured hide on the right forearm, bound with contrasting cord wraps and contrasting thread, with long curved claws extending past the hand and a few trailing feathers.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Skull_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hide bracer body; colour 2 on the cord wraps; colour 1 on the thin thread ties; colour 0 on the claws and feathers.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Spike_.description: A right forearm bracer built around a large bone-like claw spike that runs along the outer arm and points past the wrist. It is lashed on with many bands of cord and small peg toggles, with a rim at the elbow end.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Spike_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the claw spike and the small toggle pegs; colour 0 on the wrapped cord bands; colour 2 on the band beneath the cord; colour 3 on the rim at the top and the small trim near the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Tech_0.description: A chunky tech bracer worn on the right forearm with panelled housing, from which a long curved serrated blade sweeps down past the thigh. The blade has jagged spikes along its outer edge and a smooth inner strip.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Tech_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bracer housing; colour 2 on the serrated blade; colour 1 on the inner edge strip of the blade.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Combat_01_B.description: A curved armor plate worn on the outer right forearm, held by three contrasting straps across its face and two open octagonal cuff rings at the ends. Practical, tactical combat bracer.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Combat_01_B.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved armor plate; colour 2 on the three straps; colour 0 on the two cuff rings and buckles.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A short faceted armband worn around the right upper arm: a slightly tapered, many-sided cuff with raised bands at the top and bottom edges. It suggests a simple superhero or sci-fi accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim; colour 2 on the raised bands at the top and bottom edges; colour 1 on the main cuff body, which looks and muted on this sheet.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_01.differs: The female cuff looks mostly contrasting and muted, with a glassy sheen and little visible contrasting or light trim, while the male cuff shows a clear two-tone pattern.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_02.description: A short faceted bracer worn on the right forearm near the wrist: an octagonal tapered cuff with raised rims at the top and bottom edges, giving a clean, simple superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main cuff body and rims; colour 0 on the inner lining and thin edge highlights.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_02.differs: The female cuff is coloured mostly with colour 2 on the outside, and the male cuff has a cut-out slot on the outer side that the female one lacks.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_0.description: A pair of angular armour plates strapped to the right arm, one over the upper arm and a smaller one over the forearm, each with a bevelled edge, a curved lower panel and small rivets. Tactical cyberpunk styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate shells; colour 1 on the curved lower panel of each plate; colour 2 on the inner edges and undersides.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor.description: A short, faceted armour band that wraps the right upper arm, with a raised contrasting rim along the top edge and hex-bolt heads studded around its sides. Suggests cyborg or sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the rim trim; colour 0 on the bolt heads.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Deco_01.description: A short armoured band worn around the right forearm, with a pointed plate at the front and a long, tapering blade-like spike swept back toward the elbow, built from stacked jagged segments. Sharp, aggressive styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Deco_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer plates, spike and edge trim; colour 3 on the inner panels and recessed markings under the plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbo.description: A tapered forearm bracer of segmented armor bands, with a flat-topped rim at the elbow end bearing short cone spikes and a slim trim ring at the wrist edge. Suggests robotic sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and wrist edge trim; colour 1 on the segmented band body; colour 2 on the spikes and the seam lines between bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbo.description: A tapered right forearm bracer of horizontally segmented armor bands with a flared, faceted top cuff and thin rim at the wrist end. Short conical spikes jut from the cuff sides. Sci-fi battle-armor look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, wrist rim and side strip; colour 1 on the segmented armor bands; colour 2 on the spikes and segment lines.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbo.differs: The female version has spikes only at the cuff sides, with no extra spike on the front of the cuff.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbo.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a wide faceted rim at the elbow end, a body of horizontal segmented plates, a narrow vertical strip along one side, and short conical spikes jutting from the rim.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, cuff edge and side strip; colour 1 on the segmented plates; colour 2 on the spikes and plate gaps.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Egyptian_Ar.description: A short, snug armband worn around the upper right arm: a faceted, roughly octagonal band with fine horizontal ribbing, a smooth wide band along one edge and a thin rim on the other. Suits Egyptian or superhero looks.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Egyptian_Ar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin top rim; colour 1 on the smooth band beneath the rim; colour 3 on the ribbed lower body of the band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Elbowpad_01.description: A small elbow band worn on the right arm: a stack of thin layered rings forms a faceted octagonal cuff, with a rounded padded plate on the back of the elbow studded with a grid of small round rivets.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Elbowpad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rear elbow plate; colour 1 on the top cap and the thin edge band of the cuff; colour 2 on the layered rings; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Electric_01.description: A sci-fi forearm bracer with a smooth, slightly tapered shell, a perforated inner panel, and three coil-wrapped electrode prongs on the outer side, each capped with a hex nut. A ribbed cable loops along the edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the perforated inner panel and end lining; colour 3 on the coil windings and thin outline trim; colour 2 on the hex nuts, prong caps and cable.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_F_Variabler.description: A chunky, faceted armband block worn on the right upper arm: an angular boxy shell wraps around the arm with two short prongs hanging down and a notch cut between them, giving a robotic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_F_Variabler.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole band; no other slots visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_F_Variabler.description: A chunky, angular robotic bracer worn on the right forearm near the wrist: a boxy front housing with a small triangular emblem, framed by blocky segmented plates that wrap the back and sides.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_F_Variabler.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front housing and the central band; colour 1 on the wrapping back plates and end plates; colour 0 and colour 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fin_01.description: A small fin-like arm accessory on the right upper arm: a fan of three webbed membrane segments separated by curved, backswept spines, with a long pointed spike trailing behind. Suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 1 on the spines and edge trim; colour 3 on the spotted markings across the membrane.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fin_02.description: A set of three stacked, swept-back fin blades attached to the outer right upper arm, each ending in a long curved spike, with a contrasting edge trim and mottled surface texture. Suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin surfaces; colour 1 on the edge trim and spike tips; colour 3 on the speckled markings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Flower_01.description: A right forearm bracer of overlapping leaf-like shards fanning out in sharp points toward the elbow, bound at the wrist by thin wrapping bands with a small rose-like flower on the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist bands, flower and some shard tips; colour 1 on many of the shards; colour 2 on the darker shards; colour 3 on small accents at the shard bases.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A small faceted oval gemstone with a flat back, mounted against the side of the right hip or thigh. Its glossy cut facets form a domed cabochon-like jewel, suggesting a decorative fantasy or sci-fi accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The glossy gem facets appear to ignore the colour scheme under the default material, showing a reflective finish; no distinct slot areas are visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted gemstone in an elongated rhombus shape, with bevelled edges and a glossy surface, mounted flat against the outer upper arm on the right side. A small decorative crystal accent.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme in its default material; no colour slot is clearly visible on it.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small faceted gemstone block shaped like a beveled square slab, mounted flat on the outer side of the right wrist or hand. It has a glossy, glassy surface with angled edges and reads as a jewel-like ornament.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem surface largely ignores the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are clearly visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A single faceted pentagonal gemstone slab with a bevelled edge, mounted flat against the outer side of the right upper body. It reads as a chunky decorative jewel stud with a glossy, cut-glass look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bevelled facet edges; the glossy face ignores the scheme and stays very dark; other slots not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A small faceted gemstone cut in a heart shape, worn flat against the outer side of the right upper arm. Its angular facets and glossy finish give it a decorative, jewel-like look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gemstone ignores most of the colour scheme; it takes colour 2 on its main body, with faint colour 1 sheen on the upper facets.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A single teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone plate that sits flat against the body on the right side of the chest, with a bevelled edge on one side and a smooth, glossy face.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores most of the colour scheme; colour 1 shows only as a faint tint along the bevelled edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Greave_01.description: A smooth, tapered forearm bracer that wraps the right forearm from wrist to below the elbow. It has a flared open top edge and a faceted plate shell with small contrasting trim tabs at each end. Sleek armor styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Greave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 3 on the small trim tabs at the top and bottom edges.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Harajuku_Wr.description: A tapered cloth forearm wrap of tightly bound horizontal bands that sits on the right forearm just above the wrist, with a slightly thick rim at the top and a snug, wrinkled, bandage-like look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Harajuku_Wr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the alternating wrap bands and inner lining; colour 2 on the other alternating bands and the top rim.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A right forearm bracer of angular plate armor: a flared outer shell with layered ridged plates and wavy recessed panels, a segmented rear guard, and short prongs along the edge. Sits over the forearm just below the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and ridged edge plates; colour 1 on the wavy inset panels; colour 2 on the segmented rear plates; colour 3 on the prongs and rear rune-like bars.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_0.description: A holographic energy armband worn on the upper right arm: two angular, open-backed bands, one wrapping the arm and one higher curved panel, with a crackled translucent texture. Suggests a sci-fi force-field gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_0.colourAreas: The default energy material ignores the colour scheme and shows a glowing crackled pattern over the whole piece.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_0.differs: The female version is a glowing energy material that ignores the colour scheme, while the male version is solid with separate colour panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hornsmonste.description: A scatter of small curved bone spikes and thorns, each set on a small flat plate, studded along the right forearm; one longer horn sweeps upward along the arm. Monstrous, tribal look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hornsmonste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone spikes; colour 3 on the small mounting plates beneath each spike.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hornsmonste.description: A set of curved bone-like horns mounted on small angular base plates along the outer right forearm: one large swept horn near the elbow, a smaller spike beside it and another lower toward the wrist. Monstrous, tribal styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hornsmonste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and spikes; colour 3 on the small base plates they grow from.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Knight_02.description: A small curved plate guard for the right upper arm, shaped like a half-shell with layered ridged bands and a raised rim on top. Conical spikes and studs stud the outer face, giving a medieval knight look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and the spikes; colour 3 on the main plate body and the ridge bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A right wrist bracer made of a short smooth cuff ringed with round studs along its lower edge, topped by a thick tangle of heavy chain links coiled around the forearm. Gothic, festive and rough in feel.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 1 on the round balls around the cuff edge; colour 2 on the coiled chain links.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lockbox_66_.description: A pair of stacked angular bands worn around the right upper arm: a thin zigzag-edged upper ring with a raised inset panel on the outer side, and a thicker faceted lower band separated by a gap.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lockbox_66_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper zigzag band; colour 1 on the raised inset panel; colour 2 on the lower band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Luchadordol.description: A short cloth wrestling-style bracer worn on the right forearm, with a wide folded cuff at the top, a fitted band below, and a raised three-dimensional dollar sign mounted on the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Luchadordol.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band of the bracer and the raised dollar sign frame; colour 1 on the folded top cuff and the bottom edge trim; colour 2 and colour 3 on the patterned fill inside the dollar sign.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Luchadorhaw.description: A short cuff-style bracer worn on the forearm near the wrist, with a rolled contrasting rim and a large flat feather-like fin of splayed fingers along the outer edge. A small emblem is printed on the cuff, giving a luchador superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Luchadorhaw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and the feather fin; colour 1 on the rim, edging and fin outline; colour 2 on the small emblem markings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lycan_02.description: A long forearm covering of shaggy, jagged fur tufts that runs from the elbow down to the wrist, with sharp spiky clumps jutting out along the outer edge. It suggests a feral, lycanthrope look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lycan_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 3 on the inner tufts and spike tips; colour 0 on the fringe along the edges; colour 2 in the shadowed depths between tufts.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lycanbracer.description: A tight, furry forearm bracer with a jagged, ragged edge and rows of sharp curved spikes along the outer side. It wraps the right forearm from below the elbow toward the wrist, in a feral, lycan-like style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lycanbracer.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 0 on the ragged fur edges and tufts; colour 3 on the spikes and streaks in the fur.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Martialarts.description: A right forearm bracer shaped like a short tapered octagonal cuff with contrasting bands at both ends, plus a narrow plate extending over the back of the hand with three round knuckle studs. Martial-arts style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Martialarts.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff and the hand plate; colour 1 on the top and bottom bands of the cuff; knuckle studs take colour 0.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Mechassassi.description: A bulky angular sci-fi forearm shield-gauntlet made of layered, segmented plates with pointed wing-like edges, sitting on the outer right forearm above the wrist, with recessed inner panels and small end caps.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Mechassassi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the recessed inner panels and edge inlays; colour 3 on the end caps and thin stripe accents; colour 2 on the gaps and underside.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Nighthawk_0.description: A right forearm bracer with a rigid angular guard, a central raised panel flanked by ribbed side sections, and a contrasting hand strap ending in three long curved blade claws that extend past the knuckles. Superhero vigilante styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Nighthawk_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main guard panel; colour 1 on the central stripe and ribbed side sections; colour 2 on the rim, strap, mounting and claws.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracer.description: A ninja-style right forearm bracer: a broad angular plate runs along the outer forearm, with a wrapped, banded cloth section around the wrist and an octagonal cuff. Studded knuckle plate tips extend over the back of the hand.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour plate and the thin bands around the wrap; colour 1 on the wrapped cloth section; colour 2 on the cuff rims and edge trim.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracer.differs: The female version has only small studs on the back of the hand, with no larger knuckle plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracer.description: A right forearm bracer with a large curved plate on the outer side, tapering to a point toward the wrist. Wrapped cloth binding with thin cords sits between contrasting end caps, giving a gladiator or ninja look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer plate and thin cord wraps; colour 1 on the wrapped cloth binding; colour 2 on the end caps and rims.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Norse_Fur_0.description: A tubular fur bracer for the right forearm with shaggy, jagged fur at the wrist and elbow edges, wrapped in crossing straps in a zigzag lacing. Suggests a rugged Norse or barbarian look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Norse_Fur_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur; colour 2 on the crossing wrap straps. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Persian_01.description: A right upper-arm accessory: a stiff band with thin edge piping sits high on the arm, with a row of round disc charms dangling from its lower edge over a gathered, puffy billowing sleeve that ends above the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered puffy sleeve; colour 2 on the upper band; colour 3 on the piping along the band edges; colour 1 on the hanging discs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Persian_Bra.description: A short tapered cuff bracer worn on the right forearm, with an octagonal opening, swirling scrollwork patterns across the surface, thin contrasting trim at both edges and a rounded gem set on the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Persian_Bra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 2 on the swirling scrollwork; colour 3 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the gem.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Plugs_Cover.description: A cluster of four small hexagonal plug connectors, each with a short stepped cylindrical stub, scattered on the right upper arm. Separate studs with no band or strap, suggesting cybernetic ports.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Plugs_Cover.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hexagonal plug bodies; colour 1 on the stepped stubs and some of the hex faces. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Post_Apoc_B.description: A post-apocalyptic forearm bracer: a slightly tapered cloth-like wrap with a rigid scratched plate along the outer edge, held by two thin straps with small buckles and studded with screws. Sits over the right forearm.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Post_Apoc_B.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrap; colour 1 on the outer plate; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the buckles and screws.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Power_01.description: A right forearm bracer of angular, plate-like construction with a raised edge rim, a pointed fin flaring up at the elbow end, a recessed side panel and a small round stud on the inner edge.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bracer shell; colour 0 on the rim edging and the pointed fin; colour 2 on the raised side panel; colour 3 on the small round stud.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Power_02.description: A short armoured bracer worn on the right forearm: a tapered shell with a raised, shield-shaped plate on the outer face, a metal rim, small rivets, and a flared lower cuff panel near the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the raised outer plate; colour 1 on the main bracer shell; colour 0 on the metal rim and edging; colour 3 on the lower cuff panel and rivets.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Powersuit_0.description: A small rounded cybernetic elbow module sitting on the right arm at the elbow: a chunky bulbous casing with a circular sensor-like disc on the outer face, a contrasting strap band, and a thin fin-like plate sticking out behind.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Powersuit_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing; colour 1 on the strap band, the circular disc and the small side vents; colour 2 on the rear fin plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Qularr_Armo.description: A short segmented armor band worn around the upper right arm: an angular, faceted cuff with stacked overlapping plates across the back and a smooth rounded front, finished with a contrasting rim at the top and bottom.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Qularr_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the rim edging and the plate ridges; colour 2 on the darkest recesses between plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_.description: A short, chunky faceted armguard on the right upper arm: a boxy, slightly tapered cylinder with a mottled stone-like surface, ending in a gathered ring of stacked ridged bands above the elbow. Retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armguard shell; colour 1 on the ridged lower bands; colour 3 on thin accent lines between the bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_.description: A short retro sci-fi bracer worn on the right forearm: a tapered cuff with a rigid mottled outer shell, a clear transparent panel down the inner side and a narrow band at each end.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the transparent panel edges and lower band; colour 1 on the upper rim and part of the shell; colour 2 on the shell's darker mottled areas. Colour 3 is not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_.description: A chunky, faceted cylindrical bracer worn on the right forearm, with a boxy handheld device strapped to the outer side, showing a small screen and a keypad of buttons, held by a wide band.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer cylinder; colour 1 on the strap band and some keypad buttons; colour 2 on the device casing and screen surround; colour 3 on the screen and some keypad buttons.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ringsbicep_.description: A tight, angular armband worn around the right upper arm, made of layered straps with a contrasting central stripe and two chunky octagonal rings mounted on small blocks at the outer side. Suggests a punk or street look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ringsbicep_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main band; colour 2 on the central stripe; colour 0 on the thin edging lines beside the stripe; colour 3 on the rings and their mounting blocks.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ringswrist_.description: A snug forearm bracer wrapped in criss-crossing alternating straps between two solid cuff bands at wrist and upper end, with three octagonal D-rings mounted in a line along the outer side. Casual street or punk styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ringswrist_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom cuff bands; colour 2 on one set of wrapped straps; colour 0 on the other set of wrapped straps; colour 3 on the rings.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A small cybernetic implant on the upper right arm: an angular metal plate with a round port, from which two segmented ribbed cables curl outward, each ending in a blocky capped connector.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal plate; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 1 on the cable end connectors; colour 3 on the port at the plate's centre.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_01.differs: The female version has two cables, while the male version adds a third short cable with its own connector, lower down the arm.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A cybernetic implant for the upper right arm: an angular pronged metal clamp on the shoulder with several loose, ribbed contrasting cables looping down the arm, ending in small connector caps. Worn over the sleeve in a sci-fi style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal clamp; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 1 on the small cylindrical connectors.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_02.differs: The female version has fewer connector caps and slightly fewer cable ends than the male version.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Robotsamura.description: A right forearm bracer shaped as a flared, open-sided armored cuff with a colour-blocked shell, and three long flat blade-like fins projecting past the wrist over the back of the hand. Robotic samurai styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Robotsamura.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade fins and the rim of the cuff; colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 2 on the inner panel sections; colour 3 on the small accent patch near the top of the shell.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rock_01.description: A right-forearm bracer built from cracked, stacked stone slabs with jagged ridges at the elbow and long pointed stone claws extending past the hand. Rugged, monstrous, earthy styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs and claws; colour 2 on the cracks and outlines between the plates.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rock_02.description: A chunky bracer made of cracked, faceted rock slabs that wrap the right forearm just above the wrist, with large jagged stone shards pointing up and back along the arm. Suggests a rugged, elemental golem look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs and shards; colour 2 on the crack lines between the stones. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rolledsleev.description: A short wrapped cloth armband worn around the upper right arm, a wide rolled cuff with creased, gathered folds and a slightly angular edge. Casual and understated, it reads as a bandage or rolled sleeve.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rolledsleev.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole armband; the folds and the underside show only shading, with no other colour slot visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ruffle_01.description: A small flared lace ruffle worn as a band around the upper right arm, with scalloped, openwork-patterned layered edges that fan outward like a frilly cuff. Suggests a delicate, ornate, romantic look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ruffle_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lace ruffle's outer surface; colour 2 on the shaded inner underside and lining of the ruffle.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ruler_01.description: A short, slightly tapered armored cuff worn around the right wrist, with an octagonal rim, studded borders at both edges and round inset discs spaced around the sides. It has a sleek, sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ruler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 1 on the studs along both rims; colour 2 on the inset discs; colour 3 on the inset discs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A chunky octagonal upper-arm band with a contrasting rim, carrying a curved, wing-like fin on its outer side that sweeps back to a point. The fin has raised swirling lines and a small ring emblem.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band's side; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 2 on the fin body; colour 3 on the swirling lines and ring on the fin.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Lar.description: A samurai-style right forearm bracer of angular plates with jagged, stepped edges and a curling horn-like flare at the outer side. Swirling patterned panels sit inside bordered rims, and the piece wraps the forearm just above the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Lar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rims and the stepped back plates; colour 1 on the thin inner edge lines; colour 2 on the panel backgrounds; colour 3 on the swirl patterns.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Lar.differs: The female bracer is shorter and has no thin vertical blade-like fin along the outer side that shows on the male version.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_0.description: A short fur bracer wrapping the right forearm, made of jagged, shaggy tufts that flare into spiky points at the elbow end and ragged strands over the wrist. Suggests a feral, beastly look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur tips; colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 2 on the shaded underside strands at the back.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_0.description: A small tuft of shaggy fur on the outer forearm, made of several jagged pointed locks that sweep down toward the wrist, with a few spikes flaring up at the top. Suggests a beastly, primal look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur near the top; colour 1 on the lower fur locks, blending toward the tips.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_0.differs: The female tuft is shorter and sits higher on the forearm, with a wider flared top, while the male tuft runs longer down toward the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatchlo.description: A shaggy fur bracer wrapping the right forearm from elbow to wrist, made of long jagged tufts that flare into spiky points at the top and ragged ends near the hand. Wild, beastly look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatchlo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper tufts at the top and front of the forearm; colour 1 on the lower tufts; colour 2 on the shaded back and underside near the top.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Shacklewris.description: A chunky tapered metal cuff worn on the right wrist, with faceted panels, two bolted clasp blocks down the side, and looped handle-like rings on either side for chain attachment. Suggests prisoner restraints or sci-fi gauntlet gear.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Shacklewris.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 1 on the two side loops; colour 2 on the clasp blocks.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_St.description: A band-like upper-arm guard made of overlapping angular plates with jagged fin-shaped points rising along the outer side, wrapping the right upper arm. Sharp, segmented superhero armor styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_St.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer plates; colour 2 on the swept fin blades and inner panels; colour 0 on the lower edge plates and rim; colour 3 on the small top wedge panel.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spike_Bars_.description: A wrapped forearm bracer of layered banded strips, with a curved blade-like plate standing off the outer side and a row of four long arrow-shaped spikes projecting sideways through it. Punk, aggressive look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spike_Bars_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer wrap bands; colour 0 on the wrap bands showing between them; colour 2 on the spikes and their studs; colour 3 on the curved plate.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spike_Bars_.description: A right forearm bracer made of stacked banded rings, with four long pointed spike bars projecting sideways to a large curved, blade-like fin that sweeps down past the hand. Aggressive, monstrous superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spike_Bars_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large curved blade fin; colour 1 on the ring bands; colour 0 on the bands between the rings; colour 2 on the spike bars.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spikeelbow_.description: A pair of curved, tapering horn-like spikes of unequal size that sweep upward from a short contrasting-banded base on the outer upper arm near the elbow. Suggests a monstrous or fantasy look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spikeelbow_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering horn tips; colour 3 on the base band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spikysuit_0.description: A bulky, organic bracer worn around the right forearm near the wrist, with a textured shell-like surface and long curved horn spikes sweeping up and outward from the outer edge. Suggests a monstrous, bony gauntlet.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spikysuit_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the bracer; colour 1 on the streaked markings across the shell; colour 2 on the curved horn spikes.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Straps_01.description: A set of three thin, angular-edged bands stacked loosely around the upper right arm, slightly tilted and overlapping, like simple wrap straps. Suggests a minimal street or punk armband accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all of the straps; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapsasqua.description: A right forearm bracer of wrapped bands with thin straps cinched around it, and jagged shaggy fur tufts flaring out at both the wrist and the elbow end. Sits snugly on the forearm with a rugged, tribal look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapsasqua.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the thin straps; colour 1 on the fur tufts at both ends.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapsbicep.description: A slim angular band worn around the right upper arm, made of two wide outer straps with a narrower layered strip between them, giving a faceted, snug armband look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapsbicep.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two wide outer bands; colour 2 on the central strip; colour 0 on the thin edge lines beside the central strip.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalbrace.description: A short, wrinkled cloth-like cuff worn on the right wrist, with contrasting trim at both edges and a ring of long tapered tooth-like spikes with banded bases pointing outward and upward around it.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalbrace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and the bands on the spikes; colour 1 on the trim at the top and bottom edges; colour 2 on the spike bases; colour 3 on the spike tips.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalbrace.differs: The female cuff has a denser ring of spikes that looks more crowded, with the spikes angled more tightly around the wrist.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalfeath.description: A tribal upper-arm wrap of bunched, crumpled cloth bands with small dash markings, fastened by a round button at the outer side, from which three long feathers sweep upward above the shoulder.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalfeath.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped bands; colour 1 on the dash markings and the button rim; colour 3 on the button centre; colour 2 on the feathers.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Brace.description: A pair of thin, slightly faceted band bracelets stacked closely on the right wrist, one tilted slightly against the other. A simple casual street-style wrist accessory.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower band; colour 1 on the upper, tilted band.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Diamo.description: A wide, snug wrist cuff with a broad smooth central band, rows of faceted gem-like blocks along both edges, and a bordered rim. Two small buckled straps fasten it at the back; street-style urban look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Diamo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central band and buckle straps; colour 1 on the edge borders and rim; colour 3 on the faceted gem blocks; colour 2 on the buckle hardware.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Studd.description: A short, slightly tapered cuff worn around the right forearm just above the wrist, with contrasting trim bands at both edges and rounded raised studs in pairs around the outside. Casual street style.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Studd.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 2 on the top and bottom trim bands; colour 1 on the studs.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A chunky angular armor plate worn as a band around the right upper arm, with a notched, cupped outer shell and inset paneled windows front and back. Suggests sci-fi superhero armor.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the inset panels; colour 2 on the thin lines across the panels.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wedding_Cor.description: A wrist corsage worn on the right wrist: a snug faceted band with short ribbon tails, topped by a cluster of two layered blossoms with contrasting centres. Suggests a formal, wedding or prom look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wedding_Cor.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrist band and ribbon tails; the flowers keep their own petal shading and centres, mostly unaffected by the scheme.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wingbracer_.description: A small bat-wing bracer running along the outer right forearm: two long curved, pointed spars support a thin webbed membrane that flares outward from the arm, giving a monstrous, gothic wing-fin silhouette.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wingbracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spars and bony edges; colour 1 on the wing membrane.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wingbracer_.description: A large bat-wing worn along the right arm: long curved bone-like spars fan out from the forearm, joined by a thin membrane, and sweep up past the shoulder and back down toward the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wingbracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spars and ribs; colour 1 on the wing membrane; colour 3 on the joints and edge highlights.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wristband_0.description: A plain, short wristband: a slightly flared, faceted cuff that sits around the right wrist just above the hand, with a smooth surface and no visible fasteners or decoration. Suggests casual or sporty wear.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wristband_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; the darker edges are only shading.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wristband_0.description: A short tapered wristband cuff worn on the right forearm just above the wrist: a slightly flared band with a wide contrasting upper rim and a thin contrasting edge at the bottom. Sporty wrestling look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wristband_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the cuff; colour 1 on the wide top band and the thin bottom edge.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Urban_Anime_Armwa.description: A loose, tube-like armwarmer covering the right forearm from just below the elbow to the wrist, with a chunky rounded cuff at the top, a slim cuff at the wrist, and separate side and front panels. Casual anime-inspired street look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Urban_Anime_Armwa.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuffs and the back of the sleeve; colour 1 on the main front panel; colour 2 on the side panel and edge piping; colour 3 on the small rectangular patch.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Vine_01.description: A right-wrist bracer shaped like a short flared cuff, covered in swirling vine-like ridges and curling tendrils with pointed tips that sweep up and outward from the forearm. Organic, fantasy styling.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cuff body and the vine ridges; colour 0 on the recessed swirl panels; colour 3 on the tendril tips and thorns.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Watch_01.description: A chunky octagonal wristwatch band worn on the right wrist: a wide banded strap with raised rims top and bottom and a rectangular watch face plate with a contrasting screen on the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Watch_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main strap band; colour 0 on the raised upper and lower rims; colour 1 on the watch face plate; colour 2 on the screen and the thin lines between bands.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Wing_Tight_Batwin.description: A single membrane bat wing that hangs from the right upper arm to the wrist and down to the hip, forming a tight triangular sheet with a scalloped, ragged lower edge. It sits close against the torso side.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Wing_Tight_Batwin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing membrane; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Chestattach_R_Wing_Tight_Steelh.description: A slim, tapering feathered wing folded tight against the right arm and side, made of overlapping layered feathers that end in ragged, frayed tips near the hip. Suggests a fantasy or superhero winged look.
Female/F_Chestattach_R_Wing_Tight_Steelh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers; the piece appears to take little of the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Bracer_Anniversary.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a smooth main shell, contrasting rim trim at both ends, a segmented armor plate along one side, and two round circular nodes linked by thin branching lines. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Bracer_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim trim at both ends; colour 2 on the segmented plates and node housings and connecting lines; colour 3 on the round nodes.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Bracer_Anniversary.description: A large blade-like shield worn on the left forearm: a long tapering curved plate that sweeps up past the shoulder and down to a sharp point below the hip, with angular faceted panels and thin inset line accents.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Bracer_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper faceted plate; colour 2 on the lower long blade section and cuff; colour 3 on the thin line accents between panels.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Blackpaladin.description: A short tapered cuff-like band worn around the upper left arm, with an open top rim and a faceted, angular shape. It has contrasting panels, a wide vertical strip down the back and a separate lower band.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Blackpaladin.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the band; colour 0 on the lower edge and the front rim; colour 3 on the front top panel and the side rim; colour 2 on the back strip and the top rim.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Blackpaladin.differs: The female version has a smooth default colour pattern of large solid panels in several colours, while the male version shows a scalloped scale texture in mostly one colour with a contrasting rim.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Gladi.description: A short tapered armoured bracer worn on the left forearm, with thick rim bands at both ends, small rivets, scratch-like etched lines, and two pairs of conical spikes jutting outward from the outer side.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Gladi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the rim bands at both ends; colour 3 on the spikes on one side; colour 2 on the spikes on the opposite side.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Ironc.description: A heavy armored bracer worn on the left forearm: a chunky flared cuff at the elbow end, a segmented plated body with recessed ribbed panels and jagged flame-like cut-outs, and a pointed guard over the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Ironc.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cuff and the wrist guard; colour 0 on the main plate body; colour 3 on the recessed ribbed panels; colour 2 on the jagged inner cut-outs and the underside.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Power.description: A chunky, rounded forearm bracer of power-armor style, wrapping the left forearm with a raised slotted panel on the outer face, a narrower lower cuff, and a boxy octagonal blaster housing mounted on the inner side.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Power.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bracer shell and lower cuff; colour 3 on the raised slotted plate, the blaster housing and the cuff inserts.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Power.description: A smooth, tapered armored bracer worn on the left forearm, with a faceted plated shell and a flared cuff at the wrist. Contrasting panels line the back seam and cuff edge, giving a sleek sci-fi power-suit look.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Power.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell and cuff plates; colour 1 on the inner seam strip along the back of the forearm and the trim at the wrist cuff and top edge.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Steam.description: A short tapered bracer worn on the left forearm, with a wide riveted upper cuff, two segmented lower bands and an open window on the inner side showing a gear pattern. Steampunk mechanical styling.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Steam.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cuff and its rivets; colour 0 on the lower bracer body and window frame; colour 2 on the back-side lower band; colour 3 on the gear pattern inside the window.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A short segmented armor band worn around the left upper arm: a chunky octagonal cuff with raised rims at top and bottom, riveted layered plates on the outer face and a smooth panel on the inner side.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the riveted outer plates; colour 0 on the smooth back and inner panel.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Light_01.description: A wide armband worn around the left upper arm: a short, faceted cloth band with contrasting trim on both edges and a small rounded emblem gem on the outer side. Simple superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band body; colour 1 on the trim along the top and bottom edges; colour 3 on the round emblem stud.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Vibroman_01.description: A simple tapered bracer plate wrapping the left forearm, with a plain smooth shell that flares wider at the elbow end and rises into a pointed edge on the outer back side. Suggests light armor.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Tight_Vibroman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole plate; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the top rim.

Female/F_Chestattachl_Toxicsteel_01.description: A bulky armoured bracer worn on the left forearm: a curved shell with a small cuff at the wrist, a looping tube handle on the outer side, a nozzle-like port, and a forked fin spiking up toward the elbow.
Female/F_Chestattachl_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell, nozzle and fin; colour 2 on the rim edging and looped tube; colour 1 on the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Bracer_Anniversary.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a smooth main shell and thin rimmed cuffs at both ends. Segmented plates run along one side, with round glowing gem-like studs set in contrasting housings and thin linking lines, giving a sci-fi arcane look.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Bracer_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edges at the wrist and elbow; colour 1 on the main bracer shell; colour 2 on the segmented side plates, stud housings and linking lines; colour 3 on the round gem studs.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Bracer_Anniversary.description: A large, blade-like shield worn on the right forearm: a tall pointed upper plate flares from the shoulder and tapers to a long curved spike past the hand, with angular armored panels and thin inset lines.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Bracer_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shield plate; colour 2 on the lower blade and armored panels; colour 3 on the thin trim lines and inset accents; colour 0 barely visible.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Blackpaladin.description: A short tapered armband worn on the right upper arm: a faceted, open-topped cuff with a flared scalloped rim, angular panels and a fuzzy textured strip down the outer side. Suggests superhero or paladin armor.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Blackpaladin.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the cuff; colour 0 on the lower band and some rim facets; colour 2 on the textured side strip and inner rim; colour 3 on the rim scallops.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Gladi.description: A rounded, tapered gladiator bracer for the right forearm, with contrasting rims at both ends, small rivets, scratch marks and several cone spikes jutting from the outer side and back, plus small studs.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Gladi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the front-facing spikes and stud bumps; colour 2 on the rear-facing spikes and back studs.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Ironc.description: A short armored bracer worn on the right forearm: a chunky flared cuff at the elbow end, a segmented plated body with a ribbed vent panel and jagged spiky trim, and an angular pointed guard at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Ironc.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cuff, wrist guard and spiky edge trim; colour 0 on the main plate body and thin edge lines; colour 3 on the ribbed vent panel; colour 2 on the underside of the plating.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Power.description: A chunky power-armor bracer worn on the right forearm: a rounded plated shell with raised horizontal ridges on the outer face, a stepped lower cuff, and an open back around a short octagonal barrel-like cylinder.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Power.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and lower cuff; colour 3 on the raised ridges, the inset slots and the octagonal cylinder in the back opening.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Power.description: A right-forearm bracer of smooth, faceted armor plating that tapers toward the wrist, with a flared cuff of angular fins at the wrist and a pointed ridge running along the outer edge. Sits over the forearm in a sci-fi armor style.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Power.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate; colour 1 on the wrist cuff fins and the outer ridge along the arm.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Steam.description: A short tapered steampunk bracer worn on the right forearm: a wide riveted band at the top, a segmented tube below, and an open window on the outer side showing interlocking gear plates in a metal frame.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Steam.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tapered tube, frame and top cap; colour 1 on the riveted upper band; colour 3 on the gear panel inside the window; colour 2 in the shadowed gaps between the gears.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A chunky octagonal armour band worn around the right upper arm, with raised rims at top and bottom, a segmented ribbed front panel and a smooth plated back with small rivets.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the ribbed front panel; colour 0 on the smooth back plate and inner lining (glossy metal look).

Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Light_01.description: A short, slightly tapered armband worn around the right upper arm, with an angular faceted rim and contrasting trim at both edges, and a small round gem-like stud on the outer side. Suggests a simple superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band body; colour 1 on the trim along both edges; colour 3 on the round stud.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Vibroman_01.description: A plain tapered plate bracer worn on the right forearm near the wrist, flaring wider toward the elbow with faceted edges and one raised pointed flap rising on the outer side. Simple armored superhero look.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Tight_Vibroman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bracer plate; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestattachr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A bulky mechanical bracer on the right forearm: an angular armored shell with a tall forked prong rising toward the elbow, a looped hose along the outer edge, a cylindrical nozzle port at the back and a small cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Chestattachr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell and prong; colour 2 on the edge trim and looped hose; colour 1 on the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Chestcapelayer_Firefighter_Jack.description: A short, open-ended band of jacket hem that wraps around the hips like a low peplum or skirt, with a loose rounded silhouette and a thin contrasting edge along the top. It sits below the waist and ends at the upper thigh.
Female/F_Chestcapelayer_Firefighter_Jack.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the band; colour 1 on the thin trim along the top edge.

Female/F_Chestlayer_4arm_Spikeleft_01.description: A single curved horn-like spike jutting outward and upward from the left shoulder, tapering to a sharp point, with cracked stone-like texture and a flared base collar that sits against the shoulder.
Female/F_Chestlayer_4arm_Spikeleft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cracked main body of the spike; colour 1 on the tip and upper tapered end; colour 3 on the flared base collar.

Female/F_Chestlayer_4arm_Spikeright_01.description: A single curved horn-like spike jutting outward and upward from the right shoulder, with a cracked, segmented surface and a flared rounded base that sits against the shoulder. Suggests a monstrous or mechanical armor accent.
Female/F_Chestlayer_4arm_Spikeright_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the spike; colour 1 on the pointed tip; colour 3 on the flared base at the shoulder.

Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Jacket_01.description: A cropped, open-front bomber-style jacket with short puffy ruched sleeves, a thick padded rolled collar and lapels, shoulder panels with tech details, and a wide band at the waist; sits at the ribs with banded cuffs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the padded collar, lapels and cuff bands; colour 2 on the waist band and shoulder trim; colour 3 on small cuff indicators.

Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Jacketstraps_01.description: A cropped, short-sleeved bomber-style jacket with a thick padded rolled collar, ruched sleeves with banded tech cuffs, and a diagonal chest harness strap ending in a round buckle above a wide waist band.
Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Jacketstraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the padded collar, front edging and cuff bands; colour 2 on the waist band and shoulder piping; colour 3 on the round chest buckle.
Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Jacketstraps_01.differs: The female jacket hangs open with a visible chest harness and more fitted, ruched sleeves, and no side pocket accents.

Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_01.description: A harness of two narrow patterned straps that cross over the chest and back, joined by a round central clasp at the sternum, with a short tail strap hanging below. Circuit-like panel details give it a mechanical 90s look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the strap webbing; colour 2 on the strap end tabs and circuit-panel sections; colour 0 on the fine line details; colour 3 on the round clasp and small inset markings.
Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_01.differs: The straps cross only on the back and meet in a single V at the chest, with the tail strap hanging from the clasp.

Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_02.description: A partial chest harness of narrow circuit-patterned straps that cross over the shoulders and chest and criss-cross on the back, with two round pods at the sternum and a small buckled plate cluster at the lower chest. Techy 90s look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the strap bodies; colour 2 on the circuit-pattern segments and end caps; colour 3 on the round pods; colour 0 on small details of the lower plates.
Female/F_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_02.differs: The female harness crosses the straps in an X over the chest, with the pods sitting close together at the bust.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Amazon_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting armored cuirass with curved etched lines, a contrasting chest yoke with a small flower emblem and rounded shoulder caps. Wrapped cloth bands cinch the waist, with long tabbed strips hanging as a skirt over the hips.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the breastplate and the wrapped waist bands; colour 1 on the chest yoke and the trim along the belt and strip tips; colour 2 on the shoulder caps, etched lines and belt band; colour 3 on the flower emblem and strip markings.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Amazon_01.differs: The female version's hanging strips are shorter and set more toward the front, leaving the hips less covered than the male version.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Anniversary16_2025_0.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting qipao dress with a high mandarin collar, knot-button fastenings across the chest and a small bow at the waist. It has an asymmetric knee-length hem, a side slit and a large bird motif at the lower front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Anniversary16_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main dress body; colour 0 on the bird motif, knot fastenings, piping along the hem and slit, and the underlayer showing at the slit; colour 2 on the small fringe at the collar.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Anniversary16_2025_0.differs: The female version is a full sleeveless dress that reaches the knee, with a slit and bird motif.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Anniversary_Mechanon.description: A sleeveless, waist-length mechanical chest piece: sculpted plating with a segmented ribbed abdomen, a pointed collar plate, hand-like clamps at the sides of the bust, and a spine ridge of overlapping plates down the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Anniversary_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder, collar and back plates; colour 1 on the bust, abdomen ribs and spine ridge; colour 2 on the side clamps, hoses and waist band; colour 3 on the small dots.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Anniversary_Mechanon.differs: The female version has sculpted bust cups in the front panel, where the male has a flatter chest plate with a wider, broader ribbed abdomen panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Patterned_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped armored vest with padded cups, a large V-shaped inset panel front and back, and contrasting outlined seams and armholes. It sits over the chest and ends at the ribs, with a sporty superhero look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the V-shaped inset panel front and back; colour 2 on the outlining edge piping and seams.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Retro_Destroye.description: A sleeveless, cropped armored chest piece with a glossy shell, a pointed V-shaped front plate, an angular chevron band across the upper chest and one large cupped shoulder guard, edged in contrasting trim.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Retro_Destroye.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chevron band; colour 1 on the pointed front plate; colour 2 on the main body shell; colour 3 on the shoulder cups, collar edge and outline trim.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Retro_Destroye.differs: The female version has a darker glossy shell with only a single central chevron band and pointed plate, and the shoulder cups sit less prominently.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Retroscifi_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped chest plate with a faceted, hammered surface, deep V neckline and sculpted bust cups. It wraps the torso and shoulders like a light breastplate, ending at the ribs, with a retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Retroscifi_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plate surface and edge highlights; colour 1 on the shaded underside and side panels. The metallic default material mostly mutes the colour scheme.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Retroscifi_01.differs: The female plate has sculpted, rounded bust cups and a narrower waist, where the male version is a flatter, broader pectoral shape.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Victory_01.description: A sleeveless, corset-style superhero vest with a deep V neckline, a large panel over the bust tapering to a point down the belly, curved swooping stripes on the back, small shoulder caps, and a pointed hem at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the bust and centre panel; colour 2 on the outlining swooping stripes; colour 3 on the shoulder caps, neckline insert and hem piping.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Armor_Victory_01.differs: The female version has a narrower corset-like waist and a contrasting panel that splits into separate bust cups joined by a tapering centre strip.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Armored_01.description: A sleeveless mechanical chest armor piece: rounded plated breast shells, a central sternum plate with a small inset gem-like emblem, a narrow panel down the abdomen, layered fin-like plates at the ribs and a pointed back plate.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest shells, collar plate and back plate; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and abdomen strip; colour 1 on the layered rib plates; colour 3 on the sternum emblem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Armorninja.description: A short, cropped ninja-style armored chest piece: segmented plates over the chest and shoulders, a V-shaped centre panel tapering to a point at the sternum, a separate band across the bust, and small pads on each shoulder.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central V panel, shoulder caps and lower tip; colour 1 on the main plates and side panels; colour 2 on the band across the bust and back panel; colour 3 on the tops of the shoulder pads.
