Female/F_Chestlayer_Bounty_01.description: A partial chest armour plate with a rounded upper plate framing a hexagonal central gem, a segmented lower plate with angled side panels, and a matching back plate plus a small flared cloth panel at one shoulder.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest plate and the cloth shoulder panel; colour 3 on the central hexagonal gem; colour 1 on the angled side panels and back band; colour 2 on the plate rims and lower back edge.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Bounty_02.description: A sleeveless armored vest-tunic with a chest plate bearing a hexagonal emblem, one rounded shoulder pad, a diagonal bandolier of small cartridge-like canisters, and separate front and back tabs below the waist. Sci-fi frontier style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, front and back tabs; colour 1 on the side and lower torso panels; colour 2 on the trim edging, shoulder pad and collar; colour 3 on the emblem, canisters and strap button.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, sleeveless cardboard-box vest worn over the torso, with flat rectangular shoulder flaps, large armholes, a crossed pair of tape strips on the front and small tape patches on the back; crumpled, worn edges give a makeshift look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box body; colour 1 on the shoulder flaps; colour 3 on the crossed tape strips, tape patches and flap stripes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Cardboard_01.differs: The female box is a little shorter and more tapered at the waist, with shoulder flaps that sit more upright.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Chainlock_01.description: Heavy metal chains wrapped in a tangled criss-cross web around the torso, over the chest and back, with a padlock fastened at the front of the sternum. Worn over a top as a layered, gritty accessory.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 3 on the padlock keyhole.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Chainlock_01.differs: The padlock sits at the front of the chest, and the chains form a fairly open, loose web around the bust and ribs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Bounty_01.description: A partial armored chest piece: a rounded-octagonal upper plate with a hexagonal centre gem, a segmented lower plate with angled side panels, and a small flap over one shoulder. Rests on the chest and ribs over tights, with a ridged back plate.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate face, lower plates and shoulder flap; colour 2 on the plate rim and the lower back edge; colour 1 on the angled side panels and the back stripe; colour 3 on the centre gem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_01.description: Two small radio-style clip-on boxes with coiled and trailing cables, one at each side of the upper chest; the cords dangle down and loop around the torso. A minimal tactical accessory layer rather than a full vest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box housings; colour 1 on the coiled cables and the back of one box.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_02.description: A pair of side-by-side ammunition magazine pouches worn low at the waist, each a boxy ribbed case with a lower segmented section and a bullet tip poking out of the top; military utility styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper magazine bodies; colour 0 on the lower ribbed sections; colour 2 on the bullet tips.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_02.differs: The female magazines sit flat against the front of the waist, while the male ones hang lower at the hip.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Jacket_Holiday.description: A flared, skirt-like hip wrap with a front split that opens down the centre, vertical stripe panels, and a thick ragged fur-like trim around the hem. It sits at the hips and reaches the upper thigh, with a festive winter feel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Jacket_Holiday.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fabric; colour 3 on the vertical stripes and edge piping; colour 2 on the fur-like hem trim.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_01.description: A minimal set of small curved shoulder caps that perch on top of each shoulder, plus thin cuff rings at both wrists. Leaves the torso and arms bare, suggesting a light superhero accent layer.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder caps and wrist cuffs; the shoulder caps show a hint of colour 1 on their undersides.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_01.differs: The shoulder caps are smaller and thinner than the male version.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_02.description: Tiny thin cuff bands at each wrist, barely visible as narrow rings where the sleeve of the body meets the hands. A minimal accent with no other visible construction.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist bands; the rest of the piece is too small to distinguish other slots.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt.description: A small chest panel that hangs from a curved neckline edge over the chest and ends in a ragged, jagged hem at the ribs. It fades from light at the top to a richer shade toward the bottom, giving a torn sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the neckline trim; colour 0 on the upper panel, blending into colour 1 toward the jagged lower hem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt.description: A small torn chest panel covering the centre of the chest, with a jagged ragged top edge and a tattered, shredded hem that tapers to points over the stomach. It reads as a ripped-open shirt front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the panel, fading gradually into colour 1 toward the ragged lower edge.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt.differs: The female panel is narrower and longer, tapering to a point over the stomach, with a more V-shaped ragged hem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A pair of tapered, fin-like shoulder vents rising from the tops of the shoulders, each with a glossy metal shell, angled louvre slats down the front and a swept point at the lower edge. Mechanical retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy shell edges and frames; colour 1 on the louvre slats; colour 3 on the inner slat backing; the main shell is a glossy metal that largely ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A small flat metal starburst emblem with eight irregular pointed tips and a raised bevelled edge, one tip longer and forked. It sits on the upper right chest near the shoulder, like a badge.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole emblem face; the default metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A small flat metal emblem shaped like an irregular eight-pointed star with a raised rim, worn on the upper left chest near the shoulder. Suggests a retro mechanical superhero badge.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole emblem face and rim; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A small atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring, sitting flat on the upper right chest near the shoulder. A retro science-themed insignia with no other garment parts.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A small flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus, printed on the upper left chest near the shoulder. A tiny retro sci-fi badge with no thickness or other construction.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Strapped_01.description: A small flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, worn on the upper chest just off-centre. It is a thin decal-like badge with a tidy science-themed look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Child_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the outlines and edges of the rings.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundrel.description: A long-sleeved cropped jacket with a shoulder yoke and banded cuffs, joined to a long open-front skirt coat that splits at the front and hangs to the shins, with ragged slashed hems and a central panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundrel.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulders, sleeves and lower skirt panels; colour 0 on the chest band, cuff bands and outer skirt edges; colour 2 on the back, sleeve backs, waist panel and cuff bands; colour 3 on the shoulder accents and the underskirt stripes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundrel.differs: The female coat has a cropped top over a long split skirt with slashed hems and striped underlayer, while the male version is a shorter, hip-length coat with strapped panels and a wide open lapel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Coat_Victorian_01.description: A long-sleeved, cropped Victorian-style jacket with wide lapels, a contrasting yoke and banded cuffs, ending at the ribs, with short flared tails at the hips that open at the sides.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Coat_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest and upper sleeves; colour 2 on the upper back, inner front and sleeve backs; colour 0 on the lapels, lower torso band and forearm cuffs; colour 3 on the hip tails.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Coat_Victorian_01.differs: The female coat is a cropped jacket ending at the ribs with short contrasting-slot flared hip tails, instead of the male's long open coat skirt.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Cog_01.description: A sleeveless steampunk chest harness: a paneled cuirass with a contrasting collar ring, a central round contrasting lens housing, a small lower lens at the belt band, shoulder pads with tube frames, and a back-mounted cylinder canister with a tall antenna ending in a lens.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Cog_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and back panels; colour 1 on the wire frame, shoulder trim and canister rings; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder pads, waist band and housings; colour 3 on the lenses.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Combat_Vest_01.description: A tactical plate-carrier vest with thick padded shoulder straps, front and back panels with horizontal webbing rows, elastic side bands, and magazine pouches with a cord at the front. Sits over the torso and ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Combat_Vest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest panels, shoulder pads and side bands; colour 1 on the webbing stripes, magazine pouches and cord; colour 2 on the edge piping and straps; colour 3 on the strap tabs and small tie loops.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Corrupted_01.description: A sleeveless armored chest piece with rounded shoulder caps, a raised open collar, bust cups and a pointed, segmented lower plate that ends above the waist. Outlined panel seams and a small pendant give it a sleek, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder and upper chest plates; colour 2 on the bust cups, collar interior and seam outlines; colour 1 on the lower segmented plates and collar trim; colour 3 on the small pendant.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Cosmos_01.description: A glossy sculpted chest layer of two curved shell-like panels that cup the bust and sweep up over the shoulders, tapering into a V down the torso to a pointed tip at the waist; sleek sci-fi armour look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Default glossy metal material largely ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows a metallic finish, with slight contrast on the edge trim from the scheme.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Cosmos_01.differs: The female version forms rounded cup shapes over the bust, with shoulder panels that stand more upright and less wide.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Crimson_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length armoured corset top with a sculpted winged chest plate, cap-like shoulder pieces, a textured quilted midsection and contrasting outlined edging. It sits over the torso like a superhero bodice.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder caps and the textured lower panel; colour 1 on the side and centre panels beneath the chest plate; colour 3 on the chest and upper back plates; colour 2 on the outlines, collar and shoulder linings.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Crimson_01.differs: The female version has an open cut-out in the lower back, while the male version's back is fully closed with a textured panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Cryo_01.description: A pair of woven webbing loops that run over each shoulder and under the arm like backpack straps, each with a small chunky buckle clasp on the upper chest. Sits over the torso with a tactical, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbing straps; colour 1 on the buckle housings; colour 2 on the buckle ends and hardware.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Cryo_02.description: A sleeveless cropped armored chest piece with segmented plates, capped shoulders and two round vent pods on the chest and back. A thick ribbed hose loops under the chest, joined by a small central connector.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the armor plates and connector; colour 2 on the vent pods; colour 3 on the ribbed hose and vent markings.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A short cropped bib-like shoulder layer with a high round neck, wide flared shoulder wings and a straight lower hem, edged in contrasting trim, with two small vertical tab clasps hanging at the front and back hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the clasp tabs; colour 3 on the small indicator dots on the tabs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Deity_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted armored chest piece with a molded bust, layered segmented plates down the torso, a V-shaped collar with a small gem at the centre and a pointed lower plate at the waist. Cupped shoulder openings; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bust plates, waist band and back side panels; colour 1 on the collar, lower waist plate and back centre; colour 2 on the mid-torso plates and back top; colour 3 on the centre gem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Deity_01.differs: The female version has a molded, rounded bust shape and a lower, pointed neckline, while the male version has a flatter chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Dinosuit_01.description: A loose, long-sleeved crew-neck sweatshirt ending at the waist, with a quilted padded panel down the chest, banded cuffs and a row of triangular dinosaur-style spikes running down the centre of the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sweater body and sleeves; colour 1 on the quilted chest panel; colour 2 on the back spikes and cuff bands.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Dinosuit_02.description: A loose, puffy long-sleeved crew-neck sweater ending at the waist, with gathered cuffs and hem and a quilted, segmented padded panel across the front of the chest. Casual, cartoonish look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Dinosuit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sweater body, sleeves and collar; colour 1 on the quilted chest panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Draco_01.description: A sleeveless armoured chest piece with bulbous shoulder and chest plates, a raised angular collar, and a fitted lower band. A long spined, scaled tail panel runs down the back to below the hips, and a short plated flap hangs at the front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and shoulder plates; colour 2 on the chest plates and tail armour segments; colour 1 on the lower band and tail scales; colour 3 on the gems and back spikes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Element_Fire_01.description: A pair of separate flame-shaped cups sitting over the chest like a bra, each swept into curling, pointed tongues of fire that flick outward and upward; glossy sculpted surface, with a hollow smooth back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Default glossy material largely ignores the scheme on the flame fronts; colour 1 shows on the smooth inner back of each cup.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Element_Water_01.description: A diagonal sash-like sweep of glossy liquid-looking metal running from one shoulder across the chest to the opposite hip, with a curling splash crest at the shoulder and droplet-tipped tendrils along its length.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; a hint of colour 3 shows in the inner fold near the shoulder, with the rest showing a reflective sheen.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Element_Water_01.differs: The female version is a slimmer swoosh with a tall splash crest at the shoulder and droplets clustered at the lower end, while the male has a broader, more open scoop with droplets bunched along the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Amazon_01.description: A thick cloth sash wrapped in several gathered, crinkled layers around the waist, tied in a knot at the front with two short hanging tails. Suggests a martial or tribal look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole sash, including the knot and tails; the inner edge shows a darker shade.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Amazon_01.differs: The knot sits slightly off-centre toward the wearer's left, and the wraps cross more visibly at the back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Bounty_01.description: A narrow bandolier strap worn diagonally across the chest from one shoulder to the opposite hip, with a boxy buckle housing on the shoulder and a cluster of stick-like explosive canisters along the chest. Space western look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap's main band; colour 1 on the strap edging; colour 2 on the shoulder housing and canister bands; colour 3 on the button and canister ends.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Bounty_03.description: A small rectangular plate covering the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a smooth flat front face and a wavy-edged layered back of segmented bands. Suggests a sci-fi frontier armor panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Bounty_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face and upper back plate; colour 1 on the middle wavy band; colour 2 on the lower band.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Chainlock_01.description: A heavy chain wrapped in several tangled loops around the ribcage and midriff, with a loose length of links rising diagonally across the front. It sits over the torso like a bound restraint or improvised belt.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; the metal reads mostly as a glossy steel finish and shows little of the other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Cog_01.description: A mechanical harness of thin bent tubing that arcs over both shoulders and hooks under the collarbones, carrying a horizontal canister with ringed end caps on the upper back. Grip-like sleeves sit on each strap.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Cog_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tubing frame and the end-cap coils; colour 0 on the canister body; colour 2 on the canister rings and the sleeves on the straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Cog_02.description: A small mechanical backpack accessory: an octagonal gauge-like housing with a recessed dial, mounted on a short segmented post with a side knob and a bent metal rod. It rises beside the head from the upper back, a steampunk gadget.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Cog_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the octagonal housing and post; colour 3 on the recessed dial face; colour 1 on the side knob; colour 0 on the bent metal rod.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Corrupted_01.description: A wide, flat sailor-style collar layer resting over the shoulders and upper chest, with a raised inner neck band, a contrasting inner panel, scalloped points across the back and a small pointed gem at the front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar; colour 1 on the inner panel band; colour 2 on the edge trim and inner neck lining; colour 3 on the front pointed gem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Cryo_02.description: A single ribbed, segmented flexible hose or cable that wraps around the torso just under the chest, with both loose ends curling up in front. It suggests a mechanical cryogenic coolant line worn as an accessory.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole ribbed tube; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Draco_01.description: A thin angular metal collar that stands up around the neck and drops to a sharp V point at the upper chest, with a separate inner edge band. Sits as a partial jacket layer over the shoulders.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar edge and rim; colour 2 on the inner band and underside of the collar.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Draco_02.description: A narrow, tapering dragon-tail plate that hangs from the lower back around the hip to a point at the thigh, with segmented banded panels at the front, scaled overlapping plates and a row of spikes down the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scaled outer shell; colour 3 on the spikes down the back; colour 0 on the light front cap; colour 2 on the banded segments and gaps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_01.description: A set of bony, horn-like spikes on the upper back: two curved, segmented horns rising from each shoulder blade near the neck, plus a vertical line of three shrinking blade-shaped spikes down the spine. Monstrous, organic hybrid look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn tips and the smallest spine spike; colour 3 on the banded rings of the horns; colour 1 on the upper spine spike and the base of the lowest spike; colour 2 on the middle spine spike.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_02.description: A set of curved horn-like spikes rising from the upper back and neck line, with three large tapered horns on top and two smaller spikes running down the spine. Bone-like, monstrous accent with no garment.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large horn shafts and the small lower spike's base; colour 0 on the horn tips and the lowest small spike; colour 2 on the middle spike.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_02.differs: The female horns are slimmer and more upright, and sit closer together around the neck.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_01.description: A sleeveless, corset-like armoured vest with a high stand collar, a contrasting collar yoke with piping, shoulder flaps, studded front panels and a wide banded waist ending in a pointed hem with a small front pouch-like clasp.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main vest body and back panels; colour 0 on the chest inset and waist band edges; colour 1 on the collar and waist strap; colour 3 on the piping, studs and front buckle.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_02.description: A wide, plain utility belt with a textured band worn at the natural waist, closed by a square front buckle plate and two small vertical strap keepers on either side. Utilitarian, prison-issue style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the square buckle plate; colour 3 on the two strap keepers.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_03.description: A wide waist belt with overlapping angular armour plates hanging in a pointed tapering panel at the front and back, plus spiked plates flaring at the hips. Sits at the waist over the hips with a heavy, mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt band; colour 0 on the angular plates; colour 2 on the darker upper plate edges.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_03.differs: The female version is a belt with large overlapping angular armour plates hanging front, back and at the hips, while the male version is a plain belt with a thin strap.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Detecti.description: A detective-style jacket collar piece: a tall standing collar around the neck with two large pointed lapels that fall open down the chest to a sharp point, edged with contrasting trim. Only the collar and lapels are present, with no sleeves or body.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Detecti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lapel and collar surfaces; colour 2 on the outer edge trim and inner collar lining.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Frigid_.description: A tall standing collar that wraps the neck and upper shoulders, open at the front with pointed, stepped tips. It has a quilted textured lining, a contrasting piped edge and a centre back seam. Sleek superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Frigid_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer collar shell; colour 2 on the edge piping and seam; colour 0 on the quilted inner lining.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Frigid_.differs: The front tips of the collar are shorter and the back panel hangs a little lower to a pointed drop.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Ghosthu.description: A minimal chest-layer jacket that shows only as a raised atom emblem across the upper back, with looping orbital rings around a hexagonal core. Nothing else is visible on the torso, so it works as a superhero or sci-fi back badge.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Ghosthu.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the atom emblem outlines; colour 0 on the emblem fill within the rings.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Goth_01.description: A slim, open-fronted cloth waistband that wraps around the hips and back, with one long strap hanging down the outer left thigh and a small buttoned tab at the other front end. Reads as a partial goth jacket remnant.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and hanging strap; colour 3 on the small button on the front tab.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Goth_02.description: A narrow open-fronted collar-like band that wraps around the hips like a low belt, with folded, pointed ends at the front that do not meet and one small button on a tab. Gothic shirt-collar styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and folded ends; colour 3 on the small button.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Harajuk.description: Two small clusters of chunky cartoon pin badges on the upper chest: a smiley, a grinning skull and a heart on one side, a bear head, small face and bob-haired girl on the other. Cute harajuku street style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Harajuk.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and small round faces; colour 1 on the bear head and the girl's hair; colour 2 on the heart and the small round pin; colour 3 on the smiley face and the girl's face.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Harajuk.description: A scatter of small cute enamel-style pins on the upper chest and shoulder: a heart, a smiley face, a bear head, a girl-face badge and a few small studs near the collar. There is no garment, only the pins.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Harajuk.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bear face pin; colour 1 on the girl's hair and the small bear-shaped pin; colour 3 on the smiley face and the girl's face; colour 2 on the heart and the small studs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Holiday.description: A soft, draped hood-collar worn bunched around the neck and upper shoulders, open at the front with two pointed tips that hang down the chest. It has a wrinkled cloth shell, a lining and a trim along the edge. Casual winter style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Holiday.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer cloth and lining; colour 3 on the edge trim along the opening.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Leather.description: A small atom-symbol emblem applied flat on the upper back, made of interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus. It has no jacket body visible, only the outlined badge design.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Leather.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the emblem outline; the rest of the emblem shows the body beneath.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Leather.description: A flat emblem printed on the upper back: an atom symbol of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a hexagonal centre ring. It sits flush on the body with no garment volume, suggesting a science-themed superhero look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Leather.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit bands and inner ring fill; colour 1 on the outlines of the atom symbol.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Nightma.description: A flat decorative back emblem rather than a full jacket: an atom-like design of interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central ring, sitting on the upper back between the shoulder blades. Nothing shows on the front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Nightma.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the atom outline; the rest of the piece has no other visible features.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_01.description: A small dress-shirt insert with a folded-down pointed collar, a narrow front panel and a slim necktie hanging down the chest. It sits at the neck and upper chest, giving a sharp spy or office look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt collar and front panel; colour 2 on the necktie.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_01.differs: The female collar and shirt front are shorter and sit closer to the neck, and the tie is shorter.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_02.description: A small high stand-up collar that wraps the neck, with a long pointed bib tapering down the chest and a triangular flap dropping over the upper back. A single round fastener sits at the throat. Spy-style neckpiece.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, chest point and outer surfaces; colour 2 on the inner back flap; colour 3 on the throat fastener.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_02.differs: The female collar is slightly smaller and its chest point is longer and narrower, with a shorter, tighter back flap.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_01.description: A short band-like jacket piece that wraps as a wide, slightly faceted ring around the midriff, with a thin contrasting rim at the top edge. It leaves the chest and hips bare, so it reads as a small toy-like cummerbund.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main band; colour 0 on the thin rim along the top edge.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_02.description: A short, flared cloth skirt-like layer sitting at the waist and ending at the upper thigh, with a gathered elastic waistband, a row of four buttons down one side of the front and thin contrasting piping along the hem and side seam.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt body; colour 1 on the piping along the hem and side seam; colour 2 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_02.differs: The female version is a slimmer, snug skirt with a gathered waistband and shorter hem, while the male version is a stiffer, more flared kilt-like shape.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Bel.description: A wide waist belt with a heart-shaped buckle plate and small stud lights, plus a broad flat sash that runs from the belt diagonally over one shoulder and across the back. Toy-soldier style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Bel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diagonal sash and the rear band of the belt; colour 2 on the belt body and buckle plate; colour 1 on the belt clips; colour 3 on the small studs on the buckle.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Bel.differs: The female buckle plate shows a clear heart shape and the sash crosses higher over the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Bel.description: A wide toy-soldier style belt sitting at the waist, with a square front buckle plate showing a heart motif and small studs, plus several vertical strap loops around the band and a fabric-textured panel along the sides.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Bel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heart motif and the fabric side and back panels; colour 1 on the vertical strap loops; colour 2 on the belt band and buckle plate; colour 3 on the small studs on the buckle.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Bel.differs: The female version has a buckle plate with a heart emblem, contrasting studs and vertical strap loops, while the male version is a plain band.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Tie.description: A long, narrow necktie hanging down the centre of the chest, with a small knot at the collar and a pointed tip near the waist; the front shows a glossy metallic striped panel. Casual office or novelty style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Tie.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tie body and back; colour 3 on the knot; colour 2 on the front panel behind the stripes; the diagonal stripes look metallic and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Urban_0.description: A pair of small atom-symbol patches, each with three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus, sitting on the outer upper arms. Thin decorative line work with tiny stray marks, suggesting a sci-fi emblem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Urban_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main orbit rings of the atom emblem; colour 1 on the inner nucleus and secondary outlines; colour 2 on the small stray marks around the patch.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_01.description: A short armored midriff corset covering the abdomen, with a sculpted segmented ab-plate panel on the front, notched lower edges, and overlapping layered plates across the lower back. Suggests a mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front ab plates and the inside top; colour 3 on the main corset body; colour 0 on the back plates and edge trim; colour 2 on the small side inserts.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_01.differs: The female version's inside top is a contrasting-slotted surface and the back plates are smaller and narrower, sitting slightly lower.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_02.description: A partial, sculpted high collar and shoulder mantle: layered stacked ridges rise around the neck, flanked by a wide flared outer shell that dips to a point at the chest and back, with contrasting claw-like spikes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the stacked inner neck ridges; colour 3 on the outer flared shell and inner lining; colour 2 on the claw spikes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_02.differs: The female version has a deeper V at the chest, with the shell tapering to a narrower front point and three claws, and sits closer to the neck.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_03.description: A pair of small monstrous shoulder guards in organic, fleshy-looking shells studded with contrasting conical spikes and larger curved horns sweeping outward, perched on top of the shoulders without covering the arms or torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulder shell bodies; colour 2 on the spikes and horns.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Light_01.description: A pair of short, cuff-like upper-arm bands with a puffed, cap-sleeve shape, each stacked with several ridged tiers and thin contrasting edging. They sit over the upper arms and shoulders, suggesting a light superhero or mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of each sleeve band; colour 0 on the thin edging and ridge lines between the tiers; colour 2 on the inner opening.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_01.description: A bulky mechanical helmet shell that covers the head, with rounded side plates, an open face notch at the front and a squared chin-guard block. Small vent slats sit on each side of the face opening.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rounded shell plates and edge highlights; colour 2 on the face frame, chin block and inner lining; colour 3 on the vent slats.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_01.differs: The female helmet is more upright and the side plates are taller, with a deeper V-shaped face opening.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_02.description: A angular mecha half-visor shell that arches over one side of the head and slopes down across the eye and cheek, with a hollow inner shell, a chunky bottom edge and two chevron markings on the outer face.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 3 on the chevron markings; colour 2 on the inner shell lining.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_02.differs: The female visor sits smaller and tighter on one side of the head, covering the cheek less broadly than the male version.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Ironcla.description: A sculpted armour bra-style chest piece with two cupped plates that sweep up into pointed horn-like tips, joined by a angular central plate and a wraparound band under the bust. Sits over the chest only, with a sci-fi, mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Ironcla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cup plates, horn tips and central plate; colour 1 on the inset triangular panels of the cups and the chevron on the back band; colour 3 on the central gem-like emblem; colour 2 on the edge outlines.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Sapphir.description: A short cropped chest panel that wraps around the bust like a tube top, with a rounded hourglass-shaped emblem patch on the front. It sits over the upper torso as a simple superhero-style chest insert.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Sapphir.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel; colour 1 on the hourglass-shaped emblem patch.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Witchcr.description: A small chest clasp: two round disc buttons with star-shaped centres at the upper chest, joined by two flat straps that cross in an X between them. Reads as a decorative fastening, not a full garment.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Witchcr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossed straps; colour 1 on the disc rims and faces; colour 2 on the star-shaped centres.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Mutated_01.description: A set of curved horn-like spikes and small thorns that jut out from the upper arms and sides of the ribs. Two large curved blades sit on one side, with clusters of small spines on the other arm. Reads as a mutated, monstrous add-on.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large curved horn blades; colour 1 on the small spines and thorns and on the tips of the horns.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Talisman.description: A strapless bandeau-style bust piece made of two rounded cups joined by a small V-shaped band across the lower chest. It sits over the bust only and has no straps or sleeves, suggesting a retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Talisman.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole piece, both cups and the joining band; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_.description: A stiff, faceted metal neck collar that rises high behind the head and curves round to the sides, open at the front. Its angular panels give a retro sci-fi armored look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_.colourAreas: The default material is glossy metal and mostly ignores the colour scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on the collar.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_.differs: The collar's front tips end a little lower and sit closer together at the throat, with a slightly shorter back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_.description: A pair of small, separate curved shoulder caps that sit on top of the shoulders, each an angular faceted shell with a raised top plate and a metallic lower edge. Retro sci-fi armor styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised top plate of each cap; colour 0 on the lower faceted edge; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Scarab_01.description: A pair of curved, horn-like scarab pincers that rest on the shoulders and sweep down over the upper chest, each with a long smooth segmented shaft ending in a sharp hooked tip, separated by a small band.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long shafts; colour 2 on the small bands between shaft and tip; colour 3 on the hooked tips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Scarab_02.description: A pair of curved, horn-like mechanical blades mounted at the shoulders. Each sweeps up past the neck as a barbed spur and hooks down over the upper chest in a tapered claw. Suggests an insectoid, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper barbed spurs; colour 1 on the lower curved claws; colour 3 on the sharp tips and small end spikes; colour 2 on the small joints.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Shirt_Goth_02.description: A sleeveless, close-fitting torso layer with a scooped neckline and shaped bust, worn over the chest and ending at the waist with a slightly curved hem; it has a smooth gradient between two colours.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Shirt_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest of the shirt, fading into colour 1 on the lower torso and hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Shirt_Goth_02.differs: The female version has a scooped neckline and a shaped bust, where the male has a straight neckline.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Stealarachnid_.description: A small faceted diamond-shaped gem or plate, an elongated double pyramid, sitting at the centre of the upper chest near the collar like a brooch. Sleek and angular, with a mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Stealarachnid_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole diamond piece; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Steampunk_Jack.description: A tall, flared standing collar that wraps around the back and sides of the neck and dips low at the front, with a piped edge. It sits at the neck and suggests a steampunk jacket collar.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Steampunk_Jack.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body; colour 1 on the piped edge trim.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Steelcommando_.description: A small shield-shaped metal plate worn on the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a pointed top crest, faceted edges and tapering to a point. A raised chevron groove and rim decorate the outer face.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Steelcommando_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate body and rim; colour 3 on the raised chevron lines; colour 0 on the top crest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Steelcommando_.differs: The female plate curves more tightly and sits slightly angled to the back, with a bulkier stacked crest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Strapped_01.description: A round mechanical chest emblem: a domed central disc in a contrasting ring, set in a bevelled outer rim ringed with small pointed spikes. It sits centred on the upper chest over the tights, with a flat back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim; colour 1 on the domed centre and the inner ring; colour 2 on the ring and its small tabs; colour 3 on the outer spikes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Super_Retro_De.description: A short, waist-cinching band of segmented armor plating around the midsection, with a padded panel on the front and a hanging pouch-like flap below it. Retro mechanical supervillain look, worn over the tights.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Super_Retro_De.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim of the band; colour 2 on the main band and lower front flap; colour 1 on the padded front panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Super_Retro_De.differs: The female version has a narrower, corseted band with a smaller front panel and a longer hanging flap, sitting slightly lower.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_01.description: Two oversized four-hole sewing buttons with raised rims and recessed centres, stacked vertically on the chest and stomach like a stuffed toy's stitched-on fastenings. Flat-backed discs that sit on the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rims and the flat backs; colour 1 on the recessed button faces; colour 2 on the thread holes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_02.description: A thick, padded cloth scarf looped around the neck, with one long narrow tail hanging down the front of the chest to the waist. It is patterned with scattered heart shapes, giving a cute, casual look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scarf fabric; colour 1 on some of the hearts and the tail tip; colour 2 on the other hearts; colour 3 on the fine stitched speckles.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_02.differs: The tail hangs a little further down, ending near the waist, and drapes over the chest curve.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_03.description: A thick, soft scarf looped around the neck with one long tail hanging down the front of the chest, patterned with hearts and carrying two large four-hole buttons along the tail. A cute, plush, patchwork look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scarf fabric and button rims; colour 1 on the buttons and the heart patches; colour 2 on the button holes and the other hearts.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Brutal_0.description: A pair of wide crossing straps forming an X across the chest and back, looping over one shoulder and under the opposite arm, with a row of studs along the edge and small buckled cross-bands at the front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Brutal_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the small cross-bands near the buckles; colour 2 on the buckle hardware; colour 3 on the studs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_.description: A partial armored midriff band of angular plates: two flared side wings, a chevron-shaped centre plate with a V-shaped inset panel, and small round studs. It wraps the lower ribs and waist, and the back has a matching V shape.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side wings and outer plates; colour 2 on the chevron centre plate; colour 1 on the V-shaped inset panel; colour 3 on the round studs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_.differs: The female version sits lower on the waist and has a narrower wrap, while the male version sits higher on the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_.description: A partial chest plate of stacked hexagonal armor segments running down the centre of the chest from the collarbone to the ribs, ending in tapering spear-like tips. Set into the segments are round sockets. Sits flat on the torso, mechanical sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 0 on the raised borders and segment frames; colour 2 on the outer edge rims; colour 3 on the round sockets.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Madjeste.description: A sleeveless, waistcoat-style chest layer covering the bust with a V-cut front, a row of buttons down the centre, and a separate band that wraps the waist and ends in pointed panels at the front. Formal, jester-like look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Madjeste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest panels; colour 1 on the waist band and front points; colour 3 on the buttons; colour 2 on the edge piping.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Symbiote.description: A partial, open-lattice band of thin angular zigzag struts wrapping the midriff, with sharp hooked points at the sides and a central gem-like plate flanked by small angular shards at front and back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Symbiote.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the zigzag lattice struts and hooked points; colour 1 on the central gem plate; colour 3 on the small inset slit in the gem; colour 2 on the flanking angular shards.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Talisman.description: A tall, flared high collar that wraps around the back and sides of the neck and rises to sharp points beside the head. The front is open, tapering to long thin tips down the upper chest. Dramatic, villainous superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Talisman.colourAreas: Colour 0 is not clearly visible; colour 3 on the inner face of the collar; colour 1 on the outer face and the thin edge trim.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Talisman.differs: The female collar stands taller and more upright around the head, with a deeper cut at the front and longer tapering tips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Wolf_02.description: A pair of tall, curved blade-like fins rising from the shoulders and flaring up beside the neck, each with an inner face of swirled decorative panels and a smooth, glossy back. A mechanical, fantasy shoulder accent.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner panel face; colour 1 on the swirl patterns; colour 3 on the textured outer edge trim; colour 2 on the smooth outer backs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_01.description: A short standing collar that wraps the base of the neck, open at the centre front with a slight overlap, layered bands of contrasting trim along the edges and a flared upturned rim. Suits sci-fi and traveller looks.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body and inner lining; colour 1 on the trim band along the lower and upper edges; colour 2 on the thin outer rim edging.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_02.description: A wide, flat mantle collar that rests on the shoulders and around the neck, with a contrasting rim and a contrasting inner lining. It narrows to a pointed spike-like tip down the upper chest. Suggests a sleek traveller look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar surface; colour 2 on the rim, inner lining and front point.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_02.differs: The back of the collar hangs as a short, small point, while the male version's rear point is longer and more pronounced.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Vest_Swing_01.description: A sleeveless formal waistcoat with wide shawl lapels, a stand-up collared shirt front panel and a row of three buttons near the hem; a small pin sits on the lapel. The back is open, showing only the lapel edges.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Vest_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 2 on the lapels; colour 1 on the shirt front panel and collar; colour 3 on the buttons and lapel pin.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Vest_Swing_01.differs: The female vest is cut shorter and more fitted at the waist, with three buttons.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Warrior_02.description: A small shield-shaped chest plate covering the sternum, made of layered chevron-striped ridges that taper to a point below the chest. Flanking side panels with banded edges wrap toward the ribs; the back is a hollow shell.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Extra_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main chevron ridges; colour 0 on the stripes between the ridges and the top edge; colour 3 on the side band edges; colour 2 on the darker side bands.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Fairytop_01.description: A strapless, corset-style bustier ending at the ribs, with sculpted cups edged in jagged leaf-like points, curved side panels and a vertical accent stripe at each side. Fantasy, fairy-like styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Fairytop_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front belly panel and the jagged edge points; colour 1 on the curved side panels; colour 2 on the bust cups; colour 3 on the vertical side stripes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Firefighter_Jacket_0.description: A fitted, long-sleeved padded jacket ending at the hips, with a high rolled collar, a large chest panel, contrasting forearm cuffs and hem band, and a separate panel across the back shoulders and sleeves.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Firefighter_Jacket_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, cuffs and lower hem band; colour 1 on the torso and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the back shoulders and outer sleeves.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Firefighter_Jacket_0.differs: The female jacket has a solid chest panel and colour-blocked upper body with contrasting sleeves and back, not the striped bands and back patches of the male.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Gamer_01.description: A pair of thin suspender-style straps that run over the shoulders and cross into a Y at the upper back, ending at the waist in small clasps with short dangling tabs. Worn over a bodysuit.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 3 on the clasps and the back junction; colour 1 on the dangling tabs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Gamer_01.differs: The front straps run down either side of the chest with the clasps hanging lower, and three tabs cluster at the back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Gladiator_03.description: A sleeveless, glossy semi-transparent chest layer that hugs the torso like a second skin, with a squared shoulder line and a hem at the hips that drops into pointed tails at the front sides and rear.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Gladiator_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole layer; the glossy material largely ignores the other colour slots, and none of them is clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Golden_Age_01.description: A strapless, form-fitting corset with a sculpted sweetheart neckline, a pointed lower front and vertical boning seams; contrasting trim edges the top and hem, and thin loose ties hang at the back hem. Sits over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main corset panels; colour 3 on the top edge, hem trim and vertical boning seams; colour 2 on the small ties at the back hem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Gun_Harness_01.description: A tactical shoulder harness of thin crossing straps with adjustable buckles, joined by a square plate between the shoulder blades. A holster hangs under one arm and a single ammo pouch under the other.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Gun_Harness_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps, holster body and pouch; colour 3 on the back plate, buckle slides and pouch studs; colour 1 on the holster trim; colour 2 on the holster opening.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Gun_Harness_01.differs: The female version has a single flat pouch on the right side, with the straps crossing over the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Gunholster_01.description: A shoulder-and-chest harness of padded armor plates with an octagonal emblem at the chest, a diagonal strap across the torso, and two small pouches hanging at the ribs. Military-tactical sci-fi look, covering only the upper chest and shoulders.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Gunholster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and under-strap band; colour 1 on the straps and edge piping; colour 3 on the emblem, studs and buckle details; colour 2 on the pouches.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Gunholster_01.differs: The female version has a smaller, narrower shoulder plate and the pouches sit lower on the ribs, with a more open neckline.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_01.description: A mechanical diagonal chest harness: a segmented strap crosses the torso from one shoulder to the opposite hip, with a rounded armored shoulder cap and a plated panel on the upper chest, joined by a thin loop strap over the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands and edges; colour 1 on the chest and shoulder plating; colour 2 on the shoulder cap and strap segments; colour 3 on the small round fasteners.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_01.differs: The female version has only the shoulder strap and chest plate, with no ribbed waist band around the midsection.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_02.description: A mechanical chest harness with a diagonal strap running from one shoulder to the opposite hip, a bulky armoured shoulder cap with a padded plate, and a separate triple-banded corset belt around the midriff with small round fasteners.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap edges and belt bands; colour 1 on the shoulder plate and belt bands; colour 2 on the shoulder cap and strap backing; colour 3 on the fasteners and belt cords.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_02.differs: The female version adds a triple-banded waist belt with contrasting-accented cords, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Heraldry_01.description: A sleeveless plate cuirass with a raised stand-up collar, a shield-shaped upper chest panel bearing a sword-like emblem, and curved lower plates ending in a point at the waist. Open armholes; knightly, heraldic look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower plates and bust plates; colour 1 on the collar, upper chest panel and shoulder area; colour 2 on the outlining edges and armhole interiors; colour 3 on the central emblem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Hybrid_01.description: A sculpted organic-mechanical chest armour with swirling ridged panels, a sculpted central chest plate, short rounded shoulder caps and a pointed lower front. contrasting-tipped spikes and a spined back panel rise behind the neck; sleeveless, ending at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, raised ridges and swirling trim; colour 1 on the main armour panels and spikes; colour 2 on the edge inserts at the sides and underarms; colour 3 on the spined back panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Hybrid_01.differs: The female version has only a few spikes rising at the neck, with a smaller contrasting back panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_01.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length restraint-style jacket with a high funnel collar, diagonal harness straps across the chest holding stacked rectangular panels, horizontal stripe bands on the ribs, back and forearms, and small panels on the upper arms.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the chest straps, chest panels, upper-arm patches and back collar strip; colour 3 on the horizontal stripe bands around the ribs, back and sleeves.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_02.description: A sleeveless armoured vest with a V-shaped upper yoke, segmented ribbed plates over the torso, a small chained clasp at the chest, a wide buckled belt band, and a pointed hem with contrasting trim.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper yoke and belt band; colour 2 on the ribbed torso plates; colour 3 on the edge trim and piping; colour 1 on the belt buckle and chain.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_03.description: A sleeveless armored vest with a raised standing collar, a zip-like front strip, shaped shoulder plates, a laced-look contrasting centre panel with small studs, and a banded waist belt with a pointed lower plate and pouch-like buckle.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plates, chest inserts and waist bands; colour 1 on the collar, front strip and belt; colour 2 on the main vest body; colour 3 on the collar edging, studs and belt buckle.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_03.differs: The female vest has a lighter chest insert with a bust-shaped cut and a smoother, more tapered panel down the front.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_05.description: A sleeveless armored vest with a tall, rolled high collar, curved chest plates and short shoulder caps, plus a pointed segmented plate hanging down over the groin and a separate strap belt at the hips. Grim prison-tech look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and back plates and the hanging segmented plates; colour 2 on the high collar; colour 1 on the waist belt and collar edge; colour 3 on the small zipper pull at the chest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Inmate_05.differs: The female version's chest plates are more sculpted, and the shoulder caps are smaller and sit closer to the body.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristocrat_Cl.description: A fitted long-sleeved tailcoat-style jacket with a small folded collar, a contrasting studded front panel down the chest, wide contrasting cuffs, and pointed tails at front and back reaching the upper thigh. Formal, aristocratic look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristocrat_Cl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, collar and tails; colour 1 on the cuffs and collar edge trim; colour 2 on the central chest panel; colour 3 on the studs or dots on the panel and cuffs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristrocrat_O.description: A long-sleeved formal tailcoat with an open front showing a buttoned vest, striped lapel facings, a standing collar, wide turned-back cuffs and a single rounded tail hanging down the back to the knees.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristrocrat_O.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat, vest and tail; colour 1 on the lapel stripes, collar edge and cuff stripes; colour 2 on the lapel facing backing; colour 3 on the vest fastenings.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristrocrat_O.differs: The female tail is narrower and hangs lower from a shorter waist-cut jacket body, with the coat body ending at the hips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Child_Rocker_.description: A short cloth skirt-like jacket layer hanging from the hips to the upper thighs, with a jagged, pointed hem, contrasting outlined seams and small dotted markings; a punk, rocker look that sits loose around the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Child_Rocker_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body; colour 2 on the outlined seams and edge trim; colour 3 on the small dots and accent flashes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Colonial_01.description: A long-sleeved, thigh-length colonial-style coat with a high standing collar, an open front showing a contrasting lining, rows of looped frog-style fastenings across the chest, banded cuffs and a curved, tailed hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Colonial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body and sleeves; colour 1 on the collar and inner lining; colour 3 on the chest loops; colour 2 on the cuffs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Cowboy_Duster.description: A long-sleeved western duster jacket with a short shoulder capelet, a cropped open front with a button row, banded cuffs, and a long split skirt panel falling to the ankles at the back and one side.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Cowboy_Duster.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and long tails; colour 1 on the shoulder capelet and cuff bands; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Cowboy_Duster.differs: The female version has a cropped, waist-length front that leaves the torso open, with the long tail hanging mostly at the back and one side.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Denim_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved casual denim jacket with a wide turned-down collar, a button-up front, two flap pockets and a banded hem and cuffs. It ends at the waist and has a worn, weathered look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Denim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the jacket; colour 1 on the hem band, cuffs and front placket; colour 2 on the collar underside and one sleeve; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Denim_01.differs: The female jacket has one sleeve and the inner collar in a contrasting panel, and shows a weathered, mottled texture instead of a clean surface with small patches.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Detective_01.description: A long-sleeved detective trench coat with wide notched lapels and a high collar, cropped at the waist with a long open skirt panel falling to the ankles, split at the front with vertical trim strips and cuffed sleeves.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body, lapels and skirt; colour 2 on the collar edging and front split strips; colour 1 on the sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on small studs on the skirt front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Detective_01.differs: The female coat is a single uniform light-coloured cloth throughout, with a cropped jacket top and separate long skirt panel, while the male has contrasting upper panels.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Frigid_01.description: A sleeveless, high-collared sci-fi vest-jacket with a fitted torso, rounded shoulder caps, and a tail that sweeps down into long pointed panels at the front and back. Outlined seams and a diamond back emblem give it a sleek, mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the collar lining and the swooping tail spikes; colour 2 on the piping, outlines and shoulder caps; colour 3 on the small back emblem gem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Frigid_01.differs: The female tail flares into longer, more sweeping pointed panels at the front and sides, and the torso is shaped more closely at the waist.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Ghosthunter_0.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length jacket with a V-neck collar flap, two large flap chest pockets, round patches on the upper sleeves, and a gathered elasticated hem. An atom emblem is printed across the upper back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Ghosthunter_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the gathered hem band, the lower body gradient and the atom emblem; colour 3 on the collar flap and chest pockets; colour 2 on the sleeve patches.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Golden_Age_01.description: A cropped long-sleeved jacket with a wide open collar and lapels, loose upper sleeves ending in broad contrasting cuffs, and a boned corset-style bodice with a sweetheart neckline, trimmed edges and vertical seams at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, collar and sleeves; colour 1 on the corset panels; colour 3 on the corset trim, piping and lapel edging; colour 2 on the sleeve cuffs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_01.description: An open-front, long-sleeved jacket with wide contrasting lapels, a single small button, and cuffs in a separate material. The front edges cut away into asymmetric tails, with a thin strap hanging down one side. It ends at the hips.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and the strap; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 2 on the cuffs; colour 3 on the small button.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.description: An open-front short-sleeved jacket with wide lapels and contrasting cuff bands, cropped at the waist. A separate asymmetric skirt-like panel with a front slit and edge trim hangs from the hips to below the knee, giving a lab-coat or gothic look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and lower panel; colour 2 on the lapel, cuff and hem trim; colour 1 on the top worn underneath.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.differs: The female version is a short cropped jacket with a separate hip-hung skirt panel, with a visible gap at the waist.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Harajuku_Trac.description: A cropped, long-sleeved open-front track jacket with a raised collar, stripes down the sleeves, ribbed banded cuffs and hem, a contrasting zip line, and small cute patches on the chest. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Harajuku_Trac.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the sleeve stripes, piping and patches; colour 2 on the ribbed cuffs, hem band and heart patch; colour 3 on the zip teeth, zip pull and patch details.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Holiday_01.description: A short-sleeved, open-front holiday coat with a large hood and shaggy fur-like collar, vertical piped stripes, a wide belt band at the waist, and rough furry trim on the sleeve cuffs and knee-length hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Holiday_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body and hood; colour 1 on the shaggy collar and the inner chest panel; colour 2 on the furry cuff and hem trim; colour 3 on the stripes, piping and belt band.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved leather biker jacket with a high open collar, lapels with thin piped edging, a buckled belt at the waist and strapped, buckled cuffs. It sits open at the front and ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and lapels; colour 1 on the sleeves; colour 2 on the belt and cuff straps; colour 3 on the belt badge, cuff buckles and piping accents.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_01.differs: The front is closed and the collar is more upright, with less open chest than the male version.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_02.description: A cropped, short-sleeved biker-style jacket with wide open lapels, a belted hem with a buckle at the front, banded cuffs on the elbow-length sleeves, and a small atom-like emblem on the back. Ends at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and lapels; colour 1 on the sleeves and the lapel piping; colour 2 on the belt and sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on the belt buckle and the back emblem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_Lycan.description: A cropped leather jacket with a tall upturned collar, open at the front and ending above the waist. The right sleeve is a separate panel with strapped bands at the cuff, and a scratch-like slash marking decorates the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_Lycan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, collar and sleeves; colour 1 on the slash marking across the back; colour 3 on the edge stitching and front trim; colour 2 on the cuff bands and straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_Sleev.description: A sleeveless, waist-length leather vest jacket with wide open lapels, flap chest pockets, small studs down the front, seam lines and a hem band, and an atom emblem on the back. Worn open over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_Sleev.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the vest; colour 1 on the lapels and collar and the atom emblem; colour 3 on the studs; colour 2 on the hem band and vertical seam piping.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Madjester_02.description: A long-sleeved tailcoat-style jacket cropped short at the front, with wide patterned lapels, a pointed waistcoat panel with buttons, a waist band and a single long narrow tail hanging down the back. Formal, theatrical jester look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and tail; colour 1 on the patterned lapels, waistcoat panel and waist band; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Madjester_02.differs: The female jacket has a single narrow tail at the back that hangs down the leg, with the front cropped short, while the male version has a broad rounded tail pair that also curves forward at the hips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Modern_Sapphi.description: A cropped, short-sleeved sci-fi jacket with a tall open collar, padded shoulders, piped seam lines, banded cuffs and a buckled belt at the waist; a round emblem with a contrasting insignia sits on the upper back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Modern_Sapphi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the piping, cuff bands and chest panel; colour 3 on the small studs and the back emblem centre; colour 2 on the zip cord, buckle and back insignia.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare_Got.description: A knee-length gothic frock coat with a tall standing collar, open front with wide lapels, and flared bell cuffs. Vertical pinstripes run down the skirt, which ends in pointed, ornamented hem spikes; two bands wrap each upper arm.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare_Got.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main coat body and collar; colour 1 on the vertical stripes, lapel edging and hem outlines; colour 2 on the hem spike inserts and the back emblem; colour 3 on the upper-arm bands.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parka_Hooddow.description: A puffy quilted parka jacket with long sleeves, a cinched waist and a tall hood worn down as a high rolled collar around the neck. Two straps hang down the front, and the hem and cuffs have contrasting bands.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parka_Hooddow.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted body and sleeves; colour 1 on the hood rim; colour 2 on the hem and cuff bands; colour 3 on the front straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parka_Hoodup_.description: A puffy quilted parka jacket with long sleeves, horizontal padded baffles and a hood worn up. Two long drawstring cords hang down the front, with contrasting trim on the hood edge, cuffs and hem. Ends at the hips.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parka_Hoodup_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted jacket body and hood; colour 1 on the hood opening edge trim; colour 2 on the cuffs and bottom hem bands; colour 3 on the hanging drawstring cords.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parkafur_Hood.description: A puffy quilted parka jacket with long sleeves, a hood worn up with a ruffled fur-like edge, a cinched waist and contrasting cuffs and hem. Two narrow straps hang down the open front; it ends at the hips.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parkafur_Hood.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted body, sleeves and hood; colour 1 on the ruffled hood edge; colour 2 on the cuffs and hem bands; colour 3 on the hanging front straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pirate_Fancy_.description: A long-sleeved pirate-style frock jacket with padded shoulder caps, a high stand collar, wide cuffs and a panel down the centre back. The skirt flares into pointed, asymmetric tails that reach the upper thigh, and the front is open.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pirate_Fancy_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder caps, lower skirt tails and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the upper sleeves, torso and cuffs; colour 2 on the collar, chest and upper-back panel and the sleeve stripes; colour 3 on the centre back panel and the front panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Aviator_.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length aviator jacket with wide open lapels, a front zip, slanted zip pockets, a separate shoulder and upper-back yoke, padded banded cuffs and hem, and a round patch on the upper sleeve.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Aviator_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 3 on the shoulder yoke, pocket edges and zip line; colour 1 on the lapels, cuffs, hem band and sleeve patch.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Military.description: A fitted, long-sleeved military-style jacket with a double-breasted contrasting front panel of studded buttons, a small stand collar, shoulder epaulette patches, banded cuffs and a hem that ends at the waist with thin piped edging.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Military.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the front panel, cuffs and shoulder patches; colour 2 on the buttons; colour 3 on the thin piping along the edges.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Military.differs: The female jacket has a tapered front panel and a closed high back hem, with a small round collar that sits close to the neck.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_01.description: A long-sleeved, hip-length jacket with a wide open front, broad contrasting trim and lapels, contrasting toggle buttons and straps across the front, draped loops of cord, and bands with studs on the upper sleeves. Contrasting cuffs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 3 on the lapels, front edging, hem, collar and draped cords; colour 1 on the sleeve cuffs; colour 2 on the buttons, studs and small straps.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_01.differs: The female jacket has flatter, simpler upper sleeves with fewer bulky mechanical shoulder details.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_02.description: A short-sleeved, open-front striped hoodie jacket with a wide draped hood at the neck, contrasting trim along the edges, a pointed hem with a cut-out notch at the back, and small stud accents. Sits over the torso to about hip level.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 on the alternating stripes of the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the hood lining, edge trim and hem trim; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Retro_Talisma.description: A waist-length retro jacket with full puffed long sleeves, banded cuffs and a gathered hem. Large wide lapels fold back from a deep open V front that shows the chest, with a few small buttons low on one side.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Retro_Talisma.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels and inner collar; colour 2 on the cuffs; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Retro_Talisma.differs: The female jacket has a deeper, wider open V that exposes more of the chest, with buttons only on the lower front. The male jacket closes higher.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesclosed_0.description: A fitted long-sleeved jacket ending at the waist, with a high stand collar, a deep V-front closed by a central placket, harness-like trim bands over the shoulders, and turned-back contrasting cuffs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesclosed_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the collar, front placket, shoulder trim bands and cuffs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesclosed_0.differs: The sleeves are plain, with no colour gradient toward the cuffs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesopen_01.description: A long-sleeved cropped jacket with an open front and a long flared robe skirt that falls to the ankles, with contrasting trim along the edges and cuffs. Sleeves fade from the shoulder toward the forearm.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesopen_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, robe skirt and upper sleeves; colour 1 on the trim, lapel edging and sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on the forearm sections of the sleeves.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesopen_01.differs: The female skirt is split open at the front and its hem sweeps to a longer point at the back and sides, with gaps at the hips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rocker_01.description: A long-sleeved, open-front jacket with a tall spiky collar, cropped at the waist and paired with a jagged, tattered tail skirt that hangs to the knees. contrasting outlines, contrasting splatter accents and a small emblem on the back suggest a punk rocker look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and skirt panels; colour 2 on the outlines and edge trim; colour 3 on the splatter markings on the shoulders, sleeves and skirt; colour 1 on the emblem on the back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Santa_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved holiday jacket with a big puffy fur-like hood collar, a gathered scarf-like front panel, fluffy cuffs and a short waist band; it ends at the waist with angled contrasting panels.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, cuffs, lower sleeves and waist trim; colour 1 on the main body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the front gathered panel and a waist stripe; colour 2 on the back and upper sleeves panel and side waist panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Santa_01.differs: The female version is a short cropped jacket ending at the waist with a gathered scarf-like front, while the male one is a longer open-collared coat.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Secret_01.description: A padded, open-front bomber-style jacket with a tall stand-up collar, puffy long sleeves with twin racing stripes, ribbed cuffs and hem band, and slanted hand pockets; ends at the waist. Casual sporty look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the sleeves, pocket trim and front edge piping; colour 3 on the sleeve stripes; colour 2 on the ribbed cuffs and hem band.
