Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Secret_04.description: A loose, puffy bomber-style jacket with long sleeves, an open front with no closure, ribbed banded cuffs and hem, a sleeve patch on the upper arm and a slim stripe near each front hip. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body; colour 2 on the ribbed cuffs and hem band; colour 1 on the sleeve patch and hip stripes; colour 3 on the bars within the sleeve patch.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_01.description: A fitted long-sleeved spy-style blazer with an overall bold window-pane grid pattern, notched lapels over an open front, two buttons, and small flap pockets at the hips. Ends at the hips.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body; colour 1 on the lapels and pocket flaps; colour 2 on the grid lines; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_01.differs: The female jacket is cinched at the waist with a flared hem, and the pocket flaps sit lower on the hips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_02.description: A long-sleeved, high-collared spy jacket that ends at the hips. It is fitted through the body and flares slightly at the hem, with a contrasting centre front panel, thin seam piping on the shoulders and back, and small zip accents at the pockets and cuffs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jacket body, sleeves and collar; colour 1 on the centre front panel; colour 2 on the shoulder and back seam piping and hem trim; colour 3 on the zip accents and the centre panel stitching.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_02.differs: The female jacket has a contrasting hem trim, a slightly flared skirt-like hem, and a narrower centre panel than the male jacket.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Starowl_01.description: A long-sleeved fitted jacket with a pointed, star-like collar and zigzag hem, flaring into a long skirt of layered petal-shaped tails that reach the shins. Cuffs are contrasting bands, with thin piping down the front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and petal panels; colour 2 on the collar, cuffs and petal edging; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Starowl_01.differs: The female version has a fuller, longer skirt of petal tails that hangs closed around the legs and reaches the shins, while the male tails are more open at the front.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Steampunk_01.description: A cropped, open-front steampunk jacket with a tall turned-up collar, short puffed sleeves over separate banded forearm sleeves, a laced corset-style back panel and a short tattered tail with strapped bands. Sits over the torso to the upper thigh.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, collar and tail; colour 1 on the forearm sleeves, back panel stripes and chest side panels; colour 2 on the straps and lacing; colour 3 on the collar edge piping.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_01.description: A long-sleeved, open-front tailored suit jacket with wide notched lapels, a small row of buttons and a hip-length hem that flares slightly over the hips. It is worn over the torso, leaving the chest below the neck bare.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 3 on the buttons.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_01_Glitt.description: A fitted, long-sleeved open-front jacket with wide notched lapels, a nipped waist and a short flared hem at the hips, covered in a speckled glitter texture, with a few small buttons down the front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_01_Glitt.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves with the speckled pattern; colour 1 on the lapels and inner collar; colour 3 on the small buttons and speckle flecks.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03.description: A long-sleeved tailored suit jacket with wide notched lapels, a fitted waist and a short front-cut hem at the hips. Two small buttons close the front below the open chest, giving a formal, business look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03.differs: The female jacket closes higher with two visible buttons and a more fitted, cut-away hem, while the male jacket hangs open lower with buttons only near the bottom.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03_Glitt.description: A long-sleeved, fitted suit jacket with wide notched lapels, a single button at the front and a hem ending at the hips. The body is covered in a speckled, glittery pattern. Suggests a smart formal look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03_Glitt.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels and collar; colour 3 on the button and the speckles in the fabric.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03_Glitt.differs: The female jacket is cinched at the waist and flares slightly over the hips, and it closes higher with a button at the waist.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_01.description: A long-sleeved, open-front tailored suit jacket with wide notched lapels, a fitted waist and a slightly flared hem at the hips. Tiny buttons sit low on the front, and a contrasting inner panel shows down the centre.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 2 on the inner front panel; colour 3 on the small buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_01.differs: The female jacket is cut shorter and more fitted, ending at the hips with a flared hem, and the contrasting inner panel is narrow and wavy.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_02.description: A long-sleeved, fitted suit jacket with wide contrasting lapels, worn open over an inset vest panel. It has a nipped waist and a hip-length hem, and small buttons run down the front. Smart, formal styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 2 on the inner vest panel; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_02.differs: The female jacket is cinched at the waist with a longer, flared hem and shows a longer front vest panel with more buttons.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Swing_01.description: A long-sleeved, striped tailored jacket with broad shawl lapels, a short vest-like front panel with a row of round buttons, a small shirt front underneath, cuffed sleeves and piping at the shoulders; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest panel and stripe base; colour 1 on the stripes and shirt front; colour 2 on the lapels and cuffs; colour 3 on the buttons, shoulder piping and small chest pin.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Toy_01.description: A sleeveless, schoolwear-style vest with a rounded collar band, a hanging striped necktie, a wide cinched belt band at the waist and a pointed, angled hem. Two small buttons sit at the chest and two on the lower front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the collar band and necktie; colour 2 on the waist band, the tie stripes and the lower buttons; colour 3 on the tie knot and the upper chest button.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Toy_01.differs: The female vest has only one small contrasting button at the chest and two contrasting buttons on the lower front, with a shorter, more curved hem at the waist.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Toy_02.description: A sleeveless, high-necked glossy top joined to a short cloth skirt with a single row of buttons down the front. A wide belt with a heart-shaped buckle and side pouches sits at the waist. Toy-like, playful styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy top and skirt; colour 1 on the trim piping along the seams and hem; colour 2 on the buttons and belt; colour 3 on the armhole linings.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchchains_.description: A long-sleeved trenchcoat with an open front and a split, flared skirt reaching the ankles, with a small spiked high collar. Chains wrap diagonally across the torso and coil around both forearms, giving a rugged mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchchains_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body, collar and skirt; colour 1 on the sleeves; colour 3 on the chains and collar spikes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchopen_01.description: An open-front long-sleeved trench coat with a sleeveless-looking torso panel, separate padded sleeves with strapped cuffs, a belt at the waist, and a long split skirt that flares to the ankles.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchopen_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body and skirt; colour 1 on the sleeves; colour 2 on the belt; colour 3 on the cuff buckles and small sleeve accents.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchopen_01.differs: The female coat has a smaller, narrower chest panel with less visible lapel, leaving the front more open.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01.description: A long-sleeved, cropped open tuxedo jacket with wide contrasting lapels, cuffs with small buttons and long split tails that hang down the back to the thighs. Formal and elegant, worn open over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and tails; colour 2 on the lapels; colour 1 on the cuff bands; colour 3 on the small cuff buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01.differs: The female jacket is cropped shorter at the waist with a narrow opening at the chest, and shows no wide waist band, so the tails read as a separate hanging flap.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01_Gl.description: A cropped, open-front tuxedo jacket with long sleeves, contrasting lapels and banded cuffs, plus a single long rounded tail hanging down the back to the calves. Glittery, textured fabric gives a formal, showy look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01_Gl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and tail; colour 2 on the lapels and collar; colour 1 on the cuff bands; colour 3 on small button details.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01_Gl.differs: The female jacket is cropped short at the waist with a narrow single tail at the back, leaving the front of the hips bare.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Urban_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved urban bomber jacket with contrasting sleeves, a big soft hood bunched around the neck, an open front showing an inner zip layer, ribbed trim at hem and cuffs, and an atom emblem on the sleeve.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Urban_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the hood and inner front layer; colour 2 on the sleeves and front edge piping; colour 3 on the hem and cuff stripes and the zip pull.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wizards_01.description: A long-sleeved fitted tuxedo-style jacket with a tall flared collar, ornate scrollwork shoulder epaulettes with ridged trim, buttoned flared cuffs, and a contrasting waistcoat-like front ending in a point; long split tails hang down the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and tails; colour 1 on the inner collar lining and cuff buttons; colour 3 on the shoulder epaulettes and scroll patterns; colour 2 on the front vest panel and inner cuff bands.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wizards_01.differs: The female version is closed at the front with a contrasting fitted vest and pointed hem, and has long split tails down the back reaching the knees.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wizards_02.description: A cropped, long-sleeved open-front jacket with a tall flared collar, decorative banded shoulder embroidery, buttoned cuffs and long narrow tails hanging down the back. Fantasy wizard style with a mechanical flavour.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wizards_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and tails; colour 1 on the inner collar lining and front sash; colour 3 on the shoulder bands and embroidery; colour 2 on the cuff bands.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Zoot_01.description: A long-sleeved, single-breasted zoot-style jacket with wide notched lapels, four buttons down the front, contrasting cuffs and a pointed, angled hem that falls to the hips. Tailored, formal look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Zoot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 2 on the sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jacket_Zoot_01.differs: The female jacket is longer, with a pointed, asymmetric hem that reaches below the hips and a more flared, fitted waist.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Jumpsuit_Prisonjacke.description: A bulky mechanical stock-like collar piece: a wide segmented plate ring around the neck and shoulders with small loop handles, a ridged chest plate, and a separate studded waist band joined by a narrow central strip.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Jumpsuit_Prisonjacke.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the collar rims, chest emblem and waist band; colour 2 on the main plates and central strip; colour 0 on the inner collar panels and ribbed side blocks; colour 3 on the studs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Kaiju_01.description: A sleeveless spiked armour chest piece with sculpted muscle-like plates across the chest and abdomen, bulky shoulder guards studded with long horn-like spikes, a raised collar, and a segmented spine plate down the back. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulder guards, back plates and outer chest and waist edging; colour 1 on the sculpted chest and abdomen plates and the neck collar; colour 2 on the spikes; colour 0 on the segmented spine plates on the back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Lab_Coat_1800.description: A long-sleeved, knee-length lab coat with a high stand collar, an off-centre row of small buttons, a fitted waist and a flared skirt. Colour-blocked panels give it a Victorian scientist look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Lab_Coat_1800.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, upper sleeves and back skirt panels; colour 1 on the front chest, hem sweeps and lower sleeves; colour 2 on the waist and skirt panels and the cuffs; colour 3 on the shoulder panel; buttons take colour 0.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Lab_Coat_Modern_01.description: A long-sleeved, thigh-length lab coat with an open front, a folded collar with lapels and a flared skirt hem. A fitted panel covers the torso and the sleeves end in contrasting cuffs; a clean, modern, scientific look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Lab_Coat_Modern_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on parts of the sleeves and the skirt panels; colour 1 on the other coat sections and sleeves; colour 2 on the central torso panel and the cuffs; colour 3 on the collar and back-neck patch.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Light_01.description: A short-sleeved, waist-length superhero top with a pointed hem, a scaled feather-like panel wrapping the chest and upper back, a mask-like emblem on the chest, and banded armoured sleeve caps with thin trim edging.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main torso and hem; colour 2 on the scaled chest and back panel; colour 1 on the mask emblem and the sleeves; colour 0 on the thin trim lines and the emblem eye details.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Lockbox_65_01.description: A cropped, open-front kung fu jacket with a small standing collar, wide bell-style long sleeves and contrasting piping along the edges and cuffs. Swirl motifs sit on the shoulders, and the jacket ends above the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 0 on the piping, cuff bands and shoulder swirl patches.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Lockbox_67_02.description: A strapless corset-style bustier with glossy padded cups edged in ruffled trim, a smooth fitted midsection with a scalloped lower edge, and a peplum of pointed tabs flaring over the hips. Open at the back, worn over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cups and the peplum tabs; colour 0 on the midsection band and ruffle trim; colour 1 on the inner lining and the edging of the tabs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Lockbox_67_03.description: A cropped, short-sleeved capelet-style top covering the shoulders, chest and upper back, with a patterned swirl design, ruffled frilled edging, small dangling metal tassels and a contrasting open collar. Ends above the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Lockbox_67_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the capelet; colour 0 on the swirl patterns and collar-area panels; colour 2 on the ruffled edging and inner collar; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Mecha_01.description: A bulky mechanical chest-and-back shell: a boxy armored casing over the torso with a ridged central crest and chevron marks at the neck, side pods with round openings, twin round vents on the back and a rounded module below.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Mecha_01.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and mostly ignores the scheme. Colour 0 on the main casing; colour 2 on the crest and the lower back module; colour 3 on the chevron marks.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Mecha_01.differs: The female version has no contrasting panels, and its casing and back panel look uniformly glossy where the male version has contrasting panels.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Merc_01.description: A sleeveless sci-fi armored torso layer: bulky domed plates over the chest with a central gem, a segmented tapered midsection ending in a V at the waist, and a chunky plated back with a vertical strap.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Merc_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest domes and lower side plates; colour 1 on the midsection, back plates and hip panels; colour 2 on the grooves and back clip; colour 3 on the chest gem and back light.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Military_Coat_01.description: A fitted long-sleeved military dress jacket with a high stand collar, a row of buttons down an off-centre front, flap pockets at the hips, shoulder epaulettes, a side stripe down one sleeve and banded cuffs. Ends at the hip.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Military_Coat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body; colour 1 on the stripe down the sleeve; colour 2 on the collar, epaulettes, pocket flaps and cuff bands; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Military_Coat_01.differs: The female jacket has contrasting cuff bands and no gold-style stripes on the sleeves, and it flares slightly at the hem with an angled front.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A cropped superhero chest layer: two rounded shoulder-cap plates joined over the upper chest and back, with a ribbed fan-shaped panel and a pointed shield-like plate at the breastbone. It sits high on the torso and leaves the arms bare.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plates; colour 1 on the central arrow shape and the lower shield plate; colour 3 on the ribbed fan panels.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Destroyer_01.differs: The female version has no contrasting underside band beneath the plates, and the shoulder plates are thinner and less deep.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A mechanical chest harness with a moulded cup-shaped chest plate and crossing shoulder straps. A round dial buckle sits at the crossing, and a ribbed cartridge band and a vented shoulder plate run over one shoulder. Sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate and shoulder plate; colour 1 on the straps and chest plate panels; colour 2 on the dial, inner shell and rim edges; colour 3 on the vented panel stripes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.differs: The female version adds a moulded chest plate with cups that wraps around the bust and ribs. The male version is only straps and a shoulder plate.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Ironclad_02.description: A sculpted armour bustier of two cup-shaped plates that sweep up into curved horn-like tips, joined by a pointed centre plate with a gem-like inset and a wide band wrapping the ribs to a V-shaped back panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Ironclad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cup plates and band; colour 1 on the inner cup panels and the V-shaped back inlay; colour 3 on the centre gem; colour 2 on the outer edging.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A strapless, tube-style bandeau band wrapped around the chest, with soft gathered creases and a rolled upper edge. A hourglass-shaped contrasting emblem sits at the centre front; the midriff and arms stay uncovered by the piece.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the hourglass-shaped centre patch.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The female band has a smoother, more rounded top edge and a single smooth back panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A sleeveless, corset-style vest with rounded shoulder and chest plates, crossed lacing at the neckline, and a loose hoop at one shoulder. A long narrow tabard panel hangs from the waist down the front to mid-shin, with a tapered, ornate end.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder and chest plates and the waist band; colour 1 on the corset body and the centre of the tabard; colour 2 on the tabard side panels and top; colour 3 on the corset lines and the tabard tip motif.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.differs: The female version has a loose ring at the shoulder and crossed lacing at the neckline, and its shoulder plates are more rounded and cup the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Mutated_01.description: A bulky, organic mutated top made of twisting, fleshy ridges and swollen bulges, with contrasting horn-like spikes jutting from the shoulders and back. It has puffy elbow-length sleeves and ends cropped at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy body and sleeves; colour 1 on the bulbous growths and small spines; colour 2 on the pods and sockets; colour 0 on the large horn spikes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Padding_01.description: A partial torso armor made of separate rounded padded plates: two large domed pads over the chest, small collar tabs at the neck, and a row of segmented pads across the abdomen and ribs, worn over the bodysuit.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Padding_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar tabs and the lighter portions of the chest and abdomen pads; colour 1 on the main upper section of each pad; colour 2 on the lower section of the chest domes; colour 3 on the small abdomen pads.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Padding_01.differs: The female version has two distinct, separated domed chest pads and a smaller, slimmer abdomen cluster with more of the bodysuit showing between plates.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Patriot_01.description: A partial harness-style chest layer: a high rounded collar ring at the neck with a small button, and two thin looping bands that arc over the shoulders, ending in buckled tabs on the chest. A separate panel sits on the upper back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main harness bands and shoulder loops; colour 1 on the collar; colour 3 on the button, buckle tabs and small studs; colour 2 on the back panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A sleeveless, fitted pirate-style vest with wide open lapels edged in studded trim, a button strip down each front edge, and a hem that dips to a point at the front. Ends at the waist over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the lapel facings and button strips; colour 2 on the studded lapel edging; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Pirate_Fancy_01.differs: The female vest has a narrower opening that shows less of the chest, with smaller lapels and a shaped bust.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Power_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting armoured vest with a high stand collar, a shoulder yoke, a contoured bust panel and segmented banded panels at the waist ending in a short flared hem. Sits over the torso like layered sci-fi body armour.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the collar, shoulder yoke and the band under the bust; colour 0 on the bust panel and upper back plate; colour 1 on the trim bands, waist bands and hem flaps; colour 2 on the segmented waist panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A partial chest layer of angular armor shards: rounded bra-like cups over the bust, a pointed central wedge, a segmented lower torso plate, and spiky fins flaring at the shoulders and back. Sits over the torso as sci-fi superhero armor.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bust cups and edge trim; colour 0 on the central wedge, spiky shards and back plates; colour 2 on the lower torso plate and inner panels; colour 3 on the accent fins at the sides and back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The female version has rounded bust cups in a separate colour, with the armor plates arranged around them; the male version is a single fused mass of shards over the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Pumpkin_01.description: A skeletal ribcage overlay with slim curved ribs wrapping the torso, a visible spine down the back, a collar of small bones, and two sculpted shoulder caps joined by a central chest knot. Macabre, undead look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spine, collarbones and rib ends; colour 1 on the shoulder caps; colour 2 on the ribs; colour 3 on the central chest knot.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Renegade_Shirt_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped tank-style shirt worn over the chest, with a wide scooped neckline, contrasting binding at the neck and armholes, and a ragged, torn hem that ends above the midriff.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Renegade_Shirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shirt body; colour 1 on the lower hem area; colour 2 on the neckline binding; colour 3 on the armhole edging.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Renegade_Shirt_02.description: A sleeveless cropped cloth vest worn over the chest, with wide armholes, a scooped neckline and a jagged, torn lower hem. Its ragged edge gives a scavenged, rebellious sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Renegade_Shirt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper body of the vest; colour 1 on the lower hem area, fading in from the upper part. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Renegade_Vest_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped biker-style vest with wide notched lapels and a tall open collar, rows of pyramid studs down the front and back, diagonal zips at the hips, and jagged ragged edges at the armholes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Renegade_Vest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body and lapels; colour 1 on the jagged armhole edging and the frayed inner panel; colour 2 on the zips; colour 3 on the pyramid studs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A sleeveless mechanical armoured chest piece with a tall open collar, bulky angular plates over the chest and shoulders, glowing vent panels on the front and back, and a segmented corset-like band at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and front chest plates; colour 2 on the main torso shell; colour 1 on the shoulder caps and lower waist band; colour 3 on the vent panels.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A short, bulky armored chest piece covering the bust and upper back, with a tall open collar ring, raised vented shoulder fins, split front plates with a star emblem, and a rear spine panel; retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar trim and central front band; colour 1 on the front chest plates and fin vents; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder housings and back plates; colour 3 on the lower bust edging and the rear spine panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Samurai_02.description: A samurai-style plate cuirass covering the torso, with a raised collar, a central round gem, stacked lamellar bands with swirling patterns, a flared shoulder plate on one side, and contrasting side straps. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Samurai_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and shoulder piece; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the band backing and side straps; colour 3 on the swirl patterns and the central gem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Samurairobot_01.description: An asymmetric one-sleeved gi top: a puffy long sleeve on one arm, a thick diagonal sash-like band crossing the chest and cupping the bust, and a padded flared hem at the waist. The other shoulder and arm are bare.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Samurairobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sash edge, cuff bulge and waist band; colour 1 on the torso, sleeve and skirt panels; colour 2 on the upper sleeve, back hem and side panels; colour 3 on the small chest and cuff accents.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_01.description: A short-sleeved, cropped armored chest layer with padded plates over the shoulders and bust, ribbed vent panels on the chest, and a tapering centre plate with a badge-like front emblem, ending at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, sleeves and back plate; colour 2 on the ribbed vent panels; colour 1 on the front centre plate and its outline; colour 3 on the shield-shaped inset.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_01.differs: The female version has rounded, cup-like bust plates with smaller shoulder pads and shorter sleeves.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_02.description: A sleeveless mechanical chest plate: a rounded shell covers the chest and shoulders with a small raised badge, over a contrasting band and a pointed lower plate that drops down the abdomen. Sci-fi armour look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest shell and back plate; colour 1 on the lower abdomen plate; colour 2 on the band between the plates; colour 3 on the raised chest and abdomen badges.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Scales_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting chest layer vest ending at the waist, with a central segmented plated panel, wide shoulder panels, curved side panels and a small vertical side strip. It suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Scales_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central chest and back panel and the collar edge; colour 2 on the upper shoulder panels; colour 1 on the large side panels; colour 3 on the vertical strips at the sides. The two small glossy spots at the collar are highlights.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Scarab_01.description: A sleeveless armoured chest piece with sculpted cups, raised shoulder flares and curved claw-like spikes on the chest, over segmented layered plates around the ribs and back; ends at the ribs with a chevron plate at the front.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest shell and shoulder flares; colour 3 on the claw spikes and centre gem; colour 2 on the lower rib plates and spike edges; colour 1 on the front chevron and the upper back plate.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Scarab_01.differs: The female version has sculpted bust cups and a smaller, higher-cut front, with the claw spikes curving around the cups.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Scarab_02.description: A beetle-inspired armored chest layer: segmented plates over the chest and upper back, a ribbed abdomen plate, curved rib-like claws at the sides, and long swept horn spikes rising from the shoulders.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer chest and back plates and the shoulder horns; colour 2 on the glossy central chest panels; colour 1 on the abdomen plate and the curved side blades; colour 3 on the rib claws and horn tips.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Scarab_02.differs: The female version has the rib claws clustered on one side and a smaller, narrower chest plate with slimmer horns.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Shirt_Goth_02.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting scoop-neck tank top worn over the torso, ending at the waist with a slightly flared hem. Soft cloth with a subtle centre back seam gives a casual, gothic layering look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Shirt_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper body of the tank; colour 1 on the lower hem band, blending in as a gradient.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Shirt_Ripped_01.description: A long-sleeved, hip-length button-up detective shirt with wide lapels, a contrasting inner front panel, small buttons and contrasting cuffs. The wrinkled cloth has a pointed hem and a faint torn patch on the upper arm.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Shirt_Ripped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lower sleeves as a fading gradient; colour 2 on the inner lapel panel, collar and cuffs; colour 3 on the buttons.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Shirt_Secret_04.description: A plain sleeveless tank top with a scooped V neckline and wide armholes, hugging the torso. It ends at the waist with a gently curved hem, for a simple everyday casual look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Shirt_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tank top; the slight shading toward the hem is only lighting, with no separate trim.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Shirt_Secret_04.differs: The female hem curves down lower at the front and sides and sits at the waist, while the neckline is a rounder scoop.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Snowball_01.description: Two separate fabric strap loops that run over the shoulders and around the upper chest and back, each with a small mechanical clip housing at the front. Reads as a light harness worn over a bodysuit.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Snowball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap loops; colour 1 on the clip housings; colour 2 on the housing edges and fittings.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted cuirass vest with a musculature-molded front and back, contrasting edge trim, a V-shaped front seam, and small strapped side closures. Padded shoulder caps with round emblems sit on top; it ends at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main breastplate and back; colour 1 on the edge trim and V seam; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and side straps; colour 3 on the round shoulder emblems.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_03.description: A sleeveless, cropped Spartan-style chest piece that follows the bust and back, with a sculpted lion-face medallion on the chest, Greek-key patterned borders, padded shoulder caps and contrasting side straps.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso body; colour 1 on the lion medallion and the edge trim; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and side straps; colour 3 on the lion's eyes, the shoulder studs and the Greek-key pattern.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_03.differs: The lion medallion sits between the breasts, is smaller and rounder, and does not extend over the shoulder as it does on the male version.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Spikysuit_01.description: A sleeveless, corset-like bone-armor shell with sculpted cups topped by tall curved spikes, ribbed segments down the torso, and a jagged spiked hem flaring at the hips. Organic and monstrous in style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shell and spikes; colour 1 on the ribbed striping across the cups, torso and hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Spikysuit_01.differs: The female version is a strapless corset with separate spiked bust cups and a long flared spiky hem, while the male version is a bulky vest covering the whole torso and shoulders.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Steelarachnid_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length armoured vest with a high flared collar, sculpted chest plates with contrasting trim, segmented overlapping ab plates, and a ribbed spine column down the back with small etched crack details.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body and collar; colour 2 on the trim outlines and ab plate edges; colour 3 on the spine column and small accent lights; colour 1 on the etched back marks.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Steelarachnid_01.differs: The female version has two rounded, spider-eye shaped chest cutouts framed by contrasting trim, while the male has broad flat chest plates.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Steelcommando_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted armored torso piece with a high pointed collar, molded bust plates, overlapping segmented ribbed panels down the abdomen, and flared side plates; it ends at the waist. A shield-shaped emblem sits on the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the collar, chest centre, abdomen ribbing and lower back panel; colour 0 on the bust plates; colour 2 on the side and rib armor plates; colour 3 on the outline of the back emblem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Steelcommando_01.differs: The female version has separately molded bust cups and a more tapered, corset-like waist, where the male version has a flatter, muscular chest plate.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Strapped_01.description: A cross-strapped chest harness: flat studded straps run over the shoulders and cross on the back, meeting at a round central medallion with an atom emblem ringed by small spikes. Sits over the chest as a partial layer.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and medallion rim; colour 1 on the atom emblem and strap edge piping; colour 2 on the medallion housing; colour 3 on the spikes and strap buckle tabs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Super_Retro_Destroye.description: A sleeveless retro-superhero armoured vest with two rounded, padded chest plates studded with small diamond spikes, a high shoulder-cap collar, a segmented waist band and a small hanging pouch panel at the front; ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Super_Retro_Destroye.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest plates and inner front panel; colour 0 on the shoulder trim and collar edge; colour 3 on the diamond studs; colour 2 on the back and waist band, which look glossy metallic.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Super_Retro_Destroye.differs: The female version has contrasting chest plates with contrasting shoulder trim and a hanging front pouch panel, while the male version has contrasting chest plates over a contrasting segmented torso.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Swimsuit_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped sports-style top with a rounded neckline and wide armholes, with contrasting binding around the neck, armholes and hem. It sits snug over the chest and ends above the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Swimsuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper body of the top, fading into colour 1 toward the hem; colour 2 on the neckline, armhole and hem binding.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Swimsuit_02.description: A short, cropped bandeau-style swimsuit top with a patterned band around the bust, thin trim at the edges, and two slim shoulder straps. It sits over the chest and ends above the waist, giving a casual beach look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Swimsuit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light base of the patterned band; colour 1 and colour 3 on the branching pattern; colour 2 on the trim, straps and top panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Swimsuit_03.description: A strapless bandeau bikini top of soft draped fabric, twisted into a knot at the centre of the chest with gathered folds. It forms a short band around the bust and back, with no straps.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Swimsuit_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer twisted fabric; colour 1 on the shaded underside and inner folds.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Swing_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting camisole-style top with thin strap loops over the shoulders, a glossy V-shaped panel at the neckline, and contrasting V-shaped side panels. It ends at the waist over the tights.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top and the centre V; colour 1 on the lower side panels and hem band; colour 2 on the glossy neckline panel; colour 3 on the shoulder straps.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Swing_01.differs: The female top has a lower, scooped back and a longer hem, while the male version is a shorter cropped top.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_90s_Corset_01.description: A strapless, form-fitting corset top with sculpted bust cups, a pointed centre between them and a fitted boned waist that ends just below the ribs. It has a contrasting hem edge, a separate front panel and an open back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_90s_Corset_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cups, main corset body and sides; colour 2 on the lower bust cups and centre point; colour 3 on the front centre panel; colour 0 on the bottom hem band and the inner back lining.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Alien_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped armored chest layer with a wide shoulder collar, a V-shaped layered breastplate with a gem-like central ornament, and ribbed side panels under the arms; ends above the waist. Sci-fi alien styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shoulder collar; colour 0 on the layered breastplate and back plate; colour 1 on the ribbed side panels; colour 3 on the central chest ornament.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Alien_01.differs: The female version has smaller ribbed side panels that sit mostly under the arms, whereas the male panels wrap further over the upper arms.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ammo_Bandolier.description: A diagonal bandolier strap worn over one shoulder and across the chest to the opposite hip, lined with rows of pointed bullet-like cartridges on both edges, with a small buckle plate at the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ammo_Bandolier.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strap band; colour 3 on the edge trim and piping; colour 1 on the cartridge bases; colour 2 on the cartridge tips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ancient_01.description: A partial ancient-style chest armor: a sculpted front breastplate with raised ridges and swirling engraved patterns, rounded shoulder caps, and stacked banded ribs wrapping the torso, joined by a spiral-marked back plate and straps.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ancient_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the breastplate and shoulder caps; colour 1 on the engraved swirl patterns and ridge lines; colour 2 on the recessed shading in the ridges; colour 3 on the rib bands and back plate.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Anniversary_De.description: A short, rounded armoured chest piece with a raised collar ring, segmented plates across the bust and back, ribbed side accents and open armholes; it sits over the torso and ends above the waist, giving a retro superhero look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Anniversary_De.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest and back plates; colour 1 on the inner collar; colour 2 on the lower plates and underside; colour 3 on the ribbed side accents.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Anniversary_De.differs: The female version is rounded and sculpted around the bust, with a scalloped lower edge in front, and has smaller, less flared shoulder openings.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A V-shaped chest plate with a pointed lower tip, a raised rim and a jagged notched upper edge, sitting across the upper chest and shoulders. The same shape shows on the back. Suggests a sleek superhero emblem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the raised jagged upper edge; colour 2 on the outer rim and border.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Archer_01.description: A short-sleeved, form-fitting jacket layer ending at the waist, with a laced-open front crossed by small buckled straps, a contrasting band across the back, and ragged cut hems at the sleeves and waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jacket body and lower hem; colour 1 on the side panels and front straps; colour 2 on the front and back panels and the band across the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Archer_01.differs: The female version has no contrasting on the sleeve bands and has a more open, criss-crossed strap front that exposes the body beneath, with a cropped, narrower waist.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting chest layer with a raised collar rim, a central vertical panel with two round port-like studs, and a segmented plated back that comes to a point. Ends at the waist, with small shoulder plates.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body, shoulders and back plating; colour 1 on the central front panel; colour 3 on the scratch-like markings and rings around the studs; colour 2 on the shoulder edge trim.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armadillo_01.differs: The female version has a smoother, more sculpted bust and a single pointed back plate, whereas the male has multiple back plates.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Cheststr.description: A sleeveless sculpted armor cuirass with a shaped chest plate, banded segmented plates around the midriff and etched patterns. Riveted crossing harness straps run over the shoulders to a central round emblem, with a plain back plate. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Cheststr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the etched chest and abdomen plates; colour 1 on the shoulder harness straps; colour 2 on the chest cup edges, banding and back plate; colour 3 on the central emblem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Covertmi.description: A light tech chest armour plate sitting over the torso: a smooth moulded front with a central seam, an overlapping segmented abdomen guard, a vented ribbed back plate and a single raised shoulder plate. Ends at the midriff.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Covertmi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest shell and plates; colour 1 on the shoulder vents, side inserts and accent markings; colour 2 on the inner gaps and shadowed recesses.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Covertmi.differs: The female version has sculpted, rounded breast cups and a single shoulder plate on one side, where the male has a flatter chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Cybermin.description: A sleeveless, cropped sci-fi armor vest with rounded shoulder caps and a deep V-shaped collar band. It has glowing circuit-line accents, oval lights on the shoulders, and a boxy sensor module with small knobs on the upper back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Cybermin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest shell and back module; colour 2 on the V-shaped collar band; colour 1 on the circuit lines and shoulder ovals.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Cybermin.differs: The female version has a sculpted bust shape and a shorter, more open hem, and the collar band forms a deeper V at the front.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A sleeveless tactical armor vest with a smooth moulded chest plate, small shoulder caps, a segmented spine plate on the back, and a strapped waist belt carrying four small pouches. Sits over the torso and ends at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate and back armour; colour 1 on the shoulder caps, small chest tabs and belt bands; colour 2 on the pouches; colour 3 on the pouch emblems.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_01.differs: The female vest has a sculpted, rounded bust and pouches that sit slightly further apart, three at the front and one at the side.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_02.description: A sleeveless sci-fi armoured chest piece: a molded breastplate with a high open neckline, segmented plates down the abdomen, contrasting ribbed side panels and a segmented spine strip on the back. Sits over the torso, ending at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main breastplate and abdomen plates; colour 1 on the neck accents, chest and spine inserts; colour 2 on the ribbed side and back panels; colour 3 on the small vent marks at the sides.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_02.differs: The female version has a sculpted, rounded bust and a narrower, tapered abdomen plate, with the contrasting side panels tucked under the arms.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_03.description: A sleeveless, cropped armored chest shell with large rounded cup shapes, a high back plate and segmented ribbed layers at the sides and back; ends just below the bust, with small vent slits and a sci-fi look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and cups; colour 1 on the centre chest strip, lower cup clasp and back panel; colour 2 on the segmented underlayers and rims; colour 3 on the small side vent marks.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorvipergren.description: A sculpted tech chest plate with a rounded bust shell, ribbed back plate and shoulder guards, worn over the torso with a strapped belt of grenade canisters at the waist and a few canisters clipped at the upper chest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorvipergren.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest shell and back plate; colour 1 on the shoulder trim, straps, belt bands and small square tabs; colour 2 on the grenade bodies; colour 3 on the grenade caps.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorvipergren.differs: The female version has only a few grenades on the upper chest, angled near the collar, and a contoured bust shell, while the male has three rows of grenades down each side of the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armourbluejay_.description: A cropped, sleeveless armoured vest with moulded bust cups, small rounded shoulder caps and a jagged-edged back panel; it ends above the waist with a flared lower plate, suggesting tactical body armour.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armourbluejay_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body, shoulder caps and lower plate; colour 1 on the jagged edge trim around the neckline, shoulders and back panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Armourbluejay_.differs: The female vest is mostly colour 0 with thin colour 1 edge trim, while the male version has large colour 1 and colour 3 panels and a colour 2 shoulder yoke; it also has moulded bust cups.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombi.description: Layered cloth bandage wrap: stacked horizontal bands around the midriff and a wide strip crossing diagonally over one shoulder, leaving the other shoulder and most of the chest bare. Worn over the torso with a tattered, mummy-like look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bandage wraps and shoulder strip; colour 1 on the shaded folds and edges between the layers.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombi.differs: The female wrap covers less, with the band stack sitting at the waist and a single diagonal strip leaving the chest largely open.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombi.description: A sleeveless wrap of layered cloth bandage strips crossing over the chest and shoulders in a halter-like X, with stacked horizontal bands around the midriff. It ends at the waist, giving a ragged, mummy-like look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bandage strips; colour 2 on the thin edge lines and gaps between the strips. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Basic_01.description: A sleeveless, skin-tight torso layer that hugs the bust, ribs and midriff, with a rounded neckline and open armholes. It ends at the waist and reads as a plain, sleek base layer.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole torso layer.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.description: A cropped, sleeveless chest piece of thick hide-like armor: sculpted pec panels, rounded shoulder caps, a puffy wrinkled collar ring around the neck and a separate lower band ending at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulder and back panels; colour 3 on the wrinkled neck collar; colour 1 on the lower midriff band and shading in the folds.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bikini_Fur_Nor.description: A fur bikini top with two shaggy, tufted cups joined by a small ring at the centre, thin straps rising over the shoulders to a neck loop, and a narrow band around the ribs. Ring connectors sit at each strap and the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bikini_Fur_Nor.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the fur cups, blended from light tips to mid tones; colour 2 on the straps and back band; colour 3 on the ring connectors.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A strapless, band-like chest piece that wraps the bust and ribs, with a scalloped neckline and a pointed lower edge. A raised eagle emblem with outspread layered feathered wings sits on the front; the back is open.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest band; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the wing feathers; colour 2 on the eagle body and wing frames.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A short, cropped chest plate armor piece covering the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, with a wide neck opening, a faceted lower chest panel and two round mechanical canisters with slotted centres on the chest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 1 on the faceted lower chest panel; colour 2 on the canister housings and neck lining; colour 3 on the canister slot lights.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A compact mechanical chest armour: a domed front plate with a small emblem, angular side panels, a flared lower V-shaped belly guard, and a back of stacked hexagonal plates running down the spine.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed chest plate and lower flared guards; colour 1 on the side panels, V-shaped centre and hexagonal back plates; colour 2 on the recessed edges and gaps; colour 3 on the emblem and small stud lights.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_02.differs: The female version has a rounded, bust-shaped front dome and a wider, more continuous back plate that wraps around the ribs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_01.description: A short, rigid mechanical shoulder-and-chest plate covering the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, with a large ring fixture at the centre and hex bolts studded below and at the sides. Retro superhero styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the ring and bolts; colour 2 on the inner neck opening.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_01.differs: The female plate is smaller and cut higher at the chest, with the bolts hanging off the lower edge and sides, and the shoulder edges flare outward.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_02.description: A short, close-fitting shoulder and upper-chest layer with rounded capped shoulders and a scooped neckline. The lower edge is cut in angular notched steps front and back, ending above the bust. Superhero-style retro armour look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole piece; a thin edge line at the cut borders shows contrasting trim. Colour 1 shows as a soft tint in the shadowed back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_02.differs: The female version has a stepped, notched lower edge that curves under the bust and is shorter at the front.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A cropped wrap-style chest piece of gathered, layered cloth across the bust and upper back, crossed by several riveted straps that run over the shoulder and buckle at the front. Partial coverage with a rugged, mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and upper wrap; colour 1 on the gathered lower wrap and the lacing; colour 2 on the fold panels and buckle hardware; colour 3 on the stripes and rivets.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The female version adds a gathered cloth wrap across the bust beneath the straps, while the male version is only the crossing straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A set of wide, glossy crossing straps forming an X across the chest and upper back, looping over one shoulder and under the opposite arm, with a small clasp where they cross on the front. Worn over a bodysuit.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: The glossy straps ignore the colour scheme, so no slot is visible; the default material shows a glassy sheen.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_02.differs: The female version is only a set of bare crossing straps, with no shoulder pad or armored cap under them.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bustiermindsla.description: A sleeveless, cropped bustier with a deep V-cut neckline, sculpted cups and two thin shoulder straps that cross the upper back. A separate corset-like band with crossing straps wraps the midriff below it.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bustiermindsla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bustier cups and body; colour 1 on the shoulder straps, edge trim, and the waist band with its straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bustierstraple.description: A strapless, form-fitting bustier with sculpted cups and a sweetheart neckline, boning-like seams down the torso and a pointed lower front hem. It is open at the back and ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bustierstraple.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bustier; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bustiertop_01.description: A sculpted corset-style bustier with a sweetheart neckline, two thin shoulder straps, small decorative bows down the front and a pointed lower hem. Contrasting trim edges the top and bottom; it ends at the waist over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Bustiertop_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main corset body; colour 1 on the edge trim and the bows; colour 2 on the shoulder straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chains_01.description: A loop of heavy chain slung diagonally across the torso from one shoulder to the opposite hip, wrapped in two or three overlapping strands. Sits over the chest and back as a bandolier-style accessory.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 in the gaps between the links. Colours 0 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chains_02.description: A pair of heavy chain loops crossing in an X over the chest and back, running over the shoulders and under the arms like a bandolier harness. Worn over the torso as an open, partial accessory.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chains_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 on the gaps between links; colours 0 and 3 not visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_01.description: A sleeveless plate cuirass with a molded, bust-shaped front, embossed chevron ridges and a fleur-de-lis on the back. It is held by buckled straps at the shoulders and sides and ends at the ribs, with open armholes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate; colour 3 on the lower plate, blended in a gradient; colour 2 on the buckled straps.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_01.differs: The female plate is moulded into a rounded bust shape and the fleur-de-lis sits only on the back, while the male plate has a broader chest with the emblem on the front as well.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_Dra.description: A short armored chest plate with a large sculpted skull on the front, a tongue-like lobe hanging below, and shaped cups over the chest. Trim edges, buckled side straps and shoulder straps hold it on; it ends at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_Dra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper front plates and the back plate; colour 1 on the edge trim, cups and bands; colour 2 on the skull and buckled straps; colour 3 on the skull's eyes and the hanging lobe.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_Dra.differs: The female plate has bust-shaped cups and buckled side straps, with a contrasting back panel banded by cross straps, while the male is a smooth single-shell plate.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Back_Fur.description: A cluster of long, sharp, faceted spines fanning out across the upper back and over the tops of the shoulders, like a jagged spiky mantle. It sits at the base of the neck and suits monstrous or sci-fi looks.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Back_Fur.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all of the spines; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Back_Fur.description: A small cluster of long, jagged spines fanning out across the upper back and shoulders, with a smaller matching tuft at the front of the collarbone. A spiky, monstrous accent that sits over the upper chest and back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Back_Fur.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all the spines; the spines show no other colour slots.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Front_Fu.description: A cluster of long, sharp spines fanning downward and outward across the upper chest below the collarbones, like a spiky ruff or chest fringe. It is a small partial overlay with an aggressive, mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Front_Fu.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all the spines; no other slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Clockwork_Armo.description: A sleeveless mechanical armor cuirass of overlapping angular plates over the chest, with a cinched pointed waist plate and a separate belt band. The back is a smooth panel with small inset plates. Sci-fi hero style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Clockwork_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates, waist point and belt band; colour 1 on the underlying torso panels and back; colour 2 on the gaps between plates and the back wedge; colour 3 on small accent lines.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Clockwork_Armo.differs: The female version has a rounded bust shape with curved plates and a smooth plain back panel, and the waist plate is more cinched.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Clown_01.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length laced vest-style shirt with a deep keyhole neckline, criss-cross lacing at the chest, a narrow hem band, and full puffy gathered sleeves that cinch at the wrists. Suggests a pirate or clown look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Clown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the puffy sleeves, the centre front panel and the bottom hem band; colour 2 on the edge piping around the neckline and armholes; colour 3 on the chest lacing.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_.description: A sleeveless, waist-length button-up military-style vest with squared shoulder caps, chevron badges, two flap pockets at the hem, a cobra emblem on the back and a row of three spikes on one shoulder.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body and pocket flaps; colour 1 on the shoulder cap edge and thin seam piping; colour 2 on the chevrons and back cobra emblem; colour 3 on the buttons and shoulder spikes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_.description: A sleeveless, cropped open vest with wide flared shoulder flaps and a high back, worn over the torso. Stitched seam lines and small buttons trim the front, and strap-like tabs sit at the ribs. It has a mechanical, militaristic look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the stitched seam lines; colour 2 on the strap tabs at the ribs; colour 3 on the small buttons.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_.differs: The female vest is more closely shaped to the bust and has no visible flap pockets on the lower front, only strap tabs at the ribs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Construction_V.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting closed vest with a V-neck collar and lapels, a separate bust panel, a curved hem with a pointed front, and side inserts; it ends at the waist over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Construction_V.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, lower front hem and most of the back; colour 1 on the main vest body and back side panels; colour 2 on the bust panel and the band across the upper back; colour 3 on the side insert panels.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Construction_V.description: A sleeveless, open-front fitted vest ending at the waist, with wide flared lapel-like edges, sculpted bust cups, curved side panels and a broad band across the upper back. Reads as a work-wear style layer.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Construction_V.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, front edges and hem; colour 1 on the curved side and back panels; colour 2 on the bust cups and upper back band; colour 3 on the narrow side inserts at the ribs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Corset_01.description: A short, cinched corset that wraps the midsection from under the bust to the hips, with a front lace-up of criss-crossed cords through eyelets, thin contrasting edge trim and a seam up the side.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Corset_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the corset body; colour 3 on the front lacing; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the eyelets.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Corset_01.differs: The female corset has a curved, hourglass waist and a smooth, even top edge across the back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowl_Wide_01.description: A wide, flat cape-like cowl collar that drapes over the shoulders and upper chest in a rounded fan shape, with a small neck opening and a broad patterned border band along the hem. Suggests a ceremonial or mechanical mantle.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowl_Wide_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cowl body; colour 1 and colour 3 on the patterned border band; colour 2 on the edge piping and neck opening lining.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowl_Wide_01.differs: The female cowl is shorter and sits closer to the shoulders, with no flared, hollow drop at the shoulder ends.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowlflair_01.description: A sculpted cowl-like shoulder and chest piece: a broad V-shaped panel with tall pointed flares rising at each shoulder and an open neck hole, covering upper chest and upper back and tapering to a point below the chest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowlflair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel with a fading gradient to darker tones toward the top; colour 1 on the thin edge trim and the inner lining.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowlflair_01.differs: The female version's shoulder flares stand taller and more upright, and the front panel is narrower.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.description: A sleeveless cyborg chest armor: a moulded bust plate with a central round gem, a raised collar-like shoulder yoke, and a separate floating belt band with an oval panel at the waist. Sits over the torso as a partial sci-fi layer.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper chest plate and the oval belt panel; colour 2 on the bust cups, shoulder yoke and back plates; colour 0 on the under-bust and belt band; colour 3 on the central gem and back gem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.differs: The female version has a smooth bust-cup shape and no raised block on the back, and the front plate is smaller.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_02.description: A sleeveless light cyborg armour vest: a raised shoulder-and-chest plate with open neck, segmented mid-torso plates with small studs, and a banded waist belt joined to the chest by exposed cables. Open at the sides and back, with a cutaway behind the shoulders.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper chest and shoulder plate, lower belly panel and lower back panel; colour 0 on the mid-torso plates and waist band; colour 2 on the cables and the inner side and back panels; colour 3 on the studs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_02.differs: The female version has a curved bust-shaped chest plate and a more open, cut-away back and side, with the back panel showing less coverage.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_01.description: A rigid, angular armored cowl that sits over the shoulders and upper chest. It has a wide open neck, a V-shaped front dropping to a small pointed plate, and a raised back panel with thin contrasting trim lines.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cowl shell; colour 3 on the thin trim lines along the edges and panel outlines; colour 2 on the inner underside of the collar.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_Updat.description: A partial mechanical collar-yoke that drapes over the neck and upper chest, with a raised rim, a V-shaped front plate with round port details and segmented angular panels; the back forms a short flared cape-like flap.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_Updat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, front plate and back flap; colour 1 on the panel edges and inner lining; colour 2 on the segmented side panels; colour 3 on small marks at the back of the collar.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_Updat.differs: The female version sits closer to the neck with a smaller, narrower chest plate and a more V-shaped drape.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A sleeveless sci-fi armored chest rig: a molded plate shell over the torso and shoulders, open armholes with segmented side panels, a padded centre pod, a separate plated waist band and a ridged spine plate on the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer chest shell, shoulder plates and waist band; colour 1 on the padded centre, back spine plate and inner accent panels; colour 2 on the side panels and underarm segments; colour 3 on the small centre lights.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_01.differs: The female version has a rounded, bust-shaped chest shell, and the waist band sits as a separate floating piece with a gap beneath the chest pod.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_02.description: A sleeveless sci-fi power-armor vest of chunky rounded plates over the chest and shoulders, with open arm holes, segmented ribbed panels at the sides and a separate banded waist plate with a triangular emblem. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer chest, shoulder and back plates and the waist band; colour 0 on the inner side and shoulder panels; colour 2 on the centre chest plate, ribbed panels, back panel and lower waist plate.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Eagle_Drka_01.description: A cropped shoulder-and-collar armor piece with a raised open collar, a V-shaped front plate and wide winged shoulder caps. Back panels are layered like feathers, with contrasting inner lining at the neckline; sits over the upper chest and shoulders.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Eagle_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, front plate and upper feather layers; colour 1 on the shoulder tips and the lower feather panels across the back; colour 2 on the inner neckline lining and the round front discs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Eclipse_01.description: A partial mechanical chest and shoulder layer of bat-wing-like armored panels with curved contrasting claw spikes, joined by a V-shaped yoke to a segmented ornate plate down the sternum; it wraps over the shoulders and upper back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Eclipse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame, edging and central sternum plate; colour 1 on the wing-like panel inserts; colour 2 on the curved spikes and accents; colour 3 on the small central gem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Eclipse_01.differs: The female version's sternum plate is a little shorter and the shoulder wings sit slightly narrower and more swept back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Egyptian_Beads.description: A broad Egyptian-style beaded collar in concentric rings of tiny beads, fanning out over the shoulders and upper chest with a rounded scalloped outer edge; sits flat around the neck like a wide necklace.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Egyptian_Beads.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer bead rows; colour 1 on the inner wide band of beads; colour 2 on the band between; colour 3 on the accent beads along the outer edge.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Electric_01.description: A sleeveless chest armour vest of segmented plates with a raised padded collar ring, a large round energy-coil emblem at the sternum, thick ribbed cables looping around the sides, and two boxy vented pods on the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the collar ring and under-plate; colour 3 on the central emblem disc and thin trim lines; colour 2 on the cables and back pods.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Electric_01.differs: The female version has the side cable loops sit lower and tighter around the ribs, and the front plate ends in a narrower point.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Energyhero_01.description: A draped cloth kerchief worn around the neck, knotted at the back and falling as a soft triangular bib that tapers to a point down the chest. Casual, loose folds with a small contrasting collar band at the neck.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Energyhero_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the kerchief; colour 2 on the narrow band at the neck edge; colours 1 and 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Feathertop_01.description: A sleeveless, sleek tunic-style chest layer with a glossy plunging bra-like bodice, a wide banded midriff and a short flared skirt with a frilled hem, ending at the hips over the body.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Feathertop_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy bodice cups, straps and vertical side panels; colour 1 on the midriff band and panels between the straps; colour 0 on the skirt front, back panel and frilled hem trim; colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Frontspikes_01.description: A scattering of small conical metal spikes studded across the upper chest and bust, pointing outward in a loose, uneven cluster. Sits directly on the torso as a punk or mechanical accent.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Frontspikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Frontspikes_01.differs: The female spikes are spread over the bust in an uneven cluster, with some pointing sideways and downward around the curve of the breasts.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Furback_01.description: A shaggy fur cowl and mantle of jagged, feather-like tufts that ring the neck, spread over the shoulders and taper into a long point down the chest and upper back. It suggests a wild, barbaric look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Furback_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur tufts; colour 0 on the fur near the neck and along the centre of the chest and back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Furback_01.differs: The female version's fur drapes lower and narrower over the chest and back, with less spread across the shoulders.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Furboth_01.description: A shaggy fur mantle of jagged, feather-like tufts draped over the shoulders, collar, upper chest and upper back, tapering to a point down the centre of both chest and back. Wild, primal look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Furboth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur tufts; colour 0 on the lighter fur at the neck and along the central strip.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Furfront_01.description: A small V-shaped tuft of jagged, shard-like fur tufts lying flat across the upper chest and collarbone, with spiky points fanning down toward the sternum and out over the shoulders. Suits a wild or superhero look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Furfront_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner centre of the tuft; colour 1 on the outer tips and edges; colour 2 on the underside seen from behind.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A short armored midsection band that wraps the waist and lower ribs, with a deep V-shaped notch at front and back and raised side wings over the obliques. Thin contrasting trim edges the notches and the front opening.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor shell; colour 1 on the inner surface; colour 0 on the thin trim along the edges.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_01.differs: The female version has tall, narrow side wings and a deeper, sharper V notch in front, with an inner trim bar across the front opening.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_02.description: A sleeveless, fitted chest layer with a wide flared collar that sweeps up into two pointed wing-like tips at the shoulders, tapering to a V over the torso and ending in a separate band at the waist. Thin trim edges the outline.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the piece and waist band; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the flared collar and V panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_02.differs: The female version has a smoother, more continuous torso panel with a lighter waist band, while the male has a separate armor-like plated band at the waist.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_04.description: A boxy, sleeveless chest plate with open arm and neck holes and a separate segmented waist band below. It has a circular emblem on the chest, slotted vent marks on the sides, and thin contrasting piping along the edges. Sci-fi armor look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and waist band; colour 1 on the edge piping and trim; colour 3 on the chest emblem; colour 2 on the vent slots.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A strapless, form-fitting corset with a sweetheart neckline, vertical boning lines and a pointed V hem at the front. It cinches the waist and sits over the torso, with a low open back and a thin trim edge. It suggests a retro pin-up superhero look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main corset body panels; colour 3 on the top edge, boning lines and bottom trim; colour 2 on the small ties at the back hem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Grenadestrap_0.description: A diagonal bandolier strap looping from one shoulder across the chest and back to the opposite hip, studded with rows of small cylindrical grenades in contrasting clips, with a small square tab at the shoulder.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Grenadestrap_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap; colour 1 on the grenade bodies; colour 3 on the shoulder tab and grenade bands; colour 2 on the clips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Grenadestrap_0.description: A single flat bandolier-style strap forming a closed loop that runs diagonally from one shoulder across the chest and back, with a small boxy fastener at the shoulder. Suits tactical or military looks.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Grenadestrap_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band; colour 3 on the small shoulder fastener.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A cropped plate-armor chest piece with sculpted cups, a raised stand-up collar, a central segmented breastplate and a round gem at the throat. Carved scroll-pattern panels wrap over the shoulders and across the upper back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and collar rim; colour 1 on the recessed scroll inlays and border lines; colour 2 on the collar lining and the round centre stud; colour 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hipan_01.differs: The female version has separately shaped cups over the bust and a more open, rounded shoulder cut.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A partial chest overlay of translucent, glowing holographic plates: curved shells over the chest, angular shoulder fins, a segmented spine strip down the back and a band around the ribs. Futuristic superhero energy armor.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material is a glowing energy effect that ignores the colour scheme, so the whole piece shows one bright translucent look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The female version is a glowing translucent energy material that ignores the colour scheme, while the male version is solid opaque plating that takes the colour slots.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A partial chest-layer overlay of flat, angular hexagonal facets forming an arched cluster across the upper chest and collarbone, with small detached hex tiles at the edges; a holographic tech look.
