Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: The whole piece shows as one bright tone, which appears to be colour 0; no other slots are visible.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Holohex_01.differs: The female version is a wider, flatter arch that curves over the upper chest and shoulders, while the male one forms a compact peaked triangle.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_0.description: A partial set of jagged bone-like spikes running down the spine from the neck to the lower back, with a few small spikes scattered over the shoulder blades and sides. Suggests a monstrous, skeletal look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the base plates and the thin ridge along the spine.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_0.differs: The spikes form a tight, continuous row along the spine with denser, larger spikes, where the male version is spread more widely across the back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_0.description: A sparse set of long bone-like spikes around the neck and shoulders, with a dense ridge of smaller jagged spines running down the centre of the back, and a few small shards down the chest. Worn over the torso as a monstrous accent.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the trim edging at the base of each spike.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_0.differs: The female version has a longer, denser spine ridge down the back, with fewer and smaller spikes around the shoulders.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_0.description: A scattered ring of small bone-like spikes and curved blades studded around the collarbone and upper chest, with larger flared fins near each shoulder. Each spike has a contrasting edge; suits a monstrous or tribal look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main spike surfaces; colour 3 on the edge trim along each spike base.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_0.differs: The female version has more spikes, spread wider across the upper chest, with a longer central spike between the breasts.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A bulky mechanical chest harness of segmented armour plates with a raised ring collar, ribbed abdominal plating and thick ribbed hoses looping around the ribs and shoulders, ending at the waist. Sci-fi power-armour look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the abdominal and spine plating and the collar edges; colour 1 on the outer shell, collar ring and waist band; colour 2 on the chest and back panels; colour 3 on the ribbed hoses.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Martial.description: A long-sleeved, fitted martial-arts style jacket with a deep plunging V neckline edged in jagged, torn-looking trim, and a separate wide band around the waist. Ends at the waist over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Martial.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body and sleeves of the jacket; colour 1 on the lower waist band, blending up into the body; colour 3 on the neckline edge trim; colour 2 on the inner neckline lining.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Martial.differs: The female version has a deeper V opening with a small cut-out notch at the chest and fits tighter, while the male neckline is a plainer V with pointed flared edges.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Punk_01.description: A short, open-front punk jacket with a tall flared collar edged in contrasting piping, rolled-up elbow-length sleeves and slanted stitched seam lines across the chest. It ends at the waist and has a glossy leather-like finish.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the slanted seam lines and stitching; colour 3 on the collar piping; colour 2 on the shoulder panels, though the glossy default material mutes the scheme.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Punk_01.differs: The female jacket has no separate shoulder panels and its glossy finish shows darker; the male version has distinct contrasting shoulder patches.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Space_S.description: A cropped, long-sleeved fitted jacket with an open front, high padded shoulders, curved swooping panels down each side of the chest, a padded band at the hem and contrasting cuffs; ends above the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Space_S.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the jacket and upper sleeves; colour 0 on the hem band and lower sleeves; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder tops and back of the sleeves; colour 3 on the curved chest panels.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Space_S.differs: The female jacket has curved, swooping chest panels that wrap around the bust and a slimmer, higher hem, instead of the male's two straight vertical chest stripes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Suit_01.description: A fitted long-sleeved suit jacket with notched lapels, a contrasting vest-like front panel with small buttons, and a short flared peplum skirt at the hip. Cuffs are set in a separate band; sits over the torso in a formal, tailored style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Suit_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the jacket body and front upper sides; colour 3 on the central vest panel; colour 0 on the lapels, cuffs and peplum flare; colour 2 on the back yoke and sleeve backs; colour 2 on the buttons.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Knifestrap_01.description: A bandolier-style strap looping diagonally over one shoulder and across the torso, holding several throwing knives fanned out at the chest and back, with a small clasp at the shoulder. Tactical, mercenary look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Knifestrap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap; colour 2 on the knife blades; colour 1 on the knife handles; colour 3 on the shoulder clasp and knife guards.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Knifestrap_01.differs: The female version has a mix of blades including one textured, serrated-looking blade at the front, and fewer knives visible on the back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A rounded, shaggy fur patch that covers only the chest, like a small tufted bib with ragged edges and a slightly bulging shape. It sits over the bust and is best suited to monstrous or festive looks.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur tufts; colour 2 on the darker swirled strands and shadowed gaps; colour 0 on the highlights at the edges.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Krampus_Attach.description: A rounded, shaggy patch of furry tufts covering the chest, like a fur bib or mantle sitting over the bust. It has a ragged, uneven lower edge and no sleeves, with a monstrous festive look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Krampus_Attach.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur tufts; colour 2 on the deeper streaks and shadowed strands; colour 0 on the highlights at the edges.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A layered torso harness: a thin strap band encircling the upper chest with a buckle, above a stacked waist wrap of a padded rolled band and a corset-like panel with baseball-style contrasting stitching. Sits over the midriff.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest strap and the lower stitched waist panel; colour 1 on the upper waist band; colour 2 on the padded roll between the waist bands and the inner strap edge; colour 3 on the buckles, stitching and studs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Lycan_01.differs: The female version has a horizontal strap band around the upper chest, whereas the male version has diagonal cross-body shoulder straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting waistcoat with a deep V-neck, a row of front buttons and a pointed hem at the front. Two small contrasting points hang at the back hem, and the armholes are lined with contrasting trim. Formal jester style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper vest body; colour 1 on the lower vest and hem, blending upward from the bottom; colour 2 on the inner lining, armhole edges and back hem points; colour 3 on the buttons.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Martial_Power_.description: An asymmetric martial-arts gi tunic with a diagonal wrap across the chest, one long sleeve, a sculpted segmented chest plate over one shoulder, a sash belt and an angular hem with contrasting trim ending at the upper thigh.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Martial_Power_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tunic cloth and sleeve; colour 3 on the segmented chest plate; colour 1 on the swirl emblem on the chest; colour 2 on the belt and hem trim.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Martial_Power_.differs: The female tunic has a shorter, more flared skirt hem, and the sleeve is a fitted long sleeve on one arm only.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_.description: A sleeveless, loose cloth gi top with a deep plunging V front, wrinkled folds and slightly raised shoulder edges, ending at the waist. It sits over the torso like a casual martial arts vest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole garment; the inner neckline edge and back show a slight tint from colour 1.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_.description: A sleeveless cloth gi tank top with a deep wrapped V-neck, crossed front panels and a loose draped fold at the collar. It sits over the torso and ends at the waist with a slightly gathered hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole top; the cloth shows little of the other colour slots.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_.differs: The female version has narrow, strap-like shoulders and a lower, deeper neckline; the male version has wider, boxy shoulder caps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechaniste_01.description: A sleeveless, bulky sci-fi armor vest of layered plates over the chest and midriff, with padded tubular shoulder loops ending in small hex lights, and a segmented waist band at the back. It ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechaniste_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate frame and waist band; colour 1 on the chest, abdomen and back plates; colour 2 on the shoulder tubes and back vents; colour 3 on the shoulder lights.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechassn_01.description: A sleeveless, segmented tech armor vest with a large layered chest plate, banded ribbed plates around the torso, a contrasting waist band, and a square vented panel on the upper back. Sits over the torso to the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the waist band and lower trim panels; colour 3 on the chest piping and accent stripes; colour 2 on the rivets and the back panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechassn_01.differs: The female version has a shorter, more sculpted chest plate that flares out, and the back panel is smaller and set higher.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A partial chest plate of sleek segmented panels over the bust and upper ribs, with a central glossy V-shaped centre panel that has notched shoulder tabs. Thin outline edges wrap the sides and back like a harness.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy centre V panel and edge outlines; colour 0 on the ribbed side panels; colour 1 on the lower rim of the panels.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Nighthawk_01.differs: The female plate is a rounded, bust-shaped cup form with ribbed panels and no separate lower armoured band, while the male has a distinct lower plate.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length ninja shirt with a mesh panel at the chest, wide contrasting trim along the V-opening and armholes, and a diagonal strap across the torso carrying three shuriken stars.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt body and mesh; colour 1 on the neckline and armhole trim and the front edge panel; colour 2 on the diagonal strap; colour 3 on the shuriken.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_02.description: A sleeveless, wrap-front ninja shirt with a diagonal crossover closure edged in contrasting trim, a mesh insert showing at the chest, and flared trimmed armholes. It ends at the waist and sits over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shirt body; colour 1 on the trim along the wrap edge, collar and armholes; colour 0 on the mesh insert.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_02.differs: The female version has a slightly narrower, more fitted wrap and shorter shoulder flares.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Overalls_02.description: A short bib-front overall top with two shoulder straps that clip on at the chest with hook fasteners. Panelled, stitched seams and a cropped hem end at the ribs; a worn, utilitarian work look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Overalls_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fabric and straps; colour 1 on the clips and fastener studs; colour 3 on the stains and marks; colour 2 on the seam lines and stitching.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Pelt_01.description: A shaggy fur pelt mantle draped over the shoulders and upper chest, forming a V-shaped collar in front and a jagged, pointed spread across the upper back, with ragged tufted edges.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Pelt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the fur tips and outer edges; colour 2 on the darker underlayer and roots in the shadowed gaps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Persian_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting corset-style vest ending at the ribs, with deep V panels at front and back framed by broad crisscross-lattice bands over the shoulders, and thin horizontal straps wrapping the sides.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth main body panels; colour 1 on the lattice-patterned bands along the V edges and shoulders; colour 2 on the crisscross lines within the bands; colour 3 on the side straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A partial chest overlay of sleek angular plates: two curved horn-like cups arc around the bust, joined to a pointed waist panel with long slit cutouts that tapers to a point over the lower abdomen.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and cup surfaces; colour 2 on the raised edge outlines and inner slits. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Phantom_01.differs: The female version has two curved horn-shaped cups around the bust above a shorter waist panel, rather than the male's long forked prongs rising toward the shoulders.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Plugs_Covertmi.description: A scattering of small mechanical plug studs, ribbed cylindrical connectors with hex nut caps, mounted on the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, with a few small curved clips between them. Suggests cybernetic implants.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Plugs_Covertmi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed plug bodies and hex caps; colour 3 on the small ring band on each plug; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerarmor_01.description: A short, sleeveless sci-fi chest piece of rounded padded armor that covers the bust, ribs and upper back, with open armholes and a glossy centre panel. It ends at the ribs with a thin trimmed hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body and sides; colour 3 on the glossy front chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back and shoulder panel; colour 0 on the hem edge and armhole lining.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerarmor_01.differs: The female version has a sculpted, glossy bust panel and a smaller, more open armhole, while the male version has a flatter chest panel.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerplates_01.description: A sporty armored chest harness of rigid plates: a molded bust plate with hex bolts, a square back plate, shoulder arches, and stacked segmented bands at the ribs and waist, with a wide contrasting sash at the belly. Open at the sides.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerplates_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, back and shoulder plates and lower bands; colour 3 on the waist sash; colour 0 on the inner backing panels; colour 2 on the bolts.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerplates_01.differs: The female plate has a molded, rounded bust cup and curved shoulder arches, while the male has flatter angular chest plates and layered shoulder pauldrons.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerstraps_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting mechanical vest with a laced centre seam front and back, chunky shoulder yokes and rounded side bands at the ribs and waist, each studded with contrasting round holes. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerstraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the shoulder yokes and side bands; colour 3 on the stitched centre seam; colour 2 on the holes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerstraps_01.differs: The female vest wraps more closely around the bust and has smaller, lower shoulder yokes, with the side bands sitting as separate blocks.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powersuit_01.description: A partial sci-fi chest armour shell: a rounded, segmented plate cups the bust and upper torso, with a raised collar and shoulder flare, and a ribbed spine-like strip running down the centre of the front and back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Powersuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest and back plates and collar; colour 1 on the ribbed centre strip; colour 2 on the inner strip at the back of the neck.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Qularr_Armor_0.description: A sleeveless, cropped carapace vest of overlapping layered armor plates with a scalloped neckline and a V-shaped chest ridge, ending in a banded lower edge at the ribs. Sits over the torso with jagged plates at the sides.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Qularr_Armor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest and collar plates; colour 1 on the lower plates, side plates and waist band; colour 2 in the shadowed plate seams. The material shows a mottled, cloudy pattern across the slots.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Raccoon_Mane_0.description: A short fur-like mane collar sitting around the base of the neck and over the shoulders, with a smooth rounded neck ring and layered, pointed tufts fanning outward and downward across the collarbone and upper back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Raccoon_Mane_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner neck ring and upper base of the mane, blending into colour 0 on the outer pointed tufts; colour 2 on the shadowed undersides of the tips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rave_Shirt_01.description: A cropped, sleeveless sports-bra style top with wide straps and contrasting trim at the neckline, armholes and hem. A band of interlocking diamond patterns crosses the chest, and the fabric fades towards the lower edge.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rave_Shirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fabric; colour 1 on the lower fabric gradient; colour 3 on the diamond chest pattern; colour 2 on the trim around the neckline, straps and hem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rave_Sweater_0.description: A cropped, long-sleeved knit sweater with a wide slouchy boat neckline, slashed and ripped sleeves, and striped ribbed trim at the neck, waistband and cuffs; ends above the navel for a casual rave look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rave_Sweater_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knit body and sleeves; colours 1, 2 and 3 in vertical stripes on the neckline, waist band and cuffs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ravenswood_01.description: A mechanical harness-style chest rig: a faceted plated chest piece with shoulder straps, a segmented belt band around the ribs and waist, and a spine plate with a tail flap dropping over the lower back. Sci-fi tactical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plates, straps and belt band; colour 1 on the thin piping lines along the plate edges; colour 0 and colour 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Reactor_04.description: A mechanical shoulder-and-collar mantle that sits over the upper chest, shoulders and upper back like a padded yoke, with angular panelled segments and a rounded knob at the centre front. Sci-fi reactor styling.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mantle surface and upper collar; colour 0 on the rim edging and the central front knob; colour 2 on the front and side panels; colour 3 on small accents at the back and front.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ripper_01.description: Cybernetic chest implant rig: angular plates over the upper chest and spine, a segmented ribbed column down the sternum and back, cylindrical ports with glowing nodes, and thick ribbed cables looping around the torso and shoulders.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular plates and shoulder flaps; colour 1 on the ribbed segments and cylindrical ports; colour 2 on the coiled cables; colour 3 on the small nodes in the ports.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ripper_01.differs: The female version has a sparser, more open cable layout that hugs the chest and leaves the ribbed column more exposed.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A cluster of cybernetic implants covering the torso: a collar-like plated shoulder frame, rounded canister modules and ports on the chest and upper back, and thick ribbed cables looping around the ribs and waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plated frame and collar panels; colour 1 on the canister modules and connectors; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 3 on the port centres.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Robot_Chest_01.description: A partial mechanical chest plate: a rounded, cup-shaped upper shell over the chest tapering to a pointed segmented lower plate over the stomach, with vent slits, a central spine groove and short antenna-like prongs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Robot_Chest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating; colour 3 on the vent slits, central stripe and edge lines; colour 1 on the prongs and spikes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Robot_Chest_01.differs: The female plate has two rounded cups that curve over the bust, and the lower plate is a narrower point.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length chest layer of cobbled stone plates divided by thin seams, with a cluster of faceted crystals jutting from the upper chest. It has open arm holes and a cinched, rounded waist hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates; colour 3 on the seams between the plates; colour 1 on the crystal cluster.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.differs: The female version has a cinched waist and a crystal cluster sitting centred across the chest, with the crystals spread wider and higher.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length stone vest made of cobbled rock plates with cracked seams between them. A cluster of large angular crystals juts from the upper chest, and the armholes are open.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock plates; colour 3 on the cracks between the plates; colour 1 on the crystals.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.differs: The crystal cluster on the female version is larger and sits centred across the chest, while the waist is more cinched.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A partial mechanical chest piece of segmented armour plates that wraps the upper torso, with contrasting line detailing, small vent-like slashes at the sides, a pointed collar shard at the neck and a jagged lower edge. Flared plates sweep over the shoulders.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the neck shard and the jagged lower edge; colour 2 on the line accents; colour 3 on the vent-like slashes.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The female version has smooth, wide flared plates that sweep out over the shoulders and chest, where the male version has thin, ragged blade-like shards.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Samurai_Katagi.description: A sleeveless samurai-style kataginu vest with flared, winged shoulder pieces, a wrapped V-neck front, vertical contrasting stripes down the front and back, a small circular emblem on the chest and back, and a waist-length hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Samurai_Katagi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the shoulder wings, front wrap edges and hem trim; colour 2 on the vertical stripes and neckline edge; colour 3 on the circular emblems.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Sasquatch_03.description: A shaggy fur mantle of jagged, feather-like tufts draped around the neck and shoulders, with a V-shaped strip down the upper chest and a longer tapering fall across the upper back. Wild, tribal look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Sasquatch_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the fur tufts; colour 0 on the highlighted inner tufts along the centre and at the neckline; colour 2 on the shadowed tips near the collar.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Sasquatch_03.differs: The female version has a narrower chest strip that stays closer to the centre, with less fur spreading over the front of the shoulders.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_.description: A sleeveless sci-fi chest layer covering the bust and upper back with a rounded, panelled shell, a raised collar, an atom emblem on the front, a pointed centre tip and segmented plates flaring at the lower ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and back stripes; colour 2 on the collar and one bust cup; colour 3 on the upper chest panel and back patch; colour 0 on the atom emblem, lower plates and centre tip.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_.differs: The female version has separate rounded bust cups with an asymmetric contrasting and contrasting colour split, and lower flared plates hanging at the ribs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shackles_01.description: A mechanical harness of angular plate over the shoulders and upper chest, joined to a rigid waist band by ribbed strap panels and hanging chain links. Blocky clamp-like cuffs sit on the plates and band, giving a prison-restraint look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shackles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plates and waist band; colour 1 on the chains and clamp-like cuffs; colour 3 on the ribbed strap panels; colour 2 on the recessed back panel.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shackles_01.differs: The female harness has a narrower, more tapered shoulder plate and a slimmer waist band, with the ribbed panels sitting closer together in the centre of the torso.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shadow_Destroy.description: A cropped, sleeveless vest with armhole openings and edged trim, worn over the chest. A contrasting spindly spider-like frame runs down the front, with curved horns and segmented arms arching over the shoulders and legs dangling below the hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shadow_Destroy.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the vest body; colour 0 on the armhole and neckline edging; colour 2 on the central frame, back straps and claw legs; colour 3 on the segmented arm joints and horn bases.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shadow_Destroy.differs: The female vest is a shorter, rounded top with no shoulder cap on the far side, and its horns arch out at the sides of the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shirt_Annivers.description: A cropped, long-sleeved wrap-style top with a crossing V neckline edged in contrasting piping, soft loose sleeves that flare into bell-shaped cuffs, ending just under the chest. Suggests a mystic, kimono-like look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shirt_Annivers.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body of the top and upper sleeves; colour 1 fading in on the lower sleeves and cuffs; colour 3 on the piping along the crossing neckline; colour 2 on the cuff edges.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharnes.description: A partial shoulder harness of flat straps forming a Y-shaped panel over the chest, with a band around the ribs and straps over the shoulders. Small boxy pockets sit on each side of the upper chest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharnes.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strap panels; colour 1 on the edge piping and outlines; colour 2 on the boxy pockets and the underside of the straps; colour 3 on the small lights on the pockets.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharnes.differs: The female harness has a Y-shaped front panel with two pockets on the left and two on the right sides of the chest, and crossing straps on the back that meet in a V.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharnes.description: A cropped shoulder harness of broad straps forming a Y shape over the chest and an X across the back, joined by a band under the bust, with three small canisters clipped to each side of the upper chest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharnes.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the harness straps and chest panel; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the canister bodies and inner strap backing; colour 3 on the canister end caps.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharnes.differs: The female harness has a Y-shaped chest panel meeting at the sternum, with an under-bust band, while the male has a crossing X-shaped chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharnes.description: A cropped, sleeveless shoulder harness of flat panels wrapping over the shoulders and upper chest, with H-shaped cut-outs at front and boxy window openings at the back; sits over the torso like a light mechanical bolero.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharnes.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main harness bands; colour 1 on the thin edge trim and outlines around the openings.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharnes.differs: The female harness is a fuller, more closed panel that covers the shoulders and back, with smaller window cut-outs and a shorter, wider front.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Skullbra_Sover.description: A bra-like harness of two carved skull cups over the chest, linked by thin cables with small cylindrical connectors. Thick crossed straps loop over the shoulders and cross between the shoulder blades at the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Skullbra_Sover.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skulls; colour 1 on the straps and cables; colour 3 on the small connector caps; colour 2 on the eye sockets and fittings.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Skullbra_Sover.differs: The female version is a symmetrical bra with two skulls, one over each breast, and crossed straps over both shoulders, whereas the male version is a single diagonal sash.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Snake_01.description: A short, cropped chest armour vest of overlapping scale-textured plates with chevron ridges across the back, outlined by contrasting trim, with open armholes and a shaped V notch at the neck. Sits over the bust and upper torso as a partial layer.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the side and underarm panels; colour 2 on the outline trim along the edges.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The female version has a closed, bust-shaped front with a pointed lower hem and no gap at the front.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted chest vest of paneled armor-like plating with contoured cups, mesh side inserts, a raised round neck plate and a wide contrasting border framing the open armholes; a triangular emblem panel marks the back and it ends at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating; colour 1 on the outer border, armhole rims and back frame; colour 2 on the mesh side inserts and lower band; colour 3 on the line markings, chevrons and back triangle.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Socrates_01.differs: The female version has separate sculpted bust cups with mesh panels beneath them and a shorter cropped hem.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_.description: A short, cropped chest piece with rounded, padded bust cups over a pointed heart-shaped lower plate, open at the back with a jagged edge. Sits on the torso over the suit; a sleek sci-fi pharaoh look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bust cups and back shell; colour 0 on the upper rim and lower pointed plate; colour 3 on the swept side panel of the bust; colour 2 on the inner back panel and small trim gaps.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_.differs: The female version has rounded, padded bust cups with a heart-shaped plate beneath, rather than flat angular plates.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Speakers.description: A single round speaker disc mounted at the upper chest: a chunky faceted rim surrounds a ribbed cone with a central dome, and the cone tapers to a point behind. Mechanical, comic-style gadget.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Speakers.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim; colour 0 on the ribbed speaker cone face; colour 2 on the central dome.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelcommando_.description: A cropped mechanical armour harness worn over the chest: a collar-like shoulder yoke with rounded plates crossing over the shoulders, a central round port on the chest plate, and a ribbed segmented panel tapering down the abdomen.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelcommando_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, back plate and edge trim; colour 3 on the shoulder yoke and strap plates; colour 1 on the ribbed side and abdomen panels; colour 2 on the central port.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelcommando_.differs: The female version has a smaller, more open chest plate with the shoulder yoke sitting higher and narrower around the neck.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelhawk_Feat.description: A feathered shoulder mantle of overlapping pointed feather plates, forming a short collar-like cape across the upper chest, shoulders and upper back; the front stops just below the collarbone and the back reaches between the shoulder blades.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelhawk_Feat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather plates, shading to darker tones toward the back; the feather material mostly ignores the other colour slots.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelhawk_Feat.differs: The female mantle is shorter at the front, ending just under the collarbone, while the male one hangs lower over the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Summer_01.description: A short-sleeved, loose-fitting Hawaiian-style shirt with an open collar and a tropical print of large leaves, palm trees and hibiscus flowers. It sits at the waist over the torso and upper arms.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Summer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shirt body and sleeves; colour 2 on the lower shirt body; colour 0 on the leaf, palm tree and flower prints; colour 3 on the collar and sleeve-edge leaf accents and the flower petals.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspender_Rule.description: Pair of wide suspender straps that run over the shoulders and down the chest and back, with a scalloped scale-like texture, spiky pointed tabs at the shoulders and small cuffed ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspender_Rule.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the straps; colour 2 on the spiky shoulder tabs and the strap end tips.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspenders_01.description: Thin suspender-style straps that run over both shoulders and join in a Y at the front and back, ending in pointed tips at the waist. They sit on top of a bodysuit and follow the bust.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspenders_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap centres; colour 2 on the strap edges and outlines; colour 1 on the pointed tips and small clasp bands.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspenders_01.differs: The female straps curve around the bust and are tighter to the body, with no clasp bands on the front straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspendersthin.description: Thin suspender straps that run over each shoulder and cross into a Y shape at the front and back, ending in short frayed strap tails at the lower ribs and lower back. A light accessory over a bodysuit.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspendersthin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central stripe of each strap; colour 2 on the strap edges; colour 1 on the small connector clips; colour 3 on the dangling strap ends.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted chest layer with a molded muscle-plate torso, capped shoulders and a V-shaped contrasting panel at the neck, with a small collar. A cage of angular open bands wraps the ribs, meeting at a diamond clasp on the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulder and rib-band plating; colour 1 on the V-shaped neck and upper back panel; colour 2 on the collar and back clasp pieces; colour 3 on the small diamond at the upper back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.differs: The female version has a rounded, sculpted bust and a more open, thinner rib cage, while the male one has broader shoulders and heavier rib bands.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A partial symbiote-style band of thin, angular open-framed struts wrapping the midriff and lower ribs, with sharp curved spikes at the edges and a central gem-like plate flanked by faceted shards.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular frame struts and spikes; colour 2 on the faceted shards beside the centre; colour 1 on the central plate; colour 3 on the inset marking in the centre.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Talisman_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting vest with a tall flared stand-up collar rising behind the head, open armholes and a V-shaped front opening, all edged in contrasting trim. Ends at the waist with a pointed hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body with a fade toward the hem; colour 3 on the inside of the tall collar; colour 1 on the outside of the collar and the edge trim; colour 2 on the darker upper chest shading.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Talisman_01.differs: The female collar rises higher and more upright behind the head, and the front hem dips into a narrower point.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_01.description: A sleeveless, sleek mechanical chest layer: a pointed, winged shoulder-yoke with jigsaw-like seam lines and an arched inlay, over a corset-shaped torso plate with panelled outlines, ending at the hip.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder yoke and main plate surfaces; colour 3 on the arched inlay at the collar; colour 1 on the thin outline seams on the torso panels; colour 2 on the seam lines on the yoke.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_01.differs: The female version has a curved, corset-like torso plate that flares slightly at the hem, with a more pointed yoke.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_02.description: A sleeveless, sculpted chest armour shell with a wide flared shoulder-collar plate, curved cut-out on the upper chest, thin circuit-like inlaid lines, and a segmented lower torso section ending at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate and main shell; colour 1 on the thin circuit lines on the torso; colour 2 on the etched outlines and inner neck opening; colour 3 on the curved trim around the chest cut-out and neckline.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_02.differs: The female version has a taller, sharper pointed shoulder-collar plate with a narrower, more open neck, and the chest cut-out is less wide than the male's.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_03.description: A cropped, partial mechanical shoulder-and-upper-chest cape-collar piece that flares over both shoulders and back, with jagged panel seams and a contrasting-edged arc across the upper chest around a neck opening.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 3 on the arc piping and neck-ring edging; colour 2 on the jagged seam lines; colour 1 on the thin centre line accents.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_04.description: A strapless, corset-like sci-fi midsection wrap of smooth plates that spans from under the bust to the waist, with an open split front panel and thin circuit-like contrasting line details.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating; colour 1 on the thin circuit-like trim lines; colour 2 and colour 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_04.differs: The female version is a shorter, bust-hugging corset that ends at the waist with a split front, and has no large rounded side panels.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_05.description: A strapless, corset-like armored midsection wrapping the torso from under the bust to the hips, with a split front showing an inner panel, flared pointed hem, and thin outlined panel seams front, sides and back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor shell and inner panel; colour 1 on the thin trim lines along the panel edges; colours 2 and 3 not visible.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_05.differs: The female version is longer, reaching down over the hips with a flared, pointed hem and rising to a shaped bust line, while the male version is a short band around the ribs and abdomen.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Trumpknight_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length tunic vest with a round neckline and wide armholes. Soft draped folds and wrinkles ripple across the chest and back, and the hem gathers loosely at the waist. It sits over a long-sleeved base.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Trumpknight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tunic; the default material shows no visible use of the other colour slots.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Trumpknight_01.differs: The female tunic hangs closer to the body and is slimmer, with a rounded bust and less bulk than the male version.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Tubed_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped mechanical chest shell with a raised collar, large round reactor-style core with ring housing on the sternum, vent holes beneath it, round side studs and a separate lower band; ends above the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Tubed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, collar and core ring; colour 1 on the lower band and the round shoulder discs; colour 3 on the central core button; colour 2 on thin seam lines.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_01.description: A cropped, sleeveless open-front urban vest with a chunky bulky hood bunched at the neck, a V-shaped inner panel, ribbed hem, contrasting piping stripes and small diagonal accents; the armholes have ragged, torn edges.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the inner V-shaped panel; colour 2 on the hood; colour 3 on the front edging, piping, diagonal accents and ribbed hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_01.differs: The female vest has a deep V inner panel that shows only a narrow triangle of the chest, with the vest hugging closer at the bust.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.description: A short, sleeveless, waist-length vest that opens down the front, with a contrasting yoke across the shoulders and upper back, cap-like shoulder edges, vertical front edge panels, and a light hem band. Casual anime-inspired street look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vest body; colour 2 on the shoulder and upper-back yoke; colour 3 on the front opening edge panels; colour 0 on the bottom hem band.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Jersey_0.description: A short-sleeved sports jersey with a V-neck, large number on the chest, a name and number on the back, side panels and striped sleeve cuffs. Loose and hip-length, it looks casual and sporty.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Jersey_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves; colour 1 on the side panels, neck inset and sleeve stripes; colour 2 on the outlines and sleeve bands; colour 3 on the numbers and name lettering.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Jersey_0.description: A loose short-sleeved sports jersey with a V-neck, large number 17 on the chest and a name and number on the back, side panels, and banded sleeve cuffs; hangs to the hips as a casual layer.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Jersey_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves; colour 1 on the side panels, neck lining and sleeve bands; colour 3 on the numbers and lettering; colour 2 on the outlines and sleeve stripes.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vest_Harajuku_.description: A short, sleeveless cropped vest with wide notched lapels, a closed front fastened by two buttons, and piped edging around the armholes and hem. It sits over the chest and ends above the waist, in a casual street-fashion style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vest_Harajuku_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the lapels and the inner collar; colour 2 on the piping along the edges and seams; colour 3 on the buttons.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasic_01.description: A sleeveless, closed-front waistcoat with a deep V neckline, a stitched chest pocket and three buttons, ending in a pointed hem at the waist. The back is a separate plain panel with a small strap detail.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front of the vest; colour 1 on the buttons and pocket stitching; colour 2 on the back panel; colour 0 on the back strap.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasic_01.differs: The female vest has the chest pocket on the wearer's right, and its back panel wraps less around the sides.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasicopen_.description: A short, sleeveless waistcoat worn over the torso, open at the front with a row of buttons, a stitched chest pocket outline and a pointed hem. The back is a separate plain panel with a small strap tab.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasicopen_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panels of the vest; colour 2 on the back panel and the inner lining; colour 1 on the buttons and pocket stitching.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbiker_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped biker vest with notched open lapels, a hanging open front, a chest pocket with small stud, and contrasting piped edging on the armholes, hem and back seams; sits at the waist over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbiker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the piping along the lapels, armholes, hem and seams; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_01.description: A sleeveless, padded combat vest with a raised open collar and a centre front zip. A wide central panel contrasts with wrinkled side panels, and it ends at the waist over the torso.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and side panels; colour 1 on the central front and back panels.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_02.description: A sleeveless tactical combat vest with a zip front, a small folded collar, a contrasting centre panel front and back, and utility pouches clustered at the waist hem. Sits over the torso and ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side panels, collar and armholes; colour 1 on the centre front and back panels; colour 2 on the waist pouches.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_03.description: A sleeveless tactical combat vest with a padded front and back plate, a folded collar, side panels, and two horizontal straps with buckles around the lower torso. It sits over the chest and ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and side panels; colour 1 on the front and back plates and the lower edge; colour 2 on the two waist straps; colour 3 is not visible.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombatscie.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tactical vest with wide shoulder straps, outlined panel seams, and small strap tabs at the sides. It ends at the waist and sits over the torso like light body armor.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombatscie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body and straps; colour 2 on the outlines, seams and strap edging; colour 3 on the side tabs and fasteners.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombatscie.differs: The female vest is coloured mostly with colour 0 and has contrasting side tabs, with no separate side panels; the male version has a colour 1 front and back with separate side panels.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestknives_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length open-front vest with a deep V neckline and a contrasting hem band. Small knife blades hang from round fasteners down both fronts, and a short strap panel sits across the back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestknives_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the hem band, lower front panel and back strap panel; colour 3 on the knife blades and the round fasteners.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestoriental_0.description: A sleeveless, cropped open-front vest with a wide neckline and armholes, contrasting edge trim, and three short contrasting straps bridging the gap down the centre of the chest. Sits over the torso and ends at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestoriental_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the vest body, fading lighter toward the hem; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the chest straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestoriental_0.description: A sleeveless, cropped oriental-style vest with an open front held by a few contrasting cross-straps at the chest, contrasting trim along the edges, and large flared, angular shoulder wings that sweep up and outward.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestoriental_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main vest body; colour 0 on the shoulder wings and lower hem gradient; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the front cross-straps.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestsovereign_.description: A cropped, sleeveless cloth vest with a ragged torn hem, worn open at the front and asymmetric, with a stitched patch pauldron over one shoulder and three throwing knives strapped diagonally across the chest.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestsovereign_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest cloth; colour 1 on the knife handles and stitching; colour 2 on the knife blades and the cross mark on the shoulder patch; colour 3 on the round stud on the shoulder patch.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviper_01.description: A sleeveless tactical body-armour vest with outlined edges, wide shoulder straps, small square tabs down the front and a waist band carrying four small pouches. It sits over the torso and ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 2 on the edge outlines; colour 1 on the pouches and waist band; colour 3 on the tabs and small strap ends.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviper_02.description: A sleeveless tactical vest with contrasting outlined panels, shoulder straps with tabs, contrasting chevron accents down the chest, and a belt of buckled ammo pouches around the lower ribs. Ends at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the pouches and waist belt; colour 2 on the outlines and edging; colour 3 on the chevron patches and strap tabs.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviperknive.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tactical vest with thick outlined edges, shoulder straps, a waist band with a strap around the midsection, and small knife handles hanging low at the belt line; ends at the ribs.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviperknive.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 2 on the outlines, waist band and straps; colour 3 on the small strap tabs and clips; colour 1 on the knife sheaths at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviperknive.differs: The female vest carries the knives in short clusters at the waist only, while the male version has long knives hanging down the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vine_01.description: A partial chest overlay of curling, tendril-like vines with pointed tips, spreading over the chest and looping over the shoulders to the upper back, with a swirled centre panel. Organic, alien look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine tendrils; colour 0 on the swirled centre panel and streaks along the vines; colour 3 on the pointed tips.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vine_01.differs: The female vines sit a little higher and looser, with shorter tendrils over the ribs and a less wrapped-around side.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A sleeveless mechanical armor chest piece of segmented angular plates with a raised shoulder yoke, a ribbed abdomen section and a vented contrasting lower band. It sits over the torso, ends at the waist, and suggests heavy sci-fi power armor.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke and inner chest panels; colour 2 on the lower band and the chest vent panel; colour 3 on the small accent lights.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vulture_Mane_0.description: A short feathery mane collar that wraps around the neck and shoulders, with ragged pointed tufts hanging over the upper chest and shoulder blades. It sits as a wild, animal-like ruff over the top.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vulture_Mane_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper band at the neck; colour 0 on the shaggy tufts.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Vulture_Mane_0.differs: The female mane is a little shallower, and the opening at the front is smaller and sits flatter against the chest.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Wedding_Dress_.description: A sleeveless halter-style top with deep plunging V neckline, fitted bust cups, gathered contrasting band under the bust with a round brooch and small hanging drops, and a fitted lower section ending at the waist; open back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Wedding_Dress_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bust cups and lower waist section; colour 1 on the halter straps and gathered band; colour 3 on the brooch and hanging drops; colour 2 on the small edge trim along the band.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Windbreaker_01.description: A fitted, long-sleeved zip-front windbreaker with a small turned-down collar, a centre zip, thin piping down the sides and a gradient fade across the body; ends at the waist with a snug hem.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Windbreaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and upper body; colour 0 on the collar, lower body fade and zip; colour 3 on the side piping.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Windbreaker_01.differs: The female jacket is close-fitting with a snug hem, while the male version has puffier, looser sleeves.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Windbreakerrol.description: A fitted, long-sleeved windbreaker jacket with a wide open collar, a front zip left partly open, and thick rolled cuffs at the forearms. It ends at the waist and has thin piping down the sides.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Tight_Windbreakerrol.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper body and sleeves, fading toward colour 0 at the collar and lower hem; colour 2 on the rolled cuffs; colour 3 on the side piping stripes; colour 0 on the zip.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Toxicsteel_01.description: A pair of separate padded, rolled tube-shaped shoulder wraps that curve in a partial arc over each shoulder, with small segment seams and rounded coiled ends. Floating pauldron-like accessories with a mechanical look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the padded rolls; colour 2 on the small seam marks and stitching details.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Traveler_01.description: A sleeveless, corset-style vest with a raised standing collar, large rounded shoulder caps and a V-shaped yoke, trimmed with piping. It laces up the front with strap-and-toggle fastenings and ends in a pointed hem at the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body and collar; colour 1 on the shoulder caps, yoke, lacing straps and side bands; colour 2 on the edge piping and trim; colour 3 on the toggles.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_V.description: A sleeveless, open-front hooded vest ending at the waist, with a raised collar and bulky hood, contrasting shoulder and upper-back panels, contrasting-accented front edges and a light hem band. Urban street style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_V.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vest body and hood lining; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder and upper-back panels; colour 3 on the front edge stripes; colour 0 on the bottom hem band.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_V.differs: The female vest has a slimmer cut, with shoulder panels that are smaller and less boxy and a larger contrasting area only at the collar and upper back.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_V.description: A sleeveless, waist-length hooded vest with a high open collar, a bulky hood bunched at the back of the neck, a split open front with contrasting strips along each edge, and a light hem band. Casual urban anime look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_V.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vest body and hood lining; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder panels and upper back yoke; colour 3 on the front edge strips; colour 0 on the bottom hem band.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Vest_Swing_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length tailored vest with wide notched lapels, a pointed lower hem, a row of three buttons and a small pin on the chest. It is worn over a high-collared shirt, in a formal swing-era style.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Vest_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 2 on the lapels and collar edge; colour 1 on the shirt front and collar; colour 3 on the buttons and the chest pin.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Vest_Wizards_01.description: A strapless corset-style vest with a glossy sculpted bust section above a gathered lower panel, a row of buttons down the front, and pointed tails at the hips. It sits over the torso, ending at the waist, with a low open back.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Vest_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered lower panel and back rim; colour 2 on the bust section, hem points and edging; colour 1 on the front buttons.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Vigilante_01.description: A pair of loose looped shoulder straps that rise over each shoulder like open bands, with a rectangular buckle on each strap at the front. A casual superhero harness accent that leaves the torso bare.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad centre band of each strap; colour 1 on the edge piping and inner face of each loop; colour 3 on the buckles.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Vigilante_Short_01.description: A pair of loop straps that encircle each shoulder like harness bands, with a padded outer face, contrasting inner lining and a square buckle at the front. Sits over the shoulders as a light tactical accessory.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Vigilante_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded outer strap face; colour 1 on the edge piping and inner lining; colour 3 on the square buckles.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Warrior_01.description: A sleeveless, quilted armoured chest piece with a raised collar and padded shoulder caps, a ribbed chevron-striped centre panel and crossed straps across the back; it stops at the upper ribs, above the waist.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the quilted outer shell and shoulder caps; colour 1 on the ribbed front panel stripes; colour 0 on the stripe highlights and back panel; colour 3 on the edge trim and back strap details.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Warrior_01.differs: The female version ends at the ribs as a short cropped piece with no lower waist band, and has a raised collar.

Female/F_Chestlayer_Warrior_02.description: A small shield-shaped chest plate covering the upper torso in a downward-pointing V, with a ribbed, chevron-striped centre and layered side plates at the edges; hollow and open behind. Suggests a mechanical warrior look.
Female/F_Chestlayer_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed chest centre; colour 0 on the chevron stripes and top edge; colour 3 on the side plate edges; colour 2 on the banded side plate segments.

Female/F_Collar_Angel_01.description: A rigid armored collar-cape that rests over the shoulders and upper chest, rising to a rounded neck ring and dropping to a pointed shield-like tip at the front. It has a raised contrasting rim, panel seams, contrasting round vents and an arrow emblem.
Female/F_Collar_Angel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the neck ring and edge trim; colour 3 on the arrow emblem; colour 2 on the round vent details.

Female/F_Collar_Angel_Armor_01.description: A wide, flared armored collar with a lined inner rim, rounded cut-out details and panel seams, dropping to a pointed gem-like shield at the front of the chest. Small tabs trail at the back of the neck; sci-fi angelic style.
Female/F_Collar_Angel_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar plates; colour 1 on the inner rim, edge trim and back tabs; colour 3 on the front pointed shield; colour 2 on the round cut-out marks.
Female/F_Collar_Angel_Armor_01.differs: The female collar sits lower and slopes into a longer, more pointed front shield, with the collar opening tilted forward.

Female/F_Collar_Animal_02.description: A fur-style animal collar draped over the shoulders and upper chest, made of layered tufts that end in jagged, flame-like points, with a darker knotted tuft cluster at the centre of the chest.
Female/F_Collar_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body of the collar; colour 1 on the jagged outer tips; colour 2 on the central tuft cluster and the underside lining.

Female/F_Collar_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A soft draped hooded cowl with a deep hood and a short shoulder cape that sits over the collarbones and shoulders. Diamond-shaped studs run along the front edge, with a round clasp and a hanging tassel at one side.
Female/F_Collar_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hood and draped cloth; colour 0 on the studs and round clasp; colour 3 on the tassel.
Female/F_Collar_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The tassel hangs at the front of the chest, at the centre-left of the cowl, and is not visible from the back.

Female/F_Collar_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A tall stand-up collar with a glossy angular outer shell that flares open at the front and rises around the back of the neck, lined inside with a separate panel and edged with contrasting trim. Retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Collar_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner lining and the edge trim; the outer shell is glossy metal that largely ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Collar_Anubis_01.description: A broad Egyptian-style collar necklace lying flat over the neck and upper shoulders, with a wide banded rim, a patterned border of repeating triangular motifs, and a rectangular pendant panel dropping onto the upper chest.
Female/F_Collar_Anubis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body and pendant; colour 1 on the patterned outer border and pendant stripes; colour 3 on the thin piping lines; colour 2 on the inner rim and motif centres.

Female/F_Collar_Arcane_01.description: A high, stiff standing collar that flares into a broad pointed shoulder cape-collar, dipping to a V at the chest and back. Swirling raised scrollwork covers the surface and a thin rim edges the outline, in an arcane mage style.
Female/F_Collar_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main collar surface and inner lining; colour 0 on the swirling scrollwork and the outer rim edging; colour 2 on the thin inner edge line at the top of the collar.
Female/F_Collar_Arcane_01.differs: The female version is a tall, solid flared collar with swirling scrollwork, while the male version is an open framework necklace of separate panels.

Female/F_Collar_Bandana_01.description: A triangular bandana worn loosely around the neck like a cowl scarf, with a soft draped point hanging over the upper chest and back, and the ends knotted at the side of the neck with short tails.
Female/F_Collar_Bandana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the bandana; colour 1 on the gradient tint toward the hanging point; colour 2 on the knot and tails.

Female/F_Collar_Bolts_01.description: A pair of mechanical neck bolts, one jutting out from each side of the neck: tapered, pointed spikes with a coiled, threaded middle section and a chunky collar ring at the base. Frankenstein-style sci-fi hardware.
Female/F_Collar_Bolts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coiled threaded shafts; colour 1 on the base collar rings; colour 3 on the pointed tips.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Bolts_01.description: Two small clusters of jagged, crackling electric arcs floating at either side of the neck, like sparks jumping off the collar line. There is no solid band; the effect is thin and glowing.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Bolts_01.colourAreas: The effect ignores the colour scheme and glows a single bright shade; no colour slots are visibly applied.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Cryo_01.description: Two ribbed, hose-like tubes that curve around the neck in an open ring, split at the front and back, with small contrasting end caps. A mechanical, cryo-tech collar that floats loosely around the head and neck.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed tubes; colour 2 on the end caps.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Cryo_02.description: A pair of flexible ribbed hoses that arc around the neck like an open ring, rising to ear height at the back and curving down to the collarbones at the front, each ending in a small capped nozzle.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed hose bodies; colour 2 on the small end caps.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A narrow, single-panel cloth cape hanging from one side of the neck, sitting off-centre and draping down the body to about hip level. It has soft vertical folds and a slightly widening, rounded hem.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel; the gathered neck edge is shaded darker.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Guardian_01.description: A narrow, crest-like collar piece running down the back of the neck: a ridged, crumpled spine with a row of swept-back, tapering spines that grow larger toward the bottom. Suggests a dragon or creature fin.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ridged body of the crest; colour 1 on the swept spines and their tapering tips.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small mechanical chest plate sitting at the upper sternum: a flat anvil-shaped plate with a curved inset strip along the bottom, a thick curved central tube rising from it, and two octagonal slotted screw-heads at the top.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the curved inset strip; colour 2 on the central tube and the backs of the screw-heads; colour 3 on the slotted screw-head faces.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Lockbox_66_02.description: Two small separate mechanical fittings on the upper chest: a round, shallow disc with a recessed centre near the collarbone, and below it an upright rounded-rectangle housing with a raised rim and inset panel.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer casings of both fittings; colour 2 on the recessed centre of the round disc; colour 3 on the inset panel of the oblong housing.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Neck_Heart_01.description: A small faceted heart-shaped pendant with a gem-cut inset centre and a shallow, chunky body. It sits flat against the upper chest just below the neck, suggesting a jewel-like charm.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Neck_Heart_01.colourAreas: Glossy faceted metal-like surface mostly ignores the scheme; colour 3 shows on the inset gem centre.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Neck_Lights_01.description: A scattered ring of small teardrop-shaped studs or lights spread around the base of the neck and across the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, with no connecting band. Suggests a mechanical implant look.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Neck_Lights_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on about half of the small studs; colour 3 on the other studs.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Prisoner_01.description: A set of three small conical studs spaced around the base of the neck, one at the front centre and two at the sides or back. They float as separate points, like a minimal mechanical collar.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Prisoner_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the two side studs; colour 3 on the front stud. Colour 0 and colour 1 are not visible.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Prisoner_02.description: A minimal shoulder harness of thin flat straps: a loop around each shoulder crossing over the chest, joined by a narrow band across the upper back, with small rivets at the strap ends.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Prisoner_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder loops and straps; colour 1 on the band across the upper back.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_.description: A long, narrow cloth scarf tail hanging straight down the middle of the back from the neck to the lower back, ending in short fringe. Suggests a pulp aviator look.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scarf cloth; fringe follows the same colour.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_.differs: The female scarf tail hangs lower, reaching the lower back, and looks narrower and longer than the male one.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Space_01.description: A small faceted spherical shell, open at the top like a bowl, floating at the base of the throat over the upper chest. It reads as a compact, futuristic collar ornament with faint diagonal banding on the sides.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shell; the default material appears mostly and glossy, with no other slots clearly visible.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Starowl_01.description: A slim curved metal rod shaped like a shallow U that rests around the base of the neck and upper chest, ending in a hexagonal bolt-head cap at each tip. A minimal mechanical collar accent.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved rod; colour 1 on the hexagonal end caps.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Cape_Archer_.description: A short cloth cape hanging from the neck and shoulders down to about hip level, with a wide trapezoid shape, a triangular central panel and a broad separate band across the lower part; it hangs behind the body and drapes slightly forward at the sides.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Cape_Archer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges and border of the cape; colour 1 on the triangular upper centre panel; colour 2 on the broad lower band.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Cape_Archer_.description: A short, cloth cape hanging from the shoulders to about hip level, with a trapezoid shape that flares slightly at the hem. It has a wide contrasting band across the lower half and a separate edge trim, and reads as an archer or ranger cloak.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Cape_Archer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edge trim and upper folds; colour 1 on the upper panel; colour 2 on the wide lower band.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Festive_01.description: A small round festive bell pendant hanging at the base of the throat, split into an upper shell and a lower half with a rim between them, hung from a short knotted ribbon with two loose ends.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Festive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shell and rim; colour 1 on the lower half of the bell; colour 2 on the ribbon loops; colour 3 on the knot.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Headphones_0.description: A small atom-shaped emblem of looping elliptical orbits around a central nucleus, sitting flat on the upper chest beside the collarbone. A tiny thin accent mark appears on the opposite shoulder. Science-themed superhero badge.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Headphones_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 0 on the outer edges of the rings.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Headphones_0.differs: The female emblem sits further out toward the shoulder and has a small extra mark on the opposite shoulder.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Martial_Powe.description: A single narrow cloth panel hanging from the shoulder on one side, draping down past the hip in soft vertical folds and tapering toward a rounded hem; a one-sided partial cape.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Martial_Powe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; the inner face looks slightly tinted by colour 1.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Martial_Powe.differs: The female panel hangs a little further toward the centre of the back and looks narrower, with a shorter, more pointed hem.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Ninja_Tails_.description: Two long, narrow cloth tails hanging from the back of the neck down the upper back, like the loose ends of a ninja wrap. They taper to rounded points and hang freely. No front piece is visible.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Ninja_Tails_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both tails; a tiny sliver of colour 3 at the knot at the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Ninja_Tails_.differs: The female tails hang longer, reaching to the waist, and hang slightly apart from each other.

Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Punk_01.description: A tiny flat atom-symbol emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus, sitting on the front of the throat like a small decal. It is a minimal, science-themed accent with no collar or fabric.
Female/F_Collar_Child_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the orbit rings and nucleus; the emblem is thin, so other slots are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Collar_Coil_01.description: A neck piece made of a thick tubular band wound in two spiral loops around the neck, with the ends tapering into long sharp spikes that trail down at the front and back. Mechanical, coil-like look.
Female/F_Collar_Coil_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole coil band and its tapering spike ends.

Female/F_Collar_Coil_Dragon_01.description: A serpentine dragon necklace: a padded, segmented body coils around the neck in three stacked loops, ending in a small horned dragon head with spikes that rests at the front of the throat.
Female/F_Collar_Coil_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer coil body and dragon head; colour 1 on the inner coil bands and the horns and head fins; colour 3 on the small stitched markings along the coils.

Female/F_Collar_Corrupted_01.description: A sailor-style flat collar that drapes over the shoulders, with a raised inner neck band, layered outer and inner panels, scalloped points at the back, and a small pointed jewel-like tie at the front of the throat.
Female/F_Collar_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar panels; colour 1 on the inner layered panel; colour 2 on the neck lining and edge trim; colour 3 on the front pointed ornament.

Female/F_Collar_Cosmic_01.description: A chunky angular mechanical collar ring that sits around the neck, with an open front notch and a pointed plate dropping onto the upper chest, plus a contrasting inner lining. Sci-fi armoured look.
Female/F_Collar_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: The outer shell appears glossy and mostly ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows on the inner lining of the collar.
Female/F_Collar_Cosmic_01.differs: The female collar has a glossy, reflective finish that mostly ignores the colour scheme, rather than the male's multi-colour panels.

Female/F_Collar_Cosmos_01.description: A tall, stiff, high-collar neck piece with vertical ribbed panels around the back and sides, and two long pointed flared tabs sweeping down over the collarbones at the front. A sleek, sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Collar_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body and rim; colour 1 on the recessed vertical ribs at the back and sides; colour 3 on the pointed front tabs; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge seams.
Female/F_Collar_Cosmos_01.differs: The female collar is more closed at the front, with a glossy front face and a narrower, taller neck fit.

Female/F_Collar_Cryo_01.description: A sci-fi high collar ring with a thick coiled cable looped around its rim and small clamp connectors. A pointed, shield-like panel with chevron markings hangs over the upper chest and back, giving a cryogenic gear look.
Female/F_Collar_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar band and the chevron stripe; colour 1 on the main chest and back panels and inner collar; colour 2 on the inner collar rim; colour 3 on the coiled cable and the small panel accents.
Female/F_Collar_Cryo_01.differs: The female version has a shorter, narrower chest point and the panel stays close to the neck, without side pieces sweeping over the shoulders.

Female/F_Collar_Cryo_02.description: A mechanical high collar ring with a padded rim and a cable-wrapped tube looping around the neck, plus a V-shaped armoured chest and back plate with chevron markings. Sits over the shoulders like a cryo-suit gorget.
Female/F_Collar_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded outer collar band and chevron stripe; colour 1 on the V-shaped chest and back plates and clasps; colour 2 on the inner collar rim; colour 3 on the wrapped tube and plate markings.
Female/F_Collar_Cryo_02.differs: The female plate is a compact V that hangs mostly at the front and back, without the extended side wings over the shoulders.

Female/F_Collar_Cyber_Cowbow_02.description: A thick, rolled cowl-style scarf collar that wraps high around the neck and chin, with a thin contrasting trim along the top edge and a long, narrow cloth tail hanging down the back to about hip level.
Female/F_Collar_Cyber_Cowbow_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl and the hanging tail; colour 1 on the thin trim along the top edge of the collar.

Female/F_Collar_Cyberwire_01.description: A rigid, angular high neck collar of layered armored bands: a tall notched rear and side plate, a stepped middle band and a wide lower rim that points downward at the front. Sits snug around the neck and upper collarbone.
Female/F_Collar_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower rim; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 2 on the tall upper plate and inner lining; colour 3 not visible; light trim lines between the bands.
Female/F_Collar_Cyberwire_01.differs: The female collar is a solid, tall, stepped armored collar, while the male version is a looser, thinner ring of overlapping bands with a bulky clasp at the front.

Female/F_Collar_Cyberwire_02.description: A chunky cybernetic neck collar made of stacked ridged bands, with small round studs at the front and a boxy module at the throat linked by short segmented cable connectors that wrap around the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Cyberwire_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main collar body; colour 0 on the ridge bands and trim; colour 1 on the throat module and cable connectors; colour 3 on the round studs.

Female/F_Collar_Datareaper_01.description: A mechanical high collar of angular armored plates that rises into a pointed chin-and-mouth guard at the front, with stacked segmented plates and a round lens-like port at the back of the neck, resting on the upper neck and collarbones.
Female/F_Collar_Datareaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar plates and chin guard; colour 1 on the inset panel around the front and back lower edge; colour 2 on the lens port and shadowed recesses.
Female/F_Collar_Datareaper_01.differs: The female collar is slimmer and sits higher and tighter around the neck, with a smaller shoulder flare.

Female/F_Collar_Deity_01.description: A short, open-topped ring collar that rises from the base of the neck. It is higher at the back and sides, with a folded-over rim, an inner lining panel and a slanted front edge. Suits a sleek sci-fi or superhero jacket look.
Female/F_Collar_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar shell; colour 1 on the inner lining panels; colour 3 is not clearly visible; colour 2 on the underside edge shading.
