Female/F_Collar_Detective_01.description: A tall, upturned jacket collar with two pointed lapels that taper down the chest to a V, and a raised back flap around the neck. Sits on the neck and upper chest, giving a noir detective look.
Female/F_Collar_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the collar and lapels; colour 2 on the edge piping and the inner underside of the collar.
Female/F_Collar_Detective_01.differs: The female collar has shorter, narrower lapels that taper to sharper points.

Female/F_Collar_Draco_01.description: An angular, high-standing metal collar with sharply pointed lapel-like wings that flare at the neck and taper to a deep V point on the upper chest, with a contrasting inner lining and a low band at the back.
Female/F_Collar_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar edges and points; colour 2 on the inner lining and underside; colour 1 and colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Collar_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.description: Two separate clusters of swept-back, blade-like spikes that sit on the shoulders and upper back either side of the neck, with longer curled talon-like spines trailing down behind. Fantasy dragon-scale look.
Female/F_Collar_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper blade spikes, fading into colour 1 at the tips; colour 3 and colour 2 on the lower curled spines.
Female/F_Collar_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The female clusters sit closer together and more upright on the shoulders, with a shorter, more compact spread of spines.

Female/F_Collar_Endo_01.description: A mechanical collar ring that sits around the base of the neck and over the shoulders: a layered, segmented band of angular plates with a glossy rim and a smooth raised inner lip, with visible inner workings at the front.
Female/F_Collar_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and the inner lip; colour 2 on the layered outer plates; colour 1 on the inner mechanism at the front throat.

Female/F_Collar_Extra_Cryo_01.description: Three small detached cylindrical canisters: two short capped nozzles floating near the collarbones and one longer ribbed cylinder at head height behind the neck. A mechanical cryo-tech accessory with no straps or connecting parts.

Female/F_Collar_Extra_Cryo_02.description: Three small detached ribbed cylindrical canisters: one larger horizontal cylinder floating at head level behind the face, and two short capped pods hovering over the collarbones and shoulders. Mechanical, sci-fi accessory look.
Female/F_Collar_Extra_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all three cylinders and their ribbed caps.

Female/F_Collar_Extra_Neck_Goth_01.description: A simple close-fitting choker collar: a short, slightly faceted band that wraps once around the neck with a thin raised rim at the top edge. Gothic and understated, it sits snug at the throat.
Female/F_Collar_Extra_Neck_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band and its rim; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Collar_Extra_Neck_Goth_02.description: A small flat cross pendant with bevelled edges, resting on the upper chest below the throat. It has no visible chain in the render, giving a simple gothic jewellery accent.
Female/F_Collar_Extra_Neck_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cross; the back face appears in a darker shade but takes the same slot.

Female/F_Collar_Fluff_01.description: A thick, bulky fur collar that forms a full ring around the neck and rests on the upper shoulders and collarbone, with shaggy, tufted strands and a slightly ragged outer edge. Suggests a winter or arctic jacket ruff.
Female/F_Collar_Fluff_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the tufted tips and streaks through the fur; colour 2 on the darker fur along the inner rim at the front.

Female/F_Collar_Frigid_01.description: A tall, open-front jacket-style collar that flares around the neck, with a padded mesh-textured lining inside, contrasting edge trim, and a notched, pointed lower edge that drops to a V at the back and to points at the front.
Female/F_Collar_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer collar shell; colour 2 on the edge trim and centre back seam; colour 0 on the quilted inner lining.
Female/F_Collar_Frigid_01.differs: The female collar is a solid, opaque cloth-like shell with a textured lining and contrasting edge trim, whereas the male version is a translucent icy-looking shape without trim.

Female/F_Collar_Fur_01.description: A thick, ring-shaped fur neck warmer with a puffy, ruffled top surface and jagged tufted edges, sitting snugly around the base of the neck over the collarbone. Soft, cosy, winter-jacket styling.
Female/F_Collar_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top surface of the fur; colour 0 on the tufted outer edges; colour 2 on the underside and inner lining.

Female/F_Collar_Gamer_01.description: A slim necktie hanging from a thin loop around the neck, with a chunky knot at the throat and a long tapered blade ending in a pointed tip at mid-chest. Office-smart and casual.
Female/F_Collar_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tie blade; colour 1 on the knot; colour 2 on the neck loop.

Female/F_Collar_Gamer_02.description: A slim necktie worn loose around the neck: a triangular loop of thin band sits at the collar, with a small knot and a tapered blade hanging down the chest. Casual office look.
Female/F_Collar_Gamer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging tie blade; colour 1 on the knot; colour 2 on the neck loop.

Female/F_Collar_Gamer_Short_01.description: A slim necktie hanging from a small gathered knot at the base of the throat, with a pointed tip ending near the lower chest; it bends to follow the bust. Casual office or formal styling with no collar.
Female/F_Collar_Gamer_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tie blade; colour 1 on the knot.
Female/F_Collar_Gamer_Short_01.differs: The female tie bends outward over the bust and then angles back in, while the male tie hangs straighter.

Female/F_Collar_Gamer_Short_02.description: A necktie worn alone without a collar: a small cuff-like knot at the base of the throat with a long, narrow tie hanging down the chest to the lower ribs, ending in a pointed tip. Casual office style.
Female/F_Collar_Gamer_Short_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the knot; colour 0 on the hanging tie.

Female/F_Collar_Guardian_01.description: A tall, flared collar covered in overlapping scale-shaped plates, with a smooth rim around the neck, twin braided cords down the front and a fin-like ruffle of feathery spikes at the back. It sits around the neck and upper shoulders.
Female/F_Collar_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rim and scale outlines; colour 1 on the scale plates; colour 3 on the braided cords at the front; colour 0 on the feathery ruffle at the back and the chest insert.

Female/F_Collar_Inmate_01.description: A short padded funnel collar that sits around the neck and upper shoulders, with an open front, snap studs down the front edge, and a buckled strap running around the back of the neck. Suggests a prison-style or utilitarian jacket collar.
Female/F_Collar_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body; colour 1 on the strap; colour 2 on the snap studs and buckle.

Female/F_Collar_Inmate_02.description: A tall, padded high collar that wraps the neck and rises to the chin, with a thin contrasting rim, a flared front flap that folds outward, and a small clasp with a hanging chain at the centre front.
Female/F_Collar_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main collar body; colour 0 on the upper rim and inner lining; colour 2 on the front flap and lower edge; colour 1 on the hanging chain.
Female/F_Collar_Inmate_02.differs: The female collar has a contrasting inner lining, while the male version's inner lining is coloured like the main collar.

Female/F_Collar_Jacket_Holiday_01.description: A soft draped hood-collar that sits around the neck and shoulders, with a wide folded cowl falling behind and two pointed tapering fronts reaching down the chest; contrasting trim edges the opening. Casual winter-jacket styling.
Female/F_Collar_Jacket_Holiday_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cowl fabric; colour 3 on the trim edging along the opening and the front points.

Female/F_Collar_Kaiju_01.description: A high, stacked-ridge collar rising around the neck, flaring into a wide scalloped shoulder mantle that dips to a V at the chest, with contrasting pointed spikes along the front edge. Leathery, layered superhero look.
Female/F_Collar_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ridged upper collar; colour 3 on the flared shoulder mantle; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Collar_Lockbox_66_01.description: A mechanical armoured collar-harness: a raised padded neck ring with curved shoulder straps meeting at a central anchor-shaped chest plate with two round bolts, and a segmented plated block across the upper back.
Female/F_Collar_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded collar and chest plate surfaces; colour 1 on the crescent inlay of the chest plate and the chevron back panel; colour 2 on the outer framing, back plates and inner lining; colour 3 on the round bolts.
Female/F_Collar_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The chest plate sits centred with both shoulder straps symmetrical over the chest, and the back plating is compact and hangs lower between the shoulder blades.

Female/F_Collar_Lockbox_66_02.description: A wide, rounded mantle collar that drapes over the shoulders and upper chest, with a raised inner band of segmented patterning, a linked ring-and-chain groove around the edge, and a hanging capsule pendant at the front and back.
Female/F_Collar_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer mantle shell; colour 1 on the raised inner band and the lining; colour 3 on the inset segments and the pendant gems; colour 2 on the groove, rings and central round fitting.

Female/F_Collar_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A tall, wide jacket collar that wraps around the neck and flares out into pointed, folded-over wings at the front and back, with a contrasting inner lining. Sits high on the neck and shoulders; a modern, stylish look.
Female/F_Collar_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer folded collar; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge trim.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Animal_02.description: A spiked dog-style collar: a band around the neck with a light inner lining and thin edge piping, contrasting cone spikes along its length, and a square buckle at the front. Punk and street styling.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer band; colour 0 on the inner lining and edge piping; colour 2 on the spikes; colour 3 on the buckle.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Anniversary_Mechano.description: A tall banded neck collar of stacked horizontal rings that rises to the chin and flares into a shallow, pointed yoke over the collarbones and shoulders. It has a retro mechanical look, with a smooth panel covering the front of the throat.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Anniversary_Mechano.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front throat panel and the rings; colour 1 on the wide bands; colour 3 on the accent ring near the base; colour 2 on the thin rings and the lower edge.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Anniversary_Mechano.differs: The female collar has a pointed yoke with a contrasting underside edge that dips into a V at the front and back.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Chai.description: A small pendant of interlocked chain links hanging at the base of the throat: two rectangular links join an octagonal ring that dangles over the upper chest. A tiny mechanical neck accessory with a rugged sci-fi feel.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Chai.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rectangular links; colour 1 on the octagonal rings.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Neck.description: A small spiky neck ornament sitting at the base of the throat: a central downward-pointing blade flanked by curved, thorn-like prongs that sweep up and outward, giving a sharp, angular, alien-tech look.
A small angular pendant shaped like a downward-pointing arrowhead, with a short faceted spike rising from its top. It sits at the base of the throat on the upper chest, in a sci-fi, mechanical style.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Neck.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole pendant, including the arrowhead and its upper spike.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Spik.description: A low, slightly flared collar ring that sits around the base of the neck, with a thin raised rim and a row of short cone spikes across the front. The back is plain, giving a punky sci-fi look.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Spik.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band; colour 1 on the spikes.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Spik.differs: The spikes are spread in a row across the front only, with none at the back.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Swing_03.description: Two small flat oval discs, like thin lenses, sitting on the upper chest just below the collarbones. They are faceted and slightly angled, giving a mechanical, sci-fi accent on a bodysuit.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Swing_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the discs; the material looks glossy and may ignore the colour scheme. No other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Child_Swing_03.differs: The female discs sit flatter against the chest and face more directly forward.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Frigid_01.description: A slim, low neck band that circles the base of the neck like a collar ring, with a thick rounded rim, a thin contrasting edge and a flat inner strap. Suits a sleek bodysuit look.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main rounded rim of the band; colour 0 on the thin outer edge trim; colour 2 on the inner strap.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Goth_01.description: A gothic neck set: a narrow, stiff band collar around the throat with a thin cord loop hanging below it to the chest, ending in a small cross pendant. Sits at the neck and upper chest.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band, cord and cross pendant; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Goth_02.description: A simple band collar that wraps closely around the neck, with a slightly faceted, rolled edge and even height all the way round. Sits at the base of the neck; a plain gothic or formal accent.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar band.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Goth_02.differs: The female collar is a level, even-height ring, while the male version is tilted, sitting higher at the back and dipping lower at the front.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Heart_01.description: A thin, V-shaped cord necklace that rests around the neck and drops to a faceted heart-shaped pendant at the upper chest. Simple, delicate jewellery with a glossy gem-like heart.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Heart_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord; colour 2 on the heart casing; colour 3 on the inner heart facet.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Lights_01.description: A festive string of bulb-shaped lights draped in loose looping strands around the neck and across the shoulders, with the cord swagging over the chest and upper back and bulbs hanging at intervals.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Lights_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord in the male version, here the cord looks dark; colour 3 on some of the bulbs; colour 2 on the other bulbs; colour 1 on the small bulb sockets.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Lights_01.differs: The female cord is thicker and darker with a slightly tighter drape, whereas the male cord is a light twisted wire.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Lockbox_66_02.description: A sleek two-part neck piece: a short angled stand-up collar ring around the throat, encircled by a wider flat oval band that rests on the collarbones and shoulders, with two small inset panels at the front.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper collar ring; colour 1 on the outer oval band; colour 3 on the two front inset panels; colour 2 on the inner collar lining and underside.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Monster_Fur_01.description: A ragged, jagged-edged fur collar that rings the base of the neck, built from overlapping pointed tufts that splay outward and downward onto the shoulders. Wild, monstrous look.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Monster_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer fur tufts; colour 2 on the shadowed inner and underside tufts.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Pumpkin_01.description: A short standing collar rising around the neck, flaring into a broad pointed V-shaped yoke that lies over the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, edged with a contrasting border. A sharp, jacket-like superhero look.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the standing collar and inner yoke; colour 1 on the outer border edging of the yoke.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Reactor_01.description: A mechanical neck accessory of segmented, ribbed tentacle-like cables that arch over the shoulders and drape around the neck, each ending in a tapered nozzle tip; several tips converge at the upper chest.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light ribbed segments; colour 1 on the alternating ring segments; colour 2 on the nozzle tips; colour 3 on the central chest tip.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A chunky chain necklace of flat angular links looped around the base of the neck, with a short pendant tail of two octagonal rings hanging down the centre of the chest. Gritty, rebellious sci-fi look.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chain links; colour 2 on the inner link recesses and shading; colour 1 on the octagonal rings at the front.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_0.description: A rigid, flared metal collar ring sitting at the base of the neck, with a row of short spikes across the front and a draped chain loop ending in a trident-like spiked pendant on the upper chest.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band; colour 1 on the spikes and the pendant; chain takes a metallic finish; colour 2 on the inner collar lining.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_0.differs: The chain hangs as a single short loop at the front only, without the extra chain draped around the back and sides.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_0.description: A rigid flared metal neck collar ringed with short curved spikes along the front, with draped chain loops around the base and a single arrowhead-shaped pendant hanging at the chest. Edgy sci-fi punk look.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band and chain links; colour 1 on the spikes and the arrowhead pendant; colour 2 on the inner collar lining and the back chain.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A slim, rigid choker collar sitting low around the neck, with a raised inner rim and a row of short conical spikes across the front. The back is plain and smooth, giving a punk, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A short, wide funnel collar that sits around the base of the neck and flares slightly outward. A faceted angular plate covers the centre front, with a slim gap between it and the collar. Retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main collar band; colour 0 on the front plate (metallic sheen); colour 2 on the inner lining and edge.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The female collar is a closed ring with a small front plate, sitting higher and more upright around the neck.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Swing_01.description: A long necktie with a small knot at the throat and a pointed tip, hanging down the chest over the bust to the waist. It has a vertical-striped front with art-deco fan motifs, suiting a swing-era formal look.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot, stripes and fan motifs; colour 1 on the lower patterned section; colour 3 on a thin band beneath the knot; colour 2 on the stripe lines; the plain back takes colour 0.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Swing_02.description: A long V-shaped necklace of alternating elongated diamond-shaped metal links and small round beads, draped around the neck and hanging to a point at the centre of the chest, with a matching V at the back.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diamond-shaped links; colour 2 on the small round beads. The glossy metal look mostly ignores the rest of the scheme.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Swing_03.description: A pair of binoculars hanging on a thin cord looped around the neck, resting on the upper chest. Two rounded barrels join at a central hinge, with ringed lens ends and rear eyepieces.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Swing_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel bodies and rims; colour 1 on the lenses at the eyepiece ends; colour 2 on the neck cord.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Tateklys_01.description: A tribal-style neck piece: a thick cord loop at the throat, a segmented ribbed shoulder mantle, and a ring of long curved claw or fang pendants with small round beads hanging over the chest and upper back.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Tateklys_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw pendants; colour 1 on the segmented shoulder mantle; colour 2 on the neck cord; colour 3 on the beads.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Traveler_01.description: A flat, sailor-style collar that drapes over the shoulders and upper chest, with a wide V-shaped front ending in a pointed metal tip, a thick contrasting rim, and a hollow neck opening with a contrasting lining.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar panel; colour 2 on the rim, the inner neck lining and the pointed tip.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Traveler_01.differs: The female collar is shorter at the back and its front point hangs a little higher, sitting closer to the chest.

Female/F_Collar_Neck_Winged_01.description: A small neck collar with a thin band ringing the base of the neck and a layered front piece: two swept-back pointed wing flaps over a rounded under-panel that meets in a sharp point at the chest.
Female/F_Collar_Neck_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing-shaped flaps; colour 1 on the rounded panel beneath them; colour 2 on the underside layer; colour 3 on the neck band.

Female/F_Collar_Persian_01.description: A broad, flat collar-mantle resting over the collarbones and shoulders, covered in overlapping rounded studs or discs, with a ring of small octagonal medallions hanging along the lower edge. Ornate, jewelled-armour look.
Female/F_Collar_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the collar; colour 2 on the rounded discs and studs; colour 1 on the outer octagonal medallion rims; colour 3 on the medallion centres.

Female/F_Collar_Pom_01.description: A wide, flat flared collar that sits around the base of the neck and rests on the shoulders, with a V-shaped front panel and three cords ending in round pom-poms that hang over the upper chest.
Female/F_Collar_Pom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar; colour 1 on the V-shaped front panel; colour 3 on the hanging cords; colour 2 on the pom-poms.

Female/F_Collar_Prisoner_01.description: A rigid mechanical neck collar with a raised rim and small studs, a pointed front plate and a broad back panel, plus thin straps looping over each shoulder and a strap across the upper back. Sits at the neck and shoulders.
Female/F_Collar_Prisoner_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar rim and the shoulder straps; colour 1 on the collar body and the upper back strap; colour 3 on the small front gem; colour 2 on the studs and the front plate.
Female/F_Collar_Prisoner_01.differs: The female back strap is a narrow straight band across the upper back, and the shoulder loops hang slightly lower.

Female/F_Collar_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_01.description: A soft draped aviator scarf wrapped in bunched folds around the neck, with one long fringed tail hanging down the back to mid-back. Suggests a pulp adventurer or pilot look.
Female/F_Collar_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scarf wrap and the hanging tail; the fringe ends take the same colour.
Female/F_Collar_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_01.differs: The hanging tail is narrower and reaches lower down the back, ending near the waist.

Female/F_Collar_Pulp_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A tall, stiff standing collar that flares upward and outward around the neck and head, open at the front with a pointed V dip and a wide rim behind. Edged with thin contrasting trim, in a western-flavoured jacket style.
Female/F_Collar_Pulp_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar cloth inside and outside; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the rim and front opening.

Female/F_Collar_Pumpkin.description: A sculpted bone-like collar with a tall, swooping arched rim around the neck, flowing into layered pointed shoulder plates. Rows of sharp spikes stud the shoulder edges. Gothic, macabre styling.
Female/F_Collar_Pumpkin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar arch and shoulder plates; colour 3 on the largest spikes; colour 2 on the smaller spikes.

Female/F_Collar_Redstone_01.description: A thick, loose cowl-style neck wrap that sits around the neck and upper shoulders, with soft gathered folds and a wide open collar. Stripes of contrasting trim run diagonally across the front.
Female/F_Collar_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the wrap; colour 1 on the diagonal stripes across the front and side.

Female/F_Collar_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A loose, open ring collar with a folded rim sits around the neck, with two thin cords running down the front to a faceted octagonal pendant that hangs on the upper chest. Retro, slightly mechanical charm look.
Female/F_Collar_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the folded collar; colour 1 on the two cords; colour 3 on the octagonal pendant.

Female/F_Collar_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A stiff, open-front high collar of faceted angular panels that wraps around the back and sides of the neck and flares slightly outward, ending in pointed tips at the collarbones. Retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Collar_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: The default material appears glossy metal and mostly ignores the colour scheme; a slight colour 0 sheen shows on the outer edges, with a inner lining.

Female/F_Collar_Rocker_01.description: A thin chain necklace of chunky links that circles the neck and hangs in a V down the chest, ending in a small rectangular tag pendant. Casual rocker or street styling.
Female/F_Collar_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chain links; colour 1 on the rectangular pendant tag.

Female/F_Collar_Sandstorm_01.description: A soft cloth cowl or snood collar: a thick rolled neck ring with loose draped folds that fall over the shoulders, longer at the back. Sits around the neck and upper shoulders in a desert-wanderer style.
Female/F_Collar_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cowl; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Collar_Sandstorm_02.description: A short, wide shoulder collar: a raised, rounded neck ring sits inside a flat, angular cape-like shoulder yoke with a notched point at the front and a pointed drop at the back. It suggests a sci-fi or mechanical jacket.
Female/F_Collar_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shoulder yoke; colour 1 on the raised neck ring and its inner lining; colour 2 on the underside and the clasp piece at the front of the neck.

Female/F_Collar_Scarab_02.description: A stiff, open-front high collar that flares up into two pointed front flaps and sweeps down into a broad shield-shaped panel over the upper back, with a raised slotted plate at the nape. Sits around the neck and shoulders.
Female/F_Collar_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body and flaps; colour 1 on the raised back plate and the thin trim line at the front of the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Scarab_02.differs: The female collar is shorter and sits closer to the neck, with a narrower back panel.

Female/F_Collar_Shadow_Destroyer_02.description: A tall, pointed oval shell that rises behind and around the head like a hood or crest, ribbed on the surface with segmented trim ridges and small spikes along the edges and top. Sits on the neck and shoulders.
Female/F_Collar_Shadow_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed shell body; colour 2 on the segmented ridge bands along the edges and centre; colour 3 on the spikes.

Female/F_Collar_Ski_02.description: A padded hood-style collar that sits around the neck and shoulders, draping down the back in a soft pouch with a contrasting piped edge and a lighter lining. Short zip pulls hang at the front. Sporty ski-jacket look.
Female/F_Collar_Ski_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer hood; colour 1 on the piped edge trim; colour 3 on the zip pulls; the lining shows a lighter fabric.
Female/F_Collar_Ski_02.differs: The female hood sits more open and rounded at the front, with a wider gap at the throat.

Female/F_Collar_Space_01.description: A small rounded orb-like piece worn at the base of the throat, a glossy sphere circled by a thin angular band with a small bead-like knob on each side. Suggests a futuristic sci-fi clasp or collar ornament.
Female/F_Collar_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sphere; colour 2 on the encircling band; colour 1 on the side knobs.

Female/F_Collar_Spooky_01.description: A spiky armoured collar that wraps the neck and shoulders, with a cupped rounded front and layered jagged blades fanning over the chest, shoulders and upper back. Inset slit-like accents give it a menacing, gothic look.
Female/F_Collar_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar plates and spikes; colour 3 on the slit-shaped inset accents; colour 2 on the recessed gaps between plates.

Female/F_Collar_Starhawk_01.description: A sleek superhero shoulder collar: a banded neck ring with a raised front pod, a wide flat cape-like yoke over the shoulders with contrasting trim, a tapered front flap and a shield-shaped panel down the upper back.
Female/F_Collar_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the yoke and back panel; colour 1 on the front pod, front flap and edge trim; colour 2 on the neck band; colour 3 on the small gem-like mark at the back panel base.
Female/F_Collar_Starhawk_01.differs: The front flap is a short pointed shield shape that sits flat on the chest, and the neck pod is a narrower, taller wedge.

Female/F_Collar_Starhawk_02.description: A high, flared collar with pointed flaring wings at the sides, a V-shaped front panel dropping onto the chest, and a shield-shaped plate hanging down the upper back with a small gem-like diamond at its tip.
Female/F_Collar_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body and inner back plate; colour 1 on the raised collar edge, outer trim, side wings and front panel; colour 3 on the small diamond at the back plate's tip.
Female/F_Collar_Starhawk_02.differs: The female version is a solid, opaque collar with defined trim and a diamond on the back plate.

Female/F_Collar_Starowl_01.description: A thick, feathery fur-like collar that wraps around the neck and shoulders, with jagged pointed tufts along the lower edge. Two lobes hang at the front and are joined by a small chain with bead clasps.
Female/F_Collar_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole feathered collar body; colour 1 on the small clasp beads at the front; the thin chain takes a metallic look.

Female/F_Collar_Steampunk_01.description: A tall, flared jacket-style collar that stands up around the neck and back of the head, open at the front with pointed ends dipping toward the collarbones. It has a smooth folded edge with contrasting trim.
Female/F_Collar_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body and inner surface; colour 1 on the edge trim around the rim.

Female/F_Collar_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A high, flared retro-villain collar that rings the neck and spreads over the upper shoulders, with a wide angular front opening and a sharply pointed fold-over flap. It appears glossy and translucent, like a mechanical super-villain cape collar.
Female/F_Collar_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: The default material appears glossy and glassy, largely ignoring the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are clearly readable on this sheet.
Female/F_Collar_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.differs: The female collar renders as a glossy, translucent shell with a pointed flap, while the male version is a solid banded collar with contrasting rims.

Female/F_Collar_Swing_01.description: A tall, standing jacket collar that wraps the neck, with a wide flared fold-over edge and pointed front tips. Contrasting trim edges the rim, with small round buttons and thin straps near the points; retro formal style.
Female/F_Collar_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main collar body; colour 0 on the trim around the edge; colour 3 on the round buttons; colour 2 on the thin straps.

Female/F_Collar_Swing_02.description: A soft cloth neck scarf wrapped loosely around the collar and tied with a large bow at one side of the neck, with a long tail draping diagonally down across the chest.
Female/F_Collar_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped scarf and the long hanging tail; colour 1 on the bow loops; colour 2 on the small knot at the centre of the bow.

Female/F_Collar_Techcollar_Viper_01.description: A large cobra-hood style collar rising behind the head: a segmented, plated shell at the back curves forward into two fang-like tips, framing a scaled, textured inner lining. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Collar_Techcollar_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented outer back shell; colour 1 on the scaled inner lining and edge trim; colour 2 on the inner side rails and segment lines.
Female/F_Collar_Techcollar_Viper_01.differs: The female hood is narrower and sits more upright behind the head, with its fang tips curling closer together.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A soft draped cloth neck wrap that loops loosely around the base of the neck, twisting into folds and gathered at the front by a small wrapped knot band. Casual, scarf-like cravat styling.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped cloth loop; colour 1 on the gathered knot band at the front.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Ankh_01.description: A slim ankh pendant hanging from a thin cord loop around the neck, resting on the upper chest. The cross has a looped top and a raised rim, in an ancient Egyptian style.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Ankh_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cord; colour 1 on the ankh face; colour 0 on the raised rim of the ankh.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Anniversary_Defend.description: A rigid, glossy metal collar with a raised angular ring around the neck and a broad flat shoulder yoke that drops to a point at the chest. Sits over the upper chest and shoulders, with a retro superhero look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Anniversary_Defend.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar; the glossy metal default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A flat sailor-style collar draped over the shoulders and upper chest, with a patterned trim edge and a hanging necktie with a small knot and studs at the front. Sits low around the base of the neck; casual mage-school look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the collar body and necktie; colour 2 on the patterned border trim; colour 0 on the small diamond accents at the knot; colour 3 on the small studs.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Arcane_01.differs: The female version is a low, flat sailor collar with a hanging necktie, while the male version is a tall, stiff, high-collared shoulder cape with no tie.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Arcane_02.description: A broad, open-framed collar necklace resting on the collarbones and neck, with a V-shaped front point. Slim ribbed frames hold inset trapezoid panels, and small round studs mark the joins. It suggests an ornate, ceremonial mage style.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer frame, studs and the underside; colour 0 on the central front panel and the smaller inserts; colour 3 on the two panels flanking the centre; colour 2 on the outer side and back panels.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Arcane_Chain_01.description: A thin chain of interlocking oval links draped in a shallow V across the upper chest and collarbone, with a small curled scroll ornament hanging at the centre. It rests on the clothing like a fantasy necklace.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Arcane_Chain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links and the scroll ornament; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Archer_01.description: A small folded-down shirt collar of flat angular panels that sits around the base of the neck, with pointed front tips resting on the upper chest and a contrasting inner lining showing at the back.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar panels; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 1 only as a slight edge accent near the left front point.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Archer_01.differs: The female collar is almost entirely one colour, with only a tiny contrasting-slot accent at the front point, whereas the male has a large contrasting patch.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Armorbasic_01.description: A plain, smooth high collar forming a tall band around the neck, with a faceted polygonal top edge and a lower edge that dips to a point at the front. Sits snug against the base of the jaw; suits sleek armored or sci-fi suits.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Armorbasic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar band.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A tall, flared high collar that rises around the neck and sweeps outward into wide pointed wings at the sides. It has a smooth lining, thin contrasting edge trim and a striped outer surface, giving a dramatic villainous superhero look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer stripe panels; colour 2 on the stripes between them; colour 3 on the inner lining; colour 0 on the thin edge trim.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bandana_01.description: A triangular cloth bandana worn snugly around the neck, knotted at the back with small pointed tails, with the wide point draping down the chest in soft wrinkled folds. Casual, western or outlaw look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bandana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bandana cloth; colour 2 on the knot tails and the inner back face.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bling_01.description: A chunky bling necklace: a thick braided cord loop hanging from the neck to the upper chest, carrying a large three-dimensional dollar-sign pendant with a raised metal rim and a gem-studded face.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bling_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the braided cord; colour 0 on the pendant's metal rim and sides; colour 3 on the studded face of the dollar sign; colour 2 in the recesses.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bling_Dogz_01.description: A pendant necklace: a thin braided cord loops around the neck and holds a flat, many-sided medallion with a raised rim and three slashing claw-mark cuts across its face. It hangs on the upper chest.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bling_Dogz_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cord; colour 3 on the medallion rim and the claw slashes; colour 0 on the flat face and edge of the medallion; colour 2 on the back of the medallion.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A rigid, angular mechanical collar that sits around the base of the neck and over the tops of the shoulders. It has a blocky front with three small round ports, a bolt-like cap on each side, and a back that flares into pointed tabs.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body; colour 1 on the side bolt caps; colour 3 on the front port lights and the small back light; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A wide, flared collar that sits around the base of the neck and over the shoulders, with a raised rim at the front, a pointed V-shaped drop at the back, and a contrasting trim edge. Suggests a superhero jacket.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised inner rim and edge trim; colour 1 on the outer collar panels; colour 2 on the inner shadowed lining.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bolotie_01.description: A western-style bolo tie: a thin cord loops around the neck and passes through a round textured clasp at the throat, with two cords hanging down the chest, each ending in a small tip.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bolotie_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cords; colour 2 on the clasp and cord tips.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_01.description: A small classic bow tie with two puffed, angular wings joined by a narrow central knot, sitting at the base of the throat. A formal, dapper accent for suits and jackets.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole bow tie, wings and knot.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_01_Glitter.description: A small formal bow tie with two puffed, angular wings pinched by a central knot, sitting at the base of the throat. Its speckled glitter surface gives a dressy, festive look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_01_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the bow and knot; colour 3 on the speckled glitter flecks across the surface. Colours 0 and 2 are not visible.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_03.description: A large, chunky bow tie with two angular wings and a small central knot, sitting at the base of the throat. Soft, slightly puffed cloth construction gives a formal, dapper look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole bow tie, wings and knot.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_04.description: An oversized puffy bow tie worn at the throat: two rounded, cushioned wings with contrasting piping meet at a small knot. Formal, playful accessory that sits under the chin and flares wide past the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front faces of the wings; colour 0 on the knot and edge piping; colour 2 on the inner back panels of the wings.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bronzeking_01.description: A short, snug neck collar band with a faceted rim and lower edge, wrapped around the throat. A row of round studs runs along the middle band. Suggests a mechanical, punk-styled armoured choker.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Bronzeking_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and lower edge trim; colour 1 on the main band; colour 2 on the studs.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Camera_01.description: A small compact camera hanging on a thin flat neck strap, resting on the upper chest. It has a boxy body with top buttons, a protruding ringed lens barrel and a rear plate. A casual, mechanical accessory.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Camera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the camera body front and the strap; colour 1 on the top and bottom edges of the body; colour 3 on the lens barrel rings; colour 2 on the lens housing, rear plate and top buttons.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01.description: A short, cloth half-cape gathered at a small collar around the neck and draped down the back to about the hips, with a tapered triangular panel and a separate wide band along the hem.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges and folds of the cape; colour 1 on the central triangular panel and collar; colour 2 on the lower hem band; colour 3 on the small collar accent.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01.differs: The female cape hangs narrower and sits mostly behind the body, with a smaller drape at the front of the shoulders.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01_Bac.description: A short cloth mantle cape with a small collar at the neck, hanging from the shoulders to about the hips in a wide trapezoid with a separate hem panel, draped loosely over the back in a superhero style.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01_Bac.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges and shoulder folds; colour 1 on the central back panel; colour 2 on the lower hem panel; colour 3 on the small collar detail.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Chain_Krampus_01.description: A heavy chain necklace of chunky interlocking links draped loosely around the neck and resting on the upper chest, with three round spherical weights hanging from the front loop. Suggests a festive, menacing holiday look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Chain_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the link shading; colour 1 on parts of the hanging balls; colour 3 on part of one ball; colour 0 on the remaining ball segments.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Chains_01.description: A heavy chain of chunky rectangular links draped loosely around the neck and over the collarbones, hanging in a V at the front and ending in a short tapered fitting at the chest.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 1 on the tapered end fitting at the chest.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A shaggy, jagged-edged fur-like collar and hood that frames the head and face and drapes over the shoulders and upper chest and back in ragged spiky tufts. Suggests a wild, beast-like or icy mantle.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fur mantle; colour 1 shows faintly as a sheen on the tufts across the upper back.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Choker_01.description: A thin, flat band choker worn snug around the neck, with overlapping ends at the back and a round disc-shaped clasp or pendant at the front of the throat. Minimal, sleek accessory.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Choker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck band; colour 1 on the round front disc.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Clown_Thick_01.description: A jester-style ruffled neck collar made of pointed petal-like tabs radiating around a narrow neckband, with mesh-patterned panels and contrasting edging, resting on the collarbones and shoulders with the longest points at the chest front.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Clown_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner neckband; colour 0 on the mesh-patterned front petals; colour 2 on the back petals and the edge outlines.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Collar_01.description: A crisp, folded-down shirt collar that circles the base of the neck, with two pointed front tips resting on the chest and a small inner band showing. Formal, office-style detail worn over a suit or top.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Collar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar; colour 2 on the inner band visible inside the neckline.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cowl_01.description: A close-fitting, smooth neck cowl that wraps the neck as a short high collar and spreads onto the upper chest and shoulders in a rounded scoop. It sits like a second skin under the head.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cowl; the sheet shows no other colour slots on this piece.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cowl_Thick_01.description: A wide, flat, low collar ring of faceted angular plates that sits around the base of the neck and over the collarbones, with a contrasting panel dipping to a V at the chest and a narrow sliver at the back.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cowl_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer side and back plates; colour 1 on the front chest panel and the inner edge panel.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cravat_01.description: A cravat with a soft ruched band around the neck and a two-tiered folded front panel hanging over the chest, fastened with a small gem pin at the knot. Formal, dapper neckwear.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cravat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cravat band and folded panels; colour 1 on the gem pin.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Madjester_0.description: A cravat-style neck piece: a thick, gathered rolled collar ring around the neck with a soft, ruffled cloth jabot that hangs down the centre of the chest to the bust, in draped layered folds.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Madjester_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rolled collar band; colour 0 on the upper part of the hanging cravat, fading into colour 1 on the lower ruffled folds.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Victorian_0.description: A Victorian-style cravat: a stiff turned-down collar band around the neck with a small knot and a long, narrow, tapering tie hanging over the upper chest. It suggests formal, period dress.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Victorian_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band and knot; colour 1 on the main face of the tie; colour 2 on the tie's side panel; colour 3 on the small patch on the tie.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Victorian_0.differs: The female tie is longer and narrower, hanging in a slim pointed shape with a contrasting side panel, and has a flatter knot.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Dark_01.description: A wide, flat cowl-style collar that drapes over the shoulders and upper chest in a rounded V shape, with a stitched edge and a swirl motif at the front. Sits around the neck as a partial, sleek superhero accessory.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Dark_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body, which shows glossy and on this sheet; colour 1 on the swirl and border piping; colour 3 on the inner panels near the neckline; colour 2 on the stitching and underside.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Dark_01.differs: The default material on the female version looks contrasting and glossy, so the colour scheme barely shows, whereas the male version appears matte and light with the colours clearly visible.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Deco_01.description: A stiff art-deco head collar: a tall tapering fin rises behind the head and a thin framing band curves around the jaw and chin, like a sculpted frame around the face. The back panel has vertical stripe detailing.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Deco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back panel; colour 1 on the vertical stripes down the back panel; colour 2 on the outer edging and the face-framing band.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Deity_01.description: A flat, low V-shaped collar that lies over the shoulders and upper chest like a wide yoke, built from stacked concentric bands with a thin inner rim and a small pointed dip at the back. Suits superhero or sci-fi outfits.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide outer band; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 3 on the thin piping lines between bands; colour 2 on the inner band next to the neck and the inside lining.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Dog_01.description: A wide, snug choker collar band that wraps around the neck, with a row of eyelet holes near the front and a square buckle with a strap tongue at the front. It has a flat inner lining and a casual punk look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner top surface of the band; colour 1 on the outer band; colour 3 on the buckle; colour 2 on the underside lining and eyelet holes.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Dogtags_01.description: A thin chain necklace hanging loosely around the neck with a pair of stacked, rounded-rectangle military dog tags resting on the upper chest. Simple, casual soldier-style accessory.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Dogtags_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain and both tags; no other slots visibly used.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Festive_01.description: A formal neck piece: a stiff, upturned contrasting band collar with a pleated bow tie at the throat, a round seal-like rosette at the knot, and a small two-tone bell hanging beneath. Festive, dressy look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Festive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band and the top half of the bell; colour 1 on the front of the bow and the lower half of the bell; colour 2 on the pleated bow wings; colour 3 on the central rosette.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A thin choker band sitting around the base of the neck, with small round studs and a ring of pointed leaf-shaped petals or feathers fanning outward and downward over the collarbones and shoulders, like a flame or firebird collar.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin edge trim of the band; colour 1 on the main band; colour 3 on the petal centres and the studs; colour 2 on the petal outer shells.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Fishinghat_01.description: A bucket-style fishing hat worn at the back of the neck like a hanging hood, with a soft rounded crown, downturned brim with contrasting edging, a banded strip with small round eyelets, and a thin cord looping around the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Fishinghat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat crown, brim and neck cord; colour 1 on the brim edging; colour 2 on the band segments around the crown; colour 3 on the small round eyelets.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Glueman_01.description: A slim, plain neck band forming a faceted ring that dips into a shallow V at the front and back and sits snug around the base of the neck. Suggests a simple suit collar.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Glueman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A tall, stand-up flared collar that wraps the neck and rises to jaw and ear height, open at the front with a lined inner face and thin contrasting edge piping. A classic superhero jacket collar.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner lining; colour 1 on the top edge piping; colour 2 on the outer shell and lower edge trim.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_01.differs: The female collar is more open and swept forward at the front, and rises a little lower at the sides than the male one.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_02.description: A tall, stiff turned-up collar that rises to cheek height around the neck, with pointed front lapel-like tips that angle down toward the chest and thin contrasting edging. Suggests a classic golden-age superhero jacket.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body; colour 1 on the edge piping along the front points and inner edges.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_03.description: A tight, close-fitting neck collar that rises to the chin as a short tube and spreads into a V-shaped neckline over the upper chest and shoulders, edged with contrasting trim. A classic superhero cowl-style neck piece.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body; colour 1 on the trim around the V-shaped lower edge; colour 2 on the thin underside edge at the back.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Gravitar_01.description: A wide bib-style necklace of tightly packed beads or studs forming a mesh collar around the neck and upper chest, with dangling teardrop pendants along the lower edge and a large hexagonal gem at the centre.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Gravitar_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the beads, teardrop pendants and central hexagonal gem; the other colour slots are not clearly visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Harajuku_Bow_01.description: A small cloth bow tie sitting at the base of the throat: a central knot band with two wide folded loops and several pointed tails hanging down the upper chest. Suggests a gothic or Harajuku-style look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Harajuku_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bow, loops and tails; the central knot appears in the same colour.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Headphones_01.description: A pair of over-ear headphones worn around the neck: a padded band runs behind the neck with a raised outer rim, ending in round ear cups with atom emblems on the outer faces and contrasting rubber cushions.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Headphones_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band's centre strip and the cup rims; colour 1 on the cup faces and rim segments; colour 3 on the band's outer edge; colour 2 on the ear cushions.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A tall, rounded armored neck collar that encircles the throat, with a ring of radial vent slits around the inside opening and short conical spikes studded around the outer shell. Suits mechanical or brutal armor looks.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar shell and the spikes; colour 2 on the vent slits. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The female collar is a closed, rounded ring with vent slits all around the inside, with the spikes spread around the rim.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_High_01.description: A tall, stiff standing collar that flares upward and outward around the neck, with pointed tips at the sides and a curved cutout at the front of the throat. Vampire-like, dramatic and sleek, with a lined inner face.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_High_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the collar; colour 1 on the inner lining; colour 2 on the inner top edge trim; colour 3 on the thin outer rim piping.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_High_02.description: A tall, flaring vampire-style collar that rises stiffly from the neck to well above the jaw and fans out at the sides. It has a contrasting inner lining, thin edge trim and an open front. Suits gothic, formal or villain looks.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_High_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar shell; colour 1 on the inner lining; colour 2 on the front edge trim; colour 3 on the top edge piping at the back.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_High_Fur_01.description: A tall, flared fur collar that wraps around the neck and rises to the jaw and ears, with a shaggy striped texture, jagged splayed edges and small pointed spikes along the top rim; open at the front.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_High_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur outer surface; colour 2 on the stripe markings; colour 1 on the lower inner fur near the neck. Colour 3 is not visible.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_High_Profevil_01.description: A tall, stiff flared collar that widens from the neck into a funnel rising to the jaw and ears, with pointed wing-like tips at the sides and extra angular fins layered behind. Suggests a villainous, dramatic look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_High_Profevil_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar, including the side points and the layered fins; no other colour slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A high, flared jacket-style collar that wraps the neck, with a folded-over upper edge and angular points at the front and sides. It has a glowing, web-like energy texture and sits at the base of the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material shows a glowing energy pattern that ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slot is visibly applied.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The female version uses a glowing web-like energy material that ignores the colours, whereas the male version shows solid colour-slotted panels.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Kerchief_01.description: A fitted cloth neckerchief wrapped snugly around the neck, gathered into a small knot at the front with two tapered tails hanging down the chest. A casual, sailor-like neck accessory.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Kerchief_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the kerchief band and tails; colour 1 on the fading tips of the tails; colour 2 on the knot.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Knight_01.description: A rigid, shield-like shoulder collar with a deep V opening at the front, a pointed tip on the chest and back, and angular flared edges over the shoulders. Rounded studs dot the surface; it suggests regal knightly armor.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar plates; colour 3 on the studs; colour 2 on the inner lining visible under the edge.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_01.description: A segmented, plated mechanical collar that wraps the neck and upper shoulders like a wide open-front gorget, with a raised back panel carrying etched line details and a small round light. Suggests a sci-fi jacket collar.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main segmented plates and back panel; colour 1 on the inner neck lining and the top of the back panel; colour 2 on the shoulder-side plates; colour 3 on the etched lines and round dot.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_02.description: A rigid, sculpted sci-fi collar that sits over the neck base and upper shoulders like a padded yoke. It has an open oval neck hole, chevron-striped front plates, and vented armoured shoulder wedges with angular panels.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main collar shell and the centre back panel; colour 0 on the raised edge trim and side stripes; colour 2 on the shoulder wedges and underside; colour 3 on the thin chevron lines and vent slits.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.description: A mechanical diving-collar: a wide shallow bowl that rests on the shoulders and chest and comes to a point at the breastbone, with studs at the front. Ringed tubes and a tall arched pipe rise around the head, with a small canister on one side.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar bowl, rings and arched pipe; colour 1 on the inner rim and the mounting blocks; colour 3 on the tube sections and clamps; colour 2 on the front round port and underside.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.differs: The female version is smoother and plainer, with fewer mechanical panels and gauges on the collar, and its tubing is smooth instead of ribbed and wrapped.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.description: A feathered shoulder mantle of layered, spiky plumes draping over both shoulders and around the neck, with a smooth padded collar at the front throat. Feathers grade in tiers toward ragged tips; sits at the upper chest and back.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper feathers around the neck and back; colour 1 on the middle feather tier over the shoulders; colour 2 on the feather tips and the front collar band.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The female mantle has a lower, narrower front collar that sits closer to the throat and a fuller drape at the back.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.description: A tall, snug neck collar wrapped with a soft draped scarf that crosses at the throat and ties in a loose knot at the front, with long tapering tails hanging down the chest. Casual, slightly formal look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tight inner collar; colour 0 on the scarf outer face and tails; colour 2 on the scarf underside visible at the back.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_03.description: A thick, ring-shaped fur collar that sits around the base of the neck and rests on the shoulders, with shaggy layered tufts hanging down and small contrasting spikes studded through the fur. Suggests a rugged, savage look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur ruff; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_04.description: A thick, fur-like shoulder collar of layered, pointed tufts that wraps around the neck and drapes over the shoulders and upper back, open at the front with a contrasting lining inside. Suggests a rugged, wintry look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 1 on a small hidden trim at the lower back edge.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Luchador_01.description: A short, stand-up collar band that wraps around the neck with a ridged, folded outer surface and pointed tips at the front and back. It sits at the base of the neck as a tight, sleek accessory.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Luchador_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar's outer surface and folds; colour 1 on the inner and back faces of the band; the ridges show subtle shading from the other slots.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Luchador_01.differs: The female collar comes to a deeper point at the front of the throat, while its back edge ends in small sharp points.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Magicalgirl_01.description: A short layered cloth shoulder collar with a raised neck band, pointed panels draping over the chest and shoulders, small flared tabs at the shoulder tips and ragged, tattered edges. A cropped caplet in a magical-girl superhero style.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Magicalgirl_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main collar and shoulder panels; colour 0 on the pointed chest and back panels and the small round studs; colour 2 on the inner neck band and back layer; colour 3 on the shoulder tabs.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A soft, bunched cowl scarf wrapped loosely around the neck, with a long narrow cloth panel hanging from the front down past the hips. It suggests a martial-arts or ninja look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl and the hanging cloth panel; colour 2 on the inner lining of the cowl at the back.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Martial_Power_01.differs: The female version adds a long cloth panel hanging down the front of the body, which the male version lacks; it has only the cowl.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Arcane_01.description: A tight, flat band necklace that sits around the base of the neck and dips to a large rounded gem pendant on the chest. Swirling scroll patterns run along the band, and the gem is flanked by winged side plates over a stacked segmented base.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the winged side plates; colour 3 on the swirl patterns; colour 1 on the central gem; colour 2 on the inner band lining and the base segments under the gem.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Devil_01.description: A necklace on a thin striped cord that hangs to the upper chest, carrying a horned demon face pendant with fangs and glowing eyes, framed by two interlocking open triangles.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Devil_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the demon face and the cord stripes; colour 2 on the triangle frame and the other cord stripes; colour 0 on the horns and fangs; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Fantasy_0.description: A fantasy necklace: a flat segmented band of inset rectangular tiles rests around the neck and drops in a V to a large oval pendant with scrollwork, small studs and a round central bead, hanging at the upper chest.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Fantasy_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band frame and central bead; colour 1 on the inset band tiles and the small studs on the pendant; colour 2 on the inner band and scrollwork; colour 3 on the pendant body.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Golden_Ag.description: A thin cord necklace resting at the base of the neck and dipping in a V to a round, faceted disc pendant with a domed centre, sitting on the upper chest. Simple, retro superhero style.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Golden_Ag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord; colour 2 on the pendant's outer faceted rim; colour 3 on the domed centre of the pendant.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Golden_Ag.description: A thin cord necklace that dips into a V at the front, with a round beveled medallion at the centre of the chest topped by a flat five-pointed star. A retro superhero accent that sits low on the collarbone.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Golden_Ag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin cord; colour 2 on the round medallion body; colour 3 on the recessed centre of the medallion; colour 1 on the star.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Teethcrys.description: A tight, thin choker-style necklace band around the base of the neck, with a ring of curved claw or tooth-shaped pendants around the front and a cluster of long feather-like drops hanging at the centre of the chest.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Teethcrys.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin neck band; colour 1 on the curved tooth pendants; colour 3 on the hanging feather drops, fading darker toward their bases.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Wizard_01.description: A thin cord necklace hanging in a V from the neck, with a round domed pendant resting on the upper chest. The pendant is engraved with an eye-in-triangle emblem above stacked lines, suggesting a mystic, occult look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Wizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cord; colour 2 on the pendant body; colour 0 on the engraved emblem and lines.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Ninja_Neckwrap_01.description: A ninja-style neck wrap: a soft, gathered cloth band that sits snugly around the neck, tied in a knot at the back of the throat with two long tails hanging down the back between the shoulder blades.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Ninja_Neckwrap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap and the knot; colour 1 on the hanging tails.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Ninja_Neckwrap_01.differs: The female wrap has two long tails that reach down the back; the knot sits at the front near the chin and the tails hang in a narrower pair.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Noose_01.description: A segmented rope noose worn as a necktie: a loop circles the neck, gathered into a chunky wrapped knot at the throat, with a short frayed tail hanging down the chest.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Noose_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented loop; colour 1 on the knot wraps; colour 2 on the hanging tail.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Plantmanter_01.description: A short petal-like collar of overlapping pointed leaf blades radiating outward from a low neck ring, resting on the collarbones and shoulders. The blades alternate between two tones for a spiky, organic, monstrous plant look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Plantmanter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner neck ring; colour 1 on alternating leaf blades; colour 2 on the other alternating leaf blades.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Power_01.description: A pair of small curved rectangular plates resting on the tops of the shoulders near the base of the neck, each with a raised rim and inset panel. Mechanical, sci-fi collar accents rather than a full collar.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 0 on the raised rims and outer edges of each plate.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Prayerbeads_01.description: A tight necklace of large round beads strung in a single loop that sits snugly around the base of the neck. The beads are faceted spheres of slightly uneven size, giving a ritual or monastic look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Prayerbeads_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all the beads; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Punk_01.description: A tight, flat neck band that wraps around the throat like a choker, with a small round medallion carrying an atom-like emblem at the front. Simple, punk-flavoured collar sitting high on the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the band; colour 1 on the front medallion.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Punk_01.differs: The female band appears to be a slimmer, darker-toned choker sitting lower and tilted, whereas the male version is a taller folded collar with a turned-over edge.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Rave_01.description: A thin, tight choker-style collar ring that circles the base of the neck, dipping slightly at the front. It has a soft padded band studded with small evenly spaced blocky nodes, giving a rave or club look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 as a blended stripe along the band edges; colour 2 on the small block nodes.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Rave_02.description: A thin cord necklace that drapes in a V around the neck and shoulders, with two small beads at the front and a single faceted pointed crystal pendant hanging at the upper chest.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord; colour 1 on the crystal pendant; colour 2 on the two small beads.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A tall segmented neck collar made of stacked, angular overlapping plates that fan outward like ribs around the neck and shoulders. The front has a contrasting ribbed centre panel, and the plates end in pointed tips at the sides.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate edges and pointed tips; colour 1 on the plate inner panels; colour 2 on the front centre panel and the undersides of the plates.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: This version sits lower and more open at the front, with a narrower centre panel showing below the chin.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Ruffles_01.description: A tight neck collar of lace-like ruffles: a thin band around the neck fanned into pointed, scalloped petals with openwork cutouts, rising toward the jaw. Delicate, ornate Victorian-style neckpiece.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Ruffles_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer lace ruffles and band; colour 2 on the shaded inner and underside of the ruffles.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_01.description: A cravat-style neck piece: a banded high collar with a single flared ruffled bib that drapes over the upper chest in soft folds and ends in a wavy hem. Formal, Victorian-looking.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled bib; colour 1 and colour 2 on the banded stripes of the collar.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_01.differs: The female version has a single short ruffle tier, while the male version has a longer bib with two stacked ruffle tiers.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_02.description: A jabot-style ruffled cravat: a banded high neck collar with two tiers of pleated, gathered frills cascading down the chest to bust level. Formal, period-inspired look, open at the back.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled frills; colour 1 on the neck band and the thin collar trim.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A padded, quilted collar that sits around the base of the neck and dips to a V-point over the upper chest, with a row of oval inset windows across the front and a thin contrasting edge trim.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded collar body; colour 1 on the oval inset panels; colour 3 on the thin edge trim.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Scarf_01.description: A soft cloth scarf wrapped loosely in bulky loops around the neck, with two short tails hanging over the front of one shoulder and a small tail trailing at the back. Casual, cosy styling with a banded pattern.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Scarf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light bands of the scarf; colour 1 on the wide stripe bands; colour 2 in the shaded crossing lines of the plaid pattern.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Scarf_01.differs: The female scarf has shorter front tails that sweep over the shoulder and a small extra tail at the back.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A tall, angular sci-fi soldier collar that wraps the neck and rises to cover the jaw, with a lined inner face and pointed tabs falling to the collarbones at the front. Faceted panels give a military look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer collar shell; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 0 on the front tabs; colour 3 on the angled patch at the back and side.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Secret_02.description: A slouchy, draped hood worn down around the neck and shoulders, with a thick folded rim, soft gathered cloth folds, and two hanging drawstrings with tipped ends. Casual hoodie styling.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood cloth; colour 1 on the piping along the hood opening; colour 2 on the drawstrings; colour 3 on the drawstring tips.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Secret_02.differs: The drawstrings hang longer at the front and the hood is cut a little higher and rounder; the male version has a sharper point at the front.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Secret_04.description: A thick, fluffy fur-style collar that wraps around the neck and shoulders, with textured tufted fur and two tapering points hanging down the chest at the front. It sits high, like a jacket ruff.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and front of the fur; colour 1 on the lower back and inner fur; colour 2 on the thin inner lining at the neck.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Skull_01.description: A skull pendant on a thin cord that loops around the neck and hangs onto the upper chest. The skull is chunky and stylised, with round sunken eyes, a nose hole and carved teeth lines.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord; colour 1 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets and teeth lines; colour 2 on the nose hole.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Spiked_01.description: A snug, band-style collar sitting close around the neck, with a large square buckle at the front and rows of conical spikes and studs studded around the outside. Punk and street styling.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band; colour 1 on the spikes and studs; colour 2 on the buckle and inner lining.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Spy_01.description: A soft cloth cravat with a large bow at the throat, gathered by a small band, and a wide draped tail that falls down the chest in rippled folds with a wavy hem.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bow and upper cravat; colour 1 on the lower draped tail, fading in from the top; colour 2 on the small band at the knot.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Steampunk_Cover_01.description: A tall, stiff high collar that rises to cover the lower face, with a wide flared base that spreads over the shoulders and two pointed front flaps. A laced front seam and a contrasting upper rim complete it.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Steampunk_Cover_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body and flaps; colour 1 on the top rim; colour 3 on the front lacing panel; colour 2 on the lace cords.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Stethescope_01.description: A medical stethoscope draped around the neck: thin tubing splits into two earpiece arms at the collar, joins into a single tube down the chest, and ends in a round chest-piece hanging near the ribs.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Stethescope_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tubing; colour 3 on the upper neck tubes and earpiece arms; colour 1 on the stem above the chest-piece; colour 2 on the chest-piece disc.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_01.description: A wide, feathery mane-like collar of layered pointed tufts that fans out around the neck and over the shoulders, with a soft central panel at the front and jagged, ruffled edges. Suggests a suave, wild fur ruff.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central front panel and inner tufts; colour 3 on the upper tufts; colour 2 on the middle tuft layer; colour 1 on the lower outer tufts.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_01.differs: The female mane sits with its contrasting tufts on top and the contrasting tufts on the bottom edge, and the tufts are swept further back over the shoulders.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_02.description: A short, flared collar mane of layered, pointed feather-like tufts that fan out around the neck and upper shoulders, with a V-shaped dip at the front chest and jagged, swept-back tips.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central front and back panels; colour 1 on the lowest tufts; colour 2 on the middle tufts; colour 3 on the upper tufts.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_02.differs: The female mane is shorter and sits tighter around the neck, with a smaller front V and tufts that flare mostly sideways and back.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Talisman_01.description: A tall, flared high-collar that rises stiffly behind and around the neck and head, sweeping upward at the back and sides with a notched opening at the front. Vampiric, dramatic superhero or gothic style.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer face of the collar and its thin edge trim; colour 3 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Teddy_01.description: A soft, thick scarf wrapped loosely around the neck in a collar-like loop, with one tapering tail hanging down the front of the chest and a short tail at the back. Printed with a scattered heart pattern; cute and casual.
