Female/F_Collar_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scarf fabric; colour 1 on some of the hearts and the tail tips; colour 2 on the other hearts; colour 3 on the fine speckled stitching.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tie_01.description: A slim necktie with diagonal stripes, hanging flat from the base of the neck down the chest to about the waist, following the bust line. Gives a smart office or school-uniform look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one set of diagonal stripes; colour 1 on the alternating stripes. The stripes come from the tie's pattern.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tie_Formal_01.description: A slim formal necktie hanging from a small knot at the collar down the chest to about the waist, with a pointed tip and a contrasting panel along one edge. It lies flat against the torso.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tie_Formal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tie body and knot; colour 1 on the panel along one edge of the tie; colour 2 on the small collar opening at the top.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tie_Power_01.description: A slim diagonally striped necktie with a small knot at the throat and a jagged, lightning-bolt shaped lower edge, lying flat down the chest to about the ribs. A formal-meets-superhero accent.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tie_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one set of stripes and the knot; colour 1 on the alternating stripes.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tie_Toy_01.description: A long, narrow necktie with a small knot at the throat, a glossy striped front panel and a pointed tip. It hangs down the chest to about the ribs, following the curve of the bust. Suggests a smart office or retro look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tie_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the knot; colour 2 on the striped front panel; colour 0 on the diagonal stripes; colour 1 on the tie body and edges.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tieshort_02.description: A short, diagonally striped necktie with a small knot at the throat, hanging flat down the upper chest and ending in a pointed tip between the breasts. A casual office or school look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tieshort_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one set of stripes; colour 1 on the alternating stripes; the knot's inner shadow looks like colour 2.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Toy_01.description: A wide, flat shoulder-covering collar built from concentric rounded rings, with a raised inner neck opening and a flared outer rim. It rests over the neck and shoulders like a stacked, retro toy-style cape collar.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner neck rim and the outer edge; colour 3 on the ring nearest the neck; colour 2 on the middle ring; colour 1 on the outer broad ring.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Trey_Kings_02.description: A tall, open-front collar that rises from the neck to a crown-like crest behind and beside the head, with stepped notches, sharp pointed tips and a thin raised edge. Sits as a rigid shield framing the face and head.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Trey_Kings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer back surface; colour 1 on the inner face; colour 3 on the outer rim edging; colour 2 on the inner edge lining.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tribalskulls_01.description: A tribal necklace of three skulls, two human and one larger animal skull with fangs hanging at the centre, strung on a bone-segmented cord that rests around the base of the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tribalskulls_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skulls; colour 1 on the segmented cord.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tribalskulls_01.differs: The female necklace has only three skulls, while the male version has a longer string of six.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tribalteeth_Sovere.description: A thin cord necklace closely circling the base of the neck, with a row of tapered claw-like teeth hanging from small bead spacers across the front. Reads as a tribal trophy piece.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Tribalteeth_Sovere.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin cord and the bead spacers; colour 2 on the small block beads; colour 3 on the hanging teeth.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Urban_Necklaces_01.description: Two thin, chunky-linked chain necklaces layered around the neck, hanging in V-shaped loops of different lengths over the upper chest. A casual urban, street-style accessory.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Urban_Necklaces_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the links of the longer chain; colour 2 on the links of the shorter chain.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Urban_Necklaces_02.description: A set of layered chain and cord necklaces of different lengths draped around the neck and over the upper chest, ending in a large round coin-like medallion with an embossed symbol at the front. Urban street style.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Urban_Necklaces_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the beaded chain strands; colour 1 on the braided cord strand; colour 2 on the cord strands; colour 3 on the medallion.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Vulture_Mane_01.description: A close-fitting feathered ruff that circles the neck and drapes over the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, ending in jagged, pointed feather-like tufts. Suggests a vulture or beast mane.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Vulture_Mane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jagged tufts and outer feathers; colour 1 on the inner band around the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Vulture_Mane_01.differs: The female mane is shorter at the front and sits closer to the neck, with a smaller opening.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Wedding_Necklace_0.description: A flat ribbon-like band that loops around the neck and drops in a V to a round pendant with a domed centre gem and three hanging crystal shards. Elegant, formal jewellery worn at the collarbone.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Wedding_Necklace_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the neck band; colour 2 on the pendant's rim and mount; colour 3 on the domed gem and the hanging shards.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Wedding_Pearls_01.description: A formal necklace of round beads strung on a thin cord, worn as a loose loop that hangs from the neck to the upper chest. Bead sizes alternate between larger and smaller, giving an elegant, classic look.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Wedding_Pearls_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the beads; colour 2 on the thin cord between them.

Female/F_Collar_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A tall, flared wizard-style collar: a thin angular shell rising behind and around the head into long pointed spikes, with a central spike at the back and swept-out side wings, framing the chin at the front.
Female/F_Collar_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar shell; the inside surface shows shaded. No other slots visible.

Female/F_Collar_Traveler_01.description: A short, high stand-up collar that wraps around the neck with a small gap at the front and back. It has a soft, gathered cloth outer layer, a smooth inner lining, and contrasting piped edges at top and bottom.
Female/F_Collar_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar fabric and inner lining; colour 1 on the piping along the bottom edge and inner band; colour 2 on the top edge trim.

Female/F_Collar_Vigilante_01.description: A wide, flat sailor-style collar that lies over the shoulders, with a V-shaped point down the back and a split open front. Contrasting piping edges the outer rim and a contrasting lining shows at the neck.
Female/F_Collar_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar panels; colour 2 on the edge piping and the inner neck lining.

Female/F_Collar_Warrior_01.description: A wide, flared mantle collar with a tall rolled neck opening and concentric ridged bands fanning out over the shoulders and upper chest; rounded, layered and glossy, suggesting a ceremonial superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Collar_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner neck lining and some of the broad bands; colour 1 on the outermost rim band; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 3 on the ridged bands and edging.

Female/F_Ear_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A pair of large, pointed, swept-back ear shapes with a sharp angular outer shell and a ribbed inner ear surface, rising above the head like dragon or elf ears. A monstrous fantasy look.
Female/F_Ear_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shells of both ears; the inner ear surface shows a fixed skin-like texture that ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Ear_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_1.description: A pair of tall, pointed dragon-like ears that sweep up and back from the sides of the head, with smooth outer shells and a ridged inner ear surface. Suggests a fantasy or monstrous look.
Female/F_Ear_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_1.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shells of the ears; the inner ear surface shows a metallic-looking finish that appears unaffected by the scheme.

Female/F_Earings_Fullhelm_Steelcommando_.description: A mechanical helmet shell worn as a side accessory, wrapping around the back and sides of the head with an open face and chin. It has a segmented plated back with contrasting vent slots, rounded ear pods and a ribbed neck band.
Female/F_Earings_Fullhelm_Steelcommando_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plated shell and rim; colour 1 on the ribbed neck band and the side panels; colour 2 on the vent slots; colour 3 on the round ear pods.

Female/F_Earings_Fullhelmet_Wingedcrests.description: A pair of helmet-side ear pieces: smooth rounded plates over each ear that sweep back into stepped, feather-like fins. Angular, layered crest edges give a winged, bird-inspired sci-fi look.
Female/F_Earings_Fullhelmet_Wingedcrests.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth rounded ear plates; colour 1 on the stepped wing-like crests along the back edges.

Female/F_Earings_Pirate_Hat_Feather_002.description: A cluster of long, curved feathers with ragged edges, fanning up and outward from one side of the head above the ear. A small decorative side accessory with a pirate-hat plume feel.
Female/F_Earings_Pirate_Hat_Feather_002.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feather vanes; colour 1 on the outer feather edges and tips; colour 3 on the central quills.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Antenna_01.description: A pair of earpiece antennae: a shallow cup-shaped disc over each ear with a thin straight rod angling up and slightly outward, each topped with a round ball tip. Sci-fi, robotic or alien look.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear discs; colour 1 on the rods and the small joint where each rod meets its disc; colour 2 on the ball tips.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Antenna_02.description: A pair of tech antennae mounted on cup-shaped discs over each ear, with a thin rod projecting sideways through a set of spaced rings and ending in a small ball tip. Sci-fi, robotic head accessory.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Antenna_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear cups; colour 1 on the rods; colour 2 on the rings and end balls.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A pair of chunky faceted earrings, each a rounded many-sided disc-shaped stone with a domed inset gem on its outer face, hanging at the earlobes and sitting flat against the sides of the head.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer setting of each earring; colour 1 on the domed gem set into the face.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Blades_01.description: A pair of rounded ear caps sitting over the ears, each with a thin flat blade fin that sweeps outward and upward like a swept-back wing. Gives a sleek, mechanical or alien headset look.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Blades_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded ear caps; colour 1 on the blade fins.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Blades_02.description: A pair of rounded ear caps, one over each ear, each with a tall curved blade fin sweeping up and slightly outward from the outer edge. Gives a horned, helmet-like look.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Blades_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded ear caps; colour 1 on the curved blade fins and the inner face of the caps.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Blades_03.description: A pair of flat, swept-back blade fins that flare from the temples beside the head, each with a curved leading edge rising to a sharp tip above the head and a notched, jagged lower edge.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Blades_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade fins on both sides.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Blades_04.description: A pair of tall, curved blade-like fins mounted on flat plates at either side of the head, sweeping upward into sharp points like horns. Angular and menacing, suited to helmets or monstrous looks.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Blades_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blades and their side plates; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Fins_01.description: A pair of long, thin flat fins mounted beside the temples in front of the ears, each bending back and sweeping upward and rearward past the top of the head in a sharp angular blade shape.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Fins_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both fins; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Fins_02.description: A pair of thin, curved fin blades rising from the sides of the head beside the temples, each a flat swept-back wing shape with a sharp upward point and a bright edge. Sci-fi or monstrous head accent.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Fins_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin surfaces; colour 2 on the lower tips of the fins.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Lightning_01.description: A pair of rounded ear caps, one over each ear, each with a large jagged lightning bolt fin running along the outer side and sweeping up past the top of the head. A superhero speedster look.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dished ear caps; colour 1 on the lightning bolts.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Lightning_02.description: A pair of flat, jagged lightning-bolt ornaments worn at the sides of the head by the ears, each a zigzag slab whose top tapers into a long point that sweeps up and back past the crown.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Lightning_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole of both bolts; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A pair of swept-back, fin-like ear pieces made of sharp angular blades. Each has a long pointed spike sweeping rearward from the ear and a slim blade curving down along the jaw. Suggests a psionic dragon or alien look.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main blade surfaces; colour 2 on the darker edge blades and the underside; colour 0 on the tips of the upper spikes.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The default colour pattern differs: the female version has the blade surfaces in colour 1 with colour 2 edge blades, while the male version is a single colour 0 throughout.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Qularrtuskbig_01.description: A pair of large curved tusks or horns mounted at the sides of the head, sweeping outward and forward to sharp tips, with segmented armour-like bases and contrasting caps at the temples.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Qularrtuskbig_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tusk segments; colour 1 on the tapering tusk tips; colour 3 on the caps at the base near the temples.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A pair of tall, swept-up feathered wings that sprout from the sides of the head like ear fins, with a raised rim and layered feather ribs on each blade. Fantasy, winged-helm styling.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim and feather ribs; colour 1 on the recessed feather panels between the ribs.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Samurai_02.description: A pair of flat, blade-like head ornaments that sweep outward and upward from the temples like horns, with jagged barbs along the lower edges, a slim raised rim and swirling patterned inner panels. Fantasy or demonic in style.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Samurai_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rims and edges; colour 2 on the inner panels; colour 3 on the swirling patterns inside the panels; colour 1 on faint edge shading.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Wingedcrests_Blue.description: A pair of winged side-of-head crests: smooth rounded panels beside each ear that sweep back into stepped, feather-like fins pointing up and back. Sleek fantasy or sci-fi headgear.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Wingedcrests_Blue.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth front panels of each crest; colour 1 on the stepped feather fins and the back surfaces.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Wingedcrests_Blue.differs: The female version is a plain two-tone design of smooth panels and stepped fins, without the contrasting band and contrasting accents on the male version.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Wings_01.description: A pair of small feathered wings mounted at the sides of the head over the ears, each a flat fan of layered feathers with a long upswept tip and a veined inner panel. Fantasy, mythic winged-helm styling.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long upper feathers; colour 3 on the veined inner panels and ear mounts; colour 2 on the feather edges and lower tips.

Female/F_Earings_Tight_Wings_02.description: A pair of flat, bat-like dragon wings mounted on either side of the head at ear level, each with a scalloped membrane and pointed tips that sweep up and outward. Gives a monstrous, fantasy look.
Female/F_Earings_Tight_Wings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing membrane; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earring_Blockbuster_01.description: A pair of angular, faceted metal fins mounted at the sides of the head, sweeping up and outward like stylised wings, each with layered blades and small round bolt holes near the lower edge.
Female/F_Earring_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin surfaces; the material appears metallic and mostly ignores the other colour slots, with no visible use of colours 1, 2 or 3.

Female/F_Earring_Blockbuster_02.description: A pair of chunky angular ear guards, one over each ear, with faceted flat plates and a recessed inset panel on the outer face. They give a mechanical, helmet-like sci-fi look.
Female/F_Earring_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and faceted casing; colour 3 on the recessed outer panels.

Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_01.description: A pair of large oval faceted gemstones mounted flat against each side of the head over the ears, like big earpieces. Each has a cut-crystal face with angular facets and a domed back.
Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The gems appear glossy and mostly ignore the colour scheme; no clear colour slot is visible.

Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_02.description: A pair of large faceted rhomboid gemstones mounted flat against each side of the head over the ears, like angular crystal ear panels. Glossy cut surfaces give a bold fantasy or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; no clear slot is visible on the gems.

Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_03.description: A pair of chunky square-cut gemstone blocks with bevelled faces, mounted flat against each side of the head over the ear area like oversized earpieces. Glossy faceted look suggests a sci-fi or fantasy accessory.
Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: Glossy gem material appears to ignore the colour scheme; no clearly separate colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_04.description: A pair of faceted pentagonal gemstone earrings, each a thick pentagon-shaped crystal slab mounted flat against the side of the head over the ear, like chunky studs.
Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme, showing a reflective finish with slight tints; no clearly separate colour areas are visible.

Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_05.description: A pair of large heart-shaped faceted gemstones worn over the ears, one on each side of the head, with flat heart faces pointing outward and a chunky cut-crystal back.
Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem material ignores the colour scheme; it shows a single glassy finish across both hearts, so no colour slot is clearly visible.

Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_06.description: A pair of large teardrop-shaped faceted gemstones mounted flat against the sides of the head over the ears, pointed end upward, with a glossy polished surface like oversized earrings.
Female/F_Earring_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The glossy gem material ignores the colour scheme and shows a reflective finish; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_01.description: A large oval faceted gemstone worn flat against the side of the head over the ear, like a big earring. It has a cut-gem surface with angular facets and a slightly domed profile.
Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The whole gem is glossy and appears to ignore the colour scheme, so no slot visibly changes it.

Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted gemstone earring shaped like an elongated rhombus, mounted flat against the left ear and pointing up and down. Crisp angular facets give it a polished, glassy crystal look.
Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The gem appears glossy and reflective and mostly ignores the colour scheme; no distinct colour slot is clearly visible.

Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_03.description: A single square-cut gemstone earring worn flat against the side of the head at the ear, with a faceted bevelled top face and thick blocky sides. Reads as a bold, glossy jewel stud.
Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The gem appears glossy and largely ignores the colour scheme; no distinct slot areas are clearly visible.

Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone earring worn flat against the side of the head at the ear, forming a thin five-sided prism with glassy, angular faces.
Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Glassy gem largely ignores the scheme; faint colour 1 tint on some facets and a hint of colour 3 inside; the rest reads near-dark.

Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_05.description: A large faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn over the left ear, sitting flat against the side of the head like a chunky earpiece, with a cleft at the top and angular cut facets.
Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The whole gem is glossy and appears to ignore the colour scheme; a faint tint may show from colour 1 on some facets.

Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_06.description: A large teardrop-shaped gemstone worn flat against the side of the head over the left ear, with a faceted, pointed top and a smooth glossy face. It suggests a bold, jewel-like ear ornament.
Female/F_Earring_Left_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The whole gem takes its glossy look from the default material, which mostly ignores the colour scheme; no separate colour areas are visible.

Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_01.description: A single oval faceted gemstone worn on the side of the head at the ear, cut with angular facets and a flat back that sits against the head. Suggests a bold jewel earring.
Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The whole gem appears to take one slot with glossy faceted shading; the default material largely ignores the scheme, and slot use is unclear.

Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted rhomboid gemstone earring, a flat-sided diamond-shaped crystal with bevelled edges, worn against the side of the head at the right ear. Glossy and angular, it suggests a fantasy or sci-fi jewel.
Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The gem appears to ignore the colour scheme; its glossy glass-like material shows one reflective shade, with no visible use of colour slots 0-3.

Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_03.description: A single square-cut gemstone earring with a flat beveled face and thick faceted sides, worn on the right side of the head at the ear. Small, glossy and angular, it suits jewellery-style looks.
Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The whole gem is glossy and appears to ignore the colour scheme; no separate slot areas are visible.

Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone earring that sits flat against the side of the head at the ear, with bevelled edges and a glossy cut-crystal look.
Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme; its glassy surface reflects its own tones across all facets.

Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn flat against the side of the head at the ear position. It is a thick, angular cut stone with a notched top and a pointed bottom, in a glossy crystal finish.
Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: Colour slots don't visibly apply; the glossy gem ignores the colour scheme and shows a single reflective finish.

Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_06.description: A single faceted teardrop-shaped gemstone earring with a pointed top and rounded base, flat on the inner face with bevelled edges, worn against the side of the head at the ear.
Female/F_Earring_Right_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme in the default material; no slot is clearly visible on it.

Female/F_Earring_Tech_Visor_01.description: A pair of slim curved guard plates that run along each jawline from ear to chin, with a raised outlined panel near the ear and small vent slots on the lower plate. Sci-fi cyber cheek armour.
Female/F_Earring_Tech_Visor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long curved jaw plates; colour 0 on the raised upper panels; colour 3 on the thin inset outline of the panel.

Female/F_Earring_Wooden_01.description: A pair of long dangling earrings: a small faceted stud at the earlobe, a thin twisted cord hanging down past the jaw, and a small clasp holding a round ring at the bottom. Tribal, simple jewellery.
Female/F_Earring_Wooden_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ear studs and the hanging rings; colour 0 on the twisted cords and the clasps.

Female/F_Earrings_Anniversary_Mechanon_0.description: A pair of tall, flat angular plates standing vertically at each side of the head, tapering to a point at the top with a stepped lower edge and shallow groove lines. Retro robot-helmet styling.
Female/F_Earrings_Anniversary_Mechanon_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front faces of the plates; colour 1 on the back faces with a mottled metal finish.

Female/F_Earrings_Anniversary_Mechanon_0.description: A pair of tall, flat angular fin-like plates standing vertically at each side of the head beside the ears, with a slanted pointed top, stepped lower edge and grooved panel lines. Retro robot styling.
Female/F_Earrings_Anniversary_Mechanon_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both plates, showing the same tone on the front and a metallic sheen from behind; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Anubis_01.description: A pair of ear-mounted discs with small round studs, each with a long flat tapering strip that hangs down past the jaw to the collarbone, banded with contrasting stripes. Egyptian-inspired headdress-style side accessories.
Female/F_Earrings_Anubis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the discs and the main length of the strips; colour 1 on the stripe bands across the strips; colour 2 on the round studs, the disc centres and the strip edging.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Anubis_Earrings_.description: Two pairs of thin metal hoop rings, each pair stacked one above the other, floating at either side of the top of the head like small antenna loops. Simple, plain jewellery.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Anubis_Earrings_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the rings; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the other slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Anubis_Earrings_.description: A pair of small faceted hoop earrings stacked one above the other on the left ear, thin polygonal metal rings that hang slightly apart. A simple, understated ear accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Anubis_Earrings_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both rings; the glossy metal default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Anubis_Earrings_.description: A tiny pair of stacked, interlinked hoop earrings worn on the right ear: two thin, faceted metal rings hanging one above the other, in a simple, ancient-inspired style.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Anubis_Earrings_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both rings; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Bear_Earrings_01.description: A pair of small plain hoop rings floating at the upper sides of the head, one on each side, like animal-ear piercings. Simple thin bands with no other detail, sitting well above the ears.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Bear_Earrings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both rings; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Bear_Earrings_02.description: A small plain hoop earring for the left ear: a thin faceted torus that hangs beside the head and sits flat against the side of the face. A simple, minimal jewellery accent.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Bear_Earrings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Bear_Earrings_03.description: A small plain hoop earring for the right ear: a thin faceted metal ring hanging beside the head, with a slightly chunky low-poly band. A simple, minimal jewellery accent.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Bear_Earrings_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metal finish mostly ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Cat_Earrings_01.description: A pair of thin metal hoop rings floating on either side of the head, slightly above and in front of the ears. Small and plain, they read as simple piercing-style jewellery.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Cat_Earrings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both rings; the glossy metal mostly ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Cat_Earrings_02.description: A single small hoop earring: a plain, slightly faceted metal ring floating beside the left side of the head, above and in front of the ear, as a simple piercing-style accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Cat_Earrings_02.colourAreas: The whole ring appears as glossy metal that ignores the colour scheme; no visible slot use.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Cat_Earrings_03.description: A small plain hoop earring: a thin, slightly faceted round band that hangs beside the right ear, floating just off the side of the head. Simple, understated jewellery.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Cat_Earrings_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the glossy metal finish may ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Colossus_01.description: A pair of curved, tapering horn-like growths that sprout from the sides of the head at the ears and sweep down and forward past the jaw. Cracked, segmented surface pattern gives a monstrous, stony look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn surface; colour 3 on the crack-like veins running across it.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Face_Rockcrystal.description: A pair of faceted rock-crystal ear guards on either side of the head, each a chunky cracked stone shell that sweeps back into a tall pointed crystal spike rising above the ear.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Face_Rockcrystal.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cracked stone shells; colour 1 on the tall crystal spikes; colour 3 on the crack lines between the stone facets.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Falcon_01.description: A pair of feathered wing ornaments mounted at the sides of the head, sweeping up and outward in layered pointed feathers, with short hanging feather tufts beside the cheeks. Suggests a winged helm or falcon-themed headpiece.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper feathers; colour 1 on a band of feathers beneath them; colour 2 on a narrow row of feathers below that; colour 3 on the hanging feather tufts.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Earcaps.description: A pair of small rounded cylindrical ear caps sitting over each ear, like compact headphone cups, with a recessed inset panel on the outer face. Suggests a sleek sci-fi or mechanical helmet accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Earcaps.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cylindrical cap bodies and rims; colour 1 on the recessed inset panel on each outer face.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Viperps.description: A mechanical helmet shell with an open front window exposing the face, angular cheek guards ending in pointed jaw plates, and a rear ventilator unit of ribbed tubing and padded pods wrapping the back of the head.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Viperps.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and jaw plates; colour 1 on the curved tubes and rear panel blocks; colour 2 on the ribbed rear ventilator and underside plates.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Fullhelmet_Winge.description: A pair of curved ear-side pods with stepped, feather-like crests sweeping back and up from each rounded shell. They sit over the ears like winged headphones and suggest a bird-inspired sci-fi helmet.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Fullhelmet_Winge.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth rounded ear shells; colour 1 on the stepped winged crests.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Half_Eagle_Drka_.description: A pair of ear-mounted feather fans: each sits on a small round cap over the ear and sweeps outward and upward as a spread of long, tapered feathers with fringed tips. Suggests a fantasy bird-like headdress.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Half_Eagle_Drka_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ear caps and the feather tips; colour 0 on the feather shafts and blades; colour 2 on the inner ear discs; colour 3 on the small centre studs.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Head_Bucket_01.description: A pair of small mechanical ear pieces, one on each side of the head: a flared, ribbed bucket-shaped cup facing outward, with a short stem and an octagonal valve-wheel handle on the outer end.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Head_Bucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared bucket cups; colour 3 on the stripes around the cup rims; colour 1 on the valve wheels and stems.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Batears_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed bat-like ears rising from the sides of the head, with a smooth outer shell, ribbed inner cups and small spiky inner tufts. A monstrous, animal-like head accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Batears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of the ears and the pointed tips; colour 1 on the ribbed bands inside the ear cups; the inner tufts and fleshy inner cup show skin tones, not the scheme.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Dragon_01.description: A pair of large fin-like ears that flare out from the sides of the head, each a membrane with scalloped, pointed edges and ribbed veins, set on a small curved base at the ear. Suggests a dragon or aquatic creature.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small base mounts at the ears; colours 1, 2 and 3 blend across the membranes, with colour 3 at the outer tips and colour 2 toward the centre.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Earrings_0.description: A pair of small thin metal hoop rings floating at the sides of the head, above and behind the ears, like piercings on the temples. Simple, plain loops suited to a beastly or punk look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Earrings_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both rings; the metal finish ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Earrings_0.description: A small plain hoop earring in a faceted, slightly chunky ring shape, worn on the left ear. A simple metallic loop accessory with a rough, low-poly look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Earrings_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Earrings_0.description: A single small hoop earring for the right ear: a thick, slightly faceted round band forming a simple open ring that hangs at the ear. Suits punk, tribal or beast-themed looks.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Lycan_Earrings_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metallic default material shows little variation from the scheme.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Rat_Earrings_01.description: A pair of small thin metal hoop earrings, one at each side of the head, floating just beside and above the ears, each a plain round ring with slightly faceted edges.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Rat_Earrings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Rat_Earrings_02.description: A small plain hoop earring, a thin faceted ring worn on the left ear. It hangs as a simple loop beside the head with no other decoration.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Rat_Earrings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metallic default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Rat_Earrings_03.description: A single small hoop earring: a thin, slightly faceted round band that hangs at the right ear, seen edge-on from the front. Simple, plain jewellery suited to many styles.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Rat_Earrings_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Rat_Spikes_01.description: A pair of short, smooth conical spikes jutting sideways from the temples beside the eyes, pointing outward and slightly back like small horns. Suggests a beastly or monstrous head look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Rat_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Serpent_Horns_De.description: A pair of large curved demon horns that sprout from the sides of the head, sweep outward and then upward to sharp tips, with segmented ridged surfaces and a contrasting band at each base.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Serpent_Horns_De.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the upper lengths and tips of the horns; colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Serpent_Horns_De.description: A pair of large curved demon horns sprouting from the sides of the head, sweeping outward and then up to sharp points, with a contrasting band circling each base. Fantasy monster styling.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Serpent_Horns_De.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn surfaces; colour 1 on the horn tips and outer ends; colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Serpent_Horns_Ki.description: A pair of long, asymmetric bull-like horns that sprout from the sides of the head with banded bases. One horn sweeps out straight and pointed, while the other curls back and up in a kinked hook.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Serpent_Horns_Ki.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the middle of the horns; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the bands at the base of each horn.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Stag_Earrings_01.description: A set of small thin metal hoop rings floating around the head: one ring on one side and a pair of overlapping rings on the other, sitting above and beside the ears like stag-style ear piercings.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Stag_Earrings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the rings; the glossy metal default material mostly ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Stag_Earrings_02.description: A single small hoop earring for the left ear: a thin faceted ring with a slightly thick band, hanging beside the head as a simple piece of jewellery.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Stag_Earrings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metallic default material shows little change from the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Stag_Earrings_03.description: A small plain hoop earring, a thick faceted torus worn through the right ear. Simple polished ring with no pendants or ornament, suiting many casual, tribal or fantasy looks.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Stag_Earrings_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Antenna_01.description: A pair of earpiece antennae: shallow rounded cups sit over each ear, each with a thin straight rod rising above the head and ending in a round knob. Reads as a sci-fi or alien headset.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear cups; colour 1 on the rods and the joint where the rod meets the cup; colour 2 on the round tip knobs.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Antenna_02.description: A pair of sci-fi antennae that stick straight out sideways from cup-shaped discs at the ears. Each has a thin rod with three spaced rings and a ball tip. Reads as a robotic or alien headpiece.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Antenna_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear cups; colour 1 on the rods; colour 2 on the rings and ball tips.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A pair of chunky faceted earrings hanging from the earlobes: each is a rounded, multi-sided gem-like stud with a domed inset centre on the outer face and a flat, plain back.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer body of each earring; colour 1 on the domed inset centre; the flat backs take the same light colour 0.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Batears_01.description: A pair of large, tall pointed bat ears that flare up and outward from the sides of the head, with ribbed inner cups and small spiky tips near the ear canal. Creature-like, fantasy look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Batears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 on the ribbed inner ridges; the small inner spikes show the skin tone rather than a scheme colour.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_01.description: A pair of rounded ear caps sitting over the ears, each with a thin flat blade fin that sweeps up and outward from the cap like a swept-back wing. Suggests a sci-fi or monstrous helmet accent.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the round ear caps; colour 1 on the blade fins.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_02.description: A pair of rounded ear caps sitting over the ears, each with a tall, curved blade fin sweeping up and slightly outward from the outer edge. Gives a horned, helmet-like sci-fi or monstrous look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the round ear caps; colour 1 on the curved blades and the inner faces of the caps.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_03.description: A pair of thin, flat blade-like fins that sweep up and outward from the temples, each with a broad swept base tapering to a sharp point. They sit at the sides of the head like horn-shaped ear wings.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blades; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_04.description: A pair of tall curved blade fins mounted at the temples, each a flat angular plate at the side of the head that sweeps up into a long pointed tip. They read as horn-like head ornaments and suggest a fantasy or monstrous helm.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blade plates; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Dragon_01.description: A pair of large membranous fins that flare out from the sides of the head at ear level, each with scalloped, pointed edges and a thin rigid base rim. They suggest dragon or aquatic creature ears.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base rim where the fins attach; colours 1, 2 and 3 blend across the fin membranes, with colour 3 toward the outer edges and colour 2 toward the base.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earguard_0.description: A pair of slim angular guard plates, one on each side of the head. Each runs back along the temple, then bends down in front of the ear to a point along the cheek. A single rivet marks each bend. Sci-fi helmet-style look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earguard_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate faces and edges; colour 1 on the strip along the top of each temple section; colour 2 on the inner edge of the cheek blades.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_0.description: A pair of plain hoop earrings: thin, slightly faceted metal rings hanging from the earlobes, one on each side of the head, with the hoops turned roughly edge-on to the front.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoops; the default metallic material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_0.description: A single plain hoop earring: a slim, faceted metal ring hanging from the left earlobe, seen edge-on from the front and as a full circle from the side. A simple, understated accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metallic default material shows little variation from the colour scheme.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_0.description: A small plain hoop earring: a single thin faceted ring hanging from the right earlobe, viewed edge-on from the front and as a full circle from the side. Simple, understated jewellery.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the default metallic material barely responds to the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fins_01.description: A pair of long, flat fin blades that rise from beside the temples and sweep upward and backward past the top of the head, with an angled bend at the base. Sleek, minimal head accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fins_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both fins; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fins_02.description: A pair of thin, curved fin-like blades on each side of the head, sweeping up and back from the temples with a swept, pointed tip and a thicker edge along the front. Suggests a sleek alien or helmet-style head accent.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fins_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin panels; the thick leading edges also show the light colour with a darker tip at the base. Colours 1, 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fullhelmvi.description: A sleek sci-fi helmet shell that frames the face like a horseshoe: an open front, panelled cheek guards that reach to the jaw, a ridged vent strip on the brow and a rounded back shell around the skull.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fullhelmvi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and cheek edges; colour 1 on the side panels and the trim bands at the back; colour 3 on the brow vent slats; colour 2 on the inner face frame.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fullhelmvi.description: A sci-fi open-faced helmet shell that wraps over the crown and around the sides and back of the head, with a vented top panel, small slotted vents on the sides, and lit cheek-guard slits at the front edges.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fullhelmvi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim; colour 1 on the top vent panel and the inner and lower trim; colour 3 on the vent slits and the cheek-guard lights; colour 2 on the small details.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A pair of domed ear pods sitting over each ear, each with a rim ring around a rounded cap. Rows of small pointed studs run in arcs over the sides of the scalp above them.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim rings around the pods; colour 3 on the domed pod caps; colour 1 on the small pointed studs.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_02.description: A set of small conical spikes on tiny square bases, arranged in two curved rows that arc back over each side of the scalp from the forehead to the back of the head. Monstrous, understated head decoration.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spike cones; colour 0 on the square bases.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_03.description: A pair of round, domed ear pods worn over the ears on each side of the head, each with a raised convex cap set inside a slim rim. Suggests a small sci-fi headset or gadget.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the domed centres of the pods; colour 0 on the surrounding rims.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Curl.description: A pair of segmented ram-style horns that sprout from the sides of the head above the ears, curling forward and down in a spiral toward the cheeks and tapering to pointed tips. Each has a contrasting base band.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Curl.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the base bands where the horns meet the head; colour 0 on the main segmented horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering tips.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demo.description: A pair of curved demon horns that sprout from the sides of the head at ear level, each set in a short banded cuff and sweeping outward then up to a sharp point.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the cuffs at the base of each horn.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demo.description: A pair of huge segmented demon horns that sweep out sideways from the temples, then curve up into tall pointed tips, with contrasting bands where they meet the head. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn segments; colour 1 on the horn tips, fading in towards the ends; colour 3 on the bands at the base of each horn.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demo.description: A pair of tall demon horns that sweep outward from the sides of the head, curve upward and taper to sharp points, with contrasting bands wrapped around the base of each horn.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and shafts; colour 1 on the upper horn tips; colour 3 on the bands near the base.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Gron.description: A pair of ridged, bull-like horns that sprout sideways from bands wrapped around the sides of the head, sweeping outward and curving down and back to sharp tips. Monstrous, beastly head piece.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Gron.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases; colour 0 on the ridged horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips as a gradient.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Kiga.description: A pair of lopsided curved horns rising from the sides of the head, each with a band at the base; one sweeps long and outward while the other curls back and twists, giving a monstrous asymmetric look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Kiga.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips and their gradient ends; colour 3 on the base bands.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Yak_.description: A pair of long, ridged bovine horns projecting sideways from the temples, each with a wrapped band at the base, sweeping outward and curving down to sharp tips. Suggests a yak or beast-like fantasy look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Yak_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips, fading in along the length; colour 3 on the bands at the base of each horn.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Hornsfutur.description: A pair of smooth curved horns that start at the temples, sweep outward and up around the head, and end in long sharp points. Small spikes sit at the base of each horn. Suggests a monstrous or futuristic ornamental headpiece.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Hornsfutur.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the horns, fading lighter toward the base openings; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Left_Skull.description: A small skull-shaped earring hanging from the left earlobe, with sculpted brow ridges, hollow eye sockets, a nose cavity and a row of teeth grooves. Flat-backed and chunky, it gives a macabre gothic accent.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Left_Skull.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull surface; colour 3 on the eye sockets and tooth grooves; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Lightning_.description: A pair of rounded cap-like ear cups worn over the ears, each with a large jagged lightning bolt fin sweeping up and back from its outer face. A playful superhero head accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Lightning_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear cups; colour 1 on the lightning bolts.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Lightning_.description: A pair of flat, zigzag lightning-bolt shapes mounted at the temples, one on each side of the head. Each bolt tapers to a long sharp point that sweeps up and back past the crown. A playful superhero head accent.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Lightning_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat faces of both bolts; the thin edges show a lighter tone from the same slot. No other slots are visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Luchadorha.description: A pair of flat, winged head fins mounted at the sides of the head, each a feather-fingered blade with a hooked beak-like tip pointing down past the cheek and a small cut-out mark. Suggests a hawk luchador look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Luchadorha.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wing panels; colour 1 on the outlines and edging along the feathers and beak tips; colour 2 on the small cut-out marks.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Qularrtusk.description: A pair of large curved tusks or horns, one mounted at each side of the head, sweeping outward and forward past the cheeks with segmented plated bases and tapering pointed tips.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Qularrtusk.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tusk segments; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base caps where they meet the head.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Right_Skul.description: A small skull-shaped earring hanging from the right earlobe: a flat-backed, chunky skull with deep round eye sockets, a nose cavity and carved teeth lines. Suggests a gothic or punk accent.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Right_Skul.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull body; colour 3 on the eye sockets and teeth grooves; colour 2 in the nose cavity.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Robot_Huma.description: A pair of mechanical head wings: large angular blade-like fins sweep up and outward from the temples, with smaller spiked fins below and curved metal cheek guards with contrasting pods beside the eyes and vent slits.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Robot_Huma.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large upper wing blades and small upper spikes; colour 0 on the curved cheek-side blades; colour 2 on the pods beside the eyes; colour 3 on the small vent slits and accents.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Robot_Wing.description: A pair of mechanical head-side pods at the temples, each with swept-back angular wing blades above and pointed fin-like plates curving down along the cheeks. Sci-fi cyborg headgear that leaves the face and crown open.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Robot_Wing.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large upper wing blades; colour 0 on the lower cheek blades and plates; colour 2 on the temple pods; colour 3 on the small slot markings.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Robot_Wing.differs: The female version has the wing blades angled a little more upright and the cheek blades longer and thinner, with a slightly narrower spread.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Samurai_02.description: A pair of flat, blade-like head ornaments sweeping up and outward from the temples like horns, with jagged barbed edges, a bevelled rim and swirling engraved patterns across the surface. Worn on the forehead sides in a fantasy, demonic style.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Samurai_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim edges of the blades; colour 2 on the main blade surfaces; colour 3 on the swirling engraved patterns; colour 1 on faint edge shading.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Skull_Earr.description: A pair of small skull-shaped ear ornaments, one hanging beside each ear at jaw level. Each is a chunky, rounded skull with hollow eye sockets and a nose cavity, in a macabre gothic style.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Skull_Earr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull bodies; colour 3 on the eye sockets and the teeth lines; colour 2 in the nose cavity.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A set of short conical spikes clustered in two groups on either side of the head, sticking outward and slightly back from the temples and upper skull. Bare head otherwise, with a monstrous or punk look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the spikes show a slight bluish shading but no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_01.differs: The female version has slightly smaller spikes, with a tighter cluster above each temple.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_02.description: A set of small conical spikes studded across the upper sides of the head, angled outward and back in two loose clusters of three. They leave the scalp bare and suggest a horned, monstrous or punk look.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_02.differs: The female version has slightly more spikes, with a small extra spike in each cluster at the back of the head.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Welder_01.description: A partial welder-style head guard: a band wraps around the forehead and back of the head, with two large angular plates covering the ears and cheeks and contrasting round pads or bolts on the band and plates.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the band and side plates; colour 2 on the round pads and bolts; colour 0 on the thin strip along the forehead edge.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Welder_01.differs: The side plates sit slightly narrower and flare outward from the head, leaving more gap beside the face.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingedcres.description: A pair of stylized wing-shaped ear crests that sit over the ears on each side of the head, with a smooth rounded outer shell and stepped, feather-like ridges sweeping back and up.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingedcres.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth rounded outer shell; colour 1 on the stepped feather ridges along the back and top edges.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingedcres.differs: The female version is a simpler two-tone design with a plain shell and stepped ridges, without the contrasting banding and contrasting accents of the male version.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_01.description: A pair of feathered wings mounted at the ears, each with layered rows of feathers fanning outward and a long tall pointed feather sweeping up above the head. Fantasy, winged-helm styling.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long upper feathers; colour 3 on the inner feather panels and the ear mounts; colour 2 on the feather edges and tips.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_01.differs: The female version is a pair of feathered wings at the ears, while the male version is a set of angular swept-back deco fins.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_02.description: A pair of thin, flat bat-like wings mounted at the sides of the head, each with a pointed upper tip, scalloped lower edge and ribbed membrane, flaring outward and upward from the temples like fantasy dragon-wing ear fins.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing membrane and ribs; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_De.description: A pair of large, segmented demon horns that sprout from the sides of the head, sweep outward in a broad curve and then rise to sharp upward points. Each horn base has a contrasting band.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_De.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the upper horn tips, where the horn fades toward it; colour 3 on the base bands where the horns meet the head.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_De.differs: The female horns are set slightly lower and sweep out wider with a flatter curve, and the base bands sit further from the head centre.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_Ki.description: A pair of long, tapering bull-like horns rising from the sides of the head, with mismatched curves: one sweeps out and up with a tip flick, the other ends in a hooked twist. Each sits in a band at the base.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_Ki.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips and the fade toward the ends; colour 3 on the base bands.

Female/F_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Spikes_0.description: A pair of short conical spikes jutting sideways and slightly back from the upper sides of the head, like small horns or thorns. Plain smooth cones with no other head covering.
Female/F_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Spikes_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Earrings_Chronos_01.description: A pair of stylised swept-back wing ornaments mounted on either side of the head at the temples, each with a curved rim, a pointed upper tip and several feather-like blades fanning backward.
Female/F_Earrings_Chronos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved outer rims and upper edges; colour 1 on the feather-like blades.

Female/F_Earrings_Colossus_01.description: A pair of large curved horn-like spikes that sweep out and down from each side of the head at the ears, with a cracked, stony surface of veined plates. A monstrous, beastly side accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn surfaces; colour 3 on the crack-like veins running across them.

Female/F_Earrings_Cosmos_01.description: A pair of large curved horns that sweep out from the sides of the head, rise in a wide loop above it and end in sharp upright points, forming a tall crown-like ring. Glossy, sleek, monstrous.
Female/F_Earrings_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Glossy metallic finish appears to largely ignore the scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows along the upper horn surfaces, with the undersides shading darker.

Female/F_Earrings_Crimson_01.description: A pair of swept, blade-like side ornaments that curve from beside the cheeks down past the jaw, with thin pointed fins and jagged tips. They look translucent and sharp, with an elven or alien feel.
Female/F_Earrings_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Default material is translucent and glassy, so the colour scheme barely shows; all fins appear and largely ignore the colour slots.
Female/F_Earrings_Crimson_01.differs: The female version is translucent and glass-like, with thinner, more jagged fins, and the colour scheme does not show on it.

Female/F_Earrings_Datareaper_01.description: A pair of angular, faceted ear-and-temple guards that wrap around each side of the head, with large curved shells above the ears, a pointed plate down each cheek and a notched rear ring. Sci-fi cybernetic headgear.
Female/F_Earrings_Datareaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large outer shells; colour 2 on the rear ring, cheek spikes and inner plates; colour 3 on the small recessed vents.

Female/F_Earrings_Draco_01.description: A pair of angular metal fin-like ear guards that sit over the sides of the head, each a flat plate with a swept-back point flaring outward and upward. They suggest a dragon-crest or winged helmet look.
Female/F_Earrings_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces and edges; the default metal material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Draco_02.description: A pair of tall, curved horn-like side ornaments framing the face, each built from stacked, overlapping blade-shaped fins that sweep down past the jaw to sharp points and up to a long spike above the head.
Female/F_Earrings_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 alternate as bands across the stacked blades and horn tips; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the scheme, so colour 1 and colour 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Dragon_Silly_01.description: A pair of side-of-head ear pieces: chunky octagonal disc housings over the ears, each with a fan of swept-back, pointed fin or wing blades with outlined edges. Fantasy-creature or sci-fi headphone look.
Female/F_Earrings_Dragon_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the octagonal disc housings; colour 3 on the outer face of each disc; colour 0 on the swept fin blades.

Female/F_Earrings_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A pair of side-of-head ear accessories shaped like layered dragon fins: curved, pointed fin blades sweep up and back from the ears, with stacked smaller spiky fins fanning down along the jaw. Fantasy, monstrous style.
Female/F_Earrings_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower stacked fins nearest the jaw; colour 1 on the outer tips of the lower fins; colour 2 on the middle band of the upper fin; colour 3 on the upper fin tips.

Female/F_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_01.description: A pair of chunky disc-shaped ear caps sitting over the ears like headphones, each with a banded rim and a raised centre disc, topped by a short antenna rod angled upward from the top.
Female/F_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap rims, centre discs and antenna rods; colour 1 on the band around each cap's rim.

Female/F_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_02.description: A single chunky ear cap: a thick multi-sided disc worn over the ear, with a raised hub on the outer face and a short jointed antenna rod rising from a small mount on top. Suggests covert military comms gear.
Female/F_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc rim edges, hub and antenna; colour 1 on the wide band around the disc and the ring on the antenna joint; colour 2 on the mount block.

Female/F_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_03.description: A pair of round ear-cap communication headset pieces, each a thick disc with a banded rim, one with a short antenna stub on top and a thin boom microphone curving toward the mouth.
Female/F_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear-cap discs, antenna and microphone boom; colour 1 on the band around each cap rim.

Female/F_Earrings_Face_Headphones_01.description: Over-ear headphones: a slim arched headband across the top of the head joins two large rounded ear cups with padded cushions, each with a small accent tab at the hinge. Casual, modern and sporty.
Female/F_Earrings_Face_Headphones_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband; colour 1 on the outer ear cup shells; colour 2 on the ear cushions; colour 3 on the small hinge tabs.

Female/F_Earrings_Face_Headphones_Emblem.description: A small atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central dot, drawn as thin outlined line-work on the side of the head over the ear area, like a decal or badge.
Female/F_Earrings_Face_Headphones_Emblem.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole emblem line-work; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Face_Rockcrystal_01.description: A pair of faceted rock-crystal ear pieces: chunky angular plates cupping each side of the head, each sweeping back into a long pointed crystal spike that rises above the ear. Fantasy, monstrous look.
Female/F_Earrings_Face_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plates; colour 1 on the long crystal spikes; colour 3 on the thin crack lines between the plates.

Female/F_Earrings_Face_Wedding_Jewel_01.description: A pair of formal drop earrings: each has a small rounded stud with a second bead at the earlobe and a long, slim faceted teardrop pendant hanging below, ending in a point. Elegant and delicate.
Female/F_Earrings_Face_Wedding_Jewel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the round studs and beads at the earlobe; colour 1 on the long hanging pendants.

Female/F_Earrings_Face_Wedding_Jewel_02.description: A pair of formal drop earrings: a short vertical string of three round pearl beads ending in a long faceted pointed gem pendant, hanging from the earlobes to about jaw level. Elegant and delicate.
Female/F_Earrings_Face_Wedding_Jewel_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pearl beads; colour 1 on the pointed gem pendants.

Female/F_Earrings_Face_Wedding_Jewel_03.description: A pair of large formal drop earrings: each has a round, chunky faceted setting with a big domed central stone, small beads beneath, and three long pointed crystal pendants dangling toward the jaw.
Female/F_Earrings_Face_Wedding_Jewel_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer round setting; colour 3 on the central domed stone; colour 0 on the small beads; colour 1 on the dangling crystal pendants.

Female/F_Earrings_Falconer_01.description: A pair of side-of-head fins styled like mechanical falcon wings: each has a pointed plate at the temple with layered blades sweeping up and back, plus small angular spurs below. Sits beside the eyes and ears.
Female/F_Earrings_Falconer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the temple plates; colour 1 on the long upper blades; colour 2 on the middle blades; colour 3 on the small lower spurs.

Female/F_Earrings_Fullhelm_Earcaps_01_Ar.description: A pair of chunky cylindrical ear caps that sit over each ear, with a rounded rim and an inset angular panel on the outer face. Reads as a simple helmet-style earpiece or headphone.
Female/F_Earrings_Fullhelm_Earcaps_01_Ar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap barrels and rims; colour 1 on the inset panel on the outer face of each cap.

Female/F_Earrings_Fullhelm_Mechassn_01.description: A mechanical open-face helmet shell that wraps the skull, with vented contrasting slots on top and back, a visor-like brow band, boxy ventilator pods with ribbed edges over each ear, and a thin chin strap curving under the jaw.
Female/F_Earrings_Fullhelm_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and brow band; colour 1 on the ear ventilator pods; colour 3 on the chin strap; colour 2 in the vent slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Fullhelm_Viperps_01.description: A mechanical full-helmet shell with a large open face window, angular plated sides and a pointed chin guard. A thick ribbed tube runs across the back of the head, like a ventilator, with a banded panel below it.
Female/F_Earrings_Fullhelm_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet plates; colour 1 on the side vent pads, the tube sleeves and the back panel stripes; colour 2 on the ribbed tube segment and the chin and underside plates.

Female/F_Earrings_Fullhelm_Wings_01.description: A pair of angular side-of-head wing plates that sit over the ears and sweep upward and backward into sharp points, like decorative helmet fins. Each plate is a thin folded shell with layered stripes.
Female/F_Earrings_Fullhelm_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the wing plates; colour 1 on the inner and lower panels; colour 2 on the bands near the lower edges; colour 3 on the tips of the points.
Female/F_Earrings_Fullhelm_Wings_01.differs: The female wings are taller and curve upward more steeply, rising into narrower vertical points, while the male wings sweep back in a flatter, wider shape.

Female/F_Earrings_Gamer_01.description: A rigid angular headband wrapping around the head: a zigzag-edged band across the forehead, chunky side pods over the ears with recessed panels and slash marks, and a broad flat panel at the back.
Female/F_Earrings_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and housing; colour 3 on the recessed side and back panels; colour 2 on the slash marks.
Female/F_Earrings_Gamer_01.differs: The female version has no separate contrasting end caps on the front edges of the side pods; they match the rest of the band.

Female/F_Earrings_Gladiator_01.description: A pair of side-of-head guards: tall angular blades sweep up above the temples and taper down past the cheeks to points by the jaw, each with an octagonal ear disc. Suggests a gladiator or sci-fi helmet.
Female/F_Earrings_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges of the blades; colour 1 on the inner panel of each blade; colour 2 on the ear discs.

Female/F_Earrings_Gladiator_02.description: A pair of side-of-head winged guards: swept metal plates with tall curved horn-like tips rising above the ears and a hooked cheek edge, each with layered feather-like blades fanning backward. Gladiator or fantasy helm style.
Female/F_Earrings_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept plates and their curved tips; colour 1 on the upper feather blades; colour 2 on the middle feather blades; colour 3 on the lower feather blades.

Female/F_Earrings_Guardian_01.description: A pair of ornate side-of-head ornaments shaped like swirling flames or dragon wisps: a tall swept-back pointed fin above a lower curling wave-like plate, mounted over each ear with spiral relief detailing.
Female/F_Earrings_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper swept fins; colour 1 on the lower wave plates; colour 2 on the spiral line detailing of the upper fins; colour 3 on the thin swirl lines on the lower plates.

Female/F_Earrings_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.description: A pair of side-of-head ear pieces: each has a short round cuff over the ear with a fan of long tapered feather blades sweeping outward and back, with contrasting tips. Fantasy-alien, bird-like style.
Female/F_Earrings_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ear cuffs and the feather tips; colour 0 on the feather blades; colour 2 on the cap on the outer face of each cuff; colour 3 on the small centre light.

Female/F_Earrings_Horns_Crow_02.description: A pair of ridged, segmented horns that sprout from the sides of the temples, sweep back along the head and curl outward to tapering, slightly upturned points. Gives a demonic, monstrous look.
Female/F_Earrings_Horns_Crow_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blocky bases and the ridged upper lengths of the horns; colour 3 on the tapering tips, blending in gradually.

Female/F_Earrings_Horns_Spiral_01_Horns_.description: A pair of large ram-like spiral horns sprouting from the sides of the head, each curling back and down in a thick coil with segmented banding and a sharp pointed tip. Suggests a beastly or demonic look.
Female/F_Earrings_Horns_Spiral_01_Horns_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating horn bands; colour 1 on the other alternating horn bands; colour 2 on the horn tips.

Female/F_Earrings_Lockbox_66_02.description: A pair of flat, ear-mounted plates shaped like stylised winged emblems, with a rounded block on the front edge, a slotted panel and a small round hole. They sit against the sides of the head over the ears.
Female/F_Earrings_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate bodies and wing rims; colour 1 on the rounded blocks at the front; colour 2 on the wing backing panels; colour 3 on the slot inserts.

Female/F_Earrings_Madjester_01.description: A single-sided cluster of three sweeping plumes attached at the side of the head above the ear: two long striped feathers curve up and outward, with a shorter soft feather curling out below them.
Female/F_Earrings_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 and colour 2 on the striped upper feathers as alternating bands; colour 0 fading into colour 1 on the lower soft feather.

Female/F_Earrings_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A pair of disc-shaped ear covers with a rimmed edge, sitting over the ears. Each carries a cluster of long, swept-back spikes that rise above the head like fins, for a speedster or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Earrings_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the discs and their rims; colour 3 on the spike clusters.

Female/F_Earrings_Robot_Steampunk_01.description: A pair of mechanical ear discs: chunky octagonal knurled drums with a ringed inner face, mounted on short contrasting stems that end in faceted knobs, sticking out from each side of the head.
Female/F_Earrings_Robot_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer drum casing and flat back plate; colour 1 on the inner ring of the disc face; colour 3 on the knob at the centre and on the stem tips; colour 2 on the stems.

Female/F_Earrings_Rustbucket_01.description: A pair of chunky cylindrical ear discs, one on each side of the head, like mechanical earmuffs. Each has a smooth rim and a outward face with a central round cap ringed by radial segmented slots.
Female/F_Earrings_Rustbucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rims and discs; colour 1 on the central cap of each disc; colour 3 and colour 2 alternating on the radial segments around the cap.

Female/F_Earrings_Salamander_01.description: A pair of side-of-head accessories, each a small block at the temple with four long, tapering, backswept claw-like spines that fan out past the head. Suggests a monstrous, reptilian or alien look.
Female/F_Earrings_Salamander_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bases and the bodies of the spines; the spine tips fade toward light and near black.

Female/F_Earrings_Seacreature_01.description: A pair of large fin-like side accessories flaring outward from either side of the head, each made of angular segmented panels with pointed tips that hang down, suggesting sea-creature fins or wings.
Female/F_Earrings_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad inner fin panels; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 1 on the outer edging and framing ribs; colour 2 on the tips and veins.

Female/F_Earrings_Seahorse_01.description: A pair of fin-like ear ornaments, each a fan of layered, pointed leaf-shaped blades that sweep outward and backward from the side of the head at ear level, evoking seahorse or aquatic fins.
Female/F_Earrings_Seahorse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light outer blades; colour 1 on the mid-toned inner blades; colour 2 on the darkest blades.

Female/F_Earrings_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of flat diamond-shaped plates with a slight raised pyramid face and a thin rim, mounted upright on each side of the head beside the eyes and ears like angular ear guards.
Female/F_Earrings_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diamond plates; colour 1 on the thin rim edges. Most of the surface shows the light colour.

Female/F_Earrings_Starhawk_02.description: A pair of small curved, faceted plates worn on the sides of the head over the ears, like angular earpieces or ear guards. Chunky bevelled edges give a sci-fi headset look.
Female/F_Earrings_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole faceted plates; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Swing_01.description: A pair of long, slender dangling earrings, each a faceted elongated spike or crystal shard hanging from a tiny hook at the earlobe, reaching down past the jaw toward the neck. Sleek and sharp-edged.
Female/F_Earrings_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 appears on the whole shard; the glossy faceted surface seems to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Tactical_01.description: A pair of chunky, chamfered rectangular ear guards that sit over each ear like headphone cups, with a bevelled outer shell and a recessed, framed panel on the outer face. Suggests tactical or sci-fi headgear.
Female/F_Earrings_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shells; colour 1 on the outer rim of the recessed panel; colour 3 on the inner rim; colour 2 on the recessed panel centre.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Batears_01_New.description: A pair of large, pointed bat-like ears that sweep up and outward from the sides of the head, with a smooth outer shell, ribbed inner folds and small tapering tips near the ear canal.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Batears_01_New.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of the ears; colour 1 on the ribbed inner folds; the small inner tips take the skin tone rather than a colour slot.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Diamonds_01.description: A pair of flat, elongated diamond-shaped earrings hanging from the earlobes, each a thin faceted lozenge with slight thickness, sitting just below the ear beside the jaw.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Diamonds_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faces of the diamonds; colour 1 on the edge facets of the diamonds.
