Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Djmadbot_01.description: Oversized DJ-style headphones: a thin curved band arches over the head to two rounded cup housings over the ears, each with an outward spindle of stacked rings ending in a small knob. Sci-fi and quirky.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Djmadbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband and spindle tips; colour 1 on the ear cups; colour 2 on the rings along the spindles.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Dragon_01_New.description: A pair of large fin-like ear attachments: each has a small pointed base at the ear and a wide, ribbed membrane with scalloped, jagged edges that sweeps up and back past the head, like dragon or bat wings.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Dragon_01_New.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pointed ear bases; colour 1 on the inner part of the membranes; colour 3 on the outer edges and scalloped tips; colour 2 in the darkest shading near the ear.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Earguard_01.description: A pair of angular metal side guards on the temples: each is a slim blade-like plate that sweeps back along the head, then drops in a narrow curved shield past the ear toward the jaw, with a small rivet.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Earguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and edges; colour 1 on the striped top strip of each guard; colour 2 on the inner edge of the drop section.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Earguard_01.differs: The female guards hang lower and are longer and narrower, reaching past the cheek.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_01.description: A pair of simple round hoop earrings, thin faceted rings hanging from the earlobes, one on each side of the head. A plain, small jewellery accessory with a casual, everyday look.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoops; the metal finish appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_02.description: A small plain hoop earring for the left ear: a thin, slightly faceted band ring hanging from the earlobe, viewed edge-on from the front and as a full circle from the side.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_03.description: A small plain hoop earring for the right ear: a thin, slightly faceted round band that hangs from the earlobe and sits beside the face. A simple, understated jewellery accent.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Fullhelmviper_01.description: A horseshoe-shaped helmet-like side piece that wraps around the head from the temples to the back and down to the jaw, with smooth angular plates, a ridged vent on the forehead and small grilles by the cheeks. The face stays open.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Fullhelmviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and cheek plates; colour 1 on the side panels and back trim bands; colour 2 on the inner frame and forehead plate; colour 3 on the forehead vent slats.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Fullhelmviper_02.description: A sci-fi helmet-like headpiece shaped as a horseshoe of armored panels that wraps over the crown, sides and back of the head, leaving the face open. Vented ridges on top and small light strips at the cheeks.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Fullhelmviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and raised rim; colour 1 on the top vent panel and the inner trim band; colour 3 on the vent slits and cheek light strips; colour 2 on the small back tabs.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Heart_01.description: A single small dangling earring: a thin round hoop hanging from the ear with a flat heart-shaped pendant below it. Worn on the right ear lobe; cute and simple.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Heart_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hoop; colour 0 on the heart pendant.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Heart_02.description: A small dangling earring for the left ear: a round ring at the lobe with a flat heart-shaped charm hanging beneath it on a tiny link. Cute, simple jewellery.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Heart_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring at the lobe; colour 0 on the heart charm.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Heart_03.description: A pair of small dangling earrings: each has a thin round ring hooked at the earlobe with a flat heart-shaped pendant hanging below. Cute, simple jewellery worn on both ears.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Heart_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rings; colour 0 on the heart pendants.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Curl_01.description: A pair of segmented, ribbed curled horns, one mounted on each side of the head above the ears. Each starts with a wide band-like base, sweeps outward and forward, and curls to a tapering point.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Curl_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the base bands where the horns attach to the head; colour 0 on the upper horn segments; colour 1 on the lower curled tips, blending in gradually from colour 0.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_01.description: A pair of curved demon horns that sprout sideways from banded cuffs over the ears, sweeping outward then curling forward and up to sharp tips. Smooth tapered form suggests a monstrous, fantasy look.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cuff bands at the base of each horn; colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips, blending in gradually from the base.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_Huge.description: A pair of huge curved demon horns that sprout from the sides of the head, sweep outward and then up to sharp tips. Segmented ridges run along each horn, and a contrasting band sits at each base.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_Huge.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the upper horn shafts and tips, fading in as a gradient; colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_Huge.description: A pair of tall, thick demon horns that sweep out sideways from the temples and curve upward to sharp points, with contrasting bands where they meet the head. Worn on the sides of the head as a monstrous fantasy accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_Huge.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the bands at the base of each horn.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Grond_01.description: A pair of thick, ridged curved horns mounted on chunky octagonal collars at the sides of the head, sweeping outward and back, then curling down to tapering points like a bull or beast.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Grond_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the collar mounts at the base of each horn; colour 0 on the ridged horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering horn tips.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Kigatilik_.description: A pair of mismatched bull-like horns rising from the sides of the head: one sweeps out and up to a fine point, the other curls back with a wavy twist. Each has a contrasting band at its base.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Kigatilik_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Spiral_02.description: A pair of segmented, spiralling horns that rise from the sides of the head, curve out and back in a wavy S-shape, and end in slender curved tips. Small jagged spurs stud the bends, giving a monstrous, demonic look.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Spiral_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 alternate in bands along the horn segments; colour 2 on the curved horn tips.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Yak_01.description: A pair of wide, ridged bovine horns that sprout from banded cuffs at each side of the head, sweep outward and curve down and forward to sharp tips. Beast-like and monstrous headwear.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Yak_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cuff bands at the base of each horn; colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the tapering horn tips.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Hornsfuturistic_.description: A pair of ornamental curved horns that start at the temples, sweep outward and up around the head like a halo, and end in sharp upward points, with small spurs on the outer edges. Futuristic monstrous headpiece.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Hornsfuturistic_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the horns, fading to a lighter tone at the bases; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A pair of small curved horn-like tusks that sweep forward and outward from the ears, tapering to points. They sit beside the head as a monstrous, beastly ear accessory with a smooth faceted finish.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: The horns show a light shading rather than the scheme, so the default material appears to ignore colour slots; no clear colour slot split is visible.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The female version's horns are uniformly one colour and seem to ignore the colour scheme, while the male version has a contrasting tip and a differently coloured base.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Left_Pirate_Fanc.description: A single left-ear earring: a faceted gem stud on the lobe with a thin faceted hoop hanging below it. A small, fancy pirate-style piece of jewellery.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Left_Pirate_Fanc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoop; colour 1 on the gem stud.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Left_Skull_Earri.description: A small skull-shaped earring hanging from the left earlobe: a chunky, flat-backed skull with sunken eye sockets, a nose cavity and etched teeth lines. Gothic, macabre styling.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Left_Skull_Earri.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull body; colour 3 on the eye sockets and tooth grooves; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Luchadorhawk_01.description: A pair of stylised hawk-head side pieces that sit against the temples, each a flat plate with a hooked beak-like point at the front, a small angular eye cut-out and swept feather-like fingers fanning up and back.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Luchadorhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the outlines and beak tips; colour 2 on the eye cut-outs.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Norsehorns_Decor.description: A pair of decorative Norse-style horns that curve up and outward from the sides of the head. Each is a flat, scroll-tipped band with interlaced knotwork panels and a raised rim, giving a fantasy, Celtic look.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Norsehorns_Decor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner faces and scroll ends of the horns; colour 1 on the raised rims and outlines; colour 2 on the knotwork panels.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A pair of earrings, each a thin faceted hoop hanging below a small hexagonal gem stud at the earlobe. A fancy, swashbuckling-style accessory that dangles just below the ear.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoops; colour 1 on the gem studs.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Prop_Arrow_01.description: A novelty headband made to look like an arrow passing through the head: a thin band arcs over the top of the skull, with a straight shaft, pointed head and fletched tail sticking out at the temples.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Prop_Arrow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arrowhead, shaft ends and fletching; colour 1 on the fletching vanes and the band's side sections; colour 2 on the top of the band and the centre of the shaft; colour 3 on small marks on the shaft.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Prop_Arrow_02.description: A novelty arrow-through-head prop: a straight shaft with a pointed head on one side and fletching on the other, joined by a curved band that arches over the top of the head, so the arrow appears to pierce the skull at ear level.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Prop_Arrow_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arrowhead, fletching and shaft ends; colour 1 on the shaft segments and the sides of the arching band; colour 2 on the top of the band and the central shaft; colour 3 on the small mark at the centre of the shaft.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Right_Pirate_Fan.description: A single hoop earring for the right ear: a thick, faceted round ring hanging below the lobe, topped with a chunky faceted gemstone. A fancy pirate-style accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Right_Pirate_Fan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoop; colour 1 on the gem.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Right_Skull_Earr.description: A single skull-shaped ear ornament worn at the right ear: a flat-backed, rounded skull with deep round eye sockets, a nose cavity and carved teeth lines, sitting against the side of the head. Macabre, gothic accessory.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Right_Skull_Earr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull shell; colour 3 on the eye sockets and tooth grooves; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Robot_Human_Wing.description: A pair of mechanical side-of-head accessories: large angular wing blades sweeping up and back from the temples, with smaller spiked fins and pointed cheek plates beside the eyes and face, in a robotic, monstrous helmet style.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Robot_Human_Wing.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large upper wing blades and smaller fins; colour 0 on the pointed lower cheek plates; colour 2 on the rounded housings beside the eyes; colour 3 on the small vent slits and markings.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.description: A pair of mechanical side-of-head wing pieces: large angular swept-back fins sweep up from the temples, with smaller spikes below and a contrasting pod on each cheek that carries blade-like plates curving down along the jaw.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large upper fins and small spikes; colour 0 on the cheek blades and lower plates; colour 2 on the pods beside the eyes; colour 3 on the small slot markings.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.differs: The female version has longer, thinner cheek blades that hang lower along the jaw, and slightly shorter upper fins.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Skull_Earrings_0.description: A pair of chunky skull-shaped earrings hanging at the ears, each a small rounded skull with hollow eye sockets, a nose cavity and teeth ridges, giving a gothic, macabre accent.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Skull_Earrings_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull surfaces; colour 3 on the eye sockets and the tooth grooves.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Spikes_01_New.description: Clusters of short conical spikes of varying sizes jutting outward from each side of the head above the ears, angled back and sideways, giving a horned, monstrous or punk look.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Spikes_01_New.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the default material shows little variation from the other colour slots.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Toy_01.description: A pair of chunky retro headphone-style ear cups, each a rounded rim around a recessed speaker-like dish, sitting flat against the sides of the head over the ears with no band between them.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and shell of each cup; colour 1 on the recessed ring inside; colour 2 on the central speaker dish.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Victory_01.description: A pair of winged side-of-head ornaments: each has a tall, sweeping curved blade rising above the head, with smaller layered feather-like fins fanning out behind at the temple. Suggests a heroic, fantasy helm-wing look.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large upswept blades; colour 1 on the mid feather-like fins; colour 2 on the lowest fins nearest the head.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Welder_01.description: A head-wrapping armored band with a strap across the forehead and back of the head, carrying two rounded plates that flare down over the ears and cheeks; small round rivets or bolts and contrasting oval pads mark the strap.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plates and band; colour 2 on the round bolts and oval pads; colour 0 on the thin inner trim along the top edge of the band.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Welder_01.differs: The ear plates sit slightly further apart and hang lower and narrower, leaving more of the face visible than on the male version.

Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Wings_01.description: A pair of angular, swept-back fin-like panels that sit at the sides of the head over the temples and ears, sweeping to a point behind the head with a short drop at the front. Art-deco, helmet-like styling.
Female/F_Earrings_Tight_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the panels; colour 1 on the inner panel faces; colour 2 on the inner edge segments near the ears; colour 3 on the small tips at the rear points.

Female/F_Earrings_Traveler_01.description: A single long curved feather worn at the side of the head, sweeping up and back from above the ear with a contrasting central quill and layered, ragged barbs along both edges.
Female/F_Earrings_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather barbs; colour 2 on the central quill and shading along the spine.

Female/F_Earrings_Trooper_04.description: A pair of tall, flat-sided angular blade fins that jut upward from the sides of the head just above the ears, tapering to a narrow base. Suggests a sentai-style helmet crest or horn-like antennae.

Female/F_Earrings_Vigilante_01.description: Headset-style ear guards: two chunky octagonal earcups with inset faceted gem-like panels on the outer faces, joined by a thin band that wraps around the back of the head. Sci-fi, sporty and superhero feel.
Female/F_Earrings_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the earcup housings; colour 3 on the inset outer panels; colour 0 on the head band; colour 1 on the thin edge trim of the band.
Female/F_Earrings_Vigilante_01.differs: The female band is a thinner strip that sits higher and slimmer around the head, while the male band is taller and wider at the back.

Female/F_Earrings_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A pair of long hanging cloth streamers, like a hennin veil, attached at the sides of the head and falling past the chest. Each ends in ragged, pointed tails and has a gradient from top to bottom.
Female/F_Earrings_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper streamers near the head; colour 1 on the lower flared, pointed tails; the two blend in a gradient between them.

Female/F_Earrings_Wolf_01.description: A pair of tall, thin blade-like ear fins that sweep upward and slightly back from the sides of the head, with a curved wolf-ear shape and engraved scrollwork along the inner face.
Female/F_Earrings_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade surfaces; colour 3 on the patterned edge band; colour 1 on the swirl engraving; colour 2 on the outer edges.
Female/F_Earrings_Wolf_01.differs: The female version is much taller, narrower and more upright, rising well above the head, while the male one is shorter and wider with a wavy flared tip.

Female/F_Emblem_Astronaut_01.description: A boxy chest-mounted life-support unit with a V-shaped central panel, chunky rounded housings at the sides and two round knobs on top. Thin flexible hoses loop from the underside and wrap around the ribs toward the back.
Female/F_Emblem_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and V panel; colour 2 on the lower and side housing blocks; colour 3 on the two round knobs; colour 1 on the hoses.

Female/F_Emblem_Back_Child_Rocker_01.description: A small atom-shaped emblem of interlaced elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, sitting flat on the middle of the upper back like a printed or embossed badge. Suggests a sci-fi, rocker style.
Female/F_Emblem_Back_Child_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main orbit rings; colour 1 on the outline edge of the rings.

Female/F_Emblem_Back_Tight_01.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem printed on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus ring, drawn as a thin outlined graphic with no relief. Suggests a science or superhero theme.
Female/F_Emblem_Back_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outline of the orbits and nucleus; colour 0 on the filled bands between the outlines.

Female/F_Emblem_Bounty_01.description: A diagonal bandolier strap running from one shoulder across the chest to the opposite hip, with a square buckle plate and button at the shoulder and a row of short cartridge-like canisters along the front. A sci-fi western look.
Female/F_Emblem_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band; colour 1 on the strap edging; colour 2 on the buckle plate and canister centres; colour 3 on the button and canister caps.

Female/F_Emblem_Bounty_02.description: A diagonal bandolier strap running from one shoulder across the chest to the opposite hip, with a square buckle box holding a round button and a row of cylindrical shell cartridges. Space-western bounty hunter look.
Female/F_Emblem_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band; colour 1 on the strap edging; colour 2 on the square buckle box; colour 3 on the round button and the cartridge ends.

Female/F_Emblem_Chestlayer_Insignia_01.description: A chunky cylindrical chest emblem with a raised rim and a flat disc face showing an atom symbol of three looping orbits around a nucleus; sits at the upper centre of the chest in a superhero, sci-fi style.
Female/F_Emblem_Chestlayer_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cylinder body and rim; colour 1 on the disc face background; colour 0 on the atom symbol.

Female/F_Emblem_Chestlayer_Viperlogo_01.description: A chunky chest emblem shaped like a stylised snake head, with cut-out eye slits and fang-like inner details on a raised front face. It sits at the top of the chest as a thick, rounded triangular block.
Female/F_Emblem_Chestlayer_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised snake-head face and the block's sides; colour 1 on the recessed fang and mouth panel behind the cut-outs.

Female/F_Emblem_Chestwear_Egyptian_Scara.description: A winged scarab beetle emblem worn on the centre of the chest: a rounded segmented shell with splayed legs and raised forelegs, flanked by two spread feathered wings with layered contrasting bands. Ancient Egyptian style.
Female/F_Emblem_Chestwear_Egyptian_Scara.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beetle shell, legs and wing feathers; colour 3 on the inner wing feather band; colour 2 on the upper wing band; colour 0 on the wing edge trim.

Female/F_Emblem_Child_Modern_Sapphire_03.description: A set of five small diamond-shaped studs, each with a raised metal frame and an oval gem at the centre, arranged in a shallow V across the lower chest and stomach as a decorative emblem.
Female/F_Emblem_Child_Modern_Sapphire_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diamond frames; colour 1 on the oval gems; the backs of the studs show plain frame colour.

Female/F_Emblem_Child_Prisoner_02.description: A restraint-style chest harness: a pointed, mask-like mechanical buckle plate with small studs sits at the sternum, with a short tab above and a flat strap looping around the ribcage under the bust.
Female/F_Emblem_Child_Prisoner_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the buckle plate; colour 1 on the strap and top tab; colour 3 on the small eye-like studs.

Female/F_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A single loose chain of chunky angular links worn as a harness around the torso, looping under the bust and across the chest with a small gap at the front centre. Gritty, rebellious metal accessory.
Female/F_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: The chain uses a glossy metal default material that largely ignores the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.description: Two loose lengths of heavy chain draped across the upper chest and shoulders, each curling into a loop over the shoulder and trailing along the collarbone and upper back. A rugged, mechanical renegade accessory.
Female/F_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.colourAreas: Default metal material largely ignores the colour scheme; the chain links show a metallic finish.
Female/F_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.differs: The female chains hang in smaller loops, with one loop on each shoulder and shorter trailing lengths.

Female/F_Emblem_Child_Strapped_01.description: A small flat atom-shaped chest emblem: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central dot, drawn as thin outlined bands. It sits on the upper chest and reads as a science-themed superhero badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Child_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit bands and centre dot; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the bands.

Female/F_Emblem_Combat_Pouch_01.description: A small rectangular box-shaped pouch worn on the upper chest as a front emblem, with a flap, rounded padded edges, contrasting border trim and a raised inset panel bearing a handle-like bracket mark.
Female/F_Emblem_Combat_Pouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the border trim and edge binding; colour 1 on the inset panel; colour 3 on the bracket mark.

Female/F_Emblem_Cosmic_01.description: A small hexagonal chest emblem: a raised, chunky badge with a diagonal split face, a curved inset panel and a small rectangular tab at the top. It sits at the upper centre of the chest with a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Emblem_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the diagonal centre band and most of the hexagon body; colour 1 on the curved inset panel and upper-left facet; colour 0 on the top tab and thin edge rims; colour 3 on a small patch at the back edge.
Female/F_Emblem_Cosmic_01.differs: The female emblem has most of its face and rim in colour 2 instead of colour 0, so it looks much darker by default.

Female/F_Emblem_Cosmic_02.description: A small hexagonal chest emblem: a flat, thick slab with angular notched grooves and a swept, wing-like facet across one side, worn on the upper centre of the chest. It suggests a cosmic sci-fi badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: On this sheet the front face mostly shows a glossy near-finish that seems to ignore the scheme; colour 1 on the swept facet along the upper left edge; colour 3 on a raised edge at the back; colour 0 on thin edge trim.
Female/F_Emblem_Cosmic_02.differs: The female emblem's front is mostly contrasting and glossy, with no light panel across the lower half as on the male version.

Female/F_Emblem_Data_Panel_01.description: A small rectangular mechanical data panel worn on the midriff: a bevelled frame around a control face with an indicator light strip, three toggle switches, sliding rails and blocky keypads, held on by short pegs at the corners.
Female/F_Emblem_Data_Panel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel frame and face; colour 1 on the rails, keypads and light-strip surround; colour 2 on the switches and back pegs; colour 3 on the indicator lights and switch stripes.

Female/F_Emblem_Draycul_01.description: A chest emblem shaped like a monstrous skull face with sunken glowing eyes, flared ear-like side flanges and a row of long fangs hanging below the jaw. It sits at the centre of the chest.
Female/F_Emblem_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the skull body and fangs; colour 3 on the eyes. Colours 0 and 1 are not visible.

Female/F_Emblem_Element_Fire_01.description: A flame-shaped chest emblem: two swooping, pointed wing-like tongues sweeping out across the upper chest and collarbone, joining in a V that tapers to a jagged point at the sternum.
Female/F_Emblem_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and reflective and mostly ignores the colour scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on it.
Female/F_Emblem_Element_Fire_01.differs: This version has a glossy, reflective metallic finish instead of the translucent glowing flame look of the male version.

Female/F_Emblem_F_Tight_Ravenswood_01.description: A small round emblem disc worn on the upper chest, with a thin raised rim and a stylised raven silhouette in bold cut-out shapes with swept wing feathers. Suggests a heraldic, gothic insignia.
Female/F_Emblem_F_Tight_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the disc face; colour 2 on the raven silhouette and the back of the disc; colour 1 on the thin outer rim.

Female/F_Emblem_Frigid_01.description: A small angular chest emblem: a deep V-shaped plate with two upswept blades framing a central faceted gem on a narrow stem, sitting at the top of the chest at the neckline. Sleek, sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Emblem_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer V-shaped plate; colour 2 on the stem and the gem's setting; colour 3 on the faceted gem.
Female/F_Emblem_Frigid_01.differs: The V plate sits flatter and wider across the chest, with the blades curving around the bust; the male version follows the pectorals more steeply.

Female/F_Emblem_Haltertop_Disctie_01.description: Two small octagonal disc emblems with engraved triple-spiral designs, sitting high on the chest near the shoulders and joined by two crossing cords. It reads as a mystic charm-like halter tie.
Female/F_Emblem_Haltertop_Disctie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc rims and backs; colour 1 on the spiral designs; colour 3 on the crossing cords.

Female/F_Emblem_Holly_01.description: A small holly-sprig emblem of three spiky-edged leaves around a cluster of three round berries, worn flat on the upper chest near the shoulder as a festive badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Holly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the three leaves; colour 1 on the berry cluster.
Female/F_Emblem_Holly_01.differs: The female holly sits higher and further out toward the shoulder, tilted slightly, whereas the male one sits centred on the chest.

Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Holly_01.description: A small holly-sprig emblem: three spiky-edged leaves radiating from a cluster of three round berries, worn flat on the upper chest near the shoulder as a festive jacket decoration.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Holly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the three leaves; colour 1 on the berries.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Holly_01.differs: The female holly sits higher and further out toward the shoulder, with the leaves tilted at a more diagonal angle.

Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_01.description: A small round medal badge with a raised star at the centre and concentric rings around the rim, hanging from a striped ribbon with two notched tails; worn on the upper chest of a jacket.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the medal face; colour 3 on the star and rim rings; colour 1 on the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon stripes and the back of the medal.

Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_02.description: A small decorative medal pinned on the upper chest: a faceted round disc with a crown emblem inside a laurel wreath, hanging by a ring from a short striped ribbon that is cut at a slant.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the medal face; colour 3 on the crown, laurel wreath, rim and ribbon bar; colour 1 on the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon stripes; colour 1 on the plain back of the disc.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_02.differs: The female ribbon is cut on a slant and tilts, while the male ribbon is a straight-edged rectangle.

Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_03.description: A small medal badge worn on the upper chest: a domed centre with concentric rings inside a scalloped, eight-sided star plate, set on a two-tone ribbon with notched ends that extends to each side.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scalloped plate and dome; colour 3 on the concentric rings; colour 1 on the outer ribbon edges; colour 2 on the ribbon's centre stripe.

Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_04.description: A small hexagonal medal badge with a raised rim, a ring of studs around a central embossed star, and three ribbon tails hanging below. It sits flat on the upper chest as a prize-style emblem.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rim, studs and star; colour 0 on the recessed face of the medal; colour 1 on the outer ribbon tails; colour 2 on the middle ribbon tail and the flat back.

Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_05.description: A small flat pentagonal medal badge with a raised rim and a notched top bar, holding a five-petal flower with a domed centre. Sits on the upper chest of a jacket as a decorative emblem.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and top bar; colour 1 on the badge background; colour 2 on the flower petals and back plate; colour 3 on the domed flower centre.

Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Spy_01.description: A small rose emblem worn as a lapel-style flower pinned high on the left chest. Layered outer petals surround a tightly coiled centre bloom; formal, elegant spy styling.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer petals; colour 1 on the coiled centre of the rose.

Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Wedding_Boutonnie.description: A small formal boutonniere pinned high on the chest: a layered, faceted flower of angular petals around a contrasting round centre, with a short cylindrical stem and a few pointed leaves fanning out behind.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Wedding_Boutonnie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flower petals; colour 2 on the flower centre and inner petal fold; colour 1 on the stem and leaves.
Female/F_Emblem_Jacket_Wedding_Boutonnie.differs: The female flower is angled more upright, with narrower, more swept-back leaves and a stem that points down and to the left.

Female/F_Emblem_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small mechanical chest emblem: a curved plate with notched sides and a crescent inlay along the bottom, a thick bent pipe down the middle, and two round bolt-like knobs with slotted heads at the top.
Female/F_Emblem_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the crescent inlay; colour 2 on the central pipe and the knob rims; colour 3 on the slotted knob faces.
Female/F_Emblem_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The back of the plate is contrasting and matches the pipe, whereas the male version's back shows the light plate colour.

Female/F_Emblem_Lockbox_66_02.description: A small chest emblem made of two separate chunky capsule pieces: a round hollow cylinder above and a rounded rectangular housing below with a recessed oval panel. It sits at the upper chest, tilted slightly.
Female/F_Emblem_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer housings; colour 3 on the inset oval panel; colour 2 on the inside of the round cylinder.

Female/F_Emblem_Modern_Sapphire_02.description: A set of small mechanical stud emblems on the front of the torso: three round gem-set discs of varying size in a vertical line from the collarbone down the chest, and five diamond-shaped gem studs in a V near the waist.
Female/F_Emblem_Modern_Sapphire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc rims and diamond frames; colour 1 on the gem centres.

Female/F_Emblem_Modern_Sapphire_03.description: A chest emblem of five small diamond-shaped metal studs, each with an oval gem set in the centre, arranged in a shallow V across the upper torso. The pieces are flat and sit against the body like decorative badges.
Female/F_Emblem_Modern_Sapphire_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diamond frames; colour 1 on the oval gems; the backs of the studs take colour 0.

Female/F_Emblem_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A small chest emblem made of two round studded discs, each with an engraved star, joined by a pair of crossing thin straps that form an X across the upper chest below the collarbone.
Female/F_Emblem_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossing straps; colour 1 on the disc rims and faces; colour 2 on the star engravings.

Female/F_Emblem_Patriot_01.description: A chest emblem of three raised five-pointed stars in a row: a large central star with a bordered rim and faceted centre, flanked by two smaller plain stars. Sits high on the chest, in a patriotic superhero style.
Female/F_Emblem_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted centre of the large star; colour 3 on its outer rim; colour 1 on the two smaller flanking stars.

Female/F_Emblem_Prisoner_01.description: A mechanical chest harness: a faceted central plate with a gem-like inset and a pointed lower plate, two jointed arms with small hooked tips rising over the shoulders, and a looping strap band around the torso and back.
Female/F_Emblem_Prisoner_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central plates and arm tips; colour 3 on the inset gem; colour 1 on the strap loops and arm clamps; colour 2 on the arm tubes and small lights.
Female/F_Emblem_Prisoner_01.differs: The female strap sits higher under the bust, with arms that angle more steeply upward and a looser, wider back loop.

Female/F_Emblem_Prisoner_02.description: A mechanical restraint-style harness: a pointed, mask-like metal buckle plate with two small studs and a short strap tab sits on the sternum, with a flat band looping around the lower ribs and back.
Female/F_Emblem_Prisoner_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal buckle plate; colour 1 on the strap tab and the encircling band; colour 3 on the small stud lights.
Female/F_Emblem_Prisoner_02.differs: The band sits higher and in a flatter V shape under the bust, while the male band hangs lower as a loose loop.

Female/F_Emblem_Prisoner_03.description: A shoulder harness of two flat riveted straps that loop around each shoulder in a twisted figure-eight and cross the upper chest, joined by a narrow band across the upper back. Worn over a suit.
Female/F_Emblem_Prisoner_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the looped shoulder straps and rivets; colour 1 on the connecting band across the upper chest and back.
Female/F_Emblem_Prisoner_03.differs: The female harness has a short connecting band, visible only as a thin strip across the upper chest and back, with the loops sitting wider apart.

Female/F_Emblem_Pumpkin_01.description: A small chest emblem: a faceted jack-o'-lantern skull face with angry eyes and a jagged grin, flanked by two pointed bat-like wings that sweep outward and down across the upper chest below the collarbones.
Female/F_Emblem_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pumpkin face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the mouth and the back of the face; colour 1 on the wings.

Female/F_Emblem_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A chest harness of heavy metal chain links crossing over the torso and shoulders, with loose looped chain ends at the shoulders and a round skull medallion at the centre of the chest; the back has a plain disc and a chain loop.
Female/F_Emblem_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the medallion backing and back disc; colour 3 on the skull eyes; colour 1 on a small part under the skull. The glossy metal largely ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Emblem_Renegade_Chains_01.differs: The female chains form a more compact, symmetric harness with a larger loop hanging low around the ribs.

Female/F_Emblem_Scarab_01.description: A pair of curved mandible-like horns that arch over the top of each shoulder and hook down toward the upper chest, with a small banded joint before each tapering point. Suggests an insectoid, mechanical scarab look.
Female/F_Emblem_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long shoulder arms of the horns; colour 2 on the joint bands; colour 3 on the hooked tips.
Female/F_Emblem_Scarab_01.differs: The female horns sit slightly higher and wider on the chest, hooking down toward the upper chest.

Female/F_Emblem_Scarab_02.description: A pair of curved, horn-like blades that rise from the collarbones over the shoulders: each has a hooked lower claw on the chest and a long, thorny upper spine sweeping up and back past the neck. Glossy, sci-fi insectoid look.
Female/F_Emblem_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper spined horns; colour 1 on the curved lower claw sections; colour 3 on the sharp tips; colour 2 on the small joints between sections.
Female/F_Emblem_Scarab_02.differs: The female horns sit closer to the neck and the lower claws hook inward over the upper chest, with a shorter reach.

Female/F_Emblem_Small_L_Tight_01.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus ring, worn on the upper left of the chest. It sits flush on the suit like a badge, in a science-themed superhero style.
Female/F_Emblem_Small_L_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Female/F_Emblem_Small_L_Tight_Jacket_01.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, sitting on the upper left chest of a jacket or suit. Suggests a science or nuclear superhero look.
Female/F_Emblem_Small_L_Tight_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Female/F_Emblem_Small_Tight_01.description: A small atom-symbol chest emblem: three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus ring, with a slim raised outline. It sits flat on the upper chest, following the curve of the bust, in a science or superhero style.
Female/F_Emblem_Small_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Female/F_Emblem_Small_Tight_Jacket_01.description: A small raised atom emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus ring, worn flat on the upper centre of the chest over a jacket or tights. Suggests science or atomic-power themes.
Female/F_Emblem_Small_Tight_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Female/F_Emblem_Small_Tight_Scifi_Soldie.description: A small atom-shaped chest emblem of interlocking looping orbital rings around a central nucleus, applied flat to the upper chest like a printed badge. It suggests a sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Emblem_Small_Tight_Scifi_Soldie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the atom rings; colour 1 on the outer edge outline of the rings and the nucleus centre.

Female/F_Emblem_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A scarab beetle chest emblem: a rounded split-panel body with a small oval head, spindly legs and a pointed tail spike, flanked by two spread wings of serrated feather-like tiers. Sits on the upper chest, in an Egyptian style.
Female/F_Emblem_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing feathers, the outline rim and one half of the beetle body; colour 1 on the head, the legs and the other body panel; colour 2 on the wing bands and one body half; colour 3 on the small patch on the back of the shell.

Female/F_Emblem_Star_01.description: A small emblem of two overlapping five-pointed stars, a larger one in front with a raised bevelled centre and thick rim, and a smaller one behind it. It sits on the upper chest over the breast, in a badge style.
Female/F_Emblem_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the centre of the large star; colour 2 on the rim of the large star and the back faces; colour 1 on the centre of the smaller star; colour 0 on the rim of the smaller star.

Female/F_Emblem_Star_02.description: A small chest emblem of two overlapping five-pointed stars, a larger one in front and a smaller one offset behind it. Each has a raised beveled rim and a recessed face. It sits on the upper chest near the shoulder.
Female/F_Emblem_Star_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the face of the front star; colour 2 on the raised rim of the front star; colour 1 on the face of the rear star; colour 0 on the rim edge of the rear star.

Female/F_Emblem_Starhawk_01.description: A chest emblem shaped like a wide U or crescent with upswept curled tips and a pointed base, framing a faceted pyramid gem at the centre. Sits on the upper chest over the sternum, with a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Emblem_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crescent frame; colour 3 on the accent stripes along the lower arms of the crescent; colour 1 on the faceted gem's outer sides and rim; colour 2 on the gem's inner facets and the underside.

Female/F_Emblem_Strapped_01.description: A round, domed chest emblem showing an atom symbol, ringed by a contrasting band and a rim with a row of pointed spikes around the edge. Sits centred on the chest, superhero and mechanical in style.
Female/F_Emblem_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and the atom symbol; colour 1 on the dome face and inner ring; colour 2 on the band, small tick marks and flat back; colour 3 on the spikes.

Female/F_Emblem_Straps_01.description: A pair of crossed chest straps forming an X over the torso, running from the shoulders down to the underbust, with small square emblem plates near the top and buckled ends at the lower edge.
Female/F_Emblem_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the edge piping and outlines; colour 3 on the emblem plates; colour 2 on the small lower-end details.
Female/F_Emblem_Straps_01.differs: The female straps end lower under the bust and curve around the chest, with the lower ends sitting as short curved tabs beneath the bust.

Female/F_Emblem_Stripes_Tight_01.description: A small rectangular flag-like chest emblem made of three horizontal stripes of equal height, lying flat on the upper chest just below the collarbone with a slightly wavy cloth surface.
Female/F_Emblem_Stripes_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top stripe; colour 1 on the middle stripe; colour 2 on the bottom stripe.

Female/F_Emblem_Swing_01.description: A small mechanical chest emblem: a round-cornered gauge housing with bolted bezel and a needle dial, a small knob beneath, and a thin cable running across the chest to a flat plug tab. Sits high on the upper chest.
Female/F_Emblem_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauge housing bezel and plug tab; colour 1 on the cable; colour 3 on the dial face and needle; colour 2 on the small knob and dial recesses.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A small kite-shaped chest emblem: a faceted gem set in a raised angular frame with notched lower edges, flanked by two pointed crystal shards at the sides and a small shard below. Sits centred on the upper chest.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular frame; colour 3 on the central faceted gem; colour 1 on the three pointed side and lower shards.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A chest emblem shaped like a jagged, star-topped shield tapering to a point, with a raised metallic rim around a recessed gradient panel. It sits on the upper chest and follows the curve of the bust.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim; colour 1 on the upper part of the inner panel, fading into colour 2 toward the lower point.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A chest emblem shaped like a four-pointed star with a long downward tail, sitting on the centre of the chest as a slightly raised plate with a thin rim. Superhero look.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper face of the emblem, fading to colour 2 toward the lower point; colour 0 on the outer rim.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Badge_01.description: A small shield-shaped chest badge with a thick raised rim, a large star on a round centre disc and a curved scroll detail beneath. It sits on the upper chest and suits superhero or military costumes.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Badge_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the thick rim and the sides of the badge; colour 0 on the shield face behind the star; colour 3 on the star and centre disc; colour 2 on the scroll lines and the star's inner shading.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Badge_02.description: A small shield-shaped chest badge with a raised thick rim, a star and central disc emblem, and scroll-like edging. It sits on the upper chest, suiting police or superhero jackets.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Badge_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the badge face; colour 1 on the outer rim, sides and star outline; colour 3 on the star and central disc; colour 2 on the scroll edging.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Egyptian_Scarab_01.description: A winged scarab beetle emblem worn across the upper chest: a rounded shell with raised legs and pincers, flanked by two spread feathered wings with layered bands. Egyptian-styled, and it sits flat on the chest.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Egyptian_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beetle body, legs and outer wing feathers; colour 2 on the upper wing band; colour 3 on the inner wing feather row; colour 0 on the wing edge trim.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Evilscientist_01.description: A small round chest emblem shaped like a domed gem set in a thick, faceted rim housing. It sits at the centre of the upper chest, giving a sci-fi power-core look.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Evilscientist_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim housing; colour 1 on the domed gem face.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A small art deco chest emblem: a central pointed shield-like fin flanked by two angled wing arms, each with a stepped contrasting edge. It sits on the upper chest, slightly raised from the suit.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central fin; colour 0 on the upper faces of the wing arms; colour 3 on the lower edge trim of the wing arms.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A chest emblem of swept, blade-like fins: two broad wing-like blades flare outward across the upper chest above the bust, a small pair of curved horns rises from a central contrasting gem, and a pointed contrasting shard hangs down the sternum.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large swept wing blades; colour 3 on the curved horns at the top; colour 2 on the central gem; colour 0 on the lower pointed shard.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Firebird_01.differs: The female emblem sits higher and its wings curve around the bust, with the lower shard resting between the breasts.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Flag_01.description: A flat, roughly rectangular emblem panel that sits on the upper chest just below the collarbones. It is a thin, slightly tapered flag shape that follows the chest curve, and works as a plain badge or insignia.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Flag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole flag panel; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Foxbat_01.description: A small bat-shaped chest emblem: a thick, faceted raised badge with two swept wings, a pair of small ears at the top and a pointed tail hanging down the centre. It sits on the upper chest.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole badge; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.description: A small round chest emblem: a shallow disc with a raised rim and a stylised bat silhouette with pointed ears and a central wedge. It sits at the upper centre of the chest as a superhero badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc face and rim; colour 2 on the bat silhouette and the side band; colour 1 on the accent edging around the bat and the inner lining; colour 3 on the central wedge.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A small oval faceted gemstone emblem worn on the upper centre of the chest, with a flat table top, angular cut facets around the sides and a flat contrasting back. Suits superhero or sci-fi costumes.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top table; colour 1 on some facets along the upper left edge; colour 3 as a faint tint on the table. The glossy gem material largely ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A small faceted rhomboid gem emblem worn upright on the upper chest below the collarbone, with a flat bevelled top face, angled side facets and a flat back. Suggests a sleek superhero or sci-fi badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The gem is glossy and mostly ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint from colour 1 shows on the upper left facet, and the flat back is near-solid.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small square faceted gemstone emblem with a flat top and bevelled, sloping sides, sitting on the upper centre of the chest. It has a glossy, cut-glass look suited to superhero or sci-fi suits.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 shows faintly as a tint on one bevelled side. No other slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A small chest emblem shaped like a faceted pentagonal gemstone, with a flat raised face and bevelled sloping edges. It sits on the upper chest near the collar, suggesting a tech-styled superhero badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy metallic faceted surface largely ignores the colour scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on it.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted heart-shaped gemstone emblem worn on the upper chest, with a raised inner heart facet and angled cut surfaces, and a flat solid back. It suits a glossy jewel-like superhero chest badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the inner raised facet; colour 1 on the upper left outer facets; colour 0 on the bright cut facets. The glossy gem finish only partly follows the scheme; the back is unlit and reads black.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A small faceted teardrop gemstone emblem worn on the upper chest below the collarbone, with a raised flat-topped table, angled cut sides and a flat back. Suggests a jewel-like superhero or sci-fi chest badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top face of the gem; the faceted sides and back show glossy gem-like shading that largely ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A small five-pointed star emblem worn high on the upper chest, made as a thin flat raised plate. Classic golden-age superhero chest badge that sits close against the torso.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Golden_Age_01.differs: The female star is small, thin and flat, sitting high on the upper chest, while the male star is larger, thicker and bulges outward with a ridged, faceted surface.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Golden_Age_02.description: A flat, thin lightning-bolt chest emblem with a stepped zigzag outline and a pointed lower tip, sitting on the upper chest and running diagonally down the torso. Classic retro superhero insignia.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A small round chest emblem shaped like a thick disc with a recessed centre ring, showing a glowing crackling web of energy lines. It sits on the upper chest as a partial mechanical badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material appears to be a glowing energy effect that ignores the colour scheme; no separate slots are distinguishable on the front.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The female emblem has a glowing, web-like energy texture, while the male one is a plain solid disc.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Insignia_01.description: A small round chest emblem shaped like a thick disc with a raised rim, showing an atom symbol of three orbital rings and a nucleus on its face. It sits centred on the upper chest, superhero-style.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rim and the disc sides; colour 1 on the recessed face behind the symbol; colour 0 on the atom symbol.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Light_01.description: A small winged chest emblem worn at the base of the throat: a faceted shield-shaped badge with a central gem flanked by two swept-back feathered wings with raised rims, sitting on the upper chest and collarbone.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the badge face and the wing rims; colour 2 on the wing feathers; colour 3 on the badge's radiating segments and its back edge; colour 1 on the central gem.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A small hollow inverted-triangle chest emblem with a bevelled raised rim and an open centre. It sits at the top of the chest near the collarbone and follows the curve of the torso, suiting a clean superhero look.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the frame; colour 2 on the inner edges and the back of the frame.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Power_01.description: A small oval chest emblem: a raised metal-look rim studded with eight round bolts around a domed central cabochon, with a flat backing plate. It sits on the upper chest, suggesting a mechanical or sci-fi power badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim; colour 1 on the domed centre; colour 2 on the bolts and the flat back.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Prong_01.description: A small chest emblem: a round mechanical socket with a glowing core at the sternum, flanked by two angular bracket-like prongs that sweep outward and up across the upper chest. Suits sci-fi superhero tights.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Prong_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the central socket housing; colour 3 on the inner core; colour 1 on the outer faces of the prongs; colour 0 on the inner edges of the prongs.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Prong_01.differs: The prongs on the female version sit slightly higher and curve around the bust, with a shorter spread.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Prong_02.description: A pair of small angular chevron-shaped emblem blades mounted on the upper chest, each an L-shaped raised prong with a flat top face and thick edges, angled inward toward the sternum. Suggests a mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Prong_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top faces of the prongs; colour 1 on the outer sides and edges; colour 2 on the underside edges.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: A small diamond-shaped chest emblem with a raised, bevelled plate and a round centre inset. Two pairs of curled, hook-like ribbon arms sweep out from either side. Sits at the centre of the upper chest.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bevelled diamond plate; colour 2 on the top and bottom points of the diamond; colour 3 on the centre inset; colour 1 on the curled ribbon arms.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A small diamond-shaped chest emblem: a chunky bevelled frame with a cross of ribs dividing four triangular inset windows. It sits flat at the upper centre of the chest, with a mechanical, superhero look.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and cross ribs; colour 1 on the inset triangular panels behind the ribs.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Sapphire_01.description: A small cluster of seven faceted diamond-shaped gems arranged in a loose diamond pattern on the lower chest and abdomen, standing slightly proud of the surface. A glossy jewel emblem for tight suits.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour slots appear ignored by the glossy gem material; the gems show a single glassy finish, so no slot visibly applies.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_01.description: A small round medal badge with a raised star at its centre and concentric rings, hung from a short two-tailed striped ribbon with notched ends. It sits on the upper chest, tilted along the ribbon line.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the medal face rings; colour 3 on the star and outer rim; colour 1 on the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon stripes and the back of the medal.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_01.differs: The female medal is tilted diagonally on the chest rather than hanging upright.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_02.description: A small medal pinned on the upper chest: a rounded polygonal disc with a raised crown and laurel wreath, hanging by a small ring from a short striped ribbon. Suggests a military honour badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the medal face; colour 3 on the crown, laurel wreath, rim and ribbon bar; colour 1 on the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon stripes; the back of the disc uses colour 1.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_03.description: A small medal-style chest badge: a domed central boss ringed by two raised rims and a scalloped, notched rosette, with a striped ribbon band crossing behind it with swallow-tail ends. Sits on the upper chest.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rosette and dome; colour 3 on the raised rings; colour 1 on the outer edges of the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon's centre stripe.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_04.description: A small hexagonal medal badge with a raised rim, a ring of studs around a central star, and a trio of ribbon tails hanging below. It sits flat on the upper chest as a decorative emblem.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rim, studs and star; colour 0 on the face plate; colour 1 on the outer ribbon tails; colour 2 on the back plate and centre ribbon.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_05.description: A small flat pentagonal badge emblem with a raised rim, an inset panel and a five-lobed flower with a domed centre stud. It sits on the upper left chest, with a plain flat back.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim frame; colour 1 on the inset panel behind the flower; colour 2 on the flower petals and the back; colour 3 on the central dome.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01.description: A small chest emblem of a skull with hollow eye sockets and marked brow lines, a rounded jaw block below, and a pair of thin blade-like wings sweeping outward across the upper chest. Mechanical, occult look.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the outward wing blades; colour 3 on the eye sockets, forehead gem and jaw block; colour 2 on the fine lines on the skull.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01.differs: The female version has only a single pair of plain swept wing blades, without the extra curved claw-like spurs under them.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01_1.description: A small skull emblem worn at the top of the chest, with a jewel-like hexagonal gem hanging below the jaw and a pair of thin swept-out blades extending sideways from behind the skull like wings.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the sideways blades; colour 3 on the hanging gem, the eye sockets and the forehead gem.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01_1.differs: The female version has only one pair of long swept-out blades and lacks the extra small curved spurs found on the male version.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Snowflake_01.description: A small six-armed snowflake emblem of chunky, angular faceted metal, each arm with short side branches, worn flat at the upper centre of the chest like a brooch. Suits icy superhero or sci-fi looks.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Snowflake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faceted arms with a glossy metallic finish; colour 1 on the small inner core; colour 3 on thin edge lines along the arms. The metal finish largely ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Snowflake_01.differs: The snowflake is tilted and sits at a slight angle on the chest, but is otherwise the same design.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Steelhawk_01.description: A flat winged chest emblem shaped like a hawk's outstretched wings, with feather-like slits at each tip, tapering to a point between the breasts. It sits on the upper chest, thin against the body, in a sleek superhero style.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Steelhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole winged emblem.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Sunmoon_01.description: A chest emblem of a contrasting eclipse disc with a crescent inset, ringed by wavy, flame-like sun rays of varying length. It sits flat on the centre of the upper chest, in a superhero style.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Sunmoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the central disc; colour 3 on the crescent inset; colour 1 on the inner part of the rays; colour 0 on the outer edges and rim of the rays.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Teddy_01.description: Two large sewn-style four-hole buttons stacked down the centre of the torso, one between the upper chest and one at the waist. Each has a raised rim and recessed face, giving a playful teddy-like look.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rims and the button backs; colour 1 on the recessed faces; colour 2 on the four thread holes.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Trumpknight_01.description: A small faceted gem-like brooch with a domed top and a pointed, cone-shaped underside, pinned high on the chest near the shoulder. A contrasting band and a small rectangular mark cross the dome.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Trumpknight_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the dome and cone body; colour 0 on the rim edge; colour 2 on the band across the top and the underside facets; colour 3 on the rectangular mark.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Trumpknight_01.differs: The female brooch has a contrasting band and a rectangular mark over the dome, while the male version shows a six-armed star pattern.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Viperlogo_01.description: A chunky raised chest emblem shaped like a snake head, a rounded inverted-triangle plate with cut-out eyes and a fanged, zigzag mouth inset. It sits centred on the upper chest, suggesting a superhero or mechanical look.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised plate and its sides; colour 1 on the recessed eye and fang inset areas.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Wedding_Boutonnier.description: A small formal boutonniere flower pinned on the upper chest: layered angular faceted petals around a contrasting central bud, with a short wrapped stem and two pointed ribbon-like leaves trailing down and outward.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Wedding_Boutonnier.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the petals; colour 2 on the central bud and the small inner petal panels; colour 1 on the stem wrap and trailing leaves; colour 3 as faint blush at the petal bases.

Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Wolf_01.description: A pair of tall, curved blade-like fins rising from the collarbones on either side of the neck, each with a decorative swirl-patterned face and a smooth back. Sweeps up and outward like a flared mechanical collar.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat inner faces of the fins; colour 1 on the swirl motifs; colour 3 on the rim edging; colour 2 on the smooth outer backs.
Female/F_Emblem_Tight_Wolf_01.differs: The female fins stand narrower and more upright, angled close to the neck, with less outward sweep.

Female/F_Emblem_Trooper_01.description: A small chest emblem: a shield-shaped badge with a faceted hexagonal gem at its centre, a layered rim, and swept, spiky wing-like blades extending outward on both sides. It sits high on the chest over a bodysuit.
Female/F_Emblem_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer winged frame; colour 2 on the inner bezel and back plate; colour 3 on the central gem.

Female/F_Emblem_Victory_01.description: A small faceted diamond-shaped chest emblem with a short upper point and a long downward-tapering lower point, standing slightly proud of the body at the upper centre of the chest. Suggests a gem-like superhero badge.
Female/F_Emblem_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper facets; colour 1 fading across the lower facets toward the tip.

Female/F_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_.description: Two thin rectangular service-ribbon bars stacked in parallel on the upper chest, each with vertical stripes of varying widths; flat, slightly raised badges suggesting a military dress jacket.
Female/F_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide light stripes; colour 1 on the stripes; colour 2 on the narrow stripes; colour 3 on the wide stripes.
Female/F_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_.differs: The female bars are tilted slightly along the upper chest, following the body's curve, instead of sitting level.

Female/F_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_.description: Two small rectangular military service ribbon bars, stacked one above the other on the upper left chest, each a thin flat slab with vertical stripes of varying width. Suggests a decorated uniform or jacket.
Female/F_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide light stripes; colour 1 on the stripes; colour 2 on the thin stripes; colour 3 on the broad stripes.

Female/F_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_01.description: A small six-pointed sheriff's star badge with a raised lettered centre and a ball tip on each point, pinned high on the left of the chest. Old-west lawman style.
Female/F_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the star body; colour 3 on the SHERIFF lettering; colour 2 on the ball tips.
Female/F_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_01.differs: The female badge is smaller and sits higher toward the shoulder, tilted to follow the chest.

Female/F_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_02.description: A six-pointed sheriff's star badge with the word SHERIFF embossed across the face and a small round ball tip on each point. It sits on the upper left chest as a western lawman emblem.
Female/F_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the star face; colour 3 on the SHERIFF lettering and small speckles; colour 2 on the ball tips.
Female/F_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_02.differs: The female badge has six points, while the male badge has five.

Female/F_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_03.description: A small sheriff's badge shaped as a five-pointed star with a ball tip on each point and raised SHERIFF lettering across the face. It sits on the upper chest as a western emblem.
Female/F_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the star face; colour 1 on the shading toward the points; colour 3 on the SHERIFF lettering and speckles; colour 2 on the ball tips.
Female/F_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_03.differs: This version is a five-pointed star, while the male version is a six-pointed star.

Female/F_Eye_Birdpeople_01.description: A beaked, helmet-like head shell: a smooth curved plate covers the brow and forehead and narrows into a pointed nose guard, with a thick rim and angular cheek flaps framing the face. Suggests a bird-like mask.
Female/F_Eye_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth outer plate; colour 2 on the rim, cheek flaps and inner shell.

Female/F_Eye_Bonemantis_01.description: A pair of large, rounded bug-eye lenses that sit over the eyes, each a bulging domed lens set in a thick padded rim, with open flat backs. Suggests an insectoid mantis mask or goggles.
Female/F_Eye_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded outer rims; colour 3 on the domed lens faces.

Female/F_Eye_Cardboard_Foxbat_01.description: A flat, thin cardboard cut-out mask held in front of the face: an irregular angular outline with a printed cartoon face of a snarling, grimacing hero with pointed cowl ears and a border around the edge.
Female/F_Eye_Cardboard_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the border around the edge of the cut-out; the printed face artwork ignores the colour scheme and keeps its own fixed painted look.
Female/F_Eye_Cardboard_Foxbat_01.differs: The female cut-out is angled and tilted slightly away from the face, while the male one stands upright close to the face.

Female/F_Eye_Celestial_Halo_01.description: A flat forehead emblem lying against the skull: a small ring at the crown over a slim vertical bar with anchor-like curved ends running down the brow, flanked by a pair of swept feathered wings. Mystic, angelic style.
Female/F_Eye_Celestial_Halo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the halo ring; colour 1 on the two wings; colour 2 on the vertical bar and its curved ends.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Anniversary_Defender_.description: A simple flat, curved mask panel that wraps over the lower half of the face, covering the nose, mouth and chin with angled top edges. Plain retro superhero styling with no visible fastenings.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Anniversary_Defender_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer face of the mask; the inner face shows a lighter sheen from colour 1.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Beast_Spider_01.description: A set of spider-like extra eyes: glossy rounded orbs in graduated sizes across the forehead and upper cheeks, plus a pair of small contrasting horn-like knobs at the temples. Suggests a monstrous arachnid look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Beast_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large and small forehead eyes; colour 3 on the two central lower eyes; colour 1 on the outer lower eyes; colour 2 on the temple knobs.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Beast_Spider_01.differs: The lower eye cluster sits lower on the cheeks, under the eyes, instead of at eye level.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Bonemantis_01.description: A pair of large, rounded insect-style compound eyes: oval domed lenses set in thick padded rims, sitting over the eye sockets and bulging out from the face, with flat, hollow backs.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick rims around each eye; colour 3 on the domed eye lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Cartoon_Bunny_01.description: A pair of oversized cartoon eyeballs that bulge out from the face over each eye, each a rounded contrasting sphere with a large round contrasting pupil opening at the front and a small accent spot. Comical, bug-eyed look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Cartoon_Bunny_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball spheres; colour 2 on the large pupils; colour 1 on the small spots at the lower edge of each pupil.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Chronos_01.description: Slim wraparound-style shades: two flat octagonal lenses in thin angular frames joined by a narrow bridge across the nose, with a short arm at each side. Sits directly over the eyes; sleek, retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Chronos_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the frames, bridge and arms; the lenses stay near-and do not take the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Chronos_02.description: A pair of chunky octagonal goggles with round contrasting lenses, worn pushed up on the forehead above the eyes. Bent tube arms with small connectors run down each side, giving a quirky mechanical look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Chronos_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the octagonal goggle housings; colour 3 on the bent tube arms; colour 0 on the small connectors; colour 2 on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Crow_01.description: A set of extra eyeballs scattered across the head: one on the forehead, two higher on the brow and clusters at each temple, sitting on the skin as a monstrous multi-eyed look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Crow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball whites; colour 1 on the irises.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Demon_01.description: A rigid, angular lower-face mask: a curved plate that wraps from cheek to cheek, covering the nose bridge down to the chin with a pointed lower edge and a thin contrasting rim along the top.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Demon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rim along the upper edge; colour 1 on the main face plate, fading darker toward the top.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Drone_01.description: A pair of short octagonal barrel-shaped eye pieces that sit over each eye like mechanical lenses, with banded ribbing around the tubes and a glowing-looking lens at the front end. Robotic drone look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Drone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel bodies; colour 1 on the thin ring bands; colour 2 on the darker bands and rear edges; colour 3 on the lens faces.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_01.description: Oversized novelty glasses made of two flat heart-shaped lenses that sit over the eyes and flare out past the sides of the face, with no visible frame or arms. Cute, playful eyewear.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole heart-shaped lenses; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_02.description: Oversized translucent wraparound lenses that cover both eyes as one wide shield, sweeping outward into pointed wing-like tips beside the temples. No frame or strap is visible. Sleek, sci-fi shades.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_02.colourAreas: The lenses appear as a single tinted translucent glass surface that does not clearly take any colour slot from the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Sm.description: Small heart-shaped glasses: two flat, translucent angular lenses sit over the eyes, joined across the nose, with no visible frame or arms. Playful, novelty-style eyewear.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Sm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the translucent lenses; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Sm.description: Oversized frameless wraparound lenses: two faceted, angular translucent shades cover the eyes and sweep out to pointed tips at the temples, with no visible frame or arms. Sleek, modern eyewear.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Sm.colourAreas: Colour scheme has little visible effect; the translucent lenses take a single tint, with no separate frame to colour.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Silly_01.description: Comical eye accessory: two long coiled springs stick out forward from the eye sockets like telescoping stalks, each ending in a rounded cap with a small eyeball-like tip. Silly, cartoonish, novelty style.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spring coils; colour 3 on the rounded end caps; colour 1 on the tips at the very end; colour 2 on the small mounting tabs at the back.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glassesaviator_0.description: A pair of aviator-style sunglasses reduced to two rounded, slightly angular lens shapes floating over the eyes, with no visible frame, bridge or arms. Sleek and casual with a classic pilot look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glassesaviator_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both lenses, glossy and unaffected by the other slots; the inner faces catch a gradient sheen.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Glassesaviator_0.differs: The female lenses sit as a single flat layer over the eyes.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Googly_01.description: Two flat, round disc-shaped pads that sit on the face just below and outside the eyes, like oversized cartoon googly eyes or cheek stickers. They are simple, smooth and thin, with no other detail.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Face_Googly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both discs; the back faces show the same slot.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Full_Dino_01.description: A pair of small round, octagon-edged discs mounted on either side of the head near the temples, each with a domed centre lens and a raised rim. They read as tech sensor pods or ear-mounted lights.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Full_Dino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer casings; colour 1 on the recessed centre lens of each disc.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Glasses_Spy_01.description: A pair of round, translucent tinted lenses floating in front of the eyes, with no visible frame, bridge or arms. Reads as simple spy-style round sunglasses.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Glasses_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the lens faces; no other features take a colour slot.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Glasses_Spy_01.differs: The female lenses are darker and more opaque, and there is no visible thin arm at the temple.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Gogglesbubble_02.description: A pair of separate rounded bubble lenses that sit directly over the eyes, with no frame or strap. They curve slightly around the sides of the face, giving an insectlike or alien look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Gogglesbubble_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lens surfaces, fading to darker edges; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Gogglesbubble_03.description: Two small rounded bubble lenses sitting side by side on the forehead, like goggles pushed up on the head, with no visible strap or frame. A small, cute, monstrous or mechanical look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Gogglesbubble_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lens domes; colour 2 on the darker rims and edges of each lens.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Head_Bucket_01.description: A pair of chunky, separate octagonal bucket-shaped eye cylinders worn over the eyes. One has a slatted vent grille, the other a glowing lens; small pegs stick out around each rim. Robotic, toy-like look.
