Female/F_Eye_Child_Head_Bucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bucket housings; colour 1 on the small pegs; colour 2 on the vent grille interior; colour 3 on the round lens.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Mask_Animatronic_01.description: A mechanical lower-face and jaw guard with a segmented toothed plate across the mouth and upright side struts, plus floating angular blade-like horns and a chevron brow piece above the eyes. Suggests robotic or monstrous style.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Mask_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the horns, brow chevron and side struts; colour 2 on the jaw housing; colour 0 on the segmented mouth plates; colour 3 on the small lights.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Mask_Lion_01.description: A pair of pointed, lion-style ears that sit on the upper sides of the head. Each is a cupped, angular shell with a striped inner face, giving a beastly, animal-costume look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Mask_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rims of the ears; colour 1 and colour 2 on the alternating stripes of the inner ear faces.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Mask_Rustbucket_01.description: A pair of bulging, faceted cup-shaped eye housings that sit over each eye, each with a round lens disc bearing an upward arrow. A mechanical, cartoonish look suggesting a robot or junk-built mask.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Mask_Rustbucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted housings; colour 1 on the round lens discs; colour 2 on the arrow symbols.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A pair of separate angular eye shields, each a flat, swept-up wedge that covers the eye area with a raised, bevelled upper edge. They sit on the face like slim visor lenses, with a sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised upper rims; colour 2 on the main lens panels. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr1eyes_01.description: A single large cyclops eyeball that replaces the eyes, placed over the bridge of the nose. It is a hollow rounded shell with a faceted rim, a round iris and a contrasting pupil.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr1eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball and rim; colour 1 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr2eyes_01.description: Two large round eyeballs with a rim of lid-like contrasting shell, mounted on the sides of the face beside the cheeks and facing forward. A monstrous, alien extra-eye look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr2eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and shell; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr3eyes_01.description: Three separate hollow eyeball shells floating in front of the face: one over the nose bridge and one beside each cheek, each with a rounded rim and a central pupil. An alien, monstrous replacement for the normal eyes.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr3eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and outer shell of each eyeball; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr4eyes_01.description: Four extra eyeballs floating beside the face: a large pair on the cheeks and a smaller pair above them near the temples, each a rounded socket rim with an iris and pupil. A monstrous alien look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr4eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball whites and socket rims; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr_8eyes_01.description: Eight small faceted eyeballs in two clusters of four, one cluster on each side of the face beside the temples and cheeks, each with a round pupil facing outward. A monstrous, alien extra-eye face addition.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Qularr_8eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyeballs' irises; colour 0 on the whites of the eyes; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Scuba_01.description: A wide, wraparound visor band that covers the eyes and brow in one piece. It has a V-notched top edge, angular faceted sides and a smooth curve that runs around the head to the ears. Suits sleek sci-fi or superhero looks.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Scuba_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor band; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Scuba_02.description: A snorkel-style breathing tube: a rigid vertical pipe rising beside the head with a capped top, bending under the jaw into a ribbed flexible hose that curves up to the mouth. Reads as scuba or diving gear.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Scuba_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rigid tube; colour 3 on the top cap; colour 2 on the ribbed mouth hose; colour 1 on the small ring at the bend.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Starhawk_01.description: A thin, curved domino-style eye mask: a single winged shape with pointed upper outer corners and a notched bridge over the nose, wrapping the eyes and temples. Superhero style.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mask; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Starhawk_02.description: A wraparound visor-style eye piece: a single smooth, angular shield with a V-shaped dip over the nose and upswept pointed ends that curve back toward the temples. Suggests a sleek sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor; the glossy default material looks mostly unaffected by the other slots.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Swing_01.description: A pair of small oval lenses floating in front of the eyes with no frames, bridge or arms. They read as simple rimless glasses or monocle-like discs, translucent and slightly tilted.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Swing_01.colourAreas: Default material looks glassy and translucent, so it mostly ignores the colour scheme; no slot is clearly visible on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.description: A wraparound visor-style eye band: a single angular, faceted glossy strip that spans both eyes and curves around the sides of the head toward the temples. Sleek, futuristic shades.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour scheme appears ignored by the glossy default material; the whole band shows a glossy finish with no distinct slot areas.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Mask_Skull_01.description: A pair of flat, angular eye patches shaped like skull eye sockets, each with a pointed spike at the outer upper corner. They sit directly over the eyes and give a menacing masked look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Mask_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on both eye patches; the left patch appears in a darker shade from shading only.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Mask_Zorran_01.description: A pair of ridged ram-like horns that curl out from the sides of the head, sweeping back and around in a spiral with tapering tips. Suits beastly, demonic or fantasy characters.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Mask_Zorran_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged outer body of each horn; colour 1 on the tapering tips and inner curl.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Sharp_01.description: A thin, angular visor-style eye mask forming a single sharp winged band across both eyes, with a dipped centre over the nose and long points sweeping up and out at the temples. Suggests a sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Sharp_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole mask, fading toward a darker shade at the lower edge; other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Ski_01.description: A wraparound ski goggle visor: a single curved glossy lens shield with a thin rim and a notched nose cutout. It sits pushed up on the forehead and wraps toward the temples. Sporty, sleek look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Ski_01.colourAreas: The glossy lens takes on a reflective sheen and mostly ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on the upper edge and colour 3 as a slight tint inside the lens.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Ski_02.description: Wide wraparound ski goggles with a single glossy visor lens in a thick moulded rim, curving around the eyes from temple to temple with a nose cutout. Sits over the eyes, sleek and sporty.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Ski_02.colourAreas: The glossy visor and rim ignore the colour scheme, showing a fixed glossy finish; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_01.description: A wraparound visor band of faceted, angular glass that covers both eyes in one continuous strip, with peaked upswept corners above the outer eyes and a slight dip at the nose bridge. Sleek sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: The whole visor is glossy glass that largely ignores the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_02.description: A thin, angular visor-like slit that spans both eyes in a shallow V, sitting flat across the brow line. It has a sharp bevelled edge and no strap, suggesting a sleek tactical or sci-fi eyepiece.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole slit band; the glossy material appears to largely ignore the other colour slots.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_02.differs: The female version has a more pronounced V dip at the centre over the nose bridge.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_03.description: A pair of small, flat, angular visor slats floating just under the eyes, each a slim tapered wedge with chamfered ends that angles outward. Suggests a minimal tactical or sci-fi eye accessory.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both slats; the material looks glossy and shows little of the other colour slots.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_04.description: A slim angular visor bar that spans both eyes as a single band, with a faceted V-shaped dip at the centre over the nose bridge and tapered wrap-around ends. It reads as a sleek sci-fi or tactical eyepiece.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor band; the glossy metallic finish appears to ignore the other colour slots.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_04.differs: The female visor has a shallow centre dip with the top edge running nearly straight across, while the male has a deeper upward-pointing notch at the centre.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_01.description: A curved, shield-like face plate that wraps from cheek to cheek, covering the face from brow to chin with a pointed lower edge and a swept-up brow line. It has a pixelated angry-eye pattern and a small stitched mouth mark on the front.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the pixelated eye shapes; colour 2 on the mouth line.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_03.description: A single curved, blade-like plate that sweeps from beside the nose out over the cheekbone and eye, tapering to a point toward the temple. It suggests a beastly or armored face guard.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the plate; colour 1 on the inner surface facing the face.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_04.description: A sleek mechanical face mask covering the eyes, nose and mouth in a tapered, beak-like shape, with angular swept-back wings at the temples, a raised rim, angled eye slashes and a jagged zigzag mouth line.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the raised rim along the brow and edges; colour 3 on the angled eye markings; colour 2 on the jagged mouth line.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_06.description: A pair of flat, round disc lenses floating in front of each eye, with thin bevelled edges and no frame or strap. They give a blank, mechanical eye-cover look.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both discs; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Alt_01.description: A pair of long, sharp conical spikes that jut up and outward from the sides of the head above the ears, like pointed horns or blades. They suggest a fantasy or monstrous helm.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; the default material appears metallic and largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Alt_04.description: A headband with two tall pointed ears rising from the top of the head. Each ear has a thick angular frame with cross struts around an inset panel, and a solid wedge back. Suggests a feline or beast helmet.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Alt_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frames, struts and headband; colour 1 on the solid rear wedges of the ears; colour 3 on the inset panels inside the frames.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_01.description: A faint glowing eye accessory: rows of tiny, thin tick-like marks arcing along the brow and upper cheek line on either side of the eyes, like delicate runic or stitched markings.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glowing marks; the default glow material appears to ignore the other colour slots.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_01.differs: The female version sits around the eyes and brow, while the male version sits along the jaw and chin.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_04.description: An eye accessory that appears to add nothing visible on this body: the face shows only the bare head with no glow, overlay or attachment in any view.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_04.colourAreas: No visible features take any colour slot on this sheet.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_04.differs: The female version shows nothing visible, while the male version displays a floating cloud of glowing binary digits across the lower face.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Werewolf_01.description: A pair of jagged, swept-back tufts on either side of the forehead and temples, with serrated spiky edges. They read as a feral werewolf-style brow or hairline that leaves the rest of the head bare.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both tufts; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Eye_Child_Werewolf_02.description: A pair of swept-back tufts of fur that sit on the temples and the sides of the forehead, each made of layered, pointed locks that flare outward like a bushy werewolf brow.
Female/F_Eye_Child_Werewolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bulk of the fur tufts; colour 0 on the tips and lower edges of the locks.

Female/F_Eye_Chronos_01.description: A wraparound visor mask with a swept, winged upper edge, curving from temple to temple over the eyes, with octagonal framed eye slots. A pair of small octagonal goggle lenses on wire arms sits above the brow.
Female/F_Eye_Chronos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the visor shell; colour 3 on the eye-slot rims and the wire arms; colour 1 on the raised goggle housings; colour 2 on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Corrupted_01.description: A crown-like eye mask of jagged, curved thorn blades that sweep up from the brow and cheeks, with a central spike over the forehead and outer barbs flaring sideways. Monstrous, angular and spiky.
Female/F_Eye_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall inner thorns; colour 1 on the middle curved blades; colour 2 on the outer flared barbs; colour 3 on the central forehead spike.

Female/F_Eye_Cosmos_01.description: A large angular visor-helm shaped like a wide inverted triangle, covering the eyes and forehead and flaring out past the head. Its front has a raised central panel with radiating stripe ribs, and a deep shell wraps behind.
Female/F_Eye_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide outer plates and stripes; colour 1 on the central raised panel; colour 3 on the raised ribs and back centre lines; colour 2 on the underside shell.

Female/F_Eye_Crimson_01.description: A fantasy eye mask formed of swept, thorn-like metal filaments that curl around the brow and cheeks, with a pointed nose bridge and a pair of tall curved horns rising from the forehead.
Female/F_Eye_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow and cheek filigree and nose bridge; colour 1 on the two tall curved horns.

Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Sciencegroupfemalesu.description: Bug-eye goggles made of two large, smooth, rounded lens pods that sit over each eye. They have faceted edges, no visible strap, and a bulbous insect-like look suited to cyborg or sci-fi designs.
Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Sciencegroupfemalesu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both lens pods; no other colour slots are visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_01.description: A faceted, angular mask plate covering the eyes, nose bridge and upper cheeks, with two narrow eye slits and a pointed nose ridge. Its side wings wrap toward the temples. Sleek cyborg look.
Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and nose ridge; colour 1 on the side wings at the temples and cheeks.

Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_03.description: A robotic eyeplate visor: a angular, wedge-shaped faceplate across the eyes and nose bridge with a recessed slit, side plates, and hanging wire-like contrasting strands along the cheeks and below the nose.
Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faceplate; colour 3 on the inner slit; colour 1 on the edge trim and side plates; colour 2 on the hanging wires.
Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_03.differs: The female version has long contrasting wire strands hanging down the cheeks, where the male has broad side plates instead.

Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_04.description: A robotic face plate covering the eyes and nose bridge: a broad angular brow with a narrow slit glowing under it, side cheek plates swept back toward the temples, and a small slotted grille below the nose.
Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face plate and brow; colour 1 on the side cheek plates; colour 3 on the eye slit; colour 2 on the mouth grille bars.
Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_04.differs: The female version is a wide single visor with a horizontal eye slit and contrasting side cheek plates, while the male version has two separate round eyes, a contrasting forehead plate and dangling jaw pistons.

Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_05.description: A robotic eye-mask plate covering the brow, eyes and nose bridge with angular faceted shells, glowing eye slits, dangling claw-like cheek pieces and a tall angular fin rising up the forehead. Sits on the face in a sci-fi cyborg style.
Female/F_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face plate and cheek pieces; colour 1 on the forehead fin; colour 2 on the joint at the nose and the cheek pieces' inner gaps; colour 3 on the eye lights.

Female/F_Eye_Datareaper_01.description: A angular face mask covering the nose, mouth and chin, with a faceted front plate, a single round lens-like port at the centre, side jaw plates and a segmented chin guard. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Female/F_Eye_Datareaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main front plate; colour 0 on the side jaw plates and chin band; colour 2 on the chin guard and inner port; colour 3 on the rings of the round port.

Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Both_01.description: A pair of small atom-shaped emblems, each made of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, placed flat on each cheek below the eyes like face decals.
Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Both_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 2 on the outlines and nucleus edges.

Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Both_02.description: A pair of small atom-style emblems, each made of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, placed flat on each cheek below the eyes like face decals.
Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Both_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 2 on the thin outline edging and nucleus detail.

Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Both_03.description: A pair of small atom-shaped emblems, each with three looping elliptical orbits around a central ring, placed flat on the cheeks below the eyes like face decals or markings.
Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Both_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit outlines; colour 1 on the inner fill of the orbits and central ring; colour 2 on the thin edge outlines.

Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Facemask_02.description: A flat, thin atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a small central ring, sitting flush on the centre of the forehead like a decal or brand.
Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Facemask_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and centre ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging around the rings.

Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Left_01.description: A flat atom-symbol emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a small central nucleus, applied like a decal on the left cheek below the eye. Suggests a science or superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Left_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin outline and the nucleus ring.

Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Left_02.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central nucleus, applied like a decal or tattoo on the left cheek below the eye. It has no relief and sits flush with the skin.
Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Left_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the outlines and the central nucleus.

Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Right_01.description: A small atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central ring, sitting flat on the cheek below the right eye like a raised decal or tattoo. Suggests a sci-fi or science-themed face mark.
Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Right_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin outline edges of the rings.

Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Right_02.description: A small atom-style emblem on the right cheek: three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, raised like thin wire loops. It sits on the cheek below the eye and suggests a sci-fi or scientific look.
Female/F_Eye_Emblem_Right_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the rings; colour 1 on the thin edge outline of the rings.

Female/F_Eye_Extra_Googly_01.description: A pair of oversized, domed disc lenses sitting in front of the eyes, glossy and slightly convex on the front with hollow dish backs. A comical, cartoonish googly-eye look that suggests a goofy monster or mechanical mask.
Female/F_Eye_Extra_Googly_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material appears to ignore the colour scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on the discs.

Female/F_Eye_Extra_Mask_Animatronic_01.description: Pair of mechanical lens goggles: two separate octagonal housings sit over the eyes, each with a ribbed cylindrical lens barrel and a small glowing-style central pupil. There is no strap, so they float on the face like animatronic eyes.
Female/F_Eye_Extra_Mask_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular outer housings; colour 1 on the ribbed barrel rings; colour 2 on the lens interior; colour 3 on the central pupils.

Female/F_Eye_Extra_Mask_Lion_01.description: A flat, thin forehead emblem shaped like an atom symbol: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central ring, sitting on the brow as a decal-like ornament rather than a mask.
Female/F_Eye_Extra_Mask_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main orbit lines and centre ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the lines.

Female/F_Eye_Extra_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.description: A small headset-style communicator: a pair of flat angular plates sits by the temple and cheek, with a thin cable curving down along the jaw to a small boxy microphone tip near the mouth.
Female/F_Eye_Extra_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the temple plates; colour 1 on the cable; colour 2 on the microphone tip.

Female/F_Eye_Face_90s_Mask_01.description: A angular plated half-helmet mask covering the forehead, brow, nose and cheeks with narrow eye slits and a notched top edge. Separate side cheek plates and a chin piece give it a sleek retro superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_90s_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face plate; colour 1 on the side cheek panels; colour 2 on the chin piece.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Aquatic_01.description: A fantasy helmet with a segmented fin-like crest running front to back, angular cheek guards and pointed swept-out ear fins. It leaves the face open and covers the sides and back of the head, with an open gap at the rear.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented crest; colour 2 on the brow band under the crest; colour 3 on the main side and back shell; colour 0 on the cheek guards and outer ear fins.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Aquatic_01.differs: The female helmet has a wider open gap at the back of the head, showing more of the head, where the male shell is closed around a T-shaped opening.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Aquatic_02.description: A face-framing aquatic mask-helm with a tall central crest fin, swept-up finned cheek plates with ridged edges, a gem at the brow, and a pointed chin guard. It leaves the eyes, nose and mouth open and sits over the forehead and cheeks.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek fins and the rounded crown plate; colour 1 on the central crest, the upper fin edges and the chin point; colour 3 on the brow gem; colour 2 in the small shadowed recesses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Blindfold_Large_01.description: A wide cloth blindfold wrapped around the head across the eyes, with soft wrinkled folds. It is knotted at the back of the head with two hanging tail ends, and a small extra knot sits at the front of the forehead.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Blindfold_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire blindfold, including the knots and hanging ends.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Blindfold_Small_01.description: A wide cloth blindfold band wrapping around the head across the eyes, with gathered creases over the nose and a smooth strip continuing around the back of the head. Simple, plain and sleek.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Blindfold_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Blockbuster_01.description: A wide, angular band-style visor mask wrapping across the eyes, with a V-shaped upper edge, pointed upswept outer corners and a dipped nose bridge. It sits flat against the face and reaches back toward the temples, giving a bold superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole mask; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Blockbuster_02.description: A wide, wraparound visor-style eye mask with a shallow V-shaped brow, covering both eyes in one smooth angular shell and reaching back to the temples, with a thin contrasting rim along the edges.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin rim trim along the edges; colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Child_Deity_02.description: A wide, angular visor band that sweeps across the eyes in a shallow V, with upswept pointed tips at each temple and a pointed centre dipping toward the nose. It is a smooth, glossy single piece with no strap.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Child_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor band; the glossy default material shows little response to the other colour slots.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_01.description: Round, slightly faceted glasses lenses floating over each eye, with a tiny round disc at each temple where arms would join. No visible frame, bridge or arms; a minimal, casual bookish accessory.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lenses and temple discs; the material appears translucent glassy and largely ignores the other slots.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_02.description: A pair of round, translucent tinted lenses that sit directly over the eyes, with no visible frame, arms or bridge. Simple, lightweight eyewear suited to casual or sci-fi looks.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the lens faces seen from behind; the lenses look tinted and translucent, so the scheme shows only faintly from the front.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_03.description: A pair of round, rimless lenses, each a flat translucent disc sitting directly in front of the eyes, with no visible frame, bridge or arms. A simple, light eyewear accessory.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens discs, which read as tinted translucent glass; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Coal_01.description: A pair of chunky, faceted rock-like lumps that sit directly over each eye, hiding the eyes completely. They have rough, cracked surfaces and angular edges, giving a monstrous, stony look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Coal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lumps' whole surface; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Cosmic_01.description: A thin angular forehead ornament made of two mirrored bracket shapes around a small central cube, with antler-like arms sweeping up and outward to notched tips. Sits flat on the brow like a sci-fi circlet.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main arms; colour 1 on the inner hexagonal frames and inner edges; colour 3 on the small inner edge strips; colour 0 on the central cube and arm tips.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Cosmic_01.differs: The female version has a joined hexagonal central frame with darker arm tips, while the male version is split into two separate halves with light-coloured arm tips.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Deal_Glasses_01.description: Blocky pixelated novelty sunglasses: a single wide, flat lens band with stepped, stair-cut lower edges and a pixel-mosaic pattern over each eye, held by thin curved temple arms that hook over the ears.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Deal_Glasses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens frame band; colour 3 on the pixel pattern over one eye; colour 2 on the pixel pattern over the other eye; colour 1 on the temple arms.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_01.description: A rigid angular brow mask forming a broad V across the eyes, with a pointed centre dipping over the nose bridge and two tall pointed horns rising at the temples. It wraps slightly around the sides of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central V-shaped band; colour 1 on the upward temple points and blending into the upper edges; colour 2 on the rim edging and the inner back surface.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_02.description: A wide, chevron-shaped visor band that wraps across the eyes with a V-point dipping over the nose bridge and edges swept up at the temples. Smooth, thin, angular shield with a slim rim.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer front face of the visor; colour 1 on the inner surface; colour 2 on the thin rim edge.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_03.description: A thin, angular headpiece shaped like a wide V across the forehead with two tall pointed horn-like tips, and side plates that curve down past the temples and cheeks, leaving the eyes and face open.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer front face of the V and side plates; colour 0 on the inner and back surfaces; colour 2 on the thin edge outline.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_04.description: An angular half-helmet with two tall swept-up fins at the crown, faceted side plates and a pointed brow visor over the eyes; a glossy lens band sits under the brow and a small chevron plate covers the back of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the chevron plate; colour 1 on the band under the brow; colour 2 on the eye lens area and inner visor.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_05.description: An angular metal half-mask with narrow slanted eye openings and two tall, curved horn-like spikes rising over the forehead. Thin fins sweep back along the temples, giving a monstrous, sci-fi deity look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask plates and horns; colour 1 on the rear fins and inner edges of the horns; colour 2 on the outlines and edging; colour 3 on the eye glow inside the openings.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_06.description: A horned half-mask with a swept brow plate, angular eye openings with glowing lenses, two tall curved horns rising from the forehead, and a pointed lower jaw guard that frames the cheeks and chin.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Deity_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow plate and eye surround; colour 2 on the horns and forehead section; colour 1 on the lower jaw guard; colour 3 on the eye lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor.description: A face emblem shaped like an atom: three interlocking elliptical rings orbiting a small central ring, laid as a thin flat overlay across the eyes, nose and cheeks. Sci-fi, open-framed and lightweight.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the outlines and edging of the rings.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor.description: A face emblem shaped like an atom: three interlocking elliptical rings orbit a small central ring, overlaid on the face from forehead to chin. It is a thin, open, curved band that wraps the face without covering it.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the thin edge outlines along the rings.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor.description: A face emblem shaped like an atom: three interlocking elliptical rings around a central hexagon and ring, curving over the eyes, nose and cheeks like an open-work mask. It suggests a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the outlines and edging of the rings and the small floating marks near the temples and brow.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor.differs: The female version is smaller and sits over the eyes and nose, with the rings kept narrower and not reaching as far up the forehead or down the chin.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Emblem_Faceless_01.description: A face-covering emblem shaped like an atom symbol: three interlocking elliptical rings and a small central ring form an open lattice that curves over the nose, cheeks and mouth, leaving the eyes clear.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Emblem_Faceless_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the thin outer edging of the rings; the other slots are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_01.description: A pair of thin, blade-like eye accessories forming a spiky winged mask around the eyes, with jagged points sweeping up over the brows and out to the temples, and long curved tapering blades sweeping down the cheeks.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper brow and temple blades; colour 2 on the inner brow points over the eyes; colour 1 on the lower cheek blades.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_L_01.description: A flat, angular eye accessory of jagged blade-like shards fanning up and out over the left eye and brow, with a long tapering spike sweeping down the cheek. Suggests a fantasy or monstrous face ornament.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_L_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate, fading toward colour 1 at the cheek spike; colour 2 on the inner blade over the eye.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_L_01.differs: The female version's main plate is lighter, with a separate contrasting inner blade over the eye, while the male plate is mostly dark.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_R_01.description: A flat, bladed face ornament on the right side of the face: jagged swept-back spikes around the eye, a curved blade over the brow and a long tapering blade down the cheek. Sleek, sharp and monstrous or mechanical in feel.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_R_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and upper spikes; colour 1 on the cheek blade edge and inner trim; colour 2 on the curved brow blade.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_01.description: A simple pirate-style eye patch: a small rounded cloth pad over the left eye, held by a thin strap that runs around the head. The strap is thin and sits at brow height.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the patch pad and the strap.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_01.differs: The strap only crosses the front and sides of the head in a mostly straight band with no second strap, unlike the male version with two straps.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_02.description: A simple pirate-style eye patch covering the right eye, held by a thin strap that slants across the forehead and around the back of the head. It is a small, plain accessory.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the patch and strap.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_02.differs: The female strap is a single band that runs behind the head, while the male version adds a second strap that loops higher over the head and a patch-like piece at the back of the head.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_L_02.description: A pirate-style eyepatch covering the left eye, held by two thin crossing straps that loop around the head, one over the forehead and one lower across the back. The patch is a small rounded shield with a raised rim.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_L_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the two head straps; colour 1 on the rim and back edge of the patch; colour 0 on the front face of the patch.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_R_02.description: A pirate-style eye patch: a small rounded oval pad with a contrasting rim covers the right eye, held by two crossed thin straps that wrap around the head, one passing over the forehead and one lower at the back.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_R_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the straps; colour 0 on the front of the patch pad; colour 1 on the patch rim and its back side.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeplatel_01.description: A small curved eyeplate that covers one eye socket: an oval shell with a thick rim and a narrow almond-shaped opening at the centre. It sits flush over the eye and suggests a mechanical or cybernetic look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeplatel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 2 on the thick outer rim; colour 1 on the inner eye opening.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeplater_01.description: A curved eyeplate that covers the right eye socket: a rounded, slightly angular shell with a thick rim and an oval eye opening at its centre. It sits over the eye and cheek, suggesting a mechanical or monstrous look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Eyeplater_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 2 on the thick outer rim; colour 1 on the inner eye opening and the lining around it.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Faceless_01.description: A smooth, egg-shaped shell mask that covers the whole face from forehead to chin, hollow behind, with an embossed atom-like orbital emblem on the front and thin curved lines around the lower edge.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Faceless_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and the raised orbital emblem; colour 1 on the fine line details above the emblem and the inner upper curve; colour 2 on the inner middle line; colour 3 on the lower line near the chin.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesbubb.description: Chunky wraparound goggles with a faceted, angular frame and a raised brow ridge. Two rounded lens bubbles sit over the eyes and the frame curves back to the temples. A utilitarian, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesbubb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and brow ridge; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 2 on the inner rim edge.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesplat.description: A pair of wide goggles with a thick, rounded frame that wraps around the eyes, joined by a narrow bridge. They sit across the upper face and curve back toward the temples. Suits a superhero or sci-fi helmet look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesplat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 3 on the bridge between the lenses; colour 2 on the thin rim around the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesspor.description: A wraparound sport visor: a single wide curved shield spans both eyes and the nose bridge, with a thick angular brow rim on top and boxy blocks at each temple. Sleek, sporty and sci-fi in style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesspor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow rim and temple blocks; colour 1 on the main visor shield.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Holohex_01.description: A pair of floating angular panels that hover beside the face, one on each side of the head. Each is a faceted slab with small fin-like blocks at its top and rear, giving a holographic sci-fi look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole piece; the material appears to ignore the other colour slots, so slots 1, 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_01.description: Slim wraparound sunglasses with narrow rectangular tinted lenses in a thin angular frame, a short nose bridge and slender arms that hook over the ears. A sleek, modern everyday look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; colour 1 on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_02.description: Standard wraparound-style glasses with slim angular rectangular frames, tinted lenses and a bridge across the nose. Thin arms run back along the temples to the ears. A casual, everyday look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; colour 1 on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_04.description: Small round glasses with slightly faceted, octagonal lenses in thin rims joined by a slim nose bridge, with thin temple arms that curve down at the tips and rest over the ears.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and temple arms; colour 1 on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_01.description: Oversized novelty glasses with two heart-shaped frames and translucent tinted lenses, joined by a slim bridge over the nose, with flat angled arms running back over the ears. Playful, cute party style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the heart frames; colour 0 on the temple arms; colour 2 on the nose bridge; the lenses are tinted translucent and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_02.description: Oversized retro-style glasses with a thick rounded frame, wide tinted lenses that sweep up slightly at the outer corners, and slim angled arms that hook back over the ears.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the frame around the lenses; colour 0 on the temple arms; the lenses are tinted glass and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Small_01.description: Oversized heart-shaped glasses with thin rims, tinted translucent lenses, a slim bridge between the two hearts and straight arms running back over the ears. A playful, novelty look worn across the eyes.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the heart rims; colour 0 on the arms; colour 2 on the bridge; the lenses are a tinted translucent material that ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Small_02.description: Oversized cat-eye style glasses with thick rounded frames, tinted translucent lenses and slim straight arms with a downward bend at the ends, resting on the nose and over the ears. Casual, retro look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Small_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the frames around the lenses; colour 0 on the temple arms; the lenses are a tinted translucent material that ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Rim_01.description: Round wire-rimmed glasses with polygonal rims, tinted translucent lenses and a thin bridge, with small ring-shaped loops at the outer edges in place of temple arms. Sits on the nose and eyes; a quirky retro or scholarly look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Rim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the outer side rings; colour 2 on the nose bridge. The lenses are translucent and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Rim_02.description: Round wire-style glasses with two many-sided rims holding tinted lenses, joined by a thin bridge across the nose. No arms are visible. They sit at the eyes and suggest a scholarly, retro look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Rim_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 2 on the nose bridge; the lenses are translucent and ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Silly_01.description: Novelty glasses with a thick rounded frame and long arms, from which two coiled springs stick out far in front of the face, each ending in a domed googly eyeball cap.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glasses_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; colour 0 on the coiled springs; colour 3 on the rims of the eyeball caps; colour 1 on the centres of the eyeballs.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glassesaviator_01.description: Classic aviator glasses with two rounded, angular-cornered lenses joined by a thin double bridge, slim temple arms that curve down behind the ears, and a thin rim. Sits across the eyes in a casual, retro style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glassesaviator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame rims, bridge and temple arms; colour 1 on the lenses, which shade to a darker gradient.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glassesaviator_02.description: Aviator-style sunglasses with two rounded teardrop lenses in thin rims, a double bridge bar across the top, and slim temple arms that run back over the ears. Worn on the eyes as a casual accessory.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glassesaviator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the upper bridge bar; colour 2 on the temple arms; the lenses are glossy and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Glorious_Mask_01.description: A fantasy half-helmet mask covering the forehead, temples and back of the head, with two tall curved horn-like points rising at the sides, a V-shaped brow and raised trim lines across the front. It leaves the face open through a heart-shaped cut-out.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Glorious_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the lower edge of the shell as a gradient; colour 3 on the raised brow lines and top rim; colour 2 on the edging around the face opening.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Gogglesdown_01.description: Chunky round goggles with two octagonal rimmed lens housings worn over the eyes, joined by a short bridge and held by a flat padded strap that wraps around the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Gogglesdown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings and strap; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 2 on the strap edges.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Gogglesup_01.description: A pair of round, chunky goggles pushed up onto the forehead, with two rounded octagonal rims and domed lenses, joined by a narrow bridge and held by a flat strap that wraps around the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Gogglesup_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle rims and strap; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 2 on the strap edging and inner shading.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Golden_Age_02.description: A domino-style superhero eye mask with a wide V-shaped brow and jagged lightning-bolt points sweeping out and up at each temple, with angular eye openings and a thin contrasting edge outline, worn flat across the eyes.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Golden_Age_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the thin edge outline and the borders around the eye openings.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Googly_01.description: A pair of large, round, domed disc eyes that sit over the eyes like oversized googly eyes, with a glossy front lens and a flat, matte back. Comical, cartoonish monster look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Googly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat backs of the discs; the glossy domed fronts ignore the scheme and show a reflective finish.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Holoforce_01.description: Two angular, shield-like eye patches that flare outward and up at the outer edges and taper to points beside the nose, like a sharp domino mask. Shown as crackling energy with a web of glowing veins.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material is a glowing energy effect that ignores the colour scheme; no slot visibly takes a colour on this sheet.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Holoforce_01.differs: This version renders as glowing crackling energy that ignores the colour scheme, whereas the male version is solid and takes the colours.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Ice_01.description: A pair of jagged ice-crystal rims that ring each eye, with a fringe of small spikes on the brow edge and longer shards flaring outward at the outer corners. Frosty, monstrous eye decoration.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Ice_01.colourAreas: The piece appears mostly with a mottled frosty texture and does not clearly take the colour slots; no colour slot is clearly visible.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Ice_01.differs: The female version has finer, shorter brow spikes and thinner rims, with the long shards only at the outer corners.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Ice_02.description: Decorative eye surrounds: a ring of jagged, icy frost shards outlining each eye, with longer feathery spikes flaring outward at the outer corners and a few small diamond-shaped crystals dotted beneath each eye.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Ice_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frost rims, spikes and crystals; the inner rim texture has a glinting, metallic-looking sheen that seems to ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Ice_03.description: Decorative eye surrounds of jagged, icicle-like shards that sweep outward and upward from each eye, with a small textured rim along the lash line. They sit flat around the eyes as a frosty, monstrous makeup effect.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Ice_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jagged shards around the eyes; the small textured rim along the lash line does not visibly follow the scheme.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Ice_03.differs: The female shards flare higher and more feathery at the outer corners, with slightly longer upward sweeps.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Madjester_01.description: A half-face carnival mask covering the brow, eyes and cheeks, with a long curved beak-like nose that sweeps down and outward. It has eye holes, painted vertical slashes and round dots beside the eyes; a theatrical jester or plague-doctor style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell; colour 3 on the vertical slash markings by the eyes; colour 2 on the round dots; colour 1 on the tip of the beak, fading in from the shell.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_01.description: A simple domino-style eye mask: a thin, smooth shell with two eye openings joined over the nose bridge, sweeping up at the outer corners and wrapping to the temples. Classic masked-hero look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper and outer parts of the mask; colour 0 on the lower cheek and nose-bridge area, blending between the two.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_02.description: A domino-style eye mask with two eye openings, swept-up pointed wings at the brow corners and a V-shaped dip over the nose bridge. It hugs the upper face and reaches the temples, in a classic superhero style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper brow wings and outer mask surface; colour 0 on the lower edge below the eyes and around the eye openings.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_03.description: A thin, flat domino-style eye mask with two eye openings and pointed, upswept outer corners that slant sharply upward. It sits close on the face across the brow and nose bridge, giving a classic masked-hero look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper outer areas of the mask; colour 0 on the lower edge around the eyes.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_04.description: A thin, flat domino-style eye mask with two large eye openings joined by a narrow nose bridge. Pointed upswept tips rise at the outer corners, and a shallow point dips below each eye. Sits close on the face in a superhero style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer edges and upswept tips of the mask; colour 0 on the nose bridge and lower rim around the eyes.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_05.description: A thin, open domino-style eye mask: a V-shaped brow band across the forehead that wraps around the head, with sharp pointed spikes dropping down beside each eye and no covering over the eyes or nose.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole mask band and points; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_06.description: A thin, open-faced domino-style mask: a curved band wraps across the brow and down past the eyes to the cheeks, with tall swept-up points at each temple. The eyes are left open. Superhero style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_06.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mask band and its upswept points; colour 0 as a highlight along the centre brow edge.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_07.description: A domino-style eye mask with two eye openings, upswept pointed wings above each brow and a pointed tip running down over the nose bridge. It sits close against the face like a superhero mask.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_07.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper brow wings and the outer areas of the mask; colour 0 on the nose and lower cheek portion, blending into colour 1 with a gradient.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_07_Glitter.description: A thin domino-style eye mask with swept-up pointed wings at the outer brows, open eye holes and a pointed nose bridge. It has a speckled, glitter-flecked surface and sits flat across the upper face.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_07_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper and outer mask surface; colour 0 on the lower nose and cheek area; colour 3 on the speckled flecks.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_08.description: A domino-style eye mask with angular eye openings and a pointed brow line, topped by two slim fin-like prongs rising above each brow. It sits flat over the eyes and upper nose in a classic superhero style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_08.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main mask body; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the upper brow line and prongs.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_08.differs: The female mask has a thin contrasting trim along the top edge of the brow and prongs, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Anniversary_01.description: A full-face superhero mask with two tall pointed ears at the brow, a V-shaped forehead dip, eye openings and a wide lower panel covering the nose and cheeks, leaving the mouth free. Contrasting edging outlines it, with a mottled textured surface.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Anniversary_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer edging; colour 0, colour 2 and colour 3 appear in the mottled speckled surface, with colour 2 darkening the nose area.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Cybercat_01.description: A full-head cybernetic cat helmet with angular faceted plates, a raised crest along the top, round ear-like pods at the sides, a vented muzzle guard over the lower face, and four round sensor lenses across the front.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Cybercat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crest and top plates; colour 1 on the face panels, side sections and ear pods; colour 2 on the vented muzzle and rim details; colour 3 on the four round sensor lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_01.description: A ninja-style cloth eye mask: a band wraps around the head at eye level, with a pointed angular mask section over the eyes and a knotted bow with two flared tails at the back.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask rim, front eye piece and band edges; colour 1 on the band panels and the knot tails; colour 2 on the band sections and the knot centre.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_01.differs: The female version has a sharper, angular mask over the eyes with a pointed brow and a multi-panel band, while the male version is a soft, wrinkled cloth wrap.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Bow_01.description: A pair of small angular eye plates, one over each eye, with pointed outer tips that sweep back toward the temples. They sit separately on the face like a stylised, minimal ninja or sci-fi eye mask.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of both plates; colour 1 on the inner backing of the plates, seen from behind and the side.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Ribbon_01.description: A pair of long cloth ribbon tails tied at the side of the head, hanging down over the shoulder and back to chest level. Each tail is banded in several contrasting sections, giving a ninja-style headband look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer and lower bands of the tails; colour 2 on the middle bands; colour 3 on the upper knot end of the tails; colour 0 on the tips.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Ribbon_01.differs: The female ribbon is banded in several contrasting sections, and it hangs at the side and back of the head.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Child_Mardi_G.description: A jester-style crown band sitting across the top of the head, with a ring of tall curved cloth points that flop outward, some tipped with small round bells. Playful carnival look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Child_Mardi_G.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the shorter outer points; colour 1 on the taller curved points; colour 3 on the tallest central points; colour 2 on the small bells.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Child_Mardi_G.description: A headpiece crest with a tall pointed central fin that runs front to back along the top of the head, framed by a pair of curved horns and a pair of long swept-back thin horns on each side. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Child_Mardi_G.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the central crest fin and its small leaf-like spikes; colour 2 on the inner curved horns; colour 1 on the outer long swept horns and their bases.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Mardi_Gras_01.description: A Mardi Gras carnival mask covering the face, with a heart-shaped brow, painted swirling patterns, small eye openings and a jester-like crown of curled feather plumes tipped with tiny bells; a thin band circles the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Mardi_Gras_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the mask face and some plumes; colour 1 on the painted face patterns, lips and some plumes; colour 0 on the lower plumes, bells and head band; colour 2 on the fine outlines.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Mardi_Gras_02.description: A full-face beaked bird mask with a pointed beak, ringed eye openings and a jagged feather-like crest. A tall central fin, two curved horns, two long swept plumes and a thin band around the head crown the top.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Mardi_Gras_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face, beak and upright horns; colour 3 on the central crest, jagged brow trim and eye rims; colour 2 on the curved side horns; colour 1 on the swept plumes and head band.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Monaclel_01.description: A small mechanical monocle: a short polygonal barrel sits over one eye, with a segmented ring of alternating panels around the rim and a flat lens disc inside. It has no strap and sits directly on the face.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Monaclel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer barrel; colour 2 on the rim segments; colour 3 on the small inserts between the rim segments; colour 1 on the lens disc.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Monstereyes_01.description: A pair of small, rough-edged eye sockets set on the sides of the temples, each a rim of skin-like flesh around a contrasting hollow. They add extra monstrous eyes beside the natural ones.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Monstereyes_01.colourAreas: The rims appear skin-toned and do not clearly take the scheme; the hollows are unaffected by any slot.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Night_Mask_01.description: A horned, angular face mask covering the brow, cheeks and nose bridge, with two large upswept horns on the forehead plate, layered pointed panels over the cheeks and a pointed chin-like tip below. Fantasy, monstrous style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Night_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and forehead plate; colour 1 on the cheek and side panels; colour 3 on the thin trim under the brow; colour 2 on the pointed lower tip.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Nightvisor_01.description: A wraparound visor shaped like a wide V: a single angular, glossy tinted band sweeps across the eyes with upswept pointed wings at the temples and a narrow tapered centre panel over the nose bridge.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Nightvisor_01.colourAreas: The visor appears glossy and largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows on the edge trim and reflections.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Nightvisor_02.description: A single cyclops-style lamp: a short, faceted cylindrical housing with a thick rim around a contrasting round lens, worn in the centre of the forehead. Reads as a mechanical, sci-fi third eye.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Nightvisor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front rim and housing body; colour 1 on the band around the housing; colour 2 on the lens.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Pirate_Fancy_L_01.description: A pirate-style eyepatch: a small rounded disc covers the left eye, held by a thin strap that runs diagonally across the face and loops around the back of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Pirate_Fancy_L_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye patch disc; colour 0 on the thin strap.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Pirate_Fancy_R_01.description: A pirate-style eyepatch: a small rounded patch over the right eye, held by a thin strap that slants across the forehead and loops around the head at the back.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Pirate_Fancy_R_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye patch; colour 0 on the thin strap.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Reactor_01.description: A pair of tall, angular horn-like blades that start as faceted wedges over the eyes and sweep out and upward past the temples, curving back and ending in flat cut tips above the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower eye wedges and the body of each horn; colour 1 on the upper tips of the horns, fading in a gradient.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_01.description: A sleek, bat-like domino mask of two separate sharp-winged eye frames that meet at a point over the nose bridge, with pointed spikes sweeping up at the brows and down along the cheeks. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper mask surfaces; colour 1 on the lower cheek points as a gradient fade. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_02.description: A pair of thin, flat eye-mask pieces hugging the brow and cheekbones, with tall curved spikes sweeping up over each eyebrow and tapering points below each eye. Gives an alien, feral, antler-like look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper brow spikes; colour 1 on the lower cheek points and under-eye edges.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_L_01.description: A thin, sculpted eye mask worn over one eye: a sleek shell around the eye socket with a sharp upward brow spike and long, curved claw-like points sweeping down the cheek and beside the nose.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_L_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper brow and rim of the mask; colour 1 on the lower cheek spikes, blending in as a gradient. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_L_02.description: A thin, sculpted eye mask for the left eye: a brow ridge sweeping up into three tall curved spikes, with narrow pointed tendrils curving beneath the eye and down the cheek. It sits flat on the skin.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_L_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow ridge and spikes; colour 1 on the lower cheek tendrils and underside edge.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_R_01.description: A single-eye mask shell worn over the right eye: a thin, glossy, sharply pointed frame with a tall swept-up spike above the brow and long tapering spikes down the cheek and toward the nose. Gives an alien, renegade look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_R_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper frame and brow spike; colour 1 on the lower cheek and nose spike tips, blending in from the frame.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_R_02.description: A one-eye mask shell that wraps the right eye socket, with tall swept-back spikes rising over the brow and sharp tapering points trailing down the cheek. Alien, sleek and predatory in style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Renegade_R_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow spikes and main shell; colour 1 on the lower rim and cheek points around the eye.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Robot_Monical_01.description: A cybernetic single-eye monocle: a boxy angular housing over one eye with a protruding lens barrel and banded rings, held by a thick padded strap that loops diagonally over the top of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Robot_Monical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing and barrel body; colour 1 on the rings around the barrel; colour 3 on the lens; colour 2 on the head strap.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Robot_Monical_Dual_01.description: Mechanical twin-lens goggles: two short telescoping lens barrels on angular metal housings sit over the eyes, joined by a small bridge and held by a thin band that loops over the top of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Robot_Monical_Dual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings and barrel bodies; colour 1 on the barrel rings; colour 3 on the lens tips; colour 2 on the head band.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Sheer_01.description: An angular, glossy face mask with two tall pointed ears on top, a chevron-shaped brow plate and a pointed lower section that covers the eyes, nose and cheeks down to a point at the chin. Suggests a bat-like hero or armoured helmet style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Sheer_01.colourAreas: Mostly glossy metal-like finish that largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows on the inner lining and edge trim; colour 2 on the outer shell; colour 3 on a thin band along the brow chevron.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Sheer_01.differs: The female mask has a smoother glossy outer shell with a contrasting-lit inner lining, while the male has a separate contrasting band across the brow.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Sockpuppet_01.description: A pair of chunky octagonal button-style eye patches, one over each eye, each with a raised rim and a contrasting stitched bar across the centre. They give a cute, cartoonish sock-puppet look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Sockpuppet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the left-hand button face; colour 1 on the right-hand button face; colour 2 on the stitched bars.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_01.description: Wraparound speedster goggles: a single smooth tinted visor shell curving across both eyes with a raised angular brow ridge and stepped side fins at the temples. It sits over the eyes with no visible strap.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the visor shell, brow ridge and side fins; the inner surface picks up a faint tint from colour 1.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_02.description: Wraparound speedster goggles: two large rounded lenses in thick padded frames joined by a nose bridge, topped by an angular swept-back brow ridge that wraps to the temples. Sits across the eyes, sleek and superhero-styled.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow ridge and outer temple caps; colour 2 on the lens frames and bridge; the lenses are a glassy tint that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_Gla.description: A one-piece wraparound visor-style pair of goggles: a single curved lens band with a pinched bridge over the nose, sweeping around the eyes to the temples. It has a sleek, sporty speedster look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_Gla.colourAreas: The glass lens ignores the colour scheme and shows a glossy finish; no other slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_Gla.description: Two separate curved lens shells, each a rounded teardrop shape, sitting directly over the eyes with no frame or strap. They give a sleek, minimal speedster visor look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_Gla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both lens shells; the glassy default material largely ignores the rest of the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Teddy_01.description: A pair of large four-hole sewing buttons covering the eyes, each a round disc with a raised rim and a recessed centre with four holes. Flat plain backs. A creepy doll-like look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rims and backs; colour 1 on the recessed button faces; colour 2 on the four holes.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Thirdeye_01.description: A single extra eye set in the centre of the forehead: a rounded eyeball with iris and pupil inside fleshy, slightly raised lids. Reads as a mutant or mystic third eye.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Thirdeye_01.colourAreas: Skin-toned lids follow the character's skin; colour 1 on the eye socket and the of the eyeball; iris and pupil keep their own default look.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_01.description: A curved anglerfish-style stalk rising from the top of the forehead, arching forward over the face and ending in a small teardrop lure that hangs in front of the nose. Monstrous, creature-inspired accessory.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalk; colour 3 on the stripe along the top edge of the stalk; colour 1 on the lure bulb.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_02.description: An anglerfish-style lure: a thin curved stalk rises from the centre of the forehead, arches forward over the face and ends in a teardrop bulb hanging in front of the nose. Monstrous, creature-like accessory.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalk; colour 3 on the stripe along the top edge of the stalk; colour 1 on the bulb.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_03.description: Two curved anglerfish-style stalks rising from the centre of the forehead and arcing forward over the face, each ending in a small rounded bulb dangling in front of the nose. Monstrous, creature-like head accessory.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalk bodies; colour 3 on the stalk edge stripes; colour 1 on the bulbs at the tips.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_04.description: Monstrous anglerfish-style eye accessory: two bulbous round eye orbs sit over the eyes, and a thin curved stalk rises from the forehead, arcs forward and ends in a teardrop lure hanging in front of the face.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye orbs and the lure bulb; colour 0 on the stalk; colour 3 as a thin stripe along the top of the stalk.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Blaster_01.description: A single-eye blaster: a chunky faceted cylindrical barrel covering one eye socket, with a ringed open muzzle at the front and a tapered rear housing that reaches back toward the temple. Sci-fi cyborg style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Blaster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted rear housing; colour 1 on the front barrel section; colour 0 on the ring around the muzzle; colour 2 on the inner lens; the crosshair marker is not part of the piece.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Blaster_02.description: A large single-eye blaster: a chunky tube-shaped cannon that projects forward from one eye, with a ringed open muzzle at the front and a faceted, angular rear housing that sits against the side of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Blaster_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main barrel body and inner muzzle; colour 0 on the muzzle rim and the rear housing; colour 3 on the small crosshair-like targeting marks and the deep centre of the muzzle.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Eyesbulbous_01.description: A pair of large, rounded bulbous eyes that bulge out from the face over each eye socket, like insect or monster eyes. Each is a smooth glossy dome with a hollow back, worn in place of normal eyes.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Eyesbulbous_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on both eye domes, with shading toward darker tones at the edges; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A feathered headpiece of layered swept-back plumes that rise into wing-like tips above the temples, with a central crest of pointed feathers on the forehead and short spiky contrasting feather shards fanning down the sides of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central forehead crest; colour 1 on the upper long plumes; colour 2 on the middle layer of plumes; colour 3 on the lower plumes and the side spikes.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Firebird_01.differs: The female version has longer, more upright plumes and side spikes that sit slightly farther back on the head.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_01.description: A tiny flat rectangular patch floating on the forehead above the eyes, apparently an effect anchor for flaming eyes. Almost nothing of the piece is visible as geometry.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small flat patch; no other visible features take the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_02.description: A tiny flat rectangular patch floating on the forehead above the brows. It is likely a placeholder for an eye effect, and the visible geometry shows no flames or eye detail.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small flat patch; no other coloured features are visible.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_02.differs: The female patch is a thinner, flatter rectangle than the male's squarer one.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampun.description: Steampunk goggles with two gear-shaped rims around grid-covered lenses, joined by a bridge and a wide padded band that wraps around the head. Small knobbed levers stick out at the sides.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gear rims; colour 2 on the head band and bridge; colour 1 on the small levers; colour 3 on the lens grids and lever knobs.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampun.description: Steampunk goggles with two rounded lens housings joined by a thin bridge, a telescoping barrel between them and a small side knob, held by a broad band wrapping around the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head band and small knob; colour 1 on the lens housings; colour 3 on the lenses and barrel tip; colour 2 on the barrel and bridge wires.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampun.description: Steampunk twin-lens goggles with round, chunky barrel housings set with rectangular panels, joined by a small bridge over the eyes and held by a wide flat strap with round studs that circles the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head strap; colour 1 on the goggle housings, bridge and strap studs; colour 3 on the rectangular panels around the barrels; colour 2 on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampun.description: Round steampunk goggles with two rounded metal lens cups, contrasting lenses and a thin bridge, ringed by sharp cone spikes. A thin buckled strap loops over the top of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal lens cups and bridge; colour 1 on the head strap and the rear caps of the cups; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_01.description: Close-fitting bubble goggles with a rounded, molded frame around two large domed lenses over the eyes, held by a thin flat strap that runs around the head above the ears.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle frame; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 3 on the head strap.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_03.description: Wide swimming-style goggles with two rounded lens bubbles in a chunky rimmed frame, held by a thin elastic strap that circles the head. Worn pushed up on the forehead, giving a practical, aviator-like look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle frame; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 3 on the head strap.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_03.differs: The female goggles sit higher on the forehead, so the strap runs above the brow line rather than showing beneath the frame.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesinsulated.description: Wraparound winter goggles with a single wide lens set in a thick rounded frame over the eyes, held by a slim strap that loops over the top of the head. Sporty, practical look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesinsulated.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle frame; colour 1 on the lens; colour 3 on the head strap and the small bridge strip between the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Joke_01.description: Novelty glasses with thick squarish frames, open lenses and long arms reaching back to the ears, topped by a pair of jagged, spiky cartoon eyebrows sitting above the frame.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Joke_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frames and arms; colour 1 on the spiky eyebrows.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Party_Glasses_01.description: Novelty party glasses with two four-pointed star-shaped lenses in thick rims, joined by a small bridge, with thin angular temple arms that run back over the ears. Playful, cute costume eyewear.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Party_Glasses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the bridge and temple arms; colour 2 on the lenses seen from the front; colour 3 on the inner lens faces seen from behind.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Secret_03.description: Round, chunky-rimmed glasses with slightly faceted lenses and long straight arms, topped by a spiky tuft of jagged hair-like fringe above each lens, giving a quirky, comic look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frames and arms; colour 1 on the spiky tufts above the lenses; the lenses are tinted translucent and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_01.description: A wide welder-style visor: a boxy front shield with a single contrasting horizontal slit sits over the eyes, flanked by swept-back side wings with slotted stripes that wrap around the head to a pointed rear band.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front shield box; colour 0 on the side wings and rear band; colour 3 on the stripe accents and small marks on the shield; colour 2 on the viewing slit.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_02.description: A wraparound visor band worn across the eyes: a boxy front frame holding a contrasting slit lens, with angular swept-back side wings that taper toward the temples and carry paired slash marks.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept side wings and rear band; colour 1 on the boxy lens frame; colour 3 on the slash marks and small frame studs; the lens itself stays dark.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_03.description: A single-eye visor monocle: a chunky angular wedge that covers one eye with a contrasting rectangular lens slot, tapering back along the temple toward the ear with two slim vent slits. Reads as a sci-fi welder or cyber visor.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and rear housing; colour 1 on the front frame around the lens slot; colour 3 on the small vent slits and accent marks; colour 2 on the lens slot.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_04.description: A tall vertical monocle visor covering one eye: a narrow angular shell with a deep contrasting slit lens, a raised rim, and a swept-back plate that wraps toward the temple. Small marks sit at the brow end.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept-back shell and brow plate; colour 1 on the rim and front frame; colour 2 on the lens slit; colour 3 on the small marks.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Toy_01.description: A pair of round, chunky faceplate lenses worn over each eye, each a thick polygonal rim around a dished dial face with a small central knob and a thin needle, like vintage toy gauges.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer rims and back casings; colour 3 on the dial faces; colour 1 on the inner ring and needles; colour 0 on the central knobs.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Trumpknight_02.description: A wraparound visor band across the eyes and upper cheeks, with a pointed lower edge over the nose bridge and chunky cylindrical pods at each temple. A lens-like disc sits on the outer face of each pod. Sci-fi eyewear.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Trumpknight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band; colour 1 on the lower visor edge and nose point; colour 2 on the temple pods; colour 3 on the lens discs.
