Female/F_Eye_Face_Until_Eyepatch.description: A sci-fi tech eyepatch: a contrasting angular lens plate over one eye, linked by a thin cable and short cylindrical coupling to a large rounded earpiece housing on the side of the head, with a translucent cheek panel.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Until_Eyepatch.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing shell and coupling; colour 1 on the lower housing panels and cable; colour 2 on the eye plate and housing edges; colour 3 on the top patch of the housing.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Urban_Glasses_01.description: Wide angular wraparound shades: a single visor-like lens with a notch over the nose, a slim thin frame, and straight arms ending in small hooked tips that rest over the ears.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Urban_Glasses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; colours 1 and 3 in alternating horizontal stripes across the lens.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Victory_Mask_01.description: A flat, angular headpiece that frames the face like a crown-helm: two upswept horn-like points rise at the temples, a V-shaped brow with raised ridged lines, and long side plates that taper down past the cheeks. Open at the face and back.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Victory_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the lower and rear panel shading; colour 2 on the raised outer rim and brow ridges; colour 3 on the thin inner edge lining.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_01.description: A smooth helmet-like brow plate covering the forehead and crown, with a wraparound band of tinted visor lenses over the eyes and small angled cheek flaps at each side. Open at the face and back of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow plate and cheek flaps; colour 1 on the visor lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_02.description: A wraparound visor with a chunky angular brow band, a single lens strip across both eyes, and blocky plates that wrap the temples and cheeks. Sits over the eyes and upper face; sleek superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band and temple plates; colour 1 on the lens strip.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Broad_01.description: A broad wraparound visor: a single angular tinted band across both eyes, framed by a thick flat rim along the top and side plates that reach back toward the ears. Sci-fi and superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Broad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame and side plates; colour 1 on the visor lens band.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.description: A angular faceplate mask that covers the forehead, eyes and nose down to the upper lip, with a band across the brow and two swept-back horn-like fins rising from the top of the head. Mechanical, armoured look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main face shell and upper fin; colour 2 on the brow band; colour 0 on the chin edge, fin tips and side panels; colour 3 on the inner edge trim at the side of the face.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.differs: The male version is entirely one colour with no contrasting blue, contrasting or contrasting areas on the default scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.description: A mechanical skull-cap helm of angular plates that covers the crown and back of the head, with a notched brow edge and a split tail panel trailing down the nape; sci-fi with a clockwork feel.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main crown plates; colour 0 on the front brow panel and the lower back panels; colour 2 on the rear band; colour 3 on the thin accent strip along one side.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.differs: This version has no hanging visor plate in front of the eyes; the brow edge is a plain notched line.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.description: A wide angular plate visor that covers the brow and upper face, with two forked horn-like fins sweeping back over the top of the head. The faceted panels look mechanical and armoured, with a flat lower edge across the nose.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor plate and its swept-back fins; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.differs: The female version has shorter, more upward-angled fins and a slightly narrower face plate.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.description: An open-topped angular helmet shell that arches over the crown and sweeps back into a tapering flared plate down the back of the head, leaving the face, sides and nape uncovered. Suggests a mechanical, armored look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rear plate; the inner lining and front notch panel show a separate tone, not clearly following the test scheme.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_.differs: The front has a wider central notch with a pointed panel dipping toward the brow, and the rear plate flares slightly more.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Sharp_01.description: A wraparound eyeplate visor: a rigid angular frame with a pointed V-shaped brow ridge and swept side wings over the temples, holding a tinted lens band across the eyes. Superhero or sci-fi mask style.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Sharp_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame and side wings; colour 1 on the lens band across the eyes.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_01.description: A sleek wraparound visor band that covers the eyes in one continuous strip, with a small notch over the nose and a round disc-shaped cap at each temple. Its faceted, banded surface gives a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band edges and centre ridge; colour 3 on the striped bands across the visor; colour 1 on the round temple discs; colour 2 on the small hardware and centre of each disc.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_02.description: A chunky rectangular visor block that wraps across the eyes and the sides of the head, with a flat framed front panel and a small central slot. The boxy shell closes around the head like a retro headset.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and sides; colour 0 on the framed front panel and slot; colour 1 on the small end caps at the temples.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_03.description: A wraparound tech visor with one wide angular tinted lens band across the eyes and thick faceted arms that sweep back along the temples to the back of the head. It reads as a sleek sci-fi shade.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_03.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; the lens band and arms show a glossy finish with a slight sheen on the edges, and no distinct areas of colours 0-3 are clearly visible.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_03.differs: The female visor has a plain smooth centre over the nose, without the small emblem plate on the bridge.

Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_04.description: A wraparound tech visor: a single angular tinted lens band spanning both eyes, with a raised metallic upper rim and a small central housing over the nose bridge. Sits across the eyes and reaches the temples.
Female/F_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_04.colourAreas: The material looks glossy and largely ignores the scheme: the lens and rim show a reflective finish; the small central housing may take colour 2.

Female/F_Eye_Facemask_Lightning_01.description: A domino-style eye mask with jagged, lightning-bolt edges: a angular upper brow band sweeps out into long pointed spikes at the temples, and a lower band across the cheeks and nose bridge ends in zigzag points.
Female/F_Eye_Facemask_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower cheek and nose band and the outer spikes; colour 2 on the upper brow band around the eyes.

Female/F_Eye_Facemask_Phantom_01.description: A rigid, shell-like half-mask covering the forehead, eyes and cheeks, with a notched V cut-out at the brow, angular eye openings and two narrow strips running down past the cheeks toward the jaw. Suggests a sleek superhero or phantom look.
Female/F_Eye_Facemask_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 2 on the edge outlines and inner cut-out borders. The female version shows no visible use of colour 1 or 3.
Female/F_Eye_Facemask_Phantom_01.differs: The female mask has no contrasting rim around the eye openings and has a deeper V-shaped brow notch, while the male version has a contrasting-slot rim around the eyes.

Female/F_Eye_Fullbandana_02.description: A cloth head wrap that covers the whole skull and forehead, with a cut-out band across the eyes and a knotted tie with short tails at the back. An atom-style emblem sits on the forehead, giving a superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Fullbandana_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap; colour 1 on the atom emblem on the forehead.

Female/F_Eye_Fullhelmet_Crown_Spiked_01.description: A small angular helmet front plate that sits across the brow and down the bridge of the nose, with swept-up pointed wings at each side and a tapering spike ending over the nose tip. Suits a monstrous or armoured helmet look.
Female/F_Eye_Fullhelmet_Crown_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the downward nose spike; colour 1 on the upswept side wings; colour 2 on the central panel across the brow.

Female/F_Eye_Fullhelmet_Gogglesdown_01.description: Oversized round goggles with two chunky, rounded eye cups that project forward from the face, joined by a small bridge piece over the nose. Tube-like lens housings give a bulky, retro-mechanical look.
Female/F_Eye_Fullhelmet_Gogglesdown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings and bridge; colour 1 on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Fullhelmet_Wingedgoggles_Bl.description: Butterfly-shaped winged goggles: two angular contrasting lenses set in raised rims, joined at a small nose bridge, with pointed swept-up wing panels over the brows and temples that wrap around the sides of the face.
Female/F_Eye_Fullhelmet_Wingedgoggles_Bl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing panels and outer frame; colour 1 on the rims around the lenses and the nose bridge; colour 3 on the small studs along the lower rims; lenses stay regardless of the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Gamer_01.description: A chunky angular cybernetic eye plate covering one eye and temple, with a glowing round lens below and two curved cables looping out around the front and the side of the head. Suggests a sci-fi gamer or cyborg look.
Female/F_Eye_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 1 on the side panel strip and the back plate; colour 2 on the looping cables; colour 3 on the eye lens.
Female/F_Eye_Gamer_01.differs: The female version has a larger contrasting back plate that reaches behind the ear; the male back is plain and only the strip at the side shows blue.

Female/F_Eye_Glasses_Spy_01.description: Small round spectacles with faceted polygonal rims, tinted lenses and a thin bridge. Slim wire arms hook back over the ears. Sits on the eyes as a light, retro, bookish accessory.
Female/F_Eye_Glasses_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the bridge and temple arms; the lenses show a tint that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Glassesnolens_04.description: Lensless spectacles with thin, octagonal wire-like frames joined by a small nose bridge, with straight arms that run back to the ears and end in small upturned tips. Classic scholarly, bookish look.
Female/F_Eye_Glassesnolens_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole frame, including the rims, bridge and arms.

Female/F_Eye_Glassesnolens_Harajuku_01.description: Thin wire-frame reading glasses with lensless, low-slung angular rims that sit on the nose, and slim arms curving back over the ears. A light, bookish accessory with a casual, studious feel.
Female/F_Eye_Glassesnolens_Harajuku_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire frame, rims and arms.

Female/F_Eye_Heraldry_01.description: A metal heraldic face guard covering the lower face from nose to chin, with a pointed top edge, a bordered rim, curved contrasting-lit vent slots above and a cluster of small round breathing holes below; it curves around the cheeks.
Female/F_Eye_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the raised outer rim; colour 3 on the recessed slots.

Female/F_Eye_Heraldry_02.description: A faceplate shaped like a knight's visor: a faceted front with a horizontal eye slit, a lower grille with cross-shaped vents, and a wavy, pointed crest with a raised rim around the edge. It covers the face from brow to chin.
Female/F_Eye_Heraldry_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the raised edge rim; colour 3 on the eye slit; colour 2 on the vent openings.

Female/F_Eye_Heraldry_03.description: An angular armoured face mask covering the lower face from nose to chin: a broad upper plate with a pointed brow, a slotted lower guard with ribbed bands, and contrasting side fins curving back along the cheeks.
Female/F_Eye_Heraldry_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate and its back; colour 1 on the lower guard; colour 3 on the ribbed bands and the central band's studs; colour 2 on the side fins and the frame around the guard.

Female/F_Eye_Heroic_Visor_01.description: A wraparound band visor that covers the eyes and wraps to the temples, with a thick trimmed top edge, a pointed lower edge over the nose bridge and two thin stripes across the middle. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Eye_Heroic_Visor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main visor body; colour 2 on the thick top edge; colour 3 on the outer stripes; colour 1 on the central stripe.

Female/F_Eye_Huge_Goggles_01.description: Oversized wraparound goggles with a chunky panelled frame, two large octagonal lenses, bolt heads at the temples and a thin strap around the back of the head. Cracked veiny detail marks one lens; sci-fi, monstrous look.
Female/F_Eye_Huge_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and bolts; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 3 on the vein-like cracks over one lens; colour 2 on the outline edging and rear strap.

Female/F_Eye_Jewels_01.description: A decorative face mask made of many faceted, elongated gemstones arranged in a fan around both eyes, with a large pointed gem on the brow and a small gem on the nose bridge; a row of teardrop gems runs beneath each eye.
Female/F_Eye_Jewels_01.colourAreas: The glossy gems mostly ignore the colour scheme and show a reflective metallic finish; a few gems show slight colour 1 tinting, and small drop gems below the eyes pick up colour 3.
Female/F_Eye_Jewels_01.differs: The female version has a wider spread of teardrop gems curving further under and out from each eye, forming a fuller mask outline.

Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Boar_01.description: A single side-set beast eye in the style of a boar: a small angular eye with a round pupil and iris sitting in a pointed surround at the outer edge of the face, placed on the side of the head.
Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed surround around the eye; the eyeball, iris and pupil keep their own eye colouring.

Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.description: A single rounded, slightly faceted eyeball shell with a tall vertical slit pupil, sitting over one eye like a dragon or reptile eye. The back is hollow and open. Suggests a monstrous beast look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball surface; colour 2 on the slit pupil. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Fox_02.description: A single left eye replacement in a fox-like style: an almond-shaped, slanted lid shape surrounds a glossy round eyeball with a large contrasting pupil and highlights. It sits over the eye socket as a small feature.
Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Fox_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular fox-like eyelid surround; the eyeball and pupil are unaffected by the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Hyena_01.description: A single animal-style eye replacement for the left eye: a slanted almond shape with a large round pupil, a small highlight and a heavy angular lid patch above and outside the eye, giving a feral hyena look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid patch around the outer edge of the eye; colour 2 on the pupil; colour 0 on the eyeball and iris.

Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Kitsune_01.description: A single slanted, almond-shaped fox-like eye overlay that replaces the left eye, with a narrow pupil and a sharp upswept outer edge. It sits over the eye socket, giving a feral, beastly look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Kitsune_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyelid shape and slanted outer surround; the eyeball and pupil keep their own eye texture.

Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Orc_01.description: A single small eye insert for the left eye: an angular, slightly slanted almond-shaped socket surround with a round glossy iris and pupil. It sits flush over the eye opening and gives a beastly, orc-like gaze.
Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Orc_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye socket surround; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Werewolf_01.description: A single beast-like eye replacement: a small glossy eyeball with a large contrasting pupil and highlight, framed by an angular pointed brow wedge that sweeps up and outward, giving a fierce werewolf glare.
Female/F_Eye_L_Beast_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular brow wedge; the eyeball itself keeps its own and look and does not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Child_Tight_Basic_01.description: A single small left eye insert with a rounded iris, pupil and highlight, set within an almond-shaped surround in the eye socket. It is a plain, natural-looking eye with no other head covering.
Female/F_Eye_L_Child_Tight_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye surround and lid area; the iris, pupil and highlight keep their own eye shading and do not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Bat_01.description: A single oversized, glossy oval eye replacing the left eye: a large contrasting pupil with bright highlights inside a thin rim, sitting slightly proud of the face. Gives a beastly, bat-like or monstrous look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the iris surround; colour 1 on the thin outer rim of the eye; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Bear_02.description: A single left eye replacement with a large rounded iris, a big contrasting pupil and a glossy highlight, set in a slightly angular outer rim. It sits in the eye socket and gives a cartoonish, animal-like look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Bear_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim of the eyeball; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Bear_03.description: A small replacement left eye with an animal-style shape: a slightly angular, almond eyeball with a large round pupil and a pointed corner wedge at the outer edge. It sits in the eye socket and is nearly invisible from a distance.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Bear_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer corner wedge; colour 2 on the large pupil; colour 0 on the eyeball surround.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Bull_01.description: A single bull-style eye placed on the side of the face, low beside the nose. It is a glossy round eyeball with a highlight, set in a small pointed wedge of textured skin-like surround. Suits beastly or monstrous heads.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the surround around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own glossy and look and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.description: A single stylised cat eye with a large round pupil, a bright highlight and a pointed outer corner that sweeps toward the temple. It sits over the left eye socket as a small cartoonish, cute animal-like eye replacement.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer eyelid edge; the iris, pupil and highlight ignore the scheme; the skin-toned rear shell follows the mannequin's skin, not a colour slot.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Cobra_01.description: A single reptilian eye patch: a faceted, angular plate on the side of the head holding a large round eye with a slit-like pupil, set beside the temple like a snake or cobra eye.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Cobra_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted plate around the eye; colour 0 on the eyeball; colour 2 on the pupil; colour 3 on small skin-toned facets at the plate edges.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Corgi_01.description: A single large, cartoon-style eye replacing the natural left eye: a glossy round pupil with two contrasting highlights inside a slightly angular, flat iris shape with a thin rim. Gives a cute, anime-like animal look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Corgi_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on a small strip at the top of the eye; the pupil, highlights and rim take their own fixed shading and mostly ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Coyote_01.description: A single animal-style eye replacement: a realistic eyeball with a narrow pupil, framed by a sharp angular wedge that sweeps back toward the temple, giving a predatory coyote-like slant to one eye.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Coyote_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular wedge around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own texture and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.description: A single monstrous eye insert: a slanted, wedge-shaped eye with a glossy round pupil and highlight, sitting on the side of the head beside the natural eye, with a faceted outer shell. Suggests a cyber-beast look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted outer shell around the eye; the eyeball and pupil ignore the scheme and keep their own glossy shading.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Dinosaur_Large_01.description: A single wedge-shaped eye replacement for the left side of the face, with a large glossy pupil and highlights set in a slanted almond shape; a solid outer wedge sweeps back toward the temple. Gives a reptilian, cartoonish look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Dinosaur_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer wedge at the temple side; the eyeball itself keeps its own textured iris and pupil, not using the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Doberman_01.description: A single small eye piece for one side of the face: an angular, slightly raised almond-shaped lid with a round glossy iris and pupil, giving a sharp animal-like eye that replaces the normal eye.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Doberman_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid surround; the iris and pupil keep their own eye colouring and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Dragon_01.description: A single replacement eye with a large round iris, glossy highlights and a small pupil, framed by a pointed, swept-out lid that stretches into a sharp wedge at the outer corner for a reptilian, dragon-like look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed lid wedge; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A single reptilian eye replacing the left eye: a slit-pupil eyeball set in a curved, angular scaly lid that sweeps up and outward at the outer corner, giving a fierce dragon-like look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyelid surround; the eyeball, iris and pupil are fixed details that ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Fennec_01.description: A single large anime-style eye insert for the left side of the face: a slanted, angular wedge with a glossy contrasting pupil, contrasting highlights and a contrasting iris, framed by a fur-textured flared border at the outer corner.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer fur-like border and wedge edge; colour 0 on the iris and highlights; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Feral_01.description: A single left eye replacement with a slanted, angular lid plate that sweeps up and outward, giving a fierce, predatory look. It sits over the eye socket, with a round pupil and glossy highlight.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Feral_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid plate around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own iris and pupil shading and does not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Fishmonster_01.description: A single monstrous fish-style eye replacing the left eye: an oversized almond-shaped eye with a large glossy pupil and highlight, set slanted toward the temple with a separate panel along the outer edge.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Fishmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer edge panel beside the eye; the eyeball, pupil and iris keep their own fixed shading and ignore the colour scheme.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Fishmonster_01.differs: The female eye is smaller and sits slimmer and more slanted, leaving more of the natural eye visible beside it.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Goat_01.description: A single goat-style eye replacement: a slit-pupil eyeball with a large glossy pupil, set in a pointed, angular eyelid wedge that extends outward at the outer corner. Sits over the left eye as a partial animal face piece.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eyelid wedge; the eyeball and pupil keep their own textured look and do not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Horse_01.description: A small replacement eye for a horse-like head: a glossy round eyeball with a large pupil, set in a pointed wedge-shaped lid that sits on the side of the face, giving a beast-like look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wedge-shaped lid surround; the eyeball itself ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Husky_01.description: A single animal-style eye replacement for one eye: a slanted, almond-shaped eyeball with a large round pupil and highlight, framed by a pointed upper lid patch. It sits over the eye socket and suggests a beastly, husky look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Husky_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper lid patch and the outer edge of the eye; the eyeball and pupil keep their own fixed appearance and do not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Kangaroo_01.description: A single left eye replacement in an animal style: a slit-pupil eyeball with a highlight, set inside a sharp angular wedge-shaped lid panel that extends outward toward the temple.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid panel around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own iris and pupil texture and does not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Kitty_01.description: A single stylised cat eye that replaces the left eye: a curved, almond-shaped iris with a slit pupil and a highlight, set in a pointed angular surround that flares outward at the outer corner.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eye surround; the iris, pupil and highlight keep their own eye texture and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Lion_01.description: A single lion-style eye piece: a small angular eye with a large round pupil and highlight, framed by a pointed, slanted lid shape that sweeps outward over the eye. Sits on the eye socket only.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed lid surround; the iris, pupil and highlight ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Lizard_01.description: A single reptilian eye replacing the left eye: a slanted, almond-shaped eyeball with a large glossy pupil and highlight, set in a pointed scaly-looking lid wedge that sweeps toward the temple.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eyelid wedge around the eye; the eyeball, pupil and iris show their own painted textures and do not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Llama_01.description: A single large animal-style eye replacing the left eye: a big contrasting pupil with a small highlight in a rounded, slightly pointed almond shape that bulges out from the face at the side of the head.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer corner of the eye; the pupil, highlight and iris texture are fixed and do not take a colour slot.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Mouse_01.description: A single stylised cartoon eye overlay for the left eye: a large glossy round pupil with a highlight and a contrasting iris, framed by a pointed, angular wedge of contrasting trim that sweeps toward the temple.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Mouse_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer wedge around the eye; the iris, pupil and highlight keep their own fixed eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Otter_01.description: A single small animal-style eye replacing the left eye: a glossy round pupil and iris set in a pointed, angular eye patch that sweeps back toward the temple, giving an otter-like look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Otter_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eye patch surrounding the eye; the pupil and iris are fixed eye textures that ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Owl_01.description: A single large rounded owl-style eye replacing the left eye: a glossy oversized pupil with a bright highlight spot, set in a slightly bulging rim that sits over the eye socket. Cute, animal-like look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Owl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the highlight spots; colour 1 on the outer rim of the eye; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Pig_01.description: A small replacement left eye for a pig-like face: a tiny wedge-shaped eyeball with a contrasting pupil and a angular lid flap on the outer side, sitting high on the brow rather than in the normal eye socket.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Pig_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wedge-shaped lid flap; the eyeball and pupil keep their own fixed appearance and ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Pitbull_01.description: A single replacement left eye in a beast-like style: a glossy eyeball with a large round pupil and highlight, set in a small curved lid-shaped rim that wraps the eye socket. Only the one eye is changed.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Pitbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer eyelid rim; the iris, pupil and highlight are unaffected by the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Rabbitl_01.description: A single stylised cartoon eye with a large round pupil and highlight, set in a small angular pointed socket patch. It sits at the outer side of the face, beside the temple, giving a rabbit-like creature look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Rabbitl_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular socket patch around the eye; the eyeball and pupil ignore the colour scheme.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Rabbitl_01.differs: The eye sits low at the side of the face next to the natural eye, whereas the male version sits higher above the natural eye.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Raccoon_01.description: A single left eye replacement with a round iris and glossy highlight, framed by a small angular patch of coloured skin that extends toward the outer corner, giving an animal-like, mask-like eye shape.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Raccoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular patch around the eye; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_01.description: A single extra eye that sits on the side of the forehead above the normal eye, like a raptor's. It is a glossy round eyeball with a large pupil and highlight, set in a slim rim that bulges slightly outward.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim around the eye; the eyeball, pupil and iris keep their own painted detail and ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_02.description: A single large reptilian raptor eye set on the side of the head beside the temple: a glossy round pupil with a highlight inside a rimmed iris, backed by a thin contrasting socket plate.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the socket plate behind the eye; the iris and glossy pupil use their own eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_03.description: A single small raptor-style eye set on the side of the temple beside the face: a rounded, slightly angular socket with a large glossy round pupil and a highlight, giving a creature or monstrous look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer socket rim at the back of the eye; colour 0 on the iris area around the pupil; colour 2 on the glossy pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Reptillian_Large_01.description: A single reptilian-style eye replacing the left eye: a slanted, angular almond shape with a glossy contrasting pupil and highlight, and a pointed flap sweeping up and out toward the temple.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Reptillian_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer flap; the eyeball and pupil use their own textured shading and do not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Salamander_01.description: A single oversized animal-style eye that sits at the side of the head beside the face: a rounded, slightly angular oval with a large glossy pupil, a small highlight spot and a textured iris ring.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Salamander_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the thin rim behind the eyeball; the iris, pupil and highlights are painted texture and do not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Seahorse_01.description: A single oversized eye replacing the left eye: a faceted, roughly octagonal disc with a rounded iris ring and a raised central pupil, sitting flat over the eye socket. Suggests a creature or mechanical look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Seahorse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faceted rim of the eyeball; colour 1 on the iris ring; colour 3 on the central pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Set_01.description: A single narrow, slanted almond-shaped eye set into the side of the face, with a large contrasting pupil and a pointed outer corner that sweeps up toward the temple. Suggests a monstrous or alien extra eye.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Set_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed upper edge of the eye shape; the eyeball, pupil and highlights are fixed and do not take the scheme.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Set_01.differs: The female eye is larger and sits slightly further back toward the temple, with a longer sweeping shape.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Shisa_01.description: A small replacement eye piece for the head: an angular, slanted eyeball with a large pupil and a sharp pointed wedge at the outer corner, giving a fierce, beast-like gaze. Sits within the eye socket.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Shisa_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer-corner wedge; the iris and pupil keep their own fixed eye texture and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Tiger_01.description: A single feline-style eye piece for the left eye: a slanted, almond-shaped faceted eye with a round pupil and a sharp angular upper lid that sweeps up and outward, giving a fierce beast-like look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Tiger_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted upper lid shape; the eyeball and pupil keep their own default shading and do not show a clear colour slot.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_01.description: A single small replacement left eye: an almond-shaped eyeball with a large contrasting pupil and a glassy highlight, framed by a sharp angular surround. It sits in the eye socket as a subtle monstrous, vampiric face detail.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular rim around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_01.differs: The female eye has a larger, more pronounced angular surround that wraps round the lower and outer edge of the eyeball.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_02.description: A single small, slit-shaped replacement eye for the left side of the face: an angular, almond-shaped iris and pupil with a glossy highlight, sitting in place of the natural eye. Suggests a vampiric or feline look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular outer eye shape around the iris; the iris and pupil keep their own and shading, independent of the colour scheme.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_02.differs: The female eye sits level with the natural eye and is a larger, elongated almond shape.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_03.description: A single left eye replacement with a glassy round iris, contrasting pupil and highlight, set in a thin almond-shaped surround that gives a sharp, predatory look. Sits in the eye socket only.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye surround and lid; colour 0 on the iris and eyeball; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_Large_01.description: A single left eye replacement: a large glossy contrasting pupil with a highlight, set in a contrasting iris, with a pointed angular wedge that juts out from the outer corner. Gives a bat-like monstrous stare.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed wedge at the outer corner; the pupil and iris keep their own eye shading and do not follow the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Whiterhino_01.description: A small angular monster eye with a slit pupil in a faceted, chunky socket, set at the side of the face beside the cheek as a single beast-like eye accessory.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Whiterhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted socket frame; the eyeball and pupil show fixed texture detail that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Wolf_01.description: A single left eye replacement with a glossy contrasting pupil, a highlight and a rim of iris, framed by small pointed corner flaps that give a slanted, predatory wolf-like shape.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed corner flaps around the eye; the iris and pupil use their own painted texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Wolf_Suave_01.description: A stylised wolf-like eye replacement: a large round iris and pupil set within a sharp, angular almond-shaped lid patch that sweeps up and outward toward the temple, giving a fierce, feline-canine look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Face_Wolf_Suave_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid patch around the eye; the iris and pupil show their own eye texture and do not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Ferret_01.description: A single left eye replacement with a large glossy round pupil and highlight, set in an enlarged iris with a surrounding rim. It gives a cartoonish, animal-like look and sits in the eye socket.
Female/F_Eye_L_Ferret_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim around the iris; colour 2 on the pupil; colour 0 on the iris and eyeball surround.

Female/F_Eye_L_Monkey_01.description: A single left eye replacement: a small angular, pointed eye shape with a round iris and highlight, framed by a sharp contrasting wedge-shaped lid that angles down toward the nose. Sits over the natural eye.
Female/F_Eye_L_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid wedge around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own textured look and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Starowl_01.description: A stylised bird-of-prey eye replacement: a round contrasting iris with a large pupil and highlight, framed by a swept-back angular lid plate that flares outward and up toward the temple. Sits over the left eye.
Female/F_Eye_L_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid plate around the eye; the iris and pupil show their own eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Basic_01.description: A plain, realistic left eye: an almond-shaped surround with a round iris, contrasting pupil and small highlight, sitting in the eye socket. Simple, natural styling with no extra ornament.
Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the almond eye surround and the outer edge of the eyeball; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.description: A single left eye replacement in a beast style: a slanted, almond-shaped eye with a round iris and narrow contrasting pupil, framed by a pointed angular lid shape that sits flat over the eye socket.
Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid shape around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A single replacement eye for the left side: a small, angular eyeball with a large glossy contrasting pupil and a highlight, set in a slightly wedge-shaped socket with a pointed outer corner. It gives a monstrous, mismatched look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim and corner of the eye socket; the pupil and eyeball shading are fixed and do not follow the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A small eye insert for the left eye: a thin curved, angular shard that fills the eye socket like a monstrous slit eyeball, sitting inside the eyelids with no other head coverage.
Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eye shard; the small inner edge takes colour 1. No other colours are clearly visible.
Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The female eye insert looks like a single contrasting curved shard with no visible contrasting panel, while the male version has a separate contrasting panel on top.

Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Full_01.description: A single small eye piece for the werewolf head type: an angular, slanted almond-shaped eye with a round iris and pupil, sitting over the eye socket and giving a fierce, beastly look.
Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Full_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyelid rim and outer eye shape; the iris and pupil keep their own fixed eye texture.

Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_01.description: A single small eye insert with a beast-like almond shape, a round iris and pupil, and a pointed outer corner. It sits over one eye socket as a partial werewolf-style eye replacement.
Female/F_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eyelid surround; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Mask_Alien_01.description: An angular alien face mask with a pointed brow crest, side plates framing the head, faceted eye sockets and a ribbed, mandible-like mouth guard. It covers the face from forehead to chin in a sci-fi, insectoid style.
Female/F_Eye_Mask_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brow crest and side plates; colour 0 on the faceted face plates; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the mouth ribs and the brow triangle.

Female/F_Eye_Mask_Animatronic_01.description: A mechanical skull-like face mask with round goggle eyes, an open mouth vent, a segmented jaw and contrasting banded frame. A angular brow plate carries two tall blade-like ears that sweep up and outward.
Female/F_Eye_Mask_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell and jaw; colour 1 on the brow plate, ears and goggle rims; colour 2 on the banded frame and jaw brackets; colour 3 on the eye lenses and mouth interior.

Female/F_Eye_Mask_Lion_01.description: A full-face lion mask with a snarling muzzle, pointed ears, and an etched atom emblem on the brow. A ribbed crest arcs over the top, and scrolled ornamental side panels flank the face, giving a regal beast look.
Female/F_Eye_Mask_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and emblem; colour 1 on the facial stripes, side scroll panels and alternating crest ribs; colour 3 on the alternating crest ribs, chin stripes and side trim.

Female/F_Eye_Mask_Rustbucket_01.description: A riveted, robot-like face mask that covers the whole head and face: smooth plated dome, bulging round eyes, a protruding nose, a moulded mouth and a contrasting chin and side plate, open at the back.
Female/F_Eye_Mask_Rustbucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome and plating; colour 1 on the forehead stripe, nose, eye rings and chin and jaw plates; colour 3 on the lips.

Female/F_Eye_Mask_Rustbucket_02.description: A pair of bulging, faceted eye covers that stick out from the face like protruding goggles. Each has a round inset lens disc with an arrow symbol. Crude, chunky and monstrous-mechanical in style.
Female/F_Eye_Mask_Rustbucket_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer shells; colour 1 on the round lens discs; colour 2 on the arrow symbols.

Female/F_Eye_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A wraparound superhero eye mask with large angular lens openings, a V-shaped raised brow rim and a nose bridge, covering the eyes and upper cheeks and wrapping around the temples.
Female/F_Eye_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body; colour 1 on the raised brow rim along the top edge; colour 2 on the lens insets.

Female/F_Eye_Monocle_Classic_L_01.description: A single round monocle with a faceted, polygonal rim and a tinted lens worn over one eye, held by a thin wire arm that curves back over the cheek and hooks behind the ear. Classic, refined look.
Female/F_Eye_Monocle_Classic_L_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim; the lens is tinted and appears unaffected by the scheme; colour 2 on the thin wire arm.

Female/F_Eye_Monocle_Glass_Victorian_01.description: A small flat, round monocle lens disc with a thin rim, floating just in front of one eye. It reads as a Victorian-style eyepiece; only the glass insert is shown, with no frame or chain.
Female/F_Eye_Monocle_Glass_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin rim edge; the lens face is a translucent glass-like surface that appears to ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Monocle_Victorian_01.description: A single round monocle worn over one eye, with a thin rim and a glassy lens. A long fine chain hangs from it down the front of the chest and ends in a small hook. Victorian gentleman's style.
Female/F_Eye_Monocle_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim of the lens; colour 2 on the hanging chain; the lens itself is glassy and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Plague_Mask_01.description: A plague doctor mask with a long downward-curving beak, rounded eye openings and a hollow shell that covers the face, edged with a row of studs along the rim and down the beak.
Female/F_Eye_Plague_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell; colour 1 on the studs and the rims around the eye openings.
Female/F_Eye_Plague_Mask_01.differs: The female mask is a single uniform shell colour, while the male version has a contrasting two-tone pattern on the beak and face.

Female/F_Eye_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A wraparound visor-style eye mask with a V-shaped brow line, sharply upswept pointed wings at the temples and a deep point down over the nose bridge. It is a smooth angular shell that sits across the eyes.
Female/F_Eye_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell of the mask; colour 1 on the upper brow edge and inner back lining; the glossy finish shows highlights.
Female/F_Eye_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The female version appears to use a different default colour pattern, with a contrasting main shell and contrasting trim along the brow edge.

Female/F_Eye_Qularr1eyes_01.description: A single large insect-like eye: a hollow, faceted dome with a rim, and an iris with a contrasting central pupil. It sits over the middle of the forehead, giving a monstrous third-eye look.
Female/F_Eye_Qularr1eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and sclera; colour 1 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Female/F_Eye_Qularr2eyes_01.description: A pair of large, bulbous eyeballs, each with a round pupil and a faceted rim, mounted at the sides of the face beside the cheeks. They give an alien, insect-like look.
Female/F_Eye_Qularr2eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted rims and outer shells; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Eye_Qularr3eyes_01.description: Three separate bulbous insect-like eyeballs floating on the face: one centred on the brow above the nose and one on each cheek. Each is a rounded hollow dome with a pupil dot and a rim.
Female/F_Eye_Qularr3eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer edges of the eyeballs; colour 1 on the iris area of each eye; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Eye_Qularr4eyes_01.description: Four floating insect-like eyeballs, two on each side of the face: a large round eye hangs beside each cheek with a smaller eye above and behind it near the temple. Suggests an alien or monstrous look.
Female/F_Eye_Qularr4eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eye whites and rims; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Eye_Qularr_8eyes_01.description: Eight faceted, octagonal insect-style eyes arranged in two clusters of four, one on each side of the face beside the eye sockets and cheeks, each with a small contrasting pupil.
Female/F_Eye_Qularr_8eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyeball surfaces; colour 0 on the rims and highlights of each eye; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Eye_Qularr_Humanface_01.description: A pair of large, bulbous insect-style eye domes, each set in a raised rounded rim, sitting over the eye sockets like oversized goggles. The domes are smooth and glossy, giving an alien, bug-like look.
Female/F_Eye_Qularr_Humanface_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rims surrounding the eyes; colour 0 on the smooth domed eye surfaces.
Female/F_Eye_Qularr_Humanface_01.differs: The female eyes have smooth glossy domes and the two rims sit separate, while the male domes are faceted and the rims nearly touch at the nose bridge.

Female/F_Eye_R_Beast_Boar_01.description: A single small replacement eye for the right side of the head: a narrow, angled eyeball set into a pointed hooded lid, giving a sideways-set, beast-like eye. It sits at the temple, well to the side of the face.
Female/F_Eye_R_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hooded lid surround; the eyeball itself keeps its own texture and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Safety_Glasses_Glass_01.description: A wraparound visor-style pair of safety glasses: a single curved lens band spanning both eyes with a nose notch and angled side wings that wrap toward the temples. It has no frame or strap.
Female/F_Eye_Safety_Glasses_Glass_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole lens band; the glass-like material appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Eye_Safety_Goggles_01.description: Wraparound safety goggles with a single wide tinted lens in a rounded frame, side vent studs and small square buckles, held by a broad strap that loops over the top of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Safety_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle frame and side studs; colour 1 on the head strap; colour 3 on the square side buckles; the lens ignores the scheme and looks glassy.

Female/F_Eye_Safety_Goggles_Glass_01.description: Wraparound safety goggles with a single wide lens set in a moulded rim that curves back to the temples, with small round vent studs on each side. Sits across the eyes and brow, no strap visible.
Female/F_Eye_Safety_Goggles_Glass_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and rim; colour 2 on the side vent studs; the lens is glass and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Scuba_01.description: A full-face diving mask with an angular, faceted frame around a clear lens, a tall side-mounted snorkel tube topped with a mouthpiece-style cap, a corrugated hose curving under the chin, and crossing head straps at the back.
Female/F_Eye_Scuba_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and snorkel tube; colour 1 on the inner rim and lower panels; colour 3 on the head straps and snorkel tip; colour 2 on the corrugated hose.

Female/F_Eye_Spectacles_01.description: Small round wire-rimmed spectacles with two slightly octagonal lenses joined by a thin bridge. Thin arms run back along the head and end in small downward-curving tips behind the ears. Suggests a scholarly or vintage look.
Female/F_Eye_Spectacles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; the lenses show a tinted translucent look that ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Spectacles_Lens_01.description: A pair of thin, round faceted lenses for spectacles, floating in front of the eyes with no frames or arms. They sit slightly below the eye line and read as small tinted discs.
Female/F_Eye_Spectacles_Lens_01.colourAreas: The lenses ignore the colour scheme and show a translucent glassy tint; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Eye_Spectacles_Lens_01.differs: The female lenses sit slightly lower and lack the contrasting rim edge visible on the male ones.

Female/F_Eye_Spiked_01.description: A wide, flat band that wraps around the head at eye level, covering the eyes like a blindfold. Conical spikes stick out around its circumference, with small round studs between them. Punk or monstrous look.
Female/F_Eye_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 3 on the spikes and larger studs; colour 2 on the small round studs.

Female/F_Eye_Starhawk_01.description: Wraparound superhero goggles: a single curved lens with a wavy upper and lower edge sits over both eyes, framed by a raised rim and a short band that wraps back toward the temples.
Female/F_Eye_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised front rim; colour 1 on the inner side band; the lens is translucent and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Starhawk_02.description: Wraparound visor-style goggles: a single tinted lens with a V-shaped brow line sweeps across both eyes and curves back toward the temples, edged by a thin rim. Superhero or sci-fi eyewear.
Female/F_Eye_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and frame; the lens ignores the colour scheme and appears as tinted glass.

Female/F_Eye_Super_Retro_Destroyer_02.description: A retro superhero cowl-crown: a swept, V-dipping brow band with two tall, curved horn-like fins rising at the temples and a pointed, notched edge around the back of the head. Leaves the face and top of the head open.
Female/F_Eye_Super_Retro_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Default material appears mostly glossy metal and largely ignores the colour scheme; the light rim edge along the brow and fins may take colour 0.
Female/F_Eye_Super_Retro_Destroyer_02.differs: The female version's back edge dips into a slightly deeper, more pointed notch pattern and its fins sit a little higher and narrower.

Female/F_Eye_Swing_01.description: A pair of small reading glasses with two oval lenses in thin rounded rims joined by a short bridge, with straight arms running back over the ears. Sits on the nose and eyes; casual, bookish look.
Female/F_Eye_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frames and arms; the lenses are translucent and ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Swing_02.description: Twin-lens goggles with rounded shell housings joined by a thin bridge, each lens ringed by a contrasting bezel. A wide, gathered elastic strap wraps around the head, sitting across the eyes and forehead.
Female/F_Eye_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle shells and bridge; colour 1 on the head strap; colour 2 on the lens bezels; colour 3 on the lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Techno_01.description: A rigid, angular face-mask visor that wraps across the eyes and cheeks from ear to ear, tapering to a pointed lower edge over the nose, with small wedge-shaped studs at each outer corner. Suggests a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Eye_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main mask shell; colour 2 on the small wedge-shaped studs at the outer corners.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_01.description: A transparent wraparound visor-style pair of goggles: a single faceted clear lens band spanning both eyes with a notched lower edge over the nose, curving back toward the temples. Sleek retro 90s look with no visible strap.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour scheme barely shows; the clear glass-like lens ignores the colour slots and only the thin edge outline is faintly visible.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_02.description: A large transparent wraparound visor-style goggle lens that spans both eyes from temple to temple, with a straight top edge and a V-notched lower edge dipping over the nose. It has no visible strap or frame.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_02.colourAreas: Glass-like clear material that ignores the colour scheme; no visible areas take colour slots 0-3.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_02.differs: The female lens has a shallower, more angular V-cut along the lower edge and a slightly narrower shape.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Bat_Winged_01.description: A domino-style eye mask shaped like bat wings: a wide band across the eyes with scalloped, pointed wing tips sweeping up and out at the temples and teardrop lens openings. Sits close to the face in a superhero style.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Bat_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask frame; colour 1 on the lens inserts.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.description: A small angular brow and nose guard: a broad V-shaped plate across the forehead with swept-out winged tips, a central panel that drops into a narrow pointed strip running down the bridge of the nose.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer brow wings; colour 2 on the central forehead panel; colour 0 on the nose strip.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.differs: The female guard has a longer nose strip that reaches nearly to the nose tip and sits with steeper brow wings.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Face_Prisonguard_01.description: A rigid armored face plate covering the eyes and nose bridge: a heavy angular brow ridge, two hexagonal eye openings, a rounded nose cap and a contrasting lower edge. It sits across the upper face, suggesting a mechanical guard look.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Face_Prisonguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate body and brow; colour 3 on the eye panels; colour 1 on the nose cap; colour 2 on the lower edge trim.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Feather_01.description: A domino-style eye mask with two eye openings and feather-like wings sweeping up and outward over the brows and temples, a pointed central brow crest, and a beak-like point over the nose bridge. Bird-themed and fantasy in style.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body and upper wing feathers; colour 1 on the central brow crest; colour 2 on the outer wing feathers and edge layers; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Feather_02.description: A domino-style eye mask with a crossed, sculpted band over the nose and eyes, sweeping outward into layered feather wings that rise above each temple and reach toward the sides of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Feather_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mask band around the eyes; colour 2 on the upper feather layers; colour 3 on the feather strips; colour 0 on the lighter feather edges and eye rims.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Feather_03.description: A domino-style eye mask with swirling outlined eye surrounds and a pointed nose bridge, extending on one side into a tall swept-up feather-like plume across the forehead. Fitted flat to the face, with a stylised, masquerade look.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Feather_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask and feather panels; colour 1 on the swirling eye-surround linework; colour 2 on the outer edging and feather outlines; colour 3 on the nose bridge piece.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_01.description: A full-face gas mask in a smooth, skin-tight shell covering the face, with round rimmed eye lenses, a ribbed cylindrical filter snout over the mouth, and thin straps that cross over the top and back of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and head straps; colour 1 on the lens rims; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter snout.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.description: A full-face gas mask hugging the head, with rounded oval eye lenses in raised rims, a large filter canister on the mouth with a side canister, and thin straps crossing the back of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and head straps; colour 1 on the lens rims and side canister cap; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter canisters.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.differs: The female mask has a plain closed strap loop at the back, with a rounded frown-shaped lower strap.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.description: A wraparound tech visor with a contrasting glossy lens band edged in contrasting piping, a boxy device pod with a square panel on each temple, and a thin cable microphone boom curving down to the mouth.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the temple pods and side tabs; colour 1 on the lens rim piping, the back shield panel and the cable; colour 2 on the lens and mic tip; colour 3 on the pod panels.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The female back panel is coloured with colour 1, matching the rim piping.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Goggles_01.description: Chunky round-lensed goggles with thick octagonal rims joined by a curved bridge, held by a wide ribbed strap that wraps around the head. Small block hinges sit at the temples; a casual, retro-mechanical look.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 0 on the bridge and side hinge blocks; colour 2 with colour 0 striping on the head strap; colour 3 on the small strap patch.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.description: A faceted, star-shaped domino mask covering the eyes and brow, with a tall central point above the forehead, sharp wing points sweeping out to each side and small points beneath the eyes. Bold golden-age superhero style.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mask; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Greendragon_01.description: A close-fitting half mask covering the brow, cheeks and nose bridge, with two tall pointed wing-like horns sweeping up at the temples, eye cut-outs, a scale-textured pattern and a pointed beak-like nose piece.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Greendragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central brow and cheek areas; colour 1 on the scale-patterned wings; colour 3 around the eye openings; colour 2 on the nose piece and lower edges.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Jackfool_Skull_01.description: A cracked skull half-mask covering the brow, cheeks and nose, with two pointed horn-like ears on top, hollow eye sockets and an open contrasting mouth ringed by a row of teeth. Suggests a monstrous, gothic look.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Jackfool_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone of the skull; colour 1 on the teeth along the lower edge; colour 2 on the mouth cavity and crack lines.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Jackfool_Skull_02.description: A cracked bird-skull half mask covering the brow, eyes and nose, with pointed horn-like ears at the top, hollow eye sockets and a long downward-curving beak with nostril holes; small studded tabs sit at the beak's base.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Jackfool_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and beak; colour 1 on the small tabs at the base of the beak; colour 2 on the cracks and inner shadow.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Jeweled_01.description: A domino-style eye mask with upswept pointed outer corners and two eye openings, studded with scattered small raised gems or beads across the front. It sits close over the eyes and nose bridge, suiting a masquerade or superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Jeweled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the pointed outer tips, blending in from the edges; colour 2 and colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Jeweled_02.description: A domino-style eye mask with two eye openings joined over the nose and swept-up pointed wings at the outer corners. Rows of small studded gems line the front edge. It sits close on the face like a masquerade or superhero mask.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Jeweled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask body around the eyes and the inner edge; colour 1 on the pointed outer wings; colour 3 on some of the studded gems; colour 2 on the other gems.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Gladiator_01.description: A gladiator-style face mask that wraps the upper head and brow, with angular brow plates over the eyes, a long nose guard, and two cheek bars studded with small gems. A gem sits at the centre of the forehead.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and nose guard; colour 0 on the brow plates and cheek bars; colour 3 on the forehead gem and the studs.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_01.description: A close-fitting superhero domino mask covering the eyes, brow and upper cheeks, with angular pointed edges, a notch over the nose bridge and a contrasting inner band around the eye openings.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer mask shell; colour 1 on the inner band around the eyes; colour 3 on the thin rim of the eye openings; colour 2 on the outer edge lining.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_02.description: A tight, flat superhero domino mask wrapping across the eyes and nose bridge, with sharp pointed wings sweeping up at the temples, a angled brow band, and narrow angular eye openings with rimmed edges.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body; colour 1 on the angled brow band across the forehead; colour 3 on the rims around the eye openings; colour 2 on the thin outer edge outlines.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_02.differs: The female mask has shorter, less tall temple points and a slightly narrower brow band, with a thicker, curved bridge on the inside.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_03.description: A superhero half-mask covering the brow, eyes, cheeks and nose bridge, with a pointed forehead crest, a diamond gem at the centre, angled eye cut-outs and tiger-like stripes sweeping across the cheeks.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the diamond gem; colour 2 on the cheek stripes; colour 3 on the edge trim.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_03.differs: The female mask has a slightly narrower, more sharply pointed forehead crest and wing-like lower cheek points.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_04.description: A superhero domino-style eye mask with swept-up pointed ear-like tips on the brow, angular eye openings with raised rims, a nose bridge point and cheek wings. It sits flat against the upper face.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the raised rims around the eye openings; colour 2 on the thin edge outlines.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_06.description: A curved, shield-like domino mask covering the upper face: a wide plate with a notched top edge, hexagonal eye holes, a pointed nose bridge and side flanges running down the cheeks, edged with a thin contrasting rim.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the painted patches around the eyes; colour 1 on the eye-hole rims; colour 2 on the outer edge trim.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_06.differs: The female mask has a deeper V-shaped notch across the top edge and a slightly more curved plate.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_07.description: A superhero half-helmet mask covering the forehead, crown and eye area, with a raised central crest panel, angular eye openings, pointed cheek flares and a thin contrasting edge trim. The open back shows a hollow shell.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and cheek flares; colour 1 on the raised forehead crest panel; colour 3 on the thin edge trim; colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_08.description: A rigid superhero domino-style eye mask with angular hexagonal eye openings and a deep V-shaped upper edge that rises into two tall points over the brow. A small diamond gem sits at the bridge, with trim along the top edge.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_08.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 3 on the trim along the upper edge; colour 1 on the diamond gem at the brow; colour 2 on the eye opening rims.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Skull_01.description: A faceted, low-poly skull mask covering the forehead, eyes, nose and upper jaw, with a hollow interior, angular brow ridges, open eye sockets, a nose hole and a toothed lower edge. It suggests a menacing, monstrous look.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull crown, cheeks and teeth; colour 1 on the outer edges, brow rims and side panels; colour 3 on the streaks above the eyes and the nose strip.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Zorran_01.description: A metal half-mask helm covering the brow, eyes and nose bridge with angular plates and a pointed nose guard, topped with two large ridged ram horns that curl back and around the sides of the head. Beast-like fantasy styling.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Mask_Zorran_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask plates and the outer ridges of the horns; colour 1 on the inner curls and tips of the horns and the inner mask edges; colour 3 on the eye rims.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Maskfoxbat_01.description: A close-fitting face mask with a smooth shell covering the forehead and cheeks, two tall curved horn-like points rising above the brow, eye openings, a narrow nose stripe and a separate chin plate. Bat-like superhero style.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Maskfoxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and chin plate; colour 1 on the stripe down the nose.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Maskfoxbat_Zombie_01.description: A ragged, zombie-like half mask with a shell that wraps the face and sides of the head. It has tall pointed, chipped fins rising at the brow, a stripe down the nose bridge, cut-out eyes and a torn jaw edge.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Maskfoxbat_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and jaw piece; colour 1 on the stripe down the nose bridge.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Power_01.description: A set of small floating disc-shaped sensor pods arranged around the head: a ringed pod at the brow centre, pods beside each eye and at the back of the skull, and two larger domed discs at the temples. Sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two large temple discs; colour 0 on the ringed pods at the brow and eyes and on the rear discs; colour 2 on the pod centres and lens openings.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Pulp_Aviator_Goggles_.description: Pulp aviator goggles with two rounded-angular lenses in a thick metal frame, a padded cushion lining behind the eyes, and a thin strap with a small buckle circling the head.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Pulp_Aviator_Goggles_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and outer frame; colour 1 on the padded lining behind the lenses; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the inner frame rims.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Pulp_Aviator_Goggles_.description: Pulp aviator goggles pushed up onto the forehead: two rounded lenses in padded rims with a nose bridge, held by a thin band around the head and a wide padded panel at the back.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Pulp_Aviator_Goggles_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded goggle frames and head band; colour 2 on the rims and bridge fittings; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 1 on the back panel.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A bird-of-prey beak mask covering the eyes and nose: rounded eye rims sit on a ridged, downward-curving raven beak that hangs over the mouth, with side plates reaching back toward the temples.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beak and eye rims; colour 0 on the brow and lower edge trim and the side plates; colour 3 on the cheek recesses; colour 2 on the inner shadow panels.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Retroscifi_Goggles_01.description: A transparent wraparound visor-style goggle: one continuous curved lens shield covering both eyes and the nose bridge, with a thin outlined edge, a notch over the nose, and sides that curve back toward the temples.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Retroscifi_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour scheme barely shows; the whole lens is a translucent glassy surface, with only a faint edge outline picking up colour 0.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Riotfacemask_01.description: A riot-style face shield: a segmented headband circles the head and holds a thick brow bar, from which a curved transparent visor hangs down past the chin, edged with a thin rim.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Riotfacemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the headband; colour 2 on the brow bar and visor rim; colour 1 on the visor, which has a glassy gradient and mostly ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Riotfacemask_01.differs: The female shield sits higher, with a taller headband that rises above the brow bar; the male band is hidden behind the brow bar.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A sculpted half-face mask covering the forehead, brow and eye area down to the upper cheeks, with a scowling, wrinkled brow ridge, open eye holes and a thin curved stripe across the forehead.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the curved stripe across the forehead.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Sharp_01.description: Angular wraparound visor glasses with a broad V-shaped lens band across the eyes and long swept-back spikes at each temple, joined by a thin zigzag frame that runs around the back of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Sharp_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame rim; colour 1 on the inner temple spike panels; colour 2 on the outer spike tips; colour 3 on the lens.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Sharp_01.differs: The frame on this body appears darker and more metallic, with less of the light rim showing than on the male version.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Ski_01.description: Wraparound ski goggles with a large curved glossy lens in a rounded frame with a nose notch, held by a segmented, faceted strap that circles the head. Worn high on the forehead like a sporty headband.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame rim; colour 1 on the segmented head strap; the lens is glossy and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Ski_02.description: Ski goggles worn down over the eyes: a wide, rounded single-lens shield with a slim rim, held by a thick segmented strap that wraps around the head at brow level. Sporty, casual eyewear.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Ski_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented head strap; colour 0 on the rim around the lens; the glossy lens ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Tactical_01.description: A wraparound tactical visor: a wide angular band circles the head with a contrasting stripe at the back, and a single tinted lens strip covers the eyes with small indicator lights at the brow.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band and visor frame; colour 1 on the edge piping of the stripe; colour 3 on the back stripe and small brow indicators; colour 2 on the underside of the visor.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Tactical_02.description: A tactical visor band wrapping the head at brow level, with a raised slit housing across the front and a contrasting lens shield hanging below it over the eyes. A contrasting striped strip runs around the back of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Tactical_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band and slit housing; colour 2 on the lens shield beneath; colour 3 on the inner strip at the back and sides; colour 1 on the edging around that strip.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Tactical_03.description: A wraparound tactical visor band that sits across the eyes and brow: a faceted, angular top shell with small slit vents, a lower lens strip, and a rear strip with a side panel that reaches back around the head.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Tactical_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top shell and rim; colour 1 on the lower lens strip; colour 3 on the side and back accent strip; colour 2 on the inner rear edges.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Tactical_04.description: A wraparound tactical visor band worn across the eyes and brow: a broad angular shell with a flat raised top plate, a recessed lens strip with a thin trim line beneath, and a wide rear band with an inset stripe.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Tactical_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top plate and outer shell; colour 1 on the thin trim line under the lens; colour 3 on the inset stripe around the back and sides; colour 2 on the inner underside.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Tactical_04.differs: The top plate is a smooth, rounded slab with a small notch at the front, while the male version has a stepped brow ridge with a more open front.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Titan_01.description: A faceted, gem-like crest running from the brow up over the top of the head like a mohawk: a diamond-shaped central section, a tapering fin rising behind it, and a small angular nose-bridge plate at the front.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Titan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faceted sides of the diamond; colour 1 on the central front panel, the rear fin and the brow plate rim; colour 2 on the fin's centre strip; colour 3 on the small gems at the fin base and brow plate.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: A wide, angular domino-style eye mask with a pointed nose bridge and diamond-shaped eye holes, wrapping around the head to the temples. Its upper edge has contrasting trim, giving a classic vigilante superhero look.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body; colour 1 on the top edge trim and the vertical end panels at the sides.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Hawkmask_01.description: A half-face masquerade mask covering the brow, eyes and nose, with angular swept-up brow points, outlined eye openings and a long pointed beak-like nose ridge. Thin outline strips curve back toward the ears.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Hawkmask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the edge trim and around the eye openings; colour 2 on the linework curves; colour 3 on the central beak stripe.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Mask_01.description: A masquerade-style eye mask covering the brow, eyes, nose bridge and upper cheeks, with a pointed winged brow line, swirling scroll patterns, dotted accents and curled trim tails at the cheeks.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek panels; colour 2 on the brow and nose-bridge section; colour 1 on the swirl trim and edging; colour 3 on the small dots.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Mask_01.differs: The female mask has a sharper, V-shaped brow line that dips at the centre and narrower cheek panels.

Female/F_Eye_Tight_Wingedgoggles_Bluejay.description: Winged superhero eye goggles: a butterfly-shaped shell with swept-up pointed tips over the temples and two angular contrasting lenses set in thin rimmed frames, joined by a small nose bridge.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Wingedgoggles_Bluejay.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer wing-shaped shell; colour 1 on the lens rims and nose bridge; colour 3 on the small studs along the rims; colour 2 on the lenses.
Female/F_Eye_Tight_Wingedgoggles_Bluejay.differs: The female goggles have open contrasting lenses in thin rims, while the male version fills the eye cups with coloured panels, a contrasting band and a vertical stripe.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_01.description: A full mechanical helmet-mask covering the face and crown, with a angular brow plate, slanted eye patches, a pointed chin, tall swept-back spikes above the ears and boxy ear pods. A row of small dotted markings runs across the cheeks.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spikes; colour 2 on the brow band and lower face; colour 3 on the forehead plate and eye patches; colour 1 on the ear pods.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_01.differs: The female version has a row of small dotted markings across the cheeks that the male version lacks.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_02.description: A domino-style armored eye mask with a swept-back brow ridge that rises into sharp points at the temples, a pointed nose guard, jagged cheek plates, and side wings that wrap toward the back of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek plates, nose guard and rear wings; colour 1 on the brow ridge; colour 2 on the inner lining around the eyes; colour 3 on the eye lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_03.description: An asymmetric half-face mask: a swept-up angular plate covers one eye and brow with a raised, outlined almond cut-out and a pointed horn-like tip, joined to a curved lower guard over nose, mouth and cheeks.
