Female/F_Eye_Valorous_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eye plate and the inner surface; colour 1 on the lower mouth and cheek guard; colour 3 on the outline around the eye cut-out; colour 2 on the edge trim and the pointed tip.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_04.description: A robotic wolf or jackal head mask covering the face and skull: tall pointed ears with inner panels, a smooth snout with jagged jaw lines, round ear-cup discs at the sides, and a cap panel across the brow.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and ears; colour 1 on the brow and forehead cap panel; colour 3 on the ear interiors, eye slashes and jaw gaps; colour 2 on the side ear-cup discs.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_04.differs: The female snout is plain and smooth, without the rows of small binary-digit markings on the muzzle.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_05.description: A horned eye mask: a angular, pointed band across the eyes with a faceted central point over the nose and two tall curved horns sweeping up from the temples. Fantasy-armour style with a contrasting fringe of hair-like trim beneath.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask band and horns; colour 2 on the faceted centre point; colour 1 on the fringe of strands beneath the band.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_06.description: An owl-like eye mask with two tall swept-back horn points, a domed ridged crest over the brow, a beak-shaped nose piece and round goggle-like eye rings in angular plated housings across the upper face.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn points, brow plates and beak; colour 1 on the domed crest; colour 2 on the eye housings and lower trim; colour 3 on the round eye lenses.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_07.description: A sleek domino-style eye mask with swept-back wing-like points at the temples, angled eye openings and a pointed nose bridge. A crescent brow band crosses the forehead and a broad panel wraps the back of the head.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell and side wings; colour 1 on the forehead crescent, the under-eye trim and the back-of-head panel.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_08.description: A domino-style superhero eye mask with a sharp angular brow ridge, pointed eye openings and a downward-pointing nose bridge. Jagged lightning-like spikes flare down over the cheeks, and it wraps closely around the eyes.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_08.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised brow ridge and the inner lining; colour 3 on the main mask face around the eyes; colour 1 on the jagged cheek spikes and the small patches inside the lining.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_Glass_01.description: A curved, smooth face plate that wraps from the brow down past the nose to a point below the mouth, with pixelated angry eye shapes and a small stitched-smile line. Modern sci-fi cyber mask.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_Glass_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the pixelated eye shapes; colour 2 on the smile line and lower edge shading.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_Glass_01.differs: The female plate is plain, while the male version has a scatter of binary digit markings across the cheeks and lower face.

Female/F_Eye_Valorous_Glass_04.description: A sleek, glossy full-face mask shell covering the face from brow to chin in a pointed, muzzle-like shape, with a raised rim, jagged zigzag mouth line, slanted eye markings and a scatter of binary digits across the cheeks.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_Glass_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and raised rim; colour 3 on the slanted eye markings; colour 2 on the zigzag mouth line; colour 1 not clearly visible. The binary digits are a lighter surface print.
Female/F_Eye_Valorous_Glass_04.differs: The female mask has a pattern of binary digits printed across the cheeks and muzzle, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Eyes_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_0.description: Two separate short, chunky octagonal barrel goggles sitting over each eye, each with a bright rim ring around a deep contrasting lens opening. The backs are closed with faceted caps. No strap is visible, giving a compact sci-fi look.
Female/F_Eyes_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrel bodies; colour 0 on the front rim rings; colour 2 inside the lens openings.
Female/F_Eyes_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_0.differs: The female version has closed, faceted back caps on the barrels and slightly shorter, tapered housings, while the male barrels are open tubes.

Female/F_Eyes_Tight_Robot_Eyes_01.description: A robotic cyclops face plate: a curved angular shell wrapping across the brow, eyes and cheeks with a single large round lens in a raised housing, small rivet dots along the edges and slashed vents near the bottom.
Female/F_Eyes_Tight_Robot_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 1 on the eye housing and the inside ring; colour 2 on the lens; colour 3 on the rivet dots and slash marks.

Female/F_F_Head_Tight_Variablerobot_01.description: A full robotic helmet with a boxy, faceted shell, narrow eye slits, an angular faceplate and a small slot on the forehead. Round disc-like ear pods and a jaw strut sit at the sides, giving a mechanical sci-fi look.
Female/F_F_Head_Tight_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main helmet shell and faceplate; colour 3 on the ear discs, jaw strut and chin trim; colour 2 on the small forehead slot and eye recesses.

Female/F_Foot_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.description: A clawed monster foot covering the left foot up to the ankle: a bulbous, lumpy talon-like shape with three forward toes tipped in long curved claws, a smaller side toe, and a contrasting band at the ankle opening.
Female/F_Foot_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the foot body and toes; colour 1 on the band at the ankle; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Animal_01.description: A bare beast-like left foot with three thick rounded toes tipped in long curved claws, a small side dew-claw and a raised ankle ridge. It replaces the foot at the ankle, giving a monstrous reptilian look.
Female/F_Footl_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour slots appear not to affect the skin-textured foot; the claws show a fixed glossy finish that ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Animal_02.description: A left foot shaped like an animal paw, with a furry, sinewy top, a low ankle cuff, four toes and curved pointed claws. The sole has a ragged fur edge and a small dewclaw at the heel. Suits beast or monster looks.
Female/F_Footl_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furry upper foot and toes; colour 1 on the sole and the ragged fur edge at the toes and heel; colour 3 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A low, ankle-high retro robot shoe with a smooth glossy upper, a thick flat sole and a wide separate cuff around the ankle carrying a round button-like stud on the outer side. Sleek, toy-like sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Footl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the round stud.

Female/F_Footl_Arcane_01.description: A knee-high scaled boot with an overlapping fish-scale pattern along the shin and calf, a pointed toe cap, zigzag trim over the instep, and a flared top with a gem-set diamond plate and swept-up spiked fins.
Female/F_Footl_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled shaft and toe band; colour 1 on the toe cap and the flared spikes; colour 2 on the front top plate; colour 3 on the gem.

Female/F_Footl_Armor_Rockcrystal_01.description: A chunky left boot-and-shin guard built from stacked, rounded stone slabs with crack lines between them, and contrasting crystal shards jutting from the outer calf. It rises to mid-calf with a raised front peak, in a monstrous fantasy style.
Female/F_Footl_Armor_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between slabs and the inner opening; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Female/F_Footl_Armor_Rockcrystal_01_1.description: A chunky left boot built from stacked, cracked rock slabs, rising to mid-calf with a jagged peak at the front and clustered crystal shards jutting from the outer side and back. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Female/F_Footl_Armor_Rockcrystal_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between the stones and the inner lining; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Female/F_Footl_Astronaut_01.description: A low, chunky astronaut shoe with a thick platform sole and a ribbed, rounded protective toe cap. The soft upper has a rolled cuff at the ankle and a small tab on the instep. Sporty sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the sole and toe cap; colour 3 on the instep tab.

Female/F_Footl_Astronaut_02.description: A low ankle shoe with a chunky platform sole and a rounded, ridged toe cap, a soft upper with a small tongue panel, and a padded cuff at the ankle. Sporty sci-fi astronaut styling.
Female/F_Footl_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the tongue panel; colour 2 on the sole and toe cap.

Female/F_Footl_Beast_Mechanical_01.description: A mechanical beast-claw foot piece: a cuffed ankle housing with a round gear detail, extended toes of cylindrical joints tipped with long curved talons, and a rear spur claw on a jointed strut. Replaces the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Beast_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ankle housing, toe cylinders and talon panels; colour 0 on the talons and cuff rim; colour 2 on the inner claw blades and mechanical joints; colour 3 on small accents in the rear claw.

Female/F_Footl_Boots_Goth_01.description: A chunky ankle boot with a rounded reinforced toe cap, front lacing with eyelets, a folded-over cuff at the ankle wrapped by a buckled strap, and a thick lugged sole. Suits punk and gothic looks.
Female/F_Footl_Boots_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and cuff; colour 1 on the thick lugged sole; colour 2 on the ankle strap; colour 3 on the buckle and eyelets.

Female/F_Footl_Boots_Goth_02.description: A mid-calf lace-up boot with a rolled cuff, criss-cross laces with eyelets, two wide padded straps across the shin, and a chunky platform sole with a thin accent line. Gothic street style.
Female/F_Footl_Boots_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the two shin straps; colour 3 on the laces, eyelets, strap buttons and sole accent line.

Female/F_Footl_Boots_Ski_01.description: A chunky padded ankle-high ski boot with a thick rounded sole, a stitched toe cap, three cross straps with small fasteners over a padded tongue, and a wide trimmed cuff. Sporty winter style.
Female/F_Footl_Boots_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and tongue; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the piping, cuff rim and straps; colour 3 on the strap fasteners.
Female/F_Footl_Boots_Ski_01.differs: The female boot has a taller cuff and a more upright tongue with an emblem ring at the top.

Female/F_Footl_Boots_Spy_01.description: A single calf-high leather boot with a smooth rounded toe, a low block heel and a tall straight shaft with a turned-down inner cuff. Two small buttons sit on the outer side of the top; the look is neat, spy-like and casual.
Female/F_Footl_Boots_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall upper shaft and cuff; colour 1 on the foot and ankle section; colour 3 on the two buttons; colour 2 on the sole and heel.

Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Cryo_01.description: A pair of segmented, ribbed tube coils that curve around the lower left calf and ankle as an open, split ring, with a gap at front and back. It reads as a mechanical cryo hose or cable.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole segmented tube; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Cryo_01.differs: The female tubes are taller and narrower, forming a slim upright loop that reaches higher up the calf.

Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Draco_01.description: A single curved dragon-fin blade attached to the outside of the left lower leg, swept up into a long hooked spike above a cluster of layered, jagged fin-like plates that point downward toward the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole fin blade and its plates; colour 0 on the edge of the lower plates.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Draco_01.differs: The female fin hangs lower on the calf with a shorter, straighter upper spike and less of a hook.

Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_0.description: A small curved greave plate worn on the lower left leg, shaped like a blocky robotic face with two ear-like corners, hexagonal socketed eyes, a nose ridge and a ribbed mouth strip; the back is a plain flat panel.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame, ears and nose ridge; colour 0 on the face panel and back panel; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth.

Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_0.description: A minimal sandal-like foot accessory: a thin looped sole outline with an open toe hole, and a single wide instep strap with a notched, V-shaped top edge and contrasting trim, sitting over the top of the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the instep strap; colour 0 on the strap's edge trim; colour 2 on the thin sole outline and the inner back panel.

Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Steelcommand.description: A single curved, blade-like greave plate that flares outward from the outer lower leg, tapering to a sharp upward point, with raised ridge lines and an angular inset panel near the base. Sci-fi armour style.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Steelcommand.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and ridges; colour 1 on the angular inset panel near the lower edge; colour 2 on the outer surface and edges.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Greave_Steelcommand.differs: The female plate is longer and narrower, with a slimmer, more upright blade.

Female/F_Footl_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small robotic face plate worn on the left lower leg below the knee: a curved angular frame with two ear-like corners, hex-socketed round eyes, a nose ridge and a ribbed mouth strip, with a plain panel on the back.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and nose ridge; colour 0 on the face and back panel; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth strip.

Female/F_Footl_Child_Renegade_01.description: A small set of three separate conical spikes of different sizes that jut out around the left ankle and heel: one tall central spike and two angled side spikes. Monstrous, aggressive accent with no boot or cover.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall central spike; colour 1 on the spike at the inner side; colour 2 on the spike at the outer side.

Female/F_Footl_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A tiny flat octagonal cap or disc sitting around the lower leg just above the ankle, like a thin cut-off seal. It is a minimal utility piece for capping leg pieces, with no visible detail.

Female/F_Footl_Child_Wheelie_01.description: A small wheel mounted on the outer side of the left ankle: a thick rounded tyre ring around a hub with a raised star-shaped centre and thin spokes. Playful, cartoonish mechanical accessory.
Female/F_Footl_Child_Wheelie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tyre ring; colour 2 on the star hub; colour 1 on the spokes behind the star.

Female/F_Footl_Clown_01.description: A soft, low jester shoe with a slouchy ankle-high body, a long upturned curling toe ending in a round pom-pom, and a flared cuff at the back carrying a diamond emblem. Playful clown style.
Female/F_Footl_Clown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body; colour 1 on the toe pom-pom and the back cuff; colour 3 on the diamond emblem.

Female/F_Footl_Corrupted_01.description: A left boot of overlapping armored plates: a flared ankle cuff with a small crystal spike, a smooth central shaft, and a toe of layered, clawed scale-plates that fan out in points. Suggests a monstrous, mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff plates and toe scales; colour 0 on the central shaft; colour 2 on the cuff rim and plate outlines; colour 3 on the small crystal spike.

Female/F_Footl_Cosmic_01.description: A sci-fi mechanical calf-high boot with a thick banded cuff at the top, a small angular plate on the outer side, strapped shin and ankle sections, and a rounded toe cap. Sits over the lower leg and foot.
Female/F_Footl_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, shin panel and ankle plate; colour 1 on the calf, ankle section and boot sides; colour 2 on the top cuff and straps; colour 3 on the thin accent line above the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Cosmic_01.differs: The female boot has a contrasting calf that is fuller at the back, with a pointed heel section, and the front shin has a central contrasting stripe.

Female/F_Footl_Cosmos_02.description: A chunky angular ankle boot with a faceted pointed toe, a plated heel and side section, a raised separate panel over the instep, and a straight cuff at the ankle. Thin sole edge; sturdy sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel and side plating and the instep panel; colour 1 on the toe cap and the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the sole edge.

Female/F_Footl_Cryo_01.description: A low, ankle-high sneaker-style boot with a slouched, wrinkled upper, a rounded contrasting toe cap, a thin flat sole band and a small notch panel at the heel. Sits on the left foot with a casual, sporty look.
Female/F_Footl_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the slouched upper; colour 2 on the toe cap; colour 1 on the sole and heel panel; colour 3 on the small heel stripe.

Female/F_Footl_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A knee-high high-heeled boot with segmented armored plating: a pointed kneecap guard, layered shin and ankle plates, a reinforced toe cap and a flared upper cuff. It suggests a rugged cyber-western look.
Female/F_Footl_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plating, toe cap, heel and trim bands; colour 3 on the shin and calf panels; colour 1 on the small studs at the sides.

Female/F_Footl_Defender_Update_01.description: A calf-high angular armoured boot with a pointed flared cuff at the top, faceted shin and calf panels, a recessed side panel, and a layered plated toe and ankle section on a flat sole. Suits a superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shin plate, ankle plates and sole; colour 1 on the main calf and toe panels; colour 2 on the top cuff and toe cap; colour 3 on the recessed side panel.

Female/F_Footl_Detective_01.description: A casual ankle boot with a rounded toe cap, a thick sole and a folded-over padded cuff, criss-cross laced at the front. A short sock-like inner cuff pokes out of the top.
Female/F_Footl_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and folded cuff; colour 1 on the sole and a thin strip under the laces; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the inner sock cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Detective_02.description: A low ankle shoe in a two-tone spectator style: a rounded toe cap and a taller ankle cuff with a slightly flared top edge, front lacing, and a thin flat sole. Suits a retro detective or casual look.
Female/F_Footl_Detective_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff; colour 1 on the toe cap and the lace tongue; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Draco_01.description: A low, angular armoured shoe for the left foot with a broad panelled upper, a pointed toe cap, small spikes along the sides and a tall pointed fin rising at the ankle front with an inset gem.
Female/F_Footl_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe upper; colour 1 on the toe cap panel and ankle collar; colour 2 on the outlines, trim bands and spikes; colour 3 on the ankle gem.

Female/F_Footl_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.description: A clawed, dragon-like left foot: a bulbous, scaly-looking paw with three large curved front talons and a small rear spur, ending at the ankle with a short cuff and a contrasting side panel.
Female/F_Footl_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the ankle panel; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Dryad_01.description: A left foot covering shaped like a creature paw: an ankle-high sleeve with bark-like ridged folds running down to a broad, sculpted foot with five short toes ending in sharp curved claws.
Female/F_Footl_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main paw and ankle surface; colour 3 on the thin vein-like markings running along the ridges; colour 2 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Dryad_03.description: A beast-like left foot covering with layered, petal-like organic ridges sweeping over the instep, pointed spurs at the ankle and a rounded heel, ending in separate toes with contrasting claws. Fantasy creature style.
Female/F_Footl_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot body and ridges; colour 1 on the streaked patch along the instep and heel; colour 2 on the claw tips; colour 3 on thin veining lines.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Arvad_01.description: A decorative calf ornament on the left lower leg: a pair of tall, curved scroll-like frame pieces meet in a lyre shape, with swirling spiral flourishes set within. Sits on the outer shin as an ornate accent.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer curved frame; colour 1 on the curling flourishes at either side; colour 2 on the central spiral.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Raptor_Claw_01.description: A set of separate curved talons for the left foot: a tall hooked spur rising at the heel or ankle, plus several smaller claws fanned out around the toes. Suggests a raptor or beast-foot look.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Raptor_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the claws and the spur; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Reactor_04.description: A minimal sandal-like sole for the left foot: a thin flat platform with a raised rim, a single angled strap band across the instep, and one tall cone spike jutting up at the toe.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat footbed; colour 1 on the sole rim and the instep strap; colour 3 on the toe spike.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tactical_01.description: A pair of small hexagonal cylinder canisters dangling by thin flexible cables near the lower calf and ankle, with banded striped sides and a ringed base. A mechanical gadget accessory with a sci-fi tactical look.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the cables, base rings and part of the diagonal stripes; colour 3 on the other stripes; colour 2 on the canister ends.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A column of three curved, pointed fin-like spikes stacked down the outer side of the left lower leg, sweeping backward and upward like an aquatic fin ridge. It suggests a monstrous, sea-creature look.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 1 on the faceted edges and undersides of the spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Iceskates_01.description: A bare ice-skate blade for the left foot: a long, thin metal runner with a curved underside and short upright posts at the heel, middle and toe, plus small teeth at the toe tip. It sits under the sole with no boot.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Iceskates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; the default metal appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes with jagged barbed edges that sweep up and down along the outer calf, attached at the lower leg. Monstrous, mechanical, gothic styling with recessed inset panels.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade bodies and edges; colour 3 on the recessed inset panels.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.differs: The female blades sit slightly higher and are more separated, with longer thin tips extending up the calf.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes on the left lower leg, each with an angular frame around an inset panel and long tapering points sweeping up and down. It suggests a monstrous, mechanical fantasy look.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade frames and spikes; colour 3 on the inset panels between the blades.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.description: Left-foot punk spike decoration: a dense cluster of pyramid studs across the toe and top of the foot, plus a thin curved row of small spikes around the back of the ankle. No boot body is visible.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the studs and spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Rollerblade_0.description: A set of four inline skate wheels in a single row beneath the left foot, each a rounded disc with a recessed hub. There is no boot, only the wheels, giving a sporty, mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Tight_Rollerblade_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wheel rims and outer tyres; colour 1 on the wheel hubs; colour 2 on the small inner rings and axle edges.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Valerian_02.description: A small cross-shaped armour plate strapped to the left lower leg just below the knee, with a raised rim around a recessed cross panel and angular chamfered edges. Suggests a gothic, knightly greave accent.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Valerian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim; colour 2 on the recessed cross panel in the centre.

Female/F_Footl_Extra_Victory_01.description: A small ornamental ankle fin for the left foot: two slim, curling blade-like fronds sweep upward from the heel, one larger and one shorter, with contrasting outlined edges. Suggests a winged or fantasy boot accent.
Female/F_Footl_Extra_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the larger outer frond; colour 1 on the smaller inner frond; colour 2 on the edge outlines.

Female/F_Footl_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A blocky mechanical left boot-leg with angular plated shin, a toothed jaw-like opening at the front, fin-like side panels and a pointed claw toe. It reads as a robotic or monstrous armoured foot piece.
Female/F_Footl_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin and boot body; colour 3 on the side fins, jaw panels and toe claw; colour 2 on the lower foot and inner toothed opening; colour 0 on the teeth.

Female/F_Footl_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A plain ankle-high boot for the left foot with a smooth rounded toe, a thin flat sole and a small low heel. It has no visible fastenings and stops just above the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.
Female/F_Footl_Foxbatcon_2025_01.differs: The female version has a thin sole with a small low heel, making it a proper ankle boot, while the male version is a soft sock-like shoe with no sole.

Female/F_Footl_Gamer_01.description: A chunky ankle-high sneaker boot with a padded flared collar, a wide strap across the ankle, small angular gem-like side plates, short contrasting laces, and a thick layered sole. Sporty, gamer-inspired look.
Female/F_Footl_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body and toe; colour 1 on the collar, ankle strap, heel and sole trim; colour 3 on the side plates; colour 2 on the laces and sole.

Female/F_Footl_Gladiator_01.description: A left ankle-high shoe with a soft, slightly slouched cloth upper, a large rounded toe cap, a thick edged sole and a faceted heel block at the back. A pointed angular panel sits over the front of the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth upper; colour 1 on the toe cap and sole edging; colour 2 on the front ankle panel; colour 3 on the faceted heel block.

Female/F_Footl_Gladiator_02.description: A chunky ankle boot with a broad rounded toe cap, a thick flat sole, a tall panelled shaft and a angular heel guard. Separate front and side panels give it a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap and lower vamp; colour 1 on the shaft and side panels; colour 3 on the front tongue panel and heel plate; colour 2 on the sole and heel trim.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Alien_01.description: A left shin and calf greave of angular alien armor: a large smooth shell wraps the back and sides of the lower leg, with stacked overlapping segment plates down the front and small spikes on the outer side.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer shell and edge rim; colour 1 on the segmented front plates; colour 3 on the spikes and the diamond studs on the shell.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Alien_02.description: A left shin and calf greave with a tall smooth back plate that flares upward, and a front of stacked, chevron-ridged plates. Small spikes stick out at the sides and a few gouged marks sit on the back plate. Alien, beastly armor.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large back shell and edge rim; colour 1 on the stacked front plates; colour 3 on the side spikes and the small diamond marks on the back plate.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Alien_02.differs: The female greave has small contrasting diamond marks on the back plate, and its spikes sit further forward at the sides.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Anniversary_Destro.description: A single left shin greave: a rigid front plate that narrows to a strap tab with a small round gem at the top, wrapped around a calf section of stacked horizontal ribbed bands, with flared rims at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Anniversary_Destro.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front plate, rims and strap tab; colour 1 on alternating ribbed bands; colour 0 on the remaining bands; colour 3 on the small gem.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Anniversary_Mechan.description: A small faceted knee guard shaped like a rough, angular rock, with a few round dished rivet-like recesses on the front and an open, hollow back. It sits over the left knee, with a retro robotic look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Anniversary_Mechan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole knee guard, with a metallic finish; the scheme's other colour slots are not visible on it.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Aquatic_01.description: A left shin and calf greave of segmented curved plates with contrasting edging, a pointed diamond crest and spiked upper front, and a flared lower cuff ending in a small point. Sits over the lower leg, suggesting aquatic armor.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main curved plates; colour 0 on the lower cuff; colour 3 on the front diamond panel and crest gem; colour 2 on the edging, rim and spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Armored_01.description: A short armoured greave for the left lower leg: a plated front shield with a contrasting inset panel and a slot detail, open segmented back straps, and a flared cuff at the ankle. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and back straps; colour 2 on the front inset panel; colour 3 on the slot detail and thin accent line above the cuff; colour 1 on the ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Arvad_01.description: A small ornamental greave on the lower left shin: two tall curving frame arms meet in a lyre-like loop, with scrolled curls and a spiral motif set inside. Decorative rather than enclosing, with a fantasy-mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer curved frame; colour 1 on the outer scrolled curls; colour 2 on the central spiral.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ascendant_01.description: A shin-length armoured greave with a flared upper cuff, a pointed front plate with a gem-like inset, a central spine down the front and a separate ankle strap over a low, pointed-toe shoe cover. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim trim, central spine and ankle strap edging; colour 1 on the upper shin plate and the shoe cover; colour 2 on the lower greave body and heel; colour 3 on the gem inset and toe accent.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ascendant_02.description: A knee-high armoured greave boot for the left leg, with a flared back cuff, a pointed front shin plate holding a V-shaped inset panel, a contrasting band below the knee and a rounded armoured toe cap.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main boot shell and shin plate; colour 3 on the knee inset panel and small toe gem; colour 0 on the band below the knee and the toe trim; colour 2 on the shin panel and toe stripe.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ascendant_02.differs: The female boot has a slimmer, taller shaft and a more pointed toe; the male toe cap is chunkier and rounder.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ascendant_03.description: A low, armoured shoe piece for the left foot: a pointed, plated toe cap and instep with a raised rim, and a chunky angular heel block behind, with a small V-shaped accent at the front of the toe.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ascendant_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toe and instep plate; colour 0 on the raised rim edging; colour 2 on the heel block; colour 3 on the small toe accent.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ascendant_04.description: A chunky, rounded left shoe covering the foot, with a squared toe cap, a small pointed tongue panel at the ankle, and a large curved heel-guard plate standing behind the foot. Suits a sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ascendant_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shoe body and rear heel plate; colour 0 and colour 2 on the two stripe bands across the toe; colour 3 on the small triangular tongue accent.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Blockbuster_01.description: A chunky angular greave for the left lower leg: a faceted armored shell with a flared open top, a padded inner cuff, side fins and round pods with glowing lens-like centres near the ankle. Mechanical, monstrous look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and fins; colour 1 on the inner cuff and the back strip panel; colour 2 on the round pods; colour 3 on the pod lenses and the small front panel.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Blockbuster_01.differs: The female greave is narrower and taller, with a longer shell up the calf and smaller flared side fins.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Blockbuster_02.description: A left-leg shin greave in smooth sculpted plating, tapering from a raised calf-level shield down to a notched hem above the ankle. A contrasting upper panel holds a recessed oval insert, with rounded side pods at the knee.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell; colour 1 on the upper shield panel and its edging; colour 2 on the side pods; colour 3 on the oval insert.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Blockbuster_02.differs: The female greave has a slightly more pointed, tapering lower hem and a narrower fit around the calf.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Boot_Spurs_01.description: A western-style riding spur: a U-shaped curved band that wraps around the back of the ankle, with a small hooked bracket and a spiked rowel wheel projecting rearward, and rounded pads at the band ends.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Boot_Spurs_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the band and hooked bracket; colour 0 on the spiked rowel wheel; colour 3 on the rounded end pads; colour 2 on the pad rims.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Bounty_01.description: A calf accessory of a boxy flap pouch with a small emblem, beside a row of short cylindrical canisters or shells with banded middles, arranged loosely around the lower leg. Suggests a bounty-hunter sci-fi western look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body; colour 2 on the pouch edging and the canister ends; colour 1 on the canister bands; colour 3 on the pouch emblem.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Bounty_02.description: A short armored greave wrapping the left lower leg: a tapered shell with layered front plates, a contrasting recessed vertical strip down the shin, and a wide gathered cloth band around the middle. Rugged space-western look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor shell plates; colour 1 on the gathered band around the middle; colour 2 on the recessed strip down the front.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Brutal_01.description: A left shin greave with a jagged, crown-like upper edge and a pointed front plate, wrapped in spiralling bands over a contrasting shell. A pointed lower plate sits above a ragged, frayed fringe and a bunched cuff at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapping bands, the jagged top edge and the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the shell and the lower plate; colour 3 on the strips between the bands and the front knob; colour 1 on the frayed fringe and the inner lining.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Brutal_02.description: A flat sandal with a thick rope-edged sole, a toe-post thong, and a wide wrapped cloth band crossing over the top of the foot with a thin strap looping behind the heel. Casual, tribal look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped cloth band and heel strap; colour 1 on the sole insole; colour 2 on the rope-like sole edge and toe post.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Brutal_03.description: A flat sandal with a thick rope-like rim around the sole, a wide crumpled wrap strap across the top of the foot, a thin toe post and a slim strap looping behind the heel. Suggests a rugged, tribal look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide wrap strap and heel strap; colour 1 on the sole insole; colour 2 on the rope-like sole rim and toe post.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Brutal_04.description: A small diamond-shaped plate worn on the outer side of the lower leg below the knee, with a raised bevelled rim, a recessed inner panel and a bat-wing-like scalloped inset at the top.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Brutal_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim; colour 1 on the main inner panel; colour 2 on the scalloped upper inset.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Buckled_01.description: A pair of thick octagonal straps worn on the left leg, one below the knee and one at the ankle, each fastened with a square buckle on the front of the shin.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Buckled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 2 on the square buckle frames; colour 3 on the small buckle pins.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Buckled_02.description: A short octagonal ankle cuff worn on the left ankle, with a large square buckle and prong on the outer front and a small contrasting-accented rivet beside it. Reads as a simple strap or band.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Buckled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the square buckle frame and prong; colour 3 on the small rivet detail.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Bunny_01.description: A plush, open-backed bunny slipper with a rounded fluffy toe box, stitched face details, two upright ear flaps on top and a small pom tail at the heel. Worn on the left foot; cute, casual loungewear.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Bunny_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the slipper body and outer ears; colour 1 on the inner ears, nose and insole; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the tail pom.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Buckled_02.description: A wide octagonal ankle cuff worn on the left ankle, with a large square buckle and thin prong on the outer front. It has a soft, slightly creased strap and reads as a simple belt-like band.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Buckled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the square buckle frame and prong; colour 3 on the small rivet or stud at the buckle centre.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Kaiju_02.description: A small monstrous knee guard: a curved, scoop-shaped plate wraps the front of the leg below the knee, with a rounded domed cap behind and a cluster of tall curved horn spikes sweeping upward.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved outer plate; colour 3 on the domed cap; colour 2 on the horn spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mecha_01.description: A small rectangular armoured plate strapped to the front of the left lower leg below the knee, with a bevelled rim, four slim slot vents and an open back with a channel between two side flanges.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and rim; colour 1 on the inner back channel; colour 3 on the four slot inserts.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mecha_01.differs: The female plate is smaller and shorter, sitting as a compact block on the shin.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mecha_02.description: A boxy mechanical kneepad plate that wraps partway around the front of the left knee, with angled side flanges, a bevelled top edge and four small slotted vents on the face. Suggests a robotic or sci-fi armour look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and bevelled edge; colour 1 on the inner back panel; colour 3 on the four slotted vents.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mutated_01.description: Three small pointed spikes in a vertical row along the outside of the left lower leg, each a short faceted pyramid-like cone angled outward and slightly backward. A monstrous, mutated leg accent.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mutated_01.differs: The female spikes are short, angular faceted pyramids, whereas the male ones are curved, horn-like cones.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mutated_02.description: A vertical row of three small, sharp pointed spikes running down the outer side of the lower leg, angled outward like thorns. Suggests a monstrous or mutated look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Mutated_02.differs: The female spikes are shorter and more compact, and they angle a little more sharply toward the back.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spi.description: A scatter of small cone-shaped spikes studding the left lower leg: a larger cluster of angled spikes near the knee and a sparser lower group around the calf, pointing outward in several directions.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the larger spikes near the knee; colour 1 on the smaller angled spikes in the knee cluster; colour 2 on the lower calf spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spi.description: A small mechanical accessory on the lower leg: a flexible ribbed hose arcs from a hexagonal fitting to a short cylindrical canister with a banded end cap, dangling around the side of the calf.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spi.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hose; colour 0 on the canister body; colour 1 on the small label patch on the canister; colour 2 on the hexagonal fitting and canister end caps.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A small calf-mounted pod: a curved, wedge-shaped bracket wraps the outer leg and carries two upright canisters with ridged screw caps and contrasting nozzle bases, like retro rocket thrusters. Mechanical, pulp sci-fi style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved mounting bracket; colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 2 on the screw caps and lower nozzles; colour 3 on the nozzle tips.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.differs: The female canisters sit closer together and overlap more from the front, on a slightly more compact bracket.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A small boxy vent module strapped to the left leg near the knee: a squared metal frame with louvred slats at the front, a plain slab panel behind, and a ring detail on the side. Retro mechanical style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal frame, slats and side ring; colour 1 on the back slab panel; colour 3 on the recessed interior behind the slats; colour 2 on the side plate.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A small boxy vent unit worn on the outside of the left lower leg below the knee: a square metal frame with slatted louvres at the front, a smooth angled backing plate and a ring detail on the side.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal frame, louvres and ring; colour 1 on the backing plate; colour 3 on the recessed interior behind the louvres; colour 2 on the side panel.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A pair of short flexible wire-wrapped hoses on the left lower leg below the knee, each curving around the leg and ending in a boxy exhaust-like nozzle at the back, with small clamp rings. Mechanical, retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped hoses and clamp rings; colour 1 on the boxy nozzle ends.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: Two short mechanical pipe pieces on the left lower leg below the knee, each a wrapped flexible hose bending out from a blocky cylindrical canister with a small ring collar. Industrial, retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar rings; colour 1 on the canisters; colour 2 on the wrapped hoses.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A pair of short flexible wire conduits that arch around the left lower leg just below the knee, each ending in a boxy cylindrical canister with a thin ring collar. Mechanical, retro-industrial accent.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrapped wire tubing; colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the thin collar rings.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A short, crumpled metal wrap band worn around the left leg at the knee, with rippled folds and a slightly flared upper rim. Reads as a retro, mechanical knee guard.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: The default glossy metal largely ignores the colour scheme; faint colour 0 shows on the upper rim highlights and the folds read near colour 2.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Scarab_01.description: A single curved scarab-like pincer or horn that arcs out from the outer lower leg, with a smooth tapering hook at one end and a segmented, pointed tip at the other. It suggests a monstrous, insectoid greave accent.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tapering hooked arm; colour 1 on the thick upper arc; colour 2 on the small joint band; colour 3 on the pointed tip.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Scarab_02.description: A single curved, horn-like scarab claw accessory on the left lower leg: one long arched spine sweeps around the calf and ends in a hooked tip, while a second separate horn crosses over it near the knee.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower curled tip; colour 2 on the middle segment; colour 3 on the upper horns.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Scarab_02.differs: The female version has two horns that stay more upright and cross less sharply over the calf, and the lower curl is shorter.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Swan_01.description: A feathery, flame-like cuff wrapped around the left knee, with jagged pointed tips along the top edge and long layered feather-like strands trailing down the shin. A contrasting angular panel sits at the front.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer feather strands; colour 1 on the inner lining and the upper tips; colour 2 on the front angular panel.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Swan_01.differs: The female cuff hangs longer down the shin, with a taller, narrower front panel.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Victory_02.description: A small faceted, diamond-shaped knee guard on the outer left leg, tapering to a point below the knee, with a wrapped side wing curving round the back of the leg. Angular, armored look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Victory_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main front shell; colour 0 on the rim of the side edge and the back panel.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Child_Victory_02.differs: The female guard is a longer, narrower diamond that tapers to a sharper point below the knee.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Corrupted_01.description: A left shin greave with layered, scalloped armor plates over the upper calf and a smooth tapering guard below, topped by a raised crest with a pointed gem at the front. Sits on the lower leg over the tights.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scalloped upper plates; colour 0 on the lower shin guard; colour 2 on the edge trim and rim; colour 3 on the gem crest and small studs.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cosmic_01.description: A short, plain octagonal cuff greave worn around the lower shin above the ankle, slightly tapered, with raised rims at the top and bottom edges and a small contrasting patch near the front top.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body and the rims; colour 1 on the small patch at the upper front and side.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cosmos_01.description: A left shin greave of angular plate: contrasting faceted panels taper toward the ankle, with a raised diamond-shaped front plate holding a round gem and jagged fins flaring at the calf top. Sci-fi cosmic armor.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main greave plates; colour 1 on the diamond front plate; colour 3 on the round gem and small ankle accents; colour 0 on the inner rim.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cosmos_02.description: A single angular greave worn on the left lower leg: a faceted armored shell that wraps the shin and calf, with a large crystal-like gem jutting up at the front and a tall blade-like spike rising beside it.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 on the armored shell and spike; colour 3 on the large gem at the top front.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cosmos_02.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower, extending further down toward the ankle, with a lower pointed hem at the front.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cryo_01.description: A sci-fi greave worn on the left lower leg above the ankle: a tapered smooth shell with contrasting strap bands top and bottom, a central contrasting spine, a tall finned fin-like blade at the front and looping ribbed hoses at the sides.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the front fin blade and hose connectors; colour 2 on the straps, bands and central spine; colour 3 on the hoses and the small round lights or studs.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Cryo_01.differs: The female greave is taller and slimmer, with a longer front fin and larger, more drooping hose loops.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Deity_01.description: A single left shin greave in smooth plate: a tall, tapering shell with a pointed, flared top edge and a faceted crystal-like gem jutting from the upper front, finished with a contrasting flared band at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell; colour 1 on the ankle band; colour 3 on the gem at the top; colour 2 on the gem's inner facets.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Deity_01.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower, running further down the calf, with a more upright, slender cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Deity_02.description: A single shin greave for the left lower leg: a tall, smooth shell with a pointed peak at the front of the top edge, curved ridges down the back, and a contrasting cuff band around the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell; colour 1 on the ankle cuff band.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Deity_02.differs: The female greave is taller and narrower, reaching higher up the shin with a more sharply pointed peak.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Deity_03.description: A small faceted kneepad shaped like a angular crystal shard, with an upper plate that caps the front of the knee and a separate lower point that hangs down over the shin. Chunky, low-poly and monstrous.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Deity_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper knee plate; colour 2 on the lower shard section.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Deity_03.differs: The female kneepad is narrower and more elongated, with a longer downward point over the shin.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dharmor_01.description: A small angular kneepad worn on the left knee: a slightly curved plate with chamfered corners, a raised rim and a recessed inset panel, wrapping the front of the knee. Suits sci-fi or armoured looks.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and plate edge; colour 1 on the recessed inset panel.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Draco_01.description: A left shin greave shaped like a dragon: a curved plate wraps the front of the lower leg, topped by a spiked knee crest, with jagged fin spines down the outer edge and a hooked horn curling up behind the calf.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plate; colour 1 on the central strip and lower edge; colour 3 on the knee crest, spines and rear horn; colour 2 on the crest edging.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox.description: A single flame-like fin attached to the outside of the left lower leg: a tapering, sculpted shell of layered ragged tongues that flare outward at the calf and narrow to a point near the ankle. Suggests a dragon or beast look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the fin and its inner surface; colour 1 on the outer flared tips of the spiky tongues.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox.description: A single flame-like fin or plate on the outer left calf, made of swept, rippling ridges that taper to a point near the ankle and flare into jagged tips at the back; a monstrous, dragon-like leg accent.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the ridges and the smooth inner face; colour 1 on the jagged tips, shading in toward the rear edge.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dryad_01.description: A single left shin guard of draped, folded organic-looking wrap that wraps around the lower leg, with a rough mossy patch at the top front and tapering, tattered pointed folds hanging toward the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main folded wrap; colour 1 on the rough patch at the top front and side; colour 3 on the thin veins running down the folds.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dryad_03.description: A small organic, gnarled growth attached to the outside of the left lower leg, with two curved, pointed leaf or thorn-like protrusions sweeping upward and outward. Its lumpy, bark-like surface suggests a nature-guardian look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the lumpy surface; colour 0 on the mottled patches and the inner and underside areas of the protrusions.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A left shin and calf wrap made of layered, draped cloth-like folds that hang in pointed tapering tips at the lower edge, with a flared top rim and thin vein-like streaks; sits over the lower leg above the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main draped folds; colour 1 on the patch at the top rim and along the front edge; colour 3 on the thin streaks running down the folds.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Element_Fire_01.description: A left lower-leg wrap of glossy, flame-shaped shards: layered swooping tongues that curl and taper to points, covering the calf and shin from below the knee to above the ankle. Suggests an elemental fire theme.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the flame shards; colour 0 on the small plate near the top of the shin. The glossy material mostly ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Element_Fire_02.description: A flame-shaped greave wrapping the left lower leg, made of glossy layered tongues of fire with curling pointed tips that flare out around the calf and shin. Fantasy elemental style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: Glossy reflective default material largely ignores the colour scheme; any tint is faint, mostly colour 1 sheen across the flame shapes.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Element_Fire_02.differs: The female flames wrap more loosely around the calf with a wider, more ragged spread of tongues, and sit slightly lower than the male.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Element_Water_01.description: A pair of slender, curving glossy fins or blades rising along the outer left lower leg and ankle, tapering to curled tips at the top, with one longer blade and a shorter one beside it. Suggests an elemental water look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: The default glossy material largely ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows a reflective sheen, with no clearly separate colour areas visible.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Element_Water_02.description: A single left-leg accessory of glossy, curling water-like tendrils that spiral from the thigh down to the ankle, with branching fin-like wisps and thin tips that twist around the calf. A fantastical elemental look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Element_Water_02.colourAreas: Glossy reflective material that mostly ignores the colour scheme; only faint tints of colours 0 and 1 show on some tendrils, with colour 2 on the lower twisting strands.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_01.description: A low armoured shoe cover for the left foot: a pointed, angular plate over the instep and toe with a rimmed edge, and a separate chunky heel-block plate at the back. Suggests a sci-fi superhero boot.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the instep and toe plate; colour 0 on the rim trim around the edges; colour 2 on the heel block; colour 3 on the small accent at the toe.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_02.description: A chunky left shoe-cover with a rounded toe cap, a V-shaped chevron band across the instep, a small triangular gem-like tab at the ankle opening, and a separate flared heel block behind the foot. Suggests a superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shoe body and heel block; colour 0 and colour 2 on the two chevron bands; colour 3 on the triangular ankle tab.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Brutal_04.description: A small diamond-shaped plate worn on the outer side of the left lower leg below the knee, with a raised rim and a notched, bat-wing-like inset panel. Angular armored accent with a sci-fi, superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Brutal_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim; colour 1 on the large inset panel; colour 2 on the notched upper inset section.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Ice_02.description: A small cluster of jagged, faceted crystal shards fixed to the outer side of the left leg near the knee, with one tall central spike and shorter shards angled around it.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Ice_02.colourAreas: Glossy crystal that mostly ignores the scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows on some facets, and the rest is shaded near-by the material.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Valerian_02.description: A small cross-shaped armour plate that curves around the outside of the lower left leg just below the knee, with a raised angular rim around a recessed cross-shaped centre. Medieval, knightly look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Extra_Valerian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim; colour 2 on the recessed cross-shaped centre.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Feathers_01.description: A shin greave with a ridged, tapering front plate held on the left lower leg by three buckled straps, topped by a crest of sharp feather-like spikes flaring above the knee end.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ridged greave plate and strap tabs; colour 2 on the three straps; colour 3 on the feather crest at the top.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Firebird_01.description: A left shin greave with a angular knee cap bearing contrasting oval vents, above a tapered shin plate edged with raised trim lines; chevron-like bands wrap the calf back. Sits from knee to ankle in a superhero-armour style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the knee cap; colour 0 on the shin plate and calf bands; colour 3 on the edge trim and piping; colour 2 on the knee vents.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Flipper_01.description: A single swim-fin style foot piece for the left foot: a low heel cup with a contrasting strap over the instep, and a long flat, ribbed blade extending well past the toes.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Flipper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel cup rim; colour 2 on the instep strap; colour 1 on the fin blade and sole.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Fluff_01.description: A thick, shaggy fur cuff that wraps around the left ankle as a short ring, with spiky, tufted strands along both edges. It sits just above the foot and suggests a wintry, primal or fantasy look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Fluff_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the fur; colour 1 on the tips of the fur tufts. The fur texture shows no other colour slots.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Fluff_02.description: A short, thick fur cuff wrapped around the left ankle above the foot, with shaggy tufted strands that stick out unevenly at the top and bottom edges. It gives a wild, beastly look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Fluff_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the fur; colour 1 on the tips and streaks of the fur strands; colours 2 and 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_01.description: A single large oval faceted gemstone worn on the outside of the left knee, with a pointed faceted crown on the front and a flat, shallow back. Reads as a decorative jewel accent.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The gem appears to take a single glossy material; the colour scheme seems largely ignored, with a faint tint of colour 1 on the flat back.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_02.description: A single flat, diamond-shaped gemstone plate with bevelled facets, worn on the outer side of the lower leg near the knee. A small decorative crystal accent with a glossy faceted face.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme; its default material shows no visible use of colour slots 0-3.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_03.description: A single square-cut gemstone slab strapped to the outer left lower leg just below the knee, with a faceted bevelled edge and a flat glossy face; a small angular accent piece.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem material appears to ignore the scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on the gem.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_04.description: A single flat pentagonal gemstone with bevelled facets, worn as a small ornament on the outer side of the left lower leg just below the knee. Faceted, glossy and jewel-like.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slot is clearly visible; the gem shows its own reflective finish.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn on the front of the left knee. It is a single glossy cut gem with a notched top and a flat, translucent back, and it sits like a decorative knee charm.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme and reads as one faceted stone; the flat back shows a faint tint, and no other slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_06.description: A single teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone worn on the outer side of the left knee, pointed at the top with a flat polished front facet and a shallow recessed back. It suggests fantasy jewelled decoration.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The gem appears to ignore the colour scheme, showing a glossy glassy finish; no clear split between colour slots is visible.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gladiator_01.description: A left shin greave of layered armor plates: a pointed front crest with stacked ridged edges, an inset lighter panel, and a tapering pointed lower edge with raised outlines. It sits over the lower leg from knee to ankle, in a sci-fi gladiator style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell of the greave; colour 0 on the inset front panel and inner lining; colour 2 on the stacked ridged edges along the front; colour 3 on the raised outline trim.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gladiator_02.description: A left shin greave with a textured mesh-like outer panel framed by a glossy rim, ending in a pointed hem at the ankle, and a tall angular plate at the knee holding an inset panel and a small block.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured shin panel; colour 2 on the rim and the tall knee plate; colour 1 on the inset knee panel; colour 3 on the small block.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Heraldry_01.description: A single shin greave for the left lower leg: a tall front plate flaring at the top and tapering to a pointed tip over the ankle, with a thin contrasting edge and a short band around the calf back.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main greave plate and the calf and ankle bands; colour 2 on the edge trim and the pointed ankle tip; colour 0 on the exposed leg panel showing through the side opening.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ice_01.description: A cluster of jagged crystal shards clamped around the left lower leg, with tall spikes rising toward the knee and a small separate group of shards floating above. Fantasy ice-crystal greave.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ice_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the crystal bodies; colour 1 on the facets and edges of some shards. The glossy crystal material largely ignores colours 0 and 3.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ice_02.description: A small cluster of jagged crystal shards attached to the outer side of the left knee, with one tall pointed shard and several shorter ones fanning out. Suggests an icy, fantasy armour accent.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ice_02.colourAreas: The crystal has a glossy, reflective default material that largely ignores the scheme; a faint tint from colour 1 shows on some facets.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ice_Beast_01.description: A cluster of jagged crystal shards clumped on the outer left lower leg, with a smaller separate shard group floating above near the knee. Spiky, monstrous ice growth that sits on the leg rather than wrapping it.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Ice_Beast_01.colourAreas: The glossy crystal ignores most of the scheme and shows mostly faceted surfaces; colour 1 shows faintly as a tint on some facets.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Kaiju_01.description: A monstrous armored greave for the left lower leg: a bulky rounded shell wrapping the calf with a flared upper rim, a round opening at the side, and clusters of curved contrasting spikes running up the front and back, ending in a pointed shin tip.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 is not clearly visible; colour 3 on the main shell plates; colour 1 on the upper rim and lower shin panel; colour 2 on the spikes.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Kaiju_01.differs: The female greave has a longer, narrower shin tip and a slimmer shell than the male one.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Kaiju_02.description: A small knee-side guard: a curved, plated cup wrapping the front of the knee, topped with a rounded bulbous cap that sprouts a cluster of long, curved monstrous horns. Kaiju-style armor with a beastly, fantasy look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved lower cup plate; colour 3 on the rounded cap; colour 2 on the horns.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Kneepad_01.description: A single large rounded kneepad on the left knee: a domed faceted cap with four small recessed dots, mounted on a ribbed, ridged band that wraps around the leg. Suits sporty, sci-fi or superhero costumes.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Kneepad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front cap; colour 1 on the backing plate and band edges; colour 2 on the ribbed bands; colour 3 on the recessed dots.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Kneepad_Basic_01.description: A small left-knee pad: a rounded, angular-edged plate with a split centre seam and small side loops, held by a ribbed flexible band that wraps fully around the leg at the knee.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Kneepad_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and band frame; colour 1 on the central pad plate; colour 3 on the small side loops; colour 2 on the ribbed band inserts.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Knife_01.description: A single wide strap buckled around the lower thigh just above the knee, holding a short katana-style knife in a scabbard that hangs down the outer leg, with a wrapped hilt and round guard pointing upward.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the strap; colour 1 on the scabbard; colour 0 on the hilt wrap; colour 2 on the guard, hilt diamonds and scabbard tip.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Knife_01.differs: The female version has only one strap, worn around the thigh above the knee, while the male version has two straps on the shin.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Knife_02.description: A leg-mounted knife holster: two buckled octagonal straps, one below the knee and one near the ankle, hold a long sheathed blade upright with its wrapped handle and round guard pointing up. Suits ninja or tactical looks.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Knife_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on both straps; colour 1 on the sheath; colour 0 on the wrapped handle; colour 2 on the guard, handle diamonds and sheath tip.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Knife_02.differs: The female version has a second strap near the ankle and a longer sheath running down the shin; the male has a single strap at the knee with a shorter sheath.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_65_01.description: A single left shin greave with a horned, demon-like guard over the knee and upper shin, a flared cuff at the back of the knee, and segmented plates down the calf with flame-shaped contrasting panels.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plates and knee guard; colour 0 on the horns, cuff edges and metallic highlights; colour 1 on the flame panels and lower shin; colour 3 on the eye gems of the knee guard.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The knee guard horns are shorter and the flame panels sit lower than on the male version.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_65_02.description: A shin-length greave worn on the left lower leg, with a sculpted snarling beast-head guard with spiky mane-like fins at the knee and a smooth segmented plate below with a contrasting stripe. Martial-arts fantasy style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main greave plates; colour 1 on the beast head, mane spikes and the stripe and edge trim; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth; colour 0 on small highlights of the head.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.description: A left shin greave shaped like a tapered cup around the lower leg, with a flared rim at the top, a thick banded cuff at the ankle and a raised angular face plate on the front with two hexagonal eyes and a V-shaped inlay.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the greave; colour 2 on the ankle cuff, face plate frame and edge panels; colour 1 on the V-shaped inlay and the mouth strip; colour 3 on the eyes and the small triangle below the mouth.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_66_02.description: A left-leg greave of segmented armor plates reaching just below the knee, with a circular emblem and angular flared fins at the top, a raised front ridge with strap plates, a paneled calf back, and an open sandal-like sole with an ankle strap.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates and the sole; colour 1 on the front ridge, strap plates and ankle band; colour 2 on the calf and shin inset panels and the sole edging; colour 3 on the emblem and the top fins.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_0.description: A small angular knee plate on the left leg with a rigid frame and two ear-like corner tabs. The front is a robotic face with hexagonal eye sockets, a nose ridge and a ribbed mouth; the back is a padded panel.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and nose ridge; colour 0 on the face plate and back panel; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth and the ribbed strip on the back; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_0.description: A minimal sandal-like foot accessory: a thin outlined sole rim with an open toe loop, crossed by a single wide instep strap with a notched, V-shaped upper edge and light trim. Fantasy-flavoured and very sparse.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the instep strap; colour 0 on the trim along the strap edges; colour 2 on the thin sole outline and the inner strap backing.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_67_01.description: A shaggy fur cuff wrapped around the lower left calf and ankle, built from layered, jagged tufts that hang in points; the upper tufts are longer and the lower layer forms a contrasting fringe. Suits beastly or tribal looks.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur tufts; colour 1 on the lower layer of fur tufts.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Martial_Power_01.description: A shin greave built from vertical rounded slats forming a hollow tube around the lower leg, held by two wide bands with a diagonal strap crossing between them. Martial, east-asian armour style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on alternating slats; colour 1 on the other slats; colour 2 on the upper and lower bands; colour 3 on the diagonal strap.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Martial_Power_02.description: A small knee accessory: two thin overlapping bands wrap around the leg just below the knee, with a diamond-shaped faceted gem in an angular frame mounted at the front of the kneecap.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band edges; colour 1 on the band centre stripes; colour 2 on the diamond frame; colour 3 on the gem faces.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Martial_Power_03.description: A small diamond-shaped gem ornament worn on the outer side of the left knee: a thick angular frame surrounds a faceted pyramid gem, and the back is a plain pointed shell. No strap is visible.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Martial_Power_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the diamond frame and back shell; colour 3 on the faceted gem.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mecha_01.description: A mechanical ankle greave worn on the left lower leg: a boxy plated cuff with a flat upright plate above, and tapered angular fins flaring down either side of a central strip, over the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate, front strip and side panels; colour 1 on the flared side fins; colour 2 on the cuff housing and central slot; colour 3 on the small markings and underside glow-like accents.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mecha_02.description: A mechanical shin greave: an open-backed, angular faceted cup wrapped around the lower calf, with a tall front plate rising to a rounded bulky cap below the knee and a small inset panel near the bottom edge.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the greave plates and rim; colour 1 on the rounded cap at the top; colour 3 on the small panel near the bottom; colour 2 on the recessed slot under the cap.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mecha_02.differs: The female greave is taller and narrower, with a longer front plate reaching up to the cap, while the male one is shorter and squatter with the cap sitting right on the cup.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mechassn_01.description: A small angular knee guard for the left leg: a broad flat front plate over the kneecap, with two stacked curved panels wrapping below and behind the knee. Robotic, armored look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front kneecap plate; colour 1 on the lower and rear wrapping panels; colour 2 on the small edge gaps.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Destroyer_0.description: A left-leg greave covering the shin and calf from below the knee to the ankle, with a smooth tapered shell, a notched front hem, an angled front panel and a separate ring cuff floating above the top edge.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Destroyer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the front shin panel; colour 2 on the cuff ring and top rim; colour 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Destroyer_0.differs: The female cuff ring is smaller and tilted, and the top opening shows less of the inner contrasting lining.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A left shin greave of plated armor that tapers toward the ankle, with a tall raised front plate, a winged chevron band with a gem-like diamond at the knee end, a segmented inset panel, and a flared ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and rim; colour 1 on the segmented inset panels; colour 2 on the chevron band and ankle cuff; colour 3 on the diamond gems.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A small faceted kneecap plate: a angular, gem-like shell with a raised pointed front and a flat backing, strapped onto the outer side of the left knee. Suggests a modern armoured or mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer shell; colour 2 on the edge rim and the flat backing plate.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A form-fitting single-leg sleeve covering the left leg from the upper thigh to the ankle, with a curved top edge, inset side panels, a faceted gem-like knee guard, small stud details and a cuffed ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg sleeve and cuff; colour 1 on the inset thigh and calf panels; colour 3 on the knee gem and small studs; colour 2 on the panel outlines.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Witchcraft_.description: A left-lower-leg accessory of loose cloth bands: a separate strip at the top and two crossing wrapped loops below, joined by an angular diamond-shaped metal connector with a small hanging round charm at the front.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Modern_Witchcraft_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth bands; colour 2 on the angular diamond connector; colour 3 on the hanging charm.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Monster_Fur_01.description: A ragged cuff of jagged, pointed fur tufts wrapped around the left ankle, with spiky tips pointing up and down. It gives a wild, beastly look, like a monster's hairy ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Monster_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts, with lighter shading toward the front and lower tips; no other visible colours.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mutated_01.description: A lumpy, fleshy monstrous greave that wraps the outside of the left lower leg, rising to a tall pointed crest at the top, with ridged organic folds, small bone-like spikes and a few knobby growths.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy shell; colour 0 on the small spikes; colour 2 on the knobs on the front and rear; colour 1 on the bulbs near the back and lower side.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mutated_02.description: A lumpy, organic shin guard of layered fleshy ridges wrapping the left lower leg, with a small cluster of bulbs on the front and a row of short bony spikes down the back. Monstrous, mutated look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy shell; colour 1 on the bulbous nodules at the front; colour 0 on the small spikes along the back.
