Female/F_Footl_Greave_Phantom_01.description: A left shin guard shaped like a half-shell: a smooth angular plate wraps the front of the lower leg, with an open hollow back and a flared rim at the top and ankle. Suits sleek sci-fi or superhero boots.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer front plate; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim edges; colour 2 on the inner hollow.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A pair of stacked octagonal straps wrapped around the left leg just above the knee, each fastened with a square open buckle at the front. A fancy pirate-style garter or leg band.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central strap bands; colour 0 on the raised edge piping; colour 2 on the buckles.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Pony_01.description: A short ankle cuff of tufted fur or hair: a ring of long pointed curved locks fans upward on top, with a ragged jagged-edged skirt of shorter tufts hanging below. Worn around the left lower shin above the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Pony_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper pointed locks; colour 1 on the lower ragged tufts; colour 2 on a few inner locks at the side.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Pony_02.description: A shaggy ankle cuff of overlapping pointed tufts that wrap around the lower leg just above the foot, with longer upright spikes on top and a ragged jagged lower fringe. Suggests a beastly, fantasy fetlock.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Pony_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper tufts; colour 1 on the ragged lower fringe; colour 2 on the small inner accent tufts between them.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Pumpkin_01.description: A skeletal shin guard of curved rib-like bands wrapping the lower leg, with a central spine strip ending in a pointed tip and a shaped panel at the top flanked by contrasting jagged spikes. Macabre, monstrous fantasy style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rib bands and central spine; colour 1 on the panels at the top of the guard; colour 2 on the jagged spikes at the top.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Punk_01.description: A small shin guard on the left lower leg: a tapered, leaf-shaped shell with a padded front, a rim of contrasting trim and a pointed tip at the top, plus a glossy panel on the back and outer side.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded front of the guard; colour 2 on the rim edging; colour 1 on the glossy back and side panel.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Punk_01.differs: The female guard is taller and narrower, with a sharply pointed tip at the top; the male guard is shorter with a rounded top.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Punk_02.description: A small left-ankle guard: a padded band around the ankle rising into a tall pointed shin-side plate that tapers upward, with a glossy outer shell and a soft padded inner face. Punk-styled and partial.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Punk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded inner face; colour 1 on the ankle band; colour 2 on the glossy outer shell and edge trim.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Punk_02.differs: The female plate is taller and more sharply pointed, rising higher up the calf.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A small rounded kneepad of layered, faceted plates that cups the front of the left knee and wraps slightly round the sides, tapering to a point below the kneecap. Suggests a rough, monstrous armor look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front of the kneepad; colour 1 on the lower and side edges and the back plates.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_01.description: A single baggy knit leg warmer worn on the left lower leg above the ankle, with a ribbed band at the top, slouchy loose fabric through the calf, and a thick ribbed cuff at the bottom. Casual, sporty retro look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knit body; colour 1 on the lower slouch, blending up from the bottom of the fabric; colour 2 on the bottom cuff; colour 3 on the top band.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_02.description: A slouchy knitted leg warmer worn on the left lower leg above the ankle, with bunched, wrinkled ribbed fabric, a thick folded top cuff and a separate snug band at the bottom. Casual retro rave style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper knit body; colour 1 on the lower knit body where it shades in; colour 3 on the top cuff; colour 2 on the bottom band.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_Anklet_01.description: A short angular ankle band with a zigzag upper edge and a jagged lower edge, worn snug around the left ankle. Small triangular inset marks decorate its faceted panels, giving a rave-meets-mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_Anklet_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper band and main shell; colour 0 on the lower zigzag panel; colour 1 on the small triangular marks on the upper part; colour 3 on the triangular marks on the lower panel.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_Anklet_02.description: A chunky octagonal anklet band worn snug around the left ankle, with raised rims top and bottom, a contrasting central strip, and several pyramid-shaped spikes jutting outward. Punk rave styling.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_Anklet_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and lower rims; colour 1 on the central band; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_Fur_01.description: A left ankle cuff of layered, shaggy fur or feather tufts in four stacked tiers, with a smooth flat band at the top and ragged pointed tips at the hem. Sits around the lower calf and ankle in a rave or party style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top band and uppermost tuft tier; colour 1 on the second tier; colour 2 on the third tier; colour 3 on the bottom tier.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_Fur_02.description: A left ankle cuff of layered, shaggy fur or feather tufts hanging from a smooth band at the top, fading into ragged, pointed strands at the bottom; sits around the ankle above the foot with a wild, tribal beast look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Rave_Fur_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top band; colour 2 on the upper tufts; colour 1 on the middle tufts; colour 0 on the lower tips of the tufts.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Reactor_01.description: A mechanical shin greave for the left lower leg: a smooth tapered shell with a raised cuff at the top, a ribbed vent insert down the front, a small angled side plate and a tiny round stud.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and side plate; colour 1 on the top cuff; colour 2 on the ribbed front insert; colour 3 on the small round stud.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Reactor_02.description: A left shin greave with a plated front that tapers toward the ankle, a padded calf pocket behind the knee, and a rimmed top cuff with a round reactor light at the knee. Sci-fi armor with vent-like slots on the back.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave plating; colour 1 on the top cuff and the rear slot inserts; colour 2 on the padded calf section; colour 3 on the round knee light.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A left shin greave in angular sci-fi plate: a pointed, scooped knee cap flares above a segmented calf guard with a ribbed front channel, and a small plate cuff with round studs sits at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee cap, calf plates and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the raised edge piping and channel borders; colour 2 on the round studs and the banded calf inserts; colour 3 on the front chevron panel.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Armor_02.description: A left knee guard of chunky faceted armour plates: a pointed kneecap shield over a lower scalloped cup, with round bolt-like knobs at the sides and a rounded wrap-around back plate. Sits on the knee with a mechanical sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armour plates; colour 2 on the round side knobs and the central knob.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Armor_03.description: A chunky angular ankle cuff of faceted, crumpled-looking plates wrapping the left ankle, with a raised pointed front plate and a hexagonal bolt-like cap on each side. Sci-fi armoured anklet.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plates; colour 2 on the hexagonal side caps; colours 1 and 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A left shin greave of angular segmented plates with a padded calf wrap at the back, a round spiked disc on the outer knee, small spikes along the edges and a looping cable. Sits on the lower leg; sci-fi renegade style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plates and top cuff; colour 1 on the calf wrap and some spike tips; colour 2 on the round disc and spikes; colour 3 on the cable and small dots.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Straps_01.description: A column of six small straps stacked up the outer side of the left lower leg, each wrapping partway around the calf and shrinking toward the ankle, with a small fastening stud. Sits over the leg as a minor accessory.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Renegade_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the small studs.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky angular greave for the left lower leg: faceted plated shin guard with a raised knee cap block, round lens-like discs at the sides, a vented panel at the back and a flared plate at the ankle. Mechanical, retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plating; colour 0 on the ankle edge highlights and upper shell rim; colour 1 on the knee cap accent panel and side discs; colour 3 on the vent slats and disc centres.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A bulky mechanical greave for the left lower leg: a smooth metal shin guard with a vented grille box at the top front, twin canister tanks on the outer side, looping hoses, and a flared plate over the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin shell and canisters; colour 1 on the bracket plates behind the canisters and the grille frame edge; colour 3 on the vent slats and side panel inserts; colour 2 on the hoses and ankle edge.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_02.description: A bulky mechanical greave for the left lower leg: a rigid shin shell with a slotted vent grille at the top, a raised front panel, twin canister pods on the outer side, curved hoses, and a crumpled cuff at the top.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and cuff; colour 1 on the raised side and front plating; colour 3 on the inset front panel and vent slats; colour 2 on the hoses and canister caps.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_02.differs: The female version has a longer, narrower shin shell with a smaller front panel, and the vent grille sits further above the canisters.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Roc.description: A small calf-mounted rocket pack: two upright canisters with ribbed screw-on caps sit side by side on a curved, notched mounting plate. It sits on the outer lower leg, suggesting a retro sci-fi booster.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Roc.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mounting plate; colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 2 on the caps and canister bases; colour 3 on the canister nozzles.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Ven.description: A small mechanical leg accessory worn on the lower thigh: a boxy slatted vent grille with a flat back plate, and two ribbed hoses curving around the leg to end in short exhaust-like nozzles.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Ven.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vent frame and nozzles; colour 1 on the top and back panel; colour 3 on the interior behind the slats; colour 2 on the hoses.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Ven.differs: The female version sits on the outer side of the leg with the vent facing sideways and the hoses wrapping behind, while the male wraps the hoses around the front with the vent centred.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Wra.description: A retro mechanical leg wrap sitting on the left lower thigh above the knee: a draped cloth sleeve at the back, a boxy slatted vent grille at the front, and two ribbed hoses ending in short exhaust canisters.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Wra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth wrap and the canisters; colour 1 on the top panel of the grille box; colour 2 on the hoses and grille frame; colour 3 on the interior behind the grille slats.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Wra.differs: The cloth wrap sits slightly higher and more to the side, and the vent box is bigger and more prominent.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Roman_01.description: A left shin greave of overlapping segmented plates that taper to a point over the ankle, with a scalloped top edge, swirling raised motifs, small rivets and buckled straps wrapping around the calf. Roman-style armor.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Roman_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate faces and straps; colour 0 on the raised swirl motifs; colour 2 on the plate edges and rims; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Roman_02.description: A Roman-style segmented greave for the left lower leg: a flared top plate over overlapping lames that taper to a pointed toe-end, with small studs on each plate and contrasting edging. Worn on the shin, without straps.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Roman_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plate surfaces; colour 0 on the swirling tribal-like motifs and plate rims; colour 2 on the outer edging; colour 3 on the small gem studs.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Roman_03.description: A segmented armoured shin guard of overlapping curved plates that step down the front of the lower leg to a pointed tip over the ankle, with a rimmed top plate and small studs on each plate.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Roman_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plate surfaces; colour 0 on the angular jagged motifs and the upper plate face; colour 2 on the plate edges and rims; colour 3 on the small gem studs.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Sandstorm_01.description: A single left greave-style boot cover: a smooth shin guard with a contrasting rim at the top, a contrasting band at mid-shin, and a soft slouched lower section wrapping the foot and ankle with a thin edge trim at the toe.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shin guard; colour 3 on the band at mid-shin; colour 0 on the slouched lower boot; colour 2 on the top rim and the edge trim.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Sandstorm_02.description: A chunky armoured greave worn on the left lower leg just below the knee: a faceted shell with a raised front plate, a flared upward fin at the top, a rounded calf guard behind and a thin band around the ankle side.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and upper fin; colour 3 on the front shin panel; colour 0 on the rounded side and calf guard plates; colour 2 on the bottom band.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Scarab_01.description: A sleek left shin greave: a smooth shield-like front plate that wraps the lower leg, with a raised curved rear shell and a V-shaped lower edge at the ankle. Suggests a beetle-like superhero or sci-fi boot guard.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shin plate and the curved rear rim; colour 1 on the rear shell; colour 3 on the small inset panel at the side; colour 2 on the bottom edge trim.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Scarab_02.description: A left shin greave shaped like a scarab shell: a smooth armoured guard wrapping the lower leg, with swept horn-like spikes at the top, a curling tusk-like spur at the front, and a flared cuff at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front and side shell; colour 0 on the rear panel and the curled spur; colour 3 on the horn spikes and top rim; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and edge trim.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Scarab_Alt_01.description: A single curved, horn-like scarab claw that arcs around the outer lower leg, tapering from a thick segmented base to a sharp pointed tip, with a small contrasting band before the tip. Suggests an insectoid, monstrous look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Scarab_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tapering curved horn section; colour 1 on the thicker base section; colour 2 on the narrow band between sections; colour 3 on the sharp tip.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Scarab_Alt_02.description: A single curved, horn-like greave that wraps around the left lower leg: two crossing pointed spikes at the knee, a segmented central section, and a tapering claw that curls down toward the ankle. Monstrous, insect-like styling.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Scarab_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper spikes and curved horns; colour 2 on the middle segment; colour 0 on the lower curling claw.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Scarab_Alt_02.differs: The female claw has a narrower, more upright pair of upper spikes, while the male spikes sweep out wider and the lower claw curls out further.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Seacreature_01.description: A cluster of curved, blade-like fins or spines fanning out from the outer side of the left lower leg, layered in a stack with chevron-patterned panels. Suggests an aquatic, creature-inspired accessory.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main surfaces of the fins; colour 1 on the edge outlines and chevron panels; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the small top spine and the darkest fin undersides.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Seacreature_01.differs: The female fins are shorter and more tightly stacked, sitting closer against the calf.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Seacreature_02.description: A cluster of four curved, blade-like fins or spines fanned out along the outer left lower leg above the ankle. Each has a ridged, chevron-patterned edge, giving a monstrous aquatic look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Seacreature_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner faces of the fins; colour 1 on the outer edges and ridge lines; colour 2 on the webbed patterning; colour 3 on the chevron stripes.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Seacreature_02.differs: The female fins sit tighter against the calf and sweep downward in a more vertical, overlapping stack.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Starhawk_02.description: A sleek left shin greave: a pointed, shield-like cap sits below the knee, a slim tapered spine runs down the shin, and a small angled cuff band wraps the ankle. Suggests a sci-fi hero look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the knee cap and ankle cuff; colour 0 on the shin spine and cuff inner panel; colour 3 on the rear panel under the knee cap; colour 2 on the thin edge line under the cap.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Starhawk_02.differs: The female greave has a narrower, slimmer shin spine with a smaller contrasting rear panel and a lighter ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Starowl_01.description: A shaggy, feather-like greave for the left lower leg, covered in layered pointed tufts that flare into long spikes at the top and around the ankle, with clawed toe points at the front. Suggests a griffon or beast.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole feathered greave; small speckle markings in colour 2; a faint tint of colour 1 in the shadowed folds.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Starowl_02.description: A furry, feather-like calf wrap for the left leg, with a ragged crown of long pointed tufts at the top and trailing claw-like spikes near the ankle. Speckled surface gives a beastly, griffon look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Starowl_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur and tufts; colour 2 on the speckles and spots; colour 1 on faint speckles.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Steelcommando_01.description: A left-leg greave covering the shin and calf, with a sculpted armored cuff at the top that rises into pointed fins at the sides and a tapering lower section. Recessed inset panels and angular plates suggest a retro sci-fi mechanical style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff plates and side fins; colour 1 on the main shell of the shin and calf; colour 3 on the recessed inset panels.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Steelcommando_02.description: A curved, blade-like armored fin worn on the outer side of the lower leg, tapering to a sharp point at the top with angular inset panels near the base. Sleek sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Steelcommando_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 1 on the angular inset panel near the lower edge; colour 2 on the inner surface and edge lines.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Steelcommando_02.differs: The female version is taller, narrower and more sharply tapered, with a longer blade-like tip.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Swan_01.description: A left shin greave with a feathery, spiky fringe at the top and a smooth armored shell that tapers to the ankle. It has a zigzag trim line, a diamond gem on the side and a flared cuff at the bottom.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armored shell and feather tufts; colour 1 on the zigzag trim, top feather tips and ankle cuff; colour 2 on the inner panel; colour 3 on the diamond gem.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Symbiote_01.description: A single curved horn-like spike with a blocky base, mounted on the outer side of the left lower leg near the knee. It sweeps upward to a sharp point, giving a monstrous, organic look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blocky base of the spike; colour 1 on the curved blade, blending from the base toward the tip.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Symbiote_Long_01.description: A shin-length organic greave that wraps the lower left leg, tapering toward the ankle with soft rippled folds and a jagged, pointed upper rim. It suggests a symbiote-like living shell.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Symbiote_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper greave and jagged rim; colour 0 blends in toward the ankle end.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Symbiote_Long_01.differs: The female greave is slimmer and taller, with a narrower rim that has one main point at the back and front.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Symbiote_Long_02.description: A tapered, membrane-like greave wrapping the lower left shin, with a wide jagged upper rim and a few sharp points sticking up, narrowing to a smooth cuff at the ankle. Organic, symbiote-like look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Symbiote_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the greave; colour 0 fading in at the ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Symbiote_Long_02.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower, running further up the shin.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tactical_01.description: A cluster of four small hexagonal canisters angled outward from the outer left calf, each with a contrasting end ring, banded body and chevron markings. A tactical, mechanical gadget accent rather than a garment.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the hexagonal end caps and chevron stripes; colour 2 on the rings at the canister ends; colour 3 on the chevron accents.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.description: A left-leg greave: a loose, smooth shin guard that flares slightly at the top and runs down to the ankle, with a separate riveted plate over the instep and a thin strap-like stirrup under the foot. Retro mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin guard and the under-foot stirrup; colour 1 on the instep plate; colour 2 on the rivets.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.description: A single flat, blade-like fin mounted on the outside of the left lower leg, with a smooth swept top edge and several jagged feather-like points trailing downward toward the ankle. Suits retro superhero or mechanical looks.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.colourAreas: The whole fin appears to be a glossy metallic finish that mostly ignores the colour scheme; no separate coloured features are visible.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.differs: The female fin is narrower and slimmer, with sharper, more widely spaced points and a thinner profile.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.description: A single thin, blade-like fin or feather-shaped fin attached to the outer left lower leg, with a straight leading edge and several jagged swept-back points. It stands out from the calf like a retro winged accent.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the fin; colour 2 on the back face and edge. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Armor_Draycu.description: A shin greave of plate armor with a sculpted snarling fanged demon face on the front, a gaping open mouth with protruding tusks, riveted edges with contrasting trim, and a back shell held by a thin band at the top.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Armor_Draycu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and face; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth; colour 2 on the fangs and the retaining band.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Armor_Draycu.differs: The female greave has only a single strap band near the top of the calf, and the back shell is narrower.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Armorviper_0.description: A small angular knee guard on the left leg: a faceted, pointed plate wraps the front and outer side of the knee, with a narrow vertical ridge running above and below the kneecap. Suggests a creature-like or mechanical armour style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Armorviper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knee plate and side wings; colour 1 on the vertical ridge above and below the kneecap.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Birdpeople_0.description: A loose, baggy left lower-leg cover of soft wrinkled cloth that bunches at the ankle, topped by a angular, beak-like armoured cap with small feather-like spikes at the back of the upper shin.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Birdpeople_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baggy cloth leg; colour 2 on the beak-shaped cap and its feather spikes.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Birdpeople_0.differs: The female version has a plain cuff at the ankle, with no visible opening at the hem.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Defender_01.description: A small diamond-shaped kneepad worn on the left knee: a faceted, pointed shield plate with a raised ridge down the middle and a curved crescent marking on the front, with a shallow hollow back.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the crescent marking; colour 1 on the inner back of the plate.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Defender_01.differs: The female pad is a flatter, thinner plate with a smooth back, while the male pad is thicker and bulges outward with a dented back.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Extra_Winged.description: A pair of small feathered wings attached at the left ankle, one on each side of the calf, each with a curved rigid spar along the top edge and layered overlapping feathers sweeping back and down.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Extra_Winged.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers; colour 1 on the curved spars along the leading edge of each wing.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Kneepad_Skul.description: A angular, low-poly skull kneepad worn on the left knee, with faceted cranium plates, hollow eye sockets, a nose cavity and jagged teeth pointing down. Sharp streak markings run across the face, suggesting a monstrous or gothic style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Kneepad_Skul.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell; colour 1 on the eye sockets; colour 3 on the streak markings.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spiked plates worn on the outer left lower leg below the knee, with swooping claw points sweeping up and down and recessed inset panels. Sharp, gothic and monstrous in feel.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade plates and spikes; colour 3 on the recessed inset panels.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.description: A small calf accessory made of two curved, thorn-like blade sweeps that wrap partway around the lower leg, with sharp hooked tips and recessed inset panels. Monstrous, clawlike look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade frames and hooked spines; colour 3 on the inset panels between the blades.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.differs: The female blades are longer and more swept, with tall spikes trailing up and down the calf, and sit lower and more to the outer side of the leg.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Traveler_01.description: A small shield-shaped knee plate with a raised, faceted centre and a thick contrasting rim, sitting on the front of the left knee. It has an open back and suits armoured or fantasy looks.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted centre of the plate; colour 1 on the raised rim around the edge.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Valerian_01.description: A left shin greave covering the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with a smooth rounded shell, a thick top band with a raised front cap, and an angular cross-shaped armour plate down the front.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and the outer edges of the front plate; colour 2 on the top band and the centre of the front plate; colour 3 on the narrow strip at the bottom of the front plate.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Valerian_02.description: A small angular metal shin plate shaped like a cross, with a raised beveled rim around a recessed cross-shaped centre. It sits on the outside of the lower left leg above the ankle, in a medieval-gothic style.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Valerian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim and border; colour 2 on the recessed cross centre.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Victory_01.description: A single left shin greave in a sleek superhero style: a smooth tapering guard from knee to above the ankle, with a bordered upper edge and a large faceted angular gem-like crystal spike jutting up at the knee.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plate; colour 3 on the raised border trim that runs along the edge and around the top; colour 2 on the faceted knee spike.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Victory_02.description: A single faceted, kite-shaped kneepad worn on the left knee: a pointed angular shell with a sharp tip below the knee and a lighter wrap-around piece that cups the back of the joint. Sharp armored look for superhero or sci-fi outfits.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Victory_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front shell of the kneepad; colour 0 on the rear wrap-around plate and side facets.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Victory_02.differs: The female kneepad is longer and more elongated, with a sharper point extending further down the shin.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Victory_03.description: A single ankle wing accessory: two curved, blade-like fins sweep up from the heel, one long and one shorter, each edged with a thin outline. Worn on the left ankle, in a stylised superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Victory_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long outer wing; colour 1 on the shorter inner wing; colour 2 on the thin edging.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Vigilante_01.description: A small hexagonal armor plate worn on the outside of the left lower leg near the knee, with a bevelled rim around a raised inset panel and a small curved slot at its lower centre. It has a flat smooth back.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer bevelled rim and the back plate; colour 1 on the raised inset panel; colour 3 on the small slot detail.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Vigilante_02.description: A small knee guard: an octagonal band wraps the leg just below the knee, with a faceted angular cup at the front topped by a chunky rounded cap plate. Sits on the left knee with a chunky, armoured look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central stripe of the band; colour 1 on the band edges; colour 3 on the knee cup; colour 2 on the cap plate.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Warrior_01.description: A short ankle cuff made of stacked segmented bands that alternate between two materials, with a flat cap at the top. It wraps the lower shin above the foot and looks like a mechanical warrior greave.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light bands; colour 1 on the alternating bands; colour 2 on the flat top cap and the thin separating lines.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Warrior_02.description: A left shin greave: a tapered, segmented-plate cuff wrapping the lower leg, with a raised rim at top and bottom, an X-shaped frame across the front holding a ridged central plate, and a small ribbed guard over the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged front plate and ankle guard; colour 1 on the main body of the greave; colour 3 on the rims and front frame; colour 2 on the ankle band.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Warrior_Beast_01.description: A short ankle cuff made of stacked, faceted bands that alternate between two materials, with a flat cap at the top. It wraps the lower shin above the boot and suggests a rugged, beast-warrior look.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Warrior_Beast_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating lighter bands; colour 1 on the other alternating bands; colour 2 on the flat top cap.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Wingbracer_01.description: A small bat-wing fin worn on the outside of the left lower leg: a thin membrane stretched between two long curved spines that taper to points above the calf, ending near the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Wingbracer_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spines and frame; colour 1 on the wing membrane.

Female/F_Footl_Greave_Wingbracer_02.description: A small bat-wing fin attached to the outer left lower leg: two long curved spines with a thin membrane stretched between them, sweeping up to sharp points along the calf. A monstrous, beastly accessory.
Female/F_Footl_Greave_Wingbracer_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the wing spines and bones; colour 1 on the thin membrane panel; colour 0 on faint membrane veining.

Female/F_Footl_Greaves_Spooky_01.description: A left shin greave that wraps the lower leg from ankle to just below the knee, with swept ridged ribs running diagonally and a jagged, spiked upper rim; a thin band circles the ankle edge.
Female/F_Footl_Greaves_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave body and ribs; colour 1 on the ankle band; colour 3 on the small slits in the front ribs.

Female/F_Footl_Heraldry_01.description: A low, ankle-high left shoe with a jagged, crown-like cuff at the ankle, a thin layered sole, a strap band across the instep and a large pointed armored toe cap. Suggests a stylised heraldic fantasy or superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and sole stripes; colour 2 on the band across the instep; colour 3 on the pointed toe cap.

Female/F_Footl_Holohexarmor_01_Shortboot.description: A short sci-fi boot with a soft ribbed ankle sock and angular armored plates over the toe, instep and heel. Small round sensor studs and a central glowing lens sit on the instep.
Female/F_Footl_Holohexarmor_01_Shortboot.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed sock and inner wrapping; colour 1 on the armor plates; colour 2 on the toe cap window and side vents; colour 3 on the instep lens.

Female/F_Footl_Holohexarmor_01_Tallboot.description: A single sci-fi tall boot with a faceted, angular shin guard that rises to pointed fins below the knee, a glowing round sensor on the shin, and a low sneaker-like foot with a banded ankle and toe cap.
Female/F_Footl_Holohexarmor_01_Tallboot.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shin plates and most of the shoe; colour 0 on the ankle and shoe bands; colour 2 on the pointed shin tips and toe cap; colour 3 on the round sensor lights.

Female/F_Footl_Inmate_01.description: A chunky, boxy left boot with a wedge-shaped foot and a square cuff around the ankle. The cuff carries a row of small raised control-like buttons on its side, and the sole is a thin separate slab. Suggests a prisoner or mechanical restraint style.
Female/F_Footl_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 1 on the small buttons on the cuff; colour 3 on the thin sole edge.

Female/F_Footl_Junkbot_01.description: A mechanical left foot replacement: a banded ankle cuff, chunky cylindrical side pods, thin exposed rods running down to clawed, segmented toe blocks, and a curved spur at the heel. Scrap-built, robotic and monstrous.
Female/F_Footl_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe blocks and rod fittings; colour 1 on the ankle pods and toe segments; colour 2 on the cuff and heel spur; colour 3 on small inset panels and the cuff accents.

Female/F_Footl_Junkbot_02.description: A mechanical junkyard-robot left foot piece: a low pointed shoe shell with patchwork panels, an open ankle frame with a hinged cylindrical piston and small rod struts, and blocky bolt-on weights at the back of the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, heel weights and rods; colour 1 on the shoe body, ankle cuff and straps; colour 2 on the panel patches and the piston cap; colour 3 on the piston band.

Female/F_Footl_Kaiju_01.description: A monstrous clawed left foot: a short ankle-high cuff flows into a lumpy, scaly three-toed foot with long curved talons. It replaces the whole foot, giving a beast or kaiju look.
Female/F_Footl_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the foot body and toes; colour 2 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Light_01.description: A knee-high armoured boot with a pointed toe, segmented ankle and shin bands with thin edge trim, and a winged medallion emblem on the front of the shin. Superhero-knight styling.
Female/F_Footl_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main boot body; colour 0 on the edge trim and bands; colour 2 on the wings and emblem frame; colour 1 on the emblem centre.

Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_65_01.description: A short kung fu style shoe with a rounded toe, a folded-over cuff at the ankle, and a separate swooping panel with a curled scroll motif across the toe and up the front. It has a thin flat sole.
Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shoe body and sole; colour 0 on the ankle cuff and the toe and front scroll panel.

Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_65_02.description: A short ankle boot in the style of a martial-arts shoe, with a flat thin sole, a smooth rounded toe and a swooping curved trim line across the instep. A padded cuff sits at the ankle and a separate angular panel covers the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main boot body; colour 0 on the cuff, sole, swooping instep trim and heel panel.

Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_66_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi boot with a rounded toe cap, layered ankle band and a tall front plate shaped like a robot face with small gem-like eyes and a V-shaped inset below. Rigid tab rises at the back.
Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body and toe panels; colour 2 on the toe cap, ankle band, sole and face plate frame; colour 1 on the V-shaped inset; colour 3 on the eyes and the small chevron.
Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The female boot is taller and slimmer in the calf, with a larger raised face plate at the front and back tab.

Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_67_01.description: A furry beast-foot covering for the left foot: a short shaggy fur cuff at the ankle flowing into a rounded paw with a split, hoof-like tip. Suggests a monstrous, animal-legged look.
Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaggy fur; colour 2 on the split hoof tips.

Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_67_02.description: A low ankle boot with a folded-over cuff at the top, criss-cross lacing over the instep, thin decorative piping lines across the sides, a flat sole, and a small pointed fin-like flap at the back of the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body; colour 2 on the inner cuff and the flap; colour 1 on the piping, lacing and sole edge.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Bounty_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi western boot with a plated shin guard, a cuffed band below the top, a contrasting front seam strip, a reinforced toe cap with a small light, and a thick sole with a heel block.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shin plates; colour 1 on the cuff band, lower boot body and sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap, heel block and front strip; colour 3 on the toe light.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Ghosthunter_01.description: A mid-calf lace-up boot with a rounded toe, a thin contrasting sole, and three contrasting straps wrapped around the shaft. A criss-cross lace runs down the front; the smooth upper looks sporty and a little sci-fi.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the straps and top band; colour 3 on the laces.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A smooth, form-fitting left boot that rises to the upper thigh, with a fine seam down the back and a thin contrasting rim at the top. It ends in a rounded toe on a slim high heel.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh and shin, fading into colour 1 on the foot and ankle; colour 3 on the thin top rim; colour 2 on the heel and sole edge.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Retro_Talisman_01.differs: The female boot has a slim high heel; the male boot has a flat sole and stops at the knee or just above.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Super_Destroyer_01.description: A retro superhero left boot with a glossy metallic shin guard, a flared knee cap with a small pointed fin at the back, a contrasting side panel down the calf, and a low open-strapped shoe with a toe plate.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Super_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the knee cap and the calf side panel; colour 3 on the knee fin and the small knee insert; the glossy shin and shoe ignore the scheme and show as metal.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Super_Destroyer_01.differs: The female knee cap has a small insert at the front and a more tapered calf panel, without the diamond-shaped gem the male version has.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Tactical_01.description: A chunky sci-fi ankle boot with a flared angular collar shell, a lug sole, a warning-triangle emblem on the side, and small cylindrical thruster canisters on the ankle, linked by a thin cable that loops around the shaft.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the collar shell, sole and toe cap; colour 0 on the boot body panels and warning-sign area; colour 2 on the inner lining, laces panel and heel section; colour 3 on the warning triangle and canister markings.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Traveler_01.description: A left mid-calf boot in smooth, slightly creased material with a low flat heel and rounded toe. Two buckled straps wrap the shaft and a small accent strip crosses the toe; a heroic, spacefarer look.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the straps and toe stripe; colour 3 on the buckles and the toe accent; colour 2 on the sole and heel.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Trooper_01.description: A mid-calf superhero boot with a smooth main shaft, a V-notched flared cuff at the top, angular inset panels down the front and back of the calf, a capped toe and a thin contrasting sole.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot shaft; colour 1 on the V-shaped top cuff; colour 2 on the calf panels and toe cap; colour 3 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Valerian_01.description: A knee-high sci-fi boot with a smooth, sleek shaft, a thick rounded cuff at the top, an angular cross-shaped armour plate down the shin, a segmented strip to the ankle, and a contrasting toe cap and sole.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and armour edges; colour 1 on the toe cap and sole; colour 2 on the top cuff and shin plate; colour 3 on the strip down the front of the shin.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Vigilante_01.description: A tall, sleek superhero boot reaching just below the knee, with a smooth panelled shaft, a layered angular cuff at the top, a strap band over the ankle, and a thin flat sole with a contrasting toe panel.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the front stripe and toe panel; colour 2 on the top cuff, ankle strap, back spine plate and sole; colour 3 on the small light at the back of the cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Vigilante_02.description: A calf-high superhero boot with a smooth rounded shaft, a contrasting front stripe running from the top down to a panelled toe cap, two buckled straps around the shaft and a strap across the instep.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and straps; colour 1 on the front stripe and toe panel; colour 3 on the strap buckles; colour 2 on the sole.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Vigilante_02.differs: The female boot has its two buckled straps spaced further apart, with the upper one sitting higher on the shaft and a narrower front stripe.

Female/F_Footl_Long_Wheelie_01.description: A left ankle boot-cuff that replaces the foot with a single wheel underneath, like a mechanical roller unit. It has a chunky shell, a swooping front plate, and star-marked round discs on each side of the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Long_Wheelie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shell and wheel; colour 1 on the swooping front plate, ankle band and star discs; colour 3 on the disc rims and wheel axle caps; colour 2 on the stars.

Female/F_Footl_Mecha_01.description: A mechanical three-toed foot: a short cuff at the ankle above a rounded contrasting joint, with two chunky angular toe blocks pointing forward and a smaller heel block behind. Reads as a robotic or monstrous talon-like foot.
Female/F_Footl_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe and heel blocks; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the rounded joint housing.

Female/F_Footl_Mecha_03.description: A left mecha foot: a low, flat, angular wedge-shaped shoe with a broad plate sole and small boxy side blocks, topped by a boxy angular ankle cuff with ribbed vents at the front.
Female/F_Footl_Mecha_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body and sole; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the ribbed inner vent panel.

Female/F_Footl_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A low, ankle-high sneaker with a rounded toe cap, stitched seam panels, a thin sole and a padded ring cuff at the ankle. A contrasting stripe runs down the tongue and over the vamp; sporty, modern superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body and toe cap; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the tongue stripe; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A glossy ankle-high heeled bootie with a rounded toe, a chunky block heel and a thin sole. A rectangular outlined panel runs down the front, and a trimmed rim circles the ankle opening.
Female/F_Footl_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the rim trim and the front panel outline; colour 2 on the heel and sole.

Female/F_Footl_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A short ankle boot with a smooth rounded toe, a thin flat sole and a rolled cuff. A draped wrap of cloth sits around the ankle, pinned at the sides with small diamond-shaped ornaments. Casual, slightly witchy look.
Female/F_Footl_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the draped ankle wrap; colour 3 on the diamond ornaments; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Monster_Bootripped_01.description: A monstrous ankle boot with a laced front, a padded contrasting cuff at the top and a raised heeled sole. The toe end is ripped open so clawed talons poke out, giving a beastly, tattered look.
Female/F_Footl_Monster_Bootripped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the sole and heel; colour 2 on the top cuff and laces; colour 3 on the claws (default material shows skin-like talons).

Female/F_Footl_Moth_01.description: A monstrous left foot covering that splits into two clawed toes, with a ruffled cuff at the ankle and layered, tattered cloth-like wraps down each toe. Each toe ends in a contrasting band and a long curved talon.
Female/F_Footl_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ankle cuff; colour 1 on the layered toe wraps; colour 2 on the bands at the base of the claws; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Mutated_01.description: A low, ankle-high mutated foot covering with fleshy, rippled folds and vein-like ridges, small rounded lumps at the toes and a few small nodules on top. Looks organic and monstrous, and covers the whole foot.
Female/F_Footl_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy body of the foot; colour 1 on the bulbous lumps at the sides and toe tip; colour 2 on the small nodules on top of the toes.

Female/F_Footl_Mutated_02.description: A lumpy, organic left foot covering with ridged, muscle-like folds running over the toes and ankle, a few small raised nodules, and a gathered rim at the ankle. It suggests a mutated, monstrous look.
Female/F_Footl_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy body of the foot covering; colour 1 on the raised blotches on the top and side; colour 2 on the small nodules near the toe.

Female/F_Footl_Persian_Shoe_01.description: A soft, ankle-high slipper-style shoe in loose gathered cloth, with a long upturned pointed toe and a jagged trimmed cuff with a small V-shaped inset at the front. Suggests a Persian or fairy-tale look.
Female/F_Footl_Persian_Shoe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the trim around the cuff and inset edge; colour 3 on the V-shaped front inset; colour 2 on the underside of the toe tip.

Female/F_Footl_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A left-boot armour piece with a tall, angular shin guard, a spiky fin crest at the top, stacked plates around the calf and a clawed, spiked toe cap. Dragon-like sci-fi styling that reaches mid-calf.
Female/F_Footl_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, crest spikes and edge plates; colour 1 on the upper cuff, calf plates and ankle band; colour 2 on the central shin blade; colour 3 on small inner accents.
Female/F_Footl_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, narrower shin blade and a sleeker foot that reaches higher up the leg.

Female/F_Footl_Pumpkin_01.description: A chunky, rounded left shoe with a thick flat sole, jagged tooth-like edges along the toe and sides, swirling curled line motifs on the ankle, and a bat-wing shaped tongue flap at the ankle opening. Monstrous, playful Halloween look.
Female/F_Footl_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body and tooth edges; colour 3 on the toe and side panels and swirl lines; colour 1 on the winged tongue flap; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Big_01.description: A left foot replaced by a large raptor-style clawed foot: a thick stump-like ankle flows into a long three-toed foot with segmented toes and long curved talons, with a rear spur. Scattered pores and small dashed markings add reptilian texture.
Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Big_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the scaly skin of the foot keeps its own fleshy tone, and colour 1 on the small dashed markings on the toes.

Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Big_02.description: A large clawed raptor-style foot with a bulky skin-textured ankle block, three long forward toes, a raised rear spur and curved talons, with small speckled markings and dashed stripes across the toes.
Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Big_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the skin-textured foot body ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 on the small stripe marks across the toes.

Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Big_03.description: A raptor-style clawed foot: a thick, skin-textured ankle stump flows into a long, splayed three-toed foot with segmented toes tipped in long curved talons, plus a raised dewclaw at the side. Monstrous beast look.
Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Big_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; colour 1 on the small ridge markings across the toes; colour 2 on the small spots; the foot skin itself does not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Big_04.description: A raptor-style clawed foot: a bare, scaly three-toed foot with a short ankle stub, long curved talons on each toe and a raised rear dewclaw, dotted with small pits and short stripe markings. Replaces the whole left foot.
Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Big_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the skin-toned foot body ignores the scheme; colour 1 on the small stripe markings on the toes; colour 2 on the small dots.

Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Claw_01.description: A left foot styled as a beast's raptor claw: a short ankle-high sheath over the foot with segmented scaly toes, curved talons on the toes and a large raised sickle claw on the inner side.
Female/F_Footl_Raptor_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the foot base, ankle cuff and toe pads; colour 1 on the scaly toe plates across the top; colour 0 on the talons and sickle claw.

Female/F_Footl_Ravenswood_01.description: A left shin guard of segmented armor plates with a raised, pointed front blade and small side spikes, an open cuff at the top and glowing-style tribal filigree lines down the front; sits over the lower leg to the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main armor shell and back plates; colour 1 on the filigree lines and thin seam trim; colours 0 and 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Footl_Reactor_01.description: A short left ankle boot with stacked, segmented armour-like cuff plates around the ankle and a smooth rounded toe cap, set on a thick chunky sole with a contrasting edge strip.
Female/F_Footl_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented ankle cuff plates; colour 1 on the toe cap and upper; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the small sole trim segments at the toe and side.

Female/F_Footl_Reactor_02.description: A chunky sci-fi left ankle shoe with a rounded reinforced toe cap, a thick raised heel block, a padded cuff at the ankle, and a round reactor-style disc on the outer side of the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, foot upper and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the heel block and ankle section; colour 3 on the round discs at the sides of the heel.

Female/F_Footl_Reactor_03.description: A chunky sci-fi left boot with a rounded, plated toe cap, a tall blocky heel column behind the ankle, and a faceted cuff panel at the ankle with small round studs. contrasting bumper pads sit around the sole edge.
Female/F_Footl_Reactor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body, toe plates and heel column; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the sole bumper pads; colour 3 on the small round studs.

Female/F_Footl_Reactor_04.description: A chunky, angular armoured shoe with a faceted plated upper, small rivets, a thick platform sole and a contrasting band across the instep. A tall cone spike juts from the toe and a smaller one from the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plated upper and toe cap; colour 1 on the sole and the instep band; colour 3 on the toe spike, heel spike and heel panel; colour 2 on the ankle rim and sole edge.

Female/F_Footl_Renegade_01.description: A chunky high-top sneaker-style boot for the left foot, with angular armoured overlay plates on the toe, heel and ankle strap, three lace-like bars across the instep, and short spikes on the toe and sides.
Female/F_Footl_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, ankle strap and angular overlay plates; colour 1 on the main boot body, sole and collar; colour 3 on the instep bars; colour 2 on some of the spikes, with others in colour 0 and colour 1.

Female/F_Footl_Renegade_02.description: A chunky low sneaker-style boot with a rounded toe cap, a separate angular plate over the instep fitted with rivets, and sharp horn-like spikes rising from the plate. A heavy heel block sits at the back.
Female/F_Footl_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and toe cap; colour 1 on the instep plate; colour 2 on the heel block and the large spike; colour 3 on the rivets.
Female/F_Footl_Renegade_02.differs: The female version adds sharp spikes on the instep plate, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Footl_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky angular shoe with a thick platform sole, a faceted armored toe cap crossed by a strap with a small emblem plate, and a short open collar around the ankle. Retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole edge and the ankle collar; colour 1 on the toe cap and side panels; colour 3 on the small emblem plate on the strap.

Female/F_Footl_Robotexo_01.description: A robotic exoskeleton left foot: a round ankle joint housing with a glowing hub, cable bundles down the instep, a layered plated cover over the top, segmented articulated toes, and a heel block joined by struts.
Female/F_Footl_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel block, ankle cap, instep plates and toe segments; colour 1 on the cables and struts; colour 2 on the ankle housing and toe joints; colour 3 on the hub centre and small toe accents.

Female/F_Footl_Robotexo_02.description: A mechanical left foot: a domed plated toe cap and a separate heel block joined by angled strut arms, with a round wheel-like ankle joint and a thin sole plate. Sits on the foot and ankle, with a cyborg exoskeleton look.
Female/F_Footl_Robotexo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe plate, heel block and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the struts, sole plate and toe stripes; colour 2 on the ankle joint housing; colour 3 on the ankle hub and small inner accents.

Female/F_Footl_Sandstorm_01.description: A short ankle boot with a soft, slightly crinkled shaft, a thin contrasting cuff at the top, a contrasting zipper seam running up the back, and a chunky flat sole with a notched toe. Suits sci-fi or space-suit looks.
Female/F_Footl_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff; colour 3 on the back zipper; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Sandstorm_02.description: A low, chunky left shoe with a rounded toe, thick flat sole with a toe cap, and a contrasting ankle cuff. An angular flared panel rises at the outer back of the heel. Sporty sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the heel panel; colour 2 on the sole and toe cap.

Female/F_Footl_Santa_Boot_01.description: A short Santa-style ankle boot with a rounded toe, small heel and a chunky folded cuff around the top; a square buckle plate sits across the instep. Festive, cartoonish and partial in coverage.
Female/F_Footl_Santa_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot, toe and buckle; colour 1 on the boot shaft and part of the cuff; colour 3 on the folded cuff and the buckle inset.
Female/F_Footl_Santa_Boot_01.differs: The female boot has a visible small heel under the foot, while the male version sits flatter.

Female/F_Footl_Scarab_02.description: A clawed monster foot covering: a smooth, rounded ankle and instep cover ending in three segmented, armored toes, each tipped with a long curved talon. Suggests a beastly, scarab-like creature foot.
Female/F_Footl_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle and foot cover; colour 2 on the segmented toe plates; colour 3 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Shoe_Urban_01.description: A high-top canvas sneaker for the left foot with a rounded toe cap, thin sole, crossing laces, small eyelets, a circular side emblem and a flared, floppy ankle collar. Casual street style.
Female/F_Footl_Shoe_Urban_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and ankle collar; colour 1 on the laces and the lace-side stripe; colour 3 on the toe cap, eyelets and the emblem; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Shoe_Victorian_01.description: A low ankle-high shoe with a slightly chunky heel, a rounded toe cap, and a panel that wraps up the back and sides of the ankle. It sits on the left foot with a simple period-boot look.
Female/F_Footl_Shoe_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper and heel side; colour 1 on the back and side ankle panels and the top rim; colour 2 on the toe cap and the heel and sole.

Female/F_Footl_Shoes_Spy_01.description: A low-cut dress shoe with a squared-off toe, a chunky platform sole and heel, a lace-up front panel, and a short cuff at the ankle. Sits on the left foot with a polished, casual-formal look.
Female/F_Footl_Shoes_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper and toe; colour 1 on the lace panel; colour 2 on the sole and heel; colour 3 on the ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Skeleton_02.description: A skeletal left foot replacing the foot: articulated toe bones and a heel block, topped by a short straight cuff band at the ankle. Reads as an undead or monstrous bare-bone foot.
Female/F_Footl_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the mottled patches across the heel and joints; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footl_Skeleton_02.differs: The female version has a taller, chunkier cuff and no separate ankle bones, so the foot attaches directly to the cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Skeleton_Monster_01.description: A skeletal monster foot: long parallel bone-like rods run down from the ankle to segmented toe joints tipped with curved, sharp claws, replacing the normal foot with a stretched, bony, beast-like paw.
Female/F_Footl_Skeleton_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long bone rods and ankle disc; colour 1 on the toe joint segments; colour 2 on the toe knuckle sections; colour 3 on the claw tips.

Female/F_Footl_Skin_Fur_01.description: A bare, beast-like left foot covering with jagged fur tufts around the ankle and instep, a separate panel across the forefoot, and individually shaped toes ending in short pointed claws. Suggests a werewolf or monstrous look.
Female/F_Footl_Skin_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel, sole and claw tips; colour 1 on the fur tufts and toes; colour 2 on the forefoot panel; colour 3 is not clearly used, with a skin-toned patch at the ankle that ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.description: A left foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: a furry ankle cuff, a fingerless-style toe section with separate pointed claws, and a bare skin patch at the ankle. Sits over the foot and ankle with a monstrous look.
Female/F_Footl_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel and sole; colour 1 on the ankle fur and the claws; colour 2 on the toe section; skin-toned patches at the ankle ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Sneakers_02.description: A low-cut athletic running sneaker with a chunky cushioned sole, mesh upper, overlaid diagonal support stripes, a padded ankle collar and a criss-cross lace-up front. Worn on the left foot, ending at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Sneakers_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh upper; colour 1 on the toe cap, sole and side overlays; colour 3 on the heel and sole stripes and thin overlay lines; colour 2 on the ankle collar and laces.

Female/F_Footl_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A left calf-high sci-fi greave with a flared angular cuff at the top, faceted panels down the shin, a tall back panel, and an open front at the ankle that leaves the toe uncovered.
Female/F_Footl_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff and heel section; colour 1 on the main shin and side panels; colour 2 on the back panel and ankle wedge; colour 3 on the small square shin panel.

Female/F_Footl_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi boot with a chunky segmented shaft: a wide upper cuff, a banded panel, a thick separate ring at the ankle, and a rounded foot with a small hex bolt on the side.
Female/F_Footl_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff, ankle cuff and foot; colour 1 on the shaft panel and ankle panels; colour 2 on the ankle band and the top opening; colour 3 on the small heel panel.
Female/F_Footl_Space_Scoundrel_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, smoother shaft with a more sculpted, sleeker outline and a lower, more tapered foot.

Female/F_Footl_Spats_Victorian_01.description: A single ankle-height spat covering the foot and lower ankle, with a tall cuff, a centre front panel, a separate toe cap and a small heel. Suggests a Victorian-style dress shoe cover.
Female/F_Footl_Spats_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot and heel covering; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and heel accent; colour 2 on the toe cap; colour 3 on the front panel of the cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Starhawk_02.description: A short, ankle-high boot with a honeycomb-patterned upper, a thick contrasting sole with a raised heel counter, and a small contrasting toe cap and heel block. Sleek, sci-fi superhero footwear.
Female/F_Footl_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the honeycomb upper; colour 3 on the hexagon line pattern; colour 1 on the sole and heel counter; colour 2 on the toe cap and heel block.

Female/F_Footl_Steelarachnid_01.description: A mechanical armoured left boot rising to below the knee, with segmented plates, a pointed clawed toe cap, a raised fin-like spike at the front top, and slotted vent lines on the calf.
Female/F_Footl_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin, calf and toe plates; colour 2 on the front top fin, ankle inserts and joint panels; colour 1 on the slotted calf lines; colour 3 on the small marks at the front top.

Female/F_Footl_Steelcommando_01.description: A low, ankle-high retro sci-fi boot with a glossy rounded toe, a chunky layered sole with angular grooves, a raised outlined panel down the front of the shin and a separate strap panel across the side.
Female/F_Footl_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe and main upper; colour 1 on the sole, heel cuff and side strap panel; colour 3 on the outlined trim around the front panel; colour 2 on the front and side insets.

Female/F_Footl_Swan_01.description: A short ankle-high left boot with a low, chunky angular build, a wedge-shaped toe cap, a pointed triangular flap over the instep, a rounded heel block and a thin sole. Simple, sporty superhero styling.
Female/F_Footl_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle shaft; colour 1 on the toe cap; colour 3 on the triangular instep flap; colour 2 on the heel block and sole.

Female/F_Footl_Swing_01.description: A short ankle boot with a rounded, contrasting toe cap and a low flat sole. Thin piping outlines the sides, and a buckled ankle strap and a few small round studs on the front suggest a sporty, casual look.
Female/F_Footl_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the toe cap and sole; colour 2 on the ankle band and piping; colour 3 on the buckle and the small studs.

Female/F_Footl_Swing_02.description: A left ankle boot with a smooth, slightly wrinkled cuff, a rounded toe cap, a low flat heel and sole, and a small fan-shaped ridged plate at the instep. Casual and stylised with a retro feel.
Female/F_Footl_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the toe cap and foot; colour 3 on the sole and heel; colour 2 on the fan-shaped instep plate and the small triangular back accents.

Female/F_Footl_Tactical_01.description: A low-cut angular sneaker-style shoe with faceted panels, a chunky rounded sole and a stripe of contrasting trim along the side. It sits over the foot and stops at the ankle, with a short inner cuff opening.
Female/F_Footl_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shoe panels; colour 1 on the sole; colour 3 on the side stripe; colour 2 on the ankle cuff opening.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_01_Shortboot.description: A short, smooth, tight-fitting ankle boot covering the foot and just above the ankle, with a rounded toe and no visible fastenings. Plain, low-profile footwear that suits most styles.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_01_Shortboot.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_2toes_01.description: A bare, skin-textured left foot with only two broad toes, each tipped with a small nail or claw-like cap. It replaces the normal foot from the ankle down, giving a beastly or mutant look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_2toes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the toe nail tips; the rest of the foot is skin and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_90s_Boot_01.description: A calf-high mechanical boot with segmented plated shins, a large curved shield plate over the front of the shin, two contrasting straps with small studs at the top back, and a rounded, separate-panel toe cap.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_90s_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin and ankle plating; colour 1 on the front shin plate, foot piece and toe cap; colour 2 on the back straps; colour 3 on the small studs and ankle gem.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi boot with segmented armored panels, a flared knee cuff with a small pointed fin, a contrasting front shin plate and three curved blade-like spikes sweeping out from the outer side and back of the calf.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body, cuff and toe panels; colour 1 on the knee cap, side stripes and lower calf; colour 2 on the shin plate and toe tip; colour 3 on the calf panel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The female boot has three long curved spikes along the outer calf and back, and a rounded knee cap with a pointed fin.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A left leg piece with a segmented, ribbed lower-leg wrap, a rounded knee guard and a high-heeled boot with a contrasting toe cap. A bulky gadget cuff with small lights and a wire sits on the upper thigh. Tech-styled and sci-fi.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed leg segments and toe cap; colour 1 on the knee guard, boot and band above the knee; colour 2 on the thigh cuff and its straps; colour 3 on the small lights.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.differs: The female version ends in a high-heeled boot rather than a flat-soled boot.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aberrant_01.description: A bulbous, alien left foot covering from mid-shin to toes, with wrinkled fleshy skin, scattered contrasting pores, and thick rounded claw-like toe pads at the front. Sits over the foot as a swollen, monstrous mutation.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aberrant_01.colourAreas: Texture-driven skin look mostly ignores the scheme; the toe pads show a bluish tint that appears to follow colour 1, and the pores are spots.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Alien_01.description: A clawed, taloned left foot covering: a smooth, slightly crinkled ankle cuff and foot shape ending in three long pointed claws. Sits over the foot from the ankle down, suggesting an alien or beast-like look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and ankle covering; colour 1 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.description: A single left boot with a calf-high shaft of stacked, overlapping curved armour bands studded along the side, engraved with alien glyph-like markings, above a ridged, pointed toe cap and a strapped sole.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armour bands and ridged toe cap; colour 3 on the engraved glyph markings; colour 1 on the sole and inner foot section; colour 2 on the sole base.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A shin guard worn on the lower left leg: a rounded calf sleeve with two strapped bands, a rigid pointed plate down the front shin in a bordered frame, and a rim at the top and bottom.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the calf sleeve; colour 1 on the plate border and rim; colour 0 on the shin plate; colour 2 on the straps.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Amazon_01.differs: The female piece is a tall shin guard with a front plate and straps, while the male version is a low ankle boot.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Amazon_02.description: A tapered greave worn on the left shin: a rounded back shell with two buckled straps, and a front plate in a pointed, framed shape with cross-bars. A flared top rim rises to a peak at the outer edge.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 1 on the front frame, cross-bars and the top and bottom rims; colour 0 on the front plate inset; colour 2 on the straps.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Amazon_03.description: A short, chunky ankle boot with a rounded upper, a rolled cuff at the ankle, and a segmented plated toe cap made of overlapping bands, on a thin flat sole. Suggests a sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Amazon_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented toe cap; colour 3 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the rolled cuff; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ankle_01.description: A short, plain ankle boot with a smooth rounded body, a thin flat sole, a contrasting toe patch and a separate cuff band around the ankle opening. It has a simple casual look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ankle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and toe patch; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Anniversary_Defende.description: A knee-high superhero boot with a flared cuff at the top, a smooth shaft, and a rounded toe cap. Segmented ribbed panels with thin piping run down the back and sides of the calf, with cut-out arches at the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Anniversary_Defende.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cuff and toe cap; colour 0 on the lower front of the boot and the band below the cuff; colour 2 on the shaft and the ribbed back panels; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Anniversary_Nightha.description: A calf-high superhero boot with a flared, angled top, a smooth glossy shaft, a contrasting toe cap with a swooping side panel, a low chunky sole, and a row of small fin-like blades up the outer edge.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Anniversary_Nightha.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the boot shaft and sole; colour 0 on the upper front of the foot and the rim of the cuff; colour 1 on the swooping side panel; colour 3 on the toe cap; colour 0 on the blades.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcr.description: A soft, slouchy ankle shoe with a rounded toe, a centre seam over the vamp and a thin sole. A swept-up flared collar with a side cutout opens at the ankle, giving a retro witchy look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shoe body with a glossy sheen; colour 3 on the sole edge and the inner lining of the collar; colour 0 on the seam piping and cutout edge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A calf-high left boot with a pointed, upturned toe, a banded shaft and a row of curved fin-like spikes running up the outer edge; a contrasting plated strip runs down the front of the shin and a contrasting cuff sits at the top.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and spikes; colour 1 on the thin bands around the shaft; colour 2 on the front shin strip and top cuff; colour 3 on the foot section.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A low ankle shoe for the left foot with a smooth, rounded upper and a thick flat sole. Stacked, layered bands wrap around the sides and a contrasting cuff rings the ankle, giving a sleek, sporty look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and the outlines of the bands; colour 3 on the stripe band across the side.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aquatic_03.description: A close-fitting ankle-high foot covering for the left foot with a scaly, reptile-like cell pattern across the surface and a glossy contrasting strip running diagonally down the front and inner side. Suggests an aquatic, creature-skin look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aquatic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the scale pattern; colour 1 on the scale-like cells; colour 2 on the glossy diagonal strip.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aquatic_04.description: A snug ankle-high foot covering for the left foot with a scale-like patterned front and toe, and a separate smooth back panel over the heel, split by a thin seam. Suggests aquatic or reptilian tights.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Aquatic_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scale pattern cells; colour 0 on the gaps between the scales; colour 3 on the smooth heel and back panel; colour 2 on the seam line.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Archer_01.description: A soft, slouchy mid-calf boot with wrinkled loose shaft, a thin flat sole and a rounded toe, topped by a wide flared cuff with notched, jagged edges. Suggests an archer or adventurer look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the thin sole edge; colour 2 on the folded top cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armor_Ancientarmor_.description: A knee-high armoured boot for the left foot with a pointed front shin guard, curving ridged panels down the leg, a chunky mottled toe and foot section, and two thin straps around the calf and ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armor_Ancientarmor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled boot body, toe and shin tip; colour 1 on the curving ridged panel lines; colour 2 on the back and side shading of the leg; colour 3 on the calf and ankle straps.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armor_Draycul_01.description: A left armoured boot reaching mid-calf, with a snarling fanged monster face and open mouth on the shin, spiked fangs, riveted plates with contrasting trim, a pointed toe and contrasting straps at the calf and ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armor_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and face; colour 1 on the edge trim and plate lines; colour 3 on the mouth and eyes; colour 2 on the straps and fang spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armor_Draycul_02.description: A low armoured shoe with a tapered pointed toe, segmented plates over the instep, a stepped ankle cuff and rows of small rivets on the sides and heel. Sits closely around the foot and ankle in a sleek fantasy-armour style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armor_Draycul_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the outlining bands, cuff rim and plate edges; colour 2 and colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armorblackpaladin_0.description: A left knee-high armoured boot with a smooth plated shin and calf guard, a row of rivets down the front, a spiked flared cuff at the top and spiked ankle collar, ending in a rounded toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armorblackpaladin_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot plating and cuff; colour 1 on the thin trim lines running down the shin and around the ankle; colour 2 on the rivets.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armorblackpaladin_0.differs: The female boot has a rounded blunt toe, where the male version ends in a pointed toe.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armorninja.description: A ninja-style armoured boot for the left foot: a quilted soft foot wrap with a toe strap, a plated shin guard, and a rounded armoured knee-cup with a curved blade spur and a small strapped tab on top.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted foot wrap; colour 1 on the shin and knee plates; colour 2 on the plate edging, toe strap and blade spur; colour 3 on the small stitched marks on the top tab.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armorninja.differs: The female version is a slimmer, lower-cut boot that shows more of the leg above the foot wrap, while the male foot wrap rises higher around the ankle.
