Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A left mid-calf armoured boot made of angular segmented plates, with a rounded toe cap, a raised open collar, and a contrasting ribbed column with small vent slits down the back of the heel. Suits sci-fi and superhero looks.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin and calf plates; colour 1 on the sole edge and the collar accents; colour 2 on the ribbed heel column; colour 3 on the small vent slits.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Armorviper_01.differs: The female boot has a smoother, less segmented shin, with a single broad plate and a simple rounded collar.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A low, ankle-high shoe-like foot covering with a snug sock cuff, raised curving outlines and inset panels across the toe and sides. It has a sleek, sporty sci-fi look and hugs the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the inset panels over the toe, sides and heel; colour 3 on the raised outline trim; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A low, ankle-high left shoe or slipper-boot with a smooth toe cap, swooping glossy side panels and a raised heel cup. Raised piping traces the panel edges, giving a sleek, sporty superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole and heel area; colour 1 on the toe cap and ankle cuff; colour 2 on the swooping side panels; colour 3 on the raised piping outlines.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ball_01.description: A simple faceted spherical ball that replaces the left foot, joined to the ankle by a thick band-like cuff. A blocky, cartoonish, mechanical or monstrous stump foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ball; colour 1 on the ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Banded_01.description: A smooth, snug calf-high boot with a rounded toe and a thick, chunky octagonal band around the top cuff. The band sits below the knee, and the boot suggests a simple superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Banded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the top band and the toe cap.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bare_Tiptoes_01.description: A bare left foot with individually shaped toes and toenails, posed arched up onto the tiptoes with a raised heel. It ends at the ankle, replacing the mannequin's foot with natural skin.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bare_Tiptoes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toenails; the skin of the foot ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bear_01.description: A furry animal-paw covering for the left foot, with a rounded foot shape, jagged fur tufts rising to the ankle and calf, and short curved claws at the toes. Suggests a beast or monster look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot fur; colour 1 on the fur tufts up the ankle; colour 2 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.description: A left foot shaped like a rhino's hoof: a wrinkled, skin-textured foot with a short ankle cuff, three broad toes and blunt hoof-like nails at the front. It replaces the bare foot in a monstrous, animal style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toenails or hooves; the rest of the foot keeps its skin-like texture and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.description: A beastly wolf-paw foot and lower-leg cover with a rounded paw, contrasting claws at the toes, and a shaggy crest of jagged fur spikes flaring around the calf. Suits monstrous or werewolf looks.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw and lower foot; colour 1 on the fur tufts up the calf and small toe accents; colour 2 on the tips of the fur spikes; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.description: A tuft of jagged, faceted fur worn on the lower left calf, tapering to a narrow cuff at the ankle and flaring upward into sharp, claw-like spikes around the top. Feral, beastly styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper fur mass; colour 2 on the spiky tips and shading; colour 3 on the lower cuff near the ankle.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Small_01.description: A left foot covering shaped like a wolf paw: a low, rounded slipper with toe ridges, small spikes across the top of the foot and contrasting claws jutting from the toe tips. Sits over the foot only, in a beastly style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body; colour 1 on the spikes across the top of the foot; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A left leg replaced by a bird-like talon: a scaly, ringed lower leg ending in a clawed three-toed foot, topped by a fitted shin guard with a knee plate bearing a winged emblem and a contrasting rim and strap.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shin guard and its lower flange; colour 2 on the rim, strap and emblem; colour 0 on the claws; the scaly leg and foot keep a fixed skin tone regardless of the scheme.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The female version has a fitted armoured shin guard with a winged emblem plate and a long, exposed scaly bird leg, whereas the male version has a loose baggy leg covering.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A left lower-leg cover shaped like a bird's leg: a loose baggy shin section with a stiff angular cuff at the top, ending in a scaly bare-looking bird foot with long curved talons over the toes.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the loose leg section; colour 2 on the angular top cuff; colour 1 on the talons; the scaly foot keeps a skin-like tone not driven by the scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_03.description: A bare, bird-like taloned foot replacing the left foot: a scaly, skin-textured foot with segmented scutes over the top and three long curved claws at the front plus a rear spur, sitting at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the scaly skin takes a skin tone that does not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A low, chunky ankle boot with a faceted, angular shell, a contrasting stretch panel down the front of the instep, a thick contrasting sole rim, a small tab at the back of the heel and a recessed rear panel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shell; colour 1 on the sole rim and the heel tab; colour 2 on the front instep panel; colour 3 on the recessed rear heel panel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A chunky armoured left shoe with a short angular ankle cuff, a broad rounded toe cap, a thin flat sole rim and a round bolt-like button on each side. Sits at the foot and ankle in a mechanical, sci-fi style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and sole rim; colour 1 on the toe cap and heel panel; colour 2 on the mid-side panel and bolt housings; colour 3 on the round side buttons.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: A steampunk prosthetic lower leg: a bulky padded calf socket with a round dial gauge and banded straps, a thin strut down to a small armoured plate, and a curved blade-like runner in place of the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf casing and the plates near the ankle; colour 1 on the bands, strut and curved blade runner; colour 3 on the small indicator lights at the back of the calf.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bobbysock_01.description: A Mary Jane style block-heel shoe with a rounded toe and a wide instep strap, topped by a ruffled lace cuff that flares around the ankle. Sweet, cute look that sits on the left foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bobbysock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the lace cuff and instep strap; colour 2 on the heel and sole edge; colour 3 on the inner heel accent.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bobbysock_02.description: A low-cut ankle shoe with a chunky block heel, a rounded pointed toe and a short cuff around the ankle. The faceted, low-poly shape suggests a simple casual or stylised heeled boot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bobbysock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body, toe and heel; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the small patch at the back of the cuff; colour 2 on the shadowed inner heel edge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.description: A pointed-toe ankle boot with a slim stiletto heel and a short shaft. Two straps with small buckles wrap over the instep and around the ankle, on a wide contrasting band. Sleek, fashion-forward look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 2 on the straps and wide instep band; colour 3 on the buckles; colour 1 on the heel and sole.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.differs: The female boot is a short ankle boot with a high stiletto heel, while the male version has a taller shaft and a low flat heel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armo.description: A left mechanical armored boot of angular plates: a tall shin guard with a raised knee-level cap, a strapped ankle band, and a chunky toe cap over a ridged sole with toe teeth. Suits sci-fi robotic looks.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plates, ankle band and sole; colour 1 on the upper shin panel and foot; colour 3 on the toe cap; colour 2 on the back gap and sole underside.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armo.differs: The female boot has a taller, narrower shin guard that rises higher up the leg, and a slimmer foot section.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.description: A tall mechanical boot with segmented plated shin, a vented cuff flaring at the top with a raised back fin, a riveted plate over the instep, and contrasting ribbed cables looping along the sides.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot plates, toe and instep plate; colour 1 on the top cuff, vent panel and side inserts; colour 2 on the cables and sole; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Madjester_01.description: A chunky ankle boot with a slouched, wrinkled shaft, a rounded toe and a thick lugged platform sole. Criss-cross front lacing runs through two side straps with round studs; suits punk or street looks.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and straps; colour 2 on the platform sole; colour 1 on the laces; colour 3 on the studs.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Spurs_01.description: A mid-calf western cowboy boot with a wrinkled, slightly flared shaft, a scalloped dipped top edge, a textured foot section with a chunky stacked heel, and a buckled strap across the instep and up the side.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Spurs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the textured foot section; colour 2 on the top edge, heel and instep strap; colour 3 on the buckles.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Steampunk_Rock.description: An ankle-high, high-heeled lace-up boot with a pointed toe cap and riveted trim, with a cylindrical rocket thruster canister strapped to the outer ankle, with vent fins at the back. Steampunk, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Boot_Steampunk_Rock.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the toe cap, heel and thruster casing; colour 2 on the laces and edge trim; colour 3 on the thruster panels.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bootsole_01.description: A plain, smooth knee-high left boot with a straight tapered shaft, a rounded toe and a thin, slightly raised sole with a small heel. It sits over the lower leg and foot, suiting superhero and casual looks.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bootsole_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and upper; colour 1 on the sole edge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bootsole_02.description: A short, smooth ankle boot for the left foot with a snug fit, a rounded toe and a thick flat sole with a small stepped heel. It ends just above the ankle, giving a plain, simple look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bootsole_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot including the sole; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bowtie_01.description: A knee-high left boot with a rounded toe and a flared, folded-over cuff. A large bow with a round centre knot and trailing ribbon tails sits at the front of the calf, with a strap band around the upper shaft. Cute magical-girl style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe, sole area, cuff rim, bow and strap; colour 1 on the lower shaft and the bow knot; colour 2 on the upper shaft panels; colour 3 on the rear calf panel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A left-foot wrapped sandal: a thick rope-textured sole with a raised rim, a toe-post thong, crumpled cloth wrap crossing diagonally over the instep, and a loose heel strap behind the ankle. Barefoot, casual look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth wrap and heel strap; colour 1 on the sole's inner footbed; colour 2 on the outer rope-textured sole edge and toe thong.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The toe thong is dark (colour 2) and the female sandal's wrap sits slightly higher and flatter on the foot.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bull_01.description: A single beast-like cloven hoof foot piece: a short furry cuff around the ankle flares into a chunky, angular split hoof with a central cleft. It replaces the foot and gives a monstrous, animal look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the furry ankle cuff; colour 3 on the hoof; colour 2 on the cleft between the toes and streaks in the fur.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Calflaced_01.description: A single left calf-high boot with a small block heel and a rounded toe, fitted at the shin. A lace-up front runs the full length, threaded through eyelets, with a contrasting tongue strip showing at the top. Classic, slightly retro styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Calflaced_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the laces; colour 3 on the eyelets; colour 2 on the tongue strip at the top.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, angular left boot-and-shin piece: a tall block-like shin guard with a flared flap at the top back, a slim front panel, and a chunky rounded boot with a strap across the instep. Sci-fi, mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot, shin shell and top flap; colour 1 on the curved side panels and small instep accents; colour 2 on the front shin panel; colour 3 on the band above the ankle at the back.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A shaggy, fur-textured beast foot covering the whole foot up to the ankle, with a cloven two-toed hoof at the front and two small dewclaws at the heel. Suggests a chimera or monster.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur; colour 1 on the hooves and dewclaws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A left foot shaped like a clawed beast paw: a pebbled, scaly heel and sides, raised overlapping scales across the top, and four sharp curved claws at the toe tips. It replaces the whole foot from the ankle down.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pebbled skin of the heel, sides and toe pads; colour 1 on the raised scales across the top of the foot; colour 3 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.description: A low, smooth ankle-height shoe for the left foot with a rounded toe and a contrasting cuff at the ankle that dips into swooping cut-outs at the sides. Simple, sleek, superhero-style footwear.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shoe body; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and swoop trim; colour 0 on the inner lining at the ankle.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.description: A snug ankle-high foot covering for the left foot, like a sock or tight boot, with swooping curved stripes running from the ankle opening over the foot to the toe. Gives a casual, abstract look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the foot covering; colour 1 on the wide curved stripes; colour 2 on the narrower stripes.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.description: A low, smooth ankle-high shoe covering the left foot, with a plain rounded toe and a top edge cut into pointed V-shaped notches at front, back and sides, edged with thin contrasting trim.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body; colour 2 on the V-shaped trim along the ankle opening.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.description: A low, close-fitting ankle sock-style foot covering for the left foot, with two thin bands around the ankle cuff and a pair of contrasting stripes running down the top of the foot to the toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot covering; colour 1 on the two ankle cuff bands; colour 2 on the stripes down the top of the foot.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Colossus_01.description: A bulky monstrous left boot built from cracked, rocky stone slabs, rising to a pointed ridge at the front of the shin and ending in three large sharp talon-like claws at the toes.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs; colour 3 on the glowing crack lines between slabs; colour 1 on the claws and the small spikes at the ankle and shin.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Combatluchador_Doll.description: A calf-high luchador wrestling boot with front lacing up the shin, a contrasting cuff at the top, a thick rounded sole, and large dollar-sign graphics on the toe and the back of the leg.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Combatluchador_Doll.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff, laces and sole; colour 2 on the dollar signs and lace eyelets.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.description: A knee-high armored combat boot with a raised front shin guard, a back calf plate, a strapped ankle cuff and a padded, rounded toe. Its fitted, tech-military look suits sci-fi or tactical outfits.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shin guard, calf plate and ankle cuff; colour 0 on the boot body, side panel and sole upper; colour 2 on the sole.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.differs: The female boot has a narrower shin guard that leaves more of the boot body showing at the sides.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Combatsock_01.description: An ankle-high hiking boot with a padded, creased upper, a folded-down cuff with a small front tongue flap, a thick flat sole, and a ribbed sock top rising above the cuff. Casual, practical footwear.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Combatsock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and cuff; colour 1 on the ribbed sock top; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.description: A tall western cowboy boot reaching below the knee, with a pointed toe, raised heel, decorative stitched swirl pattern, a V-cut top with pull-up tabs, and a strap with rotating spur at the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft, foot and sole; colour 1 on the top trim, heel and ankle strap; colour 3 on the spur and spur rowel; colour 2 on the stitched pattern lines.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, slimmer shaft reaching closer to the knee, while the male boot is shorter and wider.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.description: A left cowboy boot reaching to just below the knee, with a pointed toe, raised stacked heel, V-dipped top edge with contrasting trim, two pull-on tabs and stitched flame-like decoration up the shaft.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot leather; colour 1 on the top trim, sole edge and heel; colour 2 on the stitching lines.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Heeled_01.description: A calf-high western cowboy boot with a dipped, V-shaped top, pull straps, decorative stitched swirl patterns, a high slim heel and a strap around the ankle carrying a rowel spur at the back.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Heeled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the top trim, ankle strap and heel; colour 3 on the spur and its round ankle buttons; colour 2 on the stitched line patterns.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Heeled_02.description: A calf-high western cowboy boot with a pointed toe, stacked heel, dipped V-shaped top edge, pull-on straps at the sides and decorative stitched flame-like patterns up the shaft.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Heeled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the top trim, sole edge and heel; the stitching is line detail.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Short_01.description: A short ankle-height cowboy boot with a squared toe and stacked heel, a broad strap across the ankle with a round concho, and a long curved spur ending in a spiked rowel behind the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the heel, sole edge and ankle strap; colour 3 on the spur, concho and rowel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Short_02.description: A short ankle-height cowboy-style boot with a smooth upper, squared rounded toe, small stacked heel and contrasting sole edge. Small pull-on notches sit at the top of the shaft; western casual footwear.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Short_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the sole and heel; colour 2 on the small notch lines at the top of the shaft.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_01.description: A mid-calf western-style boot with a smooth, tapered shaft, a pointed toe and a low heel. A strap with a round buckle circles the ankle, and swirling line decoration runs down the shaft.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the round buckle; colour 3 on the swirl decoration lines.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_02.description: A calf-high western-style left boot with a smooth, slightly pointed toe, swirling flame-like line patterns on the shaft, and a strap across the ankle holding a small spiked spur wheel at the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 3 on the swirl line patterns; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the spur and strap buttons.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_Short_0.description: A short ankle boot with a smooth, pointed toe, a low block heel and a slightly flared cuff. A wide strap wraps around the ankle and ends in a round, faceted side disc, giving a western-robot look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_Short_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the side disc.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cross_01.description: A soft, mid-calf sci-fi boot with a thick octagonal cuff at the top, a contrasting toe cap, and a small cross-shaped mechanical plate set on a slim raised panel down the front of the shin.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cross_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff and toe cap; colour 2 on the cross plate; colour 3 on the panel behind the cross.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cross_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, more upright cuff that sits higher on the leg.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A low, sleek ankle shoe with a raised panelled shaft, a rounded plated toe cap with small stud accents, and a thick contrasting sole. Futuristic, form-fitting footwear worn on the left foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ankle shaft and side panels; colour 0 on the toe cap and heel plate; colour 1 on the sole; colour 3 on the small dots on the toe cap.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cyberlord_01.description: A left boot in a chunky, faceted mechanical style: a tall tapering shaft with a clawed, talon-like toe of several pointed segments, a contrasting ankle band with a round gem-like socket on the side, and angular fins at the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cyberlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe claws; colour 1 on the ankle band and fins; colour 3 on the round side socket; colour 2 on the heel underside.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: A cyberpunk left shoe with a split two-toed front, a thick wedge sole and a wide ankle cuff. A round disc sensor sits on the outer ankle, and contrasting panels cover the top of the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and toe tips; colour 2 on the sole and piping; colour 3 on the centre of the ankle disc.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The female shoe has a taller wedge sole and a more pointed, arched foot, while the male one sits flatter.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A sleek knee-high cybernetic boot for the left foot: a fitted leg sleeve with a domed knee guard and small round sensor lights, a flared upper cuff, and a high-heeled foot with buckled straps across the instep.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the leg sleeve; colour 0 on the foot and the knee guard; colour 1 on the cuff edge, straps, heel and trim; colour 3 on the round lights.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.differs: The female boot has a raised high heel, while the male boot sits on a low, flat block heel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Defender_01.description: A mid-calf superhero boot with a smooth shaft and a low shoe section with strapped bands over the instep. The top flares into pointed armored flanges with slashed inset accents on the sides and rear.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft and the flared cuff plates; colour 1 on the shoe upper and instep straps; colour 2 on the sole and toe cap; colour 3 on the slashed accents in the cuff.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Defender_01.differs: The cuff flanges are shorter and the front points sit closer to the leg than on the male version.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Deity_01.description: A short, chunky ankle shoe for the left foot with a thick rounded sole, a tall angular cuff and a separate panel over the toe. Split into a heel section, a mid section and a toe cap; simple, stylised and slightly alien.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mid section over the instep; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the heel and back panel; colour 3 on the toe cap.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A left knee-high boot with a soft, slightly wrinkled cloth-like shaft, a low flat foot with a strap band at the ankle, and thin contrasting piping tracing angular seams up the front and back.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot body; colour 2 on the piping and seam lines; colour 0 on the inner rim of the top edge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A left mid-calf boot in a sci-fi armored style, with a segmented ribbed shin plate down the front, a pointed upper cuff with small side spikes, and a separately plated, rounded toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf shell and cuff; colour 1 on the segmented shin strip and the foot plates; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1.description: A left knee-high armored boot with a smooth calf shell, a segmented front strip of plates, a pointed flared top with small spikes at each side, and a plated toe section. Sci-fi warrior look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf shell and pointed top; colour 1 on the segmented front strip and the segmented foot; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1_1.description: A left mid-calf armored boot with a smooth shin shell, a segmented ribbed front strip, a flared angular cuff topped with small spikes, and a paneled rounded toe. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin shell, cuff and back of the boot; colour 1 on the segmented front strip and the foot; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi boot with a sneaker-style foot, a rigid front shin plate, a thick cuff at the top and a segmented ribbed panel up the back and sides. Laced with straps over the instep.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shin plate, cuff and shoe upper; colour 0 on the ribbed calf panel and the instep straps; colour 2 on the shoe vents and rib grooves; colour 3 on the sole edge.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Dharmor_01.differs: The female boot is slimmer, with a taller octagonal cuff and a narrower shin plate.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A cartoonish dinosaur-foot covering for the left foot: a soft, rounded padded paw with three curved claws at the toes and a thick fluffy cuff at the ankle. Playful costume-creature style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded foot; colour 1 on the claws; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Drka_01.description: An open-toed sandal greave with a curved, segmented armour plate up the front of the shin, padded cuffs at the calf and ankle, a thong strap sole, and contrasting curved talons extending over the toes.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate and toe cover; colour 1 on the calf and ankle cuffs and the sandal sole and straps; colour 2 on the talons.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Drka_01.differs: The female shin plate is shorter and straighter, with less of a curved flare at the top.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Dual_Claw_02.description: A bare-skin style left foot with a bulky, bird-like shape ending in sharp curved claws: one at the toe front, one at the side and a rear spur. It replaces the foot and ends just above the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Dual_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the foot itself shows a skin-like tone that does not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Dual_Claw_03.description: A bare, beast-like left foot with a short skin-toned ankle and foot, ending in two long curved talons at the front and a small spur at the heel. Sits at the ankle, replacing the normal foot, for a monstrous Halloween look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Dual_Claw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the foot itself shows a skin tone that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.description: A knee-high gladiator-style sandal with a flat sole, toe-loop straps over the foot and a caged lattice of horizontal straps between vertical bands up the calf, fastened with small rings at the top.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole and the strap lattice; colour 1 on the small rings and fasteners at the top and along the sides.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.differs: The female sandal has a taller, narrower cage with fewer wide gaps between the horizontal straps.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_02.description: A short gladiator-style Egyptian sandal: a flat sole with a toe loop, crisscrossing straps over the foot, and an ankle cuff joined to a rear heel panel. It sits low on the left foot and ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole, straps and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the small rings at the ankle and the rear heel panel; the bare foot and toenails are not part of the piece.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A left mid-calf boot in a retro-futuristic art deco style, with a smooth shin shell, a raised fin-like flare at the outer edge, thin etched grooves, a trimmed top edge and a rounded sneaker-like toe cap.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shell, fin and sole upper; colour 1 on the top rim, front edge trim and toe cap; colour 2 on the etched grooves.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.differs: The female boot has a narrower, taller shaft with the fin sitting further back and a more closed, slimmer top opening.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Extra_Winged_01.description: A pair of small feathered wings attached at the outer and inner sides of the lower leg near the ankle, each with a curved leading spar and layered swept-back feathers. Mythic, Hermes-style ankle wings.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Extra_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved wing spars and rounded base knobs; colour 0 on the feathers.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A chunky armored boot with a ribbed shin guard held by three straps, a studded plate over the instep and striped sole, topped by a spiky crest of feathers at the shin top.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the shin guard and instep plate; colour 2 on the straps and sole stripes; colour 3 on the feather crest.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Feathers_02.description: A short, rounded ankle boot with a smooth, slightly wrinkled cuff. A dimpled plate sits over the instep, held by two straps that wrap around the foot, with small tabs hanging at the side. Suggests a chunky armored sci-fi or creature look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Feathers_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the dimpled instep plate and side tabs; colour 2 on the straps and sole edge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A short ankle boot for the left foot with a smooth rounded toe, a thin sole, and a cuff with contrasting trim and a vertical strip up the front. A wraparound side panel and a heel cap add sporty superhero styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 3 on the sole, cuff trim and vertical strip; colour 1 on the side strap panel; colour 2 on the heel cap.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Flared_01.description: A smooth, knee-high superhero boot with a soft rounded toe and a seam running down the front. The top ends in a flared, pointed cuff that peaks at the front and back, with an inner lining showing.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the flared cuff; colour 2 on the seam line.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Flipper_01.description: A single swim-fin style foot piece: a short ankle sock cuff leads to a contrasting foot strap over the instep, and a long flat flared blade extends well beyond the toes. Suggests aquatic, diving or amphibian styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Flipper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the foot strap over the instep; colour 1 on the flared fin blade.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Flower_01.description: A left ankle boot with a rounded smooth foot, a small spiky flower motif on the toe, wrapped bands at the ankle, and a ring of long pointed thorn-like leaf spikes flaring up around the ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot foot and the tips of the spikes; colour 1 on the ankle wraps and the flower petals; colour 2 on the spike panels and the bands; colour 3 on small accents and the toe line.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Folded_01.description: A soft, plain left boot with a slim shaft and a wide folded-over cuff at the top of the calf, giving a pirate-style turned-down look. The toe has a contrasting tip and the inside of the cuff shows a separate lining.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Folded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and folded cuff; colour 1 on the toe tip and the inner lining of the cuff.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Folded_01.differs: The inside of the cuff is coloured with colour 1 and the cuff has no coloured rim, while the male version has a coloured rim along the top edge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Folded_Heel_01.description: A short high-heeled ankle boot with a pointed toe and slim stiletto heel, a narrow exposed shaft, and a wide folded-over cuff at the top of the ankle. Sleek, stylish footwear with a sci-fi edge.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Folded_Heel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff top, toe cap and heel; colour 1 on the boot body and inside of the cuff; colour 2 on the narrow ankle shaft and cuff side panel; colour 3 on the heel back panel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Furdogz_01.description: A calf-high soft boot with a shaggy fur cuff around the top, two straps with small square buckles on the shaft, and a rounded toe cap studded with small bolts. Worn on the left foot and lower leg.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Furdogz_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the straps and toe cap; colour 2 on the fur cuff; colour 3 on the buckles and toe studs.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Furlined_01.description: A soft, slouchy mid-calf boot with a rounded toe and wrinkled, loose-fitting shaft, finished with a thick, chunky folded cuff at the top. Casual, cosy styling that sits over the lower leg.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Furlined_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the folded top cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A left calf-high armoured boot with a smooth plated shaft, a pointed front flare at the top, rows of cone spikes down the outer side, a strapped ankle band and a long pointed toe spike.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot plating; colour 1 on the rim, ankle band and sole trim; colour 2 on the front flare, toe spike and heel panel; colour 3 on the spikes and scratch marks.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The female boot has a larger, darker front flare at the top of the shin, and its ankle band carries fewer contrasting spikes.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Glass_Slipper_01.description: A translucent high-heeled pump with a thin stiletto heel, low-cut sides and a smooth rounded toe box that lets the foot show through; worn on the left foot in an elegant, fairytale style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Glass_Slipper_01.colourAreas: The glass-like material largely ignores the colour scheme and shows a glossy translucent finish; no distinct colour slots are clearly visible on the slipper.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Glow_01.description: A low ankle-height tight-fitting shoe with a textured, dimpled surface, outlined panels across the instep and toe cap, a round disc on the outer ankle, and thin seam lines running along the sole.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main textured shoe body; colour 1 on the instep panel, toe cap, heel patch and ankle disc; colour 3 on the thin seam lines along the sole and panels; colour 2 on the outlines around the panels.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A single thigh-high boot for the left leg, smooth and close-fitting with a small heel and rounded toe, topped by a flared folded cuff at the upper thigh. A classic retro superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft, heel and foot; colour 1 on the flared cuff at the top.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Golden_Age_02.description: A left ankle boot with a slim stiletto heel and a softly wrinkled, rounded toe, topped by a thick folded cuff band around the ankle. Classic superhero styling that stops just above the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Golden_Age_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and heel; colour 1 on the folded ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Gravitar_01.description: A single thigh-high boot for the left leg: a smooth, close-fitting shaft rising to the upper thigh with a thin banded top edge and small buckle, flaring into a cuffed ankle above a heeled sole.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Gravitar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and upper; colour 1 on the heel and sole; colour 2 on the buckle at the top band.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Greave_01.description: A sleek armoured greave for the left leg: a smooth, tapered shin guard rising from a low, rounded shoe to just below the knee, with a slightly flared open top and a small notch panel at the back.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Greave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin guard; colour 1 on the shoe; colour 3 on the thin outline of the small back panel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Harajuku_Boot_01.description: A calf-length boot with a smooth, loose shaft, a banded octagonal cuff, a diagonal zipper running up the shin, an ankle strap with a ring buckle, and a chunky layered platform sole. Youthful street-fashion look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Harajuku_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe; colour 1 on the top cuff, diagonal zipper band and ankle strap; colour 3 on the layered sole; colour 2 on the zipper pull and ring.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Harajuku_Slipper_01.description: A T-strap high-heeled pump with a rounded toe, slim tapered heel, polka-dotted inner panel, and a buckled strap across the ankle. A large bow sits on the toe, giving a cute, retro Harajuku look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Harajuku_Slipper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe body, heel, T-strap and ankle strap; colour 3 on the bow and the inner panel; colour 0 on the polka dots; colour 2 on the heel and buckle.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Harajuku_Slipper_St.description: A thigh-high patterned stocking for the left leg with a folded cuff, checkerboard band, horizontal stripes and polka dots, paired with a T-strap high-heeled shoe with a small bow at the ankle. Playful Harajuku style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Harajuku_Slipper_St.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cuff, checkerboard squares, stripes, dots and shoe bow; colour 0 on the stocking's light checker, stripe and dot pattern areas; colour 1 on the shoe and its T-strap.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A sleek sci-fi left boot with a tall armored shin guard: flared side fins rise up the calf, round pod-like discs sit at the ankle and knee side, and a smooth rounded foot section ends in a low sole.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot and shin plates; colour 1 on the round discs at the ankle and calf; colour 2 on the small socket on the front of the shin.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Hiboot_01.description: A smooth, soft thigh-high boot with gentle wrinkles at the knee and ankle, a rounded flat-soled toe, and a thin contrasting trim line around the top opening at the upper thigh.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Hiboot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the thin trim around the top opening; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Highheel_01.description: A left high-heeled shoe with a smooth, closed pointed-toe upper that covers the foot up to the ankle, sitting on a slim tapered stiletto-style heel. Sleek and simple with a low-poly faceted look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Highheel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe upper; colour 1 on the heel-back panel at the rear of the shoe.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Highheel_02.description: A low-cut, closed-toe pump with a thick block heel, smooth rounded upper and a slightly pointed toe, covering the foot and sitting just below the ankle. Simple, sleek and plain in construction.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Highheel_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the heel and back of the heel cup.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A mechanical armored boot-brace for the left leg: a segmented shin frame with a round disc at the knee, strapped panels at the calf and ankle, and a plated, rounded toe cap over the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin frame, toe cap and main plates; colour 1 on the ankle and calf straps and the trim bands; colour 2 on the back calf and ankle blocks; colour 3 on the small inner accents at the top and back.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The female version's top cuff is a taller, chunkier plated collar, and the shin frame is a bit more enclosed.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Hoof_01.description: A rounded, blocky hoof-shaped covering for the left foot, with a thin cuff at the ankle, a smooth flared body and a small notch split at the front of the toe. Suggests a beast or satyr look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Hoof_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and upper hoof; colour 1 on the lower hoof and the toe notch.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi boot with a chunky octagonal cuff, panelled shin and heel sections, and thick ribbed hose-like tubes running down each side to the foot, with small straps and a rounded bumper toe cap.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, toe cap, heel and small straps; colour 0 on the main shin and foot panels; colour 2 on the inset shin and instep panels; colour 3 on the ribbed hoses.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Iceskates_01.description: A lace-up ice skate boot with a padded ankle cuff, a curved side panel, a star emblem on the side, a raised heel block and a thin blade mounted under the sole on posts.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Iceskates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and blade; colour 1 on the curved side panel, heel block and sole edge; colour 2 on the laces; colour 3 on the star emblem and the eyelet studs.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Jetboot_01.description: A bulky angular armored jet boot covering the foot and lower calf, with a rounded padded front plate, a small square vent block at the top back, a swept fin on the outer side and thin contrasting trim lines.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Jetboot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and front plate; colour 1 on the upper cuff and toe accents; colour 2 on the side panels, fins and top block; colour 3 on the thin trim lines.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Knight_01.description: A left leg piece of open-framed greave and sandal-like foot: a slim shin guard with a knee cap, narrow outlined frame bars down the leg, two contrasting straps behind the calf and ankle, mesh at the heel, and banded straps across the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee cap, shin panel and foot base; colour 1 on the frame outlines and foot bands; colour 2 on the back straps; colour 3 on the mesh at the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Knight_01.differs: The female greave is a slimmer open frame with plain shin panel and no ornamental diamond motifs on the shin.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Knight_02.description: A single high-heeled strappy sandal with a separate armored greave: a rigid shin plate with a pointed knee cap and edged border, held by two straps at the back, above a stiletto heel with an open toe and banded straps.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate, knee cap and sandal base; colour 1 on the plate edging and the sandal strap bands; colour 2 on the two back straps.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A chunky, hoof-like left foot piece with a blocky rounded toe and a shaggy, spiky fur cuff at the ankle. Patchwork panels give it a beastly, monstrous Krampus look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur cuff and the lower hoof front; colour 1 on the large upper panels of the foot; colour 2 on the heel and side patches; colour 3 on a small inner accent under the cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.description: A shaggy fur cuff wrapped around the left ankle, with a smooth band along the top edge and jagged, spiky tufts hanging down over the foot. Monstrous, festive beast styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts; colour 1 on the top band and patches; colour 2 on the side panel; colour 3 barely visible inside the cuff.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.differs: The female version has mostly light fur tufts with the contrasting band only along the top, and no contrasting streak on the outside.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Leech_01.description: A bare-skin left foot with a short ankle cuff and a fan of about seven long, tapering tentacle toes splaying forward from the front of the foot, with a gradient along each toe. Monstrous and partial.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle and foot skin section; colour 1 on the tentacle toes, fading toward the tips.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.description: A low, ankle-high left shoe with a smooth rounded body, a dipped opening at the ankle with a thin edge trim, a contrasting welt around the sole and a rounded reinforced toe cap.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the band along the sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap, sole and opening edge; colour 0 on the light inner ankle lining.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_01.description: A plain, smooth, sock-like left boot that fits closely around the foot and rises to just below the knee. It has a rounded toe, no visible seams or fastenings, and a straight top edge.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_01_1.description: A left wrestling boot rising to just below the knee, with a front lace-up closure, a contrasting cuff band at the top, a rounded toe cap seam and a thin flat sole. It suits sporty, luchador or street looks.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and toe cap; colour 1 on the top cuff band; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole and eyelets.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.description: A snug, mid-calf tight boot with a smooth rounded toe and a swooping diagonal seam between the upper shaft and the ankle section. A small oval emblem sits on the outer side and a recessed heel panel shows at the back.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shaft, foot and toe; colour 1 on the diagonal ankle panel; colour 2 on the recessed heel panel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_.description: A chunky armored shin guard worn on the left lower leg above the boot, with a rounded cuff of horizontal ridged bands, a lower front plate, and a small boxy side pod. Suggests a sci-fi superhero blaster look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell, cuff frame and side pod; colour 3 on the ridged bands, lower front plate and pod inset. The boot beneath is not part of the piece.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_.description: A smooth, calf-high stiletto-heeled boot with a slim pointed toe and a sculpted armored cuff panel wrapped around the upper shin, with raised ridged bands and a lower plate. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and heel; colour 1 on the cuff frame and side plates; colour 3 on the recessed cuff panels and lower shin plate.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Arvad_01.description: A knee-high smooth boot with a rounded toe and thin sole, topped by a stack of layered bands at the cuff. Ornate swirling curled panels run up the front of the shin, giving an east-asian fantasy look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and the raised front scroll frame; colour 1 on the sole and the curled front swirls; colour 2 on the middle cuff bands and the central spiral; colour 3 on the top cuff band.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.description: A soft, smooth calf-high boot with a rounded toe and thin sole, topped by a band of small cylindrical canisters ringed around the upper calf on a slim frame. Sci-fi, mechanical utility look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the sole edge and canister end caps; colour 3 on the band at the boot top; colour 2 on the canister bodies.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.description: A single left boot reaching to just below the knee, with a smooth close-fitting shaft and a plain rounded foot. A V-shaped chevron notch is cut into the front of the top edge, which has a thin rim.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; the rim at the top also shows colour 0. No other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, slimmer shaft that fits closely to the calf, and its top rim is more angled.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boo.description: A left-foot cybernetic boot: a plain calf-high boot shaft with a rigid armoured shin plate held by a wrap-around band at the top, studded with bolts and trailing ribbed cables down the front and side.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the shin plate and calf band; colour 2 on the cables; colour 3 on small accent lines on the plate.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Deity_01.description: A mid-calf single boot with horizontal banded stripes up the shaft, angular chevron panels across the instep and toe, a rounded heel patch and a thin flat sole. Stitched edging gives it a superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band, alternating shaft bands and toe panels; colour 1 on the other shaft bands, toe cap and chevrons; colour 3 on the heel patch and stitched edge lines; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Edged_01.description: A plain, smooth calf-high boot with a slim, slightly tapered shaft and a rounded toe, ending below the knee. The top opening is an open octagonal rim; it suggests a simple, sleek superhero boot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Edged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Edged_01.differs: The female boot has a thin raised rim around the top opening, while the male boot's top is a flat cut edge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Fins_01.description: A smooth, calf-high left boot with a plain rounded toe and a flared top edge, with three jagged, swept-back fins projecting from the outer rear of the calf. A superhero style with a light winged look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Fins_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the fins; colours 1, 2 and 3 are not visible on this sheet.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Fins_01.differs: The fins sit on the outer side of the calf and sweep backward, projecting out from the rear edge of the boot.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Flared_02.description: A smooth, close-fitting left boot reaching to just below the knee, with a tall pointed flare at the outer edge that curves away from the calf. The foot and lower leg are plain and sleek.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Flared_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.description: A single tight leg covering that runs from the upper thigh down over a low-cut boot, with sweeping curved panels, a row of small spikes along the outer calf and a banded ankle cuff. It has a sleek, superhero-style look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front of the thigh and the foot; colour 1 on the outer calf panel and ankle band; colour 2 on the glossy back and side panels of the thigh and calf; colour 3 on the small heel patch.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.description: A form-fitting left leg covering from just above the knee to a soft, low-cut sock-like foot, built from angular colour-blocked panels with a front kneecap patch and a contrasting cuff at the ankle. Sleek superhero styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front of the leg, the foot and the knee patch; colour 1 on the side panels and the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the glossy back-of-calf panel and upper back; colour 3 on the small heel patch.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.description: A single calf-high armoured boot with a flared angular cuff at the top, layered chevron plates down the shin, a banded ankle strap with rivets and a rounded, pointed toe cap. Sleek sci-fi gladiator style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cuff, front shin plate and ankle strap; colour 2 on the chevron shin plates and toe cap; colour 0 on the lower calf band and boot upper; colour 3 on the sole and heel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.description: A left-foot shin and ankle wrap that leaves the foot bare: a snug, calf-high sleeve with angular pointed top edges, diagonal contrasting panel seams, and an open heel and toe loop at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main wrap body; colour 2 on the edge trim and diagonal seam lines; colour 0 and colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_.description: A close-fitting wrapped shin sleeve for the left leg with angled overlapping panels and contrasting edge trim, rising to a pointed top edge. It has a stirrup heel opening and leaves the toes bare with sharp claw tips.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main wrapped leg panels; colour 2 on the edge trim and the seams between panels; colour 0 on the toe claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_.description: A left shin-and-foot guard of segmented plates: a tall greave with scalloped fin-like panels down the front and sides, a flared back shell, an ankle plate, and a bare foot with clawed toe tips.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and back shell; colour 1 on the scalloped front panels and ankle plate; colour 2 on the side inset strip; colour 3 on the small side pivot knobs.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.description: A single left boot that rises to mid-calf, smooth and close-fitting, with a tall thin lightning-bolt fin on the outer side that zigzags and tapers to a long point above the calf. Superhero speedster style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot and the lightning-bolt fin; the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.differs: The female bolt is a flatter, more sharply zigzagging fin rising from the outer calf, while the male bolt is thinner and appears as a separate double-blade spike.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lycanarmor_01.description: A calf-high armoured boot with a soft wrapped body, a rigid plate down the front of the shin, a rounded studded toe cap and buckled straps across the shin and instep. Practical, mechanical sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Lycanarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and back; colour 1 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 2 on the straps and sole; colour 3 on the buckles and rivets.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Maniacsarmor_0.description: A calf-high left boot with a soft wrapped shaft, a front shin plate held by two straps with buckles, and a skull-shaped toe cap studded with spikes. Rugged, menacing, fantasy-armor styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Maniacsarmor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the shin plate and skull toe cap; colour 2 on the straps and sole; colour 3 on the spikes and the top cap of the shaft.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Pointed_01.description: A smooth, tight-fitting left boot that rises to mid-calf with a plain cut top edge and tapers to a slim, elongated pointed toe. It has no visible seams, straps or heel detail, giving a simple superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Pointed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Pointed_01.differs: The female boot has a longer, sharper pointed toe, while the male toe is shorter and blunter.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boo.description: A mid-calf left boot of segmented, banded plates with a rounded toe cap, topped by a separate angular cuff panel bearing a round emblem on the front of the shin. Sci-fi power-suit look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented boot body and toe; colour 1 on the upper cuff panel; colour 2 on the ring around the emblem; colour 3 on the emblem centre.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boo.description: A knee-high heeled boot made of overlapping segmented armor plates along the shin and foot, with a tall angular cuff at the top bearing a round emblem on the front, and a slim stiletto heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented lower boot plates and foot; colour 1 on the upper cuff; colour 3 on the round emblem on the cuff front; colour 2 on the ring around the emblem; colour 1 on the heel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.description: A left clawed alien foot with a bare-toed paw and pointed talons, topped by a layered, segmented ankle guard of overlapping plates that flares into a spiked, angular cuff at the shin.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the paw and the flared upper cuff; colour 2 on the layered ankle plates; colour 3 on the band above the paw; colour 1 on the claw tips and cuff edges.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.differs: The female version has a taller, more sharply pointed cuff and a slightly more angular, layered ankle guard.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_02.description: A left ankle boot shaped like a clawed beast foot: a bare-toed clawed paw with two sharp talons, wrapped in layered strap-like bands around the ankle and topped by a flared, pointed cuff with jagged spikes.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the paw and the fur-like cuff; colour 2 on the layered ankle wraps; colour 3 on the band across the instep; colour 1 on the claw tips and cuff edge highlights.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandal_01.description: A gladiator-style open sandal with a thin flat sole, toe strap and cross straps over the foot, a heel strap, and criss-crossing laces wrapped up the calf to a thick cuff below the knee.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sole, foot straps and calf laces; colour 2 on the top cuff, ankle band and heel strap.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_.description: A tribal sandal boot wrap for the left foot: a patterned cloth cuff reaches the mid-calf with a geometric triangle band, and long dangling fringe hangs over the ankle and instep, above a flat sandal with a toe strap.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff body and toe strap; colour 2 on the triangle and pattern bands and the fringe tips; colour 0 on the sandal sole.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_.differs: The female version's fringe hangs shorter and more sparsely over the foot, so it looks lighter than the male version's.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Spiked_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting mid-calf boot with a plain rounded toe. Three curved spines sweep outward and back from the outer side of the calf. Sits on the left foot and suits a sci-fi or monstrous look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the spines.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Tribalwrap_Sov.description: A tribal left-foot wrap: crisscrossing cloth bands wind up the ankle and lower shin and strap across a bare foot, topped by a fringed shaggy cuff below the calf; contrasting claw-like toe tips extend from the front.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Tribalwrap_Sov.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrap bands, foot straps and top cuff band; colour 2 on the shaggy fringe; colour 0 on the toe claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Viperps_01.description: A single left armoured boot rising to mid-calf, built from segmented sci-fi plates with a flared angular cuff, a large rear calf panel, a contrasting ribbed gap at the back of the shin, and a chunky plated toe and heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plate, cuff and toe cap; colour 1 on the calf panels, ankle plates and heel guards; colour 2 on the ribbed inner gaps.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Viperps_02.description: A knee-high armoured heeled boot in a sci-fi style, with a segmented plated shin guard, a raised angular cuff, a large rear calf plate, side ankle flaps and a slim high heel with a pointed toe plate.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Viperps_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plating, cuff and toe cap; colour 1 on the calf plates, knee and ankle panels and heel flaps; colour 2 on the inner gaps and recessed joints.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.description: A smooth, calf-high left boot with a pointed toe and a flared angular cuff at the top, plus a bat-like wing fin with scalloped edges sweeping out and back from the outer ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the wing; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.differs: The wing sits at the back of the outer calf and sweeps rearward, and it is larger and more clearly bat-shaped than on the male boot.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.description: A calf-length left boot-sock in a tight, tattered zombie style, with stained and blotchy texture, an open toe showing contrasting claw-like toenails, and a thin sole edge. It fits closely from mid-calf to the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sock body; colour 1 on the thin sole edge; colour 3 on the raw patches on the toes and foot; colour 2 on the stains and toenails.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.differs: The female version has dark, pointed toenails with fewer contrasting toe patches showing at the front.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Longheeled_01.description: A smooth, plain knee-high boot with a slim stiletto heel, rounded toe and straight cut-off top just below the knee. Sleek, close-fitting shaft; suits superhero or fashion looks.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Longheeled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire boot; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Longheeled_02.description: A smooth, plain knee-high boot with a straight shaft, rounded toe and a thick block high heel. It fits close to the leg and ends just below the knee, giving a sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Longheeled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A bare beast-like left foot with a short, tapering paw shape and four sharp pointed claws at the toe tips. It replaces the foot from the ankle down, giving a werewolf look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the foot itself shows skin tone and does not take a visible colour slot.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A low, ankle-high patchwork foot covering for the left foot, made of stitched cloth panels with a rounded toe cap and a contrasting patch over the instep. Rough contrasting stitching gives a ragged jester or rag-doll look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the foot; colour 1 on the toe cap and the heel-side panel; colour 3 on the patch over the instep; colour 2 on the stitching.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Madjester_01.differs: The female version has the contrasting patch over the top of the instep, with a diagonal contrasting toe panel, while the male version has contrasting on the heel and outer side.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Madjester_02.description: A mid-calf boot with a chunky rounded toe and thick platform sole, an angular faceted cuff with contrasting edge piping, and two cross straps with small round studs around the upper shaft.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and sole; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 2 on the edge piping along the cuff and panel seams; colour 3 on the small studs on the straps.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Malvan_01.description: A single sci-fi armored boot with a tall segmented shin guard, a rounded knee cup, a banded ankle cuff and a chunky toe cap studded with small spikes. The shin guard flares out into a plate at the back of the knee.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee cup, upper shin plate and toe cap; colour 1 on the shin panels, ankle cuff and toe patch; colour 2 on the lower shin band and ankle strap; colour 3 on small accents at the shin and ankle.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A single left calf-high soft boot with a smooth, snug cloth-like shaft and a thin flat sole that ends in a small pointed, upturned toe cap. Suggests a martial-arts or ninja look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower boot; colour 1 on the upper shaft, fading into colour 0 toward the ankle; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Martial_Power_02.description: A Japanese geta-style sandal worn on the left foot: a tabi-like split-toe sock sits on a raised wooden platform with two low blocks underneath, held by a thick thong strap, with a boxy panel at the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wooden platform and its base blocks; colour 2 on the tabi sock; colour 1 on the thong strap; colour 3 on the heel panel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Mechanon.description: A mechanical left foot in the form of a clawed, digitigrade robotic talon: a contrasting ankle cuff, a round joint disc at the ankle, segmented armoured plates and long pointed toe claws, with a raised block heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armoured plates and claws; colour 1 on the heel block and toe plates; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and linkage; colour 3 on the accent stripes and heel band.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Mechanon_Shinguard.description: A single angular mechanical shinguard worn on the lower leg, built from overlapping plates with sharp flared fins at the sides and a pointed tip near the ankle. It suggests robotic, sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Mechanon_Shinguard.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour plates and spiked fins; colour 1 on the curved inner shell panels; colour 2 on the lower vertical strips and segments; colour 3 on the small accents at the top and ankle tip.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Monster_01.description: A bare monstrous left foot with a skin-like surface, three long curved front claws with banded bases, and a rear spur claw at the heel. It replaces the foot and stops at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; colour 1 on the bands around the claw bases; the foot skin surface appears to ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A single digitigrade-style mechanical leg piece: a large rounded armor shell over the calf with a pointed fin at the top, a thin exposed ankle column, a segmented ankle cuff, and a clawed, talon-toed foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf shell, ankle cuff and toe plates; colour 1 on the foot base and sole; colour 2 on the inner calf panel, shell edging and claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.description: A spiked armoured greave for the left lower leg: a bladed knee-cap guard with long curved thorns, segmented ribbed plates down the shin tapering into a sharp point below the foot, and an open contrasting front cavity.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour edges, thorns and pointed tip; colour 1 on the shin and calf plates; colour 3 on the inner trim lines and accents; colour 2 on the interior.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.differs: The female version has taller, more sweeping curved blades at the top and a slimmer, more pointed lower shell.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.description: A spiky, armored lower-leg piece for the left foot, covering the shin and calf with layered plates, curved blade-like spikes rising at the sides and back, and a pointed tip below. Monstrous, fantasy styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame, ribs and curved spikes; colour 1 on the lower plates and pointed tip; colour 3 on the inner trim lines; colour 2 on the inner opening.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ninjaboots_01.description: A ninja-style tabi boot with a split-toe foot and a short wrapped shin cuff that ends below the knee. The cuff is a snug tube with diagonal wrap creases, giving a martial, East Asian look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ninjaboots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the split-toe foot; colour 1 on the wrapped shin cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_None_01.description: An empty left-foot option: nothing is worn on the foot, and the leg ends bare at the ankle. Only a tiny flat cap shows at the cut-off point.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: No visible features take a colour slot; only a tiny disc at the ankle end.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Norse_01.description: A shaggy fur boot for the left foot, reaching just below the knee with a ragged tufted cuff and fur-covered foot. contrasting straps cross in an X up the shin and bind the ankle, giving a Norse, barbarian look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Norse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the boot and cuff; colour 2 on the crossing straps and ankle band.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Norse_01.differs: The female boot is taller and slimmer, with the X straps sitting higher on the shin and a single band at the ankle.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Padding.description: A left foot and lower-leg armour set: a low rounded boot with an ankle cuff, segmented shin plates with a strap band, and a bulbous padded calf guard at the back. Sporty sci-fi tactical look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot toe and main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and plate insets; colour 2 on the shin strap band and calf pad edge; colour 3 on the small heel patch and ankle accent.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Padding.differs: The shin plates are slimmer and sit more separately from the leg, with a detached-looking calf pad.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Patterned_01.description: A left mid-calf superhero boot with a smooth rounded foot and a stiff shin guard. A pointed chevron panel on the front is set off by thin contrasting trim, and a plain wide panel covers the back of the calf.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chevron panel and the back calf panel; colour 1 on the foot, the upper shin cap and the lower front; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Paw_01.description: A beast-like left foot covering: a short, blocky ankle cuff flows into a rounded paw with four bulging toes, each tipped with a curved claw. It replaces the foot for a monstrous, animal look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Paw_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body with a mottled texture picking up colour 1; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pegleg_01.description: A peg-leg replacement for the left foot: a faceted, mottled cup-shaped socket wraps the lower shin and tapers into a slim tapering wooden-looking post that replaces the foot. Pirate-style prosthetic.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pegleg_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the socket cup with its mottled texture; colour 0 on the tapered peg post.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Persian_01.description: A flat open sandal for the left foot: a thin sole, crossing straps over the top of the foot, a strap running between the toes, and a wide cuff around the ankle joined to the heel by a narrow back strap.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sole and the straps over the foot; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and the toe strap.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Persian_01.differs: The female sandal has a contrasting sole and only two straps across the foot, where the male version has three straps and a light-coloured sole (colour 0).

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A knee-high pirate boot in soft cloth with a wide turned-down cuff, a small gem at the front of the cuff and a pointed, upturned toe on a thin flat sole. Has a slightly slouched shaft.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft and cuff; colour 1 on the foot and toe, fading upward into the shaft; colour 2 on the sole, toe tip and cuff edging; colour 3 on the gem.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A calf-high pirate boot with a pointed toe cap and a wide flared cuff of vertical panels at the top. Three horizontal straps with square buckles wrap the shin, giving a swashbuckling look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff panels; colour 1 on the three straps; colour 3 on the buckle frames; colour 2 on the sole, toe cap and cuff edging.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.differs: The female boot has a taller, narrower cuff that sits higher on the leg, with the buckles on the outer side rather than the front.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.description: A left knee-high pirate boot with a wide folded-over cuff at the top, a buckled strap around the calf, a thin side rod, a contrasting ankle strap and a pointed toe cap. Soft, slightly slouched cloth-like construction.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the calf strap; colour 2 on the ankle strap, toe cap and cuff edging; colour 3 on the buckle and small studs.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.differs: The female boot has a taller, more flared cuff that reaches higher up the leg.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Point_01.description: A futuristic pointed shin guard for the left leg: a chunky ring cuff at the ankle, a long tapering front plate ending in a sharp downward spike, and a ribbed, layered panel down the back of the calf.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Point_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate and cuff rim; colour 1 on the cuff and side edges; colour 2 on the rear ribbed panels; colour 3 on the cuff light strips and small front inserts.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pointed_01.description: A plain, smooth left short boot that ends just above the ankle, with a narrow pointed toe that tapers to a sharp tip. It has a simple, close-fitting shape with no visible fastenings.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pointed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; the sole tip shows a small edge that appears to use another slot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pointed_01.differs: The female boot has a slimmer, more sharply pointed toe, while the male toe is blunter and broader.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Power_01.description: A segmented armored greave for the left lower leg: a pointed kneecap-like plate on top, a central shield-shaped shin panel with angular side plates, a bulky calf guard, and overlapping plates over the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side shin plates and calf guard; colour 1 on the central shin panel; colour 3 on the knee plate face; colour 2 on the plate edges, foot plates and lower back section.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Powersuit_01.description: A left mechanical armored boot reaching below the knee, with smooth plated shin and calf shells, a contrasting front seam strip, a rimmed top edge, and a segmented toe cap with small round bolt details near the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Powersuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin and calf plating, the rim and the toe plate; colour 1 on the front seam strip and the toe and ankle panels; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Powersuit_02.description: A knee-high sci-fi heeled boot with a smooth armored shaft, a contrasting front stripe running down the shin, plated panels over the instep and toe, and a slim stiletto heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Powersuit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft, toe and heel body; colour 1 on the front shin stripe and the instep and toe plates; colour 0 on the rim at the top edge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pulp_Heels_01.description: A T-strap high-heeled pump with a rounded closed toe featuring small teardrop cut-outs, a central strap running up the instep to an ankle strap with a buckle, and a tall slim stiletto heel. Retro pinup style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Pulp_Heels_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper, the T-strap and the ankle strap; colour 1 on the edge trim, the heel and the sole; colour 2 on the buckle.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Punk_01.description: A chunky ankle-high lace-up sneaker-boot with a rounded, slightly bulbous toe cap, a thin flat sole, criss-cross laces and a thick rolled cuff at the ankle. Casual street-punk footwear for the left foot.
