Female/F_Footl_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the rolled ankle cuff; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.description: A mid-calf punk boot with a flared, folded-over cuff, a glossy shaft, and a chunky rounded toe with a thick sole. Clusters of small metal spikes stud the toe and heel sides.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, sole and spikes; colour 1 on the upper shaft panel and toe cap; colour 2 on the glossy lower shaft; colour 3 on the side panel near the toe.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01.description: A left foot covering shaped like a clawed creature foot: a short ankle cuff with a contrasting diagonal band, a furry-looking bare-foot sole and toes ending in pointed claws. Sits low at the ankle and foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and toe body; colour 1 on the claws; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the band across the ankle and the side wedge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01_1.description: A left foot covering shaped like a clawed beast paw, with a mottled, streaked surface, a short ankle cuff, and pointed talons on the toes; it fits close to the foot like a skin.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot surface; colour 1 on the streaked patches and the claw tips; colour 2 on the thin streaks.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Radical_01.description: A low, ankle-high sock-like foot covering that hugs the left foot, with a separate panel wrapping the top and inner side of the ankle and a textured, dimpled surface over the heel, toe and outer side.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Radical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth panel over the top and inner side of the ankle and instep; colour 1 on the textured heel, toe and outer side.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Rave_01.description: A single thigh-high striped stocking with a snug cloth fit, a rolled contrasting band at the top and a rounded sneaker-like foot with a contrasting toe cap. Multiple thin horizontal bands run the whole length. Playful rave style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide stripes and the foot base; colour 2 on the thin stripes and the toe and sole; colour 3 on the accent stripes; colour 1 on the top band.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Rave_01.differs: Extends higher up, to the thigh, while the male version stops around the knee.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A mid-calf tribal sandal-boot with an open toe and a thin sole. Crisscrossing straps lace up the foot and shin, and a fringed, patterned cuff with a jagged serrated rim sits at the top.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the straps, sole and cuff fringe; colour 3 on the cuff patterns and inner rim; colour 2 on the serrated cuff edge.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A low, smooth ankle shoe with a rounded toe, a thin contrasting sole edge, a separate cuff panel at the ankle and a raised stripe running from the cuff over the top to the toe. Sleek sci-fi footwear.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the sole edge; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the central stripe.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Retroscifi_Boot_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a smooth, faceted tube shaft that flares slightly at the top and a rounded, bulbous toe. A small round port sits on each side of the ankle, and a thin trim edges the sole.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Retroscifi_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap and the back of the shaft; colour 1 on the front of the shaft and the sole edge and port rings; colour 3 on the centre of the ankle ports; colour 2 on the underside of the heel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.description: A left mecha boot: an angular armored ankle cuff with vent slots and thin glowing-line seams, a contrasting clamp band at the ankle, and long blade-like fins sweeping forward over the toe with a tall spike at the heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff plates; colour 1 on the toe blades and heel spike; colour 2 on the clamp band and joint housing; colour 3 on the seam lines and vent insets.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.description: A mid-calf robotic samurai boot with angular plated panels, a tall flared rear guard, thin blade-like fins rising at the sides, and a strapped open-toe foot with a round side stud. Sci-fi armour styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rear calf guard, sole rim and toe accents; colour 1 on the main boot body and toe cap; colour 2 on the front shin plate, straps and fins; colour 3 on the inner calf panel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Rocker_01.description: A mid-calf leather-look boot with a smooth, slightly wrinkled shaft, a rounded toe and a chunky block heel on a contrasting sole. It has a plain, casual, rock-inspired look and covers the left foot and lower leg.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot shaft and upper; colour 0 on the sole and heel.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Rocker_01.differs: The female boot has a raised block heel and a shorter shaft, while the male version has a flat sole and a taller shaft.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Rollerblade_01.description: A left inline skate: a padded ankle-high boot with laced front, two cuff straps, contrasting toe cap and sole, mounted on a frame carrying a row of small wheels. Sporty street style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Rollerblade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, cuff lining and sole edge; colour 1 on the boot body and top cuff; colour 3 on the straps, wheel frame and small studs; colour 2 on the laces and wheel hubs.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A fitted left leg covering from upper thigh to a pointed high-heeled boot, with a decorative knee guard bearing a spiked gem, stacked segmented bands around the calf, and a trimmed top edge.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg and boot; colour 1 on the top cap, edge trim and knee guard panels; colour 2 on the stacked calf bands; colour 3 on the knee gem and spike.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.description: A left ankle-high armored boot in an east-asian samurai style: swirl-patterned front shin plate topped by a pointed blade-like crest, a swept side fin, two thin ankle straps, and a sharply upturned pointed toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin back plate, sole and pointed crests; colour 1 on the thin edge trim; colour 2 on the ankle straps; colour 3 on the swirl patterned panels and toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.differs: The toe on the female boot is shorter and less sharply pointed, and the side fin is smaller.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_01.description: A left-foot geta sandal: a flat wooden platform raised on two chunky block teeth, with a thong strap over the toes and a split-toe tabi-style sock covering the foot. Sits under the foot; traditional Japanese look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wooden platform and teeth; colour 2 on the thong strap; colour 0 on the split-toe sock.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_Skin.description: A bare-foot geta sandal for the left foot: a flat wooden board raised on two chunky block teeth, held on by a thin thong strap between the toes. Sits under the foot, with toes and skin exposed.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_Skin.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wooden board and teeth; colour 2 on the thong strap; the bare foot and toenails ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sapphire.description: A thigh-high, form-fitting left boot with a short heel: a smooth upper leg shaft with a contrasting trim rim and small gems at the top front, curved trim bands around the calf, and a lower boot section with small gem studs at the toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sapphire.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper leg shaft; colour 0 on the lower boot and foot; colour 1 on the rim and curved trim bands; colour 3 on the small gems.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_0.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a wide contrasting cuff at the top, a banded ribbed shaft, a thin contrasting sole edge, and a row of small cone spikes running along the top of the toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the top cuff and sole edge; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the spike bases and the shaft band lines.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_0.differs: The female boot has a rounded, octagonal cuff that is level all the way around.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A sci-fi soldier left boot with a slim tapered shin, a chunky armored cuff below the knee with a notched front plate and small rear tab, side ankle discs and a rounded, capped toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin, boot body and cuff edges; colour 1 on the cuff, ankle bands, ankle discs and toe panels; colour 2 on the toe cap and front cuff insert; colour 3 on the small tab at the back of the cuff.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.differs: The female boot has a slimmer, longer shin and a narrower ankle, with the cuff sitting a little lower on the calf.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Secret_01.description: A high-top casual sneaker with a chunky rounded sole, laced front, padded collar and a small pull tab at the heel. Overlaid side panels and a separate toe cap give it a sporty street look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side panels, tongue and heel; colour 1 on the main upper and collar; colour 2 on the toe cap and laces; colour 3 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Secret_02.description: A short lace-up casual ankle boot with a rounded toe cap, stitched seams, a thick chunky sole, a padded tongue and a small pull loop at the heel. It sits over the left foot and ankle in a casual, street style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and toe cap; colour 1 on the tongue; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Secret_03.description: A low-top casual sneaker with a chunky flat sole, laced front, padded heel tab and a short ribbed sock cuff showing at the ankle. Overlay panels on the toe and sides give it a sporty, everyday look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe upper; colour 0 on the toe cap, side panels, heel tab and laces; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the sock cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Secret_04.description: A left mid-calf lace-up boot with a rounded reinforced toe cap, a chunky flat sole, criss-cross front lacing through eyelets, and two buckled straps wrapped around the calf. Casual, practical street style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and toe cap; colour 1 on the laces and the two calf straps; colour 3 on the eyelets and strap buckles; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A left mid-calf boot with a slim, sleek profile, a flat sole and a rounded toe cap. A contrasting cuff sits at the top, and a large pointed fin juts backward from the heel. Angular colour-blocked panels run up the shaft.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, toe cap, sole edge and heel fin; colour 1 on the main shaft and toe sides; colour 2 on the diagonal side panel and toe tip; colour 3 on the small diagonal panel at the upper front and side.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.description: A low-cut, square-toed shoe with a small stacked heel and a wide strap across the instep fastened by a large square buckle. A short contrasting cuff shows at the ankle. Colonial or pirate-style dress shoe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe body and instep strap; colour 2 on the buckle; colour 0 on the small ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.differs: The female shoe is coloured mostly with colour 1, while the male version is coloured with colour 0.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoecasual_01.description: A casual low-top sneaker for the left foot with a chunky rubber sole, laced front, and side stripes, plus a slouchy scrunched sock cuff that rises above the ankle. Sporty street look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoecasual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper and sole; colour 1 on the laces, side stripes and sole edge; colour 2 on the heel patch and stripe outlines; colour 3 on the sock cuff.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoeheel_01.description: A low-cut, slip-on shoe with a smooth rounded toe, a shallow scooped opening at the ankle and a short block heel. It covers only the left foot and looks like a simple casual or formal pump.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoeheel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoe including the heel; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoeheel_01_Glitter.description: A low-heeled ankle shoe with a smooth, rounded toe box, a small block heel and a short ankle cuff. Separate panels break up the upper and the cuff, giving a sleek, simple casual look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoeheel_01_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe upper and the round side patch; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and the swooping panels across the vamp and heel; colour 3 on small accents at the toe, heel and cuff edge; colour 2 on a thin strip at the back of the heel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoesock_01.description: A low-top casual sneaker with a lace-up front, side stripes and a thick flat sole, worn with a ribbed calf-length tube sock with horizontal stripe bands at the top.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Shoesock_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sock body and stripe bands; colour 1 on the wide sock bands, sneaker side stripes and toe area; colour 0 on the sneaker upper and laces; colour 2 on the sock thin stripes and heel and sole trim.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Simian_01.description: A ragged, fur-like lower leg covering for the left foot: shaggy tapered strands hang from mid-calf to the ankle with a jagged torn hem, leaving the bare foot and toes exposed. Suggests a simian or beastly look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Simian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaggy leg covering, fading darker toward the hem, with colour 2 shading the tattered tips.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Skin_01.description: A bare, skin-textured left foot with individually modelled toes and toenails, ending at the ankle. It replaces the footwear entirely, leaving the foot uncovered beneath the leg.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Skin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toenails; the foot itself is skin and does not take a visible slot colour.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Skin_Claw_01.description: A bare, skin-like left foot replacing the boot, with a low ankle cuff and five short pointed claws at the toe tips. Gives a beastly, animalistic look while staying close to a natural foot shape.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Skin_Claw_01.colourAreas: The foot skin appears to use its own skin tone and ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Skull_01.description: A left boot in a monstrous, demonic style: a tapered lower leg wrapped in organic-looking material, a flared armored cuff with a tall spike and skull-like face with glowing eyes at the shin, and a curled, clawed toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, spikes and toe plates; colour 1 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the fine grooves and spike details.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Snake_01.description: A calf-high scaled boot with a segmented plated foot, a glossy oval panel on the outer calf, a trimmed top edge and a sharp curved horn-like fin flaring up at the outer side of the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled calf; colour 1 on the foot plates and top trim; colour 2 on the glossy oval calf panel; colour 3 on the horn fin.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The oval calf panel sits toward the outer front of the leg and the horn rises at the front, while on the male it sits more to the side and back.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sneakers_Gear_01.description: A chunky high-top canvas sneaker for the left foot, with a rounded toe cap, a thick lugged sole, criss-cross laces and a small gear emblem on the outer side. Ankle-height, casual street style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Sneakers_Gear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the canvas upper; colour 0 on the toe cap and gear emblem; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a flat sole, a contrasting reinforced toe cap with small vents, a raised front stripe running up the shin, and a wide flared cuff band around the top with an open front window.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body and cuff top; colour 1 on the inner stripes along the shin and foot; colour 3 on the raised front stripe, cuff band, and sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Space_01.description: A low futuristic shoe with a chunky rimmed sole, a rounded toe and a short ankle cuff. A wide strap panel crosses the instep, with a separate band over the midfoot and small tabs at the sides.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and the midfoot band; colour 1 on the sole rim and the small tabs; colour 2 on the shoe upper; colour 3 on the instep strap panel.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_01.description: A Greco-Roman gladiator sandal with a shin guard: a smooth, shaped plate covers the front of the lower leg from knee to ankle, with a trimmed edge and crisscrossing straps wrapping the calf and lacing over the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate; colour 1 on the trim edging the plate; colour 2 on the straps and sandal sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_03.description: A Greek-style gladiator sandal with a shin guard that rises to a sculpted lion head over the knee. The guard has a Greek-key border, and criss-crossing straps wrap the calf and lace across the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin panel; colour 1 on the lion head and the guard edging; colour 2 on the sandal straps, soles and calf straps; colour 3 not visible.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_03.differs: The female shin guard is slimmer and its calf straps cross diagonally in an X, while the male version has parallel horizontal straps.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A left boot of organic, bone-like plating that reaches mid-calf, with a jagged crown-like rim, textured ridged panels and a rounded toe. A long curved horn spike sweeps up from the outer top edge.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot shell; colour 1 on the ridged marking patterns across the boot; colour 2 on the curved horn spike.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Steampunk_01.description: A short, chunky steampunk ankle boot with a wide cuff at the top, a studded rounded toe cap, a strap across the instep, and a large gear-shaped bolt fixed to each side of the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, toe cap and rear panel; colour 1 on the boot shaft and sole edge; colour 2 on the instep strap and toe plates; colour 3 on the gears and studs.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A left ankle boot of layered mechanical armor plates: a flared angular cuff at the top, a segmented shin guard, a round side knob, a strap plate over the instep and a blunt plated toe cap.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, shin plates and heel; colour 1 on the ankle and toe inserts; colour 2 on the toe cap, strap plate and inner shin plates.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.differs: The female boot has a slightly narrower, more tapered ankle, with the contrasting plates hanging further down the back of the shin.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Steelhawk_01.description: A single mid-calf boot with a smooth angular shell, a flat trim cap at the top, layered bands wrapped around the ankle, a pointed talon-like toe, and a small stack of feather-like fins flaring from the outer calf.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Steelhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shell; colour 3 on the top cap and ankle band trim; colour 1 on the calf fins; colour 2 on the pointed toe cap.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered.description: A mid-calf boot with an overlapping feather-scale shaft, a banded cuff with a raised pointed back tab, and a smooth armoured foot with edge trim. Three sharp talon-like claws extend past the toe. Suggests a raptor or steel-hawk look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather-scale shaft; colour 1 on the cuff, the back tab and the foot edge trim; colour 2 on the foot plate; colour 3 on the talons.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Strappy_01.description: A low, flat ballet-style slipper with a small heel and an open top, worn on the left foot. Long thin straps criss-cross up the shin and calf, tied off at the back of the ankle. Suggests a dancer or gladiator-sandal look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Strappy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body; colour 1 on the small ankle stud at the back; colour 2 on the criss-crossing straps.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Superlong_01.description: A thigh-high heeled boot in smooth fitted material with a lace-up front running from the toe to the top of the thigh, ending in a short block heel and a rounded toe. Sleek, fetish-leaning or stage-style look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Superlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the laces; colour 3 on the eyelets along the lacing; colour 2 on the small inner lining at the top.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Superlong_01.differs: The female boot reaches the upper thigh with a lace-up front, while the male version stops below the knee with a two-tone cuff and studded trim.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.description: A skin-tight, bare-foot style covering for the left leg: a calf-high sleeve with a jagged, torn upper rim that fades into a sculpted foot with veiny detail and clawed, pointed toes.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower leg; colour 1 on the upper calf sleeve, blending into colour 0 lower down; colour 3 on the toe claws.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.differs: The upper rim is a little shorter and less jagged, and the calf tapers more slimly.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_02.description: A bare-foot monster boot that wraps the foot and lower shin like skin, with veined wrinkles, a jagged flared cuff at the top and five long pointed claws at the toes. Suggests a beast or symbiote creature.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower part of the foot skin; colour 1 on the upper shin and jagged cuff, blending into colour 0; colour 3 on the toe claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Short_01.description: A bare, skin-like monstrous left foot covering with a smooth, slightly wrinkled surface that ends just above the ankle. Five sharp, pointed claws extend from the toe tips, giving a beastly, symbiote look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot covering; colour 3 on the toe claws.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Tech3toes_01.description: A bulky mechanical left boot with a rounded armored shin-shell, a vented front panel with round holes, slotted vents at the back, thin contrasting seam lines, and a chunky three-toed clawed foot base.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Tech3toes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot shell; colour 1 on the front vented panel and the toe caps; colour 2 on the foot base and ankle mechanism; colour 3 on the seam lines and inside the vent slots.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Tech3toes_Warlord_0.description: A bulky mechanical left boot: a faceted armored shin housing tapering to a three-toed clawed foot with hazard-striped soles, small rungs down the front, and rivets. Sits over the lower leg and foot in a heavy robotic style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Tech3toes_Warlord_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin armor housing; colour 1 on the three toes and the front rungs; colour 3 on the hazard-striped toe edges and small rivets.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Teddy_01.description: A shaggy, furry ankle-high foot covering shaped like a chunky beast paw, with a thick shaggy body and rounded toe lumps at the front that fade from the fur into a distinct toe colour; a thin band circles the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur of the foot; colour 3 on the rounded toe lumps, blending up into the fur; colour 1 on the thin ankle band.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Thick_01.description: A plain, smooth calf-high left boot with a slightly flared open top, a straight shaft and a rounded toe. It sits over the foot and lower leg, giving a simple superhero look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Toy_01.description: A calf-high left boot with a smooth rounded toe, a thin sole edge, a band at the top and a chunky folded cuff. contrasting outline panels and two round contrasting studs run along the outer side, giving a retro toy-robot look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot body; colour 2 on the top cuff and the outline panels; colour 0 on the band below the cuff and the sole edge; colour 3 on the two round buttons on the side.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Toy_02.description: A calf-high toy-soldier boot with a straight, slightly flared shaft, two stacked trim bands at the top, a stylised scrollwork emblem down the front, a rounded toe and a thin contrasting sole.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the two bands around the top; colour 2 on the front scrollwork emblem; colour 3 on the sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Trooperbot_01.description: A mid-calf robotic armored boot with a smooth shin plate, a padded ankle strap and a rounded toe cap. A thick rounded cuff at the top carries short spikes, and small studs dot the shin and toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Trooperbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 1 on the top cuff; colour 2 on the ankle strap; colour 3 on the spikes and studs.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Trunk_01.description: A monstrous tentacle-like foot covering for the left foot: a swirl-patterned organic mass with a cuffed top, curling hooked tendrils at the ankle and long clawed tips spreading below the foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Trunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swirling patterned body; colour 1 on the cuff top, swirl markings and tendril bodies; colour 3 on the claw tips and tendril ends.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.description: A calf-high anime-style boot with a faceted, panelled shaft, a strap-like band across the ankle and a rounded toe. Colour-blocked sections give it a sleek, sporty, slightly mechanical look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, toe cap and heel panel; colour 1 on the main shaft, ankle band and foot; colour 2 on the middle band of the shaft; colour 3 on the small side panel and toe accent.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Urban_Boot_01.description: A mid-calf smooth boot with a wide straight shaft, rounded toe and thin contrasting sole. Two buckled straps with small square clasps wrap the shaft and ankle. Clean, sporty urban styling.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Urban_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 3 on the sole; colour 2 on the small strap clasps.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Vibroman_01.description: A single knee-high armoured boot for the left foot: a smooth angular shin plate with a raised edge and a seam line, and a rounded toe cap with a strap-like band over the instep. Sci-fi superhero style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Vibroman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot, including the shin plate, toe cap and instep band; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A left barefoot shin and ankle guard with layered angular blades flaring up the front of the shin, a smooth wrapped calf shell, and a strap across the ankle; the toes are left bare with clawed tips.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin and calf shell; colour 1 on the blade edges, ankle straps and toe claws; colour 2 on small accents between the blades.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Vine_01.description: A left boot of twisting, vine-like organic growth with swirling carved patterns and curling tendrils that end in sharp tips along the cuff, ankle and toe. It rises to mid-calf and suggests a monstrous, fantasy look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the boot and cuff top; colour 0 on the swirling pattern bands; colour 3 on the tendril tips and thorns.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Viperia_01.description: A knee-high superhero boot with a heeled contrasting lower foot and a tall shaft that rises to just above the knee. The shaft carries a snake-head motif at the front, a flared trim rim at the top, and a thin zigzag line at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Viperia_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tall shaft; colour 1 on the top rim, snake-head motif and toe tip; colour 0 on the lower boot; colour 3 on the thin zigzag line at the ankle.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Viperia_01.differs: The female boot has a higher, narrower heel and a pointier, more tapered toe.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Viperlogo_01.description: A mid-calf armoured boot with a high-heeled sole, segmented ribbed plates over the calf and a flared, clawed cuff at the top. Angular spiked toe and heel edges give it a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented calf plates; colour 1 on the cuff, toe and heel housings and spikes; colour 2 on the inner boot opening; colour 3 on the heel vent panel and small logo.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Viperlogo_01.differs: The female boot sits on a raised high heel with a taller, more pointed cuff, while the male boot has a flatter sole.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wedding_Opentoe_01.description: A formal open-toe high-heeled sandal with a closed heel cup, criss-crossed toe straps, a thin ankle strap fastened with a small buckle, and a tapered stiletto-style heel. Worn on the left foot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wedding_Opentoe_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shoe body, toe straps and heel cup; colour 0 on the edge trim, inner panels and ankle strap; colour 2 on the heel and buckle.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Winged_01.description: A mid-calf heeled boot with a slightly flared, folded cuff, outlined seams, scrollwork on the instep, a small round emblem at the cuff and a strap with buckle across the ankle. A feathered wing sweeps out from the outer side.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and wing feathers; colour 1 on the outlines, heel and sole; colour 3 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the small emblem details.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Winged_01.differs: The female boot is taller, reaching mid-calf on a block heel, with a single large wing on the outer side; the male version is an ankle boot with a flat sole and a pair of wings.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01.description: A left wingtip brogue with laced upper, decorative perforated toe cap and thin sole, worn with a ribbed calf-length sock that is held by a thin garter band with straps at the top. A casual-formal, retro style.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe upper; colour 0 on the wingtip toe cap and side panels; colour 3 on the sole, laces, garter band and sock studs; colour 2 on the ribbed sock.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A single left leg covering: a loose, wrinkled cloth legging from the upper thigh to the ankle, topped by a patterned band with a greek-key motif, ending in a short cuffed soft boot.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrinkled legging; colour 2 on the top band and its inner lining; colour 0 on the key pattern; colour 1 on the boot.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wizards_Heels_01.description: A high-heeled ankle-strap pump with a rounded toe, a sturdy stiletto-style heel, contrasting edge trim and a buckled strap at the ankle. A vertically striped panel runs over the instep, with small oval cutouts near the toe.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wizards_Heels_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body and ankle strap; colour 1 on the heel, edge trim and sole; colour 2 on the stripes over the instep; colour 3 on the small oval toe accents.

Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wolf_Armor_01.description: A single-leg armoured greave and boot: stacked, segmented plates with zigzag trim wrap from the knee to the ankle, ending in a clawed, talon-like foot with pointed toe spikes. Suggests a wolf-themed, mechanical warrior look.
Female/F_Footl_Tight_Wolf_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg plates and foot; colour 3 on the trim edging and the top knee band; colour 2 on the inset panels and ankle wraps; colour 1 on the claws and small gem-like inlay.

Female/F_Footl_Toxicsteel_01.description: A monstrous clawed foot piece: a chunky ankle-high boot with a rounded heel and a layered, crumpled plate over the top of the foot, ending in a contrasting toe spike and several talon-like claws at the toes and heel.
Female/F_Footl_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the heel, sole and toe base; colour 2 on the crumpled plates over the instep; colour 1 on the claws; colour 0 on the central toe spike.

Female/F_Footl_Victory_01.description: A low ankle boot with a rounded toe cap, a contrasting rim at the ankle and a thin strap line up the front. Curved fin-like blades sweep up from the heel and a gem sits at the back. Sleek, winged superhero style.
Female/F_Footl_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and the tall fin blade; colour 1 on the toe cap, heel base and the smaller side fin; colour 2 on the ankle rim, sole and front strap line; colour 3 on the heel gem.

Female/F_Footl_Werewolf_01.description: A bare beast-foot covering for the left foot: a digitigrade, paw-like shape with four splayed toes ending in long curved claws and a small dewclaw at the side. It replaces the foot below the ankle, in a monstrous werewolf style.
Female/F_Footl_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole paw and toes; colour 1 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Animal_01.description: A bare, skin-textured beast foot replacing the right foot: a splayed three-toed paw with a rear dewclaw, fine scale texture at the ankle, and long curved talons. Suits monstrous or animal-themed characters.
Female/F_Footr_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the foot; colour 2 on the claws. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Footr_Animal_02.description: A right foot covering shaped like a canine paw: a furred, muscular foot with four splayed toes ending in curved claws and a small dewclaw at the inner ankle. A tufted fur edge runs along the sole.
Female/F_Footr_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furred foot surface; colour 1 on the sole and heel tufts; colour 3 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A chunky ankle boot with a smooth rounded toe, a thick flat sole with a raised rim, and a separate angled cuff around the ankle with a round button-like stud on the outer side. Retro robotic style.
Female/F_Footr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the round stud; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Arcane_01.description: A knee-high scaled boot with an overlapping fish-scale shaft, a flat pointed toe cap with zigzag-edged band, and a flared top cuff of sharp angular fins around the knee. Fantasy mage styling.
Female/F_Footr_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled shaft, heel and toe side panel; colour 1 on the toe cap and the inner cuff fins; colour 2 on the knee cuff centre and zigzag detailing; colour 3 on the small gem-like accents at the knee front.

Female/F_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01.description: A chunky right boot made of stacked, cracked stone slabs that rises to the shin, with a broad blocky toe and a cluster of jagged crystal shards jutting up from the outer side of the calf. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Female/F_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs; colour 3 on the glowing cracks between the stones and the inner opening; colour 1 on the crystal shards.
Female/F_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, narrower stone shaft with the crystals sitting higher on the calf.

Female/F_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01_1.description: A chunky right boot built from cracked, cobblestone-like rock slabs that cover the foot and shin, with a jagged raised edge at the top and a cluster of angular crystal shards jutting from the outer side.
Female/F_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between the stones and the inner top opening; colour 1 on the crystal shards.
Female/F_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01_1.differs: The crystal cluster sits on the outer back of the boot and the top rim is taller and more jagged on one side.

Female/F_Footr_Astronaut_01.description: A chunky low astronaut-style shoe with a thick flat platform sole, a rounded armoured toe cap with grooved ridges, a smooth upper with a small strap patch at the instep, and a soft rolled ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the rolled ankle cuff; colour 2 on the toe cap and sole; colour 3 on the instep patch.

Female/F_Footr_Astronaut_02.description: A chunky astronaut-style right shoe with a thick flat platform sole, a ribbed rounded toe cap, a smooth ankle-high upper, a small strap panel on the instep and a soft padded cuff at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the sole and toe cap; colour 3 on the instep strap panel.

Female/F_Footr_Beast_Mechanical_01.description: A mechanical beast-foot covering the right foot: a banded ankle cuff, plated top, and long curved blade-like claws at the front with small roller joints and a rear spur, giving a monstrous robotic look.
Female/F_Footr_Beast_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw blades, cuff rim and plated top edges; colour 1 on the ankle cuff, toe plates and roller joints; colour 3 on the small marks on the claws; colour 2 on the inner mechanical joints.

Female/F_Footr_Boots_Goth_01.description: Chunky ankle boot with a thick treaded platform sole, rounded toe cap, front lacing with eyelets and a folded-over cuff. A wide strap with a buckle and eyelets circles the ankle. Gothic, punk-leaning street style.
Female/F_Footr_Boots_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the thick tread sole; colour 2 on the ankle strap; colour 3 on the eyelets, buckle and lace studs.

Female/F_Footr_Boots_Goth_02.description: A right mid-calf lace-up boot with a chunky platform sole, front lacing with small eyelets, a folded cuff at the top and two wide straps with buckle plates across the shaft. Gothic, punk-leaning footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Boots_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and cuff; colour 1 on the platform sole; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the strap plates, laces, eyelets, cuff button and sole accent lines.

Female/F_Footr_Boots_Ski_01.description: A chunky, padded ankle-high snow boot with a rounded toe, a thick contrasting sole, a padded cuff, and three cross-straps with small clasps down the front. Contrasting piping outlines the panels and heel. Sporty, winter-gear look.
Female/F_Footr_Boots_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and padded tongue; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the straps, piping and rim; colour 3 on the strap clasp accents.

Female/F_Footr_Boots_Spy_01.description: A right mid-calf boot with a pointed toe and short stacked heel, topped by a tall separate cuff panel with a slightly flared, angular rim and two small buttons on the outer side. Smooth leather look with a spy-like feel.
Female/F_Footr_Boots_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper calf cuff; colour 1 on the foot and toe section; colour 2 on the sole and heel; colour 3 on the buttons.
Female/F_Footr_Boots_Spy_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, narrower cuff that reaches higher up the calf.

Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Cryo_01.description: A pair of segmented, ribbed tube arcs that loop around the lower calf above the ankle like a broken ring, with a gap at the front and back. Reads as a mechanical or cryo-tech accessory.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole ribbed tube; no other slots visible.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Cryo_01.differs: The female version loops as a more upright, oval ring around the calf, while the male's hoops are looser and tilt at an angle.

Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Draco_01.description: A single curved dragon-horn spike worn on the outer side of the right lower leg, with a long hooked tip rising toward the knee and a cluster of small serrated fins tapering down near the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole spike and its serrated fins; the small inner face shows a light patch that takes colour 0.

Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_0.description: A small angular plate worn on the right shin, with two raised ear-like corners and a robotic face design: two hexagonal socketed eyes, a notch for a nose and a ribbed mouth strip. The back is a plain panel.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and ear corners; colour 0 on the face plate and the back panel; colour 3 on the eye lenses; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth strip.

Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_0.description: A minimal sandal-like foot accessory: a thin flat loop outlining the sole with an open toe, and a single angled instep strap with a notched V top edge and contrasting trim. Sits on the right foot.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the instep strap face; colour 0 on the trim along the strap edges; colour 2 on the thin sole loop and strap inner side.

Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Steelcommand.description: A curved, blade-like armored fin worn on the outside of the lower right leg, tapering to a point at the top, with layered angular plates and inset panels on its outer face. Suggests retro mechanical armor.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Greave_Steelcommand.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plates and inner shell; colour 1 on the lower inset panels; colour 0 on the thin edge highlights.

Female/F_Footr_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small angular plate strapped to the right lower leg below the knee, shaped like a robotic face with two hexagonal eye sockets, a grinning ribbed mouth and pointed ear-like corners; the back is a plain flat panel.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer plate frame and ear corners; colour 0 on the face panel and the back panel; colour 3 on the eye lenses; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth.

Female/F_Footr_Child_Renegade_01.description: A set of three separate conical spikes of different sizes studding the right ankle and heel area: a tall central horn flanked by a smaller spike on each side. Aggressive, monstrous accent for boots or bare feet.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall central spike; colour 1 on the spike at the inner side; colour 2 on the spike at the outer side.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Renegade_01.differs: The female spikes are slimmer and sit more widely spread around the ankle, with the outer spike angled further out and back.

Female/F_Footr_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A tiny flat, faceted oval patch at the front of the right ankle, a cap that barely covers the leg and is mostly hidden. It adds almost no visible shape, only a small plain panel.

Female/F_Footr_Child_Wheelie_01.description: A small wheel attached to the outside of the right ankle: a chunky rounded tyre ring around a rim with a raised star-shaped hub and thin spokes. A playful, toy-like mechanical accent.
Female/F_Footr_Child_Wheelie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tyre ring and rim; colour 2 on the star hub; colour 1 on the spokes behind the star.

Female/F_Footr_Clown_01.description: A jester-style right shoe with a soft, low body that tapers into a long upturned curling toe ending in a round pom-pom. A flared cuff at the ankle carries a small diamond emblem.
Female/F_Footr_Clown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and toe pom-pom; colour 3 on the diamond emblem.

Female/F_Footr_Corrupted_01.description: A right-foot armoured boot in a monstrous, clawed style: a flared ankle cuff with a small horn-like spike, a smooth central instep, and overlapping segmented plates that fan out into pointed talon-like toes and a scalloped heel.
Female/F_Footr_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ankle cuff, toe plates and heel plates; colour 0 on the smooth instep section; colour 2 on the cuff rim and plate edging; colour 3 on the small spike at the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Cosmic_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a wide banded cuff at the top, a small angular fin-like flap on the outer side, straps across the shin and ankle, and a rounded toe cap over a slim foot.
Female/F_Footr_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shin panel and toe cap; colour 1 on the sides and back of the shaft and the foot; colour 2 on the top cuff, straps and ankle band; colour 3 on the thin accent line above the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Cosmic_01.differs: The female boot has mostly contrasting-scheme colour 1 on the shaft's sides and back, with colour 0 restricted to a front shin strip, whereas the male has more colour 0 on the shaft.

Female/F_Footr_Cosmos_02.description: A short, chunky ankle boot with a faceted, angular build: a rounded-octagonal cuff, a separate plated panel over the instep, a wedge-shaped pointed toe and a thin contrasting sole edge. Sci-fi, slightly armoured look.
Female/F_Footr_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff and toe cap; colour 0 on the instep panel; colour 2 on the heel and side shell; colour 3 on the sole edge.

Female/F_Footr_Cryo_01.description: A chunky, ankle-high sneaker-style boot with a soft, wrinkled upper, a thin sole strip, a rounded reinforced toe cap, and a small accent panel at the heel. Casual, sporty, slightly cartoonish look.
Female/F_Footr_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrinkled upper; colour 2 on the toe cap; colour 1 on the sole strip and heel panel; colour 3 on the small heel stripe.

Female/F_Footr_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A right-foot high-heeled, mid-calf boot with segmented armored plates over the toe, ankle and shin, a flared angular cuff at the top, and a slim stiletto heel. Western-cyber styling with worn leather panels.
Female/F_Footr_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, ankle bands and armor plates; colour 3 on the leather calf and shin panels and the studs; colour 2 on the heel, sole and cuff edges.

Female/F_Footr_Defender_Update_01.description: A right boot in a superhero armoured style: a tall shaft with a angular flared cuff at the top, layered plates down the shin and calf, and a chunky segmented toe and sole.
Female/F_Footr_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side plates, heel and sole; colour 1 on the main shaft and toe cap; colour 2 on the top cuff and toe tip; colour 3 on the rear calf inset panel.
Female/F_Footr_Defender_Update_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, slimmer shaft with a more pointed front cuff and a narrower foot.

Female/F_Footr_Detective_01.description: A casual ankle boot with a rounded toe cap, a thick sole and a folded-down cuff at the ankle. contrasting laces cross over the front, and a contrasting inner shaft shows at the top.
Female/F_Footr_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and folded cuff; colour 1 on the sole; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the inner shaft at the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Detective_02.description: A short lace-up ankle shoe with a rounded toe cap, a tall padded cuff that rises just above the ankle, a thin flat sole and a laced front tongue. Casual, detective-style footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Detective_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and upper body of the shoe; colour 1 on the toe cap, heel patch and tongue; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Draco_01.description: A low, chunky armoured shoe with a pointed, spiked toe cap, small spikes along the sides, and a tall pointed fin rising at the front of the ankle with a gem inset. Suggests a mechanical dragon look.
Female/F_Footr_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body and the back heel; colour 1 on the toe cap panels and ankle collar; colour 2 on the toe rim, spikes and edge trim; colour 3 on the ankle gem.

Female/F_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.description: A right foot shaped like a clawed beast paw: a chunky rounded foot with bulging toes tipped in long curved claws, and a short ankle cuff with a contrasting band. Suggests a dragon or monster look.
Female/F_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body and ankle rim; colour 1 on the ankle band; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.description: A clawed dragon-foot covering for the right foot: a bulbous, scaly-looking paw with three large curved talons at the front and a small rear spur, ending in a short cuff at the ankle with a contrasting band.
Female/F_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw and ankle cuff; colour 0 on the claws; colour 1 on the band at the top of the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The female version has a contrasting ankle band, while the male version has a wider contrasting strap and a slightly longer, flatter paw.

Female/F_Footr_Dryad_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast or root-like paw: an ankle-high, bark-textured cuff flowing into a toed foot with five pointed claws, ridged with vein-like grooves. Suggests a dryad or monster look.
Female/F_Footr_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot and ankle body; colour 3 on the vein-like grooves; colour 2 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Dryad_03.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: layered, bark-like ridges sweep up around the ankle into pointed spikes, with separate toes ending in sharp claws. It sits over the foot and ankle, with an organic, fantasy look.
Female/F_Footr_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ridged foot body; colour 1 on the mottled patch running along the outer ankle and instep; colour 2 on the claw tips.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Arvad_01.description: A decorative calf ornament of swooping, curled metal scrollwork: two tall curved horns frame the front of the lower leg, with spiral curls and a small S-shaped swirl, forming an open, ornate cage-like guard.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer swooping frame and horns; colour 1 on the upper curled scrolls; colour 2 on the central spiral swirl.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Raptor_Claw_01.description: A set of curved, pointed talons attached to the right foot: two long claws project forward from the toes, a larger hooked spur rises at the heel, and a small claw sits on the outer side.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Raptor_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the claws and the heel spur; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Reactor_04.description: A minimal sandal-like right foot piece: a thin flat sole with a low rim, one angular strap across the top of the foot, and a single tall cone-shaped spike jutting from the heel. Sci-fi with a monstrous edge.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sole and the instep strap; colour 3 on the heel spike; colour 2 on the thin outline edge of the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tactical_01.description: A pair of small hexagonal cylindrical canister devices dangling near the lower calf and ankle on thin looping cables, with banded chevron panels and ringed end caps; a mechanical, sci-fi gadget accent.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 1 on the cables and end rings; colour 2 on the end caps.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tactical_01.differs: The two canisters hang apart at slightly different heights, side by side near the ankle, and are not stacked together as on the male.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A column of three curved, pointed fin-like spikes stacked down the outer side of the lower leg, sweeping backward and upward. It suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Iceskates_01.description: A single flat ice-skate blade for the right foot: a long thin runner under the sole with three upright mounting posts and a small toothed pick at the toe. It has no boot, so it sits directly beneath the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Iceskates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade and posts; the default metal material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes on the right lower leg, each a sweeping horn with a barbed fin and inset panel, jutting from the calf and curving downward past the ankle. Monstrous, sharp styling.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade bodies; colour 3 on the inset panels within each blade.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.differs: The female blades are longer and thinner, curving in a tall sweep down the leg, with a smaller panel area.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes mounted on the outer and inner sides of the right lower leg near the ankle. Each has a swept-back horn and small barbs around an inset panel, giving a monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade bodies and barbs; colour 3 on the inset panels between the blades.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Bla.differs: The female blades are taller and narrower, and they sweep up the shin in long slender points.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.description: Punk stud decoration for the right foot: a dense cluster of pyramid studs across the top of the toes and a thin curved row of small studs around the back of the ankle. No boot body is shown.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the studs; the studs are the only visible feature and the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.differs: The female version's ankle row of studs is sparser and more curved, and the toe cluster is rounder than the male one.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Rollerblade_0.description: A right-foot set of inline skate wheels only: four chamfered wheels in a row under the sole, with hub caps on the outer faces. There is no boot or frame, so it reads as a minimal skate accessory.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Tight_Rollerblade_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wheel rims; colour 1 on the wheel hubs; colour 2 on the small inner rings.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Valerian_02.description: A small cross-shaped armour plate strapped to the outside of the right lower leg below the knee, with a raised bevelled rim around a recessed cross-shaped centre. Gothic, knightly styling.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Valerian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim; colour 2 on the recessed cross centre.

Female/F_Footr_Extra_Victory_01.description: A small decorative ankle accessory for the right foot: two thin, curved blade-like fins that sweep up and back from the heel, one larger with a contrasting inner panel and edging, one smaller below it.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large upper fin; colour 1 on the smaller lower fin and the inner panel; colour 2 on the edging.
Female/F_Footr_Extra_Victory_01.differs: The female fins sit more upright and vertical along the back of the ankle, with less sideways curl than the male version.

Female/F_Footr_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A robotic right lower-leg and foot piece made of angular, blocky plates: a tall shin guard with a toothed vent opening at the front, flared fin-like side plates, a rear calf block, and a pointed toe wedge.
Female/F_Footr_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin and foot shell; colour 3 on the front vent hood, side fins, rear calf plate and toe tip; colour 2 on the toe base and inner foot panel.

Female/F_Footr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A short ankle boot with a smooth, rounded toe, a thin flat sole with a small heel step, and a plain upper that ends just above the ankle. A simple, casual style with little detail.
Female/F_Footr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot upper and sole; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Footr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.differs: The female version is a structured ankle boot with a distinct thin sole and small heel, while the male version is a soft, sole-less slipper-like foot covering.

Female/F_Footr_Gamer_01.description: A chunky ankle-high sneaker boot with a padded flared cuff, a wide hook-and-loop strap across the ankle, small lace eyelets, angular gem-like side studs and a thick layered sole. Sporty, futuristic gamer look.
Female/F_Footr_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the cuff, ankle strap, heel and toe trim; colour 2 on the sole and laces; colour 3 on the gem-like side studs.

Female/F_Footr_Gladiator_01.description: A right ankle boot with a soft, slightly slouched cuff, a rounded bulbous toe cap, a pointed angular plate over the instep, and a faceted heel guard at the back. Chunky, cartoonish superhero footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle shaft; colour 1 on the toe cap, sole and heel rim; colour 2 on the instep plate; colour 3 on the heel panel.

Female/F_Footr_Gladiator_02.description: A right ankle boot with a chunky rounded toe, thick flat sole and a short straight-cut shaft. Separate panels wrap the ankle, with an angled front insert and a layered heel plate at the back. Sporty sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footr_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe and foot body; colour 1 on the ankle shaft and side panels; colour 3 on the front ankle insert and heel plate; colour 2 on the sole and heel trim.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Alien_01.description: A right-leg greave worn on the lower shin and calf: a smooth angular shell open at the front, with a separate segmented lower plate stepping down the front and small spikes projecting from the rear edges. Alien sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer shell; colour 1 on the segmented front plates; colour 3 on the small spikes and diamond marks.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Alien_02.description: A shin greave shaped like an open, pointed shell that wraps the lower leg, with a smooth outer plate, a stack of overlapping ridged segments down the front, and small angular spikes jutting from each side.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer plate and rim; colour 1 on the ridged front segments; colour 3 on the side spikes.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Anniversary_Destro.description: A right shin greave: a metal shell with a raised centre spine and open top flange wraps the lower leg, with banded ribbed calf panels behind and a small round stud at the front. Retro mechanical look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Anniversary_Destro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal rims and rib bands; colour 1 on the ribbed calf inserts; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 3 on the small stud at the top front.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Anniversary_Mechan.description: A small faceted knee guard: a chunky angular shell with rounded dimple-like recesses on the front, resting over the right knee. It has a smooth hollow back and a retro, crude mechanical look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Anniversary_Mechan.colourAreas: The whole guard appears to take a single metallic finish that largely ignores the colour scheme; no separate coloured features are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Aquatic_01.description: A right shin greave of segmented, overlapping curved plates with contrasting trim bands, a flared rim at the top and a pointed tip at the front of the ankle, with a central spiky ornament down the shin.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main overlapping plates; colour 0 on the lower ankle plate; colour 3 on the inner shin panel; colour 2 on the rims, trim lines and spiky front ornament.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Aquatic_01.differs: The spiky front ornament sits mostly on the front of the shin and the contrasting panel is narrower, while the male version has it wrapped toward the outer side.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Armored_01.description: An angular armoured greave for the right shin: a tapering plate shell with a recessed front panel bearing a vertical slot, a flared open rim at the top, cross bands across the calf, and a chunky cuff at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave plates and bands; colour 2 on the recessed front panel; colour 3 on the slot and thin ankle line; colour 1 on the ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Armored_01.differs: The female greave is taller and slimmer, extending further up the calf with a narrower taper toward the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Arvad_01.description: A small ornamental greave for the right lower leg: open, curling scrollwork framing the calf, with swirling hooked flourishes and a central spiral. Its sweeping, pointed curves suit fantasy or mechanical designs.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer scrolled frame; colour 1 on the hooked flourishes at the sides; colour 2 on the central spiral.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_01.description: A right shin greave with a separate low foot piece: a tapered armoured calf guard with a flared top rim, a pointed front plate with a V-shaped inset and a gem-like accent, and a low open shoe cap. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, edging and vertical front trim; colour 1 on the upper front plate and the foot cap; colour 2 on the main calf panels and foot heel; colour 3 on the triangular inset accents.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_02.description: A knee-high superhero greave-boot with a smooth rounded shin guard, a flared top cuff, a recessed front insert with angular panels, a banded ankle strap and a low heeled foot piece with a toe band.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell of the boot and shin; colour 3 on the upper knee insert and small ankle accent; colour 2 on the lower shin panel and toe band; colour 0 on the thin trim bands at the knee and instep.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_03.description: A short armored shoe cover that wraps the foot and ankle: a pointed, angular front plate over the instep, a separate tall heel-cup panel at the back, and a thick rounded rim edging both sections.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edging; colour 1 on the front instep plate; colour 2 on the heel-cup panel; colour 3 on the small triangular accents at the toe.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_04.description: A low, short shoe with a rounded toe cap, a V-shaped opening over the instep with a small triangular tab, contrasting bands across the toe, and a tall flared heel guard rising behind the ankle. Superhero footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shoe body and heel guard; colour 0 on the lighter band across the toe; colour 2 on the darker band and edging at the toe; colour 3 on the triangular tab at the instep.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_01.description: A chunky angular mechanical greave for the right lower leg: a tall faceted shin plate with flared winged edges at the top, a contrasting inner cuff, a rear panel strip, and round hex-nut pods at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plate and flared edges; colour 1 on the top cuff and the rear strip; colour 2 on the hex nuts and pod housings; colour 3 on the small square light and the pod centres.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_01.differs: The female greave is taller, reaching higher up the calf, with a longer narrow shin plate.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_02.description: A mechanical shin greave for the right lower leg: a smooth curved shell with a raised flared front edge, an inset glowing-style oval sensor, a separate rear calf panel, and rounded side pods. Ends in a trimmed ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the inset front and rear calf panels; colour 2 on the side pods and the sensor housing; colour 3 on the oval sensor.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_02.differs: The side pod on the outer side is smaller and sits higher; the male version has a larger pod on the front-facing side.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Boot_Spurs_01.description: A single boot spur: a curved U-shaped heel band wraps the ankle and ends in a short shank carrying a toothed rowel wheel at the back, with a small round stud on the opposite side. Western, mechanical style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Boot_Spurs_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved band and shank; colour 0 on the spiked rowel wheel; colour 2 on the rowel hub and one side disc; colour 3 on the round stud face.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Bounty_01.description: A small right-shin accessory: a flap-topped utility pouch with a round gem-like stud, beside a scattered cluster of short cylindrical canisters with banded middles, sitting on the lower leg above the ankle. Sci-fi western bounty-hunter style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body; colour 2 on the pouch edging and canister caps and ends; colour 1 on the canister bands; colour 3 on the stud on the pouch flap.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Bounty_01.differs: The canisters are grouped in two tight clusters at the front and back of the leg, with the pouch on the outer side, rather than spread evenly around the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Bounty_02.description: A rigid shin greave worn on the right lower leg: a tapered armored shell with angular front plating, a recessed vertical strip down the front, a notched top edge and a wide cloth-like band around the middle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell; colour 1 on the band around the middle; colour 2 on the recessed strip down the front and the notch at the top.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Bounty_02.differs: The female greave has a separate band wrapped around the middle and a contrasting front strip, while the male version is a glowing glassy shell with no band.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Brutal_01.description: A right shin greave wrapped in horizontal bands, with a jagged, crown-like top edge, a pointed front plate and a ragged spiky fringe at the bottom over a soft cuff at the ankle. Brutal, tribal styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the wrapping bands, top rim and ankle cuff; colour 3 on the front strips and knot between the bands; colour 1 on the spiky fringe and inner lining.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Brutal_02.description: A flat sandal with a thick rope-textured sole, a toe-post thong, a wide ruched wrap panel across the instep and a thin heel strap behind the ankle. Casual, low-profile footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruched instep panel and heel strap; colour 1 on the insole; colour 2 on the rope-textured sole edge and toe thong.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Brutal_03.description: A single right-foot sandal with a thick rope-textured edge around the sole, a padded, gathered wrap strap across the instep, a thin toe-post thong and a slim heel strap. Sits low on the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered instep wrap and heel strap; colour 1 on the sole insole; colour 2 on the rope-textured sole edge and toe thong.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Brutal_04.description: A small diamond-shaped greave plate worn on the outer right lower leg just below the knee, with a raised rim around a recessed face and a scalloped heart-like inner panel. Reads as monstrous or mechanical armor.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Brutal_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim; colour 1 on the large inner panel; colour 2 on the upper recessed section behind the scalloped edge.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Buckled_01.description: A pair of thick, octagonal buckled bands worn around the right lower leg, one below the calf and one at the ankle, each fastened at the front with a square frame buckle and a small tongue.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Buckled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bands; colour 2 on the buckle frames; colour 3 on the small buckle tongues.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Buckled_02.description: A wide, faceted strap band worn around the right ankle, closed at the front by a square buckle with a small prong and a stitched loop keeper. It has a plain, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Buckled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band; colour 2 on the buckle frame; colour 3 on the small rivet or eyelet beside the buckle.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Bunny_01.description: A plush bunny slipper with a rounded, fluffy toe box, a face of small eyes and a nose, two upright lined ears at the front, an open heel, an inner sole and a small round tail puff at the back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Bunny_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plush slipper body and outer ears; colour 1 on the nose, inner ears and inner sole; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the tail puff.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Bunny_01.differs: The female slippers have shorter, stubbier ears that sit closer together and lean slightly inward.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Buckled_02.description: A wide, faceted anklet cuff that wraps around the right ankle, closed at the front with a square buckle frame and a strap loop. Plain, chunky and utilitarian, it suits casual or restraint-style looks.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Buckled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the buckle frame; colour 3 on the small stud or rivet inside the buckle.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Kaiju_02.description: A small knee-mounted guard: a curved, scooped plate cupping the front of the knee, with a rounded raised cap at the back and a cluster of long curved claw-like spikes fanning upward.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved outer plate; colour 3 on the rounded cap behind the spikes; colour 2 on the spikes.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Kaiju_02.differs: The female version has fewer, more widely spread spikes that stand a bit taller.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Mecha_01.description: A small angular plate worn on the lower leg below the knee: a slightly curved rectangular shell with a raised bevelled rim along the top and sides, four slim slots on the front, and an open back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and edge; colour 1 on the main plate body; colour 3 on the small slots.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Mecha_02.description: A small angular kneepad: a flat-faced box-like plate with a bevelled rim and short side wings that wrap partway round the leg, with four slot-shaped vents on the face. Sits on the right leg just above the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate face and raised bevelled rim; colour 3 on the small slot vents.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_01.description: A set of three small pointed spikes jutting outward in a vertical line along the outer side of the right lower leg, like bony or horn-like protrusions. Suggests a mutated, monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_01.differs: The female spikes are chunkier, faceted pyramids and stick out at slightly different angles; the male ones are thinner, curved claw-like cones.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_02.description: A column of three small pointed spikes running down the outer side of the lower leg, each a short cone angled backward. A monstrous, spiky accent with no other coverage.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; the metallic finish does not visibly use the other colour slots.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spi.description: A scatter of separate conical spikes studded along the outer side of the right lower leg and knee, with larger spikes near the knee and smaller ones down the calf. Aggressive, monstrous renegade styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long spikes near the knee; colour 1 on the spikes clustered around the knee; colour 2 on the small spikes down the calf.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spi.description: A small mechanical leg accessory: a cylindrical canister with a labelled panel on the side of the knee, trailing a thick curved hose that arcs up and around the leg to end in a hexagonal nut-like cap.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body; colour 1 on the label panel; colour 2 on the canister end caps and hex cap; colour 3 on the hose.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A pair of chunky canisters with ridged screw-top caps, mounted side by side on a curved, notched bracket plate worn at the side of the right lower leg. Mechanical retro-rocket styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bracket plate; colour 0 on the canister caps and bodies; colour 2 on the canister housings and lower ends; colour 3 on the canister bases.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A small boxy mechanical vent unit worn on the outer lower leg: a contrasting metal frame with four horizontal louvre slats, a ring detail on the side, and a tall flat panel plate rising on the back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top plate and louvre slats; colour 1 on the large back panel; colour 2 on the outer frame and ring; colour 3 on the interior behind the slats.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.differs: The female vent sits lower on the shin, nearer the ankle, and hangs from the leg with its back panel flush against it.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A boxy mechanical vent module strapped to the right lower leg: a contrasting frame holding stacked horizontal louvre slats, with a circular port on the side and a flat panel plate wrapping the back of the calf.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the louvre slats and top plate; colour 2 on the outer frame; colour 1 on the back panel and top flap; colour 3 on the recessed interior behind the slats.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A pair of curved, ribbed cable hoses with thick cylindrical canister ends, wrapping around the lower leg just below the knee from front to back. Mechanical, retro-industrial accent.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ribbed hoses and canisters; colour 0 on the small collar rings where the hoses join the canisters.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.differs: The female hoses sit slightly further apart with shorter, more bent arcs, while the male pair wrap in a more continuous band around the leg.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A pair of flexible ribbed hoses wrapping around the lower leg just below the knee, each ending in a short chunky cylindrical nozzle at the back and a small hexagonal collar at the front. A mechanical, retro-industrial accent.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ribbed hoses; colour 0 on the cylindrical nozzles and the small front collars.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.differs: The hoses sit as two short separate curved pieces with the nozzles angled toward the back of the calf, giving a more open, staggered look than on the male.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A pair of flexible ribbed hoses wrapped around the lower leg just below the knee, each ending in a short chunky barrel-like nozzle at the back. Mechanical, exhaust-pipe styling worn as a small accessory.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hose collar rings; colour 2 on the ribbed hose tubing; colour 1 on the metal nozzle ends.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.differs: The female hoses curve in a tighter loop around the leg, and the two hoses sit closer together than on the male.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.description: A short crumpled wrap band around the right lower leg just below the knee, with creased, wrinkled folds and a slightly flared, uneven upper rim. Suggests a worn, patched retro-mechanical look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wrap, with the glossy surface showing the scheme mostly as light and shadow; no other slots clearly visible.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_01.description: A curved, horn-like scarab pincer worn on the outer side of the right lower leg near the calf. It arcs around the leg as a smooth tapering spike with a segmented tip, giving a monstrous, insectoid look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rear curved arm; colour 1 on the front upper section; colour 2 on the band between segments; colour 3 on the pointed tip.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_01.differs: The female version is slimmer and sits closer against the calf, so the arc wraps less widely around the leg.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_02.description: A single leg accessory of curved, tapering horn-like blades that wrap around the right calf. A pointed upper horn and a swooping crossing horn sit over a segmented lower section that curls down toward the ankle. Insectoid, monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper horns; colour 2 on the middle segment; colour 0 on the lower curling tail-like section.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_02.differs: The female version has its curved horns spread more loosely around the calf and sits slightly lower on the leg.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Swan_01.description: A feathery, flame-like cuff worn around the right knee: a ring of tall jagged spikes at the top, layered swept feather tufts below, and a longer pointed tail trailing down the back of the leg.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer feather tufts and lower layers; colour 1 on the inner lining and spike tips; colour 2 on the underside panel at the front.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Swan_01.differs: The female version has a pointed tail that trails further down the back of the leg and a taller front spike crown.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Victory_02.description: A single faceted kneepad-style guard: an angular, kite-shaped shell that wraps the front and sides of the right knee, tapering to a point below, with a contrasting inner shell edge and a smooth back panel.
