Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Victory_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front and outer shell; colour 0 on the inner edge facets and the back panel.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Child_Victory_02.differs: The female guard is taller and narrower, with a longer point extending down the shin, and sits more upright on the knee.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Corrupted_01.description: A right-leg greave wrapping the shin and calf: layered, scalloped bat-wing-like plates over the upper part, a smooth tapered guard below ending in a notched hem at the ankle, and small spikes at the top edge.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower shin guard; colour 1 on the layered scalloped upper plates; colour 2 on the rim and outline edging; colour 3 on the spikes at the top.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Corrupted_01.differs: The female greave has a taller, more pointed front spike at the top and a longer, narrower fit down the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cosmic_01.description: A short octagonal greave cuff worn on the right lower leg just above the ankle: a slightly tapered plain tube with thin raised rims at top and bottom and a small inner patch showing at the front top.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the small inner patch at the front top; colour 0 on the thin rims.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_01.description: A right shin greave of faceted angular plates that taper toward the ankle, with a raised diamond-shaped front panel holding a round gem-like inset and pointed spikes flaring at the top rim. Sits over the lower leg.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main greave plates; colour 1 on the diamond front panel; colour 3 on the gem inset and the inner ankle accents; colour 0 on the inner top lining.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_02.description: An angular, faceted metal greave for the right lower leg, ending in a pointed heel. A tall blade-like spike rises at the outer edge and a large crystal shard juts from the front of the shin.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main greave plates; colour 3 on the crystal shard; colour 2 on the inner recess and edge details; colour 0 on the spike.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_02.differs: The female greave is slimmer and taller, with a narrower crystal and a longer spike, and a less open top cup.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cryo_01.description: A right-leg mechanical greave: a tapered shell with a flared rim around the lower calf, held by contrasting bands at the top and ankle and a strip down the front and back. A slim vented fin rises at the side, and looping ribbed cables hang from side connectors.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the straps, bands and centre strips; colour 1 on the fin and the cable connectors; colour 3 on the cables and the ankle stud and fin vents.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Cryo_01.differs: The female greave is longer and more tapered, and its cable loops hang lower and wider around the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Deity_01.description: A right-leg greave covering the shin from ankle to just below the knee, with smooth curved plates, a raised front peak with a faceted crystal-like gem at the top, and a contrasting angular band at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave plates and top edge trim; colour 1 on the ankle band; colour 3 on the gem; colour 2 on the shadowed inner facets of the gem.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Deity_01.differs: The female greave is taller and more tapered along the shin, with a narrower, pointed front peak.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Deity_02.description: A right-leg greave shell wrapping the lower shin and calf, with a pointed front edge that flares open at the top and a V-shaped contrasting band at the ankle. Smooth plated look suggests fantasy or sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and its top rim; colour 1 on the ankle band.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Deity_02.differs: The female greave is taller and narrower, reaching higher up the calf with a more tapered shape.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Deity_03.description: A small faceted kneepad shaped like a rough angular crystal shard, strapped onto the right knee. Its upper half is a broad shield-like cap and its lower half tapers to a point below the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Deity_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper cap of the kneepad; colour 2 on the lower pointed section.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dharmor_01.description: A small curved kneepad plate that wraps partway around the right knee, with a raised rim and a recessed inset panel; simple, angular-edged armor suggesting sci-fi or superhero styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and plate edge; colour 1 on the recessed inset panel.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Draco_01.description: A right-leg greave, a shin guard of armor plates with a pointed lower edge. A spiky knee-cap crest sits at the top, and a long curved horn-like spine sweeps up the outer side. Dragon-themed and armored.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plate and the back cuff; colour 1 on the lower and side panels; colour 3 on the knee crest and the curved spines; colour 2 on the crest edges and the bottom trim.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox.description: A flame-like, sculpted fin or plume attached to the outer calf, swept in wavy ridges with jagged tips at the top and tapering to a long point toward the ankle. Suggests a dragon or beast leg accent.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the plume and its lower tapering tip; colour 1 on the jagged upper tips, blending in as a gradient.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox.description: A sculpted flame-like fin attached to the outer side of the right lower leg, made of layered swept ridges that taper to a point near the ankle and rise into spiky tips at the calf.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the flame and lower tapering tip; colour 1 on the upper spiky tips at the back of the calf, blending from colour 0.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox.differs: The female fin is longer and narrower, running further down the leg toward the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dryad_01.description: A single draped shin wrap of layered, flowing organic cloth-like folds that wraps the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with ragged tapering edges and a mossy patch near the top.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main draped folds; colour 1 on the mossy patches at the top and front; colour 3 on the thin vein-like lines along the folds.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dryad_03.description: A small organic, root-like ornament of twisted, lumpy tendrils with pointed curling tips, attached at the outer side of the right lower leg near the ankle. Suggests a wild dryad or forest-creature style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the tendril surface; colour 0 on the mottled patches and the inner underside of the curling tips.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A right-leg greave made of smooth, organic folded panels that wrap around the shin and hang in draped, pointed lobes toward the ankle, with fine grooved veins running down its length. It has a natural, beast-like look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main folded panels; colour 1 on the mossy patch at the top and back; colour 3 on the thin vein lines.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_01.description: A shin-and-calf wrap of layered, curling flame-shaped tongues that swirl around the lower right leg, with pointed tips flaring outward and a glossy sculpted finish. A fantasy elemental fire accessory.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; colour 2 on most of the flame body, with hints of colour 1 in the folds between the tongues.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_01.differs: The flames sit a little further back and wrap more around the calf, with a smaller open flame blade at the front of the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_02.description: A flame-shaped greave for the right lower leg: glossy, swirling tongues of fire that wrap around the calf and shin, with long licks rising toward the knee and jagged points at the bottom.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: The glossy default material mostly ignores the colour scheme; faint colour 1 sheen shows in the folds, and the rest reads as near-reflective surface.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Element_Water_01.description: A pair of slender, curved glossy fin-like blades rising along the outer side of the right lower leg, each tapering to a small curled tip at the top. Suggests an elemental water-themed accessory.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; the fins show a reflective sheen, with no clear separate slot areas visible.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Element_Water_02.description: A glossy, water-like sweep of curling tendrils that spirals up the outside of the right leg from the ankle toward the thigh, with branching wisps and a few separate twisted strands near the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Element_Water_02.colourAreas: The default glossy material largely ignores the scheme; it shows reflective metallic tones, with a few twisted strands near the ankle appearing as a contrasting darker part.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_01.description: A low armored foot guard covering the top and back of the foot: a pointed front plate with a triangular accent, a separate heel cup behind it, and a raised rim of contrasting trim around every edge.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top foot plate; colour 0 on the raised edge trim; colour 2 on the heel cup; colour 3 on the small triangular accent near the toe.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_02.description: A low, rounded-toe shoe with a chevron-shaped pair of bands across the toe, a small triangular gem-like accent at the ankle opening, and a separate tall curved heel cup rising behind the ankle. Superhero style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe body and heel cup; colour 0 on one band across the toe; colour 2 on the other toe band; colour 3 on the triangular ankle accent.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Brutal_04.description: A small diamond-shaped armor plate worn on the outer side of the right lower leg below the knee, with a raised rim, a recessed inner panel and a notched, bat-wing-like upper edge. Suggests a superhero greave accent.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Brutal_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim; colour 1 on the main recessed panel; colour 2 on the notched upper section.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ice_02.description: A small cluster of jagged, faceted ice-crystal shards attached at the outer side of the right lower leg just below the knee, with several pointed spikes fanning out and upward.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ice_02.colourAreas: The glossy crystal ignores most of the scheme; a faint colour 1 tint shows in the facets, and the rest reads as very crystal.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ice_02.differs: The female shards form a shorter, more compact cluster with several separate points fanning out.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Valerian_02.description: A small cross-shaped armour plate worn on the outer side of the right lower leg, with a raised bevelled rim around a recessed cross panel. It suggests gothic, knightly greave styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Extra_Valerian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim and edges; colour 2 on the recessed cross-shaped inner panel.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Feathers_01.description: A right shin greave with a tapered, ribbed plate held by three wrap-around straps with small buckle tabs, topped by a spiky fringe of feather-like blades at the upper edge. Sits on the lower leg below the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed shin plate; colour 2 on the three straps; colour 3 on the feather blades at the top; colour 0 not visible.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Firebird_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting shin greave covering the lower leg from knee to ankle, with a pointed angular knee cap holding contrasting vent openings, and contrasting edge trim plus chevron lines across the calf back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave body; colour 1 on the knee cap; colour 3 on the edge trim and chevron lines; colour 2 on the vent openings.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Firebird_01.differs: The female version has a smaller, narrower knee cap that sits on the front of the leg, while the male knee cap is larger and wraps further around the knee.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Flipper_01.description: A swim-fin style foot accessory for the right foot: a low open heel cup with a strap over the instep, extending forward into a long, flat, ribbed blade that flares wider toward the tip.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Flipper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel cup rim; colour 2 on the instep strap; colour 1 on the fin blade and sole.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Fluff_01.description: A thick, shaggy fur cuff that wraps around the right ankle as a short, chunky band with spiky, tufted strands. It sits just above the foot and suggests a wintry, primal or fantasy look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Fluff_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the tufted fur tips and streaks. Colours 2 and 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Fluff_02.description: A thick, shaggy fur cuff that wraps around the right ankle as a short band, with spiky, tufted strands pointing outward. It suggests a beastly, primal look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Fluff_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the tips and streaks of the fur strands.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_01.description: A single large oval faceted gemstone worn on the outside of the right knee, with a domed cut front and a flat back. It reads as a decorative jewel-like knee ornament.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The gem is glossy and appears to ignore the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_02.description: A single diamond-shaped faceted gemstone worn on the side of the lower leg just below the knee, a flat rhombus slab with a shallow pointed ridge and glassy facets.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The glassy gem material mostly ignores the colour scheme, so no slot is clearly visible; the whole gem shows its own dark, reflective look.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_03.description: A single square-cut gemstone worn as a small flat accessory on the outer right shin below the knee. It has a faceted, bevelled edge and a smooth glossy face, and it sits slightly proud of the leg.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: Glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; the bevelled back facets show a faint tint from colour 1, while the front face stays glossy and near-uniform.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_03.differs: The female gem is a tilted square with a visibly bevelled, faceted back, and its front face is smooth and reflective.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_04.description: A small pentagonal gemstone slab worn on the outside of the right knee area, a faceted crystal with a flat pentagon face and shallow depth, sitting like a decorative knee gem.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main gem body; the glassy default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_05.description: A small faceted gemstone cut in a heart shape, worn on the outside of the right knee like a decorative charm. It has a glossy front face and a textured, crystalline back, and sits on the leg at an angle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 2 appears on the front face and a faint tint of colour 1 on the textured back and inner facets.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_06.description: A single teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone worn on the outer side of the right lower leg near the knee, with a pointed top, a flat glossy face and a faceted rear side.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The gem is glossy and appears to ignore the colour scheme; no separate colour slot areas are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_01.description: A right-shin greave of layered armor plates: a tall pointed front guard framed by contrasting angular edging, an inner contrasting plate at the calf, and a tapering lower shell with contrasting trim lines, worn from below the knee to the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell plates; colour 0 on the inner calf plate; colour 2 on the angular edge framing; colour 3 on the trim lines and piping.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_02.description: A right shin greave wrapping the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with a mesh-textured outer shell, a raised rim and a pointed upper flare at the knee holding an inset panel with a small raised block.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh-textured shell; colour 2 on the rim, spine and upper flare; colour 1 on the inset panel; colour 3 on the small block.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_02.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower with a more pointed lower tip and a taller upper flare.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Heraldry_01.description: A right-leg greave guard covering the front of the shin and a band around the upper calf, with a scooped opening at the side and back. It ends in a pointed flared toe cap at the ankle; the styling is fantasy armor.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin plate and the upper calf band; colour 2 on the inner lining and the flared ankle cuff edge; colour 0 is not visible.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Heraldry_01.differs: The female greave is taller and more tapered, with a narrower shin plate and a sharper pointed ankle flare.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ice_01.description: A cluster of jagged crystal shards clumped around the right lower leg below the knee, with a separate smaller shard group sitting off to one side. Faceted, spiky fantasy ice look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ice_01.colourAreas: The glossy crystal material largely ignores the colour scheme; faint tints from colour 1 show on some facets, otherwise it reads as reflective crystal.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ice_01.differs: The female version has a smaller, separate shard cluster set higher and further behind the main group, giving a more scattered arrangement.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ice_02.description: A small cluster of jagged, faceted crystal shards strapped to the outside of the right knee, with several pointed spikes of different sizes splaying upward and outward. Suggests an icy, fantasy or monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ice_02.colourAreas: The crystal glosses ignore most of the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on some shard facets, and the rest reads as a glassy near-black.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ice_02.differs: The female cluster is a more upright bundle of several separate splayed shards, while the male one is a flatter, more fused wedge.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ice_Beast_01.description: A cluster of jagged ice-crystal shards clinging to the outer lower leg, with tall spikes rising toward the calf and a separate smaller crystal clump floating just above near the knee. Monstrous, frozen look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Ice_Beast_01.colourAreas: The material is glossy crystal and largely ignores the scheme; faint colour 1 tints show on some shard facets, with the rest reflecting a glassy finish.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_01.description: A monstrous armored shin guard wrapping the lower right leg, with a curved shell open at the side, a flared rim at the knee, a pointed tip at the ankle, and rows of curved contrasting spikes down the front and sides.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell of the greave; colour 1 on the flared top rim and the lower ankle plate; colour 2 on the curved spikes.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_01.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower, with the spike rows running down the front of the shin and a slimmer shell.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_02.description: A small knee guard worn on the right leg: a curved, crescent-shaped plate cups the front of the knee, with a rounded rear cap and a cluster of long curved claw-like spikes rising from the top. Monstrous, armoured look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved knee plate; colour 3 on the rounded cap between the plate and the spikes; colour 2 on the claw spikes.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Kneepad_01.description: A chunky kneepad: a rounded, faceted front cap studded with four small recessed dots, mounted on a wide segmented band of ribbed layers that wraps around the leg at the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Kneepad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front cap; colour 3 on the recessed dots; colour 1 on the band's outer plates and edges; colour 2 on the ribbed bands between the plates.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Kneepad_Basic_01.description: A single knee pad on the right leg: a rounded, faceted padded cap set in a thick angular rim, with small side clips, held by a segmented ribbed band that wraps around the back of the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Kneepad_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and band edges; colour 1 on the padded cap; colour 3 on the small side clips; colour 2 on the ribbed band segments.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Knife_01.description: A short sword strapped to the lower right leg: a sheathed blade with a wrapped diamond-pattern hilt and small guard, held vertically by two wide buckled straps, one below the knee and one near the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the two leg straps; colour 1 on the sheath; colour 0 on the hilt wrap; colour 2 on the guard, hilt diamonds and sheath tip.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Knife_02.description: A wide octagonal strap buckled around the lower thigh above the knee, with a short sheathed knife attached at the side. The sheath angles down along the leg and the hilt has a wrapped grip and round guard.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Knife_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the strap; colour 1 on the sheath; colour 0 on the wrapped hilt grip; colour 2 on the guard and sheath tip.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Knife_02.differs: The knife hangs lower and angles further down the outside of the leg, away from the strap, while the male version's sheath sits closer to the leg and against the strap.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_01.description: A right-leg greave that runs from below the knee to the ankle, with a flared knee guard carrying curved horns and a round eye-like boss. The tapered shin plate has flame-shaped inlays and a segmented calf plate at the back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee guard and horn housing; colour 2 on the main shin and calf plates; colour 1 on the flame inlays and lower cuff; colour 3 on the central boss.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_02.description: A right shin greave of layered armored panels wrapping the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, topped with a snarling spiky beast-head guard at the knee front. Martial-arts fantasy style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beast head and the curved trim lines on the shin; colour 2 on the main greave panels and back flap; colour 0 on the chevron band under the head; colour 3 on the eyes.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower, with a tapered shin and a smaller beast head sitting higher on the leg.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.description: A right-leg greave shaped like a tapering shin guard, with a raised angular face plate at the front showing two round eyes and a V-shaped chest marking, an open flared cuff at the top and a banded ankle section.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin shell and cuff interior; colour 2 on the face plate frame, edge plating and ankle band; colour 1 on the mouth bar and V-shaped inlay; colour 3 on the eyes and the small inner V.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The female greave is taller and narrower, with a more tapered shin shell and a longer flared toe-side plate at the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_02.description: A right-leg greave with an angular armoured shin plate, a flared upper collar with pointed fins, a circular emblem on the knee and a central spine down the front. Thin loop straps hold it at the ankle and across the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour plates and upper collar; colour 1 on the front spine, ankle band and foot strap panel; colour 2 on the recessed calf panels and thin outline loops; colour 3 on the emblem and collar fins.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_0.description: A small knee plate shaped like a stylised monster face: angular ear-like corners, two hexagonal glowing-looking eye sockets, and a grille-like mouth strip. It sits on the front of the right knee with a smooth inner backing panel.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and ear corners; colour 0 on the face panel and inner backing; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the mouth strip and the ridged panel at the back.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_0.description: A minimal open sandal for the right foot: a thin looped sole outline with a wide V-notched strap band across the instep, edged in contrasting trim. It leaves the toes and heel bare.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the instep strap; colour 0 on the strap's edge trim; colour 2 on the thin sole loop and the strap's inner side.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_67_01.description: A shaggy fur cuff wrapping the right lower leg from just below the knee to the ankle, built from layered jagged tufts with a ragged, pointed lower edge. Suggests a beastly, barbarian look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and middle fur tufts; colour 1 on the lower layer of fur tufts.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_01.description: A shin guard wrapping the lower leg, built from vertical alternating slats that form a split tube open at the front. Two bands circle the top and bottom, with a diagonal strap between them. Martial-arts styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light vertical slats; colour 1 on the alternating vertical slats; colour 2 on the upper and lower bands; colour 3 on the diagonal strap.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_02.description: A pair of thin criss-crossing bands wrapped around the leg just below the knee, fastened at the front by a large diamond-shaped gem in an angular frame. Ornate, martial-style leg accent.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bands' main stripe; colour 0 on the band edging; colour 2 on the gem frame and the back plate; colour 3 on the gem.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_03.description: A small diamond-shaped gem ornament set in an angular frame, worn on the outer side of the right lower leg just below the knee. It has a faceted pyramid gem in front and a pointed back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the diamond frame and the back shell; colour 3 on the faceted gem.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mecha_01.description: A mechanical right-leg greave: an angled plate rises above the shin, over a contrasting central housing with a vertical spine. Two long tapered armored flaps hang down either side of the ankle, giving a sleek, robotic look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate and the spine trim; colour 1 on the two hanging flaps; colour 2 on the central housing; colour 3 on small marks on the plate and the flap undersides.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mecha_01.differs: The female version has longer, narrower flaps that reach lower toward the foot and hang closer to the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mecha_02.description: A single angular mechanical greave shaped like a tall open-topped faceted sleeve around the lower leg, with a narrow front plate rising to a rounded armored pod at the knee and a small slot marking near the bottom.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the greave body and rising plate; colour 1 on the knee pod; colour 3 on the small panel near the base.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mecha_02.differs: The female version is a taller, narrower sleeve that reaches up the shin toward the knee, with the pod perched above it.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mechassn_01.description: A small angular knee guard on the right leg: a front plate with a flared upper edge sits over the kneecap, with a separate stacked panel wrapping the back of the knee and upper calf.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front kneecap plate; colour 1 on the rear wrap panels below and behind the knee.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Destroyer_0.description: A smooth shin greave covering the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with a contrasting rim, a raised ring loop above the knee, a contrasting front insert, a pointed lower edge and a narrow contrasting panel down the front.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Destroyer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and front insert; colour 2 on the top rim and ring loop; colour 1 on the narrow front panel.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A rigid shin greave covering the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with a raised plate at the front top, a chevron-shaped collar band with diamond gems, a recessed segmented panel and a flared ankle rim.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and upper plate; colour 1 on the recessed shin panel; colour 2 on the chevron collar band and ankle rim; colour 3 on the diamond gems.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A small faceted, gem-like plate worn on the outside of the right knee or shin. It has an angular hexagonal outline, a raised faceted front and a flat backing with a thin edge lip.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted front surface; colour 2 on the flat back and edge rim. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A close-fitting sci-fi leg covering for the right lower leg, running from just above the knee to the ankle, with an angled top edge, inset side panels, a small angular knee plate and rivet-like studs, ending in a snug ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg sleeve and cuff; colour 1 on the inset side panels; colour 3 on the knee plate and the small studs; colour 2 on the thin outlines around the inset panels.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The female version is a longer, narrower sleeve with a sharply slanted top edge rising up the thigh.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Witchcraft_.description: A wrap of loose cloth bands around the lower leg: a gathered upper cuff and two crossing straps forming an X, joined by a small diamond-shaped clasp with a dangling bead charm at the front.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Witchcraft_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and crossing bands; colour 2 on the diamond clasp; colour 3 on the hanging bead.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Modern_Witchcraft_.differs: The female bands sit closer to the leg and cross in a tighter X, with the clasp and charm at the front; the male bands hang looser and wider with the clasp lower on the back.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Monster_Fur_01.description: A ragged cuff of jagged, spiky fur tufts wrapped around the right ankle, with pointed shards of varying length flaring up and down. Suggests a beastly, monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Monster_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the fur tufts; colour 0 on the lighter tips and lower edges of the tufts.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mutated_01.description: A monstrous fleshy greave wrapped around the right lower leg, made of lumpy, muscle-like ridges that rise to a pointed crest at the top, with small bone-like spikes down the outer side and a contrasting and a glossy nodule at the back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fleshy body of the greave; colour 0 on the spikes; colour 2 on the nodule at the side; colour 1 on the small bulb at the back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mutated_01.differs: The female version is a slimmer, narrower shell that hugs the calf with a more upright pointed crest, and its rear bulb sits lower on the leg.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mutated_02.description: A mutated, fleshy shin guard of twisted, ropy ridges that wraps the lower right leg, with a raised flared edge at the front, a small bulbous node on the shin and short contrasting spikes along the back edge.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy body of the guard; colour 1 on the small bulbous node on the shin; colour 0 on the spikes.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Mutated_02.differs: The female version is a longer, narrower guard with a taller, slimmer front flare.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Phantom_01.description: A right-leg shin greave: an open-backed angular shell with an octagonal top rim, wrapping the front of the calf and tapering to the ankle, with a raised edge along the back opening. Sleek, sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim; colour 2 on the inner hollow surface.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Phantom_01.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower, running further up the calf with a slim, straight-sided shell and a tall open back.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A pair of stacked octagonal straps worn just below the right knee, each with a square buckle at the front. A thick banded edge gives it a chunky, pirate-style garter look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the broad band of each strap; colour 0 on the thin edge stripes; colour 2 on the buckles and the outer rims.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pirate_Fancy_01.differs: The female straps have a wider contrasting rim on the top and bottom edges and a slightly thicker band, where the male version shows lighter edge stripes.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pony_01.description: A tuft-like ankle cuff of overlapping pointed, feather-like locks that flare upward and outward around the right ankle, with a shorter layered fringe of points at the lower edge. Suggests a fantasy pony-fur fetlock.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pony_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper locks; colour 1 on the lower fringe of points; colour 2 on the small inner shadow tufts at the sides.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pony_02.description: A ragged ankle cuff of fur tufts: long pointed contrasting locks flare upward and outward around the ankle over a shorter jagged lower fringe, with small contrasting accent tufts at the sides. Wild, beastly look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pony_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper tufts; colour 1 on the lower jagged fringe; colour 2 on the small side tufts.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pony_02.differs: The female version has longer, more upswept front tufts that rise into a tall point, while the tufts elsewhere are shorter.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pumpkin_01.description: A right shin and calf guard formed from curved bone-like ribs that wrap around the lower leg, with a padded cuff at the top and jagged chunks jutting upward. Skeletal, monstrous fantasy styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rib bones; colour 1 on the cuff panels at the top; colour 2 on the jagged chunks at the top.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Punk_01.description: A small pointed fin-like shell attached to the outside of the lower leg above the ankle, with a padded soft front face and a glossy contrasting rim and back plate. Punk, creature-like accent.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded front face; colour 2 on the glossy rim and back plate.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Punk_01.differs: The female fin is taller and narrower, with a sharper pointed tip rising up the calf.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Punk_02.description: A small pointed guard fin worn on the right lower leg: a tall, tapering leaf-shaped panel rising from a short band around the ankle, edged with a thin rim, with a smooth back shell. Punk-styled accessory.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Punk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the panel; colour 1 on the ankle band; colour 2 on the rim and the back shell.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Punk_02.differs: The female fin is taller and narrower with a more sharply pointed tip, rising higher up the calf.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A small kneepad guard on the right leg: a chunky, faceted shield-like plate over the kneecap with a lumpy textured face and angular layered plates behind, tapering to a point below.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the kneepad; colour 1 on the edges and rear layered plates.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Qularr_Armor_01.differs: The female kneepad is a flatter, narrower plate with the layered edge plates stacked tightly behind it.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_01.description: A single slouchy knit leg warmer worn on the right lower leg, bunched and wrinkled with a ribbed band at the top and a thick ribbed cuff at the ankle. Casual, retro rave styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knit body, fading toward colour 1 near the bottom; colour 3 on the top band; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_02.description: A short, scrunched knit leg warmer worn around the right lower leg above the ankle, with a thick ribbed cuff at the top, slouchy wrinkled fabric and a snug ribbed band at the bottom. Casual, retro rave look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main slouchy fabric; colour 1 on the lower part of the fabric, blending into it; colour 3 on the ribbed top cuff; colour 2 on the bottom band.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_Anklet_01.description: A chunky anklet band worn around the right ankle, with zigzag jagged upper and lower edges, layered angular panels and small triangular cut-outs. It reads as a mechanical, monstrous or rave-style cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_Anklet_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main band and jagged upper rim; colour 0 on the lower zigzag edge panel; colour 1 on the small triangular inserts; colour 3 on the triangular accents near the front and back.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_Anklet_02.description: A chunky octagonal anklet worn on the right ankle: a wide band with raised rims and contrasting centre panel, studded with large pyramid-shaped spikes that jut outward. Punk rave styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_Anklet_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and lower rims; colour 1 on the central band panel; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_Fur_01.description: A right ankle cuff of shaggy, layered fur tufts with a smooth band at the top. Four stacked rows of jagged strands hang down over the ankle and upper foot, giving a rave or festival look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top band and the uppermost fur row; colour 1 on the second fur row; colour 2 on the third fur row; colour 3 on the bottom fur row.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_Fur_02.description: A right-ankle cuff of layered, shaggy fur or feather tufts hanging from a smooth rounded band, with ragged pointed tips in three tiered rows; sits around the ankle above the foot in a wild, beastly style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Rave_Fur_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top band; colour 2 on the upper tuft layer; colour 1 on the middle tuft layer; colour 0 on the lower tuft tips.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Reactor_01.description: A sci-fi shin and calf guard for the right leg: a smooth tapered shell with a ridged contrasting vent panel down the front, a raised cuff at the top, and small round studs on the side plates.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main guard shell; colour 1 on the top cuff; colour 2 on the ridged vent panel; colour 3 on the small round studs.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Reactor_02.description: A sci-fi shin greave with a tapered plated shell that wraps the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle. It has a round reactor light at the front top, padded side and calf panels, and a ribbed panel down the back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and edging; colour 1 on the top cuff and the back strip details; colour 2 on the padded calf and side panels; colour 3 on the reactor light.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Reactor_02.differs: The female greave has a shallower, slimmer cuff at the top, which tilts slightly around the knee.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A right-leg greave of angular plated armor: a flared, pointed knee guard, a segmented shin and calf shell with banded ribbing, and a small strapped cuff at the ankle, all studded with round rivet-like knobs. Sci-fi renegade style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee guard, outer plates and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the front shin strip and the thin bands around the calf; colour 2 on the ribbed calf segments and the round knobs; colour 3 on the chevron panel down the front of the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_02.description: A right knee guard of faceted plates: a pointed, cup-like front kneecap shield with a banded rear wrap, plus chunky bolt-like side fasteners and a lower pointed edge. Suggests sci-fi armor worn at the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and bands; colour 2 on the round side bolts and the front fastener.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_02.differs: The female knee guard has a taller, more pointed front shield with a lower point that extends further down the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_03.description: A right ankle guard made of two angular, faceted plates that meet in a V around the ankle, with a chunky octagonal pod fixed at each side. Sci-fi armor look, sitting just above the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular plates; colour 2 on the octagonal side pods; colour 1 on the plate edge trim.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A right-leg greave of angular plated armor covering the shin and calf, with a round spiked boss at the knee, rows of small spikes down the front edge, a rear calf panel and a looping cable at the top.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shin plates and the top and bottom rims; colour 1 on the calf panel and some spikes; colour 2 on the knee boss and the spikes; colour 3 on the cable and the small dots on the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Straps_01.description: A column of six separate flat straps wrapped around the outer right lower leg, shrinking in size toward the ankle. Each strap has a small fastening stud and a loose flap end, giving a sci-fi renegade look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the small studs at the strap ends.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky angular shin greave for the right leg, made of faceted plates with a flared cuff at the top, round lens-like nodes at the sides, a vented panel at the back of the calf and a bright edge at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bright edge trims at the ankle and plate edges; colour 2 on the main faceted plates; colour 1 on the side nodes and the chevron plate at the knee; colour 3 on the round lens and the rear vent slats.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A mechanical right-shin greave: a tapered armoured shell with a slatted vent box at the top, twin canister pods on a side bracket, curved pipes, a crumpled cuff and a flared toe-side plate over the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and canisters; colour 1 on the side bracket and vent frame; colour 3 on the inset panels; colour 2 on the pipes and cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_01.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower, with the vent box sitting higher and a more pointed lower plate.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_02.description: A bulky mechanical right-shin greave with a slatted vent grille at the top, twin canister pods on the outer side, a crumpled cuff at the rim, hose piping, and a curved plate over the ankle. Retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell, cuff and canisters; colour 1 on the side fins and rear panel; colour 3 on the recessed front strip and small rear plate; colour 2 on hoses and vent interior.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_02.differs: The female greave is taller and narrower, with the vent grille and canisters sitting higher on the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Roc.description: A pair of cylindrical canisters with ridged screw-on caps, mounted side by side on a curved wrap-around plate that sits on the outer lower leg near the calf. Retro mechanical style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Roc.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved mounting plate; colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 2 on the caps and canister casings; colour 3 on the canister bases.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Roc.differs: The female plate is narrower and the canisters sit further forward and slightly apart, with the plate cut away in a deeper notch at the front.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Ven.description: A small mechanical vent unit strapped to the right lower leg below the knee: a boxy louvred grille with a flat rear panel, and two flexible ribbed hoses curving around the calf to exhaust nozzles at the back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Ven.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the grille frame and exhaust nozzles; colour 1 on the flat rear panel and top plate; colour 2 on the hoses; colour 3 on the interior behind the louvres.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Ven.differs: The female version has its exhaust hoses both pointing to the back, with the vent box sitting more on the front of the leg, while the male box sits further to the outer side and its hoses loop more widely.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Wra.description: A short band of draped, wrinkled cloth wrapped around the lower leg below the knee, with a boxy louvered vent block on the front and flexible hoses curving round to small cylindrical canisters at the back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Wra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth wrap and the vent frame; colour 1 on the plate behind the vent; colour 3 on the inner vent glow; colour 2 on the hoses and canisters.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Roman_01.description: A Roman-style right shin greave of overlapping segmented plates with a scalloped upper edge and a pointed lower plate, held on by several wide straps wrapped around the calf. Sits on the lower leg above the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Roman_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate faces and the wrap straps; colour 0 on the swirl-like plate ornaments; colour 2 on the plate edges and rims; colour 3 on the small rivets.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Roman_01.differs: The female greave has the straps wrapped tightly and closely against the calf, with the plates hugging the shin more narrowly.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Roman_02.description: A Roman-style shin greave made of five overlapping segmented plates that taper to a point at the ankle, with a raised rim, engraved swirl motifs and small studs; worn on the right lower leg.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Roman_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plate surfaces; colour 0 on the engraved swirl designs and lower point; colour 2 on the plate rims and edging; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Roman_03.description: A right shin greave of overlapping segmented plates that step down the lower leg to a pointed toe-end, each plate with a raised rim, jagged swirl motifs and a small stud. Roman-style fantasy armor.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Roman_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plate surfaces; colour 0 on the swirl motifs and the front plate face; colour 2 on the plate rims; colour 3 on the small studs.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Roman_03.differs: The female greave is a bit shorter and sits slimmer on the calf, with the lowest plate ending in a sharper point.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_01.description: A single right-foot greave boot: a slouchy, wrinkled lower boot with an open toe edge, a banded stripe above it, and a smooth shin guard rising to a rimmed, slightly angled top cuff below the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower boot; colour 1 on the shin guard; colour 3 on the diagonal band; colour 2 on the top rim and the edging around the boot opening.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_01.differs: The shin guard is a little slimmer, with a more slanted, diagonal band and a lower-sitting rim than the male version.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_02.description: A right-leg greave guard worn on the shin below the knee: a chunky angular shell with a tall flared upper plate, a pointed front panel, a rounded rear calf plate and a thin strap band at the bottom.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell, upper plate and front edging; colour 3 on the front shin panel; colour 0 on the rear calf plate; colour 2 on the bottom strap band.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_01.description: A sculpted shin greave for the right leg: a smooth curved shell with a raised front plate, a rolled rear ridge and a small accent panel at the side, ending in a pointed lower edge above the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shin plate; colour 1 on the rear shell and the rolled ridge; colour 3 on the small side panel; colour 2 on the bottom edge trim.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_01.differs: The female greave is narrower and more tapered, with the front plate covering less of the shin than the male version.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_02.description: A right shin greave with a curved, plated shell running from below the knee to the ankle, topped by curved horn-like spikes at the knee, a curling claw-like blade down the front and a flared angular ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin plate; colour 0 on the side and back shell and the curling claw; colour 2 on the rim trim, top opening and ankle cuff; colour 3 on the knee horns.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_02.differs: The female greave has a longer curling claw blade running down the front of the shin, and the horns sit more upright.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_01.description: A curved, scarab-like claw worn on the outside of the lower leg: a smooth arched horn that starts at the calf, bends around the leg and ends in a sharp tapered point near the ankle, with a segmented tip.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper arc of the horn; colour 1 on the main curved section; colour 2 on the narrow band at the base of the tip; colour 3 on the pointed claw tip.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_01.differs: The female claw is narrower and hugs the leg more closely, with a smaller arc than the male version.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_02.description: A right-calf accessory of curved, claw-like horns: a long tapering hook rises from a segmented central spine, a second horn arcs around the leg, and a slender curved tail sweeps down toward the ankle. Beast-like and mechanical.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large curved horns; colour 2 on the central segmented spine and horn tips; colour 0 on the lower curved tail.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_02.differs: The female version has its upper horns spread apart with a shorter, more upright lower curl.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_01.description: A cluster of curved, fin-like blades stacked down the outside of the lower leg, each a tapering spike with a panelled, chevron-patterned edge. Sweeps backward from the calf like a sea creature's fins.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main surface of each blade; colour 1 on the outlines and edging; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the recessed panels.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_01.differs: The female fins are larger and fan out more widely, with their tips sweeping further back from the leg.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_02.description: A cluster of curved, blade-like fins or spines sweeping back and downward from the outer right lower leg, each with a contrasting inner surface and chevron-patterned edges; a monstrous aquatic accessory.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner fin surfaces; colour 1 on the outlines and edges; colour 2 on the panels between patterns; colour 3 on the chevron stripes.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_02.differs: The female version has four longer, more widely spaced fins that sweep further down and back.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Starhawk_02.description: A right-leg greave with a flared, pointed shin plate at the top of the calf, a narrow tapering strip running down the shin, and a small angular band around the ankle. Sleek sci-fi superhero armor.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shin plate and ankle band; colour 0 on the tapering strip and the ankle wedge; colour 3 on the inset panel beneath the shin plate; colour 2 on the thin edge lining.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Starhawk_02.differs: The female version has a slimmer, more upright shin plate and a narrower strip down the leg.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Starowl_01.description: A feathery, beast-like shin guard wrapping the lower right leg from calf to ankle, with jagged pointed tufts along the top and trailing spiky feather-like points at the ankle; flecked with small spots.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feathered body; colour 1 on the faint speckles; colour 2 on the spots.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Starowl_01.differs: The female version is longer and narrower, with the trailing points at the ankle extending further down toward the foot.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Starowl_02.description: A shaggy, feathered beast-leg wrap covering the lower calf and ankle, with jagged pointed tufts flaring at the top and bottom edges and scattered speckled spots; suits griffon or owl creature looks.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Starowl_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feathered body; colour 1 on the small speckles; colour 2 on the larger spots.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_01.description: A right shin and calf greave with a smooth curved shell, angular layered plates and a pointed flared top cuff at the knee. A recessed ribbed panel runs down the front, and the piece ends above the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and lower cuff; colour 2 on the upper cuff plates and side blades; colour 3 on the recessed ribbed inner panel; colour 0 barely visible.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_01.differs: The female greave has a darker, all-contrasting upper cuff and a slimmer, more tapered shell, with no light-coloured plate inside the top.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_02.description: A curved, pointed vent fin worn on the outer right calf: a tapering shell of layered metal plates with raised edges and angular inset panels, flaring to a sharp tip at the top. Suggests retro armored commando styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main outer shell and edges; colour 1 on the lower inset panels; colour 0 on the highlights along the plate rims.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Swan_01.description: A right-leg greave covering the shin, with a smooth armored shell, a glossy inset panel down the front, a jagged outlined edge and a flared cuff at the ankle. A ring of feathery, spiky plumes crowns the top below the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and feather plumes; colour 1 on the edge outlines, ankle cuff and plume tips; colour 2 on the glossy front inset; colour 3 on the diamond gems.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Swan_01.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower, reaching down to the ankle with a pointed, tapered lower edge and a smaller front panel.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_01.description: A small curved horn-like spike worn on the outer side of the right lower leg below the knee, with a flat blocky base that tapers into a swept, pointed tip. Monstrous, symbiote-style accent.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blocky base and lower part of the spike; colour 1 on the curved tip, fading in from the base.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_01.description: A right lower-leg greave in an organic, symbiote-like style: a tapering sheath with a hollow, jagged flared rim at the top and soft ridged folds running down to a narrow base above the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the greave, fading toward colour 0 at the lower end; no other slots clearly visible.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_01.differs: The female greave is slimmer and more tapered, with a smoother surface and a slightly taller, narrower rim.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_02.description: A tall, organic shin guard of smooth, membrane-like material that wraps the lower leg above the ankle, rising to several jagged, pointed fins at the top edge. Suggests a symbiote or monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the guard, fading toward colour 0 near the bottom edge.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_02.differs: The female guard is taller and narrower, with long, thin points rising in a split V at the front of the top edge.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tactical_01.description: A cluster of four short hexagonal canister pods clipped around the lower calf, angled outward like small thrusters, with banded ends and zigzag striping. A tactical, mechanical accessory on one leg.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the end caps and some zigzag stripes; colour 3 on the other zigzag stripes; colour 2 on the rings at the pod ends.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.description: A loose, soft cloth spat-style greave covering the lower shin down to the ankle, with a rigid studded plate strapped over the top of the foot and a thin strap under the arch. Retro, mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin wrap and underfoot strap; colour 1 on the plate over the foot; colour 2 on the rivets.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.description: A single swept-back fin blade attached to the outer side of the right lower leg, made of stacked pointed feather-like spikes that taper downward. It looks like a retro superhero calf fin.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.colourAreas: The whole fin appears in a metallic finish that seems to ignore the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.description: A single swept-back fin-like blade attached to the outer lower calf of the right leg, with a row of jagged feather-like points along its lower edge. Suggests a retro winged greave for beast or monster looks.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the blade; colour 2 on the back face; the material looks glossy and metallic, so the other slots barely show.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armor_Draycu.description: A right shin greave of plate with a snarling fanged monster face on the front, open mouth and pointed rim, held by two thin straps around the calf. Gothic vampiric armor covering the lower leg.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armor_Draycu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and face; colour 1 on the edge trim and rivets; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth; colour 2 on the straps and fangs.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armor_Draycu.differs: The female greave is longer and narrower, running further up the shin, with a more pointed top edge.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armorviper_0.description: A small angular kneepad of faceted armor plates on the right knee: a broad pointed cap with a ridged centre and a contrasting pointed strip running above and below it. Suggests sci-fi or monstrous armor.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armorviper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knee cap plates; colour 1 on the pointed upper and lower strip panels.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Birdpeople_0.description: A loose, baggy shin cover for the right leg, a wrinkled tube that gathers at the ankle, with a stiff angular cuff at the top whose front is a pointed, feather-like plate. Suggests a bird-folk or beastly look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Birdpeople_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baggy leg cover; colour 2 on the top cuff and feather-like front plate.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Defender_01.description: A small diamond-shaped kneepad with a raised central ridge and pointed top and bottom, strapped to the outside of the right knee. It has a curved crescent marking on the front and a flat, smooth back.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the crescent marking on the front; colour 1 shows faintly on the flat back of the plate.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Defender_01.differs: The female kneepad has a flat, smooth back, while the male one has a dented, contoured back.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Kneepad_Skul.description: A faceted, angular skull-shaped kneepad worn over the front of the right knee, with hollow eye sockets, a nose cavity and a jagged brow ridge. Its low-poly plates flare out at the edges for a monstrous, gothic look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Kneepad_Skul.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell; colour 1 on the eye sockets; colour 3 on the sharp streak markings around the brow and jaw.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes flanking the right lower leg below the knee, each with a swept-back barbed fin and an inset inner panel. Sharp, aggressive, monstrous-mechanical styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade bodies and edges; colour 3 on the inset panels between the blade edges.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.differs: The female blades are longer and slimmer, with tall thin tips that sweep further up and down the leg.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes on the right lower leg, one on each side of the calf, each with a recessed inset panel and sweeping tips that point down past the ankle. Monstrous, clawlike styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade bodies and edges; colour 3 on the inset panels inside each blade.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Bl.differs: The female blades sit lower on the calf and hang more vertically, with longer, narrower tips reaching toward the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Traveler_01.description: A small shield-shaped plate worn at the outer side of the right knee: a pointed, faceted panel with a raised bordering rim, curving slightly around the leg. Suggests fantasy or mechanical armour.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plate face and back; colour 1 on the raised rim around the edge.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Valerian_01.description: A right shin greave wrapping the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with a thick rounded cap band at the top, a cross-shaped raised armor plate on the front shin, and a thin contrasting stripe down the front.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and the raised edges of the front plate; colour 2 on the top cap band and the recessed cross plate; colour 3 on the thin stripe down the front.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Valerian_02.description: A small cross-shaped armor plate worn on the outer side of the right lower leg above the ankle, with a raised bevelled rim around a recessed cross panel. Gothic, knightly styling.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Valerian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim; colour 2 on the recessed cross panel.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Victory_01.description: A right shin greave: a smooth curved plate wrapping the lower leg from below the knee to above the ankle, with a V-shaped contrasting trim edge and an angular faceted guard flaring up over the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plate and the back knee facet; colour 3 on the contrasting trim border and back panel; colour 2 on the front knee guard.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Victory_02.description: A single faceted kneepad shaped like a pointed angular shard, with a pointed tip below the knee and a folded, creased wrap-around back panel. It sits over the right knee in an armor-like style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Victory_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer front shell; colour 0 on the inner folded back and edge panels.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Victory_02.differs: The female kneepad is a narrower, more elongated diamond shard with a longer point at the top and bottom, while the male one is wider and shallower.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Victory_03.description: A pair of slender, curving wing-like blades at the outer ankle: a larger sweeping fin swept upward and a smaller lower fin twisting beside it, with contrasting edging. Superhero flair for boots or bare feet.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Victory_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large upper wing; colour 1 on the smaller lower wing and inner underside; colour 2 on the edge outlines.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Vigilante_01.description: A small angular shin or knee guard: a faceted hexagonal plate with a raised rim around an inset front panel that has a small slot detail, sitting on the outside of the lower leg near the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and the back plate; colour 1 on the inset front panel; colour 3 on the small slot detail.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Vigilante_02.description: A small knee guard on the right leg: an angular octagonal band wraps around the leg with a striped edge, and a contrasting wedge-shaped cup with a chunky faceted cap sits over the front of the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the band; colour 0 on the stripe along the band; colour 3 on the knee cup; colour 2 on the faceted cap.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Warrior_01.description: A short segmented ankle greave made of stacked faceted bands that alternate between two materials, with a flat cap ring at the top. It wraps the lower shin just above the foot, in a mechanical, armoured style.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating light bands; colour 1 on the other set of alternating bands; colour 2 on the top cap ring and the thin gaps between bands.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Warrior_02.description: A right-leg greave of rigid armor: a tapered shin guard with a raised rim at the top and a contrasting frame crossing over the front, plus a ribbed fin-like plate down the shin and a segmented ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin shell; colour 3 on the top and bottom bands and the front frame; colour 0 on the ribbed shin plate and ankle guard; colour 2 on the base cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Warrior_Beast_01.description: A short segmented ankle cuff made of stacked faceted bands that pinch slightly at the middle and flare at the ends, worn on the right lower leg just above the ankle. Its look is armoured and tribal.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Warrior_Beast_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating light bands; colour 1 on the other alternating bands; colour 2 on the top rim.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Wingbracer_01.description: A small bat-wing bracer for the outer right calf: two long, slender curved spines sweep up from the ankle, joined by a thin webbed membrane. It gives a spiky, gothic-fantasy look.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Wingbracer_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spines; colour 1 on the membrane between them.

Female/F_Footr_Greave_Wingbracer_02.description: A small bat-wing fin attached to the outer side of the right lower leg: two long curved spiny ribs with a thin, veined membrane stretched between them, tapering to a point near the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Greave_Wingbracer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing ribs and bone spines; colour 1 on the thin membrane between them.

Female/F_Footr_Greaves_Spooky_01.description: A single right shin greave shaped like a tapering shell, with swept layered ridges running diagonally down its length and thorn-like spikes flaring at the top rim. A narrow contrasting band circles the ankle edge.
Female/F_Footr_Greaves_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and ridges; colour 1 on the band at the ankle edge; colour 3 on the small inset gems along the front of the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Heraldry_01.description: A low, ankle-high boot with a smooth rounded upper, a jagged crown-like cuff around the ankle, a banded strip across the instep and a large pointed, beak-like toe cap. Sole edged with a thin stripe.
Female/F_Footr_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and sole stripes; colour 2 on the band above the toe; colour 3 on the pointed toe cap.
Female/F_Footr_Heraldry_01.differs: The toe cap is shorter and blunter, and the boot sits a little lower on the foot.

Female/F_Footr_Holohexarmor_01_Shortboot.description: A short, sneaker-like sci-fi boot with a soft ruffled ankle cuff, a padded upper, and angular hex-plate armour over the toe, sides and heel. Small round sensor lights and a contrasting toe vent give it a mechanical look.
Female/F_Footr_Holohexarmor_01_Shortboot.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and the padded upper; colour 1 on the armour plates over the toe, sides and heel; colour 2 on the toe vent and the round sockets; colour 3 on the small lights.

Female/F_Footr_Holohexarmor_01_Tallboot.description: A sci-fi armoured tall boot with a hard shin and calf shell that rises to pointed fins at the knee, a glowing round sensor on the shin, panelled plates, and a chunky segmented ankle and toe section.
Female/F_Footr_Holohexarmor_01_Tallboot.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin shell and boot body; colour 0 on the ankle bands and lower boot straps; colour 2 on the knee spikes and back panel; colour 3 on the round sensor lights.

Female/F_Footr_Inmate_01.description: A chunky, blocky right boot with a wedge-shaped angular foot and a square open-topped cuff at the ankle. The cuff is marked with small rectangular panel details, suggesting a prison-issue or mechanical shackle look.
Female/F_Footr_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot section; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 1 on the small rectangular panels on the cuff; colour 3 on the sole.
Female/F_Footr_Inmate_01.differs: The cuff is set at a slightly different angle and the foot looks longer and narrower, but the design is the same.

Female/F_Footr_Junkbot_01.description: A right foot shaped like a clothes iron: a pointed, smooth sole-plate with segmented panels, an ankle cuff, and a bar bridge with a hexagonal handle, thin rods and barrel-like side canisters. A mechanical, junkyard robot look.
Female/F_Footr_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole-plate tip, ankle cuff and side canisters; colour 1 on the sole-plate side panels and supports; colour 2 on the sole-plate band and handle end; colour 3 on the handle centre band.

Female/F_Footr_Junkbot_02.description: A robotic right foot made of scrap parts: a ring cuff at the ankle, chunky cylindrical pipe housings around the heel, and thin rods running forward to two clawed, blocky toe segments. Junkyard mechanical style.
Female/F_Footr_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ankle ring and some joint parts; colour 1 on the pipe housings, toe blocks and heel panels; colour 0 on the toe tips, bands and rods; colour 3 on the cuff patch and small heel panels.

Female/F_Footr_Kaiju_01.description: A monstrous clawed right foot covering, ending just above the ankle, with a chunky rounded scaly-looking foot, muscular ridges over the top and three long curved talons at the front. Suggests a kaiju or beast look.
Female/F_Footr_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the foot body; colour 2 on the claws.
Female/F_Footr_Kaiju_01.differs: The female version shows three claws from the front, with a slightly smaller, narrower foot.

Female/F_Footr_Light_01.description: A knee-high superhero boot with a pointed toe, stepped cuffs at the ankle and calf, and a flared angular top. A winged emblem badge sits on the outer shin, with thin contrasting piping along the edges.
Female/F_Footr_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the boot body; colour 0 on the piping trim along the cuffs and top; colour 2 on the winged emblem; colour 1 on the small centre gem of the emblem.

Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_65_01.description: A short right ankle boot in a kung fu style, with a rounded toe cap bearing a curled scroll motif, a V-shaped panel across the front and a folded cuff around the ankle. It sits on the foot only.
Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main boot body and sole; colour 0 on the toe cap with its scrolls, the front panel and the ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The female boot is a clean, smooth version in the sheet colours, while the male one has a weathered, mottled surface and a darker toe panel.

Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_65_02.description: A short, ankle-high kung fu style shoe with a rounded toe, thin flat sole and a raised collar at the ankle. A swooping decorative curve runs across the toe and up the instep, with a separate panel at the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main upper of the shoe; colour 0 on the sole, collar rim, swooping toe trim and heel panel.

Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_66_01.description: A calf-high mechanical boot with a rounded capped toe, a banded ankle cuff and a tall shaft. A angular robot-face plate with small eye lenses sits at the front top, with a V-shaped inset below it.
Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe sides; colour 2 on the toe cap, cuff, rear panel and face plate frame; colour 1 on the V inset and mouth; colour 3 on the eye lenses.

Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_67_01.description: A shaggy, beast-like right foot covering: a furry hoof-shaped boot with ragged layered tufts around the ankle and a split cloven hoof tip at the front. Ends at the ankle, suggesting a monstrous or animal look.
Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaggy fur; colour 2 on the split hoof tips.

Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_67_02.description: A low ankle boot with a chunky sole, laced front with decorative web-like stitched trim, a folded-over contrasting cuff at the ankle, and a small pair of butterfly-like wing fins at the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body; colour 2 on the folded cuff; colour 1 on the sole, stitched trim, laces and wing fins.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Bounty_01.description: Mid-calf sci-fi boot with a segmented, paneled shaft, a wide contrasting band below the top, a contrasting centre strip down the front, a chunky capped toe with a small inset light, and a thick sole with a heel block.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shaft panels; colour 1 on the band, lower boot body and sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap, front strip and heel block; colour 3 on the toe light.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Ghosthunter_01.description: A mid-calf lace-up boot with a smooth, slightly flared shaft, criss-cross front lacing, contrasting straps across the shaft and ankle, a contrasting band at the top and a thin contrasting sole. Sporty, practical look.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 2 on the straps and top band; colour 3 on the laces; colour 1 on the sole.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, narrower shaft that fits closer to the calf, with a slimmer toe.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A single right boot reaching just below the thigh, with a smooth, close-fitting shaft, a slim seam down the back and side, a rounded toe and a high stiletto heel. Retro, glossy look with a thin contrasting rim at the top.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shaft; colour 1 on the foot and lower shaft; colour 3 on the thin top rim; colour 2 on the heel and sole edge.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Retro_Talisman_01.differs: The female boot has a high stiletto heel and a taller, thigh-high shaft, while the male boot has a flat sole and stops below the knee.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Super_Destroyer_01.description: A retro superhero right boot: a glossy calf-high sleeve with a flared knee cap and pointed top, a front shin plate, a band at the ankle, and a low sole with a separate toe plate and a small side fin at the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Super_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe and instep plates; colour 1 on the knee cap, shin plate and ankle band; colour 3 on the small knee fin and gem; colour 2 on the calf sleeve and sole.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Super_Destroyer_01.differs: The female boot has a smaller, sleeker toe plate and a slimmer foot, with a small contrasting gem on the front of the knee cap.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Tactical_01.description: A chunky tactical sci-fi right boot with an angular armored cuff, open mesh-like ankle panel, lugged tread sole, warning-triangle emblem on the side, and small canister thrusters on each side of the ankle with a looping cable.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, sole and toe panels; colour 0 on the boot body and canisters; colour 2 on the ankle panel, laces and rear vents; colour 3 on the warning emblem and canister markings.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Traveler_01.description: A mid-calf right boot with a smooth, slightly loose shaft, a rounded toe and a low flat sole. Two buckled straps wrap the shaft and a small angled strap crosses the instep, for a retro space-explorer look.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the straps and instep band; colour 3 on the buckle frames and instep tab; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Trooper_01.description: A mid-calf superhero boot with a smooth, sleek shaft, a chevron-shaped angular cuff at the top, contrasting inset panels on the front and sides, a contrasting rounded toe cap and a thin sole.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the chevron cuff; colour 2 on the inset panels and toe cap; colour 3 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Valerian_01.description: A right knee-high sci-fi boot with a smooth shaft, a thick rounded cuff at the top, an angular armoured shin plate with jutting fins, a strip down the front of the ankle, and a chunky sole with a toe cap.
