Female/F_Footr_Long_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and upper; colour 1 on the sole and toe cap; colour 2 on the top cuff and shin plate; colour 3 on the front ankle strip.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Vigilante_01.description: A calf-high right boot with a smooth rounded foot and thin sole, a blade-like layered armor shell up the front shin and back of the calf, and a strap band across the ankle. Sleek sci-fi superhero style.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body; colour 1 on the toe panel and the stripe up the front of the shin; colour 2 on the armor shell, ankle strap and sole; colour 3 on the small mark at the back top.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Vigilante_02.description: A calf-high superhero boot with a smooth flared cuff, a contrasting front stripe, two buckled straps around the shin and a strap across the instep. It has a rounded toe panel and a thick sole.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body, straps and toe rim; colour 1 on the front stripe and toe panel; colour 3 on the strap buckles; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Long_Wheelie_01.description: A single-wheel skate boot cuff worn on the right ankle: a padded, ribbed ankle shell with a V-shaped strap panel, round star-emblem discs on each side, and one large wheel under the foot with small studded axle knobs.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Wheelie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle shell and wheel; colour 1 on the V-shaped strap panel and disc centres; colour 3 on the disc rims and axle knobs; colour 2 on the stars.
Female/F_Footr_Long_Wheelie_01.differs: The female wheel is smaller and thinner, with a slimmer ankle shell and less bulky side discs.

Female/F_Footr_Mecha_01.description: A mechanical bird-like right foot: a short cuffed ankle band above a contrasting arched joint, with two long angular wedge toes pointing forward and a small blocky heel spur at the back. Sci-fi, monstrous mecha look.
Female/F_Footr_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 0 on the toe wedges and heel blocks; colour 2 on the arched ankle joint.
Female/F_Footr_Mecha_01.differs: The female version has two long toe wedges plus a smaller heel block behind, giving a more splayed stance, while the male version has a wider central toe and extra side toe blocks.

Female/F_Footr_Mecha_03.description: A low mechanical right foot piece: a flat, angular pointed sole plate with small side lugs, a smooth wedge-shaped upper, and a chunky notched ankle cuff with a ribbed vent inside. Robot-like and sci-fi in style.
Female/F_Footr_Mecha_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole and upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the ribbed vent inside the cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A low, ankle-high sneaker-style shoe with a rounded toe cap, stitched seams and a chunky flat sole, finished with a thick ring cuff at the ankle and a swooping contrasting panel across the laces area.
Female/F_Footr_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body and toe cap; colour 1 on the ankle ring cuff; colour 3 on the diagonal front panel; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A glossy ankle-high heeled bootie with a rounded toe, chunky block heel and thin sole. A slim outlined panel runs down the front of the shaft, and the collar has a contrasting trim edge.
Female/F_Footr_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the outline trim around the collar and front panel; colour 2 on the heel and sole.

Female/F_Footr_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A short, rounded ankle boot with a soft slouched cuff, a chunky flat sole and a wrapped separate panel around the ankle, fastened with small diamond-shaped ornaments on each side.
Female/F_Footr_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the wrapped ankle panel; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the diamond ornaments.
Female/F_Footr_Modern_Witchcraft_01.differs: The female boot sits with a taller, narrower shaft and a more pointed toe, and the ankle panel wraps higher on the shaft.

Female/F_Footr_Monster_Bootripped_01.description: A short ankle boot with torn, ragged edges at the toe, from which large skin-toned animal claws protrude. It has a laced front, a padded cuff at the top and a thick angular sole with a raised heel block.
Female/F_Footr_Monster_Bootripped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 2 on the top cuff and the laces; colour 1 on the sole and heel; the claws show a fixed skin tone and ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Footr_Moth_01.description: A clawed monstrous right foot covering: a flared cuff at the ankle, layered crumpled wraps over the foot, and two forked toe sections each ending in a long curved talon. Suggests a beast or insect creature.
Female/F_Footr_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ankle cuff; colour 1 on the layered foot wraps; colour 2 on the toe caps; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Mutated_01.description: A right ankle-high boot with a lumpy, organic shell of swollen ridges and folds, ending in a blunt toe with a cluster of small round nodules and a small bulb at the tip. Suggests a mutated, monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main boot body; colour 2 on the toe nodules; colour 1 on the small bulbs at the toe and ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Mutated_02.description: A right foot covering shaped like a lumpy, fleshy mutated boot, with folded, wrinkled ridges and a few bulbous blisters and small contrasting nodules across the top. It sits low, just above the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main wrinkled boot body; colour 1 on the bulbous blisters on top; colour 2 on the small nodules.

Female/F_Footr_Persian_Shoe_01.description: A soft, slipper-like ankle shoe with a long upturned curling pointed toe, a low heel-less sole and a notched, pointed cuff with a triangular front gusset. Suggests Persian or genie-style fantasy footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Persian_Shoe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the shoe; colour 1 on the trim along the cuff and gusset edges; colour 3 on the front triangular gusset; colour 2 on the underside of the toe tip.

Female/F_Footr_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A spiky armoured boot-and-shin guard for the right leg: a pointed shin plate with a flared crest at the top, layered calf plates behind, and a clawed, jagged-edged foot cover. Dragon-like sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Footr_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot cover, crest and back edge spikes; colour 1 on the ankle flare and layered calf plates; colour 2 on the front shin plate; colour 3 on small inner accents.
Female/F_Footr_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The female version has a slim, tall contrasting shin blade and a smaller, lower foot cover, with the contrasting plating sitting mostly at the ankle and calf.

Female/F_Footr_Pumpkin_01.description: A chunky, rounded ankle-high shoe with a thick flat sole, jagged tooth-like panels across the toe and sides, swirling curved lines on the heel, and a clawed bat-wing shaped bow at the ankle. Cartoonish monster style.
Female/F_Footr_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 3 on the jagged toothed panels and swirl lines; colour 1 on the winged bow at the ankle; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Big_01.description: A large reptilian raptor foot for the right leg: a short stump-like ankle leads to a long, splayed three-toed foot with a rear spur and long curved talons, textured with small speckles and ridges.
Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Big_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the talons; colour 1 on the small marks along the toes; colour 3 on the main skin of the foot and ankle; colour 2 on the small speckles.

Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Big_02.description: A right foot shaped like a raptor's: a thick, bare skin-textured foot that begins at the ankle and splits into three long toes, each ending in a sharp curved claw, plus a rear spur. Spots and small stripe markings dot the surface.
Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Big_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the skin-textured foot ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 on the small stripe markings across the toes.

Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Big_03.description: A right foot replacement shaped like a reptilian raptor foot: a short thick ankle block leads to a long, three-toed clawed foot with long curved talons and a small rear spur, covered in skin with small spots and dashes.
Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Big_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the scaly skin keeps a fleshy tone of its own, with small spots and dashes in contrasting marks. Colours 1, 2 and 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Big_04.description: A right foot replaced by a bird-of-prey or raptor talon: a short rounded ankle stump and long splayed toes with long curved claws, plus a rear spur. Scaly skin with small speckles marks it as a beastly look.
Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Big_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; colour 1 on the small marking patches along the toes; colour 2 on the small speckles; the skin itself shows a fixed skin tone that ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Claw_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a bird-of-prey talon: a short ankle-high cuff, ridged scaly toes, a rounded ball pad, and long curved claws at the front and a raised dewclaw at the inner side. Monstrous, beastly look.
Female/F_Footr_Raptor_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ankle cuff, ball pad and underside; colour 1 on the ridged scaly toe plates; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Ravenswood_01.description: A shin guard for the right lower leg: a rounded, cuff-like greave with a stepped plate at the calf and a pointed front shield with swirling etched patterns and swept spikes, ending in a point near the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main greave plates and cuff; colour 1 on the etched swirl patterns and thin line accents.

Female/F_Footr_Reactor_01.description: A right ankle boot made of chunky, faceted stacked plates around the ankle, with a smooth rounded toe cap and a thick sole rim with a contrasting accent strip. Suggests a sci-fi armored superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stacked ankle plates; colour 1 on the toe cap and upper front; colour 2 on the sole rim; colour 3 on the accent strips along the sole edge.

Female/F_Footr_Reactor_02.description: A chunky, rounded ankle boot with a bulbous domed toe cap marked by small dimples, a raised block heel, a thick cuff at the ankle and round side pods on either side of the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe, upper foot and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the heel block and ankle section; colour 3 on the round side pods; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Reactor_04.description: A chunky, angular right ankle boot with faceted panels, small rivets, a thick platform sole and a contrasting padded cuff. A single large cone spike juts forward from the toe, and a rounded panel fills the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and toe panels; colour 1 on the sole and the band across the instep; colour 3 on the toe spike and heel panel; colour 2 on the cuff opening and outlines.
Female/F_Footr_Reactor_04.differs: The toe spike on the female version points more upright and sits closer to the toe tip, and the boot appears shorter.

Female/F_Footr_Renegade_01.description: A chunky ankle-high sneaker-style boot with angular armour plates over the toe and heel, a cross strap with elasticated bands over the instep, and three short spikes jutting from the toe cap and sides.
Female/F_Footr_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, heel plates and strap; colour 1 on the main boot body, sole and one spike; colour 3 on the bands over the instep; colour 2 on two of the spikes and the strap fasteners.
Female/F_Footr_Renegade_01.differs: The female boot has three spikes on the toe and sides, with a taller spike rising from the centre of the toe cap.

Female/F_Footr_Renegade_02.description: A chunky low sneaker-style boot with a rounded toe cap, a separate strap panel across the top of the foot fastened with studs, and sharp spikes jutting from the panel's front and sides. Sits at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole, toe cap and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the top strap panels; colour 2 on the heel block and spikes; colour 3 on the studs.
Female/F_Footr_Renegade_02.differs: The female version adds three sharp spikes rising from the top and sides of the strap panel, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Footr_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky angular boot-shoe with a thick layered sole, faceted armoured toe cap and a wide strap panel across the instep with a small inset patch; a short faceted ankle cuff rises behind.
Female/F_Footr_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff; colour 1 on the toe cap, strap panel and heel plates; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the small patch on the strap.
Female/F_Footr_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The female version sits on a slightly raised, more tapered sole and has a taller, more upright heel and ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Robotexo_01.description: A robotic exoskeleton right foot: a rounded heel block, a contrasting ankle joint disc with a hub, exposed cable bundles running to a layered armored instep plate, and segmented mechanical toes. Sits below a flat ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel block, ankle cuff, instep plate and toe segments; colour 1 on the cables; colour 2 on the ankle joint and toe joints; colour 3 on the hub centres and small toe markings.

Female/F_Footr_Robotexo_02.description: A mechanical cyborg right foot: a cuffed ankle joint with a round wheel-like hub, strut arms running forward to a separate plated toe cap, and a rear heel block, all on a thin sole. Digitigrade-style, robotic and sci-fi.
Female/F_Footr_Robotexo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff, heel block and toe plates; colour 1 on the struts, soles and toe stripes; colour 2 on the ankle joint housing; colour 3 on the hub centre and inner heel details.

Female/F_Footr_Sandstorm_01.description: A short ankle boot with a soft, slightly wrinkled shaft, a rounded toe, a thin sole, and a contrasting cuff at the top. A thin zip-like seam runs up the outer side and the back. Casual, practical footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff opening; colour 3 on the seam stitching; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Sandstorm_02.description: A low, chunky right shoe with a rounded toe, thick sole with a squared toe cap, a folded ankle cuff and a tall separate panel hanging down the back of the heel. Sporty, sci-fi footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 2 on the sole and toe cap; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the heel panel and the small front cuff panel.

Female/F_Footr_Santa_Boot_01.description: A right ankle boot in a festive Santa style: a contrasting rounded-toe foot with a small heel, a taller shaft and a thick folded-over cuff at the top, plus a square buckle across the instep.
Female/F_Footr_Santa_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot of the boot and the buckle; colour 1 on the shaft and part of the cuff; colour 3 on the rounded cuff section; colour 2 on the buckle's inner slot.

Female/F_Footr_Scarab_02.description: A monstrous clawed right foot: a smooth ankle-high boot base extends into three segmented, armoured toes, each tipped with a long curved talon. It suggests a beast or scarab-like mechanical creature.
Female/F_Footr_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth foot base; colour 2 on the segmented toe plates; colour 3 on the talons.

Female/F_Footr_Shoe_Urban_01.description: A high-top canvas sneaker with a rounded toe cap, thick flat sole, criss-cross laces, eyelets, a folded floppy collar and a diamond-shaped emblem patch on the ankle. Casual street footwear worn on the right foot.
Female/F_Footr_Shoe_Urban_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body and collar; colour 1 on the laces and the ankle strip; colour 3 on the toe cap, eyelets and the emblem outline; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Shoe_Victorian_01.description: A low ankle-high Victorian boot with a smooth upper, a separate textured toe cap, a small stacked heel and a rounded side bulge at the ankle. It sits on the right foot in a period-style look.
Female/F_Footr_Shoe_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper; colour 2 on the toe cap and heel; colour 1 on the panel down the back and outer side of the ankle and on the small tip and edge accents.

Female/F_Footr_Shoes_Spy_01.description: A chunky low-cut dress shoe with a square rounded toe, glossy upper, laced front panel and a thick platform sole with a small heel, plus a short cuffed sock top at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Shoes_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the laced front panel; colour 2 on the thick sole; colour 3 on the sock cuff at the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Skeleton_02.description: A skeletal right foot with individually modelled toe and foot bones and a bulky heel bone, joined to a separate straight-cut cuff band at the ankle. Reads as a bare bone foot for undead or monstrous looks.
Female/F_Footr_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint bands and patches over the heel and knuckles; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Skeleton_02.differs: The female version has a taller, flared ankle cuff that sits higher, while the male version has a thin cuff with a bone ankle joint visible below it.

Female/F_Footr_Skeleton_Monster_01.description: A skeletal monster foot: long, separate bone-like toe rods fanning out from a small flat ankle cap, each ending in a segmented joint and a curved, pointed claw. Worn on the right foot, it suggests a beastly, undead look.
Female/F_Footr_Skeleton_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long toe bones and ankle cap; colour 1 on the toe joint segments; colour 2 on the claw bases; colour 3 on the claw tips.
Female/F_Footr_Skeleton_Monster_01.differs: The female foot has shorter, more upright toe bones that sit closer together.

Female/F_Footr_Skin_Fur_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: a furry ankle cuff with jagged tufts, a separate skin-toned patch on the outer side, a panel over the midfoot, and clawed, separated toes.
Female/F_Footr_Skin_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ankle cuff, fur and toes; colour 0 on the heel and sole and the claw tips; colour 2 on the midfoot panel over the front of the foot; the patch on the outer side ignores the scheme and keeps its skin tone.

Female/F_Footr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: a furred ankle and heel section with jagged tufts, a separate patch on the outer side, a padded toe section and long curved claws at each toe tip.
Female/F_Footr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel and the claw tips; colour 1 on the ankle fur and the claws; colour 2 on the toe pad; colour 3 on the side patch.

Female/F_Footr_Sneakers_02.description: A right-foot running sneaker with a chunky rounded sole, breathable mesh upper, curved overlay stripes down the side, a padded heel with cushioning inserts, a short contrasting ankle cuff and loosely threaded laces.
Female/F_Footr_Sneakers_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh upper; colour 1 on the sole, toe cap and heel; colour 3 on the side stripes and heel inserts; colour 2 on the laces and ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A tall, angular boot-greave for the right leg with a flared, faceted rim at the calf, a cut-away open front over the instep and a wide back panel. Built from separate panels, it has a sleek sci-fi pharaoh look.
Female/F_Footr_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, heel and lower side panels; colour 1 on the main front and foot panels; colour 2 on the back stripe and ankle cut-out; colour 3 on the small band at mid-shin.

Female/F_Footr_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A right boot with a chunky rounded toe and a mid-calf shaft with a hexagonal opening. Layered panels and a separate ankle cuff with a bolt-like fastener give it a sci-fi, adventurer look.
Female/F_Footr_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shaft and the foot; colour 1 on the mid-shaft panel and the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the top opening and the band below the shaft; colour 3 on the small panel at the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Spats_Victorian_01.description: A right ankle boot with a short cuff and a separate spat panel wrapped over the instep and heel, plus a contrasting toe cap and small heel. Sits at the ankle, with a vintage, dapper look.
Female/F_Footr_Spats_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spat panel over the instep and heel; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and heel edge; colour 3 on the front strip of the cuff; colour 2 on the toe cap.

Female/F_Footr_Starhawk_02.description: A low ankle boot with a hexagon-patterned upper, a chunky rounded sole, a swept-up angular heel cap and a small capped toe. It sits at the ankle and suggests a sleek, sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hexagon-patterned upper; colour 3 on the hexagon cell lines; colour 1 on the sole and heel-cap surround; colour 2 on the toe cap and heel block.

Female/F_Footr_Steelarachnid_01.description: A right-foot mechanical armoured boot: segmented plated shin guard rising to a pointed back fin, with slim vent slits, layered ankle plates and a sharp pointed toe cap. Sci-fi style, sitting over the lower leg and foot.
Female/F_Footr_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin and foot plates; colour 1 on the slit accents down the shin; colour 2 on the ankle panels and back fin; colour 3 on the small marks near the knee.

Female/F_Footr_Steelcommando_01.description: A right ankle-high sci-fi boot with a smooth rounded toe, a glossy panel down the front of the shaft outlined by a raised border, a thin strap across the instep, and a chunky sculpted sole.
Female/F_Footr_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and toe; colour 1 on the sole, instep strap and back of the shaft; colour 2 on the glossy front panel and inner sides; colour 3 on the border around the front panel.

Female/F_Footr_Swan_01.description: A low, ankle-high shoe with a long rounded toe, a chunky sole and a heel block at the back. A pointed contrasting panel runs up the instep, giving a simple sporty, sleek look.
Female/F_Footr_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and side upper; colour 1 on the toe cap and front of the shoe; colour 3 on the pointed instep panel; colour 2 on the sole and heel block.

Female/F_Footr_Swing_01.description: A short ankle boot with a rounded, bulbous toe cap, low flat heel and a thick sole. A contrasting strap with a small buckle wraps the ankle, with two small studs on the front and thin line detailing on the back.
Female/F_Footr_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the toe cap and sole; colour 2 on the ankle strap and line trim; colour 3 on the buckle and small studs.

Female/F_Footr_Swing_02.description: A right ankle boot with a tall, slightly crinkled soft shaft, a broad rounded toe cap and a low flat heel. A contrasting fan-shaped plate sits at the front of the ankle, with a small triangular emblem on the back of the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the toe cap and lower foot; colour 3 on the sole and heel; colour 2 on the fan-shaped ankle plate and heel emblem.

Female/F_Footr_Tactical_01.description: A low-cut angular sneaker with a chunky faceted upper, a slim contrasting stripe band along the side, a thick separate sole and a short padded ankle opening. Sits on the right foot in a sporty sci-fi style.
Female/F_Footr_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper panels; colour 3 on the stripe band along the side; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the ankle collar.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_01_Shortboot.description: A plain, smooth, close-fitting ankle boot for the right foot: a low tube hugging the ankle and foot with a rounded toe and no visible seams, fasteners or sole detail.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_01_Shortboot.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_2toes_01.description: A bare, skin-toned right foot reshaped into a two-toed, hoof-like form: the foot ends in two short rounded toes with small pointed nails, and it stops at the ankle. Suggests a beast or monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_2toes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 and colour 0 on the small nail tips of the two toes; the foot itself shows skin and takes no test colour.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_90s_Boot_01.description: A knee-high mechanical boot with segmented armoured shin plating, a large curved plate at the front of the upper shin, a low soft foot section, and contrasting double straps with small studs around the back of the calf.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_90s_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin and calf casing; colour 1 on the front shin plate and the foot section; colour 2 on the calf straps; colour 3 on the small studs and lights.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A right boot with a segmented, armored shin and a contrasting-toed foot, with a swept-back cuff at the top and a row of curved blade-like spikes along the outer side of the calf. It suggests a 90s superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot, front shin plate, cuff and spikes; colour 1 on the calf sides, ankle trim and top cuff; colour 2 on the toe cap and the front shin panel; colour 3 on the calf band and side panel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The female boot fits closely to the slimmer leg and ends in a raised high-heeled shape at the back, while the male boot is a bulkier flat-soled boot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A right-leg piece with a segmented, ribbed leg sheath from mid-thigh to ankle, a rounded knee guard, a chunky electronic strap module with indicator lights at the thigh, and a high-heeled boot with contrasting toe cap.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed leg segments and toe cap; colour 1 on the knee guard, band above the calf and boot; colour 2 on the thigh module and strap; colour 3 on the indicator lights.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.differs: The female version ends in a high-heeled boot, while the male has a flat-soled boot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aberrant_01.description: A bulbous, monstrous right foot that swells out from the ankle like a fleshy stump, with wrinkled skin, contrasting pore-like holes and crystalline toe-like growths at the front. Suggests an alien mutant limb.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aberrant_01.colourAreas: The piece keeps its own skin-like texture, so the colour scheme has little visible effect; the crystal toe growths show a bluish tint that does not clearly map to a slot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Alien_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a clawed alien paw: a smooth, rounded ankle-high foot piece ending in three large pointed talons at the toes. Suggests a monstrous creature foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and ankle covering; colour 1 on the three talons.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.description: Right calf-high alien gladiator boot built from stacked overlapping segmented plates with rows of glyph-like engraved markings, a row of studs up the front, a pointed ridged toe cap and a strap across the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stacked calf plates and toe cap; colour 3 on the glyph markings; colour 1 on the sole upper and ankle strap area; colour 2 on the sole and gaps between plates.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.differs: The female boot has a more tapered, slender calf shell with a more pointed toe than the male version.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A single lower-leg guard worn on the right shin and calf: a tapered sleeve with two buckled straps, a hard angular front plate with a raised rim, and a pointed back peak at the top.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main sleeve; colour 1 on the plate rim, top and bottom edges and top cap; colour 0 on the recessed front plate; colour 2 on the two straps.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Amazon_01.differs: The female version is a shin and calf guard with an angular front plate and buckled straps, while the male version is a low shoe.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Amazon_02.description: A shin guard worn on the right lower leg: a rounded tapered shell with a pointed, framed front plate divided into windowed panels, two buckled straps around the calf, and flared rim edges top and bottom.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 1 on the frame, rim edges and buckles; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 0 on the recessed front panels.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Amazon_03.description: A right-foot shoe with a short ankle-high shaft, a padded rounded cuff, and a low flat sole. Layered banded plates cover the toe and instep, giving a chunky, cartoonish armoured-sneaker look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Amazon_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented toe and instep plates; colour 3 on the ankle shaft; colour 1 on the top cuff; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ankle_01.description: A short, simple ankle boot with a rounded body, a thin flat sole and a separate band around the ankle opening. A contrasting patch covers the toe. Plain, low-profile footwear that suits casual or superhero looks.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ankle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and toe patch; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Defende.description: A right mid-calf superhero boot with a flared cuff, glossy toe and foot section, and banded ribbed panels down the shin and calf outlined with thin piping. Retro, armoured-looking design with a flat sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Defende.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cuff and toe cap; colour 0 on the glossy foot and upper shin plates; colour 2 on the ribbed calf and shin panels; colour 3 on the thin piping outlines.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Nightha.description: A single calf-high superhero boot with a smooth, slightly flared shaft that dips at the front, a chunky treaded sole, a contrasting toe cap with a swooping side stripe, and a row of small fin-like spikes along the outer side.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Nightha.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and upper; colour 3 on the toe cap; colour 1 on the swooping side stripe; colour 2 on the sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Nightha.differs: The female boot has a slightly taller, narrower shaft and its outer spikes sit a little lower on the side; the male boot is shorter and looser.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcr.description: A soft, slouchy ankle shoe with a rounded toe, wrinkled leather-like upper, a pointed flap at the heel and a side opening showing the lining, set on a thin contrasting sole edge. Suits witchy or fantasy looks.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper and stitched seams; colour 2 on the inner lining and the shaded back of the shoe; colour 3 on the sole edge and the heel flap trim.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A right boot with a tall shin-guard shell, segmented banded plates, a row of curved fin-like spines along the outer edge, and a rounded low-cut foot with a pointed upturned toe and contrasting trim bands.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf shell and spines; colour 1 on the thin stripes across the calf; colour 2 on the top cap and edge plates; colour 3 on the foot section.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A low, ankle-high right shoe with a smooth rounded upper, a thick flat sole and a pointed toe. Layered ridged bands wrap the ankle above a separate coloured stripe, giving a sleek aquatic look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper; colour 1 on the sole; colour 3 on the stripe around the ankle; colour 2 on the ridged bands, the top cuff and the sole edge.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_03.description: A close-fitting ankle-high foot covering with a scaly, net-like reptilian pattern, and a glossy strip running diagonally from the ankle down across the instep to the toe. Suggests aquatic or creature-themed tights.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base scaly surface between the cells; colour 1 on the scale cell pattern; colour 2 on the glossy diagonal strip.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_04.description: A close-fitting ankle-high foot covering with a scaly, net-like patterned upper over the foot and instep, and a smooth separate panel wrapping the heel and back of the ankle. Suggests aquatic, creature-skin styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gaps between the scale cells; colour 1 on the scale cells across the foot and instep; colour 3 on the smooth heel and back panel; colour 2 on the thin seam between panels.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A calf-length boot with a smooth flat sole and a pointed dip-and-peak upper edge. Swirling scroll patterns run up the shaft, with rounded gem-like studs on each side of the shin. Arcane, fantasy styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 3 on the swirling scroll patterns; colour 1 on the rounded side studs; colour 2 on the pointed inner cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Archer_01.description: A soft, mid-calf right boot with a slouchy, wrinkled shaft, a softly pointed toe and a thin sole. A separate flared cuff with notched edges sits around the top, giving a casual archer or adventurer look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe; colour 2 on the top cuff; colour 1 on the sole edge.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armor_Ancientarmor_.description: A single right calf-high armored boot with a mottled, stone-like foot and a rigid greave carrying engraved chevron channels, a flared pointed top edge, and two strap bands around the calf and ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armor_Ancientarmor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled boot body and greave plating; colour 1 on the engraved channel inlays; colour 3 on the two straps and the small side clasp; colour 2 on the rear calf panel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_01.description: A right-foot armored boot with a pointed toe, segmented plates and trim lines over the foot, and a tall shin guard. A snarling monstrous face with an open mouth and fangs sits at the front, and a strap wraps the calf.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot plates and face; colour 1 on the edge trim and plate lines; colour 2 on the straps and fangs; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_01.differs: The female boot is slimmer with a shorter, blunter toe and a taller shin guard.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_02.description: A low armored shoe for the right foot with a pointed, tapering toe, segmented plates over the instep, a raised angular cuff at the ankle, and small rivets along the sides and heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates of the shoe and cuff; colour 1 on the trim lines, bands and cuff edging; colour 2 not visible; colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armorblackpaladin_0.description: A right knight-style armoured boot reaching below the knee, with a flared kneecap-like cuff studded with small spikes, segmented shin panels, a spiked ankle band and a rounded pointed toe cap.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armorblackpaladin_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee guard, toe and sole; colour 1 on the upper shin, calf and ankle band with spikes; colour 2 on the lower calf band; colour 3 on the rear heel panel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armorblackpaladin_0.differs: The female boot is slimmer, with a smaller knee cuff and a narrower, more pointed toe than the male version.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armorninja.description: A right-foot ninja-style armoured boot with a split-toe tabi foot, a segmented shin guard and a bulky rounded knee cup that ends in a curved blade spur. Angular plates sit over a slim ankle strap.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot, shin plates and spur; colour 1 on the knee cup, ankle strap and plate edges; colour 2 on the shin and ankle inserts; colour 3 on the knee panel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armorninja.differs: The female boot has a sleeker, more segmented lower leg with contrasting inserts and a contrasting panel on the knee, where the male has bulkier plates.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi armored boot made of angular segmented plates, with a raised rim at the top, a vented panel behind the calf, a contrasting tubular booster column down the heel, and a thin sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and toe; colour 1 on the sole, top rim accent and heel trim; colour 2 on the rear booster column; colour 3 on the small vent slits.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A low, close-fitting shoe-like foot covering that ends at the ankle, with a thin cuff at the top and raised, swooping outlined panels across the toe, instep and heel. It gives a sleek, sporty sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the inset panels over the toe, instep and heel; colour 3 on the raised outlines around the panels; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A low, ankle-height sporty shoe-boot covering the right foot, with a rounded toe cap, swooping curved panels along the side and a thin raised outline on every seam; sleek and form-fitting, in a sci-fi superhero style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel and rear sole panel; colour 1 on the toe cap, ankle cuff and front panels; colour 2 on the swooping side and ankle panels; colour 3 on the outline piping.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ball_01.description: A faceted spherical ball that replaces the right foot, capped by a short cylindrical cuff band at the ankle. A simple, low-poly mechanical or monstrous stump-foot with a rounded, blocky silhouette.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ball; colour 1 on the ankle cuff band.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Banded_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting calf-length boot with a thick, chunky octagonal cuff around the top and a contrasting toe cap. It is a plain, simple boot in a sleek, slightly mechanical style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Banded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the top cuff and the toe cap.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bare_01.description: A bare right foot with sculpted toes and small toenails, ending at the ankle so the tights leg meets it. Reads as plain skin with no footwear, for barefoot looks.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bare_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toenails; the foot skin does not take a colour slot from the scheme.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bare_Tiptoes_01.description: A bare right foot in an arched, tiptoe pose, with the heel raised and toes pointing down. It is sculpted with individual toes and painted toenails and ends at the ankle, so it suits barefoot looks.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bare_Tiptoes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toenails; the rest of the foot is a fixed skin tone and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bear_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a bear paw: a smooth rounded foot with four contrasting claws at the toes, rising into a cuff of long jagged fur spikes that reach up the ankle and lower calf.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower fur; colour 1 on the upper fur spikes, blending in a gradient; colour 2 on the claws.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bear_01.differs: The female paw has longer, taller fur spikes that reach higher up the calf and a slimmer ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.description: A beast-like right foot covering shaped like a rhino hoof: a rounded, wrinkled hide foot with a shaded gradient up the ankle and three broad, blunt toe hooves at the front.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toe hooves; the hide portion keeps its own skin-like texture and ignores the colour scheme.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.differs: Shows three toe hooves across the front, and the foot is narrower.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.description: A right-foot wolf paw covering: a tapered, digitigrade lower leg that ends in a clawed paw with toe pads, topped by a ragged crest of jagged fur tufts just below the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw and lower leg; colour 1 on the upper fur tufts and toe pads; colour 2 on the tips of the fur spikes; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.description: A tapered wolf-fur calf wrap for the right leg, narrow at the ankle and flaring upward into a shaggy mass of jagged, pointed tufts that reach just below the knee. Feral, beastly look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fur near the ankle; colour 1 on the main body of the fur; colour 2 on the spiky tuft tips, with a gradient blending between them.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.differs: The female tufts form a fuller, bushier crown around the top of the calf, while the male has taller, more upright spikes at the front.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Small_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: a rounded, low-cut shoe with separated toe bulges, small spiky ridges across the top and pointed claws extending past the toes. Suggests a wolf or monster.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body; colour 1 on the small spikes across the top of the foot; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A right lower-leg piece that replaces the foot with a scaly bird leg and talon foot with long curved claws, topped by a tall angular greave with a rounded knee guard and a trim rim below the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the greave and the cuff at the ankle joint; colour 2 on the rim and the knee guard detail; colour 0 on the claws; the scaly bird skin ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The female version has a fitted, armored greave rising to the knee with a guard, while the male version has a loose baggy trouser cover over the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A right lower-leg cover with a loose, baggy shin sleeve ending in a bird-like scaly talon foot with long curved claws. A small angular cuff with a pointed front flap sits below the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the loose leg sleeve; colour 2 on the top cuff and flap; colour 1 on the claws. The talon foot skin keeps its own fleshy tone regardless of the scheme.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_03.description: A right foot shaped like a bird's or reptile's talon: scaly, ridged skin over the foot and ankle, with three long curved claws at the front and a short rear spur. It replaces the bare foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the scaly skin of the foot does not appear to follow the colour scheme and shows its own skin tone.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A chunky, angular low-top sneaker-boot with a faceted upper, a wide flat contrasting sole with an angled edge, a recessed panel down the instep, a raised tab at the heel and an inset panel at the back.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper; colour 1 on the sole rim and heel tab; colour 2 on the instep panel; colour 3 on the inset heel panel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A chunky, angular low shoe with a faceted rounded toe cap, a thin raised sole rim, and a short armoured ankle cuff. A round disc-like module sits on each side of the ankle. Mechanical, sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and sole rim; colour 1 on the toe cap and heel panel; colour 2 on the mid-foot panel and the disc housings; colour 3 on the centres of the ankle discs.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: A mechanical prosthetic lower leg replacing the right calf and foot: a padded cuff below the knee with a gauge dial, banded segmented housing, and a thin strut ending in a curved blade-like runner.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded cuff top and strut brackets; colour 2 on the cuff body and gauge housing; colour 1 on the bands and the curved runner; colour 3 on small studs and indicator lights.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bobbysock_01.description: A low block-heeled Mary Jane style shoe with a rounded toe and a broad instep strap, topped by a ruffled lace-edged ankle cuff. Sits on the right foot and ankle; cute, retro and dressy.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bobbysock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the instep strap and the lace cuff; colour 2 on the heel and sole; colour 3 on the inner heel edge.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bobbysock_02.description: A right-foot heeled shoe with a pointed, angular toe and a thick block heel, topped by a short crumpled ankle cuff. Low-poly, chunky construction sitting on the foot and ankle; suits casual or street looks.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bobbysock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body, sole and heel; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the small patch at the back of the cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.description: A short pointed-toe ankle boot on a tall stiletto heel, with two parallel buckled straps across the instep and a wide contrasting band wrapping the ankle. It has a sleek, fashion-forward look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 2 on the straps and ankle band; colour 3 on the buckles; colour 1 on the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.differs: The female boot is a short ankle boot with a tall stiletto heel, while the male version is a taller calf-height boot with a low heel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armo.description: A right-leg mechanical armored boot reaching to just below the knee, built from angular segmented plates with a raised pointed knee-top guard, a strap band at the ankle and a toothed, treaded sole with a contrasting toe cap.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower shin plates, ankle band and sole; colour 1 on the upper shin panel and the foot upper; colour 3 on the toe cap; colour 2 on the recessed shin and heel gaps.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armo.differs: The female boot is slimmer and taller, with a narrower shin and a smaller foot section.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.description: A tall mechanical boot with segmented armor plates up the shin, a vented cap at the top of the calf, a plated strap over the instep and a chunky sole. Ribbed cables loop down each side of the leg.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plates and foot; colour 1 on the vented top cap and the recessed side panels; colour 2 on the cables and sole; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.differs: The female boot is taller and slimmer, running higher up the calf with longer cables that hang loose beside the leg.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Madjester_01.description: A right ankle boot with a chunky treaded platform sole, rounded toe and slightly slouched cuff. Crossed front lacing runs between two strap tabs with round studs, giving a punky, playful look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and cuff; colour 1 on the criss-cross laces; colour 2 on the platform sole; colour 3 on the round studs on the straps.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Spurs_01.description: A mid-calf cowboy boot with a slouched, wrinkled shaft that has a scooped, contrasting top edge, a textured textured-hide foot, a chunky stacked heel, and a strap with a buckle across the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Spurs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft; colour 1 on the foot and toe; colour 2 on the top edge, ankle strap, sole and heel; colour 3 on the buckles.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Steampunk_Rock.description: A right ankle boot with a pointed toe, a stiletto-style heel and criss-cross lacing up the front, trimmed with riveted panel edges. A cylindrical rocket thruster canister is strapped to the back of the ankle and calf, with vent slots.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Boot_Steampunk_Rock.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the toe cap, heel and thruster casing; colour 2 on the lacing and outline trim; colour 3 on the thruster vent panels.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bootsole_01.description: A plain, smooth calf-length boot with a straight tube shaft ending just below the knee, a rounded toe and a thick flat sole with a low heel. Simple, clean superhero styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bootsole_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; the thick sole edge also takes colour 0 on this sheet.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bootsole_02.description: A short, snug ankle boot with a smooth upper ending just above the ankle, a slightly pointed toe and a thick flat sole with a small raised heel block. Plain, simple everyday footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bootsole_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and sole; the sole edge shows a slightly lighter rim; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bowtie_01.description: A mid-calf boot with a flared, cuffed top and a soft rounded toe, wrapped by a strap at the calf and finished with a large ribbon bow with trailing tails on the front. Cute magical-girl styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot foot, cuff, strap and bow; colour 1 on the lower shaft panels and bow knot; colour 2 on the upper shaft and back panels; colour 3 on the small panel at the back of the lower leg.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Brutal_01.description: An open toe-post sandal with a thick braided-rope edged sole and a wide gathered wrap strap across the instep, plus a heel strap; the toes and heel stay bare. Casual, tribal look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered instep wrap and heel strap; colour 1 on the sole's inner footbed; colour 2 on the braided sole edge and toe post.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The toe post is a contrasting thin loop between the toes, and the wrap sits slightly higher and tighter over the foot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bull_01.description: A cloven hoof foot piece: a chunky, blocky hoof with a split down the front, topped by a short shaggy fur cuff at the ankle. Suggests a beast or monster leg.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaggy fur cuff, with colour 2 streaks in the fur; colour 3 on the hoof.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Calflaced_01.description: A knee-high boot with a small stacked heel and pointed toe, laced up the front with criss-crossed laces through eyelets, and a contrasting tongue panel at the top. Victorian-flavoured, sits on the right foot and lower leg.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Calflaced_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and heel; colour 1 on the laces; colour 3 on the eyelets; colour 2 on the tongue panel at the top.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, angular right boot made of flat cardboard-like panels: a tall shin guard with a slanted flap at the top, a front slit showing a separate panel, and a rounded low foot with a strap tab over the instep.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and outer shin panels; colour 1 on the curved side panels and small foot accents; colour 2 on the front slit panel; colour 3 on the band above the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cardboard_01.differs: The female version has a narrower, taller shin section with a more tapered calf.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A furry beast-foot covering for the right foot: a shaggy, tufted foot with a cloven hoof tip split in two, and small dewclaw-like spurs at the back of the ankle. Ends just above the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur; colour 1 on the split hoof tips and the rear dewclaws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A monstrous clawed foot covering: a short ankle-height sleeve of pebbled, reptilian hide with a ridge of overlapping scales across the top of the foot and four sharp curved talons at the toes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pebbled hide of the sole, heel and sides; colour 1 on the scaled plates across the top of the foot; colour 3 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.description: A low, smooth shoe that covers the foot and stops at the ankle, with a contrasting swooping trim band around the ankle opening and a curved slash accent on the side. Sleek superhero footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shoe body; colour 2 on the ankle trim band and the curved side accent.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.description: A close-fitting tights foot covering for the right foot, ending just above the ankle, with wavy abstract stripes that sweep from the ankle down over the toes. Reads as a plain skin-tight sock or sleek boot base.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the foot covering; colour 1 on the wavy stripes; colour 2 on the stripes between them.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.differs: The female version has narrower stripes with a more curved sweep, and the front of the foot is mostly striped rather than mainly plain.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.description: A low, smooth ankle-high foot covering that wraps the whole right foot like a sleek bootie, with a small pointed V-shaped webbing accent at the ankle front and back. Suits a superhero or sci-fi tights look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot covering; colour 2 on the V-shaped webbing accents at the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.description: A right foot covering shaped like a low ankle sock-shoe, hugging the whole foot up to the ankle. Two thin bands circle the ankle and two contrasting stripes run from the ankle over the toe. Sporty, sleek look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot covering; colour 1 on the two ankle bands; colour 2 on the stripes running down the top of the foot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Colossus_01.description: A monstrous right foot and lower-leg covering built from chunky cracked stone-like plates, rising to a calf-height point at the back and ending in large clawed talons at the toes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cracked stone plates; colour 3 on the crack lines between plates; colour 1 on the claws and the small spikes along the side.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Combatluchador_Doll.description: A knee-high luchador-style wrestling boot with front lacing up the shin, a wide contrasting cuff at the top, a thick rimmed sole, and large dollar-sign graphics on the toe and along the outer calf.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Combatluchador_Doll.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff, laces and sole rim; colour 2 on the dollar-sign graphics and lace eyelets.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.description: A mid-calf combat boot with a light sneaker-style shoe and a tall armored shin guard on the front, a padded panel below the knee, and a strap plate at the ankle. Sporty sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe and the leg fabric; colour 1 on the shin guard, rear calf plate and ankle strap plate; colour 2 on the sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.differs: The female version has a narrower, taller shin plate that shows more of the leg fabric at the sides, and a lighter, slimmer shoe.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Combatsock_01.description: An ankle-high hiking boot with soft wrinkled leather uppers, a laced front opening, a flared collar and a thick chunky sole, worn over a ribbed sock cuff that rises above the top of the boot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Combatsock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the ribbed sock cuff; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.description: A mid-calf western cowboy boot with a pointed toe, a stacked heel and a scooped, pointed top edge with two pull tabs. Decorative stitched feather-like patterns run up the shaft, and a strap at the ankle carries a spiked spur.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top trim, ankle strap, heel and sole edge; colour 3 on the spur and its ankle buttons; colour 2 on the stitched line patterns.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.description: A tall western cowboy boot reaching below the knee, with a pointed toe, stacked heel, V-dipped top edge with contrasting trim, two pull-straps and stitched flame-like decoration up the shaft.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top trim, heel and sole edge; colour 2 on the stitching lines.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.differs: The female boot has a taller, narrower shaft that reaches nearer the knee.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Heeled_01.description: A mid-calf western cowboy boot with a pointed toe, tall high-heeled block heel, stitched feather-like swirl patterns on the shaft, a scooped contrasting top edge with pull loops, and a strapped ankle band carrying a rowel spur.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Heeled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the top trim, ankle strap, heel and sole edge; colour 3 on the spur and the strap medallion; colour 2 on the stitched line patterns.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Heeled_02.description: A knee-high cowboy boot with a pointed toe, tapered high heel, and a scooped, V-notched top edge with pull-loops. Decorative stitched flame-like patterns run up the shaft, and trim edges the opening and sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Heeled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the top-edge trim, sole edge and heel; the stitched pattern is fine line detail.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Short_01.description: A short ankle-height western cowboy boot with a pointed toe and small stacked heel, wrapped by a wide contrasting ankle strap with a round concho and a spiked rowel spur extending from the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle strap, sole edge and heel; colour 3 on the spur, its rowel and the round concho.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Short_02.description: A short ankle-high cowboy boot with a smooth pointed toe, a low stacked heel and a small notched pull-tab detail at the top of the shaft. It sits on the right foot with a western feel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Short_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the sole and heel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_01.description: A mid-calf cowboy-style boot with a smooth shaft, a long pointed toe and a small heel. A strap with a round stud circles the ankle, and swirling scroll patterns decorate the sides of the shaft.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the round stud at the ankle; colour 3 on the swirling scroll patterns and the lines around the shaft.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_02.description: A calf-high western-style boot with a pointed toe, swirling scroll patterns and thin lines along the shaft, a strap around the ankle with a round buckle, and a spiked spur wheel on the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 3 on the swirl and line decoration; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the spur and buckle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_02.differs: The spur on this female boot sits on the outer side of the heel and points backward, and the shaft is slightly shorter.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_Short_0.description: A short ankle boot with a smooth, slightly pointed toe, a low stacked heel and a short cuff. A diagonal strap wraps the ankle and fastens at a round side disc, giving a robotic cowboy look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_Short_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and sole; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the round side discs.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cross_01.description: A smooth, snug mid-calf boot with a thick faceted cuff at the top, a contrasting toe cap, and a small cross-shaped mechanical plate mounted on a raised panel down the front of the shin.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cross_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff and toe cap; colour 3 on the raised shin panel; colour 2 on the cross-shaped plate.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A right ankle-high sneaker-style boot with a rounded toe cap, angular panelled ankle cuff with etched line details, a thick sole, and small dot accents on the toe. Sleek, futuristic sportswear look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap and heel panel edges; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the small dots on the toe.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cyberlord_01.description: A bulky, angular mechanical right boot shaped like a tapered armoured greave, with a banded ankle collar, small round side sensor lights and a forked, clawed toe. Suggests a monstrous cyborg or robotic style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cyberlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the greave shell and claw toes; colour 1 on the ankle band and a side strip; colour 3 on the round side lights; colour 2 on the heel tip.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: A low, split-toe cyberpunk boot on a chunky platform sole, with a wide ankle cuff, round mechanical discs on each side of the ankle and two separate angular toe caps. Sits on the right foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and toe-top panels; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and toe caps; colour 2 on the sole and disc rims; colour 3 on the disc centres.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A right-leg cybernetic boot-legging: a fitted shin-length leg sleeve with a rimmed kneecap plate holding a round sensor node, plus an ankle boot with strapped bands and a chunky high heel. Sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the leg sleeve; colour 0 on the boot upper and knee plate backing; colour 1 on the rims, straps, and heel; colour 3 on the round knee nodes and small accents.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.differs: The female boot has a raised chunky heel, while the male boot has a low flat heel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Defender_01.description: A right calf-high superhero boot with a smooth shaft, pointed winged flares at the top of the calf, and slashed accent cuts on the outer flare. It ends in a strapped, rubber-capped sneaker-style foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and flared cuff; colour 1 on the shoe upper and toe strap; colour 2 on the toe cap and sole; colour 3 on the slashed accents in the cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Deity_01.description: A low, chunky ankle shoe with a thick flat sole, a rounded toe cap, a separate side panel and a tall heel section. Simple, stylised and slightly cartoonish, it covers just the right foot and ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the heel and back panel; colour 3 on the toe cap.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A right mid-calf boot with a smooth fabric-like shaft, a peaked front edge and thin contrasting bands crossing the shin and running down the back. It ends in a soft pointed toe with a separate segmented toe plate.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 2 on the crossing bands and edge trim; colour 0 on the thin inner top lining.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Destroyer_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, sharper peak at the front of the shaft and a smaller, less plated toe.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A right mechanical armoured boot reaching just below the knee, with a smooth shin shell, a front strip of segmented plates, a flared pointed cuff studded with small spikes, and a segmented plated foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin shell and cuff; colour 1 on the segmented front strip and the foot plates; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1.description: A right calf-high boot with a smooth tapered shaft, a segmented ribbed panel down the front of the shin, a plated segmented toe, and a flared upturned cuff at the top studded with small spikes. Sci-fi armoured look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and flared cuff; colour 1 on the segmented shin panel and the toe section; colour 2 on the small spikes.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1_1.description: A right calf-high armoured boot in a sci-fi style, with a smooth shin shell, a segmented front strip, a segmented toe cap, and a flared top rim that peaks at the front with small spikes on each side.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf shell and flared cuff; colour 1 on the segmented front strip and the boot foot; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A mechanical armored boot with a chunky octagonal cuff at the top of the shin, a curved front shin plate, a segmented ribbed panel down the calf, and a low sneaker-style foot with lace-like bands and a contrasting sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, shin plate and boot upper; colour 0 on the ribbed calf panel and lace bands; colour 2 on the strap slots and rib lines; colour 3 on the sole edge.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Dharmor_01.differs: The female version has a slimmer, more tapered shin plate and a narrower boot than the male version's bulkier one.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A cartoonish dinosaur-foot covering for the right foot: a puffy rounded paw with wrinkled creases, three curved claws at the toes, and a thick fluffy cuff around the ankle. Playful costume style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot body; colour 1 on the claws; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Drka_01.description: A right-foot sandal greave: a plated shin guard with a raised curved front blade and open latticed back, held by padded ankle and calf straps, over an open sandal sole with clawed talons at the toes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plates and toe strap panel; colour 1 on the padded straps and sandal sole; colour 2 on the talons.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Dual_Claw_02.description: A bare-skinned, clawed beast foot for the right side: a wrinkled, rounded foot shape with two long curved talons pointing forward and outward, plus a small spur at the heel. Suits monstrous or bestial looks.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Dual_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skin-like foot and ankle; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Dual_Claw_03.description: A bare, skin-textured monstrous right foot with a short ankle cuff and two long curved talons at the toes, plus a few small spikes near the top of the foot. Reads as a beast or Halloween creature foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Dual_Claw_03.colourAreas: Skin colour is fixed and ignores the scheme; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.description: A knee-high gladiator-style sandal: a flat sole with toe and instep straps, and a cage of vertical and horizontal straps laced up the calf, with small rings at the top edge. Ancient, Egyptian-inspired look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole and straps; colour 1 on the small rings and connecting fasteners at the strap junctions.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_02.description: A flat gladiator-style sandal with a thin sole and several narrow straps crossing the instep, a strap band around the ankle, and a solid heel cup at the back. Egyptian-inspired and open-toed.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole, straps and heel cup; colour 1 on the small ties at the ankle strap.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A calf-high retro-futuristic boot with a smooth plated shaft, grooved seam lines, a raised front spine with contrasting edging, a small flared fin on the outer side, and a rounded sneaker-like toe.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft plates and sole; colour 1 on the toe cap, front trim and top edge; colour 2 on the groove lines.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.differs: The female boot has a slimmer, more tapered shaft that is open at the front, with a narrow front spine, where the male boot has a wider, fuller shaft.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Extra_Winged_01.description: A pair of small feathered wings attached at the ankle, one on each side of the lower leg, each with a curved spar sweeping upward and layered feathers fanning back. Fantasy, superhero-style ankle wings.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Extra_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers; colour 1 on the curved wing spars and ankle mounts.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A right boot with a chunky rounded foot and a ribbed shin guard strapped on behind by three straps. A studded toe plate and a spiky feather-like fringe at the top edge give it a sci-fi, monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ribbed shin guard and the studded toe plate; colour 2 on the straps and sole stripes; colour 3 on the feather fringe at the top.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Feathers_02.description: A short ankle boot with a soft, puckered rounded shaft and a thick sole. A studded, dimpled plate sits over the instep, held by straps that wrap around the foot. Suggests a sci-fi or creature-inspired look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Feathers_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the dimpled instep plate; colour 2 on the straps and sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Feathers_02.differs: The female boot has straps that run more steeply down the sides of the foot, so the toe looks less open, and the plate is smaller.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A short, chunky ankle boot with a rounded toe, a thick sole with contrasting edge trim, a raised strap panel on the side, a padded heel block and a tall trimmed cuff with a vertical stripe. Sporty superhero style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the side strap panel and heel surround; colour 3 on the sole edge, cuff trim and stripe; colour 2 on the heel pad.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Flared_01.description: A right knee-high boot with a smooth, snug shaft and a low flat sole, closed by a thin seam down the back. The top is a flared cuff with pointed, upswept peaks. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the flared cuff; colour 2 on the seam line.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Flared_01.differs: The female boot is taller and slimmer through the shaft, with a longer, narrower foot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Flipper_01.description: A single swim-fin style foot piece: a snug ankle sock with a contrasting foot pocket and a long flat splayed blade extending forward past the toes. Aquatic, playful look worn on the right foot only.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Flipper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle sock; colour 2 on the foot pocket opening; colour 1 on the fin blade and sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Flower_01.description: A right ankle boot with a smooth rounded foot and a flower-like starburst at the toe. Ankle bands hold a cuff of jagged, shard-like leaf panels that flare into spikes above the ankle. Fantasy nature-creature style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot foot and the spiky tips; colour 1 on the cuff panels, ankle bands and toe swirl; colour 2 on the leaf shards; colour 3 on the small accents and toe stripe.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Folded_01.description: A slim, calf-length boot with a smooth tapered shaft and a wide folded-over cuff at the top, with a faceted rim. The toe has a separate contrasting cap. Suggests a pirate or fantasy look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Folded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and folded cuff; colour 1 on the toe cap and the inner lining of the cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Folded_01.differs: The female boot has a slim, tapered shaft with a smaller cuff, and the inside of the cuff is barely visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Folded_Heel_01.description: A single high-heeled ankle boot with a pointed toe and slim stiletto heel, a narrow shaft, and a wide folded-over cuff at the top. It sits on the right foot and lower calf, with a sleek, stylish look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Folded_Heel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the folded cuff exterior and the toe cap; colour 1 on the boot foot and the inner cuff; colour 2 on the narrow shaft; colour 3 on the heel-side panel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Furdogz_01.description: A calf-high boot with a smooth sneaker-style foot, a rounded studded toe cap, two strapped bands with small square buckles on the shin, and a shaggy fur cuff around the top. Casual, sporty look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Furdogz_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the toe cap and the two shin bands; colour 2 on the fur cuff; colour 3 on the buckles and toe studs.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Furlined_01.description: A soft, slouchy mid-calf boot in wrinkled cloth-like material with a rounded toe and a thick, folded-over cuff at the top. Sits below the knee and suggests a casual, superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Furlined_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the folded top cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A calf-high armored right boot with a smooth plated shaft, rows of cone spikes down the outer side, a pointed shin fin at the top, strapped ankle bands and a long spiked toe. Gladiator-style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot plates; colour 1 on the top rim, ankle straps and sole edge; colour 3 on the spikes and studs; colour 2 on the toe spike, shin fin and heel block.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The female boot has fewer, smaller spikes lined along the outer edge and a slimmer shaft.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Glass_Slipper_01.description: A single translucent glass high-heeled pump with a pointed toe and thin stiletto heel, worn on the right foot. The clear shell shows the bare foot and toes through it, giving a fairytale, elegant look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Glass_Slipper_01.colourAreas: The glass material ignores the colour scheme, so no slot visibly changes it; the toenails show a faint tint but no clear slot assignment.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Glow_01.description: A low, ankle-high sneaker-style shoe with a textured dimpled surface, a large panel over the instep, a capped toe, round ankle discs and thin lines running along the sides in a Y pattern. Sporty, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the instep panel, toe cap, heel patch and ankle discs; colour 3 on the thin line details; colour 2 on the outlines around the panels.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A thigh-high, form-fitting high-heeled boot with a smooth, sleek shaft and a slim stiletto heel, finished with a flared, folded cuff at the top of the thigh. Retro pin-up superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft, foot and heel; colour 1 on the flared cuff at the top.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Golden_Age_02.description: A right ankle boot with a pointed toe and a slim stiletto heel, topped by a wide, slightly crumpled folded cuff at the ankle. A retro, pin-up superhero look that stops just above the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Golden_Age_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and heel; colour 1 on the folded ankle cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Gravitar_01.description: A single thigh-high boot for the right leg: smooth, close-fitting leg shaft rising to the upper thigh with a thin banded top edge and small buckle, a flared ankle cuff, and a rounded toe on a chunky heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Gravitar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leg shaft, ankle cuff and upper boot; colour 1 on the sole and heel; colour 2 on the small buckle on the top band.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Greave_01.description: A right-leg greave and low shoe: a smooth, tapered shin guard with a flared, scooped upper edge and thin rim, ending above the ankle, over a soft flat-soled shoe. Sleek, minimal armor look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Greave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the greave shell and rim; colour 1 on the shoe; colour 3 on the small tab outlines at the top and ankle of the greave back.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Greave_Extra_Winged.description: A pair of small feathered wings attached at the lower calf and ankle of the right leg, one on each side, sweeping upward and outward with curved spars and layered feathers. Suggests a winged-boot, mythic superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Greave_Extra_Winged.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved wing spars and bases; colour 0 on the feathers.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Harajuku_Boot_01.description: A calf-high right boot with a thick layered platform sole, an octagonal trimmed top edge, a zip running diagonally up the shin, and an ankle strap with a ring at the side. Casual, sporty street style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Harajuku_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top trim, ankle strap and diagonal piping; colour 3 on the platform sole; colour 2 on the zip pull.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Harajuku_Slipper_01.description: A high-heeled T-strap pump with a rounded toe, slim stiletto heel, buckled ankle strap and a vertical strap down the instep. A large bow sits at the toe, and the inner panel has a polka-dot pattern. Cute, retro-pop style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Harajuku_Slipper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe body, heel and straps; colour 3 on the bow and the inner panel; colour 0 on the polka dots; colour 2 on the heel and sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Harajuku_Slipper_St.description: A single thigh-high patterned stocking with a folded cuff at the top, bands of checks, stripes and polka dots down the leg, worn with a T-strap high-heeled shoe finished with small bows. Playful Harajuku street style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Harajuku_Slipper_St.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stocking's checks, stripes and dots; colour 3 on the folded cuff, stocking dots and the shoe bows; colour 1 on the shoe and its T-strap.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Heel_01.description: A single ankle-high pump-style high-heel shoe with a smooth pointed toe, a closed rounded heel cup and a slim tapered stiletto heel. It covers the foot up to just above the ankle.
