Female/F_Footr_Tight_Heel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoe; the heel shows a slightly shaded tone but no separate colour slot is visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A sleek sci-fi right boot with a rounded toe and a tall shin guard made of two flared side fins that rise from the ankle to the calf. Round disc pods sit at the ankle and on the fins, and a small round port is on the front.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot and the fin plates; colour 1 on the round disc pods at the ankle and on the fins; colour 2 on the small round port on the front.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The female boot has narrower, more upright fins and a slimmer foot, with the ankle pods sitting closer to the boot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Hiboot_01.description: A right thigh-high boot in soft, slouchy material with gentle wrinkles down the leg, a flat thin sole and a rounded toe, finished with a thin contrasting edge at the top of the thigh.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Hiboot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the thin trim around the top opening; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Highheel_02.description: A right ankle-height high-heeled shoe with a smooth, pointed toe and a thick, chunky block heel. The upper rises to just above the ankle and hugs the foot, giving a simple, plain look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Highheel_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoe, including the upper and heel; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi armoured boot with segmented plates, a rounded toe cap, strap bands across the shin, ankle and heel, and a small ring-shaped disc jutting from the outer upper edge. Sleek, futuristic and mechanical.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin and boot plates and the toe; colour 1 on the wrapping bands and accent panels; colour 2 on the strap pads and toe tip; colour 3 on the small inner accents at the top.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Hoof_01.description: A rounded, blocky hoof covering the right foot, with a cloth-like cuff at the ankle and a small cleft split at the front toe. Smooth and monstrous, it suits beast or satyr costumes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Hoof_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and upper hoof; colour 1 on the lower hoof and toe cleft.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Hoof_01.differs: The female hoof has a single deep cleft at the front toe, while the male hoof is split into a wider, more pronounced cloven shape with side notches.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi boot with a chunky octagonal cuff, padded ribbed tubes running down the front and sides, a panelled shin and heel, small strap bands, and a rounded bulky toe cap.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, strap bands and toe cap; colour 3 on the ribbed tubes; colour 2 on the inset shin and heel panels and the ankle joint; colour 0 on the main boot body and toe highlight.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Iceskates_01.description: An ankle-high lace-up figure skate with a padded cuff, criss-crossed laces, a chunky heel block, a star emblem on the side and a metal blade mounted under the sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Iceskates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and blade; colour 1 on the heel, sole edge and side panel; colour 2 on the laces; colour 3 on the star emblem and eyelet studs.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Jetboot_01.description: A chunky armored jet boot covering the foot and ankle, with an angular plated shell, a rounded front shin plate held by small studs, a wedge toe, and a small swept fin on the outer side; a sci-fi mecha look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Jetboot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot's side and back plates and toe; colour 1 on the upper cuff and toe base; colour 2 on the fin, inner recess and top tab; colour 3 on the thin stripe accents.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Jetboot_01.differs: The female boot is a taller, narrower shell that stays close to the foot, with a smaller side fin.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Knight_01.description: A right-foot armored greave and sandal-like boot: a shin guard with a kneecap-style cap, edging trim and two buckled straps, over a mesh ankle section and a low foot cover crossed by strap bands.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate, kneecap and foot cover; colour 1 on the edge trim and the foot bands; colour 2 on the leg straps; colour 3 on the mesh ankle section.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Knight_01.differs: The female version has a plainer shin plate without the decorative diamond-shaped engraving on the front.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Knight_02.description: A right-foot armored high-heeled sandal: a rounded knee cap and a shin guard held by two straps at the back, above a strappy open-toe heel with a stiletto and a small ankle plate. Knight-like fantasy style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee cap, shin plate and sandal body; colour 1 on the plate edging and the toe and foot straps; colour 2 on the two calf straps.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A short, hoof-like beast boot for the right foot: a blocky cloven hoof base with a ragged, spiky fur cuff around the ankle. Suggests a monstrous, krampus-style creature foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur cuff and parts of the hoof front; colour 1 on the main boot body; colour 2 on the hoof sole and rear panels and the ragged edge behind the cuff; colour 3 on a small patch under the cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.description: A shaggy fur cuff wrapped around the right ankle, with a smooth band at the top and jagged, pointed tufts hanging down over the foot. Suggests a beastly, festive-monster look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts; colour 1 on the upper band and inner rim; colour 2 on a separate patch of fur at the outer side.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.differs: The female cuff is neatly banded with a light fur fringe and a single contrasting patch, and no red; the male one is bulkier and patchier, with contrasting and contrasting fur panels.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Leech_01.description: A bare-looking right foot and ankle whose toes are replaced by a fan of long, tapering tentacle digits, splayed outward from the front of the foot. Gives a monstrous, alien creature-foot look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle and foot section (skin-toned in the default material); colour 1 on the tentacle tips, blending toward the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Leech_01.differs: The female version has around seven tentacles fanned wider and more spread out, with a slightly shorter foot section.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.description: A low, slip-on ankle shoe with a smooth glossy upper, a scooped opening at the ankle, a contrasting welt band around the sole and a rounded reinforced toe cap. Worn on the right foot only.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the band around the sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap, sole and ankle opening edge; colour 0 on the sock-like inner lining at the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_01.description: A plain, smooth, close-fitting calf-high boot for the right foot, with a rounded toe and a slightly angled top edge just below the knee. Simple superhero footwear with no visible seams or fastenings.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_01_1.description: A calf-high wrestling boot with a criss-cross lace-up front, a contrasting cuff band at the top, a rounded toe cap and a thin flat sole. Smooth and sporty, it covers the right foot and lower leg.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and toe cap; colour 1 on the top cuff band; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole and eyelets.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.description: A right mid-calf boot in a smooth, form-fitting superhero style, with a plain rounded toe, a contrasting panel across the ankle and shin, and a small contrasting heel panel at the back.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and the upper shaft; colour 1 on the ankle and shin panel; colour 3 on the small heel panel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_.description: A soft, smooth calf-high boot with a rounded toe, worn with a chunky armored cuff strapped around the shin. The cuff has raised horizontal ridges, a lower panel with recessed detail and open sides. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot; colour 1 on the cuff shell and edges; colour 3 on the ridged bands and lower panel inserts.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_.description: A sleek, mid-calf high-heeled boot with a smooth, tight shaft and stiletto heel, topped by a rigid armored cuff on the shin with raised horizontal ribs and a recessed panel. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft, foot and heel; colour 1 on the outer frame of the armored cuff; colour 3 on the recessed panels and ribbed inserts of the cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Arvad_01.description: A calf-high smooth boot with a rounded toe and thin contrasting sole, topped by stacked layered bands at the cuff. Curling scroll-like ornaments run up the front of the shaft, giving a stylised sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and raised scroll frames; colour 1 on the sole and curled front swirls; colour 2 on the cuff bands and centre swirl; colour 3 on the top cuff band.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.description: A tall, smooth, close-fitting right boot reaching below the knee, with a thin contrasting cuff at the top and a band of upright cylindrical canisters ringed around the calf on a metal frame. Suggests sci-fi gear.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and the canister frame; colour 1 on the sole edge and canister caps; colour 2 on the canister barrels; colour 3 on the cuff band.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.description: A plain, smooth right boot reaching just below the knee, with a straight tube shaft, a rounded foot and a V-shaped notch cut into the front of the top edge. Simple, sleek superhero footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; the top rim shows the same colour and no other slots are visible.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.differs: The female boot is taller and slimmer, with a narrower shaft that hugs the calf and a deeper, more pointed front notch.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boo.description: A cybernetic right-shin guard: a curved armour plate down the front of the lower leg, held by a wide band at the calf, with bolts, hex nuts and looping contrasting cables. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boo.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shin plate and the calf band; colour 0 on the bolts and nuts; colour 2 on the cables and hoses; colour 3 on the thin accent lines on the plate. The foot below is bare and not part of the piece.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boo.differs: The female version is only a shin guard with a bare foot below it, with no boot covering the foot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Deity_01.description: A mid-calf right boot with a thin contrasting sole and a rounded toe, wrapped in diagonal chevron bands up the shin with thin contrasting piping. It has a cloth-like look and a heel panel at the back.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating shin bands, toe panel and rim; colour 1 on the other shin bands, toe cap and side panels; colour 3 on the heel panel and thin piping; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Edged_01.description: A plain, smooth calf-length boot with a tapered shaft and a rounded, low-profile toe. The octagonal top opening has a thin contrasting rim. Fits close to the leg like a sleek, minimal tights-style boot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Edged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 0 on the thin rim around the top opening.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Edged_01.differs: The female boot has a thin contrasting rim edging the top opening, which the male boot lacks.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Fins_01.description: A right calf-high boot with a smooth, plain shaft and rounded toe, topped by three swept-back, pointed fins along the outer side of the calf. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Fins_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the fins; no other slots visibly used.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Flared_02.description: A smooth, plain right boot rising to mid-calf, with a sharp pointed flare at the outer top edge and a rounded toe. It sits close to the leg and gives a sleek, simple superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Flared_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.description: A tall, snug right-leg boot that rises to the upper thigh, with a smooth front panel, contrasting side and back panels, a row of small spikes down the outer edge, and a cuffed ankle over a low rounded foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front of the leg and the foot; colour 1 on the side panel, ankle cuff and spikes; colour 2 on the back panel; colour 3 on a small patch at the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.differs: The female boot climbs higher, to the upper thigh, and its spikes are smaller and more closely spaced along the outer edge.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.description: A single right-leg tight-fitting boot that rises to the upper thigh, made of sleek multi-panel sections with a swooping angled top edge, a low soft foot and an ankle band. Suggests a classic superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shin panel and the foot; colour 1 on the side and back swooping panels and the ankle band; colour 2 on the rear calf panel; colour 3 on a small patch at the back of the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.differs: The female boot is a slimmer, tighter thigh-high piece whose top edge slants sharply, and the foot has a lower profile.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.description: A right-foot armoured boot reaching below the knee: a flared angular cuff at the top, layered plate segments down the shin, a banded ankle strap with rivets and a rounded toe. Sci-fi gladiator styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cuff and ankle strap; colour 2 on the shin plates and toe cap; colour 0 on the lower calf section and upper sole; colour 3 on the sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.differs: The female boot has a slimmer, more pointed toe and a lower, more angular front cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.description: A shin-length wrap covering the lower leg from just below the knee to the ankle, leaving the foot and heel bare. Angular overlapping panels with slim contrasting trim lines give a sleek, martial look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main wrap panels; colour 2 on the trim lines and edging around the top and ankle opening.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.differs: The female wrap is longer and narrower, running higher up the shin with a sharply pointed top edge.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_.description: A right shin and ankle wrap that runs from below the knee to the ankle, with angular overlapping panels and slashing trim lines. It leaves the heel and foot bare, and clawed toe tips extend from the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main wrap; colour 2 on the edge trim and the diagonal panel lines; colour 0 on the toe claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_.description: A shin-length armoured greave for the right leg with scalloped, feather-like panels down the front, a contrasting inset strip at the side, an ankle cuff, and a bare clawed foot with contrasting talons.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the greave shell and outer edges; colour 1 on the scalloped front panels and ankle cuff; colour 2 on the side inset strip and claws; colour 3 not visible.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_.differs: The female greave sits a little slimmer on the shin and has a more pointed, angled top edge.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.description: A smooth, calf-height right boot with a slightly flared top edge and a rounded toe. A thin, jagged lightning-bolt blade rises from the outer side of the shin, running well above the boot top. Superhero speedster style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the lightning bolt; the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.differs: The female lightning bolt is a thinner, narrower blade with small jagged notches, while the male bolt is broader and more clearly zigzag.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lycanarmor_01.description: A right calf-high boot with a smooth padded shaft, a separate plate down the front of the shin and a rounded plate over the toe, both riveted. contrasting straps with buckles cross the shin and ankle. Suits sci-fi armour looks.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Lycanarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 2 on the straps and sole; colour 3 on the rivets and buckles.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Maniacsarmor_0.description: A calf-high right boot with a smooth shaft, a separate front shin plate, two buckled straps and a skull-shaped toe cap studded with spikes. Mechanical, punk-styled and worn over the lower leg and foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Maniacsarmor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the shin plate and skull toe cap; colour 2 on the straps and sole; colour 3 on the spikes, buckle details and top edge of the shin plate.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Pointed_01.description: A plain, smooth right boot reaching just below the knee, with a snug calf and a tapered, elongated pointed toe. It has no visible seams or fastenings and sits directly over the foot and lower leg.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boo.description: A mid-calf sci-fi power suit boot made of stacked segmented plates over the foot and shin, topped by a wide, angular cuff with a round emblem on the front outer side.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented lower boot plates; colour 1 on the upper cuff; colour 2 on the ring around the emblem; colour 3 on the emblem centre.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boo.description: A knee-high heeled boot built from overlapping segmented armor plates down the shin and foot, with a stiff flared cuff at the top bearing a round emblem on the front, ending in a slim stiletto heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented plates of the shin, foot and toe; colour 1 on the top cuff and the heel; colour 3 on the round emblem; colour 2 on the ring around the emblem and the plate seams.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.description: A right clawed beast-foot boot: a bare talon foot with three claws, topped by a layered segmented ankle cuff with a contrasting band and a jagged flared rim rising to a spike at the shin.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the clawed foot and the upper rim; colour 1 on the claw tips and rim edges; colour 2 on the layered ankle cuff; colour 3 on the band around the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_02.description: A right clawed boot covering the foot and lower shin: a bare-looking taloned foot with three sharp toe claws, a layered leather-like ankle wrap with a contrasting band, and a tall pointed flared cuff at the top.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and the cuff edge; colour 1 on the claw tips and cuff shading; colour 2 on the layered ankle wrap; colour 3 on the band at the ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Sandal_01.description: A gladiator-style strappy sandal with a thin flat sole, toe loop and crossing straps over the foot, a heel strap, and long laces criss-crossing up the calf to a wide cuff below the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sole, toe and foot straps and the calf laces; colour 2 on the ankle strap and the top calf cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_.description: A tribal sandal boot for the right foot: a calf-high patterned cuff with triangle and diamond motifs, long dangling fringe strands over the ankle and instep, and a flat thong sandal sole with toe strap.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff body, toe strap and fringe; colour 2 on the triangle and band patterns and fringe tips; colour 0 on the sandal sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Spiked_01.description: A smooth, plain calf-high boot for the right foot with a rounded toe and a straight top edge below the knee. Three curved spines sweep outward from the outer side of the calf.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the spines; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Tribalwrap_Sov.description: A tribal open-toed foot wrap: criss-crossed straps wound up the ankle, a strap band across the instep and heel, and a ragged fringed cuff of shredded strips around the lower shin, with pointed claw tips on the toes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Tribalwrap_Sov.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrapped straps, instep bands and the top cuff band; colour 2 on the shredded fringe; colour 0 on the toe claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Viperps_01.description: A heavy, mid-calf sci-fi armored boot with a rim at the top, large rounded calf plates, a ribbed vertical shin strip, a strapped ankle joint and a chunky segmented toe cap with separate plates.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shell, cuff rim and toe cap; colour 1 on the calf plates, ankle plates and toe plates; colour 2 on the inner ribbed panel and gaps.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Viperps_02.description: A calf-high mechanical heeled boot built from segmented armour plates, with a raised angular cuff, a central ridged shin strip, layered panels over the ankle and a pointed plated toe on a chunky block heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Viperps_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plates, cuff and toe cap; colour 1 on the calf and ankle panels and toe plates; colour 2 on the inner joint sections at the back of the leg and ankle.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.description: A tall, calf-length superhero boot with a flared, angled top edge and a smooth rounded toe. A bat-like membrane wing with a pointed spike juts out from the outer side of the upper shaft.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the wing; no other slots are visible on this sheet.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.differs: The female boot is taller, reaching up the calf, and its wing is a smaller fin that sits at the top of the shaft, angled outward.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.description: A tattered, mid-calf boot with a soft, close-fitting shaft splattered with stains and worn patches, and a thin contrasting sole. Bloodied toe and exposed mechanical bits at the front suggest a zombie look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the sole edge; colour 3 on the toe area and stain splotches; colour 2 on the small mechanical detail at the toe.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Longheeled_01.description: A smooth, plain calf-length boot with a straight tubular shaft, a fitted rounded toe and a thin stiletto high heel. It covers the right foot and lower leg up to below the knee, with a sleek, simple look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Longheeled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; the sheet shows no other colour slots on this piece.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Longheeled_02.description: A smooth, plain right boot reaching just below the knee, with a tapered shaft, rounded toe and a thick block high heel. Simple and sleek, with no visible seams or fastenings.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Longheeled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A bare beast-like right foot with a thick, low-poly paw shape, an arched top and four long curved claws at the toes. It replaces the foot at the ankle, giving a werewolf look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the fur-skin foot takes a skin tone that does not follow the colour slots.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A right-foot ankle-high patchwork bootie made of stitched cloth panels, with a rounded toe cap, a heart-like patch on the outer side and chunky rag-doll stitching across the seams. Jester-like and whimsical.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the bootie; colour 1 on the toe cap; colour 3 on the patch over the instep and outer side; colour 2 on the stitches.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Madjester_01.differs: The female version places the contrasting patch on the front and outer side of the foot, with only a small patch at the heel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Madjester_02.description: A right mid-calf boot with a chunky rounded toe and thick platform sole, an angular panelled shaft edged with contrasting trim, and two buckled straps wrapped around the ankle and lower calf.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and sole; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 2 on the edge trim and panel outlines; colour 3 on the small round studs on the straps.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Malvan_01.description: A single right armored boot reaching to just below the knee: a segmented shin guard over an ankle band, with a chunky toe cap studded with small spikes. Sci-fi, mechanical styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 1 on the side panels, ankle cuff and toe accents; colour 2 on the lower shin band and ankle strap; colour 3 on small trim at the ankle and knee edge.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A soft, calf-high cloth boot with a smooth, sock-like shaft that gradually shifts in tone toward the foot, ending in a pointed toe with a thin contrasting sole and a small notched toe cap.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shaft, fading into colour 0 on the lower shaft and foot; colour 2 on the sole; colour 0 on the toe trim.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Martial_Power_02.description: A right foot covering in the style of a tabi sock worn with a raised wooden geta sandal: split-toe ankle-high sock, thong strap across the toes, and a flat platform on two tall blocks, with a separate panel at the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the geta platform and blocks; colour 1 on the thong strap; colour 2 on the tabi sock; colour 3 on the heel panel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Mechanon.description: A mechanical right foot piece: a taloned robotic boot with a flat cuff at the ankle, round side joints, a blocky heel and layered angular plates over the foot ending in long clawed toe spikes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle joints, upper plates and claw tips; colour 1 on the heel block and toe casings; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and inner plates; colour 3 on the ankle band and toe accents.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Mechanon.differs: The female version has a taller, more upright heel block and a slimmer foot with the claws pointing more steeply down.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Mechanon_Shinguard.description: A mechanical shinguard of angular layered plates strapped over the lower leg, with a raised pointed knee-side plate, a large swept fin-like spike on the outer side, and dangling narrow plates down the shin.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Mechanon_Shinguard.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates and spikes; colour 1 on the underlying panels and the outer fin; colour 2 on the hanging shin plates; colour 3 on the central band and the small tip at the bottom.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Monster_01.description: A bare monstrous right foot with a skin-like surface, three long curved talons at the toes and a smaller claw at the heel, with small bony ridges on top. Sits directly over the foot, suggesting a beast or creature look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws and the small ridges on top of the foot; colour 1 on the bands where the claws join the toes; the foot skin ignores the colour scheme and keeps its own tone.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A single right-leg mechanical armored boot with a bulky rounded calf guard, a thin exposed ankle column with a small cuff, and a clawed talon-like foot with segmented toe plates. Suggests a beastly cyborg look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf plate, ankle cuff and toe plates; colour 2 on the calf back edge, inner calf housing and claws; colour 1 on the foot base and sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.description: A spiked armored greave for the right lower leg: a flared angular cuff with curved blade-like spines at the knee, tapering to a long pointed plated shin guard that extends past the foot. Sinister, mechanical look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, spines and edge trim; colour 1 on the segmented shin plates and back panel; colour 3 on the accent inlays under the cuff; colour 2 on the inner cavity.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.description: A right-foot armored boot-guard with segmented banded plates running down the shin to a pointed toe, an open scalloped cuff at the top, and long curved blades sweeping up from the ankle and calf. Suits a monstrous fantasy look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rims, cuff and curved blades; colour 1 on the banded shin and heel plates; colour 3 on the inner trim strips and cuff lining; colour 2 on the inner opening and heel tip.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.differs: The female version has tall blades that sweep upward along the calf and a narrower cuff, while the male blades flare out sideways.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ninjaboots_01.description: A right-foot tabi-style ninja boot: a soft split-toe sock foot with a short, slightly tapered wrapped shin cuff with ridged, layered bindings and an open octagonal top, sitting at the lower calf.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ninjaboots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the split-toe foot; colour 1 on the wrapped shin cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_None_01.description: An effectively empty right-foot piece: only a tiny flat patch appears at the ankle, and no boot, sock or covering is visible. It leaves the foot bare and is meant as a blank option.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: No visible features take a colour slot; the tiny patch at the ankle is too small to tell.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Norse_01.description: A shaggy fur boot reaching just below the knee, with a ragged fur cuff at the top, a fur-covered foot, and contrasting straps criss-crossing up the shin and wrapping the ankle. Tribal, wintry style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Norse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the boot and cuff; colour 2 on the crossing straps and ankle band.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Norse_01.differs: The female boot is taller and slimmer, with a longer shaft and straps that criss-cross higher up the shin.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Padding.description: A right-leg tactical armor set: a low shoe-like boot with a banded ankle cuff, segmented shin plates with a contrasting strap section, and a rounded knee or calf guard. Sci-fi, mechanical look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe and the main shin plates; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and the plate edges and bands; colour 2 on the strap band and the rounded calf guard; colour 3 on the small heel patch.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Padding.differs: The female boot is slimmer and lower, with the calf guard sitting further back and a smaller heel patch.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Patterned_01.description: A mid-calf superhero boot with a smooth rounded foot and a rigid shin guard. A pointed front panel and a separate back panel are outlined in contrasting trim, with a flared top opening.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin and calf panels; colour 1 on the foot and the pointed inset at the top and front; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Paw_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like an animal paw: a chunky low-poly boot ending just above the ankle, with rounded toe pads and four curved claws at the front. Suggests a beast or monster look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Paw_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main paw body, with a mottled texture; colour 1 on the toe pads; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pegleg_01.description: A crude peg-leg prosthetic for the right lower leg: a faceted, tapered cup that cradles the shin, ending in a thin straight peg in place of the foot. Weathered, mottled surface suggests a rough pirate or mechanical look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pegleg_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cup, with mottled darker weathering; colour 0 on the peg.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pegleg_01.differs: The female cup has a fairly clean, even rim and a slightly narrower shape.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Persian_01.description: A right-foot strappy sandal with a thin flat sole, a wide ankle cuff, a strap running down the instep to a toe loop, and two thin diagonal straps across the top of the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sole and the crossing foot straps; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and the central instep strap.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Persian_01.differs: The female sandal has a coloured sole and only two thin crossing straps over the foot, with a toe loop.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A right pirate-style boot reaching just below the knee, with a wide folded-over cuff edged in contrasting trim and a small gem on the front, a soft slouched shaft, and a pointed toe on a thin sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and upper shaft; colour 1 on the lower boot and toe; colour 2 on the cuff edging and sole; colour 3 on the small gem.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A right pirate-style boot reaching below the knee, with a wide folded-over cuff with vertical stripe panels, three buckled straps down the shin, and a pointed toe cap on a thin sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the three straps; colour 3 on the buckle frames; colour 2 on the cuff stripes, toe cap and sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.description: A right knee-high pirate boot in soft cloth with a wide folded-over cuff, a strap with a square buckle below the knee, a thin cord running down to a contrasting ankle band, and a pointed reinforced toe cap.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the strap below the knee; colour 2 on the ankle band, toe cap and cuff edging; colour 3 on the buckle outline and small cord studs.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Point_01.description: A mechanical right lower-leg guard that tapers to a long blade-like point below the foot, with a rounded cuff at the top, contrasting inset side panels and small light strips. Reads as a sci-fi armoured greave.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Point_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front shell and point; colour 1 on the top cuff and side edging; colour 2 on the recessed side panels; colour 3 on the small light strips.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pointed_01.description: A short, plain ankle boot with a smooth, sock-like fit and a long tapering pointed toe. It rises just above the ankle on the right foot and has a simple, minimal style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pointed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Power_01.description: A segmented armored shin guard for the right leg, with a pointed emblem plate over the knee, banded plates wrapping the calf and a layered plated toe piece over the foot. Rugged fantasy-mechanical look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf plates and toe plates; colour 1 on the central shin strip; colour 3 on the knee emblem plate; colour 2 on the plate edges and lower back of the boot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Power_01.differs: The female version has a shorter, more open ankle section with only a small toe plate, while the male version has a fuller layered toe cap.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Powersuit_01.description: A knee-high powersuit boot with a smooth plated shin and calf shell, a contrasting front channel down the shin, a thin rim at the top, and a segmented plated toe and ankle section with a small round fastener on a thick tread sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Powersuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin and calf plating, toe cap and ankle plates; colour 1 on the front shin channel and the panels over the toe and ankle; colour 3 on the top rim; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Powersuit_02.description: A knee-high armored heeled boot for the right foot: a smooth plated shaft with a narrow front stripe, layered plates over the ankle and toe, a small strap detail at the ankle, and a tall stiletto heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Powersuit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shaft and boot plates; colour 1 on the front stripe, ankle plate and toe panels; colour 2 on the sole and heel; colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pulp_Heels_01.description: A T-strap high-heeled pump with a closed rounded toe featuring two small keyhole cutouts, a vertical strap up the instep, and a buckled ankle strap. Sits on a slim stiletto heel; retro pin-up style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Pulp_Heels_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper and straps; colour 1 on the heel, sole and the thin edge trim; colour 2 on the buckle.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Punk_01.description: A chunky low-cut sneaker-boot with a rounded bulbous toe, a thin flat sole, criss-cross lacing up the front and a thick rolled padded cuff at the ankle. Casual, skate-punk footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body; colour 1 on the rolled ankle cuff; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.description: A mid-calf punk boot with a flared, folded-over cuff, a smooth panelled shaft and a chunky studded toe cap. Small heel, with separate panels and clusters of pyramid studs at the toe and heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, toe cap edge and sole; colour 1 on the upper shaft and foot panels; colour 2 on the middle shaft; colour 3 on the side panel of the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.differs: The female boot has a higher, more slender shaft and a raised heel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01.description: A right foot cover shaped like a clawed creature foot: a furry-looking toe section with two pointed front claws, and a short segmented ankle cuff with an angled contrasting panel across the front. Alien, beastly style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furry foot; colour 1 on the claw tips; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the angled panel on the cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01_1.description: A right foot covering shaped like a clawed beast paw: a snug, mottled skin-like foot that ends at the ankle, with pointed talons extending from the toes. Suggests a monstrous creature look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot surface; colour 1 on the claw tips and the streaks around the ankle and sides; colour 2 on the small mottled patches.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Radical_01.description: A low, ankle-high sock-like foot covering for the right foot, hugging the shoe shape with a textured, bumpy toe and heel section and a smooth contrasting panel up the front and inner ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Radical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the textured toe, sole and heel section; colour 0 on the smooth front and ankle panel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Rave_01.description: A single knee-high striped stocking with a snug, slightly slouched fit, a contrasting trim band at the top edge and a rounded sneaker-like sole and toe cap at the foot. Playful rave or punk styling for the right leg.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide stripes and the shoe upper; colour 2 on the stripes and the sole; colour 3 on the thin stripes; colour 1 on the top trim band.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A calf-high tribal sandal-boot with an open toe and a smooth shaft laced up the front and back with criss-crossing straps. A jagged toothed rim and a fringed, patterned cuff sit at the top.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe panels; colour 1 on the criss-cross straps, sole edge and cuff fringe panels; colour 3 on the inner cuff and cuff zigzag details; colour 2 on the toothed rim.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A low, smooth ankle boot for the right foot with a thin flat sole, a separate cuff panel at the ankle and a contrasting stripe running from the cuff over the top of the toe. Sleek, sporty sci-fi footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the boot; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the stripe over the top.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Retroscifi_Boot_01.description: A right sci-fi boot with a rounded, bulbous toe cap and a straight, slightly tapered calf-high shaft. Round side discs sit at the ankle and a thin contrasting sole edge runs around the foot. Sleek retro-futuristic look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Retroscifi_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft and toe cap; colour 1 on the sole edge and the inner face of the shaft; colour 2 on the ankle discs; colour 3 on the centre of the ankle discs.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.description: A robotic right foot armor: an angular ankle-high shell with panel lines and glowing slots, a contrasting band with a round joint at the ankle, and long blade-like fins pointing forward from the toe and up the heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle shell; colour 1 on the toe blades and heel fin; colour 2 on the ankle band and joint; colour 3 on the slots and panel seams.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.differs: The female toe blades angle steeply downward like a pointed hoof, giving a high-heeled look, while the male version lies flatter.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.description: A single calf-high mechanical boot with angular armored panels, a thin sole rim, side disc joints at the ankle and two slim antenna-like spikes rising from the tall rear cuff. Suggests a robotic samurai look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole rim, cuff top and back plate; colour 1 on the main boot body and toe; colour 2 on the front shin panel, ankle band and antenna spikes; colour 3 on the recessed back panel and inner side strip.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Rocker_01.description: A mid-calf leather-look boot with a soft, slightly slouched shaft, rounded toe and a chunky raised heel on a separate sole. Casual, rock-inspired footwear worn over the foot and lower leg.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot upper; colour 0 on the sole and heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Rocker_01.differs: The female boot is shorter, ending at mid-calf, and has a chunky raised heel on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Rollerblade_01.description: A right inline skate: a padded, lace-up ankle boot with two chunky buckled straps, a rounded toe cap and a raised cuff, mounted on a frame carrying a single row of wheels under the sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Rollerblade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, toe cap, sole edge and heel band; colour 1 on the boot upper and padded cuff lining; colour 3 on the straps, wheel frame and rivets; colour 2 on the laces.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A right-leg covering from upper thigh to foot: a smooth fitted leg with a rounded panel at the thigh, layered angular armoured plates around the knee and shin with a jewel accent, banded ankle cuffs, and a high-heeled pointed boot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg and boot; colour 1 on the thigh panel, trim edges and knee plate highlights; colour 2 on the knee plates and ankle bands; colour 3 on the knee gem.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sacred_01.differs: The female boot has a tall stiletto heel and a shorter, more upright toe than the male.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.description: A right-foot samurai armor boot with a plated shin guard, swooping horn-like flares at the sides of the calf, layered ankle plates and a long upturned pointed toe. Two thin straps circle the shin and ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin back, sole and outer plate edges; colour 1 on the thin edge trim; colour 3 on the swirl-patterned front panels and toe; colour 2 on the straps.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.differs: The female boot has a taller, more sharply swept calf flare and a shorter toe point than the male boot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_01.description: Japanese geta-style sandal: a flat rectangular wooden platform raised on two chunky cross-blocks, with a thong strap between the toes and a split-toe sock covering the foot. Sits under the right foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the split-toe sock; colour 1 on the wooden platform and blocks; colour 2 on the thong strap.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_Skin.description: A bare-foot geta sandal: a flat wooden board raised on two chunky cross blocks, held by a thin thong strap between the toes. Sits under the right foot with the toes and skin left exposed, in a traditional Japanese style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_Skin.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wooden platform and blocks; colour 2 on the thong strap; colour 0 on the toenails; the foot skin ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sapphire.description: A thigh-high heeled boot on the right leg with a snug, smooth upper and a shaped, notched top edge. A pointed contrasting band wraps the shin, and the foot has a short stiletto heel and a studded toe. The look is sleek and sci-fi.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sapphire.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower boot; colour 2 on the thigh and shin section; colour 1 on the trim bands and top edge; colour 3 on the small gems at the top and toe.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_0.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a broad contrasting cuff, horizontal ridged bands up the shaft, a rounded sole edge, and a row of small cone spikes along the outer side of the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the top cuff and sole edge; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the spike bases and ridge shading.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_0.differs: The female boot has a taller cuff and shaft reaching higher up the calf, with the spikes running further up the front of the foot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi soldier boot with a segmented armoured cuff below the knee, a slim panelled shin and a rounded toe cap. Small round joint studs sit at the ankle. A small clip or holster nub is on the cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin and foot panels; colour 1 on the cuff plates, shin stripes and ankle studs; colour 2 on the front cuff panel and toe cap; colour 3 on small accents at the top of the cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.differs: The female boot has a slimmer, more tapered shin and foot than the male one.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Secret_01.description: A chunky high-top casual sneaker with a thick rounded sole, laced front, padded collar, contrasting toe cap and side panels, and a small pull loop at the heel. Sits over the right foot and ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, heel and side overlays; colour 1 on the main upper; colour 2 on the toe cap and laces; colour 3 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Secret_02.description: A short ankle boot with a rounded toe cap, stitched seams, a chunky thick sole, a pull tab at the heel and a laced front with a contrasting tongue. Casual, street-style footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and stitched trim; colour 1 on the tongue; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Secret_03.description: A low-cut casual sneaker with laced front, padded tongue, a rounded toe cap, side overlay panels, a heel tab and a thin flat sole, plus a short ribbed ankle sock cuff showing above the collar.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, side overlays, heel tab and tongue top; colour 1 on the main upper and laces area panels; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the sock cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Secret_04.description: A tall, calf-height lace-up boot with a rounded reinforced toe cap, a chunky flat sole, criss-cross front lacing with eyelets, and two buckled straps wrapped around the shaft. A casual, sporty street look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and toe cap; colour 1 on the laces and straps; colour 3 on the eyelets and strap buckles; colour 2 on the sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Secret_04.differs: The female boot has a taller shaft that reaches closer to the knee.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A mid-calf right boot with a flat, pointed toe, a wide cuff at the top and a swept-back fin spike at the heel. Angular patchwork panels give it a sleek, sporty superhero look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, toe cap, sole and heel fin; colour 1 on the main boot body; colour 2 on the glossy angular panel down the front and side; colour 3 on a small panel near the top of the boot.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.description: A low, closed colonial-style shoe with a smooth rounded upper, slightly raised block heel and a wide strap across the instep fastened with a square buckle. Sits on the right foot, ending at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe body, heel and instep strap; colour 2 on the buckle (glossy metal look).
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.differs: The female shoe has a visible raised heel and a shorter, more rounded toe.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoecasual_01.description: A casual low-top sneaker for the right foot with a laced front, striped side panels, a contrasting toe and heel patch, and a thick sole, worn with a short ribbed sock cuff at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoecasual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper and sole; colour 1 on the toe edge, side stripes, laces and sole trim; colour 2 on the heel patch and stripe outlines; colour 3 on the sock cuff.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoeheel_01.description: A low, plain slip-on shoe with a rounded pointed toe, a low-cut opening around the ankle and a short chunky block heel. Soft, smooth construction with no fastenings, suggesting simple casual or period footwear.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoeheel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoe; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoeheel_01_Glitter.description: A low-cut, glossy heeled shoe with a short block heel, angled ankle collar and a separate side panel sweeping over the instep; slim, ankle-height and worn on the right foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoeheel_01_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe, inner side and heel cap; colour 1 on the ankle collar and the large outer side panel; colour 2 on a thin edge at the back of the heel.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoesock_01.description: A casual low-top sneaker with a ribbed tube sock that rises to mid-calf. The sock has horizontal stripe bands at the top, and the shoe has laces, side stripes and a thick sole. Casual sporty look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Shoesock_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sock; colour 1 on the sock stripe band, shoe side stripes and sole edge; colour 0 on the shoe body and laces; colour 2 on the thin sock stripes and shoe heel and trim.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Simian_01.description: A shaggy, ragged leg covering for the right lower leg: a tapering fur-like sleeve with a torn hole at the front of the shin and a jagged, tattered hem, ending above bare ape-like toes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Simian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper part of the leg covering, fading to colour 2 toward the ragged hem; the hole shows the body beneath.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Skin_Claw_01.description: A bare right foot replacing the tights, with a skin-like surface and five toes that each end in a sharp pointed claw. It starts at the ankle and gives a beastly, barefoot look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Skin_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the foot itself is skin and does not take the colour scheme.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Skull_01.description: A monstrous right boot in an organic, sculpted style: a tapering shin sleeve topped by a skull-like armored cap with glowing eyes and swept-back spikes, with clawed armored plates at the toe and heel.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot sleeve; colour 0 on the skull cap, toe and heel plates; colour 2 on the engraved lines and spike edges; colour 3 on the eyes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Skull_01.differs: The female version has a shorter toe claw and the side spikes point upward and back, while the male version's spikes sweep further forward.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Snake_01.description: A scale-textured right boot reaching mid-calf, with a segmented armored toe and foot plate, a raised flared cuff at the top, a glossy oval plate on the outer calf and a pointed fin-like spike rising behind the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled calf; colour 1 on the foot plates and top cuff; colour 2 on the glossy calf plate; colour 3 on the spike.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The female boot is a slimmer, more fitted shape with a narrower, lower-profile foot plate.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sneakers_Gear_01.description: A chunky high-top sneaker for the right foot with a padded ankle cuff, criss-cross laces, a glossy rounded toe cap, a thick treaded lug sole and a small gear-shaped emblem on the outer side.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Sneakers_Gear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the canvas upper; colour 3 on the laces; colour 0 on the toe cap and the gear emblem; colour 2 on the chunky sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A right calf-high superhero boot with a sleek panelled shaft, a raised contrasting-trim band around the top with a cutout at the front, a central stripe running down to a rounded toe cap, and a thin sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shaft panels; colour 1 on the inner stripe accents; colour 3 on the top band, front trim stripe and sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap and heel patch.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Socrates_01.differs: The female boot is taller and slimmer, with a longer shaft and a more pointed toe than the male one.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Space_01.description: A low, chunky futuristic shoe for the right foot with a thick rimmed sole, a short padded ankle cuff, and a wide flap strapped across the instep with a separate cross band. Sleek sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shoe body; colour 1 on the sole rim, collar edge and small tabs; colour 3 on the instep flap; colour 0 on the ankle cuff and cross strap.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_01.description: A right-leg Spartan greave sandal: a curved shin plate with a contrasting rim, criss-crossing straps wrapping the calf and ankle, and a flat open sandal with toe straps over the foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate; colour 1 on the plate rim; colour 2 on the straps and sandal sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_03.description: A Greco-Roman gladiator sandal with a shin greave: a lion-head guard sits over the knee, a Greek-key patterned plate runs down the shin, and thin straps lace around the calf, ankle and foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate; colour 1 on the lion head, the greave edging and the key-pattern border; colour 2 on the sandal straps and calf straps.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_03.differs: The lion head sits higher and stands out more at the knee, and the greave is longer and narrower.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A right boot that reaches mid-calf, with a rough organic, bone-like surface, a ragged jagged upper rim and rows of small raised nodules. A long curved horn sweeps up and back from the outer side of the shin.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body and toe; colour 1 on the nodules and bands across the surface; colour 2 on the curved horn.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Steampunk_01.description: A right ankle boot of mechanical steampunk design: a short shaft with a chunky octagonal cuff, riveted side panels, a strap across the instep, and a large cog-shaped fastener on each side of the ankle. A studded sole edge finishes it.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, toe cap and outer side panels; colour 1 on the shaft and sole edge; colour 2 on the instep strap and toe plate; colour 3 on the cogs and rivets.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A right mechanical armored boot with a flared angular cuff at the shin, layered plates over the ankle and instep, and a chunky reinforced toe cap. A round knob sits at the outer ankle; suits a sci-fi commando look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, boot body and sole plates; colour 1 on the ankle and toe panels; colour 2 on the toe cap, shin plates and side knob.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_01.description: A mid-calf right boot with a smooth angular shaft, a flat octagonal cap at the top, layered wraps around the ankle, a pointed talon-like toe, and a small fan of blade-like fins on the outer side of the calf.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 3 on the top cap, ankle bands and thin edge trim; colour 1 on the side fins; colour 2 on the pointed toe tip.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_01.differs: The female toe tip is shorter and curves downward, giving a less elongated point than the male.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered.description: A mid-calf right boot covered in overlapping feather-scale plating, with a trimmed cuff that peaks at the back and a smooth armored foot ending in sharp talon-like claws at the toes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather-scale shaft; colour 1 on the cuff, cuff peak and foot edging; colour 2 on the foot plate; colour 3 on the talons.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Strappy_01.description: A low, slim flat-soled shoe with a small heel and a contrasting cuff at the ankle, with a long ribbon that criss-crosses and spirals up the calf. Ribbon ties give a ballet or gladiator-sandal look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Strappy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body; colour 3 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the criss-crossing ribbon straps; colour 1 on the small ankle beads.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Superlong_01.description: A thigh-high heeled boot with a snug, smooth shaft rising to the upper thigh and a pointed toe. A criss-cross lace-up runs down the front with looped eyelets, and the top edge has a small contrasting opening.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Superlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft, toe and heel; colour 1 on the laces; colour 3 on the eyelet loops along the lacing; colour 2 on the inside of the top opening.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Superlong_01.differs: The female boot is a tight thigh-high lace-up with a slim heel, while the male version is a looser, shorter knee-high boot with a separate lower foot section and jewelled toe trim.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.description: A bare-foot, organic skin-tight covering that runs from a jagged, split-edged rim below the knee down over the calf and foot, ending in a row of pointed claw-like toe tips. Suggests a symbiote or monstrous look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower leg; colour 1 on the upper calf, fading into colour 0 lower down; colour 3 on the toe claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Long_02.description: A right foot covering shaped like a bare monstrous foot, with organic wrinkled skin-like texture, a tall ankle-to-calf cuff ending in jagged split points, and five long pointed claws at the toes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower part; colour 1 fades in over the upper cuff; colour 3 on the toe claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Short_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a bare monstrous foot, smooth and slightly wrinkled, rising to the ankle and ending in a row of five long pointed claws at the toes. Suggests a beastly or symbiote look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot covering; colour 3 on the claws.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Tech3toes_01.description: A mechanical armoured boot covering the right foot and lower shin: a bulky rounded shin guard with vented slats at the back, a perforated front insert, and a chunky three-toed clawed foot with a wide base.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Tech3toes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin armour shell; colour 1 on the perforated front panel and the toe tips; colour 2 on the toe and ankle blocks; colour 3 on the thin seam lines and the back vents.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Tech3toes_Warlord_0.description: A bulky mechanical right boot with a chunky, angular armoured shin shell carved with a face-like relief and small rung-like clips at the side, ending in a three-toed clawed foot with hazard-striped edges.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Tech3toes_Warlord_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin shell and back plating; colour 1 on the three-toed foot and the side clips; colour 2 on the hazard stripes at the toe edges; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Teddy_01.description: A right-foot covering shaped like a chunky furry animal paw: a shaggy, shapeless foot with a thin trim band at the ankle and three rounded toe pads at the front. Suits beast or costume looks.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur of the foot; colour 1 on the thin ankle band; colour 3 on the rounded toe pads, fading into the fur.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Thick_01.description: A plain, smooth right boot with a thick, slightly tapered shaft and a rounded toe. It reaches to just below the knee and has an open top, with no visible seams, straps or fastenings.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Toy_01.description: A single knee-high boot in a retro toy-robot style: smooth rounded shaft with a thick sole edge, a contrasting band below a chunky faceted cuff, and a side plate carrying two round contrasting buttons.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot shaft; colour 0 on the sole edge and the band below the cuff; colour 2 on the top cuff and the side plate edging; colour 3 on the round buttons.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Toy_02.description: A right calf-high boot in a toy-soldier style: a smooth, rounded, stiff shaft with two stripes of trim around the top, a stylised stick-figure emblem down the front, and a chunky rounded toe on a thin contrasting sole.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the two bands around the top; colour 2 on the front emblem; colour 3 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.description: A mechanical armoured boot with a smooth shin plate, a padded cuff at the top studded with pointed spikes, a separate strapped ankle band, and a rounded low toe cap with small spikes. Sits below the knee.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 1 on the spiked top cuff; colour 2 on the ankle band; colour 3 on the spikes and small studs.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Trunk_01.description: A monstrous right foot shaped like a tentacled, tree-trunk stump, with a swirling marbled surface, curled tendrils around the top and long clawed talon-like toes splaying downward. Sits at the foot and ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Trunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the marbled swirl pattern of the body; colour 1 on the top cap, the swirl bands and the tendrils; colour 3 on the claw tips and tendril tips.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.description: A calf-high anime-style boot with a faceted, angular shaft, a flared padded cuff at the top, a separate band panel at mid-calf, and a wrapped strap over the instep leading to a soft rounded toe.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, toe cap, heel and side shaft; colour 1 on the front shaft panels, instep wrap and foot; colour 2 on the mid-calf band; colour 3 on the back calf panel and small toe accents.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Urban_Boot_01.description: A mid-calf urban boot with a smooth, slightly flared shaft, a rounded toe, a thin contrasting sole, and two buckled straps around the calf. Casual, sporty footwear that sits over the foot and lower leg.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Urban_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the two calf straps; colour 2 on the strap buckles; colour 3 on the sole.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Vibroman_01.description: A right-foot armored boot with a smooth, tapering calf shaft that rises to a pointed, angular front plate, plus a strapped, rounded toe cap and a thick sole. Sits on the lower leg and foot in a clean sci-fi style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Vibroman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot, including the shaft, toe cap and sole; no other colour slots are visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A right lower-leg and foot wrap: a smooth shin sleeve rising from the ankle with stacked, swept-back angular fins at the top, a strap under the arch, and clawed toe tips on the bare foot.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin sleeve and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the fin edges, strap bands and toe claws; colour 2 on the small inserts at the fin bases; colour 3 on the faint fine lines along the sleeve.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Vikorin_01.differs: The female version has a taller, narrower sleeve with a ring-shaped cuff at the back of the calf and toes that are clawed but without the blended fur-like tint.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Vine_01.description: A right-foot boot of twisting, vine-like organic growth: swirling ridged bands wrap the foot and calf, with curling tendrils and sharp thorn-like tips sprouting from the ankle, toe and flared top cuff.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff top and the raised swirling vine bands; colour 0 on the recessed base between the swirls; colour 3 on the thorn tips and tendril ends.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Vine_01.differs: The female boot has taller, more numerous thorny tendrils rising up the calf and a more sculpted, upright shaft.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Viperia_01.description: A right knee-high boot with a fitted contrasting shaft reaching above the knee, cobra-head shaped panels on the knee and shin, and a heeled lower boot with a pointed toe cap and thin zigzag trim at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Viperia_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the knee and shin panels, top edge and toe cap; colour 0 on the lower boot and heel; colour 3 on the thin zigzag trim at the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Viperia_01.differs: The female boot has a high slim heel and a longer, more pointed toe, with a snugly fitted shaft.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Viperlogo_01.description: A right armored high-heeled boot with segmented ribbed plates up the calf, a spiked flared cuff at the top, a pointed toe with side spikes, and a chunky heel; it suggests a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented calf plates; colour 1 on the top cuff, toe, heel and spikes; colour 2 on the inner boot opening; colour 3 on the heel panel and small back markings.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Viperlogo_01.differs: The female boot has a raised stiletto-style heel and a narrower pointed toe, while the male boot is flat-soled.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wedding_Opentoe_01.description: A high-heeled open-toe sandal with crossed upper panels over the forefoot, a slim stiletto heel, a cupped heel counter and a thin ankle strap fastened with a small buckle. A dressy, formal shoe.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wedding_Opentoe_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crossed upper panels and heel counter; colour 0 on the ankle strap, sole edge and inner accent panels; colour 2 on the heel and buckle.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Winged_01.description: A mid-calf heeled boot with a folded cuff, swirling contrasting trim on the front, a buckled ankle strap, small round eyelets, and a feathered wing swept out from each side of the ankle.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and the wing feathers; colour 1 on the trim outlines, swirls and heel; colour 3 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the small eyelet rings.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Winged_01.differs: The female boots are taller, reaching mid-calf, with a block heel and contrasting feathered wings; the male boots are ankle boots with a flat sole and contrasting-tipped wings.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01.description: A lace-up wingtip brogue with perforated toe cap and contrasting panels and sole, worn with a ribbed calf-high sock held up by a thin ring garter with straps. Retro dapper style.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shoe body and heel; colour 0 on the toe cap and side panels; colour 3 on the laces, sole edge, garter ring and small sock buttons; colour 2 on the ribbed sock.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A single right leg covering: a loose, wrinkled trouser leg gathered over a soft short boot with a flared cuff, topped by a wide band of geometric key-pattern trim with a glossy peaked edge at the upper thigh.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baggy trouser leg; colour 1 on the boot; colour 2 on the glossy peaked top edge and the pattern band background; colour 0 on the pattern band detailing.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wizards_Heels_01.description: A high-heeled ankle shoe with a rounded toe, a striped fabric panel rising over the instep to an ankle cuff with a small buckle strap, and two small oval decorations on the toe cap. Quirky, playful and slightly theatrical.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wizards_Heels_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the heel, edge trim and outlines; colour 2 on the stripes of the instep panel; colour 3 on the toe ovals.

Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wolf_Armor_01.description: A right-leg armoured boot rising to below the knee, built from stacked overlapping plates with a decorated rim at the top, contrasting segmented panels, a small gem on the shin and clawed talon-like toes.
Female/F_Footr_Tight_Wolf_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg and foot plates; colour 2 on the segmented panels and ankle bands; colour 3 on the rim, edge trim and top band; colour 1 on the shin gem and the toe claws.

Female/F_Footr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a clawed monstrous foot: a rounded heel block with a segmented, angular plated top over the instep, rivets along the side, and a row of pointed claws at the toes.
Female/F_Footr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plated top of the foot; colour 3 on the heel and toe section; colour 1 on the claws; colour 0 on the small toe plate.

Female/F_Footr_Victory_01.description: A right ankle boot with a pointed toe cap, a panelled upper and a thin contrasting cuff at the ankle. Swept wing-like fins curve up and back from the heel, and a diamond gem sits at the back of the heel. Superhero style.
Female/F_Footr_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper of the boot and the fins; colour 1 on the toe cap, heel base and the small curved side fin; colour 2 on the cuff, sole and edge trim; colour 3 on the heel gem.
Female/F_Footr_Victory_01.differs: The female boot has tall, thin fins that sweep upward from the outer side, and the cuff is a single plain band.

Female/F_Footr_Werewolf_01.description: A right foot shaped like a beast's paw: a smooth, sculpted foot ending at the ankle, with four long pointed claws on the toes and a small dewclaw at the side. Suggests a werewolf or monster look.
Female/F_Footr_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body; colour 1 on the claws.

Female/F_Greave_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer_02.description: A short, tapered cuff-style greave wrapping the lower leg below the knee, with a smooth plain sleeve and an octagonal contrasting rim at the top and a thin matching band at the bottom.
Female/F_Greave_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave sleeve; colour 1 on the top rim and bottom edge band.

Female/F_Greave_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer_02.description: A short tapered cuff-like greave worn on the right lower leg just above the ankle, with an octagonal cross-section, plain smooth sides and contrasting trim bands at the top and bottom edges.
Female/F_Greave_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the greave; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim bands.

Female/F_Greavel_Krampus_01.description: A thick rigid anklet band worn around the left ankle, ringed with round slit bells like sleigh bells, with small clasp blocks at the join carrying contrasting studs. A festive, jingly, slightly monstrous accessory.
Female/F_Greavel_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and clasp blocks; colour 1 on the round bells; colour 3 on the studs at the clasp.

Female/F_Greaver_Krampus_01.description: A thick anklet band worn on the right ankle, ringed with round jingle bells with slit openings, plus a small hinged clasp block with two studs. Festive, monstrous holiday styling.
Female/F_Greaver_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the bells; colour 3 on the studs of the clasp block.

Female/F_Hair_Animal_02.description: A swept, spiky hairstyle with a tall crest on top and shaggy, pointed locks that sweep to one side and hang chin-length over one ear. Two small horn-like tips rise at the crown, and the sides of the head are shaved.
Female/F_Hair_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and roots of the hair; colour 1 on the lower tips and the longer side locks; colour 2 on a few tip accents; colour 3 on a small strip at the base of the nape.

Female/F_Hair_Anniversary_Mindslayer_01.description: Long, flat, ribbon-like tentacle strands of hair that start at a straight hairline across the forehead and hang down past the shoulders to the upper back, curling outward at the tips. A monstrous, alien look.
Female/F_Hair_Anniversary_Mindslayer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the strands.
Female/F_Hair_Anniversary_Mindslayer_01.differs: The female strands hang longer, reaching the upper back and covering more of the face and chest, while the male version is shorter.

Female/F_Hair_Back_Child_Spike_02.description: A single swept lock of hair sitting off-centre on the top of the head, rising from the crown and sweeping forward over the forehead in a long, sharp, tapering spike that ends near the chin.
Female/F_Hair_Back_Child_Spike_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the roots and the tapering tips of the spike.

Female/F_Hair_Back_Spike_01.description: A tall mohawk-style hairstyle of long, sharp, feather-like spikes swept back from a central ridge along the crown, with the sides of the head bare. Spikes taper to points and hang to mid-back.
Female/F_Hair_Back_Spike_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the spikes; colour 0 on the spike mid-sections and tips; colour 2 on the darkest spikes at the crown and roots. Colour 3 not visible.
Female/F_Hair_Back_Spike_01.differs: The female version hangs a little longer, reaching mid-back, while the male version stops at the upper back.

Female/F_Hair_Back_Spike_02.description: A single swept lock of spiky hair rising from the crown and sweeping down across one side of the forehead in a sharp, tapered point, ending near the chin. Short, punk-styled bangs.
Female/F_Hair_Back_Spike_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tips and root of the lock; colour 2 on the main body of the hair. Colours 0 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Hair_Bat_Head_Female.description: A short, tall-on-top hairstyle of jagged, pointed clumps swept forward and up into a spiky crest, with longer tapered spikes over the forehead and back; sides and nape are left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Bat_Head_Female.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and top clumps; colour 1 on the tips of the forward spikes; colour 2 on the back and rear section; colour 3 on the tips of the crest and rear spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Beast_Boar_01.description: A tall, wild mohawk-style hairstyle made of many sharp, curved spikes radiating outward from the crown and sweeping down the back to shoulder length, with the sides of the head left shaved.
Female/F_Hair_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and middle of the spikes; colour 1 on the spike tips and outer edges; colour 2 in the shaded roots.

Female/F_Hair_Beast_Mouse_01.description: A tall, swept-back mohawk of jagged, feathery spikes with a curved horn-like tip at the front, running front to back along the crown and trailing into a long ragged tail at the nape; sides of the head stay bare.
Female/F_Hair_Beast_Mouse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved front tip and the tips of the crest; colour 1 on the spiky mid section of the crest; colour 2 on the rear crest tufts; colour 3 on the long tail at the back and the hairline at the front.

Female/F_Hair_Bowlcut_01.description: A chin-length bowl cut: a rounded cap of straight, streaky strands falling from a central crown swirl to a blunt fringe over the brow, with a shorter, sharply cut under-layer around the nape and ears.
Female/F_Hair_Bowlcut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the streaked upper hair strands; colour 2 on the shorter under-layer at the nape and sides.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Animal_02.description: Swept-back, asymmetric spiky hair with a tall tousled crest and small horn-like tufts on top. Long jagged locks trail down one side to chin length, leaving the other side of the head bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and upper hair; colour 1 on the tips of the lower locks and side strands; colour 2 on a few darker strand undersides.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Anniversary_Mindslay.description: Long hair of thick, ribbed tentacle-like strands that hang from a flat band across the forehead and hairline, sweeping back and down to upper-back length. It has a monstrous, alien feel with glossy, segmented locks.
