Female/F_Hair_Child_Anniversary_Mindslay.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands; colour 1 on the thin edge piping along the strands; the inner sides of the strands use colour 2.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Anniversary_Mindslay.differs: The female version hangs longer, reaching the upper back, with the strands splayed further apart.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Back_Spike_01.description: A tall, mohawk-like hairstyle of long, sharp, feather-like spikes swept back from the crown and falling to mid-back, with the sides of the head left bare. Wild, punky and monstrous in feel.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Back_Spike_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spike roots and mid-lengths; colour 0 on the spike tips; colour 2 on the darker streaks near the crown. Colour 3 is not visible.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Back_Spike_01.differs: This version falls to mid-back length, slightly longer than the male version.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Bat_Head_Female.description: Short, tall-on-top spiky hairstyle of sharp, clawlike tapered locks swept forward over the brow and sideways, with shaved-looking sides and longer pointed tufts at the crown and nape; a punky, wild look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Bat_Head_Female.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front and side locks; colour 2 on the back and crown locks; colour 1 on the tips of the front and side locks; colour 3 on the tips of the crown and nape spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Beast_Boar_01.description: A wild mass of sharp, blade-like spikes radiating outward from the whole head, swept back into a tall crest on top and hanging to shoulder length at the back. Feral, punk-style hair with a shaved-looking side.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the roots and centre of the spikes; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 2 in the shadowed undersides of the spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Beast_Mouse_01.description: A tall, spiky mohawk-style hairstyle with a curved horn-like front sweep, jagged tufts along the crown and a long ragged tail trailing down the nape; the sides of the head are left shaved.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Beast_Mouse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved front sweep; colour 1 on the jagged tufts beside it; colour 2 on the crown and back tufts; colour 3 on the long tail at the nape.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Birdpeople_01.description: A short crest of sharp, jagged feather-like spikes swept upward and back across the top of the head, with a few small spikes at the temples and nape, leaving the face and crown sides bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole crest of spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Bowlcut_01.description: A short, rounded bowl-cut hairstyle with streaky strands radiating from a crown swirl, a straight fringe across the forehead and a shaved-look band of hair at the nape and sides, ending around ear level.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Bowlcut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 mix as streaks through the top hair; colour 2 on the short undercut band at the sides and back.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Cold_01.description: Tall, chin-length hair made of sharp, jagged crystalline shards that sweep upward into a spiky crest, with shorter spikes flaring at the nape and sides. A thin band across the forehead ends in two curved claw-like hooks.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Cold_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shards; colour 1 on the shading along the shard tips and sides; colour 2 on the headband; colour 3 on the curved hooks at the brow.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Curly_01.description: A short, dense cap of tight sculpted curls that covers the crown, back and sides of the head, with a ragged hairline at the front and sides. It ends above the neck and leaves the face and ears clear.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Curly_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole head of curls; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Cybernetic_Monster_0.description: A tall mechanical mohawk made of a row of segmented, curved blade-like spines running front to back along the centre of the scalp, each ending in a sharp hooked tip, growing longer toward the crown. Suggests a cybernetic monster look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Cybernetic_Monster_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plated spine bodies; colour 1 on the raised panel sections of each spine; colour 2 on the joints and bases; colour 3 on the hooked tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Dreadlocks_Long_03.description: Long hairstyle of thick twisted, braided dreadlocks swept back from the face and hanging loose past the shoulders to upper-back length, with a contrasting band across the hairline and blunt curled ends.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Dreadlocks_Long_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands of the locks; colour 1 on the twisted accent strands and tips; colour 2 on the band at the hairline.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Element_Fire_01.description: Chin-length hair sculpted into tall, swept-back flame shapes: glossy layered tongues and curling tips rise high above the head and trail backward, with a short fringe over the forehead. Suggests an elemental fire look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; the whole hairstyle shows a shiny, reflective finish with faint hints of colour 1 in the highlights.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Element_Water_01.description: A tall, sculpted hairstyle shaped like a rising wave or flame: glossy swirling tendrils sweep upward and curl at the tips, with a short jagged fringe across the forehead and chin-length hair at the sides and back.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: The glossy tendrils mostly ignore the colour scheme and show a reflective finish; colour 3 shows faintly in the front recesses; the short fringe and underlayer take colour 2.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Iro.description: Long swept-back hair with streaky strands that fall past the shoulders to the upper back, ending in ragged pointed tips. A fan-pleated cap section sits over the crown and forehead, like a retro headwrap.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Iro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands of hair; colour 1 on the fan-pleated crown section; colour 2 on the darkened tips of the strands.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Iro.differs: Hair falls to upper-back length, a little longer than the male version, which stops at the shoulders.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Sap.description: Long, layered hair with a swept side-parted fringe over the forehead, falling down the back and gathered low into a ponytail by a small tie, ending in a wavy, tapered tail at about waist length.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Sap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 1 on streaks and highlights through the strands; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_01.description: Slicked-back hair that hugs the scalp and is gathered low at the nape into a single long braid, tied off with a small band. The braid hangs down the back to upper-back length and tapers to a point.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and braid; colour 1 on the hairline and top of the scalp; colour 3 on the small tie band at the nape; colour 2 on the tapering braid tip.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_02.description: A close-fitting hair cap with a receding hairline that gathers into a single tied braid at the nape. The braid drapes over one shoulder and tapers to a point at chest level.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the hair and the braid; colour 1 on the front and top of the cap with streaked highlights; colour 2 on the braid tip and streaks; colour 3 on the braid tie.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_02.differs: The female braid is longer and hangs over the shoulder, reaching down the chest.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bangslong_01.description: Mid-back length straight hair with a short, rounded fringe of bangs across the forehead and long streaky strands falling past the shoulders, ending in ragged, uneven tips. Sits close to the scalp with a simple, casual look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bangslong_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bangs; colour 0 on the streaked upper hair and roots; colour 2 on the streaks through the hair; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bangsshort_01.description: A chin-length bob with a rounded crown, heavy straight-cut bangs across the brow, and two thin face-framing strands at the cheeks. The ends are blunt and slightly ragged, giving a neat, modern look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bangsshort_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, bangs and front strands; colour 1 on the streak across the front and the large sections at the sides and back; colour 2 on the lower ends and underside of the bangs.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bob_01.description: A chin-length bob with heavy full-length bangs that fall over the eyes and a swept, gathered crown. The blunt-cut sides and back curve inward around the head, giving a sleek, streaked, striped look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bob_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper strands; colour 2 on the streaks and stripes through the hair; colour 1 on the lower lengths, bangs and ends.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Braidedcowl_01.description: A short, close-fitting hairstyle with a side part and a striped, streaky texture. The hair sweeps over one eye and gathers behind the neck into a single braid over one shoulder, tied off with a small band and a pointed tip.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Braidedcowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair's light streaks; colour 2 on the streaks across the hair; colour 1 on the braid and its pointed tip; colour 3 on the hair ties.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Braidedcowl_02.description: A shoulder-length hairstyle with a short side-swept fringe over the forehead, hair gathered at the nape into a single braid that drapes over one shoulder onto the chest, tied with a small bow near the tip.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Braidedcowl_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 form the striped hair; colour 1 on the braid's lower section and its pointed tip; colour 3 on the bow.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_01.description: Chin-length swept-back hair gathered into a small top knot with a tie, with a contrasting band across the brow, curved claw-like horn tips at the sides and jagged feathery spikes flaring at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair at the front and top; colour 1 on the hair toward the back and lower sections; colour 3 on the top-knot tie; colour 2 on the brow band, horn tips and jagged nape spikes.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_01.differs: The female top knot sits lower and is smaller, with less height on top.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_02.description: A swept-back undercut hairstyle with the sides shaved close and a smooth top section combed back into a single long braid down the centre of the back of the head, bound with several contrasting ties and ending in a pointed tip.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept-back hair top; colour 1 on the streaks in the hair and braid; colour 3 on the bands tying the braid.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_02.differs: The female braid hangs from a slightly lower point and the top hair is shorter, at chin length.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_03.description: A chin-length, layered hairstyle of long straight strands with a heavy fringe falling over the eyes and jagged, pointed tips; the crown is smooth and the ends are choppy and feathered. Punky and rugged.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands and crown; colour 1 on the pointed tips and the accent locks; colour 2 on the darker shading at the crown and under the fringe.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_03.differs: The female version is chin length with a closed fringe covering the forehead, while the male version is slightly shorter and has an open hollow at the front.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bun_01.description: A short hairstyle swept back over the scalp in streaky strands, with a small faceted bun gathered high at the crown and a short cropped fringe and nape ending above the jaw.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaks running through the strands; colour 1 on the bun.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bun_Chopsticks_.description: A short, cropped hairstyle with swept, layered strands and wispy fringe, gathered into a small rounded bun at the back of the crown, pierced by two thin chopsticks that angle upward and outward.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bun_Chopsticks_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the streaked strands through the hair; colour 1 on the bun; colour 3 on the chopsticks.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bun_Fan_01.description: A short, cropped hairstyle with tousled streaked strands swept across the forehead and sides, a rounded faceted bun at the back of the crown, and a small upright fan-shaped ornament with a swirling pattern behind the bun.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Bun_Fan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaks; colour 1 on the bun and the fan's inner panel; colour 3 on the fan's edge trim.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.description: A short spiky mohawk-style hairstyle: a narrow tuft of sharp, swept-back blades of hair runs along the crown, with a longer point sweeping forward over the forehead. The sides of the head stay bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair tuft.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Chimera_01.description: A tall, swept-back mohawk of long feathery spikes running as a narrow crest from forehead to nape, with jagged pointed tips and a strip down the front of the face; sides of the head are left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair strands; colour 1 on the spiky tips and the rear spine spikes; colour 2 on the shaded underside and the front parting edge.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Chimera_01.differs: The female crest is more contrasting in the main strands with bright tipped spikes, and its front strip is a thin flat panel; the male has a broader, chunkier front edge.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Crazy_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of jagged, faceted spikes radiating in every direction, sitting close to the scalp and ending at the nape, with banded layers and a small tuft at the forehead and back. Wild, punk-like look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Crazy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the spikes across the crown and sides; colour 2 on the banded spikes at the sides and back; colour 0 on the lighter band near the hairline; colour 3 on the tufts at the forehead and nape.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Curlylocks_01.description: Shoulder-length hair with short blunt fringe and a smooth crown, falling into many tight corkscrew ringlets around the head and neck; ringlet ends flare into ribbon-like tips. Playful, cute style.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Curlylocks_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair at the crown, fringe and upper ringlets; colour 2 on the striped streaks running through the hair; colour 1 on the ringlet tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Curtain_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle with a centre parting and straight, choppy strands that sweep down into a fringe over the forehead and brow, with longer side locks framing the face and a blunt-cut nape.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Curtain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair overall, with the strands shading darker toward the underside and back.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Cybercat_01.description: A tall mohawk-style crest of segmented, cable-like braids that arch over the top of the head and fall in long straight strands to upper-back length, leaving the sides of the scalp bare. Suggests a cyber, stealthy look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Cybercat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the alternating bands along each braid; colour 2 on the crest base at the top of the head; colour 3 on the tips of the braids.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Cybercat_01.differs: The braids look darker and more metallic, with a flatter, denser crest that has a less distinct banded pattern.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Cyberwire_01.description: Chin-length swept hair with a long side-swept fringe falling over one eye, an undercut shaved side, and streaked strands at the front and back; a thin braided cable runs along the shaved side.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass, fading toward at the tips; colour 1 on the streaked strands in the fringe and back; colour 3 on the tiny cable details at the ear.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Cyberwire_01.differs: The female version has only a faint, contrasting braided line and small accents on the shaved side, while the male has a prominent thick braided cable band along it.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Long.description: Long dreadlocks hairstyle of thick, ropy locks falling from a crown that sweeps forward over the forehead, reaching the upper back. Bands of beads or wraps ring the locks, and a couple of longer strands hang by the face.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Long.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lengths of the dreadlocks; colour 1 on the crown and roots; colour 2 on the band wraps across the locks; colour 3 on a few small accent beads.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Medi.description: Shoulder-length dreadlocks made of thick, segmented ropes that radiate from a crown swirl and hang straight down around the head, with small bands wrapped near the tips. Casual, street-style hair.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Medi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lengths of the locks; colour 1 on the crown and roots of the locks; colour 2 and colour 3 on the small bands near the tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Medi.differs: The female version hangs longer, reaching the shoulders, while the male version stops at the neck.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Eartuckcowl_01.description: Shoulder-length hair parted at the crown, swept over the forehead and tucked behind the ears, then gathered low at the nape into a short tapered tail with jagged, pointed tips. Strands are modelled as streaky bands.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Eartuckcowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass with striping from colour 2; colour 1 on the tapered tail tips at the nape.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Eartucklong_01.description: Long, straight mid-back hair parted at the crown and falling smoothly around the face and shoulders, with streaky strands and ragged, jagged-cut ends; it looks tucked back behind the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Eartucklong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown down to the mid-lengths, with darker streaking from colour 2; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Eartuckshort_01.description: A chin-length bob with a centre parting and heavy blunt fringe that falls over the eyes. Strands hang straight with a slightly ragged hem, and the sides are tucked behind the ears. Casual, modern look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Eartuckshort_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands and highlights; colour 2 on the darker streaks between strands; colour 1 as a faint tint in the lighter strand shading.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Emo_01.description: A chin-length bob with a deep side part and long swept fringe that falls over one eye; the strands are layered in streaky bands and taper to jagged points at the nape and sides.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Emo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the darker streaks and the fringe shadowing; colour 1 on the secondary streaks between the strands.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Fluffy_01.description: Upper-back-length hair with a tall, tousled, spiky crown, straight blunt fringe across the forehead and long straight strands falling behind the shoulders, with two thin front locks framing the face. Shaggy, layered punk-like look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Fluffy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tousled top of the crown; colour 1 on the fringe and upper mid-section; colour 0 on the long lower lengths; colour 3 on the two front locks and a few stray tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Fluffy_01.differs: The female version's front locks hang longer and the back hair is shorter, ending at the upper back.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Frenchbraid_01.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with layered, textured locks over the crown and sides, gathered at the nape into a single slender braid that tapers to a pointed tip at upper-back length.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Frenchbraid_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top and front locks; colour 1 on the sides and lower back of the head; colour 3 on the streaked panel at the back of the crown; colour 0 on the braid.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_01.description: A short, chin-length swept hair style with layered jagged locks that taper into points at the nape, and a curled forelock rolled up over the crown and flicking out at the side.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the curled forelock and its tip; colour 3 on the pointed tips at the nape; colour 2 as shading beneath the curl.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The female version sits lower and more compact on the crown, with a flatter top.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_02.description: A short, swept-over hair piece: a rounded, layered tuft sits high on one side of the head and curls down past the temple into a pointed, flicked lock. The rest of the head is bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and crest of the tuft; colour 1 on the lower swept lock; colour 2 on the inner edge of the sweep. The colours blend in a gradient.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_01.description: Short, chin-length spiky hair with layered jagged locks swept forward into a side-parted fringe, pointed tufts flicking out at the sides, and ragged tips at the nape. A messy goth or punk look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and fringe locks; colour 2 on the mid-layer locks and side tufts; colour 0 on the tips of the lower locks at the back and sides.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_02.description: A chin-length bob with heavy blunt-cut strands and long side-swept bangs that fall across one eye. The hair is smooth and rounded over the crown, with jagged, uneven tips at the ends.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hair from the crown down to mid-length, fading into colour 0 toward the tips; the hair strands show slight colour 2 shading in the gaps.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_02.differs: The female bob is chin length, with bangs swept over one eye that leave the other side of the face visible.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Harajuku_Pigtai.description: Shoulder-length wavy hair swept over the forehead with a side part, falling in loose streaked waves around the head and ending in ragged, wispy tips at the shoulders.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Harajuku_Pigtai.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the darker streaks running through the waves; colour 1 on the tips and lower ends of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull like a smooth cap, with a few jagged side-swept bangs over the forehead and small tapered tufts at the temples. It ends well above the jaw.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hairstyle; the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.differs: The female bangs are shorter and sit higher on the forehead, with the tufts cut more sharply at the temples.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hatcurls_02.description: Two clusters of three chunky cylindrical curls, one at each side of the head beside the eyes and ears, angled forward. Each curl is a segmented tube with banded rings, giving a robotic, mechanical hairstyle.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hatcurls_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer curl of each cluster; colour 0 on the middle curl; colour 1 on the inner curl; colour 3 on the thin ring bands around each curl.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Default_.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull like a smooth cap, with a jagged, uneven fringe across the forehead and small tapered tufts by the temples; it leaves the ears and nape bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Default_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair shape.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Long_01.description: Shoulder-length hair swept back from the forehead in a smooth cap with streaked banding, ending in ragged, matted, spiky tips that hang down the back and past the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cap of the hair; colour 2 on the streaks across the cap; colour 1 on the ragged lower lengths and tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Long_01.differs: The female version hangs longer to shoulder length and has a separate contrasting colour on the lower tips, while the male version is shorter and mostly one tone.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01.description: A short, chin-length spiky hairstyle with layered pointed tufts that flick outward, a swept-back fringe across the forehead, and a small swirled crest sweeping over the top that stays low on the head.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hair mass; colour 0 on the tips of the spiky tufts; colour 2 on the swept fringe and top crest; colour 3 on the underlayer at the nape and lower back.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01.differs: The female version has a lower, flatter top crest that sits close to the head.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_0.description: A short mohawk-style hairpiece: a tuft of swept, layered locks along the crown that curl up into sharp pointed tips, with a tall curved lock at the front. The sides of the head stay bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tips of the locks; colour 2 on the roots and lower body of the hair. The hair fades between the two.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_0.description: A short, chin-length swept-back hairstyle with layered, textured locks ending in pointed tips that flick outward, plus a jagged fringe across the forehead and a shaggy, tiered nape at the back.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hair mass and top layers; colour 0 on the flicked tips of the locks; colour 3 on the underlayer at the nape and sides; colour 2 on the jagged fringe.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_02.description: Long, loose wavy hairstyle with a side-swept, layered fringe and a short parting at the crown. Rippled strands fall behind the shoulders to upper-back length and end in ragged, pointed tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown down to the mid-lengths; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips, blending in as a gradient; colour 3 on the crown parting.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_02.differs: This version falls longer, to the upper back, where the male version stops at the shoulders.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with layered, swept-back strands and a tall crown of stiff, splayed spikes on top. A blunt fringe falls over the forehead and a few curved tendrils hang at the temples. Punk, animal-quill look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips of the side and back strands; colour 2 and colour 3 on the crown spikes, shading from roots to coloured tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_0.description: A short mohawk-style hairpiece of thick, pointed quills fanning up and back from a central strip on top of the head, with a few curved claw-like tufts hanging down at the front and sides of the temples.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the base and middle of the quills; colour 3 on the quill tips and the hanging tufts.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_0.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with layered strands combed from the front over the crown, ending in jagged porcupine-like spikes at the nape and around the back. It has no bangs and sits close to the head.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and roots; colour 1 on the spiky tips and ends of the strands.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_04.description: Long, loose, layered hair falling to the upper back, with a centre parting at the crown and wavy, jagged-tipped strands that sweep back over the shoulders and frame the face.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 3 on the parting streak at the crown; colour 1 on highlight streaks through the lower strands; colour 2 on the underlying lower lengths and tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_04.differs: This version is longer, reaching the upper back, with the hair falling further behind the shoulders.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_05.description: A chin-length, tousled bob of layered, pointed locks that sweep across the forehead in a heavy side fringe, covering the brow. Ragged, feathered tips flick out at the sides and back for a punky, energetic look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the sweeping fringe and upper tips; colour 1 on the lower tips and underside; colour 3 on the streak at the crown.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06.description: A swept-back hairstyle gathered into a tall ponytail with a tie at its base, ending in jagged, clawed tips that curve backward. Short spiky locks frame the face, with a slightly parted front.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and ponytail; colour 1 on the spiky ends of the side locks and fringe; colour 2 on the ponytail tips; colour 3 on the hair tie.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06.differs: The female version has hair swept off the forehead with a clear parting, while short locks stay at the sides.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_0.description: Short chin-length hair with a smooth swept-back crown and side-parted bangs that fall over the temples, ending in jagged pointed tips around the face and nape. Sits close to the scalp with a sharp, stylised look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair crown and roots; colour 1 on the lower lengths, bangs and pointed tips; colour 2 on small shaded gaps at the back of the crown.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_0.differs: The female version hangs to chin length, slightly longer than the male version's neck length.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_0.description: A short swooped ponytail gathered high at the crown with a band, with tall swept-back layered locks on top and a tail of jagged, pointed strands that curves down past the neck; the sides of the head are bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair, fading toward colour 2 on the lower strands and tips; colour 3 on the hair band.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_0.differs: The female version has a shorter front sweep, with no long lock falling across the face.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_07.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of layered, swept-back locks with jagged pointed tips, a messy fringe falling over the forehead, and tapered layers covering the nape and sides of the head.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips and underlayers of the locks; colour 3 on the crown swirl at the top.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_08.description: Neck-length layered hair swept back from a pointed widow's peak, with a contrasting angular fringe panel over the brow and loose jagged strands falling around the face and down the back.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_08.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 3 on the crown and top of the scalp; colour 1 on the tips of the lower strands; colour 2 on the fringe panel over the brow.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_09.description: A chin-length, voluminous bob of wavy, tousled hair with layered pointed locks, a side-swept fringe that falls over the forehead, and a jagged, feathered lower edge; sits close around the head and ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_09.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the streaked tips of the locks; colour 3 on the parting at the crown.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_10.description: A tall mohawk of layered, pointed feather-like spikes running in a narrow strip from forehead to nape, fanning upward and tapering into a long tail down the back of the neck; the sides of the head stay bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper tips of the spikes; colour 0 on the mid-length of the spikes; colour 3 on the roots along the scalp; colour 2 on the lower tail and back tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_11.description: A chin-length bob with a centre parting, layered streaky strands that fall around the head and ends in jagged tips. Fringe pieces sweep over the forehead and brow, giving a sleek, modern look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_11.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 3 on the parting along the crown; colour 1 on the tips and lower ends of the strands; colour 2 in the shadowed streaks.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_12.description: A short, cropped hairstyle with a swooping side parting, layered wavy top and jagged, feather-like tips flicking out at the sides and nape; a blunt fringe falls over the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_12.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 3 along the centre parting; colour 1 on the flicked tips and ends; colour 2 on the fringe and lower nape strands.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hyena_01.description: A hyena-mane hairstyle with a strip of long tapered spikes running from the forehead over the crown to a pointed tail down the back of the neck, and longer spiky tufts fanning out over one side; the sides of the head are shaved.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the central strip and its highlights; colour 1 on the tips of the central strip and back tail; colour 3 on the spiky side tufts; colour 2 on the roots between the tufts.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hyena_02.description: A narrow mohawk-style crest of long, sharp layered hair spikes running from the forehead over the crown and down the back of the head, sweeping to a pointed tip at shoulder length. Sides of the scalp stay bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hyena_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest at the top and front of the head; colour 1 blending in along the lower length and tips of the spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hyena_03.description: A short, spiky hairstyle piled high on top of the head in a tousled crest, with long pointed tapering locks sweeping forward and to the side. The sides of the head are left bare, giving a wild, punk look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Hyena_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the roots and base clump at the top of the hair; colour 3 on the long pointed tips and strands.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Kangaroo_01.description: A chin-length, layered hairstyle with a tall crest of pointed tufts at the front, swept-back top hair and ragged, flicked ends at the back and sides. Suggests a wild, animal-like punk look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper swept-back hair; colour 1 on the ragged lower ends and the band along the hairline; colour 3 on the front crest, fading to colour 2 at the tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Knitcap_01.description: A short, close-fitting cap of hair that hugs the skull, with a jagged, saw-toothed fringe across the forehead and a matching ragged edge at the nape. It leaves the ears exposed and has a rough, unkempt look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Knitcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair piece.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Krampus_01.description: A short, wild hairstyle made of many sharp, overlapping horn-like shards that bristle outward over the crown, sides and back of the head, with longer blades sweeping back from the forehead. Monstrous, beastly look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on many of the outer shards; colour 1 on the crown and other shards; colour 2 on a few shards on the top and back; colour 3 on small accent shards.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Layered_01.description: A shoulder-length layered hairstyle with a tousled, voluminous crown, a long fringe swept over the eyes, and choppy strands that taper into wispy, feathered ends around the neck.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Layered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tips of the lower strands and fringe; colour 3 on the scattered streaks and patches through the top and sides; colour 2 on the shaded underlayers near the temples.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Layered_01.differs: The female version falls to shoulder length, slightly longer at the back and sides.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Lizard_01.description: A chin-length asymmetric hairstyle: a swept, layered lock of hair sweeps from a top-side knot down across one side of the face, with thin pointed contrasting strands hanging beneath it. The rest of the head stays bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept lock, fading toward colour 1 at the tips; colour 3 on the thin pointed strands underneath; colour 2 on the knot at the top.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Llama_01.description: A short, choppy, layered hairstyle of jagged pointed locks with a fringe over the forehead, small horn-like tufts poking up from the crown, and ragged tips ending above the jaw. Sits close around the head.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top layer of locks and crown tufts; colour 2 on the inner underlayer at the sides and back; colour 0 on the lower tips and fringe.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Long_01.description: Long loose hair with a centre parting, falling in wavy streaked locks past the shoulders to the upper back, with face-framing strands that curl in front of the chest and pointed tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaks running down the locks; colour 1 on the inner underlayer and front tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Long_01.differs: The female hair falls longer, to the upper back, with front locks reaching down over the chest.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Long_02.description: Long, straight hair parted in the middle and swept down both sides of the face, falling in streaky strands to mid-back with a slightly ragged, tapered end.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 form the streaky strand pattern over the crown and upper length; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Long_Loose_01.description: Shoulder-length loose hair with choppy, layered strands and long face-framing bangs that fall over the forehead and eyes. The ends taper into ragged, wispy points at the back and sides, giving a messy, casual look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Long_Loose_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head of hair.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Longelegant_01.description: Long, sleek hair with a centre part and streaked strands, swept back over the head and falling straight past the neck to the shoulders. Front locks frame the face, and the ends are jagged and ragged.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Longelegant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light streaks through the hair; colour 2 on the streaks and the front locks; colour 1 on the underlayer and the ragged tips at the ends.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Longelegant_01.differs: The female hair falls slightly longer, to the shoulders, with the front locks hanging further down past the chin.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Longpigs_01.description: A hairstyle of two high pigtails set at the top sides of the head, hanging to about shoulder length and tapering to points, with a short fringe across the forehead and a small tie around each pigtail base.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Longpigs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair body and striped highlights; colour 2 on the stripe pattern; colour 1 on the tapered tips of the pigtails; colour 3 on the hair ties.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Lycan_01.description: A short, chin-length wild hairstyle: a smooth, swept-up cap of hair rising to a pointed peak at the crown, with jagged, choppy fringe spikes around the forehead and nape and small side tufts.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass over the crown and sides; colour 1 on the jagged fringe and lower layer; colour 3 on the streaks running through the lower hair.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Martial_Power_0.description: A tall high ponytail bound by a banded tie at the crown, streaming down to mid-back in a tapered, pointed sweep. Short fringe and side locks frame the face, with a few sharp strands flicking up at the top.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Martial_Power_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and fringe; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the ponytail; colour 2 on the streaks, side locks and top flick; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Martial_Power_0.description: A tall, high ponytail gathered at the crown by a wide band, with long straight strands sweeping up, arching back and falling to mid-back in a pointed tip. Loose side locks and streaked layers give a martial, warrior look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Martial_Power_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the lower tips of the ponytail; colour 2 on the darker streaks and top tuft; colour 3 on the binding band.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messy_01.description: A chin-length messy hairstyle with tall, spiky swept-up strands on top, a long side-swept fringe over the forehead, and a neat, straight-cut back that ends at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head of hair; the darker shading in the tips at the crown is from the hair's default material.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messylong_01.description: Shoulder-length messy hair with loose wavy strands, swept back from the face over the crown and falling in ragged, uneven tips past the neck to the shoulders. A casual, tousled look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messylong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands of the hair; colour 2 on the streaks between the waves and at the crown; colour 1 on the tips of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messylong_02.description: Long, messy hairstyle with a loose centre-ish part, wavy streaked strands falling past the shoulders to mid-back, and ragged, choppy tips. Sits close over the crown and hangs freely behind and at the sides of the face.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messylong_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair and highlight streaks; colour 2 on the darker wavy streaks near the roots; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messymohawk_01.description: A messy punk mohawk: a tall crest of jagged, spiky strands runs from front to back over a cropped cap of hair, with longer ragged fringe falling over the forehead and thin wisps at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messymohawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cap of hair and the fringe; colour 2 on the front and side sections of the crest; colour 3 on the rear crest strip; colour 0 on the wispy strands at the sides and nape.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messyshort_01.description: A short, messy cropped hairstyle above the jaw, made of jagged pointed layered locks that sweep forward into a fringe, with small spiky tufts on top and a serrated edge at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messyshort_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and crown of the hair; colour 1 on the front fringe and top-front locks; colour 3 on small accents near the hairline at the temples and nape.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messyshort_02.description: A chin-length messy bob with a side-swept fringe falling over the forehead and eyes, and layered, wavy strands with ragged ends that frame the face and cover the back of the neck.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Messyshort_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 1 on the alternating streaks between strands; colour 2 in the shadowed strands and fringe tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Mohawk_01.description: A narrow mohawk strip running front to back along the centre of the scalp, formed of stiff swept-back ridged locks that rise tall on top and flare into points at the nape; the sides of the head stay bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Mohawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair strip and its speckled outer face; colour 1 on the streaks running through the ridged locks.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Mullet_Long_01.description: A shoulder-length spiky mullet: a tall crown of jagged, radiating tufts on top, with fringe strands falling over the forehead and long pointed layers hanging down the back and sides.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Mullet_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 2 on the streaky stripes through the strands; colour 1 on the tips of the longer strands.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Pigtail_Braids_.description: Short neck-length hair with a striped, tiger-like texture, worn in two high pigtail braids that arc up and curl down beside the head, tied with ribbons and ending in pointed tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Pigtail_Braids_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the striped hair cap and braid tops; colour 2 on the stripes; colour 1 on the braids and pointed tips; colour 3 on the ribbon ties.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A chin-length hair piece with a central parting, choppy layered strands and a ragged fringe that sweeps across the forehead. The hair frames the face and ends in pointed tips, with a casual, slightly pirate-like look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the hair and the fringe; colour 1 on the outer side strands; colour 3 on the inner side strands and tips; colour 2 on the front side sections around the face.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: Two thin braided strands hang from the temples in front of the ears, each tapering to a point at the top, with a wrapped ornate band near the bottom and a small cuff and tuft at the tip. Hangs to shoulder level.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the braided strands; colour 3 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the small cuffs; colour 1 on the tassel tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.description: Long, straight hair with a choppy fringe of bangs over the forehead, falling behind the shoulders to upper-back length and ending in jagged, feathered tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fringe and crown; colour 2 on the darker patches at the top and sides; colour 3 on the mid-lengths; colour 0 on the jagged tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.differs: The female hair falls longer, to the upper back, while the male version stops at the shoulders.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ponytail_01.description: A high ponytail with a short swept-back cap of hair striped in streaks, gathered at the crown by a small tie; the tail hangs straight down to upper-back length with a tapered point and a fringe at the temples.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ponytail_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the striped streaks of the cap; colour 2 on the alternating streaks and the top of the tail; colour 1 on the lower tail tips; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ponytail_02.description: A high ponytail hairstyle with short, swept-back hair over the head and a long tapering tail gathered by a small band at the crown, with a pointed lock falling across the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ponytail_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair; colour 2 on the striped streaks through the hair; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the tail and fringe lock; colour 3 on the hair band.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Ponytail_02.differs: The female version has a longer tail and a narrow fringe lock falling down the centre of the face, rather than a swept bangs fringe.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_01.description: A chin-length punk hairstyle with swept, layered strands and a long side fringe falling diagonally across the forehead. Small pointed tufts stick up on top, and the nape ends in jagged, choppy tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 3 on the roots, crown and jagged nape tips; colour 1 on the swept side fringe.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_02.description: Chin-length punk hairstyle with a long swept fringe falling diagonally across one side of the face, layered streaky locks over the crown, and jagged sheared ends at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 3 on the crown, sides and jagged tips at the nape; colour 1 on the swept fringe lock.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_03.description: A chin-length, choppy hairstyle of layered pointed spiky locks with long side-swept fringe falling over the eyes, topped by a slouchy soft beret-like cap perched on one side of the head. Punk rockabilly style.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair locks; colour 3 on the tips of the locks; colour 1 on the slouchy cap.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_04.description: A tall punk mohawk: a narrow central crest of swept-back, streaky locks rising to a point above the forehead and running down the back of the head, with jagged spiky tufts along both sides. The sides of the scalp are left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept locks; colour 1 on the underlayer and side tufts; colour 3 on the tips of the spikes and some inner spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_05.description: A short, choppy hairstyle with jagged layered tips at the fringe and nape, topped by a big swooping quiff that sweeps across the forehead and curls over one side. It has a punk, stylish look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the swooping front quiff; colour 3 on the streaks and edges within the quiff.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_Long_01.description: A neck-length punk bob with a centre parting, long side-swept fringe falling over the eyes, and jagged, choppy ends. Long thin spiky strands hang down at the front and back, with streaked striping across the hair.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaks running through it; colour 1 on the underlayer beneath the fringe; colour 3 on the long spiky strands.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_Shaved_01.description: A short punk hairstyle with the sides and back shaved close. A raised strip of angular, streaky spikes runs from the front hairline over the crown toward the nape, swept back into a faux-hawk.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_Shaved_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light streaks; colour 1 on the mid-tone strands; colour 2 on the streaks in the strands. Colour 3 is not visible.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_Short_01.description: A sparse punk hairstyle of thin, sharp shards: long spiky fringe strands sweep down over the forehead and face, with two separate pointed locks hanging at the sides of the neck and a sparse crown on top.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main lengths of the strands; colour 2 on the roots and tips near the scalp, blending into colour 3.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Reactor_01.description: A hood-like mechanical hairstyle made of stacked padded horizontal segments that drape over the head to shoulder length, ending in a ragged, chunky-edged hem at the back and sides. Suggests a sci-fi helmet or reactor cowl.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top crown segments; colour 2 on the middle segment bands; colour 3 on the lower bands; colour 0 on the chunky hem tips and front visor edge.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_03.description: A short, tousled hairstyle swept across the forehead in layered wavy locks, with jagged fringe over the brow and ragged, feathered tips at the nape and sides. It sits close to the head and ends around the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and swept-over fringe locks, with a soft blend at the crown from colour 3; colour 1 on the lower sides and back layer; colour 2 on the jagged tips at the nape.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_04.description: A chin-length bob with a centre-side parting and long streaked strands that sweep across the forehead to cover one eye. The ends are jagged and layered and curve under around the head and nape.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 streak across the strands, with colour 1 stronger toward the sides and back; colour 3 tints the parting along the crown.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_04.differs: The female bob is neater and rounder, with a fringe swept over one eye, and the ends are shorter at the nape.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Shortpigs_01.description: Short chin-length hair with a choppy fringe across the forehead, gathered into two high pigtails on either side of the crown. Each is a rounded, pointed tuft tied with a ribbon, and the hair carries a striped pattern.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Shortpigs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and stripe highlights; colour 2 on the stripe markings; colour 1 on the tips of the pigtails; colour 3 on the ribbons.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Side_Bee_Hive_0.description: A tall, egg-shaped beehive hairstyle piled high above the head and ending around chin height, with swept streaky strands and a small twisted band of hair across the front hairline.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Side_Bee_Hive_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair and highlights; colour 1 on the lower streaks and the front band; colour 2 in the darkest strands near the base.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Side_Buns_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with streaky striped strands, a short choppy fringe, and two rounded buns high on either side of the head, each tied at the base with trailing ribbons.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Side_Buns_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the streaks running through the hair; colour 1 on the buns; colour 3 on the ribbons.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Side_Buns_Kung_.description: A chin-length, close-cropped hairstyle with short fringe and striped strands, topped by two rounded side buns wrapped in fabric covers, each with a pair of hanging ribbon tails. Suggests a kung fu or martial-arts look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Side_Buns_Kung_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair strands; colour 2 on the streaks in the hair; colour 1 on the bun wraps; colour 3 on the hanging ribbons.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Snakes_01.description: A hairstyle of writhing snakes that replaces hair: a dozen or so thick serpents with open mouths and forked tongues radiate around the head, hanging to shoulder length, with a spotted scale pattern.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Snakes_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the snake bodies and their spots' surrounding scales; colour 1 on the underlying snakes and shadowed necks beneath; colour 2 on the spots.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Spikey_Long_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle of stiff, angular spikes swept up and outward into a tall, flame-like crown, with shorter jagged tufts around the sides and back and a flat fringe panel across the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Spikey_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the spikes and the forehead panel; colour 1 on the spike tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Spy_01.description: Neck-length layered hairstyle with a long swept fringe that falls across the eyes and face. Glossy, streaky strands build up over the crown and end in flicked, feathered tips around the neck.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair at the crown and top; colour 2 on the middle band of strands; colour 1 on the flicked tips and the hair covering the front of the face.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Spy_02.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with a tall rounded quiff, streaky strand texture, and short sideburn tufts in front of the ears. A separate flat fringe panel sits over the forehead. Ends around chin or nape length.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and base of the hair strands; colour 0 on the streaked highlights and tips; colour 2 on the fringe panel under the front.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Straightlong_01.description: Long, straight, sleek hair parted in the centre and falling past the shoulders to mid-back, with streaky strands and ragged, uneven tips; it hangs in front of and behind the shoulders.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Straightlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair and roots with streaks of colour 2 through the strands; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Straightshort_0.description: A chin-length bob with smooth, straight strands swept over the crown, heavy blunt-cut bangs across the forehead and a few loose wisps at the front; the hair hangs close to the head and ends in a straight edge.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Straightshort_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and front of the hair and the loose wisps; colour 1 on the lower back and side sections; colour 2 on the bangs and the blunt bottom edge.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Suave_Wolf_01.description: A short, sleek mohawk-style hairstyle of a few swept-back, pointed tufts forming a tall crest along the centre of the scalp, with three sharp tips rising at the front and sides; the rest of the head is bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Suave_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the crest; colour 1 on the tallest central tip; colour 2 on the tip of the outer tuft; colour 3 on the small tuft at the side.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Swoop_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with smooth sides and back, and a tall, swept-up crest of jagged, spiky strands on top. Choppy fringe hangs over the forehead, giving an edgy, punky look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Swoop_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair overall, with the hair's own shading; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Tight_Middlepar.description: Shoulder-length hair parted in the middle, with long streaky strands that sweep down and outward from the crown and end in slightly ragged, wavy tips resting on the shoulders. Sits close to the head with a casual, natural look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Tight_Middlepar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands and highlights; colour 2 on the darker streaks between strands; colour 1 on the tips at the lower ends of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Tight_Swoop_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle swept back and over the top of the head, with streaky strands that fall to a jagged, flipped-out hem at the neck and cover the sides of the face. It has a sleek, striped look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Tight_Swoop_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crown and strands; colour 1 on the lower lengths and flared tips; colour 2 on the streaks between strands.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Undercut_01.description: Short undercut hairstyle: close-cropped sides and back with a fringe across the forehead, topped by a tall, swept-back mass of jagged, feathery strands that sits like a raised crest above the head.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Undercut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the short sides, back and fringe; colour 1 on the tall swept top section; colour 2 on the shadowed underside band beneath the top.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the head, with a rounded crown and a jagged, uneven fringe across the forehead. It ends around the ears and nape, giving a neat, trimmed look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; the underlayer and roots show a textured, mottled finish that does not follow the colour scheme clearly.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_01.differs: The female version is a smooth, tightly trimmed cap of hair with a ragged fringe, while the male version is a longer, layered swept-back style with spiky tips and a two-tone underlayer.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_02.description: A short, layered, chin-length hair style with a swept fringe over the brow, spiky flicked strands at the crown and sides, and longer feathered locks curling down at the temples and nape; edgy and punk-styled.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on streaks through the top and sides; colour 2 on the darker band toward the lower back; colour 0 on the tips at the nape and fringe underside.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_02.differs: The female version has spiky flicked strands and longer curled locks at the sides, with a contrasting-tipped nape, while the male is a smooth, compact cut.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Facemask_Chaosman_01.description: A short, spiky crop of hair sitting on top of the head like a raised cap, made of jagged faceted spikes, with a longer swept fringe of sharp contrasting spikes at the front. The sides and back are shaved bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Facemask_Chaosman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sides and back spikes; colour 1 on the top of the crop; colour 2 on the front fringe spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Facemask_Chaosman_02.description: Short spiky hairstyle with a crown of jagged, upswept spikes and a longer fringe of sharp tufts at the front, over close-cropped sides and back that hug the head to above the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Facemask_Chaosman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown spikes, with colour 1 shading toward their tips; colour 2 on the front fringe spikes; colour 3 on the cropped sides and back.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Fennec_01.description: A short mohawk-style hairpiece: a narrow ridge of layered, swept-back locks along the crown, each ending in a sharp upward-curving point. It sits on top of the head, leaving the sides bare, for a spiky, animal-like look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and body of the locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the locks.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Braid_01.description: A single thick braid of hair hanging from the back of the head down to the upper back, with a band partway down and a small bladed, bow-like tip flaring at the end. Suggests a mechanical helmet-style look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Braid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the braid; colour 1 on the inner braid strands and the tip's wing-like blades; colour 2 on the band; colour 3 on a small accent at the tip.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Braid_02.description: A single smooth, tube-like braid of hair that hangs from the back of the head down to the upper back, with a banded tie partway down and a pointed tip. It suggests a mechanical helmet or creature look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Braid_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main length of the braid; colour 2 on the tie band near the top; colour 1 on the wrapped sections and the tip; colour 3 on small accents at the tip.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Med_01.description: A shoulder-length hair piece for helmet wear, forming a tube-like curtain that wraps the lower head and neck, with jagged, pointed tips at the hem and a striped, furry texture.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Med_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main striped fur; colour 2 on the stripes; colour 1 on the tapered tips at the bottom.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Ponytail_.description: A high ponytail of smooth, tapering hair gathered by a round bobble at the crown, running as a single tapered lock from the forehead over the top of the head and hanging down past the nape to a point.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Ponytail_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaked stripes running down the length; colour 3 on the round hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Short_01.description: A chin-length straight hair piece: a jagged-edged curtain of hair that wraps around the head from brow to jaw, with a straight fringe across the front and ragged, uneven tips. Striped markings suggest an animal-like, wild look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Fullhelmet_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair body; colour 2 on the stripe markings; colour 1 on the tips at the ends of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Gladiator_01.description: A close-cropped hairstyle with a swept-back top, shaved-looking sides and a single long braid hanging from the back of the head over one shoulder, tied with a small band near the tip. Sporty, warrior-like look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept top hair and braid highlights; colour 1 on the braid strands and tapering ends; colour 2 on the short sides and back; colour 3 on the braid band.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Gladiator_01.differs: The braid is longer, reaching the upper back, and hangs further down the front of the chest.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Gladiator_02.description: Shoulder-length wavy hair swept back from the forehead in smooth streaked strands, falling in loose layered waves with curling, pointed ends that flick outward behind the shoulders.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown and roots; colour 1 on the lower lengths and wavy tips, blending gradually from the roots.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Gladiator_Helmet_01.description: A single long braid hanging from a small cap-like knot at the side of the head, draping forward over the shoulder and ending in a tied tuft with a small band. Plain, practical warrior look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Gladiator_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the knot at the head and the braid's outer strands and tip tuft; colour 0 on the braid's highlighted inner strands; colour 3 on the tie band.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Gladiator_Helmet_01.differs: The braid hangs a little longer, reaching the upper back, and drapes more loosely over the shoulder.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Goat_01.description: A chin-length, side-swept hair piece: a heavy fringe sweeps across the forehead over one eye, with layered, pointed locks that taper to sharp tips. It covers one side of the head and leaves the rest bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the long swept fringe lock; colour 2 on the lower tips of the locks; colour 3 on the small side tip near the ear.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Goat_02.description: A short, chin-length choppy hairstyle with a swept-up quiff of jagged locks over the forehead, tapering ragged tips at the sides and back, and a small tuft at the crown. Punky, edgy look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Goat_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept fringe quiff and crown tuft; colour 0 on the side sections; colour 2 on the top and back near the crown; colour 3 on the lower tips and front locks.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Goat_02.differs: The female version is chin length, with slightly shorter locks framing the face, and lets the face show through the front.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Guardian_01.description: A small tapering hair tuft hanging from the back of the head to the nape, sculpted in stacked, swept flame-like tiers that flare outward into pointed tips; a fantasy dragon-tail ponytail.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tuft; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the tiers.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Guardian_01.differs: The female tuft hangs a little longer, reaching to shoulder level, with more pronounced flared tiers.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Highrise_01.description: A boxy, flat-topped high-top hairstyle with a textured, clumpy surface, cut straight across the back and sides to chin length, with short sideburn points by the ears and a hollow open gap across the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Highrise_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the textured clumps toward the top; colour 0 on the lower hair and base; the inner forehead cutout shows a neutral surface.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Longmane_L.description: A one-sided mane of coarse hair that sweeps from the crown down over the left side of the head to chin length, with layered tufts and pointed contrasting tips. It leaves the rest of the head bare, suggesting a beastly, punk look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Longmane_L.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer ridge of the mane; colour 1 on the inner layered tufts; colour 0 on the pointed tips and lower ends; colour 3 on a small inner patch.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Longmane_R.description: A chin-length, horse-style mane worn as a single strip of hair down the middle of the scalp, falling over one side of the face. It has a raised ridge along the top, ragged pointed tips and layered locks beneath.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Longmane_R.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the raised ridge along the top; colour 1 on the main body of the mane; colour 0 on the ragged tips; colour 3 on the inner underlayer.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Shortmane_.description: A narrow, mohawk-style mane strip running from the forehead over the crown to the nape, with a low curled tuft at the front and a chin-length rear panel. Blocky, stylised hair suggests a horse or beast look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Shortmane_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front tuft and the lower back tip; colour 1 on the sides and main body of the mane; colour 2 on the top of the crown and upper back; colour 3 on small inner accents by the front.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Shortmane_.differs: The female mane sits lower and flatter on top, with a shorter front tuft.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Spikymane_.description: A narrow mohawk-style mane of jagged, angular spikes running front to back along the centre of the scalp, with a longer spiky tuft sweeping down the back of the head. Low-poly, beastly punk look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Spikymane_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the mane strip; colour 0 on the spike tips and the lower side flaps; colour 2 on the inner shadowed underside at the nape.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Kabuki_01.description: Very long kabuki-style hair: a tall, voluminous crown swept back with a star-shaped burst on top, sharp jagged front locks framing the face, and a long tapering mass falling past the waist down the back.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Kabuki_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the star-shaped burst on top; colour 3 on the jagged front locks; colour 2 on the long tips at the back.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Kitty_01.description: A short, choppy swept hairstyle: a thick top patch of layered spiky locks combed sideways and forward over the forehead, with small pointed tufts at the front. The sides and back of the head are left bare, giving an edgy undercut look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair mass; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle of overlapping feather-like layered plates that sweep back from the forehead, with jagged fringe points at the front and sharp spiky tips fanning down the nape and sides. A small horn-like spike juts from the back of the crown.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main feather layers, fading toward colour 0 at the front crown; colour 2 on the back and underside of the hair; colour 3 on the spiky tips and the horn spike.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Mad_Scientist_02.description: A tall, swept-back hairstyle with a voluminous crest on top, jagged spiky tips fanning out at the back and crown, and short strands at the temples. It ends around chin length with a wild, eccentric look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Mad_Scientist_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jagged tips and back of the hair; colour 1 on the swept top and front strands; colour 3 on the side patches above the ears; colour 2 not visible.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Mindslayer_01.description: Long, loose upper-back-length hair with a centre part, swept back from the crown in smooth waves. The ends break into curling, tentacle-like strands that hang in front of the face and over the shoulders.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Mindslayer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair roots and upper lengths; colour 1 on the wavy ends and curling strands, blending from the roots.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Mindslayer_01.differs: The female version hangs slightly shorter at the back and the curling front strands sit closer to the face.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A swept-back hairstyle with layered, sculpted locks forming a tall crest on top and a long tapering tail down the back of the head, with a longer strand falling forward over one side of the face.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main locks and crest; colour 1 on the underlying strands and inner streaks along the sides and back.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: Long, loose hair swept back from the face and falling to mid-back, with a gradient into pointed tips at the ends and a few long face-framing strands that hang forward over the front.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tips at the ends; colour 2 on the swept strands across the top and sides; colour 3 on the long front strands.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: This version falls to mid-back length, slightly longer than the male version.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: Upper-back-length wavy hair with a deep side sweep. Two thick swooping front locks frame the forehead, and long layered waves fall past the shoulders and taper into pointed, wispy tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tips of the lower waves; colour 2 on the two swooping front locks.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Monkey_01.description: A short, tall spiky hairstyle of layered flame-like locks that sweep upward into pointed tips, with a jagged hairline across the forehead and a cropped, rounded shape above the jaw at the sides and back.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair locks; colour 1 on the shadowed inner strands and edges between locks.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Monkey_01.differs: The female version is cropped shorter at the nape and sides, while the male version hangs slightly longer, to chin length.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Moth_01.description: A mane-like hairstyle of layered, feathery tufts that frames the face and wraps around the head and neck, falling to a pointed tip at the chest and upper back. Suggests a moth or beast look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and top of the hair, fading into colour 1 on the lower tufts and the rest of the mane.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Moth_02.description: Long, swept-back hair with a smooth crown that becomes a shaggy, feather-like mane of jagged pointed tufts. It drapes over the shoulders and chest and reaches the upper back, with small contrasting claw-like tips at the sides.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Moth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the lower tufts, blending from colour 0 toward the ends; small tips at the sides also take colour 0.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antenna_01.description: A pair of slender insect antennae that sprout from short segmented stalks at the brow above the eyes, then sweep back and outward in thin tapering curved points. Suggests an alien or insectoid head type.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalk bases and segments; colour 2 on the long tapering antenna tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antennahelm_0.description: A flat, shield-like cap that sits on top of the head with a pointed brow tip over the forehead. It has a mottled, spotted surface and short curved horn spikes on each side, suggesting an insectoid alien crest.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antennahelm_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and horns; colour 1 on the spots and blotches across the surface; colour 2 on the horn tips and the underside shadowing.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antennahelm_0.description: A partial insect-like head plate covering the crown and forehead, pitted with rounded dimples, ending in a point at the brow. A row of curved horn spikes runs along the top ridge, with a larger one sweeping back.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antennahelm_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 1 on the dimples; colour 2 on the horn spikes and central ridge.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Rave_01.description: A short hairstyle with shaved-looking sides and back, and a tall swept-up top of layered, jagged feathery locks that sweep back over the crown. Ragged fringe tufts fall over the forehead and temples, giving an edgy party look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top hair; colour 3 on the short sides and back and the front band; colour 1 on the tips of some tufts; colour 2 on the shaded streaks within the top locks.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Rave_02.description: A short, wild feathered hairstyle: layered feather-like locks swept forward into a long fringe over one eye, with tall spiky feathers on top and a jagged ragged edge at chin length. Punk rave look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fringe and main body of the locks; colour 3 on the feather streaks at the crown and sides; colour 1 on the ends near the nape and fringe tips; colour 2 on the spiky top feathers and side tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Rave_03.description: Shoulder-length spiky rave hairstyle with tall, swept-back feathery spikes on top, heavy blunt fringe over the eyes, and one long tapering lock hanging down the front on one side.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Rave_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and mid sections of the hair; colour 2 on the darker streaked strands and inner layers; colour 3 on the tips and fringe underside; colour 0 on the highlights near the crown.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Rave_03.differs: The female version has a longer, more sweeping front lock on one side and a slightly shorter, tidier back.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Rave_04.description: Two side clusters of long banded cable-like tendrils that spring from clamp-like mounts on each side of the head and hang past the shoulders, each ending in a sharp metal point. Leaves the crown bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Rave_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the clamp mounts and the bands of the tendrils; colour 1 on the wide bands; colour 2 on the narrow banding; colour 3 on the striped bands of the longest strands.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_01.description: Shoulder-length, tousled hair swept back and across the forehead in loose wavy layers, with a band wrapped around the crown and a few thin tendril strands hanging at the front. A separate contrasting section sits under the top layer at the side and front.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept-back hair; colour 1 on the band across the crown; colour 3 on the hanging tendrils; colour 2 on the underlying hair section at the front and side.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_02.description: Wild, swept-back hair with long jagged tapering locks falling past the shoulders to the upper back. Small curved horn-like flares sit at the brow and temples, with contrasting side tufts framing the face. Fantasy-alien rebel look.
