Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and upper strands of the hair; colour 0 on the long lower tips and front locks; colour 3 on the brow horn flares; colour 2 on the side tufts under the horns.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_02.differs: The female hair falls longer, to the upper back, with longer tapering tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_Alt_01.description: A small swept hair piece worn on one side of the head: broad sheet-like locks curve down past the cheek to chin length, with a couple of thin pointed strands curling up over the forehead like bangs.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole hair piece; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_Extra_01.description: Shoulder-length, tousled layered hair swept back from the face with a thick band across the crown, a contrasting underlayer, and loose wavy strands falling at the front sides and back. Casual, edgy, space-rebel style.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_Extra_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the band across the crown; colour 2 on the underlayer and front side locks.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Renegade_Extra_01.differs: The female hair falls to shoulder length and is slightly fuller around the head.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A short, chin-length choppy hairstyle of layered, pointed strands radiating from a crown swirl, with a long side-swept fringe falling over one eye and ragged tips at the nape and ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base hair and most strands; colour 1 on the streaked strands running from crown to tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Sasquatch_01.description: A pair of jagged, blade-like sideburn tufts hanging in front of the ears down to the jaw line, with serrated, fur-like edges that taper to sharp points. Suits a beastly or monstrous look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of each tuft; colour 1 on the outer edges and lower serrations; colour 2 on the tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Sidepeak_01.description: Chin-length, wild spiky hair swept up into tall jagged shards on top and back, with a raised swept-back forelock at the front and feathered wing-like tufts flaring over the temples and sides.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Sidepeak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main spiky mass of hair, fading toward colour 0 at the tips; colour 2 on the front forelock swept over the brow; colour 3 on the flared side tufts by the temples and ears.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Swing_01.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle made of layered, pointed locks that sweep from a side part across the forehead, with jagged tips at the fringe, nape and crown. It sits close to the head and stops at about the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the edges and tips of the locks and on the underside shading.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Swing_02.description: Chin-length wavy hair swept to one side with a thick fringe falling over the brow, and curled, flicked-out ends that wrap around the ears and nape. Soft layered locks give a tousled retro swing look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair at the crown and roots; colour 1 on the curled lower locks and ends, blending from the top down.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Beast_Lycan_01.description: Chin-length feral hair styled as a swept-back crest of jagged, spiky fur tufts with streaked markings, running from a pointed brow peak over the crown, with shaggy locks framing the sides and nape.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Beast_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 0 on the fluffy fur edges and tips; colour 2 on the streaks; colour 3 on the accent markings.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Beast_Lycan_01.differs: The female version has a narrower, taller crest that leaves the top of the forehead more open, with a sharp central peak.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_01.description: A large, rounded afro hairstyle with a soft, textured, clumpy surface. It sits tall and full on top of the head, ends above the jaw, and has small sideburn tufts by the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the highlights across the top of the hair; colour 1 on the lower hair and sideburn tufts; colour 2 on the shadowed clumps.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_01.differs: The female version sits slightly higher with a fuller, more spherical shape and no visible hairline band at the forehead.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_02.description: A short, rounded afro: a dense, textured mass of curls that sits high and full on top of the head, with short tapered sideburn points in front of the ears. It ends above the jaw.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and highlights of the curls; colour 1 on the lower curls, sideburns and underside; the mottled texture blends the two.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_02.differs: The female afro sits taller and puffier on top, with short sideburn points at the temples and no visible hairline band at the forehead.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_03.description: A short, rounded afro of lumpy, textured hair that sits close over the crown and ends above the jaw, with small pointed sideburn tips in front of the ears and a slightly ragged lower edge.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper mass of the hair; colour 1 toward the lower edge and the sideburn tips, with the shading between them mottled by the hair texture.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_03.differs: The female version has no front band across the forehead and the fringe sits higher and more ragged.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Arcane_01.description: A chin-length, tousled hairstyle swept up and back into two pointed, ear-like tufts at the sides, with short wispy layers over the nape and a knotted headband tied across the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 1 on the knotted headband.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Arcane_02.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of swept, sculpted locks that cover the whole head, with two curling horn-like tufts rising at the front and jagged, feathery strands flaring out at the sides and nape. Suits fantasy mage looks.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and the front fringe; colour 1 on the two curling front tufts; colour 2 on the side wing-like locks above the ears.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Cornrows_.description: Close-cropped cornrow hairstyle: narrow raised braided ridges run front to back over the scalp, curving down along the sides, with gaps between rows showing the scalp. Ends above the jaw at the nape and temples.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Cornrows_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the braid ridges; colour 1 on the braid tips near the forehead and temples; colour 2 on the lower braid ends at the nape and sides.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Dreadsspi.description: A short, dense hairstyle of many thin braided spikes radiating outward in all directions from the scalp, tapering to sharp points. It sits tight to the head, tall on top, and ends around chin height at the back.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Dreadsspi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main length of each braid; colour 3 on the tapering tips and some of the braid ends; colour 1 as faint shading near the roots.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Werewolf_.description: A narrow mohawk crest of layered, pointed blade-like tufts running from the forehead over the crown and down the back of the head to the nape, leaving the sides bare. Wild, feral punk styling.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Werewolf_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tufts, mostly toward the outer tips; colour 0 on the inner roots and the front of the crest.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A crest of long, rigid faceted spikes fanning out from the front hairline over the top of the head. The spikes arc back and up, with blunt crystalline tips, like a stylised flaming or feathered headdress.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 at the base where the spikes meet at the forehead; colour 1 on the inner spike lengths; colour 2 on the middle band of each spike; colour 3 on the outer spike tips.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.description: A short, tight punk hairstyle swept back from the face with a heavy fringe across the forehead, spiky layered tips at the crown and back, and two long thin locks hanging down in front of the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the hair and fringe; colour 1 on the tips and the long side locks; colour 2 on the darker roots at the crown and back.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.differs: The female version is chin length, with longer front locks and a more pronounced spiky crown than the male version.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.description: Short punk hair swept back from a centre parting in layered ridged strands, with a cap-like crown and pointed spiky locks falling in front of the ears and along the sides to chin length.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper strands; colour 1 on the lower tips of the strands; colour 2 on the underside at the parting and back; colour 3 in faint streaks on the crown.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.differs: This version hangs to chin length, with the side locks slightly shorter.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topkno.description: A tight, rounded hairstyle with a tall cylindrical topknot bound at its base by a thin tie. A short straight fringe sits across the forehead and two thin strands hang past the ears. Chin-length, samurai-inspired.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topkno.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 form a striped pattern across the hair and topknot; colour 3 on the tie around the topknot base.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topkno.differs: The female version has a blunt straight fringe and two thin loose strands hanging in front of the ears, with the rounded hair sitting closer around the head.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topkno.description: Short, chin-length hair with a swept fringe and streaky banded strands, gathered into a tall topknot bound by a band at the crown; the tip fans out in messy, spiky tufts.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topkno.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the streaks through the hair; colour 1 on the topknot binding band; colour 3 on the thin edging of the band.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Topknot_01.description: A high topknot ponytail gathered by a small cylindrical tie at the crown, with a single smooth tapered sweep of hair arcing back and down to a point at neck length, leaving the sides of the head bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Topknot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 1 on the hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Topknot_02.description: A short high ponytail gathered at the crown of the head by a chunky cylindrical tie, with a single smooth tapering lock that sweeps back and down to a point at chin length.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Tight_Topknot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair lock; colour 1 on the cylindrical hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_01.description: Swept-back hair with smooth ridged strands combed from the front hairline over the crown, gathered at the back, then falling in loose layered wavy locks to shoulder length with pointed tips.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept-back top section; colour 1 on the lower flowing lengths; colour 3 on streaks through the lower locks.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_01.differs: The female version hangs longer, reaching the shoulders, while the male hair ends at the neck.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_02.description: A sparse hairstyle of a few long, tapering locks swept back from the forehead, with short pointed bangs at the front hairline and longer strands trailing down past the ears to chin length; the crown is left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long side and back locks; colour 1 on the short front bangs and the top locks.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_03.description: A small ponytail of a single tapering hair lock, gathered by a short cylindrical band at the back of the crown and falling to roughly chin length in a pointed, swept-back tip. Only the ponytail is present, so the rest of the head stays bare.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair lock; colour 3 on the tie band.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_04.description: A sparse hairstyle of a short ponytail swept back and bound high on the back of the head by a band, plus a few thin, pointed bangs that curve down across the forehead and sides of the face.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands of the ponytail and bangs; colour 1 on the tips of the front bangs; colour 3 on the ponytail band.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Traveler_04.differs: The female ponytail sits higher and further back on the crown, with the band tilted upward.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with a centre parting, swept side bangs falling over the forehead, and layered choppy strands with jagged tips at the nape. Separate coloured sections give it a striking multi-tone look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and side hair and the lower nape tips; colour 3 on the crown and back section; colour 1 on the bang streak on one side; colour 2 on the bang streak on the other side.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_02.description: A chin-length braided hairstyle: thick woven plaits cover the crown and back, with shorter shaved-looking side panels and a band wrapped around the back. Hanging braided tails end in small contrasting cuffs.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the braids and band; colour 1 on the side panels at the temples; colour 3 on the cuffs at the braid ends and the band clasp.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_03.description: A chin-length, swept-back hairstyle with long side-swept front locks that fall over the eyes, a thick rope-twist band wrapped across one side of the head, and a straight-cut blunt section falling below it.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and back; colour 3 on the rope-twist band; colour 1 on the straight hanging section below the band; colour 2 on the thin curled front strands.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_04.description: Short, textured swept-back hair ending at the nape, with a fringe across the forehead and a crest of long, curved pointed blades or flames sweeping up and back from the front hairline over the top and sides.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mass of hair and the fringe; colour 1 on the base of the front crest blades; colour 2 on the tall central crest blades; colour 3 on the outer side blades.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_05.description: A long, side-swept hairstyle with a swooping front fringe over one side of the face and a shaved-looking other side. Layered strands fall to the upper back, with a separate ruffled panel at the side.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept top fringe; colour 0 on the front strands by the face; colour 2 on the main back and side hair; colour 3 on the ruffled side panel and inner back strands.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_05.differs: The female hair falls to the upper back, slightly longer than the male version, which stops at the shoulders.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_06.description: Chin-length layered hair swept back from the forehead into a twisted, pulled-back crown, with a long fringe of jagged strands falling over the eyes and choppy, tapered ends around the neck.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Valorous_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair and back; colour 1 on the fringe strands; colour 3 on the streak edging the fringe and the side stripe.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Windswept_01.description: Upper-back-length windswept hair swept back into layered, jagged spiky locks, with a short messy fringe on top and two low braided pigtails tied with small bands that hang over the chest.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Windswept_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the fringe and crown; colour 0 on the main hair and braids; colour 1 on the spiky tips and braid ends; colour 3 on the braid ties.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Windswept_01.differs: The female version has the pigtail braids hanging clearly in front of the shoulders and a fuller, more swept-out back.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Windswept_02.description: Tousled, swept-back hair with a short choppy fringe over the forehead and long, sharp layered spikes streaming back and down past the nape to upper-back length, giving a wild windblown look.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Windswept_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the fringe and top layer at the front; colour 0 on the mid-section strands; colour 1 on the tips and lower back spikes.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Windswept_02.differs: The female version hangs longer, reaching the upper back, with longer trailing spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Child_Winged_01.description: Long, straight, swept-back hair with a smooth crown, falling in streaky layered strands to mid-back with a jagged, ragged hem. Small curled locks frame the temples in front of the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Child_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass, fading toward colour 2 at the jagged ends; colour 1 on the curled locks at the temples.

Female/F_Hair_Chld_Face_Anniversary_Witc.description: Very long, straight, loose hair with full blunt bangs over the forehead and a fluffy crown. Wispy, pointed tips flick outward, and the hair falls past the waist down the back and over the shoulders.
Female/F_Hair_Chld_Face_Anniversary_Witc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the roots, crown and most of the hair; colour 1 on the tapering ends and the wispy tips.

Female/F_Hair_Cold_01.description: A tall swept-up crown of jagged, icicle-like crystalline spikes with a chin-length shaggy fringe, plus a pair of curved claw-like prongs that arc over the forehead. Suggests a frozen, monstrous or elemental look.
Female/F_Hair_Cold_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the spikes; colour 1 on the shading toward the spike tips and back; colour 2 on the base under the spikes; colour 3 on the curved forehead prongs.

Female/F_Hair_Curly_01.description: A short, tightly curled hairstyle made of dense, sculpted spiral curls that cap the crown and sides and reach the nape. The front is cut back to leave the forehead and face open.
Female/F_Hair_Curly_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all of the curls, with the shading showing the curl detail.

Female/F_Hair_Cybernetic_Monster_01.description: A mohawk made of a single row of segmented mechanical plates, each ending in a long backward-curving claw-like spike. The blades are tallest at the front and shorter toward the nape, running down the centre of the head.
Female/F_Hair_Cybernetic_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate segments; colour 1 on the raised bands across the plates; colour 2 on the joints and plate edges; colour 3 on the curved spike tips.

Female/F_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle of sharp, flame-like sculpted locks that blend toward pointed tips streaming behind the head. A separate band sits across the forehead, and the spiky, layered mass sits close to the skull.
Female/F_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the locks; colour 2 on the front band across the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.differs: The female version has a separate band across the forehead, closing off the front hairline.

Female/F_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_B.description: A swept-back hairstyle of layered, flame-like pointed locks that flare into long spiky tips trailing behind the head. A separate band crosses the forehead at the hairline. Chin-length, with a wild, monstrous look.
Female/F_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_B.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the locks; colour 1 on the tips of the locks, fading in from the base; colour 2 on the forehead band.
Female/F_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_B.differs: The female version has a contrasting band across the forehead at the hairline, while the male version has an open, hollow-looking fringe edge instead.

Female/F_Hair_Dreadlocks_Long_03.description: Long braided dreadlocks swept back from the forehead and hanging to the upper back, with thick twisted plaits and curled ends. A contrasting band sits across the hairline, and shorter braids frame the front of the shoulders.
Female/F_Hair_Dreadlocks_Long_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main braided strands; colour 1 on the twisted accent strands running through the plaits and the tips; colour 2 on the band at the hairline.

Female/F_Hair_Element_Fire_01.description: A tall, chin-length hairstyle sculpted as swept-back flames: glossy, pointed tongues of hair rise high over the crown and stream backward, with a short blunt fringe across the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the scheme and shows a sheen; a hint of colour 1 shows in the inner flame layers, with the rest reading as a near-solid mass.

Female/F_Hair_Element_Water_01.description: A tall, flame-like hairstyle of swept, curling tendrils that rise to a hooked tip above the crown and fall to chin length around the head, with a short fringe of spiky strands over the forehead. Fantasy elemental look.
Female/F_Hair_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: The whole piece has a glossy, reflective material that largely ignores the colour scheme, so no single slot reads clearly on the tendrils.
Female/F_Hair_Element_Water_01.differs: The female version has a glossy, reflective finish that ignores the colour scheme, while the male version shows a clear colour pattern.

Female/F_Hair_Face_90s_Wavy_01.description: A 90s-style hairstyle with a high ponytail tied at the crown, a wavy tail that curls out to the back and swings down to upper-back length, a puffy bun-like top, side-swept bangs and loose curly tendrils by the face.
Female/F_Hair_Face_90s_Wavy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top bun, bangs and tail tip; colour 1 on the front fringe and outer sections of the ponytail; colour 2 on the tie and the inner ponytail bands; colour 3 on the hairline patch at the temples.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Ironclad_.description: Long, straight, swept-back hair with streaky strands that fall past the shoulders to the upper back, with a fan-shaped pleated section across the crown and a ragged, pointed tip on each strand.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Ironclad_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 1 on the fan-shaped crown section at the front of the head; colour 2 on the darkened tips of the strands.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Ironclad_.differs: The female hair falls longer, to the upper back, while the male version stops at the shoulders.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Sapphire_.description: Long, swept-back hair with side-parted fringe falling around the face, gathered into a low tie at the lower back and ending in a wavy, tapered ponytail that reaches past the waist. Retro glamour style.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Sapphire_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on streaked highlights through the strands; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Witchcraf.description: Very long, straight hair with a full crown and choppy blunt fringe over the forehead, falling in layered tapered locks past the waist down the back, with jagged wispy tips and a few strands drawn forward.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Witchcraf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 1 tints the ends of the locks toward the tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_01.description: A slicked-back hairstyle that hugs the scalp with a receding front hairline, gathered at the nape by a small tie into a single long plaited braid that hangs down the back to upper-back length and tapers to a point.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and braid; colour 1 on the top and front scalp edge of the hair; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_02.description: A close-fitting scalped hair cap with a single long braid gathered at the nape by a small tie, then swinging over the shoulder and tapering to a point at chest level. A sleek, practical look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and braid; colour 1 on the streaked top and front of the cap; colour 2 on the braid's tapering tip; colour 3 on the hair tie.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_02.differs: The braid is longer and reaches further down the chest, while the male braid ends shorter, at neck length.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Bangslong_01.description: Long, straight hair with a short rounded fringe across the forehead, streaked strands and ragged, jagged tips. It falls past the shoulders to mid-back and frames the face on both sides.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Bangslong_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fringe; colour 0 on the upper strands and streaks; colour 2 on the streaks near the roots; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Bangsshort_01.description: A chin-length bob with straight, choppy bangs cut across the brow and two longer face-framing strands at the temples. The hair is layered and rounded over the crown, with a ragged, slightly uneven edge at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Bangsshort_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, bangs and front strands; colour 1 on the side and back sections and a swept patch at the front of the crown; colour 2 on the lower ends of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Bob_01.description: A chin-length bob with a heavy fringe that sweeps across the forehead and partly covers the eyes, with a swept-back crown and tapered, slightly uneven ends. Streaky banded striping runs across the top and down the back.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Bob_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crown and streaks; colour 2 on the stripes across the top and back; colour 1 on the lower lengths, fringe and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Braidedcowl_01.description: A short, close-fitting hairstyle with a centre parting and a streaked, striped texture, gathered at the nape into a single thin braid that hangs over one shoulder and ends in a pointed tip.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Braidedcowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and the braid highlights; colour 2 on the streaks in the hair; colour 1 on the braid tip and lower braid; colour 3 on the small bands tying the braid.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Braidedcowl_02.description: A shoulder-length bobbed hairstyle with a side-swept fringe over the forehead, gathered at the nape into a single braid that hangs over one shoulder and ends in a tapered tip tied with a bow.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Braidedcowl_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 make up the striped hair; colour 1 on the braid's tapered tip and part of its weave; colour 3 on the bow.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Brutal_01.description: Chin-length swept-back hair gathered into a small top knot with a tie. A jagged fringe band with a curved claw-like tip crosses the brow, spiky feather-like points flick out at the nape, and small curved horns curl from the sides and knot.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair strands, knot and fringe; colour 1 on the gradient across the crown and back of the hair; colour 3 on the tie around the knot; colour 2 on the darker tips of the horns and nape spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Brutal_02.description: A swept-back hairstyle with a shaved-sides mohawk-like top, combed smoothly from the forehead to the back, gathered into a long braid down the centre of the back of the head, bound with contrasting ties and ending in pointed tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and braid strands; colour 1 on the streaked highlights through the hair and braid; colour 3 on the ties wrapped around the braid.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Brutal_03.description: A chin-length, layered shaggy hairstyle with long streaky strands, ragged pointed tips and a heavy fringe that falls over the eyes; the crown is smooth and the ends are jagged and wild.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and strands; colour 2 on the darkened crown and parting; colour 1 on the ragged tips and a few highlight tufts.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Brutal_03.differs: The female version is chin length with a closed fringe over the forehead, while the male version is neck length with a more open, hollow-looking front.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Bun_01.description: A short, cropped hairstyle with swept-back strands and a faceted, rounded bun perched on top at the back of the head; ends above the jaw with short wisps at the nape and temples.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Bun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaky strand markings; colour 1 on the bun.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Bun_Chopsticks_01.description: A short, cropped hairstyle with swept, streaky layered strands over the forehead and ears, gathered into a rounded faceted bun at the back of the crown, pierced by two thin chopsticks that angle outward.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Bun_Chopsticks_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the streaky stripe strands through the hair; colour 1 on the bun; colour 3 on the chopsticks.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Bun_Fan_01.description: A short, cropped hairstyle with streaky, swept strands over the forehead and sides, topped by a faceted bun at the back of the crown and a small fan-shaped ornament with a decorative pattern standing upright in front of it.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Bun_Fan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass, with streaks from the hair texture; colour 1 on the bun and the fan panel; colour 3 on the fan's edge trim; colour 2 on the swirl pattern on the fan.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Buzzcut_01.description: A short, boxy buzzcut with a flat top and a tapered sides-and-back cut, with a jagged tufted edge above the ears and a peaked front hairline. It sits close to the head and suggests a clean, sporty or street style.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Buzzcut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top, the fringe and the main hair mass; colour 1 on the jagged tufted patches at the temples, sides and back.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.description: A short, spiky tuft of hair sitting on top of the head like a mohawk, with sharp pointed locks swept forward over the brow and back toward the crown; the sides of the head stay bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tuft of hair.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Child_Rocker_01.description: Wild, shaggy hairstyle with tall, teased volume on top and long jagged layered strands falling past the shoulders to the upper back, with a few face-framing locks over the forehead. Rocker or punk style.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Child_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on streaks through the strands; colour 3 on the tips of the front locks over the forehead; colour 2 on the darker ends of the side and back strands.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Chimera_01.description: A tall, narrow mohawk of long streaked strands swept back from the forehead into a crest, with jagged spiky tips along both sides and a tapering tail down the nape. The sides of the head are left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 on the spiky tips and edges of the crest; colour 2 on the shaded roots near the hairline.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Crazy_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of jagged, faceted spikes radiating in all directions, with bands of contrasting layers and a small tuft of spikes at the crown and nape. Wild, feral and punkish.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Crazy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the spikes; colour 0 on the band of spikes along the hairline; colour 2 on the darker spike clusters at the back and sides; colour 3 on the tufts at the front crown and nape.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Curlylocks_01.description: Shoulder-length hairstyle with short straight bangs and a smooth crown, falling into many tight corkscrew ringlets around the head and neck, with the curls ending in ribbon-like tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Curlylocks_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair; colour 2 on the streaked stripe pattern through the crown and curls; colour 1 on the tips of the ringlets.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Curtain_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle with a centre parting and long, heavy fringe that sweeps down over the eyes and one side of the face. Straight, choppy layers fall to a blunt edge at the jaw and nape.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Curtain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair overall, with shading toward the underside and back.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Cybercat_01.description: A crest of thick segmented cable-like dreadlocks rising from a narrow strip along the top of the head and hanging in long strands past the shoulders, with banded rings along each strand and capped tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Cybercat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on alternating bands along each strand; colour 2 on the base strip at the crown; colour 3 on the strand tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Cyberwire_01.description: A chin-length asymmetric undercut bob: swept-back top hair with long side-swept bangs over one eye, a shaved side and nape, and a thin braided cord running along the side of the head.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair, fading darker toward the tips; colour 1 on the streaked strands at the front and sides; colour 3 on a tiny bead at the ear.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Cyberwire_01.differs: The female version has a contrasting braided cord along the side and only a tiny accent bead, while the male has a thick, prominent braided cable running from the temple down the back of the head.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Long_01.description: Long dreadlocks made of many thick ropey strands falling from a crown of tangled locks to upper-back length, with a few banded strands hanging at the front and contrasting wrap bands near the ends.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lengths of the dreadlocks; colour 1 on the crown and roots; colour 2 on the wrap bands near the ends; colour 3 on small bands on the front strands.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Medium_01.description: Shoulder-length dreadlocks made of many thick, segmented ropes that fall from a crown parting and sweep forward over the forehead, hanging straight down around the head with small bands near the tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Medium_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the locks; colour 1 on the crown and upper roots; colour 2 and colour 3 on the small bands near the tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Medium_01.differs: The female locks hang longer, reaching the shoulders, while the male version stops at neck length.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Eartuckcowl_01.description: A shoulder-length hairstyle with a centre parting, strands swept across the face and tucked behind the ear, gathered low at the nape into a loose tapered tail with jagged, feathered tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Eartuckcowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 on the striped strands across the main head of hair; colour 1 on the tapered tail tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Eartucklong_01.description: Long, straight hair parted at the centre and swept back behind the ears, falling in streaky strands to mid-back with raggedly cut, uneven ends that flare slightly outward over the shoulders.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Eartucklong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown down to the mid-lengths, with streaks of colour 2 running through it; colour 1 on the lower ends of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Eartuckshort_01.description: A chin-length bob with a centre parting and long, heavy bangs that sweep down over the eyes. The hair is streaky and layered with ragged ends, tucked behind the ears, and falls straight down around the head.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Eartuckshort_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair strands; colour 2 on the darker streaks between the strands; colour 1 as a faint tint in the lighter highlights.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Emo_01.description: A chin-length bob hairstyle with a side-swept fringe that falls over one eye, and a rounded crown. Strands are sleek and streaked, ending in jagged points at the nape. Casual, emo-inspired look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Emo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on alternating streaks of the hair; colour 2 on the streaks and the shadowed fringe. Colour 3 is not visible.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Extraterrestialmohawk.description: A short, tall mohawk of sharp, jagged spikes running front to back along the centre of the scalp, with the sides left bare. The spikes fan upward and sweep back into a swept crest at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Extraterrestialmohawk.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike tips at the front hairline; colour 1 on the middle of the spikes; colour 2 on the crest at the top; colour 3 on the rear spikes and the back cluster.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Extraterrestialmohawk.description: A short alien mohawk split into two parallel ridges of sharp, shard-like spikes running front to back along the crown, fanning upward and outward and leaving the sides of the head bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Extraterrestialmohawk.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front tips of the spikes; colour 3 on the rear spikes; colour 2 as a gradient in the middle; colour 0 on the roots at the front.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Fluffy_01.description: Upper-back-length hair with a tall, tousled, spiky crown, straight blunt fringe across the forehead and long straight strands falling behind the shoulders, with two longer face-framing locks in front. A shaggy, wild style.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Fluffy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tousled crown; colour 1 on the fringe and upper mid-section of the hair; colour 0 on the long lower strands; colour 3 on the face-framing front locks.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Frenchbraid_01.description: A short swept-back hairstyle with textured layered locks over the top and sides of the head, gathered into a thin tapering French braid that hangs down the back to upper-back length.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Frenchbraid_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top and front of the hair; colour 1 on the side and lower back locks; colour 3 on the streak of hair at the back of the crown; colour 0 on the braid.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_01.description: Chin-length swept-back hair in layered jagged locks that taper to pointed tips at the nape, with a curled topknot lock at one side of the crown that flicks outward. Sits close to the head with a slightly edgy, punk feel.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the curled crown lock and its tip; colour 3 on the pointed tips at the nape and lower back; colour 2 on a small shadowed strand beside the curl.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The female version sits lower and closer to the head, with a shorter, flatter crown and curl.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_02.description: A short, swept-back hair piece forming a raised layered quiff on top of the head, with a curled lock of bangs sweeping down over one temple to a pointed flick. Chunky sculpted strands suggest a stylised, edgy look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper quiff and top strands; colour 1 on the swept-down side lock and its tip; colour 2 on the edge strands along the back of the quiff.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Golden_Age_01.description: A mid-back length ponytail of thick, jagged streaked locks, gathered at the back of the head and hanging down between the shoulder blades, with ragged pointed tips and a bold striped pattern.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light streaks of the hair; colour 2 on the stripes running down the locks; colour 1 on the lower tips and ends.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Goth_01.description: Short, chin-length, choppy hairstyle of layered pointed locks swept across the forehead, with spiky tufts flicking out at the sides and a ragged, feathered fringe at the nape. Gothic and punk in feel.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and swept fringe locks; colour 2 on the mid-layer locks and side tufts; colour 0 on the lower tips at the back and nape.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Goth_02.description: A chin-length bob with straight, streaky strands and heavy side-swept bangs that fall over one eye. The back is cut in a blunt, slightly uneven line, with a sleek gothic look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown and upper hair, fading into colour 0 toward the lower strands and tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Goth_02.differs: The female bob is cut chin length, with bangs swept to one side so they cover one eye and leave the other side of the face visible.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Harajuku_Pigtails_Lon.description: Shoulder-length wavy hair gathered into two high pigtails on top of the head, with loose streaky strands falling around the face and back. A thin band across the crown ends in small horn-like tips at each pigtail base.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Harajuku_Pigtails_Lon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the darker streaks; colour 1 on the ends of the hair; colour 3 on the headband and the small horn-like tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Harajuku_Pigtails_Lon.description: Shoulder-length wavy hair swept to one side with a side-swept fringe over the forehead, falling in loose, streaky waves with tapered, ragged ends that flick outward at the tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Harajuku_Pigtails_Lon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands and streaks; colour 2 on the darker streaks running through the waves; colour 1 on the tapered tips of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull in a smooth cap shape, with a few jagged, swept-across bangs over the forehead and tapered sides that stop above the ears and jaw.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair mass; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Hatcurls_02.description: Two clusters of chunky segmented cylinders hang beside the temples and ears like mechanical curls, each cluster having three barrels of different lengths with thin ring bands. A stylised robotic hairstyle with no hair on top.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Hatcurls_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the middle barrels; colour 1 on the front barrels; colour 2 on the rear barrels; colour 3 on the thin ring bands.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Default_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull as a smooth rounded cap, with a slightly jagged hairline across the forehead and small tapered tufts by the ears; ends well above the jaw.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Default_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair cap.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_01.description: Shoulder-length swept-back hair with a smooth rounded crown and streaky banded strands, ending in ragged, jagged tips that hang past the neck. Tucks behind the ears and leaves the face open; a rough, matted look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper strands; colour 2 on the streaks running through the top; colour 1 on the lower strand tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_01.differs: The female version hangs to shoulder length and has two-tone streaking, with the lower strands taking a separate colour; the male version is shorter and plainer.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_02.description: Shoulder-length sleek hair swept straight back from the hairline in smooth strands, hanging down the back with ragged, uneven tips. Streaked banding runs along the strands, giving a sharp, styled look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair at the crown and upper strands; colour 2 on the streaked stripes running through the strands; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_02.differs: The female hair has bold streaked stripes along the strands and a contrasting-tipped gradient toward the ends, while the male version is a smoother, plain mass.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_03.description: Shoulder-length hair swept straight back from the forehead in a smooth, streaked cap, falling behind the head into long straight strands with jagged, uneven tips. Sleek and slicked, with a striped strand pattern.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crown and the light streaks; colour 2 on the streaks running through the strands; colour 1 blending in toward the lower lengths and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_01.description: A short, chin-length spiky hairstyle with layered pointed tips around the crown and nape, blunt fringe across the forehead, and a swept top tuft that curls back into a small upswept tail.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main crown and top of the hair; colour 0 on the spiky tips and highlights; colour 2 on the fringe and swept top tuft; colour 3 on the underlayer at the nape and sides.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_01.differs: The female top tuft is lower and sweeps flatter across the head, while the male version has a taller, upswept quiff.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_01.description: A short, tall swept-back hairstyle: a narrow crest of stiff, layered locks with pointed tips fans from the front hairline over the crown, with one lock curling upward at the front. Sides and back are bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tips of the locks; colour 2 on the roots and lower body of the hair; the hair fades between them.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_02.description: Short, chin-length spiky hairstyle with a swept, layered crown, sharp pointed tips flicking outward at the sides and back, a jagged blunt fringe across the forehead, and a tiered spiky underlayer at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and crown of the hair; colour 0 on the flicked spiky tips; colour 3 on the underlayer at the nape and behind the ears; colour 2 on the fringe.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_02.description: Long, swept-back layered hair with a side-parted, tousled crown and wavy ripple texture. It falls loose past the shoulders to the upper back and ends in ragged, pointed tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown down the length; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips; colour 3 on the streak at the crown parting.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_02.differs: The female hair hangs longer, reaching the upper back, while the male version stops around shoulder length.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_03.description: Short, chin-length hair with choppy, spiky layers and a fringe across the forehead, topped by a tall crest of pointed blades on the crown, with small curved tendrils hanging near the temples.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips of the side and back locks; colour 3 and colour 2 on the crown spikes and temple tendrils, fading from one to the other.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_03.differs: The female version's crown crest is slightly taller and sits further back, with a shorter fringe.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_01.description: A short, tall mohawk-style hairstyle made of broad, pointed blade-like locks that fan up and back from the crown, with a few thin claw-like tendrils curling down at the temples and nape. Punky and monstrous.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the roots and most of each lock; colour 3 on the tips of the locks and tendrils.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_02.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with layered strands that end in sharp, spiky tips around the crown and nape. A separate flat fringe panel covers the forehead. The cut sits close to the head and stops above the neck.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and the fringe panel; colour 1 on the spiky tips and the ends of the strands.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_04.description: Long, layered, wavy hair swept back from a central parting, with a smooth crown and ragged, tapered tips that fall past the shoulders to the upper back. Loose, slightly tousled strands give a casual, flowing look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the mid-length strands and highlights toward the tips; colour 2 on the underlayer and ends; colour 3 on the parting streak at the front.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_04.differs: The female version falls longer, to the upper back, while the male version stops around shoulder length.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_05.description: A chin-length bob of layered, feathery hair in pointed locks, with a heavy fringe swept over the forehead and eyes. The cut is full and rounded around the head, with jagged tips at the nape and sides.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the fringe and upper locks; colour 1 on the tips of the lower locks; colour 3 on the crown streak.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_06.description: A high ponytail hairstyle with swept-back top hair, a tie at the crown, and a long tail of layered spiky locks that curls out and down behind the head, with jagged side-swept bangs framing the face at chin length.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and main mass of the hair; colour 1 on the tips of the bangs and side locks; colour 2 on the ends of the ponytail; colour 3 on the hair tie.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_06.differs: The female version's hair is chin length, with bangs that sweep off the forehead to the sides. A contrasting band shows across the forehead.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_01.description: Short, chin-length hair with a smooth swept-back crown, side-parted bangs falling over the forehead, and long jagged, spiky strands that flick outward around the ears and nape. Gives a punky, energetic look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth swept crown at the top; colour 1 on the spiky strands and bangs below, fading from the crown.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_01.differs: The female hair reaches about chin length, slightly longer than the male version.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_02.description: A tall swept-back ponytail of layered, jagged locks rising from a central strip over the crown, gathered by a small band at the back of the head and trailing to neck length with spiky, tapering tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair, fading toward colour 2 at the lower tips; colour 3 on the hair band.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_07.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of layered, swept-back wavy locks with jagged pointed tips, a messy fringe falling over the forehead and tapered layers covering the nape and sides of the head.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips of the locks and underlayers; colour 3 on the crown at the top of the head.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_08.description: Neck-length swept-back hair with a V-shaped widow's peak hairline, a heavy fringe falling over the eyes, and long tapering layered strands that hang loose down the back and sides, ending in ragged points.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_08.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 3 on the crown and top of the head; colour 1 on the tips of the strands and the fringe ends.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_09.description: A chin-length wavy bob of layered, tousled locks with jagged pointed tips. A side parting sweeps a heavy fringe across the forehead, and the hair sits full and rounded over the head and nape.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_09.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on streaks through the wavy locks; colour 3 on the parting at the crown; colour 2 on the darker tips at the ends.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_09.differs: The female bob is neater and rounder, with the fringe swept to one side and clear of the eyes.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_10.description: A tall mohawk of long, pointed feather-like spikes running in a narrow strip from forehead to nape, fanning upward and sweeping back into a tapering tail at the neck. The sides of the head are left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper tips of the spikes; colour 0 on the mid-length of the spikes; colour 3 on the roots along the scalp; colour 2 on the tapering tail and lower spike edges.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_11.description: A chin-length bob with a centre parting, layered streaky strands and jagged pointed tips. Long side-swept bangs fall over the forehead, and the hair frames the face and covers the nape in a neat rounded shape.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_11.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and streaks; colour 1 on the lower tips and ends; colour 3 on the roots along the parting; colour 2 in shading streaks between strands.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_11.differs: The female bob is neater and rounder with sharper, more even tips, and the bangs sit more sharply over the eyes.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_12.description: A short, chin-length swept hairstyle with layered, feathery locks that swoop back from a central parting, blunt fringe across the forehead and jagged pointed tips at the nape and sides. Suggests a wild, animal-like superhero look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Heroic_12.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 3 on the strip along the centre parting; colour 1 on the swept tips of the upper locks; colour 2 on the fringe and jagged lower tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Hyena_01.description: A wild, mohawk-like hairstyle of sharp, tapering spiky locks: a tall crest runs from the forehead over the crown and down the back of the neck, with jagged clumps splaying out to one side. The sides of the head look shaved.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the crest and the roots of the central strip; colour 1 on the tips of the central strip down the back; colour 3 on the splayed spiky clumps on one side; colour 2 at the roots of those clumps.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Hyena_02.description: A narrow mohawk-style crest of layered, jagged spiky locks running front to back along the centre of the head, sweeping down past the nape to a pointed tail at shoulder length; the sides of the head stay bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Hyena_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and upper locks, fading into colour 1 toward the pointed tips of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Hyena_03.description: A short, tall hairstyle of sharp, jagged spikes swept back and to the side from a gathered tuft on top of the head, with long pointed locks and bare shaved sides. Punk, beast-like look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Hyena_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the roots and top tuft of the hair; colour 3 on the spiky tips and lengths of the locks.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Kangaroo_01.description: Chin-length hair swept back into layered, choppy locks that flick outward at the nape, with a tall cluster of pointed, flame-like tufts rising at the front hairline. Wild, punky beast-like styling.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair mass; colour 1 on the ends of the back and side locks and the fringe band at the brow; colour 3 on the front tuft panels; colour 2 on the tips of the pointed tufts.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Knitcap_01.description: A short, close-fitting cap of hair that covers the top and back of the head, with a jagged, zigzag fringe across the brow and a choppy edge at the nape. It leaves the ears partly uncovered and gives a rough, unkempt look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Knitcap_01.differs: The female version sits slightly shorter, with a bit more of the ears and neck showing.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Krampus_01.description: A short, wild hairstyle made of overlapping pointed shards or blades that bristle outward over the crown, sides and back of the head, with a swept-back crest on top; gives a monstrous, spiky look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer bladed shards; colour 1 on the large front and crown plates and many back spikes; colour 2 on the crest panels; colour 3 on a few small accent spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Layered_01.description: A shoulder-length layered hairstyle with a voluminous, tousled crown, choppy feathered layers and a heavy fringe sweeping over the eyes; the ends are ragged and wispy, giving a shaggy, edgy look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Layered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tips and lower ends; colour 3 on scattered streaks and patches across the top and back; colour 2 on shaded strands around the fringe and sides.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Layered_01.differs: The female version hangs to shoulder length with a longer, lower back and sides.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Lizard_01.description: A single swept-over lock of hair, gathered high on one side of the crown, with a smooth banded top that tapers into long pointed strands hanging to chin level. The rest of the head stays bare, giving an asymmetric, edgy look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth banded top and upper strands; colour 1 on the tips of the long hanging strands; colour 3 on the inner spiky strands; colour 2 on the gathered knot at the crown.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Llama_01.description: A short, choppy hairstyle of layered, jagged locks with a fringe over the forehead and small horn-like tufts at the crown. Tapered tips end above the jaw. Wild, messy, beast-like styling.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top layer and crown tufts; colour 2 on the middle layer, mostly at the sides and back; colour 0 on the lower tips and fringe.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Llama_01.differs: The female version is slightly shorter, ending above the jaw with a slightly shorter fringe.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Long_01.description: Long hair with a centre parting and loose face-framing strands, falling in streaky, tapered locks to the upper back. Wispy pointed tips hang down at the front, giving a loose, tousled style.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaky stripes running down the locks; colour 1 on the underlayer and the front tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Long_01.differs: This version reaches the upper back, while the male version stops at the shoulders.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Long_02.description: Long, straight hair parted in the middle and swept back from the face, falling in streaky strands to mid-back with a ragged, jagged hem. Smooth and sleek, with a natural, casual look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 form the streaky strands over the crown and upper lengths; colour 1 tints the lower lengths and ends of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Long_Loose_01.description: Shoulder-length loose hairstyle with layered, choppy strands, long side-swept bangs that fall over the forehead and eyes, and jagged pointed tips at the back and sides. Casual, tousled look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Long_Loose_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair mass; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Longelegant_01.description: Long, sleek hairstyle with a centre parting, swept smoothly over the crown and falling straight to the shoulders in streaked strands, with a longer curved lock framing each side of the face and jagged, ragged ends.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Longelegant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad streaks across the top and back; colour 2 on the strands framing the face and the darker streaks; colour 1 on the ragged tips and lower underlayer.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Longelegant_01.differs: The female hair falls to shoulder length with longer face-framing locks that hang lower at the front.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Longpigs_01.description: Long twin pigtails set high on the sides of the head, with short swept-back hair on top and tapering tips that fall past the shoulders. Each pigtail is tied with a small band and the strands have a striped, streaky texture.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Longpigs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair base; colour 2 on the streaks running through the hair; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the pigtails; colour 3 on the hair bands.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Lycan_01.description: A short, chin-length wild hairstyle: a smooth, pointed crest sweeping up and back over the crown, with jagged, choppy fringe and ragged tufts around the hairline and small spikes at the sides.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main smooth crest of the hair; colour 1 on the jagged fringe and lower layer; colour 3 on the streaks running through the lower tufts.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Marie_Curie_Frizzy_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with a rounded, puffy fringe across the forehead, a smooth cap over the crown, and a gathered bun at the back with stray frizzy wisps sticking out around the nape and sides.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Marie_Curie_Frizzy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front fringe and the sides of the puffy hair; colour 1 on the crown and upper back; colour 3 on the small patch at the top of the crown; colour 2 on the bun at the back.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Marie_Curie_Smooth_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle with a smooth, close-fitting cap of hair swept back from a rounded fringe over the brow, gathered into a low rounded bun at the back of the head. Neat, vintage-scientist look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Marie_Curie_Smooth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fringe and side hair near the face; colour 1 on the crown and upper back of the head; colour 3 on the small parting patch at the top; colour 2 on the bun and the lower back hair.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Martial_Power_01.description: A tall high ponytail gathered at the crown by a band, with a long tapering tail sweeping to mid-back, short side bangs and a few thin contrasting locks framing the face; sleek, martial-arts styling.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair; colour 1 on the lower tips of the ponytail; colour 2 on the thin strands and the swept tuft at the top; colour 3 on the hair band.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Martial_Power_02.description: A tall, high ponytail gathered at the crown by a short banded tie, falling in a long tapered sweep to mid-back with sharp blade-like locks and a few thin strands at the sides. Martial, warrior style.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair; colour 1 on the tapered tips; colour 2 on the darker streaks and top tuft; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Messy_01.description: A short messy hairstyle with tall, swept-up spiky strands on top, a side-swept fringe over the forehead, and straight layered hair cut at nape length across the back and sides.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Messy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hairstyle, with darker shading in the underlayer at the crown and back of the head.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Messylong_01.description: Shoulder-length messy hair with wavy, streaked strands swept back from the forehead and falling loosely around the head, ending in ragged, choppy tips that flick outward at the ends.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Messylong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and highlight streaks; colour 2 on the streaks between the strands; colour 1 on the tips of the strands.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Messylong_02.description: Mid-back length messy hair with a centre-swept top, wavy strands falling past the shoulders and over the chest, and ragged, jagged tips. Loose and tousled, with a casual, wild look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Messylong_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair roots and upper lengths, with streaks running through it; colour 1 on the ragged lower lengths and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Messymohawk_01.description: A short, messy mohawk hairstyle: a tall crest of jagged spikes runs front to back over the crown, flanked by a fuller cap of choppy strands and a shaved-looking underlayer, with loose fringe falling across the face.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Messymohawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cap and side strands; colour 2 on the spiky crest at the front and top; colour 3 on the rear crest spikes and back strip; colour 0 on the shaved underlayer and fringe tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Messyshort_01.description: A short, messy cropped hairstyle of jagged, spiky layered locks that sweep forward into a ragged fringe over the forehead and stay tight at the nape, with small spikes sticking up on top.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Messyshort_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and back of the hair; colour 1 on the front fringe and side locks; colour 3 on the roots at the hairline and nape.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Messyshort_02.description: A chin-length messy bob with layered, wavy strands that fall from a centre parting, with ragged uneven tips and choppy fringe strands falling across the forehead; it covers the back and sides of the head.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Messyshort_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair strands; colour 1 and colour 2 on alternating streaks running through the strands, giving a striped look.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Mohawk_01.description: A single-strip mohawk: a narrow crest of swept, ridged hair running from the forehead over the crown to the nape, standing tall and angular on top with the sides of the head left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Mohawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair strip and its speckled edges; colour 1 on the streaks along the ridges and strands.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Mullet_Long_01.description: A shoulder-length spiky mullet: a tall crown of jagged, radiating spikes on top, long ragged fringe over the forehead, and long tapering shards hanging down the back and sides with streaked banding.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Mullet_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaked stripes through the strands; colour 1 on the tips of the long lengths.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Pigtail_Braids_01.description: Short, neck-length hair swept back over the head with a striped pattern, tied into two high pigtails on either side. Each pigtail is braided and loops up then down, bound with ribbon ties and ending in a pointed tip.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Pigtail_Braids_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair cap and the upper braid loops; colour 1 on the lower braided sections and pointed tips; colour 3 on the ribbon ties; colour 2 on the striping through the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A chin-length layered bob with a centre parting, jagged choppy tips and long side-swept fringe that falls across the forehead and one eye; the hair sits close to the crown and frames the face.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, back and fringe; colour 1 on the strands along the sides; colour 3 on the inner side layers and tips; colour 2 on the front side sections near the face.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.differs: The female fringe sweeps across the face with the contrasting section as a lower side panel, while the male version has a heavier contrasting hood-like front.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: Two thin twisted braids hang in front of the ears, each curving up to a pointed tip at the temple. Each braid is bound by a rune-marked band and ends in a small cuff and tuft; the rest of the head stays bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the twisted braid strands; colour 3 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the small cuffs; colour 1 on the tufted ends.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.differs: The female braids hang longer, to shoulder length, with the bands and tufts sitting lower on the chest.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.description: Long straight hair with a choppy fringe swept across the forehead, falling in one smooth mass down the back to upper-back length and ending in jagged, feathered points. Pirate-flavoured and casual.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fringe and top of the hair; colour 2 on the crown and part line; colour 3 on the mid-length strands; colour 0 on the tips of the lower hair.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.differs: The female version hangs longer, reaching the upper back, with longer tapered tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Ponytail_01.description: A sleek high ponytail: hair pulled tight over the scalp in streaked strands, gathered by a small band at the crown, with a long tapering tail falling to the upper back and a short fringe across the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Ponytail_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the streaked strands over the scalp; colour 2 on the darker streaks and the top of the tail; colour 1 on the tapering tail ends; colour 3 on the hair band.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Ponytail_02.description: A high ponytail hairstyle with short, swept-back hair over the head and a long tapering tail gathered by a small band at the crown; a pointed fringe lock falls down the forehead. Sleek, streaky strands.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Ponytail_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair; colour 2 on the streaks running through the strands; colour 1 on the tip of the ponytail and the fringe lock; colour 3 on the hair band.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Ponytail_02.differs: The female version has a narrow pointed fringe lock falling over the face, and the ponytail hangs a little longer.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_01.description: A short, chin-length punk hairstyle of layered, swept strands with a long side-swept fringe that falls across one eye, a couple of small pointed tufts on top, and a jagged, choppy edge at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the swept side fringe; colour 3 on the roots at the crown and on the tips at the nape.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_02.description: A chin-length punk hairstyle of swept, layered strands combed heavily to one side, with a long fringe falling across the brow and jagged, sheared ends at the nape. Small pointed tufts stick up on top.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair strands; colour 3 on the roots and the jagged tips at the back and crown; colour 1 on the sweeping side fringe.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_03.description: Chin-length, choppy hair with jagged pointed tips and a long swept fringe that falls over the eyes, topped by a slouchy soft beret-like cap perched on one side of the head.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 3 on the tips of the hair locks; colour 1 on the cap.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_04.description: A tall, narrow mohawk of swept-back hair strands forming a central ridge from forehead to nape, with jagged spiky tips along the crest and sides. Sides of the head are left bare, giving a punk look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 1 on the underlayer and inner spikes; colour 3 on the pointed tips along the crest.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_05.description: A short chin-length punk hairstyle with choppy, jagged layered tips at the fringe and nape, and a large swept-over lock that curls across the front and side of the head, giving a swooping, rebellious look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and jagged tips; colour 1 on the large swooping front lock; colour 3 on the accent streaks along the edge of the swoop.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_Long_01.description: A neck-length punk bob with a centre parting, heavy side-swept fringe over the eyes, and streaks of striped layering. Jagged, spiky contrasting tufts hang at the front and back edges, giving a choppy, edgy look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaks running through it; colour 1 on the fringe underlayer; colour 3 on the jagged spiky tufts at the front and back.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_Shaved_01.description: A short punk hairstyle: a swept-back strip of choppy, layered locks running front to back along the top of the head, with the sides and nape left shaved. Jagged tips give it an edgy look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_Shaved_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the highlighted strands; colour 1 on the main body of the hair; colour 2 on the shadowed streaks between locks.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_Short_01.description: A sparse punk hairstyle of spiky, tapering strands: a short fringe of jagged locks sweeps across the forehead, with two long pointed sideburn-like locks hanging down past the ears to neck length. The crown is left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Punk_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the strands, fading toward colour 2 at the roots; the scalp is left bare.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Reactor_01.description: A hood-like mechanical head covering made of parallel padded, segmented tubes that sweep from a peaked brow back over the head and drape to the shoulders, ending in blunt hexagonal tips. Sits over the scalp and leaves the face open.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top segments near the brow and crown; colour 2 on the upper-middle bands; colour 3 on the lower middle bands; colour 0 on the brow edge and the tube tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Rock_01.description: A short cap of rocky hair: angular stone shards and cracked plates cover the crown, with jagged crystals bristling outward around the edge. Sits close to the skull above the jaw for a monstrous, mineral look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Rock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone shards and plates; colour 3 on the cracked seams between plates; the texture shows little variation from the other slots.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Rock_01.differs: The female version has a smaller cluster of larger, chunkier shards with wide cracked plates on top and a more open, jagged fringe; the male has a denser, overlapping shard pattern.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Rocker_01.description: A wild, shaggy rocker hairstyle with tall, teased and spiky layers on top, choppy strands falling over the face, and a long ragged mane reaching the upper back with a few darker tapered tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on streaks through the strands; colour 2 on the darker tips and underside strands; colour 3 on the front fringe tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Secret_03.description: A short, chin-length casual hairstyle with layered, swept-back strands on top, a side-swept fringe falling over the forehead, and jagged, choppy tips over the nape and ears. Suits everyday or edgy looks.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and fringe strands; colour 1 on the mid layer at the sides and back; colour 2 on the jagged lower tips; colour 3 as a soft tint at the crown.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Secret_04.description: A chin-length bob with a centre-ish parting and long streaky strands that sweep down over one side of the face like a fringe, ending in ragged, jagged tips around the jaw and nape.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 blend across the strands in streaks; colour 3 tints the hair along the parting at the crown.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Secret_04.differs: The female bob is neater and rounder, with a heavier side-swept fringe covering one eye and a slightly shorter, tidier back.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Shortpigs_01.description: Short chin-length hairstyle with a cropped fringe and two high, chunky pigtails tied at the crown with thin ribbons. The pigtails flare into pointed, faceted tips that sit above and behind the ears, with a striped pattern throughout.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Shortpigs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and stripe base; colour 2 on the stripe markings; colour 1 on the tips of the pigtails; colour 3 on the ribbon ties.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Side_Bee_Hive_01.description: A tall, egg-shaped beehive hairstyle piled high above the head and ending around chin level, with streaky swept strands and a small twisted band across the front hairline. Smooth, rounded, retro styling.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Side_Bee_Hive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crown of the hair; colour 1 on the lower strands and streaks; colour 2 on the darkest streaks near the base and the front band shadows.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Side_Buns_01.description: Short, chin-length hair with a choppy fringe across the forehead and two rounded buns high on either side of the head, each tied with a hanging ribbon. Striped streaks run through the strands, giving a cute, playful look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Side_Buns_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the striping through the hair; colour 1 on the two buns; colour 3 on the ribbons.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Side_Buns_Kung_Fu_01.description: A short, chin-length cropped hairstyle with choppy fringe and a striped pattern, topped by two rounded side buns at the crown, each wrapped in a cover with two hanging ribbon tails. Kung-fu inspired look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Side_Buns_Kung_Fu_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 2 on the stripe pattern through the hair; colour 1 on the bun covers; colour 3 on the dangling ribbons.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Snakes_01.description: A shoulder-length Medusa-style hairstyle made of a writhing mass of spotted snakes with open mouths and forked tongues, radiating outward from the scalp in all directions and hanging down around the neck.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Snakes_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the snake bodies; colour 2 on the spots and markings; colour 1 on the underbelly snakes visible beneath the scalp; the tongues show a separate pinkish tone.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Spikey_Long_01.description: A tall, swept-up hairstyle of sharp faceted spikes that fan outward from the crown, with shorter jagged locks around the sides and nape and a smooth band across the forehead. Anime-style and stylised.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Spikey_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and forehead band; colour 1 on the spike tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Spy_01.description: Neck-length layered hairstyle swept back from the forehead with long fringe strands falling over the eyes and face. Ends in jagged, flicked-out tips around the neck, giving a sleek, edgy spy look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair and swept-back strands; colour 2 on the mid-length transition; colour 1 on the lower tips and the fringe over the face.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Spy_02.description: A short, chin-length swept-back hairstyle with a tall rounded pompadour front, streaky strand texture, and short sideburn tabs down past the ears; a separate flat panel sits under the front fringe, covering the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and roots of the hair; colour 0 on the strand highlights toward the ends and sideburns; colour 2 on the panel under the front.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Straightlong_01.description: Long, straight hair parted in the centre and falling smoothly past the shoulders to mid-back, with streaky strands and ragged, jagged tips; some hair drapes forward over the chest and the rest hangs down the back.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Straightlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair and streaks near the scalp; colour 2 on the streaks between strands; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Straightshort_01.description: A chin-length straight bob with heavy blunt fringe covering the brow, swept-back layered strands over the crown, and a neat, sleek cut that hugs the head and ends level at the jaw.
