Female/F_Hair_Face_Straightshort_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and front strands of the hair; colour 1 on the mid-layer at the sides and back; colour 2 on the blunt fringe and the lower ends of the bob.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Suave_Wolf_01.description: A short, tall-crested mohawk-style hairstyle: a narrow central fin of layered, feather-like locks sweeping up and forward into pointed tips, with small side spikes; the sides of the head are left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Suave_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the crest; colour 1 on the tall front tip; colour 2 on the darker tips of the side points; colour 3 on the small side spike.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Swoop_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with a tall swept-up crest of jagged, spiky strands on top, heavy blunt-cut fringe across the forehead, and smooth tapered sides and back that hug the head.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Swoop_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair overall, with the shading of the strands varying along their length.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Tight_Middleparted_Me.description: Shoulder-length hair parted in the middle, falling in loose, slightly wavy strands that frame the face and end in ragged, uneven tips just above the shoulders. A casual, natural look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Tight_Middleparted_Me.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and the strand highlights; colour 2 on the darker strand streaks; colour 1 on the tips of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Tight_Swoop_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle swept back tightly over the crown in streaky strands, then falling straight around the head to jagged, uneven ends at the jaw. The fringe covers the forehead and eyes.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Tight_Swoop_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept-back top and crown strands; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips; colour 2 in the streaks between strands.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Undercut_01.description: A short undercut hairstyle: closely cropped sides and back with a fringe over the forehead, topped by a tall, swept-back mass of jagged, feathered strands that sits like a crest above a shaved-looking band.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Undercut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the short sides, back and fringe; colour 1 on the tall swept top section; colour 2 on the band beneath the top layer at the back.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Anime_01.description: Upper-back-length anime-style hair with a side-swept fringe falling over one eye, streaked strands, and two long front locks that hang over the chest and end in jagged, feathered tips.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and streaked strands; colour 2 on the darker streaks and crown; colour 1 on the jagged tips of the front locks.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Anime_01.differs: The female version is much longer, reaching the upper back with two long front locks with contrasting tips, while the male version is a short cut.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Buzz_Shapes_01.description: A close-cropped, skull-hugging buzz cut with jagged, flame-like spikes swept across the front hairline and horizontal slashed bands shaved into the sides and back. It gives a sleek, edgy urban look.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Buzz_Shapes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown and back bands; colour 1 on the front fringe spikes and the side slash tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Mohawk_01.description: A mohawk of long, tapering spikes in a single narrow row from forehead to nape, fanning out and sweeping back. The sides of the head stay bare. A punk look with a bold silhouette.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Mohawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bases near the scalp; colour 1 on the mid-length of each spike; colour 2 on the spike shafts between the mid-length and the tips; colour 3 on the spike tips.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Punk_01.description: A short, chin-length punk hairstyle with a spiky, tousled crown, choppy layered strands and long side-swept fringe sweeping across the forehead; the tips are streaked with contrasting bands and the nape is cut short.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown and upper hair; colour 1 and colour 3 on the streaked lower strands and fringe tips; colour 2 on the darker inner strands at the back.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Urban_Punk_01.differs: The female version has a longer side-swept fringe that falls across one eye, leaving more of the face visible.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Villain_01.description: A short, neat cropped hairstyle with textured strands swept back and to the side from the crown, a straight-cut fringe over the forehead, and a tapered back that ends at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on most of the hair; colour 1 on streaks through the top and sides; colour 2 on the fringe and the ends of the hair.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Villain_01.differs: The female hair is smooth and neatly trimmed with a short, tidy outline, without the spiky tufts or the light tips of the male version.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Villain_02.description: Short, chin-length layered hairstyle with a swept-over top, jagged feathered strands flicking out at the sides and front, and a shaved-looking nape with a gradient. Sits close to the head with punky edges.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Villain_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the streaks through the top and sides; colour 2 on the band at the lower back; colour 0 on the tips at the nape and fringe.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Villain_02.differs: The female version has longer jagged, flicked-out locks at the sides and front and a sweeping side lock, while the male version is a smooth, compact cut.

Female/F_Hair_Face_Wedding_Upsweep_01.description: A formal hairstyle with hair swept smoothly up and back into a rounded bun at the crown, with swirling strands across the top and a short tapered nape; small curled wisps sit by the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Face_Wedding_Upsweep_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 2 on the swirling streaks through the strands; colour 1 on subtle shading in the nape strands.

Female/F_Hair_Facemask_Chaosman_01.description: Short cropped hairstyle of jagged, faceted spikes forming a flat-topped crest across the crown, with a few longer separate spikes at the front hairline; the sides and back of the head are bare.
Female/F_Hair_Facemask_Chaosman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes at the sides and back; colour 1 on the top of the crest; colour 2 on the front fringe spikes and the small strands at the hairline.

Female/F_Hair_Facemask_Chaosman_02.description: Short, spiky hair with jagged shards standing up on top and a fringe of sharp spikes at the front. A close-cropped band of hair wraps the sides and back of the head, ending above the jaw.
Female/F_Hair_Facemask_Chaosman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes of the crown; colour 1 on the tips and top of the spikes; colour 2 on the front fringe spikes; colour 3 on the cropped sides and back.

Female/F_Hair_Fennec_01.description: A short, crest-style hairstyle of layered swept locks that rise into several sharp, curved points along the centre of the head, like fox-ear tufts. The sides of the head are left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and body of the locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of each lock.

Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Braid_01.description: A single long braid of hair that hangs down the back from the crown to upper-back length, banded partway down and ending in a small angular, fin-like bow or tip with pointed flares.
Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Braid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the braid strands and the bow tip; colour 2 on the band near the top of the braid; colour 1 on the inner strand sections and the bow's side flares; colour 3 on a small accent at the centre of the bow.

Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Braid_02.description: A single long braid-like ponytail that rises from a hollow socket at the back of the head and hangs down the spine to upper-back length, with a banded segment near the top and a pointed, tapered tip.
Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Braid_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main length of the braid and the socket top; colour 2 on the band near the top; colour 1 on the mid-length panels and tip segment; colour 3 on small accents at the tip.

Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Med_01.description: A striped, fur-textured neck sleeve that wraps the whole neck like a short cowl, with a raggedly pointed lower edge that flares onto the shoulders, front and back. It leaves the head bare and reads as beastly.
Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Med_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 2 on the stripes; colour 1 on the shaggy tips at the lower edge.

Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Ponytail_01.description: A high ponytail of thick, tapering hair, gathered at the crown by a rounded tie and sweeping back and down to a point at shoulder length, with streaked stripes running along its length; the rest of the head is bare.
Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Ponytail_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 2 on the streaked stripes through it; colour 3 on the round hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Short_01.description: A chin-length straight hair piece worn as a hanging curtain that wraps around the lower head, with jagged, uneven tips and a striped, animal-like fur pattern; it sits low, meant to pair with head wear.
Female/F_Hair_Fullhelmet_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair body and stripe base; colour 2 on the stripes; colour 1 on the fading tips of the strands.

Female/F_Hair_Gladiator_01.description: A swept-back hairstyle with a close-cropped, shaved-looking sides and back and a voluminous swept top, plus a long single plait draped over one shoulder and down the chest, tied off with a band near the tip.
Female/F_Hair_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept top hair and the plait highlights; colour 1 on the fading tips, the lower hair and the plait strands; colour 3 on the band tying the plait; colour 2 on the cropped sides and back.
Female/F_Hair_Gladiator_01.differs: The female plait hangs longer, reaching the upper back and chest, and the cropped sides sit tighter to the head.

Female/F_Hair_Gladiator_02.description: Shoulder-length wavy hair swept back and to the side from a raised, smooth crown, with layered strands that curl and flick outward at the ends. Sits over the head and falls behind the shoulders.
Female/F_Hair_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the roots and upper hair; colour 1 on the lower lengths and curled tips as a gradient; colour 2 on the small band at the front hairline.

Female/F_Hair_Gladiator_Helmet_01.description: A single long braid attached at the side of the head by a small helmet-like cap, hanging past the shoulder over the front of the chest, with a tie near the end and a loose tapered tuft.
Female/F_Hair_Gladiator_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cap and the braid strands and tuft; colour 0 on the highlight strands between the braid plaits; colour 3 on the tie band.
Female/F_Hair_Gladiator_Helmet_01.differs: The female braid hangs longer, reaching to upper-back length, with the tuft ending lower over the chest.

Female/F_Hair_Goat_01.description: A chin-length asymmetric hairstyle: a swept side fringe of layered, pointed locks falls over one side of the face, while the rest of the head is left bare. The tips are jagged and spiky, with a hollow underside at the back.
Female/F_Hair_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the long sweeping front fringe strand; colour 2 on the tapered lower tips; colour 3 on the short strand at the side.

Female/F_Hair_Goat_02.description: A chin-length hairstyle of jagged, choppy layers with a large swept-up tuft over the forehead, a separate side section and a small tuft at the crown. Ragged, pointed tips frame the face and nape.
Female/F_Hair_Goat_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept front tuft and crown tuft; colour 0 on the side sections; colour 2 on the upper back and top of the hair; colour 3 on the fringe and the lower tips.
Female/F_Hair_Goat_02.differs: The female version has a shorter chin-length cut with the fringe swept aside, leaving the face more open.

Female/F_Hair_Guardian_01.description: A small sculpted hair tuft at the back of the head, hanging down the nape as a tapering, twisted lock with layered swept-back spikes like dragon fins; it ends in a sharp point near the neck.
Female/F_Hair_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the lock; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the swept spikes.
Female/F_Hair_Guardian_01.differs: The female lock hangs a little longer and thinner, reaching shoulder length with more widely spaced spikes.

Female/F_Hair_Halfhelmet_Med_01.description: Shoulder-length straight hair swept back tight against the scalp, with streaky strand lines running down its length and a ragged, jagged-cut hem that flicks slightly outward at the nape and behind the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Halfhelmet_Med_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaky strand stripes; colour 1 on the jagged tips at the ends.

Female/F_Hair_Halfhelmet_Med_03.description: Shoulder-length straight hair swept back from the face and hugging the skull, with streaky striped strands falling down the back and ending in a ragged, jagged hem at the neck.
Female/F_Hair_Halfhelmet_Med_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaks running down the strands; colour 1 on the tips of the hair at the ends.

Female/F_Hair_Halfhelmet_Short_01.description: A chin-length hair piece with straight, sleek strands swept back from a centre parting, covering the crown and back of the head. The ends are jagged and the front falls in a heavy fringe over the forehead and eyes.
Female/F_Hair_Halfhelmet_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair; colour 2 on the streaked stripe pattern through the strands; colour 1 on the tips of the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Helmet_Harajuku_Pigtails_0.description: Chin-length hair with a centre parting, swept smoothly over the head and gathered into two low pigtails at the nape, each tied with a small bow; a decorative clip sits at each temple. Cute, playful Harajuku style.
Female/F_Hair_Helmet_Harajuku_Pigtails_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 on the hair strands, with colour 1 as a tint in the highlights; colour 3 on the bows and the temple clips.

Female/F_Hair_Highrise_01.description: A boxy, flat-topped high-top hairstyle with a textured, rough surface that fades toward the lower edge. It has a squared front hairline with an angular cut-out above the brow, short sideburn points, and a straight cropped nape.
Female/F_Hair_Highrise_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper, textured part of the hair; colour 0 on the lower, faded part; colour 2 on the angular front cut-out panel.

Female/F_Hair_Kabuki_01.description: Very long, tall kabuki-style hair: a big swept-up crown with a starburst of spiky strands on top, two front locks of jagged tips framing the face, and a long tapering mane down the back past the waist.
Female/F_Hair_Kabuki_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the starburst at the top of the crown; colour 3 on the front locks; colour 2 on the lower length of the mane.

Female/F_Hair_Kitty_01.description: Short, swept hairstyle of sculpted spiky locks piled on top of the head and combed to one side, with pointed tips over the forehead and temple; the sides and back of the head are left bare, giving a punky, feline look.
Female/F_Hair_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair mass; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_65_01.description: A chin-length swept hairstyle with a long side-swept fringe and streaked strands, gathered into a tall top bun held by an ornate metal clasp with a central gem and curling horn-like prongs.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hair and bun; colour 2 on the streaked strands; colour 0 on the metal clasp; colour 3 on the gem in the clasp.

Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_65_02.description: Long, loose wavy hair gathered into a tall top knot on the crown, fastened with a small pointed clasp, with the rest falling in layered locks to the upper back and framing strands at the face.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hair mass and top knot; colour 2 on the darker streaks framing the face and sides; colour 0 on the clasp at the base of the knot.

Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_65_03.description: Chin-length swept hair with a long side-swept fringe and streaked strands, gathered into a tall round topknot at the crown. A metal ornamental clasp with curved horn-like prongs and a central gem wraps the bun base.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_65_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hair and bun; colour 2 on the streaks in the fringe and sides; colour 0 on the metal clasp; colour 3 on the gem in the clasp.

Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_65_04.description: Long, loose wavy hair worn in a half-up style, with a small top knot gathered by a pointed clasp above the crown. The rest falls in layered, tapered locks to the upper back, with a few contrasting strands framing the face.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_65_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hair and top knot; colour 0 on the clasp band around the knot; colour 2 on the accent strands at the temples and sides.

Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_66_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle built from overlapping feather-like layered plates that fan back from the forehead over the crown, with short jagged fringe at the front and sharp pointed tips flicking out around the nape and sides, plus a small horn-like spike at the back.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the feather plates; colour 0 on the fanned plates at the front of the crown; colour 2 on the back and underside of the plates; colour 3 on the spiky tips and the small horn spike.

Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_01.description: Mid-back hairstyle with a short blunt fringe over the eyes, hair swept back into a thin braided band around the head, and four long twisted locks with bulbous knots and pointed tips hanging over the shoulders.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass, fringe and head braid; colour 1 on the four hanging knotted locks.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The female version has hanging locks that fall in front of and behind the shoulders, with two in front and two behind. The male version has them mostly at the front and back of the chest.

Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_02.description: Chin-length, tousled hair with a deep centre-ish part, wavy layered strands, long fringe falling over the eyes, and a curling contrasting front section that sweeps to one side with flicked-out ends at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the swept front section, curled fringe locks and the strands at one side.

Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_03.description: Mid-back length hair with a blunt fringe over the eyes and a smooth swept-back crown held by a thin braided band; two long segmented braids hang forward over each shoulder, tied into tapered bulbs.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and the braided band; colour 1 on the hanging braids and their tapered tips.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_03.differs: The female version has two braids hanging in front over the chest, while the male version has four braids split between front and back.

Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_04.description: Chin-length, tousled, layered hair with a deep side-swept fringe falling over the eyes, wavy shaggy ends and a few curled, flicked locks at the front and sides; a tapered, choppy back.
Female/F_Hair_Lockbox_67_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the front fringe and side section of curling locks.

Female/F_Hair_Mad_Scientist_01.description: A short, wild hairstyle of stiff, jagged spikes sitting close over the crown and reaching around the sides and back of the head, with a raised central tuft and banded sections of hair.
Female/F_Hair_Mad_Scientist_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light bands at the front hairline and back; colour 1 on the central tuft and the broad banded patches; colour 2 on the swept spikes on top; colour 3 on small side panels.

Female/F_Hair_Mad_Scientist_02.description: Tall, swept-back hairstyle with a voluminous rounded crown, streaked strands and jagged spiky tips fanning out at the back and top; short side pieces sit over the ears, with a pointed hairline at the forehead.
Female/F_Hair_Mad_Scientist_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiky tips, back and hairline; colour 1 on the top and front of the hair and the strands at the ears; colour 3 on the side panels above the ears.

Female/F_Hair_Mindslayer_01.description: Long, loose, wavy hair combed back from a centre parting, falling in layered strands to the upper back, with curling ringlet tips that hang forward past the shoulders and over the face.
Female/F_Hair_Mindslayer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown down to the mid-length; colour 1 on the lower strands and curling tips, fading in gradually.

Female/F_Hair_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A swept-back, shoulder-length hairstyle piled tall on top in layered, sculpted locks that sweep back into a high ponytail with pointed tapering tips; a single lock falls forward beside the face.
Female/F_Hair_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the locks and the top; colour 1 on the inner strands and streaks beneath the outer layers; the tips shade toward colour 2.

Female/F_Hair_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: Long, straight, loose hair swept back from the face and hanging to mid-back, with a gradient toward the tips. Separate face-framing strands fall over the forehead and sides, with a few pointed locks at the ends.
Female/F_Hair_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass at the crown and lengths; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the hair; colour 2 on the strands framing the top of the face; colour 3 on the long front locks.
Female/F_Hair_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The female version hangs slightly longer, to mid-back, while the male version stops at the upper back.

Female/F_Hair_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: Upper-back-length wavy hair swept back from the face, with two thick curved front locks at the brow and loose layered waves ending in pointed tapered tips at the shoulder blades.
Female/F_Hair_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tapered tips, blending up from the ends; colour 2 on the two curved front locks.

Female/F_Hair_Monkey_01.description: Short, tall spiky hairstyle of layered flame-like blades swept upward into a pointed crest, sitting close above the jaw with a sharp pointed hairline at the forehead. Wild, anime-style look.
Female/F_Hair_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair blades; colour 1 on the shadowed edges and streaks between the blades.

Female/F_Hair_Moth_01.description: A full, hood-like mane of layered feathery tufts that wraps the whole head and frames the face, then drapes down over the shoulders and chest to a pointed fringe. Monstrous, moth-like look.
Female/F_Hair_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown of the head, fading into colour 1 across the rest of the tufts down to the tips.

Female/F_Hair_Moth_02.description: Upper-back-length swept-back hair made of layered, feather-like jagged locks, with a smooth crown, a pointed face-framing mask shape at the front and a fanned, tapering fall that drapes over the shoulders and upper back.
Female/F_Hair_Moth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper locks; colour 1 on the lower feathery tips and the underside layer; small claw-like tips at the front also take colour 0.
Female/F_Hair_Moth_02.differs: The female version falls in a narrower, more tapered fan that hangs more toward the back and sides.

Female/F_Hair_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.description: Chin-length swept-back hair with a voluminous top of wavy, layered locks ending in sharp pointed spikes, a shorter jagged lower layer around the nape and sides, and a single curved horn-like tip at the temple.
Female/F_Hair_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept upper hair and spikes; colour 1 on the shorter lower layer and fringe; colour 2 on the curved horn at the temple.

Female/F_Hair_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01_.description: Chin-length swept-back hairstyle with a voluminous top of wavy, flame-like locks ending in sharp pointed spikes, a shorter jagged underlayer around the nape and ears, and a small curved horn-like tip at the temple.
Female/F_Hair_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept upper locks; colour 1 on the shorter underlayer at the nape and fringe; colour 2 on the small curved horn tip at the temple.

Female/F_Hair_Qularr_Antenna_01.description: A pair of insect antennae: short segmented stubs at the brow above each eye that sweep back into long, thin tapering whiskers. Small and slender, worn on the forehead for an alien or insectoid look.
Female/F_Hair_Qularr_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the short base segments; colour 2 on the long tapering whiskers. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Hair_Qularr_Antennahelm_01.description: A shallow, angular alien crest plate that sits over the top of the head and points down to a V at the forehead. It has a mottled, blotchy surface and short curved horn spikes on each side.
Female/F_Hair_Qularr_Antennahelm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface and the horn spikes; colour 1 on the blotchy patches across the plate; colour 2 on the horn tips.

Female/F_Hair_Qularr_Antennahelm_02.description: A shallow, angular insect-like plate that sits over the top of the head like a cap, pitted with round dimples and pointing down to a tip at the brow, with three curved horn spikes rising along the crown ridge.
Female/F_Hair_Qularr_Antennahelm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the rounded dimples and the underside pits; colour 2 on the horn spikes and central ridge fin.

Female/F_Hair_Rave_01.description: A short, punky hairstyle with a tall, swept-back top of layered, feathery spiked strands, a shaved-looking undercut around the back and sides, and jagged locks falling over the forehead and temples.
Female/F_Hair_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top hair and fringe; colour 3 on the undercut sides and back and the forehead band; colour 1 on the tips of some strands; colour 2 on the shaded streaks in the top locks.

Female/F_Hair_Rave_02.description: A short, wild, feathery hairstyle with tall spiky tufts on top, a long swept fringe falling over one side of the face, and ragged layered strands ending around chin length. Suits a rave, punk or street look.
Female/F_Hair_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair and fringe; colour 3 on the feathery streaks over the top and back; colour 1 on the lower ends of the hair; colour 2 on the spiky tips and side strands.

Female/F_Hair_Rave_03.description: Shoulder-length spiky hair with heavy blunt fringe over the brow, tall swept-back layered spikes on top, and one long tapering lock hanging past the chin on one side; a jagged, punky rave look.
Female/F_Hair_Rave_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and crown strands; colour 0 as the highlight streaks in the crown; colour 2 on the mid lengths; colour 3 on the tips, the fringe ends and the long side lock.
Female/F_Hair_Rave_03.differs: The female version has a thicker fringe and a shorter, fuller back that ends at the nape.

Female/F_Hair_Rave_04.description: Two clusters of long, banded wire-like tendrils rising from clamp-like collars at each side of the head, hanging to upper-back length and ending in sharp pointed tips. A cyber-rave hairstyle with a mechanical, insectoid feel.
Female/F_Hair_Rave_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar clamps and alternating stripes of the tendrils; colour 1, colour 2 and colour 3 on the other alternating stripe bands, which vary between strands.

Female/F_Hair_Renegade_01.description: Shoulder-length, tousled wavy hair swept back and over the crown, with a band wrapped around the head and loose ribbon-like tails hanging at the temple. A contrasting visor-like fringe falls over the eyes with curled strands.
Female/F_Hair_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept-back hair; colour 1 on the headband; colour 3 on the dangling ribbon tails; colour 2 on the front fringe and the underside locks.

Female/F_Hair_Renegade_02.description: Swept-back, upper-back-length hair in long jagged strands that taper to pointed tips, with small curved horn-like fins above the brows and contrasting side tufts framing the face. Wild, alien-renegade look.
Female/F_Hair_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper hair mass and top layers; colour 0 on the lower tips and strands; colour 3 on the horn-like fins above the brows; colour 2 on the side tufts.
Female/F_Hair_Renegade_02.differs: The female version falls to the upper back and has a longer, more flowing back section.

Female/F_Hair_Renegade_Alt_01.description: A single asymmetric swept hair lock on one side of the head: a broad smooth sheet with a thin separate bang curling over the forehead, tapering to a curled point near chin level.
Female/F_Hair_Renegade_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the entire hair piece; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Hair_Renegade_Extra_01.description: Shoulder-length layered hair with wispy, tapered ends, swept back from the face under a wide band across the crown. A separate contrasting section hangs in loose curling locks at the front and one side, with no bangs.
Female/F_Hair_Renegade_Extra_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the band across the crown; colour 2 on the front and side locks and the strip under the band.
Female/F_Hair_Renegade_Extra_01.differs: The female hair is slightly longer, reaching shoulder length, with fuller tapered ends.

Female/F_Hair_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A short, choppy hairstyle of layered pointed locks radiating from a crown swirl, with a long side-swept fringe falling across the eyes. It ends around chin length and has a tousled retro feel.
Female/F_Hair_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base hair locks; colour 1 on the streaked strands running through the locks.

Female/F_Hair_Sasquatch_01.description: A pair of sideburns made of jagged, tapering hair tufts with serrated edges, hanging in front of the ears down to the jaw line. The pointed, beast-like shape suggests a monstrous look.
Female/F_Hair_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and inner parts of each tuft; colour 1 on the outer serrated edges; colour 2 on the tips.
Female/F_Hair_Sasquatch_01.differs: The female tufts are slightly shorter and more swept back, with longer, more curved points.

Female/F_Hair_Sidepeak_01.description: Chin-length, spiky hair swept up into tall jagged shards on top, with a forward-swept fringe tuft over the forehead and feathered wing-like locks at the temples; the back is layered in sharp spikes.
Female/F_Hair_Sidepeak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mass of spikes, fading toward colour 0 at the tips; colour 2 on the front fringe tuft; colour 3 on the swept temple locks.

Female/F_Hair_Swing_01.description: A short, swept hairstyle of layered pointed locks that comb across the forehead to one side, with spiky tips at the crown and nape. It sits close to the head and ends around ear to nape length.
Female/F_Hair_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the edges and tips of the strands and the shaded streaks between them.

Female/F_Hair_Swing_02.description: A chin-length wavy hairstyle with a voluminous swept crown and a side-parted fringe falling over the brow. The ends curl into glossy, flipped-out locks around the ears and nape, giving a retro swing look.
Female/F_Hair_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the curled lower locks and tips, blending up from the crown.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_01.description: A large, rounded afro hairstyle: a tall, puffy, textured mass of hair that sits high on the head and ends above the jaw, with small sideburn tufts by the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 blend across the hair mass as a mottled texture; colour 1 on the small sideburn tufts by the ears.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_01.differs: The female version sits slightly higher and leaves the forehead more open, with no lower fringe band across the brow.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_02.description: A short, rounded afro hairstyle: a tall, lumpy, cloud-like mass of curls sitting high on the head, with short sideburn tufts and a cropped nape that stays above the jaw.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled highlights across the top of the curls; colour 1 on the lower curls, sideburns and nape hair; colour 2 in the shadowed clumps.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_02.differs: The female afro sits taller and puffier on top, with no visible hairline band across the forehead.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_03.description: A short, rounded afro with a lumpy, textured surface that sits close to the head and ends above the jaw, with small pointed sideburn tufts in front of the ears and a slightly ragged lower edge.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mass of the hair, with colour 0 highlights and colour 2 shading across the surface; colour 1 on the sideburn tufts.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Arcane_01.description: A chin-length, tousled hairstyle swept up and back into wavy strands with two pointed, ear-like flares at the sides, worn with a knotted cloth headband tied at the front of the brow.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 1 on the knotted headband.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Arcane_02.description: A short, chin-length swept-back hairstyle with sculpted, feather-like layered locks, two curved tufts rising at the front, and contrasting swept panels at the temples. Fits close to the head with jagged tapering ends at the nape.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and nape locks; colour 1 on the two curved front tufts and the top streaks; colour 2 on the swept panels at the temples.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Buzzcutflared_0.description: A short, flat-topped buzzcut hairstyle that sits close to the head, with a squared crown, a flared front hairline and jagged, spiky patches at the temples and sides. It stops well above the jaw.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Buzzcutflared_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and main body of the hair; colour 1 on the jagged patches at the temples, sides and back of the head.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Cornrows_01.description: Short cornrow hairstyle of narrow raised braid ridges with gaps between them, running from the front hairline back and curving down the sides to the nape, hugging the skull closely.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Cornrows_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main braid ridges; colour 1 on the front tips of the braids; colour 2 on the lower ends near the nape.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Dreadsspikey_01.description: A hairstyle of many thin, tapering braided spikes radiating outward from the whole scalp like a sea urchin, with a tall crown and short spikes at the nape. Wild, punky and monstrous.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Dreadsspikey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main length of the braids; colour 3 on the spike tips; colour 1 on a few small accents near the scalp; colour 2 in the shadowed roots.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Golden_Age_02.description: A chin-length, retro-styled hairdo of sculpted swept waves across the top, ending in tight rolled curls around the sides and back, with a small clip at the side. Suggests a classic 1940s golden-age look.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Golden_Age_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top waves and highlights; colour 1 on the wave streaks and swirled bands throughout; colour 2 on the lower curls and underside; colour 3 on the small side clip.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Golden_Age_03.description: A chin-length wavy bob with heavy blunt fringe covering the brow, rippling wave texture throughout, and curled ends that flip outward at the sides and back, framing the face in a retro glamour style.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Golden_Age_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the crown and roots; colour 0 on the mid-length waves; colour 1 on the streaks between the waves and on the ends; colour 2 on the deepest shadowed strands near the tips.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Werewolf_01.description: A narrow mohawk of layered, pointed blade-like tufts running from the forehead over the crown and down to the nape, leaving the sides of the head bare. Feral and punk in style.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Face_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer tufts and most of the crest; colour 0 on the inner base and the front tufts.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A fan-shaped crest of many rigid, tapering quills or plumes radiating from a central point on the crown, sweeping up and back with angular, hooked tips. It suggests a fiery bird-like or tribal headdress.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the roots of the quills; colour 1 on the middle band of each quill; colour 2 on the transition below the tips; colour 3 on the outer tips.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Harajuku_Pigtails_01.description: Neck-length hair with a centre parting and a striped, zebra-like pattern, gathered into two short low pigtails tied with small bows, and decorated with several small hair clips at the fringe and sides. Cute, playful Harajuku style.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Harajuku_Pigtails_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 form the striped hair, with hints of colour 1 in the shading; colour 3 on the bows and hair clips.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Harajuku_Pigtails_02.description: A neck-length hairstyle with a centre parting and smooth swept sides, gathered into two short low pigtails tied with small bows. A pair of hair clips sits at each temple. Cute, schoolgirl-inspired styling.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Harajuku_Pigtails_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 on the hair strands in a striped pattern; colour 3 on the bows and the hair clips.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Rockabilly_01.description: A rockabilly hairstyle with a rounded, puffed crown swept up and over the forehead with short fringe, and a ring of long spiral ringlet curls hanging around the head to shoulder length. Retro pin-up style.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Rockabilly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and curls; colour 2 on the streaky striping through the hair; colour 3 on the small hair clip or band at the top of the crown; colour 1 as a faint tint in the curl shadows.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Rockabilly_01.differs: The female version has a rounded puffed crown with long hanging spiral ringlets, while the male version is a short swept-back quiff with no curls.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Victory_Rolls_0.description: Chin-length 1940s-style hair with a big swept-up roll over the forehead that falls across the brow, smooth waves down the back, and curled rolls at the ends by the jaw and neck. Retro pin-up styling.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Victory_Rolls_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and top roll; colour 1 on the curled ends and undersides; colour 2 on the streaky wave lines running through the hair.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.description: A short punk hairstyle with swept-back streaked hair, a pointed widow's-peak fringe and long spiky strands falling in front of the ears. Spiky tufts crown the back of the head; ends around chin length.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.colourAreas: The hair uses a streaked texture blending colour 0 at the top with colour 1 toward the tips; colour 3 and colour 2 appear as streaks and shading toward the back and crown.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.differs: The female version has slightly longer side strands, reaching about chin length.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.description: Short punk hairstyle with a swept, centre-parted top and layered bangs that taper into sharp, pointed strands framing the face; longer spiky locks hang down past the ears to about chin length.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown to the mid-length; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the strands; colour 3 in streaked highlights across the top.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.differs: The female version hangs to chin length, with slightly longer side locks than the male.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting hairstyle swept up into a tall cylindrical topknot bound by a thin tie. A straight fringe sits across the forehead, with two thin strands hanging down in front of the ears, and the back stays short.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 form the striped pattern across all the hair; colour 3 on the tie around the topknot.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_01.differs: The female version has a straight, blunt fringe across the forehead and thin strands hanging in front of the ears.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_02.description: Short chin-length hair with streaked strands swept back from the face and a tall messy topknot gathered high on the crown by a band, ending in spiky, tousled tips that flick backward.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the streaks through the hair; colour 1 on the topknot band; colour 3 on the thin edging of the band.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Topknot_01.description: A high topknot ponytail gathered at the crown by a short cylindrical tie, with a single smooth tapering lock that arcs up and back then hangs down to a point past the nape. Sleek, simple styling.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Topknot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair lock; colour 1 on the hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Tight_Topknot_02.description: A short topknot ponytail: a single smooth, tapering lock gathered by a cylindrical tie at the crown, arcing back and down to a point at the nape. The rest of the head stays bare.
Female/F_Hair_Tight_Topknot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair lock; colour 1 on the cylindrical hair tie.

Female/F_Hair_Traveler_01.description: Swept-back hairstyle with smooth, combed strands sculpted over the crown and pulled to a gathered point at the back, then falling in loose, tapered layered locks to about shoulder length.
Female/F_Hair_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept-back crown section; colour 1 on the lower hanging locks; colour 3 on streaks through the lower locks.
Female/F_Hair_Traveler_01.differs: The female version hangs a little longer, to around the shoulders, and the lower locks are slightly fuller.

Female/F_Hair_Traveler_02.description: A sparse chin-length hairstyle of a few long, tapered locks swept back from the hairline, with a short contrasting-coloured tuft at the front; the locks hang loosely at the sides and back, leaving most of the scalp bare.
Female/F_Hair_Traveler_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long swept locks; colour 1 on the short front tufts along the hairline.

Female/F_Hair_Traveler_03.description: A small ponytail of smooth, tapering locks swept back from a short cylindrical tie at the back of the head, hanging down behind the neck in a pointed tip; an accessory-sized hairstyle piece rather than a full head of hair.
Female/F_Hair_Traveler_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair locks; colour 3 on the tie band at the base of the ponytail.

Female/F_Hair_Traveler_04.description: A sparse hairstyle of a small ponytail tied high at the back of the crown with a band, plus a few thin swept-back bangs that curve across the forehead. The rest of the scalp is left bare.
Female/F_Hair_Traveler_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ponytail strands and most of the bangs; colour 1 on the curved tips of the front bangs; colour 3 on the tie band around the ponytail.

Female/F_Hair_Valorous_01.description: Chin-length layered hair with a side-swept fringe over the forehead, a parted swept-back crown and jagged, feathered tips that taper down the nape and sides. Styled as a casual, tousled short cut.
Female/F_Hair_Valorous_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair and tips; colour 3 on the top and back layer; colour 1 on the front side lock; colour 2 on the swept fringe lock.

Female/F_Hair_Valorous_02.description: Chin-length hair in thick woven braids swept back over the crown, with a braided band circling the back of the head and loose braided strands hanging below, each capped with a banded tip. Short side sections sit beneath.
Female/F_Hair_Valorous_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the braids and hanging strands; colour 1 on the side and under-hair sections; colour 3 on the bands around the braid tips and the back band.

Female/F_Hair_Valorous_03.description: Chin-length layered hair swept back from the forehead, with a long side fringe falling over one eye, a thick rope-twisted band across the crown and a straight-cut panel of hair hanging at the back and side.
Female/F_Hair_Valorous_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and swept top; colour 3 on the rope-twisted band; colour 1 on the straight hanging panel at the back and side; colour 2 on the thin fringe strands.

Female/F_Hair_Valorous_04.description: Short, tousled cropped hair with textured layers over the back and sides, and a swept-up fringe topped by long pointed blade-like locks that curve upward and back from the front hairline, giving a punky superhero look.
Female/F_Hair_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the base of the swept front locks; colour 2 on the tall curved spikes at the crown; colour 3 on the slim outer spikes at the sides.

Female/F_Hair_Valorous_05.description: An asymmetric, side-swept hairstyle with a long fringe swept across the forehead to one side, a shaved-looking opposite side, and long layered locks falling down the back to the upper back.
Female/F_Hair_Valorous_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept top and fringe; colour 0 on the front side locks; colour 2 on the main back mass; colour 3 on the inner strands at the side and back.
Female/F_Hair_Valorous_05.differs: The female version falls slightly longer, to the upper back, with a looser tail at the back.

Female/F_Hair_Valorous_06.description: Chin-length layered hair swept back from the crown in smooth ridged waves, with a contrasting front section of jagged, feathered locks falling over the forehead and a contrasting-edged streak along the side. Casual, edgy style.
Female/F_Hair_Valorous_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept-back hair and back lengths; colour 1 on the front fringe locks; colour 3 on the streak edging the fringe section.

Female/F_Hair_Windswept_01.description: Upper-back-length windswept hair swept back from the face in layered, jagged spiky locks, with a short choppy fringe on top and two loose front braids tied with small bands that hang over the chest.
Female/F_Hair_Windswept_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the fringe and crown; colour 0 on the main hair lengths and braids; colour 1 on the spiky tips and lower ends; colour 3 on the braid ties.
Female/F_Hair_Windswept_01.differs: The female version has the braids hanging lower over the chest and a slightly shorter, tighter back mass.

Female/F_Hair_Windswept_02.description: Wild, swept-back hair with a messy fringe over the forehead and long, sharp, spiky locks streaming backward from the crown to the upper back, giving a windblown, energetic look.
Female/F_Hair_Windswept_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front fringe and top of the head; colour 0 on the mid-length locks; colour 1 on the tips and the long back spikes.
Female/F_Hair_Windswept_02.differs: The female hair reaches the upper back and has longer trailing spikes, while the male version stops at the shoulders.

Female/F_Hair_Winged_01.description: Long, mid-back length hair swept back from the forehead in smooth streaked strands, with a few curled locks framing the face at the temples and ragged, jagged tips at the ends.
Female/F_Hair_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the curled locks at the temples; colour 2 on the jagged tips at the ends of the hair.

Female/F_Hand_L_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A clenched-fist hand covering with a bulky, rounded scaly glove that runs from the wrist over the whole fist, with segmented fingers and small curved claw tips at the fingertips. Suggests a dragon or monstrous look.
Female/F_Hand_L_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly hand covering; colour 0 on the claw tips.

Female/F_Hand_R_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet covering the right hand in a chunky, scaly dragon-style shell, with segmented finger plates ending in short pointed claws; it stops at the wrist.
Female/F_Hand_R_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly hand shell and finger segments; colour 0 on the claw tips.

Female/F_Handl_Animal_01.description: A clenched left fist with a skin-textured, snake-like hand shape, contrasting inner palm and short curved contrasting claw tips at the fingertips, which sit mostly hidden inside the curled fingers.
Female/F_Handl_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the inner palm; the skin-toned fist and the claw tips do not follow the colour scheme.
Female/F_Handl_Animal_01.differs: The female claws are smaller and mostly tucked out of sight, with only a tip or two showing at the fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Animal_02.description: A bulky animal-themed glove covering the whole left fist and wrist, with a furry mitten shape, jagged fur tufts ringing the palm opening, and a single curved claw at the fingertips. Suggests a beast or coyote paw.
Female/F_Handl_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur of the glove and fingers; colour 1 on the jagged fur tufts around the palm opening; colour 2 on the inner shadowed opening; colour 3 on the claw.
Female/F_Handl_Animal_02.differs: The female glove shows only one visible contrasting claw at the fingertip, while the male version has a row of several claws across the fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A chunky, robotic gauntlet covering a clenched fist: a large segmented armour plate over the back of the hand, a contrasting band at the wrist edge, and separate rounded finger segments curled at the front.
Female/F_Handl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main back-of-hand plate; colour 2 on the darker plate sections and joints; colour 1 on the wrist band; colour 3 on the finger segments and the top cap.

Female/F_Handl_Astronaut_01.description: A bulky, padded space-suit glove covering the whole left hand in a closed fist, with a wide rolled cuff at the wrist, a contrasting side stripe and a separate panel over the palm and fingertips.
Female/F_Handl_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the side stripe and small panel under the fist; colour 3 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the palm panel.

Female/F_Handl_Baseball_01.description: A padded baseball fielder's glove for the left hand: rounded leather mitt with four finger sleeves, a deep pocket, an open wrist hole, and contrasting stitching and X-lacing, with an H-shaped web across the palm.
Female/F_Handl_Baseball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the H-shaped web and lacing strips; colour 3 on the stitching and X laces.

Female/F_Handl_Beast_Claw_Mechanical_01.description: A mechanical clenched-fist claw hand: a rounded plated back-of-hand shell with ribbed vertical channels, a cuff at the wrist, and pointed blade-like fingertips with barrel-shaped knuckle caps.
Female/F_Handl_Beast_Claw_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates and fingertip blades; colour 1 on the ribbed channels, wrist cuff ring and knuckle barrels; colour 3 on the striped vents inside the fingers; colour 2 on the inner gaps and joints.

Female/F_Handl_Bounty_01.description: A chunky left-hand glove for a clenched fist, with a short cuff, panelled construction and a raised hexagonal plate on the outer wrist. Small armoured tips cover the fingers. Suggests a sci-fi bounty hunter look.
Female/F_Handl_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff edging and side panels; colour 1 on the main back-of-hand and palm panels; colour 2 on the wrist plate housing and fingertip guards; colour 3 on the inset of the wrist plate.
Female/F_Handl_Bounty_01.differs: The female glove's finger tips are smaller and sit tucked closer to the palm, with a slimmer wrist plate.

Female/F_Handl_Bracers_Holoforce_01.description: A left forearm bracer of translucent, glassy angular plates: a large stepped guard over the upper forearm, a separate cuff near the wrist, and a long thin blade-like spike running along the outer edge toward the hand.
Female/F_Handl_Bracers_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and glass-like and largely ignores the colour scheme; the plates show a pale, near-sheen with no clear split between slots.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_01.description: A rotary gatling-gun attachment for the left hand: a cluster of long parallel barrels bundled by two thick bands, hanging below the fist with the muzzle ends pointing downward. Chunky, mechanical, sci-fi weapon look.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrels; colour 0 on the two bands and the notched muzzle ring; colour 3 on the barrel tips.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_02.description: A chunky cylindrical gadget cuff worn around the left forearm just above the wrist, with a flat top disc, a recessed screen panel on the inner side, and three curved vents on the outer side.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cylinder body and top disc; colour 1 on the screen; colour 2 on the recessed panel around the screen and the base rim; colour 3 on the side vents.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_03.description: A chunky D-shaped forearm block worn on the left lower arm: a flat-backed housing with a rounded front, a row of vertical cartridge-like barrels around the curved face, and a bevelled rim top and bottom. Suggests a compact gatling or ammo-belt wrist unit.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, rim and flat back; colour 1 on the vertical barrels or cartridges; colour 2 on the band between the rim and barrels.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_04.description: A compact cylindrical forearm-mounted device with a capped top, chunky segmented casing, recessed side panels and a short rod on one side; a thin cable trails down toward the wrist ending in a small connector.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing and rod; colour 1 on the top cap, bottom ring, inset panels and connector; colour 2 on the recessed panels; colour 3 on the cable.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_01.description: A chunky gatling-style barrel cluster hanging from the left fist: a bundle of long parallel tubes held by two thick ribbed rings, with short tips at the lower end. Suggests a rotary cannon hand weapon.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrel tubes; colour 0 on the two rings; colour 3 on the barrel tips at the muzzle end.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_02.description: A chunky cylindrical gauntlet-like canister worn around the left forearm near the wrist, with a recessed screen panel on the inner side, three glowing slots on the outer side, and a round plate on top.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and top plate; colour 2 on the recessed panel frame; colour 1 on the screen; colour 3 on the three slot inserts.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_03.description: A compact bracer-like block worn on the left forearm near the wrist: a flat-topped, D-shaped metal housing with a bevelled edge and a band of ribbed cylindrical canisters around the curved side. Suggests a sci-fi weapon module.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, flat plate and bevelled frame; colour 1 on the ribbed canisters; colour 2 on the gaps between the canisters and housing.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_04.description: A compact cylindrical gatling-style ammo canister with chamfered ends, a capped top, a glossy window panel on the back and a short side nub with a looping cable ending in a small connector. It floats at the left forearm.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body and side nub; colour 1 on the top cap, end ring and inner window trim; colour 2 on the glossy window panel and connector; colour 3 on the cable.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Long_Mecha_01.description: A long rectangular mechanical clamp housing worn over the left hand, with a slot cut through the middle showing interlocking stepped teeth and a split, banded tip at the fingers. Suggests a mecha or sci-fi gauntlet.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Long_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and teeth; colour 2 on the thin band above the tip; colour 3 on the end tip sections.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A slim blade-like fin of stacked feather shapes running along the outer forearm from elbow toward the wrist, with short pointed barbs jutting out in a swept wing-like row. Reads as bird-person or winged-hero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather blades; the underside shows in a darker tone from the same piece, with no other separate colour areas visible.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A minimal flat cap that seals the open end of the left sleeve at the wrist: a thin, roughly ten-sided disc with no cuff, trim or other detail, sitting over the hand opening.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap disc.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Tight_Prisonguantle.description: A pair of loose chain lengths dangling from the left wrist, as if from broken prison shackles. Heavy oval links hang in two strands, one longer than the other, with no cuff visible.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Tight_Prisonguantle.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all the chain links.

Female/F_Handl_Child_Tight_Prisonguantle.description: Two short lengths of heavy chain links hanging loose from the left wrist, dangling down past the fist like broken prisoner shackles. No cuff is visible. A gritty prison-break or street look.
Female/F_Handl_Child_Tight_Prisonguantle.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all of the chain links.

Female/F_Handl_Chimera_01.description: A bulky, rounded oversized fist covering for the left hand, with wrinkled, creased surfaces like heavy hide, ending in a cluster of sharp angular claw-like points at the knuckle end.
Female/F_Handl_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fist covering; colour 3 on the claw tips and spikes at the knuckles.

Female/F_Handl_Chimera_02.description: A bulky, fur-textured beast paw covering the left hand and wrist, with a wide cuff, chunky rounded knuckle pads and long curved claws at the fingertips. Suggests a monstrous, animal-like chimera look.
Female/F_Handl_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furry paw body and toe pads; colour 1 on the inner pad patches; colour 3 on the claws.

Female/F_Handl_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A chunky, angular clawed gauntlet for the left hand: a faceted, rough-textured fist block with a curled finger section and long sharp blades projecting from the knuckles. Suggests a cyber-western brawler look.
Female/F_Handl_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fist and gauntlet body; colour 2 on the claw blades and inner finger pieces.

Female/F_Handl_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A chunky armored left gauntlet with a faceted plate covering the back of the hand and wrist, a angular banded ridge across the top, and segmented finger sections on a closed fist. Suits sci-fi western looks.
Female/F_Handl_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate over the back of the hand and wrist; colour 2 on the angular band across the plate; colour 3 on the fingers and palm section; colour 1 on the knuckle studs along the edge.

Female/F_Handl_Defender_Update_01.description: A superhero gauntlet glove for the left hand: a fitted fist covering with separate finger segments, topped by a long angular forearm guard built from stacked plates with contrasting panels and a flared cuff.
Female/F_Handl_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the glove body and main forearm plates; colour 0 on the finger tips, cuff edges and upper plate; colour 2 on the side forearm panels and wrist band; colour 3 on small accents at the knuckles.

Female/F_Handl_Draco_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a smooth padded back-of-hand panel, a lighter inner palm and segmented armoured finger plates tipped with a single long curved claw at the little-finger side. Sits over the left hand with a short cuff.
Female/F_Handl_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main back-of-hand panel; colour 0 on the palm, cuff rim and inner plates; colour 2 on the finger segments and knuckle plates; colour 3 on the claw and small knuckle tips.
Female/F_Handl_Draco_01.differs: The female version has one long claw at the side of the fist and short knuckle tips, while the male version has a row of several long claws along the fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Dryad_01.description: A chunky clenched-fist glove with a faceted, bark-like surface covered in streaky vein or scratch markings; the fingers curl into a rough, angular fist with a blunt open cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Handl_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove surface; colour 3 on the streaky vein markings running across the knuckles and back of the hand.

Female/F_Handl_Dryad_02.description: A bulky clenched-fist glove with a rounded cuff and a mossy, mottled organic texture across the back of the hand, plus segmented plated knuckles and finger tips. Suggests a nature-guardian look.
Female/F_Handl_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and base of the glove; colour 1 on the mottled moss-like patches; colour 2 on the plated knuckle and finger segments.
Female/F_Handl_Dryad_02.differs: The female version has larger contrasting plating over the front of the fist, while the male plating is smaller and sits higher.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Gamer_01.description: A retro game controller strapped to the left forearm by a curling cable that runs down to a chunky wristband cuff at the hand. The flat rectangular pad carries a cross button and round buttons, for a playful geek look.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the controller body; colour 3 on the cross and round buttons and the cuff stripe; colour 1 on the cable; colour 2 on the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Lockbox_67_01.description: A left-hand piece with a padded wrist cuff fastened by a small buckle, and a cluster of sharp, jagged blade-like claws spiking from the knuckles and fingers, joined by thin open link frames.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cuff and the claw spikes; colour 1 on the cuff edge piping and the thin link frames around the claws.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Long_Mechaclaw_01.description: A left-hand mechanical claw: a small angular cuff panel at the fist with two long, curved blade-like talons hanging down past the hand, each ending in a sharp point with spiky notches at the top.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Long_Mechaclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hand cuff panel; colour 0 on the two long talon blades.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Reactor_04.description: A small sci-fi hand guard that wraps the back of the left hand and knuckles: a curved plate with a jagged lower edge, a separate raised panel along one side, and small studs.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the raised side panel; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Short_Retroscifi_Bu.description: A thin, translucent curved shell shaped like part of a bubble, cupped against the outer edge of the left fist. It sits as a small glassy dome on the hand and suggests a retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Short_Retroscifi_Bu.colourAreas: The shell is glass-like and seems to ignore the colour scheme; no colour slot is clearly visible on it.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Drill_01.description: A single conical drill bit held in the left hand, with a flat polygonal top cap and vertical fluted stripes running down to a sharp point; hangs pointing downward from the fist.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cap and the raised ridges between the stripes; colour 3 on the alternating stripes of the cone body.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Punk_01.description: A short wrist cuff for the left hand: a ribbed knit sleeve rolls up out of a glossy metal-edged band, with a raised rounded plate on the outer side. Punk, street look sitting at the wrist.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed knit cuff; colour 0 on the metal-look band; colour 3 on the raised outer plate; colour 2 on the edge trim and lower band.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A sci-fi hand device: a bulky angular gauntlet block with notched, horn-like prongs, small twin cylinder barrels and a curved blade spike, ringed by detached curved fin-like plates floating around the left hand.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauntlet plates, blade and cylinder barrels; colour 1 on the floating curved plates and the lower gauntlet band; colour 2 on the upper housing and prongs; colour 3 on the small indicator lights.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.description: A bulky sci-fi armoured gauntlet for the left hand: a tall, jagged-topped plated shell over the back of the hand with a curved blade-like spike, a cuffed base, and two small cylindrical emitters on a boxy mount.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light plates of the shell; colour 2 on the upper shell, spike and cylinders; colour 1 on the cuff band, inner lining and emitter mount; colour 3 on the small round lights.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.differs: The spike is a plain contrasting curved horn, and the shell has more jagged, notched upper points.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A set of three curved, tapering claw blades that hang in a row beside the left hand, each with a blocky flat base and a long sweeping point. Suggests a monstrous symbiote or organic weapon look.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper blade bases; colour 1 on the tapering blade tips, blending gradually from the base.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.differs: The three claws are packed closer together and overlap more when seen from the front.

Female/F_Handl_Extra_Wrapped_Hook_01.description: A hand-held hook weapon: a faceted, angular U-shaped blade with a short straight shaft on one side and a longer pointed tip curving up on the other, held in the left hand and hanging at the side.
Female/F_Handl_Extra_Wrapped_Hook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hook body, including the faceted blade and the shaft; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handl_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A chunky robotic left gauntlet with a faceted, angular fist and a large boxy cuff over the back of the hand, with segmented finger knuckles and a flat plate at the wrist edge.
Female/F_Handl_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fist and cuff body; colour 2 on the flat plate at the wrist edge; the finger segments also take colour 1.

Female/F_Handl_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A smooth, rounded glove covering the left hand in a clenched fist, with a plain cuff edge at the wrist and softly modelled, short fingers curled into the palm. Simple, casual-looking design.
Female/F_Handl_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove including the fingers; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Handl_Gatling_01.description: A large forearm-mounted rotary gatling cannon: a cluster of long barrels projects past the hand, with a chunky housing, round drum canisters and a cap at the elbow end. Sci-fi heavy weapon look.
Female/F_Handl_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, drums, rings and end caps; colour 1 on the barrels and drum bands; colour 3 on the vent slots and small markings; colour 2 on small details.

Female/F_Handl_Gatling_Alt_01.description: A large arm-mounted rotary gatling cannon worn over the left forearm and hand: a bundle of long barrels with clamp rings, a chunky housing with vented slots, and a side ammo canister with small wires. Sci-fi heavy weapon.
Female/F_Handl_Gatling_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, canister and clamp rings; colour 1 on the barrels and housing bands; colour 3 on the vent slots and wires; colour 2 on small inserts.

Female/F_Handl_Glove_Odragon_01.description: A short, smooth fitted glove with a flared cuff covering the fist and part of the forearm, with a swooping jagged-edged panel running up the outer wrist and thin edge piping. Clean superhero martial-arts styling.
Female/F_Handl_Glove_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove and hand; colour 1 on the swooping forearm panel; colour 2 on the edge piping and cuff rim.

Female/F_Handl_Glove_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A fitted glove with a flared forearm cuff, a wide strapped band at the wrist and a knuckle section over a closed fist. A vertical contrasting stripe runs along the forearm, giving a sporty sci-fi look.
Female/F_Handl_Glove_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff top and the knuckle and finger sections; colour 1 on the forearm panel and the hand back; colour 2 on the wrist band and the forearm stripe.

Female/F_Handl_Heraldry_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet for the left hand with a large angular armored plate over the back of the hand, a textured panel beneath, and short pointed claw tips along the knuckles.
Female/F_Handl_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the armored plate and finger segments; colour 1 on the textured inner panel; colour 3 on the claw tips.
Female/F_Handl_Heraldry_01.differs: The female version has only short claw tips along the knuckles, without the long contrasting spikes.

Female/F_Handl_Insect_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a smooth wrapped cuff and back of hand, tipped with long curved insect-like claws over the knuckles and a segmented chitinous underside with small contrasting spikes along the fingers.
Female/F_Handl_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and cuff; colour 1 on the segmented finger plates underneath; colour 3 on the knuckle claws and thumb plate; colour 2 on the small spikes and inner claws.

Female/F_Handl_Insulating_Gloves_01.description: A chunky left glove with a wide flared cuff, a padded forearm section with an inset front panel, and a fitted fist with knuckle pieces. It reads as a protective, utility-style glove for a superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Handl_Insulating_Gloves_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff rim and knuckle highlights; colour 1 on the forearm section and edging around the hand; colour 3 on the inset front panel; colour 2 on the palm and hand.

Female/F_Handl_Junkbot_01.description: A left hand replaced by a scrap-built mechanical claw: a chunky cuff at the wrist, boxy plated palm and thin rod-like finger struts with angular jutting blades, giving a jury-rigged robotic look.
Female/F_Handl_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm blocks and finger rods; colour 1 on the wrist cuff top and angled plates; colour 2 on the cuff underside and joints; colour 3 on the small side panel and accents.
Female/F_Handl_Junkbot_01.differs: The female version has a larger contrasting side panel and more compact, upright rods than the male.

Female/F_Handl_Kaiju_01.description: A short, snug glove-like hand covering with a segmented armored plate across the back of the hand and long curved talons extending from the knuckles and side, plus small contrasting claw tips. Monstrous, beastlike look.
Female/F_Handl_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the glove body; colour 1 on the back-of-hand armor plate; colour 0 on the long talons; colour 2 on the small claw tips.

Female/F_Handl_Kaiju_02.description: A monstrous oversized left hand covering: a bulbous mass of overlapping jagged scales with a horn-like spike at the top, tapering into a long curved talon-like claw that hangs well below the wrist.
Female/F_Handl_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly upper mass and spike; colour 1 on the long curved claw section.

Female/F_Handl_Largehook_01.description: A large curved hook hanging from a short cuff at the left wrist. A thin flat blade drops down, kinks once, then sweeps into a deep J-shaped barb that reaches roughly knee height. Suggests a pirate or grappling tool.
Female/F_Handl_Largehook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff; colour 1 on the hook blade.

Female/F_Handl_Lockbox_67_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a banded strapped cuff, a smooth padded back decorated with swirling tribal line patterns, and jagged blade-like spikes jutting from the knuckles and fingertips. Street-fighter or fantasy claw look.
Female/F_Handl_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body; colour 1 on the swirling line patterns and the edging of the cuff; colour 2 on the cuff band and the knuckle spikes.

Female/F_Handl_Long_Gamer_01.description: A long, boxy gauntlet shaped like a retro game controller strapped to the forearm, with an octagonal cuff, a raised D-pad and button panel, a coiled cable wrapped around the wrist, and a gloved fist with a wrist pad.
Female/F_Handl_Long_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauntlet body and glove; colour 1 on the coiled cable; colour 2 on the cuff rim and wrist pad; colour 3 on the D-pad, buttons and stripe accents.

Female/F_Handl_Long_Mecha_01.description: An oversized mechanical gauntlet block over the left hand: a faceted angular housing with a small triangular marker, side fin panels, and a slotted clamp-like jaw with notched teeth ending in banded tips.
Female/F_Handl_Long_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and clamp body; colour 1 on the side fin panels; colour 3 on the triangle marker and the tip bands; colour 2 on the thin stripe near the tips.

Female/F_Handl_Long_Mechaclaw_01.description: A bulky mechanical gauntlet-claw worn over the left hand: a boxy open-topped cuff, a large plated back-of-hand shell with paired cylindrical pistons, and long curved blade talons extending past the fingers.
Female/F_Handl_Long_Mechaclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plated shell and the claw blades; colour 1 on the cuff and the small side plate; colour 2 on the piston cylinders; colour 3 on the small clamps and brackets.

Female/F_Handl_Mas_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A fitted fingerless-style glove covering the back of the hand and wrist, with an angular contrasting cuff edge and decorative ring-like bands with small pointed fins or spikes around the fingers. Suggests a wintry sci-fi or fantasy look.
Female/F_Handl_Mas_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main glove body; colour 1 on the cuff edge, borders and finger ring bands; colour 0 on the finger sections and ring accents; colour 3 on the thin ring lines.

Female/F_Handl_Mecha_02.description: A chunky mecha-style left gauntlet: a segmented robotic fist with separate finger blocks, a bulky angular cuff over the wrist, and a large flat rectangular slab plate standing off the outer side of the hand.
Female/F_Handl_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knuckle and finger plates; colour 1 on the large slab panel; colour 2 on the wrist cuff; colour 3 on the finger blocks.

Female/F_Handl_Mitten_Santa_01.description: A rounded, puffy holiday mitten covering the whole left hand in a closed-fist shape, with a thick fluffy cuff at the wrist and thin stitched seam lines along the sides.
Female/F_Handl_Mitten_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mitten body; colour 1 on the fluffy cuff and the thin seam piping.
Female/F_Handl_Mitten_Santa_01.differs: The female mitten is coloured in a simple pattern with a light body and a contrasting cuff, whereas the male version splits the mitten into several colour panels.

Female/F_Handl_Moth_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with segmented armoured finger plates, a pleated flared cuff panel over the back of the hand and wrist, and small pointed claw spikes at the knuckles. Suggests a winged-creature superhero look.
Female/F_Handl_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented finger and knuckle plates; colour 3 on the pleated back-of-hand panel; colour 0 on the claw spikes.
Female/F_Handl_Moth_01.differs: The female version has shorter, smaller claws set at the knuckles, while the male has longer claws along the fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Nightmare_Bladed_01.description: A single angular bracer-blade worn on the left forearm: a tapering armored shell with a squared cuff at the wrist end that extends into a long curved blade point past the hand, with notched edges and inset panels.
Female/F_Handl_Nightmare_Bladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, blade edge and central band; colour 1 on the cuff panel at the top; colour 3 on the long inset panel along the blade.

Female/F_Handl_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A left forearm bracer of layered angular plates with a tall swept-back spike at the elbow and a smaller fin-like blade along the outer edge; it ends in a segmented cuff at the wrist. Suggests dragon-like fantasy armor.
Female/F_Handl_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; the default metallic material largely ignores the rest of the scheme, so no other slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Handl_Reactor_04.description: A chunky sci-fi gauntlet-fist that encases the whole left hand and wrist in angular segmented plates, with a raised contrasting panel on the back of the hand, panel seams, small stud dots and separate finger sections.
Female/F_Handl_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and knuckle shell; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and the fingers; colour 3 on the small dots; colour 2 on the panel seam lines.
Female/F_Handl_Reactor_04.differs: The female gauntlet is more angular with sharper plate edges, and its fingers are shorter and more separated.

Female/F_Handl_Renegade_01.description: A left gauntlet-glove with a clenched fist: a smooth, short cuff over the wrist and back of the hand, a contrasting band with a small round fastener across the knuckles, and segmented finger sections.
Female/F_Handl_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and back of the hand; colour 1 on the band across the hand; colour 2 on the fingers and knuckle sections.

Female/F_Handl_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A clenched-fist armoured gauntlet with segmented, rounded knuckle plates and a large, angular slab-like guard covering the back of the hand and wrist. It suggests a chunky retro sci-fi or warlord look.
Female/F_Handl_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fingers, knuckles and palm-side segments; colour 2 on the large back-of-hand plate; colour 0 on the thin rim trim around the plate.

Female/F_Handl_Retro_Warlord_02.description: A forearm-mounted rotary minigun replacing the left hand: a chunky ribbed cylindrical housing with a hollow open top, a contrasting collar ring, and a cluster of long barrels held by spaced clamp rings.
Female/F_Handl_Retro_Warlord_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed housing and the thin ring below the collar; colour 2 on the collar band and barrel clamp rings; colour 0 on the barrels.
