Female/F_Handl_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.description: A chunky mechanical left hand: a faceted plated back-of-hand block with a raised side plate, bolt heads on the knuckles, and blocky segmented fingers curled into a fist. Suggests a steampunk robotic gauntlet.
Female/F_Handl_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand casing; colour 1 on the raised back plate; colour 2 on the finger segments; colour 3 on the bolts, cylinders and knuckle pistons.

Female/F_Handl_Robotexo_01.description: A mechanical exoskeleton hand for the left wrist: a wide cuff ring, a rigid frame along the back of the hand with a studded plate, hex-shaped joint housings, and thin articulated finger claws.
Female/F_Handl_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and the studded back plate; colour 1 on the finger segments and frame rails; colour 2 on the joint housings and knuckle block; colour 3 on the round joint lights.

Female/F_Handl_Scarab_01.description: A bulky armoured gauntlet for the left hand: a wide rounded cuff and back-of-hand shell with a separate raised plate on the outer edge, and segmented, plated knuckles over the clenched fingers. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and main hand shell; colour 2 on the raised outer plate; colour 1 on the segmented knuckles and fingers; colour 3 on small tips at the finger ends.
Female/F_Handl_Scarab_01.differs: The female version has smooth finger plates ending in tiny tips, while the male version adds long spiky claws on the knuckles.

Female/F_Handl_Scarab_02.description: A armored left gauntlet covering the hand and wrist: a segmented, rounded cuff with a horizontal seam, swept-back blade-like spikes along the outer edge, and articulated knuckle plates ending in pointed fingertips.
Female/F_Handl_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and the swept spikes; colour 2 on the finger and knuckle plates and inner hand; colour 3 on the fingertip points.

Female/F_Handl_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_0.description: A sci-fi glove with a clear glass bubble dome enclosing the fist, set on a small mechanical cuff at the wrist with tiny panels and fittings. It gives a retro space-suit look.
Female/F_Handl_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff housing; colour 1 on small cuff details; the bubble is clear glass and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Handl_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_0.description: A left-hand glove of angular, segmented armour plates around the fist and back of the hand, enclosed in a clear glass bubble dome. Ribbed vent-like slats show inside, with thin contrasting trim lines. Retro sci-fi robotic look.
Female/F_Handl_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates and fingers; colour 1 on the thin trim lines and the palm disc; colour 2 on the inner slats; the glass dome ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Handl_Skeleton_02.description: A left skeletal hand made of separate long finger and knuckle bones with jointed ends, curled into a loose claw. A short flat cuff band at the wrist holds it on. Suggests a gothic undead look.
Female/F_Handl_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shafts; colour 1 on the joint ends and knuckles; colour 2 on the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Handl_Skin_Fur_01.description: A clenched left hand with skin-toned knuckles and finger creases, streaked with contrasting fur-like markings. Jagged tufts of fur spike up around the wrist cuff. Fingers end in short claw tips. Monstrous werewolf style.
Female/F_Handl_Skin_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts at the wrist and the fading upper hand; the skin and claw tips do not take the colour scheme visibly.
Female/F_Handl_Skin_Fur_01.differs: The female hand has smaller, less prominent claws that are mostly tucked into the fist.

Female/F_Handl_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.description: A clenched, skin-textured monstrous fist with a ruff of jagged fur spikes along the wrist and back of the hand, and short curved claws that barely show at the fingertips.
Female/F_Handl_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.colourAreas: The skin-tone hand ignores the colour scheme; the fur tufts at the wrist and the claw tips take their colour from the default material rather than clearly from a slot.
Female/F_Handl_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.differs: The female claws are short and stubby, barely poking out from the fingertips.

Female/F_Handl_Steelcommando_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet with a smooth metal cuff and back-of-hand plate, segmented armored finger plates curled into the palm, and a row of small sharp spikes along the knuckle edge. Retro superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and back-of-hand plate; colour 1 on the segmented finger and thumb plates; colour 3 on the knuckle spikes.

Female/F_Handl_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A chunky retro-superhero gauntlet covering the left hand in a closed fist: a smooth rounded backhand plate, a faceted cuff at the wrist, segmented finger guards and small rounded pads at the fingertips.
Female/F_Handl_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the backhand plate and knuckle shell; colour 1 on the wrist cuff, finger segments and palm-side guards; colour 3 on the rounded fingertip pads.

Female/F_Handl_Swing_01.description: A chunky fist-shaped glove for the left hand: a blocky cuff and back-of-hand shell with separate contrasting panels on the sides, and segmented finger sections curled into a clenched fist. Sporty, superhero look.
Female/F_Handl_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and main hand shell; colour 1 on the side panels; colour 2 on the fingers and palm underside.

Female/F_Handl_Swing_02.description: A soft, slightly wrinkled cloth glove on the left hand, shaped in a closed fist with curled fingers and a short open cuff at the wrist. Simple, casual styling with no added hardware.
Female/F_Handl_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_01_Glove.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the left hand in a clenched fist, ending in a plain cuff at the wrist. Smooth, simple construction with separate sculpted fingers, suggesting everyday or superhero wear.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_01_Hand.description: A bare left hand with five separate fingers curled into a relaxed fist, thumb tucked across the fingers. It ends in a plain cut-off wrist and gives a natural, unadorned look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_01_Hand.colourAreas: The hand uses the skin tone and does not take the colour scheme; the fingernails show a light tip that does not clearly follow any slot.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_2fingers_01.description: A bare left hand in a closed fist with two fingers curled and fingertips showing small nails, ending at the wrist. It is a simple, natural hand with no glove or added detail.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_2fingers_01.colourAreas: The hand takes its skin tone and ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 appears only as a tint on the fingernails.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A superhero forearm gauntlet with a flared angular cuff, a fitted glove with a padded knuckle section, and three long curved blade claws along the outer edge. A recessed panel runs down the back of the forearm.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff and the fingers; colour 1 on the main forearm shell and knuckle base; colour 2 on the glove back and the claw tips; colour 3 on the recessed back panel.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The female version has a narrow tapering slit-shaped recessed panel on the back of the forearm, and the claws sit slightly further back.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A left forearm sleeve of overlapping segmented plates running from a bulky wrist-like cuff band near the elbow down to a fitted fist glove, with a small blade-like antenna sticking out at the top.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates; colour 1 on the glove and the stripes of the upper cuff; colour 2 on the cuff housing and plate gaps; colour 3 on tiny indicator lights on the cuff.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_90s_Tech_02.description: A left-hand gauntlet with a segmented, ridged forearm guard running from below the elbow to the wrist, ending in a fitted fist covering with a small contrasting control-pad box on the outer wrist. Sci-fi tech styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_90s_Tech_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged forearm plates; colour 1 on the hand covering; colour 2 on the control box and its fittings.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Alien_01.description: A close-fitting alien glove covering the whole fist, with smooth faceted plating and a trimmed cuff at the wrist. Short pointed claw-like tips curve out from the fingertips under the curled fist.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove; colour 1 on the cuff trim; colour 2 on the finger claws; colour 3 on the claw tips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Alien_01.differs: The female claws are short and sit tucked against the curled fingers, with small contrasting spikes on the knuckles.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Archer_01.description: A fitted archer's gauntlet covering the left forearm and hand: a tapered angular bracer with segmented panels, a banded wrist section, and a fingerless glove with a padded knuckle plate leaving the fingertips exposed.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist band and the glove back and fingers; colour 1 on the bracer panels and knuckle plate; colour 2 on the inset strip along the bracer and the palm.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A chunky armoured forearm gauntlet on the left hand: a boxy plated cuff with raised rounded slot-like ridges, an open cylindrical barrel end at the elbow side, and a ribbed finger-side extension over the back of the hand. Suggests a superhero blaster.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cuff plating, ribbed extension and outer frame; colour 3 on the raised ridge bars, the barrel end and small side panels; colour 0 on the hand and fingertips' base; colour 3 on the fingertip claws.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Armorninja.description: A tight armoured fist-glove: a smooth, angular plate covers the back of the hand and knuckles, with a row of round studs across the knuckles, a contrasting trimmed cuff, and fitted fingers below.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand plate; colour 2 on the cuff edge and lower trim; colour 1 on the knuckle studs; colour 3 on the fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Ball_01.description: A smooth, faceted spherical ball that replaces the left hand, joined to the wrist by a short flat cuff band. Bulbous, plain and cartoonish, it suggests a robotic or cute superhero look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Ball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ball; colour 1 on the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Banded_01.description: A snug, long left glove covering the hand and forearm, ending in a wide flared cuff with a thin contrasting band along its edge. The fingers are closed in a fist. Simple, clean superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Banded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and cuff; colour 2 on the thin band at the cuff edge.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Bear_01.description: A furry bear-paw hand covering: a rounded, fur-covered fist with short contrasting claws at the knuckles, and a shaggy cuff of long jagged fur tufts flaring up the forearm.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long fur tufts up the forearm, fading toward colour 0 on the paw fur; colour 2 on the claws.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Bear_01.differs: The female claws are smaller and sit tucked at the knuckles.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A left gauntlet-style glove with a loose, wrinkled forearm cuff that flares slightly at the top, edged with a contrasting rim, and a row of pointed feather-like blades along the outer edge of the forearm.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and hand; colour 1 on the rim at the top of the cuff; colour 2 on the feather-like blades.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A long gauntlet-style glove covering the hand and forearm, with a contrasting flared cuff at the top and a row of layered, pointed feather blades sweeping back along the outer forearm like a small wing.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and fist; colour 1 on the cuff band and the wing feather blades.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: A segmented armored gauntlet with a flared cuff and ridged finger plates, with long slender blades extending past the fingertips like shears. Thin wires and hooked fittings run along the hand; sits on the left forearm and hand with a menacing, blade-fingered look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the gauntlet plates, cuff and fittings; colour 1 on the long blades; colour 3 on small accents at the cuff joints.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Boxing_01.description: A padded, rounded boxing glove for the left hand, with a puffy fist and thumb section, a short cuff at the wrist with a lettered label band, and criss-crossed lacing up the side.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Boxing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded glove body; colour 3 on the label band at the cuff; colour 2 on the lettering; colour 1 on the laces.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Bracer_Cosmic_01.description: A left forearm bracer of segmented, angular armor: a tapered tube with horizontal bands, a glossy vertical strip along the inner edge, a flared cuff at the wrist and a raised plated block with a small fin at the elbow end.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Bracer_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main tube body and the wrist cuff edge; colour 2 on the horizontal bands, glossy strip and top plate; colour 0 on the elbow block and metallic side plates; colour 3 on the wrist band.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cannon_01.description: A chunky cylindrical hand cannon that encloses the left fist and hangs past the wrist. It has a faceted barrel body, a tapered rim with small notched marks, and an open muzzle facing upward.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main barrel body and tapered rim; colour 1 on the muzzle interior and end cap; colour 3 on the small marks around the rim.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cannon_02.description: A chunky segmented cannon gauntlet covering the left hand and fist: stacked angular blocks with a round barrel opening on top, side vents and a raised fin, giving a heavy sci-fi weapon look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cannon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper block panels and middle segment faces; colour 1 on the outer casing, lower segment and side plates; colour 2 on the small gaps and vents between segments.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cartoon_01.description: A cartoon-style clenched-fist glove with a rounded, puffy shape and a large bulbous cuff at the wrist. Three short stitched lines mark the back of the hand, and the fingertips are contrasting.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cartoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the puffy cuff; colour 3 on the three stitched lines; colour 1 on the fingertips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cartoon_01.differs: The female glove has only a small patch of contrasting colour on the fingertips, while the male version shows more of it.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Claw_01.description: A bare clenched left fist with short, sharp, tapered claws projecting from the knuckle side of the hand. The hand is otherwise unadorned, giving a feral, understated look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the fist itself is the mannequin's skin and takes no colour slot.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Claw_02.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the left fist and wrist, ending just above the wrist, with pointed claw tips on the fingers and a row of small thin spikes along the outer knuckle edge.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove including the finger claws and knuckle spikes.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Claw_02.differs: The female glove has a row of thin spikes along the outer knuckle edge, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Colossus_01.description: A bulky, rounded fist covering shaped like cracked rock slabs, with contrasting seams between the plates and a few sharp angular shards jutting from the knuckles. Sits over the left hand and wrist, suggesting a stone golem look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates; colour 3 on the cracks and seams between plates; colour 1 on the shards at the knuckles.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Colossus_01.differs: The female version has larger, more splayed knuckle shards and a more open fist shape at the front.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A snug, short fingerless-style glove on a clenched fist, with a cuff band at the wrist, a large panel over the back of the hand with recessed rectangular vents, and angular fin-like accents along the knuckles and edge.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrist cuff; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel; colour 0 on the fingers and palm; colour 3 on the vents and the angular knuckle and edge accents.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A clenched cybernetic left hand with angular, faceted plated knuckles and fingers, topped by a chunky octagonal wrist cuff with a contrasting inner panel, ribbed side slots and a raised rim.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand plates and fingers; colour 1 on the cuff rim and ribbed cuff frame; colour 2 on the cuff panel; colour 3 on the fingertips.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Defender_01.description: A superhero left gauntlet glove: a smooth fist glove with a flared, angular bracer rising up the forearm, swept blade-like knuckle fins, and thin slash markings along the bracer. It ends open at the elbow side.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and fist; colour 1 on the bracer and knuckle plates; colour 3 on the slash markings and thin edge lines; colour 2 on the palm interior.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Deity_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a rounded fitted mitt, a tall angular plate rising along the back of the hand and wrist with a curved cuff, small flat plates on the knuckles and pointed tips at the fingers.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main glove body; colour 0 on the tall back-of-hand plate, knuckle plates and finger tips; colour 3 on the inner lining of the raised cuff; colour 2 on the small tips under the fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A left forearm bracer that flares from the wrist up to the elbow, with a pointed, angular upper edge and a hollow inner lining. Segmented panels are divided by thin banding, in a sleek armored superhero style.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main forearm panels; colour 2 on the segment banding and edge trim; colour 0 on the inner lining and the gloved hand.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A left-hand armoured gauntlet: a segmented, angular vambrace with a flared cuff, a large plate along the outer forearm, a ribbed wrist band and a fitted plated fist covering the hand.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and the forearm segments; colour 1 on the large outer forearm plate; colour 2 on the flared cuff; colour 3 on the ribbed wrist band.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A cartoonish dinosaur-suit glove for the left hand: a smooth, rounded fist with three slash-like stripe marks on the back, small pointed claw tips on the fingers, and a puffy fluffy cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the claw tips; colour 2 on the puffy cuff; colour 3 on the stripe marks.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Drill_01.description: A tapered conical drill worn over the left hand, pointing downward from the wrist, with vertical striped flutes and a studded cylindrical collar ring at the wrist end. Reads as a chunky sci-fi or superhero hand attachment.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar ring and the alternating flute stripes; colour 3 on the other alternating flute stripes; colour 1 on the small inner band beneath the collar; colour 2 on the collar studs.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Edged_01.description: A plain, smooth long glove for the left hand: a fitted closed fist with a wide flared cuff that extends over the forearm to just below the elbow, with a simple open, angled top edge.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Edged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gauntlet_Short_01.description: A short armored gauntlet for the left hand: a segmented plated shell over the back of the fist and wrist, with small rivets, ridged finger plates and a separate inner panel lining the palm and cuff opening.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gauntlet_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and finger segments; colour 3 on the inner palm lining and the panel along the back of the cuff; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gautlet_01.description: A medieval-style armored gauntlet for the left hand: a tapered plate cuff with a rolled rim and rivets, a segmented knuckle guard, and articulated finger plates over an exposed inner glove.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gautlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and plates; colour 3 on the inner glove beneath the plates; colour 1 on the rim trim, if any.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gladiator_Mace_01.description: A gladiator mace held in the left hand: a large round spiked ball covered in cone-shaped spikes and scratched with crack-like grooves, mounted on a short handle with a banded cap at the top. Suggests an ancient arena weapon.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gladiator_Mace_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ball and the metal band of the cap; colour 3 on the spikes and crack markings; colour 1 on the top of the cap; colour 2 on the handle.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gladiator_Sword_01.description: A broad, long gladiator sword held point-down in the left hand: a wide tapering blade with a bordered edge and scratch marks, a spiked guard cluster around the grip, and a banded pommel cap.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gladiator_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade face and the band on the pommel; colour 1 on the blade edge border and the pommel cap; colour 2 on the grip; colour 3 on the guard spikes and the scratch marks.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Glove_Clockwork_Arm.description: A tight left glove that runs into a forearm gauntlet, with a flared cuff at the elbow end, panelled angular plating along the forearm, a banded wrist ring and a fitted fist with segmented knuckle plates. Superhero-tech style.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Glove_Clockwork_Arm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, wrist band and knuckle plates; colour 1 on the main forearm panels and the hand; colour 2 on the inner forearm panel and side of the hand; colour 3 on small accent panels at the wrist and back of the hand.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Glove_Golden_Age_01.description: A short, snug glove covering the left hand in a closed fist, with a thick cuff band at the wrist and a small flared fin-like flap rising from the outer edge. Classic retro superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Glove_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the wrist cuff band; colour 3 on the flared flap and its small stud.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Aquatic_.description: A short, snug glove covering the left fist and wrist, with a scale-like or spotted aquatic pattern across the whole surface. It has a plain cuff edge at the wrist and slight wrinkles at the knuckles and fingers.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Aquatic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric of the glove; colour 1 on the oval spots across the pattern.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendan.description: A short superhero glove covering the fist and wrist, with a V-shaped panel on the back of the hand edged by a raised contrasting trim line. The cuff ends in a contrasting band and the fingers are contrasting and segmented.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and the chevron on the back of the hand; colour 1 on the inset back-of-hand panel; colour 3 on the raised trim outlines; colour 2 on the cuff band and fingers.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendan.differs: The female glove has a contrasting cuff band along the bottom edge of the wrist, which sits lower and looks more boxy.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendan.description: A short, form-fitting superhero glove for the left hand: a cuff wraps the back of the hand and wrist with curved swooping stripe lines and a contrasting band, over a smooth fist with bare-looking fingers.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fist and fingers; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel; colour 2 on the band across the knuckles; colour 3 on the piping and stripe lines.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the whole clenched fist, with a contrasting cuff band at the wrist that has a pointed, flared upper edge and a small contrasting inner panel. Casual superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 2 on the wrist cuff band; colour 0 on the small inner cuff panel.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.differs: The female cuff has sharper, more pointed flared edges at the wrist, while the male cuff is a plainer, straighter band.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.description: A short, close-fitting glove over a clenched fist, ending at the wrist, with bold swooping stripe panels across the back of the hand and knuckles and a small recessed panel at the palm. Sporty superhero look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the swooping stripe panels; colour 2 on the palm opening and inner recess.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.differs: The female glove has a more angular, layered cuff and a raised armored-looking palm plate, with broader stripe panels on the back of the hand.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the left hand in a clenched fist, ending at the wrist, with a thin raised web-like line pattern of looping and pointed shapes across the back of the hand.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the raised webbing lines.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering a clenched fist and ending at the wrist, with a thin angular line of contrasting piping running down the back of the hand. Simple, sleek superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the angular line trim.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjeste.description: A short, fitted fingerless-style glove for the left hand, covering the fist and wrist in patchwork panels of different fabrics, joined with visible contrasting cross-stitching. Harlequin jester look with a slightly ragged cuff edge.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjeste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knuckle and finger panels; colour 1 on the wrist and back-of-hand panel; colour 3 on the inner-hand patch; colour 2 on the stitching.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjeste.differs: The female glove has a large contrasting panel across the back of the hand and wrist, with contrasting mostly on the fingers and palm; the male version has contrasting on the back of the hand and contrasting on the palm side.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the fist and wrist, with a contrasting cuff band, angular faceted panels over the back of the hand, and segmented fingertip caps that give a sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and knuckle panels; colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the side panel of the glove and fingertip plates; colour 3 on the finger segments.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_.differs: The female glove has the light panel over the back of the hand and a contrasting side panel, while the male glove is mostly contrasting across the back with light fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Glow_01.description: A close-fitting fabric glove on a clenched fist, textured with a fine dimpled weave, with a large rounded panel over the back of the hand, thin lines running to knuckle pads, and exposed fingertips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and knuckle pads; colour 3 on the thin line details; colour 2 on the outlines around the panels.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gravitar_01.description: A long, smooth opera-style glove for the left arm, running from the fist to the upper arm with a flared cuff at the wrist and a fitted band with a small buckle at the top edge.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gravitar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the small buckle at the top band.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gunhand_Mechassn_02.description: A bulky mechanical gun-arm replacing the left hand: boxy armored casings around the forearm, ribbed segments and side pods, ending in a cluster of short gun barrels in a ringed muzzle. Sci-fi assassin style.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gunhand_Mechassn_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy casings and muzzle rings; colour 1 on the ribbed segments, pods and top cap; colour 3 on the small panel inserts; colour 2 on the barrels and joints.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gunhand_Warlord_01.description: A bulky sci-fi gun-hand replacing the left hand: a boxy armoured receiver with hazard stripes, a circular emblem and a vented side magazine, with a long ribbed barrel and a small loop handle hanging down the forearm.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Gunhand_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the receiver casing and barrel sections; colour 1 on the top block, vented side, barrel ribs and handle loop; colour 2 on the hazard stripes and small details.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A sci-fi armored gauntlet and glove for the left hand: a fist-fitted glove under a long scalloped plate shell over the forearm, with a round gem-like disc at the wrist and a pointed fin trailing behind.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and armor shell; colour 1 on the round wrist disc and the thin scalloped trim lines; colour 2 on the inner vent openings.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A sci-fi armoured glove covering the left hand in a clenched fist: smooth segmented plates over the back of the hand, contrasting finger joints, and a large angular hexagonal shield plate on the outer side with a round glowing emitter.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand plates; colour 1 on the large hex shield plate; colour 2 on the fingers and joint gaps; colour 3 on the round emitter.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Hook_01.description: A pirate-style hook hand: a tapered cup-shaped cuff capped with a flat stepped top sits over the left wrist, with a thin angular curved hook hanging down from its base.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Hook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff cup and its stepped top; colour 1 on the hook and the small neck joining it.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Hook_01.differs: The female hook is a little shorter and hangs more narrowly, with the curve less open than on the male.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A sci-fi armoured glove and forearm guard: a chunky octagonal cuff at the top, banded plating down the forearm, two segmented hoses running from the cuff to the knuckles, and a padded fist with knuckle guard.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and forearm plates; colour 1 on the cuff, bands, clamps and knuckle trim; colour 3 on the segmented hoses; colour 2 on the inner backing, fingers and hose ends.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a shaggy, fur-covered back and jagged tufts, a banded cuff at the wrist, and short claw-like tips along the knuckles. Monstrous, festive-demon styling worn on the left hand.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaggy fur covering the back of the hand; colour 1 on the cuff and knuckle-plate edges; colour 0 on the fingers and cuff stripes.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The female version has shorter, stubbier fingertips with a single contrasting claw hanging at the side, while the male has longer, pointed claws on each finger.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Leech_01.description: A left hand replacement forming a chunky, rounded fist with a smooth fleshy back, and short stubby tentacle-like digits curling from the front. Organic, creature-like and monstrous in style.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the fist and back of the hand as a fleshy skin tone; colour 1 on the tips of the tentacle digits, blending into the skin tone.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Leech_01.differs: The female version has shorter, more clustered tentacle digits tucked under the fist, while the male version has longer, more spread tentacles.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Light_01.description: A close-fitting superhero glove with a smooth fist and a long sleeve covering the forearm to just below the elbow, finished with a banded striped cuff at the wrist and thin trim at the top edge.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove back and cuff band; colour 1 on the palm and finger underside; colour 3 on the forearm sleeve; colour 2 on the thin cuff stripes and top edge trim.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Light_02.description: A short, snug glove for the left hand, covering the fist and wrist and ending in a cuff with two thin contrasting stripes. The palm and inner fingers are a separate panel. Simple superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Light_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and cuff; colour 1 on the palm and inner finger panel; colour 2 on the thin cuff stripes; colour 3 on the open cuff interior.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_01.description: A plain, smooth long glove that fits closely over the left hand and fist and runs up the forearm to just below the elbow, ending in a straight cuff edge. No visible trim or fastenings.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.description: A tight, form-fitting long glove reaching mid-forearm, with a folded cuff band at the top, a lengthwise contrasting panel down the front of the forearm, a fitted hand section and separate finger and knuckle segments.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff band and the finger tips; colour 1 on the forearm body and the finger segments; colour 3 on the front forearm panel; colour 2 on the hand and palm section.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Alien_Gladiato.description: A long alien gauntlet covering hand and forearm: a ribbed, organic-looking inner sleeve and knuckled fist, with stacked segmented armour plates down the outer forearm, each bearing a stud and pointed spikes.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Alien_Gladiato.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed sleeve and fist; colour 1 on the stacked forearm plates and knuckle band; colour 2 on the round studs and the wrist gaps; colour 3 on the spikes.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_0.description: A left-hand armoured gauntlet with a flared, angular cuff, a panelled forearm section with small spikes along the edges, and a fitted fist with segmented knuckle plates. Fantasy knight styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim and knuckle plates; colour 3 on the forearm centre panel; colour 1 on the side and back forearm panels and the trim around the fist; colour 2 on the hand and palm.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_0.differs: The female gauntlet has a large separate panel and contrasting hand section, while the male version is a single smooth armour piece with rows of round holes along the forearm.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.description: A long, smooth, tight glove covering the hand and forearm, with a ring of short cylindrical canisters strapped around the forearm just below the elbow-side end. Contrasting bands hold the canisters in place. Sci-fi gadget look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove; colour 2 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the canister end caps; colour 3 on the bands between the canisters.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.description: A snug, plain left-hand glove covering the fist and extending into a flared, long cuff over the forearm, with a small V-shaped notch at the inner front edge and a slightly thickened rim. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove including the cuff and rim; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting long glove covering the left hand and forearm to just below the elbow, with the fingers curled into a fist and short thin claw tips poking out at the knuckles.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and claws; other colour slots not visible.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_01.differs: The female claws are thinner, shorter and more needle-like, while the male version has larger, thicker curved claws.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_02.description: A tight long glove covering the hand and forearm, with a contrasting band near the elbow and a tall blade-like fin sweeping up from the back of the forearm. Small claw tips sit at the knuckles. Sleek, superhero look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and fin; colour 2 on the band near the elbow; colour 3 on the inner face of the fin; colour 1 on the small claw tips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_02.differs: The female version has tiny, barely visible claw tips at the knuckles, while the male claws are larger and more prominent.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_03.description: A tight, long glove reaching up the forearm, with a separate band around the upper cuff, a row of curved spines along the outer edge of the forearm and short claw tips at the knuckles.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and forearm spines; colour 2 on the cuff band; colour 1 on the knuckle claw tips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_03.differs: The female glove has a separate band around the upper cuff and small claw tips at the knuckles, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_04.description: A fitted glove covering the hand and forearm in a closed fist, with a thick banded cuff near the elbow studded with hex bolts, and three thin claw spikes extending from the knuckles.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove; colour 2 on the cuff band; colour 3 on the bolts; colour 1 on the claw spikes.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_04.differs: The female version has slim, thin claws sticking out sideways from the knuckles, while the male claws are chunkier and curl along the fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.description: A fitted, fingerless wrap covering the left hand and forearm, with angular contrasting trim bands and a triangular panel near the elbow end. Short curved claws jut from the knuckles.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap body; colour 2 on the trim bands and edging; colour 1 on the claws.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.differs: The claws are small and short, angled outward from the knuckles rather than a clustered set.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.description: A tight long glove covering the left hand and forearm, with swept, blade-like fins stacked along the forearm and pointed claw tips on the clenched fingers. Ancient, mystical gauntlet styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the swept fins and forearm blades; colour 3 on the claw fingertips and knuckles.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.description: A left-hand armored gauntlet made of overlapping scalloped plates that fan out along the forearm, with a fitted knuckle cover and only tiny claw tips at the fingers. Suits fantasy or alien armor looks.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer scalloped plates and hand cover; colour 2 on the underlying gaps and inner panels; colour 0 on the small claw tips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.differs: The female version has only tiny claw tips at the knuckles, while the male version has long, prominent curved claws.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Edged_01.description: A smooth, plain long glove for the left hand: it covers the fist and fingers and runs up the forearm to just below the elbow, ending in a flat, slightly angular cuff edge.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Edged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Flare_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting long glove covering the hand and forearm, with a wide flared cuff that bells outward below the elbow. Plain and sleek, suited to elegant, formal or superhero looks.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Flare_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Flare_02.description: A smooth, tight-fitting glove covering the left fist, extending up the forearm into a flared cuff cut at a sharp angle, higher on the outer edge. Plain, sleek superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Flare_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Flared_01.description: A fitted long glove covering the hand and forearm, with a thin band at the wrist and a seam down the front. The cuff ends in sharp pointed flares that fan out around the elbow side.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and hand; colour 1 on the flared cuff points; colour 2 on the wrist band and seam line.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Flared_01.differs: The female flare has a small cut-out window in the side of the points and the points are more separated, giving a more open, split look.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.description: A long, tight superhero glove that runs from the fist to the upper forearm, built from stacked colour-blocked bands with a flared angled cuff and a row of small metal spikes along the outer edge of the forearm.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and lower forearm band; colour 1 on the cuff, mid-forearm band and knuckle cap; colour 2 on the glossy band at the elbow end; colour 3 on the inner cuff accents and palm trim; the spikes take a metallic finish.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.description: A long, tight superhero glove covering the hand and forearm to just below the elbow, built from stacked colour-blocked panels with a flared angular cuff and a small knuckle detail at the fist.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and forearm panels; colour 1 on the cuff, mid-forearm band and knuckle cap; colour 2 on the wide band below the cuff; colour 3 on the small inner cuff and knuckle accents.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Glove_Folded_0.description: A snug left-hand glove covering the fist and forearm, finished with a thick folded-over cuff that flares out just below the elbow. Smooth, plain construction with a casual or superhero feel.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Glove_Folded_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove including the folded cuff; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.description: A snug fingerless hand and forearm wrap that runs from just below the elbow to the knuckles, with angular chevron-shaped contrasting trim bands, a small pleated panel near the top, and a thumb opening.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrap body; colour 2 on the edge trim, chevron bands and cuff outline.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.description: A snug, forearm-length glove covering the hand and wrist, with a flared cuff and a tall jagged lightning-bolt fin rising along the outer forearm. Superhero look, sleek and smooth.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the lightning fin; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Punk_01.description: A snug, fist-shaped glove with a wide flared cuff that stands away from the wrist, edged with a thin contrasting band at the join. Sits on the left hand and lower forearm in a punk-superhero style.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove hand; colour 1 on the narrow band at the wrist; colour 3 on the flared cuff; colour 2 on the thin edge line.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.description: A long, form-fitting glove covering the fist and forearm, with alternating bands of contrasting material and rows of long conical spikes along the outer forearm and across the knuckles. Suggests a punk or street-fighter look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, the middle forearm band and the thumb and fingers; colour 0 on the palm, back of the hand and the forearm bands between; colour 3 on the spikes.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.differs: The female glove has long, sharp conical spikes on the forearm and knuckles, and its cuff is open and angular.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Spines_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting long glove covering the hand and forearm up to below the elbow, with a row of long curved spines sweeping back along the outer edge of the forearm.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Spines_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the spines; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Steampunk_04.description: A bulky steampunk gauntlet with a flared forearm cuff, embossed knuckle plate and fist, a looping tube along the side, a round dial at the wrist, and three short cylindrical electrode prongs pointing outward.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Steampunk_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff and knuckle plating; colour 0 on the looping tube and fingers; colour 2 on the dial ring and prong end caps; colour 3 on the electrode cylinders and thin line details.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.description: A long, smooth left-hand glove reaching past the wrist to the forearm, with a flared cuff and a bat-like scalloped wing membrane sweeping back from the outer forearm. Suggests a gothic superhero look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the wing; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.description: A long, close-fitting glove reaching the forearm, with a separate contrasting cuff band at the top and stained, blotchy patches across the hand and wrist. Fingertips are exposed, giving a grimy, undead look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove; colour 1 on the upper cuff band; colour 2 on the exposed fingertips and grime spots; colour 3 on the blood-like stains.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Longarmor_02.description: A fitted left-hand gauntlet covering the fist and forearm with stacked segmented plates, a contrasting flared cuff at the top and a long side panel down the arm, plus small studs across the knuckles.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Longarmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates and fist; colour 1 on the top cuff and the long side panel; colour 3 on the knuckle studs; colour 2 on the thin base under the studs.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A snug fingerless martial-arts glove worn on the left hand: a soft cloth wrap covers the back of the hand and palm to the knuckles, leaving the fingers bare, with a small contrasting cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper wrist and back of the hand; colour 0 on the knuckle and palm area and the lower cuff; colour 2 on the finger tips shown as small nails.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Mechanon.description: A left-hand gauntlet of layered, angular mechanical plates and struts forming a cage-like fist, with a thick banded cuff at the wrist and small pointed spikes at the knuckles. Robotic, sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates and struts; colour 1 on the inner panels and framework; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and some plates; colour 3 on the small spikes and inner accents.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.description: A clenched alien fist with a mottled, crystalline-looking hand and two clawed fingers, wrapped by a segmented band and topped by a tall armoured gauntlet cuff with a flared, ridged rim at the forearm.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the gauntlet cuff and its ridges; colour 3 on the segmented band across the back of the hand; colour 0 and colour 1 mottled across the hand and claws.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.differs: The female version has visible thin claw spikes protruding from the fingers and a slightly shorter, more tapered cuff.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Medium_Flared_01.description: A smooth, tight-fitting glove covering the left hand in a closed fist, with a slightly flared cuff that extends over the wrist and lower forearm. Plain, simple construction suited to most costume styles.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Minigun_01.description: A rotary minigun replacing the left hand: a cluster of long parallel barrels held by stacked ring clamps and banded collars, with short thick muzzle-like housings at the wrist end. Hangs at the arm's end as a bulky sci-fi weapon.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Minigun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrels; colour 3 on the ring clamps and end housings; colour 1 on the banded collar panels; colour 2 on the barrel bases and small details.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Monster_01.description: A clenched monstrous left fist with faceted, low-poly skin-like knuckles and short curved claws at the fingertips. It sits on the hand only, giving a beastly, creature-like look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the fist itself shows a skin tone that does not appear to follow the colour scheme.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Monster_01.differs: The female claws are shorter and stubbier, curling less far out from the fingertips.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_None_01.description: An essentially empty left-hand piece: only a tiny flat disc-shaped cuff at the wrist end of the sleeve, with no glove, fingers or added detail. The bare hand shows through.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tiny wrist disc; no other coloured features.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Paw_01.description: A clenched, furry beast-paw glove for the left hand, with a straight cuff at the wrist, mottled shaggy fur across the fist, padded palm areas and contrasting curved claws at the fingertips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Paw_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrist cuff and fur streaks; colour 3 on the mottled fur; colour 1 on the paw pads; colour 0 on the claws.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A short fingerless glove wrap for the left hand: a soft, wrinkled cloth sleeve covers the back of the hand and wrist, with a wide folded cuff edged in a band with zigzag triangular cutouts. Pirate-style.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth glove and cuff; colour 2 on the cuff band with its triangular notches.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A long fitted glove covering the hand and forearm, ending in a wide flared cuff with a zigzag-edged band at the rim. Chevron-shaped panels run down the outer forearm, giving a fancy pirate look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and cuff; colour 1 on the inner lining of the cuff; colour 2 on the zigzag band at the cuff rim; colour 3 on the chevron panels.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Power_Gauntlet_01.description: A chunky armoured gauntlet covering the forearm and closed fist: a flared cuff, segmented plates with inset contrasting panels, round gem-like studs on the forearm and knuckles, and contrasting gripping fingers. Bold superhero styling.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Power_Gauntlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armour plates and cuff; colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the round gems and knuckle studs; colour 2 on the fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Powersuit_01.description: A left-hand powersuit glove with a smooth fitted hand and a wide, angular flared cuff over the forearm. A separate armour plate sits over the knuckles, with small round inset lights and contrasting fingertip tips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Powersuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove hand and wrist; colour 1 on the cuff and knuckle plate; colour 3 on the round insets; colour 2 on the fingertip tips.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Prisonguantlet_01.description: A chunky, bulky armoured forearm gauntlet covering the wrist and hand, with a curved outer shell, layered segmented plates on top and a draping chain looped between round studs along the outer side. Suggests sci-fi prison restraint gear.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Prisonguantlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and cuff band; colour 2 on the upper housing, studs and lower hand cover; colour 0 on the segmented ridge plates; colour 3 on the chain.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Punk_01.description: A punk-style left gauntlet glove with a ribbed knit cuff, a rigid armored forearm shell with a raised outer plate, and a fist section with ribbed knuckle guard ending in pointed claw-like spikes.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauntlet shell and hand; colour 1 on the ribbed cuff and knuckle band; colour 3 on the raised forearm plate and knuckle claws; colour 2 on the rim and finger details.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Raptor_01.description: A clenched left-hand covering shaped like a reptilian fist, with rows of rounded spots across the knuckles and fingers and sharp curved claws jutting from the fingertips and palm side. Reads as a monstrous raptor talon.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Raptor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand covering; colour 3 on the spots and fingertip markings; colour 1 on the claws.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Raptor_01.differs: The female claws sit mostly beneath the fingers and curl downward, while the spots run in longer rows over the knuckles.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting glove covering the hand and forearm, with a tribal cuff of hanging pointed flaps and painted U-shaped motifs down the forearm, finished with a ragged, feathery contrasting edge at the top.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 3 on the cuff band and the line motifs; colour 1 on the pointed cuff flaps; colour 2 on the ragged top edge.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A bulky sci-fi gauntlet enclosing the hand and forearm in layered armor plates, with curved blade-like fins along the sides, short cylindrical barrels at the wrist and a central segmented strip.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 2 on the upper housing, spikes and joints; colour 1 on the curved side fins and trim bands; colour 3 on the central strip and small indicator lights.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A cybernetic left forearm and hand piece: an angular plated forearm guard flaring at the wrist, with a bare fist below. Coiled cables wrap the forearm and small hex-bolted sensor nodes sit on the outer face. Sci-fi implant look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forearm plating; colour 0 on the fist and the sensor nodes; colour 2 on the coiled cables; colour 3 on small indicator dots in the nodes.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A cybernetic left hand and forearm implant: a chunky angular plated bracer runs from the forearm over the back of the hand, with a segmented mechanical fist, bolt heads and coiled cables looping around it.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mechanical fist and fingers; colour 1 on the forearm plating; colour 2 on the coiled cables; colour 3 on small accent details and bolt highlights.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Robot_Claw_01.description: A mechanical replacement hand: a boxy wrist cuff with a layered plated forearm block leads to a jointed two-pronged pincer claw with segmented articulated fingers and small rivet-like studs. Sci-fi cyborg look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Robot_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating and finger segments; colour 1 on the wrist cuff and the curved claw tips; colour 2 on the joints and cabling; colour 3 on the small round lights and studs.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A clenched-fist hand covering with a crumpled, mottled surface, jagged crystal-like shards curling around the knuckles and fingers, and a few thin spines poking out; it fits snugly over the hand to the wrist.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fist and wrist surface; colour 1 on the shard facets and streaks along the back of the hand; colour 2 on the mottled patches.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.description: A left hand replaced by an organic, tentacle-like fleshy gauntlet that wraps the hand and forearm, with curling tendrils and small side tabs, ending in a curved crescent axe blade with a pointed tip and eye-like disc.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fleshy tendril mass (skin-like tone); colour 1 on the small tabs and the axe blade; colour 2 on the blade's underside edge; colour 3 on the eye-like disc.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.differs: The female axe blade is a narrow, long pointed spike hanging down past the hand, rather than a wide crescent blade.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Gun_01.description: An oversized, fleshy alien gun-hand: a bulbous, veined organic mass enclosing the hand and tapering to clawlike points below the fist, with small curling tendrils along the sides.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Gun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fleshy body; colour 1 on the veined streaks and ridges. The default material appears to show mostly its own skin-like tone.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Sword_01.description: A long, narrow, pointed blade held in the left hand, with a fleshy tentacle-like organic grip of curling tendrils wrapped around the hand and hilt. The blade has small round holes along its length and hangs down the thigh.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; the tentacle grip keeps a fleshy skin tone and ignores the colour scheme; the blade edges take colour 2.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A sci-fi soldier gauntlet for the left hand: a chunky armoured forearm cuff with a flared rim and a slab panel on the outer edge, tapering to a fitted fist glove with knuckle plating and segmented fingers.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm cuff and finger segments; colour 1 on the cuff top, wrist and inner sleeve; colour 2 on the glove back, knuckle plating and side slab; colour 3 on the wrist patch.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Shortfolded_01.description: A snug, short glove covering the left hand in a closed fist, with a thick folded-over cuff at the wrist. Simple, smooth fabric with soft creases across the knuckles; suits casual or superhero looks.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Shortfolded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the folded cuff.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_01.description: A skeletal left hand with a smooth wrist cuff, long individual finger bones and a separate thumb. The fingers curl inward into a claw-like grip, and a jagged faceted ring sits at the wrist.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones and palm; colour 1 and colour 3 on the faceted wrist ring.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_01.differs: The female hand has the fingers curled into a tight claw-like grip, while the male hand is held open with outstretched fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.description: A skeletal monster hand: a lumpy bony wrist and back-of-hand plate with a flared cuff, long thin finger bones curled into a claw, and sharp hooked talons at the fingertips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and back-of-hand bones; colour 1 on the long finger bones; colour 2 on the knuckle joints and lower finger segments; colour 3 on the sharp claw tips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.differs: The female hand has longer, more curved contrasting claws that flare outward from the fist.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Sleeve_01.description: A tapered tube-shaped sleeve covering the left forearm to the wrist, with a contrasting band at the upper cuff and a separate hem band at the lower opening. Loose, softly wrinkled cloth suggests a casual or superhero style.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Sleeve_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sleeve; colour 1 on the upper cuff band; colour 2 on the lower hem band.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Sleeve_01.differs: The female sleeve has a distinct, thick hem band around the lower opening and flares slightly wider at the wrist.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A clenched left-hand covering with a short cuff at the wrist and long, thin, curved claw-like fingertips that curl into the palm; the surface looks mottled and icy, suggesting a frosty monstrous or alien hand.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand and fingers; colour 1 on the mottled streaks across the knuckles and cuff.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The female version has the claws curled tighter into a fist and the fingertips are slightly shorter, with the thumb claw less extended.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Space_01.description: A fingerless sci-fi glove for the left hand: smooth, padded fist shell with a raised cuff panel on the back of the hand, segmented knuckle plates and exposed fingertips with separate tip caps.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove shell and finger bases; colour 1 on the cuff and back-of-hand panel; colour 2 on the knuckle plates and edge trim; colour 3 on the fingertips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Space_01.differs: The female glove has a shorter cuff and slimmer fingertips that stick out further from the fist.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A left gauntlet of layered angular armor plates running from the forearm to the fist, with open cutout gaps in the forearm, a segmented wrist joint, and a plated knuckle guard over fingers. Sci-fi ancient-tech look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the armor plates of the forearm and fist; colour 2 on the wrist joint and inner hand; colour 0 on small edge highlights; colour 3 on tiny accents on the plates.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A sleek armored left gauntlet covering the hand and forearm: segmented plates run along the back of the forearm to a pointed cuff, with a ribbed inner section, a contrasting inset panel, and a closed fist with rounded knuckle tips.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm and hand plates; colour 1 on the inner forearm band and the knuckle tips; colour 2 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the fingers and thumb.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Superlong_01.description: A skin-tight extra-long glove covering the hand and whole forearm and reaching up over the biceps, ending in a thin contrasting band below the shoulder. The surface is smooth and glossy, with a fist-shaped hand.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Superlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and lower forearm; colour 2 on the upper arm and upper forearm section; colour 1 on the top trim band.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A smooth, closed-fist glove with a short cuff and a separate panel down the back of the hand. Rounded knuckle ridges and a small hollow palm insert give it an organic, symbiote-like look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and knuckles; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and palm insert; colour 2 on the small fingertip points.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_01.differs: The female glove has only small, stubby fingertip points, where the male version has long curved contrasting claws.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A close-fitting symbiote-style glove covering the fist, with a contrasting cuff that sweeps into a long pointed tip along the outer hand and a few short contrasting claw spikes over the knuckles.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm and fist; colour 1 on the cuff and outer sweeping panel; colour 2 on the knuckle spikes.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_02.differs: The female glove has a few short knuckle spikes and a single long swept tip on the outer hand, while the male version has tall claw-like spikes rising from the back of the hand.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A bulky angular armored gauntlet for the left hand, built from faceted plates with a frame handle on top and two cylindrical canisters on the back of the hand. Long tapering claws extend past the fingers, suggesting a sci-fi acid weapon.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted armor plates and frame; colour 1 on the edge panels and the claws; colour 3 on the canisters and their caps; colour 2 on the inner cavity and canister bases.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Talon_01.description: A clenched left hand with a scaly, segmented plated back that runs over the knuckles and fingers, contrasting banded fingertips and short curved contrasting claws at the tips. A fantasy or monstrous gauntlet look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Talon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scaly plates across the back of the hand; colour 0 on the finger tips and bands; colour 2 on the claws; the skin-toned palm and wrist areas are not part of the colour scheme.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Talon_01.differs: The female claws are shorter and mostly tucked into the palm, while the male ones are larger and more visible.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Teddy_01.description: An oversized, lumpy fist covering for the left hand, with a rough, fluffy fur-like texture that wraps the wrist and knuckles. Angular crystal-like shards jut from the underside of the fist. Suits monstrous or elemental looks.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lumpy fist covering; colour 1 on the crystal shards at the base of the fist.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Terror_01.description: A monstrous clenched-fist glove with a lumpy, skin-like surface streaked with jagged contrasting markings, and a row of long sharp metallic claws jutting from the knuckles plus a large curved blade along the outer edge of the hand.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Terror_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skin-like fist surface; colour 2 on the jagged streak markings; colour 0 on the claws and knuckle plates.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Terror_01.differs: The female fist shows a skin-toned surface with contrasting streaks, while the male version defaults to a bolder colour-3 dominated pattern with fewer visible skin-like tones.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Thick_01.description: A smooth, thick left-hand glove with a clenched fist and a wide tubular cuff that extends up the forearm nearly to the elbow. The plain, slightly bulky cloth-like shape has an open rounded top edge.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Thick_01.differs: The female glove has a rounded, closed-looking cuff opening that flares gently, while the male cuff is cut with a sharper, slanted upper edge.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Trey_King_01.description: A left-hand wrist wrap with a bandaged cuff, holding a long curved saw blade with jagged, notched teeth along one edge. The blade hangs down past the thigh, giving a brutal, monstrous weapon look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Trey_King_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist wrap and the blade's hilt plates; colour 1 on the blade's flat face; colour 2 on the blade's edge and back side.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Trey_King_01.differs: The female blade is narrower and hangs straighter and more slender than the male one, which is broader and more curved.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Urban_Rings_01.description: A set of chunky metal rings worn on the fingers of the left hand, with angular, faceted bands sitting around the curled fingers. A tough street-style accessory.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Urban_Rings_01.colourAreas: The rings are glossy metal and ignore the colour scheme; the hand shown is the bare mannequin hand, not part of the piece.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A sci-fi armored forearm gauntlet and glove: a flared, scoop-shaped shell with a backswept fin rises at the elbow, and a smooth sleeve carries several loose spaced rings down to a fitted knuckle-plated fist.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sleeve and glove panels; colour 1 on the flared shell, rings and knuckle trim; colour 2 on small vent slots on the fins.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Viperia_01.description: A left-hand piece combining a fitted glove with a long sleeve that runs from the upper arm to the wrist. It has a separate band around the forearm, contrasting-edged jagged panel seams and a trimmed upper cuff. Suits a sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Viperia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sleeve; colour 1 on the glove and forearm band; colour 2 on the upper cuff and the seam edging.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Webbed_01.description: A bare clenched left fist with skin-like webbing stretched between the fingers, and thin spiky barbs jutting from the outer edge and knuckle side. It fits the hand only and suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Webbed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 is not visible on this piece; the whole hand and barbs show the skin tone, which ignores the colour scheme.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Webbed_01.differs: The female version has thin barbs sticking out from the side of the fist and no visible fingernails.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.description: A tiny ring worn on a finger of the left hand, a thin band with a small faceted stone that points downward from the clenched fist. It is a delicate, formal piece of jewellery.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and stone setting; colour 1 on the gem.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.differs: The female ring hangs visibly below the fist with a bigger pointed gem, while the male ring is almost hidden under the fingers.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Ring_Superl.description: A long, form-fitting opera-length glove reaching the upper arm, with a light cuff at the top, chevron-shaped trim lines on the forearm and near the wrist, and a closed fist. A small ring detail sits at the hand. Formal, elegant style.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Ring_Superl.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the glove body and fingers; colour 0 on the top cuff and the chevron trim lines; colour 2 on the small ring detail at the hand.

Female/F_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Superlong_0.description: A very long, smooth, form-fitting glove covering the left hand and forearm and reaching up over the biceps, with a plain cuff band at the top and chevron-shaped trim lines at the wrist and forearm. It suggests a formal, elegant style.
Female/F_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Superlong_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main glove body; colour 0 on the top cuff band and the chevron trim lines.

Female/F_Handl_Toy_01.description: A chunky cylindrical arm piece covering the forearm, with a thick hexagonal cap at the elbow end bearing a small round jewel-like button, and two heavy rounded bands near the wrist. Textured body suggests a retro mechanical gadget.
Female/F_Handl_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured forearm tube; colour 2 on the elbow cap and the wrist bands; colour 3 on the small round button on the cap.

Female/F_Handl_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A left fingerless glove with a short cuff and a large smooth back-of-hand panel, plus separate rings and knuckle plates on the curled fingers, with angular trim edges. Suggests a winter-themed, ornate fantasy look.
Female/F_Handl_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main glove panel; colour 1 on the cuff edge, lower hem and some ring segments; colour 0 on the finger rings and plates.
Female/F_Handl_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The female version is a full fingerless glove with a cuff and back-of-hand panel, while the male version is only a set of bare finger rings.

Female/F_Handl_Wrapped_Hook_01.description: A left-hand forearm wrap ending in a curved pointed hook in place of the hand, with a ragged crumpled cuff at the elbow end, banded coils of cord, and a slim curved guard plate along the outer side.
Female/F_Handl_Wrapped_Hook_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the crumpled wrapped sleeve; colour 3 on most of the cord bands; colour 1 on a few cord bands; colour 0 on the guard plate and the metal hook.
Female/F_Handl_Wrapped_Hook_01.differs: The female hook is slimmer and narrower, with a slender blade-like point, and the guard plate is smaller.

Female/F_Handr_Animal_01.description: A right clenched-fist hand covering in a skin-like tone with segmented fingers and short, curved pointed claw tips at the fingertips; it sits on the hand only and gives an animal, monstrous look.
Female/F_Handr_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner hollows around the palm and knuckles; colour 2 on the claw tips; the skin-toned hand surface ignores the colour scheme.
Female/F_Handr_Animal_01.differs: The female claws are short, small tips barely showing at the fingertips.

Female/F_Handr_Animal_02.description: A furry animal-style glove covering the right hand and wrist, with a shaggy tufted cuff, jagged fur edges around the fist opening and short curved claw tips at the fingertips.
Female/F_Handr_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur and finger pads; colour 1 on the jagged inner fur tufts; colour 2 on the darkest inner fur spikes; colour 3 on the claw tips.
Female/F_Handr_Animal_02.differs: The female version has fewer, shorter claw tips, mostly hidden beneath the fingers, and a smaller opening in the fist.

Female/F_Handr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A chunky right-hand gauntlet forming a closed fist: a bulky segmented armoured cuff and back-of-hand plate with a banded lower edge, and separate articulated finger segments curled into the palm. Retro robot look.
Female/F_Handr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff plating; colour 2 on the main hand plate and finger bases; colour 1 on the lower cuff band; colour 3 on the finger segments and the top rim of the cuff.

Female/F_Handr_Astronaut_01.description: A chunky sci-fi astronaut glove for the right hand: a rounded, padded fist with a thick rolled cuff ring at the wrist, a separate side panel, and a bulky contrasting palm grip with segmented finger pads.
Female/F_Handr_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the side panel and the inset under the palm; colour 2 on the palm pad; colour 3 on the cuff ring.

Female/F_Handr_Baseball_01.description: A padded leather baseball catcher's glove worn on the right hand, with four stubby fingers, a deep pocket, a woven lattice web between the thumb and fingers, an open wrist hole, and contrasting stitching along the seams.
Female/F_Handr_Baseball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 3 on the stitching and lacing marks; colour 1 on the woven web and lattice.

Female/F_Handr_Beast_Claw_Mechanical_01.description: A mechanical right-hand gauntlet forming a clenched fist: a segmented plated back of hand, ribbed finger plates with grooved channels, a round bolt-like cap at the knuckle side, and small claw tips, fitted over a narrow wrist cuff.
Female/F_Handr_Beast_Claw_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand plates and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the finger grooves, ribbing and round cap; colour 2 on the inner joints and claw undersides; colour 3 on the small striped panels near the knuckles.

Female/F_Handr_Bounty_01.description: A chunky sci-fi gauntlet glove covering a closed fist, with a short flared cuff, panelled body and an octagonal plate on the outer side of the hand. Segmented knuckle guards sit across the back of the fingers.
Female/F_Handr_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm side and cuff panels; colour 1 on the main back of the glove and inner palm; colour 2 on the knuckle guards and plate frame; colour 3 on the octagonal plate face.

Female/F_Handr_Bracers_Holoforce_01.description: A right forearm bracer of angular, translucent glassy plates: a layered shell over the forearm, a separate band near the wrist, and a long blade-like spike running along the outer edge toward the hand.
Female/F_Handr_Bracers_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and glassy and mostly ignores the colour scheme; the plates show a pale, light finish, with little visible use of colours 1, 2 or 3.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_01.description: A rotary gatling-gun hand piece: a cylindrical bundle of long barrels clamped by two chunky rings, one mid-way and a studded, notched ring at the muzzle end. It hangs below the right fist like a mechanical forearm cannon.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrels; colour 0 on the two clamp rings; colour 3 on the barrel tips at the muzzle end.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_02.description: A chunky cylindrical gauntlet-like cuff worn around the right forearm just above the hand, with an angular faceted casing, a recessed screen panel on the outer face, three rounded vent slots and a circular cap on top.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and top cap; colour 2 on the recessed panel surround and bottom rim; colour 1 on the screen; colour 3 on the three vent slots.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_03.description: A half-round bracer-like block worn on the right forearm near the wrist: a curved front face of ammunition-like cylinders between a rim and contrasting banding, with a flat plain back. Reads as a gatling gun mount.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer casing and rim; colour 1 on the row of cylinders; colour 2 on the banding and underside.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_04.description: A chunky cylindrical canister worn on the right forearm above the wrist, with a capped top, a recessed side panel, a short rod beside it and a bent hose ending in a small connector near the hand.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body and rod; colour 1 on the top cap, end ring, side panel and connector; colour 2 on the back panel; colour 3 on the hose.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_01.description: A rotary gatling barrel cluster hanging below the right hand: a bundle of parallel tubes held by two chunky band rings, with a notched collar at the muzzle end. Open at the top, with a sci-fi weapon look.
