Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrel tubes; colour 0 on the two band rings and the notched muzzle collar; colour 3 on the barrel tips.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_02.description: A chunky cylindrical canister worn around the right forearm just above the wrist, with chamfered edges, a circular recessed cap, a contrasting inset panel with a framed insert on the front, and three curved slots on the back.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and cap; colour 2 on the front panel and edge bands; colour 1 on the framed insert in the front panel; colour 3 on the three curved slots.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_03.description: A chunky half-round wrist-mounted gun block worn on the right forearm: a flat-sided housing with a rounded back, a recessed dished top and a ring of ribbed cylindrical barrels or cells wrapped around the curved edge.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer housing and top plate; colour 1 on the ribbed cylinders; colour 2 on the bands and base around the cylinders.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_04.description: A chunky cylindrical canister strapped along the right forearm, with capped ends, a contrasting inset panel on the outer side, a short side nozzle and a thin cable dangling to a small connector near the wrist. Suggests a sci-fi ammo or power unit.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body and nozzle; colour 1 on the end caps and the inner stripe; colour 2 on the inset side panel; colour 3 on the dangling cable.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Long_Mecha_01.description: A long, boxy mechanical clamp housing that encloses the right hand and extends past the fist, with a slotted window showing small block teeth inside and a split, chamfered end with contrasting bands.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Long_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing; colour 2 on the thin band above the tip; colour 3 on the end tips of the clamp jaws; colour 1 on the small teeth inside the window.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Long_Mecha_01.differs: The female version is slimmer and longer, sitting further down the forearm with a narrower window and more teeth.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A wing-like blade fin of stacked, swept-back feather shapes that runs along the outer forearm from the wrist toward the elbow, with a tiny knuckle stud on the fist. Suggests a bird-person or alien look.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather blades' edges and knuckle stud; colour 2 on the inner faces of the feather blades.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A tiny flat octagonal cap that seals the end of the right sleeve at the wrist, covering the opening with a thin disc. It has no other detail and reads as a plain cover.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap disc.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Tight_Prisonguantle.description: A short length of heavy chain links hanging from the right wrist, looped around it in two strands like a broken shackle. No cuff or glove is visible, so the hand stays bare. Gives a prisoner or escaped-captive look.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Tight_Prisonguantle.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all the chain links; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Handr_Child_Tight_Prisonguantle.description: A short length of heavy chain with two loose strands of linked oval links, hanging from the right wrist and dangling past the hand. No gauntlet body is visible, so it reads as a broken prisoner's shackle chain.
Female/F_Handr_Child_Tight_Prisonguantle.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all of the chain links.

Female/F_Handr_Chimera_01.description: An oversized, bulbous fist covering the right hand, with a wrinkled, muscular hide-like surface and jagged claw-like points at the knuckles; it sits at the end of the wrist like a monstrous gauntlet.
Female/F_Handr_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fist mass; colour 3 on the jagged claw tips and knuckle spikes.

Female/F_Handr_Chimera_02.description: A bulky beast-paw gauntlet for the right hand: a wrinkled, fur-textured mitten covers the fist and wrist, ending in four chunky fingertips with curved claws and a pad on the palm side.
Female/F_Handr_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrinkled paw covering and finger tips; colour 1 on the palm pad and patches between the fingers; colour 3 on the claws.

Female/F_Handr_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A chunky angular gauntlet covering the right hand in a clenched fist, built from faceted plates with a pointed guard over the back of the hand and long, narrow blade-like claws jutting forward from the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faceted hand plates; colour 2 on the claw blades and inner knuckle parts. Colours 1 and 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Handr_Defender_Update_01.description: A right-hand armoured gauntlet with a long angular forearm guard built from stacked segmented plates, a bulky fist section with a hexagonal knuckle plate, and exposed fingertip caps. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Female/F_Handr_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff, back plate and finger caps; colour 1 on the main forearm and fist plates; colour 2 on the front forearm panel and wrist band; colour 3 on the small accents on the hand.
Female/F_Handr_Defender_Update_01.differs: The female gauntlet's forearm guard is slightly shorter, with a less bulky fist.

Female/F_Handr_Draco_01.description: A fingerless fist glove with a smooth padded cuff and back, segmented armored knuckle plates over the fingers, and a few tiny claw tips at the knuckles. Sits on the right hand with a sporty, armored look.
Female/F_Handr_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main glove body and cuff; colour 2 on the knuckle plates; colour 0 on the palm and inner finger plating; colour 3 on the tiny claw tips.
Female/F_Handr_Draco_01.differs: The female glove has only tiny claw tips at the knuckles, while the male version has long, prominent claw spikes.

Female/F_Handr_Dryad_01.description: A chunky clenched-fist covering for the right hand, made of layered, bark-like angular plates with streaky vein-like markings, and stacked finger segments curled into the palm. Suggests a nature-guardian look.
Female/F_Handr_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the fist and finger plates; colour 3 on the streaky vein markings running along the plates.
Female/F_Handr_Dryad_01.differs: The female fingers are shorter and tucked tightly into a compact fist, while the male version has longer, more separated finger plates that stick out.

Female/F_Handr_Dryad_02.description: A clenched right-hand glove in a chunky, organic style: a smooth wrist cuff, mossy textured patches across the back and side of the fist, and segmented armored finger plates curling into the palm.
Female/F_Handr_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and main glove body; colour 1 on the mossy textured patches and finger edges; colour 2 on the segmented finger and knuckle plates.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Gamer_01.description: A wrist cuff with a curved back plate and a bulky padded front, joined by a looping cable to a slim rectangular game-controller slab that dangles along the forearm. It suggests a playful, casual gamer look.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the controller body and the outer wrist plate; colour 2 on the cuff; colour 3 on the controller buttons, cross pad and cuff stripe; colour 1 on the cable.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Lockbox_67_01.description: A wrist cuff with a buckled band paired with a cluster of sharp, blade-like claw spikes and thin linked frame loops across the knuckles and fingers of the fist. Aggressive, gauntlet-style street or sci-fi weapon look.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrist band and the claw blades; colour 1 on the band edging and the thin linking frames.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Long_Mechaclaw_01.description: A pair of long, flat curved blade claws that hang down from the right fist, alongside a separate angular guard plate at the hand. Sleek, sharp mechanical weapon-gauntlet look.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Long_Mechaclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two long claw blades; colour 1 on the angular hand guard plate.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Reactor_04.description: A short armoured hand guard for the right fist: a rounded plate wraps the wrist and back of the hand, with a separate side panel, thin edge trim and small rivets. Its jagged lower edge sits over the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate over the hand and the lower knuckle edge; colour 1 on the side panel; colour 2 on the thin edge trim; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Short_Retroscifi_Bu.description: A small translucent curved shell shaped like a half bubble, attached to the outer edge of the right hand and wrist. It is thin and glassy, in a retro sci-fi style.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Short_Retroscifi_Bu.colourAreas: The default material appears glassy and translucent and ignores the colour scheme; no colour slot is clearly visible.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Drill_01.description: A tapering conical drill held in the right fist, with a flat multi-sided cap at the top, a sharp point downward and vertical fluted stripes running the length of the cone. Simple, chunky tool-hand style.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top cap and alternating flutes; colour 3 on the other alternating flutes; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Punk_01.description: A short wrist cuff with a ribbed knit band rising above a rounded, beveled armored bracer. A raised hexagonal panel sits on the outer side of the wrist. Punk-styled and worn on the right wrist.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell; colour 1 on the ribbed knit cuff; colour 3 on the raised outer panel; colour 2 on the edge trim and lower rim.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A floating, oversized sci-fi right-hand device: an angular armoured casing with clawed prongs, small barrel-like cylinders and a contrasting sensor dot, ringed by detached curved blade-like fins hovering around the hand.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing plates and inner fin panels; colour 1 on the outer fin edges and the lower casing band; colour 2 on the prongs and upper housing; colour 3 on the sensor dot.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The female version has a small contrasting cylinder cluster and a slightly larger casing, with no separate contrasting-edged square emblem below the hand.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.description: A bulky sci-fi gauntlet for the right hand: angular layered armor plates around the forearm and fist, with jagged fins on top, a curved blade-like spike beside the hand and two small cylindrical emitter barrels at the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 2 on the upper fins, blade spike and plate edges; colour 1 on the cuff band and the small block under the barrels; colour 3 on the small round studs.

Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A set of three curved, tapering claw blades that extend from the right hand's knuckles and hang downward, with blocky bases and sharp points. Suggests a monstrous symbiote or organic weapon look.
Female/F_Handr_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw bases and upper blades; colour 1 on the tapering claw tips, blending down from the bases.

Female/F_Handr_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A chunky robotic right-hand gauntlet forming a closed fist, with faceted angular plating over the back of the hand and segmented mechanical finger joints. A flat, blocky plate sits across the knuckles and fingertips.
Female/F_Handr_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main faceted hand shell and finger segments; colour 2 on the flat blocky knuckle plate.

Female/F_Handr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A clenched right-hand covering shaped like a chunky fist, with a smooth rounded back and blocky, stubby fingertips curled into the palm. It ends at the wrist with a plain straight cuff edge.
Female/F_Handr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hand covering, including the fingers; no other slots visible.
Female/F_Handr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.differs: The female fingers are short, blocky rounded segments, while the male version has longer, more pointed clawed fingertips.

Female/F_Handr_Gatling_01.description: A large arm-mounted gatling cannon replacing the right hand: a cluster of long barrels with segmented rings, a boxy housing with drum magazines and vented side canisters, plus a small tank and exposed wiring behind.
Female/F_Handr_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, drums, rings and barrel bands; colour 1 on the barrels and housing panels; colour 3 on the vent slots, panel marks and barrel tips; colour 2 on the small lens and gaps.

Female/F_Handr_Gatling_Alt_01.description: A bulky sci-fi gatling gun replacing the right hand: a cylindrical armored housing at the forearm with slotted vents, a side canister, and a barrel cluster of long rods ending in a ringed muzzle.
Female/F_Handr_Gatling_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, canister and muzzle rings; colour 1 on the barrel rods and housing bands; colour 3 on the vent slots, small cables and barrel tips; colour 2 on the side panel and sensor.

Female/F_Handr_Glove_Odragon_01.description: A fitted right-hand glove in a closed fist pose with a short forearm cuff. A jagged, swooping separate panel runs up the outer wrist, edged with thin contrasting piping and a trimmed top edge.
Female/F_Handr_Glove_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove and fingers; colour 1 on the swooping wrist panel; colour 2 on the piping and cuff edge.

Female/F_Handr_Glove_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A fingerless fist glove with a tall, flared forearm cuff, a wide strapped wrist band and a padded knuckle section. Fingertips and thumb are left bare. Suggests a sci-fi adventurer or space scoundrel look.
Female/F_Handr_Glove_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff and knuckle pads; colour 1 on the mid forearm panel and the hand sections; colour 2 on the wrist strap and the stripe down the cuff.

Female/F_Handr_Heraldry_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet with a rigid angular plate over the back of the hand and knuckles, a textured mesh palm, and short pointed claw tips protruding from the fingertips. Gives an armored, predatory look.
Female/F_Handr_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the armored plates and finger segments; colour 1 on the textured palm and side mesh; colour 3 on the fingertip claws.
Female/F_Handr_Heraldry_01.differs: The female claws are short and sit at the fingertips, with the finger segments lying flat along the knuckles.

Female/F_Handr_Insect_01.description: A clenched right-hand covering shaped like an insect claw: a smooth wide cuff over the back of the hand, with pointed talon tips on the knuckles and curled segmented fingers carrying small contrasting spurs.
Female/F_Handr_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand and cuff shell; colour 3 on the large knuckle claws and finger tips; colour 1 on the curled finger segments; colour 2 on the small spurs and the thumb hook.
Female/F_Handr_Insect_01.differs: The female version has longer, more pronounced contrasting claws along the knuckles and small contrasting spikes at the finger tips, with a single large contrasting hook on the back of the hand.

Female/F_Handr_Insulating_Gloves_01.description: A chunky insulated glove with a wide flared cuff that reaches partway up the forearm, a separate rectangular panel on the outer forearm, and a padded fist section with segmented knuckle guards. Suggests superhero or sci-fi hazard gear.
Female/F_Handr_Insulating_Gloves_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim and knuckle tips; colour 1 on the main glove and forearm body; colour 3 on the rectangular forearm panel; colour 2 on the palm and fist padding.

Female/F_Handr_Junkbot_01.description: A right-hand replacement built from scrap-metal parts: a wrist cuff, thin rod struts, angular plates and a claw-like grip of mismatched pieces. It sits over the hand and looks improvised and robotic.
Female/F_Handr_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rods, struts and main plates; colour 1 on the wrist cap and angular panels; colour 2 on the cuff band and the flat grip plates; colour 3 on the small side panel and bolts.
Female/F_Handr_Junkbot_01.differs: The female version has a more compact, clustered hand body with a boxier contrasting panel on the front, and lacks the thick cylindrical block on the outer side.

Female/F_Handr_Kaiju_01.description: A right-hand covering with a short, fitted cuff over the hand and three long, curved talon-like claws extending from the knuckles, plus a raised segmented plate across the back of the hand. Monstrous, creature-like style.
Female/F_Handr_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main hand covering; colour 1 on the segmented plate on the back of the hand; colour 0 on the long claws; colour 2 on the small claw tips near the knuckles.

Female/F_Handr_Kaiju_02.description: An oversized monstrous right hand: a bulbous cluster of overlapping jagged scales around the fist that tapers into one long curved, ridged talon hanging downward. Fantasy creature style with a spiky crest at the top.
Female/F_Handr_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the overlapping scale cluster; colour 1 on the long curved talon.
Female/F_Handr_Kaiju_02.differs: The scale crest has a smaller, less prominent spike at the top than the male version.

Female/F_Handr_Largehook_01.description: A large pirate-style hook replacing the right hand: a short cylindrical cuff at the wrist with a thin, angular metal shaft that kinks and curls into a long pointed barb hanging down past the hip.
Female/F_Handr_Largehook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff; colour 1 on the hook shaft and barb.

Female/F_Handr_Lockbox_67_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a soft, slightly baggy hand and a buckled cuff band at the wrist. Tribal-style line patterns decorate the back of the hand, and sharp contrasting claw spikes jut from the knuckles and fingertips.
Female/F_Handr_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the cuff band and the knuckle claws; colour 1 on the pattern lines, piping and cuff edge trim.

Female/F_Handr_Long_Gamer_01.description: A chunky retro game-controller gauntlet: a wide cylindrical forearm cuff with an octagonal rim, a raised button panel with a cross and dots on the outer side, and coiled cable wraps at the wrist ending in a small wrist pad.
Female/F_Handr_Long_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and glove; colour 1 on the coiled cable wraps; colour 2 on the rim and wrist pad; colour 3 on the cross, dots and stripe markings.

Female/F_Handr_Long_Mecha_01.description: A blocky mechanical gauntlet-clamp worn over the right hand: a wide angular housing with a triangular marking tapers into a slotted twin-pronged pincer with notched teeth and banded tips, flanked by two side fins.
Female/F_Handr_Long_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and prongs; colour 1 on the side fins; colour 3 on the triangle marking and the pincer tips; colour 2 on the thin bands near the tips.

Female/F_Handr_Long_Mechaclaw_01.description: A boxy mechanical gauntlet housing over the right hand with an open-topped cuff, twin cylindrical pistons along the side, small clamp fittings, and two long curved blade claws sweeping down past the fingers.
Female/F_Handr_Long_Mechaclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and the long claw blades; colour 1 on the top cuff and the small hooked claw; colour 2 on the piston cylinders; colour 3 on the clamps and fasteners.

Female/F_Handr_Mas_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A fitted right-hand glove covering the back of the fist, with a contrasting trim band at the wrist and a cluster of decorative ring-like bands and small spikes over the knuckles and fingers. Fingertips are left partly open.
Female/F_Handr_Mas_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main glove body over the back of the hand; colour 1 on the wrist trim, finger bands and ring settings; colour 0 on the knuckle and finger details and small panels.

Female/F_Handr_Mecha_02.description: A chunky mechanical right-hand gauntlet: a segmented, angular fist with plated fingers curled shut and a large slab-like shield plate mounted along the outer side of the hand. Sci-fi mecha styling.
Female/F_Handr_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large side plate; colour 2 on the back-of-hand block and knuckle base; colour 0 on the finger plates and top cap; colour 3 on the finger tips and inner joints.
Female/F_Handr_Mecha_02.differs: The side plate is a slightly thicker, more tilted slab on the female version, and the finger plates show more of their contrasting segments.

Female/F_Handr_Mitten_Santa_01.description: A chunky, rounded mitten covering the right fist, with a thumb tucked against the palm and a thin seam line down the side, finished with a thick puffy fur-like cuff at the wrist. Festive, cartoonish holiday style.
Female/F_Handr_Mitten_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mitten body; colour 1 on the puffy cuff and the fine seam lines.
Female/F_Handr_Mitten_Santa_01.differs: The female mitten is mostly one main colour with a contrasting cuff, while the male version is split into several colour panels.

Female/F_Handr_Moth_01.description: A right-hand clenched gauntlet with a segmented, plated fist and a wide flared cuff of ridged panels at the wrist. Short pointed claws jut from the knuckles, giving a creature-like superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the flared cuff and wrist panels; colour 1 on the segmented fist plates; colour 0 on the claw tips.
Female/F_Handr_Moth_01.differs: The female version has short, small claws on the fist edge, while the male version has long, curved claws along the knuckles.

Female/F_Handr_Nightmare_Bladed_01.description: A bladed forearm guard: a long, tapering armored plate with a swept, pointed blade tip extending past the wrist, angular panels and an open back. It sits along the outer forearm with a dark, fantasy-armor look.
Female/F_Handr_Nightmare_Bladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame, edges and blade; colour 1 on the upper panel near the elbow; colour 3 on the large lower panel; colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Handr_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A right forearm bracer of overlapping angular plates with a flared cuff at the wrist and a long swept-back spike rising past the elbow. It sits over the forearm like fantasy armour.
Female/F_Handr_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the spike; colour 1 on the smaller inner plates and cuff edges. The glossy metallic finish largely ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Handr_Reactor_04.description: A chunky armoured gauntlet over a clenched fist, made of segmented plates with a raised cuff panel on the outer side, small rivet-like dots, and separate finger blocks. It reads as a sci-fi power fist.
Female/F_Handr_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knuckle and back-of-hand plates; colour 1 on the cuff panel and the fingers; colour 3 on the small rivet dots; colour 2 on the seam lines between plates.

Female/F_Handr_Renegade_01.description: A right-hand glove in a sci-fi armoured style: a short cuff and smooth hand shell with a contrasting wrap-around band across the back of the hand, two screw-like fasteners, and separate segmented finger plates.
Female/F_Handr_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove shell and cuff; colour 1 on the raised band across the back of the hand; colour 2 on the segmented finger plates; colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Handr_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A right-hand fist gauntlet with a bulky, angular plated block over the back of the hand and knuckles, rounded segmented finger pieces curled into a fist, and a bevelled rim of contrasting trim around the plate.
Female/F_Handr_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the large back-of-hand plate; colour 0 on the bevelled rim trim and edging; colour 1 on the segmented fingers and thumb.

Female/F_Handr_Retro_Warlord_02.description: A rotary minigun replacing the right hand: a chunky ribbed cylindrical housing with a separate collar ring, a cluster of long parallel barrels, and banded muzzle rings at the tip. Hangs at the side of the body.
Female/F_Handr_Retro_Warlord_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed housing; colour 2 on the collar ring; colour 0 on the barrels and muzzle rings.

Female/F_Handr_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.description: A mechanical right hand in a steampunk style: a boxy plated back of hand with a bolted side panel, segmented finger pieces ending in round contrasting-capped joints, and a chunky cylindrical thumb. Covers the whole hand.
Female/F_Handr_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back-of-hand plate; colour 1 on the side panel; colour 2 on the finger segments and inner palm; colour 3 on the bolts, joint caps and thumb cylinder.
Female/F_Handr_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.differs: The female hand has longer, more separated finger segments that extend further out from the palm.

Female/F_Handr_Robotexo_01.description: A robotic gauntlet hand: a segmented cuff at the wrist, a boxy plated back of hand with three round studs, and angular clawed mechanical fingers curled into a fist. Suggests a sci-fi cyborg or power-armor hand.
Female/F_Handr_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and the back-of-hand plate; colour 1 on the fingers, thumb and struts between cuff and hand; colour 2 on the knuckle blocks and joint housings; colour 3 on the round lights on the palm side and joints.

Female/F_Handr_Scarab_01.description: A chunky right-hand gauntlet with a wide cuff and a glossy angular plate on the outer side. Segmented, knuckle-like finger plates curl into a fist with tiny claw-like tips. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Handr_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff and hand body; colour 2 on the glossy outer plate; colour 1 on the segmented finger plates; colour 3 on small tips at the finger ends.
Female/F_Handr_Scarab_01.differs: The female version has only tiny, barely visible contrasting tips at the fingers, while the male version has long, prominent contrasting claws.

Female/F_Handr_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_0.description: A short retro sci-fi glove for the right hand: a fingerless, padded fist wrap with segmented knuckle guards, enclosed by a clear glass bubble dome around the hand. Sits at the wrist and hand only.
Female/F_Handr_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knuckle guards and glove plates; colour 1 on the small inset panel on the back of the hand; colour 2 on the inner glove lining; the bubble dome is glassy and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Handr_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_0.description: A right-hand glove made of angular segmented plates over a clenched fist, enclosed by a clear glass bubble dome on the palm side. contrasting-lit seams and a round palm panel give it a retro sci-fi robotic look.
Female/F_Handr_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented finger and knuckle plates; colour 1 on the glowing seam lines and round palm panel; colour 2 on the inner gaps; the bubble dome is clear and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Handr_Skeleton_02.description: A skeletal right hand made of separate finger and thumb bones with rounded joint knobs, curled into a loose fist and attached to a short flat cuff band at the wrist. Gothic, macabre look.
Female/F_Handr_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint ends; colour 2 on the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Handr_Skin_Fur_01.description: A bare clenched right hand with skin-textured fingers and a tuft of shaggy, spiky fur along the outer edge and wrist, with contrasting scratch-like markings. Monstrous werewolf style; the fingertips end in small contrasting claws.
Female/F_Handr_Skin_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts along the outer hand and wrist; colour 1 as shading in the fur; colour 2 on the claw tips and scratch markings; the skin ignores the colour scheme.
Female/F_Handr_Skin_Fur_01.differs: The female hand has only short, subtle contrasting claw tips barely visible on the fingers, where the male has long, prominent claws on every finger.

Female/F_Handr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.description: A clenched right fist with skin-textured, wrinkled knuckles, a ragged tuft of fur spikes around the wrist, and short curved claws at the fingertips. Monstrous werewolf hand that sits from wrist to fingers.
Female/F_Handr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts at the wrist; colour 2 on the claws; the skin-toned hand does not follow the colour scheme.
Female/F_Handr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.differs: The female claws are shorter and stubbier, curling close to the fingertips.

Female/F_Handr_Steelcommando_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet with a smooth, glossy metal-like plate covering the back of the hand and knuckles, segmented articulated finger plates, and small pointed contrasting-tipped spikes along the fingertips. Retro armored superhero style.
Female/F_Handr_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back-of-hand plate; colour 1 on the segmented finger plates; colour 3 on the fingertip spikes; colour 2 on the darker inner shading of the plate.

Female/F_Handr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet with a faceted, angular glossy shell over the hand, segmented finger plates, a short octagonal cuff at the wrist, and rounded knuckle studs. A retro superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove shell; colour 1 on the wrist cuff, finger plates and edge panels; colour 3 on the rounded knuckle studs.
Female/F_Handr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.differs: The female version has a slightly slimmer, more faceted shell, with the finger plates larger and more defined, but the design is otherwise similar.

Female/F_Handr_Swing_01.description: A chunky, clenched-fist glove with a rounded cuff, angular panels over the knuckle and outer side of the hand, and segmented padded finger sections. It has a bulky, sporty-superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and cuff; colour 1 on the raised outer and knuckle panels; colour 2 on the fingers.

Female/F_Handr_Swing_02.description: A smooth, soft cloth glove for the right hand, shaped into a clenched fist with a short cuff at the wrist. Loose creases across the back and a plain, unadorned finish suggest a casual or superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_01_Glove.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with a plain cuff ending just above the wrist and individually modelled curled fingers. Simple casual or superhero styling.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_01_Hand.description: A bare right hand with five separate fingers curled into a relaxed fist, thumb wrapped across the front. It sits at the end of the wrist and shows a natural, unadorned human shape.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_01_Hand.colourAreas: Skin tone is fixed and ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 appears only on the flat wrist cut-off and the fingertip nails.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_2fingers_01.description: A bare right hand with a closed fist, showing the fingers curled in with two fingertips tipped by short nails. It sits at the end of the sleeve and suggests a plain, natural hand.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_2fingers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fingernails of the two visible fingers; the rest of the hand shows skin tone and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A right-hand gauntlet with a flared, angular forearm guard, a fitted fist section with knuckle plates, and three long curved blade claws along the outer edge. Superhero styling with a 90s comic feel.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff and the knuckle plates; colour 1 on the lower forearm and the claw undersides; colour 2 on the glove and some claw tips; colour 3 on the back panel of the forearm.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The female gauntlet's cuff is slightly shorter and has a notched, open top edge.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A right-hand piece made of a fitted glove and a segmented, ribbed armour sleeve running from a tech cuff band below the shoulder to the wrist. It suggests a sleek 90s sci-fi look, with a small antenna-like clip on the cuff.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed forearm sleeve segments; colour 1 on the glove and the cuff stripes; colour 2 on the cuff housing and segment edges; colour 3 on the small cuff light.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_90s_Tech_02.description: A tech gauntlet with a segmented, overlapping-plate forearm guard running from below the elbow to the wrist, ending in a fitted glove with a knuckle plate and a small panel on the outer hand.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_90s_Tech_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates; colour 1 on the glove fabric; colour 2 on the wrist panel and knuckle plate; colour 3 on a small accent on the wrist panel.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Alien_01.description: A chunky, angular glove covering the whole clenched fist, with faceted planes, a banded cuff at the wrist and short claw-like fingertip points that curl in against the palm. Suggests alien armor.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the claw fingers; colour 3 on the claw tips and small marks on the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Alien_01.differs: The female claws are shorter and curl tightly into the palm, with small contrasting marks on the knuckle side.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Archer_01.description: A right-hand archer's gauntlet: a snug bracer that flares slightly from the wrist up the forearm, with angled panel sections, joined to a fitted glove with segmented finger plates and a strap across the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove back, finger plates and the lower forearm band; colour 1 on the main forearm panels, knuckle cap and glove sides; colour 2 on the angled forearm panel and inner glove; colour 3 on the thin edge trim at the cuff and thumb.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A bulky armored gauntlet-blaster covering the right forearm and wrist, with raised banded ridges on the outer face, a swept side panel, and a ribbed finned barrel extending toward the knuckles. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell, ridged barrel and edge frames; colour 3 on the raised ridge bands, side panels and inner recess; colour 0 on the hand glove; colour 3 on the fingertip claws.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Armadillo_01.differs: The female version has a longer, flatter blade-like plate hanging down beside the hand and blunter fingertip tips.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Armorninja.description: A fingerless armoured glove for the right hand: a rounded, plated cuff and back-of-hand guard with a row of round studs across the knuckles, and exposed segmented finger sections beneath.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plated hand guard and cuff; colour 2 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the round knuckle studs; colour 3 on the finger sections.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Ball_01.description: A smooth, faceted spherical ball that replaces the right hand, joined to the wrist by a short thick cylindrical cuff band. Simple, rounded and cartoonish, it suits robotic or cute costumes.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Ball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ball; colour 1 on the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Banded_01.description: A smooth, tight right-hand glove covering the fist and reaching up the forearm, finished with a wider, flared cuff band at the top edge with a thin separating line. Simple, clean superhero styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Banded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and the cuff band; the thin separating line at the cuff edge is a darker inset.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Bear_01.description: A right-hand and forearm covering styled as a bear paw: shaggy, jagged fur tufts run up the forearm and fade toward a smooth, rounded paw, which ends in short curved claws at the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts up the forearm; colour 0 on the paw base and fur tips; colour 2 on the claws.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A right-hand glove with a long, slightly wrinkled cuff reaching up the forearm and a fitted fist, with a contrasting band at the top edge and a row of layered, feather-like blades sweeping back along the outer forearm.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and hand; colour 1 on the top cuff band; colour 2 on the feather blades along the outer edge.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A long, smooth glove covering the fist and forearm, with a wide flared cuff at the top and a row of stacked, swept-back feather blades along the outer edge of the forearm, giving a bird-wing look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and fist; colour 1 on the cuff band and the feather blades.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: A right gauntlet with a flared cylindrical cuff, segmented armored finger plates and thin cable wiring, with long blade-like shears extending past the fingers. Reads as a menacing, gothic bladed weapon glove.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the gauntlet cuff, finger plates and cables; colour 1 on the long blades; colour 3 on a small accent light on the cuff.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Boxing_01.description: A padded, rounded boxing glove for the right hand, with a thumb tucked against the fist, a short cuff around the wrist, a criss-cross lace at the back and a printed band with lettering on the cuff.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Boxing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded glove body and cuff; colour 1 on the laces; colour 3 and colour 2 on the lettered cuff band.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Bracer_Cosmic_01.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a thick cuff at the elbow end, two raised straps around the middle and a banded cuff at the wrist. A small angular fin and a hexagonal plate sit on the outer back of the arm. Sci-fi superhero style.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Bracer_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell and the hexagonal back plate; colour 1 on the wrist band and shell panels; colour 2 on the elbow cuff, straps and vertical stripe; colour 3 on part of the wrist band.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cannon_01.description: A heavy, faceted cannon covering the right hand and wrist: a chunky octagonal barrel built from stacked segments with small fin ridges, side vents and a ringed muzzle at the top. Reads as sci-fi weapon gauntlet.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper barrel plates and the middle segment; colour 1 on the barrel sides, lower housing and outer rings; colour 2 on the small gaps and latches; colour 3 on the underside of the base.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cannon_01.differs: The female cannon is built from multiple stacked segments with fins and vents in a two-tone pattern, while the male one is a single smooth faceted barrel.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cannon_02.description: A large smooth cylindrical cannon worn over the right hand, with a faceted, tapered body, a chamfered top rim with a ringed opening and small vent slits, and a capped base at the wrist end. Sci-fi hand weapon.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cannon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main barrel casing; colour 1 on the end cap and the inner opening; colour 3 on the small slits around the rim.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cannon_02.differs: The female version is a plain, smooth barrel with only small rim slits, while the male version is a chunkier, multi-part cannon with raised fins and cut-out vents.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cartoon_01.description: A cartoon-style clenched glove for the right hand: a puffy rounded cuff at the wrist, a smooth chunky fist with simple curled fingers, and three short stitched lines on the back of the hand.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cartoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the puffy cuff; colour 1 on the fingertips; colour 3 on the three lines on the back of the hand.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Claw_01.description: A right hand posed in a tight fist with a short, sharp, pointed claw extending from each fingertip. The claws are slim and curved slightly forward, suggesting a feral or superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the hand itself shows skin and does not take a colour slot.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Claw_02.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with small pointed claws jutting from the knuckles and fingertips. It ends at the wrist, giving a feral superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the claws and the shaded underside of the fingers.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Claw_02.differs: The female version has short, thin spikes sticking out from the knuckles and side of the fist, and its claws are smaller and less curved.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Colossus_01.description: An oversized, clenched right fist covered in rounded, cobblestone-like rock plates separated by narrow seams, with a few jagged crystal shards jutting from the knuckle side. Sits over the hand as a chunky stone gauntlet.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock plates; colour 3 on the seams between the plates; colour 1 on the jagged shards at the knuckles.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A clenched-fist glove with a chunky, faceted cuff and back-of-hand guard edged in contrasting trim, rounded knuckle studs along the front, and segmented fingers. Suggests a sci-fi western gauntlet.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and hand guard; colour 2 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the knuckle studs; colour 3 on the fingers.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A tight fingerless-style glove for the right hand with a short cuff, a panel over the back of the hand with slotted vents and pointed knuckle fins, and segmented finger sections. It suggests a techy, cyber look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the finger sections and palm; colour 1 on the main back-of-hand panel; colour 2 on the cuff; colour 3 on the vent slots, knuckle points and cuff fin.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A right-hand cybernetic fist with faceted, segmented knuckles and rounded fingertip caps, topped by a chunky octagonal wrist cuff with vertical slots and contrasting trim. Sits on the hand and wrist in a sci-fi style.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and fingers; colour 2 on the wrist cuff body; colour 1 on the cuff trim and slotted ribs; colour 3 on the fingertip caps.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Defender_01.description: A right-hand gauntlet with a smooth fitted glove and a tall angular flared cuff that rises over the forearm, with swooping slash grooves and pointed knuckle plates over the fist. Superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and inner hand; colour 1 on the forearm cuff and knuckle plates; colour 3 on the slash grooves and seam lines; colour 2 on the palm interior.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Deity_01.description: A close-fitting right-hand glove with a clenched-fist shape, rigid angular plates over the knuckles and fingers, small pointed tips at the fingertips, and a flared cuff with a contrasting inner lining at the wrist.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the glove body and fingers; colour 0 on the knuckle plates, fingertip tips and outer cuff shell; colour 3 on the inner cuff lining.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A right-hand gauntlet with a segmented plated fist and a long angular forearm guard that flares open at the elbow end. Ridged panels are crossed by thin raised bands, giving a rugged armoured look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fist plates and the inner lining of the flared cuff; colour 1 on the forearm panels; colour 2 on the crossing bands and edge trim.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A right gauntlet of segmented plate: a tall angular cuff at the forearm, a banded wrap at the wrist, a fitted fist with articulated fingers, and a long side plate with rivet detailing running along the outer forearm.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm sleeve and the fist; colour 1 on the long outer side plate; colour 2 on the cuff rim; colour 3 on the wrist bands.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A cartoonish dinosaur-suit glove for the right hand: a chunky closed-fist mitt with pointed claw tips on the fingers, three slash marks on the outer side, and a puffy rounded fluffy cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the claw tips; colour 2 on the puffy cuff; colour 3 on the slash marks.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Drill_01.description: A right-hand drill attachment: a long, tapering striped cone that points downward from the wrist, topped by a studded cylindrical cuff with a row of round holes. Suggests a comic-book superhero gadget.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and the stripes of the cone; colour 3 on the alternating stripes of the cone; colour 1 on the inner core visible between the cuff and cone.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Edged_01.description: A smooth, plain long glove for the right hand: a slightly flared open cuff reaches up over the forearm, and the glove tapers down to a closed fist with sculpted fingers. Simple, plain construction with no visible seams.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Edged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Foamfinger_01.description: A flat foam-finger novelty prop shaped like a giant hand with the index finger pointing downward, printed with an emblem and finger outlines. It hangs at the right hand and reads as a casual, cute sports-fan accessory.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Foamfinger_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foam body and thick edge; colour 1 on the printed outline, finger lines and central emblem.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gauntlet_Short_01.description: A short armored fist gauntlet with overlapping segmented plates across the knuckles and back of the hand, exposed fingertip plates, and a rim at the wrist. It suits sci-fi or military armor looks.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gauntlet_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor plates and finger plates; colour 3 on the inner lining and palm panel; colour 2 and colour 1 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gautlet_01.description: A right-hand plate gauntlet with a flared, rivet-studded cuff that reaches partway up the forearm, a clenched fist of overlapping segmented finger plates, and a raised knuckle guard over an exposed inner lining.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gautlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, finger plates and knuckle guard; colour 3 on the inner hand lining and palm; colour 1 and colour 2 are not visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gladiator_Mace_01.description: A spiked ball mace head held at the right hand: a large round scuffed head studded with many cone spikes, topped by a short octagonal metal collar and band where the handle would be. Brutal arena-fighter styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gladiator_Mace_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ball head and the collar's lower ring; colour 1 on the collar cap and band; colour 3 on the spikes and the scratch markings on the ball.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gladiator_Sword_01.description: A broad gladiator sword held in the right hand, pointing downward: a wide tapering blade with a bevelled edge and scratch marks, a cluster of spiked claw-like guard prongs, and a banded cylindrical pommel cap at the wrist.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gladiator_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade face and the pommel band; colour 1 on the blade edges and the pommel cap top; colour 2 on the grip core; colour 3 on the spiked guard prongs and blade scratches.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Glove_Clockwork_Arm.description: A tight right-hand glove with an extended forearm gauntlet made of angular panels, a wide banded cuff below the elbow end, a wrist band, and segmented knuckle plates over the fist. Suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Glove_Clockwork_Arm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff bands, knuckle plates and upper rim; colour 1 on the main forearm and hand panels; colour 2 on the inset panels and palm; colour 3 on the small accents at the wrist and rim.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Glove_Golden_Age_01.description: A tight, smooth glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist shape, finished with a short angular cuff at the wrist and a flared fin-like flap on the outer side, with a small round stud. Classic superhero styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Glove_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the cuff band; colour 3 on the flared flap on the outer wrist.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_02.description: A short, form-fitting glove covering the right hand and fist, with a wrist cuff and curved swooping bands of contrasting piping across the back of the hand and knuckles; fingers are bare-shaped and smooth. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm and fingers; colour 1 on the back-of-hand and wrist panel; colour 2 on the band across the knuckles; colour 3 on the piping lines.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Aquatic_.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, ending at the wrist. It has a printed scale-like or spotted pattern and separately shaped fingers, with a smooth stretchy fit.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Aquatic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric; colour 1 on the repeating oval scale pattern. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendan.description: A short, form-fitting superhero glove covering a clenched fist, with a chevron-shaped panel on the back of the hand, piped edges, a contrasting cuff band, and separate segmented finger sections.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back-of-hand chevron panel and upper wrist; colour 1 on the main glove body; colour 3 on the piping and trim lines; colour 2 on the finger segments.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.description: A short, close-fitting glove for the right hand, shown as a clenched fist with sculpted finger segments. A separate contrasting cuff sits at the wrist, and the glove ends just past the wrist bone. It suggests a classic superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 2 on the wrist cuff band.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.description: A short, snug tight-fitting glove on a clenched fist, ending just past the wrist, with swooping abstract stripe panels across the back of the hand and knuckles and contrasting openings at the palm and finger gaps.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the swooping stripe panels across the back, side and cuff; colour 2 on the inner palm and finger openings.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.description: A short, snug glove on the right hand that covers the fist and ends at the wrist. Raised web-like line work in a contrasting colour forms a triangular, spiderweb pattern across the back of the hand. Suits a classic superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the raised webbing lines across the back of the hand.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, ending at the wrist. Thin contrasting linework runs along the outer edge in an angular chevron, giving a clean classic superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the thin line trim along the outer edge.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjeste.description: A short, fingerless-style fist glove with a patchwork jester look: a wrist cuff and back-of-hand panels in separate colour blocks, joined by contrasting criss-cross stitching, with the finger area left exposed.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjeste.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff and main back-of-hand panel; colour 3 on the patch near the knuckles and wrist; colour 0 on the palm, finger area and centre panel; colour 2 on the stitching.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjeste.differs: The female glove has the contrasting-slot cuff and back panel as the largest area, with the light panel mostly on the palm and fingers, while the male one is mostly light with the contrasting on the front.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_.description: A short, close-fitting glove for the right hand that covers the fist and wrist, with a cuff band at the wrist, a large panel over the back of the hand, and separate angular caps over each finger.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm side and the outer glove body; colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the back-of-hand panel and finger undersides; colour 3 on the fingertip caps.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_.differs: The female glove has the light main body on the palm and outside with the contrasting panel on the back of the hand, and contrasting finger caps, whereas the male glove reverses this.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Glow_01.description: A snug, textured fabric glove covering the right hand in a closed fist, with a raised rounded panel on the back of the hand, thin lines running to knuckle pads on each finger, and a small pad on the thumb side.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and knuckle pads; colour 3 on the thin lines; colour 2 on the outlines around the panel and pads.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gravitar_01.description: A long, smooth opera-style glove reaching the upper arm, with gentle wrinkling at the elbow and forearm, a separate flared cuff at the wrist, and a small buckled band around the top edge. Suits superhero or formal looks.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gravitar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the buckle and small tab at the top band.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gunhand_Mechassn_02.description: A bulky mechanical gun-arm that replaces the right hand and forearm: boxy armoured housings, a ribbed segmented barrel section with cable-like braces, and twin barrels ending in ringed muzzles at the wrist.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gunhand_Mechassn_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy armour housings and braces; colour 1 on the ribbed segments, rear block and barrel tips; colour 3 on the small inset panels and stripes; colour 2 on the barrels and joints.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gunhand_Warlord_01.description: A bulky sci-fi gun-arm replacing the right hand: a boxy armored housing at the wrist with a vented side, hazard-striped edge and round emblem, feeding a long barrel with a ribbed rail and a trigger loop.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Gunhand_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armored housing and barrel casing; colour 1 on the top block, ribbed rail, vents and barrel tip; colour 2 on the hazard stripes and small fittings; colour 3 on small details.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A right-hand armored gauntlet with a chunky fist and a long scalloped forearm shell that flares to a point past the wrist, with a round glowing socket on the outer plate and small contrasting vents. Sci-fi armor look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauntlet shell and fist; colour 1 on the round socket and the scalloped ridge lines; colour 2 on the small vent openings.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The female version has a wider, flatter outer shell plate that stands slightly away from the arm.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A sleek armored glove for the right hand: segmented plates cover the back of the hand and articulated fingers, with a large angular shield plate on the outer edge that carries a small octagonal emblem and rivets.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and back-of-hand plates; colour 1 on the outer shield plate; colour 2 on the finger segments and inner trim; colour 3 on the octagonal emblem.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A right-hand gauntlet with a chunky octagonal cuff at the forearm, banded glove and knuckle plate, and two ribbed hoses running along the outer forearm to the wrist, clamped by small straps. Sci-fi power-armor look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and forearm bands; colour 1 on the cuff, strap clamps and knuckle plates; colour 2 on the fingers and inner mechanism; colour 3 on the ribbed hoses.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A right-hand fist glove covered in shaggy, jagged fur tufts over the back of the hand, with a contrasting cuff at the wrist and segmented claw-like fingertips curling into the palm. A monstrous holiday-creature look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaggy fur; colour 1 on the wrist cuff and finger edging; colour 0 on the finger segments and palm plates.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The female glove has short, blunt finger segments and a chunkier palm plate, while the male has longer, sharper claw tips.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Leech_01.description: A right hand replaced by a clenched, fist-shaped organic mass with skin-like faceted surfaces and short, blunt tentacle-like fingers curling from the front edge, giving a monstrous, alien look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fist and knuckle mass (skin-toned surface); colour 1 on the tips of the tentacle fingers, fading into the base.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Leech_01.differs: The female tentacles are shorter and tucked closer under the fist, with fewer visible finger tips at the back.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Light_01.description: A right-hand glove and forearm sleeve in one piece: a fitted fist-shaped glove with a banded cuff, leading into a smooth sleeve that runs up past the elbow with a thin trimmed top edge. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove back, fingers and the sleeve's top opening; colour 1 on the palm and knuckle panels; colour 3 on the sleeve; colour 2 on the cuff and top edge stripes.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Light_02.description: A short, snug superhero glove covering a clenched fist and wrist, with a flat octagonal cuff opening, thin double banded stripes at the cuff edge, a raised back-of-hand panel and separate segmented finger ridges.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Light_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and finger ridges; colour 1 on the back-of-hand and palm panel; colour 2 on the thin stripes at the cuff; colour 3 on the cuff top.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_01.description: A plain, smooth long glove for the right hand and forearm, covering the fist and fingers and ending below the elbow with a straight edge. Fitted and seamless, with no added detail.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.description: A snug long glove covering the right hand and forearm, with a wide contrasting cuff band at the top, a recessed panel down the inner forearm, and a separate fist section with exposed finger tips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff band and the finger tips; colour 1 on the forearm and knuckle edges; colour 3 on the inset forearm panel; colour 2 on the hand section.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.differs: The female glove has distinct coloured panels: a cuff band, inset forearm stripe and separate hand section. The male version has a single speckled texture.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Alien_Gladiato.description: A long right-hand gauntlet covering fist and forearm: ridged, rib-textured organic sleeve with a row of stacked segmented plates along the outer edge, each carrying a stud and a pointed spike, plus a knuckle guard with spikes.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Alien_Gladiato.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed sleeve and the fist; colour 1 on the stacked outer plates and knuckle guard; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the round studs and knuckle grille.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_0.description: A long armored gauntlet for the right hand and forearm, with a flared octagonal cuff, a raised panel down the outer forearm, a row of small spikes along the edge, and a chunky fist section with studded knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, upper forearm and finger plates; colour 1 on the lower forearm shell and knuckle edging; colour 3 on the inset forearm panel; colour 2 on the fist and back of the hand.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.description: A smooth, long form-fitting glove reaching the forearm, with a ring of upright cylindrical canisters strapped around the upper forearm cuff, held by thin bands. Suggests a sci-fi superhero gadget look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove; colour 2 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the canister end caps; colour 3 on the bands between the canisters.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.description: A tight right-hand glove with a long flared gauntlet cuff reaching partway up the forearm, with a V-shaped chevron notch cut into the outer edge of the rim. The hand is a closed fist with defined fingers.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and cuff; the sheet shows no other colour slots on this piece.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_01.description: A smooth, tight-fitting long glove for the right hand, reaching partway up the forearm, with a closed fist and short thin claw tips at the fingertips. Sleek, form-fitting superhero or feral style.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; the claw tips appear to take a shade, likely colour 2.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_01.differs: The female claws are shorter, thinner and more subtle than the male version's longer, curved claws.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_02.description: A tight long glove covering the hand and forearm, with a contrasting band near the elbow and a tall pointed blade-like fin flaring up the back of the forearm; small claw tips at the fingers.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and fin edge; colour 2 on the band; colour 3 on the inner face of the back fin; colour 1 on the small fingertip claws.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_03.description: A tight, long right-hand glove reaching up the forearm, with a separate contrasting band at the top, a row of long curved spines along the outer forearm edge, and small claw tips on the fingertips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and the forearm spines; colour 2 on the top band; colour 1 on the fingertip claws.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_03.differs: The female glove has a separate band at the top of the cuff and contrasting fingertip claws, while the male version has no band and its claws take the glove colour.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_04.description: A tight, smooth glove covering the hand and forearm in a clenched fist, with long pointed claws extending from the fingertips and a wide contrasting cuff near the top secured by hex bolts.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove; colour 1 on the claws; colour 2 on the cuff band; colour 3 on the bolts.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_04.differs: The female claws are longer and extend visibly outward past the knuckles, while the male claws are shorter and curl in against the palm.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.description: A fingerless wrap glove covering the hand and forearm almost to the elbow, with angled contrasting trim bands and a V-shaped panel; short claw tips poke out at the knuckles. Suggests a martial, fantasy look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap body; colour 2 on the trim bands and edging; colour 1 on the claw tips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.differs: The claws are short and small, barely extending past the knuckles.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.description: A right-hand gauntlet that runs from the fist up the forearm: a snug glove with a row of curved, blade-like fins along the outer edge, a flared cuff, and pointed claw tips over the knuckles. Suggests an ancient mystical look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and forearm sleeve; colour 1 on the curved fins, cuff edging and knuckle guard; colour 3 on the claw tips and knuckles.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.description: A right gauntlet of stacked, scalloped armor plates fanning out along the forearm, with a flared cuff and a fitted hand section over the knuckles. Only tiny claw tips show at the fingers. Fantasy armor styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scalloped plates, cuff and hand covering; colour 2 on the inner gaps between plates; colour 0 on the tiny claw tips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_.differs: The female version has only tiny, barely visible claw tips, while the male version has long, prominent claws on the fingers.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Edged_01.description: A long, smooth glove covering the right hand and forearm, closed over a clenched fist with sculpted fingers. It has a plain straight-cut, slightly polygonal edge just below the elbow. Simple, sleek fit for superhero or casual looks.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Edged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; the sheet shows no other colour slots on this piece.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Flare_01.description: A long, smooth glove for the right hand that covers the fist and forearm to just below the elbow, ending in a wide, flared angular cuff. Fitted at the hand, it suggests a superhero or formal look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Flare_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 across the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Flare_02.description: A tight, smooth glove covering the right fist and forearm, ending in a flared, angled cuff that opens wider on the outer side. Plain, sleek superhero styling with no visible fasteners.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Flare_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and cuff; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Flared_01.description: A tight, long right-hand glove covering the hand and most of the forearm, with a seam down the centre and a thin band at the wrist. The top edge flares into pointed, V-shaped cuff wings with contrasting trim.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the flared cuff edge and points; colour 2 on the seam and wrist band.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Flared_01.differs: The female cuff flare is a little smaller and more open at the front, showing a narrower inner cutout.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.description: A tight, long superhero glove that runs from the fist up over the forearm to just below the elbow, with stacked banded sections, a flared angular cuff at the top and a row of small metal spikes along the outer edge.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and lower forearm; colour 1 on the knuckle cap, the middle band and the upper cuff; colour 2 on the band around the upper forearm; colour 3 on the cuff inset panel and fingertip accents.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.description: A long, tight superhero glove that runs from the fist up over the forearm to just below the elbow, with a flared cuff at the top, banded colour panels and a separate trim accent at the knuckles and fingertips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm, hand and upper forearm panel; colour 1 on the cuff, mid-forearm band and fingertips; colour 2 on the elbow-side band; colour 3 on the small cuff notch and knuckle trim.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Glove_Folded_0.description: A tight glove covering the right hand and forearm, ending in a thick, rolled-over cuff below the elbow. The fist is closed and the fit is smooth, giving a simple elegant look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Glove_Folded_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the folded cuff.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.description: A snug fingerless wrap covering the right forearm and back of the hand, with angular diagonal bands and a V-shaped panel on the front edged in contrasting trim. Leaves the fingers bare; a martial, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrap fabric; colour 2 on the edging trim and diagonal bands; colour 1 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting right-hand glove with a flared cuff reaching the forearm, topped by a thin jagged lightning-bolt fin that sweeps up the outer edge with small zigzag spikes. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and lightning fin; colour 2 on the thin edge lines along the fin.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.differs: The female bolt is a thin, narrow spike with tiny zigzag notches, while the male bolt is a larger, bolder lightning shape.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Punk_01.description: A snug fist-shaped glove with segmented knuckles and a wide, flared, faceted cuff that extends over the wrist, divided from the hand by a thin contrasting band. Superhero-punk look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove hand; colour 1 on the thin band at the wrist; colour 3 on the flared cuff; colour 2 on the thin edge line beside the band.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.description: A long, close-fitting glove covering the fist and forearm, banded in alternating panels, with a row of sharp conical spikes along the outer edge of the forearm and small spikes across the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff band, middle band and fingers; colour 0 on the palm and the lighter forearm bands; colour 3 on the spikes.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.differs: The female version has longer, more prominent spikes along the forearm edge.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Spines_01.description: A tight, smooth long glove covering the right hand and forearm up to below the elbow, with a row of long curved spines sweeping outward along the outer edge of the forearm. Superhero or punk styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Spines_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and the spines; the other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Steampunk_04.description: A long, flared gauntlet covering the forearm and fist, with a round dial on the outer side, three short cylindrical coil rods projecting outward, looping flexible pipes, hex bolts and a knuckle-plated fist. Steampunk electrical gadget styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Steampunk_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main gauntlet shell and knuckle plates; colour 0 on the looping pipes and the palm and finger section; colour 3 on the coil rods and thin line accents; colour 2 on the dial ring and rod end caps.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.description: A tight, form-fitting long glove covering the right hand and forearm, with a flared cuff below the elbow and a single bat-like membrane wing with pointed spines projecting from the outer edge of the forearm.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the wing membrane; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.description: A long, tight-fitting glove that runs from the fist to mid-forearm, with a separate contrasting cuff band at the top. It is stained and torn, with a ragged wound at the knuckles that exposes contrasting finger tips. Suits zombie or horror looks.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body; colour 1 on the cuff band; colour 3 on the blood stains and wound; colour 2 on the exposed fingertips and grime spots.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Longarmor_02.description: A right-hand armoured gauntlet covering the fist and forearm, built from stacked segmented plates with a wide contrasting cuff at the top and a side band running to a knuckle guard with small studs.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Longarmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates and hand; colour 1 on the top cuff, side band and knuckle guard; colour 3 on the knuckle studs.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A snug fingerless glove for the right hand, covering the wrist, palm and back of the hand and stopping at the knuckles so the fingers are bare. Soft cloth with a plain, martial-arts look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrist cuff and upper back of the glove; colour 0 on the palm and lower knuckle area, blending into colour 1 as a gradient.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Mechanon.description: A robotic right-hand gauntlet made of angular segmented plates wrapped around a fist, with an open strut cage at the back, a thick cuff band at the wrist and small spikes along the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knuckle and finger plates; colour 1 on the struts and inner panels; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and some back plates; colour 3 on small accents at the wrist opening and plate tips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Mechanon.differs: The female version has bulkier back plates and a more closed, tightly packed knuckle shell, while the male has larger contrasting-slot fin-like panels across the back of the hand.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.description: An alien right-hand gauntlet: a clenched two-fingered fist with small pointed claws, a wrapped band at the wrist, and a tall segmented flared cuff with fin-like ridges rising over the forearm.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the flared cuff and forearm plates; colour 3 on the wrist band; colour 0 on the fist; colour 1 on the mottled shading of the fist and the claw tips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.differs: The female version has shorter, smaller claw points on the fist, while the male fist has longer claws that curve across the fingers.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Medium_Flared_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with a short flared cuff that ends just above the wrist. Plain, simple construction suited to superhero or casual outfits.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Medium_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Minigun_01.description: A rotary minigun replacing the right hand: a cluster of long parallel barrels held by stacked ring plates, with bands around the middle and near the muzzle, and short rounded barrel tips at the far end.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Minigun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long barrels; colour 1 on the banded panels of the rings; colour 3 on the ring plates and barrel tips; colour 2 on the barrel ends.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Monster_01.description: A clenched right hand with a faceted, skin-like monstrous surface and short pointed claws on the knuckles and fingertips, plus a small claw at the thumb side. Sits on the hand only, giving a creature-like look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the skin-toned hand surface does not follow the colour scheme.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Monster_01.differs: The female claws are shorter and sit close to the fingertips, with a small claw on the thumb side and side spur, while the male version has longer claws.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_None_01.description: An effectively empty right-hand piece: only a tiny flat disc-like cuff edge appears at the wrist, with no glove, gauntlet or visible hand covering. The bare hand is left uncovered.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tiny wrist edge; no other visible features take a colour.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Paw_01.description: A tight, fur-textured animal paw glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with a short cuff at the wrist, padded pads on the palm side and sharp curved claws protruding from the fingertips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Paw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; colour 1 on the paw pads and knuckle patches; colour 2 on the cuff and fur streaks; colour 3 on the mottled fur patches.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A short fingerless cloth glove for the right hand, with a soft wrinkled wrist and palm wrap that leaves the fingers bare, topped by a wide turned-back cuff with a contrasting band and triangular notch motifs. Pirate style.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and cuff fabric; colour 2 on the cuff band and its triangular motifs.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A fitted pirate-style glove with a long flared cuff that reaches past the wrist onto the forearm, rimmed with a zigzag-edged band and marked by chevron stripes down the outer forearm.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and cuff; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the zigzag cuff band; colour 1 on the inner lining of the cuff.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Power_Gauntlet_01.description: A chunky armoured right gauntlet covering the forearm and fist, with layered angular plates, a flared open cuff, a large oval gem on the outer side, and small round studs over the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Power_Gauntlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the recessed inset channels along the forearm; colour 2 on the fingers and palm; colour 3 on the oval gem and knuckle studs.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Powersuit_01.description: A right-hand powersuit glove with a smooth, fitted fist and a separate angular flared cuff at the forearm. A plate covers the back of the knuckles, and both cuff and knuckle plate carry round inset studs.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Powersuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the forearm cuff and knuckle plate; colour 3 on the round inset studs; colour 2 on the knuckle tips.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Prisonguantlet_01.description: A bulky right-hand gauntlet with a large curved back plate, segmented ridged plates over the knuckles and forearm, a banded cuff, and a loop of heavy chain draped down the outer side on round fasteners.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Prisonguantlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the back plate and cuff band; colour 0 on the segmented ridge plates; colour 2 on the fist cap and plate bases; colour 3 on the chain.
