Female/F_Handr_Tight_Punk_01.description: A right-hand punk gauntlet: a fitted glove with a ribbed knit cuff, a wide bevelled forearm guard with a raised outer plate, and a row of short curved claw spikes over the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and guard base; colour 1 on the ribbed cuff and the knuckle band; colour 3 on the outer plate and the claw tips; colour 2 on the bevelled edging and knuckle pads.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Raptor.description: A clawed, monstrous right-hand covering shaped like a raptor's talon, with a closed fist covered in scaly plates marked with spots and sharp curved claws extending from the fingertips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Raptor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand covering and scaly plates; colour 3 on the spots along the knuckles and fingers; colour 1 on the claws.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Raptor.differs: The female claws curve downward from the fingertips, while the male claws also point outward at the wrist and back of the hand.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A snug right-hand glove reaching mid-forearm, with a tribal patterned band down the forearm and a cuff of hanging pointed tabs edged with a ruffled trim, giving a tribal, handcrafted look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 3 on the forearm pattern lines and the cuff rim; colour 1 on the hanging cuff tabs and their patterns; colour 2 on the ruffled edge at the top.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Reactor_01.description: An oversized sci-fi gauntlet-cannon for the right hand: a bulky armored housing with jagged blade-like prongs on top, small twin barrels at the side, a central glowing-style strip and curved crescent fins flaring below the fist.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor housing and fin undersides; colour 2 on the upper prongs and rear casing; colour 1 on the crescent fins and the band and clip at the wrist; colour 3 on the central strip and small indicator dots.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A right-hand cybernetic implant covering the forearm and fist with an angular armored shell. Hex-nut bolts with small gem centres and looped ribbed cables sit on the outer side and wrist flare. Sci-fi, industrial look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forearm shell and armor plates; colour 0 on the fist, knuckles and bolt housings; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 3 on the small gem centres.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A heavy cybernetic right-hand implant: a clenched mechanical fist with an angular plated forearm shell, bolted hex nuts and coiled ribbed cables wrapped around the wrist and arm. Suggests a bulky sci-fi prosthetic.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mechanical fist; colour 1 on the forearm plating; colour 2 on the coiled cables; colour 3 on small accents and indicator slits.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Robot_Claw_01.description: A robotic right-hand replacement: a boxy cuffed wrist block leads to two jointed, segmented pincer arms with rounded joints and curved claw tips, giving a mechanical grabber in place of the hand.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Robot_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist block and pincer segments; colour 1 on the wrist cuff plates and claw tip panels; colour 3 on the joint lights and studs; colour 2 on the inner joint mechanisms.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A close-fitting right hand covering in a clenched-fist pose, with a marbled, streaked surface and small jagged, crystalline ridges around the curled fingertips. It ends at the wrist and suggests an alien or elemental look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove surface; colour 1 on the streaks along the wrist and on the fingertip ridges; colour 2 in the mottled streaks.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.description: An alien organic hand-weapon: the fist is wrapped in fleshy, tentacle-like tendrils that curl over the knuckles, with a broad crescent axe blade fused beneath it that carries a single eye-like circular mark.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flesh-like tendrils and hand; colour 1 on the small inset plates and the axe blade; colour 2 on the blade edge and underside; colour 3 on the eye-like mark.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Gun_01.description: An organic, fleshy alien gun-gauntlet covering the right hand and forearm, tapering to a ragged point at the fingertips, with curling tendrils, ridges and folds across its surface. Looks grown rather than built.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Gun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 3 appear blended across the fleshy body; colour 1 on the veined streaks and ridges. The default skin-like material largely mutes the scheme.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Sword_01.description: A long, narrow, pointed blade held point-down in the right hand, with a fleshy tentacle-like grip that wraps the hand and fingers in curling tendrils. Notched edges and small round holes run along the blade; alien, organic styling.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the round hole details and blade edges; the tentacle grip keeps its own fleshy tone and does not take a colour slot.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A sci-fi armoured glove and forearm guard: a chunky segmented vambrace with a notched rim and a flared cuff ring, a contrasting back-of-hand plate, and a padded fist with plated knuckles. Suits soldier or tactical looks.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vambrace shell, cuff ring and knuckle plates; colour 1 on the top rim, lower forearm and finger base; colour 2 on the back-of-hand plate and side panel; colour 3 on the small wrist insert.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Shortfolded_01.description: A snug, plain glove covering the right hand in a closed fist, with sculpted individual fingers and a thick folded-over cuff band at the wrist. Casual, everyday look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Shortfolded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the folded cuff.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_01.description: A skeletal right hand: a smooth covered palm and back of hand with a flared cuff at the wrist, and exposed finger and thumb bones curling inward into a loose claw-like grip.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm and finger bones; colour 3 and colour 1 on the wrist cuff edge and its inner shading.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_01.differs: The female hand is posed with curled, clawed fingers, while the male version has long straight, splayed finger bones.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.description: A skeletal right hand with a bony wrist cuff, knuckle plates, long segmented finger bones and jagged clawed spikes along the fingers. It is curled into a loose grip, giving a monstrous, undead look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and knuckle bones; colour 1 on the long finger bones; colour 2 on the finger joints and tips; colour 3 on the jagged claw spikes.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.differs: The claw spikes on the female hand are larger and more tangled, sitting in a tighter curl over the fingers.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Sleeve_01.description: A loose cloth sleeve covering the right hand and wrist, with a contrasting band at the wrist end and a wide flared, open cuff hanging past the hand. Soft creases give a relaxed, casual superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Sleeve_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sleeve; colour 1 on the band at the wrist end; colour 2 on the trim around the flared cuff edge.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Sleeve_01.differs: The female sleeve flares into a wide, open bell-shaped cuff with a clean contrasting edge, while the male sleeve is more closed and crumpled.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A right-hand covering of thin, twig-like fingers that curl into long pointed claw tips around a gnarled palm, with a short cuff at the wrist. Reads as a frosty, skeletal, monstrous hand.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand and fingers; colour 1 on streaky patches over the knuckles, cuff and finger sides.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The female fingers curl together into a tight, spiralling fist of claws, with no single long hooked finger.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Space_01.description: A fingerless fist-style glove with a padded cuff, angular segmented knuckle guard and trim edging, and exposed fingertips. Sits on the right hand and wrist, giving a sleek sci-fi combat look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and finger bases; colour 1 on the cuff and wrist panel; colour 2 on the trim, knuckle guard and edging; colour 3 on the fingertips.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A right-hand armoured gauntlet with segmented, overlapping plates running up the forearm, cut-out gaps showing the arm, and a fist guard with small round vent holes over the knuckles. A sci-fi take on ancient pharaonic armour.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forearm plates and knuckle guard; colour 2 on the wrist and palm sections; colour 0 on the inner edge highlights; colour 3 on small accent markings.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A sleek armoured gauntlet for the right hand: a tapered forearm guard of layered plates with a glossy back panel, a ribbed contrasting band near the elbow end, and a fitted fist with segmented knuckle caps.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates of the forearm and hand; colour 1 on the ribbed band and the fingertip studs; colour 2 on the glossy back panel and inset slots; colour 3 on the knuckle and finger caps.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Superlong_01.description: A tight, smooth extra-long glove covering the right hand and whole forearm, reaching up over the upper arm just below the shoulder. It has a thin contrasting band at the top edge and a glossy finish, suggesting a superhero or sleek formal look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Superlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and lower forearm; colour 2 on the upper forearm and upper arm; colour 1 on the top cuff band.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A close-fitting symbiote-style glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with a smooth panelled shell and a contrasting back panel; short curved claw-like tips extend from the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove shell and finger casings; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and the palm opening inside; colour 2 on the claw tips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_01.differs: The female claws are shorter and stubbier, and sit tighter against the knuckles.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A close-fitting symbiote-style right glove covering the fist, with a contrasting cuff and back-of-hand panel sweeping to a point, and short contrasting claws jutting from the knuckles. Creepy, monstrous look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm and fingers; colour 1 on the cuff and back-of-hand panel; colour 2 on the claw tips.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_02.differs: The female version has short, small claws at the knuckles, while the male has long claws sweeping along the back of the fingers.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A bulky angular armored gauntlet with layered plates over the back of the hand, a handle-like frame on top, cylindrical canisters with ribbed caps at the sides, and long curved translucent claws extending past the fingers.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and frame; colour 1 on the inner panels and claw tips; colour 3 on the canisters and their caps; colour 2 on the recesses and canister bases.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Talon_01.description: A fitted right-hand covering of scaly, segmented plating across the back of the hand and wrist, with banded finger segments ending in long curved contrasting claws. Its monstrous, reptilian look leaves the palm bare.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Talon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scaled plates over the back of the hand and wrist; colour 0 on the finger bands and knuckle segments; colour 2 on the claws; the palm and skin show the mannequin's own skin.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Talon_01.differs: The female claws are fewer and shorter, curling in toward the palm, while the male has a longer set that fans out from the fingers.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Teddy_01.description: A bulky, shaggy fur-like mitt that swallows the right fist, with a rough, rumpled surface and an open cuff at the wrist; jagged crystal-like shards poke out around the knuckle end.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy mitt body; colour 1 on the jagged shards and the lower shading of the mitt.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Teddy_01.differs: The female version has a smaller mitt with the shards mostly tucked inside the fist opening, rather than showing outward.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Terror_01.description: A clenched right hand covering with a skin-like fleshy surface crossed by contrasting jagged vein-like markings, and long curved metallic claws extending from the knuckles. It suggests a monstrous, predatory gauntlet.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Terror_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fleshy hand surface (it reads as a skin tone on this sheet); colour 2 on the jagged vein-like markings; colour 0 on the claws and knuckle plates.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Terror_01.differs: The female version shows the fleshy surface in a skin-like tone rather than a bright colour pattern, and its claws curve down and forward from the knuckles.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Thick_01.description: A thick, smooth long glove for the right hand, covering the fist and forearm up to just below the elbow, with a slightly flared open cuff and softly molded fingers; a plain, casual superhero look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Trey_King_01.description: A right-hand saw blade replacing the hand: a wrapped, banded cuff at the wrist leads into a long, curved, thin blade with jagged, spiky teeth along the rear edge, hanging down along the leg.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Trey_King_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff wraps and the blade's base guard; colour 1 on the blade body and teeth.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Urban_Rings_01.description: A set of chunky metal band rings worn on the fingers of the right fist, with a thick ring on the first finger and smaller bands on the neighbouring fingers. Urban, street-style hand jewellery.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Urban_Rings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring bands; the glossy metal largely ignores the rest of the scheme.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A right forearm gauntlet with a pointed, angular armored cuff that sweeps up past the elbow, a stack of loose spaced rings around the wrist, and a sleek hand cover with small claw-like tips at the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm plate and hand cover; colour 1 on the upper cuff shell, the rings and the hand trim; colour 2 on the small vent slits and edge notches.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Vikorin_01.differs: The female version has small claw-like spikes at the knuckles and slightly looser wrist rings.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Viperia_01.description: A form-fitting superhero sleeve-and-glove for the right arm, covering the forearm and hand as a fist. It has a contrasting upper cuff, a contrasting band near the wrist and thin trim lines between the panels.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Viperia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm sleeve; colour 1 on the glove and the wrist band; colour 2 on the upper cuff and trim edges.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Webbed_01.description: A bare, clenched right hand rendered in skin, with thin webbing between the fingers and a few small thorn-like spikes jutting from the outer edge of the fist and the heel of the palm.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Webbed_01.colourAreas: Colour slots do not visibly affect this piece; the whole hand keeps its skin tone, including the small spikes.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Webbed_01.differs: The female hand has thin spikes sticking out from the outer edge and knuckle side, and no separate nails.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.description: A tiny ring with a small pointed stone, worn on a finger of the closed right fist. The stone hangs down below the knuckles, and the thin band is mostly hidden by the curled fingers.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pointed stone; colour 1 on the thin band.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.differs: The female version shows a visible pointed stone on the ring below the fist, while the male version shows no clearly visible ring.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Ring_Superl.description: A tight, opera-length glove covering the right hand and the whole arm up to the upper arm, with a rolled cuff at the top, thin chevron-shaped trim lines at the forearm and wrist, and a small ring dangling at the knuckles.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Ring_Superl.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main glove; colour 0 on the top cuff and thin chevron trim lines; colour 1 on the small ring charm at the fist.

Female/F_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Superlong_0.description: A single extra-long glove reaching up to the upper arm, smooth and close-fitting with a fist-shaped hand, a flat rolled cuff at the top, and thin chevron-shaped trim lines near the elbow and wrist. Formal, elegant look.
Female/F_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Superlong_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main glove; colour 0 on the top cuff and the thin chevron trim lines.

Female/F_Handr_Toy_01.description: A right-arm sleeve covering the forearm and part of the upper arm, in textured worn fabric. A thick chunky cuff with a small round jewel sits at the top, and two stacked bands circle the wrist above a bare fist.
Female/F_Handr_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured sleeve; colour 2 on the top cuff and wrist bands; colour 3 on the small round jewel; colour 1 on the ring around the jewel.

Female/F_Handr_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A fingerless fist glove covering the back of the hand and wrist, with a contrasting cuff band and segmented finger rings with small ornamental spikes at the knuckles. Suggests a festive winter street style.
Female/F_Handr_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main glove body; colour 1 on the cuff edge and lower finger sections; colour 0 on the finger rings and panel highlights.
Female/F_Handr_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The female version includes a full fingerless glove covering the back of the hand, while the male version is only a set of rings on the fingers.

Female/F_Handr_Wrapped_Hook_002.description: A bare angular metal hook that replaces the right hand: a thick faceted J-shaped curve with a pointed tip, hanging below the fist. No wrapping or cuff is present on this version.
Female/F_Handr_Wrapped_Hook_002.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hook; the metal finish shows no other slots.
Female/F_Handr_Wrapped_Hook_002.differs: The female version is only the bare metal hook, without the wrapped bindings and armoured cuff of the male version.

Female/F_Handr_Wrapped_Hook_01.description: A pirate-style hook prosthetic for the right hand: a forearm bundle of ragged wrapped cloth bound with several coils of cord and a curved plate along one side, ending in a sharp angular metal hook.
Female/F_Handr_Wrapped_Hook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved plate and the hook; colour 2 on the ragged wrapped cloth; colour 3 and colour 1 on the alternating cord bindings.

Female/F_Head_Anniversary_Defender_01.description: A full-coverage retro superhero helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a raised rim framing two large side panels, a broad angular visor plate over the face, and a pointed collar piece resting on the shoulders.
Female/F_Head_Anniversary_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and the pointed collar; colour 2 on the visor plate, the back shell and the central crest strip; colour 3 on the two large side panels of the crown.

Female/F_Head_Anubis_01.description: A full jackal head covering the whole head, with a long tapered snout, closed sleepy eyes, tall upright pointed ears and a smooth neck-hugging base. Egyptian-style animal-headed look, with a diamond mark on the brow.
Female/F_Head_Anubis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the head, neck and inner ears; colour 1 on the outer ear tips, the sides of the head and the brow diamond; colour 2 on the snout and face; colour 3 on the throat patch under the jaw.
Female/F_Head_Anubis_01.differs: The female version has a contrasting face and snout with a diamond mark on the brow and multi-coloured panels, and its eyes are closed.

Female/F_Head_Anubis_02.description: A full jackal-headed mask in the Anubis style: a long tapering snout, two tall pointed upright ears, sculpted brow ridges and narrow glowing eyes, with a smooth rounded skull cap and a thin band at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Anubis_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, snout and ears; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the thin neck band.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Bat_01.description: A furry animal head with a tapered muzzle, small contrasting nose and tall pointed ears with lined inner surfaces. A ragged ruff of fur tufts hangs around the neck and jaw. Beastly and cute in style.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head fur and outer ears; colour 0 on the muzzle and inner ear lining; colour 1 on the neck fur tufts and the inner ear base; colour 2 on the nose and eyes.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Bat_01.differs: The female ears have a fleshy tone on their outer backs, while the male ears use the main head colour throughout.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Bear_02.description: A full bear head with a short blunt muzzle, a contrasting nose, small rounded ears and a swept mane of spiky fur that covers the crown, sides and back of the head. Suits a beast or animal-themed hero.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Bear_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiky fur mane and ear rims; colour 3 on the fur around the eyes and cheeks; colour 1 on the muzzle and chin; colour 2 on the nose and eyes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Bull_01.description: A full bull head replacing the human head: elongated snout with a large nose ring, small side ears with studs, a shaggy mop of hair over the brow and crown, and two long upswept curved horns.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy hair and the nose ring; colour 1 on the horns; colour 3 on the face, ears and neck band; colour 2 on the muzzle tip.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Cat_01.description: A full anthropomorphic cat head with large pointed ears, a furry face with a contrasting muzzle and expressive eyes, and a shaggy ruff of spiky fur that hangs long down the neck and back of the head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head, ears and neck ruff; colour 2 on the muzzle and face mask; colour 3 on the nose; colour 1 on the eyes.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Cat_01.differs: The female version has a longer, flowing fur mane that hangs down the back of the neck, and the ruff is smoother.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.description: A full dragon head replacing the wearer's own: scaled snout with open toothed jaws and a long tongue, branching antler-like horns, a fan of feathery frills around the head, whisker-like tendrils, and a scaled back panel over the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled head, frills and jaw; colour 1 on the horns, tongue, inner mouth and frill tips; colour 3 on the whisker tendrils and the scale outlines at the back.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bat_Mouth_01.description: Two small clusters of sharp, pointed fang-like spikes that sit at either side of the jaw and lower cheeks, angled downward. Suggests bat-like monstrous tusks or teeth as an add-on to the head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bat_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fang spikes; the shading varies across the facets but no other colour slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bat_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed bat-like ears rising from the top of the head and flaring outward. Each has a smooth outer shell and a hollow inner cup with a gradient shading, giving a creature or beast look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bat_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and rim of the ears; colour 0 fading into colour 1 on the inner ear cups.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bat_Top_01.differs: The outer shell of the female ears shows a skin-like tone in the default scheme rather than a strong contrasting finish, and the ears are slightly smaller.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Mouth_03.description: A beast-mouth head piece: a chunky, angular U-shaped muzzle that wraps around the lips and chin, with thick upper and lower lip rims and a row of small teeth showing inside. Suggests a bear or monster face.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Mouth_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main lip and chin surfaces; colour 0 on the upper rim edges and teeth.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Mouth_03.differs: The female mouth has smaller, less prominent teeth and no visible fangs, and the lower lip sits more tightly against the chin.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Top_03.description: A pair of small rounded bear ears with textured, furry surfaces, perched on the upper sides of the head. Each ear has a hollow inner cup, giving a cute animal look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Top_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear cups.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Ear_01.description: A pair of large pointed cat ears set high on the sides of the head, with smooth outer backs and spiky tufted fur lining the hollow inner faces; a playful animal look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces and the inner fur tufts; colour 2 in the shadowed inner hollows.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Mouth_01.description: A pair of small pointed fangs that jut upward from the lower lip on either side of centre, giving a feline or beastly mouth. The tiny cones sit at the front of the mouth and nothing else changes on the face.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both fangs; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Mouth_01.differs: The fangs sit on the lower lip inside the mouth, whereas the male fangs sit lower on the chin below the lip.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Chimera_01.description: A tall, swept-back mohawk of long layered strands rising in a crest from forehead to nape, with spiky pointed tips along the ridge and a bare shaved scalp at the sides. It trails down the back of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 on the spiked tips along the crest; colour 2 on the shaded underside near the front edge.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Cobra_Mouth_01.description: A pair of curved cobra fangs at the mouth: two long, flat curved tusk-like blades hang down past the lips on either side, each with a small sharp tooth beside it. A monstrous snake-like look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Cobra_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fangs and small teeth; colour 1 shows as a slight tint on the inner faces of the large fangs.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Cobra_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, swept-up spiky horn-like fins rising from each side of the head, with smaller secondary spikes beside them and curved clawlike blades hooking down over the brow and temples. Monstrous cobra-inspired look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Cobra_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tips of the tall spikes and on the curved brow blades; the lower spike bodies show the skin tone rather than a scheme colour.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Corgi_Ear_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears sitting on top of the head, each with a hollow inner face and tufts of spiky fur fanning out at the base. Cute, beast-like headpiece with a furry look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Corgi_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces and fur tufts; colour 1 on the inner ear faces.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Corgi_Mouth_01.description: A set of small pointed animal teeth arranged in a U around the mouth and chin, with a row of tiny lower teeth and two larger tusk-like fangs jutting down at the sides of the jaw.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Corgi_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small teeth; colour 1 on the two large tusk fangs.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Ear_01.description: A pair of pointed, coyote-style animal ears that sit high on the sides of the head. Each has a smooth outer shell, a tufted inner lining and a swept-back tip, giving a feral or cute beast look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and the fur tufts around the rim; colour 1 on the inner ear lining.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Mouth_0.description: A U-shaped row of small pointed conical teeth that wraps around the mouth and lower jaw, with longer fangs curving up at the corners. It gives a feral, predatory beast look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Mouth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the shaded undersides pick up a hint of colour 1 in places.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Ear_0.description: A pair of fin-like ear frills sweeping out and back from the sides of the head, each a webbed membrane with cut-out slots and a rim of clawlike pointed spines along the lower edge. Suggests a dinosaur or beast head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Ear_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and spines; colour 1 on the membrane; colour 2 on the slot cut-outs and inner shading; colour 3 on small speckles in the membrane.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Mouth.description: A set of two curved rows of conical teeth on square bases, forming an upper and lower jaw that sweeps out from the mouth and around the chin. Suggests a monstrous dinosaur or beast maw.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Mouth.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth; the square bases show a light metallic finish that appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Side_.description: A pair of side-of-head cheek frills: clusters of pointed, fin-like spikes fanning backward from each side of the jaw and cheek, like a dinosaur's head crests. Faceted and angular, they leave the face and skull otherwise bare.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Side_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the spikes and frills; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Top_0.description: A narrow fin-like crest running front to back along the centre of the head, like a mohawk. It has swept-back jagged spikes, a raised rim and cut-out teardrop openings over an inset panel. Suits a beast or dinosaur look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Top_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and spikes; colour 1 on the inset panel between the openings; colour 3 on small flecks within the panel.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Ear_Bull_01.description: A set of small metal hoop rings floating beside the head at ear level: a pair of thin bands clustered on one side and a single ring on the other. They read as bull-style ear piercings.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Ear_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring bands; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Fennec_Mouth_0.description: A curved row of sharp conical fang-like teeth arranged in an arc along the jaw and chin, with larger fangs at the corners. It gives a beastly, monstrous grin to the lower face.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Fennec_Mouth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Fishmonster_Mo.description: A ring of sharp triangular fangs that wraps across the mouth and cheeks, with upper and lower rows of pointed teeth in a monstrous fish-like grin. Sits over the lips and reads as a beastly face piece.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Fishmonster_Mo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Hair_Bull_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of tousled, sculpted locks swept across the forehead to one side, with pointed tips flicking out near the cheeks and a rounded, full crown that covers the back of the head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Hair_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head of hair; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Hair_Hyena_01.description: A wild, spiky hair piece with a swept-back mohawk-like ridge, long jagged strands splaying over the crown and forehead, and a tapering ponytail-like mane down the back of the neck. Suggests a feral hyena look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Hair_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spiky crown strands; colour 2 on the roots and shading at the crown; colour 0 on the upper mane and side hair; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the back mane.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Headwear_Celes.description: A pair of long, thin dragon-style whiskers that sprout from beside the cheeks and curve outward and back in wavy, tapering tendrils with a banded, segmented pattern. They are fantasy face and head accents.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Headwear_Celes.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light bands along the whiskers; colour 1 on the mid bands; colour 3 on the accent bands; colour 2 on the bands and root ends.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Horns_Bull_01.description: A pair of large curved bull horns that sweep outward from the temples and turn upward to sharp tips, with ridged bands along the base. They float on the sides of the head like a headband-free horn set.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Horns_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged base and lower horn surfaces; colour 1 on the upper horn tips as a gradient.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Horse_01.description: A wild, spiky mane-style hairpiece: long pointed locks sweep outward from the crown and one side, while a narrow tapering ponytail hangs down the back of the neck. The sides of the head stay bare.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer spiky locks on top and one side; colour 2 on the darkened roots at the crown; colour 0 on the swept side locks and upper ponytail; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the ponytail and side locks.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Horse_02.description: A neck-length, mane-like hair piece: a strip of coarse layered locks runs from the forehead over the crown and down the back of the head, with ragged tapered tips and a few strands falling at the front.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Horse_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the central strip along the crown and back; colour 2 on the tips of the strands.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Hyena_01.description: A tiny set of thin, wispy whiskers fanning out in two clusters from either side of the muzzle area near the mouth and cheeks, giving a subtle animal, hyena-like touch without covering the face.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whiskers; the finest strands catch light and show slightly darker tips, but no other slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Kaiju_Mouth_01.description: A pair of long curved tusks that sweep down from either side of the mouth past the chin, plus a few small fang-like teeth around the lips. A partial monstrous face accessory in a beast style.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Kaiju_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tusks and small fangs; the pieces show no other visible colour slots.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Kaiju_Top_01.description: A set of small pointed, faceted nodules or scale-like studs scattered across the head: two on the crown, pairs at the temples and brow, and pairs on the cheeks and back of the skull. Suggests a monstrous kaiju look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Kaiju_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the nodules; the rest of the piece shows no other colour slots.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Kaiju_Top_02.description: A pair of small, chunky faceted horn nubs set symmetrically on the upper forehead, each a blunt angular wedge tilting outward. Suggests a young monster or kaiju head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Kaiju_Top_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both horn nubs; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Kitty_01.description: A short, swept hairstyle of layered, pointed locks that sit on top of the head and sweep across the forehead to one side, with small cat-ear-like tufts at the crown and spiky tips at the back.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair mass; colour 1 in the shaded underside and tips.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Ear_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears rising upright from the top of the head, with a textured fur-like outer surface, a raised rim and a smooth hollow inner face. Cute, playful beast style.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur and rim of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear hollows.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Hair_01.description: A short, choppy spiky hair piece of layered jagged locks with a fringe over the forehead and tapered pointed tips around the ears and nape; a few tufts stick up on top. Beast-child styling.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top layer of tufts and fringe; colour 2 on the middle layer at the sides and back; colour 0 on the lower tips and fringe ends.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Mouth_01.description: A small curved lower-jaw piece with a row of rounded, scalloped teeth-like bumps and pointed tips at each end, sitting under the lips along the chin as part of an animal mouth.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gum band and tooth edges; colour 1 on the rounded tooth shapes and end tips; colour 2 in the shadowed hollows between teeth.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Side_01.description: A single curved, tapering tongue-like protrusion hanging from the mouth down over the chin and throat, with a rounded tip and smooth low-poly surface; a playful llama-style beast feature.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and front surface of the tongue; colour 1 on the lower tip and underside; colour 2 on the inner edge seen from the side.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_01.description: A pair of long, slender moth-like antennae rising from the top of the head, curving outward and upward in a sweeping horn shape with a feathery, striated texture and a contrasting edge line.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper lengths of the antennae; colour 1 on the base and lower gradient of each antenna; colour 2 on the thin edge outline.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_02.description: A pair of smooth, faceted oval shells fixed over the brow and upper eye area, tilted outward like moth-like compound eyes or eye-masks. They sit on the face and leave the rest of the head bare.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye shells, fading toward colour 0 along their inner edges.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_03.description: A moth-like fluffy mane of layered, feathery tufts that frames the face and drapes over the head, neck and shoulders, ending in a jagged point at the upper back. Suggests a monstrous, insect-like creature.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and top tufts, fading into colour 1 on the lower tufts around the neck and shoulders.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_01.description: A pair of long, slender moth-like antennae sweeping up and outward in a V from the brow, tapering to fine points with feathery vanes and a contrasting central spine; they rise well above the head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathery outer vanes; colour 1 on the inner vane edges; colour 2 on the central spine; colour 3 on the small tips at the base.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_01.differs: The female antennae curve less and stand more upright and forward from the brow when seen from the side.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_02.description: A pair of smooth, angular faceted plates set on either side of the face beside the eyes and cheeks, like moth-like wing or ear panels. They stand slightly off the head and leave the face uncovered.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on both side plates; the plates shade darker toward their lower edges.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_03.description: Swept-back, feathery moth-like hair with a smooth crest over the scalp and a contrasting plate at the forehead. Long layered feathery tufts fall past the shoulders to upper-back length, ending in jagged points, with small claw-like tips at the sides.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, forehead plate and small side tips; colour 1 on the lower feathery tufts, blending in from the top; colour 2 on the shaded underside layers at the shoulders.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Mouth_01.description: A pair of large rodent-like buck teeth: two flat, tapered, chisel-shaped incisors side by side, hanging at the chin below the mouth. Suggests a cartoonish mouse or beast character head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tooth faces; colour 1 on the shaded outer edges and backs of the teeth.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Side_01.description: A set of thin, straight mouse whiskers that fan out sideways from either side of the upper lip, three or four strands per side, angled slightly downward. A small animal-face accessory that leaves the head bare.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the whisker strands; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, upright rounded-oval mouse ears rising from the top sides of the head, with smooth outer shells and deeply cupped inner faces edged by a thin rim.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shells and rims; colour 1 fading to colour 0 on the inner cup of each ear.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Top_01.differs: The female ears have an outer shell and rim in a skin-like tone rather than the male's solid glossy contrasting-slot finish.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Mouth_Celestia.description: A monstrous mouth attachment: a long tapering tongue that curls out and down past the chin, framed by two rows of thin, jagged fang-like teeth around the lips. Sits over the mouth and jaw as a partial face piece.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Mouth_Celestia.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the tongue; colour 1 on the tongue tip and lower length; colour 2 on the teeth.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Pitbull_Side_0.description: A lolling beast tongue: a broad, flat, tapered tongue that juts out from the mouth and curls down past the chin toward the chest, with a rounded tip and subtle surface creases. Suits a monstrous dog-like head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Pitbull_Side_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base of the tongue; colour 1 toward the tip and lower end; colour 2 on the shaded underside edge.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Plantmonster_M.description: A ring of sharp conical teeth wrapping around the head: an upper row of downward-pointing fangs across the brow and a lower row of upward-pointing teeth across the jaw, forming a monstrous open maw around the face.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Plantmonster_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth; the teeth show no other colour slots on this sheet.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Reptillian_Mou.description: Two small clusters of curved tusk-like fangs jutting upward from either side of the lower lip and chin, each with a tall pointed tusk beside a shorter blunt tooth. Monstrous reptilian mouth accessory.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Reptillian_Mou.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tusks and teeth; the default material appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Ring_Bull_01.description: A thick open metal hoop, like a bull nose ring, hanging in front of the face and resting near the throat, with a gap at the top and a faceted, slightly chunky band.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Mou.description: A wide, exaggerated row of small pyramid-shaped teeth that curves in a U-shape around the mouth and jaw and sweeps back along the cheeks toward the ears, giving a monstrous, salamander-like grin.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Mou.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Sid.description: A pair of swept-back head fins or frills, one on each side of the head above the ears. Each is a cluster of long, thin, curved spines that taper to points, giving a beastly, salamander-like look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Sid.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spines, with the tips fading toward colour 0.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Top.description: A pair of feathery, fin-like antennae that sweep up and outward from the top of the head, each with a ridged, layered vane, a bordering edge and a small lower flap. Suggests a sea creature or monstrous look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Top.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged feather vanes; colour 3 on the outer edge ribs; colour 1 on the small lower flaps.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Helme.description: A narrow crest of jagged spikes running front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk, with tall spikes at the crown and smaller ones trailing down the nape. The rest of the head stays bare.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Helme.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the spikes and the ridge; colour 1 on the spike tips as a gradient.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Side_.description: A pair of fin-like side-head ornaments: each is a fan of layered, pointed, leaf-shaped fronds that sweep outward from the temple above the ears, suggesting seahorse or aquatic frills.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Side_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some fronds in each fan; colour 1 on other fronds; colour 2 on the darker fronds.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Top_0.description: A pair of leaf-like feathered fronds that rise from two points on top of the head and fan outward in a V. Each has slender branching blades with spotted markings, giving a fantasy sea-creature look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Top_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frond blades; colour 2 on the spots; colour 1 on the base stems where the fronds meet the head; colour 3 on a small accent near each base.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned.description: A wide, grinning row of thin, sharp fang-like teeth that curves around the mouth and stretches back along the cheeks toward the ears, like an oversized monstrous maw drawn over the lower face.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned.description: A set of three curved, tapering horn spikes in graduated sizes that jut downward from the lower lip and chin on each side, like small tusks or fangs. Suggests a serpent-like beast or monster face.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn spikes, with slight shading towards the tips; no other slots are visible.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned.differs: The female version has two small spikes set slightly further from the large one and the large central spike is shorter and wider.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned.description: A set of small curved horn spikes on the head: two short pairs angled back above the temples and one single horn at the nose bridge. Bare skin shows between them, so this is a minimal monstrous accent.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns, with a lighter tip; the other slots are not visible.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned.differs: The female horns have pale, light-coloured tips, and the nose horn is shorter and sits lower on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Mouth_01.description: A set of pointed monster teeth forming a U-shaped row of small pyramid fangs that wraps around the mouth and jawline, like an open toothy maw. Reads as a monstrous or beastly face piece.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the teeth; colour 1 on the shaded faces of some teeth.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Top_01.description: A pair of long, tapering monster horns rising from the top of the head and sweeping backward in a smooth curve, with hollow, lightly ribbed undersides and blunt cut bases sitting on the crown.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer surfaces of both horns; colour 0 on the hollow inner undersides; colour 1 on a small strip along the inner edge.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Top_01.differs: The female horns are a little slimmer and stand more upright at the front, with sharper tips.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Shisa_Mouth_01.description: Two pairs of small fang-like tusks flanking the mouth: a broad tapered tusk on each side of the lower lip, each with a smaller pointed cone tooth beside it. Suggests a beastly, guardian-lion look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Shisa_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the large tusks; colour 0 on the small cone teeth.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Shisa_Mouth_01.differs: The female tusks are near contrasting by default, whereas the male tusks take the mid contrasting colour.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Side_Celestial.description: Pairs of swept-back fin-like fronds fanning out from each side of the head: an upper cluster above the temple and a lower cluster along the cheek and jaw. The bald crown is left bare. Fantasy dragon look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Side_Celestial.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer tips and upper edges of the fins; colour 1 on the inner bases and lower gradients of the fins.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Snake_Hair_01.description: A short mohawk split into two parallel ridges of sharp, jagged spikes running front to back along the crown, sweeping backward, with the sides of the head left bare. Beastly, punk-like styling.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Snake_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front spikes; colour 0 on the spike roots at the hairline; colour 2 on the middle of the ridges; colour 3 on the rear spikes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Hair_01.description: A short, sleek mohawk-style crest of hair running front to back along the top of the head, swept into tall pointed tufts that rise at the front and crown, with a smaller spike on one side; the sides of the head stay bare.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the crest; colour 1 on the tall front tuft tips; colour 2 on the tips of the smaller rear tufts; colour 3 on the small side spike.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Mouth_01.description: A set of small sharp conical fangs arranged in two curved rows that run from the mouth corners back along the jaw line, giving a beastly, predatory wolf-like grin. Sits on the lower face only.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Wolf_Top.description: A pair of upright, pointed wolf ears set high on the top of the head, each a smooth tapered cone with a hollow inner cup and a slim rim. Suggests a sleek animal or beastly look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Wolf_Top.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner hollow of each ear.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Top_Celestial_.description: A pair of slender, branching antler-like horns rising from the top of the forehead, each forking into several pointed tines that sweep upward and slightly back, with a smooth tapering gradient along their length.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Child_Top_Celestial_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of each horn, blending into colour 1 toward the tips; the darkest tine ends take colour 2.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Cobra_01.description: A full cobra head replacing the wearer's own: a scaled snake face with brow ridges and small fangs, framed by a huge flared hood that sweeps up and out to either side, with spines at the top corners.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Cobra_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scaled face, crown and spines; colour 3 on the hood rim and outer edges; colour 0 on the smooth inner hood panel with faint line details.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Cobra_01.differs: The female hood is taller and narrower, rising to sharper pointed tips, and the spines are shorter and more swept back.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Corgi_01.description: A full anthropomorphic corgi-like animal head with a glossy snout, open toothy mouth, upright pointed ears and shaggy fur tufts around the cheeks, neck and back, covering the whole head and upper neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Corgi_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ears, the fur at the back of the head and the cheek tufts; colour 1 on the shaggy fur along the sides and neck; colour 2 on the glossy face and snout; colour 3 on the tongue and inner mouth patch.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Coyote_01.description: A full coyote head with a long muzzle, large pointed ears and a swept-back mane of layered fur locks, plus a ragged spiky ruff of fur around the jaw and neck. Covers the whole head in an animal-beast style.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Coyote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mane locks and ear outsides; colour 1 on the inner ears, ruff tips and mane ends; colour 2 on the muzzle, nose and face fur; the rear head fur is split between colour 0 and colour 2.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Coyote_01.differs: The female head has a contrasting face and muzzle and a back of the head split into light and contrasting halves, where the male version is mostly light-coloured all over.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Croc_01.description: A full crocodile head replacing the human head: a long tapering snout with an open, toothy jaw, a contrasting mouth interior, small side-set eyes and a plated, scaly skull and neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Croc_01.colourAreas: The skin-toned scaly hide does not appear to follow the colour scheme; the mouth interior and teeth keep their own tones. No clear slot assignments are visible.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Crow_01.description: A full crow-head replacement with a long pointed beak, shaggy feathered ruff around the face and neck, several small eyes along the beak, and two tall ridged curved horns sweeping up from the brow.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Crow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathered head and beak; colour 3 on the horns, fading toward colour 0 at their bases; colour 2 on the small eyes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Dinosaur_01.description: A full reptilian dinosaur head with a long toothy snout, scaly skin and a tall central crest. Frilled, feather-like fins sweep out from each side and back of the skull, giving a monstrous, raptor-like look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Dinosaur_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly head and snout; colour 0 on the crest spine and fin edges and tips; colour 1 on the inner fin panels; colour 2 on the fin markings.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Doberman_01.description: A full-head doberman mask with a long tapered muzzle, a rounded nose, sculpted eyes and tall pointed upright ears. It covers the whole head and continues down over the neck, giving a sleek, animal look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Doberman_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head and neck skin; colour 1 on the inner ears and the underside of the muzzle and jaw; colour 2 on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Dog_01.description: A full husky-style dog head covering the whole head, with tall pointed ears, a tapered muzzle with a glossy nose, and shaggy layered fur that falls in tufts over the neck and nape.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner ears; colour 3 on the fur of the head, ears and neck ruff; colour 1 on the muzzle and around the eyes; colour 2 on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Dragon_01.description: A full dragon head replacing the wearer's own: a long toothy snout, swept-back brow plates over the eyes, a smooth domed skull with a tall central horn and small side spikes, and a finned crest trailing down the back of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout and jaw; colour 3 on the skull, horn and spikes; colour 2 on the brow plates; colour 1 on the crest fin and the neck patch.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Fennec_01.description: A full fennec fox head covering with a short muzzle, large upright pointed ears with inner fluffy fur, tufted cheek fur and a swept crest of spiky fur along the top; fully replaces the head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer fur, ear rims and back of the head; colour 0 on the face, inner ear fur and crest; colour 1 on the muzzle tip, inner ear shading and crest tips; colour 2 on the nose and eyes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Feral_01.description: A full replacement head shaped like a feral wolf or fox: long tapering snout, tall pointed ears, an open toothy mouth with fangs, and a shaggy mane of jagged fur tufts flowing down the back of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Feral_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout top, ears and fur mane; colour 1 on the face sides, cheeks and lower jaw; colour 3 on the mouth interior and gums.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Ferret_01.description: A full ferret head replacing the human head: a tapered snout with a rounded nose, fine whiskers, small round ears, and shaggy layered fur tufts over the skull and neck, ending in a ruffled ruff at the throat.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Ferret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur and head; colour 1 on the inner ears and the ruffled neck fringe; colour 3 on the nose; colour 2 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Fishmonster_01.description: A full monster head with scaly, textured skin, heavy angled brows, wide-set eyes, a broad toothy grin and a jutting lower jaw. It covers the whole head down to the neck, with a fish-like, reptilian look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Fishmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly head and neck skin; colour 1 on the lower jaw, chin and the patches around the eyes; colour 2 on the brow ridges; colour 0 on the teeth and eyes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Fox_02.description: A full fox head replacing the wearer's own: a long tapering muzzle with a rounded nose, thin whiskers, upright pointed ears, and short furry texture that continues down the back of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Fox_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head, ears and neck; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 3 on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Gator_01.description: A full alligator head replacing the wearer's own: a long toothy snout with an open jaw, ridged scaly skin across the skull, small side-set eyes and a slender neck. Monstrous, reptilian look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Gator_01.colourAreas: The default skin-like material largely ignores the colour scheme; the scaly skin, teeth and mouth interior keep their own fixed shading, so no clear colour slot is visible.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Gator_01.differs: The female head has a slimmer neck and a slightly narrower, smoother skull, with the jaw opened a bit wider.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Goat_01.description: A full animal head covering with a long tapered muzzle, wide-set eyes and broad ears that sweep out sideways and taper to points. It covers the whole head and neck, with a smooth, skin-like finish and a beastly look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head, ears and neck; colour 1 on the patches around the eyes; colour 0 on the muzzle and inner ear edges; colour 2 on the nose.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Goat_01.differs: The female head has a longer, narrower muzzle and a slimmer neck.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Horse_02.description: A full horse head replacing the wearer's own, with a long muzzle, upright pointed ears, and a shaggy mane that falls from the forehead down the back of the neck. Suggests a beastly, animal-headed look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Horse_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skin of the head and ears; colour 1 on the blaze down the face and part of the mane; colour 0 on the muzzle and the mane strands; colour 2 on the mane tips and around the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Hyena_01.description: A full hyena head with a furry canine muzzle, large rounded ears, a contrasting nose and whiskers, and a swept-back shaggy mane of spiky tufts that trails down the nape in a long tapering strip.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the face fur and inner ears; colour 1 on the chin and lower muzzle shading and the tip of the mane; colour 0 on the mane strip and inner ear fur; colour 2 on the nose and the fringe tufts.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Kaiju_01.description: A full-head dragon-like monster helm with a ridged, scaled snout plate, two long swept-back horns, jagged swept mane spikes, curved side tusks and a pointed armoured collar that covers the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the snout plates, back stripe and neck collar; colour 2 on the horns and spiky crest; colour 0 on the tusks; colour 1 on the recessed face and eye area.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Kaiju_02.description: A full monstrous kaiju head covering: a broad crested skull-like helm with swept side flares, a pair of short upward horns, small fangs at the brow, and a segmented collar with a pointed front panel. A long curved horn juts from the jaw.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the crested helm and front collar panel; colour 0 on the jaw, neck collar and lower face plates; colour 2 on the horns and jaw horn; colour 1 on the small fangs.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Kangaroo_01.description: A full animal head with a long tapered muzzle, contrasting nose, and large pointed ears that sweep outward and back. Fluffy tufts frame the cheeks, and the head covers the whole head down to the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head shell, muzzle top and outer ears; colour 0 on the cheek tufts, underjaw and inner ears; colour 1 on the eye markings and inner ear shading; colour 2 on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Kitty_01.description: A full anthropomorphic cat head with furry skin, tall pointed ears with pink inner lining, a swept tuft of hair on top, long whiskers, and tufted cheek fur with striped facial markings.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head fur and outer ears; colour 1 on the muzzle, nose area and stripe markings; colour 0 on the hair tuft and whiskers; colour 2 on the nose and eye details.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Lizard_01.description: A full lizard head with a long tapered snout, scaly texture, small pointed teeth, side-set eyes and angular patches across the crown and cheeks; a swept mane of hair falls down one side.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled top of the head and the mane; colour 1 on the angular scale patches and mane tips; colour 3 on the strands within the mane; the snout and underjaw show a skin tone not set by the scheme.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Lizard_01.differs: The female head has a slimmer, shorter snout with less prominent teeth and a mane that hangs more forward over the face.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Lizard_02.description: A full lizard head with a long tapered snout, scaled skin, small pointed teeth and side-set eyes. A swept hair-like crest of long strands falls down one side of the face, with angular patches across the crown and cheeks.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Lizard_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled top of the head and the crest strands; colour 1 on the angular patches over the crown, cheeks and neck; colour 3 on the darker crest strands; the snout and lower face keep a skin tone that ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Lizard_02.differs: The crest on the female head sweeps over the front and side of the face, with its long strands hanging in front. The male crest is gathered further back and hangs behind the head.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Llama_01.description: A full llama head with an elongated furry muzzle, tall upright ears, shaggy layered fringe and tufted crest, a small nose and a tongue hanging from the mouth; it covers the whole head and neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the cheeks, fringe and ears; colour 1 on the face, forehead tuft, neck and tongue; colour 2 on the tufts behind the fringe; colour 3 on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Mantis_01.description: A full head covering shaped like a mantis skull: a smooth bony front plate with large domed bulging eyes, a row of sharp fang-like teeth along the jaw, and a soft cloth hood-like back that drapes down the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Mantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony front plate and eye rims; colour 1 on the cloth back panel; colour 3 on the domed eyes; colour 2 on the inner neck opening.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Mantis_01.differs: The cloth back panel ends higher at the base of the skull and hangs shorter, with the teeth sitting clear of it.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Mecha_Horse_01.description: A full robotic horse head replacing the wearer's head: long angular muzzle, glowing eye slits, side cheek plates with hex bolts, two pointed ears and a mane of blocky slats down the back of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Mecha_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek plates and back panels; colour 1 on the muzzle tip and nose caps; colour 2 on the main head shell and mane slats; colour 3 on the eye lights.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Mecha_Horse_01.differs: The mane slats are shorter and sit further down the neck, and the ears are angled slightly more upright.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Mechanical_Dragon_01.description: A full mechanical dragon head covering the whole head: a long, angular armoured snout tapering to a point, a tall blade-like crest, rounded horn-like nubs on top, and segmented plates across the back of the skull, exposing an inner layer at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Mechanical_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout plates and back-of-head segment rims; colour 2 on the horn nubs, crest edges and panels; colour 3 on the inner neck and gap layer; colour 1 on small accents.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Monkey_01.description: A monkey-faced head with a scowling muzzle, pointed ears and a tall swept-back crest of long spiky fur tufts, plus shaggy fur sideburns and a pointed beard. Covers the whole head in a wild beastly style.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur crest, sideburns and beard; colour 1 on the eye areas and faint tints in the fur; the face skin ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Moth_01.description: A moth-like beast head covered in a thick, shaggy fur mane that drapes over the head and down to the chest, with a small contrasting insectoid face, side eyes, and two long curved swept-back horn-like antennae.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face, the top of the fur and the antennae; colour 1 on the lower, shaggy fur mane, blending up from colour 0; colour 2 on the antenna edges; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Moth_02.description: A moth-like beast head: a smooth pointed face with slender curved eye slits, two long tapering feathered antennae sweeping up and outward, and a thick shaggy fur ruff that spills over the shoulders and chest.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Moth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur and antenna tips; colour 1 on the face and the lower fur ruff; colour 3 on the eye markings; colour 2 on the underside of the face.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Moth_02.differs: The female ruff hangs slightly shorter and narrower over the chest, with the fur swept back more at the sides.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Mouse_01.description: A full mouse-head replacement with a tapered snout, fine whiskers, large upright rounded ears with gradient inner faces, and a furry contrasting head. Marked eye patches and a contrasting muzzle give a cute animal look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Mouse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head fur and the lower inner ears; colour 1 on the eye patches and the upper inner ears; colour 2 on the muzzle; colour 3 on the nose and outer ears (skin-toned here).
Female/F_Head_Beast_Mouse_01.differs: The female mouse has skin-toned outer ears and nose, where the male has these features in a strong contrasting colour.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Owl_01.description: A full owl head replacing the wearer's own: a heart-shaped facial disc with round glossy eyes and a small hooked beak, a ruffled feathered crown and back that flare into a pointed cape-like nape, and a shaggy feathered ruff at the throat.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Owl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the facial disc and throat ruff; colour 1 on the crown and back feathers; colour 2 on the darker feather tips at the nape; colour 3 on the beak.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Pig_01.description: A full pig head replacing the wearer's own: a wrinkled, heavy-jowled face with a broad flat snout, small deep-set eyes and two rounded upright ears, blending into the neck with a short collar-like base.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Pig_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head, ears and neck; colour 1 on the snout tip.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Pitbull_01.description: A full-head dog mask in a pitbull style: a smooth close-fitting cranium, tall pointed upright ears with inner lining, a short broad muzzle with a contrasting nose, sculpted jowls and a lolling tongue hanging below the chin.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Pitbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the head, the centre stripe and the outer ears; colour 1 on the face and cheek patches and the tongue; colour 3 on the muzzle and inner ears; colour 2 on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Plantmonster_01.description: A full monstrous head covering shaped like a rounded bulb with a huge gaping toothed maw at the front. Lumpy rimmed lips frame rows of sharp fangs and an inner mouth lining, and raised round blotches are scattered over the skin.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Plantmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bulbous head skin and the fangs; colour 3 on the raised blotches; colour 2 on the lumpy lips around the mouth; colour 1 on the inner mouth lining.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Pumpkin_02.description: A large round ribbed pumpkin covering the whole head, with a carved jack-o'-lantern face of angular eyes, a triangular nose and jagged teeth, a curled stem on top and a flared neck collar below.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Pumpkin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pumpkin shell; colour 1 on the stem and curled vine; colour 3 on the flared neck collar.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Pumpkin_02.differs: The neck collar is a longer, more pointed tongue-like flare hanging from the front of the chin, while the male version has a shorter collar.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Rabbit_01.description: A full rabbit head replacing the human head: a furred, tapering muzzle with thin whiskers, angled eyes, and two tall pointed ears with lighter inner linings, ending in a neck base that sits at the collar.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Rabbit_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fur of the head and outer ears; colour 0 on the inner ears and whiskers; colour 1 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Raccoon_01.description: A full anthropomorphic raccoon head with a short muzzle, large pointed upright ears, spiky swept-back fur tufts, bold mask-like eye patches and a rounded snout with a small nose. It covers the whole head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Raccoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur and outer ears; colour 2 on the eye mask patches; colour 1 on the muzzle and around the eyes; colour 3 on the nose and inner ears.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Raptor_01.description: A full replacement raptor-lizard head with a long toothy snout, small horns at the nose and a large fanned frill of ridged panels tipped with long spikes; finned ear flaps and a throat patch complete the reptilian look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Raptor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaly skin of the snout, face and frill spikes; colour 1 on the throat, ear fins and patterned frill panels; colour 3 on the frill stripes, mouth interior and back of the head.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Raptor_02.description: A full raptor-like reptile head replacing the wearer's own: a long toothy snout with an open jaw, and a wide fan-shaped frill of spiked ribs behind the skull. Small fins flare at the cheeks and neck. Monstrous, beastly look.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Raptor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout, jaw and frill ribs; colour 3 on the frill markings, back of the head and inner mouth; colour 1 on the frill patches, cheek fins and throat; colour 2 on the frill edges and spike tips.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Raptor_03.description: A full replacement raptor head with a long tapered snout, open toothy jaw and side-set eyes, topped by a fan-shaped frill edged with a row of curved horn spikes and small fins at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Raptor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout, jaw and frill underside; colour 1 on the throat, frill patches and neck fins; colour 3 on the mouth, head markings and frill stripes; colour 2 on the spike tips and frill edging.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Reptillian_01.description: A full reptilian beast head with a long snout, heavy brow ridges, pointed ears at the back corners and a raised central crest ridge. Scaly, textured skin covers the whole head and wraps down onto the throat.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Reptillian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose tip; colour 1 on the throat and jaw underside; colour 2 on the central crest plates; colour 3 on the head skin.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Salamander_01.description: A full amphibian head replacing the human one: a smooth, tapered salamander snout with side-set eyes, marbled skin patterning, whisker-like barbels at the cheeks, and a pair of large frilled fin-like crests sweeping up and back from the temples.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Salamander_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main skin of the head and snout; colour 2 on the marbled markings and streaks; colour 1 on the lower fin fringes and some skin patches; colour 0 on the ribbed fin crests and barbels.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Seahorse_01.description: A full seahorse head replacing the wearer's own: a knobbly, studded head with a long tubular snout, round glossy eyes, feathery fin tufts at the sides, and leafy frond-like antlers branching from the crown.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Seahorse_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head and snout; colour 0 on the leafy fronds and spots' surrounding area; colour 1 on the eyes and spiky fin accents; colour 2 on the fin feathers and frond spots.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Serpent_Horned_01.description: A full reptilian head replacing the human head: a long tapering snout, wide toothy mouth with contrasting lips, side-set eyes, and a scaly crest of segmented plates running from brow to the back of the skull.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Serpent_Horned_01.colourAreas: The head is textured skin that mostly ignores the scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on the skin, crest or mouth.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Set_01.description: A full reptilian monster head with a long dragon-like snout, toothy jaw, sculpted brow ridges and two long swept-back horns; a ridged neck section covers the neck. Suggests a dragon or lizard creature.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Set_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head, horns and neck; colour 1 around the eyes; colour 0 on the teeth, jaw underside and inner horn surfaces.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Set_01.differs: The female head has longer, more upright horns and a narrower, more pointed snout.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Shisa_01.description: A full head covering styled as a Shisa guardian lion: snarling muzzle with fangs, brow ridges, pointed ears, and a mane of carved spiral curls ending in jagged locks that hang past the neck.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Shisa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face, muzzle and curled mane; colour 1 on the crest panel on the forehead and the markings around the eyes and mouth; colour 2 on the mouth interior and eye recesses.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Skeletal_01.description: A full skeletal skull head with hollow glowing eye sockets, a fanged open jaw and a small collar-like neck base, topped by two long curving ridged horns that sweep up and outward, suggesting a demonic undead monster.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Skeletal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and jaw; colour 1 on the horns; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the teeth and fangs.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Spider_01.description: A full monstrous spider head covering the whole head and neck: a rounded carapace with clusters of bulbous eyes, small round gems below them, and two curved downward fangs with pointed tips. Mottled speckled surface, with a small mouth between the fangs.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the carapace and fang bases; colour 0 on the speckled patches and the large eyes; colour 1 on the small round gems and the fang tips; colour 2 on the small side eyes.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Spider_01.differs: The female version has a small toothed mouth visible between the fangs, where the male has a pair of small contrasting mandibles.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Starowl_01.description: A full owl-griffon head with a hooked beak, tufted pointed ears, a masked eye area and shaggy layered feathers that flare into a ruff around the neck and cover the whole head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers and beak; colour 1 on the face mask patches and inner ears; colour 2 on the ear tips and beak tip; colour 3 on the eyes.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Starowl_01.differs: The female ruff is a little shorter, and the beak and ears sit slightly smaller and finer.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Suave_Wolf_01.description: A full wolf head with a long tapered muzzle, two tall pointed ears, a swept-back tuft of fur and shaggy cheek and neck ruffs with spiky tufts; a beastly yet sleek anthropomorphic look that covers the whole head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Suave_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head, ears and ruffs; colour 1 on the inner ears, tuft tips and spiky cheek tufts; colour 3 on the muzzle and face mask; colour 2 on the nose and ear tips.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Swan_01.description: A full swan head on a long, curved S-shaped neck, with a smooth rounded skull, a pointed downward-angled beak, small eyes and a patch on each cheek. A ruff of jagged feather tufts sits at the base of the neck on the shoulders.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, neck and feather ruff; colour 1 on the cheek patches; colour 2 on the beak and the underside of the ruff; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Beast_Swan_02.description: A full swan head with a curved, tapering neck bending forward, a long pointed bill, small round eyes and a ruff of jagged feathers around the base of the neck, sitting over the whole head.
Female/F_Head_Beast_Swan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, neck and feather ruff; colour 1 on the cheek patches around the eyes; colour 2 on the bill and the base of the ruff; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Bear_Mouth_01.description: Two small clusters of conical tusk-like teeth pointing upward, one on each side of the lower jaw near the chin corners, giving a bestial bear-like look. Not attached to the mouth itself, they sit at the jawline.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Bear_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all the teeth; other colour slots not visible.
