Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Bear_Top_01.description: A pair of rounded bear-style ears set high on either side of the head, each a cupped shell with a tufted fur-like lining on the inner face. A cute animal look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Bear_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 on the fur tufts inside the ears; colour 2 on the shadowed inner rim.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Bonemantis_01.description: A ring of six curved, tapering bone-like fangs arranged around the base of the neck, pointing downward and inward like mandibles. Suggests a monstrous, mantis-inspired collar that leaves the head and neck otherwise bare.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the fangs, with a faint tint from colour 1 on the shaded undersides.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Coyote_Hair_01.description: A chin-length, swept-back hairstyle with a tall, spiky crest on top and long jagged strands flaring out toward one side and the back. Small pointed ear-like tufts stick up, giving a wild, feral look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Coyote_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair and crest; colour 1 on the lower tips and side strands; colour 2 on a few underside strand tips; colour 3 on the small band at the nape.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Dragon_Mouth_0.description: A ring of separate, sharp conical fangs arranged in a U-shaped arc around the jaw and neck, like a dragon's teeth. Larger fangs sit along the jawline and smaller ones taper down toward the throat.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Dragon_Mouth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fangs; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Fennec_Ears_01.description: A pair of large, pointed fennec-fox ears rising from the sides of the head, with a rim around each ear, a hollow inner face lined with tufted fur, and a fringe of small feathery tufts along the lower edge.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Fennec_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner ear hollows; colour 0 on the fur tufts inside the ears.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Fennec_Hair_01.description: A short mohawk-style hairpiece of swept, layered locks that rise into tall pointed tips along the centre of the head, with the sides left bare. It suggests a fox-like, spiky punk-fantasy look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Fennec_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and body of the locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the locks.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Ears_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that sit high on the sides of the head and sweep up and outward, with a hollow inner cup lined with a tufted, feathery edge. Feral, beastlike fantasy look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 on the inner ear lining.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Teeth_01.description: A set of feral fangs arranged in a U-shaped row along the jawline and chin, with two large curved tusks flaring up at the mouth corners and smaller pointed teeth trailing down and around toward the neck.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Teeth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and tusks; colour 1 on the bases of some of the smaller teeth.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Tongue_0.description: A long, tapering tongue-like flap that hangs from the mouth down past the chin to the neck, with a ridged, wrinkled surface and a pointed tip. Suggests a feral beast or monster head.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Tongue_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tongue surface; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Ears_01.description: A pair of small pointed animal ears perched high on the sides of the head, each a cupped, slightly crumpled shell with an inner hollow facing forward. A cute ferret-like beast look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of each ear; colour 1 on the inner hollow of each ear.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Mouth_0.description: A set of sharp animal fangs sitting at the mouth: a row of small pointed teeth with two longer canines curving up from the upper row and two longer tusks pointing down at the corners. Feral and monstrous.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Mouth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and fangs; the lower tips show darker shading. No other colour slots are clearly visible.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Mouth_0.differs: The female fangs sit slightly smaller and lower, with a more compact row of teeth and shorter lower tusks.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Side_01.description: A pair of thin, angular whisker clusters that sprout from either side of the nose and splay outward and slightly back. Each is a few fine bristles, giving a ferret-like animal look; no other head change is visible.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Fox_02.description: A pair of fox whisker sets: thin, tapering strands fanning out in small clusters from each cheek or jaw side, sweeping outward and slightly down. Small, delicate animal-style face accessory.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Fox_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whisker strands; colour 2 on the darker root tips of the whiskers.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Goat_Top_01.description: A pair of goat-like ears that stick out sideways and slightly back from the upper sides of the head. Each is a long, pointed, leaf-shaped flap with a small contrasting inner base, giving a beastly look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Goat_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear surfaces; colour 2 on the small inner base edge under each ear.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Kangaroo_Top_0.description: A pair of tall, narrow kangaroo-style ears that rise from the top of the head and taper to points, splaying slightly outward. Each has a smooth outer shell and a lighter, shaded inner face.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Kangaroo_Top_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shells and rims of the ears; colour 0 on the inner ear faces; colour 1 on the inner tips.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Kangaroo_Top_0.description: A pair of long kangaroo-style ears that sit on top of the head and angle outward and down in a droopy, sideways sweep. Each ear is a tapered, rounded shape with a lined inner surface, giving a cute animal look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Kangaroo_Top_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer surface of both ears; colour 1 and colour 0 on the inner lining of each ear.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Lizard_Hair_01.description: A small side-swept hair piece sitting on one side of the head: a thick swoop of hair across the forehead, with pointed locks trailing down to about chin length beside the cheek and neck. It leaves the rest of the scalp bare.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Lizard_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept lock; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the hair; colour 3 on the narrower locks behind the main sweep; colour 2 on the root at the top of the head.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Lizard_Mouth_0.description: Two rows of small conical fangs and spines that run along each side of the mouth and jaw, curving back toward the cheeks. It gives a reptilian, monstrous face ornament without covering the face.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Lizard_Mouth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the teeth and spines; the pieces show no other colour slots.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Mecha_Horse_Ha.description: A mohawk-like crest of five separate chunky rectangular blocks set in a single line from the forehead over the crown to the nape, suggesting a mechanical horse mane. The blocks are blocky and segmented.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Mecha_Horse_Ha.colourAreas: All the blocks appear to take the default look; colour slots are not clearly distinguishable on this sheet, so likely colour 2 on the blocks.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Mecha_Horse_Mo.description: A U-shaped mechanical jaw guard that curves under the chin and along the jawline, ending in a round octagonal disc at each side of the head. Suggests a robotic horse muzzle or cheek piece.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Mecha_Horse_Mo.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer jaw band; colour 0 on the inner face of the band; colour 1 on the side discs.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Mecha_Horse_Si.description: A pair of hexagonal mechanical plates mounted on the sides of the head over the ears, like robotic earpieces. Each has a dished outer face with a central round bolt, small rivets and a raised bevelled rim.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Mecha_Horse_Si.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the recessed inner face of each plate; colour 2 on the rim and bevelled edges; colour 0 on the polished outer surfaces, which look glossy metal; colour 3 on the small dots.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Mecha_Horse_To.description: A pair of sharp, angular pointed ears or horns that rise from the top of the head and lean slightly outward. They are faceted and blade-like with a flat cut base, suggesting a mechanical horse or beast head.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Mecha_Horse_To.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer faces of the horns; colour 2 on the inner faces and edges; colours 0 and 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Hair_01.description: A short, tall swept-up hairstyle of sharp, flame-like locks that rise into a spiky crest above the forehead. It sits close to the head and ends above the jaw, giving a wild, animalistic look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair locks; colour 1 on the shaded strands between the locks and along the edges.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_0.description: A stylised beard and sideburn set of layered, pointed blade-like tufts: swept-out flared wings of spikes at each cheek join a tapering, pointed goatee hanging from the chin. Suggests a wild beast or monkey-king look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tufts; colour 1 on the thin edge highlights and inner streaks of the strands.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_0.description: A furry beard-like chin piece: a pointed collar wraps under the jaw and the shaggy fur tapers to a long jagged point down the throat and upper chest. It suggests a beastly monkey or primate look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur and collar; colour 1 on the thin streaks running through the fur.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_0.differs: The female version hangs longer and narrower, tapering to a deeper point down the chest, while the male one is shorter and wider.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_0.description: Two pairs of small conical fangs set along the corners of the mouth, one pointing up and one pointing down on each side. A subtle bestial mouth accent with no other head coverage.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upward fangs; colour 2 on the downward fangs. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_01.description: A row of chunky orc-style teeth set along the mouth line, with a long curved tusk sweeping up on one side and a large blunt stubby tooth on the other, giving a brutish underbite look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long tusk; colour 1 on the teeth flanking the centre; colour 2 on the two centre teeth; colour 3 on the large blunt tooth.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_02.description: A row of orc-like lower tusks and teeth along the mouth: two large curved outer tusks sweep up and outward, with smaller pointed teeth between them. Suggests a brutish, monstrous underbite.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the left large tusk; colour 3 on the right large tusk; colour 1 on the small teeth beside the tusks; colour 2 on the two centre teeth.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_02.differs: The female version has four small teeth in a row between the tusks, with slightly more spread, while the male has fewer, larger looking centre teeth.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_01.description: A small chunky hoop ring with a dimpled, hammered surface, worn through the ear as a piercing. It is a thick rounded band with a hollow centre, giving a crude tribal, monstrous look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_02.description: A small chunky ring set through the ear, like a gauge or plug earring, with a hammered, faceted outer surface and a hollow centre. Sits on the side of the head, suggesting a brutish orc look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the ring; the inner lining shows a slightly different shade, likely from shading rather than a separate slot.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_03.description: A pair of chunky rough-textured ear gauges, one ring on each side of the head at ear level, with a thick chiselled band and open centre. A tribal, monstrous brute-style piercing.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; the other slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Pitbull_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that rise from the top of the head and curve slightly outward. Each has a smooth outer shell and a hollow inner face. Suggests a beastly, pitbull-like look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Pitbull_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells of both ears; colour 3 on the inner ear hollows, fading toward colour 2 at the base of each hollow.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Raccoon_Mouth_.description: A row of small sharp fangs arcing along the lower jaw just under the lips, with clusters of longer spikes at each side and a gap at the centre. Gives a feral raccoon-like snarl.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Raccoon_Mouth_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth, with colour 1 shading toward the tips.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Raccoon_Mouth_.differs: The female teeth form a more continuous curved row that sits slightly lower and looks more evenly spaced.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Raccoon_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that stand upright on the top of the head, angled slightly outward. Each ear is a hollow cupped shape with a thin rim and a recessed inner face.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Raccoon_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces and rims; colour 3 on the inner ear hollows; colour 1 on the small base patches where the ears meet the head.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Starowl_Ear_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears rising from the top front of the head, angled outward with tapered tips and hollow inner cups, like an owl or griffon's ear tufts. Suits beastly fantasy characters.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Starowl_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces; colour 2 on the tips and the marking strokes; colour 1 on the inner cup of each ear.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Starowl_Mouth_.description: A hooked raptor beak worn over the nose and mouth: a smooth, pointed shell that curves down to a sharp tip past the chin, with small nostril dimples near the top. Suggests a griffon or owl head.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Starowl_Mouth_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 2 on the hooked tip and lower edge, blending from colour 0 towards the tip.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Whiterhino_Ear.description: A pair of small pointed animal ears with skin-like surfaces, angled outward and upward from the upper sides of the head. Each tapers from a wider base to a folded tip, giving a beastly rhino-like look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Whiterhino_Ear.colourAreas: Colour slots don't visibly apply; the ears show a skin-toned surface that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Whiterhino_Mou.description: A set of blocky, chunky teeth in upper and lower rows that curve around the mouth like a beast's jaw, worn over the mouth area. Suggests a rhino or monstrous creature look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Whiterhino_Mou.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the teeth show no other colour slots.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Ears_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears with faceted, angular shells and a hollow inner cup, set high on the sides of the head and angled outward like a wolf's. Suggests a beastly or cute animal-person look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of each ear; the inner ear cup shows a skin-like tone that does not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Mouth_01.description: A set of jagged, spiky wolf teeth forming a U-shaped ring that wraps along the jawline and chin, with two longer fangs at the front. It sits around the mouth like a monstrous toothy jaw.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth; colour 1 on the shadowed bases and gum edges of the teeth.
Female/F_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Mouth_01.differs: The female teeth are sparser and more widely spaced, with longer fangs at the front and a narrower jaw ring.

Female/F_Head_Child_Disco_01.description: A spherical, translucent bubble helmet that encloses the whole head, covered in a glittering, iridescent faceted sparkle pattern. It sits around the head down to the neck, giving a retro-futuristic disco or space look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Disco_01.colourAreas: The default material is an iridescent, sparkling glass-like finish that ignores the colour scheme; no colour slot is clearly visible.

Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A pair of large, pointed, swept-back fantasy ears that replace the normal ears. Each has a smooth outer shell and a textured inner ear, flaring from the sides of the head into sharp tips angled up and back.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shells of the ears; the inner ear lining keeps a fixed textured skin look that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A pair of swept-back finned brow ridges, one over each eye, curving from the brow toward the temples with layered feather-like ridges. They read as dragon-like head ornaments that leave the rest of the face bare.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower and outer parts of each brow fin; colour 1 on the upper tips and the ridge edges, blending from colour 0.

Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A short, swept-back mane of layered, flame-like locks that fan out behind the head in pointed tips, with a separate band across the forehead. Suggests a wild, dragon-like fantasy hairstyle.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the locks; colour 2 on the band across the forehead.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.differs: The female version has a contrasting band across the forehead that sits over the brow, while the male hairline is open.

Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A V-shaped ruff of layered, feather-like or fur-like tufts that wraps around the jaw and neck, with tapering tips at the chin and swept-up pointed plumes rising beside each ear. Suggests a beastly, dragon-like look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tufts of the ruff; colour 1 on the tips of the tufts and the small chin panel; colour 2 and colour 3 on the upright plumes by the ears, fading from one to the other.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.differs: The female version has a small separate panel under the chin and a slimmer, more open ruff at the front.

Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: Swept-back, spiky dragon-like hair with feathery tapered tips, small curved horn-like ornaments at each temple, and twin braided locks with a band hanging in front of the shoulders. A contrasting blindfold-like band covers the eyes.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and braids; colour 1 on the hair tips and the braid bands; colour 3 on the horn-like temple ornaments; colour 2 on the eye band and inner horn parts.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.differs: The female version includes a solid band across the eyes like a blindfold, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A U-shaped row of small pointed fang-like teeth that traces the jawline from ear to ear around the lower face, giving a monstrous, beast-like grin. No other head covering is included.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A pair of slender, curved, tapering tendrils or whiskers that start at the sides of the neck and sweep down and outward toward the shoulders, ending in fine points. A small dragon-like accent.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both tendrils; no other colours visible.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.differs: The female tendrils sit lower at the neck and base of the throat, hanging over the collarbone.

Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A pair of antler-like horns rising from the top of the head, each sweeping up and outward from a thick rounded base into a long curved main tine with a smaller side prong and a pointed tip.
Female/F_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick bases of the horns; colour 1 across the mid-shafts, blending into colour 2 at the tips. Colour 3 is not visible.

Female/F_Head_Child_Drone_Top_01.description: A small headpiece sitting on the forehead and crown: an oval contrasting gem-like plate with a rim, flanked by two tall swept-up pointed fins that form a horned, V-shaped crest. Suggests a sleek robotic or alien drone helm.
Female/F_Head_Child_Drone_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two upswept fins; colour 1 on the thin edge trim of the fins and band; colour 3 on the rim around the oval plate; colour 2 on the oval plate.

Female/F_Head_Child_Full_Falcon_Side_02.description: A pair of angular winglike head fins mounted over the ears: each has a pointed plate at the temple with tall swept-back blade feathers and a small forward spike. They leave the face and scalp bare, suggesting a mecha falcon look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Full_Falcon_Side_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pointed ear plates; colour 1 on the tall upper blades; colour 2 on the middle blades; colour 3 on the small lower spikes.

Female/F_Head_Child_Full_Falcon_Top_02.description: A slim open metal circlet-helm: a thin band rings the head with a pointed brow that dips to a gem, and a central crest of layered fins runs front to back, topped by a tall blade and small side spikes.
Female/F_Head_Child_Full_Falcon_Top_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and crest plates; colour 1 on the tall crest blade; colour 2 on the small side spikes and rear crest clip; colour 3 on the brow gem.

Female/F_Head_Child_Kitsune_01.description: Two clusters of long, thin curved whiskers, one on each cheek, fanning outward from beside the mouth. Slim and delicate, they suggest a fox or cat animal-character look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Kitsune_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whiskers; colour 2 on the darker whisker tips and roots.
Female/F_Head_Child_Kitsune_01.differs: The whiskers sit lower, around the jaw and chin, and appear more swept back than the male set, which sits at mouth level.

Female/F_Head_Child_None_01.description: A small rounded, scoop-shaped neck patch that fills the base of the neck and upper chest, like a tiny bib or collar insert. Its edge is thin and flat, and it is open at the back.
Female/F_Head_Child_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole patch; the inner underside shows as a shadowed surface with no separate colour slot.

Female/F_Head_Child_None_02.description: A small shallow, rounded-triangular plate that sits at the base of the neck and upper chest like a flat bib or collar insert, with a thin raised rim and an open hollow back.
Female/F_Head_Child_None_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole plate and its rim.
Female/F_Head_Child_None_02.differs: The female version is a plain smooth plate, without the raised rim and central ball of the male version.

Female/F_Head_Child_None_03.description: A small rounded-triangular gorget plate resting at the base of the throat, with a raised rim around a shallow recess and a domed stud at its centre; it flares slightly at the back like a collar.
Female/F_Head_Child_None_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and its central dome; the underside of the plate shows a shaded tone from the same slot.

Female/F_Head_Child_None_04.description: A small angular collar-like plate sitting at the base of the neck and upper chest, shaped as a rounded triangle with a raised rim and a single round bump in the centre. Reads as a partial armour gorget.
Female/F_Head_Child_None_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and its raised rim and central bump; the inner underside appears shaded, with no other slots visible.

Female/F_Head_Child_Robot_Steampunk_01.description: A pair of small octagonal disc ear-plates mounted on short contrasting stems at each side of the head, each ending in a rounded knob that sticks outward. The discs have layered rims and a recessed centre, giving a mechanical steampunk robot look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Robot_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer disc rims and backs; colour 1 on the recessed ring of each disc; colour 3 on the central and end knobs; colour 2 on the stems.

Female/F_Head_Child_Robot_Steampunk_02.description: A pair of small octagonal barrel-shaped filter canisters worn at either side of the mouth and jaw, with banded, segmented metal casings and recessed round openings facing forward. Suggests a steampunk respirator.
Female/F_Head_Child_Robot_Steampunk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister casings; colour 3 on the recessed openings.

Female/F_Head_Child_Scarab_02.description: A pair of tall curved horns rising from the sides of the head, built from chunky segmented blocks that taper into sharp upturned tips. They sit at the temples and suit a demonic or insectoid fantasy look.
Female/F_Head_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base segments of each horn; colour 1 on the middle segments; colour 2 on the narrow band below the tip; colour 3 on the pointed tips and the base ends.

Female/F_Head_Child_Sockpuppet_Eyes_01.description: A pair of chunky, flat octagonal button eyes, each with a short curved stitched bar across the middle, sitting on the forehead like a sock puppet's sewn-on eyes. Playful and cartoonish.
Female/F_Head_Child_Sockpuppet_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one button eye; colour 1 on the other button eye; colour 2 on the stitched bars across both.

Female/F_Head_Child_Sockpuppet_Hair_01.description: A small cap of short, straight strands of hair sitting on top of the head like a tuft, with a central parting and thicker rope-like strands running along the crown and sides; leaves the sides and back of the head bare.
Female/F_Head_Child_Sockpuppet_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands of hair; colour 1 on the thicker rope-like strands along the crown and edges.

Female/F_Head_Child_Steelcommando_01.description: A retro metal face guard: a curved visor band across the eyes with two flat cheek plates that run down along the sides of the face toward the jaw, leaving the nose and mouth open.
Female/F_Head_Child_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the visor band and its polished edge; colour 1 on the inner edges of the cheek plates; the rest shows the glossy metal default.
Female/F_Head_Child_Steelcommando_01.differs: The female visor band sits slightly higher and curves more sharply, with a narrower front and cheek plates that hug the face more closely.

Female/F_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_01.description: A flat, thin rounded-square screen panel that floats in front of the face like a TV head, with softly curved corners. It shows a glitchy, scrambled pixel-block image and looks cute and retro.
Female/F_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_01.colourAreas: The panel shows a fixed printed image that ignores the colour scheme; no slot visibly changes it.
Female/F_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_01.differs: The female screen shows a scrambled, glitchy pixel pattern instead of a clear picture of a rainbow and a cat.

Female/F_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_02.description: A pair of thick, rounded-rectangular slab panels floating on either side of the head like screens or earpieces, with bevelled edges and no connection to the skull. Reads as a minimal sci-fi head accessory.
Female/F_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both panels; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Cosmic_01.description: A smooth, sculpted face mask with open eye holes and a defined nose and lips, framed by a raised brow crest and hexagonal side plates with small emblem-like insets at the forehead and temples. Sci-fi, helmet-like styling.
Female/F_Head_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole mask shell; colour 0 on the thin rims around the hexagonal plates; colour 2 on the small insets and the shadowed gaps under the side plates.

Female/F_Head_Cosmic_02.description: A sleek sci-fi face mask that follows the features, with eye openings, a hexagonal plate on the forehead, and hexagonal side plates at the temples and jaw joined by segmented jaw panels; it leaves the scalp bare.
Female/F_Head_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mask shell and hexagonal plates; colour 2 on the recessed jaw segments and the small marks inside the hexagons.

Female/F_Head_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.description: A full replacement head shaped like an elongated, skull-like monster with a long toothed snout, angular plated crown, curled brow ridges and a neck collar that covers the throat. Reads as a mechanical beast for cyberpunk or monstrous looks.
Female/F_Head_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell and snout; colour 1 on the neck collar and the curled trim around the eyes and cheeks; colour 2 on the side plates above the ears; colour 3 on the nostril lights.

Female/F_Head_Demon_01.description: A monstrous bald head with a long, crocodile-like snout, heavy brow ridges, small pointed ears and rows of sharp fangs, with larger tusks jutting from the jaw. Replaces the whole head with a demonic, beastly look.
Female/F_Head_Demon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fangs and tusks; the skin-like head surface does not visibly use the colour scheme.
Female/F_Head_Demon_01.differs: The female jaw is slightly shorter and narrower, with the tusks set closer to the snout.

Female/F_Head_Demon_02.description: A bald, skull-like demonic head with a ridged brow, deep sunken eye sockets, small pointed ears and a long narrow jaw lined with sharp fangs down each side. The sculpted skin looks organic and gaunt.
Female/F_Head_Demon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fangs; the skin of the head takes a skin tone that does not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Demon_03.description: A bald, skull-like demon head with a ridged brow, deep hollow eye sockets, a sunken nose and a jawless lower face, with rows of long pointed fangs along the cheeks and a smooth tapering neck.
Female/F_Head_Demon_03.colourAreas: The head and neck take the skin tone, which is not one of the four test colours; the fangs show a ivory tint that does not follow the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Disco_01.description: A full spherical disco-ball helmet that covers the whole head, built from horizontal bands of small reflective tiles with a sparkling glitter finish. It sits over the head with a small neck collar visible beneath.
Female/F_Head_Disco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 tint the mirrored tiles, with the sparkle finish largely overriding the scheme; colour 3 on the small neck piece beneath the ball.
Female/F_Head_Disco_01.differs: The female ball is smoother, with ring bands and fewer visible tile gaps, and it shows a narrower contrasting neck trim.

Female/F_Head_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A full dragon head covering the whole head: a smooth scaled snout with a contrasting nose, whisker tendrils, a beard tuft, two tall curved antler horns, and a swept-back mane of layered feathery spikes down the back.
Female/F_Head_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the face, snout and neck collar; colour 0 on the mane tufts, whiskers and beard; colour 1 on the mane tips and horn bases; colour 2 on the nose, brow markings and horn tips.

Female/F_Head_Drone_01.description: A full mechanical drone helmet with a smooth segmented shell, two tall pointed fins rising above the brow, a contrasting oval visor, and a rounded ribbed face section with small side lens pods. Side plates flare down along the jaw.
Female/F_Head_Drone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell plates, fins and jaw flares; colour 1 on the panel seams and edge trim; colour 3 on the ribbed face section and visor rim; colour 2 on the visor and inner fin surfaces.

Female/F_Head_Dryad_01.description: A full head replacement shaped like a hollow tree stump: a wood-grain, plank-like shell with jagged splintered spikes rising at the crown, a skull-like face with glowing eyes and a narrow nose slit, and a ridged collar at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bark shell and splintered crown; colour 3 on the thin cracks in the wood grain; colour 1 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Dryad_02.description: A full monstrous head replacement resembling a bark-like tree spirit: a ridged, elongated neck and skull crowned with jagged thorn-like spikes, patches of rough textured growth on top, narrow glowing eyes and a fanged, snarling mouth.
Female/F_Head_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged bark-like head and neck; colour 2 on the rough patches across the crown and brow; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 3 on the thin vein lines and inner mouth.

Female/F_Head_Face4partialmask_01.description: A close-fitting luchador-style cloth mask covering the whole head, with a seam running over the crown and a gathered edge at the neck. Wide bordered openings frame the eyes, nose and mouth.
Female/F_Head_Face4partialmask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth hood; colour 1 on the borders around the eye, nose and mouth openings; colour 0 on the stitched seams.

Female/F_Head_Face4partialmaskluchador_0.description: A close-fitting cloth luchador-style hood covering the whole head, with visible stitched seams over the crown and back, and contrasting borders around open eye and mouth cutouts. The face is left partly exposed.
Female/F_Head_Face4partialmaskluchador_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood fabric and seam stitching; colour 1 on the borders around the eyes, nose and mouth openings.

Female/F_Head_Face_01.description: A bare, hairless humanoid head with a smooth rounded skull, defined brow, eyes, nose and lips, and small ears. It is a plain skin-toned base head with no added hair or headgear.
Female/F_Head_Face_01.colourAreas: Mostly skin tone that ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 appears to touch the irises of the eyes; the lips and eye makeup are part of the skin texture.

Female/F_Head_Face_01_Pharaoh.description: A full head skin replacement with painted-on arcane markings: a broad band across the forehead, a mask-like panel over the eyes and cheeks, a marked chin and a stripe down the front of the neck. The bare scalp stays smooth.
Female/F_Head_Face_01_Pharaoh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scalp, ears and back of the head; colour 1 on the forehead band, jaw and neck markings; colour 2 on the eye mask panel and the bands at the sides of the head; colour 3 on the lips and the stripe down the throat.

Female/F_Head_Face_Chicken_01.description: A full cartoon chicken head covering the whole head and neck, with a scalloped feather texture, a serrated spiky comb on top, a hooked beak, wattle, round contrasting-ringed eyes and a jagged feathered collar edge.
Female/F_Head_Face_Chicken_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathered head and neck; colour 1 on the comb, face and wattle; colour 2 on the beak; colour 3 on the rings around the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Face_Classic_Tights_01.description: A close-fitting full-head cowl that covers the scalp and forehead down to the cheeks, with cut-outs around the eyes, nose and mouth, and swirling curled bands across the brow. A superhero mask style.
Female/F_Head_Face_Classic_Tights_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cowl; colour 1 on the swirling brow bands and the thin trim around the eye and face openings.

Female/F_Head_Face_Classic_Tights_02.description: A skin-tight painted head covering that hugs the skull and face, with vertical stripes running from the crown down the forehead, cheeks and back of the head, plus curved side panels and outlined eye and mouth openings.
Female/F_Head_Face_Classic_Tights_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head covering; colour 2 on the vertical stripes; colour 1 on the curved side panels and the marking around the nose bridge.

Female/F_Head_Face_Classic_Tights_03.description: A smooth, hairless head skin with raised web-like line patterns across the forehead and cheeks, outlined rings around the eyes, and branching marks running down the neck. Suggests an energetic, sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Head_Face_Classic_Tights_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head and face surface; colour 1 on the raised webbing lines across the forehead and face; colour 3 on the rings around the eyes; colour 2 on the marks down the neck.

Female/F_Head_Face_Classic_Tights_04.description: A smooth, skin-tight full-head hood that leaves the face open. Three vertical stripes run over the forehead, and bold bands frame the brow and cheeks like a mask. It extends down the neck to a rounded collar edge.
Female/F_Head_Face_Classic_Tights_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood; colour 1 on the three forehead stripes; colour 2 on the brow and cheek band lines.

Female/F_Head_Face_Cosmic_01.description: A close-fitting sci-fi head covering that wraps the skull and neck, with a hexagonal emblem plate on the brow, a smooth face panel with eye openings, and angular trim lines running down the cheeks to the jaw.
Female/F_Head_Face_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, neck and hexagon plate with its trim; colour 1 on the brow band, side stripes and chin area; colour 2 on the face panel and the back and side bands.

Female/F_Head_Face_Cyberwire_01.description: A bare, hairless head with a cybernetic face: a contrasting band wraps around the eyes like a visor mask, and a separate panel covers the lower face from nose to chin, with thin seam lines at its edges.
Female/F_Head_Face_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell; colour 1 on the lower-face panel; colour 2 on the eye band; colour 3 on the thin seam lines along the panel edges.

Female/F_Head_Face_Cyborg_02.description: A bare, hairless head with a cyborg face: one side of the face is replaced by a mechanical metal plate with a hollow eye socket and a small inset panel at the cheek, with thin seam lines running across the scalp.
Female/F_Head_Face_Cyborg_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the small inset panel at the cheek; the skin and the metal faceplate largely ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Face_Deity_01.description: A smooth, hairless head covering with an elongated, tapering skull and neck that runs down to the collarbone. It has a jagged mask-like cutout that leaves the eyes, nose and mouth open, giving an alien, otherworldly look.
Female/F_Head_Face_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole smooth head and neck covering; the exposed face is skin and takes no colour slot.

Female/F_Head_Face_Fox_01.description: A full cartoon fox head with a pointed snout, contrasting nose, large angled eye holes, rounded ears and a toothy lower jaw. Fluffy fur covers the head, studded with rows of small leaf-shaped spikes over the crown and back.
Female/F_Head_Face_Fox_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the face, ears and head; colour 1 on the lower jaw and the spike tips; colour 2 on the nose and eye holes.

Female/F_Head_Face_Holoforce_01.description: A skin-tight full head and neck covering with a glossy face panel that has small oval eye openings, a broad band across the forehead, and stripes running down the neck. Sci-fi hologram look; the ears stay exposed.
Female/F_Head_Face_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, back of the head and neck edges; colour 1 on the forehead band and side neck panels; colour 2 on the glossy face panel and the ear-level side patches; colour 3 on the lips and the front neck stripe.

Female/F_Head_Face_Kigatilik_01.description: A bare-headed female face and skull with tribal-style painted markings: a bold diamond-shaped glyph on the forehead, curving lines around the eyes and cheeks, and a bracketed slash mark on each temple.
Female/F_Head_Face_Kigatilik_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the forehead glyph and temple slashes; colour 1 on the curved lines around the eyes and down the cheeks; the skin itself ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Face_Lycan_03.description: A bald, skin-toned head with a heavy wrinkled brow ridge, sunken contrasting eyes, pointed ears, flattened snarling nose and contrasting lips; a partial werewolf-like face with a smooth hairless skull.
Female/F_Head_Face_Lycan_03.colourAreas: The skin ignores the colour scheme and shows a fixed skin tone; the lips and eye shadow are fixed, with no visible use of colour slots 0-3.

Female/F_Head_Face_Mechanon.description: A full robotic helmet enclosing the whole head, with a smooth domed crown, contrasting angular eye and mouth openings, a circular ring emblem at the brow and a pointed chin guard that extends down over the neck.
Female/F_Head_Face_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, chin guard and back of the helmet; colour 1 on the side panels and stripes; colour 2 on the eye and mouth openings; colour 3 on the ring accent and the trim at the rear and neck.

Female/F_Head_Face_Mechanon_02.description: A full mechanical helmet enclosing the whole head: a smooth domed crown with a contrasting central ridge, a round lens port and small disc sensors on the face, angular side plates, and a chin guard. Robotic sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Head_Face_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main dome, face and chin; colour 0 on the side plates, back shell and disc sensors; colour 2 on the crown ridge and lens ring; colour 3 on the brow marking and rear neck panels.

Female/F_Head_Face_Noear_01.description: A bare humanoid head with a smooth, hairless, elongated rounded skull, no ears, a narrow chin and softly sculpted facial features including eyes and lips. It sits directly on the neck as a plain base head.
Female/F_Head_Face_Noear_01.colourAreas: The head is skin-toned and does not take the colour scheme; the eyes have their own fixed colouring.

Female/F_Head_Face_Punk_01.description: A bare, bald head with sculpted facial features and ears, ending in a short neck with a high collar-like band of trim at the base. A plain skin head type with no hair or accessories.
Female/F_Head_Face_Punk_01.colourAreas: The head is skin and ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 and colour 2 appear on the neck collar band at the base.

Female/F_Head_Face_Reactor_01.description: A bare, hairless head with a fitted neck ring collar at the base of the skull. The collar is slim and metallic-looking, with a small inner band showing at the front. Suits sci-fi tights looks.
Female/F_Head_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer neck collar; colour 1 on the inner band at the front of the collar; the head itself shows skin and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Face_Robotsamurai_01.description: A full-coverage robotic helmet with a smooth rounded dome, a fanged snarling mouth guard, small round ear discs and a neck sleeve that extends down to the collarbone; segmented panels wrap around the back of the head.
Female/F_Head_Face_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome centre stripe, face plates, ear discs and fangs; colour 1 on the side panels of the dome and the lower face and neck; colour 2 on the back band, temple panels and neck sleeve; colour 3 on the mouth interior.

Female/F_Head_Face_Rock_01.description: A full head replacement with a cracked, rocky skin texture: a network of fissures divides the face, scalp and neck into stone-like plates. The features are smooth, sculpted and slim, with lips shown as a separate tone.
Female/F_Head_Face_Rock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates of the head and neck; colour 3 on the crack lines and the neck; colour 1 on the lips.
Female/F_Head_Face_Rock_01.differs: The female head has a slimmer, more delicate face with defined coloured lips and wide crack lines, while the male has a heavy brow and thinner contrasting crack lines.

Female/F_Head_Face_Santabeer_01.description: A novelty Santa-style hat with a slouching cone crown, a thick furry brim and a pom-pom at the back, plus a drink can hung over each ear with thin tubes running down toward the mouth.
Female/F_Head_Face_Santabeer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hat crown; colour 2 on the fur brim and pom-pom; colour 0 on the drink cans; colour 3 on the tubes.

Female/F_Head_Face_Tight_Redbanner_01.description: A painted face head type: a smooth bare head with a face covered in a mask-like paint pattern, with heavy angular eye surrounds, small brow flourishes and a patch along the jaw and cheek. The rear and crown of the head stay bare skin.
Female/F_Head_Face_Tight_Redbanner_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the painted face area; colour 1 on the brow flourishes and jaw patch; colour 2 on the eye surrounds; the rest of the head shows skin, which is not part of the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Face_Valvee_01.description: A close-fitting superhero head covering: a smooth skull cap with panelled seams and a integrated eye mask with pointed wing-like edges and a nose bridge, bordered by a thin edging that dips to a point at the nape.
Female/F_Head_Face_Valvee_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull cap; colour 1 on the mask and the swooping stripes on the cap; colour 2 on the edging around the mask and the back hairline.

Female/F_Head_Facemask_01.description: A smooth, seamless skin-tight head covering that wraps the whole skull and neck, with openings cut around the eyes and the lower face so the mouth and chin stay bare. Plain, sleek and minimal, suited to superhero looks.
Female/F_Head_Facemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head covering; the exposed eyes, mouth and chin are the mannequin's own skin and take no slot.

Female/F_Head_Facemask_Valdia_01.description: A close-fitting superhero cowl covering the whole head with a smooth shell, a chevron-shaped stripe running over the crown, raised seam lines, small ear bulges and a pointed masked eye area with a separate lining, leaving the face open.
Female/F_Head_Facemask_Valdia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cowl shell; colour 1 on the mask lining around the eyes; colour 2 on the chevron stripe over the crown.

Female/F_Head_Facemask_Valhex_01.description: A close-fitting cloth superhero hood that covers the whole head and stops at the neck, with an open eye-and-nose mask cutout, a segmented ridge running over the crown, and outlined angular panel seams down the back.
Female/F_Head_Facemask_Valhex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood; colour 1 on the mask surround around the eyes; colour 2 on the outlining piping and the crown ridge segments.
Female/F_Head_Facemask_Valhex_01.differs: The female hood ends in a longer neck section that tapers to a point at the back of the neck.

Female/F_Head_Facemask_Valstar_01.description: A close-fitting superhero hood covering the whole head and neck, with a quilted panel seam pattern, a raised diamond-shaped panel running up the forehead and crown, and a bordered mask surround at the eyes. Nose, mouth and chin are left open.
Female/F_Head_Facemask_Valstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood and neck; colour 1 on the forehead panel and the eye-surround inlay; colour 2 on the borders around the panel and eye openings.

Female/F_Head_Fishangler_01.description: A full monstrous fish-head covering the whole head: smooth rounded skull with a vein-patterned crest, large glossy side-set eyes, and a wide gaping mouth lined with rows of needle-like teeth and a ridged lower jaw.
Female/F_Head_Fishangler_01.colourAreas: The piece shows mostly its own skin-toned texture, with little response to the scheme; the eyes and jaw rim show separate texture details, and the crest has a paler veined pattern.

Female/F_Head_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A full replacement head shaped like an axolotl: a smooth rounded head with a wide grinning mouth, glossy eyes and faint speckles, crowned by three feathery external gills that fan out on each side.
Female/F_Head_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head skin; colour 1 on the gill fronds; colour 3 on the gill tips and edges and on the eyes; colour 2 on the small neck slot under the chin.

Female/F_Head_Full_Falcon_02.description: A full-coverage falcon-themed helmet with a sharp downward beak, angular armored plates, swept-back crest feathers and small contrasting eye gems. A segmented plated collar extends down over the neck.
Female/F_Head_Full_Falcon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and neck plates; colour 1 on the beak and the crest feathers; colour 2 on the inner crest, eye surrounds and edge trim; colour 3 on the eye gems and side accents.

Female/F_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Full_01.description: A full werewolf head covering with a long snarling muzzle, bared teeth, pointed ears and a shaggy fur mane that hangs down the back of the neck; the mane reaches past the nape in a long, tapered fall.
Female/F_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Full_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur of the head and mane; colour 1 on the muzzle, cheek fur and streaks in the mane; colour 2 on the nose and mouth interior.
Female/F_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Full_01.differs: The female mane hangs longer and narrower down the back of the neck, while the male mane is shorter and bushier.

Female/F_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_01.description: A full werewolf head with a long snout, bared fangs, pointed ears and a shaggy mane of layered fur tufts sweeping back over the skull and down the neck; a contrasting-furred face suggests a feral monstrous look.
Female/F_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur mane and face fur; colour 1 on shading streaks within the fur tufts; the skin of the muzzle, nose and ears uses a fixed skin tone rather than the scheme.
Female/F_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_01.differs: The female version has fur covering the whole face, with only the nose and inner ears showing skin, and a shorter muzzle.

Female/F_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_02.description: A werewolf head with a shaggy, spiky fur mane swept back over the skull and down the nape, small horn-like tufts above the brow, pointed ears, a furred throat ruff, and a human-like face with a snarling mouth.
Female/F_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur; colour 1 on the streaky fur tips and shading in the mane; the face skin keeps its own tone and is not affected by the scheme.
Female/F_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_02.differs: The female head has a slimmer, more human face with a shorter, less bulky mane and no heavy muzzle or jaw.

Female/F_Head_Gadgetbot_01.description: A robotic full helmet with a rounded domed shell, contrasting side panels and contrasting stripes, a single protruding cyclops lens barrel over the face, a slim jaw guard, and a thin neck collar ring on a narrow neck.
Female/F_Head_Gadgetbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome shell and lens housing; colour 1 on the side panels, back module and neck ring; colour 2 on the stripes; colour 3 on the lens.
Female/F_Head_Gadgetbot_01.differs: The female helmet has a plain, narrow neck stem with a thin collar ring, while the male has a chunkier segmented neck piece.

Female/F_Head_Huge_Floatingbrain_01.description: A detached, floating brain with deeply folded, wrinkled surface hovering above the shoulders in place of a head, with a small contrasting neck collar plate and knob sitting at the neck base.
Female/F_Head_Huge_Floatingbrain_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brain; colour 2 on the neck plate and knob.

Female/F_Head_Huge_Floatingbrain_03.description: A head replacement in the form of a detailed, wrinkled human brain floating above the neck, with no face. It hovers over a small shallow collar cup that holds a ball at the neck base. Monstrous, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Head_Huge_Floatingbrain_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brain; colour 0 on the neck collar cup and ball.

Female/F_Head_Junkbot_01.description: A full-head replacement shaped like a boxy toaster: a rounded cuboid with two vertical slots in the face, a flat top with a small lever and a bolt, and a flat back panel. It sits on a thin collar ring over the neck.
Female/F_Head_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back panel, side panel and collar ring; colour 1 on the rounded front shell and neck tubes; colour 2 on the top plate and slot interiors; colour 3 on the lever and bolt head.

Female/F_Head_Junkbot_02.description: A retro CRT television worn as a full head replacement: a boxy rounded-edge casing with a bright static-like screen, side control knobs and a tapered back, perched on a thin cable-like neck stalk.
Female/F_Head_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front bezel, control panel and lower casing; colour 1 on the casing sides and knobs; colour 2 on the top and bottom edges; colour 3 on the corner edge strips. The screen shows its own picture.
Female/F_Head_Junkbot_02.differs: The female version has a thin neck of contrasting rods with a small ring collar, and its screen picture is a pixelated colour pattern.

Female/F_Head_Junkbot_03.description: A full-head retro television helmet: a boxy rounded-corner cabinet with a glowing static-filled screen on the front, two control dials and a speaker grille at the side, and a tapered back casing that covers the whole head.
Female/F_Head_Junkbot_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing, bezel and side panel; colour 1 on the large curved panels of the cabinet and the dials; colour 2 on the base and the vent slot at the back; colour 3 on the top corner panel. The screen image ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Head_Junkbot_03.differs: The screen shows a scrambled, glitchy static pattern instead of a clear cartoon cat with a rainbow.

Female/F_Head_Junkbot_Antenna_01.description: A small rounded cap-like plate sitting on top of the head, with two thin telescoping antennae angled outward in a V like rabbit-ear TV aerials. A quirky robot or retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Head_Junkbot_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap rim and antenna rods; colour 1 on the main cap panels and antenna segments; colour 2 on the front panel and antenna tips; colour 3 on the rear side panel.

Female/F_Head_Junkbot_Screen_01.description: A flat, slightly curved rectangular screen panel that sits across the eyes and upper face like a visor, floating in front of the head. It shows a glitchy, pixelated display and leaves the rest of the head bare.
Female/F_Head_Junkbot_Screen_01.colourAreas: The screen shows a fixed multicoloured glitch image that ignores the colour scheme; no colour slots are visible on it.
Female/F_Head_Junkbot_Screen_01.differs: The female screen displays a glitchy, pixelated static pattern instead of the male's cartoon picture.

Female/F_Head_Kitsune_01.description: A full fox-head replacement with tall pointed ears, a long tapering muzzle, a contrasting nose, fine whiskers, and swept cheek ruffs. contrasting swirl markings run over the brow and cheeks, and the neck is enclosed down to the shoulders.
Female/F_Head_Kitsune_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fur of the head, ears and neck; colour 1 on the muzzle and lower face as a fade; colour 0 on the brow and cheek markings and whiskers; colour 2 on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Lizard_02.description: A full lizard head replacing the human head: a smooth rounded skull with a scaly crest, small spikes along the brow and jaw, a wide toothy mouth with sharp fangs, and a small horn on the snout.
Female/F_Head_Lizard_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and scale patterning across the top and back of the head; the face skin, eyes, fangs and jaw and eye markings keep their own fixed textures and do not follow the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Mech_Mechrobot_01.description: A full mechanical robot helmet: a rounded domed shell with contrasting slit grooves and side panels, a skeletal jaw and teeth grille below, a cylindrical vent post on top, and a curved collar piece under the chin.
Female/F_Head_Mech_Mechrobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome shell and jaw; colour 1 on the side panels, top post, rear frame and chin collar; colour 2 on the grooves and joint gaps.
Female/F_Head_Mech_Mechrobot_01.differs: The female helmet has a hollow, skull-like face with no glowing eyes visible, while the male version shows eyes in the sockets.

Female/F_Head_Monster_Child_Vampire_Larg.description: A monstrous set of oversized fangs: a row of long pointed teeth sits at the mouth, and a second U-shaped row of spiky teeth hangs down over the chest. Suggests a vampire or beast maw.
Female/F_Head_Monster_Child_Vampire_Larg.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth and fangs; the other colour slots are not visibly used.

Female/F_Head_Monster_Pumpkin_01.description: A full pumpkin-shaped head covering with ribbed, rounded lobes, a curved stalk on top, and a carved jack-o'-lantern face with angry eyes and a jagged toothy grin. A neck piece below the chin links it to the body.
Female/F_Head_Monster_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pumpkin shell; colour 2 on the stalk; colour 3 on the eye and mouth interiors; colour 1 on the neck piece under the chin.

Female/F_Head_Monster_Snowman_01.description: A full snowman head: a rounded, lumpy snow-textured sphere with a long pointed carrot-like nose, small round studs for eyes and mouth, a wide-brimmed top hat with a band, and a flared collar-like neck piece that hangs down onto the chest.
Female/F_Head_Monster_Snowman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snowy head, hat and brim; colour 1 on the hat band and the eye and mouth studs; colour 2 on the nose; colour 3 on the neck piece.
Female/F_Head_Monster_Snowman_01.differs: The neck piece is a longer tongue-like flap hanging in front of the chest, and the face looks slightly narrower.

Female/F_Head_Monster_Vampire_01.description: A monstrous vampire head with a mostly human face and bald skull, but an elongated, gaunt jaw that hangs open with rows of sharp fangs and two long curved tusks; scarred, sunken cheeks add a gaunt look.
Female/F_Head_Monster_Vampire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and tusks; the skin, eyes and mouth interior ignore the colour scheme and keep their default look.
Female/F_Head_Monster_Vampire_01.differs: The female version keeps a human-shaped head and ears with a long stretched jaw, while the male has a bat-like face with large pointed ears and a flat snout.

Female/F_Head_Monster_Vampire_02.description: A monstrous bat-like vampire head: elongated bald skull, large pointed ears, flat slit nose, scowling brow and a wide mouth of jagged fangs over a separate jaw band. Covers the whole head and neck.
Female/F_Head_Monster_Vampire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the skin of the head and neck; colour 1 on the eyes; the teeth, jaw band and inner ears keep fixed textured shades not affected by the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Monster_Vampire_Large_01.description: A monstrous bat head with large pointed ears, a sunken flat nose and a long tapering snout. The wide-open jaw is lined with rows of sharp fangs. It replaces the whole head and ends in a short neck.
Female/F_Head_Monster_Vampire_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the fangs and teeth; the skin ignores the scheme and shows a fixed flesh tone; the ear interiors and nose are dark; the eyes are fixed.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Beak_02.description: A rounded eagle-beak mask covering the nose and mouth: a smooth upper beak curves down to a sharp hooked tip, with small nostril holes and a separate lower mandible tucked beneath. Suits bird-themed or monstrous looks.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Beak_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 1 on the lower mandible and the inner edges.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Beak_03.description: A long, pointed stork-like beak worn over the nose and mouth, with a smooth tapering upper bill, small nostril holes and a thin lower shell tucked beneath. Suits animal, bird-mask and plague-doctor looks.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Beak_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper bill; colour 1 on the lower shell and the inner edges of the beak.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Beak_04.description: A hooked owl-style beak worn over the nose and mouth: a rounded upper mandible curving to a downward point, small nostril holes on the sides, and a separate smaller lower mandible beneath.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Beak_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper mandible; colour 1 on the lower mandible and the underside edges.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Beak_05.description: A duck-bill mouth piece: a broad, flat, rounded beak that extends forward from the nose and mouth, with small nostril slits on top and thin flared edges at the cheeks. Suggests an animal or monstrous costume.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Beak_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper beak and sides, blending into colour 0 toward the tip and lower bill; colour 2 on the underside and inner edges.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_01.description: A pelican-style beak worn over the mouth and chin: a long pointed upper bill with nostril slits above a deep, pouch-like lower bill that hangs below the jaw. A fantasy animal mask piece.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pouch and sides of the bill; colour 0 on the ridge and tip of the upper bill and the lip edge.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_02.description: A bird-of-prey beak worn over the nose and mouth: a hooked upper beak ridged down the centre and tapering to a sharp downward point, with a separate lower mandible beneath. Small nostril holes mark the sides.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 1 on the lower mandible and the edges of the beak.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_03.description: A long, pointed stork-like beak worn over the nose and mouth, with a smooth curved upper bill, small nostril holes and a separate thin lower mandible panel tucked beneath. It gives a bird-headed, creature look.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper bill; colour 1 on the lower mandible and the thin edge flaps.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_03.differs: The lower mandible on the female version hangs lower and forms a deeper, wider V-shaped pouch under the chin.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_04.description: A hooked owl-style beak that covers the nose and mouth: a rounded upper mandible curving to a point, a smaller separate lower mandible beneath, and small nostril holes. Suggests a bird or beast-person face.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 1 on the lower mandible and underside edges of the beak.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_05.description: A flat, broad duck-bill beak that covers the nose and mouth and projects forward. It has small nostril slits near the top, a rounded tip and a smooth, slightly wrinkled surface, with flared edges at the cheeks. Suggests a cute animal or creature look.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper bill and nostril area; colour 0 on the lower bill and tip, with a smooth gradient between them. Colour 2 on the underside.

Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Krampus_01.description: A long monstrous tongue that hangs out of the mouth and down over the chin and neck, curling out at the lips and tapering to a curved tip. A partial head piece with a beastly, festive-demon feel.
Female/F_Head_Mouth_Child_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lip rim and the tip; colour 1 on the main body of the tongue; colour 2 on the upper top surface; colour 3 on the small marking patch.

Female/F_Head_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.description: A bare, hairless head with smooth skin and stylised face paint: swooping crescent marks above each eye and small pointed streaks beneath the eyes. It replaces the default head and suggests a demonic look.
Female/F_Head_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the under-eye streaks; colour 1 on the inner brow swoops; colour 2 on the outer crescent marks; skin tone is unaffected by the scheme.
Female/F_Head_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.differs: The female head has swooping crescent and streak face markings, while the male head is plain with no markings.

Female/F_Head_None.description: A small rounded cap-shaped plug that fills the neck opening at the base of the neck, with a thin raised rim. It is a head-type placeholder that leaves the head bare.

Female/F_Head_None_01.description: A small smooth neck-cap: a shallow rounded wedge that fills the neck opening at the top of the torso, giving a headless look. It is a plain cap with no other detail.
Female/F_Head_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole neck cap.
Female/F_Head_None_01.differs: The female version is a simple flat cap, while the male version is a raised rim with a small ball sitting in the middle.

Female/F_Head_Qularrhead_01.description: A full insect-head covering with a pointed, swept-back carapace crest, wide flared cheek plates, large round eyes, mandible-like fangs at the mouth and thin whisker antennae. Speckled spots cover the shell, and stepped ridged plates run down the back.
Female/F_Head_Qularrhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and ridged back plates; colour 1 on the spots, eyes and fang tips; colour 3 on the side sacs by the mandibles and the mouth; colour 2 on the shadowed shading around the face.

Female/F_Head_Robot_Steampunk_01.description: A full robotic head covering with a smooth domed cranium, large round bulbous eye lenses, a snout-like breathing mask with side canisters, small side antenna studs, and a flared high neck collar that sits over the shoulders.
Female/F_Head_Robot_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, plating and canisters; colour 1 on the stripes, eye housings, mask and neck collar; colour 3 on the eye lenses and antenna tips.
Female/F_Head_Robot_Steampunk_01.differs: The female stripes on the cranium are narrower and the collar is slimmer and lower at the sides.

Female/F_Head_Scarab_01.description: A full insect-like helmet with a flared bell-shaped rear rim, angular eye lenses and a contrasting toothy mouth grille. A tall curved central spine rises from the crown and forks into two backward-curving horns.
Female/F_Head_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and spine; colour 3 on the eye lenses; colour 2 on the horn tips and mouth grille; colour 1 on the neck collar beneath the helmet.

Female/F_Head_Scarab_02.description: A full-coverage insect-like helmet with angular layered plates, narrow slanted eye openings and a pointed lower face guard. Two tall segmented horns curve upward from the temples, and a neck collar sits below.
Female/F_Head_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and horn bases; colour 1 on the lower horn segments and neck collar; colour 2 on the middle horn segments and mouth area; colour 3 on the eye lenses and horn tips.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Bear_02.description: A full-head bear skull replacing the head: long tapered snout, flared cheek arches, open jaw with pointed fangs, and an exposed vertebral spine running down the back to a flat collar plate at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Bear_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, jaw and collar plate; colour 1 on the spine vertebrae; colour 3 on the fangs; colour 2 on the back teeth.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Crocodile_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a crocodile skull: a long toothed snout, hollow eye sockets and flared bony ridges at the back, perched on an exposed vertebrae neck with a small collar plate.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Crocodile_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, jaw and teeth; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae; the small neck plate takes colour 0.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Deer_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a deer skull with a long snout, eye sockets and a pair of large branching antlers, resting on an exposed segmented spine that forms the neck. Bestial, macabre fantasy look.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Deer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 3 on the antlers; colour 1 on the exposed neck vertebrae.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Horse_02.description: A full-head horse skull replacing the head: long tapered muzzle with nostril holes, visible teeth line and eye sockets, and a row of vertebra-like spikes running down the back of the skull to a thin collar plate at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Horse_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and neck collar plate; colour 1 on the row of spinal spikes down the back.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Hyena_02.description: A full hyena skull head replacing the head: long muzzle, open jaw with rows of small teeth and large fangs, flared cheekbone arches, and a segmented vertebra column at the back with a small collar plate at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Hyena_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, jaw and collar plate; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae; colour 3 on the small teeth; colour 2 on the large fangs.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Hyena_02.differs: The female skull has a contrasting vertebra spine visible inside the throat under the jaw and a smaller, narrower collar plate at the neck.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Lizard_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a lizard skull, with hollow eye sockets, a toothy jaw and bony spikes radiating around the crown and cheeks. A short ringed vertebrae-like neck column supports it.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Lizard_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, spikes and jaw; colour 1 on the ringed neck vertebrae.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Raptor_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a raptor dinosaur skull: long open-boned snout, large eye and skull-side openings, rows of sharp teeth, and an exposed vertebral spine at the neck above a thin flat collar plate.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Raptor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, jaw and collar plate; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae; teeth appear and follow no visible slot.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Raptor_02.differs: The female collar plate is a smaller, narrower flat disc than the male one, and the jaw looks slightly more closed.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Rat_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a rodent skull, with long buck teeth, hollow eye sockets, flared cheek arches and a separate lower jaw, sitting on an exposed vertebrae neck with a small flat collar plate at the base.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Rat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and jaw; colour 1 on the spine vertebrae of the neck; colour 2 on the tips of the teeth and the hollows inside the skull.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Rat_02.differs: The female neck plate is a small, narrow collar tucked close under the jaw, and the vertebrae are set more upright.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Skeleton_02.description: A full skeleton-skull head replacing the face: rounded cranium, hollow eye sockets, exposed teeth with a jagged grin, a separate jaw and a short visible spine column at the neck, with a flat collar ring at the base.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull bone; colour 1 on the eye sockets and shading in the bone hollows; colour 3 on the teeth; colour 2 on the neck collar ring.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Tiger_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a tiger skull, with a long muzzle, open eye sockets, flared cheek arches and bared fangs. An exposed spine of vertebrae runs down the back into the neck.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Tiger_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and jaw bone; colour 1 on the vertebrae of the neck; colour 3 on the fangs and inside the mouth.

Female/F_Head_Skull_Wolf_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a wolf skull with an elongated snout, open jaw with sharp fangs, small ridges and flared bone plates at the back, and an exposed vertebrae neck with a thin collar plate.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull bone and collar plate; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae; colour 3 on the eye sockets and nose area; colour 2 on the teeth.
Female/F_Head_Skull_Wolf_02.differs: The collar plate at the neck base is a small sliver, and the skull is set slightly higher on a longer neck.

Female/F_Head_Sockpuppet_01.description: A whimsical sock-puppet head: a knit tube that covers the whole head and neck, with a long beaked snout and open mouth, button eyes, yarn-like tufts on top, and a rolled contrasting trim at the neck opening.
Female/F_Head_Sockpuppet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knit body, snout and yarn tufts; colour 1 on the neck-edge trim, the eye patch and the ribbon-like bands on top of the head.

Female/F_Head_Steelarachnid_01.description: A smooth, egg-shaped full helmet covering the whole head with a blank faceplate. Rows of slanted chevron slits sit across the front, and hexagonal plates are mounted over each ear. A sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Head_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the slits in the faceplate; colour 2 on the ear plates and the lower edge trim.

Female/F_Head_Steelcommando_01.description: A full-coverage retro helmet with a smooth rounded shell and raised seam lines, a wide T-shaped visor opening with a recessed face plate, and a tall pointed metal neck guard that flares over the shoulders.
Female/F_Head_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the helmet shell and face plate; colour 0 on the neck guard; colour 2 on the recessed side panels and visor surround.
Female/F_Head_Steelcommando_01.differs: The female neck guard is narrower and more sharply pointed at the front and back, with a tighter collar shape.

Female/F_Head_Teddy_02.description: A full-head plush teddy bear mask: a rounded, quilted-texture head with two round ears edged in zigzag stitching, a raised snout with a small triangular nose and two bead eyes. It encloses the whole head.
Female/F_Head_Teddy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head and outer ears; colour 1 on the snout and inner ears; colour 3 on the eyes and nose; colour 2 on the stitching.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.description: A full bear-head covering with a snarling muzzle, bared teeth, small rounded ears and a shaggy fur mane that drapes down the back of the head and neck to the shoulders, giving a feral monstrous look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head and mane; colour 3 on the patches around the eyes and brow and the inner ears; colour 2 on the nose; colour 1 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Bear_03.description: A full bear head covering with a rounded muzzle, contrasting nose, small round ears and layered shaggy fur tufts that fall in jagged points around the neck and down the back of the head.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Bear_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur and ears; colour 1 on the fur across the forehead, brow and muzzle; colour 2 on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Boar_02.description: A full boar head replacing the wearer's own: a long blunt snout with wide nostrils, small pointed ears, curved tusks rising from the lower jaw, and a spotted skin pattern that runs down the thick neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Boar_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tusks; colour 1 on the nostrils and eyes; the skin takes a fixed flesh tone with spots that does not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_01.description: A full feline head covering with a sculpted cat face, pointed ears, snarling muzzle with long sabre fangs, and swept-back spiky whisker fins on each cheek. It fits tightly over the whole head, suiting beast or monstrous characters.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head and fur surfaces and cheek spikes; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 3 on the nose; the inner ears, fangs and mouth appear to keep fixed shading.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_02.description: A full tiger head covering that replaces the human head: a snarling feline face with rounded ears, fur tufts at the cheeks, contrasting whiskers, bared teeth and a striped pattern running over the crown and down the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the nose bridge, crown, back of the head and neck; colour 1 on the cheeks, muzzle, ears and inner face; colour 2 on the stripes and eyes; colour 0 on the whiskers and teeth.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_03.description: A full lion head replacing the wearer's own: a broad feline face with a short muzzle, small rounded ears and a thick, layered mane that flows down past the shoulders in long streaked locks.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the face and ears; colour 0 on the mane; colour 1 on streaks in the mane and on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Tiger_01.description: A set of bestial tiger-like teeth: rows of sharp conical fangs and teeth across the mouth, with two tall thick tusks at the corners. It sits over the lips and gives a monstrous, feral look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Tiger_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and fangs; the other colour slots are not clearly visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Werewolf.description: A pair of tall, curved pointed ears or horn-like spikes rising from the sides of the head, each with a broad flared base that sweeps up into a sharp tip and a lined inner face. Beastly and monstrous in style.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Werewolf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the spikes; colour 3 on the inner faces and the fur-like panels at the base.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Wolf_Mou.description: A monstrous wolf-like open jaw worn around the mouth and chin, with angular upper and lower jaw plates lined with rows of sharp fangs and a contrasting inner mouth panel, giving a snarling beast look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Wolf_Mou.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jaw plates and bone-like edges; colour 1 on the teeth; colour 2 on the inner mouth panel and the darker jaw hinge tips.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Chimera_01.description: A full bird-like head covering with a hooked beak, sculpted brow and eyes, and a tall crest of layered feather-like spikes running from forehead to nape, fanning out to the sides. Monstrous, avian look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head and face skin; colour 0 on the beak and the crest feathers; colour 1 on the crest tips and the spiked ridge down the back.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_01.description: A monstrous full-head replacement: a skull-like face with cracked, vein-networked skin, a jagged tusked jaw, and a crest of rough spiky plates sweeping back over the crown and skull.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cracked face and head skin; colour 3 on the vein-like crack lines; colour 1 on the spiky crest plates and small tooth-like accents around the mouth.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_01.differs: The female version has a slightly smaller, narrower head with a taller crest and shorter jaw tusks.
