Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_02.description: A tight, full-head monstrous helm-like head type with a smooth swept-back crest, a pointed beak-like snout with small eye holes, and a cracked, cobbled plated skin covering the sides, back and neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the smooth crest and upper head shell; colour 0 on the cobbled plates of the face sides, beak and neck; colour 3 on the crack lines between plates.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Lycan_03.description: A full werewolf head replacing the human head: a smooth skinned canine skull with a long snarling muzzle, bared fangs, tall pointed upright ears with contrasting interiors, a heavy brow and a neck that blends into the shoulders.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Lycan_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the skin of the whole head and ears; the teeth and eyes keep their own fixed look and do not follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Otter_02.description: A full otter head that replaces the wearer's own, with a smooth rounded skull, small side ears, a short tapered muzzle, a broad nose, eyes with lids and thin contrasting whiskers. The fur is short and finely textured, and the neck tapers down to the collar.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Otter_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fur covering the head and neck; colour 1 on the nose and eyelids; colour 0 on the whiskers.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Rat_01.description: A full rat head replacing the wearer's own: a tapering snout with a rounded nose, whiskers, bared teeth, a furrowed brow, and two rounded upright ears. Skin-like texture with a fur-like finish; it covers the whole head down to the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Rat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head and ear surfaces; colour 3 on the nose and brow areas; colour 1 on the eyes; the teeth and inner mouth keep fixed default shading.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Greatwhi.description: A full replacement head shaped like a great contrasting shark: a tapering snout, small side-set eyes, gill-like creases along the cheeks and a toothy underslung mouth, with a smooth skin-like surface that sits directly on the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Greatwhi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and snout; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the mouth interior and gill-crease shading; the teeth show a fixed shade.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Hammerhe.description: A full hammerhead shark head: a tall swept-back dorsal fin rises over the crown, a wide T-shaped crossbar extends sideways with an eye at each tip, and a toothy mouth sits below on the face.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Hammerhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin-like head and crossbar; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 0 and colour 2 on the teeth and mouth area.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Reef_01.description: A full shark-head replacement with a tapering hammer-like snout, a swept-back dorsal fin crest, small round eyes, gill-like creases and a wide toothy jaw with a separate lower panel. Monstrous aquatic look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Reef_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and fin; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the jaw and mouth interior; teeth show detail that does not follow the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Skull_Bird_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a bird skull, with a long pointed beak, open fenestrations along the beak, hollow eye sockets and a rounded cranium. An exposed vertebrae-like spine column runs down the neck. Monstrous, macabre look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Skull_Bird_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, beak and cranium; colour 3 on the inside of the eye sockets; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Skull_Cat_02.description: A full head replacement shaped like a feline skull, with wide cheekbone arches, hollow eye sockets, a short snout and exposed teeth, plus a segmented spine that trails down the back of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Skull_Cat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and jaw; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae; colour 3 on the gums around the teeth; colour 2 on the teeth and some inner details.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Squid_01.description: A tight, full-head cephalopod mask: a smooth domed cranium with ridged brow and a face of long tentacles hanging over the chin, with shorter tentacles flaring at the sides and back of the neck. Suggests an eldritch horror.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Squid_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main head shell and tentacles; colour 0 on the ridged facial markings and tentacle undersides; colour 1 on the neck collar ring beneath the head.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Squid_01.differs: The female version has a slightly shorter, tighter fall of tentacles at the front and back of the neck.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Stag_01.description: A full animal head with a long tapering muzzle, furrowed brow, bared teeth and two upright pointed ears with inner ear detail. It replaces the head and continues down the neck, for a monstrous beast look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Stag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head skin and outer ears; colour 3 on the brow, cheeks, muzzle and neck; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the nose.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Vulture_01.description: A full vulture head replacing the wearer's own: a wrinkled, rounded skull with heavy brows, round side-set eyes and a large hooked, open beak, ending in a short neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Vulture_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrinkled head and neck skin; colour 2 on the hooked beak; colour 1 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Werewolf_01.description: A full werewolf head with a long tapered snout, tall pointed ears and a shaggy fur ruff that spills over the neck and shoulders. Jagged teeth show along the muzzle, and the fur has a ragged, feral look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head and outer ears; colour 2 on the muzzle and the fur tips; colour 1 on the nose, brow tufts and lower jaw fur; colour 3 on the inner ears and jaw edging.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Werewolf_01.differs: The female head has a plain face without contrasting patches around the eyes, while the male has contrasting fur markings around the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Whiterhino_01.description: A full rhinoceros head replacing the wearer's own: wrinkled, folded skin, small rounded ears, a heavy brow and blunt muzzle, with a large horn on the nose and a smaller horn behind it.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Whiterhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to have no visible effect on the head; the skin keeps its own tone from the default material; colour 1 on the two horns, fading toward the base.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.description: A full wolf head with a long tapered snout, pointed upright ears with inner ear lining, and a shaggy mane of jagged fur locks falling to the neck and shoulders. The mouth is slightly open, showing teeth.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head, ears and mane; colour 2 on the darkened mane tips and nose; the muzzle skin, inner ears and teeth take their own fixed tones.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.differs: The female wolf has a slightly softer, closed-looking muzzle with a calmer expression and a tidier mane.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.description: A full wolf head replacing the human head, with a long snout, snarling toothy mouth, angry brow and tall pointed ears. Layered shaggy fur locks hang past the jaw and down the back of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head fur and mane; colour 2 on the darker tips of the mane locks; colour 3 on the inner ears and muzzle skin; colour 1 on the nose and eyes.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.differs: The female mane hangs in shorter, thinner locks that frame the jaw, and the mouth is closed with a tighter snarl. The male has a wide open, toothy mouth and a longer mane.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Alt_01.description: A full wolf head replacing the face: tall pointed ears, a long tapered snout with a nose tip, a snarling toothed mouth, and a shaggy mane of jagged tufts falling past the jaw and down the back of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head and ears; colour 1 on the nose and teeth accents; colour 2 on the darker tips of the mane; colour 3 on the inner ears and snout skin.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Alt_01.differs: The female mane is shorter and sits closer to the neck, with a smaller, less ragged fringe than the male version.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_01.description: A wolf head replacing the wearer's own: long pointed snout with visible teeth, tall upright ears, and a shaggy mane of jagged tapering fur locks that hangs past the neck to the shoulders.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head, ears and mane; colour 2 on the darker tips of the mane and the nose; the inner ears and muzzle skin are unaffected by the scheme.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_01.differs: The female wolf has a longer, narrower snout with a more closed mouth and a neater, less shaggy face.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_02.description: A full wolf head with a snarling open mouth, bared teeth, pointed upright ears with inner lining, and a shaggy mane of jagged fur tufts falling past the neck to the shoulders. Fits tightly over the whole head.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur and outer ears; colour 2 on the darker tips of the fur tufts and the nose; colour 3 on the inner ears, muzzle skin and mouth; colour 1 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Bucket_01.description: A full robotic head shell shaped like a rounded bucket, with two protruding lens sockets for eyes, a thin seam for a mouth, valve-wheel knobs on each side and a ring of piston-like rods at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Bucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and top panel; colour 1 on the side valve wheels and small eye details; colour 3 on the mouth seam and one eye lens; colour 2 on the neck rods and base.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Bucket_01.differs: The neck collar is a solid flanged ring with a cluster of rods behind, rather than the separate open hoop of spaced rods on the male.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Camera_02.description: A whimsical vintage film-camera head: a boxy housing covers the whole head, with a flared square lens hood at the front, twin film reels on top and a hand crank on the side, mounted on a thin wired neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Camera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the camera body and lens hood; colour 1 on the lens barrel rings, crank handle and side panel details; colour 2 on the film reels and cables; colour 3 on the lens glass and the small round lights.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Boar_02.description: A pair of large curved tusks that join at a small point under the chin and sweep up along each side of the face, ending in sharp tips near eye level. Suggests a beast or boar-like look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Boar_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tusks; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Cat_02.description: A set of thin, curved cat whiskers fanning out in two clusters from either side of the muzzle area, each with several slender tapered strands. A cute animal-style face accessory that leaves the rest of the head bare.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Cat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the whisker strands; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Cat_03.description: A shoulder-length lion-mane hairstyle of thick, streaky layered locks that frame the face like a hood, sweeping back from the crown and flaring into a full beard-like ruff around the cheeks and chin, ending in pointed tufts.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Cat_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the streaks and shading through the locks; a faint touch of colour 3 near the crown parting.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Kitty_02.description: A set of thin, curved cat whiskers fanning out in two clusters from either side of the upper lip and muzzle area. Slender and delicate, they add a playful feline touch to the face.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Kitty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Otter_01.description: A pair of thin, curved whisker clusters that fan out from either side of the nose and upper lip, each with several fine crossing strands. Only the whiskers are added; the head and face are unchanged.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Otter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Rabbit_0.description: Two sets of thin, curved whisker strands that fan outward from either side of the muzzle area of the face, like a rabbit's or cat's whiskers. It is a small animal-style face accessory with no other head covering.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Rabbit_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whisker strands; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Camera_02.description: A small cylindrical spotlight lamp perched on top of the head, its round lens facing forward, held by a thin strap under the chin area and trailing a few cables from the rear.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Camera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lamp housing and rim; colour 3 on the front lens; colour 2 on the strap; colour 1 on the cables at the back.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Side_Camera_02.description: A novelty head attachment of two film reels mounted side by side on a bracket at one side of the head, with a strip of film looped between them and a hand crank sticking out on the opposite side.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Child_Side_Camera_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the reel discs; colour 0 on the film strip between the reels; colour 1 on the hand crank and the axle pins.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Cyberlord_01.description: A full mechanical helmet enclosing the whole head, with a smooth faceplate and a broad central band running over the top and down the face, a small round sensor at the brow, panelled side plates with circular ear discs, and exposed tubes and cables at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Cyberlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell, panel seams and the neck ring; colour 1 on the central face band, the top strip and the side discs; colour 3 on the brow sensor and the neck cables; colour 2 on the seam lines.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Cyborg_01.description: A full head covering in a cyborg style: a smooth faceplate with narrow eye slits and a thin mouth line, a segmented cap of panels across the crown and temples, and a band wrapping around the back of the head.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Cyborg_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceplate; colour 2 on the crown panels and the band around the back; colour 0 on the side and rear plates and the neck; colour 3 on the eye slits.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Cyborg_Dummy_01.description: A smooth, mannequin-like robotic head with a blank sculpted face, segmented back shell with small bolts, crash-test-dummy marker plates on each side, and a ribbed neck column with cables and banded collar rings.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Cyborg_Dummy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell; colour 1 on the neck rings and collar bands; colour 2 on the neck segments; colour 3 on the neck cables. The side marker plates use a fixed yellow-and-pattern that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Djmadbot_01.description: A cartoonish retro-robot head: a rounded cube covering the whole head, with spiral-pattern round eyes, a small triangular nose, a grille-like toothed mouth, and a stacked round button or beacon on top.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Djmadbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cube head; colour 0 on the eye rims, nose and mouth grille; colour 2 on the eye spirals; colour 3 on the top beacon and the neck piece.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Domeemperyan_01.description: A smooth, egg-shaped full helmet that covers the whole head with no openings, decorated with etched circuit-like panel lines, raised plates across the face and a domed crown. It reads as a sleek sci-fi tech helmet.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Domeemperyan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 3 on the domed crown, face panels and thin outline stripes; colour 1 on the small bracket marks and ring.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Domeemperyan_01_1.description: A smooth, egg-shaped full-head mask with a painted toy-soldier face: arched brows, round eyes, a curled moustache and a segmented grille mouth. A separate cap panel covers the crown and back of the head.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Domeemperyan_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face and lower back of the head; colour 1 on the top cap, brows and moustache; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth grille lines; colour 2 on the pupils and mouth interior.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Exartdecofull_01.description: A smooth, full-coverage helmet with a rounded egg-shaped shell, a central panel running front to back, and two thin eye slits with a vertical seam down the face. Side and rear panels wrap the head, with a flared band at the base of the skull.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Exartdecofull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central face and crown panel; colour 1 on the side and rear panels and neck band; colour 2 on the seam lines and eye slits. The neck area is the mannequin's own neck, not part of the piece.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Anniversary_Iro.description: A bald, smooth head type with a stern, angular face, pointed ears and three raised curved ridges across the brow. It covers the whole head and neck as skin, with no hair.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Anniversary_Iro.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skin of the whole head and neck; colour 1 on the brow ridges, and on the lips and eye areas.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Anniversary_Iro.differs: The female head has a darker, glossier skin finish and tinted lips and eyes, while the brow ridges are less prominent.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Big_Mouth_01.description: A monstrous head covering with skin-like texture, veined markings across the scalp and a huge vertical maw stretched down the face, filled with rows of sharp fangs; the jaw is banded with contrasting stripes.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Big_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin-like head surface; colour 1 on the stripes along the jaw; colour 2 on the vein markings and mouth interior; the teeth ignore the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Birdpeople_01.description: A full bird-head covering with layered feather plumage over the face, neck and back of the head, a spiky feather crest, a curved beak, and a smooth helmet-like faceplate with a rimmed edge over the brow.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the feathers; colour 0 on the smooth faceplate and beak; colour 2 on the rim around the faceplate.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Clockwork_Armor.description: A tight, full-coverage robotic helmet with a smooth faceplate, angular side cheek plates, and swept fin-like crests at the top rear. A neck section runs down to the collar, with a contrasting open panel at the back of the head.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Clockwork_Armor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, crests and cheek plates; colour 1 on the faceplate stripe, side flaps and neck; colour 3 on the lower face panel and neck stripe; colour 2 on the back panel.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Clockwork_Armor.differs: The female helmet has a light faceplate with a contrasting and contrasting stripe across the front, while the male version has a contrasting visor-like front panel.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Edgy_01.description: A skin-tight face covering painted onto the head, leaving the scalp bare. A diagonal edge runs across one eye to the jaw, with thin bordering stripes and a separate band under the chin, giving an edgy masked look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Edgy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face panel; colour 1 on the border stripes and chin band; colour 2 on the outer edge lines and under-jaw shading.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Edgy_01.differs: The main face panel is the light colour (colour 0) with contrasting edging, whereas the male has a contrasting main panel with a light outline.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Noseless_01.description: A bare, hairless head with a smooth skin-toned surface, and a flat, nose-free face with only a faint ridge where the nose would be. Eyes, lips and ears are modelled; the head has a slim neck and a rounded skull.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Noseless_01.colourAreas: The skin tone ignores the colour scheme; none of the colour slots is visibly used on this head.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Simian_01.description: A bald ape-like head with a smooth domed skull, heavy brow ridge, flat broad nose, protruding muzzle and thin lips. The face is a separate contrasting tone from the skull, with small ears and a tapered neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Simian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, brow and neck; the face, ears and lips keep their own skin-like tone, and the eyes show a fixed blue.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Skull_01.description: A full skull head replacing the face: smooth domed cranium, deep eye sockets with glowing rims, exposed teeth and jaw, and a visible spine of stacked vertebrae for the neck, ending at a small skin-toned collar.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and vertebrae; colour 1 on the glowing rims inside the eye sockets; the small orange neckline is skin, not part of the colour scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Skull_02.description: A skull-face head type with a smooth close-cropped cranium, hollow angular eye sockets, a ridged nose cavity and a bared toothed jaw, continuing into a bare neck. Gives the wearer a skeletal, macabre look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone of the face and jaw; colour 2 on the crown of the skull; colour 1 on the eyes and teeth; the neck shows skin.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_01.description: A monstrous vampire head: bald, smooth skull with large pointed bat-like ears, sunken eyes, a flattened skull-like nose, gaunt cheeks and a small fanged mouth, with ribbed inner ear detail.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 mostly ignored; the skin shows its own tone across the head and ears; colour 1 on the ribbed inner ears and eyes.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_01.differs: The female head has a smoother, less deformed face with no protruding fangs and plain ear interiors that read as contrasting ribbing.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_02.description: A monstrous bat-like vampire head with a bald tapering skull, tall pointed ears with ridged inner surfaces, deep-set eyes, a sunken flattened nose and a snarling mouth with small fangs.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and ears; colour 1 on the eyes; the ridged inner ears show a separate texture that ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_02.differs: The female head has a plainer, more sunken face with a small snout, and no coloured nose or prominent large fangs.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_03.description: A bare-skinned bald head with a snarling, scowling vampire face, bared teeth, and large pointed ears that sweep up and outward. Smooth, sleek scalp with no hair; suits a monstrous or gothic vampire look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and ears; colour 1 on the eyes; the inner ear shading and lips follow the skin tone.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_03.differs: This version has a smoother, younger-looking face with a milder scowl and plain inner ears, while the male has deeply wrinkled, gaunt features.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_01.description: A tight, bald monstrous head covering that sculpts a gaunt, alien-looking face: sunken eyes, a flattened pointed nose, thin lips, and large ribbed bat-like ears at the sides. It blends into the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed inner ears; the skin-toned head and face do not follow the colour scheme.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_01.differs: The female version has smoother, plainer features and no visible fangs, with contrasting ears rather than contrasting ones.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_02.description: A tight, skin-like monstrous head covering: a smooth bald skull with sunken, shadowed eye sockets, a flattened bat-like nose, ridged cheeks and a small grim mouth. Fits close to the head and neck with a vampiric look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_02.colourAreas: Colour slots mostly don't show; the skin-toned surface ignores the scheme. Colour 1 appears on the irises.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_02.differs: The female version has a smoother, less detailed mouth with no visible fangs and no coloured nose; the male has prominent fangs and a coloured nose.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_03.description: A bald, skin-tight monstrous head with a smooth rounded skull, heavy scowling brow ridges, sunken cheek creases and a pinched mouth, running down into a narrow neck. Suggests a gaunt vampire or ghoul.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_03.colourAreas: Skin tone follows the default head material and does not take the colour scheme; colour 1 on the eyes.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_03.differs: The female head has a smoother, more delicate face with milder creases and a narrower jaw, whereas the male's is more deeply wrinkled and gnarled.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_01.description: A bald, bare-skin head sculpt with a zombie face: deep wrinkles across the brow, sunken glowing eye sockets, and a decayed, blotchy jaw and cheek area around exposed bared teeth. Covers the head and neck only.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_01.colourAreas: The skin ignores the colour scheme and keeps its own skin tone; the decay patches, eyes and teeth also keep fixed default looks.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Halfskul.description: A bald, skin-toned head with a decayed zombie face: one side is rotted with wrinkled, stained flesh, while the other half of the face and skull is exposed bone with a visible eye socket, cheekbone and bare teeth.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Halfskul.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the exposed skull bone; colour 1 on the ragged edge where flesh meets bone; colour 2 on the stained, decayed patches of flesh. The skin itself ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nohead_0.description: A headless zombie neck stump: a short skin-toned neck ends in a ragged, torn contrasting flesh top, with a bony spine of stacked vertebrae sticking up from the centre. Gruesome horror style sitting where the head would be.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nohead_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spine vertebrae; colour 2 on the torn ragged top edge and fringe; the neck stump keeps its fixed skin tone regardless of the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nojaw_01.description: A bald zombie head with deeply wrinkled brow, sunken glowing eyes and a ragged, decayed lower face where the jaw is missing, leaving tattered contrasting strands hanging below the mouth.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nojaw_01.colourAreas: Skin tone is fixed and ignores the scheme; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the ragged decayed mouth and jaw strands.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nojaw_01.differs: The female version has a narrower, more tapered chin and the ragged jaw area is shorter and less full than the male one.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Partialm.description: A skin-tight zombie head covering with wrinkled brow ridges, sunken eye sockets and a decayed lower face showing exposed flesh and teeth, with torn patches of rotting skin scattered over the scalp and cheeks.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Partialm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth head covering; the flesh patches, eyes and teeth show fixed texture colours that ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting full helmet that covers the whole head down to the neck, with a separate central crown stripe and a broad face panel over the lower face. Clean, sleek lines suggest a superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 2 on the central crown and back stripe; colour 1 on the lower face panel.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Alien_01.description: A close-fitting full-coverage sci-fi helmet with a smooth domed crown, angular faceted cheek plates, a raised contrasting brow ridge with diamond and round inset lights, a lower face guard, and chevron-banded panels at the back and neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, cheek plates and back chevron bands; colour 1 on the side and neck panels; colour 2 on the brow ridge, centre strip and lower face guard; colour 3 on the diamond and round inset lights.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Dino_01.description: A full-coverage armoured helmet shaped like a dinosaur head, with a long snout, toothed maw, round side eyes, two tall horn spikes on the crown and a segmented neck guard at the back.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Dino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, neck guard and horns; colour 1 on the snout and cheek panels; colour 3 on the teeth and mouth interior; colour 2 on the eye rings.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Holohex_01.description: A close-fitting full helmet with a smooth rounded shell divided into vertical panels, a wide glossy wraparound visor band with side pods over the ears, and a angular faceplate ending in a chin guard. Sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the centre stripe and faceplate; colour 1 on the side shell panels; colour 2 on the visor band and side pods; colour 3 on the small cheek accents.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Symbiote_01.description: A full helmet with a sleek, pointed faceplate that tapers to a chin point, a segmented crest ridge over the brow, and wide winged panels flaring out to each side above the ears. Angular alien-armor styling.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceplate and rear panel; colour 1 on the crest, side wing tips and ear pods; colour 2 on the top plates and the neck section; colour 3 on the eye slits.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Symbiote_01.differs: The female helmet has wide, flat wings that sit high above the face and a contrasting neck section, while the male has a contrasting face frame and the wings are smaller.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelmdestroyer_01.description: A full-coverage helmet with a smooth, slightly rippled shell that covers the whole head and comes down to a point over the chin, leaving only a narrow eye slit. A raised centre ridge and cross bands wrap around the back and sides.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelmdestroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the raised ridge and cross bands; colour 3 on the eyes visible in the slit.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelmviper_01.description: A smooth, rounded full-coverage helmet with a large solid face plate that ends in a V-shaped point at the brow. A contrasting stripe runs over the crown, there are small vented panels at the sides, and a trim band circles the base of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelmviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the central crown stripe; colour 3 on the face plate and the neck band; colour 1 shows only on the mannequin neck, not on the helmet.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelmviper_02.description: A sleek full-face helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a wide central stripe running front to back that ends in two small horn-like points at the rear, a large smooth visor panel and side vents with small light strips.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Fullhelmviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 2 on the central stripe and side panels; colour 3 on the visor panel and the rim around the neck opening; colour 1 on the small side light strips.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A full toad-like head replacing the normal head: a broad, rounded, warty skull with heavy brow ridges, a wide flat mouth line, a baggy throat pouch under the jaw, and small speckled bumps across the top and back.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skin of the head; colour 0 on the speckled warts; colour 1 on the throat pouch and lower jaw.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Golden_Age_Mask_01.description: A close-fitting cloth cowl covering the whole head, with two pointed cat-like ears on top, a wide eye-mask band with cutout eye openings, and thin piping lines running over the crown and down the back. Retro superhero style.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Golden_Age_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cowl; colour 1 on the eye-mask band; colour 3 on the piping lines and the edge outlines; colour 2 on the ears.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Grondling_01.description: A monstrous bald head type with a smooth elongated skull, heavy brow ridges, glossy round contrasting eyes and a wide fanged mouth. Small curved hooks project from the jaw at each side. Suits alien or brutish creature characters.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Grondling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyes; colour 1 on the jaw hooks and inner mouth; the skin-tone head surface does not follow the colour scheme.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Grondling_01.differs: The female head is narrower with a slimmer jaw and a more sloped, elongated skull.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Horsehead_01.description: A full cartoon horse head that replaces the whole head: a long tapered muzzle with flared nostrils and visible teeth, large round side-set eyes, a stripe down the face, and pointed upright ears. Smooth and rounded, it suggests a novelty mask.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Horsehead_01.colourAreas: The piece is textured, so it mostly ignores the colour scheme; the skin-tone coat, muzzle and ears, face stripe and eyes keep their default appearance.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Horsehead_Eyes_01.description: A pair of small rounded eye-like domes floating at the sides of the head, like a horse's side-set eyes, each with a horizontal band across the middle and a narrow vertical stripe below.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Horsehead_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main dome of each eye; colour 2 on the horizontal band; colour 0 on the rim edge; colour 3 on the small vertical stripe.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Horsehead_Eyes_01.differs: The female eyes sit lower, level with her own eyes at the sides of the face, rather than higher up on the head.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A skin-tight full-head covering shaped like a Krampus demon, with a contrasting face mask holding hollow contrasting eyes and a toothy grin, short curved side horns, and a wrapped, panelled cap over the skull and neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns, back of the head and diagonal cap stripes; colour 1 on the cap panels and lower cheeks; colour 2 on the face mask and band across the head; colour 3 on the lips and tongue.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Krampus_02.description: A full head covering in the shape of a monstrous Krampus head: smooth skull-hugging shell with small side ear-points, hollow eye sockets, an open fanged mouth, and thin tendril-like tongue or beard strands hanging below the chin.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Krampus_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear tips, the neck edge and swirled patches across the head; colour 1 on the large panels of the skull and the tendrils; colour 2 on the face and one side of the crown; colour 3 on the neck and throat patches.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A tight, featureless full-head hood made of patchwork fabric panels joined by heavy contrasting stitching, with star-like stitched burst patches where the eyes would be; it extends down over the neck. Ragdoll or jester-style.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light patches including the face and back panels; colour 1 on the main crown, lower head and one eye burst; colour 3 on the patches, neck edge and other eye burst; colour 2 on the stitching.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Madjester_01.differs: The female hood has a contrasting patch at the side of the face and a stitched contrasting-and-light patchwork on the back of the head, with the neck ending in a stitched collar; the patch layout differs from the male.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_01.description: A skin-tight full head covering that fits smoothly over the whole head and neck, with a bald, slightly elongated crown, faint sculpted nose, mouth and ears, and glossy almond eye openings; gives an uncanny, alien look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head covering; colour 1 on the eye areas.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_04.description: A full-head burlap-style sack mask with a gathered, wrinkled surface, hollow eye sockets, a stitched-open skull-like mouth with jagged teeth, and seam lines with stitch marks across the head. A lumpy cinched band closes it at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sack fabric; colour 3 on the stitches; colour 1 on the neck band; colour 2 on the mouth and nose cavity.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tig.description: A skin-tight full-head mask that covers the whole head and neck, with cut-outs around the eyes and a bare-looking nose and mouth area. Swooping curled brow markings sit across the forehead, giving a classic wrestler or superhero look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tig.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask over the forehead, cheeks and crown; colour 1 on the curled brow markings; colour 3 on the neck, eye surrounds, nose and mouth area.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tig.description: A skin-tight full-head mask covering the whole head and neck, with an abstract painted pattern: curved stripes running over the crown and down the face, a nose-bridge marking, and separate panels around the eyes and mouth.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tig.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the curved side-crown panels and nose-bridge marking; colour 2 on the stripes over the crown and face; colour 3 on the skin-like neck, eye surrounds and mouth area.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tig.description: A smooth, skin-tight full-head mask covering the whole head and neck, with raised web-like line patterns across the forehead and down the nose, outlined eye openings, and a jagged contrasting pattern at the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tig.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the raised webbing lines; colour 3 on the rims around the eye openings; colour 2 on the jagged neck pattern.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tig.description: A tight full-head mask that follows the skull and neck, with three thin painted strokes over the forehead, a contrasting band across the brow, a second band across the cheeks, and a separate panel over the eyes, nose and mouth. Superhero style.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tig.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask and neck; colour 1 on the forehead strokes; colour 2 on the brow and cheek bands; colour 3 on the eye surrounds and the lower face panel.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tig.differs: The female mask has slightly thicker forehead strokes that curve outward, and the eye surrounds are larger and rounder.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Glow_01.description: A skin-tight full-head hood that leaves the face open, with raised armoured panels on the brow, jaw, cheeks and back of the skull, joined by thin glowing seam lines. Suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fabric hood; colour 1 on the raised brow, cheek, chin and back-of-head panels; colour 3 on the thin seam lines.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Holoforce_0.description: A skin-tight full-head mask that covers the whole head and neck like a smooth hood. A wide band wraps across the eyes with small oval eye openings, and separate panels cover the crown and neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Holoforce_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and back of the head; colour 1 on the forehead and neck panels; colour 2 on the eye band; colour 3 on the chin and the strip down the front of the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Holoforce_0.differs: The female mask has a narrower contrasting strip running down the front of the neck, while the male has a broader contrasting patch at the chin.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Patternseta.description: A skin-tight full-head mask that covers the whole head and dips into a short neck, with flame-shaped eye patches that sweep up and outward toward the temples, edged by a thin contrasting outline.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Patternseta.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main hood and neck; colour 0 on the flame-shaped eye patches; colour 1 on the thin outline around the eye patches.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Microphone_01.description: A full-head helmet shaped like a vintage broadcast microphone: a rounded, slotted metal grille encloses the head, held in a rectangular yoke under an arched "WFOX" sign, and it sits on a slim neck stem with cables.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Microphone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the grille and mesh body; colour 1 on the yoke frame and sign rim; colour 2 on the sign panel, inner backing and neck base; colour 3 on the sign lettering.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Monster_02.description: A monstrous full head replacement with smooth, hairless, elongated skin, deep-set contrasting eye sockets, a sunken snout and a wide mouth of long jagged fangs. Ridged bands run from the brow over the crown and down the back of the skull.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Monster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and neck; colour 1 on the ridged bands over the crown and back of the head; colour 2 on the eye sockets; colour 0 on the teeth.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Mummy_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting head covering in a mummy style: a rounded cap over the crown, a separate face panel, a lower-face panel over the mouth and chin, and a few small loose strip tails poking out at the crown and ears.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Mummy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top cap; colour 1 on the face and neck panels and the crown patch; colour 3 on the lower face panel; colour 0 on the small loose strip tails.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Mummy_01.differs: The female version is a smooth, painted-looking hood with flat colour panels and no visible bandage wrapping, unlike the male version's layered wrapped strips.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting full-head cowl with a beaked, hawk-like brow ridge, recessed eye areas and a ribbed lower face guard that continues into a textured neck sleeve. Small round discs sit at the sides of the head.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth head shell; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth guard and neck sleeve; colour 3 on the eye areas; colour 2 on the side discs and edge trim.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A skin-tight full-head hood that covers the whole head and neck with smooth, seamless fabric. It has a central stripe over the crown, forehead, nose and down the back of the neck, with side panels over the cheeks and ears, and no openings beyond faint eye recesses.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central stripe over the crown, nose and back of the neck; colour 0 on the two swept panels on the top of the head; colour 3 on the side panels covering the face and ears.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Qularr_01.description: An alien insect head covering: a large pointed hood-like carapace sweeps up and back over the skull, with a spotted face, bulbous eyes, small horns, thin antennae and dangling mandible-like fangs at the jaw.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Qularr_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the carapace shell and face plates; colour 1 on the spots and the tips of the mandibles; colour 2 on the eyes and nostril openings; colour 3 on the mandible bases.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Robot_Human_Wings_01.description: A small mechanical forehead plate with two long, flat, angular blade-like wings sweeping up and outward in a V. It sits on the brow at the hairline, suggesting a robotic or mecha helmet crest.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Robot_Human_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forehead plate; colour 2 on the two wing blades; colour 3 on the small corner accents of the plate.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.description: A small head accessory: an angular block sits on the forehead at the hairline, with two long flat blade-like wings sweeping up and outward in a V. Small slashes mark the block. Suggests a mecha or robotic helmet crest.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forehead block; colour 2 on the wing blades; colour 3 on the small slashes on the block and wing roots.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Robotexo_01.description: A robotic head replacing the natural head: a smooth, sleek face plate with sculpted features, cracked segmented side and back panels, a round eye socket, and exposed cables and tubes running down a slender neck to a ring collar.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the face plate, top shell and neck core; colour 0 on the side and back panels, collar ring and neck struts; colour 3 on the cables; colour 2 on the panel cracks and seams.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Robotexo_01.differs: The female head has a smoother, more rounded face with softer features and a slimmer neck with a closed collar ring.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: An alien full-head covering: a swept-back crested helmet with layered spiky plates over the crown, a contrasting-trimmed brow band, and a mottled skin-like face and neck with side vent discs and ridged jaw plates.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet plates and jaw ridges; colour 3 on the brow band trim; colour 1 on the mottled skin of the face and neck; colour 2 on the side discs.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Serpent_01.description: A full reptilian head replacing the human head: a smooth, tapered snout with a wide toothy mouth, side-set eyes under heavy brow ridges, and a scaled crest patch running from brow over the crown and back of the head.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Serpent_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled crest and crown patch; skin tone on the snout and cheeks is not from the scheme; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the mouth edges and jaw markings; colour 3 on the inner mouth.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Serpent_02.description: A full serpent-like reptilian head replacing the human one: smooth scaly skin with a broad crest stripe over the skull, a long snout with a wide toothy grin, small spines by the eyes and jaw, and a lower jaw with spiked chin.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Serpent_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and upper head plates with their vein-like lines; the skin areas on the sides of the head and neck take the skin tone, not a slot; the mouth, teeth and jaw edging appear to ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Snake_01.description: A full replacement snake-like head with a smooth, tapered reptilian snout, side-set glossy eyes, a wide grooved lower jaw with a visible mouth line, and a scale-plated crown that runs down the back of the skull to the neck.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scale plates across the crown and back of the head; the skin-toned face and neck do not take a slot from the scheme; colour 2 on the lower jaw and snout underside; colour 1 on the eyes.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Spotlight_02.description: A full-head stage spotlight helmet: a rounded housing with a wide ringed lens opening at the front, four flat barn-door flaps around it, and three small flared lamp nozzles at the back and sides.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Spotlight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, lens rim and nozzles; colour 1 on the barn-door flaps and side clamps; colour 3 on the nozzle interiors; colour 2 on the lens.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Tv_01.description: A full-head retro television helmet: a rounded boxy casing with a glowing picture-screen face, contrasting side panels bulging out at each ear, and a small collar ring at the neck. Playful, cute, mechanical look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Tv_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main casing; colour 0 on the side panels; colour 1 on the neck ring; the screen shows its own picture and ignores the colour scheme.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Tv_01.differs: The screen shows a partly pixelated rainbow and landscape picture without the cartoon creature seen on the male version.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Wingedcrest_Bluejay_.description: A close-fitting helmet that covers the crown and back of the head, with a serrated fin-like crest running front to back and angular cut-outs at the temples. Thin segmented lines trace across the shell, giving a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Wingedcrest_Bluejay_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the crest and the thin panel lines across the shell.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Wingedcrest_Bluejay_.differs: The female helmet has a plain shell with thin line details, while the male version has a bold multi-panel colour pattern.

Female/F_Head_Tight_Worm_03.description: A monstrous worm-like head: a long, tall tubular neck that curves forward into a small hooked, mandibled face, with a ridged crest, two thin antennae with tips, and small claw-like pincers around the mouth.
Female/F_Head_Tight_Worm_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crest, back and upper body of the head; colour 0 on the underside of the throat; colour 3 on the antenna tips and crest bulb; the pincer tips take a fixed gold-like tone.

Female/F_Head_Toxicsteel_01.description: A full-coverage mechanical helmet with a smooth rounded shell divided by thin panel lines, a round speaker-like disc over the face, cylindrical side pods on short arms, and a V-shaped chin and neck panel.
Female/F_Head_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chin and neck panels; colour 3 on the main shell; colour 0 on the face disc, side pods, their arms and the small studs.

Female/F_Headaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025_.description: Two symmetrical clusters of three long, frond-like gills that fan out and upward from either side of the head, each with a feathery, serrated edge. Suggests an axolotl or aquatic creature costume.
Female/F_Headaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of each gill frond; colour 3 on the frilled edges and tips; colour 0 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Headsmallaccessories_Dragonbody.description: A pair of long, thin tapering whiskers that sprout from either side of the upper lip and sweep down and outward past the chin in curved points, like a dragon's barbels or a drooping moustache.
Female/F_Headsmallaccessories_Dragonbody.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Anniversary_Mi.description: A small rounded oval plate sitting on the forehead, with a raised four-pointed diamond star embedded in its centre. It is hollow and flat-backed, like a retro alien or mind-power brow ornament.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Anniversary_Mi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the oval plate; colour 3 on the raised diamond centre.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Anniversary_Mi.differs: The female version is a small oval forehead plate with a diamond gem, while the male version is a set of long tentacle-like strands hanging from the head over the face and shoulders.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Armyhelmet_03.description: A pair of round goggles with chunky octagonal rims and domed lenses joined by a short bridge, worn pushed up on the forehead and held by a flat strap that circles the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Armyhelmet_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the goggle rims and bridge; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 0 on the head strap; colour 2 on the small strap connectors at the sides.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Astronaut_01.description: A partial helmet faceplate shaped like a deep curved bowl that covers the lower face from nose to chin and wraps toward the ears, with a raised nose notch and small pointed tips at the sides.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the thin edge rim along the top and side tips.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Aztecheaddress.description: A large fan-shaped feathered headdress: layered rows of long feathers radiate in a wide half-circle from a small cap on the head, with shorter contrasting feathers forming an inner ring. Tribal ceremonial style.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Aztecheaddress.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the long outer feathers; colour 2 on the shorter inner feathers; colour 0 on the small cap at the head.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bonemantis_01.description: A pair of large rounded insect-style compound eyes, each a domed oval lens set in a thick padded rim, sitting over the eyes on the face. Suggests a monstrous mantis or insect mask.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims around the eyes; colour 3 on the domed lenses.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bonemantis_01.differs: The female version is a pair of domed insect eyes worn over the eyes, whereas the male version is a set of curved fangs hanging below the chin.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A retro sci-fi antenna: a rounded dome base topped by a thin upright mast with three stacked rings that widen toward the bottom, ending in a small ball tip. It floats above the head as a quirky accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome base; colour 1 on the mast and the thin spokes inside the rings; colour 2 on the rings and the ball tip.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A pair of retro sci-fi antennae floating out at either side of the head: each is a thin rod with a rounded bulb at the inner end, a small ball at the tip and several thin rings spaced along the shaft.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded bulbs; colour 1 on the central rods; colour 2 on the rings and tip balls.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A single thin antenna with a small round base and a slender curved stalk that bends and droops sideways, ending in a larger round bulb. It floats above the top of the head in a retro sci-fi style.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base ball; colour 1 on the curved stalk; colour 2 on the tip bulb.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A pair of thin, curved antennae rising from the top of the head, each a slender stalk with a small ball at the base and a larger bulb at the tip that droops outward. A retro sci-fi, alien look.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base balls; colour 1 on the thin stalks; colour 2 on the tip bulbs.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A small retro sci-fi antenna: a rounded base pad on top of the head holds a thin central rod with three stacked rings of increasing width and a round ball tip. Sits above the crown as a whimsical accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded base; colour 1 on the central rod and thin spokes; colour 2 on the rings and the ball tip.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: Pair of floating retro sci-fi antennae, one at each side of the head: a rounded bulb on a thin rod with a small tip ball, wrapped by several thin open rings. They hover clear of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded bulbs; colour 1 on the central rods; colour 2 on the rings and tip balls.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A single thin antenna: a small round base ball on top of the head with a slim stalk that bends and droops slightly to the side, ending in a round bulb tip. Retro sci-fi accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base ball; colour 1 on the stalk; colour 2 on the tip bulb.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A pair of thin, curved antennae that rise from small spherical bases on top of the head and droop slightly, each tipped with a round bulb. A playful retro sci-fi or insect-like head accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spherical bases; colour 1 on the thin stalks; colour 2 on the tip bulbs.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A retro sci-fi antenna: a slim central mast rising from a small rounded dome base, topped with a ball tip and three widening rings threaded down the shaft with thin spokes. It floats above the head as a whimsical accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome base; colour 1 on the central mast and thin spokes; colour 2 on the rings and the ball tip.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A thin, gently bent antenna stalk topped with a small faceted ball at the tip and a larger rounded ball at its base. It floats above the head, a retro sci-fi accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large base ball; colour 1 on the thin stalk; colour 2 on the small tip ball.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A pair of thin, curved antennae that rise from the top of the head and splay outward, each with a round bulb at the base and a small ball at the tip. Retro sci-fi, alien or insect-like look.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base bulbs; colour 1 on the thin stalks; colour 2 on the tip balls.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A retro sci-fi antenna: a small rounded dome base with a thin slanted mast rising from it, three stacked open rings of increasing size and a ball tip. It floats above the top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome base; colour 1 on the mast and thin spokes; colour 2 on the rings and the ball tip.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A pair of retro sci-fi antennae that stick out sideways from each side of the head, each with a rounded bulb at the base, a thin rod threaded with several spaced rings, and a small tip ball.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded bulbs; colour 1 on the central rods; colour 2 on the rings and tip balls.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A single thin, bendy antenna with a small round ball at the base and a larger round bulb at the tip, arching and drooping to one side. It sits above the top of the head, with a retro sci-fi feel.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base ball; colour 1 on the stalk; colour 2 on the tip bulb.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.description: A pair of thin, bendy antennae rising from the top of the head, each with a round bead at its base and a small ball at the tip, curving gently outward in a retro sci-fi, bug-like style.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retrosc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the round base beads; colour 1 on the thin stalks; colour 2 on the tip balls.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bucket_01.description: A thin curved wire loop resting around the neck and collarbone, with a small rounded cylindrical bead at the front. The ends taper up toward the jaw like a minimal headset or choker accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Bucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin wire; colour 1 on the cylindrical bead at the front.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Cartoon_Bunny_.description: A pair of cartoon bunny ears on short stalks that sit on top of the head and angle outward in a V. Each ear is a flat oval frame with a recessed inner panel and a small ringed base.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Cartoon_Bunny_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer ear rims; colour 2 on the inner ear panels; colour 3 on the short stalks; colour 0 on the small ringed bases.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Cartoon_Cat_01.description: A pair of soft, rounded cartoon cat ears set high on either side of the head, each a cupped, slightly floppy shell with a recessed inner face. Cute, playful animal headwear.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Cartoon_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells of the ears; colour 1 on the recessed inner faces.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Cartoon_Dog_01.description: A pair of cartoon dog ears: tall pointed ears that flare outward and curve up from either side of the top of the head, with a hollow inner face and small tapering tips at the base.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Cartoon_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces; colour 1 on the upper tips with a gradient fading into colour 0; colour 2 on the inner ear hollows.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Chicken_Eyes_0.description: A pair of rounded, bulging eyeball shapes with round pupils, mounted on the sides of the head above the ears, as on a chicken or bird mask. Cartoonish and monstrous, with no other head covering.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Chicken_Eyes_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball surfaces; colour 2 on the pupils; colour 3 on the small highlight dots in the pupils.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Corrupted_01.description: A spiky monstrous head accessory of sharp, thorn-like blades fanning up and out from the brow and temples, with a tall central spike and curved side horns. Sits on the forehead and crown, leaving the face open.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall upper thorns; colour 1 on the inner side blades; colour 2 on the outermost curved blades; colour 3 on the central spike.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Crimson_01.description: A fantasy circlet-mask worn across the brow: an ornate metal band with flame-like curling prongs, swept-out winglike side points, a pointed nose bridge, and two tall curved horns rising from the forehead.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band, side points and prongs; colour 1 on the two tall horns.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Dome_Crest_01.description: A mechanical dome-shaped crest that arches over the top of the head from brow to nape, made of segmented armored plates with a lit front lip and a flared rear plate; it leaves the face open, sci-fi in style.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Dome_Crest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor plates and rear plate; colour 1 on the side panels along the arch; colour 2 on the band and inner strips; colour 3 on small accents beneath the arch.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Dragon_Silly_0.description: A pair of octagonal disc pods worn over the ears like headphones, each with a fan of pointed, swept-back fin or wing blades sprouting from behind. A playful, dragon-like head accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Dragon_Silly_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the disc rims and outer casings; colour 3 on the outer disc faces; colour 0 on the fin blades; colour 2 on the blade outlines.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Enclosure_Cryo.description: Two thin, tube-like hoses arch over the shoulders, each curving up from the upper chest and back over the shoulder line with a kinked, angular bend. They are loose, open ends with no helmet attached.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Enclosure_Cryo.colourAreas: Colour 3 on both tubes; other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Cowboyhat.description: Steampunk goggles worn pushed up on the forehead: two round lens cylinders with panelled housings joined by a short bridge, held by a thin studded headband that circles the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Cowboyhat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband; colour 1 on the goggle housings, bridge and studs; colour 3 on the inset panels of the housings; colour 2 on the lenses.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Patriot_M.description: Round-lens goggles with octagonal rimmed lenses and small side blocks, worn over the eyes on a wide padded band that wraps around the head. The band is layered and slightly ribbed.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Patriot_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded band; colour 1 on the lens rims; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the side blocks and band edging.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Patriot_M.differs: On the female version the band dips lower at the back, with a narrow strip visible beneath the rear band and the lens rims showing from behind.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Fox_Eyes_01.description: A pair of small rounded eye-shaped domes floating at the temples beside the eyes, each with a small slanted contrasting pupil facing forward and a thin pointed shell edge at the back. Fox-mask style accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Fox_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome shells; colour 3 on the pupils.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Techno_01.description: A mechanical jaw guard that wraps the lower face: a V-shaped chin plate with angular blade-like flares rising along each cheek toward the ears, and vented side panels with small round perforations. Sci-fi, armored look.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin plate and the outer cheek flares; colour 1 on the perforated side panels; colour 2 on the inner recesses and edge gaps.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_0.description: A wide angular visor band that wraps across the eyes and temples: a flat faceted strip with a notch at the nose and upswept ends at the sides. Suggests a sentai-style trooper mask.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor band; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_0.description: A angular V-shaped visor band that sits across the eyes, dipping to a point over the nose bridge and wrapping back toward the temples. A slim bright edge outlines the top. Suggests a sentai-style hero mask.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the visor face; colour 0 on the thin upper rim and inner surface.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_0.description: A pair of flat, leaf-shaped eye plates that angle outward and upward from beside the nose across each eye, like a sentai-style mask. They are thin, unattached shells with no strap, sitting on the face.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both eye plates; the plates appear to be a single colour with no other visible features.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_0.description: A wraparound visor band in one smooth curved shell that covers the eyes and upper face, dipping to a point over the nose and wrapping to the temples. It suggests a sleek, plain sentai-style helmet.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor shell; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Guardian_01.description: A pair of stylized dragon-flame ear ornaments floating at the sides of the head: upper swept, pointed fin-like blades with swirl engravings above lower curling wave-shaped scrolls. Fantasy, east-asian look.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper swept blades; colour 2 on the swirl engravings; colour 1 on the lower curling scroll shapes; colour 3 on the thin swirl lines in the lower scrolls.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Lockbox_66_01.description: A close-fitting cap of layered, overlapping feather-like plates fanning back from the brow, with a small horn at the crown and sharp tapered tips flicking out around the nape and sides. Suggests a fantasy serpent-bird headdress.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper feather plates, blending toward colour 0 near the front edges; colour 2 on the underside and back plates; colour 3 on the crown horn and the feather tips.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Lockbox_66_02.description: A floating crest of long pointed feathers arranged in a fan arc that runs from ear to ear over the top of the head, with the tallest feather at the centre. Suggests a tribal headdress.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lower feather bases; colour 3 on the feather tips; colour 2 on the shading between them.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Modern_Ironcla.description: A tall, swept-back crest of layered, blade-like plates running from the forehead over the crown and down past the nape, tapering to pointed tips. Reads as a stylised mohawk or mechanical helmet fin.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Modern_Ironcla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crest plates; colour 1 on the inner edges and accent plates between the layers; colour 2 on the tapering tips.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Modern_Kinetik.description: A pair of ear-mounted discs with clusters of long, swept-back blade-like spikes rising from each. The spikes sweep up and back past the head, giving a winged, speedster-style look.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Modern_Kinetik.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear discs and their rims; colour 3 on the spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Pirate_Fancy_0.description: A fan-shaped plume of long, overlapping feathers rising from a small tuft at the crown of the head and sweeping back and outward, like a flamboyant pirate hat feather worn as a crest.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Pirate_Fancy_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather vanes; colour 0 on the feather centres and inner fade; colour 2 on the feather tips; colour 3 on the central quills and the base tuft.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Pirate_Hat_Fea.description: A small cluster of long, curved plume feathers fanning out from a single point at the side of the head, each with a central quill and frayed edges, in the style of a pirate hat plume.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Pirate_Hat_Fea.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feather vanes; colour 1 on the outer edges of some feathers; colour 3 on the central quills; colour 2 on the feather tips and shading.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Super_Retro_De.description: A pair of angular tubular frames flanking the head, each rising from a low point under the chin to a bent upright beside the ear, with small hooked prongs near the jaw. It reads as a retro villain collar or helmet frame.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Super_Retro_De.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long tubular frame bars; colour 2 on the upper ends of the bars; colour 1 on the small hooked prongs near the jaw.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Tight_Emissive.description: A translucent glass-like face shield that curves over the eyes, cheeks and nose and tapers to a point below the chin. It has a notched, angular upper edge at the forehead and no rear part. Sci-fi visor style.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Tight_Emissive.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shield, shown as a glossy glassy surface that mostly ignores the other colour slots; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Tight_Flighthe.description: A small headset microphone boom: a cylindrical earpiece capsule on a slim open-frame arm at the cheek, with a jointed thin stalk curving down and forward to a flattened mic tip near the mouth.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Tight_Flighthe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm, frame and mic tip; colour 0 on the capsule body; colour 1 on the capsule's outer end cap.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Victory_01.description: A pair of swept-back head fins or wings, one on each side of the head, each made of a long curved blade with smaller layered feather-like blades beneath it, pointing upward and outward like horns.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer blades; colour 1 on the middle layered blades; colour 2 on the lower under-blades.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Winterevent_20.description: A tall conical hennin hat with a long pointed peak and a draped veil that hangs from the tip down the back and sides, finished with a scalloped lace edge. Medieval, fairy-tale court style.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Winterevent_20.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone and upper veil; colour 1 on the lower veil, fading in from the cone; colour 2 on the lace trim.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Winterevent_20.description: A tall, tapering cloth cape rising to a sharp point above the head, like a hennin, then draping down the back to about the hips as a narrow, flat triangular sheet.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Winterevent_20.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape, with a slightly bluish tint on the back face; no other visible colour slots.

Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Wolf_Pelt_03.description: A pair of small, pointed ear-like tufts perched on the upper forehead, angled outward like a wolf's ears, each with a hollow inner panel and a thin rim. Only the two ears show; nothing covers the rest of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Accessory_Wolf_Pelt_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim of each ear; colour 1 on the inner panel of each ear.

Female/F_Helmet_Amazon_01.description: A domed, segmented helmet with a broad brow band ending in a pointed nose guard, hinged cheek plates beside the face, and a flared rear neck flap. Ancient warrior style, worn over the top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome plates and neck flap; colour 1 on the brow band; colour 3 on the swirl markings and the small stud on the band; colour 2 on the outlines and seams between plates and on the cheek plates.

Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A bald monstrous brute head with a heavy brow, pointed ears with a hoop earring, and a jutting underbite jaw showing a large curved tusk, small teeth and a protruding tongue. Slimmer, narrower jaw than a bulky orc.
Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tusk and earring; colour 1 on the eyes and teeth gums; colour 2 on the teeth; colour 3 on the tongue; the skin ignores the scheme and keeps its own tone.
Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The female head has a narrower, less heavy jaw and a smaller, slimmer skull, and only one tusk is clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_02.description: A full-head wrestler-style mask with a smooth cloth-like shell, raised rim stripe over the crown, angular eye surrounds, a nose point and a fanged tiki mouth. A ragged pointed beard-like flap hangs below the chin.
Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mask shell; colour 0 on the eye surrounds, crown stripe and teeth band; colour 3 on the eye fills; colour 2 on the nose, mouth interior and chin flap.

Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.description: A full-face metal helmet with a domed crown, a brow band forming a V over glowing eyes, tall curved spikes rising from the top and sides, and a pointed mask-like faceplate that tapers to a chin point.
Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band and rim trim; the main helmet shell is glossy metal that largely ignores the scheme; colour 3 on the eye glow; colour 1 in the eye surrounds.

Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A full robotic helmet with a smooth glossy dome, panel seams, a round central eye lens on the brow, narrow eye slits, and a pointed chin guard. Round ear pods and tall angular fins rise at each side.
Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Glossy metal ignores the scheme for most of the shell; colour 1 on the ear pods, chin tip and rear ridge; colour 3 on the central brow lens; colour 0 on the side fins.
Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.differs: The female helmet has narrow, contrasting eye slits under the brow lens, while the male has glowing eyes set in a heavier scowling brow.

Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary_Mindslayer_0.description: A retro supervillain headpiece with two large curling ram-like horns with a mesh texture, a central brow ridge holding a diamond-shaped gem, a band across the eyes, and long tentacle-like strands hanging down behind the head to the shoulders.
Female/F_Helmet_Anniversary_Mindslayer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns, brow plate and hanging strands; colour 1 on the eye band and strand edging; colour 3 on the diamond gem.

Female/F_Helmet_Arcane_01.description: A jackal-headed full helmet in an Egyptian style: a long tapering snout, two tall pointed ears, a round jewelled medallion on the brow and a striped cloth headdress that drapes to the shoulders and back.
Female/F_Helmet_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face plating and the stripes on the headdress; colour 2 on the snout, ears and headdress cloth; colour 1 on the headband and medallion ring; colour 3 on the centre gem and side ornaments.

Female/F_Helmet_Arcane_02.description: An Egyptian-style headdress: a rounded cap with a pointed brow and openwork ornament, topped by two tall pointed jackal-like ears, with a long patterned cloth veil draping past the shoulders behind and at the sides.
Female/F_Helmet_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cap; colour 2 on the ears, brow ornament and edge trim; colour 0 and colour 3 on the patterned veil cloth.

Female/F_Helmet_Armyhelmet_01.description: A rounded military combat helmet with a camouflage-style blotchy pattern, small leaf-like scraps sticking out of the shell, a contrasting band around the base with a small buckle, and two long dangling chin straps.
Female/F_Helmet_Armyhelmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell base; colour 3 on the camouflage blotches and the band around the base; colour 1 on the hanging chin straps; colour 2 on the small buckle and some scraps.

Female/F_Helmet_Armyhelmet_02.description: A rounded military-style combat helmet with a mottled camouflage-patterned shell, a band around the rim with a small buckle, a small box-shaped attachment on the left side, and two dangling chin straps.
Female/F_Helmet_Armyhelmet_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 3 in a mottled camouflage pattern on the shell; colour 3 on the rim band; colour 2 on the side attachment and buckle; colour 1 on the hanging straps.

Female/F_Helmet_Armyhelmet_03.description: A rounded military-style helmet with a contrasting rim band, rivet dots and a strap band circling the shell that holds a pair of round goggles on the brow; two dangling chin straps with contrasting tips hang at the sides.
Female/F_Helmet_Armyhelmet_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the goggle band; colour 1 on the rim band and goggle housings; colour 3 on the goggle lenses and the hanging straps; colour 2 on the strap tips and small fittings.

Female/F_Helmet_Astronaut_01.description: A full-enclosure astronaut helmet with a rounded shell, a large domed visor and a contrasting brow band with small vent slots. Side ear pods and a chin-mounted mic piece sit on a trim ring; a raised triangular emblem marks the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and trim ring; colour 1 on the visor dome, ear pods and chin piece; colour 2 on the brow band; colour 3 on the vent slots.

Female/F_Helmet_Aztecheaddress_01.description: A tribal feathered headdress: a large fan of long layered feathers radiates behind and above the head, with a small skull ornament at the brow and short strands hanging beside the face. Ancient ceremonial style.
Female/F_Helmet_Aztecheaddress_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer feathers; colour 2 on the inner feathers near the skull; colour 0 on the skull and head band; colour 1 on the hanging strands and face trim.

Female/F_Helmet_Bike_01.description: A sleek aerodynamic cycling-style helmet with a long pointed peak over the brow, angular fins on the sides, vent cut-outs and rear openings. It sits over the top of the head, leaving the face open, with a sporty superhero look.
