Female/F_Helmet_Bike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and crown; colour 3 on the central chevron stripe and vent panels; colour 1 on the side fins and lower rear shell; colour 2 on the small side pivot buttons.

Female/F_Helmet_Blockbuster_01.description: A smooth, rounded skullcap helmet that sits close to the head, with a brow line over the forehead and a tall fin-like crest running front to back, with a hollow opening at its front end.
Female/F_Helmet_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the central crest and its front opening rim; colour 2 on the thin edge trim around the base.

Female/F_Helmet_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: A large, monstrous full-head covering shaped like a downward-pointing triangle, with a wide flared top and a pointed chin. Its surface is carved with organic, ribbed swirls, and it completely hides the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: The whole helmet takes a dark, glossy stone-like finish that largely ignores the colour scheme; the scheme is barely visible on the surface.

Female/F_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere.description: A large spherical fishbowl-style helmet that encloses the whole head, sitting on the neck with a thin rim. On this sheet it renders as a faceted, opaque, stone-like ball that hides the face. A retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole sphere; the surface shows a rocky mottled texture rather than the scheme, and the neck rim is barely visible.
Female/F_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere.differs: The female helmet renders as an opaque, faceted, rock-textured sphere that hides the face, while the male one is a clear glass bubble showing the head.

Female/F_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere.description: A large transparent glass bubble helmet, a smooth sphere enclosing the whole head and resting on the neck and shoulders with a thin rim. Retro sci-fi spaceman style; the face stays fully visible.
Female/F_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere.colourAreas: The clear glass ignores the colour scheme; no colour slots are visibly applied.
Female/F_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere.differs: The female version is clear glass that shows the face inside, while the male version is an opaque, faceted, rock-textured sphere that hides the head.

Female/F_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere.description: A large faceted bubble helmet, a solid sphere of triangular facets that fully encloses the head and rests on the neck with a slim open rim at the base. It suggests a retro sci-fi space helmet.
Female/F_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere.colourAreas: Colour 0 across the whole sphere surface; the default material shows a mottled stone-like texture, so the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Bucket_01.description: A humorous upturned metal bucket worn over the whole head, tapering slightly toward the top, with ridged bands near the rim and a thin wire handle hanging under the chin with a grip.
Female/F_Helmet_Bucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bucket body; colour 1 on the handle grip; the wire handle takes the light colour.

Female/F_Helmet_Cartoon_Cat_01.description: A full-head cartoon cat mask helmet with a rounded, furry-looking shell, two rounded ears with inner linings, striped markings on the forehead, and a large face panel with big eyes, cheeks and nose. Its collar rim rests on the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Cartoon_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell, ears and collar rim; colour 1 on the inner ears and irises; colour 2 on the face panel and forehead stripes; colour 3 on the nose and cheek blushes.

Female/F_Helmet_Cartoon_Dog_01.description: A full cartoon dog head covering: rounded shaggy fur with a tuft of spikes on top, tall pointed ears with tipped ends, a short snout with a nose, painted expressive eyes and cheek marks, and a small collar ruff at the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Cartoon_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur, snout and neck ruff; colour 1 on the ear tips and the eye markings; colour 2 on the nose and inner ears; colour 3 on the cheek marks.

Female/F_Helmet_Chicken_01.description: A full-head cartoon chicken mask with a glossy hooked beak, round bulging eyes, a serrated comb running from forehead to back, and scale-textured feathered cover that flares into a ruffled collar at the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Chicken_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaly feathered head and neck ruff; colour 1 on the face, comb and wattle; colour 2 on the beak; colour 3 on the eye rims.
Female/F_Helmet_Chicken_01.differs: The female version has contrasting-rimmed eyes with contrasting pupils set flat in the face, rather than protruding contrasting eyeballs.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Bear_03.description: A small, faceted bear muzzle and snout piece that sits over the mouth and upper chin, jutting forward as a blunt wedge with a soft, sculpted nose ridge. Suits animal or beast character heads.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Bear_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and sides of the snout; colour 0 on the front and underside of the muzzle; colour 2 in the shadowed tip and lower edge.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Bear_03.differs: The female snout is longer and narrower, projecting further forward from the mouth.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Beast_Croc_Tophat_.description: A tall, slightly crumpled cloth top hat with a wide flat brim, a band of segmented panels studded with small spikes around the base of the crown, and a single long feather tucked in at the side.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Beast_Croc_Tophat_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the small spikes and underside of the brim; colour 3 on the feather.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Beast_Gator_Tophat.description: A tall, slightly crumpled cloth top hat with a wide flat brim, a banded hatband studded with small contrasting spikes, and a long feather tucked in at the side. It sits perched on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Beast_Gator_Tophat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hatband; colour 2 on the small spikes along the band; colour 3 on the feather.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Emblem_01.description: A small flat atom-shaped emblem on the forehead: three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus ring, with a thin outline. It sits flush against the skin as a decorative mark.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Emblem_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Emblem_Facemask_01.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring, applied to the centre of the forehead. It sits directly on the skin and leaves the rest of the head bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Emblem_Facemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main orbit bands and central ring; colour 1 on the outlines and edging of the emblem.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Aci_01.description: A rounded open-face pilot helmet that caps the skull and drops to cover the ears, with a raised seam band around the back, small stud rivets, and an inset side panel over each ear. Trimmed edge.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Aci_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the trim along the lower edge and ear flaps; colour 3 on the inset ear panels.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Baseballcap_0.description: A casual baseball cap worn forward: a rounded panelled crown with a curved brim over the brow and contrasting stitched seams. Sits snugly on top of the head, leaving the face and hair area below open.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Baseballcap_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front panels and brim; colour 0 on the back and side panels of the crown; colour 2 on the stitched seams and piping.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Baseballcap_0.description: A casual baseball cap worn backwards: a rounded panelled crown sits snugly on the head with the short curved brim pointing down the back of the neck, and contrasting stitched seams outline the panels.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Baseballcap_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front crown panels; colour 1 on the brim and rear crown panels; colour 2 on the stitched seam lines.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Blackpaladin_.description: A full-face helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a stylised face mask with angular eye openings, a tall central spike and several contrasting spikes on the crown, plus curved horn-like prongs swept out from each side.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Blackpaladin_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and face mask; colour 1 on the eye lenses; colour 2 on the crown spikes and the back hexagon; colour 3 on the side horns.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Bowlerhattall.description: A tall bowler-style hat with a straight-sided rounded crown, a narrow curled brim and a wide band around the base of the crown. It sits on top of the head, with a low-poly, whimsical, gentlemanly look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Bowlerhattall.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Bowlerhattall.description: A tall, rounded-top bowler-style hat with a wide contrasting band around the base of the crown, a narrow curled brim, and a small card tucked into the band at the side. Sits on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Bowlerhattall.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the underside of the brim; the tucked card also takes colour 0, with a square panel on its side.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Bunnyears_01.description: A pair of tall, tapering rabbit ears rising from the top of the head, one bending slightly outward, with a cupped inner face and a smooth outer surface. Cute, playful animal-themed headwear.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Bunnyears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces and rims of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear faces, with a slight blending toward colour 3 inside.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cadethat_01.description: A small folded garrison-style cadet cap that sits snug on top of the head, with a soft creased crown that peaks along the centre line and a contrasting piped seam running front to back.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cadethat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap body; colour 1 on the piping along the centre seam.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Catears_01.description: A pair of pointed cat ears rising from the top of the head, angled slightly outward, with smooth outer shells and inner faces shaded with a gradient. Cute animal-style head accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Catears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer backs of the ears; colour 1 and colour 3 blend across the inner faces of the ears.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Clowncap_01.description: A jester's cap with a band around the head and several long, curved, tapering points that droop outward, each ending in a round pom-pom. Soft padded cloth with contrasting inner panels and edging; sits on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Clowncap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap and points; colour 1 on the headband and the inner panels of the points; colour 3 on the thin stripe on the band and the edge piping; colour 2 on the pom-poms.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Combatnypd_01.description: A rounded tactical combat helmet that sits snugly over the top of the head, with a wide band wrapping around the brow that extends into a short front peak, small ear flaps, and a thin chin strap.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Combatnypd_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and rear of the shell; colour 1 on the front and side shell panels and ear flaps; colour 2 on the brow band and rear stripe; colour 0 on the chin strap.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitar.description: A close-fitting military tech helmet with a wide visor panel pulled down over the eyes, segmented shell plates on the sides and back, round ear discs, and circuit-like inlaid lines across the crown.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell plates, ear discs and inlaid line details; colour 1 on the visor panel and top crown; colour 2 on the seams and gaps between plates.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitar.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet shell with the visor raised out of view, leaving the face bare. It has a smooth domed crown, panelled sides with etched detail, and round earpiece discs, in a modern military style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitar.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown and top panels; colour 0 on the side and rear shell plating, earpiece discs and rear band; colour 3 on small accents by the earpieces.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitar.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet with a padded cloth crown, riveted side plates, a ridged band across the back, ear cups and a boom microphone curving toward the mouth, plus a thin antenna rising at the side.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitar.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cloth crown and ear cup accents; colour 0 on the side plates, back band and microphone; colour 2 on the ear cups and antenna.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_01.description: A classic cowboy hat with a soft, creased crown pinched slightly at the front and a wide brim that curls up at the sides. Sits on top of the head, tilted low over the brow, in a western style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and the top of the brim; the underside of the brim takes a darker shade from the scheme.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_02.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, boxy, slightly creased crown and a broad flat brim that sits low over the eyes. The brim has a pointed front and back and a thin edge; western style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and the upper side of the brim; colour 2 on the underside of the brim.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_02.differs: The female brim is wider and flatter, and its underside is a distinct contrasting colour that is clearly visible from behind. The crown is taller and more boxy.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Cru.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, crumpled and creased crown and a slightly wavy, drooping brim. It sits on top of the head, shading the face, with a casual western look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Cru.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim alike; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Cru.description: A crumpled wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a dented, creased crown and a floppy brim ragged along the edge and pierced by small holes. It sits on top of the head, giving a worn, weathered look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Cru.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Gun.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, creased crown pinched at the front and back, and a broad flat brim that dips slightly. It sits low on the head, shading the eyes, in a western gunslinger style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Gun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; no separate trim or band is visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Tal.description: A tall ten-gallon cowboy hat with a high, slightly pinched crown and a wide, gently curved brim that sits low over the brow. Soft felt-like shaping suggests a classic western look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Tal.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; the underside of the brim takes a darker shade.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Une.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, softly creased crown and an uneven, wavy brim that dips at the front and flares up at the sides. Sits on top of the head in a western style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Une.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Une.description: A cowboy hat with a tall, creased, slightly crumpled crown and a wide brim that curls up at the sides and dips low over the eyes. Small worn holes and nicks show on the crown and brim edge.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Une.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Une.description: A translucent, ghostly cowboy hat with a tall creased crown and a wide, uneven brim that flares and curls up at the sides. It sits on top of the head, with a thin band around the base of the crown.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Une.colourAreas: The hat is a semi-transparent, glass-like material that largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 shows faintly across the crown and brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Une.description: A translucent, ghostly cowboy hat with a tall creased crown, a band around its base and a wide brim that curls up unevenly at the sides. It sits on top of the head, with a western feel.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Une.colourAreas: The default material is translucent and glassy and largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint shows on the hat band and brim edge.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Crownsasquatc.description: A tribal crown-style headpiece: a flat stitched cloth band with a small cap top and two dangling side straps, ringed by tall curved, swirl-carved blade-like plumes and thin spikes rising around the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Crownsasquatc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, cap top and hanging straps; colour 3 on the tall curved plumes and centre spike; colour 2 on the bands across the plume bases; colour 1 on the stitching.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedora_01.description: A classic fedora with a softly creased, tapered crown and a short brim that sits low over the brow. A wide hatband with thin edge piping wraps the crown, with a contrasting block at the front-side. Suggests a noir or pulp look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedora_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hatband; colour 1 on the thin piping along the band edges; colour 3 on the block section of the band at the front.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedorabig_02.description: A wide-brimmed fedora with a tall, softly creased crown and a flat, broad brim that shades the eyes. A band circles the base of the crown with a small contrasting patch at the front-right. Classic noir style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedorabig_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 3 on the small patch on the band.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedoraflat_03.description: A wide-brimmed fedora with a soft creased crown and a broad, flat brim that sweeps out evenly and shades the eyes. A band with a contrasting patch at the front circles the base of the crown; zoot-suit, noir style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedoraflat_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 3 on the patch at the front of the band.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Fishinghat_01.description: A soft cloth bucket-style fishing hat with a rounded crown, a wide downward-sloping brim edged in contrasting trim, a banded strip around the crown and small round eyelets spaced around the sides. Sits snugly on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Fishinghat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the brim edge trim; colour 2 on the segmented band around the crown; colour 3 on the eyelets.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Hardhat_01.description: A construction-style hardhat: a rounded dome with raised ridges on top and a short brim all the way round, a wide contrasting band around the base, and a rectangular badge with an emblem on the front.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Hardhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and brim; colour 2 on the band around the base and the badge frame; colour 1 on the badge emblem.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Hardhat_02.description: A rounded construction-style hardhat with a short all-round brim, moulded ridges and small vent notches, circled by a band and carrying a front-mounted headlamp with a chunky hexagonal housing and round lens.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Hardhat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and brim; colour 2 on the band and the lamp bracket; colour 1 on the lamp housing; colour 3 on the lamp lens.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Headset_01.description: A slim communications headset: a thin band arcs over the top of the head to a rounded earpiece on one side, with a thin antenna rising from it and a curved microphone boom reaching toward the mouth.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Headset_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband, earpiece, antenna and microphone boom; the small ear-side tab pieces also take colour 0.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Hockey_Mask_0.description: A hockey-style face mask covering the face with a rounded, pointed-chin shell, eye slits and rows of ventilation holes, held by contrasting straps with small studs over a separate cap-like panel on the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Hockey_Mask_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face shell and rim; colour 1 on the rear cap panel; colour 2 on the top and side straps; colour 3 on the small studs at the strap joints.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Holiday_Hat_0.description: A soft Santa-style holiday hat: a thick, textured cuff band circles the head, with a slouchy cone of cloth flopping to one side and ending in a round pom-pom at the tip.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Holiday_Hat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cone of the hat; colour 1 on the fluffy cuff band; colour 2 on the pom-pom.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Huntershat_01.description: A furry trapper-style cap with a rounded, panelled crown, a short front brim, a band of contrasting trim around the base, and fold-down ear flaps with dangling ties. Sits snugly on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Huntershat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front, side and rear crown panels and the ear flaps; colour 1 on the alternating crown panels; colour 2 on the trim band and ties; colour 3 on the small tuft at the crown top and the flap studs.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Knitcap_01.description: A close-fitting ribbed knit skullcap that covers the crown and sits just above the brows and ears, with two thin contrasting stripes around the band. A casual, sporty beanie look with no brim or cuff.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Knitcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed knit body of the cap; colour 1 on the two stripes around the band.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Knitcap_02.description: A snug, smooth swim cap that covers the whole crown and the back of the head, with gentle wrinkles across the top and two thin contrasting stripes circling the lower edge above the forehead and ears.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Knitcap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap body; colour 1 on the two stripes around the rim.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Militarytall_.description: A tall, straight-sided cylindrical military shako-style hat with a flat top, a wide contrasting band around the lower part, and a short flat peak jutting out at the front. Sits upright on the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Militarytall_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cylinder, flat top and front peak; colour 1 on the wide band around the lower hat.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Officerhat_01.description: A peaked officer's cap with a wide flat crown that overhangs a short band, a small curved visor at the front, and a thin decorative strip along the band. Sits on top of the head; military or naval style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Officerhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and band; colour 1 on the visor; colour 3 on the decorative strip across the front of the band; colour 2 on the thin stripe at the back of the band and the piping around the crown edge.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Piratehatwide.description: A wide-brimmed tricorn-style pirate hat with the brim folded up into a curved peak at the front and back, and a broad rim that sweeps down over the sides. It sits high on the head and has a piped edge.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Piratehatwide.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and brim of the hat; colour 1 on the piped edge trim along the folded brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Piratehatwide.description: A tricorn pirate hat with a rounded crown and three upturned brim corners, one at the front and two at the sides. The brim has contrasting edge trim and a small stitched cross on each side panel.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Piratehatwide.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the edge trim around the brim; colour 2 on the cross stitches; colour 3 on the thin line under the brim edge.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Police_01.description: A police-style peaked cap with a wide, flat-topped crown, a band of contrasting trim around the base, a short stiff visor at the front and a small badge emblem on the front of the band. Sits on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Police_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown; colour 3 on the thin trim band; colour 1 on the hatband and visor; colour 2 on the badge.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Tight_Paintba.description: An open-topped visor band that wraps around the forehead, with a broad angular brim jutting forward over the eyes and a central panel on the brim. The crown is left bare, giving a sporty, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Tight_Paintba.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rim and outer shell; colour 1 on the central front brim panel; colour 2 on the underside of the brim; colour 3 on the inner band and back trim.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Tight_Russian.description: A fur ushanka-style winter hat with a rounded crown, thick fluffy fur panels and side ear flaps that sit against the head, with a front brim panel; a cold-weather look that leaves the face uncovered.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Tight_Russian.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown top and back panel; colour 1 on the front brim and ear flaps; colour 2 on the edge seams and trim lines between the panels.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Tophat_01.description: A tall, slightly tapered top hat with a flat crown, a broad band around the base of the crown and a narrow flat brim. It sits on top of the head and gives a formal, gentlemanly look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Tophat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Tophat_01_Gli.description: A tall, straight-sided top hat with a flat crown, a narrow slightly wavy brim and a wide contrasting band around the base of the crown. It sits on the head, tilted low over the eyes, with a speckled glitter-like texture.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Tophat_01_Gli.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim, with a speckled glitter texture; colour 1 on the hat band.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Witch_01.description: A classic witch's hat: a tall, crumpled cone that bends to a curled tip, with a wide, drooping, slightly ruffled brim and a contrasting band around the base. It sits on top of the head, shading the eyes.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Face_Witch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone and the brim; colour 1 on the band around the base of the cone.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Fullhelmet_Crown_S.description: A metal spiked crown band circling the head, with tall curved blade-like spikes rising around the rim, a pointed brow piece at the front with a set gem, and an inner lining band beneath the rim.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Fullhelmet_Crown_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown band and spikes; colour 1 on the inner lining band; colour 3 on the gems.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.description: An Egyptian-style headdress helmet with striped cloth lappets falling behind and beside the face, topped by a glossy beaked crest with curled horn-like sweeps and a ribbed panel at the temples. Suggests an eagle-headed pharaonic look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the striped cloth lappets; colour 3 on the stripe bands and edge piping; colour 1 on the ribbed temple panels and crest centre; colour 2 on the beaked crest and curled horns.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Hat_Fez_01.description: A fez hat: a short, flat-topped truncated cone that tapers slightly toward the crown and sits on top of the head. A thin cord runs across the top and drops into a tassel hanging at the side.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Hat_Fez_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat body; colour 2 on the cord across the top; colour 3 on the small cap where the tassel attaches; colour 1 on the tassel.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_01.description: A pair of large ram-style horns with ridged, ribbed surfaces that sweep back from the top of the head, curl down past the ears and flick outward at the tips. A fantasy or monstrous head accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper ridged part of the horns; colour 1 on the curled lower tips, blending in from the base.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_02.description: A pair of large ram-style horns with ridged, ribbed surfaces, rising from the top of the head, curling outward and down past the ears, and ending in smooth tapered tips that sweep outward.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged base and main curve of each horn; colour 1 on the smooth tapering tips, blending in from the base.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_03.description: A pair of large ridged ram-style horns that sprout from the sides of the upper head, sweep back and curl down and forward into pointed tips. The surface is heavily ribbed, giving a bone-like, beastly look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base and top of each horn; colour 1 on the lower curl and tips of each horn.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_04.description: A pair of long ridged ram-like horns that sweep up and outward from the top of the head, then curve back and down to tapered points. Each rises from a small flared base on the scalp; a beastly, monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged bases and shafts of both horns; colour 1 on the tapering tips, blending in gradually.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horsehead_Horn_01.description: A single spiralling unicorn horn that rises from the centre of the forehead and tilts slightly forward, tapering to a point, with twisting ridged bands and a small rounded base on the brow.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horsehead_Horn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised spiral ridges and the base; colour 1 on the recessed spiral band; colour 2 on the darker twisting groove.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horsehead_Horn_02.description: A single spiralling unicorn horn that rises from the centre of the forehead and sweeps slightly back, tapering to a point with twisting faceted ridges. Sits alone on the head as a fantasy accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Horsehead_Horn_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiral ridges and the base; colour 1 on the alternating bands of the twist; colour 2 on the darker grooves between the ridges.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Lion_Helmet_01.description: A lion-head headdress worn like a hood: a snarling lion face sits over the brow with fangs framing the open face, rounded ears, and a shaggy layered mane of jagged strands falling around the head and nape.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Lion_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head and mane; colour 1 on the nose and inner ears; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the fangs.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Nephilim_Face_Mask.description: A smooth face mask shaped like a humanlike face with hollow contrasting eye sockets, a sculpted nose and no mouth opening. It covers the forehead, cheeks and nose, and the lower edge stops above the mouth.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Nephilim_Face_Mask.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mask surface; the eye sockets are hollow. Colours 1, 2 and 3 are not visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Nephilim_Mask_Full.description: A thin, hollow face mask shaped like an alien humanoid face, with large almond-shaped contrasting eye openings, a narrow nose, full lips and a tall smooth forehead. It covers the face only, open at the back like a shell.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Nephilim_Mask_Full.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the lips and the shading around the eyes; the eye openings are voids.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Qularr_Villain_01.description: A segmented insect-carapace head cover: a smooth pointed plate over the crown with a decorated front panel, and stacked overlapping blade-like plates fanning out behind the head. Leaves the face open and looks alien and monstrous.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Qularr_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and stacked back plates; colour 1 on the front panel and under-brow band; colour 3 on the emblem marking; colour 2 in the gaps between plates.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_.description: A close-fitting segmented skullcap of banded plates with a row of round studs around the lower back edge, topped by a textured brow visor that sweeps to a point and two short curved horn spikes at the front.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded side and back plates and the horn spikes; colour 1 on the crown panel; colour 2 on the textured brow visor and rim; the stud dots also take colour 2.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_.description: A close-fitting segmented cap with a swept brow ridge, a round mechanical disc on the forehead, and a row of rivets at the rear. A single crest of long, curved feather-like blades sweeps back from a central ridge.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded cap and the stripes on the crown; colour 1 on the crown panel; colour 2 on the brim edge and crest blades; colour 3 on the glowing slits in the blades and the disc detail.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_.differs: The female crest is a narrow single row of blades sweeping back along the centreline, with one taller spike at the front, while the male crest fans out wider.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_.description: A angular helmet-visor with a pointed brow that covers the forehead and eyes, ribbed segmented plates at the back, and a fan of tall slotted fins sweeping back from the crown like a crest, with a thin central blade.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest fins, centre stripe and rear band; colour 1 on the side and brow plates; colour 2 on the segmented top and back plates; colour 3 on the slots in the fins and small accents.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_.description: A sleek serpent-inspired headdress: a pointed beak-like snout with a gem at the brow, swept-back horn fins on the crown, and a banded segmented rim around the back of the head. Leaves the face open below the snout.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim plates; colour 1 on the fin edges, side bands and lower back band; colour 2 on the snout tip and inner panels; colour 3 on the brow gem.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Spikes_01.description: A row of five curved, tapering horn-like spikes running front to back along the centre of the scalp like a mohawk, each sweeping backward and upward and shrinking in size toward the nape.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shafts of the spikes; colour 1 on the pointed tips; colour 2 on the base ends where the spikes meet the head.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Snake_Headdress_02.description: A close-fitting segmented helmet cap with a pointed brow visor and a round medallion at the front, topped by a fan of long, blade-like crest fins sweeping back from the crown. Rivet-like studs ring the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Snake_Headdress_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded lower cap and stripes on the crown; colour 1 on the upper crown shell; colour 2 on the crest blades, brow edge and medallion rim; colour 3 on the glowing slits in the crest blades.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Spartan_Helmet_01.description: A smooth, rounded Greco-Roman style helmet with a domed crown and a subtle ridge line across the brow. Broad cheek guards drop to points on each side of a T-shaped face opening, with thin contrasting edging.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Spartan_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and cheek guards; colour 1 on the thin edging around the face opening and lower rim.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A small forehead ornament: an oval domed gem in a framed setting with swirling filigree beneath, flanked by pairs of curved, branching horn-like prongs that sweep outward across the brow. Sits on the forehead like a tiara.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed gem; colour 2 on the frame and top nub; colour 0 on the horn prongs; colour 3 on the scrollwork filigree.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Artdeco_01.description: A sleek art-deco style helmet with a tall swept-back fin crest running from brow to beyond the skull, a face plate with eye slits and a nose ridge, and a small pointed flare at each side of the head. Fitted close to the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Artdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face plate, crest edges and outer shell; colour 1 on the curved side panels and stripes; colour 2 on the central crest panel and rear underside; colour 3 on the small accent panels at the temples.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Bandana_01.description: A snug cloth bandana skullcap that sits close over the crown of the head, with gentle gathered folds, a polka-dot pattern, and a small knot at the back with two short pointed tails hanging down.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Bandana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the bandana and the knot tails; colour 1 on the round dot pattern.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Beret_01.description: A soft, rounded cloth beret sitting slightly tilted on top of the head, with a thin contrasting band around the rim and a small badge on the front-left side. Military-style headwear.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Beret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the beret crown; colour 1 on the rim band; colour 3 on the badge.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Biker_01.description: A smooth, rounded open-face half helmet that sits on top of the head like a shell, with a thin contrasting rim around the edge and small rivets on each side. Suggests a biker or retro military style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Biker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the rim band around the edge; the small rivets appear to take the shell colour.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Biker_02.description: A small rounded skull-cap helmet that sits high on the head, with a thin flared rim around the base, a few small rivets along the sides, and a short pointed spike rising from the crown. Suggests a retro biker or military look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Biker_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the rim; colour 1 on the crown spike; the rivets take a metal tone.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Bowler_01.description: A rounded bowler-style hat with a domed crown, a short brim that curves up slightly at the edges, and a contrasting hat band around the base of the crown. It sits on top of the head, tilted slightly forward.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Bowler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Bowlerfeathe.description: A soft bowler-style hat with a rounded crown, a wide slightly wavy brim tilted low over the eyes, a contrasting band around the base of the crown, and a long feather tucked in at one side.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Bowlerfeathe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the feather.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Bronzeking_0.description: A circlet-style crown band wrapped around the head, studded with round rivets and topped by tall thin upright blades, with broad decorated fin-like panels flanking each side. Fantasy, warrior-king styling.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Bronzeking_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upright blades and the band's edge trim; colour 1 on the band and the panel bodies; colour 3 on the etched markings across the side panels; colour 2 on the rivets.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Circlet_Basi.description: A slim circlet band worn around the forehead, dipping to a V-shaped point at the brow with a round gem, and decorated with a lattice weave and swirling scroll motifs along a thin contrasting edge.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Circlet_Basi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front V panel and scroll base; colour 1 on the outer edge trim; colour 2 on the lattice weave and scrollwork; colour 3 on the gem.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Circlet_Basi.differs: The female circlet sits with a deeper, more pronounced V dip at the brow and a slightly taller front panel.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Cone_01.description: A novelty traffic cone worn upright on top of the head: a tall tapered cone with a reflective band around the middle, a small hole at the tip, and a flat square base plate that rests above the head like a hat brim.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Cone_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cone body; colour 0 on the reflective band; colour 2 on the square base plate. Colour 1 is not visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Cooliehat_01.description: A very wide, shallow conical straw coolie hat with fine radiating ribs, a ragged frayed rim edged in contrasting trim, and a small crown with a banded neck ring. It sits low over the head and hides the face.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Cooliehat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cone of the hat and crown; colour 3 on the trim around the rim; colour 1 on the small band at the base of the crown.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Cowboyhat_01.description: A flat-topped cowboy hat with a slightly creased, boxy crown and a wide, gently drooping brim, sitting level on the head and shading the eyes. A simple western style with low-poly faceted edges.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Cowboyhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and the upper side of the brim; colour 2 on the underside of the brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Croc_Tophat_.description: A tall, slightly crumpled top hat with a wide flat brim, a banded strap around the base studded with small contrasting spikes, and a long curved feather tucked in at the side. Sits upright on the head; whimsical gothic-dandy style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Croc_Tophat_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the banded hatband; colour 2 on the small spikes; colour 3 on the feather.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Basic_.description: A slim metal crown band circling the head with three tall pointed peaks at front and back, each tipped with a small round ball. A scrolling swirl pattern and round set gems run along the band, edged with stitched trim.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Basic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band body; colour 1 on the edge trim and the ball tips; colour 3 on the round gems; colour 2 on the swirl line details.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Laurel.description: A laurel wreath circlet of overlapping pointed leaves that wraps around the head just above the brow and ears, thickest at the back, with a leaf-covered band open toward the temples. Classical, regal styling.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Laurel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leaf surfaces; colour 1 on the leaf edges and the veins between overlapping leaves.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked.description: A metal circlet crown with a ring of tall, curved spikes around the head, a taller central spike and a pointed gem-set brow plate at the front. A trim band runs underneath, sitting low on the forehead.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown body and spikes; colour 1 on the underside band; colour 3 on the gems.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked.differs: The female crown has a darker, thicker top rim band around the inside of the spikes, and the spikes rise from a slightly narrower ring.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked.description: A spiked crown circlet sitting on top of the head: a segmented band with tall tapered spikes around it, a pointed front plate with ridged stripes that sweeps forward, and a thin floating hoop hovering above.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown band and spikes; colour 1 on the pointed front plate; colour 2 on the stripe markings on the spikes and plate; colour 3 on the thin hoop above the crown.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked.description: A slim crown circlet sitting on the top of the head, with a low band and tall tapered spikes rising around it. Two longer pointed prongs at front and back, and a thin floating hoop above, give a monstrous, regal look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and short spikes; colour 1 on the long front and back prongs; colour 3 on the thin hoop above the band; colour 2 on the ridged tips of the spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Decoface_01.description: A thin angular face plate covering the lower face from the eyes and nose down to the chin, with zigzag Art Deco edges and two long swept-back horn-like spikes rising past the temples along the sides of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Decoface_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the diagonal stripes on the side fins and the nose-bridge stripe; colour 2 on the horn-like spikes and the outline edging.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Destroyerbot.description: A smooth, rounded full-head helmet with a V-shaped brow cut and a narrow open face slit, edged with contrasting trim. Small spikes stud the sides and back, and a short neck flap trails behind, giving a medieval look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Destroyerbot.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the edge trim around the face opening and lower rim; colour 1 on the small spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Face_Dorag_0.description: A snug cloth bandana or do-rag that covers the top and back of the head, with a hemmed band across the forehead and a knot at the back leaving two short tails hanging behind the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Face_Dorag_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 form a star-like patterned print across the whole cloth; colour 2 shows in the shadowed hem edge.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A small, thin curved plate that sits on top of the head like a single crest fin, running from a pointed tip at the forehead over the crown toward the back. Faceted and smooth, it leaves the rest of the head bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole plate; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.description: A small partial head piece: a smooth plate over the forehead and crown that runs back as a ridge with two thin fins rising from the front and hollow, fin-like ridges behind. It suggests an alien or insectoid crest.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and the fin edges; colour 1 on the inner surfaces of the crest between the fins.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.differs: The female crest sits higher on the crown and its back opening is deeper and more triangular.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.description: A close-fitting helmet that covers the back and sides of the head and the brow, with a swept face opening and a tall thin blade-like fin running front to back along the crown.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the crown fin; colour 1 gives a slight tint on the lower back of the shell.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.description: A thin, blade-like fin crest running front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk, with a swept, scalloped edge that rises toward the back and a pointed base plate on the forehead.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pointed base plate at the forehead; colour 1 on the tall fin panel.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.description: A close-fitting smooth helmet that covers the crown, brow and back of the head, with a slim central crest and a swept-back fin on each side. It leaves the lower face open, giving a sleek, creature-like sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow plate and fins; colour 1 on the rear and side shell of the helmet.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_.differs: The female version has a thin fin ridge on top and no small pointed tabs at the nape.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gasmaskfull_.description: A gas mask hood covering the face and sides of the head, with round eye lenses in rimmed frames, a ribbed cylindrical filter snout over the mouth, and thin straps crossing the crown and back of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gasmaskfull_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and straps; colour 1 on the lens rims; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter snout.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gasmaskfull_.description: A full-face gas mask with a smooth rounded hood-like shell, oval rimmed eye lenses and a twin-canister filter respirator over the mouth, held by thin straps that cross the back and top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gasmaskfull_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and head straps; colour 1 on the lens rims and side valve; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter canisters.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Harlequin_01.description: A snug jester-style cap that hugs the crown and forehead, with several long curved horn-like points radiating outward and upward, each ending in a round bobble. Whimsical harlequin look with a thin edging line.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Harlequin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap and its curved points; colour 1 on the round bobbles at the tips; colour 2 on the thin edge line around the cap.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Hood_Fullope.description: A soft cloth hood with wrinkled folds that covers the top, back and sides of the head and comes forward over the brow, leaving the lower face open. It has a slightly pointed crown and rests loosely on the shoulders.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Hood_Fullope.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood; no other colour slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Hoodbaggy_01.description: A soft cloth hood pulled up over the head, with a rounded crown, gently wrinkled fabric and an open face oval. The edges drape down to the neck and jaw on both sides. Casual, hooded, low-key style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Hoodbaggy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood, including the inner lining; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Medieval_01.description: A smooth, rounded full-head helmet with a central ridge, a V-shaped face opening with a raised rim and a nose bar down the middle, and a row of small rivets on each side. It ends at the neck with an open back.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Medieval_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper dome, fading toward colour 0 on the lower helmet and cheek plates; colour 2 on the edging around the face opening; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Ninjaheadban.description: A cloth ninja-style headband wrapped around the forehead, with a rectangular badge panel at the front and a knot at the back with two short tails hanging down behind the head. Reads as martial-arts or ninja wear.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Ninjaheadban.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, knot and tails; colour 2 on the front badge panel; colour 3 on the small emblem on the badge.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Ninjahood_01.description: A loose cloth hood with a pointed peak and soft wrinkled folds that draws over the head and hangs to the base of the neck. The front opening is shadowed and covers the brow, leaving the lower face bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Ninjahood_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood; no other colour slots are visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Partyhat_01.description: A small cone-shaped party hat with spiral stripes, perched on top of the head at a slight tilt and held by a thin chin strap running down the side of the face. Playful, festive look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Partyhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone body; colour 2 on the spiral stripes and underside; colour 1 on the thin chin strap.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Pointedcap_0.description: A small faceted cap that sits as a narrow pointed patch on the top of the head, tapering to a point on the forehead and running back over the crown; the rest of the head stays bare.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Prisonguard_.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet cap with a raised central strip from brow to crown, layered shell plates, ribbed side panels and a thick padded rear roll around the nape. The face and ears stay uncovered.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Prisonguard_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates and brim; colour 1 on the central strip; colour 3 on the ribbed side inserts; colour 2 on the rear padded roll and the panels around the crown.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Ravenspeaker.description: A close-fitting pilot-style helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, with raised ridges running front to back, angular swept panels, and round ear-mounted speaker pods with small knobs; the face stays open.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Ravenspeaker.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ridges, side shells and ear-pod rings; colour 0 on the swept chevron panels and rear lower edge; colour 2 on the ear pods, inset panels and knobs; colour 3 on the thin stripes and outlines.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A full alien-style helmet with a swept-back crest of pointed blades, a angular brow guard forming a nose-bridge point, ribbed segmented plates over the cheeks and back of the head, and round contrasting ear discs. The mouth and chin are left open.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, crest blades and ribbed plates; colour 3 on the strip beneath the brow; colour 2 on the ear discs.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Roundedcap_0.description: A small, smooth rounded cap panel covering only a narrow strip along the top-front of the head, from the forehead back toward the crown, with a thin edge lip. Suggests a minimal, sleek helmet or head plate.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Roundedcap_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap surface; its thin edge lip shows a slightly darker shade of the same slot.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A samurai kabuto helmet: a rounded, riveted dome with a small top finial, a brim across the forehead, small flared front crests, and a broad neck guard of stacked lames flaring out over the back and sides of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, brim and neck guard plates; colour 1 on the edge trim of the lames and crests; colour 2 on the top finial and the underside of the brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Skullcap_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting skullcap helmet that covers the crown and back of the head down to the nape, with a pointed brow edge and narrow cheek flaps at the temples; the face stays open.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Skullcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap shell; the small gaps at the temples show the inner edge and take no separate colour.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Spiked_01.description: A small, close-fitting rounded skull cap helmet with a seam down the centre and small vent holes at the sides, studded with short cone spikes across the crown, sides and back. Leaves the face and ears bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: An alien mechanical head piece: a smooth curved shell hugs the face and sweeps back into a long spine down the back of the neck, crowned with a fan of angular crest fins and dangling spindly side prongs.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth shell and back spine; colour 1 on the crest fins, side prongs and spine inlay; colour 3 on thin line accents along the shell.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Vine_01.description: A partial face piece of twisting, vine-like tendrils that curl around both eyes and across the brow, with thorn-like tips sweeping up from the forehead and down the cheeks. It leaves the mouth and lower face bare and suggests a fantasy or monstrous style.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine tendrils; colour 0 on the swirled inner panels over the brow and eyes; colour 3 on the thorn-like tips and points.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Viperpsionic.description: A smooth, rounded skull-cap helmet that leaves the face open. Raised curving ridges with small round studs run over the brow and sides, and three thin antenna-like spines sweep back from the crown. Suggests a psionic sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Viperpsionic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the raised ridges and rear panel; colour 3 on the small studs and brow gem; colour 2 on the antenna spines.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Welder_01.description: A boxy welder-style helmet that covers the whole head, with a broad angular shell, a narrow contrasting-lit slot at the chin, two padded rectangular blocks on top, small side bolts and contrasting straps at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Tight_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 on the top pads and rear straps; colour 3 on the visor slot at the front.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Viper_Supremeserpe.description: A snug, open-faced helmet shaped like a serpent's head: a segmented scaled ridge runs front to back over the crown, flanked by sculpted side panels with small eye-like slits and a fanged brow that overhangs the face.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Viper_Supremeserpe.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central scaled crest and lower side bands; colour 2 on the brow, outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the sculpted cheek panels; colour 3 on the eye slits.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_01.description: Werewolf-style fur ruff: a ragged band of jagged fur tufts wraps around the jaw and neck, with longer swept-back tufts at the temples and ears. It leaves the face and top of the head bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tufts at the temples and the fur at the back of the neck; colour 1 on the main body of the jaw and neck fur; colour 3 on the tips of the neck fur; colour 2 on the darker tuft tips.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_01.differs: The female version has a fuller, shaggier ruff at the back of the neck, with longer contrasting fur hanging below the nape.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_02.description: Sparse werewolf-style fur tufts: jagged spiky clumps at the temples and sideburns, plus a ruff of layered feathery fur that wraps under the jaw and around the neck, leaving the head bald.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the temple and sideburn tufts; colour 1 on the upper part of the neck ruff; colour 3 on the tips of the ruff.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_02.differs: The female version has a thinner neck ruff with no ragged tufts hanging below it and no fur at the nape.

Female/F_Helmet_Child_Wooden_01.description: A tribal crown of long pointed leaf-like blades fanning out around the head from the brow to the nape, leaving the face open. It suggests a feathered or carved wooden headdress.
Female/F_Helmet_Child_Wooden_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on alternating blades; colour 1 on the other blades; colour 3 on thin veins along the blades; colour 2 on the narrow band at the brow.

Female/F_Helmet_Corrupted_01.description: A monstrous full helmet with a domed crown, swept-back horn-like spikes and tall blades rising from the top, a jagged face guard with a central ridge, and a flared, angular neck guard covering the lower head.
Female/F_Helmet_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the tall crown horns; colour 1 on the neck guard, lower face plates and side blades; colour 2 on the outlines, side horns and swirling trim; colour 3 on the central crest and the accent spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Cosmos_01.description: A faceted, angular helmet that covers the crown and the back and sides of the head, with an open face and flared panels that taper down past the cheeks and nape. Stacked plates give it a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmet_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed top; colour 0 on the side and back plates; colour 1 on the lower tips of the cheek and nape panels.

Female/F_Helmet_Cowboy_Studded_01.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a pinched, dented crown, a row of small studs or eyelets around the crown, and a contrasting band at its base. The very broad brim sweeps out and shades the face.
Female/F_Helmet_Cowboy_Studded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the underside of the brim and the band's buckle.

Female/F_Helmet_Crimson_01.description: A full armored helmet with a sculpted, mask-like faceplate, swept-back spiked fins at the cheeks and crown, and a segmented neck guard. Two long curved plumes arc upward and outward like antennae, giving a fantasy insectoid look.
Female/F_Helmet_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceplate, spikes and helmet shell; colour 1 on the crest, cheek trim and neck guard bands; colour 2 on the recesses and edge lines; colour 3 on the long plumes.

Female/F_Helmet_Cyborg_Plated_01.description: A close-fitting cyborg skullcap covering the crown and back of the head, with a raised plate running front to back over the top, a small vented block on the forehead panel, and a band around the lower back.
Female/F_Helmet_Cyborg_Plated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap sides and back; colour 1 on the raised top plate; colour 2 on the vented block; colour 3 on the band around the lower back and sides.

Female/F_Helmet_Datareaper_01.description: A chunky sci-fi headset helmet sitting low over the brow: a raised central ridge runs front to back, flanked by rounded side pods with small round lens ports and rectangular plates. A contrasting band covers the eyes.
Female/F_Helmet_Datareaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central shell and ridge; colour 1 on the side pods and front inlay; colour 2 on the eye band, lens ports and rear section; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Defender_Update_01.description: A sleek superhero helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, with a smooth domed top, layered angular side plates, and a contrasting visor band across the eyes. Narrow cheek guards run down each side of the face, leaving the mouth and chin bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and outer plating; colour 1 on the forehead insignia, side plates and rear band; colour 2 on the eye band, top stripe and cheek guard edges; colour 3 on the small accents beside the temples.

Female/F_Helmet_Detective_01.description: A soft fedora-style detective hat with a slightly dented crown, a contrasting band at its base and a wide, gently drooping brim that shades the eyes. Sits on top of the head; pulp noir style.
Female/F_Helmet_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim; colour 1 on the crown; colour 2 on the hat band.

Female/F_Helmet_Draco_01.description: A metal dragon-style full helmet with a smooth domed crown, a pointed beak-like nose guard, and swept-back spikes and fins fanning out from the crown and sides. Angular eye slits sit under trim-edged brow plates.
Female/F_Helmet_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, spikes and side fins; colour 1 on the nose guard and its edging; colour 3 on the brow and eye-slit trim; colour 2 on the central crest spike and inner spikes.
Female/F_Helmet_Draco_01.differs: The side fins on the female helmet are longer and sweep further outward and upward, giving a more flared, wing-like crown.

Female/F_Helmet_Dragon_Silly_01.description: A cartoonish dragon-head helmet with a blunt snout, googly eyes, small antlers and brow ridges, sitting over the head. A band circles the head with side ear discs, fin-like frills and curling whisker wires.
Female/F_Helmet_Dragon_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell, antlers and frills; colour 1 on the band around the head; colour 3 on the side discs and the fangs beneath the snout; colour 2 on the whisker wires, frill outlines and eye pupils.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Bat_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed bat-like ears that rise from the sides of the head and sweep up and slightly outward. Each has a smooth outer shell and a hollow, softly gradient-shaded inner cup.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 0 and colour 1 blend as a gradient across the inner surface, with colour 0 toward the tip and colour 1 toward the base.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Bat_01.differs: The female ears have a skin-toned outer shell that does not take the contrasting colour slot, so the outside shows a different default colour pattern from the male.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Bear_01.description: A pair of rounded, pointed animal ears that sit on the top of the head, each with a soft outer shell and a hollow inner cup filled with tufts of fur. Cute, beast-like and partial.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner fur tufts; colour 2 on the shadowed inner ear hollow.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Cat_Spooky_01.description: A pair of pointed cat ears set on top of the head, with a smooth back and a hollow inner face of jagged, fur-like tufts. Suggests a feline, beastly look.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Cat_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and fur tufts; colour 1 tints the outer shell towards the base; colour 2 in the shaded inner ear hollows.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Corgi_01.description: A pair of large pointed animal ears sitting on top of the head, with a smooth outer shell, a hollow inner cup, and tufts of spiky fur clustered at the base of each ear. Cute, playful beast style.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Corgi_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and fur tufts; colour 1 on the inner ear cups.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Coyote_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears set on top of the head, angled outward. Each has a smooth outer shell and an inner face with jagged, fur-like tufts around the edge. Suggests a coyote or fox.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Coyote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and the fur tufts around the rims; colour 1 on the inner ear faces.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Dinosaur_01.description: A pair of fin-like frills that sweep out and back from the sides of the head at ear level, each with a webbed inner panel edged by long pointed spines. A fantasy, beast-like look.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Dinosaur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer spines and rim; colour 1 on the inner webbed panel; colour 2 on the openings between the ribs; colour 3 as small accents on the panel.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Dragon_01.description: A pair of membranous, bat-like dragon wings that fan out from the sides of the head where ears would be, each with slender curved ribs and swept-back spikes. Fantasy creature look.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribs and spines; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 2 in the shaded patches near the base of the membranes.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Fennec_01.description: A pair of large, pointed fox ears that sit high on the sides of the head, each with a raised outer rim, a lined inner face with contrasting fur tufts, and a small fringe of swept feather-like tufts at the base.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner ear faces; colour 0 on the fur tufts inside the ears.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Feral_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that sit on top of the head and sweep up and outward, with jagged fur-tuft edges and a hollow inner face. Suggests a feral fox or wolf look.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Feral_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces and edge tufts; colour 1 on the inner ear fur.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Ferret.description: A pair of small pointed animal ears with a rounded, slightly crumpled shell and a hollow inner cup, set on top of the head toward the front. Cute, beastlike accessory suited to ferret or cat looks.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Ferret.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 on the inner ear hollows.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Fishmonster_01.description: A pair of fin-like ear frills: stacked, ribbed fan blades that flare outward and sweep down beside each side of the head, ending in points near the jaw. Suggests a fish-monster or aquatic creature look.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Fishmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ridges of the fins; colour 1 on the inner ribs between the ridges; colour 2 on the shaded edges and tips.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Flame_01.description: A pair of large pointed animal-like ears rising from the top of the head, each with a flame-shaped tip, an inner hollow, and a fringe of small feather-like tufts along the front lower edge.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Flame_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer ear shells and edges; colour 2 on the inner ear hollows; colour 0 on the feather tufts and rear panels; colour 3 on the patches near the ear tips.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Goat_01.description: A pair of goat-like ears that sweep out horizontally from the sides of the head, tapering to long pointed tips, with a thin inner rim visible from the front. A monstrous, animal-style head accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear surfaces; colour 2 on the thin inner rim of each ear.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Guardian_01.description: A pair of tall, swept-back pointed ear fins with scalloped, bat-like trailing edges and hollow inner faces, worn high on the sides of the head like dragon or beast ears. Fantasy creature styling.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the ear fins; colour 1 on the inner hollows of the fins.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Guardian_01.differs: The female ears sit a little higher and more upright, with less contrasting showing on the inner faces from the front.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_01.description: A pair of tall, narrow animal ears that point straight up from the top of the head, each a pointed leaf shape with a hollow inner face. Suggests a kangaroo or rabbit costume.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 0 and colour 1 on the inner face of each ear, shading from one to the other.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_01.differs: The female ears stand upright, pointing straight up, while the male ears are angled down and outward.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_02.description: A pair of long, pointed kangaroo ears that splay outward and droop sideways from the top of the head, with a hollow inner face and a contrasting lining visible from behind.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 on the inner lining edge; colour 0 on the inner ear surface.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_02.differs: The female ears flop out sideways and droop nearly horizontal, while the male ears stand upright.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Llama_01.description: A pair of tall, upright animal ears with a furry, textured outer surface and a smooth inner hollow, rising from the top of the head. Cute, beastly costume accent.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the outer ears and rims; colour 1 on the inner ear hollows.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Mask_Lion_01.description: A pair of pointed, triangular feline ears set high on the top of the head, each with a smooth outer shell and an inner face striped with alternating bands. Suggests a lion or cat beast look.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Mask_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer back of the ears; colour 1 on the striped bands inside the ears; colour 2 on the stripes between them.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Mask_Lion_01.differs: The female ears have a contrasting outer shell, whereas the male outer shell takes the light colour slot.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Mouse_01.description: A pair of tall, rounded-oval mouse ears rising from the upper sides of the head, with a rim of skin-toned outer shell and a hollow inner face that fades in tone. Cute animal-costume style.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Mouse_01.colourAreas: The outer shell and rim use the skin tone and ignore the colour scheme; colour 1 on the upper inner surface of each ear, fading toward colour 0 at the base.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Pitbull_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that rise from the top of the head and curve slightly outward, each with a hollow inner cup and a smooth rounded outer shell. Suggests a beastly, pitbull-like look.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Pitbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells of the ears; colour 3 on the inner cups, shading toward colour 2 deeper inside.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Pitbull_01.differs: The female ears are shorter and more upright, and sit closer together on the crown.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Pony_01.description: A pair of pointed, upright animal ears set on top of the head, with soft rounded outer shells, a raised rim and a hollow inner cup. Suggests a pony or unicorn costume.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Pony_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner hollow of each ear.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Rabbit_02.description: A pair of tall, furry rabbit ears rising from the top of the head in a V shape, with tapered pointed tips, tufted fur edges and a hollow inner face. Suggests a cute animal costume.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Rabbit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur of the ears; colour 1 on the fur gradient toward the base; colour 2 on the inner ear hollows.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Set_01.description: A pair of long, tapering monstrous horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping back in a curve with pointed tips and a hollow, lighter inner face along the underside.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Set_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer horn surfaces; colour 0 on the hollow inner face; colour 1 on a small edge of the inner lining.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Set_01.differs: The female horns stand more upright at the front, and their tips curl slightly upward.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Starowl_01.description: A pair of tall, swept-back pointed ears or horns with a hollow cupped interior and a faint ridge line, set high on the forehead and temples. Animal-like, suggesting an owl or griffon.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ear shells; no other slots are visible on this sheet.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Starowl_01.differs: The female version appears entirely in a single colour, with no contrasting tips, no swoosh markings and no separate coloured inner lining.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Suave_Wolf_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed wolf-style ears that sit high on the sides of the top of the head, tilting slightly outward. Each has a smooth rounded outer shell and a hollow inner cup with a thin rim.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Suave_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 1 on the inner cup of each ear.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Techcat_01.description: A pair of pointed cat-ear shells sitting on top of the head, each with a rimmed hard casing, a smooth outer back, and an inner face of striped vent-like slats above a flat panel. Suggests a mechanical feline headpiece.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Techcat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rims; colour 1 on the flat inner panels; colour 3 on the inner stripes; colour 2 on the gaps between the stripes.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Whiterhino_01.description: A pair of short, pointed animal ears that rise from the top of the head and angle outward and slightly back, each a tapered, faceted cone with a narrow base. They suggest a rhino or beast look.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Whiterhino_01.colourAreas: The ears show a skin-like tone that does not follow the test scheme; no colour slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Wolf_Pelt_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed wolf ears that sit on top of the head, angled up and outward. Each has a smooth outer shell, a hollow inner face and small tufts of fur at the base.
Female/F_Helmet_Ear_Wolf_Pelt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 2 on the inner ear hollows; colour 1 on the fur tufts at the base of each ear.

Female/F_Helmet_Emblem_Facemask_01.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem with three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central ring, sitting on the forehead and upper brow like a painted or raised badge. It suggests a sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Helmet_Emblem_Facemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and central nucleus ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Cryogenic_01.description: A sealed cryogenic dome helmet: a tall rounded opaque dome sits on a wide layered collar ring with tubing along the edges and a boxy vented block at the front, plus a plain plate at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Cryogenic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the collar rim; colour 1 on the collar band; colour 3 on the tubing and the front vent slots; colour 2 on the front block and back plate.
Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Cryogenic_01.differs: The female dome is opaque and hides the head, while the male dome is a transparent glass-like bubble that shows the face.

Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Hoses_01.description: A sci-fi enclosed helmet with a clear domed visor, a wide collar ring at the neck, two tall curved back-mounted panels with boxy tips, side canister fittings and looping hoses running around the neck and face.
Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar ring and side canisters; colour 1 on the curved back panels and helmet shell; colour 2 on the mouth vent, box tips and rear plate; colour 3 on the hoses and small lights. The visor is clear glass and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bub.description: A retro sci-fi bubble helmet: a clear egg-shaped dome with a pointed top, set in a chunky angular collar ring with a round vent or port at the chin and a tall panelled plate behind the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bub.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin collar and the clear dome frame; colour 1 on the inner lining behind the face opening; colour 3 on the thin piping lines and the port centre; colour 2 on the rear plate seams. The dome is transparent and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bub.description: A retro sci-fi space helmet with a clear rounded glass bubble over the head, set into a chunky angular collar ring with a large back panel and a round vent port at the chin. Sits over the head and neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bub.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar ring front and chin section; colour 1 on the inner visor lining behind the face; colour 2 on the back panel and side plates; colour 3 on the thin trim lines and the chin port centre. The bubble is clear and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bub.description: A full-enclosure retro sci-fi helmet: an opaque, tall egg-shaped dome with a faceted, pointed crown, a small round lens port at the front chin, and a separate angular plated collar band wrapping the lower back and sides.
