Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bub.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the collar band; colour 1 on the shaded side facets of the dome; colour 3 on the thin trim lines and the lens port; colour 2 on the lens port ring.
Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bub.differs: The female dome has a faceted, low-poly pointed crown, while the male dome is smoother and more rounded.

Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bub.description: A full-enclosure retro sci-fi bubble helmet with a smooth opaque rounded dome, a collar ring around the neck with a single round eye-like port at the front, and a rear panel with thin trim lines.
Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bub.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and neck collar; colour 1 on the rear and side panels; colour 3 on the thin trim lines and the front port centre; colour 2 on the port rim.

Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Warlord_01.description: A full enclosure sci-fi helmet with a large transparent domed visor showing the face, angular side panels, a wide flared collar ring around the neck, small hexagonal side lights and a thin antenna rising from the top.
Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar ring and visor frame; colour 1 on the side and back panels and the tinted visor; colour 2 on the top crest and back centre strip; colour 3 on the collar lights and small side sensors.
Female/F_Helmet_Enclosure_Warlord_01.differs: The female helmet has a see-through visor that reveals the face, whereas the male version has a solid opaque dome front.

Female/F_Helmet_Exartdecohalf_01.description: A smooth retro-futuristic helmet covering the skull and face down to the nose, with narrow eye slits, side panels, and a long swept-back fin that extends past the back of the head ending in a ribbed tail flare.
Female/F_Helmet_Exartdecohalf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central crest, forehead and nose guard; colour 1 on the side panels and rear band; colour 2 on the outline seams; colour 3 not visible; the ribbed fin tip shows a metallic tone.

Female/F_Helmet_F_Graduationcap_01.description: A graduation mortarboard: a flat square board sits atop a short, snug cylindrical skullcap, with a cord running from a centre button to a dangling tassel at the side. Formal, academic and cute.
Female/F_Helmet_F_Graduationcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skullcap band; colour 1 on the flat square board; colour 3 on the tassel and cord; colour 2 on the tassel's top knot.

Female/F_Helmet_F_Varialblerobot_01.description: A blocky, faceted robotic helmet that sits over the crown and sides of the head, with a raised central ridge from front to back, boxy cheek and ear modules, and small side blocks. It leaves the face open.
Female/F_Helmet_F_Varialblerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the central ridge stripe; colour 2 on the lower cheek and ear modules; colour 3 on the small side blocks.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_90s_Mask_01.description: A thin, shell-like face mask covering the brow, nose, cheeks and jaw, with angular eye slits, a notched top edge and separate cheek panels at the sides. It ends in a contrasting chin guard and has a hollow back.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_90s_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face shell and brow edges; colour 1 on the side cheek panels; colour 2 on the chin piece.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_90s_Tech_01.description: A mechanical head band with a central shield-shaped plate on the brow and chunky panelled cheek and ear guards on each side that drop toward the jaw. The face stays open, giving a retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band; colour 1 on the forehead shield, side plates and cheek trim; colour 2 on the recessed mechanical panels and jaw pieces; colour 3 on the thin stripes and small lights.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_90s_Tech_01.differs: The female version has narrower side guards that sit further out from the face, with a less bulky cheek section.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Aci_01.description: A smooth, rounded open-face pilot helmet that covers the crown, sides and back of the head, with a raised band across the back, small rivets, recessed ear panels and a trimmed lower edge that dips over the ears.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Aci_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the lower edge trim and inner ear lining; colour 3 on the recessed ear panels; colour 2 on the inner shadowed edges.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Ancientarmor_02.description: A close-fitting ancient-style helmet with a ridged central crest, a pointed brow guard with a small nose guard, side plates over the ears and a decorative scrolled band around the lower rim. Leaves the face open.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Ancientarmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the scrollwork band and side ornament; colour 2 on the weathered shading and edges.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Anniversary_Nightha.description: A draped cloth hood with a thick cowl collar around the neck and a small point at the back, fitted with a large curved bird-beak mask and angry glowing eye sockets over the face. Suggests a raptor or nighthawk theme.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Anniversary_Nightha.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood and cowl; colour 1 on the beak; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the eye surround trim.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Baseballcap_02.description: A casual baseball cap worn forward: a rounded multi-panel crown with a stiff curved brim over the brow, contrasting stitched seams and piping, and a plain back panel with a small opening at the rear.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Baseballcap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and side panels of the crown; colour 1 on the front panels and brim; colour 2 on the stitched seams and piping.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Baseballcap_03.description: A casual baseball cap worn backwards: a rounded, panelled crown fits snugly over the head, with the stiff curved brim sitting at the nape of the neck. Stitched seams outline the panels and brim.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Baseballcap_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panels of the crown; colour 1 on the brim and the back panels; colour 2 on the stitching and seam lines.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Blackpaladin_01.description: A full-face helmet with a smooth rounded shell, angular eye openings, a sculpted nose and mouth, and cheek guards. Curved horns sweep out from each side and contrasting spikes crown the top and back.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Blackpaladin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and cheek guards; colour 1 on the eye lenses; colour 3 on the curved side horns and the side hex boss; colour 2 on the spikes.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Blackpaladin_01.differs: The female version has a single small hex stud on the back of the shell, while the male has an extra small spike and a second stud.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bonemantis_01.description: A monstrous insect-like head covering with an elongated, tapering skull shape, large bulbous compound eyes on the sides, and a row of small fang-like spines along the jaw. The back is open, showing a ribbed inner lining.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and eye rims; colour 3 on the large eyes; colour 1 on the ribbed inner lining at the back; colour 2 on the mouth opening.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bonemantis_01.differs: The female version has a ribbed inner lining with a raised centre ridge at the back, which shows a contrasting colour, while the male interior is smooth.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bowlerhattall_01.description: A tall, flat-topped hat with a slightly rounded crown and a narrow rounded brim, wrapped by a contrasting band around the base of the crown. Sits upright on top of the head; a classic formal look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bowlerhattall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the band around the base of the crown.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bowlerhattallcard_0.description: A tall, rounded-top hat with a narrow curled brim, a wide contrasting band around the base of the crown, a small square card tucked into the side and a little feather-like tab at the back. Sits upright on the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bowlerhattallcard_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the underside of the brim; the side card and small tab appear to follow colour 0.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bunnyears_01.description: A pair of tall, tapered rabbit ears rising from the top of the head. One ear stands upright and the other bends outward at the tip. Each has a hollow inner face, giving a cute, playful costume look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bunnyears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces and rims; colour 1 on the inner ear lining, fading toward a pinkish skin-like inner tone.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Bunnyears_01.differs: The female ears stand more upright, with one ear bending gently outward at the tip.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cabbyhat_Vitctorian.description: A soft flat cap in a Victorian newsboy style: a low rounded crown made of stitched wedge panels with a short rounded peak at the front and a thin contrasting band around the edge, sitting snug on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cabbyhat_Vitctorian.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown panels and peak; colour 1 on the thin band along the lower edge; colour 2 on the seam lines.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cadethat_01.description: A small soft garrison-style cadet cap that sits on top of the head: a folded cloth crown that peaks along the centre, with a contrasting piped seam running front to back over the top.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cadethat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap fabric; colour 1 on the piping along the centre seam.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cardboard_01.description: A paper-bag style head covering: a boxy, creased sack with a flat folded top that pulls over the whole head, small eye holes on the front, and a ragged, torn lower edge resting at the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bag surface and top; colour 1 on the large curved patches across the front, back and sides; colour 3 on the side panel patch; colour 2 on the jagged lower band.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Catears_01.description: A pair of pointed, triangular cat ears standing upright on the top front of the head, with hollow inner faces and a smooth outer surface. They read as playful, animal-themed costume ears.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Catears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the ears; colour 1 and colour 3 as a gradient on the inner faces of the ears; colour 2 in the shadowed inner base.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Catears_02.description: A pair of small pointed cat ears set on the upper front of the head, each a simple angular triangular shell with a hollow inner face. Cute, animal-like accessory.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Catears_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 and colour 3 blend across the inner ear faces.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Child_Tophat_02.description: A small top hat with a tall, slightly tapered cylindrical crown, a flat top, a wide band around the base and a narrow flat brim with a scalloped edge. It perches on top of the head and suggests a formal, whimsical look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Child_Tophat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Clowncap_01.description: A jester's cap: a snug headband with a thin contrasting stripe and four long, curved, drooping points radiating from the crown, each tipped with a round pom-pom. The points have contrasting inner panels and stitched edging.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Clowncap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap and points; colour 1 on the headband and the inner panels of the points; colour 3 on the thin band stripe and edge stitching; colour 2 on the pom-poms.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Combatnypd_01.description: A rounded, close-fitting tactical helmet with a wide contrasting band around the brow that extends into a short peak at the front, small ear flaps, and a thin chin strap. Sits snugly on the crown of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Combatnypd_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper shell; colour 1 on the front and side panels and ear flaps; colour 2 on the wide brow band; colour 0 on the chin strap.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cosmic_01.description: A sci-fi helmet of faceted armour plates that covers the crown, back and sides of the head. It has a horizontal visor band across the brow, hexagonal side details, a segmented rim and a pointed chin guard, leaving the lower face open.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rear band, visor band and lower neck flare; colour 1 on the crown plates and trim edges; colour 0 on the chin guard and some panel borders; colour 3 on the brow and side accents.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cosmic_01.differs: The female helmet's default colour pattern is mostly near-contrasting on the back and sides, while the male version has large light panels there.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_01.description: A rounded military tech helmet with a solid visor panel pulled down over the eyes, riveted side plates with round ear discs, and a segmented back shell with a ridge line. Sits snug over the whole skull, leaving the lower face bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side plates, back shell and ear discs; colour 1 on the visor panel and crown; colour 0 on the thin etched trim lines across the visor.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_02.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet with a smooth domed crown, segmented side plates with bolt holes and a round earpiece disc on each side. The visor is raised, leaving the face open, and a ridged band wraps the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown panel and small trim stripes; colour 0 on the side and rear plates and the earpieces; colour 2 on the rear band and gaps.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_03.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet with a smooth cloth-like crown, riveted plated sides, a banded rear neck guard, a tall thin antenna, and ear cups with a boom microphone curving toward the mouth.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown and the trim stripes; colour 0 on the side plates, ear cups, rear band and microphone; colour 2 on the antenna and the ear cup housings.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_01.description: A classic cowboy hat with a creased, softly dented crown and a wide brim that curves up slightly at the sides. It sits low over the brow, giving a western look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and upper brim; the underside of the brim shows darker shading.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_02.description: A wide-brimmed western cowboy hat with a tall, flat-topped, boxy crown with soft creases and a broad, nearly flat brim that angles slightly down at the edges. Sits high on the head, shading the eyes.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; the underside of the brim takes a darker shade of the same colour.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Crumpled_.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a soft, crumpled crown that is dented and creased, and a flat, slightly wavy brim all round. It sits on top of the head, with a casual, worn western look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Crumpled_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, brim and crown alike; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Crumpled_.description: A battered wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a crumpled, dented crown and a ragged, uneven brim pocked with small holes and worn edges; sits on top of the head with a weathered, tattered look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Crumpled_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, including crown and brim; the holes show gaps rather than a separate colour.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Gunslinge.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, creased crown pinched into a notch at the front and back. The brim is broad and slightly drooping, and the hat sits low over the brow. A western gunslinger style.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Gunslinge.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, both crown and brim; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Steampunk.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy-style hat with a tall flat-topped crown, a broad sloping brim that droops low over the face, and a studded band with a pair of small goggle lenses on the front. Steampunk western look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Steampunk.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim and the band's upper strip; colour 2 on the crown sides and goggle lenses; colour 3 on the crown top and goggle detailing; colour 1 on the lower hat band and goggle straps.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Tall_01.description: A ten-gallon cowboy hat with a tall, softly creased crown that pinches at the top and a wide, slightly drooping brim. It sits low over the brow, in a classic western style.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Tall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; the underside of the brim takes colour 2.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_01.description: A cowboy hat with a tall, softly creased crown and a wide, irregular brim that dips and curls unevenly at the sides. It sits on top of the head, giving a rough western look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_02.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, creased crown and a brim curled up at the sides. Worn tilted low over the brow, with small worn holes and ragged edges giving a battered frontier look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; the small holes and worn spots show other colours only faintly.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_02.description: A translucent, ghostly cowboy hat with a tall pinched crown and a wide, uneven brim that flares and curls unevenly at the sides. It sits on top of the head, with a thin band around the crown base.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_02.colourAreas: The default material is see-through and glassy, so it largely ignores the colour scheme; only faint tinting shows on the crown and brim edges.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_03.description: A translucent, ghostly cowboy hat with a tall, slightly dented crown, a thin band around its base and a wide, uneven brim that curls up at the sides. It sits on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_03.colourAreas: The default material is translucent and glassy, so it mostly ignores the colour scheme; the band shows a faint metallic tint.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Creepy_01.description: A hollow face mask with a long, beak-like pointed chin, a raised central ridge stripe, and swirling raised brow motifs around the eye openings. It covers the face only and looks like a monstrous ritual mask.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Creepy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the central ridge stripe; colour 3 on the raised swirls around the eyes; colour 2 on the thin angular lines near the chin.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Crownsasquatch_01.description: A tribal crown: a flat-topped stitched headband sits on the crown of the head, ringed with tall curved blade-like plumes carved with spiral patterns, a thin central spike, and two narrow cloth flaps hanging by the cheeks.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Crownsasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband and hanging flaps; colour 3 on the tall plumes and central spike; colour 2 on the banding across the plume bases; colour 1 on the stitching.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a low, pinched crown, a broad gently drooping brim with a contrasting edge, and a band of segmented blocks around the base of the crown with thin vertical accents. Sits on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper brim; colour 1 on the segmented hatband; colour 3 on the thin crown accents; colour 2 on the brim edge and underside of the brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cyberpunk_01.description: A two-part cyberpunk head piece: a wide curved visor shield covering the eyes and upper face with a nose notch, plus a separate segmented plate across the crown. The bare head shows between them.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Glossy metallic default material largely ignores the scheme; faint colour 1 sheen along the visor and crown plate edges.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Dinosuit_01.description: A full-head dinosaur costume mask with a rounded, soft-looking snout, open jaw showing small pointed teeth, large round eyes, and a row of angular spikes running down the crown and back of the head. It sits over the whole head, with the face visible inside the open mouth.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell and snout; colour 1 on the eye rings and teeth; colour 3 on the pupils; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Feather_01.description: A full-head bird mask with a long pointed beak, hexagonal eye plates and a jagged-edged brow border, crowned by a ring of spiky feathers that fan around the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and feathers; colour 1 on the beak and eye plate insets; colour 3 on the jagged trim around the face edge.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Fedora_01.description: A classic fedora with a short, softly creased crown and a narrow brim that slopes slightly down around the head. A wide band circles the base of the crown, with a thin edge line and a small contrasting patch at the front-right.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Fedora_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 1 on the thin edging lines along the band; colour 3 on the small patch on the band.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Fedorabig_02.description: A wide-brimmed fedora with a tall, softly creased crown and a broad flat brim that sits low over the eyes. A band wraps the base of the crown, with a contrasting patch at the front-right.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Fedorabig_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hatband; colour 3 on the patch on the band; colour 1 on a thin edge line along the band.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Fedoraflat_03.description: A wide-brimmed flat-topped fedora with a softly pinched, dented crown and a broad drooping brim that shades the eyes. A band circles the base of the crown with a contrasting patch at the front. Zoot-suit or noir style.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Fedoraflat_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 3 on the patch at the front of the band.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Fishinghat_01.description: A soft cloth bucket-style fishing hat with a rounded crown and a short downward-sloping brim edged in contrasting trim. A strap band with rows of eyelets circles the crown. It sits on top of the head, casual and outdoorsy.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Fishinghat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the brim edge trim; colour 2 on the band around the crown; colour 3 on the eyelets.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Flower_01.description: A full helmet shaped like a flower head: a rounded cap with a face opening ringed by a ring of plump, pointed petals that flare outward around the head, joined by segmented bands at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the petal outsides and back of the cap; colour 1 on the petal centre stripes, the inner face surround and the cap panel; colour 2 on the crown top and the segmented band behind the petals; colour 3 on a small accent at the neck.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Foxbat_Classic_01.description: A full-head helmet with two large pointed bat-like ears, a central crest running down over the brow and nose, and ribbed inner ear linings. Eye openings and an open jaw guard leave the mouth exposed.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Foxbat_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, ear rims and jaw guard; colour 1 on the top crest, nose stripe and inner ears; colour 3 on the ribs inside the ears.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Foxbat_Classic_01.differs: The female helmet has slightly broader, more flared ears and a more open, wider jaw guard than the male one.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_03.description: A domed gladiator-style helmet with a ring of contrasting spikes around the crown and brow, a tribal face-like emblem on the forehead, ribbed cheek guards, a slotted face bar and a ridged flared rim at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet dome and face bars; colour 1 on the ribbed cheek guards and rear rim; colour 2 on the spikes; colour 3 on the forehead emblem and markings.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alienf_01.description: A full helmet with a smooth bell-shaped dome that flares out at the back and sides, a slatted mesh face grille with a rimmed lower edge, and a row of tall flat fins running along the crown. Gladiator-like with an alien feel.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alienf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the rim; colour 1 on the crest fins; colour 2 on the grille mesh; colour 3 on the grille slots.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alienf_02.description: A full alien gladiator helmet with a smooth elongated crest that sweeps forward over the brow, swept-back fin-like ridges on top, and a flared rear skirt with engraved trim. An open face panel ends in a pointed chin guard.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alienf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and rear skirt; colour 1 on the face panel and chin guard; colour 2 on the swept ridges and side vents; colour 3 on the small fang-like tips beside the face.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alienf_02.description: A full-head alien helmet shaped like a reptilian beast's skull, with a long snout brow, swept-back fin blades on the crown and sides, hanging fang-like spikes at the front, and an engraved scrollwork band around the flared rear rim.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alienf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and engraved band; colour 2 on the swept fin blades and side plates; colour 3 on the front fangs.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hardhat_01.description: A rounded construction-style hardhat with moulded ridges along the crown, a short brim all round, a wide band circling the base and a rectangular badge panel with an emblem at the front.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hardhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and brim; colour 2 on the band and the badge frame; colour 1 on the badge panel; colour 3 on the small emblem in the badge.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hardhat_02.description: A rounded construction-style hardhat with a short brim and moulded ridges, banded by a wide strap around the crown. A hexagonal headlamp with a lens sits at the front on a mounting plate.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hardhat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat shell and brim; colour 2 on the band and lamp mounting plate; colour 1 on the lamp housing; colour 3 on the lamp lens.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hat_Chef_01.description: A tall, puffy chef's hat of soft gathered cloth with vertical folds, billowing above a plain snug headband that sits around the forehead. A playful, casual novelty head piece.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hat_Chef_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 blend across the puffed cloth crown, with colour 1 toward the top; colour 2 on the band around the head.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hat_Crown_01.description: A regal royal crown with a band around the head, arched metal bands rising to a central finial, and a padded cap between the arches with diamond-shaped cutouts. Sits on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hat_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, arches and finial; colour 1 on the padded cap; colour 2 on the diamond patterns; colour 3 on the studs along the band.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hat_Crown_02.description: A tall royal crown with a band of small heart-shaped studs, tall pointed metal arches at front and back, and puffy padded cushion panels filling the gaps. A cross-shaped finial and small spikes rise from the top.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hat_Crown_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, arches and finials; colour 1 on the padded cushions; colour 3 on the heart studs and trim details; colour 2 on the front gem.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hat_Fur_01.description: A tall, cylindrical fur hat with a flat top and thick shaggy sides, sitting on the crown of the head. Its soft, fluffy texture suggests a Russian ushanka-style winter hat.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hat_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the flat top; colour 2 on the band just below the top; colour 1 on the middle of the sides; colour 0 on the lower rim.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Headset_01.description: A slim communications headset: a thin band arcs over the top of the head to a rounded earcup on one side, with a thin boom microphone curving toward the mouth and a tall whip antenna rising behind. A small flat pad sits over the other ear.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Headset_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband, earcup, microphone boom, antenna and ear pad; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hockey_Mask_01.description: A hockey-style face mask with a smooth rounded shell, angled eye slits, drilled ventilation holes across the cheeks and chin, and a pointed chin. Straps with small studs wrap around a rear cap covering the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Hockey_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and the rim around the back; colour 1 on the rear head cap; colour 2 on the strap bars; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Holiday_Hat_01.description: A soft slouchy Santa-style holiday hat with a thick, textured fur-like cuff around the head and a crumpled cone of cloth that droops to one side, ending in a round pompom.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Holiday_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth cone of the hat; colour 1 on the fur cuff band; colour 2 on the pompom.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Horsemask_01.description: A full-head cartoon horse mask with a long muzzle, bulging round eyes, upright pointed ears, a spiralled unicorn horn on the forehead and a small flap opening at the back of the neck. Sits over the whole head as a novelty or beast look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Horsemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main head shell; colour 2 on the muzzle, ears and around the eyes; colour 0 on the forehead blaze and horn tip; colour 1 on the eyes and horn spiral.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Horsemask_01.differs: The female mask has a spiralled unicorn horn on the forehead and contrasting-ringed eyes; the male version has no horn.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Huntershat_01.description: A fur-look trapper cap with a rounded, paneled crown, a short front brim, a banded edge with contrasting trim and fold-down ear flaps tied with thin dangling cords. Sits snugly on the head in a rugged hunter style.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Huntershat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown panels, brim and ear flaps; colour 1 on the alternating crown panels; colour 2 on the trim band and ties; colour 3 on the small tip at the crown top and flap details.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Jester_01.description: A cloth jester's cap with two long floppy horns that curve back and down past the shoulders, each ending in a small metal star. A banded brim with diamond-shaped gems circles the forehead.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Jester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one horn and half of the cap; colour 1 on the other horn and half of the cap; colour 2 on the brim band; colour 3 on the diamond gems on the brim; the star tips are a metallic finish.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_01.description: A close-fitting ribbed knit skullcap that sits snugly over the top of the head, ending just above the brow and ears, with two thin contrasting stripes running around the rolled edge. Casual, plain cold-weather style.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed knit body of the cap; colour 1 on the two stripes around the brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_02.description: A snug, smooth swim cap that hugs the skull like a second skin, with gentle wrinkles across the crown and two thin contrasting bands circling the lower edge just above the brow and ears.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap; colour 1 on the two thin bands around the rim.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_01.description: A snug cloth luchador wrestling mask covering the whole head, with a stitched seam over the crown, cut-out eye, nose and mouth openings edged in contrasting trim, and a low rear edge at the nape.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the mask; colour 1 on the trim around the eye, nose and mouth openings.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_02.description: A snug cloth luchador wrestling mask covering the whole head, with large angular eye openings and a mouth opening, each edged in contrasting trim. A visible seam runs over the crown and it ends at the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the mask; colour 1 on the trim around the eye and mouth openings.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_03.description: A fabric luchador wrestling mask that covers the whole head, with a stitched seam over the crown and back, angular eye openings and a mouth opening framed by raised contrasting trim, and a short flap at the nape.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the mask; colour 1 on the raised trim around the eyes, nose and mouth; the eye and mouth openings show the mannequin's skin.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_04.description: A close-fitting wrestler's hood covering the whole head, with stitched seams over the crown and back, large angular eye openings and a mouth opening, each edged with thick contrasting trim. It ends at the base of the skull.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the hood and seam stitching; colour 1 on the trim around the eye and mouth openings.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_05.description: A close-fitting luchador-style full-head mask that covers the skull, face and chin, with openings at the eyes and a jagged-edged crown panel. Contrasting panels wrap the sides and back, with a small trim at the chin.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Maskluchadora_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown panel and back of the head; colour 1 on the side and forehead panels; colour 2 on the face area and the back bands; colour 3 on the chin trim and small forehead accent.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Militarytall_01.description: A tall, straight-sided cylindrical military shako-style hat with a flat top, a wide contrasting band around the lower half, and a short stiff peak jutting forward over the brow.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Militarytall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crown and the peak; colour 1 on the wide lower band.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Mooseskull_01.description: A moose skull helmet with a long bony snout over the face and wide palmate antlers splaying upward and outward, tipped with sharp points. A hanging cloth panel drapes over the back of the head and neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Mooseskull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and antlers; colour 2 on the swirling markings, antler tips and band at the base of the cloth; colour 1 on the hanging cloth panel.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Mountie_01.description: A wide-brimmed campaign-style hat with a tall, tapered crown pinched at the top and a broad, gently drooping flat brim. A band with a small contrasting patch at the front circles the base of the crown.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Mountie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 3 on the small patch at the front of the band; colour 1 on thin edge piping.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Ninja_Mask_01.description: A cloth ninja-style balaclava covering the whole head and lower face, with a horizontal eye slit and rumpled fabric folds around the mouth and cheeks. It gathers snugly at the neck with a loose, wrinkled drape.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Ninja_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth hood and face wrap; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Officerhat_01.description: A peaked officer's cap with a wide flat crown that flares over a short band, a small stiff visor at the front, and thin piping around the crown edge. Sits on top of the head in a naval or military style.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Officerhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and band; colour 1 on the visor; colour 3 on the stitched trim strip around the band; colour 2 on the piping edges and a thin strip at the back of the band.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Officerhat_01.differs: The female cap has a contrasting band strip across the back, which the male cap lacks.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Patriot_Mask_01.description: A close-fitting skullcap helmet with a central raised stripe, a banded rim, and an atom-style emblem on each side. Twin round goggle lenses sit over the eyes, with a pointed beak-like nose guard below. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Patriot_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap shell and rim band; colour 2 on the central stripe; colour 1 on the goggle housings, beak guard, lower edge trim and atom emblems; colour 3 on the goggle lenses.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A short, tricorn-style pirate cap sitting high on the head, with a rounded crown, upturned pointed corners edged in contrasting trim, a small contrasting emblem at the front and a large swept plume of feathers rising from the top and back.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap body and feather quills; colour 1 on the edge trim and the feather vanes; colour 2 on the front emblem and feather tips; colour 3 on the thin piping and feather midribs.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Pirate_Hat_Feather_.description: A tricorne pirate hat with a rounded crown and a wide, wavy brim turned up into three points, edged in contrasting piping and studded underneath, with a band around the base and a cluster of long feathers swept out from one side.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Pirate_Hat_Feather_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper brim; colour 3 on the brim edge piping; colour 1 on the hat band and some feather tips; colour 2 on the underside of the brim and the front emblem.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Piratehatwide_03.description: A wide-brimmed tricorn pirate hat with a low crown and brim folded up into curved peaks at the front, back and sides, edged with contrasting trim. It sits on top of the head, leaving the face uncovered.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Piratehatwide_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hat body and brim; colour 1 on the edge trim along the folded brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Piratehatwide_04.description: A tricorn pirate hat with a rounded crown and a broad brim folded up into three points, edged with contrasting binding. Small stitched cross marks decorate the brim sides. It sits on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Piratehatwide_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and inner brim; colour 1 on the brim edge binding; colour 2 on the cross stitch marks; colour 3 on a thin line under the brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Plague_Mask_01.description: A plague-doctor mask with a long downward-curving beak, round eye openings with rims, and rows of studs along the edges. A thin strap band loops over the top of the head to hold it on the face.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Plague_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and beak; colour 1 on the studs along the edges and the eye rims; colour 0 on the head strap.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Police_01.description: A police-style peaked cap with a soft, full rounded crown, a narrow contrasting band around the base, a short curved visor at the front, and a small shield-shaped badge above the visor. Sits level on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Police_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown; colour 3 on the band around the base; colour 1 on the visor; colour 2 on the badge patch.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Qlyphotic_01.description: A monstrous full-head helm with a rounded domed crown, a thin central crest, swept-out curved horns at each side and a masked face with small studs, plus a long veil-like drape falling to the knees with a tattered, hole-ridden hem and two trailing streamers.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Qlyphotic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, mask and upper drape; colour 1 on the horns, crest and the lower drape and streamers, fading in as a gradient; colour 3 on the small eye and stud details.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Reactor_01.description: An angular faceted helmet with a contrasting pointed visor opening over the eyes, two tall swept-up horn-like fins on top, and slim side cheek pieces with small hinged jaw guards; leaves the mouth and chin bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the horn fins and cheek and jaw pieces; colour 2 on the visor opening; colour 3 on the small side lights.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Reactor_02.description: A full-head sci-fi helmet with a smooth domed crown, two tall pointed ear fins, a swept visor-like band across the face, a fanged lower jaw guard and a bulky segmented padded collar at the back of the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell, ear fins and jaw guard; colour 1 on the side bands, the crown tint and the padded neck collar; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Reactor_04.description: A sleek, angular sci-fi helmet covering the whole head, with a smooth domed crown, raised ridged crest panels, a pointed V-shaped face guard and a wide flared collar band at the base with vented side inserts.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and outer edge trim; colour 1 on the face guard and lower collar band; colour 2 on the crest ridges; colour 3 on the side vent inserts and small rivets.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Reindeer_01.description: A cute soft cloth beanie cap with a banded brim, small ear flaps at the sides, two eyes and a round nose on the front, and a pair of branching antlers rising from the top.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Reindeer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap body and ear flaps; colour 2 on the antlers and the brim band; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the nose.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Sharkfin_01.description: A close-fitting, smooth head covering with a tall curved fin sweeping up and back from the crown, a diagonal band across the brow, and a pointed lower edge over the nose. It leaves the mouth and chin bare, in a shark-like superhero style.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin tip and the pointed lower edge; colour 1 on the main hood surface; colour 2 on the diagonal band across the brow; colour 3 on the small side panels.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Sharkfin_02.description: A close-fitting full-head hood with a tall, backswept shark-fin crest running along the crown, angular contrasting panels across the brow and sides, and a pointed chin section. The face is covered.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Sharkfin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin tip and the chin and lower-back panels; colour 1 on the main hood sides and the central crest strip; colour 2 on the top brow panel and the back neck patch; colour 3 on the small side inset panels.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Socrates_01.description: A smooth, elongated full-head helmet that tapers to a point above the crown, with a blank faceplate and thin contrasting trim lines running down the front and sides. The back has a small panel with three dots and a rear vent.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 3 on the trim lines, the dots and the small nub at the top; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Socrates_02.description: An alien full-head helmet with a smooth, elongated dome ending in a crown of jagged spikes at the top, with a pointed chin, teardrop eye openings at the sides and thin vein-like ridges across the surface.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Socrates_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spikes; colour 3 on the branching vein lines and the slashes near the face.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Space_01.description: A sleek sci-fi helmet with a smooth domed shell that has a large V-shaped opening at the front, so the face shows. A pointed mask covers the lower face and jaw. Thin contrasting trim outlines the opening.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed shell; colour 3 on the trim around the front opening; colour 1 on the lower face mask and the rim edge; colour 2 on the darker mask insert.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Steam_Plague_Mask_0.description: A full-head plague doctor mask shaped like a bird skull, with a long pointed beak, round goggle-style eye lenses, stitched-look markings, a padded cap with cut-out openings and a crown of tall spikes around the top.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Steam_Plague_Mask_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull-like shell and crown spikes; colour 3 on the padded cap panels; colour 1 on the stitch markings; colour 2 on the beak tip and the eye lens rims.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A partial, open-faced helmet shell covering the crown and forehead, with a smooth curved plate that extends into a beak-like nose guard and a bordered rim with thin side flaps beside the cheeks. Suggests a bird-people costume.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forehead and crown plate; colour 2 on the raised rim, nose guard and side flaps.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tight_Paintball_01.description: An open-topped visor band that circles the head like a sun visor, with a wide angular brim projecting over the eyes. The brim has a raised central panel and textured, carbon-like inserts. Sporty sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tight_Paintball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and rim; colour 1 on the raised central brim panel; colour 2 on the underside of the brim; colour 3 on the textured rear band and inner strip.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tight_Russianhat_01.description: A fur ushanka cold-weather hat with a rounded crown, a front brim panel and side ear flaps, with a textured shaggy surface and contrasting edging between the panels. It sits snugly on the head, leaving the face open.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tight_Russianhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back panel and the upper crown fur; colour 1 on the front brim panel and the ear flaps; colour 2 on the edging between panels.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01.description: A tall, slightly tapered top hat with a flat crown, a broad flat brim and a wide contrasting band around the base of the crown. It sits high on the head, giving a formal, gentlemanly look.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01_Glitter.description: A tall top hat with straight cylindrical crown, a flat top and a modest wavy brim, wrapped by a wide contrasting band around the base of the crown. The surface has a flecked glitter texture. Sits upright on the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim, with a speckled glitter texture; colour 1 on the hat band.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01_Glitter.differs: The female hat is a plain top hat, without the large "10" numerals attached to the front of the band.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tophat_Wizards_01.description: A tall cloth top hat with a slightly slanted crown, creased fabric and a narrow flat brim, wrapped in a knotted band whose ragged ribbon tails hang down the back of the neck. Sits on the head; whimsical wizard or formal style.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tophat_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band and hanging ribbon tails.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Tophat_Wizards_01.differs: The ribbon tails hang from the back of the hat and fall behind the neck, with a shorter brim. The male tails are longer and hang further down the back.

Female/F_Helmet_Face_Witch_01.description: A classic witch hat: a tall, crumpled cone that curls to a bent tip, with a wide wavy brim and a contrasting band around the base of the cone. It sits on top of the head, and the brim shades the eyes.
Female/F_Helmet_Face_Witch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone and the brim; colour 1 on the band around the base of the cone.

Female/F_Helmet_Facemask_Defender_01.description: A close-fitting cloth cowl-style head mask covering the skull and upper face with eye and nose openings, a diamond-shaped forehead plate, and angular swept-back side plates with slashed vents over the ears.
Female/F_Helmet_Facemask_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl and face cover; colour 1 on the forehead diamond and side plates; colour 3 on the chevron mark and the slashes in the side plates.

Female/F_Helmet_Facemask_Lockbox_65_01.description: A fox-like face mask covering the brow, eyes and nose, with two tall pointed ears tipped by small beads, a raised central crest plate with a club-shaped emblem, and flared scalloped cheek edges.
Female/F_Helmet_Facemask_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mask shell and ear tips; colour 0 on the crest plate, ear edging and trim lines; colour 2 on the club emblem and ear interiors.

Female/F_Helmet_Falcon_01.description: A falcon-themed full head mask helmet with a hooked beak over the nose and mouth, angry eye openings, swept-back wing-like feather blades rising from the sides, and dangling feather tufts at the cheeks.
Female/F_Helmet_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and wing feathers; colour 1 on the beak, brow crest and headband; colour 2 on the crest feathers and eye surround; colour 3 on the cheek tufts and eye glints.

Female/F_Helmet_Fox_01.description: A full cartoon fox head mask with a pointed snout, upright rounded ears, and rows of small leaf-like spikes over the crown and back. It has a contrasting lower jaw with a toothy grin and contrasting hollow eye sockets.
Female/F_Helmet_Fox_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head and ears; colour 1 on the lower jaw and the tips of the scale-like spikes; colour 3 on the teeth and mouth lining; colour 2 on the nose.
Female/F_Helmet_Fox_01.differs: The female version has hollow contrasting eye sockets instead of the big round cartoon eyeballs.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Anniversary_Defende.description: A full-coverage retro superhero helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a raised U-shaped band over the crown, a broad panel on each side of the crown and a large clear visor across the face. Open at the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Anniversary_Defende.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell and the centre crown panel; colour 0 on the U-shaped band and the trim lines around the visor and lower edge; colour 3 on the side crown panels; the visor is a translucent panel that ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Anniversary_Defende.differs: The female helmet has a see-through visor panel across the face, while the male version has a solid faceplate.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Bounty_01.description: A full-coverage sci-fi bounty hunter helmet with a smooth domed shell, a raised central crest ridge running front to back, a T-shaped visor opening and two horizontal bands around the head. Trimmed edges give a rugged military look.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome and face plate; colour 3 on the crest ridge and edge trim; colour 1 on the rear panel and inset cheek panels; colour 2 on the horizontal bands and the visor and rim edging.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Bounty_02.description: A full-coverage helmet in a Spartan-like style: rounded shell with a raised central crest ridge, a T-shaped open face slot, flared rear neck guard, and boxy ear-mounted modules on each side.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek and side plates; colour 1 on the top panels and brow band; colour 2 on the crest, outer shell edging and rear shell; colour 3 on the side ear modules.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Cosmos_02.description: A full-head angular helmet with a pointed V-shaped front that tapers to a chin point, a faceted crown plate, a recessed diamond panel at the brow, and winged points flaring at the rear corners.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and front shell plates; colour 3 on the V-shaped stripe along the front edge; colour 1 on the rear shell, side panels and flared points; the glossy metal finish mutes the scheme on the crown.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Cosmos_02.differs: The brow diamond is the same colour as the shell rather than a separate contrasting panel, and the front stripe reads with metallic shading.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Sandstorm_01.description: A rounded, full-head helmet with an open face and a smooth shell. A ridged crest band runs front to back, with a separate inset panel on top, a stepped brow plate, and angular cheek guards framing the face.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the crest band, brow plate and rear plate; colour 3 on the inset top panel; colour 2 on the cheek guards and rear vents.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Techno_01.description: A full-coverage techno helmet made of faceted, hexagonal armour plates, with a raised centre ridge, vented ear pods, a swept V-shaped visor panel and an open chin guard. It sits over the whole head and suggests a sci-fi or cyber look.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, ridge and ear pod housings; colour 3 on the visor panel and ear vents; colour 1 on the cheek panels, the forehead badge and the rear neck light.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Trooper_01.description: A full-coverage sentai-style helmet with a smooth rounded dome, a contrasting band across the brow, angular visor recess, octagonal ear discs and a pointed lower jaw guard with a ribbed vent panel at the mouth.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and face shell; colour 2 on the brow band and ear discs; colour 1 on the jaw guard and neck section; colour 3 on the mouth vent.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Trooper_02.description: A full-coverage sentai-style helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a raised central fin from brow to nape, chevron stripes at the back, angular side vents and an open angular mouth cutout. Sits over the whole head.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Trooper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the stripes and trim lines; colour 2 on the crest fin and side pods; colour 3 on the mouth opening.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Trooper_03.description: A full-face sentai-style helmet with a smooth rounded shell, large angular eye lenses framed by chevron stripes, a toothy grille mouth and a band around the jaw with square ear modules on each side.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Trooper_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the crown panel, chevron stripes and eye rims; colour 1 on the jaw band and ear modules; colour 3 on the mouth grille.

Female/F_Helmet_Full_Trooper_04.description: A full-face sentai-style helmet with a smooth rounded dome, a large pointed visor plate edged in a contrasting rim, a chin guard band, side pods with small square inserts, and two tall slanted antenna fins rising from the sides.
Female/F_Helmet_Full_Trooper_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, visor plate and side pods; colour 1 on the chin guard band; colour 2 on the visor rim; colour 3 on the antenna fins and side pod inserts.

Female/F_Helmet_Fullbandana_01.description: A close-fitting cloth head wrap that covers the whole scalp and brow, with a knotted tie and short loose ends at the back. A small atom-style emblem sits on the forehead. A superhero look.
Female/F_Helmet_Fullbandana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap fabric; colour 1 on the atom emblem; the knot uses colour 0.

Female/F_Helmet_Fullhelmet_Crown_Spiked_.description: A spiked metal crown band circling the head, with tall curved blade-like spikes rising around it, a taller central spike over a pointed brow guard, and a small teardrop gem at the front.
Female/F_Helmet_Fullhelmet_Crown_Spiked_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, brow guard and spikes; colour 1 on the inner band strip; colour 3 on the teardrop gems.

Female/F_Helmet_Gem_Crown_01.description: A crown of tall, jagged crystal shards rising from a ring of smaller chunky crystals that circles the top of the head. The shards fan upward and outward in a spiky, fantasy style.
Female/F_Helmet_Gem_Crown_01.colourAreas: The crystal material is glossy and largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint from colour 1 shows in the crystal ring and some facets.

Female/F_Helmet_Gladiator_01.description: A gladiator-style helmet with a rounded, plated dome, a central raised crest panel, a T-shaped visor opening, and tall swept-back horn-like fins at the temples. A flared neck guard drops behind the head and small round side discs cover the ears.
Female/F_Helmet_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side plates and swept horn fins; colour 1 on the central crest and dome panels and the edge trim; colour 2 on the neck guard, ear discs and inside of the visor.

Female/F_Helmet_Gladiator_02.description: A gladiator-style helmet with a domed crown, a central ridge, a nose guard and open face, and cheek plates. Swept-back winged fins with layered feather-like blades flare from each side, and a rounded neck guard covers the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, nose guard, central ridge and the outer wing spikes; colour 1 on the dome panels, neck guard and upper wing blades; colour 2 on the middle wing layer; colour 3 on the zigzag inlay lines and lower wing blades.

Female/F_Helmet_Gladiator_03.description: A full-coverage domed gladiator helmet with a tall rounded crown, a cluster of small round breathing holes on the front, and a thick padded rim at the neck. Battle-scratch gouges and stains mark the surface.
Female/F_Helmet_Gladiator_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the padded neck rim; colour 3 on the scratches, stains and rim stitching.

Female/F_Helmet_Guardian_01.description: A full dragon-head helmet with a snouted muzzle, bulging eyes, swept-back flame-like fins at the temples, a furry mane around the jaw, and two branching antler horns on top; worn over the whole head, leaving the mouth visible.
Female/F_Helmet_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout, fins and antlers; colour 1 on the fur mane, antler rings and line patterns; colour 2 on the crown plate and swirl details; colour 3 on the nose studs, eyes and flame edges.

Female/F_Helmet_Hair_Victorian_01.description: A voluminous, chin-length hairstyle swept up into a tall rounded mass on top with a small bun or knot at the crown; it is built from chunky sections with pointed tips at the fringe and nape, in a Victorian updo style.
Female/F_Helmet_Hair_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and lower sections of the hair; colour 1 on the top and side sections; colour 2 on the front swept section and the crown knot; colour 3 on the patch at the side.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_01.description: A close-fitting half helmet that covers the crown, sides and back of the head, leaving the face open. A layered upper shell with a swept-back brow ridge sits over a smooth lower cap, with thin piping and a rim band at the base.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower cap and inner lining; colour 1 on the upper shell; colour 3 on the rectangular side patches; colour 2 on the piping and bottom rim.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_02.description: A close-fitting half helmet like a swim cap, with a smooth rounded crown, a ridge of separate side and rear panels, and a thin rimmed edge framing the face and ears; the face and neck stay bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown; colour 1 on the side and upper rear panels; colour 3 on the lower rear and temple panels; colour 2 on the rim edging.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_02.differs: The female version has a rim that dips into a pointed notch at the front of the temple and no separate brow band across the forehead.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Deity_01.description: A close-fitting skullcap helmet with a seamed crown that dips to a point at the brow, plus rounded side panels covering the ears and temples. Thin edging outlines the lower rim. Sleek, superhero-style headwear.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and back of the cap; colour 1 on the side ear panels; colour 2 on the thin edging along the rim.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Deity_02.description: A close-fitting half helmet made of concentric angular bands that arc from the crown down to the temples and back of the head, leaving the face open. It has a chevron-like layered profile and a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outermost crown band; colour 1 on the second band; colour 2 on the third band; colour 3 on the innermost front band and edge lining.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Deity_03.description: A half helmet that caps the top of the head like a smooth shell, with a raised trimmed rim, a pointed shield-shaped panel on the forehead and an open back and face. Suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Deity_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the raised rim trim; colour 2 on the border around the forehead panel; colour 3 on the forehead panel inset.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.description: An Egyptian-style headdress helmet with a striped cloth-like nemes drape falling past the ears and down the back, topped by a bird-like beaked crest with curled horn shapes and a segmented side plate.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the striped drape; colour 3 on the stripes and edge piping; colour 1 on the segmented plates and crown panel; colour 2 on the beak crest and curled horns.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_01.description: A rounded plate helmet with an open face and a V-shaped brow, a raised central crest strip carrying three tall pointed spikes, and scalloped contrasting panels on the sides and back. Sits snugly over the crown and down to the nape.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the scalloped side and back panels and the edge trim; colour 3 on the crest strip; colour 2 on the spikes and the groove lines.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_02.description: A knightly full-face helmet with a horizontal visor slit, a stitched-mouth grille, small studs and spikes at the brow, and trimmed edges. A tall swept-back mane of hair rises from the crown and flows down the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the hair mane; colour 1 on the edge trim, brow line and studs; colour 3 on the visor slit; colour 2 on the mouth grille.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_02.differs: The female mane is bunched into a tall topknot with shorter spikes and less flowing length; the male mane sweeps back in a longer, larger crest.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_03.description: A rounded open-faced helmet with a nose guard and curved cheek edges, topped by a large swept-back mane of shaggy hair or fur that streams down the back in loose locks. Suggests a heraldic fantasy warrior.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the mane; colour 1 on the front brow plate; colour 3 on the central stripe on the brow.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Nightvisor_01.description: A partial sci-fi headpiece: a wide band wraps around the head with a single large round cyclops lens at the brow and a strap with buckle at the side. A padded crest strip runs over the crown, leaving the top of the head open.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Nightvisor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and lens surround; colour 1 on the padded crest strip over the crown; colour 3 on the small studs beside the lens and the stripe on the crest; colour 2 on the buckle and lens.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Norse_01.description: A Norse-style half helmet with a domed cap, a central ridge band, knotwork patterns, a nose guard, spectacle-like eye rims with brow bands, cheek guards, and a flared neck guard at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Norse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and neck guard; colour 1 on the ridge band, knotwork, nose guard, eye rims and cheek guards; colour 2 on the brow bands and the band around the helmet base.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Norse_02.description: A close-fitting Norse-style half helmet with a rounded dome, a central ridge stripe and knotwork chain patterns. Open cheek guards and a flared neck guard carry interlaced trim, and a thin band rings the brow. No nose guard.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Norse_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the lower neck guard; colour 1 on the ridge stripe, knotwork patterns and cheek and neck panels; colour 2 on the rim band.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Norse_02.differs: The female helmet has a plain, low brow band, while the male version adds a thick raised brow ridge with a light visor-like panel across the eyes.

Female/F_Helmet_Half_Victory_01.description: A smooth rounded helmet shell with a central stripe and a pointed brow opening that leaves the face exposed. Tall swept-back horn-like fins rise from each side, with smaller curved blades below them. Superhero style.
Female/F_Helmet_Half_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the large upper side horns; colour 1 on the central stripe and the curved side blades; colour 2 on the lower rear blades; colour 3 on the inner face opening and the edge piping.

Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Baseballcap_04.description: A casual baseball cap with a curved brim and a six-panel crown with contrasting seam piping, worn with the brim to the front. A knotted headband wraps around the base of the crown, with loose tails hanging at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Baseballcap_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown panels at the back and sides; colour 2 on the brim and the front panel; colour 3 on the seam piping; colour 1 on the knotted band and its tails.

Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Fez_01.description: A classic fez: a short, flat-topped, slightly tapered cylindrical cap that sits upright on the crown of the head, with a thin cord running across the top to a hanging tassel at the side.
Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Fez_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap body; colour 2 on the cord across the top; colour 3 on the small tassel cap; colour 1 on the tassel.

Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Madjester_01.description: A four-pronged jester cap made of patchwork cloth with visible stitching. Each floppy horn arches out and down from the crown and ends in a small bell-like tassel. It sits on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main patchwork sections; colour 1 on alternating patches and the tassel tips; colour 3 on the remaining patches near the horn bends; colour 2 on the stitching.
Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Madjester_01.differs: The female hat has a more angular, pointed horn shape with a bolder alternation of patches, and its tassels hang slightly shorter.

Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Martialartsheadband_.description: A martial-arts cloth headband wrapped around the forehead, tied in a knot at the back of the head with two loose tails hanging down the nape. Simple, casual fighter style.
Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Martialartsheadband_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole headband, knot and tails.
Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Martialartsheadband_.differs: The female knot sits slightly higher and to one side, with the tails bunched together and hanging rather short and crumpled.

Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Robotsamurai_F.description: A wide, shallow conical hat in the style of an East Asian straw hat, with a broad flat brim and low peak, and angular raised ridge panels and inset patches on the crown. It sits high over the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Hat_Robotsamurai_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim edge and underside rim; colour 1 on the main crown surface; colour 2 on the raised angular ridge panel over the crown and the underside; colour 3 on the rectangular inset patches.

Female/F_Helmet_Hats_Spy_01.description: A small rounded bowler-style hat with a domed crown and a short, slightly angular brim, wrapped by a band with a layered rosette flower on one side. Sits snugly on top of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Hats_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band and the centre of the flower; colour 0 on the outer flower petals.

Female/F_Helmet_Headcage_01.description: A open-frame cage worn over the whole head: vertical metal bars meet at a small round cap on top and are joined by horizontal bands, with small rivet-like studs at the crossings and a ring of spokes at the base.
Female/F_Helmet_Headcage_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bars, bands and top cap; colour 1 on the studs at the bar crossings.

Female/F_Helmet_Hood_Dark_01.description: A soft cloth hood with a pointed peak that sweeps back from the crown, draped folds over the face opening, and a V-shaped front edge that rests on the upper chest. Contrasting stitched trim runs along the opening. Assassin-style.
Female/F_Helmet_Hood_Dark_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood cloth; colour 2 on the stitched trim along the face opening.

Female/F_Helmet_Hood_Vigilante_01.description: A soft cloth hood with a pointed peak that drapes over the head and gathers loosely at the nape. Contrasting trim outlines the face opening, and a fabric panel hangs across the lower face like a veil.
Female/F_Helmet_Hood_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood cloth and the lower face panel; colour 2 on the trim around the face opening.
Female/F_Helmet_Hood_Vigilante_01.differs: The female hood has a fabric panel covering the lower face, while the male opening is more open.

Female/F_Helmet_Horns_Ragingbull_01.description: A pair of bull horns joined by a continuous curved band across the forehead, with segmented plated sections that sweep outward and end in sharp upturned tips. Sits high on the head like a horned crown.
Female/F_Helmet_Horns_Ragingbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the centre forehead plate and the horn tips; colour 1 on the outer band segments; colour 2 on the band sections near the ends of the curve.

Female/F_Helmet_Junkbot_01.description: A bowl-shaped colander helmet worn low over the brow, with a caged light bulb on top and two bulbous knob lights angled out from either side. Small hooks hang at the rim. Junkyard robot style.
Female/F_Helmet_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bowl body, bulb cage and knob tips; colour 1 on the bowl's broad band and the bulb top; colour 2 on the rim underside and the base around the bulb; colour 3 on the knob lights.

Female/F_Helmet_Junkbot_02.description: An upturned kitchen colander worn as a helmet: a faceted bowl dome with a short raised rim on top, small round holes, and little wire loop handles at the sides. Sits low over the brow, junkyard-robot comic style.
Female/F_Helmet_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, handles and the bowl's base panels; colour 1 on the large bowl panels; colour 2 on the diagonal stripe panels; colour 3 on the small rectangular patch near the front.

Female/F_Helmet_Kabuto_01.description: A Japanese kabuto-style helmet with a rounded dome front carved as a snarling fanged beast face, wide flared neck guards and side flaps studded with dots, a decorative knot finial on top, and a tied chin cord.
Female/F_Helmet_Kabuto_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and beast face; colour 1 on the knot finial, chin cord and the outer face of the neck guards; colour 2 on the guard edging; colour 3 on the dots, fangs and small accents.

Female/F_Helmet_Knight_01.description: A full-face knight's helmet with a rounded domed crown, a raised central crest ridge, curved ribbed grooves across the top, and a pointed visor-like faceplate that ends in a wedge over the chin. Hinge plates and small rivets sit at the sides.
Female/F_Helmet_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and faceplate; colour 1 on the central crest ridge and the rim trim; colour 2 on the grooves; colour 3 on the rivets at the sides.

Female/F_Helmet_Lemurian_Bubble_01.description: A tall, translucent glass-like bubble helmet that fully encloses the head, with rounded dome top and straight sides that extend down past the chin to rest around the neck and shoulders. Suggests an alien or sci-fi life-support dome.
Female/F_Helmet_Lemurian_Bubble_01.colourAreas: The default material is transparent and glassy and ignores the colour scheme; no colour slot is clearly visible on any part.

Female/F_Helmet_Lion_Helmet_01.description: A lion-head headpiece worn over the head with the face showing beneath an open snarling mouth. It has rounded ears, a sculpted snout, curved fangs and a shaggy, jagged mane that falls behind and around the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Lion_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, snout and mane; colour 1 on the ears and nose; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the fangs.
Female/F_Helmet_Lion_Helmet_01.differs: The female version is coloured mostly with colour 0 and has a compact mane; the male version has a mane with large colour 1 areas, a colour 1 snout top and colour 3 accents.

Female/F_Helmet_Lockbox_65_01.description: An oversized, wide conical parasol-style hat with a flat, ribbed brim that covers the shoulders. It has hanging tassels and beads around the rim, a small ornate horned crest on top, and an inner headband loop.
Female/F_Helmet_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the broad hat canopy and inner band; colour 0 on the crest ornament and small beads; colour 2 on the tassels and hair-like tuft; colour 3 on the small crest gem.
Female/F_Helmet_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The female hat sits flatter and sits wider, with a shallower cone and a more horizontal brim than the male version.

Female/F_Helmet_Lockbox_66_01.description: A beast-like head piece with a hard bird-of-prey mask covering the forehead and upper face, and a layered crest of overlapping feather plates sweeping back over the crown, ending in pointed tips and small horn spikes.
Female/F_Helmet_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the beak mask and the fade at the crest front; colour 1 on the feather plates; colour 2 on the darker rear feathers and mask trim; colour 3 on the eyes and the spike tips.

Female/F_Helmet_Lockbox_66_02.description: A full helmet styled as a tribal mask: a face plate with a carved grinning mouth and a central oval gem, a broad fan-shaped crest of tapering feather spikes around the brow, and a smooth rounded back shell.
Female/F_Helmet_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest frame, helmet back shell and chin edges; colour 1 on the face plate, feather bodies and back stripe; colour 2 on the recessed forehead panel and feather bases; colour 3 on the oval gem, mouth line, crest insets and feather tips.

Female/F_Helmet_Mask_Space_01.description: A sleek, rounded sci-fi helmet with segmented ribbed shell panels, a angular brow and cheek guard around the eyes with small round lenses, and a thin chin strap band leaving the mouth and chin open.
Female/F_Helmet_Mask_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and face plate; colour 2 on the ribbing bands, chin strap and rear plates; colour 0 on the brow and cheek edge highlights; colour 3 on the eye lenses.

Female/F_Helmet_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A full-coverage metal helmet with a domed crown ringed by tall curved spikes, a broad contrasting band around the brow, a pointed nose guard and narrow eye slits, covering the head to the neck like a villain's war helm.
Female/F_Helmet_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and helmet shell; colour 1 on the spikes, brow band and nose guard; colour 3 on the glowing eye slits.

Female/F_Helmet_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A full-face fantasy helmet in the style of a Greco-Roman warrior: a rounded cap with a T-shaped opening, a small gem on the brow, a spiked crest and a tall swept-back plume of layered locks flowing down the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the plume; colour 1 on the face panels, the brow band and the streaks in the plume; colour 2 on the edge trim around the opening; colour 3 on the brow gem.

Female/F_Helmet_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A full sci-fi superhero helmet with a rounded shell, angular tinted visor openings, a separate lower face guard, and a short collar at the neck. Long swept-back spikes flare from each side like fins.
Female/F_Helmet_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and collar; colour 1 on the trim lines, visor rim and lower face guard; colour 2 on the visor and the back vent panel; colour 3 on the side spikes and the small brow mark.

Female/F_Helmet_Mutated_01.description: A full-head mutated hood of lumpy, fleshy folds and ridged tendrils, with an open oval face gap and a thick neck section draping down over the neck. Studded with bulbous growths; monstrous, organic look.
Female/F_Helmet_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy surface; colour 1 on the larger bulbous growths and neck patches; colour 2 on the small glossy nodules.
Female/F_Helmet_Mutated_01.differs: The female version extends lower into a longer, draping neck section, while the male version ends closer to the jaw.

Female/F_Helmet_Nephilim_Face_Mask_01.description: A smooth, hollow face mask sculpted like a stylised humanoid face with deep contrasting eye sockets, a sculpted nose and no mouth, covering the forehead, cheeks and nose and ending above the chin. It has a shell-like open back.
Female/F_Helmet_Nephilim_Face_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mask shell; colour 1 as a faint tint around the eye sockets.

Female/F_Helmet_Nephilim_Mask_Full_01.description: A thin, hollow face mask sculpted as an alien humanoid face with large almond-shaped contrasting eyes, a narrow nose and full lips. It covers the face from brow to chin, leaving the back of the head bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Nephilim_Mask_Full_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the lips and the shading around the eyes; the eye openings are and take no colour.

Female/F_Helmet_Odragon_01.description: A full dragon-head helmet with a snouted face mask, fanged jaw and pointed chin, a pair of long swept-back horns, and spiky frilled fins flaring out at the cheeks and back of the head. It renders glossy and translucent, with an oriental monster look.
Female/F_Helmet_Odragon_01.colourAreas: The default material appears glassy and mostly ignores the scheme; only the horns show a gradient from colour 0 to colour 1 at the tips.
Female/F_Helmet_Odragon_01.differs: The female helmet renders as a translucent glassy shell with no visible contrasting-and-contrasting pattern, contrasting eyes or studs, unlike the solid painted male helmet.

Female/F_Helmet_Pilgrim_Hat_01.description: A pilgrim-style hat with a tall, slightly tapered flat-topped crown, a wide drooping brim and a broad buckled band around the base of the crown. The crown and brim are split into large angular panels.
Female/F_Helmet_Pilgrim_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and parts of the brim; colour 1 on the hat band and some crown and brim panels; colour 2 on other crown and brim panels; colour 3 on the underside of the brim.
Female/F_Helmet_Pilgrim_Hat_01.differs: The female hat uses a colour-blocked pattern of large panels across the crown and brim, with no distinct brim edge trim, whereas the male hat is mostly solid with a coloured band.
