Female/F_Helmet_Pot_01.description: A novelty cooking pot worn upside down as a helmet: a short cylindrical metal body with a rolled rim sitting low over the brow and a flat base on top, plus a thin curved handle sticking out sideways.
Female/F_Helmet_Pot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pot walls and rim; colour 1 on the flat base on top and the small handle mount; colour 2 on the handle.

Female/F_Helmet_Power_01.description: A close-fitting superhero helmet with a rounded crown, a raised central panel with a small slot, a thick band across the brow, and angular fin-like plates flaring out at each side. Sits over the top of the head and leaves the face open.
Female/F_Helmet_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side plates, brow shell and rear rim; colour 1 on the crown panel; colour 3 on the band across the brow and around the back; colour 2 on the edge outlines and the slot.

Female/F_Helmet_Qularr_Villain_01.description: An insect-like carapace helmet: a smooth pointed dome over the crown with a patterned front panel, and stacked, overlapping blade-like plates fanning out layered down the back of the head. The face stays open.
Female/F_Helmet_Qularr_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and the swept back plates; colour 1 on the front panel and the inner lining; colour 3 on the emblem marking on the front panel.
Female/F_Helmet_Qularr_Villain_01.differs: The female version sits higher and tighter on the head, with the layered back plates fanning out more sharply.

Female/F_Helmet_Raptorcrestplate_01.description: A fan-shaped crest headpiece sitting on top of the head like a raptor's frill, with ribbed radiating panels, a row of curved horn spikes around the edge, and small fin-like tabs at the nape.
Female/F_Helmet_Raptorcrestplate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged rim and spike tips; colour 3 on the radiating rib markings; colour 1 on the blotchy panel patches; colour 2 on the central studs and back of the crest.

Female/F_Helmet_Raptorfan_01.description: A dinosaur-style neck frill that fans out around the face and head in a ring of ribbed, webbed segments with pointed spikes at the tips, plus a small curved crest of bony ridges above the forehead.
Female/F_Helmet_Raptorfan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frill membranes and the crest; colour 1 on the inner blend of each segment; colour 3 on the outer edge, rib lines and spike tips; colour 2 on the zigzag markings.

Female/F_Helmet_Ravenswood_01.description: A bird-headed hood shaped like a raven: a smooth cowl with pointed ear-like tufts, a long curved beak over the face, small round eyes at the sides, and ragged feather strands hanging around the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hood and cowl; colour 0 on the beak; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the hanging feathers.

Female/F_Helmet_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A full-head retro helmet of smooth, rounded armored plates with a central stripe over the crown, an open visor window at the face, a chin guard with a notched edge, and a raised angular panel at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 1 on the crown stripe; colour 3 on the chin guard and rear panel; colour 2 on the inner visor opening.

Female/F_Helmet_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A retro sci-fi hat with a wide, flat flaring brim like a flying saucer and a domed canopy crown. A raised ridge arches over the dome, with a small oval ornament at the front and vented side panels on the brim.
Female/F_Helmet_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim; colour 1 on the domed canopy; colour 2 on the arched ridge and vent grilles; colour 3 on the front oval ornament and small brim accents.

Female/F_Helmet_Serpent_Spikes_01.description: A row of five curved, tapering horn-like spikes running front to back along the centre of the scalp like a mohawk, the largest at the rear sweeping upward and back, the smaller ones angled outward toward the front.
Female/F_Helmet_Serpent_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each spike; colour 1 on the pointed tips and shaded ends; colour 2 at the spike bases.

Female/F_Helmet_Skeletal_01.description: A ram-skull mask helmet covering the face and head, with hollow eye sockets, a contrasting nose cavity, small fangs at the jaw and large ridged spiralling horns that curl down and outward beside the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Skeletal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and the upper horn ridges; colour 1 on the horn tips and the fangs; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Female/F_Helmet_Sombrero_01.description: A wide-brimmed sombrero with a short tapered crown and a broad, slightly upturned brim. A star-shaped ornamental band with cut-out filigree and fine radiating lines sits around the crown, with small motifs on the brim. Worn level on the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Sombrero_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim surface; colour 1 on the brim edge, star-shaped band and motifs; colour 2 on the filigree cut-outs and underside; colour 3 on the fine radiating lines.
Female/F_Helmet_Sombrero_01.differs: The female brim is wider and flatter, with a more pronounced star-shaped ornament and a sharper crown taper.

Female/F_Helmet_Spartan_Helmet_01.description: A Corinthian-style Spartan helmet: smooth domed crown with a subtle brow ridge, long cheek guards sweeping down either side of a narrow T-shaped face opening, and a slightly flared rear rim. Covers the head and cheeks.
Female/F_Helmet_Spartan_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and cheek guards; colour 1 on the thin edge trim around the rim and face opening.
Female/F_Helmet_Spartan_Helmet_01.differs: The female helmet has a solid back rim with a single small central notch, while the male one has a split flap at the back.

Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_01.description: A tall, straight-sided stovepipe top hat with a flat crown and a narrow, slightly angular flat brim. Horizontal bands wrap the body above the brim. It sits upright on top of the head, with a formal, whimsical look.
Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown top and the middle band; colour 1 on the upper body of the hat; colour 2 on the lower band; colour 3 on the brim.
Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_01.differs: The female hat has a shorter band of contrasting on the upper body and a taller crown section, with the light band thinner than on the male hat.

Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Fancy_01.description: A tall stovepipe top hat with a curved brim that sweeps up at the sides, a contrasting rim band with a notch at the front, and a criss-cross lace-up panel with eyelets running up the front.
Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown of the hat; colour 3 on the brim and the rim band around the top; colour 1 on the front laces; colour 2 on the eyelets.

Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Madjester_.description: A tall flared stovepipe top hat with a wide angular brim, a contrasting band around the base, a ring of dots along the rim, and a cluster of long striped and soft feathers swept back on one side.
Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Madjester_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat body, brim and feather; colour 1 on the hatband and the feather tips; colour 3 on the rim dots and the striped feathers; colour 2 on the stripes of the feathers.

Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Party_01.description: A tall, slightly tapered stovepipe hat with a soft floppy brim and a padded crown, wrapped in broad horizontal bands with a narrow trim band at the base. Sits on top of the head in a festive party style.
Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Party_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown top, brim and base band; colour 3 on the upper band; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 1 on the lower band.
Female/F_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Party_01.differs: The female hat's crown is a little taller and narrower.

Female/F_Helmet_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A retro full helmet with a rounded dome crown and a small central spike, a flared brim at the back, and two tall curved horn-like wings sweeping up from the brow. A framed face guard with angular bars and side breathing vents covers the face.
Female/F_Helmet_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the horn-like wings; colour 1 on the side vent canisters and the visor interior; colour 2 on the face frame and the mouth grille; colour 3 is not clearly visible. The glossy metal finish partly ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmet_Swing_01.description: A flat-topped, wide-brimmed boater-style hat with radiating stripes on the crown and brim, a thick contrasting band around the base, and a pair of small goggles with round lenses perched on the front of the band.
Female/F_Helmet_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the alternating stripes of the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 0 on the goggle housings; colour 3 on the goggle lenses.

Female/F_Helmet_Teddy_01.description: A full-head furry teddy-bear mask: a rounded shaggy head with small round ears, big glassy eyes, a snout with a nose, and a spiky tuft of fur swept up over the forehead. Playful, costume-mascot style.
Female/F_Helmet_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the muzzle fur, ears and lower cheeks; colour 1 on the inner ears, nose and eye rims; colour 2 on the face centre and forehead tuft; colour 3 on the outer head fur and the eye centres.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A close-fitting superhero cowl helmet with tall swept-back bat-like ear fins and flared side wings, eye openings, and a chin strap band. Panelled in separate diagonal sections across the face, crown and back.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the face mask, crown panel and outer side fins; colour 0 on the diagonal side panels, chin and lower back; colour 2 on the ear tips and top of the head; colour 3 on the side cheek panels.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The female version splits the helmet into diagonal multi-colour panels, with a contrasting crown and contrasting cheek insets, and has a smoother face mask. The male has a plain contrasting crown and contrasting face.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ancient_01.description: An ancient-style full helmet with a rounded domed crown, swept ridged bands over the top, and a long pointed nose guard with a T-shaped face opening. A flared neck rim sits at the back; weathered, worn metal look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ancient_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and nose guard; colour 1 on the swept bands across the crown and the back emblem markings; colour 2 in the shadowed face opening.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A small circlet-style forehead ornament: a large oval domed gem in a contrasting bezel with a tiny top loop, flanked by curved, branching antler-like horns that sweep out across the brow, with scrollwork at the base.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns; colour 1 on the central gem; colour 2 on the gem bezel and top loop; colour 3 on the scrollwork.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A close-fitting skullcap with a patterned, cobblestone-like top panel and a smooth band around the sides and back; a narrow strip drops down the forehead to the nose bridge. Sits snug on the head, animal-hide in style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the patterned top panel and its edge piping; colour 2 on the plates within the pattern; colour 1 on the side and back band.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Armorninja.description: A small armoured headpiece that sits over the crown and brow: a central segmented plate with a ridged front crest, two swept-back winged blades curving out to each side, and small angular gem-like nodes at the temples.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved side blades and the central ridged plate; colour 1 on the main crown plates; colour 2 on the inner wing panels; colour 3 on the temple nodes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Artdeco_01.description: A close-fitting art deco helmet with a tall, swept-back pointed crest running over the head, a face plate framing the eyes and nose, and angular side fins flaring out behind the ears.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Artdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face plate and crest edges; colour 1 on the large rounded side panels and stripes; colour 2 on the central crest panel and rear fin; colour 3 on small accent panels at the temples.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Artdeco_01.differs: The female helmet has a tall, pointed crest that sweeps up and back, with flared fins at the back, while the male version has a lower, flatter top.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Asiandragon_01.description: A circlet made of a coiled serpentine dragon that wraps around the head, with a horned dragon head rising at the front and small dragon heads along the sides. A central ridged strip runs over the forehead and a small tab sticks up on top.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Asiandragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coiled dragon body and heads; colour 1 on the ridged strip, the underside scales and the horns; colour 3 on the stitch-like markings along the body.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Asiandragon_01_Tak.description: A circlet made of a coiled serpentine dragon that wraps around the head, with a horned dragon head rising at the front, a central ridged strip over the forehead and small dragon heads on the sides. East-asian fantasy style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Asiandragon_01_Tak.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dragon's body and head; colour 1 on the ridged strip, underbelly scales and horns; colour 3 on the stitch-like markings along the body.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Bandana_01.description: A snug cloth bandana skullcap that covers the crown and hugs the head, with gentle gathered folds at the sides and a small knot at the back of the head with two short pointed tails hanging down.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Bandana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base cloth of the bandana; colour 1 on the round polka-dot pattern; colour 2 on the small inner fabric visible at the front edge.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Beanie_01.description: A small, close-fitting cap made of alternating wedge panels that meet at a button on top, with a contrasting band around the rim. A slim propeller on a short stem spins above the crown, giving a playful, cute look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Beanie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on alternating cap panels; colour 1 on the other alternating panels and the stem beads; colour 2 on the rim band; colour 3 on the top button.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Beanie_01.differs: The female version has a propeller on a stem above the cap, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Beret_01.description: A soft, rounded cloth beret with a flat crown that slopes down to one side, sitting snug on the head above a thin contrasting band, with a small shield-shaped badge on the front. Military in style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Beret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the beret body; colour 1 on the edge band; colour 3 on the badge.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Biker_01.description: A rounded, close-fitting open-face helmet shell with a low brim that wraps the head, a faint centre seam and small rivets on each side; sits over the crown and leaves the face and ears bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Biker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the rim band; the side rivets take the rim colour.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Biker_02.description: A rounded, close-fitting open-face helmet shell like a German-style biker or army helmet, with a flared rim of contrasting trim, small rivets at the sides, and a short pointed spike rising from the crown.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Biker_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the rim band and rivets; colour 1 on the top spike.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Bowler_01.description: A bowler-style hat with a rounded domed crown and a short, slightly upturned brim, encircled by a wide contrasting band at the base of the crown. It sits on top of the head, evoking a classic formal or noir look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Bowler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Bowlerfeather_01.description: A soft brimmed hat with a rounded crown and a wide, slightly wavy brim, worn tilted low over the brow. A contrasting band circles the crown and a single long feather sweeps out from the side.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Bowlerfeather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the feather.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Brainjar_01.description: A small clear dome sitting on the crown of the head, holding an exposed wrinkled brain. A riveted band rings its base, and coiled rod electrodes stick out sideways from both temples. Comic mad-scientist style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Brainjar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome rim, band and rod shafts; colour 1 on the brain; colour 3 on the coil rings; colour 2 on the rod tips and small spikes at the brain base.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Brainjar_02.description: A small transparent dome sits on top of the head over an exposed, wrinkled brain. A riveted band circles the base of the dome, and two small connectors sit at the sides. A monstrous, mad-scientist look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Brainjar_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the riveted base band and the dome rim; colour 1 on the brain; colour 2 on the small side connectors. The dome is clear and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Bronzeking_01.description: A crown-like headband circling the head with upright curved metal blades at the front and two tall decorated fin panels on each side, studded with round rivets; the back band dips into a shallow curved plate.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Bronzeking_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upright blades and the band edging; colour 1 on the band and the fin panels; colour 3 on the etched swirl markings of the fin panels; colour 2 on the rivets.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Bronzeking_01.differs: The back of the female band is a raised curved plate with a contrasting lower strip, while the male band has a wavy swooping edge with a light inner stripe.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Celestial_Halo_01.description: A floating halo accessory: a thin faceted ring standing upright behind the head, with a pair of feathered wings spreading from its sides and a long vertical bar with hooked ends crossing through the centre.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Celestial_Halo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the halo ring; colour 1 on the wings; colour 2 on the vertical bar.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Circlet_Basic_01.description: A slim circlet worn around the forehead, dipping to a V-shaped point at the brow with a round gem. The band has a woven lattice pattern and scrolled swirls on the front, with a thin edge trim along the top.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Circlet_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate and swirl panel; colour 2 on the lattice weave and swirls; colour 1 on the top edge trim; colour 3 on the gem.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Circlet_Basic_01.differs: The female circlet dips lower at the back into a V-shaped point behind the head, while the male band stays level around the back.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A close-fitting mechanical helmet with a rounded cap, flared side fins, and ear-level housings. A framing plate runs down each cheek and under the chin, leaving the face open. Futuristic superhero style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cap and ear housings; colour 3 on the top and back centre stripe; colour 2 on the front brow panel and the vents behind the ears; colour 0 on the cheek frame, side fins and chin plate.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.differs: The female front brow shows a contrasting panel with only a small contrasting patch at the top, while the male version has a contrasting band across the forehead.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_02.description: A close-fitting mechanical helmet with a smooth rounded cap, an open face framed by angular plates, wide flared side wings swept back from the cheeks, and a segmented neck guard at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap, face frame and side wings; colour 1 on the crown patch, side panels and neck guard; colour 2 on the recessed gaps and vents; colour 3 on a small accent at the rear.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Cone_01.description: A novelty traffic cone worn as a hat: a tall tapering cone with a small open tip rests on a flat square base that sits on top of the head like a wide brim. Playful and cartoonish.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Cone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone body and part of the base; colour 1 on the large patches of the cone and the base corners; colour 2 on the band around the cone; colour 3 on a small panel low on the cone.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Cooliehat_01.description: A very wide, shallow conical coolie hat with fine radiating ribs, a ragged frayed rim edged with contrasting trim, and a small notched crown collar on top. It sits over the head and shades the face.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Cooliehat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat cone and crown; colour 3 on the rim edge trim; colour 1 on the band around the base of the crown.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Cowboyhat_01.description: A cowboy hat with a boxy, softly creased crown and a wide brim that dips slightly at the front and back. It sits on top of the head, with the underside of the brim showing as a separate surface.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Cowboyhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and the upper surface of the brim; colour 2 on the underside of the brim.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Croc_Tophat_01.description: A tall, slightly crumpled cloth top hat with a wide brim, a broad banded hatband studded with small contrasting spikes, and a long curved feather tucked into the side and sweeping backward. Sits upright on the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Croc_Tophat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat crown and brim; colour 1 on the banded hatband; colour 2 on the small spikes; colour 3 on the feather.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Basic_01.description: A slim open-backed crown band with five tall pointed peaks tipped with round knobs, decorated with embossed scrollwork, small round gems and stitched edging. It sits low on the crown of the head, with a regal fantasy look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and peaks; colour 1 on the outer edge trim and the knobs on the peak tips; colour 3 on the round gems.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Eclipse_01.description: A spiked metal crown-band sitting around the forehead, with tall blade-like points, a central raised spike, a skull-like front plate with a gem and curved claw-like tendrils hanging over the brow. A separate contrasting panel runs along the front band.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Eclipse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, spikes and front plate; colour 1 on the inset panel along the front band; colour 3 on the gems; colour 2 on the curved claw tendrils.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Eclipse_01.differs: The female crown has a shorter, more slanted central spike and a lower back band with fewer tall points.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Laurel_01.description: A laurel wreath crown of overlapping pointed leaves circling the head just above the brow, thickest at the back and thinning toward the front, where the two branches meet. Classical, ceremonial styling.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Laurel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leaf surfaces; colour 1 on the leaf edges and the stems between the leaves.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Laurel_02.description: A laurel wreath crown of overlapping pointed leaves that circles the head at the brow and ties off at the back, with a glossy metallic look. Classical, ceremonial styling.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Laurel_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper faces of the leaves; colour 1 on the underlying leaf layer and edges, most visible at the back and sides.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.description: A spiked metal crown band worn around the forehead, with tall curved spikes around the rim, a taller central spike, a pointed brow plate with a small gem, and a contrasting inner band.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown band and spikes; colour 1 on the inner band beneath the rim; colour 3 on the gem at the brow.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.differs: The female crown has a contrasting top rim and a small pointed tab at the back, while the male version has a lighter rim and a wider back plate.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_02.description: A spiked crown band circling the head, with tall tapered spikes around the rim, a separate thin floating hoop above, and a pointed panel at the brow that sweeps up into a curved horn-like blade.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown band and spikes; colour 1 on the front brow panel and its upswept blade; colour 2 on the stripe markings on the spikes and panel; colour 3 on the floating hoop.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_02.differs: The female version has a shorter front blade and smaller spikes, with the brow panel sitting lower and closer to the band.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_03.description: A spiked crown band circling the head, with a mottled ring, tall thin spikes with banded tips around it, two longer pointed prongs at front and back, and a separate thin floating hoop above.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled band and short spikes; colour 1 on the two long front and back prongs; colour 2 on the banded spike tips; colour 3 on the floating upper hoop.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_04.description: A thin circlet crown ringed with tall, tapered spikes that each carry notched chevron grooves, with a larger swept-back horn-like plate rising from the brow at the front. Sits low on the head; monstrous fantasy style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the circlet band and the spikes; colour 1 on the front brow plate and its horn; colour 2 on the grooves and stripes; colour 3 on the small eye markings on the brow plate.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_04.differs: The front horn plate is shorter and more upright, and the rear of the circlet has no raised fin.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Cybermind_02.description: A smooth, close-fitting helmet cap with an oval gem-like panel on the forehead and an open face with a trimmed edge. Two ribbed flexible cables loop out from the sides and hang down behind the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Cybermind_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the forehead oval; colour 2 on the ribbed cables and face-opening trim; colour 0 on the small cable end caps.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Decoface_01.description: A thin, angular face plate that covers the lower face and nose bridge, with a jagged brow edge and long pointed horn-like fins sweeping back over the temples. Diagonal stripe details run along the swept side panels; it suggests an art deco sci-fi mask.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Decoface_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face plate and side panels; colour 1 on the diagonal stripes and the nose-bridge strip; colour 2 on the outline edging and the upper swept horn spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Deity_01.description: A faceted, angular full helmet with two tall swept-back horn-like ears, a crest-shaped plate on the brow, an open face with a mask-like lower panel, and a flared collar that flares out around the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and ears; colour 1 on the inner face panel around the eyes and mouth; colour 3 on the brow crest; colour 2 on the flared collar rim and brow edges.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A smooth, rounded medieval-style helmet covering the crown and back of the head, with a V-shaped brow and open face cut-out framed by a thick border, plus small spikes studding the sides and back.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the edge border around the face opening and lower rim; colour 1 on the small spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Dinoskullbone_01.description: A bone dinosaur skull worn like a cap on top of the head, with hollow eye sockets, small spikes on the brow and crown, and a long snout that juts forward over the face, ending in a row of pointed teeth.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Dinoskullbone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone of the skull and snout; colour 1 inside the eye sockets; colour 3 on the nostril tip of the snout; colour 2 on the teeth.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Dinoskullbone_01.differs: The teeth hang lower and more sparsely under the snout tip, and the skull sits slightly higher, leaving the face more open.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Dragon_01.description: A full-head dragon helmet shaped like a skull with a long tapering snout, glowing eyes, small spikes along the sides and two tall branching antlers on top. It covers the whole head and ends at the jaw.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and snout; colour 1 on the antlers and side spikes; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Egyptian_Pharaoh_0.description: A pharaonic nemes-style headdress: a striped cloth cap that sits over the crown with a band across the brow, and two broad striped lappets hanging down either side of the face to the collarbones, open at the back of the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Egyptian_Pharaoh_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the striped crown and the outer stripes of the cloth; colour 2 on the alternate stripes; colour 1 on the brow band and the inner lappet panels and stripes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Emissive_01.description: A full-coverage sci-fi motorcycle-style helmet with a clear glass visor across the face, segmented shell plates, angular contrasting trim lines and a round side emblem plate with a small glowing mark; sits snug over the whole head.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Emissive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the trim lines and side plate ring; colour 3 on the small side emblem; the visor is clear glass and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Face_Bullskull_01.description: A bull skull worn as a headpiece: the long muzzle hangs over the face, with wide curving horns sweeping out and upward from the brow and a wrapped cloth band binding it around the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Face_Bullskull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the horns and eye sockets; colour 3 on the forehead marking and the wrapped band.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Face_Dorag_01.description: A close-fitting cloth bandana with a snug crown and a band across the forehead, knotted at the back of the head with two short tails hanging down. Casual street or pirate look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Face_Dorag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the star-patterned cloth; colour 2 on the shadowed folds and edges.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Face_Dorag_01.differs: The female version has a small pointed fold hanging at the front of the band; the male version has a small knot or badge at the front instead.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Fantasy_01.description: A slim segmented circlet that arcs over the top of the head like a headband, made of small rectangular panels on a central block at the forehead, with tapered ends that curve down behind the temples.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band frame and tapered ends; colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 2 on the central block; colour 3 on the small window in the central block.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A close-fitting fantasy helmet with a smooth dome, a tall central spike at the crown, and swept-back cheek guards. A V-shaped brow plate holds a diamond gem, and a pair of tall fins flares from each side of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, central spike and cheek guards; colour 1 on the brow plate and the side fins; colour 3 on the diamond gem; colour 2 on the bottom rim edge.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Firebird_02.description: A partial fantasy helmet: an open-faced crown band with a raised pointed front peak, a faceted gem at the brow, cheek guards curving down the sides and tall swept-back horn-like fins rising at each temple.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Firebird_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek guards and rim; colour 1 on the peak and the tall side fins; colour 3 on the brow gem.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Firefighter_01.description: A classic firefighter helmet: a rounded domed crown with raised ridge ribs, a crest strip down the centre, a front shield badge with an emblem, and a wide brim that sweeps out in front and stretches back into a long tail.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Firefighter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and brim; colour 1 on the ridge ribs and the front badge; colour 3 on the centre crest strip and the rear panel; colour 2 on the badge backing and the underside of the brim.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Firefighter_01.differs: The female brim's underside shows a contrasting lining and a visible inner band at the back, which the male version lacks.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Flighthelmet_01.description: A close-fitting pilot's flight helmet with a rounded shell, a translucent tinted visor over the eyes, side ear cups, and a boom microphone curving toward the mouth. Panelled shell with thin raised ridges.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Flighthelmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shell and visor frame; colour 1 on the crown and back of the shell; colour 2 on the ear cups and top panel; colour 3 on the forehead patch and back stripe. The visor ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_01.description: A full-face gas mask: a smooth moulded face shell with round rimmed eye lenses and a ribbed cylindrical filter snout, held by thin straps over the crown and around the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face shell and head straps; colour 1 on the lens rims; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter canister.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.description: A close-fitting full-face gas mask with a smooth, rounded shell over the face, oval goggle lenses with raised rims, and twin side-mounted filter canisters at the mouth. Thin straps loop over the head and around the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face shell and head straps; colour 1 on the lens rims and side valve fittings; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter canisters.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.differs: The female mask's front filter canister is smaller, with a finer perforated grille, and the strap at the back forms a closed curved loop under the chin.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A loose cloth sack hood that covers the whole head, rising to a pointed crown and gathering in soft folds at the neck. Two round eyeholes with contrasting rims sit at the front, giving a pulp-era look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood fabric; colour 1 on the rims around the eyeholes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Halo_01_New.description: A thin floating halo: a faceted torus ring hovering level above the top of the head without touching it. A simple angelic or heavenly accent with a slightly polygonal, rounded tube.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Halo_01_New.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Halo_03.description: A thin floating halo ring hovering above the head, with six pointed spikes radiating outward around its rim. Worn detached from the head, it suggests a fantasy or monstrous angelic look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Halo_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring; colour 3 on the spikes at the front-left, right and back-left; colour 2 on the remaining spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Harajuku_Bear_01.description: A cute, snug cloth cap shaped like a teddy bear head, with two rounded swirl-patterned ears on top, short ear flaps at the sides, a contrasting muzzle-like front brim with a small nose, contrasting eye patches and cross-stitch seams down the centre.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Harajuku_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap and ear flaps; colour 1 on the ears and the front muzzle brim; colour 3 on the nose and eye patches; colour 2 on the cross stitches.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Harlequin_01.description: A snug jester-style cap that covers the crown and back of the head, with a hairline-cut front edge and several long curled horn-like points, each tipped with a small faceted ball.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Harlequin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap and its curled points; colour 1 on the ball tips; colour 2 on the thin edge outline.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Heroic_01.description: A close-fitting superhero cowl covering the crown and back of the head, with two short pointed ears, angular cheek guards flanking the eye openings, and an atom emblem on the forehead.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl shell and ears; colour 1 on the atom emblem and the eye-lens trim; colour 2 on the inner edges of the cheek guards.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A fantasy helmet with layered, scale-like plates sweeping back over the skull, a central ridge crest, a nose-guard faceplate leaving the face open, and large segmented curling horns sweeping out from each side.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and crest; colour 2 on the faceplate and inner edges; colour 1 on the horns; colour 2 on the small side stud.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A close-fitting, translucent holographic helmet covering the crown, back and sides of the head, with a web of fine crackling lines across the surface and an open face and cutaway at the nape.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material is a glowing energy effect that largely ignores the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are clearly distinguishable.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The female version is a translucent glowing web-like shell, while the male version is a solid segmented helmet with separate panels and a flared lower rim.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Archer_01.description: A close-fitting cloth hood with a pointed peak, draped over the head and down to the neck and shoulders, with an integrated face wrap covering the nose and mouth. Angular panels give it a stealthy archer or assassin look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hood body and face wrap; colour 2 on the inner hood lining and a side panel; colour 3 on the diamond-shaped panels on the back and sides; colour 0 on the lower collar edge and the chin and neck drape.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Fullopen_01.description: A soft cloth hood with a pointed crown and wrinkled folds, pulled forward over the brow and down the sides of the face. The front is open, leaving the mouth and chin bare. Suggests an assassin or rogue look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Fullopen_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood; the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Fullopen_01.differs: The female hood has a bunched, folded band of cloth across the brow and eyes, so less of the face shows.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Heroic_04.description: A close-fitting cloth hood with a pointed crown and an oval face opening, its lower part gathering into a draped, wrinkled cowl that rests over the neck and upper shoulders. Suggests a stealthy, assassin-like look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Heroic_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown of the hood, fading into colour 0 on the draped cowl around the neck; the face opening shows the mannequin's interior.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Light_01.description: A soft, loose cloth hood that drapes over the head and pulls forward into a deep opening around the face, with a rumpled, slightly ragged edge and a fold of fabric hanging behind the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood fabric; colour 1 on the contrasting trim along the face opening edge.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Nighthawk_01.description: A close-fitting cloth hood that drapes over the head and down the back of the neck, with wrinkled folds and a pointed front peak carrying a triangular inset panel. Open at the face, with a contrasting-edged rim.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood cloth; colour 1 on the triangular brow panel; colour 2 on the edge piping around the face opening.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Santa_01.description: A close-fitting Santa-style hood with a thick rolled fur-like rim framing the face and a long pointed tail ending in a round pom-pom that droops down the back. Panelled in patches, it covers the head and sits over the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face rim and lower back of the hood; colour 1 on the main body of the hood and the pom-pom; colour 2 on the panel running along the tail; colour 3 on the square patch on top.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Santa_01.differs: The female hood has a plain contrasting interior and a sleeker fit, with the tail drooping to the side; the male has a contrasting interior lining and a contrasting band at the neck.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Secret_01.description: A soft cloth hoodie hood pulled up over the head, with gathered folds, contrasting edge binding around the face opening and two hanging drawstrings with tipped ends. Sits close to the head and ends at the neck; casual street style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood fabric; colour 1 on the binding around the face opening; colour 2 on the drawstring cords; colour 3 on the drawstring tips.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Secret_01.differs: The female hood is cut shorter at the back and sits tighter against the neck, with the drawstrings hanging slightly closer to the face.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hoodbaggy_01.description: A soft cloth hood that fits closely around the head, with a rounded crown, gently creased folds and a wide face opening. The edges drape to the neck and the hood sits over the head like a casual cowl.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hoodbaggy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood; the inner lining also takes colour 0.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hoodbaggy_02.description: A soft, fitted cloth hood that wraps over the head and falls in loose folds to the neck, with an open face and a small pointed drape at each side of the jaw. Plain, casual and hooded.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Hoodbaggy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood, including the inner lining.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ice_Crown_01.description: A delicate, jagged crown of thin interlaced shards forming a lattice band around the head, with long tapering icicle-like spikes rising and flaring outward. Sits on top of the head, suggesting a frozen, fantasy ice queen look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ice_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin crown framework and spikes; the glossy crystalline inner surfaces ignore the colour scheme. Other slots not clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A close-fitting full helmet with a smooth domed shell, flame-like swirl patterning across the crown and sides, a raised rim framing a T-shaped face opening, and a small hexagonal nozzle at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the flame patterning and crown panel; colour 1 on the raised rim around the face opening; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Kabuki_Mask_01.description: A thin, face-hugging kabuki-style mask covering the face from brow to chin, with eye openings, a sculpted nose and lips, and bold painted stripes above the eyes, around them and across the chin.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Kabuki_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask surface; colour 1 on the brow stripes, eye rims and chin stripe; colour 2 on the swooping lines beside the eyes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A pair of large curled ram-style horns rising from the forehead and sweeping back and around in a spiral on each side of the head, ending in thin curved tips. Beast or demon look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and curled tips; colour 1 on the mid sections of the horns; colour 2 on the outer bands; colour 3 on the small inner underside patches.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.description: A transparent glass bubble helmet set on a bulky mechanical collar ring that sweeps down into a chin plate. Ribbed hoses arc over the dome and loop around the face, with a round vent at the front and side canisters.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar ring and mechanical plates; colour 1 on the hoses, front vent disc and side canisters; colour 3 on the coiled spring sections; colour 2 on the underside. The dome is glass and ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Liberty_Crown_01.description: A crown-like headband sitting on the forehead and crown of the head, with a shallow curved band and a ring of long radiating spikes, like a statue's crown. Suggests a patriotic superhero look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Liberty_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the band; colour 1 on the front band and the spike bases; colour 2 on the spike tips and one front panel; colour 3 on the stripes along some spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Liberty_Crown_02.description: A crown-like band worn around the top of the head, with a ring of long radiating spikes fanning outward like a statue's diadem. Its shallow curved band has a split two-tone front panel, giving a patriotic superhero look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Liberty_Crown_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the band and the spike bases; colour 1 on one half of the front band and the spike shafts; colour 2 on the other half of the front band and the spike tips; colour 3 on the stripes along the spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A full-face oni demon mask with two long curved horns on the brow, a scowling sculpted face, hollow glowing-looking eyes, open mouth cavity and curved contrasting fangs. A thin rim wraps around the head to hold it in place.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face and horns; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the mouth interior; colour 2 on the fangs.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Maskfoxbat_01.description: A thin shell mask covering the face and forehead, with two tall curved horn-like fins sweeping up from the temples, a raised brow ridge over the eyes, and a cut-out mouth and chin. Suggests a bat-like superhero look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Maskfoxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell and fins; colour 1 on the narrow stripe down the nose bridge.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Medieval_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting full helmet that covers the skull and sides of the head, with a V-shaped brow and a T-shaped open face slit edged in contrasting trim, plus a row of small rivets along each side. It ends at the jaw.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Medieval_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper dome, fading into colour 0 on the lower face and cheek plates; colour 2 on the trim around the face opening; colour 3 on the small rivets.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Medieval_01.differs: The female helmet extends lower at the back, with a longer rear skirt and a visible vertical split, while the male one stops higher at the nape.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ninjaheadband_01.description: A cloth ninja headband wrapped around the forehead and temples, with a separate rectangular front plate bearing a small emblem, and a knot at the back with two long tails hanging down the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ninjaheadband_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, knot and tails; colour 2 on the front plate; colour 3 on the emblem.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ninjahood_01.description: A loose cloth hood with a pointed peak that covers the whole head and drapes to the neck. Soft wrinkled folds run down the fabric, and the front opening is a shadowed slit across the eyes, leaving the mouth bare. Suggests a ninja or assassin look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ninjahood_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood fabric; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Parasite_01.description: An alien parasite-like head covering: a glossy dome cap ringed by a bony contrasting shell, with long segmented tentacle-legs curling down past the cheeks to the chin and clawed contrasting tips at the back and face.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Parasite_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and tentacle limbs; colour 1 on the ribbed stripes along the limbs and the speckles; colour 2 on the dome cap; colour 3 on the claw tips and the back emblem.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_01.description: A small metal crown with a narrow band and tall, flared, pointed spikes of varied height, with a row of round and teardrop gems around the band. It perches on top of the head like a royal circlet.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown band and spikes; colour 3 on some of the round gems; colour 2 on the other round gems; colour 1 on the teardrop gem.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_02.description: A small spiked crown with a narrow band set with diamond-shaped studs and tall zigzag points, each tipped with a round ball. It sits on top of the head like a party crown, with a lining showing inside the front.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the crown points; colour 1 on the ball tips; colour 2 on the diamond studs; colour 3 on the inner lining at the front.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_03.description: A small open-frame crown sitting on top of the head: a lattice of thin angular bands rises into tall points tipped with diamond-shaped finials, with diamond cutouts around the base band. Regal, fantasy-flavoured party headwear.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base band and inner lattice; colour 1 on the tall outer points and finials; colour 2 on the inner back spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Party_Hat_Tiny_01.description: A miniature top hat perched on the upper side of the head: a wide flat brim, a short cylindrical crown with a zigzag-edged cap and two thin bands, and a tied bow with dangling ribbon tails. Playful party style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Party_Hat_Tiny_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim and the crown sides; colour 1 on the zigzag-edged top of the crown; colour 2 on the bands around the crown; colour 3 on the bow and ribbon tails.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Partyhat_01.description: A small cone-shaped party hat with spiral stripes, perched on top of the head and held by a thin chin strap running down the side of the face. Playful, festive novelty headwear.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Partyhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone body; colour 2 on the spiral stripes and underside; colour 1 on the thin chin strap.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Persian_01.description: A decorative headband circling the forehead, covered in rows of embossed round medallions with a second row of larger discs hanging below, plus two long smooth cloth strands falling past the shoulders at each side.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the embossed medallions; colour 1 on the band base behind them; colour 2 on the hanging discs and thin back cord; colour 0 on the long side strands.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Persian_02.description: A headband-style circlet worn across the forehead: a raised band covered in embossed concentric discs, with a row of octagonal disc studs hanging below and joined by a thin cord around the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Persian_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the band base; colour 3 on the embossed concentric discs and the centres of the hanging octagonal discs; colour 2 on the rims of the octagonal discs.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Persianhood_01.description: A flat-topped cloth cap with a thick, wrinkled band around the brim, and a draped head-wrap hanging from it that covers the hair, ears, neck and lower face in loose folds, leaving the eyes and upper face open.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Persianhood_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cap crown; colour 2 on the wrinkled band; colour 0 on the draped head-wrap.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Persianhood_01.differs: The wrap on the female version drapes closer around the lower face and chin, with the cap sitting slightly tilted.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Pointedcap_01.description: A small, thin faceted cap that covers a narrow strip along the top of the head, running from a pointed V at the forehead back over the crown to a rounded edge. It sits flush on the scalp like a mohawk-shaped skullcap.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Pointedcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Pompom_01.description: A knitted beanie with a ribbed folded cuff and horizontal stripe bands, topped with a large shaggy pompom. Two braided cords hang from the ear areas, each ending in a small spiky pompom. Casual winter style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Pompom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, top pompom and braided cords; colour 1 on the wide stripe bands and the dangling pompoms; colour 2 on the stripe; colour 3 on the thin stripe near the crown.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Prisonguard_01.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet with a rounded shell, a raised central stripe running front to back, segmented panels with ribbed insets, and a thick padded band wrapping low around the back and sides of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Prisonguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the central stripe and front tab; colour 2 on the padded rear band and top edge panels; colour 3 on the ribbed side insets.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Pulp_Aviatorcap_01.description: A close-fitting leather aviator cap with a paneled, seamed crown and ear flaps that hang down each side of the face. Fleece-like trim edges the brow and flaps, and a small buckled strap dangles at each ear.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Pulp_Aviatorcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leather crown and flaps; colour 1 on the fleece trim around the edge; colour 2 on the small buckles.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Pulp_Aviatorcap_02.description: A close-fitting leather aviator cap with panelled seams, a band around the crown, and ear flaps with contrasting piping and small buckle straps. Goggles with rounded lenses sit on the forehead. Classic pulp flyer style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Pulp_Aviatorcap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap shell, band and goggle frames; colour 1 on the piping and lining edges of the ear flaps; colour 3 on the goggle lenses; colour 2 on the goggle rims and buckles.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Railroadspikes_01.description: A cluster of long railroad-spike nails radiating outward from a single point on the crown of the head, each with a tapered shaft and a flat rounded head. Punk, monstrous look, sitting on top of the scalp.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Railroadspikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike shafts; colour 1 on the flat heads of the spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A close-fitting pilot-style helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, open at the face, with raised ridges running front to back, chevron-shaped panels, and round speaker-like pods with small knobs over each ear.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised ridges, ear-side shell and pod rings; colour 0 on the chevron panels and lower rear panels; colour 2 on the recessed crown panels and ear pods; colour 3 on the thin accent lines along the chevrons and back stripes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Redstone_01.description: A smooth, streamlined helmet that hugs the skull, built from faceted angular panels with grooved seams running front to back. It ends in a short fringe-like brow over the forehead and leaves the face open.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell panels; colour 1 on the rear and lower side panels; colour 2 on the seam grooves.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Redstone_01.differs: The female helmet has a straight, bang-like brow edge across the forehead, while the male one has a pointed V-shaped brow over the nose.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Resistance_02.description: A smooth, rounded full-head helmet with a domed crown and open back. The front has a angular T-shaped opening for the eyes and nose, with a narrow guard running down over the chin. Sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Resistance_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole helmet shell; the chin guard and inner edges also take colour 0. No other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Retroscifi_Skullca.description: A close-fitting skullcap that covers the crown and back of the head, with a contrasting band trimming the front hairline and running down past the temples. Its smooth, plain shape suggests a retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Retroscifi_Skullca.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one half of the cap; colour 2 on the other half; colour 1 on the trim band along the hairline and sides.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ripper_01.description: An open-topped mechanical headband-helmet: a thick band wraps the head with spiky skeletal ribs arching over the crown, a knuckle-like ridged brow, claw-like prongs framing the eyes and cheeks, and short cylindrical pods jutting from each temple.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main band and brow; colour 0 on the crown ribs and the claw-like prongs around the eyes; colour 2 on the temple pods; colour 3 on the rings of the pods.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.description: A tight-fitting hairstyle made of overlapping stone plates, with tall jagged shards rising at the front and crown and a few larger crystal spikes fanning out at the temples. It covers the scalp down to about chin level.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates; colour 1 on the large crystal spikes; colour 3 on the cracks and seams between the plates.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A close-fitting full helmet with a tall swept-back central fin, layered angular plates stacked over the crown and back, a large visor panel over the face, and ribbed vented cheek guards. Sci-fi armoured look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell plates and cheek guards; colour 2 on the central fin; colour 1 on the visor panel; colour 3 on the thin accent stripe above the visor.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_02.description: A close-fitting alien helmet with a swept-back crest of pointed fins on top, a pointed brow guard over the eyes, ribbed cheek and ear vents, and a segmented ribbed band around the back of the skull. The face stays open below the brow.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest, brow and main shell; colour 3 on the accent strip beneath the crest; colour 2 on the ear vents and back ribbing; colour 1 on the ribbed cheek plates.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.description: A close-fitting armoured helmet with a pointed brow visor over the eyes, swept-back spiky crest plates, ribbed cheek guards with round side vents, and stacked segmented bands wrapping the back of the head. Leaves the mouth and chin bare.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, crest plates and brow; colour 3 on the strip under the crest; colour 2 on the round side vents and the recessed back bands; colour 1 on subtle band edges.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.differs: The female helmet has a shorter, lower crest with fewer swept spikes and darker banding at the back.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Roundedcap_01.description: A small, smooth rounded cap that covers only a narrow strip along the top-centre of the head, from the forehead hairline back toward the crown, with a thin edge. Suggests a sleek helmet plate.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Roundedcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap surface.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A winged knightly helmet: a smooth rounded metal cap with a faceplate guard over the nose and cheeks, a leaf-patterned crest panel on the brow, and two tall feathered wings sweeping up from the sides.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the feather edges on the front of the wings; colour 1 on the trim edging, faceplate rims and the wing feathers; colour 3 on the crest panel over the brow.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A samurai kabuto helmet: a ribbed, studded dome with a small peak finial, a narrow brim, upturned side wings, and a flared neck guard of stacked lamellar plates covering the sides and back of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and neck-guard plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and trim lines; colour 2 on the finial and the underside of the brim.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Samurai_01.differs: The female version has no contrasting cloth lining showing beneath the front of the helmet and its side wings are slimmer.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: An open-faced sci-fi helmet frame: a segmented band wraps the forehead and sides of the head, with angular cheek plates and a chin guard that curves under the jaw, leaving the face and crown uncovered.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and some plates; colour 1 on the large curved cheek and brow panels; colour 2 on the rectangular side blocks and brow band; colour 3 on the chin edge trim.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.differs: The female version's brow band sits higher and is open across the front, so it reads as a lighter frame, while the male version has a solid brow strip across the eyes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Skullcap_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting skullcap helmet that covers the crown and back of the head down to the nape, with a pointed dip at the brow and narrow tabs framing the temples. Sleek, plain and sporty-superhero in style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Skullcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap shell; the small temple tabs also take colour 0.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Sorceror_01.description: A tall, tube-like sorcerer's hat with a jagged, crown-like upper rim of pointed spikes, a contrasting trim band at the brow, a square glyph badge at front and back, and thin spikes projecting from each side.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Sorceror_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hat; colour 2 on the jagged upper rim and side spikes; colour 1 on the brow band and badge plate; colour 3 on the glyph symbol.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A pharaoh-style nemes headdress: a cloth hood with two broad lappets falling past the jaw to the shoulders, a rigid browband with a central emblem, and a narrow tail hanging down the back. Diagonal panels give it a sci-fi ancient look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the browband, inner face frame, back tail and some diagonal panels; colour 1 on the main cloth of the hood and lappets; colour 2 on the diagonal panels and lappet hems; colour 3 on small accents under the lappets and side.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_02.description: A pharaoh-style nemes headcloth: a soft, flowing cloth hood that drapes over the crown and hangs in two lappets past the ears to the shoulders, with a banded diagonal pattern and a narrow tail down the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cloth and lappet fronts; colour 0 on the brow band, inner folds and rear tail; colour 2 on the diagonal back stripe and lappet edges; colour 3 on small accents at the neck edges.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A chunky sci-fi visor headset: a boxy front shield covers the eyes and upper face, joined by a band around the head to round earcup discs at the sides, with a rear panel.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front visor block, earcup hubs and trim stripes; colour 1 on the headband and earcup shells; colour 2 on the strip above the visor; colour 3 on the inner and rear panels.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.differs: The female version has a contrasting strip along the top of the visor with a contrasting panel visible behind it, and the front block sits slightly lower.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_01.description: A close-fitting skullcap helmet with a smooth seamed shell and small vent holes at the sides, studded with rows of short cone spikes over the crown, sides and back. Sits snug on the head with the face and ears left open.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the cone spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_01_New.description: A floating open-ring halo hovering above the head, a thick curved band with three long tapering spikes: one on each side and one pointing forward at the front. Gothic, monstrous accent with a gap at the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_01_New.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring band; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_0.description: A thin spiked halo crown standing upright above the head like a floating arc: a curved band with a tall central spike, angled side spikes, two small horn-like spikes above and two swept, hooked contrasting barbs at the outer ends.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved band and its central and side spikes; colour 3 on the two small upper spikes; colour 2 on the two outer hooked barbs.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_0.differs: The female band has a visible break or kink near the centre, where the two halves of the arc meet unevenly.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_0.description: A broken halo of spikes floating in a vertical arc behind and above the head: a segmented curved band with a tall central spike, smaller side spikes, and detached hooked blades at the outer ends.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved band and the tall central and side spikes; colour 3 on the small floating spikes; colour 2 on the outer hooked blades.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_0.description: A floating spiked halo arc hovering above the head, made of a curved band with a tall central spike and shorter side spikes, plus small detached cone spikes and two curved hook-like blades flaring outward at the sides.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved band and its spikes; colour 3 on the small cone spikes; colour 2 on the outer hook blades.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_0.description: A floating spiked halo crown: a thin curved band with a tall central spike and smaller side spikes, flanked by two small detached horn-like thorns and two swept, hooked barbs at the sides. It sits above the head without touching it.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved band and its spikes; colour 3 on the two small thorns above the band; colour 2 on the hooked barbs at the sides.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Large_.description: A floating halo ornament hovering above the head: concentric spiral bands wrap around a central round gem, with three long tapering spikes radiating outward, one pointing forward-down. Suggests a sci-fi or fantasy crown.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Large_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiral bands; colour 3 on the central orb; colour 2 on the three spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spikeymask_01.description: A sleek, angular mask-helmet covering the crown, forehead and upper face, with a pointed brow ridge, narrow slanted eye openings and a crest of sharp spikes fanning out around the top and sides. Superhero or monstrous style.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Spikeymask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the mask; colour 1 on the tips of the spikes as a fade; colour 3 on the trim lining the eye openings; colour 2 on the inner back of the shell.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathere.description: A hawk-styled head covering: overlapping feathers cover the crown, back of the head and neck, ending in a feathered ruff at the collarbone. A beaked half mask with swept-up pointed ear tufts covers the eyes and nose and leaves the mouth open.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathere.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers and ruff; colour 1 on the beaked mask and the outer edges of the ear tufts; colour 2 on the inner sides of the ear tufts.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Steelhawk_Mask_01.description: A close-fitting metal helmet with segmented horizontal ridges over the crown, a swept nose-guard and brow piece over the face, and tall feathered wing blades sweeping up from each side. Superhero hawk styling.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Steelhawk_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and chin edge; colour 1 on the wing blades; colour 2 on the brow and nose-guard plate and thin ridge lines.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A close-fitting helmet with a swept-back crest of segmented plates, pointed fin-like wings at the temples, a nose guard and open eye slits. It covers the crown, sides and back of the head, with a sharp point at the nape.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell, side wings and nose guard; colour 1 on the band flanking the crest and the large back panel; colour 3 on the segmented crest plates.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Techcat_01.description: A full-head mechanical cat helmet with pointed ears holding ribbed inner panels, a smooth domed crown, angular cheek plates, slanted eye slits and a separate faceplate that covers the nose and mouth down to the chin.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Techcat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed crown, ear rims and cheek plates; colour 1 on the faceplate and jaw panels; colour 3 on the eye slits and the ribbed ear inserts; colour 2 on the seams and the ribbing between the ear inserts.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Tiara_Warrior_01.description: A slim superhero tiara sitting low across the forehead, with a central pointed shield-shaped plate holding a star emblem, winged chevron layers either side, and thin banded strips wrapping around the head to the back.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Tiara_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band, shield frame and outer strips; colour 1 on the winged chevron layers and part of the star; colour 3 on the outline edging and the rear star; colour 2 in the shield centre.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Tiara_Warrior_01.differs: The front plate is smaller and the winged chevrons spread wider, with the side strips sitting slightly higher on the head.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Titan_01.description: A close-fitting angular helmet with a faceted domed crown, broad side panels and cheek guards that frame an open face. The brow is a pointed visor-like ridge, and the back is smooth. Suits a sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Titan_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the crown and brow; colour 0 on the side and back panels; colour 1 on the front cheek guards and the panel edges.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Urban_Beanie_01.description: A knitted, ribbed beanie that sits low on the head and covers the forehead down to the brows, with a slightly slouched crown and a wide contrasting cuff band edged with thin piping.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Urban_Beanie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed knit crown; colour 2 on the wide cuff band; colour 1 on the piping edging the cuff.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Vikorin_02.description: A crested alien headpiece: a smooth capped shell over the crown and brow with a fan of angular, hooked fins along the top, side prongs by the temples, and a long rigid tail curving down the back of the neck.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Vikorin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth shell and the tail; colour 1 on the crest fins, side prongs and edge panels; colour 3 on the thin inset lines.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Vine_01.description: A partial head piece of two mirrored, curling vine-like tendrils that frame the eyes and cheeks, with sharp thorn tips sprouting upward and curling round the temples and back of the head. Organic and monstrous, worn as a mask-like crown.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine tendrils; colour 0 on the swirled inner panels and highlights; colour 3 on the thorn tips and spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Viperpsionic_01.description: A smooth close-fitting helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, with raised curving trim lines, small round studs at the brow and temples, and three thin swept-back antenna spikes along the top. It leaves the face open.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Viperpsionic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the raised curving trim bands; colour 3 on the small studs and a thin ridge line; colour 2 on the antenna spikes.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Wedding_Tiara_01.description: A slim formal tiara: a thin curved band across the top of the forehead rising into scrolled, curling filigree arches around a central round gem. It sits at the hairline, giving an elegant, regal look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Wedding_Tiara_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the band and scrolls; colour 2 on the inner band and back edges; colour 3 on the central gem.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Wedding_Tiara_02.description: A formal bridal-style veil draped over the back of the head and falling past the shoulders, with a small jewelled tiara across the brow and a sheer panel hanging over the face. Scalloped, swirl-patterned edges.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Wedding_Tiara_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the veil cloth; colour 0 on the edge trim and swirl embroidery; colour 2 on the tiara band; colour 3 on the tiara gem.

Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Welder_01.description: A boxy welder-style helmet that covers the whole head and face down to the nose. It has a wide angular shell, a low slot opening at the front, two padded blocks on top and small bolts at the sides.
Female/F_Helmet_Tight_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the padded blocks on top and the straps inside the back; colour 3 on the front slot panel and the inner back panel.

Female/F_Helmet_Tinfoil_Hat_01.description: A snug, lumpy skullcap-style hat with a rolled band around the rim, a vertical stripe panel down the front, and two thin crinkled foil strips sticking up from the top like antennae. Comic, homemade look.
Female/F_Helmet_Tinfoil_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cap; colour 3 on the front stripe panel; colour 2 on the rim band and top patch; colour 0 on the antenna strips.

Female/F_Helmet_Toy_01.description: A tall, rounded cylindrical toy-soldier shako hat sitting high on the head, with a zigzag-edged band around the base and a raised fleur-de-lis style emblem on the front. Playful, cute military look.
Female/F_Helmet_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hat body; colour 1 on the zigzag band around the base; colour 2 on the front emblem.

Female/F_Helmet_Toy_Crown_01.description: A simple toy-style crown: a narrow open band worn on top of the head, rising into several tall, thin pointed spikes of uneven height. Flat, plain construction with a fantasy royal feel.
Female/F_Helmet_Toy_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crown band and spikes; the default material appears to darken the scheme, with no other separate colour areas visible.
Female/F_Helmet_Toy_Crown_01.differs: The female crown is darker and glossier, with taller, more irregular spikes that flare outward at uneven angles.

Female/F_Helmet_Traveler_01.description: A soft, rounded cap made of eight glossy leather-like wedge panels meeting at a small button on top, with a lighter inner band and thin contrasting piping around the rim. It sits snugly on the crown of the head.
Female/F_Helmet_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on alternating wedge panels; colour 3 on the other alternating wedge panels; colour 0 on the inner band at the rim; colour 2 on the piping and top button.

Female/F_Helmet_Traveler_02.description: A soft, slouchy beret-style cap with a puffed, wrinkled crown over a narrow contrasting band at the brow, topped by a tall curved feather plume that sweeps up from the side.
Female/F_Helmet_Traveler_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap crown; colour 2 on the band and the feather quill; colour 1 on the feather barbs.

Female/F_Helmet_Trumpknight_02.description: A smooth, rounded full-head helmet with a wide horizontal eye slit and a deep chin guard that covers the lower face and neck, finished with a thin contrasting rim at the bottom edge.
Female/F_Helmet_Trumpknight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper dome of the helmet; colour 1 on the lower face and neck guard; colour 2 on the bottom rim edging.

Female/F_Helmet_Umbrella_01.description: A novelty umbrella hat: a wide, shallow canopy of pointed fabric panels radiating from a central tip, with slim ribs ending in small ball tips, worn on top of the head on a narrow headband.
Female/F_Helmet_Umbrella_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on alternating canopy panels; colour 3 on alternating canopy panels; colour 2 on the remaining canopy panels; colour 0 on the ribs, ball tips and headband.

Female/F_Helmet_Unicorn_Horn_01.description: A single spiralling unicorn horn that tapers to a point, mounted on the centre of the forehead at the hairline and angled forward and upward. Twisting bands run along its length, giving a fantasy creature look.
Female/F_Helmet_Unicorn_Horn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded base and one spiral band; colour 1 on another spiral band; colour 2 on the twisting bands between them.

Female/F_Helmet_Urban_Anime_Hood_01.description: A close-fitting hood with a rounded crown and an open face, made of patchwork panels with a wide textured band wrapping around the back and sides of the head; the hem drapes to a point at the neck. Urban anime look.
Female/F_Helmet_Urban_Anime_Hood_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown patches and the inner front panel; colour 1 on the front brow band and lower side panels; colour 2 on the wide textured band around the head; colour 3 on small accents at the lower edges.

Female/F_Helmet_Urban_Anime_Hood_Ears_01.description: A soft, rounded hood with two pointed cat-like ears on top, an open face and a pointed peak at the back. A wide textured panel wraps the back and sides, with a contrasting inner lining around the face.
Female/F_Helmet_Urban_Anime_Hood_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, back and inner lining of the hood; colour 1 on the front brow band, ears and lower edges; colour 2 on the wide textured panel across the back and sides; colour 3 on small accents at the lower edge.

Female/F_Helmet_Viper_Supremeserpent_01.description: A snug serpent-styled helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, with a segmented central ridge running front to back, angular cheek plates with small eye slits, and short fang-like points at the brow. The face stays open.
Female/F_Helmet_Viper_Supremeserpent_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented central ridge, back shell and lower band; colour 0 on the cheek plates; colour 2 on the brow and side frame; colour 3 on the eye slits.

Female/F_Helmet_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A tall conical hennin hat with a textured scale-like cone and a decorative band at the brim, trailing a long triangular veil down the back with a scalloped lace edge, plus loose hair strands at the sides.
