Female/F_Helmet_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone and the upper veil; colour 1 on the lower veil and hair tips; colour 2 on the scalloped veil edge; colour 3 on the decorative band.
Female/F_Helmet_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The veil hangs slightly longer and sweeps further out behind the head, with a narrower, more pointed drape.

Female/F_Helmet_Wizard_Hat_01.description: A classic wizard hat with a wide, wavy, drooping brim and a tall crumpled cone that bends into a curled tip. A belt band with a square buckle wraps around the base of the cone.
Female/F_Helmet_Wizard_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim and cone; colour 1 on the curled tip of the cone, fading in from the cone; colour 2 on the band; colour 3 on the buckle.
Female/F_Helmet_Wizard_Hat_01.differs: The female hat has a plain band with only a buckle, without the small skull ornament on the side.

Female/F_Helmet_Wolf_01.description: A full wolf-head helmet with a long tapered muzzle, tall pointed ears with swirling filigree at their bases, a central raised crest running down the snout, and swept-back pointed flares at the rear. It covers the whole head.
Female/F_Helmet_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 3 on the central snout stripe and thin edge lines; colour 2 on the ears and swirl ornaments; colour 1 on the eyes.

Female/F_Helmet_Wolf_Pelt_01.description: A wolf-pelt headdress worn over the head like a hood: the wolf face with pointed ears sits over the brow, and shaggy fur drapes over the shoulders and back. Two paws cross at the chest, tied with a knot.
Female/F_Helmet_Wolf_Pelt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the cape, ears, muzzle and paws; colour 1 on the fur over the head and face and the fur tips; colour 3 on the knot at the chest; colour 2 on the nose and inner ears.

Female/F_Helmet_Wooden_01.description: A tribal face mask helm with a carved skull-like face, curved horns at the temples, a ring of long pointed feather-like spikes fanning around the head, and small hoop earrings hanging beside the jaw.
Female/F_Helmet_Wooden_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face, horns and spikes; colour 1 on the central face marking, spike tips and horn tips; colour 3 on the eyes, mouth line and horn bands; colour 2 on the horn stripes and spike edges.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_01.description: A pair of tall, slender segmented antennae rising from the top of the head and curving outward then inward, each with jointed sections and a tapered tip. Suggests an alien or insectoid look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower antenna stalks; colour 1 on the upper jointed segments; colour 2 on the joint bands; colour 3 on the tips.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_01.differs: The female antennae curve more sharply forward, with a longer arc and tips pointing toward the front, and are set slightly wider apart.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_02.description: A pair of long, thin curving antennae rising from the top of the head, each with a thick base stalk, a slender ringed upper section and a rounded knob at the tip. Suggests an insectoid or alien look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the thick lower stalks; colour 0 on the slender upper stalks; colour 2 on the small rings; colour 3 on the tip knobs.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Amazon_01.description: A helmet crest worn along the centre of the head: a curved metal base band supports a tall, swept-back fin-like plume that trails to a long point behind the head, with small spiked studs along the ridge.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plume; colour 2 on the base band; colour 0 on the thin edge trim along the band; colour 3 on the small spikes and struts.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Animatroinc_01.description: A pair of tall, tapering faceted spikes like mechanical horns or antennae, each mounted on a small rectangular bracket on top of the head and angled slightly outward and upward.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Animatroinc_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tapered spikes; colour 0 on the small mounting brackets.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Anniversary16_2025.description: A pair of side-of-head feather fans that flare out from the temples and ears, with small feather tufts under the jaw and a small bone-shaped ornament across the top of the head. Tribal, fantasy styling.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Anniversary16_2025.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the feathers and jaw tufts; colour 2 on the inner feather panels and the band on the bone; colour 0 on the bone ends.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Anniversary16_2025.differs: The female version has contrasting feathers with contrasting inner panels and a contrasting bone band, unlike the male's mixed light and contrasting feather colouring.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Anniversary_Destro.description: A thin metal circlet band sitting around the crown of the head, dipping to a pointed V over the brow, with several tall curved spikes rising from it like a spiked crown. Villainous retro sci-fi style.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Anniversary_Destro.colourAreas: Glossy metal ignores most of the colour scheme; the band and spikes show a metallic finish, with colour 0 faintly on the band edges.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Anniversary_Destro.differs: The female version has a slightly heavier, flatter band with a more pronounced pointed brow dip, and the spikes are shorter and more swept back.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Anniversary_Mindsl.description: A small round forehead plaque with a faceted rim and a raised, pinched diamond-shaped gem-like bulge at its centre. It sits flat on the brow like a third-eye ornament, with a plain flat back.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Anniversary_Mindsl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the round plaque base; colour 3 on the raised diamond centre.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Batwings_01.description: A pair of small bat wings mounted on the top of the head, one at each side. Each has a curved, jointed arm with clawed tips and thin membrane panels stretched between the fingers. Gives a demonic, gothic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Batwings_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing arms and finger bones; colour 3 on the claw tips at the wing peaks; colour 1 on the membrane, fading toward colour 0 at the edges.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Beanie_01.description: A small propeller-beanie topper: a slim turned spindle with a pointed tip rises from the crown of the head, carrying a thin two-blade propeller with a twisted, tapered shape on a central hub. Whimsical and cute.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Beanie_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spindle and tip; colour 0 on the propeller blades and hub; colour 3 on the small rings on the spindle.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Beanie_02.description: A slim vertical spindle rising from the crown of the head like a propeller mast: a tapered shaft, a small ringed bulge, a chunky cylindrical hub, a short collar and a pointed cone tip. Whimsical mechanical topper.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Beanie_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tapered shaft, ring bulges and pointed tip; colour 0 on the cylindrical hub; colour 3 on the thin ring below the hub; colour 2 on the collar under the tip.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Beast_Stag_Antlers.description: A pair of wide stag antlers rising from small base nubs on top of the head, sweeping outward with forked tines; the right antler is shorter and broken-looking. Suits a beast, fantasy or woodland look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Beast_Stag_Antlers.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base nubs and lower antler shafts; colour 1 on the upper branches and tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Beast_Stag_Antlers.description: A pair of wide-spreading stag antlers rising from small bases on top of the head, sweeping outward and upward with several sharp pointed tines per side. Suggests a fantasy beast or forest creature look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Beast_Stag_Antlers.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bases and lower antler beams; colour 1 on the upper branches and tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: Heavy chains looped in angular, zigzagging bands that wrap around the head and neck in a cage-like tangle, with a few loose links floating beside the head. Suggests a gothic, monstrous restraint look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: Chains mostly take the metal material and show little of the scheme; colour 3 shows as a reddish tint in the deeper links, and colour 2 in the shadowed links.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Bloodmoon_2025_01.differs: The female version has only the chains, with no contrasting neck-and-jaw guard piece under them.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Bowtie_01.description: A small angular bow accessory perched on the upper front-side of the head, with a rounded faceted central knot and stiff pointed loops and tails splaying outward. Suggests a cute, sci-fi magical-girl hair ornament.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central knot and main bow loops; colour 1 on the curved panels of the loops and knot; colour 2 on the upright loop tip; colour 3 on the inner tail accents.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Brutal_01.description: A slim, faceted headband that circles the forehead and crown. It has a padded main strip with thin contrasting edge piping, and a diamond-shaped gem at the centre front flanked by two round studs. Suggests a sci-fi or tribal look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the edge piping; colour 2 on the central diamond and the studs.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Brutal_01.differs: The female band has a slightly narrower, more angular polygonal outline. A small pointed tab shows at the back below the band.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Buzzsaw_01.description: A cluster of floating toothed circular saw blades with hollow hubs and studded rivet dots, hovering unattached around one side of the head: two by the cheek, one at the temple, one behind the ear.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Buzzsaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade faces; colour 1 on the blade rims; colour 3 on the rivet dots; colour 2 on the hub rings and the darker blade undersides.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Buzzsaw_01.differs: The blades sit slightly differently around the head, but the piece has the same design, so there is no meaningful difference.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Buzzsaw_02.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades mounted on one side of the face: one large blade over the cheek, a smaller one below it, and a third angled up across the brow like an eye guard.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Buzzsaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade rims and toothed edges; colour 1 on the blade discs; colour 3 on the star-shaped hub patterns; colour 2 on the blade undersides and centre holes.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Buzzsaw_02.differs: The brow blade is tilted higher and sits farther out from the forehead, while the cheek blades sit slightly lower on the face.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Buzzsaw_03.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades floating at the side of the head, one large blade beside the eye, a smaller one below it and a contrasting blade angled up over the forehead. Mechanical, monstrous cyborg styling.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Buzzsaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade discs and teeth; colour 1 on the inner ring of each blade; colour 3 on the small rivet dots; colour 2 on the upper forehead blade.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Buzzsaw_03.differs: The upper forehead blade is contrasting and the blades show contrasting rings with contrasting dots, while the male version's blades look plain contrasting and glossy.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Celestial_Dragon_0.description: A pair of slender, branching antler-like dragon horns rising from the top of the head and sweeping up and slightly back, each forking into several pointed tines. Fantasy creature headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Celestial_Dragon_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of each horn; colour 1 on the upper branches and tips, blending in a gradient.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Celestial_Dragon_0.differs: The female horns are somewhat more upright and slimmer, with the branches held closer to the stem.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Anubis_Stag_.description: A pair of wide, sweeping stag antlers rising from small bone-like bases on the forehead, each curving outward and up into several sharp tines. Fantasy beast headpiece with a natural, organic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Anubis_Stag_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bases and the lower antler shafts; colour 1 on the upper shafts and branching tines; colour 2 on the sharp tine tips.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Anubis_Stag_.differs: The female antlers sit lower and sweep out more sideways and backward, so they look less upright and less tall than the male ones.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Anubis_Stag_.description: A pair of wide, branching stag antlers rising from small bony bases at the brow, sweeping outward with several pointed tines. One antler is visibly broken and shorter than the other. Suggests a beastly, mystic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Anubis_Stag_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony bases and lower antler shafts; colour 1 on the upper shafts and branching tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Anubis_Stag_.differs: The female antlers sit lower and sweep out more to the sides, with a more noticeably broken, shorter left antler.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Beast_Stag_A.description: A pair of wide-spreading stag antlers rising from small bases on top of the head, each with a long sweeping main beam and several sharp upward tines. Suits beast, fantasy or woodland-spirit looks.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Beast_Stag_A.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bases and the lower parts of the beams; colour 1 on the upper beams and tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Beast_Stag_A.description: A pair of wide stag antlers rising from small bony bases on top of the head, sweeping outwards with several tapering tines; one side is asymmetrically broken and shorter. Suits beast, fantasy or woodland looks.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Beast_Stag_A.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bases and the lighter lower antler shafts; colour 1 on the upper shafts and tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Crow_01.description: A pair of tall, ridged horns rising from the top of the head and curving up and slightly forward to sharp tips, with segmented banding along each length. Suggests a demonic or beastly look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Crow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of each horn; colour 3 on the tips, blending into colour 0 along the length as a gradient.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Dragon_Spine.description: A mohawk-style crest of curved fin membrane running from forehead over the crown and down the back of the head, studded with long curved horn spikes, ending in a sweeping tail-like point behind the neck.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Dragon_Spine.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fin membrane; colour 2 on the shaded edges and base of the membrane; colour 3 on the spikes.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Face_Hornssm.description: A pair of small smooth cone-shaped horns set on the forehead either side of the brow line, pointing outward and slightly back from the head. A subtle, monstrous accessory for creature or demon looks.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Face_Hornssm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both horns; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Foxbatcon_20.description: Head attachment of six frond-like gill feathers, three fanning out from each side of the head, with serrated edges. They float around the skull with no cap or covering, giving an aquatic, monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Foxbatcon_20.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of each frond; colour 3 on the frond edges and tips near the base. Colour 0 and colour 2 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Full_Dino_01.description: A pair of short, angular pyramid-shaped horns rising from the top of the head, tilted slightly outward and forward. They are faceted and tapered to sharp points, giving a monstrous or demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Full_Dino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both horns across all faces; the default material shows no other colour slots.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Fullhelm_Mec.description: A sleek, sharply swept helmet cap that sits on top of the head and leaves the face open. Segmented armor plates run back into a long pointed crest, with a raised faceted panel at the brow.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Fullhelm_Mec.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 3 on the stripe running along the crest and the brow lines; colour 1 on the faceted brow panel and small side fin; colour 2 on the underside and rear opening.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Fullhelm_Vip.description: A sleek, angular sci-fi cap-style helmet that covers the crown and upper head, with layered plates, a central vented ridge, a raised boxy block on top, and pointed rear flaps. The face and lower head stay bare.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Fullhelm_Vip.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell plates; colour 2 on the central ridge and inner vent panels; colour 1 on the raised block on top; colour 3 on the small accent slits in the ridge.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Gadroon_Stag.description: A pair of wide-spreading stag antlers rising from small bony bases on the top of the head, each branching into several long tapering tines that sweep outward and upward. Suggests a woodland beast or fantasy creature.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Gadroon_Stag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bases and the lower part of each antler; colour 1 on the upper beams and tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Gadroon_Stag.description: A pair of wide, branching stag antlers rising from the top of the forehead and sweeping outward, with several tines per side. One antler is shorter and snapped, giving an uneven, broken look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Gadroon_Stag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and lower stems of the antlers; colour 1 on the upper branches; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Head_Bucket_.description: A small faceted crest or strip that arches over the top of the head from forehead to the back of the skull, like a mohawk-shaped cap. It leaves the sides of the head and the face bare.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Head_Bucket_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crest; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Horns_Legend.description: A pair of long, curved horns rising from the top of the forehead, sweeping up and outward then bending back at pointed tips, with ridged, grooved surfaces. Suits demonic, beastly or fantasy characters.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Horns_Legend.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and body of each horn; colour 1 on the upper tips, fading in as a gradient toward the points.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Horns_Legend.description: A pair of large ridged horns that start at the brow and sweep outward and upward in long tapering curves with pointed tips. The horns are separate, with grooved surfaces, and suggest a beastly or demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Horns_Legend.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and main lengths; colour 1 on the horn tips as a gradient fade.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Knighthelmet.description: A thin, curved metal fin that runs front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk, rising to a tall crest at the front. Rows of small studs run along its side, and the edge is a pointed ridge.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Knighthelmet.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin body; colour 3 on the studs along the side; colour 1 on the thin edge trim.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lemurian_Fin.description: A single tall fin-shaped crest running front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk: a membrane webbed between curved, tapering spines that sweep outward and back, with a spotted surface.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lemurian_Fin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane; colour 1 on the curved spines and edge trim; colour 3 on the spots across the membrane; colour 2 on the shaded base of the membrane.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lemurian_Fin.description: A pair of membranous fins mounted on either side of the head, each fanned out with long curved spines and a spotted webbing, sweeping up and back from the temples like a lemurian sea-creature crest.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lemurian_Fin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spotted webbing between the spines; colour 1 on the spines and edging; colour 3 on the spots; colour 2 on the shaded inner webbing.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lemurian_Fin.differs: The female fins are smaller and set lower, with shorter, more swept-back spines.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lemurian_Fin.description: A crest of fin-like membranes with curved spiny ribs running front to back over the top of the head, forming a mohawk-style ridge with a tall central spike and smaller fins flaring to each side.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lemurian_Fin.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiny ribs and central spike; colour 0 on the membrane between the ribs; colour 3 on the spots across the membranes; colour 2 on the shaded membrane bases.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lockbox_66_F.description: A feathered crest headdress: a single arc of pointed feathers fanning across the top of the head from ear to ear, tallest at the centre and shorter toward the sides, floating above the scalp like a tribal crown.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lockbox_66_F.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lower part of each feather; colour 3 on the feather tips; colour 2 on the darkened blend between them.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lockbox_66_M.description: A close-fitting angular helmet covering the skull and back of the head, with a separate faceplate that has a nose ridge, eye slits and a greek-key motif on the chin. A V-shaped stripe crosses the back.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Lockbox_66_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the faceplate, the stripe trim along the crown and the chin motif; colour 3 on the thin lines around the eyes and mouth; colour 2 in the eye openings.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.description: A pair of slender insect antennae rising from the brow above each eye, each with a faceted collar base and a long tapering stalk that arcs outward and back, ending in a small bead tip.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted base collars; colour 1 on the main stalk sections; colour 2 on the thin outer stalk ends; colour 3 on the tip beads.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.description: A pair of long, slender insect antennae that rise from small socket bases at the brow, sweeping outward and back in gently curved, tapering segments with tiny tips. Suits alien or insectoid characters.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the socket bases and the base end of each antenna; colour 1 on the middle segments; colour 2 on the thin outer segments; colour 3 on the tiny tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.description: A pair of slender insect-like antennae rising from small socket bases at the top front of the forehead, sweeping forward and outward in long tapering curves that end in tiny tips.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the socket bases; colour 1 on the thick lower stalks; colour 2 on the thin outer segments; colour 3 on the tiny tips.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.differs: The female antennae are longer and sweep further forward, and they angle less upward than the male ones.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.description: A pair of long, slender insectoid antennae rising from the forehead and sweeping forward and outward, each with a rounded base socket, a thick tapering shaft, a segmented ribbed tip and a tiny bead at the end.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded base sockets; colour 1 on the main shafts; colour 2 on the ribbed segmented tips; colour 3 on the small end beads.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.description: A pair of long, slender antennae rising from the top of the head and sweeping backward, each with a small faceted base, a segmented tapering shaft and a tiny tip. Suggests an insectoid or alien look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base sockets; colour 1 on the middle of each shaft; colour 2 on the upper shaft; colour 3 on the tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.description: A pair of slender antennae rising from the forehead near the hairline and sweeping forward and outward. Each has a chunky faceted base, a thicker tapered middle section and a thin whip-like tip with a small bead. Alien, insectoid look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted base sockets; colour 1 on the thick middle shafts; colour 2 on the thin tapering tips; colour 3 on the small tip beads.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.description: A pair of long, thin segmented antennae rising from the top-front of the head and sweeping back, each with a small base socket, a thicker banded middle section and a tapering tip.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Qularr_Anten.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base sockets; colour 1 on the thick middle segments; colour 2 on the thin upper shafts; colour 3 on the tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Ravenspeaker.description: A crest of broad feathers fanned in a mohawk-like arc along the centre line of the head from forehead to nape, each feather rising from a short contrasting quill. Suggests a tribal or raven-themed headdress.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Ravenspeaker.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quills and feather highlights; colour 1 on the main feather vanes; colour 2 on the feather edges and shadowed tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Ravenspeaker.description: A fan of long, pointed feathers on short quills, arranged in a radiating crest along the centre of the scalp from forehead to back of head, like a mohawk. Flamboyant luchador or tribal headdress style.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Ravenspeaker.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quills at the feather bases; colour 1 on the feather vanes; colour 2 on the darker feather edges and tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Serpent_Horn.description: A pair of segmented goat-like horns rising from the top-back of the head, curving backward and outward to sharp tips, each seated in a short collar-like base band.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Serpent_Horn.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn segments; colour 1 on the horn tips, fading in from the light shade; colour 3 on the base bands at the skull.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Spartanplume.description: A Spartan-style helmet crest: a bristly, brush-like plume arcing from brow to nape along the centre of the head, mounted on a narrow curved base strip with contrasting edge bands. The bare head shows on both sides.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Spartanplume.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bristle plume; colour 0 on the base strip; colour 1 on the inner edge band; colour 2 on the thin outer edge line.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Spartanplume.description: A Spartan-style helmet crest: a wide, fan-shaped plume of bristly strands mounted sideways, running ear to ear in an arc over the top of the head, with a layered banded base and no helmet shell.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Spartanplume.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bristle plume; colour 1 on the curved band at its base; colour 0 on the inner base strip.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Blade_.description: A single thin blade-like crest running front to back along the centre of the scalp, rising as a swept fin that sharpens to a point forward. Mohawk-like, it suggests a monstrous or sci-fi head ornament.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Blade_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crest; the material appears smooth and metallic, with little use of the other colour slots.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Blade_.description: A thin, flat blade-like crest running front to back along the centre of the skull, rising in a swept-back curve with a pointed tip over the back of the head. Punk mohawk styling in a monstrous, fantasy vein.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Blade_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade crest.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Blade_.description: A thin flat blade-like crest that rises from the centre of the crown, sweeping up and forward to a sharp point like a mohawk fin. It sits along the head's midline and suggests a monstrous or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Blade_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crest blade; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Blade_.description: A thin, flat blade-like crest shaped as a half-disc arc, standing upright along the midline of the head from forehead toward the back, like a sharp mohawk fin. Suggests a monstrous or sci-fi helmet crest.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Blade_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved outer edge of the blade; colour 1 on the flat side faces of the blade.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Crestf.description: A flat, U-shaped head crest with fluted grooves along its face and two outward-flaring pointed tips, mounted on a small wedge base at the front of the crown and standing upright above the forehead.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Crestf.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole crest and its base; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Destro.description: A slim angular circlet across the forehead with a central pointed gem-like crest, sweeping outward and up into two long tapering horn blades on either side. Sits on the brow, suggesting a sleek villainous or robotic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Destro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the circlet band and horn blades; colour 1 on the central crest gems.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Fullhe.description: A thick mohawk-style crest fin that runs from the forehead over the top of the head to the nape, tapering to a point at the brow. Its hollow, slab-like edge gives a bold, angular punk or creature look.
A narrow mohawk-style crest of smooth curved metal running front to back over the centre of the head, with a boxy louvred vent grille at the front. Sci-fi cyber look, leaving the face and sides bare.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Fullhe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest shell; colour 1 on the vent grille frame and slats; colour 2 on the grille interior.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Halo_0.description: A thin, faceted torus halo that floats horizontally above the head, hovering clear of the scalp with no attachment visible. A simple ring with a smooth rounded cross-section.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Halo_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring, with slight shading toward colour 1 on its underside.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.description: A pair of curved demon horns rising from the forehead near the hairline, each with segmented ridged bands, a swept-up tapering point and a small faceted base collar. Suggests a demonic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bands and shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips and upper shafts; colour 3 on the base collars at the skull.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.description: A pair of long, slender gazelle-style horns that rise from the top of the head, sweeping upward and backward in a gentle curve to fine points. Each sits in a small collar-like base.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the tapering horn tips; colour 3 on the base collars.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.differs: The female horns rise more upright and curve less sharply backward, while the male horns sweep further back.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.description: A pair of curved goat horns rising from the top of the head and sweeping backward in ridged arcs to sharp tips, each seated in a thick contrasting collar band at the base.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the base collars.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.description: A pair of large ridged goat horns rising from the top of the head and sweeping back in long curves to pointed tips, each seated in a angular collar-like base band on the crown.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips with a gradient blend; colour 3 on the base bands at the head.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.description: Four curved horns in two pairs rising from the top of the head: a long pair sweeping up and back, and a shorter pair curving forward from the brow. Each horn sits in a small collar-like base ring.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts, fading toward the tips; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the base rings around each horn.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.description: A set of six curved, tapering horns in two clusters of three, rising from the top of the head and sweeping up and back, each rooted in a small contrasting base collar. Monstrous, demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Horns_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips, fading from the shafts; colour 3 on the base collars at the roots.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.description: A set of swept-back curved horns on each side of the head, with ridged spines, small side horns and a thin serrated fin crest running front to back over the crown, attached by a slim band.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns, spines and crest fin; colour 3 on the horn tips and the thin band across the head.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.description: A head attachment of tall upright curved horns with ridged, banded surfaces, a row of smaller spikes along the crown, and swept fin-like wing blades at each side of the head, joined by thin bands over the scalp.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns, spikes and side blades; colour 3 on the horn bases, tips and the thin bands across the scalp.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.description: A small monstrous head piece: a pair of ridged horns sweeping back from the forehead, with a thin band along the scalp centre carrying a row of jagged, fin-like spikes running down to the nape.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and the spiked crest; colour 3 on the horn tips and the thin band along the scalp.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.description: A monstrous head accessory of curled, ridged horns: two clusters of tall curved horns over the crown, small pointed horns at the temples and rear, and a serrated fin-like crest running front to back along a thin band.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and crest plates; colour 3 on the horn tips and the thin band along the crest.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.description: A narrow mohawk-like ridge of jagged, angular plates running front to back along the centre of the skull, with a thin band base hugging the scalp and spikes that grow taller toward the back.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Hornsm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jagged spikes; colour 3 on the thin base band along the scalp.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Lightn.description: A thin, flat lightning-bolt crest standing upright on top of the head, running front to back with a single zigzag step. Edge-on from the front it reads as a slim spike; it suggests a comic-book superhero look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Lightn.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bolt panel; the thin edges catch the light but no other colour slot is visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Middle.description: Three separate conical spikes set in a line along the centre of the scalp, from forehead to crown, like a spiked mohawk. The tips point up and outward, with a small hexagonal stud at the front of the head.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Middle.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Middle.differs: The female version has its rear spike set lower and angled more sharply outward, with a smaller hexagonal stud at the front.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Mummy_.description: Three small curled strips of bandage-like cloth that float around a bare head: one curving up from the crown and one beside each ear. The head is left otherwise bare, suggesting a loose mummy wrapping look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Mummy_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the curled strips; colour 1 on the small base tab of the crown strip; colour 2 on the thin edges of the ear strips.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Mummy_.differs: The female version's crown strip is mostly light with only a small contrasting base, and the ear strips are smaller and more curled.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Rhino_.description: A single large rhino-style horn rising from the centre of the forehead, curving up and back to a sharp point, with ridged segments and a small rimmed base sitting on the hairline.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Rhino_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower horn body; colour 1 on the upper horn, fading toward the tip; colour 3 on the rim at the base.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Rhino_.description: A single small ridged horn rising from the centre of the forehead and curving up and back to a point, seated on a faceted, angular base plate. Suggests a rhino or beast look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Rhino_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the faceted base plate; colour 0 on the lower ridged section of the horn; colour 1 on the upper tip of the horn, blending from colour 0.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Ripper.description: A crown of thick flexible cable loops arching over the top of the scalp from forehead to back, each ending in a small connector plug that presses against the head. Suggests cybernetic implants or a neural interface.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Ripper.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cable hoses; colour 3 on the thin trim lines along the hoses; colour 1 on the connector rings; colour 0 on the plug tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Rocket.description: A slim head crest: a thin blade-like fin runs from the brow over the crown and sweeps up and back past the skull, joined to a narrow angular brow band with a pointed centre. Sleek, retro-futuristic styling.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Rocket.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band and the outer edges of the crest; colour 1 on the central stripe running along the crest; colour 2 on the thin outlines and the back of the fin.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Sharkf.description: A single thin, skin-like dorsal fin running front to back along the centre of the skull like a mohawk, rising to a tall swept-back point with a small notched edge at the rear. Monstrous, aquatic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Sharkf.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to tint the whole fin; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Sharkf.description: A large shark-fin crest running front to back along the centre of the head, a thin blade-like membrane that sweeps up and back to a pointed tip, with scalloped, ragged edges at the rear.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Sharkf.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to cover the whole fin; it takes a skin-like tone, so the other slots are not visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Sidesp.description: A set of conical horn-like spikes studding the head: two short blunt cones on the forehead and two pairs of longer pointed spikes sweeping up and back from the sides and crown. Suggests a monstrous or demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Sidesp.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the metallic default material shows little of the other colour slots.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Sidesp.differs: The female version has two blunt forehead nubs and fewer long spikes at the front, while the male has pointed spikes on the forehead.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Spiked.description: A floating open ring halo hovering above the head, made of a thick rounded band with a gap at the front and three long sharp spikes: one out to each side and one pointing down at the front.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Spiked.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring band; colour 2 on the spikes and the small connector block.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Spiked.description: A floating halo hovering above the head: concentric spiralling rings around a small central sphere, with three long tapering spikes radiating outward, one pointing forward and two sideways. It is not attached to the head and reads as a fantasy or alien crown.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Tight_Spiked.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiral rings; colour 3 on the central sphere; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Worm_Stag_An.description: A pair of wide-spreading stag antlers rising from small bases on the top of the head, each sweeping outward and up with several sharp branching tines. Suits beast, fantasy and woodland looks.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Worm_Stag_An.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small bases and the lower stems of the antlers; colour 1 on the upper branches and tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Worm_Stag_An.description: A pair of wide, thin stag antlers rising from small base knobs on the top of the head, sweeping outward with several sharp tines; one side is broken shorter. Suggests a fantasy beast or forest creature look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Child_Worm_Stag_An.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base knobs and the lighter lower antler shafts; colour 1 on the upper antler branches and tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Cosmic_01.description: A floating headpiece of two flat angular metal bands that arc from the temples up and outward, ending in upright prongs above the head, with a small hexagonal ring hovering at the forehead and another behind the head.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light band faces; colour 2 on the darker band faces and hexagon rings; colour 1 and colour 3 on the small connector blocks at the temples. The glossy metal material only partly follows the scheme.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Crest_Ironclad_01.description: A segmented armored crest running front to back along the centre of the skull like a mohawk, built from angular plates that step up toward the rear, with a fan of spiky blades and a round gem at the front.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Crest_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented crest plates; colour 1 on the fan of blades at the front; colour 2 on the round socket around the gem; colour 3 on the central gem.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Crest_Norse_01.description: A mohawk-style helmet crest running front to back over the centre of the head: a ridged, segmented central fin set in a rimmed border with a row of small rivets, ending in a small hooked flick at the rear.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Crest_Norse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and border; colour 1 on the ridged central fin; colour 2 on the rivets.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Crimson_01.description: A small crown-mounted head accessory: a compact angular base on top of the head holds two short segmented stalks, each sprouting a long feathery plume that arcs outward and downward like curved antennae.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the base; colour 0 on the stalks; colour 3 on the feathery plumes.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Cyborg_Ridge_01.description: A curved, plated mohawk ridge arching from the forehead over the crown to the nape, with a separate top plate along its spine, plus a thin angular band wrapping around the head at brow level.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Cyborg_Ridge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate of the ridge; colour 2 on the main body of the ridge; colour 1 on the head band.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Destroid_Crest_01.description: A head crest of two tall, swept-up horn-like fins rising from a curved band across the forehead, with a rounded oval plate at the front. It sits on top of the head, giving a mechanical helmet-horn look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Destroid_Crest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two fin blades; colour 1 on the edge trim of the fins and the band at the back; colour 2 on the oval front plate; colour 3 on the rim around the oval plate.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Dinosaur_01.description: A mohawk-style crest that runs front to back over the centre of the head, with a blade-like ridge of swept-back spikes along the top and a filigree of openwork curls in a separate inner panel. Suggests a dinosaur or monstrous fantasy look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Dinosaur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer spiked ridge and the curled framing; colour 1 on the inner panel behind the openwork; colour 3 on small markings in the inner panel.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Draco_01.description: A head-mounted circlet of swept-back horn blades: two large curved spikes with smaller barbs rise from each side of the brow, joined by a narrow V-shaped band that dips to a point over the forehead.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn blades and outer shell; colour 3 on the inner V-shaped band along the brow.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Dragon_Spines_01.description: A mohawk-like crest of curved spines running from the forehead over the crown and down past the nape, with a thin fin membrane between the spikes and a long swept-back tail. Suggests a dragon or beast.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Dragon_Spines_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fin membrane running along the crest; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the shaded edges of the membrane.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Dragonbody_Lockbox.description: A pair of curved antler-like horns rising from the temples, sweeping up and outward with a small side prong on each and pointed tips. A smooth gradient runs from base to tip. Suits a beastly or fantasy look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Dragonbody_Lockbox.colourAreas: Colour 0 at the base of each horn; colour 1 through the middle of the shafts; colour 2 at the tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Cyberpunk_Mons.description: A pair of segmented, curved horns made of angular mechanical plates, rising from the sides of the head and sweeping up and backward to tapered tips. A monstrous, cyberpunk look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Cyberpunk_Mons.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base segments of each horn; colour 1 on the middle segments; colour 2 on the narrow joints between segments; colour 3 on the tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Dog_01.description: A pair of pointed cartoon dog ears that stand upright on top of the head, each with a hollow inner cup, a tapered tip and a small spike at the base. They give a playful animal look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces; colour 1 as a gradient toward the ear tips; colour 2 on the inner ear hollows.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Kitten_01.description: A pair of cartoon cat ears with rounded triangular outer shells and hollow inner cups, perched on top of the head at either side of the crown. Soft, cute, animal-inspired styling.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Kitten_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rims of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear cups.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Mecha_Horse_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed mechanical horse ears: narrow angular blades that flare slightly at the base and taper to sharp tips, sitting upright on top of the head and tilting slightly outward.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Mecha_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer faces of the ears; colour 2 on the inner faces; colour 0 on the small panel patches at the back of the ears.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Raccoon_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that sit on top of the head and angle outward, each with a hollow cupped inner face and a smooth rounded back. Suggests a cute raccoon or fox costume.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Raccoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rims and front edges of the ears; colour 1 on the outer backs of the ears; colour 3 on the inner ear hollows; colour 2 in the deepest part of the inner hollows.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Teddy_01.description: A pair of small, round teddy-bear ears with a fuzzy, textured outer shell and a hollowed inner face. They sit high on the top-front of the head, angled slightly outward, for a cute animal look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fuzzy outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 1 on the inner ear face.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Teddybear_01.description: A pair of small rounded bear ears set on top of the head, each with a fuzzy outer shell, a zigzag stitched edge and a concave inner cup facing forward. Cute, playful animal-style headwear.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Teddybear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 1 on the inner ear cup; colour 2 on the zigzag stitching around the edge.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Werewolf_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed beast ears that sweep up and slightly outward from the sides of the head, with a curved outer shell and a separate inner panel. Suggests a werewolf or monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Ear_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of each ear; colour 3 on the inner ear panels.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Exartdecofullcrest.description: A thin, tall fin-like crest running front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk. It sweeps up and back in a curved blade with a raised edge, ending in a point at the rear. Art deco style.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Exartdecofullcrest.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crest blade; colour 1 on the raised edge band along the front; colour 2 on the thin inlaid line down the middle.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Exartdecohalfcrest.description: A thin, swept-back fin crest that runs front to back along the centre line of the head like a mohawk, curving up into a tall blade at the front and flaring to a pointed tail behind. Retro-futuristic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Exartdecohalfcrest.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crest body; colour 1 on the front edge strip; colour 2 on the thin groove line along the middle.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Extra_Brutal_01.description: A small diamond-shaped gemstone with a faceted, glossy surface, sitting flat against the middle of the forehead like a third-eye jewel. Slightly thick with a raised central ridge, suggesting a fantasy or monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Extra_Brutal_01.colourAreas: The whole gem is a single glossy material that largely ignores the colour scheme; no distinct colour slot is clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Extra_Tight_Ribbon.description: A single long, narrow ribbon that starts at the top of the head, arches over the crown and hangs straight down the back to below the hips, tapering to a point. Simple cloth accessory with a soft, flowing drape.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Extra_Tight_Ribbon.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the band where it crosses the top of the head; colour 0 on the main length of the ribbon; colour 1 on the thin edge and tip.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Face_Bunnyears_01.description: A pair of tall, slender rabbit ears rising from the top of the head, each with a curved outer shell and a hollow inner face. One ear is bent over at the tip. Cute, playful animal styling.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Face_Bunnyears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells of the ears; colour 1 on the inner edges and lining of the ears.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Face_Bunnyears_01.differs: The female ears stand more upright and taller, with one ear folded at its tip.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Face_Catears_01.description: A pair of pointed cat ears rising from the top front of the head, with smooth outer shells and hollow inner faces that show a gradient. Simple low-poly, cute animal-style headwear.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Face_Catears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells of the ears; colour 1 and colour 3 blend across the inner faces of the ears.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Face_Catears_02.description: A pair of small, pointed cat ears with a smooth outer shell and a hollow inner face, perched on the upper front of the head and angled slightly outward. A cute animal-themed head accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Face_Catears_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of each ear; colour 1 and colour 3 blended on the inner face of each ear.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Face_Hornssmall_01.description: A pair of small smooth conical horns mounted on the forehead near the hairline, one on each side, pointing outward and slightly forward with flat open bases. Suggests a demonic or beastly look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Face_Hornssmall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both horns; no other colours visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Fairy_01.description: A pair of thin antenna-like stalks rising from the top of the head and angling outward, each ending in a flat curling spiral. A whimsical fairy or insect look, sitting on the crown.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Fairy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalks and the inner spiral; colour 1 on the upper stalk and the spiral's middle coil; colour 2 on the outer spiral edge.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Fairy_01.differs: The female stalks are shorter and sit closer to the head, so the spirals curl nearer the skull.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Falcon_01.description: A crest-like head piece: a curved band sweeps over the brow and up around the sides of the head, with a row of tall, pointed feather blades fanning upward and a small faceted gem at the brow. It suggests a falcon-inspired superhero look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved outer brow band; colour 1 on the tall central blade; colour 2 on the flanking feather blades; colour 3 on the gem at the brow.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Falcon_01.differs: The female crest has smoother, more uniform feather blades that stand more upright, and the side band tips are less sharply hooked.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Falcon_02.description: A crest of angular feather-like blades fanned across the top of the head: a tall central pair, two darker tall blades beside them, and outer curved blades flaring along the hairline. Suggests a bird-of-prey headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Falcon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall central blades; colour 2 on the two inner side blades; colour 1 on the outer curved blades.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Falconer_01.description: A circlet-style helm band that rings the head, dipping to a point over the brow with a gem, and topped by a central segmented crest fin flanked by small spikes. Angular, falcon-like sci-fi headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Falconer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and crest plates; colour 1 on the tall rear crest blade; colour 2 on the small side spikes; colour 3 on the brow gem and side gems.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Feather_Strap_01.description: A simple flat headband circling the forehead with a single long feather tucked in at the back of the band, curving up and forward in a narrow, slender arc with a jagged tip. Tribal, casual head accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Feather_Strap_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the headband; colour 0 on the feather quill and lower vane; colour 1 on the feather tip.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Feather_Strap_01.differs: The female feather is a narrower, more sharply curled arc, while the male feather is a fuller, wider plume.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Fishmonster_01.description: A fin-like crest running from the forehead over the crown and down the back of the head to the nape, made of a thin webbed membrane with long curved spines along the edge, plus a small spine cluster behind the ear.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Fishmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spines; colour 1 on the fin membrane; colour 2 on the base along the crest line.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Fishmonster_01.differs: The crest sits a little shorter and tighter to the head, with slightly smaller spines at the nape.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Full_Dino_01.description: A pair of tall, sharp, four-sided pointed spikes rising from the top of the head, angled slightly outward like horns. Each has a flat faceted base, suggesting a beastly or monstrous headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Full_Dino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole surface of both spikes; the faces shade lighter and darker but no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Fullhelm_Crest_01.description: A tall, swept-back helmet crest like a smooth fin or mohawk blade, running front to back along the top of the head, tapering to a point at the rear with a hollow open back and a stripe down its centre.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Fullhelm_Crest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crest surface; colour 1 on the central stripe; colour 2 on the hollow inner back of the crest.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Fullhelm_Mechassn_.description: A sleek mechanical helmet cap that sits on top of the head, with segmented armored plates, a raised central ridge and a crest that sweeps back to a long point. A faceted chevron plate sits at the brow.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Fullhelm_Mechassn_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 3 on the stripe running along the crest and down the brow; colour 1 on the chevron plate at the brow; colour 2 on the underside and the recessed gaps between the plates.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Fullhelm_Steelcomm.description: A low, close-fitting armored helmet cap covering the top of the head, with a segmented plated crown, a raised brow plate with rivet-like studs, and jagged layered edges at the back and sides. Reads as a military sci-fi headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Fullhelm_Steelcomm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown plate and side guards; colour 1 on the side and back shell panels; colour 2 on the jagged rear layers; colour 3 on the brow band and rear lower panel.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Fullhelm_Viperps_0.description: A shell-like sci-fi helmet cap that sits over the top of the head and forehead, with layered angular plates, a contrasting central ridge with small vent slits, a raised block on top, and a flared rear edge. The face and lower head stay bare.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Fullhelm_Viperps_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell plates; colour 2 on the central ridge and inner plating; colour 1 on the raised top block; colour 3 on the small vent slits.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Gamer_01.description: A gaming headset: a curved band arches over the top of the head, ending in chunky faceted ear cups. One side has a boxy block cup with a curved boom microphone that sweeps down toward the mouth.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband; colour 1 on the ear cups and the mic mount; colour 2 on the boxy cup on the mic side; colour 3 on the microphone boom.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Gladiator_01.description: A Roman-style helmet crest: a tall fan of bristled plume that runs front to back along the top of the head and sweeps into a long tapering tail down the back, held by a narrow metal base strip.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the plume crest; colour 0 on the metal base strip; colour 2 on the shaded inner strip of the plume.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Guardian_01.description: A pair of slim, antler-like horns rising in a V from the top of the head, each a tapered shaft with a short forked prong, a ring band and a few thin stripes near the base.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts and prongs; colour 1 on the ring bands; colour 2 on the thin stripes around each shaft.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Head_Mirror_Down_0.description: A slim rigid headband circling the forehead, with a small hinged bracket at the front that holds a round reflective head mirror flipped down over one eye. Doctor-like, mechanical look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Head_Mirror_Down_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband, bracket and half of the mirror face; colour 1 on the inner band lining and the other part of the mirror face; colour 2 on the mirror rim and back; colour 3 on small marks at the mirror edge.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Head_Mirror_Up_01.description: A doctor-style head mirror: a wide, flat band circles the head at forehead level, with a small round reflective disc on a short hinge at the front, tilted up and away from the face.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Head_Mirror_Up_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband outer surface and the disc front; colour 1 on the inner lining of the band and one half of the disc; colour 2 on the disc back and rim; colour 3 on small marks on the disc edge.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Heraldry_01.description: A row of three pointed, faceted spikes rising from short collar-like bases along the centre of the head from front to back, like a mohawk crest. Sits on top of the skull.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the spike blades; colour 3 on the short bases.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Heraldry_02.description: A swept-back mohawk-style crest of long, layered locks with small spiky tips, running from the forehead over the crown and trailing in a curled tail past the nape, tied with a small band at the crown.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Heraldry_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair locks; colour 1 on the small band at the crown.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Cursed_01.description: A pair of large antler-like horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping up and back in long curves before branching into many tapering tines. The surface is rough and bony, with a fantasy, monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Cursed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower shafts and bases of the horns; colour 1 on the outer branching tines, blending gradually from the base.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Dragon_Silly.description: A pair of short, stubby antler-like horns rising from the top of the head, each with a small forked side prong and a blunt rounded tip. They give a cartoonish, silly dragon or deer look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Dragon_Silly.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole horns; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Hybrid_01.description: A pair of angular, faceted horns that sweep out from the sides of the head and curve upward to sharp points, with banded, segmented ridges along their length. Monstrous or demonic fantasy headwear.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and the bands; colour 3 on the ridged bands along each horn. Colour 1 and colour 2 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Legendary_01.description: A pair of large segmented horns that sweep out sideways from a small brow piece, then curve upward into sharp tips, with smaller spikes beside the forehead. Plated, ridged sections give a monstrous, beastly look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Legendary_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented horn plates; colour 2 on the seams between segments; colour 1 on the horn tips and the small brow spikes.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Legendary_02.description: A pair of long, tall curved horns rising from the top of the forehead, swept upward and outward then tipped inward, with a ridged, grooved surface. Suits demons, beasts and monstrous characters.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Legendary_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and lower length of the horns; colour 1 blends in toward the tips of the horns.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Legendary_03.description: A pair of long, ridged horns that sprout from the brow on either side of the head, sweep outward and back, and curve upward into sharp tips. The grain is ribbed and the look is beastly and fantasy.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Legendary_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies and ridges; colour 1 on the tips, blending in as a gradient toward the ends.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Skeletal_01.description: A pair of large ridged ram-style horns that sweep back from the top of the head, curl down past the ears and flick outward at the tips. Ribbed, bone-like surface suggests a beastly or demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Skeletal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper ridged bases of the horns; colour 1 on the lower curled tips, blending gradually from the base.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Skeletal_02.description: A pair of large ram-style horns with ridged, ribbed surfaces that sweep up and back from the sides of the head, curl down around the ears and flare outward into smooth pointed tips.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Skeletal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged main length of each horn; colour 1 on the smooth curled tips, blending in from the ridged section.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Skeletal_03.description: A pair of large ram-style horns rising from the top of the head and curling in wide spirals down past the ears, with deep ridged ribbing along each horn and pointed tips. Suits beast, demon or monster looks.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Skeletal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base and outer ridges of the horns; colour 1 on the lower curled sections and tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Skeletal_04.description: A pair of long ridged ram-style horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping up and outward in a curve with tips that hook forward and down. Reads as a beastly or demonic accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Skeletal_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main length of both horns; colour 1 on the tips, fading in gradually from the base colour.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Wendigo_01.description: A pair of tall, branching stag antlers rising from the top of the head, each with several tapering tines sweeping up and outward. Wide, natural silhouette suggesting a wendigo or forest beast.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Wendigo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole antler surface; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Wooden_01.description: A pair of curved bull-like horns that sweep outward from the sides of the forehead and then up to sharp points, with thin ridged bands across each horn. Suggests a beastly or demonic fantasy look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Horns_Wooden_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and lower body of each horn; colour 1 on the upper tips; colour 2 on the thin band near the middle; colour 3 on the band beside it.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Jaggedhorns_01.description: A pair of large ram-style horns that sprout from the sides of the head, curl down and forward in segmented ridged spirals, and end in sharp curved tips, with a short upward spike at each base. Monstrous, demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Jaggedhorns_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged horn bodies; colour 2 on the grooves between the ridges; colour 1 on the horn bases; colour 3 on the upward spikes and the curled tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Kabuto_01.description: A small ornamental crest perched on top of the head: a squared pedestal base with engraved key-pattern panels, a slim neck, and an upright interlaced knotwork plate with curled horn-like tips. Suggests a samurai helmet ornament.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Kabuto_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pedestal rim and neck; colour 3 on the pedestal panels; colour 2 on the engraved pattern lines; colour 1 on the knotwork crest.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Knighthelmet_Fin_0.description: A narrow, curved mohawk-style fin that runs front to back along the centre of the head, with a swept-up crest, a layered edge band and rows of small rivets down both sides.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Knighthelmet_Fin_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fin body; colour 1 on the edge band along the lower side; colour 3 on the rivets.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Lemurian_Fin_01.description: A single tall fin crest running front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk, with a thin membrane stretched between curved spiny ribs that sweep outward and back. Suggests an aquatic, monstrous creature look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Lemurian_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved ribs and edge spines; colour 0 on the membrane; colour 3 on the spots across the membrane; colour 2 on the shaded base of the membrane.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Lemurian_Fin_02.description: A pair of fin-like head ornaments, one on each side of the head above the ears, each a webbed membrane stretched between long curved spines that sweep upward and back. Suggests an aquatic, monstrous creature look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Lemurian_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spines and fin edges; colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 3 on the spotted markings; colour 2 on the darker inner membrane areas.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Lemurian_Fin_03.description: A crest of three finned ridges running front to back along the top of the head, each made of curved spiny rays joined by a thin spotted membrane, with a tall central spike. Suggests a sea-creature or monster headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Lemurian_Fin_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiny rays and central spike; colour 0 on the membrane between the rays; colour 3 on the spots across the membrane; colour 2 on the shaded roots of the fins.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Lizard_01.description: A mohawk-style crest of curved, tapering horn-like spikes running in a single row from the forehead over the crown to the nape, fanning backward and upward; the spikes are many and closely spaced. Suggests a lizard or punk look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bulk of each spike; colour 1 on the tips of the spikes as a fade.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Lizard_01.differs: The female crest has more spikes, packed more closely and running further down toward the nape, with shorter individual spikes.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Lockbox_65_01.description: A decorative hair accessory: an ornate metal crown-like clasp on top of the head with two contrasting gem-tipped prongs, holding two very long tresses that arc up and outward, then hang down past the hips.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal clasp; colour 1 on the gem-like prongs; colour 3 on the small central jewel; colour 2 on the long hair tresses.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Lockbox_66_02.description: A full-face tribal helmet styled as a grinning mask with a fan of tall feathered spikes crowning the brow. It has an angular framed headdress, a gem at the forehead and a rounded skull cap at the back.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headdress frame and back of the helmet; colour 1 on the mask face and feather bases; colour 2 on the brow panel; colour 3 on the forehead gem, feather tips and small trim inserts.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Lockbox_67_01.description: A pair of ridged ram-like horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping up and back in a curve before flaring outward at the tips. Ribbed surface with thin outlined edges suggests a beastly or demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged horn surfaces; colour 2 on the horn edges and grooves between ridges.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Mechanon_Horn.description: A pair of mechanical horns that curve up and inward from small ear-level housings, with segmented banded sections and pointed tips, plus small flared spikes at the base. Worn on the sides of the head like a robotic helm.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Mechanon_Horn.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main horn shells; colour 2 on the banded segments; colour 0 on the horn tips and lower spikes; colour 3 on the inner ear housing accents.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Mechanon_Horn.differs: The female horns curve up and inward but are spread a little wider and sit slightly further out from the head, with the tips leaning apart rather than nearly touching.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Mechanon_Horn_02.description: A pair of mechanical horn-like head attachments, one over each temple: swept-back angular fins ending in thin pointed tips, mounted on small blocky connector plates with striped detailing. Suggests robotic minion headgear.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Mechanon_Horn_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fin panels; colour 2 on the inner edge panels; colour 0 on the horn tips, outer edging and connector stripes; colour 3 on the connector accents.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Mechanon_Horn_02_T.description: A pair of curved, blade-like horns mounted on small striped clips at the temples, each sweeping outward and upward from a layered angular housing to a pointed tip; a mechanical, monstrous head accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Mechanon_Horn_02_T.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main horn body; colour 2 on the inner edge panels; colour 0 on the horn tips and underside fins; colour 3 and colour 0 on the striped clips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Mechanon_Horn_Side.description: A pair of mechanical horns mounted on small ear-level plates, one each side of the head, sweeping outward and up in angular segmented curves that end in tapering points; the lower edge has a small pointed flare.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Mechanon_Horn_Side.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main horn bodies; colour 2 on the banded middle segments; colour 0 on the horn tips and lower spikes; colour 3 on the ear mounts, with light metallic inserts.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Modern_Destroyer_0.description: A low circlet band with a scalloped, notched upper edge, ringed by tall curved thorn-like spikes of varying height that sweep upward. It sits around the crown of the head, giving a menacing, crown-like villain look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Modern_Destroyer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the circlet band; colour 1 on the curved spikes; colour 2 on the band's underside edge.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Modern_Witchcraft_.description: A slim double-band circlet worn around the forehead, with a central spiked medallion holding a round gem flanked by two small spheres, and small round studs at the back sides. Mystic, fantasy style.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Modern_Witchcraft_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the double bands and side spheres; colour 1 on the spikes and medallion frame; colour 3 on the central gem; colour 1 on the small back medallion.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Modern_Witchcraft_.differs: The back of the female circlet has a small rounded medallion with no spikes, and the band dips below it.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Moth_01.description: A pair of long, slender moth-like antennae that rise from the top of the head and sweep outward in curved arcs, tapering to fine points with feathery, fringed edges and a contrasting outline.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper feathered lengths of the antennae; colour 1 on the base ends where they blend in; colour 2 on the thin outer edges.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Moth_02.description: A pair of long, slender moth antennae that rise from small bases at the top of the forehead and sweep upward and outward in a V. Each is a tapering feathered blade with a fine central spine.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Moth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer feathered surface of each antenna; colour 1 on the inner vane edges; colour 2 on the central spine; colour 3 on the small bases at the head.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Odragon_01.description: A pair of long, swept-back dragon horns rising from the top of the head, each curving up and outward to a sharp tip with a small secondary spike near the point. Suggests an eastern dragon or monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and lower shafts of the horns; colour 1 on the upper tips as a gradient.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Party_01.description: A thin party headband with two open, pointed ear-like frames at the front of the head, each topped by a long thin stalk ending in a faceted star, like bobbing antennae. Rests over the top of the head.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Party_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband and ear frames; colour 3 on the thin stalks; colour 2 on one star; colour 1 on the other star.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A fan of long, pointed feathers rising from a central point on top of the head and sweeping back in a mohawk-like crest, with visible central quills and tapering tips. A flamboyant pirate-style headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer feather vanes; colour 0 on the inner feather bases; colour 3 on the central quills; colour 2 on the feather tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Plunger_01.description: A novelty plunger stuck to the top of the head: a rounded rubber cup sits on the crown with a long straight handle sticking up and slightly back. A comedic, cartoonish head accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Plunger_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rubber cup; colour 0 on the handle.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Present_Ribbon_01.description: A gift-wrap style bow: a rounded cluster of pointed, looped ribbon petals in layered rings, perched on the upper side of the head like a festive hair ornament.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Present_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the ribbon loops; colour 0 on some petals; colour 2 on the shaded inner loops; colour 3 on a small inner patch.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Present_Ribbon_02.description: A small decorative hair bow with two looped ribbon wings, two trailing tails and a round central knot, perched on top of the head toward one side. Cute, playful and festive.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Present_Ribbon_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main ribbon loops; colour 0 on the light patches of the ribbon; colour 2 on the darker panels and tails; colour 3 on the small accent in the knot.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Present_Ribbon_03.description: A small gift-style bow of stiff ribbon loops fanning out from a central knot, perched on top of the head. Loops of varied size radiate outward, giving a cute festive hair accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Present_Ribbon_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer faces of the ribbon loops; colour 0 on the inner faces and some loop edges; colour 3 on the edging of some loops; colour 2 on the shaded inner loops.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A spiky crown-like head piece of layered angular plates sitting on the forehead and crown, with a tall central horn, smaller flared side spikes and a pointed brow plate that dips between the eyes. Fantasy dragon-armour style.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the plates and the central horn; the material appears mostly and glossy, with little sign of other colour slots.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Puppy_Ear_01.description: A pair of small, pointed puppy ears that stick out sideways from the upper sides of the head. Each is a flat, angular wedge that tapers to a tip, giving a cute animal look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Puppy_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of each ear surface; colour 0 on the highlighted upper edges and tips; colour 2 on the shaded undersides.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Qularr_Antenna_01.description: A pair of slender insect antennae rising from small hexagonal sockets at the brow, each a segmented tapering stalk that curves outward and back and ends in a tiny tip. Suits alien or monstrous looks.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Qularr_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hexagonal sockets; colour 1 on the thick lower stalk segments; colour 2 on the thin outer stalks; colour 3 on the tiny tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Qularr_Antenna_02.description: A pair of long, slender insect antennae that sprout from small socket bases at the brow and sweep up and outward in gentle curves, tapering to fine tips. Segmented shafts give a monstrous, alien look.
