Female/F_Helmetattach_Qularr_Antenna_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the socket bases and the base of each shaft; colour 1 on the middle shafts; colour 2 on the outer shafts; colour 3 on the tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Qularr_Antenna_Hum.description: A pair of slender insect-like antennae rising from the forehead and sweeping forward and outward. Each has a faceted socket base, a thicker segmented stalk and a thin tapering whip ending in a tiny bead tip.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Qularr_Antenna_Hum.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted socket bases; colour 1 on the thick stalk sections; colour 2 on the thin whip sections; colour 3 on the small tip beads.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Qularr_Antenna_Hum.description: A pair of long, thin insect-like antennae rising from the top-front of the head and sweeping backward, each with a small base cup, a thicker segmented shaft tapering to a fine tip with a small bulb end.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Qularr_Antenna_Hum.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base cups; colour 1 on the thicker lower shafts; colour 2 on the thin upper stalks; colour 3 on the tip bulbs.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Raptorspikes_01.description: A set of small conical horn spikes scattered over the scalp in a central crest, with larger spikes at the temples and back of the head and a few tiny ones trailing behind; a beastly, punk-like head accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Raptorspikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bases; colour 1 on the spike tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A fan of large, angular feathers rising from a row of short quills along the centreline of the head, from crown to back, like a crest or mohawk. Suggests a tribal or raven-like fantasy headdress.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quill shafts; colour 1 on the feather vanes; colour 2 in the shading and edges of the feathers.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Salamander_01.description: A pair of swept-back fin-like antennae rising from the top of the head, each a ribbed membrane framed by a slim curved edge with a smaller lower fin beneath. Suggests a sea creature or monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Salamander_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed upper membranes; colour 3 on the outer edge ribs and framing; colour 1 on the lower fins.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Scarab_01.description: A tall head crest rising from the top of the skull: a smooth curved stalk that forks into two sweeping, pointed horns. It has a small segmented base plate on the crown. Suggests a beetle-like, monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalk and fork; colour 2 on the two horn tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Scarab_02.description: A pair of segmented curved horns rising from the sides of the top of the head, sweeping outward then up into sharp tapering tips. Chunky faceted banded sections give a monstrous, insect-like look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base sections of each horn; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 2 on the narrow band below the tip; colour 3 on the pointed tips and the base end caps.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Seacreature_01.description: Two symmetrical clusters of curved, blade-like fins or claws sprouting upward and outward from the top of the head, each with a long main blade and smaller side blades; a sea-creature or monstrous crest.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad inner faces of the blades; colour 1 on the blade edges and rims; colour 3 on the chevron markings; colour 2 on the tips and the backs of the blades.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Seahorse_01.description: A pair of fin-like, leaf-shaped crests that sweep up and outward from two anchor points on top of the head, each with layered, pointed fronds and spotted markings, giving a fey, aquatic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Seahorse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fronds; colour 2 on the spots; colour 1 on the bases where the fronds join; colour 3 on the small gem-like dot at each base.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Seahorse_01.differs: The female version's fronds sit slightly narrower and more upright, with the inner set angled more steeply.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Seahorse_02.description: A narrow crest of sharp, swept-back spikes running in a single line from the forehead over the crown and down the back of the head, like a mohawk or seahorse dorsal fin.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Seahorse_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the crest and the ridge along the scalp; colour 1 on the tips of the spikes.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Serpent_Spikes_01.description: A row of five curved, tapering horn-like spikes set in a line along the centre of the scalp like a mohawk, sweeping backward and upward and shrinking in size toward the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Serpent_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the middle of each spike; colour 1 on the pointed tips; colour 2 on the spike bases.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Spartanplume1_01.description: A Spartan-style crest: a narrow curved base strip with layered trim lines arcs over the top of the head from front to back, carrying a bushy, bristled plume that sweeps forward over the brow.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Spartanplume1_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved base strip; colour 1 on the inner trim band; colour 2 on the thin edge line between the bands; colour 3 on the bristled plume.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Spartanplume2_01.description: A Spartan-style helmet crest worn sideways: a wide fan of feathery bristles arcing over the head from ear to ear, mounted on a curved band with an inner rim, standing upright above the crown.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Spartanplume2_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bristled plume; colour 1 on the curved mounting band; colour 0 on the inner rim under the band.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Spiked_01.description: A narrow studded band arching over the top of the head from forehead to nape, with a pointed tip at the brow and a large cone spike on each side. Punk, mohawk-like accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 2 on the small studs; colour 3 on the cone spikes and the rear boss.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Spiked_01.differs: The front end tapers to a longer pointed tip, and the rear end is also pointed, while the male version ends squarely at the back.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Spy_01.description: A small rose ornament worn on the side of the head above the ear: layered outer petals surround a tightly spiralled bloom centre, with a rounded cup-shaped back. Suggests an elegant, decorative hair flower.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer petals; colour 1 on the spiral petals at the centre of the bloom.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Star_01.description: A small eight-pointed faceted star ornament on a short tapered socket, rising from the crown of the head like an antenna. The top point is longer, and the flat, thin star has glossy, angular facets.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the base socket; the star's facets take a mix of colour 0, colour 1 and colour 3 in alternating points, with a glossy metallic finish.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Swing_01.description: A small circlet worn across the top of the head: a flat metal band carrying a crown-like cluster of three spiked contrasting finials topped with round knobs, and three toothed cog wheels with central studs at the front.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 2 on the spiked finials and knobs; colour 1 on the cog wheels; colour 3 on the cog centres.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Ancient_01.description: A thin, blade-like crest that runs front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk fin. It sweeps up to a point at the front, with a carved glyph on each face and streaky, weathered texturing.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Ancient_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crest surface; colour 1 on the carved glyph and edge lining; the streaky texture comes from the material and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears rising from the top of the head, each broad at the base and tapering to a sharp tip, with a hollow inner cup and a softly textured surface.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ears, inside and out; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blade_01.description: A thin, blade-like head crest running front to back along the centre of the skull, rising to a swept-back fin with a sharp forward-pointing tip. Flat and angular, like a mohawk fin.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crest blade; the edge shows a metallic sheen and no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blade_02.description: A single thin blade-like crest running front to back along the centre of the head, like a mohawk. It rises from a narrow front edge to a tall swept-back fin with a pointed tip, in a monstrous, punk look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade crest; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blade_03.description: A thin, flat blade-like crest running front to back along the centre of the head. It rises from the forehead and sweeps up and back in a sharp angled edge, like a mohawk fin.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blade_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; the edge shows a glossy metallic sheen that ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blade_04.description: A thin, flat blade-like crest shaped as a half-disc arc, standing upright along the centre line of the top of the head from front to back like a mohawk fin. Suggests a sleek helmet or creature crest.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blade_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved leading edge of the blade; colour 1 on the flat faces of the blade.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blockbuster_.description: A V-shaped angular headpiece worn across the forehead: two flat blade-like wings sweep up and outward from a pointed centre at the brow, with slotted vents on the front. Sleek, sci-fi horned look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Blockbuster_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper blade surfaces and back plates; colour 1 on the lower edge band and centre point; colour 2 on the slot vents.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Crest_01.description: A sleek, swept-back fin-like crest that runs front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk, tapering to a point behind, with a raised stripe down its spine and a hollow open back.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Crest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the crest; colour 1 on the central stripe along the ridge; colour 2 on the hollow interior at the back.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Crestfluted_.description: A flat, U-shaped crest with fluted grooves and two outward-flared, pointed tips, mounted upright on a small wedge base at the top-front of the head. It suggests a horned, mechanical or monstrous headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Crestfluted_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole crest and its base; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Deity_01.description: A slim antler-like headpiece: a V-shaped band that dips to a point at the forehead and sweeps up into two curved, forked prongs on either side. It sits on the brow like a crown, with a fantasy, horned-deity feel.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower V of the band at the brow; colour 1 on the upper curved prongs, fading toward the tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Destroyerbot.description: A slim angular circlet worn across the forehead, with a central faceted gem-like crest and two long tapering blade horns sweeping up and outward from the temples. Suggests a fantasy or mechanical demon look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Destroyerbot.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the circlet band and horns; colour 1 on the central crest and the small crest fins.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Djmadbot_01.description: A small, plain cylindrical block that sits upright on top of the head like a short crest or fez, with flat top and smooth straight sides. It leaves the face and the rest of the head uncovered.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Egyptian_Pha.description: A small rearing cobra ornament sitting on top of the head like a crest, with a flared hood, studded rim, ribbed underbelly and a coiled tail curling down the back of the head. Egyptian pharaoh style.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Egyptian_Pha.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood shell and tail; colour 1 on the snake head, the inside of the hood and the centre seam; colour 2 on the ribbed belly; colour 3 on the back markings and eyes.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Firebird_02_.description: A fan-shaped crest of long, tapering plumes radiating from a point at the front of the crown and sweeping up and back, each ending in a blocky angular tip. Sits on top of the head like a headdress.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Firebird_02_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plume bases near the forehead; colour 1 on the middle of the plumes; colour 2 on the transition bands between sections; colour 3 on the outer plume tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Firebird_03.description: A pair of long, swept-back horn-like flames rising from the top of the head, each ringed at the base by clusters of shorter curved spikes. The horns taper to sharp points and give a demonic, fiery look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Firebird_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the base of the horns and spikes; colour 2 on the mid-section of the horns; colour 1 on the horn tips and spike tips; colour 0 on the small spike points.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Fullhelm_Fin.description: A thick, smooth mohawk-style crest that runs front to back along the centre of the head, tapering to a point at the forehead and widening toward the nape. It has a flat top and a thin hollow underside.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Fullhelm_Fin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crest; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Fullhelm_Sco.description: A mohawk-style crest that arches from the forehead over the top of the head to the nape, flaring wider at the back. A recessed slatted vent grille sits at the front, giving a mechanical helmet-fin look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Fullhelm_Sco.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crest shell; colour 1 on the vent grille frame and slats; colour 2 on the grille interior.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A single oval faceted gemstone set on the middle of the forehead, with a flat table facet in the centre and angular cut facets around the edge; it sits flush and slightly domed against the skin.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The gem appears glossy and mostly ignores the scheme; a faint tint from colour 1 shows on some edge facets.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted diamond-shaped gem mounted flat on the middle of the forehead, with a raised beveled centre and pointed top and bottom. A small jewel-like brow ornament with a fantasy or sci-fi feel.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The gem appears glossy and dark; it seems to ignore the colour scheme, with no visible use of colour slots 0, 1 or 3.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small square faceted gemstone with bevelled edges and a flat back, mounted on the middle of the forehead like a brow jewel. Glossy and angular, it suggests fantasy or sci-fi headgear.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; faint hints of colour 1 show in the facets, with no other slots visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone with bevelled edges, set flat on the centre of the forehead like a third-eye jewel. It has a glossy, polished surface with a slightly recessed centre facet.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 2 shows on the bevelled facets, with a faint hint of colour 1 along one upper edge.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn flat on the centre of the forehead, with a cut-crystal front face and a shallow, slightly domed back. A small decorative brow jewel with a fantasy or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The gem is glossy and mostly ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint from colour 1 shows along the upper facets.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_05.differs: The central front facet is glossy and contrasting like the rest of the gem, with no separate light panel.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A single teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone set flat on the centre of the forehead, pointing upward, with a smaller inner facet and a flat back. Suggests a third-eye or mystic brow jewel.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint glint of colour 1 shows on the outer facets, and the inner facet stays glassy.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_06.differs: The female gem's inner facet is a contrasting glassy surface, whereas the male version has a lighter, brushed inner facet.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Harajuku_Hai.description: A large fabric hair bow with two wide, flared wings pinched by a central knot, perched on top of the head near the front hairline. Cute, playful Harajuku-style accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Harajuku_Hai.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bow wings and knot; the inner folds show shading only.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Harajuku_Hai.description: A small cloth hair bow with two layered, hollow loops on each side and a narrow central knot band, perched on the upper side of the head. Cute Harajuku-style accent.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Harajuku_Hai.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bow loops and central knot; the inner loop hollows look shaded but take the same slot.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Blackf.description: A pair of tall curved horns rising from short banded bases at the temples, sweeping outward then upward to sharp tips, with segmented bands along their length. Sits on the forehead as a monstrous headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Blackf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts and tips; colour 1 on the cylindrical bands at the horn bases; colour 2 on the darker segments and joints along the horns.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Bonema.description: A pair of tall, sweeping bone-like horns rising from small angular base plates on the forehead, curving up and inward to fine tips, with ridged surfaces and a small spur on each horn.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Bonema.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies and ridges; colour 1 fading in toward the horn tips; the small base plates take a neutral grey.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Creepy.description: A pair of tall curved horns rising from the top of the head, tapering to sharp glossy tips, with segmented ridged shafts wrapped in thin contrasting bands. Monstrous, demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Creepy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower horn shafts; colour 1 on the upper shaft blending toward the tips; colour 3 on the thin bands around the shafts; colour 2 on the horn tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Crow_0.description: A pair of long ridged horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping outward and up in a curve that tapers to sharp tips. Segmented ribbing runs along each horn, giving a monstrous, demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Crow_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of each horn; colour 3 on the tapering tips, blending smoothly from the base.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Cyberc.description: A pair of mechanical cat-ear horns: short cylindrical metal tubes with segmented barrels that rise from the top of the head in a V, each with a ringed base collar and a small capped tip.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Cyberc.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the base collars and the tip caps; colour 1 on the upper barrel sections; colour 0 on the lower barrel sections; colour 2 on the band details.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Demon_.description: A pair of curved demon horns that sprout from the forehead near the hairline, each a segmented, ridged horn that sweeps outward then up to a sharp point, seated in a small angular base collar.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Demon_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn segments; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the base collars at the forehead.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Dragon.description: A pair of tall, segmented dragon horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping outward and back in a gentle curve to sharp tips. Ridged banding runs along each horn, giving a monstrous fantasy look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Dragon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged horn bases and shafts; colour 1 fades in toward the tips of both horns.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Facele.description: A pair of long, smooth curved horns rising from the top of the forehead and sweeping up and slightly inward to sharp points, with thin ringed bands of contrasting lines spiralling along each horn.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Facele.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn surfaces; colour 1, colour 2 and colour 3 on the thin banded lines wrapping each horn.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Gazell.description: A pair of long, smooth gazelle-like horns that rise from small collars on top of the head, curve backward and taper to sharp points. They sit on the crown and suggest a beast or monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Gazell.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the tapering horn tips; colour 3 on the base collars.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_0.description: A pair of curved goat horns rising from the top of the head and sweeping backward in segmented ridged arcs to pointed tips, each seated in a short contrasting base collar. Suggests a beastly or demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips, fading in from the shaft; colour 3 on the base collars.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_0.description: A pair of large ridged goat horns rising from the top of the forehead, sweeping up and back in a long curve to pointed tips. Each sits in a small angular base collar. Suggests a beastly or demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips, shading toward the ends; colour 3 on the base collars.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_0.description: A pair of long, slender goat horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping up and back in a wavy curve with ridged texture and tips that flick outward. Animalistic, monstrous fantasy look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the base of each horn; colour 0 on the ridged horn shafts; colour 1 on the outer tips, fading in gradually from the shaft.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_0.description: A pair of tall spiralling goat horns rising from the top of the head, twisting in a corkscrew and curving outward, then flicking back to sharp tips. Ridged, segmented surface suggests a beastly, monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the horn bases; colour 0 on the middle of each horn; colour 1 on the upper spiral and tips. Colour 3 is not visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Hook_0.description: A pair of tall curling horns rising from the sides of the head, each a segmented hooked stalk with banded joints and several sharp tines branching outward and upward, giving a monstrous antler-like crown.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Hook_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and long stalk segments; colour 1 on the banded joints and collars; colour 3 on the upper forward-pointing tines; colour 2 on the lower tines and hook tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Quad_0.description: Four curved, tapering horns sprouting from the top and front of the head: a large pair sweeping up and back, and a smaller pair curling forward near the brow, each rooted in a chunky segmented collar.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Quad_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts, fading toward colour 1 at the tips; colour 3 on the base collars.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Reinde.description: A pair of large branching reindeer antlers that curve outward and upward from the sides of the head, with many tines and forward-curling brow prongs near the temples. Worn as a head accessory with a fantasy, beastly feel.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Reinde.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main antler surface; colour 1 gives a faint tint toward the shaded tines. Colours 2 and 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Reinde.description: A pair of large branching reindeer antlers that curl out from the sides of the head, sweep back and up, and split into many tines. They rise well above the head, suggesting a fantasy creature or woodland spirit.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Reinde.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main antler branches and tines; colour 1 as a faint tint in the shaded curves; the tips are darkened by shading.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Six_01.description: A set of six curved, tapering horns, three on each side of the crown, sweeping up and back to sharp points. Each horn rises from a small collar-like base sitting on the top of the head, giving a demonic, monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Six_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips as a fade; colour 3 on the base sockets at the roots.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Spiked.description: A pair of curling monstrous horns that sweep down from the top of the head and back up past the ears. Each has a spotted, spiky furred base, a segmented banded middle and a sharp hooked tip.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Spiked.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spotted furred base of the horns; colour 2 on the spots and small spikes; colour 1 on the banded segments; colour 3 on the hooked tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Unicor.description: A single tapering unicorn horn rising from the centre of the forehead and sweeping forward and upward in a gentle curve to a sharp point, with a faceted base sitting on the brow.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Unicor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and lower shaft of the horn; colour 1 blends through the middle of the shaft; colour 2 on the tip.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Zorran.description: A pair of ridged ram-style horns that sprout from the sides of the head just above the ears and curl backward and down in a tight spiral. Beastly, monstrous look, worn as a partial head accessory.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Zorran.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ridged surface of the horns; colour 1 on the inner curl and tips of the horns.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Zorran.differs: The female horns have a contrasting outer surface with contrasting only on the inner curls, while the male horns default to a mostly contrasting outer surface.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.description: A set of swept-back curved horns with ridged surfaces, two large pairs on the crown plus small side horns by the ears, joined by a thin band and a serrated fin-like crest running front to back over the head.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and the serrated crest; colour 3 on the horn tips and the thin band across the head; colour 1 and colour 2 not visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.description: A monstrous head crest of tall curved, ridged horns rising from the crown, with shorter spikes along the forehead line and swept-back fin-like blades at each side of the head. Sits on the scalp like a spiked tiara.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns, spikes and side blades; colour 3 on the tips of the forehead spikes and the thin band along the scalp edge.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.description: A head-mounted set of two curved, ridged horns sweeping up and forward from the crown, joined by a thin band running front to back, with a row of jagged fin-like spikes forming a mohawk crest down the centre.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and the crest spikes; colour 3 on the horn tips and the thin band along the head.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.description: A monstrous head accessory: a thin band over the crown carrying several curled, ridged horns of varying size, two small horns at the sides, and a jagged fin-like crest running front to back along the centre.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts and crest; colour 3 on the horn tips and the thin band.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.description: A thin mohawk-style ridge of jagged, angular spikes running front to back along the centre of the head, mounted on a narrow skin-toned band that hugs the scalp. Monstrous, punk-like crest.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Hornsmonster.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jagged spikes; the thin base band along the scalp takes a skin-like tone that ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Lightning_01.description: A thin, flat lightning-bolt crest that stands upright on the top of the head, running front to back. It has a zigzag profile and a slim edge when seen head-on, a simple sci-fi or superhero head accent.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bolt; the edges catch light but no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Middlespikes.description: Three separate conical spikes set in a line along the centre of the head, front to back, like a mohawk of horns. They curve slightly backward and rise at differing angles, giving a punk or monstrous look.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Patriot_Wing.description: A pair of feathered head wings mounted at the temples on short cylindrical stubs, sweeping up and back in tall curved arcs with a smooth rounded spine and layered pointed feathers ending in a sharp tip.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Patriot_Wing.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved spine of each wing; colour 3 on the mounting stubs; colour 0 and colour 2 on the layered feathers.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Rhino_Large_.description: A single large curved rhino-style horn rising from the centre of the forehead at the hairline, with a segmented ridged surface, a tapering point that sweeps forward and up, and a chunky faceted base collar.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Rhino_Large_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower horn shaft; colour 1 on the upper horn and tip; colour 3 on the base collar.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Rhino_Small_.description: A single small rhino-style horn mounted at the centre of the forehead near the hairline, with a ridged, segmented surface that curves back and up to a point, set on an angular faceted base plate.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Rhino_Small_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the faceted base plate; colour 0 on the lower horn ridges; colour 1 on the upper tip of the horn, blending from colour 0.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Ribbons_01.description: A single long, narrow ribbon that starts at the top of the head, arches over the crown and hangs straight down the back to a tapered point around thigh level, with a subtly frayed, streaked look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Ribbons_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the band where the ribbon starts over the crown; colour 0 on the main length of the ribbon; colour 1 on the thin edge along the tail.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Ripper_Hoses.description: A crown of thick segmented hoses arching over the top of the scalp from forehead to back of head, each ending in a ribbed connector plug that presses into the skull. Suggests cybernetic implants or a monstrous neural interface.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Ripper_Hoses.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hose bodies; colour 3 on the thin edge lines running along the hoses; colour 1 on the ring bands at the joints; colour 0 on the plug-shaped connector tips.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Rocketcrest_.description: A slim head crest: a thin blade-like fin runs from the brow over the crown and sweeps back and upward past the skull, joined to a narrow angular brow band with pointed edges and a thin rim around the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Rocketcrest_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band and the outer edges of the crest; colour 1 on the central stripe along the crest; colour 2 on the trim edges, the rear of the crest and the rim around the back of the head.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Samurai_Top_.description: A head crest: a tall, thin fin-like plate with a notched, swept-back top rising along the centre of the skull, plus a small octagonal jewel set in a frame on the forehead flanked by two contrasting studs.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Samurai_Top_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest's outer rim; colour 1 on the inner edging and the jewel frame; colour 2 on the crest's swirl-patterned face and the round studs; colour 3 on the swirl pattern and the central jewel.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_01_.description: A thin, swept-back fin that runs along the centre of the head from forehead to nape, like a mohawk. It curves up and back to a sharp tip, with a notched, jagged trailing edge.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_01_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the piece uses a skin-like default material, so the other slots are not visible.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_01_.differs: The female fin is a little shorter and sits closer to the head.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_02_.description: A large swept-back shark fin worn as a crest along the top of the head: a thin, curved skin-like membrane rising to a sharp point, with ragged pointed edges along its rear base.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_02_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece, and the default skin material shows a skin tone.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Sidespikes_0.description: A set of short conical metal spikes sprouting from the sides and top of the head: a pair of low blunt studs on the forehead and clusters of longer swept-back horns above and behind the temples.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Sidespikes_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes and studs; the glossy metal-like default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Spike_Crown_.description: A thin curved crown band arching across the top of the forehead, with rows of long cone spikes radiating outward and inward and small studs along the front face. Reads as a punk or monstrous spiked circlet.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Spike_Crown_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown band; colour 1 on the spikes and studs.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Titan_01.description: A pair of tall, sharply curved horns rising from the top of the head and sweeping outward then upward to points. Each is a hollow blade-like shell with a flat inner face, giving a monstrous, demonic look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Titan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the horns; colour 2 on the hollow inner faces; colour 1 gives a slight tint on the back-facing edges.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Wedding_Flow.description: A small formal flower hair accessory worn on the side of the head above the ear: layered angular petals around a contrasting centre, with a short ribbon knot and trailing ribbon tails hanging down behind it.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Tight_Wedding_Flow.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the petals; colour 2 on the flower centre; colour 1 on the ribbon knot and trailing tails.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Trumpknigh_01.description: A tall, spiky plume of jagged feather-like hair tufts gathered by a short cylindrical tie on top of the head, then swept back and down to chin length, layered in ragged points.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Trumpknigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front crest tufts and the tie; colour 1 on the outer top and lower tufts; colour 2 on the inner back layers; colour 3 on a small accent tuft at the lower back.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Valorous_04.description: A pair of tall, pointed angular ear-like fins on a thin band across the top of the head. Each has a framed outer edge with struts and an inset panel facing forward, suggesting a beastly mechanical helmet.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and frames; colour 1 on the connecting band and strut highlights; colour 3 on the inset inner panels.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Valorous_04.differs: The female version has a lighter frame around each ear with a visible raised band between them, while the male ears are shorter-framed and sit closer together with a rounded connector.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Winged_01.description: A slim circlet band worn around the head with a pointed V-shaped dip at the brow. Two tall, swept-back feather-like wings rise from the sides like long ears, with striped bands of layered feathers.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the circlet band; colour 0 on the outer edges and tips of the wings; colour 1 and colour 2 on alternating stripes along the wing feathers.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Winterevent_2025_0.description: A tall cone-shaped cloth hood or veil that rises to a sharp point high above the head, then drapes down the back in a diamond-shaped fall with a scalloped lace edge.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Winterevent_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cone; colour 1 on the lower drape, fading in from the cone; colour 2 on the scalloped lace edging.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Winterevent_2025_0.differs: The female drape hangs slightly narrower and shorter down the back, and the cone rises more upright.

Female/F_Helmetattach_Wooden_01.description: A crest of long, pointed leaf-like blades radiating from a thin band around the crown and back of the head, flaring outward in a spiky, feathered headdress with a tribal, wild look.
Female/F_Helmetattach_Wooden_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade surfaces; colour 1 on alternating blades and the blade faces; colour 3 on the thin veins along the blades; colour 2 on the edge lines and the headband.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Anniversary_Destroy.description: A thin metal circlet band that dips into a V-shaped point at the brow, with tall curved spikes rising from its upper edge. It sits around the crown of the head like a spiked tiara.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Anniversary_Destroy.colourAreas: The material looks glossy metal and mostly ignores the scheme; colour 0 may tint the band edges and spikes slightly.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Anniversary_Mindsla.description: A head covering of long, ribbed tentacle-like flaps hanging from a flat band across the crown, draping over the face, sides and back to shoulder level. Suggests an alien, monstrous psychic headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Anniversary_Mindsla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ribbed strands; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the strands; colour 2 in the shadowed folds between the ribs.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Anubis_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed ear guards made of ridged, fin-like plates that sweep up and outward from the sides of the top of the head, giving a jackal-like, animal-eared silhouette.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Anubis_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ridged plates; the piece appears to use only this one slot, with no visible contrasting parts.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Arcane_01.description: A bell-shaped cloth headdress that drapes over the head and falls to the shoulders with a flared, ruffled hem and two stripe bands. A trim band frames the crown, with a round medallion at the front and small rosette ornaments at the sides.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main draped cloth and hem; colour 0 on the stripe bands; colour 1 on the trim band and the front medallion; colour 3 on the medallion centre and the side rosettes.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Arcane_01.differs: The front drape hangs lower, covering the brow and eyes, while the male version sits higher and leaves the face more open.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Aztecheaddress_01.description: A small sculpted human skull perched on top of the head like a headdress, with hollow eye sockets, a nasal cavity and a jaw, sitting above the forehead rather than covering the face.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Aztecheaddress_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skull; the eye sockets show shading only and no other slot is visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Beanie_01.description: A novelty propeller topper: a slim stacked stem of ringed segments with a pointed tip rises from a small hub, carrying a thin twisted two-blade propeller. It floats just above the crown of the head, with no cap shown.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Beanie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the propeller blades and central hub; colour 1 on the stem segments and pointed tip; colour 3 on one ring of the stem; colour 2 on the short stem section below the tip.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Beanie_02.description: A tiny propeller-beanie spindle: a slim vertical stack of segmented rings and a cylindrical hub topped with a pointed cone, standing upright on the crown of the head. No cap or blades are visible.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Beanie_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cylindrical hub; colour 1 on the pointed tip, upper ring and lower ridged segments; colour 2 on the band under the tip; colour 3 on the ring above the lower segments.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Bike_01.description: A brow-mounted visor shield: a swept, angular peak with a central V-shaped ridge and pointed upward wings, sitting across the forehead. Two short side arms with round bolts wrap toward the temples, leaving the face and back of the head open.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Bike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower edges and the underside of the peak; colour 1 on the outer wing tips and side arms; colour 3 on the central V panel and ridge; colour 2 on the side bolts.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Bonemantis_01.description: A set of curved, claw-like bone spikes arranged in a V around the front of the throat and collarbone, like a mantis-style fang necklace. Six tapering points sit unattached to any garment, in a monstrous, tribal style.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the bone spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Bonemantis_01.differs: This version is a ring of bone claws worn at the throat, whereas the male version is a pair of large insect eyes over the face.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Brainjar_Dome_01.description: A translucent glass dome that sits on top of the head like a raised, faceted crown. It has a rounded top and a straight cut edge around the forehead and sides, leaving the face bare. Suggests a sci-fi brain case.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Brainjar_Dome_01.colourAreas: The dome is translucent glass and largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint at the rim edge is the only visible variation.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Cape_Qlyphotic_01.description: A long hooded cloth cape that drapes from the head over the shoulders and down the back to below the knees, with a ragged, hole-riddled hem and long trailing tattered streamers at the sides.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Cape_Qlyphotic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood and upper cape; colour 1 on the lower cape and tattered hem, blending down from colour 0.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Cartoon_Bunny_01.description: A pair of cartoon bunny ears: two tall oval rims with hollow contrasting centres, each on a short stalk set into a small mechanical socket on top of the head, angled outward in a V.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Cartoon_Bunny_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the oval ear rims; colour 3 on the short stalks; colour 2 on the inner ear hollows; colour 0 not clearly visible; the sockets are and metallic.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Cartoon_Cat_01.description: A pair of oversized cartoon eyeballs, smooth rounded spheres with a large iris and a pupil, floating at either side of the face in front of the eyes. A whimsical, comical, cute look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Cartoon_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball spheres; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Cartoon_Dog01.description: A pair of oversized round cartoon eyeballs that bulge out from the front of the face over the eyes, each with an off-centre iris and pupil. Comical, low-poly and partial, suited to silly dog or monster looks.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Cartoon_Dog01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball spheres; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Pompom_01.description: A pair of pom-pom ornaments hanging at either side of the head: shaggy, tufted round balls dangling from twisted rope-like cords that rise beside the ears. Playful, cute and whimsical, resting near the jaw and neck.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Pompom_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tufted pom-pom balls; colour 0 on the twisted cords.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Teddy_Eyes_01.description: A pair of oversized round eyeball-shaped orbs that sit at either side of the head beside the cheeks, each with a ringed iris and pupil dots facing forward. Cute, cartoonish, monster-like head decoration.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Teddy_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball spheres; colour 1 on the ring around each iris; colour 3 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupils and spots.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Teddy_Eyes_02.description: A pair of oversized four-hole sewing buttons floating at each side of the head, like teddy-bear button eyes or ear ornaments. Each is a flat disc with a raised rim and a recessed centre, with a plain back.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Teddy_Eyes_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rims and the plain backs; colour 1 on the recessed button centres; colour 2 on the four holes.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Wooden_02.description: A pair of curved horns that sprout from the sides of the head, sweeping outward then upward to sharp tapered points, with thin contrasting bands near the tips. A monstrous, fantasy headpiece.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Wooden_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and shafts; colour 1 on the pointed tips; colour 2 on one thin band on each horn; colour 3 on a second thin band on each horn.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Wooden_03.description: A pair of long dangling earrings: a small knob stud at each ear, a twisted rope-like cord hanging down past the jaw, a small clasp block, and a round hoop ring at the bottom.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Child_Wooden_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ear knobs and the hoop rings; colour 0 on the twisted cords and clasp blocks.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Crimson_01.description: A small head-top crest: a tiny angular base plate on the crown holds two short segmented stalks that sweep up into long feathered plumes, which arc outward and droop to each side like antennae.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the small base plate; colour 0 on the short stalks; colour 3 on the long feathered plumes.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Crimson_02.description: A pair of curved, blade-like cheek guards that sweep from beside the eyes down along the jaw to sharp points, each with a raised fin-like ridge on top. The face stays open; the look is monstrous and fantasy.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Crimson_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer curved blades; colour 1 on the raised fin ridges. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Cryo_Bubble_Pointy_.description: A tall, smooth bubble helmet with a domed top and straight sides that cover the whole head and drop to the neck base. It has no visible openings or details, giving a sealed, cryogenic look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Cryo_Bubble_Pointy_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole helmet shell; the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Cryo_Bubble_Pointy_.differs: The female helmet looks opaque and solid, hiding the head, while the male version is see-through glass that shows the head inside.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Dome_Open_01.description: A translucent dome-shaped helmet that encloses the whole head like a bubble, open at the face with a straight cut front edge, and flaring slightly at the back and sides down to the neck and jaw.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Dome_Open_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome shell; the material is glassy and translucent, so the other colour slots are barely visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Draco_01.description: A slim, open circlet-style head piece that sweeps into a V-shaped point over the brow, with two large swept-back horn blades rising from each temple. It sits on top of the head and leaves the face and crown uncovered.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn blades and outer circlet; colour 3 on the inner V-shaped brow band.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Draco_02.description: A partial head piece of angular, dragon-like blades: swept horn-shaped plates rise from each brow and temple, with small faceted fins behind them and a pair of curved claw-like fangs pointing down the cheeks.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow blades and temple fins; colour 3 on the tips of the cheek fangs; colour 2 on the darker faceted plates.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Dragon_Silly_02.description: A pair of small, smooth, forked horns that rise from the top of the head and angle outward, each with a short side prong. They suggest a playful, cartoonish dragon or deer look.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Dragon_Silly_03.description: Two small floating rectangular blocks that hover above the top of the head, angled outward like stubby antennae or horns. There is no cap or helmet, only the two separate pieces.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Dragon_Silly_04.description: A pair of cartoonish googly eyes perched on top of the head like stalks, each a rounded faceted eyeball with a large glossy pupil and highlight. A cute, silly monster look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Dragon_Silly_04.colourAreas: The eyes use their own painted texture and appear to ignore the colour scheme; no visible feature takes colour slots 0-3.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Earrings_Draco_01.description: A pair of angular, blade-like fins that sweep up and back from the sides of the head, covering the ears like winged earguards. Flat faceted plates with a sharp tapering tip suggest a dragon-inspired helm.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Earrings_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin plates; the default metal shows little variation from the other colour slots.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Earrings_Draco_02.description: A pair of curved, horn-like head fins framing the face: each sweeps up from behind the ears into a long pointed horn and down to a pointed tip at the neck, with layered blade-like ridges along the outer edge.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Earrings_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn tips and alternating ridge blades; colour 2 on the alternating ridge bands; colour 1 on the inner base of the ridges.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Hoses_01.description: A thin, translucent glass-like curved shell that arcs over the top and one side of the head like a swept-back crest, standing clear of the skull without covering the face. Sci-fi energy-containment look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glassy shell; the glass-like default material largely ignores the other colour slots.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Hoses_01.differs: The female shell is fuller and wraps further down the side of the head toward the cheek.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Warlord_0.description: A smooth, thin shell shaped like a swept-back dome that sits over the top and back of the head. It leaves the face open and flares into a shallow crest behind the head, giving a sleek helmet-like silhouette.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Warlord_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 across the whole shell; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Warlord_0.differs: The female version is a thin, swept-back shell that leaves the face and crown exposed. The male version is a thick, rounded dome that covers the whole forehead and top of the head.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Feather_01.description: A crest of overlapping leaf-like feathers arranged in a fan-shaped arc from the forehead over the crown to the nape, like a mohawk or headdress, with tips flaring outward and upward.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers; the shading varies across the crest. No other colour slots clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Feather_02.description: A pair of small flat hexagonal feather-like plates that sit on the sides of the face beside the eyes, each with a curved crescent notch cut into it. They read as stylised cheek or temple ornaments.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Feather_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main faces of the plates; colour 0 on the edges and the crescent notch highlights.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Horsemask_01.description: A pair of small domed eyeball shapes floating at the sides of the head, like a horse's eyes, each with a band across the middle and a small vertical marking. Monstrous, cartoonish beast styling.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Horsemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim of each eye; colour 1 on the eyeball domes; colour 2 on the horizontal band across each eye; colour 3 on the small vertical marking.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Horsemask_01.differs: The female version has contrasting eyeballs with a contrasting band and contrasting marking, while the male version is mostly contrasting eyeballs with a small round pupil.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Patriot_Mask_0.description: A small atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring, sitting flat on the side of the head above the temple. It reads as a decal-like badge with a science theme.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Patriot_Mask_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the outline edges and the central nucleus ring.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_01.description: A pair of tall, angular horn-like blades that sweep up from a V-shaped chin and mouth guard, curving up past the cheeks and temples on both sides of the face. Suggests a monstrous, sci-fi helm.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower guard and the lower part of the horns; colour 1 on the upper tips of the horns; the two blend in a gradient.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_02.description: A smooth, close-fitting skull cap with a low-poly faceted surface. It covers the crown and back of the head, and a slanted front section sweeps down into a point over the eyes and upper face like a visor.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the back and upper shell of the cap; colour 0 on the front and top panel; colour 2 on the lower front visor section.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_04.description: A partial angular face piece: a pointed, V-shaped mask panel covers the mouth and chin, with swept-back horn-like fins running along each side of the head to sharp tips behind the ears. Thin glassy lines cross the scalp.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed mask panel; colour 0 on the swept side fins; thin glass-like lines over the scalp ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Falcon_01.description: A partial crest of layered, blade-like feather shapes that sweeps back from a pointed gem at the brow over the top of the head, with a separate cluster of longer feathers at the back. The bare face and hair area stay open.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer brow-sweep feathers and the rear feathers; colour 1 on the central front feather and the side and back feathers; colour 2 on the inner feathers; colour 3 on the gem at the brow.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Falcon_02.description: A pair of swept-back feathered wings mounted at the temples, layered feather blades fanning upward and outward, with short hanging feather tufts that drop beside the cheeks. Suggests a winged fantasy or superhero helm.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Falcon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wing feathers; colour 1 on a lower band of feathers in each wing; colour 2 on the darker feather row beneath; colour 3 on the hanging feather tufts.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Full_Anniversary_De.description: A simple curved half-mask plate that wraps across the lower face from below the eyes to the chin, with a notched top edge and slightly flared sides. It is a plain, sleek retro-superhero face guard.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Full_Anniversary_De.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the plate; the inner surface looks lighter and the scheme is only faintly visible. Other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Full_Bounty_01.description: A minimal flat band-shaped visor that wraps across the eyes and around the sides of the head, with a long downward flap on each side of the face. Simple, angular construction with a sleek, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Full_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole band; the thin top edge shows a lighter tint of the same slot.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Full_Bounty_02.description: A wide, flat visor band that wraps across the eyes and temples, with a slightly angular, notched top edge and a thin contrasting rim. It is a simple opaque strip in a retro sci-fi bounty-hunter style.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Full_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the visor band; colour 1 (lighter) on the thin edge rim.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Full_Techno_01.description: A faceted angular half-mask that wraps across the cheeks, nose and mouth, with a pointed chin guard and small wedge-shaped studs at the temples. Open at the top and rear, it sits over the lower face like a sleek tech visor.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Full_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell of the mask; colour 2 on the small wedge-shaped studs at the temples.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Full_Trooper_04.description: A pair of slim, flat-sided angular blades that stand up and flare slightly outward from either side of the head, like antennae or short horns. Only the two spikes are present, with no helmet shell.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Gladiator_01.description: A pair of open, blade-like cheek and temple guards that sweep up into tall pointed fins beside the head and taper down to points along the jaw, with round ear discs. The face and crown stay uncovered.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges of the blades; colour 1 on the inner panels of the blades; colour 2 on the ear discs.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Gladiator_02.description: A pair of separate winged side pieces that sit over the ears and sweep up and back in tall curved blades, each with layered feather-like fins behind and a pointed cheek guard curving down beside the face.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade edges and cheek guards; colour 1 on the upper feather layer; colour 2 on the middle feather layer; colour 3 on the lower feather layer.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_01.description: A decorative dragon-style face piece: swept, feathery crests curl up and outward around each eye, joined by a thick shaggy whisker band that runs under the nose and around the cheeks and jaw. Suggests a fantasy beast mask.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eye crests and feathery tufts; colour 1 on the shaggy whisker band that loops around the face.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_02.description: A pair of forked antler-like horns rising from the top of the head in a V, each a smooth tapered shaft with a short side branch, a ring band and a few thin stripes near the base.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts and branches; colour 1 on the ring bands; colour 2 on the thin stripe bands.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_02.differs: The horns sit closer together and more upright, rising from a smaller head.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_03.description: A pair of tall, pointed ear-like fins rising from the top of the head, each a curved shell with a notched, scalloped rear edge and a hollow inner face. Suggests a beastly or dragon-like fantasy look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the ear shells; colour 1 on the hollow inner faces.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_03.differs: The female ears sit slightly wider apart and angle outward less sharply, with a more upright, flared silhouette.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_04.description: A pair of bulging cartoon-like eyeball ornaments mounted on either side of the head at the temples, each a rounded shell with concentric iris rings and a pupil facing outward. Playful, monstrous, creature-inspired headgear.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded eyeball shells; colour 1 on the irises; colour 3 on the pupils; colour 2 on the outlines around the irises.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_05.description: A pair of small rounded, faceted knobs on short stalks, placed at either side of the face near the cheeks like ornamental horn-buds or sensors. Each has swirling contrasting bands across its surface.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_05.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main bulb of each knob; colour 1 on the swirling bands; colour 0 on the short stalks.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Guardian_05.differs: The knobs sit low beside the cheeks, near the mouth and nose level.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Half_Deity_03.description: A small curved plate covering the forehead and front of the crown, with a stepped, angular upper edge and a raised pointed shield-shaped inset down the centre. Sits like a partial helmet or brow guard over the bare head.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Half_Deity_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the stepped upper rim; colour 3 on the central shield inset; colour 2 on the outline around the inset.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Half_Nightvisor_01.description: A single round cyclops-style lens housing worn on the middle of the forehead: a chunky faceted ring with a glossy contrasting lens, a contrasting band around the rim and a smooth domed back.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Half_Nightvisor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ring and housing; colour 1 on the band around the rim; colour 2 on the lens.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Hat_Madjester_01.description: Four small floating bells hover around the head, two on each side, with no band or hat connecting them. Each bell is a flared cone with a small round clapper ball on top, suggesting a whimsical jester look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Hat_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bell bodies; colour 0 on the round balls on top of each bell.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Hats_Spy_01.description: A small rosebud-style flower worn on the side of the forehead near the temple: an outer ring of broad petals around a tightly coiled centre. A cute, decorative accent rather than a full hat.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Hats_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer petals; colour 1 on the coiled centre of the rose.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Heraldry_01.description: Three pointed cone spikes in a row along the centre of the head from front to back, each on a short cuffed base, forming a mohawk-like crest that curves back and down.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the spike cones; colour 3 on the short base collars.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Heraldry_02.description: A swept-back mohawk-style hair piece: a tall tuft of jagged, feathered locks rises from the crown and sweeps back into a long tapering tail past the nape, tied with a small band and topped with tiny spikes.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Heraldry_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair locks; colour 1 on the small band at the base of the tuft.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Heraldry_02.differs: The female version's tuft sits higher and more upright on the crown, with a shorter, less sweeping tail.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Horsemask_Longmane_.description: A partial mane piece that sits on one side of the head, running from the forehead over the crown to the nape, with a ridged top strip and jagged, pointed tufts hanging at the lower edge.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Horsemask_Longmane_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top ridge of the mane; colour 1 on the main side panel; colour 0 on the pointed tufts and lower edge; colour 3 on the inner underside.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Horsemask_Longmane_.description: A partial mane-like head piece sweeping over one side and the back of the skull in layered, ragged locks, with jagged tapered tips at the lower edge; suggests a horse-mask or beast costume accent.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Horsemask_Longmane_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the mane; colour 2 on the top ridge and back strip; colour 0 on the lower tips and edges; colour 3 on a small underlayer near the front.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Horsemask_Shortmane.description: A short, narrow mohawk-style mane that runs in a curved ridge from the forehead over the crown to the nape, with chunky faceted panels; suggests a horse or beast mask crest.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Horsemask_Shortmane.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front tip and the lower rear tip of the mane; colour 1 on the main side panels; colour 2 on the top central strip; colour 3 on the small accents at the base.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Horsemask_Spikymane.description: A narrow mohawk-style crest of angular, faceted spikes running from the forehead over the crown to the nape, with a swept-back curve. It sits along the centre of the head like a beastly mane.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Horsemask_Spikymane.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faceted spike plates; colour 1 on the inner side panels between the spikes; colour 2 on the small underside sections at the front and back.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Jester_01.description: A pair of small five-pointed metal stars floating on either side of the head at about ear height, standing free of the head with no band or cap. A whimsical jester-style accent.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Jester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stars; the default metal-like finish shows little of the other colour slots.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Kabuto_01.description: A small ornamental kabuto crest that floats above the crown of the head: a squared base with a carved key-pattern band, a slim neck, and a tall openwork knotwork plaque with curled, horn-like tips on each side.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Kabuto_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and the narrow neck; colour 3 on the recessed band of the base; colour 2 on the key-pattern carvings; colour 1 on the knotwork crest.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Kabuto_02.description: A helmet chin-strap accessory: two thick braided cords rise from a small plate under the chin up past the cheeks, joined below by a big looped bow knot with dangling tails. No helmet shell is shown.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Kabuto_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the braided cords and bow knot; colour 0 on the small chin plate; colour 2 on the plate's edge outline.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Lemurian_Bubble_01.description: A translucent glass-like bubble helmet that encloses the whole head, with a tall rounded dome and a flared lower rim that hangs to the shoulders and neck. Suggests an aquatic or alien life-support dome.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Lemurian_Bubble_01.colourAreas: The default glassy material ignores the colour scheme; no slot is clearly visible on the bubble.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Lockbox_66_02.description: A full-coverage helmet with a smooth faceted dome, a beast-like face mask with a ridged snout and narrow eye slits, a geometric key-pattern band across the chin, and a V-shaped stripe over the back of the head.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and chin pattern; colour 1 on the face mask and the stripe trim running over the crown and back; colour 3 on the lines outlining the eyes and mouth; colour 2 in the eye openings.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A thin crown-like band that sits around the top of the head, with a jagged notched rim and a ring of tall curved horn spikes rising from it, evoking a villainous, monstrous coronet.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the curved horn spikes.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A superhero domino-style eye mask with angular, pentagonal eye openings and a pointed V-shaped brow that sweeps up to the sides. It wraps the eyes and nose bridge and ends in a flared, angled edge at the temples.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body; colour 1 on the raised upper brow rim; colour 2 on the thin outline around the eye openings.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Modern_Kinetik_02.description: A pair of angular, slanted eye-shield lenses that sit over each eye like a stylised mask, with upswept outer corners and a thin raised rim; no strap is visible and the pieces do not join across the nose.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Modern_Kinetik_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised rim edges; colour 2 on the main lens surfaces.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Odragon_01.description: A pair of tall, curved dragon horns rising from the sides of the head and sweeping up and outward to sharp points, each with a small secondary spike near the tip. Fantasy monster headgear.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower and middle of each horn; colour 1 on the upper tips, fading in as a gradient.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Odragon_02.description: A set of floating fang-shaped tusks around the mouth: four downward-pointing cones hang from the upper lip and four smaller upward-pointing cones rise from the chin, forming a monstrous, dragon-like bite.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Odragon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the fangs, upper and lower; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Pirate_Hat_01.description: A small forehead ornament: two curved, horn-like arms sweep out from a central pointed plate, with a thin curved crest above. It sits flat on the brow like a stylised emblem, with a gothic, monstrous feel.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Pirate_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two curved side arms; colour 0 on the central plate; colour 2 on the lower pointed centre; colour 3 on the upper crest.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A flat, angular half-mask plate that covers the lower face from below the eyes to the chin, with a straight notched top edge and a stepped, pointed bottom over the chin. Suggests a retro warlord or monstrous look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer face of the plate; colour 1 on the inner surface, which shows from behind.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The female plate is a single flat sheet, while the male version has several layered, stacked plates with ridged edges.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_P.description: A translucent retro sci-fi bubble helmet: a tall, egg-shaped glass dome that tapers to a point above the head and sits open at the neck, enclosing the whole head with generous space around it.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_P.colourAreas: The whole dome is a see-through glass-like material that largely ignores the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_P.description: A full-head opaque bubble helmet with a tall, pointed egg shape and a faceted, rough surface. It encloses the whole head with a flared lower edge that drops to the neck at the back.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_P.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shell; the shading across the shell suggests other slots are not used.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_P.differs: The female helmet has a rough, faceted stone-like surface with a low-poly look, while the male version is smooth.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_R.description: A large, translucent round bubble helmet that encloses the whole head in a smooth glassy dome, with an open flared lower rim resting around the neck and shoulders. Retro sci-fi spacesuit or diver style.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_R.colourAreas: The default material is glassy and translucent and does not visibly take the colour scheme; there are no separate coloured features.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_R.description: A smooth, opaque rounded dome helmet that fully encloses the head, with a plain front and a lower rim that stops at the neck. Its retro sci-fi bubble shape hides the face completely.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_R.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole dome; the surface shows a mottled, faceted texture and no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Space_Glass_01.description: A sleek, translucent glass-like helmet shell covering the crown, brow and back of the head, with angular faceted edges, a V-shaped cut over the eyes and a notched lower rim at the nape. Futuristic space style.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Space_Glass_01.colourAreas: Glossy glass-like material that largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint from colour 0 on the shell and edge trim.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Stovepipe_Hat_Madje.description: A small cluster of long curved feathers rising from a single point on top of the head and sweeping backward: two banded plumes with pointed tips and a wider soft feather beneath. A flamboyant jester-style head accent.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Stovepipe_Hat_Madje.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the banded stripes of the two long plumes; colour 2 on the alternating bands and edges of those plumes; colour 0 and colour 1 on the wider soft feather, fading from one to the other.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Super_Retro_Destroy.description: A pair of flat, angular teardrop-shaped eye lenses that sit over the eyes, each angled downward toward the nose with a thin flat profile. Evokes retro comic-villain goggles without a frame or strap.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Super_Retro_Destroy.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both lens shapes, with a slight colour 1 sheen on the back faces; no other visible features.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Super_Retro_Destroy.description: An open-topped, retro superhero headpiece: two tall swept-up pointed fins rise at the sides of the head, joined by a V-shaped brow that dips to a point over the forehead, with small spikes at the back.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Super_Retro_Destroy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of the fins and brow; the thin edge trim may take colour 1. The glossy metal finish largely ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Swing_01.description: A padded fabric headband worn around the forehead, with a pair of twin-lens goggles mounted on the front, resting on the brow. Rounded housings hold circular lenses with contrasting rims, joined by a ribbed bridge.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the headband; colour 0 on the goggle housings and bridge; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the lens rims.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Swing_01.differs: The female version has a small contrasting plate at the back of the band, where the male version has a wider curved plate.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Swing_02.description: A partial hair-like head piece: a band of layered, swept feather-shaped locks wrapping the back and sides of the head, with a contrasting angular swoop across the forehead and scattered thin spikes.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the streaks and edges of the locks; colour 2 on the angular front panel.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Swing_03.description: A band of swept, wavy hair-like locks that wraps around the head at brow and nape level, with curling tufts flicking out at the temples and a flat angular panel across the forehead. Leaves the crown bare.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Swing_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swirling locks; colour 0 on the highlight streaks in the locks; colour 2 on the flat forehead panel.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Swing_03.differs: The forehead panel is a smooth flat strip, and the locks sit lower over the brow.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Teddy_01.description: A pair of rounded, teddy-bear-style ears with a fuzzy textured outer shell and a inner face, mounted high on either side of the head like buns. Cute, playful animal headwear.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fluffy shell and rims of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear faces.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Crown_Eclipse.description: A spidery crown-like headpiece: a wide angular band across the forehead with a central spider-shaped ornament over the brow, curved claw-like spikes hanging down and rising at the temples, and a recessed panel between rims.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Crown_Eclipse.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band rims and central ornament; colour 1 on the recessed inner panels; colour 2 on the curved claws; colour 3 on the jewel in the centre ornament.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Flighthelmet_.description: A wraparound flight helmet visor: a single curved, translucent shield covering the eyes and brow, with a notched cut-out over the nose and edges reaching back toward the temples. It sits on the face like sleek pilot goggles.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Flighthelmet_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor shield; the tinted, glossy surface shows little of the other colour slots.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Flighthelmet_.description: A curved, translucent visor panel that wraps across the eyes and cheeks from temple to temple, with a straight top edge and a shallow angled lower edge. It suggests a flight helmet or sci-fi visor.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Flighthelmet_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor; the translucent glassy material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Mask_Archer_0.description: A tight cloth lower-face mask covering the nose-bridge-down to the chin, with a separate upper edge panel and a fabric neck piece that wraps around the throat. Ninja or archer-like, sleek and form-fitting.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Mask_Archer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck wrap and side sections; colour 1 on the front chin panel; colour 2 on the upper nose-and-mouth panel.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Mask_Archer_0.differs: The female mask ends in a shorter neck wrap that sits closer under the chin.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Pompom_01.description: A small rounded pom-pom ball of crumpled, layered tufts that sits on top of the head like a topknot. It looks like fluffy fur or wadded cloth, with a playful, cute feel.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Pompom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole pom-pom; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A pair of tall, swept-up winged head ornaments rising from either side of the head, each a curved feathered wing with ribbed feather lines and a raised rim. Fantasy, valkyrie-like styling.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rims and feather ribs; colour 1 on the wing panels between the ribs.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Space_Pharaoh.description: A pharaoh-style nemes headcloth: a soft cloth head covering with two broad lappets hanging down either side of the face, a striped, angular fold across the crown, and a thin tail trailing down the back.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Space_Pharaoh.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cloth of the lappets and crown; colour 0 on the front fold, inner lining and back tail; colour 2 on the striped panels and lappet hems; colour 3 on small accents at the edges.
