Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Techcat_01.description: A pair of pointed cat-ear head pieces joined at the centre of the crown, with smooth angular outer shells and inner faces of ribbed, layered panels. Sits on top of the head in a tech-feline style.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Techcat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the lower inner panel of each ear; colour 3 on the ribbed stripes; colour 2 on the recessed gaps between the stripes.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Tiara_Warrior.description: A small flat five-pointed star ornament worn on the centre of the forehead, faceted like a pyramid with each point split into separate faceted panels. It sits flush against the skin like a tiara gem.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tight_Tiara_Warrior.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper-left facets of the star; colour 1 on the right facets; colour 2 on the lower-left facets; colour 3 on the back face of the star.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Tophat_Wizards_01.description: Two long, narrow cloth tails with ragged, pointed ends that hang straight down from the top of the head, one in front of the face and one behind. They read as loose hat streamers with a tattered, wizardly look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Tophat_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both tails; the back of the rear tail shows a slightly textured finish. Colours 0, 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Traveler_01.description: A single large curved feather mounted at the side of the head, its contrasting central quill sweeping up and back with layered, ragged barbs along both edges; a decorative, tribal-fantasy hair accessory.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather vanes; colour 2 on the central quill and shading at the base; faint colour 1 tint at the barb edges.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Umbrella_01.description: A novelty umbrella hat: a wide, shallow canopy of pointed fabric panels on thin ribs with small ball tips at the edges, floating above the head like a small parasol. Playful and comic in style.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Umbrella_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribs and ball tips; colours 1, 2 and 3 on the alternating canopy panels.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A pair of long, narrow cloth streamers hanging from either side of the head down past the chest, ending in jagged, pointed layered tips. Suggests a fantasy hennin veil with a flowing drape.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper lengths of the streamers; colour 1 on the lower tips and jagged ends, blending in a gradient.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_01.description: A small fur cap that sits on top of the head, with two tall pointed wolf ears and a shaggy, jagged-tufted fur fringe that hangs down the back of the head. It suggests a beastly, animalistic look.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ears, the back tufts and the outer fur; colour 1 on the front and top fur of the cap; colour 2 on the inner ear lining.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_01.differs: The female cap has no contrasting jagged fur edge along the front of the brow and sits slightly further back on the head.

Female/F_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_02.description: A row of six pointed conical fangs set side by side across the mouth area, with larger tusk-like fangs at each end, pointing downward like a snarling beast's teeth.
Female/F_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat tops of the fangs; the cone bodies take a shading from the default material.

Female/F_Hip_Child_Pants_Denim_01.description: Tiny patches of denim pants rather than a full garment: a rectangular panel on the outer upper thigh and a small wrapped knee patch on the other leg, with a thin strip on the calf. Casual, worn-in style.
Female/F_Hip_Child_Pants_Denim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh, knee and calf patches; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Hip_Pants_Denim_01.description: Low-rise, loose-fitting denim jeans with a fade from the hips down the legs, wide straight legs with rolled cuffs, back pockets, and ripped, frayed patches over both knees and thighs. Casual street style.
Female/F_Hip_Pants_Denim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper jeans; colour 1 on the lower legs and cuffs, fading in from the hips; colour 3 on the torn, frayed patches showing beneath the rips; colour 2 on the waistband.

Female/F_Hipasttach_L_Steelarachnid_F.description: A rigid armored thigh guard worn on the left leg, curving around the outer thigh with a pointed spike rising at the hip, two angled recessed slots and a segmented, jagged lower edge. Mechanical, arachnid-like styling.
Female/F_Hipasttach_L_Steelarachnid_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor shell; colour 2 on the rim, edge trim and spike; colour 1 on the recessed slot inserts; colour 3 on the tiny accents near the lower edge.

Female/F_Hipasttach_R_Steelarachnid_F.description: A curved, armored thigh guard for the right leg: a smooth segmented shell with a pointed fin rising at the hip, angled vents cut into its outer side, and a notched lower edge above the knee. Mechanical, insect-like styling.
Female/F_Hipasttach_R_Steelarachnid_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the rim, the pointed top fin and the edge trim; colour 1 on the recessed vent slots; colour 3 on the small accents along the lower edge.

Female/F_Hips_Animal_01.description: Form-fitting scaled leggings that reach the lower calf, fading out toward the ankle. A layered belly-scale panel runs down the front of the hips and crotch, and rows of curved fin-like spikes flare along the outer thighs.
Female/F_Hips_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the leggings and outer spikes; colour 0 on the front belly-scale panel; the lower legs fade to the bare skin tone.
Female/F_Hips_Animal_01.differs: The female version has larger, more flared spike fins on the outer thighs, and they extend further down the leg.

Female/F_Hips_Animal_02.description: Fur-covered animal leg piece: close-fitting trousers with shaggy fur tufts along the outer thighs and a contrasting inner-thigh and groin panel, ending in ragged fur cuffs above smooth lower-leg sleeves.
Female/F_Hips_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the thighs and hips; colour 1 on the front inner-thigh and groin panel; colour 2 on the fur tips at the cuffs; colour 3 on the lower-leg sleeves.

Female/F_Hips_Animal_Alt_02.description: Furry animal-style leg covering: shaggy fur-textured trousers from waist to ankle with a feathery V-shaped panel across the front hips and thighs, ragged tufts at the lower calf, and smooth fitted lower legs below.
Female/F_Hips_Animal_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur of the thighs and calves; colour 1 on the front hip and thigh panel; colour 3 on the lower leg sleeves; colour 2 on the jagged tufts at the calf edges.

Female/F_Hips_Astronaut_01.description: Loose, full-length astronaut pants with a high padded waistband, harness-style straps crossing the hips, round hip connectors, contrasting thigh and shin panels, and contrasting bands strapped around the knees and calves; cuffs gather at the ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pant legs and waistband; colour 1 on the thigh, knee and shin panels and the rear seat panel; colour 2 on the knee and calf bands and harness straps; colour 3 on the hip connectors and harness fittings.

Female/F_Hips_Astronaut_02.description: Full-length astronaut-style trousers with a high waist, contrasting front and rear leg panels, and contrasting straps with knee and shin bands. Round connector discs and a harness-like strap sit at the hips, and the cuffs are snug.
Female/F_Hips_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trousers and waist; colour 1 on the front thigh, shin and rear panels; colour 2 on the straps and leg bands; colour 3 on the round hip discs and harness accents.

Female/F_Hips_Beast_Mechanical_01.description: Robotic digitigrade-style leg armour: a low-slung hip plate with armoured thigh shells, exposed cabling and tubes along the legs, and jointed mechanical knees with disc pivots leading to slim metallic shins.
Female/F_Hips_Beast_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hip plate, thigh shells and knee housings; colour 0 on the shin plates and lower thigh panels; colour 2 on the holster-like thigh boxes and joints; colour 3 on the exposed cables.
Female/F_Hips_Beast_Mechanical_01.differs: The female version has slimmer, less bulky thigh shells and a lower, smaller hip plate.

Female/F_Hips_Child_Moth_01.description: A pair of tall, curved wing-like panels flaring from the hips down the outer thighs to the knees, with a thin raised edge along the top and a pointed tip at the hip. Gives a moth-wing, monstrous look.
Female/F_Hips_Child_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper panels and the raised edge; colour 3 on the lower panels, blending down from colour 0; colours 1 and 2 are not visible.
Female/F_Hips_Child_Moth_01.differs: The female panels are narrower and more slender, hanging further down the outer thigh with longer pointed lower tips.

Female/F_Hips_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A tiny flat, curved patch sitting low across the front of the hips, like a small cap or waistband fragment. It is thin, plain and covers very little; it barely wraps toward the back.
Female/F_Hips_Child_Tight_None_01.differs: The female version curves downward into a crescent at the front and dips into a small contrasting-edged flap at the sides and back.

Female/F_Hips_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: Full-length trousers with a loose, gathered upper section over the hips and thighs, and close-fitting lower legs that end at the ankle. Separate knee-down panels with angled seams, and patch pockets on the back.
Female/F_Hips_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip and thigh sections; colour 3 on the knee-down lower leg panels; colour 2 on the back pockets and waistband interior.

Female/F_Hips_Dinosuit_01.description: Baggy, loose-fitting pants with a banded elastic waist, a large quilted padded panel over the front of the hips and groin, and gathered cuffs at the ankles. Suggests a martial-arts or sporty superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pant legs and waistband; colour 1 on the quilted front panel; colour 2 on the ankle cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Dress_Victorian_01.description: A wide, bell-shaped Victorian skirt starting at the waist, with a smooth front panel, gathered swagged ruffles below it and tiered flounces with a ragged edge, flaring to a full ankle-length hem.
Female/F_Hips_Dress_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper front panel; colour 2 on the gathered swagged layer; colour 1 on the ruffle band and the hem edging; colour 3 on the lower skirt tier.

Female/F_Hips_Dryad_01.description: A partial legs piece: a crumpled, ruffled short-like hip wrap over an exposed mechanical skeleton of legs, with slim rod-like struts, segmented cylinder columns and bulky knee rings. Organic-meets-robotic look.
Female/F_Hips_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ruffled hip wrap; colour 0 on the struts, plates and knee rings; colour 1 on the cylinder columns; colour 3 on small bands and details on the columns.

Female/F_Hips_Dryad_02.description: Organic-mechanical leg piece: a wrapped twist of leafy, vine-like bands around the hips, with slender segmented leg frames of metal-like struts, knee guards and vertical tubes running down to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip swirls, leg struts and knee guards; colour 1 on the hip cloth panel and the tube inserts along the legs; colour 3 on small accents between the tubes.
Female/F_Hips_Dryad_02.differs: The female version has a smaller hip wrap that sits lower with a less prominent front panel.

Female/F_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_01.description: Robotic leg piece: short, crumpled shorts of layered ribbed material at the hips, with exposed mechanical legs below made of slim armoured struts, cylindrical piston-like calves and bulky knee joints, ending above the feet.
Female/F_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shorts; colour 0 on the armoured struts, knee joints and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the cylindrical leg tubes; colour 3 on small bands within the tubes.

Female/F_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_02.description: Robotic exoskeleton leg frame: exposed mechanical limbs with segmented struts and ribbed inner cabling, jointed knee guards, and a swept, leaf-like hip mantle of curled plates with a separate inner panel at the waist.
Female/F_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip mantle plates, struts and knee guards; colour 1 on the inner hip panel and the leg cable sections; colour 3 on small accents between the leg segments; colour 2 on the joints.
Female/F_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_02.differs: The hip mantle is a rounded, swirling wrap with the inner panel mostly at the front; the leg frame is slimmer.

Female/F_Hips_Endo_01.description: A robotic exoskeleton-style leg frame: layered curved armor plates around the hips, then slender segmented legs of exposed mechanical struts, cylindrical actuators and rounded knee joints, ending in ankle cuffs above the boots.
Female/F_Hips_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plates, outer struts and knee and ankle joints; colour 1 on the actuator cylinders and front hip panel; colour 3 on the small connector accents; colour 2 on the inner hip lining and joint gaps.

Female/F_Hips_Endo_02.description: A robotic exoskeleton leg frame: layered curved plates wrap the hips, with slim mechanical struts down each leg, bulky knee joints and cylindrical piston segments along the thighs and shins. Skeletal, open construction.
Female/F_Hips_Endo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plates, struts and knee joints; colour 1 on the piston cylinders and front crotch panel; colour 3 on the small accents between the pistons; colour 2 on the inner hip and joint recesses.

Female/F_Hips_Holohexarmor_01.description: Form-fitting sci-fi leggings with segmented ribbed underlayer and raised hex-style armor plates over the hips, thighs, knees and shins, plus a rounded rear plate and contrasting vent recesses. Sits from waist to ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Holohexarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed leggings underlayer and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the raised armor plates; colour 2 on the recessed vents and gaps in the plates; colour 3 not visible.
Female/F_Hips_Holohexarmor_01.differs: The female version has a smaller, rounded rear plate and slimmer thigh plates, with a shorter front waist panel and less ribbing visible on the thighs.

Female/F_Hips_Inmate_01.description: Loose, ankle-length cloth trousers with a band around each upper thigh, a contrasting front panel at the fly, and crisscrossing strips down the legs. The hems are slit at the front and slightly frayed; a utilitarian prison-issue look.
Female/F_Hips_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser fabric; colour 1 on the thigh bands and the strips running down the legs; colour 3 on the front fly panel; colour 2 on the small tags on the thigh bands.

Female/F_Hips_Moth_01.description: Form-fitting insect-inspired leg piece with a jagged-edged hip panel, rounded rear, layered plates down the thighs and shins, and tall wing-like fins flaring off the outer hips. Reaches the ankles with segmented boot-like cuffs.
Female/F_Hips_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hip panel, rear and ankle cuffs; colour 0 on the thigh and shin plates and the outer fins; colour 1 on the lower-leg guards; colour 2 on the small inner gap accents.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Basic_01.description: Plain low-rise fitted pants that hug the hips and thighs and flare slightly into bootcut hems at the ankles, with soft creasing at the knees and crotch. A casual, everyday look.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole pair of pants, with slight shading variation; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Basic_01_Glitter.description: Low-rise, slightly bootcut casual pants with a mottled, worn-looking surface, a plain waistband and a thin contrasting stripe running down the outer side of each leg; they reach the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Basic_01_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fabric of the pants; colour 1 on the thin side stripes down each leg. The surface texture is speckled and worn.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_01.description: Low-rise, fitted bell-bottom trousers that hug the hips and thighs, then flare into wide bell cuffs at the ankles. Smooth cloth with soft creasing at the knees gives a retro casual look.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole trouser surface; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_01.differs: The female pair sits lower on the hips and has a wider, more dramatic flare at the cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_Glitter.description: Low-rise bell-bottom pants that fit closely through the hips and thighs and flare widely from the knee to the ankle. A thin contrasting stripe runs down each outer seam, and the fabric has a speckled, glittery texture.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pants fabric with speckled texture; colour 1 on the thin side-seam stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Bounty_01.description: Low-rise pants with a glossy leather look: a contrasting front panel down each leg, a separate back and outer-side panel, a thin waistband, and slouchy wrinkles gathering at the ankles. A casual western-flavoured style.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front leg panels; colour 0 on the back and outer-side panels; colour 2 on the waistband.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Bounty_01.differs: The contrasting front panels cover more of each leg, with only a thin strip of the outer panel visible at the side.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_01.description: Pair of leg accessories made of rows of short, flat metal bands stacked down the outer sides of each thigh and calf, with small tabs and rivets. Worn over bare tights, giving a sci-fi renegade look.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bands; colour 1 on the small side tabs and fasteners; metallic material mostly ignores the other slots.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_02.description: Two columns of short curved metal slats stacked down the outer thighs like exposed ribs, each slat with a small rivet. They float off the leg without covering it, giving a sci-fi mechanical look.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the slat surfaces; colour 1 on the inner edges of the slats; colour 2 on the rivets.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_03.description: Two columns of small separate straps wrapped around the outer sides of each lower leg, stacked from knee to ankle with small fasteners; they sit over the bare legs as decorative bands rather than full pants.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the fastener tabs and strap edges.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_03.differs: The female straps are spaced wider and vary in size, with fewer, longer bands per leg than the male set.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Cowboychaps_01.description: Western-style leather chaps: open-backed leg coverings with flared, boot-cut lower legs, fringe down the outer seams, and a belted waistband with a small buckle. Worn over a separate pair of trousers that show at the seat and back of the legs.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Cowboychaps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer leg panels; colour 0 on the underlying trousers showing at the front, seat and inner back of the legs; colour 2 on the waistband and back hip panels; colour 3 on the small buckle detail.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Ghosthunter_01.description: Fitted casual-tactical pants with slim legs that gather into cuffs above the ankles, large contrasting panels on the outer thighs, rounded knee pads, and a lower leg section in a separate colour. Sits at the hips.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pants and waistband; colour 3 on the thigh panels; colour 2 on the knee pads; colour 1 on the lower legs, fading up from the cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Gi_01.description: Loose martial-arts gi pants with a low waistband, soft wrinkled cloth through the hips and legs, a faint seam down each outer leg, and gathered cuffs at the ankles. Suits martial-arts or casual looks.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Gi_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole pants; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Goth_01.description: Loose-fitting cargo-style trousers with a contrasting waistband, a side thigh pocket with a small stud, and gathered cuffs at the ankles finished with narrow trim bands; sits at the hips and reaches the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser fabric; colour 2 on the waistband and ankle cuff bands; colour 3 on the small stud on the thigh pocket.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Goth_02.description: Close-fitting gothic pants from waist to ankle, with quilted thigh panels, a separate panel over each shin, and criss-cross lacing at the thighs and lower legs. They end at the ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pants and thigh panels; colour 1 on the panel behind the lacing at each shin; colour 2 on the lacing cords.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Lockbox_65_01.description: Flared kung fu pants sitting at the waist with a contrasting waistband, vertical stripes down each leg, swirling flame-like patterns on the thighs and shins, and tattered, ragged bell-bottom hems reaching the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main pants; colour 0 on the waistband, vertical stripes and flame-like swirl patterns.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Madjester_01.description: Snug harlequin pants with an all-over diamond check pattern, running from a low-set hip waistband down to gathered ankle cuffs. A jester-style, theatrical look with a slightly relaxed fit through the legs.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light diamonds; colour 1 on the mid diamonds; colour 2 on the outlines between the diamonds; a thin waist edge shows no clear slot.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Madjester_01.differs: The female version has a thin contrasting waist edge that barely shows, without the wide contrasting waistband of the male pants.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Martial_Power_01.description: Baggy martial-arts style knee-length pants with a high waist, full billowing legs gathered into cuffs just below the knee, and broad vertical stripes running down the front and back.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the pants; colour 0 on the vertical stripes down each leg. The lower legs below the cuffs are the mannequin's tights, not part of the piece.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Martial_Power_02.description: Knee-length martial-arts pants with a fitted waistband, baggy legs that puff out above gathered cuffs at the knee, and curling swirl motifs on the lower legs. Suggests an East Asian fighter look.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waistband and upper hips, fading into colour 0 on the main legs; colour 2 on the swirl motifs and knee cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Persian_01.description: Loose, baggy harem-style trousers gathered into puffy cuffs at the ankles, with a large cut-out on each outer hip and thigh edged in a ruffled trim, exposing skin. Low-slung on the hips.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser fabric; colour 1 on the ruffled trim around the side cut-outs; the cut-outs show bare skin, not a colour slot.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Persian_01.differs: The female version has large open cut-outs down each outer hip and thigh edged with ruffled trim, while the male version has closed sides with a narrow decorative stripe.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Pulp_Aviator_01.description: Pulp aviator riding breeches: full, baggy thighs that taper and gather at the knee, a slim waistband with a small button, curved piping on the front pockets, and short fitted boot cuffs below.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Pulp_Aviator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the breeches; colour 1 on the curved pocket piping; colour 2 on the lower boot cuffs; colour 3 on the waistband button and cuff buttons.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Rave_01.description: Low-rise, wide-leg flared pants with a contrasting waistband, a fly seam, and a strap with a stud around each shin above a zipper that runs down the front of the lower leg. Casual street rave style.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper legs and hips, fading toward colour 0 on the lower legs and flared hems; colour 3 on the waistband; colour 2 on the zippers and pull tabs.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Rave_02.description: Low-rise wide-leg rave pants with a contrasting waistband, studded patch pockets on the front and back hips, a strap around each knee and a zipper line down the lower leg, ending in a flared hem.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper legs and body of the pants; colour 0 on the lower legs and knee straps; colour 3 on the waistband and pocket patches; colour 2 on the zippers and studs.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Renegade_01.description: Full-length, close-fitting pants with a gradient from hip to ankle. Each outer leg has a cut-out slit laced with short crossing straps that stick out sideways, giving a sci-fi renegade look. Sits at the hips.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper pants and the side straps; colour 1 on the lower legs, where the colour blends in; colour 2 on the gaps inside the side slits; colour 3 on the thin stitched edging along the slits.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Renegade_02.description: Form-fitting sci-fi pants with a low-rise waistband and a separate centre panel over the hips and crotch. Each outer thigh has a column of contrasting slots joined by thin cords, and the legs taper to the ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and centre hip panel; colour 1 on the legs; colour 2 on the slot inserts down the outer thighs; colour 3 on the thin cords linking the slots.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Rocker_01.description: Low-rise flared rocker pants: short hip section, banded thigh sections with studded strips, and wide bell-bottom lower legs with flame-shaped cut-outs and scattered stud dots at the hems. Glam-rock, stage-costume style.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip section and the lower flared legs; colour 1 on the banded thigh sections; colour 2 on the flame shapes, hem edges and band edging; colour 3 on the small stud dots and strip details.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Santa_01.description: Full-length pants with a wide waistband, colour-blocked panels over the thighs and shins, and gathered cuffs at the ankles. Slim through the leg, with a small round patch on the seat and on each cuff.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, seat, back of the legs and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the upper thighs and lower legs; colour 2 on the mid-thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow inner shin panels.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Santa_01.differs: The female pants fit closer to the leg and the cuffs are narrower, with a slimmer tapered leg.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Secret_01.description: Baggy casual sweatpants with an elastic waistband, loose billowing legs gathered into snug cuffs at the ankles, and twin stripes running down each outer side. Sits at the hips and reaches the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pant legs; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 3 on the side stripes; colour 2 on the ankle cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Secret_02.description: Loose, straight-cut casual slacks with a plain waistband, relaxed full-length legs that bunch at the ankles into narrow cuffs, and two patch pockets on the back. Sits at the hips, with an everyday street feel.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the trousers; colour 2 on the ankle cuffs; colour 3 on the back patch pockets.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Secret_03.description: Casual fitted trousers with a snug hip and thigh and a gentle straight leg that reaches the ankle. A contrasting waistband sits low on the hips, and the hems have a thin contrasting edge.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the legs; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 2 on the thin hem edging.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Secret_04.description: Loose casual cargo pants with a contrasting elastic waistband, large flapped cargo pockets on the outer thighs, small buttoned back pockets, and gathered, cuffed hems that bunch above the ankles. Sits at the hips.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser legs; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 2 on the cargo and back pockets; colour 3 on the small button details on the back pockets.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Secret_04.differs: The female version's lower legs and cuffs stay the same light shade with no gradient, and the waistband looks slightly lower and narrower.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Ski_01.description: Close-fitting ski pants that run from the waist to the ankles, with a gradient that fades toward the lower legs, a contrasting stripe down each outer leg, and angled zip pockets at the hips and back waist.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper pants; colour 1 in the gradient on the lower legs; colour 2 on the side stripes; colour 3 on the zip pocket tabs at the front and back waist.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Spy_01.description: Fitted full-length pants with a glossy panelled construction: a high waistband, large knee patches, curved side panels and a narrow inset stripe down each shin. They end in a slight flare at the ankle. Suggests a sleek spy or biker look.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, hips, seat and lower legs; colour 1 on the thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the knee patches; colour 3 on the narrow shin stripes.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Spy_01.differs: The female version is made of fitted colour-blocked panels with knee patches and shin stripes, while the male version is looser plaid-patterned trousers.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Spy_02.description: Slim, casual jeans-style trousers sitting low on the hips, with a small button at the waistband, front pockets and two patch pockets on the back. They taper to the ankle and fade to a different shade toward the hem.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trousers and waistband, fading into colour 1 on the lower legs; colour 2 on the back pockets; colour 3 on the waist button.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Tight_01.description: Plain casual pants that hug the hips and thighs, with a low waistband and a slight flare at the ankle hem. Soft cloth wrinkles show at the knees, and the legs reach to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole pants; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Tight_01.differs: The female pants sit lower on the hips and have smoother knees with a gentler flare at the hem.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Tornskin_01.description: Low-rise, fitted cropped pants ending below the knee with ragged, jagged torn hems and slightly flared lower legs; back pockets with small flaps and a simple waistband give a casual, distressed street look.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Tornskin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pants fabric; colour 2 on the edging along the torn hems; small details such as the pocket flaps follow colour 0.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Urban_Baggy_01.description: Low-slung baggy urban cargo pants with loose, bunched fabric that pools at the ankles, a visible waistband band, a webbing belt with a hanging tail and buckle, cargo pocket on the thigh, and a draped chain at the hip.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Urban_Baggy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pant legs and pockets; colour 3 on the waistband/underwear band at the top; colour 1 on the belt and its hanging strap; colour 2 on the buckle and chain.

Female/F_Hips_Pants_Urban_Rolled_01.description: Baggy urban cargo pants with a wide waistband, a thin belt with a square buckle and a dangling strap, a side cargo pocket, a hanging chain, and loose bunched legs rolled up below the knee.
Female/F_Hips_Pants_Urban_Rolled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pant legs and belt trim; colour 1 on the waistband and the dangling belt strap; colour 2 on the buckle and chain.

Female/F_Hips_Patriot_01.description: Full-length superhero pants with a fitted hip and thigh, large contrasting inner-thigh panels, loose gathered shin sections, and a contrasting ankle band. contrasting outlines edge the panels and a short seam runs down the front of the waist.
Female/F_Hips_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hips, outer thighs and ankle bands; colour 3 on the inner-thigh panels; colour 1 on the gathered lower legs; colour 2 on the seam outlines.

Female/F_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_02.description: A robotic exoskeleton for the legs: slim mechanical struts run down each leg with bundled cable-like actuators, round knee joints and ankle cuffs, and angled plates around the hips under a contrasting waist band.
Female/F_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the struts, hip plates and joint casings; colour 1 on the actuator tubes along the legs; colour 3 on small accents on the actuators; colour 2 on the waist band and hip trim.
Female/F_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_02.differs: The female version has a slimmer frame with layered angled hip plates that sit lower, and a visible contrasting band across the hips.

Female/F_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_03.description: A robotic exoskeleton leg frame: a slim hip cage with angular plates and a waist band, and thin mechanical legs with exposed muscle-like cylinders, ringed knee and ankle joints, and segmented struts, leaving the body between them visible.
Female/F_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plates, struts and joint casings; colour 1 on the cylindrical actuator columns along the legs; colour 3 on small accents in the hips and actuators; colour 2 on the waist band.

Female/F_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_J.description: Robotic exoskeleton legs beneath a short loose cloth shorts-style hip piece with a thin centre seam. Segmented mechanical shins and thighs hold cylindrical piston-like tubes, with rounded knee joints and armoured ankle cuffs.
Female/F_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_J.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts and the armoured leg plates and knee joints; colour 1 on the cylindrical tubes along the legs; colour 3 on the centre seam and small accents in the tubes; colour 2 on inner joint gaps.
Female/F_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_J.differs: The female shorts are shorter and the seam line is thinner and less prominent, and the mechanical legs are a bit slimmer.

Female/F_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_J.description: A retro sci-fi exoskeleton leg piece: short loose cloth shorts with a thin front seam, over exposed robotic legs made of jointed metal plates, bulky knee and ankle cuffs and banded cylinder segments.
Female/F_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_J.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts, plating and knee and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the cylinder segments along the legs; colour 3 on the front seam and small accents; colour 2 on the inner joints.
Female/F_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_J.differs: The female shorts are shorter with a fainter front seam and fit closer to the hips.

Female/F_Hips_Robotexol_01.description: Asymmetric full-length tights: one plain, smooth, form-fitting leg with a hip-high waist, while the other leg is replaced by an exposed robotic prosthetic with jointed metal segments, cable-like tubes, and a ringed knee and ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Robotexol_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth tight leg, the hip cuff and the metal joint casings; colour 1 on the mechanical leg's inner tube sections; colour 3 on small accents between the tubes; colour 2 on the inner mechanism.

Female/F_Hips_Robotexol_Retroscifi_Jumps.description: Asymmetric retro sci-fi jumpsuit legs: one full trouser leg with a diagonal stripe, a band at the knee and a trim at the ankle, while the other leg is an exposed mechanical prosthetic with tubes and joints.
Female/F_Hips_Robotexol_Retroscifi_Jumps.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser fabric and mechanical casings; colour 1 on the knee band and the cylinders in the robotic leg; colour 3 on the diagonal stripe, ankle trim and waist seam.

Female/F_Hips_Robotexor_01.description: Asymmetric legwear: a smooth form-fitting tight covers the left leg and hip, while the right leg is an exposed robotic limb of segmented metal plates, cabling and glowing tubes, with a rigid hip cuff and jointed knee and ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Robotexor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tight leg and the hip cuff and armour plates of the mechanical leg; colour 1 on the tubes and cable sections; colour 3 on the small bands and accents within the tubes; colour 2 on the inner joints.

Female/F_Hips_Robotexor_Retroscifi_Jumps.description: A retro sci-fi jumpsuit bottom with loose cloth trousers on one leg and an exposed mechanical robotic leg on the other, with piston-like tubes, a jointed knee and ankle, and a diagonal stripe with banded cuffs on the cloth leg.
Female/F_Hips_Robotexor_Retroscifi_Jumps.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth trousers and metal leg casing; colour 1 on the cloth leg's calf bands and the robotic leg's tube segments; colour 3 on the diagonal stripe, the centre seam and the ankle band; colour 2 on the joints and inner mechanics.

Female/F_Hips_Skin_Furlong_01.description: Skin-tight werewolf leg covering with a fur-textured surface from the hips to the ankles, streaked with contrasting tufts and a smooth patch of exposed skin along the waistband and inner thighs. The silhouette is smooth and sleek.
Female/F_Hips_Skin_Furlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur texture of the legs; colour 1 on the shadowed fur tufts; colour 2 on the streaks at the crotch and calves; the skin-toned waistband and inner thigh patches ignore the colour scheme.
Female/F_Hips_Skin_Furlong_01.differs: The female legs have a smooth, flat fur texture that hugs the leg, without the shaggy tufts that stick out at the sides of the male version.

Female/F_Hips_Swing_01.description: Straight-leg pinstriped trousers with a slim waistband, a contrasting fly panel at the front, and turned-up cuffs at the ankles. They sit at the hips and have a relaxed vintage swing-era look.
Female/F_Hips_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vertical pinstripes and waistband; colour 1 on the stripes and the front fly panel; colour 2 on the ankle cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Teddy_01.description: Shaggy fur trousers with a loose, baggy drop-crotch cut, layered tufted fur covering the legs from waist to ankle, with a darker fade at the waist and ragged fringed hems at the cuffs.
Female/F_Hips_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur of the legs; colour 2 on the darkened fur around the waist; colour 3 on the fringed fur at the cuffs; colour 1 on the thin waist edge.
Female/F_Hips_Teddy_01.differs: The female version has a visible gap at the front of the crotch under the hips, with a more pronounced drop-crotch shape.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_01.description: Plain, smooth form-fitting tights that start at the hips and run down both legs to the ankles, with no seams, trim or extra details. A simple base layer suited to almost any costume.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_1.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, built from many thin horizontal segmented bands that give a robotic, banded look. They sit low on the hips and hug the whole leg.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main leggings surface; colour 2 on the thin grooves between the bands and on the waistband edge.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_11.description: Bare-skin legs with a low-cut bikini-style brief at the hips, with thin contrasting edging along the waistband and leg openings. The skin runs from the hips down to the ankles, leaving the feet uncovered.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_11.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brief; colour 1 on the thin edging trim; the skin-toned legs do not appear to follow the colour scheme.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryb.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a high-cut brief, contrasting panels down the outer thighs and knees, small marks on the front thighs, and contrasting straps with bands around the shins and ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner thighs, lower legs and centre of the hips; colour 1 on the brief edge and the outer thigh and knee panels; colour 3 on the small thigh marks; colour 2 on the shin straps and ankle bands.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryp.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with a slim contrasting waistband, chevron-shaped panels on the thighs and knees, and diamond-shaped panels over the calves with contrasting cuffs at the ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryp.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hips, upper legs and calf backgrounds; colour 2 on the waistband, outer thigh chevrons and ankle cuffs; colour 0 on the knee and lower thigh panels; colour 3 on the calf diamonds.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryr.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a high-cut hip and a thin waistband trim. Swooping curved side panels run down the thighs, a central panel covers the crotch and seat, and shaped panels wrap the calves.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh and leg fabric; colour 2 on the swooping side panels along the hips and thighs; colour 3 on the centre crotch and seat panel and the calf inserts; colour 1 on the waistband trim and lower calves.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryy.description: Form-fitting superhero tights with a low-rise waistband, chevron-shaped contrasting panels over the hips and thighs, and separate calf-length lower legs with trimmed tops and small diamond emblems at the knees.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs and upper legs; colour 1 on the waistband, hip chevron panels and the trim bands below the knees; colour 2 on the lower leg sections; colour 3 on the knee emblems.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Pharaoh.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a patchwork of colour-blocked panels: a hip band, thigh sections, and shaped calf and ankle panels with slim accent stripes down the shins. Sits at the hips and runs to the ankles, giving a sleek, tattoo-like look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_01_Pharaoh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, back of the buttocks, rear calf strips and ankles; colour 1 on the upper front thighs, knee and outer calf panels; colour 2 on the mid-thigh sections; colour 3 on the narrow shin stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_90s_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from the waist to the ankles, with quilted padded panels down the outer thighs and over the shins and knees, ribbed side panels, and a separate waistband panel with small emblem marks at the hip.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_90s_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main leggings and ribbed side panels; colour 0 on the quilted thigh and shin panels; colour 2 on the waistband panel; colour 3 on the hip emblem marks and thin seam piping.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Alien_01.description: Skin-tight, glossy leggings running from the low waist to the ankles, with layered panels down the thighs, rounded kneecap patches, and a segmented, chevron-shaped waistband with contrasting trim. Sleek, alien-flavoured superhero styling.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main leg fabric; colour 3 on the thigh side panels, knee patches and waistband chevrons; colour 2 on the inner thigh panels, lower calf panels and waistband centre; colour 0 on the top waistband edge.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Alien_Hybrid.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with segmented colour-blocked panels: a hip band, thick thigh sections, curved calf panels with narrow inset strips, and a swooping shape across the buttocks. They end at the ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Alien_Hybrid.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, rear and lower legs; colour 1 on the upper hip and calf panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow inset strips at the knees and calves.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings covered in a fish-scale mesh pattern, with slim swooping accent stripes down each front thigh and contrasting fin-like flares at the lower shins. Ends at the ankles; an aquatic superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the scale pattern of the leggings; colour 3 on the swooping thigh stripes; colour 2 on the flares at the lower shins.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a fish-scale mesh panel down the front and inner legs, edged by jagged zigzag borders, and smooth panels over the hips, back and outer legs. Sits at the hips and runs to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the smooth outer and rear panels; colour 0 and colour 1 on the scale-patterned front panel; colour 2 on the jagged edge outlines.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Archer_01.description: Tight, form-fitting pants made of separate panels: a hip band, front thighs, a contrasting mid-thigh band, a knee section with a raised side strip, and swooping curved seams down the back of the legs. Ends at the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, rear seat and lower calves; colour 1 on the upper thigh and shin panels; colour 2 on the mid-thigh bands; colour 3 on the raised knee strips.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings that run from the hips to the ankles, with large contrasting panels on the outer thighs, a small V-shaped panel at the front of the hips, and banded calf guards, all outlined in thin piping.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the outer thigh panels and lower calf bands; colour 1 on the upper calf panels and the hip V; colour 3 on the piping and outlines.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with large padded oval panels on the outer thighs and back of the thighs, fitted calf sleeves, a V-shaped front waist inset and thin piping outlines.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the thigh panel borders and calf sleeves; colour 2 on the thigh panel centres and the front waist inset; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: Close-fitting bird-person leggings covered in overlapping feather-scale texture over the hips and thighs, ending in ragged feathery fringes at the calves, with separate banded wraps on the lower legs.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the leggings and feathery cuffs; colour 3 on the banded lower-leg wraps.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The female version has scale-like feather texture across the hips and rear, and no separate waistband panel.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Child_Partial_01.description: A minimal partial leg piece: two small faceted panels with thin rimmed edges resting on the upper thighs at the hip line, plus thin rings at each ankle. Most of the leg stays uncovered.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Child_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and ankle bands; colour 2 on the faceted thigh panels.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Chimera_01.description: Tight, full-length furry leggings covered in layered shaggy tufts from hips to ankles, with ragged fur fringes at the calves and a separate banded cuff around one ankle. A beastly, monstrous look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur across both legs; colour 3 on the ankle cuff band on one leg.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Chimera_02.description: Tight, full-length monster leggings covered in layered, shaggy fur tufts with jagged pointed strands, shaggier around the knees and ankles. They sit from the hips to just above the feet, giving a feral beast look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur across the whole piece; the lower ankle tufts show slightly different fur tones, but no other slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Chimera_03.description: Tight, full-length shaggy fur trousers covered in layered tufted strands from hips to ankles, with ragged fur fringes at the shins and separate smooth cuffs around the ankles. A beastly, monstrous look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Chimera_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the legs; colour 3 on the ankle cuffs. Colours 1 and 2 are not visible.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.description: Skin-tight full-length tights that sit at the hips. The upper legs are one solid panel, and the lower legs are a contrasting panel with swirling tribal flame-like scrollwork climbing the shins and calves.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the thighs and upper legs; colour 0 on the lower-leg panel; colour 1 on the tribal scrollwork; colour 2 on the small curled marks near the ankles.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, with smooth stretchy thighs and streaky, brush-stroke panels flaring up the calves in a jagged edge. Suggests a sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main leggings; colour 0 and colour 2 on the streaky calf panels; colour 1 on small accents at the lower calves.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from waist to ankle. The upper legs are one smooth panel with jagged, flame-like edges at mid-shin, and the lower legs have a separate panel with branching web-like vein patterns.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper thigh panel; colour 0 on the lower leg panel; colour 2 on the branching webbing pattern on the shins and calves.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the hips to the ankles, with a plain waistband, a central crotch and rear panel, and thin angular circuit-like lines down each leg. Triple bands wrap each thigh. Suits a sleek superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings and waistband; colour 2 on the linework stripes; colour 1 on the triple thigh bands; colour 3 on the central front and rear panel.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Clockwork_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a high hip band and colour-blocked panels: a swooping front hip panel, separate thigh panels, calf inserts and lower shins. Sleek, sporty superhero styling with a small round patch on the rear.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Clockwork_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, rear patch, seat and lower shins; colour 1 on the hip and calf panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the calf inserts.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Color_Patch_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from waist to ankle, built from swooping colour-blocked panels that cut diagonally across the thighs, knees and calves. Smooth, glossy, athletic superhero styling.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Color_Patch_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hip and thigh panels; colour 0 on the lower-leg and inner-thigh panels; colour 3 on the waist-side, knee and calf accent patches; colour 2 on the hip-top and ankle patches.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a triple band of contrasting stripes above each knee and another triple band at each ankle. Smooth, plain, athletic look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 3 on the upper stripe of each band; colour 2 on the middle stripe; colour 1 on the lower stripe.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Corrupted_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-cut brief-style hip section: a contrasting front gusset panel, a separate waistband strip, and side and rear panels that sweep around the hips. They end at the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the legs; colour 1 on the front gusset and rear centre panel; colour 2 on the waistband strip; colour 3 on the rear side panels.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a low-slung hip band, diagonal strap lines across the hips, and multi-panelled legs: thigh blocks, knee-to-calf swooping panels with a narrow accent stripe, and short lower cuffs above the feet.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, seat, straps and lower shin panels; colour 1 on the front hips and the calf and back-leg panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow calf accent stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from hip to ankle with a glossy contrasting crotch and hip panel, contoured concentric-line patterns over the front thighs, and swirling contour lines down the outer legs and calves. A sleek cosmic superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy highlights of the hip and seat panels; colour 1 on the outer leg and calf swirl lines; colour 3 on the concentric front thigh patterns; colour 2 on the central hip panel and inner legs.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_02.description: Skin-tight glossy leggings running from the hips to the ankles, split into contrasting panels across the upper thighs and calves, with narrow inset stripes at the knees. A sleek, smooth superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main leg sections; colour 1 on the upper-thigh and calf panels; colour 3 on the narrow knee and calf inserts; colour 0 shows as sheen on the hips and rear.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_02.differs: The female version is smooth skin-tight tights with simple colour-blocked panels, without the raised armour plates on the thighs and shins that the male version has.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cryo_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from a low-slung brief-style waistband to the ankles, with long contrasting side panels down the outer legs outlined in contrasting piping, small knee patches and a separate brief-like panel at the hips and seat.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legs and inner thighs; colour 1 on the long outer leg panels; colour 2 on the piping, waistband edge and knee patches; colour 3 on the hip and seat brief panel.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: Tight full-length leggings with a sci-fi cyber-grid look: glossy, layered panels run down the thighs and shins, with a central hip panel and seams. They sit from the waist to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy thigh and hip panels; colour 1 on the side shin and thigh panels; colour 2 on the base leggings; colour 3 on small accent details near the knees and hips.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cybergrid_01.differs: The female version has a smoother, glossier finish with thinner, less distinct armour panels and no separate contrasting seat panel at the back.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: Asymmetric form-fitting cyberpunk leggings: one leg is a plain mesh-textured tight, the other is covered in segmented armored panels with ribbed knee and shin guards. Sits from the hips to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh-textured leg and the waistband; colour 1 on the armored leg panels and knee and shin plates; colour 2 on the joint inserts and seam lines; colour 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The female version has a plain mesh-textured hip panel with a smaller contrasting inset, while the male version has a contrasting front hip panel.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.description: Asymmetric cyberpunk tights: one leg is armored with segmented plates, a knee guard and a shin cuff, while the other leg is a bare, textured mesh-like stocking. A brief with contrasting trim sits at the hips.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip brief and the mesh-textured leg; colour 1 on the armor plates and the covered leg; colour 2 on the joint gaps and inset panels; colour 3 on the thin trim lines.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.differs: The female version is asymmetric: one leg is armored and the other is a bare mesh stocking, whereas the male version has armor on both legs.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_03.description: Form-fitting cyberpunk leggings with a low-cut brief-style hip band, armored plates running down both legs, segmented knee guards with vented detail and fitted ankle cuffs. Both legs carry matching armor.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band and textured brief panel; colour 1 on the armored leg plates and knee guards; colour 2 on the glute and inner-thigh panels; colour 3 not visible.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_03.differs: Both legs are fully covered in matching armored contrasting plating, while the male version armors only one leg and leaves the other as a plain textured panel.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: Skin-tight sci-fi leggings from hip to ankle, built from a smooth hip section and long swooping side panels, with segmented knee caps and small dot details. The lower legs have contrasting calf panels.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip section, inner thigh and knee bands; colour 1 on the outer thigh and shin panels; colour 2 on the knee caps and calf panels; colour 3 on the small dot details.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Defender_Update_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, built from colour-blocked panels: a high hip band, a front thigh block, calf panels with a narrow inset stripe, and a round patch on the seat.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, seat, back of the legs and ankles; colour 1 on the hips and lower legs; colour 2 on the thigh blocks; colour 3 on the inset calf stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Deity_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with a stitched fly-panel outline at the front and contrasting side and back panels running down the outer legs and seat.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front, inner leg and waistband areas; colour 1 on the side and rear leg panels; colour 2 on the seam outlines.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Draco_01.description: Form-fitting scale-textured tights covering the full leg, with short shorts-like hip panels edged in trim and pointed cuffs at the shins that flare into separate boot-style greave bands above the ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled leg material; colour 1 on the hip and shorts panels; colour 2 on the trim lines and edging; colour 3 on the lower shin bands.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Firebird_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a V-shaped waistband, a small contrasting front panel, and contrasting jagged flame-like panels down the thighs edged with curved contrasting stripes.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main leggings and lower legs; colour 0 on the jagged thigh panels; colour 3 on the waistband and curved thigh stripes; colour 2 on the front crotch panel.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Fish_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-cut waistband and a chevron at the front hip. Curved swooping stripe bands wrap the lower legs, with smooth panels over the thighs and seat, edged in thin contrasting piping.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Fish_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the smooth thigh, seat and knee panels; colour 0 on the waist chevron and the light stripe bands; colour 1 on the swooping stripe bands; colour 3 on the thin piping outlines.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Foxtech_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights with a low-cut brief top, segmented armored thigh plates down the outer legs, contrasting side panels, and shin guards with pointed trim. They run from the hips to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Foxtech_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the brief, the knee and shin accents and the lower-leg trim; colour 1 on the inner leg panels and waistband trim; colour 0 on the outer thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the armored thigh and shin plates.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Gamer_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-cut hip line, circuit-like patterned panels across the hips and groin, thin traced lines running down each leg, and thin contrasting bands at the waist and ankles. Sporty sci-fi gamer look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the circuit panels at the hips and groin; colour 2 on the lines down the legs; colour 3 on the waist and ankle bands.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: Form-fitting textured tights from waist to mid-calf, with angular outlined panels running down the outer thighs to the knees and segmented, ribbed shin guards below. A superhero-gladiator look with a contrasting waistband edge.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main textured tights; colour 0 on the angular thigh and knee panels; colour 3 on the lower shin guards; colour 2 on the waist edge and panel outlines.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Glow_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from waist to ankle with bordered, angular panel lines down the thigh, knee and calf, a small triangular panel at the crotch, and oval spots at the knees. Sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the bordered stripe panels and crotch panel; colour 2 on the slim stripes and oval spots; colour 3 on the thin outlines around the panels.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Glow_01.differs: The female version has no round spots at the hips beside the crotch panel, which the male version has.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Gravitar_01.description: A minimal, high-cut brief with thin side straps and small buckle tabs at the hips, a snug front panel and a cheeky rear. Sits low on the hips with bare legs, giving a revealing, sleek swimwear look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Gravitar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main brief fabric; colour 2 on the small buckle tabs at the hips.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, built from colour-blocked panels: a wide hip band, thigh and knee sections, contrasting inset stripes at the calves, and a round spot on each buttock.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, back seat with its round spot, and lower legs; colour 1 on the upper front thighs, calf sides and back swoops; colour 2 on the thigh blocks; colour 3 on the calf stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Hoses_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a textured hexagon scale pattern running from the hips to the ankles, a brief-style hip section with a contrasting waistband and front panel, thin edge piping, and a column of small oval studs on each outer thigh.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the legs; colour 1 on the waistband and back panel; colour 2 on the front crotch panel; colour 3 on the edge piping and thigh studs.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Hoses_01.differs: The female version has a rounded, brief-cut hip section and piping only around the hips, with no long seam lines down the legs.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Jeweled_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a textured, studded-looking surface and large swooping panels down the thighs and shins, each edged with a beaded jewelled outline. Sits at the hips and runs to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Jeweled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main textured leg surface; colour 3 on the large swooping thigh and shin panels; colour 1 on the jewelled edging around those panels.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Jumpsuit_01.description: Loose, baggy trousers with a low waist and soft wrinkled folds through the thighs and knees. The legs are straight and the hems bunch up in slouchy folds over the feet. A casual, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Jumpsuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole leg garment; colour 1 gives a slight tint in the folds; the hem cuffs are lighter, also colour 0.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Junkbot_01.description: Mechanical junkyard-robot leg piece: an exposed cluster of hoses and joints at the hips, with skeletal piston legs, panelled thigh and shin casings, and rounded knee joints. Sits from the hips down to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plates, knee joints and outer leg casings; colour 1 on the thigh and shin panels; colour 3 on the accent bands and the hip core; colour 2 on the hoses and inner joints.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Junkbot_02.description: Robotic exoskeleton legs and hips built from exposed mechanical struts, pistons and cables, with rounded knee joints and ankle cuffs. Slim segmented limbs and a looping hip frame give a scrap-built cyborg look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame, knee joints and hip struts; colour 1 on the leg panels and hip plates; colour 3 on the small accents between the leg pistons and hip core; colour 2 on the inner cables and gaps.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kaiju_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a brief-style hip panel, jagged-edged segmented armor plates down the front and back of each thigh, small knee pads behind the knees, and pointed flame-like panels on the calves and ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip brief panel; colour 1 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the segmented thigh plates and knee pads; colour 3 on the waist notch, calf panels and ankle points.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kaiju_01.differs: The female version has raised, ridged segmented plates running down the front of the thighs, while the male thigh panels are smoother and flatter.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_01.description: A bare-skin leg base with a low-cut, brief-style bottom at the hips and a thin contrasting edge. The bare legs run down to the ankles; it is a minimal base layer for building a skirt or shorts look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brief panel; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the leg openings; skin tone on the legs and waistband is unaffected by the scheme.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_02.description: Plain, skin-tight leggings that cover the hips and both legs down to the ankles, with a smooth seamless finish and no added details. Designed as an under-layer to sit beneath a medium-length skirt.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_Ascendant_.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from hip to ankle, with contrasting side panels along the thighs and back, a small V-shaped front panel at the waist, and banded lower-leg panels with thin piped edges.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the thigh side panels, back panels and lower calf panels; colour 1 on the upper calf bands and the front waist panel; colour 3 on the thin piping along panel edges.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_Ascendant_.description: Form-fitting superhero tights covering the hips and full legs to the ankles, with large inset panels on the thighs and buttocks, shaped calf panels, and thin piping outlining each section. The low waistband has a small contrasting front trim.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tights and waistband; colour 1 on the borders around the thigh panels and on the calf panels; colour 2 on the thigh and hip inset panels; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_Retroscifi.description: Close-fitting retro sci-fi trousers running from the hips to the ankles, with diagonal stripe panels down each thigh, a short seam line at the front waist, and banded wraps below each knee and at the ankle cuffs.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_Retroscifi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trouser fabric; colour 3 on the diagonal thigh stripes, front seam and ankle bands; colour 1 on the knee bands.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Krampus_01.description: Tight monster-style leggings with a high waist, colour-blocked thigh panels and shins. Ragged torn edges and cut-out gaps expose the knees, and the legs end in fitted cuffs above the feet.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, rear panel, and lower shins; colour 1 on the upper thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the mid-thigh panels.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Krampus_02.description: Tight, full-length leggings with a wide waistband, segmented panels over the thighs and calves, a slim contrasting stripe along the shin, and a small round patch on each buttock. Ends at the ankles, with a monstrous-costume feel.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Krampus_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, buttocks, back of the legs and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the hips, upper thighs and calves; colour 2 on the mid-thigh panels; colour 3 on the shin stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Leathersuit.description: Skin-tight leggings from hips to just below the knee, built from swooping colour-blocked panels: a hip yoke, diagonal thigh sections, and diamond-shaped knee patches behind the knee. A sporty superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Leathersuit.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band; colour 1 on the outer thigh and lower calf panels; colour 2 on the inner and rear thigh panels; colour 3 on the diamond knee patches.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_65_Dragon_01.description: Form-fitting scaled leggings with a layered plated panel across the hips and groin, segmented contrasting panels down the back of the thighs, and armored shin and knee sections. A monstrous, dragon-like look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_65_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaled leg surface; colour 0 on the overlapping hip and groin plates; colour 2 on the segmented back-thigh panels; colour 1 on the knee and shin guards and lower-leg side stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.description: Form-fitting textured tights with a high-cut brief at the hips, diagonal segmented straps across each thigh, and angular shin guards with a pointed cuff at the back of each calf. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brief; colour 0 on the textured leg fabric; colour 2 on the thigh straps; colour 3 on the shin guards and calf cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with swooping curved side panels on the thighs, chevron-shaped trim bands above the knees and separate contrasting lower-leg sections with angular inset panels.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh and hip fabric; colour 2 on the swooping thigh panels, waist edge and shin inset panels; colour 1 on the lower legs; colour 3 on the chevron bands and thin outlines.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.description: Loose straight-cut trousers with a flared leg that reaches the ankle, a banded waist with a hanging drawcord tie at the front, and swirling decorative panels running down the outer sides of each leg.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trouser fabric; colour 1 on the swirling side panels and the drawcord; colour 2 on the waistband and inner edging.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Longskirt_01.description: A bare skin-look base layer for the legs and hips: bare legs from the hips to the ankles with a low-cut brief at the top. Meant to sit under a long skirt, it adds no skirt of its own.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Longskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brief; colour 1 on the thin edge trim of the brief; the leg skin does not take a scheme colour.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Longskirt_02.description: Plain skin-tight leggings running from the hips to the ankles, following the leg contours with no seams or trim. Designed as a base layer under a long skirt.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Longskirt_03.description: Two bare lower-leg sections with no fabric: short tube-like shapes covering the calves from below the knee to just above the ankle. They read as exposed skin beneath cropped tights, so the piece adds no clothing of its own.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Longskirt_03.colourAreas: The piece shows skin tone and takes no colour slot from the scheme; the cropped leggings and boots are the mannequin's own.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Longskirt_Retroscifi.description: Tight retro sci-fi jumpsuit legs that run from the hips to the ankles, with diagonal stripes down the thighs, banded wraps below the knees and at the ankles, and a short centre seam at the front.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Longskirt_Retroscifi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 3 on the thigh stripes, front seam and ankle bands; colour 1 on the bands below the knees.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Firebird_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a low-cut waistband, jagged flame-like panels running down the outer thighs, curved contrasting stripes across each thigh, and a small centre panel at the front; they end at the ankles.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Firebird_02.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low waistband and a centre front panel. Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Fish_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with swooping fin-like stripe bands running diagonally down the shins and outer thighs, a glossy panel over the thighs and rear, and thin contrasting outlines. Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Foxtech_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a brief-style hip section, layered armored plates down the outer thighs and shins, a contrasting inner-leg panel, and segmented knee and calf guards. Sleek, beast-tech superhero styling.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Foxtech_02.description: Form-fitting full-length leggings with a brief hip section, segmented armored thigh and shin plates, a central stripe down each leg and layered knee guards. Sleek, sporty superhero-tech look with a monstrous edge.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Gamer_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the hips to the ankles, with a thin waistband trim and ankle trim. Branching circuit-like lines run down the legs, and a web of vein-like patterns covers the groin and hip area. Gamer sci-fi look.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Gamer_02.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-cut hip and a thin waistband, decorated with angular circuit-like lines running down the outer legs and ornate filigree panels across the hips. Thin cuffs sit at the ankles.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Gladiator_01.description: Tight full-length leggings with a textured, scale-like pattern, outlined armor-style panels running down the outer thighs to the knees, and separate segmented greave-like shin guards that end above the ankles.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Gladiator_02.description: Form-fitting textured tights running from the waist to the lower shin, with angular armored panels along the outer thighs and knees and segmented plated shin guards below. The look is sleek, sci-fi and monstrous.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Glow_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from hip to ankle, with bordered stripe panels running down each leg, round patches at the knees and angled bands around the shins. Suggests a sleek, glowing creature-themed bodysuit.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Glow_02.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-rise waist, patterned with bold outlined stripe panels running down the thighs and calves, oval patches at the knees and a small triangular panel at the crotch; a creature-like, glowing-suit look.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Monster_Jeweled_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a rough, pebbled, fur-like texture and swooping contrasting panels down the thighs and shins, edged with a row of small studs or gems. They sit at the hips and end at the ankles.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with segmented armored plates over the hips, thighs, and shins, plus a plated front panel at the crotch. Ribbed stretch fabric shows between the plates, giving a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large thigh, hip and shin plates; colour 1 on the stretch leggings fabric and the waistband; colour 2 on the inset panels and shin chevrons; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_None_01.description: A minimal placeholder hip piece: a small flat oval patch sitting at the pelvis just below the waist, with no skirt or shorts shape. It adds almost nothing to the silhouette.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Partial_01.description: Robotic leg piece with short, loose brief-like shorts over the hips and exposed mechanical legs below, with segmented armored plates, ringed knee joints, and cylindrical inner actuators running down to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts, knee rings and outer leg plates; colour 1 on the cylindrical leg actuators; colour 3 on small accents on the actuators; colour 2 on the inner joints and cabling.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Partial_02.description: Cybernetic leg piece: short brief-style shorts at the hips with a rolled edge, over exposed robotic legs of segmented metal plates, ribbed tube-like actuators and chunky knee joints, ending above the feet.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal leg plates, knee joints and the shorts' inner panel and rim; colour 1 on the leg actuator tubes; colour 3 on small accents and the trim line; the outer shorts take skin-like tone rather than the scheme.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Partial_02.differs: The female version has a short, cut-away brief with an orange-toned outer layer and a separate inner panel, rather than the tall boxy contrasting waistband of the male version.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Patternseta_Bolt_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-cut brief-style waistband, a jagged zigzag border across the thighs and a crackling bolt pattern down the shins. They end at the ankles, in a superhero style.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Patternseta_Bolt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper thighs and hips; colour 1 on the waistband and lower legs; colour 3 on the thin zigzag border lines; colour 2 on the bolt markings.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Patternseta_Fire_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low waistband bearing a flame-shaped contrasting emblem at the front, and jagged flame tongues rising from a solid contrasting band around each lower calf, ending above the feet.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Patternseta_Fire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legs; colour 2 on the flame emblem at the waistband; colour 3 on the lower calf bands; colour 1 on the flame edge accents at the calves.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Phantom_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings reaching the lower calf, with a high-cut hip brief, glossy panels over the hips and buttocks, contrasting trim curving around them, a small front triangle, and a separate lower-leg section.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front thighs and knee panels; colour 1 on the back thighs and the trim around the hip panels; colour 2 on the glossy hip and buttock panels; colour 3 on the front triangle and lower calves.
