Female/F_Hips_Tight_Phantom_02.description: Form-fitting superhero tights from the waist to the ankles, with outlined chevron-shaped panels down the outer thighs and calves, and contrasting angled cuffs with a thin contrasting band at the lower legs.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Phantom_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 3 on the outlined thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the lower leg cuffs; colour 1 on the thin bands at the cuff tops.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Phantom_03.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a high-cut brief at the hips, lightning-like jagged panels running down the outer thighs, and jagged zigzag-topped boot-like calf sections. Sits from waist to ankle in a sleek, form-fitting way.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Phantom_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the brief and the jagged thigh panels; colour 3 on the calf sections.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Power_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with fine horizontal banded ribbing across the hips and thighs, a slim waistband and a plain cuff at each ankle. Sits at the natural waist with a sleek, sporty look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed banding over the leggings; colour 2 on the base fabric and lower thigh sections; colour 1 on the waistband and ankle cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Pumpkin_01.description: Skin-tight full-length tights that hug the hips and legs down to the ankles, with a shallow V-shaped waistband at the front and faint vein-like or muscle-like markings running down the legs.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the tights; colour 1 on the faint vein-like markings down the legs; colour 2 on the waistband edge.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Punk_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, with contrasting side panels that flare into pointed shapes at the hip, knee and calf. A sleek, sporty superhero look with no other detailing.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and back centre of the legs and the seat; colour 1 on the side panels and lower calves.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Radical_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, with a contrasting stripe running down the outside of each leg from hip to ankle. Smooth, plain, sporty superhero styling.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Radical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the stripe down one outer leg; colour 2 on the stripe down the other outer leg.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Ravenswood.description: Tight full-length leggings with a fitted hip section, a pointed hem at the shin, and glossy lower legs in a separate material. Thin angular piping lines trace the thighs and calves, giving a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Ravenswood.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs and hips; colour 2 on the glossy lower legs; colour 3 on the thin piping lines along the thighs and calves.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Reactor_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from a low-cut brief waistband to the ankles, with glossy thigh panels, ribbed lower-thigh sections, knee patches, thin banding straps and small ankle cuffs. A V-shaped emblem sits at the front of the waist.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip, upper thigh and lower shin panels; colour 1 on the ribbed thigh and calf sections; colour 2 on the waistband, banding lines and ankle cuffs; colour 3 on the front waist emblem, knee patches and ankle accents.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The female version has a low-cut, thong-like back with a thin waistband, and the shins are slimmer and more tapered.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.description: Retro superhero tights with a snug waist and hips, running down the legs to just below the knee, with round contrasting patches on the hips and banded knee wraps. The lower shin looks like a separate boot or legging.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main tights; colour 3 on the hip patches and knee bands; colour 0 on the lower leg sections below the knees.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The female version is fitted more closely to the legs, while the male tights are baggier around the thighs and knees.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.description: Skin-tight retro superhero leggings with a wide contrasting waistband, thin piping outlining rectangular panels on the thighs and back, and contrasting seam lines and bands at the knees and ankles. They end at the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the legs; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 3 on the thigh and hip piping; colour 2 on the knee and ankle bands and the calf seams.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit_.description: Retro sci-fi jumpsuit legs: snug full-length trousers with a crinkled, worn-looking fabric, diagonal stripes down each thigh, banded straps just below the knees and thin cuffs at the ankles. Sits from the waist to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trouser fabric; colour 3 on the diagonal thigh stripes, centre front seam line and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the knee bands.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.description: Skin-tight retro superhero leggings reaching the ankles, built from colour-blocked panels: a band at the hips, a front-centre panel, thighs, swooping calf sections and a small round patch on each buttock, with narrow inset stripes at the knees.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waist band, seat, lower legs and back-of-leg panels; colour 1 on the front hip panel and calf and outer-leg swoops; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow knee and calf inset stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Robotexo_Legboth_03.description: Robotic exoskeleton legs with smooth short-shorts at the hips, exposed mechanical thighs and calves with bundled cable and piston details, armoured knee joints and slim segmented lower legs ending at the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Robotexo_Legboth_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip shorts, knee joints and outer leg plating; colour 1 on the inner leg cables and piston sleeves; colour 3 on small accents between the cable bundles; colour 2 on the joint gaps.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Robotexo_None_01.description: Robotic exoskeleton legs: segmented mechanical limbs with plated hip guards, bulky knee joints and exposed internal tubing along the thighs and calves, worn from the hips down to the feet in a sci-fi cyborg style.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Robotexo_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor plates and joint casings; colour 1 on the inner leg mechanisms and panels; colour 3 on small accents at the hips and joints; colour 2 on the deepest recesses between parts.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.description: Skin-tight leggings with a hip band and angular colour-blocked panels running diagonally down the thighs and calves, with diamond-shaped panels behind the knees. They end mid-calf, above the ankles, for a sleek superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band; colour 1 on the outer thigh and lower calf panels; colour 2 on the inner thigh, seat and knee panels; colour 3 on the diamond patches behind the knees.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_01.description: Form-fitting paneled tights from the hips to the ankles, with ribbed segments over the upper thighs and knees, a V-shaped front crotch panel, swooping diagonal piping across the thighs, and banded cuffs at the calves and ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the ribbed thigh, knee and ankle segments; colour 1 on the front crotch panel; colour 3 on the diagonal piping and the bands below the knees.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_02.description: Form-fitting full-length tights with a low-cut brief-style hip section, banded contrasting knee panels with thin contrasting piping, and narrow trim rings at the ankles. A sleek superhero legwear piece.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg tights and hip edge; colour 1 on the brief-style hip section; colour 2 on the banded knee panels; colour 3 on the piping at the knees and ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_02.differs: The female hip section is cut as a shorter, low-rise brief with a plain front, while the male version has a Y-shaped panel on the front.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scaled_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from the hips to the ankles, with a V-shaped front panel at the waist, diagonal bands down the thighs, contrasting knee patches, thin outlined panel lines and bands at the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scaled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the waist panel, thigh bands and ankle bands; colour 2 on the knee patches; colour 3 on the thin outline seams and the waist edge.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scarab_01.description: Form-fitting superhero leggings with padded, quilted panels over the hips and thighs, contrasting side and knee panels, small accent tabs at the back hips, and contrasting cuffs at the ankles. Sits from the waist to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front thigh and hip panels and the back calves; colour 1 on the lower front legs and the waist tab; colour 2 on the side panels, knee pads and ankle cuffs; colour 3 on the small back hip tabs.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scarab_01.differs: The back is mostly light panelling with contrasting side panels, while the male version has a mostly contrasting rear and seat.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scarab_02.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a glossy panelled hip section, angled contrasting front thigh panels, contrasting knee caps, ankle cuffs and contrasting geometric glyph markings down the outer and rear legs.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip panels and lower front shins; colour 1 on the rear legs, side strips and ankle cuffs; colour 2 on the front thigh panels; colour 3 on the glyph markings and the hip trim.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scarab_02.differs: The front thigh panels and glyph markings are arranged slightly differently, with the glyphs sitting mostly on the rear and outer legs and no separate calf glyph.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: Skin-tight sci-fi soldier leggings running from the hips to the ankles, built from colour-blocked panels: a hip band, a front thigh panel, knee panels with narrow inset strips, and swooping calf panels. Sleek, athletic and form-fitting.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, rear seat and lower calves; colour 1 on the upper front thighs and the swooping calf panels; colour 2 on the knee-to-thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow inset strips at the shins.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Skirtlongcap_01.description: A plain, long straight skirt with a slightly tapered, form-fitting cut from the waist over the hips, falling to about the ankles. Soft cloth with gentle wrinkles and no visible seams or fastenings.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Skirtlongcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A bulky, rounded snow-mound skirt shaped like a stacked snowman base. It starts at the waist, swells into a wide cone with lumpy tiers, and reaches the ankles, hiding both legs entirely. Whimsical holiday costume.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main snowy body of the skirt; colour 1 on the mottled speckled patches scattered across the surface.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The female mound is a narrower cone with a smoother, less lumpy surface and slightly less pronounced tiers.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Space_01.description: Form-fitting sci-fi leggings with a low V-shaped waistband, hexagonal panels on the thighs and calves, glowing-style line trim tracing curves down the legs, and segmented shin plating; they run the full leg to the ankle.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer thigh and shin panels; colour 2 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the curved line trim and shin outlines; colour 3 on the waistband, hexagon panels and knee bands.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: Form-fitting sci-fi leggings with a paneled, colour-blocked design: a contrasting waistband and rear patch, thigh panels, and shin panels with a narrow vertical stripe at each knee. The legs end just above the ankles, and the lower calves stay tight.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, rear patch and lower legs; colour 1 on the hip and calf panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the vertical knee stripes.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.differs: The female version has slightly more fitted lower legs and a smaller, tighter knee stripe.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Spinal_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from waist to ankle with printed circuit-like line patterns, chevron ribs down the thighs, a spine-like chevron trail down the back of the legs and a decorative emblem on the rear.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Spinal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the back panel, side panels and chevron dashes; colour 3 on the outer piping lines and the rear emblem; colour 2 on the rib chevrons at the front and back of the thighs.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Spooky_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a spotted animal-like pattern, feathery ribbed texture along the thighs and jagged contrasting panels at the hips and inner thighs. They run from the waist down to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric and ribbed texture; colour 1 on the jagged panels at the hips and inner thighs; colour 2 on the spots.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Starhawk_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights with solid outer-leg panels edged in contrasting trim, jagged zigzag borders, and a mesh-textured inner leg and rear panel. A high-cut brief at the hips, the legs run to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the solid outer panels and brief; colour 2 on the trim outlines; colour 0 on the fishnet mesh inserts.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Starhawk_01.differs: The female version has solid panels that run down over the knees and shins, with mesh only in narrow zigzag bands along the inner thigh and rear.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Starowl_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, printed with constellation patterns of star shapes joined by thin lines, and finished with narrow contrasting bands at the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 3 on the star shapes; colour 2 on the constellation lines and the ankle bands.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings covering the hips down to the ankles, patterned all over with scattered star shapes. A plain smooth waistband sits at the hips. A classic superhero or sporty look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric of the leggings; colour 1 on the stars on the front; colour 2 on the stars on the back and sides.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_02.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with a large star on the seat and smaller stars over each knee. A smooth, sleek, form-fitting cut.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the star appliqués at the seat and knees.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_02.differs: The female version has one star on the seat and two on the knees, with no stars on the hips.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_03.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings reaching the ankles, with a high-cut brief-style hip section patterned with small stars. The star section sits at the hips and rear, and the legs below are plain and smooth.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the star-patterned hip section background; colour 3 on the stars; colour 1 on the leggings legs.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_03.differs: The female version has a high-cut, brief-shaped star section that stops at the hips, while the male version has a longer, shorts-like star section reaching the upper thigh.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_04.description: Skin-tight leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with a contrasting waistband and a side stripe down each outer leg that ends in a small star point at the ankle. A sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the stripe edging and waistband; colour 2 on the centre of the side stripe and the top waist edge.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_05.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings that run from the hips to the ankles, with a small angular contrasting panel with a jagged edge on one side of the hip that wraps toward the lower back. A plain, sleek superhero base layer.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legging body; colour 1 on the asymmetric hip panel; colours 2 and 3 not visible.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_06.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with a wide starred stripe down each outer side seam. A superhero look with a sporty, retro feel.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 3 on the side stripes; colour 1 on the stars; colour 2 on the thin edge piping beside the stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_07.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a star-patterned upper section at the hips and thighs, ending in a jagged zigzag edge above plain lower legs that run down to the ankles. A patriotic superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hip and thigh section; colour 3 on the star patterns; colour 1 on the lower legs; colour 2 on the thin outline along the zigzag edge.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_08.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with short shorts-like upper thighs and a star-patterned lower section running to the ankles, split by a jagged contrasting seam across each thigh. Sits at the hips and covers the full legs.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_08.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shorts section; colour 2 on the seam lines across the thighs; colour 0 on the lower leg base; colour 3 on the star pattern.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_08.differs: The seam line across the thighs is a thinner, shallower step on the female version, while the male version has a more angular, stepped seam.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_09.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a wide star-patterned panel running down the centre of the front and back of each leg, bordered by thin edging, and plain side panels. Sits at the hips and reaches the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_09.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer side panels of the legs; the centre panels carry a star pattern with colour 0 as the base and colour 3 for the stars; colour 2 on the thin edging.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_09.differs: The star panel stops at the knee at the front and is a narrower strip, leaving more of the side panel visible.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_10.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings split down the centre into two halves: one plain leg and one leg covered in a scattered star pattern. They sit at the hips and end at the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plain leg half; colour 0 as the base of the star-patterned leg; colour 3 on the stars.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Stars_10.differs: The split between the plain and star halves is a smooth straight line, and the stars are smaller and more evenly scattered.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Swan_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings that run from the waist to the ankles, with large side panels over the hips and outer thighs edged in contrasting trim and marked with stacked chevron stripes. A sleek superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legs; colour 1 on the hip and thigh side panels; colour 2 on the panel edging; colour 3 on the chevron stripes.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Tactical_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the hips to the ankles, with contrasting panels along the outer thighs and calves, small angular marks at the front of the hips, and thin bands at the ankles. A sleek tactical superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the thigh and calf panels; colour 3 on the small hip markings; colour 2 on the ankle bands.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Toy_01.description: Close-fitting full-length pants with a low waistband, smooth sleek legs and narrow ankle hems. A thin contrasting stripe runs down each outer leg and zigzags into a diamond with small triangular accents, giving a retro look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pants and waistband; colour 1 on the zigzag side stripes; colour 2 on the triangle accents; colour 3 on the triangle accents.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Traveler_01.description: Close-fitting full-length tights that run from the waist to the ankles, with a narrow contrasting waistband and thin ankle cuffs. The fabric is smooth with soft wrinkles, and the lower legs fade into a second shade.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper legs and hips; colour 1 fading in over the lower legs and ankles; colour 2 on the waistband and ankle cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Tucked_01.description: Skin-tight plain trousers that run from the hips to the ankles, with a smooth fit and a slight bulge at the knees where the legs would be tucked into boots. A casual, sleek, superhero-friendly base layer.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Tucked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole trouser surface; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Urban_Anime_Leggings.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with colour-blocked panels: a hip band, thigh sections, and swooping calf panels. Cutouts on the inner shins show bare skin, and the legs end in fitted ankle cuffs. Sporty anime street look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Urban_Anime_Leggings.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, seat patch, outer lower legs and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the upper thigh and calf swoops; colour 2 on the mid-thigh panels. The inner shin cutouts show the mannequin's skin, not the piece.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valdia_01.description: Form-fitting superhero leggings with sleek outlined panel lines running down the thighs and hips, angular knee guards, a lower-shin section in a separate colour, and a cuffed ankle band. A slim waistband with a V-shaped notch sits at the hips.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valdia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs and upper legs; colour 1 on the lower legs; colour 2 on the panel outlines, waistband and ankle cuffs; colour 3 on the knee patches and waistband accent.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valelectric_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights from waist to ankle, with a notched contrasting waistband, contrasting outer-thigh panels, curved striped lines across the front thighs, and contrasting angular shin guards with pointed knee accents.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valelectric_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main legs, hips and lower calves; colour 0 on the outer thigh and side panels; colour 3 on the thigh stripes and shin panels; colour 2 on the waistband and panel edging.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valerian_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with thin branching vein-like lines across the legs and slashed claw-mark gashes on the outer thighs. Suggests a monstrous, wounded superhero look.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the thin vein-like lines; colour 3 on the claw-slash marks on the thighs.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valflare_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from a low hip line to the ankles, with swooping flame-like panels down each leg, a triangular front crotch panel, a scalloped back waistband, and contrasting cuffs at the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valflare_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer thigh panels and back of the hips; colour 1 on the main leg fabric and waistband scallops; colour 2 on the swooping outline trim; colour 3 on the front crotch panel and ankle cuffs.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valhex_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights from waist to ankle, with large oval panels down the front and back of each thigh outlined in contrasting piping, a chevron at the waist, hexagonal knee pieces and separate calf panels.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valhex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer legs and waist; colour 1 on the thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the piping, knee hexagons and panel edges; colour 3 on the small waist accent.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valstar_01.description: Form-fitting superhero leggings with a low-cut brief-style front, segmented scaled armor-plate panels running down the outer thighs, shaped kneecap plates and shin guards over the lower legs; reaches the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main leg fabric and buttock area; colour 0 on the front brief panel, lower calves and waist trim; colour 3 on the outer thigh plates, knee plates and shin guards; colour 2 on the edging around the plates.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valvee_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with angular outlined panels on the hips and thighs, chevron stripes above the knees, rounded knee patches and contrasting shin guards down the calves.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Valvee_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the waistband, hip panels and chevron stripes; colour 2 on the outlines and shin panels; colour 3 on the knee patches and the front waist accent.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with large side panels down the thighs, a central strip at the crotch and chevron-shaped bands across the knees. The lower legs form a separate section.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer thigh and rear panels; colour 0 on the inner thigh and lower leg sections; colour 2 on the central crotch strip; colour 3 on the knee chevrons.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Vigilante_01.differs: The female tights have narrower knee chevrons with a smaller contrasting edge line, and the crotch strip is slimmer.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Warrior_01.description: Form-fitting quilted tights with a diamond-stitched texture running from a contrasting waistband to the ankles, ending in angular segmented shin guards with glowing-line trim and a contrasting cuff at the base.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted leg fabric; colour 1 on the waistband and ankle cuffs; colour 2 on the shin guard plates; colour 3 on the trim lines of the shin guards.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01.description: Bare-skin leg piece with underwear-style briefs and ragged, torn-flesh patches on the thighs and knees, showing exposed bone-like strips; a decayed undead look for horror or monster characters.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the briefs; skin tone on the legs is fixed; colour 1 on the torn wound patches and their edges; colour 3 on the strips inside the wounds.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01.differs: The female version has softer, more blended wound patches with a contrasting bone-like streak, while the male has sharper, darker-edged tears.

Female/F_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01_Tights.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with an attached low-cut brief waistband, printed with ragged torn patches, stains and exposed-wound blotches on the thighs and shins. A tattered, zombie-like look that fits close to the legs down to the ankles.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01_Tights.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brief waistband; colour 0 on the leg fabric; colour 2 on the wound and grime patches; colour 3 on the blotchy stain spots.
Female/F_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01_Tights.differs: The female version has a plain waistband, with no back panel and no visible yellow patch on the thigh.

Female/F_Hips_Toxicsteel_01.description: Robotic leg piece: a rounded, armoured hip shell with a ruffled upper rim, plus exposed mechanical legs made of slim external struts, cable-like piston columns and bulky knee and ankle joints. Reads as sci-fi cyborg.
Female/F_Hips_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hip shell and its ruffled rim; colour 0 on the outer struts, knee and ankle joints and hip braces; colour 1 on the piston columns down the legs; colour 2 on the inner mechanical gaps.
Female/F_Hips_Toxicsteel_01.differs: The hip shell is a shorter, more brief cut that leaves the buttocks curve exposed at the back, and the leg struts are slimmer.

Female/F_Hips_Toxicsteel_02.description: A robotic exoskeleton leg piece: short rounded hip shorts with a ruffled, ridged waistband, and exposed mechanical legs made of jointed struts, tubes and bulky knee and ankle joints, built as a partial cyborg look.
Female/F_Hips_Toxicsteel_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hip shorts and waistband; colour 0 on the outer struts, knee joints and ankle joints; colour 1 on the tubes and inner leg panels; colour 2 on small joint gaps.

Female/F_Hips_Trousers_Victorian_01.description: Skin-tight full-length trousers built from stacked colour-blocked panels: a high waistband and hip section, thigh panels, a calf section with a slim contrasting stripe, and lower shins, ending at the ankles. Sleek superhero styling.
Female/F_Hips_Trousers_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, hips, seat and lower legs; colour 1 on the upper front thighs and calves; colour 2 on the mid thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow calf stripes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Alien_01.description: A curved armor shell worn on the outer left hip and thigh, made of stacked chevron plates that taper to a jagged lower edge, with contrasting-tipped spikes along the top and sides and small studs. Alien, monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate; colour 2 on the middle band and studs; colour 1 on the lower jagged plate; colour 3 on the spikes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Arcane_01.description: A short, hexagonal band wrapped around the upper left thigh, with raised swirling scroll patterns across its surface and a large round dome-shaped gem at the front of the outer side. The open top edge is flat.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band base; colour 3 on the raised swirl patterns; colour 1 on the round gem; colour 2 on the top opening.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Armored_01.description: A curved armored thigh guard worn on the outer left thigh, open at the top like a cup, with a raised angular panel and stepped layered edges. Suggests a sci-fi or superhero armor look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and outer rim; colour 1 on the raised panel frame; colour 2 on the inset centre of the panel; colour 3 on the thin inner border layer.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Astronaut_01.description: A curved flexible hose hanging at the left hip: ribbed segmented tubing leads to a smooth fabric-wrapped section, with a capped connector fitting on each end. Reads as an astronaut life-support line, sci-fi and mechanical.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the connector tips; colour 2 on the ribbed tubing and connector collars; colour 0 and colour 1 blend along the fabric-wrapped hose section.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Astronaut_02.description: A flexible hose attached at the left hip, hanging down the outer thigh in a U-shaped curve. It has ribbed tubing, a wrapped cloth-like middle section and a capped nozzle at each end. Suggests a sci-fi astronaut life-support line.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the nozzle tips; colour 2 on the ribbed tubing and end collars; colour 0 and colour 1 blend along the wrapped middle section.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Birdpeople_01.description: A rigid, open-sided thigh guard wrapping the back and outer left thigh, with a faceted hollow shell, a cut-out window on the front and a small strap tab with contrasting fasteners near the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole guard shell; colour 2 on the small fasteners at the lower strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_01.description: A curved, tapering hip guard worn on the left outer thigh: a shell-like frame with a translucent inner panel, angular flared top edge and a round mechanical pod with a lens on the hip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell frame; colour 0 on the inner panel; colour 2 on the pod housing; colour 3 on the pod lens.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_02.description: A long angular blade-like armor shard hanging from the left hip along the outer thigh, tapering to a sharp point near the knee, with faceted planes and small rivet studs near the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted upper plates and lower edge; colour 1 on the top outer facet; colour 2 on the darker side panels; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Bounty_01.description: A curved armoured thigh guard wrapping the outer left upper leg, with a thick bevelled frame, a triangular inset panel on the front, two horizontal ribs across the back and a strap around the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and ribs; colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the triangular inset; colour 3 on the strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Bounty_02.description: A curved thigh guard on the left upper leg: a wrapped shell with a thick angular frame around a window-like panel and a narrow inset strip, held by an elastic strap around the thigh. Suggests a sci-fi bounty hunter look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the frame and back shell; colour 0 on the large curved panel; colour 1 on the narrow inset strip; colour 3 on the thigh strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Brutal_01.description: A hip-mounted armor shell for the left side: a curved, crumpled plate with jagged pointed edges and a ragged hollow opening in the middle, like a monstrous jawbone. Sits on the outer hip and upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shell; the hollow inside is shadow and takes no colour.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Chains_01.description: A length of heavy chain wrapped in loose spiral coils around the left upper thigh, with chunky rectangular links. The coils are spaced apart and slightly uneven, giving a rugged, restrained look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 on the recessed gaps inside the links.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Chains_01.differs: The female chain coils are looser and more widely spaced, with a taller spiral that reaches higher on the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_0.description: A small cluster of three narrow cloth streamers hanging from the outer lower leg near the calf, each tapering to a pointed diamond-shaped tip, with tiny studs along the strips; a loose, flared, punky accent.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the streamer strips; colour 3 on the diamond tips and the small stud dots.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_0.differs: The female streamers hang more steeply down the calf with diamond tips that are larger and more visible from the front.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_0.description: A cluster of three long, curved blade-like flares hanging down the outside of the left lower leg near the ankle, each tapering to a sharp tip with small studs along its length and diamond-shaped pointed ends.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved flare bodies; colour 3 on the diamond-shaped tips and the small studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Mutated_01.description: Three separate curved horn-like spikes attached along the outer left thigh and knee, graduated in size with the largest nearest the knee. Sharp, bony monstrous accents that sit off the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Mutated_01.differs: The female spikes are narrower and more pointed, with the largest one a slimmer shard than on the male.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Mutated_02.description: A cluster of three curved, pointed horn-like spikes on the outer left leg: one larger, thick-based spike near the thigh-knee and two small thorns trailing down the shin. Monstrous, partial leg accent.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Scarab_01.description: A slender curved horn or spike hanging from the left hip along the upper thigh, tapering to a sharp point, with a band at the tip and a pointed end. Suggests a mechanical insectoid or monstrous accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long curved shaft; colour 2 on the band near the tip; colour 3 on the pointed tip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Scarab_02.description: A curved scarab-style pincer or tail worn at the left hip, arcing down along the outer thigh. A segmented, spined armored hook ends in a contrasting tip, and a ringed stinger points up from the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved hook body and spines; colour 0 on the hook tip; colour 2 on the ring joint at the base of the stinger; colour 3 on the stinger.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Tight_Ascend.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central hub, hovering against the outer side of the left thigh like a badge. Thin, wire-like construction with a sci-fi feel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Tight_Ascend.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and central hub; colour 1 on the thin edge outline of the rings.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Tight_Strapp.description: A small boxy rectangular pouch with rounded padded faces and a flap over the top, edged in contrasting trim. A vertical strap runs down its side, with a round button-like stud on the flap. It sits at the left hip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Tight_Strapp.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and vertical strap; colour 3 on the round stud.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Vigilante_01.description: A small rectangular pouch with rounded top corners, worn on the outer left thigh beside the hip. It has a flap fastened by a round snap and a contrasting tab hanging down the back; a practical vigilante utility style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the hanging tab; colour 3 on the round snap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Vigilante_02.description: A pair of small rectangular flap-topped pouches sitting side by side on the outer left hip and upper thigh, boxy and softly padded, in a tactical utility style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Child_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both pouches and their flaps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A angular armored thigh guard for the left leg: a shell of faceted plates wraps the outer thigh, with a raised panel on the front, a separate side plate and jagged pointed edges at the lower hem.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main front and lower shell plates; colour 0 on the raised edge panels and trim; colour 3 on the side plate insert; colour 2 on the jagged lower tips and small notches.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Corrupted_01.description: A single hip-mounted armour panel hanging down the outer left thigh, made of stacked jagged plates with curved contrasting spikes along the rear edge and a ragged, bat-wing-like outline. Suggests a monstrous, mechanical fantasy look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate edges and upper plate; colour 3 on the inset stripe panels; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 2 on the inner lining and outline.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Cosmic_01.description: A faceted, octagonal band worn around the left upper thigh, with slightly flared rims at top and bottom and angular triangular facets across the front. Reads as a sleek sci-fi leg cuff.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main faceted body; colour 0 on the upper rim edge; colour 1 on a glossy side panel and lower rim.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Cosmic_01.differs: The female band has visible triangular facets pressed into the front surface, while the male band is smoother with larger plain panels.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_01.description: A glossy, sculpted leg shell wrapping the outer left thigh down to just below the knee, with curved raised ridges along the front edge and a pointed flared top at the hip. Sleek and armour-like.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the raised curved ridge and edge trim. The glossy material largely ignores the other slots.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_02.description: A tapered, open-topped thigh guard worn on the left outer hip, made of curved segmented plates with swooping raised ribs on the upper front and a glossy hollow interior. Its angular, armored look suggests sci-fi.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell of the guard; colour 1 on the raised swooping ribs and edge trim; colour 3 on the inset slits at the front; colour 0 on the glossy inner lining, which is reflective.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_02.differs: The female version has fewer, narrower contrasting inset slits on the front, mostly a single slit; the male version shows several stacked slits.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dharmor_01.description: A segmented armored thigh guard on the left leg: a short open-topped sleeve with a large front plate, a thin contrasting band across the middle, and stacked angled plates wrapping the back of the thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front and side plates; colour 3 on the middle band and the upper back plate; colour 2 on the middle back plate; colour 0 on the lower back plate.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dharmor_Hoses_01.description: A mechanical thigh guard for the left leg: a boxy armored shell with bolted plates, a small knee-side cap below, and a thick ribbed hose that loops up past the hip to a capped end, held by a strap.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dharmor_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell rims and edging; colour 2 on the front plates, strap and hose end cap; colour 1 on the inner side panel; colour 3 on the ribbed hose.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Draco_01.description: A short armored thigh band wrapping the left upper leg: a rounded plate cuff with a tall pointed contrasting fin rising at the back, a raised central spine panel at the front, and edging bands at top and bottom.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top cap, pointed fin and front spine panel; colour 0 on the side plates; colour 1 on the top and bottom edging; colour 2 on the lower band and panel outlines.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Draco_01.differs: The top cap and rear fin use colour 3 on the female version, while the male version uses colour 1 there.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_01.description: A thigh-side hip attachment of overlapping jagged bark-like plates with ragged upper edges, wrapping the outer left thigh. A rough mossy patch covers the front and back, giving a wild dryad or forest guardian look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bark plates; colour 1 on the mossy patches; colour 3 on the thin cracks and veins between the plates.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_02.description: A small organic hip ornament of two curved, horn-like thorny growths joined at a lumpy base, hanging at the left hip beside the thigh. It has a gnarled, bark-like texture and suggests a woodland creature style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the lumpy surface; colour 0 on the tips and the patches along the ridges.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A single-sided thigh guard of overlapping bark-like plates with jagged upper edges and thin vein lines, patched with a rough mossy growth. It hangs over the outer left thigh to about mid-thigh, in a wild forest-guardian style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bark plates; colour 1 on the rough mossy patches; colour 3 on the thin vein lines.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_01.description: A cluster of glossy, flame-shaped tendrils attached at the left hip and hanging down the outer thigh, with jagged licking tips and a rippled, twisted surface. Suggests an elemental fire or monstrous accent.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Default glossy material largely ignores the colour scheme; most of the flames show a reflective sheen, with only faint hints of colour 1 and colour 3 in the ripples.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_01.differs: The female flames hang slightly shorter and sit further forward on the hip, with a larger solid mass at the top.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_02.description: A glossy, flame-shaped hip accessory on the left thigh: a curved shell of jagged, licking tongues that sweeps from the hip down the outer thigh, ending in ragged points. Fantasy elemental style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and largely ignores the scheme; it shows mostly one tone with faint reflections, so no clear colour slot is visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Element_Water_01.description: A glossy, wave-like hip and thigh accessory of layered swooping fins and curling tendrils that hang down the outer left thigh to just above the knee, giving a liquid, monstrous elemental look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows one uniform sheen, with slight tint variation only from reflections.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Element_Water_02.description: A glossy, wing-like sheet of swept, rippling fins attached at the left hip and hanging down the outer thigh, ending in ragged points with small curled tendrils at the top. A fantasy, elemental look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Element_Water_02.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; faint hints of colour 3 show in the fold recesses.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A chunky angular thigh-mounted armored box on the left leg: a faceted, tapering casing with a raised front panel, a small triangular emblem and a tall notched upper corner, hanging at the outer hip and thigh. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole casing and the raised front panel; colour 2 on the recessed edges and the triangular emblem.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Falcon_01.description: A left thigh guard: a tall tapered armour shell wrapping the thigh, with a pointed lower edge, a lower cuff band and a jagged winged fin rising along the outer side to a crest gem. Fantasy-mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the edge trim and bands; colour 2 on the spiked outer fin and top surface; colour 3 on the crest gem and small band gem.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Frigid_01.description: A curved hip and thigh guard for the left side: a rigid shell with a bordered edge, a banded top rim and a pleated, ribbed centre panel, hanging from the hip to the upper thigh. It looks like sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed pleated centre panel; colour 1 on the banded top rim and the border around the panel; colour 2 on the outer shell and the outer edge trim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Gladiator_01.description: A single angular hip guard plate hanging from the left hip: a tapering shield-like slab with a bordered edge, a recessed centre panel with a slashed inset, and a flared cap over the top. Suggests sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cap and outer shell; colour 0 on the inner centre panel; colour 2 on the raised border; colour 3 on the slashed inset.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Heraldry_01.description: A curved armored thigh guard worn on the left leg: a tall shield-like plate with a raised rim, a heraldic blade emblem on the front, and a pointed, layered cuff with a small hanging tag just above the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and the cuff band; colour 2 on the rim, top edge and knee cap piece; colour 3 on the front emblem and small details; colour 1 on the panel at the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Heraldry_01.differs: The female guard has a taller pointed knee cap piece with a deeper contrasting panel that hangs lower on the leg.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Holohex_01.description: A cluster of flat, angular hexagonal shards floating around the left lower leg, stacked from below the knee to the ankle with small spiky fragments jutting outward. Suggests a holographic or energy field accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shard cluster; the piece appears as a single flat tone, so other slots are not visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Holster_Bounty_01.description: A slim, open-framed holster on the left hip and thigh: a tapered pouch with a looped guard, a narrow flared handle tab pointing upward, and a contrasting strap band around the middle. Suggests a sci-fi gunslinger look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Holster_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body, loop and tab; colour 1 on the strap band across the middle; colour 3 on a tiny tip accent at the top.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Hoses_01.description: A cluster of segmented, ribbed flexible hoses hanging from the left hip along the outer thigh, curving downward in open-ended loops. Reads as mechanical or tentacle-like, a partial accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all of the hose segments.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Ironclad_01.description: A angular armored hip plate mounted on the left outer thigh: stacked segmented bands with jutting ridged edges and a flared rim, forming a chunky mechanical guard hanging down the upper leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the raised ridges and rim edges; colour 0 on the top panel; colour 1 on the middle panel; colour 2 on the lower panel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Kaiju_01.description: A side hip and thigh guard of layered, overlapping armour plates that curve around the outer left thigh, with a longer segmented panel hanging below and curved contrasting horns sweeping up from the hip. Monstrous, mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the lower hanging panel; colour 2 on the horns and spikes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Knight_01.description: A curved thigh plate worn on the outer left thigh, with a bordered edge and scratched, worn surface, held on by two thin round straps that wrap around the leg. Suggests medieval knightly armour.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the raised border edging; colour 2 on the two leg straps. The plate face also shows a pinkish gradient shading.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Knight_01.differs: The female plate has a distinct raised edging around its border, while the male plate has a plain edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Knight_02.description: A curved plate guard worn on the outer left thigh, tapering toward the knee, with a row of conical spikes along its outer edge and two thin octagonal straps that wrap around the leg. Suggests a brutal knight or monster look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and spikes; colour 2 on the two thigh straps. Colour 1 and colour 3 are not clearly visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_01.description: A single hip and thigh guard hanging from the left hip: a curved armor panel with a gridded lattice pattern, scrolled trim along the lower edge and pointed tails at the front and back. Suggests martial-arts fantasy armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and scrollwork trim; colour 2 on the lattice-filled panel fields; colour 1 on the inner lining.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The female version shows less of the ornate lattice on the front and has longer, more pointed tails at the front and back.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_02.description: A beast-head hip ornament on the left hip: a snarling wolf or dragon face with swept-back spiky mane and a fan of curved tusk-like spines, mounted on a ring-shaped base. Fierce martial-arts fantasy look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the head, mane and base; colour 0 on the curved spines and brow markings; colour 2 on the darker spine tips; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_01.description: Three separate octagonal bands stacked down the left leg: a wide thick band on the upper thigh, a thin band above the knee and a chunky band just below the knee. Simple, segmented cuffs with a jester-like feel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outside of the upper thigh band; colour 1 on its inner lining and on the middle band; colour 2 on the lower knee band, with colour 1 on its inner lining.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_02.description: A set of three separate bands stacked down the left thigh: a wide wrapped, creased cuff high up, a thinner strap below it and a chunky octagonal band above the knee, each with a small stud.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide wrapped cuff; colour 1 on the inner lining of the cuff and the middle strap; colour 2 on the lower octagonal band; colour 3 on the studs.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_02.differs: The female cuff is wider and sits higher with a visible contrasting lining showing beneath it, and the wrap looks more twisted than the male's.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_01.description: A boxy mechanical hip pod worn on the outer left thigh: a chamfered block with a contrasting vertical slot, a raised back plate, and a round domed disc with a segmented ring mounted at the rear.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box body and back plate; colour 1 on the round domed disc; colour 3 on the ring around the disc; colour 2 on the vertical slot.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_01.differs: The round disc sits further back on the rear edge of the box, so it is hidden from the front view.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_02.description: A boxy, faceted mechanical hip pod mounted on the outer left thigh: an open-topped angular casing with a tall, raised back plate and a slot beneath. It gives a sci-fi armoured, mecha look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and lower plating; colour 1 on the tall back plate and upper rim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A curved armored hip-and-thigh plate on the left leg, wrapping the outer side and reaching mid-thigh, with a raised padded panel, thin contrasting piping, a small round fastener at the top and a thick trimmed lower edge. Modern sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 1 on the raised padded panel; colour 3 on the thin piping line; colour 2 on the lower edge band and top flared rim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Moth_01.description: A single curved wing-like panel hanging from the left hip down the outer thigh, tapering to a ragged point near the knee. It has a thin raised edge along the top and a soft, membranous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the panel and its raised edge; colour 3 on the lower part of the panel, blending from colour 0 toward the hem.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_01.description: A lumpy, muscular-looking fleshy growth clinging to the outer thigh, tapering to a pointed tip near the knee, with bony spikes along the front and small contrasting and small round spots on the surface.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fleshy growth; colour 0 on the bony spikes; colour 1 on the small round spots on the back; colour 2 on the small opening at the front.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_02.description: A mutated organic growth strapped to the outer left thigh: a lumpy, fleshy shell that sweeps up into a horn-like point at the hip and tapers down to a clawed tip near the knee, with small bony spurs and nodules.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy shell; colour 0 on the small spurs and thorns; colour 2 on the nodules on the front; colour 1 on the small nodules at the back.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_02.differs: The female growth is longer and narrower, with a taller horn at the hip and a thinner tip reaching toward the knee, and it has fewer large spurs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Newholster_01.description: A small western-style holster pouch on the outer thigh: a tall, open-topped flat case with a wedge-shaped mouth, a cross strap with a large buckle, and swirling scroll ornamentation on the face.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Newholster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body; colour 1 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle and scroll ornament.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Persian_Sword_01.description: A curved Persian-style sword hanging at the left hip in a rectangular clip mount, with a wrapped grip, a heavy round pommel with a central jewel, and a blade that sweeps down and hooks at the tip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Persian_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the hip clip mount; colour 2 on the grip wrap and pommel; colour 3 on the pommel jewel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Persian_Sword_01.differs: The sword hangs more vertically against the thigh, with a shorter-looking blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Pirate_Fancy_Gun.description: A flintlock-style pistol worn at the left hip, hanging muzzle-down: a curved, bulbous grip with an inset side plate, a banded collar, a slim barrel with ring details and a flared muzzle tip, plus a thin rod along the side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Pirate_Fancy_Gun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved grip and barrel sections; colour 2 on the grip cap, side plate, lower barrel and muzzle; colour 1 on the collar band; colour 3 on the thin rod along the side.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Pirate_Fancy_Sword.description: A rapier hanging at the left hip: a long thin blade points down toward the ankle, with a swept cage guard of looping bars, crossed quillon arms and a small pommel at the top. Pirate swashbuckler style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Pirate_Fancy_Sword.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the looping hand guard; colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the crossed quillons and grip; colour 1 on the pommel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A hip-mounted armor cluster on the left thigh: overlapping angular plates and tall pointed shards fanning upward, with a shield-like plate at the lower front. Its crystalline, dragon-like form suggests a sci-fi or fantasy look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the plates and shards; the material appears to ignore the other colour slots, so nothing else shows clearly.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Pumpkin_01.description: A cage of curved bone-like ribs wrapped around the left thigh, joined by a vertical spine-like ridge at the back and front. Open gaps between the ribs show the leg beneath; a skeletal, macabre look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spine ridge and alternating rib segments; colour 1 on the front spine and many rib segments; colour 2 on some rib tips and segments; colour 3 on a few ribs at the outer thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Punk_01.description: A punk thigh harness of two buckled straps that wrap around the upper and lower left thigh, joined by a thin vertical strap running up toward the hip. Both straps are studded with round dots.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 3 on the round studs; colour 2 on the buckles.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Qularr_Armor_03.description: A thigh guard worn on the left outer thigh: overlapping angular armor plates on the front with stacked horizontal segments around the back, forming an open-backed cuff. Suggests alien or monstrous plated armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Qularr_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the plate edges and rim; colour 2 on the darker gaps between the stacked segments.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Renegade_Straps_01.description: A column of six short flat straps stacked down the outer left thigh, each a curved band with a small rivet and a short overlapping tab. They sit open on the leg, suggesting a sci-fi renegade look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Renegade_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the small rivets and the tab ends.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Renegade_Straps_01.differs: The female straps are spaced further apart and taper to smaller bands toward the knee, while the male set is evenly sized.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky armored thigh guard worn on the left upper leg: a hollow, tapered shell of angular faceted plates with a contrasting band around the top and a hexagonal gem-like stud near the back.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the interior lining at the top rim; colour 1 on the upper band and side panel; colour 2 on the main faceted plates; colour 3 on the hexagonal stud.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A curved metal thigh guard worn on the left upper leg: a tall shell wrapping the outer thigh, with a flared rolled rim at the top and a tapered lower edge. A recessed vertical panel with a pointed bracket motif runs down the outer side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the top rim; colour 1 on the outlined inset panel border; colour 3 on the small ribbed detail inside the panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Retrosteelhead_01.differs: The female guard is taller and extends higher up the hip, with a more sharply curved, flared top edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Sandstorm_01.description: A curved thigh guard wrapping the left upper leg, a smooth open-topped sleeve with contrasting edging, a notched lower hem, and raised swooping raised strips and hooked panels on the front and back. Sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the raised hooked panels; colour 3 on the slanted raised strips; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Sandstorm_02.description: A single tapered thigh guard worn on the outer left thigh, a curved plate with a bevelled lower edge and a pointed lower panel, held by two thin straps that wrap around the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the pointed lower panel; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_01.description: A narrow armoured thigh guard hanging from the left hip, made of a curved outer plate with a contrasting inner lining, a pointed spur at the front and a blunt cap at the lower end. It has a sleek, insect-like superhero look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge outlines; colour 3 on the pointed front spur; colour 1 on the lower cap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_02.description: A left-thigh armour guard: a rounded, cuff-like upper band with a raised contrasting spike at the hip, over a tapered plate that ends in a pointed hem, with curved fin-like accents down the side and a padded panel at the back.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper band and the hem edge; colour 0 on the main thigh plate; colour 1 on the curved side fins; colour 3 on the hip spike and the back panel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_Alt_01.description: A single curved, tapering scarab-style claw hanging from the left hip along the upper thigh, with a smooth hooked upper end and a pointed tip set off by a contrasting collar band. Mechanical, insectoid look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long curved shaft; colour 2 on the collar band at the base of the tip; colour 3 on the pointed claw tip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_Alt_02.description: A curved, hook-like scarab claw worn on the left hip and thigh: a pointed segmented tip at the hip, a small collar joint, then a long tapering arm with barbed spines that curls around the thigh to a contrasting claw tip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the pointed upper tip; colour 2 on the joint ring; colour 1 on the curved arm and barbed spines; colour 0 on the claw tip at the lower end.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Spooky_01.description: A narrow, jagged ridge of overlapping shard-like spines running down the outer left hip and thigh, tapering to a point near the knee, with small eye-like studs near the top; monstrous, beastly styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper spines and ridge; colour 1 on the lower spines toward the tip; colour 3 on the small eye-like spots.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Spy_01.description: A futuristic spy pistol worn on a thigh strap: an octagonal padded band circles the upper leg, with a boxy pistol with ribbed grip and a long ribbed suppressor barrel hanging down the outer thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and casing; colour 1 on the top of the strap plate, grip ribs and barrel sections; colour 2 on the strap band and underside; colour 3 on the thin stripes and small sights.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Starhawk_01.description: A left thigh accessory of two octagonal plates stacked around the upper leg and joined by thin looping bands, with a pointed blade-like fin and a faceted gem-like spike at the outer side. A superhero armour look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two octagonal plates and the lower fin edge; colour 0 on the central blade-shaped fin; colour 3 on the faceted spike; colour 2 on the connecting bands.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Starhawk_02.description: A left thigh armor accessory: a large angular plated cap on the outer upper thigh with layered edging, joined by a slim curved strip to a small chevron-shaped plate above the knee. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cap and the lower chevron plate; colour 0 on the connecting strip; colour 3 on the stripe between the layers; colour 2 on the darker top edge and underside trim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Steelcommando_01.description: A single armored thigh guard for the left leg: a raised front plate over a wide, flared shell that wraps the outer thigh and ends in jagged, pointed tips above the knee. Mechanical, retro-military look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised front plate; colour 2 on the main shell and lower band; colour 0 on the thin edge highlights along the rim.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Steelcommando_01.differs: The female guard is narrower and hangs lower, with longer, more ragged pointed tips along the bottom edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Super_Retro_Destro.description: A single curved, shield-like metal plate that hangs off the left hip and upper thigh, tapering to a point at the bottom. It is hollow and open on the inner side, with a thin lighter rim, in a retro superhero style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Super_Retro_Destro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate surface; colour 1 on the lower tip shading; colour 2 on the hollow interior; colour 0 on the rim edge. The glossy metal finish mostly ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Symbiote_01.description: A curved, shield-like plate on the outer left hip and thigh, with a recessed oval centre holding a pair of pointed pyramid studs. Its organic-mechanical look suits a monstrous, symbiote style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer curved plate; colour 1 on the recessed oval centre; colour 3 on the pyramid studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Draycul.description: A small plate-armor guard for the outer left thigh: a pointed shield-shaped upper plate over a wider curved lower plate with a bordered rim and small rivets, held by two thick octagonal straps that ring the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Draycul.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 1 on the plate borders and rims; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Rockcry.description: A cluster of chunky, faceted rock slabs with thin glowing cracks, attached at the left hip and hanging down the outer thigh. It has a jagged, monstrous stone look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Rockcry.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock surfaces; colour 3 on the cracks between the stone facets.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Rockcry.differs: The female rocks sit as a tighter, shorter cluster hugging the hip, with the lower chunk closer to the upper mass.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.description: A thigh-mounted utility band on the left upper leg: a segmented octagonal strap carrying a large flap pouch, a row of ammo cartridges, a small vented box and upright buckle tabs. Tactical, retro-military style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and strap; colour 1 on the pouch, flap and tabs; colour 2 on the vented box and fittings; colour 3 on the cartridges and small round studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_90s_Foxbat_0.description: A chunky faceted band worn around the left upper thigh, with an octagonal cross-section, rounded disc bumps on the outer side and a contrasting top edge. Suggests a retro superhero or mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_90s_Foxbat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band body and the round discs; colour 1 on the upper rim and the inner top edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Alien_02.description: A small rounded kneepad shell with two inset oval panels and a raised rim, topped by a thick curved band that arcs over the top of the knee. Sits on the left knee with a sleek, alien-armor look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the two inset oval panels; colour 2 on the curved band across the top.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ammo_Cartrid.description: A thigh band of upright ammunition cartridges with pointed tips hanging below a flat strap, plus two boxy magazine pouches with contrasting panels on the outer side of the left upper leg. Tactical, military look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ammo_Cartrid.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and cartridge bands; colour 1 on the cartridge casings; colour 2 on the bullet tips and pouch panels; colour 3 on the pouch frames and thin lines around the band.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ammo_Cartrid.differs: The female version has two magazine pouches side by side, while the male version has three in the three-quarter view.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A small hip guard on the left thigh made of two stacked, overlapping curved plates with thick bevelled rims, forming a shield-like armoured flap that hangs from the hip over the upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 2 on the thick rims and edges of the plates.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A set of three curved, blade-like fins that sweep down and back from the left hip and upper thigh, each with a contrasting edge. They stack like claw slashes and suggest an aquatic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top fin; colour 1 on the middle fin; colour 0 on the lowest fin; colour 2 on the edging.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armor_Ancien.description: A tapered thigh plate worn on the outer left thigh, split by narrow vertical slits and carved with swirling angular spiral patterns, held on by two rigid octagonal bands that wrap fully around the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armor_Ancien.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the carved spiral line patterns; colour 2 on the weathered speckled patches; colour 3 on the two encircling bands.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorninja.description: A small angular armour guard wrapped around the left upper thigh just above the knee, made of faceted plates with a curved central panel and a sharp pointed upper edge. Suggests ninja or sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper edge plates and inner rim; colour 1 on the large central curved panel; colour 2 on the rear and outer side plates; colour 3 on the lower accent flap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_0.description: A rigid segmented thigh guard on the left leg: a hollow, tapered shell of layered angular plates with raised ridges and small vent slits, open at the top and ending above the knee. Suggests sci-fi or armoured creature styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and rim; colour 1 on the inset side panels and corner accents; colour 3 on the small vent slits; colour 2 on the darker edge lining.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_0.description: A small angular armored kneepad: a faceted shell with a pointed vertical ridge that juts out over the front of the left knee, with flared side plates. Suggests monstrous or mechanical armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and side plates; colour 1 on the central vertical ridge and the pointed upper and lower tips.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A curved, shield-shaped thigh plate worn on the outer left upper leg, with a bevelled rim, a notched lower edge and an atom emblem on its face. Suggests a superhero or sci-fi armour accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the main panel face.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A single draped cloth swag hanging from two round medallion anchors on the left hip, one at the front and one at the back, with a loose trailing tail of fabric ending near mid-thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped cloth; colour 1 on the medallion rims; colour 3 on the star-shaped centres of the medallions.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bandtied_01.description: A narrow cloth band wrapped around the upper thigh and knotted at the side, with two short pointed tails hanging down from the knot. Reads as a simple garter or bandage-style leg accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bandtied_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band, knot and tails; the tails fade toward a darker tip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer.description: A short, plain tapered greave that wraps the lower left leg above the ankle, with an octagonal rim at the top and bottom edge. The smooth, simple shell suggests a light monster-hunter or fantasy armour piece.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim bands.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer.description: A monstrous armored calf bracer: a tapered octagonal cuff with contrasting trim, a raised cross-shaped plate on the outer front and a large curved scythe-like blade sweeping back from the side of the lower leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 1 on the rim and edge trim; colour 3 on the cross plate; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bowtie_01.description: A thigh band worn high on the left leg, with a large bowtie-style knot at the outer side and short pointed ribbon tails hanging down. A rounded stud sits on the band, giving a cute magical-girl look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band edge, knot centre and ribbon tails; colour 1 on the bow loops and band panels; colour 2 on the inner band sections; colour 3 on a small accent patch on the band.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel.description: A tapered, open-topped armoured bracer worn around the lower leg just above the ankle, with a rim of contrasting trim and a large angular cross-shaped plate mounted on the outer front.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the rim edging and the framing around the front; colour 3 on the large cross plate.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel.differs: The female bracer has a smooth, plain shell, while the male one has a pitted, worn surface texture.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bucklestraps.description: Three separate studded straps stacked around the left upper thigh, each closing with a small buckle block on the outer side. A casual, street or punk-style leg accessory that sits loosely on the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bucklestraps.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the buckle blocks.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, open-topped cardboard-carton shape worn on the outer left thigh, with flat angular panels and a rim at the top. It reads as a quirky, novelty leg attachment rather than a garment.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and lighter side panels; colour 1 on the curved and corner panels and the inner top; colour 2 on the large front and back panels; colour 3 on the small square patch at the back.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cartridges_0.description: A pair of thin bands wrapped around the left upper thigh, carrying two small upright rectangular cartridge cases with bevelled edges and recessed contrasting panels on the outer side of the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cartridges_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two thigh straps; colour 1 on the cartridge casings; colour 2 on the recessed panels of the cartridges.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cartridges_0.differs: The female version has two cartridges side by side, whereas the male has a wider block that looks like it holds three.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cowboy_Lasso.description: A coiled twisted-rope lasso hanging at the left hip, with several loops of thick braided rope and a small knotted loop at one end. A western accessory that hangs beside the thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cowboy_Lasso.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole rope coil and knot; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: Two angular armoured plates strapped to the left leg: a larger curved guard on the outer upper thigh and a smaller shield-like plate just below the knee, with small rivets and a glossy, sleek finish.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 1 on a recessed inner panel along the edge of each plate; colour 2 on the underside and edges. The glossy finish partly ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cyborgarmor_.description: A bolted armour shell worn on the outer left thigh: a curved, open-backed plate with angular edges, hex bolt heads at the corners, a ridged inner lining and a heavy lower band. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
