Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cyborgarmor_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 0 on the ridged inner lining and upper edge; colour 2 on the lower band; colour 3 on the bolts.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Defender_01.description: A small diamond-shaped kneepad worn on the front of the left knee: a faceted, pyramid-like shell with a raised ridge and a curved crescent marking, with a flat underside against the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 3 on the crescent marking; colour 1 on the inner back surface.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Defender_01.differs: The female pad is a flatter, more slender diamond that sits close to the knee, with a less pronounced back.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Deity_01.description: A curved, shield-like thigh guard worn on the outer left thigh: a smooth rounded shell with a contrasting front panel, a flared rear edge that extends past the leg, and a hollow open top. Suggests sleek sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and rear flared edge; colour 1 on the main front panel; colour 2 on the recessed side gap at the back.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Electric.description: A hexagonal armored thigh plate worn on the outer left thigh, with a segmented lower band, bolted panel and three coil-like electrode posts on the outside, plus a thick flexible cable arching over the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Electric.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and the rim; colour 1 on the ribbed lower band; colour 3 on the coil windings of the electrodes; colour 2 on the cable, bolts and electrode caps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Fincalf_01.description: A small fin-shaped calf accessory: a flat spotted panel on the outer left calf with three swept-back pointed fin blades and a long trailing tip at the lower back. Suggests aquatic or monstrous styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Fincalf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spotted panel surface; colour 3 on the spots; colour 1 on the fin blades and edge trim; colour 2 in the shaded stripes between the fins.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Fincalf_02.description: A small fin-like calf accessory on the outer left lower leg: a flat speckled membrane panel ribbed by three swept-back curved fins with pointed tips, giving a monstrous aquatic look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Fincalf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the speckled membrane panel; colour 1 on the fin ribs and edge trim; colour 3 on the spots; colour 2 on the shading between the fins.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_01.description: A small monstrous fin attached to the outer left thigh: a tapered membrane panel with several swept-back spiny ribs, mottled with spots, sitting flat against the side of the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fin ribs and edges; colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 2 shading at the panel bases; colour 3 on the spots.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_01.differs: The female fin is longer and narrower, hanging lower along the thigh, with the ribs swept more vertically.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_02.description: A fin-like thigh accessory on the outer left thigh: a stack of swept, membrane-like panels with sharp pointed spines along the edges, angled diagonally down the leg. Suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiny edge ribs and outer rims; colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 3 on the speckled markings; colour 2 on the shaded diagonal bands.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Flower_01.description: A leg band of intertwined vine-like tendrils wrapped around the left thigh, with a large layered flower of pointed petals at the outer side and small leaf-like blades along the loops. Fantasy nature-inspired accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vines and many petals; colour 0 on the vine ends and some petal tips; colour 2 on the flower centre petals and leaf accents; colour 3 on the thin accent vines.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Furpads_01.description: A fur hip pad on the left outer hip: a flat, slightly curved backing plate covered in long, shaggy, pointed fur strands that hang down over the upper thigh. It suggests a beastly or savage look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Furpads_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur strands; colour 0 on the flat backing plate and its edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Gamer_01.description: A slab-shaped arcade controller panel hanging at the side of the left hip, with a plain flat outer face and a bevelled edge. Its inner face carries a joystick, rows of round buttons and small contrasting indicator marks.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel casing; colour 1 on the joystick; colour 2 on the round buttons; colour 3 on the small indicator marks.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Garterbelt_0.description: A lace garter band worn around the upper left thigh, with layered ruffled frills and scalloped, openwork edges that flare outward slightly. A small, delicate accessory with a cute, frilly look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Garterbelt_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lace frills; colour 2 on the inner lining of the band.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A curved armour plate strapped to the outer left thigh, with a bordered rim, rivets and cracked surface lines, a riveted rear panel, and several cone spikes projecting outward. Gladiator-style and aggressive.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the rim and outer shell; colour 2 on the rear riveted panel; colour 3 on the spikes and crack lines.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The female version has a shorter, narrower plate with a darker riveted panel that sticks out more at the front edge, and fewer spikes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Golden_Age_S.description: Two raised, flat-faced five-pointed stars of different sizes stacked down the outer side of the left thigh, standing slightly proud of the leg. A small superhero emblem accent in a golden-age style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Golden_Age_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both stars; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Golden_Age_S.differs: The two stars are spaced farther apart and sit lower on the thigh, with the upper star larger than the lower.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A left-leg accessory of angular, segmented armour plates curving around the outer thigh and ending in a curved band above the knee. The surface has a crackling energy-web pattern, giving a hard-light sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material shows a glowing energy effect that ignores the colour scheme, so no slot is clearly visible on the plates.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The default material is a glowing contrasting energy pattern that ignores the colour scheme, whereas the male version shows solid coloured plates.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowbo.description: An empty western-style thigh holster on the left leg: a tall open-topped pouch hangs at the outer thigh from a thin octagonal leg loop, with a rivet row at the mouth, a rounded central panel and a small angled hand-rest tab.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowbo.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster top band, lower cap and central panel; colour 0 on the middle section and the leg loop edge; colour 2 on the rivets and inner holster side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowbo.differs: The female holster has a longer angled tab sticking out from the front of the loop, and the pouch hangs slightly lower on the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowbo.description: An empty open-topped western holster shell worn on the left outer thigh: a tapered, angular boxy pouch with a band of rivets near the rim, a rounded central plate and contrasting banding.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowbo.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper band, rounded plate, lower band and outer side; colour 0 on the middle sections and rim; colour 2 on the rivets.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holsterpisto.description: A thigh-mounted pistol holster on the outer left leg: a tall, boxy holster body with a pistol grip poking out the top, held by two open octagonal leg straps wrapped around the thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holsterpisto.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster body and the two thigh straps; colour 0 on the inner panel strip of the holster; colour 3 on the pistol grip; colour 2 on the pistol's small joint and trigger area.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Inmate_01.description: A small knee guard on the left leg: a shield-shaped padded plate with a contrasting rim, held by a single wide strap wrapped around the leg just below the knee. Plain, utilitarian, prison-issue look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 2 on the rim edging around the plate; colour 1 on the wrap-around strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Knife_01.description: A thigh-mounted combat knife hanging from a flat, angular octagonal band worn high on the left thigh. The blade is broad and pointed with a small hole near the tip and a blocky handle with a crossguard.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band; colour 2 on the handle and crossguard; colour 3 on the blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Knifesasquat.description: A jagged, crude knife strapped to the outer left thigh by three parallel bands, with a wrapped handle at the top and an irregular serrated blade pointing down. Suggests a tribal or monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Knifesasquat.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the knife blade and handle ends; colour 2 on the three thigh straps and the handle wrapping.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Light_01.description: A side hip-and-thigh panel made of overlapping tiers of leaf-shaped plates with raised rims and jagged lower points. It sits on the outer left hip and reaches mid-thigh, in a fantasy armor style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate surfaces; colour 0 on the raised rims and edging between the leaf sections.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Light_01.differs: The female version is a shorter, more compact wrap that sits on the hip, with tiers that flare outward.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Lockbox_66_0.description: Two separate angular band cuffs stacked on the left thigh: an upper stepped, zigzag-edged band and a lower thinner band with a small tab flap at the front. Mechanical armour-like styling, sitting mid-thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Lockbox_66_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band body; colour 1 on the upper band's edge trim; colour 2 on the lower band body; colour 3 on the lower band's edge trim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A curved plate guard worn on the outer left thigh, dented and scratched, with a few slotted screw-like fasteners. It is held by two thin straps with square buckles wrapping the thigh. Rugged, monstrous-mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate; colour 2 on the two thigh straps; colour 3 on the buckles and slotted fasteners.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Mechanon.description: A cluster of angular, overlapping armor plates strapped to the left outer thigh, with jagged shard-like edges and a banded section across the lower part. Suggests a robotic, mechanical leg guard.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edge plates and fins; colour 1 on the main plate faces; colour 2 on the inner panels; colour 3 on the horizontal band.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Mechassn_02.description: A mechanical armored thigh guard for the left leg: a tapered plated shell with an angled octagonal top rim, raised panels and small knobs on the sides, and a pointed lower cap ending above the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Mechassn_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower cap and outer plating edges; colour 1 on the main shell panels and raised blocks; colour 3 on the angled top rim; colour 2 on the recessed slots.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Padding.description: A pair of rounded padded thigh plates on the left upper leg, one on the front and one on the back, with a gap between them at the side. Bulky, sporty tactical armor with a small inset panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate shells; colour 1 on the large curved panels; colour 2 on the top and bottom edge panels; colour 3 on the small inset panel on the front plate.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Pockets_01.description: A band of padded pouches wrapped around the upper left thigh, with a flat strap segment and several small flap-topped pockets, each with a round central fastener. Suggests a tactical or utility look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Pockets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the flat strap section; colour 3 on the round fasteners on the pouch flaps.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Pockets_01.differs: The female version has more pouches packed close together around the band, with only a small gap for the strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Power_01.description: A rigid armored thigh guard on the left leg: an open-backed tapered shell with a tall angular plate rising along the outer edge, a stepped notch cut into the front, and an inset side panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall angular plate and rim; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 1 on the inset panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Power_01.differs: The female version's inset panel is mostly hidden toward the back of the leg, so less of it shows from the front.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Powerarmor_0.description: A mechanical armor plate strapped to the outer left thigh: a large rounded shell with contrasting inset panels and a small round port, plus a smaller separate plate sitting behind it. Sci-fi power-armor styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Powerarmor_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and the smaller rear plate; colour 2 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the small round lights in the ports; colour 0 on the inner mechanical detail.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Powersuit_01.description: A mechanical hip-mounted frame on the outer left thigh: a tall, curved shell with a large oval cut-out, tapering down to two small wheel-like rollers near the knee. Suggests a powersuit or sci-fi armor attachment.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Powersuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame shell and its edge trim; colour 2 on the roller wheels; colour 1 on the small hubs inside the wheels.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Quiver_01.description: A slim thigh quiver on the left leg: a flat strap loops around the upper thigh and holds a narrow frame of fletched arrows angled down the outer thigh, with clamp bands and a pointed tip cap at the bottom.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh strap, frame rails and arrow fletching; colour 1 on the arrow shafts and clamp bands; colour 2 on the small fasteners; colour 3 on the base tip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_01.description: A pair of looping straps hanging from two small rings on the left outer thigh, each ring fixed to a short tab; the strips droop in swooping U-shapes down the leg. A casual rave or street accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hanging loops; colour 1 on the tabs; colour 0 on the tab edging; colour 2 on the rings.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_02.description: A pair of looping straps hanging from two small rings on flat tabs at the left hip, draping in loose U-shaped swags down the outer thigh. A casual rave or street accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tabs; colour 0 on the tab edges; colour 2 on the rings; colour 3 on the hanging straps.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_02.differs: The female straps hang a little further apart, with a wider spread between the two tabs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A hollow, tapered armoured sleeve encasing the left thigh, with an open top rim, faint embossed vent slots and small studs on the side, and a banded lower edge ending in a notched, pointed hem above the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main thigh shell; colour 2 on the band below it; colour 0 on the lower notched hem; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_T.description: A sleek angular thigh plate for the left leg: a tapered, open-backed shell of flat faceted panels that wraps the outer thigh from hip to above the knee. Suggests retro sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_T.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bright front edge panel and the outer face; colour 1 on the back and inner side panels.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_T.differs: The female plate is more open at the top, with a thin pointed flap rising toward the hip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rhino_01.description: A bulky, rounded thigh sleeve for the left leg, a short tube of thick mottled material with a contrasting band near the top and a ragged, crumpled cuff at the bottom. Sits over the upper thigh to above the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh sleeve; colour 1 on the band near the top; colour 3 on the crumpled lower cuff.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ringsthigh_0.description: A thigh wrap of criss-crossing overlapping straps between two contrasting bands at top and bottom, with octagonal metal rings and small tabs attached along the outer and rear sides. Sits on the left upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ringsthigh_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossing straps; colour 2 on the gaps and underlayer between straps; colour 1 on the top and bottom bands; colour 3 on the rings and tabs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A small angular hip plate with a socket, from which several thick ribbed cables or tentacle-like tubes loop and hang down the outer thigh, ending in blunt tips. Mechanical, monstrous look for a left hip accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plate; colour 2 on the ribbed cable bodies; colour 3 on the thin lines running along the cables and the socket.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Robot_Leg_At.description: A bulky, angular mechanical thigh guard on the left hip: a faceted armored shell with pointed upper tips, rows of recessed oval vents down the sides, thin etched lines, and a hanging pointed blade-like plate at the front.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Robot_Leg_At.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor shell and top panel; colour 3 on the recessed vent slots and etched lines; colour 1 on the hanging pointed plate; colour 2 on the small connector fittings.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Robotsamurai.description: A hip-mounted armour guard for the left thigh: a stack of overlapping, angular segmented plates that step down the outer thigh from a taller upper plate, like samurai tassets. It hangs to mid-thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Robotsamurai.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the plate faces; colour 1 on the upper plate and alternating panels; colour 2 on the edge fins and some lower panels; colour 3 on small accent strips between plates.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.description: A mechanical leg attachment worn on the left upper thigh: an open oval band with a ring-shaped socket at the top, ribbed vent panels on the back and a soft cloth-like lining inside. Sci-fi holster-like styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth lining and the outer band edges; colour 2 on the ribbed back panel and lower armoured block; colour 1 on the trim lines along the band.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.description: A two-part armored leg accessory for the left leg: an open thigh band with a flared front panel and a separate angular shin guard with a spiked fin on top, ridged vents and contrasting trim. Alien, mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band and shin guard shell; colour 1 on the ridged vent panels of the shin guard; colour 3 on the accents under the shin guard; colour 2 on the edge bands and trim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.description: A left-leg accessory of two separate armored pieces: an open curved thigh band with a raised ring at the back, and a pointed shin guard with a spiked crest, ridged vents and layered plates below the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band and main shin plates; colour 2 on the band's underside and the plate edges; colour 1 on the vented panel of the shin guard; colour 3 on the accents under the shin guard's crest.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.differs: The thigh band sits slightly higher and looks more open at the front than on the male.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A curved, shell-like hip guard on the left side of the hip, hollow underneath, with a rolled contrasting rim along the top edge, a pointed lower edge, and feather-like plates in recessed panels with small studs. Suggests fantasy or sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer shell; colour 1 on the edge border and trim; colour 2 on the rolled top rim and the feather-like plates; colour 3 on the small studs and gem accents.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samurai_Larg.description: A single samurai-style hip and thigh guard hanging from the left hip: a rigid, angular plate with a raised zigzag border, jagged stepped edge at the front and a patterned swirl panel inset. Ends at upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samurai_Larg.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate, rim and jagged edge; colour 1 on the thin inner border line; colour 2 on the swirl panel background; colour 3 on the swirl pattern.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate.description: A segmented thigh guard on the left upper leg: three stacked curved plates across the front with contrasting edging, and a ribbed, banded octagonal block wrapping the back of the thigh. Suggests samurai-style armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and the panel behind them; colour 2 on the ribbed rear block.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate.description: A samurai-style hip guard of four stacked, overlapping curved plates (kasazuri) hanging from the left hip to the upper thigh, with raised bordered edges. It wraps the outer hip like a short tassset.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the plates; colour 1 on the raised borders and the inner faces of the plates.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate.description: A samurai-style layered thigh guard of overlapping lamellar plates that wraps around the outside of the upper left thigh, with a stack of ring bands at the top holding it in place. Reads as fantasy or east-asian armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and the inner plate faces; colour 2 on the stacked ring bands at the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate.differs: The female version wraps a little further round the front and back of the thigh, and the plates sit more spread out, with a gap at the back of the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Scarletshiel.description: A pair of stacked buckled straps wrapped around the left leg just below the knee, each with a square frame buckle and a short tail end. Casual, edgy accessory with a slightly faceted band shape.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Scarletshiel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 2 on the buckle frames; colour 1 on the strap tail loops beside the buckles.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Scifi_Soldie.description: A sci-fi armored thigh guard worn on the left outer thigh: a segmented shell with a notched upper edge, a raised angular front plate and a hollow open top, giving a tactical soldier look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Scifi_Soldie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and edge plates; colour 1 on the curved front and back panels; colour 2 on the angled band and inner recess; colour 3 on the rear edge strip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Seacreature_.description: A cluster of curved, blade-like fins or spines swept downward from the left hip, with chevron-patterned panels and thin contrasting edging. It suggests a mechanical sea-creature look worn as a hip accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Seacreature_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fin surfaces; colour 1 on the edging and outer fin panels; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the undersides and inner sections.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Shackleankle.description: A chunky mechanical ankle shackle: a tapered, faceted cylindrical cuff with a vertical seam, paired contrasting clamp blocks on the front and back, and two rounded loop handles on the sides. Worn on the left ankle.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Shackleankle.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 1 on the two side loop handles; colour 2 on the clamp blocks.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Shacklethigh.description: A wide, angular thigh shackle: an octagonal metal band around the upper left thigh with a raised seam, a square locking plate on each side and a rounded C-shaped handle loop at the back.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Shacklethigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the square lock plates; colour 1 on the handle loops.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A small angular fin-like guard strapped to the outer left thigh above the knee: layered pointed plates sweep upward and back like a shark fin, held by a thin strap around the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer fin plates and spikes; colour 1 on the inner and back panels; colour 2 on the front panel and strap; colour 3 on small accents at the lower edge.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_01.differs: The female fin is slightly taller with a larger contrasting outer plate, while the male has a darker front panel and more separate spikes along the lower edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Space_Scound.description: A sci-fi thigh holster on the left leg: a tall angled pouch shell hangs at the outer thigh from a flat strap around the leg, with a diagonal strap and a flat octagonal plate below.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Space_Scound.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster shell, thigh band and plate edges; colour 1 on the plate top and the strap's inner section; colour 2 on the diagonal strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Space_Scound.description: A sci-fi thigh holster on the left leg: a flat band wraps the upper thigh, with a boxy, angular holster shell on the outer side and a long strap sweeping up toward the hip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Space_Scound.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band and holster shell; colour 1 on the band's top surface and a strap section; colour 2 on the long diagonal strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A set of conical spikes studded in vertical rows down the outer side of the left thigh, with larger spikes pointing outward and smaller ones alongside. Sits directly on the leg with no base garment, giving a monstrous or punk edge.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_Calf_.description: Three curved, tapering horn-like spikes stacked in a vertical row on the outer left calf, each with a flared base collar and a long sweeping point. A monstrous, beast-like leg accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_Calf_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base collars.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_Thigh.description: Three curved, tapering horn-like spikes stacked in a vertical line down the outer left thigh, each sweeping outward and backward from a short collar-like base. A monstrous, creature-inspired accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_Thigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each spike; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base rim of each spike.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A lumpy, bone-like armor mass with blunt spikes and knobbly ridges, hanging off the outer hip and upper thigh. Its rough, monstrous surface has rows of small oval markings on the outer face.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bony shell; colour 1 on the oval markings and recessed patches along the lower face.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Steampunk_Co.description: A short, open-topped tubular cuff or sleeve hanging at the outer hip, made of stiff panelled material with stitched edging. Three buckled straps wrap around it, with a studded strap band across the top. Suggests a steampunk western holster.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Steampunk_Co.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the cuff; colour 1 on the straps and studded top band; colour 3 on the stitched edge lines; colour 2 on the buckles.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A hip accessory on the left side: a small boxy pack with a vertical seam and a small round indicator light, and a fan of several long striped straps that sweep back over the hip, held by contrasting clamp bands.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pack body and the strap edges; colour 1 on the stripes of the straps; colour 2 on the clamp bands and the pack's vertical seam; colour 3 on the small indicator light.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapped_02.description: A small rectangular box-style pouch worn on the outer left thigh at the hip, with a padded body, a flap on the back edge closed by a round stud, and a contrasting vertical strap running down its side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapped_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and vertical strap; colour 3 on the round stud; colour 1 on the side panel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapsasquat.description: Four thin, flat bands wrapped around the left thigh at slightly uneven angles and spacing, each with a slight angular bend at the side. A simple tribal or street-style leg accessory sitting on the mid to upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapsasquat.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all four bands; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapsthigh_.description: A wrap of overlapping criss-crossing strips bound around the left mid-thigh, finished with a solid band at the top and bottom edges. A short, snug cuff-like piece with a casual, street or punk feel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapsthigh_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom edge bands; colour 0 on the light wrapping strips; colour 2 on the darker strips and gaps between wraps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sword_01.description: A sheathed sword hanging at the left hip: a long segmented scabbard with a flared, angular guard-shaped mouth, a small crossguard piece and a wrapped hilt pointing up along the side of the waist.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard mouth and scabbard body; colour 1 on the crossguard and hilt end cap; colour 2 on the grip and scabbard tip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Thighpad_01.description: A padded thigh guard on the outer left thigh: a rounded, ribbed front plate with a contrasting rolled band at its lower edge, held by two contrasting straps that wrap around the leg. Sporty, tactical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Thighpad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed plate; colour 1 on the lower rolled band; colour 2 on the two wrap-around straps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Tyrant_01.description: Two separate faceted armour plates strapped to the outer left thigh: a long upper plate at hip level and a shorter one above the knee, with chunky angular edges. A rugged, monstrous mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Tyrant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both plates; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Victory_01.description: A small curved hip panel hanging at the left hip: a rounded, pointed-tip shield shape with a raised border and layered, stitched inner panels stepping down to a point. Suggests a superhero hip guard.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer rim and back shell; colour 0 on the inner lower panel; colour 3 on the middle curved band; colour 1 on the upper panel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Vine_01.description: A small wrap-like leaf or fin shape on the left outer thigh, draped over the leg with swirled underside patterning, a curling tendril tip rising toward the hip and small thorn-like spikes along the edge.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer surface; colour 0 on the swirled underside and lower band; colour 3 on the thorn spikes and the curled tip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Vine_01.differs: The female version is wider and more rounded, sitting more flatly on the thigh with a shorter, less pointed lower end.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Amazo.description: A straight, broad-bladed sword hanging point-down at the left hip, with a wrapped grip, round pommel, ornate winged guard and short loose cords. The blade has a darkened, slightly serrated edge. Suggests a fantasy warrior look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Amazo.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blade; colour 1 on the guard; colour 3 on the grip wrap and cords; colour 0 on the pommel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Escri.description: A single escrima stick carried in a small holder at the left hip, hanging straight down the outer thigh. It has a banded striped shaft, a capped top end and a curved flap that sits against the hip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Escri.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stick shaft; colour 3 on the stripes along the shaft; colour 2 on the holder, flap and top bands; colour 1 on the small stud on the holder.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Gamer.description: A chunky retro sci-fi toy-style blaster hanging upright at the left hip: a boxy body with a contrasting angled panel and small studs, a long slim barrel pointing down, and a ribbed cap at the muzzle.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Gamer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gun body and barrel; colour 1 on the muzzle cap and the accent blocks on the body; colour 2 on the side panel; colour 3 on the small round lights.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Sides.description: A long rapier-style side sword hanging at the left hip, with a straight narrow blade, a swept metal hand guard with curling loops, a wrapped grip and a round pommel. Thin cords trail from the guard.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Sides.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the blade and the trailing cords; colour 1 on the grip; colour 2 on the hand guard and pommel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Tonfa.description: A tonfa holstered at the left hip: a long straight baton hangs down the outer thigh in a small contrasting bracket, with a short side handle sticking out sideways. Marked with thin stripe details near the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Tonfa.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baton body; colour 1 on the side handle; colour 2 on the mounting bracket and handle end cap; colour 3 on the stripe markings along the baton.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Wood_.description: A small toy sword worn at the left hip: a straight, flat wooden blade, a chunky crossguard, a wrapped grip and a round pommel. It hangs point-down beside the thigh as a playful, simple accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Wood_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade; colour 2 on the crossguard; colour 3 on the grip wrapping; colour 0 on the pommel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Wrappedstrap.description: A set of overlapping wrapped straps spiralling around the left thigh, criss-crossing in bands of varying width with a small round fastener and a patch near the lower edge; a rough, bandage-like partial leg accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Wrappedstrap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide outer wrap bands and round fastener; colour 1 on the underlying wrap layers; colour 2 on the central bands; colour 3 on the small patches near the lower edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Traveler_01.description: A short tubular thigh sleeve worn on the left upper leg, with a rimmed top edge, a curved hem, and two contrasting straps fastened with ring buckles across the front. It suggests a utilitarian space-traveller look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sleeve body; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 3 on the ring buckles; colour 2 on the top rim and hem edging.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Vigilante_01.description: A left thigh rig of two padded straps with clasp buckles, joined to a flap pouch that hangs at the outer hip with a snap button and a contrasting tab. Practical vigilante or tactical styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and pouch body; colour 3 on the buckle clasps and the pouch snap button; colour 1 on the pouch tab.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Vigilante_02.description: Two octagonal straps wrap the upper left thigh, each with a large square buckle at the front and a contrasting edge trim. Two boxy flap pouches hang from the outer and rear side of the straps.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap centre bands and the pouches; colour 1 on the strap edges and trim; colour 3 on the buckles and small strap tabs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Waistbag_01.description: A hip-slung thigh bag on the left side: a patterned webbing belt runs around the hips with looping leg straps and ring fasteners, holding a flap pouch with studded closures and a small side holder.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Waistbag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbing straps and pouch body; colour 1 on the rings and studs; colour 2 on the pouch flaps and side holder; colour 3 on the stitched edging.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Brainscramb.description: A chunky sci-fi blaster pistol worn at the outer left hip and thigh, with an angular body, ridged contrasting grip and barrel, an open frame, a short antenna spike, and a row of three capsule-like canisters along one side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Brainscramb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and frame; colour 1 on the grip panels; colour 2 on the ridged barrel and grip; colour 3 on the canisters.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Chakram_01.description: A circular chakram weapon worn flat against the outer left hip: a ring with a blade edge, curved horn-like points at the gap, an ornately etched inner band and a wrapped grip section along the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Chakram_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade edges; colour 1 on the inner band; colour 3 on the etched swirl patterns; colour 2 on the wrapped grip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Cleaver_01.description: A large rectangular butcher's cleaver with a wide flat blade and a handle with rivets, hanging blade-down at the side of the left hip like a carried weapon. Rough, gritty street or monstrous flavour.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Cleaver_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle scales; colour 0 on the handle edge trim; colour 0 on the blade with a darker steel look.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Cold_01.description: A sci-fi pistol in a bulky angular holster-shell worn against the outer left thigh, with a round dial, ribbed vents, layered armor plates and a protruding grip angled up toward the hip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Cold_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster shell and plates; colour 1 on the pistol grip and the rings inside the housing; colour 3 on the vent slats and ring accents; colour 2 on the darker casing and barrel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Combat_Knif.description: A hanging combat knife with a curved, forward-swelling kukri-style blade and a short banded handle with small pin holes, hung at the left hip so it dangles down the outer thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Combat_Knif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle and its band; colour 1 on the blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Destabiliza.description: A compact sci-fi blaster hanging at the outer thigh: a tapered, angular housing with a bulky segmented base, a thin side rod, and several claw-like prongs pointing down from the muzzle. Reads as a mechanical hip-mounted gadget.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Destabiliza.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper housing, side rod and outer frame; colour 0 on the central barrel section and prong tips; colour 2 on the lower base; colour 3 on the small inset panels and stripes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Gunsword_01.description: A hip-mounted pistol-sword: a long straight blade with a serrated edge extends downward from a revolver-style cylinder and grip, hanging vertically at the left hip. Rugged mechanical hybrid weapon look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Gunsword_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the grip; colour 3 on the frame and hammer; colour 2 on the cylinder and blade base; colour 0 on the blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Hammer_01.description: A claw hammer worn hanging at the left hip, with a long slightly flared handle and a rounded head with a curved split claw. It hangs handle-up along the outer thigh like a holstered tool.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Hammer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle; colour 1 on the hammer head and claw.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Hatchet_01.description: A small hatchet worn hanging at the left thigh: a long straight handle with a collar at the base and a compact single-bladed axe head pointing sideways at the bottom. Reads as a practical hip-carried tool.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Hatchet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle; colour 0 on the axe head and collar.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Icepick_01.description: A mountaineering ice axe hanging at the left hip, point-down along the thigh. It has a long straight shaft with a padded grip at the top, a curved serrated pick and a flat adze blade at the bottom.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Icepick_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lower shaft; colour 2 on the padded grip; colour 0 on the pick, adze and end spike; colour 3 on a small stud on the grip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Katana_01.description: A sheathed katana worn at the left hip, hanging diagonally down the outer thigh. It has a wrapped hilt, a round guard, a slightly curved scabbard with a capped tip and short tie cords at the hip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Katana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard; colour 2 on the hilt wrap, guard and scabbard tip; colour 1 on the tie cords; colour 3 on small accents in the hilt wrap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Kunai_01.description: A single ninja kunai hanging point-down at the left hip: a leaf-shaped double-edged blade, a wrapped handle and a round ring at the top. Reads as a throwing-knife accessory in an east-asian ninja style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Kunai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the wrapped handle; colour 1 on the ring.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Mad_Scienti.description: A small retro ray gun worn at the left hip: a boxy, angular body with a perforated barrel tipped by a contrasting cap, contrasting-ringed coils, and a flared dish base with claw-like prongs gripping the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Mad_Scienti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gun body, barrel and base prongs; colour 1 on the barrel tip, dish base and small side fittings; colour 3 on the coil rings and dots.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Mad_Scienti.description: A chunky sci-fi ray blaster hanging at the left hip: a boxy casing with a round lens housing, a curved grip and hooked top handle, and a small canister slung beneath, ending in a ribbed nozzle.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Mad_Scienti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and lens housing; colour 1 on the grip, top handle and nozzle tip; colour 2 on the barrel sleeve and canister base; colour 3 on the lens and small dots.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Maraca_01.description: A single maraca hanging at the left hip: a rounded, egg-shaped rattle with zigzag and banded patterned stripes, a small collar ring, and a long tapering handle angled upward and forward.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Maraca_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle and the band near the top of the rattle; colour 0 on the collar ring and the zigzag bands; colour 3 on the zigzag bands; colour 2 on the thin stripes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Newspaper_0.description: A rolled-up newspaper worn as a hip accessory on the left side, hanging vertically along the outer thigh. It is a loose spiral roll, slightly pinched in the middle, printed with columns of text.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Newspaper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the newsprint roll; the printed text and creases are part of the texture and take no separate colour slot.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pipe_Wrench.description: A large pipe wrench hanging at the left hip: a fat rounded grip with a capped end, a thin shank, and a chunky adjustable jaw housing with a curved hooked jaw at the bottom. Casual mechanic's prop look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pipe_Wrench.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the grip; colour 2 on the grip end cap; colour 1 on the jaw housing; colour 0 on the shank and hooked jaw.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_02.description: A compact submachine gun held on the outer left thigh in an open angular frame-style holster that wraps around the leg, with a short barrel pointing forward and a boxy body with a vertical magazine.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster frame; colour 0 on the gun body; colour 2 on the barrel and grip housing; colour 3 on the small dots on the gun.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_05.description: A tall, narrow revolver holster hanging at the outer left thigh, held by a thin octagonal thigh strap. The holster has a rounded side plate and studs, with the pistol grip and cartridges showing at the top. Western style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body and thigh strap; colour 1 on the side plate, grip and holster bands; colour 3 on the cartridges; colour 2 on the hammer and rivets.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_Scif.description: A retro sci-fi pistol worn on the outer left thigh, hanging with the barrel pointing down. It has an angular grip, a wrapped holster-like casing around the barrel and a boxy magazine with slotted vents.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_Scif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the grip, barrel and body of the pistol; colour 1 on the wrap around the barrel; colour 2 on the magazine block and upper fittings; colour 3 on the slots in the magazine.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Renegade_01.description: A hip-mounted sickle weapon hanging at the left thigh: a ring pommel on a wrapped handle with a collar, leading to a curved, hooked blade with a jagged, serrated edge and mottled metal finish.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle wrap; colour 0 on the pommel ring and collar; the blade is a glossy metal with a mottled finish that largely ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Roller_01.description: A cartoonish wooden rolling pin hanging vertically at the side of the left hip: a thick, slightly faceted, textured barrel with a narrow turned handle projecting from each end. Playful kitchen-weapon prop.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Roller_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central barrel; colour 1 on both handles.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Sai_01.description: A sai strapped to the outer left thigh: a flat octagonal band circles the upper leg, holding a long tapering spike with a cord-wrapped handle and two curved side prongs hanging point-down.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Sai_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the thigh band; colour 1 on the wrapped handle; colour 3 on the blade; colour 0 on the curved prongs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Sickle_03.description: A hip-mounted sickle with a short ribbed handle and a broad, deeply curved crescent blade that hangs down the outer thigh, with a small guard where the blade meets the grip. Suggests a fantasy or monstrous weapon.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Sickle_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the handle end cap; colour 0 on the blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spatula_01.description: A kitchen spatula hanging at the left hip: a slotted flipper blade on a long thin metal shaft, with a thick studded grip and a loop end at the top. Hangs down the outer thigh like a holstered weapon.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spatula_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the loop at the top of the handle; colour 2 on the handle grip and studs; the metal shaft and blade ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spy_01.description: A sci-fi spy pistol hanging vertically at the left thigh, with a boxy grip pointing upward, a chunky slide with ribbed panels, and a long suppressor of two studded cylinders extending down the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and slide; colour 1 on the ribbed panels, grip insert and suppressor cylinders; colour 3 on the small sights and stud dots; colour 2 on the grip panel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spy_02.description: A closed umbrella hanging at the left hip, pointing down along the thigh. It has a hooked curved handle, a thin shaft, a furled canopy with a band and a small pointed metal tip; a few loose ribs stick out near the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furled canopy; colour 1 on the canopy band and stripes near the top; colour 3 on the hooked handle; colour 2 on the shaft and tip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Stick_02.description: A slender, gently curving branch-like stick with one short side twig near the thick top end, hanging along the outside of the left hip and thigh. A rustic, natural-looking carried weapon or staff.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Stick_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire stick; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Straplesspi.description: A tall, tapered western-style revolver holster hanging on the outer left thigh, with banded panels, a round side plate and a row of studs at the mouth. A revolver with a curved grip and contrasting cartridges sits in it, strapless.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Straplesspi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower holster body bands and the revolver frame; colour 1 on the upper holster, round plate, stripes, cuff at the base and revolver grip; colour 2 on the studs and hammer; colour 3 on the cartridges and grip trim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Swing_Cane_.description: A slim swing cane hanging diagonally at the left hip: a curved crook handle, a segmented collar joint, a long straight shaft and a small forked metal claw tip at the bottom. Suggests a gadget or gentleman's weapon.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Swing_Cane_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved handle; colour 3 on the long shaft; colour 2 on the collar joint; colour 0 on the metal claw tip and fittings.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Swing_Pisto.description: A flintlock-style swing pistol carried muzzle-down at the left hip: a curved grip with a round pommel, a cylindrical chamber with a hammer and trigger guard, and a long barrel with a glowing slot and a capped tip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Swing_Pisto.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel and frame; colour 1 on the grip and inner stripe; colour 2 on the chamber, pommel and muzzle cap; colour 3 on the glowing barrel slot.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Trooper_01.description: A slim sci-fi blaster or sidearm hung vertically at the outer left hip, with a long angular body, a tall side plate, a looping open handle frame and a segmented, glowing-looking core strip down its side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and side plates; colour 1 on the looping handle frame and outer bracket; colour 2 on the muzzle end and inner channel; colour 3 on the core strip and circuit-like markings.

Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Wheellockpi.description: A holstered flintlock-style pistol hanging at the left hip: a tapered, open-topped holster shell with a curved grip poking out above and a long slim barrel extending down the outer thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Wheellockpi.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper holster shell; colour 0 on the lower holster body and barrel; colour 2 on the grip and barrel tip; colour 3 on the small lock details.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Alien_01.description: A chunky alien armour plate strapped to the outer right thigh, with a contrasting ridged upper shell, a banded lower cuff with a pointed lower edge, and several sharp spikes jutting out from the top and sides.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shell; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 1 on the lower cuff; colour 3 on the spikes and small studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Arcane_01.description: A wide band worn around the right upper thigh, with raised swirling scroll patterns across its surface and a round domed gem set on the outer side. Suggests an arcane, tribal-fantasy leg accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band base; colour 3 on the raised scroll patterns; colour 1 on the round gem; colour 2 on the open top interior.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Armored_01.description: A curved thigh guard of armor plating wrapping the outer right thigh, open toward the inside, with a raised angular rim at the top and a large hexagonal recessed panel with layered borders on the outer face.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell and outer rim; colour 1 on the raised border around the recess; colour 3 on the thin inner trim line; colour 2 on the recessed centre panel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_01.description: A curved flexible hose hanging at the right hip: a ribbed segmented tube joined to a soft fabric-wrapped section, with chunky collared connector caps and rounded nozzle tips at both ends. Suggests astronaut life-support gear.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wrapped hose section; colour 1 on the lower wrapped section; colour 2 on the ribbed tube and connector collars; colour 3 on the nozzle tips.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_01.differs: This version hangs a little further from the hip and its curve is looser, with the ribbed section longer than on the male.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_02.description: A flexible hose-like accessory hanging at the right hip: a ribbed segmented tube leads to a wrapped fabric-like section that curls back up into a second nozzle. Both ends have a capped connector and a rounded tip. Mechanical, space-suit feel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the nozzle tips; colour 2 on the ribbed tube and end connectors; colour 0 on the upper wrapped section; colour 1 on the lower wrapped section.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Birdpeople_01.description: A segmented, angular thigh guard wrapping the right upper leg, open at the front with a vertical slot and a faceted rim at top and bottom. Small contrasting clasps sit at the lower edge. Suggests sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 2 on the small clasps at the lower edge; colours 1 and 3 not visible.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Birdpeople_01.differs: The female guard has a taller open front slot that reaches nearly to the bottom clasp, and it sits slightly higher on the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_01.description: A tapered armored thigh guard on the right hip: an open-backed shell with a rimmed edge, a lighter inner panel, and round mechanical discs at the front and back. It narrows to a pointed tip near the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the inner panel; colour 2 on the disc housings; colour 3 on the disc centres.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_02.description: A long, tapering angular blade-like plate hanging from the right hip along the outer thigh, made of faceted planes that narrow to a sharp point above the knee, with small rivet studs near the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper faceted panel; colour 0 on the middle facets; colour 2 on the lower outer facets; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_01.description: A curved thigh guard on the right outer thigh: a hexagonal plate in a thick angular frame with a triangular inset, split by two cross bars, with a fabric strap around the leg and a contrasting backing shell.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the triangular inset; colour 2 on the frame, cross bars and backing shell; colour 3 on the strap.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_01.differs: The female guard is a flatter plate whose contrasting backing shell sits behind the thigh, while the male version has a taller, more rounded backing shell wrapping over the front of the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_02.description: A curved thigh guard worn on the right outer thigh: a translucent shield-like plate in a thick angular frame with an inset vertical panel, held by a fabric strap wrapped around the leg. Sci-fi western style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the frame and back plate; colour 1 on the inset vertical panels; colour 3 on the wrapping strap; colour 0 shows faintly on the translucent plate.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_02.differs: The female guard is a flat, narrow plate held out from the thigh, while the male version wraps further round the leg with a curved, domed back shell.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Brutal_01.description: A hip-mounted armour shell for the right side: a rounded, crumpled plate with a hollow interior, jagged fang-like points along its lower edge and a raised spike at the top. Suggests a monstrous or brutal look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole outer shell; the hollow interior shows as shadow with no visible slot.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Chains_01.description: A length of heavy chain wound loosely in several criss-crossing loops around the right thigh, spiralling steeply from upper to lower thigh. Gives a rugged, punk or industrial accent.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 in the gaps between links.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Chains_01.differs: The female chains spiral in taller, steeper loops that stretch further down the thigh, with a figure-eight crossing.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_0.description: A set of three curved, blade-like cloth flares that sweep down and outward from the outer right calf, stacked in a row, each tapering to a point with a diamond-shaped tip and small studs along its length.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved flare strips; colour 3 on the diamond tips and the small studs; colour 2 on the inner edges of the strips.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_0.differs: The female flares are stacked in a tidy row of three down the outer side of the calf, whereas the male version has them split into a pair and a separate single flare.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_0.description: A foot accessory of curved, blade-like spines stacked down the outer lower leg near the ankle, each curling forward, with diamond-shaped hanging tips at the bottom. A monstrous, clawed look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved spines; colour 3 on the diamond-shaped tips and small studs along the spines.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_01.description: Three small, separate pointed spikes floating down the outer side of the right thigh toward the knee, growing larger toward the bottom. They look like bony, mutated growths for a monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_01.differs: The female spikes are shorter and more angular and stubby, with a blunter, faceted lowest spike.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_02.description: A small cluster of bony, tapered spikes on the outer right leg: one large curved horn near the upper knee and two smaller thorn-like spikes below it, pointing outward and down. Monstrous accent.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the piece shows no other colour slots.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_02.differs: The female version has two small spikes below the large horn, while the male has two shorter, stubbier ones.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Scarab_01.description: A slender curved scorpion-like tail hanging from the right hip along the outer thigh, with a smooth bone-like shaft that ends in a segmented joint and a sharp hooked stinger. Suggests a monstrous, insectoid look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long tail shaft; colour 2 on the joint band above the stinger; colour 3 on the stinger tip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Scarab_02.description: A curved, hook-like scarab claw hanging at the right hip: a pointed spike rises from a banded base, and a sweeping armoured horn curls down the outer thigh with a small spiny fin and a tip at the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved horn body and fins; colour 3 on the upper spike; colour 2 on the band joining spike and horn; colour 0 on the lower tip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Tight_Ascend.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central hexagon ring, worn on the outer side of the right thigh. It is thin and outlined, like a decal or badge.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Tight_Ascend.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and hexagon; colour 1 on the thin outline edging.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Tight_Strapp.description: A small rectangular box pouch hanging at the right outer hip and thigh, with a padded flap, a round stud clasp, a narrow strap running down its side and contrasting edge trim. Compact, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Tight_Strapp.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and strap; colour 3 on the round clasp stud.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Vigilante_01.description: A small boxy pouch worn on the right hip, with a padded rounded body and a folding flap closed by a round snap button, plus a contrasting tab strip down the flap. Casual tactical utility style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the tab strip down the flap; colour 3 on the snap button.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Vigilante_02.description: A pair of boxy utility pouches with folded-over flap lids, set side by side on the outer right hip and upper thigh. Tactical, practical vigilante look with soft cloth-like construction.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Child_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both pouch bodies and flaps; no other slots clearly visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A segmented armored thigh guard for the right leg: angular layered plates wrap the outer thigh, with a raised upper flange, a flared lower cuff and jagged points just above the knee. Sci-fi mechanical styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main upper and lower plates; colour 0 on the mid-panel bands and rim edges; colour 3 on the side panel inserts; colour 2 on the small vents and the lower cuff points.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Corrupted_01.description: A single tapering hip-to-thigh plate on the right side, edged with jagged, bat-wing-like scalloped points and studded with curved horn-like spikes down its outer face; a monstrous, armoured side guard.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate body and edging; colour 1 on the curved spikes; colour 3 on the chevron-shaped inlays; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Cosmic_01.description: A short, wide faceted band worn around the right upper thigh, with an octagonal cross-section, raised rims at top and bottom, and glossy crystalline facets on its outer face. Suggests a sci-fi or alien leg cuff.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main band body and facets; colour 0 on the top and bottom rims; colour 1 on faint highlights in the facets. The glossy finish mutes the scheme.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Cosmic_01.differs: The female version has a glossy, faceted crystalline surface with a darker trim, while the male version is a smooth matte band with bright rims.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Cosmos_01.description: A curved, shell-like guard for the right thigh: a smooth glossy plate with a raised swooping rim and a hollowed front face, tapering to a angled point just below the knee. Sits on the outer thigh with a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the raised rim and lower section. The glossy default material shows little of the scheme.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Cosmos_02.description: A hollow, scoop-shaped armor guard worn on the outer right thigh, open and tapering toward the knee, with layered swept plates at the top and slim contrasting trim bands running down its length.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept upper plates and trim bands; colour 2 on the lower body of the guard; colour 3 on the recessed inserts; colour 0 on the glossy inner surface.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_01.description: A short segmented armour cuff wrapping the right upper thigh: a large front plate with a contrasting horizontal band, and stacked angular panels at the back and side. Open at the top, ending above the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front and outer plates; colour 3 on the horizontal band and upper back panel; colour 2 on the middle back panel; colour 0 on the lower back panel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_Hoses_01.description: A bulky armoured thigh guard on the right leg: an open-topped shell with rounded padded plates, a wrapped flexible hose looping up to a capped end at the hip, and a small separate pad above the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell frame and rims; colour 1 on the side inset panel; colour 2 on the padded plates, caps and knee pad; colour 3 on the hose.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_Hoses_01.differs: The female version has a slightly shorter, more tapered shell, with the hose looping further out at the side.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Draco_01.description: A rigid thigh guard wrapping the right upper leg, with a tall pointed fin-like plate up the front, a curved panel on the side, a raised flat cap at the back top and a banded rim at top and bottom.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main side panel; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim bands; colour 3 on the front fin, the back cap and the strip down the back; colour 2 on the edging and lower band.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Draco_01.differs: The female version has a contrasting top cap and a taller front fin that rises higher, while the male version has a contrasting cap and a front fin that stays lower.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_01.description: A hip-mounted thigh guard of overlapping bark-like plates with jagged, pointed upper edges, covered on the outer face by a rough mossy growth. It hangs from the hip to above the knee on the right leg, suggesting a woodland guardian style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the layered plates; colour 1 on the rough mossy patch over the outer face; colour 3 on thin vein-like lines along the plate edges.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_02.description: A small organic hip accessory of two curling, horn-like leaf or thorn shapes with pointed tips, joined at the base and hanging at the right hip beside the hand. Mottled surface suggests a fantasy nature or beast style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the curled shapes; colour 0 on the inner ridges, tips and mottled patches.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_02.differs: The female version's two horns are more widely splayed and slimmer, with more light-coloured ridging showing at the front.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A right-thigh guard made of overlapping bark-like plates with jagged, leaf-shaped upper edges and a rough mossy patch on the outer side. It sits on the outer hip and thigh, ending above the knee, in a fantasy nature style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the rough mossy patch on the outer side; colour 3 on the thin vein lines between the plates.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_Alt_01.differs: The female version is split into narrow, separated plates with visible gaps, and the moss patch sits mostly on the outer side. The male version has a broader smooth plate across the front.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Fire_01.description: A cluster of glossy, flame-shaped tongues that hangs from the right hip down the outer thigh, with jagged pointed tips and a swept, curling silhouette. It suggests a fiery, elemental hip accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; the flame body shows a reflective finish with faint sheen highlights, so colour slots have little visible effect.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Fire_02.description: A flame-shaped hip accessory on the right thigh: layered glossy swept tongues with jagged tattered tips flare from the hip and curl upward at the top, hanging to mid-thigh like a ragged mantle.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: Mostly glossy material that largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows as a faint sheen on some flame edges and undersides; the rest reads as the glossy body of the flames.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_01.description: A glossy, sculpted cluster of jagged wave-like shards and pointed fins that clings to the outside of the right thigh, hanging from hip to just above the knee. Elemental water-spike look with ragged trailing tips.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: The default glossy material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly in sheen on the shard undersides, and the rest reads as reflective surface.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_01.differs: The female version has a smaller, more compact mass with a flatter hip panel and fewer flared shards at the top.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_02.description: A glossy, fin-like hip and thigh attachment on the right side: layered swooping ribbed panels with curled tendril tips at the top, hanging to mid-thigh like a stylised wave or monstrous wing.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_02.colourAreas: The glossy material largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 2 appears on most of the panels, with faint colour 1 sheen along the ribs.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_02.differs: The female version hangs slightly longer and narrower, with a more tapering lower tip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A chunky angular armor plate worn on the outer right thigh: a faceted, coffin-shaped shell with a raised bevelled front panel, a small emblem, and a notched, stepped top edge. Suggests mechanical sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole plate body; colour 2 on the recessed edge grooves and the front panel border; the small emblem takes the same colour as the plate.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Falcon_01.description: A right thigh guard shaped like a tapering cuff, with a pointed lower edge, a raised front plate with swept spiky fins and a tall crystal-like point on top; a banded strap with a small diamond gem wraps the back.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the rim and edge trim; colour 2 on the spiked front plate and fins; colour 3 on the top point and the diamond gem.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Falcon_01.differs: The female guard sits a little higher and looks shorter, with a more pronounced flared lower point.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Frigid_01.description: A curved armour-like hip plate on the right thigh, with a bordered outer face holding a textured ribbed panel and an angled upper band. Its inside is a smooth open shell, giving a partial, sci-fi guard.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured central panel; colour 1 on the upper band and border of the outer face; colour 2 on the outer rim and the smooth inner shell.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Gladiator_01.description: A single angular hip guard on the right side: a curved shield-shaped plate with a thick raised rim and a contrasting inset panel with a small accent stripe, hanging along the outer thigh. Sci-fi armoured look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and top rim; colour 2 on the inner frame edging; colour 0 on the inset panel; colour 3 on the small accent stripes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Heraldry_01.description: A right thigh guard of curved armor plating that wraps the outer and front thigh, with a raised angular upper edge, a sculpted heraldic crest on the front, and a cuffed, flared band with a small emblem buckle above the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and the cuff band; colour 2 on the upper rim and lower knee trim; colour 3 on the crest and emblem; colour 1 on the knee-side panels.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Heraldry_01.differs: The female guard is longer and narrower, reaching lower down towards the knee, with a taller pointed upper edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Holohex_01.description: A cluster of angular, faceted floating plates clustered around the right lower leg, with a larger central block, small jutting fins above and a tapered shard below the calf. Suggests a holographic or mechanical sci-fi field.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Holohex_01.colourAreas: All of the piece renders as a single flat tone on this sheet, so the colour slots cannot be told apart; it appears to take colour 0.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Holster_Bounty_01.description: A slim leg holster worn on the right outer thigh: a padded pouch-like sleeve with an open loop at the front and a flat tapering strap extending up toward the hip, crossed by a single contrasting band.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Holster_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body and upper strap; colour 1 on the band across the holster.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Hoses_01.description: A pair of segmented, ribbed flexible hoses draped down the right hip and outer thigh, curving and looping with open cut ends. They hang loosely from the hip like dangling cables, suiting a mechanical or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on both hoses; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Ironclad_01.description: A curved armored thigh guard on the outer right hip, built from stacked horizontal bands with raised flared ridges between them and a thick rim along the front edge. Mechanical, angular styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rim and ridges between bands; colour 0 on the top band; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 2 on the lower band.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Kaiju_01.description: A monstrous armoured hip and thigh guard on the right leg: layered, jagged plates with a longer tapering panel hanging below, and several curved horn-like spikes rising from the hip side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper armour plates; colour 1 on the lower hanging panel; colour 2 on the horn spikes; colour 0 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Kaiju_01.differs: The female version hangs slimmer and longer, with a narrow lower panel that trails down the outer thigh, and the plates sit further back on the hip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Knight_01.description: A single curved thigh plate on the outer right leg, a shield-like shell with a raised rim, held by two thin octagonal straps that wrap around the thigh. Suggests knightly armour.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 1 on the rim edging; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Knight_01.differs: The female plate has a distinct raised edging around its rim and a rounder outline, while the male plate is plain-edged and more angular.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Knight_02.description: A curved plate guard worn on the outer right thigh, held by two loop straps around the leg, with a row of conical spikes along its outer edge and a few studs on the face. Medieval armor with a brutal edge.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and the spikes; colour 3 tints the lower plate surface; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Knight_02.differs: The female plate sits slightly further back on the thigh, with spikes running along its front edge and studs on the outer face.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_01.description: A curved hip guard worn on the right hip that wraps partway round the thigh, with a flared, pointed lower hem and a lattice of raised ribs. Its angular plates give a martial, armoured look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plate body; colour 0 on the raised lattice ribs and edge trim; colour 1 faintly on the inner lining.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The female version's plates are darker and more uniform, with less visible contrasting rim trim than the male version, and it sits slightly higher on the hip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_02.description: A beast-head hip guard styled like a snarling wolf or lion face with angular plates, a fanged muzzle and swept-back spiky mane blades, worn on the right hip like a fantasy martial-arts ornament.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the head and main plates; colour 0 on the curved mane spikes and tusks; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on some shadowed spikes and inner plates.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_01.description: Three separate octagonal bands stacked down the right leg: a wide thick band on the upper thigh, a thinner one above the knee, and a narrow one below the knee. Simple angular cuffs with a faceted look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the upper thigh band; colour 1 on the inside of the upper band and on the middle band; colour 2 on the lower band's outer surface, with colour 1 inside it.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_02.description: A set of three octagonal bands stacked down the right leg: a wide, creased wrap high on the thigh, a slim band below it, and a thin band at the knee, each with a small stud.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide upper thigh wrap; colour 1 on the inside of the wrap and on the slim middle band; colour 2 on the lower knee band; colour 3 on the small studs.
