Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_02.differs: The female upper wrap is taller with more pronounced criss-cross creasing, and the bands sit slightly closer together.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_01.description: A boxy mechanical thigh pack on the right leg: an angular panelled block with a contrasting vertical slot on its face and a raised back plate, plus a round dial-like disc mounted on the outer side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy housing; colour 2 on the vertical slot; colour 1 on the round side disc; colour 3 on the dashed ring detail of the disc.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_01.differs: The female disc sits fully on the outer side of the box and is mostly hidden from the front, while the box sits slightly lower on the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_02.description: A boxy, angular mechanical thigh guard worn on the right outer hip and upper thigh. Faceted plates form an open-topped shell with a tall raised fin on the outer side and a stepped lower edge.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the tall outer fin and upper side panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_02.differs: The female version's shell sits lower and is narrower, with the tall fin angled back along the outer hip and a slim gap under the lower edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A curved armoured hip and thigh guard for the right leg: a rounded shell with a raised upper rim, a large padded side panel, thin piping along its edge, a small round fastener and a thick bevelled hem.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the large padded panel; colour 3 on the thin piping; colour 2 on the bottom hem.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Modern_Ironclad_01.differs: The female guard sits a little lower and is narrower at the front, with a taller flared rim at the hip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Moth_01.description: A single wing-like fabric panel hanging from the right hip along the outer thigh, pointed at the top with a raised edge and tapering to a ragged, slightly flared hem near the knee. Suggests a moth-wing side flap.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised upper edge and top of the panel; colour 3 on the lower body of the panel, fading in from the top.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mutated_01.description: A fleshy, mutated growth on the right outer hip and thigh: a tapering, folded mass of lumpy tissue hanging to the knee, studded with several small contrasting spikes along the front edge.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy mass; colour 0 on the spikes; colour 1 on small patches at the back; colour 2 on small spots near the lower front.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mutated_02.description: A mutated, fleshy growth wrapped along the outer right thigh, with layered ridged lobes that sweep up into a curved horn-like tip and taper into a pointed tail below the knee, dotted with small spikes.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy body of the growth; colour 0 on the small spikes and claws; colour 1 on a small nodule; colour 2 on a bulbous node.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Newholster_01.description: A small holster sleeve worn on the outer right thigh: a tall tapered cloth-like pouch with a slanted open top, a strap with a square buckle around it, and ornate scrolled flourishes above. Western style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Newholster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body; colour 1 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle and scrolled ornaments.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Newholster_01.differs: The female holster has a shorter, more angled flare at the bottom edge and sits slightly more forward on the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Persian_Sword_01.description: A hip-mounted curved sword hanging at the right thigh: a long blade sweeping down into a hooked, backward-curving tip, with a ribbed grip, a round gem-set pommel, and an angular bracket clip holding it at the hip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Persian_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bracket clip; colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the grip and pommel; colour 3 on the pommel gem.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Pirate_Fancy_Gun.description: A holstered flintlock-style pistol hanging at the right hip, pointing downward: a curved rounded grip with octagonal end plate, a wide strapped band, and a slim barrel with a flared muzzle tip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Pirate_Fancy_Gun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved grip body; colour 1 on the wide band around the grip; colour 2 on the barrel, muzzle and grip end plate; colour 3 on the thin rod along the barrel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Pirate_Fancy_Sword.description: A long slender rapier hanging at the right hip, with a looping swept hilt guard, crossed quillon bars and a small pommel. The thin blade angles down and back past the knee. Pirate swashbuckler style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Pirate_Fancy_Sword.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the looped hand guard; colour 2 on the crossed quillons and grip; colour 1 on the pommel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A single angular hip guard of layered, faceted plates that sweeps up into several pointed fins along the right outer hip and thigh, ending in a blunt rounded plate at the lower edge. Suggests a psionic dragon-scale look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and upper spikes; colour 1 on the lower edge trim. The material looks glossy and pale, so the scheme shows only weakly.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The female version has slightly taller, more separated spikes and a narrower, more pointed lower plate.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Pumpkin_01.description: A rib-cage-like bone cage wrapped around the right thigh: a vertical spine at the back and a narrower ridge at the front, with curved rib bars arching between them. Skeletal, macabre monster style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spine and many of the ribs; colour 1 on the front ridge, spine tips and alternating ribs; colour 2 on some ribs; colour 3 on a few ribs near the top.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Punk_01.description: A punk leg accessory of two buckled straps around the upper and lower thigh, joined by a long diagonal strap that rises toward the hip. The straps are studded with rounded dots.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 3 on the dot studs; colour 2 on the buckles.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Qularr_Armor_03.description: A short segmented armour guard wrapped around the right upper thigh: overlapping curved plates at the front and stacked horizontal bands at the back, with a flared open top rim. Suits fantasy or sci-fi armour looks.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Qularr_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and bands; colour 1 on the edges and recessed folds of the plates; colour 2 on the plate undersides.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Renegade_Straps_01.description: A column of six short, flat straps stacked down the outside of the right thigh, each wrapping partway round the leg and fastened with a small stud. Loose tab ends stick out at the side, giving a sci-fi renegade look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Renegade_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky angular armoured thigh guard worn on the right upper leg, a hollow tube of faceted plates with a raised hexagonal gem on the outer side and a contrasting inner band showing at the open top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer armour plates; colour 1 on the inner band and lining at the top; colour 3 on the hexagonal gem; colour 0 on the inner rim and edge highlights.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The female guard is narrower, and its front plate rises higher over the top with a notched opening.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A rigid, tapered thigh guard on the right leg: a smooth curved shell with a raised, swooping upper rim that sweeps higher at the front, a pointed lower edge, and a vertical inlaid strip with a pointed-arch motif.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the upper rim; colour 1 on the inlaid strip outline; colour 3 on the small mechanism detail within the strip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Retrosteelhead_01.differs: The female guard has a taller, swooping rim that rises at the front and slopes down the back, so it reads as slanted rather than level.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Sandstorm_01.description: A tapered thigh guard wrapping the right upper leg, with a slanted open top edge and notched lower edge. Raised curved and slashed panels run down the outer face, giving a sleek sci-fi armour look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main guard shell; colour 1 on the raised curved bracket-shaped panels; colour 3 on the slanted slash panels; colour 2 on the thin edge trim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Sandstorm_02.description: A curved thigh guard worn on the outer right thigh: a rounded, bevelled armor plate with a pointed lower panel, held by two thick straps that wrap around the leg. Suggests a mechanical or armored look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the lower pointed panel; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_01.description: A curved armour-like plate worn along the outer right thigh, with a slender raised ridge running down its edge that ends in a pointed claw-like tip, plus a angular cap near the knee. Suggests a mechanical scarab shell.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plate; colour 2 on the edge outline and inner lining; colour 3 on the pointed tip; colour 1 on the knee cap.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_01.differs: The female plate has a smoother, more rounded lower edge, while the male version has a jagged notched back edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_02.description: A rounded, shell-like thigh guard on the right leg, with a broad top rim, a tapering lower panel edged in trim, curling fin-like fronds along the sides and a tall curved spike at the hip; a segmented panel shows at the back.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lower shell; colour 2 on the top rim and bottom edge trim; colour 1 on the curling side fronds; colour 3 on the hip spike and the segmented back panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_02.differs: The female version's top rim sits a little lower and is more angled, with a slightly less bulky shell than the male one.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_01.description: A single curved, bone-like claw that hangs from the right hip down the outer thigh, a smooth tapering arm ending in a contrasting collar and a sharp hooked talon. Suggests a monstrous, insectoid or mechanical hip accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long curved shaft; colour 2 on the collar band at the base of the talon; colour 3 on the pointed talon tip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_01.differs: The female claw is more slanted and hangs diagonally across the hip and thigh, while the male one hangs more vertically.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_02.description: A curved, hook-like insectoid claw hanging at the right hip and running down the outer thigh: a tapering pointed tip on a banded base, a long arched shell blade, and a small spined fin curling off it.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the pointed tip; colour 2 on the band at the base of the tip; colour 1 on the curved shell blade and spined fin; colour 0 on the lower end cap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Spooky_01.description: A monstrous hip-mounted cluster of overlapping jagged spiked plates or feathers that tapers into a long point down the outer right thigh, with small contrasting-looking gem studs near the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plates and spikes; colour 1 on the lower tapering tips, blending in as a gradient; colour 3 on the small eye-like gems near the top.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Spy_01.description: A sci-fi spy pistol holstered on the right thigh: a strap band with a flat octagonal plate holds a boxy pistol with ribbed grips and a long ridged suppressor barrel pointing down the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body; colour 1 on the thigh plate top, ribbed grip sections and suppressor barrel; colour 2 on the thigh strap and plate edge; colour 3 on the small accent stripes and sensor.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_01.description: A right thigh guard made of two stacked octagonal armor plates joined by a thin angular wire loop, with a faceted gem-like spike and a pointed side blade panel. Sits on the outer upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two octagonal plates and the edging of the side blade; colour 0 on the inner side blade panel; colour 2 on the wire loop; colour 3 on the faceted gem.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_02.description: A right-thigh armour guard: a smooth curved sleeve panel along the outer thigh, capped by a faceted angular plate at the top and a pointed chevron cuff lower down, with layered trim bands between.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long sleeve panel along the thigh; colour 1 on the faceted upper plate and lower chevron cuff; colour 3 on the thin trim band under the upper plate; colour 2 on the top edge lining.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_02.differs: The female upper plate is smaller and sits higher, with a more sharply pointed lower cuff, and the guard hugs the outer thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Steelcommando_01.description: A curved armor plate that wraps the outer right thigh, with a raised faceted panel on the front and a contrasting flared back shell that ends in ragged, pointed tails above the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised front panel; colour 2 on the main shell and jagged lower edge; colour 0 on the thin edge highlights along the rim.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Steelcommando_01.differs: The female plate is narrower and sits closer to the outer thigh, with a longer, more ragged lower edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Super_Retro_Destro.description: A single curved, shield-shaped hip plate that cups the outer right hip and upper thigh, tapering to a point downward with a slightly raised rim and hollow interior. Suggests retro superhero armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Super_Retro_Destro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the plate, fading to colour 2 toward the lower point; the rim edge is picked out in colour 0. The metallic finish partly ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Super_Retro_Destro.differs: The female plate sits slightly higher and wraps more toward the front of the hip, with a shallower rim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Symbiote_01.description: A curved, leaf-shaped shell plate worn on the outer right hip and thigh, with an oval inset panel and two pointed faceted crystal spikes jutting out. Suggests an alien symbiote armour growth.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell plate; colour 1 on the inset oval panel; colour 3 on the two faceted spikes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Thigharmor_Draycul.description: A right thigh guard of two stacked, angular armor plates with pointed notched edges and small rivets, held by two thick rounded straps that loop around the thigh. Sits on the outer thigh; sci-fi or monstrous armor style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Thigharmor_Draycul.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surfaces; colour 1 on the plate edge trim; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Thigharmor_Rockcry.description: A cluster of chunky, faceted rock slabs hanging from the right hip and outer thigh, with cracked seams between plates and a couple of pointed shards dangling lower. Monstrous, stony armor accent.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Thigharmor_Rockcry.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock plates; colour 3 on the glowing crack lines between the plates.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Thigharmor_Rockcry.differs: The female version has slightly fewer, more compact plates hanging in a tighter cluster.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.description: A thigh band worn high on the right leg: a segmented panel strap carrying a large buttoned pouch, a row of bullet-like ammo cartridges, a boxy vented module and small tab clips. Tactical, 90s action-hero look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the pouch, side plates and tab clips; colour 2 on the boxy module and small blocks; colour 3 on the cartridges.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_0.description: A chunky faceted band worn around the upper right thigh, with a many-sided angular profile, a raised rounded boss on the outer side and a contrasting upper rim. Suggests a retro superhero or mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band body and the round boss; colour 1 on the upper rim section.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_0.differs: The female band has a single round boss on the outer side, and it sits slightly higher on the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Alien_02.description: A small rounded kneepad worn on the right knee: a smooth oval shell with two inset side panels and a raised rim, topped by a curved, overhanging band that shields the top of the knee. Suggests alien sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the two inset side panels; colour 2 on the curved top band.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Cartrid.description: A thigh band studded with a row of upright bullet-like cartridges with pointed tips, plus a pair of boxy magazine pouches with flat panels at the outer side. Worn on the upper right thigh in a tactical style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Cartrid.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and cartridge collars; colour 1 on the cartridge bodies; colour 2 on the pouch panels and cartridge tips; colour 3 on the pouch frames and thin bands between the cartridges.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Cartrid.differs: The female version has two magazine pouches at the outer side of the thigh, set side by side.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A pair of stacked, overlapping curved plates forming a small hip guard on the right side, each with a raised pointed lower edge and a contrasting rim. It wraps the outer upper thigh like fin-shaped armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 2 on the raised rims and edges of each plate.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: Three curved, blade-like fins stacked down the right hip and outer thigh, each a swept, tapering spike with a contrasting edge. They flare backwards around the hip, giving a monstrous aquatic look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top fin face; colour 1 on the middle fin face; colour 0 on the lowest fin face; colour 2 on the edges of all three fins.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armor_Ancien.description: A single curved thigh plate on the right leg, split by narrow vertical slits, with spiral, maze-like engraved patterns and a weathered stone-like surface. Two loose strap loops encircle the thigh to hold it in place.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armor_Ancien.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 1 on the engraved spiral lines; colour 3 on the two thigh straps; colour 2 on the worn, scuffed patches.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armor_Extrat.description: A right-leg armor set of segmented plates: a long thigh guard, a separate shin guard and a small textured foot piece, held by thin loop bands around the leg. Angular, mottled plating with glowing-line panel details gives an alien, mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armor_Extrat.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the loop bands around the thigh and shin; colour 1 on the inset line patterns along the plates; the plate surfaces and foot piece show a mottled default texture that mostly ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorninja.description: A angular armored thigh guard for the right leg: a faceted, open-backed shell with a raised pointed front ridge and layered panels, sitting on the upper thigh above the knee. Ninja-like, sleek and segmented.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer front ridge and rear edge plates; colour 1 on the main curved panels; colour 2 on the side and inner shell; colour 3 on the small lower accents.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_0.description: A segmented armored thigh guard on the right leg: a curved, layered shell of angular plates with small vent slits, a flared upper rim and a pointed lower edge, open at the back with a recessed inner panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer plates; colour 1 on the small end caps and the recessed inner stripe; colour 3 on the vent slits; colour 2 on the inner edges of the rim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_0.description: A small faceted kneepad on the right knee: an angular, segmented shell with a raised central ridge and pointed tabs extending above and below the joint. Suggests monstrous or mechanical armour.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faceted shell; colour 1 on the central ridge and the upper and lower pointed tabs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A curved shield-shaped thigh plate worn on the outer right thigh, with a bevelled raised rim, a notched lower edge and an atom emblem on the face. Superhero-style armour panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim; colour 1 on the main plate face; colour 0 on the atom emblem.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A draped cloth swag hung from two round medallion clasps at the right hip, one on the front and one on the back, falling in soft folds to a loose point along the outer thigh. Fantasy sash style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped cloth; colour 1 on the rims of the medallion clasps; colour 3 on the star-shaped centres of the medallions.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_02.differs: The female drape hangs more as a single panel with a narrower swag between the clasps and a shorter fold at the back.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bandtied_01.description: A narrow cloth band wrapped around the right upper thigh, tied in a small knot at the outer side with two short pointed tails hanging down. Casual, understated accessory with a faceted, gathered look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bandtied_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band, knot and tails; no other colour slots visible.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bandtied_01.differs: The knot and tails sit on the outer side of the thigh, angled toward the front, rather than toward the back as on the male version.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer.description: A plain, short tapered greave shaped as an octagonal tube, worn around the right lower leg above the ankle, with contrasting rims at top and bottom. Simple, smooth and partial in coverage.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the greave; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim bands.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer.description: A short ankle bracer cuff with a contrasting rim and edging, a chunky cross-shaped ornament on the front of the shin, and a large curved, scythe-like blade sweeping out and back from the outer side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer cuff; colour 1 on the rim and edge trim; colour 3 on the cross ornament; colour 2 on the curved blade.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer.differs: The female version's blade sits further back and points straight behind the ankle, with a smaller cross set higher on the cuff.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bowtie_01.description: A thigh garter band worn high on the right leg, with an angular faceted ring and a large rosette-style bow on the outer side. Pointed ribbon tails and small spikes fan out from the centre medallion, giving a cute, magical-girl look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band edges, rosette points and ribbon tails; colour 1 on the bow loops, medallion and band panels; colour 2 on the inner band and bow folds; colour 3 on small accent panels beneath the bow.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel.description: A short tapered armoured bracer wrapped around the lower right leg near the ankle, with a thin octagonal rim at each end and a large angular cross-shaped spike mounted on the outer front. Fantasy angelic-warrior styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the rims and edge framing; colour 3 on the cross ornament.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel.differs: The female cuff has a smooth, plain surface with no carved texture.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bucklestraps.description: Three stacked octagonal straps wrapped around the right upper thigh, each punched with small rivet holes and closed at the outer side by a boxy buckle. A partial leg accessory with a mechanical, street or punk look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bucklestraps.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the buckle blocks.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, open-topped rectangular casing worn around the right thigh like a carton or crate, with flat angular panels, a slight taper toward the bottom and a hollow rim. Sits mid-thigh; quirky and mechanical.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back panel and the rim; colour 1 on the curved panel patches and inner top; colour 2 on the front and lower panels; colour 3 on the diagonal stripe on the outer side.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cartridges_0.description: A pair of upright hexagonal cartridge pouches with recessed contrasting panels, mounted on the outer right thigh and held by two thin bands that wrap around the leg. Tactical, sci-fi utility gear.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cartridges_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two thigh straps; colour 1 on the cartridge casings; colour 2 on the recessed cartridge panels.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cowboy_Lasso.description: A coiled twisted-rope lasso hanging at the right hip, with several loops bundled together and a small knot near the top. A western cowboy accessory that sits against the outer thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cowboy_Lasso.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rope strands; the knot and loops appear to use only colour 0.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: Two separate angular armor plates on the right leg: a larger curved shield on the outer thigh and a smaller guard at the knee, each with layered ridges and small rivets. A sci-fi tactical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plate shells; colour 1 on the ridged panels and lower edges of each plate; colour 0 on the small rivets and edge trim.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The female plates sit slightly higher and are narrower and more curved to the leg, with a darker default colour pattern.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor_.description: A short, open-topped armored cuff wrapping the right upper thigh: angular faceted plates with a stepped lower edge, ridged side sections and large hex bolts at the corners. Suggests cyborg or mechanical armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plate faces; colour 0 on the ridged side sections and rim; colour 2 on the lower edge band; colour 3 on the hex bolts.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor_.differs: The female plate sits slightly higher on the thigh and shows more of the contrasting ridged section at the side, with less contrasting on the outside.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Defender_01.description: A small diamond-shaped kneepad on the right knee: a faceted, slightly peaked plate with a crescent slash marking on the front and a flat, plain back. Suits armoured superhero or sci-fi looks.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the crescent marking on the front; colour 1 on the edge highlights.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Defender_01.differs: The female back is a flat, smooth panel, while the male back is faceted with a slight ridge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Deity_01.description: A curved shell-like thigh guard worn on the right upper leg: a rounded, open-backed plate with a contrasting front panel and a flared, pointed lower edge. Smooth, sleek and sci-fi in style.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, rim and pointed lower edge; colour 1 on the main front panel; colour 2 on the recessed inner back opening.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Electric.description: A rigid thigh-mounted generator plate on the outer right leg: an angular armored shell with a ribbed side panel, three coiled electrode bolts on the outer face, and a looping cable arching over the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Electric.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate shell and bolt caps; colour 1 on the ribbed side panel; colour 3 on the coils and thin edge lines; colour 2 on the cable.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Fincalf_01.description: A small fin-like calf accessory: a flat membrane panel with three swept-back pointed spines along its edge, spotted with a mottled pattern. It sits on the outer side of the right lower leg, suggesting an aquatic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Fincalf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 1 on the spines and edge trim; colour 3 on the spots; colour 2 in the shaded gradients between the ribs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Fincalf_02.description: A fin-like calf accessory on the outer side of the right lower leg: a layered membrane with three swept-back contrasting-edged spines, spotted skin panels and a pointed tail at the bottom. Suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Fincalf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spines and the edge trim; colour 0 on the spotted membrane panels; colour 3 on the spots; colour 2 on the shaded creases between the panels.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_01.description: A small fin-like accessory on the outer right thigh: three stacked, membrane-like segments separated by curved, pointed ridges that sweep back into spiky tips. Suggests a monstrous or aquatic creature look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the edge ridges and pointed spines; colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 3 on the spotted markings; colour 2 on the shaded areas of the membranes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_02.description: A cluster of stacked, blade-like fins attached to the outer right thigh, with sharp curved tips sweeping backward and down. Each fin has a mottled membrane and a contrasting edge, giving a monstrous, creature-like look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fin edges and spines; colour 0 and colour 2 on the mottled fin membranes; colour 3 on the spotted markings.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_02.differs: The female fins are wider and sit further out from the thigh, with longer trailing points.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Flower_01.description: A thin vine-like garland that wraps around the right thigh, made of twisting stems with small pointed leaves and a large layered flower rosette on the outer side. Suggests a fey, nature-themed look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine stems and many petals; colour 3 on the thin secondary vines; colour 0 on some leaves and the flower centre; colour 2 on the darker petals and leaf tips.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Furpads_01.description: A single hip pad on the right side: a curved flat backing plate covered with a shaggy curtain of jagged fur strands that hang down over the outer thigh. Suggests a beastly or savage look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Furpads_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur strands; colour 0 on the flat backing plate at the hip edge; colour 2 on the darker strand tips and roots.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Gamer_01.description: A boxy retro arcade-style control panel worn flat against the outer hip, with a bevelled slab shape, rows of round buttons, small indicator bars and a ball-topped joystick beside the hand.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel casing; colour 1 on the joystick; colour 2 on the buttons; colour 3 on the indicator bars.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Garterbelt_0.description: A lace garter band worn around the upper right thigh, with layered scalloped lace ruffles flaring outward over a plain inner band. Delicate, frilly and decorative, suggesting a lingerie or gothic-romantic look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Garterbelt_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lace ruffles; colour 2 on the inner band lining and the shadowed underside of the lace.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A curved armor plate strapped to the outer right thigh, with a bordered rim, rivets, fine cracks and rows of conical spikes jutting outward. A layered contrasting panel sits behind it. Gladiator-style and monstrous.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the rim and top edge; colour 3 on the spikes, crystals and crack lines; colour 2 on the rear layered panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The female version has fewer, smaller spikes along the plate and a narrower contrasting rear panel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Golden_Age_S.description: Two flat, thick five-pointed stars of different sizes stacked vertically on the outer side of the right thigh, the larger one above. Simple superhero-style decorative emblems that sit on the leg like appliqués.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Golden_Age_S.differs: The female stars sit slightly farther forward on the outer thigh and are more widely spaced, with the larger star clearly bigger than the lower one.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A right thigh guard made of angular, segmented plates with cut-out gaps, rendered as a glowing crackling energy surface. It sits on the outer thigh from hip to above the knee, with a sci-fi armoured look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default energy material ignores the colour scheme and glows uniformly, so no colour slots are visibly applied.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The female version is a glowing energy material with no visible colour pattern, while the male version is solid painted armour plates in several colours.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holstercowbo.description: An empty western-style thigh holster: a tall open-topped pouch with a rounded knee panel and studded upper band, hanging at the right outer thigh from an octagonal leg loop with light edging.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holstercowbo.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster body, studded band and knee panel; colour 0 on the mid-panels, top lip and loop edging; colour 2 on the studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holstercowbo.description: An empty western-style thigh holster: a tall, tapered open-topped sheath hanging at the outer right thigh, with banded sections, a rounded central plate, and rows of round studs near the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holstercowbo.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top band, side plate and bottom band, and on the outer back panel; colour 0 on the middle sections and the rim; colour 2 on the studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holsterpisto.description: A drop-leg pistol holster on the outer right thigh: a long open-topped sleeve holding a chunky sci-fi pistol, secured by two thin angular straps that loop around the thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holsterpisto.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster sleeve and both thigh straps; colour 3 on the pistol body and grip; colour 2 on the pistol's joint details; colour 0 on the pistol's inner barrel section.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Inmate_01.description: A small angular shield-like plate with a bordered edge, strapped to the lower leg just below the knee by a wide band that wraps around the calf. It suggests a prison-issue or mechanical leg guard.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 2 on the plate's border and rim; colour 1 on the encircling strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Knife_01.description: A thigh-mounted combat knife: a flat octagonal band circles the upper right thigh, with a broad-bladed knife hanging point-down from it beside the leg, complete with cross-guard and short handle.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band; colour 2 on the handle and cross-guard; colour 3 on the blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Knifesasquat.description: A jagged, serrated knife strapped to the outer thigh by four horizontal bands that wrap around the leg, with the blade pointing downward and a wrapped handle at the top. A rough, tribal look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Knifesasquat.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the knife blade and handle end; colour 2 on the thigh straps and handle wrapping.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Light_01.description: A hip-mounted side plate for the right leg: two overlapping tiers of jagged, leaf-shaped panels with raised vein-like ridges and a bordered edge, hanging over the outer thigh. Fantasy armour with a spiky lower edge.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the panel surfaces; colour 0 on the raised veined ridges and edge trim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Lockbox_66_0.description: Two separate angular armoured bands worn stacked on the right upper thigh: a wider upper cuff with a stepped, notched front edge and a narrower lower band with a raised back tab. Both have contrasting rims.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Lockbox_66_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band; colour 1 on the rim of the upper band; colour 2 on the lower band; colour 3 on the rim of the lower band.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A curved thigh plate worn on the outer right thigh, with patched seams, scratch marks and screw-like fasteners, held by two buckled straps that wrap around the leg. Rugged, mechanical armor look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the buckles and screw fasteners.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechanon.description: A cluster of jagged, overlapping angular plates strapped around the right thigh, like a mechanical armour guard. Shards of differing lengths splay outward, giving a robotic, sci-fi look that hangs over the outer and upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long outer plates and edge shards; colour 1 on the central curved plates; colour 2 on the darker vertical panels; colour 3 on the band across the front plate.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechassn_02.description: A mechanical armoured thigh guard wrapped around the upper right leg: a segmented shell with raised panels and small side modules, a wedge-shaped angular lower cuff, and an open rim at the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechassn_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower cuff and edge frame; colour 1 on the main armour shell and side modules; colour 3 on the top rim band; colour 2 on the small recessed vent.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechassn_02.differs: The female top rim is a thin open band, so the inside of the guard shows from above.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Padding.description: A pair of curved, padded armor shells strapped to the right thigh, one on the front and one on the back, with a gap between them at the side. Chunky, rounded tactical leg protection.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell edges and outer rims; colour 1 on the large curved panels; colour 2 on the top edge and lower bands; colour 3 on a small vertical inset strip on the front shell.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Padding.differs: The front and back shells sit further apart, with a wider side gap, and the contrasting inset strip is on the inner edge of the front shell.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Pockets_01.description: A band of padded pouches wrapped around the right upper thigh, each a squared, puffy pocket with a flap and a small gem-like clasp, joined by a flat backing strip on one side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Pockets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the flat backing strip; colour 3 on the gem clasps.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Pockets_01.differs: The female band has its flat backing strip at the back of the thigh, with pouches across the front and outer side.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Power_01.description: A rigid armoured thigh guard worn on the right leg: an open-backed tapered shell with a tall angled outer plate, a recessed side panel and a stepped notch edge. Reads as a sci-fi mechanical leg accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and rim; colour 1 on the recessed side panel; colour 2 on the rear and inner shell.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Powerarmor_0.description: A sci-fi armored thigh guard on the right leg: a large curved shell with vent holes and small contrasting lights, plus a smaller separate plate at the back, with inset panels and notched tabs at the lower edge.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Powerarmor_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and back plate; colour 2 on the inset panels; colour 0 on small edge details; colour 3 on the small round lights.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Powersuit_01.description: A tall, curved armor frame on the outer right thigh: a slim angular shell with a large oval cutout, tapering down to the knee, where it ends in a pair of small wheels. Suggests a mechanical powersuit.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Powersuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and its raised edge trim; colour 2 on the wheel tyres; colour 1 on the wheel hubs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Quiver_01.description: A slim tubular quiver strapped to the outer right thigh by an octagonal band, holding several fletched arrows upright with their feathers at the top; small clamps and an end cap hold it along the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band, quiver frame and arrow fletching; colour 1 on the arrow shafts and clamp sections; colour 2 on the small fasteners; colour 3 on the bottom tip accents.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_01.description: A pair of short tabs with metal rings on the outer right thigh, each holding a long looped strap that hangs in two drooping U-shaped swags down the leg. Suggests a rave or street accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tabs; colour 0 on the tab edges; colour 2 on the rings; colour 3 on the hanging straps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_02.description: A pair of looped fabric straps hanging from two ringed tabs at the outer right thigh. The long, narrow straps droop in loose U-shapes down the leg. A rave or club accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hanging straps; colour 1 on the tabs; colour 0 on the tab edges; colour 2 on the metal rings.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_02.differs: The female straps hang as long, narrow loops that trail in a point toward the knee; the ends are looser and less looped than the male version.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A rigid thigh guard for the right leg: a tapered open-topped shell with small recessed vents and rivets, ending in a contrasting band and a pointed, notched lower cap just above the knee.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main thigh shell; colour 2 on the band above the lower cap; colour 0 on the lower cap; colour 3 on the small rivets.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The female version is a slimmer, more tapered shell that sits higher on the thigh, with a more sharply pointed lower cap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_T.description: A curved, faceted thigh guard wrapping the outer right thigh from hip to above the knee, with angular plating and a tapered lower edge. Sleek, segmented sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_T.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front and outer surface of the guard; colour 0 on the back panel and the angled inner facets; colour 2 on the edge trim.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_T.differs: The female guard has a shallower opening at the top and sits a little higher and tighter on the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rhino_01.description: A thick, bulky tube-like leg covering on the right thigh, wrinkled like heavy hide, ending in a rough cut above the knee with a small contrasting ragged cuff below. It suggests a beastly, monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh covering; colour 1 on the band near the top; colour 3 and colour 1 on the small cuff at the bottom.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ringsthigh_0.description: A wide thigh wrap made of overlapping criss-crossing strap bands between two contrasting trim bands, with metal rings and buckle plates attached down the outer side. Sits on the right upper thigh, with a punk or mechanical feel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ringsthigh_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossing strap bands; colour 2 on the darker bands beneath them; colour 1 on the top and bottom trim bands; colour 3 on the rings and buckle plates.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A small angular plate on the outer right hip with several thick segmented cables looping down the outer thigh in long drooping arcs. Ribbed tubing with inset stripes gives a mechanical, cybernetic look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plate; colour 2 on the segmented cable tubing; colour 3 on the thin stripes running along the cables.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Robot_Leg_At.description: A boxy mechanical thigh guard on the outer right thigh, with angular plates, pointed upper spikes, three recessed vent slots and thin circuit-like seams. A small tapered contrasting-slot pendant piece with two prongs hangs below.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Robot_Leg_At.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plate; colour 3 on the recessed vent slots and seam lines; colour 1 on the tapered lower pendant; colour 2 on the small prongs.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Robot_Leg_At.differs: The female version has its vent slots facing more toward the front of the thigh and sits with a shorter, more compact plate.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Robotsamurai.description: A side hip and thigh guard made of stacked, overlapping segmented plates that step down the outer right thigh like samurai armor lames, topped by a taller angled plate at the hip. Mechanical, armored look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Robotsamurai.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main overlapping plates; colour 1 on the plate edges and underlayers; colour 2 on the top hip plate and lower bands; colour 3 on small accent inserts between plates.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.description: A mechanical thigh-mounted frame on the right leg: an open angular loop of segmented armored plating with a ring-shaped top mount, ribbed vent slots on the back, and a soft panel of cloth inside the frame.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner cloth panel and rim edge; colour 2 on the ribbed armored frame and ring mount; colour 1 and 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.differs: The female version's frame sits slightly lower and wraps further round the back of the thigh, with a more open loop at the front.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.description: Right-leg armour set: an open angular thigh band with a ring-shaped clasp on the outer side, plus a separate knee-to-shin guard with a swept horn-like spike and vented panel. Alien-mechanical, sits on the leg as partial armour.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating of the thigh band and shin guard; colour 1 on the vented panel at the knee; colour 3 on the accents under the shin guard; colour 2 on the darker edges and underside.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.description: Two separate armored leg pieces on the right leg: a curved open thigh guard with a ring-like top and a wraparound band, and a lower shin guard with a tall pointed spike and layered edges. Monstrous, partial armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates of the thigh and shin guards; colour 2 on the edge bands and undersides; colour 1 on the vented inset at the top of the shin guard; colour 3 on the small accents at the front of the shin guard.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A curved, shield-like hip guard on the right thigh, pointed at the bottom, with a thick rolled top edge, recessed edge trim, feather-like carved panels and small round studs. Ornate armoured styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the edge trim and border; colour 2 on the top rim and the feather-like panels; colour 3 on the small studs and accents.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Larg.description: A samurai-style hip and thigh guard on the right leg: a curved, angular plate with a stepped, serrated front edge and a swirl-patterned central panel, framed by a raised rim with contrasting trim.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Larg.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and rim; colour 1 on the thin inner trim line; colour 2 on the swirl panel background; colour 3 on the swirl pattern.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Larg.differs: The female version is a narrower plate whose swirl panel sits lower on the thigh, with a smaller solid flare at the hip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate.description: A thigh band of stacked, ribbed segments wrapping the upper right thigh, with three overlapping curved plates on the outer front and a flat backing panel behind. Suggests samurai-style armor.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the three front plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and the rear backing panel; colour 2 on the ribbed band around the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate.description: A curved hip-and-thigh plate made of four stacked, overlapping lamellar bands, like a samurai tasset, wrapping around the outer side of the right upper leg. It looks like segmented armor with framed panels.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate faces; colour 1 on the plate border lines and the inner lining; colour 2 not visible.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate.differs: The female plate sits lower and wraps more to the outer side of the thigh, with the inner lining showing mainly from the front three-quarter view.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate.description: A samurai-style thigh guard: four stacked, curved lamellar plates flaring outward on the outer right hip and thigh, with a small plate cluster below and a ringed band around the upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and the inner-side panels; colour 2 on the ringed thigh band.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate.differs: The female plates sit higher and flare wider off the hip, with the lower plate cluster set further forward on the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scarletshiel.description: Two stacked, faceted band straps wrapped around the lower leg just below the knee, each closed with a square buckle on the front and a short tab of contrasting strap. Reads as a utilitarian leg brace.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scarletshiel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the strap tabs at the buckle; colour 2 on the buckle frames.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scifi_Soldie.description: A sci-fi thigh guard of angular plated panels worn on the outer right thigh: a large curved shell wraps the side, with a notched upper edge, a smaller inner plate and a short hanging flap behind.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scifi_Soldie.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and edges; colour 1 on the curved inlay panels; colour 2 on the wedge insets; colour 3 on the hanging rear flap.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scifi_Soldie.differs: The female version sits narrower on the thigh with a smaller shell and shows less of the contrasting rear flap, and it lacks the round studs on the shell.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Seacreature_.description: A cluster of curved, blade-like fins or claws fanning out from the right hip and hanging down the outer thigh. Each pointed segment has a smooth inner face and a chevron-patterned edge, giving a monstrous aquatic look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Seacreature_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth inner faces of the blades; colour 1 on the outlines and edges; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the panels between the stripes.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Shackleankle.description: A chunky faceted ankle shackle: a slightly tapered octagonal metal cuff with a seam down the middle, two square lock blocks on each side, and a rounded loop handle projecting from each side. Worn on the right ankle.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Shackleankle.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 2 on the square lock blocks; colour 1 on the side loop handles.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Shacklethigh.description: A chunky angular shackle band that wraps around the right upper thigh, with a faceted rim, a contrasting lock plate on the outer face and on the back, and a loop handle on one side. Mechanical, restraint-like look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Shacklethigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the loop handle; colour 2 on the lock plates.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A sharkfin-style leg accessory on the right outer thigh: layered, jagged angular plates sweep up into a pointed fin above a segmented cuff around the knee. It has a sci-fi, monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fin plates and lower edge blades; colour 1 on the outer side panels and cuff segments; colour 2 on the inset panels and rim; colour 3 on small accent patches near the cuff.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_01.differs: The female fin is narrower and more slender, with less flared panel at the front and a thinner, more open rim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Space_Scound.description: A thigh-mounted holster on the right leg: a boxy open-topped case on the outer thigh, held by a flat leg band, with a long angled strap running up toward the hip and a flat octagonal platform below. Sci-fi scoundrel look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Space_Scound.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster case, leg band and platform rim; colour 1 on the platform top and the strap's inner section; colour 2 on the long strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Space_Scound.description: A sci-fi thigh holster: a boxy angular pouch hangs on the outer right thigh, held by a flat leg band with a flat top plate, and a long thin strap curves up toward the hip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Space_Scound.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body and thigh band; colour 1 on the top plate of the band and the inner strap panel; colour 2 on the upper strap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A set of conical spikes studding the outer side of the right thigh in rows, with longer spikes jutting sideways and shorter blunt cones on the front. A punk or monstrous leg accent attached directly to the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Calf_.description: A set of three long curved horn-like spikes stacked down the outside of the right calf, each sweeping backward to a sharp point from a short banded base ring. Monstrous, clawlike accent.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Calf_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips as a fade; colour 3 on the base rings.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Thigh.description: A set of three curved horn-like spikes stacked down the outside of the right thigh, each with a flared base cap and a long tapering tip that sweeps backward. Suggests a monstrous or mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Thigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base caps.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Thigh.differs: The female spikes are spaced further apart down the thigh and sweep more sharply backward.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A single chunky, lumpy bone-like armor growth attached to the outer right hip and thigh, with jagged spiky ridges along its edge and rows of finger-like grooves down its side; monstrous, organic styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the growth; colour 1 on the grooved finger-like markings along its lower side.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Steampunk_Co.description: A tall, tapered holster-like sleeve hanging from the hip along the outer thigh, with a flared open top, contrasting stitched edging, a studded strap at the top and three buckled straps below. Steampunk western styling.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Steampunk_Co.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the holster; colour 1 on the straps and top studded band; colour 3 on the stitched edging; colour 2 on the buckles and studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A hip-mounted gadget pack: a boxy rectangular pouch with a central strap and small round indicator, from which several curved, padded striped fins or strips fan out over the hip and buttock, held by contrasting straps.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch and the padded strips; colour 1 on the stripes along the strips; colour 2 on the straps and the pouch's central band; colour 3 on the small round indicator.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_01.differs: The strips form a tighter, more closely bunched fan that lies along the hip and buttock.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_02.description: A small rectangular box-shaped pouch worn on the outer right thigh, with a padded body, a flap on the outer face fastened by a round stud, and a vertical strap running down its side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and vertical strap; colour 3 on the round fastener.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapsasquat.description: Three thin, flat angular bands stacked around the right upper thigh, each a faceted strap that wraps the front and sides and stops open at the inner back. A simple tribal or street-style leg accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapsasquat.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all three straps; other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapsthigh_.description: A short wrapped thigh band on the right leg: overlapping diagonal strips wind around the upper thigh between two thicker contrasting rims, giving a bandage-like or strapped look with a slightly open top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapsthigh_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapping strips; colour 2 on the gaps and undersides between strips; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sword_01.description: A sheathed sword worn on the right hip, hanging down the outer thigh at a slight angle. It has a segmented scabbard with banded ridges, a curved forked mouth guard, a crossguard and a wrapped hilt.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard and the curved mouth guard; colour 1 on the crossguard and the pommel cap; colour 2 on the hilt grip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Thighpad_01.description: A padded thigh guard on the right leg: a rounded, ribbed cushion shell over the outer and front thigh with a contrasting cuff at the lower edge, held by two thin straps wrapping around the back of the leg.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Thighpad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded shell; colour 1 on the lower cuff; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Tyrant_01.description: Two separate angular armor plates on the outside of the right leg: a taller slab at the hip and thigh, and a smaller shorter plate near the knee. Chunky, faceted and worn as add-on protection.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Tyrant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both plates; the plates show no other colour slots.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Tyrant_01.differs: The female pads sit slightly higher and further apart, with the upper plate at the hip and the lower plate just above the knee.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Victory_01.description: A curved, shield-like hip plate hanging at the right hip, tapering to a pointed tip at the front. Layered stripe panels with a raised rim give it a sleek superhero look; the back is a smooth plain shell.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide inner stripe; colour 1 on the upper panel; colour 3 on the middle stripe; colour 2 on the outer rim and the back shell.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Vine_01.description: A curled, organic leaf-like flap that hangs over the outer right thigh, with a smooth outer surface, swirled ridged underside, small hooked spikes and a tall curling tendril tip at the hip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer surface and tendril; colour 0 on the swirled inner ridges and lower edge; colour 3 on the spikes, tendril tips and dots.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Amazo.description: A straight double-edged sword worn at the right hip, hanging angled down the outer thigh with its tip pointing toward the knee. It has a wrapped grip, a winged guard, a round pommel and loose cord ends.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Amazo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pommel and grip cap; colour 3 on the grip wrap and dangling cords; colour 1 on the guard; colour 2 on the blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Escri.description: A slim baton (escrima stick) carried at the right hip in a small holder with a strap and a small stud, hanging straight down the outer thigh. Banded grip end with thin stripe markings along the shaft.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Escri.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baton shaft; colour 3 on the stripe markings; colour 2 on the holder and strap; colour 1 on the small stud on the holder.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Gamer.description: A chunky retro sci-fi ray pistol worn hanging vertically at the outer hip and thigh: a boxy angular body with a wide grip-like fin, small studs and a long cylindrical barrel ending in a banded cap.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Gamer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and barrel; colour 1 on the end cap, side block and rear tip; colour 2 on the recessed panels; colour 3 on the small round studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Sides.description: A rapier-style side sword hanging at the right hip, with a long straight narrow blade, an ornate swept hilt with curling guard loops, a wrapped grip and a round pommel. Thin cords trail from the guard. Suggests a swashbuckling look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Sides.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the blade and trailing cords; colour 1 on the grip; colour 2 on the guard, crossguard loops and pommel (metal fittings).
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Sides.differs: The female sword hangs angled slightly back and out from the hip, while the male sword hangs straighter down the front of the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Tonfa.description: A tonfa holstered at the right hip: a long straight baton with banded stripes hangs point-down in a contrasting clip-on holder, its short side handle jutting out sideways. A practical, tactical martial-arts weapon.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Tonfa.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baton shaft; colour 3 on the stripes and bands; colour 1 on the side handle; colour 2 on the holder and handle end caps.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Wood_.description: A small wooden-style toy sword hanging at the right hip, with a straight flat blade, a chunky bar crossguard, and a wrapped grip ending in a rounded pommel. It hangs point-down along the thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Wood_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade; colour 2 on the crossguard; colour 3 on the grip wrapping; colour 0 on the pommel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Wrappedstrap.description: A wrap of overlapping, criss-crossing strips winding around the right thigh from mid-thigh to just above the knee, with a small round fastener on the outer side. Ragged, bandage-like and loosely layered, it suits mummy-wrap, punk or monstrous looks.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Wrappedstrap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer strips at the top and bottom; colour 1 on the intermediate strips; colour 2 on the central band of strips; colour 3 on the small patches near the lower edge.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Traveler_01.description: A tube-like thigh wrap for the right leg, sitting mid-thigh with a slanted top edge and a curved lower hem. Two horizontal bands with ring fasteners across the front give it a sci-fi, practical look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh cover; colour 1 on the two horizontal bands; colour 3 on the ring fasteners; colour 2 on the top edge trim and cap.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_01.description: A pair of padded thigh straps worn high on the right leg, each closed with a buckle clasp, with a small flap pouch attached at the outer side. Practical vigilante or tactical utility gear.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and pouch body; colour 1 on the pouch's central tab; colour 3 on the strap clasps and the pouch stud.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_02.description: A pair of octagonal thigh straps worn one above the other on the right upper leg, each closed with a buckle at the front and edged with contrasting trim. Two flap pouches hang off the outer side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands and the pouches; colour 1 on the strap edging and trim; colour 3 on the buckles.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_02.differs: The female version has a single wide pouch and a second smaller flap on the outer side, and its straps lack the vertical connecting tab seen on the male.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Waistbag_01.description: A thigh-mounted utility pouch hung from a patterned strap that slants across the hip, with a flap pocket on the outer side, a small side tab, and looping straps with ring fasteners cradling the front of the thigh.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Waistbag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and pouch backing; colour 1 on the ring fasteners and the buttons on the flap; colour 2 on the pouch flap and side tab; colour 3 on the stitching and strap pattern.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Brainscramb.description: A chunky sci-fi pistol worn against the outer right thigh, with an angular open-frame body, ribbed grip and barrel, a slanted ridged fin at the rear, and three small cylindrical canisters along one side.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Brainscramb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and frame; colour 2 on the ribbed grip, barrel and underside; colour 1 on the ridged rear fin panels; colour 3 on the three canisters.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Chakram_01.description: A ring-shaped chakram weapon hanging at the right hip, set edge-on against the thigh. It has a braided grip section, a broad inner band with swirling engraved patterns, and sharp outward-curving blade edges with pointed tips.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Chakram_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade edges; colour 1 on the inner band; colour 3 on the swirling engraved patterns; colour 2 on the braided grip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Cleaver_01.description: A butcher's cleaver hanging point-down at the right hip: a rectangular broad blade with a small hole in the lower corner, and a rounded handle with rivets. Suggests a gritty, brutal weapon accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Cleaver_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle; colour 0 on the handle edge trim; the blade shows metal and ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Cold_01.description: A sci-fi blaster pistol worn in a bulky mechanical holster on the outer right thigh, with a segmented casing, a round emitter port, vent slits, a curved grip rising at the top and a thin antenna rod.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Cold_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing plates and metal housing; colour 1 on the grip, antenna and inner casing panel; colour 2 on the body of the holster; colour 3 on the vent slits and ring markings.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Combat_Knif.description: A curved, leaf-shaped combat knife (kukri-style) hanging point-down at the right hip, with a short cylindrical handle and a ring collar above a broad blade that swells then tapers to a point.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Combat_Knif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle and ring collar; colour 1 on the blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Destabiliza.description: A compact sci-fi hand blaster hanging at the outer thigh: a contrasting barrel base with vent slits and downward prongs, a contrasting central chamber, and an angular armored shell with a small side spur on top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Destabiliza.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and top spur; colour 2 on the lower barrel base and prongs' housing; colour 0 on the central chamber; colour 3 on the small inset accents and vent slits.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Destabiliza.differs: The female blaster has a longer thin rod sticking out sideways from the top and hangs slightly higher, with shorter prongs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Gunsword_01.description: A hip-worn gun-sword hybrid: a revolver-style pistol with a curved grip and cylinder, its barrel extended into a long straight blade that hangs down the outer thigh. Mechanical, weapon-like and partial.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Gunsword_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the grip; colour 3 on the pistol frame and hammer; colour 2 on the cylinder; colour 0 on the blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hammer_01.description: A claw hammer worn at the right hip, hanging head-down: a long straight handle with a flat end cap, a metal head with a rounded striking face and a curved claw. Reads as a practical tool-weapon.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hammer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle; colour 1 on the hammer head; colour 3 not visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hatchet_01.description: A small hatchet hanging at the right hip beside the thigh: a long straight handle with a short single-bladed axe head at the lower end, hanging point-down. A practical, rugged weapon accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hatchet_01.colourAreas: The default material renders as a glowing translucent outline that ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slot is clearly visible.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hatchet_01.differs: The female hatchet renders as a glowing translucent outline, while the male version shows a solid handle and axe head.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Icepick_01.description: A mountaineering ice axe hanging at the right thigh: a long straight shaft with a padded grip at the top, a metal collar, a curved perforated pick and a small flat adze blade at the bottom.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Icepick_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper grip; colour 1 on the lower shaft; colour 0 on the collar, pick and adze; colour 3 on a tiny mark near the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Icepick_01.differs: The female axe hangs angled, with the pick pointing outward at the hip, and hangs slightly higher and more forward on the thigh.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Katana_01.description: A sheathed katana worn at the right hip: a long, gently curved scabbard with a round guard, a wrapped handle and a short cord tied near the guard. It hangs almost straight down the leg, hilt up.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Katana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard; colour 2 on the handle wrap, guard and cord; colour 1 on small fittings at the scabbard mouth and handle.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Katana_01.differs: The female katana hangs almost vertically down the outer leg, hilt upward, instead of angling forward across the hip.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Kunai_01.description: A single kunai throwing knife hanging point-down at the right hip: a leaf-shaped pointed blade, a long wrapped handle and a round ring pommel at the top. Ninja-style weapon accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Kunai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the wrapped handle; colour 1 on the ring pommel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Mad_Scienti.description: A retro sci-fi ray gun holstered at the right hip: a boxy, chunky body with a vented barrel, small antenna spikes and a flared muzzle, resting in a round dish-shaped cradle with clawed legs.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Mad_Scienti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gun body and the cradle's claw legs; colour 1 on the muzzle tip, the side panel and the round cradle dish; colour 3 on the stripes and dots; colour 2 on small vents and details.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Mad_Scienti.description: A chunky sci-fi blaster holstered at the right hip and thigh: a boxy body with a round lens-like emitter, a swept-back curved grip or stock, a small canister underneath, and a short muzzle tip pointing down.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Mad_Scienti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and emitter housing; colour 1 on the grip, stock and muzzle tip; colour 2 on the swept upper stock and lower vents; colour 3 on the emitter lens and small dots.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Maraca_01.description: A single maraca hanging at the right hip: a rounded gourd head with zigzag and striped bands, a short contrasting collar and a tapering handle pointing upward. Festive, tribal-style percussion prop.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Maraca_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle and one band of the gourd; colour 3 on the zigzag bands; colour 0 on the collar and light bands; colour 2 on the stripes and zigzag edges.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Newspaper_0.description: A tightly rolled newspaper hanging at the right hip, slightly waisted in the middle with printed columns of text and a visible spiral end. It sits beside the thigh as a casual prop.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Newspaper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the newsprint; the printed text and spiral shading come from the texture and are not affected by the other colour slots.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pipe_Wrench.description: A large pipe wrench hanging at the right hip, handle up: a thick tapered grip with a capped end, a slim shaft, and an adjustable jaw with a knurled thumb wheel and hooked lower jaw.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pipe_Wrench.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the handle end cap; colour 0 on the shaft and hooked jaw; colour 1 on the wrench head housing.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_02.description: A compact submachine gun worn on the right outer thigh, held vertically in an angular open-frame holster band that wraps around the leg; the boxy body has a rear grip and small detail markings.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gun body; colour 1 on the holster frame; colour 2 on the grip and barrel tip; colour 3 on the small dot markings.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_05.description: A tall, boxy revolver holster hanging at the outer right thigh on a thin loop strap around the leg, with a revolver grip and hammer poking out of the open top, a row of round studs, and a rounded side panel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body and thigh strap; colour 1 on the revolver grip, side panel and lower band; colour 3 on the cartridges inside the top; colour 2 on the hammer and studs.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_Scif.description: A retro sci-fi pistol worn on the outer right thigh, hanging with the barrel pointing down. It has an angular swept-back grip, a chunky boxy magazine block and a wrapped holster-like casing around the barrel.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_Scif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and grip; colour 1 on the barrel casing wrap; colour 2 on the magazine block and rear housing; colour 3 on the stripes on the magazine.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Renegade_01.description: A small curved sickle weapon hanging at the right hip: a ring pommel, a cord-wrapped handle with a collar, and a hooked, angular blade with a sharp point. It looks like a sci-fi fantasy weapon.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle wrap; colour 0 on the pommel ring and collar; the blade is a glossy mottled metal that largely ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Roller_01.description: A large cartoonish rolling pin hanging at the right hip, hovering beside the thigh: a thick cylindrical barrel with a slightly textured surface and a turned handle protruding from each end.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Roller_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel; colour 1 on both handles.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sai_01.description: A thigh-worn sai: a slim strap band around the upper right thigh holds a pointed sai with a wrapped handle and two curved side prongs, hanging blade-down along the outer leg. Suits ninja or martial styles.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sai_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the thigh strap; colour 0 on the curved prongs and guard; colour 1 on the handle wrap; colour 3 on the long blade.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sickle_03.description: A single-bladed sickle worn at the right hip, with a short grip and a long blade that curves into a sharp hook, hanging down the outer thigh. Practical, martial look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sickle_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal blade; colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the handle end caps.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sickle_03.differs: The female sickle has a narrower, more elongated blade whose hook curls back more tightly, while the male blade is a wider, rounder crescent.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spatula_01.description: A oversized kitchen spatula hanging point-down at the right hip: a slotted metal turner blade on a long thin shaft, with a chunky grip handle ending in a hanging loop. A quirky, casual novelty weapon.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spatula_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the grip handle; colour 1 on the loop at the top of the handle; colour 0 on the shaft and slotted blade, which look like glossy metal.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spy_01.description: A sci-fi spy pistol hanging at the right thigh, with a boxy angular body, angled grip and a long barrel ending in two ribbed cylindrical suppressor sections. It hangs vertically at the side of the leg.
