Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and grip; colour 1 on the ribbed suppressor sections and side grip panels; colour 3 on the small sight and indicator marks; colour 2 on the grip inset panel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spy_02.description: A furled spy umbrella hanging at the right hip: a curved crook handle, a slim shaft, a pleated canopy tied with a small band, and a pointed metal tip. It reads as a gentleman-spy accessory.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furled canopy; colour 1 on the canopy stripes and the tie band; colour 2 on the shaft and tip; colour 3 on the crook handle.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Stick_02.description: A slender, gently curved wooden stick with a short side branch near its thicker top end, hanging at the right hip along the outer thigh like a carried staff or branch. Rustic, primitive look.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Stick_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole stick; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Straplesspi.description: A strapless right-thigh pistol holster: a tall tapered case with studded upper band, banded lower sections and a knee-like side panel, holding a revolver whose grip, hammer and contrasting cartridges poke out the top.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Straplesspi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main holster body and revolver frame; colour 1 on the bands, side panel and revolver grip; colour 2 on the studs and hammer; colour 3 on the cartridges and grip trim.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Swing_Cane_.description: A slim walking cane worn hanging at the right hip, angled down along the thigh. It has a curved handle, a segmented mechanical collar, a long straight shaft and a small metal hooked tip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Swing_Cane_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved handle; colour 3 on the long shaft; colour 0 on the metal collar joints and the hooked tip; colour 2 on the connector segments.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Swing_Pisto.description: A flintlock-style pistol worn hanging at the right thigh, muzzle pointing down. It has a curved grip with a rounded pommel, a cylindrical chamber, a trigger guard, a hammer, and a long barrel with a glowing slot and capped tip.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Swing_Pisto.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the grip and the lower barrel panel; colour 0 on the upper grip collar and barrel body; colour 2 on the pommel, chamber, hammer and muzzle cap; colour 3 on the slot along the barrel.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Trooper_01.description: A sci-fi blaster pistol holstered against the outer right thigh: a slim angular body with a glowing circuit-line channel, ribbed lower housing and an open looped handle guard. Reads as a sentai-style sidearm.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and ribbed housing; colour 1 on the looped guard and back edge; colour 2 on the recessed centre channel and muzzle; colour 3 on the circuit lines and central node.

Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Wheellockpi.description: A wheellock pistol in a tapered holster hanging at the right hip and thigh, with a curved grip poking out of a wrapped top flap and a long barrel tip extending below the holster.
Female/F_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Wheellockpi.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster top flap and strap; colour 0 on the lower holster body; colour 2 on the grip and barrel; colour 3 on the small lock detail.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Ammo_Harness_01.description: A low-slung harness belt with a buckled strap at the waist, a row of bullet-like cartridges along its edge, and wide straps looping around the hips and under the groin, leaving the legs bare.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Ammo_Harness_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt and harness straps; colour 3 on the edge piping and inner lining; colour 1 on the cartridge bodies; colour 2 on the buckle and bullet tips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Ammo_Harness_01.differs: The female harness has wide straps that angle diagonally across the hips and thighs, with a narrower belt band.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A long flared robe skirt with a studded waistband, an open front split showing two long contrasting panels edged with contrasting trim, and soft draped folds that fall to a slightly uneven calf-to-ankle hem.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skirt body and waistband; colour 2 on the two front panels; colour 0 on the panel edging and waistband trim; colour 3 on the waistband studs.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Anniversary_Mechanon_.description: A retro robot-style hip brief made of armour-like plates: a raised waistband with a central angular buckle plate at the front, a contrasting inner lining, and a rounded back panel with a pointed chevron seam.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Anniversary_Mechanon_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and upper back plates; colour 1 on the lower back panel and side edges; colour 2 on the inner lining and front pouch; colour 3 on the central front plate.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Anniversary_Mechanon_.differs: The female version has a deeper, more pointed front panel that dips lower between the legs.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Armorninjaf.description: A short, rounded hip-layer brief with a bulging, padded look: a wide main shell wrapping the hips and rear, a separate panel at each side, and a contrasting pointed panel at the front and lower edge.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Armorninjaf.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hip shell; colour 3 on the side panels and small inner accents; colour 0 on the front point and lower edge panels.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Blockbuster_01.description: A small hip-layer armour piece on the buttocks: a chunky angular plate with a notched, heart-like top sits between two curved shell plates that flare out over each side of the rear. Bulky, mechanical, monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central notched plate; colour 0 on the two curved side shell plates.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Blockbuster_02.description: A pair of small angular armor plates at the hips and buttocks, each a separate faceted shell with an inset slanted panel on the back and a thin contrasting edge trim. Reads as a mechanical, superhero-style armored hip accent.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shells; colour 1 on the thin edge trim; colour 3 on the slanted inset panels at the back.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Bounty_01.description: A pair of separate, stiff hip plates, one on each side of the hips, each a short curved panel with a thin contrasting edge. Worn over the hips as partial armor-like flaps in a space western style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main surface of both plates; colour 2 on the thin edge trim around each plate.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Bounty_01.differs: The female plates are slimmer and more tapered, flaring outward like short curved wedges at the hips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Clothing_Lockbo.description: A knee-length wrap skirt with a plain smooth inner front panel, an open front slit, and a back and side cloth patterned with a geometric diamond weave. It has a banded waist and a hem with contrasting trim and pointed, uneven corners.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Clothing_Lockbo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and the plain front panel; colour 1 on the diamond motifs; colour 3 on the zigzag lines between the diamonds; colour 2 on the hem trim.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Mutated_01.description: A set of small curved horn-like spikes studded around the hips: two large tusks curve out at each side of the hips, with a row of tiny thorns along the front and back of the waistline.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the horns and spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Mutated_01.differs: The female version has slightly smaller, more widely spaced front thorns, and the side tusks sit lower on the hips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Skirt_Birdpeopl.description: A pair of separate rigid thigh shells, each an octagonal tube wrapping the upper leg from hip to just above the knee, with an open cut-out on the front and small strap fasteners at the lower edge.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Skirt_Birdpeopl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh shells; colour 1 on the outer side and back faces; colour 2 on the small fasteners at the lower edges.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Swan_01.description: A pair of separate feathered hip wings, one on each side of the hips, made of layered swept feathers that taper to pointed tips and hang down over the outer thighs. Suggests a fantasy bird-like look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper feathers; colour 1 on the lower feather tips, fading from the upper part; colour 1 on the edge binding along the top of each wing.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Swan_01.differs: The female wings have a bolder edge binding along the top and sit slightly lower on the hips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Angel_Epi.description: A small curved armour plate worn over the rear hips and lower back, with a jagged bat-wing upper edge, a pointed lower tip and a round emblem at the centre. The front is an open shell, giving a monstrous, mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Angel_Epi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer back plate surface; colour 1 on the rim, edging and inner shell; colour 3 on the central emblem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Birdpeopl.description: A pair of small rounded shield-shaped hip plates, one on each side of the hips, each with a raised rim and a winged bird emblem on its outer face. Worn as a partial hip accessory with a heraldic feel.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Birdpeopl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 2 on the rims and the backs of the plates; colour 3 on the bird emblems.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Victory_0.description: A small shield-shaped hip panel that tapers to a point over the upper thigh, with a thick raised border and swooping chevron ribs down the face. Superhero-style, it sits on the side of the hip as a partial accessory.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Victory_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer border; colour 0 on the flat panel between the ribs; colour 3 on the raised swooping ribs and chevrons; colour 1 on the small diamond at the tip.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Corrupted_01.description: A partial hip skirt made of two pointed tabards, front and back, with layered bordered edges. A ragged, jagged-edged side panel hangs at each hip. Sits low on the hips, ending at mid-thigh, with a fantasy-warrior look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central face of the front and back tabards; colour 1 on the inner border band; colour 2 on the outer edge trim; colour 3 on the ragged side panels.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Crimson_01.description: A knee-length split skirt of quilted, scale-like textured panels that opens at the centre front and back, edged with curled trim and a riveted hem band, sitting on the hips under a thin waistband.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured skirt panels; colour 1 on the curled edge trim and hem piping; colour 2 on the riveted hem band; colour 3 on the waistband.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Crimson_01.differs: The female skirt is shorter at the front with a wider slit, showing more of the thighs.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Lockbox_66_0.description: A knee-to-calf-length wrap skirt with a draped, gathered overlayer at the hips that fades into a patterned lower panel with diamond motifs, a contrasting hem band and pointed, uneven edges. Front is split open at the thighs.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Lockbox_66_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped hip overlayer and the pattern background; colour 1 on the diamond motifs and the lower fade of the drape; colour 3 on the zigzag pattern lines; colour 2 on the hem band.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Lockbox_66_0.differs: The female skirt has a more open, split front at the hips, with layered flaps showing the legs, and a slightly longer, more tapered hem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Retro_Talism.description: A short, plain fitted mini skirt sitting low on the hips and ending at upper thigh, with a gently curved hem and a smooth gradient between two colours. Simple casual look with no visible fastenings.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Retro_Talism.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper skirt body; colour 1 on the lower hem fade and the inner waistband lining.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Retro_Talism.differs: The female version is a short mini skirt, while the male version is a pair of knee-length shorts with separate legs.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_01.description: Casual knee-length board shorts with an elastic waistband and a tied drawstring at the front, loose cloth legs, and a large printed tropical flower pattern across the front and back.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric and waistband; colour 1 on the large flower shapes; colour 3 on the smaller leaf and petal shapes and hem edge; colour 2 on the drawstring.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_02.description: Loose knee-length board shorts with an elastic waistband, a drawstring tied in a bow at the front and an all-over pattern of shark silhouettes. They sit at the hips and hang straight to just above the knee.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts fabric and waistband; colour 1 on some of the shark shapes; colour 3 on the other shark shapes; colour 2 on the drawstring.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_03.description: Short, high-waisted brief-style swimsuit bottom with a printed branching, coral-like vein pattern across the body and a smooth contrasting waistband and leg-opening edging. Sits at the hips and covers only the pelvis.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric; colour 1 and colour 3 on the branching pattern; colour 2 on the waistband and leg trim.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_04.description: A cloth sarong-style hip wrap tied in a knot at the front hip, with loose hanging ends, an asymmetric diagonal hem and a patterned floral body with contrasting border trim. Sits at the hips, above the knee.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap fabric; colour 1 on the large round flower motifs; colour 3 on the small flowers and border pattern; colour 2 on the hem border and underside edge.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Bac.description: A short split skirt panel worn at the hips that wraps around the sides and back. Two separate flared flaps with contrasting edge trim leave a gap down the centre back, and the piece ends at upper thigh length.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Bac.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the flaps; colour 1 on the inner surface; colour 2 on the edge trim along the flap borders.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Bac.description: A rear-hanging cloth skirt panel split down the centre into two pointed tails with a contrasting edge trim. It hangs from the waist to about knee level and leaves the front of the legs open, in a traveler style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Bac.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 2 on the edge trim along the hem and centre split.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Fro.description: A short, hip-length cloth skirt split into separate front and back panels, with a slit down the centre front and back. A contrasting stripe with small buttons runs down each front edge, and contrasting trim outlines every hem.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Fro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt panels; colour 1 on the vertical front stripes; colour 2 on the edge trim and waistband; colour 3 on the buttons.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Fro.description: A knee-length wrap skirt of cloth split into front and back panels with pointed, uneven hems, hanging from the hips. Contrasting bands with small studs run down the front slits, and contrasting trim edges every panel.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Fro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt panels; colour 1 on the vertical front bands; colour 3 on the small studs along the bands; colour 2 on the edge trim.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Fro.differs: The front slit is a wider central gap with the two contrasting-banded panels set apart, while the male version has the bands closer to the centre and overlapping panels.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Cosmic_01.description: A sci-fi hip armour set of angular plates: a pointed front panel hanging over the groin and hips, a matching rear plate, and separate tapered plates flaring at each hip. Segmented, sleek and partial in coverage.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front panel and outer hip plates; colour 1 on the inset panels and hip accents; colour 0 on the rear plate and the hip plate edges; colour 3 on small rear markings.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Cosmic_01.differs: The female front panel is mostly contrasting with a contrasting inset, and the rear plate is light; the male version is the opposite, with a light front panel and a contrasting band across it.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Cosmic_02.description: A short segmented hip skirt made of three separate rigid panels, one at the front and one at each hip, with angular cut-in details and thin edge lines. Sits low on the hips over the tights, in a sci-fi armoured style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the front and side panel surfaces; colour 2 on the panel cutouts, back side panels and inner areas; colour 0 on the thin edge lines and the back centre panel; colour 3 on small edge accents at the rear.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Cosmic_02.differs: The female version has a plain contrasting back centre panel, and its side panels hang slightly further apart with darker outer surfaces.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Cosmos_01.description: A pair of angular hip guards shaped like layered blades, one on each hip. Each has a broad shield-like upper plate with inset trim lines and pointed segmented tips that taper down the thigh. Suggests a mechanical or monstrous sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper plates; colour 3 on the inset trim lines; colour 0 on the metallic lower blade edges; colour 2 on the inner blade panels.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Crimson_01.description: A short armoured hip skirt of jagged, pointed plates with a curved waist band and swirling scroll ornaments at the hips. It hangs to the upper thighs in split front and back panels with a gap at the centre, in a fantasy style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt plates; colour 1 on the waist band panel; colour 2 on the raised edging, scroll ornaments and the centre-front panel.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Crimson_01.differs: The female version has a wider central front panel that sits as a contrasting inner plate, and the front plates are more asymmetric.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Cryo_01.description: A set of four separate curved hip plates that sit around the hips: two small ones at the front sides and two wider ones at the sides and back. Smooth and sleek, with slightly flared edges and no fastenings.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the plates; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Draco_01.description: A pair of curved hip guards worn on the outer hips, each built from stacked overlapping plates with pointed fin-like edges and small triangular spikes, tapering downward. Suggests dragon-scale armor with a mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main curved plates; colour 1 on the layered trim bands and lower edges; colour 3 on the triangular spikes.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Element_Fire_01.description: A ragged ring of flame-shaped tongues wrapped around the hips, with pointed licks hanging down over the upper thighs and a gap at the front centre. Reads as a fiery, monstrous partial skirt.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The default material appears glossy and mostly ignores the colour scheme, with only faint bluish sheen across the flame shapes; no clear colour slot areas are visible.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Element_Fire_01.differs: The female version is a solid, glossy flame-shaped skirt rather than the translucent glowing flames of the male version.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Extra_Clothing_Travel.description: A short skirt-like hip cover made of two flat, slightly flared panels split down the centre, with contrasting edge trim. It sits at the hips and hangs to the upper thigh, covering mostly the back and sides.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Extra_Clothing_Travel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel surfaces; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Extra_Clothing_Travel.description: A rear-only cloth skirt panel hanging from the hips, split down the centre into two long pointed tails with hemmed edges. It reaches roughly knee to calf length behind the legs, in a traveler style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Extra_Clothing_Travel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 2 on the edge trim along the hems and centre split.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Gamer_01.description: A hip harness of thin flat straps forming loops around the hips and upper thighs, joined at rounded hubs front and back, with small square buckles and forked clip-like prongs rising near the waist.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the forked prongs; colour 2 on the buckles; colour 3 on the rounded hubs and joints.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Gladiator_01.description: A short gladiator-style loincloth of gathered cloth at the hips, with a long pointed apron panel hanging at the front and back, edged in thick contrasting trim with stepped chevron bands. It ends at the upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth; colour 2 on the outer edge trim; colour 3 on the inner chevron band; colour 1 on the lower chevron band.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Gladiator_02.description: A short gladiator-style hip skirt of jagged, pointed tabs that hang over the hips and upper thighs, with a central front tab and overlapping side panels. The whole piece has a glossy, translucent look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: The default material appears glossy and translucent and largely ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slot is clearly visible on the piece.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Gladiator_02.differs: The female version renders as a glossy translucent skirt with no visible separate trim or panels, and its shape is simpler than the male version, which has a distinct front plate with insets and a contrasting back.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Heraldry_01.description: A short armored hip skirt of stacked, overlapping segmented plates over a fitted waist band, open at the front centre and split at the back. Small rivets edge the plates, with short tie straps at the waist. It suggests medieval or fantasy armor.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waist band and upper hip panel; colour 0 on the segmented plates; colour 2 on the plate edging and outlines; colour 3 on the tie straps and rivets.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Kaiju_01.description: A short, brief-like armoured hip guard of layered ridged plates, with pointed fin-like flares jutting out at each hip and a smooth rounded back panel; sits low on the pelvis with a monstrous, sci-fi feel.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ridged front plates; colour 3 on the smooth back panel and inner lining; colour 0 on the fin-like hip flares.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Lockbox_66_01.description: A knee-length cloth wrap skirt that hangs from the hips, open at the front with a wide V and pointed, uneven hems. The back is draped and gathered, with a geometric diamond-patterned lower panel and contrasting edge trim.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper draped cloth and inner lining; colour 1 on the gradient fade and the diamond motifs; colour 3 on the zigzag lines of the pattern; colour 2 on the hem trim.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Lockbox_66_02.description: A pair of separate curved hip guards, one over each hip, each a pointed shield-like plate with a raised rim, a ring ornament near the top and a tapering point that hangs down the upper thigh. Sci-fi armour styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer frames; colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the small chevron and stripe accents along the lower edge; colour 2 on the ring detail and inner grooves.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_01.description: A long, flowing skirt with a gathered waistband, a tiered ruffle across the hips, and a front split that reveals the legs. Uneven, handkerchief-style hems with ruffled edging fall to about the ankles.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt panels and hip ruffle; colour 1 on the waistband and the ruffled hem edging.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The female skirt has a deep front split that opens between the legs like a wide trouser, while the male version has a more closed front.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_02.description: A short hip-layer skirt of overlapping pointed tapered tabs hanging from a banded waist, with a knotted, wrapped front and a scalloped rear plate; the fangs or claw-like tips give it a tribal, beastly look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waistband, front centre panel and some of the tabs; colour 0 on the front wraps, rear plate and long back tabs; colour 2 on the rear panel and alternating tabs; colour 3 on a thin edge at the top of the waist.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Long_Swing_01.description: A long, full flared skirt with a short overlaid tier at the hip. Chevron stripes sit on the upper tier, geometric patterned bands trim both hems, and a ruffled contrasting flounce finishes the hem at calf length.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Long_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt body and waistband; colour 1 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the patterned trim bands; colour 3 on the ruffled bottom flounce.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Martial_Power_01.description: A short martial hip skirt of quilted, padded side panels that flare outward, with pointed contrasting front and back panels and crossed wrap bands at the waist. contrasting edging outlines every panel; sits low on the hips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the quilted side panels; colour 0 on the front and back triangular panels; colour 1 on the crossed waist wraps; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Mecha_01.description: A mechanical hip-layer armour piece: a rounded pelvic shell with a tapering front plate, angular hip guards on both sides, and two segmented plates hanging at the back. Sits low on the hips with a sci-fi mecha look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shell and back plates; colour 0 on the front plate and hip guard plates; colour 2 on the lower shell and plate edges; colour 3 on the back panel inserts and small accents.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Mechanon.description: A ring of separate angular armour plates hanging from the hips like a jagged, segmented skirt, with pointed tips at different lengths around the body. Sits at the hips with the legs left bare, giving a mechanical, monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate faces and pointed tips; colour 1 on the large angled plates and edges; colour 2 on the small inset panels; colour 3 on the long front plates.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A short, brief-style hip piece of stiff armored panels: a thick rounded rim at the waist, large angular side plates, a central vertical stripe and curved lower panels that cut high at the legs. Sits low on the hips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large side plates; colour 0 on the central front and back stripe; colour 3 on the lower curved panels; colour 2 on the waist rim and edge outlines.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: Short, snug hip-hugging shorts with a large rectangular front panel, angular side panels edged in contrasting piping, and small round studs down each side. Sits at the hips and ends at the upper thigh, with a sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shorts body; colour 1 on the front panel and side panels; colour 2 on the piping edges; colour 3 on the round studs.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The female version has side panels that reach further down the sides, forming pointed wedge shapes on the outer hips, and its back is mostly plain.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A long split skirt with a fitted hip yoke, a narrow centre panel with vertical line details and an angular knotted emblem near the hem, and wide side panels hanging to the calves with a separate band across the thighs.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long side panels and the thigh band; colour 1 on the hip yoke and the centre panel; colour 2 on the seam lines and the top edge; colour 3 on the emblem at the hem.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.differs: The female version has a floating separate band across the thighs and a narrower centre panel that hangs longer, nearly to the ankles, with a ragged, pointed hem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_02.description: A long, open-sided skirt with a fitted hip yoke, a central tapered panel with vertical line detailing ending in a lattice motif, and flowing side panels with pointed, uneven hems that reach near the ankles.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flowing side panels; colour 1 on the hip yoke and central panel; colour 2 on the outlines and vertical lines; colour 3 on the lattice motif at the hem of the centre panel.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_02.differs: The female skirt's central panel hangs longer and narrower, with its lattice motif lower down, while the male version sits shorter with a broader panel.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Mutated_01.description: A fleshy, muscle-like monstrous hip wrap of ribbed lumpy tissue draping over the hips and upper thighs, with tapering tendril tails hanging down, bony horn spikes jutting from the sides, and small eye-like contrasting nodules.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fleshy body and tendrils; colour 0 on the horn spikes; colour 1 on the small nodules; colour 2 on the eye spots.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Mutated_01.differs: The female version hangs in two longer tendrils to mid-thigh and reads more like a split skirt, with a slightly smaller bulk on the hips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Pants_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: Baggy knee-length pirate breeches with a wide fitted waistband, full billowing legs and gathered cuffs that pouch below the knee. A swashbuckling look worn low on the hips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Pants_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the waistband; colour 1 on the main body of the legs; colour 0 on the gathered lower legs and cuffs, blending smoothly into colour 1.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A low-slung hip guard of faceted, angular plates: a thin band around the hips with sharp thorn-like spikes at each side, and a V-shaped pointed panel covering the groin at front and a tapering point at the back.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: The piece shows a glossy metallic finish that largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 appears faintly on the plates.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The female version has a slightly wider, more open V-shaped front panel and thinner side spikes.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Pumpkin_01.description: A pair of separate hip guards, one on each side: bony, openwork shell plates with jagged edges and curved contrasting horns on top, over segmented lamellar plates that hang down the outer thigh. Monstrous fantasy style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony outer shells; colour 1 on the segmented hanging plates and the inner panels; colour 2 on the horns.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky armored hip belt of angular plates: raised side pods with contrasting panels, a V-shaped front plate dipping over the groin, and a faceted tapering plate hanging down the back. Sits low on the hips; sci-fi warlord style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and back plate; colour 3 on the side hip panels and small accents; colour 1 on the V-shaped front plate and inner edge trim. The glossy inner surface ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A brief, rigid brief-style hip piece with a glossy metallic outer shell, a raised rim at the waist, two small vertical plates at the front centre, and a contrasting inner lining. It sits low on the hips, with a retro mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim; colour 1 on the inner lining and edge band; colour 2 on the small front plates and the underside.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_01.description: A brief, jockstrap-like hip piece: a wide belt band circles the hips, joined to a pentagonal front pouch and a rounded rear panel with a trimmed edge. Sleek, revealing and superhero in style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front pouch plate and rear panel; colour 1 on the edge trim and the side and back panel backing; colour 2 on the belt band; colour 3 on the corner tabs beside the front plate.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_01.differs: The female version's belt sits as a level band and the contrasting fabric folds at the front hip are fuller; the male belt dips diagonally to the front pouch with straps running under the rear panel.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_02.description: A brief, brief-style hip layer: a padded waistband with a V-shaped front panel over a layered underbrief, with a small angular armoured plate at the front that tapers into a narrow strip between the legs. Sits low on the hips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the underbrief and lower layer; colour 1 on the padded waistband and front panel; colour 3 on the front plate and the strip between the legs.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Santa_01.description: A short, puffy band-like coat hem that wraps around the hips like a padded skirt ring, with rounded lumpy folds and patchwork panels; it sits at the hips and leaves the legs and torso bare. Festive holiday styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the hem; colour 0 on the back and side panels and the rear bumps; colour 2 on the front-left and side stripe panel and the top edge; colour 3 on the diamond-shaped patch at the front right.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Scarab_02.description: A short, rigid armoured hip guard shaped like a beetle shell: sculpted plates wrap the hips and rear with a V-shaped front, raised side fins, curved groove accents and a small pointed centre piece at the crotch.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 1 on the front centre piece and underside edge; colour 3 on the curved accent grooves; colour 2 on the inner side fins.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Short_Pencil_Skirt_01.description: A short, plain pencil skirt that hugs the hips and buttocks and tapers slightly toward a straight hem with a slightly slanted edge, ending at upper thigh. It sits at the natural waist with no visible detailing.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Short_Pencil_Skirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Shorts_Breeches_01.description: Knee-length fitted breeches with a wide contrasting waistband, small buttons at the waist, and cuffed hems. A row of buttons runs up a contrasting side panel on each outer leg. Suggests a period or pirate look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Shorts_Breeches_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main breeches fabric; colour 1 on the waistband, hem cuffs and side button panels; colour 2 on the buttons.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Anniversary_Wit.description: A high-waisted, mid-thigh wrap skirt of smooth cloth with a diagonal overlapping front panel that forms angular pointed hems, a gradient fade toward the hem, and thin contrasting piping along the edges.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Anniversary_Wit.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper skirt; colour 1 on the lower hem area where the gradient fades in; colour 3 on the edge piping.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Arcane_01.description: A short hip-slung wrap skirt of smooth cloth with a crossing front overlap, twisted rope-like trim at the waist and hem, and a winged eye emblem at the centre front. Mystic, fantasy look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt cloth; colour 2 on the twisted rope trim at waist and hem; colour 3 on the winged emblem; colour 1 on the eye centre of the emblem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Arcane_02.description: A hip-slung fantasy belt of angular winged panels ringed by thin curved rib-like bands around the hips, with a single long narrow cloth panel hanging down the front to about the knee. Leaves the legs otherwise bare.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging front panel and the thin curved bands; colour 1 on the large hip panels and the central knot; colour 2 on the panel segments; colour 3 on small accents at the back of the hips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Birdpeople_01.description: A hip-slung skirt with a draped, gathered upper cloth section, a contrasting belt-like band, and rigid armored thigh plates below with strap brackets. A long cloth flap hangs down the front centre between the legs.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the gathered upper cloth, fading toward colour 0 lower down; colour 0 on the thigh plates and front flap; colour 2 on the band along the hem of the cloth.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Birdpeople_01.differs: The front flap hangs from a knot at the waist and falls shorter, while the cloth skirt sits higher and more draped over the hips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Drka_01.description: A short wrapped cloth skirt sitting at the hips, ending at the upper thigh, with a soft draped surface and a front opening. A tapering tie-like panel with a contrasting border hangs down the centre front.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt cloth; colour 1 on the border of the centre front panel; colour 2 on the inner tapering panel.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Drka_01.differs: The female skirt is shorter and more fitted, ending in a slanted hem at the upper thigh.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Egyptian_01.description: A short Egyptian-style wrapped hip skirt of horizontally banded cloth with fine pinstripes, sitting low on the hips and gathered at the front, with a long tapering panel hanging down the front centre.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Egyptian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded wrap of the skirt; colour 3 on the thin stripes between the bands; colour 1 on the long front panel, fading darker toward its tip; colour 2 in the shadowed gather at the top front.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Egyptian_01.differs: The female skirt is wrapped and gathered low on the hips with an open, folded front, and the front panel hangs from the gather, while the male skirt is a flatter, straighter kilt.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Firebird_01.description: A hip-slung, mid-thigh skirt with a slim waistband and a smooth, softly draped panel that dips to a point at front and back. Long pointed feather-like tabs with inset gem shapes hang from the hem over the thighs.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt panel and tab bodies; colour 1 on the edge piping along the hem and tabs; colour 2 on the waistband; colour 3 on the gem-like inserts in the tabs.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Firebird_01.differs: The female skirt has a more open, asymmetric front with a shorter side panel and the tabs hang in a tighter cluster near the front of the thighs.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Frontslit_02.description: A short, fitted wrap-style skirt with two overlapping front panels that cross into an angled, asymmetric hem, sitting at the hips and ending at upper thigh; contrasting piping edges the hem. Casual to sporty look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Frontslit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt body; colour 2 on the edge piping along the hem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Hakama_01.description: A long, wide-legged hakama skirt with a wrapped sash waistband, vertical pleats down the front and a smooth flared back. It falls to the ankles with side slits at the hips. East-asian martial style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Hakama_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pleated body and waist sash; colour 2 on the thin pleat lines and small back hip details; colour 1 on the inner panel and back lining.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Hakama_01.differs: The female version has open cut-outs at the hips on the sides, showing more of the body.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Harajuku_Layere.description: A short, layered flared mini skirt with a wide waistband closed by a row of small buttons, a shorter overlay panel split open at the centre front, and a fuller underskirt showing beneath. Playful street-fashion look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Harajuku_Layere.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and underskirt; colour 1 on the overlay panel; colour 3 on the dots patterned across the overlay; colour 2 on the buttons.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Harajuku_Rings_.description: A short, flared, ruffled mini skirt with a laced corset-style waistband that dips into garter-like straps ending in metal rings, plus a layered frilly underskirt hem. Sits at the hips, ending at upper thigh; punk-harajuku style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Harajuku_Rings_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waistband and garter straps; colour 3 on the main ruffled skirt; colour 0 on the underskirt frill layers; colour 2 on the seams and lacing; the rings take a metallic look.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Long_Cairngorn_.description: A long, flared layered skirt-robe from the waist to about the calves, with a tiered hem, a pointed contrasting panel down the front, and edge trim on each layer. Loose, flowing cloth with a simple fantasy look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Long_Cairngorn_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt cloth; colour 1 on the front triangular panel and the hem trim bands.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Long_Cairngorn_.differs: The female version has a slightly shorter, more fitted hip with the front panel reaching a little higher at the waist.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Long_Fantasy_01.description: A long, calf-to-ankle-length wrap skirt with a slim waistband and a wide open front slit that reveals a separate contrasting under-panel; the outer cloth ends in pointed, trimmed hems. Fantasy styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Long_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer skirt cloth; colour 1 on the waistband and edge trim along the hems and slit; colour 2 on the inner front under-panel.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Short_Wedding_L.description: A short asymmetric wrap-style skirt with two stacked tiers that slant diagonally from the high hip down toward one thigh, each tier edged in contrasting binding, with a fine beaded fringe line between layers.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Short_Wedding_L.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt panels; colour 1 on the wide outer hem bands of each tier; colour 3 on the thin piping along the tier edges; colour 2 on the small beaded trim between tiers.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Trumpknight_01.description: A short wrap-style cloth skirt sitting at the hips, with a side slit and large angular colour-blocked panels. The hem is uneven and dips lower at the back. Suggests a casual, fantasy-tinged look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Trumpknight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper front wedge and the lower back hem; colour 1 on the large diagonal panel over the front and back; colour 2 on the front lower band; colour 3 on the side and rear-side panel.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_01.description: A knee-length wrap skirt sitting low on the hips, with a V-shaped front waist flap, a cut-away asymmetric hem, repeating chevron stripes and a bold hem band with contrasting piped edging. Tribal, warrior-like look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt body; colour 1 on the chevron stripes, waist flap and wide hem band; colour 2 on the small dashed and chevron marks at the waistband; colour 3 on the piped hem edge.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_01.differs: The female skirt has a deeper, more pointed cut-away notch in the front hem and a shorter side drape.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_02.description: A knee-length wrap skirt with banded waistbands, a wide back panel and open side flaps. A narrow patterned apron with diamond motifs hangs down the front centre. Tribal, warrior-like look, worn low on the hips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt body and the pattern's light areas; colour 1 on the back panel, front side patches and apron stripes; colour 2 on the waistbands, trim bands and the apron's pattern; colour 3 on the top waist panel, the edge piping and the apron diamonds.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_02.differs: The female skirt is asymmetric: the front apron sits slightly off-centre with a larger contrasting patch on one side and a longer, more flared side flap.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Wedding_Layered.description: A long, fitted formal skirt falling to the ankles, with two diagonal ruffled bands sweeping across the hips and a wide contrasting hem band. Smooth cloth body with frayed edging suggests a wedding or gown style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Skirt_Wedding_Layered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt body; colour 1 on the diagonal bands and the hem band; colour 3 on the thin edging along the bands and hem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Spikysuit_01.description: A short, bony hip skirt made of a ring of tapering, pointed plates with ribbed, vertebrae-like ridges, sitting low around the hips with a contrasting lining underneath. Monstrous, armoured look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pointed plate edges and outer surfaces; colour 1 on the ribbed segments between the points; colour 2 on the inner lining under the hem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Steelarachnid_01.description: Brief armoured hip piece shaped like a segmented arachnid shell: a plated front with small vent-like slits, ridged overlapping plates across the rear split by a central strip, cut like briefs at the hips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and front plating; colour 1 on the ridged rear plates and side segments; colour 3 on the central rear strip and the small slits.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Steelcommando_01.description: A low-slung armored hip piece: a thick angular plated waistband dipping to a pointed V at the front, with a pointed codpiece-like panel and separate rounded shorts panels covering the buttocks and upper hips at the back.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plated waistband and central front and back panel; colour 1 on the rounded hip and buttock panels; colour 0 on the inner lining of the band.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Subligar_Long_Viper_0.description: A partial hip belt with a snake-head buckle at the front, spiked plated guards over each hip and a long narrow segmented scaled panel hanging down the front to mid-thigh; a thin cord loops around the waist.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Subligar_Long_Viper_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip guard spikes and belt plates; colour 1 on the hip guard pods and thin cord; colour 2 on the guard undersides and inner details; colour 3 on the long scaled front panel.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Subligar_Long_Viper_0.differs: The female version has the long scaled panel only at the front, with a shorter back; the back is a plain waist band.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Subligar_Rockcrystal_.description: A brief briefs-shaped hip piece of cracked, stacked stone plates with crystal shards jutting up along the waistline, held by thin strap lines around the hips. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Subligar_Rockcrystal_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates and thin straps; colour 3 on the crack lines between the plates; colour 1 on the crystal shards.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Subligar_Rockcrystal_.differs: The female version has thinner, more visible straps at the hips and the crystal spikes sit slightly more spread along the front waist edge.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Super_Retro_Destroyer.description: A brief, smooth superhero brief-style hip piece with a high-cut leg opening and a slightly dished top edge, sitting at the hips with a sleek, glossy finish and no added details.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Super_Retro_Destroyer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and top edge; colour 1 on the main body of the briefs; colour 2 on the inner lining.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Super_Retro_Destroyer.differs: The female version has a dished, bowl-like top opening that dips inward, while the male version has a flat, capped top.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Swan_01.description: A hip-slung armored belt with angular plates and faceted gems at each hip, a brief panelled front and back, and long pointed feathered side flaps hanging down the outer thighs. Fantasy-mechanical winged look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plate rims and feather fringe; colour 1 on the front and back panels and the feathered flaps; colour 2 on the belt band underside; colour 3 on the hip gems.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Swing_01.description: A short hip-slung skirt with a layered flounce, open at the front in two angular tail-like flaps with rows of small buttons, revealing a striped lining inside. Sits low on the hips with a swingy, jacket-tail look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer skirt flaps and flounce; colour 1 on the striped inner lining; colour 3 on the buttons and button tabs.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Swing_01.differs: The female skirt sits lower and hangs looser at the sides, with the front flaps more sharply angled and uneven.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Alien_01.description: A low-slung hip band forming a wide V-shaped brief: crossing angular panels sweep across the front and wrap around the hips, ending in a small pointed plate at the groin and back. Sleek, alien-looking armor.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and crossing panels; colour 1 on the pointed plates at the front and back and the inner lining.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Alien_01.differs: The female band sits lower and flatter, with its front panels crossing in a shallow curve; the male has a taller, more steeply peaked V.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_01.description: A small hip-layer loincloth of armored plates: a shield-shaped front and back panel, each with a V-shaped emblem, a contrasting hanging tab below and swept spikes at the top corners. Hangs at the groin and rear over tights.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate frames and side plates; colour 0 on the V-shaped inner bands; colour 3 on the central emblem and the top spikes; colour 2 on the hanging lower tabs.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_02.description: A small armoured hip piece: a shield-shaped plate with a circular emblem, angular spiked fins at the sides, and a long narrow pointed tail panel hanging down the front, plus a matching side plate on the hip.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer plate shell and side plate; colour 0 on the inner panel; colour 3 on the emblem and spikes; colour 2 on the long hanging tail panel.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_Epic_03.description: A hip-layer armour set: curved, heart-shaped plates with jagged upper edges and a pointed centre over the front and back of the hips, with bat-wing-like fins at each side and a small rectangular loincloth flap hanging at the front.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_Epic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front and back plates; colour 1 on the side wing fins and plate edging; colour 3 on the central emblem; colour 2 on the front hanging flap.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_Epic_04.description: A small rigid rear hip plate shaped like a curved shield with jagged, horn-like upper points and a pointed lower tip. It sits over the buttocks and lower back, with a raised rim and a central emblem. Fantasy-armor styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_Epic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the raised rim and the inner shell; colour 3 on the central emblem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Armorbriefs_04.description: Low-slung armored briefs made of padded, stitched plates: a rim band around the hips, a rounded front pouch panel and large back panels, with criss-cross lacing at the front and back and small stitched details.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Armorbriefs_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, rim and edging; colour 1 on the padded front pouch and back panels; colour 2 on the lacing; colour 3 on the small stitched marks.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Barbarian_Norse.description: A tribal fur loincloth-style brief with shaggy, jagged-edged fur around the hips and upper thighs, worn under a wide studded belt with a large sculpted buckle at the front. Barbarian, Norse-inspired look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Barbarian_Norse.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur body; colour 1 on the fur tips; colour 2 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the studs and buckle.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Belly_01.description: A band wrapping the midriff with a large rounded, bulging belly shape at the front, smooth and slightly wrinkled, flattening into a plain strip around the sides and back. Suggests a monstrous or bloated-creature look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Belly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole belly piece; the flat band at the back and sides shows a faint tint of colour 1.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A low-slung hip piece: a snug brief-style base with a contoured waistband, a round central disc at the front, and two large shield-shaped plates at the hips, each bearing a raised winged emblem and edged with a rim. Small curved spurs rise from the band.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brief base and the plate faces; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 2 on the plate rims, spurs and front disc; colour 3 on the winged emblems.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A hip-slung tattered skirt with a jagged spiky waistband, a pointed V-shaped front panel with ragged hem, angled side strips, and long tapering tail-like strips hanging down the centre. Beastly, savage style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt panels; colour 1 on the waistband spikes and the tips of the hanging strips; colour 2 on the edge piping and the inner strips; colour 3 on the angled side strips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The female skirt has a long central tail strip hanging at the front between the legs, with the skirt panels shorter and more open at the sides.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Defender_Update.description: A pair of angular hip and thigh plates: pointed, tapering shell panels down each outer thigh, held by stacked banded straps with inset accent strips. Sits over the hips as a partial, armoured, sci-fi add-on.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Defender_Update.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed shell panels; colour 2 on the strap bands; colour 3 on the inset strips along the bands. Colour 0 is not visible.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Defender_Update.description: Pair of hip and thigh armour guards, each made of overlapping pointed plates that taper down the outer thigh, held by stacked bands with slim inset strips. They sit at the hips over the bare legs, giving a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Defender_Update.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed plates; colour 2 on the bands and their brackets; colour 3 on the thin inset strips. Colour 0 is not visible.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Deity_01.description: A brief, high-cut brief-style hip piece with a stiff angular band around the waist that rises into notched points at front and back, and a smooth cloth-like seat and pouch below. Sits low on the hips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front pouch and the upper waistband; colour 1 on the back, side panels and inner lining.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Electric_01.description: A brief, armored hip layer shaped like high-cut briefs, with a segmented front plate, ribbed rear panels, and two curved cable-like conduits arching up from the hips with a thin wire between them. Sci-fi tesla-coil styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main brief shell and rim; colour 1 on the ribbed front and rear panels; colour 2 on the conduits, hip mounts and crotch trim; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Electric_01.differs: The female version has no contrasting coil springs at the hip mounts and adds a thin wire linking the two conduits across the front.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Fairy_01.description: A short hip-slung skirt with a jagged, leaf-like hem of pointed tapering tips, some ending in small claw-like points. A wide contrasting band wraps the hips, giving a wild fairy or forest look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Fairy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper front panel and the central hem points; colour 1 on the side and back hem points and upper panels; colour 2 on the wide hip band; colour 3 on the small inner hem points.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Fantasy_01.description: A fantasy hip piece: a short contrasting loincloth-style wrap with a pointed, trimmed hem, worn under a studded belt with round shield-like plates, a large ornate oval buckle at the front and smaller discs at the sides.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap; colour 1 on the hem trim; colour 3 on the belt band and shield plates; colour 2 on the studs, buckle relief and belt edging.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Giskirt_01.description: A short, wrinkled cloth gi skirt sitting low on the hips, with a slightly curved hem, a loose crumpled drape and small side slits that let it flare open at the sides. Suggests martial-arts wear.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Giskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; the inner waist lining shows a darker shade of the same cloth, with no other visible colour slots.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A low-slung hip belt of translucent, glassy holographic panels: a thin band circles the hips with angular blocky pouches at the sides and back and a faceted pouch hanging at the front.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material is a glowing, translucent effect that ignores the colour scheme, so no slot visibly changes it.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The female version is a translucent holographic effect that ignores the colour scheme, while the male version is solid with distinct colour panels.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Knight_02.description: A short armoured hip skirt of three stacked, overlapping plates ringing the hips, studded with cone spikes at the sides and back, with a long narrow tapered front tabard hanging to mid-thigh and bearing a tribal lightning-like pattern.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and the front tabard; colour 1 on the pattern on the tabard; colour 2 on the inner lining at the waist edge and the plate edge lines.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Knight_02.differs: The tabard is offset slightly to the front-centre and sits a little lower, with the plates shaped more sharply over the hips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Knightsubligar_.description: A short banded armor skirt of stacked horizontal plates with stitched edges, worn at the hips. Buckled straps hang from the waistband, and the front is cut away in a deep arch for a knight-like tasset look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Knightsubligar_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and upper plates; colour 3 on the lower plates; colour 1 on the stitched edging and rivets; colour 2 on the buckle straps.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Knightsubligar_.differs: The female version has visible stitched trim lines along each plate edge and a narrower, deeper front cut-out.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Light_01.description: A short hip-slung armoured loincloth skirt with pointed front and back panels, a cut-away open side, and stacked chevron bands on the back. Contrasting piping outlines the plates. Sits low on the hips in a fantasy-knight style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panels; colour 1 on the outline piping and edge trim; colour 2 on the chevron bands on the back and inner side.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Light_01.differs: The female version is open on one side, leaving the hip bare, and its chevron bands show mostly at the back and on that side opening.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_02.description: A short tribal loincloth hanging from the hips, with a front and back panel that have ragged hems, open sides with stitched edging, and a painted thorny glyph design. It sits low on the hips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panels; colour 1 on the waist edge and one half of the side stitching; colour 3 on the other half of the stitching; colour 2 on the painted glyph markings.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_Lemur.description: A hip-slung armoured loincloth with separate front and back plates joined by ribbed side wings; stacked chevron bands point downward on the front, and a matching pointed rear plate hangs behind. Sits low on the hips with a sci-fi, alien feel.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_Lemur.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed side wings; colour 1 on the chevron bands and front centre panel; colour 2 on the main plate bodies; colour 3 on the thin etched line markings.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_Lemur.differs: The front is a wide, shallow panel with chevron bands that stay near the hips, and the ribbed side wings flare outward over the hips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Loinclothmedici.description: A short tribal loincloth with separate front and back panels hanging from a slim waistband, decorated with a thorny branch-like motif. Trimmed edges and a padded, flapped medicine pouch sit on the right hip.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Loinclothmedici.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panels and pouch; colour 1 on the waistband line and part of the edge trim; colour 3 on the other part of the edge trim; colour 2 on the branch-like print.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Loinclothmedici.differs: The female pouch hangs lower and is larger and thicker on the hip, with a more pronounced flap.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Magicalgirl_Lac.description: A short flared miniskirt sitting at the hips, with a glossy centre front panel, contrasting side panels and a scalloped, zigzag-edged frilly hem that flares outward. Cute magical-girl styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Magicalgirl_Lac.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy centre panel and the frilly hem; colour 1 on the inner side panels and the hem zigzags; colour 2 on the outer side panels and waistband edge.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Monster_01.description: A hip-slung skirt of overlapping, downward-pointing bone-like plates in tiers, with a small V-shaped upper panel at the waist. Front and back sections hang to mid-thigh and taper to sharp points, giving a monstrous look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main plates; colour 0 on the plate edges and ridges; colour 1 on the V-shaped waist panel.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Monster_02.description: A short hip skirt of overlapping pointed plates in stacked, chevron-shaped tiers, with a V-shaped panel at the waistband and jagged tips at the hem. It hangs from the hips to the upper thigh, with a bestial, bone-armour look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Monster_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main overlapping plates; colour 1 on the V-shaped waist panel and upper edge; colour 0 on the highlights along the plate ridges.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A low-slung armored hip piece: segmented plates form a briefs-like shape with a V-shaped belt band across the front and a rounded, panel-lined section covering the buttocks. Sleek, mechanical, sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 2 on the V-shaped belt band and the trim edges; colour 1 shows only faintly in the panel shading.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.description: A short wrapped hip skirt with a thick gathered sash at the waist, a layered flared skirt beneath with contrasting edging, and a katana with scabbard tucked through the sash at a diagonal, hilt up by the ribs.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the gathered sash; colour 0 on the skirt layer; colour 1 on the skirt edging, sword handle wrap and scabbard; colour 3 on the sword guard and scabbard tip.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.differs: The female skirt is a little shorter and flares wider at the hem, and the sword sits higher on the ribs.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Padding.description: A ring of separate rounded armor pads around the hips: two large padded plates over the buttocks, a curved plate at the front of the pelvis, and smaller pads at each hip. It reads as tactical hip protection.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper surfaces of the pads and the front plate; colour 1 on the curved side sections of each pad; colour 2 on the lower panels of the rear pads and inner hollows; colour 3 on a small accent under the front plate.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Padding.differs: The female version has a smaller, more pointed front plate that sits lower, with the hip pads spaced further apart.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Power_01.description: A brief, low-slung hip piece: a thick padded waistband with a square buckle plate and round centre lens, over a short brief-style panel that tapers to a pointed front and rounded rear. Superhero power-suit look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband; colour 1 on the square buckle plate; colour 2 on the round centre lens; colour 3 on the brief panel and inner lining.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Puffy_01.description: Short puffy bloomer-style breeches with a fitted waistband studded with small round buttons. Vertical panels balloon out over the hips and thighs and gather in at the mid-thigh hem, giving a historical, swashbuckling look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Puffy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the waistband and the seams between panels; colour 3 on the studs along the waistband; colour 1 on the wide striped panels; colour 0 on the alternating panels and the front crotch panel.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Punk_01.description: Low-slung, short button-fly denim-style shorts with a row of buttons down the front, back pockets, and ragged, frayed leg hems. They sit at the hips with a mottled, worn look and a punk, street feel.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 split across the fabric, with a worn, mottled texture; colour 3 on the front buttons; colour 2 on the inner waistband.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Punk_01.differs: The female shorts show a two-tone split, one half of the fabric appearing patched or contrasting, and have a slightly more ragged, uneven hem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_01.description: Knee-length loose cloth shorts with a low waistband, baggy legs and turned-up cuffs at the knee. Contrasting panels with contrasting stitching run down the outer thigh and over the lower front of each leg. Casual street look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the shorts; colour 2 on the side and lower-leg panels; colour 1 on the cuffs; colour 3 on the stitching.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_02.description: Tight ankle-length pants with a low contrasting waistband and legs slashed into horizontal strips that grow wider and more open toward the ankles, leaving a ladder-like strap effect. Punk rave styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hips and upper legs; colour 1 on the mid legs; colour 2 on the lower legs and strap bands; colour 3 on the waistband and ankle trim.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_03.description: Knee-length, low-slung shorts with a contrasting V-notched waistband and slashed, ladder-like cuts down the outer thighs and lower legs. The fabric fades toward the hems, giving a torn rave or street look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shorts body; colour 1 on the lower legs and hem strips, blending up from the light upper fabric; colour 3 on the waistband.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_03.differs: The female version's slashes are fewer and mostly on the outer thigh and lower leg, with a lower-cut, hip-hugging waist.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A pair of rigid, sci-fi thigh guards worn on the outer hips and upper thighs: curved armored shells with vented slits and small stud lights, plus a softer separate flap panel at the inner edge of each guard.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor shells; colour 1 on the inner flap panels, trim edges and lower caps; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_02.description: A pair of separate angular armored hip plates, one on each side, that hang down the outer thighs as pointed blade-like shields, with segmented plating, contrasting inner panels and small stud rivets. Mechanical, salvaged sci-fi look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and pointed tips; colour 1 on the inset panels and edge stripes; colour 2 on the inner segmented sections; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_04.description: A pair of long, tapering side panels hanging from the hips to below the knees, one with segmented plated ribs and contrasting edge trim, the other a smooth plain sweep; a mechanical, monstrous wing-like skirt.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented plate panels; colour 1 on the edge trim and on the smooth panel; colour 2 on the darker recessed sections between plates; colour 3 on the small round markings.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_04.differs: The smooth plain panel sits on the wearer's left hip with the plated panel on the right, so the plain panel is set further back than on the male.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Retroscifi_Subl.description: A brief, faceted hip piece shaped like a high-cut brief, with a pointed front and a wide back panel. Low-poly triangular facets give it a crystalline, armoured look, and thin curved edges flare at the hip.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Retroscifi_Subl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faceted surface; colour 2 on the darker facets and edge flares at the hips; colour 1 gives a slight tint to some facets on the back.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Retroscifi_Subl.differs: The female version is cut higher on the hips with thin flared edges at the sides, and it looks more like a thong-style brief.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Rippedshorts_01.description: Loose-fitting cropped trousers that sit low on the hips and end below the knee with jagged, frayed hems. Small torn holes show on the thighs, knees and rear, giving a scruffy, worn look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Rippedshorts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole garment; the torn patches show a darker inner surface; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A cybernetic hip layer: a brief brief-shaped armored panel with a ribbed centre plate, cylindrical pod nodes studded around the waist, and thick looping cables wrapping the hips. Sits low at the pelvis with a sci-fi, mechanical look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armored panel and framing; colour 1 on the ribbed front plate and the cylindrical pods; colour 2 on the looping cables; colour 3 on the small centre lights of the pods.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Ripper_01.differs: The female version has a smaller ribbed plate at the front and a narrower, more angular panel with wider-set cable loops.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.description: A mechanical hip armour skirt of angular plated panels, with front and back flaps, a round bolt-like hub on each hip, small clawed prongs at the waist and swept-back fins jutting from the sides. Sci-fi mecha style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer front and rim panels; colour 2 on the back panels, hip hubs and prongs; colour 1 on the side fins and vent stripes; colour 3 on the panel seams, hub centres and accent marks.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.differs: The female version has a more open, flared front split between two large plates, with a slightly longer front flap.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.description: A small flat rectangular hip panel hanging over one upper thigh, like a samurai tasset. It is a thin plate with a rounded central shape, a wide horizontal band across the middle and a small rectangular inset near the top.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Robotsamurai_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel's outer border and backing; colour 1 on the large rounded central shape; colour 2 on the horizontal band across the middle; colour 3 on the small rectangular inset near the top.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A low-slung hip brace with a raised, pointed rim around a wide open frame, a fitted panel over the rear, and a single long narrow cloth flap hanging down the front of one thigh to the knee.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging flap and rear panel; colour 1 on the outer rim; colour 2 on the inner edge of the frame.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The female version has a slimmer frame with a more pointed rim at the hip, and the flap hangs closer to the side of the thigh.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A short, padded hip wrap shaped like briefs or a loincloth, with a raised waistband and a pointed front and back. Contrasting side panels with piped edges flank the hips, and small flaps hang at the sides.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main padded body; colour 2 on the side and back waistband panels; colour 1 on the piping along the panel edges.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Samuraiplate_01.description: Two separate hip guards of stacked, overlapping rectangular lames, one curving over each outer hip and thigh, leaving the front and centre open. Samurai-style segmented armour hanging to mid-thigh.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Samuraiplate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faces of the plates; colour 1 on the edge trim around each plate; colour 2 on the inner undersides of the plates.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01.description: A ragged fur loincloth-style skirt hanging from the hips, with jagged, tattered strands at the hem; it drapes over the front and back with an open gap at the sides. Suggests a beastly, primal look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur at the waistline, fading gradually into colour 1 toward the tattered tips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01.differs: The female version is a shorter front panel with a wide open gap at the hip sides and a fuller, deeper back panel, and the colour fades more strongly to colour 1 at the tips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01_Be.description: A ragged fur loincloth-style hip skirt with a fitted top edge at the hips and jagged, tattered tufts hanging to mid-thigh at front and back, open at the sides. Suggests a beast or primitive look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01_Be.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the fur near the waist; colour 1 on the lower fur and jagged tips, blending down from the top.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Scifi_Solldier_.description: Brief armoured sci-fi hip briefs made of smooth segmented plates, with a pointed, layered front codpiece panel and rounded side and rear panels. They sit low on the hips and leave the legs bare.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Scifi_Solldier_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central front and back panels and the lower edges; colour 1 on the large side and rear panels; colour 2 on the edge panels at the hips and rear.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Shorts_01.description: Fitted capri-length pants sitting at the hips, snug through the seat and thighs, with soft wrinkles at the knee and a slightly gathered, flared hem below the knee. Casual, plain cloth construction.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Shorts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole garment; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Shorts_01.differs: The female version is longer, with a gathered hem that ends just below the knee, and it fits closer to the leg.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongpleats.description: A long pleated skirt with a fitted low-slung yoke at the hips that flares into many vertical pleats, ending in a slightly ruffled hem near the ankles. Flowing, soft and casual-to-fantasy in style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongpleats.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt including the pleats and yoke; colour 1 on a thin contrasting band along the hem.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongruffle.description: A long, fitted skirt that sits at the waist and narrows down the hips and legs to the ankles, ending in a tiered ruffled flounce at the hem. Soft cloth with a plain, elegant look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongruffle.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt body and the ruffled hem; no other colour slots are clearly visible.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongslitsi.description: A plain, close-fitting long skirt that sits on the hips and falls to about the ankles, with high slits up both sides that show the legs. The cloth has soft wrinkles and a straight, narrow hem.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongslitsi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; a small area at the waistband may take another slot, but it is too small to tell.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmed_01_Web.description: A fitted mid-thigh skirt that sits at the hips. The solid upper part turns into an open spiderweb lattice of radial strands and curved cross-bands, with pointed tips at the hem. Gothic, spider-themed style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmed_01_Web.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt, both the solid upper part and the web lattice; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmedangle_0.description: A plain, close-fitting cloth pencil skirt sitting at the hips with a diagonal asymmetric hem, shorter on one side and dipping lower on the other, ending around mid-thigh. Simple, smooth construction with soft folds.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmedangle_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; colour 1 shows faintly on the inner lining at the waist.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmedcap_02.description: A plain, tight pencil skirt that sits at the hips and ends around the knees, with a slightly tapered hem and soft cloth wrinkles. Simple, smooth construction suits casual or formal outfits.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmedcap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; no other colour slots are visible.
