Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmedpleats_.description: A short pleated skirt with a fitted low-slung yoke at the hips and a band of contrasting trim, flaring into sharp knife pleats that end with a jagged hem around mid-thigh. Casual, schoolgirl or sporty in style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmedpleats_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt including the pleats and yoke; colour 1 on the thin trim band around the yoke.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmedruffles.description: A fitted knee-length pencil skirt sitting at the hips, with a smooth tapered body and a band of stiff pleated ruffles flaring out around the upper hip like a peplum. Neat, tailored, office-formal look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtmedruffles.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt and the ruffles; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtshort_Gold.description: A short flared cloth miniskirt sitting at the hips, with a pointed V-shaped hem, a broad contrasting border and vertical stripes running down from the waist. Suggests a retro superhero or sporty look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtshort_Gold.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt fabric; colour 1 on the hem border and the vertical stripes.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtshortangle.description: A short, plain cloth hip skirt with an angled hemline: high across the front and left hip, then sweeping down to a longer point at the wearer's right side and back. Sits low on the hips.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtshortangle.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtshortbasic.description: A plain, short fitted mini skirt of soft cloth that hugs the hips and ends at upper thigh, with a slightly darker inner lining visible at the waistband and a simple straight hem.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtshortbasic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt exterior; the inner waistband lining shows a metallic-looking shade from the default material and does not follow a clear slot.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtshortpleat.description: A very short pleated mini skirt that sits low on the hips, with a flat waistband, a contrasting stripe band across the upper skirt, and flared pleats ending well above mid-thigh. Casual, schoolgirl-like style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtshortpleat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pleated skirt body and waistband; colour 2 on the inner waistline lining visible at the top. The stripe band across the upper skirt also takes colour 0.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_0.description: A short hip-slung brief-style piece with a banded waist, a contrasting front panel hanging down the centre, angular pointed flaps at the sides and a rounded fitted seat at the back. Suggests a sci-fi Egyptian loincloth.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the brief and side panels; colour 0 on the hem flaps, rear panel and upper edge trim; colour 2 on the front centre panel and waistband sections; colour 3 on the waistband segments at the sides.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_0.differs: The female version has longer, more pointed side flaps that hang away from the hips, while the male version sits closer to the body.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Spartanskirt_01.description: A short Spartan-style skirt of overlapping rigid vertical strips hanging from a studded waistband, over a plain under-skirt that shows between the strips. Sits on the hips and ends above mid-thigh; suits a greco-roman or gladiator look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Spartanskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging strips; colour 1 on the outlines, waist rim and hem edging; colour 3 on the round studs along the waistband; colour 2 on the under-skirt.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Steelhawk_01.description: Brief, high-cut hip layer shaped like briefs, with a winged V-shaped front panel of layered feather-like plates, open cut sides and a smooth rounded back. Sits low on the hips with a superhero look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Steelhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole piece, including the winged front plates and the back; colour 2 on the thin edge lines at the sides and leg openings.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Steelhawk_01.differs: The female version has a deeper V-shaped winged front panel with open, thin-lined cut sides, and lacks the jagged side edges and contrasting piping bands of the male version.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Subligarluchado.description: High-waisted wrestling briefs with a wide banded waistline, soft gathered cloth and high-cut leg openings that sit at the top of the thighs. Casual, sporty luchador-style underwear or shorts.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Subligarluchado.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole brief body; colour 1 possibly on the waistband and leg-opening edges, though these look mostly the same light tone on this sheet.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: Two separate layered fin-like blades flaring out from each hip, made of stacked curved plates with pointed tips and a jagged notch. They sit on the outer hips as a monstrous, biomechanical accent.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer and lower plates; colour 1 on the middle plate of each cluster; colour 2 on the tall inner spike plates; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A pair of curved, blade-like fins that jut from the hips, each a sweeping crescent with a rim edge and a separate inner face. Worn over the hips and upper thighs, with a sleek symbiote look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edges; colour 1 on the outer faces of the fins; colour 2 on the inner faces.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Teleosskirt_02.description: A medium-length wrapped skirt sitting at the hips, with soft draped cloth folds and a hem cut into pointed arches at front and back that dip to points at the sides of the thighs. Edged with contrasting trim.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Teleosskirt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt cloth; colour 1 on the hem edge trim.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Teleosskirt_02.differs: The female skirt hangs slightly longer at the side points and closes around the hips, while the male hem opens more at the front thigh.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Trenchcoat_01.description: A knee-length, fitted trench coat skirt with an elastic waistband, a double-breasted front closure with two rows of large buttons, and a slightly angled hem. It sits at the hips, in a casual noir style.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Trenchcoat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt body and waistband; colour 1 on the front seam line; colour 2 on the buttons.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Trenchcoat_01.differs: The female skirt is a slimmer, tapered pencil shape with a slanted hem and a visible contrasting seam line, and its buttons sit in a slightly offset arrangement.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Trenchcoatshort.description: A very short, flared cloth mini skirt cut from a trench coat, with a ribbed elastic waistband, two large round buttons and a thin contrasting seam down the front. It sits low on the hips and ends at the upper thigh.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Trenchcoatshort.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt body and waistband; colour 1 on the thin front seam line; colour 2 on the two buttons.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Cargo_01.description: Loose-fitting cargo capri pants ending below the knee with split, flared hems. A slanted decorative belt with a square buckle sits low on the hips, and flap pockets hang on the outer thighs.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Cargo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trousers and pockets; colour 1 on the slanted belt band; colour 3 on the belt buckle and small studs or dots; colour 2 on the thin waist belt.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Cargo_01.differs: The female belt buckle sits at the side of the hip and the belt slopes gently, while the male buckle sits nearer the front centre.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Shorts_01.description: Loose, baggy calf-length urban shorts with a low-slung waistband, a wide studded belt with a square buckle, and ripped, frayed patches and raw hems. They sit on the hips with a casual street look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Shorts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts fabric; colour 2 on the upper waistband; colour 1 on the belt base; colour 3 on the belt studs and buckle.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Victory_01.description: Two curved, shield-shaped pointed panels hang from the hips, one at the front and one at the back, each with a thick contrasting border and a diamond tip. The back panel has chevron ridges; a superhero tabard-like look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel surfaces; colour 2 on the thick outer borders and edging; colour 3 on the raised chevron stripes of the back panel; colour 1 on the diamond tips.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Victory_02.description: A small shield-shaped hip panel hanging from the back of the hips, tapering to a point at mid-thigh, with a raised border and swooping chevron-like stripes. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Victory_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer border; colour 0 on the main panel surface; colour 3 on the raised curved stripes; colour 1 on the diamond at the tip.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A short armoured hip skirt made of stacked, chevron-shaped overlapping plates that flare outward and end in points, with a narrow vertical plate down the front centre. Sits low on the hips, mid-thigh at most.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces and centre front plate; colour 1 on the plate edging and borders; colour 3 on the thin stripe lines across the plates; colour 2 on the slot in the front plate.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A short, loose cloth skirt with a gathered elastic waistband, soft draped folds and a flared hem that sits high on the thighs, finished with a wide band of interlocking geometric key-pattern trim.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt body; colour 2 on the patterned hem band, with the pattern picked out in a contrasting slot.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Urban_Anime_Shirt_Wra.description: A jacket or shirt tied around the hips by its sleeves, forming a short skirt-like wrap with a contrasting panel, a square patch at the front hip, and two sleeves hanging down the front thigh. Casual street look.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Urban_Anime_Shirt_Wra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the shirt and the lower sleeve cuff; colour 1 on the large contrasting panels at the back and sides; colour 2 on the waist band and one hanging sleeve; colour 3 on the square patch.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A large decorative bow worn at the small of the back, with two long pointed tails hanging down the backs of the legs to the calves, each tipped with a small round bobble. Jester-like, festive styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot, bobbles and parts of the loops and tails; colour 1 on the tail stripes and some loop sections; colour 2 on the loop and tail panels; colour 3 on the loop sections and tail stripes.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The female bow has bright, patchwork-like panels of alternating colour on its loops and tails; the male version looks darker and glossier, mostly one contrasting tone.

Female/F_Hipslayer_Wolf_01.description: A hip-length armored skirt of separate plates with a wide belted centre, flared side panels with swirl engravings, and jagged, pointed lower edges with a long central spike. Trim borders every plate; fantasy beast styling.
Female/F_Hipslayer_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the swirl engravings and central belt emblem; colour 2 on the belt band and rear inner panel; colour 3 on the trim edging.

Female/F_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.description: Scaled, form-fitting monster leggings reaching the ankles, with overlapping plates across the hips and groin, segmented plates down the back of each thigh, and banded plates around the shins and calves.
Female/F_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaled leg surfaces; colour 0 on the overlapping hip and groin plates; colour 2 on the segmented back-thigh panels; colour 1 on the shin and calf plates.
Female/F_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The female version has narrower back-thigh panels that end lower and a stripe of contrasting plating running down the outer side of the calf.

Female/F_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.description: Form-fitting scaled leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a layered segmented plated groin panel at the front, padded panels on the back of the thighs, and ridged segmented shin guards.
Female/F_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaled legs; colour 0 on the segmented groin panel; colour 1 on the ridged lower-leg sections; colour 2 on the padded back-thigh panels.
Female/F_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The contrasting lower-leg sections run longer and slimmer, and the front of the shin shows a distinct segmented panel; the male version has shorter calf sections.

Female/F_Legs_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a contrasting panel on each inner thigh and crotch and scattered small round spots down the outer legs and back. Sleek, amphibian-like look.
Female/F_Legs_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg surface; colour 2 on the inner thigh and crotch panels; colour 3 on the small spots.

Female/F_Legsaccessories_Dragonbody_Lock.description: A single tapering fin-like calf accessory of layered, swept flame or scale ridges that flares outward at the top and narrows to a point down the outside of the lower leg, suggesting a beast or dragon body.
Female/F_Legsaccessories_Dragonbody_Lock.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the ridges and the smooth inner panel; colour 1 on the outer ridge tips, forming a gradient toward the top.

Female/F_Legsaccessoriesl_Dragonbody_Loc.description: A flame-like fin or plume attached to the outer side of the left lower leg, built from layered swept ridges that fade to jagged pointed tips toward the back. A smooth flat inner face sits against the calf.
Female/F_Legsaccessoriesl_Dragonbody_Loc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the plume and its smooth inner face; colour 1 on the pointed flame tips toward the rear, blending gradually from colour 0.

Female/F_Legsaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_2025.description: A pair of curved, feather-like fins attached along the outer side of the left leg, one on the thigh and one on the calf, each with a swept tip and ragged frilled edge. Suggests an aquatic, monstrous creature look.
Female/F_Legsaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_2025.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner surface of each fin; colour 3 on the frilled outer edges and rims of each fin.

Female/F_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Loc.description: A flame-like fin or frill attached to the outer right calf, made of swept, wavy ridges that flare into pointed tips at the top and taper to a long point near the ankle. Suggests a dragon or beast look.
Female/F_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Loc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower and front parts of the frill; colour 1 on the upper flared tips, blending in as a gradient.

Female/F_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Loc.description: A sculpted, flame-like fin or plume attached to the outer right calf, with swept ridged layers that taper to a wispy point near the ankle. It reads as a monstrous or dragon-inspired leg accessory.
Female/F_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Loc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the plume and its lower tip; colour 1 on the upper rear crest, blending into colour 0 lower down.
Female/F_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Loc.differs: The female version is a slimmer, narrower plume that hugs the calf more closely.

Female/F_Legsaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_2025.description: A pair of frilled, feather-like fins attached to the outer side of the right leg, one at the thigh and one at the calf. Each is a swept, pointed blade with ragged, layered edges, giving an organic aquatic look.
Female/F_Legsaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_2025.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer edges and rims of each fin; colour 1 on the inner body of each fin.

Female/F_Lockbox_65_Dragon_Hips_Tight_01.description: Form-fitting scaled dragon legs with a textured reptilian skin, overlapping segmented plates across the hips and groin, padded ridged panels down the back of the thighs, and armoured knee and shin segments; reaches the ankles.
Female/F_Lockbox_65_Dragon_Hips_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaled leg skin; colour 0 on the overlapping hip and groin plates; colour 1 on the knee guards and the lower shin panels; colour 2 on the back thigh panels.

Female/F_Mask_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.description: A demonic horned half-helm mask covering the brow, eyes and nose with a spiked crest. Two tall curved horns sweep up from the temples, and a separate lower face guard covers the mouth and jaw. Monstrous fantasy look.
Female/F_Mask_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and horns; colour 3 on the flame-like markings around the eyes; colour 1 on the lower face guard.

Female/F_Mouth_Armor_Viper_Supremeserpen.description: An angular armored jaw guard that wraps along the jawline from ear to ear. Chunky plates sit over the cheeks, banded metal segments run along the jaw, and a pointed fanged chin cup sits at the front. Suits a monstrous or sci-fi helmet look.
Female/F_Mouth_Armor_Viper_Supremeserpen.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cheek plates; colour 1 on the chin cup and its fang points; colour 2 on the jaw band; colour 0 on the lighter underside segments.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Abe_Lincoln_01.description: A chin-strap style beard in the Abe Lincoln manner: a thick, textured band of hair-like fur running from the sideburns along the jaw and under the chin, leaving the mouth and upper lip bare.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Abe_Lincoln_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the beard; colour 1 as streaky mottled patches through the beard; colour 2 as darker streaks near the chin edge.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_01.description: A wild, full beard made of layered pointed tufts that run from the sideburns around the jaw and chin, ending in long jagged tips at the chin. Suggests a feral, beastly look.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and upper part of the tufts; colour 1 on the tips of the tufts.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_02.description: A full braided beard with a moustache and cheek whiskers that sweep up into horn-like points beside the ears, ending in a thick plaited tail cinched by a band and tipped with a clawed tuft. Suggests a brutal, barbaric look.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and tips; colour 1 on the shaded locks and streaks through the beard; colour 3 on the band around the braid.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_03.description: A thick, bushy moustache of streaky strands that sits over the upper lip and curves down past the corners of the mouth into pointed, drooping tips. Suggests a rugged, brutish or old-fashioned look.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips and lower ends of the strands.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Cobra_01.description: A large handlebar-style moustache with a thick, gathered centre above the lip and two long, tapering, pointed tips sweeping down and outward past the mouth corners. Pleated, fur-like ridges suggest a stylised, flared cobra hood.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Cobra_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the gathered centre and inner sections; colour 0 on the tapering outer tips, blending from one to the other.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Dragonbody_Lockbox_.description: A beard-like mouth accessory of layered, swept feather-like tufts that wrap from the chin along the jaw and sweep up and back beside each ear, ending in tall curved horn-like plumes; a monstrous, beastly look.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Dragonbody_Lockbox_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tufts along the chin and jaw; colour 1 on the tips of the tufts; colour 2 on the base of the ear plumes; colour 3 on the tips of the ear plumes.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Gladiator_01.description: A full, thick beard with a swept-up moustache, spiky layered sideburn locks and a braided tail that ends in a contrasting tie and a frayed tip. It hangs from the chin to the upper chest and suggests a rugged warrior.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the moustache and the upper beard and sideburns; colour 1 on the lower beard, braid and tip; colour 2 on the braid tie.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_01.description: A full beard made of layered, pointed strands that taper to a point below the chin, flanked by swept-back feathery whisker fins at each cheek. It wraps the jaw and has a smooth backing panel behind the neck.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the beard strands and cheek fins; colour 1 on thin accent streaks between the strands and along the fin edges; the back panel takes colour 0.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_01.differs: The female beard is shorter and narrower under the chin, with a smaller, more pointed tip.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_02.description: A shaggy, fur-like beard hanging from the chin in a narrow tapering shape, with jagged strands falling to a point on the upper chest and a smooth cupped backing behind the jaw. Suits beast or monkey-king looks.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur tufts and backing; colour 1 on the thin streaks running through the strands.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_02.differs: The female beard is narrower and more pointed, hanging in a slim wedge rather than spreading wide.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_01.description: A bushy handlebar mustache with strands of textured hair sweeping outward from the upper lip into long, pointed curls at each side, plus a small soul-patch tuft beneath the lower lip.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the mustache and the tuft; colour 1 on the outer curled tips and the tuft's underside, blending from colour 3.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_02.description: A spider-shaped beard hugging the chin: a compact, veined body with eight slender, pointed legs sweeping up along the jaw, plus a small separate pointed fang piece above the lip.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the veined spider body and the leg bases; colour 1 on the leg tips and the small upper fang piece.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_02.differs: The female spider body is smaller and sits lower on the chin, with longer, more swept-out legs that reach up toward the mouth corners.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_03.description: A monstrous beard and moustache made of layered, feathery petal-like strands that fan over the chin, with long curling tentacle tendrils sweeping up around each cheek and a pointed tip hanging below the chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the moustache and the main beard strands; colour 1 on the curling tentacle tips, blending in from the beard base.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_04.description: A stylised villain facial-hair set: a wide moustache with long curling upturned tips, and a broad pointed goatee gathered into a tie below the chin, ending in a tapered tuft. Sits on the upper lip and chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the moustache and goatee hair; colour 1 on the curled moustache tips and the tuft ends; colour 2 on the tie band.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_05.description: A villainous handlebar moustache and beard in one piece: a curled moustache above a broad, fibrous beard that fans out to each side into long, curling tendril tips, sitting over the mouth and chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_05.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main moustache and beard mass; colour 1 on the curling tendril tips, blending into colour 3 at the base.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_06.description: A stylised winged facial-hair accessory: a thin angular moustache band across the upper lip sweeps out into pointed wing tips at the cheeks, with two curved whiskers below and a small spike at the chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_06.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the central moustache band and lower whiskers; colour 1 on the outer wing tips and chin spike, blending into colour 3.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_07.description: A full hair beard with a separate moustache: shaggy, textured strands run from the sideburns along the jaw and cover the chin, with a heavy curled moustache over the upper lip and a jagged upper edge by the ears.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the moustache; colour 3 on the main beard and sideburns; colour 1 on the inner side of the sideburns and jaw edge.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_07.differs: The female version has a contrasting moustache that is separate from the beard, with a broad gap around the mouth.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_08.description: A full chin-strap beard of coarse, wavy hair that runs from the sideburns along the jaw and around the chin, with an open gap at the mouth. It has a rough, shaggy texture and reads as casual and rugged.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_08.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main beard hair; colour 1 on the inner edges and underside near the jaw.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_08.differs: The female beard has no separate moustache and leaves the mouth area open, with a thinner, more ragged outline.

Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_09.description: A thick handlebar mustache with a textured, strand-like surface, sitting across the upper lip and sweeping outward into long, pointed tips that curl upward past the cheeks. A playful, villainous facial-hair accessory.
Female/F_Mouth_Beard_Villain_09.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the mustache; colour 1 on the curled outer tips, blending from colour 3 towards the ends.

Female/F_Mouth_Beast_Spider_01.description: A pair of spider-style mandibles: bulbous rounded pods flanking the mouth and cheeks, each with a mottled patch of small plates and tapering into a curved, pointed fang that hangs down beside the chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Beast_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the mandible pods; colour 0 on the mottled patches; colour 2 and colour 1 on the fang tips, fading from one to the other.

Female/F_Mouth_Bike_01.description: A mechanical jaw guard that wraps from both sides of the head down under the chin to a pointed front, with slatted vents along the cheeks, angular cheek plates and a small contrasting front vent. Sci-fi biker style.
Female/F_Mouth_Bike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin piece, jaw bar and rear panels; colour 1 on the outer cheek plate frames; colour 3 on the recessed inner cheek panels; colour 2 on the front vent.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Beard_Monkey_02.description: A shaggy, tapering beard hanging from the chin, with a smooth cupped upper edge under the lip and streaky, wispy strands ending in ragged points at the chest. Suggests a beastly or monkey-like look.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Beard_Monkey_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the beard; colour 1 on the thin streaks running through the strands.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Beard_Monkey_02.differs: The female beard is narrower and longer, forming a slim pointed tuft that hangs further down the chest.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Beast_Spider_01.description: A pair of spider-like mandibles: two swollen, rounded pods with a bumpy speckled patch on the outer face, each tapering to a curved fang tip, hanging on either side of the mouth and chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Beast_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the mandible pods; colour 0 on the speckled patches; colour 2 on the fang tips, fading to colour 1 at the points.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Beast_Spider_01.differs: The female version has only the two side mandibles, without the small central piece between them at the mouth.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Celestial_Dragon_02.description: A set of separate monstrous fangs: a row of long pointed upper teeth across the mouth with curved tusks at the corners, and a smaller lower row of spikes curving down along the jaw and chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Celestial_Dragon_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Celestial_Dragon_02.differs: The lower teeth curve down further along the jaw and form a longer, more U-shaped row.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Cyberpunk_Monster_T.description: A U-shaped row of small pyramid-like teeth that loops from the jaw hinge on each side down around the throat, forming a monstrous toothed maw or jaw fringe over the lower face and neck.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Cyberpunk_Monster_T.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Dragon_Silly_01.description: A jagged row of flat, angular triangular plates that forms a spiky collar-like fringe around the jaw and neck, with the points rising along both sides of the face. Suggests a silly dragon-like, monstrous accessory.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Dragon_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the triangular plates; colour 2 on the thick edging around each plate.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Gasmask_Insect_01.description: An insect-style gas mask covering the mouth and chin, with a ribbed filter grille at the front, curved contrasting mandible-like spikes at each side, and thick hose loops running up and over the back of the head to a cylindrical clasp.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Gasmask_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed grille; colour 1 on the mask shell and the cylindrical clasp at the back of the head; colour 2 on the mandible spikes; colour 3 on the hoses and small details.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Guardian_01.description: A spiked collar of overlapping angular shards that ring the base of the neck, with a larger pointed fang hanging at the front centre and shards fanning out at the sides and back. Suggests a dragon-scale or monstrous necklace.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiked shards; colour 1 on small hidden underside segments visible at the back of the neck.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Guardian_02.description: A long, flowing beard-like piece that hangs from the chin down over the upper chest, with a cupped upper edge, swept vertical strands and a tapering, jagged point at the bottom. It suggests a wise dragon or fantasy sage.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Guardian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the beard; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the strands.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Guardian_03.description: A smooth, elongated beak-like snout cover that starts wide at the mouth and tapers to a blunt point below the chin, projecting forward and downward. It is hollow behind and suggests a stylised dragon or bird muzzle.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Guardian_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole snout; the hollow inner side takes a darker shading of the same slot.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_01.description: Two pairs of small mandible-like appendages at the sides of the neck: long tapering tusks with a bulbous tip and a skull motif near the base, plus a pair of short curved contrasting hooks between them. Monstrous alien styling.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bulbous tips; colour 0 on the upper tusk shafts and skull motifs; colour 1 on the tapering tusk points; colour 2 on the short inner hooks.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_02.description: A pair of long curved mandibles hanging from the jaw line down over the collarbones, each with a bulbous tip, a tapering tusk-like blade with small claw spikes on the inner edge, plus two small contrasting fangs at the throat.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bulbous tips; colour 0 on the upper shafts and the small spikes; colour 1 on the tapering lower blades and skull-like markings; colour 2 on the small throat fangs.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_03.description: A pair of giant curved mandibles jutting from the sides of the jaw: each has a rounded cap and a segmented collar, then a long tapering horn-like tusk with small spikes along the inner edge, sweeping down over the collarbones.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rounded caps and the tusk bodies; colour 0 on the collar segments; colour 3 as speckled markings on the tusks; colour 2 on the tusk tips.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_01.description: A beast-like muzzle piece that covers the nose and mouth in a long, tapering snout, with rows of curved fangs lining both sides and hanging below the chin. Suggests a raptor or monstrous creature look.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper snout; colour 1 on the lower snout and tip, blending from colour 0; colour 2 on the teeth.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_02.description: A beast-like muzzle piece: an angular, wedge-shaped snout covering the nose and mouth area, tapering toward the chin, with rows of curved fangs projecting along both sides of the jaw. Suggests a raptor or monster.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper snout, fading into colour 1 toward the chin end; colour 2 on the curved teeth.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_03.description: A beast-like mouth piece: a faceted, hollow beak-shaped cover over the mouth and chin that tapers into a long, thin pointed tongue-like tip extending forward and down past the chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cover and mouth housing; colour 1 on the tapering tip, blending in as a gradient; colour 2 on the inner hollow.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_03.differs: The tip on the female version is longer and reaches further below the chin.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Tight_Leech_01.description: A monstrous leech-like mouth piece: a ribbed, fluted cup sits over the nose and mouth, with a dense fringe of thick tentacle-like tendrils hanging down past the chin to the neck.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed cup, which shows a skin-like tone from the default material; colour 1 on the hanging tendrils, fading towards the cup.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_01.description: A set of sharp, jagged monstrous teeth forming a ring around the mouth and jaw, with two taller curved fangs at the corners pointing upward. It sits over the lower face as a beastly mouth overlay.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and fangs; the other colour slots are not visibly used on this sheet.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_01.differs: The female version has only short upward corner fangs, while the male version adds two long curved tusks hanging down past the chin.

Female/F_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_02.description: A set of bestial teeth around the mouth: a row of small jagged fangs along the jaw, with two long curved tusks sweeping down past the chin to the neck. Reads as a monstrous werewolf look.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and tusks; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_02.differs: The female version has two very long curved tusks hanging down past the chin to the neck; the fangs along the jaw are smaller.

Female/F_Mouth_Cigar_01.description: A short, rounded cigar-shaped stick held at the corner of the mouth, with a contrasting band near the lit end, a fluffy fibrous tip at the other end and a thin twisted fuse trailing off it.
Female/F_Mouth_Cigar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cigar body; colour 3 on the band near the mouth end; colour 0 on the fluffy tip and the fuse.

Female/F_Mouth_Cigar_01_1.description: A small cylindrical cigar held in the mouth, angled downward and outward from the lips, with a rounded wrapped body, a narrow contrasting band near the mouth end and a rough textured tip at the far end.
Female/F_Mouth_Cigar_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cigar body; colour 3 on the band; colour 0 on the rough ash tip.

Female/F_Mouth_Cyberwire_01.description: A cybernetic jaw guard: a curved, segmented plate cups the chin and jawline and rises to a round disc pod over each ear, with a contrasting rim and small circular vents. Sci-fi partial face piece.
Female/F_Mouth_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jaw plate; colour 2 on the ear discs and chin band; colour 1 on the rim of each ear disc; colour 3 on the circular inserts in the discs and jaw sides.

Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_01.description: A mechanical cyborg jaw plate that wraps under the chin and along both jawlines, rising to angular hinge plates by the ears with hex-bolt pivots. Leaves the lips and mouth open.
Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jaw plate and hinge plates; colour 1 on the underside of the jaw; hex bolts take colour 0.

Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_03.description: A cybernetic jaw guard that wraps under the chin and along the jawline, with angular plates rising toward the ears and a rounded central panel over the chin. Suggests a mechanical or monstrous look.
Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer jaw plates and rising side plates; colour 1 on the central chin panel; colour 2 on the panel edges and inner recesses; colour 3 on the thin trim lines along the lower edge.
Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_03.differs: The female version has a solid chin panel with contrasting trim and no vented grille, while the male version has a ventilator grille and ear-side nubs.

Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_04.description: A cyborg jaw brace: a curved metal band cradles the chin and jaw, rising to studded knobs near the ears, with a boxy vented respirator grille over the mouth. Reads as a mechanical, sci-fi face guard.
Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jaw band and respirator housing; colour 1 on the grille slats and inner rim; the ear knobs also take colour 0.
Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_04.differs: The female version is a vented respirator grille with a curved jaw band reaching up to knobs by the ears, while the male version is a solid smooth plate covering the mouth with no grille or ear knobs.

Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_05.description: A angular armored mouthguard: a chunky faceted plate covering the mouth and chin, with a lighter top edge under the nose and thin side wings curving back along the cheeks toward the jaw.
Female/F_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and side wing edges; colour 1 on the main front plate and inner surfaces; colour 2 on the darker inner recess.

Female/F_Mouth_Dragon_Silly_01.description: A U-shaped jaw-like guard wrapping around the chin and along both jawlines, with a segmented ridged upper band, two curved fangs at the front corners, and a row of triangular spikes hanging below like a dragon's lower jaw.
Female/F_Mouth_Dragon_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main jaw band; colour 3 on the segmented upper ridge and the fangs; colour 0 on the hanging triangular spikes; colour 2 on the back and underside of the band.

Female/F_Mouth_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.description: A pair of slender curved horn-like whiskers that start at the corners of the mouth and sweep outward and down in tapering points, like a dragon's barbels. They hang at the mouth and reach past the chin toward the collarbones.
Female/F_Mouth_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible.
Female/F_Mouth_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The whiskers sit at the mouth line but hang lower, near the collarbones, and look slightly thinner than on the male.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Alien_Hybrid_01.description: A face mask covering the nose and mouth down to the chin, made of angular overlapping plates with a diagonal band across the upper face and small studded details; pointed side flaps reach toward the ears. Suits alien or sci-fi looks.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Alien_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main lower plates; colour 2 on the diagonal upper band; colour 0 on the side flaps and edges; colour 3 on the angled patch near the mouth.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Animatronic_01.description: A robotic jaw brace that wraps under the chin: a boxy central block with two small round lights, a band of blocky teeth along the lower lip, and angular slab plates rising at each side of the jaw.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the chin block, jaw band and side slabs; colour 0 on the teeth and inner edge trim; colour 3 on the round lights.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Aquatic_01.description: A small faceted bird-beak accessory that covers the nose, with a raised ridge along the top and a pointed tip. Two contrasting nostril-like wedges sit at the base. Suggests an avian or animal-themed costume.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper ridge of the beak; colour 0 on the main lower beak body; colour 2 on the nostril wedges.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Beard_Santa_01.description: A full, fluffy fake beard with a moustache, a contrasting horizontal band across the cheeks and a jagged, tufted lower edge hanging to the chest. A thin loop strap runs over the head to hold it in place.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Beard_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the beard, the side whiskers and the thin head loop; colour 1 on the moustache and main beard body; colour 2 on the horizontal band across the upper beard; colour 3 on the central vertical stripe.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Beard_Santa_01.differs: The female version has a thin loop strap over the top of the head, and its side whiskers are shorter and less spiked.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Destroid_01.description: A pair of angular plate guards flanking the lower face, one on each cheek and jaw. Each is a flared, pointed panel with a bordered edge, leaving the mouth open, in a mechanical armored style.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Destroid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the raised edge trim around each plate.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Fangs_01.description: A pair of curved, tapering fangs that hang down from the upper lip on either side of the mouth, each ending in a sharp point. They suggest a vampiric or beastly look.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Fangs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fang bodies; the pointed tips show a darker shade that does not follow the scheme.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Holoforce_01.description: A faceted, gem-like mouth guard that covers the nose bridge down to the chin, with a pointed top and angular segmented panels. It has a glowing, translucent energy look, suggesting a sci-fi holographic mask.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material appears glowing and translucent and mostly ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows bright with faint energy streaks.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Holoforce_01.differs: The female version is a glowing, translucent energy shell, while the male version is a solid opaque faceted guard with contrasting edge trim.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Joke_01.description: An oversized joke nose that fits over the real nose: a rounded, bulbous, hollow-backed shape with a jagged, spiky fringe flaring out beneath it above the upper lip. Comic, clown-like.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Joke_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the nose; colour 1 on the jagged fringe underneath.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Nightvisor_01.description: A V-shaped mechanical mouth and jaw guard that wraps under the chin and sweeps up both cheeks to round ear-side pods with contrasting lens-like centres, topped by tall angular fins. Sci-fi tactical helmet style.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Nightvisor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jaw plates and pod rims; colour 1 on the upward fins; colour 3 on the accent panels along the lower edge and chin; colour 2 on the pod centres.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Steam_Plague_Mask_01.description: A skeletal jawbone frame that wraps around the face from ear to ear, meeting in a pointed chin, with rows of sharp teeth along the inner edges. It leaves the face open, suggesting a monstrous steampunk look.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Steam_Plague_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone-like jaw frame; colour 1 on the spiked teeth.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Tentacle_01.description: A cluster of thick, tapering tentacles hanging from the mouth and chin area, with a long central tentacle flanked by shorter curling ones that end in sharp points. A monstrous, cephalopod-like face accessory.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Tentacle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to have no clear separate area; the whole piece shows a single fleshy skin tone with darkened tips, so it looks unaffected by the colour scheme.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Urban_Lipring_01.description: A small octagonal hoop lip ring worn through the lower lip, just left of centre, hanging in front of the mouth. A simple, edgy piercing suited to street and punk looks.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Urban_Lipring_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metal finish appears to take little from the other colour slots.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Urban_Lipring_02.description: A pair of small metal lip rings, each a thick open hoop with a tiny bead end, set on either side of the lower lip near the mouth corners. A subtle street or punk piercing.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Urban_Lipring_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both rings; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Vine_01.description: A cluster of thick, tentacle-like tendrils hanging from the mouth and chin, curling and tapering to sharp claw-like tips, with striped swirling markings. Suggests an alien or monstrous beast mask.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tendrils; colour 1 on the swirling stripes and bands; colour 3 on the pointed tips.

Female/F_Mouth_Face_Witch_Nose_01.description: A large prosthetic witch nose with a broad bridge and bulbous sides, extending down and curving into a long hooked point that ends in a tapered tip past the mouth. Sits over the natural nose.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Witch_Nose_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the nose; colour 0 on the tapering hooked tip.
Female/F_Mouth_Face_Witch_Nose_01.differs: The female nose shows a skin-tone finish rather than the contrasting default colouring on the male version.

Female/F_Mouth_Falconer_01.description: A faceted, angular bird-beak mask covering the nose, mouth and chin, tapering to a sharp downward point with small nostril holes on top and a wrapped shell that curves around the jaw toward the neck.
Female/F_Mouth_Falconer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole beak mask; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Medium.description: A half-face respirator mask covering nose and mouth, with a small breather nozzle on top, angular armored plates, ribbed vent slots on the front, and round filter canisters on both cheeks. Suits military, sci-fi and cyberpunk looks.
Female/F_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Medium.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper brow-like plates and edging; colour 1 on the front chin panel and the round cheek filters; colour 2 on the side and back plates; colour 3 on the vent slits.

Female/F_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Prison.description: A compact respirator mask covering the mouth and chin, with a vented front grille and side filter canisters. Two thick hoses loop up and around the head to a padded cylindrical block at the back of the skull.
Female/F_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Prison.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front grille and vent plates; colour 1 on the mask shell, filter canisters and the rear cylinder block; colour 3 on the hoses and small studs.
Female/F_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Prison.differs: The hoses arch higher and the rear cylinder sits further up the back of the head, so the loop is taller.

Female/F_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Mask_Paintball.description: A sleek half-face mask covering the nose bridge, cheeks and chin, with a central ribbed breather grille and angled side vents crossed by thin bars. It wraps around the jaw toward the ears in a sci-fi, tactical style.
Female/F_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Mask_Paintball.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell and grille rim; colour 1 on the central breather grille; colour 3 on the side vent panels; colour 2 on the bars across the side vents.

Female/F_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Ripper_01.description: A cybernetic jaw guard covering the chin and lower face, with a toothed grille over the mouth, jagged spiked ridges rising along the cheeks, and four short cylindrical vent nozzles jutting out from the sides and underside.
Female/F_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main jaw shell; colour 0 on the jagged cheek ridges, rim and mouth grille; colour 2 on the nozzle cylinders; colour 3 on the rings around the nozzles.

Female/F_Mouth_Gasmask_Insect_01.description: A small insectoid respirator over the mouth, with a ribbed grille and twin filter pods, flanked by two curved contrasting mandible-like claws. Tubes loop up around the face to a padded cylindrical block on top of the head.
Female/F_Mouth_Gasmask_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed grille; colour 1 on the mask body, filter pods and head block; colour 3 on the tubes and small accents; colour 2 on the mandible claws.

Female/F_Mouth_Guardian_01.description: A dragon-inspired mouth and jaw guard: a rounded, padded cover across the lower face with a bordered rim, spiky fin-like flares at the sides and a tapering, feathery beard-like tuft hanging below the chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded front cover, spikes and beard tuft; colour 1 on the inner lining and the tip of the tuft; colour 2 on the border band; colour 3 on the piping along the rim.
Female/F_Mouth_Guardian_01.differs: The female guard has less pronounced side spikes and the contrasting piping runs as two separate lines rather than joining across the bottom.

Female/F_Mouth_Helmetgrill_01.description: A rigid mouth and jaw guard that wraps under the chin and up the cheeks to round rivet-like pivots near the ears, with a contrasting rim along the top edge and rows of short slashed grooves across the front.
Female/F_Mouth_Helmetgrill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and inner lining; colour 1 on the upper rim edge; colour 3 on the slashed marks; colour 2 on the pivot bolts.

Female/F_Mouth_Jaw_Rockcrystal_01.description: A U-shaped jaw of chunky stacked rock slabs that wraps around the chin and up along both jawlines to the cheeks, with rows of sharp crystal spikes jutting forward and outward like teeth. Monstrous, fantasy style.
Female/F_Mouth_Jaw_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between the stones; colour 1 on the crystal spikes.

Female/F_Mouth_Kabuto_01.description: A small kabuto-style chin guard: a curved plate sits under the lower lip, with two cord ties rising along the cheeks toward the ears and a decorative bow knot with dangling tails hanging beneath the chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Kabuto_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin plate; colour 2 on the plate edge outline; colour 1 on the cords and the bow knot.

Female/F_Mouth_Kazoo_01.description: A small kazoo: a tapered rectangular tube with three finger holes along the top and a round capped membrane cup near the wider end. It is held in the mouth and points forward, angled slightly downward.
Female/F_Mouth_Kazoo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the kazoo body; colour 1 on the round cap; colour 3 on the marking on top of the cap.

Female/F_Mouth_Kazoo_02.description: A small kazoo held in the mouth: a tapered, boxy tube that points forward from the lips, with slots along the top and a round wheel-like cap near the far end. Playful novelty accessory.
Female/F_Mouth_Kazoo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and sides of the body; colour 0 on the underside and the slot panels; colour 3 on the round cap; colour 2 on the small centre hub of the cap.

Female/F_Mouth_Llama_Tongue_01.description: A single curved, tapering tongue that extends forward from the mouth then bends sharply downward, hanging over the chin. It has a smooth, faceted, rounded form and reads as a playful beast or creature mouth accessory.
Female/F_Mouth_Llama_Tongue_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the tongue near the mouth; colour 1 on the lower hanging tip; colour 2 on the underside edge near the mouth.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Blackpaladin_01.description: A rigid, angular mouth mask covering the nose tip down to the chin, with stacked horizontal louvre ridges across the front and small round studs at each side where the mask meets the cheeks. Suggests a mechanical respirator or grill.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Blackpaladin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and louvre ridges; colour 1 on the inner recessed curves of the interior; small round side studs take colour 0.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_01.description: A mechanical lower-face mask covering nose bridge to chin, with a jagged-toothed grin plate, a heavy banded frame, two tall slab fins rising at the cheeks and round discs at the sides. Sci-fi, monstrous and prison-brute in style.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer frame bands and cheek edges; colour 0 on the grin plate and fin edges; colour 1 on the mouth interior behind the teeth; colour 2 on the tall fin panels and side discs.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_02.description: An asymmetric half mask covering only one side of the lower face and chin, with a thick padded band looping around the head at nose level and a stitched, grinning mouth design on the fabric panel.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the loop band around the head; colour 0 on the fabric mouth panel; colour 3 on the stitched grin markings.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_03.description: A fabric surgical-style mouth mask covering the nose-to-chin area with a vertical seam down the centre, held by a thin rigid loop band that wraps around the head above the eyes and down the cheeks.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin band framing the mask and looping around the head; colour 2 on the cloth of the mask; colour 3 on the centre seam stripe.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_04.description: A paneled cloth mouth and jaw mask covering nose-bridge to chin, with contrasting edge binding, dashed stitch lines across each panel, and three round vent-filter rings at the chin and both cheeks.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 3 on the edge binding and stitching; colour 1 on the round vent rings; colour 2 on the top nose strip and bottom rim.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_05.description: A cloth respirator-style mouth mask covering the lower face, with a printed toothy grin band across the front, a thin border strap looping over the head, and round ribbed filter canisters on each cheek.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth mask body and border strap; colour 1 on the grin teeth band; colour 3 on the cheek filter canisters.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Jaw_01.description: A half-face mask covering the nose, cheeks and jaw, with a rigid plated upper shell, curled scroll-like ridges at the sides, and a lower jaw lined with rows of sharp fangs. Suggests a monstrous or samurai-style guard.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Jaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell and side scrolls; colour 1 on the inner jaw lining and lower rim; colour 3 on the teeth and gums.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Muzzle_01.description: A restraint-style muzzle mask covering the lower face, with a rigid curved plate over the nose and mouth, slotted mouth vents, and a thin frame band arching over the head. A wide strap of bundled cables wraps around the back of the head.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Muzzle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face plate and frame band; colour 1 on the mouth slots and small studs; colour 3 on the rivets and strap clasps; colour 2 on the rear strap.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Ragingbull_01.description: A bull-faced mask covering the face from brow to muzzle, with a broad elongated snout, a hooded eye band with a central seam, angled cheek panels and a hanging nose ring. The back is a smooth hollow shell.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Ragingbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forehead, snout and nose ring; colour 1 on the cheek and muzzle panels; colour 2 on the eye band; colour 3 on the small jaw-side accents.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Steampunk_01.description: A steampunk mouth-and-nose mask covering the lower face, with a central panel of eyelet holes, angular side plates, and a plain lining inside. Thin straps with small rings loop over the head and cheeks to hold it.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central mask panel and inner lining; colour 1 on the angular side plates and top brow piece; colour 3 on the head straps; colour 2 on the eyelets and rings.

Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Teddybear_01.description: A cute teddy bear muzzle mask: a rounded, softly textured snout that covers the nose, upper lip and chin, with a small diamond-shaped nose on the tip and a thin curved mouth line underneath.
Female/F_Mouth_Mask_Teddybear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the muzzle; colour 1 on the nose; colour 2 on the mouth line.

Female/F_Mouth_Party_Blower_01.description: A small party blower held in the mouth: a straight tube mouthpiece with a banded tip end, and a paper coil that curls into a flat spiral and extends out in front of the lips. Playful, festive novelty accessory.
Female/F_Mouth_Party_Blower_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tube; colour 2 on the tube end and the band at the coil joint; the coil has a spotted pattern with colour 1 spots and dots that ignore the scheme, on a light base.

Female/F_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_01.description: Two pairs of insectoid mandibles flanking the jaw and neck: long tapering spikes with a bulbous tip and a skull-like marking, plus a small pair of short curved fangs between them. Monstrous, alien styling.
Female/F_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bulbous tips; colour 0 on the upper spike segments and skull markings; colour 1 on the tapering spike ends; colour 2 on the small inner fangs.
Female/F_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_01.differs: The female version hangs the long mandibles slightly further from the neck and angled outward, with the small fangs spaced a little wider.

Female/F_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_02.description: A pair of long, curved insectoid mandibles hanging from the jaw line down toward the collarbones, each tapering to a point with small side barbs and a bulbous tip, plus two small inner curved blades near the chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bulbous tips; colour 0 on the upper shafts and small side barbs; colour 1 on the lower tapering shafts and skull-like marking; colour 2 on the small inner blades.

Female/F_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_03.description: A pair of giant curved mandibles that sit at the sides of the mouth and sweep down past the chest. Each has a rounded capped base, a segmented collar and a tapering horn-like tusk edged with small spikes.
Female/F_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rounded caps and the tusk bodies; colour 0 on the collar segments at the base; colour 3 as small speckled markings on the tusks; colour 2 on the tusk tips and shadowed undersides.

Female/F_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_Humanfac.description: A pair of long curved insect mandibles that jut from either side of the mouth and sweep down past the chin, each ending in a sharp tip with a row of small spikes along the inner edge.
Female/F_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_Humanfac.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rounded base caps and the mandible shafts; colour 0 on the collar rings at the base; colour 3 on speckled markings along the shafts; colour 2 on the tips and spikes.

Female/F_Mouth_Sandstorm_01.description: A mouth-and-nose respirator mask with a rounded front filter plate showing vented slots, framed by a thick padded rim and a wide ridged strap that wraps around the head, fastened by an octagonal clasp at the back.
Female/F_Mouth_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the strap; colour 1 on the front filter plate; colour 3 on the vent slots inside the plate; colour 2 on the rear octagonal clasp.

Female/F_Mouth_Scuba_01.description: A snorkel-style mouth piece: a mouthpiece sits at the lips, a rigid segmented tube rises up past one side of the face with a capped top, and a ribbed flexible hose curves back along the other cheek.
Female/F_Mouth_Scuba_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rigid tube; colour 3 on the tube's top cap; colour 2 on the ribbed flexible hose; colour 1 on the thin trim ring at the mouthpiece.

Female/F_Mouth_Spiked_01.description: A jaw-wrapping band that runs under the chin and angles up along both sides of the face toward the ears, with a small block at the chin and short cone spikes along the lower edge. Brutal, monstrous look.
Female/F_Mouth_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main band; colour 1 on the chin block; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 0 on the inner edge of the band.
Female/F_Mouth_Spiked_01.differs: The female band is contrasting and glossy, with fewer visible rivet holes and a slimmer profile than the male band.

Female/F_Mouth_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of curved, blade-like cheek guards, each a pointed leaf-shaped plate with a raised rim, standing off the cheeks from beside the eyes down to the jaw. Suggests a sleek sci-fi or beastly helmet accent.
Female/F_Mouth_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim edges; colour 1 on the outer plate surfaces.

Female/F_Mouth_Starhawk_02.description: A pair of curved, blade-like cheek guards that sweep from beside the eyes down along the jaw to points near the chin, leaving the mouth open. Faceted, shell-like plates suggest a beastly or mechanical helm.
Female/F_Mouth_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of both plates; colour 1 on the inner surfaces and edges. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Mouth_Starowl_01.description: A hooked bird-beak mask covering the nose and mouth: a hollow, pointed shell that curves downward to a sharp tip past the chin, with small nostril marks on top. Suggests a raptor or owl costume.
Female/F_Mouth_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 2 on the lower tip and underside of the beak.

Female/F_Mouth_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A retro villain-style mouth frame: two separate angular metal tubes, each running up the cheek, turning along the jaw and ending near the chin, with a small hooked prong curving in toward the mouth.
Female/F_Mouth_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 on the metal tube frames, giving a glossy metallic finish; colour 1 on the hooked prongs by the mouth.

Female/F_Mouth_Techno_01.description: An angular sci-fi mouth and jaw guard: a V-shaped metal plate cups the chin, with tall pointed cheek fins sweeping up each side and vented side panels with round perforations. Sits over the lower face.
Female/F_Mouth_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin plate, cheek fins and outer shell; colour 1 on the perforated side panels; colour 2 on the inner recesses beneath the fins; colour 3 on the small holes in the side panels.

Female/F_Mouth_Tendril_01.description: A pair of long, thin, whip-like tendrils that sprout from small collars at either side of the mouth and curve outward and upward past the cheeks, tapering to fine points like dragon whiskers.
Female/F_Mouth_Tendril_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tendrils; colour 0 on the small collars where they attach at the cheeks.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Armor_Jaw_01.description: A slim, open metal jaw guard: a thin angular band that runs from in front of each ear down along the jawline and meets in a shallow point under the chin, leaving the mouth and cheeks bare.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Armor_Jaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the band; colour 2 on the underside of the chin and the inner edges. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Bear_Boss_01.description: A jaw-shaped mouth guard of thin angular plates with large jagged teeth along the bottom edge, curving under the chin from ear to ear and fastened by round bolt-like discs at each cheek.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Bear_Boss_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner face of the plates; colour 2 on the outer face and edging of the plates; colour 1 on the round bolts at the cheeks.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A angular chin guard: a faceted cup under the chin with thin flat bands that sweep up along the jawline toward the cheeks. It reads as a mechanical, armoured mouth piece.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole guard, including the chin cup and the jaw bands.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Carrot_01.description: A long tapering cone worn as a false nose, like a carrot or beak, projecting straight out from the centre of the face and pointing slightly downward, with faint ridged banding along its length.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Carrot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide base of the cone, blending into colour 1 toward the tip.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Clownnose_01.description: A small round clown nose: a smooth, hollow rubber-like ball that sits over the tip of the nose. The back is open to fit over the face. Suggests a playful, cute costume.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Clownnose_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole nose ball; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Cowboyrobotjaw_02.description: A small angular armored chin guard covering the mouth and jaw, with a flat top lip, a thin horizontal slot across the front, and short flared side wings at the cheeks. Suggests a robotic or mechanical half-mask.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Cowboyrobotjaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole chin guard and side wings; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Cowboyrobotjaw_03.description: A slim, angular mechanical chin guard that covers the mouth and jaw and tapers to a blunt point below the chin. A central vertical panel is edged with thin contrasting stripes and flanked by faceted side plates.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Cowboyrobotjaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted side plates and upper rim; colour 1 on the central front panel; colour 3 on the thin stripes bordering the central panel.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: A sci-fi open-face helmet shell: a thick angular ring framing the face and wrapping around the head, with layered side panels, ribbed vent inserts on top and a small boxy sensor block at the chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and the inner face lining; colour 1 on the recessed panels and inserts; colour 3 on the thin stripe accents; colour 2 on the chin block and edge framing.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The female chin block is a little narrower and sits slightly lower, and the ring is less bulky at the sides.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Deity_01.description: A faceted, angular mouth guard that wraps across the lower face from cheek to cheek, with a V-shaped upper edge and a pointed chin. Folded planes give it a sleek, alien, armored look.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the right half of the front and its raised upper edge; colour 1 on the left half of the front and the inner back surface.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Dinojawbone_01.description: A skeletal dinosaur jawbone worn like a chin frame: two bony arms rise along the sides of the face to pointed tips above the ears and join under the chin, where a row of curved claw-like teeth points forward.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Dinojawbone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony jaw arms; colour 2 on the teeth.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Dual_Tusk_02.description: A pair of short, chunky tusk-like guards set either side of the chin below the mouth, each with a flared upper cuff, banded segments and a pointed tip curving forward. Suggests a beastly or armoured helmet look.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Dual_Tusk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared upper cuffs and the pointed tips; colour 1 on the main body of each tusk; colour 2 on the banded segment near the tip.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Egyptian_Pharaoh_01.description: A pharaoh-style ceremonial false beard: a tapered rectangular column with a woven herringbone pattern, banded at the top, and a flared, ribbed curled tip at the bottom. It hangs from the chin.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Egyptian_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the woven beard body; colour 2 on the bands at the top and bottom of the beard; colour 1 on the ribbed tip and the top cap.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Gasmask_Medium_01.description: A half-face respirator mask covering nose bridge, mouth and chin, with angular armored plates, a ribbed front filter panel and rounded filter canisters on each cheek. Suggests a tactical or sci-fi combat look.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Gasmask_Medium_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper nose and outer armor plates; colour 1 on the front filter panel and cheek canisters; colour 2 on the side housings and back shell; colour 3 on the vent slats.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Gasmask_Prisonguard.description: A high-tech respirator covering the mouth and chin, with side filter canisters and ribbed front vents. Thick hoses loop from the mask around the head to a canister at the back, held by thin head straps.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Gasmask_Prisonguard.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed front vent plate; colour 1 on the filter canisters and mask housing; colour 3 on the hoses and small studs; colour 2 on the head straps and the mask's underside.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Grassblade_01.description: A single thin grass stem held in the corner of the mouth, bending in two gentle angles and trailing down past the chin to a small serrated, feathery tip. A casual, rustic accessory.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Grassblade_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the stem; colour 0 on the serrated tip and the lower end of the stem.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Armorninja.description: An armoured ninja-style mouth mask made of stacked, segmented plates over the mouth and chin, with a pointed chin guard and long swept-back blades along each cheek toward the ears. Sits over the lower face.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper nose plate, chin plates and outer cheek blades; colour 1 on the framing cheek panels and plate edges; colour 2 on the central bands; colour 3 on the small cheek accents.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Light_01.description: A rigid, shield-shaped lower-face mask covering the nose bridge to the chin, with a raised central ridge, curved inset panels on each side and a pointed chin tip. Suggests a ninja or armored warrior look.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and central ridge; colour 1 on the inset side panels; colour 2 on the small chin tip.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Paintball_01.description: A rigid lower-face mask covering nose bridge to chin, with a raised central nose ridge, a ribbed vent grille over the mouth and angled cheek panels with cross-strapped inserts. Sporty, protective, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Paintball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth grille; colour 3 on the cheek panel inserts; colour 2 on the straps across the cheek panels and grille slits.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegr.description: A respirator-style face mask covering nose, mouth and chin, with a moulded rigid filter housing and round vent at the front, segmented cloth panels with contrasting seams, and two elastic straps around the head.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mask panels and head straps; colour 0 on the filter housing; colour 2 on the seams, strap fasteners and vent centre.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegr.description: A respirator-style face mask covering nose and mouth, with a round filter canister on each cheek and thin straps looping over the head and around the back. Paneled seams give a tactical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegr.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mask body, canisters and straps; colour 2 on the seam lines and strap fasteners.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskdragon_01.description: A small respirator-style mask covering the nose and mouth, with two rounded vent cups on the front and thin whip-like tendrils curving out sideways from each cheek. Suggests a dragon-themed, monstrous sci-fi look.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskdragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell; colour 1 on the rings around the vent cups; colour 3 on the vent centres; colour 2 on the tendrils.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskdragon_02.description: A smooth, close-fitting mouth and nose mask covering the lower face, with a raised nose ridge and a pair of round, octagonal filter vents on the cheeks. Thin edge strips loop around the jaw to the back of the head.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskdragon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and thin edge strips; colour 1 on the vent rims; colour 3 on the vent centres.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskstraps_01.description: A fitted mouth-and-nose mask with vertical seam panels and contrasting stitched edging, held by two thin straps that wrap around the head, one across the forehead and one under the eyes at the cheeks.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Maskstraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mask body and both straps; colour 2 on the seam lines, edging and strap clips.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Persian_01.description: A soft cloth face covering that wraps from the nose bridge down past the chin, draping in loose folds with a slightly pointed lower edge and a notched upper edge; wraps around the sides of the face like a bandit mask.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth covering; a hint of colour 1 shading along the lower edge.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Qularrtuskbig_01.description: A pair of large curved tusks rising from beside the face over the head and sweeping down to sharp tips at the shoulders, built from segmented plates with jointed bands. Beastly, monstrous look.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Qularrtuskbig_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper tusk segments; colour 1 on the lower tusk segments and tips; colour 3 on the base caps near the face; colour 2 on the joint bands.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Redstone_01.description: A soft cloth face wrap forming a loose, crinkled tube that covers the nose, mouth and chin and wraps fully around the head below the eyes, with a pair of contrasting stripes on each side.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the wrap; colour 1 on the paired stripes at the sides; the inner lining follows colour 0.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A mechanical lower-jaw guard that wraps the chin and cheeks, with a toothed grille over the mouth, jagged serrated plates rising along the jaw toward the ears, and short cylindrical pipes jutting out from the chin and sides.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main jaw shell; colour 0 on the serrated edge plates and the central brow above the grille and teeth; colour 2 on the pipes; colour 3 on the rings around the pipes.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Rudolph_01.description: A smooth, rounded ball-shaped nose that sits over the tip of the nose at the centre of the face. It is hollow at the back, like a clown or reindeer nose, and suits cute, holiday and costume looks.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Rudolph_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole nose; the sheet shows no other colour slots on this piece.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A samurai-style half mask covering the nose, cheeks, mouth and jaw, sculpted with a raised nose bridge, a grimacing toothy mouth slot and a thin trim line along the edges, with a contrasting rim under the eyes.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask plate; colour 1 on the thin trim line across the cheeks and jaw; colour 2 on the rim along the upper edge and the mouth interior.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_02.description: A samurai-style half mask covering the lower face: a sculpted armored jaw with a snarling toothy mouth, a contrasting rim under the eyes, cord ties looping up to the ears, and a layered plated neck guard below tied with a bow.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jaw plate and neck guard plates; colour 1 on thin line details along the plates; colour 2 on the upper rim and toggles; colour 3 on the cords and bow.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_02.differs: The female version has no bristly moustache above the mouth.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_Large_03.description: A samurai-style half mask covering the nose, mouth and chin, with a raised nose bridge, a pointed chin guard, a contrasting band across the mouth, and swirl-patterned cheek panels that wrap toward the ears with thin strap lines behind.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_Large_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask plate and chin point; colour 1 on the vertical ribs and the thin line across the upper lip; colour 2 on the mouth band and the cheek panel backgrounds; colour 3 on the swirl patterns on the cheek panels.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Scuba_01.description: A scuba-style breathing apparatus: a ribbed mouthpiece with two rounded side cartridges sits over the mouth, joined by looping hoses that run around the head to a cylindrical canister at the back of the head.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Scuba_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed mouthpiece; colour 1 on the side cartridges and the rear canister; colour 3 on the hoses.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Scuba_01.differs: The hoses loop higher and wider around the head, and the rear canister sits higher at the back of the head with a gap between it and the cartridges.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Secret_03.description: A novelty disguise: an oversized rounded false nose with a broad base sits over the nose, with a ragged, jagged-edged moustache hanging beneath it above the lips. Comic, casual gag-costume style.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to tint the false nose (shown in a skin tone); colour 1 on the moustache.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: An angular half-face mask covering nose bridge to chin, with a contrasting central panel, bulky side filter pods with small round studs, and short fang-like tusks jutting down at the mouth. Sci-fi rebel look.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose guard, side pods and tusks; colour 1 on the edge trim and inner accents; colour 2 on the main front panel.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Steampunk_01.description: A cloth mask-scarf wrapping the lower face from nose to chin and around the neck, with vertical seam lines, a studded rim along the top and a round filter canister on one cheek. Steampunk respirator style.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body; colour 3 on the top rim band and the seam lines; colour 1 on the canister and the small studs; colour 2 on the inner lining.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Steampunk_01.differs: The top rim of the female version is a flatter band with a broad fluffy patch on top, while the male rim shows a smaller starburst-like patch.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_01.description: A tactical jaw-guard band that curves under the chin and up both cheeks to a boxy pod at each ear, with a small contrasting lens panel on the side of each pod and a vent at the chin. Sits over the lower face.
