Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ear pods and the outer cheek bands; colour 0 on the inner chin band and chin plate; colour 2 on the lens panels and chin vent; colour 3 on the thin rims around the lens panels.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_02.description: A angular chin guard that wraps under the jaw in a V shape, with flat plates rising along each cheek to a point and a small hexagonal module at the chin. Suggests a tactical sci-fi mask.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jaw plates and cheek wings; colour 2 on the underside and chin housing; colour 3 on the small chin module.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_03.description: A angular chin guard of faceted plates that wraps under the jaw and sweeps up along both sides toward the cheeks, with a gem-like block at the chin. Suggests tactical or sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jaw plates; colour 1 on the chin block; colour 2 on the outer edge and underside trim.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Techmask_01.description: A compact respirator-style mouth mask covering the nose to chin, with a central studded vertical strip, large round filter canisters on each cheek, and small marking stripes at the nose bridge. Suits sci-fi or tactical looks.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Techmask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the central strip; colour 2 on the cheek canisters; colour 3 on the studs, canister rings and nose marks.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Titan_01.description: An angular faceted mouth guard covering the lower face from below the eyes, with a V-notched upper edge and a long pointed chin spike that hangs down over the throat. Suggests a sci-fi or monstrous helmet mask.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Titan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised upper rim edge; colour 2 on the main faceted plates of the guard; colour 1 has little visible effect.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Welder_01.description: A rigid angular half-mask covering the mouth and jaw, with a faceted front plate, round vent ports on the sides and two short upright filter posts near the cheeks. It has a lighter lining inside and suits industrial or sci-fi looks.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mask shell; colour 2 on the upright posts and vent ports; colour 0 on the inner lining under the chin.

Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Whiskers_01.description: A set of thin, curved whiskers fanning out from each side of the upper lip, three or four fine strands per side, giving a cat-like animal look. Sits at the muzzle without covering the face.
Female/F_Mouth_Tight_Whiskers_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whisker strands; the fine tips show a faint metallic sheen and no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Mouth_Toy_01.description: A novelty false nose and moustache: a chunky faceted rounded knob sits over the nose, with two long, thin, upswept curled moustache tips extending out to each side above the lip. Comic, toy-like styling.
Female/F_Mouth_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose knob, which shows a stone-like finish; colour 2 on the moustache tips, with colour 1 showing on their undersides.

Female/F_Nightmareinvasion_Demon_Mask_Ja.description: A demonic jaw mask wrapping the lower face and chin, with a row of jagged teeth along the upper edge, a pointed chin panel, and curved blade-like horns sweeping up past the ears on round side hinges.
Female/F_Nightmareinvasion_Demon_Mask_Ja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toothed rim and the curved side blades; colour 1 on the inner jaw panel and chin plate; colour 2 on the round side hinge discs; colour 3 on the marks on the hinges.

Female/F_Patriotcelebrationr_2025_01.description: A curved, cup-shaped shoulder guard with a raised rim and a row of parallel vertical ribs across the outer face. Small studs sit at the corners of the frame. Sits over the shoulder cap in a sleek superhero style.
Female/F_Patriotcelebrationr_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and frame; colour 2 on the raised ribs; colour 1 on the recessed panel between the ribs; colour 3 on the studs.
Female/F_Patriotcelebrationr_2025_01.differs: The female version is a plain ribbed shoulder cup with no eagle head or hanging feather fringe.

Female/F_Spadl_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A single left shoulder guard with a tall, flat angular blade rising well above the shoulder, and a chunky faceted pod at the shoulder with small glowing-style vent strips; a mechanical, sci-fi armour look.
Female/F_Spadl_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tall blade and the base plate; colour 1 on the faceted shoulder pod; colour 0 on the top edge of the blade; colour 3 on the small vent strips and accents.
Female/F_Spadl_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The female version has a chunkier, more enclosed pod with a mostly contrasting blade, while the male has a more open, curved cup with a lighter blade.

Female/F_Spadl_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a snarling bulldog head, with wrinkled brow, bared fangs and glowing eyes, set in a hollow rounded shell with a raised rim that caps the shoulder. Retro mechanical villain styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sculpted head; colour 1 on the rim and inner shell; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Anniversary_Destroyer_02.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a scowling, sculpted face with heavy brow ridges and a wrinkled snout, set in a hollow rim-edged shell. It caps the outer shoulder, with small spikes at the bottom edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Anniversary_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised rim and the hollow inner shell; the sculpted face is glossy metal that ignores the scheme; colour 3 shows on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a smooth, glossy shell that domes over the top of the arm, with a notched open underside and a thin contrasting rim. Retro robotic look.
Female/F_Spadl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, which has a glossy metallic finish; colour 1 on the rim and inner lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Aquatic_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder, with a raised metal rim and three swept-back fin-like spikes along the top. Three stripe panels run across the shell, giving an aquatic superhero look.
Female/F_Spadl_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes and the outer stripe panel; colour 1 on the middle stripe panel; colour 3 on the stripe panel nearest the spikes; colour 2 on the rim.

Female/F_Spadl_Aquatic_02.description: A curved, fin-like shoulder plate that caps the left shoulder, with a thick rim, layered swept panels, a stripe down the middle and a small square gem at each end; sleek, aquatic sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept outer panels; colour 1 on the central stripe panel; colour 2 on the rim border; colour 3 on the square gems.

Female/F_Spadl_Balloon_Toy_01.description: A small twisted balloon-animal dog perched on top of the left shoulder: glossy sausage-shaped balloon segments form the body, four legs, a head with long upright ears and a small tail. Playful and novelty in style.
Female/F_Spadl_Balloon_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, snout and neck segment; colour 1 on the legs and body balloons; colour 2 on one ear; colour 3 on the tail and the other ear.

Female/F_Spadl_Bounty_01.description: A curved, shell-like left shoulder cap that arches over the shoulder, with a thick rounded rim and two angled inset panels on the outer face plus a narrow raised strip along the top. Sci-fi bounty-hunter look.
Female/F_Spadl_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shell and rim; colour 1 on the upper inset panel; colour 0 on the lower inset panel; colour 3 on the top strip.

Female/F_Spadl_Buzzsaw_01.description: A cluster of three notched circular saw blades floating at the left shoulder, each with a central hole and toothed rim, angled at different tilts so they fan out over the shoulder and upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Buzzsaw_01.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and reflective, so it largely ignores the colour scheme; the blades show a shiny metallic finish across all discs.
Female/F_Spadl_Buzzsaw_01.differs: The blades render as a uniformly shiny reflective metal with no visible colour panels, unlike the male version's multi-coloured discs.

Female/F_Spadl_Buzzsaw_02.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades floating around the left shoulder, one large and two smaller, each with a raised centre disc and a star-shaped hub. Mechanical, industrial shoulder decoration.
Female/F_Spadl_Buzzsaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toothed blade rims; colour 1 on the inner blade discs; colour 3 on the star-shaped hubs.
Female/F_Spadl_Buzzsaw_02.differs: The three blades are arranged in a vertical stack down the upper arm and shoulder, with the smallest sitting lower on the arm.

Female/F_Spadl_Buzzsaw_03.description: Three floating circular saw blades with toothed edges and ring-shaped hubs, clustered at the left shoulder in different sizes and tilts. A mechanical, industrial shoulder accessory that is not attached to the body.
Female/F_Spadl_Buzzsaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade discs and hub rings; colour 1 on the inner band of each blade; colour 3 on the small rivets around the hubs; colour 2 on the teeth of the lower blade.

Female/F_Spadl_Cannonarm_01.description: A shoulder-mounted laser cannon: a streamlined armoured housing with contrasting vents sits on the back of the shoulder, and a long multi-barrel muzzle with open framework points up and forward past the head.
Female/F_Spadl_Cannonarm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and barrel shrouds; colour 1 on the edge trim and outer barrel rails; colour 2 on the vents and inner mechanism; colour 3 on small accents near the muzzle.

Female/F_Spadl_Cat_01.description: A small sculpted cat sitting upright on the top of the left shoulder, facing forward with pointed ears, front paws together and a long tail curling down the back of the shoulder. A cute, whimsical companion accessory.
Female/F_Spadl_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cat's body, ears, paws and tail; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Chicken_01.description: A novelty rubber chicken draped over the left shoulder like a scarf, its plump body resting on the back with legs dangling behind and a long limp neck hanging down the front of the chest.
Female/F_Spadl_Chicken_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chicken body and neck; colour 3 on the feet, comb and wattle; colour 2 on the small tuft of feathers at the head; colour 1 on the eye.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Aquatic_01.description: A row of three curved, fin-like spikes in graduated sizes, running along the top of the left shoulder toward the neck. Each is a swept, angular blade on a small faceted base, suggesting shark fins or aquatic ridges.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three fins; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Draco_01.description: A left shoulder piece of sharp, layered plates that sweep up and outward into long curved horn-like blades, with a jagged serrated panel on the front. Sits on top of the shoulder in a dragon-inspired, aggressive style.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the jagged serrated plates; colour 2 on the long curved horn blades and underlying edge plate.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Future_01.description: A single left shoulder gadget: a thick rounded ring with a recessed inner core, a spiked fin at its top edge, mounted on a slim angled strut with a cut-out slot that rises from the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ring rim; colour 1 on the strut and the spiked fin; colour 3 on the inner ring core; colour 2 on the ring's inner shadow and the strut tip.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Future_02.description: A single curved blade-like loop worn on the left shoulder: a slim, smooth hooked arc that rises over the shoulder and ends in a barbed, fishhook-like point at the front. Sleek, futuristic accent.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Future_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole curved blade; the other colour slots are not visible.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Punk_01.description: A cluster of four separate tapering spikes sprouting from the top of the left shoulder, fanning upward and outward at different angles. They are small, sharp and punky, with no base plate or strap.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A scatter of small conical spikes on the left shoulder: larger ones sweep outward and back from the top of the shoulder, with a smaller cluster of tiny spikes lower on the upper arm. Punkish and mechanical.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the larger shoulder spikes; colour 2 on the small lower spikes on the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.differs: The female version has a slightly different spike arrangement, with more spikes in the upper group swept back across the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.description: A slim adjustable strap band worn around the upper left arm, with two overlapping loose strap ends passing through hexagonal metal buckle loops. A utilitarian sci-fi look with a snug fit and trailing tabs.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands and tabs; colour 1 on the hexagonal buckle loops.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.differs: The female strap sits tighter on the arm, with the two loose strap ends overlapping in a bunched pair at the front.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Steelarachnid_01.description: A single angular blade-like spike mounted on a small round base at the left shoulder, extending outward then sweeping up to a sharp point. Faceted, segmented mechanical construction suggests an arachnid leg or horn.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted spike body; colour 2 on the round base disc; colour 1 on a small stripe on the disc.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tactical_01.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a small central nucleus, thin and decal-like, sitting on the outer left shoulder. Suggests a science or energy-themed superhero badge.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of looping elliptical orbits around a central ring, sitting on top of the left shoulder like a decal. Suggests a sci-fi superhero insignia.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit loops; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the loops.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.differs: The female emblem is a single atom motif, while the male version adds two small separate fragments below it on the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A left shoulder attachment of three long curved bone-like spines that sweep outward and forward from a segmented central spine, with contrasting hooked spikes on top and small curved thorns trailing down the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented central spine and the small thorns; colour 1 on the long curved spines; colour 2 on the hooked spikes.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The long spines splay out more widely and sweep further forward past the chest, and the piece sits slightly higher on the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A ring-shaped shoulder collar of layered, jagged fur-like spikes that encircles the left shoulder, open in the centre so the arm passes through. Feral, savage look, sitting around the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur spikes; the inner shadowed spikes appear darker from shading only.

Female/F_Spadl_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A boxy, angular mechanical shoulder pad for the left shoulder: a hollow shell with a raised rear fin, a textured front panel and a lower plated band, suggesting sci-fi robotic armor.
Female/F_Spadl_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and rear fin; colour 2 on the textured front panel and inner lining; colour 0 on the lower band; colour 3 on the angled accent patches.

Female/F_Spadl_Corrupted_01.description: A left shoulder piece shaped like a bat wing: a domed cap with scalloped, pointed flaps that sweep down over the upper arm and back, plus two curved horn-like spikes rising from the top.
Female/F_Spadl_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed cap and central ridges; colour 1 on the outer wing flaps and underside; colour 3 on the curved spikes.

Female/F_Spadl_Cosmic_01.description: A thin, curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder, wedge-shaped and tapering to a point over the upper arm. Its top carries stepped, angular raised panels with a slim contrasting edge along the underside.
Female/F_Spadl_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plate surface and raised panels; colour 1 on the angular trim and lower edge lining; colour 0 on the underside lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Cosmos_01.description: A single angular metal shoulder guard for the left shoulder: layered curved plates with a raised ridge band, sweeping out to a sharp point at the front and back, with a lining panel visible inside the rim.
Female/F_Spadl_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plates; colour 2 on the recessed ridge band and edge lines; colour 1 on the inner lining panel. The glossy metal finish mutes the scheme on the outer plates.

Female/F_Spadl_Cosmos_02.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a curved horn: a smooth metal shell with a raised rim that sweeps outward and up into a sharp point, with a contrasting inset panel along the top edge. Sits on the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer shell; colour 1 on the inset panel along the top edge; colour 2 on the inner underside and rim.
Female/F_Spadl_Cosmos_02.differs: The female version has a lighter outer shell with a more visible contrasting inset panel, while the male version's outer surface is mostly contrasting with a thin strip.

Female/F_Spadl_Crimson_01.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a snarling dragon head, with swept-back spiky horns and flame-like crests, a rounded plated dome and a patterned underside lining. Sits over the shoulder cap in an ornate fantasy style.
Female/F_Spadl_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome plates; colour 2 on the dragon head, horns and rim edging; colour 1 on the patterned inner lining; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Cryo_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a layered plate with a stepped upper panel, edged by a thick arched band over the top, with small angular nubs at both ends. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadl_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower plate edge; colour 1 on the stepped upper panel; colour 2 on the arched band; colour 3 on the end nubs.

Female/F_Spadl_Defender_Update_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron of angular, segmented armor plates: a smooth domed outer shell with stacked panels and a small round port on the outer face, sitting over the top of the shoulder in a sci-fi superhero style.
Female/F_Spadl_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome shell; colour 1 on the upper and lower panel plates; colour 2 on the darker inset panels; colour 3 on the thin accent strip between plates.

Female/F_Spadl_Dog_01.description: A small figurine-like puppy lying on the left shoulder, with upright pointed ears, a bow tie at the neck, forepaws draped over the front and a thin tail hanging down the back. Cute, playful novelty shoulder piece.
Female/F_Spadl_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the puppy's body and legs; colour 0 on the inner ears, paws and muzzle; colour 2 on the bow tie; colour 3 on the eyes and bow tie centre.
Female/F_Spadl_Dog_01.differs: The puppy lies with its body angled along the shoulder, its head turned toward the front and its tail hanging down the back.

Female/F_Spadl_Draco_01.description: A single-shoulder pauldron: a curved plate with a rimmed edge caps the left shoulder, and tall curved, barbed spikes sweep up and back from it like dragon horns. Angular, sci-fi fantasy styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the rim trim; colour 3 on the inner barbed spikes; colour 2 on the outer long curved spike.

Female/F_Spadl_Dragon_01.description: A small winged dragon figure perched on the left shoulder, with a segmented belly, spread bat-like wings, swept-back horns and a long curling spiked tail hanging down the back. Suggests a fantasy pet companion.
Female/F_Spadl_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, wing arms and tail; colour 1 on the horns and wing claws; colour 2 on the chest panel and wing membranes; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Dryad_01.description: A left shoulder piece made of a curved, shell-like cap with a tangle of twisting woody branches or roots that sweep outward and one tall tendril rising up. Sits over the shoulder in a fantasy, nature-guardian style.
Female/F_Spadl_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the twisting branches; colour 0 on the shell-like cap; colour 1 on the spots or patches on the cap.

Female/F_Spadl_Dryad_02.description: A curved, shell-like shoulder plate that sweeps over the left shoulder, with a smooth main panel, a bordering frame of twisting vine-like ribs, and a lacy, organic cut-out growth across the outer half.
Female/F_Spadl_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 2 on the vine-like frame edging; colour 1 on the lacy outer growth.

Female/F_Spadl_Element_Fire_01.description: A left shoulder piece of swept, flame-like tongues that curl upward and outward, with a glossy rippled surface. It sits on top of the shoulder, stretching from the neck base toward the arm, with a fantasy-superhero elemental look.
Female/F_Spadl_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material ignores most of the colour scheme; the whole piece shows a reflective metallic finish, with no clear separate slot areas.

Female/F_Spadl_Element_Fire_02.description: A small left shoulder piece of glossy, rippled flame-like shapes: jagged swept tongues rise toward the neck and trail down over the upper arm, giving a spiky, flowing silhouette that perches on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: The default glossy material largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows in the reflections, with the rest reading as a reflective metallic finish.

Female/F_Spadl_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A boxy mechanical shoulder pad shaped like an inverted U-bracket, with a slatted vent panel on the front edge and two dial-like knobs on the outer housing. It sits on the left shoulder and stands off the body.
Female/F_Spadl_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the U-shaped bracket frame; colour 1 on the outer housing and dials; colour 3 on the vent slats.

Female/F_Spadl_Falcon_01.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a stylised falcon head, with swept feather crests and a hooked beak, rising from a flared, stud-decorated base band. A curved shell sits over the shoulder cap. Heroic, mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadl_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather crest and the base band; colour 1 on the outer rim, beak and studs; colour 2 on the feather slits; colour 3 on the eye.

Female/F_Spadl_Firebird_01.description: A small angular shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a shallow faceted cup with a sharply pointed flared outer edge, and a raised swept fin-like plate rising from the centre. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and pointed rim; colour 1 on the raised central fin plate; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Frigid_01.description: A single left shoulder guard made of layered, stepped armor plates with a beveled edge, capping the shoulder and sweeping down the upper arm. A cluster of long, swept-back crystalline spikes rises from the top.
Female/F_Spadl_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate layers; colour 2 on the inner lining and plate edging; colour 1 on the tall spike cluster.

Female/F_Spadl_Future_01.description: A futuristic left shoulder piece: a small flared cap on the shoulder with a raised rim, a slim stem carrying a ring with a spiked fin, and curved claw-like prongs sweeping forward over the chest.
Female/F_Spadl_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap, the spiked fin and the stem; colour 0 on the cap edge, ring frame and curved prongs; colour 3 on the inside of the ring.
Female/F_Spadl_Future_01.differs: This version has a smaller, narrower shoulder cap and a smaller ring that sits closer to the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Gearbreak_01.description: A single curved shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a tall tapered plate with a thick contrasting rim, a small octagonal stud on the front and a boxy latch-like pod on the rear edge. Mechanical, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Spadl_Gearbreak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 2 on the rim edging and the boxy pod; colour 1 on the octagonal stud and the strap on the pod.

Female/F_Spadl_Gladiator_02.description: A single left shoulder guard: a curved, shell-like pauldron with a raised rim and swept, pointed fins at the front and back edges, sitting over the top of the shoulder. Sleek armoured look with a separate inner panel.
Female/F_Spadl_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer rim and pointed fins; colour 0 on the inner panel lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Heraldry_01.description: A rounded, domed left shoulder pauldron with a raised inner lining panel along its rim, a small rivet at the side, and two stacked overlapping lames flaring below. Sits over the shoulder cap in a superhero-armour style.
Female/F_Spadl_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome of the pauldron; colour 3 on the inner lining panel; colour 1 on the stacked lames below; colour 2 on the rim edging and underside.
Female/F_Spadl_Heraldry_01.differs: The female pauldron has a taller, more upright rim with a larger exposed lining, and the domed plate is set slightly narrower on the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Hybrid_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a bordered shell, a glowing eye-like gem in the middle, a ridged underside and several curved horn-like spikes pointing up and out. Monstrous, mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadl_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell surface and underside ridges; colour 2 on the outer rim and border plates; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 3 on the eye gem.

Female/F_Spadl_Ice_01.description: A single left shoulder piece made of a jagged cluster of faceted crystal shards, with a long pointed spike sweeping outward and smaller splinters hanging below. It sits on top of the shoulder as an icy, fantasy-style pauldron.
Female/F_Spadl_Ice_01.colourAreas: The glossy crystal ignores most of the scheme; colour 1 shows as a tint on some upper facets, and the rest of the shards are a glossy reflective finish that takes little of the other colours.

Female/F_Spadl_Ice_02.description: A cluster of jagged, faceted crystal shards heaped over the left shoulder and trailing down the upper arm in a tapering, irregular column. Glossy angular fragments give it a frozen, fantasy look.
Female/F_Spadl_Ice_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the glossy shard surfaces; colour 1 on some of the shard facets as highlights. The glossy material largely ignores the other colour slots.
Female/F_Spadl_Ice_02.differs: The female shards form a longer, narrower trail down the arm with a smaller cluster on the shoulder top.

Female/F_Spadl_Insect_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron shaped like an insect shell: a domed top plate studded with rows of sharp spikes, pointed fins sweeping forward and back, and a tongue-like flap hanging over the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed top plate; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 0 on the pointed front and rear fins; colour 1 on the hanging flap and underside panels.

Female/F_Spadl_Jaggedhorns_01.description: A large curled ramlike horn that sprouts from the left shoulder: a thick segmented base sweeps up and around in a spiral, with ridged bands and tapering spiked tips at both ends. Monstrous, demonic style.
Female/F_Spadl_Jaggedhorns_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main segmented horn body; colour 2 on the thin ridge lines between segments; colour 1 on the upper horn band; colour 3 on the tips of both horn ends.

Female/F_Spadl_Kaiju_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a slightly bumpy, leathery surface and many curved horn-like spikes of varied size, one large spike sweeping up and back. Monstrous, aggressive styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulder cap; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Spadl_Kitten_01.description: A small kitten figure perched on the left shoulder, crouched with its front paws draped over the front of the shoulder and a long tail hanging down the back. Cute, soft and rounded, with pointed ears and small eyes.
Female/F_Spadl_Kitten_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole kitten body, ears, paws and tail; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Kitten_Toy_01.description: A small low-poly toy cat lying sprawled on top of the left shoulder, with a rounded head, pointed ears, stitched whisker lines and dot eyes, dangling front paws with paw-pad marks, and a long tail trailing behind.
Female/F_Spadl_Kitten_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, head, ears and limbs; colour 1 on the paw pads; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the whisker marks.

Female/F_Spadl_Lockbox_65_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron topped with a snarling dragon or beast head with spiky mane and horns, on a curved cap-shaped plate with trim edging and small hanging tassels. Ornate east-asian fantasy style.
Female/F_Spadl_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beast head and mane; colour 0 on the horns, teeth and plate trim; colour 2 on the shoulder plate and tassels; colour 3 on the eyes and tassel beads.
Female/F_Spadl_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The female version has only one tassel hanging at the front, and a smaller, more tangled mane and head.

Female/F_Spadl_Lockbox_65_02.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a horned beast or dragon head, with curved horns sweeping up and back, a snouted face on the outer shoulder, and a ragged fur-like fringe hanging around the lower edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head plating and horns; colour 1 on the inset swirl panels; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the fur fringe. The glossy finish looks darker and more reflective on this sheet.
Female/F_Spadl_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The default finish renders darker and more metallic, so the coloured panels and eyes are less distinct than on the male version.

Female/F_Spadl_Lockbox_66_01.description: A curved, angular shoulder plate for the left shoulder: a bordered shell with a raised hex-nut boss at the centre, a segmented band of small blocks along one edge, and notched tabs at the corners. Mechanical sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 2 on the outer frame and tabs; colour 1 on the segmented band; colour 3 on the centre boss light.

Female/F_Spadl_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron of smooth, swept metal plating curling in a crescent around a faceted, angular beast-head ornament at its centre. It caps the shoulder with a pointed rear flare, in a heroic sci-fi style.
Female/F_Spadl_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept shoulder plate; colour 1 on the faceted beast head; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A domed metal left shoulder guard with a raised outer rim, a stylised bird-head shape with a small eye on the front, flame-like cut-out panels and a round ring fitting at the point. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the inner and flame-shaped panels; colour 3 on the eye; colour 2 on the underside segments.

Female/F_Spadl_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a smooth shell that arches over the top of the arm and flares outward, with a contrasting band across it and a thick rim around the edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the band across the shell; colour 2 on the rim and underside.

Female/F_Spadl_Moth_01.description: A smooth, domed shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a hollow rounded shell with a thin rim of contrasting edging, covering the top of the shoulder and upper arm. It has a sleek, organic-looking superhero style.
Female/F_Spadl_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 1 blending into the upper edge of the shell; colour 0 on the thin rim edging.

Female/F_Spadl_Patriotcelebration_2025_0.description: A single curved shoulder cap with a stylised eagle-head crest on top, a rim of angular plates with small studs, rows of contrasting overlapping scale panels, and a fringe of long feather-like tabs hanging over the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Patriotcelebration_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim plates and claw-like tips; colour 1 on the eagle crest and the hanging feather fringe; colour 2 on the scale panels; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Spadl_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A small left shoulder ornament of clustered, sharp horn-like spikes and blade shards fanning outward and back from the top of the shoulder, with a larger swept fin at the rear. Suggests a dragon-claw look.
Female/F_Spadl_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: All of the piece is one glossy material that appears to ignore the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Spadl_Qularr_Spines_01.description: A cluster of thin, jointed insect-like spines sprouting from the left shoulder and upper back, each segmented leg arching outward and tapering to a fine tip, with rounded socket bases. Suits monstrous or alien looks.
Female/F_Spadl_Qularr_Spines_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded joint bases; colour 1 on the main spine segments; colour 2 on the tapering outer sections; colour 3 on the tiny tips.
Female/F_Spadl_Qularr_Spines_01.differs: The female spines are clustered in a tighter group that sits further back on the shoulder, with fewer spines reaching out to the front.

Female/F_Spadl_Raven_01.description: A small perched raven figure sitting on the left shoulder, with textured feathered plumage, a tapering tail sweeping back, a sharp beak and thin clawed feet gripping the shoulder. A companion-style pet accessory.
Female/F_Spadl_Raven_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feathered body; colour 3 on the beak; colour 2 on the feet and claws.

Female/F_Spadl_Ravenswood_01.description: A single left shoulder piece: a slim curved cap that arcs over the top of the shoulder, with a raised inner section near the neck and a flat pointed wing flaring outward past the arm. Sleek, angular, and mechanical in style.
Female/F_Spadl_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner panel nearest the neck; colour 2 on the outer flared section of the shoulder cap.

Female/F_Spadl_Reindeer_Toy_01.description: A small plush toy reindeer perched on the left shoulder in a lying pose, with a rounded body, stubby legs, a round nose, branching antlers and a fuzzy collar ruff. Cute holiday novelty accessory.
Female/F_Spadl_Reindeer_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, head and ears; colour 1 on the collar ruff and rump patch; colour 2 on the antlers and hooves; colour 3 on the nose and eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Renegade_Punk_01.description: A single left shoulder pad of angular, faceted armor plating with a raised rim and a cluster of four sharp spikes along the top; a separate under-plate extends outward over the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Renegade_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the rim and edge trim; colour 2 on the under-plate; colour 3 on the spikes.

Female/F_Spadl_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A mechanical left shoulder guard: a curved metal cup with a thick domed cap on top, studded with large cone spikes, a face-like plate with small contrasting spikes below, and a buckled strap around the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal cup, face plate and strap; colour 1 on the domed cap and strap buckle accents; colour 3 on the large cone spikes and the line markings on the plate; colour 2 on the small lower spikes.
Female/F_Spadl_Renegade_Spikes_01.differs: The female cap sits more upright with a shorter rim, and spikes are bunched more toward the back of the cap.

Female/F_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A small angular shoulder pad forming a curved hollow shell over the top of the left shoulder, with a raised contrasting cap plate stepped on top and chunky faceted edges. Suggests retro sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised top cap plate; colour 0 on the lower shell and side edges; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Female/F_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_02.description: A boxy mechanical missile launcher floating above the left shoulder, with six round ported openings on its front face and a ribbed flexible hose curving down from a collar fitting at the rear to the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box housing; colour 1 on the front face plate with the ports; colour 2 on the port rings and the hose end; colour 3 on the ribbed hose.

Female/F_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_03.description: A boxy missile-launcher pod mounted on the left shoulder, its front face holding six round tube openings. A thick ribbed flexible hose curls down from a collar on the pod's rear, like a feed line, giving a retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pod's casing and top; colour 1 on the front face plate with the launch tubes; colour 3 on the ribbed hose; colour 2 on the tube openings.

Female/F_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A curved plate pauldron for the left shoulder: a tall, flared shell with a notched lower edge, a bright metal rim along the top, and a separate angled panel beneath. Suggests retro mechanical armour.
Female/F_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the raised rim edging; colour 1 on the lower angled panel.

Female/F_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_02.description: A single left shoulder guard: a curved, shell-like metal plate with a raised ridge and notched, angular lower edges, plus a rolled contrasting rim at the base. It sits over the top of the shoulder in a retro mechanical superhero style.
Female/F_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plate; colour 0 on the thin raised edge trim; colour 1 on the rolled lower rim.

Female/F_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.description: A tapered, shell-like left shoulder cap with a raised rim, curving down over the shoulder to a pointed tip at the front. Angled slatted vents sit on the front and back faces; a retro mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim edging; colour 1 on the vent slats and the lower front tip; colour 3 on the recessed vent backing.

Female/F_Spadl_Rockcrystal_01.description: A shoulder cluster of chunky, faceted rock slabs with cracked seams between them, sitting over the left shoulder and sweeping outward into jagged crystal spikes with a smaller cluster hanging below.
Female/F_Spadl_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between the slabs.

Female/F_Spadl_Rubber_Duck_01.description: A small rounded toy duck perched on the left shoulder beside the neck, with a smooth low-poly body, upturned tail, round head, small eyes and a flat open beak. Playful novelty shoulder accessory.
Female/F_Spadl_Rubber_Duck_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the duck's body and head; colour 1 on the beak; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Sandstorm_01.description: A short, soft cloth shoulder wrap forming an open cowl-like cuff around the upper arm, with gathered, wrinkled folds and a slightly twisted front edge; sits over the left shoulder like a loose sleeve.
Female/F_Spadl_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper folds of the wrap; colour 1 on the lower band and hem, blending into the upper part.
Female/F_Spadl_Sandstorm_01.differs: The female version is a lower, narrower ring that hangs around the upper arm, with a twisted front fold and a mostly open loop.

Female/F_Spadl_Sandstorm_02.description: A small angular left shoulder guard: a faceted, cup-shaped plate over the shoulder with an inner curved lining, a short trim band below and a tab hanging down the upper arm, held by a thin loop strap.
Female/F_Spadl_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate; colour 1 on the inner lining and lower band; colour 3 on the hanging tab; colour 2 on the strap loop.
Female/F_Spadl_Sandstorm_02.differs: The female guard is smaller and sits higher on the shoulder, with a more upright cup than the male one.

Female/F_Spadl_Sandstorm_Alt_01.description: A short, open-ended cloth sleeve-cap that wraps around the upper left arm like a wide cuff, with soft wrinkled folds and a flared top edge sitting over the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Sandstorm_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the cuff; colour 1 gradient toward the lower hem.
Female/F_Spadl_Sandstorm_Alt_01.differs: The female version is a tighter cylindrical cuff on the upper arm, while the male version is a larger rounded cap that covers the top of the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Scarab_01.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a domed beetle shell, open on the underside, with a pointed horn on top, a rolled edge along the neck side, and hooked claw-like tips at front and back.
Female/F_Spadl_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and top horn; colour 1 on the rolled edge along the inner rim; colour 2 on the lower edge band; colour 3 on the hooked tips.

Female/F_Spadl_Scarab_02.description: A left shoulder guard of angular, swept plates with pointed edges, cut-out openings showing a glossy inset, and a separate curved fin-like panel rising over the top of the shoulder. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 1 on the curved panel over the shoulder top; colour 2 on the glossy inset in the openings.

Female/F_Spadl_Shiba_Toy_01.description: A small plush toy dog with pointed ears, a curled tail and stubby paws, lying sprawled on top of the left shoulder like a perched pet. Soft stitched fabric look with a cute stuffed-animal style.
Female/F_Spadl_Shiba_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, head and ears; colour 1 on the belly, paws, tail tip, ear insides and eye patches; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the nose.

Female/F_Spadl_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A small mechanical shoulder piece: an angular, faceted cup with a round socket opening on the outer side, a contrasting curved cap over the top and a small contrasting inset panel. It sits on the left shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower cup and rear plate; colour 1 on the main shell and inner socket lining; colour 2 on the curved top cap and front wedges; colour 3 on the small inset panel.
Female/F_Spadl_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The female version has a broader, flatter rear plate, and its top cap sits further back.

Female/F_Spadl_Splendor_01.description: A single left shoulder pauldron of layered, swept-back armoured fins that curve over the shoulder, with a smooth inset panel in the centre and a pair of pointed tips at the rear. Superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Splendor_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and edge plates; colour 0 on the large upper inset panel; colour 1 on the curved inner panel; colour 2 on the narrow strip beside it.

Female/F_Spadl_Spooky_01.description: A single angular shoulder guard shaped like a skull-like mask, with a contrasting eye slot, a recessed glowing inset, and stacked tapering plates that run down the outer upper arm. Sits over the left shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and stacked plates; colour 3 on the recessed inset panel; colour 2 on the eye slot.
Female/F_Spadl_Spooky_01.differs: The female version has a longer, narrower tail of tapering plates running down the arm, while the male shoulder guard is wider and more compact.

Female/F_Spadl_Starhawk_01.description: A thin, open metal band arching over the left shoulder like a curved bracket, with jagged angular points at the front and back ends. It sits on top of the shoulder without covering it, suggesting a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Spadl_Starhawk_02.description: A small curved shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a thin arched band wrapping partway around the upper arm, ending in angular blade-like fins at both ends that stick up. Mechanical, sleek superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upright angular fins at each end; colour 1 on the main curved band; colour 2 on the inset panel at the front; colour 3 on a thin accent line along the band.
Female/F_Spadl_Starhawk_02.differs: The female version's fins stand taller and more upright, with a thicker, chunkier band, while the male version's fins sweep lower and the band is thinner.

Female/F_Spadl_Steampunk_01.description: A chunky mechanical left shoulder pad shaped like a cogwheel: a round bolted plate ringed with blocky recessed segments, with curved contrasting brackets and an inner lining that cup the shoulder. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cog plate and blocky segments; colour 1 on the curved brackets and rim; colour 3 on the inner lining panel; colour 2 on the bolts and recessed insets.

Female/F_Spadl_Steelarachnid_F.description: A single left shoulder pauldron of angular layered plates that sweeps outward over the upper arm, with slotted vents, small round studs and a tall curved horn-like spike rising from the top near the neck.
Female/F_Spadl_Steelarachnid_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the horn spike; colour 1 on the recessed slots along the plates; colour 2 on the edge trim and the small cap on top; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Spadl_Steelcommando_01.description: A rounded, dome-shaped metal pauldron with a hollow underside that caps the left shoulder. Raised seam lines divide the shell into curved plates, giving a retro mechanical armour look.
Female/F_Spadl_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper rim and top edge of the shell; the glossy metal body of the shell largely ignores the scheme; raised seams take no separate colour.
Female/F_Spadl_Steelcommando_01.differs: The female pauldron is a smaller, more compact cap that sits higher on the shoulder, with a slightly narrower shell than the male one.

Female/F_Spadl_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A single left shoulder guard: a smooth, curved metal cap with faceted edges that arches over the top of the shoulder and is hollow underneath. It has a retro mechanical, superhero look.
Female/F_Spadl_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper surface of the plate; colour 1 on the lower edge of the plate. The glossy metal shading partly ignores the scheme.

Female/F_Spadl_Tactical_01.description: A small curved shoulder patch that wraps the outside of the left upper arm, with a raised bevelled rim around a recessed panel showing an atom emblem. Suggests a tactical or science-themed superhero uniform.
Female/F_Spadl_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and the atom symbol; colour 1 on the recessed panel behind the atom; colour 2 on the inner edge and back of the shell.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_90s_Bullets_01.description: A padded, quilted shoulder cap that arches over the left shoulder, with layered rectangular bands of trim, a contrasting central plate and a row of bullet-like cartridges held by wire loops, plus a strap tab at the front and back.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_90s_Bullets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted padding and cartridge casings; colour 1 on the trim bands and the strap tab; colour 2 on the central plate; colour 3 on the cartridge bands.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_90s_Knife_01.description: A puffy, quilted shoulder pad arching over the left shoulder, with layered contrasting trim frames, a strap with a buckle, a row of small tube-like cartridges and a flat combat knife lying across the top.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_90s_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted padding and cartridge casings; colour 1 on the trim frames and strap; colour 2 on the inner panel and knife blade; colour 3 on the cartridge bands.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron with a smooth, tapering armored shell of segmented plates, held by a mechanical housing at the outer edge with vents and small indicator lights, plus a broad band and chevron stripe accents. Sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented shell plates; colour 1 on the broad band and lower edge trim; colour 2 on the mechanical housing and inner lining; colour 3 on the chevron stripes and small indicator lights.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Alien_01.description: A small angular shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a layered, hollow shell with a raised flat top plate, a beveled edge band and a curved spike jutting out to the side and back. Sci-fi alien styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower rim of the shell; colour 1 on the main shell body; colour 2 on the raised top plate and inner hollow; colour 3 on the spike.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.description: A curved, shell-like left shoulder pauldron of angular plate with a raised flared rear crest, hexagonal bolt heads across the outer face and contrasting edge trim. It caps the shoulder like an alien gladiator guard.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the edge trim and side panels; colour 3 on the crest and small edge accents; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 1 on the hex bolts.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A small left shoulder cap shaped like a curved plate that drapes over the shoulder, with a pointed outer edge, swirling cloud-like scroll ornament, and layered striped bands hanging slightly front and back. East-Asian-inspired.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the draped bands; colour 3 on the plate edging and stripe between the bands; colour 2 on the curled scroll and scroll linework.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ancient_01.description: A left shoulder guard of layered angular plates with a raised winged fin at the top, engraved swirl patterns, and a ringed cuff band around the upper arm. Ancient-fantasy armor that sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ancient_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and fin; colour 3 on the cuff ring, edge trim and lower strap; colour 1 on the engraved swirl patterns.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ancient_01.differs: The female version has a wide wing-like fin flaring up and outward from the shoulder, and the plates sit more tightly stacked.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Face_01.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a sculpted face plate with a raised outer rim, a lower flared cuff, small spikes on top and a long curved blade-like talon sweeping down behind the arm. Fantasy-gothic armor look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Face_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sculpted face plate; colour 1 on the rim and the upper outer shell; colour 2 on the lower cuff, talon and top horns; colour 3 on the small spike tips.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.description: A curved, squared-off shoulder plate for the left shoulder: a single rounded shell with a jagged notched lower edge and a second overlapping layer beneath, framed by a contrasting border. Sits on the shoulder cap like a sci-fi pauldron.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate faces; colour 1 on the raised border trim and the inner lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Round_01.description: A rounded, shield-like left shoulder cap with a raised rim that curls into hooked points at the top and bottom. A star-and-diamond emblem sits on the face, with small spikes at the edge. Superhero style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Round_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and hooked ends; colour 1 on the face panel and the underside; colour 3 on the star-shaped emblem; colour 2 on the small spikes.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.description: A curved, layered shoulder plate with jagged edges sits on the left shoulder. A contrasting cross-shaped block on top holds a large sweeping scythe-like blade that arcs outward and back, giving a fantasy-mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate face; colour 1 on the plate edging and outer shell; colour 3 on the cross-shaped block; colour 2 on the blade.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.differs: The female blade sweeps out and back from the shoulder with no extra spike on the plate's underside.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Anniversary_Defende.description: A small left shoulder cap of stacked, ridged armor plates that step down into a wide, flared outer visor-like flap. Sits on top of the shoulder and reads as retro superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Anniversary_Defende.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ridged upper plates; colour 0 on the ridge edges and inner plate; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 3 on the flared outer flap.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A left shoulder cap shaped like a swept, pointed pauldron: a layered upper shell with a round inset gem, over a glossy lower plate that juts outward in a point, with a cutout and thin edge trim.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper shell; colour 0 on the lower pointed plate; colour 1 on the round gem-like inset; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A rounded, dome-shaped shoulder cap for the left shoulder, covered in a pebbled pattern of irregular plates like an armadillo shell, with a thin banded rim around the edge and a hollow underside.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell surface between the plates; colour 2 on the irregular plate patches; colour 1 on the segmented edge trim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.description: A domed, hollow shoulder cap that curves over the left shoulder like a shell, with a contrasting raised panel along the upper edge and a round mechanical port with a small lens on the front.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the raised upper panel, edge piping and inner lining; colour 2 on the rim edges; colour 3 on the lens in the round port.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.description: A steampunk mechanical shoulder piece: a boxy tapered metal housing with a vented grille and small panel, a tall thin smokestack pipe rising from it, a side gear wheel, a small cylinder on top, and a flexible segmented hose beneath. A curved cloth flap drapes over the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing and hose rings; colour 1 on the cloth flap, top cylinder, side panel and small pipe; colour 2 on the smokestack, gear wheel and hose segments; colour 3 on the vent slats.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armor_Viperlogo_01.description: A single left shoulder pauldron of angular armor plating with a spiked crest on top, a raised rim, and segmented ribbed fins showing between the front and back plates; it sits over the shoulder cap.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armor_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor plates and spikes; colour 1 on the ribbed inner segments; colour 2 on the inner shadowed segments and underside; colour 3 on the small paired marks on the plate.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armorninja.description: A curved rectangular shoulder plate with a raised rim, mounted on the left upper arm, with a segmented banded lower section and a sharp curved horn-like blade sweeping out from the outer side. Suggests a ninja or mechanical armor style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, back of the plate and the curved blade; colour 1 on the main plate face and lower edge; colour 3 on the rectangular inset panel; colour 2 on the lower band.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A small angular shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a hollow faceted cap with a raised ridge along the top and a tapering pointed extension that juts down toward the front and back of the arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the cap; colour 1 on the tapered lower extension and the inner underside.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Armorviper_01.differs: The female version has a taller, more upright ridge and a narrower, more pointed shell than the male one.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A curved, shallow shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a raised rounded-angular plate with a bevelled rim, an atom emblem on its face, and a hollow underside. Suggests a clean superhero science look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the main plate face and inner lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A small left shoulder plate: a curved, angular cap with a pointed lower tip and a raised rim around a recessed panel. It sits on top of the shoulder and reads as sleek sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim and edges; colour 1 on the recessed face panel, fading toward colour 2 at the lower point.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_02.differs: The female plate has a taller, thicker rim on the front edge, so it looks more raised and bulky around the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.description: A furry animal head shoulder piece with pointed ears, a snarling open mouth with small teeth and a rounded nose, resting on the left shoulder with ragged fur tufts around the neck edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur; colour 1 on the fur tufts and shading around the edges; colour 3 on the nose and inner ears.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A rounded left shoulder cap with a raised outer rim that curves up behind the shoulder. A contrasting bordered panel on the outer face holds a feather-like wing motif, giving a sleek avian sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder cap surface; colour 1 on the raised outer rim and edging; colour 2 on the border framing the panel; colour 3 on the feather motif.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The female version is a rounded cap with a tall rim and a feather-wing panel, without the stacked overlapping plates and studs of the male version.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a beaked, curved shell with a thick rim and stacked, layered lower plates ending in a serrated, feather-like edge. Three rounded bulbs sit on the top surface; sits over the shoulder cap.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and inner surfaces; colour 2 on the rim and the lower layered plates; colour 3 on the three rounded bulbs.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.differs: The female version has a layered, serrated lower edge and three raised round bulbs, whereas the male version has a smooth contrasting-rimmed shell with a single angular winged plate.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A small faceted, angular shoulder cap that arches over the left shoulder like a hollow shell, with a chevron-shaped pair of grooves along its length and a round octagonal lens-like port at the front end.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted shell; colour 2 on the chevron grooves; colour 1 on the octagonal port rim; colour 3 on the port centre.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.differs: The female version has the round port only on the front end of the shell, whereas the male version has one at both ends.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A mechanical shoulder piece: a thick curved arch that bridges over the top of the shoulder, with contrasting angular tips at front and back and two blocky side panels with slashed markings hanging down the outer arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the arch; colour 2 on the arch tips and panel edges; colour 1 on the side panels; colour 3 on the slash marks.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Bolts_01.description: A small angular shoulder plate, curved like a shallow shell, sitting on the outer left shoulder. Hex bolt heads and short pegs stud its surface, giving a mechanical, utilitarian look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Bolts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and bolts; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A left shoulder guard of layered armor plates that flare into a wide upturned collar-like rim, with raised ribbed strips and rows of curved claw-like spikes along the top and outer edge. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the spikes; colour 1 on the upper flared rim, the edge trim and the ribbed strips; colour 2 on the claw spikes.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The upper rim flares out as a broader, more swooping contrasting-trimmed wing over the shoulder, while the lower plates hang a little narrower.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a hollow, skull-like shell with a contrasting cavity, a raised angular rim and small tusk-like points, ringed by a spiky fringe of fur tufts around the edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and rim; colour 1 on the spiky fur fringe; colour 2 on the inner cavity.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_03.description: A curved shoulder pauldron with a flat angular plate edged in a jagged spiky fringe, a snarling beast-face mask on the outer side, and lacing cords across the plate. Sits over the left shoulder with barbaric styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface and lacing cords; colour 1 on the spiky fringe edging; colour 2 on the plate rim and studs; colour 3 on the beast-face panel.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Child_Space_01.description: A smooth, rounded dome-shaped shoulder pod floating over the left shoulder, slightly faceted with a hollow open underside and a subtle horizontal seam. Suggests a sleek futuristic shoulder guard.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Child_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole dome shell; the material appears to ignore the other colour slots, and no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Combat_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder: a smooth, tapered shell that curves over the top of the arm like a short pauldron, ending in a point. Suggests a light, practical combat look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Combat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoulder plate; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.description: A single flat, padded strap that arches over the left shoulder from the base of the neck down the upper arm, tapering to a small rivet-like snap at the end. It has a rimmed edge and a hollow underside.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole strap; the recessed underside and snap look and take no distinct slot.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Covertmilitary_01.description: A small domed shoulder pad with faceted, angular edges, a raised octagonal disc on the outer face, and inset channelled panels with small vent-like slots along the lower edge. Sits on the left shoulder cap in a tech-military style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Covertmilitary_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and octagonal disc; colour 1 on the inset edge panels and trim channels; colour 2 on the underside.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cross_And_Cirlce_01.description: A small mechanical shoulder emblem for the left shoulder: a flat octagonal ring with a central hub and cross spokes, four curved anchor-like prongs radiating outward. It sits flat on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cross_And_Cirlce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring and central hub; colour 2 on the cross spokes and prongs.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A left shoulder cap made of three stacked, arched band panels with thick contrasting edging, overlapping like segmented plates over the top of the shoulder, fastened at the front by a round button-like stud. Casual western-cyber look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded panel faces; colour 2 on the edging around each band; colour 1 on the round stud at the front.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A left shoulder pad: a curved, dented metal plate with a rolled rim caps the shoulder. An octagonal vent stack rises from a collar on top and a short cylindrical nozzle sticks out at the side. Rugged cyber-western look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 1 on the collar ring at the base of the stack; colour 3 on the vent stack and side nozzle; colour 2 on the plate rim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A small domed mechanical shoulder cap that sits over the left shoulder, with a raised top plate holding an oval inset, a flared lower skirt with small vent slits, and a thick rim along the inner edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised top plate; colour 1 on the flared skirt and outer shell; colour 3 on the oval inset and the small vent marks; colour 2 on the thick rim edge.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap that sits over the left shoulder. A rounded upper shell tapers to a banded lower rim and carries small hex bolts. It reads as a light, mechanical cyborg-style pauldron.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shell; colour 0 on the lower band; colour 2 on the inner edge of the rim; colour 3 on the hex bolts.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.differs: The female version has its bolts placed a little further apart, and its shell is slimmer and more tapered.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Defender_02.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder, built from three stacked scalloped plates with a thick band between them and a hollow, lined interior. Sits over the top of the shoulder in a sleek superhero style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Defender_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and lower plates; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 1 on the inner lining and thin edge trim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A single left shoulder fin: a swept, winged panel that rises to a sharp point beside the neck and flares outward over the shoulder, crossed by three raised ribs and edged with a thin rim.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fin panel; colour 2 on the edge rim and the three ribs; colour 0 on the inner side of the rising point.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Destroyer_01.differs: The female fin sits closer to the neck and stands more upright, with the outer sweep angled less far out over the arm.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A curved, open-backed shoulder guard that wraps the outer left shoulder like a short half-cylinder, with a raised rim, horizontal ridged bands on the outer panel and short pointed studs scattered across it.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and inner edge; colour 1 on the outer banded panel; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Destroyerbot_02.description: A single curved shoulder guard forming a shallow half-cylinder cap over the left upper arm, with a thick rim, a padded panel with faint horizontal segment lines, and a flat squared edge. Suggests gladiator or sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Destroyerbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and inner lining; colour 1 on the padded outer panel.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A small rounded shoulder plate that caps the left shoulder as a hollow, faceted shell, with a separate lower band of segmented panels along the rim. Suggests a sleek sci-fi or superhero armour pad.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed outer shell; colour 2 on the side and inner panels; colour 0 on the lower rim segments; colour 3 on the small accent panel at the front of the rim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_02.description: A small segmented shoulder plate for the left shoulder: a rounded cap with stacked, overlapping curved bands over recessed inner panels. It sits close on the shoulder in a sleek, mechanical superhero style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cap and the inner panels; colour 1 on the stacked outer bands; colour 3 on the recessed strips between the panels; colour 2 on the shadowed underside.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_02.differs: The female plate is smaller and sits closer to the shoulder, with its bands wrapped flat around the cap.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_03.description: A small mechanical shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a rounded, hollow shell made of stacked angular segments, with a smooth domed top plate and banded ribs down the outer side. Sci-fi, armoured styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed top plate and the ribs between the bands; colour 1 on the segmented outer plates; colour 3 on the inset strips between the ribs; colour 2 on the inner edges and gaps.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Disk_01.description: A small faceted disc-shaped shoulder piece with a shallow dished face and thick rim, mounted on the outer left shoulder and angled outward like a mechanical socket cap.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Disk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole disc, including the rim and dished face; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Double_01_Basic.description: A compact left shoulder pad made of stacked, overlapping curved plates that wrap over the top of the shoulder and taper to a stepped, pointed edge down the upper arm. It has a superhero-armour look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Double_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top rim plate; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 3 on the outer lower shell and edge trim; colour 0 on the inset panels.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Double_02_Basic.description: A small left shoulder pad made of two stacked, angular layered plates with a rim of conical spikes along the top and outer edge, a thin stripe between the layers, and an open hollow underside. Suits a mechanical or punk look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Double_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rims and spikes; colour 2 on the domed top panel; colour 0 on the inner face panel; colour 3 on the thin stripe.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Double_03_Basic.description: A left shoulder guard of stacked, layered curved bands over a rounded cap, with a tall swept fin rising at the back and small blade-like points at the front. It sits over the shoulder in a mechanical superhero style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Double_03_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer bands, fin and blade points; colour 0 on the inner rounded cap visible between the bands.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Draycul_01.description: A left shoulder plate shaped like a sculpted monstrous skull face, with a glowing-eye bulge, a large rounded cheek dome and curved contrasting claw-like fangs at the front. Riveted panel lines and a trim edge wrap over the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull plate; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the eye and the large dome; colour 2 on the fangs, the inner shoulder panel and the panel lines.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Electric_01.description: A domed left shoulder cap ringed by a curved metal rim, with hex-nut bolts and coiled contrasting-wound electrode coils sprouting from the top and sides like a Tesla coil. Sits over the shoulder as a mechanical superhero pad.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed cap; colour 3 on the seam lines and the coiled windings; colour 0 on the curved rim and side bolt; colour 2 on the hex-nut caps and coil ends.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Epaulette_02.description: A small military-style epaulette resting on top of the left shoulder: a flat, rounded plate with a narrow tab extending inward, edged with a thin contrasting rim and hung with a dense fringe of short strands along the outer edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Epaulette_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top plate; colour 2 on the thin rim and underside band; colour 1 on the hanging fringe strands.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Epaulette_02.differs: The female plate has a longer, more sloping tab and is set slightly narrower on the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A single left shoulder guard in an art deco style: a smooth, beak-like pointed cap that extends outward over the arm, backed by a tall swept-up fin that curls into a scroll at the base, with a contrasting band near the tip.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder cap; colour 1 on the upright fin, its curled base and the band near the tip; colour 2 on the thin seam lines.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_02.description: A left shoulder pad shaped like a curved, shell-like scoop with a thick rolled rim and an inner panel etched with thin grooves. A raised fin-like plate rises at the neck side. Retro art-deco sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim and shell; colour 0 on the inner panel and the raised fin plate; colour 2 on the thin groove lines.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_02.differs: The female pad has a shallower, more flared shell, and its raised fin plate is shorter and more swept back.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A single feathered wing-like shoulder piece: a band wraps the top of the left shoulder and a fan of layered feathers sweeps outward and back, fading toward the tips. Angelic, fantasy look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shoulder band; colour 0 on the feather bases; colour 1 on the feather tips.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Feathers_03.description: A small curved shoulder cap sitting on the left shoulder, with a smooth domed shell and diagonal stripe panels, ringed along its lower edge by a fringe of pointed, feather-like spikes. Suggests sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Feathers_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 on the diagonal band across the shell; colour 3 on the small stripe panel on the front; colour 0 on the feather fringe and the rim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Fin_01.description: A small membranous fin-like shoulder piece: a webbed, spotted skin panel stretched between several curved spiny ribs that sweep backward and outward from the left shoulder, giving a sharp, creature-like silhouette.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spotted membrane; colour 1 on the curved ribs and spines; colour 3 on the spots or speckles across the membrane; colour 2 on the shaded folds.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Fin_01.differs: The female fin is a narrower, more swept-back wing that trails farther behind the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Fin_02.description: A large fin-like shoulder piece: a thin webbed membrane stretched between several curved spines, sweeping outward and back from the top of the left shoulder in a ragged, wing-like fan.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane surface; colour 1 on the curved spines and edge ribs; colour 2 on the shaded underside and inner panels; colour 3 on the spotted markings.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Fin_02.differs: The female fin sweeps out and back in a longer, flatter fan with more widely spread spines.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Flower_01.description: A small rose-like flower worn on the left shoulder: a tight cluster of layered curled petals at the centre, ringed by longer pointed leaf-like petals that fan outward over the shoulder. Suggests a fantasy nature theme.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer pointed petals; colour 1 on the petal bands and inner petals; colour 2 on the petal centre and tips; colour 3 on small accents deep in the bloom.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Furrypad_01.description: A large fur shoulder pad for the left shoulder: a curved shell densely covered in layered, pointed fur tufts that sweep down and outward over the upper arm. Suggests a wild, animalistic look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Furrypad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts; colour 2 on the darker tips and roots of the fur; colour 0 on the inner shell rim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Fursmall_01.description: A small fur shoulder tuft for the left shoulder: a cap of shaggy layered fur with jagged, pointed strands that drape over the top of the shoulder and hang partway down the upper arm. Suggests a wild or barbarian look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Fursmall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur at the top of the shoulder; colour 1 on the tips of the hanging strands; colour 2 on the shadowed underside.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Furspiked_01.description: A small fur shoulder pad for the left shoulder: a shaggy cap of jagged, pointed fur tufts that sweep outward and downward over the shoulder and upper arm, with longer spikes toward the front. Wild, savage look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Furspiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur near the shoulder top; colour 1 on the lower tips of the tufts, blending as a gradient; colour 2 in the shadowed underside.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A single sleek shoulder guard: a smooth, swooping shell that curves over the top of the left shoulder and sweeps up into a pointed tip near the neck, with a thin contrasting edge trim.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Gadroonfancy_01.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a swept manta wing, with a raised central dome and tall angular spikes at the front and back. Thin pointed wings extend outward over the shoulder, giving a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Gadroonfancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer wing surfaces and spikes; colour 0 on the central dome; colour 3 on the inner spike underside and edge; colour 2 on small inset panels.
