Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A domed left shoulder pauldron with a contrasting rim, a raised fin-like edge at the back, segmented stacked bands along the lower edge, a round port at the front and several cone spikes and small studs across the surface.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome and inner surface; colour 1 on the outer rim and lower rim bands; colour 2 on the round front port and segment bands; colour 3 on the spikes and raised studs.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Golden_Age_Bolt_01.description: A thin raised lightning-bolt emblem lying against the outer left shoulder, with a jagged stepped edge and a pointed tip running down the upper arm. Classic comic-book superhero styling.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.description: A small five-pointed star emblem that sits flat and slightly curved on the outside of the left upper arm, thin and faceted with a raised look. Suggests a classic retro superhero costume.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the star; colour 2 on the shaded underside and edges.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a smooth shell striped by curved vent bands on top and a rolled lip that ends in a contrasting round port at the rear.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and rolled lip; colour 1 on the vent stripes; colour 2 on the round port.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The vent stripes run as straight diagonal bands on this version, not the chevron-shaped bands of the male version.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A curved, shield-shaped armored shoulder pad for the left shoulder, with a rim around the edge, ridged wavy channels across the face and a row of small spikes along the top edge. Fantasy dragon styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim, ridges and spikes; colour 1 on the wavy inset channels; colour 2 on the underside lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A small mechanical shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a angular pointed plate on the upper arm, held by a flat strap with notched, forked ends that wraps over the shoulder. Sci-fi and sleek.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and the strap; the other colour slots are not clearly visible on this piece.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A floating field of faceted hexagonal shards hovering off the left shoulder, angular plates clustered into a tapered, upright shape with small spiky fins around it. It suggests a holographic energy shield.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire shard field; the piece appears a single flat tone and the other slots are not visible.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.description: A small cluster of jagged, bone-like spikes on the left shoulder, each mounted on a flat angular base plate. The spikes are arranged in a loose vertical line and give a monstrous, spiny look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the flat base plates under each spike.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.differs: The spikes are stacked in a vertical line down the outer shoulder, rather than in an arc across the top of the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.description: A cluster of jagged, bone-like spikes and swept fins rising from small base plates along the top and back of the left shoulder, with long blades fanning outward. Monstrous, spiky, partial shoulder ornament.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes and fins; colour 3 on the small base plates that anchor the spikes to the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.differs: The female version has longer, more sweeping blade-like spikes fanning outward and a fourth smaller spike, while the male version has shorter, chunkier spikes.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A small mechanical shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a curved, angular rim frames a domed plate, with several segmented ribbed hoses arching over the top and clamped by small straps. It sits on the shoulder cap.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved rim and the clamp straps; colour 3 on the segmented hoses; colour 0 on the domed plate and hose end fittings; colour 2 on the inset panels and underside fittings.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Insignia_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a raised rim and a domed face bearing an atom-style emblem. It sits on top of the shoulder like a shield, in a superhero style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed face; colour 0 on the atom emblem; colour 3 on the raised rim and inner lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Insignia_02.description: A large rounded pauldron capping the left shoulder, a domed shell with a raised contrasting rim and an atom-style emblem of looping orbits on the outer face. Superhero style, sitting high on the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Insignia_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed shell; colour 3 on the raised rim and the inner lining; colour 0 on the atom emblem.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A single angular armored shoulder cap with a raised, flared outer rim and a light inset panel bearing a swirling tribal-like emblem; a small round stud sits at the front corner, with an inner lining underneath. Sits on the left shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the inset panel; colour 2 on the emblem design; colour 3 on the inner lining and the small stud.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ironclad_01.differs: The female version has a shallower inner lining that barely shows beneath the shell, while the male lining hangs lower as a visible contrasting skirt.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Justiciar_01.description: A small angular shoulder plate for the left shoulder: two flat, folded panels form a shallow ridge over the top of the arm, with a stepped, contrasting trim edge along the lower rim. Suits a sleek sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Justiciar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate panels; colour 1 on the stepped lower edge trim; colour 2 on the small inner panel at the top.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Knight_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron of layered, segmented plates: a ridged upper cap with rivets curves over the shoulder, and stacked overlapping lames fan down over the upper arm. Medieval knightly styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cap plates; colour 3 on the lower lames, fading in with a gradient; colour 2 on the rivets and inner shading.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Knight_02.description: A left shoulder pauldron of layered, overlapping plates with raised ridges and rivets, studded with conical spikes along the top and outer edge. It caps the shoulder and upper arm in a medieval knight style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate and the spikes; colour 3 on the lower overlapping plates, fading in from the upper plate; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_01.description: A left shoulder accessory of two swept-up, fin-like blades with ribbed inner faces and glossy outer shells, fanning from a flat angular base plate on top of the shoulder. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base plate top and the inner ridges; colour 1 on the ribbed inner faces of the blades; colour 2 on the glossy outer shells; colour 3 on the edge of the base plate.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_01.differs: The blades are shorter and stubbier, curving more tightly over the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_02.description: A left shoulder piece shaped like a domed cap with two swept-back blade-like fins that flare outward past the shoulder. It has a contrasting segmented edge and etched line details, giving a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top plate of the dome; colour 1 on the swept fins and side plates; colour 2 on the underside and edge housing; colour 3 on the etched lines and small edge slots.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Light_01.description: A winged shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a domed, ribbed cap with a contrasting outlined rim, sweeping outward into layered, sharp feather-like blades that trail down and back, in a heroic style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed dome; colour 1 on the outer rim and border panel; colour 0 on the feather tips and highlights; colour 2 on the lower feather blades.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lionshield_01.description: A curved shoulder guard sculpted as a lion's head with swept mane ridges, sitting over the left shoulder like a cowl-shaped cap, edged with a thin contrasting rim. Heroic, fantasy-armor look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lionshield_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head and mane; colour 1 on the rim edging around the shield; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a dished shell with a raised pointed fin at the back, a bordered rim of segmented plates, contrasting-tipped rivets and painted claw-like streaks across the surface.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented rim; colour 2 on the main shell and back fin; colour 1 on the claw-like streaks; colour 3 on the rivets.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_01.differs: The female version has a taller, more upright pointed fin at the back of the shell.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_02.description: A small curved shoulder cap that arches over the top of the left shoulder like a half-tube, with a thick rolled contrasting edge, scuffed patchy surface, rows of small drilled holes and a single round screw head.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell panel; colour 1 on the rolled outer edge; colour 3 on the screw head; colour 2 on the small holes.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Magicalgirl_01.description: A small left shoulder cap in a magical-girl style: a curved, dome-like panel arching over the shoulder, edged with a thick ruffled rim and a frilled lower hem with a short trailing flap. Sits on top of the shoulder only.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Magicalgirl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled outer rim and frilled hem; colour 1 on the inner panel and small triangular accents along the rim; colour 2 on the main dome panel and the trailing flap.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Martial_Power_02.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a flared, wing-like pauldron: a smooth curved plate with a wavy scalloped edge, a contrasting blade-like rim underneath, a ridged vented fin along the top and a faceted gem at the front.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main curved plate; colour 0 on the underside rim; colour 2 on the frame, fin housing and edging; colour 3 on the fin slots and the gem.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Mechanon.description: A mechanical left shoulder piece made of angular, layered armor plates that sit on top of the shoulder, with a swept-back winged fin and a pointed spike rising up beside the neck. Suggests a robotic sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plates and fin tips; colour 1 on the curved outer panels and edge plates; colour 2 on the inner and upper plates and the spike; colour 3 on small accent inserts between the plates.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Mechassn_01.description: A left shoulder pad in a sci-fi mechanical style: a rounded cup over the shoulder topped by an angular armored casing that tapers into a cylindrical barrel at the back, with fin-like side plates and a slim chevron accent.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top casing and side plates; colour 1 on the shoulder cup and inner rim; colour 2 on the rear barrel and lower panels; colour 3 on the chevron stripes.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Monster_01.description: A left shoulder cap made of overlapping curved plates that stack down over the upper arm, with jagged bone-like spikes and thin blades rising along the top and jutting out at the rear. Monstrous, organic look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main overlapping plates; colour 1 on the seams between plates; colour 0 on the spikes and blades along the top and rear.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Padding.description: A small rounded shoulder pad that caps the left shoulder, a smooth curved shell with a flared lower edge and a diagonal band of contrasting panels across it. Suits tactical or superhero suits.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 on the diagonal band across the pad; colour 0 on the rim and inner edge; colour 3 on the top patch.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Patterned_01.description: A small angular shoulder pad for the left shoulder: a domed upper plate with a contrasting lower panel, stacked layered lips below and a thick outlined edge. Sits over the top of the shoulder in a superhero style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper domed panel; colour 0 on the lower stacked panels; colour 2 on the outline edging.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a spiky shell: a large cone spike rises from the top, with smaller spikes projecting back and a cluster of round dimples down the front. It ends in a toothed edge at the bottom.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spikes; colour 1 on the round dimples; colour 3 on the toothed underside trim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Power_01.description: A single left shoulder pad: an angular, faceted top plate with a raised ridge sits over a rounded underlayer that wraps the upper arm and shoulder. It suggests a sleek sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper faceted plate; colour 1 on the rounded underlayer beneath it; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Prisonguard_01.description: A small angular sci-fi shoulder pad for the left shoulder: a wedge-shaped shell with a raised top panel, bordered edges and a slim vent-like stripe on the side, sitting on top of the shoulder and sloping outward.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Prisonguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the border trim and outer side casing; colour 1 on the raised top panel; colour 2 on the underside and lower shell; colour 3 on the small stripe detail on the side.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Psiagent_01.description: A thin, flat shoulder mantle of two overlapping angular plates with a notched gap between them, curving over the top of the left shoulder from collarbone to back. It has a veined, web-like surface texture and a sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Psiagent_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle plates; the web-like veining shows as lighter texture. No other colour slots are clearly visible.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Psiagent_01.differs: The female version is a shorter, more compact mantle that sits closer to the neck and shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Psineophyte_01.description: A curved, cap-like left shoulder guard made of stepped angular panels with a notched split line and a veined, circuit-like surface texture. It sits over the top of the shoulder, suggesting a psionic sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Psineophyte_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoulder guard; the default material appears to ignore the other colour slots, and no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Psislicer_01.description: A single left shoulder blade-like fin: a small rounded disc sits on the shoulder cap and sweeps up and outward into a thin, curved spike with a lacy, web-like translucent surface. Psychic, energy-blade styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Psislicer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole piece, disc and web-like blade; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Punk_01.description: A single shoulder pad shaped like a shallow round dish, worn upright on the left shoulder. It has a raised rim, a ribbed turbine-style ring, a domed centre and a small central spike. Mechanical punk look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim; colour 1 on the ribbed ring; colour 2 on the domed centre and the back of the dish; colour 3 on the central spike and its base.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A small left shoulder cap of layered, crumpled cloth-like folds forming a pointed, draped wedge over the top of the shoulder, with a rim of contrasting edging and a lower flap. Suggests a light chiton-style shoulder piece.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main folded surface; colour 1 on the edging and rim along the folds.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.differs: The female version is a pointed, draped wedge with a hanging lower flap, while the male one is a rounder, boxier cap.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.description: A single left shoulder guard of angular, segmented armour plates that rise to a pointed fin at the back, with an inset triangular panel and a crumpled layered lining beneath. Sits on top of the shoulder; sci-fi alien styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main armour plates; colour 3 on the inset triangular panel; colour 1 on the crumpled lining, with colour 0 highlights on its folds.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.differs: The female version has a taller, more upright point and a slimmer, more compact shell with less lining showing.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.description: A single left shoulder guard: a rounded, segmented armor cap with a tall backswept horn-like spike rising from the top, contrasting inset panels on the sides, and a curling rim of contrasting trim around the shoulder joint.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main armor shell and spike; colour 3 on the inset side panels; colour 1 on the curled rim trim at the shoulder edge; colour 0 as highlights on the rim.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.differs: The female version is a smaller cap with a more upright spike and a thinner curled rim that sits close to the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Longshoulder.description: An alien, organic left shoulder growth: a tall curved horn-like tentacle with ribbed, banded segments and a ruffled flared base, topped by a sharp tip with a small secondary spike, rising from a rounded dome on the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Longshoulder.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ribbed body; colour 3 on the ruffled edges and the tip; colour 1 on the fine ridge bands, the small spike and the base dome.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Shoulderbig_.description: A single left shoulder pauldron of smooth segmented plates that sweeps out and down past the shoulder in a pointed, elongated shell, with an inner lining and thin seam lines. Sci-fi armor with a sleek, mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Shoulderbig_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 2 on the raised top panel; colour 1 on the inner lining under the shell; colour 3 on the thin seam lines and small central stud.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Spikeandball.description: A single left shoulder piece: a rounded octagonal plate cupping a large glossy sphere, with a long segmented curved horn sweeping outward and small spikes around the plate edge. Alien, organic and monstrous in feel.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Spikeandball.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate and the horn segments; colour 3 on the banded rings along the horn and small markings on the plate; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 2 on the sphere.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a smooth layered shell, a separate raised panel on top and two thick rounded bars arching over it. Suggests a sleek, mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the rim and inner lining; colour 2 on the raised top panel; colour 3 on the two arching bars.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Redstone_01.description: A single angular shoulder guard made of flat slabs: a tall fin-like plate rising up beside the neck, with two shorter blocky plates angled forward and down over the shoulder, edged in contrasting trim. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the edge trim and end bands; colour 2 on the small inset slot detail.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Retroscifi_Coils_01.description: A left shoulder piece made of a fan of stacked, ribbed overlapping plates under a thick curved ring that arcs up and over the shoulder like a horn. Sits on top of the shoulder, retro sci-fi in style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Retroscifi_Coils_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the stacked ribbed plates; colour 0 on the outer arching ring; colour 3 on the thin trim line along the ring; colour 2 on the ring's back edge.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: Three long flowing ribbons anchored at a small flower-like rosette on the left shoulder, arching up and back over the shoulder then trailing down behind the body in tapered, pointed ends. Elegant, decorative superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper ribbon lengths; colour 1 on the ribbon tips and the rosette petals; colour 2 and colour 3 on the small centre details of the rosette.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.differs: The ribbons hang more steeply down the back and stay closer to the body, ending around hip level.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Rings_01.description: A fan of three thin, open C-shaped flat rings stacked and splayed outward from a single hinge point on top of the shoulder, like mechanical blades or fins jutting up and back from the arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Rings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the rings; the small hinge ends show a darker shade from the default material.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Rings_01.differs: The female version's rings are stacked tightly and lean upward as a narrow fan, while the male's are spread wider and tilted apart.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A mechanical left shoulder cap: a segmented, domed armour plate ringed with short hex-capped connectors and looping thick cables, giving a cybernetic implant look that sits over the top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate panels; colour 2 on the cable loops and inner plate; colour 1 on the connector nozzles and hex caps; colour 3 on the small lights in the connector tips.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.description: Two segmented flexible hoses arc in loops over the left shoulder, each ending in a chunky cylindrical connector cap. A small mechanical cybernetic accent that sits on top of the shoulder and reaches toward the back.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the segmented hoses; colour 1 on the cylindrical connector caps.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.differs: The female hoses form tighter, more overlapping loops with the connector caps bunched together, whereas the male loops are wider and more separated.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Robot_Shoulder_01.description: A boxy angular mechanical shoulder pad sitting on the left shoulder, with a large swept-back fin blade rising behind it, thin spiky fins trailing rearward and downward, a round bolted socket at the front, and a contrasting strap over the top.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Robot_Shoulder_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pad body and swept fin blade; colour 1 on the thin trailing fins; colour 2 on the strap and socket housing; colour 3 on the studs and the socket centre.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Robotsamurai_F_01.description: A single left shoulder guard in a samurai-inspired mechanical style: a curved, upswept horn-like crest on top over stacked angular plates that step down the upper arm, with a separate panel at the lower edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Robotsamurai_F_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and outer edges; colour 1 on the crest underside and lower plates; colour 2 on the inner crest and the inset panel; colour 3 on the small accent panel at the lower edge.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A domed, shell-like left shoulder guard with a swirling gear-toothed spiral pattern, a raised rim edging, a round gem at the front and several long curved blade spikes fanning forward and back.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed shell; colour 0 on the spiral pattern and the spike blades; colour 1 on the rim edging and spike edges; colour 3 on the front gem.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The female spikes sweep more outward and downward along the arm, while the shell sits slightly smaller.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_02.description: A sleek mechanical left shoulder piece shaped like a small winged craft, with ridged vents, contrasting curved horn spikes on top and a small round light at the front, plus a long narrow cloth tail trailing down the side of the body.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder shell and the long trailing tail; colour 1 on the underside panel; colour 2 on the horn spikes; colour 3 on the small round lights.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.description: A domed left shoulder cap with a raised rim, a swirling gear-like pattern on its surface, and a cluster of long curved blade-like spikes fanning out from the front. A gem sits at the front edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim and the underside of the cap; colour 2 and colour 0 on the swirl and gear pattern of the dome; colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the gem.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.differs: The female spikes sweep forward and outward as a lower, more swept-back claw cluster, while the male spikes rise upward in a taller fan.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.description: A sleek, angular alien-tech shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a segmented plated shell with ribbed vent slats, a glowing round end cap and two tall curved contrasting spikes rising from the top.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plated shell; colour 1 on the underside plate and the ribbed vent inserts; colour 2 on the curved spikes; colour 3 on the round end cap.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.differs: The female version has no long hanging cloth panel; it is only the shoulder shell with spikes.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A left shoulder piece shaped like a stylised bird or fish head, with swirling striped markings, a large eye, a beak-like point and feathered fins below, backed by a curved shield-like arc and a diamond stud.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved backing arc and the beak and jaw spikes; colour 1 on the head markings, stripes and feather fins; colour 2 on the diamond stud; colour 3 on the eye and stud gem.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A curved, segmented shoulder plate that arches over the top of the left shoulder like a short shell, with several raised ribs across its length and a contrasting edge trim. Samurai-inspired armour.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 3 on the thin ribbed lines between the segments; colour 1 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.description: A left shoulder guard of layered, segmented plates with a spiky, winged upper crest and a round cut-out notch, edged with raised rims and covered in swirling engraved patterns. Overlapping plates step down the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rims and edges; colour 1 on the thin inner border lines; colour 2 on the plate faces; colour 3 on the swirl patterns.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Scales_01.description: A small left shoulder guard made of overlapping pointed scale plates with raised ribs and a bordered edge, studded with small pegs. It perches on top of the shoulder over a contrasting lining, giving a mechanical, armoured look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Scales_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scale plate faces; colour 1 on the raised borders and rims; colour 3 on the small peg studs; colour 2 on the inner lining.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Scales_01.differs: The female version is smaller and sits higher on the shoulder, with a shorter, more compact stack of plates and less of the contrasting lining showing.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A thin, flat, curved sci-fi shoulder plate for the left shoulder, with a stepped notched edge, a wide contrasting band across its middle and a small accent tab at the top. It sits close on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stepped outer edge of the plate; colour 1 on the main curved plate surface; colour 2 on the band across the middle; colour 3 on the small tab at the top.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A shoulder piece of four or five curved, fin-like blades fanning out from the left shoulder, each with a chevron pattern and a bordered edge. Sweeps back and outward like a sea creature's fins.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade surfaces; colour 1 on the blade edging and outlines; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the chevron backing and underside.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.description: A one-shouldered mechanical cape: a small finned shoulder plate anchors a curved, thorny spar that arcs up and back, with a long draped cloth sheet hanging from it nearly to the ankles along the left side.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging cloth sheet; colour 1 on the finned shoulder plate; colour 2 on the curved spar.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.differs: The female version hangs a solid, smooth cloth sheet, while the male version has separate slatted strips.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A small left shoulder piece made of stacked, angular fin-like plates that overlap and sweep back across the top of the shoulder, with a curved inner panel. It suggests sleek superhero or sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer plates and main shell; colour 0 on the middle layered plate edges; colour 2 on the lower layered plates and the fin tips; colour 3 on the inner recessed panel.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shouldercape_01.description: A single-shoulder cape: a stiff folded cloth mantle with contrasting edge trim sits over the left shoulder, held by a contrasting strap, with a long tapering cloth panel hanging down the back to about thigh level.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shouldercape_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth mantle and the hanging panel; colour 1 on the edge trim of the mantle; colour 2 on the strap and shoulder band; colour 3 on small details on the strap.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shouldercape_02.description: A single-shoulder cape: a rounded cloth shoulder cap with contrasting edge trim, from which a long, narrow panel of cloth hangs down the side of the body to about hip or thigh level.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shouldercape_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap top and the hanging cape panel; colour 1 on the edge trim of the shoulder cap; colour 2 on the underside of the cap.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shouldercape_03.description: A single-shoulder cape: layered angular shoulder plates with a narrow neck band, and a long tapering cloth panel hanging from the shoulder down the front to hip level. Asymmetric, with a superhero or military look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shouldercape_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging cloth panel and the inner shoulder plate; colour 2 on the outer shoulder plate layers; colour 1 on the plate edging; colour 3 on the neck band.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shouldercape_04.description: A single-shoulder cape: a small angular layered pauldron-like collar sits on the left shoulder with a contrasting edge, and a long narrow panel of soft cloth hangs from it down the back to about hip or thigh level.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Shouldercape_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging cloth panel and the inner shoulder layer; colour 2 on the outer shoulder layer; colour 1 on the edge trim of the shoulder piece.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Skull_01.description: A left shoulder piece shaped like a skull-plate cap with a tall ridged horn rising from the top, glowing eye sockets, and a jagged lower rim of curved spikes around a rounded inner dome. Gothic, occult style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull plate and horn; colour 2 on the ridge lines and stripes; colour 1 on the spiked lower rim; colour 3 on the inner dome and eye spots.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Skull_02.description: A faceted, low-poly skull worn as a left shoulder pad, with hollow eye sockets facing forward and a jagged, angular flared rim of contrasting trim around the base. Suits gothic, monstrous or punk looks.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell; colour 1 on the jagged rim and edge trim; colour 3 on the small markings on the crown and around the eyes; colour 2 in the eye sockets.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Snake_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder, with a scaly snake-like textured surface, embossed bulbous scale ridges and a rimmed edge, plus two sharp blade-like fangs pointing downward from the lower edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled inner panel beneath the raised centre; colour 1 on the rim and the fang spikes; colour 2 on the raised scaled centre; colour 3 on the eye-like markings.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder, with a rounded cap, a raised band looping around one side and a pointed fin-like blade extending outward. Sleek superhero styling with a hollow underside.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and blade; colour 1 on the looping outer band; colour 3 on the stripes running across the plate.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Space_01.description: A futuristic left shoulder piece: a glossy domed glass-like bubble in an angular angled housing, with a thin band and small round knob across it and a curved fin-like panel behind, sitting on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome; colour 2 on the angular housing and band; colour 1 on the curved panel behind the shoulder; colour 3 on the small knob.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.description: A rounded, segmented left shoulder cap with stitched panel seams and inset streaks, topped by a curved crossbar holding four long pointed spikes that fan out diagonally across the shoulder and upper back.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap; colour 0 on the inset streaks and seam highlights; colour 3 on the curved crossbar; colour 2 on the spikes.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.differs: The spikes fan out diagonally and sweep backward from a slanted crossbar, rather than standing upright in a row.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.description: A left shoulder piece: a small rounded cap with slashed markings, topped by a tall curved blade fin that sweeps upward, with a row of four contrasting arrow-shaped spikes between them. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap; colour 0 on the slash markings of the cap; colour 3 on the curved blade fin; colour 2 on the arrow spikes.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A small cluster of three sharp conical spikes on the left shoulder, pointing outward and slightly forward and back at different angles. Small, partial accent that gives a punk or armoured edge.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_0.description: A cluster of three curved, tapering horn-like spikes rising from the left shoulder, one large central spike with a banded base and two smaller spikes curving outward beside it. Sits on top of the shoulder as a fantasy or sci-fi accent.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower part of the main spike; colour 1 on the spike tips and the smaller spikes; colour 3 on the band at the base.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.description: A small left shoulder ornament: one stout ribbed cone-shaped spike with segmented plating, pointing outward, surrounded by a few tiny loose spikes scattered around the shoulder. Suggests a mechanical or armored superhero look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main spike body and small spikes; colour 1 on the spike tips.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.description: A cluster of four curved, tapering horn-like spikes of differing sizes, with segmented ridged surfaces and rimmed hollow bases, sprouting outward and upward from the left shoulder. Suggests a monstrous or armoured look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each spike; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 3 on the rimmed bases.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.differs: The female version has a longer main spike and the smaller spikes are spread further apart, giving a more fanned-out cluster.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A left shoulder piece of bony, ribbed segments that fan out over the shoulder cap, each tapering to a pointed claw-like tip. It sits on top of the shoulder and suggests an organic, monstrous armor.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised ribs and pointed tips; colour 1 on the recessed bands between the ribs.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered.description: A rounded metal shoulder cap for the left shoulder with a contrasting edge and thin inset stripe, a round gem-like emblem at the front, and a fan of long swept-back contrasting feathers at the outer side like a wing.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the rim edge and inset stripe; colour 3 on the round central gem; colour 2 on the feathers.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A curved, partial left shoulder cap made of layered bands that arc over the top of the shoulder. An outer band sweeps into a pointed hook at the front, with a flared lip at the back. Sleek, symbiote-like superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared outer band along the arm side; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 2 on the raised inner band that ends in the hooked point.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Techsphere_01.description: A large rounded spherical shoulder pod floating over the left shoulder, with a recessed circular socket on each side, small raised round nodes and thin jagged panel-line trim across the shell. A mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Techsphere_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sphere shell; colour 1 on the circular sockets; colour 2 on the jagged outline trim; colour 3 on the small round nodes.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Teeth_01.description: A cluster of long, curved tapering spines fanning out from a thin curved band on the left shoulder. The spines sweep outward and backward, giving a tribal, spiky shoulder crest.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Teeth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin shoulder band; colour 2 on the spine bases and most of each spine; colour 1 on the spine tips.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Teeth_01.differs: The spines splay outward and sweep backward and sideways, lying flatter along the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Tigon_01.description: A small fitted shoulder cap for the left shoulder, a curved shell built from several banded panels that wraps over the top of the shoulder and stops short of the upper arm. Sleek, mechanical superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Tigon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top edge panel; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 3 on the outer side panel; colour 0 on the lower panel.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Tire_01.description: A chunky segmented shoulder cap shaped like a curved tire tread arch, with blocky ridged tread pieces over the left shoulder and a small perforated pointed plate hanging off the outer edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Tire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tread blocks; colour 3 as splatter markings across the tread; colour 1 on the hanging perforated plate.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Tire_02.description: A chunky left shoulder pad shaped like a curved segment of tyre tread: a hollow arch of blocky ridged tread that caps the shoulder. Rugged, mechanical, post-apocalyptic look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Tire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tread blocks and surface; colour 3 on the splattered markings across the top and sides; colour 1 on the shaded side and underside faces.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Toy_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a shield-like padded panel with a pointed lower edge and a raised rim, topped by a round dome button in a contrasting socket. Retro toy-robot styling.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main padded panel; colour 0 on the raised rim edging; colour 2 on the socket ring and underside; colour 3 on the dome button.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Toy_01.differs: The female pad is a shorter, more rounded half-dome cap that sits closer to the shoulder, with a semicircular underside.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Victory_01.description: A curved, fin-like shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a swept, pointed shell with a raised rim, an inner panel, layered contrasting trim stripes and a round pivot joint at the front. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the large inner panel; colour 3 on the upper trim stripe; colour 1 on the lower trim stripe.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A mechanical single shoulder piece: a flat angular frame with forked, hooked prongs rising and dropping around the shoulder, holding a swept fin-like plate at the front. Sits on the left shoulder in a sci-fi style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the frame and prongs; colour 0 on the swept plate; colour 3 on the thin lines along the plate; colour 2 on the small slots and panel marks.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Vine_01.description: A left shoulder piece of curling, tentacle-like vine tendrils that fan out from a swirl-etched base, ending in sharp curved tips. It sits on top of the shoulder and sweeps outward and down, with an organic, fantastical look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine body; colour 0 on the swirl patterns and raised centre highlights; colour 3 on the pointed tips and the streaks along the tendrils.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Viper_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder: a segmented shell of vertical bands with thin contrasting piping, arching over the top of the arm like a compact pauldron cap.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light bands of the plate; colour 1 on the central raised panel; colour 3 on the thin piping between bands; colour 2 on the outer rounded end and inner edge.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Viper_01.differs: The female plate is narrower and sits more upright on the shoulder, with vertical bands running top to bottom.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A chunky mechanical shoulder pad: a rounded, vented shell with a gaping intake mouth and layered angular outer bands, two round knobs on the front and thin stripes along the top. Sits on the left shoulder in a sci-fi style.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and lower jaw plate; colour 1 on the outer angular bands and edge trim; colour 2 on the knobs, intake interior and top stripes; colour 3 on the thin stripes on the front and top.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Wildfur_01.description: A left shoulder piece of layered, feathery fur tufts that form a wedge shape over the shoulder and upper arm. Each tuft ends in a swept, pointed tip, and the piece has a rough, wild look.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Wildfur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur tufts; colour 1 on the accent streaks within the layers; colour 2 on the darkened pointed tips.

Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Wolf_01.description: A left shoulder cap made of two stacked, overlapping curved plates with raised rims and etched swirl patterns. It sits over the top of the shoulder, with a hollow underside and a slight flare at the edges.
Female/F_Spadl_Tight_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper plate; colour 3 on the rims and edge trim; colour 0 on the lower plate; colour 2 on the etched swirl details.

Female/F_Spadl_Toxicsteel_01.description: A small rounded, domed shoulder cap for the left shoulder, made of padded plates with a pentagonal inset panel on top, thin contrasting piping lines and two small rectangular studs on the sides. It suggests a mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Spadl_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 0 on the pentagon panel, piping and small side studs; colour 2 on the outline and seam lines around the panel.

Female/F_Spadl_Traveler_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder, made of soft padded cloth with a layered flap over a lower panel, contrasting piped edging and a small snap button at each end. Suggests a casual traveller's jacket.
Female/F_Spadl_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper flap; colour 1 on the lower panel; colour 2 on the piped edging; colour 3 on the snap buttons.

Female/F_Spadl_Warrior_01.description: A partial left shoulder guard made of two overlapping angular plates with ribbed, segmented faces and rounded inset panels, edged in raised trim. Two thin straps with small rings wrap the upper arm to hold it.
Female/F_Spadl_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed plate faces; colour 1 on the rounded inset panels; colour 3 on the raised edge trim, rings and the back of the plates; colour 2 on the straps.

Female/F_Spadl_Warrior_02.description: A small curved shoulder panel that wraps the outer upper arm like a short cuff, with a smooth plain inner face and repeating horizontal stripe bands on the outside. Suggests a casual or mechanical-uniform shoulder patch.
Female/F_Spadl_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel body and the wide bands between stripes; colour 1 on the upper and middle stripes; colour 2 on the stripes; colour 3 on the stripes.

Female/F_Spadl_Wires_01.description: A small left shoulder guard of angular plates: a curved padded slab on top of the shoulder over a jagged, notched plate that wraps the upper arm, with a contrasting lower edge and two small round studs.
Female/F_Spadl_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top padded slab; colour 0 on the jagged plates; colour 2 on the lower edge; colour 3 on the round studs.
Female/F_Spadl_Wires_01.differs: The female version is a slimmer guard, with a thinner top slab and more open, spiky plates that reach further down the arm.

Female/F_Spadr_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A right shoulder pad with a tall, angular blade-like fin rising well above the shoulder, mounted on a rounded mechanical cap with a glowing-style vent panel and small side cannon nub. Sci-fi armoured look.
Female/F_Spadr_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tall fin; colour 0 on the fin tip; colour 1 on the shoulder cap housing; colour 3 on the vent panels and fin slit.
Female/F_Spadr_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The female fin is mostly contrasting and stands nearly upright, with the cap sitting lower and rounder on the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.description: A right shoulder guard sculpted as a snarling beast head with wrinkled muzzle, small fangs and glowing eyes, hollow behind and edged with a raised contrasting rim; sits over the shoulder cap.
Female/F_Spadr_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sculpted head, which shows as glossy metal; colour 1 on the rim and inner shell; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Anniversary_Destroyer_02.description: A right shoulder guard sculpted as a snarling beast face with a wrinkled brow, deep-set eyes and small spikes at the muzzle. A hollow, flared rim edges the back, and it caps the shoulder like a pauldron.
Female/F_Spadr_Anniversary_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised rim and the inner shell; colour 2 on the sculpted face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 0 on the small spikes.

Female/F_Spadr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single right shoulder pauldron: a smooth, rounded, hollow metal dome that caps the shoulder, with a thin contrasting rim along its open edge and a slightly angular, faceted outline. Retro robot styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the pauldron; colour 1 on the thin rim around the edge and the inner lining. The glossy metal shading mutes the scheme.

Female/F_Spadr_Aquatic_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron shaped like a curved shield, made of three segmented armor panels inside a raised rim, with three swept-back curved spikes along the top ridge. Sits on top of the shoulder; suits a sci-fi or aquatic-themed look.
Female/F_Spadr_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer panel and the spikes; colour 1 on the middle panel; colour 3 on the inner panel; colour 2 on the rim.

Female/F_Spadr_Aquatic_02.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved, shell-like cap with a thick rim, layered fin-like plates on top and small square gem inserts at the front and back edges. It sits over the shoulder in a sleek sci-fi style.
Female/F_Spadr_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the layered upper plates; colour 1 on the curved centre fin panel; colour 2 on the outer rim and underside; colour 3 on the square inserts.

Female/F_Spadr_Balloon_Toy_01.description: A small twisted balloon-animal dog perched on the right shoulder, built from glossy sausage-shaped segments: a head with two upright ears, a rounded body, a tiny tail and four stubby legs draped over the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Balloon_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, neck and body segments; colour 1 on the legs; colour 2 on one ear; colour 3 on the tail and the other ear. The glossy balloon finish gives a shiny look.
Female/F_Spadr_Balloon_Toy_01.differs: The female balloon dog sits more upright, with its legs hanging down the front and back of the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Bounty_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved, hollow cap with a thick rounded rim that wraps over the top of the shoulder, with inset angled panels on the outer face and a tall central panel on top.
Female/F_Spadr_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the upper inset panels; colour 0 on the lower inset panels; colour 3 on the central top panel.
Female/F_Spadr_Bounty_01.differs: The female pad is smaller and sits tighter on the shoulder, with the contrasting panel on the top strip and the shell more closed at the front.

Female/F_Spadr_Buzzsaw_01.description: Three toothed circular saw blades floating in a stacked cluster around the right shoulder, each with a raised central hub, a ring of small studs and notched edges. A mechanical, sci-fi shoulder ornament.
Female/F_Spadr_Buzzsaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade faces and hub rings; colour 1 on the blade rims and edge trim; colour 2 on the blade faces and central rings; colour 3 on the small dots around each blade.

Female/F_Spadr_Buzzsaw_02.description: A right shoulder ornament of three toothed circular saw blades floating in a loose cluster over the shoulder and upper arm, each with a central disc and a star-shaped hub. Industrial, mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Spadr_Buzzsaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toothed blade rims; colour 1 on the blade discs; colour 3 on the star-shaped hubs; colour 2 on the shaded underside of the lowest blade.
Female/F_Spadr_Buzzsaw_02.differs: The three blades are set in a tighter, more vertical stack, with one blade tilted lower and further out from the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Buzzsaw_03.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades floating around the right shoulder, each with a hollow centre, an inner ring of contrasting panel and small studs. They are set at different angles for a mechanical, industrial look.
Female/F_Spadr_Buzzsaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade teeth and outer discs; colour 1 on the inner ring panels; colour 3 on the small studs around the rings; colour 2 on the darker shaded blade faces and centres.

Female/F_Spadr_Cannonarm_01.description: A large shoulder-mounted laser cannon carried upright behind the right shoulder: a sleek, angular casing with a tapered rear housing, a multi-barrel muzzle pointing up and trim rails along the sides. Sci-fi heavy weapon style.
Female/F_Spadr_Cannonarm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing; colour 1 on the side rails and barrel housings; colour 2 on the rear vents and inner mechanism; colour 3 on small accents at the muzzle tips.
Female/F_Spadr_Cannonarm_01.differs: The female cannon sits more upright and is shorter, rising close to the shoulder and head rather than angling far back across the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Cat_01.description: A small sculpted cat sitting upright on the right shoulder, facing forward with pointed ears and a long tail curling down behind. A whimsical pet-style shoulder accessory.
Female/F_Spadr_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cat's body and tail; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Chicken_01.description: A novelty rubber chicken draped over the right shoulder like a limp scarf, with its plump body on the back, legs dangling down the shoulder blade and a head with a beak, comb and eye hanging over the front.
Female/F_Spadr_Chicken_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chicken body; colour 3 on the feet, legs, beak and wattle; colour 2 on the comb; colour 1 on the eye.
Female/F_Spadr_Chicken_01.differs: The female chicken is slightly smaller and its head hangs lower on the front of the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Aquatic_01.description: A row of three curved, fin-like spikes in graduated sizes, swept backward and set in a line along the top of the right shoulder. Suggests aquatic or shark-fin styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three fins; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Aquatic_01.differs: The female fins are set slightly further back and sit more spread along the top of the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Draco_01.description: A spiky right shoulder guard of layered angular blades, with a long curved horn sweeping up and back from the shoulder and jagged serrated fins along the top. Suggests a dragon-like armoured fantasy look.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main serrated blade plates and fins; colour 2 on the long curved horn and underside blades.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Future_01.description: A mechanical shoulder accessory: a thick octagonal ring with a recessed inner core, flanked by a long tapered spike behind and a swept fin with a cut-out hole in front. It floats at the right shoulder, standing edge-on.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ring; colour 1 on the spike and the swept fin; colour 3 on the inner core of the ring.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Future_02.description: A small curved blade-like shoulder accessory: a narrow hooked arc of smooth metal that arches over the top of the right shoulder and ends in two pointed barbs at the front and back. Futuristic and sleek.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Future_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole arc; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Punk_01.description: A small cluster of four tapered conical spikes of varied length, fanned out from the top of the right shoulder near the neck. Sharp, aggressive accent in a punk sci-fi style.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all of the spikes; the spikes are the only visible part of the piece.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Punk_01.differs: The female version has four spikes, two of them angled forward and two upright, while the male version has two thin and two larger spikes with a different spread.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A scattering of separate cone-shaped spikes floating around the right shoulder and upper arm: a larger cluster of long spikes pointing outward and back over the shoulder, and a few smaller spikes lower down the arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large shoulder spikes; colour 2 on the smaller spikes lower on the upper arm.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.description: A narrow strap band wrapped around the upper right arm, with overlapping strap ends fastened through hexagonal buckle loops and a raised rim along the edge. A simple, sleek sci-fi armband accessory.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band and its rim; colour 1 on the hexagonal buckle loops.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Steelarachnid_01.description: A single angular, mechanical shoulder blade: a faceted, bent metal spike that runs out from a small round socket cap and curves upward to a sharp point, floating beside the shoulder like an arachnid leg.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted blade; colour 2 on the round socket cap; colour 1 on the small stripe on the cap.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Tactical_01.description: A small flat atom-style emblem on the outer right shoulder: three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central ring, with a thin raised outline. It lies flush against the sleeve as a decorative badge.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the emblem rings and their outline; the rest of the emblem shows little separate colour.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring, lying flush on top of the right shoulder like a decal. Sci-fi, superhero look, thin and outlined.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main orbit bands; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the bands.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.differs: The female emblem is a clean single atom symbol, with no extra detached fragments beside it.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A bone-like shoulder spine for the right shoulder: a segmented central ridge with long curved blade-like spikes sweeping outward, shorter contrasting hooked claws on top, and small tooth-like spikes trailing down the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented ridge and the small tooth spikes; colour 1 on the long curved spikes; colour 2 on the short hooked claws on top.

Female/F_Spadr_Child_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A ring-shaped shoulder fringe of many jagged, spiky fur-like tufts that encircles the right shoulder, leaving the centre open. It has a rough, feral look and suits brutal or monstrous designs.
Female/F_Spadr_Child_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all the spiky tufts; no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Spadr_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A chunky angular mechanical pauldron for the right shoulder: a domed, faceted shell with a raised curved fin at the front, a hollow inner cavity, and a layered lower rim band. Suggests sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Spadr_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and raised fin; colour 3 on the angular inset panels and lower rim accents; colour 2 on the front block and rear inner cap; colour 0 on the lower rim band and inner cavity.

Female/F_Spadr_Corrupted_01.description: A right shoulder piece shaped like a bat wing: a domed cap with ribbed, scalloped edges, a long pointed membrane sweeping down over the upper arm, and curved horn spikes rising from the top.
Female/F_Spadr_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed cap plates; colour 1 on the underlying wing membrane and edge; colour 3 on the curved horn spikes.

Female/F_Spadr_Cosmic_01.description: A single right shoulder pad shaped like a curved, tapering shield that caps the shoulder. Angular raised panels and a square cut-out pattern sit on top, with segmented edge trim and a hollow underside. Sci-fi, superhero style.
Female/F_Spadr_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised top panels and outer edge; colour 2 on the recessed segments and inner panels; colour 0 on the underside lining.

Female/F_Spadr_Cosmos_01.description: A single angular metal shoulder guard with a swept, pointed back and layered ridged plates over the top of the shoulder. It has a hollow inner lining and sits on the right shoulder, with a sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plates and raised edge trim; colour 1 on the inner lining and lower tab; colour 2 on the recessed grooves between plates.

Female/F_Spadr_Cosmos_02.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a curved horn: a shallow shell over the shoulder that sweeps up into a sharp crescent point beside the neck, with a rim edge and a contrasting strip along the inner side.
Female/F_Spadr_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell surface; colour 1 on the strip along the inner edge; colour 2 on the outer rim and underside.
Female/F_Spadr_Cosmos_02.differs: The female version has a metallic, glossy finish on the shell and rim, where the male version's rim and underside are matte.

Female/F_Spadr_Crimson_01.description: A right shoulder guard styled as a horned dragon head, with jagged flame-like spikes and a snarling snout at the front, set on a broad curved plate with a patterned lower panel and a rimmed edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the dragon head, spikes and outer rim; colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the patterned lower panel; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Cryo_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the right shoulder, with a layered plate and a contrasting angular panel on top. A thick arched band with short tubular nozzles at both ends spans over it, giving a mechanical, cryo-tech look.
Female/F_Spadr_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the angular top panel; colour 2 on the arched band; colour 3 on the nozzle tips.
Female/F_Spadr_Cryo_01.differs: The arched band sits narrower and more upright on the shoulder, with a smaller plate.

Female/F_Spadr_Defender_Update_01.description: A rounded, shell-like mechanical shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a hollow cup open on the inner side, with stacked angular plates and segments on the outer face, plus a small round port. Suggests a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Spadr_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer shell; colour 1 on the upper and lower angled plates; colour 2 on the inset panels between plates; colour 3 on the thin accent stripe.

Female/F_Spadr_Dog_01.description: A small figurine-like puppy lying on the shoulder, with upright pointed ears, a long tail hanging down the back, paws draped over the front, and a bow tie at its neck. Cute, playful companion piece.
Female/F_Spadr_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the dog's body; colour 0 on the inner ears, muzzle patch and paws; colour 2 on the bow tie; colour 3 on the eyes and bow tie centre.

Female/F_Spadr_Draco_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved plate capping the shoulder with a contrasting edge, topped by a sweeping crest of sharp, swept-back spikes and a long curved horn-like blade that rises above and behind the shoulder. Dragon-themed armour.
Female/F_Spadr_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate surface; colour 1 on the plate edge trim; colour 3 on the inner crest spikes; colour 2 on the long curved blade and outer spikes.

Female/F_Spadr_Dragon_01.description: A small winged dragon figurine perched on the right shoulder, with a long tail hanging down the upper arm, spread bat-like wings, horns and spines along the back. Fantasy pet-companion style.
Female/F_Spadr_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dragon's body, wings and tail; colour 1 on the horns and wing tips; colour 2 on the wing membranes and chest underbelly panels; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Dryad_01.description: A right shoulder piece of twisting, root-like branches woven over a shallow curved shell. Tangled tendrils sweep outward and one horn-like twig rises above the shoulder. Organic fantasy look.
Female/F_Spadr_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the branches and tendrils; colour 0 on the inner shell and its rim; colour 1 on the spots showing through the shell.

Female/F_Spadr_Dryad_02.description: A single right shoulder piece: a smooth curved cap sweeping over the shoulder, with a lattice of organic, vine-like openwork on the outer side and a thick framing rim with a small upward prong. Suggests a nature-guardian look.
Female/F_Spadr_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth shoulder cap; colour 1 on the openwork lattice; colour 2 on the framing rim and prong.

Female/F_Spadr_Element_Fire_01.description: A right shoulder accessory shaped like swept, rippling flames: glossy, curling tongues stretch from the front of the shoulder over the top to the back, ending in sharp pointed tips. It sits on top of the shoulder rather than wrapping the arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; a little colour 1 shows in the recesses of the flame folds and a hint of colour 3 near the front tip.

Female/F_Spadr_Element_Fire_02.description: A right shoulder piece of glossy, swirling flame-like shapes: jagged ragged tongues fan out over the shoulder, with one long curled tip sweeping up toward the neck and another tapering down the front of the arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: Glossy reflective default material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly in some swirls and colour 3 faintly on the underside of the front tongue; the rest is glossy.
Female/F_Spadr_Element_Fire_02.differs: The female piece sweeps its long curled tip forward toward the neck and its lower tongue points down the front of the arm, while the male version sits more compactly on top of the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_F_Variablerobot_01.description: A boxy mechanical shoulder pad that arches over the right shoulder like an inverted U, with a chunky angular outer block, two round dial fittings on the front face and a slatted vent grille beside them.
Female/F_Spadr_F_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and the front block with the round dials; colour 2 on the inner arch and rear slab; colour 3 on the vent slats.

Female/F_Spadr_Falcon_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a falcon head with swept feather crests, a hooked beak and a glaring eye, set on a curved plate rim studded with small diamond-shaped spikes. Sits on top of the shoulder in a fantasy-superhero style.
Female/F_Spadr_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathered head and the main plate; colour 1 on the beak and the raised rim edging and studs; colour 2 on the feather slots; colour 3 on the eye.

Female/F_Spadr_Firebird_01.description: A single angular shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a flared, faceted outer shell with pointed edges surrounds a raised inner cap with a swept crest, and a small spiky fin sits at the front edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer angular shell and front spikes; colour 1 on the raised inner cap; colour 2 on the inner lining beneath the cap.
Female/F_Spadr_Firebird_01.differs: The female version has the front spikes set slightly apart from the main shell, and the shell is smaller and lower on the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Frigid_01.description: A single right shoulder pauldron of layered curved plates with slim contrasting edging, topped by a cluster of long swept-back blade-like spikes rising from the outer shoulder. Sleek, angular sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate surfaces; colour 2 on the inner plate and the edge trim; colour 1 on the blade-like spikes.
Female/F_Spadr_Frigid_01.differs: The female version's spikes are a little shorter and the inner contrasting plate is smaller, curving less over the shoulder top.

Female/F_Spadr_Future_01.description: A single right shoulder piece: a small rounded cap with a long finned spar rising from it, a ringed turbine-like disc at the tip with a spike, and curved pincer-like hooks at the front. Sci-fi and mechanical.
Female/F_Spadr_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring housing and curved hooks; colour 1 on the shoulder cap, spike and fins; colour 3 on the inner ring.
Female/F_Spadr_Future_01.differs: The female shoulder cap is smaller and sits tighter on the shoulder, so the spar and hooks stand out more.

Female/F_Spadr_Gearbreak_01.description: A curved, shield-like mechanical shoulder plate that wraps the outside of the right shoulder and upper arm, edged with a thick contrasting rim. A boxy module with a clasp is mounted on the outer face, with small octagonal fittings at the sides.
Female/F_Spadr_Gearbreak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main curved plate; colour 2 on the rim and the boxy module; colour 1 on the clasp and the octagonal side fittings.

Female/F_Spadr_Gladiator_02.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a flared, curved plate that sweeps over the shoulder, with a raised outer edge and pointed tails trailing down the front and back. It has a translucent glassy look.
Female/F_Spadr_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: The default material ignores the colour scheme and appears glassy and translucent; no slot is clearly visible on the plate.
Female/F_Spadr_Gladiator_02.differs: The female version renders as a translucent glassy plate with no visible contrasting inner panel, unlike the male's two-part shell.

Female/F_Spadr_Heraldry_01.description: A domed right shoulder pauldron with a rolled contrasting edge, a rivet at the front, a hollow inner lining that flares upward, and two stacked overlapping lames layered below the dome over the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome; colour 3 on the inner lining; colour 1 on the stacked lower lames; colour 2 on the rim edging and underside.
Female/F_Spadr_Heraldry_01.differs: The female pauldron's lower lames are angled and hang lower, with a more pointed tip at the front.

Female/F_Spadr_Hybrid_01.description: A right shoulder pad shaped like a domed shell with a contrasting rounded outer rim, a paneled inner surface, a contrasting eye-like gem in the side and several curved spikes sticking out; sits over the shoulder cap with a lower skirt edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell panels and lower skirt edge; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 2 on the outer rim and edge plating; colour 3 on the eye-like gem.

Female/F_Spadr_Ice_01.description: A shoulder piece made of a jagged cluster of glossy, faceted shards that pile over the right shoulder, with a long pointed shard sweeping forward and smaller spikes hanging down the upper arm. Suggests a crystalline, fantasy look.
Female/F_Spadr_Ice_01.colourAreas: The glossy faceted material largely ignores the scheme; hints of colour 1 show on a few shard facets, while the rest reflects and light.

Female/F_Spadr_Ice_02.description: A right shoulder piece made of clustered, jagged faceted shards that pile over the top of the shoulder and trail down the upper arm in a tapering cascade. Glossy and angular, it suits an icy or crystalline fantasy look.
Female/F_Spadr_Ice_02.colourAreas: The glossy shard material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly as a tint on some facets, with the rest reflecting as a near-sheen.

Female/F_Spadr_Insect_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered, insect-like shell plates: a glossy domed cap studded with sharp spikes, over a swept pointed outer plate and curved lower lobes that wrap the top of the arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed top cap; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 0 on the swept outer plate and rim; colour 1 on the lower lobes and inner accents.

Female/F_Spadr_Jaggedhorns_01.description: A large segmented curling horn rising from the right shoulder, sweeping up and around behind the head. Ridged plated bands with contrasting seams taper to a hooked tip, with a small second spike at the base.
Female/F_Spadr_Jaggedhorns_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main segmented horn body; colour 2 on the seam lines between segments; colour 1 on the band near the base and the tip's upper section; colour 3 on the tapering tips.

Female/F_Spadr_Kaiju_01.description: A small right shoulder cap: a curved, open-bottomed shell with a slightly pitted surface, studded with contrasting conical spikes and a cluster of longer swept-back horns along its edges. Gives an aggressive, monstrous look.
Female/F_Spadr_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shell; colour 2 on the spikes and horns.

Female/F_Spadr_Kitten_01.description: A small figurine-like kitten perched on the right shoulder, crouched with front paws draped over the front of the shoulder and a long tail hanging down the back. Cute, playful pet accessory.
Female/F_Spadr_Kitten_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole kitten body, ears, paws and tail; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Kitten_Toy_01.description: A small toy cat figure lying sprawled across the top of the right shoulder, with a rounded head, pointed ears, a simple stitched face, stubby dangling legs with paw pads and a thin tail trailing down the back. Cute and playful.
Female/F_Spadr_Kitten_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, head, ears, legs and tail; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the whisker marks; colour 1 on the paw pads.

Female/F_Spadr_Lockbox_65_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a smooth domed pauldron with a snarling dragon-head crest of spiky fins on top and tasselled cords hanging from the front edge. East-asian martial-arts styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed shoulder plate and tassels; colour 1 on the dragon head crest; colour 0 on the spiky fins, plate rim and head accents; colour 3 on the eyes and cord beads.
Female/F_Spadr_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The female dragon head is smaller and more tangled with jagged fins, sitting further forward on the shoulder, with a less clearly defined face.

Female/F_Spadr_Lockbox_65_02.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a horned dragon or beast head, with curved horns, a swept back plate, an inset diamond gem eye and a ragged fur-like fringe hanging around the lower edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell, horns and back plate; colour 1 on the swirling markings; colour 3 on the diamond gem eye; colour 2 on the fringe. The glossy finish makes the colours look darker and reflective.

Female/F_Spadr_Lockbox_66_01.description: A curved, sci-fi shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a glossy rimmed shell with a broad central plate, a hexagonal light-like stud, a segmented strip along one edge and angular flanges at the front and back.
Female/F_Spadr_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shell rim and flanges; colour 0 on the central plate; colour 1 on the segmented edge strip; colour 3 on the hexagonal stud.

Female/F_Spadr_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A right shoulder guard of swooping, curled plates that sweep over the shoulder and around a recessed hollow, with a sculpted snarling beast head set in the centre. Suggests a mechanical, armoured villain look.
Female/F_Spadr_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swirled shoulder plates; colour 1 on the beast head; colour 3 on its eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A single right pauldron shaped like a domed, hooded shell with a raised rim at the back and a stylised bird-head face on the outer side. Flame-like swooping panels and a round ring fitting sit on the lower edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, rim and bird face; colour 1 on the inner lining and the panels beneath the face; colour 2 on the lower edge trim; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a smooth, shallow hooded shell with a raised band across its top and a thick contrasting edge rim. Sleek and modern, in a superhero style.
Female/F_Spadr_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the band across the top; colour 2 on the edge rim and underside.

Female/F_Spadr_Moth_01.description: A single right shoulder cap: a smooth, rounded shell that curves over the top of the shoulder and upper arm, with a thin contrasting rim along the open inner edge. Suggests a soft organic or mechanical shoulder guard.
Female/F_Spadr_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 1 as a gradient toward the top of the shell; colour 0 on the thin rim edge.

Female/F_Spadr_Patriotcelebration_2025_0.description: A right shoulder pauldron shaped as a hollow curved dome, with a smooth rim and alternating raised vertical bands that step down over the upper arm. Small round studs sit on the front and back corners of the rim.
Female/F_Spadr_Patriotcelebration_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and edge frame; colour 1 on alternating vertical bands; colour 2 on the other bands and inner shell; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Spadr_Patriotcelebration_2025_0.description: A right shoulder pauldron shaped like an eagle's head and wing: a domed cap with a curved beak-like crest, a band of contrasting segmented plates, metal edge plates with small studs, and a fringe of feather-like strips hanging over the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Patriotcelebration_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal edge plates, claw-like spikes and back plate; colour 1 on the crest cap and the hanging fringe strips; colour 2 on the segmented band plates; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Spadr_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A right shoulder ornament of jagged, faceted spikes and claw-like talons fanned out over the top of the shoulder, with a taller blade-like fin at the back. Suggests a stylised dragon crest.
Female/F_Spadr_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole spiky shoulder piece; the glossy material shows little of the other slots.

Female/F_Spadr_Qularr_Spines_01.description: A cluster of thin, jointed insect-like spines sprouting from the right shoulder, each with a thick base segment tapering to a fine hooked tip. They sweep outward and back in two groups, giving an alien, arachnid look.
Female/F_Spadr_Qularr_Spines_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main spine segments; colour 0 on the rounded base joints; colour 2 on the spine tips; colour 3 on the very ends of the tips.
Female/F_Spadr_Qularr_Spines_01.differs: The female spines form two fairly distinct clusters, one on the top of the shoulder and one lower on the upper arm.

Female/F_Spadr_Raven_01.description: A realistic raven perched on the right shoulder, with textured feathers, a long tapering tail, a stout curved beak and thin clawed legs gripping the shoulder. Sits beside the neck and faces forward.
