Female/F_Spadr_Raven_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feathered body and head; colour 3 on the beak; colour 2 on the legs and claws.

Female/F_Spadr_Ravenswood_01.description: A single right shoulder piece: a flat, swept-back panel that points outward past the shoulder, with a separate folded-over strip along the neck side. It sits on top of the shoulder like a stiff jacket collar or epaulette.
Female/F_Spadr_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main swept shoulder panel; colour 1 on the folded strip along the neck edge.

Female/F_Spadr_Reindeer_Toy_01.description: A small plush toy reindeer perched on the right shoulder, lying with its legs tucked under it. It has a rounded body and head, branching antlers, a round nose, a wrapped neck scarf and small ears. Festive and cute.
Female/F_Spadr_Reindeer_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body and head; colour 1 on the neck scarf and inner ear and tail tufts; colour 2 on the antlers and hooves; colour 3 on the nose and eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Renegade_Punk_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron of angular, segmented plates with cracked panel texture and contrasting edge trim, topped by a row of tall cone spikes, with a contrasting underplate and open inner side. Punk sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Spadr_Renegade_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the edge trim and inner lining; colour 2 on the underplate; colour 3 on the spikes.
Female/F_Spadr_Renegade_Punk_01.differs: The female version carries four spikes in a tight cluster at the front, with a smaller extra spike near the rear.

Female/F_Spadr_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A right shoulder guard: a rounded, cap-like upper plate with a raised open front edge and large conical spikes, over a segmented mechanical upper-arm cuff with small spikes and a buckled strap. Sci-fi punk look.
Female/F_Spadr_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shoulder cap; colour 3 on the large spikes and inner trim lines; colour 0 on the arm cuff plates and strap; colour 2 on the small cuff spikes.

Female/F_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A compact angular shoulder pauldron: a hollow, arched metal shell with a faceted lower edge and a raised stepped cap panel on top, sitting over the right shoulder. Suggests retro sci-fi armour.
Female/F_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised top cap panel; colour 0 on the faceted lower shell; colour 2 on the inner lining and underside edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The female pauldron is smaller and sits higher, with a more upright, boxy shell that covers less of the upper arm.

Female/F_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_02.description: A boxy mechanical missile launcher block mounted above the right shoulder, with six round barrel openings on its front face and a ribbed flexible hose curving down toward the chest. Retro sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing; colour 1 on the front face plate holding the barrel openings; colour 2 on the barrel openings; colour 3 on the ribbed hose.

Female/F_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_03.description: A boxy missile launcher pod floating at the right shoulder, with six round barrel openings on its front face and a ribbed flexible hose curling down from the back over the shoulder blade. Retro sci-fi mechanical styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the launcher casing; colour 1 on the front face frame and edge trim; colour 2 on the barrel openings and hose connector; colour 3 on the ribbed hose.

Female/F_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved, plate-like cap with a raised, flared front edge, an angular pointed rear, and a rolled contrasting lower rim. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm in a retro mechanical style.
Female/F_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main outer plate; colour 0 on the front edge trim and the rear angular panel; colour 1 on the lower rim.

Female/F_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_02.description: A single right-shoulder plate: a curved, hooded shell with a flared, pointed front lip and a rim of contrasting trim, set over a separate lower band at the upper arm. Retro mechanical armour look.
Female/F_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the raised front rim and the back-facing outer panel; colour 1 on the lower band around the arm.

Female/F_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.description: A tapered, wedge-shaped shoulder vent for the right shoulder: a smooth hard shell with a framed front opening of angled louvre slats, and a smaller slotted vent at the back. Retro mechanical, sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and frame; colour 1 on the louvre slats and the back vent bars; colour 3 on the recessed interior behind the slats; colour 2 on the inner shadowed panels.
Female/F_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.differs: The female version is narrower and ends in a notched, pointed lower edge at the back, with a longer, more tapering front vent.

Female/F_Spadr_Rockcrystal_01.description: A right shoulder pad made of a cluster of chunky, faceted rock slabs veined with cracks, with a pointed crystal spike on top and a jagged shard trailing outward; it sits on top of the shoulder as a rugged fantasy pauldron.
Female/F_Spadr_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the crack veins between the slabs; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Spadr_Rubber_Duck_01.description: A small novelty rubber duck figure perched on the right shoulder, with a rounded body, small tail bump, round head and a flared open beak with small eyes. Playful, cute and toy-like.
Female/F_Spadr_Rubber_Duck_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the duck's body and head; colour 1 on the beak; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Sandstorm_01.description: A loose, open-ended cloth sleeve tube worn over the right shoulder like a draped cowl, with crumpled folds and a rolled upper rim. It covers only the shoulder and upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and inner fabric; colour 1 on the lower outer band of the sleeve; colour 2 on the shadowed hem edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Sandstorm_01.differs: The female shoulder wrap is shorter and sits lower on the arm, with a flatter, more crumpled opening.

Female/F_Spadr_Sandstorm_02.description: A compact, angular armoured shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a faceted cup-shaped plate with an inset lining, a short collar band below, and a small tab at the bottom. Sci-fi, mechanical styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plates; colour 1 on the inner lining and the band under the plate; colour 3 on the small tab at the bottom; colour 2 on the inner strap ring.
Female/F_Spadr_Sandstorm_02.differs: The female version is smaller and sits tighter on the shoulder, with a less open strap ring visible at the front.

Female/F_Spadr_Sandstorm_Alt_01.description: A short, soft cloth shoulder wrap forming an open cowl-like tube that sits over the right shoulder, with rumpled folds and a rolled upper edge; casual superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Sandstorm_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rolled edge and inner lining; colour 1 on the lower band of the wrap.

Female/F_Spadr_Scarab_01.description: A domed, smooth shoulder cap that sits over the right shoulder, with a single swept-back spike on top, a contrasting rolled rim along the inner edge, and curved talon-like tips at the front and back.
Female/F_Spadr_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and spike; colour 1 on the rolled inner rim; colour 2 on the lower edge band; colour 3 on the talon tips.

Female/F_Spadr_Scarab_02.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered curved plates with pointed edges and glossy inset hollows, topped by a separate swept fin-like plate that flares upward. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm, with a mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Spadr_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pauldron plates; colour 1 on the swept upper fin plate and the edge trim beneath; colour 2 on the glossy inset hollows.
Female/F_Spadr_Scarab_02.differs: The female pauldron is smaller and sits higher, with the upper fin plate flaring outward more separately from the shell.

Female/F_Spadr_Shiba_Toy_01.description: A small plush toy dog lying on its belly across the right shoulder, with a rounded stuffed body, pointed ears, stubby paws, a curled tail and simple stitched face details. Cute and playful.
Female/F_Spadr_Shiba_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body, ears and tail; colour 1 on the muzzle and chest, ear insides, paws, back patch and tail tip; colour 2 on the nose; colour 3 on the eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A mechanical right shoulder pauldron of layered angular plates that cups the shoulder, with a hollow ring opening on the outer side, a stepped upper crest and a small accent panel. Sci-fi pharaoh-inspired armour.
Female/F_Spadr_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower rim and outer edge plates; colour 1 on the main shell and inner ring; colour 2 on the upper crest and under-plates; colour 3 on the small accent panels.

Female/F_Spadr_Splendor_01.description: A right shoulder piece of layered, swooping pointed plates that curve over the shoulder like a stylised wing, with a smooth inner panel and a teardrop inlay. Sleek superhero styling with sharp upswept tips.
Female/F_Spadr_Splendor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large inner panel; colour 1 on the teardrop inlay; colour 2 on the inner stripe; colour 3 on the outer layered plates and edging.

Female/F_Spadr_Spooky_01.description: A small angular shoulder guard on the right shoulder: a rounded, faceted cap with a slit-shaped cutout on the outer side, and stacked pointed plates tapering down the upper arm like a spike. Sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and the lower pointed plates; colour 3 on the inner slit accent; colour 2 on the cutout opening.

Female/F_Spadr_Starhawk_01.description: A thin, open metal shoulder band for the right shoulder: an angular, jagged ring that wraps around the top of the arm and rises into pointed, zigzag prongs at the front and back. It leaves the shoulder mostly bare.
Female/F_Spadr_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; no other colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Spadr_Starhawk_01.differs: The female band has broader, more upright prongs at the front and back. The male band is a lower, more sharply zigzagged ring.

Female/F_Spadr_Starhawk_02.description: A slim curved shoulder band that arcs around the upper right arm, with angular fin-like blades rising at both ends and a contrasting central strip. Sleek, sci-fi styling that sits on the outer shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upturned end blades and outer edges; colour 1 on the main curved band; colour 2 on the inset section; colour 3 on a small accent under the band.

Female/F_Spadr_Steampunk_01.description: A chunky mechanical shoulder pad: a round rivetted disc ring carrying several boxy, faceted armour blocks with small inset windows, seated over a curved inner cuff piece at the shoulder. Steampunk sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted blocks and outer disc ring; colour 1 on the inner cuff housing and side clamps; colour 3 on the inner lining panel; colour 2 on the rivets and window insets.

Female/F_Spadr_Steelarachnid_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron of angular segmented plates with jagged pointed edges and a rim, topped by a tall curved horn-like spike and a small round cap. Sits over the shoulder in a sci-fi mechanical style.
Female/F_Spadr_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the inset stripes; colour 2 on the edge rim, the horn and the top cap; colour 3 on the small round studs.

Female/F_Spadr_Steelcommando_01.description: A domed, hollow shoulder cap that covers the top of the right shoulder and upper arm, made of segmented curved plates with raised seam lines and a slightly flared open rim. It suggests retro mechanical armor.
Female/F_Spadr_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer plates and raised seams; colour 2 on the hollow inner lining.

Female/F_Spadr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A single right shoulder pad: a smooth, curved, hollow shell that caps the shoulder with faceted, slightly angular edges and an open inner side. It has a retro superhero look and no visible straps or extra parts.
Female/F_Spadr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 0 on the rim edge. The glossy metal finish mutes the scheme.

Female/F_Spadr_Tactical_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the right upper arm, with a raised rim around a recessed panel bearing an atom emblem. The plate is open and unlined behind, a superhero or tactical patch-style pad.
Female/F_Spadr_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and outer plate; colour 1 on the recessed panel; the atom emblem takes a light colour matching the rim.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_90s_Bullets_01.description: A right shoulder pad shaped as a rounded, padded cushion arching over the shoulder, with layered bordered panels on top carrying a row of small bullet-like cartridges and a vertical strap with a buckle plate at the front and back.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_90s_Bullets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted padding and cartridge casings; colour 1 on the border bands and strap; colour 2 on the inner panel; colour 3 on the cartridge tips.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_90s_Knife_01.description: A right shoulder pad made of a puffy padded cushion that arches over the shoulder, with layered rectangular trim bands, a row of small cartridge-like tubes on top, a central strap, and a flat blade or bar sticking out sideways.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_90s_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded cushion and tube casings; colour 1 on the layered trim bands and strap; colour 2 on the inner panel and the flat blade; colour 3 on the tube bands.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a swept, tapering armour shell that points outward past the arm, with a raised vented tech band at the inner edge, ribbed panel lines and chevron stripes; a mechanical sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the wide band along the inner edge; colour 3 on the chevron stripes and small indicator lights; colour 2 on the vented housing and edge trim.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Alien_01.description: A small angular alien shoulder pad for the right shoulder: a layered plate with a bevelled rim, a raised glossy panel on top, and a single sharp curved spike jutting outward from the front.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bottom rim plate; colour 1 on the main plate body; colour 2 on the raised top panel; colour 3 on the spike.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.description: A single right-shoulder pauldron: a curved, shell-like plate that arches over the shoulder, with a tall flared collar edge beside the neck, hex-bolt studs across the face and a contrasting rim, in an alien gladiator style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the rim and edge panels; colour 3 on small accents near the top edge; colour 2 on the hex bolts and inner lining.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a curved cap, with a swirling cloud-like scroll pattern on the outer panel, a wide banded strip running over the top and hanging down front and back, and a thin edge trim.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer panel; colour 1 on the wide strip over the shoulder; colour 2 on the scroll pattern and curled top edge; colour 3 on the thin edge trim and stripes along the strip.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ancient_01.description: A right shoulder guard of layered angular plates with a pointed fin rising at the back, carved swirl patterns, and a band wrapping the upper arm; the plates sit tilted over the shoulder. Ancient, mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ancient_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled shoulder plates and fin; colour 3 on the upper arm band and cuff ring; colour 1 on the swirl engravings and band pattern.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ancient_01.differs: The female version has a wider, flatter fin and plates tilted back, with a longer strap running over the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Face_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a sculpted, wrinkled face plate with a raised rim, sitting on top of the shoulder. A curved talon-like blade sweeps back and down, with small spikes at the top and a contrasting underside.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Face_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sculpted face plate; colour 1 on the raised rim; colour 2 on the underside, talon blade and spikes; colour 3 on the small spike tips.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.description: A curved rectangular shoulder plate with a jagged notched lower edge and a thin raised rim, sitting over the right shoulder and upper arm as two overlapping layers. It has a mechanical, armored superhero look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate surface; colour 1 on the rim and inner lining.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.differs: The female plate is a plain shell with no extra parts under it, while the male version has a small contrasting spike under the plate.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Round_01.description: A shield-shaped right shoulder plate with a raised rim, a cross-like star emblem set in a diamond-shaped recessed panel, small spikes at the ends, and curled tips. It sits on top of the shoulder in a heroic style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Round_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and curled tips; colour 1 on the recessed panel and underside; colour 3 on the cross emblem; colour 2 on the small spikes.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.description: A right shoulder guard made of a curved layered plate with a jagged lower edge, topped by a cross-shaped block from which a large curved scythe-like blade sweeps up and outward behind the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner plate surface; colour 1 on the outer shell and edge trim; colour 3 on the cross-shaped block; colour 2 on the curved blade.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.differs: The female blade sits slightly higher and projects more sharply upward and back, with the guard sized smaller.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Anniversary_Defende.description: A right shoulder cap of stacked curved plates: a wide flared lower lip, a thin band above it, and a ridged fan of fluted ridges on top. It sits over the shoulder in a retro superhero style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Anniversary_Defende.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the flared lower lip; colour 2 on the thin band between the lip and the ridges; colour 1 on the fluted ridges; colour 0 on the outer ridge edges.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A single right shoulder piece: a curved, hooded cap with a raised upper panel and a separate lower shell that sweeps out to a pointed tip, edged in thin contrasting trim with a small round gem-like stud.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower shell; colour 3 on the raised upper panel; colour 1 on the round stud; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A rounded, dome-shaped right shoulder cap that covers the top of the shoulder and upper arm. Its surface has a cracked, cell-like pattern of raised plates, with a contrasting edge band. The inside is open and hollow.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base shell between the plates; colour 2 on the cell-like plate pattern; colour 1 on the edge trim along the rim.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armadillo_01.differs: The female cap is a slightly smaller, more closed dome with less of the hollow interior visible from the front.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a curved, hollow shell that caps the shoulder, with a contrasting upper panel, a thin trim line along the lower edge, and a small round mechanical socket on the front.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and socket housing; colour 1 on the upper panel and inner lining; colour 2 on the lower edge trim; colour 3 on the socket centre.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.description: A mechanical shoulder-mounted engine box with a tall contrasting smokestack pipe topped by a small cap, a side gear wheel, a vented front grille, a coiled hose at the base, and a curved plate that arches over the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box housing and hose rings; colour 1 on the shoulder plate, top canister and back panel; colour 2 on the smokestack, wheel and hose; colour 3 on the glowing vent slots.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.differs: The shoulder plate curves outward and forward like a flared tongue, and the stack sits slightly more upright.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Viperlogo_01.description: A right shoulder armor cap with a angular, faceted outer shell and jagged spikes along the edges, open at the side to show stacked segmented plates beneath; small paired slits accent the front and back.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and edge spikes; colour 1 on the stacked inner segments; colour 2 on the recessed inner gaps and underside; colour 3 on the paired slit marks.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armorninja.description: A curved, cup-like right shoulder guard of layered armor plating, with a raised outer rim, a banded lower section, a rectangular inset panel and a single curved horn-like blade jutting out from the front edge. Mechanical ninja look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, rim and curved blade; colour 1 on the main plate face; colour 2 on the lower band; colour 3 on the rectangular inset panel.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A small faceted shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a hollow, angular shell with a pointed ridge rising at the top and a contrasting wedge extending down the outer edge. It suggests a sleek sci-fi armour cap.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and ridge; colour 1 on the lower wedge panel at the outer edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Armorviper_01.differs: The female version is a more upright, rounded shell with a shorter wedge at the outer edge.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A single curved shoulder cap that sits over the top of the right shoulder like a shallow shell, with a bevelled metal-look rim and a raised panel bearing an atom emblem. Suggests a clean superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main panel; colour 0 on the rim and the atom emblem.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A small angular shoulder plate for the right shoulder: a shallow shield-like shell with a pointed lower tip, a raised rim edge and a notched, swept-back front. Sits on the outside of the shoulder, suggesting a sleek sci-fi suit.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and outer edge; colour 1 on the main face of the plate; colour 2 on the shaded lower point and inner lining.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_02.differs: The female plate is taller and more cupped, with a deeper rim that wraps further around the front of the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.description: A furry animal-head shoulder piece: a bear head with small rounded ears, a shaggy jagged fur ruff and an open toothy mouth, perched on top of the right shoulder and facing forward.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur; colour 1 on the fur tufts and streaks along the ruff; colour 3 on the nose and inner ears; colour 2 on the mouth interior and eyes.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a curved, upturned cup with a thick raised rim and a smooth inner panel, decorated with a stylised winged bird emblem and feather-like plates on the front.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main inner panel; colour 1 on the outer rim and shell; colour 2 on the bird emblem frame; colour 3 on the feather-like wing details.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The female version is a tall, cupped shell with a raised rim and a bird emblem, while the male version is a low, layered pad with spiky feather edges and three round studs.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A domed, layered shoulder cap for the right shoulder, with a smooth rounded shell, contrasting banded rims and small feather-like fringed tiers stepping down the outer edge; three round studs sit on top. Mechanical superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and inner lining; colour 2 on the rims, layered tiers and fringe; colour 3 on the round studs.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.differs: The female version is a compact dome with layered feather-like tiers and three round studs on top, whereas the male version is an open-backed shell with a wide rim and a winged panel.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A faceted, angular single shoulder guard that caps the right shoulder, open on the neck side, with chevron-shaped grooved bands across the top and a round bolted lens-like port on the outer end. Mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the chevron grooves; colour 1 on the port ring; colour 3 on the port centre.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.differs: The female version has a smaller, more compact shell with only one port visible on the outer end, while the male has a port on both ends.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A mechanical right shoulder piece: a curved, arching plate over the top of the shoulder with angular edges, ending in two chunky armoured pods at the front and back, each with small slash marks.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arching top plate; colour 2 on the plate edges and pod frames; colour 1 on the pod panels; colour 3 on the slash marks.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Bolts_01.description: A small angular shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a hollow, faceted metal shell curving over the joint, studded with three hex-bolt heads on its outer surface. Suggests a mechanical, sci-fi armour accent.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Bolts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and bolt heads; the piece shows no other visible colour slots.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered, segmented armor plates with a flared upturned rim and rib-like ridges. A row of curved claw spikes runs along the outer edge. Sits over the shoulder cap with a brutal, mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the outer flared rim, edge trim and raised ridges; colour 2 on the large claw spikes; colour 0 on the smaller side spikes.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The female pauldron is more compact, with a smaller, more closed flared rim and shorter ridges.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a hollow, skull-like shell with a swept-up rim and pointed side fins, ringed by a dense fringe of long spiky tufts. It sits over the top of the shoulder, giving a brutal, monstrous look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and its pointed fins; colour 1 on the spiky fur-like fringe around the rim; colour 2 on the hollow interior.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_03.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered angular plates with a ragged jagged-edged fur or feather fringe around the rim, a textured snarling face panel on the outer side, small spikes on the edge and lace-like cord ties.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner plate surfaces and the cord ties; colour 1 on the jagged fringe around the rim; colour 2 on the plate edges and spikes; colour 3 on the face panel on the outer side.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Child_Space_01.description: A single rounded, bowl-like shoulder pad: a smooth faceted dome with a horizontal seam near the base and a shallow open cup underneath. It floats over the right shoulder, suggesting a sleek futuristic look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Child_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole dome and lower shell; the material looks glossy and pale, so the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Combat_01.description: A small, smooth shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a single curved, tapering shell that covers the top of the upper arm and shoulder, with a slightly flared lower edge. Simple, sleek and plain, suits combat outfits.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Combat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoulder shell; no other colour slots visible.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.description: A single right-shoulder plate: a slightly curved, tapering panel with a raised rim and a small rivet near the outer tip. It sits over the top of the shoulder like a small pauldron, suggesting a sleek sci-fi combat suit.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole plate and its rim; the hollow underside shows a darker inner surface that does not follow the scheme.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_.differs: The female plate is narrower and tapers to a more pointed tip, with a smaller opening under the collar edge.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Covertmilitary_01.description: A compact angular shoulder pad for the right shoulder: a faceted, domed shell with a recessed octagonal ring on the outer face, an angular trim channel along the edges and a flat underside with small rivets.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Covertmilitary_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and octagonal ring; colour 1 on the inset edge trim lines; colour 2 on the flat underside.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cross_And_Cirlce_01.description: A mechanical shoulder emblem: a flat octagonal ring with a central hub and four cross spokes ending in flared, claw-like tips. It floats upright on the outer right shoulder like a small sci-fi badge.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cross_And_Cirlce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring and central hub; colour 2 on the four cross spokes and their flared tips.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A right shoulder guard made of three curved, padded bands arched over the shoulder, each with a thick contrasting edge, and a round button-like stud on the outer side. Suggests a sleek cyber-western look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded band centres; colour 2 on the band edges and borders; colour 1 on the round stud.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A single right shoulder cap of rounded, dented metal plating with a raised rim, topped by a tall octagonal exhaust stack on a narrow collar, plus a short round vent nozzle on the outer side. Cyber-western look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate; colour 1 on the collar ring at the base of the stack; colour 3 on the stack and the side nozzle; colour 2 on the plate rim edging.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A small domed shoulder pad for the right shoulder: a rounded shell with a raised top plate, a round button-like light at the front, a row of small vents on the side, and a thick curved band arching over the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised top plate; colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 2 on the arching band; colour 3 on the round button and the small side vents.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.description: A small angular shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a faceted domed top panel over a deeper banded lower edge that flares slightly outward, with small hex bolts on the top panel. A mechanical, cyborg-style look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed top panel; colour 0 on the lower band; colour 2 on the underside edge; colour 3 on the hex bolts.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Defender_02.description: A small rounded shoulder cap that sits over the right shoulder, open on the inner side like a scooped shell, with a wide contrasting band wrapped across its middle. Sleek, superhero-style tights armour.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Defender_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the cap; colour 2 on the wide band across the middle; colour 1 on the thin edge trim and the inner lining.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Defender_02.differs: The female cap is smaller and sits more compactly on the shoulder, with the band running more evenly around the shell.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A single right shoulder fin: a swept, wing-like blade rising to a sharp point beside the neck and flaring outward over the shoulder, with three raised ribs across a rimmed panel. Sci-fi, superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fin panel; colour 2 on the rim and the raised ribs; colour 0 on the inner face of the upright point.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Destroyer_01.differs: The female fin sits lower and sweeps out further sideways, with a narrower upright spike.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A curved, cup-shaped shoulder guard with a raised rim and a padded outer plate ribbed by horizontal seams, studded with short cone spikes. It sits over the right shoulder and upper arm, suiting a gladiator or mechanical look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and inner shell; colour 1 on the ribbed outer plate; colour 2 on the spikes.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Destroyerbot_02.description: A single curved shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a flat, open-backed shell that wraps partway around the upper arm, with a contrasting rim and a segmented outer panel with faint horizontal ridges. Gladiator-style armor.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Destroyerbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the inner shell; colour 1 on the outer segmented panel.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A small rounded shoulder plate for the right shoulder: a domed cap with a hollow underside, a raised pointed fin at the front edge, and a segmented lower rim with an inset panel. Suits mechanical superhero armour.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed outer shell; colour 2 on the inner lining and side walls; colour 3 on the inset panel under the rim; colour 0 on the lower edge segments.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_01.differs: The female plate has a raised pointed fin at the front and a narrower shape, while the male plate is a broader, smoother dome without the fin.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_02.description: A right shoulder pad of layered, scalloped armor plates: a smooth domed cap over the shoulder with stacked curved bands below, separated by recessed inserts. Mechanical superhero styling, sitting over the shoulder and upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed cap and the inset panels between bands; colour 1 on the stacked scallop bands and edges; colour 3 on the recessed strips; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Disk_01.description: A small rounded shoulder disc worn on the right shoulder: a shallow dome with a faceted rim and a hollow recessed centre, standing slightly proud of the arm. Mechanical, minimal, sci-fi pauldron style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Disk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole disc; no other slots visible.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Double_01_Basic.description: A right shoulder pauldron of stacked, overlapping angular plates that curve over the top of the shoulder and taper to a pointed lower edge on the upper arm, with a rounded cap and layered lower ridges. Suits superhero or sci-fi outfits.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Double_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top cap plate; colour 1 on the middle band of plates; colour 3 on the outer lower plates and edge trim; colour 0 on the inner panel faces.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Double_02_Basic.description: A small right shoulder pad made of two stacked, angular layered plates with raised rims and a row of cone spikes along the top and outer edge; sits on top of the shoulder as a punk, mechanical accent.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Double_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner plate surfaces; colour 1 on the outer rims and spikes; colour 2 on the top panel; colour 3 on the thin stripe along the panel edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Double_02_Basic.differs: The female pad sits upright on the shoulder, and the spikes are arranged in a tighter cluster along the outer edge.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Double_03_Basic.description: A right shoulder piece of stacked, overlapping curved bands forming a rounded cap over the shoulder, with a tall swept-up blade-like fin rising at the back and small pointed blades trailing behind. Sleek mechanical superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Double_03_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer blade fin, band edges and trailing blades; colour 0 on the inner layered plates between the bands.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Double_03_Basic.differs: The blade fin rises higher and stands more upright, with sharper trailing spikes.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Draycul_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a snarling monster face with a gaping open mouth, fangs and tusk-like spikes, backed by a flat angular plate with rivets and slashed grooves. Sits over the shoulder cap.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face sculpt and plate; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the fangs, spikes and rear plate; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Electric_01.description: A domed shoulder cap with a bracketed rim and bolted side plate, topped by several coiled electrode posts with hex-nut caps. A Tesla-coil style mechanical pauldron sitting over the right shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, bracket and hex-nut cap edges; colour 1 on the dome shell; colour 3 on the coil windings and the thin seam lines; colour 2 on the hex caps and coil end pieces.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Epaulette_02.description: A military-style shoulder epaulette: a flat, rounded octagonal plate with a narrow tab extending toward the neck, a thin rim, and a hanging fringe of short bullion strands along the outer edge. Sits on the right shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Epaulette_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top plate and neck tab; colour 2 on the thin rim underneath; colour 1 on the hanging fringe.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron in an art deco style: a smooth, streamlined dome that tapers to a point over the upper arm. A tall, curved fin rises at the back edge and ends in a scroll curl, with contrasting bands across the cap.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder shell; colour 1 on the rising fin, the scroll curl and the bands across the cap; colour 2 on the thin seam lines.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_02.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a swept, flaring fin or scoop, with a broad panel, thick contrasting rim and a raised ridge with fine groove lines. Sits atop the shoulder in a retro art deco, sci-fi style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel and raised ridge; colour 1 on the thick outer rim and inner lining; colour 2 on the thin groove lines.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_02.differs: The female version sits lower and flatter across the shoulder, with a shorter rear fin and a wider curved scoop.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A small feathered wing-shaped shoulder piece for the right shoulder: layered feathers sweep outward and back from a thick band that wraps the upper arm, giving a light angelic silhouette.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the band around the arm; colour 0 on the feather bases; colour 1 on the feather tips.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Feathers_03.description: A small domed shoulder cap for the right shoulder, ringed by a fringe of short pointed feather-like spikes around its rim, with a stripe and a small panel across the top. Suggests a sci-fi armored feather look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Feathers_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main dome of the cap; colour 0 on the feather fringe and underside rim; colour 2 on the band across the top; colour 3 on the small panel on the front of the dome.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Fin_01.description: A small membranous fin worn on the right shoulder, swept backward, with thin spined ribs of contrasting trim fanning across a mottled webbed panel. Its edges taper into sharp points, giving an alien, creature-like look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 3 on the spots mottling the membrane; colour 1 on the spined ribs and edge trim; colour 2 on the underside.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Fin_02.description: A large fin-like shoulder ornament for the right shoulder: a thin webbed membrane stretched between several curved spines, sweeping backward and outward from the shoulder like an aquatic or alien fin.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane surface; colour 1 on the curved spines and edge trim; colour 3 on the mottled spots across the membrane; colour 2 on the underside and shading.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Fin_02.differs: The female fin sits flatter and sweeps further back and outward, with a longer, narrower spread of spines.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Flower_01.description: A small rose-like flower perched on top of the right shoulder, with a tight spiral of petals at the centre and pointed outer petals splayed outward. Suggests a nature or fantasy shoulder ornament.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the petal tips and edges; colour 1 on the main petal surfaces; colour 2 on the inner spiral and petal undersides; colour 3 on tiny accents at the flower centre.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Furrypad_01.description: A large shoulder pad for the right shoulder, made of layered, jagged fur tufts that sweep downward over the upper arm from a thin shell cap. Wild, feral look suited to beastly or barbarian styles.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Furrypad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts; colour 2 in the shadowed depths of the tufts; colour 0 on the inner shell cap under the fur.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Fursmall_01.description: A small fur mantle for the right shoulder: a rounded cap of layered, shaggy tufts that fade to ragged pointed tips and hang over the upper arm. Suggests a primal or barbaric look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Fursmall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur near the top of the shoulder; colour 1 on the fur toward the ragged tips; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Furspiked_01.description: A single right shoulder mantle of shaggy, jagged fur tufts that fan out over the shoulder and upper arm in layered pointed spikes, with a gradient from the top down to the tips. Wild, feral look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Furspiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur near the top of the shoulder; colour 1 on the lower fur tips, blending between the two; colour 2 in the shadowed inner gaps.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A sleek single-piece shoulder guard shaped like a smooth curved shell that sweeps up to a point beside the neck and flares over the outer shoulder, with a thin contrasting edge trim and a hollow underside.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Gadroonfancy_01.description: A sharp, angular shoulder guard on the right shoulder: a low fin-shaped shell with a raised inner panel and several swept-back spikes, one tall spike rising by the neck and a long point flaring outward over the arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Gadroonfancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and spikes; colour 0 on the raised inner panel; colour 3 on the thin edge trim and inner spike faces.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a rounded, open-fronted plate with a raised rim, several cone spikes jutting outward and back, a contrasting cylindrical port at the front, and stacked banded ridges beneath the plate.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the rim and lower edge bands; colour 2 on the front port and the banding between ridges; colour 3 on the spikes and scratch-like markings.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Golden_Age_Bolt_01.description: A flat, thin lightning-bolt emblem worn on the right shoulder, standing slightly proud of the sleeve with a zigzag edge and a tapering point down the upper arm. Classic comic-book superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Golden_Age_Bolt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bolt; no other colour slots are visible.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.description: A small five-pointed star emblem with faceted raised points, mounted flat on the outer right shoulder. A simple angular badge in a classic retro superhero style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole star; the raised faces show only lighter and darker shading of it.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A small rounded shoulder pad cap for the right shoulder, with a striped vented top panel and a lower lip on the outer side holding two round contrasting intake holes. Mechanical, sleek sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and lip; colour 1 on the vent stripes across the top; colour 2 on the round intake holes.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A right shoulder pad of curved, overlapping ridged plates with chevron-shaped ribbing, framed by a raised rim and a row of small spikes along the top edge. It is a fantasy-style armour cap with a contrasting inner lining.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and ridge plates; colour 1 on the chevron ribbing panels; colour 2 on the inner lining and spike tips.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved, shell-like plate tapering to a point over the upper arm, with a raised rim and forked clip-like tabs extending front and back across the shoulder. Sleek, mechanical sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoulder plate and tabs; the piece shows almost entirely in colour 0, with no other slots clearly visible.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A floating cluster of flat, faceted hexagonal shards hovering off the right shoulder, forming a tall angular plate that rises beside the neck and flares into small points near the arm. Suggests a holographic energy field.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shard cluster; the default material ignores the other colour slots, so no other slots are visible.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.description: A small cluster of four short, angular bone-like spikes, each rising from a flat base plate, scattered across the right shoulder and upper arm. Jagged, sparse and monstrous, it adds a spiky accent without covering the body.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the flat base plates under each spike.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.differs: The female version spreads four spikes in a looser arc down the shoulder and upper arm, while the male one sits more compactly on top of the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.description: A cluster of long, jagged bone-like spikes for the right shoulder: four separate angular blades sweep up and outward from small flat base plates, giving a monstrous, spiky silhouette.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike blades; colour 3 on the small base plates.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.differs: The female version has four spikes in a larger cluster, including one long upswept blade, while the male version has only two bases.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A mechanical right shoulder piece: a rounded dome shell held in an open angular frame, with four ribbed hoses arching over the top and clamped by small straps. Sits on the outer shoulder, suggesting a sci-fi power unit.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome shell and hose end caps; colour 1 on the outer frame and clamp straps; colour 2 on the inset panels and base; colour 3 on the ribbed hoses.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Insignia_01.description: A rounded, hollow shoulder cap for the right shoulder with a raised rim and a flat atom emblem on the outer face. It sits over the top and outside of the shoulder in a superhero style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer face of the cap; colour 0 on the atom emblem; colour 3 on the rim and inner lining.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Insignia_02.description: A large rounded right shoulder pauldron shaped like a domed shell with a raised contrasting rim and a hollow inner lining, printed with an atom emblem on the outer face. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm in a superhero style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Insignia_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed outer shell; colour 3 on the rim and inner lining; colour 0 on the atom emblem.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A domed, angular shoulder pauldron with a raised curved fin rising over the top of the shoulder, a flat plate on the outer face carrying a spiky emblem, and a small round stud at the lower edge; a hidden inner lining sits underneath.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell, fin and rim; colour 0 on the face plate; colour 2 on the emblem; colour 3 on the round stud and inner lining.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ironclad_01.differs: The female version has a smaller inner lining, with only a little of it showing beneath the shell.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Justiciar_01.description: A small angular right shoulder guard made of two flat, folded plates that meet at a ridge over the upper arm, with a contrasting lower edge band and a contrasting notch at the top. Suggests sleek mechanical superhero armor.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Justiciar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main flat plates; colour 1 on the lower edge band; colour 2 on the notch at the top.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Knight_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered, overlapping curved plates with raised ridges and small rivets. A wide domed cap sits over the shoulder, with stepped lames fanning down over the upper arm. Medieval knightly styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shoulder cap plates; colour 3 on the lower stepped arm lames, blending in as a gradient; colour 2 on the rivets.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Knight_02.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered, overlapping metal plates that curve over the shoulder and upper arm, studded with rows of conical spikes and small rivet holes. A medieval, aggressive knight look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shoulder plates and spikes; colour 3 on the lower arm-side plates, which fade from the upper plates.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_01.description: A right shoulder piece of two upswept, curved fin-like blades with ribbed inner faces, rising from a flat angular base plate at the top of the shoulder. Sleek sci-fi superhero look, worn as a small partial accessory.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shells of the blades; colour 1 on the ribbed inner faces; colour 0 on the layered plates above the base; colour 3 on the base plate rim.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_01.differs: The female version has two narrower, more widely spread blades that stand more upright.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_01.description: A right shoulder cap with a domed panel etched with chevron grooves, framed by sweeping blade-like fins that curve outward and back over the shoulder. contrasting inner lining and small segmented plates show underneath; sci-fi styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed top panel and underside plates; colour 1 on the sweeping fins; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge; colour 3 on the grooves and accent lines.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_01.differs: The female version has shorter fins and less of the segmented upper-arm plating showing beneath the cap.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Light_01.description: A winged shoulder piece for the right shoulder: a rounded cap with a contrasting rim, ribbed panels and swept-back blade-like feathers that fan out past the arm. Superhero styling with a mechanical, armored feel.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim and edge frame; colour 3 on the ribbed cap panels; colour 0 on the feather blades; colour 2 on the underlying lower feather blades.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lionshield_01.description: A domed shoulder guard on the right shoulder, sculpted as a lion's head with a swept mane flowing back over the shoulder, hollow underneath and edged with a thin contrasting rim. Suits a heroic or fantasy look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lionshield_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head and mane; colour 1 on the rim trim around the edge; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a rounded, domed cap with a raised pointed fin at the back. It has a wide contrasting rim, panel seams and screw-like fasteners, and a scratched, clawed-looking surface.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and edge plating; colour 2 on the domed centre; colour 1 on the claw-scratch markings; colour 3 on the screw heads.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lycan_02.description: A curved, open-ended shoulder cap that arches over the right shoulder like a half-tube, with a thick rolled contrasting rim, a cracked and scuffed surface, small rivet holes and a screw-like fastener. Suggests a patched, mechanical or armour-like look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Lycan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the rolled rim edging; colour 3 on the round screw fastener; colour 2 on the small rivet holes and scuff patches.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Magicalgirl_01.description: A small, stiff shoulder ornament perched on top of the right shoulder: a curved, pointed panel edged with a ruffled, frilly arch and short trailing ribbon tabs at the front and back. Cute, magical-girl styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Magicalgirl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled edge and ribbon tabs; colour 2 on the main panel; colour 1 on the inner panel sections.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Martial_Power_02.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a swept, wedge-shaped cowl with a wavy contrasting edge, a contrasting curved blade-like lower lip, a tall vented fin rising at the back, and diamond-shaped gem studs at each end.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the curved lower lip; colour 2 on the trim, rim and fin frame; colour 3 on the gem studs and fin vents.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Martial_Power_02.differs: The female version's rear fin is smaller and sits further back, so the shell reads lower and more compact.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Mechanon.description: A right shoulder piece of angular, layered plates: a swept-back curved fin with a pointed tip, a contrasting upright blade, and a stacked cluster of faceted panels over the shoulder cap. Mechanical, robotic superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the pointed fin tip; colour 1 on the large curved fin and outer panel faces; colour 2 on the upright blade and inner panel segments; colour 3 on small accent strips between the plates.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Mechassn_01.description: A sci-fi right shoulder guard: an angular layered plate canopy with raised ridges over a curved inner cup, and a contrasting ribbed housing with small round nozzles at the front. It sits on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 3 on the raised stripes and top panel; colour 1 on the inner cup and thin rings; colour 2 on the ribbed housing.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Monster_01.description: A right shoulder cap of stacked, overlapping curved plates with a tall bony spike rising from the top and smaller spines flaring off the front and rear edges. Monstrous, creature-like pauldron sitting over the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the stacked shoulder plates with a blended shading between the plate seams; colour 0 on the spikes and spines.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Padding.description: A small right shoulder pad: a rounded, faceted shell that caps the top of the shoulder and curves down over the upper arm, with a raised rim and angular panel divisions. Suits tactical or sci-fi armor.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim edges; colour 2 on the diagonal band across the pad; colour 3 on the small stripe at the top.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Patterned_01.description: A right shoulder pad made of a domed upper cap over two stacked, overlapping lower plates, all edged with thick contrasting trim. It sits on top of the shoulder as a compact, hollow-backed cap. Suits a superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cap and the inner lining; colour 0 on the lower stacked plates; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a rounded, bulging shell with a tall spike on top and two smaller spikes stepping down the back, pitted with a cluster of round recesses; a toothed edge trims the lower rim.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spikes; colour 1 on the round recessed dimples; colour 3 on the toothed trim along the lower rim.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Power_01.description: A single right shoulder pad: a ridged, angular cap with a raised centre crest and a rim, over a softer, rounded padded layer beneath. It sits on top of the shoulder and suggests a sleek sci-fi or superhero look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crested cap; colour 1 on the lower padded layer under the cap; colour 2 on the shadowed underside edge.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Prisonguard_01.description: A sleek angular shoulder pad for the right shoulder: a wedge-shaped contrasting shell with a bevelled light rim and inset panels on top, plus a small slot detail on the outer face. Sci-fi armoured look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Prisonguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bevelled rim edging; colour 1 on the inset top panels; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 3 on the small slot accents.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Prisonguard_01.differs: The female pad lies flatter and wider across the shoulder, with two separate top panels split by a rim, while the male pad rises higher into a tall raised fin.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Psiagent_01.description: A thin, flat shoulder cover for the right shoulder made of two or three overlapping rectangular panels with small gaps between them, curving over the shoulder like a stiff mantle. It has a veined, cracked surface texture and suggests a light sci-fi agent look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Psiagent_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panels; the veined pattern appears to take the same light colour across the whole piece, with a faint hint of colour 3 near the neck edge.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Psineophyte_01.description: A right shoulder cap made of two stepped, angular plates with a narrow gap between them, covering the top of the shoulder and upper arm. Its surface is patterned with fine vein-like or circuit-like lines, giving a sci-fi psionic look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Psineophyte_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoulder plate surface and its vein pattern; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Psislicer_01.description: A single right-shoulder accessory: a small faceted disc sits on top of the shoulder and sweeps up into a tall, curved, blade-like spike of thin webbed, crystalline-looking material. Suggests a psychic energy shard.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Psislicer_01.colourAreas: The default material appears to ignore the colour scheme, showing a glowing translucent finish across the disc and spike; no visible use of colour slots 0-3.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Psislicer_01.differs: The female spike is shorter and leans slightly forward, with a more ragged, jagged lower edge.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Punk_01.description: A round, dish-shaped mechanical shoulder pad worn on the right shoulder, like a turbine or jet intake: a rimmed disc with radial fins around a central spike, and a smooth domed back.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and the back shell; colour 1 on the radial fins; colour 2 on the central hub; colour 3 on the central spike.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Punk_01.differs: The female version is a clean, symmetric turbine disc with a central spike, while the male version has a patchwork panelled surface.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A small right shoulder piece shaped like a rounded, pebbled shell cap with a flared, folded edge and a hollow underside. It sits on top of the shoulder as a partial cover, with an alien, armor-like look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured main shell; colour 1 on the folded rim and edge panels.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.differs: The female version is a smaller, more compact shell that sits higher on the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.description: A single right pauldron: a rounded, segmented armor shell that rises to a sharp point at the top, with a triangular chevron-patterned inset on the outer face and a soft, crumpled lining flaring out at the inner edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main armor shell; colour 3 on the chevron inset on the outer face; colour 1 and colour 0 on the crumpled inner lining and edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.differs: The female pauldron sits higher with a taller, more upright point on the shell.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.description: A single right shoulder guard: a rounded, segmented armor cap with a tall swept-back spike rising from the outer edge, grooved ridges along its length and a small angular inset gem-like panel on the side. Sci-fi alien styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell and spike; colour 3 on the inset side panel; colour 1 on the rim edging along the inner shoulder; colour 0 on highlights of the rim.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.differs: The female version has a smaller contrasting-trimmed rim that sits mostly tucked against the shoulder, while the spike stands taller relative to the cap.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Longshoulder.description: A tall, curved organic shoulder growth rising from the right shoulder like a tapering horn or tentacle, with banded ripples, a ruffled flared base and two sharp spikes at the tip, resting on a small rounded knob.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Longshoulder.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded body of the horn; colour 3 on the stripes and ruffled base edges; colour 1 on the thin ripple lines, the tip spike and the rounded knob at the base.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Shoulderbig_.description: An elongated, streamlined shoulder guard of smooth plates that sweeps from the top of the right shoulder down over the upper arm, tapering to a pointed tip. It has a raised contrasting central ridge, thin seam lines and a small round port, with a fin-like underlayer.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Shoulderbig_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 2 on the raised ridge panel; colour 1 on the underlayer fins beneath the plates; colour 3 on the thin seam lines.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Spikeandball.description: A right-shoulder pad made of a faceted angular plate topped with a large glossy sphere, small spikes studding the plate, and a long curved banded horn sweeping outward and forward from the shoulder. Alien, organic look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Spikeandball.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate and the horn's bands; colour 3 on the horn's alternating stripes and the glow around the sphere base; colour 1 on the small spikes; colour 2 on the sphere.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A compact right shoulder cap: a rounded, shell-like pad with a contrasting inset panel on top and two raised rounded bars running across it, with a hollow, contrasting lining underneath. Suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 1 on the inner lining and edge rim; colour 2 on the inset top panel; colour 3 on the raised bars.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The female version has two thick bars, while the male version has three thinner bars.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Redstone_01.description: A blocky angular right shoulder guard made of a tall slanted plate that rises above the shoulder, with a low box-like section along the outer arm and an open slot near the top. It has a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and raised fins; colour 1 on the edge trim and rim borders; colour 2 on the recessed slot.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Retroscifi_Coils_01.description: A right shoulder piece: a domed cap of stacked, ribbed segments sits on the shoulder, with a large curved ring-shaped fin rising behind and above it. Retro sci-fi look with a thin contrasting inner edge.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Retroscifi_Coils_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed dome segments; colour 0 on the inner face of the arc and the underside; colour 2 on the outer arc; colour 3 on the thin piping along the arc.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: A shoulder ornament of three long tapering ribbons that rise from a small flower-shaped rosette on the right shoulder, arch up and back over it, then trail down behind the body to below the waist.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the ribbons; colour 1 on the lower ribbon tips and the rosette petals; colour 3 on the rosette centre; colour 2 on the rosette base.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Rings_01.description: A shoulder ornament of three thin, open-centred curved rings fanned out from a single point on the shoulder, like stacked flared blades. It sits on the outer shoulder and gives a sleek, mechanical superhero look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Rings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three rings; the small mounting points at the shoulder take colour 2.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Rings_01.differs: The rings are smaller and fan more tightly upward and backward from the shoulder, and they are fitted to the left shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A mechanical right-shoulder cap of segmented armor plating, with looping thick cables arching over the top and clusters of short bolt-like connector nubs sprouting from it. Cyberpunk implant look, sitting on the shoulder only.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap plating; colour 2 on the armor segments and the looping cables; colour 1 on the connector nubs and cylinders; colour 3 on the small centre lights in the connectors.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_02.differs: The female version has a larger cylindrical connector jutting forward from the front of the shoulder and slightly fewer nubs.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.description: Cybernetic implant on the right shoulder: segmented flexible hoses loop in tight arcs over the shoulder, ending in chunky hexagonal connector caps. A small, partial mechanical accent that suggests a sci-fi or cyberpunk build.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the segmented hoses; colour 1 on the hexagonal connector caps.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.differs: The female hoses form tighter, more compact loops with bulkier connector caps clustered on the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Robot_Shoulder_01.description: A right-shoulder mecha pauldron: an angular wedge-shaped armour block with a tall pointed fin at the back, a round mechanical socket at the outer side, a contrasting handle-like bracket on top, and swept blade-like spikes trailing behind.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Robot_Shoulder_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the trailing spikes and fins; colour 2 on the top bracket and socket housing; colour 3 on the small studs and the socket centre.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Robotsamurai_F_01.description: A single right shoulder guard of angular layered armour plates that curve over the shoulder, with a tall swept-up horn-like crest at the top and stepped lamellar plates hanging down the upper arm. Robotic samurai styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Robotsamurai_F_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crest and outer plate edges; colour 1 on the main shoulder plates and lower lames; colour 2 on the band and square panel at the neck side; colour 3 on the small accents at the bottom of the plates.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A right shoulder cap with a domed, swirl-patterned gear-like surface edged by a thick rim, bearing a cluster of long swept-back spikes at the front and a round gem-like stud at the front edge. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim and the underside of the cap; colour 2 on the swirl panel; colour 0 on the spikes and gear-tooth details; colour 3 on the round stud.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The spike cluster sits lower and points forward and outward from the front of the shoulder, with fewer spikes rising off the top.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_02.description: A sleek mechanical shoulder piece shaped like a small starship, with a vented housing, contrasting lens details and contrasting curved horn-like fins on top. A single long narrow cloth streamer hangs from it down the back to the calf.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and the hanging streamer; colour 1 on the underside panels and trim; colour 3 on the small round lights; colour 2 on the horn fins.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_02.differs: The female version has a single narrow streamer hanging behind, where the male version has two wide cloth panels.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.description: A right shoulder cap with a domed, rounded shell edged by a thick raised rim, decorated with a gear-and-spiral pattern. Long curved blade-like spikes fan out at the front around a round gem-like stud.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim and the underside of the shell; colour 2 on the spiral-patterned shell surface; colour 0 on the spikes and gear teeth; colour 3 on the round stud.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.differs: The spikes fan forward and outward from the front of the shoulder, while the male version's spikes rise along the top and back of the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.description: A mechanical right shoulder guard: a rounded, ridged armor shell with a finned vented underside, a glowing round lens at the front and two curved contrasting horns sweeping up and back. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plating; colour 1 on the vented underside and the lower shoulder plate; colour 2 on the horns; colour 3 on the round lens.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.differs: The female version has only the shoulder guard, with no long cloth panels hanging from it.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A single right shoulder piece shaped like a stylised fish or beast head with a large eye, striped crest and feathery fins, backed by a tall curved shield-like plate and studded with a diamond-shaped spiked ornament.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved back plate, the jaw and the eye surround; colour 1 on the head crest, stripes and fins; colour 2 on the diamond ornaments; colour 3 on the eye and the ornament centres.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A curved, samurai-style shoulder plate for the right shoulder: a stiff arched shell with three raised ridges and thin piping, forming a hollow cap that sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate shell; colour 3 on the ridge lines across the plate; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the hollow underside.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.description: A large samurai-style right shoulder guard: a swirl-patterned curved plate with jagged, horn-like upper points and a round cutout, edged in raised trim, with stacked lamellar plates stepping down the upper arm and a serrated flap at the front.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised edge trim and the serrated front flap; colour 1 on the thin inner border lines; colour 2 and colour 3 on the swirl-patterned main plate surfaces.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.differs: The female version has a smaller, narrower front flap that sits closer to the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Scales_01.description: A right shoulder guard of layered, overlapping segmented plates with pointed tips, framed by contrasting trim and small studs, over a contrasting underlayer. It sits on top of the shoulder and flares outward like an insect wing shell.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Scales_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented scale plates; colour 1 on the framing trim and pointed edge strips; colour 3 on the small studs; colour 2 on the underlayer beneath the plates.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Scales_01.differs: The female version is smaller and sits flatter on the shoulder, with a more open, flared shell and less of the contrasting underlayer showing.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A thin, flat sci-fi shoulder plate for the right shoulder: a curved layered shell with a stepped, notched outer edge and a wide contrasting stripe across it. Sits on top of the shoulder like a light pauldron.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stepped outer rim and underside edge; colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 on the wide stripe and inner underside; colour 3 on the small tab at the top and the underside ribs.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A right shoulder fin cluster of several curved, pointed blade-like spines fanning backward from the shoulder, each with a glossy inner panel and chevron-patterned outer edge; an aquatic, sci-fi ornamental shoulder accessory.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth inner fin panels; colour 1 on the fin edges and outlines; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the darker tips and recesses.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.description: A single-shoulder piece: a small angular armored shoulder cap with a long thorny curved spar rising above the head, ending in a flared horn tip. A wide, smooth draped cloth sheet hangs down behind the body to ankle level.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped cloth sheet; colour 2 on the thorny spar and horn tip; colour 1 on the shoulder cap plates; colour 3 on small accents at the cap.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.differs: The female version has a solid, smooth draped cloth sheet, while the male version is split into many thin separate hanging strips.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A right shoulder piece made of stacked, angular layered plates that sweep to a point like a shark fin, sitting over the top of the shoulder with an inner lining. Suggests a sleek mechanical superhero style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top plate and outer shell; colour 0 on the middle layered plate edges; colour 2 on the lower plates and upper fin panel; colour 3 on the inner lining.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shouldercape_01.description: A single-shoulder cape: a stiff, rounded shoulder cap with contrasting edge trim sits on the right shoulder, and a long cloth panel hangs down the arm side to about hip level. A thin strap crosses the chest and back to hold it.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shouldercape_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and the hanging cloth panel; colour 1 on the trim around the cap edge; colour 2 on the strap; colour 3 on small details on the strap.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shouldercape_02.description: A single-shoulder cape: a flat, squared cloth epaulette-like collar sits over the right shoulder with contrasting edging, and a long narrow panel of simulated cloth hangs down the side to about hip or thigh level.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shouldercape_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cloth and the hanging panel; colour 1 on the edge trim around the shoulder piece; colour 2 on the underside lining of the shoulder piece.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shouldercape_03.description: A single-shoulder cape: a stiff angular shoulder plate with a contrasting edge sits on the right shoulder, a thin strap crosses the chest and back, and a long loose cloth panel hangs down to about thigh level.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shouldercape_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging cape panel and the inner shoulder plate; colour 2 on the outer shoulder plate; colour 1 on the plate edging; colour 3 on the strap.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shouldercape_04.description: A single-shoulder cape: an angular layered shoulder plate with a flared, pointed edge sits on the right shoulder, and a long narrow drape of cloth hangs from it down the side to about thigh level.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Shouldercape_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging cloth drape and the inner shoulder panel; colour 2 on the outer shoulder plate; colour 1 on the thin edge trim around the plate.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Skull_01.description: A single right shoulder piece shaped like a jagged, cracked skull-cap with a tall ribbed fin rising from the top. A spiky, clawed rim of contrasting panels curls around the base, and a rounded dome sits beneath.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell and fin; colour 1 on the spiky rim and claw-like blades; colour 3 on the rounded dome and the eye spots; colour 2 on the ribbed lines and edging.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Skull_02.description: A low-poly skull-shaped shoulder cap for the right shoulder, with hollow eye sockets facing outward, a faceted cranium, and a jagged contrasting rim with pointed jaw and teeth spikes hanging over the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull surface; colour 1 on the rim and jagged edge trim; colour 3 on the small markings on the brow, forehead and nose.
