Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Snake_01.description: A small right shoulder cap shaped like a serpent's head: a scaled rim surrounds a raised, textured centre with two slit eyes, and a bordering edge ends in two sharp fang-like spikes pointing down the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled rim; colour 1 on the outer border edge and fang spikes; colour 2 on the raised textured centre; colour 3 on the eyes and small markings.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the right shoulder with a hollow underside, a looping raised rim, a cross-shaped raised stripe on top and a pointed fin-like blade extending outward. Sleek superhero styling.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and the pointed blade; colour 1 on the looping rim; colour 3 on the raised cross stripes; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Space_01.description: A futuristic right shoulder piece: a large glossy domed sphere like a space helmet, held in an angular faceted mount with a thin band and a small round stud, and a curved fin-like panel rising behind it.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy dome (glassy default material); colour 2 on the angular mount and band; colour 1 on the curved rear panel; colour 3 on the small round stud.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap with scuffed, streaked panels, topped by a curved thin bar carrying four long arrow-like spikes that fan outward and upward from the shoulder. Mechanical superhero style.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap; colour 0 on the streaks and scuffs of the cap; colour 3 on the curved bar; colour 2 on the spikes.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.differs: The spikes are longer and fan out more widely, and the curved bar sits higher and more upright on the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.description: A right shoulder piece with a small rounded, faceted cap and a tall curved blade-like fin rising above it. A row of four arrow-shaped spikes projects from the fin's outer face. Aggressive, armoured sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the curved fin; colour 1 on the faceted shoulder cap; colour 0 on small highlight facets of the cap; colour 2 on the arrow spikes.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A small cluster of three short conical spikes studding the right shoulder, pointing outward and slightly forward and back from the top of the shoulder. A minimal, aggressive accent for punk or armored looks.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_0.description: A cluster of curved horn-like spikes sprouting from the right shoulder: one tall main spike sweeps upward from a short banded base, with smaller spikes angling outward and down around it. Suggests a monstrous, armored look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the main spike; colour 1 on the spike tips and the smaller spikes; colour 3 on the band at the base.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.description: A small right-shoulder ornament: a stout, ridged cone-shaped spike jutting outward from the shoulder, ringed by several smaller separate spikes scattered around it. Suits a spiky superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cone and the small spikes; colour 1 on the base tips and edges of the spikes.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.differs: Its large cone points more directly outward from the shoulder, with the small spikes spread more widely around it.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.description: A cluster of four curved, segmented horn-like spikes sprouting from the right shoulder, one large central spike sweeping upward with smaller ones fanning out around it, each ringed by a contrasting base band.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips as a gradient; colour 3 on the base bands at the root of each spike.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.differs: The female version has its spikes splayed more widely, with the largest spike leaning further forward and a smaller spike set farther back.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A right shoulder piece made of a fan of ribbed, bone-like plates that taper into pointed tips and drape over the top and front of the shoulder. Suggests an organic, monstrous armor.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces and pointed tips; colour 1 on the ridged bands running across each plate.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered.description: A domed, cap-like shoulder guard with a raised rim and a thin inset line, fitted over the right shoulder. A round gem-like boss on the front holds a swept row of long contrasting feather blades pointing outward.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome of the guard and the mount around the boss; colour 1 on the rim edging and inset line; colour 3 on the round boss; colour 2 on the feather blades.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A single right shoulder piece: a smooth, layered cap that curves over the shoulder, with a glossy horn-like blade sweeping up and back from its upper edge. Stacked bands give it a sleek, symbiote-like look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shoulder cap; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 2 on the glossy swept-back blade along the top.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Techsphere_01.description: A large rounded spherical shoulder pod that sits over the right shoulder like an oversized orb, with jagged outlined seams, a recessed round lens-like disc on the outer face and small raised dots across the shell.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Techsphere_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the recessed circular disc; colour 3 on the small raised dots; colour 2 on the seam outlines and edging.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Teeth_01.description: A right-shoulder fan of long, tapering curved spines that sweep outward and slightly back from a thin curved base strip along the shoulder. It reads as a tribal, claw-like spiked shoulder accent.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Teeth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin base strip along the shoulder; colour 2 on the main body of the spines; colour 1 on the spine tips.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Teeth_01.differs: The spines fan out mostly sideways and backward, lying flatter and longer, rather than pointing upward.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Tigon_01.description: A small fitted shoulder cap for the right shoulder, a rounded hollow shell with a raised rim at the neck side, built from stacked bands of contrasting panels. Sits snug over the shoulder like a sleek jacket shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Tigon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the raised upper rim; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 3 on the outer side panel; colour 0 on the lower panel.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Tire_01.description: A single right shoulder guard made of a chunky, segmented half-ring of blocky panels that arches over the shoulder, with a small perforated, fin-like piece hanging from the underside. Mechanical, industrial look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Tire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented shoulder blocks; colour 3 on the worn, splattered marks across them; colour 1 on the perforated fin piece underneath.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Tire_02.description: A chunky segmented shoulder guard shaped like a section of tyre tread, forming a curved open-bottomed cap over the right shoulder with blocky faceted tread pieces and rough worn edges. Suits a scrappy post-apocalyptic look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Tire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tread blocks; colour 3 on the splattered markings across the surface; the inner underside follows colour 0.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Toy_01.description: A small right shoulder plate shaped like a shield-shaped pauldron cap, with a raised rim of contrasting trim around a padded panel and a glossy dome button on top. Sits on the top of the shoulder, retro toy-like.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main padded panel; colour 0 on the rim trim; colour 2 on the button base ring; colour 3 on the dome button.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Toy_01.differs: The female plate is a rounded, domed cap with a solid curved side, whereas the male one is a flatter, folded wedge that hangs over the upper arm.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Victory_01.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a curved, sweeping fin or wing: a smooth dished plate with a raised outer edge, layered stripes along the rim and a small round pivot at the tip. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main inner plate; colour 2 on the outer rim and edge shell; colour 3 on the stripe below the plate; colour 1 on the thin lower stripe.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A mechanical shoulder piece: a wedge-shaped plate with a contrasting inner panel and thin piping, framed by flat angular struts that branch up and down like spider legs, with small slotted marks. Floats off the right shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the struts and outer frame; colour 0 on the wedge's inner panel; colour 3 on the thin piping lines; colour 2 on the small slots and marks.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Vikorin_01.differs: The female version's struts stand more upright and spread apart, leaving a more open frame around the shoulder.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Vine_01.description: A right-shoulder ornament of organic, tentacle-like vine shapes: a broad swirl-patterned base sprouting several curling, pointed tendrils that sweep outward and curl up above and around the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine body; colour 0 on the swirl markings; colour 3 on the pointed tendril tips and thin streaks along the tendrils.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Viper_01.description: A small rounded shoulder plate for the right shoulder: a shallow hollow cap with a wide raised central stripe bordered by thin contrasting piping, sitting over the top of the shoulder as a partial superhero pad.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer side bands of the cap; colour 1 on the central stripe; colour 3 on the thin piping beside the stripe; colour 2 on the inner and rear shell of the plate.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A bulky mechanical shoulder guard shaped like an angular vented housing, with a contrasting-trim frame, recessed contrasting vent panels, slim striped slots and two round nozzle caps on the front. A stepped lower flange extends over the upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and lower flange plates; colour 1 on the outer frame and edging; colour 2 on the vent recesses and nozzle caps; colour 3 on the thin accent stripes.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Wildfur_01.description: A shoulder piece of layered, overlapping fur tufts with swept, pointed tips, forming a wedge that caps the right shoulder and upper arm. It has a smooth backing on the inner side and a wild, feral look.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Wildfur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur layers and inner backing; colour 1 on the streaks within the tufts; colour 2 on the darkened pointed tips.

Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Wolf_01.description: A right shoulder cap shaped like a curved shell, with a hollow underside and a layered flared lower edge. Swirling engraved scrollwork runs along the lower tier, and contrasting trim outlines each edge. Suggests fantasy armour.
Female/F_Spadr_Tight_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 3 on the edge trim; colour 0 on the lower tier and the inner lining; colour 2 on the scroll engraving.

Female/F_Spadr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A domed, rounded shoulder cap for the right shoulder, made of a dented, worn shell with a hexagonal panel and a bordered stripe on top, and small rectangular studs along the sides. It has a mechanical, industrial look.
Female/F_Spadr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 0 on the hexagonal panel, the outline stripe and the small side studs; colour 2 on the thin line details inside the panel.

Female/F_Spadr_Traveler_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a rounded, cloth-like shell with a raised upper flap over a lower panel, edged in contrasting trim and fastened with small snap buttons. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Female/F_Spadr_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper flap; colour 1 on the lower panel; colour 2 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the button studs.

Female/F_Spadr_Warrior_01.description: A right shoulder guard made of two overlapping angular plates with ridged, grooved surfaces and a raised contrasting rim, sitting on top of the shoulder and held by loose straps with small ring fittings.
Female/F_Spadr_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged plate surfaces; colour 1 on the inset rounded patches; colour 3 on the plate rims and ring fittings; colour 2 on the straps.

Female/F_Spadr_Warrior_02.description: A short curved shoulder band or patch wrapping the outer upper arm, with horizontal stripes of alternating bands and a plain rim at the top. Open on the inner side, it suggests a military-style uniform armband.
Female/F_Spadr_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and the base of the band; colour 1, colour 2 and colour 3 on the alternating horizontal stripes.

Female/F_Spadr_Wires_01.description: A single right shoulder guard made of a curved outer plate with a jagged, notched crescent wrapping the front and back of the upper arm, ending in angular lower tips with small studs. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Female/F_Spadr_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer curved plate; colour 0 on the crescent wings; colour 2 on the lower edge tips; colour 3 on the small studs.

Female/F_Tail_Child_Tight_Phoenix_02.description: Three long, slender tail feathers that fan out from the base of the spine and trail down past the knees, each tapering from a thin shaft to a barbed, leaf-shaped tip with a glossy inset centre.
Female/F_Tail_Child_Tight_Phoenix_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shafts near the base; colour 1 on the lower shafts; colour 2 on the barbed feather tips; colour 3 on the inset centre of each tip.

Female/F_Tail_Child_Tight_Phoenix_03.description: Four long, thin feather-like tail streamers fanning out from the base of the spine, two to each side, each ending in a jagged, barbed plume tip with a glossy teardrop centre. Hangs to roughly the knees or below.
Female/F_Tail_Child_Tight_Phoenix_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the streamer roots near the waist; colour 1 on the long streamer shafts; colour 2 on the barbed plume edges; colour 3 on the teardrop centres of the plumes.

Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Amazon_01.description: Three narrow hanging cloth tabs with pointed, leaf-shaped tips, worn at the hips and hanging to mid-thigh. Each tab has embroidered scroll motifs and vertical lines, suggesting an ancient warrior loincloth.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the tabs; colour 1 on the edge outline and the leaf-shaped tips; colour 3 on the vertical lines and scroll embroidery.

Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Amazon_02.description: A short rectangular cloth drape hanging from the lower back down the upper thighs, with swirling scrollwork at the top, a bold chevron band in the middle and curling flame-like scrolls along the hem. Reads as an amazon-style tabard.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth; colour 1 on the scrollwork at the top; colour 2 on the chevron band; colour 3 on the curling hem scrolls.

Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A rear tail-skirt of long, narrow tapering strips that hang from the lower back to about mid-thigh, with jagged pointed ends and thin contrasting edging. It gives a slashed, cybernetic-cloth look.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper strips and main body of the panels; colour 1 on the lower strip faces; colour 3 on the edging along the strip borders.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Cyberwire_01.differs: The female version is a shorter, narrower fan that sits at the back and hangs to mid-thigh, with no centre emblem-like plate at the waist.

Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Harajuku_Bow_0.description: A pair of long, flat, rounded ribbon ends hanging from the lower back, side by side and reaching to about mid-thigh. Thin, soft and slightly translucent, they suit a cute, playful Harajuku-style bow.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Harajuku_Bow_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbon ends, with a slightly different tone near the tops that suggests a small area of colour 1 or 2; no other separate features visible.

Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A single fin-like tail piece worn at the side of the hip: a flared, ribbed fan with jagged, spiky edges and a raised pointed tip at the top, tapering toward the hip. Suggests a sea-creature or monstrous look.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed fan surface; colour 1 on the outer edging and border lines; colour 2 on the inner panel; colour 3 on the zigzag markings along the centre.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_01.differs: The female fin sits further out from the hip and is larger, with a wider fan and more pronounced jagged points.

Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_02.description: A sea-creature tail accessory of thin, swept-back fin blades: a broad finned wedge with sharp pointed tips hangs at one hip, with a long narrow spike extending outward. Looks like a stylised aquatic fin or tail.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fin membranes; colour 1 on the outlines and ribbing; colour 2 on the darker fin panels; colour 3 on the small markings along the ribs.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_02.differs: The female version sits low at the hip with the fin blades hanging wider and lower.

Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_03.description: A pair of thin, blade-like fin panels hanging at the hips and rear, ribbed with vertical stripes and edged with a contrasting border. They taper to sharp points and sweep outward like sea-creature fins.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed stripes of the fins; colour 1 on the edge borders; colour 2 on the inner panels; colour 3 on the zigzag markings.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_03.differs: The two fins are unevenly sized and placed, with a larger fin on one side and a smaller, shorter one on the other.

Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_04.description: A set of separate, detached fin-like blades floating around the hips and rear: a large spiny dorsal fin with ribbed membrane, plus smaller pointed fins splayed out to the sides. Suggests an aquatic monster or creature look.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed fin membranes; colour 1 on the fin edges and spines; colour 3 on the accents between the ribs; colour 2 on the darkest fin tips.
Female/F_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_04.differs: The female version has its fins spread wider and lower around the hips, with the large fin angled out to one side.

Female/F_Tail_Foxbatcon_2025_02.description: A long, thick amphibian-style tail with a rounded blunt base at the hips, tapering to a curved tip. A frilly, feathery fin fringe runs along its upper edge and it has a speckled surface.
Female/F_Tail_Foxbatcon_2025_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tail body with speckles; colour 2 on the rounded base cap; colour 1 on the inner fin ridge; colour 3 on the frilly fin edges.

Female/F_Tail_Kaiju_01.description: A thick, tapering monster tail that attaches at the lower back with a rounded base plate. Rows of curved horn-like spines and small spikes run along its length, and it ends in a curling tip.
Female/F_Tail_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the base plate and the small spikes along the top; colour 1 on the underside of the tail; colour 2 on the large curved horns; colour 0 on the plates between the horns.
Female/F_Tail_Kaiju_01.differs: The female tail hangs lower and curls more sharply at its tip, and it has a somewhat larger base plate.

Female/F_Tail_Peacock_Base_01.description: A fan of long peacock tail feathers attached at a small patch on the lower back, with thin contrasting quills sweeping down and out into large eyed feather tips that spread wide and reach below the knees.
Female/F_Tail_Peacock_Base_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quills and upper feather shafts; colour 1 on the feather vanes; colour 3 on the eye spots; colour 2 on the feather edges and the base patch.
Female/F_Tail_Peacock_Base_01.differs: The female tail spreads into a wider fan of more separate feather clusters, with one central cluster hanging between the legs at the back.

Female/F_Tail_Starowl_01.description: A skirt-like rear piece made of layered, feather-shaped panels with pointed tips, hanging from the waist to about the knees. It wraps around the hips, open at the front, giving a owl-wing fantasy look.
Female/F_Tail_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel surfaces; colour 2 on the chevron bands and outer edges of each feather; colour 3 on the thin edge piping.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Alien_01.description: A segmented, jointed tail that projects from the lower back and sweeps downward and out, splitting near the end into two clawed prongs with pointed tips. Mechanical, insectoid look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jointed upper segments; colour 1 on the forked lower prongs; colour 2 on the joint bands; colour 3 on the pointed claw tips.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Bird_01.description: A short skirt-like tail of overlapping layered feathers hanging from the waist at the rear and wrapping round the hips, with ragged pointed feather tips along the hem. Suggests a bird-like costume.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Bird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer feathers at the back and their spots; colour 1 on the top band and the spots and tips of the feathers; colour 3 on the inner feather layer seen at the front.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Bird_01.differs: The female version wraps further round the front of the hips and hangs slightly longer, while the male version sits mostly behind.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A feathered skirt-like tail piece of overlapping layered feathers sitting at the hips, short in front and fuller at the back, ending in pointed tips around mid-thigh. Suggests a bird-person costume.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scale-like feathers at the back; colour 1 on the long outer feathers and front feathers; colour 2 on the shadowed underlayer; colour 3 on the waistband edge.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Bunny_01.description: A small rounded bunny tail: a puffy, faceted low-poly ball with creased tuft-like folds that gathers to a point, sitting on the lower back at the tailbone.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Bunny_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and outer puff; colour 1 on the lower and back part of the puff, fading in as a gradient.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Cat_01.description: A slender, tube-like cat tail that rises from the base of the spine, arcs out behind the hips and curves down toward the knees, tapering slightly with a gentle S-curve. Animal-inspired and minimal.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the tail; colour 1 fades in along the lower length toward the tip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Cat_01.differs: This tail hangs lower and sweeps down along the legs, reaching about knee height, while the male tail ends nearer the thigh and trails further out to the side.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Child_Cores_01.description: Three small glowing spherical orbs floating in a loose cluster beside the hip and thigh, each a faceted ring-like core with a hazy centre. They hover unattached to the body, suggesting mystical or energy-based tail cores.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Child_Cores_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the glowing outer shells of the orbs; the hazy centres are a glow effect that ignores the colour scheme.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A long, sinuous tail that starts as a thick ridged, muscular stalk at the lower back and curves outward and down into a large, swept-back tuft of layered feather-like strands with pointed tips.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ridged tail stalk; colour 0 on the strands of the tuft; colour 1 on the spiky feather tips.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A long beast-like tail that grows from the base of the spine: a thick tapering fleshy stalk curving out and down, ending in a dense swept tuft of layered feather-like spiky fronds.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail stalk; colour 0 on the base of the tuft fronds; colour 1 on the pointed frond tips; the cut end at the base takes colour 0.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Chimera_02.differs: The tail hangs lower and curves more sharply down behind the legs, with the tuft sitting close to the thigh.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Devil_01.description: A slim, curving devil tail that springs from the base of the spine, sweeps outward and down in a long S-curve, and ends in a flat arrowhead point. Playful demonic accessory.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Devil_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail's main surface and arrowhead; colour 2 on the underside shading of the tail.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Devil_01.differs: The female tail curls in a tighter hook that swings around toward the hip, while the male tail trails out more straight and long.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dino_01.description: A long, tapering reptilian tail that grows from the lower back and sweeps out and down to a curved point, with rows of sharp curved spines along its underside. Suggests a dinosaur or monster look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dino_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail body; colour 0 on the spines; colour 1 on the shaded underside. Small ring markers are scattered along the tail.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dino_02.description: A long, tapering reptilian tail that curves out from the base of the spine and sweeps to one side, ringed with rows of sharp curved spikes along its length and ending in a narrow pointed tip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dino_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail body; colour 0 on the large spikes; colour 1 on the small studs along the tail and the shaded underside.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dino_02.differs: The female tail curls in a tighter sweep to one side and hangs lower, with spikes fanning out along the curve, while the male tail stays straighter and trails further out.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dino_03.description: A long tapering reptilian tail that emerges from the lower back and sweeps out and down to a curled point, with a row of sharp spikes along its top ridge. It suggests a dinosaur or lizard creature look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dino_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 1 on the underside of the tail; the upper tail body shows skin tone, so the default material seems to ignore the scheme.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A long tapering dinosaur-style tail that sprouts from the lower back, curving out and down to a pointed tip. A row of pointed spikes runs along the upper ridge, giving a monstrous, beast-like look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tail body; colour 2 on the row of spikes along the ridge.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Dinosuit_01.differs: The female tail curves more steeply downward, hanging closer to the legs, while the male tail extends further out behind.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Draco_01.description: A long segmented dragon tail that emerges from the lower back and sweeps out and down in a curve, tapering to a pointed blade-like tip. Rows of sharp spines run along the top, with contrasting underside ribbing.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main tail plates; colour 3 on the spines and the tip blade; colour 2 on the underside ribbing; colour 0 on the flat base where it joins the body.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Draco_02.description: A short, tapering dragon tail that sits at the base of the spine and curves down behind the hips to a point. It has a plated upper shell, a segmented underside and a row of spikes along the ridge, giving a mechanical, monstrous look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shell plates; colour 3 on the ridge spikes; colour 0 on the flat cap where the tail joins the body; colour 2 on the segmented underside bands.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A pair of long, whip-like feathered tails springing from the lower back and sweeping outward and down past the hips, each with a slender spine, serrated feather edges and a curled eye-marked feather tip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather blades near the base; colour 2 on the thin spines; colour 0 on the fringe along the edges; colour 3 on the curled eye-patterned tips.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fin_01.description: A single curved tail that sweeps out from the lower back and tapers to a thin hooked tip, with a ridge of spiky, webbed fin spines along its upper edge. Suggests a monstrous or aquatic creature look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the smooth tail body; colour 2 on the underside shading and fin ridge edges; colour 0 and colour 1 on the webbed fin membrane between the spines.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fin_01.differs: The female tail is shorter and fatter, and curls sharply downward from a high base at the back. The male tail is longer and thinner, with a lower, more swept-back curve.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fin_02.description: A thick, tapering tail that sweeps out from the lower back and curls to a point, with a row of spiny, membranous fins along its upper ridge. Suggests a monstrous, aquatic or demonic creature look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin ribs and membranes; colour 1 on the underside of the tail; colour 2 on the fin webbing; colour 3 on the main tail body.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fin_02.differs: The female tail is thicker and curves in a tighter hook at the tip, while the male tail is longer and more slender.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Finlarge_01.description: A large fin-shaped tail worn at the lower back: a thick curved tapering tail sweeps back and down, topped by a webbed fin membrane held up by several curved spines. Aquatic, monstrous look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Finlarge_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail body and the spines; colour 0 and colour 2 on the webbed fin membrane; colour 1 on small speckles and the underside shading.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Finlarge_01.differs: The female tail sits slightly higher and curls more sharply downward behind the legs, and it has a more pronounced curve at the base.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Finlarge_02.description: A pair of large fin-like tail appendages sprouting from the hip and rear: a thick tapering curved tail base with spiny ribs and webbed membranes between the spines, sweeping down and outward to a pointed tip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Finlarge_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbed membrane panels; colour 1 on the underside edge and fine speckled markings; colour 2 on the inner fin panels; colour 3 on the tail body and spines.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fluffy_01.description: A large, plump fluffy tail shaped like a rounded teardrop, attached at the lower back and projecting outward and backward with a tapering tip. Its furry surface suggests a playful animal or beast style.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fluffy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur over most of the tail; colour 0 on the fur toward the base; colour 2 on the tip.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fox_01.description: A short, plump fox tail growing from the lower back and angling down and to one side, tapering to a blunt point at the base with a ragged, jagged-edged tip. Soft fluffy, animal styling.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fox_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the tail; colour 0 fading in toward the base end; colour 3 on the jagged tip fur.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fox_02.description: A large, bushy fox-style tail with a tapered tip, shaggy tufted fur and a soft gradient along its length. It sprouts from the lower back, sweeps out behind and hangs down beside the hip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Fox_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the tail fur; colour 0 on the tapered tip; colour 2 on the base near the body, blended in a gradient.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Harajuku_Bow_01.description: A large fabric bow sits across the lower back at the waist, with a pinched central knot, and two long narrow rounded panels hang down from it like drooping bunny ears or tails. Cute, playful look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Harajuku_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bow loops and the two hanging panels; the central knot appears to use the same colour 0.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_01.description: A single large, bushy fox-style tail with a teardrop shape and textured fur strands, attached at the hip and sweeping down and back, ending in a curled upturned tip. Suggests a kitsune or beast look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base of the tail fur; colour 1 on the lower fur and curled tip, blending as a gradient from base to tip.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_02.description: A set of three large, fluffy fox tails fanning out from the lower back and sweeping down and outward past the hips, each with a curled, pointed tip. Fur is layered and feathery, giving a kitsune-inspired fantasy look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur near the base of the tails; colour 1 on the fur toward the tips, blending from base to tip; colour 2 on the small central hub where the tails join.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_03.description: A set of three large, fluffy fox tails fanning out from the lower back, one hanging down the centre and two sweeping outward and down to each side. Each tail is thick and furry with a tapered, contrasting tip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur near the base of the tails; colour 1 on the mid-length fur; colour 2 on the tail tips.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A slim, tapering monster tail that projects from the lower back and sweeps down and to the side, ending in a shaggy tuft with a small contrasting claw-like tip. It suggests a beastly, demonic look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaggy tuft and the base band; colour 2 on the middle of the tail; colour 3 on the upper stem; colour 0 on the claw tip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The female tail is longer and sweeps out further from the hips, with a more curved stem.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Leopard_01.description: A thick, tubular leopard tail with a spotted pattern, emerging from the lower back, curving down and sweeping out behind before hooking upward into a rounded tip. Suggests a feline, beastlike look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Leopard_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main tail body; colour 1 on the spots and the rounded tip.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Lion_01.description: A slim, smooth lion tail that springs from the lower back, arcs out and down in a gentle curve, and ends in a tufted fur brush. A playful animal-costume accessory.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tail shaft; colour 1 on the tuft; colour 3 on the tuft tips and underside.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Lizard_01.description: A single smooth lizard-style tail that starts at the base of the spine, sweeps out behind the hips and curls in a long tapering curve toward a pointed tip. It has no segments or spikes and gives a beastly look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail, with a slight shading toward colour 1 along the underside.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Lizard_01.differs: The female tail curls downward and inward toward the legs, while the male tail is a straighter, more horizontal sweep with small floating rings beside it.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Magicagirl_01.description: A short flared skirt sitting at the hips, with a light waist band and a wide banded hem that curves into two pointed, wing-like sweeps at front and back. Loose cloth, suggesting a magical-girl or fantasy look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Magicagirl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waist band; colour 1 on the middle band of the skirt; colour 2 on the lower hem section.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Magicagirl_02.description: A short flared skirt-like rear piece that hangs from the hips to mid-thigh, with two wide pointed panels sweeping outward at the sides and a banded, layered look. It suggests a magical-girl or superhero style.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Magicagirl_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top band at the hips; colour 1 on the middle swooping band; colour 2 on the lower flared panels.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Megaterak_01_1.description: A mechanical segmented tail that mounts at the base of the spine: a chunky armoured base housing followed by tapering plated segments with small spikes underneath, ending in a curved barbed tip. It sweeps back and down like a robotic scorpion tail.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Megaterak_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour plates and base housing; colour 1 on the inset panels of each segment; colour 2 on the underside spikes and joints; colour 3 on small accents on the base.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Otter_01.description: A thick, tapering animal tail with an open rounded base at the tailbone that curves down and outward to a pointed tip. Banded stripes wrap around it. Suits beast, animal or creature costumes.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Otter_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main tail body; colour 1 on the stripe bands wrapping around it.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Peacock_01.description: A fan of long peacock tail feathers that sprouts from the lower back and drapes down and outward behind the legs, fading from thin contrasting quills to broad eyed feather tips. It spreads into several separate plumes, suiting a fantasy or beast look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Peacock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper quills and the fade at the feather bases; colour 1 on the broad feather vanes; colour 3 on the eye markings near the tips; colour 2 on the feather edges.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Peacock_01.differs: The female tail spreads into a wider, more symmetric fan of about five plumes hanging behind both legs.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Phoenix_01.description: A fan of long feathered tail plumes attached at the lower back and sweeping down to about knee level. Each plume has a fluffy fringed base, a thin tapering shaft and a spiky, pointed gem-like tip. Suggests a phoenix or firebird look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Phoenix_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fluffy feather bases; colour 1 on the long shafts and the feather fringes; colour 2 on the spiky tip casings; colour 3 on the inset tip gems.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Phoenix_02.description: A fan of seven long, slender feather-like tail plumes radiating from the lower back and sweeping down past the knees, each ending in a spiky, barbed leaf-shaped tip with a glossy central gem-like panel.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Phoenix_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the root where the plumes gather and the top of each shaft; colour 1 on the long shafts; colour 2 on the spiky barbed tips; colour 3 on the central panel of each tip.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Pig_01.description: A short curly pig tail: a thin, tapering furry tail that loops once in a tight curl and ends in a cut stub at the base. It sits low on the back at the hip, a playful beast-like accessory.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Pig_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furry tip and upper part of the tail; colour 3 on the looped base section and stub.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Pony_01.description: A full, bushy pony-style tail that starts at the small of the back and sweeps down and back in fluted, streaky strands, ending in several jagged, pointed tufts. Fantasy creature look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Pony_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tail; colour 1 on the root where it attaches; colour 2 on the shaded streaks through the middle; colour 3 on the pointed tips.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Pony_02.description: A large, bushy pony-style tail of layered, swooping locks that sweeps out and back from the lower back and tapers to a point, with jagged tufts along the top and pointed tips at the bottom.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Pony_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the lower tips and edges of the locks; colour 2 on the jagged upper tufts; colour 3 on the pointed tip where the tail meets the body.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Rat_01.description: A long, bare rat-style tail that starts at the base of the spine, sweeps out and down behind the body in a gentle curve, and tapers to a thin point. Fine ridged texture suggests skin segments.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Rat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail, with faint colour 1 shading in the ridges.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Rat_01.differs: The female tail curls more tightly, with its tip hooking round toward the front of the body, while the male tail stays straighter.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Rattlesnake_01.description: A long, tapering snake-like tail that curves out and down from the lower back, with a hollow open base and a segmented rattle tip at the far end. Suggests a beastly or monstrous creature costume.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Rattlesnake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base of the tail; colour 1 on the tapering lower length; colour 2 on the rattle segments.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Rattlesnake_01.differs: The female tail curves more steeply downward, with the rattle hanging near the back of the thigh.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Retro_01.description: A slender, flexible tail that springs from the base of the spine and curves down and back, ending in a stack of three tapering segmented cones that form a pointed, stinger-like tip. Suggests a retro mechanical or monstrous look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Retro_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail cord; colour 0 on the cone segments of the tip; colour 2 on the joint rings between segments; colour 1 on a thin inner stripe along the cord.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Retro_01.differs: The tail cord is coloured with colour 3 on the female sheet, with only a thin colour 1 line visible, whereas the male cord looks more strongly contrasting-and-contrasting striped.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Scorpion_01.description: A segmented scorpion tail rising from a flared cup at the lower back, arching up over the shoulder with rounded plated segments and ending in a pair of pincer-like bulbs with a curved contrasting stinger.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Scorpion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower rounded tail segments; colour 1 on the upper segments and terminal bulbs; colour 2 on the stinger; colour 3 on the base cup.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A long scaly fish-like tail that emerges from the lower back, curves out and down, and ends in a large spiny fin with a tall sail-like dorsal ridge and fine ribbed membranes. Fantasy sea-creature look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled tail body and fin ribs; colour 1 on the fin edges and membrane; colour 2 and colour 3 on the inner fin markings.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Seacreature_01.differs: The female tail curves down into a single swept tail fin with a tall dorsal ridge, while the male version splits into several fins spread wide behind.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Shark_01.description: A shark tail worn at the lower back: a thin, sweeping fin-like shape that trails backward and down from the hips, with a pointed upper tip, a broad curved lower lobe and a small secondary fin near the base.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Shark_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail, with no visible contrast on other slots.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Skeleton_01.description: A skeletal spine-like tail of stacked vertebrae with short rib-like spurs, thick at the base over the lower back and tapering to a thin curling tip that trails behind and downward.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vertebrae and spurs; colour 1 on the inner joints and connecting sections; colour 2 and colour 3 not clearly visible.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Skeleton_01.differs: The female tail hangs lower and curls down towards the ground behind the legs.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Snake_01.description: A long, tapering serpent tail that sprouts from the lower back and sweeps down and outward, with a ridge of overlapping spiky plates along the top, a segmented underside and a thin curled tip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiny dorsal plates; colour 0 on the scaly side bands and edge; colour 2 on the underside and the open base.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The tail curves in a tighter hook that ends near the back of the thigh, so it looks shorter and more curled.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Squirrel_01.description: A large bushy squirrel tail with streaked, fur-like strands. It rises from the lower back, curls up and over in an S-curve, and tapers to a point that hangs down the back. Suggests an animal costume.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Squirrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0, 1, 2 and 3 appear mixed together in streaks across the fur texture; no separate parts are visible.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Squirrel_02.description: A large bushy squirrel tail with streaky fur-like strands, rising from the lower back in a big S-curve up and over, with a ragged tufted tip. It sits behind the body and reaches above the shoulders.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Squirrel_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the tail with streaks of colour 0 and colour 3 through the fur strands; colour 2 in the shadowed strands near the base.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A long monstrous tail that extends from the lower back, curving down and outward. It has a ribbed, muscular body with a row of small spikes along the spine and ends in a large curved blade with small side claws.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed upper ridge along the tail; colour 3 on the outer tail body and the segments near the tip; colour 1 on the spines; colour 2 on the curved blade and claws.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A long, curving symbiote-style tail that starts at the lower back, arches outward and downward, and tapers to a single hooked contrasting barb. A ridged, ribbed strip runs along its top over a smooth contrasting underside.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged strip along the top; colour 3 on the tail body and underside; colour 2 on the hooked barb tip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_02.differs: The female tail arches higher and curls in a tighter downward hook, with the barb ending closer to the legs.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A long, thick, snaking monster tail that emerges from the lower back and curves outward and down, with a row of small jagged spikes along its upper ridge and a large curved blade-like barbed tip.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail body; colour 0 on the row of spikes along the ridge; colour 1 on the blade-like tip; colour 2 on the open cut end at the base.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_03.differs: The female tail curls more tightly, looping round toward the front of the hips, and the blade tip hangs lower behind the legs.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Teddy_01.description: A small round fluffy pom-pom tail, like a cotton ball with a crinkled, tufted surface, sitting at the base of the spine on the lower back. Cute bunny-style rear accessory.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fluffy surface, fading to colour 1 toward the top and back of the puff.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Werewolf_01.description: A large bushy werewolf tail of layered, shaggy fur tufts with sharp claw-like spikes along the edges. It sprouts from the lower back, sweeps down and out behind the legs, and tapers toward the base.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper fur near the base; colour 0 on the lower shaggy tufts; colour 2 on the claw-like spikes; colour 3 on the tip at the root end.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Werewolf_01.differs: The female tail hangs a little lower and reads slightly fuller and bushier below the hips.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_01.description: A short, bushy wolf tail attached at the lower back, built from low-poly, tapering tufts of fur that end in jagged, pointed tips and sweep back and down. Suggests a beastly, feral look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the tail fur; colour 3 on the base where it joins the body; colour 2 on the pointed tips of the tufts.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_02.description: A short furry canine tail that curves outward and downward from the base of the spine, with a hollow open stump at the root and a shaggy, pointed tip. Suits animal, beastly costumes.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur near the base of the tail; colour 1 on the fur toward the tip.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_04.description: A bushy wolf tail with layered, shaggy fur tufts, tapering to a pointed tip at the front. It hangs from the lower back and curves around the hip, giving a beastly, animalistic look.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the fur along the lower edge; colour 1 on the upper fur tufts; colour 2 on the shaggy fur at the base end; colour 3 on the tip.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_05.description: A short, bushy wolf tail with a rounded furry base at the lower back that sweeps back and downward into jagged, tapered tufts ending in points. Reads as an animal costume accessory.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fluffy fur at the base of the tail; colour 1 on the long tufts along the body of the tail; colour 3 on the underside at the root; colour 2 on the tips of the tufts.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_Armor_01.description: A tail shaped like a flat, curved steel blade with a hooked crescent notch and swept barbs, carrying swirling engraved scrollwork and a small clasp at the base. It hangs from the lower back, sweeping down and out behind the legs.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade body; colour 3 on the engraved scrollwork; colour 1 on the small clasp at the base.

Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_Short_04.description: A short, bushy wolf tail made of layered fur tufts, tapering to a pointed tip, with small spikes along the top. It attaches at the base of the spine and angles backward and down, in a beastly style.
Female/F_Tail_Tight_Wolf_Short_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the tail near the body; colour 1 on the main fur body and tufts; colour 2 on the tapered tip.

Female/F_Tail_Traveler_Back_01.description: A long rear cloth panel hanging from the waist down the back of the legs to below the knees, with a curved scalloped hem, a central seam and a thin contrasting edge trim. Open at the front.
Female/F_Tail_Traveler_Back_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 2 on the edge trim and central seam.

Female/F_Tails_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A long, tapering dragon-like tail with a scaly textured upper surface and a smooth underside, edged with a row of feather-like fins along the spine. It juts out from the lower back and sweeps down in a curve behind the legs.
Female/F_Tails_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaled upper surface and end cap; colour 1 on the underside; colour 0 on the feathery spine fins.
Female/F_Tails_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.differs: The tail curls in a tighter downward hook behind the legs, whereas the male tail sweeps out more level and straight.

Female/F_Uarml_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single ribbed, segmented mechanical sleeve covering one arm from shoulder to wrist, with a small rigid cap at the shoulder and tightly stacked rings along the tube-like arm. Retro robotic style.
Female/F_Uarml_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper sleeve rings, fading toward colour 0 near the wrist; colour 2 on the shoulder cap.
Female/F_Uarml_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.differs: The shoulder cap is smaller and plainer, sitting as a slim plate on top of the shoulder.

Female/F_Uarml_Arm_Insect_01.description: A single-arm mechanical armour sleeve covering the shoulder to the wrist: a domed shoulder cap, segmented upper arm with ribbed inset panels, a flared elbow guard, and a sleek plated forearm with small spike accents.
Female/F_Uarml_Arm_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap, elbow guard and outer plating; colour 1 on the ribbed inset panels; colour 2 on the side panels and joints; colour 3 on the small spikes and elbow gems.

Female/F_Uarml_Dryad_03.description: An asymmetric single-arm piece: a cluster of long, curved, claw-like glossy blades sweeping up and back over the shoulder, above a ribbed, petal-like fibrous sleeve that wraps the forearm. Organic, fantasy look.
Female/F_Uarml_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy shoulder blades; colour 0 on the ribbed forearm sleeve; colour 3 on the reddish veining marks in the sleeve.

Female/F_Uarml_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A single organic, vine-wrapped arm covering from shoulder to wrist: a veined, bark-like sleeve with a rounded shoulder cap, a broad flowing panel down the outer arm, and twisting tendrils coiling around the forearm.
Female/F_Uarml_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the veined arm sleeve and shoulder cap; colour 1 on the broad panel and some tendrils; colour 2 on the coiling tendrils; colour 3 on the thin vein markings.

Female/F_Uarml_Endo_01.description: A mechanical single-arm prosthetic covering the upper arm: a rounded shoulder cap with a swirl-disc housing, a striped cylindrical piston section, exposed rods with small bolts, and a contrasting forearm guard ending near the wrist.
Female/F_Uarml_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap, rings and rods; colour 0 on the housing plate and forearm guard; colour 3 on the stripes and disc swirl; colour 2 on the bolts and small joints.

Female/F_Uarml_Junkbot_Arm_01.description: A single mechanical right arm: a rounded armored shoulder cap, an upper arm with a caged work-light bulb on the front, a chunky joint, and an exposed piston-and-strut forearm. Junkyard robot style, worn over the arm only.
Female/F_Uarml_Junkbot_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and forearm plating; colour 1 on the upper arm shell and forearm pistons; colour 3 on the light bulb; colour 2 on the elbow joint and cage wires.

Female/F_Uarml_Junkbot_Arm_02.description: A mechanical single-arm piece: a cylindrical extinguisher-like canister upper arm with a jagged spiked shoulder plate, thin strap bands, a hex-nut joint at the elbow and a segmented plated forearm with a cable loop. Scrappy junkbot look.
Female/F_Uarml_Junkbot_Arm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister and forearm plates; colour 1 on the shoulder plate, bands and arm panels; colour 2 on the joints and forearm blocks; colour 3 on small accents and edge tabs.

Female/F_Uarml_Mecha_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style arm covering the left arm: a domed shoulder cap with a circular vent, segmented ribbed upper arm, ball-jointed elbow with a ribbed band, and a plated forearm ending at the wrist.
Female/F_Uarml_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shoulder cap and segmented upper arm; colour 0 on the shoulder rim, forearm plates and lower arm; colour 1 on the elbow joint knobs; colour 3 on the shoulder ring and the ribbed band at the elbow.

Female/F_Uarml_Mecha_02.description: A mechanical single-arm armour sleeve on one arm only: a rounded shoulder cap with a rim, ribbed upper section, angular segmented plates, a bulbous elbow joint and ringed cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Uarml_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular arm plates and shoulder rim; colour 1 on the shoulder cap, ribbed joints, elbow and cuff rings; colour 3 on the small indicator light; colour 2 in the gaps between segments.
Female/F_Uarml_Mecha_02.differs: The female shoulder cap is smaller and sits closer to the arm, with a slimmer rim than the male's large flared shoulder guard.

Female/F_Uarml_Mechanon_Arm_02.description: A single mechanical arm covering: a rounded shoulder cap, segmented armored plates along the upper arm and forearm, exposed piping and a ringed joint at the elbow, ending in a banded cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Uarml_Mechanon_Arm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap, piping and main plates; colour 1 on the forearm and upper arm armor panels; colour 2 on the joint gaps, vents and wrist cuff; colour 3 on small accents at the shoulder and forearm.

Female/F_Uarml_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.description: A mechanical steampunk arm brace for one arm: a cogged shoulder housing, slim rods and flexible tubes running down the upper arm to a bolted ring joint at the elbow, ending in a contrasting cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Uarml_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder housing, rods and forearm casing; colour 1 on the tubes and rod segments; colour 3 on the elbow ring joint and small bolts; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and cable.
Female/F_Uarml_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.differs: The female version is slimmer with a smaller shoulder housing and thinner rods and tubes, and it sits closer to the arm.

Female/F_Uarml_Robotexo_Arm_01.description: A mechanical exoskeleton arm covering one arm only: a chunky segmented shoulder cap and upper-arm casing, exposed piston and cable joints at the elbow, and a slim ringed forearm frame ending at the wrist.
Female/F_Uarml_Robotexo_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder and upper-arm casing and forearm plates; colour 3 on the shoulder cap top; colour 0 on the ring bands and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the joints, cables and inner mechanisms.

Female/F_Uarml_Skeleton_02.description: A single mechanical skeletal arm overlay: slim bone-like rods run from a small shoulder cap down past jointed elbow knobs to a thick cuff at the wrist, worn over one arm of a bodysuit.
Female/F_Uarml_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone rods; colour 1 on the joint knobs at the shoulder and elbow; colour 2 on the shoulder cap and wrist cuff.
Female/F_Uarml_Skeleton_02.differs: The female shoulder cap is smaller and thinner, and the wrist cuff is chunkier.

Female/F_Uarml_Skeleton_03.description: A single skeletal arm overlay: a long upper-arm bone and split forearm bones with knobbed joint ends at the shoulder and elbow, ending in a short wrist cuff. It lies over one sleeve and suggests a macabre, mechanical look.
Female/F_Uarml_Skeleton_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shafts; colour 1 on the joint ends at the shoulder and elbow; colour 2 on the wrist cuff.

Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A single-arm covering shaped like a gnarled twig: a rounded knob at the shoulder, a thin rim behind it, and a knotted, bark-like limb down to the wrist with small thorn-like spikes near the elbow and forearm.
Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the branch-like arm and shoulder knob; colour 1 on the streaky patches along the arm.
Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The female version has a small rounded shoulder knob with a thin rim, rather than the large faceted angular shoulder plate.

Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_03.description: A single-arm covering shaped like a rough wooden branch: a bark-textured sleeve from the shoulder to the wrist with a rounded stump cap at the shoulder, a joint break at the elbow and small twig spikes.
Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bark surface of the sleeve and shoulder cap; colour 1 on the streaky mottled markings along the arm; small twig spikes follow colour 0.

Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A mechanical single-arm cybernetic sleeve: a mesh-textured shoulder cap under a curved armor loop, segmented plates down the upper arm and forearm, and exposed cable-like rods ending in a narrow cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh shoulder cap and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the armor plates and shoulder loop; colour 2 on the rods and inner mechanism; colour 3 on small accent marks.
Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The shoulder loop is smaller and sits closer to the shoulder, with no protruding side knobs on the forearm.

Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.description: A single mechanical toy-like arm covering one arm only: a rounded shoulder cap with a thin rim, segmented upper arm and forearm, and a ball joint at the elbow, like a jointed doll or action figure limb.
Female/F_Uarml_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper arm, forearm and shoulder cap; colour 2 on the shoulder rim and joint gaps; colour 1 shows faintly in the shading of the underside.

Female/F_Uarml_Toxicsteel_01.description: A single fitted armoured sleeve covering one arm from shoulder cap to wrist, with a angular shoulder piece and segmented ridged plates along the forearm. Reads as a mechanical, sci-fi asymmetric arm guard.
Female/F_Uarml_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole sleeve, including the shoulder cap and segmented plates.
Female/F_Uarml_Toxicsteel_01.differs: The female shoulder cap is smaller and sits closer to the shoulder, with a slimmer tapered sleeve.

Female/F_Uarml_Wires_01.description: A mechanical single-arm upper piece: a domed shoulder cap with a round lens-like socket, and bundled cables and rods running down the arm past a joint pod to a banded cuff at the wrist.
Female/F_Uarml_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder dome top, the arm plates and the wrist cuff; colour 1 on the shoulder shell, brackets and rods; colour 2 on the cables; colour 3 on the shoulder lens and joint lights.

Female/F_Uarmr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single ribbed, segmented mechanical sleeve covering one arm from shoulder to wrist, with a small angular rounded cap plate on the shoulder. Retro robotic style, worn over the bare torso.
Female/F_Uarmr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper part of the ribbed sleeve, fading toward colour 0 near the wrist; colour 2 on the shoulder cap.
Female/F_Uarmr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.differs: The female shoulder cap is smaller and sits flatter on the shoulder.

Female/F_Uarmr_Arm_Insect_01.description: A single-arm armoured sleeve with a rounded pauldron-like shoulder cap, ribbed segmented plates down the outer arm and a flared forearm bracer with small barbs. Sleek, insectoid and mechanical in style.
Female/F_Uarmr_Arm_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and outer armour shells; colour 1 on the ribbed plates; colour 2 on the inner recesses and side panels; colour 3 on the small barbs.
Female/F_Uarmr_Arm_Insect_01.differs: The shoulder cap is a smaller, smoother shell that opens at the top with less visible inner detail than the male version.

Female/F_Uarmr_Dryad_03.description: A single-arm organic guard: a cluster of curved, glossy thorn-like blades sweeps up and back from the shoulder, above a ribbed, fibrous forearm sleeve with fine vein-like lines. Bare elsewhere; suggests a monstrous woodland look.
Female/F_Uarmr_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy shoulder thorns; colour 0 on the ribbed forearm sleeve; colour 3 on the fine vein lines in the sleeve.

Female/F_Uarmr_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A single-arm sleeve covering the upper arm to the wrist, with a bunched, gathered shoulder and twisting vine-like tendrils wrapping around the arm, plus a broad flared panel along the outer shoulder. Organic fantasy look.
Female/F_Uarmr_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sleeve body with fine veining; colour 1 on the outer shoulder panel and some of the vines; colour 2 on the twisting vines around the forearm.

Female/F_Uarmr_Endo_01.description: A mechanical prosthetic-style arm piece on the left arm only: a boxy shoulder housing with a spiral disc, a ribbed striped cylinder on the upper arm, exposed jointed rods at the elbow and a plated forearm sleeve.
Female/F_Uarmr_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder housing and forearm plating; colour 1 on the shoulder cap, rings, elbow struts and joints; colour 3 on the stripes of the upper-arm cylinder and the spiral; colour 2 on the elbow bolts and joint nubs.
Female/F_Uarmr_Endo_01.differs: The female shoulder housing is a flatter angular plate with a small hooked contrasting cap, while the male one has a larger rounded cap covering the shoulder.

Female/F_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_01.description: A single mechanical arm covering for one arm: a cylindrical extinguisher-like upper section with ragged, jagged shoulder plating, a segmented joint, and a bulky hex-nut forearm with protruding blade-like fins and a cuffed wrist.
Female/F_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cylinder body, hex nut and fins; colour 1 on the shoulder plates and forearm casing; colour 2 on the joint rings and lower forearm; colour 3 on small accent tabs at the shoulder and elbow.
Female/F_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_01.differs: The female upper arm is slimmer and more cylindrical, with a more open, ragged shoulder plate and a less bulky contrasting casing above the elbow.

Female/F_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_02.description: A single mechanical right arm piece: a rounded metal shoulder cap, a caged bulb set in the upper arm, and a jointed forearm of exposed pistons and rods. Its paneled upper sleeve suggests a scrap-built junkyard robot look.
Female/F_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and forearm frame; colour 1 on the upper-arm panel and forearm sections; colour 3 on the bulb; colour 2 on the elbow joint block.
Female/F_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_02.differs: The bulb cage is slimmer and sits more tightly against the arm, and the shoulder cap has a sharper angular cut.

Female/F_Uarmr_Mecha_01.description: A single mechanical arm covering: a segmented shoulder cap with a rim, ribbed upper arm plates, a jointed elbow with round connectors, and a banded, plated forearm guard ending at the wrist. Robotic sci-fi look.
Female/F_Uarmr_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder rim, forearm plates and upper armour edges; colour 2 on the segmented upper arm and shoulder cap; colour 1 on the elbow joint knobs and band; colour 3 on the shoulder and elbow vent details.

Female/F_Uarmr_Mecha_02.description: A single mechanical arm armour on one arm: a rounded shoulder cap, segmented upper-arm plates, a bulky jointed elbow and an angular forearm guard ending in ringed cuff bands. Sci-fi robotic style.
Female/F_Uarmr_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper-arm and forearm plates and shoulder rim; colour 1 on the shoulder cap, elbow joint and cuff rings; colour 2 on the gaps between segments; colour 3 on the small indicator lights.

Female/F_Uarmr_Mechanon_Arm_02.description: A single mechanical arm sleeve with a shoulder cap, exposed piston-like rods and an elbow joint, and segmented armored plates along the forearm ending in a cuff at the wrist. Reads as a robotic prosthetic-style arm.
Female/F_Uarmr_Mechanon_Arm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rods, elbow joint and metal plating; colour 1 on the armor panels of the upper arm and forearm; colour 2 on the inner mechanism, shoulder interior and wrist cuff; colour 3 on small accent lights and markings.

Female/F_Uarmr_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.description: A mechanical steampunk arm rig on one arm: a boxy shoulder housing with a looping cable, rod-like struts down the upper arm, a geared elbow joint, and a banded cuff at the wrist over the bare tights.
Female/F_Uarmr_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder housing, struts and elbow casing; colour 1 on the tubes and hoses between the joints; colour 3 on the elbow gear ring and shoulder fittings; colour 2 on the cable and wrist band.
Female/F_Uarmr_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.differs: The female version has a smaller, slimmer shoulder housing and a lighter elbow joint.

Female/F_Uarmr_Robotexo_Arm_01.description: A single mechanical arm replacement: a segmented, ribbed upper arm with a capped shoulder piece, exposed cable joints at the elbow, and a ringed forearm with visible tubes and a banded cuff at the wrist. Cyborg exosuit style.
Female/F_Uarmr_Robotexo_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented upper arm, elbow joint and forearm casing; colour 3 on the shoulder cap; colour 0 on the forearm rings and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the inner cables and gaps.

Female/F_Uarmr_Skeleton_02.description: A single-arm skeletal overlay: a bone-like upper arm and forearm with jointed elbow, running from a flat shoulder cap down to a wide cuff at the wrist. Worn over the arm of a bodysuit, with a mechanical, anatomical look.
Female/F_Uarmr_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint ends and elbow; colour 2 on the shoulder cap and wrist cuff.
Female/F_Uarmr_Skeleton_02.differs: The female shoulder cap and wrist cuff are wider and chunkier, with the cap a more open, hollow-looking disc.

Female/F_Uarmr_Skeleton_03.description: A skeletal arm overlay: a slender upper-arm bone and a split forearm of two bones, with rounded joint knobs at shoulder and elbow, ending in a short band at the wrist. Sits over each arm like exposed bones.
Female/F_Uarmr_Skeleton_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint ends at shoulder and elbow; colour 2 on the wrist band.

Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A single-arm covering shaped like a rough twig or branch, running from a rounded cap at the shoulder down to the wrist, with small thorn-like spikes jutting from the forearm and elbow. Organic, whimsical snowman-stick look.
Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and most of the branch surface; colour 1 on the mottled streaks along the arm; the small thorns follow colour 0.
Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The female shoulder cap is a smaller, plainer rounded cup without the wide flared rim.

Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_03.description: A single sleeve shaped like a gnarled twig or branch, covering one arm from shoulder to wrist with a bark-like textured surface and small thorn-like spurs poking out near the elbow and forearm.
Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main branch surface; colour 1 on the streaks and veins running along the length; the small spurs follow colour 0.

Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A single mechanical sleeve covering one arm: a curved armored shoulder cap over mesh-textured inner joints, segmented plated upper and forearm sections, and a wrist section of vertical rods ending in a narrow cuff.
Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap, arm plates and forearm shell; colour 0 on the mesh joints and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the wrist rods; colour 3 on small accents.
Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The female shoulder plate is a smaller, tighter cap that rises into a curved collar-like flap beside the neck, while the male one is a wide open loop.

Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.description: A single mechanical doll-like arm: a rounded ball shoulder with a thin shoulder-cap rim, segmented upper arm, ball elbow joint and smooth tapered forearm ending at the wrist. Toy or robot style, worn on one arm only.
Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder ball, upper arm and forearm segments; colour 1 on the shoulder rim and joint edges.
Female/F_Uarmr_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.differs: The female shoulder ball is smaller and sits close to the body, with a less pronounced rim than the male version.

Female/F_Uarmr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A single fitted sleeve covering one arm from shoulder to wrist, with a rounded shoulder cap and segmented, ridged plating along the forearm and upper arm. Reads as a mechanical, partial jacket arm.
Female/F_Uarmr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole sleeve, including the shoulder cap and ridged segments.

Female/F_Uarmr_Wires_01.description: A mechanical single-arm rig: a domed shoulder cap with a round glowing socket, then exposed cables and rods running down the arm past a spherical elbow joint to a cuff at the wrist. Sci-fi cybernetic look.
Female/F_Uarmr_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder dome, elbow joint and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the shoulder trim, brackets and rod segments; colour 2 on the cables; colour 3 on the socket at the shoulder.

Female/F_Ulegl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style leg cover on one leg only, from upper thigh to ankle: segmented armored plates, exposed ribbed tubing panels at the calf, and a looping cable clasp around the shin. Robotic, sci-fi look.
Female/F_Ulegl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim of the thigh cap; colour 1 on the ribbed calf panels; colour 2 on the armor plates, cables and lower shin; colour 3 on the small round indicator on the thigh.

Female/F_Ulegl_Dryad_01.description: A single-leg covering that wraps one leg from hip to ankle in smooth, fitted panels crossed by thick tangled vine-like bands, with contrasting vein lines and clawed, ragged toes. Organic, monstrous forest-guardian style.
Female/F_Ulegl_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leg panels; colour 2 on the twisting vine bands; colour 3 on the thin vein lines.

Female/F_Ulegl_Dryad_02.description: A single-leg covering of twisting woody vines and branches wrapped around the right leg from hip to ankle, over a mottled patterned underlayer, with a small separate plate at the knee and ragged root-like tips at the ankle.
Female/F_Ulegl_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the vine branches and wrapping; colour 1 on the mottled underlayer; colour 0 on the mottled patches and the knee plate.

Female/F_Ulegl_Endo_01.description: A mechanical single-leg brace worn on one leg only: a large angular armored thigh shell, a jointed knee with a coiled spring-like band, and segmented shin plates ending in a small ankle joint. Sci-fi cyborg look.
Female/F_Ulegl_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh shell, shin plates and ankle cap; colour 1 on the knee joint housing and rod supports; colour 3 on the knee coil bands and small connectors; colour 2 on the hydraulic pistons and inner knee.
Female/F_Ulegl_Endo_01.differs: The female version has a broader, flatter thigh shell with a visible dished top and a small square gem-like stud, whereas the male has a protruding contrasting rod at the hip.

Female/F_Ulegl_Mecha_01.description: A single mechanical leg brace on one leg: a rounded hip cap, segmented angular thigh and shin plates with recessed slots, and a cylindrical knee joint with ribbed cable detail, ending in an ankle ring.
Female/F_Ulegl_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip cap and the thigh and shin plates; colour 1 on the joint cylinders at the hip, knee and ankle; colour 3 on the recessed slot strips; colour 2 on the knee ribbing.

Female/F_Ulegl_Mecha_02.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style leg on one side: a domed hip cap, segmented angular armour plates down the thigh, a round knee joint and a tapered plated shin ending in an ankle ring. Reads as robotic and sci-fi.
Female/F_Ulegl_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip cap and the thigh and shin plates; colour 1 on the hip, knee and ankle joint balls; colour 2 on the knee-front panel and calf insert; colour 3 on small stripes at the hip and ankle joints.
Female/F_Ulegl_Mecha_02.differs: The hip cap is a plain dome with no marking on top, and the contrasting stripe on the hip joint sits lower.

Female/F_Ulegl_Ravenswood_01.description: A rigid, tapered thigh plate worn on the outer left leg, with raised swirling vine-like relief and a thin contrasting edge trim; a plain smooth back surface gives it an arcane, monstrous armor look.
Female/F_Ulegl_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plate base and back; colour 1 on the raised swirling relief; colour 3 on the thin edge trim.

Female/F_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_01.description: A single exposed skeletal leg attachment on one leg: a long bone-like shaft with a knuckled joint, a narrower lower segment with a thin cable, and a chunky clawed foot block at the ankle. Monstrous, mechanical look.
Female/F_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper bone; colour 1 on the lower shin segment; colour 2 on the thin cable; colour 3 on the chunky foot block.

Female/F_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_02.description: A single exposed skeletal leg: a long thigh bone runs down the outer leg from a ragged band at the upper thigh, with a jointed knee, a thinner shin bone and a clawed, bony foot cuff at the ankle.
Female/F_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh bone and knee joint; colour 1 on the shin bone; colour 3 on the thigh band and the ankle and foot piece; colour 2 on the thin cable along the shin.
Female/F_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_02.differs: The thigh band sits lower and looser on the thigh and the bone runs along the outer leg, with a slightly longer thigh bone.

Female/F_Ulegl_Skeleton_01.description: A single skeletal leg made of bone: a rounded hip joint, long thigh bone, knee joint and paired shin bones running down to the ankle. It sits on one leg only, over the mannequin's tights, in a monstrous undead style.
Female/F_Ulegl_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint ends and shading around the knee and ankle.

Female/F_Ulegl_Skeleton_02.description: A skeletal leg overlay on one leg only: a bone-like femur, knee joint and shin run down the outer thigh to an ankle cuff, held at the hip by a flat strap loop. Suggests a monstrous or mechanical look.
Female/F_Ulegl_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the knee joint accents; colour 2 on the hip strap and ankle cuff.
Female/F_Ulegl_Skeleton_02.differs: The female version shows a single slim shin bone below the knee, with a smaller hip strap.

Female/F_Ulegl_Steampunk_01.description: A mechanical prosthetic-style leg on one side only: a segmented piston-like thigh with a boxy hip housing, a jointed knee cap, and a slim lower leg with a cuffed ankle. Steampunk, robotic and partial.
Female/F_Ulegl_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip rim, knee cap and ankle rings; colour 1 on the thigh cylinder segments; colour 3 on the joints, valve fittings and lower leg; colour 2 on the hip housing and bands.
Female/F_Ulegl_Steampunk_01.differs: The lower leg is a slim, smooth contrasting-slot piston with no bulky fittings, and the hip housing sits closer to the body.

Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_01.description: A mechanical leg attachment: a rounded hip pod on the outer thigh with a strap, two thin rods running down to a knee cluster of valves, wheels and pipes, then a slim shin tube ending in a small ankle ring.
Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip pod shell, rods and ankle ring; colour 1 on the pod panel, shin tube and knee parts; colour 2 on the hip cap and strap; colour 3 on the bands and knee accents.
Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_01.differs: The female pod is a rounder, smoother dome with a darker flat cap, and the shin tube is slimmer.

Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_02.description: A mechanical single-leg attachment on the outer thigh: a chunky cuff at the hip, a long slatted blade-like strut with a loop handle down the thigh, and a jagged, scrappy cluster of pipes and spikes around the shin.
