Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strut and pipes; colour 1 on the shin housings and parts of the hip cuff; colour 2 on the top of the hip cuff; colour 3 on the shin panel and foot tip.
Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_02.differs: The female version has a larger, rounder hip cuff sitting higher on the hip, with the strut hanging a little further out from the leg.

Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A single mechanical prosthetic leg worn on one side: a thick hip band with a flared plate, a segmented thigh strut, a ball-jointed knee, exposed wiring, and a ribbed coil section above a small ankle cuff.
Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hip plate and thigh panels; colour 0 on the struts, knee ball and shin frame; colour 1 on the inner panels and ankle cuff; colour 3 on the wires and cables.
Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Mechanon_02.differs: The female version has a larger, flatter hip plate that stands out from the body, and the leg looks slimmer and more angular.

Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Robotexol_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic leg replacing one thigh and shin: a hexagonal hip plate, exposed piston-like cylinders and cabling along the thigh and calf, and plated knee and ankle joints. Sits on one leg only.
Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Robotexol_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plate, knee and ankle armour and frame plates; colour 1 on the cylinders; colour 3 on the small bands and accents on the cylinders and hip; colour 2 on the cables and inner workings.

Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Toy_Leg_01_1.description: A single-leg mechanical prosthetic-style piece: a segmented doll-like leg with a rounded thigh shell, ball-jointed knee and tapered shin, held at the upper thigh by an angular hoop band. Covers only one leg.
Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Toy_Leg_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh, shin and knee segments and the hoop band; colour 2 on the joint gaps at the knee and upper thigh.
Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Toy_Leg_01_1.differs: The female version has a slimmer, more tapered thigh and shin with a smaller hoop band.

Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Trooperbot_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic leg worn on one side only: a jointed hip cap, slim piston-like thigh, rounded knee joint and ribbed shin with exposed hoses, ending above the foot. Sci-fi robotic look.
Female/F_Ulegl_Tight_Trooperbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg plating and joint casings; colour 1 on the hoses and joint rings; colour 2 on the ribbed segments and hip cap details; colour 3 on worn patches at the knee.

Female/F_Ulegl_Toxicsteel_01.description: A single-leg mechanical armour piece: a bulky thigh casing with a flat plated top, rounded knee pods, and a tapered segmented shin guard ending in a ring cuff at the ankle. Covers one leg only.
Female/F_Ulegl_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the thigh casing, knee pods and ankle ring; colour 0 on the top plate and shin guard; colour 1 on a small connector at the front of the thigh; colour 2 on edge lining.

Female/F_Ulegr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style leg cover on one leg only: segmented armored plating from hip to ankle, exposed ribbed cabling and panels at the calf, and a looped ring clasp at the knee.
Female/F_Ulegr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim cap; colour 1 on the ribbed calf panels; colour 2 on the main armor plates and cabling; colour 3 on the small side light.
Female/F_Ulegr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.differs: The female version is a long plated sleeve with ribbed contrasting-slot panels only on the lower thigh and calf, while the upper thigh stays plainer.

Female/F_Ulegr_Dryad_01.description: A single-leg covering that runs from the hip to the ankle, wrapped in twisting vine-like bands over a smooth, veined leg sheath, with a clawed, ragged edge at the ankle. Organic, monstrous nature look.
Female/F_Ulegr_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leg sheath; colour 2 on the vine bands; colour 3 on the thin veins.

Female/F_Ulegr_Dryad_02.description: A single-leg covering of twisting woody vines and thorny root shapes wrapped around a mottled panel, running from the hip to the ankle with a knotted band at the knee. Organic, monstrous nature-guardian look.
Female/F_Ulegr_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the vine and root wrapping; colour 1 on the mottled leg panel; colour 0 on the mottled patches and the knee plate.

Female/F_Ulegr_Endo_01.description: A single mechanical leg brace on one leg only: a large angular armoured thigh shell with a rod down the front, a coiled knee joint, a segmented shin guard and a small bone-like ankle bolt.
Female/F_Ulegr_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh shell and shin plates; colour 1 on the knee joint and top nubs; colour 3 on the knee coils and ankle tips; colour 2 on the inner rod and recessed gaps.
Female/F_Ulegr_Endo_01.differs: The female thigh shell is shorter and slimmer with a more open front, while the knee joint sits slightly lower.

Female/F_Ulegr_Mecha_01.description: A single mechanical leg brace on one leg: a curved hip plate over a round joint, an angular armored thigh segment, a chunky knee joint, and a segmented shin guard ending in a ring at the ankle.
Female/F_Ulegr_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plate and the thigh and shin armor; colour 1 on the hip, knee and ankle joints; colour 3 on the recessed slots in the armor; colour 2 on small joint details.

Female/F_Ulegr_Mecha_02.description: A single mechanical leg armour on one leg only: a flared hip cap over a ball joint, faceted segmented thigh and shin plates, a knee ball joint and an ankle ring, giving a robotic prosthetic look.
Female/F_Ulegr_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip cap and the thigh and shin plates; colour 1 on the ball joints and ankle ring; colour 2 on the knee and shin panel; colour 3 on the thin bands at the hip and ankle.
Female/F_Ulegr_Mecha_02.differs: The female version has a slim strap-like hip band and a smaller hip cap that sits higher on the thigh.

Female/F_Ulegr_Ravenswood_01.description: A curved, shield-like thigh plate worn on the outer right thigh: a tapered, angular slab with a smooth hollow back and raised twisting tendril or circuit-like relief on the outer face, edged in contrasting trim.
Female/F_Ulegr_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plate body and the hollow back; colour 1 on the raised swirling relief pattern; colour 3 on the thin edge trim.

Female/F_Ulegr_Skeletal_Monster_01.description: A single skeletal leg attachment: a long bone runs down the outside of one leg from thigh to knee, then a shorter jointed bone with a thin cord leads to a chunky, jagged bone cluster at the ankle. Monstrous and asymmetric.
Female/F_Ulegr_Skeletal_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper bone; colour 1 on the lower jointed bone; colour 2 on the thin cord; colour 3 on the ankle bone cluster.

Female/F_Ulegr_Skeletal_Monster_02.description: A partial skeletal-monster leg piece on one leg: a thin band at the hip, a long exposed thigh bone, a knee joint, a slim lower bone with a thin cable, and a chunky segmented plate cluster at the ankle.
Female/F_Ulegr_Skeletal_Monster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh bone and knee joint; colour 1 on the lower leg bone; colour 3 on the hip band and ankle plates; colour 2 on the thin cable.

Female/F_Ulegr_Skeleton_01.description: A single exposed skeletal leg on one side: a femur with a ball joint at the hip, a kneecap and knee joint, and a slender shin bone down to the ankle, sitting over the leg.
Female/F_Ulegr_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shafts and joint balls; colour 1 on the joint shading around the knee, hip socket and ankle ends.

Female/F_Ulegr_Skeleton_02.description: A single exposed skeletal leg: thigh bone with ball joint, kneecap and shin bones, held by a thin band around the upper thigh and a cuff at the ankle. It lies over the body's leg like a bone overlay.
Female/F_Ulegr_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint shading around the knee; colour 2 on the thigh band and ankle cuff.
Female/F_Ulegr_Skeleton_02.differs: The female version has a wider, flatter thigh band and a smaller kneecap, sitting further toward the outside of the leg.

Female/F_Ulegr_Steampunk_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style leg piece on one leg: a hip cap with a curved rim, a segmented piston thigh with valves, a knee joint ring, and a slim tapered lower leg ending in a small ankle band.
Female/F_Ulegr_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hip cap and joint bands; colour 0 on the hip rim, knee ring and ankle band; colour 1 on the thigh casing; colour 3 on the valves and lower leg.
Female/F_Ulegr_Steampunk_01.differs: The female lower leg is a slimmer, smoother tapered shape with a longer contrasting shin section, without the bulky boot-like calf casing on the male.

Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_01.description: A partial mechanical leg attachment on one leg: a bulky hip cap with a long rectangular strut and handle-like loop down the thigh, ending in a tangle of pipes, joints and plates around the shin and ankle.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the struts, loop and pipework; colour 1 on the hip cap top, joints and lower plates; colour 2 on the hip cap underside and ankle piece; colour 3 on the shin panel.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_01.differs: The female version has a chunkier, blockier contrasting hip cap that sits higher and a more tangled lower-leg assembly, with more exposed pipes.

Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_02.description: A single-leg mechanical attachment: a rounded armored thigh pod held by a strap, with thin rods running down to a shin of jointed pipe sections, valve wheels and small canisters, ending in a cuff above the ankle.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh pod shell, rods and cuff; colour 1 on the pod panel and shin tube; colour 2 on the pod top cap and strap; colour 3 on the joint bands and valve fittings.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_02.differs: The female thigh pod sits lower on the hip with a contrasting cap on top and a broad strap, and it has fewer contrasting panel pieces than the male.

Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A mechanical single-leg brace on the character's left leg: a flared hip plate at the thigh, segmented rods and cable-like piping down the thigh and shin, a ball joint at the knee, and ringed ankle segments.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hip plate and thigh panel; colour 0 on the rods, ball joint and casing; colour 1 on the ankle rings, piping and inner segments; colour 3 on thin cable accents near the knee and calf.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Mechanon_02.differs: The female version has a larger, wider hip plate that sits out from the hip, and a ball joint that sits over the outside of the hip.

Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Robotexor_01.description: A single mechanical leg replacement on one side: an angular armoured hip cuff, exposed cylindrical piston tubes down the thigh and calf, and segmented plates with ring joints at the knee and ankle.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Robotexor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip cuff, armour plates and joint rings; colour 1 on the piston cylinders; colour 3 on the bands around the pistons and the hip cuff edge; colour 2 on the inner mechanics.

Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Toy_Leg_01_1.description: A single mechanical doll-like leg piece on one leg only: a smooth rounded thigh segment capped by a tilted hip ring, a ball-joint knee and a slim tapered shin. Suggests a toy or robotic prosthetic.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Toy_Leg_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh and shin segments and the hip ring; colour 2 on the joint band above the knee and the ring's inner edge; colour 1 subtly on the knee ball and shaded sides.

Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.description: A single mechanical leg brace worn on one leg: a domed hip cap, a jointed thigh strut with ribbed hydraulic pistons, a rounded knee joint and a segmented shin plate. Exposed cables run down the leg, giving a robotic sci-fi look.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strut and shin plates; colour 1 on the cables and knee joint rings; colour 2 on the piston ribs and hip cap; colour 3 on small accents.
Female/F_Ulegr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.differs: The female version has a domed hip cap sitting higher on the hip and a slightly more slender knee joint.

Female/F_Ulegr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A single-leg mechanical armour piece: a tapered thigh shell with a flat angular plate at the hip, rounded knee guards, and a segmented shin greave ending in a ringed ankle cuff. Sits on one leg only, with a sci-fi, monstrous look.
Female/F_Ulegr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the thigh shell, knee guards and ankle cuff; colour 0 on the hip plate and shin greave; colour 2 on the edge trim and small joint details; colour 1 on a small accent at the knee.

Female/F_Vehicle_Arachnid_Bike_01.description: A low, wide mechanical bike shaped like a spider or crab, with a segmented armoured hull, blocky rear pods and long curved bladed legs splayed out to the sides. It is a vehicle that sits beneath the rider, in a sci-fi monstrous style.
Female/F_Vehicle_Arachnid_Bike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hull plates and underside blade; colour 3 on the curved leg blades, spines and front canopy shell; colour 2 on the mechanical joints and rear sections; colour 1 on the small stripe bands across the legs.

Female/F_Vehicle_Glider_Mayhem_01.description: A winged hover glider the wearer stands on: a rounded central hull with organic swirl markings, long swept wings ending in hooked claw-like tips, and curved fin blades angled below and above the wings.
Female/F_Vehicle_Glider_Mayhem_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hull plating and wing surfaces; colour 3 on the swirl markings, wing joints and rear housing; colour 1 on the curved fin blades, wing tips and central stripe.

Female/F_Vehicle_Horse_01.description: A mechanical horse mount with a streamlined armored body, a saddle with a rider seat, spiked mane ridge and ears, a cluster of rocket thrusters at the rear, and side pipes and a long lance-like rod along the flank.
Female/F_Vehicle_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, muzzle, side plating and pipes; colour 1 on the main body shell, neck and thruster casings; colour 2 on the underbelly panels, leg sections and thruster nozzles; colour 3 on the saddle panel over the back and small tip accents on the rod.

Female/F_Vehicle_Horse_02.description: A mechanical horse vehicle: a horse-like head and neck with pointed ears and a studded mane ridge, a smooth body block behind, and a cluster of chrome exhaust pipes and a long rod trailing below and to the sides.
Female/F_Vehicle_Horse_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the head, neck and mane area; colour 0 on the muzzle, pipes and mechanical fittings; colour 2 on the body block and rod shaft; colour 3 on small tips and accents.

Female/F_Vehicle_Horse_03.description: A vehicle attachment shaped like a rocket-powered body: a tapered, open-backed hull shell with a cluster of four large flared thruster nozzles at the rear and small round lens-like details at the front. It floats beside the body.
Female/F_Vehicle_Horse_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hull shell and the nozzle flares; colour 2 on the nozzle barrels and the inner hull; colour 0 on the hull's top highlights and the collar rings between nozzles and hull.

Female/F_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_01.description: A mechanical bull-shaped hover bike: a bulky bovine body with long curved horns and tusks, a saddle-like back, side-mounted pipes, a cluster of rocket thrusters at the rear and a slim lance-like spike projecting forward under the head.
Female/F_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bull body and head; colour 0 on the horns, side pipes, armour panels and lance shaft; colour 2 on the thruster nozzles and rear joints; colour 3 on the saddle area and the lance tip.

Female/F_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_02.description: A vehicle front attachment shaped like a bull's head with long curved horns, mounted on a mechanical frame with side exhaust pipes and a long slender gun barrel projecting forward. Monstrous and mechanical, sitting ahead of the body.
Female/F_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bull head; colour 0 on the horns, pipes and gun body; colour 2 on the back of the head and the barrel tip; colour 3 on the small accent blocks and barrel end.

Female/F_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_03.description: A large cylindrical engine block for a bike, with a rounded front and a cluster of four flared exhaust nozzles at the rear, each ringed by a collar. Sits in front of the hips as a bulky mechanical attachment.
Female/F_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main body of the housing and the nozzles; colour 0 on the upper panel; colour 1 on the front cap, nozzle rims and inner rings.

Female/F_Waist_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A small belt accessory of curved, claw-like spines fanning out from the left hip, with contrasting-tipped spikes on one side and larger hooked, tapering talons on the other; a monstrous, dragon-like ornament.
Female/F_Waist_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the spines, blending from one to the other toward the tips; colour 2 and colour 3 on the larger hooked talons, blending from one to the other.

Female/F_Waistaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_202.description: A single swept-back fin cluster worn on the left hip: three layered, ribbed fin blades that fan backwards and taper to points, with a rounded, smoothly curved outer surface and a scalloped lower edge.
Female/F_Waistaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_202.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner and lower fin surfaces; colour 3 on the outer fin edges and upper ridges, blending into colour 1 across the fin membranes.
Female/F_Waistaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_202.differs: The female fins are smoother and more rounded, with ribbed, fanned blades and a scalloped lower edge, while the male version is more angular and folded.

Female/F_Waistaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_202.description: A single swept-back fin ornament on the right hip: three stacked, ribbed fin layers curve to a point, with a frilled ragged lower edge. Suggests an amphibian or monster look.
Female/F_Waistaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_202.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer rims and ribbed fin edges; colour 1 on the inner fin surfaces and frilled underside.

Female/F_Waistr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A small cluster of curved, clawlike spikes worn at the right hip: long tapering blades fan out from a knotted base, with shorter talon-like points curling below. Suggests a monstrous dragon-scale accent.
Female/F_Waistr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the middle of the long spikes; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 2 on the base knot; colour 3 on the lower curling talons.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Future_01.description: A pair of large curved blade-like mechanical wings that arc up and out from the back, each with a ringed circular hub, a hooked tip, a contrasting inner blade panel and a slim trim line along the edge.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade surfaces and hub housing; colour 1 on the edge trim and inner stripes; colour 2 on the inner blade panels; colour 3 on the ring in each hub.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Future_01.differs: The female wings are set at a more upright angle, with the near wing held higher and closer to the body, whereas the male pair spreads wider and lower.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Future_02.description: A pair of small mechanical blade wings floating at the sides of the back: each has a round ringed hub with a glowing core and a long swept, tapering blade with a small spike on top, hanging down past the hips.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Future_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer hub rings; colour 1 on the long blades and top spikes; colour 2 on the underside blade panels; colour 3 on the inner hub cores.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Jetpack_Mechanical_.description: A pair of detached mechanical jet-fighter wings floating out to each side of the back, each with a central fuselage, swept wing blades with serrated edges, tall tail fins and a small canopy. Sci-fi jetpack style.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Jetpack_Mechanical_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fuselage and wing plates; colour 1 on the wing blades and tail fins; colour 2 on the fin insides and underside details; colour 3 on the canopies and small markings.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_.description: A pair of mechanical wing arms mounted on the upper back: jointed clamp mounts feed curved arms that arc up and out, ending in swept feather-like blades with spiky crests. Sits behind the shoulders in a static pose.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mounting clamps and lower blade edges; colour 1 on the curved arms and upper feather crests; colour 2 on the inner blade surfaces and joints.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_.description: A pair of static feathered wings held out and slightly back from the shoulders, with layered feathers that lengthen into long pointed tips. Fantasy angelic style, hanging behind the body at about knee depth.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper leading edge and feather tops; colour 1 on the mid feather layers; colour 3 on the long lower feather tips; colour 2 on the darkened transition between the mid and tip feathers.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_.description: A pair of mechanical arched wing-arms mounted on the upper back by small clamp plates, sweeping out and up in curved spines, then down into long blade-like feather tips with a spiky feathered crest at each peak.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mounting clamps and the lower blade edges; colour 1 on the curved spines and the crest feathers; colour 2 on the inner blade surfaces and the shadowed underside.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_.description: A pair of large feathered wings rising from the upper back and sweeping outward and down, with layered rows of feathers that lengthen into long pointed tips. Fantasy angelic style, worn as a back accessory.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper leading edge and top feather tips; colour 1 on the middle feather layers; colour 3 on the long lower feather tips.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_01.description: A pair of static stone-look back wings: two long, narrow angular arms rise from carved shield-shaped plates at the shoulder blades and spread in a V, each tipped with a small rounded ornament with a circular emblem.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long arms and the carved plates; colour 1 on the rounded tip ornaments; colour 3 on the circular emblems; colour 2 on the cap atop each tip.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_01.differs: The two wings are spread more symmetrically in a wide V, both rising high above the shoulders.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_02.description: A pair of rigid, static angular wings made of stacked plank-like feather segments, with blocky crenellated tips and stepped, tooth-like lower edges. They stand out from the upper back, splayed slightly outward and angled back.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blocky upper tips; colour 0 on the main feather panels; colour 3 on the stepped lower feather ends.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_02.differs: The female wings are posed at a wider spread, with the second wing angled further out behind the body.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_Fl.description: A pair of mechanical back-mounted wing struts: shield-shaped stone-like plates at the shoulder blades, each with a long slender arm angling up and outward, ending in a rounded capped bulb with a circular emblem.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_Fl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long arms and base plates; colour 1 on the bulb casings at the tips; colour 3 on the circular emblems; colour 2 on the caps atop the tips.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_Fl.description: A pair of large, angular slab-like wings rising from the upper back, made of flat stone-like panels with a blocky capped top edge and a jagged, notched lower edge. They angle outward and sweep down past the hips.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_Fl.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blocky capped tops of the wings; colour 0 on the main panel surfaces; colour 3 on the notched lower feather tips.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Scibladed_Alt_01.description: A compact mechanical back unit: a round, rimmed disc housing a recessed circular core, joined by a short connector to a tapered, plated pack running down the spine. Sits centred between the shoulder blades and mid-back, sci-fi in style.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Scibladed_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc rim and the outer pack casing; colour 1 on the central core hub, the neck connector and the small vent marks; colour 2 on the recessed disc face and the inner pack panel.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Scibladed_Alt_02.description: Back-mounted wings made of six detached blade-like shards, three fanning out on each side of the shoulders. Each shard is a slim angular wedge with a bladed tip, floating clear of the body in a radiating arrangement.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Scibladed_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central spine of each blade; colour 1 on the blade tips and edges; colour 2 on the inner underside of the blades.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Scibladed_Alt_03.description: Six thin, detached blade-like shards fan out from the upper back, three per side, like a spread of angular energy wings. They float away from the body, tapering to sharp points, with a sci-fi mechanical feel.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Scibladed_Alt_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all of the blades; the default material shows a faint glow that does not follow the other colour slots.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Tight_Armored_01.description: A single large feathered wing swept back from the shoulder blade, with layered rows of long, pointed armoured feathers that graduate in length and taper to sharp tips. Suggests a fantasy or superhero winged look.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Tight_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper covert feathers; colour 2 on the middle row of long feathers; colour 0 on the lower flight feathers.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Tight_Armored_01.differs: The female version shows a single wing pointing to one side of the back, with a narrower base.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Tight_Scarab_01.description: A pair of insect-like wings sprouting from the upper back, each a broad, tapered membrane with a network of raised veins. They sweep outward and slightly down, giving a scarab or beetle look.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Tight_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing membranes; colour 3 on the veins and edge lines.

Female/F_Wings_Child_Tight_Scarab_02.description: A pair of large butterfly-style wings attached at the upper back: each side has a tall pointed upper wing and a long downward-sweeping lower wing, with jagged, notched edges. They are thin, angular and rigid, and flare wide of the body.
Female/F_Wings_Child_Tight_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main wing surfaces; colour 0 and colour 1 on the edge trim and the wing veins, faintly visible from the side.

Female/F_Wings_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.description: A single wing-like mechanical appendage of layered, blade-shaped feather plates: long pointed upper blades sweep outward, with shorter angular plates fanned beneath. It floats off one side of the upper back, giving a sci-fi angular look.
Female/F_Wings_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper blades; colour 1 on the mid-row plates; colour 2 on the lower shorter plates; colour 3 on the small pivot dots.

Female/F_Wings_Future_01.description: Four curved, scythe-like mechanical blade wings floating behind the shoulders: two long arcs and two shorter blades, each with a round ringed hub, a pointed tip and a contrasting inner blade panel. Sci-fi, hovering design.
Female/F_Wings_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade edges and hub housings; colour 1 on the inner blade edges and spines; colour 2 on the blade panels; colour 3 on the hub centres.

Female/F_Wings_Jetpack_Mechanical_01.description: A large mechanical jetpack of stacked jet-fighter modules fanning out across the back, with swept, serrated wings, finned engine pods and tall tail fins spanning well beyond the shoulders. Sci-fi superhero flight gear.
Female/F_Wings_Jetpack_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing plates and pod casings; colour 1 on the wing surfaces and fins; colour 3 on the engine intakes and cockpit-like caps; colour 2 on the small vents and joints.

Female/F_Wings_Jetwings_01.description: A single large mechanical jet wing swept back from a small shoulder harness on the chest and back. Long angular overlapping feather-like blades and spiked tips form a segmented swept silhouette, with a sci-fi aircraft look.
Female/F_Wings_Jetwings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the harness and the outer edge blades; colour 1 on the upper wing panels and edge blades; colour 2 on the main inner wing panels; colour 3 on the chest harness centre.
Female/F_Wings_Jetwings_01.differs: The female wings show the main wing blades mostly in a contrasting glossy finish, with the light colour limited to the edges, while the male wings show them mostly light.

Female/F_Wings_Jetwings_02.description: A single large swept-back mechanical wing mounted at the upper back, built from overlapping angular blade-like panels and pointed feather spikes that fan out and taper to sharp tips, giving a jet-like aggressive look.
Female/F_Wings_Jetwings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade panels and edge spikes; colour 1 on the upper wing panels and some layered plates; colour 2 on the inner panels and struts near the mount.
Female/F_Wings_Jetwings_02.differs: The female version shows a darker default finish, with the wing panels appearing mostly contrasting and contrasting rather than pale.

Female/F_Wings_Jetwings_Wing_01.description: A single wing made of many jagged, angular blade-like shards fanned out from the shoulder blade and sweeping back and outward. Overlapping metallic plates give a sharp, mechanical jet-wing look.
Female/F_Wings_Jetwings_Wing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer and upper blade shards; colour 1 on the lower and underside blade panels; colour 2 on the large central blades.
Female/F_Wings_Jetwings_Wing_01.differs: This version shows the shards in the test colour scheme, with contrasting panels, whereas the male version appears in a single contrasting metallic finish.

Female/F_Wings_Kaiju_01.description: A pair of large, swept-back mechanical wings with ridged, cracked-looking upper panels and a lower perforated feather section, joined by a spiny central spine clamped across the upper back and shoulders.
Female/F_Wings_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wing panels; colour 1 on the lower perforated wing sections; colour 3 on the central spine and shoulder mount.
Female/F_Wings_Kaiju_01.differs: The female spine mount is smaller and sits tighter against the back, with fewer protruding spikes.

Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_66_01.description: A pair of large mechanical wings on shoulder-blade mounts with round plates and rigid arm struts curving up past the head. Each wing has long straight feather panels, a contrasting blocky upper section and a crenellated lower edge.
Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the struts, shoulder plates and feather panels; colour 2 on the upper wing blocks; colour 3 on the crenellated feather tips; colour 1 on the round joint caps and small mount lights.
Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_66_01.differs: Both wings sit fairly symmetrically, spread on either side of the back, and the struts rise beside the head.

Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_66_02.description: A pair of large static feathered wings that arc up and out from a small mechanical clasp plate across the upper back, with curved metal spars, layered swept-back feathers and pointed tips that reach below the hips.
Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the clasp plate and the upper feather edges; colour 1 on the main feather blades; colour 2 on the curved spars and feather tops; colour 3 on the feather tips.

Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_66_Flap_01.description: A pair of large mechanical wings mounted on shoulder plates on the back, with long angled struts rising over the shoulders and tall segmented feather panels with notched, battlement-like edges. Suits a superhero or sci-fi look.
Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_66_Flap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the struts, shoulder plates and lower feather panels; colour 2 on the notched upper feather sections; colour 3 on the feather tips; colour 1 on the shoulder joint caps and small connectors.

Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_66_Flap_02.description: A pair of large feathered wings on curved mechanical arm struts joined by a small clasp plate across the upper back. Layered feathers sweep up into hooked tips at the top and taper into long pointed tips below.
Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_66_Flap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the clasp plate and the upper feather areas; colour 1 on the main feather blades; colour 3 on the lower feather tips; colour 2 on the struts and the darker feather edges.

Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_67_01.description: Large translucent fairy-like wings: two pairs of broad, pointed, leaf-shaped wings on each side, upper pair sweeping up and out, lower pair angled down, attached at the upper back with a frosty veined texture.
Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: The wings appear icy and glossy and largely ignore the colour scheme; no clear slot colours are visible on them.
Female/F_Wings_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The female wings are pale, translucent and fairy-like with broad rounded lobes, while the male version is a pair of long, narrow, drooping moth-like wings with patterned spots.

Female/F_Wings_Moth_01.description: A pair of large butterfly-style wings with broad upper lobes and rounded lower lobes, patterned with fine veins, eyespots and concentric rings, joined at a small central clasp on the upper back. Fantasy insect look.
Female/F_Wings_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing membranes; colour 1 on the wing tips, veins and ring markings; colour 2 on the eyespots and tip stripes; colour 3 on the central clasp at the back.

Female/F_Wings_Scibladed_01.description: A mechanical back-mounted wing rig: a round ringed hub between the shoulder blades with eight long segmented arms fanning out, each tipped with a flat angular blade. Sci-fi, energy-weapon look.
Female/F_Wings_Scibladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hub ring and arm casings; colour 1 on the bands along the arms and the hub centre; colour 2 on the blades and hub core; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Wings_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of mechanical wings mounted at the shoulder blades: each has a curved upper panel fanning into rows of long, layered blade-like feathers with contrasting edging, spreading outward and slightly downward to about hip height.
Female/F_Wings_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved upper panels; colour 3 on the feather blades; colour 1 on the thin line between panel and feathers; colour 2 on the edging around the feathers.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Armored_01.description: A single large mechanical wing mounted at the upper back: a jointed armored arm with rounded shoulder housings carries long layered feather blades that sweep back and out to sharp tips. Suggests a sci-fi angelic look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm segments and the lower feather rows; colour 1 on the shoulder housings and the main feathers; colour 2 on the longest upper feather tips; colour 3 on the small joint lights.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Armored_01.differs: The female wing is a single wing folded closer to the body with a narrower spread, while the male one shows a wider, more open span.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Bird_01.description: A single large feathered bird wing worn on the back, swept out and back in a long, arched shape with a smooth leading edge and layered rows of feathers that fan into ragged tips.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Bird_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper leading edge; colour 1 on the mid band of small covert feathers; colour 3 on the main long flight feathers; colour 0 on the outer feather tips and underside.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Bird_01.differs: The wing is a single wing swept out to one side of the back, with a more upright, swept-back angle than the male version.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A single large feathered bird wing worn on one side of the back, with a rounded padded leading edge, layered rows of long flight feathers sweeping outward and back, and a small patch of scaly feathering near the shoulder.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded leading edge and shoulder covert; colour 1 on the long flight feathers; colour 3 on the feather bases along the wing's inner band; colour 2 on the feather tips.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A pair of angular mechanical wings mounted on the upper back: each has a swept-up blade panel, a central pivot housing with a round joint, and long spiked blades pointing downward, giving a sleek jet-like superhero look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiked inner fins and lower blade edges; colour 1 on the pivot housings and lower wing sections; colour 3 on the upper swept panels and long downward blades; colour 2 on the round joints.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Butterfly_01.description: A pair of large butterfly wings on the upper back: broad upper wings sweep up and outward, with smaller lower wings ending in trailing tails. Veined, gradient-textured membranes give a delicate, fantasy insect look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Butterfly_01.colourAreas: The wings carry a painted texture rather than flat slots: the wing edges and veins take tones, the central gradient areas take a to-blend, so the scheme is largely baked into the texture.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Butterfly_02.description: A pair of large butterfly wings on the back: broad upper wings and smaller lower wings with a trailing tail tip, patterned with eyespots, veins and scalloped edges. They spread wide behind the shoulders.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Butterfly_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing borders and outer membrane; colour 1 on the inner vein streaks of the upper wings; colour 2 on the lower wing patches and spots; colour 3 on the eyespot and vein markings.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A single large feathered wing on the back, with a bony, clawed spar along the leading edge, a smooth membrane near the shoulder and layers of long feathers trailing toward the tip; a fantasy-monstrous hybrid look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bony spar and joints; colour 0 on the membrane and shoulder area; colour 1 on the long flight feathers; colour 2 on the claw tips.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_01.differs: The female wing is a single wing on one side of the back, swept out and tilted, rather than a spread pair.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bat_Left_01.description: A single bat-style wing (left side) mounted at the upper back: a jointed, bony arm frame with claw-tipped fingers stretches a thin membrane between the spars, giving a scalloped trailing edge. Suits gothic, monstrous or fantasy looks.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bat_Left_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bony arm and finger frame; colour 0 on the membrane; colour 1 as a soft tint toward the outer edge of the membrane; colour 2 on the claw tips.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bat_Right_0.description: A single bat-like wing that extends out from the right shoulder blade: a bony, jointed arm with a knuckle spur and several ribs supporting a thin membrane that ends in clawed tips. Fantasy or monstrous styling.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bat_Right_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the bony arm frame and ribs; colour 0 on the membrane, with colour 1 as a gradient toward the lower edge; colour 3 on the wing claw tips.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bird_Left_0.description: A single large feathered bird wing, the left one, rising from the upper back and sweeping up and outward, with layered rows of small covert feathers and long flight feathers at the tip.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bird_Left_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leading edge and the small covert feathers; colour 1 on the long flight feathers; colour 3 on a blended patch of feathers near the wing base.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bird_Right_.description: A single large feathered bird wing attached at the upper back, sweeping out and back from the shoulder with a smooth leading edge, rows of small overlapping covert feathers and long layered flight feathers at the tip.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bird_Right_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leading edge and the small covert feathers on one side; colour 1 on the long flight feathers; colour 3 on a band of feathers along the wing's upper spine.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Colossus_01.description: A single large wing mounted on the upper back: a jointed, segmented armature with cracked, vein-like surface detail carries rows of long pointed crystalline feather blades that sweep outward and downward.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented wing armature; colour 1 on the crystal feather blades; colour 3 on the cracks and veining in the armature.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Colossus_01.differs: The wing is shown sweeping out to one side of the body only, with a shorter reach than the male version.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Demon_01.description: A single large bat-like dragon wing sweeping out from the upper back, with thick jointed bony arms, long clawed finger spars and a stretched membrane between them. Reads as a demonic, fantasy back accessory.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Demon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bony arm and finger spars; colour 1 on the membrane between the spars.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Demon_01.differs: The female version shows a single wing extending out to one side, with its shoulder joint at the upper back.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Demon_Large_01.description: A pair of large bat-like demon wings sprouting from the upper back: bony, tapering arm spars with clawed tips support scalloped membranes. The wings sweep outward and upward, with a fantasy, monstrous look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Demon_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony spars and joints; colour 1 on the wing membranes.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Demon_Large_01.differs: The wings are held more symmetrically and closer to the back, with both wings angled upward beside the body.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Draco_01.description: A pair of large bat-like mechanical dragon wings rising from the upper back, with a tall curved spiked leading edge, angular armoured plates and long blade-like feathers that fan down to below the knees.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade-like feather panels and inner struts; colour 1 on the leading-edge armour plates; colour 2 on the gaps and joints; colour 3 on the small gem-like patches on the upper wings.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Draco_01.differs: The wings sit slightly narrower and their long lower blades hang closer to the body than the male version.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Drka_01.description: A pair of large mechanical wings mounted on the upper back: layered angular armored plates at the roots sweep out into long, spiky blade-like feathers that fan upward and outward, giving a sci-fi superhero look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armored root plates and their edges; colour 1 on the long blade-like feathers.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Engine_01.description: A pair of mechanical wings mounted on the back: angular armored engine housings with circular turbine details at the base, sweeping into long rows of layered metallic feather blades that angle up and outward.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Engine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather blades; colour 1 on the engine housing panels and circular details; colour 2 on the housing frame and undersides.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_.description: A single feathered wing attached at the upper back, sweeping outward and up in layered rows of feathers that fan into pointed tips. Folded and compact, it suggests an angelic or superhero look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers nearest the shoulder; colour 1 on the middle band of feathers; colour 2 on the next band; colour 3 on the outer feather tips.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_.differs: The female wing is angled further out to the side and looks more swept back, with a more slender base.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_.description: A single feathered wing attached at the shoulder, swept back and out in a long tapering shape. Rows of layered feathers fan from a small wrapped base, with banded bands of feather colour giving a bird-like superhero look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped base at the shoulder; colour 1 on the inner feathers; colour 2 on the middle feather band; colour 3 on the outer feather tips.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Feathered_01.description: A pair of mechanical bladed wings mounted on round socket joints at the shoulder blades. Each wing sweeps up and out in layered, pointed metallic feathers with contrasting tips, suggesting a sci-fi armoured look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Feathered_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the round shoulder sockets; colour 0 on the wing spars and inner feather plates; colour 2 on the outer feather blades; colour 3 on small accents at the joints.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Feathered_01.differs: The two wings are mirrored and spread evenly, so they look symmetrical from the back.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Beetle_01.description: A compact beetle-wing pack: a domed, rounded shell split into three segments sits on the upper back, its hollow inside holding folded veined membrane wings. Insect-like and mechanical in feel.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Beetle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and inner rim; colour 1 on the upper membrane of the folded wings; colour 3 on the lower wing tips; colour 2 on the wing veins.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Beetle_02.description: A pair of beetle-style insect wings on the back: two rounded, glossy wing-case shells at the shoulders over long, veined translucent wings that sweep down and outward to below the hips, with a rim edge.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Beetle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing-case shells and the wing rims; colour 1 on the veined wing membranes; colour 3 on the wing tips as a gradient; colour 2 on the veins.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Beetle_03.description: A pair of insect beetle wings worn on the upper back: translucent veined membrane wings sweep out and down to each side beneath two rounded, domed shell covers (elytra) that sit over the shoulder blades.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Beetle_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed shell covers and the wing edging; colour 1 and colour 3 on the veined wing membranes, blending from one to the other; colour 2 on the vein lines.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Dragonfly_01.description: Two pairs of translucent dragonfly wings with contrasting vein patterns, mounted on a small metal bracket between the shoulder blades; the wings sweep outward and slightly back, the upper pair above the lower.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Dragonfly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central bracket and wing edges; colours 1 and 3 on the wing membranes as a gradient; colour 2 on the veins.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Insecttriple_01.description: Insectoid back wings: a pair of long, slender upper wings sweeping outward and a cluster of shorter petal-shaped wings below, all with veined translucent membranes, attached to a segmented spine-like mount between the shoulder blades.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Fem_Insecttriple_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented spinal mount and wing edges; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 3 on the wing veins and lower tinting; colour 2 on the wing tips.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Firewing_01.description: A pair of large feathered butterfly-style wings sprouting from the upper back, with long layered swept-back feathers that taper to pointed tips and a gradient of shades across each feather, flaring wide to both sides.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Firewing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the feathers, especially the outer front face; colour 1 on the upper feather tips; colour 3 on the inner back feather band; colour 2 on the feathers nearest the spine.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Firewing_02.description: A pair of large static feathered wings sweeping up and outward from the upper back, built from layered spiky feather blades that fan into pointed tips, with shorter feathers hanging low behind the hips.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Firewing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the feathers and the lower feather fringe; colour 1 on the upper wing tips; colour 3 on the inner feather bands on the back; colour 2 on the inner feathers near the spine.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Firewing_03.description: A pair of static, feathered wings sprouting from the upper back, swept up and outward in jagged flame-like feather tips that taper to points, with longer lower feathers hanging past the hips. Suits fantasy, demonic or gothic looks.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Firewing_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer feather tips and upper wing; colour 2 on the inner wing base and lower feathers; colours 0 and 1 are not visible.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Blade_01.description: A single wing of energy blades attached at the upper back: several long, curved, tapering talon-like blades fan out and sweep upward and back, with a mottled, translucent holographic surface. Suggests a sci-fi or fantasy superhero look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Blade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing blade; the default energy material ignores the other colour slots and glows uniformly.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Fixed_01.description: A pair of rigid, swept-back mechanical wings mounted on a hexagonal hub at the upper back and shoulders. Each wing is a flat angular blade with a slot along its edge; a translucent, cracked holographic texture covers it. Suits a sci-fi hero.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Fixed_01.colourAreas: The default material ignores the colour scheme; the wings show a glowing, translucent crackle across the whole piece, so no colour slot is clearly visible.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Fixed_01.differs: The female version shows a translucent, cracked holographic surface that ignores the colour scheme, rather than the male's solid panels with distinct colour areas.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Ice_01.description: A pair of wings made of jagged, shard-like ice blades in staggered rows, spreading outward and sweeping back from the shoulder blades. The crystalline feathers taper to sharp points and give a fantasy or elemental look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Ice_01.colourAreas: The wings show a glossy crystalline finish that appears to ignore the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are visible.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Ice_01.differs: The female wings are held lower and closer to the back, and they angle downward more than the male wings, which fan up and out.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.description: Two pairs of long, narrow dragonfly wings sprouting from the upper back, each a translucent angular panel with a thin rim and a hexagonal outline, swept outward and slightly back like a mechanical insect.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the translucent wing panels; colour 0 on the thin edge rims; colour 1 shows as a tint on some wing surfaces.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Megaterak_01.description: A pair of mechanical bat-style wings: jointed metal arm frames with rounded shoulder pods, clawed tips and pleated membrane panels fanning between the struts. They spread outward from the upper back in a sci-fi, cyborg look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Megaterak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder pods and joint segments; colour 0 on the strut plating and claw tips; colour 2 on the pleated membrane and the spurs; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_01.description: A single large wing of separate curved, blade-like feather shards that fans out from the upper back, sweeping outward and downward with detached tips floating above. Angular, claw-like and fantasy-styled.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing; no other colour slots are visible on the blades.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_02.description: A pair of flat, tribal-style blade wings with a ring-like hub near the shoulders and long, curved, claw-like feathers sweeping outward and down, plus two tall spikes on top. Sits on the upper back.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing surface; the glossy metal edges show highlights and ignore the other colour slots.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_02.differs: The female wings sit closer to the body and spread out in a more compact fan.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Phoenixflight_01.description: A single large translucent energy wing sweeping out from the upper back, made of layered feather-like streaks that taper into long ragged tips; suggests a flaming phoenix wing in a superhero style.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Phoenixflight_01.colourAreas: Colour scheme appears largely ignored by the glowing energy material; the whole wing shows one glowing tone rather than distinct slots.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A pair of mechanical wings on jointed metal support arms that reach out from the upper back. Each wing has a sleek housing with a round joint, angular blades and layered feather-like panels that sweep back.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the support arms, housings and upper blades; colour 1 on the lower feather panels and joint rings; colour 3 on small accent marks on the housings; colour 2 on the darkest lower feathers.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The female wings appear to be set as a single overlapping pair angled to one side, with arms rising higher above the shoulder.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Scarab_01.description: A pair of insect-style wings mounted on the upper back: each has a curved, hard shell-like plate at the shoulder and a long, tapering membrane with fine radiating veins, swept outward and slightly down.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved shoulder shell plates; colour 2 on the wing membranes; colour 3 on the vein lines and wing edges.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Scarab_01.differs: The female wings sit lower and more swept back, with shorter, narrower shells and the wing tips angled steeply downward.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Scarab_02.description: Butterfly-style wings: two large upper wings sweeping up and out and two long, narrow lower wings sweeping down, all with jagged, notched edges. They attach at the upper back, and the glossy, segmented panels suggest an insectoid fantasy look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the wing surfaces; colour 1 on a few veined panels on the inner wing faces; colour 0 on the edge trim. The glossy material largely ignores the scheme.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Scarab_02.differs: The female wings are more solid and smooth-surfaced, with little visible cell-like segmenting on the wing panels.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Shadow_01.description: A single wing of ragged, smoky shadow rising from the upper back and sweeping outward and back, splitting into long tapering feather-like tendrils with wispy frayed edges. Suggests a dark, spectral fantasy look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Shadow_01.colourAreas: The wing is a energy effect that seems to ignore the colour scheme; no visible use of colour slots 0-3.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Skeleton_01.description: A single bat-like skeletal wing frame made of thin jointed rods, with a main arm and several long finger struts that fan out and curve downward. It attaches at the shoulder and upper back and is worn on one side only, with no membrane between the struts.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rods and finger struts; colour 1 on the joint nodes and connectors; colour 2 on the darker finger tips.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Space_02.description: A pair of mechanical back wings with angular armored spars that sweep up and outward from the shoulder blades, long blade-like feather panels, small stacked thruster fins, and hanging pointed blades below. Sci-fi mecha styling.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Space_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armored wing housings and small stacked fins; colour 1 on the long blade panels and inner blades; colour 2 on the joints and undersides; colour 3 on the small glowing accents at the wing hubs.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Spooky_01.description: A single large bat-like demon wing sweeping out from the upper back, with a thick jagged spiked bone frame and thin membrane stretched between long fingers that taper to points. Gothic, monstrous look.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the spiked bone frame and edges; colour 0 on the upper membrane; colour 1 on the membrane tips and lower edges.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Spooky_01.differs: The female wing sits on one side of the back and extends to the side and behind, while the male has a wider spread with the membrane angled further back.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Statue_01.description: A pair of large feathered angel-style wings rising from the upper back, with rows of long layered flight feathers, a thick rounded leading edge and a bulky shoulder joint. The wings sweep up and out, then taper downward.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Statue_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather surfaces; colour 0 on the feather highlights and tips; colour 2 on the leading edge and shoulder joint; colour 3 on small markings on the wings.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Statue_01.differs: The female wings are more swept back and closer together at the shoulders.

Female/F_Wings_Tight_Tech_01.description: A pair of static mechanical wings: each has a long blade-like upper spar and a fan of narrow blade feathers, mounted on segmented shoulder brackets. They sweep outward and back from the upper back, in a sci-fi style.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spars, feather blades and shoulder brackets; colour 1 on the support struts and the spar tips; colour 2 on small joint details.
Female/F_Wings_Tight_Tech_01.differs: The wings are angled more tightly, sitting close together and swept back from the upper back, whereas the male pair spreads wider apart.

Female/F_Wings_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A pair of large snowflake-shaped wings on the back, each a radiating starburst of six spiky branches with smaller side barbs and diamond-shaped blade tips, fanned out symmetrically around the shoulders and torso.
Female/F_Wings_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the branch arms and barbs; colour 1 on the central inner blades near the spine; colour 2 on the diamond tips.
Female/F_Wings_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The female wings are centred at shoulder height behind the torso, so the snowflakes fan out around the upper body.

Female/F__Tight_Arcane_01.description: A single calf-length boot with a plain soft foot and swirling raised scroll panels up the shaft, ending in a pointed, flared top cuff at front and back. Round orb-like studs sit on the front and sides of the shin.
Female/F__Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 3 on the swirling scroll patterns; colour 1 on the round orbs on the shin; colour 2 on the inside of the pointed top cuff.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Chariot_Flower_Base_0.description: A large flower-shaped vehicle base: layered petals and green leaves fan out around a contrasting bowl, with tall grass blades, small berries and a round patterned wooden disc seat in the centre. Floats around the hips like a lotus.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Chariot_Flower_Base_0.colourAreas: The default material appears to use its own painted textures, mostly ignoring the scheme; no clear colour slot is identifiable on the petals, leaves or disc.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_Space_.description: A large sci-fi chariot vehicle: a wide hull with a contrasting seat, a tall shield-like emblem plate at the front, curved bow-like arms flaring outward, and spiky claw fins along the underside. Ancient pharaonic styling.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_Space_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shield plate, the fins and the hull trim; colour 1 on the hull and the curved outer arms; colour 2 on the seat and panels; colour 3 on the accents on the side struts.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_Space_.description: A half-sphere bowl-shaped globe with a faceted rim, sitting on the ground beneath the figure like a vehicle attachment. It has a wide contrasting band across it and a small separate panel, with a thick lip around the edge.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_Space_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and lip; colour 1 on the main bowl surface; colour 2 on the broad band running over the bowl; colour 3 on the small patches on the inner and outer bowl.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_F_Chariot_02.description: A chariot-style vehicle platform: an open-backed curved tub with a sculpted monstrous face on the front, riveted rims, side fins, a rounded pod underneath with a small turbine fan, and a thin curved rail arching overhead.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_F_Chariot_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tub body, rims and fan ring; colour 3 on the top rim band, edge stripes and side spikes; colour 2 on the side panels; colour 0 on the face, underside pod, floor disc and overhead rail.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_F.description: A long, low hot-rod style vehicle bike with a streamlined body, front radiator grille, round headlamps, exposed engine block, a single rider seat and large rear wheel pods; retro-futuristic and sporty.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body shell and side panels; colour 1 on the swooping stripe panels, engine cover and canopy hump; colour 2 on the wheels, tyres and underside; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_Gl.description: A curved, dome-like windscreen shell for a bike: a thin, smooth canopy shaped like a rounded wedge with an open hollow underside, floating off to one side of the body rather than worn on it.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_Gl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shell; the glossy surface appears to mostly ignore the other colour slots.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_Se.description: A large curved shield-like bike seat panel, a smooth rounded oval slab with a raised rim that tapers into a short flat tab at the bottom. It hangs off the hip and side of the body, angled outward.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_Se.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner face and the outer rim; colour 1 on the outer back panel; colour 2 on the shaded edges and lower back patch.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_03_F.description: A sleek sci-fi hoverbike with a long tapered nose cowl, a low seat with a small windscreen frame, side fins and swept rear blades, and a ribbed circular turbine housing at the back. The rider sits on top of it.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_03_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose cowl and some fairing panels; colour 1 on the main body plates, fins and turbine ring; colour 2 on the panels and engine sections; colour 3 on the seat and inner cockpit area.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_05_F.description: A sleek sci-fi hoverbike with a rounded nose fairing, swept delta wings, twin rear thruster nozzles and a raised seat, with curving panels wrapping the front; the rider sits on top, and the bike hovers beneath her.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_05_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body shell, wing surfaces and thruster housings; colour 1 on the wing stripes, curved side fairings and seat back; colour 2 on the nose intake and underside interior; colour 3 on the accent panels near the front and seat.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Wind.description: A curved, scoop-shaped hoverbike windshield: a smooth angular shell that flares outward and sweeps back to a pointed edge, floating beside the hip as a detached vehicle attachment with a hollow back.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Wind.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shell, outer and inner surfaces; no other colour slots visible.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Wind.description: A hoverbike windshield made of separate translucent glass-like shards: a large swept-back wedge canopy at waist height plus two curved fin-shaped panels floating low at the sides. Sleek and angular, sci-fi vehicle styling.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Wind.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main windshield and side panels; the glassy surface largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ninjabike_01_F.description: A long, sleek motorbike vehicle with a bladed, segmented fairing at the front, a rounded body with a saddle-like seat, a rear wheel housing with a spiked underside and thin antenna-like whiskers. Fantasy-mechanical, insect-like styling.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ninjabike_01_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bladed front fairing plates and trim; colour 1 on the main body shell and rear housing; colour 3 on the seat; colour 2 on the underside and tyres.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_01_F.description: A long, low steampunk hover-bike vehicle with a boxy front cowling, exposed pipes and tubes along the sides, a curved swooping seat and rear fender, and spiked fins at the back; the rider sits on top.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_01_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front stripes, seat and bumper; colour 1 on the body shell and rear fender; colour 3 on the front cowling side panels and end caps; colour 2 on the seat back, rear fins and engine parts.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_Glas.description: A thin, angular V-shaped glass windscreen panel for a steam bike, a flat strip that wraps around the front and sides at hip height with sharp folded corners. It floats separately from the body.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_Glas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole panel; the glassy surface largely ignores the other colour slots.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_Seat.description: A large padded bike seat shaped like a rounded slab that rises behind the body and curves forward into a small tongue at the crotch. It has a thick contrasting edge and a cushioned top, and suits a steampunk or mechanical vehicle look.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_Seat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cushioned seat surface; colour 2 on the thick edge and underside band.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steelshadow_F.description: A long, sleek hover bike with a pointed nose, angular armoured fairings and a rounded rear pod ringed by curved claw-like spines. Spiky fins flare along the sides; the rider seat sits mid-body.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steelshadow_F.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body shells and fairings; colour 0 on the nose, side blades and underlying framework; colour 3 on the seat and rear cowl patches; colour 2 on the underside pod and mechanical parts.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Toxicsteel_01_.description: A long, low hover-bike vehicle with a tapered angular nose, a broad rear housing with a cluster of round exhaust ports, twin cylindrical tanks on top at the back, side pipes, and looping cables. It suggests a rugged sci-fi machine.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Toxicsteel_01_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body and pipes; colour 0 on the edge trim and rim panels; colour 3 on the tanks and handlebar-like fittings; colour 2 on the cables and recesses.

Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Winter_Sleigh_.description: A large ornate sleigh vehicle with a deep curved cabin and bench seat, swooping scrollwork filigree along the sides and front, and long curved runners underneath. Sits around the wearer as a seasonal ride.
Female/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Winter_Sleigh_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the seat, frame struts and runners; colour 1 on the cabin interior and scroll filigree accents; colour 3 on the cabin rim trim and side panels; colour 2 on the underside, wheels and scrollwork.

Female/M_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_02_F.description: A set of four long, jointed mechanical spider legs sprouting from a hub on the upper back, crossing in an X and arching outward around the body, each segmented limb ending in a sharp bladed tip.
Female/M_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_02_F.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main leg segments and spiked tips; colour 0 on the metallic joint plates and edges; colour 1 on small accent panels at the joints; colour 3 on tiny markings near the tips.

Female/M_Back_Holoforce_Insect_02.description: A pair of translucent insect-style wings with fine branching veins, angled outward and down from a small angular mounting plate between the shoulder blades. They hang to about hip height and suit sci-fi, psionic or insect looks.
Female/M_Back_Holoforce_Insect_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing membranes and the mounting plate; colour 0 on the wing veins; colour 1 on the sheen along the wing edges and the small mount inset.

Female/M_Back_Holoforce_Insect_03.description: Two pairs of translucent insect wings with a dense network of veins, spreading from a small angular chest-and-shoulder emblem plate. Upper wings sweep up and out, lower wings hang down and out. Suggests a psionic, holographic fairy or insect look.
Female/M_Back_Holoforce_Insect_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing membranes; colour 0 on the vein lines; colour 1 on the wing tint seen from behind; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Female/M_Cape_Trenchcoat_01.description: A cropped, double-breasted jacket with wide notched lapels, a raised inner collar and two rows of large buttons. Long glossy sleeves end in strapped cuffs, and the body stops at the ribs.
Female/M_Cape_Trenchcoat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and lapels; colour 1 on the sleeves and lapel piping; colour 2 on the buttons; colour 3 on the cuff straps.

Female/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglessport_01.description: Sporty wraparound goggles with a single wide curved lens across both eyes, a raised angular frame along the brow, small side blocks at the temples, and a flat band that circles the head.
Female/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglessport_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow frame and side blocks; colour 1 on the lens; colour 2 on the head strap; colour 3 on the strap segments beside the temples.

Female/M_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_03.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a hollow scalloped shell, with layered angular plates stepped down the outside and small inset slots along its bands. It caps the shoulder and suggests a sci-fi armoured look.
Female/M_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cap and inner rim; colour 1 on the stacked outer plates; colour 3 on the slot inserts; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge gaps.

Female/M_Wings_Holoforce_Insect_01.description: A pair of translucent insect wings with a fine network of veins, sweeping outward and slightly upward from a small angular mounting plate between the shoulder blades. The upper pair is shown, with a psionic, holographic feel.
Female/M_Wings_Holoforce_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing membranes and mounting plate; colour 0 on the wing veins and the small chevron accent on the plate; colour 1 gives a faint sheen on the far wing.

Female/M_Wings_Kaiju_Static_01.description: A pair of large, static mechanical wings that sweep up and outward from a spiky central mount between the shoulder blades. Each wing has a sculpted armoured upper edge with cut-outs and a lower feathered section with small star details.
Female/M_Wings_Kaiju_Static_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armoured upper wing plates; colour 1 on the lower feather panels; colour 3 on the central spiky mount at the spine.

Female/M_Wings_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A pair of angular mechanical wings built from overlapping shard-like metal blades that fan out and sweep back from a compact central plate on the upper back, with small panels wrapping over the shoulders.
Female/M_Wings_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the large blade plates; colour 0 on the edge highlights and small front panels; colour 1 on the inset panels and central back plate; colour 3 on the small accents near the shoulders.

Female/M_Wings_Tight_Bat_01.description: A pair of small bat-style wings worn high on the upper back, each with a thick padded leading edge, scalloped webbed membrane and fingerlike ribs. They are compact, roughly shoulder-width, and sit close to the body.
Female/M_Wings_Tight_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the thick padded wing edges and ribs; colour 3 on the outer membrane panels; colour 1 on the inner membrane panels; colour 0 on the membrane near the shoulder joint.

Female/M_Wings_Tight_Cherub_01.description: A pair of small feathered wings mounted high on the upper back at the shoulder blades, swept outward and back with layered rows of long flight feathers fanning out; a compact angelic, fantasy look.
Female/M_Wings_Tight_Cherub_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper covert feathers near the wing base; colour 1 on the longer flight feathers at the tips. Colours 0 and 2 are not clearly visible.

Female/M_Wings_Tight_Fairy_F_01.description: A pair of slender, fairy-like wings rising from the upper back, each made of a curled spiral tip, a curved main spar and fanned, pointed petal-like fins trailing down past the hips with tiny drooping tendrils.
Female/M_Wings_Tight_Fairy_F_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved main spars and tendril tips; colour 1 on the large fanned petal panels; colour 2 on the upper wing panels; colour 3 on the small accent petals between the fans.

Female/M_Wings_Tight_Tech_Flap_02.description: A pair of small mechanical wings mounted high on the upper back: each has a long slim blade-like spar with a row of shorter angular feather blades hanging below it, and the wings sweep out and back from the shoulder blades.
Female/M_Wings_Tight_Tech_Flap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main spars and feather blades; colour 1 on the tips and end caps of the spars and the joint fittings; colour 2 on the recessed slots and inner panels; colour 3 is not clearly visible.

Female/Vehicle_Glider_Rocker_F_01.description: A flat hovering glider platform with swept-back angular wings, banks of round speaker cones and stacked twin exhaust pipes at the rear, a central tail fin, and star-patterned deck panels. The rider stands on top; it suggests a rock-and-roll stage look.
Female/Vehicle_Glider_Rocker_F_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main body, wings and speaker housings; colour 3 on the central fin and deck stripe; colour 1 on the star markings; colour 0 on the speaker cones and exhaust tips.

Male/C_Wings_Tight_Skeleton_01.description: A pair of bat-like wings reduced to bare skeletal frames: thin jointed bone-like struts fan out from the upper back, with no membrane between the ribs. They sweep wide and back, suggesting a gothic, monstrous look.
Male/C_Wings_Tight_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bone struts; colour 1 on the joint nodes; colour 2 on the finger tips and thin ends.

Male/Character_Librarym_Spadl_Tight_Pris.description: A small angular shoulder pad for the left shoulder: a wedge-shaped armoured cap with a raised ridge, layered panels on top, a thin contrasting edge trim and small vent-like slashes on the underside.
Male/Character_Librarym_Spadl_Tight_Pris.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell and underside; colour 1 on the top panels; colour 0 on the edge trim and border; colour 3 on the small slashes at the underside.

Male/F_Helmetextra_Child_Emblem_01.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central ring, resting on the middle of the forehead like a decal or brand. Suggests a science or superhero insignia.
Male/F_Helmetextra_Child_Emblem_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit bands; colour 1 on the thin outline edges and the central ring.

Male/F_Vehicle_Arachnid_Bike_02.description: A low, hovering spider-like bike body: a segmented mechanical hull with raised armored side pods, a central engine block, and long curved clawed legs sweeping out to each side and forward like a predatory arachnid.
Male/F_Vehicle_Arachnid_Bike_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hull plating and underside; colour 3 on the curved legs, claws and side pods; colour 1 on the thin stripe bands across the hull; colour 2 on the rear armor and engine parts.

Male/Geo_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Bow_01.description: A pair of small, pointed, pillowy cloth tufts sitting over each eye like a ninja mask's knotted ends, slanting outward and slightly upward with creased, gathered folds.
Male/Geo_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both cloth tufts; the piece shows no other colour slots.

Male/Geo_Head_Tight_Cyborg_Dummy_01.description: A smooth, featureless mannequin-style robotic head with a plain face, small rivets on the skull, and a crash-test target plate on each side. A ribbed, segmented neck with exposed cabling sits in a wide collar ring.
Male/Geo_Head_Tight_Cyborg_Dummy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth head shell; colour 1 on the neck collar ring and neck framing; colour 2 on the ribbed neck segments and the target plate quadrants; colour 3 on the neck cables. The yellow plate background is a fixed part of the material and does not follow the scheme.

Male/Geo_Helmet_Face_Plague_Mask_01.description: A plague doctor mask with a long, downward-curving beak, round contrasting eye openings and a hollow back. A thin strap runs around the head, and rows of small studs trim the edges and beak.
Male/Geo_Helmet_Face_Plague_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and head strap; colour 1 on the studs along the edges and beak; colour 2 on the eye openings.

Male/Geo_Helmet_Tight_Cone_01.description: A novelty traffic cone worn as a hat: a tall tapered cone with a flat square base slab that rests on top of the head, with blocky patches and bands wrapped around the cone.
Male/Geo_Helmet_Tight_Cone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone body and parts of the base slab; colour 1 on the large swooping patches of the cone and on the base slab edges; colour 2 on the band around the cone; colour 3 on the rectangular patch near the lower cone.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Chariot_Flower_Sphere_0.description: A large lotus-flower vehicle body made of layered, pointed petals in several rings around a hollow centre, with thin spikes rising between the petals and small mechanical pods or jets on the front sides. It sits low around the hips like a bowl.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Chariot_Flower_Sphere_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front petals, outer petal rims and the small side pods; colour 1 on the inner upright petals; colour 2 on the lowest outer petals and the petal tips; colour 3 on a small inner panel visible at the side.
