Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_02.description: A hovering chariot vehicle: an open-backed, bowl-shaped hull with a monstrous carved face on the front, riveted rim, thin winged blades above, a round jet fan underneath and a rounded pod beneath. The rider stands on a flat platform inside.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hull shell, rim and fan housing; colour 2 on the side panels; colour 3 on the rim band, spikes and fin accents; colour 0 on the face, floor disc, underside pod and upper blades.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_Space_Ph.description: A hovering pharaoh-style space chariot platform: a wedge-shaped hull with a large ornate shield-like crest at the front, curved bow-like side arms with angular tips, and spiked claw fins along the underside. The rider stands on top.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_Space_Ph.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front crest, hull plates, claw spikes and arm tips; colour 1 on the hull body and curved side rails; colour 2 on the seat panels and struts; colour 3 on the arm grips and accent bands.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_Space_Ph.description: A hemispherical bowl-shaped globe, open at the top, with a faceted rim and a broad vertical band running down one side. It sits on the ground below the feet, like a vehicle attachment, with a sci-fi ancient look.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Chariot_Space_Ph.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and outer shell edge; colour 1 on the inner bowl surface and lower shell; colour 2 on the broad vertical band; colour 3 on the small patches near the rim.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_01.description: A hot-rod style hover bike vehicle: long low chassis with a curved rear seat cowl, a grille-like radiator at the front, chunky fender-covered wheels at both ends, and small lamps and exposed engine parts. The rider sits in the middle.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body panels and fenders; colour 1 on the seat cowl and stripe panels along the chassis; colour 2 on the tyres and grille interior; colour 3 on small accents near the rider's controls.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_Glas.description: A curved, shell-like windscreen fairing: a smooth swept dome with a thin rim and hollow back, floating in front of the hips like a vehicle canopy. It suggests a motorbike attachment.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_Glas.colourAreas: The glassy shell appears to ignore the colour scheme; no separate slot areas are distinguishable.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_Seat.description: A large, curved bike seat shell shaped like a rounded paddle, with a broad padded cushion tapering to a narrow flat tail that sweeps forward. It sits at the hips as a separate vehicle attachment.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Holidaybike_Seat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim; colour 1 on one half of the cushion surface; colour 2 on the half of the cushion nearest the tail edge.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_03_M.description: A sci-fi hoverbike: a long streamlined fuselage with a pointed nose, a glass canopy, a ribbed rear engine barrel, small swept stabiliser fins and a central wheel-like drum. The rider sits behind the canopy.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_03_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fuselage, fins and body plating; colour 1 on the engine barrel, seat and lower pods; colour 3 on the intake glows and underside panels; colour 2 on the vents and thruster details. The canopy glass ignores the scheme.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_05.description: A sleek sci-fi hoverbike with a rounded nose canopy, a large curved rear shell, twin rear turbine jets and broad swept wings with small antenna-like fins; the rider sits astride the middle of the body.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose, wings and main body panels; colour 1 on the rear shell, wing stripes and canopy sections; colour 2 on the cockpit and underside details; colour 3 on small accents at the wing tips and inner shell.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Windsh.description: A curved, shell-like hoverbike windshield: a smooth swept plate with a hollow inner side and thin raised edges, tapering toward the front. It hangs at the hip and thigh as a detached, floating shield.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Windsh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell surface; the inner face and edge rim show a shaded tone of the same slot. No other slots are visible.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Windsh.description: A hoverbike windshield attachment: a thin, swept wedge-shaped glass canopy floating at hip height, with two small curved fin-like shards separated below it. Sits around the waist and hips as a detached vehicle part.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Windsh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main windshield and the curved shards; the glassy surface shows little variation from the other colour slots.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Windsh.description: A hoverbike windshield attachment made of a wedge-shaped glass canopy at hip height, with separate curved fin-like shards floating below it at the sides. The pieces hover around the hips and look detached from the body.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Hoverbike_Windsh.colourAreas: Glass material appears to ignore the colour scheme, so no slot clearly applies; any tint comes from the default glass material.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ninjabike_01.description: A long, sleek motorbike vehicle with a pointed, fin-like front fairing of layered plates, a rounded rear housing with a large wheel pod, spiky claw-like protrusions underneath, and a saddle seat where the rider sits.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ninjabike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front fairing plates and body shell; colour 1 on the frame, rear housing and mechanical detailing; colour 3 on the seat and top cowl; colour 2 on the underside wheel pod.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_01.description: A hover-bike shaped like a charging bull: a rounded armoured body with a horned head and long curved horns, side exhaust pipes, a cluster of rear thruster nozzles and a long lance-like spike out front. The rider sits on top.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns, head plating, pipes and back saddle panels; colour 1 on the main body shell and thruster housings; colour 3 on the shoulder patches and lance tip; colour 2 on the thruster interiors and rear hooves.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_02.description: A motorcycle front-end attachment shaped like a bull's head with long curved horns, mounted on a mechanical frame with stacked exhaust pipes to each side and a long slim lance or barrel pointing forward. It sits low around the hips and legs.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns, pipes and frame; colour 1 on the bull's face and lower head panels; colour 2 on the rear head section; colour 3 on the small accents and lance tip.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_03.description: A vehicle engine block: a chunky tapered body carrying a cluster of five flared exhaust nozzles at the rear, with ribbed rings around each nozzle. It sits behind and around the waist like a thruster pack.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Ragingbull_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper casing panels; colour 1 on the front cap, nozzle bells and nozzle rings; colour 2 on the textured lower casing and nozzle bases.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_01.description: A long, low steam-powered hover bike with a padded seat, large rounded front cowling, exposed pipes and mechanical housings along the sides, swept fins at the rear and a thin skirt beneath. The rider sits astride it.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body casing, pipes and cowling stripes; colour 1 on the large body panels, seat back and rear wheel; colour 2 on the seat, tyres and mechanical parts; colour 3 on the front and rear panel inserts.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_Glass_.description: A thin, curved angular strip of glass-like windshield panel that wraps in a shallow V across the hips at the front, with a short upright flap at one side; a small vehicle attachment piece, not clothing.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_Glass_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole windshield strip; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_Seat_0.description: A smooth, curved bike-seat shell shaped like a long rounded saddle, wide at the back and tapering to a narrow nose that curls forward between the legs; it sits at the hips and back like a large rear panel.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steambike_Seat_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main seat surface and nose; colour 2 on the side edges and underside panels.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steelshadow.description: A long, sleek hoverbike vehicle with a pointed nose, two bulbous rounded pods and a rear drum-like housing, decorated with spiky fins, blades and claw-like spurs underneath. It carries the rider seated mid-length, with a mechanical, beastlike sci-fi look.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Steelshadow.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body pods and armor panels; colour 0 on the nose, side fins, spikes and underframe; colour 3 on the tank-like cover behind the rider and the front cap; colour 2 on the underside spheres and the wheel-like parts.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Toxicbike_01.description: A long, low hover-bike vehicle with a pointed wedge nose, chunky rear engine block with a cluster of cylindrical tanks or pistons, side exhaust pipes and looping cables; the rider sits low along its length.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Toxicbike_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body, nose and pipes; colour 3 on the cylinders, handlebars and seat details; colour 0 on the thin trim lines and rim edges; colour 2 on the cables and wheel parts.

Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Winter_Sleigh_01.description: A vehicle-mounted winter sleigh: a deep rounded passenger cab with a curved back and a padded rim, carried on long runners with swirling wrought-iron scrollwork and curling front prongs. Holiday styling with an ornate, Victorian feel.
Male/Geo_Vehicle_Player_Winter_Sleigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the seat rim, runners and main scroll supports; colour 1 on the cab interior and the thin scroll accents; colour 3 on the side panels of the cab; colour 2 on the ironwork curls and undercarriage.

Male/Hair_Child_Face_Extraterrestialmoha.description: A short double mohawk of two parallel rows of sharp, blade-like spikes running front to back along the crown, sweeping backward and flaring into longer pointed tufts at the nape; the sides of the head stay bare.
Male/Hair_Child_Face_Extraterrestialmoha.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike tips at the front; colour 1 on the front and upper spike bodies; colour 2 on the middle of the spikes; colour 3 on the long rear tufts.

Male/Hair_Face_Extraterrestialmohawkdual.description: A short, split mohawk of two parallel rows of sharp, blade-like spikes running from the forehead over the crown to the nape, sweeping backward and flaring into longer pointed tips at the back. Suggests an alien or monstrous look.
Male/Hair_Face_Extraterrestialmohawkdual.colourAreas: Colour 0 at the roots of the front spikes; colour 1 on the spike bodies, fading toward the tips; colour 2 in the middle of the crest; colour 3 on the long rear tips.

Male/Helmet_Face_Mooseskull_01_Basic.description: A moose skull headpiece with a long snout covering the nose and brow and huge flat palmate antlers spreading wide to each side, tipped with spikes. A fabric hood-like drape hangs down the back of the head and neck.
Male/Helmet_Face_Mooseskull_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and antlers; colour 2 on the swirling markings, spike tips and band at the neck; colour 1 on the draped neck cloth.

Male/M_Armsaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_2025_0.description: A single fin-like blade running along the outer left forearm, tapering to a point at the wrist, with several curved frilly spikes along its edge and a tall curled tip near the elbow. Fantasy, aquatic creature styling.
Male/M_Armsaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the fin; colour 3 on the frilled spikes and edge tips, blending into colour 1 toward the middle.

Male/M_Armsaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_2025_0.description: A single organic fin-like blade running along the outside of the right forearm, with a smooth tapered base and several curved, frilled spurs branching off toward the elbow. It suggests aquatic creature styling.
Male/M_Armsaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the fin; colour 3 on the spur tips and upper edges, blending into colour 1.

Male/M_Back_Alien_01.description: A narrow spinal ridge of layered, curved blade-like fins running down the centre of the upper back, each fin ending in a sharp spike. A jagged central strip pokes out past the shoulders. Alien, organic-armor look.
Male/M_Back_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central ridge strip and fin edges; colour 1 on the curved fin panels; colour 2 on the inner fin shadows and undersides; colour 3 on the spike tips.
Male/M_Back_Alien_01.differs: The male ridge runs a little longer down the spine, with more closely packed spikes.

Male/M_Back_Alien_02.description: A pair of segmented mechanical arms that sprout from the upper back and arch up and over the shoulders, each ending in a large finned claw with a curved talon. Alien, insectoid cyborg look.
Male/M_Back_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented arm sections; colour 2 on the joint bands between segments; colour 1 on the claw heads; colour 3 on the curved talons.

Male/M_Back_Amazon_Blade_01.description: A straight sheathed sword carried diagonally across the back, hilt rising above the right shoulder. It has a wrapped grip, round pommel, winged guard and a long tapering blade in a ridged scabbard.
Male/M_Back_Amazon_Blade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pommel and metal fittings; colour 3 on the grip wrap; colour 1 on the winged guard and scabbard mouth; colour 2 on the scabbard and blade.

Male/M_Back_Animal_Snake_01.description: A narrow spinal ridge of overlapping, pointed scale plates running down the centre of the back from between the shoulder blades to the lower back, tapering at the ends. It suggests a snake or reptile.
Male/M_Back_Animal_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth central strip along the spine; colour 3 on the overlapping scale plates.

Male/M_Back_Astronaut_01.description: A boxy two-tier astronaut life-support backpack of padded, quilted cloth, with a smaller upper block on a larger lower block, a thin antenna on top, and a contrasting harness plate with straps facing the body. Reads as retro space gear.
Male/M_Back_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded casing; colour 1 on the horizontal bands, back vents and harness straps; colour 2 on the harness plate, antenna and back hatch; colour 3 on the small lights and strap ends.

Male/M_Back_Backpack_Cat_01.description: A cute plush cat backpack clinging to the upper back: rounded stuffed body with pointed ears, big round eyes, dangling tail and small bat-like wings spread out at the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Backpack_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cat body and wing bones; colour 1 on the wing membranes and neck bow; colour 2 on the inner ears; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Back_Backpack_Halloween_01.description: A soft cloth trick-or-treat sack worn as a backpack, tapering to the bottom, printed with crescent moons, stars and swirls. Its contrasting rim overflows with candy canes, a round bomb-like sweet and wrapped treats. Cute holiday styling.
Male/M_Back_Backpack_Halloween_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sack body; colour 3 on the crescents, stars and candy stripes; colour 1 on the swirls, the band below the rim and some sweets; colour 2 on the rim, the bottom patch and the candy sticks.

Male/M_Back_Bat_Saw_01.description: A baseball bat with a circular saw blade fixed to its head, slung diagonally across the back with the saw resting above the shoulder and the handle ending near the hip. Improvised, mechanical street-weapon look.
Male/M_Back_Bat_Saw_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the saw blade and the bat handle; colour 3 on the bat barrel and the end knob; colour 2 on the grip bands and the saw's inner ring.

Male/M_Back_Blacktalonrocketpack_01.description: A mechanical backpack with a wide armored plate across the upper back and two articulated arms rising over the shoulders, each holding a boxy rocket pod with vented panels. Wraps slightly over the shoulders with small flat tabs at the front.
Male/M_Back_Blacktalonrocketpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and pod casings; colour 1 on the pod end panels and back plate inserts; colour 2 on the joints, arm mounts and edge trim; colour 3 has no clear use.
Male/M_Back_Blacktalonrocketpack_01.differs: The rocket pods sit slightly lower and further apart on the male version.

Male/M_Back_Bow_01.description: A large puffy bow worn across the upper back, with two rounded loops meeting at a central knot and two long tails hanging down the spine to the thighs. Cute, decorative and slightly mechanical in style.
Male/M_Back_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot, loop edging and the tails' outer strips; colour 1 on the outer faces of the loops and the tail centres; colour 2 on the loop tips and tail panels; colour 3 on the loop undersides.

Male/M_Back_Cannon_01.description: A backpack-mounted pair of heavy cannons: a rounded armored plate sits between the shoulder blades and two tall segmented barrels rise past the shoulders, angled forward, linked by looped ribbed cables.
Male/M_Back_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the backplate and barrel housings; colour 1 on the barrel bodies, vent panel and cable bands; colour 3 on the muzzle discs and the joint connectors.

Male/M_Back_Cannonarm_01.description: A pair of large mechanical cannons mounted on the upper back, each with a streamlined casing, a rounded intake at the base and a long multi-barrel muzzle rising above the shoulders. Sci-fi heavy-weapon style.
Male/M_Back_Cannonarm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casings; colour 1 on the barrel shrouds and edge panels; colour 2 on the intakes and inner mechanisms; colour 3 on small accent lights near the muzzles.
Male/M_Back_Cannonarm_01.differs: The two cannons are spaced wider apart across the shoulders and angle outward more than on the female.

Male/M_Back_Child_Backpack_Cat_01.description: A pair of small stylised wings sitting on the upper back, one at each shoulder blade. Each has a slim curved bone-like spar with jagged, feather-like tips that sweep outward, giving a cute, fantastical look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Backpack_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing spars; colour 1 on the jagged feather-like tips.

Male/M_Back_Child_Backpack_Halloween_01.description: A small cluster of holiday sweets worn at the upper back near the neck: candy canes, a striped wrapped candy, a round bomb-like sweet, a mitten-like contrasting lump and a striped stick poking out in several directions.
Male/M_Back_Child_Backpack_Halloween_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the candy cane and candy stripes and the wrapper; colour 3 on the stripes of the canes and the round candy; colour 1 on the lump and wrapper twists; colour 2 on the round sweet and the stick.
Male/M_Back_Child_Backpack_Halloween_01.differs: The male version sits a little lower and more spread out across the shoulder, with the contrasting stick striped in contrasting trim.

Male/M_Back_Child_Cannon_01.description: A pair of chunky mechanical cannons mounted over the shoulders on the back, standing upright and angled slightly forward with the muzzles above the shoulders. Each has an octagonal barrel, segmented armored casing and a narrow tapering rear connector. Sci-fi heavy weapon backpack.
Male/M_Back_Child_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer barrel casing and housing plates; colour 0 on the inner segments and rim highlights; colour 3 on the muzzle caps; colour 2 on the small joints and connectors.
Male/M_Back_Child_Cannon_01.differs: The two cannons are mounted symmetrically at the same height, standing more upright and closer to the head.

Male/M_Back_Child_Cryo_01.description: Two separate curved, glossy flat panels stacked on the upper and lower back with a gap between them, each slightly wrapped around the torso like a shield plate. Suggests a minimalist sci-fi back unit.
Male/M_Back_Child_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both back panels; the glossy default material shows little of the other colour slots.

Male/M_Back_Child_Cryo_02.description: A scatter of small faceted crystal or ice chunks clustered down the upper and mid back along the spine, thinning out toward the lower back. Sits directly on the body like frozen growths, with a cryogenic feel.
Male/M_Back_Child_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crystal chunks; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Back_Child_Cryo_03.description: A pair of woven shoulder straps that loop over each shoulder and under the arms like a harness, each fastened with a chunky mechanical buckle clip. The two straps sit separate, with loose open ends, in a sci-fi utility style.
Male/M_Back_Child_Cryo_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the woven straps; colour 1 on the buckle housings; colour 2 on the buckle clasp edges and fittings.
Male/M_Back_Child_Cryo_03.differs: The two straps are separate loops that sit apart on each shoulder and chest, with the ends splaying wider across the back.

Male/M_Back_Child_Feathers_01.description: Four long, blade-like feathered limbs radiating from the upper back, two per side, sweeping outward and down past the hips with jagged serrated tips. A mechanical, winged look suited to sci-fi or monstrous designs.
Male/M_Back_Child_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather shafts and inner vanes; colour 3 on the serrated outer tips; colour 0 on the light streaks near the middle of each feather.
Male/M_Back_Child_Feathers_01.differs: The male version's feathers are somewhat shorter and sit lower, with a flatter outward sweep.

Male/M_Back_Child_Feathers_02.description: A pair of long, whip-like feathered tendrils sprouting from the lower back, sweeping outward and down past the hips. Each has a serrated feather fringe along a thin spine and ends in a large eye-marked plume. Fantasy or monstrous look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Feathers_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather vanes near the base; colour 2 on the thin spine; colour 0 on the serrated fringe edges; colour 3 on the eye-marked end plumes.

Male/M_Back_Child_Feathers_03.description: Six long, curved peacock-style feathers fanning out from the upper back in two tiers, with thin stems, eye-spot tips on the upper pair and broad swept blades on the lower pair. Fantasy, decorative back accessory.
Male/M_Back_Child_Feathers_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long feather stems and barbs; colour 3 on the broad feather blades and eye-spot surrounds; colour 0 on the fringe edges; colour 2 on the eye-spot centres and vane shafts.
Male/M_Back_Child_Feathers_03.differs: The male feathers arc higher and curve further forward over the shoulders, with the upper pair angled outward.

Male/M_Back_Child_Future_01.description: A pair of small mechanical ring thrusters floating at the lower back, each a thick octagonal hoop with a glowing inner ring and a short angular nozzle bracket. Suggests compact futuristic wings.
Male/M_Back_Child_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer hoops; colour 3 on the inner rings; colour 1 on the nozzle brackets.
Male/M_Back_Child_Future_01.differs: The male rings sit lower, near the hips and lower back, and are held closer to the body.

Male/M_Back_Child_Ghost_Hunter_01.description: A pair of padded backpack-style shoulder straps that arch over each shoulder, with a piped edge and a small end tab, then trail down as thin webbing straps across the chest and back. Sits as a light harness.
Male/M_Back_Child_Ghost_Hunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the padded strap tops; colour 0 on the piping edges and underside of the straps; colour 3 on the small end tabs; colour 2 on the thin trailing webbing.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_01.description: A pair of slender helicopter rotor blades floating in a line above the head, each blade tapering from a small central hub with a ringed joint, giving a playful mechanical look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade surfaces; colour 1 on the stripes and bands along each blade; colour 2 on the blade tips; the central hubs take a shade.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_01.differs: The male blades have contrasting colour stripes and contrasting tips, while the female blades show as a single uniform glossy shade.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_02.description: A pair of separate jet-pack pods floating out to each side of the back, each a domed rounded engine with a winglike panel, small vertical thrusters and pointed tips. A mechanical, sci-fi superhero flight rig.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the engine domes, wing panels and thrusters; colour 1 on the panel insets, dome caps and piping; colour 3 on the vents on the domes; colour 2 on small joints.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Bla.description: A plain placeholder cube with flat faces and sharp edges, shown floating near the body. No jetpack or helicopter details are visible, so it reads as an unfinished or stand-in model.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Bla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cube; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Blu.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges, floating near the body. It does not show any jetpack or rotor detail, so its real form is unclear.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Blu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Gre.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges, floating near the back with no visible jetpack or rotor detail. Little can be told about its intended style.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Gre.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cube; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Gre.description: A plain, featureless cube placeholder floating in the zoomed views, with no visible jetpack or helicopter detail and no attachment to the body. Nothing shows on the full-body views, so little can be said about its real form.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Gre.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cube faces; the shading looks uniform, with no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Ora.description: A plain placeholder-like cube with flat faces and sharp edges, floating in the zoomed views; it does not show as an attached jetpack or helicopter shape and is not visible on the full body.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Ora.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cube; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Pin.description: A plain cube-shaped block with flat faces and sharp edges, shown floating with no visible straps or jetpack detail. It is not visible on the full-body views, so its placement on the back is unclear.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Pin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cube; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Pur.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges, floating near the body. It shows no jetpack or helicopter detail, so its actual form is unclear.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Pur.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Red.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges. It floats near the body and no jetpack or rotor detail is visible, so it does not read as a helicopter pack.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Red.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Whi.description: A plain cube-shaped block with flat faces and sharp edges, seemingly a placeholder for a jetpack. It is not visible on the body in the full views, so nothing more can be said about its placement.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Whi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Yel.description: A plain cube-shaped placeholder block with flat faces and sharp edges. It floats near the body without visibly attaching to it, and no jetpack or helicopter details can be seen.
Male/M_Back_Child_Helicopter_Jetpack_Yel.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole block; the faces show only shading differences, and no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Back_Child_Jetengine_01.description: A pair of thin curved harness straps that arch over each shoulder, run down the front of the chest and the back, and end in small tips near the ribs. The straps look like the mounting for a jet pack.
Male/M_Back_Child_Jetengine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the small connector tips at the strap ends.

Male/M_Back_Child_Jetengine_02.description: A pair of boxy jet engine pods mounted at the shoulder blades, each with a vented rear grille, bolted corners and a downward exhaust nozzle, with long segmented swept-out wings extending sideways from each pod.
Male/M_Back_Child_Jetengine_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pod casings and wings; colour 1 on the exhaust nozzles and the intake tops; colour 3 on the rear vent grilles; colour 2 on the bolts.

Male/M_Back_Child_Kaiju_01.description: A single-sided cluster of jagged, overlapping spikes sweeping outward from a smooth rounded panel that runs down one side of the upper back and chest. Monstrous, kaiju-like dorsal ridge with a spiky, aggressive silhouette.
Male/M_Back_Child_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the smooth panel and the outer spikes; colour 2 on the darker inner spike layers.
Male/M_Back_Child_Kaiju_01.differs: The male panel is wider and more rounded, with a thicker rim, and the spikes form a shorter, denser cluster.

Male/M_Back_Child_Kaiju_02.description: A small monstrous growth on the lower back: a smooth rounded ridge that wraps toward the flank, with clusters of jagged spikes and layered shards running down its length. Suggests a kaiju or alien organic look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer spikes and the smooth rounded ridge; colour 2 on the inner recesses between the spikes.
Male/M_Back_Child_Kaiju_02.differs: The male spikes sit more compactly along the spine, in a taller, narrower cluster that is less spread out to the side.

Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_01.description: A small stuffed shisa lion-dog charm hanging by a twisted cord beside the shoulder, floating off the body. It has a plush rounded body, upright ears, a circular eye rosette, a starburst mane motif and dangling tassels; suggests festive east-asian lantern styling.
Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plush body; colour 0 on the mane starbursts, cord and toe studs; colour 3 on the eye rosettes and tassels; colour 2 on the ears and underside.

Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_02.description: A small paper lantern hanging on a twisted wire loop with a hook, floating off to the side of the back. Ribbed octagonal cylinder body with flat caps top and bottom and a splashed ink-brush pattern on one face.
Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the lantern body; colour 1 on the top and bottom caps; colour 2 on the ink-brush pattern; colour 0 on the wire loop and hook.

Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_03.description: A ribbed accordion-style paper lantern hanging from a looped hanger cord, floating beside the body at shoulder height. Its stacked pleats form a cylinder with flat caps, and a calligraphy-like glyph marks one side.
Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the pleated lantern body and caps; colour 1 on the hanging loop; colour 3 on the glyph marking.

Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_04.description: A small round paper-style lantern charm hanging from a looped cord, with a capped top collar, a scalloped contrasting band across the upper dome, a small base fitting and a long tassel. It floats beside the hip as a back accessory.
Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the lantern body; colour 2 on the scalloped upper band; colour 0 on the top and bottom caps; colour 1 on the loop cord and tassel.

Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_05.description: A small hanging pagoda-style lantern with a flared, upturned roof, a square windowed body of paned glowing panels, and a base with clasps. It dangles from a looped cord and ring, floating beside the hip like a charm.
Male/M_Back_Child_Lantern_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the roof, frame and base; colour 3 on the window panes; colour 2 on the base clasps and cord; colour 0 on the metal ring and bottom pin.

Male/M_Back_Child_Mane_Spikey_01.description: A small, mane-like tuft of layered, jagged spikes worn on the lower back at the waist, with a solid faceted cap at the top and pointed strands that fade in tone toward the tips.
Male/M_Back_Child_Mane_Spikey_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted cap and the upper spikes; colour 0 on the central strands and spike tips; colour 2 on the darker shading between the strands.

Male/M_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_01.description: Four mechanical spider legs sprout from the upper back, two rising above the shoulders and two sweeping down past the hips. Each is a jointed, segmented limb ending in a flat, curved blade tip; a sci-fi villain look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light inner limb segments; colour 2 on the darker outer limb segments; colour 1 on the blade tips.

Male/M_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_02.description: Four jointed mechanical spider legs sprouting from the upper back, two arching up over the shoulders and two reaching down past the hips, with slim segmented limbs, round joints and curved blade tips.
Male/M_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blades and main limb sections; colour 3 on the middle limb segments; colour 1 on the round joints; colour 0 on the short collars and bands beside the joints.
Male/M_Back_Child_Mecha_Spider_02.differs: The male legs show contrasting segments: contrasting blades, banded limbs and round joints. They are also shorter, with a tighter, more X-shaped spread.

Male/M_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_01.description: A pair of tall mechanical weapon pods worn on the back, each a boxy housing with a round drum and a long, thin, ringed barrel rising well above the head; held by a strap band at the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings and drums; colour 1 on the barrels, frames and joints; colour 2 on the strap bands and barrel rings; colour 3 on the barrel tip lights.
Male/M_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_01.differs: The male pods sit further apart and point more upright across the broader back.

Male/M_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_02.description: A pair of boxy mechanical cylinder canisters that float out to either side of the torso, each with a capped top, a side nozzle and a vented panel. Sci-fi gadget pods suggesting a tactical payload pack.
Male/M_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the caps on top; colour 2 on the vent slots and nozzle; colour 3 on the small marks on the front panel.
Male/M_Back_Child_Nighthawk_2025_02.differs: The male canisters are larger and hang further out from the body, and appear without the small marks on the front panel.

Male/M_Back_Child_Renegade_01.description: A small mechanical hose or cable worn on one shoulder: a ribbed nozzle on a jointed connector with a long flexible tube that loops down over the chest and back, ending in a tip. Sci-fi accessory.
Male/M_Back_Child_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nozzle and tube tips; colour 1 on the connector joint; colour 3 on the flexible tube.
Male/M_Back_Child_Renegade_01.differs: The nozzle is longer and ribbed and the tube loop is tighter and shorter, sitting closer to the shoulder.

Male/M_Back_Child_Renegade_02.description: A single flexible hose or cable that runs from a funnel-shaped metal nozzle at the shoulder, across the upper chest and around under the arm, ending in a small pointed tip. A banded collar joins the nozzle to the hose.
Male/M_Back_Child_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nozzle and the tip; colour 1 on the band ring where the nozzle meets the hose; colour 3 on the hose.
Male/M_Back_Child_Renegade_02.differs: The hose is longer and bends in sharper angles, stretching further across the chest.

Male/M_Back_Child_Seacreature_03.description: A pair of spiky, layered fin-like wings mounted on the upper back, with jagged ribbed blades that sweep outward and upward from the spine. Suggests an aquatic or alien creature look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Seacreature_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ribbed fin surfaces; colour 1 on the edging and bands along the fins; colour 3 on the accent stripes; colour 2 on the darkest blade tips and underside.

Male/M_Back_Child_Skateboard_01.description: Two small skateboard truck assemblies with paired wheels, one perched at the base of the neck and one at the lower back. They read as a split, playful street-style back accessory.
Male/M_Back_Child_Skateboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the truck axles and mounting plates; colour 2 on the wheels.

Male/M_Back_Child_Skateboard_02.description: A flat atom-symbol decal on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring. It lies flush against the body with no thickness, like a printed emblem on a suit.
Male/M_Back_Child_Skateboard_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outlines of the orbits and nucleus; colour 0 on the fill inside the orbit lines.

Male/M_Back_Child_Snowball_01.description: A pair of segmented, curved metal pipes rising from the upper back, one bending forward over the shoulder to a round fan-like nozzle while the other stands shorter and upright with its nozzle facing forward.
Male/M_Back_Child_Snowball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pipe segments and nozzle rims; colour 1 on the nozzle faces; colour 2 on the ring around each hub; colour 3 on the central hub.
Male/M_Back_Child_Snowball_01.differs: The male version has one pipe upright and shorter with its nozzle facing forward, and the other bent forward, so the pair looks more asymmetric than the female one.

Male/M_Back_Child_Snowball_02.description: Two floating clusters of snow-capped, icicle-fringed chunks hovering on either side of the head at ear height, each a lumpy snow mound above jagged dripping ice shards. Wintry fantasy look, not attached to the body.
Male/M_Back_Child_Snowball_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snow mounds and ice shards; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Back_Child_Snowball_03.description: A pair of woven webbing harness straps that loop over each shoulder and cross under the arms, each with a small mechanical buckle housing at the shoulder and loose strap ends. Minimal, playful gear look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Snowball_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbing straps; colour 1 on the buckle housings and their panels; colour 2 on the buckle edges and fittings.

Male/M_Back_Child_Space_01.description: Three small glossy spherical nodes stacked in a vertical line down the spine, from the base of the neck to the mid-back. They read as mechanical studs or ports and suit a futuristic look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Space_01.colourAreas: The glossy metallic spheres appear to ignore the colour scheme, so no slot shows clearly on them.

Male/M_Back_Child_Speakers_01.description: A backpack of two tall speaker cabinets rising above the shoulders, each with paired woofer rings and strapped mid-height, mounted on a wide boombox-style base unit with twin speakers and a central handle block.
Male/M_Back_Child_Speakers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cabinet shells, straps and base casing; colour 1 on the speaker grille panels; colour 2 on the central handle block and woofer rims; colour 3 on the small studs and ring accents.

Male/M_Back_Child_Teleos_01.description: A floating glowing ring-shaped energy orb hovering at the centre of the upper back, orbited by four small translucent egg-shaped shards scattered around the shoulders and ribs. Not attached to the body; suggests a sci-fi power source.
Male/M_Back_Child_Teleos_01.colourAreas: The glowing ring and shards ignore the colour scheme and show as self-lit energy; no colour slots visibly apply.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_01.description: A back-mounted armored tail of three stacked, segmented plates that curls up from the mid-back and over one shoulder, with scratch marks and blotchy panels. Sleek, scorpion-like, monstrous look with small pointed edges.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 2 on the blotches and inner edges; colour 3 on the small flecks; colour 1 is barely visible.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_01.differs: The male version sits more centrally on the upper back, with a chunkier, tighter curl that rises higher behind the head.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_02.description: A pair of mechanical arm-like spikes mounted at the base of the neck, each with a cuffed socket that bends outward and sweeps up past head height into a thin pointed tip, like robotic insect pincers.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main arm segments; colour 1 on the socket cuffs; colour 2 on the joint bands and elbow sections.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_02.differs: The male arms are more upright and evenly matched in height, with straighter tips and a slightly narrower spread.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_03.description: A small V-shaped armor plate that hangs over the upper chest, held by two chunky linked chains that rise over the shoulders toward the neck. It has claw-scratch marks and segmented panels, in a feral mechanical style.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Blackfang_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface and scratched area; colour 2 on the segmented panels; colour 3 on the small studs or dots on the panels; colour 1 on the chain links.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A back-mounted fan of six long, tapering cylindrical pods with contrasting tips, splayed upward and outward from the upper back and rising above the shoulders like mechanical spines. Suggests a sci-fi or cyberpunk backpack.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pod bodies; colour 2 on the pod tips and darker inner sections; colour 0 and colour 3 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Cybergrid_01.differs: The male version fans the pods wider and more upright, rising higher behind the head, while the female's are more compact and angled sideways.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Demon_Huge_01.description: A pair of large bat-like demon wings sprouting from the upper back, each with a bony arm and long fingered spars that stretch a scalloped membrane outward and slightly upward in a wide spread.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Demon_Huge_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 0 on the bony spars and edge ridges.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Hunchback_Hair_0.description: A strip of coarse, striped fur running down the spine from the neck to the lower back, with jagged spiky tufts along the ridge and a ragged tapering edge. Suits a werewolf or beast look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Hunchback_Hair_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur edges and lower fur; colour 1 on the central ridge and spiky tufts; colour 2 on the stripe markings; colour 3 on a few accent stripes.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.description: Four long segmented mechanical tentacle arms sprout from a central mount on the upper back. Two arch up over the shoulders and two sweep down and outward, each ending in a three-pronged claw with a collar-like joint.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm segments; colour 2 on the joint bands and claw prongs; colour 1 on the claw wrist collars; colour 3 on the thin stripe running along each arm.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_02.description: A pair of segmented mechanical tentacle arms rising from the upper back, arching up and over the head and forward. Each ends in a boxy wrist joint with a spread of pointed claws, in a villainous sci-fi style.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented arm plates; colour 3 on the thin cable lines along the arms; colour 1 on the wrist housings; colour 2 on the claws and base mounts.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_03.description: A pair of long segmented mechanical tentacle arms rising from the upper back, arcing out past the shoulders and curling forward around the body to end in three-pronged claw hands near the hips. Suggests a supervillain harness.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light segments along the arms; colour 2 on the underside of the arms; colour 3 on the thin stripe along each arm; colour 1 on the claw wrist housings; claw prongs stay near black.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Mecha_Claw_03.differs: The male arms curl more widely around the body, with one claw sweeping forward at the front and the other held out to the side.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_01.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem worn on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a hexagonal core with a small central ring. It lies flush against the body like a printed badge.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and core; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_02.description: A flat atom-symbol emblem printed on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central ring. It lies flush against the body like a decal and suits a sci-fi or superhero look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_03.description: A flat atom-style emblem on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central ring, with a thin raised outline. It sits flush on the shoulder blades, suggesting a science-themed superhero look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tight_Shield_Basic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit bands and central ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging.

Male/M_Back_Child_Tubes_01.description: A pair of curved, segmented mechanical tubes that rise from behind the shoulders and arc forward over them, ending in open, ragged tips at the back. Banded ridges mark each segment, giving a cyborg or mechanical-limb look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tubes_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tube bodies; colour 3 on the thin bands between segments.
Male/M_Back_Child_Tubes_01.differs: The male tubes are longer and arc higher, with the front tips curling forward toward the face. They are more evenly mirrored.

Male/M_Back_Child_Vigilante_01.description: A bundle of three long arrows slung diagonally across the back, with feathered fletching poking up past the shoulder and barbed, multi-pronged heads hanging near the lower back. A vigilante archer look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fletching feathers; colour 0 on the arrow shafts; colour 2 on the barbed arrowheads.

Male/M_Back_Child_Weapon_Broadsword_02.description: Three broadswords appear driven through the upper back and shoulder, with blades poking out the front of the chest and shoulder. Each has a straight crossguard, short grip and round pommel; runic etched blades suggest a grim fantasy look.
Male/M_Back_Child_Weapon_Broadsword_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blades; colour 3 on the etched runes and blood-like markings along the blades; colour 2 on the crossguards, grips and pommels.

Male/M_Back_Child_Wings_Patriot_01.description: A pair of large feathered wings rising from the upper back, arching up and out then sweeping down to long pointed tips below the hips, with layered feather rows and a bordered leading edge.
Male/M_Back_Child_Wings_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper feather row; colour 1 on the middle feather row; colour 2 on the long lower flight feathers; colour 3 on the leading edge trim.
Male/M_Back_Child_Wings_Patriot_01.differs: The male wings spread wider apart and flare further outward, with a broader arch than the female version.

Male/M_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_01.description: A pair of mechanical thruster wings worn on the upper back: two long, angled armoured pods with slim fin-like blades and small vented tips fanning outward and down past the shoulders, in a sleek sci-fi superhero style.
Male/M_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main pod shells and blades; colour 0 on the inner panels and plating; colour 3 on the small fins and vent accents; colour 2 on the thruster nozzles and recesses.

Male/M_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_02.description: A pair of mechanical thruster wings mounted at the shoulder blades, each made of several long tapering pods angled backward and down, with segmented armored casings, nozzle tips and contrasting intake housings at the front.
Male/M_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main pod casings; colour 0 on the banding and edge stripes; colour 3 on the nozzle tips and side fins; colour 2 on the intake housings and inner recesses.
Male/M_Back_Child_Wings_Thruster_02.differs: The male wings sit higher and closer together across the upper back, with the pods fanning out in a wider spread on each side.

Male/M_Back_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A small mechanical backpack plate sitting between the shoulder blades, with angular armored panels and two jointed robotic arms that arc over the shoulders and reach down onto the upper chest with clawed tips.
Male/M_Back_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jointed arms and inner plates; colour 1 on the arm trim and side stripes; colour 2 on the main back plates; colour 3 on small accents at the arm tips and the joint panel.
Male/M_Back_Clockwork_Armor_01.differs: The male arms spread wider and lie flatter across the shoulders, with a smaller back plate.

Male/M_Back_Cosmic_01.description: A pair of tall, thin angular back panels that rise behind the shoulders like mechanical wings. Each is a segmented, zigzagging plate with layered stripes, angled inward toward the spine and sitting off the upper back.
Male/M_Back_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate edges and framing; colour 1 on the long stripe panels; colour 2 on the zigzag inset segments; colour 3 on the small accent blocks near the lower tips.

Male/M_Back_Cosmos_01.description: A large floating metal ring standing upright behind the head and shoulders, with four sharp diamond-shaped spikes set around it at the top, both sides and the bottom. Suggests a halo-like mechanical sci-fi backpiece.
Male/M_Back_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring's inner highlights; colour 2 on the ring body; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 3 on the diamond inlays in the spikes.

Male/M_Back_Crusher_Blade_01.description: A large mechanical broadsword carried diagonally across the back, with a chunky blocky hilt of stacked metal segments, a hollow open-frame blade with rungs and a pointed tip, hanging down past the hip.
Male/M_Back_Crusher_Blade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hilt blocks and blade rungs; colour 1 on the hilt centre accents; colour 2 on the grip and pommel; colour 3 on the blade frame.
Male/M_Back_Crusher_Blade_01.differs: The male sword lies at a shallower diagonal across the back, with the tip angled out toward the side, rather than hanging steeply.

Male/M_Back_Cryo_01.description: A mechanical cryo backpack: a tall clear glass cylinder with a capped, camera-like top, a bulky lower base of rocket-shaped pods and vents, looping hoses, and shoulder straps. Sits high on the back in a sci-fi style.
Male/M_Back_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cap and lower pods; colour 0 on the shoulder straps and the top housing trim; colour 2 on the base vents and panels; colour 3 on the hoses. The cylinder is clear glass and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Back_Crystal_01.description: A cluster of faceted, elongated crystal shards fanned out from one side of the upper back and reaching around the shoulder to the front, with one large shard on top. Glossy and angular, it suggests a fantasy or mystic look.
Male/M_Back_Crystal_01.colourAreas: The glossy crystal material largely ignores the colour scheme; no clear slot is visible on any of the shards.
Male/M_Back_Crystal_01.differs: The male cluster is bunched toward one shoulder with a larger shard on top, and it reaches further around the front of the chest.

Male/M_Back_Cyberpubk_Monster_01.description: A segmented mechanical spine crest running down the upper back from the neck to mid-back, made of stacked plate blocks with pairs of long curved contrasting spikes jutting out sideways, tapering in size toward the bottom.
Male/M_Back_Cyberpubk_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stacked spine segments; colour 1 on the joint housings holding the spikes; colour 2 on the curved spikes; colour 3 on the thin seam lines and small rivets between segments.

Male/M_Back_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A tapering, leaf-shaped back piece running from between the shoulder blades down the spine, with a smooth inner face and an outer surface of rippled, flame-like ridges that flare into pointed tips at the side.
Male/M_Back_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth inner panel and the ridged body of the piece; colour 1 on the flared ridge tips and the lower texture on the outer surface.

Male/M_Back_Element_Fire_01.description: A cluster of jagged, flame-shaped tongues that sits on the upper back and pokes through to the chest front, like fire bursting out of the torso. Glossy, ragged edges give it a fantastical elemental look.
Male/M_Back_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; the flame tongues show a glossy finish with faint colour 1 highlights, and the chest-side burst shows a bright glossy sheen.

Male/M_Back_Engine_01.description: A single mechanical wing mounted on the upper back: an angular engine housing with circular turbine details and a hexagonal port, sweeping out into rows of long, flat metallic feather blades. Suggests a sci-fi jet or angel wing.
Male/M_Back_Engine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather blades and the hexagonal port rim; colour 1 on the engine housing panels; colour 2 on the underside and inner housing sections.

Male/M_Back_Extra_Cannon_01.description: Two thin segmented cable loops hang from small angular mounting blocks on the upper back and shoulders, curving down and around the sides to the chest. Suggests the wiring for back-mounted mechanical cannons.
Male/M_Back_Extra_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 alternate on the ribbed segments of each cable; colour 2 on the small mounting blocks at the shoulders.

Male/M_Back_Extra_Vigilante_01.description: A slung mechanical recurve bow worn diagonally across the back, with swept, blade-like limbs, a jointed segmented grip with chunky clamp bands, and a thin taut string running between the limb tips.
Male/M_Back_Extra_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved bow limbs; colour 0 on the jointed grip segments; colour 3 on the clamp bands and the string; colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Back_Feathers_01.description: A back-mounted fan of long, curling feather plumes radiating outward from the spine like a peacock-tail array, some tipped with eye-spot markings; the plumes arc up, out and down past the hips, giving a dramatic, exotic silhouette.
Male/M_Back_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner feather shafts and barbs; colour 3 on the outer feather vanes and eye-spot tips; colour 0 on the feather edges and quills; colour 2 on the eye centres.

Male/M_Back_Flagpole_01.description: A tall flagpole carried diagonally across the back, with a rounded metal finial at the top, a spear-like tip at the bottom, a bound grip section and a small cloth flag hanging near the top.
Male/M_Back_Flagpole_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the pole shaft; colour 1 on the binding wraps and straps across the back; colour 0 on the flag cloth; the finial and tip use a metallic default material.
Male/M_Back_Flagpole_01.differs: The male pole slants more sharply from the left shoulder down to the right hip, with the flag hanging on the opposite side from the female version.

Male/M_Back_Flagpole_02.description: A long flagpole carried diagonally across the back, with a rounded metal finial at the top and a spear-like tip at the bottom. A larger cloth flag billows out from the top on the right, with thin cords wrapped around the shaft.
Male/M_Back_Flagpole_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the pole shaft; colour 1 on the wrapped cords and grip section; colour 0 on the flag cloth; colour 2 on the finial and lower tip.
Male/M_Back_Flagpole_02.differs: The male pole is the right-hand version: it slants from the left shoulder down to the right hip, and the flag on the right is larger and fuller than the female flag.

Male/M_Back_Future_01.description: A mechanical back rig of four long, curved blade-like wings, two large and two small, each with a ringed circular joint. It is mounted on a harness plate across the shoulders and upper back, with a chest strap, and has a sci-fi look.
Male/M_Back_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade surfaces and harness plate; colour 1 on the inner blade edges and fins; colour 2 on the blade undersides and harness straps; colour 3 on the ring centres and the back emblem.

Male/M_Back_Fx_Windup_Key.description: No windup key is visible on this sheet. The zoomed views show only the mannequin's face and ear, and the piece-alone view is empty, so its shape and placement on the back can't be described.
Male/M_Back_Fx_Windup_Key.colourAreas: No visible features take any colour slot on this sheet.

Male/M_Back_Gamer_01.description: A rounded casual backpack with a padded main body, zipped pockets, angry-eye shaped patches on the back flap, a buckled front clip, and shoulder straps joined by a chest strap. Sits high on the back.
Male/M_Back_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back face and side panels; colour 1 on the straps, base and front panel; colour 2 on the zips and eye patches; colour 3 on the buckle and small clasps.

Male/M_Back_Ghost_Hunter_01.description: A boxy mechanical backpack unit with dials, a control panel and vertical cylindrical canisters down both sides, plus cables looping from the top. Padded shoulder straps hold it high across the upper back, in a sci-fi paranormal-gadget style.
Male/M_Back_Ghost_Hunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main box housing; colour 1 on the canisters, top connectors and shoulder straps; colour 2 on the cables, top frame and dial knobs; colour 3 on small accents on the straps and canisters.

Male/M_Back_Golf_01.description: A cylindrical golf bag worn diagonally across the back, with a padded rounded cap at the top, several zippered pockets along the side and lower end, and cross straps holding it in place. Casual, sporty carry piece.
Male/M_Back_Golf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bag body; colour 1 on the cap, pockets, straps and base trim; colour 3 on small stitched accents at the strap joins.

Male/M_Back_Guitar_Acoustic_01.description: An acoustic guitar slung diagonally across the back, its neck rising past the shoulder and its body resting at the lower back. Held by small angled brackets at the shoulder and hip; a casual, musician look.
Male/M_Back_Guitar_Acoustic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the guitar body and neck back; colour 1 on the fretboard, sound-hole surround and pickguard; colour 2 on the sound hole and tuning pegs; colour 3 on the strap brackets.

Male/M_Back_Guitar_Electric_01.description: An electric guitar slung diagonally across the back on a strap, body resting at the lower back and the neck with headstock rising past the opposite shoulder. Solid-body rock instrument with a pickguard, knobs and strap tabs.
Male/M_Back_Guitar_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the guitar body and headstock; colour 1 on the pickguard panel; colour 3 on the neck and strap; colour 2 on the knobs, tuning pegs and bridge details.

Male/M_Back_Guitar_Heavy_01.description: A heavy-metal electric guitar slung diagonally across the back, with a winged, blade-edged body, a skull emblem on the face, a small skull on the back and a long neck ending in a tuning-peg headstock, held by a thin strap.
Male/M_Back_Guitar_Heavy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade-like body wings and headstock; colour 2 on the neck and body centre; colour 3 on the skull emblem; colour 0 on the strap, small skull and blade tips.

Male/M_Back_Guitar_Heavy_02.description: A bladed electric guitar slung across the back on a thin strap, with a jagged, winged body full of cutouts and blade-like points, and a long neck rising past the shoulder to a spiked headstock. A metal-band fantasy weapon.
Male/M_Back_Guitar_Heavy_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer body wings and headstock spikes; colour 1 on the neck front and inner body swirls; colour 0 on the central body panel; colour 2 on the strap and fretboard.

Male/M_Back_Guitar_Heavy_03.description: A heavy-metal electric guitar slung diagonally across the back on a thin strap, with a dragon-like spiky body of swept talon wings and a long neck ending in a bat-wing headstock.
Male/M_Back_Guitar_Heavy_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the guitar body, neck and headstock; colour 2 on the fretboard and strap; colour 3 on the strings and pickup area; colour 0 on small metal fittings.

Male/M_Back_Halo_01.description: A floating halo worn behind the head: a flat faceted disc ringed by a thick curved lower band, two jagged flame-like fins at the sides and a contrasting pointed crest on top. Sci-fi, superhero look.
Male/M_Back_Halo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central disc; colour 1 on the thick lower band; colour 3 on the two side fins; colour 2 on the top crest.
Male/M_Back_Halo_01.differs: The male halo is larger and sits further out from the head and shoulders.

Male/M_Back_Halo_02.description: A smaller upright halo disc worn behind the head and shoulders: a flat central disc ringed by a segmented lower arc, two jagged flame-like fins at the sides and a small pointed crest on top.
Male/M_Back_Halo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central disc and thin inner rim; colour 1 on the lower segmented arc; colour 3 on the two side flame fins; colour 2 on the top crest.
Male/M_Back_Halo_02.differs: The male halo is a smaller version that sits lower behind the head and neck, closer to the shoulders.

Male/M_Back_Helicopter_01.description: A wide mechanical backpack jetpack with two domed rotor housings topped by thin propeller blades, blocky central boxes and broad side wing panels tipped with pointed thruster pods. It sits across the upper back and spreads well past the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Helicopter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings, wing panels and thruster pods; colour 1 on the panel insets and trim bands; colour 3 on the small vent details on the domes; colour 2 on the joints and undersides.

Male/M_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_01.description: A set of four long, jointed mechanical spider legs mounted at the upper back, crossing in an X behind the body. Each segmented limb ends in a sharp pointed claw, giving a menacing sci-fi look.
Male/M_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg segments and claws; colour 2 on the joints and hub; colour 1 and colour 3 show only as small accents near the joints.
Male/M_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_01.differs: The male legs read as bright, light-coloured segments rather than contrasting ones, and the limbs are slightly more upright and evenly spaced.

Male/M_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_02.description: A set of four long segmented mechanical arms radiating from a central hub on the upper back, two rising above the shoulders and two sweeping down past the hips, each jointed and ending in a bladed claw tip.
Male/M_Back_Holoforce_Arachnid_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm segments and claw blades; the joints and central hub show little variation from the scheme, with the glossy metal largely ignoring the other colour slots.

Male/M_Back_Holoforce_Insect_01.description: A pair of translucent insect-style wings with fine branching veins, sprouting from a small angular emblem-like anchor between the shoulder blades. They sweep outward and slightly upward, and are semi-transparent and lightweight.
Male/M_Back_Holoforce_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing veins; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 2 on the central anchor piece at the upper back.

Male/M_Back_Hybrid_01.description: A pair of curved, horn-like spikes rising from the upper back over the shoulder blades, each segmented with knobby joints and tapering to a sharp point, giving a monstrous, organic hybrid look.
Male/M_Back_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main spike segments and joint blocks; colour 3 on the banded joints and ridges between segments.

Male/M_Back_Ice_01.description: A cluster of jagged crystalline ice shards mounted on the upper back: one tall spiky spire rising past the shoulder beside a rounded faceted lump with small chips around it. Faceted and angular, it suits fantasy or elemental looks.
Male/M_Back_Ice_01.colourAreas: Glossy crystal that mostly ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 shows faintly as a tint on some facets.

Male/M_Back_Jetengine_01.description: A mechanical jetpack with two large boxy engine pods on the upper back, each with a vented panel and a nozzle below, joined by a central harness with chest straps and long swept-back wings extending to each side.
Male/M_Back_Jetengine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the engine housings and wings; colour 1 on the harness, straps, central mount and nozzles; colour 3 on the vent grilles.

Male/M_Back_Jetwings_01.description: A compact mechanical jetpack worn on the upper back: a central plated housing flanked by two round turbine fans, with a lower ribbed exhaust plate and several long thin fins swept out from the shoulders and sides.
Male/M_Back_Jetwings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the turbine casings and lower plate; colour 1 on the central housing and the swept fins; colour 3 on the inner core panel; colour 2 on small underside details.

Male/M_Back_Kaiju_01.description: A narrow strip of jagged, spiky fins running down the centre of the back from the neck to the lower back, with a smooth rounded lobe wrapping around to the front at the shoulder and waist. Monstrous, armoured look.
Male/M_Back_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer spikes and the smooth front lobes; colour 2 on the inner gaps between spikes.

Male/M_Back_Kaiju_02.description: A pair of large bat-like wings sprouting from the upper back, with a membrane stretched between many curved ribs that end in sharp pointed tips along a scalloped edge. They spread wide and sweep outward.
Male/M_Back_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wing membrane; colour 3 on the ribs and the root where the wings join the back; colour 0 on the sharp claw tips.
Male/M_Back_Kaiju_02.differs: The male wings spread wider and flatter, sitting farther apart on the back.

Male/M_Back_Lantern_01.description: A long striped carrying pole slung diagonally across the back, plain and straight with no attachments. It suggests a simple staff or festive accessory.
Male/M_Back_Lantern_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating pole segments; colour 1 on the other pole segments.
Male/M_Back_Lantern_01.differs: The male version is only the bare striped pole, without the hanging animal-shaped lantern and chain.

Male/M_Back_Lantern_02.description: A long straight staff carried diagonally across the back, with a banded shaft and capped ends. It has no hanging attachment and is a plain, simple carried weapon.
Male/M_Back_Lantern_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the staff shaft; colour 0 on the end caps; colour 2 on the tips of the ends.
Male/M_Back_Lantern_02.differs: The male version is only the bare staff, with no hanging beast-shaped lantern on a chain.

Male/M_Back_Lantern_03.description: A long plain carrying staff slung diagonally across the back, with a contrasting shaft and capped ends. It sits behind the shoulders with no hanging attachment.
Male/M_Back_Lantern_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the staff shaft; colour 1 on the end caps and grip bands.
Male/M_Back_Lantern_03.differs: The male version is only the bare staff, with no hanging lion-head lantern.

Male/M_Back_Lantern_04.description: A long plain straight staff slung diagonally across the back, with capped ends and a simple banded grip at each tip. No lantern or other attachment is visible.
Male/M_Back_Lantern_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the staff shaft; colour 0 on the end caps and bands.
Male/M_Back_Lantern_04.differs: The male version is only the bare staff, with no hanging animal-shaped lantern.

Male/M_Back_Legendary_Hammer_01.description: A large fantasy war hammer carried upright on the back, its handle wrapped in cord with loose ends. The head is a square block with a round ornate emblem; the wide, flared, ornately engraved blade sits low on the back.
Male/M_Back_Legendary_Hammer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hammer head, the blade rim and the end blocks; colour 1 on the handle wrapping and cord ends; colour 2 on the engraved ornament; colour 3 on the recessed panels of the blade and the head emblem.

Male/M_Back_Light_01.description: A floating winged back piece: a broad U-shaped frame sweeping out into pointed wing tips, with rows of layered feather blades along each side and a slim spiked arc rising behind the head like a halo.
Male/M_Back_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer frame and small flame spikes; colour 2 on the feather blades; colour 1 on the halo arc and its central spike; colour 0 on the feather edge highlights.
Male/M_Back_Light_01.differs: The male wings spread wider and flatter with a shallower centre, rather than the steeper upward tilt of the female version.

Male/M_Back_Lockbox_65_01.description: A back-mounted halo: a thin rigid arch rises behind the head and shoulders, ringed by clusters of swirling stylised flame shapes with spiral centres. Suggests an East Asian mystic or elemental spirit look.
Male/M_Back_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the arch band; colour 1 on the flame bodies; colour 3 on the spiral centres and inner flame accents.

Male/M_Back_Machete_02.description: A large broad-bladed machete carried diagonally across the back, handle rising past the shoulder beside the head and blade tip reaching the opposite hip. The grip is wrapped in cord and ends in a flat pommel cap.
Male/M_Back_Machete_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the wrapped grip; colour 2 on the pommel and guard; the blade is bare metal and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Back_Mallet_01.description: A large mallet carried diagonally across the back, with a long slim handle ending in a pointed tip and a big cylindrical head with frayed edges, held by a knotted cord strap across the shoulder blade.
Male/M_Back_Mallet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mallet head barrel; colour 0 on the handle; colour 2 on the head end caps and frayed edges; colour 3 on the cord strap and handle rings and tip.

Male/M_Back_Mane_Blackfang_01.description: A shaggy fur mane running from the nape down the upper back in a tapering, ragged strip, with several swords and daggers stuck through it at angles. Feral, savage style with jagged, tufted edges.
Male/M_Back_Mane_Blackfang_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tufts at the crown of the neck and the fur tips; colour 1 on the main body of the mane; colour 2 on the fur patches and the sword blades and hilts; colour 3 on the inner panel and the blade markings.

Male/M_Back_Mane_Blackfang_02.description: A wild, fur-like mane that starts as a tuft at the crown of the head and streams down the back in a long tapering shape, with jagged, feathery tips and layered patches of differing shades.
Male/M_Back_Mane_Blackfang_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown tuft and the light streaks along the edges; colour 1 on the main body of the mane; colour 2 on the patches near the top and the side; colour 3 on the narrow inner stripe.

Male/M_Back_Mane_Spikey_01.description: A dense mane of long, sharp, overlapping spikes spread across the upper back and shoulders, drooping in layers down the back and curling slightly over the shoulder toward the front. Feathery, feral, punk-superhero look.
Male/M_Back_Mane_Spikey_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the base and upper spike layers; colour 0 on the spike middles and tips near the bottom; colour 2 on the darker spike tips and shading.

Male/M_Back_Martial_Power_02.description: A large single-edged sword worn diagonally across the back, with a wide straight blade, a curved fang-shaped pommel rising above the shoulder, a wrapped grip and small ring guards at the hilt.
Male/M_Back_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the curved fang pommel and hilt guard; colour 3 on the grip wrapping; colour 2 on the small guard rings.

Male/M_Back_Martial_Power_Alt_01.description: A long curved jagged-edged sword worn diagonally across the back, hilt up over the shoulder. It has a hooked grip with wrapped bands, a spiked crossguard and a tapering serrated blade running to the opposite hip.
Male/M_Back_Martial_Power_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade and crossguard; colour 1 on the hooked hilt and pommel; colour 2 on the grip wraps.

Male/M_Back_Mecha_Spider_01.description: A back-mounted set of four long articulated mechanical arms radiating in an X from the shoulder blades, each jointed and segmented with small joint nodes, ending in flat curved blade tips. Evokes a villainous cybernetic harness.
Male/M_Back_Mecha_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main limb segments; colour 2 on the darker limb edges and sections; colour 3 on the small joint nodes; colour 1 on the blade tips.
Male/M_Back_Mecha_Spider_01.differs: The male arms carry small contrasting joint studs at the hub and elbows, and the limbs are thicker and more sweeping.

Male/M_Back_Mecha_Spider_02.description: A backpack harness of crossed straps holding four long jointed mechanical spider legs that cross behind the body and end in curved blade tips. Segmented limbs with round joints give a sleek, sci-fi villain look.
Male/M_Back_Mecha_Spider_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the harness straps and blade tips; colour 3 on the leg segments; colour 0 on the leg bands; colour 1 on the round joints.
Male/M_Back_Mecha_Spider_02.differs: The male legs have separate colour panels on each segment, with contrasting blades and joints, and they cross in an X behind the body.

Male/M_Back_Monster_Arms_01.description: A pair of oversized monstrous arms sprouting from the upper back and shoulders, with muscular sinewy limbs, contrasting spikes along the shoulders, ragged flesh at the join and long curved claws hanging down past the hips.
Male/M_Back_Monster_Arms_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the muscular flesh of the arms and shoulders; colour 1 on the veins and streaks along the limbs; colour 2 on the shoulder spikes; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Back_Monster_Arms_02.description: A large monstrous extra arm that sprouts from the upper back and arcs out beside the shoulder, with a muscular, sinew-veined limb, spiny ridges along the top, a jagged fringe at the shoulder and long curved claws.
Male/M_Back_Monster_Arms_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the muscular arm and shoulder fringe; colour 2 on the spines and ridge tips; colour 1 on the vein-like lines; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Back_Monster_Arms_03.description: A single oversized monstrous arm attached at the back of the shoulder, hanging down past the hip. It is muscular and fur-textured, with a ragged edge at the shoulder, spiked ridges along the elbow, and long curved claws.
Male/M_Back_Monster_Arms_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the furry arm body and spikes; colour 1 on the thin vein-like lines along the arm; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Back_Null_01.description: A placeholder effects piece for a back slot: only a small plain cube is visible, floating near the body. It shows no wings or other construction detail, so the actual flight effect is not visible.
Male/M_Back_Null_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cube faces; no other coloured features are visible.

Male/M_Back_Porcupine_01.description: A dense cluster of long, sharp quills radiating from one shoulder blade, sweeping down the upper back and over the shoulder edge. Reads as a single-sided spiny mantle with a menacing, monstrous look.
Male/M_Back_Porcupine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quill bases and shafts; colour 1 on the quill mid-sections and small base shards; colour 2 on the quill tips.

Male/M_Back_Power_01.description: A segmented spine-like back plate: a winged, notched cap at the upper back, then a column of overlapping chevron plates tapering to a point down the spine, ending near the mid-back.
Male/M_Back_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cap and top plates; colour 2 on the middle plates; colour 3 on the lowest plates; colour 0 on the plate edges and underside.

Male/M_Back_Power_Blade_01.description: An oversized single-edged buster sword carried diagonally across the back, with a broad curved blade, a notch near the hilt, a round engraved emblem at the base, and a long wrapped handle rising past the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Power_Blade_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade body and engraved panel lines; colour 2 on the guard block at the blade base; colour 3 on the wrapped handle; colour 0 barely visible.

Male/M_Back_Psionic_Dragon_Wings_01.description: A compact pair of angular, faceted wings made of overlapping shard-like blades that fan out from the upper back and shoulder blades, with smaller spiky fragments clustered around the spine. Sci-fi fantasy look.
Male/M_Back_Psionic_Dragon_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade edges and lower shards; colour 1 on the inner wing panels and spine cluster; colour 2 on the large central wing panels; colour 3 on the small accents between the blades.

Male/M_Back_Scarab_01.description: A mechanical back rig: a small central spine plate between the shoulder blades with four jointed, segmented limbs. Two arch up past the head ending in curved claw tips; two curl around the waist to the front with hooked claw tips.
Male/M_Back_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central spine plate; colour 1 on the jointed limb segments; colour 3 on the claw tips; colour 2 on the joint gaps.
Male/M_Back_Scarab_01.differs: The male limbs are longer and splay wider, with the upper claws rising higher above the shoulders and the waist limbs reaching farther around the torso.

Male/M_Back_Scarab_02.description: Four large, pointed butterfly-style wings, two upper and two lower, spreading from a round mechanical hub with a diamond-shaped gem between the shoulder blades. Veined, segmented membranes with metallic edging give an insectile, mechanical look.
Male/M_Back_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing membranes and hub; colour 0 on the vein and edge trim; colour 1 on some wing panels; colour 3 on the gem in the hub.
Male/M_Back_Scarab_02.differs: The male wings show raised veining that divides them into cells and a contrasting gem on the hub, which the female version lacks.
