Male/M_Back_Seacreature_01.description: A back-mounted cluster of long, curved, feather-like fins or tendrils hanging from the upper back, with pointed tips, chevron-patterned edges and a few tall curved spikes rising past the shoulders and head.
Male/M_Back_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feather blades; colour 1 on the edges and tip highlights; colour 3 on the chevron markings; colour 2 on the base joint where the blades meet.
Male/M_Back_Seacreature_01.differs: The male version is narrower and sparser, with fewer blades that hang more vertically down the back rather than fanning out wide.

Male/M_Back_Seacreature_04.description: A cluster of sharp, swept-back fin blades fanning out from the upper back and shoulder blades, with ribbed layered membranes and long pointed tips that rise above the shoulders. Aquatic, creature-like styling.
Male/M_Back_Seacreature_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin edges and ridged surfaces; colour 1 on the ribbed bands between the spines; colour 2 on the glossy membrane areas; colour 3 on the thin accent stripes.

Male/M_Back_Skateboard_01.description: A full-size skateboard carried diagonally across the upper back, tilted from one shoulder toward the opposite hip, with two axle trucks and four wheels facing outward and an atom-style emblem on the deck underside.
Male/M_Back_Skateboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the deck face; colour 0 on the atom emblem and the plain top surface; colour 3 on the trucks; colour 2 on the wheels.

Male/M_Back_Sled_01.description: A wooden toboggan-style sled carried upright on the back: a curved-rail frame with crossbars, and a bed of vertical slats. It stands from above the head to the hips, like a winter-themed novelty accessory.
Male/M_Back_Sled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vertical slats; colour 1 on the curved runner frame and crossbars.

Male/M_Back_Snowball_01.description: A mechanical backpack with an angular, panelled housing on the back and two thick curved hoses arching over the shoulders to forward-facing round nozzles capped with snow and icicles; strapped on with loops and a front plate.
Male/M_Back_Snowball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoses, casing frame and straps; colour 1 on the front plate, nozzle rims and casing panels; colour 3 on the nozzle centres, side lights and hanging cords; colour 2 on small casing details.
Male/M_Back_Snowball_01.differs: The male pack has a visible contrasting plate against the chest side, contrasting side lights and dangling contrasting cords beneath the housing.

Male/M_Back_Space_01.description: Three glossy spherical orbs stacked down the spine from the neck to the mid-back, each ringed by a thin band with small knobs at the sides. A futuristic, mechanical back accessory.
Male/M_Back_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spheres; colour 2 on the encircling bands; colour 1 on the small side knobs. The glossy spheres largely ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Back_Speakers_01.description: A backpack of two tall boxy speaker cabinets standing side by side above a wider low speaker box, strapped to the upper back with contrasting shoulder straps and a padded contrasting back panel. Playful, mechanical gadget look.
Male/M_Back_Speakers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cabinet casings, straps and cross bands; colour 1 on the speaker faces; colour 2 on the padded back panel and the display and cone rings; colour 3 on the small rivets and cone markings.

Male/M_Back_Spooky_01.description: A small spine-mounted ornament: four chunky, faceted angular segments stacked in a tapering column down the centre of the upper back, with a large diamond-shaped top piece, like a low-poly crystal spine.
Male/M_Back_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large top diamond segment; colour 1 on the second segment; colour 2 on the third segment; colour 3 on the bottom pointed segment.
Male/M_Back_Spooky_01.differs: The male version uses four distinct colour slots, one per segment, and has a larger diamond-shaped top segment.

Male/M_Back_Squirtgun_01.description: A toy-like oversized water gun carried diagonally across the back: a blocky handle and pump housing, a large rounded tank, a ringed barrel with a long thin nozzle, and an angular fin-shaped panel at the side.
Male/M_Back_Squirtgun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blocky housing and barrel shafts; colour 1 on the tank and nozzle collars; colour 2 on the tank bands and end caps; colour 3 on the barrel bands and the angular side panel.

Male/M_Back_Steampunk_Metal_01.description: A steampunk back piece: a tapered, pointed plate down the upper back with curved rib-like bands and toothed edge blocks, plus two large cog wheels floating at the shoulders. Sits on the shoulder blades and spine.
Male/M_Back_Steampunk_Metal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main back plate; colour 3 on the curved bands across the plate; colour 0 on the toothed edge blocks and the outer cog teeth; colour 2 on the cog hubs and centres.

Male/M_Back_Steelcommando_01.description: A rigid, boxy backpack-style armour plate worn across the upper back, with a top carrying bar, a central shield-shaped emblem panel, and two long angular side pieces that taper downward into pointed tips.
Male/M_Back_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer side plates and frame; colour 1 on the main back panel and shield face; colour 3 on the inset accent lines and lower panels; colour 2 on the top carrying bar.

Male/M_Back_Steelcommando_02.description: A small shield-shaped plate worn on the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a pointed top crest, tapering point below, raised bevelled rim and a chevron-shaped raised inlay. Retro mechanical superhero styling.
Male/M_Back_Steelcommando_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate body and rim; colour 3 on the raised chevron line inlay; colour 0 on the top crest highlights.

Male/M_Back_Swordpack_01.description: A back-mounted bundle of many swords and knives fanned out in a starburst behind the shoulders: long straight blades, a serrated sawback blade, short daggers and spiked scabbards, with wrapped grips and guards.
Male/M_Back_Swordpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long blades, scabbards and spiked sheaths; colour 0 on the broad and sawback blades; colour 2 on the dagger grips and short sheaths; colour 3 on the grip wraps, guards and pommels.

Male/M_Back_Teleos_01.description: A mechanical back piece of four large angular blade-like wing panels radiating in an X from a central glowing hub between the shoulder blades, each panel with a rounded inset gem-like disc on the front and a thin trim line.
Male/M_Back_Teleos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel surfaces and rims; colour 1 on the thin trim lines and ring outlines on the back faces; colour 3 on the round inset discs; colour 2 on the darker panel undersides.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Airtank_01.description: A single scuba-style air cylinder worn on the upper back, held by two wide buckled bands and a thin strap over the shoulder, with a valve and regulator knob on top and a rubber base cap; a flat backing pad sits behind it.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Airtank_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cylinder body; colour 1 on the bands, straps and backing pad; colour 2 on the valve fitting; colour 3 on the valve knob and base cap.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Angel_Big_01.description: A pair of large feathered angel wings rising from the upper back, with long swept-up tips, layered rows of feathers and a webbed, vein-like pattern at the base. Fantasy style, sitting close behind the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Angel_Big_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper feather blades; colour 3 on the feather bases and vein pattern; colour 2 on the feather edges and tips; colour 0 on the light lattice lines.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Angel_Big_01.differs: The male wings spread wider apart, with a broader gap between them and the tips fanned outward.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Angel_Small_01.description: A pair of small stylised wings worn high on the upper back: each has a shield-shaped panel at the base and layered, webbed feather blades sweeping outward and curling up into a hooked tip.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Angel_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather edges and outer rims; colour 1 on the webbed feather surfaces; colour 3 on the shield panels and curled tips; colour 2 on the panel borders.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_01.description: A pair of large webbed fins attached across the upper back and shoulder blades, each with curved spiny ribs fanning outward around a mottled membrane. Organic, aquatic and monstrous, like wings or gills.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved spine ribs; colour 0 and colour 2 on the webbed membrane panels; colour 3 on the speckled spots.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_01.differs: The male version has two fins, one on each shoulder blade, rather than a single fin on one side.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_02.description: A pair of large fin-like membranes rising from both shoulder blades, each stretched between long curved spines that flare outward and downward. The mottled, blotchy skin gives an aquatic, monstrous look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spines and edge ribs; colour 0 on the membrane; colour 2 on the shaded membrane areas near the spines; colour 3 on the blotches.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fin_02.differs: The male version has a matching pair of fins, one on each shoulder, while the female version has a single fin on one side of the back.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Finsingle_01.description: A single membranous fin mounted on the upper back beside the spine, with curved spiny ribs supporting a webbed panel that fans out to the side. Aquatic, creature-like styling with a scalloped, pointed edge.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Finsingle_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved spiny ribs; colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 3 on the speckled spots across the membrane; colour 2 on the shading at the base of each rib.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Finsingle_02.description: A single large fin-like membrane attached to one side of the upper back, with curved spiny ribs fanning out to pointed tips and a speckled webbed surface between them. It sweeps out and down past the ribs, suggesting an aquatic creature look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Finsingle_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved fin ribs and spines; colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 2 on the shaded inner membrane bands; colour 3 on the spots speckled across the membrane.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fintrio_01.description: A back piece of three webbed fin fans that sit across the upper back and shoulder blades, each with curved spiny ribs and a membrane between them. Sharp tips flare outward and downward, giving an aquatic, monstrous look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fintrio_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin membranes; colour 1 on the curved spine ribs and edges; colour 2 on the shadowed inner membrane folds; colour 3 on the speckled spots on the membranes.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fintrio_02.description: A large fan of three stacked fin clusters rising from the upper back and shoulder blades, each with long curved spines joined by webbed membrane. Spines splay outward past the shoulders, giving an aquatic, monstrous look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Aquatic_Fintrio_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved spines and edging; colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 2 on the shaded bands between spines; colour 3 on the spotted markings on the membrane.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A rounded, shell-like back piece of overlapping segmented plates that rises into a cowl-like dome behind the head and tapers down the back to a point at the lower back, with a mottled cell pattern across the surface.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate rims and shell edges; colour 2 on the pebble-like cell patches; colour 3 on the small accents along the plate edges; colour 1 as faint tint in the shell.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Armadillo_01.differs: The male shell is broader and shorter, with wider stacked plates spanning the back and a blunter tip.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A pair of small mechanical turbine ducts worn on the upper back. Each is an arched, angular housing that rises over the shoulder top, with a vented intake at the front and a slim panel hanging down the back.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arched housings; colour 1 on the hanging panels; colour 3 on the front intake vents.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Artdeco_01.description: A retro twin-tank jetpack: two rounded rocket canisters with pointed tips and flared nozzle bases sit side by side across the upper back, flanked by swept, stepped wing fins that angle outward past the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Artdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nozzle bases, tips and wing edges; colour 1 on the canister bodies and wing panels; colour 3 on the inner recesses between the canisters and wings.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Backpack_01.description: A bulky rounded-box combat backpack worn high on the back, with a padded flap top, main compartment, horizontal cinch straps, small snap pockets on the sides and a lower pouch. Suggests a tactical, military field pack.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Backpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main compartment face and side pockets; colour 1 on the outer shell, flap and frame edging; colour 2 on the straps; colour 3 on the strap fittings, snaps and stitched tabs.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Backpack_Military_01.description: A boxy military backpack worn high on the back, with a rounded top flap, rows of small buttoned pockets on the outside, side pouches, and horizontal straps with buckles across the top and bottom.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Backpack_Military_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pack body and pockets; colour 1 on the top flap, edge piping and pocket panels; colour 2 on the horizontal straps; colour 3 on the strap clasps and pocket buttons.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Backpack_Tech_01.description: A compact, rounded-trapezoid tech backpack sitting high on the upper back, with two boxy shoulder-top pods, bolt-like hex nuts across the top, recessed side panels and a central vent strip; mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Backpack_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and top pods; colour 1 on the inset panels, hex nuts and pod windows; colour 3 on the small vent strip and edge accents; colour 2 on the thin seams and underside slits.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Banners_01.description: A pair of banner poles worn crossed in a V on the back, each with a pointed tip and a rectangular cloth banner bearing a dragon motif, splayed outward above the shoulders in an east-asian warrior style.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Banners_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banner cloth; colour 1 on the dragon designs; colour 2 on the poles and banner edges; colour 3 on the spear tips.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Blackfang_01.description: A bulky organic-mechanical backpack shell with a ribbed, segmented carapace coiled around a toothed maw, plus two tall curved horn-like prongs rising past the head from shoulder-mounted collars. Sits across the back.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Blackfang_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell plates and horns; colour 1 on the lower rim and collar joints; colour 2 on the plate patches and horn segments; colour 3 on the rib stripes.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Blackfang_01.differs: The male shell is deeper and wraps further around the side, showing a coiled ribbed spiral, and has an extra shoulder plate at the front.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A small mechanical cylinder mounted vertically on the upper back, like a compact thruster or canister. It has a wide capped top with a recessed round port, a long contrasting barrel and a flared base collar.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cap; colour 2 on the long barrel; colour 1 on the flared base collar; colour 3 on the recessed port in the top.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Bulwark_01.description: A back-mounted armor spine of segmented, hexagonal plates running from between the shoulder blades down the spine, ending in two clawlike prongs. Each plate has a raised metal rim and some carry round sockets; sci-fi, mechanical look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Bulwark_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate insets; colour 0 on the raised rims and edging; colour 3 on the round socket centres; colour 2 on the socket rings and underside edges.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A mechanical backpack shaped like a fan: a broad panel over the shoulder blades, a fan of tapered cylindrical spikes rising past the shoulders, and side canisters. Thin bands wrap the waist. Sci-fi jetpack look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fan panel and spikes; colour 0 on the metal back plate and housings; colour 3 on the canister stripes; colour 2 on the waist bands and trim.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Cyberkatana_01.description: A sheathed cyber-katana worn diagonally across the back, hilt up over one shoulder. It has a ring-shaped pommel, a wrapped grip, a small guard and a long straight scabbard with segmented panels and a wide blade tip.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Cyberkatana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring pommel, guard and scabbard tip; colour 1 on the grip wraps and scabbard bands; colour 2 on the central scabbard panels; colour 3 on the small accent patches near the guard and scabbard.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Demon_Big_01.description: A pair of large bat-like demon wings on a central spade-shaped back mount, with long curved arm bones rising above the head and scalloped, ribbed membranes that hang down to about knee level.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Demon_Big_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central mount and wing arm bones; colour 0 on the upper membrane; colour 3 on the lower membrane ribs and fill; colour 2 on the membrane edges.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Demon_Big_01.differs: The male wings spread wider from the back, with a larger mount sitting between the shoulder blades.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Demon_Huge_01.description: A pair of large bat-like demon wings sprouting from the upper back, each with a bony curved arm and finger spars supporting a scalloped membrane. Swept up and outward in a wide spread, with a gothic fantasy look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Demon_Huge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony arm and finger spars; colour 1 on the wing membranes.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Demon_Small_01.description: A pair of small bat-like demon wings joined at a central spine between the shoulder blades, with scalloped membranes, ribbed struts and long curling claw-tipped points; the wings spread outward and sit across the upper back.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Demon_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central spine and wing ribs; colour 3 on the membrane panels; colour 2 on the curling wing tips and edges.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Demon_Small_01.differs: The male wings sit lower and spread wider across the upper back, angling more sideways than the female ones.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Electric_01.description: A backpack of two stacked Tesla coils, each a chunky cylindrical housing with a ribbed accordion section ending in a contrasting octagonal tip. They angle outward from the upper and mid back, with the housings poking out past the sides.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coil casings; colour 1 on the end caps and casing bands; colour 3 on the ribbed sections; colour 2 on the octagonal tips.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Electric_01.differs: The male coils sit higher across the shoulder blades and angle out more steeply, with the lower coil tucked closer beneath the upper one.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Electric_02.description: A backpack of four Tesla coils, each a short cylindrical body with a ribbed coil section and a capped emitter tip. They angle outward from the upper back in a wide X-shaped cluster, the caps poking past the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Electric_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar bands of each coil; colour 1 on the cylinder bodies and end caps; colour 3 on the ribbed coil sections and thin lines; colour 2 on the emitter tips.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Electric_02.differs: The male coils spread wider across the back in a broad X, angled more horizontally.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Envirosuit_01.description: A bulky mechanical backpack: a broad ribbed plate hugs the back, with two curved arms arching up past the shoulders to boxy end caps. Flexible ribbed hoses loop down from the lower edges, and the back face carries a control panel.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Envirosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and ribbed front; colour 1 on the panel plating, arm sections and hose clips; colour 2 on the hoses; colour 3 on the arm end lights and small indicator lights.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Envirosuit_02.description: A mechanical back unit: a rounded central pack on the shoulder blades with four segmented thruster pods that splay outward like arms, linked to the pack by thick flexible hoses. Sci-fi jetpack style.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Envirosuit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central pack and the pod casings; colour 1 on the pod panels and pack vents; colour 2 on the hoses and cables; colour 3 on the small markings and lights on the pod tips.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A pair of art deco mechanical wings mounted on a small shield-shaped back plate. Long curved spars sweep up and outward, with segmented feather-like panels fanned between them and a trimmed lower edge, giving a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back plate and the curved wing spars; colour 3 on the segmented wing panels; colour 1 on the lower edge trim of the wings and the centre gem; colour 2 on the thin panel dividing lines.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_02.description: A retro-futuristic jet-fin backpack: a tall central spine with a rounded intake and a turbine vent rising above the shoulders, flanked by swept angular wings that jut out to each side. Worn on the upper back.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central spine, wings and intake housing; colour 1 on the V-shaped trim and edge stripes; colour 2 on the underside panels of the wings; colour 3 on the turbine housing.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Exartdeco_02.differs: The wings are broader and sit higher across the shoulders, with a wider spread and more upright angle.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Gadroonjetpack_01.description: A retro twin-tank jetpack: two rounded, bullet-shaped cylinders joined by a flat bridge plate, each with a thin spike on top and a ringed base nozzle. Sits across the upper back between the shoulder blades.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Gadroonjetpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tank bodies and bridge plate; colour 1 on the base rings; colour 2 on the top spikes.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Gadroonjetpack_01.differs: The male tanks sit side by side, evenly spaced across a wider back, with small fins on the front of each tank.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A single oval faceted gemstone worn flat on the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a domed, cut-glass crown of angular facets facing outward and a flatter underside against the body.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The glossy gem appears to ignore the colour scheme; the default material shows its own shading, so no slot clearly applies.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted rhombus-shaped gemstone with a flat back and angular bevelled facets, mounted between the shoulder blades on the upper back like a jewel embedded in the suit.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The glossy gem appears to ignore the colour scheme; no colour slots are clearly visible on it.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small square-cut gemstone with bevelled edges and a flat table, mounted on the upper back between the shoulder blades. It rises as a shallow faceted block, suggesting a mechanical or jewelled emblem.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; it shows a reflective finish with faint sheen across all facets.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A single faceted pentagonal gemstone, glossy with bevelled edges, mounted flat on the upper back between the shoulder blades like an embedded crystal emblem. It suggests a sci-fi or mystic look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; only faint tints of colour 1 show on its bevelled facets.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn as a small emblem on the upper back between the shoulder blades. It is a rounded, glossy, cut-crystal form with angular facets, standing slightly proud of the body.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The gem appears to ignore the colour scheme, showing a glossy crystal finish; no distinct colour slots are visible on it.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A small teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone worn flat on the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a pointed top, a domed faceted face and a hollow underside. It suggests a mechanical or fantasy jewel.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The whole gem uses a glossy, glass-like default material that mostly ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint shows on the upper facets, likely colour 1.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Gemstone_06.differs: The male gem is narrower and taller, with a more sharply pointed top.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Harajuku_Bearpack_01.description: A cute plush teddy bear backpack worn between the shoulder blades: a boxy head with round swirled ears, X-stitched eyes, a snout and dangling limbs with small claws, carried by thin ribbed straps that loop over the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Harajuku_Bearpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bear body, head and straps; colour 1 on the ears, snout, belly patch and paw patches; colour 3 on the eyes and nose; colour 2 on the claws and head seam.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Hunchback_Armor_Human_.description: A mechanical back piece: a curved, ribbed crescent shell wraps from the upper back around the ribs to the front of the torso, with a segmented carapace on the back and two long curved spiky arms rising above the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Hunchback_Armor_Human_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crescent band and ribbed inner shell; colour 1 on the back carapace, the arms and the end panels; colour 2 on the joints and patches; colour 3 is not clearly visible.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Hunchback_Hair_02.description: A strip of furry, striped hair running down the spine from the nape to the lower back, with a jagged spiky crest at the top and ragged tapering edges. It sits on the back like a werewolf mane.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Hunchback_Hair_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur edges and lighter fur; colour 1 on the central strip of the mane; colour 2 on the tiger-like stripes; colour 3 on small accent streaks within the central strip.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_01.description: A compact backpack-style jetpack with a rounded padded pack, a raised collar-like nozzle at the neck and a segmented plated panel on the back. Two swept, angular delta wings with edge trim extend sideways from the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main pack body; colour 0 on the back panel, top edging and small side block; colour 2 on the wings and neck nozzle; colour 3 on the wing edge trim.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_01.differs: The male version has wings that spread wider and flatter, and a more plated back panel.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Candy_Cane_01.description: A festive jetpack with a rounded, plated backpack body and two tall candy-cane thrusters rising above the shoulders on either side, joined by looping cables and small round nozzles at the base; worn on the upper back.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Candy_Cane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower pack body and side pods; colour 1 on the upper pack shell and piping; colour 3 on the candy-cane stripes and the round vent centre; colour 2 on the cables and the stripe twist.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Modern_01.description: A compact backpack jetpack with a rounded shell and a central eye-like emblem. Two curved horn-shaped arms sweep up past the shoulders to large turbine housings with fan intakes and nose cones, with exhaust spikes below and small nozzles at the hips.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Modern_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower pack shell, arms and turbine housings; colour 1 on the upper pack panel, piping lines and fan blades; colour 2 on the nozzles, vents and nose cones; colour 3 on the central emblem.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Modern_01.differs: The male pack has smoother, more curved turbine arms and a contrasting lower shell that carries a contrasting stripe down the back, rather than the female's angular horns.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Retroscifi_01.description: A retro rocket-style jetpack: a single bullet-shaped metal canister with a rounded nose, thin trim lines, small side thruster pods with vents, and a funnel nozzle with ring coils below. Curved fins sweep out behind it.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Retroscifi_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main canister body; colour 1 on the nozzle funnel; colour 3 on the trim lines, vertical stripes and the nozzle rings and bulb; colour 2 on the curved fins and vent slats.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Jetpack_Retroscifi_01.differs: The fins are folded closer to the sides of the canister and hang lower, whereas the female version's fins sweep further out behind the pack.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A large upright wooden barrel worn on the back, bound with thin hoops and held by padded shoulder harness straps that cross the chest and join a ring-shaped waist strap. A festive, fantasy-mechanical carrier.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel hoops and waist ring; colour 1 on the barrel staves and harness edging; colour 2 on the shoulder straps and barrel patches; colour 3 on the shoulder caps.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.description: A back-mounted mechanical harness with four long segmented tentacle arms ending in clawed pincers. Two arms arch up above the shoulders and two curve down and forward past the hips. A small shield-shaped plate sits at the chest.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate and arm segments; colour 1 on the claw joints and sleeves; colour 2 on the back harness and claw tips; colour 3 on the thin stripes along the arms.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Mecha_Claw_01.differs: The male arms are arranged more symmetrically: the upper pair arches close together and the lower pair curves forward and down, closer to the body.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.description: A pair of mechanical dragonfly wings: four long, narrow, angular panels with honeycomb-like texture and thin metal edging, fanning from a glossy mechanical pod mounted between the shoulder blades. Sci-fi, insectoid look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.colourAreas: The glossy metal pod ignores the scheme; colour 1 on small accents at the pod and on the tint of the wing panels; metal rims follow the default material.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.differs: The male wings are longer, with a visible honeycomb pattern on the panels and a larger pod with a small glowing accent.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Mechaniste_01.description: A back-mounted pair of mechanical arms: boxy panelled upper segments hang from the back, with jointed contrasting cylinder forearms that curve up over the shoulders and end in clawed, spiked tips. A shoulder-plate box sits at the front of one shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Mechaniste_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy panel casings; colour 1 on the stripes and inset panels; colour 2 on the cylindrical joints and forearms; colour 3 on the joint caps and claw tips.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Mechaniste_01.differs: The arms angle further outward and forward over the shoulders, and the front shoulder box is larger and more angular.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Military_Backpack_01.description: A large hiking-style military backpack with a padded main pack, side pockets, a lower pouch, a rolled bedroll on top, a water bottle at the hip and a long strap hanging down the back. It sits on the upper back and suggests field gear.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Military_Backpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pack body, pockets and bottle; colour 1 on the bedroll and thin piping lines; colour 3 on the straps and cinch bands; colour 2 on the buckles and the hanging strap.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_02.description: A compact mechanical jetpack worn on the upper back: a shield-shaped shell with rounded shoulder caps, thruster nozzles at the shoulders and a top cap, and a ribbed vented panel with a power-symbol mark on the back.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and shoulder caps; colour 1 on the top cap and thruster nozzles; colour 3 on the vent slats and power symbol; colour 2 on the inner recesses.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_02.differs: The male version has larger, more rounded shoulder caps that wrap further over the shoulders, with an extra thruster at the bottom of the shell.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_03.description: A compact jetpack worn high on the back: a rounded, capsule-shaped main housing with a notched top, a circular turbine vent at the rear, banded lower rim with small nozzles, and a pair of swept blade-like wings at the sides.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Modern_Jetpack_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and wings; colour 1 on the edge trim and stripes along the wings and lower bands; colour 2 on the base and nozzles; colour 3 on the turbine vent.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Nighthawk_2025_01.description: A mechanical backpack with a boxy central frame, two long slender antenna-like barrels rising above the shoulders, and cylindrical thruster pods hanging at each side. Glowing-looking side panels and a lattice frame suggest a sci-fi gadget rig.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Nighthawk_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy housings and pods; colour 1 on the long barrels, frame struts and central spine; colour 2 on the barrel tips and joints; colour 3 on the small inset panels and back window.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Phantom_01.description: Two separate thick, angular blade-like wings that curve out from the upper back and taper to a point toward the spine, forming a V. They stand proud of the back with a sleek mechanical look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole piece; the default material shows little variation from the other colour slots.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Phantom_01.differs: The male version is two separate thick curved blades that stand off the back, with no flat plate or diamond-shaped opening.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Psihypnotist_01.description: A mechanical back rig with a hexagonal hub between the shoulder blades and four long articulated arms splaying outward, two up and two down, each ending in a curved blade-like fin. Sci-fi psychic gadget.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Psihypnotist_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arms, blades and hub; the frosted, crackled surface appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Quiver_Box_01.description: A boxy rectangular quiver worn diagonally across the upper back, running from the shoulder down toward the opposite hip, with contrasting bands near top and bottom, a small angled flap on the side, and a bundle of fletched arrows sticking out of the top.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Quiver_Box_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver box and flap; colour 3 on the bands around the box; colour 1 on the arrow shafts; colour 2 on the arrow fletching.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Quiver_Large_01.description: A large boxy back quiver worn across the upper back, packed with a fan of fletched arrows rising above the shoulders. It has banded panels, a small front clasp plate and stacked ridges along the bottom edge.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Quiver_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver rim, front plate and bottom ridges; colour 1 on the upper and lower body panels and arrow shafts; colour 2 on the middle band and arrow fletching; colour 3 on the small clasp accents.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Quiver_Round_01.description: A tapered round quiver worn diagonally across the back, with its tip low near the hip and a full bundle of fletched arrows sticking out at the shoulder. Stitched seams wrap the body, and a small open tube juts from the side.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Quiver_Round_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver body; colour 3 on the stitched seams; colour 1 on the arrow shafts; colour 2 on the arrow fletching.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpachk_Orb_0.description: A large rounded orb worn on the upper back, gripped by curling tapered tendril claws with banded stripes at the sides and a pointed tail-like tendril hanging down the spine. Veined surface gives an alien, organic look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpachk_Orb_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the orb; colour 3 on the veins and stripes of the tendrils; colour 0 on the tendril bands and the small block below the orb; colour 1 on secondary tendril accents.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpackdualcla.description: A mechanical back harness: a V-shaped plated yoke over the shoulders and upper back carries two articulated arms with wrapped joints, each ending in a large curved blade-like claw that sweeps up and forward over the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpackdualcla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the yoke and the claw blades; colour 1 on the thin accent stripes and claw markings; colour 2 on the wrapped arm joints; colour 3 on the small dots and details.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularr_Backpackdualcla.differs: The claws sweep forward in a more curved, hooked shape over the shoulders, rather than standing upright like the female version.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularr_Crest_01.description: A back piece of stacked, overlapping angular plates forming a swept crest across the upper back, with layered fins fanning outward and a solid wedge base. Reads as insectoid, chitinous armour.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularr_Crest_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper edges of the plates; colour 0 on the highlight bands between plates; colour 2 on the lower plate faces and base wedge.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularr_Crest_01.differs: The male crest is wider and sits lower on the back, with broader flared plates and a heavier base.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularrlongpack_01.description: A pair of alien organic back attachments at the upper back: rounded bulbs set in contrasting fin-like shells, each with a long banded tendril sweeping outward and back over the shoulders. Bio-mechanical, partial coverage.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularrlongpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shells and bands of the tendrils; colour 3 on the bulbs and tendril stripes; colour 1 on the small spikes under the shells; colour 2 on the bulb centres.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Qularrlongpack_01.differs: The male tendrils are shorter and both sweep out symmetrically to the sides, held higher across the shoulder blades.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Reactor_03.description: A mechanical back-mounted articulated arm: a compact jointed base on the upper back, a long segmented boom rising past the shoulder, and a bent forearm ending in a large open, helmet-like reactor housing above the head.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Reactor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the reactor shell, joint caps and boom segments; colour 1 on the base housing, forearm and joint blocks; colour 3 on the stripes along the boom and shell top; colour 2 on the inner opening and the rear boom.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Robot_Jet_Pack_01.description: A compact mechanical jet pack on the upper back: a curved collar-like shell over the shoulders holds two rounded thruster pods, with long narrow swept fins trailing down past the hips. Sci-fi, robotic superhero styling.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Robot_Jet_Pack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved shell over the shoulders; colour 2 on the thruster pods; colour 3 on the small glowing accents on the pods; colour 1 on the long trailing fins.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Robot_Jet_Pack_01.differs: The male version has a larger shell wrapping further around the shoulders, and its thruster pods sit wider apart with broader-spread fins.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.description: A back piece of stacked, cracked rock slabs across the upper back and behind the neck, with clusters of large pointed crystals jutting outward. A thin ragged rock ring wraps around the torso front.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between the rocks; colour 1 on the crystal spikes.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Rocket_01.description: A chunky rocket-shaped jetpack worn on the upper back: a rounded nosecone above a banded barrel with swept fins at the base, a cord strapped around the middle, and a curved plate wrapping over the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Rocket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nosecone tip, fins and shoulder plate; colour 1 on the barrel and part of the nosecone; colour 2 on the band; colour 3 on the back panel patch.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Rocket_01.differs: The male shoulder plate is a larger, more curved piece that wraps over the shoulder, and the contrasting patch sits on the back of the barrel.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Rocket_02.description: A large rocket-shaped backpack with a rounded nose cone, banded body and three swept fins at the base, held by a belt-like cord at the waist and a shoulder wrap piece at the front. Playful retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Rocket_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose cone, fins and lower body; colour 1 on the main body sections; colour 2 on the wide band around the middle; colour 3 on the panel patch.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Rocket_02.differs: The male version's front wrap is a shoulder-plate shape on one side, and the contrasting patch sits toward the back edge of the body.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Rope_01.description: A large twisted rope ring standing upright behind the head like a halo, gathered at the bottom by a chunky knot with two tassel-like ends resting between the shoulder blades. Three teardrop charms float inside the ring. Ritual, shrine-like style.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Rope_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the twisted rope ring; colour 0 on the knot and its tassel ends; colours 1, 2 and 3 on the three hanging teardrop charms.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Shaman_Sovereign_01.description: A back rig of crossed, banded poles fanning up and out from the spine, topped by a skull and a contrasting carved head, with shrunken heads dangling from cords at the lower ends. Tribal voodoo style.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Shaman_Sovereign_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the poles; colour 3 on the top skull and the small wrapped bindings; colour 0 on the carved heads and shrunken heads; colour 2 on the cords and hair.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A single curved shark-fin blade rising from the upper back, with a long swept tip pointing outward and a tapered lower point. Thin and smooth, it suggests a mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin, which is the only visible part of the piece.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_01.differs: The fin is larger and sits higher across the shoulder blade, with a longer outward sweep than the female one.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_02.description: A single large curved fin rising from one shoulder blade, swept back into a sharp point with a notched, ragged trailing edge and a second spike tapering down the back. Smooth membrane-like surface; suits sci-fi or monstrous looks.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Sharkfin_02.differs: The fin is larger and sits more upright over the shoulder blade, staying closer to the back rather than extending out to the side.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_01.description: A large heater-style shield worn across the back, slightly curved with a pointed bottom. The outer face has a broad bordered rim and a central atom emblem; the inner face has two vertical straps and a small hook.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield's inner face and outer rim edge; colour 1 on the broad border band on the outer face and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the inner border lines and the buckle; colour 3 on the two straps.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_02.description: A heater-style shield carried on the back, with a curved face, a raised rim and a scalloped top edge. An atom emblem sits on the outer face and two strap loops show on the inner side.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one half of the outer face; colour 1 on the other half of the outer face; colour 2 on the rim and the inner face; colour 3 on the inner straps; the atom emblem is a lighter tint of the face colours.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_02.differs: The male shield is wider and squarer with a shorter point, and it sits flatter across the back.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_03.description: A heater-style shield worn flat on the back, with a slim raised rim, a quartered face bearing an atom emblem, and two strap loops on the inner side. Reads as a heroic, knightly accessory with a sci-fi twist.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Basic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the face; colour 1 on the other two quarters; colour 2 on the rim and inner back; colour 3 on the straps; the atom emblem is a subtle tone on the face.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Lion_01.description: A large round shield worn on the upper back, with a raised lion-head relief in the centre, a ring of zigzag patterning around a rim, and a plain dished inner face with a small hooked grip. Suggests a heroic, medieval style.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and outer rim; colour 1 on the lion head and the ring band around it; colour 2 on the lion's mane and the recessed background; colour 3 on the lion's eyes.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Malvan_01.description: A large oval shield worn flat on the back, with a notched waist on each side, a raised rim and two vertical slots. The outer face has a radiating sunburst around a diamond glyph, ringed by alien lettering.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Shield_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face; colour 1 on the outer rim and lettering band; colour 2 on the central diamond glyph and sunburst slots; colour 3 on the lettering.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_01.description: A small pair of stylised feathered wings forming a V on the upper back, with banded feather sections, jagged ragged trailing edges and split feather tips at the base; a compact superhero back accessory.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing tips and the feather tips at the base; colour 1 on the main wing bands; colour 2 on the darker banded stripe and the ragged trailing edges.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_01.differs: The male wings show banded stripes of contrasting colour with ragged feather edges and split feather tips at the base, rather than the female's smooth solid blades.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_02.description: A long draped cape that hangs from the shoulders to about the calves, with soft folds and a flared hem. Winged shoulder pieces with a small central clasp rise at the neck, giving a heroic mantle look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Smallwings_Bluejay_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape body and clasp; colour 1 on the upswept wing tips at the shoulders; colour 2 on the underside of the shoulder wings.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A grid of twelve small conical metal spikes across the upper back and shoulder blades, in four rows of three. The top row sits high on the shoulders and points upward and outward. The look is punk and mechanical.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Spikes_01.differs: The top row of spikes rises up over the shoulders and points outward, and the cluster sits higher on the back.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Spikes_Huge_01.description: Clusters of large curved horn-like spikes sprouting from the upper and mid back in two groups, each spike rising from a banded collar base and tapering to a point; the biggest sweep outward and up past the shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Spikes_Huge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 3 on the band collars at the spike bases.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Spikes_Huge_01.differs: The male spikes fan out wider and higher from the shoulder blades, with the small spikes bunched into denser clusters lower down.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Steampunk_01.description: A steampunk mechanical backpack: a central boxy housing with a vented panel, tall capped exhaust stacks on top, ribbed hoses curving out at the shoulders, and square side tanks with porthole-like emblems and vent grilles, sitting across the upper and mid back.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and tank panels; colour 1 on the trim, stack bands and edge borders; colour 2 on the ribbed hoses; colour 3 on the vent slats and small emblem details.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Steampunk_01_1.description: A steampunk jetpack with a rounded egg-shaped central tank, riveted band and two side canisters topped with small nozzles, joined by flexible hoses. A vented panel and curved wing-like fins flare from the back and shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Steampunk_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tank dome, side canisters and flared fins; colour 1 on the riveted bands, arrow-shaped markings and lower panels; colour 2 on the hoses and dividing rings; colour 3 on the vent grille slots.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Steampunk_03.description: A rigid steampunk back plate shaped like a shield, with a high flared collar behind the head and riveted side panels. contrasting mechanical canisters, a boxy motor and ribbed hoses are mounted across the back.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Steampunk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate shell and collar edge; colour 2 on the inner collar and panel borders; colour 1 on the canisters, motor and nozzles; colour 3 on the rivets; colour 2 on the hoses.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Steampunk_04.description: A steampunk backpack device: a round geared plate with a ringed dial sits on the upper back, with a horizontal cylindrical tank strapped below, a tall vertical antenna rod and two angled cylinder prongs on top, and a hanging handle loop.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Steampunk_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate, housing and tank straps; colour 1 on the tank; colour 3 on the central dial, the angled prongs and the rod stripes; colour 2 on the rod, prong caps and handle.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.description: Four curved, blade-like spider legs sprouting from the upper back: two long spikes arc up past the head and two shorter ones sweep outward across the shoulder blades. Angular faceted metal suggests a mechanical arachnid look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all four blade legs; the default material shows a glossy metallic finish that mostly ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A compact, rounded rocket-pack worn high on the back, with a smooth shell, a broad plated dome over twin thruster nozzles on the back face and swept-back fin blades jutting out at the front edges. Sleek superhero-tech styling.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 0 on the fin blades, inner panel and upper rim; colour 3 on the domed plate and the thruster nozzles; colour 2 on the bands and gaps between plates.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male pack adds swept-back fin blades at the front edges, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_02.description: A compact twin-booster jetpack: two ribbed cylindrical rocket canisters with nozzle tips sit either side of a central angular plate and a small third tank, held by wide straps across the upper back and shoulders.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Steelcommando_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed booster bodies; colour 2 on the central plate, straps and bands; colour 0 on the nozzle tips, side panels and centre tank; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Stickbones_01.description: A mechanical back rig of four long spindly bone-like arms fanning out from a central mount between the shoulder blades, each ending in a cluster of round knobs or a ringed loop, joined by thin cords.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Stickbones_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long arm shafts and ring loops; colour 2 on the banded segments and connecting cords; colour 3 on the knob clusters and small wrapped tendrils.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Stickbones_01.differs: The male arms spread wider and lower, with the cords forming broader webbing between the arms.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Sword_01.description: A large sheathed sword carried diagonally across the back, hilt over the right shoulder and tip near the left hip. It has a segmented scabbard with ridged bands, a small crossguard and a wrapped grip.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard; colour 1 on the crossguard and the pommel cap; colour 2 on the grip.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Swordsdual_01.description: A pair of sheathed short swords worn crossed in a V on the upper back, hilts rising above the shoulders and tapered scabbards pointing down toward the spine, with banded scabbard ridges and flared crossguards.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Swordsdual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbards; colour 1 on the crossguards and pommel caps; colour 2 on the grip wraps.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Tools_01.description: A gadgeteer harness with a chest-and-back plate strapped over the torso, carrying several jointed mechanical arms: a satellite dish on a stalk, a pincer claw, a forked prong on a curved cable, and thick cylindrical tool pods.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Tools_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the harness plates and tool casings; colour 1 on the dish, jointed arm segments and plate panels; colour 2 on the cables, pods and joints; colour 3 on the claw, prongs and small lights.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Tools_01.differs: The male arms splay outward at a slightly different angle and the harness sits a bit lower and wider on the torso.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Tools_02.description: A mechanical backpack with a panelled body and a side-mounted cylindrical arm ending in a clawed tool with pointed prongs, plus a flexible jointed stalk carrying a round satellite dish beside the head.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Tools_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pack body panels; colour 1 on the satellite dish, stalk joints and pack accent panels; colour 2 on the arm segments and clamps; colour 3 on the tool prongs and small lights.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Tools_02.differs: The tool arm is a shorter, thicker cylinder mounted beside the pack and angled less steeply than the female version.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Tools_03.description: A mechanical gadgeteer backpack with a rounded plated pack on the back, a long drill-tipped tool arm and a wrench-clawed arm on jointed segments, plus a tall curling cable rising over the head to a pronged claw.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Tools_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pack shell and arm casings; colour 1 on the pack panels, coils and stripes; colour 2 on the cables and drill housing; colour 3 on the claw tips, wrench jaws and small lights.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Tools_03.differs: The drill arm is folded across the back at a diagonal and points forward on one side, while the female arm stays outstretched at the shoulder.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Urban_Anime_Messenger_.description: A cross-body sling messenger bag: a wide strap runs diagonally over one shoulder and chest, with a rounded, angular-panelled satchel resting on the lower back and a small flap with a tab on top.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Urban_Anime_Messenger_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide strap and upper bag body; colour 1 on the lower bag and strap sections; colour 2 on the strap edging and side panel; colour 3 on the flap tab.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Vine_01.description: A monstrous organic back piece: a swirl-patterned carapace across the shoulder blades, ringed with sharp thorn-like spikes, with two long serpentine necks rising over the shoulders, each ending in a toothed, open-jawed head.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main carapace, necks and heads; colour 0 on the swirl patterns and inner mouth details; colour 3 on the thorn spikes and tips.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Vine_01.differs: The male version has its heads rising more upright above the shoulders, and its carapace spreads wider across the upper back.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Wires_01.description: A cluster of flexible cable-like tentacles growing from the upper back, looping over the shoulders toward the front. Each ends in a clamp-like sleeve with a metal tip, giving a mechanical, cybernetic look.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cables; colour 1 on the sleeves and clamps at the cable ends; colour 0 on the small metal tips.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Wires_01.differs: The male wires spread wider across the shoulder blades and are arranged in a slightly different loop pattern.

Male/M_Back_Tight_Wires_02.description: A set of mechanical spinal implants running down the upper back: three short cylindrical plugs with capped ends alternate with two hexagonal sockets, and small curved shells show through at the front of the torso.
Male/M_Back_Tight_Wires_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cylinder bodies; colour 3 on the cylinder end caps and hexagon centres; colour 2 on the hexagonal sockets and curved shells.

Male/M_Back_Tubes_01.description: A mechanical backpack of boxy plated housings with round vented ports and a central slatted vent panel, worn across the upper back. Two thick ribbed tubes arc over the shoulders and hang down the front.
Male/M_Back_Tubes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plated housings; colour 1 on the small bolts and port rings; colour 2 on the tubes and port centres; colour 3 on the tube bands and vent slats.
Male/M_Back_Tubes_01.differs: The male version's tubes arc wider and hang lower down the front of the shoulders.

Male/M_Back_Turtleshell_01.description: A large oval turtle shell worn on the back: a domed outer carapace of hexagonal scutes, a scalloped rim of rounded plates, and a hollow, smooth inner face. It covers the back from shoulders to hips.
Male/M_Back_Turtleshell_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the carapace scutes and their highlights; colour 1 on the centre patches of the scutes and the outer edge; colour 3 on the inner face and the rim plates seen from the front; colour 2 on the seams between scutes.

Male/M_Back_Variablerobot_01.description: A mechanical backpack with two large angular wing-like panels that sweep up and outward above the shoulders, with slatted vents and tips. A boxy framed core with small hardware sits between the shoulder blades, with lower blocks hanging behind the hips.
Male/M_Back_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large wing panels and the pack body; colour 2 on the wing tips and the lower hanging blocks; colour 3 on the central framed core and small hardware; colour 0 on small inner details of the core.

Male/M_Back_Vigilante_01.description: A back-mounted recurve bow with swept, angular limbs and a thin taut string, strapped diagonally alongside a segmented cylindrical quiver of arrows with crossed straps and clamps. A mechanical archer's rig for a vigilante look.
Male/M_Back_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver body and bow riser; colour 1 on the bow limbs and arrow fletching; colour 2 on the quiver bands and clamps; colour 3 on the crossed straps and the bowstring.

Male/M_Back_Viperrocketpack_01.description: A mechanical backpack with a wide angular main plate, two shoulder-mounted rocket pods on jointed arms rising above the shoulders, and two long thruster canisters hanging at the sides. Sits across the upper back; sci-fi military look.
Male/M_Back_Viperrocketpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate, pod casings and canister bodies; colour 1 on the pod windows, canister panels and central thruster inserts; colour 2 on the joints, arms and lower thruster housings; colour 3 on the thin stripes near the canister tops.

Male/M_Back_Warlordrocketpack_01.description: A bulky mechanical backpack: twin rounded armoured pods across the upper back, a jointed arm on the left carrying a boxy monitor-like turret, and a thin antenna with a small sensor on the right. Sci-fi military gear.
Male/M_Back_Warlordrocketpack_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pod shells and turret casing; colour 1 on the pod panels, turret screen and sensor; colour 2 on the joints, arm and pod undersides; colour 3 on the small sensor lights.

Male/M_Back_Warrior_02.description: A small angular back plate shaped like a shield or arrowhead, sitting on the upper back between the shoulder blades and tapering to a point down the spine; a striped inner panel is framed by flared side edges.
Male/M_Back_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and the striped edges at the sides; colour 0 and colour 1 alternate in the stripes of the central back panel; colour 2 in the stripes at the flared side edges.
Male/M_Back_Warrior_02.differs: The male plate is bulkier and deeper, standing further off the back with a thicker rounded shell.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_01.description: A large double-bladed battle axe carried diagonally across the back: a long segmented, ribbed haft topped with a rounded pommel, and a wide butterfly-shaped head with ridged panels, a central round gem and a downward spike.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the haft and the ridged blade faces; colour 1 on the blade edges and outer rims; colour 3 on the central gem and inner accents; colour 2 in the recesses.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_01.differs: The male axe is slung at a steeper diagonal, with the head hanging off to one side of the hip and the haft crossing the back.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_02.description: A large alien battle axe carried diagonally across the back: a long ribbed handle with a ringed pommel and a looping chain, ending in a broad fan-shaped blade with panel lines, a central round gem and pointed spikes.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Axe_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle, chain and blade body; colour 1 on the blade edge fins and spikes; colour 3 on the central gem and blade inlay lines; colour 2 on the handle shaft joints.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Sword_0.description: A large sword worn diagonally across the back, with a segmented ridged hilt above the shoulder, a wide angular guard plate with a round gem, a long grooved blade and a spiky, leaf-like organic tip near the thigh.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Sword_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hilt, guard plate and blade body; colour 1 on the hanging loop and the organic tip section; colour 3 on the gem and the blade groove line.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Sword_0.description: A large sci-fi sword carried diagonally across the back, with a broad slab blade, a ribbed mechanical grip, an angular clawed guard with a round central gem and a curved cable-like loop rising over the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Alien_Organic_Sword_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hilt, guard and curved loop; colour 1 on the blade; colour 3 on the guard gem and the thin blade line; colour 2 on the grip segments.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Angon_01.description: A long, thin javelin-like spear (angon) carried diagonally across the back, with a contrasting shaft, a small contrasting band near the middle and a slender metal barbed point extending down past the legs.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Angon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaft; colour 1 on the small band at the middle of the shaft; colour 0 on the metal spearhead and shaft tip.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Animestylesword_03.description: An oversized broad-bladed sword carried diagonally across the back, with a wide flat blade, contrasting edge trim, a wrapped grip poking up past the shoulder, and a spiky claw-like guard resting near the neck.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Animestylesword_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade face; colour 3 on the blade edge trim; colour 1 on the wrapped grip; colour 2 on the spiky guard and pommel.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Axe_Wood_01.description: A large twisted axe carried diagonally across the back: a long handle of gnarled, intertwined vine-like branches with a forked tip above the shoulder, and a double-bladed feathered-looking head resting at the lower back.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Axe_Wood_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the twisted handle and branches; the axe blades ignore the scheme and show a glossy metal finish.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Balloon_01.description: A twisted-balloon sword worn diagonally across the back: a long smooth cylindrical blade, a looped crossguard of balloon lobes, a short grip and a small round pommel knob poking up behind the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Balloon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the grip; colour 2 on the crossguard loops; colour 3 on the pommel. The glossy balloon finish mutes the scheme.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Baseball_Bat_02.description: A full-length baseball bat carried diagonally across the back, handle end low at the hip and barrel tip rising past the shoulder. It has a tapered body with a separate grip section and a capped end.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Baseball_Bat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel tip, handle and end cap; colour 1 on the upper and lower bands of the shaft; colour 2 on the main body of the shaft; colour 3 on the small accent marks.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Baseball_Bat_02.differs: The male bat is angled more steeply across the back, running from the low hip up to the opposite shoulder.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Bat_Bent_01.description: A bent, dented baseball bat slung diagonally across the back, handle up over one shoulder and the fat barrel hanging low at the opposite hip. A wrapped grip and a crumpled kink mid-shaft give it a battered street-brawler look.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Bat_Bent_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrapped handle grip; colour 0 on the upper shaft and the knob end; colour 1 on the barrel end.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Bat_Bent_01.differs: The bat is angled more sharply across the back, with the barrel hanging lower at the hip.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Battery_01.description: A large sci-fi plasma rifle slung diagonally across the back, from the shoulder down to the opposite hip. It has a sleek casing, fin-like blades near the muzzle, a round sensor lens, ribbed coil segments and angular vent panels.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Battery_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rifle casing; colour 1 on the fins, ribbed coils and barrel bands; colour 3 on the diamond vent panels and the round lens; colour 2 on the darker underside and grip.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Bayonet_01.description: A long bolt-action rifle with a scope and a bayonet fixed to the muzzle, slung diagonally across the back from the upper shoulder down to the hip. It suggests a military or pulp look.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Bayonet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rifle stock and barrel body; colour 1 on the buttplate, scope, sling loop and fittings; colour 2 on the small barrel bands; colour 3 on the bayonet blade.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Bayonet_01.differs: The rifle lies at a shallower diagonal across the back, with the muzzle and bayonet reaching down beside the hand.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Blasterassaultrifle_0.description: A sci-fi blaster assault rifle carried horizontally across the upper back, with a bulky receiver, pistol grip, top-mounted scope rail, short muzzle and angular stock, held by a triangular bracket plate.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Blasterassaultrifle_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rifle body and top rail; colour 1 on the grip, bracket plate and trim pieces; colour 2 on the stock and barrel; colour 3 on the small vent details.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Blasterassaultrifle_0.differs: The male rifle lies more level across the back with the stock on the left.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Bone_01.description: An oversized bone modelled as a femur, carried diagonally across the back with the rounded head rising past one shoulder and the knuckled end hanging near the opposite hip. No straps are visible.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Bone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shaft; colour 1 on the lower knuckled end; colour 2 on the upper head of the bone.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_01.description: A broadsword carried diagonally across the back, hilt over one shoulder and point reaching the opposite hip. It has a straight crossguard, a long grip with a round pommel, and a wide blade etched with rune-like markings.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hilt, crossguard and pommel; colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the etched runes along the blade.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_02.description: Three broadswords appear stuck through the upper back and shoulder, with blades poking out the front of the torso. contrasting crossguards and grips, engraved blades with rune-like markings; a grim, medieval fantasy look.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hilts, crossguards and pommels; colour 0 on the blades; colour 3 on the etched markings along the blades.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Broadsword_02.differs: The male version spreads the swords wider across the shoulders, with two hilts high at the shoulder blades and the third lower on the back.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Broom_01.description: A witch-style broomstick slung diagonally across the back, with a long gnarled handle that curls into a hook above the shoulder and a bushy fibrous bristle head hanging at hip level, bound by banded wraps.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Broom_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle; colour 0 on the bristles; colour 2 on the binding band; colour 3 on the thin ring accent above the binding.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Chainsaw_01.description: A large mechanical chainsaw sword worn diagonally across the back: a boxy engine housing with vents and a rear handle, a curved loop grip at the top, and a long toothed blade running down past the hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Chainsaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the engine housing, loop grip and blade guard; colour 1 on the blade's central band; colour 2 on the rear handle and blade edge; colour 3 on the round buttons and small indicator lights.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Combat_01.description: A double-bladed battle axe carried diagonally on the back, its handle rising past the shoulder to a spiked, winged finial, with a mechanical hub and two swept crescent blades hanging low at the hip. Ornate fantasy styling.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Combat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the axe head hub and the finial; colour 1 on the crescent blade edges; colour 3 on the shaft and the ring at its centre.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Cosmic_Slayer_01.description: An oversized slab-bladed greatsword carried diagonally across the back, with a wide flat blade tapering to an angular tip, a wedge-shaped guard, a long wrapped grip and a small round pommel.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Cosmic_Slayer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the wedge guard; colour 1 on the wrapped grip; colour 3 on the pommel.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Crowbar_01.description: A slender metal crowbar carried diagonally across the back, with a flat pry end angled out above one shoulder and a curved, split claw hook at the lower end near the opposite hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Crowbar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crowbar; the metal finish appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Doubleheadedaxe_01.description: A double-headed battle axe carried diagonally on the back: two broad curved blades with contrasting cutting edges flank a boxy mechanical head with knobs, on a long ringed shaft with a gripped end, held by a contrasting strap.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Doubleheadedaxe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade faces and axe head; colour 3 on the blade edges; colour 1 on the shaft; colour 2 on the knobs, grip bands and strap.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Draco_01.description: A long polearm carried diagonally across the back, with a contrasting shaft, a barbed spearhead at the top and a winged, spiked blade cluster with a long tapered spike near the lower end. Ornate dragon-themed fantasy weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaft; colour 1 on the spearhead and blade wings; colour 0 on the blade edges and lower spike.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Draco_02.description: A long spear carried diagonally across the back, with a slim shaft, a small pointed tip at the top and a wide multi-pronged trident-like head with feathery spiked fins near the hip. Suggests a fantasy dragon-themed weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaft; colour 1 on the prongs and blade blades of the lower head; colour 0 on the spiked fins and tip; colour 3 on the small central gem.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Falchion_01.description: A single-edged falchion with a broad, curved blade, wrapped grip, flat crossguard and round pommel, slung diagonally across the back with the hilt above the shoulder and the tip near the opposite hip. Medieval fantasy weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Falchion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the blade's edge trim; colour 1 on the wrapped grip and small binding cords; colour 2 on the crossguard and pommel.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Fantasy_01.description: A fantasy broadsword carried diagonally across the back, hilt above the right shoulder and point near the opposite hip. It has a wrapped grip, a winged guard with a small gem, and a tapering blade with a contrasting edge line.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the grip wrap and the small cords near the guard; colour 2 on the guard and pommel; colour 3 on the grip rings, the gem and the blade edge lines.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Frigid_01.description: A long slender sword worn diagonally across the back, with a narrow tapering blade, a small winged crossguard with spiky accents, and a large curling hooked crescent guard rising above the shoulder. Fantasy styling.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the crossguard and spiky accents; colour 2 on the curved crescent guard; colour 3 on a small gem at the hilt.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Frigid_01.differs: The male sword is angled more steeply across the back, with the blade tip reaching low past the hip, while the female one hangs more upright.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Frigid_Rifle_01.description: A sci-fi rifle slung diagonally across the back, with a bulky angular stock, a cylindrical canister on top and a forked, claw-like muzzle of prongs hanging down near the hip. Segmented mechanical construction.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Frigid_Rifle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rifle body and muzzle prongs; colour 1 on the stock, grip and underside panels; colour 3 on the canister; colour 2 on small vents and details.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Frosty_01.description: A chunky sci-fi rifle slung diagonally across the back, with the long tapered stock rising past the shoulder and the bulky angular body, tank-like cylinder and ribbed grip hanging low near the hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Frosty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stock tip and the metal frame edges; colour 1 on the stock, casing and side fins; colour 3 on the cylinder and the inset stripe; colour 2 on the grips, vents and cable loops.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Frosty_01.differs: The rifle is angled more diagonally and hangs lower on the back, with the stock ending beside the shoulder.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gamer_01.description: A sci-fi blaster slung diagonally across the back, with a forked, fin-like upper housing rising past the shoulder, a long barrel running toward the opposite hip, a pistol grip and a hanging magazine.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forked upper housing; colour 1 on the barrel body; colour 2 on the grip and magazine; colour 3 on the small vent markings and ribbed accents.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gear_01.description: A large mechanical sword worn across the back: a gear-shaped hub with a glowing core sits between the shoulder blades, with a hilt rising diagonally above one shoulder and a long multi-pronged blade sloping down past the opposite hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade; colour 2 on the gear housing and hilt top; colour 0 on the hilt shaft and gear teeth; colour 3 on the centre of the gear.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gear_01.differs: The male sword is slung diagonally across the back, with the blade sloping down to one side, rather than hanging straight down the spine.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gladiator_01.description: A large double-headed war hammer carried across the lower back: a long ribbed handle with a flared pommel rises past the shoulder, ending in two chunky, bevelled blocks with recessed line panels. Bulky gladiator style.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hammer head blocks; colour 1 on the handle ribbing and the small plates on the head corners; colour 2 on the handle shaft and pommel; colour 3 on the recessed line inlays.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gladiator_02.description: A large two-handed axe carried diagonally across the back, with a long twisted-grip haft, a curved crescent blade on one side and a blocky hammer head on the other, joined by an ornate winged central mount.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade, hammer block and haft cap; colour 2 on the twisted haft; colour 1 on the inner panels of the central mount; colour 3 on the collar rings and mount trim.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gladius_01.description: A short Roman-style gladius sheathed diagonally across the back, hilt rising over the shoulder: a broad leaf-shaped blade with edged border, a wrapped grip, a flat guard and a knobbed pommel, held by thin cords.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Gladius_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade face; colour 3 on the blade edges; colour 1 on the wrapped grip, pommel cap and thin cords; colour 2 on the guard and pommel.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Glaive_01.description: A glaive carried diagonally across the back: a long slender pole topped with a broad leaf-shaped blade, slanting from the lower hip up past the shoulder. A wrapped grip section sits near the lower end, giving a fantasy, medieval polearm look.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Glaive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the upper pole shaft; colour 1 on the lower grip section of the pole.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Glaive_01.differs: The male glaive has a longer pole, with a visible lower grip section that extends below the hip, and it shows more of the mid-contrasting lower shaft.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Grenade_Launcher_01.description: A chunky revolver-style grenade launcher slung diagonally across the back, with a rotating drum of striped chambers, a boxy angular receiver on top, a short cylindrical barrel pointing down, and a fabric strap tab at the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Grenade_Launcher_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the receiver, drum casing and barrel; colour 1 on the shoulder strap tab; colour 3 and colour 2 on alternating stripes of the drum chambers.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Hacker_01.description: An oversized cleaver-style sword carried diagonally across the back, with a wide flat slab blade that has a squared, notched tip and a long wrapped handle rising above the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Hacker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the small guard band at the base of the handle.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Halberd_01.description: A long halberd carried diagonally across the back, with a slender pole, a small round pommel at the top, a crescent axe blade with a side hook and a long spear point at the lower end.
