Male/M_Back_Weapon_Halberd_01.colourAreas: The piece shows as a wireframe-like outline on this sheet and does not visibly take the colour scheme; no clear colour slot assignments can be seen.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Halberd_01.differs: This version appears as a thin contrasting outline rather than solid coloured parts, with no visible wrapped grip section.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_01.description: A heraldic mace carried diagonally across the back: a long banded shaft topped with a pointed spearhead, ending in a flared, bell-shaped head with studded spikes and a ringed base. Suggests a ceremonial medieval fantasy weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spearhead, the flanged collar and the base rim and spikes; colour 1 on the bell-shaped mace head; colour 3 on the shaft sections; colour 2 on the shaft joints and fittings.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_02.description: A long heraldic spear carried diagonally across the back, with a barbed leaf-shaped head at the top, a segmented shaft with banded rings and a smaller pointed butt spike at the bottom. Fantasy medieval look.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spearhead and butt spike; colour 3 on the collar rings and bands; colour 0 on the upper shaft section; colour 2 on the lower shaft grips.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Heraldry_02.differs: The spear lies at a shallower diagonal across the back, with the butt reaching further out past the opposite hip.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Hooksword_01.description: An oversized slab-bladed greatsword carried diagonally across the back, with a wide flat blade, a small guard block at the top, and a long wrapped handle ending in a pommel cap that rises past the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Hooksword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the guard block at the base of the handle; colour 2 on the handle grip; colour 3 on the pommel cap.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Ice_01.description: A large jagged ice-crystal sword worn on the back: a clustered burst of sharp icicle spikes sits at the shoulder blades, a tapering faceted blade slants diagonally down the back, and a slim hilt with a spiked pommel rises above the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Ice_01.colourAreas: Glossy crystalline material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on the spike cluster and hilt accents, with the rest of the blade and hilt taking the glossy finish.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Ice_01.differs: The sword is slung diagonally across the back, with the blade angled down toward one hip and the hilt tilted over the opposite shoulder.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Industrial_01.description: A large industrial sword worn diagonally across the back, hilt above the shoulder with a wrapped grip and hooked pommel. The blade is a broad, segmented, leaf-shaped mechanical piece with a jagged guard and a pointed tip near the hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Industrial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade and guard; colour 2 on the wrapped grip; colour 3 on the collar ring below the pommel. The blade shows a metallic finish that mostly ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Ionic_01.description: A long sci-fi energy rifle carried diagonally across the back, from above the shoulder down to the hip. It has a boxy angular body, a short side grip near the top, vented panels and a thin muzzle rod.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Ionic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rifle body and casing; colour 1 on the clamp bands and end block; colour 3 on the small round indicator dots and vent strips; colour 2 on the recessed slots.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Ji_01.description: A long ji polearm carried diagonally across the back: a straight shaft topped with a crossbar-braced head, a central spike and two curved crescent blades. It rises past the shoulder and reaches down toward the opposite hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Ji_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade head and crescents; colour 1 on the long shaft.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Ji_01.differs: The male polearm lies at a shallower diagonal, and the shaft's lower end reaches further out past the hip; the female one sits steeper and more upright.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Katana_01.description: A katana in a straight scabbard carried diagonally across the back, hilt above the right shoulder and tip near the left hip. It has a wrapped handle, a small round guard and a knotted cord tied at the chest.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Katana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard; colour 2 on the handle wrap base, guard and scabbard ends; colour 3 on the handle wrap diamonds; colour 1 on the knotted cord.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Katana_Cyberninja_01.description: A sheathed katana slung diagonally across the back, with a gently curved scabbard, a tech-detailed hilt and pommel poking up past the shoulder, and a contrasting strap with small cords holding it at the chest.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Katana_Cyberninja_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scabbard; colour 0 on the hilt and its mechanical detailing; colour 2 on the strap and cords.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Lance_01.description: A long conical lance sheathed in a tapering cloth-covered case slung diagonally across the back, with a crown-like metal collar at the top, small ornamental emblems, a pointed metal tip and a wrapped grip and blade shaft rising over the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Lance_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal crown collar, tip and hilt; colour 1 on the tapering case; colour 3 on the small ornaments on the case; colour 2 on the grip wrapping.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Lance_Elegant_01.description: A long lance carried diagonally across the back, with a slim plain shaft, a small angular guard near the top, a short striped upper section and a pointed tip at the lower end. Suggests an elegant fantasy weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Lance_Elegant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shaft section near the guard; colour 2 on the guard, the long lower shaft and the tips; colour 0 in small details on the shaft.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Lance_Elegant_01.differs: The male lance is mostly a plain contrasting shaft with only a short coloured section at the top, rather than a spiral-striped shaft.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Lead_Pipe_01.description: A long straight metal pipe carried diagonally across the back, from over one shoulder down to the opposite hip, with two contrasting bands near the bottom and a bent elbow-joint fitting at the end. Improvised, industrial weapon look.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Lead_Pipe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pipe shaft; colour 2 on the bands near the lower end; colour 1 on the elbow fitting.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Mad_Scientist_03.description: A compact sci-fi submachine-gun slung diagonally across the back, with a long ribbed barrel, top-mounted plunger, pistol grip and a curved, clawed shoulder stock. Angular mechanical housings suggest a mad-scientist gadget.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Mad_Scientist_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main receiver and barrel housing; colour 1 on the stock, grip and side panels; colour 3 on small accents near the trigger; colour 2 on small fittings.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Microphone_Stand_01.description: A vintage-style microphone stand worn diagonally across the back, with a rounded mic head at the shoulder, a slim telescoping pole with a collar joint, and a flared round base near the opposite hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Microphone_Stand_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the microphone head; colour 3 on the mic grille details; colour 0 on the pole, collar and base; colour 2 on the small joint band.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Missilelauncher_01.description: A bazooka-style rocket launcher carried diagonally across the back, with its muzzle above the shoulder and a flared rear end near the opposite hip. It has a side grip, a sight block and a mounting bracket at the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Missilelauncher_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main tube body and the shoulder bracket; colour 0 on the muzzle, sight and grip housings; colour 2 on the rear flare; colour 3 on the thin bands around the tube.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Morningstar_01.description: A spiked morning star carried diagonally across the back, with the handle up by the shoulder and the studded ball hanging low at the side of the waist. The wrapped grip has a guard, and a thin cord loops over the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Morningstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrapped grip, guard and cord; colour 2 on the shaft and pommel; colour 0 on the spiked ball; colour 3 on the spikes.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Morningstar_01.differs: The weapon slants more steeply, so the ball hangs out at the side of the waist rather than near the centre of the lower back.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Odragon_01.description: A large sheathed sword worn diagonally across the back, hilt rising over the shoulder. It has a ringed pommel, a wrapped grip, a sculpted dragon-shaped guard and a long tapering scabbard with engraved patterning.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pommel, dragon guard and scabbard patterning; colour 3 on the grip; colour 2 on the scabbard body; colour 0 on the scabbard edge and tip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Odragon_01.differs: This version shows distinct colour panels on the pommel, grip, guard and scabbard, whereas the female version renders as a contrasting glowing white.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Okatana_01.description: A sheathed katana (scabbard only) slung diagonally across the back, slightly curved, with end caps at both ends and a small band near the top. The tip points down toward the opposite hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Okatana_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scabbard; colour 2 on the end caps and the small band.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Pitchfork_01.description: A long-handled pitchfork carried diagonally across the back, with a slender straight shaft and a four-tine head hanging low near the hip. Simple rustic farm-tool weapon with a thin metal collar joining head and shaft.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Pitchfork_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft; colour 2 on the collar and shaft tip; colour 1 on the tines.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Plunger_01.description: A toilet plunger carried diagonally across the back: a long thin straight handle rising past the shoulder, with a rounded rubber cup resting at the lower back by the hip. A comic novelty prop.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Plunger_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle; colour 1 on the rubber cup.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Plunger_01.differs: The male plunger shows solid colours, with the handle in colour 0 and the cup in colour 1, instead of a glossy see-through finish.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Punk_01.description: A keytar-style keyboard worn slung diagonally across the back: a long narrow neck rising past the shoulder and a broad paddle-shaped body at the hip, with a keyboard, a row of small lights and a thin sling strap at the chest.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing and body; colour 1 on the keys; colour 3 on the row of small lights along the neck; colour 2 on the keys and the neck end.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Rake_01.description: A garden rake carried diagonally across the back: a long slim pole rising past one shoulder, with a wide flat head of fine tines at the bottom near the hip, drawn as a thin outlined frame.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Rake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pole, head bar and tines; the default material appears to ignore the other colour slots.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Rake_01.differs: The male rake is a thin outlined frame that renders in a single light tone with a larger head, while the female version is a solid pole with a separate collar and finer tines.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Recurvebow_01.description: A recurve bow slung diagonally across the back, with long curved limbs, a wrapped central grip and a thin taut string. It runs from above the shoulder down toward the opposite hip, suggesting an archer or hunter look.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Recurvebow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer limb surfaces; colour 1 on the grip section; colour 3 on the accent panels near the grip; colour 2 on the string and limb tips.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Renegade_01.description: A large sci-fi rifle slung diagonally across the back, with a bulky receiver, a side-mounted ribbed magazine, a rear grip and stock, and a muzzle that points down toward the hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body panels and stock; colour 1 on the frame, outer housing and magazine casing; colour 3 on the top rail and accent strips; colour 2 on the muzzle tip and joints.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Rifle_02.description: A modern assault rifle carried diagonally across the back, muzzle up over the shoulder and stock down by the opposite hip, with a carrying handle, ribbed handguard, magazine and thin sling straps.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Rifle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the receiver, magazine and stock body; colour 1 on the handguard, stock end and sling straps; colour 3 on small accent rings on the handguard; colour 2 on the barrel and sights.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Scythe_Heavy_01.description: A heavy mechanical scythe carried across the back: a long, kinked pole runs diagonally from the hip up past the shoulder to a jagged mechanical head with a huge curved blade sweeping forward beside the head.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Scythe_Heavy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade and head housing; colour 1 on the pole and the small knob at the top; colour 3 on the joint where the blade meets the pole; colour 2 on the grip end.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shield_Heraldry_01.description: A large kite-shaped heraldic shield carried on the back, with a thick rim, a pointed lower tip, a small grip handle on the inner face and a raised fleur-de-lis crest on a recessed panel on the outer face.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shield_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and outer plate; colour 2 on the rim and handle; colour 1 on the recessed back panel; colour 3 on the fleur-de-lis crest.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_02.description: A sawn-off double-barrelled shotgun carried diagonally across the back, with a curved pistol grip at the upper shoulder, exposed hammers and short side-by-side barrels pointing down toward the opposite hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved grip; the barrels, hammers and receiver are worn metal that does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_04.description: A chunky sci-fi shotgun slung diagonally across the back, with the stock at the upper shoulder and the barrel angled down toward the opposite hip. It has a pump section, panel details and small contrasting fins.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shotgun_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the body, stock and pump housing; colour 0 on the barrel tip and the metal muzzle sections; colour 2 on the small fins and recessed panels; colour 3 on the small markings.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shovel_01.description: A full-size digging shovel carried diagonally across the back, with a D-shaped grip handle at the shoulder, a long straight shaft and a broad flat blade hanging near the hip. Practical, rugged work-tool look.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shovel_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blade's upper part and the D-shaped handle frame; colour 1 on the lower part of the blade; colour 3 on the handle grip and shaft.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shovel_01.differs: The male shovel has a mostly contrasting blade with only a small two-tone tip, and its handle shaft is darker, with less visible red.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shovel_02.description: A full-size shovel carried diagonally across the back, with a long slim shaft, a thick padded grip at the top and a broad pointed spade blade hanging near the hip. Rugged utilitarian weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Shovel_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the lower edge of the blade; colour 2 on the shaft; colour 3 on the grip.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sickle_02.description: A long-handled sickle carried diagonally across the back, with a banded shaft, a small collar at the head and a single long, sharply curved metal blade sweeping out at hip level.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sickle_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle shaft; colour 2 on the bands and end caps; colour 3 on small marks along the handle; colour 0 on the blade, which has a metallic finish.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sickle_02.differs: The male version has an opaque, solid metal blade and a handle that takes colour, while the female version is a glassy, translucent white.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Skeletal_01.description: A long staff carried diagonally across the back, topped with a horned skull with glowing eyes. Below it sit a wrapped grip and a tapering shaft lined with thorn-like spines, ending in a sharp point near the calves.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Skeletal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and horns; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the grip section below the skull; colour 1 on the spiked shaft and spines.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Skeletal_01.differs: The male staff slants more sharply across the back, with its head over the shoulder and its tip angled out to the side.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sledgehammer_01.description: A large sledgehammer carried diagonally across the back, with a long straight round handle rising past the shoulder and a chunky faceted head resting low near the hip. Rugged, practical melee weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sledgehammer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle; colour 1 on the hammer head.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sniperrifle_03.description: A long sniper rifle slung diagonally along the back, with a long slender barrel rising above the shoulder, a side-mounted scope, a bulky angular stock with a thumbhole grip, and small side brackets.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sniperrifle_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel shaft and body plating; colour 1 on the scope, muzzle tip and side brackets; colour 2 on the stock and grip; colour 3 on the small accents and scope lens rim.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Spear_Aztec_01.description: A long spear slung diagonally across the back, with a metal-capped butt, a wrapped shaft with banded fittings, and a broad leaf-shaped blade with a ridged, jagged edge hanging near the hip. Suggests an ancient Mesoamerican-inspired weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Spear_Aztec_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal caps, collars and banded fittings; colour 1 on the shaft; colour 3 on the spearhead blade; colour 2 on the blade edges and darker details.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Splintered_01.description: A large sword worn diagonally across the back, with a wrapped grip, a heavy crossguard and a broad blade made of layered splintered shards that fan down to the thigh. Reads as a savage, jagged fantasy weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Splintered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the splintered blade shards; colour 1 on the inner shards and accents between them; colour 2 on the crossguard and pommel; colour 3 on the grip wrapping.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Splintered_01.differs: The blade is angled more sharply, sweeping across the back toward the right hip, with the hilt rising over the left shoulder.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Staff_Skull_01.description: A long thin cane or staff carried diagonally across the back, topped with a small skull head and ending in a small capped tip at the lower end. Suggests a gothic, occult gentleman's cane.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Staff_Skull_01.colourAreas: The male sheet renders the piece as a outline, so the colour slots are not clearly visible. Colour 1 is most likely on the skull, colour 0 on the shaft and colour 2 on the end cap, matching the female sheet.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Steelcommando_01.description: A retro rifle-style weapon slung diagonally across the back, with a flat blocky stock at the upper shoulder, boxy receiver parts along the body and a slim barrel pointing down toward the opposite hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: The piece renders as a glossy, glassy sheen that mostly ignores the colour scheme, so the slots have little visible effect.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Streetlamp_01.description: A long street lamp post carried diagonally across the back, with a slim straight pole, a bent neck at the top and an elongated rounded lamp head angled out to one side. Suggests an improvised urban weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Streetlamp_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pole and neck joint; colour 1 on the lamp head; colour 2 on the underside of the lamp head.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sulitsa_01.description: A long slender spear worn slung diagonally across the back: a thin straight shaft with a small leaf-shaped point at the lower end and a plain tip at the top. Suggests a medieval or tribal weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sulitsa_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaft; colour 0 on the small metal spearhead.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Aztec_01.description: A macuahuitl-style broadsword carried diagonally across the back: a long slab blade with a central groove and a row of jagged teeth along each edge, an angular guard, and a short handle ending in a ring pommel.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Aztec_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade body and guard; colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 3 on the edge teeth and tip cap; colour 2 on the central groove.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Aztec_02.description: A spiked mace carried diagonally across the back: a wrapped handle with a flared contrasting pommel rises over the shoulder, and a tapering segmented head of stacked rings with pyramid studs ends in a pointed tip near the hip.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Aztec_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stacked head segments; colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the pommel and the bands between segments; colour 3 on the spikes and the tip.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Kunai_01.description: A single oversized kunai carried diagonally across the back: a long leaf-shaped flat blade tapering to a point, a thin wrapped handle, and a round ring pommel poking up past the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Kunai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the wrapped handle; colour 1 on the ring pommel.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Stick_01.description: A long, rough wooden branch worn slung diagonally across the back, from the right shoulder down toward the left hip, with a few short stubby twig offshoots and cut ends. Suggests a rustic staff or improvised weapon.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Stick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole branch; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Stick_03.description: A long, slightly curved wooden walking stick with small knots and stubs of cut branches along its length, worn slung diagonally across the back from the shoulder to the opposite hip. Rustic, simple and unadorned.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Sword_Stick_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole stick; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Tateklys_01.description: A long-hafted scythe-like polearm carried diagonally across the back, with a broad curved blade at the top, small fin-like blades below it, banded grip wraps and a pointed spearhead tip at the lower end.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Tateklys_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade body; colour 1 on the blade edge and the fin-like blades and spike tip; colour 2 on the shaft; colour 3 on the bands around the shaft.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Therakiel_01.description: An oversized sword worn diagonally across the back: a broad, jagged blade with notched edges and studded inlays, a spiked round guard, a wrapped grip and a curved, spiked pommel rising above the shoulder.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Therakiel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade plates; colour 1 on the guard and pommel; colour 2 on the wrapped grip; colour 3 on the spikes, blade inlay lines and studs.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Therakiel_01.differs: The blade slants more sharply across the back, with the tip reaching out past the hip on the side.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Bow_01.description: A recurve bow slung diagonally across the back, with swept, blade-like curved limbs, a padded grip, wrapped bands along the limbs and a thin taut string. It suggests a fantasy ranger or sci-fi archer.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bow limbs; colour 1 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the grip; colour 3 on the string.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Staff_01.description: A slender staff carried diagonally across the back, with a curled, hooked head that wraps around a faceted gem, a twisted shaft bound with thin cord wraps, and a pointed tip near the legs. Ornate fantasy styling.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Staff_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the staff shaft and curled head; colour 3 on the gem; colour 2 on the cord wraps.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_01.description: A long straight sword worn diagonally across the back, its handle rising above the shoulder. It has a slim tapered blade, a wrapped grip with a rounded pommel, and an ornate curved crossguard with small decorative details.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade; colour 2 on the grip; colour 3 on the crossguard accents; colour 0 on the pommel and small guard details.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_02.description: A long straight greatsword slung diagonally across the back, hilt up beside the head and blade tapering to a point near the thigh. It has a winged ornate crossguard, a long wrapped grip, and a blade with a central fuller and edge bands.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrapped grip; colour 0 on the crossguard and centre of the blade; colour 1 on the blade edges and fuller; colour 3 on small pommel and guard accents.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Traveler_Sword_02.differs: The male sword shows distinct coloured grip, crossguard and blade panels, while the female version renders as a glossy translucent glass-like material.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Trident_Arvad_01.description: A long trident carried diagonally across the back, with a slender straight shaft, a rounded end cap at the bottom, and a curved multi-pronged metal head with hooked outer barbs. Suits an aquatic fantasy look.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Trident_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaft; colour 2 on the end cap; the trident head is glossy metal and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Trooper_01.description: A huge slab-like sci-fi sword carried diagonally across the back, with a long contrasting grip and pommel poking above the shoulder, jagged angular guard plates down the spine side, and a toothed serrated edge along the blade.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the jagged armour plates and pommel; colour 0 on the flat blade face; colour 2 on the grip; colour 3 on the round studs on the upper plates; colour 0 on the serrated teeth along the edge.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Trooper_02.description: A long curved katana slung diagonally across the back, with the hilt rising above the shoulder and an angular winged guard. The scabbard tapers down past the hip, with jagged accent markings on the handle.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Trooper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade and scabbard; colour 3 on the handle wrap and jagged markings; colour 2 on the guard and pommel; colour 1 on small accents along the scabbard.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Vacuum_01.description: An upright vacuum cleaner slung diagonally across the back: a tapered fabric bag on a long thin handle with a curved grip, and a wide flat cleaner head hanging at the hip. Comic household-gadget style.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Vacuum_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cleaner head casing; colour 1 on the fabric bag; colour 2 on the underside of the head and the handle shaft; colour 3 on the handle grip and the head's front strip.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Vigilante_01.description: A large recurve bow carried diagonally across the back, rising above the head and ending near the hip. It has swept, blade-like limbs, a jointed mechanical grip with clamp-like sections, and a thin taut string.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved limbs; colour 0 on the jointed central riser; colour 3 on the grip clamps and the bowstring.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Vladic_01.description: A large broadsword worn diagonally across the back, hilt up over the shoulder. It has a wide blade with notched cut-outs along one edge, a winged bat-like crossguard around a round gem, and a long grip ending in a small spiked pommel.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Vladic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the grip; colour 2 on the crossguard wings and pommel; colour 3 on the round gem.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Warhammer_02.description: A long-handled double-headed warhammer carried diagonally across the back, head resting above the shoulder. Octagonal faceted striking plates flank a rounded waisted core, and a ringed, wrapped haft has a small angular guard.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Warhammer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hammer head core; colour 3 on the striking faces and haft rings; colour 1 on the handle and the angular guard; colour 2 on the small fittings and handle end cap.

Male/M_Back_Weapon_Westernrifle_01.description: A lever-action western rifle slung diagonally across the back, with the wooden stock rising past the shoulder and the barrel pointing down toward the opposite hip. A short strap with small bands holds it in place.
Male/M_Back_Weapon_Westernrifle_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the stock and forestock; colour 2 on the receiver and lever; colour 0 on the barrel; colour 3 on the strap bands and stock butt trim.

Male/M_Back_Werewolf_01.description: A narrow strip of shaggy fur-like mane running down the centre of the upper back from the neck to the mid-back, with jagged tufts and pointed locks swept out to one side.
Male/M_Back_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base of the mane; colour 1 on the jagged tips and outer locks, blending into colour 0.

Male/M_Back_Wings_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A set of long, tapering tentacles that spring from a central hub on the upper back. Several arch out and over the shoulders with pointed tips, while shorter ones hang down behind the body. Alien, mechanical-organic look.
Male/M_Back_Wings_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hub and the lower hanging tentacles; colour 1 on the middle and outer tentacle segments; colour 2 on the arched segments; colour 3 on the sections near the tips.
Male/M_Back_Wings_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The male tentacles are split into separate colour bands (colours 0, 1, 2 and 3) along their length rather than mostly one colour with thin stripes.

Male/M_Back_Wings_Patriot_01.description: A pair of large feathered angel wings rising from the upper back, arching above the shoulders and sweeping down past the knees in long layered feather tiers with pointed tips. Heroic, patriotic-superhero styling.
Male/M_Back_Wings_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper leading-edge feathers; colour 1 on the middle feather band; colour 2 on the long lower flight feathers.

Male/M_Back_Wings_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of rigid, static mechanical wings mounted at the shoulder blades, each a fan of overlapping tapered feather-like blades with contrasting edging and a curved upper plate, swept outward and slightly down.
Male/M_Back_Wings_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved upper plates; colour 3 on the feather blades; colour 2 on the blade edging; colour 1 on the thin line trim along the plates.
Male/M_Back_Wings_Starhawk_01.differs: The male wings are larger and angle more sharply back and out from the shoulders, with a deeper curve to each wing.

Male/M_Back_Wings_Thruster_01.description: A pair of mechanical thruster wings mounted on the upper back: two long, tapering pod-like housings, each with swept fin blades along the outer edge and a short bracket arm attaching to the shoulder area. Sci-fi superhero jet-pack styling.
Male/M_Back_Wings_Thruster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing frames and mounting brackets; colour 1 on the large panels and fin blades; colour 3 on the small accent fins and vents; colour 2 on the nozzle tips.

Male/M_Belt_Ammo_Bandolier_01.description: A wide belt with a front buckle and punched holes, ringed by a row of upright bullet cartridges that hang around the whole circumference. It sits low on the waist and suggests a military or tactical look.
Male/M_Belt_Ammo_Bandolier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the edge piping and inner lining; colour 1 on the cartridge bands and tops; colour 2 on the buckle and bullet tips.

Male/M_Belt_Aquatic_01.description: A low-slung, ornate fantasy belt band that dips into a V at the front, with a layered pointed gem-set buckle, swirling scrollwork flourishes, and a small V-shaped point at the back. Sits on the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band and rim; colour 1 on the inner stripe and the layered buckle plates; colour 2 on the scrollwork and top edge piping; colour 3 on the central gem.

Male/M_Belt_Aquatic_02.description: A low-slung, wide belt band with a raised rim and jagged lightning-like fins sweeping down to a central diamond-shaped gem buckle at the front. The back is a plain, smooth band.
Male/M_Belt_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the jagged front fins; colour 2 on the inside lining; colour 1 on the outer band and the gem's outer setting; colour 3 on the gem's centre.

Male/M_Belt_Arcane_01.description: A belt of thin curved bands that loop and cross around the hips like a cage, with flared panels at the front and back, a small central clasp, and a long narrow cloth tab hanging down the front to the knees.
Male/M_Belt_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin bands and the hanging tab; colour 1 on the flared panels and central clasp; colour 2 on some panel sections; colour 3 on small accents at the panel edges.

Male/M_Belt_Armored_01.description: A chunky armoured V-shaped belt guard worn low on the hips, with a thick angled rim, a padded contrasting interior and a contrasting front panel below the rim. Sci-fi plating that dips to a point at front and back.
Male/M_Belt_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised V-shaped rim; colour 1 on the front panel below the rim; colour 2 on the padded interior and outer edging.
Male/M_Belt_Armored_01.differs: The male version has a more closed, rounded front with the padded top covering more, while the female one is more open and shows more of the inner padding.

Male/M_Belt_Bounty_01.description: A wide, slightly crumpled cloth-like band belt sitting low on the hips, with a chunky blocky H-shaped buckle at the front centre and a small matching piece visible at the back edge.
Male/M_Belt_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 3 on the H-shaped buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Chainlock_01.description: A heavy chain wrapped in several loose, overlapping loops around the midsection, crossing over itself at front and back. Chunky rectangular links give it a rough, industrial, restraint-like look.
Male/M_Belt_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; the metal reads as glossy and largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Cryo_01.description: A pair of curved, segmented ribbed tubes that arc out from each hip like hooked tusks or hoses, floating at the waist without a band. Mechanical and creature-like, an unusual sci-fi belt accessory.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole ribbed tube on both sides; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Lion_01.description: A pentagonal belt plaque with a sculpted lion head set in a studded, bevelled frame, with two square open loops at the sides. It sits low at the front of the hips, suiting fantasy or mechanical looks.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head; colour 1 on the frame and the plain back plate; colour 2 on the side loops; colour 3 on the lion's eyes.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small shield-shaped belt buckle plate with a thick rounded rim, a notched lower edge and a zigzag emblem in the centre, flanked by stepped angular fin-like wings on both sides. Sits at the front of the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rim and the back plate; colour 0 on the inner face; colour 3 on the zigzag emblem; colour 1 on the stepped side wings.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Lockbox_67_01.description: A small ornate belt ornament shaped like a butterfly, with cut-out openwork wings, scrolled curls underneath and a fleur-de-lis shaped backing plate. It sits centred at the front of the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the openwork wings and scrolls; colour 1 on the central backing plate and lower fleur-de-lis; colour 2 on the darker rim and recesses behind the wings.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A small circular belt buckle plate: a thick segmented ring around a domed round centre, with two small studs and inset panels, worn at the front of the waist. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower and left segments of the outer ring; colour 1 on the upper ring band; colour 3 on the domed centre; colour 2 on the inset panels and studs.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Modern_Sapphire_02.description: A small hanging strap accessory worn at the hip: a narrow band with a fork of two hooked clips at the top, a buckle block in the middle and a ring-tipped tab with a rivet at the bottom.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Modern_Sapphire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band and lower tab; colour 1 on the top clips, the middle buckle block and the bottom ring; colour 3 on the rivet.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A tiny flat decal-like atom symbol with orbiting ellipses and small arc marks, sitting on the lower abdomen and again on the lower back. It adds a subtle mystic-tech emblem without any real bulk.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the atom symbol and its surrounding arc marks.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Ornament_01.description: A round belt ornament: a carved guardian-lion face with fangs and swirl details in a thick rim, topped by a crest of flame-like curled fins. It sits at the navel as a centred buckle medallion with a flat back, in an east-asian fantasy style.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Ornament_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the carved lion face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the outer rim and the flat back; colour 1 on the flame-like crest.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A small rounded-rectangular armor plate worn at the front of the groin like a codpiece, with a slightly dented surface, four curved spikes jutting out of recessed sockets, and two short stubs on its top edge.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate; colour 3 on the four spikes; colour 1 on the two stubs along the top edge.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A low-slung studded belt made of segmented panels covered in pyramid studs, with contrasting edging, small contrasting buckle tabs and a looped chain-like clasp at the front and back. It sits around the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the studded panels; colour 0 on the belt edging and inner band; colour 1 on the chain clasp loops; colour 2 on the buckle tabs.

Male/M_Belt_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.description: A pair of loose chain loops draped along one hip and thigh, hanging from large ring clasps at the front and back of the hip. Wallet-chain style accessory with a punk, street look.
Male/M_Belt_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring clasps; colour 3 on the chain links, with colour 0 on the link highlights.

Male/M_Belt_Combat_01_Straps.description: A tactical utility harness of thin crossing straps that loop around the waist and groin, with a buckled front belt, boxy pouches on the hips and back, and clusters of small cylindrical canisters on one side.
Male/M_Belt_Combat_01_Straps.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the harness straps and belt; colour 1 on the pouches; colour 3 on the canisters and small belt accents; colour 2 on the buckle and pouch flaps.

Male/M_Belt_Corrupted_01.description: A sculpted armored waist guard with swirled, winged front plates and a raised rear fin, from which a pointed loincloth-like panel hangs at the front and back, with contrasting ragged side flaps. Sits low on the hips, with a fantasy-monstrous look.
Male/M_Belt_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swirled waist plates and rim; colour 1 on the pointed front and back panels; colour 3 on the centre back panel and a sliver at the side; colour 2 on the outlines, rear fin and side flaps.
Male/M_Belt_Corrupted_01.differs: The male version has a shorter, blunter front plate and a shorter front panel, with the contrasting side flaps hanging shorter.

Male/M_Belt_Cosmos_01.description: A low-slung, glossy metal hip belt forming a deep V at front and back, with curved horn-like prongs rising from each side and a smooth inner panel. Sits around the hips as a sleek sci-fi accessory.
Male/M_Belt_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: The default glossy metal largely ignores the scheme; colour 0 and colour 1 show faintly on the inner panel and outer band; no other slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Belt_Crimson_01.description: A rigid, armored hip-guard belt with a pointed front plate, a central gem, two horizontal bands, and small ear-like points at the top. A quilted, pointed panel hangs at the back with a contrasting flap at the side.
Male/M_Belt_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 2 on the bands, edging, and side flap; colour 3 on the gem; colour 1 on the quilted rear panel.
Male/M_Belt_Crimson_01.differs: The male version has a larger contrasting side flap hanging behind the hip and a more upright, taller plate.

Male/M_Belt_Cryo_01.description: A belt made of several stacked, rope-like tube bands wrapped around the waist, with a rounded front buckle plate, contrasting side clamps, small canisters at the back, and two looping hoses arching up from the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tube bands and looping hoses; colour 1 on the front buckle plate; colour 2 on the side clamps; colour 0 on the canisters and small connectors.

Male/M_Belt_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A sci-fi gunslinger belt: a wide waistband with a raised front gem-like buckle and two crossed bands that sweep down over the hips and thighs, each edged with contrasting trim and studded with small rectangular panels.
Male/M_Belt_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and crossed bands; colour 1 on the small rectangular panels and rivets; colour 2 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the front buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Cyberwire_01.description: A low belt with a wide banded waist and rectangular side pouches, plus a row of round studs at the front; a ragged skirt of long jagged tapered strips with contrasting edging hangs from it to about the knees.
Male/M_Belt_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt strips and the trim lines on the belt; colour 1 on the belt bands and pouch panels; colour 2 on the round studs; colour 3 on the outlines along the strip edges.
Male/M_Belt_Cyberwire_01.differs: The male belt has a row of three round contrasting studs across the front and cleaner, smooth banded panels.

Male/M_Belt_Draco_01.description: A wide, corset-like armoured belt with jagged, bat-wing style points at the hips, a pointed front plate hanging to the crotch, a swooping horned centre emblem and a matching pointed panel at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and back hanging plates; colour 1 on the centre emblem and back centre panel; colour 3 on the raised outline around the front emblem; colour 2 on the outer hip wings and lower edge points.

Male/M_Belt_Element_Fire_01.description: Two separate clusters of wispy, jagged flame tongues licking around the sides of the ribs and waist, with curling pointed tips. Translucent and glowing, they read as an elemental accent rather than a garment.
Male/M_Belt_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The flames are a glowing energy effect that ignores the colour scheme; no colour slot clearly applies.
Male/M_Belt_Element_Fire_01.differs: The male version appears as translucent glowing flames, whereas the female version renders as glossy contrasting sculpted flames.

Male/M_Belt_Element_Water_01.description: A diagonal sash-like belt piece shaped like a swooping wave of translucent fins, sweeping from the upper hip across the front to a hanging ragged tip, with small looped beads near the lower end.
Male/M_Belt_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: Default material is a translucent glowing energy that ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows a single glow tone.
Male/M_Belt_Element_Water_01.differs: The male version is a translucent, glowing energy-like form, while the female version is a solid glossy metallic form.

Male/M_Belt_Firebird_01.description: A layered band belt with a bevelled outer rim and a stacked underside, worn level around the waist. A contrasting buckle panel sits at the front, and a pointed shield-shaped plate hangs at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim of the band; colour 1 on the lower layered edge; colour 2 on the front buckle panel; colour 3 on the pointed plate at the back and the small plate at the front.
Male/M_Belt_Firebird_01.differs: The male belt sits level at the waist all the way round, without the low V-shaped dip at the front seen on the female version.

Male/M_Belt_Frigid_01.description: A long insect-wing-like skirt with a contrasting veined pattern and a ragged, pointed hem reaching the shins. It hangs from a thin, wispy, spiky belt ring at the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt wisps and the upper wing panels; colour 1 on the lower hem of the skirt; colour 2 on the veins.
Male/M_Belt_Frigid_01.differs: The male version has a thin, spiky, wispy belt ring with no central gem clasp, unlike the female version's solid clasp with a gem.

Male/M_Belt_Gamer_01.description: A wide, plain band belt sitting at the hips, with a rounded upper rim over a lower band. A stepped, piped seam between them holds small contrasting rectangular vent slots. Sporty, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Belt_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper rim band; colour 0 on the lower band and inner lining; colour 3 on the piping along the stepped seam; colour 2 on the small slots.

Male/M_Belt_Gladiator_01.description: A wide, sculpted belt with a padded, layered band that dips to a gentle curve at the front and back, a large rounded centre buckle plate with side clasps, and a thin accent line running along the band.
Male/M_Belt_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded belt band; colour 1 on the front buckle plate and the rear band panel; colour 2 on the side clasps; colour 3 on the thin accent stripe.
Male/M_Belt_Gladiator_01.differs: The male belt sits higher around the waist and its lower edge dips only slightly, giving a shallower curve.

Male/M_Belt_Heroic_01.description: A superhero belt made of two flat angular bands that cross over each other in an X around the hips, with a small shield-shaped buckle at the front centre. It sits low on the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossing bands; colour 1 on the shield rim; colour 2 on the shield's backing; colour 3 on the shield's inner emblem.

Male/M_Belt_Heroic_02.description: A wide, segmented superhero belt worn at the waist, level all the way round. It has a central buckle plate with a chevron emblem, contrasting side clasps, and a thin contrasting stripe along the band.
Male/M_Belt_Heroic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and buckle plate; colour 1 on the chevron emblem; colour 3 on the thin stripe along the band; colour 2 on the edging, inner lining and side clasps.
Male/M_Belt_Heroic_02.differs: The male belt sits level at the natural waist with a taller band and a wider buckle plate.

Male/M_Belt_Heroic_03.description: A wide, sleek superhero belt band sitting at the waist, with a stepped, notched front edge and a thin rim along top and bottom. The angular panel design gives a clean, plain look.
Male/M_Belt_Heroic_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main band; colour 0 on the top and bottom rim edging and the front notch trim; colour 2 on the thin inner edge lines.

Male/M_Belt_Inflatable_Ring_01.description: A glossy inflatable swim ring worn around the waist, shaped like a giraffe: a raised neck and head with small knobbed horns at the front, a short tail nub at the back, and a spotted upper tube over a contrasting lower rim.
Male/M_Belt_Inflatable_Ring_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main body of the tube, head and neck; colour 1 on the spots and the eye; colour 3 on the underside rim and the mouth line; colour 0 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Belt_Inflatable_Ring_02.description: A glossy inflatable pool ring shaped like a unicorn, worn around the waist like a belt. A rounded horse head with a spiral horn and mane rises at the front, with a tail flare at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Inflatable_Ring_02.colourAreas: Default glossy material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows on the mane and tail; the rest of the ring and head take a metallic sheen with darker patches on the ring.

Male/M_Belt_Large_Cairngorn_01.description: A wide, angular belt with a large oval medallion at the front, ringed with a circular glyph pattern, a central disc and small studs. Ribbed side panels and swirling scroll motifs wrap to the back; it sits at the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Large_Cairngorn_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt band and medallion rim; colour 0 on the ribbed panels, scroll patterns and medallion face; colour 2 on the central disc and glyph lines; colour 3 on the small studs around the disc.

Male/M_Belt_Lion_01.description: A wide, layered waist belt with a padded upper band, puffy rounded hip pods at each side and a lion-head plaque at the front. A broad tattered cloth skirt panel hangs from the front centre.
Male/M_Belt_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the puffy hip pods, lion plaque and hanging panel; colour 1 on the upper band, plaque frame and the fading hem of the panel; colour 2 on the front band insert; colour 3 on the back band panel.
Male/M_Belt_Lion_01.differs: The male hanging panel is wider and shorter, ending around mid-thigh, with a back panel hanging behind as well.

Male/M_Belt_Lockbox_65_01.description: A wide waist wrap that crosses over at the front in overlapping flaps, with contrasting piping along the edges and swirling cloud motifs. It sits at the midriff, with a flat back and a slightly flared hem.
Male/M_Belt_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the wrap; colour 0 on the piping, the crossing flap edges and the inner top facing; the swirl motifs also take colour 0.
Male/M_Belt_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The male version is a straighter, boxier band with a less pronounced dip at the front crossover.

Male/M_Belt_Lockbox_65_02.description: A wide, folded-over cloth sash belt sitting at the waist and hips, with a turned-down upper cuff, pointed panels at front and back, and a central pointed emblem plate with a layered contrasting centre. Martial-arts style.
Male/M_Belt_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main sash body; colour 0 on the edge trim and the central pointed plate; colour 2 on the inner cuff lining and the centre insert.

Male/M_Belt_Lockbox_66_01.description: A belt with angular, swept-out hip plates encircling the waist and a long tabard-like panel hanging from the front centre to mid-thigh, with a jagged zigzag pattern and a notched, pointed hem. Fantasy-mechanical look.
Male/M_Belt_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plates; colour 2 on the outlines and edging; colour 3 on the zigzag markings; colour 1 on the clasps and hem bands; the panel body takes a neutral tone.
Male/M_Belt_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The male version centres the long panel at the front with hip plates ringing the whole waist symmetrically.

Male/M_Belt_Low_Sapphire_01.description: A slim, low-slung belt band sitting on the hips, dotted with small diamond studs and closed by a square frame buckle at the front. A thin trim edge runs along the top.
Male/M_Belt_Low_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and top edge; colour 1 on the buckle frame; colour 3 on the diamond studs and buckle studs.

Male/M_Belt_Low_Segmented_Drka_01.description: A slim, low-slung segmented band that dips at the front and rides on the hips, with a small rectangular buckle plate at the centre front and a thin strand hanging at the back. Mechanical, minimal styling.
Male/M_Belt_Low_Segmented_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the front buckle plate and the small strand at the back.

Male/M_Belt_Mecha_01.description: A chunky, angular armoured belt forming a wide band around the waist, with a thick raised outer rim and a hollow inner lining, dipping to a shallow point at the front and back; suggests mecha or sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Belt_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick outer rim; colour 1 on the inner lining and the back section.
Male/M_Belt_Mecha_01.differs: The male belt is a wider, shallower band sitting higher at the waist, with a less pronounced V at the front.

Male/M_Belt_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A wide, low-slung superhero belt band with contrasting edge piping, dipping to a V at the front where a heart-shaped shield plate sits between two round knobs; small pointed flaps hang below at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 2 on the edge piping and rim; colour 1 on the central heart-shaped plate and back flaps; colour 3 on the round knobs at the sides of the buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A layered belt with a raised central gem-like plate and round studs at the front, with a long cloth loincloth panel hanging from the front to about the knees. Sci-fi warrior styling.
Male/M_Belt_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the loincloth panel and belt rim; colour 1 on the belt bands; colour 3 on the central plate; colour 2 on the round studs.
Male/M_Belt_Modern_Ironclad_01.differs: The male belt is a deeper band and its cloth panel is wider, hanging directly from under the central plate.

Male/M_Belt_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A low-slung modern belt with a wide flat band and a plastic side-release buckle at the front, plus layered curved flaps hanging in short tiers over the hips, open at front and back centre.
Male/M_Belt_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 1 on the layered hip flaps; colour 2 on the buckle.
Male/M_Belt_Modern_Kinetik_01.differs: The male version sits higher at the waist, with the flaps hanging straighter and the back flaps closer together.

Male/M_Belt_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A slim sci-fi utility belt with a wide banded strap, a large round buckle housing with a domed centre at the front, an angular clasp block beside it, and a hanging strap with a clip ring.
Male/M_Belt_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 1 on the buckle housing, clasp block, strap fittings and hanging strap clip; colour 2 on the inner band groove; colour 3 on the domed buckle centre and small indicator marks.
Male/M_Belt_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The hanging strap is centred at the back and hangs down the rear, with the round buckle placed at the front.

Male/M_Belt_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A slim sci-fi belt band with a row of round disc pods along one side and large round atom-emblem discs at the front and the back, sitting low on the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the large round discs; colour 2 on the small disc pods; colour 3 on the atom symbols.

Male/M_Belt_Nightmare_Goth_01.description: A low-slung padded belt with a rectangular hip plate, a square buckle held by small straps, and a long studded strap hanging down the front to a pointed, notched tip. Gothic and slightly mechanical in feel.
Male/M_Belt_Nightmare_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band, hip plate and hanging strap; colour 2 on the buckle, studs and strap tip; colour 1 on the small straps holding the buckle.
Male/M_Belt_Nightmare_Goth_01.differs: The male belt has its hanging strap in the same colour as the band, and a plainer, unspiked buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Ornament_01.description: An east-asian styled armored waist wrap with a snarling guardian lion face buckle on a strap at the front, a spiky mane crest, plated hip guards, embossed swirl panels at the back and a ragged fur-like hem.
Male/M_Belt_Ornament_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body panels and mane crest; colour 0 on the lion face, trim and scale plates; colour 3 on the waist band; colour 2 on the fur hem and inner lining.
Male/M_Belt_Ornament_01.differs: The male version is a fuller, more closed wrap with a contrasting fur-lined interior and cleaner panels, while the female version has a more open front and a more ragged hem.

Male/M_Belt_Patriot_01.description: A wide superhero belt sitting at the hips, with a broad centre band edged by contrasting trim, a chunky octagonal buckle at the front, and a back section with two small round studs.
Male/M_Belt_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the edge trim and the back panel; colour 3 on the buckle frame and the back studs; colour 2 on the buckle centre.
Male/M_Belt_Patriot_01.differs: The male version shows a solid band with contrasting edge trim, an octagonal buckle with an inset panel, and studs on the back, all in the colour scheme.

Male/M_Belt_Pumpkin_01.description: A belt of layered, curved armor plates: swept hip guards on each side with pointed upper fins, and a segmented, spiny centre plate that hangs down over the groin and rear. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Male/M_Belt_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the layered hip plates; colour 1 on the pointed upper fins; colour 2 on the segmented centre front and back plates.

Male/M_Belt_Punk_01.description: A slim punk-style belt worn around the waist, with a large rectangular open buckle at the front, a small tab keeper, and evenly spaced round dots studded along the padded strap.
Male/M_Belt_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the round dots; colour 2 on the buckle frame; colour 1 on the small keeper tab.

Male/M_Belt_Rave_01.description: A slim belt made of several parallel strands of linked rectangular blocks that circle the hips, with a small square buckle at the front and a few looser strands draping down over one hip. Suggests a rave or cyberpunk look.
Male/M_Belt_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rectangular blocks; colour 0 on the connecting links between blocks; colour 1 on the front buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A chunky armoured belt with a thick layered band, a large angular front buckle plate with a recessed chevron and rivet-like bolts, and a short hanging plate with contrasting spikes that drops over the groin. A matching plain plate hangs at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the hanging plates; colour 1 on the buckle plate; colour 3 on the spikes and the chevron inlay; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Belt_Renegade_Basic_01.description: A wide, flat belt band sitting low on the hips, with a recessed side panel of pyramid studs, upright clip-like brackets at intervals, and rows of round rivets and eyelets across the front and back plates.
Male/M_Belt_Renegade_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and rim; colour 1 on the recessed side panels and upright brackets; colour 3 on the pyramid studs; colour 2 on the rivet and eyelet holes.

Male/M_Belt_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A low-slung studded belt of segmented panels with pyramid studs and a thin band round the back, with looped ring clasps on one hip and three swagged chains hanging down the thigh. Punk, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Belt_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the studded panels and chains; colour 0 on the belt edging and the band round the back; colour 1 on the ring clasps and loops; colour 2 on the buckle blocks.

Male/M_Belt_Renegade_Chains_02.description: A double-band studded belt: an upper strap with a large square buckle and a lower, tilted band of pyramid studs, joined by ring clasps with several draped chains hanging down one hip. Punk, sci-fi look worn low on the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Renegade_Chains_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt straps and edging; colour 1 on the buckle and ring clasps; colour 3 on the studded panels and chains; colour 2 on the small strap keepers.

Male/M_Belt_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A slim strap belt worn low on the hips, wrapped around the waist with a loose tail crossing diagonally over the front and hanging past the crotch. Diamond-shaped studs run along its length, giving a retro punk look.
Male/M_Belt_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the diamond studs; colour 2 on the edge outline.

Male/M_Belt_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A wide, angular metal-look belt band that sits low at the waist. It has a flared upper rim, a deep outer band, and an open gap at the front with two squared flaps. Retro, mechanical style.
Male/M_Belt_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and top faces of the band; colour 1 on the lower outer band and front flaps; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Belt_Retrosteelhead_02.description: A wide, angular band belt worn at the waist, with a flared upper rim and a front opening. Two slanted flat plates bracket the gap, giving a retro mechanical, armoured look.
Male/M_Belt_Retrosteelhead_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and inner surface of the band; colour 1 on the lower outer band and the front plates. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Belt_Ring_01.description: A small belt ornament: a thick faceted ring hangs from a square block with a raised oval boss on its face. It sits at the front of the waist or hips as a mechanical, industrial accent.
Male/M_Belt_Ring_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole piece, both the ring and the block; other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Belt_Rockerr_01.description: A pair of thin, overlapping belts slung at a tilt around the hips, each with a square open buckle at the front and small studded dots along the strap. A loose, casual rocker look.
Male/M_Belt_Rockerr_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt straps; colour 3 on the small studs or dots along the straps; colour 2 on the square buckles.

Male/M_Belt_Satchel_01.description: A plain, thin flat belt band sitting low on the hips, with a small buckle and a short fastening tab with two rivets at the front right. A simple, utilitarian accessory with no pouches visible.
Male/M_Belt_Satchel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band; colour 3 on the buckle frame and the strap end panel; colour 1 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Belt_Ski_01.description: A slim padded belt sitting at the waist, with a round octagonal ring buckle at the front and several small rectangular tabs spaced evenly around the band. Suggests a sporty, superhero utility look.
Male/M_Belt_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the rectangular tabs; colour 3 on the ring buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Starhawk_01.description: A low-slung angular armored belt with a shallow V-dipping front and back, pointed hip wings holding raised curved panels, a faceted gem-like shard at the front centre and a small pointed tail spike at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt frame and edge trim; colour 3 on the hip panels, front shard and back diamond stud.
Male/M_Belt_Starhawk_01.differs: The male belt sits flatter with a shallower front V, a smaller central shard and a small raised ridge between the hip wings.

Male/M_Belt_Starhawk_02.description: A low-slung angular hip belt with a V-shaped front plate, pointed downward wings and a raised chevron at the back. Faceted, armour-like sections sit on the hips, giving a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Belt_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back chevron and the inner rim; colour 1 on the front V plate and hip sections; colour 2 on the hip-side spikes; colour 3 on the small side panel by the hip.

Male/M_Belt_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A slim, rigid metal ring belt with faceted edges and a level, even width all the way round; a flat rectangular panel sits at the front, worn around the waist in a retro superhero style.
Male/M_Belt_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 2 on the front panel and the inner lining. The glossy metal finish partly ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Belt_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.differs: The male belt is a level ring with a flat front panel, without the V-shaped dip at the front seen on the female version.

Male/M_Belt_Swing_01.description: A slim padded belt that hangs loosely and tilts low across the hips, with a raised stitched edge, a small seam tab at the side and a round ornate buckle plate at the front centre.
Male/M_Belt_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the buckle plate; colour 3 on the inner rosette markings of the buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Swing_02.description: A slim, padded belt band sitting level around the waist, dotted with small round studs, with a large round dial-like buckle at the front that has a gauge face and small bolts. Retro sci-fi style.
Male/M_Belt_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the studs and the buckle rim; colour 3 on the gauge face; colour 2 on the gauge interior details.
Male/M_Belt_Swing_02.differs: The male belt sits level at the waist rather than slanting low over the hips.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A wide utility belt sitting at the waist, with angular segmented front plates around a bat-wing-shaped buckle, a smooth band across the back, and chunky boxy pouches at each side. Superhero vigilante styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and front plates; colour 1 on the buckle wings and the corner accents of the band; colour 2 on the side pouches; colour 3 on the small stripes near the pouches.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The male version sits level at the waist, with the pouches set toward the front of the sides.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_90s_Pockets_01.description: A utility belt with a thin cord band carrying many small square pouches, canister-like cylinders on the hips, and small hooked clips or handles. The pieces are spaced all the way around, sitting at the waist in a tactical, 90s comic style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_90s_Pockets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin belt band and the lower parts of the cylinders; colour 1 on most pouches and the cylinder tops; colour 2 on the darker pouches and clips; colour 3 on the central front pouch and small buttons.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_90s_Pockets_01.differs: The male version has a contrasting pouch at the front centre flanked by a contrasting pouch on one side and contrasting pouches on the other, and the cylinders sit toward the front rather than the hips.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_90s_Round_01.description: A wide, segmented utility belt with a large oval central buckle, panelled plating with etched lines, small flap pouches and rows of cylindrical capsules along the sides. It sits at the waist, with a sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_90s_Round_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt plating; colour 1 on the pouches, capsule cylinders and buckle rim; colour 3 on the central buckle gem and capsule tips; colour 2 on the recessed panel lines and gaps.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_90s_Round_01.differs: The male belt carries more capsules, in longer rows along the front and sides, with a boxier band.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A wide cloth sash wrapped twice around the waist in overlapping, crumpled folds, tied in a bulky knot at the front with two short hanging tails. Casual martial-arts style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole sash, knot and tails.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Defender_0.description: A brief armored hip piece shaped like briefs: a rigid metallic rim with notched corners, a segmented plate over the front and back of the hips, and chevron-striped panels on the hip sides. Sits low on the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Defender_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and glossy metallic plates; colour 1 on the brief-like lower fabric section; colour 3 on the chevron-striped hip panels; colour 2 on the front and back centre plates.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Defender_0.differs: The male version has the striped side panels sitting more toward the sides and mostly hidden from the front, with a lower, flatter rim.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcraft.description: A wide, soft sash-style belt wrapped around the waist, tied in a central knot at the front with two long tapered tails hanging down over the crotch and upper thigh, edged with contrasting piping.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcraft.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sash band and knot; colour 1 on the inner faces of the hanging tails; colour 3 on the edge piping.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcraft.differs: The male version has a central knot with two tails hanging down the front, rather than a single off-centre tail.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Arcane_Belt_01.description: A low-slung ornate belt band with swirling scrollwork pattern, a large rounded gem-like orb at the centre front flanked by curved horn-like prongs, and small round studs hanging at the hips. Arcane, mystic style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Arcane_Belt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the orb's frame; colour 3 on the scrollwork and the hanging round studs; colour 1 on the central orb; colour 2 on the curved prongs and the inner rim.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Archer_01.description: A wide, plain belt sitting at the waist with a rectangular front buckle and a single hip pouch hanging from one side on a strap. The pouch has a folded flap and a contrasting edge strip.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band, buckle and pouch base; colour 1 on the pouch flap and panels; colour 2 on the pouch edge strip; colour 3 on the small top tab of the pouch.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Archer_01.differs: The male belt sits level at the waist and lacks the padded lump at the opposite front hip.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Archlich_01.description: A low-slung spiked belt of segmented bony plates with an inner banded strip, a pointed shield-like codpiece at the front with a contrasting heart-shaped opening, and a small pointed flap at the back. Monstrous, armoured look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Archlich_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and front shield; colour 1 on the inner band strip; colour 2 on the spikes and the front opening; colour 3 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Archlich_01.differs: The male front shield is larger and sits higher on the hips, with a shorter back flap.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Armorbriefs_01.description: Brief-style hip piece with a thin banded waist and leg openings, fitted with stitched padded plates over the front pouch, hips and buttocks, joined by criss-cross lacing at the centre front and back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Armorbriefs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brief base and waist bands; colour 1 on the stitched plates; colour 2 on the lacing; colour 3 on the small studs on the plates.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Armorninja.description: A wide cloth sash wrapped around the hips and knotted at the front left, with two long tails hanging down the thigh nearly to the knee. Diagonal colour blocks give it a martial-arts feel.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot and parts of the sash and tails; colour 1 on diagonal bands of the sash and tails; colour 2 on the front sash panel and tail stripes; colour 3 on the diagonal stripe at the back of the sash.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Armorrivets_01.description: A wide, chunky band belt sitting at the waist, with a flat top edge, a scalloped lower edge on a separate panel, and large round rivet studs spaced around the circumference. Armoured, mechanical look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Armorrivets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and scalloped lower edge; colour 1 on the main band panel; colour 2 on the rivet studs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Armorviper_01_Metal.description: A segmented armored hip piece like a low brief-shaped girdle, with a rimmed waist band, a front plate and contrasting angular fins jutting from each hip. Panels wrap around the back, giving a sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Armorviper_01_Metal.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the girdle and rim highlights; colour 3 on the rim, lower front and rear panels; colour 1 on the centre stripe and back tab; colour 2 on the front plate and hip fins.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A wide, low-slung band belt with thick rolled edges and a separate central strip, sitting on the hips. A spiky angular emblem plate with a contrasting rim hangs at the front, with a small contrasting point visible at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rolled upper and lower edges; colour 1 on the central band; colour 3 on the front and rear emblem points; colour 2 on the emblem rim and inner lining.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_01.differs: The male belt has a visible contrasting emblem point hanging below the band at the back.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A low-slung, angular segmented belt band worn on the hips, split into separate front and back wedge-shaped panels with a raised rim and a contrasting inner lining, leaving gaps at the centre front and back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer faces of the panels; colour 1 on the inner lining and part of the back panels; colour 0 on the rim edging.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_01.description: A shaggy fur loincloth worn low on the hips: a short brief-shaped band of layered, jagged-edged tufts that covers the hips and backside, with a small open gap at the sides. Suggests barbarian or beastly tribal styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the fur tips and lower fringe; colour 2 in the shaded underlayer at the crotch.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_02.description: A wide tribal belt with a padded cushion-like top band ringed by contrasting skulls all around the waist, a hoop ornament at the front centre and short hanging spike tassels below. Striped banding wraps the sides and back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the padded upper band, hoop and straps; colour 2 on the skulls; colour 3 on the striped bands and hanging spikes; colour 0 barely visible.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_03.description: A tribal hip belt with a wide striped band, a ring of skulls around the waist, a hoop ornament with dangling tassels at the front, and a shaggy fur skirt fringe hanging to the upper thighs.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt band, hoop and fur tips; colour 3 on the stripes, tassels and web lines; colour 0 on the fur; colour 2 on the skulls.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_03.differs: The male version's fur hangs slightly lower, with trailing straps at the sides and a larger front hoop with a longer tassel row.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_Norse_01.description: A broad belt ringed by a shaggy fur fringe with jagged, pointed tufts above and below. A wide strap carries a large curled buckle at the front and round studs all the way round, sitting at the hips in a barbarian style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Barbarian_Norse_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the buckle and studs; colour 0 on the fur; colour 1 on the fur tips and shading.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Belly_01.description: A bare-skin midriff band that wraps the whole abdomen, with a rounded, slightly protruding belly at the front and sculpted stomach muscles. It sits between the chest and hips, exposing the midsection under a cropped top.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Belly_01.colourAreas: Colour slots do not visibly affect this piece; it shows a skin-tone texture across the whole band.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Belt_Sideways_01.description: A padded, ribbed tech belt worn tilted low across the hips, with a centre buckle panel, two round gadget discs at one hip and a row of three boxy pouches at the other side. Utilitarian sci-fi look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Belt_Sideways_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded belt band; colour 1 on the buckle panel and the outer shells of the round discs; colour 2 on the pouches; colour 3 on the disc centres.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Belt_Sideways_01.differs: The male belt carries three pouches along the side, where the female version has two.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Beltsash_01.description: A wide, plain band belt sitting low on the hips, with a rectangular contrasting panel at the front from which hang a few ragged, tattered strands. A simple sash-style waist piece.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Beltsash_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the front panel; colour 2 on the hanging tattered strands.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Beltsash_01.differs: The panel and hanging strands sit near the front centre-right of the belt, rather than off at the hip.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bigbow_01.description: A large, puffy cloth bow worn at the small of the back with a central knot and two long, wide tails hanging down over the buttocks to mid-thigh; the tails have inset panels and small round dots near the ends.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bigbow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central knot, tail edges and lower tail tips; colour 1 on the bow loops and the large curved panels of the tails; colour 2 on the inner bow loops and the rectangular tail patches.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bigbow_01_Tail.description: A large padded bow sitting at the lower back with a central knot and two long hanging ribbon tails running down the backs of the thighs; a cute, costume-style rear accessory.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bigbow_01_Tail.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot and the ribbon tails' edges; colour 1 on the bow loops and the curved panels of the tails; colour 2 on the inner loop sides and the rectangular tail panels.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A wide, flat waistband with a bird motif at the front: a stylised eagle with outspread, feathered wings and a pointed tail that hangs down over the groin. A ragged, pointed contrasting fringe drops at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main waistband; colour 1 on the feathered wing panels; colour 2 on the eagle body, wing edges and back tail piece; colour 3 on the eagle's eye.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A curved plated groin guard hanging from the lower abdomen: a broad angular front plate with a contrasting band across the top, tapering to a separate pointed panel between the legs. Sci-fi armour look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 2 on the band across the top; colour 1 on the lower pointed panel.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A low-slung armoured hip guard forming a V-shaped plate that dips to a front codpiece with four round perforations, with flared side wings, small horn-like spikes at the hips and a matching V-shaped back panel.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and spikes; colour 1 on the diagonal side panels at the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Blockbuster_02.differs: The male version has symmetric hip wings that rise evenly on both sides of the front plate.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A slim, low-slung band belt worn around the hips, with a faceted polygonal outline, a raised contrasting rim along the top and bottom edges, and a row of rounded studs or gems spaced evenly around the outside.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the raised rim edging; colour 3 on the round studs.
