Male/M_Belt_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A wide, corset-like waist band with jagged tufted fur edging along the top and bottom, a thin trim line beside each fur edge, and a strap with rectangular buckle plates and diamond studs wrapped around the midsection.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the fur edging at top and bottom; colour 2 on the thin trim lines; colour 3 on the strap, buckle plates and diamond studs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Buckle_01.description: A wide, plain flat belt band worn around the hips, with a large square frame buckle at the centre front. Simple, angular faceted construction that suits casual and superhero looks.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Buckle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the square buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Buckle_02.description: A wide, plain belt band sitting low on the hips, with a large oval buckle at the front carrying a raised star-like relief. Western-style, slightly angular faceted band.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Buckle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the oval buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Buckle_Holsterboth_01.description: A western gunslinger belt with a wide band, large rectangular buckle and rows of cartridge loops across the front. Two crossed drop straps hang low over the hips, also lined with cartridges, in a holster-rig style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Buckle_Holsterboth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and hanging straps; colour 2 on the buckle frame and cartridge tips; colour 1 on the cartridge bodies; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Buckleandwrap_01.description: A slim eyelet-studded belt sitting level around the waist, with a large square buckle at the front, a tapered strap end hanging down beside it, and a short tail hanging at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Buckleandwrap_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt straps and hanging tails; colour 3 on the buckle and eyelet rings; colour 0 on the small strap keepers at the sides.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Buckleandwrap_01.differs: The male belt sits level at the waist with the strap hanging straight down, instead of a diagonal wrap crossing the hips.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_01.description: A wide, flat belt worn around the waist, with a large square frame buckle at the front and rows of small cartridge-like bullets lined along both sides. The back is a plain smooth band.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and bullet casings; colour 2 on the buckle frame and bullet caps.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_01.differs: The male belt sits level and higher around the waist, forming an even ring rather than dipping at the front.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_02.description: A wide, low-slung belt band sitting on the hips, dipping at the front, with a large oval raised buckle at the centre and rows of small bullet-like cartridges along both sides. Military, tactical look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bucklebullets_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the oval buckle and the cartridge caps; colour 1 on the cartridge bodies.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bulwark_01.description: A partial armored waist guard of angular plates: a chevron-shaped centre piece with a V-shaped inset and tall flared side fins with round studs, wrapping around the waist as a segmented belt.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bulwark_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared side plates and outer shell; colour 1 on the V-shaped inset under the chevron; colour 2 on the chevron centre plate; colour 3 on the round studs.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Bulwark_01.differs: The male version sits higher on the torso with taller, broader side plates.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Celestial_01.description: A slim band belt sitting low on the hips, with a large round buckle at the front set in a ring, flanked by swept feathered wings and crossed by a vertical anchor-like bar. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Celestial_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the band and buckle disc; colour 0 on the ring around the buckle; colour 1 on the wings; colour 2 on the vertical bar.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Chains_01.description: A loose belt of chunky metal chain links wrapped in several overlapping loops around the waist, crossing over itself at front and back and sitting level. Rugged, industrial look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; the gaps between links show the body underneath.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Chains_01.differs: The male chains sit level around the waist in a tidier, evenly stacked band.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Chains_Skull_01.description: A loose belt of heavy chain looped several times around the hips, with small spikes poking out and a large skull buckle at the front centre. Gothic, monstrous accessory worn low at the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Chains_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chain links and spikes; colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the skull's eye glow.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Chains_Skull_02.description: A belt of heavy chunky chain links looped several times around the waist and crossing at the back, with a large skull buckle at the front centre and small spikes along the chain.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Chains_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chain links and spikes; colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the skull's eye glow; colour 2 on the gaps between links.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A low-slung V-shaped waist sash with a contrasting inner band and edging, and a single narrow cloth panel hanging at the front and back that ends in long jagged, claw-like tatters down the thighs.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the broad band of the sash and the tips of the jagged tatters; colour 0 on the edging of the sash and the upper part of the hanging panel.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A wide, angular mechanical belt band sitting at the waist, with faceted panels, contrasting swooping side panels and a small clasp mechanism with tiny levers and wires at the front centre. Sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and clasp levers; colour 1 on the swooping side and front panels; colour 2 on the inner lining and small clasp parts; colour 3 on the small wire details at the clasp.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cobralords_Belt_01.description: A wide, flat belt band that sits level around the waist, with a large skull buckle at the front centre surrounded by short curved spikes. It has a punk, monstrous look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cobralords_Belt_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt band; colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the eye sockets; colour 3 on the spikes.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cobralords_Belt_01.differs: The male belt sits level and higher around the waist, without the front dip seen on the female version.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.description: A tactical utility belt with a slim band ringed by boxy pouches and hanging rectangular panels at the hips and back, plus a rectangular front buckle plate; sits low on the waist with a sci-fi gadget look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and hanging panels; colour 1 on the pouches and front buckle plate; colour 2 on the thin stripe along the band and small slots.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Combatstraps_01.description: A utility harness of thin crossing straps looping around the hips and upper thighs, with a belt band carrying square pouches and cylindrical canisters with contrasting clips and hooks. Sits low on the hips; tactical, mechanical look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Combatstraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and belt band; colour 1 on the square pouches; colour 3 on the cylindrical canisters; colour 2 on the clips, hooks and small plates.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Construction_01.description: A wide, low-slung tool belt with a raised front plate, layered pouches around the hips, a large rear pocket with a flap, and a long hammer hanging from a loop at the side.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Construction_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band, front plate and hammer handle; colour 1 on the pouches; colour 3 on the pouch flaps and straps; colour 2 on the rear pocket and hammer head.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A wide, chunky segmented belt band with a faceted oval outline and layered rims. It sits low on the waist like a sci-fi buckle ring, with contrasting panels and contrasting inserts along the sides.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer band; colour 1 on the top face and side wedge panels; colour 3 on the two angled panels on the top face; colour 2 on the inserts along the sides.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_01.differs: The male belt shows bold contrasting and contrasting panels across its top face and contrasting rims, while the female has a darker top and a heavier contrasting lower rim.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_02.description: A thick sci-fi belt band worn at the waist, with three hexagonal framed panels across the front and sides, a smooth contrasting band with contrasting rims, and a plain rounded back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and hexagon frames; colour 1 on the hexagon inserts and top panels; colour 2 on the main band; colour 3 on accent panels.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_02.differs: The male belt has a smooth contrasting band and a plain back, with the hexagon panels grouped more tightly at the front.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_03.description: A slim segmented belt of linked hexagonal plates joined by thin bars, with a larger hexagonal buckle plate at the centre front. It sits low on the hips and gives a sci-fi, mechanical look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the linking bars and outer hexagon plates; colour 1 on the plate edges and underlayer panels; colour 2 on the front buckle plate.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_04.description: A wide, chunky hip belt with a smooth armoured upper band, two thin rings around the lower edge, and a hexagonal gem-like buckle at the front with angular struts sweeping outward. Sits low on the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band, buckle frame and lower panels; colour 1 on the buckle gem and large patches on the lower section; colour 2 on the vertical patches; colour 3 on the rings.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cosmic_04.differs: The male version has a lighter default colour pattern, with the upper band and buckle in colour 0 and mottled colour 1 and 2 patches below, and the front struts are shorter.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cummerbund_01.description: A wide, softly gathered cummerbund-style sash worn around the hips, with horizontal wavy folds, and a long narrow pointed cloth tail hanging from the left hip down the thigh with a contrasting edge.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cummerbund_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered sash band; colour 1 on the hanging tail; colour 3 on the tail's lower edge trim.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cummerbund_01.differs: The male version adds a long narrow cloth tail hanging from one hip down the thigh, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cybermind_01.description: A slim, flat band belt worn at the waist with a small oval buckle at the centre front and two large rounded disc pods projecting from the hips, one on each side. Tech-styled with thin circuit-like lines.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Cybermind_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt band; colour 0 on the discs and centre buckle; colour 1 on the central lens of each side disc and the thin circuit lines.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Deity_01.description: A waist belt with a raised armoured front plate of stacked ridged bands around a contrasting glossy window, flanked by swept-back blade-like fins at the sides and back, plus a rounded back panel.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade fins; colour 1 on the plate border and back panel; colour 3 on the stacked ridged bands; colour 2 on the front window.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Deity_01.differs: The male version adds a large front armoured plate with a contrasting window and a solid back panel, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Deity_02.description: A pair of curved, blade-like metal fins on each side of the waist, swept into sharp points at the front and back. There is no central plate, so the pieces sit as separate claw-like guards on the abdomen and lower back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the blade fins; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Deity_02.differs: The male version has only separate blade fins with no front plate, no stacked bands and no rear panel.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: Short, low-slung hip shorts with a V-shaped front waistband, a chevron-seamed front panel and high-cut leg openings. Contrasting piping edges the waist and legs, and a vertical strap runs down the back centre.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shorts fabric; colour 0 on the top edge of the waistband; colour 2 on the piping and back strap; colour 3 on the small stitched marks along the piping.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A wide, straight cloth-like belt band worn around the waist, with vertical stripe seams, a thin contrasting edge trim and a raised skull-and-crossbones emblem at the centre front.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the skull emblem; colour 3 on the skull's eyes; stripe seams pick up a light tint.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.differs: The male belt is a taller, more even band sitting at the waist, while the female one is a shallower curved band that sits lower and dips at the back.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: Brief-style armoured hip piece of segmented plates forming a low-cut, high-leg silhouette with a raised banded waist rim and angular side plates. Sits on the hips and rear like armoured underwear; suits sci-fi or superhero looks.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edge and the lower side plates; colour 1 on the front waist band; colour 3 on the side accent plates; colour 2 on the front and rear centre panels.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_02.description: A brief-shaped armored hip piece with a thick banded waistband, layered angular plates with stitched-looking seam lines on the front and a segmented back, open at the sides; sits low on the hips with a sci-fi look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 3 on the trim strip at the top edge of the band; colour 2 on the edge outlines and inner lining.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_02.differs: The male version has more segmented plates with visible seam and rivet lines on the front and back, rather than a smooth rounded back.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_03.description: A hip-hugging brief-style armored belt with layered plate segments over the groin and rear, a contrasting upper band, boxy side pouches and a row of small cylindrical canisters across the front. Tactical sci-fi utility look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and brief body; colour 1 on the upper waistband; colour 2 on the side pouches; colour 3 on the canisters and the thin piping along the top edge.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Dharmor_03.differs: The male version has the canisters split into two groups near the sides, leaving the front centre clear, and a lower leg line.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Disc_01.description: A slim, flat belt band sitting at the waist with a large round disc buckle at the front, set in a thick rim. Simple, plain superhero styling with a slightly faceted band.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Disc_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the rim of the disc buckle; colour 2 on the face of the disc.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Discside_01.description: A slim segmented belt band with horizontal ribbed grooves around its faceted loop, and a large round disc buckle mounted off-centre on the wearer's right hip. Sits at the waist, with a sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Discside_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt band; colour 3 on the ribbed inset stripes; colour 1 on the buckle rim; colour 0 on the buckle face.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Eclipse_01.description: A low-slung segmented belt of armored, bone-like plates ringed with sharp contrasting spikes, with a pointed shield-shaped buckle at the front and a V-shaped contrasting panel beneath. Monstrous, draconian style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Eclipse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented plates and buckle; colour 1 on the V-shaped panel under the buckle; colour 2 on the spikes and the buckle marking.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Eclipse_01.differs: The male belt has no extra small ornament above the front buckle, and the buckle sits higher on the waist.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Egyptian_Scarab_01.description: A slim low-slung belt band with a winged scarab beetle emblem at the front: outstretched feathered wings with layered stripes flank a rounded beetle body with raised front legs, hanging over the hips and lower abdomen.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Egyptian_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the scarab body, legs and wing feathers; colour 2 on the wing stripe band; colour 3 on the wing accent feathers.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A low art deco belt: a band circles the hips and forms a shallow V at the front, with angular armored side panels and a pointed centre buckle. It sits at the hips over the tights.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt band and the front panel; colour 0 on the angular side plates and centre buckle; colour 2 on the thin inset lines.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Exartdeco_01.differs: The male belt sits higher and rounder around the hips, with a shallower V at the front.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Extraterrestial_01.description: A ribbed sash-style belt worn at the waist, with a hexagonal metal buckle plate bearing an emblem at the front and angular chevron-marked armor plates with spiky tips at each hip. Alien, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Extraterrestial_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed sash band; colour 0 on the hexagonal buckle frame and hip plate edges; colour 1 on the emblem field and the chevron panels of the hip plates.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Extraterrestial_01.differs: The male belt is a thinner, single ring band at the waist, with a more prominent rear hexagon plate and larger hip plates.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Flower_01.description: A slim belt of twisting vine stems wound loosely around the waist, studded with small pointed leaves and a round layered flower at the front centre. Reads as a natural, woodland-fairy accent.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some vine strands and leaf tips; colour 1 on most of the leaves and twining stems; colour 2 on the darker vine strands and flower centre; colour 3 on the flower's inner petals.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Formal_01_Basic.description: A slim belt sitting at the waist, with a small square buckle at the front and evenly spaced vertical loops or keepers around the band. Simple, tidy formal or utility styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Formal_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main belt band; colour 1 on the edge trim along the band; colour 0 on the vertical keepers; colour 2 on the buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_01.description: A wide, flat superhero belt with a raised letter F emblem at the front, pairs of round striped spherical studs at the sides, and a cylindrical canister hanging from a strap bracket on the right hip.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and canister body; colour 1 on the F emblem; colour 2 on the round spheres; colour 3 on the canister caps, bracket and belt edging.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_01.differs: The male belt sits level at the waist, with the canister hanging closer to the side of the hip.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.description: A wide, angular superhero belt sitting at the waist, with a raised upper rim, a contrasting front band carrying a large letter F buckle, and small cylindrical pouches or canisters at the front and sides. Plain rear band.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower band, canisters and F buckle; colour 1 on the upper rim panels; colour 2 on the front band behind the buckle; colour 3 on the small stripe accents on the rim.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.differs: The male belt sits level and straight around the waist, with the canisters spaced further apart across the front.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.description: A slim, level band belt worn around the waist. It has a light central stripe with contrasting edging, a contrasting clasp buckle and two small loop tabs at the front.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central stripe; colour 1 on the edging and inner band; colour 2 on the buckle; colour 3 on the small loop tabs.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The male belt sits straight and level at the waist, with the two loop tabs spaced wider on either side of the buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_01.description: A short, loose martial-arts gi skirt wrapping the waist and hips like a wide wrinkled cloth band, with small side slits and a straight hem ending just below the hips. Suggests dojo or sporty wear.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt exterior; the inner waist lining shows a darker shade, likely colour 2.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_01.differs: The male skirt is a flatter, shorter band with a straighter hem, sitting higher at the waist rather than draping fuller over the hips.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_02.description: A martial arts gi hip wrap of loose creased cloth that sits just below the waist and reaches only the top of the hips, with a thick knotted sash and two long tails hanging down.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gi cloth; colour 3 on the sash, knot and hanging tails.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Giskirt_02.differs: The male version is a short cloth band that barely drops below the sash, with the knot offset to the side, instead of a full skirt.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A bulky armoured midsection wrap: rounded plates with a domed front centre, panelled sides with recessed screens, and three spikes down the back and each side. A tall smooth plate rises at the top front.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates, top front plate and back stripe; colour 1 on the raised rims and edging; colour 2 on the front dome and recessed panels; colour 3 on the spikes and small scratch marks.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The male version has a tall, solid plate rising at the top front instead of a scooped cutaway.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.description: A slim, flat superhero belt with a wide band edged in contrasting trim, studded with small round rivets along its length, and a large five-pointed star buckle centred at the front on a separate contrasting panel; sits at the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 3 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the star; colour 2 on the panel behind the star and on the rivets.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_02.description: A slim, flat superhero belt band sitting at the waist, with a raised contrasting rim along both edges, small round studs spaced around it, and a contrasting rectangular buckle panel at the centre front.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 3 on the raised edge trim; colour 2 on the front buckle panel and the studs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Goth_01.description: A wide, plain band belt with stitched edges that sits low on the hips, fastened at the front by an octagonal skull buckle ringed with small round studs. Gothic look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the skull; colour 2 on the octagonal buckle plate; colour 3 on the round studs and eye sockets.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Goth_02.description: A strappy hip harness of thin flat bands crossing in X shapes at the front and back, joined by small metal rings and tiny end tabs, slung low around the hips. Goth or punk styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 2 on the metal rings; colour 3 on the small tabs where the straps join.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Harajuku_Basic_01.description: A slim casual belt worn low and tilted around the hips, with a round ring buckle at the front, a short keeper loop, and a row of small studs along its length, edged in contrasting trim.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Harajuku_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt strap and keeper; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the studs; colour 2 on the ring buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Harness_01.description: A hip harness of narrow flat straps forming an open cage around the hips and groin, with a waist band and straps that meet in a pouch-like brief shape. Wide gaps show the body beneath.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Harness_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the straps and the waist band.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Harness_01.differs: The male harness has no front buckle and its straps form a brief-like shape at the crotch.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A hip-slung belt with a thin banded waistband and a centre emblem, two broad pointed side flaps with round vent discs, and a long narrow front tab with a wavy chevron pattern hanging to mid-thigh. Ancient-tech loincloth look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side flaps and waistband; colour 1 on the emblem and the wavy stripes of the front tab; colour 2 on the thin band at the waist and the vent discs.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The male version has larger, wider side flaps that hang lower along the thighs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A segmented armored hip belt with a large round glossy eye-like orb at the front centre, layered overlapping plates fanning around the hips, a shorter lower front plate, and looping fabric sashes draped at the sides.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate edges, orb surround and lower rim; colour 1 on the inset banded plates; colour 2 on the orb and rear underside; colour 3 on the draped sashes.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Hipan_01.differs: The male version has a shorter, more compact front and back plate, with the side plates wrapping down over the hips.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A low-slung sci-fi belt made of overlapping angular armored segments forming a wide band around the hips, with a raised notched edge and thin contrasting trim lines along the seams.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt segments; colour 1 on the thin trim lines along the panel edges.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holster_01.description: A slim, flat tech belt with segmented panels and inset stripe details, plus a chunky rounded holster pouch hanging on the wearer's right hip. Sits at the waist; a sleek sci-fi utility look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the holster; colour 3 on the inset stripes; colour 2 on the belt edging and segment marks.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holsterleft_01.description: A double gunslinger belt with two overlapping bands crossing at a slant around the hips, each with a large square buckle at the front, rows of small cartridge loops at the sides, and a longer flap hanging down the hip.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holsterleft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt bands and flap; colour 2 on the buckles and the cartridge loops.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holsterleft_01.differs: The male belt has a longer flap hanging lower down the hip and thigh.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holsterright_01.description: A western-style double belt: a flat waist band with a square buckle, plus a second band slung diagonally low over the hip with its own buckle, a hanging tab and cartridge loops running along the lower edge.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holsterright_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt bands and tab; colour 2 on the buckle frames and cartridge casings; colour 1 on the cartridge tips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Holsterright_01.differs: The male version has cartridge loops on both ends of the slung band and a smaller buckle on the upper band.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Inmate_01.description: A wide, padded cloth waist band with two stacked rolled tiers and thin grooves between them, closed at the front by vertical straps and a rectangular plate buckle. Sits at the natural waist.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the shadowed groove lines and undersides of the band; colour 2 on the vertical straps and the buckle frame; colour 3 on the buckle plate.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Inmate_02.description: A wide, plain belt band sitting at the waist, with a square raised buckle plate at the front, two small vertical straps or keepers at the sides, and a textured, slightly rough surface.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the square buckle and the small back plate; colour 3 on the two side keepers.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Insignia_01.description: A wide flat band belt worn level around the waist, with a large round disc buckle at the front carrying an atom emblem. The disc stands proud of the band and its back also shows behind.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt band; colour 3 on the rim and back of the disc; colour 1 on the emblem background; colour 0 on the atom symbol.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Insignia_01.differs: The male belt is a wider band that sits level around the waist, while the female belt is a thinner strap that dips into a low V at the front.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ironclad_Anniversary_0.description: A wide, tube-like waist wrap with a contrasting front panel and a long narrow tassel-like flap hanging down the front of the hips, ending in a zigzag diamond-patterned hem. Ancient, ceremonial look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ironclad_Anniversary_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waist band and the hanging flap; colour 1 on the front panel and the flap's hem edge; colour 2 on the diamond hem pattern and the panel's lower edge; colour 3 on the thin vertical lines on the flap.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A loose ring of chunky chain links draped around the hips, with several round two-tone spheres dangling at intervals like weights. Sits low on the waist as a menacing, monster-themed accessory.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links and one half of each sphere; colour 1 on the other half of some spheres; colour 2 on the other half of some spheres; colour 3 on small accents on a few spheres.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Light_01.description: A winged belt ornament: a hexagonal central medallion with a small gem sits over a pointed kite-shaped plate, flanked by two feathered wings that sweep upward across the hips, worn low at the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing feathers and the panels of the plate; colour 0 on the edge piping and outlines; colour 3 on the medallion and the plate edging; colour 1 on the central gem.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.description: An ornate filigree belt of thorny, leaf-like scrollwork wrapping the waist, with a butterfly-shaped cut-out plate at the front and curling swirl ornaments at the sides. A tall leaf spray rises at the back. Gothic and fantasy in feel.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the butterfly plate at the front; colour 1 on the curling swirls and the central leaf ornament; colour 2 on the thorny filigree band and leaf spikes.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The butterfly plate is slightly smaller and set left of centre, with a larger leaf spray beside it at the front and another at the back.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.description: A short, wide superhero waist belt band that tapers to points at the sides, with pointed fang-like spikes along the lower front edge, a contrasting inner lining at the front and a hexagonal panel at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower front edge and the fang spikes; colour 1 on the side and back sections of the band; colour 3 on the hexagonal back panel; colour 2 on the inner front lining.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.differs: The male belt has a fully hexagonal back panel, and lacks the contrasting edge trim at the side that the female version shows.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Loinclothmedicinebag_0.description: A thin hip belt with a single rectangular flapped pouch hanging at the wearer's right hip. The pouch has stitched edging and a printed tribal motif on the flap and body. Suggests a tribal, hide-craft look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Loinclothmedicinebag_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and pouch body; colour 1 on the belt edge stripe; colour 3 and colour 1 on the stitched pouch edging; colour 2 on the printed motifs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A wide, soft cloth sash belt worn around the waist, with gently gathered horizontal folds and an even, level lower edge. Simple, casual and slightly theatrical.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Madjester_01.differs: The male sash sits level around the waist with a straight lower edge and shallower folds, without the low front dip.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Madjester_02.description: A low-slung studded belt with a pointed tail end and small buckle, lined inside, worn at the waist, with several floating curled strips with pointed tips and studs spiralling loosely above it.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the floating curled strips; colour 1 on the outer belt band; colour 2 on the inner lining of the belt; colour 3 on the studs and buckle.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Madjester_02.differs: The male belt shows a contrasting inner lining (colour 2) around the band, and the floating strips sit closer above it.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A twisted-rope belt wrapped around the waist, tied at the back in a looped bow with a contrasting knot. Two thick braided cords hang down the back, each ending in a spherical weight and a tassel.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the twisted rope belt and bow loops; colour 2 on the central knot; colour 1 on the hanging cords and tassels; colour 3 on the spherical weights.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Martial_Power_01.differs: The male belt has a more compact bow with the loops tucked closer together, and the hanging cords are longer.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Martialarts_Rope_01.description: A thick twisted rope belt wrapped twice around the waist and knotted at the front, with two rope ends hanging down the front and two shorter tails hanging at the back. Suggests martial-arts or casual wear.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Martialarts_Rope_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole rope; the twisted strands show shading only, and no other slots are visible.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Martialarts_Rope_01.differs: The front knot's rope ends hang shorter and the back tails are shorter than on the female version.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Martialartsbelt_01.description: A wide cloth martial arts sash wrapped around the waist and tied in a knot at the front hip, with two long tails hanging down the thigh. Simple, casual dojo-style belt.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Martialartsbelt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front section of the sash; colour 1 on the side band and on the upper part of each hanging tail; colour 2 on the back section, the knot and the tail tips.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Mechaniste_01.description: A brief, brief-style hip piece with angular faceted panels, a quilted raised front plate, padded ribbed pads at the back hips and open leg holes. Sits low on the hips with a sci-fi mechanical look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Mechaniste_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the briefs; colour 1 on the quilted front plate and the small back tab; colour 2 on the padded side and back pads.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Mechassn_01.description: A low-slung, brief-style armored hip piece with a stacked two-segment plated front tapering to a point, a smooth rounded rear, and crossing diagonal straps over each hip. Mechanical look with an open side.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating front and back; colour 1 on the side panels beneath the straps; colour 3 on the crossing hip straps and edge panels; colour 2 on the plate seams and inner lining.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Mechassn_01.differs: The male version has a deeper front with two stacked plate segments and a lower rim, while the female front plate is shorter and flares upward with a contrasting inner rim.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Monster_01.description: A ring of separate curved bone-like blades and small winged fins placed around the hips, each mounted on a small base plate. Sparse and spiky, they sit at the waistline with no band joining them.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blades and fin shapes; colour 1 on the fin membranes and some blade edges; colour 3 on the small base plates.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Monster_01.differs: The male version has more long, upright blades spread across the front and back of the waist, giving a denser ring.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Necromancer_01.description: A slim double-strap belt with a wide band at the waist and a second thinner strap looping diagonally down to the hip, carrying a small padded satchel pouch on the side of the hip.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Necromancer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and looping strap; colour 1 on the satchel pouch.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.description: A thick, loosely gathered cloth sash wrapped around the waist, with a katana thrust through it diagonally: hilt with wrapped grip and round guard at the front-left, scabbard trailing down behind the opposite hip.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped sash; colour 1 on the scabbard and hilt; colour 3 on the hilt wrap diamonds; colour 2 on the sword guard and fittings.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.differs: The male sash sits lower around the hips and the sword lies flatter, with the scabbard tip trailing further behind.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ornamental_01.description: A wide, segmented band belt worn level at the waist, with a square front buckle bearing a knot-like emblem and angular glyph-like markings around the band, edged with thin contrasting trim. Ornate east-asian styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ornamental_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the emblem face; colour 1 on the edge trim and the buckle frame; colour 2 on the buckle backing; colour 3 on the glyph markings.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ornamental_01.differs: The male belt sits level around the waist as a straight even band, without the lower dip at the hips seen on the female version.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Padding.description: A slim, padded belt band that wraps once around the hips, made of faceted segments with small round dots and sitting level at the waist. It has a tactical, armored look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front and back segments and the round dots; colour 1 on the side segments; colour 2 on the darker patches near the sides; colour 3 on small accent patches at the sides.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Patterned_01.description: Brief-style hip piece with a high-cut leg opening, a V-shaped panel at front and back, and a thin outlined edge along the waist and leg openings. Sits low on the hips like superhero trunks.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the briefs; colour 1 on the triangular front and back panels; colour 2 on the edge trim and dividing lines.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_01.description: A wide, softly draped cloth sash wrapped around the hips in gathered folds, tied in a knot at the front-left hip with a single long tail hanging down the thigh. Suggests an eastern or fantasy wrap.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped sash and knot; colour 1 on the hanging tail; colour 3 on the trim band at the tail's end.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_01.differs: The knot sits higher toward the front of the hip, and the tail hangs closer to the centre of the front of the thigh.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_02.description: A low-slung ancient-style belt with a thick padded, gathered waistband, a contrasting band across the front and a round central gem. A wide front loincloth panel with braided edging hangs to mid-thigh, and draped side panels sit over the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and front loincloth; colour 1 on the draped side panels and the centre gem; colour 3 on the band across the waistband and the braided panel edging; colour 2 on the gem setting.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_02.differs: The male version has no row of beads, a plainer waistband with a contrasting band across it, and a wider, shorter front panel.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_03.description: A low-slung, gathered cloth hip wrap with a round central medallion, a stripe of piping across the front, and a long narrow panel with braided-looking edging hanging down the front of the thigh.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered wrap and hanging panel; colour 3 on the stripe of piping along the wrap; colour 1 and colour 3 on the braided panel edging; colour 2 on the medallion setting; colour 1 on the medallion gem.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_03.differs: The male version has no row of contrasting beads along the top edge and a plainer back, with a smooth wrap and a longer front panel.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_04.description: A low-slung, puffy gathered cloth belt band around the hips, with a contrasting stripe along its length and a central round clasp holding an oval gem at the front; the top edge has a thin rim.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered band and rim; colour 3 on the stripe; colour 2 on the round clasp housing; colour 1 on the central gem.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Persian_04.differs: The male version has no row of round discs along the edge, just the single central clasp, and it has a thin raised rim along the top.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A slim, low-slung belt band with a wide centre stripe between contrasting edge piping, closed at the front by a round, faceted medallion buckle with a domed centre. Sits on the hips; a fancy, pirate-flavoured accent.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the edge piping; colour 1 on the wide centre stripe; colour 2 on the buckle housing; colour 3 on the domed centre of the buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Plain_01a.description: A plain, flat band belt worn around the waist, with slightly angular faceted edges and a subtle dip at the front. Two small round spots sit near the front and back. A minimal, sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Plain_01a.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the small round spots.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Plated_01.description: A slim segmented belt made of a row of square blocky plates set edge to edge around the waist, with a larger raised buckle plate at the centre front. Sits at the natural waist with a mechanical, armoured look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Plated_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plates; colour 1 on the front buckle plate; colour 0 on the thin inner strip and gaps between plates.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Pockets_01.description: A slim utility belt with a square front buckle and padded flap pouches placed around the front and sides, each with a small button-like clasp. It sits at the hips and suits tactical or superhero looks.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Pockets_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt strap; colour 1 on the buckle; colour 0 on the pouches; colour 3 on the pouch clasps.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Pockets_01.differs: The male belt has the buckle at the centre front with pouches split evenly on either side, and pouches also reach the back edges.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Pockets_02.description: A slim ribbed belt worn at the hips, ringed with a row of small flap-covered pouches with recessed pocket fronts and a rectangular clasp at the centre front. Utilitarian, tactical look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Pockets_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch flaps and outer pouch bodies; colour 1 on the banded belt strap, the clasp and the recessed pocket fronts.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Pockets_03.description: A utility belt with a wide flat strap and a row of small square pouches around the front and sides, centred on a square buckle plate. It sits at the waist and suggests a practical superhero or tactical look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Pockets_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouches; colour 1 on the square front plate; colour 2 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the small emblem marks on the pouches.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Power_Cells_01.description: A slim belt band worn at the waist, ringed with upright cylindrical canisters with domed caps and ribbed bands, plus a square buckle box at the front with a round button. Suggests a sci-fi utility or power-cell rig.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Power_Cells_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the canister caps and the buckle face; colour 2 on the canister bodies and the buckle housing; colour 3 on the canister stripes and the round button.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Powersuit_01_Armor.description: A sleek powersuit belt: a wide, faceted segmented band sits at the waist, with a small armored groin plate hanging from it that has a separate upper panel and a tapered lower tip. Suits sci-fi or superhero looks.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Powersuit_01_Armor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the lower tip of the groin plate; colour 1 on the upper panel of the groin plate.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A short, hip-slung armoured loincloth of stacked, chevron-shaped segmented plates that wrap around the hips, with a pointed V-shaped front panel and a rolled upper edge; open at the sides. Suggests alien or mechanical armour.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panel and the underside; colour 1 on the rolled upper rim and the banded plate ridges; colour 2 on the shaded plate creases.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Rave_04.description: A wide, low-slung band belt sitting on the hips, with a flat solid top and two rows of round raised studs around the outside edge. Rave or club styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Rave_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 2 on the upper row of studs; colour 3 on the lower row of studs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A broken, open hip band made of two curved segments, one at each side of the hips. Each segment has a thick raised outer plate over a thin inner strip. It sits low on the hips and suggests a sci-fi utility look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick outer plates; colour 1 on the plate edges and the thin inner strips.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Rings_01.description: A low-slung, slim band belt sitting on the hips, made of layered strap bands with a raised rim on top. Heavy metal rings hang from small tabs around the front, sides and back, giving a utilitarian, fetish-punk look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Rings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper rim and outer band; colour 0 on the middle strap band; colour 2 on the inner band lines; colour 3 on the rings and their tabs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ruler_01.description: A wide, chunky championship-style belt worn at the waist, made of stacked horizontal bands with a large raised rectangular front plate embossed with a fist emblem. Faceted, slightly angular band edges give a sporty superhero look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Ruler_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main band and top; colour 2 on the thin stripes between bands; colour 0 on the front plate; colour 1 on the fist emblem.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Safari_01.description: A wide, thick band-style belt with a rough, hide-like texture, sitting low around the waist. Curved horn-like spikes jut outward at the front, sides and back, giving it a primitive, beastly look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Safari_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and lighter edges of the band; colour 1 on the main body of the band; colour 3 on the bases of the horns; colour 2 on the horn tips.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Samuraiplate_01.description: A low-slung samurai-style armour belt: a layered band of rounded contrasting cords with segmented, trimmed plates hanging as short hip guards at the sides, plus a small inner panel behind them. Sits on the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Samuraiplate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour plates; colour 1 on the trim lines and the inner panel; colour 2 on the cord belt band.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Samuraiplate_01.differs: The plates on this version wrap further round the hips and sit more level, with the inner panel showing at the front and back.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Samuraiplate_02.description: A samurai-style armored belt with layered rectangular plates hanging as hip guards at the sides, a pointed central front panel and a small diamond plate at the back. Swirling carved patterns and bordered edges suggest east-asian lamellar armor.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Samuraiplate_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate borders and the back diamond panel; colour 1 on the inner backing panels and plate edging; colour 2 on the belt band and front centre panel; colour 3 on the swirl patterns of the plates.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Santa_01.description: A wide, plain band belt with a smooth, slightly tapered shape sitting at the waist, closed at the front by a round buckle with a detailed snowflake-like emblem.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the buckle rim and emblem; colour 1 on the buckle face and edge.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Santa_01.differs: The male belt has a plain single-colour top surface with no contrasting panel, and the buckle lacks the small accent marks.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_01.description: A wide tribal waist band made of layered cloth wraps, with thick horizontal straps across the middle and rims stitched with cross-lacing. The top is closed by a flat panel with angular line patterning. It sits at the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrapped band; colour 2 on the horizontal straps, rims and top panel; colour 1 on the stitching and the line patterns on the top panel.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_01.differs: The male band has a closed flat top panel with a line pattern, rather than an open ring.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_02.description: A thick, straight-sided tribal belt band worn at the waist, made of stacked light bands separated by contrasting straps, with contrasting stitching along the edges, two round medal discs on the front and a patterned top surface.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide bands; colour 2 on the straps, edge binding and top panel; colour 1 on the stitching, top line pattern and medal rims; colour 3 on the medal designs.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_02.differs: The male belt sits higher on the waist as a straight, thick band with a closed patterned top, rather than the female's low, tapered open shape.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_03.description: A thick tribal belt made of stacked horizontal bands with stitched lacing marks and a rim of small ties, worn at the waist. A long serrated knife hangs from one hip, with a patterned top surface.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide bands; colour 2 on the bands and rims; colour 1 on the stitching, top-surface line pattern, rim ties and the knife.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_03.differs: The male belt is a taller, boxier band, and its knife is longer with a more pronounced serrated edge that sticks out from the hip.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_04.description: A wide, layered tribal waist wrap of stacked banded coils with stitched edging, two round medallions on the front, and a long serrated knife hanging at the left hip. Sits at the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the bands between them; colour 1 on the stitching, medallions and knife; colour 3 on the medallion markings.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sasquatch_04.differs: The male knife is longer with pronounced saw-tooth edges and hangs farther out from the hip, and the belt is a taller band.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Secret_02.description: A wide, padded casual belt sitting at the hips, with a rolled inner edge, a large square front buckle with a hooked prong, and two short cross-straps on each side of the band.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band; colour 1 on the inner lining and edge piping; colour 2 on the small strap dividers; colour 3 on the buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Secret_04.description: A slim, plain belt band that sits low on the hips, tilted slightly downward at the front, with a small rectangular open buckle at the centre front. Simple casual styling with a faceted edge.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 3 on the buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Shackle_01.description: A wide, rigid faceted band worn around the waist like a shackle cuff, with a square contrasting plate at the front and curved handle-like loops spaced around its outer surface. Mechanical, restraint-inspired look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Shackle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the curved loops; colour 2 on the front plate.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Shaman_Sovereign_01.description: A wide cloth sash wrapped around the hips with striped bands, carrying a shrunken severed head with long hair hanging at one hip and two small voodoo dolls dangling at the other. Macabre tribal style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Shaman_Sovereign_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sash; colour 2 on the sash stripes, doll limbs and hair; colour 1 on the shrunken head and doll bodies; colour 3 on the doll chests and head markings.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A wide band belt at the hips with a pointed fin-like blade at the front and two round studs at the back, hung with layered, jagged fin-shaped panels that flare over the hips like a short skirt.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and front fin; colour 2 on the upper layer of panels; colour 1 on the lower jagged fin panels; colour 3 on the accent strips on the panel tips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Sharkfin_01.differs: The male belt has a sharp pointed fin projecting at the front instead of a knotted tab, and the band is more upright.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Skull_01.description: A low-slung band belt worn at the hips, with a large skull buckle at the front bearing small side spikes and a hanging octagonal flap below. A matching ring-shaped flap hangs at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt band; colour 0 on the skull and its side spikes; colour 2 on the stripes across the skull; colour 3 on the eyes and the hanging octagonal flaps.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Skull_01_1.description: A slim low-slung waistband with a large front skull buckle that has small side spikes and a hanging octagonal drop below it. A matching octagonal ring hangs at the back. Gothic, monstrous styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Skull_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waistband; colour 0 on the skull and its spikes; colour 3 on the skull eyes and the hanging octagonal pieces front and back; colour 2 on the grooves and lines of the skull.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Skull_Belt_01.description: A slim, plain band belt sitting low on the hips, with a large sculpted skull buckle at the front centre. A second skull-shaped lump also shows at the back. Dips slightly at the front; gothic, monstrous styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Skull_Belt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets and teeth lines; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Skulls_01.description: A tribal waist belt with a wide band trimmed at the edges, a row of skulls across the front and tied drawstring pouches hanging at the hips. Sits at the waist with a shaman feel.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Skulls_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide belt band; colour 3 on the band edging and pouch ties; colour 1 on the skulls; colour 2 on the pouches.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Skulls_01.differs: The male belt has a wide band with edge trim all around the waist, instead of a thin strap.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Snake_01.description: A low-slung, briefs-like belt with a scaled band around the hips, a V-shaped front dipping into a deeper pointed plated pouch of stacked ridged segments, and a contrasting rim along the top edge. Suggests serpent-themed armor.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled hip band; colour 1 on the segmented plates of the front and back pouch; colour 2 on the top rim and edge trim.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The male version has a taller, broader front pouch with deeper plates and fuller coverage at the back.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A wide, slightly faceted band belt sitting low on the hips, with a raised rim top and bottom, stepped racing-stripe piping along the front and a triangular buckle emblem at the centre front.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the rim edges; colour 3 on the stripe piping and the triangle's inner centre; colour 1 on the triangular frame.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A sci-fi armoured belt: a wide segmented band with a short pointed front plate, a bow-like centre with two winged hip fins swept upward, and a contrasting inner panel edged with a raised rim.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edging, the hip fins and the bow's centre; colour 1 on the front plate, the bow wings and the outer plates; colour 2 on the band panel; colour 3 on the thin accent stripes.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The male belt has a shorter front point and a wider bow with two large wing plates, rather than a round knot.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A sci-fi utility belt made of two stacked bands: a wide upper cummerbund-like band and a lower hip band with small slots. Boxy pouches and a round contrasting buckle sit at the front, with a small cylinder at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bands and pouches; colour 1 on the upper band's panels and pouch caps; colour 2 on the back strip, front buckle and cylinder ends; colour 3 on the small clips and brackets.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_01.description: Two pairs of curved, tapering horn-like spikes that jut outward and upward from the hips, one pair on each side, with a rimmed base at each root. A monstrous, decorative belt accessory.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the rimmed bases.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Spikesandskulls_01.description: A wide, tribal waist belt with a striped band, a ring at the front, and skulls set around the hips. Long curved tusk-like horns with pointed tips sweep out from both sides, with skulls along the back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Spikesandskulls_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main belt band, top and front ring; colour 3 on the stripes in the band; colour 2 on the skulls; colour 0 on the horns.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Spikesandskulls_01.differs: The male belt is a flatter, more even band, with longer horns that sweep forward at the sides.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Steampunk_Cowboy_01.description: A padded belt band sits at the waist with a large square buckle and a keeper loop. A second strap runs diagonally down over one hip and thigh, forming a loose gunslinger-style drop loop. Both straps have eyelet holes.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Steampunk_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and diagonal strap; colour 1 on the keeper loops; colour 2 on the buckle; colour 3 on the eyelets.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_01.description: A low-slung metal belt whose front is shaped like a spread-winged hawk with angular feather tips, and a slim banded strip circling the hips. Small feather-like spikes hang down at the back. Suggests a sleek, mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hawk and the belt band; colour 2 on the stripe along the band; colour 1 on the lower band edge; the thin top rim also takes colour 0.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Stlcommando_01.description: A small downward-pointing triangular plate that hangs over the groin and lower hips like a tapered tasset, with three chevron grooves across its face. It suggests a mechanical or armoured commando look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Stlcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 2 on the chevron grooves across the front.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Straight_01.description: A slim, flat band belt sitting at the waist, running straight around the body. Two round disc studs sit on the front and two on the back, giving a simple superhero look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Straight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole belt band; colour 0 on the round discs.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Straight_01.differs: The male belt has two round discs at the front and two at the back, and sits higher at the waist; the female band is plain with no discs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A slim, low-slung belt band made of a faceted ring with a raised rim and a broad centre stripe, crossed by several vertical strap plates and a larger square buckle plate at the front. Sits on the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide centre stripe; colour 1 on the upper and lower rim edges; colour 3 on the buckle plate and the vertical straps.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Subligar_Ancientarmor_.description: A brief armoured loincloth-style hip piece: a ribbed waist band with a deep curved front plate, chunky hip guards and a wide rear panel, all carved with spiral patterns in an ancient style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Subligar_Ancientarmor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and hip guards; colour 1 on the carved spiral lines; colour 2 on the worn edges and shading; colour 3 on the ribbed waist band and rear straps.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Subligar_Ancientarmor_.differs: The male version has a broader, deeper front plate with hip guards blended into it, and a single joined rear panel held by short straps.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Subligarbasic_01.description: A plain, close-fitting brief-style bottom with a high-cut leg opening and a low front dip. It sits on the hips as a simple smooth underlayer, suited to a superhero or athletic look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Subligarbasic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole brief; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Subligarbronzeking_01.description: A stone-like loincloth brief with a tall, rounded waistband studded with contrasting round bosses, scalloped lower edge, and a briefs-shaped front and back panel with curling tribal swirl patterns and small rivets, plus cracked surface details.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Subligarbronzeking_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central front and back panels and the top of the band; colour 1 on the studded waistband and the side panel backgrounds; colour 3 on the curling swirl patterns; colour 2 on the studs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Takofanes_01.description: A low-slung segmented belt band studded with contrasting spikes, with a pointed armored front plate and a long tapering codpiece-like front and back flap. Beast-like, mechanical armor styling sits at the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Takofanes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt segments and the front and back plates; colour 1 on the inner strip and the edges of the flaps; colour 2 on the spikes and the plate recess.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Tattered_01.description: A tattered belt skirt: a rolled waistband above a ragged upper edge, with a long panel hanging to the ankles at the front, sides and back. The hem is torn into jagged strips and the cloth fades toward the bottom.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rolled waistband and the lower part of the skirt; colour 0 on the upper skirt and the ragged upper edge.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Tattered_01.differs: The male version hangs as a fuller long skirt that also covers the front, while the female version is cut short at the front.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Tattered_02.description: A long tattered skirt-like belt panel hanging from a banded waistband with a diamond emblem at the front. Ragged jagged hem falls to the shins, split at the sides, with a bat-wing shaped patch on front and back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Tattered_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper skirt and waistband edging; colour 1 on the waistband stripe and the lower fade of the skirt; colour 2 on the bat-wing patches and waistband band; colour 3 on the emblem and the patch outlines.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Tattered_02.differs: The male version hangs slightly shorter and is split at the front and sides, showing the legs, rather than falling as a full flared skirt.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_01.description: A thin flat band belt worn low on the hips, with a small crumpled front plate bristling with sharp contrasting fang-like spikes of varied height. Monstrous, armoured accent piece.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the front plate; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_02.description: A short segmented plate skirt of layered horizontal bands with rivets and edged trim, split open at the front. A clawed, toothy monstrous buckle with contrasting spikes sits at the centre of the waist.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armour plates; colour 1 on the edge trim and piping; colour 3 on the central buckle; colour 2 on the spikes.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Teeth_Draycul_02.differs: The male skirt has a wider open front gap between two separate plate flaps, while the female front opening is narrower.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Thick_01_Basic.description: A wide, thick belt band that sits around the waist, with a large open square buckle at the front and a plain, slightly textured strap that wraps evenly all the way round.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Thick_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt strap; colour 1 on the square buckle.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Triple_01.description: Three stacked, separate wide straps wrapped around the waist like a corset, each with a front buckle, a keeper loop and a row of hexagonal studs; the bands are slightly angular and worn snug over the midriff.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Triple_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the keeper loops; colour 2 on the buckle frames; colour 3 on the studs.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.description: A slim, flat belt band worn at the waist, with a rounded bulbous buckle at the front and small strap loops beside it. Its patchwork panels give it a casual anime-inspired street look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light belt segments; colour 1 on the front buckle, strap loops and some panels; colour 2 on the panels; colour 3 on small accent patches near the back and side.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.differs: The male belt is a flatter, thinner band sitting at the waist, with a smaller round buckle at the front.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Utility_01.description: A utility belt with a wide strap, a large round buckle with a central lens-like dome and side plates, and boxy pouches with metal-edged flaps at the hips and back. Sits at the waist in a tactical superhero style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Utility_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the belt strap and pouch bodies; colour 0 on the buckle housing and pouch edge plates; colour 3 on the buckle side panels and small lights; colour 2 on the central dome.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_V_02.description: A plain, flat-faceted band belt sitting at the waist, dipping to a sharp V point at the front and narrowing to a thin strip across the back. Simple, angular superhero styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_V_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole belt band; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Victory_01.description: A belt of layered, ribbon-like bands looping around the hips in V-shaped swoops that dip to a point at front and back, with open gaps between the strips. Sleek, angular superhero styling.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide inner faces of the bands; colour 3 on the edging and outer rims of the bands.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Victory_01.differs: The male version has a simpler pattern, with contrasting edging around contrasting bands, and the loops form a tidier, more closed and layered stack.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: A slim band-style belt sitting low on the hips, with a broad striped outer face edged by thin contrasting rims top and bottom. Simple, patriotic superhero look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide band face; colour 3 on the vertical stripes; colour 1 on the rims and inner lining.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_02.description: A double-banded belt with a tilted second band that droops diagonally below the main waist band, both with contrasting strap slots, and a boxy central buckle. Sits at the waist and hips in a superhero vigilante style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of both bands; colour 1 on the edging and inner lining; colour 2 on the small strap bars; colour 3 on the front buckle.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Vigilante_02.differs: The lower band hangs less steeply on the male version, sitting closer to the main waist band.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A slim segmented waist band with a central pointed, rounded armored buckle plate bearing a small round eye-like stud, plus a large angular fin-shaped guard flaring out over each hip. Suggests an alien or mechanical creature-armor look.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the centre buckle plate and hip fins; colour 3 on the thin lines and piping along the band and fins; colour 2 on the inner lining of the band.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Vine_01.description: A low-slung hip band of twisting organic vines with swirling carved patterns, curling thorn-like hooks along the top edge and a pointed front panel that drops into a fringe of clawed tendrils at the crotch.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine band and swirl bands; colour 0 on the central front panel and swirl highlights; colour 3 on the curled thorn tips and dangling tendril points.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Viper_01.description: A tactical utility belt of layered banded strips worn low on the hips, with a large drop-leg gun holster on one hip, a sheathed knife on the other, and small pouches spaced across the front and back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded belt strips; colour 1 on the holster, pouches and knife sheath; colour 3 on the knife handle and small pouch details.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Viperlogo_01.description: A wide, flat belt band worn around the waist, with a snake-head buckle plate at the centre front showing fangs and eye slits. Reads as a sleek, villainous serpent-themed accessory.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snake-head buckle plate; colour 1 on the fangs and eye markings; colour 2 on the belt band.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Viperlogo_01.differs: The male belt is a wide straight band sitting at the waist, while the female one is a thinner band worn low on the hips that dips into a V.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wedding_Ribbedv_01.description: A wide, briefs-style waistband with a V-shaped front point, ribbed parallel stripes following the V, and a mostly level band around the back; it sits at the hips like a short cummerbund.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wedding_Ribbedv_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ribbed band; colour 1 on the stripes and top rim; colour 2 on the thin rear edge.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wedding_Ribbedv_01.differs: The male belt is a shallower band with a less pronounced V at the front, sitting higher at the waist with only a small trailing edge at the back.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A low-slung, brief-shaped belt with a V-shaped front panel, a band of interlocking key-pattern scrollwork around the hips, a circular emblem at the centre and thin strings trailing at the back.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel and band; colour 2 on the scrollwork, outline and emblem lines; colour 1 and colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wizards_02.description: A low-slung wide belt with a V-shaped front dip, swirling engraved patterning and a central oval gem. A flat pouch hangs at one hip, and a round flask and two tube vials hang at the other hip. Fantasy wizard style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wizards_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and pouch; colour 2 on the swirl patterns and edge trim; colour 3 on the central gem and the lower halves of the vials; colour 1 on the upper halves of the flasks, vial tops and stoppers.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wizards_02.differs: The male belt has a deeper V dip at the front, and its round flask and vials hang slightly further apart at the side.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wrappedtight_01.description: A wide, soft cloth wrap band around the waist, with slightly crumpled folds and small loose corners at the top edge. It is patterned with leaf motifs and a central glyph, in a casual East Asian style.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wrappedtight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base cloth of the band; colour 1 on the leaf pattern; colour 2 on the central glyph mark.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wrappedtight_01.differs: The male wrap is a straight, even-height band sitting at the waist, without the dipped front.

Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wrestling_01.description: A wide championship belt with a broad strap and a large ornate front plate showing two clenched fists and a lettered banner, plus hexagonal medallion plates around the sides and back. Sits on the waist and hips.
Male/M_Belt_Tight_Wrestling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide strap; the front plate, fists and medallions use a metallic default material that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Belt_Toy_02.description: A wide, flat belt band with a square front plate carrying a heart-shaped cutout and three small studs, plus several padded loops spaced around the band. Sits at the waist with a toy-like, playful look.
Male/M_Belt_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band's outer panels; colour 2 on the front plate and the band sections; colour 1 on the loops; colour 3 on the three studs.

Male/M_Belt_Traveler_01.description: A casual double-layered belt worn low and tilted on the hips: a wide strap with a buckle lies over a second strap knotted through a ring, with a long tail hanging down the front.
Male/M_Belt_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knotted outer strap and its hanging tail; colour 1 on the underlying buckled belt; colour 3 on the buckle and ring; colour 2 on the edge outlines.

Male/M_Belt_Trooper_01.description: A wide, chunky band belt with stacked ridged tiers and a faceted, angular shield-shaped buckle at the front, with a small tab peeking out at the back. Sits at the waist in a sentai-hero style.
Male/M_Belt_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the front buckle and the small rear tab; colour 2 on the recess inside the buckle.
Male/M_Belt_Trooper_01.differs: The buckle is slightly larger and the belt band sits a little lower and deeper at the waist.

Male/M_Belt_Trumpknight_01.description: A slim ring belt of flat rectangular tiles around the hips, each tile carrying a playing-card suit symbol (spade, heart, diamond, club), with small raised tabs along the top edge. It has a playful casino look.
Male/M_Belt_Trumpknight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and tiles; colour 1 on the spade and club symbols; colour 2 on the heart and diamond symbols; the tab edges follow colour 0.
Male/M_Belt_Trumpknight_01.differs: The male belt is a slim band of tiles showing card-suit symbols, not the chunky angular armour blocks with contrasting plates seen on the female.

Male/M_Belt_Variablerobot_01.description: A chunky angular mechanical belt with a faceted, plated band around the hips, a screw-like round cap on each side, and a small brief-like panel that hangs down at the front and back over the groin and rear.
Male/M_Belt_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main belt band and side plating; colour 1 on the top surface and the lower hanging panels at front and back; colour 3 on the front panel plate; colour 0 is not clearly visible.

Male/M_Belt_Warrior_01.description: A tribal warrior belt: a wide, padded waistband wrapped in criss-crossing zigzag bands, with a stacked diamond ornament at the front and a long narrow tassel-like panel hanging between the legs, patterned with chevrons and ending in a ribbed pointed tip.
Male/M_Belt_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband base and the panel backing; colour 1 on the zigzag wraps and the ribbed tip; colour 3 on the diamond ornament and the chevron panel; colour 2 on the diamond centres and the panel edging.

Male/M_Belt_Warrior_02.description: A wide, padded belt with a textured, scaly-looking band and a contrasting inner lining. A narrow striped strip hangs from the front and ends in a three-pronged metal tip; a matching tip trails at the back. Sits at the hips.
Male/M_Belt_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly belt band; colour 2 on the edging and inner lining; colour 1 on the striped front strip; colour 0 on the three-pronged metal tips.

Male/M_Bike_Rocket_01.description: A sci-fi hover-bike attachment: a long, tapering nose fuselage with a sleek central stripe, wide rocket pods with vented grilles on both sides, and small landing struts underneath. It sits under and around the rider as a vehicle.
Male/M_Bike_Rocket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hull panels; colour 1 on the central stripe and trim; colour 2 on the pod housings and underside; colour 3 on the vented grilles of the rocket pods.

Male/M_Bike_Rocket_02.description: A long sci-fi hover-bike body with a pointed nose, a raised rear housing of vented rocket exhausts, and twin angled side pods on swept struts; the rider sits on top and the whole vehicle extends well in front of and behind the body.
Male/M_Bike_Rocket_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hull panels and pods; colour 2 on the engine housings, struts and undercarriage; colour 1 on the stripe and marking panels; colour 3 on the rear vent grilles.

Male/M_Bike_Rocket_03.description: A long hover-bike body with a pointed nose, a ribbed engine block at the rear, and two side-mounted rocket pods on struts. Layered angular plating and exhaust vents give it a mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Bike_Rocket_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on nearly the whole bike body, pods and plating; the other colour slots are hardly visible on this sheet.

Male/M_Bracer_L_Tight_Cosmic_02.description: A short, tight faceted wrist bracer: an octagonal tapered cuff with a raised rim at the top and a separate thin band near the wrist edge, sitting snugly on the lower forearm. Simple sci-fi look.
Male/M_Bracer_L_Tight_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main cuff body and the raised bands; colour 0 on the inner lining visible at the top opening.

Male/M_Bracerl_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A left wrist bracer made of a narrow flat cuff ringed with a row of round studs along its lower edge, with several loose coils of heavy chain wrapped thickly around the forearm above it. Gritty, festive-gothic look.
Male/M_Bracerl_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat cuff band; colour 1 on the round ball studs; colour 2 on the wrapped chain links.

Male/M_Bracerl_Toxicsteel_01.description: A bulky forearm bracer of angular plates with a looping handle-like cable on the outer side, a cuff band at the wrist, and a long forked blade fin extending up along the arm toward the elbow. Sci-fi, industrial look.
