Male/M_Bracerl_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main plates, fin and central housing; colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the edge trim and the looped handle.

Male/M_Bracerr_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A tight right-wrist bracer made of many loosely wound heavy chain loops stacked around the forearm, sitting on a short plain cuff band with a ring of round beads along the lower edge. Rugged, festive-monstrous look.
Male/M_Bracerr_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the chain loops; colour 1 on the round beads.

Male/M_Bracerr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A chunky sci-fi forearm bracer with a bulky angular shell, a small cylindrical canister port, a looping tube or cable on the outer side, and a tall forked fin spike rising toward the elbow. A separate cuff sits at the wrist.
Male/M_Bracerr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell, canister and forked spike; colour 2 on the edge trim and looping tube; colour 1 on the wrist cuff.

Male/M_Bracers_L_Lockbox_65_01.description: An ornate, oversized left forearm bracer with a pointed cuff at the elbow, a central plate and swooping curved blades and thorn-like fins along its sides, giving an aggressive martial-arts fantasy look.
Male/M_Bracers_L_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved blade fins and edge spikes; colour 1 on the main bracer plate; colour 2 on the metal framework and trim; colour 3 on the small gems.

Male/M_Bracers_L_Lockbox_65_02.description: A left forearm bracer of layered, wrinkled leather-like wrap with a flared cuff, topped at the elbow by a spiky, dragon-head-like crest of jagged fins and a small central gem; martial, fantasy styling.
Male/M_Bracers_L_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the engraved side plating; colour 1 on the spiky crest fins and inner lining; colour 2 on the main leather body and cuff; colour 3 on the gem eye of the crest.

Male/M_Bracers_L_Tight_Robots_Bracers_01.description: A chunky angular mecha-style left bracer covering the forearm, with a faceted plated shell, a round sensor eye, grooved vents, a small spike near the elbow and swept fin-like blades jutting from the sides.
Male/M_Bracers_L_Tight_Robots_Bracers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spike; colour 1 on the fin blades; colour 3 on the grooves and circuit lines; colour 2 on the sensor eye and small studs.

Male/M_Bracers_R_Lockbox_65_01.description: A large ornate right forearm bracer with swirling tribal-style curled blades and thorn-like spikes along its outer edge, a pointed guard at the elbow and a blade-like point over the wrist and hand; fantasy martial-arts armour.
Male/M_Bracers_R_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swirling raised metal ornaments and edges; colour 1 on the inset panels between the swirls; colour 3 on the small gem-like accents; colour 2 on the inner lining and darker recesses.

Male/M_Bracers_R_Lockbox_65_02.description: A right forearm bracer with a glossy, layered wrap that flares slightly toward the wrist, topped by a spiky, dragon-like head ornament at the elbow with jagged fins and horns. Suggests martial-arts fantasy armor.
Male/M_Bracers_R_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main bracer body and plating; colour 1 on the head ornament, fins and inner cuff lining; colour 0 on the spikes and edge highlights; colour 3 on the eye gems.

Male/M_Bracers_R_Tight_Robots_Bracers_01.description: A chunky, angular armored bracer for the right forearm, with a tapered shell, small horn-like points, swept fin blades along the outer edge, slotted vents on the front and a circular sensor with fine circuit lines.
Male/M_Bracers_R_Tight_Robots_Bracers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and horn points; colour 1 on the swept fin blades; colour 3 on the vent slots, circuit lines and sensor ring; colour 2 on the sensor centre.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Basic_01_Default.description: A pair of simple, slightly arched eyebrows made of thick angular strips that sit just above the eyes, tapering toward the outer ends. A plain, natural-looking facial detail.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_0.description: A pair of sculpted, wing-like brow ridges that sweep up and outward above the eyes, each with several layered feather-like or fin-like spikes. A fantasy dragon or beast look worn on the brow line.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner brow ridges and most of each swept shape; colour 1 on the outer tips of the spikes.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_0.description: A pair of swept-back, finned brow crests that curve up and outward from above each eye, with layered feather-like ridges along the outer edge. They sit along the brow line and suggest a dragon-like beast look.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower, inner part of each crest; colour 1 on the upper ridged tips and outer fin edges.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Hornssmall_01.description: A pair of small, smooth conical horns that sit on the forehead, one on each side of the brow, pointing outward and slightly back. Simple, plain monstrous accents that suit beast or demon looks.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Hornssmall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both horns; the open base of each horn shows a darker shade, but no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Ice_01.description: A pair of jagged ice-crystal brow ornaments, one over each eye, with branching antler-like shards that sweep upward and outward to tall points at the temples. Sits on the brow line as a frosty fantasy adornment.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Ice_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crystal shards; the rest of the surface shows a frosty, mottled crystal texture that appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Ice_02.description: A pair of decorative brow pieces made of three swept, claw-like slashes each, curving from above the eyes and flicking upward and outward at the temples. They sit on the brow line and suggest icy or clawed, creature-like styling.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Ice_02.colourAreas: The default glossy, mottled metallic material ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slot visibly applies to the brow slashes.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Ice_03.description: A pair of jagged, crystalline ice-shard eyebrows: clusters of sharp spikes sweeping up and outward from the brow line, with long thin tips flaring toward the temples. Suggests a frosty, monstrous or elemental face.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Ice_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shards; the mottled surface texture on the front faces largely ignores the colour scheme, and no other slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_01.description: A pair of thick, heavy brow ridges that dip to a V at the centre and sweep outward, with jagged, tufted points along the top edges. Sits on the brow line for a bestial, monstrous look.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the brows; colour 0 on the lighter tufted tips and upper edges.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_Long_01.description: A pair of bestial brow pieces forming a V-shaped ridge across the forehead, with layered jagged spikes sweeping up and outward at each side. Sits just above the eyes, giving a fierce, monstrous look.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the brow spikes; colour 0 on the central highlight near the nose bridge; colour 2 on the inner edge bands.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_Medium_01.description: A pair of bestial brow ridges made of layered, jagged tufts that sweep outward and upward from a low central dip above the eyes, giving a fierce, feral look.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Sasquatch_Medium_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the brow tufts; colour 0 on the highlighted inner ridge and tips near the centre.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Solid_01.description: A chunky, lumpy stone-like brow ridge that wraps across the forehead over the eyes and around to the temples, with a row of sharp crystal shards jutting upward from the top. Cracked, veined surface suggests a monstrous look.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Solid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rocky brow surface; colour 3 on the crack veins; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Solid_Malvan_01.description: A pair of sharp, swept-back blade-like brow ridges with a smaller secondary spike above each, sitting over the eyes and extending outward past the temples. Alien, monstrous styling with smooth tapering forms.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Solid_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central blade surfaces; colour 1 on the upper spikes; colour 3 on the outer tips; colour 2 on the underside edge, blending smoothly between slots.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Solid_Malvan_01.differs: The male version has smooth gradient-shaded blades with colour 3 at the tips, while the female version has hard-edged faceted panels.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Spikeyswept_01.description: A pair of eyebrow pieces made of sharp, swept-back spikes that fan out and upward over each eye, forming jagged blade-like brows. They suggest a monstrous or mechanical fantasy look.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Spikeyswept_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole set of spikes, with shading only from the lighting.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Spikeyswept_01.differs: The male brows are coloured entirely with colour 0, whereas the female version is mostly colour 1 with a few lighter tips in colour 0.

Male/M_Brow_Face_Werewolf_Long_01.description: A pair of long, swept-back brow pieces made of layered, jagged fur-like tufts that rise over each eye and flare outward toward the temples, giving a feral werewolf look.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Werewolf_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bulk of the tufts and their outer tips; colour 0 on the inner roots of the tufts, blending as a gradient.
Male/M_Brow_Face_Werewolf_Long_01.differs: The male version shows a solid two-tone colour gradient on the tufts, while the female version has a translucent, glowing look that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Brow_Tight_Animatronic_01.description: A pair of angular mechanical brow plates forming a V shape, each a slim faceted bar sweeping up and outward from a small central hinge joint at the brow line. Suggests robotic or animatronic styling.
Male/M_Brow_Tight_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central hinge joint; colour 1 on the two long brow bars.

Male/M_Brow_Tight_Face_Profevil_01.description: A pair of thick, sharply angled eyebrows that slant down toward the nose in a stern, scowling look, with pointed tapering ends that sweep outward over the brow ridge.

Male/M_Brow_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A rigid angular brow band with a zigzag W-shaped profile, dipping to a point over the nose bridge and rising toward the temples. Two stepped ridges run along its length, giving a heroic, masked look.
Male/M_Brow_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the lower ridge and edge trim.

Male/M_Brow_Tight_Robotexo_01.description: A pair of thick, angular brow plates that replace the eyebrows, each a flat slab with a kinked bend that angles down toward the nose. They give a stern, mechanical look to the face.
Male/M_Brow_Tight_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both brow plates; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Cape_Chestlayer_Destroyer_Player_.description: A cape made of long, narrow hanging strands that fan out from a small collar-like yoke at the neck and shoulders. Each strand ends in a sharp pointed tip, reaching to about knee height for a ragged, mystic look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestlayer_Destroyer_Player_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder yoke; colour 1 on the upper lengths of the strands; colour 2 on the lower lengths and pointed tips; colour 3 on the thin edge trim of the tips.

Male/M_Cape_Chestlayer_Flames_01.description: A hanging cloth cape that drapes from the shoulders to about the knees and widens toward the hem. Layered flame-shaped bands run down its length and the hem ends in ragged, pointed tatters. A superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestlayer_Flames_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top shoulder band; colour 1 on the upper flame band; colour 2 on the middle flame band; colour 3 on the lower flame band and hem.

Male/M_Cape_Chestlayer_Flaps_01.description: A cape of two hanging halves split down the centre back, made of stacked feather-like flaps with jagged, pointed hems. It hangs from the shoulders to about knee level in three tiered bands, with a superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestlayer_Flaps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper flaps near the shoulders; colour 2 on the middle band of flaps; colour 3 on the long lower flaps; colour 0 on the thin shoulder edge and centre seam.

Male/M_Cape_Chestlayer_Lightning_Alpha_0.description: A short hanging cape that drapes from the shoulders to about hip or thigh level, with a jagged lightning-bolt hem and zigzag edge trim. It fades from light at the neckline to contrasting at the bottom, with a superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestlayer_Lightning_Alpha_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders, fading toward colour 2 on the lower body of the cape; colour 1 on the jagged lightning-shaped edge trim.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01.description: A plain hanging cape of simulated cloth that drapes from the shoulders down the back to about the calves, flaring widely toward an uneven hem with soft folds. It has no visible clasp or trim.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01.differs: The male cape flares wider toward the hem and sits broader across the shoulders than the female version, which hangs narrower and straighter.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Art_Deco.description: A knee-length hanging cape with a small contrasting collar piece at the neck, a V-shaped central panel and wide, pointed lower corners that flare outward. Thin ribbed lines fan across the panels in an art deco, feather-like pattern.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Art_Deco.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar piece at the neck; colour 2 on the main upper cape panels; colour 1 on the central V panel and the lower swept corners; colour 3 on the thin rib lines.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Art_Deco.differs: The male cape flares wider and sits shorter, with broad flared lower corners rather than a narrow, long drape.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Hanging_Tattere.description: A knee-length hanging cape draped from the shoulders down the back, wrapping slightly around one side. It falls in soft folds and ends in a ragged, tattered hem with torn strips.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Hanging_Tattere.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape body; colour 1 fades in over the lower cape and the torn hem.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Insect.description: A back-hung cape shaped like a pair of insect wings: two broad, tapering panels with a vein-cell pattern, joined by a small collar-like patch at the neck and hanging to about knee level with pointed tips.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Insect.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck patch at the top; colour 1 on the wing panels; colour 2 on the lower wing panels and edges; colour 3 on the vein lines.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Insect.differs: The male wings are wider and flare farther out, nearly meeting at the centre of the back.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Plated.description: A shoulder-mounted cape that hangs down the back to about the knees, with a small collar-like yoke at the neck and a solid upper section. The lower half splits into long, pointed feather-like slats, giving a jagged, winged hem.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_01_Plated.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small yoke at the neck; colour 1 on the upper cape body; colour 2 on the lower slatted feather section and the vertical slits.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Ascendant_01.description: A hanging cloth cape with a soft draped hood-like collar at the neck, falling straight down the back to about the knees. Layered angular chevron panels decorate it, and the hem has a jagged, pointed edge with contrasting trim.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body and collar; colour 1 on the border trim along the edges and hem; colour 2 on the chevron panels; colour 3 on the inner chevron panels.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01.description: A plain cloth cape hanging from the shoulders and upper back, with soft gathered folds at the neckline and a broad, straight drape that falls to about the knees, with a fairly even hem.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole outer cape; the inner lining shows a slightly different shade from the same slot.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01.differs: The male cape is a broader, squarer drape with a fairly even hem and ends slightly shorter than the female one.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01_Tattered.description: A cape of draped cloth hanging from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with soft folds and a ragged, torn lower hem. It gives a tattered, weathered superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_01_Tattered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape; colour 1 on the lower cape, fading in as a gradient toward the torn hem.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Art_Deco_01.description: A knee-length cape hanging from a small pointed collar at the upper back, with broad outer panels, a central spine panel and radiating seam lines, ending in a split, pointed fishtail hem.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Art_Deco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small collar piece at the neck; colour 2 on the broad outer panels; colour 1 on the central spine panel and lower fishtail; colour 3 on the radiating seam lines.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Art_Deco_01.differs: The male cape is wider across the shoulders and hangs a little fuller, with a shallower fishtail hem.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Ascendant_01.description: A knee-length cloth cape hanging from the shoulders, with a draped, gathered neckline and a jagged, zigzag hem. Contrasting edge trim and a stacked chevron-arrow motif run down the back. Suits a superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape cloth; colour 1 on the edge trim along the sides and hem; colour 2 on the upper and lower chevron shapes; colour 3 on the middle chevron.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Destroyer_Pl.description: A cape made of long thin hanging strands that fan out from a small collar-like panel across the upper back, each strand ending in a sharp pointed blade tip; hangs to about the thigh or knee.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Destroyer_Pl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper back panel; colour 1 on the strands; colour 3 on the pointed tips and edge highlights; colour 2 on the darkened lower ends.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Feather_01.description: A back-mounted cape of layered feather-like strips hanging from the shoulders to about the thighs, gathered in soft folds at the top and ending in ragged, pointed feather tips with contrasting markings.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body and feather strips; colour 1 on the lower feather tips; colour 3 on the middle feather markings; colour 2 on the side feather markings.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flag_01.description: A plain, full-length cloth cape that hangs from the upper back in soft draped folds, widening slightly toward a slightly uneven hem near the ankles. A simple superhero cape with no visible trim.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape, outside and inner lining.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flames_01.description: A knee-length cloth cape hanging from the upper back, with a gathered draped top and horizontal bands of flame-shaped swirls. The hem ends in ragged, pointed flame tongues. Classic superhero styling.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flames_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered top section; colour 1 on the upper band; colour 2 on the middle band and flame shapes; colour 3 on the lower band.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flaps_01.description: A cape of two split flaps hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, with layered feather-like tiers ending in jagged, pointed hems. A small collar band sits at the neck.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Flaps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck collar band; colour 1 on the upper tier of feathers; colour 2 on the middle tier; colour 3 on the lower tier and jagged tips.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Insect_01.description: A cape made of two long, translucent insect-wing panels that hang from a small collar at the neck to about the knees, tapering to pointed tips. A network of veins crosses each wing, and the two wings part down the centre of the back.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small collar at the neck; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 3 on the vein network; colour 2 on the wing edges and lower tips.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Insect_01.differs: The male wings are broader and wider at the shoulders, with a larger collar.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Lightning_Al.description: A back cape hanging from the shoulders to about knee level, with a draped cowl-like collar at the top and a hem cut into jagged lightning-bolt points, edged by a contrasting border that gives a spiky silhouette.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Lightning_Al.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and collar, fading into colour 2 lower down on the main cloth; colour 1 on the jagged lightning-shaped edge trim.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Mini_01.description: A short cloth mini-cape draped across the shoulders and upper back, with gathered folds at the neckline. It hangs loosely to around the hips, giving a classic superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Mini_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; the cloth is one uniform surface with no separate trim.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Mini_01.differs: The male cape starts higher across the shoulders and is broader, while the female cape sits lower on the back and hangs more narrowly.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Modern_Destr.description: A simple hanging cape of soft draped cloth, attached across the upper back and shoulders, falling in loose folds to about knee level with a slightly uneven, pointed hem. Plain, flowing superhero style.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Modern_Destr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape; colour 1 on the lower part of the cape, blending in a gradient toward the hem.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Modern_Destr.differs: The male cape is wider and fuller across the shoulders, hanging in broader folds.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Plated_01.description: A short back cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with a contrasting collar panel, a broad main section slit with vertical gaps, and a lower band cut into long jagged tapering strips. Superhero style.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Plated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar panel at the neck; colour 1 on the main upper section of the cape; colour 2 on the lower band and the hanging strips.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Plated_01.differs: The male cape is broader across the shoulders and hangs a little longer, with a larger collar panel.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Poncho_01.description: A short back-mounted cape in the shape of a poncho panel: a flat, vertically striped cloth shield that hangs from the shoulders across the back and tapers to a point near the lower back, with thin contrasting edge trim.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth; colour 1 and colour 2 on the thin vertical stripes; colour 3 on the edge trim.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Poncho_01.differs: The male cape is wider and shorter, ending in a point around the lower back rather than reaching the thigh.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Retro_Destro.description: A plain, simple cloth cape hanging from the upper back to about knee level, with a straight top edge, gentle folds and a slightly ragged hem. It falls loosely behind the body in a classic superhero style.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Retro_Destro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape, blending into colour 1 toward the hem; the fabric shows a smooth gradient between the two.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Scalloped_01.description: A cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the calves, with soft draped folds at the neckline and a jagged, scalloped hem of pointed tips. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Scalloped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders; colour 1 on the lower cape and scalloped points, blending from colour 0 above.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Scalloped_01.differs: The male cape is wider and boxier across the shoulders and a bit shorter than the female one.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Torn_01.description: A torn cloth cape hanging from the upper back and shoulders in soft draped folds, reaching to about the knees, with a ragged, holed and shredded lower edge. Suggests a tattered, battle-worn look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Basic_Torn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders, fading into colour 1 toward the ragged lower hem.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Feather_01.description: A hanging cape of layered feather shapes that drapes from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with a ragged, pointed feathered hem and small arrow-like feather markings in rows.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape and feather bodies; colour 3 on the upper row of feather tips; colour 2 on the middle row of feather tips; colour 1 on the lowest feather tips.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Flag_01.description: A simple cloth cape that hangs from the shoulders and neck down the back to about knee height, widening into a flared A-line with soft folds. It drapes over one shoulder toward the front, giving a classic superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Flag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_01.description: A small cloth banner-like cape that floats detached beside and above one shoulder, as if hung from an unseen pole. It is a pointed, swept panel with a flared side and loose folds.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; no other slots visible.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_01.differs: The male panel is wider, with a flared triangular side that juts out, while the female version is a narrower, tall pennant.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_02.description: A single triangular cloth cape panel floating out from one shoulder like a flag on a pole, peaked at the top and tapering to a point below, with soft settled folds and a differently shaded inner face.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the cloth; colour 1 on the inner face of the cloth.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Flagpole_02.differs: The panel is broader and more open, with a wider flared triangle and gentler folds.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Mini_01.description: A short mini-cape hanging from the shoulders down the back, a single smooth cloth panel that widens toward a flared hem around hip level, with soft folds and no visible fastenings.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Modern_Destroyer_0.description: A long cloth cape that hangs loosely from the shoulders down the back to about the calves, draped over one side of the front, with soft folds and a ragged, uneven hem. Suggests a modern supervillain look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Modern_Destroyer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and shoulders; colour 1 blends in toward the lower hem as a gradient.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Pleated_01.description: A feathered wing-style cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with layered rows of long pointed feathers, a V-shaped notch at the top and ragged, fringed tips. Sits close to the back with a superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Pleated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper shoulder feathers; colour 2 on the middle feather rows; colour 1 on the long outer wing feathers; colour 0 on the lower fringed feathers.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Poncho_01.description: A short hanging cape shaped like a poncho panel, draped from the shoulders down the back and tapering to a point at hip level, with vertical stripes of cloth and a thin contrasting edge.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 1 and colour 2 on the vertical stripes; colour 3 on the outer edge trim.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A plain, smooth cloth cape hanging straight from the shoulders down the back to about knee height, with a slightly flared, uneven hem and soft folds. It suggests a classic retro superhero or villain look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders, blending into colour 1 toward the hem.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Scalloped_01.description: A long cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, with a gathered collar at the neck and a hem cut into sharp scallops. It falls in broad soft folds.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Scalloped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the neck and shoulders, blending into colour 1 toward the scalloped lower hem.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Scalloped_01.differs: This cape is wider and fuller, with a broader, more flared hem than the female version.

Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Torn_01.description: A tattered cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with a small gathered neckline and a ragged hem full of torn holes and frayed points. It gives a ruined, wind-worn look.
Male/M_Cape_Chestwear_Torn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders, fading into colour 1 across the lower torn portion and ragged edges.

Male/M_Cape_Flag_01.description: A knee-length cloth cape draped from one shoulder, with gathered folds at the shoulder and a broad, slightly tapered panel hanging behind and to the side of the body. It suggests a classic superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Flag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape, with a faint tint from colour 1 in the shadowed folds.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01.description: A plain simulated-cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, with soft draped folds gathered at the top and a slightly flared, uneven hem. Suits jackets and superhero looks.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; the inner lining shows a slightly different shade of the same slot.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01_Art_Deco.description: A long back cape that hangs from the shoulders to about the knees, with a small collar-like yoke at the top. Layered panels end in pointed, swallowtail-like hems and fine radiating seams give it an art deco look.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01_Art_Deco.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the yoke at the neck and shoulders; colour 2 on the outer side panels; colour 1 on the central and lower panels; colour 3 on the thin radiating seam lines.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01_Insect.description: A back-mounted cape made of two long, narrow wing-like panels with pointed tips, split down the middle and joined by a small triangular collar patch at the neck. Veined, insect-wing pattern; reaches about knee to mid-calf.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01_Insect.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck patch; colour 1 on the wing panel surfaces; colour 2 on the darkened wing tips and edges; colour 3 on the vein network.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01_Plated.description: A back-mounted cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with a V-shaped upper panel, vertical seam lines, and a lower section cut into long tapering strips that end in ragged points. Superhero style.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01_Plated.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and neck yoke at the top; colour 1 on the main upper cape panel; colour 2 on the lower band and hanging strips.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01_Tattered.description: A plain, tapering cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with a ragged, tattered hem of jagged strips. Soft folds give a loose, flowing drape suited to a rugged superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_01_Tattered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape, fading into colour 1 toward the tattered lower hem.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Ascendant_01.description: A broad cloth cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with draped folds at the neckline, a jagged zigzag hem, and layered spear-shaped emblem panels down the centre back.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape cloth; colour 1 on the edge border and jagged hem trim; colour 2 on the central and outer spear-shaped panels; colour 3 on the inner spear-shaped panels.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Destroyer_Player_01_1.description: A cape made of narrow hanging strands falling from a small triangular collar panel across the shoulders, each strand tapering to a pointed tip near the knees. Loose, sheer and mystic in feel.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Destroyer_Player_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the triangular shoulder panel; colour 1 on the upper lengths of the strands; colour 2 and colour 3 on the darker pointed tips and edges of the strands.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Feather_01.description: A short cape hanging from the shoulders, gathered into soft drapes at the top and ending in a ragged hem of long pointed feather shapes, with feather-tip markings in rows down the lower half.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth; colour 3 on the upper feather tips; colour 2 on the middle feather tips; colour 1 on the lowest feather tips.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Flag_01.description: A plain, wide cloth cape hanging straight from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with soft gathered drapes at the top and a loose, slightly flared hem. Suits a superhero jacket look.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Flag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; a faint tint of colour 1 on the inner surface.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Flames_01.description: A cloth cape that hangs from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, with a draped gathered top and a ragged, flame-shaped lower edge. Stacked bands of flame-like scallops run down its length, giving a dramatic superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Flames_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped upper section near the shoulders; colour 1 on the upper flame band; colour 2 on the middle flame band; colour 3 on the lower flame band and tattered hem.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Flaps_01.description: A long back-hung pair of cloth flaps split down the centre, with a small collar-like yoke at the shoulders and three stacked tiers of jagged, pointed edges; falls behind the body to about the knees or lower.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Flaps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar yoke at the neck; colour 1 on the upper tier; colour 2 on the middle tier; colour 3 on the lower tier and hem points.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Lightning_Alpha_01.description: A back-hung cape that drapes from the shoulders in soft cloth folds and tapers down past the knees to jagged, lightning-bolt shaped points, with a contrasting edge trim along the zigzag hem.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Lightning_Alpha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper draped cape and fading into colour 2 toward the lower body; colour 1 on the jagged edge trim along the sides and hem.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Mini_01.description: A short cloth mini-cape draped from the shoulders with deep gathered folds along the top edge, falling in a broad rectangular shape to a waist-length hem; a plain superhero back piece.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Mini_01.differs: The male cape is broader and boxier, with deeper gathered folds across the shoulders and an even hem.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A simple cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, draped in soft folds with a slightly ragged lower hem. Suits classic superhero or villain looks.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and shoulders; colour 1 blends in over the lower part of the cape toward the hem.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Poncho_01.description: A short cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back, ending in a pointed V hem around hip level. Vertical stripe panels run down its length, giving a simple poncho-like drape for jackets.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body; colour 1 and colour 2 on the vertical stripes running down the cape; colour 3 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A plain, simple cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about ankle length, with a slightly flared, gently rippled hem and a smooth gradient of two tones. Suits a classic retro superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders; colour 1 on the lower cape and hem, blending as a gradient between them.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Scalloped_01.description: A long cloth cape hanging from the shoulders with a draped, cowl-like fold at the neckline and a jagged, scalloped hem reaching about the calves. Flowing superhero styling worn over a jacket.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Scalloped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and draped neckline; colour 1 on the lower cape and scalloped points, blending gradually from colour 0.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Scalloped_01.differs: The male cape has a broader shoulder drape that covers more of the upper back and shoulders.

Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Torn_01.description: A tattered cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about knee level, with draped folds at the neckline and a ragged hem full of torn holes. Suits worn jackets and a post-battle look.
Male/M_Cape_Jacket_Torn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and shoulder drapes; colour 1 on the lower torn portion and ragged hem, fading in from the top.

Male/M_Cape_Moth_01.description: A pair of long, narrow insect-style wings hanging separately from the upper back to about the knees, with veined translucent membranes, rounded tips and darker banded ends. Fantastical and organic look, worn like a split cape.
Male/M_Cape_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wing membranes; colour 1 on the rounded wing tips and fine veins; colour 2 on the bands at the tips; colour 3 on the upper wing roots.

Male/M_Cape_Redstone_01.description: A single narrow cloth panel draped over one shoulder blade and hanging down the back to the waist, with deep creased folds and a curved top edge, like a wrapped scarf tail.
Male/M_Cape_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel.
Male/M_Cape_Redstone_01.differs: The male panel is offset to one side, starting at the shoulder and hanging down the back with deeper folds, while the female panel hangs centred lower on the back and hips.

Male/M_Cape_Redstone_02.description: A long draped cloth panel hanging from one shoulder down the back and side, with soft vertical folds and a tapered lower edge, ending around the knees. It reads as a wrapped scarf or half-cape.
Male/M_Cape_Redstone_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole draped cloth panel.
Male/M_Cape_Redstone_02.differs: The male version is a wider panel hung asymmetrically from one shoulder down one side, while the female version is a narrow strip centred low on the back.

Male/M_Cape_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A cloth cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with a wide flared hem and uneven trailing corners. A large teardrop-shaped panel runs down the back with a jagged band across it and a narrow vertical strip below. Ancient-Egyptian sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Cape_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body; colour 1 on the large teardrop panel; colour 2 on the jagged band across the panel; colour 3 on the narrow vertical strip.
Male/M_Cape_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The male cape is wider with a more flared hem and uneven trailing corners, and ends a little higher, around the knees.

Male/M_Cape_Tied_Rope_01.description: Three vertical strings of teardrop-shaped beads floating in a row above the head, each a chain of four or three stacked drops shrinking toward the ends. Ornamental and ritual in feel, not attached to the body.
Male/M_Cape_Tied_Rope_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top drop of the centre string; colour 1 on the upper drops of each string; colour 2 on the middle drops; colour 3 on the lowest drops.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_01.description: A plain cloth cape hanging from gathered draped folds across the upper back, falling in a slightly flared, tapering shape to about ankle length behind the legs. Simple superhero style.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Anniversary.description: A long, plain cloth cape hanging straight from the shoulders to about the knees, with a large oval emblem on the back, a pentagon-shaped banner panel across the middle and a narrow vertical strip below. Superhero style with soft draping folds.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth and small round spots at the edges; colour 1 on the large oval; colour 2 on the pentagon panel; colour 3 on the vertical strip.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Art_Deco.description: A long, narrow cape hanging from the shoulders to about the calves, with a draped collar at the neck, a central chevron-patterned panel and a split, pointed feather-like hem. Art deco superhero styling.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Art_Deco.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped collar; colour 2 on the main cape body; colour 1 on the central panel and the lower hem sections; colour 3 on the thin radiating lines.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Insect.description: A close-hanging cape shaped like two long insect wings, joined at a small collar panel at the upper back and splitting into two tapering, pointed panels that reach to about knee level. Both panels carry a network of vein-like ridges.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Insect.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper collar panel; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 2 on the darker lower wing areas and edges; colour 3 on the vein pattern.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Plated.description: A tight-hanging back cape with a draped upper collar panel, vertical plated bands down the body and a chevron-shaped lower section split into long ragged strips. It hangs from the shoulders to about the knees, in a superhero style.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Plated.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped upper collar panel; colour 1 on the main cape body; colour 2 on the vertical plate bands and the split lower strips.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Tattered.description: A plain cloth cape that hangs straight from the shoulders down the back to about the knees, with a raggedly torn, tattered lower hem and a soft draped fall. Suggests a heroic or post-apocalyptic look.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Tattered.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape; colour 1 on the tattered lower hem, blending in as a gradient.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Torn.description: A torn, tattered cloth cape hanging from the shoulders with draped folds at the top, falling to about knee length with ragged holes and a shredded, jagged hem. Suits a battered superhero or post-apocalyptic look.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Torn.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and draped folds; colour 1 on the lower cape, fading in toward the ragged hem.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Webbed.description: A tight, spiderweb-patterned cape of thin cobweb strands with arched, scalloped ribs, hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the calves and open in the gaps, with a ragged, pointed lower edge.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Webbed.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the web strands; the rest of the piece is see-through and takes no colour.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_01_Webbed.differs: The male cape spans a wider shoulder area with a gathered top edge and hangs slightly longer.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A short, flat cape hanging from the shoulders over the upper back to about the waist, made of layered cloth panels with a large central panel, side panels, contrasting trim edges and a small cut-out emblem near the top.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the large central back panel; colour 1 on the upper and lower side panels; colour 0 on the edge trim and shoulder folds.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The male cape is wider and reaches the waist, with a small emblem-shaped cut-out at the top of the back panel.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A narrow, single-strip cloth cape that hangs from one shoulder down the back to about the knee, tapering to a point at the hem with soft draped folds. A mage-like, flowing accent piece.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape strip; the small gathered part at the shoulder is also colour 0.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A tight, narrow cloth cape hanging straight down the back from the shoulders to about the knees, with a draped gathered top, a zigzag pointed hem and layered arrowhead-shaped panels down the centre.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape cloth; colour 1 on the edge trim and zigzag hem; colour 2 on the central arrowhead panels; colour 3 on the inner arrowhead panels.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Bow_01.description: A pair of narrow, tapering cloth tails hanging side by side from the lower back to about mid-thigh, each with a wide contrasting band across the middle and a small oval fastener near the tip. Suggests a sleek superhero cape accessory.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tail panels and oval tips; colour 1 on the curved side panels; colour 2 on the wide middle bands.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A plain, smooth cloth cape hanging straight from the upper back in one wide panel that tapers slightly and flares at the hem, ending around the calves. Simple superhero styling with no visible trim or fastenings.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Destroyer_Player_01.description: A cape made of separate thin hanging strands that fall from a small triangular yoke across the upper back, each strand tapering to a pointed blade-like tip near the knees. Gives a mystic, superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Destroyer_Player_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the triangular yoke at the shoulders; colour 1 on the upper lengths of the strands; colour 2 and colour 3 on the darkened tips and edges of the strands.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Feather_01.description: A short cloth cape with draped folds at the shoulders and a hem cut into long feather-like tapering points, hanging from the upper back to about thigh level. Feather tips carry contrasting markings, giving a tribal, winged look.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth and feather bodies; colour 3 on the upper row of feather tip markings; colour 2 on the middle row of feather tips; colour 1 on the lowest feather tips.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Flames_01.description: A knee-length cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back, gathered in soft drapes at the top. Layered flame-shaped bands step down to a ragged, tattered hem. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Flames_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper drape at the shoulders; colour 1 on the first flame band; colour 2 on the middle flame band; colour 3 on the lower flame band and hem.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Flaps_01.description: A tight, back-hung cape split down the centre into two long panels with jagged, zigzag-cut tiers and a small draped collar at the neck; it hangs close to the back to about knee level, with a superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Flaps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar drape at the neck; colour 1 on the upper tier of the panels; colour 2 on the middle tier; colour 3 on the lower tier and jagged hem.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Furlined_01.description: A long, tapered cape that hangs from the shoulders in vertical pleats and flares wide toward the hem, reaching around calf length. It has a shaggy fur-like edge along the bottom and a smooth gradient of colour.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Furlined_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape near the shoulders; colour 1 on the lower flared part of the cape; colour 2 on the fur-like trim along the hem.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Lightning_Alpha_01.description: A long cloth cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, gathered in soft draped folds at the neckline and ending in a jagged, lightning-bolt zigzag hem with contrasting edging along the sides and bottom.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Lightning_Alpha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape body, fading toward colour 2 at the lower body; colour 1 on the jagged lightning-bolt edging along the sides and hem.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Mini_01.description: A short cloth mini-cape hanging from the shoulders and upper back, with draped gathered folds at the top and a broad, flared hem ending around the hips. It hangs loose behind the arms in a classic superhero style.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Mini_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the cape; colour 1 on the inner lining seen from behind.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Mini_01.differs: The male cape is broader across the shoulders with a wider, more even hem, and it drapes over the shoulders.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A plain, simple cloth cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, draping in soft folds with a slightly ragged, pointed hem. It falls straight down the back, with the neckline dipping low between the shoulder blades.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape; colour 1 on the lower cape, blending in as a gradient toward the hem.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A tight, back-mounted cape hanging from the shoulder blades to about the knees, with a short contrasting upper section, a central tie-like strip, and tiered, jagged, pointed panels layered down to a ragged hem.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long layered lower panels; colour 2 on the upper shoulder section and the central strip.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Poncho_01.description: A short, tight cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back, tapering to a pointed tip at the hips. Vertical stripes give it a pinstriped, panelled look with a slim, close-hanging silhouette.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body; colour 1 and colour 2 on the vertical stripes; colour 3 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A plain, simple cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about the calves, with a softly flaring hem and gentle cloth folds. It has a retro superhero look and no visible fastenings.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape, blending smoothly into colour 1 at the lower hem.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Scalloped_01.description: A cloth cape hanging from the upper back with gathered drapery folds at the shoulders. It falls straight to about knee length and ends in a jagged, scalloped hem. Suits a superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Scalloped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cape and shoulder drape; colour 1 on the lower cape and scalloped points, blending in a gradient.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_01.description: A short, single cloth panel cape that hangs from the shoulder down one side of the back to about hip level, with rippled vertical folds and a broad, slightly flared hem.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_01.differs: The male cape is wider and more rectangular, with a broader top edge and a shorter hem that ends at about hip level.

Male/M_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_Forked_01.description: A cloth half-cape hanging from one shoulder down the side of the body to about hip level, with a forked, pointed hem and soft draped folds. It covers part of the back and flank, giving a superhero look.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_Forked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Cape_Tight_Sidecaper_Forked_01.differs: The male cape is wider and ends around hip level, with a shallower fork at the hem.

Male/M_Cape_Winter_Ice_01.description: A pair of long, narrow crystalline shards forming a split cape that hangs from the shoulders to about the knees, its lower edges breaking into jagged, clawlike icicle spikes with glossy faceted surfaces.
Male/M_Cape_Winter_Ice_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy metallic edge highlights; colour 1 on the faceted inner surface visible from behind; colour 2 on the main body of the shards. The glossy material largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Cape_Winter_Ice_02.description: A split, back-mounted cape made of two long panels of jagged, faceted ice-like shards that hang from the shoulders and end in sharp, claw-like spikes at about knee to calf length. It suits a fantasy or elemental look.
Male/M_Cape_Winter_Ice_02.colourAreas: Mostly glossy, reflective material that largely ignores the scheme; faint colour 1 sheen on some shard facets, the rest reads as near-black.
Male/M_Cape_Winter_Ice_02.differs: The male cape spreads a little wider at the hem, with longer trailing spikes at the sides.

Male/M_Cape_Winter_Ice_03.description: A cape split into two long jagged panels hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, each ending in shard-like crystalline spikes with faceted, glossy plates; it gives a harsh, icy fantasy look.
Male/M_Cape_Winter_Ice_03.colourAreas: Glossy faceted surface largely ignores the scheme; colour 2 on the main panel bodies; colour 1 shows as a sheen on the inner edges and some shards; colour 0 on a few of the shard highlights.
Male/M_Cape_Winter_Ice_03.differs: The male cape has broader, more solid panels starting higher across the shoulders, with a narrower gap between the panels.

Male/M_Capebelt_Backskirt_Frigid_01.description: A long, wing-like skirt hanging from the waist, with a web of contrasting vein-like lines over translucent panels and a ragged, pointed hem that drops to the shins. The fabric fades toward the hem. Fantasy or monstrous styling.
Male/M_Capebelt_Backskirt_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper panels; colour 1 on the lower hem panels, where the fade appears; colour 2 on the vein lines and torn edging.

Male/M_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_01.description: A tattered cloth back-skirt hanging from the waist to about the shins, with a ragged jagged hem, a large bat-wing emblem with edging on the back, and a gradient from the top down to the hem. Sits behind the legs.
Male/M_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper skirt; colour 1 on the lower gradient toward the hem; colour 2 on the bat emblem; colour 3 on the stitched edging around the emblem.
Male/M_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_01.differs: The male skirt hangs narrower and straighter, with less flare at the hem.

Male/M_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_02.description: A long back skirt panel hanging from the waist over the rear and sides, with a plain upper section and a torn hem of jagged strips and small holes, reaching the lower calves. Suggests a tattered, fantasy robe-like look.
Male/M_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the panel; colour 1 on the ragged lower hem, blending down from the top.
Male/M_Capebelt_Backskirt_Tattered_02.differs: The male panel is wider and wraps further around the hips, hanging longer and fuller like a short robe.

Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Anniversary_I.description: A short front apron-style loincloth panel hanging from the waist to mid-thigh, with vertical piping lines and a contrasting deep hem decorated with diamond cut-outs; cloth hangs flat at the front only.
Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Anniversary_I.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel; colour 3 on the vertical piping lines and thin edge line; colour 1 on the bottom hem band; colour 2 on the diamond shapes in the hem.
Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Anniversary_I.differs: The male panel is wider and flares out more, with a stiffer curved shape that sits further from the legs.

Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Chimera_01.description: A hanging cloth panel worn low at the front of the hips, wider and more rectangular at the top, ending in several long jagged spikes that reach past mid-thigh. Its loose, tattered shape suggests a monstrous, beastly style.
Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the panel; colour 1 on the lower spiked tips, blending down from colour 0.
Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Chimera_01.differs: The male panel is wider and blockier at the top and hangs a little longer, with broader spikes at the hem.

Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Lion_01.description: A short front loincloth panel of vertically pleated, draped cloth hanging from the waist to mid-thigh, with a ragged, pointed lower hem. It sits centred on the front of the hips as a partial skirt flap.
Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the cloth; colour 1 fades in toward the lower hem as a gradient.
Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Lion_01.differs: The male version is wider with straighter, more regular vertical pleats and a more even hem.

Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Roinesh_01.description: A single narrow front cloth panel hanging from the waist to about mid-thigh, with gathered folds at the top and a rounded lower hem. It is thin and hangs loosely over the crotch like a loincloth flap.
Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Warrior_01.description: A narrow front loincloth-style skirt panel hanging from the waist to mid-thigh, with a chevron-ribbed upper section, a pointed ribbed lower flap, and a thick contrasting edge border. Suits warrior or fantasy looks.
Male/M_Capebelt_Frontskirt_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top waist band; colour 3 on the chevron-ribbed upper section; colour 1 on the pointed lower flap; colour 2 on the outer edge border.

Male/M_Capebelt_Hipscape_Cyberwire_01.description: A hip-mounted tabard skirt of jagged, shard-like panels that hang to mid-thigh, with longer tapering points at front and back. Sharp outlined edges give it a cybernetic, tattered-cloth look.
Male/M_Capebelt_Hipscape_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panels; colour 1 on the lower panel faces and inner shading; colour 3 on the edge trim along the points; colour 2 on the thin outer outline.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Anniversary_Destroyer_.description: A slim curved belt plate with a padded, stitched look, capped at each end by a round domed disc in a rimmed setting on short stubs. It sits low at the waist as a retro villain-style belt.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Anniversary_Destroyer_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the belt plate and the backs of the discs; colour 3 on the rims of the discs; colour 1 on the domed disc faces. Colour 0 is not visible.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Astronaut_01.description: A short flexible hose hanging in a U-curve from the left side of the waist, with a wrinkled fabric sleeve and a chunky segmented connector and rounded nozzle cap at each end. Suggests an astronaut life-support line.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wrinkled hose sleeve, fading into colour 1 on the lower sleeve; colour 2 on the connector collars; colour 3 on the rounded end caps.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Birdpeople_01.description: A small oval shield-like plaque worn on the left hip, with a thick rim and a flat face bearing a raised winged bird emblem with swept feathers. Hangs at the hip as a superhero belt accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plaque face; colour 2 on the thick outer rim and back; colour 3 on the raised winged bird emblem.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_01.description: A small boxy satchel-style pouch hanging at the left hip, with a folded-over front flap, a gem-like teardrop stud on the flap, contrasting edge trim and a short loop strap at the top.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and top loop; colour 3 on the teardrop stud.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_02.description: A small boxy pouch worn on the left hip, with a fold-over front flap, a rounded gem-like stud closure, contrasting binding around the edges and a loop on the back for a belt. Practical frontier-utility style.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge binding and back loop; colour 3 on the stud closure.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_03.description: A pair of small cylindrical canisters or charge packs worn side by side at the left hip. Each has a flared, ridged cap at both ends and a banded central section, giving a sci-fi gunslinger look.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ridged end caps; colour 2 on the central bands; colour 0 on a thin vertical strip down the back edge of each canister.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_03.differs: The male version adds a thin vertical strip down the back edge of each canister, in its own colour slot.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_04.description: A row of small cartridge-like canisters hanging side by side from the left hip, each with flared ends and a central band. They sit on the hip and wrap slightly toward the back, suggesting a sci-fi western ammunition bandolier.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the canister caps and bodies; colour 2 on the central bands.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Bounty_04.differs: The male version has the canisters bunched more tightly together, with a few overlapping, while the female has them spread slightly more loosely.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A narrow rectangular cloth tabard panel hanging from the left hip to about mid-thigh, printed with a jagged tribal glyph pattern and a crown-like motif at the top, with a gear-shaped edging along the curved hem.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panel; colour 2 on the outlined glyph border and crown motif; colour 3 on the inner zigzag lines and diamond; colour 1 on the gear-like hem trim.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Child_Modern_Witchcraf.description: A long, narrow hanging panel worn at the left hip, falling to mid-thigh. It has a stiff, layered look with a central stripe, angular outlined side panels and a pointed lattice motif at the hem, suggesting a sci-fi or fantasy tabard.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Child_Modern_Witchcraf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges and side borders; colour 1 on the main central panel; colour 2 on the top cap and inner outlines; colour 3 on the lattice motif at the hem.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_01.description: A pair of side-by-side ammunition magazines worn on the left hip: ribbed upper casings with a slotted lower section, each topped with a pointed bullet tip. Reads as a compact tactical belt accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed upper casings; colour 0 on the slotted lower sections; colour 2 on the bullet tips.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_02.description: A boxy utility pouch worn at the left hip, with a soft padded flap that leaves an open mouth showing a contrasting interior. A strap band wraps around it and a chunky clip buckle sits on the side.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the straps and bands; colour 3 on the buckle clip; colour 2 on the interior visible in the opening.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_02.differs: The male pouch has a softer, rounded shape with an open mouth showing a contrasting interior, while the female pouch has a closed flap with contrasting trim.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_03.description: A small rectangular belt pouch with a tall flap edged in contrasting trim, closed by a strap and buckle at the front. It sits on the left hip and suits tactical or military costumes.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the flap edging; colour 1 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle frame.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_04.description: A tall padded rectangular utility pouch worn at the left hip, with a trimmed flap over the top, a wide strap band across the front and a chunky central buckle.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the strap bands; colour 3 on the buckle; colour 2 on the edge trim of the flap and pouch.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Combat_Pouch_04.differs: The male pouch is taller with a closed flap, contrasting edge trim and a front-centre buckle, rather than an open top with the item showing.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Corrupted_01.description: A small hip-mounted cape panel with bat-wing scalloped, jagged edges, hanging at the left hip. Layered folds with a bordered trim, an inner lining and a small crystal-like spike suggest a gothic, monstrous look.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner face of the upper panel; colour 2 on the outer shell, edge trim and fold; colour 1 on the lower scalloped wing layer; colour 3 on the small spike.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A single hip-mounted fin cluster: three stacked, swept-back fin blades with ribbed surfaces that flare outward and taper to points, sitting on the side of the hip like an aquatic creature's frill.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ribbed fin surfaces; colour 1 on the base and inner edges of the fins, blending between the two.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Gladiator_01.description: A belt accessory of three large octagonal metal rings joined by small chain links, each ring holding a hanging rounded plaque with pyramid studs. It dangles at the hip in a gladiator style.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and chain links; colour 1 on the plaque faces; colour 2 on the plaque borders, pyramid studs and connectors.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Gladiator_02.description: A short chain of chunky octagonal links alternating large and small, draped in a shallow curve across the front of the hips as a decorative belt accessory. Rough, industrial and gladiator-like in style.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the chain links; the metal ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Grenade_01.description: A small pineapple-style hand grenade hanging at the left hip, with a deeply segmented rounded body, a narrow neck, and a curved safety lever running down one side from a fuse cap. Suits military and tactical looks.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Grenade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented grenade body; colour 1 on the fuse cap and safety lever; colour 2 on the neck between body and cap.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Handcuffs_01.description: A pair of metal handcuffs hanging from a short flat belt strap on the left hip. The cuffs are two stacked rings with a small linked chain at the bottom; a police and tactical accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Handcuffs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rings and bodies; colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 on the hanging strap; colour 3 on the small round stud on the strap.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lion_01.description: A pentagonal belt-buckle plate with a sculpted lion head in relief, framed by a segmented raised border, with a square loop on each side for attaching a cape or belt. Sits at the front of the waist.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head; colour 1 on the pentagonal frame and back plate; colour 2 on the side loops; colour 3 on the lion's eyes.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_01.description: A wide sash belt wrapped around the waist and tied in a knot at the left hip, with a long single tail hanging to the upper thigh and ending in an ornate pointed filigree pendant set with a gem.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the sash and hanging tail; colour 0 on the metal pendant and the sash's inner lining; colour 3 on the gem in the pendant.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_02.description: A slim, plain belt band that wraps once around the waist at a slight tilt, with a contrasting inner edge and trim along both borders, and a small angular metal buckle at the front.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main belt band; colour 0 on the edge trim, inner lining and buckle.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_03.description: A small hanging belt charm: a spiky, winged metal crest with a central gem, a decorative knotted cord and bead, and a dangling faceted orb in a claw-like cage. It hangs at the left hip.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_65_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and cage metalwork; colour 3 on the crest gem, bead and orb; colour 1 on the knotted cord and link; colour 2 on the darker crest edges.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_66_02.description: A small angular armour plate hanging at the front of the hips like a short tapered tabard, with a chunky faceted cap at the top, layered side panels and recessed slot details. Flat and open at the back.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted top cap; colour 1 on the main front plate; colour 2 on the side panels and recessed slot details.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A round belt medallion worn at the left hip: a thick ringed frame with segmented outer plates, small round studs and contrasting inset panels around a domed centre boss. It sits flat against the body like a mechanical buckle.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper ring of the frame; colour 0 on the lower segmented plates and the back; colour 2 on the inset panels and small studs; colour 3 on the domed centre.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Modern_Sapphire_02.description: A hanging belt strap accessory on the left hip: a flat strap with a forked pair of hooks at the top, a chunky buckle clip in the middle, and a lower tab with a rivet and a D-ring at the end.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Modern_Sapphire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and tab; colour 1 on the hooks, buckle clip and D-ring; colour 3 on the rivet.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_01.description: A pair of padded rectangular pouches sitting on the left hip: a larger front pouch with a flap, a small contrasting stud and a star-like swirl motif, and a second slimmer pouch behind it with a pointed strap tab.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 1 on the swirl motif on the front flap and the pointed tab on the rear pouch; colour 2 on the small stud.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_02.description: A small belt accessory on the left hip: a soft flap pouch with a strap-and-clasp closure, tucked behind a cluster of three upright cylindrical canisters with banded caps and pointed bottoms. Suggests a tactical or gothic utility look.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and the bands around the canisters; colour 1 on the pouch's strap closure; colour 3 on the canister bodies and caps.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Nightmare_Goth_02.differs: The canisters sit tight against the front of the pouch and overlap it, rather than standing apart.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Ornament_01.description: A round belt ornament showing a sculpted snarling guardian-lion face in relief, set in a thick rim with flame-like fins curling up from the top edge. It sits at the front of the waist, with a flat plain back.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Ornament_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the rim and the back plate; colour 1 on the flame-like fins.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A small rectangular armor plate with clipped corners and a dented, hammered surface, studded with four large cone spikes pushing out through holes. It hangs at the front of the hip from the belt, with a flat smooth back.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate; colour 3 on the four spikes.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A pair of draped chain loops hanging from two ring attachments at the left hip, swagging in curves from front to back across the hip and thigh. Gives a punk, rebellious belt-chain look.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the metal ring attachments; colour 3 on the chain links, with colour 0 showing on some link highlights.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Skull_01.description: A belt-buckle ornament: a chunky skull with a single pointed horn on its brow, set in a curved winged plate with upswept pointed edges and small cutouts. It sits at the front of the hips.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the winged backing plate; colour 3 on the horn.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Tubes_01.description: A belt accessory on the left hip: a small curved plate mounted at the waist with a segmented flexible tube that bends up and outward, banded with joints and ending in a blunt capped tip. Sci-fi mechanical styling.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Renegade_Tubes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mounting plate; colour 3 on the tube sections; colour 2 on the tube joints and bends; colour 0 on the tube end cap and the collar near the plate.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Satchel_01.description: A padded rectangular satchel worn at the left hip, with a top carry handle, zippered end pockets and broad hook-and-loop straps across the sides. It has a soft, tactical utility look with a camouflage-like pattern.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Satchel_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the satchel; colour 0 on the mottled patches, handle and pocket edges; colour 2 on the wide straps and side panels; colour 3 on the zipper pulls and stitched accents.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Satchel_02.description: A boxy tactical satchel worn at the left hip, with a top carry handle, a webbing panel and vertical straps on the front, and a smaller side pouch with a zipper. Padded, utilitarian and military in style.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Satchel_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the satchel; colour 0 on the camouflage patches, handle and trim edges; colour 2 on the webbing panel and straps; colour 3 on the zipper and buckle tabs.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Satchel_Alt_02.description: A boxy tactical satchel worn at the left hip, with a top carry handle, a front webbing panel, vertical straps with buckles, stitched seams and a smaller side pouch. Patterned fabric body suggests military utility gear.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Satchel_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle, base panel and camouflage patches; colour 1 on the main fabric body; colour 2 on the webbing straps and front panel; colour 3 on the stitching and strap buckle tabs.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Scissors_01.description: A small pair of scissors hanging point-down at the left hip, with two rounded loop handles over slim tapering metal blades joined by a central pivot screw. A quirky, practical belt accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Scissors_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two handle loops; the blades and pivot are unaffected by the scheme and show as bare metal.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Skulls_01.description: A pair of sculpted skull ornaments hanging at the left hip: a small human-like skull beside a larger elongated, monstrous skull with a snout and tusk-like teeth. Suggests a gruesome trophy charm.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Skulls_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both skulls; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Swing_01.description: A hip-mounted gear pack: a padded, ribbed rectangular pouch with a circular cross emblem on its face, held to a rounded backing plate by two bands, plus a small separate gadget pouch with a gear badge beside it.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and ribbed padding; colour 2 on the backing plate and the two bands; colour 1 on the cross emblem and the gear badge.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Swing_01.differs: The male version's backing plate is a shorter, more rounded shield that hangs a little further out from the hip, with the small gadget pouch sitting lower on the front.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Swing_02.description: A small boxy pouch hung at the left hip from two thin straps over the belt line. It has a flap front with a raised looping outline and a small stud, and a ribbed end panel.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flap and body of the pouch; colour 1 on the raised outline, edge framing and stud; colour 3 on the ribbed end panel; colour 2 on the straps.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tattered_01.description: A small belt ornament: a faceted jack-o'-lantern skull face with glaring eyes and a jagged grin sits at the front of the waist, flanked by two pointed, bat-wing-like tattered cape flaps sweeping out to the hips and around the back.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted skull face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the pointed wing flaps; colour 2 on the small backing plate behind.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A rigid, dagger-shaped hanging panel with a pointed tip and a stepped, angular top, held at the left hip by a horned crescent bracket with outward-curving spikes. Framed by raised outlines, it suggests a fantasy or monstrous style.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horned crescent bracket; colour 1 on the main panel surface; colour 2 on the raised outlines and ribs of the panel.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A horned animal skull worn as a belt ornament at the front of the hips, with a tapering snout pointing down and two thick curved horns sweeping out to each side. Bone-like, monstrous and tribal.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the eye sockets; colour 3 on the horn bases; colour 2 on the horns.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_01.description: A pair of heavy chain loops hanging from the left hip, each anchored by a small skull ornament at the belt line, with the chains draping down the thigh in a long tail. Gothic accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 0 on the skulls; colour 3 on the skull eyes.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_02.description: A small sculpted skull ornament worn at the left hip on the belt, with hollow glowing eye sockets, a cracked cranium and a flat plain backing plate. A gothic, macabre belt charm.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull bone; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 1 on the flat back plate.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A small oni demon mask worn as a hip ornament on the left side of the belt: a sculpted skull-like face with two curved horns, narrow glaring eyes, fang-like spikes and a flat backing plate against the body.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face and backing plate; colour 1 on the horns and the small spikes beside the face; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A small angular belt ornament: a hollow, downward-pointing triangular frame with a bevelled front edge, worn flat at the front of the hips as a buckle-like emblem. Sleek, mechanical and superhero in feel.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the frame; colour 2 on the back and outer edges. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A small rectangular satchel pouch with a folded flap hanging at the left hip, held by a narrow strap that runs up to a rectangular buckle loop at the belt line, with a ring fastener on the strap.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the thin trim under the flap; colour 2 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle loop and ring fastener.
