Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A small flat rectangular pouch with a rounded folded flap, hanging at the left hip. A vertical strap with a ring buckle runs down the front, with a contrasting band under the flap and a pointed strap tail.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the band beneath the flap; colour 2 on the vertical strap; colour 3 on the ring buckle.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Quiver_01.description: A slim cylindrical quiver hung at the left hip, angled backward, holding a bundle of fletched arrows at the top. A thin strap loops up to a small buckle tab at the belt line.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver body ends and arrow shafts; colour 1 on the quiver sides and arrow fletching; colour 3 on the square patch on the quiver; colour 2 on the strap and belt tab.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Spellbook_01.description: A small hanging spellbook worn at the left hip, hung from a thin buckled strap that rises toward the waist. It has a thick hardcover with a circular sigil on the cover, a contrasting spine band and lashed cord details.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Spellbook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and cover; colour 1 on the circular sigil and cover markings; colour 2 on the spine band and page block; colour 3 on the cord lashings and strap buckles.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Spellbook_02.description: A small hardcover spellbook hanging at the left hip from two upright belt straps with buckles. The cover has a bordered frame and a circular arcane sigil, with clasps on the edge and contrasting page block and spine.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Spellbook_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the book cover and spine; colour 3 on the page block and the border pattern on the cover; colour 0 on the sigil, clasps and corner fittings; colour 2 on the straps.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Spellbook_03.description: A rolled scroll with contrasting end caps and swirling patterned wrapping, hanging at the left hip from a looped cord that ties in a knot at the top. A small, dangling belt accessory with a fantasy scholar look.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Spellbook_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scroll paper; colour 1 on the swirling pattern; colour 2 on the end rollers and caps; colour 3 on the hanging cord and knots.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A small pair of stacked boxy pouches worn on the left hip, each with a flap lid edged in contrasting trim and fastened by a round stud. Compact, tactical utility look.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 2 on the edge trim around the flaps; colour 3 on the round studs.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_02.description: A small pair of stacked rectangular box pouches worn at the left hip, each with a flap and a round stud fastener. The chunky, boxy shape suggests a utility or tactical belt accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 2 on the edge trim and frames around the flaps; colour 3 on the round studs.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_03.description: A small pair of boxy stacked pouches on the left hip, each a two-tier block with a contrasting-edged flap and a round stud fastener. Small blocks sit near the front and back of the hip, giving a tactical utility look.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Strapped_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the flap edges and trim; colour 3 on the round fasteners.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: A pair of small boxy utility pouches with flap lids, each closed by a round stud and a contrasting tongue panel, worn side by side on the left hip. Padded, rounded edges give a practical superhero look.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 1 on the tongue panel of each flap; colour 3 on the round stud closures.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_01.differs: The two pouches are set closer to the front of the hip, overlapping one another, with both flaps facing forward.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_02.description: A small rectangular utility pouch worn at the left hip, with a deep body and a fold-over flap across the top. Boxy and slightly tapered, it sits flat against the thigh side in a practical vigilante style.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body; colour 1 on the top flap and the side and back panel.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_03.description: A pair of small rectangular ammo-style pouches with flap lids, sitting side by side on the left hip. Boxy fabric bodies with contrasting flaps give a tactical, utilitarian look.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Tight_Vigilante_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 1 on the top flaps.

Male/M_Capebelt_L_Viper_01.description: A chunky snake-head plate worn at the front of the belt line, a shield-like triangle with angular brow ridges, cut-out eyes and a fanged open-mouth recess, with a plain flat back.
Male/M_Capebelt_L_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head plate and rim; colour 1 on the recessed mouth and eye insets.

Male/M_Capebelt_Lockbox_66_01.description: A single narrow hanging cloth panel worn at the front of the hips, ending mid-thigh with a notched, slightly pointed hem. Bold jagged glyph-like markings and a crown motif run down its length, with a curled band along the bottom edge.
Male/M_Capebelt_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel; colour 2 on the outlines and crown-shaped top motif; colour 3 on the zigzag inner markings and diamond; colour 1 on the band along the hem.
Male/M_Capebelt_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The male panel is wider and hangs flatter and stiffer against the body.

Male/M_Capebelt_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A single narrow panel of soft draped cloth hanging from the waist down the front of the thighs to about knee level, with a rounded hem and gentle folds; a loincloth-style tabard with a little gathering at the back.
Male/M_Capebelt_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Anniversary_Destroyer_.description: A slim rectangular belt plate worn at the lower back, with short connector rods on each end holding a round domed disc, like a retro villain's cape clasp. Curves gently around the waist.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Anniversary_Destroyer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back plate face; colour 2 on the plate's front side and edge; colour 3 on the disc rims and connector rods; colour 1 on the domed disc centres.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Astronaut_01.description: A curved flexible hose in a U shape, with a wrinkled fabric sleeve and a rigid collar at each end capped by a rounded nozzle. It hangs at the right hip and suggests an astronaut's life-support tube.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fabric of the hose; colour 1 on the lower fabric of the hose; colour 2 on the collars; colour 3 on the end nozzles.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Birdpeople_01.description: A shield-shaped oval plaque worn at the right hip, with a thick raised rim, a flat face and a winged bird emblem raised at its centre. The outer side is a plain smooth dome.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plaque face; colour 2 on the rim and the domed outer back; colour 3 on the raised bird emblem.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Bounty_01.description: A small rectangular utility pouch worn on the right hip, with a fold-over flap fastened by a round stud, a loop at the top for a belt, and edging around the border. Suits a sci-fi western look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edging and belt loop; colour 3 on the round stud.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Bounty_02.description: A small rectangular utility pouch worn at the right hip, with a fold-over flap, a rounded gem-like stud at its centre and contrasting binding along the edges. It has a loop at the top for a belt.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge binding and top loop; colour 3 on the gem stud; colour 1 on the inner side panel.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Bounty_03.description: A pair of short, chunky cylindrical canisters hanging side by side at the right hip, each with a pinched, ribbed top and bottom and a smooth central band. They suggest cartridges or explosive charges for a space-western look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Bounty_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed top and bottom sections of each canister; colour 2 on the central band; colour 0 on a narrow strip down the back of each canister.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Bounty_03.differs: The male version has a narrow contrasting strip running down the back of each canister, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Bounty_04.description: A row of small cylindrical cartridge or shell-like canisters with flared ends and a central band, hung side by side along the right hip and lower back. Suggests a bandolier-style ammo belt accessory for a sci-fi western look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Bounty_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the canister bodies and flared end caps; colour 2 on the central bands.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A narrow rectangular cloth panel hanging from the right hip to mid-thigh, with a jagged tribal glyph design down its length, a crest-like notched top and a knotted band gathered at the hem.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 2 on the outlines of the glyph design; colour 3 on the zigzag inner markings and central diamond; colour 1 on the knotted band at the bottom.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Child_Modern_Witchcraf.description: A narrow rectangular cloth panel hanging from the right hip down the outer thigh to about the knee, with a tapered pointed hem, a central stripe with angular outlined panels and a lattice-patterned point at the bottom.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Child_Modern_Witchcraf.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central stripe and upper panel; colour 0 on the outer angular border panels and hem edges; colour 2 on the top edge and the thin line details; colour 3 on the lattice point at the hem.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_01.description: A pair of boxy ammunition magazines sitting side by side on the right hip, each with a ribbed lower section and a small pointed round poking out of the top. Tactical, military look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper magazine bodies; colour 0 on the ribbed lower sections; colour 2 on the bullet tips at the top.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_02.description: A soft, padded cloth utility pouch at the right hip with an open top showing a cylindrical canister inside. A wide strap wraps around the front and a clip buckle sits at the side.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the wrapping straps; colour 2 on the canister inside; colour 3 on the buckle.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_02.differs: The male pouch is a softer, squatter cloth pouch with an open top showing a canister, without the contrasting-edged flap of the female version.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_03.description: A small rectangular utility pouch with a padded flap that folds over the front, edged in contrasting trim and closed by a strap with a square buckle. It hangs at the right hip from the belt.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the flap edging; colour 1 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_04.description: A small boxy utility pouch worn at the right hip. It has a fold-over flap with contrasting edging, a strap band wrapped around it with a chunky buckle on the side, and a ribbed rear panel. Tactical look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the strap band and top stripe; colour 2 on the edging around the flap and opening; colour 3 on the buckle.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Combat_Pouch_04.differs: This version has a closed flap outlined with contrasting edging and a narrower, slimmer profile, while the female one has an open cutaway front.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Corrupted_01.description: A small hip-mounted shield-shaped panel with a raised rim, a central ridge holding a pointed gem, and a jagged bat-wing-like cloth flap behind it. Sits on the right hip as a partial belt accessory with a gothic monstrous look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inset panels either side of the ridge; colour 2 on the rim, central ridge and the rear ragged flap; colour 1 on the lower scalloped fabric edge; colour 3 on the gem.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A single hip fin ornament worn on the right hip: a stack of three layered, swept-back fin blades with ridged edges that curve outward and taper to a point behind the hip. Suggests a creature or amphibian look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer fin surfaces and ridged edges; colour 1 on the inner surfaces and the lower fin undersides.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Gladiator_01.description: A belt accessory of three octagonal metal rings joined by small chain links, each ring holding a hanging rounded plate with a bordered edge and diamond studs. Hangs at the hip in a fantasy gladiator style.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and chain links; colour 1 on the hanging plate faces; colour 2 on the plate borders, connectors and studs.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Gladiator_02.description: A short chain of five octagonal metal links, alternating large and small, hanging across the lower back at hip level. It works as a rugged, decorative belt accessory in a gladiator or punk style.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the links; the metal material appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Grenade_01.description: A small hand grenade worn on the right hip: an oval body of chunky segmented pineapple-style blocks, a tapered neck, a flat fuse cap and a long curved safety lever running down one side.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Grenade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented grenade body; colour 2 on the tapered neck; colour 1 on the fuse cap and safety lever.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Handcuffs_01.description: A pair of metal handcuffs hanging from a short strap loop with a small round stud, clipped at the right hip; two chunky cuff rings are joined by a short chain. Suggests police or street gear.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Handcuffs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rings and plates; colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 on the hanging strap; colour 3 on the stud.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lion_01.description: A small pentagonal belt plaque worn at the lower back, with a sculpted lion's head relief framed by a segmented border and two square loops at the sides for attaching to a belt. Suggests a beastly, armored look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head; colour 1 on the segmented border and back plate; colour 3 on the lion's eyes; colour 2 on the side loops.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_01.description: A wide martial-arts sash wrapped around the waist and knotted at the back, with one long tail hanging down the thigh and ending in an ornate pointed metal charm set with a gem.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the sash and its tail; colour 0 on the metal charm and the inner lining of the sash; colour 3 on the gem.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The knot sits at the back of the waist and the tail hangs behind the hip, whereas the female version has the knot at the front.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_02.description: A slim, flat belt band that sits at the waist and tilts slightly around the hips, with a contrasting edge trim and a small anchor-shaped metal buckle at the front. Simple martial-arts styling.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main belt band; colour 0 on the edge trim, inner lining and buckle.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_03.description: A dangling hip charm: an ornate spiked metal crest with a central gem, hanging on a decorative knot and a short bead to a large round gem cradled in a claw-like metal cage. Hangs at the right hip.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_65_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and cage metalwork; colour 1 on the knot cord and chain; colour 3 on the gems and bead; colour 2 in the crest's recesses.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_66_02.description: A small angular armored hip plate hanging at the right side of the belt: a wedge-shaped capped top above a faceted, slightly tapering panel with a shallow notched lower edge. Sits over the hip and buttock.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cap and the outer face of the plate; colour 1 on the inner, rear-facing panel and edge.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A small round mechanical belt medallion: a thick segmented ring with a domed centre boss, small side studs and a notched lower plate. It sits on the right hip as a sci-fi buckle accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer ring; colour 0 on the segmented rim plates and back face; colour 3 on the domed centre; colour 2 on the small studs and lower recess.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Modern_Sapphire_02.description: A narrow hanging strap accessory for the right hip: twin hook prongs at the top clip over the waist, then a strap with a buckle block, a short lower tab with a rivet and a small D-ring at the end.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Modern_Sapphire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and lower tab; colour 1 on the hooks, buckle block and D-ring; colour 3 on the rivet.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Nightmare_Goth_01.description: A pair of boxy, padded pouches on the right hip, one larger in front and one smaller behind, each with a flap closure, a swirling diamond-shaped line motif, a small stud and a narrow tab.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Nightmare_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 1 on the diamond line motif and the narrow tabs; colour 2 on the small central stud.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Nightmare_Goth_02.description: A belt accessory for the right hip: a flat flap-closed pouch with a strap fastening, beside a cluster of three short pointed cylindrical canisters bound with banded rings. It sits at the hip and suggests a grim, utilitarian look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Nightmare_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and the bands around the canisters; colour 1 on the pouch's central fastening strap; colour 3 on the canister bodies.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Ornament_01.description: A round ornamental medallion worn at the small of the back: a carved guardian-lion face with fangs and glaring eyes, set in a thick rim topped by a crest of flame-like spiked fronds. Its flat plain back faces the body.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Ornament_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the carved lion face; colour 1 on the crest of fronds; colour 2 on the rim and the flat backing; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A small rounded-rectangular armor plate with clipped corners, worn on the lower back at the hip. Four large conical spikes jut from recessed sockets on its outer face, giving a brutal, monstrous sci-fi look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate; colour 3 on the four spikes.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Armor_01.differs: The male plate is slightly larger and flatter, with a thinner rim.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A pair of draped chain strands hanging in loose swags from large ring clips at the right hip, curving around from the front of the hip toward the back. Edgy punk or space-outlaw belt accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chain links; colour 1 on the ring clips at the hip; colour 0 on small highlights within the links.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Skull_01.description: A small belt ornament: a skull with a tall contrasting-tipped central spike sits on a curved, horned plate with swept-up side points and two cut-out holes, worn at the lower back near the hip.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and the domed cap; colour 1 on the horned backing plate; colour 3 on the central spike.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Tubes_01.description: A small mechanical belt accessory: a curved plate sits at the right hip, with a segmented flexible tube rising from it, bending at a joint and ending in a small hexagonal cap. Suits sci-fi or cyberpunk outfits.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Renegade_Tubes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hip plate; colour 3 on the tube segments; colour 2 on the tube joints; colour 0 on the tube end cap and the collar where the tube meets the plate.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Satchel_01.description: A small padded duffel-style satchel hanging at the right hip, with a top carry handle, zippered end pockets and contrasting webbing straps with loops across the sides. Camouflage-patterned, tactical utility look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Satchel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the camouflage-patterned padded body and handle; colour 2 on the webbing straps; colour 3 on the zipper lines.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Satchel_02.description: A padded, boxy duffel-style satchel worn at the right hip, with a top carry handle, vertical webbing straps with buckles, a zippered front pocket and a wide back panel of horizontal loops. Tactical, utilitarian look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Satchel_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the camouflage body of the satchel; colour 0 on the lighter camouflage patches, top handle and back panel; colour 2 on the webbing straps and loops; colour 3 on the zipper stitching.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Satchel_Alt_02.description: A small padded duffel-style satchel worn at the right hip: a boxy rounded pouch with a top carry handle, vertical straps, zip-line seams, a side pocket and a hook-and-loop panel on the back. Casual tactical look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Satchel_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the camouflage patches, handle and underside; colour 1 on the main camouflage body; colour 2 on the straps and back panel; colour 3 on the zipper seams and stitching.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Scissors_01.description: A small pair of scissors hanging point-down at the right hip: two rounded loop handles above a pair of narrow, tapering metal blades joined by a pivot screw. A quirky, practical belt accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Scissors_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the loop handles; the blades and pivot are unaffected metal that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Swing_01.description: A hip-mounted equipment pack on the right side: a padded rectangular pouch with a circular crosshair emblem and two straps, on a flat backing plate that hangs down the thigh, plus a small separate flap pouch beside it.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded pouch bodies and the small flap pouch; colour 2 on the straps and edging of the backing plate; colour 1 on the circular emblem and the small round badge.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Swing_02.description: A small boxy hip pouch or case hanging at the right hip from two thin straps that rise to the belt line. It has a framed lid with looping decorative scrollwork, a small stud clasp and a ribbed end panel.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box body and lid; colour 1 on the frame, scrollwork and clasp stud; colour 3 on the ribbed end panel; colour 2 on the straps.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tattered_01.description: A small back-of-waist ornament: a grinning angular skull mask with glaring eyes sits at the centre, flanked by two sharp bat-wing-like tattered points that sweep up and out. Sits low on the lower back, with a monstrous Halloween feel.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the mouth and teeth recesses; colour 1 on the wing-shaped cloth points.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A narrow, dagger-shaped hanging panel with a bordered, cracked-looking face, worn at the lower back below the waist. A curved horn-like crescent with upswept tips sits across the top. Monstrous, mechanical fantasy look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved horn crescent at the top; colour 1 on the main panel face; colour 2 on the panel border and edging.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A horned animal skull worn at the belt line, with a textured bone-like face tapering to a point and two thick curled horns sweeping outward, each with a contrasting band at its base. Sits low on the hips as a monstrous belt ornament.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 2 on the horns; colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases; colour 1 on the eye sockets.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Goth_01.description: A pair of heavy chain loops hanging from the right hip, each anchored by a small skull ornament at the belt and draping down the thigh to about knee level. Gothic, punk-style belt accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 0 on the skulls; colour 3 on the skull eyes; colour 2 on the small belt mount tabs.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Goth_02.description: A small sculpted skull ornament worn at the right hip on the belt, with hollow glowing-looking eye sockets and a toothed jaw; its flat backing plate faces the body. A gothic, macabre accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 1 on the flat backing plate.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A small oni demon mask worn as a hip ornament on the right side: a sculpted angular face with two long curved horns, narrow glaring eyes, small fangs, and a flat backing plate that sits against the hip.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face and backing; colour 1 on the horns and fangs; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A small flat triangular frame ornament with a hollow centre and bevelled edges, worn at the lower back of the belt line as a tiny emblem-like accent. Sleek and minimal, suited to superhero looks.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole frame, seen as a front face; the back face shows a glossy metallic sheen that ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Phantom_01.differs: The male frame is a broader, more even triangle that sits flatter against the body.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A small rounded satchel-style pouch with a folded flap, hanging at the right hip from a narrow strap that loops through a square ring hanger at the top; a circular ring buckle sits on the strap.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the trim under the flap; colour 2 on the hanging strap; colour 3 on the square hanger and the round buckle ring.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A small boxy pouch with a folded-over flap, worn on the right hip. A narrow strap with a large octagonal ring runs down the outer face of the flap. Suggests a pirate-style belt satchel.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the small trim strip under the flap edge; colour 2 on the strap; colour 3 on the ring.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Quiver_01.description: A slim cylindrical arrow quiver hanging at the right hip, tilted slightly, with a banded body, open top holding fletched arrows, and a thin strap loop on a small mount at the belt line. Practical archer look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quiver base and arrow shafts; colour 1 on the main quiver body and fletching; colour 3 on the band around the middle; colour 2 on the strap and belt mount.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Spellbook_01.description: A small spellbook hanging at the right hip on two thin straps that rise to the waist. It has a thick rectangular cover with a circular rune emblem, a rune-marked band, contrasting spine bindings and pages visible on the edge.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Spellbook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cover, pages and straps; colour 1 on the circular rune emblem and rune markings; colour 2 on the spine and binding bands; colour 3 on the strap fasteners and stitching.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Spellbook_02.description: A small hardcover spellbook hanging at the right hip from two upright straps with buckles, carrying a circular arcane sigil and ornate patterned border on the cover, with visible page edges and metal corner fittings.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Spellbook_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the book cover and back; colour 0 on the sigil, corner fittings and buckles; colour 3 on the page block and cover border; colour 2 on the straps and small clasp bands.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Spellbook_03.description: A small rolled scroll hanging at the right hip from a looped cord, with contrasting end caps and swirling patterned paper wrapped around a rod, tied with a knotted cord. A fantasy mage accessory.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Spellbook_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scroll paper; colour 1 on the swirl pattern; colour 2 on the rod end caps; colour 3 on the hanging cord and ties.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A pair of small boxy pouches stacked vertically on the right hip, each with a flat lid framed by a raised border and a round stud clasp at the front. Sits at the belt line, with a utilitarian look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the raised borders around the lids; colour 3 on the round clasp studs.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_02.description: A small belt pouch made of two stacked rectangular boxes with contrasting edging, each closed by a flap with a round stud. It sits on the right hip at the lower back, with a boxy, tactical look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box tops and sides; colour 1 on the flap panels; colour 2 on the edging and trim; colour 3 on the round studs.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_03.description: A small pair of stacked boxy pouches with drawer-like fronts and small round studs, mounted on the right hip at belt level. Compact, angular and mechanical in feel, with contrasting edge trim.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Strapped_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the edge trim and borders; colour 3 on the round studs.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: A pair of small boxy utility pouches stacked at the right hip, each with a buttoned flap and a contrasting tongue strip down the front. Padded, squared cloth construction suggests a practical vigilante look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies and flaps; colour 1 on the flap tongue strips; colour 3 on the button studs.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_02.description: A small rectangular belt pouch worn at the right hip, with a deep folded-over flap covering the top and a soft, slightly creased body below. Simple, practical vigilante styling.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top flap and the back panel; colour 0 on the pouch body and front face.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_03.description: A pair of small boxy pouches sitting side by side on the right hip, each with a folded-over top flap and a tapered body. Simple, practical utility styling for a vigilante or tactical look.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Tight_Vigilante_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 1 on the top flaps.

Male/M_Capebelt_R_Viper_01.description: A small, thick, shield-shaped plate worn at the lower back near the hip, with a snake-head face on its outer side: angry eye slits, a flared hood and fanged mouth cut into the surface.
Male/M_Capebelt_R_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate body and rim; colour 1 on the recessed fang and eye inlays.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Anniversary_Witchc.description: A pair of narrow hanging cloth tabs on one hip, each a long tapered strip with a pointed lower end and contrasting edge trim. They hang thigh-length from the waist as a small asymmetric accent.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Anniversary_Witchc.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main faces of the tabs; colour 0 on the outer backing and edges; colour 3 on the thin edge trim.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_01.description: A single oval faceted gemstone worn as a small belt accessory at the lower back, with a flat underside and a cut-crystal crown of angular facets on the outer face.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the gem body; colour 1 on the large central facet and some edge facets. The glossy gem material largely ignores the other slots.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_02.description: A small faceted diamond-shaped gemstone with a flat rhomboid outline and bevelled facets, worn at the lower back at the belt line as a decorative accent.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the gem body; the glossy facets show a slight sheen and appear to largely ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_03.description: A small square faceted gemstone with bevelled edges and a flat raised centre, mounted on the lower back at the belt line as a belt accessory. Glossy, jewel-like and angular.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: Glossy gem material largely ignores the scheme; the bevelled frame stays while the flat back face takes a hint of colour 1.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone with a flat back and bevelled edges, worn as a belt ornament at the lower back. It has a glossy cut-crystal look and suits fantasy or sci-fi outfits.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 shows on the bevelled facets and the back face of the gem; the rest of the glossy gem does not visibly take the scheme colours.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_05.description: A small faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn flat against the lower back at the belt line, with a rough contrasting front face and a smooth cut-crystal back. It reads as a decorative jewel accent.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme and shows its own material; no clear colour slot is visible.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_06.description: A small teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone with a flat front and a pointed top, worn on the lower back at the belt line as a single decorative accent. The back is cut with an inset teardrop facet.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Back_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front and outer body of the gem; colour 1 on the inset facet on the back. The glossy gem surface shows little of the other slots.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Bigbow_01.description: Two long, narrow hanging cloth panels, like bow ends or tails, that drop from the waist over the hips and upper thighs, with a contrasting curved inset and a cross band on each. Suits a superhero or fantasy belt.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Bigbow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the panels and the small dots near the tips; colour 1 on the curved inset on each panel; colour 2 on the cross band across each panel.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Bigbow_01_Tail.description: Two separate long, narrow cloth streamers hanging side by side from the lower back to about mid-thigh, each with a wide contrasting band across the upper part and a small round dot near the tip. Reads as trailing bow ends.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Bigbow_01_Tail.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each streamer and the small dots; colour 1 on the curved side panels; colour 2 on the wide band across the upper section.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_01.description: A small oval faceted gemstone worn at the front of the belt line, with a flat table on top ringed by angular cut facets and a shallow domed back. Reads as a decorative jewel or clasp.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The glossy gem appears to ignore the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible on it.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted rhombus-shaped gemstone with a bevelled front face, set at the front of the belt line just below the navel as a small decorative belt jewel. Suggests a fantasy or mystic accent.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The gem looks glossy and and seems to ignore the colour scheme, so no slot is clearly visible on it.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_03.description: A small square faceted gem set on the front of the belt line at the hip: a flat-backed block with bevelled edges and a smooth inset face, worn as a belt buckle-style ornament.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows a single glassy finish, with no visible use of colour slots 0-3.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone worn at the front of the belt line, slightly off-centre. It is a deep prism with bevelled top facets and a glossy jewel-like finish, sitting as a belt accent.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; a slight tint from colour 1 shows on one bevelled facet edge.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_04.differs: The male gem is a deeper prism with a plain flat front face and a bright bevel along the top edge.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted gemstone cut into a heart shape, worn as a small belt ornament at the front of the hips. It has angular facets around the top lobes and a glossy, jewel-like finish.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem material ignores the colour scheme and shows its own finish; a hint of colour 1 shows in the notch at the top of the heart.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_05.differs: The male heart has a smoother front with facets only near the top lobes, without the large flat central facet.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_06.description: A small faceted teardrop gemstone worn at the front of the belt line, pointed end up, with a smooth glossy surface split into angled facets. Reads as a decorative belt jewel.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on the upper left facet edge.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Front_Gemstone_06.differs: The male gem is a plain faceted surface with no inset oval panel on the face.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Goth_03.description: A small skull-shaped belt buckle worn at the centre of the waist, with sunken eye sockets and a low-poly sculpted look; its flat back plate is plain and fastens against the body.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Goth_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 1 on the flat back plate.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A small round disc badge worn at the hip, with a raised rim and a recessed ring in the centre. The flat back sits against the body, giving a sci-fi, tech-emblem look.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face of the disc; colour 1 on the outer edge and the inner recessed ring.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Holoforce_02.description: A small flat circular disc worn on the lower back at the belt line, with a bevelled rim and a recessed concentric ring on its outer face. Reads as a glowing tech emblem or energy emitter.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Holoforce_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat inner face and bevelled front edge; colour 1 on the outer rim edge and the recessed ring detail.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_01.description: A short rectangular cloth loincloth panel hanging at the front of the hips, with soft draped folds and a border of zigzag stitched trim; ends around mid-thigh, in an ancient or tribal style.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 1 on the border edging; colour 3 on the zigzag stitching along the border.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_01.differs: The male panel hangs at the centre front of the hips rather than sitting over one thigh.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_02.description: A single narrow tapering cloth panel hanging from the hip down the front of one thigh to about the knee, with a patterned band of contrasting trim along its hem. A simple loincloth-style belt drape.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cloth panel; colour 3 on the patterned hem band.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_03.description: A single narrow cloth panel hanging from the hip down the outer thigh, tapering to a point toward the knee with a contrasting hem band. It hangs loose at the side as a small accent.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Persian_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cloth panel; colour 3 on the hem band; colour 0 on a small patch near the top edge.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Rear_Quiver_01.description: A cylindrical quiver worn horizontally across the lower back, wrapped in a two-tone cover with a contrasting stripe and two flat straps, with a bundle of fletched arrows sticking out of one end.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Rear_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the open end cap and arrow shafts; colour 1 on the main wrap of the quiver; colour 3 on the centre stripe; colour 2 on the two straps and inner panels.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Rear_Quiver_01.differs: The male quiver has a smooth two-tone wrap with a contrasting centre stripe and flat contrasting straps, instead of the stitched contrasting tube with woven bands.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A wide, angular sci-fi utility belt with faceted edges and small slot details, carrying a round front buckle and several boxy pouches and canisters around the hips. Sits low at the waist.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main belt band and pouches; colour 2 on the round buckle and the top panel; colour 1 on the side pouches and canister ends; colour 3 on the small tabs at the edges.

Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_02.description: A wide, flat sci-fi utility belt with an angular faceted band, a large round buckle disc at the front, and several boxy pouches and small cylinder canisters spaced around the hips. Slotted vents run along the side.
Male/M_Capebelt_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and most pouches; colour 2 on the front buckle disc and the top panel; colour 1 on the side pouches and canister bases; colour 3 on the small tabs at the top edge.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Amazon_01.description: A short pteruges-style skirt of hanging rectangular tabs with pointed tips, worn around the hips and upper thighs. Each tab has embroidered vertical lines and scroll motifs, giving a greco-roman warrior look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tab fabric; colour 3 on the vertical lines and scroll patterns; colour 1 on the tab edging and the flower-like tips.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Amazon_02.description: A pair of short hanging cloth panels at the hips, one in front and one behind, each printed with a scrolling swirl motif at the top, a chevron band and curling flame-like scrolls along the hem. Reaches to about mid-thigh.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 1 on the scrolled top motif; colour 2 on the chevron bands; colour 3 on the curling hem scrolls.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Amazon_02.differs: The male panels overlap more closely and sit as a tighter pair, hanging a little lower on the thigh.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundr.description: A short, fitted hip and thigh wrap with a curved waistband and panels down the front and back, side panels, and rows of horizontal straps with small fasteners across each thigh. Sci-fi scoundrel styling.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front and back panels and waistband; colour 1 on the outer side panels; colour 2 on the horizontal straps; colour 3 on the small fasteners.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundr.differs: The male version is a short, fitted thigh wrap with strap rows on the thighs, not a long, flared skirt with an open front.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundr.description: A cloth coat-skirt worn from the hips to about the shin. It has a split front and back, long side panels that flare outward, and stacked ragged contrasting bands with small studs on each leg. It suggests a sci-fi scoundrel look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main coat body; colour 1 on the long side panels; colour 2 on the ragged stacked bands; colour 3 on the small studs and lights.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundr.differs: The male version is a shorter coat-skirt ending near the shin, with side panels that hang closer to the body than the female version.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundr.description: A knee-length coat bottom worn from the hips over the thighs, split at the front and back like a divided skirt, with side panels and three buckled straps across each leg. Suggests a sci-fi scoundrel look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front and back panels; colour 1 on the side panels; colour 2 on the straps; colour 3 on the small studs and fasteners.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Victorian_01.description: Cloth coat tails forming a wide, short skirt panel that wraps the hips and rear, hanging to the upper thighs with a curved hem and an overlapping front flap. Victorian jacket style.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on nearly all of the cloth panel; colour 1 on the inner strip of the front overlapping flap.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Coat_Victorian_01.differs: The male version hangs longer to the upper thighs and wraps around the front hip with an overlapping flap, mostly in colour 0, unlike the shorter rear-only female tails.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Cowboy_Duster_01.description: Long duster coat tails hanging from the lower back to about the ankles, split up the middle into two straight cloth panels; a wider flap shows at the outer front of the thigh. Western-style, worn over the legs.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Cowboy_Duster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth tails, with a slight lighter edge along the outer sides.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Cowboy_Duster_01.differs: The male tails hang as broader, straighter panels, and a wide flap is visible at the front of one leg.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Detective_01.description: A simulated-cloth lower coat skirt hanging from the hips to the knees as a wrap-around tube, open at the front with contrasting vertical edge bands and tiny contrasting accents. It suggests a detective's long coat tails.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth skirt; colour 2 on the vertical edge bands at the front opening; colour 3 on the small accents on the bands.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Firefighter_Jacket.description: A short band-like jacket hem worn around the hips: a loose cloth skirt with vertical pleats, two horizontal stripes near the bottom edge, and a small tab at the front. It reads as the lower part of a firefighter coat.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Firefighter_Jacket.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body; colour 1 on the lower reflective band; colour 2 on the stripe beneath it; colour 3 on the small front tab.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.description: A hip-wrapped cloth skirt-like layer with an asymmetric, angled hem and a slit at front and back. A separate side flap rises at one hip, and contrasting trim outlines the edges. Hangs to mid-thigh with a gothic look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body and side flap; colour 2 on the edge trim along the hem and slits.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.differs: The male version adds a separate short flap at one hip and has a narrower central slit at the front.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Madjester_0.description: A cloth tailcoat-style skirt panel starting at the waist and wrapping the hips, front and back, with long pointed tails reaching the knees and side slits. Suggests a jester or theatrical look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Madjester_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer cloth; colour 1 on the lining visible at the slits and edges.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Madjester_0.differs: The male version wraps around the hips with a visible front panel, while the female version hangs only at the back.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare_G.description: A short flared skirt-like jacket layer that hangs from the waist to mid-thigh, with a split open front and a hem of pointed zigzag tips. Long vertical stripes and diamond motifs give it an ornate gothic look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare_G.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panels; colour 1 on the vertical stripes and hem outlines; colour 2 on the points and diamond centres at the hem.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare_G.differs: The male version has a wider front opening, with one front flap swinging out to the side and the front panel shifted to the other leg.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare_G.description: A flared, knee-length cloth skirt-like layer hanging from the hips, open at the front with a split, with long vertical stripes and a scalloped hem decorated with diamond and fleur-de-lis motifs. Gothic, ornate styling.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare_G.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 1 on the vertical stripes and scalloped hem edging; colour 2 on the fleur-de-lis and diamond hem ornaments.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Modern_Witchcraft_.description: A narrow, straight-hanging panel that drops from the waist to mid-thigh at the centre front and back, with a pointed lattice motif at the hem, layered inset stripes and a squared top. Sleek, techy superhero styling.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Modern_Witchcraft_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central strip and back panel; colour 0 on the outer border bands and hem edges; colour 2 on the top cap and inner stripes; colour 3 on the lattice motif at the hem.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Starowl_01.description: A waist-mounted skirt-like layer of overlapping pointed feather-shaped petals with chevron banding, hanging from the waist to about the knees around the hips and back. Flowing, fantasy-mechanical styling.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad petal surfaces; colour 2 on the chevron bands and petal tips; colour 3 on the thin edge piping.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Steampunk_01.description: A short hip-wrapped cloth skirt panel with an open front and uneven, angled hem, hanging from the waist to the upper thigh. contrasting strap bands with small fittings cross the front and back for a mechanical steampunk look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panel; colour 2 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the strap edging and inner accents; colour 3 on the small buckles and fittings.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Steampunk_01.differs: The male version sits higher on the hips and is shorter, with a straighter hem.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tails_Wide_01.description: A wide, flared coat-tail panel hanging from the waist to about the shin, open at the front with the front edges curling outward, and wrapping around the back, finished with contrasting edge trim. Simulated cloth.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tails_Wide_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 1 on the trim along the hem and side edges.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tails_Wide_01.differs: The male tails have front edges that curl outward and swoop to points at the sides, giving a more sweeping open-front shape.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_01.description: A long cloth trench coat tail hanging from the waist to the calves or ankles, split open at the front and back into two wide panels with a thin contrasting edge trim, giving a loose, flowing skirt-like silhouette.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 1 on the inner lining seen from behind; colour 2 on the thin edge trim.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_Roundpo.description: A cloth tail skirt piece hanging from the waist: a single rounded-point panel that drapes down the back to about knee level, with soft folds and a narrow sliver visible from the side. Suggests a tuxedo or trenchcoat tail.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_Roundpo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole panel; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_Roundpo.description: A single rounded-point cloth panel hanging from the waist over the hips and thighs, like a short tail or apron, with a speckled glittery texture and soft folds that taper to a pointed hem at the knee.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Trenchcoat_Roundpo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel with a glittery speckle; colour 3 appears as flecks in the glitter texture; colours 1 and 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01.description: A long cloth tail-skirt hanging from the waist to the calves, split up the centre front and back into two flowing panels with a slightly flared hem and thin edging. Suggests a formal tuxedo-tail look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole panel and its edging; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01.differs: The male version is a long plain tail reaching the calves, while the female version is a short mid-thigh skirt with a contrasting arch and hem band.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01_Glitte.description: A split tail panel of cloth hanging from the waist to about mid-shin, with a central slit front and back that forms two long flaps. It flares slightly toward the hem and gives a formal tailcoat look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_01_Glitte.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole panel with a speckled glitter texture; other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_01.description: A short tuxedo-style tail panel hanging from the hips over the thighs, with a centre split and flared, rounded hem. Plain smooth cloth that sits mostly at the back and sides, a formal jacket tail.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail panel; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_01_.description: A short cloth tail panel hanging from the lower back over the hips and upper thighs, split by a centre slit into two flared flaps with rounded hems. Suggests a formal tailcoat skirt or jacket tails.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_01_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole panel with a speckled glitter texture; the other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_Rou.description: A short rounded tailcoat flap hanging from the waist over the hips and upper thighs, with soft cloth folds and a rounded point at the bottom. It reads as a formal jacket tail worn alone.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_Rou.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the tail; colour 1 on the inner lining seen from behind.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_Rou.description: A short, rounded coattail panel hanging from the lower back over the hips and rear, ending in a soft rounded point. It is a single flat cloth flap with a speckled glitter texture, giving a formal tuxedo-tail look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_Rou.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail panel, with a speckled glitter texture that shows tiny flecks of other slots; no other distinct features.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_Swa.description: A short swallowtail coat-tail panel hanging from the lower back at the hips, split into two pointed tails that reach the upper thighs. Soft cloth with a formal tuxedo look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_Swa.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail panel; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_Swa.description: A short pair of swallowtail coat tails hanging from the lower back at the hips, split into two pointed panels with a glittery speckled finish. It is a partial formal accessory that ends at the upper thigh.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Short_Swa.colourAreas: The glitter-textured cloth appears to take colour 0 across the tails, with faint speckles of colour 3; colours 1 and 2 are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallowta.description: A pair of formal swallowtail coat tails hanging from a waist band: two long, pointed cloth panels that split at the centre back and drape over the thighs to the knees, worn without a jacket body.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallowta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail panels; no other slots visible.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallowta.differs: The male tails start at the waist with a visible band and hang longer and wider, reaching down towards the knees.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallowta.description: A pair of swallowtail coat tails hanging from the lower back over the hips and thighs, each tapering to a long point with a split between them. The glittery cloth suggests a formal tuxedo style.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Swallowta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glittery tail cloth with speckled flecks of colour 3; colours 1 and 2 are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Torn_01.description: A torn tailcoat skirt that hangs from the waist to about knee height, made of patchwork panels with stitched seams, ragged holes and a frayed hem. It flares slightly and suggests a battered, scavenged look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Torn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper and side panel and the frayed hem; colour 1 on the large middle panel; colour 2 on the lower panel near the hem; colour 3 on the stitching along the seams.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_R.description: A formal tailcoat skirt panel that hangs from the waist at the back with a rounded point, falling to about the knees. Two thin seam lines run down its length, giving a wedding or formal look.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_R.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the tails; colour 1 on the thin seam lines down the panel.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.description: A short formal tailcoat skirt that hangs from the lower back and drapes around the hips as a rounded-point panel, with two thin vertical seam lines; a simulated cloth piece in a wedding or tuxedo style.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 1 on the two thin vertical seam lines.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.description: A short formal tailcoat skirt that hangs from the waist to mid-thigh at the back and sides, split up the centre into two flaps, with thin contrasting vertical seams on each flap. Simulated cloth drapes loosely.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the tails; colour 1 on the thin vertical seam lines on each flap.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.description: A short formal tailcoat skirt that hangs from the lower back over the hips and rear: a curved cloth panel split into three pointed swallowtail tails with thin seam lines. Suits wedding or formal outfits.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the tails; colour 1 on the thin seam lines running down the tails.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.description: A pair of long formal coat tails hanging from the waist to about the calves, split up the centre with a thin seam line down each panel. Flowing cloth drapes over the hips and legs like a wedding tailcoat skirt.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tail panels; colour 1 on the thin seam lines down each panel.

Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.description: A formal swallowtail coat skirt: two long tapering cloth tails hang from the waist down the back and sides to mid-thigh, split down the middle, each with a thin contrasting seam line. Suits wedding or tuxedo looks.
Male/M_Capechestlayer_Tuxtails_Wedding_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tail panels; colour 1 on the thin seam lines down each tail.

Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Birdpeople_01.description: A long, narrow cloth panel hanging from the hips down the front of the thighs to just above the knee, with a rounded hem, soft wrinkles, and a gathered pleated top edge; a similar panel hangs at the back.
Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; the other colour slots are not visible.
Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Birdpeople_01.differs: The male panel is wider with a straighter, rounded hem, and it has a matching panel at the back.

Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Egyptian_01.description: A narrow Egyptian-style loincloth panel of cloth hanging straight from the waist front to mid-thigh, widening at the hips and tapering to an angular pointed hem. It is centred on the front of the body.
Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Egyptian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cloth panel, fading toward colour 2 at the lower hem; colours 0 and 3 not visible.
Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Egyptian_01.differs: The male panel hangs centred at the front and is wider and straighter, rather than sitting off-centre on one hip.

Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Knight_02.description: A narrow front-only loincloth panel hanging from the hips to about mid-thigh, with a rounded lower end and a tribal, spiky lightning-like pattern down the middle. Nothing covers the sides or back.
Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panel; colour 1 on the spiky pattern down the centre.

Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Nephilim_01.description: A small rectangular front loincloth panel hanging from the hips over the groin and upper thighs, with a ragged, torn lower edge, vertical fold lines and a contrasting border. Nothing covers the back.
Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Nephilim_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main cloth panel; colour 1 on the border edging around the panel.

Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Roinesh_01.description: A single narrow panel of simulated cloth hanging from the hips down the front of one thigh to about the knee, with soft folds at the top and a rounded hem. A tribal or monstrous loincloth style.
Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole loincloth panel; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Warrior_02.description: A narrow front loincloth panel hanging from the hips to mid-thigh, patterned with tribal triangle motifs at the edges and a central strip of vertical stripes and a column of diamond emblems. Hangs flat in front only.
Male/M_Capehips_Frontskirt_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel base and the background of the triangle pattern; colour 2 on the triangle pattern; colour 1 on the vertical stripes; colour 3 on the diamond motifs.

Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Anniversary_Iro.description: A short, plain cloth hip skirt panel that hangs from the hips to the upper thigh, with a slightly curved hem, soft folds at the waist and a thin contrasting edge trim. It forms a simple wrap-like half skirt.
Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Anniversary_Iro.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 3 on the trim along the hem and side edge.

Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Brutal_01.description: A partial hip cape of long jagged tapering strips hanging from the hips: a front flap with an angular top plate and narrow spiky tails behind, ending in sharp points around thigh length. Suggests a beastly, tattered look.
Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strips and front plate; colour 2 on the top edge near the waist; colour 3 as a gradient on the strip edges; colour 1 on the tips of the strips.

Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Draped_01.description: A short draped cloth panel hanging from the hips at the back, with soft rippled folds and a wide, flared, uneven hem that ends around the knees. It reads as a loose half-skirt or tail cape.
Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Draped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; the underside picks up a slight tint of colour 1.
Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Draped_01.differs: The male version is wider with a broader flare at the hem, and its folds are more sweeping and rippled.

Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Firebird_01.description: A set of separate pointed, feather-like hip panels hanging around the upper thighs, each a narrow tapering blade with a flared tip, a central oval inset and edging. Fantasy firebird style.
Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each panel; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the oval inset at the centre of each panel.
Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Firebird_01.differs: The male version has longer, narrower blades clustered more at the outer hips and sides, with a few extra thin panels.

Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Lockbox_66_01.description: A calf-length wrap skirt with a wide, plain waistband and a split front, covered in a repeating diamond zigzag pattern. The hem is bound in contrasting trim and falls to uneven points at the sides. It looks tribal and ancient.
Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and the pattern background; colour 1 on the diamond motifs; colour 3 on the zigzag lines; colour 2 on the hem binding.
Male/M_Capehips_Hipscape_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The waistband is taller and more pronounced, and the front opening is a wider overlap that covers more of the legs.

Male/M_Capehips_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A hip-mounted cloth half-skirt or cape hanging at the front and back of the hips to about mid-thigh, with a central patterned panel, contrasting side panels and a curved, uneven hem. It gives a mystic, robed look.
Male/M_Capehips_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer side panels and the cloth body; colour 1 on the central panel with vertical stripes; colour 3 on the woven diamond motif at the hem; colour 2 on the edging lines and trim.
Male/M_Capehips_Modern_Witchcraft_01.differs: The male version is shorter, ending around mid-thigh, with a wider, blunter hem.

Male/M_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_Ann.description: A hip skirt with a gathered hip band, three strapped ball-buttoned bars on the front and side, a lined interior, and a longer asymmetric panel that hangs lower at the back and sides. Military in style, with trim edging.
Male/M_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_Ann.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt panels; colour 1 on the front straps; colour 2 on the round buttons; colour 3 on the trim edging and the inner lining.
Male/M_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_Ann.differs: The male version has a taller, more upright hip band and a longer, squarer rear skirt that hangs straight to the knee, with a slanted side hem.

Male/M_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_Dra.description: A draped hip wrap with a gathered cowl-like fold around the hips and a shorter panel of soft cloth falling to about knee length, with rippled folds and an angled, pointed hem at one side.
Male/M_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_Dra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole draped cloth; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Capehipsmantle_Skirt_Hipscape_Dra.differs: The male version is shorter, ending around the knee, and has a fuller panel with an angled hem rather than a long narrow one.

Male/M_Capemantle_Chestlayer_Broochviper.description: A long draped cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with soft folds and a rolled cloth collar across the neck. Small viper-head brooches fasten it at the front of each shoulder.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestlayer_Broochviper.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and its rolled collar; colour 1 on the two brooches at the shoulders.

Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_90s_Foxbat_0.description: A short waist-length superhero mantle draped over the shoulders and upper back, with a thick padded collar, a large rounded central panel, contrasting side edges and a contrasting underlayer, ending in a scalloped hem.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_90s_Foxbat_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the collar and the large central back panel; colour 1 on the underlayer around the panel; colour 0 on the side edges.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_90s_Foxbat_0.differs: The male mantle has a thick padded collar and broad shoulder coverage, while the female has a small thin neck collar and hangs narrower down the back.

Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Arcane_01.description: A pair of upswept, pointed mantle fins with thin contrasting edging around the neck and shoulders, from which a long, loose cape drapes down the back to below the knees, flaring wider at the hem.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and inner fin panels; colour 1 on the thin edge trim around the fins.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Arcane_01.differs: The male version adds a long draped cape hanging from the shoulder fins, while the female version has only the two fins.

Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Basic_01.description: A long cloth cape with a small draped collar gathered at the neck and shoulders, falling in soft folds down the back to about ankle level. A simple, plain superhero style cape.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape and collar; the cloth takes the scheme with no separate trim visible.

Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_01.description: A draped cloth mantle with a rolled cowl collar wrapped around the neck and shoulders, falling in loose folds as a wide cape down the back to about the knees or calves. Suggests a classical, heroic look.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle including the collar and drape; a small patch of colour 2 shows inside the neck opening.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_01.differs: The male mantle is somewhat shorter and hangs wider and fuller from the shoulders, ending near the knees.

Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_02.description: A draped cloth mantle with a thick cowl-like collar around the neck and shoulders, fastened by a small round brooch at one side, falling in broad loose folds to about the knees behind the body.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mantle cloth and collar; colour 1 on the brooch.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Spartan_02.differs: The male mantle is a wider, shorter drape ending around the knees, with a fuller cowl collar.

Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Tech_01.description: A pair of mechanical shoulder mantles with vented ends sit over the shoulders and neck, with a long, loose, draped cape hanging from them down to about the calves.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and the main shell of the mantles; colour 1 on the edge trim along the mantles; colour 3 on the inner underside panels; colour 2 on the vent grilles.
Male/M_Capemantle_Chestwear_Tech_01.differs: The male version adds a long draped cape hanging from the shoulder mantles down the back, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Capemantle_Extra_Retro_Destroyer_.description: Two small octagonal disc badges floating at the front of each shoulder, each a shallow dish with a raised rim and a shiny domed centre; a retro sci-fi mantle accent with no cape or fabric attached.
Male/M_Capemantle_Extra_Retro_Destroyer_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the octagonal rims and backs of the discs; the domed centres are glossy metal and ignore the colour scheme.
Male/M_Capemantle_Extra_Retro_Destroyer_.differs: The male discs sit lower on the chest-shoulder line and face more directly forward.

Male/M_Capemantle_Extra_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A pair of shoulder harnesses made of flat double straps that arch over each shoulder from a round metal disc at the front and sweep long down the upper back in a V shape. Open and partial, mechanical superhero style.
Male/M_Capemantle_Extra_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the strap faces; colour 1 on the strap edging; colour 0 on the round discs.
Male/M_Capemantle_Extra_Tight_Wizards_01.differs: The male straps are longer and cross the chest and back in a broader V, reaching further down the torso.

Male/M_Capemantle_Fantasy_01.description: A back-worn mantle with a plain hanging cloth cape to about mid-calf and a feathered collar at the neck. Long feather plumes with eye-spot tips splay outward from the shoulders and back like peacock-feather wings.
Male/M_Capemantle_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth and the feather collar; colour 1 on the feather plume shafts and barbs; colour 3 on the eye-spot tips and the outer feather vanes; colour 2 on the darker feather edges.

Male/M_Capemantle_Fantasy_03.description: A long cloth cape with a shaggy fur mantle around the shoulders and neck, draping in soft folds down the back to about ankle length. Fantasy styling, with the fur collar wrapping over the shoulders.
Male/M_Capemantle_Fantasy_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth and the base of the fur; colour 1 on the tips of the fur tufts along the mantle.

Male/M_Capemantle_Jacket_01.description: A plain cloth mantle-cape hanging from a small padded collar at the shoulders, falling in soft draped folds to about the calves; it sits behind the body and hangs loose and straight.
Male/M_Capemantle_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body; colour 1 on the inner lining and collar edge.

Male/M_Capemantle_Jacket_Brooch_01.description: A knee-length draped cloth mantle that hangs from the shoulders down the back, with soft folds at the top and a rolled collar band. Small round brooches fasten it at each shoulder, giving a heroic, formal look.
Male/M_Capemantle_Jacket_Brooch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloak and collar band; colour 1 on the brooch rims; colour 2 on the brooch centres.

Male/M_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_01.description: A draped cloth mantle with a thick rolled cowl collar over the neck and shoulders and a long cape falling in loose folds to about the knees, hanging behind the body with a gathered drape over one side at the front.
Male/M_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle, collar and cape; a small opening at the front of the collar takes no clear slot.
Male/M_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_01.differs: The male mantle drapes over the shoulders and hangs mainly at the back and side, with a shorter, less prominent front panel.

Male/M_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_02.description: A long cloth mantle cape draped over the shoulders with a wide rolled collar and a round brooch at one shoulder; the fabric hangs in soft folds down the back and ends around the ankles.
Male/M_Capemantle_Jacket_Spartan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and collar cloth; colour 1 on the brooch.

Male/M_Capemantle_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A long, flowing hooded mantle draped over one shoulder and hanging in heavy soft folds down the back to about the calves, with a bunched cowl collar at the neck. Suggests a modern superhero cloak.
Male/M_Capemantle_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle including the cowl collar.
Male/M_Capemantle_Modern_Destroyer_01.differs: The male version is a single colour throughout, while the female version fades to a contrasting colour towards the hem.

Male/M_Capemantle_Moth_01.description: A back mantle of two long, translucent insect-like wings hanging from a sculpted, horn-eared shoulder crest at the upper back. The veined wings drop to about the knees and end in banded tips, giving a moth-like fantasy look.
Male/M_Capemantle_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper crest and the fade at the wing tops; colour 0 on the main wing membranes; colour 1 on the wing tips and vein lines; colour 2 on the tip banding and the crest's inner details.
Male/M_Capemantle_Moth_01.differs: The wings are longer and wider, hanging past the hips, with a broader crest across the shoulders.

Male/M_Capemantle_Redstone_01.description: A loosely wrapped cloth scarf gathered in soft folds into a thick loop around the neck and shoulders, with stripes on the folds. Casual, draped look sitting at the collar.
Male/M_Capemantle_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main scarf cloth; colour 1 on the stripes along the wrapped folds.
Male/M_Capemantle_Redstone_01.differs: The male version is only a neck loop with no long tail hanging down the back.

Male/M_Capemantle_Super_Retro_Destroyer_.description: A long superhero cape with a draped hood-like mantle collar around the neck and shoulders, hanging in a loose sheet of soft folds to about the calves.
Male/M_Capemantle_Super_Retro_Destroyer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape body and the outer mantle collar; colour 1 on the inner collar lining.
Male/M_Capemantle_Super_Retro_Destroyer_.differs: The male cape has deep draped folds and stays mostly one colour, with colour 1 only on the collar lining, rather than fading into colour 1 at the hem.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tattered_01.description: A long cloth mantle with a thick draped cowl collar around the neck and shoulders, and a loose cape falling to the calves with a ragged hem. A small fastening clasp sits at the upper chest.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tattered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle and cape; colour 3 and colour 1 on the small clasp details at the chest; colour 2 on a small part of the clasp.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tattered_01.differs: The male mantle is a single colour throughout, without the fade to a second colour at the hem seen on the female version.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A knee-length cloth mantle hanging from the shoulders, with a draped cowl fold at the neck, small mechanical clasp discs at the collar, and a zigzag jagged hem. A bold arrowhead-shaped panel pattern runs down the back.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body; colour 1 on the edge trim along the sides and hem; colour 2 on the central arrowhead shapes; colour 3 on the inner arrowhead panels; clasp discs at the collar are mixed and metallic.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Brooch_01.description: A long draped cloth cape hanging from the shoulders to about the knees, with soft vertical folds, a contrasting inner collar lining, and two round brooch discs fastening it at the front of the shoulders.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Brooch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape cloth; colour 2 on the inner collar lining and brooch centres; colour 1 on the brooch rims.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Brooch_01.differs: The male version is a full-length cape falling to the knees, rather than just a short shoulder mantle.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Broochviper_01.description: A knee-length draped cloth mantle hanging from the shoulders down the back, with soft folds and a gathered cowl-like collar. Small brooch-like clasps sit on the shoulders. Gives a classic superhero cape look.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Broochviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the mantle; colour 1 on the shoulder clasps; colour 2 on the inner collar fold.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cloak_02.description: A cloth mantle draped over the shoulders and upper chest, with soft gathered folds, a contrasting patterned hem band and a tulip-shaped clasp at the chest, plus a long cape hanging loosely down the back to the calves.
