Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cloak_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the mantle and cape; colour 1 on the hem band and the inner side of the clasp; colour 3 on the clasp petals; colour 2 on the hem pattern details.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cloak_02.differs: The male version adds a long cape that hangs from the mantle down the back to about calf length.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cloak_04.description: A long, draped cloth mantle that wraps over the shoulders in a soft cowl-like collar with a thin contrasting edge, then hangs in loose folds to about the shins, covering the back and falling open at the front.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cloak_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the mantle and cowl; colour 1 on the thin trim along the collar edge.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_01.description: A long draped cape with a gathered cowl-like collar over the shoulders, falling in soft vertical folds down the back to about the knees or calves. It has a striped inner lining visible at the neck.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and collar cloth; colour 2 on the inner lining at the neck.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_01.differs: The male version continues into a full-length cape hanging to about the knees, rather than stopping as a short shoulder collar.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_Foxbat_Clas.description: A short back mantle with a high standing cowl collar and a cropped rectangular panel over the upper back with a wide contrasting lower band. A draped strap crosses one shoulder to the front. Superhero style.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_Foxbat_Clas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared edges of the back panel and the shoulder drape; colour 1 on the cowl and the upper back panel; colour 2 on the wide lower band and the shoulder strap; colour 3 on the patch at the front of the cowl.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Cowl_Foxbat_Clas.differs: The male mantle drapes over the shoulders with a strap crossing one shoulder to the chest, while the female one stays at the neck and back.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Fantasy_01.description: A back mantle of long, curling feather-like plumes fanning out from the shoulders like spider legs, each ending in an eye-spotted tip, with a fluffy feathered collar and a long cloth cape hanging down the back.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar tufts, feather edging and the hanging cape; colour 1 on the inner plume blades; colour 3 on the outer plumes and eye-spot tips; colour 2 on the darker feather shading and eye centres.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Fantasy_01.differs: The male version adds a long plain cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back between the plumes.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Ice_01.description: A cape-like mantle of jagged, shard-like crystal plates: a spiky starburst collar at the neck and shoulders, with two long split panels down the back that end in ragged, icicle-like points around knee to calf length.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Ice_01.colourAreas: Glossy, mostly ignores the scheme; the shards show a metallic sheen, with colour 1 faintly visible in the recessed back panels.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Luchador_01.description: A long draped mantle cape that hangs from a shoulder wrap down to about the shins, with soft vertical folds at the front and back. It sits over one shoulder and chest and suggests a heroic wrestler style.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Luchador_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle and cape; small trim details at the shoulder edge take colour 2.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Luchador_01.differs: The male version has a plain draped shoulder wrap over the chest, without the sculpted cup shapes and round cut-outs of the female version.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A superhero mantle cape with a soft draped collar, a contrasting bird-shaped yoke across the shoulders and upper back, and a long layered cape of jagged, pointed tails falling to about the knees.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and the lower cape tails; colour 2 on the shoulder yoke and its bird shape; colour 1 on the cape's inner edge trim.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Nighthawk_01.differs: The male version's yoke is larger and drapes over the shoulders to the front, with a fuller cape and longer tails.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Pleated_01.description: A feathered mantle of layered wing-like plumes draping from a wide raised collar over the shoulders down the back to hip length, with jagged pleated tips and long outer feathers sweeping outward.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Pleated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower feathers and collar highlights; colour 1 on the long outer feathers and collar stripe; colour 2 on the middle feather layer and collar edge; colour 3 on the upper shoulder feathers.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Pleated_01.differs: The male mantle spreads wider across the shoulders, with a broad rounded collar and outer feathers flaring further outward.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Poncho_01.description: A poncho-style mantle: a thick draped cowl of cloth wraps the neck and shoulders, with a shorter pointed shield-like panel hanging over the back and chest, marked with vertical stripes. Reaches about the hips.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Poncho_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl and the main panel; colour 1 and colour 2 on the vertical stripes; colour 3 on the thin edge trim of the panel.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Poncho_01.differs: The male version is a shorter pointed panel with vertical stripes and thin edge trim, ending around the hips instead of a long, plain draped panel.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Retro_Destroyer_.description: A long cape with a broad draped mantle collar over the shoulders, fastened by a small round clasp on each shoulder. It hangs in soft folds to about the calves, in a retro comic-villain style.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Retro_Destroyer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and mantle collar; colour 1 on the shoulder clasps.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Retro_Destroyer_.differs: The male cape is a single even colour with soft folds, without the gradient toward the hem that the female version has.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Sidecaper_01.description: A short one-sided cape hanging from a small mantle at one shoulder, falling in a broad tapered drape of soft folds down the side of the body to about hip or thigh level.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Sidecaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer cape and mantle; colour 2 on the inner lining at the shoulder.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Sidecaper_01.differs: The male cape is broader, hangs more over the front of the chest, and shows a contrasting lining at the shoulder.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A long, wide cape hanging from a small shoulder collar and pauldron cap, draping to about the ankles with a flared, ragged hem and a large oval panel with a central stripe.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape body and hem; colour 1 on the large oval panel and collar edge; colour 2 on the horizontal band across the middle and the shoulder caps; colour 3 on the central stripe.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The male cape is wider and flares out more, with a more ragged, pointed hem.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_01.description: A long draped cloth mantle with a rounded cowl-like collar around the neck. It hangs loosely from the shoulders in soft folds to about the calves and is open at the front, giving a classical heroic look.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle and collar; a small emblem patch at the front of the neck takes colour 2.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_02.description: A Spartan-style draped mantle: a soft cloth cape gathered over the shoulders with a small round brooch fastening at one shoulder, hanging in loose folds down the back to about calf length.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth of the mantle; colour 1 on the brooch.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_Star_01.description: A long draped cloth cape with a wide rolled mantle collar across the shoulders, fastened at one shoulder by a small star brooch; soft folds fall to about the knees over the back and chest front.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Spartan_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape and mantle cloth; colour 2 on the star brooch.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Webbed_01.description: A cobweb-patterned mantle of thin strands forming arched web rows, hanging from a small spiky collar-like shoulder piece down to about the thighs at the back. Open lattice, tattered and lightweight, with a spidery look.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Webbed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the web strands and shoulder collar; colour 2 on the darker inner spikes of the collar; colour 1 and colour 3 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Webbed_01.differs: The male web drapes wider from the broad shoulders and hangs a little longer, reaching around the knees.

Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A long draped cloth mantle hanging from the shoulders to about the calves, with a soft cowl-like collar and two pairs of banded straps over each shoulder fastened with round clasps at the front.
Male/M_Capemantle_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth mantle and cowl; colour 3 on the shoulder straps; colour 2 on the round clasps.

Male/M_Capespadl_Destroyer_01.description: A single-shoulder cloth cape hanging from the left shoulder: a broad tapered sheet that peaks in a point above the shoulder and drapes in heavy folds behind the body to about ankle level.
Male/M_Capespadl_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; the inner face shows a slightly different shade, but no separate slot is visible.
Male/M_Capespadl_Destroyer_01.differs: The male cape is wider and flares out further from the body, with a more billowing drape and a blunter top.

Male/M_Capespadl_Destroyer_02.description: A single-shoulder cape of long, narrow parallel strands that fan out from the left shoulder and hang down past the knees behind the body, tapering to points. Suggests a mystic, wing-like fantasy look.
Male/M_Capespadl_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 3 on the thin edge lines; colour 2 on the tips near the shoulder.
Male/M_Capespadl_Destroyer_02.differs: The male strands spread wider apart into a broader, more open fan.

Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: A set of three long, thin ribbon streamers that arch up over the left shoulder from a small anchor and sweep down and outward behind the body, tapering to pointed tips. A light, flowing superhero accent.
Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the anchor loop and the upper ribbon lengths; colour 1 on the lower ribbon lengths and tips as a gradient.
Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.differs: The male streamers sweep wider and further out to the side and are longer, while the female ribbons hang more steeply down the back.

Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A single long strip of simulated cloth that hangs from the left shoulder down the side past the hip, tapering to a point. It drapes loosely and sits wider over the shoulder.
Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth strip; colour 2 on the darker top edge at the shoulder.
Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The male strip is wider and broader at the shoulder and ends a little higher, around the upper thigh.

Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_01.description: A single plain panel of soft cloth that hangs from the left shoulder down the side and back of the body, tapering slightly toward a straight hem at about hip level. Simple superhero-style half cape with gentle vertical folds.
Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_01.differs: The male cape is wider and hangs at the side of the upper arm and torso, more visible from the front than the female version.

Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_02.description: A single short cloth cape panel hanging from the left shoulder, a narrow tapered rectangle with soft vertical folds. It drapes down the side of the body to about the hip, with a plain, unadorned edge.
Male/M_Capespadl_Tight_Shouldercape_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel on the outer face; the inner face appears tinted by colour 1.

Male/M_Capespadr_Destroyer_01.description: A single-shoulder cloth cape that hangs from the right shoulder as one broad draped sheet with soft folds, flaring outward and trailing behind to about the calves. It has a pointed top and a superhero look.
Male/M_Capespadr_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Capespadr_Destroyer_01.differs: The male cape is wider and flares out to the side, while the female one hangs straighter and closer to the body.

Male/M_Capespadr_Destroyer_02.description: A shoulder-mounted fan of long, narrow cloth strands hanging from the right shoulder down to the calves behind the body, each tapering to a point, splaying outward in a wide sweep. Suggests a shadowy mystic cape.
Male/M_Capespadr_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strand faces; colour 1 on the strand edges; colour 2 at the tops where the strands gather at the shoulder.
Male/M_Capespadr_Destroyer_02.differs: The male strands splay out in a wider, more open fan that hangs lower and farther from the body.

Male/M_Capespadr_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: A set of three long, narrow ribbon streamers arching over the right shoulder from front to back, tapering to pointed tips that trail down behind the back. Sleek, flowing superhero accent.
Male/M_Capespadr_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper arch of the ribbons; colour 1 on the lower tapering tails, blending from the top down.

Male/M_Capespadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A single long strip of cloth cape hanging from the right shoulder, falling straight down the side and back of the body to about the calf, with a slightly pointed lower end. Simple one-sided drape with soft folds.
Male/M_Capespadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth strip.
Male/M_Capespadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The male strip is wider, with more visible folds, and hangs a bit further toward the back of the body.

Male/M_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_01.description: A single plain cloth cape panel hanging from the right shoulder, tapering slightly and ending in a rounded hem around hip level. It drapes in soft folds down the side and back, giving a light superhero look.
Male/M_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel.

Male/M_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_02.description: A single narrow panel of simulated cloth that hangs from the right shoulder down the back and side to about mid-thigh, with soft vertical folds and a rounded lower hem. A simple superhero half-cape.
Male/M_Capespadr_Tight_Shouldercape_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel.

Male/M_Capewristl_Inmate_01.description: A single length of heavy chain links hanging loose from the left wrist, dangling down past the hand like a broken shackle. It is thin and metallic with a gritty prison-inmate feel.
Male/M_Capewristl_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the chain links; the metal looks mostly unaffected by the other colour slots.

Male/M_Capewristl_Wraps_01.description: A single long, narrow strip of cloth that hangs loose from the left wrist down past the hip, with a slight twist and a tapered, rounded end. It reads as the trailing end of a wrist wrap.
Male/M_Capewristl_Wraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth strip.

Male/M_Capewristr_Inmate_01.description: A single length of chunky interlocking chain links hanging from the right wrist, dangling down past the hand toward the knee. It is thin edge-on, and suggests a prisoner or punk look.
Male/M_Capewristr_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the chain links; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Capewristr_Wraps_01.description: A single long cloth strip trailing from the right wrist down past the thigh, with a twist near the top and a narrowing, pointed tail. It reads as a loose trailing wrist wrap.
Male/M_Capewristr_Wraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth strip, which is the only visible feature; the inner face looks slightly shaded but takes the same slot.
Male/M_Capewristr_Wraps_01.differs: The strip is longer and more tapered, reaching lower down the leg with a more pointed tail.

Male/M_Cheslayer_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A partial, sleeveless superhero chest layer: a triangular breastplate with pointed, upswept shoulder flares, a downward-pointing lower tip, and a wide flared open ring band around the ribs and lower back.
Male/M_Cheslayer_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central chest plate, back panel and rim band; colour 1 on the side chest and shoulder sections; colour 2 on the tips of the shoulder flares and the inside of the rim.
Male/M_Cheslayer_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The male version has near-contrasting shoulder tips and a larger, open rim ring around the lower back, while the female one has contrasting inset panels on the shoulders.

Male/M_Chest_Animal_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting snake-themed top with overlapping ribbed scale plates across the chest and abdomen, layered ridged scales along the shoulders and upper arms, and sleeves that fade into scaly textured forearms. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and abdomen scale plates and underarm panels; colour 1 on the torso, collar and upper sleeves; colour 2 on the slits between the chest plates; colour 3 on the forearm scales, blended into colour 1 above.

Male/M_Chest_Animal_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting animal-fur top with a smooth sculpted chest, feathery fur streaks along the shoulders and arms, a large pointed fur mane across the upper back, and jagged fur cuffs on the forearms; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulders, upper arms and lower torso fur; colour 1 on the chest and streaks down the arms; colour 2 on the cuff tips; colour 3 on the forearm cuffs and the upper back mane.
Male/M_Chest_Animal_02.differs: The male top has a smooth, sculpted chest in place of the female version's shaggy fur tuft.

Male/M_Chest_Animal_Jacket_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length animal-themed top with overlapping scale-like ribbed plates over the chest and abdomen, a pointed open collar, a separate waist band at the back, and textured, muscle-like forearm sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Animal_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and abdomen scale plates; colour 1 on the collar and waist band; colour 2 on the stripes between the plates; the forearm sleeves show a skin-like texture that ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Chest_Animal_Jacket_01.differs: The male version has no covering on the upper back, leaving just a collar edge and a separate waist band, and it has no shoulder sleeves.

Male/M_Chest_Animal_Jacket_02.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting animal-style top with a high collar, short torso ending at the ribs, a contrasting hem at the sides and back, and separate forearm sleeves with jagged, fur-like tufted tips.
Male/M_Chest_Animal_Jacket_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the torso and collar; colour 0 on the waist band and fur streaks on the forearm sleeves; colour 2 on the tufted tips of the sleeves; colour 3 on the lower forearm sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Animal_Jacket_02.differs: The male version is a plain fitted torso with no big fur mass over the chest, and shows a contrasting waist band at the back.

Male/M_Chest_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A sleeveless, knee-length qipao dress with a high mandarin collar, asymmetric knot-style fastenings across the chest and a small bow. It has side slits and a large floral motif on the lower skirt. East-Asian style.
Male/M_Chest_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main dress body; colour 0 on the piping, knot fastenings, bow and floral motif; colour 2 on the ruffled collar edge.
Male/M_Chest_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The male piece is a sleeveless knee-length qipao dress with a floral motif, rather than the cropped bell-sleeved jacket on the female body.

Male/M_Chest_Astronaut_01.description: A long-sleeved, hip-length astronaut jacket with a padded hood-like collar, a bulky chest harness with a boxy front plate and shoulder straps, side pouches with round buttons and a hose, and contrasting cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and hood collar; colour 1 on the side and back panels and pouches; colour 2 on the harness straps and cuffs; colour 3 on the round buttons and indicator lights.

Male/M_Chest_Astronaut_02.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length astronaut jacket with a high rolled neck, contrasting side panels, and a bulky chest harness with front and back plates, small round connectors and looping hoses. contrasting cuffs end each sleeve.
Male/M_Chest_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the side and back panels and hose cases; colour 2 on the harness plates and cuffs; colour 3 on the round connectors.

Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_01.description: A compact sci-fi life-support chest box strapped over the upper chest, with a V-shaped notch, two round indicator lights at the top corners and thick cables looping down and around the sides to the back.
Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box casing and V panel; colour 2 on the lower bumpers and base; colour 3 on the round indicator lights; colour 1 on the cables.

Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_02.description: A pair of flexible, wrapped tubular arms or cables hanging at the waist sides, each curving in a U with contrasting collar fittings and small capped tips at both ends. Suggests a sci-fi astronaut or utility harness.
Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wrapped sections of the tubes; colour 1 on the lower wrapped sections; colour 2 on the collar fittings; colour 3 on the capped tips.
Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_02.differs: The male tubes hang lower with a wider, deeper curve.

Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_03.description: A boxy life-support chest module with a chunky segmented housing, a V-shaped recessed panel and two round knobs on top, sitting on the upper chest. Flexible hoses loop from the underside around the ribs toward the back.
Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing; colour 2 on the V panel and lower corner blocks; colour 3 on the round knobs; colour 1 on the hoses.

Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_04.description: A pair of flexible, wrinkled hose-like cables that arc from the sides of the torso, each U-shaped with rigid cuffs and capped nozzle ends. They hang as a backpack-style life-support accessory at the ribs.
Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hose fabric; colour 1 on the lower hose fabric, fading in from the upper part; colour 2 on the cuffs; colour 3 on the nozzle tips.
Male/M_Chest_Child_Astronaut_04.differs: The male hoses sit higher and sweep wider across the chest and sides, with a shallower curve.

Male/M_Chest_Child_Ski_01.description: A soft hood worn down around the neck and upper back, with a lined inner face, a contrasting bound edge and short zip-pull tabs at the front. Only the hood is present, giving a casual jacket or ski-wear look.
Male/M_Chest_Child_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer hood; colour 1 on the binding around the hood opening; colour 3 on the zip-pull tabs; the lining appears to take colour 0.

Male/M_Chest_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A tiny flat oval patch of material at the lower waist, sitting flush at the front and tapering to a very thin sliver around the back. Barely visible, it reads as a minimal plate.
Male/M_Chest_Child_Tight_None_01.differs: The male patch is a thinner flat oval band, while the female version is wider with a scooped curve at the front.

Male/M_Chest_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight scaled top ending at the waist, with a ridged, muscle-like plate across the chest and abs, a notched throat panel and side panels along the ribs; the scaled texture covers the arms and back.
Male/M_Chest_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sleeves, shoulders and back; colour 1 on the ridged chest and abdominal plate; colour 0 on the throat and rib side panels; colour 2 on the small underarm panels.
Male/M_Chest_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.differs: The male chest plate has pronounced segmented, muscle-like ridges down the abdomen, and the scale texture is more visible across the arms and back.

Male/M_Chest_Dryad_01.description: A sleeveless organic chest piece of smooth, ridged plates with a raised collar and rounded shoulders, wrapped at the waist by twisting vine-like tendrils. Segmented mechanical arm sleeves with banded cuffs sit below the shoulders.
Male/M_Chest_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates and cuff rings; colour 1 on the arm segments and small inset panels; colour 2 on the vine tendrils at the waist; colour 3 on the thin vein lines and the chest patch.
Male/M_Chest_Dryad_01.differs: The male version adds a contrasting patch at the upper chest near the shoulder and has rounder, less pointed shoulders.

Male/M_Chest_Dryad_02.description: A long-sleeved organic fantasy top of root-like layered swirls with a high draped collar rising around the neck, thick vine bands wrapped diagonally across the torso, a tusk-like curved spike at the hip, and segmented ringed cuffs on the arms.
Male/M_Chest_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, swirled surface ridges and cuff rings; colour 1 on the sleeves and body panels between the ridges; colour 2 on the wrapping vine bands across the torso; colour 3 on thin veining lines.

Male/M_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_01.description: A sleeveless organic-mechanical chest piece: a bulky veined shell with wide pointed shoulder flares and a high neck, wrapped at the waist in tangled vine-like bands, with segmented robotic arms and ringed cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and the cuff rings; colour 1 on the arm segments and small chest panels; colour 2 on the vine-like tendrils at the waist; colour 3 on the vein lines and a chest panel.
Male/M_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_01.differs: The male version has a contrasting panel inset on the upper chest and a bulkier shell with more visible contrasting chest panels.

Male/M_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_02.description: A long-sleeved organic-mechanical top with a swirling, root-like raised collar and shoulder mass, jointed robotic forearms with ring bands, and thick vine-like straps wrapped diagonally around the torso, ending with a curved thorn at the hip.
Male/M_Chest_Dryad_Robotic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, shoulder swirls, forearm rings and thorn; colour 1 on the torso and sleeve panels; colour 2 on the wrapped vine bands; colour 3 on thin vein-like markings.

Male/M_Chest_Endo_01.description: A sci-fi exoskeleton-style top: a rounded armored chest and shoulder shell with a central tubed spine unit, studded joint nodes, segmented mechanical arms with banded cuffs, and a flat rim at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest shell, waist rim and arm bands; colour 1 on the arm segments and joint nodes; colour 2 on the central spine unit and back pack; colour 3 on the looping cables.

Male/M_Chest_Endo_02.description: A robotic exoskeleton top: a segmented armored chest shell with a central spine column and contrasting side pods, jointed arms with ball joints and ringed cuffs, exposed hoses looping across the torso, and a flared rim at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Endo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest shell, cuff rings and waist rim; colour 1 on the arm segments and ball joints; colour 2 on the spine column, side pods and back plate; colour 3 on the looping hoses.

Male/M_Chest_Extra_Endo_01.description: A mechanical collar-like ring that sits around the base of the neck and over the top of the shoulders. It has a raised glossy rim, layered banded plates and exposed inner machinery at the front. Suggests a sci-fi android look.
Male/M_Chest_Extra_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim edge and the top inner rim; colour 2 on the banded outer plates; colour 1 on the inner mechanical parts; colour 3 on small details.

Male/M_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_01.description: A skin-tight, sleek shoulder-and-arm piece: a broad cap covering the shoulders, upper back and upper arms with an angular notch at the upper chest, plus separate forearm sleeves with a gap at the elbow. Suggests a synthetic android look.
Male/M_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap, upper arms and forearm sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_01.differs: The male version lacks the thin shoulder strap trim lines and instead has a broad shoulder cap with an angular notch at the upper chest.

Male/M_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_02.description: A pair of robotic arm armour pieces: cupped shoulder plates, segmented mechanical joints at the elbows, angular forearm guards with fine detailing, and separate cuff bands at the wrists. Sleek android look worn over the upper and lower arms.
Male/M_Chest_Extra_Robosleek_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder caps, forearm guards and wrist bands; colour 0 on the inner shoulder cups and upper-arm sleeve sections; colour 2 on the elbow joint mechanics; colour 3 on the small forearm markings.

Male/M_Chest_Extra_Ski_01.description: A flat atom-style emblem of looping orbital ellipses around a small central ring, printed on the upper back of a tight suit. It lies flush against the fabric with a thin outline, and suits sporty or superhero looks.
Male/M_Chest_Extra_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fill of the orbital loops; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the emblem.

Male/M_Chest_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight top ending at the waist, with a thin contrasting stripe across the shoulders, a pointed chest notch leading into a sculpted abdomen panel, and small spots down the outer forearms.
Male/M_Chest_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 2 on the shoulder stripe and abdomen panel; colour 3 on the spots along the arms.
Male/M_Chest_Foxbatcon_2025_01.differs: The male version has a thin shoulder stripe and a jagged, bat-like notch above the abdomen panel, rather than the wide chest band of the female version.

Male/M_Chest_Holohexarmor_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved, form-fitting glossy top that ends above the navel. It has a boxy separate chest panel, contrasting shoulders and back yoke, and forearm cuffs. It suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chest_Holohexarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the square front chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back yoke and the back of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearm cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Holohexarmor_01.differs: The male chest panel is a flat, boxy square with a faint hex-shaped edge, rather than the bust-shaped rounded panel on the female.

Male/M_Chest_Jacket_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit_.description: A retro sci-fi jumpsuit jacket top: a sleeveless, gathered vest-like torso with a pointed upright collar, two strap bands down the front and a banded hem at the waist. Forearm sleeves are separate, mismatched pieces with banded cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Jacket_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and the left forearm sleeve; colour 3 on the collar and neck panel, front straps, hem band; colour 1 on the sleeve cuff; colour 2 on the other forearm sleeve.
Male/M_Chest_Jacket_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit_.differs: The male version has a closed upper back with a collar wrapping around the neck and a gathered torso, rather than the sculpted bust and open back of the female version.

Male/M_Chest_Jacket_Wedding_Formal_Shirt.description: A sleeveless formal tuxedo shirt front with a small upturned collar, a central button placket and side panels, ending at the waist. Separate forearm cuffs with wide contrasting bands sit on the lower arms, leaving the upper arms bare.
Male/M_Chest_Jacket_Wedding_Formal_Shirt.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side panels and the forearm cuffs; colour 1 on the collar, the central placket panel and the cuff bands; colour 2 on the buttons; colour 3 on the small cuff links.

Male/M_Chest_Jacket_Zombie_Cannibal_02.description: A skin-textured zombie torso and forearm piece with raised stitched wounds slashing across the chest and abdomen, a thin band at the lower back, and bruised forearm sleeves; leaves the upper back bare.
Male/M_Chest_Jacket_Zombie_Cannibal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flesh-toned skin surface of the torso and forearms; colour 1 on the stitching and wound edges; colour 2 on the wound gaps and bruising.

Male/M_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_01.description: A robotic scrap-built chest and arms piece: a plate on the torso with a round slatted cage frame and small panel on the chest, a strapped frame across the back, and segmented mechanical arms with ringed joints and shoulder caps.
Male/M_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, waist band and arm ring segments; colour 1 on the cage frame, back frame and coiled arm segments; colour 2 on the small chest panel and inner back sections; colour 3 on the shoulder caps.

Male/M_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_02.description: A junkyard-robot chest and arm rig: a boxy plate over the torso with a round slatted cage on the front, a small square panel, a back frame of straps and mechanical segmented arms with ribbed joints and banded cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, shoulder pads and cuff bands; colour 1 on the cage, ribbed arm segments and back frame; colour 2 on the square panel and inner back sections; colour 3 on the shoulder details.
Male/M_Chest_Junkbot_Armboth_02.differs: The male version adds rounded, bulky shoulder pads with contrasting details over the upper arms, and the arm joints end in hex-shaped elbow knobs.

Male/M_Chest_Lockbox_65_01.description: A sleeveless, fitted kung fu style vest with a stand-up mandarin collar, frog-knot toggle fastenings down the centre front, and a curved, flared hem with contrasting angular panels at the hips.
Male/M_Chest_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main vest body with a glossy finish; colour 0 on the collar, frog-knot fastenings and hem panels.

Male/M_Chest_Lockbox_65_02.description: A sleeveless, glossy fitted vest with a raised stand collar and a flared, curved hem with separate angular panels. A ribbed, shield-shaped plate covers the chest, with a mechanical look.
Male/M_Chest_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main vest body; colour 0 on the collar and the lower hem panels; colour 1 on the ribbed chest plate; colour 3 on the frame around the chest plate.
Male/M_Chest_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The male vest replaces the front fastening loops with a ribbed, shield-shaped plate over the chest, framed by a contrasting border.

Male/M_Chest_Moth_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with large rounded shoulder and chest plates, chevron-like layered ribbing down the torso to a pointed hem at the waist, swooping accent markings, oval elbow panels and small wrist bands.
Male/M_Chest_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso, back and sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder and chest plates; colour 2 on the elbow panels, neck opening and wrist bands; colour 3 on the swooping accent markings and the waist band.

Male/M_Chest_Nightmare_Core_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting top of jagged, bone-like armor plates with a spiked high collar and pointed shoulder spurs. A cross-shaped chest emblem sits on a shield-like panel, and ragged plates run down the arms; it ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Nightmare_Core_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and sleeves; colour 1 on the chest and back panel; colour 3 on the central cross emblem and shoulder undersides; colour 2 on the gaps between the arm plates.

Male/M_Chest_Patriot_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a short standing collar, angular chest and back panel seams, and a separate lower waist band with contrasting panels; ends at the waist, with a small teardrop mark on each upper arm.
Male/M_Chest_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper torso, collar and sleeves; colour 1 on the waist band; colour 2 on the centre and side panels of the band; colour 3 on the arm marks and the thin lines on the band.
Male/M_Chest_Patriot_01.differs: The male top has a straighter, less cinched waist band and a teardrop-shaped mark on each upper arm.

Male/M_Chest_Patriot_Jacket_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped jacket bodice with a high folded collar and layered chest panels, over a separate wide waist band with a centre panel and thin vertical straps. Short bracer-like forearm sleeves sit apart from the body.
Male/M_Chest_Patriot_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest, collar and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the waist band; colour 2 on the centre panel and vertical straps; colour 3 on the small stitched accents.
Male/M_Chest_Patriot_Jacket_01.differs: The male version has a straighter, wider waist band and flatter chest panels, with shorter bracer-like forearm sleeves, rather than a shaped corset.

Male/M_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_01.description: A sleeveless armoured chest plate with a high rounded neckline over a fitted waist band, paired with segmented robotic arms with ringed cuffs and exposed mechanical joints. Sits on the torso to the waist, with a sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate and the arm rings; colour 1 on the waist band and the arm segments; colour 2 on the central waist panel and joints; colour 3 on the shoulder trim and thin waist accents.
Male/M_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_01.differs: The male version has a straighter waist band, a broader plate with a raised neck collar, and more visible contrasting shoulder trim.

Male/M_Chest_Patriot_Robotexo_Armboth_02.description: A robotic-exosuit top: a bulky, segmented chest plate with a raised shoulder piece over a straight waist band, paired with mechanical arms of ribbed segments and ring joints. Ends at the waist, in a sci-fi superhero style.

Male/M_Chest_Shirt_Pulp_Formalrolled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt base, collar and rolled cuffs; colour 1 on the vertical stripes; buttons show no distinct slot.

Male/M_Chest_Ski_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved puffer ski jacket with quilted padded sleeves, a high rolled funnel collar, a back hood, a centre zipper, a small chest pocket and side stripe panels; ends at the waist with a small emblem on the back.
Male/M_Chest_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, hood lining and sleeve stripe panels; colour 1 on the puffy sleeves, collar and hem trim; colour 2 on the zipper; colour 3 on the chest pocket zip and small tabs; colour 1 on the back emblem.

Male/M_Chest_Skin_Furlong_01.description: A long-sleeved furred top of layered, feather-like tufts across the chest, shoulders, back and arms, with a shaggy, spiky ruff around the neck and jagged edges at the shoulders and forearms; it ends above the navel.
Male/M_Chest_Skin_Furlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur tufts; colour 1 on the shading and undercoat between the tufts; the fur ignores colours 2 and 3.
Male/M_Chest_Skin_Furlong_01.differs: The male version has a thicker, shaggier ruff around the neck and bulkier spiked shoulder fur, with fuller coverage over the chest.

Male/M_Chest_Skin_Furmedium_01.description: A fitted, long-sleeved fur top covering the chest, back, shoulders and arms, built from layered feathery tufts that flare into jagged points along the forearms and shoulders; it stops above the navel, leaving the midriff bare.
Male/M_Chest_Skin_Furmedium_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur tufts; colour 1 on the shadowed undercoat and tips of the fur layers; the fur is textured, with little visible use of colours 2 and 3.

Male/M_Chest_Skin_Furshort_01.description: A long-sleeved, close-fitting furry top with layered tufted fur texture covering the chest, back, shoulders and arms; it ends cropped at the ribs, leaving the abdomen bare, with a rounded open neckline.
Male/M_Chest_Skin_Furshort_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts across the chest, back and arms; colour 1 on the shadowed undersides and depth of the fur; colour 2 and colour 3 show little on this piece.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Chesttight.description: A plain, skin-tight long-sleeved top that follows the muscle contours of the torso and arms, with a round neckline and a straight hem at the waist. Simple base layer for many superhero looks.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Chesttight.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole top; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Chesttight_1.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved cropped top that ends at the ribs, with a bare-skin panel over the chest, a separate band along the lower torso and forearms, and a contrasting strip down the back of the arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Chesttight_1.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulders, upper chest and upper arms; colour 0 on the lower torso band and forearms; colour 2 on the back, the back of the arms and the collar edge; the chest panel shows bare skin instead of a colour slot.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Chesttight_Skin.description: A tight, short-sleeved crew-neck shirt that follows the muscles of the chest and torso, with a contrasting band at the waist hem. The forearms are bare skin, so it reads as casual, athletic wear.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Chesttight_Skin.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt body and sleeves; colour 3 on the bare forearm skin sections; the waist hem band takes colour 0 as a lighter trim.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryb.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a contrasting collar, swooping chest and shoulder panels, a chest emblem, a V-shaped back yoke and contrasting cuffs; ends at the waist over the abdomen.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sleeves and lower torso of the top; colour 1 on the chest, shoulder and forearm panels; colour 2 on the collar, cuffs and side slashes; colour 3 on the chest emblem, piping and forearm patches.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryb.differs: The male top covers the full torso down to the waist, with no bare midriff.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryp.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top ending at the waist, with a V-shaped collar panel, a chevron panel under the chest, a banded midriff section, and forearm sleeves with diamond and angular accents.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryp.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulders and upper back; colour 1 on the midriff band and forearm sleeves; colour 2 on the chevron stripes and upper-arm side panels; colour 3 on the neck panel, chest chevron and sleeve diamonds.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryr.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting sentai-style top with a broad yoke over the chest and shoulders, swooping piping lines, a pointed V panel on the chest, angular side panels at the waist, and banded cuffs; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso body and sleeves; colour 3 on the chest and shoulder yoke and forearm accents; colour 1 on the piping, neckline and waist band; colour 2 on the side panels and arm stripes.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryr.differs: The male top has a straighter chest yoke with a wider V panel and a plain waist band, without the curved bust piping.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryy.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with chevron-shaped stripe panels down the chest and belly, shoulder caps, and banded stripes on the forearms. Ends at the waist with a contrasting hem band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Legendaryy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top and sleeves; colour 1 on the chevron stripes, collar edge, waist hem and sleeve bands; colour 2 on the shoulder panels; colour 3 on the forearm panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Ravenswood.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a yoke over the shoulders and upper back, glossy shoulder and chest panels outlined in thin piping, and a fitted torso that ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_01_Ravenswood.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke and upper back panels; colour 2 on the glossy shoulder and chest panels; colour 3 on the thin piping.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_90s_01.description: A tight, long-sleeved 90s-style top that ends at the waist. It has a central chest and shoulder panel, ribbed muscle-like side panels, a separate lower waist band, and mismatched sleeves. It sits close to the body with a round neckline.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_90s_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, shoulder and back panels; colour 0 on one sleeve and the ribbed side panels; colour 2 on the other sleeve and the lower waist band; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Alien_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top with sculpted, muscle-like panels: a raised chest plate, swooping side stripes, segmented back panels and a central contrasting spine wedge. It ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, torso sides and back centre panel; colour 1 on the chest plate and sleeves; colour 3 on the shoulder and rib stripes; colour 2 on the centre stomach and lower back wedges.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Alien_Hybrid.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped tight top ending above the navel, with a distinct rectangular chest panel, a high rounded neckline, and separate panels on the back, upper arms and forearms. A sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Alien_Hybrid.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the top and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the back of the shoulders, neck edge and rear of the arms; colour 0 on the forearms.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting scale-textured top with a crew neck, a contrasting harness-like panel across the shoulders and chest, a banded waist ending above the hips, and wrapped accent bands at the cuffs and waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scale-patterned body and sleeves; colour 2 on the shoulder and chest harness panel; colour 3 on the waist bands and cuff accents; colour 0 as the highlight in the scale pattern.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting scaled-mesh top with a separate smooth panel over the upper chest and shoulders and a matching waist band, edged with contrasting piping and banded cuffs; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scale-patterned sleeves, chest and back; colour 3 on the smooth upper chest panel and waist band; colour 2 on the piping, seams and cuff bands; colour 0 in the light scale pattern highlights.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Archer_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tights top with a contrasting-panel torso, a contrasting central chest strip that splits at a V neckline, separate cuffs and a hip-length hem; the back and upper sleeves are a separate panel.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower hem and the forearm cuffs; colour 1 on the chest and upper body; colour 3 on the central chest strip; colour 2 on the collar, back yoke and upper sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Archer_01.differs: The male version has a V-shaped split neckline at the top of the chest strip and a longer, straighter hem reaching the hips.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Archer_03.description: A cropped, long-sleeved form-fitting tight shirt ending at the waist, with a contrasting centre chest panel, separate back and upper-sleeve panels, and cuffs at the forearms. Simple sporty superhero styling.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Archer_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, front body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the centre chest panel; colour 2 on the collar, back yoke and rear sleeves; colour 0 on the forearm cuffs.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Archer_04.description: A long-sleeved, fitted shirt meant to sit under jackets: a tall centre chest stripe, a small high collar, jagged angular shoulder flaps and forearm cuffs. It reaches the waist, with a contrasting back yoke and sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Archer_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main torso and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the centre chest stripe; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder flaps, back yoke and rear sleeves; colour 0 on the forearm cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Archer_04.differs: The male version reaches the waist with a long centre chest stripe and jagged shoulder flaps, while the female version is a shorter cropped cut.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with a rounded neckline, curved piping lines down the chest and ribs, a V-shaped chevron across the upper back, and swooping striped bands on the forearms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, shoulders and upper back; colour 0 on the side panels, lower back and forearm bands; colour 2 on the upper sleeves; colour 3 on the piping, neckline trim and forearm stripes.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top ending at the waist, with a broad yoked shoulder panel and rounded collar, striped upper sleeves, angular bracket lines on the chest and back, and contrasting piping.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and forearms; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke, upper sleeves and cuffs; colour 2 on the striped bands and chest and back line details; colour 3 on the collar and piping.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Ascendant_02.differs: The male version has straighter, angular bracket lines on the chest, while the female version has curved, swooping lines.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Bird_People.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting top with a layered feather-scale yoke covering the shoulders and upper chest in a jagged edge, plain sleeves and torso, and a contrasting belt-like band at the waist hem.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Bird_People.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feathered shoulder yoke; colour 3 on the sleeves and torso; colour 2 on the waist hem band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Bird_People.differs: The male version has no metallic cup piece; the feathered yoke covers the whole upper chest and the hem band is contrasting trim.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Birdpeople_Jacket.description: A fantasy bird-people jacket front: a scalloped feather-scale yoke over the chest and shoulders, a fitted ribbed torso below ending at the waist with a band, and separate forearm sleeves. The back is mostly open.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Birdpeople_Jacket.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feathered chest and shoulder scales and the back collar; colour 3 on the lower torso and forearm sleeves; colour 2 on the waist band.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Blaster_01.description: A mechanical chest emitter: a large round cannon disc with a recessed central lens and segmented rim, a notched outer edge, a shoulder yoke over the collar area and a deep band across the lower ribs.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Blaster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder yoke, ring segments and lower band; colour 1 on the disc face and notched outer shell; colour 3 on the trim edges of the yoke and band; colour 2 on the central lens.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Blaster_01.differs: The male disc is larger and bulkier, sits slightly off-centre, and has a deeper, more solid lower band.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting top with a shaggy, fur-like torso texture that ragged-edges over the shoulders, and fine scaled sleeves running down to the wrists. Ends at the waist; creature-hybrid look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furry torso and shoulders; colour 3 on the scaled sleeves.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Classic_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with ornate swirling scrollwork panels over the chest, shoulders and upper back, a banded lower edge, and thin angular trim accents at the wrists.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sleeves, collar and lower torso; colour 0 on the shoulder and chest panels; colour 1 on the swirling scroll motifs and waist band; colour 2 on the curling outline trim and wrist accents.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Classic_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tights top with abstract zebra-like swirling stripes across the chest, shoulders and upper back, a plain band at the waist and neck, and striped panels at the wrists. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Classic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sleeves, neckline and waist band; colour 0 on the chest and back panels; colour 2 on the stripes over the shoulders and chest; colour 1 on the wrist stripes and the chest swirls.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Classic_03.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved superhero top ending at the waist, with branching web-like vein patterns spreading across the chest, shoulders, arms and back, a separate waist band, and contrasting forearm panels with pointed edges.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Classic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and upper arms; colour 2 on the web-like vein patterns; colour 3 on the waist band and forearm panels; colour 1 on the thin curved accent lines at the forearm edges and cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Classic_03.differs: The male web pattern spreads wider, with thicker veins running across the shoulders and down the upper arms, instead of a compact chest starburst.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Classic_04.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped tights top with swooping outlined bands over the shoulders and chest, a belt-like band at the waist, striped cuffs, and a separate midriff panel below the chest. It ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Classic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulders and upper torso; colour 3 on the forearms, upper-arm panels and midriff panel; colour 2 on the outline bands and waist band; colour 1 on the chest and back stripes and the cuff stripes.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Clockwork_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight cropped top that ends above the navel, with a large rectangular chest panel, a separate upper-back and rear-sleeve panel, and forearm sections in a different tone. A simple superhero look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Clockwork_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back and the back of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearms.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Color_Patch_01.description: A plain, skin-tight long-sleeved top ending at the waist, split into large angular colour-block patches across the chest, torso and arms, giving a harlequin-like superhero look with no other details.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Color_Patch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the patch over one forearm and the upper chest wedge; colour 1 on the centre chest and lower waist wedges; colour 2 on the other forearm, one side of the chest and the waist band; colour 3 on the shoulder and upper arm and the lower torso wedge.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tights top ending at the waist, with a broad multi-band sash running diagonally from one shoulder across the chest to the opposite hip, and matching banded stripes around each forearm.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 3 and colour 1 on the outer bands of the diagonal sash and forearm stripes; colour 2 on the central band between them.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.differs: The male top extends to the waist, covering the torso more fully, and the sash crosses the chest down toward the hip.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Combat_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting dress-shirt style top with a short standing collar, visible muscle-hugging creases, and buttoned cuffs; it ends at the waist with a slightly banded hem.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Combat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shirt including collar, sleeves and cuffs; no other colour slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Corrupted_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero top with a glossy upper section over the chest and shoulders, a jagged scalloped lower edge, and a contrasting waist panel with contrasting side panels; ends at the waist. Bare skin arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest and shoulder section; colour 1 on the centre waist panel; colour 2 on the side waist panels; colour 3 not visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the ribs, with a raised collar, shoulder armour plates, a blocky front chest panel, a banded hem and separate forearm sections.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and outer chest and back; colour 3 on the front chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back, back of the arms and inside the collar; colour 0 on the collar, shoulder plates, hem band and forearms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cosmic_01.differs: The male version has larger, more prominent shoulder plates and a squarer chest panel with a straight hem, and the collar is a plain neck opening rather than a raised ring.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cosmos_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a V-shaped chest panel, ribbed swooping shoulder caps, a banded ribbed waist section and V-shaped back lines; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest and upper back panel; colour 3 on the ribbed shoulder caps and the back V lines; colour 2 on the sides, sleeves and lower torso; colour 0 on the waist bands and some sleeve highlights.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cosmos_02.description: A long-sleeved, glossy form-fitting superhero top with a V-shaped neckline, chevron-patterned front panel, and twin swooping stripes running over the shoulders and down the arms; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy chest and upper sleeves; colour 2 on the chevron front panel, back and forearms; colour 1 on the collar and waist side panels; colour 3 on the stripes down the arms.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cryo_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with glossy shoulder caps, an arrow-shaped chest panel, a banded waist section and angular contrasting panels down the arms; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar area, forearm panels and outlines; colour 1 on the chest and sleeve panels; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and centre torso; colour 3 on the waist band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cryo_01.differs: The male top has an arrow-shaped chest panel and a plain straight waist band instead of a corset shape.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting sci-fi jacket with sculpted chest plates, a small raised collar, a segmented midsection panel with slots, a belt-like waist band, and banded ribbed bracers on the forearms. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates and back panel edges; colour 1 on the collar, midsection and back panel and thin piping; colour 3 on the upper sleeves; colour 2 on the forearm bands, waist band and side panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting sci-fi top with raised armor-like panels over the chest, shoulders and arms, a segmented waist band, a low collar, and a paneled back with a central spine motif; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised chest, shoulder and arm panels; colour 0 on the upper chest, sides and base fabric; colour 2 on the collar, forearms, waist band and back panels; colour 3 on the small dots.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cyberpunk top ending at the waist, with a padded collar, ribbed side panels, large segmented shoulder and arm plates, and a central chest and abdomen plate. Layered armour reaches the back.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, ribbed side panels and lower trim; colour 1 on the chest, shoulder, back and arm plating; colour 2 on the seams and inner gaps; colour 3 on the small chest lines and arm lights.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The male version has ribbed side panels, bulkier segmented arm and shoulder armour, and a lower padded collar, instead of one smooth plated chest.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting sci-fi bodysuit top with sculpted chest plates, segmented panels along the ribs and spine, small stud lights at the shoulders, and contrasting upper-arm bands; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main suit body and sleeves; colour 0 on the chest plates, upper-arm bands and lower torso panel; colour 2 on the side and back segmented panels and collar; colour 3 on the small shoulder studs.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Defender_Update_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero crop top ending above the navel, with a large rectangular chest panel, separate forearm sections, and a contrasting upper back and shoulder yoke. Smooth tights-like finish.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the top and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back and shoulder yoke and rear of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearms and a narrow band at the waist.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Defender_Update_01_1.description: A close-fitting, long-sleeved top with a torso of thin horizontal segmented bands and matching ribbed sleeves that look like flexible mechanical plating. It has a low round neckline and ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Defender_Update_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the segmented torso; colour 1 on the sleeves and shoulders.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Deity_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with thin linear seam lines tracing the chest, abs and back, a swooping contrasting band across the shoulders, and separate bands at the wrists.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 3 on the shoulder bands; colour 2 on the thin seam lines; colour 1 on the wrist cuffs.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Draco_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with rounded shoulder and chest panels, a V neckline, a separate waist panel with a banded hem, and bracer-like forearm sections; it ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder, chest and back panels and the forearm inserts; colour 3 on the waist panel, chest centre and forearm sections; colour 0 on the upper sleeves; colour 2 on the outlines, piping and hem bands.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a glossy sculpted muscle-style chest plate, flame-like swooping points on the upper arms, a round neckline with contrasting trim, ending at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulders, upper arms and body of the top; colour 1 on the neckline trim, flame points and forearm sleeves; colour 3 on the outer chest panels; colour 2 on the glossy centre chest plates.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Firebird_01.differs: The male chest plate is a flat sculpted muscle-style panel, while the female version has a corset-shaped bodice with separate bust cups.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Fish_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight top ending at the waist, printed with lionfish-like swooping stripe patterns, branching vein-like lines radiating from the collar, and ringed bands on the forearms; fitted to the torso and arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Fish_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light stripe panels and lower torso; colour 1 on the broad swooping stripes and sleeves; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and ringed arm bands; colour 3 on the branching lines and neck and cuff edging.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Formal_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting dress shirt with a pointed collar, a concealed centre button placket, a yoke seam across the back and buttoned cuffs; it ends at the waist with a slightly gathered hem.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Formal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shirt including collar, placket and cuffs; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Formal_Rolled_01.description: A fitted formal dress shirt with a placket down the front, a soft open collar, and sleeves rolled to the forearm with small cuffs. It ends at the waist, with a back yoke seam across the shoulders.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Formal_Rolled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shirt including the collar, placket and rolled cuffs; the forearms and hands below the sleeves are the mannequin's skin, not part of the piece.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Foxtech_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with a bat-wing emblem across the chest, shaped panels over the shoulders and ribs, a diamond mark on the back, and armoured forearm guards.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Foxtech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest centre, back and sleeves; colour 3 on the shoulders and chest sides; colour 1 on the inner arm, side panels and piping; colour 2 on the bat emblem, back diamond and forearm guards.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Foxtech_01.differs: The male top has larger contrasting side panels along the ribs and underarms, and a round collar trim at the neck.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Gamer_01.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved gamer top ending at the midriff, with a geometric circuit-board pattern across the chest and back, a round trim-edged neckline and hem, and honeycomb-textured lower sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top; colour 1 on the circuit-line patterns; colour 3 on the neckline and waist hem trim; colour 2 on the honeycomb forearm sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Gamer_01.differs: The male circuit pattern is a geometric triangular design on the chest, whereas the female version has swooping striped bands.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tights top with a wide scoop neckline, raised outlines forming a chevron pattern across the chest and back, ribbed upper sleeves and segmented plated forearm guards; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and shoulders; colour 1 on the ribbed upper sleeves and the waist hem; colour 2 on the outline piping and the segmented forearm sections.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Glow_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tight ending at the waist, with a textured base, bold panelled shapes across the chest, back and arms, thin contrasting piping, and glossy inset patches on the chest and arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured base, lower hem and cuffs; colour 1 on the large chest, shoulder and back panels and sleeve bands; colour 3 on the piping outlines; colour 2 on the glossy inset patches and round chest patch.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Glow_01.differs: The male version has a single round glossy patch at the centre of the chest, where the female has two patches over the bust.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Harnessherculean_01.description: A partial mechanical harness of two separate padded pieces: a broad bib-like collar plate over the upper chest and shoulders, and a curved band wrapping across the lower chest with a small square buckle at the side.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Harnessherculean_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar plate and the chest band; colour 3 on the inner edges and rim trim of both pieces; colour 1 and colour 2 are not visible.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Harnessherculean_01.differs: The male collar plate is broader and higher, covering more of the shoulders, and the band crosses the lower pectorals rather than sitting under the bust.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped superhero top that ends above the waist, with a large rectangular chest panel, a high rounded neckline, and separate lower sleeve sections. The back has a broad panel across the shoulders.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the collar, back shoulder panel and rear of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearms.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with muscle-textured surface and contrasting-lined seams tracing panels over the chest, shoulders, arms and back, a contrasting collar insert and a two-tone waist band at the ribs.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, back and sleeves; colour 3 on the piping seams; colour 2 on the collar insert and the upper waist band; colour 1 on the lower waist band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Hoses_01.differs: The male top has piping that runs down the full length of the arms and outlines panels on the chest and back, and a wider band of contrasting waist colour.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Jeweled_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a textured, jewel-studded surface, smooth shoulder caps, petal-shaped panels across the chest, a teardrop panel on the back, and striped forearms; it ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Jeweled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured body and sleeve stripes; colour 1 on the piping and edge borders; colour 3 on the shoulder caps, chest and back panels and forearm stripes.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Jeweled_01.differs: The male top has a scoop neck and a cluster of petal-shaped panels across the chest, while the female version has a high neckline with a centre zip line and a single long teardrop panel.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Kaiju_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with sculpted muscle-like chest and shoulder panels, a separate neck and side panel, contrasting forearm panels, and a spine-like ridged motif down the back.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, shoulder caps, back spine motif and lower forearms; colour 3 on the neck, side panels and back waist band; colour 0 on the upper arms, upper back and waist hem; colour 2 on the inner forearm panels.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Kaiju_01.differs: The male chest is smooth sculpted muscle definition rather than the ribbed, segmented plates of the female version.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Kigatilik_01.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved crew-neck top ending at the waist, printed with tiger-like horizontal stripes on the arms, ribs and back, with fuzzy streaked markings and a spine-and-rib pattern across the back.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Kigatilik_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the top and the chest; colour 2 on the stripes; colour 0 on the fuzzy streaks and markings; colour 1 on the small patches on the torso.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A long-sleeved, cropped, form-fitting top ending above the waist, with a large plain rectangular panel across the chest, contrasting lower sleeves and a ragged shoulder edge. Reads as a superhero tight with a festive touch.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the torso and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the back, shoulders and back of the arms; colour 0 on the lower sleeves and midriff band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The male version has a flat rectangular chest panel with no fur tuft and no bow at the collar.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Krampus_02.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting jacket top that covers the chest and stomach and ends at the ribs. It has a large chest panel, a flared back collar, and separate wrist cuffs on the bare forearms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Krampus_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower torso band, the back and the wrist cuffs; colour 1 on the shoulders and upper chest surround; colour 3 on the central chest panel; colour 2 on the back collar and cuff edges.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Leatherpads_1.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tactical top with a cropped upper-chest section, a V-shaped lower edge over a separate midriff panel, angled shoulder panels, and a high back yoke. It ends above the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Leatherpads_1.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, upper back and upper sleeves; colour 0 on the midriff panel and forearms; colour 2 on the collar and back yoke; colour 3 on the shoulder panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.description: A form-fitting sci-fi sleeveless top with sculpted contrasting armor-like panels over the chest, shoulders and upper back, and a separate plain band at the midriff. It ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top; colour 2 on the sculpted chest, shoulder and back panels; colour 1 on the waist band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The male top is sleeveless, leaving the shoulders bare, while the female version has short cap sleeves.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a V-neck collar, angled shoulder straps, a segmented waist band and banded upper arms with piped edging; a large panel covers the upper back and it ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves, shoulders and chest; colour 0 on the chest side panels and back panel; colour 2 on the waist band and shoulder straps; colour 3 on the piping and arm bands.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.differs: The male version has a light panel across the upper chest and a plain contrasting waist band, without the separate contrasting bust panels of the female version.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length fitted jacket with a high stand collar, a ruffle-edged shoulder yoke with buttons, puffed sleeves gathered into banded cuffs with frilled edges, and seam lines down the front. A small winged emblem sits on the back.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and cuff frills; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke and the back emblem; colour 2 on the ruffle edging, seam piping, waist band and cuff bands; colour 3 not visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight patchwork top made of irregular angular patches joined by contrasting cross-stitched seams, in a jester style. It covers the torso and arms and ends at the waist with a plain hem.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body patches; colour 0 on the light patches; colour 3 on the accent patches; colour 2 on the stitching.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top with contrasting shoulders and sleeves, a V-shaped chest panel outlined in contrasting piping, a separate band at the waist, and striped panels along the arms; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulders, upper chest and sleeves; colour 3 on the chest and back panel; colour 1 on the waist band and the stripes along the arms; colour 2 on the outline piping.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.differs: The male top has a flatter V-shaped chest panel under broad covered shoulders, instead of a sculpted bustier-style panel.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with jagged lightning-bolt stripes across the chest and upper back, a fitted centre panel, angular wedge panels on the forearms, and a ribbed panel at the lower back.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, back and inner sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulders, upper arms and waist panel; colour 3 on the lightning stripes; colour 2 on the forearm wedges and lower-back ribbing.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with segmented armor-like plates over the chest, abdomen and shoulders, a ribbed spine and back plating, and banded sleeves; ends at the waist with a contrasting hem.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, abdomen and shoulder plates; colour 1 on the collar, side panels, sleeve bands and hem; colour 2 on the upper chest band, central inserts and lower forearms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Nighthawk_01.differs: The male top has a broad contrasting band across the upper chest and a diamond-shaped insert on the abdomen instead of shaped bust cups.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Partial_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting torso top with sculpted muscle detail, ending at the waist, paired with mechanical segmented arm sleeves: ribbed upper arms, ringed cuffs at elbow and wrist, exposed cables, and small shoulder plates.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso, shoulder plates and the metal rings at the elbows and wrists; colour 1 on the ribbed arm segments; colour 3 on the small trim at the shoulder edges; colour 2 on the inner joints and cables.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Partial_01.differs: The male version adds small armored plates over the shoulders.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Partial_02.description: A fitted sleeveless shirt covering the chest and torso to the waist, paired with mechanical cyborg arms: segmented ribbed upper arms, exposed cable joints and ringed metal bands at the forearms, with small shoulder plates.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt, arm rings and forearm bands; colour 1 on the ribbed arm segments; colour 3 on the shoulder plate accents; colour 2 on the inner joint cables.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Partial_02.differs: The male version is a full sleeveless shirt reaching the waist, not a short bra-style top with a bare midriff.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Patternseta_Bolt_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top split diagonally into two halves, with branching lightning-bolt crack lines across the chest and back. It ends at the waist and leaves the neck bare.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Patternseta_Bolt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one half of the top, including one sleeve and shoulder; colour 1 on the other half, including the other sleeve and the lower torso; colour 2 on the branching bolt lines.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Patternseta_Fire_01.description: A skin-tight superhero top that covers the torso and arms, with flame-shaped edges licking down from the shoulders and upper back across the chest and arms. It has short sleeves over long fitted lower-arm sleeves, and ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Patternseta_Fire_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulder and upper-chest flame area; colour 0 on the lower torso and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the flame edge highlights; colour 2 on the flame tips at the sleeves.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top with a deep V-neck showing a broad central torso panel, contrasting trim along the edges, a separate waist panel, and cuff sections on the forearms. It ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulders and upper sleeves; colour 1 on the trim outlining the chest panel and the back yoke; colour 3 on the central torso panel and forearm cuffs; colour 2 on the side and lower back waist panels.
