Male/M_Chest_Tight_Phantom_01.differs: The male top has a wide central torso panel filling the chest and abdomen, while the female has a narrower central stripe with the chest covered by the main sleeve material.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Phantom_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top ending at the waist, built from colour-blocked panels: a large square chest panel, shoulders and upper arms in one colour, a separate back and sleeve panel, and a contrasting lower band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Phantom_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 1 on the shoulders, upper arms and upper back; colour 2 on the back of the shoulders and outer sleeves; colour 0 on the forearms and lower waist band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Phantom_02.differs: The male version is colour-blocked with a large square chest panel and plain forearms, without the female version's scalloped collar trim, rib chevrons or striped forearm bands.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Phantom_03.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top with a V-shaped yoke across the shoulders and upper chest, jagged spiked edges below it, a contrasting waist band, and separate forearm sections with pointed tops. It ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Phantom_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and upper sleeves; colour 2 on the shoulder yoke; colour 3 on the V stripe and forearm sections; colour 1 on the waist band.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Pumpkin_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight top that fits the muscles closely, made of plain colour blocks: a square panel on the chest, shoulders and upper arms in another section, contrasting forearms, a bare-looking midriff band, and a separate back panel. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 1 on the shoulders, upper arms and upper back; colour 0 on the forearms and midriff band; colour 2 on the back of the shoulders and arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Pumpkin_01.differs: The male version uses plain blocks of colour, with a square chest panel and a separate contrasting back and arm section, instead of the female version's ornate ribcage and spine pattern.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Punk_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight top that ends at the waist, with a high round neckline, contrasting shoulder caps and flame-shaped panels at the lower ribs. The arms are bare skin.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso; colour 1 on the flame panels at the waist; colour 2 on the shoulder caps. The arms show skin and are not part of the colour scheme.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Radical_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight top with a scooped neckline and bare skin-toned arms and shoulders. Contrasting side panels run down the ribs, and the hem ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Radical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso; colour 1 on one side panel; colour 2 on the other side panel; skin-toned arms and neckline are not tinted by the scheme.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Rave_01.description: A sleeveless fishnet mesh tank with thin trimmed straps, neckline and hem, sheer over the torso with a solid banded section near the waist; bare skin arms, ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fishnet mesh; colour 1 on the lower waist band and mesh tint; colour 2 on the edge trim along the neckline, straps and hem. Arms are skin and not recoloured.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Rave_01.differs: The male version has no separate bra top; the mesh alone covers the torso with a denser solid tint toward the waist.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Rave_Tightjacket_01.description: A sleeveless fishnet mesh vest that clings to the chest and torso, ending at the waist with a solid banded hem and thin edge trim. The back appears open above the hem, giving a rave or street look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Rave_Tightjacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the open mesh netting over the chest; colour 1 on the lower hem band and the mesh at the waist; colour 2 on the thin edge trim at the neckline and hem.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with sculpted armor-like plates over the pecs, shoulders and forearms, a contrasting central panel, contrasting-lined seams down the arms and a banded waist ending at the belt line.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulder and forearm plates; colour 1 on the fabric of the sleeves, shoulders and back; colour 2 on the central chest panel, back spine panel and cuff bands; colour 3 on the seam piping and waist band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The male version has broad overlapping pectoral plates instead of separate rounded chest cups, and a straighter waist band.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting retro superhero top with a glossy chest-and-arm plate, a separate yoke over the shoulders and neck, a waist band with a notched centre panel, and contrasting bands at the elbows and wrists.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, sleeves and lower waist panel; colour 1 on the yoke and waist band; colour 3 on the elbow bands; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and wrist cuffs.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight retro superhero top with a round neckline edged in thin trim, two contrasting bands on each upper arm, contrasting forearm sleeves, and a straight waistband ending at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and upper arms; colour 1 on the forearm sleeves and the waistband; colour 2 on the bands around the upper arms; colour 3 on the neckline and waist edge trim.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.differs: The male top has a straighter, shallower waistband with only a slight notch at the front.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit_0.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting retro sci-fi jumpsuit top ending at the waist, with a V-shaped yoked collar panel over the shoulders, two small strap tabs down the centre front, contrasting waist band, and banded upper arm and wrist cuffs. One sleeve is a separate panel.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and one sleeve; colour 3 on the yoke, waist band, strap tabs and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the upper-arm band; colour 2 on the other sleeve.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top with a large rectangular chest panel, contrasting shoulder-and-back panels, a separate band around the hem and distinct forearm sections. Smooth, retro in style.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the torso and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the back of the shoulders and upper arms; colour 0 on the hem band and forearms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.differs: The male top has a separate light band around the lower torso at the hem, where the female version shows a contrasting midriff.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Robotexo_01.description: A robotic exoskeleton top with a rounded, molded chest plate, layered shoulder armor, exposed tubes and cables at the abdomen, and slim jointed mechanical arms with ring bands; ends at the waist over a ribbed belt.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest plate, back panels and arm casings; colour 0 on the shoulder plates, arm rings and joints; colour 2 on the back vents and underlying gaps; colour 3 on the shoulder interior and the abdomen tubes.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Robotexo_02.description: A cropped robotic exo-torso: a bulky segmented chest plate with contrasting shoulder armor, exposed cables and tubes at the midriff, and slim mechanical arms with ring joints and cuffs. Ends above the waist with a narrow band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Robotexo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest plate, back panels, arm segments and waist band; colour 0 on the shoulder plates, arm rings and cuffs; colour 2 on the back vents and inner mechanics; colour 3 on the cables and small shoulder accents.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.description: A padded, gi-style top with one long sleeve on the wearer's left arm and a broad diagonal panel sweeping over the chest and shoulder. A thick quilted band wraps the waist above a short flared hem.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diagonal chest panel, waist band and cuff bands; colour 1 on the main body, sleeve and hem; colour 2 on the upper sleeve panel, back sash and back hem; colour 3 on the small accent panels and lower sleeve trim.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting sporty superhero top with a round contrasting neck band, shoulder caps, angular ribbed chevron panels on the chest, ribbed forearms and waist band, and contrasting cuffs. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and small arm bands; colour 1 on the shoulder caps; colour 2 on the ribbed chest, waist and forearm panels; colour 3 on the neck band, shoulder piping and cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_01.differs: The male top has angular chevron chest panels and a straighter, deeper waist band, where the female has swooping curved panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tight top ending at the waist, with a contrasting yoke across the shoulders and upper chest, rounded shoulder caps, a lower chest panel, and banded forearm sections with thin trim rings at the wrists.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke and lower chest panel; colour 2 on the forearm bands; colour 3 on the trim edging of the shoulders, collar and cuffs.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Scaled_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top with a broad chest panel, horizontal banded plates down the midriff, curved piping over the shoulders and a V-shaped back panel, and contrasting bands on the upper arm and wrist. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Scaled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest panel, midriff bands, back V panel and forearms; colour 1 on the shoulders, sides and back; colour 3 on the piping and hem trim; colour 2 on the arm bands.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Scarab_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top with a scarab-inspired design: crescent chest marks, segmented armour-like abdomen panels, a large shaped back panel, and contrasting cuffs. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar area, upper chest, side flashes and lower back; colour 1 on the abdomen, back panel and sleeve panels; colour 3 on the crescent chest marks; colour 2 on the side ribs, inner arm panels and cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Scarab_01.differs: The male version has flatter crescent marks across the pecs and a straighter torso, without the separate rounded chest cups.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Scarab_02.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a rounded neckline, scarab-like piping across the chest and midriff, segmented armour-style bands on the forearms and upper arms, and a large shield-shaped back panel; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the top and sleeves; colour 0 on the collar, side ribs, arm bands and back surround; colour 3 on the chest and midriff piping; colour 2 on the back panel and arm patches.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting cropped tight top ending above the navel, with a large rectangular chest panel, a separate back yoke and upper-sleeve panel, and contrasting lower forearm sections. Sci-fi soldier style.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main torso and upper front sleeves; colour 3 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the collar, back yoke and rear of the sleeves; colour 0 on the forearms and midriff band.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_01.description: A loose, baggy long-sleeved crew-neck sweater ending at the hips, with ribbed cuffs, hem and neckband, and a large front pouch pocket. Soft, plain body with a casual, sporty look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves; colour 2 on the neckband, cuffs and hem ribbing; colour 3 on the front pouch pocket; colour 1 as a soft tint on the lower sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_01.differs: The male sweater is mostly one plain colour with a large front pouch pocket and contrasting ribbed neck, cuffs and hem, rather than diagonal colour panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_03.description: A casual knit sweater-vest layered over a collared shirt with short sleeves. The vest has a deep V neckline, contrasting trim at the armholes and ribbed hem, and ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the shirt collar and short sleeves; colour 2 on the trim at the armholes, V neckline and hem.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Shirt_Secret_03.differs: The male version has fuller, looser sleeves reaching the elbow and a deeper V neckline that shows more of the collar.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A sleeveless, lumpy padded torso shaped like a snowball, ending at the waist, with mechanical segmented arms of ribbed coils, jointed cables and cuff rings from shoulder to wrist. Comic robotic-snowman look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the puffy torso and the arm cuff rings; colour 1 on the ribbed arm segments; colour 3 on the shoulder trim; colour 2 on the arm joints and cables.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The shoulder trim is a padded lining tucked inside the arm sockets rather than straps, and the torso is a rounder, heavier belly.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Space_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting futuristic bodysuit top with glossy panels across the chest and shoulders, a blocky diamond motif at the centre chest, piping lines, and patterned forearm panels; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, back and shoulder panels; colour 2 on the sleeves and waist band; colour 1 on the piping lines and the chest diamond; colour 3 on the forearm panels and lower back accents.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Space_01.differs: The male top has a diamond-shaped motif at the centre of the chest, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved, form-fitting jacket top with a large rectangular opening that leaves the chest bare, a short collar, and separate panels on the upper back and sleeves. It ends above the navel with a contrasting hem band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front body and upper arms; colour 2 on the upper back, collar and outer sleeve panels; colour 0 on the forearms and hem band. The chest opening shows bare skin, not a colour slot.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Space_Tightjacket_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting sci-fi jacket front with layered angular panels across the chest, a small upturned collar and a banded waist section, plus separate bracers on the forearms. The back is mostly open, with only a narrow waist band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Space_Tightjacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest panels and collar; colour 1 on the chest diamond, piping and thin outlines; colour 2 on the waist band, chest chevrons and outer bracer panels; colour 3 on the inner bracer panels and waist edge.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Spinal_01.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved superhero top ending at the waist, with a painted-on spinal pattern of vertebra-like dots down the back, ribbed dashes on the arms, bold outlined stripes over the shoulders, and circular markings on the chest.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Spinal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top and sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder outlines, side stripes and some rib markings; colour 2 on the dashes and shaded panels on the arms and shoulders; colour 3 on the spine dots, chest circles and stripes along the arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Spinal_01.differs: The male top adds circular markings on the chest and shoulders, and darker ribbed dashes on the back of the arms.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Spinal_02.description: A form-fitting sleeveless chest piece that covers the pecs and shoulders and hugs the torso down to the waist, with a spine-like pattern of vertical stripes and ribbed marks on the midsection. Separate forearm bands sit on the lower arms, and a small collar shows at the neck.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Spinal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest and forearm fabric; colour 3 on the chest and shoulder spots and the streaks on the forearms and neck; colour 1 on the vertical stripes at the midsection and the marks on the forearms; colour 2 on the small rib marks.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Spooky_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight top ending at the waist, with a feathery textured chest panel, fine ribbed lines across the torso, and dense spot markings over the shoulders, arms and back. A monstrous, organic look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves; colour 1 on the feather-like chest panel; colour 2 on the spot markings; colour 3 on the small accents in the centre of the chest panel.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Spooky_01.differs: The male version has larger, denser spots covering the shoulders, arms and back, and the contrasting-panel area is a wider chest shape with no bust shaping.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Starhawk_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top ending at the waist, with scale-textured mesh over the shoulders, chest and forearms, bold outlined panels across the torso and arms, and a chevron-shaped panel down the centre of the abdomen.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scale-textured mesh areas; colour 1 on the main torso and upper-arm panels; colour 2 on the outlines and cuffs; colour 3 on the small round gems at the shoulders and the belly button.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Starhawk_01.differs: The male top has a pointed chevron panel with a round gem at the abdomen and a fuller mesh chest, where the female has a shield-shaped panel with a ring.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Starowl_01.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved crew-neck top ending at the ribs, printed with star shapes joined by thin constellation lines across the chest, back and arms, with contrasting trim at the neckline and cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top; colour 3 on the stars; colour 2 on the constellation lines and the neckline and cuff trim; colour 1 not visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_01.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top with a scattering of star motifs across the chest, back and sleeves. It has a round neckline and ends at the waist, hugging the torso and arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric of the top; colour 1 on the stars across the chest and front torso; colour 3 on the stars on the sleeves; colour 2 on the stars across the back.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_02.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved superhero top ending at the waist, with a round neckline and star emblems: two on the upper chest, one large star on the abdomen, one on the upper back, and small stars on the shoulders and elbows.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tight top; colour 1 on the stars; colour 2 on the outlines around the stars.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_02.differs: The male version has two smaller stars high on the chest and a larger star on the abdomen, rather than stars placed over each breast.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_03.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top with a shrug-like sleeve and shoulder section and a star-patterned torso panel. It has a high neckline at the front and ends at the waist with a thin plain hem.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and shoulder yoke; colour 0 on the torso base and hem; colour 3 on the stars.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_04.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with a vertical stripe down the centre of the chest and back topped by a star, and thin star-tipped stripes running down each arm, plus a contrasting waist band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top and sleeves; colour 1 on the stripe borders, arm stripes and waist band; colour 2 on the centre stripe and band edge; colour 3 on the small star centres.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_05.description: A long-sleeved, skin-tight superhero top ending at the waist, with a glossy jagged panel over one side of the chest and abdomen and a matching angular patch on the lower back.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top and sleeves; colour 1 on the glossy jagged panel on the chest, abdomen and lower back.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_05.differs: The glossy panel is a shorter, blockier jagged patch over the abdomen and side of the chest, rather than a long sweeping band across the breast.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_06.description: A skin-tight, long-sleeved superhero top ending at the waist, with a bare round neckline. Contrasting striped side panels run from the shoulders down the outer arms and along the ribs, printed with stars.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and inner sleeves; colour 3 on the side panels along the arms and ribs; colour 1 on the stars; colour 2 on the thin outline edging the panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_07.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top ending at the waist, with a jagged zigzag border between a plain shoulder-and-sleeve section and a torso patterned with scattered star and sparkle shapes.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso and inner-arm base; colour 1 on the shoulders, collar and outer sleeves; colour 3 on the star and sparkle motifs; colour 2 on the thin outline along the zigzag edge.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_08.description: A close-fitting superhero top with short sleeves and a round neckline, ending at the waist. Long tight sleeves below the short cuffs carry a scattered star pattern, with a narrow banded strip at each upper arm.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_08.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the torso and short sleeve caps; colour 0 on the lower sleeves as the base of the star pattern; colour 3 on the stars; colour 2 on the narrow bands at the upper arms.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_09.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero top with a wide central panel printed with a starburst pattern, running from the neckline down the front and back. Side sections and sleeves are plain, and the hem ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_09.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and side sections; colour 0 on the star panel background; colour 3 on the star bursts; colour 2 on the thin edging between the panel and sides.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_10.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting superhero tights top split down the middle: one half is plain, the other half carries a star pattern, divided by a jagged zigzag edge. Ends at the waist with a round neckline.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Stars_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plain half of the top and its sleeve; colour 0 on the star-patterned half; colour 3 on the stars; colour 2 on the edging along the zigzag split.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Swan_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero top with a deep V neckline and swan-wing shaped glossy panels over the chest and back, tapering to a V at the waist; the arms are left bare.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the neckline, shoulder straps and lower waist band; colour 2 on the glossy chest and back panels; colour 0 on the thin swooping side accents and centre waist stripe.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Swan_01.differs: The male top has a flatter, muscular chest panel with only thin side accents, rather than large rounded bust panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Sweater_01.description: A long-sleeved knitted sweater with vertical cable-knit ribbing in bold stripes, a small folded turtleneck collar, and ribbed cuffs and hem. It fits close to the body and ends at the waist, in a casual style.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Sweater_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knit body; colour 1 on the wide cable stripes; colour 3 on the thin centre lines in the stripes; colour 2 on the collar, cuffs and hem band.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tactical_01.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tactical top ending at the waist, with a V-shaped yoke across the shoulders, panels on the upper arms and ribs, short vertical accent lines on the chest and forearms, and contrasting wrist bands.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and sleeves; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke, upper-arm panels and rib panels; colour 3 on the short accent lines; colour 2 on the wrist bands.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_01_Legend.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero chest piece with a high flared collar, layered chest panels around a central emblem, and a contrasting midriff band. Back is mostly open, with a waist band; separate forearm guards sit on each arm.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_01_Legend.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest panels, waist band and forearm guards; colour 2 on the collar and cuffs; colour 0 on the midriff band and panel edges; colour 3 on the chest emblem and forearm panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_01_Legend.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero jacket top with a scooped collar, chevron and diamond panels down the chest, and a wide waistband; separate forearm bracers with diamond insignia replace sleeves. The back is mostly bare, showing only the collar and waistband.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_01_Legend.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest body; colour 3 on the collar, chest diamond and bracer diamonds; colour 2 on the chevron stripes and bracer cuffs; colour 1 on the waistband and bracers.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_01_Legend.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting sentai-style top with a sculpted chest panel, a scooped neckline with a collar trim, and a jagged, angular lower band ending at the waist, paired with separate forearm bracers.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_01_Legend.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chest panel and the bracer accents; colour 1 on the neckline trim and waist band; colour 0 on the lower torso and bracers; colour 2 on the jagged accents at the hem.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_01_Legend.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero top with layered chevron panels across the chest and a small upturned collar at the back, ending at the waist with a banded hem. Separate banded forearm sleeves sit below the elbows.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_01_Legend.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer chest panels, hem band and collar; colour 2 on the upper chevron and the arm bands; colour 0 on the lower chevron stripes; colour 3 on the forearm panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_02.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting torso base for jackets: a muscle-shaped sleeveless top with a small low collar at the neck, ending at the waist, plus separate short forearm sleeves. Meant to be layered under jacket pieces.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso, collar and forearm sleeves; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Alien_01.description: Alien-styled armour overlay for jackets: a sculpted, muscle-like chest plate with a segmented abdomen panel, a soft draped collar at the neck, and separate armoured forearm bracers. Ends at the waist; the back is mostly bare.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and the outer torso shell; colour 1 on the chest plate and the forearm bracers; colour 3 on the trim lines around the chest and the stripes on the bracers; colour 2 on the abdomen panels and the bracer edges.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Alien_Hyb.description: A sleeveless, cropped, form-fitting jacket top with a raised rounded collar, a large chest and back panel with contrasting edging, and a separate band at the midriff. Detached forearm sleeves sit on the lower arms, giving an alien-hybrid look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Alien_Hyb.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main chest and back panel; colour 1 on the edging around the panel and the sleeve tops; colour 0 on the midriff band and forearm sleeves; colour 2 on the collar and the inner back of the sleeves.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Aquatic_0.description: A fitted aquatic-scale jacket underlayer: a sleeveless-looking torso with a fish-scale mesh pattern, curved fin-like plates across the collarbone, contrasting-lined seams down the chest, a band at the waist, and separate scaled forearm sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Aquatic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the scale-patterned fabric of the torso, waistband and forearm sleeves; colour 3 on the seam lines and bands; colour 2 on the neck trim and shoulder plates.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Aquatic_0.description: A fitted aquatic-style jacket top with a scale-patterned chest and separate scaled forearm sleeves with banded cuffs. Smooth glossy panels cover the shoulders and lower waist, with a narrow band at the back waist and a bare back.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Aquatic_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the glossy shoulder and waist panels; colour 0 and colour 1 on the scaled chest and forearm pattern; colour 2 on the outlines and cuff bands.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Ascendant.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero tank top with a scooped neckline and curved swooping piping lines down the chest, ending at the waist. Separate forearm wraps with chevron stripes sit on each arm, with a small collar flap at the back of the neck.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Ascendant.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main chest panels; colour 0 on the side panels, waist band and forearm wraps; colour 3 on the neckline trim, piping and chevron stripes; colour 2 in the shadowed seams between panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Ascendant.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero top that covers the upper chest with a shaped yoke and a small raised collar, leaving the torso bare, with contrasting straps down the abdomen and separate forearm bracers.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Ascendant.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the abdomen panel and the upper part of the forearm bracers; colour 1 on the chest yoke and lower bracers; colour 3 on the collar and thin trim lines; colour 2 on the abdomen straps.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Classic_0.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting jacket front with ornate swirling scroll panels across the chest, a small upturned collar at the neck, a band at the waist, and separate forearm bracers with angled trim; the upper back is mostly open.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the collar, waist band, lower chest and forearm bracers; colour 1 on the swirling chest scrolls; colour 0 on the chest side panels and bracer trim; colour 2 on the inner scroll accents and bracer edging.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Classic_0.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting jacket top with a small standing collar, a broad band at the waist and separate forearm cuffs. Swirling zebra-like stripes cover the chest and forearms, giving an abstract superhero look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the collar, waist band and upper cuffs; colour 0 on the chest base; colour 1 on the swirling stripes on the chest and forearms; colour 2 on the stripe accents on the chest.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Classic_0.description: A form-fitting superhero chest overlay with web-like branching panels across the chest and shoulders, a wide waist band, and separate forearm sleeves with swooping accent lines; the back is mostly bare apart from a collar edge.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest base and forearm cuffs; colour 2 on the web-like chest panels and collar pattern; colour 3 on the waist band and forearm sleeves; colour 1 on the thin curved accent lines on the forearms.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Classic_0.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting jacket top with decorative linework: swooping trim lines over the chest and shoulders, a small central emblem, a wide contrasting waist band, and separate banded forearm wraps. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and back; colour 2 on the swooping outline trim and the thin belt line; colour 1 on the thin chest lines and the forearm bands; colour 3 on the waist band and forearm wraps.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Color_Pat.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight top that covers only the front of the chest and ends at the waist, with pie-wedge colour panels, a small upturned collar flap at the neck, and separate forearm sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Color_Pat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar flap, one upper chest wedge and the left forearm sleeve; colour 1 on the upper-left chest wedge and the lower centre wedge; colour 2 on the right chest wedge and the right forearm sleeve; colour 3 on the side wedges and the waist band.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Color_Str.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight top with a diagonal triple stripe sash across the chest, plus separate forearm bands that carry matching stripes. It ends at the waist, made to sit under jackets.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Color_Str.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso and forearm sleeves; colour 3 on the upper stripe of the sash and bands; colour 2 on the middle stripe; colour 1 on the lower stripe.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Corrupted.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting torso piece with a sculpted upper chest and a pointed panel down the abdomen, ending in a wide band at the waist. The back is mostly open, with a small raised collar at the neck. Suits a jacket layered over it.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Corrupted.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and shoulder plates and the collar; colour 1 on the central abdomen panel and the back waist panel; colour 2 on the waist band and side panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Cosmos_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight top for jackets, with a sculpted chest and a V-shaped centre panel. Banded ribbing sits at the waist, with a small collar at the neck and separate bracer-like forearm sleeves. Sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest and shoulder panels; colour 2 on the lower torso, waist band and forearm sleeves; colour 3 on small accents at the shoulders and back of the waist band; colour 0 on faint highlights in the chest.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Cosmos_02.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero chest piece with a wide open V-neck collar, segmented armour-like plating over the torso, and a banded waist trim, paired with separate bracers on the forearms. The back is mostly open, leaving only the collar and waistband.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest and shoulder panels; colour 1 on the collar, inner V and waist band; colour 2 on the segmented torso plating and forearm bracers; colour 3 on the small accents at the shoulder tips and bracer cuffs.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Cryo_01.description: Form-fitting sleeveless superhero chest piece with an arrow-shaped chevron panel down the front, angular layered plates over the chest, and a wide banded waist section; separate angled forearm guards sit on the lower arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest plates and the forearm bands; colour 0 on the arrow chevron, collar edge and forearm guard panels; colour 2 on the inner chest segments and trim outlines; colour 3 on the waist band.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Deity_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero torso piece with a small upturned collar, chevron and line panel seams across the chest and abs, a narrow band at the lower back, and separate forearm bracers with contrasting bands.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso, collar and bracer tops; colour 3 on the chevron line across the chest; colour 2 on the panel seam lines; colour 1 on the bands of the forearm bracers.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Draco_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero chest piece with sculpted pectoral panels, a central dragon-like wedge emblem, a raised rear collar and a banded waist ending at the ribs, paired with separate flared forearm bracers.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest panels and the bracer inserts; colour 3 on the shoulder edges, lower torso band and bracers; colour 2 on the trim lines, central emblem and neckline; colour 0 barely visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Firebird_.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero jacket front with a scoop collar, sculpted segmented chest and abdominal armor panels with side plates, a wide band around the lower back, and separate forearm bracers.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Firebird_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest and shoulder section; colour 1 on the collar trim and forearm bracers; colour 3 on the side plates and waist band; colour 2 on the central chest and abdomen panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Fish_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting patterned tight top with a high shoulder collar and a lionfish-like fin motif of swooping stripes and thin web lines across the chest, plus separate forearm sleeves; ends at the waist with a narrow band at the back.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Fish_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shoulder collar and the stripe bands; colour 0 on the light stripe areas of the chest and forearms; colour 1 on the chevron and waist band panels; colour 3 on the thin web lines and wrist cuffs.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Foxtech_0.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero torso piece with a bat-like emblem panel across the chest, contrasting piping, and a scooped collar. It ends in a band at the waist, and separate bracers sit on the forearms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Foxtech_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main torso and waist band; colour 0 on the chest and side panels and collar edge; colour 2 on the bat emblem and forearm bracers; colour 1 on the piping and trim.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Gamer_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting sci-fi tight top ending at the waist, with circuit-like line patterns across the chest, a round contrasting neckline and hem trim, plus separate hexagon-textured forearm sleeves.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso body; colour 1 on the circuit line patterns on the chest; colour 3 on the neckline and waist hem trim; colour 2 on the hexagon-textured forearm sleeves.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Gladiator.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting gladiator-style tight top that ends at the waist, with a geometric diamond-line pattern across the chest, a trimmed neckline, and separate segmented bracers covering the forearms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Gladiator.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the torso body; colour 2 on the bracers and the chest line pattern and neckline trim; colour 1 on the waist hem and bracer top edges.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Jeweled_0.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero tight top with a textured front panel, large oval jewel-like shapes down the chest, a rounded neck trim, and separate striped forearm sleeves. The back is mostly bare apart from a neck strip and a waist band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Jeweled_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured chest panel and waist band; colour 3 on the oval chest shapes, neck trim and forearm stripes; colour 1 on the edging around the chest and the forearm bands; colour 2 on the cuff edges.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Kaiju_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting muscle-sculpted chest piece with a shoulder yoke and lower band, paired with separate forearm bracers floating below the elbows. The back is mostly open, leaving only a narrow waist band and collar strip.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest muscles and the outer forearm bracers; colour 3 on the shoulder yoke, side panels and lower chest edge; colour 0 on the hem band and collar strip; colour 2 on the inner bracer panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Lockbox_6.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight jacket with a stone-like plated chest, contrasting segmented edging around the torso, a wide band at the waist and a rounded collar; forearm sleeves are separate pieces with the upper arms bare.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates; colour 1 on the waist band; colour 2 on the edging and plate outlines; colour 3 on the collar and forearm sleeves.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Lockbox_6.description: A fitted superhero jacket-tight with a short-sleeved chest panel and small upturned collar, a wide segmented waist band with piped edges, and separate cuff-like forearm sleeves. The back is mostly open, showing only the collar and waist band.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest panel, collar and forearm sleeves; colour 2 on the waist band and chest centre panels; colour 3 on the piping and cuff trim; colour 0 on the small side panels at the ribs and shoulders.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Madjester.description: A form-fitting patchwork jester top with short sleeves, stitched-on patches with visible seams across the chest and a small collar ring at the neck, plus separate forearm sleeves; the back is mostly open, leaving a band at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Madjester.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body fabric and waist band; colour 0 on the large patches and forearm panels; colour 3 on the smaller accent patches; colour 2 on the stitching.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Modern_De.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting torso piece with a plunging open collar at the chest, a chevron-shaped panel over the ribs and a broad banded waist section, plus separate forearm sleeves. Suits a modern villain or superhero jacket look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Modern_De.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest, collar and forearm sleeves; colour 3 on the chevron rib panel; colour 1 on the waist band; colour 2 on the thin outlines between panels.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Modern_Ki.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting superhero chest piece with swooping lightning-like flashes over the chest, a segmented abdominal panel and a narrow back band at the waist, plus separate forearm bracers with angled inset panels.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Modern_Ki.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulders and bracer bases; colour 1 on the abdominal panel and waist band; colour 3 on the chest flashes; colour 2 on the bracer inset panels and back band stripes.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Patternse.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight torso layer with a jagged lightning-bolt pattern across the chest and a diagonal split between two panels, plus separate forearm bands on each arm. It ends at the waist and is meant to sit under jackets.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Patternse.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest and shoulder panel and the left forearm band; colour 1 on the lower chest, waist band and right forearm band; colour 2 on the lightning bolt lines.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Tightjacket_Patternse.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting tight top that stops at the waist, with a shaped upper chest and shoulder section decorated with flame-like swooping marks, plus separate plain forearm bands. Fits a superhero jacket layering look.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted body and sleeves; colour 1 on the hem and cuff trim; colour 2 on the neckline band.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Wedding_Formal_Shirt_.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting dress shirt with a small stand collar, a central button placket with a contrasting front stripe, a contrasting yoke across the shoulders and back, and buttoned cuffs; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Wedding_Formal_Shirt_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt body and sleeves; colour 1 on the front stripe, collar, shoulder yoke and cuffs; colour 2 on the buttons; colour 3 on the cuff buttons.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length fitted top with a wide V-neck, a broad patterned band across the shoulders and chest, and flared bell cuffs with matching geometric trim. Its fantasy robe look suits a wizard or mystic.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves of the top; colour 2 on the patterned band and cuff trim; colour 1 and colour 3 are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01.description: A bare-chested zombie skin piece: exposed muscular torso and arms with irregular stain-like blotches on the chest and back, and jagged burst-like patterns and a small contrasting wound patch on the upper arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin-toned base; colour 1 on the chest and back blotches and arm patterns; colour 2 on the wound patches on the upper arms; the exposed skin ignores the light patches.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01.differs: The male version is bare skin with blotch markings and no fabric top layer, leaving the torso exposed.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01_Tights.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting tight top ending at the waist, with a blotchy, decayed-looking pattern of patches and stains across the torso and arms, plus torn-looking gaps showing skin on the upper arms.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Zombie_01_Tights.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shirt fabric; colour 3 on the scattered patches and on skin-toned sections of the arms; colour 2 on the stains and streaks; colour 1 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Zombie_Cannibal_01.description: A bare-skin torso and arms texture with a muscular, sculpted look, marked by jagged stitched wounds across the chest, abdomen, shoulders and back, plus bruise-like streaks along the arms. Ends at the waist; suggests a zombie or monstrous look.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Zombie_Cannibal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to drive the skin surface; colour 1 on the bruise-like streaks and the stitched wound openings; colour 2 on the deepest wound shadows; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chest_Tight_Zombie_Underchest_01.description: A skin-textured zombie torso and forearm piece: a sleeveless, form-fitting upper body with a raised collar, ragged torn holes exposing the underchest, and separate forearm sleeves with mottled, decayed patches. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Tight_Zombie_Underchest_01.colourAreas: The piece uses a skin-like texture that largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows in the mottled patches around the torn chest, side rips and forearms.

Male/M_Chest_Toxicsteel_01.description: A robotic armour bodysuit with a bulky sculpted chest plate, round port details, and segmented mechanical arms with ribbed joints and ring bands. A vented back plate sits over a light lower back panel.
Male/M_Chest_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chest, torso and back plates; colour 1 on the ribbed arm segments and joints; colour 0 on the underlying side panels, arm rings and lower back panel; colour 2 on the vents and gaps.
Male/M_Chest_Toxicsteel_01.differs: The male version has a fuller, continuous chest and torso plate with round port details and no cut-away waist.

Male/M_Chest_Toxicsteel_02.description: A sleeveless sci-fi armoured torso piece with a glossy riveted chest plate tapering to a bodysuit waist, bulky mechanical shoulder pauldrons, a segmented vented back plate, and jointed tubed arms with ringed cuffs.
Male/M_Chest_Toxicsteel_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main chest and back plates and collar; colour 0 on the shoulder pauldrons, arm segments, rear hip plate and cuff rings; colour 1 on the tube inserts and accent lines; colour 2 on the gaps and seams.
Male/M_Chest_Toxicsteel_02.differs: The male version adds bulky armoured shoulder pauldrons and a raised collar plate, with mostly light arm segments rather than contrasting tubed arms.

Male/M_Chest_Variable_Robot_01.description: A bulky, angular robotic chest vest of segmented armour plates with a central vertical channel, small vents and a chunky waist band; a plain smooth slab covers the back, ending at the waist.
Male/M_Chest_Variable_Robot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder caps and side plates; colour 1 on the front chest and abdomen plates; colour 3 on the centre channel outline and piping; colour 2 on the recessed panels and the back.

Male/M_Chestaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025_0.description: A partial chest and shoulder piece of layered, petal-like curved plates: large rounded shoulder caps join a band across the chest and upper back, meeting at a pointed centre. Organic, wing-like sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main petal plates; colour 3 on the ridged stripes and edge lines running along each plate.
Male/M_Chestaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025_0.differs: The male version has bulkier shoulder caps and a wider, fuller chest band that covers more of the chest.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Alien_01.description: A sculpted alien armband that wraps the upper left arm: an open, angular band with a raised contrasting plate on the outer side, layered edge plating and a short pointed spike jutting toward the back.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edge rim; colour 1 on the main band; colour 2 on the raised plate; colour 3 on the spike.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Amazon_01.description: A curved metal upper-arm guard wrapping the outside of the left arm, with a zigzag pointed lower edge, a raised central ridge, decorative scrollwork bands and small studs, framed by contrasting edge trim. Greco-roman warrior style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the engraved scroll patterns; colour 3 on the small stud gems.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Amazon_02.description: A short wrapped cuff worn around the left upper arm: an octagonal band that flares at both ends and pinches at the middle, with contrasting rims and a thin braided cord ringing the centre.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrap body; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 2 on the braided cord around the middle.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Anniversary_Mec.description: A chunky angular metal shoulder-cap for the left upper arm, open at the inner side, with a ribbed flexible tube curving up along its front edge. Suggests retro robot or sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Anniversary_Mec.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 2 on the ribbed tube. The glossy metal shows little of the other slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Armorninja.description: A chunky angular armor band wrapped around the left upper arm, made of faceted overlapping plates with a textured front panel and a raised rear plate. Ninja-style tactical armor that sits above the elbow.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the textured front panel; colour 1 on the large rear and lower plates; colour 3 on the upper rear wedge; colour 0 on the outer side plate and edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, angular block-shaped band worn around the upper left arm, like a small cardboard carton with a flat top rim and straight faceted sides. It gives a blocky, quirky look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and the back panel; colour 1 on the upper front and side panels; colour 2 on the lower front and side panels; colour 3 on the angled stripe panel on the front.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chainlock_01.description: A loose coil of chunky metal chain links wrapped several times around the upper left arm and fastened with a small padlock on the inner side. Gives a rugged, punk or prisoner-style look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 1 on a small trim at the padlock; colour 3 on the keyhole.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chainlock_02.description: A loose tangle of chunky chain links wrapped several times around the upper left arm, fastened by a small boxy padlock on the outer side. Gives a gritty, restrained look suited to punk or street styles.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chainlock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 3 on the padlock keyhole marking; colour 1 on a small detail beside the lock.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chains_01.description: A single thin chain of small interlocking links hanging straight down from the upper chest past the hip, ending in a ring and a small key-like pendant. It dangles loosely against the body's left side.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper links near the shoulder; colour 0 on the lower links; colour 3 on the end pendant; colour 2 on the ring clasp.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chainlock.description: A small padlock-shaped ornament with a chamfered rounded body, a thick looped shackle and a recessed keyhole, worn on the side of the left upper body at the chest and arm. Suggests a punk or street look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chainlock.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the lock body and shackle; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on the thin edge strip along one side.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chainlock.description: A small chunky padlock with a faceted, chamfered body, a recessed keyhole on the face and a thick angular shackle on one side. It hangs from the chest and side as a gritty, punk-style accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chainlock.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the lock body and shackle; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on the thin edge strip along the side of the body.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chains_01.description: A single long chain of oval links hanging straight down from the chest past the hip, ending in a small hook-and-charm pendant. It dangles loosely and swings freely, like a punk or gothic accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper links of the chain; colour 0 on the lower links; colour 2 and colour 3 on the end pendant.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Punk_01.description: A small cloth knot on the upper left arm with two long pointed bow-like tails sticking out sideways. No visible band around the arm. A casual punk bandana-style accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot; colour 1 on one tail; colour 2 on the other tail.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Punk_01.differs: The male version shows only the small knot and two tails, with no visible band wrapped around the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Renegade_.description: A small sci-fi cannon module on the upper left arm: a boxy casing with a perforated vent face and a hex-nut muzzle ring, trailing a thick flexible cable that loops around the arm and ends in a small ribbed connector.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Renegade_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing and cable end connector; colour 1 on the hex muzzle ring; colour 3 on the cable; colour 2 on the muzzle opening.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Renegade_.description: A pair of flexible tubes that snake down the left upper arm in zigzag curves, each starting at a small capped mount near the shoulder and ending in a ribbed, vented cylindrical nozzle near the elbow.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Renegade_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the end caps and ribbed nozzles; colour 3 on the main tube lengths; colour 1 on the banded sections of the tubes.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Scarab_01.description: A flat, thin emblem of three interlocking elliptical loops around a small central ring, like an atom symbol, lying flush on the outer left upper arm. Reads as a decorative badge-like arm mark.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Child_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main loops and central ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the loops.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Crimson_01.description: A twin-strand twisted rope band worn snugly around the upper left arm, with two parallel braided cords forming a slim loop. A simple casual accessory, suited to sporty or pirate looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and inner half of the rope; colour 1 on the back and outer half of the rope.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Deity_01.description: A banded upper-arm cuff made of stacked padded rings, topped by a large angular curved plate that wraps over the outside of the left upper arm like a shoulder guard. Superhero armour styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large curved outer plate; colour 1 on the stacked padded bands; colour 3 on the top rim band and inner lining; colour 2 on the bottom band.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Draco_01.description: A short armored band worn around the upper left arm, with a tall pointed flare rising on one side, layered stepped trim and a faceted diamond gem set in the front panel.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised upper band and flared peak; colour 0 on the main lower panel; colour 2 on the edge trim layers; colour 3 on the diamond gem.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Draco_01.differs: The male band rises to a taller pointed peak on the upper arm, whereas the female one is lower and more rounded.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Dragonbody_Lock.description: A flame-like fin attached along the outside of the left forearm: a smooth flat edge against the arm sweeps out into layered, swept-back ridged spikes that taper to a point near the wrist. Suggests a dragon or monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Dragonbody_Lock.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth base and inner surface; colour 1 on the outer tips of the ridged spikes, fading in from colour 0.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Dragonbody_Lock.differs: The male fin is bulkier and stands out further from the forearm, with taller, more pronounced spikes.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Drill_01.description: A chunky sci-fi armband worn on the upper left arm: a rounded octagonal cuff with ribbed bands at top and bottom and a plated centre section with contrasting inset panels, a small triangular emblem and thin accent lines.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central armor plating; colour 1 on the ribbed top and bottom bands; colour 2 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the emblem and accent lines.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Element_Fire_01.description: A ragged band of swirling flame-like tongues wrapped around the upper left arm, with curled, pointed wisps flaring outward. Glossy and rippled, it reads as an elemental fire armband.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; the whole band is a reflective sheen with only faint tints from colour slots 1 and 2.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Element_Fire_02.description: A ragged, flame-like wrap for the upper left arm: swooping, glossy licks of jagged flame-shaped panels curl around the upper arm and hang in tattered points, with a gap at the front.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: The default glossy material largely ignores the scheme; the whole piece shows one uniform glossy finish, with only faint hints of colour 1 in the reflections.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Feathers_01.description: A large feathered wing worn along the left arm, made of layered rows of feathers that fan out and taper to long pointed tips below the hand. Fluffy short feathers sit at the shoulder, giving a fantasy, avian look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fluffy upper feathers near the shoulder; colour 1 on the main mid-length feather rows; colour 2 on the feather markings and bands; colour 3 on the long feather tips.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Gearbreak_01.description: A bucket-shaped mechanical shoulder cup worn on the left upper arm, with a tall curved shield plate rising on the outer side, a banded ring with inset panels near the base, and a small side pod.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Gearbreak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cup body and shield plate; colour 1 on the band frame and the pod strap; colour 3 on the inset band panels; colour 2 on the shield edge trim and the small pod.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Gladiator_01.description: A short armband band worn around the upper left arm, with a wide main panel, darker rims at top and bottom, and a pair of padded straps fastened by a small buckle. Reads as a combat or military badge band.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band panel; colour 2 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the padded straps; colour 1 on the buckle.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Heraldry_01.description: A plain, smooth band worn around the upper left arm: a short faceted tube with a slightly flared, tapering profile and a clean edge, sitting just below the shoulder like a simple armband.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Kaiju_01.description: A rounded shoulder and upper-arm guard for the left arm: a segmented plate with stepped horizontal ridges wraps the outer arm, with a separate bulging, slightly dimpled shell panel over the front and back of the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented outer plate and its ridges; colour 3 on the bulging outer shell panel.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Madjester_02.description: A pair of overlapping angular bands worn around the upper left arm, one tilted across the other like crossed hoops. Faceted, flat-edged construction gives a simple, stylised jester-like armband.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both bands; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_01.description: A small boxy mecha armband block on the upper left arm: a chunky faceted plate with a notched top, small slit accents on the front, and two short cylindrical pegs hanging below. Suggests robotic sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main block; colour 1 on the two cylindrical pegs underneath; colour 3 on the small slit accents.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_02.description: A bulky octagonal armor cuff on the left upper arm: a faceted lower band with a contrasting vent slot, topped by a sloped, stepped cap with two small slash marks. Mecha-style, sci-fi.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower faceted band; colour 1 on the top cap and ring; colour 3 on the small slash marks; colour 2 on the vent slot.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mecha_02.differs: The male version is a shorter, wider block with a sloped cap that sits over the shoulder and upper arm, unlike the taller, narrower female band.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mechanon_02.description: A segmented angular band wrapped around the left upper arm, built from zigzagging, stepped plates with jagged edges and a small tab at one end. Sci-fi armor-style armband with a robotic look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light outer plates and edge panels; colour 1 on the main stepped bands; colour 3 on small inset wedges; colour 2 on the darker end tab and underside strap.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Modern_Ironclad.description: A simple armband worn around the left upper arm: a wide faceted band with a thin raised rim at top and bottom, snug and plain, suggesting a modern, utilitarian look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Modern_Ironclad.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide central band; colour 2 on the raised rims at top and bottom.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Moth_01.description: A left upper-arm cover that wraps the bicep and shoulder cap, with a flared open collar at the top, a fluffy feathery tuft on the outer side, inset side panels and a gathered cuff edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main sleeve body and cuff; colour 0 on the fluffy tuft; colour 1 on the inset panels on the front and back of the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Moth_01.differs: The male version is shorter and bulkier, capping the shoulder with a wide flared top and a bigger tuft.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mutated_01.description: A pair of curved bone-like horns or spikes jutting out and backward from the left upper arm and shoulder, a larger one above a smaller one, each with a faceted base tapering to a sharp point.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and body of each spike; colour 1 on the tapering tips.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Padding.description: A padded upper-arm band made of two curved armor shells with a gap at the inner side. The rear shell is larger and puffy, the front shell is narrower, and each has a contrasting panel and a small strip on the front edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and lower edges of the shells; colour 1 on the main shell surfaces; colour 2 on the angled inset panels; colour 3 on the small strip on the front shell.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A billowing pirate-style puffed sleeve sleeve band worn on the left upper arm: a gathered, ruffled cloth tube cinched by a buckled strap, with a second flared frill below tied with a small bow.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered cloth and frill; colour 1 on the strap and the lower tie; colour 3 on the buckle and the round button; colour 2 on the frill hem edging.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pumpkin_01.description: A left shoulder and upper-arm guard of layered, ridged armor plates that wrap over the shoulder and end in a hooked tip, with a row of jagged, blade-like fins tucked below the plate. Gothic fantasy look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the jagged fins; colour 2 on the hooked tip at the lower edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Pumpkin_01.differs: The male plate is larger and rises over the shoulder, with the spiked fins tucked close beneath it, while the female version sits lower on the arm with the fins standing apart.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Punk_01.description: A cloth bandana tied around the upper left arm as an armband, with a folded-over striped inner band and a knot at the outer side that leaves two pointed, leaf-like tails sticking out. Punk, casual look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band; colour 1 on one knot tail and on stripes of the inner band; colour 2 on the other knot tail and on stripes of the inner band; colour 3 on stripes of the inner band.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_01.description: A short band of cloth strips wrapped in a loose spiral around the upper left arm, with gaps between the loops and ragged edges. It suggests a casual rave or street armband.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top loop; colour 1 across most of the wrapped strips; colour 2 on the lowest loop. Colour 3 is not visible.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_01.differs: The male version is mostly colour 1, with only colour 0 at the top and colour 2 at the bottom edge, and no colour 3.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_02.description: A left-arm wrap of crisscrossing fabric straps that spiral from the upper arm down to the forearm, leaving gaps that show the body beneath. Loose, frayed bands give it a rave or street look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Rave_Straps_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps at the top of the upper arm; colour 1 on the upper and mid-arm straps; colour 2 on the straps around the elbow; colour 3 on the forearm straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Reactor_01.description: A chunky sci-fi upper-arm cuff made of two joined armor halves with a notched top edge and small round stud, plus a curved cable running down to a small ribbed plate on the forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one half of the cuff, the lower rim and the small forearm plate; colour 1 on the other half of the cuff; colour 3 on the cable and the small stud.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Armor_.description: A sci-fi armor band for the upper left arm: a large cup-shaped plate with round stud holes and an inner lining, and two bent tubular cables that loop down to ribbed end caps. Worn on the upper arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and the ribbed end caps; colour 1 on the inner lining and cable bands; colour 3 on the cable tubes; colour 2 on the round holes in the plate.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Armor_.differs: The male plate is larger and deeper, with round stud holes, and the cables stay closer to its edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Cannon.description: A small sci-fi cannon module mounted on the outer upper left arm: a boxy casing with a perforated vent face and a hex-nut muzzle ring, trailing a thin looping cable that wraps around the arm and ends in a small connector.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Cannon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing and the cable end connector; colour 1 on the hex muzzle ring; colour 3 on the cable; colour 2 on the muzzle opening.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Tubes_.description: A pair of thin flexible tubes that snake in zigzag curves down the left upper arm from the shoulder, each starting at a small rigid cap and ending in a ribbed cylindrical connector. Sci-fi cybernetic accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Tubes_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main tube lengths; colour 1 on the banded sections of the tubes; colour 0 on the end caps and ribbed connectors.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Tubes_.description: Two flexible tubes that snake down the outside of the left upper arm in S-curves, each starting at a short capped collar near the shoulder and ending in a ribbed, vented cylindrical nozzle near the elbow.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Renegade_Tubes_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the end caps and ribbed nozzles; colour 3 on the main tube lengths; colour 1 on the banded tube sections.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.description: A chunky armored cuff worn around the upper left arm: a faceted plate rises over the outer side, with a lower band and a curved tubular handle-like bar swinging out from the front. Suggests retro sci-fi warlord armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large upper plate and the handle bar; colour 1 on the main cuff body and the handle tip; colour 3 on the lower band; colour 2 on the small nozzle underneath.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.description: A segmented ammunition chain draped from the chest over the shoulder and down the back of the left arm, ending in a boxy metal clasp near the upper arm. Pointed tips line its edge, for a retro warlord look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain segments; colour 1 on the pointed tips along the edges; colour 2 on the box clasp.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retrosteelhead_.description: A curved metal pauldron-like arm guard that wraps the outer left upper arm, with a raised ridged centre plate, pointed flared lower edges and a contrasting rolled band along the bottom. Retro superhero armour style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Retrosteelhead_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and ridged plates; colour 1 on the lower rolled band and edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Roman_01.description: A Roman-style segmented upper-arm guard: a curved shell of stacked overlapping plates with rivet studs, held to the outer left upper arm by two contrasting straps that wrap around the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Roman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate segments, fading into colour 1 across the middle of the shell; colour 3 on the rivets; colour 2 on the straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Roman_02.description: A segmented Roman-style upper-arm guard: a curved shell of stacked overlapping metal bands with small rivets along the edges, wrapping the outer left upper arm from shoulder to mid-arm without any straps.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Roman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded plates; colour 1 on the shaded outer curve of the shell; colour 3 on the rivets.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Sandstorm_01.description: A left upper-arm guard: a curved armored shell with raised ribbed pads on the outer face, a contrasting lower cuff band, and a contrasting flared panel that extends down toward the elbow. Sits around the upper arm; sporty sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long lower panel and inner lining; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 1 on the lower cuff band; colour 3 on the ribbed pads.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Sandstorm_02.description: A chunky angular armband worn around the left upper arm, with a faceted plated shell that steps down into a notch, a small rectangular inset panel on the outer face, and a contrasting inner lining.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band shell; colour 3 on the small inset panel; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge shadows.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_01.description: A curved armband plate worn on the outer upper left arm, with a stepped lower edge and a thick contrasting border. Its face carries an atom-like orbital emblem. Superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate face; colour 2 on the border and back shell; colour 1 on the atom emblem lines.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_01.differs: The male plate is shorter and wider, with a less pronounced stepped lower edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_02.description: A short armored cuff worn on the upper left arm: a tapered shell with a raised, bordered panel on the outer face and a separate side section, open at the top. Suggests superhero or sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised front panel; colour 1 on the side and rear shell; colour 2 on the border rim and edging.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Spikysuit_01.description: A small, lumpy organic growth clamped to the upper left arm: a rounded bony mass with several blunt knuckle-like protrusions and mottled patches, suggesting a monstrous, alien shoulder guard.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bony mass; colour 1 on the mottled patches and streaks across its surface.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Starhawk_01.description: An angular upper-arm cuff with a faceted open band, a pointed shard-like spike on the outer side, and a separate thinner ring below it, worn around the left upper arm in a superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff band; colour 3 on the upper faceted spike; colour 2 on the lower spike tip; colour 1 on the thin lower ring.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Starhawk_01.differs: The male version shows solid colours, with a contrasting spike and lower ring, while the female version renders as clear glass.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Steelcommando_0.description: A tapered armored band worn around the upper left arm, with a flared rim, a contrasting angled panel on the outer side and a small hanging tab with a faceted crystal-like block at the back. Retro military-superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Steelcommando_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main band and rim; colour 1 on the angled side panel; colour 3 on the faceted hanging block; colour 0 on the thin edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Super_Destroyer.description: A chunky faceted armband worn on the left upper arm: a short, slightly tapered cuff with angular flat planes and a raised top rim, with a notch cut into the back, in a retro superhero armored style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Super_Destroyer.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top rim and upper faces of the band; colour 2 on the lower body of the cuff. Colour 0 and colour 3 are not visible.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Super_Destroyer.differs: The male band has a notch cut into the back of the cuff, rather than being an even closed cuff.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Symbiote_01.description: A single curved horn-like spike sprouting from the left shoulder, sweeping outward and upward to a sharp point, with a flat angular base seated against the shoulder. Suggests a monstrous symbiote look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and lower part of the spike; colour 1 on the upper curve and tip, blending in a gradient.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Tactical_01.description: A short angular armored band worn around the upper left arm: a curved open-backed plate with a raised, separate strip that wraps across the outer face. It reads as a tactical arm guard.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and its rim; colour 1 on the raised strip wrapping the front.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Tactical_01.differs: The raised panel is a longer strip that wraps further around the arm, rather than a small block.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Traveler_01.description: A wide fabric armband worn around the upper left arm, with a folded, layered band, a row of small eyelets, a square buckle with a snap stud, and a short loose strap tail.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and strap tail; colour 1 on the small strap tab under the buckle; colour 2 on the buckle and its stud; colour 3 on the eyelet rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Wraps_01.description: A short band of diagonally wound, overlapping fabric wraps around the left upper arm, with a plain cuff at the top and bottom. Casual, street-style bandage look with a slightly crinkled finish.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Arm_Wraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and bottom cuffs and some of the diagonal wraps; colour 1 on the wide wrap strips; colour 2 on the wraps in the gaps between strips.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Armor_Patterned_01.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapered, angular shell, a flared pointed lip at the elbow end and a stepped cuff at the wrist. A large inset panel is framed by heavy outlines. Suits superhero and sci-fi armour looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Armor_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and cuff; colour 1 on the large inset panel; colour 2 on the outlines and edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Alien_01.description: A left forearm bracer in alien armour style: a tapered shell with a pointed cuff at the elbow, banded chevron plates down toward the wrist, and a curved separate panel along the outer side. Small curved spikes run along the edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and band ridges; colour 1 on the large outer side panel; colour 2 on the recessed bands between plates; colour 3 on the spikes.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Bracer_Amazon_01.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapered, angled shell that rises to a pointed flap at the elbow end and ends in a V-shaped cuff at the wrist. Layered folded bands wrap the upper edge, with a geometric emblem on the flap.
