Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Goth_0.description: A stack of bracers worn at the left wrist: a wide faceted band studded with round bumps, a thin ring underneath, and a tilted thin angular hoop rising above it. Gothic, punk styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Goth_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wide studded band; colour 3 on the studs; colour 0 on the upper hoop; colour 2 on the lower ring.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Hammer.description: A chunky left-forearm bracer made of a flared, boxy cuff at the wrist with two separate rounded rectangular blocks stacked up the forearm above it. Bulky, armor-like and stylised.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Hammer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large wrist cuff; colour 1 on the two stacked forearm blocks.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Krampu.description: A heavy chain wound in several tangled loops around the left forearm just above the wrist, forming a chunky bracelet-like bracer. Rough, gritty style suggesting punk, gothic or monstrous costumes.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Krampu.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all the chain links; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mecha_.description: A flat, elongated blade-shaped plate hanging beside the left hand, with a slanted pointed tip and a bordered frame holding three inset panels. It has a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mecha_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame and edges; colour 3 on the two large inset panels; colour 2 on the small middle panel.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mecha_.description: A long, slim rectangular blade-like blaster block hanging beside the hip, detached from the forearm. It has a flat plate with recessed inset strips and a boxy casing, giving a mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mecha_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer casing and end cap; colour 0 on the thin edge plate and top tip; colour 3 on the recessed strips; colour 2 on the flat inner side panel.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Mecha_.differs: The male piece is a little thinner and longer, and hangs closer to the body.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Modern.description: A small angular bracer on the left wrist: a thick band around the cuff with a tapering, pointed plate that extends down over the back of the hand. Sleek, plated, modern armoured look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Modern.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrist band; colour 0 on the tapered plate over the hand.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Moth_0.description: Three separate curved, tapering spikes in a row along the outer left forearm, each pointing down toward the wrist like moth-inspired thorns or claws. Sharp, angular and monstrous accents.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Moth_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all three spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retro_.description: A chunky forearm-mounted rotary minigun: a ribbed cylindrical housing with a banded collar, a side mounting bracket, and a cluster of long parallel barrels with ring clamps extending past the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retro_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed housing; colour 2 on the collar band, top cap and bracket; colour 0 on the barrels and barrel rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retro_.description: A detached, snaking segmented cable of stacked ribbed metal rings with small spikes along its edge, ending in a boxy block at the upper arm and arching over the shoulder and back. Industrial, post-apocalyptic warlord look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retro_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed ring segments; colour 1 on the spiky edge tips and ring edges; colour 2 on the boxy end block and inner rings.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Retro_.differs: The male version is longer and arcs out over the shoulder and upper back, while the female version curves across the chest.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Sandst.description: A small left forearm bracer: a faceted, shield-like angular plate standing off the outer arm, mounted on a chunky segmented band that wraps the arm. Sits on the upper forearm near the elbow.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Sandst.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular plate; colour 2 on the band around the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Shield.description: A heater-style heraldic shield strapped to the left forearm, with a pointed lower edge, notched sides and a thick raised rim. A swooping crest sits at the centre and two grip slots show on the back.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shield face and upper wings; colour 1 on the inner field panels; colour 3 on the central crest; colour 2 on the rim and back.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Shield.differs: The male shield is held out more from the forearm, facing forward and looking slightly larger.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Swan_0.description: A feathery cuff that wraps around the left wrist and hand, made of overlapping jagged, pointed plumes that fall around the fist, with a flat closed top. Soft, fluffy and decorative, with a fantasy or elegant feel.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Swan_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plumes, fading toward colour 1 at the feather tips; colour 1 on the flat top cap.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syring.description: A cyberpunk wrist rig: a small cylindrical hub at the wrist feeds bundled cables to four syringe needles that hang past the hand like claws, with extra cabled canisters floating off the forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syring.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hub, canister caps and needle housings; colour 1 on the needle tips and small connector bands; colour 2 on the canister bodies and needle barrels; colour 3 on the cables.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syring.differs: The canisters are spread further apart along the forearm, with one canister angled away from the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syring.description: A wrist-mounted syringe rig: a cylindrical metal cuff on the back of the wrist feeds bundled tubes to four long needle injectors over the hand, while two more tubes run up the forearm to capped canisters.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Syring.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, canister caps and injector barrels; colour 3 on the tubes; colour 1 on the needle tips and connector fittings; colour 2 on the injector bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Victor.description: A small angular band worn on the left upper arm, with a V-shaped front and two swept-up pointed fins. A contrasting stripe runs along the edge above a contrasting underside. Suits a superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Victor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper swept fins; colour 1 on the stripe along the band; colour 2 on the lower edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Weapon.description: A pair of long, narrow blade claws that extend downward from the left fist, side by side with a gap between them and tapering to sharp points with a small notch on the edge. Reads as a fantasy or superhero hand weapon.

A single long, narrow blade projecting downward from the left wrist past the hand, flanked by curved fin-like blades on either side. Angular and sharp, it suggests a sentai-style hero gauntlet weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Weapon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central blade; colour 1 on the curved side blades; colour 2 on the blade edge shading.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Wires_.description: A small curved armor plate worn on the outside of the left wrist, a half-shell with a pointed, swept-back edge and a thin raised rim, fastened by two round rivet-like studs.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Bracer_Wires_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 1 on the rim edge; colour 3 on the two studs; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A pair of long curved blade spikes projecting downward from the left fist, swept and jagged like claws, with a sharp outer edge and a contrasting inner panel. Fantasy-monstrous weapon-like bracer.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade spikes and ridges; colour 1 on the broad blade face panels; colour 2 on the inner recess of the blades.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.differs: The male version has the two blades set close together, overlapping when seen from the front, rather than spread apart.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A long curved energy blade that projects from the left forearm past the hand, thin and tapering to a sharp point, with a fractured crackling surface and a broad base near the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: The whole blade glows and ignores the colour scheme, so no slot visibly applies.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A long, curved energy blade projecting from the left forearm and sweeping down past the thigh to a sharp point. It is thin and crescent-shaped, with a cracked, crystalline surface pattern suggesting a psionic weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: The whole blade appears to ignore the colour scheme, showing a glowing surface with veined cracks; no visible slot colours.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, hovering as a thin plate beside the left wrist, facing outward. It suggests a science or energy superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the rings; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating as a thin plate just beside the left forearm near the wrist. Sci-fi superhero decoration with no straps or bracer body.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rings of the emblem; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating beside the left wrist like a badge. It is a thin, planar decal-like piece with an outlined edge, suggesting a sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring faces; colour 1 on the outer edge outline of the rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A thin, flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating beside the left wrist like a small shield. It is edge-on from the front and reads as a decorative superhero badge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings of the emblem; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A flat, paper-thin atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central disc, floating just off the outer side of the left wrist. It is nearly edge-on from the front and back.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and central disc; colour 1 on the outlines and edges of the rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A long curved blade-like spike with jagged serrated barbs along its outer edge, extending from the forearm past the hand and down toward the thigh. The thin inner edge is a separate layer, giving a menacing, sci-fi claw look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main serrated blade body; colour 1 on the thin inner edge layer.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Phantom.description: A slim, angular fin-like blade running along the outer left forearm, with a pointed flare near the elbow that tapers to a sharp point at the wrist. Sits flush on the sleeve as a sleek superhero accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Phantom.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade fin; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Retrosc.description: A thin, translucent glass bracer panel curving partway around the outer left forearm just above the wrist. It is a narrow, slightly tapered shell with a glossy edge, suggesting a retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Child_Tight_Retrosc.colourAreas: The glass panel ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slots are visible on it.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: An angular, faceted bracer worn on the outer left forearm: a tapered plated shell with a stepped side panel and a flared upper tip, ending in a small open port at the wrist. Sci-fi armour styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper tip and side edge; colour 1 on the stepped side panel and trim; colour 2 on the large textured outer shell; colour 3 on the small inner detail at the wrist opening.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Cyberclaw_01.description: A cybernetic claw gauntlet at the left wrist: a set of long, curved blade-like claws fan out over the hand, mounted on a contrasting segmented base with exposed cable-like struts and small joints.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Cyberclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw blades; colour 2 on the segmented base blocks; colour 3 on the cables and struts; colour 1 on the small joint pieces at the base.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Cyberclaw_02.description: A set of three long, curved blade claws that sweep out and up from a small base at the left fist, splayed in two groups. Sharp, angular and metallic, it suggests a feral cyborg-style weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Cyberclaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blades and base; the material appears mostly metallic, so the other colour slots are barely visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Cybermind_02.description: A cybernetic left forearm bracer shaped like a tapered cup with panelled sections, with a smooth segmented cable curving up the upper arm to a small connector at the shoulder. Suggests sci-fi cyborg styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Cybermind_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, cable and upper bracer; colour 1 on the lower bracer panels; colour 3 on the square front panel and connector accents; colour 2 on the bracer base and cable bands.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Cybermind_02.differs: The male bracer has contrasting panels and a smoother, lighter cable with contrasting bands, while the female version is a plain single-tone shell with a ribbed contrasting cable.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.description: A single curved blade claw held in the left fist, with a thin handle rod that ends in a small cap, a chunky angular guard, and a long tapered blade sweeping forward and outward from the hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade body; colour 2 on the blade's underside edge and the handle cap; colour 1 on the guard; colour 3 on the handle rod.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.differs: The blade sweeps forward and outward from the fist, whereas the female blade points straight down along the leg.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.description: A single long curved cyber blade held in the left fist: a flat tapering metal blade with a swept, pointed tip, mounted on thin angular linkage rods and small block fittings at the grip. It angles upward past the forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the thin linkage rods; colour 2 on the small block fittings; colour 1 on the small fins at the grip.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.differs: The male blade angles upward along the forearm, while the female blade points sideways, almost horizontal, out from the fist.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.description: A single curved blade claw held in the left fist: a long, flat, tapering metal blade sweeping upward to a fine point, mounted on a small grip bracket with thin strut arms. Suggests a cyberpunk, sci-fi weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the grip bracket block and the strut tip caps; colour 3 on the thin strut arms; colour 1 on the small fin at the base of the grip.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.differs: The blade angles upward from the fist along the forearm, instead of lying nearly horizontal and pointing sideways as on the female.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_04.description: A single curved cyber blade held in the left fist: a long, flat, tapering claw that sweeps to a fine point, with thin strut-like rods and small tabs at the grip. A sleek, sci-fi hand weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the thin grip struts; colour 2 on the small block tabs at the handle; colour 1 on the small fin at the knuckle.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_04.differs: The blade rises upward and back from the fist on struts that hang below the hand, whereas the female blade angles forward and out along the wrist line.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_05.description: A single slim curved blade held in the left fist, a flat tapering metal edge with a pointed tip and a fine serrated back edge. Small hilt pieces at the grip; the blade angles upward, giving a cyber-weapon look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the small hilt block at the grip. The thin and marker lines near the hilt look like helper guides rather than part of the piece.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberclaw_05.differs: The blade angles upward and outward across the hand, rather than pointing horizontally forward.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_01.description: A single angular blade-like shard held in the left fist, a faceted wedge that tapers to a sharp point and projects downward from the hand. Suggests a cybernetic or sci-fi claw weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted base of the shard; colour 2 on the tapering blade faces. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_02.description: A single slim, curved blade-like claw held in the left fist, rising along the forearm and sweeping to a sharp tip. Angular faceted metal shard with a flat broad base, suggesting a cyborg weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; the default metal shows little variation from the other slots.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_02.differs: The blade angles upward along the forearm instead of pointing sideways out of the fist.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_03.description: A single curved metal blade claw projecting from the left fist, a flat tapering shard that angles upward past the wrist to a fine point. It reads as a retractable cybernetic weapon in a sci-fi style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; colour 2 on the underside edge. The default metal mostly ignores the other colour slots.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_03.differs: The male blade angles upward along the forearm from the fist, while the female blade extends forward and down.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_04.description: A single long, narrow blade-like claw held in the left fist, widening at the grip end and curving into a thin pointed tip that extends well past the knuckles. Suggests a cybernetic or sci-fi weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; the faceted edges show shading but no other colour slot is visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_05.description: A single slender blade-like claw held in the left fist, a tapered angular shard with a flat wedge base that curves to a sharp point; it angles upward out of the hand with a sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade; the default material shows little variation from the other slots.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cybershard_05.differs: The male claw angles upward and outward from the fist, rather than pointing sideways.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_01.description: A small cybernetic claw blade for the left hand: a thin rod runs from a hexagonal base on the back of the hand to a flat, barbed arrowhead-shaped blade that hangs over the knuckles.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hexagonal base; colour 3 on the thin rod; colour 1 on the barbed blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_02.description: A small cyber-claw hand accessory: a flat plate sits on the side of the fist, with a thin bent rod rising to a small capped tip and a long rod running to a flat blade-like barb at the fingers.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plate and rod tip cap; colour 3 on the bent rod; colour 1 on the arrowhead-shaped barb near the fingers.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_02.differs: The male version has a longer rod that runs from the plate to a larger arrowhead-shaped barb at the fingers.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_03.description: A minimal cyber claw accessory for the left hand: a thin bent rod with a small capped tip rising above the fist, a flat rectangular plate at the bend, and a pointed blade attached at the rod's lower end.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bent rod; colour 2 on the rod's cap and the flat plate; colour 1 on the pointed blade.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_03.differs: The pointed blade is joined to the lower end of the rod, and the flat plate sits right at the rod's bend.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_04.description: A small cyber claw accessory on the left fist: a thin bent rod with a hexagonal cap at one end, a flat curved plate at the knuckle bend and an arrow-shaped blade tip at the other end. Sci-fi cyberpunk look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bent rod; colour 2 on the end cap and the knuckle plate; colour 1 on the arrow-shaped blade tip.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_04.differs: The arrow-shaped blade tip is attached at the end of the rod, rather than floating separately near the front of the fist.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_05.description: A tiny cyber claw accessory on the left hand: a thin bent wire rod with a small blocky cap at one end, a flat plate at the elbow of the bend and a small arrow-shaped blade tip at the other end, lying along the fist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Cyberwire_05.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bent wire rod; colour 2 on the end cap and the flat plate; colour 1 on the arrow-shaped blade tip.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Insect_01.description: A long, curved insect-style blade mounted on the left forearm by a short contrasting peg. It sweeps up past the elbow and down past the wrist, with a row of small serrated spikes along its inner edge. Suits monstrous or alien looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower blade body; colour 1 on the upper blade tip, blending in from the base; colour 3 on the serration spikes; colour 2 on the mounting peg.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Insect_02.description: A long curved insect-like blade mounted on a short cylindrical cuff at the left wrist, sweeping down past the hand in a tapering point, with a row of small serrated spikes along its inner edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Insect_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper blade; colour 1 on the lower tip of the blade, blending in from the top; colour 3 on the serrated spikes; colour 2 on the wrist mount.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_01.description: A simple chunky band ring with a faceted, roughly hexagonal outline and a wide hollow centre, worn around a finger of the left hand. Plain and low-poly with no stones or engraving.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring band; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_02.description: A chunky hexagonal band ring worn on a finger of the left hand, with a hollow six-sided opening and flat faceted sides. Reads as a simple, nut-like metal ring.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the default metal shows a glossy sheen and ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_03.description: A small chunky ring with a hexagonal, nut-like profile and a hexagonal hole through the middle, worn around a finger of the left hand. Plain and heavy, with a metallic industrial look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the glossy metal shading ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_04.description: A small chunky hexagonal band ring worn on a finger of the left hand, with a thick faceted profile and a hexagonal hole through the middle, like a nut. Simple, plain jewellery.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metallic default material shows little variation from the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Hand_Ring_Basic_05.description: A small chunky ring with a hexagonal, faceted band and a hexagonal hole, worn around a finger of the left hand. Simple, low-poly and blocky in shape.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arcane_Armban.description: A snug octagonal armband worn on the upper left arm, with a broad main band, thin edge trim at top and bottom, swirling tentacle-like engraved motifs, and chunky faceted round gems studded around its circumference.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arcane_Armban.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the top and bottom edge trim; colour 3 on the swirling motifs; colour 1 on the faceted gems.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Card_01.description: A gathered, ruffled armband worn on the upper left arm, with a smooth contrasting band around the middle and a pair of playing cards tucked upright into the top edge. Suggests a gambler or magician look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Card_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled frill edges; colour 1 on the central band; colour 3 on the playing cards; colour 2 on the card markings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Cyber_Cow.description: A small cylindrical canister with a faceted body, worn on the outer upper left arm. A bent pipe rises from the top and a short elbow pipe ends in a round flared nozzle below. Suggests a cyber-western gadget.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Cyber_Cow.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the canister body; colour 2 on the pipes, top cap and lower nozzle. Colours 0 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Cyberwire.description: A tapered armband worn on the upper left arm: a wrinkled, cloth-like cuff dipping to a point at the underside, with thin rimmed edges, a wide central strap band and a round button-like stud on the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Cyberwire.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cuff body; colour 0 on the thin rims along the edges; colour 2 on the wide central band; colour 3 on the round stud.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Martial_P.description: A segmented upper-arm guard of horizontal layered plates in a contrasting frame, curved around the left upper arm and held by two cloth straps, with small looped cord knots on top. Martial, east-asian style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Martial_P.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates; colour 2 on the frame and plate dividers; colour 1 on the cloth straps; colour 3 on the looped knots.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Martial_P.description: A curved armband of stacked horizontal slats inside a rigid rim, wrapping the outer side of the upper left arm. Small looped cords stick up from the top edge. Martial, armored look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Martial_P.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the slat panels; colour 2 on the rim and the dividing bands; colour 3 on the looped cords at the top.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Power_01.description: A short armband worn high on the left upper arm: a tapered band with a flat, shield-shaped cap on top, framed by raised rims at the top and bottom edges. Reads as a simple superhero or sci-fi arm guard.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top cap and the raised rims; colour 1 on the main band between the rims; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Steelarac.description: A chunky segmented armoured band wrapped around the left upper arm, with stacked curved plates on the front and a raised, angular flared edge at the top. Small rivet-like holes sit along one side; it suits sci-fi or superhero armour.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Steelarac.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back plating, the top flared edge and the side plates; colour 1 on the front stacked band plates; colour 2 on the gaps between the plate segments.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Toy_01.description: A snug armband worn on the upper left arm, with a shield-shaped front plate framed by a raised rim and embossed with a heart symbol. A wraparound strap overlaps at the side, giving a playful, retro-toy look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Arm_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate face; colour 1 on the rim edging and strap edging; colour 2 on the raised heart emblem; colour 3 on the wrap strap band.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armarmor_01.description: A short armored band worn around the left upper arm: a rounded-hex cuff with a raised rim at both ends, large padded oval plates front and back, and a segmented ridged strip along the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the band; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 2 on the large padded plates; colour 3 on the segmented side strip.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armband_01.description: A wide cloth band wrapped snugly around the upper left arm, knotted at the back with two short pointed tails hanging down. Soft creased folds give it a casual bandana-like look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armband_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band and knot tails; the folds show shading only.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandchain_.description: A chunky, faceted armband worn on the upper left arm: a wide band with a bevelled rim and a flat oval top face, with small knob-like bolts and loop rings on the sides for hanging chains.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandchain_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bevelled upper rim; colour 1 on the lower band; colour 3 on the flat top face; colour 2 on the side knobs and loop rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandtied_0.description: A narrow cloth armband wrapped around the upper left arm and tied in a knot at the back, with two short pointed tails hanging down. Casual, simple, cloth bandana-style accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandtied_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band, knot and tails; the piece shows no other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandwing_0.description: A slim armband worn on the left upper arm, with an open overlapping strap and a single pointed wing-like fin rising from the outer side. Sharp, angular demonic accent in a fantasy style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandwing_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and wing surface; colour 1 on the edging and rim of the band and wing.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandwing_0.description: A snug armband worn around the upper arm with a single flat, curved blade-like wing projecting sideways from it. The wing sweeps upward to a point and has grooved line details, giving a superhero or fantasy look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armbandwing_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armband; colour 3 on the wing; colour 2 on the grooves and edge lines of the wing and the band's trim lines.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armor_Extrate.description: A left forearm bracer of chunky segmented plates with carved angular glyph patterns and a small raised rounded fin near the elbow end, plus a separate floating band higher on the upper forearm. Weathered, ancient-relic look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armor_Extrate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces and band; colour 1 on the glyph line inlays and the inner fin; colour 2 on the weathered patches and edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armorbasic_01.description: A tapered sci-fi forearm bracer with a faceted open cuff, recessed slot vents on the outer face, thin trim lines, and stacked contrasting ridged bands near the wrist. Sits over the left forearm as sleek armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armorbasic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell and rim; colour 1 on the inner lining, vent slots and thin trim lines; colour 3 on the rear slot inserts; colour 2 on the ridged bands near the wrist.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_02.description: A tapered armored bracer for the left forearm, built from angular faceted plates with a cut-out opening near the elbow, pointed fin-like spikes at the top and small vent lights near the wrist. Sci-fi tactical look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the pointed spikes and the rim at the wrist; colour 3 on the small light marks near the wrist; colour 2 on the shadowed inner surfaces.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armpouch_01.description: A thin flat strap armband circling the upper left arm in a faceted loop, with a raised rectangular pouch plate on the outer side holding two vertical inset slots. Sits snug on the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armpouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and pouch plate frame; colour 1 on the inset slots and on the strap's inner edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armpouch_01.differs: The male band is a thin flat strap, while the female version is a thicker, deeper cuff with a bowl-like opening.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armtrumpknigh.description: A faceted armoured elbow band with pointed flared edges and a large round disc mounted on its outer side. The disc face carries a radiating star-like pattern, in a knightly superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armtrumpknigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the disc face; colour 2 on the star-like pattern on the disc. Colours 1 and 3 are not clearly visible on this sheet.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Armtrumpknigh.differs: The male disc has a radiating star-like pattern and a band with pointed flared edges, while the female disc has a plain central stripe and a small marking.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bicepknife_01.description: A combat knife strapped to the upper left arm by a thin, faceted band. The blade points downward along the outside of the arm, with a crossguard and a short handle above. Suggests a tactical, military look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bicepknife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm band; colour 1 on a small inner strip of the band; colour 2 on the handle and crossguard; colour 3 on the blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A small faceted band worn around the left upper arm, with a raised angular plate on the outer face that flares slightly outward. It reads as a compact, armor-like cuff with a simple rounded-polygon outline.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole band and its raised plate; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bolts_01.description: A pair of small oversized hex bolts with round heads and short shanks, floating against the upper left arm; one has a curved backing plate. A quirky industrial decoration for tech or sci-fi looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bolts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all parts of the bolts, including heads, shanks and backing plates; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bolts_01.differs: The male bolts are plain, all one colour, without the contrasting rings under the heads seen on the female version.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_01.description: A left forearm bracer with a cuff around the wrist and a long, curved blade-like spike sweeping down past the hand along the outer side. It has a cracked, energy-veined surface and suggests a psychic weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_01.colourAreas: The default material ignores the colour scheme, so the cuff and blade show a translucent, glowing veined look; no visible colour slots are distinguishable.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.description: A plain tapered forearm bracer worn on the left arm, a smooth sleeve-like cuff with faceted octagonal trim bands at the elbow end and the wrist end. Clean, simple superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the trim bands at both ends.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.description: A short tapered forearm bracer with an octagonal cuff at each end and a tall angular cross-like plate along the outer edge, giving a faceted, angelic armored look on the left forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the rim bands at the top and bottom; colour 3 on the angular outer plate.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.differs: The male plate is a taller, cross-like shape extending further along the forearm, rather than the smaller notched plate on the female.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.description: A short tapered bracer covering the left forearm, with contrasting trim rings at the elbow and wrist ends and a long curved, pointed blade sweeping up from the outer edge past the elbow. Angelic sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer body; colour 1 on the trim rings at both ends; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.description: A short tapered forearm bracer with an angular armored plate on the outer side and a long curved scythe-like blade sweeping backward from it. Rimmed cuffs at both ends give it a fantasy angelic-warrior look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer sleeve; colour 1 on the cuff rims; colour 3 on the angular outer plate; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Annive.description: A smooth, snug cloth bracer covering the forearm from below the elbow to the knuckles, with a fingerless hand section and a rigid rounded plate on the outer edge of the hand fitted with three round studs.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Annive.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm sleeve and hand cover; colour 1 on the side hand plate; colour 2 on the studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Arcane.description: A tight, flared bracer worn on the left forearm, with pointed angular flaps at the elbow end and a slanted cuff edge at the wrist. Swirling scrollwork runs across the surface, with raised oval and hexagonal studs on the outer side. Suggests a mystic, arcane look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Arcane.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 3 on the swirling scroll patterns; colour 1 on the oval and hexagonal gem studs; colour 2 on the pointed elbow flaps and trim edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Archer.description: A left-arm archer bracer: a separate band around the upper arm, plus a forearm guard with a side panel held by two wide rings near the elbow and two stacked rings at the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Archer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bands and rings; colour 1 on the forearm guard panel; colour 2 on the inserts inside the guard and band; colour 3 on the thin edge strip.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Bandag.description: A left forearm bandage wrap: overlapping diagonal strips of cloth spiral around the lower forearm just above the wrist, with visible gaps between windings and small stitch marks across the strips. Suits fighters, street and casual looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Bandag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some of the wrapping strips; colour 1 on alternating strips; colour 3 on the other alternating strips; colour 2 on the stitch marks.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Bandag.description: A tight wrapped-cloth bandage bracer on the left forearm, with criss-crossing strips of stitched, patched cloth in alternating bands and one long loose tail trailing down past the hand. Suits a street or fighter look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Bandag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base wrap and the long trailing strip; colour 1 on the wrap bands at the ends and some diagonal strips; colour 3 on the other diagonal strips; colour 2 on the stitching.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.description: A chunky angular bracer worn on the left forearm, with a faceted outer shell that tapers toward the wrist, a raised pointed ridge at the elbow end and an open hollow underside. Light stripes give it a sci-fi blaster look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer shell; colour 3 on the inner lining and underside; colour 0 on the stripes and the small inset panels.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.description: A chunky angular blaster bracer worn on the left forearm: a faceted shell with a raised peak at the back, a hollow inner cradle and a stepped lower edge. Suggests a sci-fi superhero weapon gauntlet.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 3 on the inner lining and rear edge; colour 0 on the stripes and small inset panels.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.differs: The male version has a flatter, more closed lower edge with barrels barely visible, rather than protruding muzzles at the wrist.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.description: A rigid armored bracer worn on the left forearm: angular segmented plates wrap the arm with an open channel along the front, a pointed fin rising at the elbow end, and small vent-like marks near both ends.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the elbow fin and small inset panels; colour 3 on the small marks near the edges; colour 2 on the inner edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.description: A bulky sci-fi blaster bracer on the left forearm: an angular armored casing with a vented panel and small round lights, a cylindrical canister at the side, a barrel nozzle by the wrist, hazard striping and a looped cable handle.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armored casing and canister bands; colour 1 on the canister, barrel nozzle and looped cable; colour 2 on the vent grille; colour 3 on the small round lights and the hazard stripe accents.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blockb.description: A chunky sci-fi bracer on the left forearm: a rounded armored shell with a notched lower edge, a cuff band at the top, and octagonal sockets with round lens-like studs near the elbow and wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blockb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and wrist flare; colour 1 on the upper cuff band; colour 2 on the octagonal socket housings; colour 3 on the round centre lenses.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blockb.description: A chunky sci-fi left forearm bracer with a wide, flared armored shell that tapers to a snug cuff at the wrist. Angular panels frame recessed contrasting inserts with glowing-style oval details; open at the elbow end.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Blockb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor shell; colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the recessed inner panels; colour 3 on the oval insert details.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Child_.description: A long, narrow chainsaw-blade bracer extending down from the fist past the hand, with a slotted central channel, ridged edges and a row of curved spikes like saw teeth along the sides, ending in claw-like points.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Child_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main blade body and ridged edges; colour 2 on the spikes, claw tips and slot interior.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Child_.description: A set of four long, curved blade claws that extend from the knuckles of the left hand and sweep downward past the fist, forming a Wolverine-style set of slashing talons.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Child_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all four claw blades; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Child_.description: A pair of small feathers joined at one point on the outside of the left wrist, one angled back along the forearm and one hanging down past the hand. A light tribal or fantasy accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Child_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both feathers; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Chimer.description: A tight forearm bracer covered in overlapping feather-like scales, with jagged, spiky edges at both the elbow and wrist ends. It sits snugly over the left forearm and suggests a beastly, monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Chimer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper scales near the elbow; colour 1 on the middle scales; colour 2 on the scales and jagged tips at the wrist end.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.description: A left forearm bracer of stitched panels with a flared rim at the elbow end and a hinged wrist cuff. Two short, thick blade claws project past the wrist along the back of the hand, giving a feral look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell and cuff; colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the stitching; colour 2 on the claw blades and rivet.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.differs: The male claws are shorter, thicker contrasting blades that only reach the wrist, and the bracer is bulkier.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.description: A left forearm bracer with a stitched, baseball-like wrap band and a metal cuff at the wrist, from which two long, narrow serrated blades extend past the hand. Suggests a street or superhero claw weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rims, blades and stitched band edges; colour 1 on the panels of the bracer band; colour 3 on the stitching.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_C.description: A bulky mechanical chainsaw bracer strapped to the left forearm, with a boxy engine housing at the wrist and a long toothed blade extending well past the hand, edged with spikes and a claw-like tip.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_C.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the engine housing and blade body; colour 1 on the inset panels of the housing; colour 2 on the band at the wrist and the blade teeth; colour 0 is barely visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_D.description: A serpentine dragon coiled in loops around the left forearm, with a spined ridge along the body. Two horned dragon heads sit at the wrist, each with a long curved blade claw reaching past the hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_D.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the dragon bodies and heads; colour 2 on the spines along the coils; colour 0 on the claw blades; colour 3 on the inner blade streaks.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_D.differs: The male version has two dragon heads, each with its own claw blade, whereas the female version has a single head.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_F.description: A left wrist bracer with a slim cuff band and a shaggy fur mass draping over the back of the hand, with four long curved blades extending past the knuckles. A feral, beastlike claw look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff band; colour 3 on the small studs and the marking on the cuff; colour 2 on the fur; colour 1 on the claw blades.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_S.description: A tribal wrist and hand piece shaped like a skull mask that covers the back of the hand, with long curved claw-like fangs hanging past the knuckles, bound on with cord wraps and a trailing cluster of feathers.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_S.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skull shell; colour 0 on the claws and feathers; colour 2 on the cord wraps; colour 1 on the thin inner cord accents.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_S.description: A left forearm bracer bound with layered cord wraps and thin pegs, with a large curved bone-like claw spike jutting past the wrist and hand. It has a flared rim at the elbow end. Primitive, tribal look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_S.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the claw spike; colour 3 on the flared rim and the lower edge; colour 2 on the bracer body under the cords; colour 0 on the cord wraps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_T.description: A left forearm bracer shaped like a organic thorned claw: a long panel with curling vine-like loops at the wrist, rows of small spikes along the edge, and a serrated blade extending past the hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Claw_T.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curling frame, loops and serrated blade; colour 3 on the central panel; colour 0 on the small thorn spikes.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Coil_0.description: A slim helical coil that winds around the left forearm in about three and a half loops, with tapered pointed ends at top and bottom. It reads as a simple wire spring bracer.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Cyber_.description: A short left forearm bracer made of a thick curved plate with a raised rim and rivets, plus a smaller overlapping cuff panel near the wrist. It wraps the forearm like a rugged western-style guard.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Cyber_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 2 on the rim, edging and back of the bracer; colour 3 on the lower wrist panel; colour 1 on the rivets.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Cyber_.description: A left forearm bracer made of two separate angular plates, a larger front plate with a raised rim and three curved horn spikes along its outer edge, and a smaller rear plate. Worn on the forearm below the elbow with a rugged cyber-western look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Cyber_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 2 on the rims and edges; colour 3 on the three spikes; colour 1 on small rivet accents on the rear plate.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Dragon.description: A serpentine dragon coiled in a spiral around the forearm, its tail tapering to a point at the elbow end and a horned, spiny head resting at the wrist. Scale-like belly ridges with tooth-like markings suggest a fantasy or east-asian style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Dragon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dragon's body and head; colour 1 on the back ridge, horns and fins; colour 3 on the tooth-like belly markings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Dragon.description: A serpentine dragon coiled in a spiral around the left forearm, with a tapering tail tip near the elbow and a horned, finned head resting at the wrist. Toothlike markings run along the belly of the coil.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Dragon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer body of the coil and the head; colour 1 on the inner ridged back of the coils, the fins and the horns; colour 3 on the tooth-like belly markings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Draycu.description: A tight plated bracer wrapping the left forearm, with riveted angular plates and a sculpted snarling monster face on the outer side, its open mouth holding a bulbous gem and ringed with contrasting claw-like fangs.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Draycu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and face; colour 1 on the edge trim and panel lines; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth gem; colour 2 on the fangs.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.description: A slim forearm bracer on the left arm with an ornate engraved band, sprouting a fan of layered feathers that sweep upward and back past the elbow. Fantasy or superhero winged look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bracer band and its engraved trim; colour 2 on the inner layer of feathers; colour 3 on the outer long feathers.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.differs: The male feathers stand up and flare away from the arm, rather than lying flat along it as on the female.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.description: A wrist bracer with a round cuff and a wide fan of long, pointed feather blades splaying back from the forearm. Layered feather panels with small light details give a sci-fi winged gauntlet look on the left arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff ring; colour 0 on the central feather panels; colour 2 on the outer feather blades; colour 3 on the small indicator marks and cuff detail.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.differs: The feather fan splays wider and further out from the forearm, where the female version lies close and flat along the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Fin_01.description: A slim left forearm bracer made of stacked, overlapping curved plates, each ending in a long swept-back fin spike. The plates hug the outer forearm and give it a sharp, predatory, aquatic-monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled plate surfaces; colour 3 on the spotted speckle markings across the plates; colour 1 on the fin edges and rims; colour 2 in the shaded plate gradients.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Fin_02.description: A slim bracer of three curved, blade-like fins stacked along the outer forearm, each swept back to a sharp point, with a thin edging around each fin. Creature-inspired and armour-like.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin surfaces; colour 1 on the edging around each fin; colour 3 on the speckled markings; colour 2 on the shading at the fin bases.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadroo.description: A curved, open-sided bracer plate that wraps the outer half of the left forearm from wrist to below the elbow. Its glossy, semi-transparent surface has etched circuit-board line patterns, giving a sci-fi tech look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadroo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; the etched circuit lines pick up a coppery metallic sheen that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadroo.description: A tall, tapering teardrop-shaped shield blade that hangs beside the left forearm, pointed at the top and rounded at the wrist end. It has a hollow, glassy shell with a thin edge rim and a sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadroo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell body; colour 1 on the inner surface; the glossy translucent material largely ignores the rest of the scheme.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Gadroo.differs: The male shield is a wider blade that wraps closer around the fist and wrist, with a broader base.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Golden.description: A small round shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm by a short cuff band, with a raised star on its face over concentric rings. Patriotic golden-age superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Golden.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield's outer rim; colour 3 on the inner ring; colour 1 on the star; colour 2 on the forearm cuff and shield back.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Golden.description: A small round shield worn on the outside of the left forearm, fixed by a short cuff band at the wrist. It has a thick rim and a printed atom emblem on its face, in a retro superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Golden.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shield face; colour 0 on the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and back of the shield; colour 3 on the wrist cuff.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Golden.differs: The shield sits more upright and further out from the forearm, with a smaller cuff band than the female version.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Hammer.description: A chunky armored forearm bracer with stacked padded segments and small round vents, ending in a fist guard with a large blocky hammer head jutting out from the knuckles. Worn on the left forearm and hand, with a heroic, heavy-hitter look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Hammer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hammer head, the bracer end cap and the inner band; colour 1 on the padded cuff segments and knuckle guard; colour 2 on the small vent holes.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Hammer.description: A chunky left bracer built from two stacked octagonal rings with small round vents, padded cushion blocks on the outer side, and a large boxy hammer-like cuff that extends over the back of the hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Hammer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and the large boxy cuff; colour 1 on the padded cushion blocks; colour 2 on the small round vent holes.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Holohe.description: A floating holographic field of jagged, angular hexagonal shards hovering along the left forearm, with a larger spiky cluster near the elbow and a smaller burst by the wrist. It does not touch the arm and suggests a sci-fi energy effect.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Holohe.colourAreas: Colour slots do not visibly apply; the whole field shows as a single glowing energy effect that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Inmate.description: A chunky left forearm bracer made of stacked armored plates with angular panels, held on by several buckled straps along the outer side, and a short dangling chain hanging from the wrist edge. Prison-inspired, rugged look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Inmate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plates; colour 2 on the recessed angular panels, lower cuff and chain; colour 3 on the straps; colour 1 on small strap buckles.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Inmate.description: A thick padded cuff worn on the left wrist, like a prisoner's shackle, with a single length of chunky chain hanging from its underside down past the hand. Suggests a prison or punk look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Inmate.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the chain links.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Martia.description: A snug tubular bracer covering the left forearm, wrapped with crossing bands in a zigzag pattern over a smooth cloth sleeve, with thin contrasting trim rings at the wrist and upper edge. A martial-arts style look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Martia.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 2 on the crossing straps; colour 1 on the trim rings at the top and wrist edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Martia.description: A tight leather-look forearm bracer with a padded rolled cuff at the top and a pointed, angled lower edge toward the wrist; angular T-shaped and chevron panels run down the outer face. Martial-arts, superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Martia.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim trim; colour 2 on the angular T-shaped and chevron overlay panels; colour 3 on the wedge inset beneath the T.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Mech_0.description: A tapered armored forearm bracer with a flared rolled cuff at the elbow end, a raised back fin, ribbed stepped plates along the front and a perforated inset panel on the back. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Mech_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 3 on the ribbed slashes and thin outline piping; colour 1 on the perforated back panel and side inset; colour 2 on the inner opening and fin.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Night_.description: A tight left forearm bracer with a segmented, panelled plate body, a flared open cuff that swoops up at the elbow end, a rounded round boss on the side and a thin flanged rim at the wrist. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Night_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared cuff and wrist rim; colour 2 on the main panelled body; colour 1 on the piping between panels and cuff; colour 3 on the round boss and the small strip near the top.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Night_.description: A chunky, rounded forearm bracer with a flared cuff, an octagonal disc with concentric rings on the outer side, a ribbed segmented panel and contrasting side insets. Sits on the left forearm above the wrist; superhero sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Night_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and cuff rims; colour 1 on the side insets; colour 2 on the ribbed panel; colour 3 on the centre of the disc.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Night_.description: A set of three long, thin blade claws that project from the back of the left fist and extend well past the knuckles, like retractable slashers. Flat, angular and pointed, with a feral look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Night_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main blade faces; colour 0 on the blade edges; colour 2 on the reverse sides of the blades.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Night_.differs: The three blades are spread wider apart with clear gaps between them, rather than bundled tightly together.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Night_.description: A small left bracer with a rounded rectangular armor plate on the outer forearm, embossed with stacked chevron ridges, held by two wide straps with small tabs that wrap around the forearm near the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Night_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate frame and chevron ridges; colour 1 on the recessed panels between the ridges; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the strap tabs.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nightm.description: A spiky armored bracer for the left forearm and hand, with a flared, jagged cuff plate and long curved blades sweeping down past the fist. Suggests a contrasting fantasy or villain look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nightm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff plates and blade edges; colour 3 on the striped inset panels; colour 1 on the outer blade edges; colour 2 on the inner recesses and blade undersides.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Nightm.differs: The male version shows three blade tips fanning out below the fist, while the female version has two.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Party_.description: A thin, ring-shaped bracelet of chunky faceted beads strung in a loop, worn snugly around the left wrist. It gives a casual, playful party-band look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Party_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some of the beads along one section; colour 1 on another run of beads; colour 2 on a further run of beads; colour 3 on the remaining run of beads.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Power_.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapered contrasting-panelled body, a raised shield-shaped plate along the outer forearm, and a flared cuff at the wrist with an inset panel. Small rivet-like studs and metal edging give it a fantasy armour look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Power_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bracer body; colour 0 on the metal edging and rim; colour 2 on the raised shield plate and side panel; colour 3 on the wrist cuff inset and small stud accents.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Power_.description: A tight forearm bracer with a tapered, angular shell that flares to a pointed peak at the elbow, edged in a raised rim. A raised rectangular plate sits on the outer face and a round lens-like disc at the top edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Power_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim edging, the raised rectangular plate and the disc housing; colour 3 on the round lens in the disc.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psiini.description: A short cuff bracer worn at the left wrist with a large curved, blade-like fin sweeping up and back along the forearm. The fin is thin and translucent with a cracked, web-like energy texture and a few small slits.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psiini.colourAreas: The default material appears to ignore the colour scheme, showing a glowing crackled energy texture over the cuff and fin; no clear split between colour slots is visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psisli.description: A left forearm bracer band carrying a long, thin curved blade that sweeps down past the thigh. The blade is crystalline with a cracked, faceted look, suggesting a psionic sci-fi weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psisli.colourAreas: The whole piece shows as a glassy, near-crystal, so the colour scheme has little visible effect; colour 0 is the most likely tint on the bracer and blade.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Psisli.differs: The blade looks broader and flatter, and is more visible from the front.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Quagmi.description: A tight forearm bracer made of dense interwoven vines or roots that wrap around the left forearm, with loose thin tendrils sticking out at the top and bottom edges. Gives an overgrown, swampy look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Quagmi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick central tangles and highlights; colour 1 on the outer thin tendrils and many of the surrounding strands; colour 2 on the shaded inner strands.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Quagmi.description: A left forearm bracer made of tangled, wiry vines or roots wrapped densely around the forearm, with loose stray tendrils sticking out at both ends. Wild, organic look that sits between elbow and wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Quagmi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner wrapped strands; colour 1 on the outer tendrils and loose ends; colour 2 on the shadowed strands deep in the tangle.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Qularr.description: A short armoured bracer worn on the left forearm, made of angular segmented plates with inset panels, and a fan of long tapering blades that sweep back and up past the elbow. Suggests sci-fi or fantasy armour.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Qularr.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer plates and blades; colour 3 on the inset panels and edge highlights under the plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Rockcr.description: A chunky left bracer of cracked, stacked rock slabs wrapped around the forearm, with two tall faceted crystal shards jutting up and outward from the back of the wrist. Fantasy elemental look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Rockcr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the glowing crack lines and gaps between the rocks; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Rockcr.description: A chunky left forearm bracer built from cracked, stacked rock slabs, with two pointed crystal shards jutting up and outward from the back of the forearm. Reads as a fantasy stone gauntlet.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Rockcr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the glowing crack lines and inner gaps between the rocks; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roines.description: A angular armored bracer on the left forearm with a large smooth front plate, a long blade-like spike sweeping up toward the elbow, and a ridged back section with jagged flared edges at the wrist end.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roines.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front plate and spike; colour 1 on the ridged inner panels at the top; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and jagged rear plates; colour 3 on small accents between the jagged plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roines.description: A left wrist bracer with a large curved blade-like claw that sweeps down past the fist. A contrasting angular cuff with a pointed fin sits on top, over a bladed plate with cut-out slashes and a thin banded joint.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roines.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw blade and plate; colour 2 on the upper cuff and outer shell; colour 3 on the pointed fin and small accents; colour 1 on the banded joint at the wrist.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roines.description: A wrist bracer with a large curved blade claw sweeping down past the fist. A bulky angular guard sits on the forearm with a swept-back fin-like plate, banded ring at the wrist, and a sharp tapered talon with etched grooves.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Roines.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist ring and the curved claw blade; colour 2 on the angular forearm guard and swept plate; colour 3 on the inset panel of the guard; colour 1 on the thin bands at the wrist.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sacred.description: A short, snug octagonal cuff worn around the left wrist, with faceted sides and a slightly raised rim at the top edge. Plain and simple, it suits many superhero or fantasy looks.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.description: A small shark-fin blade fixed to the outer side of the left forearm, sweeping back from a pointed tip with a notched, curved trailing edge. Reads as a sleek superhero or aquatic accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the piece shows a single flat tone with no separate slots visible.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.differs: The male fin is broader and wider, showing a larger flat surface from the front.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.description: A single swept-back fin blade attached to the outside of the left forearm near the wrist: an angular shard with a notched top edge that tapers to a long point toward the elbow.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the default material shows a single flat tone with no visible trim or second colour.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.differs: The male fin is broader and stands out further from the forearm, so its face is visible from the front.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A curved, rounded-triangle shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm with two short bands. It has a raised rim, a broad contrasting border and an atom emblem on the face, and it extends from elbow to past the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and outer rim; colour 1 on the broad border band; colour 2 on the thin inner outline and atom emblem lines; colour 3 on the two forearm straps.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.differs: The male shield is larger and wider, projecting further out from the arm than the female version.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A curved, kite-shaped shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm with two loop straps. The face is split into two halves and carries an atom emblem, with a thick rim around the edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper half of the shield face; colour 0 on the lower half and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and back; colour 3 on the two forearm straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm with two short straps. It has a raised rim and a quartered face with an atom emblem, in a superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the face; colour 1 on the other two quarters and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and back; colour 3 on the two forearm straps.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.differs: The male shield hangs more to the side of the arm, with its face turned outward, and is a little larger.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A large kite-shaped shield strapped to the left forearm with two straps, hanging along the outside of the arm and reaching below the hand. It has a raised border, a recessed face with an atom emblem, and a plain back.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and outer rim; colour 1 on the wide border band and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the thin inner edge line and the back; colour 3 on the two forearm straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped to the outside of the left forearm by two loop straps. The face is divided into quarters with an atom emblem at the centre, and a thick rim edges the shield. Medieval form with a sci-fi twist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the face; colour 1 on the other two quarters and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and the back; colour 3 on the forearm straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A round shield mounted on a short bracer band around the left forearm, with a raised lion-head relief at the centre, a ridged rim with triangular tread pattern and a concentric inner ring. Heroic, fantasy or medieval look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer band and outer rim; colour 1 on the lion face and the inner ring band; colour 2 on the recessed shield face behind the lion and the back plate; colour 3 on the lion's eyes.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A round forearm shield worn on the left wrist: a thick rim carved with runic lettering surrounds a radial-spoked face with a central diamond emblem, mounted by a short block cuff on the forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim and the cuff block; colour 3 on the runic lettering; colour 0 on the shield face; colour 2 on the diamond emblem and the backing plate.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Shield.differs: The male shield is larger and sits more squarely over the forearm, with a wider cuff.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Skull_.description: A tight left forearm bracer with a cloth sleeve band and a spiky skull-like plate on the outer side, with small eye studs, a large round gem-like centre, curved tusk spikes and a tall horn pointing up the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Skull_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cloth sleeve band; colour 0 on the skull plate and spikes; colour 2 on the stripes and curved lower blades; colour 3 on the round centre and the eye dots.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Snake_.description: A tight forearm bracer with a scaled, snake-skin panel on the outer face, segmented banded plates along the sides, and two long curved talon-like fangs sweeping past the wrist over the hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Snake_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled panel and top rim; colour 1 on the segmented side plates and edging; colour 2 on the curved fangs.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sparta.description: A tapered greave-style forearm bracer with a curved shell open along the inner side, crossed lacing straps over the opening, and a contrasting edge trim. Sits over the left forearm in a classical Greek warrior style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sparta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the crossed lacing straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sparta.description: A tapered left forearm bracer with an open front laced by crossing straps, a Greek-key border along the edge and cuff, and a sculpted lion-face guard at the elbow. Ancient Greek warrior style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Sparta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer panel; colour 1 on the outer edge trim and the lion-face elbow guard; colour 3 on the Greek-key pattern and the lion's eyes; colour 2 on the crossing straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spike_.description: Two curved, tapering horn-like spikes, one long and one short, sticking out from the outer side of the left forearm. They sweep upward and back in a loose meandering line, giving a spiky, monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spike_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spikes' upper lengths and tips; colour 0 on the wider base of the larger spike.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spike_.description: Two curved, tapering horn-like spikes of different sizes jutting outward from the left forearm, each with a flared base cup. They sit one above the other along the outer arm as small accent bracer spikes.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spike_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips as a gradient; colour 3 on the flared base rims.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spikes.description: Three curved, tapering horn-like spikes staggered down the outer left forearm, each sweeping backward and upward from a short ringed base. Suggests a monstrous, claw-like bracer accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Spikes.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each spike; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Steela.description: A angular armoured bracer on the left forearm with layered plates and a flared open cuff, with a long curved blade-like spike extending down past the hand. Suggests a sci-fi or fantasy claw weapon gauntlet.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Steela.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer plates; colour 1 on the thin bands across the forearm; colour 2 on the cuff opening and inner edges; colour 3 on the long curved spike.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Steelh.description: A wing-like blade fan attached along the outside of the left forearm: a row of long, curved, tapering feather blades stacked on a contrasting base strip, sweeping back and down past the hand. Suggests a bird-of-prey superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Steelh.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long feather blades; colour 0 on the inner strips between the blades; colour 2 on the base strip along the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Steelh.differs: The male blades are more widely spaced and splay further out from the arm, while the female version is narrower and more tightly packed.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Steelh.description: A tapered forearm bracer with overlapping scale-like feather plates, a pointed flared cuff at the elbow end, and a strap loop over the hand from which three long curved talon blades sweep down past the fist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Steelh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled feather plates; colour 1 on the pointed cuff and edge trim; colour 2 on the hand loop; colour 3 on the talon blades.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symbio.description: A short, tight forearm bracer with a smooth curved shell that wraps the left forearm, with two swept-back blade-like spikes rising from the outer edge. Sleek symbiote-style armour with an angular, aggressive look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symbio.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 on the two spikes and their base panels; colour 0 on the inner lining and rim edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symbio.description: A bulky angular left bracer of faceted plates over the forearm, with a raised frame arch, a ribbed nozzle canister on top and a cylindrical tank on the outer side; a chemical-weapon look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symbio.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted armor plates and frame; colour 1 on the side trim strips; colour 2 on the inner housing; colour 3 on the canister and tank caps.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Symbio.differs: Its plates sit a little nearer the wrist, with a shorter trailing blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tech_B.description: A chunky tech bracer worn on the left wrist with a long, curved serrated blade sweeping back and down along the leg. The blade has jagged saw-tooth edges; the cuff has panel and vent details.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tech_B.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bracer housing; colour 2 on the serrated blade edge; colour 1 on the blade's inner spine; colour 0 barely visible on small bracer details.
