Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tesla_.description: Open bracer of three stacked thin rings floating around the left forearm, joined by fine struts, with jagged lightning-bolt blades rising from the sides and a small round bead at the wrist end. Electric, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tesla_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; colour 1 on the lightning-bolt blades; colour 3 on the round bead; colour 2 on the thin connecting struts.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tesla_.description: Three loose, floating thin rings stacked along the left forearm above the wrist, each wider than the arm and joined to it by fine spoke-like wires. A sci-fi, energy-coil look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Tesla_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; colour 2 on the thin spokes.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Troope.description: A thick, cylindrical armored bracer worn on the left forearm, made of riveted, weathered plates with a spiked rim at the top and a contrasting band at the bottom edge. It has a rugged, scavenged military look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Troope.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main riveted plate body; colour 1 on the spiked upper rim and the lower band; colour 2 on the rivet holes.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vine_L.description: A loose, open tangle of thin twisting vines wrapped around the left forearm near the wrist, with small leaves sprouting from the stems. A delicate, organic nature-themed bracer that leaves the sleeve visible through the gaps.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vine_L.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vine stems; colour 1 on parts of the stems and some leaves; colour 2 on a few shaded leaves.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vine_T.description: A tangled bracer of thin twisting vines wrapped loosely around the left forearm just above the wrist, studded with small sharp thorns. An open, wiry cage that suggests a wild, gothic or fantasy look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Vine_T.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vine stems; colour 1 on the thorn tips and small accents.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Viperl.description: A sci-fi armored bracer on the left forearm: two open cuff-like plates linked by a slim spine, with angular fins and long clawlike blades pointing down over the wrist. Reads as a viper-themed gauntlet.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Viperl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and blades; colour 1 on the inner connecting panel; colour 2 on the recessed panels and blade tips; colour 3 on the small accent slits.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Wolf_0.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapered plated cuff, a flared trimmed upper edge, wrapped cord bands near the wrist, small faceted gems, and three long curved blades extending past the knuckles. Claw-fighter style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Wolf_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plating and the blades; colour 2 on the wrist wraps and the underside of the cuff; colour 3 on the trim along the upper edge; colour 1 on the small gems.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchains_.description: Heavy chunky chain links wrapped in loose crisscrossing loops around the left forearm and wrist, with a looped chain hanging over the back of the hand. Gives a bound, prisoner-like street or punk look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchains_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links, with slight mottling; the gaps between links are the see-through openings.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchains_.description: Heavy chain links wound loosely around the left forearm and wrist in overlapping loops, with a few links dangling near the hand. It reads as a shackled, cursed look with a rough, gritty feel.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchains_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links across the whole piece; the gaps between links are the mannequin showing through, not a colour slot.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchains_.description: Heavy chain wrapped in loose crisscrossing loops around the left forearm and wrist, with a few links draped over the back of the hand. A tangled, rough scourge-like bracer with a street or punk look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerchains_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links, with a mottled metallic texture; the gaps between links show the body beneath.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerexartde.description: A tight, segmented forearm bracer with stacked angular plates and thin etched lines, capped by contrasting bands at both ends and a tall curved fin blade rising along the outer edge. Retro-futuristic art deco style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerexartde.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and the tall fin; colour 1 on the end bands and edge trim; colour 2 on the etched lines.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersaniubi.description: A short tubular bracer with an octagonal cross-section that wraps the left forearm just above the wrist. A wide smooth central band sits between ribbed, banded end cuffs with thin contrasting stripes, giving an Egyptian-style wrap.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersaniubi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide central band and the top rim; colour 3 on the ribbed end cuffs; colour 1 on the thin stripes separating the cuffs from the central band.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersasquat.description: A left forearm bracer with a smooth, tapered padded shell held by three cross straps, a studded panel edged with stitched trim, and jagged spiky fur tufts flaring out at both the elbow and wrist ends.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersasquat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell; colour 1 on the fur tufts at both ends; colour 2 on the cross straps and panel perforations; colour 3 on the stitched edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersasquat.description: A left forearm bracer with a studded, panelled guard wrapped by contrasting straps, a ragged jagged fur-like tuft flaring at the wrist and elbow, curved spikes along the edge, and loose open rings floating above on the upper arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracersasquat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer plate and the upper-arm rings; colour 1 on the shaggy fur tufts at both ends; colour 2 on the straps and studs; colour 3 on the curved spikes along the edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerspiked_.description: A left forearm bracer made of a narrow plate on the outer forearm, with three long curved blade-like spikes sweeping back along the wrist and two flat octagonal discs on the inner side. It suggests a claw-like superhero gauntlet.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerspiked_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the three curved spikes and the backing panel; colour 3 on the two octagonal discs; colour 2 on the plate edge outline.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerstraps_.description: A short, snug octagonal bracer worn around the left forearm near the wrist, with stacked horizontal ridges and two buckled straps wrapped across the outer side with small square slots. Casual, practical look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Bracerstraps_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer body and strap slots; colour 1 on the two straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Buttoncuff_02.description: A short, plain faceted cuff worn around the left wrist, like a shirt cuff, with a flat octagonal button on the outer side. It sits snugly at the wrist and suggests a casual or formal look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Buttoncuff_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 1 on the button.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cardboard_01.description: A left forearm bracer shaped like a small carton: a tapered angular box with a hinged flap and open spout at the top, worn on the lower forearm. Quirky, comic-style and plain in construction.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the carton; colour 2 on the large angled panel and the flap; colour 0 on the rim, spout and inner edges; colour 3 on the small patch at the back.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Bracer_.description: A pair of long, flat, tapering blade claws projecting downward from the back of the left fist, with small notches along one edge. They are attached at the wrist with no visible glove or bracer, suggesting a feral superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Child_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blades; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Dual_01.description: A pair of long, curved jagged blades projecting downward from a segmented plated wrist guard at the left fist. The blades are slender and barbed, set close together, giving a predatory claw-weapon look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Dual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented wrist plates; colour 2 on the mounting bands; colour 1 on the blades.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Claw_Dual_01.differs: The male blades sit closer together and overlap more, with wider, more heavily barbed edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Combat_01_Bra.description: A left forearm bracer made of a curved rigid plate held by three cross straps, with two octagonal bands that wrap the arm near the elbow end and the wrist end. Sits on the outer forearm with a tactical combat look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Combat_01_Bra.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved armor plate; colour 2 on the three cross straps; colour 0 on the two octagonal arm bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A snug angular armband worn on the left upper arm: a faceted, slightly tapered cylinder with thin raised bands at the top and bottom edges and an inner lining showing at the rim. Sleek, sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim edge; colour 2 on the main band and the top and bottom bands; colour 1 on the inner lining at the rim.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.description: Two separate angular armor plates on the left arm, one over the upper arm and one on the forearm, each a glossy faceted shell with small rivets and a contrasting lower panel. A sleek cyberpunk bracer set.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper edges and outer shell of the plates; colour 1 on the lower inset panels; colour 2 on the glossy faces; colour 3 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.differs: The upper-arm plate is a wider, shorter cup wrapping the bicep, with a larger contrasting panel showing along its lower edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A short tapered bracer covering the left forearm from below the elbow to the wrist, with angular rigid plates along the outer edge, a smooth padded panel across the inner face, and small studded lights. Sci-fi cyber styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular outer plates and rim; colour 2 on the smooth padded panel; colour 1 on the thin trim at the top and cuff edge; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyborgarmor_0.description: A short faceted band of armor plating that wraps around the left upper arm, with a lighter raised rim at the top edge and hex bolt heads studding the surface. Suggests cyborg or sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Cyborgarmor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 0 on the rim and bolt heads. The other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbot_.description: A short tapered forearm bracer of horizontally banded segments with a thin vertical strip along one side, a wide faceted rim at the elbow end with two contrasting spikes jutting outward, and a narrow lip at the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim, wrist lip and side strip; colour 1 on the banded segments; colour 2 on the spikes and band lines.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbot_.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a faceted octagonal rim at the elbow end, a ribbed segmented body of stacked bands, a thin vertical seam strip, a narrow cuff at the wrist, and two contrasting spikes projecting from the rim.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, wrist cuff and vertical strip; colour 1 on the segmented ribbed body; colour 2 on the spikes and rim stud.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbot_.description: A short tapered bracer worn on the left forearm: an angular octagonal flared cuff with contrasting spikes on both sides, over a segmented banded body with a vertical seam strip and a thin trim edge at the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Destroyerbot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, the seam strip and the wrist edge; colour 1 on the banded segments; colour 2 on the spikes and the small stud.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Egyptian_Armb.description: A short, wide octagonal armband worn snugly around the upper left arm, with a bright rim at the top, a contrasting band beneath it and horizontally banded striping below. Suggests an ancient Egyptian look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Egyptian_Armb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and the stripes; colour 1 on the band just under the rim; colour 3 on the striped bands; colour 2 on the thin inner edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Elbowpad_01.description: A snug elbow band made of stacked ridged layers with a raised, rounded pad at the back of the elbow, studded with rows of small round dimples. Sits on the left arm at the elbow, with a sporty, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Elbowpad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded back pad; colour 1 on the outer band panel and its thin edge trim; colour 2 on the ridged layers between; colour 3 on the small dimples in the pad.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Electric_01.description: A sci-fi forearm bracer: a curved plate with thin outlined seams and a perforated inner side, carrying three coiled electrode coils with hex-nut caps on the outer face, plus a flexible cable looping down the edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the perforated inner lining; colour 3 on the outline seams and the coil windings; colour 2 on the hex nuts, coil caps and cable.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Extra_Bracer_.description: A set of three long, slightly curved blade claws that extend from the left fist down past the thigh, in the manner of a feral hero's retractable claws. Each blade is narrow and tapers to a sharp point.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Extra_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three blades; the default material appears to be metallic, so the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fantasy_Armba.description: A tight cloth armband on the upper left arm: a striped fabric tube that gathers slightly at the lower edge, topped by a thick contrasting octagonal band studded with oval gems. Suggests fantasy or medieval styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fantasy_Armba.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light stripes of the fabric; colour 1 on the alternating stripes; colour 2 on the top band; colour 3 on the oval gems.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A left forearm bracer with a curved plate on the outer side and a crest of pointed feather spikes flaring past the elbow end. Overlapping feather strips wrap around the back of the arm and tip outward in a tribal, fantasy style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate edges, feather spikes and wrap strips; colour 1 on the large oval panel and feather tips; colour 2 on the split panel beside the oval; colour 3 on small accents under the strips.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_01.description: A small membranous fin attached to the left upper arm: three swept-back spines with webbed panels between them, ending in long curved points. It has a spotted surface and reads as an aquatic or monstrous accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbed membrane panels; colour 3 on the spots across the membrane; colour 1 on the spines and edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_02.description: A large fin-like arm accessory on the outer left upper arm: three overlapping curved membrane panels with speckled surfaces, edged by sharp swept-back spines. It stands out slightly from the arm and suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 3 on the speckled spots; colour 1 on the spine edges and rims of the panels; colour 2 in the shading at the panel bases.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Fin_02.differs: The fin is wider and fans out further from the arm, so its three panels are more visible from behind.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Flower_01.description: A left bracer of overlapping pointed petal-like leaves that flare up and away from the forearm, bound by thin wrapping bands, with a small rose blossom on the outer wrist. Fantasy, nature-themed.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapping bands, rose and leaf tips; colour 1 on the outer leaf panels; colour 2 on the central leaf blades; colour 3 on small accents at the leaf bases.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A small oval faceted gemstone with a domed, cut-crystal top and angular facets, worn on the outside of the left wrist as a bracer accent. Its glossy surface suggests a jewel-like ornament.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The whole gem shows one glossy tone that seems to ignore the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A small faceted rhombus-shaped gemstone that sits flat against the outer side of the left wrist. It has a glassy, angular cut with a pointed top and bottom, and works as a jewel-like bracer accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lighter upper facets; colour 1 faintly on the edge facets; the main faces stay glossy and mostly ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small square-cut gemstone block with bevelled, faceted edges, mounted on the outer side of the left wrist or hand as a bracer accent. It has a glossy, angular look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted face of the gem; the glossy sides and body ignore the colour scheme and stay dark.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone with a flat face and bevelled edges, mounted flush on the outer side of the left wrist or hand as a bracer ornament. It has a glossy, cut-crystal look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Glossy gem material appears to ignore most of the scheme; the bevelled facets show a faint tint from colour 1, with no other separate areas.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A small faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn flat against the outside of the left wrist or forearm, with a flat cut top face and angular bevelled edges. A decorative jewel accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows on the upper facets.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A small teardrop-shaped faceted gem with a flat back, worn on the outer side of the left hand or wrist. It sits close to the body as a slim, pointed crystal ornament.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The gem shows a glossy material that largely ignores the colour scheme; only a faint hint of colour 1 appears on the facets.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Greave_01.description: A smooth, tapered forearm bracer of angular plate that flares open at the elbow end and narrows to the wrist. Faceted, sleek panels wrap the outer arm, with small contrasting trim accents at both ends.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Greave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 3 on the small trim accents at the top and bottom edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Harajuku_Wrap.description: A tapered cloth forearm wrap made of alternating bands that spiral around the arm, widening slightly toward the elbow with a thick rolled edge at the top. Casual street-style bracer worn on the left forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Harajuku_Wrap.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrapped bands and the rolled rim; colour 1 on the alternating bands and the inner lining.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hipanbracer_0.description: A forearm bracer with a flared, pointed outer shell of segmented ridged plates over wavy inset ribbing, and a contrasting segmented underside with interlocking square-link accents. Sits over the forearm at the wrist; fantasy dragon-armour styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hipanbracer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell plates and ridges; colour 1 on the wavy inset ribbing; colour 2 on the segmented underside; colour 3 on the square-link edge pieces.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A sci-fi armband worn on the upper left arm: a chunky angled ring band with a separate curved plate held above it by a thick strut, with small inset panels and a round detail on the lower cuff.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and the edge of the upper plate; colour 1 on the upper plate face, the lower cuff and inner panels; colour 2 on the strut and clamp; colour 3 on the small inner panel of the band.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The male version has solid panels in several colour slots and a thick clamp strut, while the female version renders entirely as a glowing energy effect.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hornsmonster_.description: A cluster of small curved bone spikes and thorn-like horns studded along the outside of the left forearm, each set on a small angular base plate, with one longer spike pointing up toward the elbow.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hornsmonster_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes and horns; colour 3 on the small base plates under each spike.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hornsmonster_.description: A small cluster of three curved bone-like spikes on the left forearm, each rising from a small angular base plate. They sit at staggered heights along the outer arm for a monstrous, savage look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Hornsmonster_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the small base plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Knight_02.description: A curved plate shoulder guard for the left upper arm, made of layered overlapping plates with raised ridges, rounded studs and three conical spikes along the outer edge. It suggests medieval knight armour.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and spikes; colour 3 on the main plate surfaces and lower edge; colour 1 on the studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.description: A pair of separate angular armbands worn on the left upper arm: an upper band with a zigzag edge and a raised inset panel, and a plainer lower band with a stepped notch. Suggests a sleek superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band's outer rim; colour 1 on the raised inset panel; colour 2 on the lower band.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Luchadordolla.description: A short cloth bracer cuff worn on the left forearm near the wrist, with a wide contrasting upper band and a raised three-dimensional dollar sign emblem on the outer side. Playful luchador-wrestler styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Luchadordolla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff and the dollar sign's raised edges; colour 1 on the upper band and the bottom edge trim; colour 3 on the dollar sign's studded face.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Luchadorhawk_.description: A short wrist bracer shaped as a cuff with a rolled rim, with a large feathered wing fin sweeping up along the outer forearm. Small contrasting feather marks decorate the cuff; a luchador-style superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Luchadorhawk_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and the wing feathers; colour 1 on the rim, the wing edging and the lower wing point; colour 2 on the small feather marks.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lycan_02.description: A fitted forearm sleeve of shaggy, layered fur tufts running from elbow to wrist on the left arm, with jagged contrasting edging and rows of sharp spiky points along the outer side. Feral, wolf-like look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lycan_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 3 on the spiky tufts; colour 0 on the jagged edge fringe along the inner side.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lycanbracer_0.description: A furry, tufted bracer wrapping the left forearm, with jagged layered fur clumps and a row of sharp curved claw-like spikes along the outer edge. Feral, beastly look suited to werewolf or savage styles.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Lycanbracer_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 3 on the spikes and inner fur streaks; colour 0 on the ragged fur tips along the edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Martialartspa.description: A short octagonal forearm bracer with contrasting bands at both rims and a plain central cuff, extended by a narrow plate over the back of the hand studded with three small round bumps. Martial-arts style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Martialartspa.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff and hand plate; colour 1 on the top and bottom bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Mechassassin_.description: A mechanical forearm shield worn on the left forearm: a narrow tube-like housing that carries angular, layered plates. Pointed wing-like panels fan out from the sides, with accent caps at the ends. Sci-fi assassin styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Mechassassin_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and housing; colour 1 on the inset panels and edge trim; colour 3 on the end caps and thin accent lines; colour 2 on the recessed mechanism and gaps.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A left forearm bracer with a padded panel, contrasting angular rim at the elbow end and a ribbed side section. A clawed hand piece with three long curved talons extends over the back of the hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer panel; colour 1 on the ribbed side section and centre stripe; colour 2 on the rim, hand mount and claws; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ninjabracers_.description: A left forearm bracer with a large angular plate along the outer forearm that extends over the back of the hand, over a padded, segmented wrap held by thin cords. Ninja-style armor with a contrasting octagonal cuff at the elbow end.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ninjabracers_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer plate; colour 1 on the padded wrap; colour 2 on the cuff rims and wrist strap; colour 0 on the thin cords.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ninjabracers_.description: A left forearm bracer with a tapered plate on the outer face that points down toward the hand, edged with a raised rim. A ribbed wrist cuff with a contrasting cap sits at the wrist. Gladiator-style armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ninjabracers_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate and its raised rim; colour 1 on the ribbed wrist cuff; colour 2 on the cuff caps and end rings; colour 0 on the thin cuff bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Norse_Fur_01.description: A short fur bracer wrapping the left forearm, with shaggy jagged fur cuffs at both ends and a fur-covered middle crossed by criss-crossing straps. Suggests Norse or barbarian styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Norse_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur; colour 2 on the criss-crossing straps; colour 1 as a faint tint in the fur shading.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Persian_Brace.description: A short, slightly tapered octagonal bracer worn on the left forearm, with swirling scrollwork patterns across its surface, contrasting edge trim at both ends and a rounded gem set on the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Persian_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body and the top rim; colour 2 on the swirling scrollwork; colour 3 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the gem.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Post_Apoc_Bra.description: A short, angular post-apocalyptic forearm bracer: a faceted main plate wraps the forearm, with a raised contrasting patch panel along one side, two thin straps with square buckles, and small screw-like rivets.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Post_Apoc_Bra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate; colour 1 on the raised side patch panel; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the buckles and rivet heads.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Powerarmor_01.description: A angular power-armor bracer worn on the left forearm: a shell of layered plates with pointed fins at the upper edge, small round sockets and a glowing round core, plus a thin strap hanging below the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Powerarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main armor shell; colour 2 on the fin tips and inset panels; colour 3 on the round core lights; colour 0 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Qularr_Armor_.description: A short segmented armor band around the upper left arm, with a smooth plain front and stacked overlapping lamellar plates across the back. Faceted, angular edges suggest ancient Greek-style armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Qularr_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the rim edges and the plate borders; colour 2 on the seams between plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_Ar.description: A chunky cylindrical armguard cuff on the left upper arm, with a rigid mottled metal shell above a ribbed, layered band of stripes at the lower edge. Retro sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_Ar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large upper shell; colour 1 on the ribbed lower band; colour 3 on the thin stripes within the band.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_Br.description: A short tapered forearm bracer with a glossy, semi-transparent outer shell and a raised panel framed by contrasting end bands, worn on the left forearm just above the wrist. Retro sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_Br.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the raised inner panel; colour 2 on the end bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_Br.description: A chunky faceted forearm bracer worn on the left arm, with a strap band around the middle and a boxy keypad device with a small screen and buttons mounted on the outer side. Retro sci-fi gadget style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_Br.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer cylinder; colour 1 on the strap band; colour 2 on the device casing and keypad; colour 3 on the screen and some keypad buttons.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ringsbicep_01.description: A tight band worn around the upper left arm, made of stacked strap layers with a thin contrasting stripe between them. Two chunky octagonal rings hang from small mounting plates on the outer side, giving a street or punk look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ringsbicep_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper and lower strap bands; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 0 on the thin stripe; colour 3 on the rings and their mounting plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ringswrist_01.description: A snug forearm bracer made of criss-crossing wrap straps between two solid end bands, with three small ring fasteners running down the outer edge. Sits on the left forearm; a street and punk look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ringswrist_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom end bands; colour 0 on the underlying wrap layer; colour 2 on the diagonal crossing straps; colour 3 on the ring fasteners.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A small angular metal plate with a round port sits on the upper left arm. Two segmented ribbed cables loop out from it and end in short cylindrical connectors. A cybernetic, mechanical look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular plate; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 1 on the cylindrical connector tips; colour 3 on the small port light.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A cybernetic implant for the left upper arm: an angular plated clamp housing with a small lens, from which many thick ribbed cables loop and dangle down the arm, ending in several connector caps.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular housing plates; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 1 on the connector caps and small collars.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ripper_02.differs: The male version has more connector caps on the cables and a larger, longer housing.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rock_01.description: A left forearm bracer of cracked, faceted rock plates that sweeps down past the wrist into long tapering claw spikes, with jagged points at the elbow end. Fitted over the forearm with a monstrous, stony look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock plates; colour 2 on the crack lines between plates; no other slots clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rock_02.description: A chunky rock bracer worn on the left forearm just above the wrist: stacked cracked stone slabs form a rugged cuff, with tall jagged shards jutting up toward the elbow. Suggests an earthen, golem-like look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs and shards; colour 2 on the crack lines between the stones.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Rolledsleeve_.description: A wide, rolled cloth armband worn around the left upper arm, with soft wrinkled folds and a slightly ragged edge. It gives a casual, makeshift wrapped look.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ruler_01.description: A short, slightly tapered armored cuff worn around the left forearm near the wrist, with raised rims at both edges lined with small studs and rounded oval studs set into the faceted band.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Ruler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band and rims; colour 1 on the small studs along both edges; colour 2 on the oval stud on one side; colour 3 on the round stud on the other side.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A chunky octagonal armband worn on the upper left arm, with a long curved, horn-like fin sweeping upward and outward from its side. The fin is a glossy plate with a ring motif and swirling inlaid line patterns.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band body; colour 1 on the band's top and bottom edges; colour 2 on the curved fin plate; colour 3 on the glowing line patterns and ring on the fin.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sacred_01.differs: The fin on the male version is longer and stands more upright, sweeping up and forward off the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Samurai_Large.description: A samurai-style left forearm bracer of angular, jagged plates with a raised curved fin flaring off the outer edge. Swirling engraved patterns fill the panels, and a bordered rim outlines each plate.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Samurai_Large.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and edge plates; colour 1 on the thin inner border line; colour 2 on the panel faces; colour 3 on the swirl patterns.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_01.description: A short furry bracer for the left forearm: a shaggy cuff of jagged, pointed fur tufts that flares at the elbow end and tapers to ragged strands over the wrist. Suggests a wild, beastly look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tips near the elbow end; colour 1 on the main body of the fur, fading towards the wrist strands.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_02.description: A small tuft of jagged, shard-like fur locks attached to the forearm, with long pointed tips streaming down toward the wrist. It reads as a wild, feral accent on one arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur tufts; colour 1 on the lower fur points, fading toward darker tips.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatch_02.differs: This version is worn on the left forearm, with longer tufts reaching further toward the wrist.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatchlong.description: A shaggy fur bracer wrapping the left forearm, built from jagged, layered tufts that flare into spiky points at the elbow end and taper into ragged strands over the wrist. Suggests a wild, beastly look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sasquatchlong.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur near the elbow, fading into colour 1 on the lower tufts toward the wrist; colour 2 in the shadowed undersides.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Shacklewrist_.description: A chunky metal wrist cuff with a slightly tapered, faceted shape, two bolted block clamps on one side and two looped handle-like rings on the sides, worn on the left wrist like a restraint shackle.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Shacklewrist_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the looped side rings; colour 2 on the bolted clamp blocks.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Shacklewrist_.differs: The male cuff has a plain front face with no slot-shaped inset; its loop rings sit at the sides.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A short forearm bracer with a swept-back fin-like spike rising from the elbow side of the cuff. It has a wide contrasting band around the middle and angular panels, giving a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bracer body; colour 0 on the fin spike and the angular edge panels; colour 2 on the wide middle band; colour 3 on small accent patches near the top.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_Stra.description: A band of overlapping angular plates wrapped around the upper left arm, with jagged fin-like points rising at the top and stacked, layered segments below; a sharp, armoured superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_Stra.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plates; colour 2 on the inner fin panels; colour 0 on the lower overlapping edge plates; colour 3 on the small top panel.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.description: A wrapped forearm bracer of stacked banded segments, with four contrasting spear-tipped spikes jutting sideways from a curved blade-like plate along the outer edge. Sits on the left forearm above the wrist; punk, aggressive style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer wrap bands; colour 0 on the bands between them; colour 2 on the spikes; colour 3 on the curved plate.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.description: A forearm bracer of stacked rings around the wrist, with four slender arrow-tipped rods projecting outward to a large curved blade fin that sweeps down past the hand. Aggressive, spiky superhero or sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large curved fin; colour 1 on the ring discs of the bracer; colour 0 on the bands between the rings; colour 2 on the spike rods and their tips.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spikeelbow_Me.description: A pair of curved, tapering horn-like spikes that sweep upward from the left upper arm near the elbow, one longer and one shorter, each sitting in a small ring-shaped base. Suggests a monstrous or fantasy look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Spikeelbow_Me.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the ring bases.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapsasquatc.description: A left forearm bracer of shaggy, jagged fur tufts poking out at both the elbow and wrist ends, wrapped around the middle by a smooth cuff bound with several thin straps. Tribal, beastlike look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapsasquatc.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts at both ends; colour 0 on the central cuff; colour 2 on the thin straps wrapped around it.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapsbicep_0.description: A tight band worn around the left upper arm, made of two broad outer straps with a narrower inner strip and a thin layered stripe between them. Angular faceted edges give it a simple, sporty superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapsbicep_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two broad outer straps; colour 2 on the central stripe; colour 0 on the thin strips beside the central stripe.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapthin_01.description: A set of three thin, flat bands wrapped loosely around the left upper arm, each an angular polygonal ring that sits slightly tilted and separate from the others. A minimalist armband accessory with a casual, superhero feel.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Strapthin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three straps; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Tribalbracer_.description: A short, snug wrist bracer of soft wrinkled cloth with thin edge bands at both ends, ringed by long tapering tooth-like spikes on segmented bases that stick out from the outer side of the forearm. Tribal in style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Tribalbracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer body and the bands of the spike bases; colour 1 on the top and bottom edge trim; colour 3 on the spike tips; colour 2 on the lower spike bases.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Tribalfeather.description: A wrapped cloth band gathered in thick horizontal folds around the upper left arm, fastened with a round medallion at the top from which a fan of three long pointed feathers sticks upward. Tribal in style.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Tribalfeather.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped cloth band; colour 1 on the medallion and the small dash markings on the wrap; colour 3 on the medallion's centre mark; colour 2 on the feathers.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Bracele.description: A pair of thin, smooth stacked bangles worn snugly around the left wrist, each a slightly faceted band with a tapered profile. A simple, casual urban accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Bracele.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower bangle; colour 1 on the upper bangle.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Diamond.description: A wide, snug wrist cuff with a smooth central band edged top and bottom by rows of small square gem-like studs in contrasting trim, closed at the outer side by two small buckled straps.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Diamond.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and the buckle straps; colour 1 on the edge trim framing the gem rows; colour 3 on the square gems; colour 2 on the buckle prongs.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Studded.description: A short, snug cuff bracer worn on the left forearm just above the wrist, with a slightly tapered shape, thin contrasting edge bands at both ends and rounded raised studs dotted around the outside.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Urban_Studded.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the round studs; colour 2 on the edge bands at top and bottom.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Variablerobot.description: A chunky, blocky angular shoulder-pad piece sitting on the upper left arm, faceted like a boxy cube with a notched opening on the underside. Suggests a robotic, sci-fi armour block.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Variablerobot.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole block; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Variablerobot.description: A blocky angular bracer worn on the left forearm: a chunky faceted housing on the outer side with a small triangular marking, framed by separate boxy plates at the top and bottom edges. Suits robotic sci-fi looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Variablerobot.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main housing and the central band; colour 1 on the upper and lower boxy plates; the small triangle marking is a subtle inset on the housing.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A small armor band wrapped around the upper left arm: a curved shell with a raised rim and a notched top edge, framing inset panels front and back. Reads as a compact sci-fi or superhero arm guard.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the inset panels; colour 2 on the thin seam lines across the panels.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Viperps_01.differs: The male plate is a chunkier, deeper shell with a wider notch at the top and a small flared lip at the back.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_01.description: A small bat-wing fin attached along the outside of the left forearm: two long curved spiny ribs joined by a thin membrane that flares out toward the elbow and tapers to a point at the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the wing ribs and edges; colour 1 on the membrane between the ribs; colour 0 as light streaks on the membrane.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_01.differs: The male wing has a fuller, wider membrane between the ribs, especially near the elbow, so it looks more like an open bat wing.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_02.description: A single large bat-wing attached at the left wrist that sweeps up past the shoulder and head. Long curved bony spars carry a thin membrane between them, with a jagged lower edge. Suits monstrous, gothic or fantasy looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 3 on the bony spars, mixed across the wing frame; colour 1 on the thin membrane between the spars.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wingbracer_02.differs: The male wing flares out wider from the arm, with a broader, more visible membrane between the spars.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wristband_01.description: A plain, short tapered wristband forming an open cuff around the left forearm just above the wrist, slightly wider at the top. Smooth, simple, with no fastenings, suited to casual or superhero looks.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wristband_01_.description: A short tight wristband worn on the left forearm just above the wrist: a slightly tapered, faceted cuff with a wide contrasting band at the top and a thin contrasting edge at the bottom. Sporty, wrestling-inspired look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Tight_Wristband_01_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the wristband; colour 1 on the wide top band and the thin bottom edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Urban_Anime_Armwarm.description: A short left forearm sleeve warmer with a thick octagonal cuff at the elbow end and a small trim band at the wrist. Panelled construction with a contrasting side strip gives a sporty, anime-street look.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Urban_Anime_Armwarm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the elbow cuff, wrist band and back panel; colour 1 on the main front sleeve panel; colour 2 on the side strip; colour 3 on the small patch on the front.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Vine_01.description: A chunky forearm bracer with swirling carved scroll patterns, from which several curling, tendril-like vines with sharp tips sprout upward and outward. It sits over the lower forearm near the wrist, with an organic fantasy feel.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swirling relief patterns; colour 1 on the main bracer body and the vine tendrils; colour 3 on the sharp thorn tips of the vines.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Watch_01.description: A chunky octagonal wristwatch band worn on the left wrist, with a wide central strap, thin rims at both edges and a small raised rectangular digital display block on the top of the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Watch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims at both edges of the band; colour 3 on the main strap; colour 1 on the raised display housing; colour 2 on the display screen and the thin edging.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Wing_Tight_Batwing_.description: A thin membrane wing hanging from the left arm to the torso side, with a ragged, scalloped bat-like trailing edge and pointed tips. It drapes loosely between the upper arm and the hip.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Wing_Tight_Batwing_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing membrane; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_L_Wing_Tight_Steelhaw.description: A tight, folded feathered wing hanging from the left arm and side of the torso, made of overlapping layered feathers that taper to a ragged, pointed fringe near the hip. Fantasy or superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_L_Wing_Tight_Steelhaw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather surfaces, with the underside showing a darker shade of the scheme; the other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Alien_01.description: A short open-backed armor band wrapped around the right upper arm, made of angular faceted plates with a recessed inner panel, a stepped lower rim and a single pointed spike jutting forward. Alien sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plates; colour 0 on the outer rim edges and lower lip; colour 2 on the recessed inner panel; colour 3 on the spike.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Amazon_01.description: A curved metal guard wrapped around the outside of the right upper arm, with a pointed, notched lower edge, a raised central ridge, scrolled engraved patterns and small round studs. It suggests warrior-style armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the outer edge trim and central ridge; colour 2 on the engraved scroll patterns; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Amazon_02.description: A short, wide cuff-like band worn around the right upper arm. It has an octagonal, slightly waisted profile, contrasting trim along both edges and a thin twisted cord band across the middle. Suggests an ancient, warrior look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band body; colour 1 on the top and bottom edge trim; colour 2 on the central cord band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Anniversary_Mec.description: A glossy metallic armor cuff for the right upper arm: an angular, faceted plate wraps the outer arm, with a ribbed, cable-like tube curving down the front edge. Retro robotic look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Anniversary_Mec.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plate, catching light; ribbed tube and darker plate surfaces show a glossy metal finish that largely ignores the colour scheme; colours 1, 2 and 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Armorninja.description: A short, rounded armored band wrapped around the right upper arm, made of faceted angular panels with a raised, notched top edge. It reads as a ninja-style bracer worn on the bicep.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light side panels; colour 1 on the main back and lower panels; colour 2 on the large front panel; colour 3 on the top wedge.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, rigid block-shaped band worn around the right upper arm, with flat angular faces, a slightly raised rim and an open recessed top. It has a plain panelled look suggesting a cardboard-box or crate style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back panel and the top rim; colour 1 on the side and top panels; colour 2 on the lower front and inner recess; colour 3 on the angled stripe on the outer side.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chainlock_01.description: A heavy chain wrapped in several loose coils around the right upper arm, fastened with a small octagonal padlock that has a keyhole. Chunky rectangular links give it a rugged, street or punk look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on a small clasp beside the padlock.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chainlock_02.description: A tangled loop of heavy chunky chain links wrapped around the upper right arm, with a small padlock hanging at the outer side. Gritty, rugged street or punk accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chainlock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on a small tag by the lock.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chains_01.description: A single long chain of interlocking links hanging straight down from the upper chest past the hip, ending in a small hook-like pendant. Thin and simple, it hangs loose against the body as an edgy accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper links near the top; colour 0 on the lower links; colour 3 on the hook pendant at the end.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chainlock.description: A small chunky padlock charm with a faceted, chamfered body, a recessed keyhole on the front and a squared shackle loop on one side. It hangs on the right upper arm or chest side as a gritty accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chainlock.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the lock body and shackle; colour 1 on the thin edge strip along one side; colour 3 on the keyhole.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chainlock.description: A small chunky padlock charm with a faceted angular body, a thick octagonal shackle loop on one side and a recessed keyhole on its face; it hangs from the chest and upper arm as a quirky accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chainlock.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the lock body and shackle; colour 3 on the keyhole; colour 1 on the thin edge band of the lock body.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chains_01.description: A single thin chain of small links hanging straight down from the chest at the right side to about mid-thigh, ending in a small hook-and-clasp weight. Simulated cloth lets it hang loosely against the body.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper links near the chest; colour 0 on the lower links; colour 2 and colour 3 on the hook and clasp at the bottom.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Punk_01.description: A small cloth knot tied on the upper right arm, with two long pointed bunny-ear-like tails sticking out from it. A casual punk accessory with no wide band visible.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot; colour 1 on one of the loose ear tails; colour 2 on the other ear tail.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Punk_01.differs: The male version shows only a small knot with two ear tails and no wide wrapped band around the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegade_.description: A small sci-fi blaster cannon mounted on the outer upper arm: a boxy perforated body with a round bolted muzzle ring at the top, and a long flexible cable that loops out and around to a small nozzle connector.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegade_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cannon body and the cable end connector; colour 1 on the muzzle ring; colour 2 on the muzzle opening; colour 3 on the cable.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegade_.differs: The cable makes a wider, more open arc extending out toward the chest, while the female version's cable hangs in a tighter loop lower on the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegade_.description: Two flexible, winding tubes that run down the outer upper right arm from hex-capped shoulder mounts, each ending in a ribbed cylindrical canister near the elbow. A sci-fi cyborg-style arm accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Renegade_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hex caps, ribbed end canisters and cuffs; colour 3 on the main tube lengths; colour 1 on the bands around the tube bends.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Scarab_01.description: A flat, atom-like emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a small central ring, applied to the outer side of the right upper arm like a decal. Suggests a scientific or superhero insignia.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Child_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the edging and outlines of the rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Crimson_01.description: A twisted rope armband worn around the upper right arm, made of two stacked braided strands that wrap in a loose band. Simple, casual accessory with a rope-cord look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the braided rope strands; colour 1 on a section of the rope at the back of the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Deity_01.description: A short armband worn on the upper right arm: a smooth curved outer plate that flares up into a pointed wing on one side, over a padded inner band of stacked, quilted segments with a lined rim.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer curved plate; colour 3 on the inner rim lining; colour 1 on the stacked padded bands; colour 2 on the bottom edge band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Draco_01.description: A short armored band worn on the upper right arm, with a layered, faceted plate that rises into a large, raised, angular crest on the outer side, and a diamond-shaped gem set in a plain panel with a rim.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band panel; colour 1 on the raised layered plate; colour 2 on the edge trim and rim; colour 3 on the diamond gem.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Draco_01.differs: The male version's crest is larger and taller, rising into a more pronounced pointed dome.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Dragonbody_Lock.description: A sculpted, flame-like fin of jagged swept-back spikes running along the outer right upper arm and forearm, with a smooth flat sheet along its inner edge. It looks fantasy or monstrous, like a dragon's crest.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Dragonbody_Lock.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth inner sheet and the upper tips of the spikes; colour 1 on the lower rear spikes, which blend gradually into colour 0.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Drill_01.description: A short, chunky armored band worn around the right upper arm: an open octagonal cylinder with ribbed end bands, a plated centre with contrasting inset windows and a small chevron emblem. Sci-fi tech look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plating; colour 1 on the ribbed top and bottom bands; colour 2 on the inset windows; colour 3 on the chevron emblem and small stripe.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Element_Fire_01.description: A ragged, flame-like wrap of glossy swirling shards that curls around the upper right arm, with pointed tongues licking up and down; a fantasy elemental arm accessory that leaves the arm open between the two clusters.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Mostly glossy metallic material that largely ignores the scheme; faint colour 1 sheen in the folds.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Element_Fire_02.description: A flame-shaped wrap for the right upper arm: a glossy, open-backed band of swirling, wavy tongues with pointed tips, wrapping round the arm and flaring outward at the edges. Suggests a fiery superhero or elemental look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: The material is glossy and mostly ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on some of the flame swirls and colour 3 on a thin inner edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Feathers_01.description: A single wing-like fan of layered feathers attached along the outside of the right arm, tapering to a long pointed tip that hangs past the hip. Rows of overlapping quills give a fantasy, avian look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper covert feathers near the shoulder; colour 1 on the middle feather rows; colour 2 on the barred markings between rows; colour 3 on the long tip feathers.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Gearbreak_01.description: A mechanical shoulder pauldron shaped like an open cylinder, with a tall curved shield plate rising on the outer side, a segmented band of small panels around the base, and a boxy pod with clips on the outside.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Gearbreak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and inner cylinder; colour 1 on the band frame, clips and pod straps; colour 3 on the small band panels; colour 2 on the shield edge and the boxy pod.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Gladiator_01.description: A chunky armband worn on the upper right arm: a wide octagonal cuff with rims, a middle band, and a layered strap with a square buckle wrapped around it. Sporty, gladiator-style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: The default material on this sheet renders as a glowing, translucent and ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slots are visible on any part.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Heraldry_01.description: A plain, smooth band worn around the right upper arm: a short faceted cylinder that tapers slightly, with a thin lighter edge along the rim. It suggests simple armour or a heraldic armband.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; the rim edge catches a lighter tone from the same slot.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Kaiju_01.description: A right upper-arm guard of segmented armor: a large curved outer plate with small dents covers the outside of the arm, joined to stacked banded plates and a pointed shoulder cap. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large outer plate; colour 1 on the shoulder cap and the banded inner plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Madjester_01.description: A pair of thin, faceted angular bands worn on the right upper arm, one tilted across the other at an angle. Slim, plain and minimal, they suggest a simple armband or belt-strap accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both bands; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mecha_01.description: A chunky angular armour block worn on the right upper arm, with a notched double-ridge top, small slit accents on the face and two round bolt-like knobs hanging below. Suggests a mecha or sci-fi power-armour look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour block; colour 1 on the two round knobs underneath; colour 3 on the small slit accents.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mecha_02.description: A chunky faceted arm band worn around the right upper arm: a tall octagonal cuff with a flared capped top band, small slot vents on the top, and a contrasting recess at the lower front edge. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lower cuff body; colour 1 on the capped top and rim band; colour 3 on the small vent marks; colour 2 on the lower recess and underside.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mechanon_02.description: A small armband of angular, segmented plates wrapped loosely around the upper right arm, with jagged zigzag edges and gaps between the panels. It suggests robotic sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and outer band; colour 1 on the inner and edge panels; colour 2 on the zigzag band section; colour 3 on small inset accents.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Modern_Ironclad.description: A simple armband worn around the upper right arm: a wide, slightly faceted band with thick contrasting rims at top and bottom. It gives a plain, modern superhero or tactical look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Modern_Ironclad.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the top and bottom rims.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Moth_01.description: A fitted cloth sleeve-like wrap around the right upper arm, with a gathered panel at the shoulder, a large separate panel on the outer arm and a jagged, crumpled cuff above the elbow. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main sleeve body and cuff; colour 0 on the gathered shoulder panel; colour 1 on the large side panels.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mutated_01.description: Two curved, tapering horn-like spikes that jut outward from the side of the right upper arm and shoulder, one above the other. Each has a blunt faceted base and a sharp swept tip, giving a mutated, monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bases and main bodies of the spikes; colour 1 on the pointed tips, fading in from the base.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Padding.description: A tactical armor pad for the right upper arm, made of two separate curved plates, one on the front and one on the back, that leave the sides open. Angular panel edges give it a military look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate rims and edges; colour 1 on the main plate surfaces; colour 2 on the diagonal stripe panels; colour 3 on the raised bar across the front plate.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A billowing cloth upper-arm puff sleeve with a ruffled, gathered top rim, cinched by a strap with a small buckle and round button, then a flared ruffled cuff tied below with a bow. Pirate-fancy style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered cloth sleeve and ruffle; colour 1 on the upper strap and lower tie; colour 3 on the round button; colour 2 on the buckle and ruffle edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Pumpkin_01.description: A right upper-arm guard: a rounded, layered shoulder-cap plate with ridged bands, a contrasting inner lining at the lower edge, and a fan of jagged, blade-like fins sweeping back from the outer arm. Fantasy armor styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the layered plate shell; colour 1 on the jagged fins and thin edge trim; colour 2 on the lining at the lower opening.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Punk_01.description: A cloth armband wrapped around the right upper arm, with a striped outer band over a gathered plain underlayer and a knotted tie with two pointed tails sticking out at the back. Punk, street-style accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered underlayer; colours 1, 2 and 3 on the striped outer band; colour 1 on one knot tail; colour 2 on the other knot tail.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_01.description: A short wrap of overlapping cloth straps spiralling around the right upper arm, with open gaps between the bands and a thin loose band at the lower edge; gives a casual rave or street look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top straps; colour 1 on the main body of the wrap; colour 2 on the thin lower band.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_01.differs: The male version is mostly colour 1 with a thin colour 2 lower band and no colour 3, and it is bulkier with a shorter lower fringe.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_02.description: A right-arm sleeve made of overlapping torn cloth strips wrapped around the arm from shoulder to wrist, with gaps showing the arm beneath. The bands fade between sections for a ragged rave or street look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Rave_Straps_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top strips near the shoulder; colour 1 on the upper arm strips; colour 2 on the middle elbow strips; colour 3 on the forearm strips.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Reactor_01.description: A rigid cylindrical armband worn around the right upper arm, with a notched raised back panel and a rivet detail. A flexible cable hangs from it to a small ribbed plate on the forearm, giving a sci-fi gadget look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band and the small ribbed plate; colour 1 on the raised notched panel; colour 3 on the cable and the rivet.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Armor_.description: A sci-fi arm accessory for the upper right arm: a large open cup-shaped armor shell with a perforated side plate, ringed by two curved flexible tubes that end in segmented metal tips and hang down the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell, side plate and tube end caps; colour 1 on the inner shell lining and bands on the tubes; colour 3 on the tubes.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Armor_.differs: The male shell is larger and deeper, covering more of the upper arm, with the tubes sitting closer around it.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Cannon.description: A small sci-fi cannon unit mounted on the upper outer arm: a boxy perforated housing with a round barrel ring at the front, and a long looping hose trailing down and around the arm to a small nozzle end.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Cannon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the perforated housing and hose nozzle; colour 1 on the barrel ring; colour 3 on the hose; colour 2 on the barrel opening.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Tubes_.description: Two flexible, kinked tubes that wind down the right upper arm from a hexagonal shoulder mount, each ending in a segmented ribbed cuff. A sci-fi cable accessory that sits over the shoulder and arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Tubes_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hex mount and the ribbed end cuffs; colour 3 on the tube lengths; colour 1 on the bands partway along each tube.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Tubes_.description: Two flexible tubes that run down the right upper arm in wavy curves, each starting at a hexagonal cap near the shoulder and ending in a ridged cylindrical nozzle. A sci-fi arm accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Renegade_Tubes_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the end caps and ridged nozzles; colour 3 on the tube lengths; colour 1 on the banded tube segments.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.description: A chunky angular armor cuff wrapped around the right upper arm, with a raised faceted plate at the top forming an open rim, banded lower section and a bent metal pipe handle curving down the outside. Retro sci-fi warlord look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top shield plate and the pipe; colour 0 on the mid plating and the inner bowl; colour 1 on the side panels and the pipe tip; colour 3 on the lower band.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.differs: The male version has an open, hollow top rim with a raised arched plate, rather than a closed solid top.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.description: A bandolier-style ammunition belt: a boxy cuff clasp on the upper right arm with a row of angular cartridges arcing over the shoulder toward the chest, tips pointing outward in a ridged, segmented line.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cuff clasp and the back of the belt; colour 0 on the cartridge casings; colour 1 on the tips and edges of the cartridges.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retro_Warlord_0.differs: The male belt curves back toward the upper arm and ends in a rounded tip, rather than reaching higher on the chest with a square end tab.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retrosteelhead_.description: A curved armor shell on the right upper arm, open on the inner side, with a pointed lower front edge, a raised rim and a contrasting band along the bottom. Retro superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Retrosteelhead_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edges and outer shell; colour 2 on the inner shell surface; colour 1 on the lower band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_01.description: A segmented Roman-style plate guard for the right upper arm: stacked curved plates with small rivets, held on by three thin straps that wrap around the arm. Sits over the upper arm from shoulder to just above the elbow.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the plate edges and a gradient along the outer plates; colour 3 on the rivets; colour 2 on the straps.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_01.differs: The male guard has three straps, while the female version has only two.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_02.description: A segmented Roman-style guard for the right upper arm: a curved shell of stacked overlapping plates with rivet heads along the edges, open on the inner side and with no straps. It sits over the upper arm from shoulder to just above the elbow.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Roman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and edges; colour 1 on the plates' central curved area as a gradient; colour 3 on the rivets.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Sandstorm_01.description: A right upper-arm guard: a rounded, open-backed shell with raised ribbed panels on the outside, a flared trim cup at the elbow with a vented pad, and a plain cloth sleeve panel hanging down the forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging sleeve panel and inner lining; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 1 on the elbow cup trim; colour 3 on the ribbed panels and elbow vent pad.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Sandstorm_02.description: A chunky angular armband worn around the upper right arm, with a faceted outer shell, a contrasting inner lining, a stepped lower edge and a small rectangular inset panel on the outer side. Suggests a sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band shell; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 3 on the small inset panels.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Scarab_01.description: A curved shield-like arm plate worn on the outer right upper arm, with a raised rim around a flat panel bearing an atom-style orbital emblem. Superhero styling, open at the inner side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel face; colour 2 on the raised rim and back shell; colour 1 on the atom emblem lines.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Scarab_02.description: A rigid, angular shield-like guard worn on the right upper arm: a tall faceted plate with a raised contrasting rim, a large flat outer panel and a separate side panel, ending in a pointed lower edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer panel; colour 1 on the side panel; colour 2 on the rim, edging and top cap.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Spikysuit_01.description: A small lumpy, bone-like growth on the outer upper right arm, made of a rounded mass with several thick pointed knuckle-like spurs jutting forward and outward. It suggests a monstrous, organic bone armour.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bone surface; colour 1 on the mottled patches spread across the growth.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of angular band rings worn around the right upper arm: a wide faceted upper band and a thinner lower hoop, joined at the outer side by a pointed, gem-like faceted spike fin.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band; colour 1 on the lower hoop; colour 3 on the upper faceted spike facet; colour 2 on the lower spike blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Steelcommando_0.description: A short armored cuff band worn around the right upper arm, flaring open at the top with a raised rim, a side panel with stitched detailing, and a small crystal-like tab hanging down the back.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Steelcommando_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main cuff body; colour 0 on the top rim and lower edge; colour 1 on the side panel; colour 3 on the hanging tab.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Super_Destroyer.description: A chunky, faceted band that wraps around the right upper arm, flaring slightly toward the elbow, with a flat top face and a raised bevelled rim. Its blocky, retro-armoured look suits a classic villain or superhero.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Super_Destroyer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top face; colour 1 on the bevelled rim and highlights; colour 2 on the main body of the band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Symbiote_01.description: A single curved horn-like spike that juts out sideways from the right shoulder and sweeps upward to a sharp point. It has a flat-cut base and a blade-like taper, suggesting an organic, symbiote-style look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the spike; colour 1 on the upper tip, blending gradually from the base.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Symbiote_01.differs: The male spike sits further out on the shoulder and curves outward more broadly, and it looks slightly thicker.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Tactical_01.description: A small open-backed armor band worn on the right upper arm: a curved plate with a raised, chunky rectangular panel on the outer face and a stepped bevelled edge. Suits tactical or military looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main curved plate and its rim; colour 1 on the raised panel and the band across it.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Traveler_01.description: A wide, softly rumpled armband worn around the upper right arm, with a row of eyelets along its edge and a strap that passes through a square buckle. The loose strap end and small tab give it a casual traveller look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and strap; colour 2 on the buckle and the small end tab; colour 1 on the strap keeper loops beside the buckle; colour 3 on the eyelet rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Wraps_01.description: A short band of overlapping cloth wraps coiled diagonally around the right upper arm, with layered strips in alternating tones and a flat open top edge. Gives a casual, street or sporty look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Arm_Wraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim, bottom edge and some wrap strips; colour 1 on the broad wrap bands; colour 2 on the shadowed strips between the wraps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Armor_Patterned_01.description: A right forearm bracer of angular armor plates with a flared, open top and a tapered wrist end. A large inset panel runs along the outer face, and contrasting outlines edge each plate. Suits superhero or sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Armor_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and flared cuff; colour 1 on the long inset panel; colour 2 on the outlines and edging.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Alien_01.description: A right forearm bracer with a large curved plate along the outer forearm, banded chevron-striped segments wrapping toward the wrist, and a row of small hooked spikes rising from the elbow end. Alien armored look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large outer plate; colour 0 on the upper forearm shell and alternating bands; colour 2 on the alternating bands and panel; colour 3 on the spikes.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Amazon_01.description: A right forearm bracer shaped like a tapered cuff, with layered chevron-ridged bands near the elbow, a thin rim at the wrist, and a tall pointed flare rising on the outer edge. Fantasy warrior look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell along the forearm; colour 1 on the layered upper bands and the wrist rim; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 3 on the flared edge trim and the diamond emblem.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Anniversary_.description: A tapered, cuff-style bracer worn on the right forearm, wider at the elbow end and narrowing to the wrist. The upper rim has a blocky notched cutout and an open side, giving a retro superhero-villain look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Anniversary_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper part of the bracer, fading to darker shading toward the wrist edge; the other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Anniversary_.description: A chunky retro-robot bracer covering the right forearm: a domed metal shell with a hollow, concave back, a ribbed flexible tube running along the front to a small angular head with two lights at the elbow, and a separate cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Anniversary_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal shell and ribbed tube; colour 1 on the wrist cuff and the inner hollow of the shell; colour 3 on the small lights in the head.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Aquatic_01.description: A short right-forearm bracer with a tapered cuff and a raised, diamond-shaped outer plate framed by thick edging. Two curved fin-like spikes sweep up from the outer edge. Sits at the forearm; aquatic fantasy style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Bracer_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and the spikes; colour 1 on the raised outer plate panels; colour 2 on the edge framing and rim.
