Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Retro_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed housing and top cap; colour 2 on the collar band and the side plate; colour 0 on the barrels and clamp rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Retro_.description: A segmented, ribbed flexible tube-like arm attachment that starts at a boxy cuff on the upper right arm and arcs up and across the chest, with stacked spiky ridges along its length. Suggests a retro sci-fi cyborg look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Retro_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy cuff and the metallic segment bodies; colour 1 on the ridge tips along the top of the segments; colour 2 on the underside of the cuff.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Sandst.description: A small angular bracer worn on the right forearm: a faceted, shield-like plate on the outer side of the arm, pointed at the wrist end, held by a thick band that wraps around the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Sandst.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer plate; colour 2 on the wrap-around band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Shield.description: A heater-style heraldic shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm, with a notched top edge, a pointed lower end, a raised rim, a central diagonal panel and an ornate fleur-like crest. The back has two grip slots.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield face and upper field; colour 1 on the central diagonal panel; colour 3 on the ornate crest; colour 2 on the rim and back.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Swan_0.description: A feathery, ruffled cuff that wraps around the right fist and wrist, with a flat top opening and a jagged, pointed lower edge of layered plumage-like tufts. Suggests a swan-feather bracer with a fantasy look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Swan_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather tufts, fading toward colour 1 at the tips and on the flat top surface.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syring.description: A mechanical forearm-and-hand rig: a cylindrical wrist housing feeds bundled tubes to needle-like syringe spikes over the knuckles, while looping hoses run up the arm to canisters and small nozzle fittings.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syring.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist housing, canisters and fittings; colour 1 on the needle tips and small tube connectors; colour 3 on the hoses; colour 2 on the syringe barrels.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syring.differs: The male version has four syringe needles over the knuckles, slightly more than the female.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syring.description: A cyberpunk forearm rig on the right wrist: a cylindrical manifold on the back of the hand feeds flexible tubes to four needle-tipped syringe claws over the knuckles, with two more tubes running up the forearm to capped canisters.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Syring.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the manifold, canister caps and syringe housings; colour 3 on the tubes; colour 1 on the needles and small connector caps; colour 2 on the syringe bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Victor.description: A slim, V-shaped open bracer worn on the right upper forearm, with a swept-back winged fin at each end and layered stripes along the edge. Reads as a sleek, angular superhero armband.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Victor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wing-like fins; colour 1 on the middle stripe band; colour 2 on the lower edge layer.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Weapon.description: A pair of long, flat, tapering claw blades that project downward from the right fist, side by side, each curving to a sharp point with a notched edge. Suggests a feral, beast-like weapon.

A right-forearm bracer blade: a long, narrow central spike extending well past the wrist, flanked by two swept-back angular fins on either side. Sleek, sharp and sci-fi in style, worn along the outside of the forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Bracer_Weapon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central blade spike; colour 1 on the flanking fins; colour 2 on the underside edge of the blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A pair of long curved blades that hang beside the right forearm and hand, like a bracer of swept, tapering blades. Each ends in a sharp point well below the fist, with a smoother, less serrated edge and a fantasy, monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner blade faces and ridges; colour 1 on the outer blade edges and fins; colour 2 on the darker inner recesses.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.differs: The male version has two smoother, simpler blades with fewer jagged serrations.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A long, thin blade-like shard of psionic energy attached beside the right forearm, flaring near the wrist and tapering to a sharp point well below the hand. Its surface shows veined, crackled patterns.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: The whole blade shows a glowing crackled energy surface that appears to ignore the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A long, thin psionic blade projecting from the right forearm and sweeping down past the knee: a narrow, tapering shard with a faceted, cracked surface and a wider base near the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 across the whole blade; the glassy, glowing default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, hovering as a thin outline just outside the right wrist. It faces sideways and reads as a scientific or superhero badge.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring outlines; colour 1 on the edge trim of the rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem made of three interlocking elliptical rings around a small central ring, floating outward from the right forearm near the wrist. It is paper-thin when seen from the front and suggests a sci-fi superhero badge.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rings and centre ring; colour 0 on the thin outline edging.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a small central ring, floating beside the right wrist and seen face-on only from the side. It reads as a thin outline badge with a sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rings and central ring; the rest of the emblem shows little of the other slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A thin, flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating just outside the right forearm near the wrist like a shield badge. It is seen edge-on from front and back.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rings and the central ring; the edges pick up a small amount of colour 2.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, floating beside the right forearm near the wrist and seen edge-on from the front. It suggests a science or energy theme.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; colour 1 on the outline edges of the rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.description: A long, curved blade with a jagged, serrated spine of angular barbs, hanging beside the right forearm and sweeping down past the thigh to a sharp point. It suggests a sci-fi or monstrous claw-like weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main jagged blade body; colour 1 on the inner edge panel along the blade's underside.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Phantom.description: A sculpted right-hand piece wrapping the fist like a ghostly claw: a curved, pointed blade-like fin sweeps up along the outer wrist and forearm, with knuckle-covering segments curling over the fingers.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Phantom.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole piece, including the sweeping fin and the knuckle segments.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Retrosc.description: A thin, curved translucent glass-like panel on the outer forearm of the right arm, a small flat shard that sits just above the wrist. Sleek retro sci-fi accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Child_Tight_Retrosc.colourAreas: The default glass-like material ignores the colour scheme; it shows a glossy translucent sheen and no visible colour slot.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A tapered angular armour bracer on the right forearm: a wedge-shaped outer shell with layered plates, a small flared cap near the elbow and a squared, open wrist end holding a round lens-like detail. Sci-fi gauntlet look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the large outer shell and wrist ring; colour 1 on the layered side plates; colour 0 on the top cap and back plate; colour 3 on the round detail in the wrist opening.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Clockwork_Armor_01.differs: The male version has a squared contrasting-rimmed wrist opening with a round lens-like detail, more clearly visible from the side.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Cyberclaw_01.description: A hand-mounted cyber claw: three long, curved blade claws extend forward from a small knuckle mount, held on by taut cords wrapped around the hand, with small blocky plates at the base. Suggests a sci-fi, Wolverine-like weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Cyberclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long claw blades; colour 3 on the cords wrapped around the hand; colour 1 on the small joints and connectors at the base; colour 2 on the blocky base plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Cyberclaw_02.description: A set of long, slender metal blades that project forward from the fist, arranged as a fan of three or four tapering claws off a small angular base at the knuckles. Wolverine-style hand weapon with a sleek, sharp look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Cyberclaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw blades; colour 2 on the small base housing at the wrist and knuckles.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Cybermind_02.description: A rounded bracer cuff worn on the right forearm, with a flexible segmented cable rising from it along the arm to the shoulder, ending in a small connector plug. Cybernetic, sci-fi styling.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.description: A single curved blade claw gripped in the right fist, jutting out below the knuckles. A small angled hilt with a contrasting grip and a finned guard sits at the top of the hand. Suggests a cyber assassin look.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_01.differs: The male blade is angled to sit more along the fist, with a larger finned guard at the hilt.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.description: A single long, curved blade claw held in the right fist, sweeping upward past the knuckles to a thin point, anchored by thin rod-like struts and small block mounts at the wrist. Sleek cybernetic weapon look.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_02.differs: The blade sweeps upward and back from the fist, whereas the female blade points forward in a more horizontal line.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.description: A single long curved blade held in the right fist, a tapered, slightly bent claw that sweeps up along the forearm, with a small contrasting grip block and thin rod struts at the hand. Sci-fi weapon style.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_03.differs: The blade sweeps up and back along the forearm, rather than pointing forward from the fist as on the female.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_04.description: A single curved cyber blade held in the right fist: a long, flat, tapering metal claw that sweeps down past the hand to a hooked point, with a small hilt and thin rod-like struts at the grip.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberclaw_05.description: A single long, slender curved blade held in the right hand, tapering to a sharp point beyond the fist, with thin rod-like grip supports and small tabs bracing it against the palm. Cyber-weapon style.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cybershard_01.description: A single tapering blade-like shard held in the right fist, with a blocky faceted base at the knuckles and a long sharp point angling down past the hand. Suggests a cybernetic claw or knife.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cybershard_02.description: A single long, slender curved blade that projects from the right fist. It is a faceted, tapering metal shard with a flared base at the knuckles, and it sweeps to a sharp point. The look is cybernetic.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cybershard_03.description: A single long curved blade claw held in the right fist, a flat tapering shard that sweeps up and back along the forearm to a thin point. Its angular faceted edges give it a cyber-blade look.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cybershard_04.description: A single long, curved blade-claw held in the right fist: a wide faceted base tapers into a slender swept shard with a hooked tip that extends well past the hand. Suggests cyborg or sci-fi weaponry.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Cyberwire_02.description: A minimal cyber hand accessory: a thin bent wire rod with a small faceted cap at one end and a flat angled plate at the elbow, with a long thin wire stretching across the fingers to a pointed blade tip.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_02.description: A chunky faceted band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with a small skull set on the outer side. The skull has hollow eye sockets, a jaw and a glowing gem-like eye. Gothic, biker-style jewellery.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the skull and the lower part of the band; colour 3 on the eye glint; colour 2 on the skull's teeth and jaw.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_03.description: A chunky faceted band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with a small skull set on its front face; the skull has hollow eye sockets and a jagged toothed jaw.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 1 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the teeth.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_04.description: A chunky ring worn on the right hand, with a faceted band that flares into a small skull front with eye sockets and a toothed jaw. A gothic, biker-style hand accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band and skull crown; colour 1 on the lower skull face and jaw; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the teeth.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_05.description: A chunky band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with a small carved skull set on the outer face. The skull has contrasting eye sockets and a toothed jaw. Suggests a gothic or biker look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Skull_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 1 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the teeth.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_01.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled in about two and a half loops around a finger of the right hand, with a tapered tail tip curling up and a small contrasting head hanging down.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the snake's head.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_02.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled in two loops around a finger of the right hand, with a tapering tail tip trailing out and a small blunt head at the other end.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the snake's head.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_03.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled two or three times around a finger of the right hand, with a tapering tail tip curling out and a small head at one end.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the snake's head.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_04.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled in two loops around a finger of the right hand, with a tapering tail end trailing loose and a tiny head at the other end.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the snake's head.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_05.description: A small ring shaped like a snake coiled in two loops around a finger of the right hand, with a tapering tail tip trailing out and a small contrasting head at one end.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Snake_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the coiled snake body; colour 2 on the small head.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_01.description: A small faceted ring with a slim angular band and a pointed shield-shaped bezel holding a round cut stone, worn on a finger of the right hand as a simple fantasy jewel accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the shield-shaped bezel; colour 3 on the central stone.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_02.description: A small angular ring worn on a finger of the right hand: a slim faceted band that widens into a flat, triangular stone-like setting on the palm side, with a shallow inset on the face.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the outer facets of the setting; colour 3 on the inset centre of the setting.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_03.description: A chunky faceted ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with an angular band and a flat, wedge-shaped stone setting on top, giving a rough carved-stone signet look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the outer faces of the stone setting; colour 3 on the top of the stone.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_04.description: A chunky faceted ring band with angular, chiselled edges and a flat pointed stone setting that projects below the band, worn on a finger of the right hand. Suggests a carved, fantasy signet style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring band; colour 1 on the outer faces of the stone setting; colour 3 on the inner face of the stone.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_05.description: A small faceted band ring worn on a finger of the right hand, with a flared angular setting on one side holding a pointed stone with a contrasting centre. Chunky, fantasy jewellery styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Hand_Ring_Stone_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the outer facets of the stone setting; colour 3 on the stone centre.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Light_01.description: A short, wide armband worn around the right upper arm, with an angular octagonal rim and contrasting trim edging. A round dome stud sits on the outer back of the band. Simple superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band body; colour 1 on the rim and edge trim; colour 3 on the round stud.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Lockbox_67_01.description: A tapered, closed sleeve-like arm piece hanging along the right side of the torso, starting angular at the shoulder and ending in a ruffled, gathered flare with a small pendant tassel dangling below.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole sleeve body and ruffled flare; colour 0 on the small hanging tassel.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A small angular shell-like shoulder-arm accessory of faceted plates that curves around the outside of the upper right arm, with a jagged fin-like point at the top and a tapering lower tip.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faceted plates, which take a glossy metallic finish; colour 1 on the inner lining edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_01.description: A single right shoulder accessory made of overlapping angular feather-like blades with veined patterning, sweeping outward from the top of the shoulder in sharp points. Suggests a raven-wing pauldron in a contrasting fantasy style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blade surfaces; colour 1 on the vein lines running along each feather blade.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_01.differs: The blades extend more horizontally outward from the shoulder, rather than hanging down along the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_02.description: A right forearm bracer shaped like a tapering flared cuff with several tall pointed petal-like fins rising toward the elbow. A small round medallion sits on the outer wrist, with thin trim along the cuff edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Ravenswood_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main bracer body and petal points; colour 2 on the round medallion; colour 1 on the thin trim line at the cuff edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Robotsamurai_Bracer.description: A short right forearm bracer with a tapered, angular shell and multi-coloured panels, fitted with three long flat blade-like fins along its outer edge that extend past the wrist and elbow. Samurai-inspired robotic styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Robotsamurai_Bracer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and the three long fins; colour 1 on the main shell panels; colour 2 on the lower and inner panels; colour 3 on the small accent panel near the top.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A chunky right forearm bracer in an ancient-Egyptian style: a slightly flared tube with a flat rim, banded panels and an angular guard plate that extends over the back of the hand toward the knuckles.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panels and the hand guard; colour 1 on the rim, the lower band and the guard's upper edge; colour 2 on the main forearm panel; colour 3 on a small accent at the rim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Spikes_01.description: A cluster of small conical spikes of varied sizes jutting outward from the right upper arm, arranged in a loose ring pattern with no base plate. Suggests a punk or monstrous arm accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Spikysuit_01.description: A bony, organic bracer covering the right forearm, a lumpy ridged shell with mottled markings and two long curved horns sweeping up and outward from the elbow end. Suggests a monstrous, alien armour look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell body; colour 1 on the mottled speckles and patches across the shell; colour 2 on the two curved horns.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Strapsfeathers_01.description: Two thin strap bands wrap around the right upper arm, with a small cluster of three long, narrow feather blades sprouting from the outer side and pointing up toward the shoulder. Tribal, decorative armband styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Strapsfeathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two straps; colour 1 on the main body of the feathers; colour 3 on the feather edges and inner shading.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Strapsfeathers_01.differs: The male version has only three feathers in a small cluster, rather than the larger fan of about eight on the female version.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_01_Gear.description: A chunky cybernetic elbow guard: a rounded, faceted casing wrapped around the right elbow, with a circular disc-like port on the outer point and thin fin-like plates along its edges. Suits sci-fi or robotic looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_01_Gear.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and fins; colour 1 on the port ring and the small strip inserts along the edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.description: A chunky armband worn on the upper right arm: a segmented band with angular panels, a buttoned pouch on the outer side and a row of cylindrical ammo shells held in loops. Suggests a 90s tactical look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the pouch and corner clips; colour 2 on the side blocks and trim; colour 3 on the shell tips.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A chunky faceted armband worn around the upper right arm, with an octagonal band shape, a raised contrasting stripe along the top edge and small round dimples on the outer surface. Suits a retro superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the top stripe edging and inner trim; colour 3 on the raised panel at the top; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Pouch_01.description: A bandolier-style band circling the upper right arm, lined with rows of upright bullet cartridges pointing downward, with a small buttoned flap pouch on the outer side. Tactical, military look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Pouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the pouch; colour 1 on the cartridge casings; colour 3 on the piping and edge trim; colour 2 on the bullet tips.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Angel_Armband.description: A short, faceted armband worn around the upper right arm: an angular multi-sided band with a raised rim and layered horizontal stripes plus a thin cross line on the outer side. Suggests armored superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Angel_Armband.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 2 on the main band; colour 0 on the lower stripe and side panels; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arcane_Armban.description: A short octagonal armband worn on the upper right arm, with a thick rimmed edge, swirling tendril-like embossed patterns and chunky faceted gem studs around the band. Suggests arcane, fantasy styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arcane_Armban.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the faceted gems; colour 2 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the swirling tendril patterns.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Card_01.description: A gathered armband worn around the upper right arm, with ruffled frilly edges and a wide contrasting central band. Two playing cards tuck into the top edge and stick up like a magician's or gambler's accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Card_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled edges and inner lining; colour 1 on the wide central band; colour 3 on the playing cards; colour 2 on the card suit markings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Cyber_Cow.description: A small cylindrical canister strapped to the outside of the upper arm, with a bent pipe rising from the top and a curved nozzle with a flared cap hanging below. Reads as a cyber-western gadget.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Cyber_Cow.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the canister body; colour 0 on the pipe, nozzle and cap tips.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Cyberwire.description: A wide cuff-like armband worn on the upper right arm, made of a tapered, crumpled cloth-like sleeve with a central banded strap, thin bordering trim and round side studs. It has a sleek, cybernetic superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Cyberwire.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main tapered sleeve body; colour 0 on the thin edge trim and border rims; colour 2 on the central band; colour 3 on the round side buttons.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Martial_P.description: A segmented martial arm guard worn on the upper right arm: a curved shell of stacked horizontal plates with contrasting edging, open at the inner side, over wrapped cloth bands, with small knotted cords at the top.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Martial_P.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate segments; colour 2 on the plate edging and dividing bands; colour 1 on the wrapped cloth underneath; colour 3 on the knotted cords.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Martial_P.description: A curved, open-sided armour band wrapping the right upper arm, built from stacked horizontal overlapping plates with a raised contrasting edge frame and small looped cord ties at the top corners. Martial, samurai-style look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Martial_P.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 1 on the plate bands' lighter overlapping surfaces; colour 2 on the edge frame and plate divider lines; colour 3 on the looped cord ties.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Power_01.description: A short armband worn on the right upper arm: a band with a flat, teardrop-shaped outer plate that flares outward, edged with thin raised rims and a contrasting middle strip. Sleek superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate face and rims; colour 1 on the band's middle strip; colour 2 on the inner lining underneath.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Steelarac.description: A chunky segmented armband worn around the right upper arm: a smooth plated shell on the outer side, stacked overlapping ridged bands on the inner side, and two small round holes on the side. Sci-fi armored look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Steelarac.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth outer shell and rim; colour 1 on the stacked ridged bands; colour 2 on the gaps between the bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Toy_01.description: A wide armband worn high on the right upper arm: a flat, angular badge plate with a raised heart outline on the outer side, framed by a bordered rim, joined to a soft band that wraps around the arm and overlaps at the inner side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Arm_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat badge face; colour 1 on the rim around the badge; colour 2 on the raised heart outline; colour 3 on the wrapping band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armarmor_01.description: A short armored band worn around the right upper arm: a rimmed cuff with large rounded plates front and back, segmented ribbed panels along the sides, and a raised trim edge at top and bottom.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band body; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim trim; colour 2 on the large rounded plates; colour 3 on the segmented side panels.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armband_01.description: A folded cloth bandana tied around the upper right arm, with rumpled creases and a knot on the outer side whose two pointed tails hang down. A simple casual or street armband.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armband_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole armband cloth, including the knot and tails.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandchain_.description: A chunky, faceted band worn snugly around the upper right arm, with a flat disc-shaped cap on the outer face and small screw-head fittings with tiny loops at each side. Suggests a sci-fi restraint or gadget cuff.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandchain_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim of the band; colour 1 on the lower band body; colour 3 on the flat cap face and inner lining; colour 2 on the screw fittings and loops.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandtied_0.description: A thin cloth armband wrapped around the right upper arm and tied in a small knot on the outer side, with two short pointed tails hanging down. Simple, casual and slightly rough in style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandtied_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band, knot and tails; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandwing_0.description: A slim armband wrapped around the right upper arm, made of two open-ended strap sections, with a tall curved spike-like wing blade sweeping upward from the outer side. Angular, demonic fantasy accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandwing_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and wing surfaces; colour 1 on the edge trim and outlines of the band and wing.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandwing_0.description: A band worn around the upper arm with a single curved, blade-like wing fin sweeping outward and upward from its outer side. The band has a textured, worn surface with trim edges. The look is superhero or fantasy.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armbandwing_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm band; colour 3 on the wing fin; colour 2 on the thin lines and edging along the fin and band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armor_Extrate.description: A right forearm bracer of weathered, chunky plate with carved spiral glyph lines, a flared cuff at the wrist end and a raised fin-like scoop at the elbow end, plus a separate open ring band higher on the upper arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armor_Extrate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the carved glyph lines and inner scoop; colour 2 on the worn edges and chipped patches.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorbasic_01.description: A tapered, angular forearm bracer with a faceted open cuff, recessed slots on the outer face, chevron-style vents near the wrist and thin trim lines. Sits over the right forearm in a sleek sci-fi armor style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorbasic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 1 on the inner lining and the small recessed slots on the front; colour 3 on the paired slots on the back and side; colour 2 on the wrist vents.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_02.description: A right forearm bracer of angular armored plates, closed around the forearm, with a rim at the elbow end, raised pointed fins and small indicator marks near the wrist. Tech-armor style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the pointed fins and small inset accents; colour 3 on the small indicator marks; colour 2 on the inner lining.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_02.differs: The male bracer wraps more fully around the forearm with a mostly closed front, while the female one has a more open, cut-away front.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armpouch_01.description: A thin, flat faceted strap looping around the upper right arm, with a small rectangular pouch plate on the outer side holding two raised vertical panels. Minimal utilitarian look suited to tactical or sci-fi outfits.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armpouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and pouch frame; colour 1 on the two raised panels and on the patches along the strap.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armpouch_01.differs: The male band is a thin flat strap with a wide gap around the arm, rather than a thick, deep cuff.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armtrumpknigh.description: A chunky band wrapped around the right elbow with a round, slightly domed disc standing out from its outer side like a small shield. The disc face is marked with a six-spoke star pattern.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armtrumpknigh.colourAreas: The default material shows mostly metallic and ignores the colour scheme; the star markings are and the band and disc take little of the test colours, so no slot is clearly visible.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Armtrumpknigh.differs: The male disc has a six-spoke star pattern on its face and appears metallic, while the female disc has a plain face with a broad stripe and a small rectangular accent.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bicepknife_01.description: A combat knife strapped to the right upper arm: a thin faceted band circles the bicep and holds a straight, tapering blade with a crossguard and handle, pointing downward along the outer arm. Tactical, street-ready look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bicepknife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm band; colour 3 on the blade; colour 2 on the handle and crossguard.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A small chunky band worn around the right upper arm, with a faceted outer shell that rises into a smooth domed bulge on the outside of the arm, edged by a thin lower rim. Suggests a crude tribal or fantasy armband.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole band; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The male version has a smoother, more domed top with a thin lower rim, while the female version has a flatter, more clearly faceted top plate.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bolts_01.description: A pair of small hex-headed bolts with round studded shafts, attached to the outer upper arm as tiny mechanical rivets. They read as an industrial, sci-fi detail rather than a garment.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bolts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire bolts, heads and shafts; no other colour slots are visible on this body.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bolts_01.differs: The male version is all one colour, without the contrasting accent rings on the bolt heads that the female version has.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_01.description: A short forearm bracer cuff with a long, thin curved blade of crackled, energy-like texture sweeping down and back past the hip from the wrist. Worn on the right forearm as a psychic slicer weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and blade; the glowing crackled surface appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.description: A smooth, tapered forearm bracer that flares slightly toward the elbow, with a thick faceted rim at the upper edge and a thin trim at the wrist. Sits on the right forearm; clean, sleek superhero armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the thick upper rim and the wrist trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.description: A tapered tube bracer worn on the right forearm, with a banded rim at each end and a large angular, cross-shaped armor plate jutting from the outer side. Suggests a chunky angelic superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer tube; colour 1 on the rim bands at both ends; colour 3 on the angular outer plate.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.description: A short tapered forearm bracer with contrasting trim bands at both rims and a tall curved, swept-back blade fin rising from the outer edge of the forearm. Angelic, armored look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer body; colour 1 on the rim bands at the wrist and elbow ends; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.description: A right forearm bracer, a short tapered cuff with thin contrasting bands at both ends. A stepped angular plate on the outer side carries a long curved scythe-like blade that sweeps forward and down past the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff; colour 1 on the rim bands at both ends; colour 3 on the stepped side plate; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Annive.description: A soft, loose-fitting cloth glove-bracer covering the forearm and back of the hand, with a folded top edge and a stiff separate cuff panel along the outer hand edge fastened with three round studs. Retro superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Annive.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm and hand sleeve; colour 1 on the side cuff panel; colour 2 on the studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Arcane.description: A right forearm bracer of rigid, flared plates with a pointed upper edge and a contrasting inner lining. Swirling scroll patterns surround oval gem-like insets on the outer side. It sits over the forearm and suggests arcane fantasy styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Arcane.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plate; colour 3 on the swirling scroll patterns; colour 1 on the oval gem insets; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Archer.description: A right-arm archer bracer made of three separate faceted rings: a loose band on the upper arm, plus a forearm guard with a tall panel down the outer side and a ring near the wrist. Sits over the sleeve.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Archer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and outer edges; colour 1 on the forearm guard panel; colour 2 on the inner band and guard sections; colour 3 on a thin accent strip on the guard.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Bandag.description: A right forearm bracer of overlapping bandage strips wound in a spiral from wrist to below the elbow, with contrasting stitch-like marks across the wraps; a rough, improvised street or fighter look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Bandag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some of the wrap strips; colour 1 on alternating wrap strips; colour 3 on other wrap strips; colour 2 on the stitch marks.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Bandag.description: Cloth bandage wrapping the right forearm in tight diagonal overlapping bands from below the elbow toward the wrist, with one long loose tail of cloth trailing down past the hand. A casual, street or fighter look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Bandag.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bandage layers and the trailing tail; colour 1 on some wrap bands; colour 3 on other alternating wrap bands; colour 2 on the stitch-like marks across the wraps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.description: A large, angular armored bracer that wraps the right forearm and flares over the wrist, built from faceted plates with a raised fin-like ridge at the elbow end and inset stripe panels. Suggests a superhero or sci-fi blaster gauntlet.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer plates; colour 0 on the inset stripes and edge panels; colour 3 on the inner side and rear rim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.description: A chunky angular right-forearm bracer housing a cluster of blaster barrels at the wrist end, with faceted armored plates, a raised fin-like ridge on top and a striped side panel. Sci-fi superhero gauntlet worn over the forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main faceted armor shell; colour 0 on the stripes, the ridge inserts and the inner edge panel; colour 3 on the underside and back edge panels.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.description: A sci-fi armored bracer for the right forearm: a faceted, angular shell with a hollowed scalloped opening along the inner side, a raised pointed fin at the elbow end, and small vent-like slots.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the pointed fin and small accent tabs; colour 3 on the small slot marks; colour 2 on the inner recess.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.description: A bulky sci-fi blaster bracer covering the right forearm: a smooth angular shell with a vented panel, small indicator lights and a hazard-striped muzzle, plus a cylindrical tank with a curved carry handle along the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blaste.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and tank bands; colour 1 on the tank, muzzle barrels, handle and vent housing; colour 3 on the small indicator lights; colour 2 on the hazard stripe details.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blockb.description: A chunky right forearm bracer with angular plated shell that tapers toward the wrist, a rounded cap of contrasting material at the elbow end with a flat top insert, and two octagonal round-lensed studs on the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blockb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main angular shell and flat top insert; colour 1 on the rounded upper cap; colour 2 on the octagonal housings; colour 3 on the round lens centres.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blockb.differs: The male bracer's upper cap has a flat light-coloured insert on top, and the shell wraps more fully around the wrist.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blockb.description: A chunky, flared forearm bracer worn on the right arm: a tapered armored shell that widens toward the elbow, with recessed contrasting panels holding small oval emblems and a narrow cuff band at the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Blockb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 1 on the wrist cuff band; colour 2 on the recessed inner panels; colour 3 on the oval emblem details.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Child_.description: A long chainsaw-style blade worn along the right forearm, extending well past the hand: a flat slab with a recessed slotted channel and a row of curved teeth along both edges, ending in a few hooked claws at the tip.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Child_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main blade body and casing; colour 2 on the teeth and the recessed slots; colour 0 and colour 1 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Child_.description: A set of four long, curved, blade-like claws projecting from the right fist, fanned side by side and sweeping downward past the hand to sharp points. Suggests a feral, animal-style melee weapon.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Child_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the claw blades; the darker edges show shading of the same blade surfaces.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Child_.description: A pair of slender, finely ridged feathers attached at the right wrist, one sweeping outward and the other angled down along the hand, forming a narrow V-shaped accent. Suggests a wild, tribal or fantasy look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Child_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both feathers; the sheet shows no other colour slots on this piece.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Chimer.description: A right forearm bracer covered in layered, feather-like or fur tufts with jagged, ragged edges at the wrist and elbow. It wraps fully around the forearm and suggests a monstrous, beastly look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Chimer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper tufts near the elbow edge; colour 1 on the middle of the forearm; colour 2 on the ragged tips at the wrist and the inner rim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.description: A right forearm bracer made of two stitched, segmented cuffs joined by straps, with a pair of short, narrow blades attached at the wrist that hang just past the hand. Suits a fantasy or sci-fi fighter.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff bands; colour 1 on the vertical straps and panels between the cuffs; colour 3 on the stitching; colour 2 on the claw blades and small pivot fittings.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.differs: The male claw blades are shorter and use the near-contrasting colour slot, whereas the female blades are longer and share the cuff colour.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.description: A short forearm bracer with a flared cuff and stitched panels, with two long serrated blade claws extending past the hand from a metal mounting plate at the wrist. Suggests street-fighter or animalistic weaponry.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, mounting plate and claw blades; colour 1 on the vertical bracer panels; colour 3 on the stitching; colour 2 on the small connecting straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_C.description: A forearm-mounted chainsaw bracer: a bulky angular motor housing sits on the forearm, with a long narrow toothed blade extending well past the hand toward the knee. Spiked teeth run along the bar; brutal, mechanical look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_C.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the motor housing and blade bar; colour 1 on the recessed panels and grip section at the top; colour 2 on the joints and connector rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_D.description: A serpentine dragon coiled around the right forearm, its spined body spiralling from elbow to wrist, ending in a horned dragon head at the hand with a pair of long curved serrated blade claws extending past the fist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_D.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the dragon body and head; colour 2 on the spines and ridges along the coils; colour 0 on the blade claws; colour 3 on the flame-like markings along the blades.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_F.description: A furry fingerless glove-bracer with a shaggy tuft covering the hand and a slim cuff at the wrist, fastened by a strap with a buckle plate. Long curved blades extend past the knuckles like claws, giving a feral look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_F.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the fur covering the hand; colour 1 on the claw blades; colour 3 on the cuff buckle plate and rivets.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_S.description: A rounded, skull-like bracer worn over the right forearm and wrist, with long curved claw fangs hanging past the hand, bound by twisted cord loops and trailing a few feathers on the inner side. Tribal, primal look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_S.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skull bracer body; colour 0 on the claws and feathers; colour 2 on the cord loops; colour 1 on thin cord accents.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_S.description: A forearm bracer bound with layered cord wraps and a contrasting band, with a long tapered bone-like claw spike jutting down past the hand along the outer arm. Small pegs hold the lashings; a crude tribal, monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_S.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the claw spike and the pegs; colour 0 on the cord wraps; colour 2 on the band under the wraps; colour 3 on the flared inner cuff at the top.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_T.description: A right forearm bracer shaped like a thorny organic claw: a curled, vine-like frame wraps a ridged central panel studded with contrasting thorns, and a long serrated blade extends past the wrist and hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Claw_T.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curled frame, the serrated blade and the outer rim; colour 3 on the ridged central panel; colour 0 on the thorns.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Coil_0.description: A helical metal coil bracer wrapping about three and a half turns around the right forearm near the wrist, tapering to pointed ends at top and bottom. Simple, open spiral that suits sci-fi or tribal looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Coil_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole coil; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cyber_.description: A right forearm bracer of thick, slightly curved plates with raised edges and round rivets. A pointed lower plate in a contrasting shade overlaps the wrist. A western-flavoured, sci-fi armoured cuff.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cyber_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer plate; colour 3 on the lower wrist plate; colour 1 on the rivets; colour 2 on the edge trim and inner shell.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cyber_.description: A right forearm bracer made of two separate angular plates that wrap the arm, one carrying three long curved spikes on its outer face, with small rivets on the second plate. Rugged western cyber style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Cyber_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plate bodies and edges; colour 3 on the three spikes; colour 1 on the small rivets or studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Dragon.description: A serpentine eastern dragon coiled in a loose spiral around the right forearm, with a ridged back, a belly of segmented scale bands with tooth-like markings, and a spiny horned head resting near the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Dragon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belly scales and head; colour 1 on the ridged back and head fins; colour 3 on the tooth-like belly markings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Dragon.description: A serpentine dragon coiled in a tight spiral around the right forearm, with a ridged back, a banded underbelly with small tooth-like markings, and a spiny, finned dragon head resting at the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Dragon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belly bands and the head; colour 1 on the ridged back, fins and head crests; colour 3 on the tooth-like markings along the belly.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Draycu.description: A rigid armored bracer worn on the right forearm, with riveted plates edged in trim and a sculpted snarling monster face with fangs, curved claw-like tusks and a big open mouth on the outer side. Gothic and monstrous.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Draycu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and the face; colour 1 on the edge trim and plate borders; colour 3 on the eyes and the inside of the mouth; colour 2 on the tusks.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.description: A slim armored bracer worn on the right forearm, with a sweeping fan of layered feathers rising from its top edge and pointing back and up past the elbow. Winged, fantasy-flavoured arm accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the bracer plate and its edge details; colour 2 on the short inner feathers; colour 3 on the long outer feathers.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.description: A wrist-mounted wing gauntlet: a cuff at the wrist with a sleek plated forearm base, from which a fan of long, sharp blade-like feathers sweeps back past the elbow. Sci-fi, angular and armour-like.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Feathe.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrist cuff; colour 0 on the plated base; colour 2 on the feather blades; colour 3 on the small marks on the base.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Fin_01.description: A small fin-shaped bracer attached to the outer side of the right forearm: a tapered mottled panel with three curved, backswept blade-like spines along its edge and a thin contrasting rim. Alien, organic look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled panel body; colour 3 on the spots on the panel; colour 1 on the spines and edge rim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Fin_02.description: A small fin-shaped bracer attachment on the outer right forearm: a flared, tapering panel with three swept-back curved spikes and a mottled spotted surface, giving a monstrous, aquatic look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mottled fin panel; colour 3 on the spots; colour 1 on the spike fins and edge trim; colour 2 on the shaded creases.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gadroo.description: A curved, open-backed shield plate that wraps the outside of the right forearm, with a smooth glossy surface etched with circuit-like line patterns. It reads as a sleek sci-fi gauntlet panel.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gadroo.colourAreas: The glossy metallic material ignores the colour scheme; the plate and its etched circuit lines show the default sheen rather than any slot colour.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gadroo.description: A large teardrop-shaped shield blade floating beside the right forearm, a smooth translucent shell that tapers to a sharp point above the elbow and ends in a blunt rounded base at the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Gadroo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; the material looks glassy and largely ignores the colour scheme, with only a faint warm tint along the edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Golden.description: A round patriotic-style shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm by a short cuff band. It has a rim, a raised central disc and a large protruding five-pointed star; the back is a plain smooth dish.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Golden.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shield rim and dish; colour 3 on the central disc; colour 1 on the star; colour 2 on the forearm cuff.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Golden.description: A small round buckler-style shield strapped to the right forearm by a short chunky cuff, with a domed face bearing an atom emblem and a thick rim. It sits off the outer forearm, a superhero golden-age look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Golden.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shield face; colour 0 on the atom emblem; colour 2 on the rim and back of the shield; colour 3 on the forearm cuff.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Hammer.description: A bulky armoured right forearm and hand piece: a segmented cylindrical bracer with padded rounded bands and small round vents, ending in an articulated gauntlet fist that carries a large blocky hammer head on the palm side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Hammer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer core, hammer head and palm; colour 1 on the padded bands and finger plates; colour 2 on the small round vents.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Hammer.description: A right-forearm bracer of two stacked octagonal metal rings with small round side ports, each backed by a padded cushion, ending in a large boxy hammer-like block that covers the fist and wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Hammer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and the hammer block; colour 1 on the padded cushions; colour 2 on the round ports and gaps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Holohe.description: A floating cluster of jagged, hexagonal energy shards that trails along the outside of the right forearm, with a larger burst near the elbow and a smaller one by the wrist. It does not wrap the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Holohe.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to cover the whole field of shards; the glowing material seems to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Inmate.description: A chunky armored bracer on the right forearm, built from stacked angular plates with strapped bands and small buckle details, plus a short chain dangling from the wrist edge. Suggests a prison-inmate or industrial look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Inmate.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and cuff; colour 2 on the underlying straps and back-side plating; colour 3 on the strap tabs and small inserts; colour 1 on small accents between the plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Inmate.description: A thick padded prisoner-style cuff worn around the right wrist, with a length of broken chain links hanging from it down past the hand. Suggests a captive or inmate look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Inmate.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cuff band; the chain ignores the scheme and keeps its own metal look.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Martia.description: A tight, tubular forearm bracer worn on the right arm, with criss-crossing wrapped straps across the front and back and contrasting trim bands at both edges. Suggests a martial arts look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Martia.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 2 on the crossing straps; colour 1 on the trim bands at the rim and cuff.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Martia.description: A tapered martial-arts bracer worn on the right forearm, flaring wider at the elbow end, with a padded rolled rim at both ends and a T-shaped angular plate inlay down the outer face.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Martia.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leather bracer body; colour 1 on the rolled rims at both ends; colour 2 on the angular T-shaped plates; colour 3 on the inset wedge within the T-plate.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Mech_0.description: A tapered armored bracer for the right forearm with a flared rolled rim at the elbow end, slotted vents down the front, thin channel lines, and a perforated raised panel with a boxy contrasting block at the back.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Mech_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell and rim; colour 3 on the front vent slots and thin channel lines; colour 1 on the perforated back panel; colour 2 on the boxy block and inner opening.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Night_.description: A tapered forearm bracer of segmented armored panels with a raised, open flared cup at the elbow end and a thin cuff ring at the wrist. Contrasting piping outlines the panels, with a round stud and a small tab on the sides.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Night_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared cup and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the main armor panels; colour 1 on the piping between panels; colour 3 on the round stud and the small side tab.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Night_.description: A chunky armoured bracer for the right forearm, flaring at the elbow end with a rounded cuff. Octagonal discs with concentric rings sit on each side, and a segmented ribbed panel runs down the outer edge. Sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Night_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and cuff edges; colour 1 on the inset panels beside the ribbing; colour 2 on the segmented ribbed strip; colour 3 on the disc centres.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Night_.description: A set of three long, narrow blade claws that extend past the knuckles of the right fist, mounted on a slim wrist bracer. Each blade is flat and tapers to a sharp point, in a superhero berserker style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Night_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade edges and bracer rims; colour 1 on the flat faces of the blades; colour 2 on the darker back and inner surfaces.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Night_.description: A small rectangular armor plate worn on the outer right forearm near the wrist, held by two contrasting straps with buckle tabs. The plate has a raised rim and chevron ridges, giving a compact sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Night_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate rim and chevron ridges; colour 1 on the recessed plate panels; colour 2 on the two straps and the back of the plate; colour 3 on the strap buckles.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nightm.description: A right forearm bracer of angular, spiked armor plating with a flared, jagged cuff, inset chevron-patterned panels, and two long curved blades sweeping well past the hand. Sits over the forearm with a dark, menacing feel.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nightm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the long blades and edge trim; colour 3 on the chevron inset panels; colour 2 on the recessed gaps and slots.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Nightm.differs: The blades are longer and extend further down past the hand, with a slightly bigger cuff.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Party_.description: A thin beaded bracelet worn loosely around the right wrist, made of a ring of chunky faceted, lumpy beads in four alternating segments; a casual, playful accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Party_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one bead segment; colour 1 on another bead segment; colour 2 on a third bead segment; colour 3 on the fourth bead segment.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Power_.description: A short armored bracer worn on the right forearm: a curved shell with a raised, flared plate along the outer edge, a bordered shield-shaped panel, small stud accents and a separate end band at the wrist. Suits fantasy or sci-fi armor looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Power_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal edge frames and rims; colour 1 on the main curved shell; colour 2 on the inner shield panel; colour 3 on the wrist-end band and small studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Power_.description: A rigid forearm bracer with a tapered, angular shell, a raised pointed flare at the elbow end, a round disc-shaped node on the outer edge and a raised hexagonal plate on the side. Sits over the right forearm; superhero-style armour.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Power_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim, edge trim and elbow flare; colour 2 on the side plate; colour 3 on the centre of the round node.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psiini.description: A short wrist bracer with a tall, curved blade-like fin sweeping up and back from the outer forearm, with two narrow slits in the fin and a veined, crackled surface. Suggests a psionic, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psiini.colourAreas: The whole bracer shows mostly the default surface with a web-like vein pattern; the colour scheme has little visible effect, so colour 0 is the likeliest slot for the main body.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psisli.description: A slim bracer worn on the right forearm with a long, tapering blade-like crystalline shard extending down past the hip toward the knee. The surface shows fractured, veined facets, giving an energy-blade look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Psisli.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer cuff and blade; the crystalline material shows veining and appears to ignore the other slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Quagmi.description: A forearm bracer made of thick, tangled vine-like tendrils wrapped densely around the right forearm, with ragged loose ends sticking out at the edges. Organic, overgrown and swampy in style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Quagmi.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the outer tangled strands; colour 0 on the thick central wrapped strands; colour 2 on the shadowed inner strands on the back of the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Quagmi.description: A tangled bracer of interwoven vine-like tendrils and thin fibrous strands wrapped densely around the right forearm, with loose frayed ends sticking out. Wild, organic and overgrown in style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Quagmi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick wrapped inner strands; colour 1 on the loose outer tendrils and frayed tips; colour 2 on a few shadowed strands in the tangle.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Qularr.description: A short armored bracer band worn on the right forearm, with a angular pointed lower edge and layered segmented plates that sweep into a tall backward-curving spike blade rising from the outer side of the forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Qularr.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the bracer shell and spike plates; colour 3 on the inset panels and inner lining; colour 0 on the narrow edge trim and segment lines.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Rockcr.description: A chunky right-forearm bracer built from stacked, cracked rock slabs with glowing seams between them, topped by two large faceted crystal shards pointing up and outward from the outer forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Rockcr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the glowing seams and cracks between the slabs; colour 1 on the crystal shards; colour 2 on the crack outlines.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Rockcr.description: A chunky right forearm bracer built from stacked, cracked rock slabs with a jagged outer edge, topped by two pointed crystal shards that jut up and forward from the outside of the arm. Fantasy elemental look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Rockcr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the glowing cracks and gaps between the rocks; colour 1 on the crystal shards.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roines.description: An angular armoured bracer worn on the right forearm: a smooth plated front panel, a long curved blade-like spike sweeping back past the elbow, and a jagged flared cuff with ribbed inner segments near the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roines.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate and spike; colour 1 on the ribbed inner segments; colour 2 on the cuff band and flared wrist fins; colour 3 on the accents inside the cuff.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roines.description: A right-wrist bracer with a large swept-back angular plate over the forearm and a long curved blade-claw hanging down past the fist. Slotted openings in the blade and a small cord wrap at the wrist give it an alien, predatory look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roines.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw blade and wrist band; colour 2 on the upper swept plate and back shell; colour 3 on the angled inset panels; colour 1 on the cord wrap at the wrist.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roines.description: A single alien-styled bracer worn on the right forearm, with a swept-back angular armored cap at the wrist and a long curved blade-like claw blade extending down past the hand. Wire-like bindings hold it at the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Roines.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long claw blade and wrist plate; colour 2 on the swept armored cap and outer housing; colour 3 on the angular inset accents; colour 1 on the wire bindings at the wrist.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sacred.description: A short, plain octagonal bracer worn snugly around the right wrist. Faceted sides with a slightly raised ridge along the edges give it a simple, sturdy, faintly ancient look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sacred.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole bracer; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.description: A single curved fin-shaped spike attached to the outer side of the right forearm. It sweeps from a pointed tip near the elbow to a broad, angled base by the wrist, in a monstrous aquatic style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the piece shows no other visible colour slots.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.description: A single large fin-shaped spike on the outer right forearm: a swept-back blade with a notched secondary barb near its base, sitting close to the arm and pointing back toward the elbow.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sharkf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the piece appears to use a single colour slot.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm by two short straps, with a raised rim, a recessed face bearing an atom emblem, and a flat plain back. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim edge and the recessed face; colour 1 on the broad border band and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the inner rim line and the back of the shield; colour 3 on the two arm straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A curved heater-style shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm, with a rounded top edge, a tapering base, a thin rim and an atom emblem on the face. Two loop straps hold it to the arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper half of the shield face; colour 0 on the lower half of the face; colour 2 on the rim and the back; colour 3 on the straps; the atom emblem is a slightly different shade of the face colours.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A heater-style shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm by two loop straps. The pointed-bottom face is quartered and bears an atom emblem, with a thick rim and a plain flat back.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the face and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the other two quarters; colour 2 on the rim and back; colour 3 on the forearm straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped to the outer right forearm by two loop straps, hanging along the arm. Its face has a raised rim, an inset field and an atom emblem; the back is plain and flat.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edge and inset face; colour 1 on the raised border band and the atom emblem; colour 2 on the back and inner rim lines; colour 3 on the two arm straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A kite-shaped heater shield strapped along the outside of the right forearm by two looped straps on its back. The face is quartered with an atom emblem at the centre and a raised rim; a plain back.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on two opposite quarters of the shield face and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the other two quarters; colour 2 on the rim and the back; colour 3 on the arm straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A round shield strapped to the outside of the right forearm by a short wrist cuff, its face showing a sculpted lion head inside a raised rim with a textured zigzag border; the back is a plain flat dish.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, outer rim and border; colour 1 on the lion face and the inner ring band; colour 2 on the lion mane and the shield back.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.description: A round shield worn on the outer right forearm, held by a short wide cuff band. The rim has a notched edge, runic lettering in two arcs, a radiating spoke ring and a central angular diamond glyph.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Shield.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff band and shield rim; colour 3 on the runic lettering; colour 0 on the face of the shield around the glyph; colour 2 on the central glyph and the back plate.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Skull_.description: A snug cloth bracer on the right forearm with a spiked, skull-like armour shell over the outer face: toothy jaw, studded eye dots, a large round gem-like orb, a tall horn and curved claw spikes.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Skull_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell; colour 1 on the cloth bracer sleeve; colour 2 on the stripes and spike edges; colour 3 on the orb and eye dots.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Snake_.description: A snug forearm bracer covered in fine overlapping scales on one side, with segmented banded plates on the other and a trimmed rim at the top. Two long curved talon blades sweep past the wrist over the back of the hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Snake_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled panel and top rim; colour 1 on the banded plates and edge trim; colour 2 on the claw blades.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sparta.description: A tapered forearm bracer, a curved shell that wraps the outer forearm with an open front lined by criss-cross lacing and cross straps, finished with contrasting edge trim. Sits between elbow and wrist in a Greco-Roman warrior style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sparta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the lacing and cross straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sparta.description: A Greek-style forearm bracer with an open front laced by crossed straps, a Greek-key border near the wrist, contrasting edge trim, and a sculpted lion-head boss at the elbow end on the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Sparta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer body; colour 1 on the lion head and edge trim; colour 3 on the Greek-key pattern and lion eyes; colour 2 on the crossed straps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spike_.description: A pair of curved, tapering spikes on the outer right forearm: one long swept-back horn-like spike and a shorter, thinner one below it, each attached directly to the arm without a band.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spike_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the large spike; colour 1 on the spike tips and the smaller spike.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spike_.description: Two curved, tapering thorn-like spikes jutting backward from short open collars on the right forearm, one near the elbow and one nearer the wrist. They give a feral, aggressive accent to a bracer.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spike_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 3 on the collar bases where the spikes attach.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spikes.description: Three curved, tapering horn-like spikes in a row along the outer right forearm, each sweeping backward to a sharp point from a small collar-like base. A menacing, monstrous bracer accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Spikes.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies, fading toward colour 1 at the tips; colour 3 on the base rims.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Steela.description: A rigid angular forearm bracer of layered metal plates with a pointed fin along the outer edge, and a long curved blade-like spike extending past the wrist and hand. Suggests an armored sci-fi or arachnid-themed weapon gauntlet.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Steela.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer plates; colour 1 on the chevron stripes across the forearm; colour 3 on the long curved blade spike; colour 2 on the inner cuff opening.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Steelh.description: A row of long, curved blade-like feather fins attached along the outside of the right arm, sweeping back and down past the hip to sharp points. It reads as a winged arm blade, in a superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Steelh.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer feather blades; colour 0 on the inner connecting spine and its underside; colour 2 on the narrow shadowed edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Steelh.description: A right forearm bracer with a scale-textured feathered cuff, a pointed flared rim at the elbow end and a strap across the hand, ending in three long curved talon blades that sweep past the knuckles.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Steelh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled feather plating; colour 1 on the pointed rim, edge trim and talon bases; colour 2 on the wrist strap; colour 3 on the talon blades.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Symbio.description: A right forearm bracer with a smooth curved shell that wraps the outer forearm, edged with a rim and topped by two sharp swept-back blade spikes on layered panels. Sits between elbow and wrist with an aggressive symbiote-like look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Symbio.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim and inner edge; colour 2 on the spiked blade panels.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Symbio.description: A chunky angular forearm bracer built from faceted plates that wrap the outside of the arm, with a raised open frame holding two cylindrical canisters and a curved side panel. Sci-fi, symbiote-tech look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Symbio.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plates and frame; colour 1 on the curved side panel; colour 2 on the inner backing; colour 3 on the canister caps and tops.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tech_B.description: A chunky tech bracer on the right forearm with panelled housing and small control details, from which a long, curved, serrated blade sweeps down past the thigh. The blade has jagged saw-tooth edges, giving a sci-fi claw weapon look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tech_B.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bracer housing and its panels; colour 2 on the blade body and serrated teeth; colour 1 on the inner edge strip of the blade.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tesla_.description: A right-forearm bracer made of three stacked open rings held apart by thin struts, with jagged lightning-bolt fins running along its length and a small round tip at one end. Sits loosely around the forearm above the wrist; sci-fi, electrical look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tesla_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the three rings; colour 1 on the lightning-bolt fins; colour 3 on the round tip; colour 2 on the thin connecting struts.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tesla_.description: Three thin floating rings stacked along the right forearm near the wrist, each held off the arm by fine contrasting spokes. They give a light energy-coil, tech-bracer look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Tesla_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; colour 2 on the thin spokes connecting them to the arm.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Troope.description: A thick, cylindrical armored bracer worn on the right forearm, with a riveted, segmented plate body, weathered mottled surface, and a raised rim of small spikes at the elbow end and a contrasting band at the wrist end.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Troope.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate body; colour 1 on the spiked upper rim and lower band; colour 2 on the rivet holes and worn stains.
