Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vine_L.description: A loose open tangle of thin twisting vine stems spiralling around the right forearm above the wrist, with small angular leaves scattered along the branches. Organic, fantasy nature-inspired bracer.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vine_L.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vine stems and most leaves; colour 2 on some darker stem sections and a few leaves; colour 1 on shaded leaves at the back.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vine_T.description: A tangle of thin thorny vines wrapped loosely in open loops around the right forearm near the wrist, with small sharp thorns jutting outward. A wild, organic, gothic-fantasy bracer.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Vine_T.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vine stems; colour 1 on the thorns.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Viperl.description: A right forearm bracer of angular armor plates with two rounded cup-like cuffs on the outer side, a central inset panel, and long pointed blades that sweep down over the back of the hand. Sci-fi superhero style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Viperl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates, cuffs and blades; colour 1 on the inset panel between the cuffs; colour 2 on the recessed panels; colour 3 on the small accent stripes.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Wolf_0.description: A right forearm bracer with a flared, angled cuff, a trimmed upper edge and contrasting wrap cords near the wrist, ending in a knuckle housing with three long curved blade claws that extend past the hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Wolf_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer plates and claw blades; colour 3 on the trim along the upper edge; colour 1 on the small diamond gems; colour 2 on the wrist wraps, back plate and knuckle housing.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchains_.description: A length of heavy chain wound in loose spiral loops around the right forearm and wrist, with a few looser coils near the elbow and a tight cluster at the fist. Gritty street or punk look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchains_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; the metal shows textured shading and no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchains_.description: Heavy chunky chain links wound in loose spiralling loops around the right forearm and wrist, with tight coils at the wrist and looser wraps up toward the elbow. Gives a shackled, cursed look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchains_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; the darker gaps between links show the body beneath, not a colour slot.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchains_.description: A heavy chain wrapped in loose spiralling coils around the right forearm and fist, with thick interlocking links and a trailing loop near the elbow. A rugged, punk or gladiator-style bracer.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerchains_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 in the shadowed gaps between links.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerexartde.description: A right forearm bracer of segmented curved plates with thin etched lines, capped by contrasting rims at wrist and elbow, and a tall swept-back fin blade along the outer edge. Retro-futuristic art deco superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerexartde.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and the fin blade; colour 1 on the rims at both ends; colour 2 on the thin etched lines between plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersaniubi.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a smooth central section and thick horizontal ribbed bands at both ends, separated by thin contrasting lines. Octagonal open shape with a wrapped, Egyptian-styled look on the right forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersaniubi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central body and rim; colour 3 on the ribbed end bands; colour 1 on the thin lines between the bands and the centre.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersaniubi.differs: The male bracer has ribbed wrapped bands at both ends with thin contrasting lines, instead of the female's panelled shape with an inset plate.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersasquat.description: A right forearm bracer made of a padded, rolled panel with an open seam edge, wrapped by three horizontal straps and studded with small rivet holes. Jagged tufts of fur spike out from both the elbow and wrist ends.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersasquat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer panel; colour 1 on the fur tufts at both ends; colour 2 on the horizontal straps and rivet holes; colour 3 on the stitched edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersasquat.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a smooth cuff wrapped in several horizontal straps, edged by tufts of jagged fur at both ends and curved, ornately patterned spikes along the outer edge; tribal, beast-hunter styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracersasquat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the fur tufts at the top and wrist; colour 2 on the horizontal straps; colour 3 on the curved spikes and the stitched edge trim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerspiked_.description: A right forearm bracer made of a curved plate with a contrasting inner lining, three long swept-back blades along the outer edge, and two flat oval discs that stick out to the side. Worn on the forearm above the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerspiked_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate; colour 1 on the inner lining and the three blades; colour 3 on the two side discs; colour 2 on the plate edging.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerstraps_.description: A short, snug wrist bracer with a slightly faceted, softly ribbed cuff and two parallel straps with small square buckles wrapped around the outer side. Sits at the wrist of the right arm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Bracerstraps_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 0 on the buckle frames.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Buttoncuff_02.description: A short, wide faceted cuff band that wraps around the right wrist, with a single round button on the outer side of the wrist. A plain, simple shirt-cuff style accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Buttoncuff_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 1 on the button.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy forearm bracer shaped like an open carton, with angular faceted sides, an open top rim and a folded flap sticking up at the elbow end. It sits on the right forearm above the wrist, with a novelty look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the open rim, inner top and flap edges; colour 1 on the main body of the carton; colour 2 on the large angled front and side panel; colour 3 on the small angled patch on the side and back.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Bracer_.description: A pair of long, flat, straight blade claws extending downward from the right fist, each tapering to a sharp point with small notches along one edge. Wolverine-style hand weapon for a feral superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Child_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blades; no other slots are visible on this piece.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Dual_01.description: A right-hand claw weapon: a layered plated cuff at the wrist with contrasting clamp bands, holding two long, curved, jagged-edged blades that sweep down past the knee beside the leg. Sharp, aggressive, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Claw_Dual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented cuff plates; colour 2 on the clamp bands; colour 1 on both blades.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Combat_01_Bra.description: A curved armor plate worn on the outer right forearm, held by three contrasting straps across its face and two open octagonal cuff rings at the ends. Practical, tactical combat bracer.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Combat_01_Bra.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved armor plate; colour 2 on the three straps; colour 0 on the two cuff rings and buckles.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A short faceted armband worn around the right upper arm: a slightly tapered, many-sided cuff with light trim bands at the top and bottom edges and a contrasting inner section. It suggests a simple superhero or sci-fi accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and bottom rim bands; colour 1 on the main outer cuff panel; colour 2 on the inner lining and side panel.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_01.differs: The male cuff shows a clear two-tone pattern, with light rim bands, a bold panel and a contrasting inner panel, rather than the female version's mostly dark, glassy look.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_02.description: A short faceted bracer worn on the right forearm near the wrist: an octagonal tapered cuff with raised rims at the top and bottom edges, and a small recessed slot on the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body and rims; colour 2 in the recessed slot.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cosmic_02.differs: The male cuff has a small recessed slot on the outer side and is coloured mostly with colour 0, while the female cuff has no slot and uses colour 2 on the outside.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.description: A pair of angular armour plates strapped to the right arm, one over the upper arm and a smaller one over the forearm, each with a bevelled edge, a curved lower panel and small rivets. Tactical cyberpunk styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate shells; colour 1 on the curved lower panel of each plate; colour 2 on the inner edges and undersides.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A short forearm bracer that widens toward the elbow, made of a smooth outer shell with a separate inset panel, small rivet-like studs and a few ridged vents near the wrist. Sits over the right forearm in a sleek sci-fi style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 2 on the inset panel; colour 1 on the thin trim along the edges and wrist cuff; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor_0.description: A short, faceted armour band that wraps the right upper arm, with a raised contrasting rim along the top edge and hex-bolt heads studded around its sides. Suggests cyborg or sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the rim trim; colour 0 on the bolt heads.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbot_.description: A tapered forearm bracer of segmented armor bands, with a flat-topped rim at the elbow end bearing short cone spikes and a slim trim ring at the wrist edge. Suggests robotic sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and wrist edge trim; colour 1 on the segmented band body; colour 2 on the spikes and the seam lines between bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbot_.description: A tapered right forearm bracer of horizontally segmented armor bands with a flared, faceted top cuff and thin rim at the wrist end. Conical spikes jut from the cuff sides, plus a round stud spike on the front.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, wrist rim and side strip; colour 1 on the segmented armor bands; colour 2 on the spikes and segment lines.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbot_.differs: The male version adds an extra small spike on the front of the cuff, beside the side spikes.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbot_.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a wide faceted rim at the elbow end, a body of horizontal segmented plates, a narrow vertical strip along one side, and short conical spikes jutting from the rim.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Destroyerbot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, cuff edge and side strip; colour 1 on the segmented plates; colour 2 on the spikes and plate gaps.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Egyptian_Armb.description: A short, snug armband worn around the upper right arm: a faceted, roughly octagonal band with fine horizontal ribbing, a smooth wide band along one edge and a thin rim on the other. Suits Egyptian or superhero looks.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Egyptian_Armb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin top rim; colour 1 on the smooth band beneath the rim; colour 3 on the ribbed lower body of the band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Elbowpad_01.description: A small elbow band worn on the right arm: a stack of thin layered rings forms a faceted octagonal cuff, with a rounded padded plate on the back of the elbow studded with a grid of small round rivets.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Elbowpad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rear elbow plate; colour 1 on the top cap and the thin edge band of the cuff; colour 2 on the layered rings; colour 3 on the rivets.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Electric_01.description: A sci-fi forearm bracer with a smooth, slightly tapered shell, a perforated inner panel, and three coil-wrapped electrode prongs on the outer side, each capped with a hex nut. A ribbed cable loops along the edge.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the perforated inner panel and end lining; colour 3 on the coil windings and thin outline trim; colour 2 on the hex nuts, prong caps and cable.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Extra_Bracer_.description: A set of three long, slightly curved blade claws that extend from the knuckles of the right fist and sweep down past the thigh. Thin, tapering metal spikes give it a feral, superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Extra_Bracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three blades; the metal finish shows little of the other slots, with no separate trim visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fantasy_Armba.description: A short tubular armband worn on the right upper arm: a soft striped cloth sleeve topped by a thick angular band studded with round gems, giving a fantasy, heraldic look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fantasy_Armba.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the alternating vertical stripes of the cloth sleeve; colour 2 on the top band; colour 3 on the gems set into the band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A short right forearm bracer with a curved shell plate and a fan of pointed feather blades along the upper edge. Three wrapping straps with tapering tips cross the forearm, giving a fantasy, tribal look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell, feather blades and straps; colour 1 on the rounded inset panels and the strap tips; colour 2 on the inner panel strip; colour 3 on the small strap fasteners.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fin_01.description: A small fin-like arm accessory on the right upper arm: a fan of three webbed membrane segments separated by curved, backswept spines, with a long pointed spike trailing behind. Suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 1 on the spines and edge trim; colour 3 on the spotted markings across the membrane.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fin_02.description: A set of three stacked, swept-back fin blades attached to the outer right upper arm, each ending in a long curved spike, with a contrasting edge trim and mottled surface texture. Suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin surfaces; colour 1 on the edge trim and spike tips; colour 3 on the speckled markings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Flower_01.description: A right forearm bracer of overlapping leaf-like shards fanning out in sharp points toward the elbow, bound at the wrist by thin wrapping bands with a small rose-like flower on the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist bands, flower and some shard tips; colour 1 on many of the shards; colour 2 on the darker shards; colour 3 on small accents at the shard bases.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A small faceted oval gemstone with a flat back, mounted against the side of the right hip or thigh. Its glossy cut facets form a domed cabochon-like jewel, suggesting a decorative fantasy or sci-fi accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The glossy gem facets appear to ignore the colour scheme under the default material, showing a reflective finish; no distinct slot areas are visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted gemstone in an elongated rhombus shape, with bevelled edges and a glossy surface, mounted flat against the outer upper arm on the right side. A small decorative crystal accent.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores the colour scheme in its default material; no colour slot is clearly visible on it.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small faceted gemstone block shaped like a beveled square slab, mounted flat on the outer side of the right wrist or hand. It has a glossy, glassy surface with angled edges and reads as a jewel-like ornament.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem surface largely ignores the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are clearly visible on this piece.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A single faceted pentagonal gemstone slab with a bevelled edge, mounted flat against the outer side of the right upper body. It reads as a chunky decorative jewel stud with a glossy, cut-glass look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bevelled facet edges; the glossy face ignores the scheme and stays very dark; other slots not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A small faceted gemstone cut in a heart shape, worn flat against the outer side of the right upper arm. Its angular facets and glossy finish give it a decorative, jewel-like look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gemstone ignores most of the colour scheme; it takes colour 2 on its main body, with faint colour 1 sheen on the upper facets.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A single teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone plate that sits flat against the body on the right side of the chest, with a bevelled edge on one side and a smooth, glossy face.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The glossy gem ignores most of the colour scheme; colour 1 shows only as a faint tint along the bevelled edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Greave_01.description: A smooth, tapered forearm bracer that wraps the right forearm from wrist to below the elbow. It has a flared open top edge and a faceted plate shell with small contrasting trim tabs at each end. Sleek armor styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Greave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 3 on the small trim tabs at the top and bottom edges.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Harajuku_Wrap.description: A tapered cloth forearm wrap of tightly bound horizontal bands that sits on the right forearm just above the wrist, with a slightly thick rim at the top and a snug, wrinkled, bandage-like look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Harajuku_Wrap.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the alternating wrap bands and inner lining; colour 2 on the other alternating bands and the top rim.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hipanbracer_0.description: A right forearm bracer of layered armor: a flared plated shell with ridged, overlapping fin-like plates along the outer edge, wavy inset grooves on top, and a segmented inner panel edged with small protruding tabs.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hipanbracer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and ridged plates; colour 1 on the wavy inset grooves; colour 2 on the segmented inner panel; colour 3 on the tab-like protrusions along the edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A angular armband worn on the upper right arm: a chunky wrapped band with a raised curved panel above it and a small cylindrical block at the back. Suggests a sci-fi force-field emitter.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band edges and the upper curved panel outer rim; colour 1 on the upper panel, back block and inner band panels; colour 2 on the strap and side clamp; colour 3 on the inner band lining.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The male version is solid with distinct colour panels, a clamp and a cylindrical back block, while the female version is a translucent crackled energy band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Holohexarmor_.description: A angular sci-fi bracer worn on the right forearm: faceted hard plates form a tapering shell with two raised horn-like spikes at the elbow end, small round studs, and a circular light node on the outer face.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Holohexarmor_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell plates; colour 2 on the spike tips and the trim inserts near the wrist and elbow; colour 3 on the circular light node; small studs take colour 2.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hornsmonster_.description: A scatter of small curved bone spikes and thorns, each set on a small flat plate, studded along the right forearm; one longer horn sweeps upward along the arm. Monstrous, tribal look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hornsmonster_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone spikes; colour 3 on the small mounting plates beneath each spike.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hornsmonster_.description: A set of curved bone-like horns mounted on small angular base plates along the outer right forearm: one large swept horn near the elbow, a smaller spike beside it and another lower toward the wrist. Monstrous, tribal styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Hornsmonster_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and spikes; colour 3 on the small base plates they grow from.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Knight_02.description: A small curved plate guard for the right upper arm, shaped like a half-shell with layered ridged bands and a raised rim on top. Conical spikes and studs stud the outer face, giving a medieval knight look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and the spikes; colour 3 on the main plate body and the ridge bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.description: A pair of stacked angular bands worn around the right upper arm: a thin zigzag-edged upper ring with a raised inset panel on the outer side, and a thicker faceted lower band separated by a gap.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper zigzag band; colour 1 on the raised inset panel; colour 2 on the lower band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Luchadordolla.description: A short cloth wrestling-style bracer worn on the right forearm, with a wide folded cuff at the top, a fitted band below, and a raised three-dimensional dollar sign mounted on the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Luchadordolla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band of the bracer and the raised dollar sign frame; colour 1 on the folded top cuff and the bottom edge trim; colour 2 and colour 3 on the patterned fill inside the dollar sign.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Luchadorhawk_.description: A short cuff-style bracer worn on the forearm near the wrist, with a rolled contrasting rim and a large flat feather-like fin of splayed fingers along the outer edge. A small emblem is printed on the cuff, giving a luchador superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Luchadorhawk_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and the feather fin; colour 1 on the rim, edging and fin outline; colour 2 on the small emblem markings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lycan_02.description: A long forearm covering of shaggy, jagged fur tufts that runs from the elbow down to the wrist, with sharp spiky clumps jutting out along the outer edge. It suggests a feral, lycanthrope look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lycan_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 3 on the inner tufts and spike tips; colour 0 on the fringe along the edges; colour 2 in the shadowed depths between tufts.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lycanbracer_0.description: A tight, furry forearm bracer with a jagged, ragged edge and rows of sharp curved spikes along the outer side. It wraps the right forearm from below the elbow toward the wrist, in a feral, lycan-like style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Lycanbracer_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 0 on the ragged fur edges and tufts; colour 3 on the spikes and streaks in the fur.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Martialartspa.description: A right forearm bracer shaped like a short tapered octagonal cuff with contrasting bands at both ends, plus a narrow plate extending over the back of the hand with three round knuckle studs. Martial-arts style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Martialartspa.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff and the hand plate; colour 1 on the top and bottom bands of the cuff; knuckle studs take colour 0.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Mechassassin_.description: A bulky angular sci-fi forearm shield-gauntlet made of layered, segmented plates with pointed wing-like edges, sitting on the outer right forearm above the wrist, with recessed inner panels and small end caps.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Mechassassin_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the recessed inner panels and edge inlays; colour 3 on the end caps and thin stripe accents; colour 2 on the gaps and underside.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A right forearm bracer with a rigid angular guard, a central raised panel flanked by ribbed side sections, and a contrasting hand strap ending in three long curved blade claws that extend past the knuckles. Superhero vigilante styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main guard panel; colour 1 on the central stripe and ribbed side sections; colour 2 on the rim, strap, mounting and claws.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracers_.description: A ninja-style right forearm bracer: a broad angular plate runs along the outer forearm, with a wrapped, banded cloth section around the wrist and an octagonal cuff. A studded knuckle plate covers the back of the hand.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracers_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour plate, knuckle plate and the thin bands around the wrap; colour 1 on the wrapped cloth section; colour 2 on the cuff rims and edge trim.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracers_.differs: The male version adds a larger plate over the back of the hand, carrying three studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracers_.description: A right forearm bracer with a large curved plate on the outer side, tapering to a point toward the wrist. Wrapped cloth binding with thin cords sits between contrasting end caps, giving a gladiator or ninja look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ninjabracers_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer plate and thin cord wraps; colour 1 on the wrapped cloth binding; colour 2 on the end caps and rims.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Norse_Fur_01.description: A tubular fur bracer for the right forearm with shaggy, jagged fur at the wrist and elbow edges, wrapped in crossing straps in a zigzag lacing. Suggests a rugged Norse or barbarian look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Norse_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur; colour 2 on the crossing wrap straps. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Persian_Brace.description: A short tapered cuff bracer worn on the right forearm, with an octagonal opening, swirling scrollwork patterns across the surface, thin contrasting trim at both edges and a rounded gem set on the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Persian_Brace.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 2 on the swirling scrollwork; colour 3 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the gem.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Post_Apoc_Bra.description: A post-apocalyptic forearm bracer: a slightly tapered cloth-like wrap with a rigid scratched plate along the outer edge, held by two thin straps with small buckles and studded with screws. Sits over the right forearm.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Post_Apoc_Bra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrap; colour 1 on the outer plate; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the buckles and screws.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Qularr_Armor_.description: A short segmented armor band worn around the upper right arm: an angular, faceted cuff with stacked overlapping plates across the back and a smooth rounded front, finished with a contrasting rim at the top and bottom.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Qularr_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the rim edging and the plate ridges; colour 2 on the darkest recesses between plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_Ar.description: A short, chunky faceted armguard on the right upper arm: a boxy, slightly tapered cylinder with a mottled stone-like surface, ending in a gathered ring of stacked ridged bands above the elbow. Retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_Ar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armguard shell; colour 1 on the ridged lower bands; colour 3 on thin accent lines between the bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_Br.description: A short retro sci-fi bracer worn on the right forearm: a tapered cuff with a rigid mottled outer shell, a clear transparent panel down the inner side and a narrow band at each end.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_Br.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the transparent panel edges and lower band; colour 1 on the upper rim and part of the shell; colour 2 on the shell's darker mottled areas. Colour 3 is not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_Br.description: A chunky, faceted cylindrical bracer worn on the right forearm, with a boxy handheld device strapped to the outer side, showing a small screen and a keypad of buttons, held by a wide band.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_Br.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer cylinder; colour 1 on the strap band and some keypad buttons; colour 2 on the device casing and screen surround; colour 3 on the screen and some keypad buttons.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ringsbicep_01.description: A tight, angular armband worn around the right upper arm, made of layered straps with a contrasting central stripe and two chunky octagonal rings mounted on small blocks at the outer side. Suggests a punk or street look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ringsbicep_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main band; colour 2 on the central stripe; colour 0 on the thin edging lines beside the stripe; colour 3 on the rings and their mounting blocks.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ringswrist_01.description: A snug forearm bracer wrapped in criss-crossing alternating straps between two solid cuff bands at wrist and upper end, with three octagonal D-rings mounted in a line along the outer side. Casual street or punk styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ringswrist_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom cuff bands; colour 2 on one set of wrapped straps; colour 0 on the other set of wrapped straps; colour 3 on the rings.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A small cybernetic implant on the upper right arm: an angular metal plate with a round port, from which two segmented ribbed cables curl outward, plus a third short cable lower down the arm, each ending in a capped connector.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal plate; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 1 on the cable end connectors; colour 3 on the port at the plate's centre.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_01.differs: The male version adds a third, separate short cable with a connector lower on the arm, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A cybernetic implant for the upper right arm: an angular pronged metal clamp with a bolt detail on the shoulder, and many loose ribbed contrasting cables looping down the arm with cylindrical connector caps along them.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal clamp; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 1 on the cylindrical connectors.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ripper_02.differs: The male version has more connector caps on the cables, including on the clamp, and a visible bolt on the clamp.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rock_01.description: A right-forearm bracer built from cracked, stacked stone slabs with jagged ridges at the elbow and long pointed stone claws extending past the hand. Rugged, monstrous, earthy styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs and claws; colour 2 on the cracks and outlines between the plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rock_02.description: A chunky bracer made of cracked, faceted rock slabs that wrap the right forearm just above the wrist, with large jagged stone shards pointing up and back along the arm. Suggests a rugged, elemental golem look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rock_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs and shards; colour 2 on the crack lines between the stones. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rolledsleeve_.description: A short wrapped cloth armband worn around the upper right arm, a wide rolled cuff with creased, gathered folds and a slightly angular edge. Casual and understated, it reads as a bandage or rolled sleeve.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Rolledsleeve_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole armband; the folds and the underside show only shading, with no other colour slot visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ruler_01.description: A short, slightly tapered armored cuff worn around the right wrist, with an octagonal rim, studded borders at both edges and round inset discs spaced around the sides. It has a sleek, sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Ruler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 1 on the studs along both rims; colour 2 on the inset discs; colour 3 on the inset discs.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A chunky octagonal upper-arm band with a contrasting rim, carrying a curved, wing-like fin on its outer side that sweeps back to a point. The fin has raised swirling lines and a small ring emblem.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band's side; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 2 on the fin body; colour 3 on the swirling lines and ring on the fin.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Large.description: A samurai-style right forearm bracer of angular plates with jagged, stepped edges and a curling horn-like flare at the outer side. Swirling patterned panels sit inside bordered rims, with a thin vertical fin along the outer edge, worn just above the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Large.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rims and the stepped back plates; colour 1 on the thin inner edge lines; colour 2 on the panel backgrounds; colour 3 on the swirl patterns.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Large.differs: The male bracer adds a thin vertical blade-like fin along the outer side and sits a little longer on the forearm.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_01.description: A short fur bracer wrapping the right forearm, made of jagged, shaggy tufts that flare into spiky points at the elbow end and ragged strands over the wrist. Suggests a feral, beastly look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur tips; colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 2 on the shaded underside strands at the back.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_02.description: A shaggy fur tuft on the outer forearm, formed of long jagged pointed locks that stream down toward the wrist, with a few spikes flaring up at the top. Suggests a beastly, primal look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur near the top; colour 1 on the lower fur locks, blending toward the tips.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatch_02.differs: The male tuft is longer and reaches further down toward the wrist, with narrower, more streaming locks.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatchlong.description: A shaggy fur bracer wrapping the right forearm from elbow to wrist, made of long jagged tufts that flare into spiky points at the top and ragged ends near the hand. Wild, beastly look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sasquatchlong.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper tufts at the top and front of the forearm; colour 1 on the lower tufts; colour 2 on the shaded back and underside near the top.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Shacklewrist_.description: A chunky, slightly tapered metal cuff worn around the right wrist and lower forearm, with faceted angular sides, a vertical seam, two contrasting clamp plates and a pair of curved handle loops on either side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Shacklewrist_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the curved handle loops and the raised central bar; colour 2 on the clamp plates.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A short, tapered forearm bracer worn on the right wrist, with a swept-back fin-like spike rising from the outer edge and a small point at the wrist. A wide contrasting band wraps the middle, giving a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin spike, the wrist points and the inner panel; colour 1 on the main bracer body; colour 2 on the wide middle band; colour 3 on the small accents near the top opening.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_Stra.description: A band-like upper-arm guard made of overlapping angular plates with jagged fin-shaped points rising along the outer side, wrapping the right upper arm. Sharp, segmented superhero armor styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_Stra.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer plates; colour 2 on the swept fin blades and inner panels; colour 0 on the lower edge plates and rim; colour 3 on the small top wedge panel.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.description: A wrapped forearm bracer of layered banded strips, with a curved blade-like plate standing off the outer side and a row of four long arrow-shaped spikes projecting sideways through it. Punk, aggressive look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer wrap bands; colour 0 on the wrap bands showing between them; colour 2 on the spikes and their studs; colour 3 on the curved plate.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.description: A right forearm bracer made of stacked banded rings, with four long pointed spike bars projecting sideways to a large curved, blade-like fin that sweeps down past the hand. Aggressive, monstrous superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large curved blade fin; colour 1 on the ring bands; colour 0 on the bands between the rings; colour 2 on the spike bars.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spikeelbow_Me.description: A pair of curved, tapering horn-like spikes of unequal size that sweep upward from a short contrasting-banded base on the outer upper arm near the elbow. Suggests a monstrous or fantasy look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Spikeelbow_Me.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering horn tips; colour 3 on the base band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapsasquatc.description: A right forearm bracer of wrapped bands with thin straps cinched around it, and jagged shaggy fur tufts flaring out at both the wrist and the elbow end. Sits snugly on the forearm with a rugged, tribal look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapsasquatc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the thin straps; colour 1 on the fur tufts at both ends.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapsasquatc.differs: The male version adds a set of loose floating rings above the bracer, around the upper forearm and elbow, that the female version lacks.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapsbicep_0.description: A slim angular band worn around the right upper arm, made of two wide outer straps with a narrower layered strip between them, giving a faceted, snug armband look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapsbicep_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two wide outer bands; colour 2 on the central strip; colour 0 on the thin edge lines beside the central strip.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapthin_01.description: A set of thin, flat straps wrapped as separate angular bands around the right upper arm, stacked loosely with slight tilts and a faceted, many-sided outline. A minimal superhero-style arm accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Strapthin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the straps; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalbracer_.description: A short, wrinkled cloth-like cuff worn on the right wrist, with contrasting trim at both edges and a ring of long tapered tooth-like spikes with banded bases pointing outward and upward around it.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalbracer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and the bands on the spikes; colour 1 on the trim at the top and bottom edges; colour 2 on the spike bases; colour 3 on the spike tips.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalbracer_.differs: The male cuff has a slightly taller band with spikes spaced more widely apart around the wrist.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalfeather.description: A tribal upper-arm wrap of bunched, crumpled cloth bands with small dash markings, fastened by a round button at the outer side, from which three long feathers sweep upward above the shoulder.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Tribalfeather.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped bands; colour 1 on the dash markings and the button rim; colour 3 on the button centre; colour 2 on the feathers.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Bracele.description: A pair of thin, slightly faceted band bracelets stacked closely on the right wrist, one tilted slightly against the other. A simple casual street-style wrist accessory.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Bracele.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower band; colour 1 on the upper, tilted band.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Diamond.description: A wide, snug wrist cuff with a broad smooth central band, rows of faceted gem-like blocks along both edges, and a bordered rim. Two small buckled straps fasten it at the back; street-style urban look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Diamond.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central band and buckle straps; colour 1 on the edge borders and rim; colour 3 on the faceted gem blocks; colour 2 on the buckle hardware.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Studded.description: A short, slightly tapered cuff worn around the right forearm just above the wrist, with contrasting trim bands at both edges and rounded raised studs in pairs around the outside. Casual street style.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Urban_Studded.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 2 on the top and bottom trim bands; colour 1 on the studs.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Variablerobot.description: A chunky, faceted block-shaped arm piece wrapped around the right upper arm, with a flat angular top and two short prongs extending down the lower edge. It gives a bulky, robotic armored look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Variablerobot.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the entire piece; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Variablerobot.description: A chunky angular bracer worn on the right forearm: a large boxy panel on the outer side with a small chevron emblem, a separate open-backed block at the upper end, and a banded segment near the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Variablerobot.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the large outer panel and lower cuff shell; colour 1 on the upper open block and the wrist band segments; colour 0 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A chunky angular armor plate worn as a band around the right upper arm, with a notched, cupped outer shell and inset paneled windows front and back. Suggests sci-fi superhero armor.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the inset panels; colour 2 on the thin lines across the panels.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wingbracer_01.description: A small bat-wing bracer running along the outer right forearm: two long curved, pointed spars support a thin webbed membrane that flares outward from the arm, giving a monstrous, gothic wing-fin silhouette.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wingbracer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spars and bony edges; colour 1 on the wing membrane.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wingbracer_02.description: A large bat-wing worn along the right arm: long curved bone-like spars fan out from the forearm, joined by a thin membrane, and sweep up past the shoulder and back down toward the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wingbracer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spars and ribs; colour 1 on the wing membrane; colour 3 on the joints and edge highlights.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wristband_01.description: A plain, short wristband: a slightly flared, faceted cuff that sits around the right wrist just above the hand, with a smooth surface and no visible fasteners or decoration. Suggests casual or sporty wear.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wristband_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; the darker edges are only shading.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wristband_01_.description: A short tapered wristband cuff worn on the right forearm just above the wrist: a slightly flared band with a wide contrasting upper rim and a thin contrasting edge at the bottom. Sporty wrestling look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Tight_Wristband_01_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the cuff; colour 1 on the wide top band and the thin bottom edge.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Urban_Anime_Armwarm.description: A loose, tube-like armwarmer covering the right forearm from just below the elbow to the wrist, with a chunky rounded cuff at the top, a slim cuff at the wrist, and separate side and front panels. Casual anime-inspired street look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Urban_Anime_Armwarm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuffs and the back of the sleeve; colour 1 on the main front panel; colour 2 on the side panel and edge piping; colour 3 on the small rectangular patch.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Vine_01.description: A right-wrist bracer shaped like a short flared cuff, covered in swirling vine-like ridges and curling tendrils with pointed tips that sweep up and outward from the forearm. Organic, fantasy styling.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cuff body and the vine ridges; colour 0 on the recessed swirl panels; colour 3 on the tendril tips and thorns.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Watch_01.description: A chunky octagonal wristwatch band worn on the right wrist: a wide banded strap with raised rims top and bottom and a rectangular watch face plate with a contrasting screen on the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Watch_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main strap band; colour 0 on the raised upper and lower rims; colour 1 on the watch face plate; colour 2 on the screen and the thin lines between bands.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Wing_Tight_Batwing_.description: A single membrane bat wing that hangs from the right upper arm to the wrist and down to the hip, forming a tight triangular sheet with a scalloped, ragged lower edge. It sits close against the torso side.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Wing_Tight_Batwing_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing membrane; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Chestattach_R_Wing_Tight_Steelhaw.description: A slim, tapering feathered wing folded tight against the right arm and side, made of overlapping layered feathers that end in ragged, frayed tips near the hip. Suggests a fantasy or superhero winged look.
Male/M_Chestattach_R_Wing_Tight_Steelhaw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers; the piece appears to take little of the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Bracer_Anniversary16.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a smooth main shell, contrasting rim trim at both ends, a segmented armor plate along one side, and two round circular nodes linked by thin branching lines. Sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Bracer_Anniversary16.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim trim at both ends; colour 2 on the segmented plates and node housings and connecting lines; colour 3 on the round nodes.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Bracer_Anniversary16.description: A large blade-like shield worn on the left forearm: a long tapering curved plate that sweeps up past the shoulder and down to a sharp point below the hip, with angular faceted panels and thin inset line accents.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Bracer_Anniversary16.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper faceted plate; colour 2 on the lower long blade section and cuff; colour 3 on the thin line accents between panels.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Armband_Medic_.description: A faceted band worn around the upper left arm, with a strapped panel on the outer side holding three upright cylindrical vials with capped tops. Suggests a medic or field-gear look.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Armband_Medic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armband ring; colour 1 on the strapped backing panel and bands; colour 3 on the vial bodies; colour 2 on the vial caps.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Blackpaladin_0.description: A short tapered armband worn around the upper left arm, with an open faceted rim and a surface patterned with overlapping scallop shapes like scales. The rim is edged with a thin contrasting border.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Blackpaladin_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and scalloped surface; colour 1 on the scallop shading; colour 2 on the top rim.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Blackpaladin_0.differs: The male version has a scalloped scale texture in mostly one colour with a contrasting rim, while the female version uses large solid colour panels with a vertical back strip.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Gladiat.description: A short tapered armoured bracer worn on the left forearm, with thick rim bands at both ends, small rivets, scratch-like etched lines, and two pairs of conical spikes jutting outward from the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Gladiat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the rim bands at both ends; colour 3 on the spikes on one side; colour 2 on the spikes on the opposite side.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Ironcla.description: A chunky armoured forearm bracer with a thick rounded cuff at the elbow end, a tapered body with vented chevron panels, jagged flame-like inlay on the outer face and a flared plate over the wrist.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Ironcla.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cuff and the wrist plate; colour 0 on the main bracer body and its trim lines; colour 2 on the jagged inlay and the lower shell; colour 3 on the chevron vent panels.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Power_A.description: A chunky, rounded forearm bracer of power-armor style, wrapping the left forearm with a raised slotted panel on the outer face, a narrower lower cuff, and a boxy octagonal blaster housing mounted on the inner side.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Power_A.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main bracer shell and lower cuff; colour 3 on the raised slotted plate, the blaster housing and the cuff inserts.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Power_S.description: A smooth, tapered bracer worn on the left forearm: a wide plated sleeve flaring at the elbow end, with a separate flared cuff band at the wrist. Clean, sleek superhero power-suit styling.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Power_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate and cuff; colour 1 on the inner edge panel, the back seam and the trim at the wrist cuff.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Steampu.description: A short tapered bracer worn on the left forearm, with a wide riveted upper cuff, two segmented lower bands and an open window on the inner side showing a gear pattern. Steampunk mechanical styling.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Bracer_Steampu.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cuff and its rivets; colour 0 on the lower bracer body and window frame; colour 2 on the back-side lower band; colour 3 on the gear pattern inside the window.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A short segmented armor band worn around the left upper arm: a chunky octagonal cuff with raised rims at top and bottom, riveted layered plates on the outer face and a smooth panel on the inner side.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the riveted outer plates; colour 0 on the smooth back and inner panel.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A small cluster of six short conical spikes jutting outward from the upper arm, arranged in a loose staggered group. A tiny punk-style accent that sits directly on the sleeve.

Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Vibroman_01.description: A simple tapered bracer plate wrapping the left forearm, with a plain smooth shell that flares wider at the elbow end and rises into a pointed edge on the outer back side. Suggests light armor.
Male/M_Chestattachl_Tight_Vibroman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole plate; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the top rim.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Bracer_Anniversary16.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a smooth main shell and thin rimmed cuffs at both ends. Segmented plates run along one side, with round glowing gem-like studs set in contrasting housings and thin linking lines, giving a sci-fi arcane look.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Bracer_Anniversary16.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edges at the wrist and elbow; colour 1 on the main bracer shell; colour 2 on the segmented side plates, stud housings and linking lines; colour 3 on the round gem studs.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Bracer_Anniversary16.description: A large, blade-like shield worn on the right forearm: a tall pointed upper plate flares from the shoulder and tapers to a long curved spike past the hand, with angular armored panels and thin inset lines.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Bracer_Anniversary16.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shield plate; colour 2 on the lower blade and armored panels; colour 3 on the thin trim lines and inset accents; colour 0 barely visible.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Armband_Medic_.description: A band worn around the upper right arm with a bank of three upright vials strapped to the outer side by a padded mount. The band has a flat, faceted cloth-like form. Suggests a medic or tactical utility look.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Armband_Medic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armband; colour 1 on the padded mount and straps holding the vials; colour 3 on the vial bodies; colour 2 on the vial caps.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Blackpaladin_0.description: A short tapered armband worn on the right upper arm: a faceted, open-topped cuff with a flared scalloped rim, angular panels and a fuzzy textured strip down the outer side. Suggests superhero or paladin armor.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Blackpaladin_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the cuff; colour 0 on the lower band and some rim facets; colour 2 on the textured side strip and inner rim; colour 3 on the rim scallops.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Gladiat.description: A rounded, tapered gladiator bracer for the right forearm, with contrasting rims at both ends, small rivets, scratch marks and several cone spikes jutting from the outer side and back, plus small studs.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Gladiat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the front-facing spikes and stud bumps; colour 2 on the rear-facing spikes and back studs.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Ironcla.description: A chunky armored bracer for the right forearm: a thick rounded cuff at the elbow end, a main plate with a chevron-striped panel and jagged spiky motif, and a flared wrist cuff with a small lower edge.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Ironcla.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate and thin bands; colour 1 on the top cuff and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the jagged spiky motif; colour 3 on the chevron-striped panel.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Power_A.description: A chunky power-armor bracer worn on the right forearm: a rounded plated shell with raised horizontal ridges on the outer face, a stepped lower cuff, and an open back around a short octagonal barrel-like cylinder.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Power_A.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and lower cuff; colour 3 on the raised ridges, the inset slots and the octagonal cylinder in the back opening.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Power_S.description: A right forearm bracer of smooth tapered plating, wider at the elbow end and narrowing to the wrist, with a separate flared cuff ring at the wrist and angular edge panels along the outer side.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Power_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm plate and cuff band; colour 1 on the angled edge panels along the side and on the wrist cuff accents.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Steampu.description: A short tapered steampunk bracer worn on the right forearm: a wide riveted band at the top, a segmented tube below, and an open window on the outer side showing interlocking gear plates in a metal frame.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Bracer_Steampu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tapered tube, frame and top cap; colour 1 on the riveted upper band; colour 3 on the gear panel inside the window; colour 2 in the shadowed gaps between the gears.

Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A chunky octagonal armour band worn around the right upper arm, with raised rims at top and bottom, a segmented ribbed front panel and a smooth plated back with small rivets.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom rims; colour 3 on the ribbed front panel; colour 0 on the smooth back plate and inner lining (glossy metal look).

Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Vibroman_01.description: A plain tapered plate bracer worn on the right forearm near the wrist, flaring wider toward the elbow with faceted edges and one raised pointed flap rising on the outer side. Simple armored superhero look.
Male/M_Chestattachr_Tight_Vibroman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bracer plate; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestattatch_L_Tight_Plugs_Covert.description: A cluster of four small hexagonal bolt-like plugs with short round studs, scattered around the upper left arm like sockets or ports. A utilitarian cybernetic look with no straps or connecting parts.
Male/M_Chestattatch_L_Tight_Plugs_Covert.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the hexagonal plug bodies and studs; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Male/M_Chestattatch_R_Tight_Plugs_Covert.description: A cluster of four small hexagonal metal plug connectors, each a nut-like housing with a short cylindrical stub, scattered around the right upper arm. Suggests cybernetic ports or bolts for a covert sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestattatch_R_Tight_Plugs_Covert.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hexagonal housings and stubs; the default metal material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestlayer_4arm_Spikeleft_New.description: A single curved spike rising from the outer shoulder, built from segmented, cracked plates that taper to a sharp tip. It sits on a flat, irregular base that hugs the shoulder, giving a monstrous, armored look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_4arm_Spikeleft_New.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented spike plates; colour 1 on the spike tip; colour 3 on the base plate around the shoulder.

Male/M_Chestlayer_4arm_Spikeleft_Newish.description: A single curved horn-like spike rising from the left shoulder, built from stacked, cracked plate segments that taper to a sharp tip, seated on a small flat base plate. Suggests a mechanical or monstrous shoulder ornament.
Male/M_Chestlayer_4arm_Spikeleft_Newish.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented plates of the spike; colour 1 on the tapering tip; colour 3 on the flat base plate at the shoulder.

Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Jacket_01.description: A cropped, open-front bomber-style jacket with short puffy ruched sleeves, a thick padded rolled collar and lapels, shoulder panels with tech details, and a wide band at the waist; sits at the ribs with banded cuffs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the padded collar, lapels and cuff bands; colour 2 on the waist band and shoulder trim; colour 3 on small cuff indicators.

Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Jacketstraps_01.description: A cropped, short-sleeved bomber-style jacket with a thick padded rolled collar, loose ruched sleeves with banded tech cuffs, and a chest harness strap with a round buckle above a wide waist band.
Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Jacketstraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the padded collar, front edging, pocket accents and cuff bands; colour 2 on the waist band and shoulder piping; colour 3 on the round chest buckle.
Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Jacketstraps_01.differs: The male jacket has contrasting trim outlining side pockets on the front and a looser, fuller body.

Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_01.description: A harness of narrow patterned straps that loop over the shoulders and cross over the chest and back, joined by a round clasp at the lower chest, with a short tail strap below. Circuit-like panels give a mechanical 90s look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the strap webbing; colour 2 on the strap end tabs and circuit-panel sections; colour 0 on the fine line details; colour 3 on the round clasp and small inset markings.
Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_01.differs: The straps form a wider loop with an extra cross over the chest, and the clasp sits lower and to one side rather than centred.

Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_02.description: A partial chest harness of narrow circuit-patterned straps that loop over the shoulders in a V down the chest and cross on the back, with two round pods at the chest and a small plate cluster at the lower sternum.
Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the strap bodies; colour 2 on the circuit-pattern segments and end caps; colour 3 on the round pods; colour 0 on small details of the lower plates.
Male/M_Chestlayer_90s_Straps_02.differs: The male harness hangs in a V-shape down the chest without crossing the straps at the front, with the pods set wider apart.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Amazon_01.description: A sleeveless armored cuirass with curved etched lines, a contrasting chest yoke with a small flower emblem and rounded shoulder caps. Wrapped cloth bands cinch the waist, with long tabbed strips hanging as a skirt around the hips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the breastplate and the wrapped waist bands; colour 1 on the chest yoke and the trim along the belt and strip tips; colour 2 on the shoulder caps, etched lines and belt band; colour 3 on the flower emblem and strip markings.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Amazon_01.differs: The male version's hanging strips wrap further around the sides and back, giving fuller hip coverage.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A loose robe-style jacket with a contrasting fitted central vest panel, long wide bell sleeves, and a patterned triangular border at each cuff. It ends at the waist and has a scooped, curved back panel.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and body; colour 2 on the front and back vest panel; colour 0 on the piping around the vest edges and the cuff border base; colour 3 on the triangle pattern at the cuffs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The male version is a waist-length jacket with wide bell sleeves and a contrasting vest panel, not a dress with a skirt.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Anniversary_Mechanon_0.description: A sleeveless, waist-length mechanical chest piece: bulky shoulder and chest plating with a segmented ribbed abdomen panel, hand-like clamps on the chest sides, and a spine ridge of overlapping plates down the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Anniversary_Mechanon_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder, chest and back plates; colour 1 on the abdomen ribs and spine ridge; colour 2 on the side clamps and hoses; colour 3 on the small dots.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Anniversary_Mechanon_0.differs: The male version has a flatter chest plate in colour 0, with the ribbed colour 1 panel only on the abdomen instead of also covering the bust.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Patterned_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped armored vest with a large V-shaped inset panel front and back, and contrasting outlined seams and armholes. It sits over the chest and ends at the ribs, with a sporty superhero look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the V-shaped inset panel front and back; colour 2 on the outlining edge piping and seams.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Retro_Destroyer_.description: A sleeveless, cropped armored chest piece with a smooth shell, a pointed V-shaped front plate, an angular chevron band across the upper chest and large cupped shoulder guards with a contrasting stripe, edged in trim.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Retro_Destroyer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and shoulder stripes; colour 1 on the pointed front plate and side panels; colour 2 on the chevron band; colour 3 on the shoulder cups, collar edge and outline trim.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Retro_Destroyer_.differs: The male version has a light shell with contrasting side panels wrapping the ribs and a contrasting chevron band, and its shoulder cups are larger with a light stripe along the rim.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Retroscifi_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped chest plate with a faceted, hammered surface and a V neckline. It has sculpted pectoral shaping and rounded shoulder caps, sits over the torso like a light breastplate, and ends at the ribs in a retro sci-fi style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Retroscifi_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plate surface and edge highlights; colour 1 on the shaded underside and side panels. The metallic default material mostly mutes the colour scheme.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Retroscifi_01.differs: The male plate has broad, flat pectoral shaping and larger shoulder caps, without the separate rounded bust cups of the female version.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Victory_01.description: A sleeveless, fitted superhero vest with a deep V neckline, a wide chest panel tapering to a point down the belly, curved swooping stripes on the back, rounded shoulder caps, and a pointed hem at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the chest panel; colour 2 on the outlining swooping stripes; colour 3 on the shoulder caps, neckline insert and hem piping.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Armor_Victory_01.differs: The male version has a single broad chest panel with a T-shaped taper and larger, rounder shoulder caps, rather than separate bust cups.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Armored_01.description: A sleeveless mechanical chest armor piece: rounded plated chest shells, a central sternum plate with a small inset gem-like emblem, a narrow panel down the abdomen, layered fin-like plates at the ribs and a pointed back plate.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest shells, collar plate and back plate; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and abdomen strip; colour 1 on the layered rib plates; colour 3 on the sternum emblem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Armorninja_01.description: A partial armored chest layer of rounded, padded plates covering the chest, shoulders and upper back, with a low open collar, segmented back plates and a small strap hanging down the spine. Ninja-tech look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Armorninja_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder caps, chest borders and collar rim; colour 1 on the large chest and upper-back plates; colour 2 on the back plates and the shoulder undersides; colour 3 on the lower chest accents.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Bounty_01.description: A partial chest armour plate with a rounded upper plate framing a hexagonal central gem, a segmented lower plate with angled side panels, and a matching back plate plus a small flared cloth panel at one shoulder.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest plate and the cloth shoulder panel; colour 3 on the central hexagonal gem; colour 1 on the angled side panels and back band; colour 2 on the plate rims and lower back edge.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Bounty_02.description: A sleeveless armored vest-tunic with a chest plate bearing a hexagonal emblem, one rounded shoulder pad, a diagonal bandolier of small cartridge-like canisters, and separate front and back tabs below the waist. Sci-fi frontier style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, front and back tabs; colour 1 on the side and lower torso panels; colour 2 on the trim edging, shoulder pad and collar; colour 3 on the emblem, canisters and strap button.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, sleeveless cardboard-box vest worn over the torso, with flat rectangular shoulder flaps, large armholes, a crossed pair of tape strips on the front and small tape patches on the back; crumpled, worn edges give a makeshift look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box body; colour 1 on the shoulder flaps; colour 3 on the crossed tape strips, tape patches and flap stripes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Cardboard_01.differs: The male box is a little taller and squarer, with wider, flatter shoulder flaps and a fully open square top.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Chainlock_01.description: Heavy metal chains wrapped in a dense, tangled criss-cross web around the torso, over the chest, shoulders and back, with a padlock fastened to the chains. Worn over a top as a layered, gritty accessory.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the padlock body; colour 3 on the padlock keyhole.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Chainlock_01.differs: The chains form a denser web that reaches higher over the shoulders, and a second padlock position is visible at the back, so the lock appears on both the front and back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Bounty_01.description: A partial armored chest piece: a rounded-octagonal upper plate with a hexagonal centre gem, a segmented lower plate with angled side panels, and a small flap over one shoulder. Rests on the chest and ribs over tights, with a ridged back plate.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate face, lower plates and shoulder flap; colour 2 on the plate rim and the lower back edge; colour 1 on the angled side panels and the back stripe; colour 3 on the centre gem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_01.description: Two small radio-style clip-on boxes with coiled and trailing cables, one at each side of the upper chest; the cords dangle down and loop around the torso. A minimal tactical accessory layer rather than a full vest.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box housings; colour 1 on the coiled cables and the back of one box.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_02.description: A pair of side-by-side ammunition magazine pouches hanging at the hip, each a boxy ribbed case with a lower segmented section and a bullet tip poking out of the top; military utility styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper magazine bodies; colour 0 on the lower ribbed sections; colour 2 on the bullet tips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Combat_Vest_02.differs: The male magazines hang lower at the hip and angle outward, while the female ones sit flat against the front of the waist.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Jacket_Holiday_0.description: A flared, skirt-like hip wrap with a front split that opens down the centre, vertical stripe panels, and a thick ragged fur-like trim around the hem. It sits at the hips and reaches the upper thigh, with a festive winter feel.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Jacket_Holiday_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fabric; colour 3 on the vertical stripes and edge piping; colour 2 on the fur-like hem trim.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_01.description: A minimal set of rounded, shell-like shoulder caps that sit over the top of each shoulder, plus thin cuff rings at both wrists. Leaves the torso and arms bare, suggesting a light superhero accent layer.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder caps and wrist cuffs; the shoulder caps show a hint of colour 1 on their undersides.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_01.differs: The shoulder caps are larger, bulkier and more prominent than the female version.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_02.description: Tiny thin cuff bands at each wrist, barely visible as narrow rings where the sleeve of the body meets the hands. A minimal accent with no other visible construction.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist bands; the rest of the piece is too small to distinguish other slots.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt_0.description: A small chest panel that hangs from a curved neckline edge over the chest and ends in a ragged, jagged hem at the ribs. It fades from light at the top to a richer shade toward the bottom, giving a torn sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the neckline trim; colour 0 on the upper panel, blending into colour 1 toward the jagged lower hem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt_0.description: A torn chest panel covering the centre of the chest, with a spiky ragged top edge and a shredded, jagged hem hanging over the upper abdomen. It reads as a ripped-open shirt front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the panel, fading gradually into colour 1 toward the ragged lower edge.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Renegade_Shirt_0.differs: The male panel is wider and boxier, with a shorter drop and a more evenly jagged hem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.description: A pair of tapered, fin-like shoulder vents rising from the tops of the shoulders, each with a glossy metal shell, angled louvre slats down the front and a swept point at the lower edge. Mechanical retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy shell edges and frames; colour 1 on the louvre slats; colour 3 on the inner slat backing; the main shell is a glossy metal that largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.description: A small flat metal starburst emblem with eight irregular pointed tips and a raised bevelled edge, one tip longer and forked. It sits on the upper right chest near the shoulder, like a badge.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole emblem face; the default metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.description: A small flat metal emblem shaped like an irregular eight-pointed star with a raised rim, worn on the upper left chest near the shoulder. Suggests a retro mechanical superhero badge.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole emblem face and rim; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.description: A small atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring, sitting flat on the upper right chest near the shoulder. A retro science-themed insignia with no other garment parts.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.description: A small flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus, printed on the upper left chest. A tiny retro sci-fi badge with no thickness or other construction.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Retrosteelhead_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Rocker_02.description: A short tattered loincloth-style skirt hanging from the hips to mid-thigh, with jagged pointed hems, bold outlined trim along the edges, and small claw-like flourishes at the sides. Punk, post-apocalyptic rocker look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Rocker_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 2 on the thick jagged edge trim and crack-like lines; colour 3 on the claw-like tips and the small speckled dots.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Strapped_01.description: A small flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, worn on the upper chest just off-centre. It is a thin decal-like badge with a tidy science-themed look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Child_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the outlines and edges of the rings.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundrel_0.description: A long-sleeved padded jacket with a wide rolled open-front lapel, bulky shoulders and cuffs, and a short coat skirt with contrasting panels and horizontal strap bands at the thighs; sits over the torso and hips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundrel_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulders and upper sleeves; colour 0 on the chest, back, and coat panels; colour 1 on the lapel, cuffs and side skirt panels; colour 2 on the underarm pads and horizontal straps.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Coat_Space_Scoundrel_0.differs: The male coat is a shorter hip-length jacket with a wide rolled lapel and strapped thigh panels, without the long split skirt and slashed hems.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Coat_Victorian_01.description: A long-sleeved Victorian-style frock coat with wide lapels, a contrasting yoke and banded cuffs, open at the front, with a long tailcoat skirt reaching the thighs and a vented back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Coat_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, shoulders and a panel on the skirt; colour 2 on the upper back and inner front; colour 0 on the lapels, skirt and cuffs; colour 3 on the lapel slashes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Coat_Victorian_01.differs: The male coat has a long tailcoat skirt reaching the thighs with contrasting lapel slashes, instead of the female's cropped jacket with short hip tails.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Cog_01.description: A sleeveless steampunk chest harness: a paneled cuirass with a contrasting collar ring, a central round contrasting lens housing, a small lower lens at the belt band, shoulder pads with tube frames, and a back-mounted cylinder canister with a tall antenna ending in a lens.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Cog_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and back panels; colour 1 on the wire frame, shoulder trim and canister rings; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder pads, waist band and housings; colour 3 on the lenses.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Collar_Anubis_01.description: An Egyptian-style broad collar (usekh) that sits around the neck and over the shoulders, with a soft rolled inner neckband, concentric patterned bands of triangles and stripes, and a small rectangular pendant panel at the chest.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Collar_Anubis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neckband and main collar body; colour 1 on the outer triangle band and pendant stripes; colour 3 on the thin outline bands and pendant edging; colour 2 on the triangle centres.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Combat_Vest_01.description: A tactical plate-carrier vest with thick padded shoulder straps, front and back panels with horizontal webbing rows, elastic side bands, and magazine pouches with a cord at the front. Sits over the torso and ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Combat_Vest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest panels, shoulder pads and side bands; colour 1 on the webbing stripes, magazine pouches and cord; colour 2 on the edge piping and straps; colour 3 on the strap tabs and small tie loops.
