Male/M_Chestlayer_Construction_Vest_Clos.description: A sleeveless, waist-length closed vest with a V-shaped neckline, a curved lower front, and separate panels over the chest and shoulders. It sits over the torso like a work or utility vest, with a small round patch on the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Construction_Vest_Clos.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower hem panel and the back patch; colour 1 on the main body of the vest and the collar edges; colour 2 on the chest and upper back panels; colour 3 on the side panel at the ribs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Construction_Vest_Open.description: A sleeveless, open-front construction vest that stops at the waist, with wide flared shoulder flaps and a deeper hem panel. Stripes of reflective-style banding run vertically and horizontally across the chest and back. Casual workwear look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Construction_Vest_Open.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest fabric and hem panel; colour 1 on the bands bordering the stripes; colour 2 on the inner stripe bands; colour 3 on the thin edge piping.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Corrupted_01.description: A sleeveless armored chest piece with rounded shoulder caps, a raised open collar, bust cups and a pointed, segmented lower plate that ends above the waist. Outlined panel seams and a small pendant give it a sleek, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder and upper chest plates; colour 2 on the bust cups, collar interior and seam outlines; colour 1 on the lower segmented plates and collar trim; colour 3 on the small pendant.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Cosmos_01.description: A glossy sculpted chest layer of two large curved plates that sweep over the pecs and shoulders and taper into a V down the torso to a pointed tip at the waist; sleek sci-fi armour look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Default glossy metal material largely ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows a metallic finish, with slight contrast on the edge trim from the scheme.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Cosmos_01.differs: The male version has broader, flatter plates that wrap over the shoulders and back with a rolled rim, rather than bust cups.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Crimson_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length armoured vest with a sculpted winged chest plate, cap-like shoulder pieces, a textured quilted midsection and contrasting outlined edging. It sits snugly over the torso in a superhero style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder caps and the textured lower panel; colour 1 on the side and centre panels beneath the chest plate; colour 3 on the chest and upper back plates; colour 2 on the outlines, collar and shoulder linings.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Crimson_01.differs: The male version's lower back is fully closed with a textured panel, while the female version has an open cut-out there.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Cryo_01.description: A pair of woven webbing loops that run over each shoulder and under the arm like backpack straps, each with a small chunky buckle clasp on the upper chest. Sits over the torso with a tactical, utilitarian look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbing straps; colour 1 on the buckle housings; colour 2 on the buckle ends and hardware.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Cryo_02.description: A sleeveless cropped armored chest piece with segmented plates, capped shoulders and two round vent pods on the chest and back. A thick ribbed hose loops under the chest, joined by a small central connector.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the armor plates and connector; colour 2 on the vent pods; colour 3 on the ribbed hose and vent markings.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Deity_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted armored chest piece with layered segmented plates over the chest and abdomen, a V-shaped collar with a small gem at the centre and a pointed lower plate at the waist. Cupped shoulder openings; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates, waist band and back side panels; colour 1 on the collar, shoulders, lower waist plate and back centre; colour 2 on the abdomen plates and back top; colour 3 on the centre gem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Deity_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, broader chest plate with a higher V collar and no molded bust shape.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Dinosuit_01.description: A loose, long-sleeved crew-neck sweatshirt ending at the waist, with a quilted padded panel down the chest, banded cuffs and a row of triangular dinosaur-style spikes running down the centre of the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sweater body and sleeves; colour 1 on the quilted chest panel; colour 2 on the back spikes and cuff bands.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Dinosuit_02.description: A loose, puffy long-sleeved crew-neck sweater ending at the waist, with gathered cuffs and hem and a quilted, segmented padded panel across the front of the chest. Casual, cartoonish look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Dinosuit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sweater body, sleeves and collar; colour 1 on the quilted chest panel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Draco_01.description: A sleeveless armoured chest piece with bulbous shoulder and chest plates, a raised angular collar, and a fitted lower band. A long spined, scaled tail panel runs down the back to below the hips, and a short plated flap hangs at the front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and shoulder plates; colour 2 on the chest plates and tail armour segments; colour 1 on the lower band and tail scales; colour 3 on the gems and back spikes.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Element_Water_01.description: A diagonal band of glossy liquid-looking metal draped from one shoulder across the chest to the opposite hip, forming an open scooped wave with a row of droplet-tipped curls along the lower edge.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; a hint of colour 3 shows in the inner fold near the shoulder, with the rest showing a reflective sheen.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Element_Water_01.differs: The male version is a broader, more open scooped wave with droplet curls bunched along the chest, while the female has a slimmer sweep with a tall splash crest at the shoulder.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Amazon_01.description: A thick cloth sash wrapped in several gathered, crinkled layers around the waist, tied in a knot at the front with two short hanging tails. Suggests a martial or tribal look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole sash, including the knot and tails; the inner edge shows a darker shade.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Amazon_01.differs: The knot sits centred at the front, and the sash forms a straighter, flatter band with the back wraps crossing less.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Bounty_01.description: A narrow bandolier strap worn diagonally across the chest from one shoulder to the opposite hip, with a boxy buckle housing on the shoulder and a cluster of stick-like explosive canisters along the chest. Space western look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap's main band; colour 1 on the strap edging; colour 2 on the shoulder housing and canister bands; colour 3 on the button and canister ends.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Bounty_03.description: A small rectangular plate covering the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a smooth flat front face and a wavy-edged layered back of segmented bands. Suggests a sci-fi frontier armor panel.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Bounty_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face and upper back plate; colour 1 on the middle wavy band; colour 2 on the lower band.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Chainlock_01.description: A heavy chain wrapped in several tangled loops around the ribcage and midriff, with a loose length of links rising diagonally across the front. It sits over the torso like a bound restraint or improvised belt.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Chainlock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; the metal reads mostly as a glossy steel finish and shows little of the other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Cog_01.description: A mechanical harness of thin bent tubing that arcs over both shoulders and hooks under the collarbones, carrying a horizontal canister with ringed end caps on the upper back. Grip-like sleeves sit on each strap.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Cog_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tubing frame and the end-cap coils; colour 0 on the canister body; colour 2 on the canister rings and the sleeves on the straps.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Cog_02.description: A small mechanical backpack accessory: an octagonal gauge-like housing with a recessed dial, mounted on a short segmented post with a side knob and a bent metal rod. It rises beside the head from the upper back, a steampunk gadget.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Cog_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the octagonal housing and post; colour 3 on the recessed dial face; colour 1 on the side knob; colour 0 on the bent metal rod.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Corrupted_01.description: A wide, flat sailor-style collar layer resting over the shoulders and upper chest, with a raised inner neck band, a contrasting inner panel, scalloped points across the back and a small pointed gem at the front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar; colour 1 on the inner panel band; colour 2 on the edge trim and inner neck lining; colour 3 on the front pointed gem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Cryo_01.description: A flexible ribbed tube that wraps around the torso at chest level, running across the front and curling around both sides to the back, with loose ends flaring outward. Suggests a cryogenic coolant line.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole ribbed tube; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Draco_01.description: A thin angular metal collar that stands up around the neck and drops to a sharp V point at the upper chest, with a separate inner edge band. Sits as a partial jacket layer over the shoulders.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar edge and rim; colour 2 on the inner band and underside of the collar.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Draco_02.description: A narrow, tapering dragon-tail plate that hangs from the lower back around the hip to a point at the thigh, with segmented banded panels at the front, scaled overlapping plates and a row of spikes down the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scaled outer shell; colour 3 on the spikes down the back; colour 0 on the light front cap; colour 2 on the banded segments and gaps.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_01.description: A set of bony, horn-like spikes on the upper back: two curved, segmented horns rising from each shoulder blade near the neck, plus a vertical line of three shrinking blade-shaped spikes down the spine. Monstrous, organic hybrid look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn tips and the smallest spine spike; colour 3 on the banded rings of the horns; colour 1 on the upper spine spike and the base of the lowest spike; colour 2 on the middle spine spike.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_02.description: A set of curved horn-like spikes rising from the upper back and neck line, with three large tapered horns on top and two smaller spikes running down the spine. Bone-like, monstrous accent with no garment.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large horn shafts and the small lower spike's base; colour 0 on the horn tips and the lowest small spike; colour 2 on the middle spike.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Hybrid_02.differs: The male horns are larger and spread wider across the shoulders and upper back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_02.description: A wide, plain utility belt with a textured band worn at the natural waist, closed by a square front buckle plate and two small vertical strap keepers on either side. Utilitarian, prison-issue style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band; colour 1 on the square buckle plate; colour 3 on the two strap keepers.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_03.description: A padded waist belt with a rounded buckle plate at the front, plus a thin strap that hangs down the centre of the chest and back with a pointed tip. Utilitarian, prison-issue style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded belt edge; colour 1 on the belt band and the chest strap; colour 3 on the buckle and strap fasteners; colour 2 on the strap tips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_03.differs: The male version is a padded belt with a buckle and a thin chest strap, lacking the large overlapping angular armour plates of the female version.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_05.description: A slim waist band carrying stacked, pointed armour plates that hang as a segmented codpiece-like flap at the front and a matching flap at the back, with curved plates along the hips. Sits low at the waist and hips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Inmate_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waist band; colour 0 on the layered plates, which take a metallic finish from the default material.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_01.description: A small skin patch that bares the upper forearm, between the sleeve hem and the wrist band. It is a short tube of skin with a slightly angled edge, meant for mixing skin into jacket or tights sleeves.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_01.colourAreas: The skin patch ignores the colour scheme and shows the default skin tone; no colour slot is visible on it.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Frigid_01.description: A tall standing collar that wraps the neck and upper shoulders, open at the front with pointed, stepped tips. It has a quilted textured lining, a contrasting piped edge and a centre back seam. Sleek superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer collar shell; colour 2 on the edge piping and seam; colour 0 on the quilted inner lining.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Frigid_01.differs: The back panel forms a wider, W-shaped drop with a notched point, and the front tips sit slightly shorter.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Ghosthunt.description: A minimal chest-layer jacket that shows only as a raised atom emblem across the upper back, with looping orbital rings around a hexagonal core. Nothing else is visible on the torso, so it works as a superhero or sci-fi back badge.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Ghosthunt.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the atom emblem outlines; colour 0 on the emblem fill within the rings.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Goth_01.description: A slim, open-fronted cloth waistband that wraps around the hips and back, with one long strap hanging down the outer left thigh and a small buttoned tab at the other front end. Reads as a partial goth jacket remnant.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and hanging strap; colour 3 on the small button on the front tab.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Goth_02.description: A narrow open-fronted collar-like band that wraps around the hips like a low belt, with folded, pointed ends at the front that do not meet and one small button on a tab. Gothic shirt-collar styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and folded ends; colour 3 on the small button.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Holiday_0.description: A soft, draped hood-collar worn bunched around the neck and upper shoulders, open at the front with two pointed tips that hang down the chest. It has a wrinkled cloth shell, a lining and a trim along the edge. Casual winter style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Holiday_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer cloth and lining; colour 3 on the edge trim along the opening.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Leather_0.description: A small atom-symbol emblem applied flat on the upper back, made of interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus. It has no jacket body visible, only the outlined badge design.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Leather_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the emblem outline; the rest of the emblem shows the body beneath.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Nightmare.description: A flat decorative back emblem rather than a full jacket: an atom-like design of interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central ring, sitting on the upper back between the shoulder blades. Nothing shows on the front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Nightmare.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the atom outline; the rest of the piece has no other visible features.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Sleeveles.description: A sleeveless chest layer that adds only a flat atom-style emblem across the upper back: interlocking elliptical orbits around a hexagonal core. Nothing shows on the front, and it sits flush against the body like a printed badge.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Sleeveles.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the emblem's orbit bands and core; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the emblem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_01.description: A small dress-shirt insert with a folded-down pointed collar, a narrow front panel and a slim necktie hanging down the chest, plus a short shirt panel at the back of the neck. Suggests a sharp spy or office look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt collar and front panel; colour 2 on the necktie.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_01.differs: The male collar is taller and the shirt front and tie hang longer down the chest.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_02.description: A stiff high stand-up collar wrapping the neck, with a long pointed bib tapering down the chest and a wide triangular flap dropping over the upper back. A single round fastener sits at the throat. Spy-style neckpiece.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, chest point and outer surfaces; colour 2 on the inner back flap; colour 3 on the throat fastener.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Spy_02.differs: The male collar is larger and wider, with a broader chest point and a bigger back flap that drapes further down the shoulders.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Steampunk.description: A tall, standing high collar that wraps around the neck and flares outward, open at the front, with a contrasting trim edge. Sits at the neck only, suggesting a dramatic steampunk or gothic jacket collar.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Steampunk.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body and inner surface; colour 1 on the trim edging around the rim.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_02.description: A short, stiff kilt-like cloth layer sitting at the waist and flaring outward to the upper thigh, with a row of four buttons down one side of the front and thin contrasting piping along the hem and side seam.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the kilt body; colour 1 on the piping along the hem and side seam; colour 2 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_02.differs: The male version is a stiffer, more flared kilt-like shape with a straight waist, while the female version is a snug skirt with a gathered waistband.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Belt_.description: A wide waist belt with a chevron-marked buckle plate and small stud lights, plus a broad flat sash that runs from the belt diagonally over one shoulder and across the back. Toy-soldier style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Belt_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diagonal sash and the rear band of the belt; colour 2 on the belt body and buckle plate; colour 1 on the belt clips; colour 3 on the small studs on the buckle.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Belt_.differs: The male buckle plate has a chevron-like emblem instead of a heart, and the sash sits slightly lower.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Belt_.description: A wide, chunky belt sitting at the waist, made of segmented padded bands with small loops at intervals and a squared front buckle plate with a heart-shaped cutout and three small studs. Toy-soldier styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Belt_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light outer band sections; colour 2 on the band sections and the buckle plate; colour 1 on the loops; colour 3 on the studs on the buckle.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Belt_.description: A plain, narrow band worn around the waist, with a slightly faceted, polygonal outline and a thin raised edge. It has no buckle, loops or other decoration.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Belt_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole band; a thin edge trim takes colour 0.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Belt_.differs: The male version is only a plain faceted band with no buckle plate, heart emblem or strap loops.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Tie_0.description: A long, narrow necktie hanging down the centre of the chest, with a small knot at the collar and a pointed tip near the waist; the front shows a glossy metallic striped panel. Casual office or novelty style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Toy_Tie_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tie body and back; colour 3 on the knot; colour 2 on the front panel behind the stripes; the diagonal stripes look metallic and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Urban_01.description: A pair of small atom-symbol patches, each with three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus, sitting on the outer upper arms. Thin decorative line work with tiny stray marks, suggesting a sci-fi emblem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Jacket_Urban_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main orbit rings of the atom emblem; colour 1 on the inner nucleus and secondary outlines; colour 2 on the small stray marks around the patch.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_01.description: A short armored midriff corset covering the abdomen, with a sculpted segmented ab-plate panel on the front, notched lower edges, and overlapping layered plates across the lower back. Suggests a mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front ab plates; colour 3 on the main corset body and inside top; colour 0 on the back plates and edge trim; colour 2 on the small side inserts.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_01.differs: The male version's inside top uses colour 3 and its back plates are wider, stacked in broader overlapping bands.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_02.description: A partial, sculpted high collar and shoulder mantle: layered stacked ridges rise around the neck, flanked by a wide flared outer shell that sweeps over the shoulders, with contrasting claw-like spikes at the chest and back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the stacked inner neck ridges; colour 3 on the outer flared shell and inner lining; colour 2 on the claw spikes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_02.differs: The male version has a broader, flatter shell that spreads wider across the shoulders, with a shallower chest point.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_03.description: A pair of small monstrous shoulder guards in organic, fleshy-looking shells studded with contrasting conical spikes and larger curved horns sweeping outward, perched on top of the shoulders without covering the arms or torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Kaiju_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulder shell bodies; colour 2 on the spikes and horns.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Madjester_02.description: A sleeveless, waistcoat-style vest with a deep V neckline, a row of buttons down the front and a pointed lower hem. A narrow band wraps round the waist to the back, and the shoulders and back are left open.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper vest body; colour 1 on the lower pointed panel and the waist band; colour 3 on the buttons; colour 2 on the outline piping.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_01.description: A bulky mechanical helmet shell that covers the head, with rounded side plates, an open face notch at the front and a squared chin-guard block. Small vent slats sit on each side of the face opening.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rounded shell plates and edge highlights; colour 2 on the face frame, chin block and inner lining; colour 3 on the vent slats.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_01.differs: The male helmet is wider and lower, with a broader shell and a squarer face opening.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_02.description: An angular mecha half-visor shell that arches over the head from front to back and drops over one eye and cheek, with a hollow inner shell, a chunky lower edge and two chevron markings on the outer face.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 3 on the chevron markings; colour 2 on the inner shell lining.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Mecha_02.differs: The male visor is a longer, wider shell that arches further over the top and back of the head.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Sapphire_.description: A short cropped chest panel that wraps around the chest like a tube top, with a rounded hourglass-shaped emblem patch on the front. It sits over the upper torso as a simple superhero-style chest insert.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Sapphire_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel; colour 1 on the hourglass-shaped emblem patch.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Witchcraf.description: A small chest clasp: two round disc buttons with star-shaped centres at the upper chest, joined by two flat straps that cross in an X between them. Reads as a decorative fastening, not a full garment.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Modern_Witchcraf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossed straps; colour 1 on the disc rims and faces; colour 2 on the star-shaped centres.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Mutated_01.description: A set of curved horn-like spikes and small thorns that jut out from the upper arms and sides of the ribs. Two large curved blades sit on one side, with clusters of small spines on the other arm. Reads as a mutated, monstrous add-on.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large curved horn blades; colour 1 on the small spines and thorns and on the tips of the horns.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A stiff, faceted metal neck collar that rises high behind the head and curves round to the sides, open at the front. Its angular panels give a retro sci-fi armored look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: The default material is glossy metal and mostly ignores the colour scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on the collar.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The collar is taller and wider, with front tips that sit further apart and rest on the shoulders.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_02.description: A pair of small, separate curved shoulder caps that sit on top of the shoulders, each an angular faceted shell with a raised top plate and a metallic lower edge. Retro sci-fi armor styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Retro_Warlord_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised top plate of each cap; colour 0 on the lower faceted edge; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Scarab_01.description: A pair of curved, horn-like scarab pincers that rest on the shoulders and sweep down over the upper chest, each with a long smooth segmented shaft ending in a sharp hooked tip, separated by a small band.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long shafts; colour 2 on the small bands between shaft and tip; colour 3 on the hooked tips.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Scarab_02.description: A pair of curved, horn-like mechanical blades mounted at the shoulders. Each sweeps up past the neck as a barbed spur and hooks down over the upper chest in a tapered claw. Suggests an insectoid, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper barbed spurs; colour 1 on the lower curved claws; colour 3 on the sharp tips and small end spikes; colour 2 on the small joints.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A small atom-symbol emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus, sitting flat on the upper chest. It is a partial chest decal with no other coverage, suited to sci-fi or superhero looks.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Shirt_Goth_02.description: A sleeveless, close-fitting tube-style torso layer with a straight neckline across the chest and a gently curved hem at the waist; it sits over the torso and has a smooth gradient between two colours.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Shirt_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest of the shirt, fading into colour 1 on the lower torso and hem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Shirt_Goth_02.differs: The male version has a straighter, squarer neckline across the chest, with no scooped neckline or bust shaping.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Steealarachnid_0.description: A small faceted diamond-shaped stud, like a two-sided pyramid, sitting on the upper chest as a single metallic emblem. Sleek and angular, it suggests a mechanical sci-fi accent on a suit.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Steealarachnid_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper facets; the lower facets appear shaded metal and the scheme is barely visible; no other slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Steelcommando_01.description: A small shield-shaped metal plate worn on the upper back between the shoulder blades, with a pointed top crest, faceted edges and tapering to a point. A raised chevron groove and rim decorate the outer face.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate body and rim; colour 3 on the raised chevron lines; colour 0 on the top crest.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male plate lies flatter and more symmetric across the back, with a single, cleaner crest at the top.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Strapped_01.description: A round mechanical chest emblem: a domed central disc in a contrasting ring, set in a bevelled outer rim ringed with small pointed spikes. It sits centred on the upper chest over the tights, with a flat back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim; colour 1 on the domed centre and the inner ring; colour 2 on the ring and its small tabs; colour 3 on the outer spikes.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Super_Retro_Dest.description: A short, waist-cinching band of segmented armor plating around the midsection, with a wide padded panel across the front and a shorter flap below it. Retro mechanical supervillain look, worn over the tights.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Super_Retro_Dest.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim of the band; colour 2 on the main band and lower front flap; colour 1 on the padded front panel.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Super_Retro_Dest.differs: The male version has a wider padded front panel that wraps toward the sides and a shorter flap, with a jagged raised back edge.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_01.description: Two oversized four-hole sewing buttons with raised rims and recessed centres, stacked vertically on the chest and stomach like a stuffed toy's stitched-on fastenings. Flat-backed discs that sit on the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rims and the flat backs; colour 1 on the recessed button faces; colour 2 on the thread holes.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_02.description: A thick, padded cloth scarf looped around the neck, with one long narrow tail hanging down the front of the chest to the waist. It is patterned with scattered heart shapes, giving a cute, casual look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scarf fabric; colour 1 on some of the hearts and the tail tip; colour 2 on the other hearts; colour 3 on the fine stitched speckles.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_02.differs: The tail hangs straight and slightly shorter, ending at the upper abdomen, and is narrower in side view.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_03.description: A thick, soft scarf looped around the neck with one long tail hanging down the front of the chest, patterned with hearts and carrying two large four-hole buttons along the tail. A cute, plush, patchwork look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Teddy_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scarf fabric and button rims; colour 1 on the buttons and the heart patches; colour 2 on the button holes and the other hearts.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A pair of wide bandolier-style straps crossing diagonally over the chest and back from the left shoulder to the opposite ribs, studded with rivets and fastened by small laced ties and buckle bits at the front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 3 on the rivets; colour 1 on the lacing ties at the front; colour 2 on the small buckle teeth.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_01.description: A partial armored chest band of angular plates: two flared side wings, a chevron-shaped centre plate with a V-shaped inset panel, and small round studs. It wraps the lower chest and ribs, and the back has a matching V shape.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side wings and outer plates; colour 2 on the chevron centre plate; colour 1 on the V-shaped inset panel; colour 3 on the round studs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_01.differs: The male version sits higher across the lower chest with larger wings, while the female version sits lower at the waist.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_02.description: A partial chest plate of stacked hexagonal armor segments running down the centre of the chest from the collarbone to the ribs, ending in tapering spear-like tips. Set into the segments are round sockets. Sits flat on the torso, mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Bulwark_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 0 on the raised borders and segment frames; colour 2 on the outer edge rims; colour 3 on the round sockets.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Light_01.description: A pair of separate sleeve-like shoulder and upper-arm covers, each a rounded cap over the shoulder above stacked, banded cuffs with thin contrasting piping. They sit over the upper arms only, leaving the torso bare.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cap and band surfaces; colour 0 on the thin piping edges along the caps and bands.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_0.description: A small chest-layer harness of thin, angular metallic struts forming open lattice bands across the upper chest and back, joined by a central gem-like emblem with angular contrasting wedges. Sits over tight clothing, with spiky ends.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lattice struts and spiky bands; colour 2 on the angular wedge shapes around the centre; colour 1 on the central emblem plate; colour 3 on the small inner marking.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Talisman_0.description: A wide, sweeping high collar that curves around the back and sides of the neck and flares up into pointed tips beside the head. The front is open, with thin tapering points reaching down the upper chest. Dramatic, villainous superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Talisman_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 is not clearly visible; colour 3 on the inner face of the collar; colour 1 on the outer face and the thin edge trim.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Tight_Talisman_0.differs: The male collar is lower and more widely splayed, curving out like a shallow bowl, with shorter chest tips.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_01.description: A short standing collar that wraps the base of the neck, open at the centre front with a slight overlap, layered bands of contrasting trim along the edges and a flared upturned rim. Suits sci-fi and traveller looks.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body and inner lining; colour 1 on the trim band along the lower and upper edges; colour 2 on the thin outer rim edging.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_02.description: A wide, flat mantle collar that rests on the shoulders and around the neck, with a contrasting rim and a contrasting inner lining. It narrows to a pointed spike-like tip down the upper chest. Suggests a sleek traveller look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar surface; colour 2 on the rim, inner lining and front point.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Traveler_02.differs: The male version has a longer, more pronounced spike-like point at the back as well as the front, while the female back point is short.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Vest_Swing_01.description: A sleeveless formal waistcoat with wide shawl lapels, a stand-up collared shirt front panel and a row of three buttons near the hem; a small pin sits on the lapel. The back is open, showing only the lapel edges.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Vest_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 2 on the lapels; colour 1 on the shirt front panel and collar; colour 3 on the buttons and lapel pin.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Warrior_02.description: A small shield-shaped chest plate covering the sternum, made of layered chevron-striped ridges that taper to a point below the chest. Flanking side panels with banded edges wrap toward the ribs; the back is a hollow shell.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main chevron ridges; colour 0 on the stripes between the ridges and the top edge; colour 3 on the side band edges; colour 2 on the darker side bands.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Wolf_01.description: A pair of curved, blade-like shoulder fins that rise from the tops of the shoulders and sweep forward and back in a crescent. The front faces carry engraved swirl patterns and an edged border; the backs are smooth and dark. Mechanical, wolf-fang styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Extra_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner face panels of the fins; colour 1 on the swirl engraving; colour 3 on the border edging; colour 2 on the smooth outer backs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Fairytunic_01.description: A short, waist-length fairy-tunic top with a V-neck lace-up front, separate shoulder caps, short sleeves ending in jagged torn edges, and a scalloped, ragged hem at the back. Fantasy woodland style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Fairytunic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front chest panel and the jagged sleeve and hem edges; colour 1 on the sleeves and back panel; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and upper collar; colour 3 on the small underarm and lower back accents.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Firefighter_Jacket_01.description: A bulky, padded long-sleeved firefighter jacket ending at the hips, with a high collar, a vertical front strip, pocket flaps, reflective-style horizontal bands across chest, sleeves and hem, and patches on the elbows.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Firefighter_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body; colour 1 on the horizontal bands; colour 2 on the thin lines beside the bands; colour 3 on the collar, front strip and elbow patches.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Firefighter_Jacket_01.differs: The male jacket is loose and contrasting-bodied with horizontal reflective bands, a front strip, pocket flaps and elbow patches, rather than the female's fitted colour-blocked design.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Gamer_01.description: A pair of thin suspender-style straps that run over the shoulders and join in a Y at the upper back, ending at the waist in small clasps with short dangling tabs. Worn over a bodysuit.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 3 on the clasps and the back junction; colour 1 on the dangling tabs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Gamer_01.differs: The male straps hang straighter, with the two front straps meeting closer together at the chest and the ends sitting higher on the torso.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Gladiator_03.description: A sleeveless, glossy semi-transparent chest layer that hugs the torso like a second skin, with a squared shoulder line and a hem at the hips that drops into pointed tails at the front sides and rear.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Gladiator_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole layer; the glossy material largely ignores the other colour slots, and none of them is clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Gun_Harness_01.description: A tactical shoulder harness of thin crossing straps with adjustable buckles, joined by a square plate between the shoulder blades. A holster hangs under one arm and a double ammo pouch under the other.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Gun_Harness_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps, holster body and pouches; colour 3 on the back plate, buckle slides and pouch studs; colour 1 on the holster trim; colour 2 on the holster opening.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Gun_Harness_01.differs: The male version has a double-compartment pouch, and its straps run vertically down the chest instead of crossing.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Gunholster_01.description: A shoulder-and-chest harness of thick armor plates with an octagonal emblem at the chest, a diagonal strap across the torso, and two small pouches hanging at the ribs. Military-tactical sci-fi look, covering the upper chest and shoulders.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Gunholster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and under-strap band; colour 1 on the straps and edge piping; colour 3 on the emblem, studs and buckle details; colour 2 on the pouches.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Gunholster_01.differs: The male version has a larger plate that covers more of the shoulders and upper chest, with the pouches sitting higher.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_01.description: A heavy mechanical harness: a segmented diagonal strap runs from a large rounded shoulder cap across the chest with a ribbed armor plate, joined by a loop strap over the back, plus a layered multi-ring band around the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands and waist ring edges; colour 1 on the chest plating and waist band panels; colour 2 on the shoulder cap and strap segments; colour 3 on the round studs and inner waist details.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_01.differs: The male version adds a layered, multi-ringed armored band around the waist and a larger, bulkier shoulder cap.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_02.description: A mechanical chest harness made of a diagonal strap crossing from one shoulder to the opposite hip, with a ribbed armoured plate over the shoulder and a bulky shoulder cap, fastened with small round studs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap edges; colour 1 on the ribbed shoulder plate; colour 2 on the shoulder cap and strap backing; colour 3 on the round fasteners.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Harness_Ironclad_02.differs: The male version is a lighter single diagonal strap and shoulder piece with no waist belt.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Harness_Singlestrap_01.description: A single diagonal harness strap crossing the torso from one shoulder to the opposite hip area, capped by a rounded segmented shoulder plate with ridged bands and a contrasting connector block, with a looped double strap beneath.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Harness_Singlestrap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate; colour 3 on the ridged bands of the shoulder piece; colour 2 on the connector block and strap centre lines; colour 1 on the strap edges.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Heraldry_01.description: A sleeveless plate cuirass with a raised stand-up collar, a shield-shaped upper chest panel bearing a sword-like emblem, and curved lower plates ending in a point at the waist. Open armholes; knightly, heraldic look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower plates and bust plates; colour 1 on the collar, upper chest panel and shoulder area; colour 2 on the outlining edges and armhole interiors; colour 3 on the central emblem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Hybrid_01.description: A sculpted organic-mechanical chest armour with swirling ridged panels, a carved central chest plate, rounded shoulder caps and a pointed lower front. A row of spikes rises over a jagged back panel; sleeveless, ending at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, raised ridges and swirling trim; colour 1 on the main armour panels and spikes; colour 2 on the edge inserts at the sides and underarms; colour 3 on the jagged back panel.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Hybrid_01.differs: The male version has a wider row of several spikes across the upper back and a larger contrasting back panel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Inmate_02.description: A sleeveless armoured vest with a V-shaped upper yoke, segmented ribbed plates over the torso, a small chained clasp at the chest, a wide buckled belt band, and a pointed hem with contrasting trim.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper yoke and belt band; colour 2 on the ribbed torso plates; colour 3 on the edge trim and piping; colour 1 on the belt buckle and chain.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Inmate_03.description: A sleeveless armored vest with a raised standing collar, a zip-like front strip, angular shoulder plates, a contrasting studded centre panel, and a banded waist belt with a pointed lower plate and a buckle.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Inmate_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plates, chest plates and waist bands; colour 1 on the collar, front strip and belt; colour 2 on the main vest body; colour 3 on the collar edging, studs and belt buckle.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Inmate_03.differs: The male vest has broader, more segmented contrasting chest plates with no bust shaping, and the shoulder plates are more angular.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Inmate_05.description: A sleeveless armored vest with a tall, rolled high collar, broad chest plates and rounded shoulder caps, plus a pointed segmented plate hanging down over the groin and a separate strap belt at the hips. Grim prison-tech look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Inmate_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest and back plates and the hanging segmented plates; colour 2 on the high collar; colour 1 on the waist belt and collar edge; colour 3 on the small zipper pull at the chest.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Inmate_05.differs: The male version has larger, bulkier shoulder caps that stand out from the arms, and a flatter chest plate.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristrocrat_Clo.description: A long-sleeved, tailored aristocrat jacket with a small folded collar, cutaway front that opens over a narrow buttoned vest panel, tapering tails at the back, and wide turned-back cuffs with buttons. Ends around the hips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristrocrat_Clo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and tails; colour 1 on the cuffs and thin collar piping; colour 2 on the centre vest panel; colour 3 on the buttons on the vest and cuffs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristrocrat_Ope.description: A long-sleeved formal tailcoat with an open front showing a buttoned vest, striped lapel facings, a standing collar, wide turned-back cuffs and a rounded tail hanging down the back to the knees.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristrocrat_Ope.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat, vest and tail; colour 1 on the lapel stripes, collar edge and cuff stripes; colour 2 on the lapel facing backing; colour 3 on the vest fastenings.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Aristrocrat_Ope.differs: The male version has a wider, fuller tail and a longer coat body with padded, squarer shoulders.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Colonial_01.description: A long-sleeved, thigh-length colonial-style coat with a high standing collar, an open front showing a contrasting lining, rows of looped frog-style fastenings across the chest, banded cuffs and a curved, tailed hem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Colonial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body and sleeves; colour 1 on the collar and inner lining; colour 3 on the chest loops; colour 2 on the cuffs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Cowboy_Duster_0.description: A long-sleeved western duster coat with a shoulder capelet, a button row down the front, banded cuffs, and a long panel skirt hanging to the ankles, open at the front over the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Cowboy_Duster_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body, sleeves and long tails; colour 1 on the shoulder capelet and cuff bands; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Cowboy_Duster_0.differs: The male version has a full-length coat with a wide tail panel hanging down the front left side as well as the back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Denim_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved casual denim jacket with wide notched lapels, a button-up front, two flap pockets and banded hem and cuffs. It ends at the waist and has a few small patches of wear.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Denim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves of the jacket; colour 1 on the lapels, hem band, cuffs and front placket; colour 2 on the small wear patches; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Denim_01.differs: The male jacket has both sleeves in the main colour with a contrasting lapel, and shows small contrasting patches instead of a weathered, mottled texture.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Detective_01.description: A long-sleeved detective trench coat with wide notched lapels and a high collar, a fitted jacket top over a long open skirt panel falling to the ankles, split at the front with trim strips and cuffed sleeves.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the jacket torso and upper sleeves; colour 0 on the lapels, lower sleeves and long skirt; colour 1 on the sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on small studs on the skirt front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Detective_01.differs: The male coat has a contrasting torso and upper sleeves contrasting with the light lapels, forearms and skirt, and a textured back panel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Extra_Detective.description: A partial detective-style jacket layer consisting only of a tall turned-up collar and two long pointed lapels that drape down the chest, with contrasting edge piping. It leaves the torso and arms uncovered.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Extra_Detective.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and lapel faces; colour 2 on the edge piping and the inner collar lining.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Frigid_01.description: A sleeveless, high-collared sci-fi vest-jacket with a fitted torso, rounded shoulder caps, and a tail that falls into pointed panels at the front and back. Outlined seams and a diamond back emblem give it a sleek, mechanical look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the collar lining and the swooping tail spikes; colour 2 on the piping, outlines and shoulder caps; colour 3 on the small back emblem gem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Frigid_01.differs: The male tail is shorter with less dramatic front panels, and the vest sits more squarely on the torso.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Ghosthunter_01.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length jacket with a V-neck collar flap, two large flap chest pockets, round patches on the upper sleeves, and a gathered elasticated hem. An atom emblem is printed across the upper back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the gathered hem band, the lower body gradient and the atom emblem; colour 3 on the collar flap and chest pockets; colour 2 on the sleeve patches.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_01.description: An open-front, long-sleeved jacket with wide contrasting lapels, a single small button, and cuffs in a separate material. The front edges cut away into asymmetric tails, with a thin strap hanging down one side. It ends at the hips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and the strap; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 2 on the cuffs; colour 3 on the small button.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.description: A long open-front coat with wide lapels, elbow-length sleeves with contrasting cuff bands, and an asymmetric hem that slants down to a slit at the back. It reaches about the knee and has a lab-coat or gothic look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body and sleeves; colour 2 on the lapels, cuffs and hem trim; colour 1 on the top worn underneath.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Goth_02.differs: The male version is one continuous knee-length coat, with no waist gap between the jacket and the skirt section.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Holiday_01.description: A short-sleeved, open-front holiday coat with a large hood and shaggy fur-like collar, vertical piped stripes, a wide belt band at the waist, and rough furry trim on the sleeve cuffs and knee-length hem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Holiday_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body and hood; colour 1 on the shaggy collar and the inner chest panel; colour 2 on the furry cuff and hem trim; colour 3 on the stripes, piping and belt band.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Holiday_02.description: A short-sleeved, knee-length winter hoodie coat with an open front, a big furry shawl collar and hood, fluffy cuffs and hem, a waist sash, and thin vertical stripe lines down the body. Holiday style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Holiday_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body and hood lining; colour 1 on the fur collar and inner chest panel; colour 2 on the fur cuffs and hem; colour 3 on the waist sash and vertical stripe piping.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Inmate_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved straitjacket-style jacket with a tall funnel collar, harness straps crossing the chest with buckled panels, horizontal stripe bands on the sleeves and back, and a small patch on the upper arm. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the chest harness straps, buckle panels, arm patch and back collar trim; colour 3 on the stripe bands across the sleeves and back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Irradiate_01.description: A waist-length, long-sleeved bomber-style jacket with a wide notched lapel collar, puffy gathered sleeves, banded cuffs with strap details, a zip front left open, and a darker lower hem with a flap pocket.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Irradiate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper jacket, sleeves and lapels; colour 2 on the lower hem band and pocket; colour 1 on the collar piping, zip edging and cuff straps; colour 3 on the zip and small pocket detail.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Irradiate_02.description: A bulky, waist-length bomber-style jacket with long sleeves, a big coiled tubular collar, a front zip, wide lapels and large flap pockets on a fitted hem band. Worn and torn-looking patches mark the sleeves and back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Irradiate_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, lapels and sleeves; colour 1 on the coiled collar and the strip beside the zip; colour 2 on the lower hem band and pockets; colour 3 on the zip and small tabs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Irradiate_03.description: A cropped, short-sleeved jacket with wide notched lapels, a raised collar and a front zipper. The fabric is torn and shredded at the shoulders, sleeves and back, and the hem is a gathered contrasting band with small pockets.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Irradiate_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, lapels and sleeves, fading toward colour 2 at the lower hem; colour 1 on the inner collar lining and zipper edging; colour 3 on the zipper pull and teeth.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved leather biker jacket with a wide open collar, lapels with thin piped edging, a buckled belt at the waist and strapped, buckled cuffs. It hangs open at the front and ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and lapels; colour 1 on the sleeves; colour 2 on the belt and cuff straps; colour 3 on the belt badge, cuff buckles and piping accents.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_01.differs: The jacket hangs more openly at the front, showing more of the chest beneath, with a wider open collar.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_03.description: A short, waist-length biker-style leather jacket with wide open lapels, a high folded collar, short sleeves ending in thick contrasting cuffs, and a buckled belt at the hem. An emblem is printed across the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the sleeves, lapel piping and back emblem; colour 2 on the sleeve cuffs and belt; colour 3 on the belt buckle.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_Lycan_0.description: A cropped, open-front leather jacket with a raised collar, one long sleeve with buckled strap cuffs, a shortened opposite sleeve, and stitched, blood-streaked edges. A painted emblem marks the back. Ends at the ribs; street or punk styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Leather_Lycan_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, collar and sleeves; colour 1 on the emblem across the back; colour 3 on the stitched seams along the front edges; colour 2 on the cuff straps and buckles.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Madjester_02.description: A long-sleeved tailcoat-style jacket with wide patterned lapels, a pointed buttoned waistcoat panel, a waist seam and a broad split tail that sweeps down to the knees, curving forward at the hips. Formal, theatrical jester look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and tails; colour 1 on the patterned lapels, waistcoat panel and waist band; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Madjester_02.differs: The male jacket has broad tails that fall to about knee length and curve forward at the hips, rather than one narrow back tail with a cropped front.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Military_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved military-style jacket with wide notched lapels, a broad open collar, a banded hem at the waist and an atom-like emblem on each upper sleeve. Fitted body with a plain, sleek finish.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Military_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, collar and hem band; colour 1 on the sleeves and the piping along the lapels; colour 3 on the small buttons; the sleeve emblems are a lighter tone of the sleeve colour.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Modern_Sapphire.description: A cropped, short-sleeved sci-fi jacket with a tall open collar, padded shoulders, piped seam lines, banded cuffs and a buckled belt at the waist; a round emblem with a contrasting insignia sits on the upper back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Modern_Sapphire.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the piping, cuff bands and chest panel; colour 3 on the small studs and the back emblem centre; colour 2 on the zip cord, buckle and back insignia.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare_Goth_.description: A knee-length gothic frock coat with a tall standing collar, open front with wide lapels, and flared bell cuffs. Vertical pinstripes run down the skirt, which ends in pointed, ornamented hem spikes; two bands wrap each upper arm.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Nightmare_Goth_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main coat body and collar; colour 1 on the vertical stripes, lapel edging and hem outlines; colour 2 on the hem spike inserts and the back emblem; colour 3 on the upper-arm bands.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parka_Hooddown_.description: A padded, puffy long-sleeved parka with horizontal quilted baffles, an open front, a lowered hood bunched around the neck, front pockets and ribbed cuffs and hem; ends at the hip. Casual winter street style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parka_Hooddown_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main padded body and sleeves; colour 1 on the hood rim around the neck; colour 3 on the inner front edge lining; colour 2 on the cuffs and bottom hem bands.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parka_Hoodup_01.description: A puffy, quilted parka with the hood raised, long sleeves and horizontal padded bands, ending at the hip. Long drawstrings hang down the front chest and the sleeves and hem have contrasting ribbed edges. Casual cold-weather streetwear.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parka_Hoodup_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted body, sleeves and hood; colour 1 on the hood's edge trim; colour 3 on the drawstrings; colour 2 on the cuffs and hem bands.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parkafur_Hoodup.description: A puffy, quilted long-sleeved parka jacket with a raised hood, a fur-like ruffled hood rim and a narrow open front with a strip down the chest; ends at the hip with a contrasting hem and cuffs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Parkafur_Hoodup.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted body, sleeves and hood; colour 1 on the ruffled hood rim; colour 3 on the front strip down the chest; colour 2 on the hem and cuffs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Aviator_01.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length aviator jacket with wide open lapels, a front zip, slanted zip pockets, a separate shoulder and upper-back yoke, padded banded cuffs and hem, and a round patch on the upper sleeve.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Aviator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 3 on the shoulder yoke, pocket edges and zip line; colour 1 on the lapels, cuffs, hem band and sleeve patch.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Military_0.description: A fitted, long-sleeved military-style jacket with a double-breasted contrasting front panel of studded buttons, an open folded collar, shoulder epaulette patches, banded cuffs and a cropped hem that exposes the lower back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Military_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the front panel, cuffs and shoulder patches; colour 2 on the buttons; colour 3 on the thin piping along the edges.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Pulp_Military_0.differs: The male jacket is cropped shorter, leaving a gap at the lower back, and has a wider open folded collar.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_01.description: A long-sleeved, hip-length open-front jacket with broad contrasting trim and lapels, toggle buttons and straps on the front, draped cord loops, and bulky shoulder pads with studs and strapped bands on the sleeves. Contrasting cuffs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 3 on the lapels, front edging, hem, collar and draped cords; colour 1 on the sleeve cuffs; colour 2 on the buttons, studs, shoulder fittings and small straps.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_01.differs: The male jacket has bulkier mechanical shoulder pads with studded fittings that stand out from the sleeves.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_02.description: A short-sleeved, open-front striped hoodie jacket with a wide draped hood at the neck, contrasting trim along the edges, a pointed hem with a cut-out notch at the back, and small stud accents. Sits over the torso to about hip level.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 on the alternating stripes of the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the hood lining, edge trim and hem trim; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Retro_Talisman_.description: A waist-length retro jacket with full puffed long sleeves, banded cuffs and a gathered hem. Big blousy lapels sweep back from a narrower open front, with a row of small buttons down one side.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Retro_Talisman_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels and inner collar; colour 2 on the cuffs; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Retro_Talisman_.differs: The male jacket has a narrower opening that sits higher on the chest and a longer row of buttons down the front, so it covers more.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesclosed_01.description: A fitted long-sleeved jacket ending at the waist, with a high stand collar, a deep V-front closed by a central placket, harness-like trim bands over the shoulders, and turned-back contrasting cuffs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesclosed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and upper sleeves; colour 3 fading in over the lower sleeves; colour 1 on the collar, front placket, shoulder trim bands and cuffs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesclosed_01.differs: The sleeves fade from the base colour into colour 3 toward the cuffs, rather than staying plain.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesopen_01.description: A long-sleeved cropped jacket with an open front and a long flared robe skirt reaching the ankles, edged with contrasting trim and cuffs. Sleeves fade toward the forearm, and a belt-like band sits at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesopen_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, robe skirt and upper sleeves; colour 1 on the trim, lapel edging and sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on the forearm sections of the sleeves; colour 2 on the waist band.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Robesopen_01.differs: The male robe skirt hangs as a fuller, more continuous piece with a contrasting waist band and pointed front panels, without the hip gaps.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Santa_01.description: A long-sleeved holiday coat with a puffy fur-like round collar, a contrasting front stripe, fluffy cuffs, a belt band and a flared skirt reaching the upper thigh with contrasting angled panels and a round patch.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, cuffs, hem trim, belt band, lower sleeves and front skirt panels; colour 1 on the main coat body and upper sleeves; colour 3 on the front stripe and side skirt stripe; colour 2 on the back and upper sleeves and skirt panels.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Santa_01.differs: The male version is a longer coat with a flared skirt to the upper thigh and a straight contrasting front stripe, rather than a cropped waist-length jacket.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Secret_01.description: A padded, open-front bomber-style jacket with a tall stand-up collar, puffy long sleeves with twin racing stripes, ribbed cuffs and hem band, and slanted hand pockets; ends at the waist. Casual sporty look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and collar; colour 1 on the sleeves, pocket trim and front edge piping; colour 3 on the sleeve stripes; colour 2 on the ribbed cuffs and hem band.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Secret_04.description: A loose, puffy bomber-style jacket with long sleeves, an open front with no closure, ribbed banded cuffs and hem, a sleeve patch on the upper arm and a slim stripe near each front hip. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body; colour 2 on the ribbed cuffs and hem band; colour 1 on the sleeve patch and hip stripes; colour 3 on the bars within the sleeve patch.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Sleeveless_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length open-front jacket with wide notched lapels, chest flap pockets, small buttons and thin banding at the hem. The back carries an atom emblem and vertical seam lines.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Sleeveless_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jacket body; colour 1 on the lapels and collar; colour 3 on the buttons; colour 2 on the hem banding and seam lines; colour 1 on the atom emblem on the back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_01.description: A long-sleeved spy-style blazer with an overall bold window-pane grid pattern, notched lapels over an open front, buttons, and small flap pockets at the hips. Ends at the hips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body; colour 1 on the lapels and pocket flaps; colour 2 on the grid lines; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_01.differs: The male jacket hangs straighter without a cinched waist, and the pocket flaps sit slightly higher on the torso.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_02.description: A long-sleeved, high-collared spy jacket that ends at the hips. It is straight-cut with a contrasting centre front panel, thin seam piping over the shoulders and back, and small zip accents at the pockets and cuffs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jacket body, sleeves and collar; colour 1 on the centre front panel and the hem trim; colour 2 on the shoulder and back seam piping; colour 3 on the zip accents and the centre panel stitching.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Spy_02.differs: The male jacket has a straighter hem with a contrasting trim edge, and a wider centre panel than the female jacket.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Starowl_01.description: A long-sleeved fitted jacket with a pointed, star-like collar and zigzag hem, opening into layered petal-shaped tails that hang to the knees and part at the front. Cuffs are contrasting bands, with thin piping down the front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and petal panels; colour 2 on the collar, cuffs and petal edging; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Starowl_01.differs: The male tails part at the front and stop around the knees, rather than forming a fuller closed skirt.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Steampunk_01.description: A cropped, open-front steampunk jacket with a tall turned-up collar, short sleeves over separate banded forearm sleeves, a laced corset-style back panel and a short tattered tail with strapped bands. Sits over the torso to the upper thigh.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, collar and tail; colour 1 on the forearm sleeves, back panel stripes and chest side panels; colour 2 on the straps and lacing; colour 3 on the collar edge piping.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_01.description: A long-sleeved, open-front tailored suit jacket with wide notched lapels, a small row of buttons and a hip-length hem. It is worn over the torso, leaving the chest below the neck bare.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 3 on the buttons.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_02.description: A long-sleeved, open-front suit jacket with wide notched lapels, a loose casual drape and a hem at hip level. Small buttons sit low on the front, and the collar is turned up slightly at the back of the neck.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels and the inner collar facing; colour 3 on the small buttons.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_02_Glitter.description: A long-sleeved, hip-length blazer worn open at the front, with wide notched lapels in contrasting fabric and a speckled, glitter-flecked texture across the body and sleeves. Casual-formal, sits over a plain top.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_02_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves, with speckled flecks in colour 3; colour 1 on the lapels.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03.description: A long-sleeved tailored suit jacket with wide notched lapels that run far down an open front, closing only near the hem with tiny buttons. It ends at the hips and gives a formal, business look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03.differs: The male jacket hangs open much lower, with the lapels running nearly to the hem and buttons only at the bottom edge, while the female jacket closes higher with two visible buttons.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03_Glitter.description: A long-sleeved suit jacket with wide notched lapels that open into a deep V at the chest, worn over the torso and ending at the hips. The fabric has a speckled, glittery pattern. Suggests a smart formal look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels and collar; colour 3 on the speckles in the fabric.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suit_03_Glitter.differs: The male jacket hangs straighter with a deeper open V front and no visible waist shaping, so it reads as more open than the female one.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_01.description: A long-sleeved, open-front tailored suit jacket with wide notched lapels and a straight hem at the hips. Small buttons sit low on the front, and a contrasting inner panel shows down the centre.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 2 on the inner front panel; colour 3 on the small buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_01.differs: The male jacket has a straighter, boxier hem with no flare, and the contrasting inner panel is a plain straight strip.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_02.description: A long-sleeved suit jacket with broad contrasting lapels, worn open over an inset vest panel. It has a straight cut ending at the hip, with a couple of small buttons at the front. Smart, formal styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 2 on the inner vest panel; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Suitvest_02.differs: The male jacket has a straighter, boxier cut with a shorter hem and fewer buttons on the front.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Swing_01.description: A long-sleeved, striped tailored jacket with broad shawl lapels, a short vest-like front panel with a row of round buttons, a small shirt front underneath, cuffed sleeves and piping at the shoulders; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest panel and stripe base; colour 1 on the stripes and shirt front; colour 2 on the lapels and cuffs; colour 3 on the buttons, shoulder piping and small chest pin.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Toy_01.description: A sleeveless, schoolwear-style vest with a rounded collar band, a hanging striped necktie, a wide cinched belt band at the waist and a pointed, angled hem. A column of buttons runs down the chest and two more sit low on the front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the collar band and necktie; colour 2 on the waist band, the tie stripes and the lower buttons; colour 3 on the tie knot and the chest buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Toy_01.differs: The male vest has a column of three contrasting buttons down the chest above two contrasting lower buttons, and a longer, straighter hem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trench_01.description: A cropped, double-breasted trench-style jacket with wide notched lapels, two rows of large round buttons, long fitted sleeves with strapped cuffs, and a plain smooth back; it ends at the ribs, above the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trench_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and lapels; colour 1 on the sleeves and the thin lapel piping; colour 2 on the buttons and cuff bands; colour 3 on the cuff buckles.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchchains_01.description: A long-sleeved trenchcoat with an open front and a split, flared skirt reaching the ankles, with a small spiked high collar. Chains wrap diagonally across the torso and coil around both forearms, giving a rugged mechanical look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchchains_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body, collar and skirt; colour 1 on the sleeves; colour 3 on the chains and collar spikes.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchopen_01.description: An open-front long-sleeved trench coat with a fitted torso panel and lapels edged with contrasting trim, separate padded sleeves with strapped cuffs, a belt at the waist, and a long split skirt flaring to the ankles.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchopen_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body and skirt; colour 1 on the sleeves and lapel trim; colour 2 on the belt; colour 3 on the cuff buckles and small sleeve accents.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Trenchopen_01.differs: The male coat has prominent folded lapels with contrasting trim and a fuller chest panel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01.description: A long-sleeved open tuxedo jacket with wide contrasting lapels, a waist band, buttoned cuffs and long split tails that hang down the back to the knees. Formal and elegant, worn open over the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body, sleeves and tails; colour 2 on the lapels; colour 1 on the cuff bands; colour 3 on the small cuff buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01.differs: The male jacket has a visible waist band across the front and tails that hang longer, reaching about the knees, with a broader front opening.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01_Glit.description: A long-sleeved, open-front tuxedo tailcoat with contrasting lapels and banded cuffs, a fitted waist and a broad rounded tail hanging down the back to the calves. Glittery, textured fabric gives a formal, showy look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01_Glit.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coat body and tails; colour 2 on the lapels and collar; colour 1 on the cuff bands; colour 3 on small button details.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Tuxopen_01_Glit.differs: The male version is a full tailcoat with a wide back skirt and a waist band, covering the hips and back more fully.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Urban_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved urban bomber jacket with contrasting sleeves, a big soft hood bunched around the neck, an open front showing an inner zip layer, ribbed trim at hem and cuffs, and an atom emblem on the sleeve.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Urban_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the hood and inner front layer; colour 2 on the sleeves and front edge piping; colour 3 on the hem and cuff stripes and the zip pull.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wedding_Tuxclos.description: A long-sleeved, closed-front tuxedo-style jacket with wide notched lapels, contrasting panels that swoop down the front and back into pointed tails, and cuffed sleeves. It ends around hip length and suits formal or showman looks.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wedding_Tuxclos.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and upper sleeves; colour 1 on the front panels, back V-panels, tail points and sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on the lapel edges, collar and cuff trim; colour 2 on the seam outlines.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wedding_Tuxopen.description: A long-sleeved open-front tailcoat with wide peaked lapels, a cut-away front and long tapering tails reaching the knees at the back. Piping outlines the seams and cuffs, with a yoke seam across the upper back. Formal wedding style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wedding_Tuxopen.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main coat body and sleeves; colour 1 on the piping, seam lines and cuff bands; colour 2 on the lapel facings.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Windbreakerroll.description: A cropped, long-sleeved windbreaker jacket with a raised open collar, centre zip front, puffy sleeves and thick rolled cuffs. It ends at the waist and sits over the torso, giving a casual sporty look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Windbreakerroll.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper body and sleeves, fading to colour 0 toward the hem and collar; colour 2 on the rolled cuffs; colour 3 on the thin side piping.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wizards_01.description: A long-sleeved open-front jacket with a tall flared collar, ornate scrollwork shoulder epaulettes with ridged trim, and buttoned flared cuffs. It hangs open at the chest and ends at the waist, with a plain back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the inner collar and front lining and the cuff buttons; colour 3 on the shoulder epaulettes and scroll patterns; colour 2 on the inner cuff bands.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Wizards_01.differs: The male version hangs open at the chest with a lined front edge, has no vest or tails, and ends at the waist.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Zoot_01.description: A long-sleeved, single-breasted zoot-style jacket with wide notched lapels, four buttons down the front, contrasting cuffs and a straight, slightly pointed hem at the waist. Tailored, formal look with structured shoulders.
