Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Zoot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lapels; colour 2 on the sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jacket_Zoot_01.differs: The male jacket is shorter, ending at the waist with a nearly straight hem instead of a long pointed one.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Jumpsuit_Prisonjacket_.description: A bulky mechanical stock-like collar piece: a wide segmented plate ring around the neck and shoulders with small loop handles, a ridged chest plate, and a separate studded waist band joined by a narrow central strip.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Jumpsuit_Prisonjacket_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the collar rims, chest emblem and waist band; colour 2 on the main plates and central strip; colour 0 on the inner collar panels and ribbed side blocks; colour 3 on the studs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Kaiju_01.description: A sleeveless spiked armour chest piece with sculpted muscle-like plates across the chest and abdomen, bulky shoulder guards studded with long horn-like spikes, a raised collar, and a segmented spine plate down the back. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulder guards, back plates and outer chest and waist edging; colour 1 on the sculpted chest and abdomen plates and the neck collar; colour 2 on the spikes; colour 0 on the segmented spine plates on the back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Labcoat_19th_Century_0.description: A long-sleeved, high-collared Victorian-style lab coat with an off-centre row of small buttons, colour-blocked panels and a short skirt to the upper thigh; fitted through the waist and slightly flared below.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Labcoat_19th_Century_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the right shoulder, sleeve and back skirt panels; colour 1 on the chest, left sleeve, collar and side panels; colour 2 on the waist band, back yoke and cuff; colour 3 on the chest patch and hem patch; buttons take a metallic shine.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Labcoat_Modern_01.description: A long-sleeved, open-front lab coat with lapels and a high collar, falling to about mid-thigh. Colour-blocked panels cut diagonally across the chest, back, sleeves and hem, with a shoulder cap and small square details at the front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Labcoat_Modern_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main coat body, lapels and collar; colour 1 on the diagonal panels of the sleeves, lower body and hem; colour 2 on the chest and upper back panel; colour 3 on the shoulder cap; small details on the front are colour 2.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Lockbox_65_01.description: A cropped, open-front kung fu jacket with a small standing collar, wide bell-style long sleeves and contrasting piping along the edges and cuffs. Swirl motifs sit on the shoulders, and the jacket ends above the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the jacket body and sleeves; colour 0 on the piping, cuff bands and shoulder swirl patches.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Lockbox_67_02.description: A strapless corset-style bustier with glossy padded cups edged in ruffled trim, a smooth fitted midsection with a scalloped lower edge, and a peplum of pointed tabs flaring over the hips. Open at the back, worn over the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cups and the peplum tabs; colour 0 on the midsection band and ruffle trim; colour 1 on the inner lining and the edging of the tabs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Lockbox_67_03.description: A cropped, short-sleeved capelet-style top covering the shoulders, chest and upper back, with a patterned swirl design, ruffled frilled edging, small dangling metal tassels and a contrasting open collar. Ends above the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Lockbox_67_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the capelet; colour 0 on the swirl patterns and collar-area panels; colour 2 on the ruffled edging and inner collar; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Mecha_01.description: A bulky mechanical chest-and-back shell: a boxy armored casing over the torso with a ridged central crest and chevron marks at the neck, side pods with round openings, missile-like pods on the front, twin round vents on the back and a rounded module below.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and side pods; colour 1 on the back panel, front pod ends and lower front plate; colour 2 on the crest trim and the lower back module; colour 3 on the chevrons, vent centres and pod dots.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Mecha_01.differs: The male version has separate contrasting panels on the back and front pods with dotted missile-style ends, where the female version has a plain glossy finish.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Merc_01.description: A sleeveless sci-fi armored torso layer: bulky domed plates over the chest with a central gem, a segmented tapered midsection ending in a V at the waist, and a chunky plated back with a vertical strap.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Merc_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest domes and lower side plates; colour 1 on the midsection, back plates and hip panels; colour 2 on the grooves and back clip; colour 3 on the chest gem and back light.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Military_Coat_01.description: A fitted long-sleeved military dress jacket with a high stand collar, an off-centre row of buttons, a waist pocket flap, shoulder epaulettes, a stripe down one sleeve and banded rank stripes on the cuffs. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Military_Coat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jacket body; colour 1 on the stripe down the sleeve; colour 2 on the collar, epaulettes and pocket flap; colour 3 on the buttons; rank stripes on the cuffs and upper arm take a separate trim colour.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Military_Coat_01.differs: The male jacket is shorter, ending at the waist, and has bright rank stripes on the cuffs and upper sleeve where the female one has contrasting bands.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A cropped superhero chest layer: two deep, rounded shoulder-cap plates joined over the upper chest and back, with a ribbed fan-shaped panel and a pointed shield-like plate at the breastbone. A contrasting band underlines the plates and it leaves the arms bare.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plates; colour 1 on the central arrow shape and the lower shield plate; colour 3 on the ribbed fan panels; colour 2 on the underside band beneath the plates.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Destroyer_01.differs: The male version adds a contrasting band under the plates and has deeper, bulkier shoulder caps.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A mechanical shoulder harness: a thick padded plate with a vented panel arches over one shoulder. Two contrasting straps cross the chest and back and join at round dial buckles. Sci-fi styling, no chest plate.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate and buckle housings; colour 1 on the straps; colour 2 on the dials and inner shoulder lining; colour 3 on the vent panel stripes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.differs: The male version has only the shoulder plate and crossing straps, with no moulded chest plate and no cartridge band.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A strapless bandeau band wrapped around the chest, with a wavy upper edge and layered ridged folds across the back. An hourglass-shaped contrasting emblem sits at the centre front; arms and midriff stay uncovered by the piece.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the hourglass-shaped centre patch.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The male band has a wavier top edge and stacked ridged layers across the back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A sleeveless, corset-style vest with sculpted shoulder plates and a high plated neckline with small round studs. A long narrow tabard panel hangs from the waist down the front to mid-shin, with a tapered, ornate end.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plates, neckline and waist band; colour 1 on the corset body and the centre of the tabard; colour 2 on the tabard side panels and top; colour 3 on the corset lines and the tabard tip motif.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.differs: The male version has structured shoulder plates and a plated collar with round studs, with no loose ring or crossed lacing.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Mutated_01.description: A bulky, organic mutated top made of twisting, fleshy ridges and swollen bulges, with contrasting horn-like spikes jutting from the shoulders and back. It has puffy elbow-length sleeves and ends cropped at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy body and sleeves; colour 1 on the bulbous growths and small spines; colour 2 on the pods and sockets; colour 0 on the large horn spikes.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Padding_01.description: A partial torso armor made of separate rounded padded plates: broad chest and shoulder-front pads, small collar tabs at the neck, and a row of segmented pads across the abdomen and ribs, worn over the bodysuit.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Padding_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar tabs and the lighter portions of the chest and abdomen pads; colour 1 on the main upper section of each pad; colour 2 on the darker panels of the chest pads; colour 3 on the small abdomen pads.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Padding_01.differs: The male version has broader, flatter chest plates that nearly meet in the middle and cover more of the upper torso, with a denser abdomen cluster.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Patriot_01.description: A partial harness-style chest layer: a high rounded collar ring at the neck with a small button, and two thin looping bands that arc over the shoulders, ending in buckled tabs on the chest. A separate panel sits on the upper back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main harness bands and shoulder loops; colour 1 on the collar; colour 3 on the button, buckle tabs and small studs; colour 2 on the back panel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A sleeveless, fitted pirate-style vest with large open lapels edged in studded trim, a button strip down each front edge, and a hem dipping to a point at the front. Ends at the waist over the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the lapel facings and button strips; colour 2 on the studded lapel edging; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Pirate_Fancy_01.differs: The male vest has broad, large lapels that open wide across the chest, showing more of the contrasting facing.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A partial chest layer of overlapping, jagged glossy shards forming a cracked, crest-like plate over the chest and upper back, with pointed spikes at the shoulders and claw-like tips hanging over the lower ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: The default material is glossy metallic and ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slot is clearly visible on the shards.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The male version is a single fused mass of jagged shards with no separate bust cups and no distinct colour accents, unlike the female version.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Pumpkin_01.description: A skeletal ribcage overlay with slim curved ribs wrapping the torso, a visible spine down the back, a collar of small bones, and two sculpted shoulder caps joined by a central chest knot. Macabre, undead look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spine, collarbones and rib ends; colour 1 on the shoulder caps; colour 2 on the ribs; colour 3 on the central chest knot.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Renegade_Shirt_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped tank-style shirt worn over the chest, with a wide scooped neckline, contrasting binding at the neck and armholes, and a ragged, torn hem that ends above the midriff.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Renegade_Shirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shirt body; colour 1 on the lower hem area; colour 2 on the neckline binding; colour 3 on the armhole edging.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Renegade_Shirt_02.description: A sleeveless cropped cloth vest worn over the chest, with wide armholes, a scooped neckline and a jagged, torn lower hem. Its ragged edge gives a scavenged, rebellious sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Renegade_Shirt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper body of the vest; colour 1 on the lower hem area, fading in from the upper part. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Renegade_Vest_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped biker-style vest with wide notched lapels and a tall open collar, rows of pyramid studs down the front and back, diagonal zips at the hips, and jagged ragged edges at the armholes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Renegade_Vest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body and lapels; colour 1 on the jagged armhole edging and the frayed inner panel; colour 2 on the zips; colour 3 on the pyramid studs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A sleeveless mechanical armoured chest piece with a tall open collar, bulky angular plates over the chest and shoulders, glowing vent panels on the front and back, and a segmented corset-like band at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and front chest plates; colour 2 on the main torso shell; colour 1 on the shoulder caps and lower waist band; colour 3 on the vent panels.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A short, bulky armored chest piece covering the chest and upper back, with a tall open collar ring, raised vented shoulder fins, split front plates with a star emblem, and a rear spine panel; retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar trim and central front band; colour 1 on the front chest plates and fin vents; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder housings and back plates; colour 3 on the lower chest edging and the rear spine panel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Rocker_01.description: A long-sleeved open-front jacket with a tall, jagged flared collar and a hem cut into pointed, tattered tails at hip to thigh length. Outlined edges, stitched-looking studded accents and a small emblem on the back give a gothic rocker look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jacket body and sleeves; colour 2 on the outlined edges and trim along the collar, front opening and hem; colour 3 on the shoulder spikes, dangling drops and dotted accents; colour 1 on the emblem on the back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Samurai_01.description: A samurai-style plate cuirass worn over the torso: a shaped chest plate with a round central jewel, a single large angular shoulder guard on one side, and stacked lamellar bands across the belly and back, all decorated with swirling scrollwork.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and shoulder guard; colour 1 on the thin edge trim; colour 2 on the recessed band panels and side straps; colour 3 on the swirl patterns and the central jewel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_01.description: A short-sleeved, cropped armored chest layer with large rounded shoulder plates, ribbed vent panels across the chest, side slats, and a tapering centre plate with a badge-like front emblem, ending at the ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, shoulders and back plate; colour 2 on the ribbed vent panels; colour 1 on the front centre plate and its outline; colour 3 on the shield-shaped inset.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_01.differs: The male version has bulkier, larger shoulder pads and flatter chest vent panels instead of separate bust cups.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_02.description: A sleeveless mechanical chest plate: a rounded shell covers the chest and shoulders with a small raised badge, over a contrasting band and a pointed lower plate that drops down the abdomen. Sci-fi armour look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest shell and back plate; colour 1 on the lower abdomen plate; colour 2 on the band between the plates; colour 3 on the raised chest and abdomen badges.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Scales_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting chest layer vest ending at the waist, with a central segmented plated panel, wide shoulder panels, curved side panels and a small vertical side strip. It suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Scales_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central chest and back panel and the collar edge; colour 2 on the upper shoulder panels; colour 1 on the large side panels; colour 3 on the vertical strips at the sides. The two small glossy spots at the collar are highlights.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Scarab_01.description: A sleeveless armoured chest piece with a broad shell, raised shoulder flares and curved claw-like spikes on the chest, over segmented layered plates around the ribs and back; ends at the ribs with a chevron plate at the front.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest shell and shoulder flares; colour 3 on the claw spikes and centre gem; colour 2 on the lower rib plates and spike edges; colour 1 on the front chevron and the upper back plate.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Scarab_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, pectoral-style shell without bust cups, and the claw spikes sit more upright on the chest.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Scarab_02.description: A beetle-inspired armored chest layer: broad segmented plates over the chest, shoulders and upper back, a ribbed abdomen plate, rib-like claws along the ribs, and long swept horn spikes rising from the shoulders.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer chest and back plates and the shoulder horns; colour 2 on the glossy central chest panels; colour 1 on the abdomen plate and the curved side blades; colour 3 on the rib claws and horn tips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Scarab_02.differs: The male version has larger, bulkier shoulder plates that cover more of the upper chest, with rib claws on both sides.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Shirt_Anniversary_Witc.description: A long-sleeved, waist-length wrap-front top with a crossed kimono-style neckline edged in piping and flared, slightly bell-shaped cuffs; the sleeves fade into a contrasting shade toward the wrists. Casual, retro-mystic look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Shirt_Anniversary_Witc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body and upper sleeves; colour 1 on the lower sleeves and cuffs, blending in as a gradient; colour 3 on the piping along the neckline and collar edge; colour 2 on the small cuff edging.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Shirt_Goth_02.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting scoop-neck tank top worn over the torso, ending at the waist with a slightly flared hem. Soft cloth with a subtle centre back seam gives a casual, gothic layering look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Shirt_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper body of the tank; colour 1 on the lower hem band, blending in as a gradient.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Shirt_Ripped_01.description: A long-sleeved, hip-length button-up detective shirt with wide lapels, a contrasting inner front panel, small buttons and contrasting cuffs. The wrinkled cloth has a pointed hem and a faint torn patch on the upper arm.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Shirt_Ripped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt body and sleeves; colour 1 on the lower sleeves as a fading gradient; colour 2 on the inner lapel panel, collar and cuffs; colour 3 on the buttons.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Shirt_Secret_04.description: A plain sleeveless tank top with a deep V neckline and wide armholes, fitted over the chest and torso. It ends at the waist with a slightly gathered hem, for a simple everyday casual look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Shirt_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tank top; the slight shading toward the hem is only lighting, with no separate trim.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Shirt_Secret_04.differs: The male version has a sharper V neckline and a shorter, slightly gathered straight hem that sits higher on the torso.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Snowball_01.description: Two separate fabric strap loops that run over the shoulders and around the upper chest and back, each with a small mechanical clip housing at the front. Reads as a light harness worn over a bodysuit.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Snowball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap loops; colour 1 on the clip housings; colour 2 on the housing edges and fittings.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted cuirass vest with a muscle-molded front and back, contrasting edge trim, a V-shaped front seam, and small strapped side closures. Padded shoulder caps with round emblems sit on top; it ends at the ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main breastplate and back; colour 1 on the edge trim and V seam; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and side straps; colour 3 on the round shoulder emblems.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_03.description: A sleeveless, cropped Spartan-style chest piece hugging the torso, with a large sculpted lion-face medallion over the chest, Greek-key patterned borders, padded shoulder caps and contrasting side straps at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main torso body; colour 1 on the lion medallion and the edge trim; colour 2 on the shoulder caps and side straps; colour 3 on the lion's eyes, the shoulder studs and the Greek-key pattern.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Spartanarmor_03.differs: The lion medallion is larger and covers more of one side of the chest, wrapping toward the shoulder.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Spikysuit_01.description: A bulky, sleeveless vest of layered bone-like armor with ridged, chevron-shaped ribbing across the chest and back, knobby small spikes, a rolled collar at the neck and heavy shoulder mounds.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shell and ridges; colour 1 on the ribbed striping between the ridges.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Spikysuit_01.differs: The male version is a full bulky vest covering chest, back and shoulders with small knobby spikes, unlike the female strapless corset with tall spikes and a flared hem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Steelarachnid_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length armoured vest with a high flared collar, broad angular chest plates outlined in contrasting trim, segmented overlapping ab plates, and a ribbed spine column down the back with etched crack details.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body and collar; colour 2 on the trim outlines and ab plate edges; colour 3 on the spine column and small accent lights; colour 1 on the etched back marks.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Steelarachnid_01.differs: The male version has broad, flat angular chest plates, while the female has two rounded spider-eye shaped chest cutouts.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Steelcommando_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted armored torso piece with a high pointed collar, muscular chest plates, overlapping segmented ribbed panels down the abdomen, and bulky shoulder-hugging side plates; it ends at the waist. A shield-shaped emblem sits on the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the collar, chest centre, abdomen ribbing and lower back panel; colour 0 on the chest plates; colour 2 on the side and rib armor plates; colour 3 on the outline of the back emblem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, muscular chest plate and bulkier shoulder plates, where the female version has separately molded bust cups.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Strapped_01.description: A cross-strapped chest harness: flat studded straps run over the shoulders and cross on the back, meeting at a round central medallion with an atom emblem ringed by small spikes. Sits over the chest as a partial layer.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and medallion rim; colour 1 on the atom emblem and strap edge piping; colour 2 on the medallion housing; colour 3 on the spikes and strap buckle tabs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Super_Retro_Destroyer_.description: A sleeveless retro-superhero armoured vest with two large rounded chest plates studded with small diamond spikes, broad shoulder caps, a segmented torso panel and a thick waist band; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Super_Retro_Destroyer_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates; colour 1 on the segmented torso panel; colour 3 on the diamond studs; colour 2 on the shoulder caps, back and waist band, which look glossy metallic.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Super_Retro_Destroyer_.differs: The male version has contrasting chest plates over a contrasting segmented torso and a plain waist band, without the hanging front pouch panel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Suspender_Ruler_01.description: A pair of wide, scale-embossed suspender straps that run over the shoulders and hang to the mid-torso, front and back, each strap ending in a small tip. Spiky crown-shaped tabs sit at the shoulder tops.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Suspender_Ruler_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the straps; colour 2 on the spiky shoulder tabs and the strap tips.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Swimsuit_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped sports-style top with a rounded neckline and wide armholes, with contrasting binding around the neck, armholes and hem. It sits snug over the chest and ends above the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Swimsuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper body of the top, fading into colour 1 toward the hem; colour 2 on the neckline, armhole and hem binding.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Swing_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped top with thin looped straps over the shoulders, a glossy V-shaped neckline panel and contrasting V-shaped side panels. It sits high on the torso with a banded hem above the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the top and the centre V; colour 1 on the side panels and hem band; colour 2 on the glossy neckline panel; colour 3 on the shoulder straps.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Swing_01.differs: The male top is a shorter, cropped cut with a wide open back, while the female version reaches the waist.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Teddy_01.description: A plush, fluffy long-sleeved teddy-bear jacket with shaggy fur texture, a contrasting furry collar, two large round sewn-on buttons down the front, and ragged fringed hem and cuffs. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body and sleeves; colour 2 on the collar; colour 1 on the buttons and the fringe along the bottom hem; colour 3 on the fringe at the cuffs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Alien_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped armored chest layer with a wide shoulder collar, a V-shaped layered breastplate with a gem-like central ornament, and large ribbed panels wrapping over the upper arms; ends above the waist. Sci-fi alien styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shoulder collar; colour 0 on the layered breastplate and back plate; colour 1 on the ribbed arm panels; colour 3 on the central chest ornament.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Alien_01.differs: The male version has larger ribbed panels that wrap over the outside of the upper arms, and a more open collar.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ammo_Bandolier_0.description: A diagonal bandolier strap worn over one shoulder and across the chest to the opposite hip, lined with rows of pointed bullet-like cartridges on both edges, with a small buckle plate at the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ammo_Bandolier_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strap band; colour 3 on the edge trim and piping; colour 1 on the cartridge bases; colour 2 on the cartridge tips.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ancient_01.description: A partial ancient-style chest armor: a sculpted front breastplate with raised ridges and swirling engraved patterns, rounded shoulder caps, and stacked banded ribs wrapping the torso, joined by a spiral-marked back plate and straps.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ancient_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the breastplate and shoulder caps; colour 1 on the engraved swirl patterns and ridge lines; colour 2 on the recessed shading in the ridges; colour 3 on the rib bands and back plate.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Anniversary_Defe.description: A short, bulky armoured chest piece with a raised collar ring, angular segmented plates across the chest and back, ribbed side accents and large open shoulder cups; it ends above the waist in a jagged lower edge, in a retro superhero style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Anniversary_Defe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest and back plates; colour 1 on the inner collar; colour 2 on the lower plates and shoulder undersides; colour 3 on the ribbed side accents.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Anniversary_Defe.differs: The male version has larger, deeper shoulder cups and a jagged, spiky lower edge instead of the smooth rounded bust shape.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A V-shaped chest plate with a pointed lower tip, a raised rim and a jagged notched upper edge, sitting across the upper chest and shoulders. The same shape shows on the back. Suggests a sleek superhero emblem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the raised jagged upper edge; colour 2 on the outer rim and border.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Archer_01.description: A short-sleeved, snug jacket layer ending at the waist, with a vertical row of buckled straps down the centre front, a contrasting band wrapping across the upper back, and ragged cut hems at the sleeves and waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jacket body and lower hem; colour 1 on the side panels and front straps; colour 2 on the chest panels and the band across the back; colour 3 on the sleeve bands.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Archer_01.differs: The male version has bands on the sleeves that take colour 3, and the front straps run in a single tidy row down the centre rather than crossing an open front.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting chest layer with a raised collar rim, a central vertical panel with two round port-like studs, and cracked-looking segmented plates across the back and shoulders. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body, shoulders and back plating; colour 1 on the central front panel; colour 3 on the scratch-like markings and rings around the studs; colour 2 on the shoulder edge trim.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armadillo_01.differs: The male version has a multi-plate segmented back and larger rounded shoulder plates, rather than a single pointed back plate.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.description: A sleeveless mechanical chest and shoulder armor: rounded, segmented plates cover the chest, shoulders and upper back, with open ring-like shoulder cutouts, a raised collar flange, and a ribbed flexible panel running down the sternum and spine.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and collar; colour 1 on the ribbed sternum and spine panel; colour 2 on the darker collar gap and shading beneath the plates.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Covertmili.description: A light tech chest armour plate worn over the torso: a smooth front shell with a central seam, an overlapping segmented abdomen guard, a ribbed vented back plate and a raised plate over one shoulder. Ends at the midriff.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Covertmili.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest shell and plates; colour 1 on the shoulder vents, side inserts and accent markings; colour 2 on the inner gaps and shadowed recesses.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Covertmili.differs: The male version has a flatter, squarer chest shell with a larger, more prominent shoulder plate, without the sculpted breast shaping.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Cybermind_.description: A sleeveless, cropped sci-fi armor vest with rounded shoulder caps and a wide V-shaped collar band. It has circuit-line accents, oval lights on the shoulders, and a boxy sensor module with small knobs on the upper back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Cybermind_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest shell and back module; colour 2 on the collar band; colour 1 on the circuit lines and shoulder ovals.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Cybermind_.differs: The male version has a plain, broad chest with no bust sculpting, a wider collar loop, and a longer, more even hem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Gladiators.description: A sleeveless armoured chest harness: a segmented plated vest with a round central emblem disc, diagonal shoulder straps that cross at the front and back, and banded ribbed plates around the midsection. It ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armor_Gladiators.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chest plates and the rim edging; colour 1 on the shoulder straps and the banded plate segments; colour 2 on the recessed gaps between plates and the back straps; colour 3 on the accent bands at the ribs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A sleeveless tactical armor vest with a smooth moulded chest plate, small shoulder caps, a segmented spine plate on the back, and a strapped waist belt carrying four small pouches. Sits over the torso and ends at the ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate and back armour; colour 1 on the shoulder caps, small chest tabs and belt bands; colour 2 on the pouches; colour 3 on the pouch emblems.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_01.differs: The male vest has a flatter, broader chest plate and pouches grouped in two pairs at the front of the belt.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_02.description: A sleeveless sci-fi armoured chest piece: a molded breastplate with a high open neckline, segmented plates down the abdomen, contrasting ribbed side panels and a segmented spine strip on the back. Sits over the torso, ending at the ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main breastplate and abdomen plates; colour 1 on the neck accents, chest and spine inserts; colour 2 on the ribbed side and back panels; colour 3 on the small vent marks at the sides.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorviper_02.differs: The male version has a flat, squared breastplate with a stepped lower abdomen plate, and the ribbed contrasting panel is larger on one side.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorvipergrenad.description: A tech chest plate with a broad angular shell, ribbed back plate and shoulder guards, worn over the torso with a strapped belt of grenade canisters at the waist and columns of grenades mounted across the chest.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorvipergrenad.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest shell and back plate; colour 1 on the shoulder trim, straps, belt bands and small square tabs; colour 2 on the grenade bodies; colour 3 on the grenade caps.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armorvipergrenad.differs: The male version has three grenades mounted in a column on each side of the chest, while the female has only a few near the collar.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armourbluejay_01.description: A cropped, sleeveless armoured vest with a bulky chest, rounded shoulder caps, a separate upper back yoke with ragged edges and a flared lower plate at the waist, suggesting tactical body armour.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armourbluejay_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest and back panels; colour 3 on the vertical centre chest panel; colour 2 on the shoulder and upper back yoke; colour 0 on the lower plate.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Armourbluejay_01.differs: The male vest has a large colour 3 centre chest panel and a separate colour 2 shoulder yoke, whereas the female version is mostly colour 0 with thin colour 1 trim.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombie_.description: Layered cloth bandage wrap: stacked horizontal bands cover the lower chest and ribs, with a wide strip crossing diagonally over one shoulder. Worn over the torso with a tattered, mummy-like look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombie_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bandage wraps and shoulder strip; colour 1 on the shaded folds and edges between the layers.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombie_.differs: The male wrap has a taller stack of bands covering the lower chest and ribs, with the diagonal strip lying over the pectoral.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombie_.description: A sleeveless wrap of layered cloth bandage strips crossing over the chest and shoulders in a halter-like X, with stacked horizontal bands around the midriff. It ends at the waist, giving a ragged, mummy-like look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombie_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bandage strips; colour 2 on the thin edge lines and gaps between the strips. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Basic_01.description: A sleeveless, skin-tight torso layer that hugs the chest, back and abs, with a rounded neckline and open armholes. It ends at the waist and reads as a plain, sleek base layer.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole torso layer.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.description: A cropped, sleeveless chest piece of thick hide-like armor: sculpted pec panels, rounded shoulder caps, a puffy wrinkled collar ring around the neck and a separate lower band ending at the ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulder and back panels; colour 3 on the wrinkled neck collar; colour 1 on the lower midriff band and shading in the folds.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Birdarmor_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length chest plate with a raised rim around the neck, a central round gem, and layered feather-like plates across the chest. Open ring-shaped shoulder loops sit at the sides, giving a mechanical, avian armor look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Birdarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate body and neck collar; colour 1 on the layered feather plates and the small lower chest panel; colour 2 on the edge trim and shoulder rings; colour 3 on the central gem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Blackpaldin_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting vest-like tunic that hugs the torso with sculpted muscle folds, a wide scooped neckline and open armholes; it ends at the waist and reads as a simple layered tight top.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Blackpaldin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tunic; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A short, cropped chest plate armor piece covering the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, with a wide neck opening, a faceted lower chest panel and two round mechanical canisters with slotted centres on the chest.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 1 on the faceted lower chest panel; colour 2 on the canister housings and neck lining; colour 3 on the canister slot lights.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A compact mechanical chest armour: a domed front plate with a small emblem, angular side panels, a pointed V-shaped lower guard with flared wing-like side fins, and a back of hexagonal plates forming a spider-like spine pattern.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate and flared side guards; colour 1 on the side panels, V-shaped centre and hexagonal back plates; colour 2 on the recessed edges and gaps; colour 3 on the emblem and small stud lights.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Blockbuster_02.differs: The male version has larger flared side fins and a spidery, spiked back plate pattern instead of a compact wrapped back plate.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_01.description: A short, rigid mechanical shoulder-and-chest plate covering the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, with a large ring fixture at the centre and hex bolts studded below and at the sides. Retro superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the ring and bolts; colour 2 on the inner neck opening.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_01.differs: The male plate is a broader, smoother cape-like yoke that drapes over the shoulders, with its bolts placed in a tidy row below the ring.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_02.description: A short, close-fitting shoulder and upper-chest layer with broad rounded capped shoulders and a scooped neckline. The lower edge has a shallow angular notch across the chest and back, ending above the pecs. Retro superhero armour look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole piece; a thin edge line at the cut borders shows contrasting trim. Colour 1 shows as a soft tint in the shadowed back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Bronzeking_02.differs: The male version has a shallower, simpler lower edge with a single shallow notch and sits higher across the chest.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A set of wide crossing straps forming a harness that loops over one shoulder and across the chest and back, studded with rivets and fastened by small buckles with lacing at the front. No cloth beneath.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 3 on the rivets; colour 1 on the lacing at the front; colour 2 on the buckle hardware.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The male version is only crossing harness straps with no gathered cloth wrap across the chest.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A one-shoulder armored cap covering the shoulder and upper chest and back, with a smooth rounded plate over the front, held by wide crossing straps with rivets and small buckles at the chest.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and the front plate; colour 1 on the shoulder cap panels and lower chest section; colour 3 on the top shoulder panel and strap rivets; colour 2 on the back panel sections.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Brutal_02.differs: The male version adds a solid armored shoulder cap and plate under the straps, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chains_01.description: A loop of heavy chain slung diagonally across the torso from one shoulder to the opposite hip, wrapped in two or three overlapping strands. Sits over the chest and back as a bandolier-style accessory.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 in the gaps between the links. Colours 0 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chains_02.description: A pair of heavy chain loops crossing in an X over the chest and back, running over the shoulders and under the arms like a bandolier harness. Worn over the torso as an open, partial accessory.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chains_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 on the gaps between links; colours 0 and 3 not visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_01.description: A sleeveless plate cuirass with a broad, barrel-shaped chest, embossed chevron ridges and a fleur-de-lis emblem on the front and back. Buckled straps at the shoulders and sides hold it on; it ends at the ribs with open armholes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate; colour 3 on the lower plate, blended in a gradient; colour 2 on the buckled straps.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_01.differs: The male plate has a fleur-de-lis emblem on the upper chest as well as the back, and a plain, broad chest instead of a moulded bust shape.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_Drayc.description: A short armored chest plate with a large sculpted skull on the front, a tongue-like lobe hanging below, and smooth rounded plates over the chest and shoulders. Trim outlines every edge; it ends at the ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_Drayc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates front and back; colour 1 on the edge trim and shoulder edges; colour 2 on the skull and straps; colour 3 on the skull's eyes and the hanging lobe.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Chestplate_Drayc.differs: The male plate is a smooth, unbroken shell without bust cups or buckled side bands, and its back plate is plain.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Back_Furba.description: A cluster of long, sharp, faceted spines fanning out across the upper back and over the tops of the shoulders, like a jagged spiky mantle. It sits at the base of the neck and suits monstrous or sci-fi looks.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Back_Furba.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all of the spines; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Back_Furba.description: A small cluster of long, jagged spines fanning out across the upper back and shoulders, with a smaller matching tuft at the front of the collarbone. A spiky, monstrous accent that sits over the upper chest and back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Back_Furba.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all the spines; the spines show no other colour slots.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Front_Furb.description: A cluster of long, sharp spines fanning downward and outward across the upper chest below the collarbones, like a spiky ruff or chest fringe. It is a small partial overlay with an aggressive, mechanical look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Child_Front_Furb.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all the spines; no other slots are visible on this piece.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_.description: A sleeveless mechanical armor cuirass with overlapping angular plates across the chest and shoulders, a pointed central sternum plate, and a banded belt with a lower point. The back shows a panel with contrasting plates and a small central inset.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plates, sternum, belt band and lower point; colour 1 on the torso panels and back; colour 2 on the shoulder plates and gaps; colour 3 on the small central strip and back inset.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_.differs: The male version has a pointed sternum plate, layered contrasting shoulder plates and a contrasting accent on the back, with a flatter chest than the female.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Clown_02.description: A puffy-sleeved shirt with a sleeveless vest layered over the torso. The vest has a deep open V neckline with criss-cross lacing and contrasting edging. Full balloon sleeves gather at the wrists, and a fitted band sits at the waist. Playful, costume-like style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Clown_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the puffy sleeves and waist band; colour 2 on the vest edging and neckline trim; colour 3 on the front lacing.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length button-up military-style vest with squared shoulder caps, chevron badges, two flap pockets at the hem, a cobra emblem on the back and a row of three spikes on one shoulder.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body and pocket flaps; colour 1 on the shoulder cap edge and thin seam piping; colour 2 on the chevrons and back cobra emblem; colour 3 on the buttons and shoulder spikes.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_02.description: A sleeveless, cropped open vest with wide flared shoulder flaps and a high back, worn over the torso. Stitched seams and small buttons trim the front, and flap pockets with strap tabs sit low on both sides. It has a mechanical, militaristic look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the stitched seam lines; colour 2 on the strap tabs on the pockets; colour 3 on the small buttons.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cobralordvest_02.differs: The male vest has distinct flap pockets on the lower front with strap tabs, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Corset_01.description: A short, snug corset that wraps the midsection from the lower chest to the waist, with a front lace-up of criss-crossed cords through eyelets, thin contrasting edge trim and a peaked upper back edge.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Corset_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the corset body; colour 3 on the front lacing; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the eyelets.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Corset_01.differs: The male corset has a straighter, boxier shape and a peaked top edge at the centre of the back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowl_Wide_01.description: A wide, flat cape-like cowl collar that drapes over the shoulders and upper chest in a rounded fan shape, with a small neck opening and a broad patterned border band along the hem. Its ends flare outward past the shoulders.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowl_Wide_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cowl body; colour 1 and colour 3 on the patterned border band; colour 2 on the edge piping and neck opening lining.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowl_Wide_01.differs: The male cowl extends further over the shoulders, with flared ends that leave a visible hollow underside.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowlflair_01.description: A sculpted cowl-like shoulder and chest piece: a broad V-shaped panel with pointed flares sweeping up at each shoulder and an open neck hole, covering upper chest and upper back and tapering to a point on the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowlflair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel with a fading gradient to darker tones toward the top; colour 1 on the thin edge trim and the inner lining.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cowlflair_01.differs: The male version's shoulder flares are shorter and sweep outward more, with a wider, deeper front panel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A cropped cloth capelet-style shoulder layer with a round neck opening, covering the upper chest, shoulders and upper back. It has an asymmetric, angled hem with contrasting edge trim and two small tabs with tiny lights on the front and back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body; colour 1 on the edge trim along the hem and sleeve edge; colour 2 on the tab housings; colour 3 on the small lights on the tabs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: A cropped, armoured cyberpunk chest piece with a high stand-up collar, bulky padded shoulder plates with vent-like slots, a centre zip line and ribbed lower panels; it ends at the ribs and has small ammo-like cells on the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the collar, shoulder plates and chest panels; colour 0 on the ribbed lower band and inner panels; colour 2 on the zip line and slots; colour 3 on the thin chest accent lines.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.description: A cyborg chest armor with a bulky segmented pectoral plate, a contrasting shoulder yoke, a central round gem, and a raised rectangular block on the upper back. A separate belt band with an oval panel sits at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest plate, back block and oval belt panel; colour 2 on the shoulder yoke and lower chest and back plates; colour 0 on the belt band and side trim; colour 3 on the chest and back gems.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.differs: The male version has a large segmented pectoral plate covering more of the chest and adds a raised rectangular block with a gem on the upper back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_02.description: A sleeveless light cyborg armour vest: a raised shoulder-and-chest plate with open neck, segmented mid-torso plates with small studs, and a banded waist belt joined to the chest by exposed cables. The back is a wide zigzag-edged plate.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper chest and shoulder plate and the lower belly panel; colour 0 on the mid-torso plates and waist band; colour 2 on the cables and the inner side and back panels; colour 3 on the studs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Cyborgarmor_02.differs: The male version has a fuller, boxier back plate with a jagged zigzag lower edge and more coverage at the sides, rather than the open cut-away back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_01.description: A rigid, angular armored cowl that sits over the shoulders and upper chest. It has a wide open neck, a V-shaped front dropping to a small pointed plate, and a raised back panel with thin contrasting trim lines.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cowl shell; colour 3 on the thin trim lines along the edges and panel outlines; colour 2 on the inner underside of the collar.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_Update_.description: A partial mechanical collar-yoke that drapes over the neck, shoulders and upper chest, with a raised rim, a V-shaped front plate with round port details and segmented angular panels; the back forms a short flared flap.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_Update_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, front plate and back flap; colour 1 on the panel edges and inner lining; colour 2 on the segmented side panels; colour 3 on small marks at the back of the collar.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Defender_Update_.differs: The male version spreads wider over the shoulders with a larger front plate and a broader back flap.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A sleeveless segmented chest armor vest with two rounded chest plates, separate shoulder guards, a ribbed lower torso panel and a detached waist band. Riveted panels with a rim edge give a sci-fi, battle-armor look over the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edging, the inner lining and the back centre panel; colour 1 on the main armor plates, the shoulder plates and the waist band.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A sleeveless sci-fi armored chest rig: a molded plate shell over the torso and shoulders, open armholes with segmented contrasting side panels, padded centre pod, a plated waist band and a ridged spine plate on the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer chest shell, shoulder plates and waist band; colour 1 on the padded centre, back spine plate and inner accent panels; colour 2 on the side panels and underarm segments; colour 3 on the small centre lights.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_01.differs: The male version has a broader boxy chest shell with a flatter front and a waist band sitting close beneath the chest pod.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_02.description: A sleeveless sci-fi power-armor vest of chunky rounded plates over the chest and shoulders, with open arm holes, segmented ribbed panels at the sides and a separate banded waist plate with a triangular emblem. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Dharmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer chest, shoulder and back plates and the waist band; colour 0 on the inner side and shoulder panels; colour 2 on the centre chest plate, ribbed panels, back panel and lower waist plate.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Eagle_Drka_01.description: A cropped shoulder-and-collar armor piece with a raised open collar, a V-shaped front plate and wide winged shoulder caps. Back panels are layered like feathers, with contrasting inner lining at the neckline; sits over the upper chest and shoulders.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Eagle_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, front plate and upper feather layers; colour 1 on the shoulder tips and the lower feather panels across the back; colour 2 on the inner neckline lining and the round front discs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Eclipse_01.description: A partial mechanical chest and shoulder layer of bat-wing-like armored panels with curved contrasting claw spikes, joined by a V-shaped yoke to a segmented ornate plate down the sternum; it wraps over the shoulders and upper back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Eclipse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame, edging and central sternum plate; colour 1 on the wing-like panel inserts; colour 2 on the curved spikes and accents; colour 3 on the small central gem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Egyptian_Beads_0.description: A broad Egyptian-style beaded collar in concentric rings of tiny beads, fanning out over the shoulders and upper chest with a rounded scalloped outer edge; sits flat around the neck like a wide necklace.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Egyptian_Beads_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer bead rows; colour 1 on the inner wide band of beads; colour 2 on the band between; colour 3 on the accent beads along the outer edge.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Electric_01.description: A sleeveless chest armour vest of segmented plates with a raised padded collar ring, a large round energy-coil emblem at the sternum, thick ribbed cables looping around the sides and over the shoulders, and boxy vented pods on the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the collar ring and under-plate; colour 3 on the central emblem disc and thin trim lines; colour 2 on the cables and back pods.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Electric_01.differs: The male version has the cable loops rising up and over the shoulders, and the front plate ends in a broader point.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Fantasy_01.description: A short-sleeved, waist-length fantasy tunic with a open V-front, swirling scrollwork embroidery on the chest panels, a contrasting neckline band studded with round beads, and trimmed sleeve hems; loose over the shoulders.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tunic body; colour 1 on the neckline band, front edging and sleeve cuffs; colour 3 on the beads around the collar; colour 2 on the scroll embroidery.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Frontspikes_01.description: A neat grid of small conical metal spikes across the upper chest and pecs, angled outward in three loose rows. Sits directly on the torso as a punk or mechanical accent.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Frontspikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Frontspikes_01.differs: The male spikes form a more regular three-by-three grid across the flat of the chest, rather than following the curve of the bust.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Furback_01.description: A shaggy fur cowl and mantle of jagged, feather-like tufts that ring the neck, spread across the shoulders and taper into a point down the chest and upper back. It suggests a wild, barbaric look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Furback_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur tufts; colour 0 on the fur near the neck and along the centre of the chest and back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Furback_01.differs: The male version's fur spreads wider across the shoulders and forms a fuller, thicker collar ring, with a shorter point down the chest.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Furboth_01.description: A shaggy fur mantle of jagged, feather-like tufts draped over the shoulders, collar, upper chest and upper back, tapering to a point down the centre of both chest and back. Wild, primal look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Furboth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur tufts; colour 0 on the lighter fur at the neck and along the central strip.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Furfront_01.description: A small V-shaped tuft of jagged, shard-like fur tufts lying flat across the upper chest and collarbone, with spiky points fanning down toward the sternum and out over the shoulders. Suits a wild or superhero look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Furfront_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner centre of the tuft; colour 1 on the outer tips and edges; colour 2 on the underside seen from behind.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A short armored midsection band that wraps the waist and lower ribs, curving up into two raised side wings over the obliques with shallow scooped notches at front and back. Thin contrasting trim edges the rim.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor shell; colour 1 on the inner surface; colour 0 on the thin trim along the rim.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_01.differs: The male version has broader, rounder side wings with shallower scooped notches, and it lacks the deep V front cut of the female version.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_02.description: A sleeveless, fitted chest layer with a wide flared collar that sweeps up into two pointed wing-like tips at the shoulders, tapering to a V over the torso and ending in a separate plated band at the waist. Thin trim edges the outline.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the piece and the raised rim of the waist band; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the collar and V panel; colour 2 on the waist band plate.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_02.differs: The male version has a thicker, separate armor-like waist band with a raised rim, rather than the smooth lighter band on the female.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_03.description: A boxy two-part armor cuirass: a rounded-square upper shell with a neck opening, big open arm holes and a front emblem, above a separate curved lower belly plate. Slotted vents and thin trim lines suggest mechanical sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Gadroon_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor shells; colour 1 on the thin trim lines along the edges; colour 3 on the front emblem; colour 2 on the vent slots.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Grenadestrap_01.description: A diagonal bandolier strap looping from one shoulder across the chest and back to the opposite hip, studded with rows of small cylindrical grenades in contrasting clips, with a small square tab at the shoulder.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Grenadestrap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap; colour 1 on the grenade bodies; colour 3 on the shoulder tab and grenade bands; colour 2 on the clips.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Grenadestrap_02.description: A single flat bandolier-style strap forming a closed loop that runs diagonally from one shoulder across the chest and back, with a small boxy fastener at the shoulder. Suits tactical or military looks.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Grenadestrap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band; colour 3 on the small shoulder fastener.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A cropped plate-armor chest piece with a raised stand-up collar, a central segmented breastplate and a round gem at the throat. Carved scroll-pattern panels wrap over the pecs, shoulders and upper back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and collar rim; colour 1 on the recessed scroll inlays and border lines; colour 2 on the collar lining and the round centre stud; colour 3 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hipan_01.differs: The male version has flatter chest plates without bust cups and broader, squarer shoulder coverage.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A partial chest harness of layered angular armor plates: shell-like pieces over the chest with a round central opening, shoulder straps and fins, a rib band, and a segmented spine strip down the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main chest and upper-back plates; colour 0 on the shoulder straps, rib band and spine segments; colour 3 on the front chest accents; colour 2 on the inner lining and spine gaps.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The male version is solid opaque plating that takes the colour slots, while the female version is a glowing translucent energy material.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A partial chest-layer overlay of flat, angular hexagonal facets forming a peaked triangular cluster on the upper chest, with small detached hex tiles at the edges and a matching patch across the upper back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: The whole piece shows as one bright tone, which appears to be colour 0; no other slots are visible.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Holohex_01.differs: The male version forms a compact peaked triangle on the chest with a matching triangular patch on the back, rather than a wide low arch.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.description: A partial set of jagged bone-like spikes scattered across the upper and mid back, each on a small base plate, in loose columns along the spine and over the shoulder blades. Suggests a monstrous, skeletal look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the small base plates behind each spike.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.differs: The spikes are spread widely as separate small clusters across the back, without the female version's continuous ridge down the spine.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.description: A ring of long bone-like spikes around the neck and shoulders, with a line of smaller jagged spines down the centre of the back and a few small shards down the chest. Worn over the torso as a monstrous accent.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the trim edging at the base of each spike.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.differs: The male version has larger, more crowded spikes around the shoulders and neck, with a shorter, sparser spine line down the back.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_04.description: A loose ring of small bone-like spikes and curved blades set around the collarbone and upper chest, with larger flared fins near each shoulder. Each spike has a contrasting edge; suits a monstrous or tribal look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main spike surfaces; colour 3 on the edge trim along each spike base.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hornsmonster_04.differs: The male version has fewer, more widely spaced spikes, with a cluster of larger blades at the shoulders and only a short central spike.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hoses_0.description: A bulky mechanical chest armour shell covering torso front and back, with rounded plates, a raised collar frame, ribbed segment panels at the waist, and flexible hoses looping around the ribs and over the shoulders.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Hoses_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised plate edges and back spine panel; colour 1 on the outer rim frames, collar and waist band; colour 2 on the main chest and back plates; colour 3 on the hoses.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Martial_P.description: A long-sleeved, loose-fitting martial-arts style jacket with a deep V neckline edged in pointed, flared trim, and a separate wide sash-like band around the waist. Ends at the waist over the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Martial_P.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body and sleeves of the jacket; colour 1 on the lower waist band, blending up into the body; colour 3 on the neckline edge trim; colour 2 on the inner neckline lining.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Martial_P.differs: The male version has a plainer V neckline with pointed flared edges and a looser cut, without the chest cut-out notch seen on the female version.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Punk_01.description: A short, open-front punk jacket with a tall flared collar edged in contrasting piping, rolled-up sleeves, contrasting shoulder patches and slanted stitched seam lines across the chest and back. It ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jacket body, sleeves and collar lining; colour 2 on the shoulder patches; colour 1 on the slanted seam lines and stitching; colour 3 on the collar piping.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Punk_01.differs: The male jacket adds separate contrasting shoulder patches on top of the shoulders, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Space_Sco.description: A cropped, long-sleeved fitted jacket with an open front, padded shoulders, two straight vertical panels on the chest, a thick padded band at the hem and contrasting cuffs; ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Space_Sco.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the jacket and upper sleeves; colour 0 on the hem band and lower sleeves; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder tops and back of the sleeves; colour 3 on the vertical chest stripes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Space_Sco.differs: The male jacket has two straight vertical chest stripes and a thicker hem band, instead of the female's curved swooping chest panels.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Toy_02.description: A sleeveless toy-soldier tunic with a short stand collar and centre button line, ending in a flared knee-length skirt with a row of large buttons down the front, cinched by a wide buckled belt with an ornate heart-shaped plate.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Jacket_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper tunic; colour 1 on the piping along the armholes and skirt hem and on the belt tabs; colour 3 on the armhole lining; colour 2 on the buttons and belt.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Kerchieflarge_01.description: A large triangular kerchief draped around the neck, knotted at the back with small pointed tails, its point hanging diagonally down across the chest. Soft folded cloth in a casual, adventurer-style scarf.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Kerchieflarge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the kerchief cloth; colour 2 on the narrow band at the neck.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Knifestrap_01.description: A bandolier-style strap looping diagonally over one shoulder and across the torso, holding several throwing knives fanned out at the chest and back, with a small clasp at the shoulder. Tactical, mercenary look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Knifestrap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap; colour 2 on the knife blades; colour 1 on the knife handles; colour 3 on the shoulder clasp and knife guards.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Knifestrap_01.differs: The male version has all blades smooth, with more knives fanned out across the back, and no textured blade.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Lemurian_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length armored chest vest with a large angular central plate, glowing-style circuit grooves, swept shoulder plates and a banded belt edge; a matching V-shaped plate covers the upper back. Suggests ancient-tech sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large chest and back plates; colour 0 on the underlying vest and shoulder panels; colour 2 on the belt band and the darker shoulder caps; colour 3 on the circuit line accents.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Light_01.description: A short-sleeved, cropped superhero top ending at the ribs, with a feathered wing-shaped panel across the chest and back, a mask-like emblem at the centre, striped sleeve bands and thin piping along the hem and neckline.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the top; colour 2 on the feathered chest and back panel; colour 1 on the sleeves and the mask emblem; colour 0 on the piping, sleeve stripes and emblem outline.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A torso harness of two diagonal shoulder straps crossing the chest and back with buckles, above a padded waist roll and a wide corset-like waist panel with baseball-style contrasting stitching.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wide diagonal strap and its stitching areas; colour 0 on the thinner shoulder strap and the lower stitched waist panel; colour 2 on the padded waist roll; colour 3 on the buckles, stitching and studs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Lycan_01.differs: The male version has diagonal cross-body shoulder straps, whereas the female version has a horizontal strap band around the upper chest.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting waistcoat with a deep V-neck, a row of front buttons and a pointed hem at the front. Two small contrasting points hang at the back hem, and the armholes are lined with contrasting trim. Formal jester style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper vest body; colour 1 on the lower vest and hem, blending upward from the bottom; colour 2 on the inner lining, armhole edges and back hem points; colour 3 on the buttons.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: An asymmetric martial-arts gi tunic with a diagonal wrap across the chest, one long sleeve, a sculpted segmented chest plate over one shoulder, a sash belt and an angular hem with contrasting trim ending at the upper thigh.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tunic cloth and sleeve; colour 3 on the segmented chest plate; colour 1 on the swirl emblem on the chest; colour 2 on the belt and hem trim.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Martial_Power_01.differs: The male tunic has a shorter hem that sits at the hips, and the sleeve is a loose long sleeve on one arm only.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_02.description: A sleeveless cloth gi top with crossed, wrapped front panels forming a deep V-neck and boxy, flared shoulder caps. It sits loosely over the torso and ends at the waist with a gathered hem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole top; the cloth shows little of the other colour slots.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_02.differs: The male version has wide, boxy shoulder caps and a higher neckline; the female version has narrow, strap-like shoulders and a deeper neckline.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_03.description: A sleeveless martial arts gi tank top of soft cloth, with wrapped crossing front lapels forming a deep V and a loose, rumpled drape. It ends at the waist and leaves the arms bare.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Martialartsgi_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tank top; the inner facing and back show a slight tint of colour 1 in shading, with no separate trim.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechaniste_01.description: A sleeveless, bulky sci-fi armor vest of layered plates over the chest and midriff, with padded tubular shoulder loops ending in small hex lights, and a segmented waist band at the back. It ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechaniste_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate frame and waist band; colour 1 on the chest, abdomen and back plates; colour 2 on the shoulder tubes and back vents; colour 3 on the shoulder lights.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechassn_01.description: A sleeveless, segmented tech armor vest with a layered chest plate, banded ribbed plates around the torso, a contrasting waist band, and a large square vented panel on the upper back. Sits over the torso to the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the waist band and side and lower trim panels; colour 3 on the chest piping and accent stripes; colour 2 on the rivets and the back panel.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Mechassn_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, boxier chest plate and a larger back panel placed lower between the shoulder blades.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A partial chest armour piece of ribbed, segmented panels over the pecs, with a glossy V-shaped centre panel with notched shoulder tabs and a separate lower plate across the ribs. Thin outline edges trace the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy centre V panel and edge outlines; colour 0 on the ribbed upper side panels; colour 1 on the lower ribcage plate.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Nighthawk_01.differs: The male version has a distinct angular lower plate across the ribs and broader, flatter chest panels, instead of rounded bust cups.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length ninja shirt with a mesh panel at the chest, wide contrasting trim along the V-opening and armholes, and a diagonal strap across the torso carrying three shuriken stars.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shirt body and mesh; colour 1 on the neckline and armhole trim and the front edge panel; colour 2 on the diagonal strap; colour 3 on the shuriken.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_02.description: A sleeveless, wrap-front ninja shirt with a diagonal crossover closure edged in contrasting trim, a mesh insert showing at the chest, and broad trimmed armholes. It ends at the waist and sits over the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shirt body; colour 1 on the trim along the wrap edge, collar and armholes; colour 0 on the mesh insert.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ninja_Mesh_02.differs: The male version has larger, more pronounced shoulder flares and a looser, draped wrap.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Overalls_02.description: A short bib-front overall top with two shoulder straps that clip on at the chest with hook fasteners. Panelled, stitched seams and a cropped hem end at the ribs; a worn, utilitarian work look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Overalls_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fabric and straps; colour 1 on the clips and fastener studs; colour 3 on the stains and marks; colour 2 on the seam lines and stitching.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Persian_Vest_01.description: A short, open-front sleeveless vest ending at the ribs, with pointed front panels, contrasting-edged trim, swirling scroll patterns, and small padded shoulder caps. Suggests an ornate east-asian or Persian-inspired look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Persian_Vest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the swirl patterns and thin stripes; colour 3 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the shoulder caps.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A partial chest overlay of sleek angular plates: a Y-shaped pair of long prongs rises from the sternum toward the shoulders, above a pointed panel with long slit cutouts that tapers over the abdomen.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 2 on the raised edge outlines and inner slits. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Phantom_01.differs: The male version has long forked prongs rising toward the shoulders instead of the female's curved bust cups.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Plugs_Covertmili.description: A scattering of small mechanical plug studs, ribbed cylindrical connectors with hex nut caps, mounted on the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, with a few small curved clips between them. Suggests cybernetic implants.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Plugs_Covertmili.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed plug bodies and hex caps; colour 3 on the small ring band on each plug; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Polo_01.description: A short-sleeved, form-fitting polo-style work shirt with a small folded collar, centre front placket, two chest pockets with flaps, yoke seams across the shoulders and back, ending at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Polo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shirt including collar, pockets and sleeves; colour 2 on the thin pocket slits and back seam lines.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Power_01.description: A sleeveless armoured chest layer with a broad yoke over the shoulders, a domed plated torso, a segmented ribbed band at the waist and a high open neck; sits over the torso and ends at the waist, in a sci-fi superhero style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulder yoke and the thin band across the lower chest; colour 0 on the main chest and back plates; colour 1 on the edge piping and the waist bands; colour 2 on the ribbed waist segments.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerarmor_01.description: A short, sleeveless sci-fi chest piece of rounded padded armor covering the chest, ribs and upper back, with wide open armholes and a smooth front panel. It ends at the ribs with a thin trimmed hem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body and sides; colour 3 on the front chest panel; colour 2 on the upper back and shoulder panel; colour 0 on the hem edge and armhole lining.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerarmor_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, boxier chest panel and larger armholes, while the female version has a sculpted, glossy bust panel.
