Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerplates_01.description: A rugged armored chest harness of rigid plates: flat bolted chest and back plates, layered shoulder pauldrons, stacked segmented bands along the ribs and waist, and a wide contrasting sash at the belly. Open at the sides.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerplates_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, back, shoulder plates and lower bands; colour 3 on the waist sash; colour 0 on the inner backing panels; colour 2 on the bolts.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerplates_01.differs: The male version has flatter angular chest plates and layered shoulder pauldrons, rather than a molded bust cup and slim shoulder arches.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerstraps_01.description: A sleeveless, fitted mechanical vest with a laced centre seam front and back, large angular shoulder yokes and chunky side bands at the ribs and waist, each punched with contrasting round holes. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerstraps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the shoulder yokes and side bands; colour 3 on the stitched centre seam; colour 2 on the holes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Powerstraps_01.differs: The male vest has larger, raised shoulder yokes that flare outward like pauldrons, and the side bands sit more openly around the torso.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped carapace vest of overlapping layered armor plates with a scalloped neckline and a V-shaped chest ridge, ending in a banded lower edge at the ribs. Sits over the torso with jagged plates at the sides.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper chest and collar plates; colour 1 on the lower plates, side plates and waist band; colour 2 in the shadowed plate seams. The material shows a mottled, cloudy pattern across the slots.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rave_Shirt_01.description: A cropped, sleeveless sports-bra style top with wide straps and contrasting trim at the neckline, armholes and hem. A band of interlocking diamond patterns crosses the chest, and the fabric fades towards the lower edge.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rave_Shirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fabric; colour 1 on the lower fabric gradient; colour 3 on the diamond chest pattern; colour 2 on the trim around the neckline, straps and hem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rave_Sweater_01.description: A cropped, long-sleeved knit sweater with a wide slouchy boat neckline, slashed and ripped sleeves, and striped ribbed trim at the neck, waistband and cuffs; ends above the navel for a casual rave look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rave_Sweater_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knit body and sleeves; colours 1, 2 and 3 in vertical stripes on the neckline, waist band and cuffs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Reactor_04.description: A mechanical shoulder-and-collar mantle that sits over the upper chest, shoulders and upper back like a padded yoke, with angular panelled segments and a rounded knob at the centre front. Sci-fi reactor styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mantle surface and upper collar; colour 0 on the rim edging and the central front knob; colour 2 on the front and side panels; colour 3 on small accents at the back and front.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ripper_01.description: Cybernetic chest implant rig: angular plates over the upper chest and shoulders, ribbed segments and clustered cylindrical ports with glowing nodes, and many thick ribbed cables that loop densely around the torso and back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular plates and shoulder flaps; colour 1 on the ribbed segments and cylindrical ports; colour 2 on the coiled cables; colour 3 on the small nodes in the ports.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ripper_01.differs: The male version has a denser tangle of cables and more port clusters wrapping the chest and sides.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Robot_Chest_01.description: A partial mechanical chest plate: a broad, angular upper shell over the chest tapering to a pointed segmented lower plate over the stomach, with vent slits, a central spine groove and short antenna-like prongs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Robot_Chest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating; colour 3 on the vent slits, central stripe, side vent and edge lines; colour 1 on the prongs and spikes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Robot_Chest_01.differs: The male plate is a flatter, more angular slab with no bust cups, and it adds a small vented coil between the upper and lower plates at the side.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length chest layer of cobbled stone plates divided by thin seams, with a cluster of faceted crystals jutting from one side of the upper chest. It has open arm holes and a straight hem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates; colour 3 on the seams between the plates; colour 1 on the crystal cluster.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.differs: The male version has a straighter, boxier waist and the crystal cluster sits off to one side of the chest.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01_1.description: A sleeveless, waist-length stone vest made of cobbled rock plates with cracked seams between them. A smaller cluster of angular crystals juts from the upper chest on one side, and the armholes are open.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock plates; colour 3 on the cracks between the plates; colour 1 on the crystals.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Rockcrystal_01_1.differs: The male version has a smaller crystal cluster placed off-centre on the chest, with a straighter, boxier waist.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A partial mechanical chest piece of segmented armour plates that wraps the upper torso, with contrasting line detailing, small vent-like slashes at the sides, a pointed collar shard at the neck and a jagged lower edge. Thin blade-like shards trail off one shoulder.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the neck shard and the jagged lower edge; colour 2 on the line accents; colour 3 on the vent-like slashes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The male version has thin, ragged blade-like shards trailing off the shoulder, where the female version has smooth, wide flared plates.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Samurai_Kataginu.description: A sleeveless samurai-style kataginu vest with flared, winged shoulder pieces, a wrapped V-neck front, vertical contrasting stripes down the front and back, a small circular emblem on the chest and back, and a waist-length hem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Samurai_Kataginu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main vest body; colour 1 on the shoulder wings, front wrap edges and hem trim; colour 2 on the vertical stripes and neckline edge; colour 3 on the circular emblems.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Sasquatch_03.description: A shaggy fur mantle of jagged, feather-like tufts draped around the neck and shoulders, with a V-shaped strip down the upper chest and a longer tapering fall across the upper back. Wild, tribal look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Sasquatch_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the fur tufts; colour 0 on the highlighted inner tufts along the centre and at the neckline; colour 2 on the shadowed tips near the collar.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Sasquatch_03.differs: The male version spreads wider, with fuller tufts over the front of the shoulders and chest.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A sleeveless sci-fi chest vest of layered angular plates over the chest, shoulders and upper back, with an atom emblem on the front, a pointed centre tip, a raised collar and an open cut-out back panel.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plates and collar; colour 0 on the outer plates, lower edge and centre tip; colour 2 on the inset panels and back centre; colour 3 on the neck trim and back bow patch; colour 0 on the atom emblem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.differs: The male version is a blocky angular plated vest with broad shoulder plates and a contrasting back panel, rather than separate rounded bust cups.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shackles_01.description: A mechanical harness of angular plate over the shoulders and upper chest, joined to a rigid waist ring by ribbed strap panels and hanging chain links. Blocky clamp-like cuffs sit on the plates and ring, giving a prison-restraint look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shackles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plates and waist ring; colour 1 on the chains and clamp-like cuffs; colour 3 on the ribbed strap panels; colour 2 on the recessed back panel.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shackles_01.differs: The male harness has broader, boxier shoulder plates and a thicker waist ring, with the ribbed panels running diagonally from one shoulder rather than sitting centred.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer.description: A cropped, sleeveless vest with armhole openings and edged trim, worn over the chest and shoulders. A contrasting spindly spider-like frame runs down the front, with curved horns and segmented arms arching over the shoulders and legs dangling below the hem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the vest body; colour 0 on the armhole and neckline edging; colour 2 on the central frame, back straps and claw legs; colour 3 on the segmented arm joints and horn bases.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer.differs: The male vest has small rounded shoulder caps over the upper arms and sits wider, with horns rising higher from the shoulders.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharness_.description: A partial shoulder harness of flat straps crossing in an X over the chest and back, with a band around the ribs. Three boxy pockets with small lights sit on the upper chest and shoulder.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharness_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strap panels; colour 1 on the edge piping and outlines; colour 2 on the boxy pockets and the strap undersides; colour 3 on the small lights on the pockets.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharness_.differs: The male harness crosses its straps in an X on both the chest and the back, and has three pockets clustered on the chest and shoulder.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharness_.description: A cropped shoulder harness of broad straps crossing in an X over the chest and back, tied together by a band around the ribs, with three small canisters clipped to each side of the upper chest.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharness_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the harness straps; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the canister bodies and inner strap backing; colour 3 on the canister end caps.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharness_.differs: The male harness crosses in an X over the chest and back, with the canisters sitting on the chest straps, unlike the female Y-shaped chest panel.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharness_.description: A cropped, sleeveless shoulder harness of flat bands looping over the shoulders and upper chest, with open H-shaped frames at the front and large window openings across the back; a light mechanical, superhero-style overlay.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharness_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main harness bands; colour 1 on the thin edge trim and outlines around the openings; colour 2 on the inner underside of the bands.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Shoulderharness_.differs: The male harness is more open, with slimmer bands, larger cut-outs and a darker inner underside, leaving more of the chest and back showing.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Skullbra_Soverei.description: A single thick strap worn diagonally across the torso from one shoulder to the opposite ribs, with two carved skulls hanging on the chest. Thin cables and small cylindrical connectors join the skulls to the strap.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Skullbra_Soverei.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skulls; colour 1 on the sash strap and cables; colour 3 on the small connector caps; colour 2 on the eye sockets and fittings.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Skullbra_Soverei.differs: The male version is a single diagonal sash carrying two skulls on one side of the chest, not a symmetrical bra with crossed shoulder straps.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Snake_01.description: A short, cropped chest armour vest of overlapping scale-textured plates with chevron ridges across the back, outlined by contrasting trim, with open armholes and a shaped V notch at the neck. Sits over the torso as a partial layer.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the side and underarm panels; colour 2 on the outline trim along the edges.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The male version has a squarer, wider front with a central notch and a visible gap at the lower front hem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted chest vest of paneled armor-like plating with a raised round neck plate, mesh side inserts, and a wide contrasting border framing the open armholes; a triangular emblem panel marks the back and it ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating; colour 1 on the outer border, armhole rims and back frame; colour 2 on the mesh side inserts and lower band; colour 3 on the line markings, chevrons and back triangle.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Socrates_01.differs: The male version is a straight, boxy vest with a flat chest and longer hem, lacking the separate bust cups.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A short, angular chest piece of faceted armour plates: a large pectoral plate, a separate pointed lower plate, and shoulder-side segments, open at the back with a jagged edge. A sci-fi pharaoh look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pectoral plates and lower pointed plate; colour 1 on the outer and side facets; colour 3 on the horizontal band across the chest; colour 2 on the inner and back panels.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The male version has flat, angular faceted pectoral plates with a contrasting-band stripe across the chest, rather than rounded bust cups.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Speakers.description: A single round speaker disc mounted at the upper chest: a chunky faceted rim surrounds a ribbed cone with a central dome, and the cone tapers to a point behind. Mechanical, comic-style gadget.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Speakers.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim; colour 0 on the ribbed speaker cone face; colour 2 on the central dome.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A cluster of curved, tapering horn-like spikes fanning out across the upper back and shoulders, with smaller spikes studding the chest and shoulder fronts. It reads as a wing-like burst of thorns on the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each spike; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 2 on the spike bases where they meet the body.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A cropped mechanical armour harness worn over the chest: broad rounded shoulder plates crossing into a V-shaped yoke, a central round port on the chest plate, and a ribbed segmented panel tapering down the abdomen.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest plate, back plate and edge trim; colour 3 on the shoulder yoke and strap plates; colour 1 on the ribbed side and abdomen panels; colour 2 on the central port.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male version has a wider, flatter chest plate and heavier shoulder plates that sit lower over the shoulders.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathe.description: A feathered shoulder mantle of overlapping pointed feather plates, covering the upper chest, shoulders and upper back; the feathers hang in a deep V down the chest and a broad rounded fan across the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather plates, shading to darker tones toward the back; the feather material mostly ignores the other colour slots.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathe.differs: The male mantle hangs lower, with a deep V of feathers over the chest, while the female one stops just below the collarbone.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Summer_01.description: A short-sleeved, loose-fitting Hawaiian-style shirt with an open collar and a tropical print of large leaves, palm trees and hibiscus flowers. It sits at the waist over the torso and upper arms.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Summer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shirt body and sleeves; colour 2 on the lower shirt body; colour 0 on the leaf, palm tree and flower prints; colour 3 on the collar and sleeve-edge leaf accents and the flower petals.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspenders_01.description: Thin suspender-style straps that run over both shoulders and join in a Y at the front and back, ending in pointed tips at the waist. Small clasp bands sit on the front straps, over a bodysuit.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspenders_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap centres; colour 2 on the strap edges and outlines; colour 1 on the pointed tips and small clasp bands.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspenders_01.differs: The male straps hang straighter down the chest and have small clasp bands on the front straps.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspendersthin_0.description: Thin suspender straps that run over each shoulder and cross into a Y shape at the front and back, ending in short frayed strap tails at the lower ribs and lower back. A light accessory over a bodysuit.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Suspendersthin_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central stripe of each strap; colour 2 on the strap edges; colour 1 on the small connector clips; colour 3 on the dangling strap ends.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A sleeveless, sculpted chest layer with molded muscle plates, capped shoulders and a V-shaped contrasting panel at the neck, with a small collar. Angular open bands wrap the ribs and meet at a diamond clasp on the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chest, shoulder and rib-band plating; colour 1 on the V-shaped neck and upper back panel; colour 2 on the collar and back clasp pieces; colour 3 on the small diamond at the upper back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, muscled chest and larger, heavier rib bands that flare out at the sides, without the sculpted bust of the female one.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A partial symbiote-style band of thin, angular open-framed struts wrapping the chest and ribs, with sharp curved spikes at the edges and a central gem-like plate flanked by faceted shards.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular frame struts and spikes; colour 2 on the faceted shards beside the centre; colour 1 on the central plate; colour 3 on the inset marking in the centre.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Talisman_01.description: A sleeveless, form-fitting vest with a wide flared stand-up collar sweeping out behind the head, open armholes and a V-shaped front opening, all edged in contrasting trim. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body with a fade toward the hem; colour 3 on the inside of the collar; colour 1 on the outside of the collar and the edge trim; colour 2 on the darker upper chest shading.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Talisman_01.differs: The male collar is wider and flares outward into sharper points at the sides, rather than rising as a tall upright shape.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_01.description: A sleeveless, sleek mechanical chest layer: a wide pointed shoulder-yoke with jigsaw-like seam lines and an arched inlay, over a boxy torso plate with panelled outlines, ending at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder yoke and main plate surfaces; colour 3 on the arched inlay at the collar; colour 1 on the thin outline seams on the torso panels; colour 2 on the seam lines on the yoke.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_01.differs: The male version has a straighter, boxier torso plate that stops at the waist, with a broader, flatter yoke.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_02.description: A sleeveless, sculpted chest armour shell with broad rounded shoulder caps, a large curved cut-out on the upper chest, thin circuit-like inlaid lines, and a segmented lower torso section ending at the ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder caps and main shell; colour 1 on the thin circuit lines on the torso; colour 2 on the etched outlines and inner neck opening; colour 3 on the curved trim around the chest cut-out and neckline.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_02.differs: The male version has broader, rounded shoulder caps that cover more of the upper arms and a larger chest cut-out, rather than a pointed flared collar plate.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_03.description: A cropped, partial mechanical shoulder-and-upper-chest cape-collar piece that flares over both shoulders and back, with jagged panel seams and a contrasting-edged arc across the upper chest around a neck opening.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 3 on the arc piping and neck-ring edging; colour 2 on the jagged seam lines; colour 1 on the thin centre line accents.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_04.description: A full sci-fi midsection guard covering the torso from the ribs to the hips, with a pointed lower edge, large rounded side panels, a split front and a blocky E-shaped circuit motif on the back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating; colour 1 on the outline trim, circuit lines and panel edges; colour 2 and colour 3 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_04.differs: The male version extends lower to the hips with a pointed lower edge, and adds large rounded side panels and a bold back circuit motif.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_05.description: A short, strapless armored band wrapped around the ribs and abdomen, open at the front with two angled plates revealing an inner panel, and thin outlined seams running over the plates and back.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and inner panel; colour 1 on the thin trim lines along the panel edges; colours 2 and 3 not visible.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Teleos_05.differs: The male version is a short band around the ribs and abdomen with an open split front, rather than a longer hip-length piece with a flared hem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Trumpknight_01.description: A bulky, sleeveless, waist-length tunic vest with a round neckline and large open armholes. Heavy draped folds and wrinkles run across the chest and back, and the hem gathers loosely at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Trumpknight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tunic; the default material shows no visible use of the other colour slots.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Trumpknight_01.differs: The male tunic is bulkier, with heavier, thicker draped folds across the chest and shoulders.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Tubed_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped mechanical chest shell with a raised collar, large round reactor-style core with ring housing on the sternum, vent holes beneath it, round side studs and a separate lower band; ends above the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Tubed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, collar and core ring; colour 1 on the lower band and the round shoulder discs; colour 3 on the central core button; colour 2 on thin seam lines.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_01.description: A cropped, sleeveless open-front urban vest with a chunky hood bunched at the neck, a wide inner panel filling the front, ribbed hem, contrasting piping stripes, angled pocket flaps and ragged torn armholes.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the inner front panel; colour 2 on the hood; colour 3 on the front edging, piping, pocket flaps and ribbed hem.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_01.differs: The male vest shows a wide, full-height inner panel across the chest and has angled pocket flaps on the front.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Anime_Turt.description: A long-sleeved, form-fitting turtleneck top with a folded high collar, a cropped hem above the waist and a separate midriff band. The chest has an open cut-out panel and the sleeves are colour-blocked in a casual anime-inspired street style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Anime_Turt.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chest, shoulders and upper back; colour 2 on the back of the arms and upper back panel; colour 0 on the collar, lower sleeves and midriff band. The chest opening shows the mannequin's skin, which is not part of the piece.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Jersey_01.description: A short-sleeved sports jersey with a V-neck, large number on the chest, a name and number on the back, side panels and striped sleeve cuffs. Loose and hip-length, it looks casual and sporty.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Jersey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves; colour 1 on the side panels, neck inset and sleeve stripes; colour 2 on the outlines and sleeve bands; colour 3 on the numbers and name lettering.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Jersey_02.description: A loose short-sleeved sports jersey with a V-neck, large number 17 on the chest and a name and number on the back, side panels, and banded sleeve cuffs; hangs to the hips as a casual layer.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Urban_Jersey_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and sleeves; colour 1 on the side panels, neck lining and sleeve bands; colour 3 on the numbers and lettering; colour 2 on the outlines and sleeve stripes.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasic_01.description: A sleeveless, closed-front waistcoat with a deep V neckline, a stitched chest pocket and three buttons, ending in a pointed hem at the waist. The back is a separate plain panel with a small cinch strap.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front of the vest; colour 1 on the buttons and pocket stitching; colour 2 on the back panel; colour 0 on the back strap.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasic_01.differs: The male vest has the chest pocket on the wearer's left, and its back panel wraps further around the sides and over the shoulders.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasic_03.description: A sleeveless, waist-length closed vest with a deep V neckline, buttons down the front, a stitched chest pocket, and a separate back panel with a small strap at the hem. Casual tailored waistcoat style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front of the vest; colour 1 on the buttons and pocket stitching; colour 2 on the back panel and shoulder panels; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasicopen_01.description: A short, sleeveless waistcoat worn over the torso, open at the front with a row of buttons, a stitched chest pocket outline and a pointed hem. The back is a separate plain panel with a small strap tab.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasicopen_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panels of the vest; colour 2 on the back panel and the inner lining; colour 1 on the buttons and pocket stitching.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasicopen_02.description: A cropped, sleeveless open-front vest with a V-shaped hem, button closure at the edge, a stitched breast pocket and a small back strap. A jagged winged emblem sits on the chest; casual, tailored superhero styling.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbasicopen_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panels and the vest's outer surface; colour 2 on the back panel, shoulder panels and inner chest panel; colour 1 on the buttons and stitching; colour 3 on the chest emblem.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbiker_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped biker vest with notched open lapels, a hanging open front, a chest pocket with small stud, and contrasting piped edging on the armholes, hem and back seams; sits at the waist over the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestbiker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the piping along the lapels, armholes, hem and seams; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_01.description: A sleeveless, padded combat vest with a raised open collar and a centre front zip. A wide central panel contrasts with wrinkled side panels, and it ends at the waist over the torso.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and side panels; colour 1 on the central front and back panels.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_02.description: A sleeveless tactical combat vest with a zip front, a small folded collar, a contrasting centre panel front and back, and utility pouches clustered at the waist hem. Sits over the torso and ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side panels, collar and armholes; colour 1 on the centre front and back panels; colour 2 on the waist pouches.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_03.description: A sleeveless tactical combat vest with a padded front and back plate, a folded collar, side panels, and two horizontal straps with buckles around the lower torso. It sits over the chest and ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombat_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar and side panels; colour 1 on the front and back plates and the lower edge; colour 2 on the two waist straps; colour 3 is not visible.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombatscienc.description: A sleeveless, fitted tactical vest with wide shoulder straps, outlined panels, and separate side panels held by small strap tabs. It ends at the waist and sits over the torso like light body armor.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombatscienc.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front and back panels; colour 0 on the side panels; colour 2 on the shoulder straps, outlines and side straps; colour 1 on the small strap details.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestcombatscienc.differs: The male vest has distinct side panels in a different colour from the front and back, with contrasting strap tabs, whereas the female version is one main colour with contrasting side tabs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestoriental_01.description: A sleeveless, cropped open-front vest with a wide neckline and armholes, contrasting edge trim, and three short contrasting straps bridging the gap down the centre of the chest. Sits over the torso and ends at the ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestoriental_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the vest body, fading lighter toward the hem; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the chest straps.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestoriental_02.description: A sleeveless, cropped oriental-style vest with an open front held by a few contrasting cross-straps at the chest, contrasting trim along the edges, and large flared, angular shoulder wings that sweep up and outward.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestoriental_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main vest body; colour 0 on the shoulder wings and lower hem gradient; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the front cross-straps.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestsovereign_01.description: A cropped, sleeveless cloth vest with a ragged torn hem, worn open at the front and asymmetric, with a stitched patch pauldron over one shoulder and three throwing knives strapped diagonally across the chest.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestsovereign_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest cloth; colour 1 on the knife handles and stitching; colour 2 on the knife blades and the cross mark on the shoulder patch; colour 3 on the round stud on the shoulder patch.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviper_01.description: A sleeveless tactical body-armour vest with outlined edges, wide shoulder straps, small square tabs down the front and a waist band carrying four small pouches. It sits over the torso and ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 2 on the edge outlines; colour 1 on the pouches and waist band; colour 3 on the tabs and small strap ends.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviper_02.description: A sleeveless tactical vest with contrasting outlined panels, shoulder straps with tabs, contrasting chevron accents down the chest, and a belt of buckled ammo pouches around the lower ribs. Ends at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 1 on the pouches and waist belt; colour 2 on the outlines and edging; colour 3 on the chevron patches and strap tabs.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviperknives_.description: A sleeveless, close-fitting tactical vest with thick outlined edges, broad shoulder panels, a waist band, and long knife sheaths strapped down the chest and hanging at the waist; ends at the ribs.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviperknives_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 2 on the outlines, waist band and straps; colour 3 on the strap tabs and clips; colour 1 on the knife sheaths.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vestviperknives_.differs: The male vest has long knife sheaths running down the chest and hanging at the waist, rather than short waist-only clusters.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vine_01.description: A partial chest overlay of curling, tendril-like vines with pointed tips, spreading over the chest and looping over the shoulders to the upper back, with a swirled centre panel. Organic, alien look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine tendrils; colour 0 on the swirled centre panel and streaks along the vines; colour 3 on the pointed tips.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vine_01.differs: The male vines wrap further around the sides of the torso, with a long tendril reaching around the waist and a larger loop over the shoulder.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A sleeveless mechanical armor chest piece of segmented angular plates with a raised shoulder yoke, a ribbed abdomen section and a vented contrasting lower band. It sits over the torso, ends at the waist, and suggests heavy sci-fi power armor.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the shoulder yoke and inner chest panels; colour 2 on the lower band and the chest vent panel; colour 3 on the small accent lights.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vulture_Mane_01.description: A short feathery mane collar that wraps around the neck and shoulders, with ragged pointed tufts hanging over the upper chest and shoulder blades. It sits as a wild, animal-like ruff over the top.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vulture_Mane_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper band at the neck; colour 0 on the shaggy tufts.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Vulture_Mane_01.differs: The male mane sits as a fuller ring around the neck, with a wider open front and longer tufts over the chest.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Windbreaker_01.description: A padded, long-sleeved zip-front windbreaker with a small turned-down collar, a centre zip, contrasting side piping and a gradient fade across the body; puffy sleeves and a banded hem end at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Windbreaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sleeves and upper body; colour 0 on the collar, lower body fade and zip; colour 3 on the side piping.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Tight_Windbreaker_01.differs: The male jacket has puffier, looser padded sleeves and a banded hem, rather than the female's close fit.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Toxicsteel_01.description: A pair of separate padded, rolled tube-shaped shoulder wraps that curve in a partial arc over each shoulder, with small segment seams and rounded coiled ends. Floating pauldron-like accessories with a mechanical look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the padded rolls; colour 2 on the small seam marks and stitching details.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Traveler_01.description: A sleeveless, corset-style vest with a raised standing collar, large rounded shoulder caps and a V-shaped yoke, trimmed with piping. It laces up the front with strap-and-toggle fastenings and ends in a pointed hem at the waist.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body and collar; colour 1 on the shoulder caps, yoke, lacing straps and side bands; colour 2 on the edge piping and trim; colour 3 on the toggles.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_Ves.description: A sleeveless, open-front hooded vest ending at the waist, with a raised collar and bulky hood, boxy contrasting shoulder and upper-back panels, wide front edge stripes and a light hem band. Urban street style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_Ves.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vest body and hood lining; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder and upper-back panels; colour 3 on the wide front stripes; colour 0 on the bottom hem band.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_Ves.differs: The male vest has larger, boxier contrasting shoulder pads and a broad contrasting upper-back panel, with wider front stripes.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_Ves.description: A sleeveless, waist-length hooded vest with a high open collar, a bulky hood bunched at the back of the neck, a split open front with contrasting strips along each edge, and a light hem band. Casual urban anime look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Hooded_Ves.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vest body and hood lining; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder panels and upper back yoke; colour 3 on the front edge strips; colour 0 on the bottom hem band.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Vest_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length casual vest with an open front, a raised collar and a padded shoulder-cap on each side. It has vertical stripes on either side of the opening and a contrasting hem band, giving a street anime look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Urban_Anime_Vest_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vest body; colour 2 on the collar, shoulder caps and upper back yoke; colour 3 on the vertical front stripes; colour 0 on the bottom hem band.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Vest_Swing_01.description: A sleeveless, waist-length tailored vest with wide notched lapels, a pointed lower hem, a row of three buttons and a small pin on the chest. It is worn over a high-collared shirt, in a formal swing-era style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Vest_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vest body; colour 2 on the lapels and collar edge; colour 1 on the shirt front and collar; colour 3 on the buttons and the chest pin.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Vigilante_01.description: A pair of loose looped shoulder straps that rise over each shoulder like open bands, with a rectangular buckle on each strap at the front. A casual superhero harness accent that leaves the torso bare.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad centre band of each strap; colour 1 on the edge piping and inner face of each loop; colour 3 on the buckles.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Vigilante_Short_01.description: A pair of loop straps that encircle each shoulder like harness bands, with a padded outer face, contrasting inner lining and a square buckle at the front. Sits over the shoulders as a light tactical accessory.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Vigilante_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded outer strap face; colour 1 on the edge piping and inner lining; colour 3 on the square buckles.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Warrior_01.description: A sleeveless, quilted armoured vest with padded shoulder caps, a ribbed chevron-striped front panel and crossed back straps; it extends down past the ribs to a checkered, pointed lower waist band.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the quilted outer shell and shoulder caps; colour 1 on the ribbed front panel stripes and lower band; colour 0 on the stripe highlights, checks and back panel; colour 3 on the edge trim and back chevron details.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Warrior_01.differs: The male version extends into a checkered, pointed lower waist band and has no raised collar.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Warrior_02.description: A small shield-shaped chest plate covering the upper torso in a downward-pointing V, with a ribbed, chevron-striped centre and layered side plates at the edges; hollow and open behind. Suggests a mechanical warrior look.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed chest centre; colour 0 on the chevron stripes and top edge; colour 3 on the side plate edges; colour 2 on the banded side plate segments.

Male/M_Chestlayer_Wolf_01.description: A short armoured chest and shoulder piece of layered plates with swept-up horn-like shoulder spikes, a pointed lower hem, raised rims and scrollwork engraving. It sits over the upper torso and shoulders, leaving the arms bare, in a fantasy-mechanical style.
Male/M_Chestlayer_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main armour plates and horn spikes; colour 3 on the raised rims and edge trim; colour 0 on the inner shoulder panels and chest inlay; colour 1 on the scrollwork engraving.

Male/M_Collar_Angel_01.description: A rigid armored collar-cape that rests over the shoulders and upper chest, rising to a rounded neck ring and dropping to a pointed shield-like tip at the front. It has a raised contrasting rim, panel seams, contrasting round vents and an arrow emblem.
Male/M_Collar_Angel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 1 on the neck ring and edge trim; colour 3 on the arrow emblem; colour 2 on the round vent details.

Male/M_Collar_Angel_Armor_01.description: A wide, flared armored collar with a lined inner rim, rounded cut-out details and panel seams, wrapping the neck and ending in a pointed gem-like shield at the front. Small tabs trail at the back; sci-fi angelic style.
Male/M_Collar_Angel_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar plates; colour 1 on the inner rim, edge trim and back tabs; colour 3 on the front pointed shield; colour 2 on the round cut-out marks.
Male/M_Collar_Angel_Armor_01.differs: The male collar is a fuller, more even ring sitting higher on the neck, with a shorter front shield and small contrasting points at the sides.

Male/M_Collar_Animal_02.description: A fur-style animal collar draped over the shoulders and upper chest, made of layered tufts that end in jagged, flame-like points, with a darker knotted tuft cluster at the centre of the chest.
Male/M_Collar_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body of the collar; colour 1 on the jagged outer tips; colour 2 on the central tuft cluster and the underside lining.

Male/M_Collar_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A soft draped hooded cowl with a deep hood and a short shoulder cape that sits over the collarbones and shoulders. Diamond-shaped studs run along the front edge, with a round clasp and a hanging tassel at one side.
Male/M_Collar_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hood and draped cloth; colour 0 on the studs and round clasp; colour 3 on the tassel.
Male/M_Collar_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The tassel hangs at the side of the shoulder and is visible from the back as well as the front.

Male/M_Collar_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A tall stand-up collar with a glossy angular outer shell that flares open at the front and rises around the back of the neck, lined inside with a separate panel and edged with contrasting trim. Retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Collar_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner lining and the edge trim; the outer shell is glossy metal that largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Collar_Arcane_01.description: An open-framework necklace made of a rounded rim with small studs and a ring of separate flat plates that hang in a V at the chest. It sits around the base of the neck and on the upper shoulders.
Male/M_Collar_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the frame rods and small studs; colour 0 on the centre front panel and some inner panels; colour 3 on the flanking front panels; colour 2 on the remaining side and back panels.
Male/M_Collar_Arcane_01.differs: The male version is an open framework necklace of separate panels with studs, not the tall solid flared collar with scrollwork of the female version.

Male/M_Collar_Arcane_02.description: A wide, flat collar draped over the shoulders like a mantle, with a patterned cracked-web inner band along the edge and a pointed tie-like strip hanging down the chest, fastened by a small gem clasp at the throat.
Male/M_Collar_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the collar body and hanging strip; colour 2 on the patterned web band; colour 0 on the clasp diamonds; colour 3 on the small gems and studs.

Male/M_Collar_Bandana_01.description: A triangular bandana worn loosely around the neck like a cowl scarf, with a soft draped point hanging over the upper chest and back, and the ends knotted at the side of the neck with short tails.
Male/M_Collar_Bandana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the bandana; colour 1 on the gradient tint toward the hanging point; colour 2 on the knot and tails.

Male/M_Collar_Bolts_01.description: A pair of mechanical neck bolts, one jutting out from each side of the neck: tapered, pointed spikes with a coiled, threaded middle section and a chunky collar ring at the base. Frankenstein-style sci-fi hardware.
Male/M_Collar_Bolts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coiled threaded shafts; colour 1 on the base collar rings; colour 3 on the pointed tips.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Bolts_01.description: Two small clusters of jagged, crackling electric arcs floating at either side of the neck, like sparks jumping off the collar line. There is no solid band; the effect is thin and glowing.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Bolts_01.colourAreas: The effect ignores the colour scheme and glows a single bright shade; no colour slots are visibly applied.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Cape_Archer_01.description: A short, cloth cape hanging from the shoulders down the back to about waist level, with a trapezoid shape, a wide lower band, a central panel and lighter edges; sits flat against the back in a simple superhero style.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Cape_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side edges and top shoulder area; colour 1 on the central upper panel; colour 2 on the wide lower band.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Cape_Archer_01_Back.description: A short, cropped cape that hangs from the shoulders down the back to about the waist, with a soft draped hem and separate horizontal bands of fabric. Suits an archer or ranger superhero look.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Cape_Archer_01_Back.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder edge and side borders; colour 1 on the upper middle band; colour 2 on the lower band across the hem.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Cape_Tight_Foxbat_Cl.description: A short, cropped cloth cape hanging from the shoulders over the upper back, with a small stand-up collar at the neck and a wide lower panel that ends around mid-back. Superhero styling with a layered look.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Cape_Tight_Foxbat_Cl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges and collar lining; colour 1 on the upper back panel; colour 2 on the wide lower panel.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Cryo_01.description: Two ribbed, hose-like tubes that curve around the neck in an open ring, split at the front and back, with small contrasting end caps. A mechanical, cryo-tech collar that floats loosely around the head and neck.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed tubes; colour 2 on the end caps.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Cryo_02.description: A pair of flexible ribbed hoses that arc around the neck like an open ring, rising to ear height at the back and curving down to the collarbones at the front, each ending in a small capped nozzle.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed hose bodies; colour 2 on the small end caps.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A narrow, single-panel cloth cape hanging from one side of the neck, sitting off-centre and draping down the body to about hip level. It has soft vertical folds and a slightly widening, rounded hem.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cape panel; the gathered neck edge is shaded darker.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Guardian_01.description: A narrow, crest-like collar piece running down the back of the neck: a ridged, crumpled spine with a row of swept-back, tapering spines that grow larger toward the bottom. Suggests a dragon or creature fin.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ridged body of the crest; colour 1 on the swept spines and their tapering tips.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small mechanical chest plate sitting at the upper sternum: a flat anvil-shaped plate with a curved inset strip along the bottom, a thick curved central tube rising from it, and two octagonal slotted screw-heads at the top.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the curved inset strip; colour 2 on the central tube and the backs of the screw-heads; colour 3 on the slotted screw-head faces.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Lockbox_66_02.description: Two small separate mechanical fittings on the upper chest: a round, shallow disc with a recessed centre near the collarbone, and below it an upright rounded-rectangle housing with a raised rim and inset panel.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer casings of both fittings; colour 2 on the recessed centre of the round disc; colour 3 on the inset panel of the oblong housing.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Neck_Heart_01.description: A small faceted heart-shaped pendant with a gem-cut inset centre and a shallow, chunky body. It sits flat against the upper chest just below the neck, suggesting a jewel-like charm.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Neck_Heart_01.colourAreas: Glossy faceted metal-like surface mostly ignores the scheme; colour 3 shows on the inset gem centre.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Neck_Lights_01.description: A scattered ring of small teardrop-shaped studs or lights spread around the base of the neck and across the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, with no connecting band. Suggests a mechanical implant look.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Neck_Lights_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on about half of the small studs; colour 3 on the other studs.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Prisoner_01.description: A set of three small conical studs spaced around the base of the neck, one at the front centre and two at the sides or back. They float as separate points, like a minimal mechanical collar.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Prisoner_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the two side studs; colour 3 on the front stud. Colour 0 and colour 1 are not visible.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Prisoner_02.description: A minimal shoulder harness of thin flat straps: a loop around each shoulder crossing over the chest, joined by a narrow band across the upper back, with small rivets at the strap ends.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Prisoner_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder loops and straps; colour 1 on the band across the upper back.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_01.description: A long, narrow cloth scarf tail hanging straight down the upper back from the neck to the mid back, ending in short fringe. Suggests a pulp aviator look.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scarf cloth; fringe follows the same colour.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_01.differs: The male scarf tail is shorter and wider, ending at the mid back.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Space_01.description: A small faceted spherical shell, open at the top like a bowl, floating at the base of the throat over the upper chest. It reads as a compact, futuristic collar ornament with faint diagonal banding on the sides.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shell; the default material appears mostly and glossy, with no other slots clearly visible.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Starowl_01.description: A slim curved metal rod shaped like a shallow U that rests around the base of the neck and upper chest, ending in a hexagonal bolt-head cap at each tip. A minimal mechanical collar accent.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved rod; colour 1 on the hexagonal end caps.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Festive_01.description: A small round festive bell pendant hanging at the base of the throat, split into an upper shell and a lower half with a rim between them, hung from a short knotted ribbon with two loose ends.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Festive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shell and rim; colour 1 on the lower half of the bell; colour 2 on the ribbon loops; colour 3 on the knot.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Headphones_01.description: A small atom-shaped emblem of looping elliptical orbits around a central nucleus, sitting flat on the upper chest near the collarbone, just beside the neck. Science-themed superhero badge.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Headphones_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 0 on the outer edges of the rings.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Headphones_01.differs: The male emblem sits closer to the neck and the thin extra mark is on the opposite shoulder, more faintly visible.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Martial_Power_.description: A single narrow cloth panel hanging from the shoulder on one side, draping down past the waist in soft vertical folds and ending in a rounded hem; a one-sided partial cape.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Martial_Power_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth panel; the inner face looks slightly tinted by colour 1.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Martial_Power_.differs: The male panel is wider and sits over the shoulder blade with a broader, rounder hem, ending near the hip.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Ninja_Tails_01.description: Two long, narrow cloth tails hanging from the back of the neck down the upper back, like the loose ends of a ninja wrap. They taper to points and lie close together. No front piece is visible.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Ninja_Tails_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both tails; a tiny sliver of colour 3 at the knot at the neck.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Ninja_Tails_01.differs: The male tails are shorter, ending around the mid back, and lie closer together.

Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Punk_01.description: A tiny flat atom-symbol emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus, sitting on the front of the throat like a small decal. It is a minimal, science-themed accent with no collar or fabric.
Male/M_Collar_Child_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the orbit rings and nucleus; the emblem is thin, so other slots are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Collar_Coil_01.description: A neck piece made of a thick tubular band wound in two spiral loops around the neck, with the ends tapering into long sharp spikes that trail down at the front and back. Mechanical, coil-like look.
Male/M_Collar_Coil_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole coil band and its tapering spike ends.

Male/M_Collar_Coil_Dragon_01.description: A serpentine dragon necklace: a padded, segmented body coils around the neck in three stacked loops, ending in a small horned dragon head with spikes that rests at the front of the throat.
Male/M_Collar_Coil_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer coil body and dragon head; colour 1 on the inner coil bands and the horns and head fins; colour 3 on the small stitched markings along the coils.

Male/M_Collar_Corrupted_01.description: A sailor-style flat collar that drapes over the shoulders, with a raised inner neck band, layered outer and inner panels, scalloped points at the back, and a small pointed jewel-like tie at the front of the throat.
Male/M_Collar_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar panels; colour 1 on the inner layered panel; colour 2 on the neck lining and edge trim; colour 3 on the front pointed ornament.

Male/M_Collar_Cosmic_01.description: A chunky angular mechanical collar ring around the neck, made of segmented panels, with an open front notch and a pointed plate dropping onto the upper chest. Sci-fi armoured look with small round lights at the back.
Male/M_Collar_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front chest plate and rim; colour 1 on most collar panels and the back; colour 2 on the side and lower front panels; colour 3 on the side patches near the front.
Male/M_Collar_Cosmic_01.differs: The male collar takes the colour scheme in distinct panels of several slots, and adds two round light-like discs on the back.

Male/M_Collar_Cosmos_01.description: A tall, stiff, high-collar neck piece with vertical ribbed panels around the back and sides, and two long pointed flared tabs sweeping down over the collarbones at the front. A sleek, sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Collar_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar rim and outer body; colour 1 on the recessed vertical ribs at the back and sides; colour 3 on the pointed front tabs; colour 2 on the inner lining and front opening.
Male/M_Collar_Cosmos_01.differs: The male collar has an open front showing the contrasting inner lining, with wider, more splayed tabs and a broader flared back.

Male/M_Collar_Cryo_01.description: A sci-fi high collar ring with a thick coiled cable looped around its rim and small clamp connectors. A pointed, shield-like panel with chevron markings covers the upper chest and back, with winged side pieces sweeping over the shoulders.
Male/M_Collar_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar band and the chevron stripe; colour 1 on the main chest and back panels and inner collar; colour 2 on the inner collar rim; colour 3 on the coiled cable and the small panel accents.
Male/M_Collar_Cryo_01.differs: The male version has larger panels that extend into pointed wings over the shoulders and a longer chest point.

Male/M_Collar_Cryo_02.description: A mechanical high collar ring with a padded rim and a cable-wrapped tube looping around the neck, plus a V-shaped armoured chest and back plate with chevron markings. Side flaps extend over the shoulders like a cryo-suit gorget.
Male/M_Collar_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded outer collar band and chevron stripe; colour 1 on the V-shaped chest and back plates, side flaps and clasps; colour 2 on the inner collar rim; colour 3 on the wrapped tube and plate markings.
Male/M_Collar_Cryo_02.differs: The male version has longer pointed side wings that extend down over the shoulders, beyond the front and back plates.

Male/M_Collar_Cyberwire_01.description: A loose ring of thin overlapping wire-like bands around the neck, gathered into a chunky mechanical clasp or lump at the front. Low and open, resting on the collarbone, with a cybernetic look.
Male/M_Collar_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: The whole piece shows a glossy, near-metallic sheen, so the colour scheme appears to be largely ignored by the default material; no separate colour slots can be distinguished.
Male/M_Collar_Cyberwire_01.differs: The male collar is a low, loose ring of thin overlapping bands with a bulky front clasp, rather than a tall, stepped armored collar.

Male/M_Collar_Datareaper_01.description: A mechanical high collar of angular armored plates that rises into a pointed chin-and-mouth guard at the front, with stacked segmented plates and a round lens-like port at the back of the neck, flaring over the upper shoulders.
Male/M_Collar_Datareaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar plates and chin guard; colour 1 on the inset panel around the front and back lower edge; colour 2 on the lens port and shadowed recesses.
Male/M_Collar_Datareaper_01.differs: The male collar flares wider over the shoulders and trapezius, forming a broader shoulder-covering base.

Male/M_Collar_Deity_01.description: A short, open-topped ring collar that rises from the base of the neck. It is higher at the back and sides, with a folded-over rim, an inner lining panel and a slanted front edge. Suits a sleek sci-fi or superhero jacket look.
Male/M_Collar_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar shell; colour 1 on the inner lining panels; colour 3 is not clearly visible; colour 2 on the underside edge shading.

Male/M_Collar_Detective_01.description: A tall, upturned jacket collar with two pointed lapels that drop down the chest in a V, and a raised back flap around the neck. Sits on the neck and upper chest, giving a noir detective look.
Male/M_Collar_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the collar and lapels; colour 2 on the edge piping and the inner underside of the collar.
Male/M_Collar_Detective_01.differs: The male collar has broader, wider-set lapels that hang slightly lower over the chest.

Male/M_Collar_Draco_01.description: An angular, high-standing metal collar with sharply pointed lapel-like wings that flare at the neck and taper to a deep V point on the upper chest, with a contrasting inner lining and a low band at the back.
Male/M_Collar_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar edges and points; colour 2 on the inner lining and underside; colour 1 and colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Collar_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.description: Two separate clusters of swept-back, blade-like spikes that sit on the shoulders and upper back either side of the neck, with longer curled talon-like spines trailing down behind. Fantasy dragon-scale look.
Male/M_Collar_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper blade spikes, fading into colour 1 at the tips; colour 3 and colour 2 on the lower curled spines.
Male/M_Collar_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The male clusters sit farther apart on the broader shoulders, with longer, more widely splayed spines.

Male/M_Collar_Endo_01.description: A mechanical collar ring that sits around the base of the neck and over the shoulders: a layered, segmented band of angular plates with a glossy rim and a smooth raised inner lip, with visible inner workings at the front.
Male/M_Collar_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and the inner lip; colour 2 on the layered outer plates; colour 1 on the inner mechanism at the front throat.

Male/M_Collar_Extra_Cryo_01.description: Three small detached cylindrical canisters: two short capped nozzles floating near the collarbones and one longer ribbed cylinder at head height behind the neck. A mechanical cryo-tech accessory with no straps or connecting parts.

Male/M_Collar_Extra_Cryo_02.description: Three small detached ribbed cylindrical canisters: one larger horizontal cylinder floating at head level behind the face, and two short capped pods hovering over the collarbones and shoulders. Mechanical, sci-fi accessory look.
Male/M_Collar_Extra_Cryo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all three cylinders and their ribbed caps.

Male/M_Collar_Fluff_01.description: A thick, bulky fur collar that forms a full ring around the neck and rests on the upper shoulders and collarbone, with shaggy, tufted strands and a slightly ragged outer edge. Suggests a winter or arctic jacket ruff.
Male/M_Collar_Fluff_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the tufted tips and streaks through the fur; colour 2 on the darker fur along the inner rim at the front.

Male/M_Collar_Frigid_01.description: A tall flared collar with pointed, notched lower edges at the front and a V-shaped drop at the back, rendered as a translucent, frosty glass-like shell that stands up around the neck and jaw.
Male/M_Collar_Frigid_01.colourAreas: The default material ignores the colour scheme, showing a glossy translucent icy finish across the whole collar; no visible use of colour slots.
Male/M_Collar_Frigid_01.differs: The male collar is a translucent icy shell with no separate trim or inner lining, unlike the female version's opaque shell with edge trim and quilted lining.

Male/M_Collar_Fur_01.description: A thick, ring-shaped fur neck warmer with a puffy, ruffled top surface and jagged tufted edges, sitting snugly around the base of the neck over the collarbone. Soft, cosy, winter-jacket styling.
Male/M_Collar_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top surface of the fur; colour 0 on the tufted outer edges; colour 2 on the underside and inner lining.

Male/M_Collar_Gamer_01.description: A slim necktie hanging from a thin loop around the neck, with a chunky knot at the throat and a long tapered blade ending in a pointed tip at mid-chest. Office-smart and casual.
Male/M_Collar_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tie blade; colour 1 on the knot; colour 2 on the neck loop.

Male/M_Collar_Gamer_02.description: A slim necktie worn loose around the neck: a triangular loop of thin band sits at the collar, with a small knot and a tapered blade hanging down the chest. Casual office look.
Male/M_Collar_Gamer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging tie blade; colour 1 on the knot; colour 2 on the neck loop.

Male/M_Collar_Gamer_Short_01.description: A slim necktie hanging from a small gathered knot at the base of the throat, with a pointed tip ending near the lower chest. Casual office or formal styling with no collar.
Male/M_Collar_Gamer_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tie blade; colour 1 on the knot.
Male/M_Collar_Gamer_Short_01.differs: The male tie hangs straighter down the chest, without the outward bend over the bust seen on the female version.

Male/M_Collar_Gamer_Short_02.description: A necktie worn alone without a collar: a small cuff-like knot at the base of the throat with a long, narrow tie hanging down the chest to the lower ribs, ending in a pointed tip. Casual office style.
Male/M_Collar_Gamer_Short_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the knot; colour 0 on the hanging tie.

Male/M_Collar_Guardian_01.description: A tall, flared collar covered in overlapping scale-shaped plates, with a smooth rim around the neck, twin braided cords down the front and a fin-like ruffle of feathery spikes at the back. It sits around the neck and upper shoulders.
Male/M_Collar_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rim and scale outlines; colour 1 on the scale plates; colour 3 on the braided cords at the front; colour 0 on the feathery ruffle at the back and the chest insert.

Male/M_Collar_Inmate_01.description: A short padded funnel collar that sits around the neck and upper shoulders, with an open front, snap studs down the front edge, and a buckled strap running around the back of the neck. Suggests a prison-style or utilitarian jacket collar.
Male/M_Collar_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body; colour 1 on the strap; colour 2 on the snap studs and buckle.

Male/M_Collar_Inmate_02.description: A tall, padded high collar that wraps the neck and rises to the chin, with a thin contrasting rim, a flared front flap that folds outward, and a small clasp with a hanging chain at the centre front.
Male/M_Collar_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main collar body and inner lining; colour 0 on the upper rim; colour 2 on the front flap and clasp; colour 1 on the hanging chain.
Male/M_Collar_Inmate_02.differs: The male collar's inner lining takes the main collar colour, while the female version's inner lining is light.

Male/M_Collar_Jacket_Clown_Thick_01.description: A jester-style collar ruff of long pointed petal-like tabs fanning outward around the neck and shoulders, with a netted, mesh-patterned surface and a narrow inner band at the neck. Theatrical and costume-like.
Male/M_Collar_Jacket_Clown_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the petal tabs and their mesh pattern; colour 1 on the inner neck band; colour 2 on the edging and the back-facing mesh; colour 3 on the fine mesh lines.

Male/M_Collar_Jacket_Holiday_02.description: A soft, down-turned hood worn as a collar: a loose cloth cowl draped around the neck and upper shoulders, gathered at the back with a contrasting trim edge running around the opening and down the front.
Male/M_Collar_Jacket_Holiday_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the hood; colour 3 on the trim edging around the opening.

Male/M_Collar_Kaiju_01.description: A high, stacked-ridge collar rising around the neck, flaring into a wide scalloped shoulder mantle that dips to a V at the chest, with contrasting pointed spikes along the front edge. Leathery, layered superhero look.
Male/M_Collar_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ridged upper collar; colour 3 on the flared shoulder mantle; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Collar_Lockbox_66_01.description: A mechanical armoured collar-harness: a raised padded neck ring with curved shoulder straps meeting at a central anchor-shaped chest plate with two round bolts, and a segmented plated block across the upper back.
Male/M_Collar_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded collar and chest plate surfaces; colour 1 on the crescent inlay of the chest plate and the chevron back panel; colour 2 on the outer framing, back plates and inner lining; colour 3 on the round bolts.
Male/M_Collar_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The chest plate sits lower on the sternum and a separate angular armour plate hangs over one shoulder in front, giving a more lopsided look.

Male/M_Collar_Lockbox_66_02.description: A wide, rounded mantle collar that drapes over the shoulders and upper chest, with a raised inner band of segmented patterning, a linked ring-and-chain groove around the edge, and a hanging capsule pendant at the front and back.
Male/M_Collar_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer mantle shell; colour 1 on the raised inner band and the lining; colour 3 on the inset segments and the pendant gems; colour 2 on the groove, rings and central round fitting.

Male/M_Collar_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A tall, wide jacket collar that wraps around the neck and flares out into pointed, folded-over wings at the front and back, with a contrasting inner lining. Sits high on the neck and shoulders; a modern, stylish look.
Male/M_Collar_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer folded collar; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge trim.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Animal_02.description: A spiked dog-style collar: a band around the neck with a light inner lining and thin edge piping, contrasting cone spikes along its length, and a square buckle at the front. Punk and street styling.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer band; colour 0 on the inner lining and edge piping; colour 2 on the spikes; colour 3 on the buckle.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Anniversary_Mechanon_.description: A tall banded neck collar of stacked horizontal rings that rises to the chin and flares into a rounded, thick yoke over the collarbones and shoulders. It has a retro mechanical look, with a smooth panel covering the front of the throat.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Anniversary_Mechanon_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front throat panel and the rings; colour 1 on the wide bands; colour 3 on the accent ring near the base; colour 2 on the thin rings.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Anniversary_Mechanon_.differs: The male collar has a thicker, rounded yoke with a light underside, rather than a pointed one with a contrasting edge.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Chains.description: A small pendant of interlocked chain links hanging at the base of the throat: two rectangular links join an octagonal ring that dangles over the upper chest. A tiny mechanical neck accessory with a rugged sci-fi feel.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Chains.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rectangular links; colour 1 on the octagonal rings.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Neckla.description: A small spiky neck ornament sitting at the base of the throat: a central downward-pointing blade flanked by curved, thorn-like prongs that sweep up and outward, giving a sharp, angular, alien-tech look.
A small angular pendant shaped like a downward-pointing arrowhead, with a short faceted spike rising from its top. It sits at the base of the throat on the upper chest, in a sci-fi, mechanical style.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Neckla.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole pendant, including the arrowhead and its upper spike.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Spikes.description: A low, slightly flared collar ring that sits around the base of the neck, with a thin raised rim and a row of short cone spikes along the front and sides. The back is plain, giving a punky sci-fi look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Spikes.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band; colour 1 on the spikes.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Renegade_Spikes.differs: The spikes wrap further round the sides of the neck, so the spike row looks denser from the side.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Swing_03.description: Two small flat oval discs, like thin lenses, sitting on the upper chest just below the collarbones. They are faceted and tilted outward, giving a mechanical, sci-fi accent on a bodysuit.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Swing_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the discs; the material looks glossy and may ignore the colour scheme. No other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Child_Swing_03.differs: The male discs are tilted more steeply outward and follow the angle of the chest and shoulders.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Cyberwire_01.description: A segmented high neck collar made of stacked bands: a layered lower ring with contrasting trim, a padded middle band, and a tall notched upper section that rises up the back of the neck and jaw. Open at the front, with a sleek, angular sci-fi look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower rim and inner front band; colour 1 on the middle padded band; colour 2 on the tall upper back section and its edge.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Frigid_01.description: A slim, low neck band that circles the base of the neck like a collar ring, with a thick rounded rim, a thin contrasting edge and a flat inner strap. Suits a sleek bodysuit look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main rounded rim of the band; colour 0 on the thin outer edge trim; colour 2 on the inner strap.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Goth_01.description: A gothic neck set: a narrow, stiff band collar around the throat with a thin cord loop hanging below it to the chest, ending in a small cross pendant. Sits at the neck and upper chest.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band, cord and cross pendant; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Goth_02.description: A simple band collar that wraps around the neck, with faceted, rolled edges. It dips lower at the front and rides higher at the back, forming a tilted ring at the base of the neck; a plain gothic or formal accent.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar band.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Goth_02.differs: The male collar is tilted, dipping lower at the front and sitting higher at the back, while the female version is a level, even-height ring.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Goth_03.description: A small beveled cross pendant with a longer vertical bar and a short crossbar, resting flat against the upper chest just below the neck. A simple gothic-style accent.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Goth_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cross; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Goth_04.description: A simple open neck collar: a slim, faceted band that wraps around the base of the neck, sitting slightly lower at the front and back with a thin rolled edge. Suggests a clean gothic or formal look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Goth_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar band; the inner lining shows a darker shade of the same slot.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Heart_01.description: A thin, V-shaped cord necklace that rests around the neck and drops to a faceted heart-shaped pendant at the upper chest. Simple, delicate jewellery with a glossy gem-like heart.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Heart_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord; colour 2 on the heart casing; colour 3 on the inner heart facet.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Lights_01.description: A festive string of bulb-shaped lights draped in loose looping strands around the neck and across the shoulders, with the contrasting twisted cord swagging over the chest and upper back and bulbs hanging at intervals.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Lights_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord; colour 3 on some of the bulbs; colour 2 on the other bulbs; colour 1 on the small bulb sockets.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Lights_01.differs: The male cord is a light twisted wire with a wider, looser drape, whereas the female cord is thicker and darker.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Lockbox_66_02.description: A sleek two-part neck piece: a short angled stand-up collar ring around the throat, encircled by a wider flat oval band that rests on the collarbones and shoulders, with two small inset panels at the front.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper collar ring; colour 1 on the outer oval band; colour 3 on the two front inset panels; colour 2 on the inner collar lining and underside.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Monster_Fur_01.description: A ragged, jagged-edged fur collar that rings the base of the neck, built from overlapping pointed tufts that splay outward and downward onto the shoulders. Wild, monstrous look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Monster_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer fur tufts; colour 2 on the shadowed inner and underside tufts.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Pumpkin_01.description: A short standing collar rising around the neck, flaring into a broad pointed V-shaped yoke that lies over the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, edged with a contrasting border. A sharp, jacket-like superhero look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the standing collar and inner yoke; colour 1 on the outer border edging of the yoke.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Reactor_01.description: A mechanical neck accessory of segmented, ribbed tentacle-like cables that arch over the shoulders and drape around the neck, each ending in a tapered nozzle tip; several tips converge at the upper chest.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light ribbed segments; colour 1 on the alternating ring segments; colour 2 on the nozzle tips; colour 3 on the central chest tip.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A chunky chain necklace of flat angular links looped around the base of the neck, with a short pendant tail of two octagonal rings hanging down the centre of the chest. Gritty, rebellious sci-fi look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main chain links; colour 2 on the inner link recesses and shading; colour 1 on the octagonal rings at the front.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_01.description: A rigid, flared metal collar ring at the base of the neck, with a row of short spikes across the front, a chain draped around the full circumference, and a trident-like spiked pendant on the upper chest.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band; colour 1 on the spikes and the pendant; chain takes a metallic finish; colour 2 on the inner collar lining.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_01.differs: The chain is draped around the whole collar, including heavy loops at the back and sides, rather than only at the front.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_02.description: A rigid flared metal neck collar ringed with short curved spikes along the front, with draped chain loops around the base and a single arrowhead-shaped pendant hanging at the chest. Edgy sci-fi punk look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Necklace_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band and chain links; colour 1 on the spikes and the arrowhead pendant; colour 2 on the inner collar lining and the back chain.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A slim, rigid choker collar sitting low around the neck, with a raised inner rim and a row of short conical spikes across the front. The back is plain and smooth, giving a punk, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 2 on the inner lining.
