Male/M_Collar_Neck_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A short, wide funnel collar sitting around the base of the neck and flaring outward over the shoulders. Its faceted angular plates wrap the front and sides and meet at a point at the chest, with a slit detail. Retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main collar band; colour 0 on the front plates (metallic sheen); colour 2 on the inner lining and edge.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The male collar has a wider plate that wraps further around the sides to a V-shaped point at the chest, and it drapes lower over the shoulders.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Swing_01.description: A long necktie with a small knot at the throat and a pointed tip, hanging down the chest to the waist. It has a vertical-striped front with art-deco fan motifs, suiting a swing-era formal look.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knot, stripes and fan motifs; colour 1 on the lower patterned section; colour 3 on a thin band beneath the knot; colour 2 on the stripe lines; the plain back takes colour 0.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Swing_02.description: A long V-shaped necklace of alternating elongated diamond-shaped metal links and small round beads, draped around the neck and hanging to a point at the centre of the chest, with a matching V at the back.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diamond-shaped links; colour 2 on the small round beads. The glossy metal look mostly ignores the rest of the scheme.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Tateklys_01.description: A tribal-style neck piece: a thick cord loop at the throat, a segmented ribbed shoulder mantle, and a ring of long curved claw or fang pendants with small round beads hanging over the chest and upper back.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Tateklys_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw pendants; colour 1 on the segmented shoulder mantle; colour 2 on the neck cord; colour 3 on the beads.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Traveler_01.description: A flat, sailor-style collar that drapes over the shoulders and upper chest, with a wide V-shaped front ending in a pointed metal tip, a thick contrasting rim, and a hollow neck opening with a contrasting lining.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar panel; colour 2 on the rim, the inner neck lining and the pointed tip.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Traveler_01.differs: The male collar extends further down the back and its front point hangs lower on the chest.

Male/M_Collar_Neck_Winged_01.description: A small neck collar with a thin band ringing the base of the neck and a layered front piece: two swept-back pointed wing flaps over a rounded under-panel that meets in a sharp point at the chest.
Male/M_Collar_Neck_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing-shaped flaps; colour 1 on the rounded panel beneath them; colour 2 on the underside layer; colour 3 on the neck band.

Male/M_Collar_Pom_01.description: A wide, flat flared collar that sits around the base of the neck and rests on the shoulders, with a V-shaped front panel and three cords ending in round pom-poms that hang over the upper chest.
Male/M_Collar_Pom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar; colour 1 on the V-shaped front panel; colour 3 on the hanging cords; colour 2 on the pom-poms.

Male/M_Collar_Prisoner_01.description: A rigid mechanical neck collar with a raised rim and small studs, a pointed front plate and a broad back panel, plus thin straps looping over each shoulder and a wider curved strap across the upper back. Sits at the neck and shoulders.
Male/M_Collar_Prisoner_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar rim and the shoulder straps; colour 1 on the collar body and the upper back strap; colour 3 on the small front gem; colour 2 on the studs and the front plate.
Male/M_Collar_Prisoner_01.differs: The male back strap is a wider, curved band across the upper back, and the shoulder loops sit higher.

Male/M_Collar_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_01.description: A soft draped aviator scarf wrapped in bunched folds around the neck, with one wide fringed tail hanging straight down the back to mid-back. Suggests a pulp adventurer or pilot look.
Male/M_Collar_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scarf wrap and the hanging tail; the fringe ends take the same colour.
Male/M_Collar_Pulp_Aviatorscarf_01.differs: The hanging tail is wider and shorter, ending around mid-back.

Male/M_Collar_Pumpkin_01.description: A sculpted, bone-like high collar that rises around the neck in swooping open loops and spreads over the shoulders in ornate pointed plates, tipped with curved spikes on each side. Gothic and fantasy in style.
Male/M_Collar_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar and shoulder plates; colour 3 on the large curved spikes; colour 2 on the smaller spikes.

Male/M_Collar_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A loose, open ring collar with a folded rim sits around the neck, with two thin cords running down the front to a faceted octagonal pendant that hangs on the upper chest. Retro, slightly mechanical charm look.
Male/M_Collar_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the folded collar; colour 1 on the two cords; colour 3 on the octagonal pendant.

Male/M_Collar_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A stiff, open-front high collar of faceted angular panels that wraps around the back and sides of the neck and flares slightly outward, ending in pointed tips at the collarbones. Retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Collar_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: The default material appears glossy metal and mostly ignores the colour scheme; a slight colour 0 sheen shows on the outer edges, with a inner lining.

Male/M_Collar_Rocker_01.description: A thin chain necklace of chunky links that circles the neck and hangs in a V down the chest, ending in a small rectangular tag pendant. Casual rocker or street styling.
Male/M_Collar_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the chain links; colour 1 on the rectangular pendant tag.

Male/M_Collar_Sacred_01.description: A padded, quilted-looking collar ring that sits around the base of the neck and dips into a V at the front chest. Oval inset gem-like lenses run across the front, and a thin contrasting piping edges the rim.
Male/M_Collar_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded collar body and inner lining; colour 1 on the oval inset lenses; colour 2 on the rims around the lenses; colour 3 on the piping along the edges.

Male/M_Collar_Sandstorm_01.description: A soft cloth cowl or snood collar: a thick rolled neck ring with loose draped folds that fall over the shoulders, longer at the back. Sits around the neck and upper shoulders in a desert-wanderer style.
Male/M_Collar_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cowl; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Male/M_Collar_Sandstorm_02.description: A short, wide shoulder collar: a raised, rounded neck ring sits inside a flat, angular cape-like shoulder yoke with a notched point at the front and a pointed drop at the back. It suggests a sci-fi or mechanical jacket.
Male/M_Collar_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shoulder yoke; colour 1 on the raised neck ring and its inner lining; colour 2 on the underside and the clasp piece at the front of the neck.

Male/M_Collar_Scarab_02.description: A stiff, open-front high collar that flares up into two pointed front flaps and sweeps down into a broad shield-shaped panel over the upper back, with a raised slotted plate at the nape. Sits around the neck and shoulders.
Male/M_Collar_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body and flaps; colour 1 on the raised back plate and the thin trim line at the front of the neck.
Male/M_Collar_Scarab_02.differs: The male collar is larger and wider, draping further over the shoulders and upper chest, with a broader back panel and a deeper open front.

Male/M_Collar_Shadow_Destroyer_02.description: A tall, pointed oval shell that rises behind and around the head like a hood or crest, ribbed on the surface with segmented trim ridges and small spikes along the edges and top. Sits on the neck and shoulders.
Male/M_Collar_Shadow_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed shell body; colour 2 on the segmented ridge bands along the edges and centre; colour 3 on the spikes.

Male/M_Collar_Ski_02.description: A padded hood-style collar that sits around the neck and shoulders, draping down the back in a soft pouch with a contrasting piped edge and a lighter lining. Short zip pulls hang at the front. Sporty ski-jacket look.
Male/M_Collar_Ski_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer hood; colour 1 on the piped edge trim; colour 3 on the zip pulls; the lining shows a lighter fabric.
Male/M_Collar_Ski_02.differs: The male hood drapes closer to the throat and the front folds in tighter, with a smaller opening.

Male/M_Collar_Space_01.description: A small rounded orb-like piece worn at the base of the throat, a glossy sphere circled by a thin angular band with a small bead-like knob on each side. Suggests a futuristic sci-fi clasp or collar ornament.
Male/M_Collar_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sphere; colour 2 on the encircling band; colour 1 on the side knobs.

Male/M_Collar_Spooky_01.description: A spiky armoured collar that wraps the neck and shoulders, with a cupped rounded front and layered jagged blades fanning over the chest, shoulders and upper back. Inset slit-like accents give it a menacing, gothic look.
Male/M_Collar_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar plates and spikes; colour 3 on the slit-shaped inset accents; colour 2 on the recessed gaps between plates.

Male/M_Collar_Starhawk_01.description: A sleek superhero shoulder collar: a banded neck ring with a rounded front pod, a wide flat yoke over the shoulders with contrasting trim, a draped front flap and a shield-shaped panel down the upper back.
Male/M_Collar_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the yoke and back panel; colour 1 on the front pod, front flap and edge trim; colour 2 on the neck band; colour 3 on the small gem-like mark at the back panel base.
Male/M_Collar_Starhawk_01.differs: The front flap hangs off to one side of the chest as a curved drape, and the neck pod is a broader rounded shape.

Male/M_Collar_Starhawk_02.description: A high, flared collar with pointed side wings, a V-shaped front drop onto the chest and a rounded plate hanging over the upper back, rendered as a translucent, glassy shell.
Male/M_Collar_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: The default material appears glassy and translucent, ignoring the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Collar_Starhawk_02.differs: The male version shows as a translucent glassy shell with a rounded back plate, without the separate trim or the diamond of the female one.

Male/M_Collar_Starowl_01.description: A thick, feathery fur-like collar that wraps around the neck and shoulders, with jagged pointed tufts along the lower edge. Two lobes hang at the front and are joined by a small chain with bead clasps.
Male/M_Collar_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole feathered collar body; colour 1 on the small clasp beads at the front; the thin chain takes a metallic look.

Male/M_Collar_Steampunk_01.description: A tall, flared jacket-style collar that stands up around the neck and back of the head, open at the front with pointed ends dipping toward the collarbones. It has a smooth folded edge with contrasting trim.
Male/M_Collar_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body and inner surface; colour 1 on the edge trim around the rim.

Male/M_Collar_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A rigid, high retro-villain collar made of stacked horizontal bands that flare outward over the shoulders, with a rounded front opening and a thick rolled rim. It reads as a mechanical, armoured super-villain neck piece.
Male/M_Collar_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top rim and the wide bottom band; colour 0 and colour 1 on the alternating middle bands; colour 2 on the thin grooves between bands.
Male/M_Collar_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.differs: The male collar is a solid banded shell with contrasting rims and a rounded opening, while the female version is a translucent glossy shell with a pointed fold-over flap.

Male/M_Collar_Swing_01.description: A tall, standing jacket collar that wraps the neck, with a wide flared fold-over edge and pointed front tips. Contrasting trim edges the rim, with small round buttons and thin straps near the points; retro formal style.
Male/M_Collar_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main collar body; colour 0 on the trim around the edge; colour 3 on the round buttons; colour 2 on the thin straps.

Male/M_Collar_Swing_02.description: A soft cloth neck scarf wrapped loosely around the collar and tied with a large bow at one side of the neck, with a long tail draping diagonally down across the chest.
Male/M_Collar_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped scarf and the long hanging tail; colour 1 on the bow loops; colour 2 on the small knot at the centre of the bow.

Male/M_Collar_Techcollar_Viper_01.description: A large cobra-hood style collar rising behind the head: a segmented, plated shell at the back curves forward into two fang-like tips, framing a scaled, textured inner lining. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Collar_Techcollar_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented outer back shell; colour 1 on the scaled inner lining and edge trim; colour 2 on the inner side rails and segment lines.
Male/M_Collar_Techcollar_Viper_01.differs: The male hood flares wider around the head and shoulders, with fang tips spread further apart and the lining showing lower on the chest.

Male/M_Collar_Teddy_01.description: A simple scarf looped once around the neck in a wide, soft collar, with one long narrow tail hanging down the front of the chest. Flat, cloth-like band with slightly crinkled surface; casual, cosy styling.
Male/M_Collar_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the scarf and tail; the crinkled inner face shows a metallic-looking texture that does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_01.description: A formal folded dress-shirt collar that wraps the base of the neck, with two pointed front tips resting on the chest and a low band at the back. Thin, open ring with no shirt body attached.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar; the small inner gap at the neck shows a darker shade, with no other separate colour areas visible.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_01_Basic.description: A snug, high tube-like cowl collar that wraps the neck and rises to just under the mouth and jaw, flaring into a shallow yoke that drapes over the upper chest, shoulders and upper back.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar and shoulder yoke; the inner lining at the top edge shows a shadowed shade, apparently not from the colour scheme.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A soft draped cloth neck wrap that loops loosely around the base of the neck, twisting into folds and gathered at the front by a small wrapped knot band. Casual, scarf-like cravat styling.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped cloth loop; colour 1 on the gathered knot band at the front.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Ankh_01.description: A slim ankh pendant hanging from a thin cord loop around the neck, resting on the upper chest. The cross has a looped top and a raised rim, in an ancient Egyptian style.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Ankh_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cord; colour 1 on the ankh face; colour 0 on the raised rim of the ankh.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Anniversary_Defender.description: A rigid, glossy metal collar with a raised angular ring around the neck and a broad flat shoulder yoke that drops to a point at the chest. Sits over the upper chest and shoulders, with a retro superhero look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Anniversary_Defender.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar; the glossy metal default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A tall stiff high collar that rises around the neck and flares into a pointed, shoulder-covering mantle reaching a V on the upper chest, with a raised curling filigree pattern across the surface and a thin edging.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main collar and mantle surface; colour 0 on the swirling filigree lines and the outer edging; colour 2 on the inner rim of the collar opening.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Arcane_01.differs: The male version is a tall, stiff, high-collared shoulder mantle with filigree and no necktie, while the female version is a low flat sailor collar with a hanging tie.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Archer_01.description: A small folded-down shirt collar of flat angular panels that sits around the base of the neck, with pointed front tips resting on the upper chest and a contrasting inner lining showing at the back.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the outer collar; colour 1 on a large patch along the left side and back of the collar; colour 2 on the inner lining.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Archer_01.differs: The male collar has a large contrasting patch covering the left side and back of the collar, where the female is nearly all one colour.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Armorbasic_01.description: A plain, smooth high collar forming a tall band around the neck, with a faceted polygonal top edge and a lower edge that dips to a point at the front. Sits snug against the base of the jaw; suits sleek armored or sci-fi suits.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Armorbasic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar band.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A tall, flared high collar that rises around the neck and sweeps outward into wide pointed wings at the sides. It has a smooth lining, thin contrasting edge trim and a striped outer surface, giving a dramatic villainous superhero look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer stripe panels; colour 2 on the stripes between them; colour 3 on the inner lining; colour 0 on the thin edge trim.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bandana_01.description: A triangular cloth bandana worn snugly around the neck, knotted at the back with small pointed tails, with the wide point draping down the chest in soft wrinkled folds. Casual, western or outlaw look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bandana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bandana cloth; colour 2 on the knot tails and the inner back face.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bling_01.description: A chunky bling necklace: a thick braided cord loop hanging from the neck to the upper chest, carrying a large three-dimensional dollar-sign pendant with a raised metal rim and a gem-studded face.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bling_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the braided cord; colour 0 on the pendant's metal rim and sides; colour 3 on the studded face of the dollar sign; colour 2 in the recesses.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bling_Dogz_01.description: A pendant necklace: a thin braided cord loops around the neck and holds a flat, many-sided medallion with a raised rim and three slashing claw-mark cuts across its face. It hangs on the upper chest.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bling_Dogz_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cord; colour 3 on the medallion rim and the claw slashes; colour 0 on the flat face and edge of the medallion; colour 2 on the back of the medallion.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A rigid, angular mechanical collar that sits around the base of the neck and over the tops of the shoulders. It has a blocky front with three small round ports, a bolt-like cap on each side, and a back that flares into pointed tabs.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body; colour 1 on the side bolt caps; colour 3 on the front port lights and the small back light; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A wide, flared collar that sits around the base of the neck and over the shoulders, with a raised rim at the front, a pointed V-shaped drop at the back, and a contrasting trim edge. Suggests a superhero jacket.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised inner rim and edge trim; colour 1 on the outer collar panels; colour 2 on the inner shadowed lining.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bolotie_01.description: A western-style bolo tie: a thin cord loops around the neck and passes through a round textured clasp at the throat, with two cords hanging down the chest, each ending in a small tip.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bolotie_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cords; colour 2 on the clasp and cord tips.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_01.description: A small classic bow tie with two puffed, angular wings joined by a narrow central knot, sitting at the base of the throat. A formal, dapper accent for suits and jackets.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole bow tie, wings and knot.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_01_Glitter.description: A small formal bow tie with two puffed, angular wings pinched by a central knot, sitting at the base of the throat. Its speckled glitter surface gives a dressy, festive look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_01_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the bow and knot; colour 3 on the speckled glitter flecks across the surface. Colours 0 and 2 are not visible.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_03.description: A large, chunky bow tie with two angular wings and a small central knot, sitting at the base of the throat. Soft, slightly puffed cloth construction gives a formal, dapper look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole bow tie, wings and knot.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_04.description: An oversized puffy bow tie worn at the throat: two rounded, cushioned wings with contrasting piping meet at a small knot. Formal, playful accessory that sits under the chin and flares wide past the neck.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bowtie_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front faces of the wings; colour 0 on the knot and edge piping; colour 2 on the inner back panels of the wings.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bronzeking_01.description: A short, snug neck collar band with a faceted rim and lower edge, wrapped around the throat. A row of round studs runs along the middle band. Suggests a mechanical, punk-styled armoured choker.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Bronzeking_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and lower edge trim; colour 1 on the main band; colour 2 on the studs.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Camera_01.description: A small compact camera hanging on a thin flat neck strap, resting on the upper chest. It has a boxy body with top buttons, a protruding ringed lens barrel and a rear plate. A casual, mechanical accessory.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Camera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the camera body front and the strap; colour 1 on the top and bottom edges of the body; colour 3 on the lens barrel rings; colour 2 on the lens housing, rear plate and top buttons.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01.description: A short, cloth half-cape gathered at a knotted collar around the neck and draped over the shoulders and down the back to about the hips, with a tapered central panel and a separate wide band along the hem.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges and folds of the cape; colour 1 on the central triangular panel and collar; colour 2 on the lower hem band; colour 3 on the small collar accent.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01.differs: The male cape is wider and drapes over the shoulders, covering more of the upper back and sides than the female version.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01_Back.description: A short cloth mantle cape with a small collar at the neck, hanging from the shoulders to about the hips in a wide trapezoid with a separate hem panel, draped loosely over the back in a superhero style.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cape_Archer_01_Back.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges and shoulder folds; colour 1 on the central back panel; colour 2 on the lower hem panel; colour 3 on the small collar detail.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Chain_Arcane_01.description: A thin metal chain necklace of oval links draped across the collarbones and upper chest, with a small decorative scrolled curl ornament hanging at the centre front. It sits loosely around the base of the neck, with a fantasy mage look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Chain_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the chain links and the curled centre ornament; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Chain_Krampus_01.description: A heavy chain necklace of chunky interlocking links draped loosely around the neck and resting on the upper chest, with three round spherical weights hanging from the front loop. Suggests a festive, menacing holiday look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Chain_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the link shading; colour 1 on parts of the hanging balls; colour 3 on part of one ball; colour 0 on the remaining ball segments.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Chains_01.description: A heavy chain of chunky rectangular links draped loosely around the neck and over the collarbones, hanging in a V at the front and ending in a short tapered fitting at the chest.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 1 on the tapered end fitting at the chest.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A feathered mantle collar of layered, pointed feather-like spikes that rises snugly around the neck and fans out over the shoulders, chest and upper back. Suggests a fantasy or beast-like winged look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper neck and inner feathers near the collar; colour 0 on the long outer feathers; colour 2 on a few feather tips at the shoulders.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Choker_01.description: A thin, flat band choker worn snug around the neck, with overlapping ends at the back and a round disc-shaped clasp or pendant at the front of the throat. Minimal, sleek accessory.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Choker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck band; colour 1 on the round front disc.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cowl_Thick_01.description: A wide, flat, low collar ring of faceted angular plates that sits around the base of the neck and over the collarbones, with a contrasting panel dipping to a V at the chest and a narrow sliver at the back.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cowl_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer side and back plates; colour 1 on the front chest panel and the inner edge panel.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cravat_01.description: A cravat with a soft ruched band around the neck and a two-tiered folded front panel hanging over the chest, fastened with a small gem pin at the knot. Formal, dapper neckwear.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cravat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cravat band and folded panels; colour 1 on the gem pin.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Madjester_01.description: A cravat-style neck piece: a thick, gathered rolled collar ring around the neck with a soft, ruffled cloth jabot that hangs down the chest in draped layered folds, sitting slightly off-centre.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rolled collar band; colour 0 on the upper part of the hanging cravat, fading into colour 1 on the lower ruffled folds.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Victorian_01.description: A Victorian-style cravat: a stiff turned-down collar band around the neck with a bulky knot and a short, wide, rounded tie hanging over the upper chest. It suggests formal, period dress.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band and the lower part of the tie; colour 1 on the knot and the main panels of the tie; colour 2 on the darker band across the tie; colour 3 on the patch at the tie's edge.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cravat_Victorian_01.differs: The male tie is shorter and wider, ending in a rounded blunt bulb below a fuller knot.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A thick, draped cloth cowl scarf wrapped loosely around the neck and rising to the chin, with one long flat tail hanging down the back to mid-back. Soft folds give a casual western-cowboy bandana feel.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main scarf folds and the hanging tail; colour 1 on the thin trim line along the top edge; colour 2 on the shadowed underside of the cowl.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A tall flared stand-up collar that widens sharply from the base of the neck to a wide rim, open at the front and higher at the back, with layered inner panels and edge piping.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body and inner surface; colour 1 on the edge piping along the rim and front edges; colour 2 on the thin inner lining line.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Dark_01.description: A wide, flat cowl-style collar that drapes over the shoulders and upper chest in a rounded V shape, with a dashed stitched edge and a swirl motif at the front. Sits around the neck as a partial superhero accessory.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Dark_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body; colour 1 on the swirl and border piping; colour 3 on the inner panels near the neckline; colour 2 on the stitching and inner lining.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Dark_01.differs: The male version appears matte with the light collar body and the colour scheme clearly visible, while the female version shows a contrasting glossy finish.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Deity_01.description: A flat, low V-shaped collar that lies over the shoulders and upper chest like a wide yoke, built from stacked concentric bands with a thin inner rim and a small pointed dip at the back. Suits superhero or sci-fi outfits.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide outer band; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 3 on the thin piping lines between bands; colour 2 on the inner band next to the neck and the inside lining.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Dog_1.description: A tight, close-fitting collar band around the neck with a row of eyelets at the front and a square buckle at the side. It has a deep front that rises under the chin, in a punk or street style.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Dog_1.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the collar band; colour 0 on the wide inner panel under the chin; colour 2 on the eyelets and the inner lining at the back; colour 3 on the buckle.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Dogtags_01.description: A thin chain necklace hanging loosely around the neck with a pair of stacked, rounded-rectangle military dog tags resting on the upper chest. Simple, casual soldier-style accessory.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Dogtags_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain and both tags; no other slots visibly used.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Festive_01.description: A formal neck piece: a stiff, upturned contrasting band collar with a pleated bow tie at the throat, a round seal-like rosette at the knot, and a small two-tone bell hanging beneath. Festive, dressy look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Festive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band and the top half of the bell; colour 1 on the front of the bow and the lower half of the bell; colour 2 on the pleated bow wings; colour 3 on the central rosette.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A thin choker band sitting around the base of the neck, with small round studs and a ring of pointed leaf-shaped petals or feathers fanning outward and downward over the collarbones and shoulders, like a flame or firebird collar.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin edge trim of the band; colour 1 on the main band; colour 3 on the petal centres and the studs; colour 2 on the petal outer shells.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Formal_Tie_01.description: A formal necktie with a small knot at the collar and a long, slim blade hanging down the chest to the upper stomach, ending in a pointed tip. A contrasting stripe runs down one side.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Formal_Tie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tie blade and knot; colour 1 on the side stripe; colour 2 on the small inner collar-band area at the knot.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Glueman_01.description: A slim, plain neck band forming a faceted ring that dips into a shallow V at the front and back and sits snug around the base of the neck. Suggests a simple suit collar.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Glueman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A tall, stand-up flared collar that wraps the neck and rises to jaw and ear height, open at the front with a lined inner face and thin contrasting edge piping. A classic superhero jacket collar.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner lining; colour 1 on the top edge piping; colour 2 on the outer shell and lower edge trim.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_01.differs: The male collar has a fuller, more closed-in front and taller side wings that rise higher toward the ears.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_02.description: A tall, stiff turned-up collar that rises to cheek height around the neck, with pointed front lapel-like tips that angle down toward the chest and thin contrasting edging. Suggests a classic golden-age superhero jacket.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Golden_Age_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar body; colour 1 on the edge piping along the front points and inner edges.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Harajuku_Bow_01.description: A small cloth bow tie sitting at the base of the throat: a central knot band with two wide folded loops and several pointed tails hanging down the upper chest. Suggests a gothic or Harajuku-style look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Harajuku_Bow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bow, loops and tails; the central knot appears in the same colour.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Headphones_01.description: A pair of over-ear headphones worn around the neck: a padded band runs behind the neck with a raised outer rim, ending in round ear cups with atom emblems on the outer faces and contrasting rubber cushions.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Headphones_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band's centre strip and the cup rims; colour 1 on the cup faces and rim segments; colour 3 on the band's outer edge; colour 2 on the ear cushions.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A tall, rounded armored neck collar that encircles the throat, with a ring of radial vent slits around the inside opening and short conical spikes studded around the outer shell. Suits mechanical or brutal armor looks.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar shell and the spikes; colour 2 on the vent slits. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The male collar is more angular and open at the front, with a V-shaped notch below the chin and vent slits visible only on the inner rim.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_High_Fur_1.description: A tall, flared fur collar that fans out around the neck and jaw, open at the front. Its striped fur is layered into radiating tufts that end in sharp points, giving a dramatic, wild silhouette.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_High_Fur_1.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur near the neck base, fading into the striped fur tips; the light and stripe pattern appears to be part of the fur texture and not a separate slot.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A high, flared jacket-style collar that wraps the neck, with a folded-over upper rim and an open front notch. Separate angled panels and contrasting trim give it a layered, sleek look at the base of the neck.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner lining and lower front panels; colour 1 on the large outer panels; colour 3 on the small side stripes; colour 2 on the upper rim at the back.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The male version shows solid colour-slotted panels with a contrasting rim and stripes, whereas the female version has a glowing web-like energy material that ignores the colours.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Kerchief_01.description: A fitted cloth neckerchief wrapped snugly around the neck, gathered into a small knot at the front with two tapered tails hanging down the chest. A casual, sailor-like neck accessory.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Kerchief_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the kerchief band and tails; colour 1 on the fading tips of the tails; colour 2 on the knot.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Knight_01.description: A rigid, shield-like shoulder collar with a deep V opening at the front, a pointed tip on the chest and back, and angular flared edges over the shoulders. Rounded studs dot the surface; it suggests regal knightly armor.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar plates; colour 3 on the studs; colour 2 on the inner lining visible under the edge.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_01.description: A segmented, plated mechanical collar that wraps the neck and upper shoulders like a wide open-front gorget, with a raised back panel carrying etched line details and a small round light. Suggests a sci-fi jacket collar.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main segmented plates and back panel; colour 1 on the inner neck lining and the top of the back panel; colour 2 on the shoulder-side plates; colour 3 on the etched lines and round dot.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_02.description: A rigid, sculpted sci-fi collar that sits over the neck base and upper shoulders like a padded yoke. It has an open oval neck hole, chevron-striped front plates, and vented armoured shoulder wedges with angular panels.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main collar shell and the centre back panel; colour 0 on the raised edge trim and side stripes; colour 2 on the shoulder wedges and underside; colour 3 on the thin chevron lines and vent slits.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.description: An ancient-looking mechanical diving collar: a broad bowl on the shoulders and chest that comes to a point at the breastbone, covered in gauges, dials and panels. Ribbed hoses ring the head, and a tall arched hose rises above it.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar bowl and metal plating; colour 1 on the ribbed hoses and dial caps; colour 3 on the small coil sections and details; colour 2 on the underside and recesses.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.differs: The male version has a busier collar covered in gauges and panels, with ribbed wrapped hoses and a coil on the back column.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.description: A feathered shoulder mantle of layered, spiky plumes draping over both shoulders and around the neck, with a smooth open collar at the front. Feathers grade in tiers toward ragged tips; sits at the upper chest and back.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper feathers around the neck and back; colour 1 on the middle feather tier over the shoulders; colour 2 on the feather tips and the inner front collar.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The male mantle has a wider open front with a visible inner collar, and the feathers sit more heavily on the shoulders and upper back.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.description: A tall, snug neck collar wrapped with a soft draped scarf that crosses at the throat and ties in a loose knot at the front, with long tapering tails hanging down the chest. Casual, slightly formal look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tight inner collar; colour 0 on the scarf outer face and tails; colour 2 on the scarf underside visible at the back.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_03.description: A thick, ring-shaped fur collar that sits around the base of the neck and rests on the shoulders, with shaggy layered tufts hanging down and small contrasting spikes studded through the fur. Suggests a rugged, savage look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur ruff; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_04.description: A thick, fur-like shoulder collar of layered, pointed tufts that wraps around the neck and drapes over the shoulders and upper back, open at the front with a contrasting lining inside. Suggests a rugged, wintry look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Lockbox_67_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 1 on a small hidden trim at the lower back edge.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Luchador_01.description: A short, stand-up collar band that wraps around the neck with a ridged, folded outer surface and pointed tips at the back. It sits at the base of the neck as a tight, sleek accessory.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Luchador_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar's outer surface and folds; colour 1 on the inner and back faces of the band; the ridges show subtle shading from the other slots.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Luchador_01.differs: The male collar has a flatter, squarer front edge that sits across the chin line instead of dipping to a deep point.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Mantle_01a.description: A long draped cloth mantle that hangs from a snug collar at the neck and shoulders down the back to about the knees, with soft folds across the shoulders. Suits a heroic or classic superhero look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Mantle_01a.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the mantle; colour 2 on the inner collar band at the neck.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Mantle_01a_1.description: A long cape with a draped, gathered collar at the neck, hanging straight down the back to about the calves. It carries a large oval central panel, a wide angular band across the middle and a narrow vertical strip below.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Mantle_01a_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cape body and draped collar; colour 1 on the large oval panel; colour 2 on the angular band across the mid-back and the collar edge; colour 3 on the narrow vertical strip.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Mantle_Cosmic.description: A long, smooth cape hanging from a small shoulder mantle with a tight collar. It falls straight down the back to about the knees, with a slight flare at the hem. Superhero style.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Mantle_Cosmic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cape body and the collar edge tips; colour 2 on the inner collar and shoulder yoke.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A thick, bunched cowl scarf wrapped loosely around the neck and rising to cover the lower face, with soft wrinkled folds and a lining visible at the back. It suggests a martial-arts or ninja look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer cowl; colour 2 on the inner lining visible at the back of the neck.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Martial_Power_01.differs: The male version is only a bulky neck cowl with no long hanging cloth panel, unlike the female version.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Arcane_01.description: A tight, flat band necklace that sits around the base of the neck and dips to a large rounded gem pendant on the chest. Swirling scroll patterns run along the band, and the gem is flanked by winged side plates over a stacked segmented base.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the winged side plates; colour 3 on the swirl patterns; colour 1 on the central gem; colour 2 on the inner band lining and the base segments under the gem.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Devil_01.description: A necklace on a thin striped cord that hangs to the upper chest, carrying a horned demon face pendant with fangs and glowing eyes, framed by two interlocking open triangles.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Devil_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the demon face and the cord stripes; colour 2 on the triangle frame and the other cord stripes; colour 0 on the horns and fangs; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Fantasy_01.description: A fantasy necklace: a flat segmented band of inset rectangular tiles rests around the neck and drops in a V to a large oval pendant with scrollwork, small studs and a round central bead, hanging at the upper chest.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band frame and central bead; colour 1 on the inset band tiles and the small studs on the pendant; colour 2 on the inner band and scrollwork; colour 3 on the pendant body.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Golden_Age_.description: A thin cord necklace resting at the base of the neck and dipping in a V to a round, faceted disc pendant with a domed centre, sitting on the upper chest. Simple, retro superhero style.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Golden_Age_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord; colour 2 on the pendant's outer faceted rim; colour 3 on the domed centre of the pendant.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Golden_Age_.description: A thin cord necklace that dips into a V at the front, with a round beveled medallion at the centre of the chest topped by a flat five-pointed star. A retro superhero accent that sits low on the collarbone.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Golden_Age_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin cord; colour 2 on the round medallion body; colour 3 on the recessed centre of the medallion; colour 1 on the star.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Rave_01.description: A thin, tight collar band that sits low around the base of the neck, with faceted angular segments and small block-like nodes spaced evenly around the ring. A sleek, mechanical, rave-style choker.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 as a blended gradient across parts of the band; colour 2 on the small block nodes.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Rave_02.description: A thin cord necklace worn around the neck in a V shape, with a faceted pointed crystal pendant hanging at the chest between two small round beads. Simple, rave-style accessory.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord; colour 1 on the crystal pendant; colour 2 on the two small beads.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Teethcrysta.description: A tight, thin choker-style necklace band around the base of the neck, with a ring of curved claw or tooth-shaped pendants around the front and a cluster of long feather-like drops hanging at the centre of the chest.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Teethcrysta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin neck band; colour 1 on the curved tooth pendants; colour 3 on the hanging feather drops, fading darker toward their bases.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Wizard_01.description: A thin cord necklace hanging in a V from the neck, with a round domed pendant resting on the upper chest. The pendant is engraved with an eye-in-triangle emblem above stacked lines, suggesting a mystic, occult look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Necklace_Wizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cord; colour 2 on the pendant body; colour 0 on the engraved emblem and lines.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Ninja_Neckwrap_01.description: A ninja-style neck wrap: a soft, gathered cloth band with fine pleats that sits snugly around the neck, tied in a knot at the back with two long tails hanging down the upper back.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Ninja_Neckwrap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap and the knot; colour 1 on the hanging tails; colour 2 on the inner fold shadows of the band.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Ninja_Neckwrap_01.differs: The male wrap is a taller, pleated band with a knot at the back of the neck and a broader pair of tails, while the female one is a looser gathered cowl.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Noose_01.description: A segmented rope noose worn as a necktie: a loop circles the neck, gathered into a chunky wrapped knot at the throat, with a short frayed tail hanging down the chest.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Noose_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented loop; colour 1 on the knot wraps; colour 2 on the hanging tail.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Plantmanter_01.description: A short petal-like collar of overlapping pointed leaf blades radiating outward from a low neck ring, resting on the collarbones and shoulders. The blades alternate between two tones for a spiky, organic, monstrous plant look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Plantmanter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner neck ring; colour 1 on alternating leaf blades; colour 2 on the other alternating leaf blades.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Power_01.description: A pair of small curved rectangular plates resting on the tops of the shoulders near the base of the neck, each with a raised rim and inset panel. Mechanical, sci-fi collar accents rather than a full collar.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 0 on the raised rims and outer edges of each plate.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Prayerbeads_01.description: A tight necklace of large round beads strung in a single loop that sits snugly around the base of the neck. The beads are faceted spheres of slightly uneven size, giving a ritual or monastic look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Prayerbeads_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all the beads; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Punk_01.description: A snug, softly folded neck collar that wraps around the throat with a turned-over upper edge, and a small round medallion carrying an atom-like emblem at the front. Punk-flavoured, sitting high on the neck.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band; colour 1 on the front medallion.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Punk_01.differs: The male version is a taller collar with a folded-over edge, coloured by slot 0, while the female version is a flat, thin choker band.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Raccoon_01.description: A ruffled, feathery neck collar of overlapping pointed plumes radiating outward from the base of the neck and resting over the shoulders and upper chest; a flared, layered fringe with a gradient blend at the neckline.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Raccoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner neckline of the collar, blending into colour 0 on the outer feather tips; the underside shows darker shading from colour 2.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A tall segmented neck collar made of stacked, angular overlapping plates that fan outward like ribs around the neck and shoulders. The front has a contrasting ribbed centre panel rising high, and the plates end in pointed tips at the sides.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate edges and pointed tips; colour 1 on the plate inner panels; colour 2 on the front centre panel and the undersides of the plates.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: This version has a taller front panel that rises up over the chin and mouth.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_01.description: A cravat-style neck piece: a banded high collar with a long ruffled jabot of two stacked tiers of pleated frills that cover the chest down to the upper abdomen. Formal, Victorian-looking.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ruffled jabot tiers; colour 1 and colour 2 on the banded stripes of the collar.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_01.differs: The male version has a longer bib with two stacked pleated ruffle tiers, while the female version has a single short ruffle.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_Small_01.description: A small cravat-style neck piece: a banded collar wraps the neck and a pleated, ruffled bib falls over the upper chest with a straight cut hem. Suggests a formal, old-fashioned look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Rufflestie_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pleated ruffle bib; colour 1 on the banded collar stripes and trim.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Scarf_01.description: A soft cloth scarf wrapped loosely in bulky loops around the neck, with a single long tail hanging straight down the front of the chest and a shorter tail trailing at the back. Casual, cosy styling with a banded pattern.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Scarf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light bands of the scarf; colour 1 on the wide stripe bands; colour 2 in the shaded crossing lines of the plaid pattern.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Scarf_01.differs: The male scarf has one long front tail hanging straight down the chest rather than shorter tails swept over the shoulder.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A tall, angular sci-fi soldier collar that wraps the neck and rises to cover the jaw, with a lined inner face and pointed tabs falling to the collarbones at the front. Faceted panels give a military look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer collar shell; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 0 on the front tabs; colour 3 on the angled patch at the back and side.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Secret_02.description: A slouchy, draped hood worn down around the neck and shoulders, with a thick folded rim, soft gathered cloth folds, and two hanging drawstrings with tipped ends. Casual hoodie styling.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood cloth; colour 1 on the piping along the hood opening; colour 2 on the drawstrings; colour 3 on the drawstring tips.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Secret_02.differs: The hood ends in a more pronounced angular point on the chest, and a drawstring tip also hangs at the back.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Secret_04.description: A thick, fluffy fur-style collar that wraps around the neck and shoulders, with textured tufted fur and two tapering points hanging down the chest at the front. It sits high, like a jacket ruff.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and front of the fur; colour 1 on the lower back and inner fur; colour 2 on the thin inner lining at the neck.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Skull_01.description: A skull pendant on a thin cord that loops around the neck and hangs onto the upper chest. The skull is chunky and stylised, with round sunken eyes, a nose hole and carved teeth lines.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cord; colour 1 on the skull; colour 3 on the eye sockets and teeth lines; colour 2 on the nose hole.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Spiked_01.description: A snug, band-style collar sitting close around the neck, with a large square buckle at the front and rows of conical spikes and studs studded around the outside. Punk and street styling.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band; colour 1 on the spikes and studs; colour 2 on the buckle and inner lining.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Spy_01.description: A soft cloth cravat with a large bow at the throat, gathered by a small band, and a wide draped tail that falls down the chest in rippled folds with a wavy hem.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bow and upper cravat; colour 1 on the lower draped tail, fading in from the top; colour 2 on the small band at the knot.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Steampunk_Cover_01.description: A tall, stiff high collar that rises to cover the lower face, with a wide flared base that spreads over the shoulders and two pointed front flaps. A laced front seam and a contrasting upper rim complete it.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Steampunk_Cover_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar body and flaps; colour 1 on the top rim; colour 3 on the front lacing panel; colour 2 on the lace cords.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Stethescope_01.description: A medical stethoscope draped around the neck: thin tubing splits into two earpiece arms at the collar, joins into a single tube down the chest, and ends in a round chest-piece hanging near the ribs.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Stethescope_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tubing; colour 3 on the upper neck tubes and earpiece arms; colour 1 on the stem above the chest-piece; colour 2 on the chest-piece disc.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_01.description: A wide, feathery mane-like collar of layered pointed tufts that fans out around the neck and over the shoulders, with a soft central panel at the front and jagged, ruffled edges. Suggests a suave, wild fur ruff.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central front panel and inner tufts; colour 3 on the upper tufts; colour 2 on the middle tuft layer; colour 1 on the lower outer tufts.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_01.differs: The male mane has its contrasting tufts at the front sides of the collar and its contrasting and contrasting tufts stacked toward the back, with a higher back rim.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_02.description: A large, layered collar mane of pointed, feather-like tufts that sweeps up and back from a deep V at the chest, framing the head and shoulders with jagged tips.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central front and back panels; colour 1 on the lowest tufts; colour 2 on the middle tufts; colour 3 on the upper tufts.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Suave_Wolf_02.differs: The male mane is larger and taller, with a deep front V and long tufts sweeping up and back around the head.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Talisman_01.description: A tall, flared high-collar that rises stiffly behind and around the neck and head, sweeping upward at the back and sides with a notched opening at the front. Vampiric, dramatic superhero or gothic style.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer face of the collar and its thin edge trim; colour 3 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tie_01.description: A slim necktie with diagonal stripes, hanging flat from the base of the neck down the chest to about the waist, following the chest. Gives a smart office or school-uniform look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one set of diagonal stripes; colour 1 on the alternating stripes. The stripes come from the tie's pattern.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tie_02.description: A flat, tapered necktie hanging from the base of the neck down the centre of the chest, ending in a pointed tip around the upper chest. It lies close against the torso, giving a formal office-wear look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tie_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tie; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tie_Power_01.description: A slim diagonally striped necktie with a small knot at the throat and a jagged, lightning-bolt shaped lower edge, lying flat down the chest to about the ribs. A formal-meets-superhero accent.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tie_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one set of stripes and the knot; colour 1 on the alternating stripes.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tie_Toy_01.description: A long, narrow necktie with a small knot at the throat, a glossy striped front panel and a pointed tip. It hangs straight down the chest to about the ribs. Suggests a smart office or retro look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tie_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the knot; colour 2 on the striped front panel; colour 0 on the diagonal stripes; colour 1 on the tie body and edges.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tieshort_02.description: A short, diagonally striped necktie with a small knot at the throat, hanging flat down the upper chest and ending in a pointed tip on the chest. A casual office or school look.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tieshort_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one set of stripes; colour 1 on the alternating stripes; the knot's inner shadow looks like colour 2.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Toy_02.description: A wide, rounded shoulder-cape collar made of concentric layered rings that flare outward from the neck and drape over the shoulders and upper chest. Smooth, soft, toy-like construction with a bulbous rolled edge.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner neck opening and the outer rim; colour 1 on the outer band; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 3 on the inner band.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Trey_Kings_02.description: A tall, open-front collar that rises from the neck to a crown-like crest behind and beside the head, with stepped notches, sharp pointed tips and a thin raised edge. Sits as a rigid shield framing the face and head.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Trey_Kings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer back surface; colour 1 on the inner face; colour 3 on the outer rim edging; colour 2 on the inner edge lining.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tribalskulls_01.description: A tribal necklace of a string of human skulls flanking a larger animal skull with fangs at the centre front, hung on a bone-segmented cord around the base of the neck.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tribalskulls_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skulls; colour 1 on the segmented cord.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tribalskulls_01.differs: The male necklace carries six skulls in a fuller row, while the female version has only three.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tribalteeth_Sovereig.description: A thin cord necklace closely circling the base of the neck, with a row of tapered claw-like teeth hanging from small bead spacers across the front. Reads as a tribal trophy piece.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Tribalteeth_Sovereig.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin cord and the bead spacers; colour 2 on the small block beads; colour 3 on the hanging teeth.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Urban_Necklaces_01.description: Two thin, chunky-linked chain necklaces layered around the neck, hanging in V-shaped loops of different lengths over the upper chest. A casual urban, street-style accessory.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Urban_Necklaces_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the links of the longer chain; colour 2 on the links of the shorter chain.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Urban_Necklaces_02.description: A set of layered chain and cord necklaces of different lengths draped around the neck and over the upper chest, ending in a large round coin-like medallion with an embossed symbol at the front. Urban street style.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Urban_Necklaces_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the beaded chain strands; colour 1 on the braided cord strand; colour 2 on the cord strands; colour 3 on the medallion.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Vulture_Mane_01.description: A close-fitting feathered ruff that circles the neck and drapes over the upper chest, shoulders and upper back, ending in jagged, pointed feather-like tufts. Suggests a vulture or beast mane.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Vulture_Mane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jagged tufts and outer feathers; colour 1 on the inner band around the neck.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Vulture_Mane_01.differs: The male mane has a wider neck opening and longer, sparser spikes that stand further out from the body.

Male/M_Collar_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A tall, flared wizard-style collar: a thin angular shell rising behind and around the head into long pointed spikes, with a central spike at the back and swept-out side wings, framing the chin at the front.
Male/M_Collar_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole collar shell; the inside surface shows shaded. No other slots visible.

Male/M_Collar_Traveler_01.description: A short, high stand-up collar that wraps around the neck with a small gap at the front and back. It has a soft, gathered cloth outer layer, a smooth inner lining, and contrasting piped edges at top and bottom.
Male/M_Collar_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar fabric and inner lining; colour 1 on the piping along the bottom edge and inner band; colour 2 on the top edge trim.

Male/M_Collar_Vigilante_01.description: A wide, flat sailor-style collar that lies over the shoulders, with a V-shaped point down the back and a split open front. Contrasting piping edges the outer rim and a contrasting lining shows at the neck.
Male/M_Collar_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main collar panels; colour 2 on the edge piping and the inner neck lining.

Male/M_Collar_Warrior_01.description: A wide, flared mantle collar with a tall rolled neck opening and concentric ridged bands fanning out over the shoulders and upper chest; rounded, layered and glossy, suggesting a ceremonial superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Collar_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner neck lining and some of the broad bands; colour 1 on the outermost rim band; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 3 on the ridged bands and edging.

Male/M_Cowl_Tight_High_01.description: A tall flared collar that wraps around the back and sides of the neck and rises to sharp points beside the face. It is open at the front, with a curved inner lining and a thin border along the top edge.
Male/M_Cowl_Tight_High_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner face of the collar; colour 0 on the outer back surface; colour 2 on the top edge trim at the front; colour 3 on the rim along the back edge.

Male/M_Cowl_Tight_High_02.description: A tall, flared standing collar that rises in a wide fan from the neck, swooping up behind and beside the head, with a lined inner face and thin contrasting edge trim. Dramatic, vampiric superhero styling.
Male/M_Cowl_Tight_High_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer back surface of the collar; colour 1 on the inner lining facing the face; colour 2 on the edge trim along the front; colour 3 on the thin edge piping at the back.

Male/M_Cowl_Tight_High_Profevil_01.description: An oversized high collar of stiff angular panels that flares up and outward around the head, with sharp pointed tips at the sides and back and a tapered V-shaped front. Sits on the neck and rises to cover the lower face and head.
Male/M_Cowl_Tight_High_Profevil_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire collar, fading toward shadow at the base; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Ear_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A pair of large, pointed, swept-back ear shapes with a sharp angular outer shell and a ribbed inner ear surface, rising above the head like dragon or elf ears. A monstrous fantasy look.
Male/M_Ear_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shells of both ears; the inner ear surface shows a fixed skin-like texture that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Earattach_Fullhelm_Viperps_01.description: An angular sci-fi helmet shell that wraps the sides and back of the head and frames the face, with a raised visor-like brow, pointed cheek guards, and a ribbed ventilator tube band curving across the back.
Male/M_Earattach_Fullhelm_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and cheek guards; colour 1 on the ventilator tubes, side pods and back panel stripes; colour 2 on the ribbed tube segment and underside panels.

Male/M_Earings_Child_Tight_Wings_01.description: A pair of small feathered wings mounted at the sides of the head over the ears, each sweeping upward and outward into a long pointed tip, with layered feather rows and a veined inner panel. Suggests a mythic, heroic look.
Male/M_Earings_Child_Tight_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long upper feathers; colour 3 on the veined inner panels and mounting blocks; colour 2 on the feather edges and undersides.

Male/M_Earings_Fullhelm_Steelcommando_01.description: A mechanical helmet shell worn as a side accessory, wrapping around the back and sides of the head with an open face and chin. It has a segmented plated back with contrasting vent slots, rounded ear pods and a ribbed neck band.
Male/M_Earings_Fullhelm_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plated shell and rim; colour 1 on the ribbed neck band and the side panels; colour 2 on the vent slots; colour 3 on the round ear pods.

Male/M_Earings_Fullhelmet_Wingedcrests_B.description: A pair of helmet-side ear pieces: smooth rounded plates over each ear that sweep back into stepped, feather-like fins. Angular, layered crest edges give a winged, bird-inspired sci-fi look.
Male/M_Earings_Fullhelmet_Wingedcrests_B.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth rounded ear plates; colour 1 on the stepped wing-like crests along the back edges.

Male/M_Earings_Sacred_01.description: A pair of tall, swept-up winged ornaments mounted at the sides of the head above the ears, each a curved feathered wing with layered rows of feather ridges and a raised rim, in a classical winged-helm style.
Male/M_Earings_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim and edging of each wing; colour 1 on the feathered wing panels.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Antenna_01.description: A pair of earpiece antennae: a shallow cup-shaped disc over each ear with a thin straight rod angling up and slightly outward, each topped with a round ball tip. Sci-fi, robotic or alien look.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear discs; colour 1 on the rods and the small joint where each rod meets its disc; colour 2 on the ball tips.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Antenna_02.description: A pair of tech antennae mounted on cup-shaped discs over each ear, with a thin rod projecting sideways through a set of spaced rings and ending in a small ball tip. Sci-fi, robotic head accessory.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Antenna_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear cups; colour 1 on the rods; colour 2 on the rings and end balls.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A pair of chunky faceted earrings, each a rounded many-sided disc-shaped stone with a domed inset gem on its outer face, hanging at the earlobes and sitting flat against the sides of the head.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer setting of each earring; colour 1 on the domed gem set into the face.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Blades_01.description: A pair of rounded ear caps sitting over the ears, each with a thin flat blade fin that sweeps outward and upward like a swept-back wing. Gives a sleek, mechanical or alien headset look.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Blades_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded ear caps; colour 1 on the blade fins.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Blades_02.description: A pair of rounded ear caps, one over each ear, each with a tall curved blade fin sweeping up and slightly outward from the outer edge. Gives a horned, helmet-like look.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Blades_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded ear caps; colour 1 on the curved blade fins and the inner face of the caps.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Blades_03.description: A pair of flat, swept-back blade fins that flare from the temples beside the head, each with a curved leading edge rising to a sharp tip above the head and a notched, jagged lower edge.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Blades_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade fins on both sides.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Blades_04.description: A pair of tall, curved blade-like fins mounted on flat plates at either side of the head, sweeping upward into sharp points like horns. Angular and menacing, suited to helmets or monstrous looks.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Blades_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blades and their side plates; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Fins_01.description: A pair of long, thin flat fins mounted beside the temples in front of the ears, each bending back and sweeping upward and rearward past the top of the head in a sharp angular blade shape.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Fins_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both fins; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Fins_02.description: A pair of thin, curved fin blades rising from the sides of the head beside the temples, each a flat swept-back wing shape with a sharp upward point and a bright edge. Sci-fi or monstrous head accent.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Fins_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin surfaces; colour 2 on the lower tips of the fins.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Lightning_01.description: A pair of rounded ear caps, one over each ear, each with a large jagged lightning bolt fin running along the outer side and sweeping up past the top of the head. A superhero speedster look.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dished ear caps; colour 1 on the lightning bolts.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A pair of swept-back, fin-like ear pieces made of sharp angular blades. Each has a long pointed spike sweeping rearward from the ear and a slim blade curving down along the jaw. Suggests a psionic dragon or alien look.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the blades and spikes; the scheme's other colour slots are not visible on this version.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The default colour pattern differs: the male version is a single colour 0 throughout, without the colour 1 and colour 2 split seen on the female version.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Qularrtuskbig_01.description: A pair of large curved tusks or horns mounted at the sides of the head, sweeping outward and forward to sharp tips, with segmented armour-like bases and contrasting caps at the temples.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Qularrtuskbig_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tusk segments; colour 1 on the tapering tusk tips; colour 3 on the caps at the base near the temples.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A pair of large blade-like head ornaments that sweep up and outward from the temples like antlers or horns, each a flat curved plate with a bordered edge, serrated notches and swirling engraved patterns.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edge borders; colour 1 on the inner rim; colour 2 on the flat blade faces; colour 3 on the swirling engraved patterns.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Wingedcrests_Blueja.description: A pair of winged side-of-head crests: broad curved shells beside each ear, flaring into layered, feather-like tips at the back and top, with a horizontal band across each side. Stylized fantasy or sci-fi headgear.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Wingedcrests_Blueja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell rims and edges; colour 1 on the main shell surfaces; colour 2 on the horizontal band across each crest; colour 3 on small accents at the lower rear.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Wingedcrests_Blueja.differs: The male version is a bolder stylized shell with a horizontal band and contrasting accent details, and a colour split across the panel that the female version lacks.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Wings_01.description: A pair of small feathered wings mounted at the sides of the head over the ears, each a flat fan of layered feathers with a long upswept tip and a veined inner panel. Fantasy, mythic winged-helm styling.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long upper feathers; colour 3 on the veined inner panels and ear mounts; colour 2 on the feather edges and lower tips.

Male/M_Earings_Tight_Wings_02.description: A pair of flat, bat-like dragon wings mounted on either side of the head at ear level, each with a scalloped membrane and pointed tips that sweep up and outward. Gives a monstrous, fantasy look.
Male/M_Earings_Tight_Wings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing membrane; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earring_Blockbuster_01.description: A pair of angular, faceted metal fins mounted at the sides of the head, sweeping up and outward like stylised wings, each with layered blades and small round bolt holes near the lower edge.
Male/M_Earring_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin surfaces; the material appears metallic and mostly ignores the other colour slots, with no visible use of colours 1, 2 or 3.

Male/M_Earring_Blockbuster_02.description: A pair of chunky angular ear guards, one over each ear, with faceted flat plates and a recessed inset panel on the outer face. They give a mechanical, helmet-like sci-fi look.
Male/M_Earring_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and faceted casing; colour 3 on the recessed outer panels.

Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_01.description: A pair of large oval faceted gemstones mounted flat against each side of the head over the ears, like big earpieces. Each has a cut-crystal face with angular facets and a domed back.
Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The gems appear glossy and mostly ignore the colour scheme; no clear colour slot is visible.

Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_02.description: A pair of large faceted rhomboid gemstones mounted flat against each side of the head over the ears, like angular crystal ear panels. Glossy cut surfaces give a bold fantasy or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; no clear slot is visible on the gems.

Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_03.description: A pair of chunky square-cut gemstone blocks with bevelled faces, mounted flat against each side of the head over the ear area like oversized earpieces. Glossy faceted look suggests a sci-fi or fantasy accessory.
Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: Glossy gem material appears to ignore the colour scheme; no clearly separate colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_04.description: A pair of faceted pentagonal gemstone earrings, each a thick pentagon-shaped crystal slab mounted flat against the side of the head over the ear, like chunky studs.
Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme, showing a reflective finish with slight tints; no clearly separate colour areas are visible.

Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_05.description: A pair of large heart-shaped faceted gemstones worn over the ears, one on each side of the head, with flat heart faces pointing outward and a chunky cut-crystal back.
Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem material ignores the colour scheme; it shows a single glassy finish across both hearts, so no colour slot is clearly visible.

Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_06.description: A pair of large teardrop-shaped faceted gemstones mounted flat against the sides of the head over the ears, pointed end upward, with a glossy polished surface like oversized earrings.
Male/M_Earring_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The glossy gem material ignores the colour scheme and shows a reflective finish; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earring_Left_Gemstone_01.description: A large oval faceted gemstone worn flat against the side of the head over the ear, like a big earring. It has a cut-gem surface with angular facets and a slightly domed profile.

Male/M_Earring_Left_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted gemstone earring shaped like an elongated rhombus, mounted flat against the left ear and pointing up and down. Crisp angular facets give it a polished, glassy crystal look.
Male/M_Earring_Left_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The gem appears glossy and reflective and mostly ignores the colour scheme; no distinct colour slot is clearly visible.

Male/M_Earring_Left_Gemstone_03.description: A single square-cut gemstone earring worn flat against the side of the head at the ear, with a faceted bevelled top face and thick blocky sides. Reads as a bold, glossy jewel stud.
Male/M_Earring_Left_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The gem appears glossy and largely ignores the colour scheme; no distinct slot areas are clearly visible.

Male/M_Earring_Left_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone earring worn flat against the side of the head at the ear, forming a thin five-sided prism with glassy, angular faces.

Male/M_Earring_Left_Gemstone_05.description: A large faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn over the left ear, sitting flat against the side of the head like a chunky earpiece, with a cleft at the top and angular cut facets.

Male/M_Earring_Left_Gemstone_06.description: A large teardrop-shaped gemstone worn flat against the side of the head over the left ear, with a faceted, pointed top and a smooth glossy face. It suggests a bold, jewel-like ear ornament.

Male/M_Earring_Right_Gemstone_01.description: A single oval faceted gemstone worn on the side of the head at the ear, cut with angular facets and a flat back that sits against the head. Suggests a bold jewel earring.

Male/M_Earring_Right_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted rhomboid gemstone earring, a flat-sided diamond-shaped crystal with bevelled edges, worn against the side of the head at the right ear. Glossy and angular, it suggests a fantasy or sci-fi jewel.

Male/M_Earring_Right_Gemstone_03.description: A single square-cut gemstone earring with a flat beveled face and thick faceted sides, worn on the right side of the head at the ear. Small, glossy and angular, it suits jewellery-style looks.

Male/M_Earring_Right_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn flat against the side of the head at the ear position. It is a thick, angular cut stone with a notched top and a pointed bottom, in a glossy crystal finish.
