Male/M_Earring_Right_Gemstone_06.description: A single faceted teardrop-shaped gemstone earring with a pointed top and rounded base, flat on the inner face with bevelled edges, worn against the side of the head at the ear.

Male/M_Earrings_Anubis_01.description: A pair of ear-mounted discs with small round studs, each with a long flat tapering strip that hangs down past the jaw to the collarbone, banded with contrasting stripes. Egyptian-inspired headdress-style side accessories.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Anubis_Earrings_02.description: A pair of small faceted hoop earrings stacked one above the other on the left ear, thin polygonal metal rings that hang slightly apart. A simple, understated ear accessory.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Anubis_Earrings_03.description: A tiny pair of stacked, interlinked hoop earrings worn on the right ear: two thin, faceted metal rings hanging one above the other, in a simple, ancient-inspired style.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Bear_Earrings_01.description: A pair of small plain hoop rings floating at the upper sides of the head, one on each side, like animal-ear piercings. Simple thin bands with no other detail, sitting well above the ears.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Bear_Earrings_03.description: A small plain hoop earring for the right ear: a thin faceted metal ring hanging beside the head, with a slightly chunky low-poly band. A simple, minimal jewellery accent.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Cat_Earrings_01.description: A pair of thin metal hoop rings floating on either side of the head, slightly above and in front of the ears. Small and plain, they read as simple piercing-style jewellery.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Cat_Earrings_02.description: A single small hoop earring: a plain, slightly faceted metal ring floating beside the left side of the head, above and in front of the ear, as a simple piercing-style accessory.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Cat_Earrings_03.description: A small plain hoop earring: a thin, slightly faceted round band that hangs beside the right ear, floating just off the side of the head. Simple, understated jewellery.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Celestial_Dragon_0.description: Two clusters of layered, blade-like fin feathers flaring out from the sides of the head at the temples and ears, swept back and up. Fantasy dragon-inspired head accessory that leaves the face and crown bare.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Colossus_01.description: A pair of curved, tapering horn-like growths that sprout from the sides of the head at the ears and sweep down and forward past the jaw. Cracked, segmented surface pattern gives a monstrous, stony look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn surface; colour 3 on the crack-like veins running across it.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Colossus_02.description: A pair of curved, horn-like ear ornaments that sweep down and forward from the ears toward the jaw, tapering to points. Their surface is cracked or veined like fractured stone, giving a monstrous look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Colossus_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main surface of the horns; colour 3 on the crack-like veins running across them.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Face_Rockcrystal_0.description: A pair of faceted rock-crystal ear guards on either side of the head, each a chunky cracked stone shell that sweeps back into a tall pointed crystal spike rising above the ear.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Face_Rockcrystal_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cracked stone shells; colour 1 on the tall crystal spikes; colour 3 on the crack lines between the stone facets.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Earcaps_0.description: A pair of small rounded cylindrical ear caps sitting over each ear, like compact headphone cups, with a recessed inset panel on the outer face. Suggests a sleek sci-fi or mechanical helmet accessory.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Mechassn_.description: An open-faced sci-fi helmet shell of segmented armor plates with a hollow crown, vented contrasting slots at front and back, bulky ear-mounted vent pods, and a thin chin strap band curving under the jaw.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Steelcomm.description: A partial mechanical helmet shell that wraps the sides and back of the head, leaving the face open. It has angular armored plates, a ribbed neck band, and round pods over the ears.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Steelcomm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet plates and the lower rim; colour 1 on the ribbed neck band and the inner side panels; colour 3 on the round ear pods; colour 2 on the vents and seams.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Viperps_0.description: A mechanical helmet shell with an open front window exposing the face, angular cheek guards ending in pointed jaw plates, and a rear ventilator unit of ribbed tubing and padded pods wrapping the back of the head.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Fullhelm_Wings_01.description: A pair of angular side-mounted helmet wings that flank the head: swept-back blade-like fins run from the temples to the sides of the neck, leaving the face and crown open. They read as decorative armour add-ons.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Fullhelmet_Wingedc.description: A pair of curved ear-side pods with stepped, feather-like crests sweeping back and up from each rounded shell. They sit over the ears like winged headphones and suggest a bird-inspired sci-fi helmet.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Gadroon_Horns_Kiga.description: A pair of long, asymmetric bull-like horns sprouting from the sides of the head, each with a contrasting-banded base; one sweeps out and tapers straight, the other curls upward with a kink at its tip.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.description: A pair of ear-mounted feather fans: each sits on a small round cap over the ear and sweeps outward and upward as a spread of long, tapered feathers with fringed tips. Suggests a fantasy bird-like headdress.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Head_Bucket_01.description: A pair of small mechanical ear pieces, one on each side of the head: a flared, ribbed bucket-shaped cup facing outward, with a short stem and an octagonal valve-wheel handle on the outer end.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear cups; colour 1 on the rods and the joint where the rod meets the cup; colour 2 on the round tip knobs.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Antenna_02.description: A pair of sci-fi antennae that stick straight out sideways from cup-shaped discs at the ears. Each has a thin rod with three spaced rings and a ball tip. Reads as a robotic or alien headpiece.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Antenna_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear cups; colour 1 on the rods; colour 2 on the rings and ball tips.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A pair of chunky faceted earrings hanging from the earlobes: each is a rounded, multi-sided gem-like stud with a domed inset centre on the outer face and a flat, plain back.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer body of each earring; colour 1 on the domed inset centre; the flat backs take the same light colour 0.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Batears_01.description: A pair of large, tall pointed bat ears that flare up and outward from the sides of the head, with ribbed inner cups and small spiky tips near the ear canal. Creature-like, fantasy look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Batears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 on the ribbed inner ridges; the small inner spikes show the skin tone rather than a scheme colour.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_01.description: A pair of rounded ear caps sitting over the ears, each with a thin flat blade fin that sweeps up and outward from the cap like a swept-back wing. Suggests a sci-fi or monstrous helmet accent.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the round ear caps; colour 1 on the blade fins.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_02.description: A pair of rounded ear caps sitting over the ears, each with a tall, curved blade fin sweeping up and slightly outward from the outer edge. Gives a horned, helmet-like sci-fi or monstrous look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the round ear caps; colour 1 on the curved blades and the inner faces of the caps.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_03.description: A pair of thin, flat blade-like fins that sweep up and outward from the temples, each with a broad swept base tapering to a sharp point. They sit at the sides of the head like horn-shaped ear wings.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blades; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_04.description: A pair of tall curved blade fins mounted at the temples, each a flat angular plate at the side of the head that sweeps up into a long pointed tip. They read as horn-like head ornaments and suggest a fantasy or monstrous helm.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Blades_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both blade plates; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Dragon_01.description: A pair of large membranous fins that flare out from the sides of the head at ear level, each with scalloped, pointed edges and a thin rigid base rim. They suggest dragon or aquatic creature ears.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base rim where the fins attach; colours 1, 2 and 3 blend across the fin membranes, with colour 3 toward the outer edges and colour 2 toward the base.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earguard_01.description: A pair of slim angular guard plates, one on each side of the head. Each runs back along the temple, then bends down in front of the ear to a point along the cheek. A single rivet marks each bend. Sci-fi helmet-style look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate faces and edges; colour 1 on the strip along the top of each temple section; colour 2 on the inner edge of the cheek blades.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_01.description: A pair of plain hoop earrings: thin, slightly faceted metal rings hanging from the earlobes, one on each side of the head, with the hoops turned roughly edge-on to the front.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoops; the default metallic material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_02.description: A single plain hoop earring: a slim, faceted metal ring hanging from the left earlobe, seen edge-on from the front and as a full circle from the side. A simple, understated accessory.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metallic default material shows little variation from the colour scheme.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_03.description: A small plain hoop earring: a single thin faceted ring hanging from the right earlobe, viewed edge-on from the front and as a full circle from the side. Simple, understated jewellery.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earrings_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the default metallic material barely responds to the other colour slots.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earringsluch.description: A pair of thick hoop earrings, one at each ear, with faceted polygonal rings hanging from the lobes and sitting slightly forward of the ear. A simple, bold accessory suited to a wrestler or street look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Earringsluch.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both hoops; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fins_01.description: A pair of long, flat fin blades that rise from beside the temples and sweep upward and backward past the top of the head, with an angled bend at the base. Sleek, minimal head accessory.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fins_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both fins; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fins_02.description: A pair of thin, curved fin-like blades on each side of the head, sweeping up and back from the temples with a swept, pointed tip and a thicker edge along the front. Suggests a sleek alien or helmet-style head accent.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fins_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin panels; the thick leading edges also show the light colour with a darker tip at the base. Colours 1, 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fullhelmvipe.description: A sleek sci-fi helmet shell that frames the face like a horseshoe: an open front, panelled cheek guards that reach to the jaw, a ridged vent strip on the brow and a rounded back shell around the skull.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fullhelmvipe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and cheek edges; colour 1 on the side panels and the trim bands at the back; colour 3 on the brow vent slats; colour 2 on the inner face frame.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fullhelmvipe.description: A sci-fi open-faced helmet shell that wraps over the crown and around the sides and back of the head, with a vented top panel, small slotted vents on the sides, and lit cheek-guard slits at the front edges.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Fullhelmvipe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim; colour 1 on the top vent panel and the inner and lower trim; colour 3 on the vent slits and the cheek-guard lights; colour 2 on the small details.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A pair of domed ear pods sitting over each ear, each with a rim ring around a rounded cap. Rows of small pointed studs run in arcs over the sides of the scalp above them.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim rings around the pods; colour 3 on the domed pod caps; colour 1 on the small pointed studs.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_02.description: A set of small conical spikes on tiny square bases, arranged in two curved rows that arc back over each side of the scalp from the forehead to the back of the head. Monstrous, understated head decoration.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spike cones; colour 0 on the square bases.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_03.description: A pair of round, domed ear pods worn over the ears on each side of the head, each with a raised convex cap set inside a slim rim. Suggests a small sci-fi headset or gadget.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Gadroon_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the domed centres of the pods; colour 0 on the surrounding rims.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Curl_0.description: A pair of segmented curled horns mounted on the sides of the head above the ears, each starting from a thick cuff-like base and sweeping forward and outward to a tapering point.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Curl_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cuff bases where the horns attach; colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips, blending in from the shafts.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demon_.description: A pair of curved demon horns that sprout from a band on each side of the head, sweeping outward and then upward to sharp tips. Tapered and smooth, they suit a monstrous or fantasy look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demon_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases; colour 1 on the upper horn curves and tips; colour 3 on the collar bands where the horns meet the head.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demon_.description: A pair of huge segmented demon horns that sweep out sideways from the temples, then curve up into tall pointed tips, with contrasting bands where they meet the head. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demon_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn segments; colour 1 on the horn tips, fading in towards the ends; colour 3 on the bands at the base of each horn.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demon_.description: A pair of tall demon horns that sweep outward from the sides of the head, curve upward and taper to sharp points, with contrasting bands wrapped around the base of each horn.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Demon_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and shafts; colour 1 on the upper horn tips; colour 3 on the bands near the base.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Grond_.description: A pair of ridged, bull-like horns that sprout sideways from bands wrapped around the sides of the head, sweeping outward and curving down and back to sharp tips. Monstrous, beastly head piece.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Grond_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases; colour 0 on the ridged horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips as a gradient.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Kigati.description: A pair of lopsided curved horns rising from the sides of the head, each with a band at the base; one sweeps long and outward while the other curls back and twists, giving a monstrous asymmetric look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Kigati.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips and their gradient ends; colour 3 on the base bands.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Yak_01.description: A pair of wide, curved bovine-style horns sprouting sideways from banded bases at the temples, sweeping outward and then down and forward to tapered points. Suggests a beastly or monstrous head look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Horns_Yak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips as a gradient; colour 3 on the band cuffs at the base of each horn.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Hornsfuturis.description: A pair of smooth curved horns that start at the temples, sweep outward and up around the head, and end in long sharp points. Small spikes sit at the base of each horn. Suggests a monstrous or futuristic ornamental headpiece.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Hornsfuturis.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the horns, fading lighter toward the base openings; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Human_Robot_.description: Mechanical head accessory with large swept-back angular wing blades rising from the temples, smaller spikes below them, and pointed cheek plates with slotted vents flanking the face. Robotic, sci-fi styling that leaves the face open.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Human_Robot_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large wing blades and spikes; colour 0 on the cheek plates and thin whiskers; colour 2 on the ear pods; colour 3 on the vent slots and small accents.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Left_Skull_E.description: A small skull-shaped earring hanging from the left earlobe, with sculpted brow ridges, hollow eye sockets, a nose cavity and a row of teeth grooves. Flat-backed and chunky, it gives a macabre gothic accent.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Left_Skull_E.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull surface; colour 3 on the eye sockets and tooth grooves; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Lightning_01.description: A pair of rounded cap-like ear cups worn over the ears, each with a large jagged lightning bolt fin sweeping up and back from its outer face. A playful superhero head accessory.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear cups; colour 1 on the lightning bolts.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Lightning_02.description: A pair of flat, zigzag lightning-bolt shapes mounted at the temples, one on each side of the head. Each bolt tapers to a long sharp point that sweeps up and back past the crown. A playful superhero head accent.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Lightning_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat faces of both bolts; the thin edges show a lighter tone from the same slot. No other slots are visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Luchadorhawk.description: A pair of flat, winged head fins mounted at the sides of the head, each a feather-fingered blade with a hooked beak-like tip pointing down past the cheek and a small cut-out mark. Suggests a hawk luchador look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Luchadorhawk.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wing panels; colour 1 on the outlines and edging along the feathers and beak tips; colour 2 on the small cut-out marks.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Qularrtuskbi.description: A pair of large curved tusks or horns, one mounted at each side of the head, sweeping outward and forward past the cheeks with segmented plated bases and tapering pointed tips.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Qularrtuskbi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tusk segments; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base caps where they meet the head.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Right_Skull_.description: A small skull-shaped earring hanging from the right earlobe: a flat-backed, chunky skull with deep round eye sockets, a nose cavity and carved teeth lines. Suggests a gothic or punk accent.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Right_Skull_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull body; colour 3 on the eye sockets and teeth grooves; colour 2 in the nose cavity.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Robot_Wings_.description: A pair of mechanical head-side pods at the temples, each with swept-back angular wing blades above and pointed fin-like plates curving down along the cheeks. Sci-fi cyborg headgear that leaves the face and crown open.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Robot_Wings_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large upper wing blades; colour 0 on the lower cheek blades and plates; colour 2 on the temple pods; colour 3 on the small slot markings.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Robot_Wings_.differs: The male version has the wing blades swept further back and broader, with wider, shorter cheek plates.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A pair of flat, blade-like antler horns that sweep up and outward from the sides of the head, with a bordered edge, jagged notches along the lower edge and swirling engraved patterns across each blade.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edge border of each blade; colour 2 on the main blade surface; colour 3 on the swirling pattern; colour 1 on the inner rim between border and surface.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Skull_Earrin.description: A pair of small skull-shaped ear ornaments, one hanging beside each ear at jaw level. Each is a chunky, rounded skull with hollow eye sockets and a nose cavity, in a macabre gothic style.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Skull_Earrin.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull bodies; colour 3 on the eye sockets and the teeth lines; colour 2 in the nose cavity.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A set of short conical spikes clustered in two groups on either side of the head, sticking outward and slightly back from the temples and upper skull. Bare head otherwise, with a monstrous or punk look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the spikes show a slight bluish shading but no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_01.differs: The male version has a slightly more spread-out arrangement, with one spike set lower toward the back of the head.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_02.description: A set of small conical spikes studded across the upper sides of the head, angled outward and back in two loose clusters. They leave the scalp bare and suggest a horned, monstrous or punk look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Spikes_02.differs: The male version has fewer spikes, with two larger front spikes and only two smaller ones at the back of each side.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Welder_01.description: A partial welder-style head guard: a band wraps around the forehead and back of the head, with two large angular plates covering the ears and cheeks and contrasting round pads or bolts on the band and plates.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the band and side plates; colour 2 on the round pads and bolts; colour 0 on the thin strip along the forehead edge.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Welder_01.differs: The side plates sit closer against the head and face, with less outward flare.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingedcrests.description: A pair of stylized winged ear crests that sit over the ears, with a curved shell split into bands and panels and a swept-back, angular outline that suggests a mechanical bird crest.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingedcrests.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and edges of the shell; colour 1 on the large curved panels; colour 2 on the horizontal band across each crest; colour 3 on small accents at the lower rear.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingedcrests.differs: The male version has a multi-panel shell with a contrasting horizontal band and small accent panels at the lower rear, rather than a smooth shell with stepped feather ridges.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingedcrests.description: A pair of stylized winged crests mounted at the sides of the head over the ears: curved, swept-back fin-like shells with banded stripes and a pointed tip, giving a luchador-mask or bird-of-prey look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingedcrests.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges and rims of the crests; colour 1 on the main curved surfaces; colour 2 on the horizontal stripe band; colour 3 on the small inner accents near the lower tips.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_01.description: Angular deco head fins: a pair of flat, swept-back metal-like blades running along each side of the head from the temples, with a sharp point at the back and panelled stripes.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade surfaces; colour 1 on the inner stripe panels; colour 2 on the angular accents near the front; colour 3 on the small tips at the back.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_01.differs: The male version is a pair of sharp angular deco fins along the sides of the head, not feathered wings at the ears.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_02.description: A pair of thin, flat bat-like wings mounted at the sides of the head, each with a pointed upper tip, scalloped lower edge and ribbed membrane, flaring outward and upward from the temples like fantasy dragon-wing ear fins.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing membrane and ribs; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingsluchado.description: A pair of angular, swept-back decorative wing panels mounted on either side of the head, running from the temples down past the ears and jaw and pointing backward. Suits a luchador or helmet-style mask look.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Tight_Wingsluchado.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper outer edges and the top surfaces of the wings; colour 1 on the main side panels; colour 2 on the lower and rear angled panels; colour 3 on the small tips and rear accents.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_Demo.description: A pair of large, segmented demon horns that sprout from the sides of the head, sweep outward in a broad curve and then rise to sharp upward points. Each horn base has a contrasting band.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_Demo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the upper horn tips, where the horn fades toward it; colour 3 on the base bands where the horns meet the head.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_Demo.differs: The male horns rise more steeply and end in tighter, more upright points, with the base bands sitting closer to the head centre.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_Kiga.description: A pair of long, tapering bull-like horns rising from the sides of the head, with mismatched curves: one sweeps out and up with a tip flick, the other ends in a hooked twist. Each sits in a band at the base.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Horns_Kiga.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips and the fade toward the ends; colour 3 on the base bands.

Male/M_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Spikes_01.description: A pair of short conical spikes jutting sideways and slightly back from the upper sides of the head, like small horns or thorns. Plain smooth cones with no other head covering.
Male/M_Earrings_Child_Vulture_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Earrings_Chronos_01.description: A pair of stylised swept-back wing ornaments mounted on either side of the head at the temples, each with a curved rim, a pointed upper tip and several feather-like blades fanning backward.
Male/M_Earrings_Chronos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved outer rims and upper edges; colour 1 on the feather-like blades.

Male/M_Earrings_Colossus_01.description: A pair of large curved horn-like spikes that sweep out and down from each side of the head at the ears, with a cracked, stony surface of veined plates. A monstrous, beastly side accessory.
Male/M_Earrings_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn surfaces; colour 3 on the crack-like veins running across them.

Male/M_Earrings_Cosmos_01.description: A pair of large curved horns that sweep out from the sides of the head, rise in a wide loop above it and end in sharp upright points, forming a tall crown-like ring. Glossy, sleek, monstrous.
Male/M_Earrings_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Glossy metallic finish appears to largely ignore the scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows along the upper horn surfaces, with the undersides shading darker.

Male/M_Earrings_Crimson_01.description: A pair of swept, blade-like side ornaments that curve from beside the cheeks down past the jaw. Each has a large fin-shaped upper blade over a longer pointed outer horn, giving an armoured, monstrous look.
Male/M_Earrings_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer curved horns; colour 1 on the upper fin blades.
Male/M_Earrings_Crimson_01.differs: The male version is solid and opaque, with two-tone fins and horns, whereas the female one is translucent and glassy.

Male/M_Earrings_Datareaper_01.description: A pair of angular, faceted ear-and-temple guards that wrap around each side of the head, with large curved shells above the ears, a pointed plate down each cheek and a notched rear ring. Sci-fi cybernetic headgear.
Male/M_Earrings_Datareaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large outer shells; colour 2 on the rear ring, cheek spikes and inner plates; colour 3 on the small recessed vents.

Male/M_Earrings_Draco_01.description: A pair of angular metal fin-like ear guards that sit over the sides of the head, each a flat plate with a swept-back point flaring outward and upward. They suggest a dragon-crest or winged helmet look.
Male/M_Earrings_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces and edges; the default metal material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Earrings_Draco_02.description: A pair of tall, curved horn-like side ornaments framing the face, each built from stacked, overlapping blade-shaped fins that sweep down past the jaw to sharp points and up to a long spike above the head.
Male/M_Earrings_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 alternate as bands across the stacked blades and horn tips; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the scheme, so colour 1 and colour 3 are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.description: A pair of side-of-head ear accessories shaped like layered dragon fins: curved, pointed fin blades sweep up and back from the ears, with stacked smaller spiky fins fanning down along the jaw. Fantasy, monstrous style.
Male/M_Earrings_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower stacked fins nearest the jaw; colour 1 on the outer tips of the lower fins; colour 2 on the middle band of the upper fin; colour 3 on the upper fin tips.

Male/M_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_01.description: A pair of chunky disc-shaped ear caps sitting over the ears like headphones, each with a banded rim and a raised centre disc, topped by a short antenna rod angled upward from the top.
Male/M_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap rims, centre discs and antenna rods; colour 1 on the band around each cap's rim.

Male/M_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_02.description: A single chunky ear cap: a thick multi-sided disc worn over the ear, with a raised hub on the outer face and a short jointed antenna rod rising from a small mount on top. Suggests covert military comms gear.
Male/M_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc rim edges, hub and antenna; colour 1 on the wide band around the disc and the ring on the antenna joint; colour 2 on the mount block.

Male/M_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_03.description: A pair of round ear-cap communication headset pieces, each a thick disc with a banded rim, one with a short antenna stub on top and a thin boom microphone curving toward the mouth.
Male/M_Earrings_Face_Covertmilitary_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear-cap discs, antenna and microphone boom; colour 1 on the band around each cap rim.

Male/M_Earrings_Face_Headphones_01.description: Over-ear headphones: a slim arched headband across the top of the head joins two large rounded ear cups with padded cushions, each with a small accent tab at the hinge. Casual, modern and sporty.
Male/M_Earrings_Face_Headphones_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband; colour 1 on the outer ear cup shells; colour 2 on the ear cushions; colour 3 on the small hinge tabs.

Male/M_Earrings_Face_Headphones_Emblem_0.description: A small atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central dot, drawn as thin outlined line-work on the side of the head over the ear area, like a decal or badge.
Male/M_Earrings_Face_Headphones_Emblem_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole emblem line-work; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Face_Rockcrystal_01.description: A pair of faceted rock-crystal ear pieces: chunky angular plates cupping each side of the head, each sweeping back into a long pointed crystal spike that rises above the ear. Fantasy, monstrous look.
Male/M_Earrings_Face_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plates; colour 1 on the long crystal spikes; colour 3 on the thin crack lines between the plates.

Male/M_Earrings_Falcon_01.description: A pair of swept-up feathered wings mounted at the sides of the head, each built from layered feather rows, with long hanging feather tails dropping past the jaw. Suggests a winged helm or hero headpiece.
Male/M_Earrings_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wing feathers; colour 1 on a band of feathers at the base of each wing; colour 2 on a row of small feathers beneath it; colour 3 on the long hanging feathers.

Male/M_Earrings_Falconer_01.description: A pair of side-of-head fins styled like mechanical falcon wings: each has a pointed plate at the temple with layered blades sweeping up and back, plus small angular spurs below. Sits beside the eyes and ears.
Male/M_Earrings_Falconer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the temple plates; colour 1 on the long upper blades; colour 2 on the middle blades; colour 3 on the small lower spurs.

Male/M_Earrings_Fullhelm_Earcaps_01_Armo.description: A pair of chunky cylindrical ear caps that sit over each ear, with a rounded rim and an inset angular panel on the outer face. Reads as a simple helmet-style earpiece or headphone.
Male/M_Earrings_Fullhelm_Earcaps_01_Armo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap barrels and rims; colour 1 on the inset panel on the outer face of each cap.

Male/M_Earrings_Fullhelm_Mechassn_01.description: A mechanical open-face helmet shell that wraps the skull, with vented contrasting slots on top and back, a visor-like brow band, boxy ventilator pods with ribbed edges over each ear, and a thin chin strap curving under the jaw.
Male/M_Earrings_Fullhelm_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and brow band; colour 1 on the ear ventilator pods; colour 3 on the chin strap; colour 2 in the vent slots.

Male/M_Earrings_Fullhelm_Wings_01.description: A pair of angular side-of-head wing plates that sit over the ears and sweep backward into sharp points, like decorative helmet fins. Each plate is a thin folded shell with layered stripes.
Male/M_Earrings_Fullhelm_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the wing plates; colour 1 on the inner and lower panels; colour 2 on the bands near the lower edges; colour 3 on the tips of the points.
Male/M_Earrings_Fullhelm_Wings_01.differs: The male wings sweep back in a flatter, wider shape, while the female wings rise more steeply upward into narrower points.

Male/M_Earrings_Gamer_01.description: A rigid angular headband wrapping around the head: a zigzag-edged band across the forehead, chunky side pods over the ears with recessed panels and slash marks, and a broad flat panel at the back.
Male/M_Earrings_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and housing; colour 1 on the front end caps of the side pods; colour 3 on the recessed side and back panels; colour 2 on the slash marks.
Male/M_Earrings_Gamer_01.differs: The male version has separate contrasting end caps on the front edges of the side pods, which take colour 1.

Male/M_Earrings_Gladiator_01.description: A pair of side-of-head guards: tall angular blades sweep up above the temples and taper down past the cheeks to points by the jaw, each with an octagonal ear disc. Suggests a gladiator or sci-fi helmet.
Male/M_Earrings_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges of the blades; colour 1 on the inner panel of each blade; colour 2 on the ear discs.

Male/M_Earrings_Gladiator_02.description: A pair of side-of-head winged guards: swept metal plates with tall curved horn-like tips rising above the ears and a hooked cheek edge, each with layered feather-like blades fanning backward. Gladiator or fantasy helm style.
Male/M_Earrings_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept plates and their curved tips; colour 1 on the upper feather blades; colour 2 on the middle feather blades; colour 3 on the lower feather blades.

Male/M_Earrings_Guardian_01.description: A pair of ornate side-of-head ornaments shaped like swirling flames or dragon wisps: a tall swept-back pointed fin above a lower curling wave-like plate, mounted over each ear with spiral relief detailing.
Male/M_Earrings_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper swept fins; colour 1 on the lower wave plates; colour 2 on the spiral line detailing of the upper fins; colour 3 on the thin swirl lines on the lower plates.

Male/M_Earrings_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.description: A pair of side-of-head ear pieces: each has a short round cuff over the ear with a fan of long tapered feather blades sweeping outward and back, with contrasting tips. Fantasy-alien, bird-like style.
Male/M_Earrings_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ear cuffs and the feather tips; colour 0 on the feather blades; colour 2 on the cap on the outer face of each cuff; colour 3 on the small centre light.

Male/M_Earrings_Horns_Crow_02.description: A pair of ridged, segmented horns that sprout from the sides of the temples, sweep back along the head and curl outward to tapering, slightly upturned points. Gives a demonic, monstrous look.
Male/M_Earrings_Horns_Crow_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blocky bases and the ridged upper lengths of the horns; colour 3 on the tapering tips, blending in gradually.

Male/M_Earrings_Horns_Spiral_01.description: A pair of ram-style spiral horns rising from the sides of the head, each curling back and around in chunky segmented bands and ending in a sharp downward-pointing tip. Suits monstrous or fantasy beast designs.
Male/M_Earrings_Horns_Spiral_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on alternating bands of each horn; colour 1 on the other alternating bands; colour 2 on the pointed tips.

Male/M_Earrings_Lockbox_66_01.description: A pair of flat, winged plate earpieces mounted at each side of the head: a rounded panel over the ear with a small round port, a raised gem-like block, and swept wing shapes with a recessed slot flaring outward.
Male/M_Earrings_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate bodies and wing edges; colour 1 on the raised blocks; colour 2 on the recessed wing backing; colour 3 on the inset slot lights.

Male/M_Earrings_Madjester_01.description: A single-sided cluster of three sweeping plumes attached at the side of the head above the ear: two long striped feathers curve up and outward, with a shorter soft feather curling out below them.
Male/M_Earrings_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 and colour 2 on the striped upper feathers as alternating bands; colour 0 fading into colour 1 on the lower soft feather.

Male/M_Earrings_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A pair of disc-shaped ear covers with a rimmed edge, sitting over the ears. Each carries a cluster of long, swept-back spikes that rise above the head like fins, for a speedster or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Earrings_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the discs and their rims; colour 3 on the spike clusters.

Male/M_Earrings_Pirate_Hat_Feather_01.description: A cluster of long, curved feathers fanning out from one side of the head above the ear, sweeping backward and down with a fringed edge and a contrasting central quill; a pirate-hat style plume worn as a side accessory.
Male/M_Earrings_Pirate_Hat_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feather vanes; colour 1 on the outer feather edges and tips; colour 3 on the central quills; colour 2 on the darkest feather tips.

Male/M_Earrings_Robot_Steampunk_01.description: A pair of mechanical ear discs: chunky octagonal knurled drums with a ringed inner face, mounted on short contrasting stems that end in faceted knobs, sticking out from each side of the head.
Male/M_Earrings_Robot_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer drum casing and flat back plate; colour 1 on the inner ring of the disc face; colour 3 on the knob at the centre and on the stem tips; colour 2 on the stems.

Male/M_Earrings_Rustbucket_01.description: A pair of chunky cylindrical ear discs, one on each side of the head, like mechanical earmuffs. Each has a smooth rim and a outward face with a central round cap ringed by radial segmented slots.
Male/M_Earrings_Rustbucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rims and discs; colour 1 on the central cap of each disc; colour 3 and colour 2 alternating on the radial segments around the cap.

Male/M_Earrings_Salamander_01.description: A pair of side-of-head accessories, each a small block at the temple with four long, tapering, backswept claw-like spines that fan out past the head. Suggests a monstrous, reptilian or alien look.
Male/M_Earrings_Salamander_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bases and the bodies of the spines; the spine tips fade toward light and near black.

Male/M_Earrings_Seacreature_01.description: A pair of large fin-like side accessories flaring outward from either side of the head, each made of angular segmented panels with pointed tips that hang down, suggesting sea-creature fins or wings.
Male/M_Earrings_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad inner fin panels; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 1 on the outer edging and framing ribs; colour 2 on the tips and veins.

Male/M_Earrings_Seahorse_01.description: A pair of fin-like ear ornaments, each a fan of layered, pointed leaf-shaped blades that sweep outward and backward from the side of the head at ear level, evoking seahorse or aquatic fins.
Male/M_Earrings_Seahorse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light outer blades; colour 1 on the mid-toned inner blades; colour 2 on the darkest blades.

Male/M_Earrings_Silly_Dragon_01.description: A pair of side-of-head ear pieces: chunky octagonal disc pods over the ears, each with a fan of pointed, wing-like fins sweeping backward and upward. Suggests a playful dragon or sci-fi headset look.
Male/M_Earrings_Silly_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the octagonal pod rims and sides; colour 3 on the pod outer faces; colour 0 on the winged fins; colour 2 on the outlines of the fins.

Male/M_Earrings_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of flat diamond-shaped plates with a slight raised pyramid face and a thin rim, mounted upright on each side of the head beside the eyes and ears like angular ear guards.
Male/M_Earrings_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diamond plates; colour 1 on the thin rim edges. Most of the surface shows the light colour.

Male/M_Earrings_Starhawk_02.description: A pair of small curved, faceted plates worn on the sides of the head over the ears, like angular earpieces or ear guards. Chunky bevelled edges give a sci-fi headset look.
Male/M_Earrings_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole faceted plates; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Swing_01.description: A pair of long, slender dangling earrings, each a faceted elongated spike or crystal shard hanging from a tiny hook at the earlobe, reaching down past the jaw toward the neck. Sleek and sharp-edged.
Male/M_Earrings_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 appears on the whole shard; the glossy faceted surface seems to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Earrings_Tactical_01.description: A pair of chunky, chamfered rectangular ear guards that sit over each ear like headphone cups, with a bevelled outer shell and a recessed, framed panel on the outer face. Suggests tactical or sci-fi headgear.
Male/M_Earrings_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shells; colour 1 on the outer rim of the recessed panel; colour 3 on the inner rim; colour 2 on the recessed panel centre.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Batears_01.description: A pair of large pointed bat ears that flare up and outward from the sides of the head, with ridged inner cups and small spiked tips inside; the smooth outer shells sweep back to sharp points.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Batears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rim of the ears; colour 1 on the ridged inner bands; colour 3 on the inner cup and small inner spikes.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Diamonds_01.description: A pair of flat, elongated diamond-shaped earrings hanging from the earlobes, each a thin faceted lozenge with slight thickness, sitting just below the ear beside the jaw.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Diamonds_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faces of the diamonds; colour 1 on the edge facets of the diamonds.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Djmadbot_01.description: Oversized DJ-style headphones: a thin curved band arches over the head to two rounded cup housings over the ears, each with an outward spindle of stacked rings ending in a small knob. Sci-fi and quirky.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Djmadbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband and spindle tips; colour 1 on the ear cups; colour 2 on the rings along the spindles.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Dragon_01.description: A pair of large membranous fin-shaped ear attachments that flare outward and upward from the sides of the head, with scalloped, pointed trailing edges, a rigid spine along the front edge and small mounts at the ears.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front spines and ear mounts; colour 1 on the inner membrane near the ear; colour 3 on the outer scalloped membrane edges; colour 2 on the small ear fittings.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Earguard_01.description: A pair of angular metal side guards on the temples: each is a slim blade-like plate that sweeps back along the head, then drops in a narrow curved shield past the ear toward the jaw, with a small rivet.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Earguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and edges; colour 1 on the striped top strip of each guard; colour 2 on the inner edge of the drop section.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Earguard_01.differs: The male guards are shorter and broader, ending nearer the ear and jaw.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_01.description: A pair of simple round hoop earrings, thin faceted rings hanging from the earlobes, one on each side of the head. A plain, small jewellery accessory with a casual, everyday look.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoops; the metal finish appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_02.description: A small plain hoop earring for the left ear: a thin, slightly faceted band ring hanging from the earlobe, viewed edge-on from the front and as a full circle from the side.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_03.description: A small plain hoop earring for the right ear: a thin, slightly faceted round band that hangs from the earlobe and sits beside the face. A simple, understated jewellery accent.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Earrings_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Fullhelmviper_01.description: A horseshoe-shaped helmet-like side piece that wraps around the head from the temples to the back and down to the jaw, with smooth angular plates, a ridged vent on the forehead and small grilles by the cheeks. The face stays open.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Fullhelmviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and cheek plates; colour 1 on the side panels and back trim bands; colour 2 on the inner frame and forehead plate; colour 3 on the forehead vent slats.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Fullhelmviper_02.description: A sci-fi helmet-like headpiece shaped as a horseshoe of armored panels that wraps over the crown, sides and back of the head, leaving the face open. Vented ridges on top and small light strips at the cheeks.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Fullhelmviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and raised rim; colour 1 on the top vent panel and the inner trim band; colour 3 on the vent slits and cheek light strips; colour 2 on the small back tabs.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Heart_01.description: A single small dangling earring: a thin round hoop hanging from the ear with a flat heart-shaped pendant below it. Worn on the right ear lobe; cute and simple.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Heart_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hoop; colour 0 on the heart pendant.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Heart_02.description: A small dangling earring for the left ear: a round ring at the lobe with a flat heart-shaped charm hanging beneath it on a tiny link. Cute, simple jewellery.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Heart_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring at the lobe; colour 0 on the heart charm.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Heart_03.description: A pair of small dangling earrings: each has a thin round ring hooked at the earlobe with a flat heart-shaped pendant hanging below. Cute, simple jewellery worn on both ears.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Heart_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rings; colour 0 on the heart pendants.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Curl_014arm.description: A pair of segmented curled horns, one on each side of the head, each rising from a wide band-like base at the temple and sweeping forward into a tapering point. Suggests a beast or demon look.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Curl_014arm.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the band-like bases at the head; colour 0 on the horn bodies, fading toward colour 1 at the tips.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_014arm.description: A pair of curved demon horns mounted at the sides of the head, each rising from a wide band over the ear, sweeping outward and forward, then hooking up into a sharp tip. Suits monstrous or fantasy looks.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_014arm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower horn shafts; colour 1 on the upper horn curves and tips; colour 3 on the mounting bands at the ears.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_Huge02.description: A pair of huge curved demon horns that sprout from the sides of the head, sweep outward and then up to sharp tips. Segmented ridges run along each horn, and a contrasting band sits at each base.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_Huge02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the upper horn shafts and tips, fading in as a gradient; colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_Huge03.description: A pair of tall, thick demon horns that sweep out sideways from the temples and curve upward to sharp points, with contrasting bands where they meet the head. Worn on the sides of the head as a monstrous fantasy accessory.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Demon_Huge03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the bands at the base of each horn.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Grond_01.description: A pair of thick, ridged curved horns mounted on chunky octagonal collars at the sides of the head, sweeping outward and back, then curling down to tapering points like a bull or beast.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Grond_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the collar mounts at the base of each horn; colour 0 on the ridged horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering horn tips.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Kigatilik_01.description: A pair of mismatched bull-like horns rising from the sides of the head: one sweeps out and up to a fine point, the other curls back with a wavy twist. Each has a contrasting band at its base.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Kigatilik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Spiral_02.description: A pair of segmented, spiralling horns that rise from the sides of the head, curve out and back in a wavy S-shape, and end in slender curved tips. Small jagged spurs stud the bends, giving a monstrous, demonic look.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Spiral_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 alternate in bands along the horn segments; colour 2 on the curved horn tips.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Yak_014arm.description: A pair of wide, curved horns projecting sideways from the sides of the head, each rising from a banded base at the temple and sweeping outward and down to a sharp tip, in a bovine or yak style.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horns_Yak_014arm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering horn tips; colour 3 on the bands at the horn bases.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Hornsfuturistic_01.description: A pair of ornamental curved horns that start at the temples, sweep outward and up around the head like a halo, and end in sharp upward points, with small spurs on the outer edges. Futuristic monstrous headpiece.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Hornsfuturistic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the horns, fading to a lighter tone at the bases; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horsemask_Longmane.description: A partial horse-mane headpiece: a thick ridge of mane runs from the forehead over the crown to the nape, with layered flowing strands draping down the left side of the head and small pointed tips at the front.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horsemask_Longmane.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the central mane ridge; colour 1 on the side strands and outer layers; colour 0 on the pointed tips and lower strand ends; colour 3 on the small inner underside patch.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horsemask_Longmane.description: A half-mohawk style mane covering the right side of the head: a ridge of stiff hair sweeps from front to back, with jagged pointed locks hanging down at the temple and behind the ear. Suggests a beastly horse-mane look.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horsemask_Longmane.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the raised central ridge of the mane; colour 1 on the main side of the mane; colour 0 on the pointed tips and lower locks; colour 3 on a small inner patch near the front.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horsemask_Shortman.description: A short, chunky mohawk-style mane running front to back along the centre of the head, arching over the crown and curling down toward the nape, built from faceted blocky panels with small side notches.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horsemask_Shortman.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front tuft, the front and rear tips and the lower edge panels; colour 1 on the main body of the mane; colour 2 on the top middle band; colour 3 on the small inner notches.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horsemask_Spikedma.description: A narrow mohawk-style crest of angular, jagged spikes running front to back along the centre of the head, sweeping down into a pointed tail at the nape. Suggests a beastly, punk mane.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Horsemask_Spikedma.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the spikes and the lower tail; colour 1 on the upper crest and spike sides; colour 2 on the small inner underside patches at the front and rear.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Human_Robot_Wings_.description: A pair of mechanical side-of-head wing accessories: large angular fins sweeping up and back from the temples, with smaller spiked fins below and jagged cheek-guard plates framing the face. Suggests a robotic helmet-style look.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Human_Robot_Wings_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large upper wing fins and smaller spikes; colour 0 on the jagged cheek plates and thin trailing blades; colour 2 on the ear pods; colour 3 on the small vent slashes and marks.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A pair of curved horn-like tusks that sweep forward and outward from the ears, tapering to points. Each has a separate tip section, giving a monstrous, beastly ear accessory.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the left horn; colour 2 on the base of the right horn; colour 0 on the tip of the right horn.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The male version has a contrasting tip on one horn and a differently coloured base, while the female version's horns are a single uniform colour.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Left_Pirate_Fancy_.description: A single left-ear earring: a faceted gem stud on the lobe with a thin faceted hoop hanging below it. A small, fancy pirate-style piece of jewellery.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Left_Pirate_Fancy_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoop; colour 1 on the gem stud.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Left_Skull_Earring.description: A small skull-shaped earring hanging from the left earlobe: a chunky, flat-backed skull with sunken eye sockets, a nose cavity and etched teeth lines. Gothic, macabre styling.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Left_Skull_Earring.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull body; colour 3 on the eye sockets and tooth grooves; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Lightning_02.description: A pair of flat, zigzag lightning-bolt blades mounted at the sides of the head by the temples, each sweeping upward and back to a sharp point like stylised antennae or wing-like head fins.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Lightning_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat faces of both bolts; the thin edges show a lighter tone, with no other slots visible.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Luchadorhawk_01.description: A pair of stylised hawk-head side pieces that sit against the temples, each a flat plate with a hooked beak-like point at the front, a small angular eye cut-out and swept feather-like fingers fanning up and back.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Luchadorhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the outlines and beak tips; colour 2 on the eye cut-outs.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Norsehorns_Decorat.description: A pair of decorative Norse-style horns that curve up and outward from the sides of the head. Each is a flat, scroll-tipped band with interlaced knotwork panels and a raised rim, giving a fantasy, Celtic look.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Norsehorns_Decorat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner faces and scroll ends of the horns; colour 1 on the raised rims and outlines; colour 2 on the knotwork panels.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A pair of earrings, each a thin faceted hoop hanging below a small hexagonal gem stud at the earlobe. A fancy, swashbuckling-style accessory that dangles just below the ear.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoops; colour 1 on the gem studs.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Prop_Arrow_01.description: A novelty headband made to look like an arrow passing through the head: a thin band arcs over the top of the skull, with a straight shaft, pointed head and fletched tail sticking out at the temples.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Prop_Arrow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arrowhead, shaft ends and fletching; colour 1 on the fletching vanes and the band's side sections; colour 2 on the top of the band and the centre of the shaft; colour 3 on small marks on the shaft.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Prop_Arrow_02.description: A novelty arrow-through-head prop: a straight shaft with a pointed head on one side and fletching on the other, joined by a curved band that arches over the top of the head, so the arrow appears to pierce the skull at ear level.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Prop_Arrow_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arrowhead, fletching and shaft ends; colour 1 on the shaft segments and the sides of the arching band; colour 2 on the top of the band and the central shaft; colour 3 on the small mark at the centre of the shaft.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Right_Pirate_Fancy.description: A single hoop earring for the right ear: a thick, faceted round ring hanging below the lobe, topped with a chunky faceted gemstone. A fancy pirate-style accessory.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Right_Pirate_Fancy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hoop; colour 1 on the gem.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Right_Skull_Earrin.description: A single skull-shaped ear ornament worn at the right ear: a flat-backed, rounded skull with deep round eye sockets, a nose cavity and carved teeth lines, sitting against the side of the head. Macabre, gothic accessory.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Right_Skull_Earrin.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull shell; colour 3 on the eye sockets and tooth grooves; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.description: A pair of mechanical side-of-head wing pieces: large angular swept-back fins rise from the temples, with smaller spikes below and a contrasting pod on each cheek that carries broad blade plates flaring along the jaw.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large upper fins and small spikes; colour 0 on the cheek blades and lower plates; colour 2 on the pods beside the eyes; colour 3 on the small slot markings.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.differs: The male version has broader, shorter cheek plates with wider contrasting slot markings, and slightly longer upper fins.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Skull_Earrings_01.description: A pair of chunky skull-shaped earrings hanging at the ears, each a small rounded skull with hollow eye sockets, a nose cavity and teeth ridges, giving a gothic, macabre accent.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Skull_Earrings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skull surfaces; colour 3 on the eye sockets and the tooth grooves.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Spikes_01_New.description: Clusters of short conical spikes of varying sizes jutting outward from each side of the head above the ears, angled back and sideways, giving a horned, monstrous or punk look.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Spikes_01_New.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the default material shows little variation from the other colour slots.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Toy_01.description: A pair of chunky retro headphone-style ear cups, each a rounded rim around a recessed speaker-like dish, sitting flat against the sides of the head over the ears with no band between them.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and shell of each cup; colour 1 on the recessed ring inside; colour 2 on the central speaker dish.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Welder_01.description: A head-wrapping armored band with a strap across the forehead and back of the head, carrying two rounded plates that flare down over the ears and cheeks; small round rivets or bolts and contrasting oval pads mark the strap.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plates and band; colour 2 on the round bolts and oval pads; colour 0 on the thin inner trim along the top edge of the band.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Welder_01.differs: The ear plates sit closer to the face and are broader and shorter, wrapping more snugly around the cheeks than on the female version.

Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Wings_01.description: A pair of angular, swept-back fin-like panels that sit at the sides of the head over the temples and ears, sweeping to a point behind the head with a short drop at the front. Art-deco, helmet-like styling.
Male/M_Earrings_Tight_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the panels; colour 1 on the inner panel faces; colour 2 on the inner edge segments near the ears; colour 3 on the small tips at the rear points.

Male/M_Earrings_Traveler_01.description: A single long curved feather worn at the side of the head, sweeping up and back from above the ear with a contrasting central quill and layered, ragged barbs along both edges.
Male/M_Earrings_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather barbs; colour 2 on the central quill and shading along the spine.

Male/M_Earrings_Trooper_04.description: A pair of tall, flat-sided angular blade fins that jut upward from the sides of the head just above the ears, tapering to a narrow base. Suggests a sentai-style helmet crest or horn-like antennae.

Male/M_Earrings_Victory_01.description: A pair of swept-back, winged head ornaments that attach at the sides of the head by the ears. Each is a cluster of long curved blades that flare upward and back, with shorter layered blades beneath. Fantasy or superhero styling.
Male/M_Earrings_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long outer blades; colour 1 on the smaller inner feather-like blades; colour 2 on the lowest blades and the base.

Male/M_Earrings_Vigilante_01.description: Headset-style ear guards: two chunky octagonal earcups with inset faceted gem-like panels on the outer faces, joined by a wide band that wraps around the back of the head. Sci-fi, sporty and superhero feel.
Male/M_Earrings_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the earcup housings; colour 3 on the inset outer panels; colour 0 on the head band; colour 1 on the thin edge trim of the band.
Male/M_Earrings_Vigilante_01.differs: The male band is taller and wider at the back of the head, while the female band is a thinner strip.

Male/M_Earrings_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A pair of long hanging cloth streamers, like a hennin veil, attached at the sides of the head and falling past the chest. Each ends in ragged, pointed tails and has a gradient from top to bottom.
Male/M_Earrings_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper streamers near the head; colour 1 on the lower flared, pointed tails; the two blend in a gradient between them.

Male/M_Earrings_Wolf_01.description: A pair of wide, curved wolf-ear blades mounted at the sides of the head, sweeping upward and back with a wavy flared tip and decorative scrollwork and a patterned band along the inner face.
Male/M_Earrings_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade surfaces; colour 3 on the patterned edge band; colour 1 on the swirl engraving; colour 2 on the outer rim.
Male/M_Earrings_Wolf_01.differs: The male version is shorter and broader, with a wavy flared tip that sweeps back, while the female one is tall, thin and upright.

Male/M_Earrings_Wooden_01.description: A pair of long dangling earrings: a small faceted stud at the earlobe, a thin twisted cord hanging down past the jaw, a small cuffed connector, and a round ring at the bottom, reaching to neck level.
Male/M_Earrings_Wooden_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ear studs and the bottom rings; colour 0 on the twisted cords and the small connector cuffs.

Male/M_Emblem_Astronaut_01.description: A boxy chest-mounted life-support unit with a V-shaped central panel, chunky rounded housings at the sides and two round knobs on top. Thin flexible hoses loop from the underside and wrap around the ribs toward the back.
Male/M_Emblem_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and V panel; colour 2 on the lower and side housing blocks; colour 3 on the two round knobs; colour 1 on the hoses.

Male/M_Emblem_Back_Child_Rocker_01.description: A small atom-shaped emblem of interlaced elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, sitting flat on the middle of the upper back like a printed or embossed badge. Suggests a sci-fi, rocker style.
Male/M_Emblem_Back_Child_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main orbit rings; colour 1 on the outline edge of the rings.

Male/M_Emblem_Bounty_01.description: A diagonal bandolier strap running from one shoulder across the chest to the opposite hip, with a square buckle plate and button at the shoulder and a row of short cartridge-like canisters along the front. A sci-fi western look.
Male/M_Emblem_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band; colour 1 on the strap edging; colour 2 on the buckle plate and canister centres; colour 3 on the button and canister caps.

Male/M_Emblem_Bounty_02.description: A diagonal bandolier strap running from one shoulder across the chest to the opposite hip, with a square buckle box holding a round button and a row of cylindrical shell cartridges. Space-western bounty hunter look.
Male/M_Emblem_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band; colour 1 on the strap edging; colour 2 on the square buckle box; colour 3 on the round button and the cartridge ends.

Male/M_Emblem_Chestlayer_Insignia_01.description: A chunky cylindrical chest emblem with a raised rim and a flat disc face showing an atom symbol of three looping orbits around a nucleus; sits at the upper centre of the chest in a superhero, sci-fi style.
Male/M_Emblem_Chestlayer_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cylinder body and rim; colour 1 on the disc face background; colour 0 on the atom symbol.

Male/M_Emblem_Chestlayer_Viperlogo_01.description: A chunky chest emblem shaped like a stylised snake head, with cut-out eye slits and fang-like inner details on a raised front face. It sits at the top of the chest as a thick, rounded triangular block.
Male/M_Emblem_Chestlayer_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised snake-head face and the block's sides; colour 1 on the recessed fang and mouth panel behind the cut-outs.

Male/M_Emblem_Chestwear_Egyptian_Scarab_.description: A winged scarab beetle emblem worn on the centre of the chest: a rounded segmented shell with splayed legs and raised forelegs, flanked by two spread feathered wings with layered contrasting bands. Ancient Egyptian style.
Male/M_Emblem_Chestwear_Egyptian_Scarab_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beetle shell, legs and wing feathers; colour 3 on the inner wing feather band; colour 2 on the upper wing band; colour 0 on the wing edge trim.

Male/M_Emblem_Child_Modern_Sapphire_03.description: A set of five small diamond-shaped studs, each with a raised metal frame and an oval gem at the centre, arranged in a shallow V across the lower chest and stomach as a decorative emblem.
Male/M_Emblem_Child_Modern_Sapphire_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diamond frames; colour 1 on the oval gems; the backs of the studs show plain frame colour.

Male/M_Emblem_Child_Prisoner_02.description: A restraint-style chest harness: a pointed, mask-like mechanical buckle plate with small studs sits at the sternum, with a short tab above and a flat strap looping around the ribcage across the lower chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Child_Prisoner_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the buckle plate; colour 1 on the strap and top tab; colour 3 on the small eye-like studs.

Male/M_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A single loose chain of chunky angular links worn as a harness around the torso, looping under the pectorals and across the chest with a small gap at the front centre. Gritty, rebellious metal accessory.
Male/M_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: The chain uses a glossy metal default material that largely ignores the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.description: Two heavy chain lengths draped across the upper chest and shoulders, with large overlapping loops curling over the shoulders and trailing along the collarbone and upper back. A rugged, mechanical renegade accessory.
Male/M_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.colourAreas: Default metal material largely ignores the colour scheme; the chain links show a metallic finish.
Male/M_Emblem_Child_Renegade_Chains_02.differs: The male chains form larger, overlapping loops that sit over the shoulders, with longer trailing lengths across the back.

Male/M_Emblem_Child_Strapped_01.description: A small flat atom-shaped chest emblem: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central dot, drawn as thin outlined bands. It sits on the upper chest and reads as a science-themed superhero badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Child_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit bands and centre dot; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the bands.

Male/M_Emblem_Combat_Pouch_01.description: A small rectangular box-shaped pouch worn on the upper chest as a front emblem, with a flap, rounded padded edges, contrasting border trim and a raised inset panel bearing a handle-like bracket mark.
Male/M_Emblem_Combat_Pouch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the border trim and edge binding; colour 1 on the inset panel; colour 3 on the bracket mark.

Male/M_Emblem_Cosmic_01.description: A small hexagonal chest emblem: a raised, chunky badge with a diagonal split face, a curved inset panel and a small rectangular tab at the top. It sits at the upper centre of the chest with a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Emblem_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top tab, the lower bevelled rim and the back; colour 1 on the curved inset panel and upper-left facet; colour 2 on the diagonal centre band; colour 3 on a small patch at the back edge.
Male/M_Emblem_Cosmic_01.differs: The male emblem has the light colour 0 on its top tab and lower rim, so it looks brighter by default, with a darker band only down the centre.

Male/M_Emblem_Cosmic_02.description: A small hexagonal chest emblem: a flat, thick slab with angular notched grooves and a swept, wing-like facet across the upper half, worn on the upper chest. It suggests a cosmic sci-fi badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper left section; colour 1 on the swept facet and the upper edge; colour 0 on the lower half of the face; colour 3 on a raised edge at the back.
Male/M_Emblem_Cosmic_02.differs: The male emblem shows a light lower panel and a clearly visible colour split across the face, while the female one is mostly contrasting and glossy.

Male/M_Emblem_Data_Panel_01.description: A small rectangular mechanical data panel worn on the midriff: a bevelled frame around a control face with an indicator light strip, three toggle switches, sliding rails and blocky keypads, held on by short pegs at the corners.
Male/M_Emblem_Data_Panel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel frame and face; colour 1 on the rails, keypads and light-strip surround; colour 2 on the switches and back pegs; colour 3 on the indicator lights and switch stripes.

Male/M_Emblem_Draycul_01.description: A chest emblem shaped like a monstrous skull face with sunken glowing eyes, flared ear-like side flanges and a row of long fangs hanging below the jaw. It sits at the centre of the chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the skull body and fangs; colour 3 on the eyes. Colours 0 and 1 are not visible.

Male/M_Emblem_Element_Fire_01.description: A flame-shaped chest emblem: two swooping, pointed wing-like tongues sweeping out across the upper chest and shoulders, joining in a V that tapers to a jagged point at the sternum. Translucent and wispy.
Male/M_Emblem_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole translucent flame emblem; the other colour slots are not visible.
Male/M_Emblem_Element_Fire_01.differs: This version is a translucent, glowing flame-like shape rather than the glossy reflective metallic look of the female version.

Male/M_Emblem_Flag_Tight_01.description: A small rectangular flag-like emblem panel resting on the upper chest, gently rippled and curving with the pectorals. Thin bordered edge; works as a simple chest badge or insignia on a bodysuit.
Male/M_Emblem_Flag_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole flag panel; the thin edge appears as a slightly lighter rim of the same panel.

Male/M_Emblem_Frigid_01.description: A small angular chest emblem: a deep V-shaped plate with two upswept blades framing a central faceted gem on a narrow stem, sitting at the top of the chest at the neckline. Sleek, sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Emblem_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer V-shaped plate; colour 2 on the stem and the gem's setting; colour 3 on the faceted gem.
Male/M_Emblem_Frigid_01.differs: The V plate is narrower and curves steeply over the pectorals, with the blades wrapping toward the sides of the chest.

Male/M_Emblem_Haltertop_Disctie_01.description: Two small octagonal disc emblems with engraved triple-spiral designs, sitting high on the chest near the shoulders and joined by two crossing cords. It reads as a mystic charm-like halter tie.
Male/M_Emblem_Haltertop_Disctie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc rims and backs; colour 1 on the spiral designs; colour 3 on the crossing cords.

Male/M_Emblem_Holly_01.description: A small holly-sprig emblem of three spiky-edged leaves around a cluster of three round berries, worn flat on the upper chest as a festive badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Holly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the three leaves; colour 1 on the berry cluster.
Male/M_Emblem_Holly_01.differs: The male holly sits centred on the chest and is slightly larger, rather than placed high toward the shoulder.

Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Badge_01.description: A small shield-shaped badge worn on the upper left chest, with a thick raised rim, a pointed star inside a round centre disc, and scrollwork beneath. It gives a police or superhero insignia look.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Badge_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised outer rim and the star outline; colour 0 on the shield face behind the star; colour 3 on the star and centre disc; colour 2 on the scrollwork below.

Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Holly_01.description: A small holly-sprig emblem: three spiky-edged leaves radiating from a cluster of three round berries, worn flat on the upper chest as a festive jacket decoration.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Holly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the three leaves; colour 1 on the berries.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Holly_01.differs: The male holly sits more centrally on the chest, over the pectoral, with the leaves spread more evenly.

Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_01.description: A small round medal badge with a raised star at the centre and concentric rings around the rim, hanging from a striped ribbon with two notched tails; worn on the upper chest of a jacket.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the medal face; colour 3 on the star and rim rings; colour 1 on the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon stripes and the back of the medal.

Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_02.description: A small decorative medal pinned on the upper chest: a faceted round disc with a crown emblem inside a laurel wreath, hanging by a ring from a short straight striped ribbon.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the medal face; colour 3 on the crown, laurel wreath, rim and ribbon bar; colour 1 on the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon stripes; colour 1 on the plain back of the disc.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_02.differs: The male ribbon is a straight-edged rectangle hanging upright, while the female ribbon is cut on a slant.

Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_03.description: A small medal badge worn on the upper chest: a domed centre with concentric rings inside a scalloped, eight-sided star plate, set on a two-tone ribbon with notched ends that extends to each side.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scalloped plate and dome; colour 3 on the concentric rings; colour 1 on the outer ribbon edges; colour 2 on the ribbon's centre stripe.
