Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_04.description: A small hexagonal medal badge with a raised rim, a ring of studs around a central embossed star, and three ribbon tails hanging below. It sits flat on the upper chest as a prize-style emblem.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rim, studs and star; colour 0 on the recessed face of the medal; colour 1 on the outer ribbon tails; colour 2 on the middle ribbon tail and the flat back.

Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_05.description: A small flat pentagonal medal badge with a raised rim and a notched top bar, holding a five-petal flower with a domed centre. Sits on the upper chest of a jacket as a decorative emblem.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Simple_Badge_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and top bar; colour 1 on the badge background; colour 2 on the flower petals and back plate; colour 3 on the domed flower centre.

Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Spy_01.description: A small rose emblem worn as a lapel-style flower pinned high on the left chest. Layered outer petals surround a tightly coiled centre bloom; formal, elegant spy styling.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer petals; colour 1 on the coiled centre of the rose.

Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Wedding_Boutonniere.description: A small formal boutonniere pinned on the upper chest: a layered, faceted flower of angular petals around a contrasting round centre, with a short cylindrical stem and broad pointed leaves fanning out to one side.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Wedding_Boutonniere.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flower petals; colour 2 on the flower centre and inner petal fold; colour 1 on the stem and leaves.
Male/M_Emblem_Jacket_Wedding_Boutonniere.differs: The male flower sits flatter against the chest, with broader leaves spread to one side and a shorter, mostly hidden stem.

Male/M_Emblem_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small mechanical chest emblem: a curved plate with notched sides and a crescent inlay along the bottom, a thick bent pipe down the middle, and two round bolt-like knobs with slotted heads at the top.
Male/M_Emblem_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate, including its back; colour 1 on the crescent inlay; colour 2 on the central pipe and the knob rims; colour 3 on the slotted knob faces.
Male/M_Emblem_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The back of the plate shows the light plate colour, whereas the female version's back is contrasting and matches the pipe.

Male/M_Emblem_Lockbox_66_02.description: A small chest emblem made of two separate chunky capsule pieces: a round hollow cylinder above and a rounded rectangular housing below with a recessed oval panel. It sits at the upper chest, tilted slightly.
Male/M_Emblem_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer housings; colour 3 on the inset oval panel; colour 2 on the inside of the round cylinder.

Male/M_Emblem_Modern_Sapphire_02.description: A set of small mechanical stud emblems on the front of the torso: three round gem-set discs of varying size in a vertical line from the collarbone down the chest, and five diamond-shaped gem studs in a V near the waist.
Male/M_Emblem_Modern_Sapphire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc rims and diamond frames; colour 1 on the gem centres.

Male/M_Emblem_Modern_Sapphire_03.description: A chest emblem of five small diamond-shaped metal studs, each with an oval gem set in the centre, arranged in a shallow V across the upper torso. The pieces are flat and sit against the body like decorative badges.
Male/M_Emblem_Modern_Sapphire_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the diamond frames; colour 1 on the oval gems; the backs of the studs take colour 0.

Male/M_Emblem_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A small chest emblem made of two round studded discs, each with an engraved star, joined by a pair of crossing thin straps that form an X across the upper chest below the collarbone.
Male/M_Emblem_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossing straps; colour 1 on the disc rims and faces; colour 2 on the star engravings.

Male/M_Emblem_Patriot_01.description: A chest emblem of three raised five-pointed stars in a row: a large central star with a bordered rim and faceted centre, flanked by two smaller plain stars. Sits high on the chest, in a patriotic superhero style.
Male/M_Emblem_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted centre of the large star; colour 3 on its outer rim; colour 1 on the two smaller flanking stars.

Male/M_Emblem_Prisoner_01.description: A mechanical chest harness: a faceted central plate with a gem-like inset and a pointed lower plate, two jointed arms with small hooked tips rising over the shoulders, and a looping strap band around the torso and back.
Male/M_Emblem_Prisoner_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central plates and arm tips; colour 3 on the inset gem; colour 1 on the strap loops and arm clamps; colour 2 on the arm tubes and small lights.
Male/M_Emblem_Prisoner_01.differs: The male strap crosses the lower chest and back in a flatter loop, with arms that sweep outward across the shoulders.

Male/M_Emblem_Prisoner_02.description: A mechanical restraint-style harness: a pointed, mask-like metal buckle plate with two small studs and a short strap tab sits on the sternum, with a flat band looping loosely around the lower ribs and back.
Male/M_Emblem_Prisoner_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal buckle plate; colour 1 on the strap tab and the encircling band; colour 3 on the small stud lights.
Male/M_Emblem_Prisoner_02.differs: The band hangs lower as a looser loop around the ribs, while the female band sits higher in a flatter V shape under the bust.

Male/M_Emblem_Prisoner_03.description: A shoulder harness of two flat riveted straps that loop around each shoulder in a twisted figure-eight and cross the upper chest, joined by a thick band across the upper back. Worn over a suit.
Male/M_Emblem_Prisoner_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the looped shoulder straps and rivets; colour 1 on the connecting band across the upper chest and back.
Male/M_Emblem_Prisoner_03.differs: The male harness has a wider, thicker connecting band across the upper back, and the straps cross over each other more diagonally at the chest.

Male/M_Emblem_Pumpkin_01.description: A small chest emblem: a faceted jack-o'-lantern skull face with angry eyes and a jagged grin, flanked by two pointed bat-like wings that sweep outward and down across the upper chest below the collarbones.
Male/M_Emblem_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pumpkin face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the mouth and the back of the face; colour 1 on the wings.

Male/M_Emblem_Renegade_Chains_01.description: A chest harness of heavy metal chain links crossing the torso and shoulders, with large loose looped chain ends over the shoulders and a round skull medallion on the chest; the back has a plain disc with chains spanning the shoulder blades.
Male/M_Emblem_Renegade_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chain links; colour 2 on the medallion backing and back disc; colour 3 on the skull eyes; colour 1 on a small part under the skull. The glossy metal largely ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Emblem_Renegade_Chains_01.differs: The male chains drape asymmetrically with bigger loops over the shoulders and the skull sits off-centre toward one side.

Male/M_Emblem_Scarab_01.description: A pair of curved mandible-like horns that arch over the top of each shoulder and hook down toward the upper chest, with a small banded joint before each tapering point. Suggests an insectoid, mechanical scarab look.
Male/M_Emblem_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long shoulder arms of the horns; colour 2 on the joint bands; colour 3 on the hooked tips.
Male/M_Emblem_Scarab_01.differs: The male horns sit closer to the neck and shoulders, with the tips hooking down less far onto the chest.

Male/M_Emblem_Scarab_02.description: A pair of curved, horn-like blades that rise from the collarbones over the shoulders: each has a hooked lower claw on the chest and a long, thorny upper spine sweeping up and back past the neck. Glossy, sci-fi insectoid look.
Male/M_Emblem_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper spined horns; colour 1 on the curved lower claw sections; colour 3 on the sharp tips; colour 2 on the small joints between sections.
Male/M_Emblem_Scarab_02.differs: The male horns sit wider over the shoulders and the lower claws run further down the chest, with a longer reach.

Male/M_Emblem_Small_L_Tight_01.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central nucleus ring, worn on the upper left of the chest. It sits flush on the suit like a badge, in a science-themed superhero style.
Male/M_Emblem_Small_L_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Male/M_Emblem_Small_L_Tight_Jacket_01.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, sitting on the upper left chest of a jacket or suit. Suggests a science or nuclear superhero look.
Male/M_Emblem_Small_L_Tight_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Male/M_Emblem_Small_Tight_01.description: A small atom-symbol chest emblem: three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus ring, with a slim raised outline. It sits flat on the upper chest, centred over the pecs, in a science or superhero style.
Male/M_Emblem_Small_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Emblem_Small_Tight_Jacket_01.description: A small raised atom emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus ring, worn flat on the upper centre of the chest over a jacket or tights. Suggests science or atomic-power themes.
Male/M_Emblem_Small_Tight_Jacket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the rings.

Male/M_Emblem_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A scarab beetle chest emblem: a rounded split-panel body with a small oval head, spindly legs and a pointed tail spike, flanked by two spread wings of serrated feather-like tiers. Sits on the upper chest, in an Egyptian style.
Male/M_Emblem_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing feathers, the outline rim and one half of the beetle body; colour 1 on the head, the legs and the other body panel; colour 2 on the wing bands and one body half; colour 3 on the small patch on the back of the shell.

Male/M_Emblem_Starhawk_01.description: A chest emblem shaped like a wide U or crescent with upswept curled tips and a pointed base, framing a faceted pyramid gem at the centre. Sits on the upper chest over the sternum, with a sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Emblem_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crescent frame; colour 3 on the accent stripes along the lower arms of the crescent; colour 1 on the faceted gem's outer sides and rim; colour 2 on the gem's inner facets and the underside.

Male/M_Emblem_Stars_01.description: A small emblem of two overlapping five-pointed stars with raised rims and recessed inset faces, one star tilted and partly behind the other. It sits on the upper chest, suiting a jacket or superhero costume.
Male/M_Emblem_Stars_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the inset face of the front star; colour 1 on the inset face of the rear star; colour 2 on the front star's rim; colour 0 on the rear star's rim and the star backs.

Male/M_Emblem_Stars_02.description: A small chest emblem of two overlapping five-pointed stars, a larger one in front and a smaller one tucked behind and offset to the upper right. Each has a raised rim and a recessed centre. It sits on the upper chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Stars_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the recessed centre of the front star; colour 2 on the front star's rim and the back of the emblem; colour 1 on the centre of the rear star; colour 0 on the rear star's rim.

Male/M_Emblem_Strapped_01.description: A round, domed chest emblem showing an atom symbol, ringed by a contrasting band and a rim with a row of pointed spikes around the edge. Sits centred on the chest, superhero and mechanical in style.
Male/M_Emblem_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and the atom symbol; colour 1 on the dome face and inner ring; colour 2 on the band, small tick marks and flat back; colour 3 on the spikes.

Male/M_Emblem_Straps_01.description: A pair of crossed chest straps forming an X over the torso, running from the shoulders down across the chest to the lower ribs, with small square emblem plates near the top and buckled ends at the lower edge.
Male/M_Emblem_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the edge piping and outlines; colour 3 on the emblem plates; colour 2 on the small lower-end details.
Male/M_Emblem_Straps_01.differs: The male straps cross higher on the chest and end at the lower ribs as flat bands, with emblem plates sitting closer to the shoulders.

Male/M_Emblem_Stripes_Tight_01.description: A small rectangular flag-like chest emblem made of three horizontal stripes of equal height, lying flat on the upper chest just below the collarbone with a slightly wavy cloth surface.
Male/M_Emblem_Stripes_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top stripe; colour 1 on the middle stripe; colour 2 on the bottom stripe.

Male/M_Emblem_Swing_01.description: A small mechanical chest emblem: a round-cornered gauge housing with bolted bezel and a needle dial, a small knob beneath, and a thin cable running across the chest to a flat plug tab. Sits high on the upper chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauge housing bezel and plug tab; colour 1 on the cable; colour 3 on the dial face and needle; colour 2 on the small knob and dial recesses.

Male/M_Emblem_Teddy_02.description: Two oversized sew-through buttons stacked vertically down the centre of the chest and upper stomach, each with a raised rim, recessed centre and four holes. A playful, cartoonish emblem that sits flat on the torso.
Male/M_Emblem_Teddy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rims and the flat backs; colour 1 on the recessed button faces; colour 2 on the four thread holes.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A small kite-shaped chest emblem: a faceted gem set in a raised angular frame with notched lower edges, flanked by two pointed crystal shards at the sides and a small shard below. Sits centred on the upper chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular frame; colour 3 on the central faceted gem; colour 1 on the three pointed side and lower shards.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A chest emblem shaped like a jagged, star-topped shield tapering to a point, with a raised metallic rim around a recessed gradient panel. It sits centred on the upper chest, standing slightly off the torso.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim; colour 1 on the upper part of the inner panel, fading into colour 2 toward the lower point.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A chest emblem shaped like a four-pointed star with a long downward tail, sitting on the centre of the chest as a slightly raised plate with a thin rim. Superhero look.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper face of the emblem, fading to colour 2 toward the lower point; colour 0 on the outer rim.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Badge_01.description: A small shield-shaped chest badge with a thick raised rim, a large star on a round centre disc and a curved scroll detail beneath. It sits on the upper chest and suits superhero or military costumes.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Badge_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the thick rim and the sides of the badge; colour 0 on the shield face behind the star; colour 3 on the star and centre disc; colour 2 on the scroll lines and the star's inner shading.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Egyptian_Scarab_01.description: A winged scarab beetle emblem worn across the upper chest: a rounded shell with raised legs and pincers, flanked by two spread feathered wings with layered bands. Egyptian-styled, and it sits flat on the chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Egyptian_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beetle body, legs and outer wing feathers; colour 2 on the upper wing band; colour 3 on the inner wing feather row; colour 0 on the wing edge trim.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Evilscientist_01.description: A small round chest emblem shaped like a domed gem set in a thick, faceted rim housing. It sits at the centre of the upper chest, giving a sci-fi power-core look.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Evilscientist_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim housing; colour 1 on the domed gem face.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A small art deco chest emblem: a central pointed shield-like fin flanked by two angled wing arms, each with a stepped contrasting edge. It sits on the upper chest, slightly raised from the suit.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central fin; colour 0 on the upper faces of the wing arms; colour 3 on the lower edge trim of the wing arms.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A chest emblem of swept, blade-like fins: two broad wing-like blades flare outward across the upper pecs, a small pair of curved horns rises from a central contrasting gem, and a pointed contrasting shard hangs down the sternum.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large swept wing blades; colour 3 on the curved horns at the top; colour 2 on the central gem; colour 0 on the lower pointed shard.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Firebird_01.differs: The male emblem lies flatter against the pecs, with the wings spread wider across the chest and the shard sitting lower on the sternum.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Foxbat_01.description: A small bat-shaped chest emblem: a thick, faceted raised badge with two swept wings, a pair of small ears at the top and a pointed tail hanging down the centre. It sits on the upper chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole badge; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.description: A small round chest emblem: a shallow disc with a raised rim and a stylised bat silhouette with pointed ears and a central wedge. It sits at the upper centre of the chest as a superhero badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Foxbat_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc face and rim; colour 2 on the bat silhouette and the side band; colour 1 on the accent edging around the bat and the inner lining; colour 3 on the central wedge.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A small oval faceted gemstone emblem worn on the upper centre of the chest, with a flat table top, angular cut facets around the sides and a flat contrasting back. Suits superhero or sci-fi costumes.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top table; colour 1 on some facets along the upper left edge; colour 3 as a faint tint on the table. The glossy gem material largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A small faceted rhomboid gem emblem worn upright on the upper chest below the collarbone, with a flat bevelled top face, angled side facets and a flat back. Suggests a sleek superhero or sci-fi badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The gem is glossy and mostly ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint from colour 1 shows on the upper left facet, and the flat back is near-solid.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small square faceted gemstone emblem with a flat top and bevelled, sloping sides, sitting on the upper centre of the chest. It has a glossy, cut-glass look suited to superhero or sci-fi suits.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 shows faintly as a tint on one bevelled side. No other slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A small chest emblem shaped like a faceted pentagonal gemstone, with a flat raised face and bevelled sloping edges. It sits on the upper chest near the collar, suggesting a tech-styled superhero badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy metallic faceted surface largely ignores the colour scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on it.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted heart-shaped gemstone emblem worn on the upper chest, with a raised inner heart facet and angled cut surfaces, and a flat solid back. It suits a glossy jewel-like superhero chest badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the inner raised facet; colour 1 on the upper left outer facets; colour 0 on the bright cut facets. The glossy gem finish only partly follows the scheme; the back is unlit and reads black.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A small faceted teardrop gemstone emblem worn on the upper chest below the collarbone, with a raised flat-topped table, angled cut sides and a flat back. Suggests a jewel-like superhero or sci-fi chest badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top face of the gem; the faceted sides and back show glossy gem-like shading that largely ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A large five-pointed star emblem across the centre of the chest, modelled as a chunky faceted piece with a raised central ridge and angled edges. Classic golden-age superhero chest badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Golden_Age_01.differs: The male star is larger, thicker and bulges outward with a ridged, faceted surface, while the female star is small, thin and flat, sitting high on the upper chest.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Golden_Age_02.description: A flat, thin lightning-bolt chest emblem with a stepped zigzag outline and a pointed lower tip, sitting on the upper chest and running diagonally down the torso. Classic retro superhero insignia.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A small round chest emblem shaped like a flat disc with a raised outer rim and a concentric ring in the centre. It sits on the upper chest as a partial mechanical badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the disc; colour 1 and colour 2 on separate sections of the back.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The male emblem is a plain solid disc with a raised ring, while the female one has a glowing, crackling energy texture.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Insignia_01.description: A small round chest emblem shaped like a thick disc with a raised rim, showing an atom symbol of three orbital rings and a nucleus on its face. It sits centred on the upper chest, superhero-style.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rim and the disc sides; colour 1 on the recessed face behind the symbol; colour 0 on the atom symbol.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Light_01.description: A small winged chest emblem worn at the base of the throat: a faceted shield-shaped badge with a central gem flanked by two swept-back feathered wings with raised rims, sitting on the upper chest and collarbone.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the badge face and the wing rims; colour 2 on the wing feathers; colour 3 on the badge's radiating segments and its back edge; colour 1 on the central gem.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A small hollow inverted-triangle chest emblem with a bevelled raised rim and an open centre. It sits at the top of the chest near the collarbone and follows the curve of the torso, suiting a clean superhero look.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the frame; colour 2 on the inner edges and the back of the frame.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Power_01.description: A small oval chest emblem: a raised metal-look rim studded with eight round bolts around a domed central cabochon, with a flat backing plate. It sits on the upper chest, suggesting a mechanical or sci-fi power badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim; colour 1 on the domed centre; colour 2 on the bolts and the flat back.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Prong_01.description: A small chest emblem: a round mechanical socket with a glowing core at the sternum, flanked by two angular bracket-like prongs that sweep outward and up across the pecs. Suits sci-fi superhero tights.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Prong_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the central socket housing; colour 3 on the inner core; colour 1 on the outer faces of the prongs; colour 0 on the inner edges of the prongs.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Prong_01.differs: The prongs on the male version spread wider and sit flatter across the chest, with taller upturned tips.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Prong_02.description: A pair of small angular chevron-shaped emblem blades mounted on the upper chest, each an L-shaped raised prong with a flat top face and thick edges, angled inward toward the sternum. Suggests a mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Prong_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top faces of the prongs; colour 1 on the outer sides and edges; colour 2 on the underside edges.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Ravenswood_01.description: A round, thick medallion emblem worn on the upper centre of the chest, with a raised rim and a stylised raven with swept, feather-like wings set into the disc. Suggests a heraldic superhero or gothic crest.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the disc face and its thick edge; colour 1 on the thin outer rim; colour 2 on the raven design.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: A small diamond-shaped chest emblem with a raised, bevelled plate and a round centre inset. Two pairs of curled, hook-like ribbon arms sweep out from either side. Sits at the centre of the upper chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bevelled diamond plate; colour 2 on the top and bottom points of the diamond; colour 3 on the centre inset; colour 1 on the curled ribbon arms.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A small diamond-shaped chest emblem: a chunky bevelled frame with a cross of ribs dividing four triangular inset windows. It sits flat at the upper centre of the chest, with a mechanical, superhero look.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and cross ribs; colour 1 on the inset triangular panels behind the ribs.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Sapphire_01.description: A small cluster of seven faceted diamond-shaped gems arranged in a loose diamond pattern on the lower chest and abdomen, standing slightly proud of the surface. A glossy jewel emblem for tight suits.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour slots appear ignored by the glossy gem material; the gems show a single glassy finish, so no slot visibly applies.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_01.description: A small round medal badge with a raised star at its centre and concentric rings, hung from a short two-tailed striped ribbon with notched ends. It sits upright on the upper chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the medal face rings; colour 3 on the star and outer rim; colour 1 on the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon stripes and the back of the medal.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_01.differs: The male medal hangs upright on the chest rather than being tilted diagonally.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_02.description: A small medal pinned on the upper chest: a rounded polygonal disc with a raised crown and laurel wreath, hanging by a small ring from a short striped ribbon. Suggests a military honour badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the medal face; colour 3 on the crown, laurel wreath, rim and ribbon bar; colour 1 on the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon stripes; the back of the disc uses colour 1.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_03.description: A small medal-style chest badge: a domed central boss ringed by two raised rims and a scalloped, notched rosette, with a striped ribbon band crossing behind it with swallow-tail ends. Sits on the upper chest.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rosette and dome; colour 3 on the raised rings; colour 1 on the outer edges of the ribbon; colour 2 on the ribbon's centre stripe.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_04.description: A small hexagonal medal badge with a raised rim, a ring of studs around a central star, and a trio of ribbon tails hanging below. It sits flat on the upper chest as a decorative emblem.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rim, studs and star; colour 0 on the face plate; colour 1 on the outer ribbon tails; colour 2 on the back plate and centre ribbon.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_05.description: A small flat pentagonal badge emblem with a raised rim, an inset panel and a five-lobed flower with a domed centre stud. It sits on the upper left chest, with a plain flat back.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Simple_Badge_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim frame; colour 1 on the inset panel behind the flower; colour 2 on the flower petals and the back; colour 3 on the central dome.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01.description: A small chest emblem of a skull with hollow eye sockets and marked brow lines, a rounded jaw block below, and swept blade wings across the upper chest with extra curved claw-like spurs curling down beside the skull.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the wing blades and curved spurs; colour 3 on the eye sockets, forehead gem and jaw block; colour 2 on the fine lines on the skull.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01.differs: The male version adds a second set of curved claw-like spurs beneath the wing blades, making it busier than the female version.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01_1.description: A small skull emblem worn at the top of the chest, with a jewel-like hexagonal gem hanging below the jaw, and swept-out blades spreading sideways behind the skull with extra small curved spurs below them.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the sideways blades and curved spurs; colour 3 on the hanging gem, the eye sockets and the forehead gem.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Skull_01_1.differs: The male version adds a second set of small curved spurs beneath the long swept-out blades, giving a more spidery, spiked look.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Snowflake_01.description: A small six-armed snowflake emblem of chunky, angular faceted metal, each arm with short side branches, worn flat on the centre of the chest like a brooch. Suits icy superhero or sci-fi looks.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Snowflake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faceted arms with a glossy metallic finish; colour 1 on the small inner core; colour 3 on thin edge lines along the arms. The metal finish largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Steelhawk_01.description: A flat winged chest emblem shaped like a hawk's outstretched wings, with feather-like slits at each tip, tapering to a point down the sternum. It sits on the upper chest, thin against the body, in a sleek superhero style.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Steelhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole winged emblem.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Sunmoon_01.description: A chest emblem of a contrasting eclipse disc with a crescent inset, ringed by wavy, flame-like sun rays of varying length. It sits flat on the centre of the upper chest, in a superhero style.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Sunmoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the central disc; colour 3 on the crescent inset; colour 1 on the inner part of the rays; colour 0 on the outer edges and rim of the rays.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Trumpknight_01.description: A small faceted gem-like brooch with a domed top and a pointed, cone-shaped underside, pinned high on the chest near the shoulder. A six-armed star pattern is streaked across the dome.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Trumpknight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and rim; colour 2 on the six star streaks and the underside facets. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible on this sheet.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Trumpknight_01.differs: The male brooch has a six-armed star pattern across the dome, while the female version has a contrasting band and a rectangular mark.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Viperlogo_01.description: A chunky raised chest emblem shaped like a snake head, a rounded inverted-triangle plate with cut-out eyes and a fanged, zigzag mouth inset. It sits centred on the upper chest, suggesting a superhero or mechanical look.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised plate and its sides; colour 1 on the recessed eye and fang inset areas.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Wedding_Boutonniere_.description: A small formal boutonniere flower pinned on the upper chest: layered angular faceted petals around a contrasting central bud, with a short wrapped stem and two pointed ribbon-like leaves trailing down and outward.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Wedding_Boutonniere_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the petals; colour 2 on the central bud and the small inner petal panels; colour 1 on the stem wrap and trailing leaves; colour 3 as faint blush at the petal bases.

Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Wolf_01.description: A pair of tall, curved blade-like fins rising from the collarbones on either side of the neck, each with a decorative swirl-patterned face and a smooth back. Sweeps up and outward like a flared mechanical collar.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat inner faces of the fins; colour 1 on the swirl motifs; colour 3 on the rim edging; colour 2 on the smooth outer backs.
Male/M_Emblem_Tight_Wolf_01.differs: The male fins sweep wider and curl further outward from the neck, sitting higher on the shoulders.

Male/M_Emblem_Trooper_01.description: A small chest emblem: a shield-shaped badge with a faceted hexagonal gem at its centre, a layered rim, and swept, spiky wing-like blades extending outward on both sides. It sits high on the chest over a bodysuit.
Male/M_Emblem_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer winged frame; colour 2 on the inner bezel and back plate; colour 3 on the central gem.

Male/M_Emblem_Victory_01.description: A small faceted diamond-shaped chest emblem with a short upper point and a long downward-tapering lower point, standing slightly proud of the body at the upper centre of the chest. Suggests a gem-like superhero badge.
Male/M_Emblem_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper facets; colour 1 fading across the lower facets toward the tip.

Male/M_Emblemb_Tight_01.description: A flat atom-style emblem on the upper back: three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a small central nucleus, drawn as a thin raised outline. Sits between the shoulder blades as a superhero or sci-fi chest-of-back badge.
Male/M_Emblemb_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings; the nucleus follows colour 0.

Male/M_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_01.description: Two thin rectangular service-ribbon bars stacked in parallel on the upper chest, each with vertical stripes of varying widths; flat, slightly raised badges suggesting a military dress jacket.
Male/M_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide light stripes; colour 1 on the stripes; colour 2 on the narrow stripes; colour 3 on the wide stripes.
Male/M_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_01.differs: The male bars sit nearly level across the chest instead of tilting.

Male/M_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_01.description: Two small rectangular service-ribbon bars stacked on the upper left chest, each a flat strip of vertical stripes in varied widths, like military medal ribbons; a longer bar sits below a shorter one.
Male/M_Emblemf_Jacket_Militarystripes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide light stripes; colour 1 on the broad and thin stripes; colour 2 on the narrow stripes; colour 3 on the wide stripes and thin accent lines.

Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Circular_01.description: A small chest emblem shaped like a short cylindrical turbine housing, with a rim and a circular fan face of radial vents around a central logo. It sits on the upper chest and juts outward.
Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Circular_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cylindrical housing; colour 0 on the outer rim ring of the face; colour 2 on the fan vanes and backing; colour 3 on the central symbol and markings.

Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Clownflower_01.description: A small chest emblem shaped like a four-petal flower with puffy, padded petals around a rounded octagonal centre stud, held by small clips at the petal gaps. Sits on the upper left chest.
Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Clownflower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the puffy petals; colour 1 on the centre button; colour 2 on the small clips between the petals.

Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_01.description: A large six-pointed sheriff's star badge with a raised lettered centre and a ball tip on each point, pinned on the left of the chest. Old-west lawman style.
Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the star body; colour 3 on the SHERIFF lettering; colour 2 on the ball tips.
Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_01.differs: The male badge is larger and sits flatter on the centre of the chest rather than up toward the shoulder.

Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_02.description: A five-pointed sheriff's star badge with the word SHERIFF embossed across the face and a small round ball tip on each point. It sits on the upper left chest as a western lawman emblem.
Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the star face; colour 3 on the SHERIFF lettering and small speckles; colour 2 on the ball tips.
Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_02.differs: The male badge has five points, while the female badge has six.

Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_03.description: A small sheriff's badge shaped as a six-pointed star with a ball tip on each point and raised SHERIFF lettering across the face. It sits on the upper chest as a western emblem.
Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the star face; colour 1 on the shading toward the points; colour 3 on the SHERIFF lettering and speckles; colour 2 on the ball tips.
Male/M_Emblemf_Tight_Tinstar_03.differs: This version is a six-pointed star, while the female version is a five-pointed star.

Male/M_Eye_Birdpeople_01.description: A beaked, helmet-like head shell: a smooth curved plate covers the brow and forehead and narrows into a pointed nose guard, with a thick rim and angular cheek flaps framing the face. Suggests a bird-like mask.
Male/M_Eye_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth outer plate; colour 2 on the rim, cheek flaps and inner shell.

Male/M_Eye_Bonemantis_01.description: A pair of large, rounded bug-eye lenses that sit over the eyes, each a bulging domed lens set in a thick padded rim, with open flat backs. Suggests an insectoid mantis mask or goggles.
Male/M_Eye_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded outer rims; colour 3 on the domed lens faces.

Male/M_Eye_Cardboard_Foxbat_01.description: A flat, thin cardboard cut-out mask held in front of the face: an irregular angular outline with a printed cartoon face of a snarling, grimacing hero with pointed cowl ears and a border around the edge.
Male/M_Eye_Cardboard_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the border around the edge of the cut-out; the printed face artwork ignores the colour scheme and keeps its own fixed painted look.
Male/M_Eye_Cardboard_Foxbat_01.differs: The male cut-out stands upright close to the face, while the female one is tilted slightly away from the face.

Male/M_Eye_Celestial_Halo_01.description: A flat forehead emblem lying against the skull: a small ring at the crown over a slim vertical bar with anchor-like curved ends running down the brow, flanked by a pair of swept feathered wings. Mystic, angelic style.
Male/M_Eye_Celestial_Halo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the halo ring; colour 1 on the two wings; colour 2 on the vertical bar and its curved ends.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Anniversary_Defender_01.description: A simple flat, curved mask panel that wraps over the lower half of the face, covering the nose, mouth and chin with angled top edges. Plain retro superhero styling with no visible fastenings.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Anniversary_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer face of the mask; the inner face shows a lighter sheen from colour 1.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Beast_Spider_01.description: A set of spider-like extra eyes: glossy rounded orbs in graduated sizes across the forehead and around the eye line, plus a pair of small contrasting horn-like knobs at the temples. Suggests a monstrous arachnid look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Beast_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large and small forehead eyes; colour 3 on the two central lower eyes; colour 1 on the outer lower eyes; colour 2 on the temple knobs.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Beast_Spider_01.differs: The lower eye cluster sits at eye level across the brow line, rather than lower on the cheeks.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Bonemantis_01.description: A pair of large, rounded insect-style compound eyes: oval domed lenses set in thick padded rims, sitting over the eye sockets and bulging out from the face, with flat, hollow backs.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick rims around each eye; colour 3 on the domed eye lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Chronos_01.description: Slim wraparound-style shades: two flat octagonal lenses in thin angular frames joined by a narrow bridge across the nose, with a short arm at each side. Sits directly over the eyes; sleek, retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Chronos_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the frames, bridge and arms; the lenses stay near-and do not take the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Chronos_02.description: A pair of chunky octagonal goggles with round contrasting lenses, worn pushed up on the forehead above the eyes. Bent tube arms with small connectors run down each side, giving a quirky mechanical look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Chronos_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the octagonal goggle housings; colour 3 on the bent tube arms; colour 0 on the small connectors; colour 2 on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Crow_01.description: A set of extra eyeballs scattered across the head: one on the forehead, two higher on the brow and clusters at each temple, sitting on the skin as a monstrous multi-eyed look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Crow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball whites; colour 1 on the irises.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Demon_01.description: A rigid, angular lower-face mask: a curved plate that wraps from cheek to cheek, covering the nose bridge down to the chin with a pointed lower edge and a thin contrasting rim along the top.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Demon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the rim along the upper edge; colour 1 on the main face plate, fading darker toward the top.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Drone_01.description: A pair of short octagonal barrel-shaped eye pieces that sit over each eye like mechanical lenses, with banded ribbing around the tubes and a glowing-looking lens at the front end. Robotic drone look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Drone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel bodies; colour 1 on the thin ring bands; colour 2 on the darker bands and rear edges; colour 3 on the lens faces.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Emblem_02.description: A flat atom-style emblem on the forehead: three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a small central nucleus, drawn as thin outlined bands. It sits flush against the skin like a decal or tattoo.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Emblem_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_01.description: Oversized novelty glasses made of two flat heart-shaped lenses that sit over the eyes and flare out past the sides of the face, with no visible frame or arms. Cute, playful eyewear.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole heart-shaped lenses; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_02.description: Oversized translucent wraparound lenses that cover both eyes as one wide shield, sweeping outward into pointed wing-like tips beside the temples. No frame or strap is visible. Sleek, sci-fi shades.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_02.colourAreas: The lenses appear as a single tinted translucent glass surface that does not clearly take any colour slot from the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Smal.description: Small heart-shaped glasses: two flat, translucent angular lenses sit over the eyes, joined across the nose, with no visible frame or arms. Playful, novelty-style eyewear.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Smal.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the translucent lenses; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Smal.description: Oversized frameless wraparound lenses: two faceted, angular translucent shades cover the eyes and sweep out to pointed tips at the temples, with no visible frame or arms. Sleek, modern eyewear.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Smal.colourAreas: Colour scheme has little visible effect; the translucent lenses take a single tint, with no separate frame to colour.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glassesaviator_02.description: A pair of aviator-style sunglasses reduced to two rounded, slightly angular lens shapes floating over the eyes, with no visible frame, bridge or arms. Sleek and casual with a classic pilot look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glassesaviator_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both lenses, glossy and unaffected by the other slots; the inner faces catch a gradient sheen.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Glassesaviator_02.differs: The male lenses appear as a doubled, layered pair of shapes when seen from the side.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Googly_01.description: Two flat, round disc-shaped pads that sit on the face just below and outside the eyes, like oversized cartoon googly eyes or cheek stickers. They are simple, smooth and thin, with no other detail.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Googly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both discs; the back faces show the same slot.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Googly_Fullhelm_01.description: Two flat, round disc eyes that sit on the cheeks just below and outside the natural eyes, like cartoon googly eyes. They are tiny, thin and meant to show through a full helmet; the piece is otherwise plain.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Face_Googly_Fullhelm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both round discs; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Full_Dino_01.description: A pair of small round, octagon-edged discs mounted on either side of the head near the temples, each with a domed centre lens and a raised rim. They read as tech sensor pods or ear-mounted lights.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Full_Dino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer casings; colour 1 on the recessed centre lens of each disc.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Glasses_Spy_01.description: A pair of round, translucent tinted lenses floating in front of the eyes, with no visible frame or bridge. A thin temple sliver shows at the side, giving a simple spy-style round sunglasses look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Glasses_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the lens faces; no other features take a colour slot.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Glasses_Spy_01.differs: The male lenses are lighter and more transparent, and thin slivers show at the side of the temple.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Gogglesbubble_02.description: A pair of separate rounded bubble lenses that sit directly over the eyes, with no frame or strap. They curve slightly around the sides of the face, giving an insectlike or alien look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Gogglesbubble_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lens surfaces, fading to darker edges; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Gogglesbubble_03.description: Two small rounded bubble lenses sitting side by side on the forehead, like goggles pushed up on the head, with no visible strap or frame. A small, cute, monstrous or mechanical look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Gogglesbubble_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lens domes; colour 2 on the darker rims and edges of each lens.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Head_Bucket_01.description: A pair of chunky, separate octagonal bucket-shaped eye cylinders worn over the eyes. One has a slatted vent grille, the other a glowing lens; small pegs stick out around each rim. Robotic, toy-like look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Head_Bucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bucket housings; colour 1 on the small pegs; colour 2 on the vent grille interior; colour 3 on the round lens.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Mask_Animatronic_01.description: A mechanical lower-face and jaw guard with a segmented toothed plate across the mouth and upright side struts, plus floating angular blade-like horns and a chevron brow piece above the eyes. Suggests robotic or monstrous style.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Mask_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the horns, brow chevron and side struts; colour 2 on the jaw housing; colour 0 on the segmented mouth plates; colour 3 on the small lights.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Mask_Lion_01.description: A pair of pointed, lion-style ears that sit on the upper sides of the head. Each is a cupped, angular shell with a striped inner face, giving a beastly, animal-costume look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Mask_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rims of the ears; colour 1 and colour 2 on the alternating stripes of the inner ear faces.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Mask_Rustbucket_01.description: A pair of bulging, faceted cup-shaped eye housings that sit over each eye, each with a round lens disc bearing an upward arrow. A mechanical, cartoonish look suggesting a robot or junk-built mask.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Mask_Rustbucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted housings; colour 1 on the round lens discs; colour 2 on the arrow symbols.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A pair of separate angular eye shields, each a flat, swept-up wedge that covers the eye area with a raised, bevelled upper edge. They sit on the face like slim visor lenses, with a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised upper rims; colour 2 on the main lens panels. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Qularr1eyes_01.description: A single large cyclops eyeball that replaces the eyes, placed over the bridge of the nose. It is a hollow rounded shell with a faceted rim, a round iris and a contrasting pupil.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Qularr1eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball and rim; colour 1 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Qularr2eyes_01.description: Two large round eyeballs with a rim of lid-like contrasting shell, mounted on the sides of the face beside the cheeks and facing forward. A monstrous, alien extra-eye look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Qularr2eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and shell; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Qularr3eyes_01.description: Three separate hollow eyeball shells floating in front of the face: one over the nose bridge and one beside each cheek, each with a rounded rim and a central pupil. An alien, monstrous replacement for the normal eyes.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Qularr3eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and outer shell of each eyeball; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Qularr4eyes_01.description: Four extra eyeballs floating beside the face: a large pair on the cheeks and a smaller pair above them near the temples, each a rounded socket rim with an iris and pupil. A monstrous alien look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Qularr4eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball whites and socket rims; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Scuba_01.description: A wide, wraparound visor band that covers the eyes and brow in one piece. It has a V-notched top edge, angular faceted sides and a smooth curve that runs around the head to the ears. Suits sleek sci-fi or superhero looks.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Scuba_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor band; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Scuba_02.description: A snorkel-style breathing tube: a rigid vertical pipe rising beside the head with a capped top, bending under the jaw into a ribbed flexible hose that curves up to the mouth. Reads as scuba or diving gear.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Scuba_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rigid tube; colour 3 on the top cap; colour 2 on the ribbed mouth hose; colour 1 on the small ring at the bend.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Starhawk_01.description: A thin, curved domino-style eye mask: a single winged shape with pointed upper outer corners and a notched bridge over the nose, wrapping the eyes and temples. Superhero style.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mask; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Starhawk_02.description: A wraparound visor-style eye piece: a single smooth, angular shield with a V-shaped dip over the nose and upswept pointed ends that curve back toward the temples. Suggests a sleek sci-fi or superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor; the glossy default material looks mostly unaffected by the other slots.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Swing_01.description: A pair of small oval lenses floating in front of the eyes with no frames, bridge or arms. They read as simple rimless glasses or monocle-like discs, translucent and slightly tilted.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Swing_01.colourAreas: Default material looks glassy and translucent, so it mostly ignores the colour scheme; no slot is clearly visible on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.description: A wraparound visor-style eye band: a single angular, faceted glossy strip that spans both eyes and curves around the sides of the head toward the temples. Sleek, futuristic shades.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour scheme appears ignored by the glossy default material; the whole band shows a glossy finish with no distinct slot areas.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Mask_Skull_01.description: A pair of flat, angular eye patches shaped like skull eye sockets, each with a pointed spike at the outer upper corner. They sit directly over the eyes and give a menacing masked look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Mask_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on both eye patches; the left patch appears in a darker shade from shading only.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Mask_Zorran_01.description: A pair of ridged ram-like horns that curl out from the sides of the head, sweeping back and around in a spiral with tapering tips. Suits beastly, demonic or fantasy characters.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Mask_Zorran_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged outer body of each horn; colour 1 on the tapering tips and inner curl.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Sharp_01.description: A thin, angular visor-style eye mask forming a single sharp winged band across both eyes, with a dipped centre over the nose and long points sweeping up and out at the temples. Suggests a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Sharp_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole mask, fading toward a darker shade at the lower edge; other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Ski_01.description: A wraparound ski goggle visor: a single curved glossy lens shield with a thin rim and a notched nose cutout. It sits pushed up on the forehead and wraps toward the temples. Sporty, sleek look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Ski_01.colourAreas: The glossy lens takes on a reflective sheen and mostly ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on the upper edge and colour 3 as a slight tint inside the lens.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Ski_02.description: Wide wraparound ski goggles with a single glossy visor lens in a thick moulded rim, curving around the eyes from temple to temple with a nose cutout. Sits over the eyes, sleek and sporty.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Ski_02.colourAreas: The glossy visor and rim ignore the colour scheme, showing a fixed glossy finish; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_01.description: A wraparound visor band of faceted, angular glass that covers both eyes in one continuous strip, with peaked upswept corners above the outer eyes and a slight dip at the nose bridge. Sleek sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: The whole visor is glossy glass that largely ignores the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_02.description: A thin, angular visor-like slit that spans both eyes, sitting nearly flat across the brow line with only a slight dip at the centre. It has a bevelled edge and no strap, suggesting a sleek tactical or sci-fi eyepiece.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole slit band; the glossy material appears to largely ignore the other colour slots.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_02.differs: The male version is flatter across the face with only a slight centre dip, rather than a pronounced V.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_03.description: A pair of small, flat, angular visor slats floating just under the eyes, each a slim tapered wedge with chamfered ends that angles outward. Suggests a minimal tactical or sci-fi eye accessory.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both slats; the material looks glossy and shows little of the other colour slots.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_04.description: A slim angular visor bar that spans both eyes as one band, with a sharp upward-swept notch at the centre above the nose bridge and tapered wrap-around ends. It reads as a sleek sci-fi or tactical eyepiece.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor band; the glossy metallic finish appears to ignore the other colour slots.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Tight_Tactical_04.differs: The male visor has a deeper, sharper notch swooping up at the centre, while the female has a shallower, flatter dip.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_01.description: A curved, shield-like face plate that wraps from cheek to cheek, covering the face from brow to chin with a pointed lower edge and a swept-up brow line. It has a pixelated angry-eye pattern and a small stitched mouth mark on the front.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the pixelated eye shapes; colour 2 on the mouth line.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_03.description: A single curved, blade-like plate that sweeps from beside the nose out over the cheekbone and eye, tapering to a point toward the temple. It suggests a beastly or armored face guard.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the plate; colour 1 on the inner surface facing the face.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_04.description: A sleek mechanical face mask covering the eyes, nose and mouth in a tapered, beak-like shape, with angular swept-back wings at the temples, a raised rim, angled eye slashes and a jagged zigzag mouth line.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the raised rim along the brow and edges; colour 3 on the angled eye markings; colour 2 on the jagged mouth line.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_06.description: A pair of flat, round disc lenses floating in front of each eye, with thin bevelled edges and no frame or strap. They give a blank, mechanical eye-cover look.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both discs; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Alt_01.description: A pair of long, sharp conical spikes that jut up and outward from the sides of the head above the ears, like pointed horns or blades. They suggest a fantasy or monstrous helm.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; the default material appears metallic and largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Alt_04.description: A headband with two tall pointed ears rising from the top of the head. Each ear has a thick angular frame with cross struts around an inset panel, and a solid wedge back. Suggests a feline or beast helmet.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Alt_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frames, struts and headband; colour 1 on the solid rear wedges of the ears; colour 3 on the inset panels inside the frames.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_01.description: A faint glowing accessory of tiny, thin tick-like marks in short rows, arranged along the jawline and chin like delicate runic or stitched markings, rather than around the eyes.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glowing marks; the default glow material appears to ignore the other colour slots.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_01.differs: The male version sits along the jaw and chin, while the female version sits around the eyes and brow.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_04.description: A glowing eye accessory made of a translucent cloud of binary digits, 0s and 1s, floating in a curved sheet across the cheeks and nose in front of the lower face, fading toward the ears.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_04.colourAreas: The glowing digits ignore the colour scheme and show as a self-lit glow; no colour slot is clearly visible.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Valorous_Glow_04.differs: The male version shows a floating cloud of glowing binary digits across the face, while the female version shows no visible effect.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Werewolf_01.description: A pair of jagged, swept-back tufts on either side of the forehead and temples, with serrated spiky edges. They read as a feral werewolf-style brow or hairline that leaves the rest of the head bare.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both tufts; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Eye_Child_Werewolf_02.description: A pair of swept-back tufts of fur that sit on the temples and the sides of the forehead, each made of layered, pointed locks that flare outward like a bushy werewolf brow.
Male/M_Eye_Child_Werewolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bulk of the fur tufts; colour 0 on the tips and lower edges of the locks.

Male/M_Eye_Childqularr_8eyes_01.description: Eight small faceted eyeballs in two clusters of four, one cluster on each side of the face beside the cheeks and temples. Each has a contrasting pupil, giving a monstrous, many-eyed look while the head stays bare.
Male/M_Eye_Childqularr_8eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whites of the eyeballs; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Eye_Chronos_01.description: A wraparound visor mask with a swept, winged upper edge, curving from temple to temple over the eyes, with octagonal framed eye slots. A pair of small octagonal goggle lenses on wire arms sits above the brow.
Male/M_Eye_Chronos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the visor shell; colour 3 on the eye-slot rims and the wire arms; colour 1 on the raised goggle housings; colour 2 on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Corrupted_01.description: A crown-like eye mask of jagged, curved thorn blades that sweep up from the brow and cheeks, with a central spike over the forehead and outer barbs flaring sideways. Monstrous, angular and spiky.
Male/M_Eye_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall inner thorns; colour 1 on the middle curved blades; colour 2 on the outer flared barbs; colour 3 on the central forehead spike.

Male/M_Eye_Cosmos_01.description: A large angular visor-helm shaped like a wide inverted triangle, covering the eyes and forehead and flaring out past the head. Its front has a raised central panel with radiating stripe ribs, and a deep shell wraps behind.
Male/M_Eye_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide outer plates and stripes; colour 1 on the central raised panel; colour 3 on the raised ribs and back centre lines; colour 2 on the underside shell.

Male/M_Eye_Crimson_01.description: A fantasy eye mask formed of swept, thorn-like metal filaments that curl around the brow and cheeks, with a pointed nose bridge and a pair of tall curved horns rising from the forehead.
Male/M_Eye_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow and cheek filigree and nose bridge; colour 1 on the two tall curved horns.

Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Sciencegroupfemalesupe.description: Bug-eye goggles made of two large, smooth, rounded lens pods that sit over each eye. They have faceted edges, no visible strap, and a bulbous insect-like look suited to cyborg or sci-fi designs.
Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Sciencegroupfemalesupe.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both lens pods; no other colour slots are visible on this sheet.

Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_01.description: A faceted, angular mask plate covering the eyes, nose bridge and upper cheeks, with two narrow eye slits and a pointed nose ridge. Its side wings wrap toward the temples. Sleek cyborg look.
Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and nose ridge; colour 1 on the side wings at the temples and cheeks.

Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_02.description: A cyborg face-plate visor covering the eyes, nose and cheeks: an angular, faceted shell with a narrow slit across the eyes and a trim edge below, with hanging vertical rods like wires dangling over the mouth and jaw.
Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 1 on the lower edge trim along the cheeks; colour 3 on the visor slit across the eyes; colour 2 on the hanging rods and wires.

Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_03.description: A robotic eyeplate visor: an angular faceplate across the eyes and nose bridge with a recessed slit, and broad cheek-guard side plates flaring down each side, with short wire prongs below the nose.
Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faceplate; colour 3 on the inner slit; colour 1 on the broad side plates and edge trim; colour 2 on the short wires under the nose.
Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_03.differs: The male version has broad solid side plates over the cheeks, where the female has hanging wire strands.

Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_04.description: A robotic skull-like face mask with two round glowing eye sockets, a raised forehead plate, a angular nose bridge, and pairs of piston-like cylinders hanging down over the cheeks and jaw.
Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face plate, nose and cheek pistons; colour 1 on the forehead plate; colour 3 on the eye lenses; colour 2 on the joint between forehead and nose.
Male/M_Eye_Cyborg_Visor_04.differs: The male version has two separate round contrasting eyes, a contrasting forehead plate and dangling jaw pistons, while the female version is a wide visor with a horizontal eye slit and side cheek plates.

Male/M_Eye_Datareaper_01.description: A angular face mask covering the nose, mouth and chin, with a faceted front plate, a single round lens-like port at the centre, side jaw plates and a segmented chin guard. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Male/M_Eye_Datareaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main front plate; colour 0 on the side jaw plates and chin band; colour 2 on the chin guard and inner port; colour 3 on the rings of the round port.

Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Both_01.description: A pair of small atom-shaped emblems, each made of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, placed flat on each cheek below the eyes like face decals.
Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Both_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 2 on the outlines and nucleus edges.

Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Both_02.description: A pair of small atom-style emblems, each made of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, placed flat on each cheek below the eyes like face decals.
Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Both_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 2 on the thin outline edging and nucleus detail.

Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Both_03.description: A pair of small atom-shaped emblems, each with three looping elliptical orbits around a central ring, placed flat on the cheeks below the eyes like face decals or markings.
Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Both_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit outlines; colour 1 on the inner fill of the orbits and central ring; colour 2 on the thin edge outlines.

Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Left_01.description: A flat atom-symbol emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a small central nucleus, applied like a decal on the left cheek below the eye. Suggests a science or superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Left_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin outline and the nucleus ring.

Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Left_02.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central nucleus, applied like a decal or tattoo on the left cheek below the eye. It has no relief and sits flush with the skin.
Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Left_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the outlines and the central nucleus.

Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Right_01.description: A small atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central ring, sitting flat on the cheek below the right eye like a raised decal or tattoo. Suggests a sci-fi or science-themed face mark.
Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Right_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the orbit rings; colour 1 on the thin outline edges of the rings.

Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Right_02.description: A small atom-style emblem on the right cheek: three interlocking elliptical rings around a central ring, raised like thin wire loops. It sits on the cheek below the eye and suggests a sci-fi or scientific look.
Male/M_Eye_Emblem_Right_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the rings; colour 1 on the thin edge outline of the rings.

Male/M_Eye_Extra_Googly_01.description: A pair of oversized, domed disc lenses sitting in front of the eyes, glossy and slightly convex on the front with hollow dish backs. A comical, cartoonish googly-eye look that suggests a goofy monster or mechanical mask.
Male/M_Eye_Extra_Googly_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material appears to ignore the colour scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on the discs.

Male/M_Eye_Extra_Googly_Fullhelm_01.description: A pair of large, round, slightly domed disc eyes that sit over the eyes, like oversized cartoonish goggles without a frame. Each disc is glossy with a hollow back, meant to peek out of a full helmet.
Male/M_Eye_Extra_Googly_Fullhelm_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material ignores the colour scheme, so no slot visibly applies to either disc.

Male/M_Eye_Extra_Mask_Animatronic_01.description: Pair of mechanical lens goggles: two separate octagonal housings sit over the eyes, each with a ribbed cylindrical lens barrel and a small glowing-style central pupil. There is no strap, so they float on the face like animatronic eyes.
Male/M_Eye_Extra_Mask_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular outer housings; colour 1 on the ribbed barrel rings; colour 2 on the lens interior; colour 3 on the central pupils.

Male/M_Eye_Extra_Mask_Lion_01.description: A flat, thin forehead emblem shaped like an atom symbol: three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central ring, sitting on the brow as a decal-like ornament rather than a mask.
Male/M_Eye_Extra_Mask_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main orbit lines and centre ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the lines.

Male/M_Eye_Extra_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.description: A small headset-style communicator: a pair of flat angular plates sits by the temple and cheek, with a thin cable curving down along the jaw to a small boxy microphone tip near the mouth.
Male/M_Eye_Extra_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the temple plates; colour 1 on the cable; colour 2 on the microphone tip.

Male/M_Eye_Face_90s_Mask_01.description: A angular plated half-helmet mask covering the forehead, brow, nose and cheeks with narrow eye slits and a notched top edge. Separate side cheek plates and a chin piece give it a sleek retro superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_90s_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face plate; colour 1 on the side cheek panels; colour 2 on the chin piece.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Aquatic_01.description: A fantasy helmet with a segmented fin-like crest running front to back, angular cheek guards and pointed swept-out ear fins. It leaves the face open and wraps the sides and back of the head, with a T-shaped opening at the rear.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented crest; colour 2 on the brow band under the crest; colour 3 on the main side and back shell; colour 0 on the cheek guards and outer ear fins.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Aquatic_01.differs: The male helmet's rear shell wraps further round with only a narrow T-shaped opening, where the female version leaves a wider open gap at the back.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Aquatic_02.description: A face-framing aquatic mask-helm with a tall central crest fin, swept-up finned cheek plates with ridged edges, a gem at the brow, and a pointed chin guard. It leaves the eyes, nose and mouth open and sits over the forehead and cheeks.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek fins and the rounded crown plate; colour 1 on the central crest, the upper fin edges and the chin point; colour 3 on the brow gem; colour 2 in the small shadowed recesses.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Blindfold_Large_01.description: A wide cloth blindfold wrapped around the head across the eyes, with soft wrinkled folds. It is knotted at the back of the head with two hanging tail ends, and a small extra knot sits at the front of the forehead.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Blindfold_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire blindfold, including the knots and hanging ends.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Blindfold_Small_01.description: A wide cloth blindfold band wrapping around the head across the eyes, with gathered creases over the nose and a smooth strip continuing around the back of the head. Simple, plain and sleek.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Blindfold_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Blockbuster_01.description: A wide, angular band-style visor mask wrapping across the eyes, with a V-shaped upper edge, pointed upswept outer corners and a dipped nose bridge. It sits flat against the face and reaches back toward the temples, giving a bold superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole mask; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Blockbuster_02.description: A wide, wraparound visor-style eye mask with a shallow V-shaped brow, covering both eyes in one smooth angular shell and reaching back to the temples, with a thin contrasting rim along the edges.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin rim trim along the edges; colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Deity_02.description: A wide, angular visor band that sweeps across the eyes in a shallow V, with upswept pointed tips at each temple and a pointed centre dipping toward the nose. It is a smooth, glossy single piece with no strap.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor band; the glossy default material shows little response to the other colour slots.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_01.description: Round, slightly faceted glasses lenses floating over each eye, with a tiny round disc at each temple where arms would join. No visible frame, bridge or arms; a minimal, casual bookish accessory.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lenses and temple discs; the material appears translucent glassy and largely ignores the other slots.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_02.description: A pair of round, translucent tinted lenses that sit directly over the eyes, with no visible frame or bridge. Simple, lightweight eyewear suited to casual or sci-fi looks.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the lens faces seen from behind; the lenses look tinted and translucent, so the scheme shows only faintly from the front.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_03.description: A pair of round, rimless lenses, each a flat translucent disc sitting directly in front of the eyes, with no visible frame, bridge or arms. A simple, light eyewear accessory.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Rim_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens discs, which read as tinted translucent glass; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Silly_01.description: Novelty spring-eyes: two coiled spring stalks that arc forward from the eye sockets, each ending in a rounded eyeball cap. Silly cartoon-style face accessory worn over both eyes.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Child_Glasses_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coiled springs and the rim of each eyeball; colour 3 on the eyeball caps; colour 1 on the tip of each eyeball; colour 2 on the inner spring shading.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Coal_01.description: A pair of chunky, faceted rock-like lumps that sit directly over each eye, hiding the eyes completely. They have rough, cracked surfaces and angular edges, giving a monstrous, stony look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Coal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lumps' whole surface; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Cosmic_01.description: A thin angular forehead ornament made of two separate mirrored bracket halves around a small central cube, with antler-like arms sweeping up and outward to notched tips. Sits flat on the brow like a sci-fi circlet.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main arms; colour 1 on the inner frames; colour 3 on the small inner edge strips; colour 0 on the central cube, arm tips and lower points.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Cosmic_01.differs: The male version is split into two separate halves with light-coloured arm tips, while the female version has a joined hexagonal central frame.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Deal_Glasses_02.description: Novelty pixel-style glasses: a wide blocky bar with stepped, pixelated lower edges spans both eyes, with small checkerboard pixel patterns on each lens area and thin curved temple arms hooking over the ears.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Deal_Glasses_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide blocky frame; colour 1 on the temple arms; colour 3 on the pixel pattern over one eye; colour 2 on the pixel pattern over the other eye.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_01.description: A rigid angular brow mask forming a broad V across the eyes, with a pointed centre dipping over the nose bridge and two tall pointed horns rising at the temples. It wraps slightly around the sides of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central V-shaped band; colour 1 on the upward temple points and blending into the upper edges; colour 2 on the rim edging and the inner back surface.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_02.description: A wide, chevron-shaped visor band that wraps across the eyes with a V-point dipping over the nose bridge and edges swept up at the temples. Smooth, thin, angular shield with a slim rim.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer front face of the visor; colour 1 on the inner surface; colour 2 on the thin rim edge.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_03.description: A thin, angular headpiece shaped like a wide V across the forehead with two tall pointed horn-like tips, and side plates that curve down past the temples and cheeks, leaving the eyes and face open.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer front face of the V and side plates; colour 0 on the inner and back surfaces; colour 2 on the thin edge outline.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_04.description: An angular half-helmet with two tall swept-up fins at the crown, faceted side plates and a pointed brow visor over the eyes; a glossy lens band sits under the brow and a small chevron plate covers the back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the chevron plate; colour 1 on the band under the brow; colour 2 on the eye lens area and inner visor.
