Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_05.description: An angular metal half-mask with narrow slanted eye openings and two tall, curved horn-like spikes rising over the forehead. Thin fins sweep back along the temples, giving a monstrous, sci-fi deity look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask plates and horns; colour 1 on the rear fins and inner edges of the horns; colour 2 on the outlines and edging; colour 3 on the eye glow inside the openings.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_06.description: A horned half-mask with a swept brow plate, angular eye openings with glowing lenses, two tall curved horns rising from the forehead, and a pointed lower jaw guard that frames the cheeks and chin.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Deity_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow plate and eye surround; colour 2 on the horns and forehead section; colour 1 on the lower jaw guard; colour 3 on the eye lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor_0.description: A face emblem shaped like an atom: three interlocking elliptical rings orbiting a small central ring, laid as a thin flat overlay across the eyes, nose and cheeks. Sci-fi, open-framed and lightweight.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the outlines and edging of the rings.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor_0.description: A face emblem shaped like an atom: three interlocking elliptical rings orbit a small central ring, overlaid on the face from forehead to chin. It is a thin, open, curved band that wraps the face without covering it.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the thin edge outlines along the rings.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor_0.description: A wide face emblem shaped like an atom: three interlocking elliptical rings around a central hexagon and ring, curving over the eyes, nose and cheeks like an open-work mask. It suggests a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the outlines and edging of the rings and the central ring around the eyes.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Emblem_Clockwork_Armor_0.differs: The male version is larger and wider, covering more of the forehead, cheeks and chin, with a central ring set right over the eyes.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Emblem_Faceless_01.description: A face-covering emblem shaped like an atom symbol: three interlocking elliptical rings and a small central ring form an open lattice that curves over the nose, cheeks and mouth, leaving the eyes clear.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Emblem_Faceless_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ring bands; colour 1 on the thin outer edging of the rings; the other slots are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Extraterrestial_01.description: Pair of large, slightly angular oval alien eye covers sitting over the eye sockets, each with a thin raised rim and a glossy, streaked lens-like surface. Gives a bug-eyed extraterrestrial look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Extraterrestial_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye surfaces; colour 0 on the streaked highlights within the eyes; the rim takes a skin-toned edge that does not appear to follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_01.description: A pair of thin, blade-like eye accessories forming a spiky winged mask around the eyes, with jagged points sweeping up over the brows and out to the temples, and long curved tapering blades sweeping down the cheeks.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper brow and temple blades; colour 2 on the inner brow points over the eyes; colour 1 on the lower cheek blades.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_L_01.description: A flat, angular eye accessory of jagged blade-like shards fanning up and out over the left eye and brow, with a long tapering spike sweeping down the cheek. Suggests a fantasy or monstrous face ornament.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_L_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the plate and the inner blade over the eye; colour 1 on the edges and cheek spike; colour 0 on the inside face of the plate.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_L_01.differs: The male version is mostly dark, with colour 1 only at the edges, while the female plate is mainly colour 0 with a separate contrasting inner blade.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_R_01.description: A flat, bladed face ornament on the right side of the face: jagged swept-back spikes around the eye, a curved blade over the brow and a long tapering blade down the cheek. Sleek, sharp and monstrous or mechanical in feel.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeblade_R_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and upper spikes; colour 1 on the cheek blade edge and inner trim; colour 2 on the curved brow blade.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_01.description: A simple pirate-style eye patch: a small rounded cloth pad over the left eye, held by two thin straps, one angled across the brow and one circling the head above the ears.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the patch pad and both straps.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_01.differs: The male version has two separate straps, one slanting down to the patch and one circling the head, and the pad also shows at the back of the head.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_02.description: A simple pirate-style eye patch covering the right eye, held by thin straps that slant across the forehead and loop around the back of the head. A small pad also sits at the back of the head where the straps meet.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the patch and straps.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_02.differs: The male version has a second strap looping over the head and a small pad at the back where the straps join, while the female has a single band.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_L_02.description: A pirate-style eyepatch covering the left eye, held by two thin crossing straps that loop around the head, one over the forehead and one lower across the back. The patch is a small rounded shield with a raised rim.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_L_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the two head straps; colour 1 on the rim and back edge of the patch; colour 0 on the front face of the patch.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_R_02.description: A pirate-style eye patch: a small rounded oval pad with a contrasting rim covers the right eye, held by two crossed thin straps that wrap around the head, one passing over the forehead and one lower at the back.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyepatch_R_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the straps; colour 0 on the front of the patch pad; colour 1 on the patch rim and its back side.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeplatel_01_Basic.description: A small rounded eyeplate that covers the left eye socket: a slightly domed shell with a thick raised rim and a small oval eye opening in the centre. It sits over the eye, suggesting a cyborg or mechanical look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeplatel_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 2 on the raised rim; colour 1 on the eye opening and its inner lining.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeplater_01_Basic.description: A small rounded eyeplate that covers the right eye like a monocle-style patch, with a slightly domed, dished surface, a thick raised rim and a small eye opening in the centre.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Eyeplater_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 2 on the thick outer rim; colour 1 on the inner eye opening.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Faceless_01.description: A smooth, egg-shaped shell mask that covers the whole face from forehead to chin, hollow behind, with an embossed atom-like orbital emblem on the front and thin curved lines around the lower edge.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Faceless_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and the raised orbital emblem; colour 1 on the fine line details above the emblem and the inner upper curve; colour 2 on the inner middle line; colour 3 on the lower line near the chin.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesbubble.description: Chunky wraparound goggles with a faceted, angular frame and a raised brow ridge. Two rounded lens bubbles sit over the eyes and the frame curves back to the temples. A utilitarian, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesbubble.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and brow ridge; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 2 on the inner rim edge.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesplate_.description: A pair of wide goggles with a thick, rounded frame that wraps around the eyes, joined by a narrow bridge. They sit across the upper face and curve back toward the temples. Suits a superhero or sci-fi helmet look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglesplate_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 3 on the bridge between the lenses; colour 2 on the thin rim around the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglessport_.description: A wraparound sport visor: a single wide curved shield spans both eyes and the nose bridge, with a thick angular brow rim on top and boxy blocks at each temple. Sleek, sporty and sci-fi in style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Gogglessport_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow rim and temple blocks; colour 1 on the main visor shield.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Holohex_01.description: A pair of floating angular panels that hover beside the face, one on each side of the head. Each is a faceted slab with small fin-like blocks at its top and rear, giving a holographic sci-fi look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Fullhelmet_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole piece; the material appears to ignore the other colour slots, so slots 1, 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_01.description: Slim wraparound sunglasses with narrow rectangular tinted lenses in a thin angular frame, a short nose bridge and slender arms that hook over the ears. A sleek, modern everyday look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; colour 1 on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_02.description: Standard wraparound-style glasses with slim angular rectangular frames, tinted lenses and a bridge across the nose. Thin arms run back along the temples to the ears. A casual, everyday look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; colour 1 on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_01.description: Oversized novelty glasses with two heart-shaped frames and translucent tinted lenses, joined by a slim bridge over the nose, with flat angled arms running back over the ears. Playful, cute party style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the heart frames; colour 0 on the temple arms; colour 2 on the nose bridge; the lenses are tinted translucent and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_02.description: Oversized retro-style glasses with a thick rounded frame, wide tinted lenses that sweep up slightly at the outer corners, and slim angled arms that hook back over the ears.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the frame around the lenses; colour 0 on the temple arms; the lenses are tinted glass and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Small_01.description: Oversized heart-shaped glasses with thin rims, tinted translucent lenses, a slim bridge between the two hearts and straight arms running back over the ears. A playful, novelty look worn across the eyes.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the heart rims; colour 0 on the arms; colour 2 on the bridge; the lenses are a tinted translucent material that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Small_02.description: Oversized cat-eye style glasses with thick rounded frames, tinted translucent lenses and slim straight arms with a downward bend at the ends, resting on the nose and over the ears. Casual, retro look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Jumbo_Small_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the frames around the lenses; colour 0 on the temple arms; the lenses are a tinted translucent material that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Rim_01.description: Round wire-rimmed glasses with polygonal rims, tinted translucent lenses and a thin bridge, with small ring-shaped loops at the outer edges in place of temple arms. Sits on the nose and eyes; a quirky retro or scholarly look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Rim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the outer side rings; colour 2 on the nose bridge. The lenses are translucent and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Rim_02.description: Round wire-style glasses with two many-sided rims holding tinted lenses, joined by a thin bridge across the nose. No arms are visible. They sit at the eyes and suggest a scholarly, retro look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Rim_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 2 on the nose bridge; the lenses are translucent and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Silly_01.description: Novelty glasses with a thick rounded frame and long arms, from which two coiled springs stick out far in front of the face, each ending in a domed googly eyeball cap.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glasses_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; colour 0 on the coiled springs; colour 3 on the rims of the eyeball caps; colour 1 on the centres of the eyeballs.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glassesaviator_01.description: Classic aviator glasses with two rounded, angular-cornered lenses joined by a thin double bridge, slim temple arms that curve down behind the ears, and a thin rim. Sits across the eyes in a casual, retro style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glassesaviator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame rims, bridge and temple arms; colour 1 on the lenses, which shade to a darker gradient.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glassesaviator_02.description: Aviator-style sunglasses with two rounded teardrop lenses in thin rims, a double bridge bar across the top, and slim temple arms that run back over the ears. Worn on the eyes as a casual accessory.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glassesaviator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the upper bridge bar; colour 2 on the temple arms; the lenses are glossy and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Glorious_Mask_01.description: A fantasy half-helmet mask covering the forehead, temples and back of the head, with two tall curved horn-like points rising at the sides, a V-shaped brow and raised trim lines across the front. It leaves the face open through a heart-shaped cut-out.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Glorious_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the lower edge of the shell as a gradient; colour 3 on the raised brow lines and top rim; colour 2 on the edging around the face opening.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Gogglesdown_01.description: Chunky round goggles with two octagonal rimmed lens housings worn over the eyes, joined by a short bridge and held by a flat padded strap that wraps around the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Gogglesdown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings and strap; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 2 on the strap edges.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Gogglesup_01.description: A pair of round, chunky goggles pushed up onto the forehead, with two rounded octagonal rims and domed lenses, joined by a narrow bridge and held by a flat strap that wraps around the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Gogglesup_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle rims and strap; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 2 on the strap edging and inner shading.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Golden_Age_02.description: A domino-style superhero eye mask with a wide V-shaped brow and jagged lightning-bolt points sweeping out and up at each temple, with angular eye openings and a thin contrasting edge outline, worn flat across the eyes.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Golden_Age_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the thin edge outline and the borders around the eye openings.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Googly_01.description: A pair of large, round, domed disc eyes that sit over the eyes like oversized googly eyes, with a glossy front lens and a flat, matte back. Comical, cartoonish monster look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Googly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat backs of the discs; the glossy domed fronts ignore the scheme and show a reflective finish.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Googly_Fullhelm_01.description: A pair of large, round, domed disc eyes with a glossy raised centre, sitting flat over each eye like cartoonish googly lenses; suited to mechanical helmets or monstrous faces.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Googly_Fullhelm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and rim of the discs; the glossy domed fronts appear to ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Holoforce_01.description: Two angular, shield-like eye patches that flare outward and up at the outer edges and taper to points beside the nose, like a sharp domino mask. Solid smooth panels with a two-tone split along the lower edge.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper main panels of each patch; colour 2 on the lower angled section near the nose; colour 0 on the inner backs.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Holoforce_01.differs: This version is solid, smooth panels with a two-tone colour split, whereas the female version renders as glowing crackling energy.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Ice_01.description: A pair of jagged ice-crystal rims that ring each eye, with a prominent row of tall spikes along the brow edge and long shards flaring outward at the outer corners. Frosty, monstrous eye decoration.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Ice_01.colourAreas: The piece appears mostly with a mottled frosty texture and does not clearly take the colour slots; no colour slot is clearly visible.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Ice_01.differs: The male version has taller, bolder spikes across the top of each brow rim.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Ice_02.description: Decorative eye surrounds: a ring of jagged, icy frost shards outlining each eye, with longer feathery spikes flaring outward at the outer corners and a few small diamond-shaped crystals dotted beneath each eye.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Ice_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frost rims, spikes and crystals; the inner rim texture has a glinting, metallic-looking sheen that seems to ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Ice_03.description: Decorative eye surrounds of jagged, icicle-like shards that sweep outward and upward from each eye, with a small textured rim along the lash line. They sit flat around the eyes as a frosty, monstrous makeup effect.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Ice_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jagged shards around the eyes; the small textured rim along the lash line does not visibly follow the scheme.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Ice_03.differs: The male shards are shorter and more compact at the outer corners, with less upward sweep.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Madjester_01.description: A half-face carnival mask covering the brow, eyes and cheeks, with a long curved beak-like nose that sweeps down and outward. It has eye holes, painted vertical slashes and round dots beside the eyes; a theatrical jester or plague-doctor style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell; colour 3 on the vertical slash markings by the eyes; colour 2 on the round dots; colour 1 on the tip of the beak, fading in from the shell.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_01.description: A simple domino-style eye mask: a thin, smooth shell with two eye openings joined over the nose bridge, sweeping up at the outer corners and wrapping to the temples. Classic masked-hero look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper and outer parts of the mask; colour 0 on the lower cheek and nose-bridge area, blending between the two.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_02.description: A domino-style eye mask with two eye openings, swept-up pointed wings at the brow corners and a V-shaped dip over the nose bridge. It hugs the upper face and reaches the temples, in a classic superhero style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper brow wings and outer mask surface; colour 0 on the lower edge below the eyes and around the eye openings.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_03.description: A thin, flat domino-style eye mask with two eye openings and pointed, upswept outer corners that slant sharply upward. It sits close on the face across the brow and nose bridge, giving a classic masked-hero look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper outer areas of the mask; colour 0 on the lower edge around the eyes.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_04.description: A thin, flat domino-style eye mask with two large eye openings joined by a narrow nose bridge. Pointed upswept tips rise at the outer corners, and a shallow point dips below each eye. Sits close on the face in a superhero style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer edges and upswept tips of the mask; colour 0 on the nose bridge and lower rim around the eyes.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_05.description: A thin, open domino-style eye mask: a V-shaped brow band across the forehead that wraps around the head, with sharp pointed spikes dropping down beside each eye and no covering over the eyes or nose.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole mask band and points; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_06.description: A thin, open-faced domino-style mask: a curved band wraps across the brow and down past the eyes to the cheeks, with tall swept-up points at each temple. The eyes are left open. Superhero style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_06.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mask band and its upswept points; colour 0 as a highlight along the centre brow edge.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_07.description: A domino-style eye mask with two eye openings, upswept pointed wings above each brow and a pointed tip running down over the nose bridge. It sits close against the face like a superhero mask.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_07.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper brow wings and the outer areas of the mask; colour 0 on the nose and lower cheek portion, blending into colour 1 with a gradient.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_07_Glitter.description: A thin domino-style eye mask with swept-up pointed wings at the outer brows, open eye holes and a pointed nose bridge. It has a speckled, glitter-flecked surface and sits flat across the upper face.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_07_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper and outer mask surface; colour 0 on the lower nose and cheek area; colour 3 on the speckled flecks.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_08.description: A domino-style eye mask with angular eye openings and a pointed brow line, topped by two slim fin-like prongs rising above each brow. It sits flat over the eyes and upper nose in a classic superhero style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_08.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole mask, including the prongs; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_08.differs: The male mask is a single solid colour with no contrasting trim along the brow edge.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_Anniversary_01.description: A full-face superhero mask with two tall pointed ears at the brow, a V-shaped forehead dip, eye openings and a wide lower panel covering the nose and cheeks, leaving the mouth free. Contrasting edging outlines it, with a mottled textured surface.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_Anniversary_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer edging; colour 0, colour 2 and colour 3 appear in the mottled speckled surface, with colour 2 darkening the nose area.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_01.description: A soft cloth ninja-style blindfold mask: a wrinkled fabric band wraps across the eyes and around the head, with a rim along the top edge and a knotted bow with two tails at the back.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wrapped cloth band, rim and knot; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_01.differs: The male version is a soft, wrinkled fabric wrap in a single colour, without the female version's pointed brow mask and contrasting panels.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Ribbon_01.description: A pair of long, narrow cloth ribbon tails knotted at the front of the head, hanging down over the face and chest. Each tail ends in a pair of thin contrasting stripes, in a ninja headband style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbon tails; colour 1 on the two stripes at each tail end; colour 2 on the small knot.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Mask_Ninja_Ribbon_01.differs: The male ribbon is mostly a single plain colour with two thin stripes at each tail end, and the knot sits at the front of the face.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Child_Mardi_Gra.description: A jester-style crown band sitting across the top of the head, with a ring of tall curved cloth points that flop outward, some tipped with small round bells. Playful carnival look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Child_Mardi_Gra.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the shorter outer points; colour 1 on the taller curved points; colour 3 on the tallest central points; colour 2 on the small bells.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Child_Mardi_Gra.description: A headpiece crest with a tall pointed central fin that runs front to back along the top of the head, framed by a pair of curved horns and a pair of long swept-back thin horns on each side. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Child_Mardi_Gra.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the central crest fin and its small leaf-like spikes; colour 2 on the inner curved horns; colour 1 on the outer long swept horns and their bases.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Mardi_Gras_01.description: A Mardi Gras carnival mask covering the face, with a heart-shaped brow, painted swirling patterns, small eye openings and a jester-like crown of curled feather plumes tipped with tiny bells; a thin band circles the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Mardi_Gras_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the mask face and some plumes; colour 1 on the painted face patterns, lips and some plumes; colour 0 on the lower plumes, bells and head band; colour 2 on the fine outlines.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Mardi_Gras_02.description: A full-face beaked bird mask with a pointed beak, ringed eye openings and a jagged feather-like crest. A tall central fin, two curved horns, two long swept plumes and a thin band around the head crown the top.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Maskfull_Mardi_Gras_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face, beak and upright horns; colour 3 on the central crest, jagged brow trim and eye rims; colour 2 on the curved side horns; colour 1 on the swept plumes and head band.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Monaclel_01_Basic.description: A single mechanical monocle: a short octagonal tube worn over one eye, with a lens filling the front and a ring of alternating segmented panels around the rim. Small, sci-fi and partial in coverage.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Monaclel_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer barrel of the tube; colour 1 on the lens; colour 2 and colour 3 alternating on the segmented ring around the rim.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Monstereyes_01.description: A pair of small, rough-edged eye sockets set on the sides of the temples, each a rim of skin-like flesh around a contrasting hollow. They add extra monstrous eyes beside the natural ones.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Monstereyes_01.colourAreas: The rims appear skin-toned and do not clearly take the scheme; the hollows are unaffected by any slot.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Night_Mask_01.description: A horned, angular face mask covering the brow, cheeks and nose bridge, with two large upswept horns on the forehead plate, layered pointed panels over the cheeks and a pointed chin-like tip below. Fantasy, monstrous style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Night_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and forehead plate; colour 1 on the cheek and side panels; colour 3 on the thin trim under the brow; colour 2 on the pointed lower tip.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Nightvisor_01.description: A wraparound visor shaped like a wide V: a single angular, glossy tinted band sweeps across the eyes with upswept pointed wings at the temples and a narrow tapered centre panel over the nose bridge.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Nightvisor_01.colourAreas: The visor appears glossy and largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows on the edge trim and reflections.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Nightvisor_02.description: A single cyclops-style lamp: a short, faceted cylindrical housing with a thick rim around a contrasting round lens, worn in the centre of the forehead. Reads as a mechanical, sci-fi third eye.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Nightvisor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front rim and housing body; colour 1 on the band around the housing; colour 2 on the lens.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Pirate_Fancy_L_01.description: A pirate-style eyepatch: a small rounded disc covers the left eye, held by a thin strap that runs diagonally across the face and loops around the back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Pirate_Fancy_L_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye patch disc; colour 0 on the thin strap.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Pirate_Fancy_R_01.description: A pirate-style eyepatch: a small rounded patch over the right eye, held by a thin strap that slants across the forehead and loops around the head at the back.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Pirate_Fancy_R_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye patch; colour 0 on the thin strap.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Reactor_01.description: A pair of tall, angular horn-like blades that start as faceted wedges over the eyes and sweep out and upward past the temples, curving back and ending in flat cut tips above the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower eye wedges and the body of each horn; colour 1 on the upper tips of the horns, fading in a gradient.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_01.description: A sleek, bat-like domino mask of two separate sharp-winged eye frames that meet at a point over the nose bridge, with pointed spikes sweeping up at the brows and down along the cheeks. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper mask surfaces; colour 1 on the lower cheek points as a gradient fade. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_02.description: A pair of thin, flat eye-mask pieces hugging the brow and cheekbones, with tall curved spikes sweeping up over each eyebrow and tapering points below each eye. Gives an alien, feral, antler-like look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper brow spikes; colour 1 on the lower cheek points and under-eye edges.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_L_01.description: A thin, sculpted eye mask worn over one eye: a sleek shell around the eye socket with a sharp upward brow spike and long, curved claw-like points sweeping down the cheek and beside the nose.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_L_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper brow and rim of the mask; colour 1 on the lower cheek spikes, blending in as a gradient. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_L_02.description: A thin, sculpted eye mask for the left eye: a brow ridge sweeping up into three tall curved spikes, with narrow pointed tendrils curving beneath the eye and down the cheek. It sits flat on the skin.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_L_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow ridge and spikes; colour 1 on the lower cheek tendrils and underside edge.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_R_01.description: A single-eye mask shell worn over the right eye: a thin, glossy, sharply pointed frame with a tall swept-up spike above the brow and long tapering spikes down the cheek and toward the nose. Gives an alien, renegade look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_R_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper frame and brow spike; colour 1 on the lower cheek and nose spike tips, blending in from the frame.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_R_02.description: A one-eye mask shell that wraps the right eye socket, with tall swept-back spikes rising over the brow and sharp tapering points trailing down the cheek. Alien, sleek and predatory in style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Renegade_R_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow spikes and main shell; colour 1 on the lower rim and cheek points around the eye.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Robot_Monical_01.description: A cybernetic single-eye monocle: a boxy angular housing over one eye with a protruding lens barrel and banded rings, held by a thick padded strap that loops diagonally over the top of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Robot_Monical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing and barrel body; colour 1 on the rings around the barrel; colour 3 on the lens; colour 2 on the head strap.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Robot_Monical_Dual_01.description: Mechanical twin-lens goggles: two short telescoping lens barrels on angular metal housings sit over the eyes, joined by a small bridge and held by a thin band that loops over the top of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Robot_Monical_Dual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings and barrel bodies; colour 1 on the barrel rings; colour 3 on the lens tips; colour 2 on the head band.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Sheer_01.description: An angular face mask with two tall pointed ears on top, a chevron-shaped brow plate divided by a contrasting band, and a pointed lower section covering eyes, nose and cheeks down to the chin. Suggests a bat-like hero look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Sheer_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper shell and ears; colour 1 on the lower face section; colour 3 on the thin band across the brow chevron.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Sheer_01.differs: The male mask shows a distinct contrasting band across the brow and a flatter matte faceted finish, with the lower face section as a separate panel.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Sockpuppet_01.description: A pair of chunky octagonal button-style eye patches, one over each eye, each with a raised rim and a contrasting stitched bar across the centre. They give a cute, cartoonish sock-puppet look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Sockpuppet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the left-hand button face; colour 1 on the right-hand button face; colour 2 on the stitched bars.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_01.description: Wraparound speedster goggles: a single smooth tinted visor shell curving across both eyes with a raised angular brow ridge and stepped side fins at the temples. It sits over the eyes with no visible strap.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the visor shell, brow ridge and side fins; the inner surface picks up a faint tint from colour 1.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_02.description: Wraparound speedster goggles: two large rounded lenses in thick padded frames joined by a nose bridge, topped by an angular swept-back brow ridge that wraps to the temples. Sits across the eyes, sleek and superhero-styled.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow ridge and outer temple caps; colour 2 on the lens frames and bridge; the lenses are a glassy tint that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_Glass.description: A one-piece wraparound visor-style pair of goggles: a single curved lens band with a pinched bridge over the nose, sweeping around the eyes to the temples. It has a sleek, sporty speedster look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_Glass.colourAreas: The glass lens ignores the colour scheme and shows a glossy finish; no other slots are visible on this piece.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_Glass.description: Two separate curved lens shells, each a rounded teardrop shape, sitting directly over the eyes with no frame or strap. They give a sleek, minimal speedster visor look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Speedster_Gloggles_Glass.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both lens shells; the glassy default material largely ignores the rest of the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Teddy_01.description: A pair of large four-hole sewing buttons covering the eyes, each a round disc with a raised rim and a recessed centre with four holes. Flat plain backs. A creepy doll-like look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rims and backs; colour 1 on the recessed button faces; colour 2 on the four holes.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Thirdeye_01.description: A single extra eye set in the centre of the forehead: a rounded eyeball with iris and pupil inside fleshy, slightly raised lids. Reads as a mutant or mystic third eye.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Thirdeye_01.colourAreas: Skin-toned lids follow the character's skin; colour 1 on the eye socket and the of the eyeball; iris and pupil keep their own default look.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_01.description: A curved anglerfish-style stalk rising from the top of the forehead, arching forward over the face and ending in a small teardrop lure that hangs in front of the nose. Monstrous, creature-inspired accessory.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalk; colour 3 on the stripe along the top edge of the stalk; colour 1 on the lure bulb.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_02.description: An anglerfish-style lure: a thin curved stalk rises from the centre of the forehead, arches forward over the face and ends in a teardrop bulb hanging in front of the nose. Monstrous, creature-like accessory.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalk; colour 3 on the stripe along the top edge of the stalk; colour 1 on the bulb.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_03.description: Two curved anglerfish-style stalks rising from the centre of the forehead and arcing forward over the face, each ending in a small rounded bulb dangling in front of the nose. Monstrous, creature-like head accessory.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalk bodies; colour 3 on the stalk edge stripes; colour 1 on the bulbs at the tips.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_04.description: Monstrous anglerfish-style eye accessory: two bulbous round eye orbs sit over the eyes, and a thin curved stalk rises from the forehead, arcs forward and ends in a teardrop lure hanging in front of the face.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Anglerballl_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye orbs and the lure bulb; colour 0 on the stalk; colour 3 as a thin stripe along the top of the stalk.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Blaster_01.description: A single-eye blaster: a chunky faceted cylindrical barrel covering one eye socket, with a ringed open muzzle at the front and a tapered rear housing that reaches back toward the temple. Sci-fi cyborg style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Blaster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted rear housing; colour 1 on the front barrel section; colour 0 on the ring around the muzzle; colour 2 on the inner lens; the crosshair marker is not part of the piece.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Blaster_02.description: A large single-eye blaster: a chunky tube-shaped cannon that projects forward from one eye, with a ringed open muzzle at the front and a faceted, angular rear housing that sits against the side of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Blaster_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main barrel body and inner muzzle; colour 0 on the muzzle rim and the rear housing; colour 3 on the small crosshair-like targeting marks and the deep centre of the muzzle.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Eyesbulbous_01.description: A pair of large, rounded bulbous eyes that bulge out from the face over each eye socket, like insect or monster eyes. Each is a smooth glossy dome with a hollow back, worn in place of normal eyes.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Eyesbulbous_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on both eye domes, with shading toward darker tones at the edges; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A feathered headpiece of layered swept-back plumes that rise into wing-like tips above the temples, with a central crest of pointed feathers on the forehead and short spiky feather shards fanning down the sides of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central forehead crest; colour 1 on the upper long plumes; colour 2 on the middle layer of plumes; colour 3 on the lower plumes and the side spikes.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Firebird_01.differs: The male version has slightly shorter plumes, and its side spikes sit closer to the face.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_01.description: A tiny flat rectangular patch floating on the forehead above the eyes, apparently an effect anchor for flaming eyes. Almost nothing of the piece is visible as geometry.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small flat patch; no other visible features take the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_02.description: A tiny flat square patch floating on the forehead above the brows. It is likely a placeholder for an eye effect, and the visible geometry shows no flames or eye detail.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small flat patch; no other coloured features are visible.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Fx_02.differs: The male patch is a larger, squarer panel than the female's thin rectangle.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampunk_.description: Steampunk goggles with two gear-shaped rims around grid-covered lenses, joined by a bridge and a wide padded band that wraps around the head. Small knobbed levers stick out at the sides.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampunk_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gear rims; colour 2 on the head band and bridge; colour 1 on the small levers; colour 3 on the lens grids and lever knobs.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampunk_.description: Steampunk goggles with two rounded lens housings joined by a thin bridge, a telescoping barrel between them and a small side knob, held by a broad band wrapping around the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampunk_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head band and small knob; colour 1 on the lens housings; colour 3 on the lenses and barrel tip; colour 2 on the barrel and bridge wires.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampunk_.description: Steampunk twin-lens goggles with round, chunky barrel housings set with rectangular panels, joined by a small bridge over the eyes and held by a wide flat strap with round studs that circles the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampunk_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head strap; colour 1 on the goggle housings, bridge and strap studs; colour 3 on the rectangular panels around the barrels; colour 2 on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampunk_.description: Round steampunk goggles with two rounded metal lens cups, contrasting lenses and a thin bridge, ringed by sharp cone spikes. A thin buckled strap loops over the top of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Goggles_Steampunk_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal lens cups and bridge; colour 1 on the head strap and the rear caps of the cups; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_01.description: Close-fitting bubble goggles with a rounded, molded frame around two large domed lenses over the eyes, held by a thin flat strap that runs around the head above the ears.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle frame; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 3 on the head strap.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_03.description: Wide swimming-style goggles with two rounded lens bubbles in a chunky rimmed frame, held by a thin elastic strap that circles the head. Worn pushed up on the forehead, giving a practical, aviator-like look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle frame; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 3 on the head strap.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesbubble_03.differs: The male goggles sit lower on the forehead, with the strap visible as a band beneath the frame across the brow.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesplate_01.description: Wide single-piece winter goggles with a rounded, slightly angular rim around two large tinted lenses, joined by a small bridge and held by a thin strap that wraps around the head at eye level.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Gogglesplate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle rim and frame; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 3 on the head strap and the centre bridge strip.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Joke_01.description: Novelty glasses with thick squarish frames, open lenses and long arms reaching back to the ears, topped by a pair of jagged, spiky cartoon eyebrows sitting above the frame.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Joke_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frames and arms; colour 1 on the spiky eyebrows.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Party_Glasses_01.description: Novelty party glasses with two four-pointed star-shaped lenses in thick rims, joined by a small bridge, with thin angular temple arms that run back over the ears. Playful, cute costume eyewear.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Party_Glasses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the bridge and temple arms; colour 2 on the lenses seen from the front; colour 3 on the inner lens faces seen from behind.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Secret_03.description: Round, chunky-rimmed glasses with slightly faceted lenses and long straight arms, topped by a spiky tuft of jagged hair-like fringe above each lens, giving a quirky, comic look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frames and arms; colour 1 on the spiky tufts above the lenses; the lenses are tinted translucent and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_01.description: A wide welder-style visor: a boxy front shield with a single contrasting horizontal slit sits over the eyes, flanked by swept-back side wings with slotted stripes that wrap around the head to a pointed rear band.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front shield box; colour 0 on the side wings and rear band; colour 3 on the stripe accents and small marks on the shield; colour 2 on the viewing slit.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_02.description: A wraparound visor band worn across the eyes: a boxy front frame holding a contrasting slit lens, with angular swept-back side wings that taper toward the temples and carry paired slash marks.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept side wings and rear band; colour 1 on the boxy lens frame; colour 3 on the slash marks and small frame studs; the lens itself stays dark.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_03.description: A single-eye visor monocle: a chunky angular wedge that covers one eye with a contrasting rectangular lens slot, tapering back along the temple toward the ear with two slim vent slits. Reads as a sci-fi welder or cyber visor.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and rear housing; colour 1 on the front frame around the lens slot; colour 3 on the small vent slits and accent marks; colour 2 on the lens slot.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_04.description: A tall vertical monocle visor covering one eye: a narrow angular shell with a deep contrasting slit lens, a raised rim, and a swept-back plate that wraps toward the temple. Small marks sit at the brow end.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Tight_Visor_Welder_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept-back shell and brow plate; colour 1 on the rim and front frame; colour 2 on the lens slit; colour 3 on the small marks.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Toy_01.description: A pair of round, chunky faceplate lenses worn over each eye, each a thick polygonal rim around a dished dial face with a small central knob and a thin needle, like vintage toy gauges.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer rims and back casings; colour 3 on the dial faces; colour 1 on the inner ring and needles; colour 0 on the central knobs.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Trumpknight_02.description: A wraparound visor band across the eyes and upper cheeks, with a pointed lower edge over the nose bridge and chunky cylindrical pods at each temple. A lens-like disc sits on the outer face of each pod. Sci-fi eyewear.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Trumpknight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band; colour 1 on the lower visor edge and nose point; colour 2 on the temple pods; colour 3 on the lens discs.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Until_Eyepatch.description: A sci-fi tech eyepatch: a contrasting angular lens plate over one eye, linked by a thin cable and short cylindrical coupling to a large rounded earpiece housing on the side of the head, with a translucent cheek panel.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Until_Eyepatch.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing shell and coupling; colour 1 on the lower housing panels and cable; colour 2 on the eye plate and housing edges; colour 3 on the top patch of the housing.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Urban_Glasses_01.description: Wide angular wraparound shades: a single visor-like lens with a notch over the nose, a slim thin frame, and straight arms ending in small hooked tips that rest over the ears.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Urban_Glasses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; colours 1 and 3 in alternating horizontal stripes across the lens.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Victory_Mask_01.description: A flat, angular headpiece that frames the face like a crown-helm: two upswept horn-like points rise at the temples, a V-shaped brow with raised ridged lines, and long side plates that taper down past the cheeks. Open at the face and back.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Victory_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the lower and rear panel shading; colour 2 on the raised outer rim and brow ridges; colour 3 on the thin inner edge lining.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_01.description: A smooth helmet-like brow plate covering the forehead and crown, with a wraparound band of tinted visor lenses over the eyes and small angled cheek flaps at each side. Open at the face and back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow plate and cheek flaps; colour 1 on the visor lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_02.description: A wraparound visor with a chunky angular brow band, a single lens strip across both eyes, and blocky plates that wrap the temples and cheeks. Sits over the eyes and upper face; sleek superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band and temple plates; colour 1 on the lens strip.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Broad_01.description: A broad wraparound visor: a single angular tinted band across both eyes, framed by a thick flat rim along the top and side plates that reach back toward the ears. Sci-fi and superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Broad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame and side plates; colour 1 on the visor lens band.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: An angular faceplate mask covering the forehead, eyes and nose down to the upper lip, with two swept-back horn-like fins rising from the top of the head. Smooth armoured shell with a mechanical look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 across the whole shell, including the face plate, fins and edges; no other colour slots are visible on this sheet.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_01.differs: The male version is a single colour on the default scheme, without the separate brow band and contrasting side trim seen on the female version.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_02.description: A mechanical skull-cap helm of angular plates over the crown and back of the head, with a notched brow edge, a see-through visor plate hanging in front of the eyes, and a split tail panel down the nape.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main crown plates; colour 0 on the brow panel, visor frame and lower back panels; colour 2 on the rear band; colour 3 on the thin accent strip along one side.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_02.differs: This version adds a visor plate hanging in front of the eyes, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_03.description: A wide angular plate visor that covers the brow and upper face, with two forked horn-like fins sweeping back over the top of the head. The faceted panels look mechanical and armoured, with a flat lower edge across the nose.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor plate and its swept-back fins; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_03.differs: The male version has longer, flatter fins that sweep straight back along the skull and a broader face plate.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_04.description: An open-topped angular helmet shell that arches over the crown and sweeps back into a long tapering plate down the back of the head, leaving the face, sides and nape uncovered. Suggests a mechanical, armored look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rear plate; the inner lining and front notch panels show a separate tone, not clearly following the test scheme.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Clockwork_Armor_04.differs: The front is a lower brow edge with small notches and a tinted inner panel, rather than a wide central pointed panel.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Sharp_01.description: A wraparound eyeplate visor: a rigid angular frame with a pointed V-shaped brow ridge and swept side wings over the temples, holding a tinted lens band across the eyes. Superhero or sci-fi mask style.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Sharp_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame and side wings; colour 1 on the lens band across the eyes.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_01.description: A sleek wraparound visor band that covers the eyes in one continuous strip, with a small notch over the nose and a round disc-shaped cap at each temple. Its faceted, banded surface gives a sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band edges and centre ridge; colour 3 on the striped bands across the visor; colour 1 on the round temple discs; colour 2 on the small hardware and centre of each disc.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_02.description: A chunky rectangular visor block that wraps across the eyes and the sides of the head, with a flat framed front panel and a small central slot. The boxy shell closes around the head like a retro headset.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and sides; colour 0 on the framed front panel and slot; colour 1 on the small end caps at the temples.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_03.description: A wraparound tech visor with a wide angular tinted lens band across the eyes, a small square emblem plate at the bridge, and thick faceted arms sweeping back along the temples to the back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_03.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; the lens band and arms show a glossy finish with a slight sheen on the edges, and no distinct areas of colours 0-3 are clearly visible.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_03.differs: The male visor has a small square emblem plate on the bridge over the nose, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_04.description: A wraparound tech visor: a single angular tinted lens band spanning both eyes, with a raised metallic upper rim and a small central housing over the nose bridge. Sits across the eyes and reaches the temples.
Male/M_Eye_Face_Visor_Tech_04.colourAreas: The material looks glossy and largely ignores the scheme: the lens and rim show a reflective finish; the small central housing may take colour 2.

Male/M_Eye_Facemask_Phantom_01.description: A rigid, helmet-like half-mask covering the forehead, eyes and cheeks, with a crescent notch at the brow, angular eye openings and long narrow strips running down along the cheeks toward the jaw. Suggests a sleek superhero or phantom look.
Male/M_Eye_Facemask_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 2 on the edge outlines and inner cut-out borders; colour 3 on the thin rim around the eye openings.
Male/M_Eye_Facemask_Phantom_01.differs: The male mask has a contrasting rim around the eye openings and a rounder crescent brow notch, while the female version has plain eye edges and a V-shaped notch.

Male/M_Eye_Fullbandana_02.description: A cloth head wrap that covers the whole skull and forehead, with a cut-out band across the eyes and a knotted tie with short tails at the back. An atom-style emblem sits on the forehead, giving a superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Fullbandana_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap; colour 1 on the atom emblem on the forehead.

Male/M_Eye_Fullhelmet_Crown_Spiked_01.description: A small angular helmet front plate that sits across the brow and down the bridge of the nose, with swept-up pointed wings at each side and a tapering spike ending over the nose tip. Suits a monstrous or armoured helmet look.
Male/M_Eye_Fullhelmet_Crown_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the downward nose spike; colour 1 on the upswept side wings; colour 2 on the central panel across the brow.

Male/M_Eye_Fullhelmet_Gogglesdown_01.description: Oversized round goggles with two chunky, rounded eye cups that project forward from the face, joined by a small bridge piece over the nose. Tube-like lens housings give a bulky, retro-mechanical look.
Male/M_Eye_Fullhelmet_Gogglesdown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housings and bridge; colour 1 on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Fullhelmet_Wingedgoggles_Blue.description: Butterfly-shaped winged goggles: two angular contrasting lenses set in raised rims, joined at a small nose bridge, with pointed swept-up wing panels over the brows and temples that wrap around the sides of the face.
Male/M_Eye_Fullhelmet_Wingedgoggles_Blue.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing panels and outer frame; colour 1 on the rims around the lenses and the nose bridge; colour 3 on the small studs along the lower rims; lenses stay regardless of the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Gamer_01.description: A chunky angular cybernetic eye plate covering one eye and temple, with a round lens below and two curved cables looping out around the front and the side of the head. Suggests a sci-fi gamer or cyborg look.
Male/M_Eye_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell and back; colour 1 on the narrow side panel strip; colour 2 on the looping cables; colour 3 on the eye lens.
Male/M_Eye_Gamer_01.differs: The male back of the plate is plain with no large contrasting panel, and only a narrow strip at the side takes colour 1.

Male/M_Eye_Glasses_04.description: Small round octagonal-rimmed glasses with thin frames, a slim bridge and two straight temple arms ending in small hooked tips that curve down behind the ears. Sits on the nose in a retro, scholarly style.
Male/M_Eye_Glasses_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frames, bridge and temple arms; colour 1 on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Glasses_Spy_01.description: Small round spectacles with faceted polygonal rims, tinted lenses and a thin bridge. Slim wire arms hook back over the ears. Sits on the eyes as a light, retro, bookish accessory.
Male/M_Eye_Glasses_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the bridge and temple arms; the lenses show a tint that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Glassesnolens_04.description: Lensless spectacles with thin, octagonal wire-like frames joined by a small nose bridge, with straight arms that run back to the ears and end in small upturned tips. Classic scholarly, bookish look.
Male/M_Eye_Glassesnolens_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole frame, including the rims, bridge and arms.

Male/M_Eye_Heraldry_01.description: A metal heraldic face guard covering the lower face from nose to chin, with a pointed top edge, a bordered rim, curved contrasting-lit vent slots above and a cluster of small round breathing holes below; it curves around the cheeks.
Male/M_Eye_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the raised outer rim; colour 3 on the recessed slots.

Male/M_Eye_Heraldry_02.description: A faceplate shaped like a knight's visor: a faceted front with a horizontal eye slit, a lower grille with cross-shaped vents, and a wavy, pointed crest with a raised rim around the edge. It covers the face from brow to chin.
Male/M_Eye_Heraldry_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the raised edge rim; colour 3 on the eye slit; colour 2 on the vent openings.

Male/M_Eye_Heraldry_03.description: An angular armoured face mask covering the lower face from nose to chin: a broad upper plate with a pointed brow, a slotted lower guard with ribbed bands, and contrasting side fins curving back along the cheeks.
Male/M_Eye_Heraldry_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate and its back; colour 1 on the lower guard; colour 3 on the ribbed bands and the central band's studs; colour 2 on the side fins and the frame around the guard.

Male/M_Eye_Heroic_Visor_01.description: A wraparound band visor that covers the eyes and wraps to the temples, with a thick trimmed top edge, a pointed lower edge over the nose bridge and two thin stripes across the middle. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Eye_Heroic_Visor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main visor body; colour 2 on the thick top edge; colour 3 on the outer stripes; colour 1 on the central stripe.

Male/M_Eye_Huge_Goggles_01.description: Oversized wraparound goggles with a chunky panelled frame, two large octagonal lenses, bolt heads at the temples and a thin strap around the back of the head. Cracked veiny detail marks one lens; sci-fi, monstrous look.
Male/M_Eye_Huge_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and bolts; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 3 on the vein-like cracks over one lens; colour 2 on the outline edging and rear strap.

Male/M_Eye_Jewels_01.description: A decorative face mask made of many faceted, elongated gemstones fanned around both eyes, with a large pointed gem on the brow and a small gem on the nose bridge; shorter teardrop gems sit under each eye.
Male/M_Eye_Jewels_01.colourAreas: The glossy gems mostly ignore the colour scheme and show a reflective metallic finish; a few gems show slight colour 1 tinting.
Male/M_Eye_Jewels_01.differs: The male version has a shorter, more compact set of under-eye gems that sit closer to the eyes, with no contrasting drop gems.

Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Boar_01.description: A single side-set beast eye in the style of a boar: a small angular eye with a round pupil and iris sitting in a pointed surround at the outer edge of the face, placed on the side of the head.
Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed surround around the eye; the eyeball, iris and pupil keep their own eye colouring.

Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.description: A single rounded, slightly faceted eyeball shell with a tall vertical slit pupil, sitting over one eye like a dragon or reptile eye. The back is hollow and open. Suggests a monstrous beast look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball surface; colour 2 on the slit pupil. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Fox_02.description: A single left eye replacement in a fox-like style: an almond-shaped, slanted lid shape surrounds a glossy round eyeball with a large contrasting pupil and highlights. It sits over the eye socket as a small feature.
Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Fox_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular fox-like eyelid surround; the eyeball and pupil are unaffected by the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Kitsune_01.description: A single slanted, almond-shaped fox-like eye overlay that replaces the left eye, with a narrow pupil and a sharp upswept outer edge. It sits over the eye socket, giving a feral, beastly look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Kitsune_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyelid shape and slanted outer surround; the eyeball and pupil keep their own eye texture.

Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Werewolf_01.description: A single beast-like eye replacement: a small glossy eyeball with a large contrasting pupil and highlight, framed by an angular pointed brow wedge that sweeps up and outward, giving a fierce werewolf glare.
Male/M_Eye_L_Beast_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular brow wedge; the eyeball itself keeps its own and look and does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Child_Tight_Basic_01.description: A single small left eye insert with a rounded iris, pupil and highlight, set within an almond-shaped surround in the eye socket. It is a plain, natural-looking eye with no other head covering.
Male/M_Eye_L_Child_Tight_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye surround and lid area; the iris, pupil and highlight keep their own eye shading and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Bat_01.description: A single oversized, glossy oval eye replacing the left eye: a large contrasting pupil with bright highlights inside a thin rim, sitting slightly proud of the face. Gives a beastly, bat-like or monstrous look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the iris surround; colour 1 on the thin outer rim of the eye; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Bear_02.description: A single left eye replacement with a large rounded iris, a big contrasting pupil and a glossy highlight, set in a slightly angular outer rim. It sits in the eye socket and gives a cartoonish, animal-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Bear_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim of the eyeball; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Bear_03.description: A small replacement left eye with an animal-style shape: a slightly angular, almond eyeball with a large round pupil and a pointed corner wedge at the outer edge. It sits in the eye socket and is nearly invisible from a distance.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Bear_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer corner wedge; colour 2 on the large pupil; colour 0 on the eyeball surround.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Bull_01.description: A single bull-style eye placed on the side of the face, low beside the nose. It is a glossy round eyeball with a highlight, set in a small pointed wedge of textured skin-like surround. Suits beastly or monstrous heads.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the surround around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own glossy and look and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cat_02.description: A single stylised feline eye insert with a slit-like round pupil and highlight, framed by an angular pointed lid shape that extends outward at the corner. It sits over one eye socket and gives a beast-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cat_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid shape around the eye; the iris, pupil and highlight are not affected by the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cat_03.description: A single feline-style eye piece: a slanted almond eye with a large round iris and slit pupil, set inside a thin angular surround that sits over the eye socket. Suggests a beastly, lion-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cat_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular surround around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and do not take a colour slot.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.description: A single stylised cat eye with a large round pupil, a bright highlight and a pointed outer corner that sweeps toward the temple. It sits over the left eye socket as a small cartoonish, cute animal-like eye replacement.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer eyelid edge; the iris, pupil and highlight ignore the scheme; the skin-toned rear shell follows the mannequin's skin, not a colour slot.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cobra_01.description: A single reptilian eye patch: a faceted, angular plate on the side of the head holding a large round eye with a slit-like pupil, set beside the temple like a snake or cobra eye.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cobra_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted plate around the eye; colour 0 on the eyeball; colour 2 on the pupil; colour 3 on small skin-toned facets at the plate edges.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Corgi_01.description: A single large, cartoon-style eye replacing the natural left eye: a glossy round pupil with two contrasting highlights inside a slightly angular, flat iris shape with a thin rim. Gives a cute, anime-like animal look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Corgi_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on a small strip at the top of the eye; the pupil, highlights and rim take their own fixed shading and mostly ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Coyote_01.description: A single animal-style eye replacement: a realistic eyeball with a narrow pupil, framed by a sharp angular wedge that sweeps back toward the temple, giving a predatory coyote-like slant to one eye.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Coyote_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular wedge around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own texture and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.description: A single monstrous eye insert: a slanted, wedge-shaped eye with a glossy round pupil and highlight, sitting on the side of the head beside the natural eye, with a faceted outer shell. Suggests a cyber-beast look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted outer shell around the eye; the eyeball and pupil ignore the scheme and keep their own glossy shading.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Dinosaur_Large_01.description: A single wedge-shaped eye replacement for the left side of the face, with a large glossy pupil and highlights set in a slanted almond shape; a solid outer wedge sweeps back toward the temple. Gives a reptilian, cartoonish look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Dinosaur_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer wedge at the temple side; the eyeball itself keeps its own textured iris and pupil, not using the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Doberman_01.description: A single small eye piece for one side of the face: an angular, slightly raised almond-shaped lid with a round glossy iris and pupil, giving a sharp animal-like eye that replaces the normal eye.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Doberman_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid surround; the iris and pupil keep their own eye colouring and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Dog_01.description: A single animal-style eye replacement with a small angular patch of surrounding skin, a round iris and a slit-like pupil with a highlight. It sits over the eye socket and gives a canine, beastly look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular patch around the eye; the iris, pupil and highlight keep their own eye colouring and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Dragon_01.description: A single replacement eye with a large round iris, glossy highlights and a small pupil, framed by a pointed, swept-out lid that stretches into a sharp wedge at the outer corner for a reptilian, dragon-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed lid wedge; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A single reptilian eye replacing the left eye: a slit-pupil eyeball set in a curved, angular scaly lid that sweeps up and outward at the outer corner, giving a fierce dragon-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyelid surround; the eyeball, iris and pupil are fixed details that ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Fennec_01.description: A single large anime-style eye insert for the left side of the face: a slanted, angular wedge with a glossy contrasting pupil, contrasting highlights and a contrasting iris, framed by a fur-textured flared border at the outer corner.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer fur-like border and wedge edge; colour 0 on the iris and highlights; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Fishmonster_01.description: A single monstrous fish-style eye replacing the left eye: an oversized almond-shaped eye with a large glossy pupil and highlight, set slanted toward the temple with a separate panel along the outer edge.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Fishmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer edge panel beside the eye; the eyeball, pupil and iris keep their own fixed shading and ignore the colour scheme.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Fishmonster_01.differs: The male eye is larger and broader, covering more of the face and sitting closer to the natural eye.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Goat_01.description: A single goat-style eye replacement: a slit-pupil eyeball with a large glossy pupil, set in a pointed, angular eyelid wedge that extends outward at the outer corner. Sits over the left eye as a partial animal face piece.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eyelid wedge; the eyeball and pupil keep their own textured look and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Horse_01.description: A small replacement eye for a horse-like head: a glossy round eyeball with a large pupil, set in a pointed wedge-shaped lid that sits on the side of the face, giving a beast-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wedge-shaped lid surround; the eyeball itself ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Hyena_01.description: A single animal-style eye insert with a slit pupil and a pointed, angular lid surround, sitting over the eye socket on one side of the face. It gives a hyena-like beastly look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid surround; the eyeball and pupil show fixed eye artwork that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Kangaroo_01.description: A single left eye replacement in an animal style: a slit-pupil eyeball with a highlight, set inside a sharp angular wedge-shaped lid panel that extends outward toward the temple.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid panel around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own iris and pupil texture and does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Kitty_01.description: A single stylised cat eye that replaces the left eye: a curved, almond-shaped iris with a slit pupil and a highlight, set in a pointed angular surround that flares outward at the outer corner.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eye surround; the iris, pupil and highlight keep their own eye texture and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Kitty_02.description: A single small cat-style eye replacing the wearer's eye: an almond-shaped eyeball with a slit pupil and highlight, set in a pointed angular lid that flares outward at the corner. Cute, animal-like face detail.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Kitty_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eyelid surround; colour 0 on the iris and highlight; colour 2 on the slit pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Lizard_01.description: A single reptilian eye replacing the left eye: a slanted, almond-shaped eyeball with a large glossy pupil and highlight, set in a pointed scaly-looking lid wedge that sweeps toward the temple.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eyelid wedge around the eye; the eyeball, pupil and iris show their own painted textures and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Llama_01.description: A single large animal-style eye replacing the left eye: a big contrasting pupil with a small highlight in a rounded, slightly pointed almond shape that bulges out from the face at the side of the head.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer corner of the eye; the pupil, highlight and iris texture are fixed and do not take a colour slot.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Mouse_01.description: A single stylised cartoon eye overlay for the left eye: a large glossy round pupil with a highlight and a contrasting iris, framed by a pointed, angular wedge of contrasting trim that sweeps toward the temple.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Mouse_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer wedge around the eye; the iris, pupil and highlight keep their own fixed eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Otter_01.description: A single small animal-style eye replacing the left eye: a glossy round pupil and iris set in a pointed, angular eye patch that sweeps back toward the temple, giving an otter-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Otter_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eye patch surrounding the eye; the pupil and iris are fixed eye textures that ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Owl_01.description: A single large rounded owl-style eye replacing the left eye: a glossy oversized pupil with a bright highlight spot, set in a slightly bulging rim that sits over the eye socket. Cute, animal-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Owl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the highlight spots; colour 1 on the outer rim of the eye; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Pig_01.description: A small replacement left eye for a pig-like face: a tiny wedge-shaped eyeball with a contrasting pupil and a angular lid flap on the outer side, sitting high on the brow rather than in the normal eye socket.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Pig_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wedge-shaped lid flap; the eyeball and pupil keep their own fixed appearance and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Pitbull_01.description: A single replacement left eye in a beast-like style: a glossy eyeball with a large round pupil and highlight, set in a small curved lid-shaped rim that wraps the eye socket. Only the one eye is changed.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Pitbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer eyelid rim; the iris, pupil and highlight are unaffected by the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Rabbitl_01.description: A single stylised cartoon eye with a large round pupil and highlight, set in a small angular pointed socket patch. It sits high on the brow above the natural eye, giving a rabbit-like creature look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Rabbitl_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular socket patch around the eye; the eyeball and pupil ignore the colour scheme.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Rabbitl_01.differs: The eye sits higher, above the natural eye near the brow, rather than beside it at the temple.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Raccoon_01.description: A single left eye replacement with a round iris and glossy highlight, framed by a small angular patch of coloured skin that extends toward the outer corner, giving an animal-like, mask-like eye shape.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Raccoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular patch around the eye; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_01.description: A single extra eye that sits on the side of the forehead above the normal eye, like a raptor's. It is a glossy round eyeball with a large pupil and highlight, set in a slim rim that bulges slightly outward.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim around the eye; the eyeball, pupil and iris keep their own painted detail and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_02.description: A single large reptilian raptor eye set on the side of the head beside the temple: a glossy round pupil with a highlight inside a rimmed iris, backed by a thin contrasting socket plate.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the socket plate behind the eye; the iris and glossy pupil use their own eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_03.description: A single small raptor-style eye set on the side of the temple beside the face: a rounded, slightly angular socket with a large glossy round pupil and a highlight, giving a creature or monstrous look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Raptor_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer socket rim at the back of the eye; colour 0 on the iris area around the pupil; colour 2 on the glossy pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Reptillian_Large_01.description: A single reptilian-style eye replacing the left eye: a slanted, angular almond shape with a glossy contrasting pupil and highlight, and a pointed flap sweeping up and out toward the temple.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Reptillian_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer flap; the eyeball and pupil use their own textured shading and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Salamander_01.description: A single oversized animal-style eye that sits at the side of the head beside the face: a rounded, slightly angular oval with a large glossy pupil, a small highlight spot and a textured iris ring.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Salamander_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the thin rim behind the eyeball; the iris, pupil and highlights are painted texture and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Seahorse_01.description: A single oversized eye replacing the left eye: a faceted, roughly octagonal disc with a rounded iris ring and a raised central pupil, sitting flat over the eye socket. Suggests a creature or mechanical look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Seahorse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faceted rim of the eyeball; colour 1 on the iris ring; colour 3 on the central pupil.
