Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Set_01.description: A single narrow, slanted almond-shaped eye set into the side of the face, with a large contrasting pupil and a pointed outer corner that sweeps up toward the temple. Suggests a monstrous or alien extra eye.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Set_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed upper edge of the eye shape; the eyeball, pupil and highlights are fixed and do not take the scheme.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Set_01.differs: The male eye is smaller and sits closer to the brow, with a shorter, more compact shape.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Shisa_01.description: A small replacement eye piece for the head: an angular, slanted eyeball with a large pupil and a sharp pointed wedge at the outer corner, giving a fierce, beast-like gaze. Sits within the eye socket.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Shisa_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer-corner wedge; the iris and pupil keep their own fixed eye texture and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Suave_Wolf_02.description: A single stylised wolf-like eye replacement: a slanted, pointed almond-shaped lid patch that sweeps outward toward the temple, wrapped around a round eyeball with a large pupil and highlight. Sits flat on the face.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Suave_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eyelid patch around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own iris and pupil colouring and does not follow the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_01.description: A single small replacement left eye: a compact eyeball with a large contrasting pupil and a glassy highlight, with only a thin angular edge around it. It sits in the eye socket as a subtle monstrous, vampiric face detail.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the thin rim around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_01.differs: The male eye has only a thin, small rim around the eyeball, so less of the angular surround is visible.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_02.description: A single small, slit-shaped replacement eye for the left side of the face: a compact diamond-shaped iris and pupil with a glossy highlight, sitting low on the cheek below the natural eye. Suggests a vampiric or feline look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular outer eye shape around the iris; the iris and pupil keep their own and shading, independent of the colour scheme.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_02.differs: The male eye is a smaller diamond shape and sits lower, on the cheek below the natural eye, rather than level with it.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_03.description: A single left eye replacement with a glassy round iris, contrasting pupil and highlight, set in a thin almond-shaped surround that gives a sharp, predatory look. Sits in the eye socket only.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye surround and lid; colour 0 on the iris and eyeball; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_Large_01.description: A single left eye replacement: a large glossy contrasting pupil with a highlight, set in a contrasting iris, with a pointed angular wedge that juts out from the outer corner. Gives a bat-like monstrous stare.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Vampire_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed wedge at the outer corner; the pupil and iris keep their own eye shading and do not follow the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Whiterhino_01.description: A small angular monster eye with a slit pupil in a faceted, chunky socket, set at the side of the face beside the cheek as a single beast-like eye accessory.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Whiterhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted socket frame; the eyeball and pupil show fixed texture detail that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Wolf_01.description: A single left eye replacement with a glossy contrasting pupil, a highlight and a rim of iris, framed by small pointed corner flaps that give a slanted, predatory wolf-like shape.
Male/M_Eye_L_Face_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed corner flaps around the eye; the iris and pupil use their own painted texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Ferret_01.description: A single left eye replacement with a large glossy round pupil and highlight, set in an enlarged iris with a surrounding rim. It gives a cartoonish, animal-like look and sits in the eye socket.
Male/M_Eye_L_Ferret_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim around the iris; colour 2 on the pupil; colour 0 on the iris and eyeball surround.

Male/M_Eye_L_Monkey_01.description: A single left eye replacement: a small angular, pointed eye shape with a round iris and highlight, framed by a sharp contrasting wedge-shaped lid that angles down toward the nose. Sits over the natural eye.
Male/M_Eye_L_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid wedge around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own textured look and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Orc_01.description: A single left eye piece with a small angular, almond-shaped lid surround that tapers to a point on the outer side, holding a round iris and pupil with a highlight. Sits over the eye socket on the head.
Male/M_Eye_L_Orc_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyelid surround; the iris and pupil use a fixed eye texture that mostly ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Starowl_01.description: A stylised bird-of-prey eye replacement: a round contrasting iris with a large pupil and highlight, framed by a swept-back angular lid plate that flares outward and up toward the temple. Sits over the left eye.
Male/M_Eye_L_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid plate around the eye; the iris and pupil show their own eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Basic_01.description: A plain, realistic left eye: an almond-shaped surround with a round iris, contrasting pupil and small highlight, sitting in the eye socket. Simple, natural styling with no extra ornament.
Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the almond eye surround and the outer edge of the eyeball; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.description: A single left eye replacement in a beast style: a slanted, almond-shaped eye with a round iris and narrow contrasting pupil, framed by a pointed angular lid shape that sits flat over the eye socket.
Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid shape around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A single replacement eye for one side of the face: an enlarged, slit-pupil beast eye with a glossy iris and highlight, framed by a small pointed lid flap that extends past the corner of the eye. Suggests a monstrous, chimera-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed lid flap around the eye; the iris, pupil and highlight show fixed eye textures that do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Feral_01.description: A single feral eye replacement: a slanted, almond-shaped eye with a large contrasting slit-like pupil and a sharp pointed outer corner that sweeps back toward the temple, giving a predatory, beast-like look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Feral_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid edge around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own default appearance and does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A small eye insert for the left eye: a curved, wedge-shaped monstrous eyeball that sits in the socket, with a separate patch on its upper face and a lighter underside, leaving the rest of the head bare.
Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main eye shell; colour 3 on the raised patch on top; colour 0 on the underside edge.
Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The male eye insert has a separate contrasting patch on the upper face and a contrasting shell, while the female version is a single plain curved shard.

Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Full_01.description: A single small eye piece for the werewolf head type: an angular, slanted almond-shaped eye with a round iris and pupil, sitting over the eye socket and giving a fierce, beastly look.
Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Full_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyelid rim and outer eye shape; the iris and pupil keep their own fixed eye texture.

Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_01.description: A single small eye insert with a beast-like almond shape, a round iris and pupil, and a pointed outer corner. It sits over one eye socket as a partial werewolf-style eye replacement.
Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed eyelid surround; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_02.description: A small replacement eye piece for a werewolf-style look: a pointed, almond-shaped eyeball with a large round pupil and angular faceted lids, sitting in the eye socket. Only the eye itself changes.
Male/M_Eye_L_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid surround; the iris and pupil show their own fixed eye texture and don't follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Mask_Alien_01.description: An angular alien face mask with a pointed brow crest, side plates framing the head, faceted eye sockets and a ribbed, mandible-like mouth guard. It covers the face from forehead to chin in a sci-fi, insectoid style.
Male/M_Eye_Mask_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brow crest and side plates; colour 0 on the faceted face plates; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the mouth ribs and the brow triangle.

Male/M_Eye_Mask_Animatronic_01.description: A mechanical skull-like face mask with round goggle eyes, an open mouth vent, a segmented jaw and contrasting banded frame. A angular brow plate carries two tall blade-like ears that sweep up and outward.
Male/M_Eye_Mask_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell and jaw; colour 1 on the brow plate, ears and goggle rims; colour 2 on the banded frame and jaw brackets; colour 3 on the eye lenses and mouth interior.

Male/M_Eye_Mask_Cybercat_01.description: A full mechanical cat-like helmet covering the whole head, with angular segmented plating, four small round eye lenses, a vented muzzle guard over the mouth, and side ear-pod housings. Suggests a cybernetic stealth look.
Male/M_Eye_Mask_Cybercat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crown and outer plating; colour 1 on the inner face panels, ear pods and back inlays; colour 2 on the facial and rear panels and the ear-pod outer rims; colour 3 on the eye lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Mask_Lion_01.description: A full-face lion mask with a snarling muzzle, pointed ears, and an etched atom emblem on the brow. A ribbed crest arcs over the top, and scrolled ornamental side panels flank the face, giving a regal beast look.
Male/M_Eye_Mask_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and emblem; colour 1 on the facial stripes, side scroll panels and alternating crest ribs; colour 3 on the alternating crest ribs, chin stripes and side trim.

Male/M_Eye_Mask_Rustbucket_01.description: A riveted, robot-like face mask that covers the whole head and face: smooth plated dome, bulging round eyes, a protruding nose, a moulded mouth and a contrasting chin and side plate, open at the back.
Male/M_Eye_Mask_Rustbucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome and plating; colour 1 on the forehead stripe, nose, eye rings and chin and jaw plates; colour 3 on the lips.

Male/M_Eye_Mask_Rustbucket_02.description: A pair of bulging, faceted eye covers that stick out from the face like protruding goggles. Each has a round inset lens disc with an arrow symbol. Crude, chunky and monstrous-mechanical in style.
Male/M_Eye_Mask_Rustbucket_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted outer shells; colour 1 on the round lens discs; colour 2 on the arrow symbols.

Male/M_Eye_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A wraparound superhero eye mask with large angular lens openings, a V-shaped raised brow rim and a nose bridge, covering the eyes and upper cheeks and wrapping around the temples.
Male/M_Eye_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body; colour 1 on the raised brow rim along the top edge; colour 2 on the lens insets.

Male/M_Eye_Monocle_Classic_L_01.description: A single round monocle with a faceted, polygonal rim and a tinted lens worn over one eye, held by a thin wire arm that curves back over the cheek and hooks behind the ear. Classic, refined look.
Male/M_Eye_Monocle_Classic_L_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim; the lens is tinted and appears unaffected by the scheme; colour 2 on the thin wire arm.

Male/M_Eye_Monocle_Glass_Victorian_01.description: A small flat, round monocle lens disc with a thin rim, floating just in front of one eye. It reads as a Victorian-style eyepiece; only the glass insert is shown, with no frame or chain.
Male/M_Eye_Monocle_Glass_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin rim edge; the lens face is a translucent glass-like surface that appears to ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Monocle_Victorian_01.description: A single round monocle worn over one eye, with a thin rim and a glassy lens. A long fine chain hangs from it down the front of the chest and ends in a small hook. Victorian gentleman's style.
Male/M_Eye_Monocle_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim of the lens; colour 2 on the hanging chain; the lens itself is glassy and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Mouthless_Mask_01.description: A smooth, sculpted half-face mask covering the forehead, eyes, cheeks and nose but leaving the mouth and chin bare, with deep hollow eye sockets, a heavy brow, and two small fang-like tusks pointing down at the sides.
Male/M_Eye_Mouthless_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 as soft shading around the eye sockets and edges; colour 2 on the eye holes.

Male/M_Eye_Plague_Mask_01.description: A plague doctor mask with a long downward-curving beak, rounded eye openings and a hollow shell that covers the face, edged with a row of studs and split into two-tone panels along the beak.
Male/M_Eye_Plague_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower cheeks and rims around the eyes; colour 2 on the upper beak and forehead panel and the inside of the mask; colour 1 on the studs.
Male/M_Eye_Plague_Mask_01.differs: The male mask has a contrasting darker panel over the forehead, top of the beak and interior, while the female version is a single uniform shell colour.

Male/M_Eye_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A wraparound visor-style eye mask with a V-shaped brow line, sharply upswept pointed wings at the temples and a deep point down over the nose bridge. It is a smooth angular shell that sits across the eyes.
Male/M_Eye_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the mask, with glossy highlights along the brow edge and wing tips.
Male/M_Eye_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The male version appears to use a single light default colour on the whole shell, without the contrasting brow trim.

Male/M_Eye_Qularr1eyes_01.description: A single large insect-like eye: a hollow, faceted dome with a rim, and an iris with a contrasting central pupil. It sits over the middle of the forehead, giving a monstrous third-eye look.
Male/M_Eye_Qularr1eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and sclera; colour 1 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_Qularr2eyes_01.description: A pair of large, bulbous eyeballs, each with a round pupil and a faceted rim, mounted at the sides of the face beside the cheeks. They give an alien, insect-like look.
Male/M_Eye_Qularr2eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted rims and outer shells; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Eye_Qularr3eyes_01.description: Three separate bulbous insect-like eyeballs floating on the face: one centred on the brow above the nose and one on each cheek. Each is a rounded hollow dome with a pupil dot and a rim.
Male/M_Eye_Qularr3eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer edges of the eyeballs; colour 1 on the iris area of each eye; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Eye_Qularr4eyes_01.description: Four floating insect-like eyeballs, two on each side of the face: a large round eye hangs beside each cheek with a smaller eye above and behind it near the temple. Suggests an alien or monstrous look.
Male/M_Eye_Qularr4eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eye whites and rims; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Eye_Qularr_8eyes_01.description: Eight faceted, octagonal insect-style eyes arranged in two clusters of four, one on each side of the face beside the eye sockets and cheeks, each with a small contrasting pupil.
Male/M_Eye_Qularr_8eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyeball surfaces; colour 0 on the rims and highlights of each eye; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Eye_Qularr_Humanface_01.description: A pair of large, bulbous insect-style compound eyes, each covered in a honeycomb of small hexagonal facets and set in a raised rounded rim. The rims nearly meet across the nose bridge, giving a fly-like look.
Male/M_Eye_Qularr_Humanface_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rims surrounding the eyes; colour 1 on the faceted compound eye surfaces.
Male/M_Eye_Qularr_Humanface_01.differs: The male eyes have a honeycomb faceted compound texture and the rims nearly touch at the nose bridge, while the female eyes are smooth glossy domes set further apart.

Male/M_Eye_Qularr_Large_01.description: A pair of oversized insect-style compound eyes: two rounded, shell-like domes with a honeycomb facet pattern, each set in a smooth rim and sitting on either side of the face over the eyes, extending outward past the cheeks.
Male/M_Eye_Qularr_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the honeycomb facets of the eyes; colour 3 on the smooth outer rim and shell of each eye.

Male/M_Eye_R_Beast_Boar_01.description: A single small replacement eye for the right side of the head: a narrow, angled eyeball set into a pointed hooded lid, giving a sideways-set, beast-like eye. It sits at the temple, well to the side of the face.
Male/M_Eye_R_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hooded lid surround; the eyeball itself keeps its own texture and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.description: A single bulbous, slightly faceted eyeball with a tall slit pupil, replacing one eye on the head. It gives a reptilian, dragon-like look and sits proud of the face like a small sphere.
Male/M_Eye_R_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball surface; colour 2 on the slit pupil. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Eye_R_Beast_Kitsune_01.description: A single stylised beast eye replacing the natural eye: a narrow, almond-shaped slit with a glossy contrasting pupil and contrasting iris, framed by a sharp swept-back pointed lid that extends toward the temple, giving a fox-like look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Beast_Kitsune_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed upper lid shape; the iris and pupil keep their own eye colouring and do not take a slot.

Male/M_Eye_R_Beast_Werewolf_01.description: A single small beast-style eye piece: a slanted, angular eye with a glossy round pupil and highlight, topped by a sharp wedge-shaped brow plate. It sits over the eye area to give a werewolf-like glare.
Male/M_Eye_R_Beast_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wedge-shaped brow plate; the eyeball and pupil are glossy and do not follow the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Child_Tight_Basic_01.description: A single small, angular eye insert with a round glossy iris and pupil set in a flat, pointed almond-shaped surround. It sits in the eye socket as a natural, realistic eye for a bare head.
Male/M_Eye_R_Child_Tight_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the almond-shaped eye surround; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Bat_01.description: A single oversized, glossy oval eye replacement that sits over the right eye, with a big contrasting pupil, a bright highlight and a thin rim behind it. Gives a bat-like, monstrous or cute look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the thin rim behind the eye; the glossy pupil and iris keep their own shading and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Bear_02.description: A single right eye insert in a bear style: a large rounded eyeball with a big contrasting pupil and a small glossy highlight, ringed by a thin contrasting rim that sits in the eye socket.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Bear_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the iris and eyeball surround; colour 1 on the outer rim of the eye; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Bear_03.description: A single small stylised animal eye insert for the right eye: a flat, angular almond shape with a large glossy round pupil and a highlight, sitting over the natural eye. Suggests a beast-like face.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Bear_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the pupil and main eye; colour 0 on the highlight and lower rim; colour 1 on the corner wedge at the outer edge.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Bull_01.description: A single large animal-style eye, shaped like a rounded almond with a glossy round pupil and a hooded outer rim. It sits at the side of the head, beside the face, giving a bull-like beast look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hooded outer rim around the eye; the glossy eyeball and pupil ignore the scheme and show their own shading.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cat_02.description: A single stylised cat-like eye replacing the natural eye: a slanted almond shape with a large round pupil and highlight, topped by an angular lid plate that gives a fierce, feline brow.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cat_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular upper lid plate; the iris and pupil keep their own eye shading and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cat_03.description: A single stylised feline eye replacing the natural eye: a slanted almond shape with a slit pupil and large iris, framed by a thick angular lid piece above. Suggests a lion or beast-like head.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cat_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper lid and brow shape; colour 0 on the iris and eyeball; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.description: A single right cat-style eye: a large glossy oval eyeball with a big pupil and highlight, set in a pointed, wedge-shaped socket that extends toward the temple. The back is a smooth skin-toned shell.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed socket rim around the eye; the eyeball keeps its own fixed glossy black, and look; the back shell shows skin tone and takes no slot.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cobra_01.description: A single faceted eye-shaped piece on the side of the head, with a large round pupil and iris set in an angular, chunky socket. It sits at the temple beside the natural eye, suggesting a monstrous snake-like look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cobra_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted socket surround; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil; colour 3 on the small accents between the facets.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cobra_01.differs: The male piece is a broader, blockier faceted shape covering more of the temple, with a squarer lower edge.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Corgi_01.description: A single large cartoon-style eye piece with a glossy round pupil, two contrasting highlights and a shaded rim, sitting over the right eye socket. It gives a cute, anime-like animal look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Corgi_01.colourAreas: Colour scheme barely shows; the eye keeps its own textured look, with the rim shading in a muted tone and no clear use of colour slots 0-3.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Coyote_01.description: A small animal-style eye replacement: a slanted, angular eye shape with a pointed outer corner and a flat wedge of contrasting rim around the eyeball. It sits over the eye on the face and suggests a coyote or beast look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Coyote_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular wedge rim around the eye; the eyeball itself ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.description: A single large monstrous eye plate for the right side of the face: a slanted, wedge-shaped socket with a glossy contrasting eyeball and highlight spots, edged by a raised angular rim at the temple.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim and socket shell; the eyeball itself keeps its own and glossy look and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Dinosaur_Large_01.description: A single large reptilian eye on the side of the head: a slanted almond-shaped eyeball with a big contrasting pupil and highlight, set in an angular wedge-shaped socket that juts out from the temple.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Dinosaur_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular socket surround; the eyeball itself keeps its own textured and look and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Doberman_01.description: A single stylised animal eye for one side of the face: a glossy round pupil and iris set in a small angular lid-shaped shell that sits over the eye socket and gives a beastly, canine look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Doberman_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid shell around the eye; the eyeball itself (iris and pupil) does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Dog_01.description: A single stylised canine eye with a large round pupil and iris set in a small angular wedge-shaped lid piece, sitting over the right eye socket. It gives a husky or beast-like look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyelid wedge surround; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Dragon_01.description: A single reptilian dragon eye replacing the right eye: a small angular, slit-like eyeball with a glossy round pupil and highlight, framed by a pointed wedge-shaped lid that flares outward at the corners.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed lid wedge around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own iris and pupil and does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A single right eye replacement in a reptilian, dragon-like style: a slit-pupil eyeball set in a small angular, wedge-shaped socket plate that sits over the eye. Reads as a monstrous partial face piece.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular socket plate around the eye; the eyeball itself (iris, pupil and highlight) does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Fennec_01.description: A single oversized cartoon eye shape on a thin angular flat panel, with a large glossy pupil and highlight spots, set over the right side of the face beside the temple. Suggests a cute anime-like fox look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer panel edge around the eye; the pupil and iris show and light shading that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Fishmonster_01.description: A single oversized fish-like eye replacing the right eye: an almond-shaped shell with a large glossy pupil and highlight, and a curved fin-like flap sweeping up and back at the outer corner.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Fishmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer fin-like flap at the temple; the eyeball and pupil keep their own textured look and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Goat_01.description: A single animal-style eye replacement for the right eye: a slanted, almond-shaped eyeball with a large contrasting elongated pupil and a glossy highlight, set in a small angular pointed surround at the outer corner.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid surround; the eyeball and pupil use their own textured look and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Horse_01.description: A single horse-style eye set on the side of the head: a glossy round eyeball with a large pupil sits in a small pointed wedge of surrounding skin-like lid. It replaces the right eye in a beast face.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lid wedge around the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own eye texture and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Hyena_01.description: A single small beast-like eye replacing the right eye: a round glossy pupil and iris under a pointed, angular brow-shaped lid that sweeps down toward the nose, giving a predatory hyena-like glare.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid and brow shape; the eyeball itself keeps its own iris and pupil, unaffected by the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Kangaroo_01.description: A single stylised animal eye overlay for one eye: a rounded glossy eyeball with a large pupil and highlight, set in an angular pointed lid shape that sweeps outward toward the temple. Gives a beastly look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular pointed lid shape around the eye; the eyeball itself shows its own iris, pupil and highlight and does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Kitty_01.description: A single stylised cat-like eye: a small almond-shaped socket with a large round pupil and glossy highlight, sitting on the right eye area of the face and replacing the normal eye. Cartoonish and animal-like.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the almond-shaped eyelid socket around the eye; the iris, pupil and highlight are not tinted by the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Kitty_02.description: A single stylised cat-like eye replacing the natural eye: an almond-shaped eyeball with a slit-like pupil and highlight, set in a pointed angular surround that flares outward toward the temple. Cartoonish and cute.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Kitty_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer surround; the eyeball, iris and pupil keep their own fixed shading and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Lizard_01.description: A single reptilian eye placed on the side of the head: a large rounded eyeball with a slit-like pupil sits in a pointed, wedge-shaped lid or socket that juts out from the temple, giving a lizard-like look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed lid and socket surround; the eyeball and pupil show their own default look and are not affected by the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Llama_01.description: A single large glossy cartoon-style eye, a rounded angular shape with a big contrasting pupil and contrasting highlights, set over the right eye socket. It gives a cute animal-like look, like a llama.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the small wedge at the outer corner of the eye; the eye itself uses a fixed pupil and highlight texture that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Mouse_01.description: A single large cartoonish animal eye replacing the right eye: a rounded glossy pupil and iris with highlights, framed by an angular pointed lid patch that sweeps out toward the temple. Suggests a cute mouse-like creature face.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Mouse_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid patch around the eye; the iris and pupil use their own painted eye texture and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Otter_01.description: A single glossy, cartoonish animal eye with a large round pupil and highlight, topped by a small angular faceted lid or brow cap. It sits on the side of the head like an otter's eye.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Otter_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted lid cap; the eyeball itself is glossy and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Owl_01.description: A single oversized owl-like eye, a glossy rounded dome with a large pupil and two small highlight spots, set in a thin rim over the right eye. It is an animal-styled, cartoonish eye replacement.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Owl_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the pupil and dome; colour 0 on the highlight spots; colour 1 on the thin outer rim. Glossy finish, so the scheme may show only partly.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Pig_01.description: A tiny single eye piece from a pig head set: a small wedge-shaped brow patch with a glossy round eyeball, sitting high on the side of the face above the natural eye. Suggests a beastly or monstrous look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Pig_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wedge-shaped brow patch; the eyeball itself shows fixed and tones that ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Pitbull_01.description: A single realistic animal-style eye piece for the right eye: a glossy round iris and pupil with a highlight, set in a slim pointed almond-shaped rim that sits on the face at the eye socket.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Pitbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer almond-shaped rim around the eye; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Rabbitl_01.description: A single animal-style eye for the side of the head: a glossy round eyeball with a large pupil and highlight, set in a small angular wedge-shaped socket, giving a rabbit-like sideways gaze.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Rabbitl_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the socket surround; the eyeball itself keeps its own glossy iris and pupil and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Raccoon_01.description: A single right eye replacement in a raccoon style: a round glossy iris and pupil set within a pointed, angular patch that sweeps outward and down at the corner, like a mask marking around the eye.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Raccoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed patch around the eye; the iris and pupil show the eye's own texture and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Raptor_01.description: A single raptor-style eye set on the side of the head above the normal eye position: a rounded, slightly angular socket with a large glossy pupil slit and a ridged iris. Suggests a beast or monstrous look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Raptor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the socket rim around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own default eye shading and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Raptor_02.description: A single large animal-style eye set on the side of the head, with a glossy round pupil and highlight inside a shallow socket rim. It gives a raptor or beast look and sits well out from the face.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Raptor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the socket rim around the eye; the eyeball and pupil keep their own glossy and texture and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Raptor_03.description: A single enlarged reptilian eye set on the side of the head: a glossy contrasting pupil with a highlight, ringed by a rounded socket rim. It suggests a raptor or beast-like head.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Raptor_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer socket rim; the glossy pupil and iris ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Reptillian_Large_01.description: A single reptilian eye piece: a small angular, slit-pupil eye shape with a pointed, swept-back brow wedge over the outer corner, placed over the right eye for a beastly look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Reptillian_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed brow wedge; the eyeball and slit pupil keep their own detail and do not take the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Salamander_01.description: A single large, oval reptilian eye that sits on the side of the head, above and outside the natural eye. It has a glossy contrasting pupil with contrasting highlights and a thin rim, suggesting a salamander or monster look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Salamander_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the thin rim behind the eye; the eyeball itself keeps its own and shading and does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Seahorse_01.description: A single bulging, faceted eye-shaped disc worn over one side of the face at the eye and temple, with a round central pupil and a flat back. Suggests a creature or mechanical eye.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Seahorse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and back of the eye; colour 1 on the ring around the pupil; colour 3 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Set_01.description: A single small stylised monstrous eye set on the side of the head beside the temple: a narrow, pointed almond shape with a large round pupil and a faceted angular edge at the back.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Set_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted angular rear edge of the eye; the eyeball and pupil are textured and do not use the colour scheme.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Set_01.differs: The male eye is slightly rounder and broader, with a larger pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Shisa_01.description: A single stylised eye replacement for the right eye: a glossy contrasting pupil with a highlight in an angular, slanted socket, with a pointed wedge flaring outward at the outer corner. Gives a fierce, beast-like gaze.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Shisa_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer wedge; the eyeball and pupil take the default eye look and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Suave_Wolf_02.description: A single stylised animal-like eye replacing the natural right eye: a round glossy iris and pupil set in a sharp, angular pointed lid that sweeps outward and downward toward the temple, giving a predatory wolf look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Suave_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed angular lid surround; the iris and pupil show a glossy eye texture that does not take a colour slot.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Vampire_01.description: A single small stylised eyeball insert for the right eye, with a large contrasting pupil, glossy highlight and a thin angular rim around it. It sits low on the face, below the natural eye, giving an uncanny, monstrous look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Vampire_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular rim around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Vampire_02.description: A single small replacement eye with a slit-like vertical pupil inside a pointed, diamond-shaped socket. It sits low on the cheek beneath the right eye, suggesting a vampire or monster look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Vampire_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed socket surround; the iris and pupil keep their own eye texture and ignore the colour scheme.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Vampire_02.differs: The male eye is smaller and sits low beneath the natural eye, rather than covering the eye as on the female.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Vampire_03.description: A single stylised right eye insert with a large round iris and pupil inside an angular, slightly pointed socket shape, giving a sharp, predatory vampire gaze. It sits over the eye and is otherwise tiny.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Vampire_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye socket surround; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Vampire_Large_01.description: A single replacement eye piece for the right eye: a small angular, faceted eyeball with a contrasting pupil and highlight, capped by a slanted brow-like shell that gives a fierce, bat-like monstrous gaze.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Vampire_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angled brow shell over the eye; colour 0 on the iris and eyeball surround; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Whiterhino_01.description: A single small monster eye set at the side of the head, beside the temple: a rounded, glossy eyeball with a large pupil sits in an angular wedge-shaped socket. It suggests a beastly rhino-like head type.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Whiterhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wedge-shaped socket casing; the eyeball itself uses its own fixed eye texture and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Wolf_01.description: A single animal-style eye insert for the right eye: a narrow, slanted almond-shaped eyeball with a large round pupil and highlight, and long pointed lid wedges at both ends. It sits over the brow line, giving a fierce wolf look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long pointed lid wedges around the eye; the eyeball, pupil and iris are not clearly recoloured by the scheme and show fixed shading.
Male/M_Eye_R_Face_Wolf_01.differs: The male eye is more slanted and elongated, with long pointed lid tips, and sits higher near the brow.

Male/M_Eye_R_Ferret_01.description: A single small animal-style eye replacing the right eye: a glossy round pupil with a highlight in a rounded iris, framed by a small angular wedge of surround at the outer corner. Suggests a beastly, ferret-like look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Ferret_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wedge-shaped surround at the outer corner; the iris and pupil keep their own fixed shading and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Monkey_01.description: A single replacement right eye with a large glossy iris and pupil set in an angular, slanted socket shape that sweeps up toward the outer corner, giving a sharp, animal-like glare.
Male/M_Eye_R_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular socket surround; the iris and pupil show their own shading and are not affected by the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Orc_01.description: A single small angular eye piece with a narrow, slanted almond shape, a round iris and pupil with a highlight, and a pointed outer edge that gives a scowling, brutish look. It sits in the eye socket.
Male/M_Eye_R_Orc_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid and eye surround; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Starowl_01.description: A single stylised eye with a large round iris and highlight, set inside an angular wedge-shaped lid plate that sweeps up and outward for a fierce, owl-like glare. Sits over the eye socket.
Male/M_Eye_R_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lid plate around the eye; the iris and pupil keep their own eye colouring and do not follow the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Basic_01.description: A basic right eye: an almond-shaped eyelid surround with a round iris, contrasting pupil and small highlight, sitting flat on the face in the eye socket. A natural, human look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eyelid surround and eye socket area; the iris and pupil keep their own fixed shading and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.description: A single stylised beast eye replacing the right eye: a round iris and pupil with a highlight, framed by a sharp angular slanted lid shape that gives a predatory wolf-like glare.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular lid surround; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.differs: The male eye has a steeper, more pointed brow-like lid that slants sharply down toward the nose.

Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A single replacement eye piece: a small almond-shaped eyeball with a large round pupil and highlight, plus a pointed wedge-like lid extension at the outer corner. It sits in the eye socket, giving a beastly, monstrous gaze.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed outer wedge around the eye; the iris, pupil and eyeball keep their own default look and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Feral_01.description: A replacement eye piece with a slanted, angular almond-shaped socket that sweeps up and back toward the temple, holding a round animal-like eye with a large contrasting pupil. Gives a fierce, feral look.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Feral_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eye socket surround; the eyeball and pupil keep their own fixed appearance and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Fox_02.description: A single stylised animal eye piece with a slanted, almond-shaped lid and a large round pupil with a glossy highlight, sitting over the eye like a fox-like eye replacement. Small and partial in coverage.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Fox_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid surround; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A small almond-shaped eye insert that fills the right eye socket, giving a monstrous, beast-like eye. It is a tiny curved shell divided into bands across its width, sitting flush within the eyelids.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer and inner ends of the eye; colour 3 on the central band across the eye.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The male eye is split into banded sections with a contrasting central stripe, rather than one uniform shade.

Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Werewolf_Full_01.description: A single small extra eye with an angular, slanted lid shape, set on the forehead above the right eye. It gives a monstrous, beast-like look and is a tiny partial head addition.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Werewolf_Full_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid surround; the eyeball and pupil show their own shading and do not take a colour slot.

Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_01.description: A single small replacement eye with a round iris and pupil, set in a slanted, almond-shaped lid that sits over the eye socket. It gives a feral, beast-like gaze without covering the rest of the face.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid surround; colour 0 on the iris and eyeball; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_02.description: A small pair of angular, almond-shaped eye inserts with a round iris and pupil, sitting over the eyes. Pointed corners give a feral, beastly look; nothing else on the head is altered.
Male/M_Eye_R_Tight_Werewolf_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the angular eyelid surround; colour 0 on the iris; colour 2 on the pupil.

Male/M_Eye_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A retro full-head helmet with a smooth domed crown, a banded brow ridge with a pointed nose guard, a contrasting visor slit, and boxy side pods. Cheek guards and a rear neck skirt cover the head, leaving the mouth and chin open.
Male/M_Eye_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed crown; colour 1 on the brow band, nose guard and side pods; colour 2 on the lower face plates and neck skirt; colour 3 on the small studs and the thin trim beneath the brow.

Male/M_Eye_Safety_Glasses_01.description: Wraparound safety glasses with a single curved lens spanning both eyes and a small nose notch, a brow bar across the top, and slim temple arms that hook back over the ears.
Male/M_Eye_Safety_Glasses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the temple arms and frame edges; colour 1 on the brow bar; colour 3 on small accents along the brow bar; colour 2 on the thin underside line of the frame. The lens is a translucent tint that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Safety_Glasses_Glass_01.description: A wraparound visor-style pair of safety glasses: a single curved lens band spanning both eyes with a nose notch and angled side wings that wrap toward the temples. It has no frame or strap.
Male/M_Eye_Safety_Glasses_Glass_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole lens band; the glass-like material appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Eye_Safety_Goggles_01.description: Wraparound safety goggles with a single wide tinted lens in a rounded frame, side vent studs and small square buckles, held by a broad strap that loops over the top of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Safety_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle frame and side studs; colour 1 on the head strap; colour 3 on the square side buckles; the lens ignores the scheme and looks glassy.

Male/M_Eye_Safety_Goggles_Glass_01.description: Wraparound safety goggles with a single wide lens set in a moulded rim that curves back to the temples, with small round vent studs on each side. Sits across the eyes and brow, no strap visible.
Male/M_Eye_Safety_Goggles_Glass_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and rim; colour 2 on the side vent studs; the lens is glass and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Scuba_01.description: A full-face diving mask with an angular, faceted frame around a clear lens, a tall side-mounted snorkel tube topped with a mouthpiece-style cap, a corrugated hose curving under the chin, and crossing head straps at the back.
Male/M_Eye_Scuba_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and snorkel tube; colour 1 on the inner rim and lower panels; colour 3 on the head straps and snorkel tip; colour 2 on the corrugated hose.

Male/M_Eye_Spectacles_01.description: Small round wire-rimmed spectacles with two slightly octagonal lenses joined by a thin bridge. Thin arms run back along the head and end in small downward-curving tips behind the ears. Suggests a scholarly or vintage look.
Male/M_Eye_Spectacles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame and arms; the lenses show a tinted translucent look that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Spectacles_Lens_01.description: A pair of thin, round faceted lenses for spectacles, floating in front of the eyes with no frames or arms. They sit just below the eye line and read as small tinted discs with a light edge.
Male/M_Eye_Spectacles_Lens_01.colourAreas: The lenses ignore the colour scheme and show a translucent glassy tint; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Eye_Spectacles_Lens_01.differs: The male lenses have a visible contrasting rim edge and sit a little higher against the eyes.

Male/M_Eye_Spiked_01.description: A wide, flat band that wraps around the head at eye level, covering the eyes like a blindfold. Conical spikes stick out around its circumference, with small round studs between them. Punk or monstrous look.
Male/M_Eye_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 3 on the spikes and larger studs; colour 2 on the small round studs.

Male/M_Eye_Starhawk_01.description: Wraparound superhero goggles: a single curved lens with a wavy upper and lower edge sits over both eyes, framed by a raised rim and a short band that wraps back toward the temples.
Male/M_Eye_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised front rim; colour 1 on the inner side band; the lens is translucent and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Starhawk_02.description: Wraparound visor-style goggles: a single tinted lens with a V-shaped brow line sweeps across both eyes and curves back toward the temples, edged by a thin rim. Superhero or sci-fi eyewear.
Male/M_Eye_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and frame; the lens ignores the colour scheme and appears as tinted glass.

Male/M_Eye_Super_Retro_Destroyer_02.description: A retro superhero cowl-crown: a swept, V-dipping brow band with two tall, curved horn-like fins rising at the temples and a pointed, notched edge around the back of the head. Leaves the face and top of the head open.
Male/M_Eye_Super_Retro_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Default material appears mostly glossy metal and largely ignores the colour scheme; the light rim edge along the brow and fins may take colour 0.
Male/M_Eye_Super_Retro_Destroyer_02.differs: The male version's fins are slightly wider and shorter, with a shallower back notch pattern.

Male/M_Eye_Swing_01.description: A pair of small reading glasses with two oval lenses in thin rounded rims joined by a short bridge, with straight arms running back over the ears. Sits on the nose and eyes; casual, bookish look.
Male/M_Eye_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frames and arms; the lenses are translucent and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Swing_02.description: Twin-lens goggles with rounded shell housings joined by a thin bridge, each lens ringed by a contrasting bezel. A wide, gathered elastic strap wraps around the head, sitting across the eyes and forehead.
Male/M_Eye_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the goggle shells and bridge; colour 1 on the head strap; colour 2 on the lens bezels; colour 3 on the lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Techno_01.description: A rigid, angular face-mask visor that wraps across the eyes and cheeks from ear to ear, tapering to a pointed lower edge over the nose, with small wedge-shaped studs at each outer corner. Suggests a sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Eye_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main mask shell; colour 2 on the small wedge-shaped studs at the outer corners.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_01.description: A transparent wraparound visor-style pair of goggles: a single faceted clear lens band spanning both eyes with a notched lower edge over the nose, curving back toward the temples. Sleek retro 90s look with no visible strap.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour scheme barely shows; the clear glass-like lens ignores the colour slots and only the thin edge outline is faintly visible.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_02.description: A large transparent wraparound visor-style goggle lens that spans both eyes from temple to temple, with a straight top edge and a V-notched lower edge dipping over the nose. It has no visible strap or frame.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_02.colourAreas: Glass-like clear material that ignores the colour scheme; no visible areas take colour slots 0-3.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_90s_Goggles_02.differs: The male lens is taller and boxier with rounded upper corners and a deeper cut over the nose.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Bat_Winged_01.description: A domino-style eye mask shaped like bat wings: a wide band across the eyes with scalloped, pointed wing tips sweeping up and out at the temples and teardrop lens openings. Sits close to the face in a superhero style.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Bat_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask frame; colour 1 on the lens inserts.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.description: A small angular brow and nose guard: a broad V-shaped plate across the forehead with swept-out winged tips, a central panel that drops into a narrow pointed strip running down the bridge of the nose.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer brow wings; colour 2 on the central forehead panel; colour 0 on the nose strip.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.differs: The male guard has a shorter nose strip that ends partway down the nose bridge, with flatter, wider brow wings.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Face_Prisonguard_01.description: A rigid armored face plate covering the eyes and nose bridge: a heavy angular brow ridge, two hexagonal eye openings, a rounded nose cap and a contrasting lower edge. It sits across the upper face, suggesting a mechanical guard look.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Face_Prisonguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate body and brow; colour 3 on the eye panels; colour 1 on the nose cap; colour 2 on the lower edge trim.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Fantasy_01.description: A fantasy half-helm mask: a studded band circles the head, with a front plate that has pointed upward wings, a central gem on the brow, cut-out eye openings and a nose guard running down the face.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and band surfaces; colour 1 on the outline trim and the inner band edge; colour 3 on the brow gem; colour 2 on the studs.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Feather_Mask_01.description: A flat domino-style eye mask with swept, feather-shaped wings extending outward past the temples, a pointed central brow piece dipping toward the nose bridge, and two eye openings. Suggests a bird of prey superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Feather_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body and outer feather edges; colour 1 on the central brow piece; colour 2 on the layered feather panels on one side.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Feather_Mask_02.description: A domino-style eye mask with a central X-shaped band across the nose bridge and layered feather-like wings sweeping up and outward past each temple. Sits tight over the eyes with a superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Feather_Mask_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central X-shaped band; colour 0 on the outer feather layers; colour 3 on the inner feather stripes; colour 2 on the topmost feather at each side.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Feather_Mask_03.description: A half-face domino mask covering the eyes and upper nose, with swept feather-like panels and outlined edges. A tall feathered plume sweeps up from one side of the brow, and a pointed nose piece runs down the bridge.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Feather_Mask_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathered mask panels; colour 1 on the swirling eye-surround linework; colour 2 on the outer edging and outline; colour 3 on the nose piece.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_01.description: A full-face gas mask in a smooth, skin-tight shell covering the face, with round rimmed eye lenses, a ribbed cylindrical filter snout over the mouth, and thin straps that cross over the top and back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and head straps; colour 1 on the lens rims; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter snout.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.description: A full-face gas mask hugging the head, with rounded oval eye lenses in raised rims, a large filter canister on the mouth with a side canister, and thin straps crossing the back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and head straps; colour 1 on the lens rims and side canister cap; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter canisters.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.differs: The male mask has a ring-shaped lower strap at the back and an extra strap band running over the top of the head.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.description: A wraparound tech visor with a contrasting glossy lens band edged in contrasting piping, a boxy device pod with a square panel on each temple, and a thin cable microphone boom curving down to the mouth.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the temple pods, side tabs and the back shield panel; colour 1 on the lens rim piping and the cable; colour 2 on the lens and mic tip; colour 3 on the pod panels.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The male back panel is coloured with colour 0, matching the pods, rather than the rim piping colour.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Goggles_01.description: Chunky round-lensed goggles with thick octagonal rims joined by a curved bridge, held by a wide ribbed strap that wraps around the head. Small block hinges sit at the temples; a casual, retro-mechanical look.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the lens rims; colour 1 on the lenses; colour 0 on the bridge and side hinge blocks; colour 2 with colour 0 striping on the head strap; colour 3 on the small strap patch.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Goggles_Insect_01.description: Insect-style goggles on a rounded headband pod across the forehead, with two long ribbed flexible tubes curving down to bulky boxy lens housings, each holding a round lens, sitting over the eyes and cheeks.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Goggles_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forehead pod; colour 3 on the lens housings; colour 1 on the round lenses; colour 2 on the ribbed tubes and small side details.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Goggles_Insect_02.description: Insect-style goggles: two rounded lens pods with small spiked pegs sit in front of the eyes, joined by thin flexible tubes that arc around the head to a padded cylindrical block at the back.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Goggles_Insect_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lens housings, pegs and the rear block; colour 2 on the connecting tubes; colour 3 on the thin rings at the ends of the rear block; the lens centres are glossy and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.description: A faceted, star-shaped domino mask covering the eyes and brow, with a tall central point above the forehead, sharp wing points sweeping out to each side and small points beneath the eyes. Bold golden-age superhero style.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mask; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Greendragon_01.description: A close-fitting half mask covering the brow, cheeks and nose bridge, with two tall pointed wing-like horns sweeping up at the temples, eye cut-outs, a scale-textured pattern and a pointed beak-like nose piece.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Greendragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central brow and cheek areas; colour 1 on the scale-patterned wings; colour 3 around the eye openings; colour 2 on the nose piece and lower edges.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Jackfool_Skull_01.description: A cracked skull half-mask covering the brow, cheeks and nose, with two pointed horn-like ears on top, hollow eye sockets and an open contrasting mouth ringed by a row of teeth. Suggests a monstrous, gothic look.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Jackfool_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone of the skull; colour 1 on the teeth along the lower edge; colour 2 on the mouth cavity and crack lines.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Jackfool_Skull_02.description: A cracked bird-skull half mask covering the brow, eyes and nose, with pointed horn-like ears at the top, hollow eye sockets and a long downward-curving beak with nostril holes; small studded tabs sit at the beak's base.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Jackfool_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and beak; colour 1 on the small tabs at the base of the beak; colour 2 on the cracks and inner shadow.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Jeweled_01.description: A domino-style eye mask with upswept pointed outer corners and two eye openings, studded with scattered small raised gems or beads across the front. It sits close over the eyes and nose bridge, suiting a masquerade or superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Jeweled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the pointed outer tips, blending in from the edges; colour 2 and colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Jeweled_02.description: A domino-style eye mask with two eye openings joined over the nose and swept-up pointed wings at the outer corners. Rows of small studded gems line the front edge. It sits close on the face like a masquerade or superhero mask.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Jeweled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask body around the eyes and the inner edge; colour 1 on the pointed outer wings; colour 3 on some of the studded gems; colour 2 on the other gems.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Gladiator_01.description: A gladiator-style face mask that wraps the upper head and brow, with angular brow plates over the eyes, a long nose guard, and two cheek bars studded with small gems. A gem sits at the centre of the forehead.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and nose guard; colour 0 on the brow plates and cheek bars; colour 3 on the forehead gem and the studs.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_01.description: A close-fitting superhero domino mask covering the eyes, brow and upper cheeks, with angular pointed edges, a notch over the nose bridge and a contrasting inner band around the eye openings.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer mask shell; colour 1 on the inner band around the eyes; colour 3 on the thin rim of the eye openings; colour 2 on the outer edge lining.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_02.description: A tight, flat superhero domino mask wrapping across the eyes and nose bridge, with tall sharp pointed wings sweeping up at the temples, a curved brow band, and angular eye openings with rimmed edges.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body; colour 1 on the curved brow band across the forehead; colour 3 on the rims around the eye openings; colour 2 on the thin outer edge outlines.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_02.differs: The male mask has taller, more swept-up temple points and a wider brow band, with a flatter inside bridge.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_03.description: A superhero half-mask covering the brow, eyes, cheeks and nose bridge, with a pointed forehead crest, a diamond gem at the centre, angled eye cut-outs and tiger-like stripes sweeping across the cheeks.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the diamond gem; colour 2 on the cheek stripes; colour 3 on the edge trim.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_03.differs: The male mask has a broader, more rounded forehead crest and shorter lower cheek points.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_04.description: A superhero domino-style eye mask with swept-up pointed ear-like tips on the brow, angular eye openings with raised rims, a nose bridge point and cheek wings. It sits flat against the upper face.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the raised rims around the eye openings; colour 2 on the thin edge outlines.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_06.description: A curved, shield-like domino mask covering the upper face: a wide plate with a shallow notched top edge, hexagonal eye holes, a pointed nose bridge and side flanges down the cheeks, edged with a thin contrasting rim.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the painted patches around the eyes; colour 1 on the eye-hole rims; colour 2 on the outer edge trim.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_06.differs: The male mask has a shallower top notch and a flatter, boxier plate.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_07.description: A superhero half-helmet mask covering the forehead, crown and eye area, with a raised central crest panel, angular eye openings, pointed cheek flares and a thin contrasting edge trim. The open back shows a hollow shell.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and cheek flares; colour 1 on the raised forehead crest panel; colour 3 on the thin edge trim; colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_08.description: A rigid superhero domino-style eye mask with angular hexagonal eye openings and a deep V-shaped upper edge that rises into two tall points over the brow. A small diamond gem sits at the bridge, with trim along the top edge.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Hero_08.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 3 on the trim along the upper edge; colour 1 on the diamond gem at the brow; colour 2 on the eye opening rims.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Skull_01.description: A faceted, low-poly skull mask covering the forehead, eyes, nose and upper jaw, with a hollow interior, angular brow ridges, open eye sockets, a nose hole and a toothed lower edge. It suggests a menacing, monstrous look.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull crown, cheeks and teeth; colour 1 on the outer edges, brow rims and side panels; colour 3 on the streaks above the eyes and the nose strip.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Zorran_01.description: A metal half-mask helm covering the brow, eyes and nose bridge with angular plates and a pointed nose guard, topped with two large ridged ram horns that curl back and around the sides of the head. Beast-like fantasy styling.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Mask_Zorran_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask plates and the outer ridges of the horns; colour 1 on the inner curls and tips of the horns and the inner mask edges; colour 3 on the eye rims.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Maskfoxbat_01.description: A close-fitting face mask with a smooth shell covering the forehead and cheeks, two tall curved horn-like points rising above the brow, eye openings, a narrow nose stripe and a separate chin plate. Bat-like superhero style.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Maskfoxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and chin plate; colour 1 on the stripe down the nose.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Maskfoxbat_Zombie_01.description: A ragged, zombie-like half mask with a shell that wraps the face and sides of the head. It has tall pointed, chipped fins rising at the brow, a stripe down the nose bridge, cut-out eyes and a torn jaw edge.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Maskfoxbat_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and jaw piece; colour 1 on the stripe down the nose bridge.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Power_01.description: A set of small floating disc-shaped sensor pods arranged around the head: a ringed pod at the brow centre, pods beside each eye and at the back of the skull, and two larger domed discs at the temples. Sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two large temple discs; colour 0 on the ringed pods at the brow and eyes and on the rear discs; colour 2 on the pod centres and lens openings.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Pulp_Aviator_Goggles_01.description: Pulp aviator goggles with two rounded-angular lenses in a thick metal frame, a padded cushion lining behind the eyes, and a thin strap with a small buckle circling the head.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Pulp_Aviator_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and outer frame; colour 1 on the padded lining behind the lenses; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the inner frame rims.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Pulp_Aviator_Goggles_02.description: Pulp aviator goggles pushed up onto the forehead: two rounded lenses in padded rims with a nose bridge, held by a thin band around the head and a wide padded panel at the back.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Pulp_Aviator_Goggles_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded goggle frames and head band; colour 2 on the rims and bridge fittings; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 1 on the back panel.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A bird-of-prey beak mask covering the eyes and nose: rounded eye rims sit on a ridged, downward-curving raven beak that hangs over the mouth, with side plates reaching back toward the temples.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beak and eye rims; colour 0 on the brow and lower edge trim and the side plates; colour 3 on the cheek recesses; colour 2 on the inner shadow panels.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Retroscifi_Goggles_01.description: A transparent wraparound visor-style goggle: one continuous curved lens shield covering both eyes and the nose bridge, with a thin outlined edge, a notch over the nose, and sides that curve back toward the temples.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Retroscifi_Goggles_01.colourAreas: Colour scheme barely shows; the whole lens is a translucent glassy surface, with only a faint edge outline picking up colour 0.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Riotfacemask_01.description: A riot-style face shield: a segmented headband circles the head and holds a thick brow bar, from which a curved transparent visor hangs down past the chin, edged with a thin rim.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Riotfacemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the headband; colour 2 on the brow bar and visor rim; colour 1 on the visor, which has a glassy gradient and mostly ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Riotfacemask_01.differs: The male headband sits low, mostly hidden behind the brow bar, instead of rising visibly above it as on the female version.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A sculpted half-face mask covering the forehead, brow and eye area down to the upper cheeks, with a scowling, wrinkled brow ridge, open eye holes and a thin curved stripe across the forehead.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the curved stripe across the forehead.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Sharp_01.description: Angular wraparound visor glasses with a broad V-shaped lens band across the eyes and long swept-back spikes at each temple, joined by a thin zigzag frame that runs around the back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Sharp_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame rim; colour 1 on the inner temple spike panels; colour 2 on the outer spike tips; colour 3 on the lens.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Sharp_01.differs: The frame shows the light rim colour clearly around the lens and back band, whereas the female version looks darker and more metallic.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Ski_01.description: Wraparound ski goggles with a large curved glossy lens in a rounded frame with a nose notch, held by a segmented, faceted strap that circles the head. Worn high on the forehead like a sporty headband.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame rim; colour 1 on the segmented head strap; the lens is glossy and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Ski_02.description: Ski goggles worn down over the eyes: a wide, rounded single-lens shield with a slim rim, held by a thick segmented strap that wraps around the head at brow level. Sporty, casual eyewear.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Ski_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented head strap; colour 0 on the rim around the lens; the glossy lens ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Tactical_01.description: A wraparound tactical visor: a wide angular band circles the head with a contrasting stripe at the back, and a single tinted lens strip covers the eyes with small indicator lights at the brow.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band and visor frame; colour 1 on the edge piping of the stripe; colour 3 on the back stripe and small brow indicators; colour 2 on the underside of the visor.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Tactical_02.description: A tactical visor band wrapping the head at brow level, with a raised slit housing across the front and a contrasting lens shield hanging below it over the eyes. A contrasting striped strip runs around the back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Tactical_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer band and slit housing; colour 2 on the lens shield beneath; colour 3 on the inner strip at the back and sides; colour 1 on the edging around that strip.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Tactical_03.description: A wraparound tactical visor band that sits across the eyes and brow: a faceted, angular top shell with small slit vents, a lower lens strip, and a rear strip with a side panel that reaches back around the head.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Tactical_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top shell and rim; colour 1 on the lower lens strip; colour 3 on the side and back accent strip; colour 2 on the inner rear edges.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Tactical_04.description: A wraparound tactical visor band worn across the eyes and brow: an angular shell with a stepped brow ridge, a recessed lens strip with thin trim beneath, and a wide rear band with an inset stripe.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Tactical_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow plate and outer shell; colour 1 on the thin trim line under the lens; colour 3 on the inset stripe around the back and sides; colour 2 on the inner underside.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Tactical_04.differs: The brow has a stepped, angular ridge with a more open front, while the female version has a smoother, rounded top slab with a small notch.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Titan_01.description: A faceted, gem-like crest running from the brow up over the top of the head like a mohawk: a diamond-shaped central section, a tapering fin rising behind it, and a small angular nose-bridge plate at the front.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Titan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faceted sides of the diamond; colour 1 on the central front panel, the rear fin and the brow plate rim; colour 2 on the fin's centre strip; colour 3 on the small gems at the fin base and brow plate.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: A wide, angular domino-style eye mask with a pointed nose bridge and diamond-shaped eye holes, wrapping around the head to the temples. Its upper edge has contrasting trim, giving a classic vigilante superhero look.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body; colour 1 on the top edge trim and the vertical end panels at the sides.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Hawkmask_01.description: A half-face masquerade mask covering the brow, eyes and nose, with angular swept-up brow points, outlined eye openings and a long pointed beak-like nose ridge. Thin outline strips curve back toward the ears.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Hawkmask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the edge trim and around the eye openings; colour 2 on the linework curves; colour 3 on the central beak stripe.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Mask_01.description: A masquerade-style eye mask covering the brow, eyes, nose bridge and upper cheeks, with a flatter, broad brow line, swirling scroll patterns, dotted accents and curled trim tails at the cheeks.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek panels; colour 2 on the brow and nose-bridge section; colour 1 on the swirl trim and edging; colour 3 on the small dots.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Wedding_Mask_01.differs: The male mask has a broader, flatter brow with a straighter top edge and fuller cheek panels, rather than a deep V-shaped dip.

Male/M_Eye_Tight_Wingedgoggles_Bluejay_0.description: Winged superhero eye goggles: a butterfly-shaped shell with swept-up pointed tips over the temples, deep eye cups filled with layered panels and a vertical stripe, joined by a pointed nose bridge.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Wingedgoggles_Bluejay_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer wing shell and nose bridge; colour 1 on the eye cup panels; colour 2 on the angled band across each cup; colour 3 on the vertical stripe in each cup.
Male/M_Eye_Tight_Wingedgoggles_Bluejay_0.differs: The male goggles fill the eye cups with coloured panels, a contrasting band and a vertical stripe, whereas the female version has open contrasting lenses in thin rims with small studs.

Male/M_Eye_Valorous_01.description: A full mechanical helmet-mask covering the face and crown, with an angular brow plate, slanted eye patches, a pointed chin, tall swept-back spikes above the ears and boxy ear pods.
Male/M_Eye_Valorous_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spikes; colour 2 on the brow band and lower face; colour 3 on the forehead plate and eye patches; colour 1 on the ear pods.
Male/M_Eye_Valorous_01.differs: The male version has a plain cheek area, without the row of dotted markings on the female version.

Male/M_Eye_Valorous_02.description: A domino-style armored eye mask with a swept-back brow ridge that rises into sharp points at the temples, a pointed nose guard, jagged cheek plates, and side wings that wrap toward the back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Valorous_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek plates, nose guard and rear wings; colour 1 on the brow ridge; colour 2 on the inner lining around the eyes; colour 3 on the eye lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Valorous_03.description: An asymmetric half-face mask: a swept-up angular plate covers one eye and brow with a raised, outlined almond cut-out and a pointed horn-like tip, joined to a curved lower guard over nose, mouth and cheeks.
Male/M_Eye_Valorous_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eye plate and the inner surface; colour 1 on the lower mouth and cheek guard; colour 3 on the outline around the eye cut-out; colour 2 on the edge trim and the pointed tip.

Male/M_Eye_Valorous_04.description: A robotic wolf or jackal head mask covering the face and skull: tall pointed ears with inner panels, a snout with jagged jaw lines and rows of small binary-digit markings, round ear-cup discs at the sides, and a brow cap panel.
Male/M_Eye_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and ears; colour 1 on the brow and forehead cap panel; colour 3 on the ear interiors, eye slashes and jaw gaps; colour 2 on the side ear-cup discs.
Male/M_Eye_Valorous_04.differs: The male muzzle carries rows of small binary-digit markings that the female version lacks.

Male/M_Eye_Valorous_05.description: A horned eye mask: a angular, pointed band across the eyes with a faceted central point over the nose and two tall curved horns sweeping up from the temples. Fantasy-armour style with a contrasting fringe of hair-like trim beneath.
Male/M_Eye_Valorous_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask band and horns; colour 2 on the faceted centre point; colour 1 on the fringe of strands beneath the band.

Male/M_Eye_Valorous_06.description: An owl-like eye mask with two tall swept-back horn points, a domed ridged crest over the brow, a beak-shaped nose piece and round goggle-like eye rings in angular plated housings across the upper face.
Male/M_Eye_Valorous_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn points, brow plates and beak; colour 1 on the domed crest; colour 2 on the eye housings and lower trim; colour 3 on the round eye lenses.

Male/M_Eye_Valorous_07.description: A sleek domino-style eye mask with swept-back wing-like points at the temples, angled eye openings and a pointed nose bridge. A crescent brow band crosses the forehead and a broad panel wraps the back of the head.
Male/M_Eye_Valorous_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell and side wings; colour 1 on the forehead crescent, the under-eye trim and the back-of-head panel.

Male/M_Eye_Valorous_08.description: A domino-style superhero eye mask with a sharp angular brow ridge, pointed eye openings and a downward-pointing nose bridge. Jagged lightning-like spikes flare down over the cheeks, and it wraps closely around the eyes.
