Male/M_Footl_Tight_Bare_Tiptoes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toenails; the skin of the foot ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Bear_01.description: A furry animal-paw covering for the left foot, with a rounded foot shape, jagged fur tufts rising to the ankle and calf, and short curved claws at the toes. Suggests a beast or monster look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot fur; colour 1 on the fur tufts up the ankle; colour 2 on the claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.description: A left foot shaped like a rhino's hoof: a wrinkled, skin-textured foot with a short ankle cuff, three broad toes and blunt hoof-like nails at the front. It replaces the bare foot in a monstrous, animal style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toenails or hooves; the rest of the foot keeps its skin-like texture and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.description: A beastly wolf-paw foot and lower-leg cover with a rounded paw, contrasting claws at the toes, and a shaggy crest of jagged fur spikes flaring around the calf. Suits monstrous or werewolf looks.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw and lower foot; colour 1 on the fur tufts up the calf and small toe accents; colour 2 on the tips of the fur spikes; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.description: A tuft of jagged, faceted fur worn on the lower left calf, tapering to a narrow cuff at the ankle and flaring upward into sharp, claw-like spikes around the top. Feral, beastly styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper fur mass; colour 2 on the spiky tips and shading; colour 3 on the lower cuff near the ankle.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Small_01.description: A left foot covering shaped like a wolf paw: a low, rounded slipper with toe ridges, small spikes across the top of the foot and contrasting claws jutting from the toe tips. Sits over the foot only, in a beastly style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body; colour 1 on the spikes across the top of the foot; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A left foot replaced by a bird-like talon with three long curved claws, covered above by a loose, wrinkled leg wrap that ends in a jagged contrasting cuff just below the knee.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the loose leg covering; colour 2 on the jagged cuff at the top; colour 1 on the claws; the scaly foot keeps a fixed skin tone regardless of the scheme.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The male version has a loose, baggy cloth leg covering with a jagged cuff and only a small talon foot, instead of the fitted armoured shin guard and long scaly bird leg.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_03.description: A bare, bird-like taloned foot replacing the left foot: a scaly, skin-textured foot with segmented scutes over the top and three long curved claws at the front plus a rear spur, sitting at the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the scaly skin takes a skin tone that does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_Cover_02.description: A left foot replaced by a bird-like talon: a loose, wrinkled cuff covers the lower shin, and below it a scaly, textured three-toed foot ends in long curved claws. Suggests a monstrous, animal-like look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Birdpeople_Cover_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the loose lower-leg cuff; colour 1 on the claws; the scaly foot skin ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A low, chunky ankle boot with a faceted, angular shell, a contrasting stretch panel down the front of the instep, a thick contrasting sole rim, a small tab at the back of the heel and a recessed rear panel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shell; colour 1 on the sole rim and the heel tab; colour 2 on the front instep panel; colour 3 on the recessed rear heel panel.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A chunky armoured left shoe with a short angular ankle cuff, a broad rounded toe cap, a thin flat sole rim and a round bolt-like button on each side. Sits at the foot and ankle in a mechanical, sci-fi style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and sole rim; colour 1 on the toe cap and heel panel; colour 2 on the mid-side panel and bolt housings; colour 3 on the round side buttons.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.description: A calf-high pointed-toe boot with a smooth tapered shaft and a low flat heel. Two straps with small buckles wrap over the instep on a wide contrasting band. Plain, practical look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 2 on the straps and wide instep band; colour 3 on the buckles; colour 1 on the heel and sole.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.differs: The male boot has a taller calf-height shaft and a low flat heel, while the female version is a short ankle boot with a stiletto heel.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armor_.description: A left mechanical armored boot of angular plates: a shin guard with a raised upper cap, a wide strapped ankle band, and a bulky rounded foot piece with a toe cap and ridged sole with toe teeth. Suits sci-fi robotic looks.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plates, ankle band and sole; colour 1 on the upper shin panel and foot; colour 3 on the toe cap; colour 2 on the back gap and sole underside.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armor_.differs: The male boot has a shorter, bulkier shin guard with a larger, more prominent contrasting foot section.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.description: A tall mechanical boot with segmented plated shin, a vented cuff flaring at the top with a raised back fin, a riveted plate over the instep, and contrasting ribbed cables looping along the sides.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot plates, toe and instep plate; colour 1 on the top cuff, vent panel and side inserts; colour 2 on the cables and sole; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Madjester_01.description: A chunky ankle boot with a slouched, wrinkled shaft, a rounded toe and a thick lugged platform sole. Criss-cross front lacing runs through two side straps with round studs; suits punk or street looks.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and straps; colour 2 on the platform sole; colour 1 on the laces; colour 3 on the studs.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Spurs_01.description: A mid-calf western cowboy boot with a wrinkled, slightly flared shaft, a scalloped dipped top edge, a textured foot section with a chunky stacked heel, and a buckled strap across the instep and up the side.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Spurs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the textured foot section; colour 2 on the top edge, heel and instep strap; colour 3 on the buckles.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Steampunk_Rocket.description: An ankle-high laced boot with a small heel, outlined panels and round rivets, plus a cylindrical rocket thruster with small fins mounted on the back of the heel. Steampunk sci-fi style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Boot_Steampunk_Rocket.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the toe cap, rocket housing and fins; colour 2 on the laces and panel outlines; colour 3 on the thruster vents.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Bootsole_01.description: A plain, smooth knee-high left boot with a straight tapered shaft, a rounded toe and a thin, slightly raised sole with a small heel. It sits over the lower leg and foot, suiting superhero and casual looks.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Bootsole_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and upper; colour 1 on the sole edge.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Bootsole_02.description: A short, smooth ankle boot for the left foot with a snug fit, a rounded toe and a thick flat sole with a small stepped heel. It ends just above the ankle, giving a plain, simple look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Bootsole_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot including the sole; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A left-foot wrapped sandal: a thick rope-textured sole with a raised rim, a toe-post thong, crumpled cloth wrap crossing diagonally over the instep, and a loose heel strap behind the ankle. Barefoot, casual look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth wrap, toe thong and heel strap; colour 1 on the sole's inner footbed; colour 2 on the outer rope-textured sole edge.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The toe thong is a twisted rope in the wrap's colour (colour 0) rather than a contrasting strap.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Bull_Hoof_002.description: A single left hoof foot piece: a furry ankle cuff flaring into a chunky, split cloven hoof with a central cleft. It covers the foot and lower ankle, suggesting a beast or satyr-like creature.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Bull_Hoof_002.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the furry ankle cuff, with streaks from colour 2; colour 3 on the hoof.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, angular left boot-and-shin piece: a tall block-like shin guard with a flared flap at the top back, a slim front panel, and a chunky rounded boot with a strap across the instep. Sci-fi, mechanical look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot, shin shell and top flap; colour 1 on the curved side panels and small instep accents; colour 2 on the front shin panel; colour 3 on the band above the ankle at the back.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A shaggy, fur-textured beast foot covering the whole foot up to the ankle, with a cloven two-toed hoof at the front and two small dewclaws at the heel. Suggests a chimera or monster.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur; colour 1 on the hooves and dewclaws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A left foot shaped like a clawed beast paw: a pebbled, scaly heel and sides, raised overlapping scales across the top, and four sharp curved claws at the toe tips. It replaces the whole foot from the ankle down.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pebbled skin of the heel, sides and toe pads; colour 1 on the raised scales across the top of the foot; colour 3 on the claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.description: A low, smooth ankle-height shoe for the left foot with a rounded toe and a contrasting cuff at the ankle that dips into swooping cut-outs at the sides. Simple, sleek, superhero-style footwear.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shoe body; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and swoop trim; colour 0 on the inner lining at the ankle.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.description: A snug ankle-high foot covering for the left foot, like a sock or tight boot, with swooping curved stripes running from the ankle opening over the foot to the toe. Gives a casual, abstract look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the foot covering; colour 1 on the wide curved stripes; colour 2 on the narrower stripes.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.description: A low, smooth ankle-high shoe covering the left foot, with a plain rounded toe and a top edge cut into pointed V-shaped notches at front, back and sides, edged with thin contrasting trim.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body; colour 2 on the V-shaped trim along the ankle opening.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.description: A low, close-fitting ankle sock-style foot covering for the left foot, with two thin bands around the ankle cuff and a pair of contrasting stripes running down the top of the foot to the toe.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot covering; colour 1 on the two ankle cuff bands; colour 2 on the stripes down the top of the foot.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Colossus_01.description: A bulky monstrous left boot built from cracked, rocky stone slabs, rising to a pointed ridge at the front of the shin and ending in three large sharp talon-like claws at the toes.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs; colour 3 on the glowing crack lines between slabs; colour 1 on the claws and the small spikes at the ankle and shin.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Combatluchador_Dollar.description: A calf-high luchador wrestling boot with front lacing up the shin, a contrasting cuff at the top, a thick rounded sole, and large dollar-sign graphics on the toe and the back of the leg.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Combatluchador_Dollar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff, laces and sole; colour 2 on the dollar signs and lace eyelets.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.description: A knee-high armored combat boot with a broad front shin guard, a large back calf plate, a strapped ankle cuff and a padded, rounded toe. Its bulky, tech-military look suits sci-fi or tactical outfits.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shin guard, calf plate and ankle cuff; colour 0 on the boot body, side panel and sole upper; colour 2 on the sole.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.differs: The male boot has a wider shin guard that wraps further round the sides, so less of the boot body shows.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Combatsock_01.description: An ankle-high hiking boot with a padded, creased upper, a folded-down cuff with a small front tongue flap, a thick flat sole, and a ribbed sock top rising above the cuff. Casual, practical footwear.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Combatsock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and cuff; colour 1 on the ribbed sock top; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.description: A western cowboy boot with a mid-calf shaft, rounded toe, raised heel, stitched swirl pattern, a V-cut top with pull-up tabs, and a strap with a spiked spur at the heel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft, foot and sole; colour 1 on the top trim, heel and ankle strap; colour 3 on the spur and spur rowel; colour 2 on the stitched pattern lines.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.differs: The male boot has a shorter mid-calf shaft, while the female boot is taller and reaches closer to the knee.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.description: A left cowboy boot reaching to just below the knee, with a pointed toe, raised stacked heel, V-dipped top edge with contrasting trim, two pull-on tabs and stitched flame-like decoration up the shaft.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot leather; colour 1 on the top trim, sole edge and heel; colour 2 on the stitching lines.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Short_01.description: A short ankle-height cowboy boot with a squared toe and stacked heel, a broad strap across the ankle with a round concho, and a long curved spur ending in a spiked rowel behind the heel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the heel, sole edge and ankle strap; colour 3 on the spur, concho and rowel.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Short_02.description: A short ankle-height cowboy-style boot with a smooth upper, squared rounded toe, small stacked heel and contrasting sole edge. Small pull-on notches sit at the top of the shaft; western casual footwear.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboy_Short_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the sole and heel; colour 2 on the small notch lines at the top of the shaft.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_01.description: A mid-calf western-style boot with a smooth, tapered shaft, a pointed toe and a low heel. A strap with a round buckle circles the ankle, and swirling line decoration runs down the shaft.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the round buckle; colour 3 on the swirl decoration lines.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_02.description: A calf-high western-style left boot with a smooth, slightly pointed toe, swirling flame-like line patterns on the shaft, and a strap across the ankle holding a small spiked spur wheel at the heel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 3 on the swirl line patterns; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the spur and strap buttons.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_Short_01.description: A short ankle boot with a smooth, pointed toe, a low block heel and a slightly flared cuff. A wide strap wraps around the ankle and ends in a round, faceted side disc, giving a western-robot look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cowboyrobot_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the side disc.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cross_01.description: A soft, mid-calf sci-fi boot with a thick rounded cuff at the top, a contrasting toe cap, and a small cross-shaped mechanical plate set on a slim raised panel down the front of the shin.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cross_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff and toe cap; colour 2 on the cross plate; colour 3 on the panel behind the cross.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cross_01.differs: The male boot has a slightly lower, more flared cuff and a chunkier, rounder foot.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A single left boot reaching to just below the knee, with a chunky rounded toe and sole, layered armoured shin plates, a raised padded knee cuff and a large rear calf panel. It suggests a futuristic space-cowboy style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and shin frame; colour 3 on the shin, knee and calf panels; colour 2 on the edge trim around the panels; colour 1 on the sole edge and the round side studs.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A low, sleek ankle shoe with a raised panelled shaft, a rounded plated toe cap with small stud accents, and a thick contrasting sole. Futuristic, form-fitting footwear worn on the left foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ankle shaft and side panels; colour 0 on the toe cap and heel plate; colour 1 on the sole; colour 3 on the small dots on the toe cap.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyberlord_01.description: A left boot in a chunky, faceted mechanical style: a tall tapering shaft with a clawed, talon-like toe of several pointed segments, a contrasting ankle band with a round gem-like socket on the side, and angular fins at the heel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyberlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe claws; colour 1 on the ankle band and fins; colour 3 on the round side socket; colour 2 on the heel underside.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: A cyberpunk left boot-shoe with a split two-toed front, a low flat sole and a wide ankle cuff. A round disc sensor sits on the outer ankle, with contrasting panels across the top of the foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and toe tips; colour 2 on the sole and piping; colour 3 on the centre of the ankle disc.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The male shoe has a lower, flatter sole and a blunter foot shape, without the raised wedge heel of the female version.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A sleek knee-high cybernetic boot for the left foot: a fitted leg sleeve with a domed knee guard and small round sensor lights, a flared upper cuff, and a low-heeled foot with buckled straps across the instep.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the leg sleeve; colour 0 on the foot and the knee guard; colour 1 on the cuff edge, straps, sole and trim; colour 3 on the round lights.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.differs: The male boot has a low, flat block heel, while the female boot has a raised high heel.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Defender_01.description: A mid-calf superhero boot with a smooth shaft and a low shoe section with strapped bands over the instep. The top flares into large pointed armored flanges with slashed inset accents on the sides and rear.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft and the flared cuff plates; colour 1 on the shoe upper and instep straps; colour 2 on the sole and toe cap; colour 3 on the slashed accents in the cuff.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Defender_01.differs: The cuff has larger side spikes that flare outward at the front and back, giving a more open, jagged top.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Deity_01.description: A short, chunky ankle shoe for the left foot with a thick rounded sole, a tall angular cuff and a separate panel over the toe. Split into a heel section, a mid section and a toe cap; simple, stylised and slightly alien.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mid section over the instep; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the heel and back panel; colour 3 on the toe cap.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A left knee-high boot with a soft, slightly wrinkled cloth-like shaft, a low flat foot with a strap band at the ankle, and thin contrasting piping tracing angular seams up the front and back.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot body; colour 2 on the piping and seam lines; colour 0 on the inner rim of the top edge.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A left mid-calf boot in a sci-fi armored style, with a segmented ribbed shin plate down the front, a pointed upper cuff with small side spikes, and a separately plated, rounded toe.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf shell and cuff; colour 1 on the segmented shin strip and the foot plates; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1.description: A left knee-high armored boot with a smooth calf shell, a segmented front strip of plates, a pointed flared top with small spikes at each side, and a plated toe section. Sci-fi warrior look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf shell and pointed top; colour 1 on the segmented front strip and the segmented foot; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1_1.description: A left mid-calf armored boot with a smooth shin shell, a segmented ribbed front strip, a flared angular cuff topped with small spikes, and a paneled rounded toe. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin shell, cuff and back of the boot; colour 1 on the segmented front strip and the foot; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi boot with a sneaker-style foot, a rigid front shin plate, a thick cuff at the top and a segmented ribbed panel up the back and sides. Laced with straps over the instep.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shin plate, cuff and shoe upper; colour 0 on the ribbed calf panel and the instep straps; colour 2 on the shoe vents and rib grooves; colour 3 on the sole edge.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Dharmor_01.differs: The male boot has a shorter, chunkier cuff and a wider ribbed calf panel that shows more from the front.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A cartoonish dinosaur-foot covering for the left foot: a soft, rounded padded paw with three curved claws at the toes and a thick fluffy cuff at the ankle. Playful costume-creature style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded foot; colour 1 on the claws; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Drka_01.description: An open-toed sandal greave with a tall, curved, segmented armour plate up the front of the shin, padded cuffs at the calf and ankle, a thong strap sole, and contrasting curved talons extending over the toes.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate and toe cover; colour 1 on the calf and ankle cuffs and the sandal sole and straps; colour 2 on the talons.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Drka_01.differs: The male shin plate is taller and sweeps out in a more pronounced curve at the top.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Dual_Claw_02.description: A bare-skin style left foot with a bulky, bird-like shape ending in sharp curved claws: one at the toe front, one at the side and a rear spur. It replaces the foot and ends just above the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Dual_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the foot itself shows a skin-like tone that does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Dual_Claw_03.description: A bare, beast-like left foot with a short skin-toned ankle and foot, ending in two long curved talons at the front and a small spur at the heel. Sits at the ankle, replacing the normal foot, for a monstrous Halloween look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Dual_Claw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the foot itself shows a skin tone that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.description: A knee-high gladiator-style sandal with a flat sole, toe-loop straps over the foot and a caged lattice of horizontal straps between vertical bands up the calf, fastened with small rings at the top.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole and the strap lattice; colour 1 on the small rings and fasteners at the top and along the sides.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.differs: The male sandal has more closely spaced horizontal straps, so the cage looks denser and shorter.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_02.description: A short gladiator-style Egyptian sandal: a flat sole with a toe loop, crisscrossing straps over the foot, and an ankle cuff joined to a rear heel panel. It sits low on the left foot and ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole, straps and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the small rings at the ankle and the rear heel panel; the bare foot and toenails are not part of the piece.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A left mid-calf boot in a retro-futuristic art deco style, with a smooth shin shell, a swept fin-like flare on the outer side, thin etched grooves, a bold outlined top edge and a rounded sneaker-like toe cap.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shell, fin and sole upper; colour 1 on the outlined top rim, front edge trim and toe cap; colour 2 on the etched grooves.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.differs: The male boot has a wider, shorter shaft with a bold trim outline around the whole top opening and a larger outward-swept fin.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A chunky armored boot with a ribbed shin guard held by three straps, a studded plate over the instep and striped sole, topped by a spiky crest of feathers at the shin top.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the shin guard and instep plate; colour 2 on the straps and sole stripes; colour 3 on the feather crest.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Feathers_02.description: A short, rounded ankle boot with a smooth, slightly wrinkled cuff. A dimpled plate sits over the instep, held by two straps that wrap around the foot, with small tabs hanging at the side. Suggests a chunky armored sci-fi or creature look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Feathers_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the dimpled instep plate and side tabs; colour 2 on the straps and sole edge.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A short ankle boot for the left foot with a smooth rounded toe, a thin sole, and a cuff with contrasting trim and a vertical strip up the front. A wraparound side panel and a heel cap add sporty superhero styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 3 on the sole, cuff trim and vertical strip; colour 1 on the side strap panel; colour 2 on the heel cap.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Flared_01.description: A smooth, knee-high superhero boot with a soft rounded toe and a seam running down the front. The top ends in a flared, pointed cuff that peaks at the front and back, with an inner lining showing.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the flared cuff; colour 2 on the seam line.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Flared_02.description: A smooth, plain left boot that hugs the foot and lower leg, rising to mid-calf with a pointed, flared front flap that curves up and outward at the top. Simple superhero styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Flared_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Flipper_01.description: A single swim-fin style foot piece: a short ankle sock cuff leads to a contrasting foot strap over the instep, and a long flat flared blade extends well beyond the toes. Suggests aquatic, diving or amphibian styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Flipper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the foot strap over the instep; colour 1 on the flared fin blade.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Flower_01.description: A left ankle boot with a rounded smooth foot, a small spiky flower motif on the toe, wrapped bands at the ankle, and a ring of long pointed thorn-like leaf spikes flaring up around the ankle cuff.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot foot and the tips of the spikes; colour 1 on the ankle wraps and the flower petals; colour 2 on the spike panels and the bands; colour 3 on small accents and the toe line.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Folded_01.description: A soft, plain left boot with a short, roomy shaft and a wide folded-over cuff at the top of the calf, giving a pirate-style turned-down look. The toe has a contrasting tip and the cuff has a contrasting rim.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Folded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and folded cuff; colour 1 on the toe tip and the top rim of the cuff.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Folded_01.differs: The top rim of the cuff has colour 1 trim, while the female version colours the inside lining of the cuff instead.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Furlined_01.description: A soft, slouchy mid-calf boot with a rounded toe and wrinkled, loose-fitting shaft, finished with a thick, chunky folded cuff at the top. Casual, cosy styling that sits over the lower leg.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Furlined_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the folded top cuff.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A left calf-high armoured boot with a smooth plated shaft, a small pointed flare at the top, rows of cone spikes down the outer side, a strapped ankle band and a long pointed toe spike.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot plating; colour 1 on the rim, ankle band and sole trim; colour 2 on the toe spike, heel panel and small ankle spikes; colour 3 on the spikes and scratch marks.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The male boot has a smaller top flare, and its ankle band carries small contrasting spikes.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Glass_Shoe_01.description: A translucent glass-look high-heeled shoe for the left foot, with a pointed open toe showing the foot, a chunky block heel, a strap with a buckle across the instep and a folded cuff at the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Glass_Shoe_01.colourAreas: Default glass material largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 shows faintly on the shoe body and cuff; colour 1 tints the toenails; colour 2 on the strap edging.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Glow_01.description: A low ankle-height tight-fitting shoe with a textured, dimpled surface, outlined panels across the instep and toe cap, a round disc on the outer ankle, and thin seam lines running along the sole.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main textured shoe body; colour 1 on the instep panel, toe cap, heel patch and ankle disc; colour 3 on the thin seam lines along the sole and panels; colour 2 on the outlines around the panels.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Greave_01.description: A sleek armoured greave for the left leg: a smooth, tapered shin guard rising from a low, rounded shoe to just below the knee, with a slightly flared open top and a small notch panel at the back.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Greave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin guard; colour 1 on the shoe; colour 3 on the thin outline of the small back panel.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Harajuku_Boot_01.description: A calf-length boot with a smooth, loose shaft, a banded octagonal cuff, a diagonal zipper running up the shin, an ankle strap with a ring buckle, and a chunky layered platform sole. Youthful street-fashion look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Harajuku_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe; colour 1 on the top cuff, diagonal zipper band and ankle strap; colour 3 on the layered sole; colour 2 on the zipper pull and ring.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A sleek sci-fi left boot with a tall armored shin guard: flared side fins rise up the calf, round pod-like discs sit at the ankle and knee side, and a smooth rounded foot section ends in a low sole.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot and shin plates; colour 1 on the round discs at the ankle and calf; colour 2 on the small socket on the front of the shin.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Heroic_01.description: A low, snug ankle-height shoe covering the foot with a smooth rounded toe and a short cuff at the ankle, with a small notch at the back. Simple superhero footwear worn over tights.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and toe; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on a small separate panel at the back of the ankle.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Hiboot_01.description: A smooth, soft thigh-high boot with gentle wrinkles at the knee and ankle, a rounded flat-soled toe, and a thin contrasting trim line around the top opening at the upper thigh.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Hiboot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the thin trim around the top opening; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A mechanical armored boot-brace for the left leg: an open, segmented shin frame with a round disc at the knee, strapped panels at the calf and ankle, and a plated, rounded toe cap over the foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin frame, toe cap and main plates; colour 1 on the ankle and calf straps and the trim bands; colour 2 on the back calf and ankle blocks; colour 3 on the small inner accents at the top and back.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The male version has a more open, skeletal shin frame with visible gaps, and a lower, thinner top cuff.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Hoof_01.description: A rounded, blocky hoof-shaped covering for the left foot, with a thin cuff at the ankle, a smooth flared body and a small notch split at the front of the toe. Suggests a beast or satyr look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Hoof_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and upper hoof; colour 1 on the lower hoof and the toe notch.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi boot with a chunky octagonal cuff, panelled shin and heel sections, and thick ribbed hose-like tubes running down each side to the foot, with small straps and a rounded bumper toe cap.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, toe cap, heel and small straps; colour 0 on the main shin and foot panels; colour 2 on the inset shin and instep panels; colour 3 on the ribbed hoses.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Iceskates_01.description: A lace-up ice skate boot with a padded ankle cuff, a curved side panel, a star emblem on the side, a raised heel block and a thin blade mounted under the sole on posts.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Iceskates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and blade; colour 1 on the curved side panel, heel block and sole edge; colour 2 on the laces; colour 3 on the star emblem and the eyelet studs.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Jetboot_01.description: A bulky angular armored jet boot covering the foot and lower calf, with a rounded padded front plate, a small square vent block at the top back, a swept fin on the outer side and thin contrasting trim lines.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Jetboot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and front plate; colour 1 on the upper cuff and toe accents; colour 2 on the side panels, fins and top block; colour 3 on the thin trim lines.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Knight_01.description: A left leg piece of armoured greave and sandal-like foot: a broad shin guard with a knee cap, raised ornamental diamond motifs down the front, two contrasting straps around the calf and ankle, mesh at the heel, and banded straps across the foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee cap, shin panel and foot base; colour 1 on the shin trim, diamond motifs and foot bands; colour 2 on the leg straps; colour 3 on the mesh at the heel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Knight_01.differs: The male greave is wider, wraps more fully around the calf and has ornamental diamond motifs down the shin.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.description: A ragged fur cuff wrapped around the left ankle, with jagged spiky tufts and separate angled panels running down the outside. Monstrous, festive beast styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the outer cuff and tufts; colour 3 on the diagonal streak panel; colour 2 on the side panel; colour 0 on the fur inside and at the back.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.differs: The male version has the outer cuff mostly covered by colour-slot panels, including a diagonal contrasting streak, with light fur mainly at the back and inside.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Krampus_Hoof_01.description: A left foot replaced by a monstrous cloven hoof: a short furry cuff with jagged tufts at the ankle, a solid hoof-shaped body, and two split toes at the front. Suggests a demonic goat-like beast.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Krampus_Hoof_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hoof body and cuff; colour 0 on the fur tufts at the back and inside of the cuff; colour 2 on the hoof toes and front fur tufts; colour 3 on the front patch of the cuff.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Leech_01.description: A bare-skin left foot with a short ankle cuff and a fan of about seven long, tapering tentacle toes splaying forward from the front of the foot, with a gradient along each toe. Monstrous and partial.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle and foot skin section; colour 1 on the tentacle toes, fading toward the tips.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.description: A low, ankle-high left shoe with a smooth rounded body, a dipped opening at the ankle with a thin edge trim, a contrasting welt around the sole and a rounded reinforced toe cap.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the band along the sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap, sole and opening edge; colour 0 on the light inner ankle lining.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_01.description: A plain, smooth, sock-like left boot that fits closely around the foot and rises to just below the knee. It has a rounded toe, no visible seams or fastenings, and a straight top edge.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_01_1.description: A left wrestling boot rising to just below the knee, with a front lace-up closure, a contrasting cuff band at the top, a rounded toe cap seam and a thin flat sole. It suits sporty, luchador or street looks.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and toe cap; colour 1 on the top cuff band; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole and eyelets.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.description: A snug, mid-calf tight boot with a smooth rounded toe and a swooping diagonal seam between the upper shaft and the ankle section. A small oval emblem sits on the outer side and a recessed heel panel shows at the back.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shaft, foot and toe; colour 1 on the diagonal ankle panel; colour 2 on the recessed heel panel.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_Bo.description: A chunky armored shin guard worn on the left lower leg above the boot, with a rounded cuff of horizontal ridged bands, a lower front plate, and a small boxy side pod. Suggests a sci-fi superhero blaster look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_Bo.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell, cuff frame and side pod; colour 3 on the ridged bands, lower front plate and pod inset. The boot beneath is not part of the piece.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.description: A soft, smooth calf-high boot with a rounded toe and thin sole, topped by a band of small cylindrical canisters ringed around the upper calf on a slim frame. Sci-fi, mechanical utility look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the sole edge and canister end caps; colour 3 on the band at the boot top; colour 2 on the canister bodies.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.description: A single left boot reaching to just below the knee, with a smooth, slightly loose shaft and a plain rounded foot. A V-shaped chevron notch is cut into the front of the top edge, which has a thin rim.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; the rim at the top also shows colour 0. No other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.differs: The male boot has a shorter, wider shaft that sits flatter at the top and looks less close-fitting.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boots.description: A left-foot cybernetic boot: a plain calf-high boot shaft with a rigid armoured shin plate held by a wrap-around band at the top, studded with bolts and trailing ribbed cables down the front and side.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boots.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the shin plate and calf band; colour 2 on the cables; colour 3 on small accent lines on the plate.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Deity_01.description: A mid-calf single boot with horizontal banded stripes up the shaft, angular chevron panels across the instep and toe, a rounded heel patch and a thin flat sole. Stitched edging gives it a superhero look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar band, alternating shaft bands and toe panels; colour 1 on the other shaft bands, toe cap and chevrons; colour 3 on the heel patch and stitched edge lines; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Edged_01.description: A plain, smooth calf-high boot with a slightly loose shaft and a rounded toe, ending below the knee. The top is a flat cut edge with no cuff; it suggests a simple superhero boot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Edged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Edged_01.differs: The male boot has a flat cut top edge without the thin raised rim seen on the female boot.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Fins_01.description: A smooth, calf-high left boot with a plain rounded toe and a flared top edge, with three jagged, swept-back fins along the outer rear of the calf. A superhero style with a light winged look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Fins_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the fins; colours 1, 2 and 3 are not visible on this sheet.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Fins_01.differs: The fins are set closer to the back seam of the calf and appear as narrow, slanted blades, with the tips angled outward from the back.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.description: A single tight leg covering that runs from the upper thigh down over a low-cut boot, with sweeping curved panels, a row of small spikes along the outer calf and a banded ankle cuff. It has a sleek, superhero-style look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front of the thigh and the foot; colour 1 on the outer calf panel and ankle band; colour 2 on the glossy back and side panels of the thigh and calf; colour 3 on the small heel patch.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.description: A form-fitting left leg covering from just above the knee to a soft, low-cut sock-like foot, built from angular colour-blocked panels with a front kneecap patch and a contrasting cuff at the ankle. Sleek superhero styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front of the leg, the foot and the knee patch; colour 1 on the side panels and the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the glossy back-of-calf panel and upper back; colour 3 on the small heel patch.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Golden_Age_01.description: A smooth, mid-calf superhero boot with a rounded toe and thin flat sole, topped by a contrasting V-notched cuff that dips at the front and back. Classic retro comic-hero styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.description: A single calf-high armoured boot with a flared angular cuff at the top, layered chevron plates down the shin, a banded ankle strap with rivets and a rounded, pointed toe cap. Sleek sci-fi gladiator style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cuff, front shin plate and ankle strap; colour 2 on the chevron shin plates and toe cap; colour 0 on the lower calf band and boot upper; colour 3 on the sole and heel.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.description: A left-foot shin and ankle wrap that leaves the foot bare: a snug, calf-high sleeve with angular pointed top edges, diagonal contrasting panel seams, and an open heel and toe loop at the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main wrap body; colour 2 on the edge trim and diagonal seam lines; colour 0 and colour 3 not visible.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_01.description: A close-fitting wrapped shin sleeve for the left leg with angled overlapping panels and contrasting edge trim, rising to a pointed top edge. It has a stirrup heel opening and leaves the toes bare with sharp claw tips.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main wrapped leg panels; colour 2 on the edge trim and the seams between panels; colour 0 on the toe claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_02.description: A left shin-and-foot guard of segmented plates: a tall greave with scalloped fin-like panels down the front and sides, a flared back shell, an ankle plate, and a bare foot with clawed toe tips.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and back shell; colour 1 on the scalloped front panels and ankle plate; colour 2 on the side inset strip; colour 3 on the small side pivot knobs.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.description: A single left boot that rises to mid-calf, smooth and close-fitting, with a thin, tall lightning-bolt blade on the outer side that has small zigzag notches and tapers to a long point above the calf.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot and the lightning-bolt blade; the other colour slots are not visible.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.differs: The male bolt is a thinner, more blade-like spike with smaller zigzag notches, while the female bolt is a broader, flatter zigzag fin.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lycanarmor_01.description: A calf-high armoured boot with a soft wrapped body, a rigid plate down the front of the shin, a rounded studded toe cap and buckled straps across the shin and instep. Practical, mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Lycanarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and back; colour 1 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 2 on the straps and sole; colour 3 on the buckles and rivets.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Maniacsarmor_01.description: A calf-high left boot with a soft wrapped shaft, a front shin plate held by two straps with buckles, and a skull-shaped toe cap studded with spikes. Rugged, menacing, fantasy-armor styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Maniacsarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the shin plate and skull toe cap; colour 2 on the straps and sole; colour 3 on the spikes and the top cap of the shaft.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Pointed_01.description: A smooth, snug left boot that reaches mid-calf with a plain straight top edge and a slightly pointed, short toe. It has no visible seams, straps or heel detail, giving a simple superhero look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Pointed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Pointed_01.differs: The male boot has a shorter, blunter pointed toe, while the female toe is longer and sharper.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boot_.description: A mid-calf left boot of segmented, banded plates with a rounded toe cap, topped by a separate angular cuff panel bearing a round emblem on the front of the shin. Sci-fi power-suit look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented boot body and toe; colour 1 on the upper cuff panel; colour 2 on the ring around the emblem; colour 3 on the emblem centre.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.description: A left clawed alien foot with a bare-toed paw and pointed talons, topped by a layered, segmented ankle guard of overlapping plates that flares into a spiked cuff at the shin.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the paw and the flared upper cuff; colour 2 on the layered ankle plates; colour 3 on the band above the paw; colour 1 on the claw tips and cuff edges.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.differs: The male version has a shorter, smoother ankle guard with a less pronounced cuff point.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_02.description: A left ankle boot shaped like a clawed beast foot: a bare-toed clawed paw with two sharp talons, wrapped in layered strap-like bands around the ankle and topped by a flared, pointed cuff with jagged spikes.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the paw and the fur-like cuff; colour 2 on the layered ankle wraps; colour 3 on the band across the instep; colour 1 on the claw tips and cuff edge highlights.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Roinesh_01.description: A clawed beast foot covering the left foot and ankle, with a tapered, digitigrade-like paw shape, pointed talons on the toes and a mottled, streaked surface. Suggests a monstrous, creature-like look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot surface; colour 1 on the streaks and the claw tips; colour 2 on small flecks.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandal_01.description: A gladiator-style open sandal with a thin flat sole, toe strap and cross straps over the foot, a heel strap, and criss-crossing laces wrapped up the calf to a thick cuff below the knee.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sole, foot straps and calf laces; colour 2 on the top cuff, ankle band and heel strap.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_01.description: A tribal sandal boot wrap for the left foot: a patterned cloth cuff reaches the mid-calf with a geometric triangle band, and long dangling fringe hangs over the ankle and instep, above a flat sandal with a toe strap.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff body and toe strap; colour 2 on the triangle and pattern bands and the fringe tips; colour 0 on the sandal sole.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_01.differs: The male version's fringe is longer and fuller, splaying wider over the foot and sandal.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Spiked_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting mid-calf boot with a plain rounded toe. Three curved spines sweep outward and back from the outer side of the calf. Sits on the left foot and suits a sci-fi or monstrous look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the spines.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Tribalwrap_Sover.description: A tribal left-foot wrap: crisscrossing cloth bands wind up the ankle and lower shin and strap across a bare foot, topped by a fringed shaggy cuff below the calf; contrasting claw-like toe tips extend from the front.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Tribalwrap_Sover.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrap bands, foot straps and top cuff band; colour 2 on the shaggy fringe; colour 0 on the toe claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Viperps_01.description: A single left armoured boot rising to mid-calf, built from segmented sci-fi plates with a flared angular cuff, a large rear calf panel, a contrasting ribbed gap at the back of the shin, and a chunky plated toe and heel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plate, cuff and toe cap; colour 1 on the calf panels, ankle plates and heel guards; colour 2 on the ribbed inner gaps.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.description: A smooth, calf-high left boot with a rounded toe and an angular flared cuff at the top, plus a small scalloped bat-like wing fin projecting from the outer side of the calf.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the wing; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.differs: The wing is a smaller, thinner fin attached at the side of the calf and angled outward, rather than a large rearward sweep.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.description: A calf-length left boot-sock in a tight, tattered zombie style, with stained and blotchy texture, an open toe showing contrasting clawed toes with contrasting segments, and a thin sole edge. It reaches from mid-calf to the foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sock body; colour 1 on the thin sole edge; colour 3 on the raw patches and toe segments; colour 2 on the stains and toenails.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.differs: The male version shows more visible contrasting toe segments and ribbed contrasting toes at the open front.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A bare beast-like left foot with a short, tapering paw shape and four sharp pointed claws at the toe tips. It replaces the foot from the ankle down, giving a werewolf look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the foot itself shows skin tone and does not take a visible colour slot.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A low, ankle-high patchwork foot covering for the left foot, made of stitched cloth panels with a rounded contrasting toe cap and a separate heel panel. Rough contrasting stitching gives a ragged jester or rag-doll look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the foot; colour 1 on the toe cap; colour 3 on the heel panel and outer-side patch; colour 2 on the stitching.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Madjester_01.differs: The male version has a large contrasting patch across the heel and outer side, with only the toe cap in blue, while the female version has the contrasting patch over the top of the instep.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Madjester_02.description: A mid-calf boot with a chunky rounded toe and thick platform sole, an angular faceted cuff with contrasting edge piping, and two cross straps with small round studs around the upper shaft.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and sole; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 2 on the edge piping along the cuff and panel seams; colour 3 on the small studs on the straps.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Malvan_01.description: A single sci-fi armored boot with a tall segmented shin guard, a rounded knee cup, a banded ankle cuff and a chunky toe cap studded with small spikes. The shin guard flares out into a plate at the back of the knee.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee cup, upper shin plate and toe cap; colour 1 on the shin panels, ankle cuff and toe patch; colour 2 on the lower shin band and ankle strap; colour 3 on small accents at the shin and ankle.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A single left calf-high soft boot with a smooth, snug cloth-like shaft and a thin flat sole that ends in a small pointed, upturned toe cap. Suggests a martial-arts or ninja look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower boot; colour 1 on the upper shaft, fading into colour 0 toward the ankle; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 not visible.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Mechanon.description: A mechanical left foot in the form of a clawed, digitigrade robotic talon: a contrasting ankle cuff, a round joint disc at the ankle, segmented armoured plates and long pointed toe claws, with a raised block heel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armoured plates and claws; colour 1 on the heel block and toe plates; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and linkage; colour 3 on the accent stripes and heel band.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Monster_01.description: A bare monstrous left foot with a skin-like surface, three long curved front claws with banded bases, and a rear spur claw at the heel. It replaces the foot and stops at the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; colour 1 on the bands around the claw bases; the foot skin surface appears to ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Nighthawk_02.description: A mechanical armoured boot and greave for the left leg: a bulky rounded plate guards the shin and calf, over a slim jointed ankle and a segmented plated foot ending in sharp talon-like claws.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Nighthawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate, ankle segments and toe plates; colour 1 on the mesh boot sole and side panels; colour 2 on the plate edges, hinge parts and claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.description: A spiked armoured greave for the left lower leg: a bladed knee-cap guard with curved thorns, segmented ribbed plates down the shin tapering into a sharp point below the foot, and an open contrasting front cavity.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour edges, thorns and pointed tip; colour 1 on the shin and calf plates; colour 3 on the inner trim lines and accents; colour 2 on the interior.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.differs: The male version has a broader, boxier top guard with shorter thorns and a wider flat calf plate.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.description: A spiky, armored lower-leg piece for the left foot, covering the shin and calf with layered plates, curved blade-like spikes rising at the sides and back, and a pointed tip below. Monstrous, fantasy styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame, ribs and curved spikes; colour 1 on the lower plates and pointed tip; colour 3 on the inner trim lines; colour 2 on the inner opening.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Ninjaboots_01.description: A ninja-style tabi boot with a split-toe foot and a short wrapped shin cuff that ends below the knee. The cuff is a snug tube with diagonal wrap creases, giving a martial, East Asian look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Ninjaboots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the split-toe foot; colour 1 on the wrapped shin cuff.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_None_01.description: An empty left-foot option: nothing is worn on the foot, and the leg ends bare at the ankle. Only a tiny flat cap shows at the cut-off point.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: No visible features take a colour slot; only a tiny disc at the ankle end.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Norse_01.description: A shaggy fur boot for the left foot, reaching just below the knee with a ragged tufted cuff and fur-covered foot. contrasting straps criss-cross up the shin and wrap the calf, giving a Norse, barbarian look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Norse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the boot and cuff; colour 2 on the crossing straps and wraps.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Norse_01.differs: The male boot is shorter and bulkier, with a second strap band around the lower calf and a wider furry foot.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Padding.description: A left foot and lower-leg armour set: a low rounded boot with an ankle cuff, segmented shin plates with a strap band, and a bulbous padded calf guard at the back. Sporty sci-fi tactical look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot toe and main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and plate insets; colour 2 on the shin strap band and calf pad edge; colour 3 on the heel patch and ankle accent.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Padding.differs: The shin plates wrap more closely around the leg and include a flared upper edge, and the heel patch is larger.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Patterned_01.description: A left mid-calf superhero boot with a smooth rounded foot and a stiff shin guard. A pointed chevron panel on the front is set off by thin contrasting trim, and a plain wide panel covers the back of the calf.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chevron panel and the back calf panel; colour 1 on the foot, the upper shin cap and the lower front; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Paw_01.description: A beast-like left foot covering: a short, blocky ankle cuff flows into a rounded paw with four bulging toes, each tipped with a curved claw. It replaces the foot for a monstrous, animal look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Paw_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body with a mottled texture picking up colour 1; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pegleg_01.description: A peg-leg replacement for the left foot: a faceted, mottled cup-shaped socket wraps the lower shin and tapers into a slim tapering wooden-looking post that replaces the foot. Pirate-style prosthetic.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pegleg_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the socket cup with its mottled texture; colour 0 on the tapered peg post.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Persian_01.description: A flat open sandal for the left foot: a thin sole, three straps crossing the top of the foot, a strap running between the toes, and a wide ankle cuff joined to the heel by a narrow back strap.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole; colour 1 on the three straps over the foot; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and the toe strap.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Persian_01.differs: The male sandal has three straps across the foot and a sole in colour 0, where the female version has two straps and a sole in colour 1.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A knee-high pirate boot in soft cloth with a wide turned-down cuff, a small gem at the front of the cuff and a pointed, upturned toe on a thin flat sole. Has a slightly slouched shaft.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft and cuff; colour 1 on the foot and toe, fading upward into the shaft; colour 2 on the sole, toe tip and cuff edging; colour 3 on the gem.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A calf-high pirate boot with a pointed toe cap and a chunky folded cuff of vertical panels at the top. Three horizontal straps with square buckles wrap the shin, giving a swashbuckling look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff panels; colour 1 on the three straps; colour 3 on the buckle frames; colour 2 on the sole, toe cap and cuff edging.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.differs: The male boot has a shorter, thicker cuff, with the buckles facing the front of the shin.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.description: A left knee-high pirate boot with a folded-over cuff at the top, a buckled strap around the calf, a thin side rod, a contrasting ankle strap and a pointed toe cap. Soft, slightly slouched cloth-like construction.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the calf strap; colour 2 on the ankle strap, toe cap and cuff edging; colour 3 on the buckle and small studs.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.differs: The male boot has a shorter, more upright cuff that sits lower on the leg.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Point_01.description: A futuristic pointed shin guard for the left leg: a chunky ring cuff at the ankle, a long tapering front plate ending in a sharp downward spike, and a ribbed, layered panel down the back of the calf.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Point_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate and cuff rim; colour 1 on the cuff and side edges; colour 2 on the rear ribbed panels; colour 3 on the cuff light strips and small front inserts.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pointed_01.description: A plain, smooth left short boot that ends just above the ankle, with a tapered pointed toe. It has a simple, close-fitting shape with no visible fastenings.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Pointed_01.differs: The male boot has a blunter, less elongated toe point than the female version.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Power_01.description: A segmented armored greave for the left lower leg: a pointed kneecap-like plate on top, a central shield-shaped shin panel with angular side plates, a bulky calf guard, and overlapping plates over the foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side shin plates and calf guard; colour 1 on the central shin panel; colour 3 on the knee plate face; colour 2 on the plate edges, foot plates and lower back section.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Punk_01.description: A chunky ankle-high lace-up sneaker-boot with a rounded, slightly bulbous toe cap, a thin flat sole, criss-cross laces and a thick rolled cuff at the ankle. Casual street-punk footwear for the left foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the rolled ankle cuff; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.description: A mid-calf punk boot with a flared, folded-over cuff, a glossy shaft, and a chunky rounded toe with a thick sole. Clusters of small metal spikes stud the toe and heel sides.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, sole and spikes; colour 1 on the upper shaft panel and toe cap; colour 2 on the glossy lower shaft; colour 3 on the side panel near the toe.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01.description: A left foot covering shaped like a clawed creature foot: a short ankle cuff with a contrasting diagonal band, a furry-looking bare-foot sole and toes ending in pointed claws. Sits low at the ankle and foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and toe body; colour 1 on the claws; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the band across the ankle and the side wedge.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Radical_01.description: A low, ankle-high sock-like foot covering that hugs the left foot, with a separate panel wrapping the top and inner side of the ankle and a textured, dimpled surface over the heel, toe and outer side.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Radical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth panel over the top and inner side of the ankle and instep; colour 1 on the textured heel, toe and outer side.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Rave_01.description: A single knee-high striped stocking with a snug cloth fit, a contrasting band at the top and a rounded sneaker-like foot with a contrasting toe cap. Multiple thin horizontal bands run the whole length. Playful rave style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide stripes and the foot base; colour 2 on the thin stripes and the toe and sole; colour 3 on the accent stripes; colour 1 on the top band.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Rave_01.differs: Ends at the knee, shorter than the female version, which reaches the thigh.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A mid-calf tribal sandal-boot with an open toe and a thin sole. Crisscrossing straps lace up the foot and shin, and a fringed, patterned cuff with a jagged serrated rim sits at the top.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the straps, sole and cuff fringe; colour 3 on the cuff patterns and inner rim; colour 2 on the serrated cuff edge.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A low, smooth ankle shoe with a rounded toe, a thin contrasting sole edge, a separate cuff panel at the ankle and a raised stripe running from the cuff over the top to the toe. Sleek sci-fi footwear.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the sole edge; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the central stripe.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Retroscifi_Boot_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a smooth, faceted tube shaft that flares slightly at the top and a rounded, bulbous toe. A small round port sits on each side of the ankle, and a thin trim edges the sole.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Retroscifi_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap and the back of the shaft; colour 1 on the front of the shaft and the sole edge and port rings; colour 3 on the centre of the ankle ports; colour 2 on the underside of the heel.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.description: A left mecha boot: an angular armored ankle cuff with vent slots and thin glowing-line seams, a contrasting clamp band at the ankle, and long blade-like fins sweeping forward over the toe with a tall spike at the heel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff plates; colour 1 on the toe blades and heel spike; colour 2 on the clamp band and joint housing; colour 3 on the seam lines and vent insets.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.description: A single mid-calf robotic samurai boot with angular armored panels, a thin rimmed sole, a round side stud at the ankle, and thin blade-like fins rising from the top of the shaft. Sits on the left foot and lower leg.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole rim, toe strap, back shaft panel and top cuff; colour 1 on the main shaft and toe panels; colour 2 on the front upper shaft and ankle bands; colour 3 on the inset side and back stripe.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Rocker_01.description: A tall, flat-soled leather-look boot with a smooth, slightly wrinkled shaft that reaches below the knee, a rounded toe and a thin contrasting sole. It has a plain, casual, rock-inspired look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot shaft and upper; colour 0 on the thin sole.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Rocker_01.differs: The male boot has a flat sole with no heel and a taller shaft, while the female version has a block heel and a shorter shaft.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Rollerblade_01.description: A left inline skate: a padded ankle-high boot with laced front, two cuff straps, contrasting toe cap and sole, mounted on a frame carrying a row of small wheels. Sporty street style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Rollerblade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, cuff lining and sole edge; colour 1 on the boot body and top cuff; colour 3 on the straps, wheel frame and small studs; colour 2 on the laces and wheel hubs.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A fitted left leg covering from upper thigh to a pointed heeled boot, with a decorative knee guard bearing a spiked gem, stacked segmented bands around the calf, and a trimmed top edge.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg and boot; colour 1 on the top cap, edge trim and knee guard panels; colour 2 on the stacked calf bands; colour 3 on the knee gem and spike.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.description: A left ankle-high armored boot in an east-asian samurai style: swirl-patterned front shin plate topped by a pointed blade-like crest, a swept side fin, two thin ankle straps, and a long upturned pointed toe.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin back plate, sole and pointed crests; colour 1 on the thin edge trim; colour 2 on the ankle straps; colour 3 on the swirl patterned panels and toe.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.differs: The male boot has a longer, more sharply curled toe and a larger side fin than the female one.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_01.description: A left-foot geta sandal: a flat wooden platform raised on two chunky block teeth, with a thong strap over the toes and a split-toe tabi-style sock covering the foot. Sits under the foot; traditional Japanese look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wooden platform and teeth; colour 2 on the thong strap; colour 0 on the split-toe sock.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_Skin_0.description: A bare-foot geta sandal for the left foot: a flat wooden board raised on two chunky block teeth, held on by a thin thong strap between the toes. Sits under the foot, with toes and skin exposed.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_Skin_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wooden board and teeth; colour 2 on the thong strap; the bare foot and toenails ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a contrasting cuff at the top that dips into a V at the back, a banded ribbed shaft, a thin contrasting sole edge, and a row of small cone spikes along the toe.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the top cuff and sole edge; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the spike bases and the shaft band lines.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_01.differs: The male boot has a cuff that dips into a V shape at the back instead of sitting level all round.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A sci-fi soldier left boot with a sturdy shin, a chunky armored cuff below the knee with a notched front plate and small rear tab, side ankle discs and a rounded, capped toe.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin, boot body and cuff edges; colour 1 on the cuff, ankle bands, ankle discs and toe panels; colour 2 on the toe cap and front cuff insert; colour 3 on the small tab at the back of the cuff.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.differs: The male boot is shorter and stockier, with a bulkier ankle and the cuff sitting higher on the calf.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Secret_01.description: A high-top casual sneaker with a chunky rounded sole, laced front, padded collar and a small pull tab at the heel. Overlaid side panels and a separate toe cap give it a sporty street look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side panels, tongue and heel; colour 1 on the main upper and collar; colour 2 on the toe cap and laces; colour 3 on the sole.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Secret_02.description: A short lace-up casual ankle boot with a rounded toe cap, stitched seams, a thick chunky sole, a padded tongue and a small pull loop at the heel. It sits over the left foot and ankle in a casual, street style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and toe cap; colour 1 on the tongue; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Secret_03.description: A low-top casual sneaker with a chunky flat sole, laced front, padded heel tab and a short ribbed sock cuff showing at the ankle. Overlay panels on the toe and sides give it a sporty, everyday look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe upper; colour 0 on the toe cap, side panels, heel tab and laces; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the sock cuff.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Secret_04.description: A left mid-calf lace-up boot with a rounded reinforced toe cap, a chunky flat sole, criss-cross front lacing through eyelets, and two buckled straps wrapped around the calf. Casual, practical street style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and toe cap; colour 1 on the laces and the two calf straps; colour 3 on the eyelets and strap buckles; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A left mid-calf boot with a slim, sleek profile, a flat sole and a rounded toe cap. A contrasting cuff sits at the top, and a large pointed fin juts backward from the heel. Angular colour-blocked panels run up the shaft.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, toe cap, sole edge and heel fin; colour 1 on the main shaft and toe sides; colour 2 on the diagonal side panel and toe tip; colour 3 on the small diagonal panel at the upper front and side.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Shinthick_01.description: A single left boot that reaches mid-calf, with a thick angular shin plate that flares slightly at the top edge and a chunky rounded toe with a cross strap band over the foot. Reads as sleek armoured sci-fi footwear.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Shinthick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot, including the shin plate, toe cap and strap band; the sheet shows no other colour slots on this piece.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.description: A low-cut, square-toed shoe with a small stacked heel and a wide strap across the instep fastened by a large square buckle. Colonial or pirate-style dress shoe.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body and instep strap; colour 2 on the buckle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.differs: The male shoe is coloured mostly with colour 0, while the female version is coloured with colour 1.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Shoecasual_01.description: A casual low-top sneaker for the left foot with a chunky rubber sole, laced front, and side stripes, plus a slouchy scrunched sock cuff that rises above the ankle. Sporty street look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Shoecasual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper and sole; colour 1 on the laces, side stripes and sole edge; colour 2 on the heel patch and stripe outlines; colour 3 on the sock cuff.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Shoesock_01.description: A low-top casual sneaker with a lace-up front, side stripes and a thick flat sole, worn with a ribbed calf-length tube sock with horizontal stripe bands at the top.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Shoesock_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sock body and stripe bands; colour 1 on the wide sock bands, sneaker side stripes and toe area; colour 0 on the sneaker upper and laces; colour 2 on the sock thin stripes and heel and sole trim.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Simian_01.description: A ragged, fur-like lower leg covering for the left foot: shaggy tapered strands hang from mid-calf to the ankle with a jagged torn hem, leaving the bare foot and toes exposed. Suggests a simian or beastly look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Simian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaggy leg covering, fading darker toward the hem, with colour 2 shading the tattered tips.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Skull_01.description: A left boot in a monstrous, demonic style: a tapered lower leg wrapped in organic-looking material, a flared armored cuff with a tall spike and skull-like face with glowing eyes at the shin, and a curled, clawed toe.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, spikes and toe plates; colour 1 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the fine grooves and spike details.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Snake_01.description: A calf-high scaled boot with a segmented plated foot, a glossy oval panel on the outer calf, a trimmed top edge and a sharp curved horn-like fin flaring up at the outer side of the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled calf; colour 1 on the foot plates and top trim; colour 2 on the glossy oval calf panel; colour 3 on the horn fin.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The oval calf panel sits more toward the side of the leg and the horn rises nearer the back, while on the female it sits toward the front.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Sneakers_Gear_01.description: A chunky high-top canvas sneaker for the left foot, with a rounded toe cap, a thick lugged sole, criss-cross laces and a small gear emblem on the outer side. Ankle-height, casual street style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Sneakers_Gear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the canvas upper; colour 0 on the toe cap and gear emblem; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.
