Male/M_Footl_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a flat sole, a contrasting reinforced toe cap with small vents, a raised front stripe running up the shin, and a wide flared cuff band around the top with an open front window.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body and cuff top; colour 1 on the inner stripes along the shin and foot; colour 3 on the raised front stripe, cuff band, and sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Space_01.description: A low futuristic shoe with a chunky rimmed sole, a rounded toe and a short ankle cuff. A wide strap panel crosses the instep, with a separate band over the midfoot and small tabs at the sides.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and the midfoot band; colour 1 on the sole rim and the small tabs; colour 2 on the shoe upper; colour 3 on the instep strap panel.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_01.description: A Greco-Roman gladiator sandal with a shin guard: a smooth, shaped plate covers the front of the lower leg from knee to ankle, with a trimmed edge and crisscrossing straps wrapping the calf and lacing over the foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate; colour 1 on the trim edging the plate; colour 2 on the straps and sandal sole.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_03.description: A Greek-style gladiator sandal with a shin guard that rises to a sculpted lion head over the knee. The guard has a Greek-key border, and horizontal straps wrap the calf and lace across the foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin panel; colour 1 on the lion head and the guard edging; colour 2 on the sandal straps, soles and calf straps; colour 3 not visible.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Spartansandal_03.differs: The male calf straps run as parallel horizontal bands, where the female version crosses them diagonally in an X.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A left boot of organic, bone-like plating that reaches mid-calf, with a jagged crown-like rim, textured ridged panels and a rounded toe. A long curved horn spike sweeps up from the outer top edge.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot shell; colour 1 on the ridged marking patterns across the boot; colour 2 on the curved horn spike.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steampunk_01.description: A short, chunky steampunk ankle boot with a wide cuff at the top, a studded rounded toe cap, a strap across the instep, and a large gear-shaped bolt fixed to each side of the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, toe cap and rear panel; colour 1 on the boot shaft and sole edge; colour 2 on the instep strap and toe plates; colour 3 on the gears and studs.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.description: A single left boot-greave in segmented mechanical plating: a tall shin guard with a raised open top, layered ankle plates, and pointed overlapping toe segments, with small slotted vents on the shin and contrasting angular heel blocks.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin, ankle and toe plates; colour 1 on the slotted stripes at the shin; colour 2 on the top flare and heel blocks; colour 3 on the small marks at the top of the shin.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A left ankle boot of layered mechanical armor plates: a flared angular cuff at the top, a segmented shin guard, a round side knob, a strap plate over the instep and a blunt plated toe cap.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, shin plates and heel; colour 1 on the ankle and toe inserts; colour 2 on the toe cap, strap plate and inner shin plates.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male boot has a bulkier, more boxy shin guard, with the contrasting plates staying shorter and closer to the cuff.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steelhawk_01.description: A single mid-calf boot with a smooth angular shell, a flat trim cap at the top, layered bands wrapped around the ankle, a pointed talon-like toe, and a small stack of feather-like fins flaring from the outer calf.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steelhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shell; colour 3 on the top cap and ankle band trim; colour 1 on the calf fins; colour 2 on the pointed toe cap.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_0.description: A mid-calf boot with an overlapping feather-scale shaft, a banded cuff with a raised pointed back tab, and a smooth armoured foot with edge trim. Three sharp talon-like claws extend past the toe. Suggests a raptor or steel-hawk look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather-scale shaft; colour 1 on the cuff, the back tab and the foot edge trim; colour 2 on the foot plate; colour 3 on the talons.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Superlong_01.description: A knee-high boot with a tall shaft and a separate lower foot section, split by a wavy band. Contrasting trim edges the flared top and the toe, with small gem-like studs. Short block heel.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Superlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper shaft; colour 0 on the foot section; colour 1 on the trim edging the top, ankle band and toe; colour 3 on the gems.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Superlong_01.differs: The male boot is a shorter knee-high two-tone boot with gem-studded trim and no lacing, unlike the female thigh-high lace-up.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.description: A skin-tight, bare-foot style covering for the left leg: a calf-high sleeve with a jagged, torn upper rim that fades into a sculpted foot with veiny detail and clawed, pointed toes.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower leg; colour 1 on the upper calf sleeve, blending into colour 0 lower down; colour 3 on the toe claws.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.differs: The upper rim has taller, more pronounced jagged spikes, especially at the back of the calf.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_02.description: A bare-foot monster boot that wraps the foot and lower shin like skin, with veined wrinkles, a jagged flared cuff at the top and five long pointed claws at the toes. Suggests a beast or symbiote creature.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower part of the foot skin; colour 1 on the upper shin and jagged cuff, blending into colour 0; colour 3 on the toe claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Short_01.description: A bare, skin-like monstrous left foot covering with a smooth, slightly wrinkled surface that ends just above the ankle. Five sharp, pointed claws extend from the toe tips, giving a beastly, symbiote look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Symbiote_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot covering; colour 3 on the toe claws.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Tech3toes_01.description: A bulky mechanical left boot with a rounded armored shin-shell, a vented front panel with round holes, slotted vents at the back, thin contrasting seam lines, and a chunky three-toed clawed foot base.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Tech3toes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot shell; colour 1 on the front vented panel and the toe caps; colour 2 on the foot base and ankle mechanism; colour 3 on the seam lines and inside the vent slots.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Tech3toes_Warlord_01.description: A bulky mechanical left boot: a faceted armored shin housing tapering to a three-toed clawed foot with hazard-striped soles, small rungs down the front, and rivets. Sits over the lower leg and foot in a heavy robotic style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Tech3toes_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin armor housing; colour 1 on the three toes and the front rungs; colour 3 on the hazard-striped toe edges and small rivets.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Teddy_01.description: A shaggy, furry ankle-high foot covering shaped like a chunky beast paw, with a thick shaggy body and rounded toe lumps at the front that fade from the fur into a distinct toe colour; a thin band circles the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur of the foot; colour 3 on the rounded toe lumps, blending up into the fur; colour 1 on the thin ankle band.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Thick_01.description: A plain, smooth calf-high left boot with a slightly flared open top, a straight shaft and a rounded toe. It sits over the foot and lower leg, giving a simple superhero look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Trooperbot_01.description: A mid-calf robotic armored boot with a smooth shin plate, a padded ankle strap and a rounded toe cap. A thick rounded cuff at the top carries short spikes, and small studs dot the shin and toe.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Trooperbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 1 on the top cuff; colour 2 on the ankle strap; colour 3 on the spikes and studs.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Trunk_01.description: A monstrous tentacle-like foot covering for the left foot: a swirl-patterned organic mass with a cuffed top, curling hooked tendrils at the ankle and long clawed tips spreading below the foot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Trunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swirling patterned body; colour 1 on the cuff top, swirl markings and tendril bodies; colour 3 on the claw tips and tendril ends.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.description: A calf-high anime-style boot with a faceted, panelled shaft, a strap-like band across the ankle and a rounded toe. Colour-blocked sections give it a sleek, sporty, slightly mechanical look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, toe cap and heel panel; colour 1 on the main shaft, ankle band and foot; colour 2 on the middle band of the shaft; colour 3 on the small side panel and toe accent.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Urban_Boot_01.description: A mid-calf smooth boot with a wide straight shaft, rounded toe and thin contrasting sole. Two buckled straps with small square clasps wrap the shaft and ankle. Clean, sporty urban styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Urban_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 3 on the sole; colour 2 on the small strap clasps.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A left barefoot shin and ankle guard with layered angular blades flaring up the front of the shin, a smooth wrapped calf shell, and a strap across the ankle; the toes are left bare with clawed tips.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin and calf shell; colour 1 on the blade edges, ankle straps and toe claws; colour 2 on small accents between the blades.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Vine_01.description: A left boot of twisting, vine-like organic growth with swirling carved patterns and curling tendrils that end in sharp tips along the cuff, ankle and toe. It rises to mid-calf and suggests a monstrous, fantasy look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the boot and cuff top; colour 0 on the swirling pattern bands; colour 3 on the tendril tips and thorns.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Viperia_01.description: A knee-high superhero boot with a low heel and a contrasting lower foot, under a tall shaft that rises to just above the knee. The shaft has a snake-head motif at the front, a flared trim rim at the top, and a thin zigzag line at the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Viperia_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tall shaft; colour 1 on the top rim, snake-head motif and toe tip; colour 0 on the lower boot; colour 3 on the thin zigzag line at the ankle.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Viperia_01.differs: The male boot has a lower, blockier heel and a broader, rounder toe.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Viperlogo_01.description: A mid-calf armoured boot with a flat sole, segmented ribbed plates over the calf and a flared, clawed cuff at the top. Angular spiked toe and heel edges give it a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented calf plates; colour 1 on the cuff, toe and heel housings and spikes; colour 2 on the inner boot opening; colour 3 on the heel vent panel and small logo.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Viperlogo_01.differs: The male boot has a flat sole and a lower, broader cuff, without the raised high heel of the female version.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Winged_01.description: A low ankle boot with outlined seams, a strap with buckle across the instep and a flat sole. Two slender wings rise from the back of the ankle, with feathers and contrasting upswept edges.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and wing feathers; colour 1 on the outlines and cuff trim; colour 3 on the instep strap and sole; colour 2 on the wing edge feathers.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Winged_01.differs: The male version is a short flat-soled ankle boot with a pair of upswept wings at the back, instead of a tall heeled boot with one side wing.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01.description: A left wingtip brogue with laced upper, decorative perforated toe cap and thin sole, worn with a ribbed calf-length sock that is held by a thin garter band with straps at the top. A casual-formal, retro style.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe upper; colour 0 on the wingtip toe cap and side panels; colour 3 on the sole, laces, garter band and sock studs; colour 2 on the ribbed sock.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01_Gl.description: A lace-up wingtip brogue with a patterned, glittery toe cap and low heel, worn with a ribbed mid-calf sock and a thin garter strap with a small button. Dapper, formal-casual styling.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01_Gl.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe upper's patterned panels; colour 0 on the wingtip overlay and toe panels; colour 2 on the sock and sole; colour 3 on the garter band and button. The glitter material tints the shoe with a speckled pattern.

Male/M_Footl_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A single left leg covering: a loose, wrinkled cloth legging from the upper thigh to the ankle, topped by a patterned band with a greek-key motif, ending in a short cuffed soft boot.
Male/M_Footl_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrinkled legging; colour 2 on the top band and its inner lining; colour 0 on the key pattern; colour 1 on the boot.

Male/M_Footl_Toxicsteel_01.description: A monstrous clawed foot piece: a chunky ankle-high boot with a rounded heel and a layered, crumpled plate over the top of the foot, ending in a contrasting toe spike and several talon-like claws at the toes and heel.
Male/M_Footl_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the heel, sole and toe base; colour 2 on the crumpled plates over the instep; colour 1 on the claws; colour 0 on the central toe spike.

Male/M_Footl_Toy_01.description: A mid-calf toy-like boot with a smooth rounded shape, a thin sole edge, a light trim band at the top and a chunky boxy cuff. A framed side panel carries two round button studs.
Male/M_Footl_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole edge and the band under the cuff; colour 1 on the boot body; colour 2 on the boxy cuff and the panel outlines; colour 3 on the round studs.

Male/M_Footl_Toy_02.description: A calf-high toy-soldier boot with a smooth rounded shaft, two thin contrasting bands around the top, a stylised stick-figure emblem on the front of the shin, and a thin contrasting sole.
Male/M_Footl_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the two bands at the top; colour 2 on the emblem on the shin; colour 3 on the sole.

Male/M_Footl_Variablerobot_01.description: A robotic left boot-shin unit: a chunky angular armored shin block with a toothed vent slot at the front, side fins, a heel block and a pointed toe wedge. It sits over the lower leg and foot in a mechanical, sci-fi style.
Male/M_Footl_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin casing; colour 3 on the side fins, front slot housing, heel block and toe tip; colour 2 on the lower foot wedge and inner slot; colour 0 on the teeth inside the slot.

Male/M_Footl_Victory_01.description: A low ankle boot with a rounded toe cap, a contrasting rim at the ankle and a thin strap line up the front. Curved fin-like blades sweep up from the heel and a gem sits at the back. Sleek, winged superhero style.
Male/M_Footl_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and the tall fin blade; colour 1 on the toe cap, heel base and the smaller side fin; colour 2 on the ankle rim, sole and front strap line; colour 3 on the heel gem.

Male/M_Footl_Werewolf_01.description: A bare beast-foot covering for the left foot: a digitigrade, paw-like shape with four splayed toes ending in long curved claws and a small dewclaw at the side. It replaces the foot below the ankle, in a monstrous werewolf style.
Male/M_Footl_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole paw and toes; colour 1 on the claws.

Male/M_Footl_Wolf_Armor_01.description: A knee-high armoured boot made of stacked, overlapping angular plates with a rimmed cuff at the top, a contrasting segmented ankle wrap, and a contrasting foot ending in sharp clawed toe spikes. Fantasy beast-warrior style.
Male/M_Footl_Wolf_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg plates and foot; colour 3 on the rim trim of the plates and cuff; colour 2 on the inset panels and ankle wrap; colour 1 on the claws and the small gem on the knee panel.

Male/M_Footr_Animal_01.description: A bare, skin-textured beast foot replacing the right foot: a splayed three-toed paw with a rear dewclaw, fine scale texture at the ankle, and long curved talons. Suits monstrous or animal-themed characters.
Male/M_Footr_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the foot; colour 2 on the claws. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Footr_Animal_02.description: A right foot covering shaped like a canine paw: a furred, muscular foot with four splayed toes ending in curved claws and a small dewclaw at the inner ankle. A tufted fur edge runs along the sole.
Male/M_Footr_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furred foot surface; colour 1 on the sole and heel tufts; colour 3 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A chunky ankle boot with a smooth rounded toe, a thick flat sole with a raised rim, and a separate angled cuff around the ankle with a round button-like stud on the outer side. Retro robotic style.
Male/M_Footr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the round stud; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Arcane_01.description: A knee-high scaled boot with an overlapping fish-scale shaft, a flat pointed toe cap with zigzag-edged band, and a flared top cuff of sharp angular fins around the knee. Fantasy mage styling.
Male/M_Footr_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled shaft, heel and toe side panel; colour 1 on the toe cap and the inner cuff fins; colour 2 on the knee cuff centre and zigzag detailing; colour 3 on the small gem-like accents at the knee front.

Male/M_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01.description: A chunky right boot made of stacked, cracked stone slabs that rises to the shin, with a broad blocky toe and a cluster of jagged crystal shards jutting up from the outer side of the calf. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Male/M_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone slabs; colour 3 on the glowing cracks between the stones and the inner opening; colour 1 on the crystal shards.
Male/M_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01.differs: The male boot is wider and squatter, with a bulkier stone shaft and larger crystals that point up and back from the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01_1.description: A chunky right boot built from cracked, cobblestone-like rock slabs that cover the foot and shin, with a jagged raised edge at the top and a cluster of angular crystal shards jutting from the outer side.
Male/M_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between the stones and the inner top opening; colour 1 on the crystal shards.
Male/M_Footr_Armor_Rockcrystal_01_1.differs: The crystal cluster is larger, with a taller main shard rising up the back of the boot, and the top rim is lower and more even.

Male/M_Footr_Astronaut_01.description: A chunky low astronaut-style shoe with a thick flat platform sole, a rounded armoured toe cap with grooved ridges, a smooth upper with a small strap patch at the instep, and a soft rolled ankle cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the rolled ankle cuff; colour 2 on the toe cap and sole; colour 3 on the instep patch.

Male/M_Footr_Astronaut_02.description: A chunky astronaut-style right shoe with a thick flat platform sole, a ribbed rounded toe cap, a smooth ankle-high upper, a small strap panel on the instep and a soft padded cuff at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the sole and toe cap; colour 3 on the instep strap panel.

Male/M_Footr_Beast_Mechanical_01.description: A mechanical beast-foot covering the right foot: a banded ankle cuff, plated top, and long curved blade-like claws at the front with small roller joints and a rear spur, giving a monstrous robotic look.
Male/M_Footr_Beast_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw blades, cuff rim and plated top edges; colour 1 on the ankle cuff, toe plates and roller joints; colour 3 on the small marks on the claws; colour 2 on the inner mechanical joints.

Male/M_Footr_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: A steampunk prosthetic lower leg: a bulky barrel-like cuff with wrapped straps sits below the knee, from which thin rods and a small spiked bracket lead down to a curved blade-like runner in place of a foot.
Male/M_Footr_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff top and the bracket; colour 1 on the strap bands, rods and curved runner; colour 2 on the cuff body; colour 3 on the small marks at the back of the cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Boots_Goth_01.description: Chunky ankle boot with a thick treaded platform sole, rounded toe cap, front lacing with eyelets and a folded-over cuff. A wide strap with a buckle and eyelets circles the ankle. Gothic, punk-leaning street style.
Male/M_Footr_Boots_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the thick tread sole; colour 2 on the ankle strap; colour 3 on the eyelets, buckle and lace studs.

Male/M_Footr_Boots_Goth_02.description: A right mid-calf lace-up boot with a chunky platform sole, front lacing with small eyelets, a folded cuff at the top and two wide straps with buckle plates across the shaft. Gothic, punk-leaning footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Boots_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and cuff; colour 1 on the platform sole; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the strap plates, laces, eyelets, cuff button and sole accent lines.

Male/M_Footr_Boots_Ski_01.description: A chunky, padded ankle-high snow boot with a rounded toe, a thick contrasting sole, a padded cuff, and three cross-straps with small clasps down the front. Contrasting piping outlines the panels and heel. Sporty, winter-gear look.
Male/M_Footr_Boots_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and padded tongue; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the straps, piping and rim; colour 3 on the strap clasp accents.

Male/M_Footr_Boots_Spy_01.description: A right mid-calf boot with a pointed toe and short stacked heel, topped by a separate cuff panel with an angular folded rim and two small buttons on the outer side. Smooth leather look with a spy-like feel.
Male/M_Footr_Boots_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper calf cuff; colour 1 on the foot and toe section; colour 2 on the sole and heel; colour 3 on the buttons.
Male/M_Footr_Boots_Spy_01.differs: The male boot has a shorter, wider cuff with a more folded-over rim.

Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Cryo_01.description: A pair of segmented, ribbed tube arcs that wrap loosely around the lower calf and ankle like a broken, tilted ring, with gaps at the front and back. Reads as a mechanical or cryo-tech accessory.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole ribbed tube; no other slots visible.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Cryo_01.differs: The male version sits as a looser, tilted pair of hoops around the ankle, rather than an upright oval ring on the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Draco_01.description: A single curved dragon-horn spike worn on the outer side of the right lower leg, with a long hooked tip rising toward the knee and a cluster of small serrated fins tapering down near the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole spike and its serrated fins; the small inner face shows a light patch that takes colour 0.

Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small angular plate worn on the right shin, with two raised ear-like corners and a robotic face design: two hexagonal socketed eyes, a notch for a nose and a ribbed mouth strip. The back is a plain panel.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and ear corners; colour 0 on the face plate and the back panel; colour 3 on the eye lenses; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth strip.

Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_02.description: A minimal sandal-like foot accessory: a thin flat loop outlining the sole with an open toe, and a single angled instep strap with a notched V top edge and contrasting trim. Sits on the right foot.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the instep strap face; colour 0 on the trim along the strap edges; colour 2 on the thin sole loop and strap inner side.

Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Steelcommando_.description: A curved, blade-like armored fin worn on the outside of the lower right leg, tapering to a point at the top, with layered angular plates and inset panels on its outer face. Suggests retro mechanical armor.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Greave_Steelcommando_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plates and inner shell; colour 1 on the lower inset panels; colour 0 on the thin edge highlights.

Male/M_Footr_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A small angular plate strapped to the right lower leg below the knee, shaped like a robotic face with two hexagonal eye sockets, a grinning ribbed mouth and pointed ear-like corners; the back is a plain flat panel.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer plate frame and ear corners; colour 0 on the face panel and the back panel; colour 3 on the eye lenses; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth.

Male/M_Footr_Child_Renegade_01.description: A set of three separate conical spikes of different sizes studding the right ankle and heel area: a tall central horn with a banded base, flanked by a smaller spike on each side. Aggressive, monstrous accent.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall central spike; colour 1 on the spike at the inner side; colour 2 on the spike at the outer side.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Renegade_01.differs: The male central spike is chunkier with a visible banded base, and the side spikes sit closer together and are shorter.

Male/M_Footr_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A tiny flat, faceted oval patch at the front of the right ankle, a cap that barely covers the leg and is mostly hidden. It adds almost no visible shape, only a small plain panel.

Male/M_Footr_Child_Wheelie_01.description: A small wheel attached to the outside of the right ankle: a chunky rounded tyre ring around a rim with a raised star-shaped hub and thin spokes. A playful, toy-like mechanical accent.
Male/M_Footr_Child_Wheelie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tyre ring and rim; colour 2 on the star hub; colour 1 on the spokes behind the star.

Male/M_Footr_Clown_01.description: A jester-style right shoe with a soft, low body that tapers into a long upturned curling toe ending in a round pom-pom. A flared cuff at the ankle carries a small diamond emblem.
Male/M_Footr_Clown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and toe pom-pom; colour 3 on the diamond emblem.

Male/M_Footr_Corrupted_01.description: A right-foot armoured boot in a monstrous, clawed style: a flared ankle cuff with a small horn-like spike, a smooth central instep, and overlapping segmented plates that fan out into pointed talon-like toes and a scalloped heel.
Male/M_Footr_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ankle cuff, toe plates and heel plates; colour 0 on the smooth instep section; colour 2 on the cuff rim and plate edging; colour 3 on the small spike at the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Cosmic_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a wide banded cuff at the top, a small angular fin-like flap on the outer side, straps across the shin and ankle, and a rounded toe cap over a sturdy foot.
Male/M_Footr_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft and toe cap; colour 1 on diagonal panels of the shaft and on the foot; colour 2 on the top cuff, straps and ankle band; colour 3 on the thin accent line above the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Cosmic_01.differs: The male boot has more colour 0 across the shaft, with colour 1 limited to diagonal panels, compared with the female's mostly colour 1 shaft.

Male/M_Footr_Cosmos_02.description: A short, chunky ankle boot with a faceted, angular build: a rounded-octagonal cuff, a separate plated panel over the instep, a wedge-shaped pointed toe and a thin contrasting sole edge. Sci-fi, slightly armoured look.
Male/M_Footr_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff and toe cap; colour 0 on the instep panel; colour 2 on the heel and side shell; colour 3 on the sole edge.

Male/M_Footr_Cryo_01.description: A chunky, ankle-high sneaker-style boot with a soft, wrinkled upper, a thin sole strip, a rounded reinforced toe cap, and a small accent panel at the heel. Casual, sporty, slightly cartoonish look.
Male/M_Footr_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrinkled upper; colour 2 on the toe cap; colour 1 on the sole strip and heel panel; colour 3 on the small heel stripe.

Male/M_Footr_Defender_Update_01.description: A right boot in a superhero armoured style: a mid-calf shaft with a wide angular cuff, layered plates down the shin and calf, and a chunky segmented toe and sole.
Male/M_Footr_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side plates, heel and sole; colour 1 on the main shaft and toe cap; colour 2 on the top cuff and toe tip; colour 3 on the rear calf inset panel.
Male/M_Footr_Defender_Update_01.differs: The male boot has a shorter, broader shaft with a wider blocky cuff and a bulkier foot.

Male/M_Footr_Detective_01.description: A casual ankle boot with a rounded toe cap, a thick sole and a folded-down cuff at the ankle. contrasting laces cross over the front, and a contrasting inner shaft shows at the top.
Male/M_Footr_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and folded cuff; colour 1 on the sole; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the inner shaft at the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Detective_02.description: A short lace-up ankle shoe with a rounded toe cap, a tall padded cuff that rises just above the ankle, a thin flat sole and a laced front tongue. Casual, detective-style footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Detective_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and upper body of the shoe; colour 1 on the toe cap, heel patch and tongue; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Draco_01.description: A low, chunky armoured shoe with a pointed, spiked toe cap, small spikes along the sides, and a tall pointed fin rising at the front of the ankle with a gem inset. Suggests a mechanical dragon look.
Male/M_Footr_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body and the back heel; colour 1 on the toe cap panels and ankle collar; colour 2 on the toe rim, spikes and edge trim; colour 3 on the ankle gem.

Male/M_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.description: A right foot shaped like a clawed beast paw: a chunky rounded foot with bulging toes tipped in long curved claws, and a short ankle cuff with a contrasting band. Suggests a dragon or monster look.
Male/M_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body and ankle rim; colour 1 on the ankle band; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.description: A clawed dragon-foot covering for the right foot: a bulbous, scaly-looking paw with large curved talons at the front and a small rear spur, with a wide contrasting strap panel across the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw; colour 0 on the claws; colour 2 on the ankle strap panel; colour 1 only in small patches under the toes.
Male/M_Footr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The male version has a wider ankle strap panel coloured with slot 2 and a slightly longer, flatter paw, while the female band is narrower and uses slot 1.

Male/M_Footr_Dryad_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast or root-like paw: an ankle-high, bark-textured cuff flowing into a toed foot with five pointed claws, ridged with vein-like grooves. Suggests a dryad or monster look.
Male/M_Footr_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot and ankle body; colour 3 on the vein-like grooves; colour 2 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Dryad_03.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: layered, bark-like ridges sweep up around the ankle into pointed spikes, with separate toes ending in sharp claws. It sits over the foot and ankle, with an organic, fantasy look.
Male/M_Footr_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ridged foot body; colour 1 on the mottled patch running along the outer ankle and instep; colour 2 on the claw tips.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Arvad_01.description: A decorative calf ornament of swooping, curled metal scrollwork: two tall curved horns frame the front of the lower leg, with spiral curls and a small S-shaped swirl, forming an open, ornate cage-like guard.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer swooping frame and horns; colour 1 on the upper curled scrolls; colour 2 on the central spiral swirl.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Brutal_02.description: A right-foot sandal with a flat rope-edged sole, a wide gathered cloth strap across the instep, a thin twisted toe loop and a slim angular heel strap. Leaves the toes and most of the foot bare.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped instep strap, toe loop and heel strap; colour 1 on the sole's footbed; colour 2 on the rope-like sole edge.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Greave_Tight_Winged_0.description: A pair of small feathered wings attached at the lower calf, angled up and outward, each with a curved horn-like spar along its leading edge and a rounded socket at the base. Fantasy, mythic ankle accessory.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Greave_Tight_Winged_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers; colour 2 on the curved spars along the wing edges; colour 1 on the rounded base sockets.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Raptor_Claw_01.description: A set of curved, pointed talons attached to the right foot: two long claws project forward from the toes, a larger hooked spur rises at the heel, and a small claw sits on the outer side.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Raptor_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the claws and the heel spur; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Reactor_04.description: A minimal sandal-like right foot piece: a thin flat sole with a low rim, one angular strap across the top of the foot, and a single tall cone-shaped spike jutting from the heel. Sci-fi with a monstrous edge.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sole and the instep strap; colour 3 on the heel spike; colour 2 on the thin outline edge of the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tactical_01.description: A pair of small hexagonal cylindrical canister devices hanging near the lower calf and ankle on thin looping cables, with banded chevron panels and ringed end caps; a mechanical, sci-fi gadget accent.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 1 on the cables and end rings; colour 2 on the end caps.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tactical_01.differs: The two canisters hang close together, overlapping one another at the calf, rather than spaced apart as on the female.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A column of three curved, pointed fin-like spikes stacked down the outer side of the lower leg, sweeping backward and upward. It suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Iceskates_01.description: A single flat ice-skate blade for the right foot: a long thin runner under the sole with three upright mounting posts and a small toothed pick at the toe. It has no boot, so it sits directly beneath the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Iceskates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole blade and posts; the default metal material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Blade.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes on the right lower leg, each a sweeping horn with a barbed fin and inset panel, jutting from the calf and curving downward past the ankle. Monstrous, sharp styling.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Blade.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade bodies; colour 3 on the inset panels within each blade.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Blade.differs: The male blades are shorter and broader, with larger inset panels, sitting more compactly on the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Blade.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes mounted on either side of the right lower leg near the ankle. Each has a swept-back horn and small barbs around an inset panel, giving a monstrous look.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Blade.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade bodies and barbs; colour 3 on the inset panels between the blades.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Nightmare_Blade.differs: The male blades are shorter and wider, with a broader inset panel and the points flaring outward around the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.description: Punk stud decoration for the right foot: a dense oval cluster of pyramid studs across the top of the toes and a thin arc of small studs around the back of the ankle. No boot body is shown.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the studs; the studs are the only visible feature and the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Rollerblade_02.description: A right-foot set of inline skate wheels only: four chamfered wheels in a row under the sole, with hub caps on the outer faces. There is no boot or frame, so it reads as a minimal skate accessory.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Rollerblade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wheel rims; colour 1 on the wheel hubs; colour 2 on the small inner rings.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Winged_01.description: A pair of small feathered wings attached at the lower calf, one on each side of the leg, each with a curved spine sweeping up and back. They suggest a mythic or superhero ankle-wing accessory.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Tight_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers; colour 2 on the curved wing spines; colour 1 on the small rounded mounts at the base of each wing.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Valerian_02.description: A small cross-shaped armour plate strapped to the outside of the right lower leg below the knee, with a raised bevelled rim around a recessed cross-shaped centre. Gothic, knightly styling.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Valerian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim; colour 2 on the recessed cross centre.

Male/M_Footr_Extra_Victory_01.description: A small decorative ankle accessory for the right foot: two thin, curved blade-like fins that sweep outward and upward from the heel, one larger with a contrasting inner panel and edging, one smaller below it.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large upper fin; colour 1 on the smaller lower fin and the inner panel; colour 2 on the edging.
Male/M_Footr_Extra_Victory_01.differs: The male fins curl out further to the side of the ankle and wrap around the heel more, rather than standing upright at the back.

Male/M_Footr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A soft, smooth foot covering that hugs the foot and ankle, with a rounded blunt toe and no distinct sole or heel. The top edge ends just above the ankle with small pointed tabs at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole foot covering; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Footr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.differs: The male version is a soft, sole-less slipper-like foot covering with small pointed tabs at the back, while the female version is a structured ankle boot with a thin sole and small heel.

Male/M_Footr_Gamer_01.description: A chunky ankle-high sneaker boot with a padded flared cuff, a wide hook-and-loop strap across the ankle, small lace eyelets, angular gem-like side studs and a thick layered sole. Sporty, futuristic gamer look.
Male/M_Footr_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the cuff, ankle strap, heel and toe trim; colour 2 on the sole and laces; colour 3 on the gem-like side studs.

Male/M_Footr_Gladiator_01.description: A right ankle boot with a soft, slightly slouched cuff, a rounded bulbous toe cap, a pointed angular plate over the instep, and a faceted heel guard at the back. Chunky, cartoonish superhero footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle shaft; colour 1 on the toe cap, sole and heel rim; colour 2 on the instep plate; colour 3 on the heel panel.

Male/M_Footr_Gladiator_02.description: A right ankle boot with a chunky rounded toe, thick flat sole and a short straight-cut shaft. Separate panels wrap the ankle, with an angled front insert and a layered heel plate at the back. Sporty sci-fi look.
Male/M_Footr_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe and foot body; colour 1 on the ankle shaft and side panels; colour 3 on the front ankle insert and heel plate; colour 2 on the sole and heel trim.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Alien_01.description: A right-leg greave worn on the lower shin and calf: a smooth angular shell open at the front, with a separate segmented lower plate stepping down the front and small spikes projecting from the rear edges. Alien sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer shell; colour 1 on the segmented front plates; colour 3 on the small spikes and diamond marks.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Alien_02.description: A shin greave shaped like an open, pointed shell that wraps the lower leg, with a smooth outer plate, a stack of overlapping ridged segments down the front, and small angular spikes jutting from each side.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer plate and rim; colour 1 on the ridged front segments; colour 3 on the side spikes.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Amazon_01.description: A right-leg greave wrapping the calf, with a rounded cuff and a tall pointed shin plate at the front, split into angular panels. Two buckled straps circle the shin. Suggests fantasy or sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main calf shell; colour 1 on the rim, edging and frame of the shin plate; colour 2 on the straps and buckles and the shin plate panels.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Amazon_02.description: A right-leg greave sitting on the lower shin and calf: a rounded, bulging back shell with two buckled straps, and a flat front plate with a raised angular rim and panelled facets. Fantasy armor style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim, top cap, bottom edge and frame of the front plate; colour 3 on the rounded calf shell; colour 2 on the two straps and front plate panels; colour 1 on the buckles.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Anniversary_Destroye.description: A right shin greave: a metal shell with a raised centre spine and open top flange wraps the lower leg, with banded ribbed calf panels behind and a small round stud at the front. Retro mechanical look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Anniversary_Destroye.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal rims and rib bands; colour 1 on the ribbed calf inserts; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 3 on the small stud at the top front.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Anniversary_Mechanon.description: A small faceted knee guard: a chunky angular shell with rounded dimple-like recesses on the front, resting over the right knee. It has a smooth hollow back and a retro, crude mechanical look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Anniversary_Mechanon.colourAreas: The whole guard appears to take a single metallic finish that largely ignores the colour scheme; no separate coloured features are visible.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Aquatic_01.description: A right shin greave of segmented, overlapping curved plates with contrasting trim bands, a flared rim at the top and a pointed tip at the ankle, with a spiky ornament and inner panel wrapped toward the outer side of the leg.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main overlapping plates; colour 0 on the lower ankle plate; colour 3 on the inner side panel; colour 2 on the rims, trim lines and spiky ornament.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Aquatic_01.differs: The spiky ornament and contrasting panel wrap around the outer side of the leg rather than sitting on the front of the shin.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Armored_01.description: An angular armoured greave for the right shin: a plate shell with a recessed front panel bearing a vertical slot, a spiky open rim at the top, cross bands across the calf, and a chunky cuff at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave plates and bands; colour 2 on the recessed front panel; colour 3 on the slot and thin ankle line; colour 1 on the ankle cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Armored_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and wider, sitting lower on the shin with a broader, blockier shape.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Arvad_01.description: A small ornamental greave for the right lower leg: open, curling scrollwork framing the calf, with swirling hooked flourishes and a central spiral. Its sweeping, pointed curves suit fantasy or mechanical designs.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer scrolled frame; colour 1 on the hooked flourishes at the sides; colour 2 on the central spiral.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_01.description: A right shin greave with a separate low foot piece: a tapered armoured calf guard with a flared top rim, a pointed front plate with a V-shaped inset and a gem-like accent, and a low open shoe cap. Sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, edging and vertical front trim; colour 1 on the upper front plate and the foot cap; colour 2 on the main calf panels and foot heel; colour 3 on the triangular inset accents.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_02.description: A knee-high superhero greave-boot with a smooth rounded shin guard, a flared top cuff, a recessed front insert with angular panels, a banded ankle strap and a low heeled foot piece with a toe band.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell of the boot and shin; colour 3 on the upper knee insert and small ankle accent; colour 2 on the lower shin panel and toe band; colour 0 on the thin trim bands at the knee and instep.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_01.description: A chunky angular mechanical greave for the right ankle and lower shin: a short faceted plate with flared winged edges, a contrasting inner cuff, a rear panel strip, and round hex-nut pods at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and flared edges; colour 1 on the top cuff and the rear strip; colour 2 on the hex nuts and pod housings; colour 3 on the small square light and the pod centres.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and wider, sitting mostly at the ankle rather than climbing the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_02.description: A mechanical shin greave for the right lower leg: a smooth curved shell with a raised flared front edge, an inset oval sensor, a separate rear calf panel, and a large rounded pod on the side. Ends in a trimmed ankle cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the inset front and rear calf panels; colour 2 on the side pods and the sensor housing; colour 3 on the oval sensor.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Blockbuster_02.differs: The side pod is larger and more prominent, extending lower on the front of the shin, than on the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Boot_Spurs_01.description: A single boot spur: a curved U-shaped heel band wraps the ankle and ends in a short shank carrying a toothed rowel wheel at the back, with a small round stud on the opposite side. Western, mechanical style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Boot_Spurs_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved band and shank; colour 0 on the spiked rowel wheel; colour 2 on the rowel hub and one side disc; colour 3 on the round stud face.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Bounty_01.description: A small right-shin accessory: a flap-topped utility pouch with a round gem-like stud, plus a set of short cylindrical canisters with banded middles spaced around the lower leg above the ankle. Sci-fi western bounty-hunter style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body; colour 2 on the pouch edging and canister caps and ends; colour 1 on the canister bands; colour 3 on the stud on the pouch flap.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Bounty_01.differs: The canisters are spaced more evenly in a ring around the shin, with the pouch sitting on the outer side, rather than bunched in two clusters.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Bounty_02.description: A right shin greave shaped as a tapered shell with a V-notched top edge, a small flared cuff at the ankle end and smooth, rippled surfaces. It sits over the lower leg.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Bounty_02.colourAreas: The default material shows a glowing, glassy look that ignores the colour scheme, so no colour slot is clearly visible on this piece.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Bounty_02.differs: The male greave is a glowing, glassy shell with a V-notch and ankle cuff, and lacks the middle band and contrasting front strip of the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Brutal_01.description: A right shin greave wrapped in horizontal bands, with a jagged, crown-like top edge, a pointed front plate and a ragged spiky fringe at the bottom over a soft cuff at the ankle. Brutal, tribal styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the wrapping bands, top rim and ankle cuff; colour 3 on the front strips and knot between the bands; colour 1 on the spiky fringe and inner lining.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Brutal_04.description: A small diamond-shaped greave plate worn on the outer right lower leg just below the knee, with a raised rim around a recessed face and a scalloped heart-like inner panel. Reads as monstrous or mechanical armor.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Brutal_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim; colour 1 on the large inner panel; colour 2 on the upper recessed section behind the scalloped edge.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Brutal_05.description: A single right-foot sandal with a thin rope-edged sole, a wide gathered cloth strap across the instep, a twisted toe-post cord and a angular heel strap behind the ankle. Casual, wrapped, ancient-style footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Brutal_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered instep strap, toe cord and heel strap; colour 1 on the sole's footbed; colour 2 on the braided sole edge.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Buckled_01.description: A pair of thick, octagonal buckled bands worn around the right lower leg, one below the calf and one at the ankle, each fastened at the front with a square frame buckle and a small tongue.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Buckled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bands; colour 2 on the buckle frames; colour 3 on the small buckle tongues.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Buckled_02.description: A wide, faceted strap band worn around the right ankle, closed at the front by a square buckle with a small prong and a stitched loop keeper. It has a plain, utilitarian look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Buckled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band; colour 2 on the buckle frame; colour 3 on the small rivet or eyelet beside the buckle.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Bunny_01.description: A plush bunny slipper with a rounded, fluffy toe box, a face of small eyes and a nose, two tall lined ears at the front, an open heel, an inner sole and a small round tail puff at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Bunny_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plush slipper body and outer ears; colour 1 on the nose, inner ears and inner sole; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the tail puff.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Bunny_01.differs: The male slippers have taller, wider-spread ears that splay outward.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Brutal_04.description: A small diamond-shaped greave plate worn on the outer side of the right lower leg just below the knee, with a raised rim, a scalloped inner panel and a shallow curved shell. Suits armoured superhero or sci-fi looks.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Brutal_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim; colour 1 on the main inner panel; colour 2 on the scalloped upper inset.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Buckled_02.description: A wide, faceted anklet cuff that wraps around the right ankle, closed at the front with a square buckle frame and a strap loop. Plain, chunky and utilitarian, it suits casual or restraint-style looks.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Buckled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the buckle frame; colour 3 on the small stud or rivet inside the buckle.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Kaiju_02.description: A small knee-mounted guard: a curved, scooped plate cupping the front of the knee, with a rounded raised cap at the back and a dense cluster of long curved claw-like spikes fanning upward.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved outer plate; colour 3 on the rounded cap behind the spikes; colour 2 on the spikes.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Kaiju_02.differs: The male version has a denser cluster of spikes, including extra ones on the outer side.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Mecha_01.description: A small angular plate worn on the lower leg below the knee: a slightly curved rectangular shell with a raised bevelled rim along the top and sides, four slim slots on the front, and an open back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and edge; colour 1 on the main plate body; colour 3 on the small slots.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Mecha_02.description: A small angular kneepad: a flat-faced box-like plate with a bevelled rim and short side wings that wrap partway round the leg, with four slot-shaped vents on the face. Sits on the right leg just above the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate face and raised bevelled rim; colour 3 on the small slot vents.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_01.description: Three curved, claw-like horn spikes set in a vertical row along the outer side of the right lower leg, tapering to fine points. Suggests a mutated, beastly look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_01.differs: The male spikes are thinner, curved claw-like cones, whereas the female ones are chunkier faceted pyramids.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_02.description: A column of three small pointed spikes running down the outer side of the lower leg, each a short curved horn-like cone angled backward. A monstrous, spiky accent with no other coverage.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; the metallic finish does not visibly use the other colour slots.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spike.description: A scatter of separate conical spikes studded along the outer side of the right lower leg and knee, with larger spikes near the knee and smaller ones down the calf. Aggressive, monstrous renegade styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spike.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long spikes near the knee; colour 1 on the spikes clustered around the knee; colour 2 on the small spikes down the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spike.description: A small mechanical leg accessory: a cylindrical canister with a labelled panel on the side of the knee, trailing a thick curved hose that arcs up and around the leg to end in a hexagonal nut-like cap.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Renegade_Spike.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body; colour 1 on the label panel; colour 2 on the canister end caps and hex cap; colour 3 on the hose.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A pair of chunky canisters with ridged screw-top caps, mounted side by side on a curved, notched bracket plate worn at the side of the right lower leg. Mechanical retro-rocket styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bracket plate; colour 0 on the canister caps and bodies; colour 2 on the canister housings and lower ends; colour 3 on the canister bases.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A small boxy mechanical vent unit worn on the outer lower leg: a contrasting metal frame with four horizontal louvre slats, a ring detail on the side, and a tall flat panel plate rising on the back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top plate and louvre slats; colour 1 on the large back panel; colour 2 on the outer frame and ring; colour 3 on the interior behind the slats.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.differs: The male vent sits higher, around the calf, and juts out from the leg at a slight angle.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A pair of curved, ribbed cable hoses with thick cylindrical canister ends, wrapping around the lower leg just below the knee, running across the front and ending in canisters at the back. Retro-industrial mechanical accent.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ribbed hoses and canisters; colour 0 on the small collar rings where the hoses join the canisters.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.differs: The male hoses wrap in a more continuous band across the front of the leg, rather than the shorter, more separated arcs on the female.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A pair of flexible ribbed hoses curving around the lower leg just below the knee, each with a small hexagonal collar at the front and a short chunky cylindrical nozzle pointing out at the back. A mechanical, retro-industrial accent.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ribbed hoses; colour 0 on the cylindrical nozzles and the small front collars.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.differs: The hoses are longer and wrap further around the front of the leg, as two long sweeping curves that nearly meet at the front.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A pair of flexible ribbed hoses wrapped around the lower leg just below the knee, each ending in a short chunky barrel-like nozzle at the back. Mechanical, exhaust-pipe styling worn as a small accessory.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hose collar rings; colour 2 on the ribbed hose tubing; colour 1 on the metal nozzle ends.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.differs: The male hoses are longer and stretch further around the leg, with the two hoses stacked more openly and spaced apart.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: Two curved, ribbed flexible hoses wrap around the right lower leg just below the knee, each ending in a boxy metal canister nozzle at the back. A mechanical, retro-industrial accent.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ribbed hoses; colour 0 on the thin joint rings; colour 1 on the canister nozzle ends.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.description: A short crumpled wrap band around the right lower leg just below the knee, with creased, wrinkled folds and a slightly flared, uneven upper rim. Suggests a worn, patched retro-mechanical look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wrap, with the glossy surface showing the scheme mostly as light and shadow; no other slots clearly visible.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_01.description: A curved, horn-like scarab pincer worn on the outer side of the right lower leg near the calf. It arcs around the leg as a smooth tapering spike with a segmented tip, giving a monstrous, insectoid look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rear curved arm; colour 1 on the front upper section; colour 2 on the band between segments; colour 3 on the pointed tip.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_01.differs: The male version has a wider, more open arc that stands further out from the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_02.description: A single leg accessory of curved, tapering horn-like blades wrapping around the right calf. A pointed upper horn and a crossing horn arch over a segmented lower section that curls down toward the ankle. Insectoid, monstrous look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper horns; colour 2 on the middle segment; colour 0 on the lower curling tail-like section.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Scarab_02.differs: The male version has its horns crossing more tightly over the front of the calf, forming an X shape.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Swan_01.description: A feathery, flame-like cuff worn around the right knee: a ring of jagged spikes at the top, layered swept feather tufts below, and a shorter rounded drape at the back of the leg.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer feather tufts and lower layers; colour 1 on the inner lining and spike tips; colour 2 on the underside panel at the front.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Swan_01.differs: The male version sits as a shorter, wider cuff with a rounder back drape and no long trailing point.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Victory_02.description: A single faceted kneepad-style guard: a broad, angular shell that wraps the front and sides of the right knee, with a shallow lower point, a contrasting inner shell edge and a smooth back panel.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Victory_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front and outer shell; colour 0 on the inner edge facets and the back panel.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Child_Victory_02.differs: The male guard is wider and shorter, with a shallower point over the shin, and wraps more around the knee.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Corrupted_01.description: A right-leg greave wrapping the shin and calf: layered, scalloped bat-wing-like plates over the upper part, a smooth tapered guard below ending in a notched hem at the ankle, with horn-like spikes at the top rim.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower shin guard; colour 1 on the layered scalloped upper plates; colour 2 on the rim and outline edging; colour 3 on the spikes at the top.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Corrupted_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and broader, with a flared rim and two horn-like spikes at the sides of the top rather than one tall front spike.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cosmic_01.description: A short octagonal greave cuff worn on the right lower leg just above the ankle: a slightly tapered plain tube with thin raised rims at top and bottom and a small inner patch showing at the front top.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the small inner patch at the front top; colour 0 on the thin rims.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_01.description: A right shin greave of faceted angular plates that taper toward the ankle, with a raised diamond-shaped front panel holding a round gem-like inset and pointed spikes flaring at the top rim. Sits over the lower leg.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main greave plates; colour 1 on the diamond front panel; colour 3 on the gem inset and the inner ankle accents; colour 0 on the inner top lining.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_02.description: An angular, faceted metal greave for the right lower leg, ending in a pointed heel. A tall blade-like spike rises at the outer edge and a large crystal shard juts from the open front cup.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main greave plates; colour 3 on the crystal shard; colour 2 on the inner recess and edge details; colour 0 on the spike.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cosmos_02.differs: The male greave is chunkier, with a wider open cup at the top, a larger crystal and a shorter spike.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cryo_01.description: A right-leg mechanical greave: a short, wide shell with a flared rim around the lower calf, held by contrasting bands at the top and ankle and a strip down the front and back. A slim vented fin rises at the side, and ribbed cables loop from side connectors.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the straps, bands and centre strips; colour 1 on the fin and the cable connectors; colour 3 on the cables and the ankle stud and fin vents.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Cryo_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and boxier, and its cable loops are tighter and sit closer to the leg.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Deity_01.description: A right-leg greave covering the lower shin and ankle, with smooth curved plates, a raised front peak holding a faceted crystal-like gem at the top, and a contrasting angular band at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave plates and top edge trim; colour 1 on the ankle band; colour 3 on the gem; colour 2 on the shadowed inner facets of the gem.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Deity_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and bulkier, ending lower on the shin with a wider, blunter top opening.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Deity_02.description: A right-leg greave shell wrapping the lower shin and calf, with a pointed front edge, a flared open top and a V-shaped contrasting band at the ankle. Smooth plated look suggests fantasy or sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and its top rim; colour 1 on the ankle band.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Deity_02.differs: The male greave is shorter and squatter, sitting closer to the ankle with a wider, boxier shell.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Deity_03.description: A small faceted kneepad shaped like a rough angular crystal shard, strapped onto the right knee. Its upper half is a broad shield-like cap and its lower half tapers to a point below the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Deity_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper cap of the kneepad; colour 2 on the lower pointed section.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dharmor_01.description: A small curved kneepad plate that wraps partway around the right knee, with a raised rim and a recessed inset panel; simple, angular-edged armor suggesting sci-fi or superhero styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and plate edge; colour 1 on the recessed inset panel.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Draco_01.description: A right-leg greave, a shin guard of armor plates with a pointed lower edge. A spiky knee-cap crest sits at the top, and a long curved horn-like spine sweeps up the outer side. Dragon-themed and armored.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plate and the back cuff; colour 1 on the lower and side panels; colour 3 on the knee crest and the curved spines; colour 2 on the crest edges and the bottom trim.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A flame-like, sculpted fin or plume attached to the outer calf, swept in wavy ridges with jagged tips at the top and tapering to a long point toward the ankle. Suggests a dragon or beast leg accent.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the plume and its lower tapering tip; colour 1 on the jagged upper tips, blending in as a gradient.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.description: A sculpted flame-like fin attached to the outer side of the right lower leg, made of layered swept ridges that taper to a point toward the ankle and rise into spiky tips at the calf.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the flame and lower tapering tip; colour 1 on the upper spiky tips at the back of the calf, blending from colour 0.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dragonbody_Lockbox_6.differs: The male fin is broader and shorter, sitting mostly on the calf with a wider flared top.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dryad_01.description: A single draped shin wrap of layered, flowing organic cloth-like folds that wraps the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with ragged tapering edges and a mossy patch near the top.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main draped folds; colour 1 on the mossy patches at the top and front; colour 3 on the thin vein-like lines along the folds.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dryad_03.description: A small organic, root-like ornament of twisted, lumpy tendrils with pointed curling tips, attached at the outer side of the right lower leg near the ankle. Suggests a wild dryad or forest-creature style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the tendril surface; colour 0 on the mottled patches and the inner underside of the curling tips.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A right-leg greave made of smooth, organic folded panels that wrap around the shin and hang in draped, pointed lobes toward the ankle, with fine grooved veins running down its length. It has a natural, beast-like look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main folded panels; colour 1 on the mossy patch at the top and back; colour 3 on the thin vein lines.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_01.description: A shin-and-calf wrap of layered, curling flame-shaped tongues that swirl around the lower right leg, with pointed tips flaring outward and a glossy sculpted finish. A fantasy elemental fire accessory.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; colour 2 on most of the flame body, with hints of colour 1 in the folds between the tongues.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_01.differs: The male version has a broader, smoother contrasting panel across the front of the shin, with flames mostly framing the sides and back.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_02.description: A flame-shaped greave for the right lower leg: glossy, swirling tongues of fire that wrap around the calf and shin, with long licks rising toward the knee and jagged points at the bottom.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: The glossy default material mostly ignores the colour scheme; faint colour 1 sheen shows in the folds, and the rest reads as near-reflective surface.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Element_Water_01.description: A pair of slender, curved glossy fin-like blades rising along the outer side of the right lower leg, each tapering to a small curled tip at the top. Suggests an elemental water-themed accessory.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; the fins show a reflective sheen, with no clear separate slot areas visible.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Element_Water_02.description: A glossy, water-like sweep of curling tendrils that spirals up the outside of the right leg from the ankle toward the thigh, with branching wisps and a few separate twisted strands near the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Element_Water_02.colourAreas: The default glossy material largely ignores the scheme; it shows reflective metallic tones, with a few twisted strands near the ankle appearing as a contrasting darker part.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_01.description: A low armored foot guard covering the top and back of the foot: a pointed front plate with a triangular accent, a separate heel cup behind it, and a raised rim of contrasting trim around every edge.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top foot plate; colour 0 on the raised edge trim; colour 2 on the heel cup; colour 3 on the small triangular accent near the toe.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_02.description: A low, rounded-toe shoe with a chevron-shaped pair of bands across the toe, a small triangular gem-like accent at the ankle opening, and a separate tall curved heel cup rising behind the ankle. Superhero style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoe body and heel cup; colour 0 on one band across the toe; colour 2 on the other toe band; colour 3 on the triangular ankle accent.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_03.description: A low, shoe-like foot cover with a wide pointed panel over the top of the foot, a raised rim at the ankle opening and a separate heel cup at the back. Plated, angular construction with a flat trim edge; suits armoured sci-fi or fantasy looks.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main top-of-foot panel; colour 0 on the raised trim edging around the panels; colour 2 on the heel cup and inner ankle; colour 3 on the small accent chevron near the toe.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_04.description: A low, rounded shoe worn on the right foot, with a broad toe cap crossed by two stripes, a small triangular tongue at the ankle and a separate raised heel cup behind. Smooth, chunky superhero styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ascendant_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shoe body and heel cup; colour 0 on the light stripe across the toe; colour 2 on the stripe across the toe; colour 3 on the triangular tongue.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ice_02.description: A small cluster of jagged, faceted ice-crystal shards attached at the outer side of the right lower leg just below the knee, with pointed spikes sweeping upward and back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ice_02.colourAreas: The glossy crystal ignores most of the scheme; a faint colour 1 tint shows in the facets, and the rest reads as very crystal.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Ice_02.differs: The male shards form a longer, more elongated mass that sweeps along the leg, with fewer separate points.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Valerian_02.description: A small cross-shaped armour plate worn on the outer side of the right lower leg, with a raised bevelled rim around a recessed cross panel. It suggests gothic, knightly greave styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Extra_Valerian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim and edges; colour 2 on the recessed cross-shaped inner panel.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Feathers_01.description: A right shin greave with a tapered, ribbed plate held by three wrap-around straps with small buckle tabs, topped by a spiky fringe of feather-like blades at the upper edge. Sits on the lower leg below the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed shin plate; colour 2 on the three straps; colour 3 on the feather blades at the top; colour 0 not visible.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Firebird_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting shin greave covering the lower leg from knee to ankle, with a bulky pointed angular knee cap holding contrasting vent openings, and contrasting edge trim plus chevron lines across the calf back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave body; colour 1 on the knee cap; colour 3 on the edge trim and chevron lines; colour 2 on the vent openings.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Firebird_01.differs: The male knee cap is larger and wraps further around the knee, while the female version has a smaller, narrower cap on the front of the leg.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Flipper_01.description: A swim-fin style foot accessory for the right foot: a low open heel cup with a strap over the instep, extending forward into a long, flat, ribbed blade that flares wider toward the tip.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Flipper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel cup rim; colour 2 on the instep strap; colour 1 on the fin blade and sole.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Fluff_01.description: A thick, shaggy fur cuff that wraps around the right ankle as a short, chunky band with spiky, tufted strands. It sits just above the foot and suggests a wintry, primal or fantasy look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Fluff_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the tufted fur tips and streaks. Colours 2 and 3 are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Fluff_02.description: A thick, shaggy fur cuff that wraps around the right ankle as a short band, with spiky, tufted strands pointing outward. It suggests a beastly, primal look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Fluff_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur body; colour 1 on the tips and streaks of the fur strands.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_01.description: A single large oval faceted gemstone worn on the outside of the right knee, with a domed cut front and a flat back. It reads as a decorative jewel-like knee ornament.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The gem is glossy and appears to ignore the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_02.description: A single diamond-shaped faceted gemstone worn on the side of the lower leg just below the knee, a flat rhombus slab with a shallow pointed ridge and glassy facets.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The glassy gem material mostly ignores the colour scheme, so no slot is clearly visible; the whole gem shows its own dark, reflective look.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_03.description: A single square-cut gemstone worn as a small chunky accessory on the outer right shin below the knee. It is a thick wedge-like prism with a flat back face and faceted front, and it sits proud of the leg.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: Glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; faint tints from colour 1 show in the front facets, and the flat back face looks uniform.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_03.differs: The male gem is a thicker wedge with a flat plain back and the facets on the front, whereas the female one has the bevelled facets on the back.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_04.description: A small pentagonal gemstone slab worn on the outside of the right knee area, a faceted crystal with a flat pentagon face and shallow depth, sitting like a decorative knee gem.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main gem body; the glassy default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_05.description: A small faceted gemstone cut in a heart shape, worn on the outside of the right knee like a decorative charm. It has a glossy front face and a textured, crystalline back, and sits on the leg at an angle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The glossy gem material largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 2 appears on the front face and a faint tint of colour 1 on the textured back and inner facets.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_06.description: A single teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone worn on the outer side of the right lower leg near the knee, with a pointed top, a flat glossy face and a faceted rear side.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The gem is glossy and appears to ignore the colour scheme; no separate colour slot areas are visible.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_01.description: A right-shin greave of layered armor plates: a tall pointed front guard framed by contrasting angular edging, an inner contrasting plate at the calf, and a tapering lower shell with contrasting trim lines, worn from below the knee to the ankle.
