Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell plates; colour 0 on the inner calf plate; colour 2 on the angular edge framing; colour 3 on the trim lines and piping.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_02.description: A right shin greave covering the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with a mesh-textured outer shell, a raised rim and a pointed upper flare at the knee holding an inset panel with a small raised block.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh-textured shell; colour 2 on the rim, spine and upper flare; colour 1 on the inset panel; colour 3 on the small block.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Gladiator_02.differs: The male greave is shorter and wider, with a broader rounded shell and a less pointed lower tip.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Heraldry_01.description: A right-leg greave guard covering the front of the shin and a band around the upper calf, leaving the side and back open. A pointed flared cuff sits at the ankle, giving a fantasy armor look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin plate and the upper calf band; colour 2 on the inner lining and the flared ankle cuff edge; colour 0 is not visible.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Heraldry_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and wider, with a broader shin plate and a blunter ankle flare.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ice_01.description: A cluster of jagged crystal shards clumped around the right lower leg below the knee, with a smaller separate shard group jutting out to one side. Faceted, spiky fantasy ice look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ice_01.colourAreas: The glossy crystal material largely ignores the colour scheme; faint tints from colour 1 show on some facets, otherwise it reads as reflective crystal.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ice_01.differs: The male version has a denser, wider main cluster of shards, with the separate side shard projecting outward and slightly forward.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ice_02.description: A cluster of jagged, faceted crystal shards fused into an elongated wedge on the outside of the right knee, with sharp points angled upward and outward. Suggests an icy, fantasy or monstrous look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ice_02.colourAreas: The crystal glosses ignore most of the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly on some shard facets, and the rest reads as a glassy near-black.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ice_02.differs: The male cluster is a flatter, more fused elongated wedge lying along the knee, while the female one is a more upright bundle of separate splayed shards.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ice_Beast_01.description: A cluster of jagged ice-crystal shards clinging to the outer lower leg, with tall spikes rising toward the calf and a separate smaller crystal clump floating just above near the knee. Monstrous, frozen look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Ice_Beast_01.colourAreas: The material is glossy crystal and largely ignores the scheme; faint colour 1 tints show on some shard facets, with the rest reflecting a glassy finish.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_01.description: A monstrous armored shin guard wrapping the lower right leg, with a curved shell open at the side, a flared rim at the knee, a pointed tip at the ankle, and clusters of curved contrasting spikes on the front and sides.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell of the greave; colour 1 on the flared top rim and the lower ankle plate; colour 2 on the curved spikes.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and bulkier, with denser spike clusters on the outer front and a wider shell.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_02.description: A small knee guard worn on the right leg: a curved, crescent-shaped plate cups the front of the knee, with a rounded rear cap and a cluster of long curved claw-like spikes rising from the top. Monstrous, armoured look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved knee plate; colour 3 on the rounded cap between the plate and the spikes; colour 2 on the claw spikes.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Kneepad_01.description: A chunky kneepad: a rounded, faceted front cap studded with four small recessed dots, mounted on a wide segmented band of ribbed layers that wraps around the leg at the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Kneepad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front cap; colour 3 on the recessed dots; colour 1 on the band's outer plates and edges; colour 2 on the ribbed bands between the plates.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Knife_01.description: A short sword strapped to the lower right leg: a sheathed blade with a wrapped diamond-pattern hilt and small guard, held vertically by two wide buckled straps, one below the knee and one near the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the two leg straps; colour 1 on the sheath; colour 0 on the hilt wrap; colour 2 on the guard, hilt diamonds and sheath tip.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Knife_02.description: A wide octagonal strap buckled around the lower thigh above the knee, with a short sheathed knife attached at the side. The sheath angles down along the leg and the hilt has a wrapped grip and round guard.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Knife_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the strap; colour 1 on the sheath; colour 0 on the wrapped hilt grip; colour 2 on the guard and sheath tip.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Knife_02.differs: The sheath sits closer to the leg and crosses the strap opening, rather than hanging out to the side as on the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_01.description: A right-leg greave that runs from below the knee to the ankle, with a flared knee guard carrying curved horns and a round eye-like boss. The tapered shin plate has flame-shaped inlays and a segmented calf plate at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee guard and horn housing; colour 2 on the main shin and calf plates; colour 1 on the flame inlays and lower cuff; colour 3 on the central boss.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_02.description: A right shin greave of layered armored panels wrapping the lower leg to the ankle, topped with a snarling spiky beast-head guard at the knee front and a raised flap behind. Martial-arts fantasy style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beast head and the curved trim lines; colour 2 on the main greave panels and back flap; colour 0 on the lighter lower back panels; colour 3 on the eyes.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The male greave is shorter and bulkier, with a larger beast head projecting forward and lighter panels on the lower back.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.description: A right-leg greave shaped like a sturdy shin guard, with a raised angular face plate at the front showing two round eyes and a V-shaped marking, an open rim at the top and a banded ankle section.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin shell and rim interior; colour 2 on the face plate frame, edge plating and ankle band; colour 1 on the mouth bar and V-shaped inlay; colour 3 on the eyes and the small inner V.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and wider, with a broader cylindrical shell and a more compact ankle plate.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_02.description: A right-leg greave with an angular armoured shin plate, a flared upper collar with pointed fins, a circular emblem on the knee and a central spine down the front. Thin loop straps hold it at the ankle and across the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armour plates and upper collar; colour 1 on the front spine, ankle band and foot strap panel; colour 2 on the recessed calf panels and thin outline loops; colour 3 on the emblem and collar fins.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_01.description: A small knee plate shaped like a stylised monster face: angular ear-like corners, two hexagonal glowing-looking eye sockets, and a grille-like mouth strip. It sits on the front of the right knee with a smooth inner backing panel.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and ear corners; colour 0 on the face panel and inner backing; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the mouth strip and the ridged panel at the back.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_02.description: A minimal open sandal for the right foot: a thin looped sole outline with a wide V-notched strap band across the instep, edged in contrasting trim. It leaves the toes and heel bare.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_66_Small_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the instep strap; colour 0 on the strap's edge trim; colour 2 on the thin sole loop and the strap's inner side.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_67_01.description: A shaggy fur cuff wrapping the right lower leg from just below the knee to the ankle, built from layered jagged tufts with a ragged, pointed lower edge. Suggests a beastly, barbarian look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and middle fur tufts; colour 1 on the lower layer of fur tufts.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_01.description: A shin guard wrapping the lower leg, built from vertical alternating slats that form a split tube open at the front. Two bands circle the top and bottom, with a diagonal strap between them. Martial-arts styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light vertical slats; colour 1 on the alternating vertical slats; colour 2 on the upper and lower bands; colour 3 on the diagonal strap.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_02.description: A pair of thin criss-crossing bands wrapped around the leg just below the knee, fastened at the front by a large diamond-shaped gem in an angular frame. Ornate, martial-style leg accent.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bands' main stripe; colour 0 on the band edging; colour 2 on the gem frame and the back plate; colour 3 on the gem.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_03.description: A small diamond-shaped gem ornament set in an angular frame, worn on the outer side of the right lower leg just below the knee. It has a faceted pyramid gem in front and a pointed back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Martial_Power_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the diamond frame and the back shell; colour 3 on the faceted gem.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mecha_01.description: A mechanical right-leg greave: an angled plate rises above the shin, over a contrasting central housing. Two short, broad armored flaps wrap either side of the ankle, giving a bulky, robotic look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate and the spine trim; colour 1 on the two ankle flaps; colour 2 on the central housing; colour 3 on small marks on the plate and the flap undersides.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mecha_01.differs: The male version has shorter, broader flaps that flare out around the ankle instead of long narrow ones.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mecha_02.description: A single angular mechanical greave shaped like an open-topped faceted cup around the lower shin, with a tall front plate rising to a rounded armored pod at the knee and a small slot marking near the bottom.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the greave body and rising plate; colour 1 on the knee pod; colour 3 on the small panel near the base.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mecha_02.differs: The male version is a shorter, wider cup that sits lower on the shin, with a squat upturned pod at the knee.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mechassn_01.description: A small angular knee guard on the right leg: a front plate with a flared upper edge sits over the kneecap, with a separate stacked panel wrapping the back of the knee and upper calf.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front kneecap plate; colour 1 on the rear wrap panels below and behind the knee.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A smooth shin greave covering the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with a contrasting rim, a raised ring loop above the knee, a contrasting front insert, a pointed lower edge and a narrow contrasting panel down the front.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and front insert; colour 2 on the top rim and ring loop; colour 1 on the narrow front panel.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A rigid shin greave covering the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with a raised plate at the front top, a chevron-shaped collar band with diamond gems, a recessed segmented panel and a flared ankle rim.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and upper plate; colour 1 on the recessed shin panel; colour 2 on the chevron collar band and ankle rim; colour 3 on the diamond gems.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A small faceted, gem-like plate worn on the outside of the right knee or shin. It has an angular hexagonal outline, a raised faceted front and a flat backing with a thin edge lip.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted front surface; colour 2 on the flat back and edge rim. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A close-fitting sci-fi leg covering for the right lower leg, running from just above the knee to the ankle, with a flat top rim, inset side panels, an angular knee plate and rivet-like studs, ending in a snug ankle cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg sleeve, top rim and cuff; colour 1 on the inset side panels; colour 3 on the knee plate and the small studs; colour 2 on the thin outlines around the inset panels.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The male version is shorter, with a flatter, more level top rim ending just above the knee.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A wrap of loose cloth bands around the lower leg: a gathered upper cuff and two wide crossing loops forming an X, joined by a small diamond-shaped clasp with a dangling bead charm.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and crossing bands; colour 2 on the diamond clasp; colour 3 on the hanging bead.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Modern_Witchcraft_01.differs: The male bands form wider, looser hoops standing off the leg, with the clasp and charm sitting lower and more toward the back than on the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Monster_Fur_01.description: A ragged cuff of jagged, spiky fur tufts wrapped around the right ankle, with pointed shards of varying length flaring up and down. Suggests a beastly, monstrous look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Monster_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the fur tufts; colour 0 on the lighter tips and lower edges of the tufts.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mutated_01.description: A monstrous fleshy greave wrapped around the right lower leg, made of lumpy, muscle-like ridges that swell into a pointed crest at the top, with bone-like spikes along the outer side and a contrasting and a glossy nodule at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fleshy body of the greave; colour 0 on the spikes; colour 2 on the nodule at the side; colour 1 on the bulb at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mutated_01.differs: The male version is a bulkier, wider shell with more open, hollowed ridges at the back, and its rear bulb sits lower on the leg.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mutated_02.description: A mutated, fleshy shin guard of twisted, ropy ridges wrapping the lower right leg, with a wide flared front edge, a small bulbous node on the shin and short contrasting spikes down the back and side.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy body of the guard; colour 1 on the small bulbous node on the shin; colour 0 on the spikes.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Mutated_02.differs: The male version is shorter and wider, with a broader flared front and spikes spread further around the back.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Phantom_01.description: A right-leg shin greave: an open-backed angular shell with an octagonal top rim, curving around the calf with a scooped side edge and a banded cuff at the ankle. Sleek, sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim; colour 2 on the inner hollow surface.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Phantom_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and wider, with a scooped diagonal side cutout and a distinct banded cuff at the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A pair of stacked octagonal straps worn just below the right knee, each closed with a square buckle at the front. Slim, flat bands give a neat pirate-style garter look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the broad band of each strap; colour 0 on the thin edge stripes; colour 2 on the buckles.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pirate_Fancy_01.differs: The male straps have light edge stripes on the top and bottom and thinner bands, where the female version has a wider contrasting rim.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pony_01.description: A tuft-like ankle cuff of overlapping pointed, feather-like locks that flare upward and outward around the right ankle, with a shorter layered fringe of points at the lower edge. Suggests a fantasy pony-fur fetlock.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pony_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper locks; colour 1 on the lower fringe of points; colour 2 on the small inner shadow tufts at the sides.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pony_02.description: A ragged ankle cuff of fur tufts: long pointed contrasting locks flare upward and outward around the ankle over a shorter jagged lower fringe, with small contrasting accent tufts at the sides. Wild, beastly look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pony_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper tufts; colour 1 on the lower jagged fringe; colour 2 on the small side tufts.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pony_02.differs: The male version has a fuller, more evenly spread crown of tufts all around the ankle, with no single tall front point.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pumpkin_01.description: A right shin and calf guard formed from curved bone-like ribs that wrap around the lower leg, with a padded cuff at the top and jagged chunks jutting upward. Skeletal, monstrous fantasy styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rib bones; colour 1 on the cuff panels at the top; colour 2 on the jagged chunks at the top.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Punk_01.description: A small rounded fin-like shell attached to the outside of the lower leg above the ankle, with a padded soft front face and a glossy contrasting rim and back plate. Punk, creature-like accent.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded front face; colour 2 on the glossy rim and back plate.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Punk_01.differs: The male fin is shorter and broader, with a blunter rounded tip.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Punk_02.description: A small pointed guard fin worn on the right lower leg: a tapering leaf-shaped panel rising from a short band around the ankle, edged with a thin rim, with a smooth back shell. Punk-styled accessory.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Punk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the panel; colour 1 on the ankle band; colour 2 on the rim and the back shell.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Punk_02.differs: The male fin is shorter and blunter with a wider, rounder tip, sitting lower on the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A small kneepad guard on the right leg: a chunky, faceted shield-like plate over the kneecap with a lumpy textured face and angular layered plates stacked behind and at the sides.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the kneepad; colour 1 on the edges and rear layered plates.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Qularr_Armor_01.differs: The male kneepad is deeper and rounder, with the side plates splayed out further from the main pad.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_01.description: A single slouchy knit leg warmer worn on the right lower leg, bunched and wrinkled with a ribbed band at the top and a thick ribbed cuff at the ankle. Casual, retro rave styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knit body, fading toward colour 1 near the bottom; colour 3 on the top band; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_02.description: A short, scrunched knit leg warmer worn around the right lower leg above the ankle, with a thick ribbed cuff at the top, slouchy wrinkled fabric and a snug ribbed band at the bottom. Casual, retro rave look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main slouchy fabric; colour 1 on the lower part of the fabric, blending into it; colour 3 on the ribbed top cuff; colour 2 on the bottom band.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_Anklet_01.description: A chunky anklet band worn around the right ankle, with zigzag jagged upper and lower edges, layered angular panels and small triangular cut-outs. It reads as a mechanical, monstrous or rave-style cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_Anklet_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main band and jagged upper rim; colour 0 on the lower zigzag edge panel; colour 1 on the small triangular inserts; colour 3 on the triangular accents near the front and back.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_Anklet_02.description: A chunky octagonal anklet worn on the right ankle: a wide band with raised rims and contrasting centre panel, studded with large pyramid-shaped spikes that jut outward. Punk rave styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_Anklet_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and lower rims; colour 1 on the central band panel; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_Fur_01.description: A right ankle cuff of shaggy, layered fur tufts with a smooth band at the top. Four stacked rows of jagged strands hang down over the ankle and upper foot, giving a rave or festival look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top band and the uppermost fur row; colour 1 on the second fur row; colour 2 on the third fur row; colour 3 on the bottom fur row.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_Fur_02.description: A right-ankle cuff of layered, shaggy fur or feather tufts hanging from a smooth rounded band, with ragged pointed tips in three tiered rows; sits around the ankle above the foot in a wild, beastly style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Rave_Fur_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top band; colour 2 on the upper tuft layer; colour 1 on the middle tuft layer; colour 0 on the lower tuft tips.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Reactor_01.description: A sci-fi shin and calf guard for the right leg: a smooth tapered shell with a ridged contrasting vent panel down the front, a raised cuff at the top, and small round studs on the side plates.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main guard shell; colour 1 on the top cuff; colour 2 on the ridged vent panel; colour 3 on the small round studs.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Reactor_02.description: A sci-fi shin greave with a tapered plated shell that wraps the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle. It has a round reactor light at the front top, padded side and calf panels, and a ribbed panel down the back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and edging; colour 1 on the top cuff and the back strip details; colour 2 on the padded calf and side panels; colour 3 on the reactor light.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Reactor_02.differs: The male greave has a taller, thicker cuff at the top that forms a solid cap-like collar around the knee.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_01.description: A right-leg greave of angular plated armor: a flared, pointed knee guard, a segmented shin and calf shell with banded ribbing, and a small strapped cuff at the ankle, all studded with round rivet-like knobs. Sci-fi renegade style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee guard, outer plates and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the front shin strip and the thin bands around the calf; colour 2 on the ribbed calf segments and the round knobs; colour 3 on the chevron panel down the front of the shin.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_02.description: A right knee guard of faceted plates: a wide, cup-like kneecap shield with a banded rear wrap, chunky bolt-like fasteners on both sides and a pointed lower edge. Suggests sci-fi armor worn at the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and bands; colour 2 on the round side bolts and the front fastener.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_02.differs: The male knee guard is wider and shallower, with a broad open-topped cup and a shorter lower point.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_03.description: A right ankle guard made of two angular, faceted plates that meet in a V around the ankle, with a chunky octagonal pod fixed at each side. Sci-fi armor look, sitting just above the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular plates; colour 2 on the octagonal side pods; colour 1 on the plate edge trim.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A right-leg greave of angular plated armor covering the shin and calf, with a round spiked boss at the knee, rows of small spikes down the front edge, a rear calf panel and a looping cable at the top.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shin plates and the top and bottom rims; colour 1 on the calf panel and some spikes; colour 2 on the knee boss and the spikes; colour 3 on the cable and the small dots on the shin.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Straps_01.description: A column of six separate flat straps wrapped around the outer right lower leg, shrinking in size toward the ankle. Each strap has a small fastening stud and a loose flap end, giving a sci-fi renegade look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Renegade_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the small studs at the strap ends.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky angular shin greave for the right leg, made of faceted plates with a flared cuff at the top, round lens-like nodes at the sides, a vented panel at the back of the calf and a bright edge at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bright edge trims at the ankle and plate edges; colour 2 on the main faceted plates; colour 1 on the side nodes and the chevron plate at the knee; colour 3 on the round lens and the rear vent slats.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A mechanical right-shin greave: a short, wide armoured shell with a slatted vent box at the top front, twin canister pods on a side bracket, curved pipes, a crumpled cuff and a lower ankle plate.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and canisters; colour 1 on the side bracket and vent frame; colour 3 on the inset panels; colour 2 on the pipes and cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and wider, with the vent box angled at the front and a blunter lower plate.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_02.description: A bulky mechanical right-shin greave with a slatted vent grille at the top, twin canister pods on the outer side, a crumpled cuff at the rim, hose piping, and a curved plate over the ankle. Retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell, cuff and canisters; colour 1 on the side fins and rear panel; colour 3 on the recessed front strip and small rear plate; colour 2 on hoses and vent interior.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_02.differs: The male greave is shorter and wider, sitting lower on the shin with the vent grille and canisters nearer the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Rocke.description: A pair of cylindrical canisters with ridged screw-on caps, mounted side by side on a broad curved plate that wraps the outer lower leg near the calf. Retro mechanical style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Rocke.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved mounting plate; colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 2 on the caps and canister casings; colour 3 on the canister bases.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Rocke.differs: The male plate is taller and boxier, covering more of the calf, and the canisters sit closer together in a tighter pair.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Vent_.description: A small mechanical vent unit strapped to the right lower leg below the knee: a boxy louvred grille with a flat rear panel, and two flexible ribbed hoses curving around the calf to exhaust nozzles at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Vent_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the grille frame and exhaust nozzles; colour 1 on the flat rear panel and top plate; colour 2 on the hoses; colour 3 on the interior behind the louvres.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Vent_.differs: The male vent box sits further toward the outer side of the leg and its two hoses loop more widely around the calf than on the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Wrap_.description: A short band of draped, wrinkled cloth wrapped around the lower leg below the knee, with a boxy louvered vent block on the front and flexible hoses curving round to small cylindrical canisters at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Retrosteelhead_Wrap_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth wrap and the vent frame; colour 1 on the plate behind the vent; colour 3 on the inner vent glow; colour 2 on the hoses and canisters.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Roman_01.description: A Roman-style right shin greave of overlapping segmented plates with a scalloped upper edge and a pointed lower plate, held on by several wide straps that criss-cross the calf. Sits on the lower leg above the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Roman_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate faces and the wrap straps; colour 0 on the swirl-like plate ornaments; colour 2 on the plate edges and rims; colour 3 on the small rivets.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Roman_01.differs: The male greave has looser, more widely spaced straps that criss-cross around the back of the calf, with gaps showing between them.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Roman_02.description: A Roman-style shin greave made of five overlapping segmented plates that taper to a point at the ankle, with a raised rim, engraved swirl motifs and small studs; worn on the right lower leg.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Roman_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plate surfaces; colour 0 on the engraved swirl designs and lower point; colour 2 on the plate rims and edging; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Roman_03.description: A right shin greave of overlapping segmented plates that step down the lower leg to a pointed toe-end, each plate with a raised rim, jagged swirl motifs and a small stud. Roman-style fantasy armor.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Roman_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plate surfaces; colour 0 on the swirl motifs and the front plate face; colour 2 on the plate rims; colour 3 on the small studs.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Roman_03.differs: The male greave extends slightly lower over the foot, with the lowest plate ending in a longer point.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_01.description: A single right-foot greave boot: a slouchy, wrinkled lower boot with an open toe edge, a banded stripe above it, and a smooth shin guard rising to a rimmed, angled top cuff below the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower boot; colour 1 on the shin guard; colour 3 on the band; colour 2 on the top rim and the edging around the boot opening.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_01.differs: The band sits nearly horizontal and the shin guard is shorter and squarer, with a broader top cuff than the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_02.description: A right-leg greave guard worn on the shin below the knee: a chunky angular shell with a tall flared upper plate, a pointed front panel, a rounded rear calf plate and a thin strap band at the bottom.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell, upper plate and front edging; colour 3 on the front shin panel; colour 0 on the rear calf plate; colour 2 on the bottom strap band.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_01.description: A sculpted shin greave for the right leg: a broad smooth shell with a large front plate, a rolled rear ridge and a small accent panel at the side, ending in a pointed lower edge above the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shin plate; colour 1 on the rear shell and the rolled ridge; colour 3 on the small side panel; colour 2 on the bottom edge trim.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_01.differs: The male greave has a wider front plate that wraps more of the shin, with the contrasting-slot shell showing mainly at the back.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_02.description: A right shin greave with a curved, plated shell from below the knee to the ankle, topped by swept horn-like spikes at the knee, a short claw-like band wrapping across the shin and a flared angular ankle cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin plate; colour 0 on the side and back shell and the wrapping claw band; colour 2 on the rim trim, top opening and ankle cuff; colour 3 on the knee horns.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_02.differs: The male greave has a shorter claw band wrapping across the shin instead of a long blade down the front, and the horns sweep further outward.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_01.description: A curved, scarab-like claw worn on the outside of the lower leg: a smooth arched horn that starts at the calf, bends around the leg and ends in a sharp tapered point near the ankle, with a segmented tip.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper arc of the horn; colour 1 on the main curved section; colour 2 on the narrow band at the base of the tip; colour 3 on the pointed claw tip.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_01.differs: The male claw is larger and sweeps out in a wider, more open arc away from the leg.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_02.description: A right-calf accessory of curved, claw-like horns: a long tapering hook rises from a segmented central spine, a second horn crosses over the leg, and a slender curved tail hooks down toward the ankle. Beast-like and mechanical.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large curved horns; colour 2 on the central segmented spine and horn tips; colour 0 on the lower curved tail.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Scarab_Alt_02.differs: The male version has the second horn crossing over the first in an X shape and a longer, flatter lower tail.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_01.description: A cluster of curved, fin-like blades stacked down the outside of the lower leg, each a tapering spike with a panelled, chevron-patterned edge. Sweeps backward from the calf like a sea creature's fins.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main surface of each blade; colour 1 on the outlines and edging; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the recessed panels.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_01.differs: The male fins sit more compactly against the calf, with a shorter spread and a more downward-pointing lower blade.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_02.description: A cluster of curved, blade-like fins or spines sweeping back and downward from the outer right lower leg, each with a contrasting inner surface and chevron-patterned edges; a monstrous aquatic accessory.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner fin surfaces; colour 1 on the outlines and edges; colour 2 on the panels between patterns; colour 3 on the chevron stripes.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Seacreature_02.differs: The male version has shorter, more compact fins that sit closer together on the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Spooky_01.description: A right-leg greave covering the shin and calf, with ridged, swept, claw-like texture and a jagged upper rim. Spiky fins rise along the outer edge, with a thin contrasting band at the ankle and small accent slashes on the front.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave body and spikes; colour 1 on the thin band at the ankle; colour 3 on the small slashes along the front edge.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Starhawk_02.description: A right-leg greave with a broad, flared, pointed shin plate at the top of the calf, a wide tapering strip down the shin, and an angular band at the ankle. Bold sci-fi superhero armor.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shin plate and ankle band; colour 0 on the tapering strip and the ankle wedge; colour 3 on the inset panel beneath the shin plate; colour 2 on the thin edge lining.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Starhawk_02.differs: The male version has a wider, bulkier shin plate and a broader strip that wraps further around the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Starowl_01.description: A feathery, beast-like shin guard wrapping the lower right leg from calf to ankle, with jagged pointed tufts along the top and spiky feather-like points around the ankle; flecked with small spots.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feathered body; colour 1 on the faint speckles; colour 2 on the spots.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Starowl_01.differs: The male version is shorter and bulkier, with a broader rim and shorter ankle points.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Starowl_02.description: A shaggy, feathered beast-leg wrap covering the lower calf and ankle, with jagged pointed tufts flaring at the top and bottom edges and scattered speckled spots; suits griffon or owl creature looks.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Starowl_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feathered body; colour 1 on the small speckles; colour 2 on the larger spots.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_01.description: A right shin and calf greave with a smooth curved shell, angular layered plates and a pointed flared top cuff at the knee. A recessed ribbed panel runs down the front, and the piece ends above the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and lower cuff; colour 2 on the upper cuff plates and side blades; colour 3 on the recessed ribbed inner panel; colour 0 on the inner lining of the top cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male greave shows a light-coloured inner plate at the top of the cuff (colour 0) and a bulkier, more rounded shell.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_02.description: A curved, pointed vent fin worn on the outer right calf: a tapering shell of layered metal plates with raised edges and angular inset panels, flaring to a sharp tip at the top. Suggests retro armored commando styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Steelcommando_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main outer shell and edges; colour 1 on the lower inset panels; colour 0 on the highlights along the plate rims.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Swan_01.description: A right-leg greave covering the shin, with a smooth armored shell, a large glossy inset panel on the front, a jagged outlined edge and a rounded cuff at the ankle. A ring of feathery, spiky plumes crowns the top below the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and feather plumes; colour 1 on the edge outlines, ankle cuff and plume tips; colour 2 on the glossy front inset; colour 3 on the diamond gems.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Swan_01.differs: The male greave is shorter and blockier, with a larger front panel and a rounder cuff sitting just above the boot.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_01.description: A small curved horn-like spike worn on the outer side of the right lower leg below the knee, with a flat blocky base that tapers into a swept, pointed tip. Monstrous, symbiote-style accent.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blocky base and lower part of the spike; colour 1 on the curved tip, fading in from the base.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_01.description: A right lower-leg greave in an organic, symbiote-like style: a chunky tapering sheath with a hollow, jagged flared rim at the top and angular ridged folds down to a base above the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the greave, fading toward colour 0 at the lower end; no other slots clearly visible.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_01.differs: The male greave is chunkier and more faceted, with a shorter, wider rim and sharper angular ridges.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_02.description: A short, organic shin guard of smooth, membrane-like material that wraps the lower leg above the ankle, with a scooped opening and a few jagged, pointed fins on top. Suggests a symbiote or monstrous look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the guard, fading toward colour 0 near the bottom edge.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Symbiote_Long_02.differs: The male guard is shorter and wider, with a scooped top edge and a bulkier shape rather than tall split points.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tactical_01.description: A cluster of four short hexagonal canister pods clipped around the lower calf, angled outward like small thrusters, with banded ends and zigzag striping. A tactical, mechanical accessory on one leg.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the end caps and some zigzag stripes; colour 3 on the other zigzag stripes; colour 2 on the rings at the pod ends.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_Ir.description: A loose, soft cloth spat-style greave covering the lower shin down to the ankle, with a rigid studded plate strapped over the top of the foot and a thin strap under the arch. Retro, mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_Ir.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin wrap and underfoot strap; colour 1 on the plate over the foot; colour 2 on the rivets.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_Ni.description: A single swept-back fin blade attached to the outer side of the right lower leg, made of stacked pointed feather-like spikes that taper downward. It looks like a retro superhero calf fin.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_Ni.colourAreas: The whole fin appears in a metallic finish that seems to ignore the colour scheme; no distinct colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_Ni.description: A single swept-back fin-like blade attached to the outer lower calf of the right leg, with a row of jagged feather-like points along its lower edge. Suggests a retro winged greave for beast or monster looks.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Anniversary_Ni.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the blade; colour 2 on the back face; the material looks glossy and metallic, so the other slots barely show.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armor_Draycul_.description: A right shin greave of plate with a snarling fanged monster face on the front, open mouth and pointed rim, held by two thin straps around the calf. Gothic vampiric armor covering the lower leg.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armor_Draycul_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and face; colour 1 on the edge trim and rivets; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth; colour 2 on the straps and fangs.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armor_Draycul_.differs: The male greave is shorter and wider, sitting lower on the shin with a broader face and flatter top edge.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armorviper_02.description: A small angular kneepad: a faceted, shield-like plate sits over the front of the right knee, with a pointed strip running vertically over it and a horizontal ridge across the middle. Suggests a sci-fi or monstrous armour look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Armorviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main curved plate; colour 1 on the vertical centre strip with its upper and lower points.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Beast_Bracer_0.description: A short, plain tubular greave worn on the right lower leg just above the ankle. It is a smooth, slightly tapered sleeve with an octagonal cross-section and a contrasting band at each end.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Beast_Bracer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sleeve; colour 1 on the top and bottom edge bands.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A loose, baggy shin cover for the right leg, a wrinkled tube that gathers at the ankle, with a stiff angular cuff at the top whose front is a pointed, feather-like plate. Suggests a bird-folk or beastly look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baggy leg cover; colour 2 on the top cuff and feather-like front plate; colour 3 on a small patch at the ankle opening.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Birdpeople_02.differs: The male version shows a small contrasting patch at the gathered ankle opening, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Defender_01.description: A small diamond-shaped kneepad with a raised central ridge and pointed top and bottom, sitting on the front of the right knee. It has a curved crescent marking on the front and a contoured back.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the crescent marking on the front; colour 1 shows faintly on the back of the plate.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Defender_01.differs: The male kneepad has a dented, contoured back, while the female version has a flat, smooth back.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Kneepad_Basic_.description: A compact kneepad: a rounded, slightly domed cap over the front of the knee with a raised rim and small notched accents, held by a segmented band with ribbed elastic strips that wraps around the leg.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Kneepad_Basic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and outer frame of the band; colour 1 on the domed pad face; colour 2 on the ribbed strips of the band; colour 3 on the small notched accents on the pad edges.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Kneepad_Skull_.description: A faceted, angular skull-shaped kneepad worn over the front of the right knee, with hollow eye sockets, a nose cavity and a jagged brow ridge. Its low-poly plates flare out at the edges for a monstrous, gothic look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Kneepad_Skull_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell; colour 1 on the eye sockets; colour 3 on the sharp streak markings around the brow and jaw.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Blad.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes flanking the right lower leg below the knee, each with barbed fins and an inset inner panel. Sharp, aggressive, monstrous-mechanical styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Blad.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade bodies and edges; colour 3 on the inset panels between the blade edges.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Blad.differs: The male blades are shorter and wider, sitting closer together around the calf with broader barbed fins.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Blad.description: A pair of curved, blade-like spikes on the right lower leg, one on each side of the calf, each with a recessed inset panel and sweeping tips flaring outward. Monstrous, clawlike styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Blad.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade bodies and edges; colour 3 on the inset panels inside each blade.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Tight_Nightmare_Blad.differs: The male blades sit higher on the calf and flare outward more, with shorter, broader curved tips.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Traveler_01.description: A small shield-shaped plate worn at the outer side of the right knee: a pointed, faceted panel with a raised bordering rim, curving slightly around the leg. Suggests fantasy or mechanical armour.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted plate face and back; colour 1 on the raised rim around the edge.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Valerian_01.description: A right shin greave wrapping the lower leg from below the knee to the ankle, with a thick rounded cap band at the top, a cross-shaped raised armor plate on the front shin, and a thin contrasting stripe down the front.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell and the raised edges of the front plate; colour 2 on the top cap band and the recessed cross plate; colour 3 on the thin stripe down the front.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Valerian_02.description: A small cross-shaped armor plate worn on the outer side of the right lower leg above the ankle, with a raised bevelled rim around a recessed cross panel. Gothic, knightly styling.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Valerian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rim; colour 2 on the recessed cross panel.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Victory_01.description: A right shin greave: a smooth curved plate wrapping the lower leg from below the knee to above the ankle, with a V-shaped contrasting trim edge and an angular faceted guard flaring up over the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plate and the back knee facet; colour 3 on the contrasting trim border and back panel; colour 2 on the front knee guard.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Victory_02.description: A single faceted kneepad forming a wide angular cup over the front of the knee, with a downward point and a creased wrap-around back panel with small raised tips. It suggests armor-like protection.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Victory_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer front shell; colour 0 on the inner folded back and edge panels.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Victory_02.differs: The male kneepad is a wider, shallower cup wrapping around the knee, without the long upward point of the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Victory_03.description: A pair of slender, curving wing-like blades at the outer ankle: a larger sweeping fin swept upward and a smaller lower fin twisting beside it, with contrasting edging. Superhero flair for boots or bare feet.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Victory_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large upper wing; colour 1 on the smaller lower wing and inner underside; colour 2 on the edge outlines.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Vigilante_01.description: A small angular shin or knee guard: a faceted hexagonal plate with a raised rim around an inset front panel that has a small slot detail, sitting on the outside of the lower leg near the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and the back plate; colour 1 on the inset front panel; colour 3 on the small slot detail.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Vigilante_02.description: A small knee guard on the right leg: an angular octagonal band wraps around the leg with a striped edge, and a contrasting wedge-shaped cup with a chunky faceted cap sits over the front of the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the band; colour 0 on the stripe along the band; colour 3 on the knee cup; colour 2 on the faceted cap.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Warrior_01.description: A short segmented ankle greave made of stacked faceted bands that alternate between two materials, with a flat cap ring at the top. It wraps the lower shin just above the foot, in a mechanical, armoured style.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating light bands; colour 1 on the other set of alternating bands; colour 2 on the top cap ring and the thin gaps between bands.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Warrior_02.description: A right-leg greave of rigid armor: a tapered shin guard with a raised rim at the top and a contrasting frame crossing over the front, plus a ribbed fin-like plate down the shin and a segmented ankle cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin shell; colour 3 on the top and bottom bands and the front frame; colour 0 on the ribbed shin plate and ankle guard; colour 2 on the base cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Warrior_Beast_01.description: A short segmented ankle cuff made of stacked faceted bands that pinch slightly at the middle and flare at the ends, worn on the right lower leg just above the ankle. Its look is armoured and tribal.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Warrior_Beast_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating light bands; colour 1 on the other alternating bands; colour 2 on the top rim.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Wingbracer_01.description: A small bat-wing bracer for the outer right calf: two long, slender curved spines sweep up from the ankle, joined by a thin webbed membrane. It gives a spiky, gothic-fantasy look.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Wingbracer_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spines; colour 1 on the membrane between them.

Male/M_Footr_Greave_Wingbracer_02.description: A small bat-wing fin attached to the outer side of the right lower leg: two long curved spiny ribs with a thin, veined membrane stretched between them, tapering to a point near the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Greave_Wingbracer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing ribs and bone spines; colour 1 on the thin membrane between them.

Male/M_Footr_Heraldry_01.description: A low, ankle-high boot with a smooth rounded upper, a jagged crown-like cuff around the ankle, a banded strip across the instep and a long pointed, beak-like toe cap. Sole edged with a thin stripe.
Male/M_Footr_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and sole stripes; colour 2 on the band above the toe; colour 3 on the pointed toe cap.
Male/M_Footr_Heraldry_01.differs: The toe cap extends into a longer, sharper point than on the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Holohexarmor_01_Shortboot.description: A short, sneaker-like sci-fi boot with a soft ruffled ankle cuff, a padded upper, and angular hex-plate armour over the toe, sides and heel. Small round sensor lights and a contrasting toe vent give it a mechanical look.
Male/M_Footr_Holohexarmor_01_Shortboot.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and the padded upper; colour 1 on the armour plates over the toe, sides and heel; colour 2 on the toe vent and the round sockets; colour 3 on the small lights.

Male/M_Footr_Inmate_01.description: A chunky, blocky right boot with a wedge-shaped angular foot and a square open-topped cuff at the ankle. The cuff is marked with small rectangular panel details, suggesting a prison-issue or mechanical shackle look.
Male/M_Footr_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot section; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 1 on the small rectangular panels on the cuff; colour 3 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Junkbot_01.description: A right foot shaped like a clothes iron: a pointed, smooth sole-plate with segmented panels, an ankle cuff, and a bar bridge with a hexagonal handle, thin rods and barrel-like side canisters. A mechanical, junkyard robot look.
Male/M_Footr_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole-plate tip, ankle cuff and side canisters; colour 1 on the sole-plate side panels and supports; colour 2 on the sole-plate band and handle end; colour 3 on the handle centre band.

Male/M_Footr_Junkbot_02.description: A robotic right foot made of scrap parts: a ring cuff at the ankle, chunky cylindrical pipe housings around the heel, and thin rods running forward to two clawed, blocky toe segments. Junkyard mechanical style.
Male/M_Footr_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ankle ring and some joint parts; colour 1 on the pipe housings, toe blocks and heel panels; colour 0 on the toe tips, bands and rods; colour 3 on the cuff patch and small heel panels.

Male/M_Footr_Kaiju_01.description: A monstrous clawed right foot covering, ending just above the ankle, with a chunky rounded scaly-looking foot, muscular ridges over the top and long curved contrasting-tipped talons at the front. Suggests a kaiju or beast look.
Male/M_Footr_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the foot body; colour 2 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Light_01.description: A knee-high superhero boot with a pointed toe, stepped cuffs at the ankle and calf, and a flared angular top. A winged emblem badge sits on the outer shin, with thin contrasting piping along the edges.
Male/M_Footr_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the boot body; colour 0 on the piping trim along the cuffs and top; colour 2 on the winged emblem; colour 1 on the small centre gem of the emblem.

Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_65_01.description: A short right ankle boot in a kung fu style, with a rounded toe cap bearing a curled scroll motif, a V-shaped panel across the front and a folded cuff around the ankle. It sits on the foot only.
Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main boot body and sole; colour 2 on the toe cap with its scrolls, the front panel and the ankle cuff. The surface looks mottled and worn.
Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The male boot has a weathered, mottled surface and a darker toe panel and cuff, where the female one is smooth and clean.

Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_65_02.description: A short, ankle-high kung fu style shoe with a rounded toe, thin flat sole and a raised collar at the ankle. A swooping decorative curve runs across the toe and up the instep, with a separate panel at the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main upper of the shoe; colour 0 on the sole, collar rim, swooping toe trim and heel panel.

Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_66_01.description: A calf-high mechanical boot with a rounded capped toe, a banded ankle cuff and a tall shaft. A angular robot-face plate with small eye lenses sits at the front top, with a V-shaped inset below it.
Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe sides; colour 2 on the toe cap, cuff, rear panel and face plate frame; colour 1 on the V inset and mouth; colour 3 on the eye lenses.

Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_67_01.description: A shaggy, beast-like right foot covering: a furry hoof-shaped boot with ragged layered tufts around the ankle and a split cloven hoof tip at the front. Ends at the ankle, suggesting a monstrous or animal look.
Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaggy fur; colour 2 on the split hoof tips.

Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_67_02.description: A low ankle boot with a chunky sole, laced front with decorative web-like stitched trim, a folded-over contrasting cuff at the ankle, and a small pair of butterfly-like wing fins at the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body; colour 2 on the folded cuff; colour 1 on the sole, stitched trim, laces and wing fins.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Arvad_01.description: A right calf-high boot with a soft, smooth shaft and thin sole, topped by stacked layered bands at the cuff and an ornate curled scroll plate with swirl motifs down the front of the shin.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Arvad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and the scroll plate's frame; colour 1 on the sole and the curled swirl accents; colour 2 on the middle cuff bands and the swirls; colour 3 on the top cuff band.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Bounty_01.description: Mid-calf sci-fi boot with a segmented, paneled shaft, a wide contrasting band below the top, a contrasting centre strip down the front, a chunky capped toe with a small inset light, and a thick sole with a heel block.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shaft panels; colour 1 on the band, lower boot body and sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap, front strip and heel block; colour 3 on the toe light.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Ghosthunter_01.description: A mid-calf lace-up boot with a smooth, sturdy shaft, criss-cross front lacing, contrasting straps across the shaft and ankle, a contrasting band at the top and a thin contrasting sole. Sporty, practical look.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 2 on the straps and top band; colour 3 on the laces; colour 1 on the sole.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The male boot has a shorter, wider shaft with a chunkier rounded toe.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A single right boot with a mid-calf shaft that is slightly wrinkled, a rounded toe and a flat low sole. Simple retro styling with a thin contrasting rim at the top.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shaft; colour 1 on the foot and lower shaft; colour 3 on the thin top rim; colour 2 on the sole edge.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Retro_Talisman_01.differs: The male boot has a flat sole and a shorter shaft ending below the knee, while the female boot has a high stiletto heel and a taller shaft.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Super_Destroyer_01.description: A retro superhero right boot: a glossy calf-high sleeve with a flared knee cap and pointed top, a front shin plate, a band at the ankle, and a flat sole with a separate toe plate and a small side fin at the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Super_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe and instep plates; colour 1 on the knee cap, shin plate and ankle band; colour 3 on the small knee fin; colour 2 on the calf sleeve and sole.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Super_Destroyer_01.differs: The male boot has a broader, chunkier toe plate and no gem on the front of the knee cap.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Tactical_01.description: A chunky tactical sci-fi right boot with an angular armored cuff, open mesh-like ankle panel, lugged tread sole, warning-triangle emblem on the side, and small canister thrusters on each side of the ankle with a looping cable.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, sole and toe panels; colour 0 on the boot body and canisters; colour 2 on the ankle panel, laces and rear vents; colour 3 on the warning emblem and canister markings.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Traveler_01.description: A mid-calf right boot with a smooth, slightly loose shaft, a rounded toe and a low flat sole. Two buckled straps wrap the shaft and a small angled strap crosses the instep, for a retro space-explorer look.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the straps and instep band; colour 3 on the buckle frames and instep tab; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Trooper_01.description: A mid-calf superhero boot with a smooth, sleek shaft, a chevron-shaped angular cuff at the top, contrasting inset panels on the front and sides, a contrasting rounded toe cap and a thin sole.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the chevron cuff; colour 2 on the inset panels and toe cap; colour 3 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Valerian_01.description: A right knee-high sci-fi boot with a smooth shaft, a thick rounded cuff at the top, an angular armoured shin plate with jutting fins, a strip down the front of the ankle, and a chunky sole with a toe cap.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and upper; colour 1 on the sole and toe cap; colour 2 on the top cuff and shin plate; colour 3 on the front ankle strip.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Vigilante_01.description: A calf-high right boot with a smooth rounded foot and thin sole, a blade-like layered armor shell up the front shin and back of the calf, and a strap band across the ankle. Sleek sci-fi superhero style.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body; colour 1 on the toe panel and the stripe up the front of the shin; colour 2 on the armor shell, ankle strap and sole; colour 3 on the small mark at the back top.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Vigilante_02.description: A calf-high superhero boot with a smooth flared cuff, a contrasting front stripe, two buckled straps around the shin and a strap across the instep. It has a rounded toe panel and a thick sole.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body, straps and toe rim; colour 1 on the front stripe and toe panel; colour 3 on the strap buckles; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Long_Wheelie_01.description: A single-wheel skate boot cuff worn on the right ankle: a padded, ribbed ankle shell with a V-shaped strap panel, round star-emblem discs on each side, and one large chunky wheel under the foot with studded axle knobs.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Wheelie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle shell and wheel; colour 1 on the V-shaped strap panel and disc centres; colour 3 on the disc rims and axle knobs; colour 2 on the stars and hub.
Male/M_Footr_Long_Wheelie_01.differs: The male wheel is larger and chunkier, with a visible contrasting hub, and the ankle shell and side discs are bulkier.

Male/M_Footr_Mecha_01.description: A mechanical claw-like right foot: a short cuffed ankle band over a contrasting arched joint, with angular wedge toes splayed forward, a small side toe block and a wedge heel at the back. Sci-fi mecha style.
Male/M_Footr_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 0 on the toe wedges and heel blocks; colour 2 on the arched ankle joint.
Male/M_Footr_Mecha_01.differs: The male version has a wider central toe wedge plus an extra small side toe block, while the female version has two long toes and a smaller heel block.

Male/M_Footr_Mecha_03.description: A low mechanical right foot piece: a flat, angular pointed sole plate with small side lugs, a smooth wedge-shaped upper, and a chunky notched ankle cuff with a ribbed vent inside. Robot-like and sci-fi in style.
Male/M_Footr_Mecha_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole and upper; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the ribbed vent inside the cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A low, ankle-high sneaker-style shoe with a rounded toe cap, stitched seams and a chunky flat sole, finished with a thick ring cuff at the ankle and a swooping contrasting panel across the laces area.
Male/M_Footr_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body and toe cap; colour 1 on the ankle ring cuff; colour 3 on the diagonal front panel; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: A glossy ankle-high heeled bootie with a rounded toe, chunky block heel and thin sole. A slim outlined panel runs down the front of the shaft, and the collar has a contrasting trim edge.
Male/M_Footr_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the outline trim around the collar and front panel; colour 2 on the heel and sole.

Male/M_Footr_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A short, rounded ankle boot with a soft slouched cuff, a chunky flat sole and a wrapped separate panel around the ankle, fastened with small diamond-shaped ornaments on each side.
Male/M_Footr_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the wrapped ankle panel; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the diamond ornaments.
Male/M_Footr_Modern_Witchcraft_01.differs: The male boot is stubbier and wider with a shorter shaft, and the ankle panel sits lower and wraps more loosely.

Male/M_Footr_Monster_Bootripped_01.description: A short ankle boot with torn, ragged edges at the toe, from which large skin-toned animal claws protrude. It has a laced front, a padded cuff at the top and a thick angular sole with a raised heel block.
Male/M_Footr_Monster_Bootripped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 2 on the top cuff and the laces; colour 1 on the sole and heel; the claws show a fixed skin tone and ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Footr_Moth_01.description: A clawed monstrous right foot covering: a flared cuff at the ankle, layered crumpled wraps over the foot, and two forked toe sections each ending in a long curved talon. Suggests a beast or insect creature.
Male/M_Footr_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ankle cuff; colour 1 on the layered foot wraps; colour 2 on the toe caps; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Mutated_01.description: A right ankle-high boot with a lumpy, organic shell of swollen ridges and folds, ending in a blunt toe with a cluster of small round nodules and a small bulb at the tip. Suggests a mutated, monstrous look.
Male/M_Footr_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main boot body; colour 2 on the toe nodules; colour 1 on the small bulbs at the toe and ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Mutated_02.description: A right foot covering shaped like a lumpy, fleshy mutated boot, with folded, wrinkled ridges and a few bulbous blisters and small contrasting nodules across the top. It sits low, just above the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main wrinkled boot body; colour 1 on the bulbous blisters on top; colour 2 on the small nodules.

Male/M_Footr_Persian_Shoe_01.description: A soft, slipper-like ankle shoe with a long upturned curling pointed toe, a low heel-less sole and a notched, pointed cuff with a triangular front gusset. Suggests Persian or genie-style fantasy footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Persian_Shoe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the shoe; colour 1 on the trim along the cuff and gusset edges; colour 3 on the front triangular gusset; colour 2 on the underside of the toe tip.

Male/M_Footr_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A spiky armoured boot-and-shin guard for the right leg: a pointed shin plate with a flared crest at the top, layered calf plates behind, and a large clawed, jagged-edged foot cover. Dragon-like sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Footr_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot cover, crest and back edge spikes; colour 1 on the ankle flare and layered calf plates; colour 2 on the shin plate edge and heel; colour 3 on small inner accents.
Male/M_Footr_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The male version has a bulkier, more enclosing foot cover with larger spikes, and the contrasting plating covers more of the front of the shin.

Male/M_Footr_Pumpkin_01.description: A chunky, rounded ankle-high shoe with a thick flat sole, jagged tooth-like panels across the toe and sides, swirling curved lines on the heel, and a clawed bat-wing shaped bow at the ankle. Cartoonish monster style.
Male/M_Footr_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 3 on the jagged toothed panels and swirl lines; colour 1 on the winged bow at the ankle; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Raptor_Big_01.description: A large reptilian raptor foot for the right leg: a short stump-like ankle leads to a long, splayed three-toed foot with a rear spur and long curved talons, textured with small speckles and ridges.
Male/M_Footr_Raptor_Big_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the talons; colour 1 on the small marks along the toes; colour 3 on the main skin of the foot and ankle; colour 2 on the small speckles.

Male/M_Footr_Raptor_Big_02.description: A right foot shaped like a raptor's: a thick, bare skin-textured foot that begins at the ankle and splits into three long toes, each ending in a sharp curved claw, plus a rear spur. Spots and small stripe markings dot the surface.
Male/M_Footr_Raptor_Big_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the skin-textured foot ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 on the small stripe markings across the toes.

Male/M_Footr_Raptor_Big_04.description: A right foot replaced by a bird-of-prey or raptor talon: a short rounded ankle stump and long splayed toes with long curved claws, plus a rear spur. Scaly skin with small speckles marks it as a beastly look.
Male/M_Footr_Raptor_Big_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; colour 1 on the small marking patches along the toes; colour 2 on the small speckles; the skin itself shows a fixed skin tone that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Footr_Raptor_Claw_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a bird-of-prey talon: a short ankle-high cuff, ridged scaly toes, a rounded ball pad, and long curved claws at the front and a raised dewclaw at the inner side. Monstrous, beastly look.
Male/M_Footr_Raptor_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ankle cuff, ball pad and underside; colour 1 on the ridged scaly toe plates; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Ravenswood_01.description: A shin guard for the right lower leg: a rounded, cuff-like greave with a stepped plate at the calf and a pointed front shield with swirling etched patterns and swept spikes, ending in a point near the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main greave plates and cuff; colour 1 on the etched swirl patterns and thin line accents.

Male/M_Footr_Reactor_01.description: A right ankle boot made of chunky, faceted stacked plates around the ankle, with a smooth rounded toe cap and a thick sole rim with a contrasting accent strip. Suggests a sci-fi armored superhero look.
Male/M_Footr_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stacked ankle plates; colour 1 on the toe cap and upper front; colour 2 on the sole rim; colour 3 on the accent strips along the sole edge.

Male/M_Footr_Reactor_02.description: A chunky, rounded ankle boot with a bulbous domed toe cap marked by small dimples, a raised block heel, a thick cuff at the ankle and round side pods on either side of the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe, upper foot and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the heel block and ankle section; colour 3 on the round side pods; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Reactor_04.description: A chunky, angular right ankle boot with faceted panels, small rivets, a thick platform sole and a contrasting padded cuff. A long cone spike projects forward from the toe, and a rounded panel fills the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and toe panels; colour 1 on the sole and the band across the instep; colour 3 on the toe spike and heel panel; colour 2 on the cuff opening and outlines.
Male/M_Footr_Reactor_04.differs: The male version's toe spike projects farther forward, and a small extra spike shows at the back of the heel.

Male/M_Footr_Renegade_01.description: A chunky ankle-high sneaker-style boot with angular armour plates over the toe and heel, a cross strap with elasticated bands over the instep, and small spikes at the toe sides and a contrasting stud at the front.
Male/M_Footr_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, heel plates and strap; colour 1 on the main boot body, sole and one side spike; colour 3 on the bands over the instep; colour 2 on the front stud, one spike and the strap fasteners.
Male/M_Footr_Renegade_01.differs: The male boot has smaller, lower spikes with a flat contrasting stud at the toe front instead of a tall central spike.

Male/M_Footr_Renegade_02.description: A chunky low sneaker-style boot with a rounded toe cap and a layered strap panel across the top of the foot, fastened with studs. Sits at the ankle with a bulky heel block.
Male/M_Footr_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole, toe cap and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the top strap panels; colour 2 on the heel block; colour 3 on the studs.
Male/M_Footr_Renegade_02.differs: The male version has a plain strap panel with no spikes.

Male/M_Footr_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky angular boot-shoe with a thick layered sole, faceted armoured toe cap and a wide strap panel across the instep with a small inset patch; a short crumpled ankle cuff rises behind.
Male/M_Footr_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff; colour 1 on the toe cap, strap panel and heel plates; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the small patch on the strap.
Male/M_Footr_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, broader sole and a lower, softer ankle cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Robotexo_01.description: A robotic exoskeleton right foot: a rounded heel block, a contrasting ankle joint disc with a hub, exposed cable bundles running to a layered armored instep plate, and segmented mechanical toes. Sits below a flat ankle cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel block, ankle cuff, instep plate and toe segments; colour 1 on the cables; colour 2 on the ankle joint and toe joints; colour 3 on the hub centres and small toe markings.

Male/M_Footr_Robotexo_02.description: A mechanical cyborg right foot: a cuffed ankle joint with a round wheel-like hub, strut arms running forward to a separate plated toe cap, and a rear heel block, all on a thin sole. Digitigrade-style, robotic and sci-fi.
Male/M_Footr_Robotexo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff, heel block and toe plates; colour 1 on the struts, soles and toe stripes; colour 2 on the ankle joint housing; colour 3 on the hub centre and inner heel details.

Male/M_Footr_Sandstorm_01.description: A short ankle boot with a soft, slightly wrinkled shaft, a rounded toe, a thin sole, and a contrasting cuff at the top. A thin zip-like seam runs up the outer side and the back. Casual, practical footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff opening; colour 3 on the seam stitching; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Sandstorm_02.description: A low, chunky right shoe with a rounded toe, thick sole with a squared toe cap, a folded ankle cuff and a tall separate panel hanging down the back of the heel. Sporty, sci-fi footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 2 on the sole and toe cap; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the heel panel and the small front cuff panel.

Male/M_Footr_Santa_Boot_01.description: A right ankle boot in a festive Santa style: a contrasting rounded-toe foot with a small heel, a taller shaft and a thick folded-over cuff at the top, plus a square buckle across the instep.
Male/M_Footr_Santa_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot of the boot and the buckle; colour 1 on the shaft and part of the cuff; colour 3 on the rounded cuff section; colour 2 on the buckle's inner slot.

Male/M_Footr_Scarab_02.description: A monstrous clawed right foot: a smooth ankle-high boot base extends into three segmented, armoured toes, each tipped with a long curved talon. It suggests a beast or scarab-like mechanical creature.
Male/M_Footr_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth foot base; colour 2 on the segmented toe plates; colour 3 on the talons.

Male/M_Footr_Shoe_Urban_01.description: A high-top canvas sneaker with a rounded toe cap, thick flat sole, criss-cross laces, eyelets, a folded floppy collar and a diamond-shaped emblem patch on the ankle. Casual street footwear worn on the right foot.
Male/M_Footr_Shoe_Urban_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body and collar; colour 1 on the laces and the ankle strip; colour 3 on the toe cap, eyelets and the emblem outline; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Shoe_Victorian_01.description: A low ankle-high Victorian boot with a smooth upper, a separate textured toe cap, a small stacked heel and a rounded side bulge at the ankle. It sits on the right foot in a period-style look.
Male/M_Footr_Shoe_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper; colour 2 on the toe cap and heel; colour 1 on the panel down the back and outer side of the ankle and on the small tip and edge accents.

Male/M_Footr_Shoes_Spy_01.description: A chunky low-cut dress shoe with a square rounded toe, glossy upper, laced front panel and a thick platform sole with a small heel, plus a short cuffed sock top at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Shoes_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the laced front panel; colour 2 on the thick sole; colour 3 on the sock cuff at the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Skeleton_02.description: A skeletal right foot with individually modelled toe and foot bones, a chunky heel bone and a visible ankle joint, topped by a thin separate cuff band at the trouser hem. Suits undead or monstrous looks.
Male/M_Footr_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint bands and patches over the heel, ankle and knuckles; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Skeleton_02.differs: The male version has a thinner, low cuff with a bone ankle joint visible below it, while the female version has a taller, flared cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Skeleton_Monster_01.description: A skeletal monster foot: long, separate bone-like toe rods fanning out from a small flat ankle cap, each ending in a segmented joint and a curved, pointed claw. Worn on the right foot, it suggests a beastly, undead look.
Male/M_Footr_Skeleton_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long toe bones and ankle cap; colour 1 on the toe joint segments; colour 2 on the claw bases; colour 3 on the claw tips.
Male/M_Footr_Skeleton_Monster_01.differs: The male foot has longer, more sloping toe bones that stretch further forward.
