Male/M_Footr_Skin_Fur_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: a furry ankle cuff with jagged tufts, a separate skin-toned patch on the outer side, a panel over the midfoot, and clawed, separated toes.
Male/M_Footr_Skin_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ankle cuff, fur and toes; colour 0 on the heel and sole and the claw tips; colour 2 on the midfoot panel over the front of the foot; the patch on the outer side ignores the scheme and keeps its skin tone.

Male/M_Footr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: a furred ankle and heel section with jagged tufts, a separate patch on the outer side, a padded toe section and long curved claws at each toe tip.
Male/M_Footr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel and the claw tips; colour 1 on the ankle fur and the claws; colour 2 on the toe pad; colour 3 on the side patch.

Male/M_Footr_Sneakers_02.description: A right-foot running sneaker with a chunky rounded sole, breathable mesh upper, curved overlay stripes down the side, a padded heel with cushioning inserts, a short contrasting ankle cuff and loosely threaded laces.
Male/M_Footr_Sneakers_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh upper; colour 1 on the sole, toe cap and heel; colour 3 on the side stripes and heel inserts; colour 2 on the laces and ankle cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A tall, angular boot-greave for the right leg with a flared, faceted rim at the calf, a cut-away open front over the instep and a wide back panel. Built from separate panels, it has a sleek sci-fi pharaoh look.
Male/M_Footr_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, heel and lower side panels; colour 1 on the main front and foot panels; colour 2 on the back stripe and ankle cut-out; colour 3 on the small band at mid-shin.

Male/M_Footr_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A right boot with a chunky rounded toe and a mid-calf shaft with a hexagonal opening. Layered panels and a separate ankle cuff with a bolt-like fastener give it a sci-fi, adventurer look.
Male/M_Footr_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shaft and the foot; colour 1 on the mid-shaft panel and the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the top opening and the band below the shaft; colour 3 on the small panel at the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Spats_Victorian_01.description: A right ankle boot with a short cuff and a separate spat panel wrapped over the instep and heel, plus a contrasting toe cap and small heel. Sits at the ankle, with a vintage, dapper look.
Male/M_Footr_Spats_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spat panel over the instep and heel; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and heel edge; colour 3 on the front strip of the cuff; colour 2 on the toe cap.

Male/M_Footr_Starhawk_02.description: A low ankle boot with a hexagon-patterned upper, a chunky rounded sole, a swept-up angular heel cap and a small capped toe. It sits at the ankle and suggests a sleek, sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Footr_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hexagon-patterned upper; colour 3 on the hexagon cell lines; colour 1 on the sole and heel-cap surround; colour 2 on the toe cap and heel block.

Male/M_Footr_Steelcommando_01.description: A right ankle-high sci-fi boot with a smooth rounded toe, a glossy panel down the front of the shaft outlined by a raised border, a thin strap across the instep, and a chunky sculpted sole.
Male/M_Footr_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and toe; colour 1 on the sole, instep strap and back of the shaft; colour 2 on the glossy front panel and inner sides; colour 3 on the border around the front panel.

Male/M_Footr_Swan_01.description: A low, ankle-high shoe with a long rounded toe, a chunky sole and a heel block at the back. A pointed contrasting panel runs up the instep, giving a simple sporty, sleek look.
Male/M_Footr_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and side upper; colour 1 on the toe cap and front of the shoe; colour 3 on the pointed instep panel; colour 2 on the sole and heel block.

Male/M_Footr_Swing_01.description: A short ankle boot with a rounded, bulbous toe cap, low flat heel and a thick sole. A contrasting strap with a small buckle wraps the ankle, with two small studs on the front and thin line detailing on the back.
Male/M_Footr_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the toe cap and sole; colour 2 on the ankle strap and line trim; colour 3 on the buckle and small studs.

Male/M_Footr_Swing_02.description: A right ankle boot with a tall, slightly crinkled soft shaft, a broad rounded toe cap and a low flat heel. A contrasting fan-shaped plate sits at the front of the ankle, with a small triangular emblem on the back of the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the toe cap and lower foot; colour 3 on the sole and heel; colour 2 on the fan-shaped ankle plate and heel emblem.

Male/M_Footr_Tactical_01.description: A low-cut angular sneaker with a chunky faceted upper, a slim contrasting stripe band along the side, a thick separate sole and a short padded ankle opening. Sits on the right foot in a sporty sci-fi style.
Male/M_Footr_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper panels; colour 3 on the stripe band along the side; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the ankle collar.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_01_Shortboot.description: A plain, smooth, close-fitting ankle boot for the right foot: a low tube hugging the ankle and foot with a rounded toe and no visible seams, fasteners or sole detail.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_01_Shortboot.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_2toes_014arm.description: A bare, skin-like right foot with only two thick, rounded toes, each tipped with a small nail or claw. It ends at the ankle and gives a monstrous, creature-like look in place of a normal foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_2toes_014arm.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toe nails or tips; the foot itself shows a skin tone that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_90s_Boot_01.description: A knee-high mechanical boot with segmented armoured shin plating, a large curved plate at the front of the upper shin, a low soft foot section, and contrasting double straps with small studs around the back of the calf.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_90s_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin and calf casing; colour 1 on the front shin plate and the foot section; colour 2 on the calf straps; colour 3 on the small studs and lights.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A right boot with a segmented, armored shin and a contrasting-toed foot, with a wide flared cuff at the top and a row of curved blade-like spikes along the outer side of the calf. It suggests a 90s superhero look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot, front shin plate, cuff and spikes; colour 1 on the calf sides, ankle trim and top cuff; colour 2 on the toe cap and the front shin panel; colour 3 on the calf band and side panel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The male boot is a bulkier flat-soled boot with a wider cuff, while the female version has a raised heel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A right-leg piece with a segmented, ribbed leg sheath from mid-thigh to ankle, a rounded knee guard, a chunky electronic strap module with indicator lights at the thigh, and a flat-soled boot with contrasting toe cap.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed leg segments and toe cap; colour 1 on the knee guard, band above the calf and boot; colour 2 on the thigh module and strap; colour 3 on the indicator lights.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.differs: The male version ends in a flat-soled boot, while the female has a high-heeled boot.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aberrant_01.description: A bulbous, monstrous right foot that swells out from the ankle like a fleshy stump, with wrinkled skin, contrasting pore-like holes and crystalline toe-like growths at the front. Suggests an alien mutant limb.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aberrant_01.colourAreas: The piece keeps its own skin-like texture, so the colour scheme has little visible effect; the crystal toe growths show a bluish tint that does not clearly map to a slot.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Alien_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a clawed alien paw: a smooth, rounded ankle-high foot piece ending in three large pointed talons at the toes. Suggests a monstrous creature foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and ankle covering; colour 1 on the three talons.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.description: Right calf-high alien gladiator boot built from stacked overlapping segmented plates with rows of glyph-like engraved markings, a row of studs up the front, a pointed ridged toe cap and a strap across the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stacked calf plates and toe cap; colour 3 on the glyph markings; colour 1 on the sole upper and ankle strap area; colour 2 on the sole and gaps between plates.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.differs: The male boot has a wider, bulkier calf shell with a blunter toe than the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A chunky right shoe with a rounded toe, a wide strapped upper across the foot, a raised heel section, a thick sole and a round cuff at the ankle opening.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe and strapped upper; colour 3 on the heel and side panel; colour 1 on the ankle cuff; colour 2 on the sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Amazon_01.differs: The male version is a low shoe with a strapped upper and thick sole, while the female version is a shin and calf guard with an angular front plate.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ankle_01.description: A short, simple ankle boot with a rounded body, a thin flat sole and a separate band around the ankle opening. A contrasting patch covers the toe. Plain, low-profile footwear that suits casual or superhero looks.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ankle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and toe patch; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Defender_.description: A right mid-calf superhero boot with a flared cuff, glossy toe and foot section, and banded ribbed panels down the shin and calf outlined with thin piping. Retro, armoured-looking design with a flat sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Defender_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cuff and toe cap; colour 0 on the glossy foot and upper shin plates; colour 2 on the ribbed calf and shin panels; colour 3 on the thin piping outlines.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Nighthawk.description: A single calf-high superhero boot with a smooth, slightly flared shaft that dips at the front, a chunky treaded sole, a contrasting toe cap with a swooping side stripe, and a row of small fin-like spikes along the outer side.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Nighthawk.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and upper; colour 3 on the toe cap; colour 1 on the swooping side stripe; colour 2 on the sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Nighthawk.differs: The male boot has a shorter, looser shaft with the outer spikes placed higher up the side.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcraf.description: A soft, slouchy ankle shoe with a rounded toe, wrinkled leather-like upper, a pointed flap at the heel and a side opening showing the lining, set on a thin contrasting sole edge. Suits witchy or fantasy looks.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Anniversary_Witchcraf.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper and stitched seams; colour 2 on the inner lining and the shaded back of the shoe; colour 3 on the sole edge and the heel flap trim.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A right boot with a tall shin-guard shell, segmented banded plates, a row of curved fin-like spines along the outer edge, and a rounded low-cut foot with a pointed upturned toe and contrasting trim bands.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf shell and spines; colour 1 on the thin stripes across the calf; colour 2 on the top cap and edge plates; colour 3 on the foot section.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A low, ankle-high right shoe with a smooth rounded upper, a thick flat sole and a pointed toe. Layered ridged bands wrap the ankle above a separate coloured stripe, giving a sleek aquatic look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper; colour 1 on the sole; colour 3 on the stripe around the ankle; colour 2 on the ridged bands, the top cuff and the sole edge.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_03.description: A close-fitting ankle-high foot covering with a scaly, net-like reptilian pattern, and a glossy strip running diagonally from the ankle down across the instep to the toe. Suggests aquatic or creature-themed tights.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base scaly surface between the cells; colour 1 on the scale cell pattern; colour 2 on the glossy diagonal strip.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_04.description: A close-fitting ankle-high foot covering with a scaly, net-like patterned upper over the foot and instep, and a smooth separate panel wrapping the heel and back of the ankle. Suggests aquatic, creature-skin styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Aquatic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gaps between the scale cells; colour 1 on the scale cells across the foot and instep; colour 3 on the smooth heel and back panel; colour 2 on the thin seam between panels.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A calf-length boot with a smooth flat sole and a pointed dip-and-peak upper edge. Swirling scroll patterns run up the shaft, with rounded gem-like studs on each side of the shin. Arcane, fantasy styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 3 on the swirling scroll patterns; colour 1 on the rounded side studs; colour 2 on the pointed inner cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Archer_01.description: A soft, mid-calf right boot with a slouchy, wrinkled shaft, a softly pointed toe and a thin sole. A separate flared cuff with notched edges sits around the top, giving a casual archer or adventurer look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe; colour 2 on the top cuff; colour 1 on the sole edge.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_01.description: A right-foot armored boot with a long pointed toe, segmented plates and trim lines over the foot, and a shin guard. A snarling monstrous face with an open mouth and fangs sits at the front, and straps wrap the calf.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot plates and face; colour 1 on the edge trim and plate lines; colour 2 on the straps and fangs; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_01.differs: The male boot has a longer, sharper pointed toe and a shorter shin guard.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_02.description: A low armored shoe for the right foot with a pointed, tapering toe, segmented plates over the instep, a raised angular cuff at the ankle, and small rivets along the sides and heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armor_Draycul_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates of the shoe and cuff; colour 1 on the trim lines, bands and cuff edging; colour 2 not visible; colour 3 not visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armorblackpaladin_01.description: A right knight-style armoured boot reaching below the knee, with a flared kneecap-like cuff studded with small spikes, segmented shin panels, a spiked ankle band and a broad, pointed toe cap.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armorblackpaladin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knee guard, toe and sole; colour 1 on the upper shin, calf and ankle band with spikes; colour 2 on the lower calf band; colour 3 on the rear heel panel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armorblackpaladin_01.differs: The male boot has a larger, wider knee cuff and a broader, blunter toe than the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armored_01.description: A right-foot armored boot reaching mid-calf, with a smooth plated shin shell, a contrasting front strip, a hinged plate over the instep and toe, small round rivets at the ankle and a thick contrasting sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin shell, ankle plate and boot toe; colour 1 on the front shin strip and the instep and toe panels; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armorninja.description: A right-foot ninja-style armoured boot with a quilted split-toe tabi foot, a broad shin plate and a bulky rounded knee cup with a curved blade spur at the side. Rimmed edges frame the plates.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted foot and lower boot; colour 1 on the knee cup, shin plate and ankle strap; colour 2 on the plate rims and spur; colour 3 on the small slots at the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armorninja.differs: The male boot has a quilted foot and large rimmed shin and knee plates, with only small contrasting slots at the knee.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi armored boot made of angular segmented plates, with a raised rim at the top, a vented panel behind the calf, a contrasting tubular booster column down the heel, and a thin sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and toe; colour 1 on the sole, top rim accent and heel trim; colour 2 on the rear booster column; colour 3 on the small vent slits.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A low, close-fitting shoe-like foot covering that ends at the ankle, with a thin cuff at the top and raised, swooping outlined panels across the toe, instep and heel. It gives a sleek, sporty sci-fi look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the inset panels over the toe, instep and heel; colour 3 on the raised outlines around the panels; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A low, ankle-height sporty shoe-boot covering the right foot, with a rounded toe cap, swooping curved panels along the side and a thin raised outline on every seam; sleek and form-fitting, in a sci-fi superhero style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the heel and rear sole panel; colour 1 on the toe cap, ankle cuff and front panels; colour 2 on the swooping side and ankle panels; colour 3 on the outline piping.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ball_01.description: A faceted spherical ball that replaces the right foot, capped by a short cylindrical cuff band at the ankle. A simple, low-poly mechanical or monstrous stump-foot with a rounded, blocky silhouette.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ball; colour 1 on the ankle cuff band.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Banded_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting calf-length boot with a thick, chunky octagonal cuff around the top and a contrasting toe cap. It is a plain, simple boot in a sleek, slightly mechanical style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Banded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the top cuff and the toe cap.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bare_01.description: A bare right foot with sculpted toes and small toenails, ending at the ankle so the tights leg meets it. Reads as plain skin with no footwear, for barefoot looks.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bare_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toenails; the foot skin does not take a colour slot from the scheme.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bare_Claw_01.description: A bare, skin-toned right foot replacing the boot, with five toes each ending in a sharp curved claw. It sits below the ankle, giving a beastly, barefoot look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bare_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the foot itself is skin and does not take a scheme colour.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bare_Tiptoes_01.description: A bare right foot in an arched, tiptoe pose, with the heel raised and toes pointing down. It is sculpted with individual toes and painted toenails and ends at the ankle, so it suits barefoot looks.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bare_Tiptoes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toenails; the rest of the foot is a fixed skin tone and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bear_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a bear paw: a smooth rounded foot with four contrasting claws at the toes, rising into a shorter, chunky cuff of jagged fur spikes around the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower fur; colour 1 on the upper fur spikes, blending in a gradient; colour 2 on the claws.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bear_01.differs: The male paw has shorter, blunter fur spikes that stop around the ankle instead of climbing the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.description: A beast-like right foot covering shaped like a rhino hoof: a rounded, wrinkled hide foot with a shaded gradient up the ankle and blunt toe hooves at the front.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the toe hooves; the hide portion keeps its own skin-like texture and ignores the colour scheme.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Rhino_01.differs: Shows two toe hooves visible at the front, and the foot is wider and blockier.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.description: A right-foot wolf paw covering: a tapered, digitigrade lower leg that ends in a clawed paw with toe pads, topped by a ragged crest of jagged fur tufts just below the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw and lower leg; colour 1 on the upper fur tufts and toe pads; colour 2 on the tips of the fur spikes; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.description: A tapered wolf-fur calf wrap for the right leg, narrow at the ankle and flaring upward into shaggy jagged tufts, with a few tall pointed spikes rising at the front. Feral, beastly look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fur near the ankle; colour 1 on the main body of the fur; colour 2 on the spiky tuft tips, with a gradient blending between them.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.differs: The male version has taller, more upright spikes at the front of the calf, while the female tufts form a fuller, bushier crown.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Small_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: a rounded, low-cut shoe with separated toe bulges, small spiky ridges across the top and pointed claws extending past the toes. Suggests a wolf or monster.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body; colour 1 on the small spikes across the top of the foot; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A right foot piece with a scaly bird talon foot and long curved claws, covered above by a loose, baggy trouser leg that gathers at the ankle and ends in a small angular cuff below the calf.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the loose leg cover; colour 2 on the angular cuff at the top; colour 1 on the claws; the scaly bird skin ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The male version has a loose cloth leg cover ending mid-calf with a small cuff, instead of a fitted armored greave with a knee guard.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_03.description: A right foot shaped like a bird's or reptile's talon: scaly, ridged skin over the foot and ankle, with three long curved claws at the front and a short rear spur. It replaces the bare foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the scaly skin of the foot does not appear to follow the colour scheme and shows its own skin tone.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_Cover_02.description: A right foot-and-lower-leg cover in the form of a bird foot: a loose, wrinkled calf wrap ends at the ankle, with a scaly, textured foot and long curved talons on the toes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Birdpeople_Cover_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the loose calf wrap; colour 1 on the talons; the scaly foot skin is a fixed skin tone that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A chunky, angular low-top sneaker-boot with a faceted upper, a wide flat contrasting sole with an angled edge, a recessed panel down the instep, a raised tab at the heel and an inset panel at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper; colour 1 on the sole rim and heel tab; colour 2 on the instep panel; colour 3 on the inset heel panel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A chunky, angular low shoe with a faceted rounded toe cap, a thin raised sole rim, and a short armoured ankle cuff. A round disc-like module sits on each side of the ankle. Mechanical, sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and sole rim; colour 1 on the toe cap and heel panel; colour 2 on the mid-foot panel and the disc housings; colour 3 on the centres of the ankle discs.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.description: A calf-height pointed-toe boot with a smooth, slightly loose shaft, a low block heel, and two buckled straps across the instep joined to a contrasting band around the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 2 on the straps and ankle band; colour 3 on the buckles; colour 1 on the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Buckle_02.differs: The male boot is a taller calf-height boot with a low flat heel, while the female version is a short ankle boot on a stiletto heel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armor_.description: A right-leg mechanical armored boot reaching to just below the knee, built from chunky angular segmented plates with a pointed knee-top guard, a wide strap band at the ankle and a toothed, treaded sole with a contrasting toe cap.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armor_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower shin plates, ankle band and sole; colour 1 on the upper shin panel and the foot upper; colour 3 on the toe cap; colour 2 on the recessed shin and heel gaps.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Clockwork_Armor_.differs: The male boot is bulkier and shorter, with a chunkier foot and thicker plates around the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.description: A mechanical boot with segmented armor plates up the shin, a vented cap at the top of the calf, a plated strap over the instep and a chunky sole. Ribbed cables loop down each side of the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plates and foot; colour 1 on the vented top cap and the recessed side panels; colour 2 on the cables and sole; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Electric_01.differs: The male boot is shorter and stubbier, ending lower on the calf with short cables that stay close to the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Madjester_01.description: A right ankle boot with a chunky treaded platform sole, rounded toe and slightly slouched cuff. Crossed front lacing runs between two strap tabs with round studs, giving a punky, playful look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and cuff; colour 1 on the criss-cross laces; colour 2 on the platform sole; colour 3 on the round studs on the straps.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Spurs_01.description: A mid-calf cowboy boot with a slouched, wrinkled shaft that has a scooped, contrasting top edge, a textured textured-hide foot, a chunky stacked heel, and a strap with a buckle across the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Spurs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft; colour 1 on the foot and toe; colour 2 on the top edge, ankle strap, sole and heel; colour 3 on the buckles.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Steampunk_Rocket.description: An ankle-high laced boot with a pointed toe cap and a small heel, criss-cross lacing up the front, and a bulky cylindrical rocket thruster with small fins strapped to the back of the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Boot_Steampunk_Rocket.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the toe cap and the rocket casing and fins; colour 2 on the lacing, outline trim and round studs; colour 3 on the vent panels of the rocket.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bootsole_01.description: A plain, smooth calf-length boot with a straight tube shaft ending just below the knee, a rounded toe and a thick flat sole with a low heel. Simple, clean superhero styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bootsole_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; the thick sole edge also takes colour 0 on this sheet.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bootsole_02.description: A short, snug ankle boot with a smooth upper ending just above the ankle, a slightly pointed toe and a thick flat sole with a small raised heel block. Plain, simple everyday footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bootsole_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and sole; the sole edge shows a slightly lighter rim; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Brutal_01.description: An open toe-post sandal with a thick braided-rope edged sole and a wide gathered wrap strap across the instep, plus a heel strap; the toes and heel stay bare. Casual, tribal look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gathered instep wrap and heel strap; colour 1 on the sole's inner footbed; colour 2 on the braided sole edge; the toe loop takes colour 0.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The toe loop is a light twisted cord rather than a contrasting thin post, and the wrap sits lower and looser.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bull_Hoof_01.description: A right foot styled as a cloven hoof: a chunky split hoof with a central cleft, topped by a short shaggy furred cuff around the ankle. Beastly, monstrous look that replaces the foot and lower ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Bull_Hoof_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hoof; colour 1 on the furry ankle cuff; colour 2 on the streaks in the fur.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, angular right boot made of flat cardboard-like panels: a tall shin guard with a slanted flap at the top, a front slit showing a separate panel, and a rounded low foot with a strap tab over the instep.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and outer shin panels; colour 1 on the curved side panels and small foot accents; colour 2 on the front slit panel; colour 3 on the band above the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cardboard_01.differs: The male version has a shorter, wider and boxier shin section.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A furry beast-foot covering for the right foot: a shaggy, tufted foot with a cloven hoof tip split in two, and small dewclaw-like spurs at the back of the ankle. Ends just above the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur; colour 1 on the split hoof tips and the rear dewclaws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A monstrous clawed foot covering: a short ankle-height sleeve of pebbled, reptilian hide with a ridge of overlapping scales across the top of the foot and four sharp curved talons at the toes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pebbled hide of the sole, heel and sides; colour 1 on the scaled plates across the top of the foot; colour 3 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.description: A low, smooth shoe that covers the foot and stops at the ankle, with a contrasting swooping trim band around the ankle opening and a curved slash accent on the side. Sleek superhero footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shoe body; colour 2 on the ankle trim band and the curved side accent.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.description: A close-fitting tights foot covering for the right foot, ending just above the ankle, with wavy abstract stripes that sweep from the ankle down over the toes. Reads as a plain skin-tight sock or sleek boot base.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the foot covering; colour 1 on the wavy stripes; colour 2 on the stripes between them.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.differs: The male version has a larger plain area across the top of the foot, with the stripes concentrated toward the toe and sides.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.description: A low, smooth ankle-high foot covering that wraps the whole right foot like a sleek bootie, with a small pointed V-shaped webbing accent at the ankle front and back. Suits a superhero or sci-fi tights look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot covering; colour 2 on the V-shaped webbing accents at the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.description: A right foot covering shaped like a low ankle sock-shoe, hugging the whole foot up to the ankle. Two thin bands circle the ankle and two contrasting stripes run from the ankle over the toe. Sporty, sleek look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot covering; colour 1 on the two ankle bands; colour 2 on the stripes running down the top of the foot.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Colossus_01.description: A monstrous right foot and lower-leg covering built from chunky cracked stone-like plates, rising to a calf-height point at the back and ending in large clawed talons at the toes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cracked stone plates; colour 3 on the crack lines between plates; colour 1 on the claws and the small spikes along the side.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Combatluchador_Dollar.description: A knee-high luchador-style wrestling boot with front lacing up the shin, a wide contrasting cuff at the top, a thick rimmed sole, and large dollar-sign graphics on the toe and along the outer calf.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Combatluchador_Dollar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff, laces and sole rim; colour 2 on the dollar-sign graphics and lace eyelets.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.description: A mid-calf combat boot with a chunky light shoe, a tall armored shin guard on the front with a raised knee-side plate, a rear calf panel and an ankle strap plate. Tactical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe and the leg fabric; colour 1 on the shin guard, rear calf plate and ankle strap plate; colour 2 on the sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.differs: The male version has a wider, bulkier shin guard that covers more of the front of the leg, and a chunkier shoe.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Combatsock_01.description: An ankle-high hiking boot with soft wrinkled leather uppers, a laced front opening, a flared collar and a thick chunky sole, worn over a ribbed sock cuff that rises above the top of the boot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Combatsock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the ribbed sock cuff; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.description: A mid-calf western cowboy boot with a pointed toe, a stacked heel and a scooped, pointed top edge with two pull tabs. Decorative stitched feather-like patterns run up the shaft, and a strap at the ankle carries a spiked spur.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top trim, ankle strap, heel and sole edge; colour 3 on the spur and its ankle buttons; colour 2 on the stitched line patterns.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.description: A western cowboy boot with a mid-calf shaft, pointed toe, stacked heel, V-dipped top edge with contrasting trim, two pull-straps and stitched flame-like decoration on the sides.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top trim, heel and sole edge; colour 2 on the stitching lines.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Basic_02.differs: The male boot has a shorter, wider shaft that ends at mid-calf.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Short_01.description: A short ankle-height western cowboy boot with a pointed toe and small stacked heel, wrapped by a wide contrasting ankle strap with a round concho and a spiked rowel spur extending from the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle strap, sole edge and heel; colour 3 on the spur, its rowel and the round concho.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Short_02.description: A short ankle-high cowboy boot with a smooth pointed toe, a low stacked heel and a small notched pull-tab detail at the top of the shaft. It sits on the right foot with a western feel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboy_Short_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper; colour 1 on the sole and heel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_01.description: A mid-calf cowboy-style boot with a smooth shaft, a long pointed toe and a small heel. A strap with a round stud circles the ankle, and swirling scroll patterns decorate the sides of the shaft.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the round stud at the ankle; colour 3 on the swirling scroll patterns and the lines around the shaft.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_02.description: A calf-high western-style boot with a pointed toe, swirling scroll patterns and thin lines along the shaft, a strap around the ankle with a round buckle, and a spiked spur wheel on the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 3 on the swirl and line decoration; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the spur and buckle.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_Short_01.description: A short ankle boot with a smooth, slightly pointed toe, a low stacked heel and a short cuff. A diagonal strap wraps the ankle and fastens at a round side disc, giving a robotic cowboy look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cowboyrobot_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and sole; colour 1 on the ankle strap; colour 2 on the round side discs.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cross_01.description: A smooth, snug mid-calf boot with a thick faceted cuff at the top, a contrasting toe cap, and a small cross-shaped mechanical plate mounted on a raised panel down the front of the shin.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cross_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top cuff and toe cap; colour 3 on the raised shin panel; colour 2 on the cross-shaped plate.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A right calf-high armoured boot with segmented plates over the toe and ankle, a thick flat sole, and a separate riveted shin and calf panel under a flared angular top cuff. Rugged sci-fi western look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and ankle plates; colour 3 on the shin and calf panels; colour 2 on the sole edge and small details; colour 1 on the small ankle studs.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A right ankle-high sneaker-style boot with a rounded toe cap, angular panelled ankle cuff with etched line details, a thick sole, and small dot accents on the toe. Sleek, futuristic sportswear look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap and heel panel edges; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the small dots on the toe.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cyberlord_01.description: A bulky, angular mechanical right boot shaped like a tapered armoured greave, with a banded ankle collar, small round side sensor lights and a forked, clawed toe. Suggests a monstrous cyborg or robotic style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cyberlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the greave shell and claw toes; colour 1 on the ankle band and a side strip; colour 3 on the round side lights; colour 2 on the heel tip.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: A low, split-toe cyberpunk boot on a chunky platform sole, with a wide ankle cuff, round mechanical discs on each side of the ankle and two separate angular toe caps. Sits on the right foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot upper and toe-top panels; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and toe caps; colour 2 on the sole and disc rims; colour 3 on the disc centres.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A right-leg cybernetic boot-legging: a fitted shin-length leg sleeve with a rimmed kneecap plate holding a round sensor node, plus a flat-soled ankle boot with strapped bands across the ankle and toe. Sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the leg sleeve; colour 0 on the boot upper and knee plate backing; colour 1 on the rims, straps, and sole; colour 3 on the round knee nodes and small accents.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.differs: The male boot has a low flat heel and an extra strap across the toe, unlike the female's raised heel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Defender_01.description: A right calf-high superhero boot with a smooth shaft, pointed winged flares at the top of the calf, and slashed accent cuts on the outer flare. It ends in a strapped, rubber-capped sneaker-style foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and flared cuff; colour 1 on the shoe upper and toe strap; colour 2 on the toe cap and sole; colour 3 on the slashed accents in the cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Deity_01.description: A low, chunky ankle shoe with a thick flat sole, a rounded toe cap, a separate side panel and a tall heel section. Simple, stylised and slightly cartoonish, it covers just the right foot and ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the heel and back panel; colour 3 on the toe cap.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A right mid-calf boot with a smooth fabric-like shaft, a peaked front edge and thin contrasting bands crossing the shin and running down the back. It ends in a pointed toe with a separate segmented toe plate.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 2 on the crossing bands and edge trim; colour 0 on the thin inner top lining.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Destroyer_01.differs: The male boot has a lower front peak and a larger, more clearly plated toe section.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A right mechanical armoured boot reaching just below the knee, with a smooth shin shell, a front strip of segmented plates, a flared pointed cuff studded with small spikes, and a segmented plated foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin shell and cuff; colour 1 on the segmented front strip and the foot plates; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1.description: A right calf-high boot with a smooth tapered shaft, a segmented ribbed panel down the front of the shin, a plated segmented toe, and a flared upturned cuff at the top studded with small spikes. Sci-fi armoured look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and flared cuff; colour 1 on the segmented shin panel and the toe section; colour 2 on the small spikes.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1_1.description: A right calf-high armoured boot in a sci-fi style, with a smooth shin shell, a segmented front strip, a segmented toe cap, and a flared top rim that peaks at the front with small spikes on each side.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01_1_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf shell and flared cuff; colour 1 on the segmented front strip and the boot foot; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A mechanical armored boot with a chunky octagonal cuff at the top of the shin, a curved front shin plate, a segmented ribbed panel down the calf, and a sturdy sneaker-style foot with lace-like bands and a contrasting sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, shin plate and boot upper; colour 0 on the ribbed calf panel and lace bands; colour 2 on the strap slots and rib lines; colour 3 on the sole edge.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Dharmor_01.differs: The male version has a shorter, bulkier cuff and shin plate, and a chunkier boot than the female version's slimmer one.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A cartoonish dinosaur-foot covering for the right foot: a puffy rounded paw with wrinkled creases, three curved claws at the toes, and a thick fluffy cuff around the ankle. Playful costume style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot body; colour 1 on the claws; colour 2 on the ankle cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Drka_01.description: A right-foot sandal greave: a plated shin guard with a raised curved front blade and open latticed back, held by padded ankle and calf straps, over an open sandal sole with clawed talons at the toes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plates and toe strap panel; colour 1 on the padded straps and sandal sole; colour 2 on the talons.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Dual_Claw_02.description: A bare-skinned, clawed beast foot for the right side: a wrinkled, rounded foot shape with two long curved talons pointing forward and outward, plus a small spur at the heel. Suits monstrous or bestial looks.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Dual_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skin-like foot and ankle; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Dual_Claw_03.description: A bare, skin-textured monstrous right foot with a short ankle cuff and two long curved talons at the toes, plus a few small spikes near the top of the foot. Reads as a beast or Halloween creature foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Dual_Claw_03.colourAreas: Skin colour is fixed and ignores the scheme; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.description: A knee-high gladiator-style sandal: a flat sole with toe and instep straps, and a cage of vertical and horizontal straps laced up the calf, with small rings at the top edge. Ancient, Egyptian-inspired look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole and straps; colour 1 on the small rings and connecting fasteners at the strap junctions.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_02.description: A flat gladiator-style sandal with a thin sole and several narrow straps crossing the instep, a strap band around the ankle, and a solid heel cup at the back. Egyptian-inspired and open-toed.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Egyptian_Sandal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole, straps and heel cup; colour 1 on the small ties at the ankle strap.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A calf-high retro-futuristic boot with a smooth plated shaft, grooved seam lines, a wide hexagonal top opening framed by contrasting edging, a flared fin on the outer side, and a chunky rounded toe.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft plates and sole; colour 1 on the toe cap, top rim and front trim; colour 2 on the groove lines.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.differs: The male boot has a wider, fuller shaft with a chunkier hexagonal top opening, where the female boot is slimmer and tapered.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A right boot with a chunky rounded foot and a ribbed shin guard strapped on behind by three straps. A studded toe plate and a spiky feather-like fringe at the top edge give it a sci-fi, monstrous look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the ribbed shin guard and the studded toe plate; colour 2 on the straps and sole stripes; colour 3 on the feather fringe at the top.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Feathers_02.description: A short ankle boot with a soft, puckered rounded shaft and a thick sole. A studded, dimpled plate sits over the instep, held by straps that wrap around the foot. Suggests a sci-fi or creature-inspired look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Feathers_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the dimpled instep plate; colour 2 on the straps and sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Feathers_02.differs: The male boot has wider straps that wrap over the instep in a sandal-like way, and the plate is larger.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A short, chunky ankle boot with a rounded toe, a thick sole with contrasting edge trim, a raised strap panel on the side, a padded heel block and a tall trimmed cuff with a vertical stripe. Sporty superhero style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the side strap panel and heel surround; colour 3 on the sole edge, cuff trim and stripe; colour 2 on the heel pad.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Flared_01.description: A right knee-high boot with a smooth, snug shaft and a low flat sole, closed by a thin seam running down the back and over the toe. The top is a flared cuff with pointed, upswept peaks. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the flared cuff; colour 2 on the seam line.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Flared_01.differs: The male boot is shorter and sturdier, with a wider foot and a seam that also runs over the toe.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Flipper_01.description: A single swim-fin style foot piece: a snug ankle sock with a contrasting foot pocket and a long flat splayed blade extending forward past the toes. Aquatic, playful look worn on the right foot only.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Flipper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle sock; colour 2 on the foot pocket opening; colour 1 on the fin blade and sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Flower_01.description: A right ankle boot with a smooth rounded foot and a flower-like starburst at the toe. Ankle bands hold a cuff of jagged, shard-like leaf panels that flare into spikes above the ankle. Fantasy nature-creature style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot foot and the spiky tips; colour 1 on the cuff panels, ankle bands and toe swirl; colour 2 on the leaf shards; colour 3 on the small accents and toe stripe.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Folded_01.description: A calf-length boot with a smooth shaft and a wide, faceted folded-over cuff at the top, showing a lining inside the rim. The toe has a separate contrasting cap. Suggests a pirate or fantasy look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Folded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and folded cuff; colour 1 on the toe cap and the inner lining at the top of the cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Folded_01.differs: The male boot has a shorter, chunkier cuff that sits lower on the shin, and the contrasting lining at the top is more visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Furlined_01.description: A soft, slouchy mid-calf boot in wrinkled cloth-like material with a rounded toe and a thick, folded-over cuff at the top. Sits below the knee and suggests a casual, superhero look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Furlined_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the folded top cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A calf-high armored right boot with a smooth plated shaft, dense clusters of cone spikes around the shin and calf, a pointed shin fin, strapped ankle bands and a long spiked toe. Gladiator-style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot plates; colour 1 on the top rim, ankle straps and sole edge; colour 3 on the spikes and studs; colour 2 on the toe spike, shin fin and heel block.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The male boot has more and larger spikes bristling around the whole shaft, including the front and back.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Glass_Shoe_01.description: A translucent glass-slipper style shoe for the right foot only: a low block heel, a squared pointed toe and a strap with buckle across the instep, with a faceted rim at the ankle. It shows the bare foot and toes through it.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Glass_Shoe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body, heel and strap; colour 1 on the toenails. The glossy glass material largely ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Glow_01.description: A low, ankle-high sneaker-style shoe with a textured dimpled surface, a large panel over the instep, a capped toe, round ankle discs and thin lines running along the sides in a Y pattern. Sporty, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoe body; colour 1 on the instep panel, toe cap, heel patch and ankle discs; colour 3 on the thin line details; colour 2 on the outlines around the panels.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Greave_01.description: A right-leg greave and low shoe: a smooth, tapered shin guard with a flared, scooped upper edge and thin rim, ending above the ankle, over a soft flat-soled shoe. Sleek, minimal armor look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Greave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the greave shell and rim; colour 1 on the shoe; colour 3 on the small tab outlines at the top and ankle of the greave back.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Harajuku_Boot_01.description: A calf-high right boot with a thick layered platform sole, an octagonal trimmed top edge, a zip running diagonally up the shin, and an ankle strap with a ring at the side. Casual, sporty street style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Harajuku_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top trim, ankle strap and diagonal piping; colour 3 on the platform sole; colour 2 on the zip pull.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A sleek sci-fi right boot with a rounded toe and a tall shin guard made of two flared side fins that rise from the ankle to the calf. Round disc pods sit at the ankle and on the fins, and a small round port is on the front.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot and the fin plates; colour 1 on the round disc pods at the ankle and on the fins; colour 2 on the small round port on the front.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The male boot has wider, more flared fins and a chunkier foot, with the ankle pods standing further out from the boot.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Hiboot_01.description: A right thigh-high boot in soft, slouchy material with gentle wrinkles down the leg, a flat thin sole and a rounded toe, finished with a thin contrasting edge at the top of the thigh.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Hiboot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the thin trim around the top opening; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi armoured boot with segmented plates, a rounded toe cap, strap bands across the shin, ankle and heel, and a small ring-shaped disc jutting from the outer upper edge. Sleek, futuristic and mechanical.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin and boot plates and the toe; colour 1 on the wrapping bands and accent panels; colour 2 on the strap pads and toe tip; colour 3 on the small inner accents at the top.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Hoof_01.description: A rounded, blocky hoof covering the right foot, with a cloth-like cuff at the ankle and a cloven split at the toe with small side notches. Smooth and monstrous, it suits beast or satyr costumes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Hoof_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle cuff and upper hoof; colour 1 on the lower hoof and toe cleft.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Hoof_01.differs: The male hoof has a wider cloven split with side notches, while the female hoof has a single deep cleft at the front toe.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi boot with a chunky octagonal cuff, padded ribbed tubes running down the front and sides, a panelled shin and heel, small strap bands, and a rounded bulky toe cap.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, strap bands and toe cap; colour 3 on the ribbed tubes; colour 2 on the inset shin and heel panels and the ankle joint; colour 0 on the main boot body and toe highlight.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Iceskates_01.description: An ankle-high lace-up figure skate with a padded cuff, criss-crossed laces, a chunky heel block, a star emblem on the side and a metal blade mounted under the sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Iceskates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and blade; colour 1 on the heel, sole edge and side panel; colour 2 on the laces; colour 3 on the star emblem and eyelet studs.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Jetboot_01.description: A chunky armored jet boot covering the foot and ankle, with an angular plated shell, a rounded front shin plate held by small studs, a wedge toe, and a swept fin on the outer side; a sci-fi mecha look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Jetboot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot's side and back plates and toe; colour 1 on the upper cuff and toe base; colour 2 on the fin, inner recess and top tab; colour 3 on the thin stripe accents.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Jetboot_01.differs: The male boot is wider and squatter, with a broader flared side wing and a larger, more open toe wedge.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Knight_01.description: A right-foot armored greave and sandal-like boot: a shin guard with a kneecap-style cap, edging trim, engraved diamond ornaments and two straps, over a mesh ankle section and a foot cover crossed by strap bands.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate, kneecap and foot cover; colour 1 on the edge trim, engraved ornaments and foot bands; colour 2 on the leg straps; colour 3 on the mesh ankle section.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Knight_01.differs: The male version has engraved diamond-shaped ornaments down the front of the shin plate, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.description: A bulky, ragged fur cuff around the right ankle, built from patchwork tufts of jagged fur in several contrasting panels, sitting loosely over the ankle. Suggests a beastly, festive-monster look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and inner fur tufts; colour 1 on the main fur and rim; colour 2 on the front fur patch; colour 3 on the outer side patch.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Krampus_Fur_01.differs: The male cuff is bulkier and more tattered, with patchwork panels including a contrasting one, rather than a neat band with a light fringe.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Krampus_Hoof_002.description: A single right-foot cloven hoof boot: a short furry ankle cuff with jagged tufts and a shaggy spiky collar, ending in a split contrasting hoof at the front. Monstrous, beast-like style, worn over the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Krampus_Hoof_002.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the cuff and tufts; colour 0 on the back and inner side fur and the top rim; colour 2 on the hooves and front fur patch; colour 3 on the side tuft.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Leech_01.description: A bare-looking right foot and ankle whose toes are replaced by a fan of long, tapering tentacle digits, splayed outward from the front of the foot. Gives a monstrous, alien creature-foot look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle and foot section (skin-toned in the default material); colour 1 on the tentacle tips, blending toward the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Leech_01.differs: The male version has around eight tentacles arranged in a tighter, more even fan, with a chunkier foot section.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.description: A low, slip-on ankle shoe with a smooth glossy upper, a scooped opening at the ankle, a contrasting welt band around the sole and a rounded reinforced toe cap. Worn on the right foot only.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoe upper; colour 1 on the band around the sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap, sole and ankle opening edge; colour 0 on the sock-like inner lining at the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_01.description: A plain, smooth, close-fitting calf-high boot for the right foot, with a rounded toe and a slightly angled top edge just below the knee. Simple superhero footwear with no visible seams or fastenings.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_01_1.description: A calf-high wrestling boot with a criss-cross lace-up front, a contrasting cuff band at the top, a rounded toe cap and a thin flat sole. Smooth and sporty, it covers the right foot and lower leg.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and toe cap; colour 1 on the top cuff band; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole and eyelets.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.description: A right mid-calf boot in a smooth, form-fitting superhero style, with a plain rounded toe, a contrasting panel across the ankle and shin, and a small contrasting heel panel at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and the upper shaft; colour 1 on the ankle and shin panel; colour 3 on the small heel panel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_Bo.description: A soft, smooth calf-high boot with a rounded toe, worn with a chunky armored cuff strapped around the shin. The cuff has raised horizontal ridges, a lower panel with recessed detail and open sides. Sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Armor_Blaster_Bo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot; colour 1 on the cuff shell and edges; colour 3 on the ridged bands and lower panel inserts.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.description: A tall, smooth, close-fitting right boot reaching below the knee, with a thin contrasting cuff at the top and a band of upright cylindrical canisters ringed around the calf on a metal frame. Suggests sci-fi gear.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and the canister frame; colour 1 on the sole edge and canister caps; colour 2 on the canister barrels; colour 3 on the cuff band.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.description: A plain, smooth right boot reaching just below the knee, with a wide straight shaft, a rounded foot and a V-shaped notch cut into the front of the top edge. Simple, sleek superhero footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; the top rim shows the same colour and no other slots are visible.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.differs: The male boot is shorter and looser, with a wider shaft that flares away from the calf and a shallower front notch.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boots.description: A cybernetic right boot: a mid-calf boot with a curved armour plate down the front of the shin, a wide band around the calf, bolts, hex nuts and looping contrasting cables. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boots.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body, bolts and nuts; colour 1 on the shin plate and the calf band; colour 2 on the cables and hoses; colour 3 on the thin accent lines on the plate.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Cybernetic_Boots.differs: The male version is a full boot covering the foot and lower leg, with the shin plate attached to it.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Deity_01.description: A mid-calf right boot with a thin contrasting sole and a rounded toe, wrapped in diagonal chevron bands up the shin with thin contrasting piping. It has a cloth-like look and a heel panel at the back.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the alternating shin bands, toe panel and rim; colour 1 on the other shin bands, toe cap and side panels; colour 3 on the heel panel and thin piping; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Edged_01.description: A plain, smooth calf-length boot with a straight shaft and a rounded toe. The top opening is a flat octagonal cut with no visible trim. Fits close to the leg in a simple superhero style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Edged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot, including the flat top opening.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Edged_01.differs: The male boot has a flat, unedged top opening with no separate rim.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Fins_01.description: A right calf-high boot with a smooth, plain shaft and rounded toe, topped by three swept-back, pointed fins along the outer side of the calf. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Fins_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the fins; no other slots visibly used.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Flared_01.description: A plain, smooth mid-calf boot with a rounded toe and a flared cuff whose top rises into a pointed, angled peak at the outer edge, with a scooped notch at the front. Superhero style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.description: A right-leg boot that rises to just below the thigh, with a flared, open top edge, a smooth front panel, contrasting side and back panels, small spikes along the outer edge, and a cuffed ankle over a rounded foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front of the leg and the foot; colour 1 on the side panel, ankle cuff and spikes; colour 2 on the back panel; colour 3 on a patch at the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.differs: The male boot is shorter, ending near the knee or just above it, with a wider flared top and larger, more widely spaced spikes.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.description: A single right-leg tight-fitting boot that rises to the knee or just above, made of multi-panel sections with an angled top edge, a soft contrasting-soled foot and an ankle band. Suggests a classic superhero look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shin panel and the foot; colour 1 on the side and back swooping panels and the ankle band; colour 2 on the rear calf panel and the top opening; colour 3 on a small patch at the back of the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.differs: The male boot is shorter, ending around the knee with a wider flared opening, and the foot is chunkier.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Golden_Age_01.description: A mid-calf superhero boot in smooth, slightly wrinkled cloth with a thin sole. The top has a heart-shaped opening with a raised, pointed front and back, edged in contrasting trim.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the top trim; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.description: A right-foot armoured boot reaching below the knee: a flared angular cuff at the top, layered plate segments down the shin, a banded ankle strap with rivets and a blunt rounded toe. Sci-fi gladiator styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cuff and ankle strap; colour 2 on the shin plates and toe cap; colour 0 on the lower calf section and upper sole; colour 3 on the sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Ironclad_01.differs: The male boot has a blunter, chunkier toe and a taller, more rounded top cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.description: A shin-length wrap covering the lower leg down to the ankle, leaving the foot and heel bare. Angular overlapping panels with slim contrasting trim lines and a slightly flared top give a martial look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main wrap panels; colour 2 on the trim lines and edging around the top and ankle opening.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.differs: The male wrap is shorter and bulkier, with a wider, folded-over top edge.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_01.description: A right shin and ankle wrap that runs from below the knee to the ankle, with angular overlapping panels and slashing trim lines. It leaves the heel and foot bare, and clawed toe tips extend from the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main wrap; colour 2 on the edge trim and the diagonal panel lines; colour 0 on the toe claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_02.description: A shin-length armoured greave for the right leg with scalloped, feather-like panels down the front, a contrasting inset strip at the side, a chunky ankle cuff, and a bare clawed foot with contrasting talons.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the greave shell and outer edges; colour 1 on the scalloped front panels and ankle cuff; colour 2 on the side inset strip and claws; colour 3 not visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.description: A smooth, calf-height right boot with a slightly flared top edge and a rounded toe. A broad, jagged lightning-bolt fin rises from the outer side of the shin, extending above the boot top. Superhero speedster style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the lightning bolt; the other colour slots are not visible.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.differs: The male lightning bolt is larger and broader with a clear zigzag shape, sitting more prominently on the shin than the female version's thin blade.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lycanarmor_01.description: A right calf-high boot with a smooth padded shaft, a separate plate down the front of the shin and a rounded plate over the toe, both riveted. contrasting straps with buckles cross the shin and ankle. Suits sci-fi armour looks.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Lycanarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 2 on the straps and sole; colour 3 on the rivets and buckles.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Maniacsarmor_01.description: A calf-high right boot with a smooth shaft, a separate front shin plate, two buckled straps and a skull-shaped toe cap studded with spikes. Mechanical, punk-styled and worn over the lower leg and foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Maniacsarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the shin plate and skull toe cap; colour 2 on the straps and sole; colour 3 on the spikes, buckle details and top edge of the shin plate.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Pointed_01.description: A plain, smooth right boot reaching just below the knee, with a snug calf and a tapered, elongated pointed toe. It has no visible seams or fastenings and sits directly over the foot and lower leg.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boot_.description: A mid-calf sci-fi power suit boot made of stacked segmented plates over the foot and shin, topped by a wide, angular cuff with a round emblem on the front outer side.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Power_Suit_Boot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented lower boot plates; colour 1 on the upper cuff; colour 2 on the ring around the emblem; colour 3 on the emblem centre.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.description: A right clawed beast-foot boot: a bare talon foot with three claws, topped by a layered segmented ankle cuff with a contrasting band and a jagged flared rim rising to a spike at the shin.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the clawed foot and the upper rim; colour 1 on the claw tips and rim edges; colour 2 on the layered ankle cuff; colour 3 on the band around the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_02.description: A right clawed boot covering the foot and lower shin: a bare-looking taloned foot with three sharp toe claws, a layered leather-like ankle wrap with a contrasting band, and a tall pointed flared cuff at the top.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Qularr_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and the cuff edge; colour 1 on the claw tips and cuff shading; colour 2 on the layered ankle wrap; colour 3 on the band at the ankle.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Roinesh_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a beast's paw: a snug, ankle-high sleeve over the foot with mottled streaky patterning and pointed claws extending from the toe tips. Suggests a monstrous or animal look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main foot surface; colour 1 on the streaky swirls and the claw tips; colour 2 on the flecks and streaks in the mottling.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Sandal_01.description: A gladiator-style strappy sandal with a thin flat sole, toe loop and crossing straps over the foot, a heel strap, and long laces criss-crossing up the calf to a wide cuff below the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the sole, toe and foot straps and the calf laces; colour 2 on the ankle strap and the top calf cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_01.description: A tribal sandal boot for the right foot: a calf-high patterned cuff with triangle and diamond motifs, long dangling fringe strands over the ankle and instep, and a flat thong sandal sole with toe strap.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Sandaloverlay_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff body, toe strap and fringe; colour 2 on the triangle and band patterns and fringe tips; colour 0 on the sandal sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Spiked_01.description: A smooth, plain calf-high boot for the right foot with a rounded toe and a straight top edge below the knee. Three curved spines sweep outward from the outer side of the calf.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the spines; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Tribalwrap_Sover.description: A tribal open-toed foot wrap: criss-crossed straps wound up the ankle, a strap band across the instep and heel, and a ragged fringed cuff of shredded strips around the lower shin, with pointed claw tips on the toes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Tribalwrap_Sover.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrapped straps, instep bands and the top cuff band; colour 2 on the shredded fringe; colour 0 on the toe claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Viperps_01.description: A heavy, mid-calf sci-fi armored boot with a rim at the top, large rounded calf plates, a ribbed vertical shin strip, a strapped ankle joint and a chunky segmented toe cap with separate plates.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shell, cuff rim and toe cap; colour 1 on the calf plates, ankle plates and toe plates; colour 2 on the inner ribbed panel and gaps.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.description: A mid-calf superhero boot with a flared, angled top and a rounded, chunky toe. A bat-like membrane wing with a spike sits on the outer side of the shaft, projecting outward and back.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot and the wing; no other slots are visible on this sheet.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.differs: The male boot is shorter, ending at mid-calf, and its wing is larger and more clearly bat-like, hanging lower at the back of the outer side.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.description: A tattered, mid-calf boot with a soft, close-fitting shaft splattered with stains and worn patches, and a thin contrasting sole. Bloodied toe and exposed mechanical bits at the front suggest a zombie look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the sole edge; colour 3 on the toe area and stain splotches; colour 2 on the small mechanical detail at the toe.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A bare beast-like right foot with a thick, low-poly paw shape, an arched top and four long curved claws at the toes. It replaces the foot at the ankle, giving a werewolf look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the fur-skin foot takes a skin tone that does not follow the colour slots.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A right-foot ankle-high patchwork bootie made of stitched cloth panels, with a rounded toe cap and chunky rag-doll stitching across the seams. Jester-like and whimsical, sitting snugly around the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the bootie; colour 1 on the toe cap; colour 3 on the heel patch; colour 2 on the stitches.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Madjester_01.differs: The male version puts the large contrasting patch on the heel and back of the ankle, with no patch on the instep.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Madjester_02.description: A right mid-calf boot with a chunky rounded toe and thick platform sole, an angular panelled shaft edged with contrasting trim, and two buckled straps wrapped around the ankle and lower calf.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and sole; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 2 on the edge trim and panel outlines; colour 3 on the small round studs on the straps.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Malvan_01.description: A single right armored boot reaching to just below the knee: a segmented shin guard over an ankle band, with a chunky toe cap studded with small spikes. Sci-fi, mechanical styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Malvan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 1 on the side panels, ankle cuff and toe accents; colour 2 on the lower shin band and ankle strap; colour 3 on small trim at the ankle and knee edge.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A soft, calf-high cloth boot with a smooth, sock-like shaft that gradually shifts in tone toward the foot, ending in a pointed toe with a thin contrasting sole and a small notched toe cap.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shaft, fading into colour 0 on the lower shaft and foot; colour 2 on the sole; colour 0 on the toe trim.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Mechanon.description: A mechanical right foot piece: a taloned robotic boot with a flat cuff at the ankle, round side joints, a blocky heel and layered angular plates over the foot ending in long clawed toe spikes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle joints, upper plates and claw tips; colour 1 on the heel block and toe casings; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and inner plates; colour 3 on the ankle band and toe accents.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Mechanon.differs: The male version sits flatter with a lower heel and claws extending forward along the ground.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Monster_01.description: A bare monstrous right foot with a skin-like surface, three long curved talons at the toes and a smaller claw at the heel, with small bony ridges on top. Sits directly over the foot, suggesting a beast or creature look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws and the small ridges on top of the foot; colour 1 on the bands where the claws join the toes; the foot skin ignores the colour scheme and keeps its own tone.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Nighthawk_02.description: A right boot with a rounded armored shin guard and a knee-high plated cuff, layered ankle straps, a segmented plated instep, a mesh-textured sole area, and contrasting clawed talons projecting from the toe. Suggests a mechanical beast-like look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Nighthawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin guard, ankle band and instep plates; colour 1 on the mesh boot body and sole; colour 2 on the shin guard's inner backing and the toe claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.description: A spiked armored greave for the right lower leg: a flared angular cuff with curved blade-like spines at the knee, tapering to a long pointed plated shin guard that extends past the foot. Sinister, mechanical look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, spines and edge trim; colour 1 on the segmented shin plates and back panel; colour 3 on the accent inlays under the cuff; colour 2 on the inner cavity.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.description: A right-foot armored boot-guard with segmented banded plates running down the shin to a pointed toe, a jagged cuff at the top, and long curved blades flaring outward and up from the ankle. Suits a monstrous fantasy look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rims, cuff and curved blades; colour 1 on the banded shin and heel plates; colour 3 on the inner trim strips and cuff lining; colour 2 on the inner opening and heel tip.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Nightmare_Bladed_02.differs: The male version has wider blades that flare out sideways from a broader cuff, rather than sweeping up along the calf.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ninjaboots_01.description: A right-foot tabi-style ninja boot: a soft split-toe sock foot with a short, slightly tapered wrapped shin cuff with ridged, layered bindings and an open octagonal top, sitting at the lower calf.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ninjaboots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the split-toe foot; colour 1 on the wrapped shin cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_None_01.description: An effectively empty right-foot piece: only a tiny flat patch appears at the ankle, and no boot, sock or covering is visible. It leaves the foot bare and is meant as a blank option.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: No visible features take a colour slot; the tiny patch at the ankle is too small to tell.
