Male/M_Footr_Tight_Norse_01.description: A shaggy fur boot with a ragged fur cuff at the top, a fur-covered foot, and contrasting straps criss-crossing over the shin and wrapping the ankle. Chunky, tribal, wintry look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Norse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the boot and cuff; colour 2 on the crossing straps and ankle band.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Norse_01.differs: The male boot has a shorter, chunkier shaft, with the straps crossing over a smaller area of the shin.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Padding.description: A right-leg tactical armor set: a chunky low boot with a banded ankle cuff, segmented shin plates with a contrasting strap section, and a large rounded knee or calf guard. Sci-fi, mechanical look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot and the main shin plates; colour 1 on the ankle cuff and the plate edges and bands; colour 2 on the strap band and the rounded calf guard; colour 3 on the heel panel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Padding.differs: The male boot is chunkier, with a larger contrasting heel panel and a guard that sits on the outer side of the shin.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Patterned_01.description: A mid-calf superhero boot with a smooth rounded foot and a rigid shin guard. A pointed front panel and a separate back panel are outlined in contrasting trim, with a flared top opening.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin and calf panels; colour 1 on the foot and the pointed inset at the top and front; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Paw_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like an animal paw: a chunky low-poly boot ending just above the ankle, with rounded toe pads and four curved claws at the front. Suggests a beast or monster look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Paw_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main paw body, with a mottled texture; colour 1 on the toe pads; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pegleg_01.description: A crude peg-leg prosthetic for the right lower leg: a faceted, tapered cup that cradles the shin, ending in a thin straight peg in place of the foot. Weathered, mottled surface suggests a rough pirate or mechanical look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pegleg_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cup, with mottled darker weathering; colour 0 on the peg.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pegleg_01.differs: The male cup is wider with a more uneven, chipped-looking rim and a visibly hollow opening.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Persian_01.description: A right-foot gladiator-style sandal with a thin flat sole, a wide ankle cuff, a central strap along the instep and three broad straps wrapping across the top of the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole; colour 1 on the wide crossing foot straps; colour 2 on the ankle cuff and the central instep strap.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Persian_01.differs: The male sandal has a light-coloured sole and three broad straps across the foot, instead of two thin ones.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A right pirate-style boot reaching just below the knee, with a wide folded-over cuff edged in contrasting trim and a small gem on the front, a soft slouched shaft, and a pointed toe on a thin sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and upper shaft; colour 1 on the lower boot and toe; colour 2 on the cuff edging and sole; colour 3 on the small gem.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A right pirate-style boot reaching below the knee, with a wide folded-over cuff with vertical stripe panels, three buckled straps down the shin, and a pointed toe cap on a thin sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the three straps; colour 3 on the buckle frames; colour 2 on the cuff stripes, toe cap and sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.description: A right knee-high pirate boot in soft cloth with a wide folded-over cuff, a strap with a square buckle below the knee, a thin cord running down to a contrasting ankle band, and a pointed reinforced toe cap.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and cuff; colour 1 on the strap below the knee; colour 2 on the ankle band, toe cap and cuff edging; colour 3 on the buckle outline and small cord studs.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Point_01.description: A mechanical right lower-leg guard that tapers to a long blade-like point below the foot, with a rounded cuff at the top, contrasting inset side panels and small light strips. Reads as a sci-fi armoured greave.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Point_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front shell and point; colour 1 on the top cuff and side edging; colour 2 on the recessed side panels; colour 3 on the small light strips.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pointed_01.description: A short, plain ankle boot with a smooth, sock-like fit and a long tapering pointed toe. It rises just above the ankle on the right foot and has a simple, minimal style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Pointed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Power_01.description: A segmented armored shin guard for the right leg, with a pointed emblem plate over the knee, banded plates wrapping the calf and a layered, stepped plated toe cap over the foot. Rugged fantasy-mechanical look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the calf plates and toe plates; colour 1 on the central shin strip; colour 3 on the knee emblem plate; colour 2 on the plate edges and lower back of the boot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Power_01.differs: The male version has a fuller layered toe cap covering the front of the foot, while the female version has a shorter ankle section with a smaller toe plate.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Punk_01.description: A chunky low-cut sneaker-boot with a rounded bulbous toe, a thin flat sole, criss-cross lacing up the front and a thick rolled padded cuff at the ankle. Casual, skate-punk footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body; colour 1 on the rolled ankle cuff; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.description: A mid-calf punk boot with a flared, folded-over cuff, a smooth panelled shaft and a chunky studded toe cap. Flat low heel, with separate panels and clusters of pyramid studs at the toe and heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, toe cap edge and sole; colour 1 on the upper shaft and foot panels; colour 2 on the middle shaft; colour 3 on the side panel of the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Punk_Boots_01.differs: The male boot is shorter and chunkier with a flat, low heel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01.description: A right foot cover shaped like a clawed creature foot: a furry-looking toe section with two pointed front claws, and a short segmented ankle cuff with an angled contrasting panel across the front. Alien, beastly style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Qularr_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furry foot; colour 1 on the claw tips; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the angled panel on the cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Radical_01.description: A low, ankle-high sock-like foot covering for the right foot, hugging the shoe shape with a textured toe and heel section and a smooth contrasting panel up the front and inner ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Radical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the textured toe, sole and heel section; colour 0 on the smooth front and ankle panel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Rave_01.description: A single knee-high striped stocking with a snug, slightly slouched fit, a contrasting trim band at the top edge and a rounded sneaker-like sole and toe cap at the foot. Playful rave or punk styling for the right leg.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide stripes and the shoe upper; colour 2 on the stripes and the sole; colour 3 on the thin stripes; colour 1 on the top trim band.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A calf-high tribal sandal-boot with an open toe and a smooth shaft laced up the front and back with criss-crossing straps. A jagged toothed rim and a fringed, patterned cuff sit at the top.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and toe panels; colour 1 on the criss-cross straps, sole edge and cuff fringe panels; colour 3 on the inner cuff and cuff zigzag details; colour 2 on the toothed rim.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A low, smooth ankle boot for the right foot with a thin flat sole, a separate cuff panel at the ankle and a contrasting stripe running from the cuff over the top of the toe. Sleek, sporty sci-fi footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the boot; colour 1 on the sole; colour 2 on the ankle cuff; colour 3 on the stripe over the top.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Retroscifi_Boot_01.description: A right sci-fi boot with a rounded, bulbous toe cap and a straight, slightly tapered calf-high shaft. Round side discs sit at the ankle and a thin contrasting sole edge runs around the foot. Sleek retro-futuristic look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Retroscifi_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaft and toe cap; colour 1 on the sole edge and the inner face of the shaft; colour 2 on the ankle discs; colour 3 on the centre of the ankle discs.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.description: A robotic right foot armor: an angular ankle-high shell with panel lines and glowing slots, a contrasting band with a round joint at the ankle, and long flat blade-like fins extending forward from the toe and up the heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ankle shell; colour 1 on the toe blades and heel fin; colour 2 on the ankle band and joint; colour 3 on the slots and panel seams.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Robot_Foot_01.differs: The male toe blades lie flat along the ground like a wide pointed sole, rather than angling steeply downward as on the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.description: A right calf-high mechanical boot made of angular plated sections, with two tall blade-like fins rising at the top edge, a rounded toe cap, round side joint discs and a thin rimmed sole. Samurai-inspired sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sole rim, the back shell and the top cuff; colour 1 on the toe cap and the main front and side plates; colour 2 on the upper front panel, the fins and the ankle band; colour 3 on the inner strip along the back of the leg.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Rocker_01.description: A tall, plain leather-look boot with a soft, slightly slouched shaft reaching below the knee, rounded toe and a thin flat sole. Casual, rock-inspired footwear worn over the foot and lower leg.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot upper; colour 0 on the thin sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Rocker_01.differs: The male boot is taller, reaching higher up the calf, and has a thin flat sole instead of a raised heel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Rollerblade_01.description: A right inline skate: a padded, lace-up ankle boot with two chunky buckled straps, a rounded toe cap and a raised cuff, mounted on a frame carrying a single row of wheels under the sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Rollerblade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, toe cap, sole edge and heel band; colour 1 on the boot upper and padded cuff lining; colour 3 on the straps, wheel frame and rivets; colour 2 on the laces.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A right-leg covering from upper thigh to foot: a smooth fitted leg with a rounded panel at the thigh, layered angular armoured plates around the knee and shin with a jewel accent, banded ankle cuffs, and a pointed boot with a small heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg and boot; colour 1 on the thigh panel, trim edges and knee plate highlights; colour 2 on the knee plates and ankle bands; colour 3 on the knee gem.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Sacred_01.differs: The male boot has a lower block heel and a longer, sharply pointed toe than the female.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.description: A right-foot samurai armor boot with a plated shin guard, curved horn-like flares at the sides of the calf, layered ankle plates and a long upturned pointed toe. Two thin straps circle the shin and ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin back, sole and outer plate edges; colour 1 on the thin edge trim; colour 3 on the swirl-patterned front panels and toe; colour 2 on the straps.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.differs: The male boot has a longer, more sharply curved toe point and shorter, wider calf flares than the female boot.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_01.description: Japanese geta-style sandal: a flat rectangular wooden platform raised on two chunky cross-blocks, with a thong strap between the toes and a split-toe sock covering the foot. Sits under the right foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the split-toe sock; colour 1 on the wooden platform and blocks; colour 2 on the thong strap.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_Skin_0.description: A bare-foot geta sandal: a flat wooden board raised on two chunky cross blocks, held by a thin thong strap between the toes. Sits under the right foot with the toes and skin left exposed, in a traditional Japanese style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Samurai_Sandal_Skin_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wooden platform and blocks; colour 2 on the thong strap; colour 0 on the toenails; the foot skin ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_01.description: A calf-high sci-fi boot with a broad contrasting cuff, horizontal ridged bands up the shaft, a rounded sole edge, and a row of small cone spikes along the outer side of the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Sciencegroupdread_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the top cuff and sole edge; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the spike bases and ridge shading.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A mid-calf sci-fi soldier boot with a segmented armoured cuff below the knee, a panelled shin and a chunky rounded toe cap. Round joint studs sit at the ankle. A small clip or holster nub is on the cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin and foot panels; colour 1 on the cuff plates, shin stripes and ankle studs; colour 2 on the front cuff panel and toe cap; colour 3 on small accents at the top of the cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.differs: The male boot has a chunkier, shorter-looking shin and a bulkier foot than the female one.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Secret_01.description: A chunky high-top casual sneaker with a thick rounded sole, laced front, padded collar, contrasting toe cap and side panels, and a small pull loop at the heel. Sits over the right foot and ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar, heel and side overlays; colour 1 on the main upper; colour 2 on the toe cap and laces; colour 3 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Secret_02.description: A short ankle boot with a rounded toe cap, stitched seams, a chunky thick sole, a pull tab at the heel and a laced front with a contrasting tongue. Casual, street-style footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and stitched trim; colour 1 on the tongue; colour 3 on the laces; colour 2 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Secret_03.description: A low-cut casual sneaker with laced front, padded tongue, a rounded toe cap, side overlay panels, a heel tab and a thin flat sole, plus a short ribbed ankle sock cuff showing above the collar.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toe cap, side overlays, heel tab and tongue top; colour 1 on the main upper and laces area panels; colour 2 on the sole; colour 3 on the sock cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Secret_04.description: A mid-calf lace-up boot with a rounded reinforced toe cap, a chunky flat sole, criss-cross front lacing with eyelets, and two buckled straps wrapped around the shaft. A casual, sporty street look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and toe cap; colour 1 on the laces and straps; colour 3 on the eyelets and strap buckles; colour 2 on the sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Secret_04.differs: The male boot has a shorter shaft that ends at mid-calf.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A mid-calf right boot with a flat, pointed toe, a wide cuff at the top and a swept-back fin spike at the heel. Angular patchwork panels give it a sleek, sporty superhero look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, toe cap, sole and heel fin; colour 1 on the main boot body; colour 2 on the glossy angular panel down the front and side; colour 3 on a small panel near the top of the boot.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shinguard_Mechanon_00.description: A mechanical left shin guard made of angular, layered plates with sharp fin-like spikes flaring from the calf and shin, a wrapping band around the lower leg, and narrow contrasting strips running down toward the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shinguard_Mechanon_00.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin plates and spiky fins; colour 1 on the curved side and calf panels; colour 2 on the inner strips and lower prongs; colour 3 on the wrap band and the small tip accents.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shinguard_Mechanon_02.description: A mechanical shin and calf guard for the right leg: angular layered plates with sharp pointed fins at the sides, a wrap band behind the calf, and thin dangling rods near the ankle. A robotic, monstrous armour look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shinguard_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main angular plates and spikes; colour 1 on the curved inner plates and side panels; colour 3 on the back band and small accents near the ankle; colour 2 on the lower rods and plate segments.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shinthick_01.description: A single right-foot boot with a thick, smooth shin guard that rises to a raised angular edge at the front and back, with a rounded toe cap and a seam across the instep. Sits mid-calf, in a clean superhero style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shinthick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole boot, including shin plate, toe cap and sole; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.description: A low, closed colonial-style shoe with a smooth upper, flat sole and a wide strap across the instep fastened with a square buckle. Sits on the right foot, ending at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe body and instep strap; colour 2 on the buckle (metal look).
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shoe_Buckle_01.differs: The male shoe is flat-soled with a longer, more pointed toe and no raised heel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shoecasual_01.description: A casual low-top sneaker for the right foot with a laced front, striped side panels, a contrasting toe and heel patch, and a thick sole, worn with a short ribbed sock cuff at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shoecasual_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoe upper and sole; colour 1 on the toe edge, side stripes, laces and sole trim; colour 2 on the heel patch and stripe outlines; colour 3 on the sock cuff.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shoesock_01.description: A casual low-top sneaker with a ribbed tube sock that rises to mid-calf. The sock has horizontal stripe bands at the top, and the shoe has laces, side stripes and a thick sole. Casual sporty look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Shoesock_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the sock; colour 1 on the sock stripe band, shoe side stripes and sole edge; colour 0 on the shoe body and laces; colour 2 on the thin sock stripes and shoe heel and trim.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Simian_01.description: A shaggy, ragged leg covering for the right lower leg: a tapering fur-like sleeve with a torn hole at the front of the shin and a jagged, tattered hem, ending above bare ape-like toes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Simian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper part of the leg covering, fading to colour 2 toward the ragged hem; the hole shows the body beneath.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Skull_01.description: A monstrous right boot in an organic, sculpted style: a tapering shin sleeve topped by a skull-like armored cap with glowing eyes and long swept spikes, with clawed armored plates at the toe and heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot sleeve; colour 0 on the skull cap, toe and heel plates; colour 2 on the engraved lines and spike edges; colour 3 on the eyes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Skull_01.differs: The male version has a longer forward-pointing toe claw and a long spike sweeping forward from the skull cap, extending further out than on the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Snake_01.description: A scale-textured right boot reaching mid-calf, with a chunky segmented armored foot plate, a flared cuff at the top, a glossy oval plate on the outer calf and a pointed fin-like spike rising behind the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled calf; colour 1 on the foot plates and top cuff; colour 2 on the glossy calf plate; colour 3 on the spike.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The male boot has a bulkier, wider armored foot and a larger calf plate.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Sneakers_Gear_01.description: A chunky high-top sneaker for the right foot with a padded ankle cuff, criss-cross laces, a glossy rounded toe cap, a thick treaded lug sole and a small gear-shaped emblem on the outer side.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Sneakers_Gear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the canvas upper; colour 3 on the laces; colour 0 on the toe cap and the gear emblem; colour 2 on the chunky sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A right calf-high superhero boot with a panelled shaft, a raised contrasting-trim band around the top with a front cutout, a central stripe running down to a rounded toe cap, and a chunky sole.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shaft panels; colour 1 on the inner stripe accents; colour 3 on the top band, front trim stripe and sole edge; colour 2 on the toe cap and heel patch.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Socrates_01.differs: The male boot is shorter and stubbier, with a blunter rounded toe than the female one.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Space_01.description: A low, chunky futuristic shoe for the right foot with a thick rimmed sole, a short padded ankle cuff, and a wide flap strapped across the instep with a separate cross band. Sleek sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shoe body; colour 1 on the sole rim, collar edge and small tabs; colour 3 on the instep flap; colour 0 on the ankle cuff and cross strap.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_01.description: A right-leg Spartan greave sandal: a curved shin plate with a contrasting rim, criss-crossing straps wrapping the calf and ankle, and a flat open sandal with toe straps over the foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate; colour 1 on the plate rim; colour 2 on the straps and sandal sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_03.description: A Greco-Roman gladiator sandal with a shin greave: a lion-head guard sits at the top of the shin, a Greek-key patterned plate runs down the leg, and straps cross the calf, ankle and foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate; colour 1 on the lion head, the greave edging and the key-pattern border; colour 2 on the sandal straps and calf straps.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Spartansandal_03.differs: The lion head sits lower and flatter against the front of the shin, and the greave is shorter, with criss-crossing calf straps.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A right boot that reaches mid-calf, with a rough organic, bone-like surface, a ragged jagged upper rim and rows of small raised nodules. A long curved horn sweeps up and back from the outer side of the shin.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot body and toe; colour 1 on the nodules and bands across the surface; colour 2 on the curved horn.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steampunk_01.description: A right ankle boot of mechanical steampunk design: a short shaft with a chunky octagonal cuff, riveted side panels, a strap across the instep, and a large cog-shaped fastener on each side of the ankle. A studded sole edge finishes it.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, toe cap and outer side panels; colour 1 on the shaft and sole edge; colour 2 on the instep strap and toe plate; colour 3 on the cogs and rivets.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.description: A mechanical armoured boot for the right foot: a segmented plated shin guard with a pointed, layered toe cap, a raised angular spike at the front top, and ridged vent slits on the calf. Sci-fi, robotic look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin and toe plates; colour 2 on the front spike and ankle blocks; colour 1 on the calf vent slits; colour 3 on the small markings on the shin.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A right mechanical armored boot with a flared angular cuff at the shin, layered plates over the ankle and instep, and a chunky reinforced toe cap. A round knob sits at the outer ankle; suits a sci-fi commando look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, boot body and sole plates; colour 1 on the ankle and toe panels; colour 2 on the toe cap, shin plates and side knob.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_01.description: A mid-calf right boot with a smooth angular shaft, a flat octagonal cap at the top, layered wraps around the ankle, a long pointed talon-like toe, and a small fan of blade-like fins on the outer side of the calf.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 3 on the top cap, ankle bands and thin edge trim; colour 1 on the side fins; colour 2 on the pointed toe tip.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_01.differs: The male toe tip extends further forward into a long, flat blade-like point.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_0.description: A mid-calf right boot covered in overlapping feather-scale plating, with a trimmed cuff that peaks at the back and a smooth armored foot ending in sharp talon-like claws at the toes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather-scale shaft; colour 1 on the cuff, cuff peak and foot edging; colour 2 on the foot plate; colour 3 on the talons.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Superlong_01.description: A knee-high boot with a loose, wide shaft and a separate lower foot section, joined by a curved band at the shin. Trim edges the top and toe, with small gem-like studs across the toe and on the cuff, and a low block heel.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Superlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper shaft; colour 0 on the lower foot and heel section; colour 1 on the trim around the top, the band and the toe edge; colour 3 on the gem-like studs.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Superlong_01.differs: The male boot is a looser knee-high with a separate lower foot section and jewelled toe trim, while the female version is a tight thigh-high lace-up.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.description: A bare-foot, organic skin-tight covering that runs from a jagged, split-edged rim below the knee down over the calf and foot, ending in a row of pointed claw-like toe tips. Suggests a symbiote or monstrous look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower leg; colour 1 on the upper calf, fading into colour 0 lower down; colour 3 on the toe claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Long_02.description: A right foot covering shaped like a bare monstrous foot, with organic wrinkled skin-like texture, a tall ankle-to-calf cuff ending in jagged split points, and five long pointed claws at the toes.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot and lower part; colour 1 fades in over the upper cuff; colour 3 on the toe claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Short_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a bare monstrous foot, smooth and slightly wrinkled, rising to the ankle and ending in a row of five long pointed claws at the toes. Suggests a beastly or symbiote look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Symbiote_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foot covering; colour 3 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Tech3toes_01.description: A mechanical armoured boot covering the right foot and lower shin: a bulky rounded shin guard with vented slats at the back, a perforated front insert, and a chunky three-toed clawed foot with a wide base.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Tech3toes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin armour shell; colour 1 on the perforated front panel and the toe tips; colour 2 on the toe and ankle blocks; colour 3 on the thin seam lines and the back vents.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Tech3toes_Warlord_01.description: A bulky mechanical right boot with a chunky, angular armoured shin shell carved with a face-like relief and small rung-like clips at the side, ending in a three-toed clawed foot with hazard-striped edges.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Tech3toes_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin shell and back plating; colour 1 on the three-toed foot and the side clips; colour 2 on the hazard stripes at the toe edges; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Teddy_01.description: A right-foot covering shaped like a chunky furry animal paw: a shaggy, shapeless foot with a thin trim band at the ankle and three rounded toe pads at the front. Suits beast or costume looks.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur of the foot; colour 1 on the thin ankle band; colour 3 on the rounded toe pads, fading into the fur.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Thick_01.description: A plain, smooth right boot with a thick, slightly tapered shaft and a rounded toe. It reaches to just below the knee and has an open top, with no visible seams, straps or fastenings.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.description: A mechanical armoured boot with a smooth shin plate, a padded cuff at the top studded with pointed spikes, a separate strapped ankle band, and a rounded low toe cap with small spikes. Sits below the knee.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shin plate and toe cap; colour 1 on the spiked top cuff; colour 2 on the ankle band; colour 3 on the spikes and small studs.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Trunk_01.description: A monstrous right foot shaped like a tentacled, tree-trunk stump, with a swirling marbled surface, curled tendrils around the top and long clawed talon-like toes splaying downward. Sits at the foot and ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Trunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the marbled swirl pattern of the body; colour 1 on the top cap, the swirl bands and the tendrils; colour 3 on the claw tips and tendril tips.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.description: A calf-high anime-style boot with a faceted, angular shaft, a flared padded cuff at the top, a separate band panel at mid-calf, and a wrapped strap over the instep leading to a soft rounded toe.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff, toe cap, heel and side shaft; colour 1 on the front shaft panels, instep wrap and foot; colour 2 on the mid-calf band; colour 3 on the back calf panel and small toe accents.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Urban_Boot_01.description: A mid-calf urban boot with a smooth, slightly flared shaft, a rounded toe, a thin contrasting sole, and two buckled straps around the calf. Casual, sporty footwear that sits over the foot and lower leg.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Urban_Boot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body; colour 1 on the two calf straps; colour 2 on the strap buckles; colour 3 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A right lower-leg and foot wrap: a smooth shin sleeve rising from the ankle with stacked, swept-back angular fins at the top, a strap under the arch, and clawed toe tips on the bare foot.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shin sleeve and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the fin edges, strap bands and toe claws; colour 2 on the small inserts at the fin bases; colour 3 on the faint fine lines along the sleeve.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Vikorin_01.differs: The male version is shorter and wider at the ankle, with a bulkier segmented cuff at the back and a contrasting gradient across the toes.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Vine_01.description: A right-foot boot of twisting, vine-like organic growth: swirling ridged bands wrap the foot and lower calf, with curled tendrils and sharp thorn tips at the toe, heel and flared top cuff.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff top and the raised swirling vine bands; colour 0 on the recessed base between the swirls; colour 3 on the thorn tips and tendril ends.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Vine_01.differs: The male boot is shorter and chunkier, with fewer tendrils and larger curled hooks at the top and toe.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Viperia_01.description: A right knee-high boot with a contrasting shaft reaching just below the thigh, cobra-head shaped panels on the knee and shin, and a low-heeled contrasting lower boot with a contrasting toe cap and thin trim at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Viperia_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the boot shaft; colour 1 on the knee and shin panels, top edge and toe cap; colour 0 on the lower boot and heel; colour 3 on the thin trim at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Viperia_01.differs: The male boot has a low blocky heel and a shorter, rounder toe, with a looser shaft.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Viperlogo_01.description: A right armored flat-soled boot with segmented ribbed calf plates, a spiked flared cuff at the top, a wide toe with side spikes, and a chunky sole; it suggests a bulky sci-fi look.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented calf plates; colour 1 on the top cuff, toe, sole and spikes; colour 2 on the inner boot opening; colour 3 on the heel panel and small back markings.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Viperlogo_01.differs: The male boot has a flat sole and a broader, blunter toe, without the raised heel of the female version.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Winged_01.description: A short ankle boot with a flat sole, contrasting trim outlines and a buckled strap across the instep, with a pair of feathered wings rising up and back from the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot body and the wing feathers; colour 1 on the trim outlines and the cuff edge; colour 3 on the instep strap and the sole; colour 2 on the wing edge feathers.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Winged_01.differs: The male boots are short ankle boots with a flat sole and two upright wings with contrasting-tipped feathers; the female boots are taller with a heel.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01.description: A lace-up wingtip brogue with perforated toe cap and contrasting panels and sole, worn with a ribbed calf-high sock held up by a thin ring garter with straps. Retro dapper style.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shoe body and heel; colour 0 on the toe cap and side panels; colour 3 on the laces, sole edge, garter ring and small sock buttons; colour 2 on the ribbed sock.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01_Gl.description: A lace-up wingtip brogue with a thick sole and decorative toe panels, paired with a tall ribbed sock reaching mid-calf, held by a thin garter strap with a small button. Dapper, retro formal footwear.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Wingtipwithsock_01_Gl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wingtip toe and heel panels; colour 1 on the mottled shoe body; colour 2 on the sole, laces and ribbed sock; colour 3 on the garter strap, button and speckled patterning.

Male/M_Footr_Tight_Wizards_01.description: A single right leg covering: a loose, wrinkled trouser leg gathered over a soft short boot with a flared cuff, topped by a wide band of geometric key-pattern trim with a glossy peaked edge at the upper thigh.
Male/M_Footr_Tight_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baggy trouser leg; colour 1 on the boot; colour 2 on the glossy peaked top edge and the pattern band background; colour 0 on the pattern band detailing.

Male/M_Footr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A right foot covering shaped like a clawed monstrous foot: a rounded heel block with a segmented, angular plated top over the instep, rivets along the side, and a row of pointed claws at the toes.
Male/M_Footr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plated top of the foot; colour 3 on the heel and toe section; colour 1 on the claws; colour 0 on the small toe plate.

Male/M_Footr_Toy_01.description: A calf-high right boot in a chunky retro toy style, with a rounded toe, thin sole rim, a thick folded cuff at the top, a band below the cuff, and a side panel with two round button-like knobs.
Male/M_Footr_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the boot body; colour 0 on the sole rim and the band beneath the cuff; colour 2 on the top cuff and the side panel edging; colour 3 on the round knobs.

Male/M_Footr_Toy_02.description: A single right boot rising to just below the knee, with a rounded toe, a thin contrasting sole and two stripes around the rim. A curling looped swirl decorates the front of the shaft, giving a playful toy-like look.
Male/M_Footr_Toy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boot shaft and foot; colour 1 on the rim stripes; colour 2 on the swirl design on the front; colour 3 on the sole.

Male/M_Footr_Variablerobot_01.description: A chunky robotic right boot with a blocky, faceted shin guard, angular fin-like plates flaring up the sides and back, and a wedge-shaped pointed toe cap with a contrasting segmented joint at the ankle.
Male/M_Footr_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shin and boot body; colour 3 on the toe tip, heel block and the side and back fin plates; colour 2 on the ankle joint and inner gap details.

Male/M_Footr_Victory_01.description: A right ankle boot with a pointed toe cap, a panelled upper and a strapped ankle cuff. Swept wing-like fins curve up and back from the heel, and a diamond gem sits at the back of the heel. Superhero style.
Male/M_Footr_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper of the boot and the fins; colour 1 on the toe cap, heel base and the curled side fin; colour 2 on the cuff bands, sole and edge trim; colour 3 on the heel gem.
Male/M_Footr_Victory_01.differs: The male boot has a double strapped ankle cuff and a shorter, curled contrasting-slot fin wrapping around the heel, instead of tall thin fins.

Male/M_Footr_Werewolf_01.description: A right foot shaped like a beast's paw: a smooth, sculpted foot ending at the ankle, with four long pointed claws on the toes and a small dewclaw at the side. Suggests a werewolf or monster look.
Male/M_Footr_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the paw body; colour 1 on the claws.

Male/M_Footr_Wolf_Armor_01.description: A knee-high armored boot of stacked, segmented plates with a wide ornate flared cuff at the top, layered angled bands down the shin and calf, and a rounded toe with sharp claw-like spikes at the front and heel.
Male/M_Footr_Wolf_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main boot plates and toe; colour 2 on the recessed under-layers and ankle band; colour 3 on the plate edges and cuff trim; colour 1 on the claws and small diamond gems.

Male/M_Greavel_Krampus_01.description: A thick rigid anklet band worn around the left ankle, ringed with round slit bells like sleigh bells, with small clasp blocks at the join carrying contrasting studs. A festive, jingly, slightly monstrous accessory.
Male/M_Greavel_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and clasp blocks; colour 1 on the round bells; colour 3 on the studs at the clasp.

Male/M_Greaver_Krampus_01.description: A thick anklet band worn on the right ankle, ringed with round jingle bells with slit openings, plus a small hinged clasp block with two studs. Festive, monstrous holiday styling.
Male/M_Greaver_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the bells; colour 3 on the studs of the clasp block.

Male/M_Hair_Animal_02.description: A swept, spiky hairstyle with a tall crest on top and shaggy, pointed locks that sweep to one side and hang chin-length over one ear. Two small horn-like tips rise at the crown, and the sides of the head are shaved.
Male/M_Hair_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and roots of the hair; colour 1 on the lower tips and the longer side locks; colour 2 on a few tip accents; colour 3 on a small strip at the base of the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Anniversary_Mindslayer_01.description: Flat, ribbon-like tentacle strands of hair that begin at a straight hairline across the forehead and hang to the shoulders, curling outward at the tips. A monstrous, alien look with a glossy finish.
Male/M_Hair_Anniversary_Mindslayer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 on the thin edge trim along the strands.
Male/M_Hair_Anniversary_Mindslayer_01.differs: The male strands are shorter, ending at shoulder length, and hang in fewer, more clustered groups than the longer female version.

Male/M_Hair_Arcane_01.description: Chin-length swept-back hair with streaky strands, two pointed horn-like tufts flaring out at the sides, a fringe over the brow and a knotted headband tied across the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 1 on the knotted headband.

Male/M_Hair_Arcane_02.description: A chin-length, swept-back hairstyle of sculpted, wavy locks with two large horn-like tufts rising at the front, side pieces with pointed tips, and a tapered point at the nape. Stylised, fantasy-comic look.
Male/M_Hair_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and the back and side locks; colour 1 on the two raised front tufts and the side swept locks; colour 2 on the layered locks behind the ears.

Male/M_Hair_Back_Spike_01.description: A tall mohawk-style hairstyle of long, sharp, feather-like spikes swept back from a central ridge along the crown, with the sides of the head bare. Spikes taper to points and hang to the upper back.
Male/M_Hair_Back_Spike_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the spikes; colour 0 on the spike mid-sections and tips; colour 2 on the darkest spikes at the crown and roots. Colour 3 not visible.
Male/M_Hair_Back_Spike_01.differs: The male version is shorter, stopping at the upper back, while the female version hangs to mid-back.

Male/M_Hair_Back_Spike_02.description: A single swept lock of spiky hair rising from the crown and sweeping down across one side of the forehead in a sharp, tapered point, ending near the chin. Short, punk-styled bangs.
Male/M_Hair_Back_Spike_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tips and root of the lock; colour 2 on the main body of the hair. Colours 0 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Hair_Beast_Boar_01.description: A tall, wild mohawk-style hairstyle made of many sharp, curved spikes radiating outward from the crown and sweeping down the back to shoulder length, with the sides of the head left shaved.
Male/M_Hair_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and middle of the spikes; colour 1 on the spike tips and outer edges; colour 2 in the shaded roots.

Male/M_Hair_Beast_Kangaroo_01.description: A chin-length, swept-back hairstyle with a tall spiky tuft on the front crown, shaved-looking sides, and long layered locks that flick out in pointed tips at the nape. Wild, animal-like punk look.
Male/M_Hair_Beast_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass at the top and back; colour 1 on the tips of the long back locks; colour 3 on the front tuft; colour 2 on the spiked tips of the tuft.

Male/M_Hair_Beast_Mouse_01.description: A tall, swept-back mohawk of jagged, feathery spikes with a curved horn-like tip at the front, running front to back along the crown and trailing into a long ragged tail at the nape; sides of the head stay bare.
Male/M_Hair_Beast_Mouse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved front tip and the tips of the crest; colour 1 on the spiky mid section of the crest; colour 2 on the rear crest tufts; colour 3 on the long tail at the back and the hairline at the front.

Male/M_Hair_Bowlcut_01.description: A chin-length bowl cut: a rounded cap of straight, streaky strands falling from a central crown swirl to a blunt fringe over the brow, with a shorter, sharply cut under-layer around the nape and ears.
Male/M_Hair_Bowlcut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the streaked upper hair strands; colour 2 on the shorter under-layer at the nape and sides.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Animal_02.description: Swept-back, asymmetric spiky hair with a tall tousled crest and small horn-like tufts on top. Long jagged locks trail down one side to chin length, leaving the other side of the head bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and upper hair; colour 1 on the tips of the lower locks and side strands; colour 2 on a few darker strand undersides.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Anniversary_Mindslayer.description: Ribbed, tentacle-like strands of hair that hang from a flat band across the forehead and hairline, sweeping back and down to shoulder length in glossy, segmented locks. It suggests an alien or monstrous look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Anniversary_Mindslayer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands; colour 1 on the thin edge piping along the strands; the inner sides of the strands use colour 2.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Anniversary_Mindslayer.differs: The male version is shorter, ending at the shoulders, with the strands grouped more tightly.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Arcane_01.description: Chin-length swept hair with streaked, wavy strands, a long fringe over the brow, and two pointed, horn-like tufts flaring out at the sides. A knotted headband wraps across the forehead with a bow at the side.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 1 on the knotted headband.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Arcane_02.description: A chin-length swept hairstyle of sculpted, swirling locks with two tall horn-like tufts on top, a heavy fringe over the forehead, and layered pointed strands tapering down the back of the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Arcane_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main locks of the fringe, sides and back; colour 1 on the two tall top tufts; colour 2 on the layered under-strands at the sides and back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Back_Spike_01.description: A tall, mohawk-like hairstyle of long, sharp, feather-like spikes swept back from the crown and falling to the upper back, with the sides of the head left bare. Wild, punky and monstrous in feel.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Back_Spike_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spike roots and mid-lengths; colour 0 on the spike tips; colour 2 on the darker streaks near the crown. Colour 3 is not visible.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Back_Spike_01.differs: This version falls only to upper-back length, slightly shorter than the female version.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Back_Spike_02.description: A single swept spike of hair rising from the front hairline, then sweeping down across the forehead to a long sharp point beside the eye. It is a small, stylised bang with a glossy, streaked look, and the rest of the head stays bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Back_Spike_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the spike, fading into colour 1 toward the tip and base edges; colours 0 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Beast_Boar_01.description: A wild mass of sharp, blade-like spikes radiating outward from the whole head, swept back into a tall crest on top and hanging to shoulder length at the back. Feral, punk-style hair with a shaved-looking side.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the roots and centre of the spikes; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 2 in the shadowed undersides of the spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Beast_Kangaroo_01.description: A chin-length, layered hairstyle with long swept strands falling over the forehead and down the back, plus a tall upright tuft of pointed spikes on top; the shaggy ends flick outward in jagged tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Beast_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips of the lower strands; colour 3 on the tall crest at the front top; colour 2 on the spike tips of the crest.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Beast_Mouse_01.description: A tall, spiky mohawk-style hairstyle with a curved horn-like front sweep, jagged tufts along the crown and a long ragged tail trailing down the nape; the sides of the head are left shaved.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Beast_Mouse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved front sweep; colour 1 on the jagged tufts beside it; colour 2 on the crown and back tufts; colour 3 on the long tail at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Birdpeople_01.description: A short crest of sharp, jagged feather-like spikes swept upward and back across the top of the head, with a few small spikes at the temples and nape, leaving the face and crown sides bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole crest of spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Bowlcut_01.description: A short, rounded bowl-cut hairstyle with streaky strands radiating from a crown swirl, a straight fringe across the forehead and a shaved-look band of hair at the nape and sides, ending around ear level.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Bowlcut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 mix as streaks through the top hair; colour 2 on the short undercut band at the sides and back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Cold_01.description: Tall, chin-length hair made of sharp, jagged crystalline shards that sweep upward into a spiky crest, with shorter spikes flaring at the nape and sides. A thin band across the forehead ends in two curved claw-like hooks.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Cold_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shards; colour 1 on the shading along the shard tips and sides; colour 2 on the headband; colour 3 on the curved hooks at the brow.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Curly_01.description: A short, dense cap of tight sculpted curls that covers the crown, back and sides of the head, with a ragged hairline at the front and sides. It ends above the neck and leaves the face and ears clear.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Curly_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole head of curls; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Cybernetic_Monster_01.description: A tall mechanical mohawk made of a row of segmented, curved blade-like spines running front to back along the centre of the scalp, each ending in a sharp hooked tip, growing longer toward the crown. Suggests a cybernetic monster look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Cybernetic_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plated spine bodies; colour 1 on the raised panel sections of each spine; colour 2 on the joints and bases; colour 3 on the hooked tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Dreadlocks_Long_03.description: Long hairstyle of thick twisted, braided dreadlocks swept back from the face and hanging loose past the shoulders to upper-back length, with a contrasting band across the hairline and blunt curled ends.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Dreadlocks_Long_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands of the locks; colour 1 on the twisted accent strands and tips; colour 2 on the band at the hairline.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Element_Fire_01.description: Chin-length hair sculpted into tall, swept-back flame shapes: glossy layered tongues and curling tips rise high above the head and trail backward, with a short fringe over the forehead. Suggests an elemental fire look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; the whole hairstyle shows a shiny, reflective finish with faint hints of colour 1 in the highlights.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Element_Water_01.description: A tall, sculpted hairstyle shaped like a rising wave or flame: glossy swirling tendrils sweep upward and curl at the tips, with a short jagged fringe across the forehead and chin-length hair at the sides and back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: The glossy tendrils mostly ignore the colour scheme and show a reflective finish; colour 3 shows faintly in the front recesses; the short fringe and underlayer take colour 2.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Ironc.description: Swept-back hair with streaky strands that fall to the shoulders, ending in ragged pointed tips. A fan-pleated cap section sits over the crown and forehead, like a retro headwrap.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Ironc.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands of hair; colour 1 on the fan-pleated crown section; colour 2 on the darkened tips of the strands.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Ironc.differs: Hair stops at shoulder length, a little shorter than the female version, which reaches the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Sapph.description: Long, layered hair with a swept side-parted fringe over the forehead, falling down the back and gathered low into a ponytail by a small tie, ending in a wavy, tapered tail at about waist length.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Sapph.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 1 on streaks and highlights through the strands; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Witch.description: Very long, straight hairstyle with a heavy fringe swept over the face and eyes, falling in layered, wispy strands past the waist to ragged, pointed tips at the back and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Anniversary_Witch.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair from the crown down; colour 1 on the tips and lower ends of the strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_01.description: Slicked-back hair that hugs the scalp and is gathered low at the nape into a single long braid, tied off with a small band. The braid hangs down the back to upper-back length and tapers to a point.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and braid; colour 1 on the hairline and top of the scalp; colour 3 on the small tie band at the nape; colour 2 on the tapering braid tip.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_02.description: A close-fitting hair cap with a receding hairline that gathers into a single tied braid at the nape. The braid is short, curls out to one side and tapers to a point near the shoulder.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the hair and the braid; colour 1 on the front and top of the cap with streaked highlights; colour 2 on the braid tip and streaks; colour 3 on the braid tie.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Asianbraid_02.differs: The male braid is shorter and ends near the shoulder instead of hanging down the chest.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Bat_01.description: Short, spiky swept-back hairstyle with tall jagged tufts on top and a fringe of sharp locks falling over the forehead; the sides are cropped close, giving a wild, punk-like crest with pointed tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front fringe and top locks; colour 1 on the tips of the front and side locks; colour 2 on the back and rear crest; colour 3 on the tips of the rear and top spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_01.description: Chin-length swept-back hair gathered into a tall top knot with a tie, with a contrasting band across the brow, curved claw-like horn tips at the sides and jagged feathery spikes flaring at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair at the front and top; colour 1 on the hair toward the back and lower sections; colour 3 on the top-knot tie; colour 2 on the brow band, horn tips and jagged nape spikes.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_01.differs: The male version has a taller, fuller top knot and more volume on top.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_02.description: A swept-back undercut hairstyle with the sides shaved close and a smooth top section combed back into a single long braid down the centre of the back of the head, bound with several contrasting ties and ending in a pointed tip.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept-back hair top; colour 1 on the streaks in the hair and braid; colour 3 on the bands tying the braid.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_02.differs: The male version has neck-length hair with a braid that hangs slightly further down the back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_03.description: A neck-length, layered hairstyle of long straight strands with jagged, pointed tips, swept forward into a fringe over the eyes with an open hollow at the front of the crown. Punky and rugged.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands and crown; colour 1 on the pointed tips and the accent locks; colour 2 on the darker shading at the crown and inside the front hollow.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Brutal_03.differs: The male version is neck length and has an open hollow at the front of the crown, where the female version has a closed fringe covering the forehead.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Buzzcut_01.description: A short, boxy buzzcut with a flat-topped crop and a squared front hairline. Ragged, jagged-edged tufts run along the temples and the sides and back of the head, giving a clean, close-cut look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Buzzcut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top and the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the jagged tufts at the temples, sideburns and lower back edges.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.description: A short spiky mohawk-style hairstyle: a narrow tuft of sharp, swept-back blades of hair runs along the crown, with a longer point sweeping forward over the forehead. The sides of the head stay bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair tuft.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Chimera_01.description: A tall, swept-back mohawk of long feathery spikes running as a narrow crest from forehead to nape, with jagged pointed tips and an angular faceted front edge; sides of the head are left bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the hair strands and the front edge; colour 1 on the spiky tips and the highlights along the rear spine; colour 0 appears little.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Chimera_01.differs: The male version defaults to a mostly contrasting colour pattern with a chunkier, faceted front edge, and it reads as a thicker crest.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Crowspeak_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull, with swept-back blade-like spiky strands on top and a pointed widow's peak; a separate flat panel sits across the forehead, and the sides and back end above the jaw.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Crowspeak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept strands of the top and front; colour 0 on the back and lower sides of the hair and the forehead panel; colour 2 in the shaded streaks between strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Curtain_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle with a centre parting and straight, choppy strands that sweep down into a fringe over the forehead and brow, with longer side locks framing the face and a blunt-cut nape.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Curtain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair overall, with the strands shading darker toward the underside and back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Cybercat_01.description: A tall mohawk-style crest of segmented, cable-like braids that arch over the top of the head and fall in long straight strands to upper-back length, leaving the sides of the scalp bare. Suggests a cyber, stealthy look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Cybercat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the alternating bands along each braid; colour 2 on the crest base at the top of the head; colour 3 on the tips of the braids.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Cybercat_01.differs: The braids show clear, evenly alternating bands of two colours, and the crest base is a distinct contrasting cap.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Cyberwire_01.description: Chin-length swept hair with a long side-swept fringe over one eye and an undercut shaved side, with a thick braided cable band running from the front temple back along the shaved side, plus streaked strands.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass, fading toward at the tips; colour 1 on the streaked strands in the fringe and back; colour 3 on the braided cable band along the shaved side.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Cyberwire_01.differs: The male version has a prominent thick braided cable band along the shaved side, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Long_0.description: Long dreadlocks hairstyle of thick, ropy locks falling from a crown that sweeps forward over the forehead, reaching the upper back. Bands of beads or wraps ring the locks, and a couple of longer strands hang by the face.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Long_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lengths of the dreadlocks; colour 1 on the crown and roots; colour 2 on the band wraps across the locks; colour 3 on a few small accent beads.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Medium.description: Neck-length dreadlocks made of thick, segmented ropes that radiate from a crown swirl and hang straight down around the head, with small bands wrapped near the tips. Casual, street-style hair.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Medium.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lengths of the locks; colour 1 on the crown and roots of the locks; colour 2 and colour 3 on the small bands near the tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Dreadlocks_Medium.differs: The male version is shorter, stopping at the neck, while the female version reaches the shoulders.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Emo_02.description: A chin-length emo hairstyle with a side-parted fringe that sweeps across the forehead and partly over one eye, and layered, jagged-tipped strands that cover the ears and nape in a rounded bob shape.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Emo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 1 on some strands in a striped pattern; colour 2 on the darker strands, the roots and the fringe underside. Colour 3 is not visible.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Extraterrestialmo.description: A short, spiky mohawk: a central crest of sharp angular shards runs from the forehead to the nape, with longer spikes swept back at the rear. The sides of the head are left bare. Suits punk or alien looks.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Extraterrestialmo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front tips and roots of the forehead spikes; colour 1 on the mid-length of the front and side spikes; colour 2 on the upper middle of the crest; colour 3 on the rear and back-swept spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Fluffy_01.description: Upper-back-length hair with a tall, tousled, spiky crown, straight blunt fringe across the forehead and long straight strands falling behind the shoulders, with two thin front locks framing the face. Shaggy, layered punk-like look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Fluffy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tousled top of the crown; colour 1 on the fringe and upper mid-section; colour 0 on the long lower lengths; colour 3 on the two front locks and a few stray tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Fluffy_01.differs: The male version's front locks are shorter and the back hair hangs slightly longer, reaching the mid upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_01.description: A chin-length, tall-on-top swept hair style with layered jagged locks tapering to points at the nape, and a large curled forelock rolled up over the crown and flicking out at the side.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the curled forelock and its tip; colour 3 on the pointed tips at the nape; colour 2 as shading beneath the curl.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The male version is taller on top, with the curled forelock standing higher above the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_02.description: A short, swept-over hair piece: a rounded, layered tuft sits high on one side of the head and curls down past the temple into a pointed, flicked lock. The rest of the head is bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Ghosthunter_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and crest of the tuft; colour 1 on the lower swept lock; colour 2 on the inner edge of the sweep. The colours blend in a gradient.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_01.description: Short, chin-length spiky hair with layered jagged locks swept forward into a side-parted fringe, pointed tufts flicking out at the sides, and ragged tips at the nape. A messy goth or punk look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and fringe locks; colour 2 on the mid-layer locks and side tufts; colour 0 on the tips of the lower locks at the back and sides.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_02.description: A neck-length bob with blunt-cut strands and thick, straight bangs that fall across the eyes. The hair is smooth and rounded over the crown, with uneven tips at the ends.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hair from the crown down to mid-length, fading into colour 0 toward the tips; the hair strands show slight colour 2 shading in the gaps.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Goth_02.differs: The male bob is neck length, with straight bangs that cover both eyes rather than being swept to one side.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Hat_Baseballcap_0.description: A thin short hair band that wraps around the head at brow level, forming a bald-with-sides hairstyle: a wider strip across the forehead, notched around the ears, and a flat band across the back of the head.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Hat_Baseballcap_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair band across the front; the back and sides of the band show a bluish shade from colour 1 or lighting, with no other separate parts.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull like a smooth cap, with jagged side-swept bangs that angle across the forehead and small tapered tufts at the temples and nape. It ends well above the jaw.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hairstyle; the other colour slots are not visible.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.differs: The male bangs sweep lower and diagonally across the forehead, with extra tufts at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Hatcurls_02.description: Two clusters of three chunky cylindrical curls, one at each side of the head beside the eyes and ears, angled forward. Each curl is a segmented tube with banded rings, giving a robotic, mechanical hairstyle.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Hatcurls_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer curl of each cluster; colour 0 on the middle curl; colour 1 on the inner curl; colour 3 on the thin ring bands around each curl.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Default_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull like a smooth cap, with a jagged, uneven fringe across the forehead and small tapered tufts by the temples; it leaves the ears and nape bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Default_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair shape.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Long_01.description: Neck-length hair swept back from the forehead in a smooth cap, with thin ragged, matted strands hanging at the nape and behind the ears.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on nearly all of the hair; colour 2 on a few shadowed strands at the front and tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Long_01.differs: The male version is shorter, reaching only the neck, and is mostly a single tone without the separate contrasting colour on the lower tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Long_02.description: Shoulder-length sleek hair swept straight back from the forehead into long, straight strands with ragged, uneven ends that hang down the back of the neck; the hairline is clean and the ears stay uncovered.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and crown strands; colour 1 on the lower lengths and some streaks; colour 2 on the streaks between the strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Swoop_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle with a short swept-up crown, a fringe that falls across the brow, and long straight strands that cover the ears and flip outward in jagged, flared tips at the nape and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Swoop_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown and top of the hair; colour 0 on the fringe, sides and back lengths; colour 3 on the streaks near the lower ends; colour 2 on the darker streaks between the crown strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Swoop_Long.description: Long swept-back hairstyle with the hair combed straight back from the forehead and falling in a loose, slightly ragged mass to the neck and upper shoulders, with streaked strands and uneven tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Helmet_Swoop_Long.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaks running through the strands; colour 1 on the lower tips of the hair.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01.description: A short, chin-length spiky hairstyle with layered pointed tufts that flick outward, a blunt fringe across the forehead, and a tall swept-up crest curling upward at the top of the head.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hair mass; colour 0 on the tips of the spiky tufts; colour 2 on the fringe and top crest; colour 3 on the underlayer at the nape and lower back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01.differs: The male version has a taller crest that curls upward from the top of the head.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_01.description: A short mohawk-style hairpiece: a tuft of swept, layered locks along the crown that curl up into sharp pointed tips, with a tall curved lock at the front. The sides of the head stay bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tips of the locks; colour 2 on the roots and lower body of the hair. The hair fades between the two.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_02.description: A short, chin-length swept-back hairstyle with layered, textured locks ending in pointed tips that flick outward, plus a jagged fringe across the forehead and a shaggy, tiered nape at the back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hair mass and top layers; colour 0 on the flicked tips of the locks; colour 3 on the underlayer at the nape and sides; colour 2 on the jagged fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_02.description: Long, loose wavy hairstyle with a side-swept, layered fringe and a short parting at the crown. Rippled strands fall past the neck to shoulder length and end in ragged, pointed tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown down to the mid-lengths; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips, blending in as a gradient; colour 3 on the crown parting.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_02.differs: This version is shorter, ending at the shoulders, where the female version reaches the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with layered, swept-back strands and a tall crown of stiff, splayed spikes on top. A blunt fringe falls over the forehead and a few curved tendrils hang at the temples. Punk, animal-quill look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips of the side and back strands; colour 2 and colour 3 on the crown spikes, shading from roots to coloured tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_01.description: A short mohawk-style hairpiece of thick, pointed quills fanning up and back from a central strip on top of the head, with a few curved claw-like tufts hanging down at the front and sides of the temples.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the base and middle of the quills; colour 3 on the quill tips and the hanging tufts.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_02.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with layered strands combed from the front over the crown, ending in jagged porcupine-like spikes at the nape and around the back. It has no bangs and sits close to the head.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and roots; colour 1 on the spiky tips and ends of the strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_04.description: Shoulder-length, loose, layered hair with a centre parting at the crown and wavy, jagged-tipped strands that fall around the face and sweep back behind the ears.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 3 on the parting streak at the crown; colour 1 on highlight streaks through the lower strands; colour 2 on the underlying lower lengths and tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_04.differs: This version is shorter, ending at shoulder length rather than reaching the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_05.description: A chin-length, tousled bob of layered, pointed locks that sweep across the forehead in a heavy side fringe, covering the brow. Ragged, feathered tips flick out at the sides and back for a punky, energetic look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the sweeping fringe and upper tips; colour 1 on the lower tips and underside; colour 3 on the streak at the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06.description: A swept-back hairstyle gathered into a tall ponytail with a tie at its base, ending in jagged, clawed tips that curve backward. Longer spiky locks fall over one side of the face.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and ponytail; colour 1 on the spiky ends of the side locks and fringe; colour 2 on the ponytail tips; colour 3 on the hair tie.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06.differs: The male version has a longer fringe that sweeps down across the forehead and one eye, rather than being swept off the face.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_01.description: Short neck-length hair with a smooth swept-back crown and side-parted bangs that fall over the temples, ending in jagged pointed tips around the face and nape. Sits close to the scalp with a sharp, stylised look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair crown and roots; colour 1 on the lower lengths, bangs and pointed tips; colour 2 on small shaded gaps at the back of the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_01.differs: The male version is cut shorter, reaching the neck rather than the chin.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_02.description: A short swooped ponytail gathered high at the crown with a band, with tall swept-back layered locks on top, a long lock falling over one side of the face, and a tail of jagged, pointed strands curving down past the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair, fading toward colour 2 on the lower strands and tips; colour 3 on the hair band.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_02.differs: The male version has a long lock that sweeps down across one side of the face.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_07.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of layered, swept-back locks with jagged pointed tips, a messy fringe falling over the forehead, and tapered layers covering the nape and sides of the head.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips and underlayers of the locks; colour 3 on the crown swirl at the top.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_08.description: Neck-length layered hair swept back from a pointed widow's peak, with a contrasting angular fringe panel over the brow and loose jagged strands falling around the face and down the back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_08.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 3 on the crown and top of the scalp; colour 1 on the tips of the lower strands; colour 2 on the fringe panel over the brow.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_09.description: A chin-length, voluminous bob of wavy, tousled hair with layered pointed locks, a side-swept fringe that falls over the forehead, and a jagged, feathered lower edge; sits close around the head and ears.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_09.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the streaked tips of the locks; colour 3 on the parting at the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_10.description: A tall mohawk of layered, pointed feather-like spikes running in a narrow strip from forehead to nape, fanning upward and tapering into a long tail down the back of the neck; the sides of the head stay bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper tips of the spikes; colour 0 on the mid-length of the spikes; colour 3 on the roots along the scalp; colour 2 on the lower tail and back tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_11.description: A chin-length bob with a centre parting, layered streaky strands that fall around the head and ends in jagged tips. Fringe pieces sweep over the forehead and brow, giving a sleek, modern look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_11.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 3 on the parting along the crown; colour 1 on the tips and lower ends of the strands; colour 2 in the shadowed streaks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_12.description: A short, cropped hairstyle with a swooping side parting, layered wavy top and jagged, feather-like tips flicking out at the sides and nape; a blunt fringe falls over the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Heroic_12.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 3 along the centre parting; colour 1 on the flicked tips and ends; colour 2 on the fringe and lower nape strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Kitty_01.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with a shaggy top cap of sharp, pointed locks that flick forward over the brow and out at the sides, leaving the sides and back of the head bare. Wild, punky look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hairpiece, with the underside and shadowed locks shading toward colour 1; no other separate colour areas are visible.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Knitcap_01.description: A short, close-fitting cap of hair that hugs the skull, with a jagged, saw-toothed fringe across the forehead and a matching ragged edge at the nape. It leaves the ears exposed and has a rough, unkempt look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Knitcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair piece.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Krampus_01.description: A short, wild hairstyle made of many sharp, overlapping horn-like shards that bristle outward over the crown, sides and back of the head, with longer blades sweeping back from the forehead. Monstrous, beastly look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on many of the outer shards; colour 1 on the crown and other shards; colour 2 on a few shards on the top and back; colour 3 on small accent shards.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Layered_01.description: A neck-length layered hairstyle, tall and tousled on top, with a long fringe falling over the eyes and choppy, wispy strands framing the face and ending at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Layered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tips of the lower strands and fringe; colour 3 on the scattered streaks and patches through the top and sides; colour 2 on the shaded underlayers near the temples.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Layered_01.differs: The male version is shorter, ending at the neck, and sits taller and fuller on top.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Llama_01.description: A short, choppy, layered hairstyle of jagged pointed locks with a fringe over the forehead, small horn-like tufts poking up from the crown, and ragged tips ending around chin height. Sits close around the head.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top layer of locks and crown tufts; colour 2 on the inner underlayer at the sides and back; colour 0 on the lower tips and fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Long_01.description: Long loose hair with a centre parting, falling in wavy streaked locks to about shoulder length, with face-framing strands hanging in front and pointed tips at the ends.
