Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaks running down the locks; colour 1 on the inner underlayer and front tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Long_01.differs: The male hair is shorter, ending at the shoulders, with shorter front locks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Long_Looseluchado.description: Neck-length loose hair with choppy, jagged strands falling over the forehead and partly across the face, layered pieces at the sides, and ragged tapered tips at the back. Messy, casual look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Long_Looseluchado.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head of hair.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Longelegant_01.description: Long, sleek hair with a centre part and streaked strands, swept back over the head and falling straight to the neck and upper shoulders. Front locks frame the face, and the ends are jagged and ragged.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Longelegant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light streaks through the hair; colour 2 on the streaks and the front locks; colour 1 on the underlayer and the ragged tips at the ends.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Longelegant_01.differs: The male hair is a little shorter, reaching the neck and upper shoulders, with shorter front locks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Martial_Power_01.description: A tall high ponytail bound by a banded tie at the crown, streaming down to mid-back in a tapered, pointed sweep. Short fringe and side locks frame the face, with a few sharp strands flicking up at the top.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and fringe; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the ponytail; colour 2 on the streaks, side locks and top flick; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Martial_Power_02.description: A tall, high ponytail gathered at the crown by a wide band, with long straight strands sweeping up, arching back and falling to mid-back in a pointed tip. Loose side locks and streaked layers give a martial, warrior look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the lower tips of the ponytail; colour 2 on the darker streaks and top tuft; colour 3 on the binding band.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Messy_01.description: A chin-length messy hairstyle with tall, spiky swept-up strands on top, a long side-swept fringe over the forehead, and a neat, straight-cut back that ends at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Messy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head of hair; the darker shading in the tips at the crown is from the hair's default material.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Messyshort_01_Bas.description: Short, messy hair cut to about chin length, with jagged, choppy spikes falling over the forehead and ragged tufts at the nape; it sits close to the scalp and suggests a rough, unkempt street look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Messyshort_01_Bas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, back and sides of the hair; colour 1 on the fringe and the tips of the front locks; colour 3 on small streaks near the roots under the fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Middleparted_01_B.description: Short, voluminous hair with a rounded, swept-forward top that rolls over the forehead in a thick front wave, with tapered sideburns and a close-cropped back. Suits a casual, classic superhero look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Middleparted_01_B.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and crown of the hair; colour 1 on the front fringe, sides and lower edges, blending into colour 0 towards the top.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Mohawk_01_Basic.description: A tall, narrow mohawk: a single ridge of swept-back spiky strands running from the forehead to the nape, with fine streaked strands along the sides of the ridge, leaving the rest of the head bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Mohawk_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair strands; colour 1 on the streaks and highlights running through the strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Moptop_01_Basic.description: A short, tousled moptop hairstyle with choppy jagged fringe strands across the forehead, streaked layers swept over the crown and sides, and a close-cropped back that stays above the jaw and neck.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Moptop_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hair mass; colour 0 on the streaks and highlights through the layers and the underlying fringe strip at the forehead.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Moptop_02_Basic.description: Chin-length emo-style hair with a long side-swept fringe of jagged, choppy tips covering one side of the forehead. It sits off-centre on the head, leaving the other side bare, and hangs in layered strands at the back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Moptop_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and underside of the hair; colour 1 on the swept fringe and top strands; colour 3 on thin streaks near the tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Mullet_Long_01.description: A shoulder-length spiky mullet: a tall crown of jagged, radiating tufts on top, with fringe strands falling over the forehead and long pointed layers hanging down the back and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Mullet_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 2 on the streaky stripes through the strands; colour 1 on the tips of the longer strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A chin-length hair piece with a central parting, choppy layered strands and a ragged fringe that sweeps across the forehead. The hair frames the face and ends in pointed tips, with a casual, slightly pirate-like look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the hair and the fringe; colour 1 on the outer side strands; colour 3 on the inner side strands and tips; colour 2 on the front side sections around the face.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: Two thin braided strands hang from the temples in front of the ears, each tapering to a point at the top, with a wrapped ornate band near the bottom and a small cuff and tuft at the tip. Hangs to neck level.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the braided strands; colour 3 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the small cuffs; colour 1 on the tassel tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.description: Shoulder-length, straight hair with a choppy fringe of bangs over the forehead, swept back behind the ears and ending in jagged, feathered tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fringe and crown; colour 2 on the darker patches at the top and sides; colour 3 on the mid-lengths; colour 0 on the jagged tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.differs: The male hair is shorter, ending at the shoulders rather than reaching the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Ponytail_02.description: A high ponytail hairstyle with short, layered hair swept across the head, a heavy bangs fringe over the brow and a tapering tail gathered by a small band at the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Ponytail_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair; colour 2 on the striped streaks through the hair; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the tail and fringe; colour 3 on the hair band.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Ponytail_02.differs: The male version has a fuller swept bangs fringe over the brow and a shorter tail.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_01.description: A chin-length punk hairstyle with swept, layered strands and a long side fringe falling diagonally across the forehead. Small pointed tufts stick up on top, and the nape ends in jagged, choppy tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 3 on the roots, crown and jagged nape tips; colour 1 on the swept side fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_02.description: Chin-length punk hairstyle with a long swept fringe falling diagonally across one side of the face, layered streaky locks over the crown, and jagged sheared ends at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 3 on the crown, sides and jagged tips at the nape; colour 1 on the swept fringe lock.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_03.description: A chin-length, choppy hairstyle of layered pointed spiky locks with long side-swept fringe falling over the eyes, topped by a slouchy soft beret-like cap perched on one side of the head. Punk rockabilly style.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair locks; colour 3 on the tips of the locks; colour 1 on the slouchy cap.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_04.description: A tall punk mohawk: a narrow central crest of swept-back, streaky locks rising to a point above the forehead and running down the back of the head, with jagged spiky tufts along both sides. The sides of the scalp are left bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept locks; colour 1 on the underlayer and side tufts; colour 3 on the tips of the spikes and some inner spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_05.description: A short, choppy hairstyle with jagged layered tips at the fringe and nape, topped by a big swooping quiff that sweeps across the forehead and curls over one side. It has a punk, stylish look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the swooping front quiff; colour 3 on the streaks and edges within the quiff.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_Shaved_01.description: A short punk hairstyle with the sides and back shaved close. A raised strip of angular, streaky spikes runs from the front hairline over the crown toward the nape, swept back into a faux-hawk.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Punk_Shaved_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light streaks; colour 1 on the mid-tone strands; colour 2 on the streaks in the strands. Colour 3 is not visible.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Reactor_01.description: A hood-like mechanical hairstyle made of stacked padded horizontal segments that drape over the head to shoulder length, ending in a ragged, chunky-edged hem at the back and sides. Suggests a sci-fi helmet or reactor cowl.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top crown segments; colour 2 on the middle segment bands; colour 3 on the lower bands; colour 0 on the chunky hem tips and front visor edge. The glossy default material dulls the scheme so colours look muted.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Sasquatch_01.description: A neck-length shaggy hairstyle with a smooth swept-back crown, layered ragged tufts that frame the face like a mane, and jagged uneven ends falling around the ears, nape and back of the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the lower layered tufts and the ragged ends.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Sasquatch_Long_01.description: A shaggy, neck-length wild mane of layered jagged locks that frames the face with long side tufts and pointed strands under the chin, falling in ragged tapered tips at the back. Beastly, sasquatch-like style.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Sasquatch_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown and upper strands of the mane; colour 0 on the lower ends and tips of the locks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Sasquatch_Long_02.description: Shaggy, neck-length wild hair in jagged, choppy strands that sweep back and down from the crown, with ragged split tips around the nape and sides. Gives a feral, beastly look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Sasquatch_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper hair and crown; colour 0 on the lower strands and tips, blending into colour 1 towards the top.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Sasquatch_Spiky_0.description: Neck-length, shaggy unkempt hair with jagged, ragged strands falling around the face and down the back, topped by a crest of sharp upswept spikes and a few contrasting spikes at the nape. Feral, beastly style.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Sasquatch_Spiky_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiky crest on top and the strand tips; colour 1 on the main body of the hair; colour 2 on the small spikes at the back of the head.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_03.description: A short, tousled hairstyle swept across the forehead in layered wavy locks, with jagged fringe over the brow and ragged, feathered tips at the nape and sides. It sits close to the head and ends around the ears.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and swept-over fringe locks, with a soft blend at the crown from colour 3; colour 1 on the lower sides and back layer; colour 2 on the jagged tips at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_04.description: A chin-length layered hairstyle with a parting at the crown and long streaked strands that fall over the forehead and one eye. The ends are jagged and choppy, and the back sits loosely at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 streak across the strands, with colour 1 stronger toward the sides and back; colour 3 tints the parting along the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Secret_04.differs: The male version is choppier and looser, with a shaggier fringe that falls over the face, and the ends are longer at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Short_02_Basic.description: A short, clipped hairstyle with a swept-forward textured top and streaky strands over the forehead, and closely cropped sides and back that stop above the ears and nape. Neat, practical, and low-profile.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Short_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the streaky top and fringe strands; colour 0 on the crown highlights and back of the top; colour 3 on the cropped sides and back; colour 2 on the streaks between strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Short_Partedcurls.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle with a parted fringe of small curls swept across the forehead and short tapered locks at the temples; the rest hugs the crown and back of the head, ending above the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Short_Partedcurls.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown and back of the hair; colour 1 on the fringe curls and the side locks at the temples.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Short_Ruler_01.description: Short, chunky faceted hair with a puffed, swept-back crown and small pointed tufts curling out at the front corners. A separate lower layer hugs the sides and back of the head down to the nape, giving a chin-length cropped look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Short_Ruler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the puffed upper crown and the front tufts; colour 1 on the lower layer around the forehead, sides and back of the head.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Slickback_02_Basi.description: Short slicked-back pompadour hairstyle with a swept-up front quiff, streaky strands combed back over the crown, and a smooth rounded back that ends above the nape and ears. Classic, tidy heroic look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Slickback_02_Basi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the hair, the back and the front band; colour 1 on the streaked strands across the top and front; colour 2 on the darker gaps between strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Slickbacktail_01.description: A slicked-back hairstyle swept up from the forehead and gathered into a single long ponytail at the back of the head. The tail is tied with a small band and tapers to a point between the shoulder blades.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Slickbacktail_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair, especially the tail and the top of the head; colour 1 on the front swept-back sections and the tips of the tail; colour 3 on the small hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Snakes_01.description: A hairstyle of writhing snakes that replaces hair: a dozen or so thick serpents with open mouths and forked tongues radiate around the head, hanging to shoulder length, with a spotted scale pattern.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Snakes_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the snake bodies and their spots' surrounding scales; colour 1 on the underlying snakes and shadowed necks beneath; colour 2 on the spots.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Spikey_Long_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle of stiff, angular spikes swept up and outward into a tall, flame-like crown, with shorter jagged tufts around the sides and back and a flat fringe panel across the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Spikey_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the spikes and the forehead panel; colour 1 on the spike tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Spy_01.description: Neck-length layered hairstyle with a long swept fringe that falls across the eyes and face. Glossy, streaky strands build up over the crown and end in flicked, feathered tips around the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair at the crown and top; colour 2 on the middle band of strands; colour 1 on the flicked tips and the hair covering the front of the face.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Spy_02.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with a tall rounded quiff, streaky strand texture, and short sideburn tufts in front of the ears. A separate flat fringe panel sits over the forehead. Ends around chin or nape length.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and base of the hair strands; colour 0 on the streaked highlights and tips; colour 2 on the fringe panel under the front.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Tight_Punkmedium_.description: A neck-length punk hairstyle: a broad central strip of hair swept back from the forehead over the crown and down the back of the head, framed by thin loose strands hanging down each side.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Tight_Punkmedium_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main central mass of hair; colour 1 on the thin loose strands and edge streaks running along the sides and back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Undercut_01.description: Short undercut hairstyle: close-cropped sides and back with a fringe across the forehead, topped by a tall, swept-back mass of jagged, feathery strands that sits like a raised crest above the head.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Undercut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the short sides, back and fringe; colour 1 on the tall swept top section; colour 2 on the shadowed underside band beneath the top.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_01.description: A voluminous, layered hairstyle swept back and outward, with strands that flick into spikes at the crown and sides. A straight fringe sits over the forehead and a shorter underlayer covers the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main upper hair; colour 1 on the streaks through the top layer; colour 2 on the fringe and underlayer; colour 0 on the tips of the underlayer.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_01.differs: The male version is a longer, layered swept-back style with spiky tips and a two-tone underlayer, while the female version is a tightly trimmed cap with a ragged fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_02.description: A short, neatly trimmed hair style swept back and to one side, with a blunt fringe across the forehead and streaky strand texture; tapers close at the nape for a clean, conventional look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on streaks swirling across the top and sides; colour 2 on the darker fade toward the fringe edge and lower back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Face_Villain_02.differs: The male version is a smooth, compact cut without the spiky flicks, curled side locks or contrasting nape tips of the female version.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Facemask_Chaosman_01.description: A short, spiky crop of hair sitting on top of the head like a raised cap, made of jagged faceted spikes, with a longer swept fringe of sharp contrasting spikes at the front. The sides and back are shaved bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Facemask_Chaosman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sides and back spikes; colour 1 on the top of the crop; colour 2 on the front fringe spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Facemask_Chaosman_02.description: Short spiky hairstyle with a crown of jagged, upswept spikes and a longer fringe of sharp tufts at the front, over close-cropped sides and back that hug the head to above the ears.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Facemask_Chaosman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown spikes, with colour 1 shading toward their tips; colour 2 on the front fringe spikes; colour 3 on the cropped sides and back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Fennec_01.description: A short mohawk-style hairpiece: a narrow ridge of layered, swept-back locks along the crown, each ending in a sharp upward-curving point. It sits on top of the head, leaving the sides bare, for a spiky, animal-like look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and body of the locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the locks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Gladiator_01.description: A close-cropped hairstyle with a swept-back top, shaved-looking sides and a single braid hanging from the back of the head over one shoulder, tied with a small band near the tip. Sporty, warrior-like look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept top hair and braid highlights; colour 1 on the braid strands and tapering ends; colour 2 on the short sides and back; colour 3 on the braid band.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Gladiator_01.differs: The braid is shorter, ending around shoulder length, and the cropped sides cover more of the head.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Gladiator_02.description: Shoulder-length wavy hair swept back from the forehead in smooth streaked strands, falling in loose layered waves with curling, pointed ends that flick outward behind the shoulders.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown and roots; colour 1 on the lower lengths and wavy tips, blending gradually from the roots.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Gladiator_Helmet_01.description: A single long braid hanging from a small cap-like knot at the side of the head, draping forward over the shoulder and ending in a tied tuft with a small band. Plain, practical warrior look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Gladiator_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the knot at the head and the braid's outer strands and tip tuft; colour 0 on the braid's highlighted inner strands; colour 3 on the tie band.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Gladiator_Helmet_01.differs: The braid is shorter, ending around shoulder length, and hangs more tightly against the neck.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Goat_01.description: A chin-length, side-swept hair piece: a heavy fringe sweeps across the forehead over one eye, with layered, pointed locks that taper to sharp tips. It covers one side of the head and leaves the rest bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the long swept fringe lock; colour 2 on the lower tips of the locks; colour 3 on the small side tip near the ear.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Goat_02.description: A short, neck-length choppy hairstyle with a swept-up quiff of jagged locks, and ragged tips that fall over the forehead and sides, plus a small tuft at the crown. Punky, edgy look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Goat_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept fringe quiff and crown tuft; colour 0 on the side sections; colour 2 on the top and back near the crown; colour 3 on the lower tips and front locks.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Goat_02.differs: The male version has a longer, heavier fringe that hangs low over the eyes, with the ragged tips reaching the neck.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Guardian_01.description: A small tapering hair tuft at the back of the head, sculpted in stacked, swept flame-like tiers that flare into pointed tips and end around neck level; a fantasy dragon-tail ponytail.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tuft; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the tiers.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Guardian_01.differs: The male tuft is shorter, ending at neck length, and sits somewhat bulkier.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Highrise_01.description: A boxy, flat-topped high-top hairstyle with a textured, clumpy surface, cut straight across the back and sides to chin length, with short sideburn points by the ears and a hollow open gap across the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Highrise_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the textured clumps toward the top; colour 0 on the lower hair and base; the inner forehead cutout shows a neutral surface.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Longmane_L_0.description: A one-sided mane of coarse hair that sweeps from the crown down over the left side of the head to chin length, with layered tufts and pointed contrasting tips. It leaves the rest of the head bare, suggesting a beastly, punk look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Longmane_L_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer ridge of the mane; colour 1 on the inner layered tufts; colour 0 on the pointed tips and lower ends; colour 3 on a small inner patch.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Longmane_R_0.description: A chin-length, horse-style mane worn as a single strip of hair down the middle of the scalp, falling over one side of the face. It has a raised ridge along the top, ragged pointed tips and layered locks beneath.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Longmane_R_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the raised ridge along the top; colour 1 on the main body of the mane; colour 0 on the ragged tips; colour 3 on the inner underlayer.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Shortmane_01.description: A narrow, mohawk-style mane strip running from the forehead over the crown to the nape, standing tall on top with a curled tuft at the front and a chin-length rear panel. Blocky, stylised hair suggests a horse or beast look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Shortmane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front tuft and the lower back tip; colour 1 on the sides and main body of the mane; colour 2 on the top of the crown and upper back; colour 3 on small inner accents by the front.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Shortmane_01.differs: The male mane stands taller on top and its front tuft curls up more prominently.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Spikymane_01.description: A narrow mohawk-style mane of jagged, angular spikes running front to back along the centre of the scalp, with a longer spiky tuft sweeping down the back of the head. Low-poly, beastly punk look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Horsehead_Spikymane_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the mane strip; colour 0 on the spike tips and the lower side flaps; colour 2 on the inner shadowed underside at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Hyena_01.description: A tall, swept-back hairstyle of long jagged spiky locks that fan out over the crown and fall to a pointed tail down the back of the neck, with a shaved-looking mohawk-like strip and bare sides.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strip of locks running down the back and one side; colour 1 on the tips of those locks, fading in; colour 3 on the spiky top and front locks; colour 2 on the roots at the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Hyena_02.description: A hyena-style mohawk: a narrow central strip of swept-back, jagged tufts runs from the forehead over the crown and down the nape, tapering to a long point between the shoulders. The sides of the head stay bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Hyena_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tufts at the front and crown; colour 1 on the long tapering tips at the back; the mid-section blends between the two.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Hyena_03.description: A short, tall-on-top spiky hairstyle: a dense crown of sharp, claw-like locks that sweep forward and to the sides into long pointed bangs, leaving the sides and back of the head bare. Wild, beastly punk look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Hyena_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the crown and the roots of the locks; colour 3 on the tips and outer spikes of the locks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Kabuki_01.description: Very long kabuki-style hair: a tall, voluminous crown swept back with a star-shaped burst on top, sharp jagged front locks framing the face, and a long tapering mass falling past the waist down the back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Kabuki_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the star-shaped burst on top; colour 3 on the jagged front locks; colour 2 on the long tips at the back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Lizard_02.description: A lopsided hairpiece sitting on one side of the head: a thick swept-back swoop of hair falls past the ear to neck length, tapering to a point, with a few thin spiky locks behind it. The rest of the scalp is left bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Lizard_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the swoop, fading into colour 1 toward the tips; colour 3 on the thin inner locks; colour 2 on the root near the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Lockbox_66_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle of overlapping feather-like layered plates that sweep back from the forehead, with jagged fringe points at the front and sharp spiky tips fanning down the nape and sides. A small horn-like spike juts from the back of the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main feather layers, fading toward colour 0 at the front crown; colour 2 on the back and underside of the hair; colour 3 on the spiky tips and the horn spike.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Mad_Scientist_02.description: A tall, swept-back hairstyle with a voluminous crest on top, jagged spiky tips fanning out at the back and crown, and short strands at the temples. It ends around chin length with a wild, eccentric look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Mad_Scientist_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jagged tips and back of the hair; colour 1 on the swept top and front strands; colour 3 on the side patches above the ears; colour 2 not visible.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Mindslayer_01.description: Long, loose upper-back-length hair with a centre part, swept back from the crown in smooth waves. The ends break into curling, tentacle-like strands that hang in front of the face and over the shoulders.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Mindslayer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair roots and upper lengths; colour 1 on the wavy ends and curling strands, blending from the roots.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Mindslayer_01.differs: The male version hangs longer down the back and the front strands drape lower over the chest.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A swept-back hairstyle with layered, sculpted locks forming a tall crest on top and a long tapering tail down the back of the head, with a longer strand falling forward over one side of the face.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main locks and crest; colour 1 on the underlying strands and inner streaks along the sides and back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: Long, loose hair swept back from the face and falling to the upper back, with a gradient into pointed tips at the ends and a few long face-framing strands that hang forward over the front.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tips at the ends; colour 2 on the swept strands across the top and sides; colour 3 on the long front strands.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: This version falls only to the upper back, slightly shorter than the female version.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: Upper-back-length wavy hair with a deep side sweep. Two thick swooping front locks frame the forehead, and long layered waves fall past the shoulders and taper into pointed, wispy tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tips of the lower waves; colour 2 on the two swooping front locks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Monkey_01.description: A tall, spiky hairstyle of layered flame-like locks that sweep upward into pointed tips, with a jagged hairline on the forehead and a fuller rounded shape reaching about chin length at the sides and back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair locks; colour 1 on the shadowed inner strands and edges between locks.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Monkey_01.differs: The male version hangs slightly longer, to chin length at the sides and back, and looks fuller than the female version.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Moth_01.description: A mane-like hairstyle of layered, feathery tufts that frames the face and wraps around the head and neck, falling to a pointed tip at the chest and upper back. Suggests a moth or beast look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and top of the hair, fading into colour 1 on the lower tufts and the rest of the mane.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Moth_02.description: Long, swept-back hair with a smooth crown that becomes a shaggy, feather-like mane of jagged pointed tufts. It drapes over the shoulders and chest and reaches the upper back, with small contrasting claw-like tips at the sides.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Moth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the lower tufts, blending from colour 0 toward the ends; small tips at the sides also take colour 0.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antenna_01.description: A pair of slender insect antennae that sprout from short segmented stalks at the brow above the eyes, then sweep back and outward in thin tapering curved points. Suggests an alien or insectoid head type.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stalk bases and segments; colour 2 on the long tapering antenna tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antennahelm_01.description: A flat, shield-like cap that sits on top of the head with a pointed brow tip over the forehead. It has a mottled, spotted surface and short curved horn spikes on each side, suggesting an insectoid alien crest.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antennahelm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and horns; colour 1 on the spots and blotches across the surface; colour 2 on the horn tips and the underside shadowing.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antennahelm_02.description: A partial insect-like head plate covering the crown and forehead, pitted with rounded dimples, ending in a point at the brow. A row of curved horn spikes runs along the top ridge, with a larger one sweeping back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Qularr_Antennahelm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 1 on the dimples; colour 2 on the horn spikes and central ridge.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Rave_01.description: A short hairstyle with shaved-looking sides and back, and a tall swept-up top of layered, jagged feathery locks that sweep back over the crown. Ragged fringe tufts fall over the forehead and temples, giving an edgy party look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top hair; colour 3 on the short sides and back and the front band; colour 1 on the tips of some tufts; colour 2 on the shaded streaks within the top locks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Rave_02.description: A short, wild feathered hairstyle: layered feather-like locks swept forward into a long fringe over one eye, with tall spiky feathers on top and a jagged ragged edge at neck length. Punk rave look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fringe and main body of the locks; colour 3 on the feather streaks at the crown and sides; colour 1 on the ends near the nape and fringe tips; colour 2 on the spiky top feathers and side tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Rave_03.description: Shoulder-length spiky rave hairstyle with tall, swept-back feathery spikes on top, heavy blunt fringe over the eyes, and a long tapering lock hanging down the front on one side.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Rave_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and mid sections of the hair; colour 2 on the darker streaked strands and inner layers; colour 3 on the tips and fringe underside; colour 0 on the highlights near the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Rave_03.differs: The male version has a shaggier, longer back with a pointed lock hanging at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Rave_04.description: Two side clusters of long banded cable-like tendrils that spring from clamp-like mounts on each side of the head and hang past the shoulders, each ending in a sharp metal point. Leaves the crown bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Rave_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the clamp mounts and the bands of the tendrils; colour 1 on the wide bands; colour 2 on the narrow banding; colour 3 on the striped bands of the longest strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_01.description: Neck-length, tousled hair swept back and across the forehead in loose wavy layers, with a band wrapped around the crown and a few thin tendril strands hanging at the front. A separate contrasting section sits under the top layer at the side and front.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept-back hair; colour 1 on the band across the crown; colour 3 on the hanging tendrils; colour 2 on the underlying hair section at the front and side.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_02.description: Wild, swept-back hair with jagged tapering locks ending around the shoulders. Small curved horn-like flares sit at the brow and temples, with contrasting side tufts framing the face. Fantasy-alien rebel look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and upper strands of the hair; colour 0 on the lower tips and front locks; colour 3 on the brow horn flares; colour 2 on the side tufts under the horns.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_02.differs: The male hair is shorter, ending at the shoulders.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_Alt_01.description: A small swept hair piece worn on one side of the head: broad sheet-like locks curve down past the cheek to chin length, with a couple of thin pointed strands curling up over the forehead like bangs.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole hair piece; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_Extra_01.description: Neck-length, tousled layered hair swept back from the face with a thick band across the crown, a contrasting underlayer, and loose wavy strands falling at the front sides and back. Casual, edgy, space-rebel style.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_Extra_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the band across the crown; colour 2 on the underlayer and front side locks.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Renegade_Extra_01.differs: The male hair is shorter, ending at the neck rather than reaching the shoulders.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A short, chin-length choppy hairstyle of layered, pointed strands radiating from a crown swirl, with a long side-swept fringe falling over one eye and ragged tips at the nape and ears.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base hair and most strands; colour 1 on the streaked strands running from crown to tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Rocker_01.description: Shoulder-length, layered hair swept up into a tall, spiky, feathered crest on top, with long ragged strands falling past the face and down the back, plus a couple of thin trailing locks at the front. A rocker style.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on streaks through the back layers; colour 3 on the roots at the front hairline sides; colour 2 on the tips of the long front locks and the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Sasquatch_01.description: A pair of jagged, blade-like sideburn tufts hanging in front of the ears down to the jaw line, with serrated, fur-like edges that taper to sharp points. Suits a beastly or monstrous look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of each tuft; colour 1 on the outer edges and lower serrations; colour 2 on the tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Sidepeak_01.description: Chin-length, wild spiky hair swept up into tall jagged shards on top and back, with a raised swept-back forelock at the front and feathered wing-like tufts flaring over the temples and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Sidepeak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main spiky mass of hair, fading toward colour 0 at the tips; colour 2 on the front forelock swept over the brow; colour 3 on the flared side tufts by the temples and ears.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Suave_01.description: A small, tall crest of hair swept into a narrow mohawk-like fin along the centre of the scalp, with sharp pointed tips that flare up and back. The rest of the head stays bare. Sleek, feral and stylised.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Suave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the crest; colour 1 on the tall front tip; colour 2 on the tip of the shorter rear point; colour 3 on the small spike at the side.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Swing_01.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle made of layered, pointed locks that sweep from a side part across the forehead, with jagged tips at the fringe, nape and crown. It sits close to the head and stops at about the ears.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the edges and tips of the locks and on the underside shading.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Swing_02.description: Chin-length wavy hair swept to one side with a thick fringe falling over the brow, and curled, flicked-out ends that wrap around the ears and nape. Soft layered locks give a tousled retro swing look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair at the crown and roots; colour 1 on the curled lower locks and ends, blending from the top down.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Beast_Lycan_01.description: Chin-length feral hair styled as a swept-back crest of jagged, spiky fur tufts with streaked markings, with a heavy fringe over the brow and shaggy locks framing the sides and nape.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Beast_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fur body; colour 0 on the fluffy fur edges and tips; colour 2 on the streaks; colour 3 on the accent markings.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Beast_Lycan_01.differs: The male version has a broader mass of fur that covers more of the forehead and brow, with a lower crest.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Aberrant_01.description: A strange chin-length hairstyle of thin, ribbed strands that arch over the scalp like a cage, with long straight locks hanging down around the ears and the back of the head. The scalp shows through between the strands.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Aberrant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arched strands across the top of the head and the roots; colour 1 on the long hanging locks and their tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_01.description: A large, rounded afro hairstyle with a soft, textured, clumpy surface. It sits tall and full on top of the head, reaches about chin length at the back, and shows a short fringe strip at the forehead with small sideburn tufts.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the highlights across the top of the hair; colour 1 on the lower hair, forehead fringe and sideburn tufts; colour 2 on the shadowed clumps.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_01.differs: The male version shows a visible hairline strip across the forehead beneath the afro and hangs a little lower, to chin length.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_02.description: A short, rounded afro: a dense, textured mass of curls sitting full over the head, with a slim hairline band at the forehead and short tapered sideburn points beside the ears. It ends above the jaw.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the highlights of the curls; colour 1 on the lower curls, hairline band, sideburns and underside; the mottled texture blends the two.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_02.differs: The male afro is slightly lower and more compact, with a visible hairline band across the forehead.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_03.description: A short, rounded afro of lumpy, textured hair that sits close over the crown and ends above the jaw, with pointed sideburn tips by the ears and a smooth band of hair across the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper mass of the hair; colour 1 toward the lower edge, the sideburn tips and the forehead band, with mottled shading from the hair texture.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Afro_03.differs: The male version adds a separate smooth band of hair across the forehead under the fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Combover_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull, with a band of swept strands combed back across the crown in separated streaks. The cut ends above the ears and nape, giving a neat, conservative look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Combover_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept strands across the top; colour 1 on the lower hair over the forehead, sides and back, with a gradient blending between them.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Cornrows_01.description: Close-cropped cornrow hairstyle: narrow raised braided ridges run front to back over the scalp, curving down along the sides, with gaps between rows showing the scalp. Ends above the jaw at the nape and temples.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Cornrows_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the braid ridges; colour 1 on the braid tips near the forehead and temples; colour 2 on the lower braid ends at the nape and sides.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Dreadsspike.description: A short, dense hairstyle of many thin braided spikes radiating outward in all directions from the scalp, tapering to sharp points. It sits tight to the head, tall on top, and ends around chin height at the back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Dreadsspike.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main length of each braid; colour 3 on the tapering tips and some of the braid ends; colour 1 as faint shading near the roots.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Maniac_01.description: Sparse, wild hairstyle of a few thin, pointed blade-like strands grouped into three spiky tufts on top of an otherwise bare scalp, splaying outward and upward with a feral, maniacal look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Maniac_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair strands; the darker shading on some strands is from the material, and no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Maniac_02.description: Sparse wild hairstyle of two separate tufts of sharp, blade-like flat strands splaying outward from each side of the top of the head, leaving the scalp bare between them; a feral, punkish look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Maniac_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 2 on the darker edges and undersides of the strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Maniac_03.description: Two spiky tufts of thin, sharp shards of hair sprouting from small bands on either side of the upper head, with a few stray spikes between them. Wild, punky look leaving the scalp mostly bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Maniac_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair spikes; colour 1 on the small bands that gather each tuft.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Mullet_01.description: A neck-length mullet hairstyle with smooth, swept-back strands that fall to the nape and flare slightly at the ends, with a few small spiky tufts poking up at the front hairline.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Mullet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaked strand lines; colour 1 on the small spiky tufts at the front.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Receding_01.description: Short, close-cropped hair that hugs the skull with a deeply receding hairline, leaving the forehead bare. A swept-back front tuft and small pointed locks frame the temples and sideburns; ends above the jaw.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Receding_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and back of the hair; colour 1 on the front tuft, temple locks and sideburns, blending into colour 0.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Receding_Me.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with a receding hairline: a bare forehead patch at the front, tapered layered locks swept back over the crown, and jagged pointed tips at the nape and temples.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Receding_Me.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front fringe edges and side locks; colour 0 on the crown and back of the hair, with a gradient blending between them; the exposed scalp patch at the front is a unrecoloured area.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Werewolf_01.description: A narrow mohawk crest of layered, pointed blade-like tufts running from the forehead over the crown and down the back of the head to the nape, leaving the sides bare. Wild, feral punk styling.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Face_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tufts, mostly toward the outer tips; colour 0 on the inner roots and the front of the crest.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A crest of long, rigid faceted spikes fanning out from the front hairline over the top of the head. The spikes arc back and up, with blunt crystalline tips, like a stylised flaming or feathered headdress.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 at the base where the spikes meet at the forehead; colour 1 on the inner spike lengths; colour 2 on the middle band of each spike; colour 3 on the outer spike tips.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Ponytail_01.description: A swept-back hairstyle with layered strands and a short fringe across the forehead, gathered high at the back of the head into a tied ponytail that hangs in a tapering tail to about neck or shoulder level.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Ponytail_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 1 on the hair tie band around the base of the ponytail.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.description: A short, tight punk hairstyle swept back from the face with a heavy fringe across the forehead, spiky layered tips at the crown and back, and two thin locks hanging down in front of the ears.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the hair and fringe; colour 1 on the tips and the long side locks; colour 2 on the darker roots at the crown and back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.differs: The male version is neck length, with slightly shorter front locks and a lower, flatter crown than the female version.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.description: Short punk hair swept back from a centre parting in layered ridged strands, with a cap-like crown and pointed spiky locks falling in front of the ears and along the sides to neck length.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper strands; colour 1 on the lower tips of the strands; colour 2 on the underside at the parting and back; colour 3 in faint streaks on the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.differs: This version has slightly longer side locks reaching neck length.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_.description: A short, tight samurai-style haircut swept back from a pointed widow's-peak front, with a tall cylindrical topknot bound at its base by a thin tie. The hair stays above the jaw and has a slight swept tail at the back.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 form a striped pattern across the hair and topknot; colour 3 on the tie around the topknot base.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_.differs: The male version is shorter, with a swept-back pointed hairline instead of a straight fringe, and has no long strands hanging by the ears.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_.description: Short, chin-length hair with a swept fringe and streaky banded strands, gathered into a tall topknot bound by a band at the crown; the tip fans out in messy, spiky tufts.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the streaks through the hair; colour 1 on the topknot binding band; colour 3 on the thin edging of the band.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Streakspiked_01.description: A short, cropped hairstyle swept back and up into a crest of long, sharp spikes on top and at the sides, with a tight contrasting base hugging the nape and a short fringe over the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Streakspiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper spikes and crown; colour 1 on streaks running through the spikes; colour 2 on the tight lower hair, nape and fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Topknot_01.description: A high topknot ponytail gathered by a small cylindrical tie at the crown, with a single smooth tapered sweep of hair arcing back and down to a point at neck length, leaving the sides of the head bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Topknot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 1 on the hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Topknot_02.description: A short high ponytail gathered at the crown of the head by a chunky cylindrical tie, with a single smooth tapering lock that sweeps back and down to a point at chin length.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Tight_Topknot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair lock; colour 1 on the cylindrical hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_01.description: Swept-back hair with smooth ridged strands combed from the front hairline over the crown, gathered at the back, then falling in loose layered wavy locks to neck length with pointed tips.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept-back top section; colour 1 on the lower flowing lengths; colour 3 on streaks through the lower locks.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_01.differs: The male hair is shorter, ending at the neck, while the female version reaches the shoulders.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_02.description: A sparse hairstyle of a few long, tapering locks swept back from the forehead, with short pointed bangs at the front hairline and longer strands trailing down past the ears to chin length; the crown is left bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long side and back locks; colour 1 on the short front bangs and the top locks.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_03.description: A small ponytail of a single tapering hair lock, gathered by a short cylindrical band at the back of the crown and falling to roughly chin length in a pointed, swept-back tip. Only the ponytail is present, so the rest of the head stays bare.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair lock; colour 3 on the tie band.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_04.description: A sparse hairstyle of a short ponytail swept back and bound by a band at the back of the head, plus a few thin, pointed bangs that curve down across the forehead and sides of the face.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands of the ponytail and bangs; colour 1 on the tips of the front bangs; colour 3 on the ponytail band.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Traveler_04.differs: The male ponytail sits lower at the back of the head and hangs more directly downward.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with a centre parting, swept side bangs falling over the forehead, and layered choppy strands with jagged tips at the nape. Separate coloured sections give it a striking multi-tone look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and side hair and the lower nape tips; colour 3 on the crown and back section; colour 1 on the bang streak on one side; colour 2 on the bang streak on the other side.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_02.description: A chin-length braided hairstyle: thick woven plaits cover the crown and back, with shorter shaved-looking side panels and a band wrapped around the back. Hanging braided tails end in small contrasting cuffs.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the braids and band; colour 1 on the side panels at the temples; colour 3 on the cuffs at the braid ends and the band clasp.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_03.description: A chin-length, swept-back hairstyle with long side-swept front locks that fall over the eyes, a thick rope-twist band wrapped across one side of the head, and a straight-cut blunt section falling below it.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and back; colour 3 on the rope-twist band; colour 1 on the straight hanging section below the band; colour 2 on the thin curled front strands.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_04.description: Short, textured swept-back hair ending at the nape, with a fringe across the forehead and a crest of long, curved pointed blades or flames sweeping up and back from the front hairline over the top and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mass of hair and the fringe; colour 1 on the base of the front crest blades; colour 2 on the tall central crest blades; colour 3 on the outer side blades.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_05.description: A side-swept hairstyle with a swooping front fringe across one side of the face and a shaved-looking other side. Layered strands fall to the shoulders, with a separate ruffled panel at the side.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept top fringe; colour 0 on the front strands by the face; colour 2 on the main back and side hair; colour 3 on the ruffled side panel and inner back strands.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_05.differs: The male hair stops at shoulder length, slightly shorter than the female version, which reaches the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_06.description: Chin-length layered hair swept back from the forehead into a twisted, pulled-back crown, with a long fringe of jagged strands falling over the eyes and choppy, tapered ends around the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Valorous_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair and back; colour 1 on the fringe strands; colour 3 on the streak edging the fringe and the side stripe.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Windswept_01.description: Upper-back-length windswept hair swept back into layered, jagged spiky locks, with a short messy fringe on top and two low braided pigtails tied with small bands at the front of the shoulders.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Windswept_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the fringe and crown; colour 0 on the main hair and braids; colour 1 on the spiky tips and braid ends; colour 3 on the braid ties.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Windswept_01.differs: The male version has more of the back mass in colour 1, and the braids sit slightly smaller and tucked closer to the neck.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Windswept_02.description: Tousled, swept-back hair with a short choppy fringe over the forehead and layered sharp spikes streaming back to shoulder length, giving a wild windblown look.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Windswept_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the fringe and top layer at the front; colour 0 on the mid-section strands; colour 1 on the tips and lower back spikes.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Windswept_02.differs: The male version is shorter, ending at shoulder length, with less trailing length at the back.

Male/M_Hair_Child_Winged_01.description: Long, straight, swept-back hair with a smooth crown, falling in streaky layered strands to mid-back with a jagged, ragged hem. Small curled locks frame the temples in front of the ears.
Male/M_Hair_Child_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass, fading toward colour 2 at the jagged ends; colour 1 on the curled locks at the temples.

Male/M_Hair_Cold_01.description: A tall swept-up crown of jagged, icicle-like crystalline spikes with a chin-length shaggy fringe, plus a pair of curved claw-like prongs that arc over the forehead. Suggests a frozen, monstrous or elemental look.
Male/M_Hair_Cold_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the spikes; colour 1 on the shading toward the spike tips and back; colour 2 on the base under the spikes; colour 3 on the curved forehead prongs.

Male/M_Hair_Curly_01.description: A short, tightly curled hairstyle made of dense, sculpted spiral curls that cap the crown and sides and reach the nape. The front is cut back to leave the forehead and face open.
Male/M_Hair_Curly_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all of the curls, with the shading showing the curl detail.

Male/M_Hair_Cybernetic_Monster_01.description: A mohawk made of a single row of segmented mechanical plates, each ending in a long backward-curving claw-like spike. The blades are tallest at the front and shorter toward the nape, running down the centre of the head.
Male/M_Hair_Cybernetic_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate segments; colour 1 on the raised bands across the plates; colour 2 on the joints and plate edges; colour 3 on the curved spike tips.

Male/M_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle of sharp, flame-like sculpted locks that blend toward pointed tips streaming behind the head. The front hairline is an open, notched cutout, and the spiky, layered mass sits close to the skull.
Male/M_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the locks.
Male/M_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.differs: The male version has no separate band across the forehead; the front is an open notch in the hair.

Male/M_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_B.description: A swept-back hairstyle of layered, flame-like pointed locks that flare into long spiky tips trailing behind the head. The front edge is an open, cut-out fringe over the forehead. Chin-length, with a wild, monstrous look.
Male/M_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_B.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the locks; colour 1 on the tips of the locks, fading in from the base.
Male/M_Hair_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_B.differs: The male version has an open, hollow-looking front edge and no separate forehead band.

Male/M_Hair_Dreadlocks_Long_03.description: Long braided dreadlocks swept back from the forehead and hanging to the upper back, with thick twisted plaits and curled ends. A contrasting band sits across the hairline, and shorter braids frame the front of the shoulders.
Male/M_Hair_Dreadlocks_Long_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main braided strands; colour 1 on the twisted accent strands running through the plaits and the tips; colour 2 on the band at the hairline.

Male/M_Hair_Element_Fire_01.description: A tall, chin-length hairstyle sculpted as swept-back flames: glossy, pointed tongues of hair rise high over the crown and stream backward, with a short blunt fringe across the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the scheme and shows a sheen; a hint of colour 1 shows in the inner flame layers, with the rest reading as a near-solid mass.

Male/M_Hair_Element_Water_01.description: A tall, flame-like hairstyle of swept, curling tendrils that rise to a hooked tip above the crown and fall to chin length around the head, with a short fringe of spiky strands over the forehead. Fantasy elemental look.
Male/M_Hair_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper tendrils and curled tips; colour 3 on the streaks running through the middle of the flames; colour 0 on the lower strands and highlights; colour 1 on the ends of the lowest strands.
Male/M_Hair_Element_Water_01.differs: The male version takes the colour scheme in bands from contrasting tips through streaked contrasting flames to contrasting lower strands, instead of a uniform glossy finish.

Male/M_Hair_Face_90s_Ponytail_01.description: A short, spiky hairstyle with jagged swept-forward bangs across the forehead and a high ponytail gathered by a small tie at the crown, tapering to a point and hanging to about neck length.
Male/M_Hair_Face_90s_Ponytail_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and streaks; colour 1 on the streaked strands running through the hair; colour 2 on the hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Ironclad_01.description: Shoulder-length, swept-back hair with streaky strands, a fan-shaped pleated section across the crown and ragged, pointed tips, worn loose behind the ears and down the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 1 on the fan-shaped crown section at the front of the head; colour 2 on the darkened tips of the strands.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Ironclad_01.differs: The male hair is shorter, ending at the shoulders rather than reaching the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Sapphire_01.description: Long, swept-back hair with side-parted fringe falling around the face, gathered into a low tie at the lower back and ending in a wavy, tapered ponytail that reaches past the waist. Retro glamour style.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on streaked highlights through the strands; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Witchcraft_.description: Very long, straight hair with a full crown and choppy blunt fringe over the forehead, falling in layered tapered locks past the waist down the back, with jagged wispy tips and a few strands drawn forward.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Anniversary_Witchcraft_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 1 tints the ends of the locks toward the tips.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_01.description: A slicked-back hairstyle that hugs the scalp with a receding front hairline, gathered at the nape by a small tie into a single long plaited braid that hangs down the back to upper-back length and tapers to a point.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and braid; colour 1 on the top and front scalp edge of the hair; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_02.description: A close-fitting short hair cap with a single thin braid gathered at the nape by a small tie, then curving over the shoulder and tapering to a point. A sleek, practical look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and braid; colour 1 on the streaked top and front of the cap; colour 2 on the braid's tapering tip; colour 3 on the hair tie.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Asianbraid_02.differs: The braid is shorter, ending around the shoulder, while the female version hangs longer down the chest.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Bat_01.description: Short, tall-on-top spiky hairstyle of sharp, swept-back tufts, with longer fringe spikes falling over the forehead and jagged points raised along the crown and back. The sides stay shaved close, giving a punk, feral look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and top tufts; colour 1 on the tips of the front and side spikes; colour 2 on the back and crown hair; colour 3 on the tips of the rear and crown spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Brutal_01.description: Chin-length swept-back hair gathered into a small top knot with a tie. A jagged fringe band with a curved claw-like tip crosses the brow, spiky feather-like points flick out at the nape, and small curved horns curl from the sides and knot.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair strands, knot and fringe; colour 1 on the gradient across the crown and back of the hair; colour 3 on the tie around the knot; colour 2 on the darker tips of the horns and nape spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Brutal_02.description: A swept-back hairstyle with a shaved-sides mohawk-like top, combed smoothly from the forehead to the back, gathered into a long braid down the centre of the back of the head, bound with contrasting ties and ending in pointed tips.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and braid strands; colour 1 on the streaked highlights through the hair and braid; colour 3 on the ties wrapped around the braid.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Brutal_03.description: A neck-length, layered shaggy hairstyle with long streaky strands, ragged pointed tips and a swept fringe over the brow; the crown is smooth and the ends are jagged and wild.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and strands; colour 2 on the darkened crown and parting; colour 1 on the ragged tips and a few highlight tufts.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Brutal_03.differs: The male version is neck length with a more open, hollow-looking front, while the female version is chin length with a fuller fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Buzzcut_01.description: A short, boxy buzzcut with a flat top and a tapered sides-and-back cut, with a jagged tufted edge above the ears and a peaked front hairline. It sits close to the head and suggests a clean, sporty or street style.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Buzzcut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top, the fringe and the main hair mass; colour 1 on the jagged tufted patches at the temples, sides and back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.description: A short, spiky tuft of hair sitting on top of the head like a mohawk, with sharp pointed locks swept forward over the brow and back toward the crown; the sides of the head stay bare.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Cat_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tuft of hair.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Chimera_01.description: A tall, narrow mohawk of long streaked strands swept back from the forehead into a crest, with jagged spiky tips along both sides and a tapering tail down the nape. The sides of the head are left bare.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 on the spiky tips and edges of the crest; colour 2 on the shaded roots near the hairline.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Crazy_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of jagged, faceted spikes radiating in all directions, with bands of contrasting layers and a small tuft of spikes at the crown and nape. Wild, feral and punkish.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Crazy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the spikes; colour 0 on the band of spikes along the hairline; colour 2 on the darker spike clusters at the back and sides; colour 3 on the tufts at the front crown and nape.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Crazy_02.description: A wild, chin-length hairstyle made of jagged, angular shards that stick out in all directions and stand tall on top, with layered bands of spiky tufts and a small strip of contrasting hair at the crown and nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Crazy_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the hair mass; colour 0 on the band of tufts along the hairline and lower layers; colour 2 on the darker shards and bands at the sides, back and crown tips; colour 3 on the strip at the front crown and the tuft at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Crowspeak_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle with sharp swept spikes on top that sweep back from a widow's-peak point at the front. It ends above the jaw, with small pointed tufts at the sideburns and a smooth cap at the back.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Crowspeak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept spikes and top strands; colour 0 on the smooth back and sides of the cap and on the flat front brow panel; colour 2 on the shading streaks between spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Curtain_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle with a centre parting and long, heavy fringe that sweeps down over the eyes and one side of the face. Straight, choppy layers fall to a blunt edge at the jaw and nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Curtain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair overall, with shading toward the underside and back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Cybercat_01.description: A crest of thick segmented cable-like dreadlocks rising from a narrow strip along the top of the head and hanging in long strands past the shoulders, with banded rings along each strand and capped tips.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Cybercat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on alternating bands along each strand; colour 2 on the base strip at the crown; colour 3 on the strand tips.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Cyberwire_01.description: A chin-length swept-back undercut with side-swept bangs falling over one eye, tapered ragged tips, and a thick braided cable-like cord running from the temple along the shaved side to the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair, fading darker toward the tips; colour 1 on the streaked strands at the front and sides; colour 3 on the braided cord along the side of the head.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Cyberwire_01.differs: The male version has a thick braided cable running from the temple down the back of the head, while the female has only a thin contrasting braid and a tiny bead.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Long_01.description: Long dreadlocks made of many thick ropey strands falling from a crown of tangled locks to upper-back length, with a few banded strands hanging at the front and contrasting wrap bands near the ends.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lengths of the dreadlocks; colour 1 on the crown and roots; colour 2 on the wrap bands near the ends; colour 3 on small bands on the front strands.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Medium_01.description: Neck-length dreadlocks made of thick, segmented ropes that fall from a crown parting and sweep forward over the forehead, ending in uneven tips with small bands around the head.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Medium_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the locks; colour 1 on the crown and upper roots; colour 2 and colour 3 on the small bands near the tips.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Dreadlocks_Medium_01.differs: The male locks are shorter, ending at neck length, and the tips are more uneven than the female version's shoulder-length locks.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Emo_02.description: Chin-length emo hairstyle with a deep side part and long fringe swept across the forehead and over one eye. Straight, choppy strands with jagged ends cover the whole head and taper to points at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Emo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands; colour 2 on the darker streaks and roots; colour 1 on the subtle highlight streaks between strands.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Extraterrestialmohawk_0.description: A short, tall mohawk of sharp, jagged spikes running front to back along the centre of the scalp, with the sides left bare. The spikes fan upward and sweep back into a swept crest at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Extraterrestialmohawk_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike tips at the front hairline; colour 1 on the middle of the spikes; colour 2 on the crest at the top; colour 3 on the rear spikes and the back cluster.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Fluffy_01.description: Upper-back-length hair with a tall, tousled, spiky crown, straight blunt fringe across the forehead and long straight strands falling behind the shoulders, with two longer face-framing locks in front. A shaggy, wild style.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Fluffy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the tousled crown; colour 1 on the fringe and upper mid-section of the hair; colour 0 on the long lower strands; colour 3 on the face-framing front locks.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_01.description: Chin-length swept-back hair in layered jagged locks that taper to pointed tips at the nape, with a tall curled lock rising at one side of the crown that flicks outward. Edgy, punk-leaning styling.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the curled crown lock and its tip; colour 3 on the pointed tips at the nape and lower back; colour 2 on a small shadowed strand beside the curl.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_01.differs: The male version is taller on top, with a larger curl standing up at the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_02.description: A short, swept-back hair piece forming a raised layered quiff on top of the head, with a curled lock of bangs sweeping down over one temple to a pointed flick. Chunky sculpted strands suggest a stylised, edgy look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Ghosthunter_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper quiff and top strands; colour 1 on the swept-down side lock and its tip; colour 2 on the edge strands along the back of the quiff.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Goth_01.description: Short, chin-length, choppy hairstyle of layered pointed locks swept across the forehead, with spiky tufts flicking out at the sides and a ragged, feathered fringe at the nape. Gothic and punk in feel.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and swept fringe locks; colour 2 on the mid-layer locks and side tufts; colour 0 on the lower tips at the back and nape.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Goth_02.description: A neck-length bob of straight, streaky strands with thick, blunt bangs that fall across the eyes. The back is cut in a slightly uneven line, giving a sleek gothic look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown and upper hair, fading into colour 0 toward the lower strands and tips.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Goth_02.differs: The male version is cut shorter, at neck length, and the bangs hang straight across the eyes rather than being swept to one side.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Hat_Baseballcap_01.description: A balding hairstyle: a thin band of short hair wrapping around the sides and back of the head at ear level, with a straight front edge across the brow and cut-outs around the ears. The crown stays bare.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Hat_Baseballcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair band across the front; the back and sides of the band take a bluish tint from colour 1 in shading.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull in a smooth cap shape, with a few jagged, swept-across bangs over the forehead and tapered sides that stop above the ears and jaw.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Hat_Fedora_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair mass; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Hatcurls_02.description: Two clusters of chunky segmented cylinders hang beside the temples and ears like mechanical curls, each cluster having three barrels of different lengths with thin ring bands. A stylised robotic hairstyle with no hair on top.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Hatcurls_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the middle barrels; colour 1 on the front barrels; colour 2 on the rear barrels; colour 3 on the thin ring bands.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Default_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle that hugs the skull as a smooth rounded cap, with a slightly jagged hairline across the forehead and small tapered tufts by the ears; ends well above the jaw.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Default_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair cap.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_01.description: Neck-length swept-back hair with a smooth rounded crown, a widow's-peak front edge and loose ragged tips that fall over the nape. Sits close to the head and leaves the face open; a rough, matted look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on almost all of the hair; slight shading toward colour 2 in the underlying strands.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_01.differs: The male version is shorter, reaching only the neck, and is mostly a single colour, without the separate coloured lower strand tips of the female version.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_02.description: Shoulder-length sleek hair combed straight back from a widow's-peak hairline, falling smoothly down the back and ending in jagged, uneven tips. Smooth and plain with little strand detail.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on almost all of the hair; colour 2 as slight shading near the front underside of the hair.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Long_02.differs: The male hair is a smoother, plain mass with no strand stripes and no contrasting coloured tips.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Swoop_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle with a short swept-up crown and a longer curtain of hair that hangs over the forehead and covers the ears, flaring out into jagged, flicked ends around the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Swoop_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept crown at the top and front; colour 0 on the long lower hair; colour 3 on the streaks near the tips; colour 2 on the streaks in the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Swoop_Long_01.description: Long swept-back hair combed off the face and falling straight down the back to about shoulder level, with striped streaks running through it and a ragged, slightly flared tapered end.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Helmet_Swoop_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaks running through the hair; colour 1 on the tips and lower ends.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_01.description: A short, chin-length spiky hairstyle with layered pointed tips around the crown and nape, a blunt fringe, and a tall swept-up top tuft that curls back into a raised tail at the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main crown and sides of the hair; colour 0 on the spiky tips and highlights; colour 2 on the fringe and tall top tuft; colour 3 on the underlayer at the nape and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_01.differs: The male top tuft is taller and sweeps upward into a raised quiff, while the female version lies lower and flatter.
