Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_01.description: A short, tall swept-back hairstyle: a narrow crest of stiff, layered locks with pointed tips fans from the front hairline over the crown, with one lock curling upward at the front. Sides and back are bare.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tips of the locks; colour 2 on the roots and lower body of the hair; the hair fades between them.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_02.description: Short, chin-length spiky hairstyle with a swept, layered crown, sharp pointed tips flicking outward at the sides and back, a jagged blunt fringe across the forehead, and a tiered spiky underlayer at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_01_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and crown of the hair; colour 0 on the flicked spiky tips; colour 3 on the underlayer at the nape and behind the ears; colour 2 on the fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_02.description: Swept-back layered hair with a tousled crown and wavy ripple texture. It falls loose to about shoulder length and ends in ragged, pointed tips.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown down the length; colour 1 on the lower lengths and tips; colour 3 on the streak at the crown parting.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_02.differs: The male hair is shorter, ending around shoulder length, while the female version reaches the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_03.description: Short, chin-length hair with choppy, spiky layers and a fringe across the forehead, topped by a tall crest of pointed blades on the crown, with small curved tendrils hanging near the temples.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips of the side and back locks; colour 3 and colour 2 on the crown spikes and temple tendrils, fading from one to the other.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_03.differs: The male version's crown crest is a little lower and more compact, with a fuller fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_01.description: A short, tall mohawk-style hairstyle made of broad, pointed blade-like locks that fan up and back from the crown, with a few thin claw-like tendrils curling down at the temples and nape. Punky and monstrous.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the roots and most of each lock; colour 3 on the tips of the locks and tendrils.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_02.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with layered strands that end in sharp, spiky tips around the crown and nape. A separate flat fringe panel covers the forehead. The cut sits close to the head and stops above the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_03_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and the fringe panel; colour 1 on the spiky tips and the ends of the strands.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_04.description: Shoulder-length, layered, wavy hair swept back from a central parting, with a smooth crown and ragged, tapered tips. Loose, slightly tousled strands give a casual, flowing look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the mid-length strands and highlights toward the tips; colour 2 on the underlayer and ends; colour 3 on the parting streak at the front.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_04.differs: The male version is shorter, ending around the shoulders, while the female version reaches the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_05.description: A chin-length bob of layered, feathery hair in pointed locks, with a heavy fringe swept over the forehead and eyes. The cut is full and rounded around the head, with jagged tips at the nape and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the fringe and upper locks; colour 1 on the tips of the lower locks; colour 3 on the crown streak.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_06.description: A high ponytail hairstyle with swept-back top hair, a tie at the crown, and a long tail of layered spiky locks that curls out and down behind the head, with jagged bangs falling across the forehead at neck length.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and main mass of the hair; colour 1 on the tips of the bangs and side locks; colour 2 on the ends of the ponytail; colour 3 on the hair tie.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_06.differs: The male version's bangs fall forward over the forehead and one eye, rather than sweeping to the sides.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_01.description: Short, neck-length hair with a smooth swept-back crown, side-parted bangs falling over the forehead, and jagged, spiky strands that flick outward around the ears and nape. Gives a punky, energetic look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth swept crown at the top; colour 1 on the spiky strands and bangs below, fading from the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_01.differs: The male hair is shorter, reaching about neck length.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_02.description: A tall swept-back ponytail of layered, jagged locks rising from a central strip over the crown, gathered by a small band at the back of the head and trailing to neck length with spiky, tapering tips.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_06_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair, fading toward colour 2 at the lower tips; colour 3 on the hair band.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_07.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of layered, swept-back wavy locks with jagged pointed tips, a messy fringe falling over the forehead and tapered layers covering the nape and sides of the head.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips of the locks and underlayers; colour 3 on the crown at the top of the head.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_08.description: Neck-length swept-back hair with a V-shaped widow's peak hairline, a heavy fringe falling over the eyes, and long tapering layered strands that hang loose down the back and sides, ending in ragged points.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_08.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 3 on the crown and top of the head; colour 1 on the tips of the strands and the fringe ends.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_09.description: A chin-length wavy bob of layered, tousled locks with jagged pointed tips. A side parting sweeps a heavy, messy fringe across the forehead, and the hair sits full over the head and nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_09.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on streaks through the wavy locks; colour 3 on the parting at the crown; colour 2 on the darker tips at the ends.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_09.differs: The male bob is shaggier, with the fringe falling lower over the eyes.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_10.description: A tall mohawk of long, pointed feather-like spikes running in a narrow strip from forehead to nape, fanning upward and sweeping back into a tapering tail at the neck. The sides of the head are left bare.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper tips of the spikes; colour 0 on the mid-length of the spikes; colour 3 on the roots along the scalp; colour 2 on the tapering tail and lower spike edges.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_11.description: A chin-length bob with a centre parting, layered streaky strands and jagged tips. Loose, slightly tousled bangs fall over the forehead, and the hair frames the face and covers the nape in a rounded shape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_11.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and streaks; colour 1 on the lower tips and ends; colour 3 on the roots along the parting; colour 2 in shading streaks between strands.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_11.differs: The male bob is looser and more tousled, with slightly longer, shaggier strands and bangs that hang lower over the face.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_12.description: A short, chin-length swept hairstyle with layered, feathery locks that swoop back from a central parting, blunt fringe across the forehead and jagged pointed tips at the nape and sides. Suggests a wild, animal-like superhero look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Heroic_12.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 3 on the strip along the centre parting; colour 1 on the swept tips of the upper locks; colour 2 on the fringe and jagged lower tips.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Kitty_01.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with a sculpted top mass of pointed locks that flick forward over the brow and out at the sides, leaving the sides and back of the head bare. Punky, stylised look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair overall, with a subtle colour 1 tint in the shaded undersides of the locks.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Knitcap_01.description: A short, close-fitting cap of hair that covers the top and back of the head, with a jagged, zigzag fringe across the brow and a choppy edge at the nape. It reaches about chin level at the sides and gives a rough, unkempt look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Knitcap_01.differs: The male version has a longer, fuller cut that reaches lower at the sides and back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Krampus_01.description: A short, wild hairstyle made of overlapping pointed shards or blades that bristle outward over the crown, sides and back of the head, with a swept-back crest on top; gives a monstrous, spiky look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer bladed shards; colour 1 on the large front and crown plates and many back spikes; colour 2 on the crest panels; colour 3 on a few small accent spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Layered_01.description: A neck-length layered hairstyle, tall and tousled on top, with choppy feathered layers and a long fringe falling over the eyes; the ends are ragged and wispy, giving a shaggy, edgy look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Layered_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tips and lower ends; colour 3 on scattered streaks and patches across the top and back; colour 2 on shaded strands around the fringe and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Layered_01.differs: The male version is shorter, ending at the neck, with more height and volume on top.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Llama_01.description: A short, choppy hairstyle of layered, jagged locks with a fringe over the forehead and small horn-like tufts at the crown. Tapered tips reach about chin level. Wild, messy, beast-like styling.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top layer and crown tufts; colour 2 on the middle layer, mostly at the sides and back; colour 0 on the lower tips and fringe.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Llama_01.differs: The male version hangs a little longer, reaching about chin level, with a slightly longer fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Long_01.description: Long hair with a centre parting and loose face-framing strands, falling in streaky, tapered locks to the shoulders. Wispy pointed tips hang at the front over an inner underlayer, for a loose, tousled style.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaky stripes running down the locks; colour 1 on the underlayer and the front tips.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Long_01.differs: This version stops at shoulder length, while the female version reaches the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Long_Looseluchador_01.description: Loose, neck-length hair in choppy, jagged strands that fall over the forehead and partly across the face, with longer wispy tips at the sides and back. It gives a messy, casual look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Long_Looseluchador_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the hair.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Longelegant_01.description: Long, sleek hairstyle with a centre parting, swept smoothly over the crown and falling straight to the neck and upper shoulders in streaked strands, with side locks framing the face and jagged, ragged ends.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Longelegant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad streaks across the top and back; colour 2 on the strands framing the face and the darker streaks; colour 1 on the ragged tips and lower underlayer.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Longelegant_01.differs: The male hair is shorter, ending around neck length, with shorter face-framing locks.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Martial_Power_01.description: A tall high ponytail gathered at the crown by a band, with a long tapering tail sweeping to mid-back, short side bangs and a few thin contrasting locks framing the face; sleek, martial-arts styling.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair; colour 1 on the lower tips of the ponytail; colour 2 on the thin strands and the swept tuft at the top; colour 3 on the hair band.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Martial_Power_02.description: A tall, high ponytail gathered at the crown by a short banded tie, falling in a long tapered sweep to mid-back with sharp blade-like locks and a few thin strands at the sides. Martial, warrior style.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair; colour 1 on the tapered tips; colour 2 on the darker streaks and top tuft; colour 3 on the hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Messy_01.description: A short messy hairstyle with tall, swept-up spiky strands on top, a side-swept fringe over the forehead, and straight layered hair cut at nape length across the back and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Messy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hairstyle, with darker shading in the underlayer at the crown and back of the head.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Messymohawk_01.description: A short, messy mohawk hairstyle: a tall crest of jagged spikes runs front to back over the crown, flanked by a fuller cap of choppy strands and a shaved-looking underlayer, with loose fringe falling across the face.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Messymohawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cap and side strands; colour 2 on the spiky crest at the front and top; colour 3 on the rear crest spikes and back strip; colour 0 on the shaved underlayer and fringe tips.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Messymohawk_02.description: A messy mohawk hairstyle with a tall crest of jagged spikes along the centre, shorter spiky sides, and ragged fringe strands falling over the forehead and brow; ends around chin length at the sides.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Messymohawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hair mass over the scalp and sides; colour 2 on the spiked crest panel beside the centre; colour 3 on the strip of spikes down the centre back; colour 0 on the fringe tips and lower edge strands.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Messyshort_01_Basic.description: Short, choppy hair with jagged, spiky tufts that sweep forward into a ragged fringe over the forehead and taper at the nape; a messy, tousled cap that stops around chin length or higher.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Messyshort_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and sides of the hair; colour 1 on the front fringe and top tufts; colour 3 on small streaks at the roots under the fringe and nape.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Middleparted_01_Basic.description: Short, voluminous swept hairstyle with a rounded, puffed crown that sweeps forward into a thick fringe over the forehead, with short tapered sides and nape sitting close to the head.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Middleparted_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and back of the hair; colour 1 on the fringe, front swept locks and lower sides, blending into colour 0 on the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Mohawk_01_Basic.description: A tall, narrow mohawk: a single ridge of swept-back strands running from forehead to nape along the centre of the head, leaving the sides bare. The strands fan into a crest with a flat textured face.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Mohawk_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 on the streaks running through the strands.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Moptop_01_Basic.description: A short, tousled moptop hairstyle with layered, jagged locks swept across the forehead in pointed fringe tips, ending above the ears and jaw, with a close-cropped rounded back and sides.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Moptop_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hair mass; colour 0 on the streaky highlights running through the hair and on the underside of the fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Moptop_02_Basic.description: A chin-length hairstyle with jagged, choppy tips: a full cap of hair over the crown and back, with an uneven fringe of spiky locks falling over the forehead and short ragged ends at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Moptop_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and lower sides of the hair; colour 1 on the top and front fringe; colour 3 on the thin streaks near the roots and ends.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Mullet_Long_01.description: A shoulder-length spiky mullet: a tall crown of jagged, radiating spikes on top, long ragged fringe over the forehead, and long tapering shards hanging down the back and sides with streaked banding.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Mullet_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaked stripes through the strands; colour 1 on the tips of the long lengths.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A chin-length choppy layered cut with a centre parting, jagged tips and a short fringe over the brow; a heavy front section curves around the face like a hood, with the rest hanging close to the head.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, back and fringe; colour 1 on the strands along the sides; colour 3 on the inner side layers and tips; colour 2 on the heavy front sections around the face.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.differs: The male version has a heavier front section forming a hood-like frame around the face, with a shorter fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: Two thin twisted braids hang in front of the ears, each curving up to a pointed tip at the temple. Each braid is bound by a rune-marked band and ends in a small cuff and tuft; the rest of the head stays bare.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the twisted braid strands; colour 3 on the wrapped bands; colour 2 on the small cuffs; colour 1 on the tufted ends.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_02.differs: The male braids are shorter, to neck length, with the bands and tufts sitting higher near the jaw.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.description: Straight hair with a choppy fringe swept across the forehead, falling in a smooth mass down the back to shoulder length and ending in jagged, feathered points. Pirate-flavoured and casual.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fringe and top of the hair; colour 2 on the crown and part line; colour 3 on the mid-length strands; colour 0 on the tips of the lower hair.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Pirate_Fancy_03.differs: The male version is shorter, ending around the shoulders instead of the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Ponytail_02.description: A short swept-back hairstyle with a high ponytail gathered by a small band at the crown, and a longer fringe that sweeps across the forehead. The tail tapers to a point behind the head.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Ponytail_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair; colour 2 on the streaks running through the strands; colour 1 on the tip of the ponytail and the fringe tip; colour 3 on the hair band.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Ponytail_02.differs: The male version has a fuller, side-swept fringe across the forehead, and the ponytail is somewhat shorter.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_01.description: A short, chin-length punk hairstyle of layered, swept strands with a long side-swept fringe that falls across one eye, a couple of small pointed tufts on top, and a jagged, choppy edge at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the swept side fringe; colour 3 on the roots at the crown and on the tips at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_02.description: A chin-length punk hairstyle of swept, layered strands combed heavily to one side, with a long fringe falling across the brow and jagged, sheared ends at the nape. Small pointed tufts stick up on top.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair strands; colour 3 on the roots and the jagged tips at the back and crown; colour 1 on the sweeping side fringe.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_03.description: Chin-length, choppy hair with jagged pointed tips and a long swept fringe that falls over the eyes, topped by a slouchy soft beret-like cap perched on one side of the head.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 3 on the tips of the hair locks; colour 1 on the cap.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_04.description: A tall, narrow mohawk of swept-back hair strands forming a central ridge from forehead to nape, with jagged spiky tips along the crest and sides. Sides of the head are left bare, giving a punk look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 1 on the underlayer and inner spikes; colour 3 on the pointed tips along the crest.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_05.description: A short chin-length punk hairstyle with choppy, jagged layered tips at the fringe and nape, and a large swept-over lock that curls across the front and side of the head, giving a swooping, rebellious look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and jagged tips; colour 1 on the large swooping front lock; colour 3 on the accent streaks along the edge of the swoop.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_Shaved_01.description: A short punk hairstyle: a swept-back strip of choppy, layered locks running front to back along the top of the head, with the sides and nape left shaved. Jagged tips give it an edgy look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Punk_Shaved_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the highlighted strands; colour 1 on the main body of the hair; colour 2 on the shadowed streaks between locks.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Reactor_01.description: A hood-like mechanical head covering made of parallel padded, segmented tubes that sweep from a peaked brow back over the head and drape to the shoulders, ending in blunt hexagonal tips. Sits over the scalp and leaves the face open.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top segments near the brow and crown; colour 2 on the upper-middle bands; colour 3 on the lower middle bands; colour 0 on the brow edge and the tube tips.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Rock_01.description: A short helmet-like cap of rocky hair: overlapping pointed stone shards cover the whole head, separated by a web of contrasting crack lines. It sits tight above the jaw with a spiky crest at the top.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Rock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone shards; colour 3 on the crack lines between them; the texture shows little variation from the other slots.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Rock_01.differs: The male version is a denser mass of overlapping pointed shards that covers the whole head with a web of crack lines; the female has larger plates on top and fewer, more open spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Sasquatch_01.description: A neck-length shaggy mane of layered, ragged strands that sweeps back from the crown and frames the face with side pieces, leaving the face open; a beastly, sasquatch-like style with a jagged, tattered lower edge.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and top of the hair, blending into colour 1 on the lower strands and the long fringe at the front and back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Sasquatch_Long_01.description: A shaggy, neck-length wild hairstyle of layered ragged strands that frames the face like a mane, with jagged tapered tips around the jaw and a full rounded volume over the crown and back.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Sasquatch_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper hair and the strands framing the face; colour 0 on the lower tips and the streaked highlights; the two blend in a gradient down the length.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Sasquatch_Long_02.description: Shaggy, neck-length wild hair built from layered jagged strands that sweep back and down from the crown, with ragged pointed tips around the nape and a rough, beastly, sasquatch-like silhouette.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Sasquatch_Long_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper hair and crown; colour 0 on the lower strands and tips near the neck, blending between the two.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Sasquatch_Spiky_01.description: Shaggy neck-length hair with a tall crest of sharp spikes on top, ragged jagged strands around the face and long tattered locks falling thickly over the back and sides of the neck. A wild, beastly look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Sasquatch_Spiky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiky crest on top and the tips of the strands; colour 1 on the main body of the hair; colour 2 on the small spikes at the back of the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Secret_03.description: A short, chin-length casual hairstyle with layered, swept-back strands on top, a side-swept fringe falling over the forehead, and jagged, choppy tips over the nape and ears. Suits everyday or edgy looks.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and fringe strands; colour 1 on the mid layer at the sides and back; colour 2 on the jagged lower tips; colour 3 as a soft tint at the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Secret_04.description: A chin-length layered cut with a side parting and long streaky strands that sweep across the forehead, ending in ragged, jagged tips around the jaw and nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 blend across the strands in streaks; colour 3 tints the hair along the parting at the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Secret_04.differs: The male cut is choppier and more tousled, with a shorter, broken fringe that leaves more of the face visible.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_02_Basic.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle with a swept-forward textured top and streaky strands, and tightly shaved sides and back that stop above the ears and nape. Casual, sporty cut sitting snug on the head.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top hair and fringe strands; colour 0 on the highlights across the crown and back of the top; colour 3 on the shaved sides and back; colour 2 on the streaks between strands.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_Golden_Age_01.description: A short, swept-back classic hairstyle with a voluminous textured top combed back from the forehead, over closely cropped tapered sides and back that leave the ears exposed. Suggests a retro superhero look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept top hair, blending into colour 3 toward the front and edges; colour 1 on the cropped sides and back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_Golden_Age_02.description: Short, classic swept-back hairstyle with a combed quill-like texture, a defined widow's-peak front edge, short sideburns and a close-cropped nape. It sits tight to the skull, giving a clean retro superhero look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_Golden_Age_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lighter roots and back of the hair; colour 1 on the streaked tips across the top and front; a separate flat panel along the hairline takes colour 0.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_Partedcurls_01.description: A short, closely cropped hairstyle with a side part and loose curls swept over the forehead, with short tapered tufts at the temples and sideburns. It fits tight to the crown and stops well above the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_Partedcurls_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and back of the hair; colour 1 on the front curls, fringe and side tufts, blending in from the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_Ruler_01.description: A short, chunky, faceted hairstyle with a swept-back top mass of blocky curls, small pointed tufts flicking out at the temples, and a close-cropped lower layer hugging the sides and nape at about chin height.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Short_Ruler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper swept curls and temple tufts; colour 1 on the close-cropped lower layer around the sides, forehead and nape.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Slickback_02_Basic.description: A short, slicked-back pompadour hairstyle with a swept-up front quiff, streaky strands running back over the crown, and smooth tapered sides and back that stop above the jaw. A separate band sits across the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Slickback_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, back and the band across the forehead; colour 1 on the swept streaks through the top and front; colour 2 on the shadowed strands at the front and sides.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Slickbacktail_01.description: A slicked-back hairstyle swept up and away from the forehead with a swooping quiff, gathered at the nape into a single long ponytail that tapers to a point and hangs between the shoulder blades, tied with a small band.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Slickbacktail_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and the ponytail lengths; colour 1 on the tips, the fringe and the swept top; colour 3 on the small hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Snakes_01.description: A shoulder-length Medusa-style hairstyle made of a writhing mass of spotted snakes with open mouths and forked tongues, radiating outward from the scalp in all directions and hanging down around the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Snakes_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the snake bodies; colour 2 on the spots and markings; colour 1 on the underbelly snakes visible beneath the scalp; the tongues show a separate pinkish tone.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Spikey_Long_01.description: A tall, swept-up hairstyle of sharp faceted spikes that fan outward from the crown, with shorter jagged locks around the sides and nape and a smooth band across the forehead. Anime-style and stylised.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Spikey_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and forehead band; colour 1 on the spike tips.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Spy_01.description: Neck-length layered hairstyle swept back from the forehead with long fringe strands falling over the eyes and face. Ends in jagged, flicked-out tips around the neck, giving a sleek, edgy spy look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hair and swept-back strands; colour 2 on the mid-length transition; colour 1 on the lower tips and the fringe over the face.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Spy_02.description: A short, chin-length swept-back hairstyle with a tall rounded pompadour front, streaky strand texture, and short sideburn tabs down past the ears; a separate flat panel sits under the front fringe, covering the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and roots of the hair; colour 0 on the strand highlights toward the ends and sideburns; colour 2 on the panel under the front.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Swoop_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle with a tall swept-up crest of jagged, spiky strands on top, heavy blunt-cut fringe across the forehead, and smooth tapered sides and back that hug the head.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Swoop_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair overall, with the shading of the strands varying along their length.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Tight_Punkmedium_01.description: Neck-length punk hairstyle: a wide central mohawk-like swath of hair swept back over the crown and down the nape, framed by thin separate strands that trail along the sides and end in ragged wisps.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Tight_Punkmedium_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main central swath of hair; colour 1 on the thin trailing side strands and edge strands.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Undercut_01.description: A short undercut hairstyle: closely cropped sides and back with a fringe over the forehead, topped by a tall, swept-back mass of jagged, feathered strands that sits like a crest above a shaved-looking band.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Undercut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the short sides, back and fringe; colour 1 on the tall swept top section; colour 2 on the band beneath the top layer at the back.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Anime_01.description: Short, chin-length anime-style hair with a long side-swept fringe covering one eye, choppy jagged strands at the fringe and nape, and a rounded cap shape over the crown.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the hair; the piece shows no other colour slots on this sheet.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Anime_01.differs: The male version is a short, chin-length cut with no long front locks or contrasting tips, unlike the long female version.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Buzz_Shapes_01.description: A close-cropped, skull-hugging buzz cut with jagged, flame-like spikes swept across the front hairline and horizontal slashed bands shaved into the sides and back. It gives a sleek, edgy urban look.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Buzz_Shapes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown and back bands; colour 1 on the front fringe spikes and the side slash tips.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Mohawk_01.description: A mohawk of long, tapering spikes in a single narrow row from forehead to nape, fanning out and sweeping back. The sides of the head stay bare. A punk look with a bold silhouette.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Mohawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bases near the scalp; colour 1 on the mid-length of each spike; colour 2 on the spike shafts between the mid-length and the tips; colour 3 on the spike tips.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Punk_01.description: A short, chin-length punk hairstyle with a spiky, tousled crown, choppy layered strands and a heavy fringe falling over the forehead; the tips are streaked with contrasting bands and the nape is cut short.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown and upper hair; colour 1 and colour 3 on the streaked lower strands and fringe tips; colour 2 on the darker inner strands at the back.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Urban_Punk_01.differs: The male version has a fuller, heavier fringe that covers more of the forehead and brow.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Villain_01.description: A voluminous, tousled hairstyle of layered strands swept back from a blunt fringe, with jagged spiky tufts at the crown and temples and longer swept locks over the ears, ending at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on most of the hair; colour 1 on streaks through the top; colour 2 on the fringe and lower back; colour 0 on the tips of the fringe and nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Villain_01.differs: The male hair is bigger and messier, with jagged spiky tufts, longer side locks over the ears and light-coloured tips on the fringe and nape.

Male/M_Hair_Face_Villain_02.description: Short, neatly trimmed hairstyle swept back and to the side from a heavy fringe, with streaked strands running front to back. Sits close to the head and ends around the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Villain_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the streaks through the top and sides; colour 2 on the darkened lower edge of the fringe and nape.
Male/M_Hair_Face_Villain_02.differs: The male version is a smooth, compact cut without the jagged flicked-out side locks or the light nape tips of the female version.

Male/M_Hair_Facemask_Chaosman_01.description: Short cropped hairstyle of jagged, faceted spikes forming a flat-topped crest across the crown, with a few longer separate spikes at the front hairline; the sides and back of the head are bare.
Male/M_Hair_Facemask_Chaosman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes at the sides and back; colour 1 on the top of the crest; colour 2 on the front fringe spikes and the small strands at the hairline.

Male/M_Hair_Facemask_Chaosman_02.description: Short, spiky hair with jagged shards standing up on top and a fringe of sharp spikes at the front. A close-cropped band of hair wraps the sides and back of the head, ending above the jaw.
Male/M_Hair_Facemask_Chaosman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes of the crown; colour 1 on the tips and top of the spikes; colour 2 on the front fringe spikes; colour 3 on the cropped sides and back.

Male/M_Hair_Fennec_01.description: A short, crest-style hairstyle of layered swept locks that rise into several sharp, curved points along the centre of the head, like fox-ear tufts. The sides of the head are left bare.
Male/M_Hair_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and body of the locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of each lock.

Male/M_Hair_Gladiator_01.description: A swept-back hairstyle with a close-cropped, shaved-looking cap at the sides and back, a voluminous swept top, and a single plait draped over one shoulder and down the chest, tied off with a band near the tip.
Male/M_Hair_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept top hair and the plait highlights; colour 1 on the fading tips, the lower hair and the plait strands; colour 3 on the band tying the plait; colour 2 on the cropped sides and back.
Male/M_Hair_Gladiator_01.differs: The male plait is shorter, ending around the shoulder, and the cropped contrasting cap covers more of the head.

Male/M_Hair_Gladiator_02.description: Shoulder-length wavy hair swept back and to the side from a raised, smooth crown, with layered strands that curl and flick outward at the ends. Sits over the head and falls behind the shoulders.
Male/M_Hair_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the roots and upper hair; colour 1 on the lower lengths and curled tips as a gradient; colour 2 on the small band at the front hairline.

Male/M_Hair_Gladiator_Helmet_01.description: A single thick braid attached at the side of the head by a small helmet-like cap, hanging down over the shoulder to the front of the chest, with a tie near the end and a loose tapered tuft.
Male/M_Hair_Gladiator_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cap and the braid strands and tuft; colour 0 on the highlight strands between the braid plaits; colour 3 on the tie band.
Male/M_Hair_Gladiator_Helmet_01.differs: The male braid is shorter, ending at shoulder length, with the tuft ending higher on the chest.

Male/M_Hair_Goat_01.description: A chin-length asymmetric hairstyle: a swept side fringe of layered, pointed locks falls over one side of the face, while the rest of the head is left bare. The tips are jagged and spiky, with a hollow underside at the back.
Male/M_Hair_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the long sweeping front fringe strand; colour 2 on the tapered lower tips; colour 3 on the short strand at the side.

Male/M_Hair_Goat_02.description: A neck-length hairstyle of jagged, choppy layers with a large swept-up tuft over the forehead, a separate side section and a small tuft at the crown. Ragged tips hang over the brow and nape.
Male/M_Hair_Goat_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept front tuft and crown tuft; colour 0 on the side sections; colour 2 on the upper back and top of the hair; colour 3 on the fringe and the lower tips.
Male/M_Hair_Goat_02.differs: The male version is neck length, with a heavier jagged fringe hanging low over the eyes.

Male/M_Hair_Guardian_01.description: A small sculpted hair tuft at the back of the head, hanging down the nape as a chunky, twisted lock with layered swept-back spikes like dragon fins; it ends in a sharp point at the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the lock; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the swept spikes.
Male/M_Hair_Guardian_01.differs: The male lock is shorter and stubbier, stopping at neck length with tighter, closer-set spikes.

Male/M_Hair_Highrise_01.description: A boxy, flat-topped high-top hairstyle with a textured, rough surface that fades toward the lower edge. It has a squared front hairline with an angular cut-out above the brow, short sideburn points, and a straight cropped nape.
Male/M_Hair_Highrise_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper, textured part of the hair; colour 0 on the lower, faded part; colour 2 on the angular front cut-out panel.

Male/M_Hair_Hyena_01.description: A hyena-inspired mohawk: a strip of long, jagged spiked locks runs from the forehead over the crown and down the back of the neck, with shorter swept-out spikes on top. The sides of the head are left bare.
Male/M_Hair_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and nape strip, fading toward colour 1 at the tips; colour 3 on the swept spikes at the front and top; colour 2 at the roots on top.

Male/M_Hair_Hyena_02.description: A hyena-style mohawk: a narrow central ridge of layered, swept-back spiky locks running from the forehead over the crown and down the nape, with the tips tapering to a point at the neck. Sides of the head stay bare.
Male/M_Hair_Hyena_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and top tufts at the crown; colour 1 on the lower locks, blending toward the tips at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Hyena_03.description: A short, tall-crowned hairstyle of sharp, tapering spikes swept forward and to the side into jagged bangs, with a raised tuft on top. The sides and back of the head are left bare. Suits a wild, feral look.
Male/M_Hair_Hyena_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spike tips and outer strands; colour 2 on the crown and roots of the hair; colour 0 and colour 1 are not visible.

Male/M_Hair_Kabuki_01.description: Very long, tall kabuki-style hair: a big swept-up crown with a starburst of spiky strands on top, two front locks of jagged tips framing the face, and a long tapering mane down the back past the waist.
Male/M_Hair_Kabuki_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the starburst at the top of the crown; colour 3 on the front locks; colour 2 on the lower length of the mane.

Male/M_Hair_Lizard_02.description: A swept-back hair piece forming a raised crest that starts at the front hairline and runs over the crown, with long tapering strands hanging down the side and back to neck length. Suggests a monstrous, punk look.
Male/M_Hair_Lizard_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the crest and the upper strands; colour 1 on the tapering strand tips; colour 3 on the inner strands beneath the crest; colour 2 on the base at the back of the crest.

Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_65_01.description: A chin-length swept hairstyle with a long side-swept fringe and streaked strands, gathered into a tall top bun held by an ornate metal clasp with a central gem and curling horn-like prongs.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hair and bun; colour 2 on the streaked strands; colour 0 on the metal clasp; colour 3 on the gem in the clasp.

Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_65_02.description: Long, loose wavy hair gathered into a tall top knot on the crown, fastened with a small pointed clasp, with the rest falling in layered locks to the upper back and framing strands at the face.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hair mass and top knot; colour 2 on the darker streaks framing the face and sides; colour 0 on the clasp at the base of the knot.

Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_65_03.description: Chin-length swept hair with a long side-swept fringe and streaked strands, gathered into a tall round topknot at the crown. A metal ornamental clasp with curved horn-like prongs and a central gem wraps the bun base.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_65_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hair and bun; colour 2 on the streaks in the fringe and sides; colour 0 on the metal clasp; colour 3 on the gem in the clasp.

Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_65_04.description: Long, loose wavy hair worn in a half-up style, with a small top knot gathered by a pointed clasp above the crown. The rest falls in layered, tapered locks to the upper back, with a few contrasting strands framing the face.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_65_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hair and top knot; colour 0 on the clasp band around the knot; colour 2 on the accent strands at the temples and sides.

Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_66_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle built from overlapping feather-like layered plates that fan back from the forehead over the crown, with short jagged fringe at the front and sharp pointed tips flicking out around the nape and sides, plus a small horn-like spike at the back.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the feather plates; colour 0 on the fanned plates at the front of the crown; colour 2 on the back and underside of the plates; colour 3 on the spiky tips and the small horn spike.

Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_01.description: Mid-back hairstyle with a short blunt fringe over the eyes, hair swept back into a thin braided band around the head, and four long twisted locks with bulbous knots and pointed tips hanging down.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass, fringe and head braid; colour 1 on the four hanging knotted locks.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The male version has the four knotted locks hanging in a row down the chest and back, rather than being split into front and back pairs.

Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_02.description: Chin-length, tousled hair with a deep centre-ish part, wavy layered strands, long fringe falling over the eyes, and a curling contrasting front section that sweeps to one side with flicked-out ends at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the swept front section, curled fringe locks and the strands at one side.

Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_03.description: Mid-back length hair with a blunt fringe over the eyes and a smooth swept-back crown held by a thin braided band; four long segmented braids hang in tied, tapered bulbs, two in front and two behind.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and the braided band; colour 1 on the hanging braids and their tapered tips.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_03.differs: The male version has four braids, two hanging in front over the chest and two down the back, while the female version has only two.

Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_04.description: Chin-length, tousled, layered hair with a deep side-swept fringe falling over the eyes, wavy shaggy ends and a few curled, flicked locks at the front and sides; a tapered, choppy back.
Male/M_Hair_Lockbox_67_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the front fringe and side section of curling locks.

Male/M_Hair_Mad_Scientist_01.description: A short, wild hairstyle of stiff, jagged spikes sitting close over the crown and reaching around the sides and back of the head, with a raised central tuft and banded sections of hair.
Male/M_Hair_Mad_Scientist_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light bands at the front hairline and back; colour 1 on the central tuft and the broad banded patches; colour 2 on the swept spikes on top; colour 3 on small side panels.

Male/M_Hair_Mad_Scientist_02.description: Tall, swept-back hairstyle with a voluminous rounded crown, streaked strands and jagged spiky tips fanning out at the back and top; short side pieces sit over the ears, with a pointed hairline at the forehead.
Male/M_Hair_Mad_Scientist_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiky tips, back and hairline; colour 1 on the top and front of the hair and the strands at the ears; colour 3 on the side panels above the ears.

Male/M_Hair_Mindslayer_01.description: Long, loose, wavy hair combed back from a centre parting, falling in layered strands to the upper back, with curling ringlet tips that hang forward past the shoulders and over the face.
Male/M_Hair_Mindslayer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown down to the mid-length; colour 1 on the lower strands and curling tips, fading in gradually.

Male/M_Hair_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A swept-back, shoulder-length hairstyle piled tall on top in layered, sculpted locks that sweep back into a high ponytail with pointed tapering tips; a single lock falls forward beside the face.
Male/M_Hair_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the locks and the top; colour 1 on the inner strands and streaks beneath the outer layers; the tips shade toward colour 2.

Male/M_Hair_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: Long, straight, loose hair swept back from the face and hanging to the upper back, with a gradient toward the tips. Separate face-framing strands fall over the forehead and sides, with a few pointed locks at the ends.
Male/M_Hair_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass at the crown and lengths; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the hair; colour 2 on the strands framing the top of the face; colour 3 on the long front locks.
Male/M_Hair_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The male version is shorter, ending at the upper back, instead of reaching mid-back.

Male/M_Hair_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: Upper-back-length wavy hair swept back from the face, with two thick curved front locks at the brow and loose layered waves ending in pointed tapered tips at the shoulder blades.
Male/M_Hair_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the tapered tips, blending up from the ends; colour 2 on the two curved front locks.

Male/M_Hair_Monkey_01.description: Short, tall spiky hairstyle of layered flame-like blades swept upward into a pointed crest, sitting close around the head with a sharp pointed hairline at the forehead. Wild, anime-style look.
Male/M_Hair_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair blades; colour 1 on the shadowed edges and streaks between the blades.

Male/M_Hair_Moth_01.description: A full, hood-like mane of layered feathery tufts that wraps the whole head and frames the face, then drapes down over the shoulders and chest to a pointed fringe. Monstrous, moth-like look.
Male/M_Hair_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown of the head, fading into colour 1 across the rest of the tufts down to the tips.

Male/M_Hair_Moth_02.description: Upper-back-length swept-back hair made of layered, feather-like jagged locks, with a smooth crown, a pointed face-framing mask shape at the front and a broad fanned fall that spreads over the shoulders and upper back.
Male/M_Hair_Moth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper locks; colour 1 on the lower feathery tips and the underside layer; small claw-like tips at the front also take colour 0.
Male/M_Hair_Moth_02.differs: The male version spreads into a broader fan that sits wider across the shoulders and covers more of the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.description: Chin-length swept-back hair with a voluminous top of wavy, layered locks ending in sharp pointed spikes, a shorter jagged lower layer around the nape and sides, and a single curved horn-like tip at the temple.
Male/M_Hair_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept upper hair and spikes; colour 1 on the shorter lower layer and fringe; colour 2 on the curved horn at the temple.

Male/M_Hair_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01_A.description: Chin-length swept-back hairstyle with a voluminous top of wavy, flame-like locks ending in sharp pointed spikes, a shorter jagged underlayer around the nape and ears, and a small curved horn-like tip at the temple.
Male/M_Hair_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01_A.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept upper locks; colour 1 on the shorter underlayer at the nape and fringe; colour 2 on the small curved horn tip at the temple.

Male/M_Hair_Qularr_Antenna_01.description: A pair of insect antennae: short segmented stubs at the brow above each eye that sweep back into long, thin tapering whiskers. Small and slender, worn on the forehead for an alien or insectoid look.
Male/M_Hair_Qularr_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the short base segments; colour 2 on the long tapering whiskers. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Hair_Qularr_Antennahelm_01.description: A shallow, angular alien crest plate that sits over the top of the head and points down to a V at the forehead. It has a mottled, blotchy surface and short curved horn spikes on each side.
Male/M_Hair_Qularr_Antennahelm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface and the horn spikes; colour 1 on the blotchy patches across the plate; colour 2 on the horn tips.

Male/M_Hair_Qularr_Antennahelm_02.description: A shallow, angular insect-like plate that sits over the top of the head like a cap, pitted with round dimples and pointing down to a tip at the brow, with three curved horn spikes rising along the crown ridge.
Male/M_Hair_Qularr_Antennahelm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the rounded dimples and the underside pits; colour 2 on the horn spikes and central ridge fin.

Male/M_Hair_Rave_01.description: A short, punky hairstyle with a tall, swept-back top of layered, feathery spiked strands, a shaved-looking undercut around the back and sides, and jagged locks falling over the forehead and temples.
Male/M_Hair_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main top hair and fringe; colour 3 on the undercut sides and back and the forehead band; colour 1 on the tips of some strands; colour 2 on the shaded streaks in the top locks.

Male/M_Hair_Rave_02.description: A short, wild, feathery hairstyle with tall spiky tufts on top, a long swept fringe falling over one side of the face, and ragged layered strands ending around neck length. Suits a rave, punk or street look.
Male/M_Hair_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair and fringe; colour 3 on the feathery streaks over the top and back; colour 1 on the lower ends of the hair; colour 2 on the spiky tips and side strands.

Male/M_Hair_Rave_03.description: Shoulder-length spiky hair with a blunt fringe over the brow, tall swept-back layered spikes on top, and one long tapering lock hanging past the chin on one side; a jagged, punky rave look.
Male/M_Hair_Rave_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and crown strands; colour 0 as the highlight streaks in the crown; colour 2 on the mid lengths; colour 3 on the tips, the fringe ends and the long side lock.
Male/M_Hair_Rave_03.differs: The male version has a looser, more open fringe and a longer back lock that hangs lower than the female version.

Male/M_Hair_Rave_04.description: Two clusters of long, banded wire-like tendrils rising from clamp-like collars at each side of the head, hanging to upper-back length and ending in sharp pointed tips. A cyber-rave hairstyle with a mechanical, insectoid feel.
Male/M_Hair_Rave_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar clamps and alternating stripes of the tendrils; colour 1, colour 2 and colour 3 on the other alternating stripe bands, which vary between strands.

Male/M_Hair_Renegade_01.description: Neck-length, tousled wavy hair swept back and over the crown, with a band wrapped around the head and loose ribbon-like tails hanging at the temple. A contrasting visor-like fringe falls over the eyes with curled strands.
Male/M_Hair_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept-back hair; colour 1 on the headband; colour 3 on the dangling ribbon tails; colour 2 on the front fringe and the underside locks.

Male/M_Hair_Renegade_02.description: Swept-back, shoulder-length hair in long jagged strands that taper to pointed tips, with small curved horn-like fins above the brows and contrasting side tufts framing the face. Wild, alien-renegade look.
Male/M_Hair_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper hair mass and top layers; colour 0 on the lower tips and strands; colour 3 on the horn-like fins above the brows; colour 2 on the side tufts.
Male/M_Hair_Renegade_02.differs: The male version is shorter, ending at the shoulders instead of the upper back.

Male/M_Hair_Renegade_Alt_01.description: A single asymmetric swept hair lock on one side of the head: a broad smooth sheet with a thin separate bang curling over the forehead, tapering to a curled point near chin level.
Male/M_Hair_Renegade_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the entire hair piece; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Hair_Renegade_Extra_01.description: Neck-length layered hair with wispy, tapered ends, swept back from the face under a wide band across the crown. A separate contrasting section hangs in loose curling locks at the front and one side, with no bangs.
Male/M_Hair_Renegade_Extra_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the band across the crown; colour 2 on the front and side locks and the strip under the band.
Male/M_Hair_Renegade_Extra_01.differs: The male hair is a little shorter, ending at the neck, and sits closer to the head.

Male/M_Hair_Retro_Talisman_01.description: A short, choppy hairstyle of layered pointed locks radiating from a crown swirl, with a long side-swept fringe falling across the eyes. It ends around chin length and has a tousled retro feel.
Male/M_Hair_Retro_Talisman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base hair locks; colour 1 on the streaked strands running through the locks.

Male/M_Hair_Rocker_01.description: Shoulder-length rocker hair swept up into a tall, spiky, feathered crest on top, with long layered strands falling past the ears and back, and a few thin, ragged locks hanging down in front.
Male/M_Hair_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the streaks and tips in the back layers; colour 3 on the roots at the front and sides of the crest; colour 2 on the ends of the front locks and the crown at the back.

Male/M_Hair_Sasquatch_01.description: A pair of sideburns made of jagged, tapering hair tufts with serrated edges, hanging in front of the ears down to the jaw line. The pointed, beast-like shape suggests a monstrous look.
Male/M_Hair_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and inner parts of each tuft; colour 1 on the outer serrated edges; colour 2 on the tips.
Male/M_Hair_Sasquatch_01.differs: The male tufts are broader and flatter, sitting straighter along the cheeks.

Male/M_Hair_Sidepeak_01.description: Chin-length, spiky hair swept up into tall jagged shards on top, with a forward-swept fringe tuft over the forehead and feathered wing-like locks at the temples; the back is layered in sharp spikes.
Male/M_Hair_Sidepeak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mass of spikes, fading toward colour 0 at the tips; colour 2 on the front fringe tuft; colour 3 on the swept temple locks.

Male/M_Hair_Suave_01.description: A short, sharply swept mohawk-like tuft of hair that rises in a narrow ridge along the centre of the scalp, splitting into a few pointed, blade-like locks that curve upward and back. Wolf-like and sleek.
Male/M_Hair_Suave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the tall central tip; colour 2 on the tip of the smaller side lock; colour 3 on the small inner lock tip.

Male/M_Hair_Swing_01.description: A short, swept hairstyle of layered pointed locks that comb across the forehead to one side, with spiky tips at the crown and nape. It sits close to the head and ends around ear to nape length.
Male/M_Hair_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the edges and tips of the strands and the shaded streaks between them.

Male/M_Hair_Swing_02.description: A chin-length wavy hairstyle with a voluminous swept crown and a side-parted fringe falling over the brow. The ends curl into glossy, flipped-out locks around the ears and nape, giving a retro swing look.
Male/M_Hair_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper hair; colour 1 on the curled lower locks and tips, blending up from the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Swoop_01.description: A chin-length hairstyle with a tall swept-up crest of jagged, spiky strands on top, heavy blunt-cut bangs across the forehead, and straight layered hair falling down the back and sides of the head.
Male/M_Hair_Swoop_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 shade the hair strands, with lighter streaks toward the crest and darker tones underneath; the hair is a single piece with no separate trim.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Child_Face_Lycan_Hair_.description: A short, wild hairstyle of jagged, spiky tufts swept upward and back, with a ragged fringe across the forehead and sharp streaky strands. It sits close to the scalp and ends around chin-to-nape level at the back, suiting a feral, beastly look.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Child_Face_Lycan_Hair_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jagged fringe along the front and sides; colour 1 on the main body of the hair on top and back; colour 3 on the streaks and spiky strand tips; colour 2 on the shading at the roots of the streaks.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Dorag_01.description: A close-fitting bandana skullcap with a smooth crown, gathered fabric folds and a small knot at the back of the head, from which two short pointed tails hang. Polka-dot pattern; casual, street or pirate look.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Dorag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the cap and tails; colour 1 on the dots; colour 2 on the small band edge at the front hairline.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Aberrant_01.description: A sparse, chin-length hairstyle of thin strands and branching ribbed bands that arch over the scalp like a cage, with long tendril-like locks hanging down around the ears and nape. Its look is monstrous and alien.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Aberrant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arching bands over the scalp and the upper part of the strands; colour 1 on the hanging tips of the strands; colour 2 on small gaps near the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_01.description: A large, rounded afro hairstyle: a tall, puffy, textured mass of hair that sits high on the head and reaches about chin level, with a short fringe band across the brow and sideburn tufts.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 blend across the hair mass as a mottled texture; colour 1 on the fringe band and sideburn tufts.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_01.differs: The male version adds a short hairline band across the forehead and is a little fuller at the back and sides.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_02.description: A short, rounded afro hairstyle: a lumpy, cloud-like mass of curls sitting on top of the head, with a cropped hairline band across the forehead, sideburn tufts and a nape that stays above the jaw.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled highlights across the top of the curls; colour 1 on the lower curls, forehead hairline, sideburns and nape hair; colour 2 in the shadowed clumps.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_02.differs: The male afro is slightly lower and flatter on top, and shows a visible hairline band across the forehead.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_03.description: A short, rounded afro with a lumpy, textured surface that sits close to the head and ends above the jaw, with small pointed sideburn tufts in front of the ears and a slightly ragged lower edge.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mass of the hair, with colour 0 highlights and colour 2 shading across the surface; colour 1 on the sideburn tufts.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Afro_03.differs: The male version has a separate band across the forehead under the front hairline, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Combover_01.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle hugging the skull, with layered strands swept back from the front hairline and separated slats on top; it ends above the ears and nape for a neat combover look.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Combover_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept top strands and crown; colour 1 on the lower sides, back and front hairline, blending in a gradient from the top.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Cornrows_01.description: Short cornrow hairstyle of narrow raised braid ridges with gaps between them, running from the front hairline back and curving down the sides to the nape, hugging the skull closely.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Cornrows_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main braid ridges; colour 1 on the front tips of the braids; colour 2 on the lower ends near the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Dreadsspikey_01.description: A hairstyle of many thin, tapering braided spikes radiating outward from the whole scalp like a sea urchin, with a tall crown and short spikes at the nape. Wild, punky and monstrous.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Dreadsspikey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main length of the braids; colour 3 on the spike tips; colour 1 on a few small accents near the scalp; colour 2 in the shadowed roots.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Lycan_Hair_01.description: A short, wild hairstyle of jagged, spiky tufts that sweeps back and up from a ragged fringe, with streaky strands through the crown. Sits close to the scalp and stops above the neck, giving a feral, beast-like look.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Lycan_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jagged fringe at the front and sides; colour 1 on the main body of hair over the crown and back; colour 3 on the streaks and spiky strands; colour 2 on the shadowed strands near the crown.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Maniac_01.description: A sparse, wild hairstyle of three separate tufts of thin, jagged blade-like strands that fan outward from the crown and sides of an otherwise bare scalp, giving a spiky, feral, punk look.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Maniac_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 shading on some strand edges and undersides.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Maniac_02.description: Two small clusters of thin, pointed blade-like strands that fan outward from either side of the crown, leaving the scalp between them bare. A wild, spiky punk or monstrous hairstyle.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Maniac_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands; colour 2 on the shaded edges and undersides of some strands.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Maniac_03.description: Two spiky tufts of thin, blade-like strands splayed outward from small bands on either side of the upper head, with a few loose strands between them. The rest of the scalp stays bare, giving a wild, punkish look.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Maniac_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiky strands; colour 1 on the small bands binding each tuft.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Mullet_01.description: A neck-length mullet hairstyle: swept-back hair on top with a few small spiky tufts at the hairline, falling in streaked, layered strands to the nape and framing the sides of the face. Casual, rock-inspired style.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Mullet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 2 on the streaked strands; colour 1 on the small tufts at the hairline.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Receding_01a.description: A short, close-cropped hairstyle with a receding hairline: hair hugs the skull, sweeps back from a pointed front tuft, and leaves a bare forehead with short pointed sideburn strands by the ears.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Receding_01a.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown and back of the hair; colour 1 on the front tuft, temples and sideburn edges, blending into colour 0.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Receding_Medium_0.description: A chin-length hairstyle with a high receding hairline that leaves a bare forehead patch. Short, slightly tousled layers with jagged ends sweep back over the sides and cover the back of the head and nape.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Receding_Medium_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair at the back and upper crown; colour 1 on the front edges and side locks; the bare forehead patch shows a light tone that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Werewolf_01.description: A narrow mohawk of layered, pointed blade-like tufts running from the forehead over the crown and down to the nape, leaving the sides of the head bare. Feral and punk in style.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Face_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer tufts and most of the crest; colour 0 on the inner base and the front tufts.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A fan-shaped crest of many rigid, tapering quills or plumes radiating from a central point on the crown, sweeping up and back with angular, hooked tips. It suggests a fiery bird-like or tribal headdress.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the roots of the quills; colour 1 on the middle band of each quill; colour 2 on the transition below the tips; colour 3 on the outer tips.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Ponytail_01.description: A swept-back hairstyle with layered, textured strands and short blunt fringe across the forehead, gathered at the back of the head into a high ponytail that tapers to a point and hangs to the neck.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Ponytail_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair; colour 1 on the hair tie band around the base of the ponytail.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Parted_01.description: Short, tight-cropped hairstyle with a side part, sitting close to the skull and ending above the ears and nape. A textured swept top and small side tufts give it a classic pulp-adventure look.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Parted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 3 on the parting line and streaks across the top; colour 1 on the tufts at the temples and sideburns; colour 2 on the small lock at the parting.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Rockabilly_01.description: A short rockabilly pompadour: hair swept up and back into a tall glossy quiff with a notched fringe at the forehead, tapering to short sides and a tidy nape at chin length.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Rockabilly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and fringe; colour 1 on the streaky highlights in the quiff; colour 2 on the sideburn tips.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Pulp_Rockabilly_01.differs: The male version is a short swept-back pompadour with no curls, unlike the female version's puffed crown with long spiral ringlets.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.description: A short punk hairstyle with swept-back streaked hair, a pointed widow's-peak fringe and spiky strands falling in front of the ears. Spiky tufts crown the back of the head; ends around neck length.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.colourAreas: The hair uses a streaked texture blending colour 0 at the top with colour 1 toward the tips; colour 3 and colour 2 appear as streaks and shading toward the back and crown.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_01.differs: The male version is slightly shorter, with side strands reaching only about neck length.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.description: Short punk hairstyle with a swept, centre-parted top and layered bangs that taper into sharp, pointed strands framing the face; side locks hang down to about neck length.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair from the crown to the mid-length; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the strands; colour 3 in streaked highlights across the top.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Punk_Bangs_02.differs: The male version is shorter, with the side locks ending at neck length.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_01.description: Short, slicked-back hair gathered into a tall cylindrical topknot bound by a thin tie. The front is swept back from the brow into a pointed widow's-peak sweep, and the sides and back stay close to the head.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 form the striped pattern across all the hair; colour 3 on the tie around the topknot.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_01.differs: The male version has a swept-back, pointed front hairline with a flick at the temples and no long strands hanging by the ears.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_02.description: Short chin-length hair with streaked strands swept back from the face and a tall messy topknot gathered high on the crown by a band, ending in spiky, tousled tips that flick backward.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Samurai_Topknot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair strands; colour 2 on the streaks through the hair; colour 1 on the topknot band; colour 3 on the thin edging of the band.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Streakspiked_01.description: A short, swept-back hairstyle with sharp, blade-like spikes fanning out from the crown and sides, a jagged fringe over the forehead, and a close-cropped nape. Suggests an edgy, anime-like superhero look.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Streakspiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bases and upper back of the hair; colour 1 as streaks running along the spikes; colour 2 on the fringe and lower nape.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Topknot_01.description: A high topknot ponytail gathered at the crown by a short cylindrical tie, with a single smooth tapering lock that arcs up and back then hangs down to a point past the nape. Sleek, simple styling.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Topknot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair lock; colour 1 on the hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Tight_Topknot_02.description: A short topknot ponytail: a single smooth, tapering lock gathered by a cylindrical tie at the crown, arcing back and down to a point at the nape. The rest of the head stays bare.
Male/M_Hair_Tight_Topknot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair lock; colour 1 on the cylindrical hair tie.

Male/M_Hair_Traveler_01.description: Swept-back hairstyle with smooth, combed strands sculpted over the crown and gathered at the back, then falling in loose, tapered layered locks to about neck length.
Male/M_Hair_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept-back crown section; colour 1 on the lower hanging locks; colour 3 on streaks through the lower locks.
Male/M_Hair_Traveler_01.differs: The male version is shorter, ending around the neck, with slightly less length in the lower locks.

Male/M_Hair_Traveler_02.description: A sparse chin-length hairstyle of a few long, tapered locks swept back from the hairline, with a short contrasting-coloured tuft at the front; the locks hang loosely at the sides and back, leaving most of the scalp bare.
Male/M_Hair_Traveler_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long swept locks; colour 1 on the short front tufts along the hairline.

Male/M_Hair_Traveler_03.description: A small ponytail of smooth, tapering locks swept back from a short cylindrical tie at the back of the head, hanging down behind the neck in a pointed tip; an accessory-sized hairstyle piece rather than a full head of hair.
Male/M_Hair_Traveler_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair locks; colour 3 on the tie band at the base of the ponytail.

Male/M_Hair_Traveler_04.description: A sparse hairstyle of a small ponytail tied high at the back of the crown with a band, plus a few thin swept-back bangs that curve across the forehead. The rest of the scalp is left bare.
Male/M_Hair_Traveler_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ponytail strands and most of the bangs; colour 1 on the curved tips of the front bangs; colour 3 on the tie band around the ponytail.

Male/M_Hair_Valorous_01.description: Chin-length layered hair with a side-swept fringe over the forehead, a parted swept-back crown and jagged, feathered tips that taper down the nape and sides. Styled as a casual, tousled short cut.
Male/M_Hair_Valorous_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair and tips; colour 3 on the top and back layer; colour 1 on the front side lock; colour 2 on the swept fringe lock.

Male/M_Hair_Valorous_02.description: Chin-length hair in thick woven braids swept back over the crown, with a braided band circling the back of the head and loose braided strands hanging below, each capped with a banded tip. Short side sections sit beneath.
Male/M_Hair_Valorous_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the braids and hanging strands; colour 1 on the side and under-hair sections; colour 3 on the bands around the braid tips and the back band.

Male/M_Hair_Valorous_03.description: Chin-length layered hair swept back from the forehead, with a long side fringe falling over one eye, a thick rope-twisted band across the crown and a straight-cut panel of hair hanging at the back and side.
Male/M_Hair_Valorous_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair and swept top; colour 3 on the rope-twisted band; colour 1 on the straight hanging panel at the back and side; colour 2 on the thin fringe strands.

Male/M_Hair_Valorous_04.description: Short, tousled cropped hair with textured layers over the back and sides, and a swept-up fringe topped by long pointed blade-like locks that curve upward and back from the front hairline, giving a punky superhero look.
Male/M_Hair_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the base of the swept front locks; colour 2 on the tall curved spikes at the crown; colour 3 on the slim outer spikes at the sides.

Male/M_Hair_Valorous_05.description: An asymmetric, side-swept hairstyle with a long fringe swept across the forehead to one side, a shaved-looking opposite side, and layered locks falling down the back to the shoulders, gathered slightly at the nape.
Male/M_Hair_Valorous_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept top and fringe; colour 0 on the front side locks; colour 2 on the main back mass; colour 3 on the inner strands at the side and back.
Male/M_Hair_Valorous_05.differs: The male version is shorter, ending at the shoulders, with the back gathered slightly at the nape.

Male/M_Hair_Valorous_06.description: Chin-length layered hair swept back from the crown in smooth ridged waves, with a contrasting front section of jagged, feathered locks falling over the forehead and a contrasting-edged streak along the side. Casual, edgy style.
Male/M_Hair_Valorous_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept-back hair and back lengths; colour 1 on the front fringe locks; colour 3 on the streak edging the fringe section.

Male/M_Hair_Windswept_01.description: Upper-back-length windswept hair swept back in layered, jagged spiky locks, with a short choppy fringe on top and two loose front braids tied with small bands that rest on the chest.
Male/M_Hair_Windswept_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the fringe and crown; colour 0 on the main hair lengths and braids; colour 1 on the spiky tips and lower ends; colour 3 on the braid ties.
Male/M_Hair_Windswept_01.differs: The male version has a fuller, longer back mass that reaches further down the back, with shorter braids.

Male/M_Hair_Windswept_02.description: Wild, swept-back hair with a messy fringe over the forehead and jagged, spiky locks streaming backward from the crown to the shoulders, giving a windblown, energetic look.
Male/M_Hair_Windswept_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the front fringe and top of the head; colour 0 on the mid-length locks; colour 1 on the tips and the back spikes.
Male/M_Hair_Windswept_02.differs: The male hair is shorter, ending at the shoulders, with shorter trailing spikes than the female version.

Male/M_Hair_Winged_01.description: Long, mid-back length hair swept back from the forehead in smooth streaked strands, with a few curled locks framing the face at the temples and ragged, jagged tips at the ends.
Male/M_Hair_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass; colour 1 on the curled locks at the temples; colour 2 on the jagged tips at the ends of the hair.

Male/M_Handl_Animal_01.description: A clenched left fist with a skin-textured, snake-like hand shape, contrasting inner palm and long curved contrasting claws that curl from the fingertips into the palm and show clearly along the fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the inner palm; the skin-toned fist and the claws do not follow the colour scheme.
Male/M_Handl_Animal_01.differs: The male claws are longer and more prominent, clearly visible curling from the fingertips.

Male/M_Handl_Animal_02.description: A bulky animal-themed glove covering the whole left fist and wrist, with a furry mitten shape, jagged fur tufts ringing the palm opening, and a row of curved claws across the knuckles. Suggests a beast or coyote paw.
Male/M_Handl_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur of the glove and fingers; colour 1 on the jagged fur tufts around the palm opening; colour 2 on the inner shadowed opening; colour 3 on the claws.
Male/M_Handl_Animal_02.differs: The male glove has a row of several claws across the fingers, rather than the single claw on the female version.

Male/M_Handl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A chunky, robotic gauntlet covering a clenched fist: a large segmented armour plate over the back of the hand, a contrasting band at the wrist edge, and separate rounded finger segments curled at the front.
Male/M_Handl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main back-of-hand plate; colour 2 on the darker plate sections and joints; colour 1 on the wrist band; colour 3 on the finger segments and the top cap.

Male/M_Handl_Astronaut_01.description: A bulky, padded space-suit glove covering the whole left hand in a closed fist, with a wide rolled cuff at the wrist, a contrasting side stripe and a separate panel over the palm and fingertips.
Male/M_Handl_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the side stripe and small panel under the fist; colour 3 on the wrist cuff; colour 2 on the palm panel.
