Male/M_Handl_Baseball_01.description: A padded baseball fielder's glove for the left hand: rounded leather mitt with four finger sleeves, a deep pocket, an open wrist hole, and contrasting stitching and X-lacing, with an H-shaped web across the palm.
Male/M_Handl_Baseball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the H-shaped web and lacing strips; colour 3 on the stitching and X laces.

Male/M_Handl_Beast_Claw_Mechanical_01.description: A mechanical clenched-fist claw hand: a rounded plated back-of-hand shell with ribbed vertical channels, a cuff at the wrist, and pointed blade-like fingertips with barrel-shaped knuckle caps.
Male/M_Handl_Beast_Claw_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates and fingertip blades; colour 1 on the ribbed channels, wrist cuff ring and knuckle barrels; colour 3 on the striped vents inside the fingers; colour 2 on the inner gaps and joints.

Male/M_Handl_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: A left gauntlet-glove with a tall cylindrical cuff and segmented knuckle plates, fitted with long blade-like claws that extend past the fingers, plus thin wire loops and curved hooks around the wrist. Gothic, predatory look.
Male/M_Handl_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cuff, glove body and wire fittings; colour 1 on the long claw blades; colour 3 on small accents at the cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Bounty_01.description: A chunky left-hand glove for a clenched fist, with a short cuff, panelled construction and a raised hexagonal plate on the outer wrist. Pointed armoured tips cover the fingers. Suggests a sci-fi bounty hunter look.
Male/M_Handl_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff edging and side panels; colour 1 on the main back-of-hand and palm panels; colour 2 on the wrist plate housing and fingertip guards; colour 3 on the inset of the wrist plate.
Male/M_Handl_Bounty_01.differs: The male glove has larger, more pointed spiky finger guards and a bigger, blockier wrist plate.

Male/M_Handl_Bracers_Holoforce_01.description: A left forearm bracer of translucent, glassy angular plates: a large stepped guard over the upper forearm, a separate cuff near the wrist, and a long thin blade-like spike running along the outer edge toward the hand.
Male/M_Handl_Bracers_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and glass-like and largely ignores the colour scheme; the plates show a pale, near-sheen with no clear split between slots.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_01.description: A rotary gatling-gun attachment for the left hand: a cluster of long parallel barrels bundled by two thick bands, hanging below the fist with the muzzle ends pointing downward. Chunky, mechanical, sci-fi weapon look.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrels; colour 0 on the two bands and the notched muzzle ring; colour 3 on the barrel tips.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_02.description: A chunky cylindrical gadget cuff worn around the left forearm just above the wrist, with a flat top disc, a recessed screen panel on the inner side, and three curved vents on the outer side.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cylinder body and top disc; colour 1 on the screen; colour 2 on the recessed panel around the screen and the base rim; colour 3 on the side vents.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_03.description: A chunky D-shaped forearm block worn on the left lower arm: a flat-backed housing with a rounded front, a row of vertical cartridge-like barrels around the curved face, and a bevelled rim top and bottom. Suggests a compact gatling or ammo-belt wrist unit.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, rim and flat back; colour 1 on the vertical barrels or cartridges; colour 2 on the band between the rim and barrels.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_04.description: A compact cylindrical forearm-mounted device with a capped top, chunky segmented casing, recessed side panels and a short rod on one side; a thin cable trails down toward the wrist ending in a small connector.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing and rod; colour 1 on the top cap, bottom ring, inset panels and connector; colour 2 on the recessed panels; colour 3 on the cable.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_01.description: A chunky gatling-style barrel cluster hanging from the left fist: a bundle of long parallel tubes held by two thick ribbed rings, with short tips at the lower end. Suggests a rotary cannon hand weapon.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrel tubes; colour 0 on the two rings; colour 3 on the barrel tips at the muzzle end.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_02.description: A chunky cylindrical gauntlet-like canister worn around the left forearm near the wrist, with a recessed screen panel on the inner side, three glowing slots on the outer side, and a round plate on top.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and top plate; colour 2 on the recessed panel frame; colour 1 on the screen; colour 3 on the three slot inserts.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_03.description: A compact bracer-like block worn on the left forearm near the wrist: a flat-topped, D-shaped metal housing with a bevelled edge and a band of ribbed cylindrical canisters around the curved side. Suggests a sci-fi weapon module.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, flat plate and bevelled frame; colour 1 on the ribbed canisters; colour 2 on the gaps between the canisters and housing.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_04.description: A compact cylindrical gatling-style ammo canister with chamfered ends, a capped top, a glossy window panel on the back and a short side nub with a looping cable ending in a small connector. It floats at the left forearm.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Gatling_Alt_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body and side nub; colour 1 on the top cap, end ring and inner window trim; colour 2 on the glossy window panel and connector; colour 3 on the cable.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Long_Mecha_01.description: A long rectangular mechanical clamp housing worn over the left hand, with a slot cut through the middle showing interlocking stepped teeth and a split, banded tip at the fingers. Suggests a mecha or sci-fi gauntlet.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Long_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and teeth; colour 2 on the thin band above the tip; colour 3 on the end tip sections.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Tight_Long_Birdpeople.description: A row of stacked, backswept blade-like fins running along the outer forearm, growing longer toward the elbow. Thin and angular, they suggest bird-people wing feathers or blades attached to the arm.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Tight_Long_Birdpeople.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the fin blades; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A minimal flat cap that seals the open end of the left sleeve at the wrist: a thin, roughly ten-sided disc with no cuff, trim or other detail, sitting over the hand opening.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap disc.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Tight_Prisonguantlet_.description: A pair of loose chain lengths dangling from the left wrist, as if from broken prison shackles. Heavy oval links hang in two strands, one longer than the other, with no cuff visible.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Tight_Prisonguantlet_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all the chain links.

Male/M_Handl_Child_Tight_Prisonguantlet_.description: Two short lengths of heavy chain links hanging loose from the left wrist, dangling down past the fist like broken prisoner shackles. No cuff is visible. A gritty prison-break or street look.
Male/M_Handl_Child_Tight_Prisonguantlet_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all of the chain links.

Male/M_Handl_Defender_Update_01.description: A superhero gauntlet glove for the left hand: a fitted fist covering with separate finger segments, topped by a long angular forearm guard built from stacked plates with contrasting panels and a flared cuff.
Male/M_Handl_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the glove body and main forearm plates; colour 0 on the finger tips, cuff edges and upper plate; colour 2 on the side forearm panels and wrist band; colour 3 on small accents at the knuckles.

Male/M_Handl_Draco_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a smooth padded back-of-hand panel, a lighter inner palm and segmented armoured finger plates, topped by a row of several long curved claws along the knuckles. Short cuff sits over the left hand.
Male/M_Handl_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main back-of-hand panel; colour 0 on the palm, cuff rim and inner plates; colour 2 on the finger segments and knuckle plates; colour 3 on the claws.
Male/M_Handl_Draco_01.differs: The male version has a row of several long claws along the knuckles, while the female version has only one long claw at the side of the fist.

Male/M_Handl_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A chunky, scaly clawed fist covering the whole left hand: a rounded, closed-fist shape with faint scale texture and a blunt cuff at the wrist, with contrasting curved claws sprouting from the finger tips.
Male/M_Handl_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly fist and cuff; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Handl_Dryad_01.description: A chunky clenched-fist glove with a faceted, bark-like surface covered in streaky vein or scratch markings; the fingers curl into a rough, angular fist with a blunt open cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Handl_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove surface; colour 3 on the streaky vein markings running across the knuckles and back of the hand.

Male/M_Handl_Dryad_02.description: A bulky clenched-fist glove with a rounded cuff and a mossy, mottled organic texture across the back of the hand, plus segmented plated knuckles and finger tips. Suggests a nature-guardian look.
Male/M_Handl_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and base of the glove; colour 1 on the mottled moss-like patches; colour 2 on the plated knuckle and finger segments.
Male/M_Handl_Dryad_02.differs: The male version has smaller contrasting plating over the knuckles, leaving more of the mossy texture visible on the front.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Gamer_01.description: A retro game controller strapped to the left forearm by a curling cable that runs down to a chunky wristband cuff at the hand. The flat rectangular pad carries a cross button and round buttons, for a playful geek look.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the controller body; colour 3 on the cross and round buttons and the cuff stripe; colour 1 on the cable; colour 2 on the wrist cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Lockbox_67_01.description: A left-hand piece with a padded wrist cuff fastened by a small buckle, and a cluster of sharp, jagged blade-like claws spiking from the knuckles and fingers, joined by thin open link frames.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the cuff and the claw spikes; colour 1 on the cuff edge piping and the thin link frames around the claws.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Long_Mechaclaw_01.description: A left-hand mechanical claw: a small angular cuff panel at the fist with two long, curved blade-like talons hanging down past the hand, each ending in a sharp point with spiky notches at the top.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Long_Mechaclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hand cuff panel; colour 0 on the two long talon blades.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Reactor_04.description: A small sci-fi hand guard that wraps the back of the left hand and knuckles: a curved plate with a jagged lower edge, a separate raised panel along one side, and small studs.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the raised side panel; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Short_Retroscifi_Bubb.description: A thin, translucent curved shell shaped like part of a bubble, cupped against the outer edge of the left fist. It sits as a small glassy dome on the hand and suggests a retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Short_Retroscifi_Bubb.colourAreas: The shell is glass-like and seems to ignore the colour scheme; no colour slot is clearly visible on it.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Drill_01.description: A single conical drill bit held in the left hand, with a flat polygonal top cap and vertical fluted stripes running down to a sharp point; hangs pointing downward from the fist.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cap and the raised ridges between the stripes; colour 3 on the alternating stripes of the cone body.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Punk_01.description: A short wrist cuff for the left hand: a ribbed knit sleeve rolls up out of a glossy metal-edged band, with a raised rounded plate on the outer side. Punk, street look sitting at the wrist.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed knit cuff; colour 0 on the metal-look band; colour 3 on the raised outer plate; colour 2 on the edge trim and lower band.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A sci-fi hand device: a bulky angular gauntlet block with notched, horn-like prongs, small twin cylinder barrels and a curved blade spike, ringed by detached curved fin-like plates floating around the left hand.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauntlet plates, blade and cylinder barrels; colour 1 on the floating curved plates and the lower gauntlet band; colour 2 on the upper housing and prongs; colour 3 on the small indicator lights.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.description: A bulky sci-fi armoured gauntlet for the left hand: a tall plated shell over the back of the hand with a sharp curved blade, a cuffed base, and two small cylindrical emitters on a boxy mount.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light plates of the shell and blade edge; colour 2 on the upper shell, blade and cylinders; colour 1 on the cuff band, inner lining and emitter mount; colour 3 on the small round lights.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.differs: The blade is a longer, straighter knife-like spike with a light-edged blade, and the shell top is smoother with fewer jagged points.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A set of three curved, tapering claw blades that hang in a row beside the left hand, each with a blocky flat base and a long sweeping point. Suggests a monstrous symbiote or organic weapon look.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper blade bases; colour 1 on the tapering blade tips, blending gradually from the base.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.differs: The three claws are spread slightly wider apart and are chunkier, so they show more separately from the front.

Male/M_Handl_Extra_Wrapped_Hook_01.description: A hand-held hook weapon: a faceted, angular U-shaped blade with a short straight shaft on one side and a longer pointed tip curving up on the other, held in the left hand and hanging at the side.
Male/M_Handl_Extra_Wrapped_Hook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hook body, including the faceted blade and the shaft; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handl_Fem_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A set of small decorative rings worn on the fingers of the left hand, with metal bands carrying contrasting leaf or snowflake-like ornaments and a cluster of soft ribbon-like loops on one finger. Festive, winter-themed jewellery.
Male/M_Handl_Fem_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal ring bands; colour 2 on the ornament insets; colour 1 on the ribbon-like loops.

Male/M_Handl_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A smooth, rounded glove covering the left hand in a clenched fist, with a plain cuff edge at the wrist and softly modelled, short fingers curled into the palm. Simple, casual-looking design.
Male/M_Handl_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove including the fingers; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Handl_Gatling_01.description: A large forearm-mounted rotary gatling cannon: a cluster of long barrels projects past the hand, with a chunky housing, round drum canisters and a cap at the elbow end. Sci-fi heavy weapon look.
Male/M_Handl_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, drums, rings and end caps; colour 1 on the barrels and drum bands; colour 3 on the vent slots and small markings; colour 2 on small details.

Male/M_Handl_Gatling_Alt_01.description: A large arm-mounted rotary gatling cannon worn over the left forearm and hand: a bundle of long barrels with clamp rings, a chunky housing with vented slots, and a side ammo canister with small wires. Sci-fi heavy weapon.
Male/M_Handl_Gatling_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, canister and clamp rings; colour 1 on the barrels and housing bands; colour 3 on the vent slots and wires; colour 2 on small inserts.

Male/M_Handl_Glove_Odragon_01.description: A short, smooth fitted glove with a flared cuff covering the fist and part of the forearm, with a swooping jagged-edged panel running up the outer wrist and thin edge piping. Clean superhero martial-arts styling.
Male/M_Handl_Glove_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove and hand; colour 1 on the swooping forearm panel; colour 2 on the edge piping and cuff rim.

Male/M_Handl_Glove_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A fitted glove with a flared forearm cuff, a wide strapped band at the wrist and a knuckle section over a closed fist. A vertical contrasting stripe runs along the forearm, giving a sporty sci-fi look.
Male/M_Handl_Glove_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff top and the knuckle and finger sections; colour 1 on the forearm panel and the hand back; colour 2 on the wrist band and the forearm stripe.

Male/M_Handl_Heraldry_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet for the left hand with a large angular armored plate over the back of the hand, a textured panel beneath, and long spikes rising from the fingers over short knuckle claw tips.
Male/M_Handl_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the armored plate, finger segments and long spikes; colour 1 on the textured inner panel; colour 3 on the short claw tips at the knuckles.
Male/M_Handl_Heraldry_01.differs: The male version adds long contrasting spikes rising from the fingers, beyond the short knuckle claw tips.

Male/M_Handl_Insect_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a smooth wrapped cuff and back of hand, tipped with long curved insect-like claws over the knuckles and a segmented chitinous underside with small contrasting spikes along the fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and cuff; colour 1 on the segmented finger plates underneath; colour 3 on the knuckle claws and thumb plate; colour 2 on the small spikes and inner claws.

Male/M_Handl_Insulating_Glove_01.description: A chunky gauntlet-style insulated glove with a wide flared cuff that rises over the forearm, a padded fist section with a textured palm area, and a raised panel on the outer forearm. It suits a superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Handl_Insulating_Glove_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim and knuckle tips; colour 1 on the main forearm section and lower edge; colour 3 on the raised forearm panel; colour 2 on the palm and fist padding.

Male/M_Handl_Junkbot_01.description: A left hand replaced by a scrap-built mechanical claw: a chunky cuff at the wrist, boxy plated palm and thin rod-like finger struts with angular blades, giving a jury-rigged robotic look.
Male/M_Handl_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm blocks and finger rods; colour 1 on the wrist cuff top and angled plates; colour 2 on the cuff underside and joints; colour 3 on the small accent panels.
Male/M_Handl_Junkbot_01.differs: The male version has longer blade-like spikes jutting out sideways and smaller contrasting accents than the female.

Male/M_Handl_Kaiju_01.description: A short, snug glove-like hand covering with a segmented armored plate across the back of the hand and long curved talons extending from the knuckles and side, plus small contrasting claw tips. Monstrous, beastlike look.
Male/M_Handl_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the glove body; colour 1 on the back-of-hand armor plate; colour 0 on the long talons; colour 2 on the small claw tips.

Male/M_Handl_Kaiju_02.description: A monstrous oversized left hand covering: a bulbous mass of overlapping jagged scales with a horn-like spike at the top, tapering into a long curved talon-like claw that hangs well below the wrist.
Male/M_Handl_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly upper mass and spike; colour 1 on the long curved claw section.

Male/M_Handl_Largehook_01.description: A large curved hook hanging from a short cuff at the left wrist. A thin flat blade drops down, kinks once, then sweeps into a deep J-shaped barb that reaches roughly knee height. Suggests a pirate or grappling tool.
Male/M_Handl_Largehook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff; colour 1 on the hook blade.

Male/M_Handl_Lockbox_67_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a banded strapped cuff, a smooth padded back decorated with swirling tribal line patterns, and jagged blade-like spikes jutting from the knuckles and fingertips. Street-fighter or fantasy claw look.
Male/M_Handl_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body; colour 1 on the swirling line patterns and the edging of the cuff; colour 2 on the cuff band and the knuckle spikes.

Male/M_Handl_Long_Gamer_01.description: A long, boxy gauntlet shaped like a retro game controller strapped to the forearm, with an octagonal cuff, a raised D-pad and button panel, a coiled cable wrapped around the wrist, and a gloved fist with a wrist pad.
Male/M_Handl_Long_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauntlet body and glove; colour 1 on the coiled cable; colour 2 on the cuff rim and wrist pad; colour 3 on the D-pad, buttons and stripe accents.

Male/M_Handl_Long_Mecha_01.description: An oversized mechanical gauntlet block over the left hand: a faceted angular housing with a small triangular marker, side fin panels, and a slotted clamp-like jaw with notched teeth ending in banded tips.
Male/M_Handl_Long_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and clamp body; colour 1 on the side fin panels; colour 3 on the triangle marker and the tip bands; colour 2 on the thin stripe near the tips.

Male/M_Handl_Long_Mechaclaw_01.description: A bulky mechanical gauntlet-claw worn over the left hand: a boxy open-topped cuff, a large plated back-of-hand shell with paired cylindrical pistons, and long curved blade talons extending past the fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Long_Mechaclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plated shell and the claw blades; colour 1 on the cuff and the small side plate; colour 2 on the piston cylinders; colour 3 on the small clamps and brackets.

Male/M_Handl_Long_Variable_Robot_01.description: A chunky robotic left gauntlet-hand: a faceted angular cuff flares over the wrist and forearm end, with a closed blocky fist of segmented fingers and a flat plate jutting from the knuckle side.
Male/M_Handl_Long_Variable_Robot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, fist and fingers; colour 2 on the flat plate at the knuckle edge.

Male/M_Handl_Mecha_02.description: A chunky mecha-style left gauntlet: a segmented robotic fist with separate finger blocks, a bulky angular cuff over the wrist, and a large flat rectangular slab plate standing off the outer side of the hand.
Male/M_Handl_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knuckle and finger plates; colour 1 on the large slab panel; colour 2 on the wrist cuff; colour 3 on the finger blocks.

Male/M_Handl_Mitten_Santa_01.description: A rounded, puffy holiday mitten covering the whole left hand in a closed-fist shape, with a thick fluffy cuff at the wrist. Its surface is split into separate colour panels.
Male/M_Handl_Mitten_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mitten body and the cuff top; colour 3 on the broad panel across the back of the hand; colour 2 on the side and back of the cuff; colour 0 on the thumb and cuff edge.
Male/M_Handl_Mitten_Santa_01.differs: The male mitten is split into several colour panels (a broad contrasting band across the hand, and contrasting side and back patches), rather than the female's light body with a single contrasting cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Moth_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with segmented armoured finger plates, a pleated flared cuff panel over the back of the hand and wrist, and long pointed claws rising from the fingers. Suggests a winged-creature superhero look.
Male/M_Handl_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented finger and knuckle plates; colour 3 on the pleated back-of-hand panel; colour 0 on the claws.
Male/M_Handl_Moth_01.differs: The male version has longer, larger claws rising along the fingers, while the female has shorter knuckle spikes.

Male/M_Handl_Nightmare_Bladed_01.description: A single angular bracer-blade worn on the left forearm: a tapering armored shell with a squared cuff at the wrist end that extends into a long curved blade point past the hand, with notched edges and inset panels.
Male/M_Handl_Nightmare_Bladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, blade edge and central band; colour 1 on the cuff panel at the top; colour 3 on the long inset panel along the blade.

Male/M_Handl_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A left forearm bracer of layered angular plates with a tall swept-back spike at the elbow and a smaller fin-like blade along the outer edge; it ends in a segmented cuff at the wrist. Suggests dragon-like fantasy armor.
Male/M_Handl_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; the default metallic material largely ignores the rest of the scheme, so no other slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Handl_Reactor_04.description: A chunky sci-fi gauntlet-fist that encases the whole left hand and wrist in angular segmented plates, with a raised contrasting panel on the back of the hand, panel seams, small stud dots and rounded finger sections.
Male/M_Handl_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and knuckle shell; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and the fingers; colour 3 on the small dots; colour 2 on the panel seam lines.
Male/M_Handl_Reactor_04.differs: The male gauntlet has larger, rounder, more clenched fingers and a smoother shell than the female version.

Male/M_Handl_Renegade_01.description: A left gauntlet-glove with a clenched fist: a smooth, short cuff over the wrist and back of the hand, a contrasting band with a small round fastener across the knuckles, and segmented finger sections.
Male/M_Handl_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and back of the hand; colour 1 on the band across the hand; colour 2 on the fingers and knuckle sections.

Male/M_Handl_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A clenched-fist armoured gauntlet with segmented, rounded knuckle plates and a large, angular slab-like guard covering the back of the hand and wrist. It suggests a chunky retro sci-fi or warlord look.
Male/M_Handl_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fingers, knuckles and palm-side segments; colour 2 on the large back-of-hand plate; colour 0 on the thin rim trim around the plate.

Male/M_Handl_Retro_Warlord_02.description: A forearm-mounted rotary minigun replacing the left hand: a chunky ribbed cylindrical housing with a hollow open top, a contrasting collar ring, and a cluster of long barrels held by spaced clamp rings.
Male/M_Handl_Retro_Warlord_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed housing and the thin ring below the collar; colour 2 on the collar band and barrel clamp rings; colour 0 on the barrels.

Male/M_Handl_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.description: A chunky mechanical left hand: a faceted plated back-of-hand block with a raised side plate, bolt heads on the knuckles, and blocky segmented fingers curled into a fist. Suggests a steampunk robotic gauntlet.
Male/M_Handl_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand casing; colour 1 on the raised back plate; colour 2 on the finger segments; colour 3 on the bolts, cylinders and knuckle pistons.

Male/M_Handl_Robotexo_01_Basic.description: A robotic exoskeleton hand with a wide plated back-of-hand shield bearing three round studs, a cuff ring at the wrist, cylindrical joint housings, and thin angular claw-like fingers curling forward.
Male/M_Handl_Robotexo_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and the back-of-hand plate; colour 1 on the fingers and struts; colour 2 on the joint housings and knuckle blocks; colour 3 on the joint lights.

Male/M_Handl_Scarab_01.description: A bulky armoured gauntlet for the left hand: a wide rounded cuff and back-of-hand shell with a separate raised plate on the outer edge, and segmented plated knuckles topped with long curved claw spikes.
Male/M_Handl_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and main hand shell; colour 2 on the raised outer plate; colour 1 on the segmented knuckles and fingers; colour 3 on the claw spikes.
Male/M_Handl_Scarab_01.differs: The male version adds long curved claw spikes along the knuckles, where the female version has only small tips.

Male/M_Handl_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_01.description: A sci-fi glove with a clear glass bubble dome enclosing the fist, set on a small mechanical cuff at the wrist with tiny panels and fittings. It gives a retro space-suit look.
Male/M_Handl_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff housing; colour 1 on small cuff details; the bubble is clear glass and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Handl_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_02.description: A left-hand glove of angular, segmented armour plates around the fist and back of the hand, enclosed in a clear glass bubble dome. Ribbed vent-like slats show inside, with thin contrasting trim lines. Retro sci-fi robotic look.
Male/M_Handl_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates and fingers; colour 1 on the thin trim lines and the palm disc; colour 2 on the inner slats; the glass dome ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Handl_Skeleton_02.description: A left skeletal hand made of separate long finger and knuckle bones with jointed ends, curled into a loose claw. A short flat cuff band at the wrist holds it on. Suggests a gothic undead look.
Male/M_Handl_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shafts; colour 1 on the joint ends and knuckles; colour 2 on the wrist cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Skin_Fur_01.description: A clenched left hand with skin-toned knuckles and finger creases, streaked with contrasting fur-like markings. Jagged tufts of fur spike up around the wrist cuff. Fingers end in prominent curved claws. Monstrous werewolf style.
Male/M_Handl_Skin_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts at the wrist and the fading upper hand; the skin and claws do not take the colour scheme visibly.
Male/M_Handl_Skin_Fur_01.differs: The male hand has larger, more prominent contrasting claws that stick out from the fingertips.

Male/M_Handl_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.description: A clenched, skin-textured monstrous fist with a ruff of jagged fur spikes along the wrist and back of the hand, and long curved claws that jut out from the knuckles and fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.colourAreas: The skin-tone hand ignores the colour scheme; the fur tufts at the wrist and the claw tips take their colour from the default material rather than clearly from a slot.
Male/M_Handl_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.differs: The male claws are long, prominent and sweep out from the knuckles, while the female claws are short.

Male/M_Handl_Steelcommando_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet with a smooth metal cuff and back-of-hand plate, segmented armored finger plates curled into the palm, and a row of small sharp spikes along the knuckle edge. Retro superhero styling.
Male/M_Handl_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and back-of-hand plate; colour 1 on the segmented finger and thumb plates; colour 3 on the knuckle spikes.

Male/M_Handl_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A chunky retro-superhero gauntlet covering the left hand in a closed fist: a smooth rounded backhand plate, a faceted cuff at the wrist, segmented finger guards and small rounded pads at the fingertips.
Male/M_Handl_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the backhand plate and knuckle shell; colour 1 on the wrist cuff, finger segments and palm-side guards; colour 3 on the rounded fingertip pads.

Male/M_Handl_Swing_01.description: A chunky fist-shaped glove for the left hand: a blocky cuff and back-of-hand shell with separate contrasting panels on the sides, and segmented finger sections curled into a clenched fist. Sporty, superhero look.
Male/M_Handl_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and main hand shell; colour 1 on the side panels; colour 2 on the fingers and palm underside.

Male/M_Handl_Swing_02.description: A soft, slightly wrinkled cloth glove on the left hand, shaped in a closed fist with curled fingers and a short open cuff at the wrist. Simple, casual styling with no added hardware.
Male/M_Handl_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_01_Glove.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the left hand in a clenched fist, ending in a plain cuff at the wrist. Smooth, simple construction with separate sculpted fingers, suggesting everyday or superhero wear.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_01_Hand.description: A bare left hand with five separate fingers curled into a relaxed fist, thumb tucked across the fingers. It ends in a plain cut-off wrist and gives a natural, unadorned look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_01_Hand.colourAreas: The hand uses the skin tone and does not take the colour scheme; the fingernails show a light tip that does not clearly follow any slot.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_01_Hand_Claw.description: A clenched left fist with a set of long, curved, pointed claws that extend from the knuckle side of the hand, sweeping forward past the fingers. Suggests a feral or monstrous look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_01_Hand_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the fist itself shows skin and does not take a colour slot from the scheme.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_2fingers_01.description: A bare left hand in a closed fist with two fingers curled and fingertips showing small nails, ending at the wrist. It is a simple, natural hand with no glove or added detail.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_2fingers_01.colourAreas: The hand takes its skin tone and ignores the colour scheme; colour 1 appears only as a tint on the fingernails.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A superhero forearm gauntlet with a flared angular cuff, a fitted glove with a padded knuckle section, and three long curved blade claws along the outer edge. A blocky recessed panel runs down the back of the forearm.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cuff and the fingers; colour 1 on the main forearm shell and knuckle base; colour 2 on the glove back and the claw tips; colour 3 on the recessed back panel.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The male version has a wider blocky recessed panel with notched edges on the back of the forearm, where the female one is a narrow slit.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A left forearm sleeve of overlapping segmented plates running from a bulky wrist-like cuff band near the elbow down to a fitted fist glove, with a small blade-like antenna sticking out at the top.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates; colour 1 on the glove and the stripes of the upper cuff; colour 2 on the cuff housing and plate gaps; colour 3 on tiny indicator lights on the cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_90s_Tech_02.description: A left-hand gauntlet with a segmented, ridged forearm guard running from below the elbow to the wrist, ending in a fitted fist covering with a small contrasting control-pad box on the outer wrist. Sci-fi tech styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_90s_Tech_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged forearm plates; colour 1 on the hand covering; colour 2 on the control box and its fittings.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Alien_01.description: A close-fitting alien glove covering the whole fist, with smooth faceted plating and a trimmed cuff at the wrist. Long, thick pointed claws extend from the fingertips and run along the palm side and back of the hand.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove; colour 1 on the cuff trim; colour 2 on the claw shafts; colour 3 on the claw tips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Alien_01.differs: The male claws are longer and thicker, jutting out prominently from the fingers, rather than short and tucked in.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A chunky armoured forearm gauntlet on the left hand: a boxy plated cuff with raised rounded slot-like ridges, an open cylindrical barrel end at the elbow side, and a ribbed finger-side extension over the back of the hand. Suggests a superhero blaster.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cuff plating, ribbed extension and outer frame; colour 3 on the raised ridge bars, the barrel end and small side panels; colour 0 on the hand and fingertips' base; colour 3 on the fingertip claws.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Armored_01.description: A left gauntlet with a wide, angular plated cuff flaring at the forearm, a smooth tight-fitting glove over the hand, and a knuckle plate with small spiked studs. Round inset discs decorate the cuff and knuckle plate.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and wrist section; colour 1 on the forearm cuff and knuckle plate; colour 3 on the round inset discs; colour 2 on the knuckle tips.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Armorninja.description: A tight armoured fist-glove: a smooth, angular plate covers the back of the hand and knuckles, with a row of round studs across the knuckles, a contrasting trimmed cuff, and fitted fingers below.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand plate; colour 2 on the cuff edge and lower trim; colour 1 on the knuckle studs; colour 3 on the fingers.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Ball_01.description: A smooth, faceted spherical ball that replaces the left hand, joined to the wrist by a short flat cuff band. Bulbous, plain and cartoonish, it suggests a robotic or cute superhero look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Ball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ball; colour 1 on the wrist cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Banded_01.description: A snug, long left glove covering the hand and forearm, ending in a wide flared cuff with a thin contrasting band along its edge. The fingers are closed in a fist. Simple, clean superhero styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Banded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and cuff; colour 2 on the thin band at the cuff edge.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Bear_01.description: A furry bear-paw hand covering: a rounded, fur-covered fist with larger contrasting claws at the knuckles, and a shaggy cuff of long jagged fur tufts flaring up the forearm.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the long fur tufts up the forearm, fading toward colour 0 on the paw fur; colour 2 on the claws.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Bear_01.differs: The male claws are longer and more prominent, projecting further from the knuckles.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Boxing_01.description: A padded, rounded boxing glove for the left hand, with a puffy fist and thumb section, a short cuff at the wrist with a lettered label band, and criss-crossed lacing up the side.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Boxing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded glove body; colour 3 on the label band at the cuff; colour 2 on the lettering; colour 1 on the laces.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Bracer_Archer_01.description: A short archer's bracer and glove for the left hand: a wide flared cuff over the forearm with an open front panel showing skin, a fitted glove with a padded knuckle guard on the back of the fist. Sporty, practical look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Bracer_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, back of the forearm and glove base; colour 1 on the side panels of the bracer and the finger straps; colour 2 on the knuckle guard and fingers. The open front panel shows the mannequin's skin, not a colour slot.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Bracer_Cosmic_01.description: A left forearm bracer of segmented, angular armor: a tapered tube with horizontal bands, a glossy vertical strip along the inner edge, a flared cuff at the wrist and a raised plated block with a small fin at the elbow end.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Bracer_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main tube body and the wrist cuff edge; colour 2 on the horizontal bands, glossy strip and top plate; colour 0 on the elbow block and metallic side plates; colour 3 on the wrist band.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cannon_01.description: A chunky cylindrical hand cannon that encloses the left fist and hangs past the wrist. It has a faceted barrel body, a tapered rim with small notched marks, and an open muzzle facing upward.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main barrel body and tapered rim; colour 1 on the muzzle interior and end cap; colour 3 on the small marks around the rim.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cannon_02.description: A chunky segmented cannon gauntlet covering the left hand and fist: stacked angular blocks with a round barrel opening on top, side vents and a raised fin, giving a heavy sci-fi weapon look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cannon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper block panels and middle segment faces; colour 1 on the outer casing, lower segment and side plates; colour 2 on the small gaps and vents between segments.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cartoon_01.description: A cartoon-style clenched-fist glove with a rounded, puffy shape and a large bulbous cuff at the wrist. Three short stitched lines mark the back of the hand, and the curled fingertips are contrasting.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cartoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the puffy cuff; colour 3 on the three stitched lines; colour 1 on the fingertips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cartoon_01.differs: The male glove shows more of the contrasting colour across the curled fingertips, so more of colour 1 is visible.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A bulky, clenched-fist covering with a wrinkled, creased surface that looks like a monstrous hide, ending in pointed claws at the knuckles and blade-like spikes jutting from the fingers. Sits over the left hand.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fist covering and finger tips; colour 3 on the claws and spikes.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A bulky, clenched monstrous fist covering the whole left hand, with wrinkled, fur-like or hide texture, a rounded mass over the knuckles and short curved claws protruding from the fingertips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrinkled hide of the fist; colour 1 on the inner finger and palm patches; colour 3 on the claws.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Claw_02.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the left fist and wrist, ending just above the wrist, with long curved claw tips extending from the fingers. The knuckle side is smooth.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove including the finger claws.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Claw_02.differs: The male glove has no spikes along the outer knuckle edge; only the finger claws are present.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Colossus_01.description: A bulky, rounded fist covering made of cracked rock slabs with contrasting seams between the plates, and a few sharp angular shards jutting from the knuckles. Sits over the left hand and wrist, suggesting a stone golem look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates; colour 3 on the cracks and seams between plates; colour 1 on the shards at the knuckles.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A chunky, faceted metal gauntlet covering the left fist, with angular plated knuckles and several long swept-back spikes rising from the back of the hand and knuckles. A rugged cyber-western look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whole gauntlet body and spikes; the default material seems to mostly ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A chunky armoured glove for the left hand: a large rounded cuff and back-of-hand plate with a curved contrasting band, segmented finger sections curled into a fist, and small rounded studs across the knuckles.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and back-of-hand plate; colour 2 on the curved band; colour 3 on the fingers and palm segments; colour 1 on the knuckle studs.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A snug, short fingerless-style glove on a clenched fist, with a cuff band at the wrist, a large panel over the back of the hand with recessed rectangular vents, and angular fin-like accents along the knuckles and edge.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrist cuff; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel; colour 0 on the fingers and palm; colour 3 on the vents and the angular knuckle and edge accents.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A clenched cybernetic left hand with angular, faceted plated knuckles and fingers, topped by a chunky octagonal wrist cuff with a contrasting inner panel, ribbed side slots and a raised rim.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand plates and fingers; colour 1 on the cuff rim and ribbed cuff frame; colour 2 on the cuff panel; colour 3 on the fingertips.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Defender_01.description: A superhero left gauntlet glove: a smooth fist glove with a flared, angular bracer rising up the forearm, swept blade-like knuckle fins, and thin slash markings along the bracer. It ends open at the elbow side.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and fist; colour 1 on the bracer and knuckle plates; colour 3 on the slash markings and thin edge lines; colour 2 on the palm interior.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Deity_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a rounded fitted mitt, a tall angular plate rising along the back of the hand and wrist with a curved cuff, small flat plates on the knuckles and pointed tips at the fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main glove body; colour 0 on the tall back-of-hand plate, knuckle plates and finger tips; colour 3 on the inner lining of the raised cuff; colour 2 on the small tips under the fingers.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A left forearm bracer that flares from the wrist up to the elbow, with a pointed, angular upper edge and a hollow inner lining. Segmented panels are divided by thin banding, in a sleek armored superhero style.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main forearm panels; colour 2 on the segment banding and edge trim; colour 0 on the inner lining and the gloved hand.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A left-hand armoured gauntlet: a segmented, angular vambrace with a flared cuff, a large plate along the outer forearm, a ribbed wrist band and a fitted plated fist covering the hand.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and the forearm segments; colour 1 on the large outer forearm plate; colour 2 on the flared cuff; colour 3 on the ribbed wrist band.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A cartoonish dinosaur-suit glove for the left hand: a smooth, rounded fist with three slash-like stripe marks on the back, small pointed claw tips on the fingers, and a puffy fluffy cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the claw tips; colour 2 on the puffy cuff; colour 3 on the stripe marks.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Drill_01.description: A tapered conical drill worn over the left hand, pointing downward from the wrist, with vertical striped flutes and a studded cylindrical collar ring at the wrist end. Reads as a chunky sci-fi or superhero hand attachment.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar ring and the alternating flute stripes; colour 3 on the other alternating flute stripes; colour 1 on the small inner band beneath the collar; colour 2 on the collar studs.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gauntlet_Short_01.description: A short armored gauntlet for the left hand: a segmented plated shell over the back of the fist and wrist, with small rivets, ridged finger plates and a separate inner panel lining the palm and cuff opening.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gauntlet_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and finger segments; colour 3 on the inner palm lining and the panel along the back of the cuff; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gautlet_01.description: A medieval-style armored gauntlet for the left hand: a tapered plate cuff with a rolled rim and rivets, a segmented knuckle guard, and articulated finger plates over an exposed inner glove.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gautlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and plates; colour 3 on the inner glove beneath the plates; colour 1 on the rim trim, if any.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gladiator_Mace_02.description: A large spiked mace head shaped like a sphere, covered in long conical spikes and scratched with gouges, hanging below the left hand on a short banded collar. A heavy, brutal gladiator-style weapon.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gladiator_Mace_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spherical head and the collar band; colour 3 on the spikes, studs and scratch marks; colour 1 on the cap at the top of the collar; colour 2 on the gap beneath the cap.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gladiator_Sword_02.description: A broad, short gladiator sword held in the left hand, with a wide tapering blade, edge trim and scratch-like marks. The hilt has a banded wrist-level grip and a cluster of spiked knuckle guards. Suggests arena combat.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gladiator_Sword_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade face and the grip band; colour 1 on the blade edges and the pommel cap; colour 3 on the spiked guard and the scratch marks; colour 2 on the guard core.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Glove_Clockwork_Armor.description: A tight left glove that runs into a forearm gauntlet, with a flared cuff at the elbow end, panelled angular plating along the forearm, a banded wrist ring and a fitted fist with segmented knuckle plates. Superhero-tech style.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Glove_Clockwork_Armor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, wrist band and knuckle plates; colour 1 on the main forearm panels and the hand; colour 2 on the inner forearm panel and side of the hand; colour 3 on small accent panels at the wrist and back of the hand.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Aquatic_01.description: A short, snug glove covering the left fist and wrist, with a scale-like or spotted aquatic pattern across the whole surface. It has a plain cuff edge at the wrist and slight wrinkles at the knuckles and fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric of the glove; colour 1 on the oval spots across the pattern.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendant_.description: A short superhero glove covering the fist and wrist, with a V-shaped panel on the back of the hand edged by a raised contrasting trim line. The contrasting fingers are segmented and the lower hem finishes with a trim edge.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and the chevron on the back of the hand; colour 1 on the inset back-of-hand panel; colour 3 on the raised trim outlines; colour 2 on the fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendant_.differs: The male glove ends in a trimmed hem with no separate contrasting cuff band, so the contrasting colour shows only on the fingers.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendant_.description: A short, form-fitting superhero glove for the left hand: a cuff wraps the back of the hand and wrist with curved swooping stripe lines and a contrasting band, over a smooth fist with bare-looking fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fist and fingers; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel; colour 2 on the band across the knuckles; colour 3 on the piping and stripe lines.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the whole clenched fist, with a contrasting cuff band at the wrist and a small contrasting inner panel. Simple, casual superhero styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 2 on the wrist cuff band; colour 0 on the small inner cuff panel.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.differs: The male cuff is a plainer, straighter band, without the sharper pointed flare at the wrist seen on the female version.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.description: A short, close-fitting glove over a clenched fist, ending at the wrist, with bold swooping stripe panels across the back of the hand and knuckles and a small recessed panel at the palm. Sporty superhero look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the swooping stripe panels; colour 2 on the palm opening and inner recess.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.differs: The male glove has a softer, smoother cuff with narrower vertical stripes and no raised palm plate.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the left hand in a clenched fist, ending at the wrist, with a thin raised web-like line pattern of looping and pointed shapes across the back of the hand.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the raised webbing lines.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering a clenched fist and ending at the wrist, with a thin angular line of contrasting piping running down the back of the hand. Simple, sleek superhero styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the angular line trim.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjester_.description: A short, snug glove for the left hand, made of patchwork panels sewn together with bold contrasting cross-stitching across the back of the hand and cuff. Harlequin jester style, ending at the wrist.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjester_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back-of-hand and cuff panel; colour 1 on the palm-side and finger panels; colour 3 on a small patch near the knuckles; colour 2 on the stitching.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjester_.differs: The male glove has contrasting on the back of the hand and cuff with heavy stitching across it, and contrasting on the palm side; the female version has contrasting on the back of the hand.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_01.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the fist and wrist, with a contrasting cuff band, a smooth panel over the back of the hand, and segmented finger plates that give a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main glove body over the back of the hand; colour 1 on the wrist cuff and edge trim; colour 0 on the finger segments and side panel.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_01.differs: The male glove is mostly contrasting across the back of the hand with light finger plates, while the female glove has a light back panel and contrasting side panel.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Glow_01.description: A close-fitting fabric glove on a clenched fist, textured with a fine dimpled weave, with a large rounded panel over the back of the hand, thin lines running to knuckle pads, and exposed fingertips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and knuckle pads; colour 3 on the thin line details; colour 2 on the outlines around the panels.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gunhand_Mechassn_02.description: A bulky mechanical gun-arm replacing the left hand: boxy armored casings around the forearm, ribbed segments and side pods, ending in a cluster of short gun barrels in a ringed muzzle. Sci-fi assassin style.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gunhand_Mechassn_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy casings and muzzle rings; colour 1 on the ribbed segments, pods and top cap; colour 3 on the small panel inserts; colour 2 on the barrels and joints.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gunhand_Warlord_01.description: A bulky sci-fi gun-hand replacing the left hand: a boxy armoured receiver with hazard stripes, a circular emblem and a vented side magazine, with a long ribbed barrel and a small loop handle hanging down the forearm.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Gunhand_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the receiver casing and barrel sections; colour 1 on the top block, vented side, barrel ribs and handle loop; colour 2 on the hazard stripes and small details.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A sci-fi armored gauntlet and glove for the left hand: a fist-fitted glove under a long scalloped plate shell over the forearm, with a round gem-like disc at the wrist and a pointed fin trailing behind.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and armor shell; colour 1 on the round wrist disc and the thin scalloped trim lines; colour 2 on the inner vent openings.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Heroic_01.description: A snug superhero glove covering the left hand in a closed fist, with a short cuff at the wrist, a main panel over the back of the hand and exposed-looking finger segments with contrasting trim.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main back-of-hand panel; colour 1 on the cuff band and edge trim; colour 0 on the finger segments and inner panel accents.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A sci-fi armoured glove covering the left hand in a clenched fist: smooth segmented plates over the back of the hand, contrasting finger joints, and a large angular hexagonal shield plate on the outer side with a round glowing emitter.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand plates; colour 1 on the large hex shield plate; colour 2 on the fingers and joint gaps; colour 3 on the round emitter.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Hook_01.description: A pirate-style hook hand: a tapered cup-shaped cuff capped with a flat stepped top sits over the left wrist, with a thin angular curved hook hanging down from its base.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Hook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff cup and its stepped top; colour 1 on the hook and the small neck joining it.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Hook_01.differs: The male hook has a wider, more open curve and a larger cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A sci-fi armoured glove and forearm guard: a chunky octagonal cuff at the top, banded plating down the forearm, two segmented hoses running from the cuff to the knuckles, and a padded fist with knuckle guard.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and forearm plates; colour 1 on the cuff, bands, clamps and knuckle trim; colour 3 on the segmented hoses; colour 2 on the inner backing, fingers and hose ends.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a shaggy, fur-covered back and jagged tufts, a banded cuff at the wrist, and long pointed claws curling from each finger. Monstrous, festive-demon styling worn on the left hand.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaggy fur covering the back of the hand; colour 1 on the cuff and the claw and knuckle-plate edges; colour 0 on the fingers and cuff stripes.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The male version has long pointed claws on each finger, while the female has shorter fingertips with a single contrasting claw hanging at the side.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Leech_01.description: A left hand replacement forming a chunky, rounded fist with a smooth fleshy back, and a cluster of thick, stubby tentacle-like fingers curling outward from the front and underside. Organic, creature-like and monstrous in style.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the fist and back of the hand as a fleshy skin tone; colour 1 on the tips of the tentacle fingers, blending into the skin tone.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Leech_01.differs: The male version has longer, more spread tentacle fingers that protrude further from the fist, while the female version has shorter, more tucked-in tentacles.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Light_01.description: A close-fitting superhero glove with a smooth fist and a long sleeve covering the forearm to just below the elbow, finished with a banded striped cuff at the wrist and thin trim at the top edge.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove back and cuff band; colour 1 on the palm and finger underside; colour 3 on the forearm sleeve; colour 2 on the thin cuff stripes and top edge trim.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Light_02.description: A short, snug glove for the left hand, covering the fist and wrist and ending in a cuff with two thin contrasting stripes. The palm and inner fingers are a separate panel. Simple superhero styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Light_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and cuff; colour 1 on the palm and inner finger panel; colour 2 on the thin cuff stripes; colour 3 on the open cuff interior.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_01_Longglove.description: A smooth, skin-tight long glove covering the left hand and fist and extending up the forearm to just below the elbow, with a plain straight cuff edge and no added detail.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_01_Longglove_Ann.description: A snug, plain long glove covering the fist and forearm, ending just below the elbow. It has a speckled, textured surface and a smooth tubular fit with no visible straps or fasteners.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_01_Longglove_Ann.colourAreas: The speckled texture mixes light and tones and does not clearly separate into slots; it appears mostly colour 0 with flecks of colour 3 across the whole glove.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Alien_Gladiator_.description: A long alien gauntlet covering hand and forearm: a ribbed, organic-looking inner sleeve and knuckled fist, with stacked segmented armour plates down the outer forearm, each bearing a stud and pointed spikes.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Alien_Gladiator_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed sleeve and fist; colour 1 on the stacked forearm plates and knuckle band; colour 2 on the round studs and the wrist gaps; colour 3 on the spikes.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Birdpeople_01.description: A long smooth glove covering the fist and forearm, with a thick contrasting band at the top cuff and a row of small layered feather-like blades fanning out along the outer edge of the forearm.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and the feather blades; colour 1 on the cuff band.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_01.description: A left-hand armoured gauntlet with a flared angular cuff, a forearm band pierced by rows of round holes, small spikes along the edges, and a plated fist with segmented knuckles. Fantasy knight styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, hand and most of the gauntlet; colour 1 on the band around the forearm; colour 2 on the round holes.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_01.differs: The male gauntlet is mostly one smooth colour with a band of round holes on the forearm, without the female version's separate coloured forearm panel and contrasting hand.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.description: A long, smooth, tight glove covering the hand and forearm, with a ring of short cylindrical canisters strapped around the forearm just below the elbow-side end. Contrasting bands hold the canisters in place. Sci-fi gadget look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove; colour 2 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the canister end caps; colour 3 on the bands between the canisters.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.description: A snug, plain left-hand glove covering the fist and extending into a flared, long cuff over the forearm, with a small V-shaped notch at the inner front edge and a slightly thickened rim. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove including the cuff and rim; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting long glove covering the left hand and forearm to just below the elbow, with the fingers curled into a fist and thick curved claws extending from the fingertips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and claws; other colour slots not visible.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_01.differs: The male claws are larger, thicker and more curved, while the female version has thinner, shorter needle-like claws.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_02.description: A tight long glove covering the hand and forearm, with a contrasting band near the elbow and a tall blade-like fin sweeping up from the back of the forearm. Prominent claws extend from the knuckles. Sleek, superhero look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and fin; colour 2 on the band near the elbow; colour 3 on the inner face of the fin; colour 1 on the claws.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_02.differs: The male version has larger, more prominent claws at the knuckles, while the female claw tips are tiny and barely visible.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_03.description: A tight, long glove reaching up the forearm with a flared open cuff, a row of curved spines along the outer edge of the forearm and curved claws extending from the knuckles.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove, spines and claws; the scheme's other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_03.differs: The male glove has a plain flared cuff with no separate band, and its knuckle claws are the same colour as the glove.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_04.description: A fitted glove covering the hand and forearm in a closed fist, with a thick banded cuff near the elbow studded with hex bolts, and three claw blades curling forward along the fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove; colour 2 on the cuff band; colour 3 on the bolts; colour 1 on the claw blades.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_04.differs: The male claws are chunkier blades that curl forward along the fingers, while the female version has thin spikes projecting sideways from the knuckles.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_01.description: A fitted, fingerless wrap covering the left hand and forearm, with angular contrasting trim bands and a triangular panel near the elbow end. Curved claws extend from the knuckles.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap body; colour 2 on the trim bands and edging; colour 1 on the claws.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_01.differs: The claws are larger and grouped into a visible cluster of curved blades over the knuckles.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_02.description: A tight long glove covering the left hand and forearm, with swept, blade-like fins stacked along the forearm and pointed claw tips on the clenched fingers. Ancient, mystical gauntlet styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the swept fins and forearm blades; colour 3 on the claw fingertips and knuckles.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_03.description: A left-hand armored gauntlet made of overlapping scalloped plates that fan out along the forearm, with a fitted knuckle cover and long curved claws extending from the fingers. Suits fantasy or alien armor looks.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer scalloped plates and hand cover; colour 2 on the underlying gaps and inner panels; colour 0 on the claws.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_03.differs: The male version has long, prominent curved claws over the fingers, while the female version has only tiny claw tips.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Flare_02.description: A smooth, tight-fitting glove covering the left fist, extending up the forearm into a flared cuff cut at a sharp angle, higher on the outer edge. Plain, sleek superhero styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Flare_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Flared_01.description: A fitted long glove covering the hand and forearm, with a thin band at the wrist and a seam down the front. The cuff ends in a sharp pointed flared collar that rises around the elbow side.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and hand; colour 1 on the flared cuff points; colour 2 on the wrist band and seam line.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Flared_01.differs: The male flare is a more continuous, wider ring-like collar with a triangular opening, rather than separate split points.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Flared_02.description: A smooth, plain left-hand glove covering the fist and forearm, with a cuff that flares outward at the open end below the elbow. Clean and form-fitting at the hand, it suits superhero looks.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Flared_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.description: A long, tight superhero glove that runs from the fist to the upper forearm, built from stacked colour-blocked bands with a flared angled cuff and a row of small metal spikes along the outer edge of the forearm.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and lower forearm band; colour 1 on the cuff, mid-forearm band and knuckle cap; colour 2 on the glossy band at the elbow end; colour 3 on the inner cuff accents and palm trim; the spikes take a metallic finish.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.description: A long, tight superhero glove covering the hand and forearm to just below the elbow, built from stacked colour-blocked panels with a flared angular cuff and a small knuckle detail at the fist.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and forearm panels; colour 1 on the cuff, mid-forearm band and knuckle cap; colour 2 on the wide band below the cuff; colour 3 on the small inner cuff and knuckle accents.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Glove_Folded_01.description: A snug left-hand glove covering the fist and forearm, finished with a thick folded-over cuff that flares out just below the elbow. Smooth, plain construction with a casual or superhero feel.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Glove_Folded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove including the folded cuff; the other colour slots are not visible on this sheet.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.description: A snug fingerless hand and forearm wrap that runs from just below the elbow to the knuckles, with angular chevron-shaped contrasting trim bands, a small pleated panel near the top, and a thumb opening.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrap body; colour 2 on the edge trim, chevron bands and cuff outline.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.description: A snug, forearm-length glove covering the hand and wrist, with a flared cuff and a tall jagged lightning-bolt fin rising along the outer forearm. Superhero look, sleek and smooth.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the lightning fin; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Punk_01.description: A snug, fist-shaped glove with a wide flared cuff that stands away from the wrist, edged with a thin contrasting band at the join. Sits on the left hand and lower forearm in a punk-superhero style.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove hand; colour 1 on the narrow band at the wrist; colour 3 on the flared cuff; colour 2 on the thin edge line.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.description: A long, form-fitting glove covering the fist and forearm, with alternating bands of contrasting material and rows of studs tipped with short spikes along the forearm and across the knuckles. Suggests a punk or street-fighter look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, the middle forearm band and the thumb and fingers; colour 0 on the palm, back of the hand and the forearm bands between; colour 3 on the spikes.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.differs: The male glove has shorter, stubbier spikes set on round studs, and a smooth rounded cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Spines_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting long glove covering the hand and forearm up to below the elbow, with a row of long curved spines sweeping back along the outer edge of the forearm.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Spines_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the spines; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Steampunk_04.description: A bulky steampunk gauntlet with a flared forearm cuff, embossed knuckle plate and fist, a looping tube along the side, a round dial at the wrist, and three short cylindrical electrode prongs pointing outward.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Steampunk_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff and knuckle plating; colour 0 on the looping tube and fingers; colour 2 on the dial ring and prong end caps; colour 3 on the electrode cylinders and thin line details.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.description: A long, smooth left-hand glove reaching past the wrist to the forearm, with a flared cuff and a bat-like scalloped wing membrane sweeping back from the outer forearm. Suggests a gothic superhero look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the wing; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.description: A long, close-fitting glove reaching the forearm, with a separate contrasting cuff band at the top and stained, blotchy patches across the hand and wrist. Fingertips are exposed, giving a grimy, undead look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove; colour 1 on the upper cuff band; colour 2 on the exposed fingertips and grime spots; colour 3 on the blood-like stains.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Longarmor_02.description: A fitted left-hand gauntlet covering the fist and forearm with stacked segmented plates, a contrasting flared cuff at the top and a long side panel down the arm, plus small studs across the knuckles.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Longarmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates and fist; colour 1 on the top cuff and the long side panel; colour 3 on the knuckle studs; colour 2 on the thin base under the studs.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A snug fingerless martial-arts glove worn on the left hand: a soft cloth wrap covers the back of the hand and palm to the knuckles, leaving the fingers bare, with a small contrasting cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper wrist and back of the hand; colour 0 on the knuckle and palm area and the lower cuff; colour 2 on the finger tips shown as small nails.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Mechanon.description: A left-hand gauntlet of layered, angular mechanical plates and struts forming a cage-like fist, with a thick banded cuff at the wrist and small pointed spikes at the knuckles. Robotic, sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates and struts; colour 1 on the inner panels and framework; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and some plates; colour 3 on the small spikes and inner accents.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.description: A clenched alien fist with a mottled, crystalline-looking hand and two clawed fingers, wrapped by a segmented band and topped by a tall armoured gauntlet cuff with a flared, ridged rim at the forearm.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the gauntlet cuff and its ridges; colour 3 on the segmented band across the back of the hand; colour 0 and colour 1 mottled across the hand and claws.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.differs: The male version has a taller, blockier cuff and shorter, less prominent claws, without the thin claw spikes seen on the female.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Medium_Flared_01.description: A smooth, tight-fitting glove covering the left hand in a closed fist, with a slightly flared cuff that extends over the wrist and lower forearm. Plain, simple construction suited to most costume styles.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Minigun_01.description: A rotary minigun replacing the left hand: a cluster of long parallel barrels held by stacked ring clamps and banded collars, with short thick muzzle-like housings at the wrist end. Hangs at the arm's end as a bulky sci-fi weapon.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Minigun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrels; colour 3 on the ring clamps and end housings; colour 1 on the banded collar panels; colour 2 on the barrel bases and small details.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Monster_01.description: A clenched monstrous left fist with faceted, low-poly skin-like knuckles and long, sharp curved claws sweeping out from the fingertips. It sits on the hand only, giving a beastly, creature-like look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the fist itself shows a skin tone that does not appear to follow the colour scheme.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Monster_01.differs: The male claws are longer and more prominent, curving far out from the fingertips.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_None_01.description: An essentially empty left-hand piece: only a tiny flat disc-shaped cuff at the wrist end of the sleeve, with no glove, fingers or added detail. The bare hand shows through.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tiny wrist disc; no other coloured features.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Paw_01.description: A clenched, furry beast-paw glove for the left hand, with a straight cuff at the wrist, mottled shaggy fur across the fist, padded palm areas and contrasting curved claws at the fingertips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Paw_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrist cuff and fur streaks; colour 3 on the mottled fur; colour 1 on the paw pads; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A short fingerless glove wrap for the left hand: a soft, wrinkled cloth sleeve covers the back of the hand and wrist, with a wide folded cuff edged in a band with zigzag triangular cutouts. Pirate-style.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth glove and cuff; colour 2 on the cuff band with its triangular notches.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A long fitted glove covering the hand and forearm, ending in a wide flared cuff with a zigzag-edged band at the rim. Chevron-shaped panels run down the outer forearm, giving a fancy pirate look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and cuff; colour 1 on the inner lining of the cuff; colour 2 on the zigzag band at the cuff rim; colour 3 on the chevron panels.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Power_Gauntlet_01.description: A chunky armoured gauntlet covering the forearm and closed fist: a flared cuff, segmented plates with inset contrasting panels, round gem-like studs on the forearm and knuckles, and contrasting gripping fingers. Bold superhero styling.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Power_Gauntlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armour plates and cuff; colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the round gems and knuckle studs; colour 2 on the fingers.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Prisonguantlet_01.description: A chunky, bulky armoured forearm gauntlet covering the wrist and hand, with a curved outer shell, layered segmented plates on top and a draping chain looped between round studs along the outer side. Suggests sci-fi prison restraint gear.
