Male/M_Handl_Tight_Prisonguantlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and cuff band; colour 2 on the upper housing, studs and lower hand cover; colour 0 on the segmented ridge plates; colour 3 on the chain.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Punk_01.description: A punk-style left gauntlet glove with a ribbed knit cuff, a rigid armored forearm shell with a raised outer plate, and a fist section with ribbed knuckle guard ending in pointed claw-like spikes.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauntlet shell and hand; colour 1 on the ribbed cuff and knuckle band; colour 3 on the raised forearm plate and knuckle claws; colour 2 on the rim and finger details.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Raptor_01.description: A clenched left-hand covering shaped like a reptilian fist, with rows of rounded spots across the knuckles and fingers and sharp curved claws jutting out around the fingers and back of the hand. Reads as a monstrous raptor talon.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Raptor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand covering; colour 3 on the spots and edge markings; colour 1 on the claws.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Raptor_01.differs: The male claws stick out at more angles, including from the back and sides of the fist, rather than mostly hanging beneath the fingers.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting glove covering the hand and forearm, with a tribal cuff of hanging pointed flaps and painted U-shaped motifs down the forearm, finished with a ragged, feathery contrasting edge at the top.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 3 on the cuff band and the line motifs; colour 1 on the pointed cuff flaps; colour 2 on the ragged top edge.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A bulky sci-fi gauntlet enclosing the hand and forearm in layered armor plates, with curved blade-like fins along the sides, short cylindrical barrels at the wrist and a central segmented strip.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 2 on the upper housing, spikes and joints; colour 1 on the curved side fins and trim bands; colour 3 on the central strip and small indicator lights.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A cybernetic left forearm and hand piece: an angular plated forearm guard flaring at the wrist, with a bare fist below. Coiled cables wrap the forearm and small hex-bolted sensor nodes sit on the outer face. Sci-fi implant look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forearm plating; colour 0 on the fist and the sensor nodes; colour 2 on the coiled cables; colour 3 on small indicator dots in the nodes.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A cybernetic left hand and forearm implant: a chunky angular plated bracer runs from the forearm over the back of the hand, with a segmented mechanical fist, bolt heads and coiled cables looping around it.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mechanical fist and fingers; colour 1 on the forearm plating; colour 2 on the coiled cables; colour 3 on small accent details and bolt highlights.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Robot_Claw_01.description: A mechanical replacement hand: a boxy wrist cuff with a layered plated forearm block leads to a jointed two-pronged pincer claw with segmented articulated fingers and small rivet-like studs. Sci-fi cyborg look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Robot_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating and finger segments; colour 1 on the wrist cuff and the curved claw tips; colour 2 on the joints and cabling; colour 3 on the small round lights and studs.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A clenched-fist hand covering with a crumpled, mottled surface, jagged crystal-like shards curling around the knuckles and fingers, and a few thin spines poking out; it fits snugly over the hand to the wrist.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fist and wrist surface; colour 1 on the shard facets and streaks along the back of the hand; colour 2 on the mottled patches.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.description: A left hand replaced by an organic, tentacle-like fleshy gauntlet that wraps the hand and forearm, with curling tendrils and small side tabs, ending in a wide curved crescent axe blade with an eye-like disc.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fleshy tendril mass (skin-like tone); colour 1 on the small tabs and the axe blade; colour 2 on the blade's underside edge; colour 3 on the eye-like disc.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.differs: The male axe blade is a broad, short crescent that hangs below the hand, rather than a long narrow spike.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Gun_01.description: An oversized, fleshy alien gun-hand: a bulbous, veined organic mass enclosing the hand and tapering to clawlike points below the fist, with small curling tendrils along the sides.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Gun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fleshy body; colour 1 on the veined streaks and ridges. The default material appears to show mostly its own skin-like tone.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Sword_01.description: A long, narrow, pointed blade held in the left hand, with a fleshy tentacle-like organic grip of curling tendrils wrapped around the hand and hilt. The blade has small round holes along its length and hangs down the thigh.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Roinesh_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; the tentacle grip keeps a fleshy skin tone and ignores the colour scheme; the blade edges take colour 2.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A sci-fi soldier gauntlet for the left hand: a chunky armoured forearm cuff with a flared rim and a slab panel on the outer edge, tapering to a fitted fist glove with knuckle plating and segmented fingers.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm cuff and finger segments; colour 1 on the cuff top, wrist and inner sleeve; colour 2 on the glove back, knuckle plating and side slab; colour 3 on the wrist patch.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Shortfolded_01.description: A snug, short glove covering the left hand in a closed fist, with a thick folded-over cuff at the wrist. Simple, smooth fabric with soft creases across the knuckles; suits casual or superhero looks.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Shortfolded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the folded cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Simian_01.description: A clenched left fist with skin-toned hand and short pointed nails, topped by a ragged tuft of spiky fur that flares up from the wrist over the back of the hand. Suggests an ape-like or beastly hand.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Simian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiky fur at the wrist and back of the hand; colour 0 on the fingernails; the hand itself keeps a fixed skin tone that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_01.description: A skeletal left hand with a smooth wrist cuff, long individual finger bones and a splayed thumb. The fingers extend straight and open, and a jagged faceted ring sits at the wrist.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones and palm; colour 1 and colour 3 on the faceted wrist ring.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_01.differs: The male hand is held open with straight, outstretched fingers, while the female hand has the fingers curled into a tight claw-like grip.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.description: A skeletal monster hand: a lumpy bony wrist and back-of-hand plate with a flared cuff, long thin finger bones curled into a claw, and sharp hooked talons at the fingertips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and back-of-hand bones; colour 1 on the long finger bones; colour 2 on the knuckle joints and lower finger segments; colour 3 on the sharp claw tips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.differs: The male hand has shorter, tighter contrasting claws that stay closer to the curled fingers.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Sleeve_01.description: A tapered tube-shaped sleeve covering the left forearm to the wrist, with a contrasting band at the upper cuff. The loose, crumpled cloth gathers at the wrist opening, with only a sliver of hem trim showing.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Sleeve_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sleeve; colour 1 on the upper cuff band; colour 2 on the small hem edge at the wrist.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Sleeve_01.differs: The male sleeve is more crumpled and gathered at the wrist, with only a thin sliver of hem trim instead of a thick band.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A left-hand covering with a short cuff at the wrist and long, thin, curved claw-like fingertips, held half-open with a long hooked thumb claw; the mottled icy surface suggests a frosty monstrous or alien hand.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand and fingers; colour 1 on the mottled streaks across the knuckles and cuff.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The male version has a more open hand with longer, more extended claws and a long hooked thumb claw.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Space_01.description: A fingerless sci-fi glove for the left hand: smooth, padded fist shell with a raised cuff panel on the back of the hand, segmented knuckle plates and exposed fingertips with separate tip caps.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove shell and finger bases; colour 1 on the cuff and back-of-hand panel; colour 2 on the knuckle plates and edge trim; colour 3 on the fingertips.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A left gauntlet of layered angular armor plates running from the forearm to the fist, with open cutout gaps in the forearm, a segmented wrist joint, and a plated knuckle guard over fingers. Sci-fi ancient-tech look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the armor plates of the forearm and fist; colour 2 on the wrist joint and inner hand; colour 0 on small edge highlights; colour 3 on tiny accents on the plates.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A sleek armored left gauntlet covering the hand and forearm: segmented plates run along the back of the forearm to a pointed cuff, with a ribbed inner section, a contrasting inset panel, and a closed fist with rounded knuckle tips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forearm and hand plates; colour 1 on the inner forearm band and the knuckle tips; colour 2 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the fingers and thumb.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Superlong_01.description: A skin-tight extra-long glove covering the hand and whole forearm and reaching up over the biceps, ending in a thin contrasting band below the shoulder. The surface is smooth and glossy, with a fist-shaped hand.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Superlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and lower forearm; colour 2 on the upper arm and upper forearm section; colour 1 on the top trim band.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A smooth, closed-fist glove with a short cuff, a separate panel down the back of the hand and rounded knuckles. Long curved claws extend from the fingertips, giving it a symbiote-like, monstrous look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and knuckles; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and palm insert; colour 2 on the claws.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_01.differs: The male glove has long, curved claws on the fingertips, where the female version has only small, stubby points.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A bulky symbiote-style glove covering the fist, with a contrasting cuff band and outer panel, plus tall tapering claw spikes rising from the back of the hand and wrist that fade toward their tips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm and fist; colour 1 on the cuff band and outer panel; colour 2 on the claw spike tips.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_02.differs: The male glove has tall claw-like spikes rising from the back of the hand and wrist, rather than a few short knuckle spikes.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A bulky angular armored gauntlet for the left hand, built from faceted plates with a frame handle on top and two cylindrical canisters on the back of the hand. Long tapering claws extend past the fingers, suggesting a sci-fi acid weapon.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted armor plates and frame; colour 1 on the edge panels and the claws; colour 3 on the canisters and their caps; colour 2 on the inner cavity and canister bases.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Talon_01.description: A clenched left hand with a scaly, segmented plated back that runs over the knuckles and fingers, contrasting banded fingertips and long curved contrasting claws that stick out from the curled fingers. A fantasy or monstrous gauntlet look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Talon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scaly plates across the back of the hand; colour 0 on the finger tips and bands; colour 2 on the claws; the skin-toned palm and wrist areas are not part of the colour scheme.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Talon_01.differs: The male claws are longer and more prominent, sticking out from the fingers, while the female ones are shorter and tucked in.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Teddy_01.description: An oversized, lumpy fist covering for the left hand, with a rough, fluffy fur-like texture that wraps the wrist and knuckles. Angular crystal-like shards jut from the underside of the fist. Suits monstrous or elemental looks.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lumpy fist covering; colour 1 on the crystal shards at the base of the fist.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Terror_01.description: A monstrous clenched-fist glove with a lumpy, skin-like surface streaked with jagged contrasting markings, and a row of long sharp metallic claws jutting from the knuckles plus a large curved blade along the outer edge of the hand.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Terror_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skin-like fist surface; colour 2 on the jagged streak markings; colour 0 on the claws and knuckle plates.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Terror_01.differs: The male fist defaults to a strongly saturated colour-3 surface with contrasting streaks, while the female version reads as a more skin-toned surface.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Thick_01.description: A smooth, thick left-hand glove with a clenched fist and a long straight cuff covering most of the forearm. The plain, slightly bulky shape has an angled, slanted upper edge.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Thick_01.differs: The male glove's cuff has a sharper, slanted upper edge, while the female cuff has a rounded opening that flares gently.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Thick_02.description: A plain, thick long glove on the left hand: a smooth clenched-fist shape with a wide, slightly flared cuff that extends well up the forearm, ending just below the elbow. Simple, sleek and unadorned.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Thick_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; the cuff rim appears in the same colour, with no other slots visible.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Toy_01.description: A left forearm sleeve with a textured, mottled tube covering the forearm, a wide flat-topped cuff at the elbow end with a small round gem, and two thick stacked bands near the wrist above the bare fist.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled forearm tube; colour 2 on the top cuff and the wrist bands; colour 3 on the small round gem; colour 1 on the cuff's inner lining.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Trey_King_01.description: A left-hand wrist wrap with a bandaged cuff, holding a long curved saw blade with jagged, notched teeth along one edge. The blade hangs down past the thigh, giving a brutal, monstrous weapon look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Trey_King_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist wrap and the blade's hilt plates; colour 1 on the blade's flat face; colour 2 on the blade's edge and back side.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Trey_King_01.differs: The male blade is broader and more visibly curved, with a wider face than the slimmer female blade.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Urban_Rings_01.description: A set of chunky metal rings worn on the fingers of the left hand, with angular, faceted bands sitting around the curled fingers. A tough street-style accessory.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Urban_Rings_01.colourAreas: The rings are glossy metal and ignore the colour scheme; the hand shown is the bare mannequin hand, not part of the piece.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A sci-fi armored forearm gauntlet and glove: a flared, scoop-shaped shell with a backswept fin rises at the elbow, and a smooth sleeve carries several loose spaced rings down to a fitted knuckle-plated fist.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sleeve and glove panels; colour 1 on the flared shell, rings and knuckle trim; colour 2 on small vent slots on the fins.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Viperia_01.description: A left-hand piece combining a fitted glove with a long sleeve that runs from the upper arm to the wrist. It has a separate band around the forearm, contrasting-edged jagged panel seams and a trimmed upper cuff. Suits a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Viperia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sleeve; colour 1 on the glove and forearm band; colour 2 on the upper cuff and the seam edging.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Webbed_01.description: A bare clenched left fist with skin-like webbing between the fingers and a flared, fin-like flap along the outer edge of the palm. Short nails sit on the fingertips. It suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Webbed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fingernails; the hand and webbing show a skin tone that ignores the colour scheme.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Webbed_01.differs: The male version has visible fingernails and a broad fin-like flap along the edge of the hand instead of thin barbs.

Male/M_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.description: A thin ring band on a finger of the left hand, almost hidden beneath the clenched fist. Only a small sliver of the band and setting shows below the knuckles.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the small stone.
Male/M_Handl_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.differs: The male ring is smaller and mostly hidden by the fist, with no prominent pointed gem hanging below the hand.

Male/M_Handl_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A set of thin finger rings on the left hand, with a frosty, thorny ornament of small leaf-like spikes on some rings and a plain band ring on another. The hand itself stays bare. Suggests a winter-themed fantasy look.
Male/M_Handl_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiky ornamented rings; colour 0 on the plain band ring.
Male/M_Handl_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The male version is only a few finger rings with frosty spikes and leaves the hand bare, with no glove or cuff.

Male/M_Handl_Wrapped_Hook_01.description: A left-hand forearm wrap ending in a chunky curved hook in place of the hand, with a ragged crumpled cuff at the elbow end, banded coils of cord, and a broad flared guard plate along the outer side.
Male/M_Handl_Wrapped_Hook_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the crumpled wrapped sleeve; colour 3 on most of the cord bands; colour 1 on a few cord bands; colour 0 on the guard plate and the metal hook.
Male/M_Handl_Wrapped_Hook_01.differs: The male hook is heavier and broader, with a wider flared guard plate and a thicker, blunter hook.

Male/M_Handr_Animal_01.description: A right clenched-fist hand covering in a skin-like tone with segmented fingers, each ending in a long, curved, sharp contrasting claw; it sits on the hand only and gives an animal, monstrous look.
Male/M_Handr_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner hollows around the fingers and palm; colour 2 on the claws; the skin-toned hand surface ignores the colour scheme.
Male/M_Handr_Animal_01.differs: The male claws are long, prominent curved talons on every finger, rather than short tips.

Male/M_Handr_Animal_02.description: A furry animal-style glove covering the right hand and wrist, with a shaggy tufted cuff, jagged fur edges around the fist opening and a row of prominent curved claws along the fingertips.
Male/M_Handr_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur and fingers; colour 1 on the jagged inner fur tufts; colour 2 on the darkest inner fur spikes; colour 3 on the claws.
Male/M_Handr_Animal_02.differs: The male version has a full row of longer, more visible claws on all four fingers and a wider fist opening.

Male/M_Handr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A chunky right-hand gauntlet forming a closed fist: a bulky segmented armoured cuff and back-of-hand plate with a banded lower edge, and separate articulated finger segments curled into the palm. Retro robot look.
Male/M_Handr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff plating; colour 2 on the main hand plate and finger bases; colour 1 on the lower cuff band; colour 3 on the finger segments and the top rim of the cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Astronaut_01.description: A chunky sci-fi astronaut glove for the right hand: a rounded, padded fist with a thick rolled cuff ring at the wrist, a separate side panel, and a bulky contrasting palm grip with segmented finger pads.
Male/M_Handr_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the side panel and the inset under the palm; colour 2 on the palm pad; colour 3 on the cuff ring.

Male/M_Handr_Baseball_01.description: A padded leather baseball catcher's glove worn on the right hand, with four stubby fingers, a deep pocket, a woven lattice web between the thumb and fingers, an open wrist hole, and contrasting stitching along the seams.
Male/M_Handr_Baseball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 3 on the stitching and lacing marks; colour 1 on the woven web and lattice.

Male/M_Handr_Beast_Claw_Mechanical_01.description: A mechanical right-hand gauntlet forming a clenched fist: a segmented plated back of hand, ribbed finger plates with grooved channels, a round bolt-like cap at the knuckle side, and small claw tips, fitted over a narrow wrist cuff.
Male/M_Handr_Beast_Claw_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand plates and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the finger grooves, ribbing and round cap; colour 2 on the inner joints and claw undersides; colour 3 on the small striped panels near the knuckles.

Male/M_Handr_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: A bulky mechanical gauntlet for the right hand and forearm, with a wide cuff, segmented finger plates and a thin cable looping along the wrist. Long blade-like claws extend past the fingers, giving a menacing, cyberpunk-gothic look.
Male/M_Handr_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the gauntlet body, cuff and finger plates; colour 1 on the long blades; colour 3 on the small accent lights on the cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Bounty_01.description: A chunky sci-fi gauntlet glove covering a closed fist, with a short flared cuff, panelled body and an octagonal plate on the outer side of the hand. Segmented knuckle guards sit across the back of the fingers.
Male/M_Handr_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm side and cuff panels; colour 1 on the main back of the glove and inner palm; colour 2 on the knuckle guards and plate frame; colour 3 on the octagonal plate face.

Male/M_Handr_Bracers_Holoforce_01.description: A right forearm bracer of angular, translucent glassy plates: a layered shell over the forearm, a separate band near the wrist, and a long blade-like spike running along the outer edge toward the hand.
Male/M_Handr_Bracers_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and glassy and mostly ignores the colour scheme; the plates show a pale, light finish, with little visible use of colours 1, 2 or 3.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_01.description: A rotary gatling-gun hand piece: a cylindrical bundle of long barrels clamped by two chunky rings, one mid-way and a studded, notched ring at the muzzle end. It hangs below the right fist like a mechanical forearm cannon.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrels; colour 0 on the two clamp rings; colour 3 on the barrel tips at the muzzle end.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_02.description: A chunky cylindrical gauntlet-like cuff worn around the right forearm just above the hand, with an angular faceted casing, a recessed screen panel on the outer face, three rounded vent slots and a circular cap on top.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and top cap; colour 2 on the recessed panel surround and bottom rim; colour 1 on the screen; colour 3 on the three vent slots.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_03.description: A half-round bracer-like block worn on the right forearm near the wrist: a curved front face of ammunition-like cylinders between a rim and contrasting banding, with a flat plain back. Reads as a gatling gun mount.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer casing and rim; colour 1 on the row of cylinders; colour 2 on the banding and underside.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_04.description: A chunky cylindrical canister worn on the right forearm above the wrist, with a capped top, a recessed side panel, a short rod beside it and a bent hose ending in a small connector near the hand.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body and rod; colour 1 on the top cap, end ring, side panel and connector; colour 2 on the back panel; colour 3 on the hose.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_01.description: A rotary gatling barrel cluster hanging below the right hand: a bundle of parallel tubes held by two chunky band rings, with a notched collar at the muzzle end. Open at the top, with a sci-fi weapon look.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the barrel tubes; colour 0 on the two band rings and the notched muzzle collar; colour 3 on the barrel tips.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_02.description: A chunky cylindrical canister worn around the right forearm just above the wrist, with chamfered edges, a circular recessed cap, a contrasting inset panel with a framed insert on the front, and three curved slots on the back.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and cap; colour 2 on the front panel and edge bands; colour 1 on the framed insert in the front panel; colour 3 on the three curved slots.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_03.description: A chunky half-round wrist-mounted gun block worn on the right forearm: a flat-sided housing with a rounded back, a recessed dished top and a ring of ribbed cylindrical barrels or cells wrapped around the curved edge.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer housing and top plate; colour 1 on the ribbed cylinders; colour 2 on the bands and base around the cylinders.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_04.description: A chunky cylindrical canister strapped along the right forearm, with capped ends, a contrasting inset panel on the outer side, a short side nozzle and a thin cable dangling to a small connector near the wrist. Suggests a sci-fi ammo or power unit.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Gatling_Alt_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister body and nozzle; colour 1 on the end caps and the inner stripe; colour 2 on the inset side panel; colour 3 on the dangling cable.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Long_Mecha_01.description: A long, boxy mechanical clamp housing that encloses the right hand and extends past the fist, with a slotted window showing small block teeth inside and a split, chamfered end with contrasting bands.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Long_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing; colour 2 on the thin band above the tip; colour 3 on the end tips of the clamp jaws; colour 1 on the small teeth inside the window.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Long_Mecha_01.differs: The male version is shorter and wider, with a broader window and fewer teeth.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Tight_Long_Birdpeople.description: A row of five stacked, blade-like feather fins jutting from the outer edge of the right forearm, growing longer toward the elbow end. It suggests a bird-person or winged hero look.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Tight_Long_Birdpeople.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the feather blades; the default material appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A tiny flat octagonal cap that seals the end of the right sleeve at the wrist, covering the opening with a thin disc. It has no other detail and reads as a plain cover.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap disc.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Tight_Prisonguantlet_.description: A short length of heavy chain links hanging from the right wrist, looped around it in two strands like a broken shackle. No cuff or glove is visible, so the hand stays bare. Gives a prisoner or escaped-captive look.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Tight_Prisonguantlet_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all the chain links; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Handr_Child_Tight_Prisonguantlet_.description: A short length of heavy chain with two loose strands of linked oval links, hanging from the right wrist and dangling past the hand. No gauntlet body is visible, so it reads as a broken prisoner's shackle chain.
Male/M_Handr_Child_Tight_Prisonguantlet_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all of the chain links.

Male/M_Handr_Defender_Update_01.description: A right-hand armoured gauntlet with a long angular forearm guard built from stacked segmented plates, a bulky fist section with a hexagonal knuckle plate, and finger caps. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Male/M_Handr_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff, back plate and finger caps; colour 1 on the main forearm and fist plates; colour 2 on the front forearm panel and wrist band; colour 3 on the small accents on the hand.
Male/M_Handr_Defender_Update_01.differs: The male gauntlet has a taller, bulkier forearm guard and a larger, more enclosed fist.

Male/M_Handr_Draco_01.description: A fingerless fist glove with a smooth padded cuff and back, segmented armored knuckle plates over the fingers, and long curved claw spikes sweeping from the knuckles. Sits on the right hand with an aggressive dragon-like look.
Male/M_Handr_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main glove body and cuff; colour 2 on the knuckle plates; colour 0 on the palm, back panel and inner finger plating; colour 3 on the claw spikes.
Male/M_Handr_Draco_01.differs: The male glove has long, prominent contrasting-slot claw spikes over the knuckles, while the female version has only tiny claw tips.

Male/M_Handr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A clenched, scaly right-hand covering shaped like a dragon's fist, with a chunky rounded wrist cuff, textured scale pattern across the back and knuckles, and sharp curved claws tipping each finger.
Male/M_Handr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaled hand covering; colour 0 on the claws.

Male/M_Handr_Dryad_01.description: A chunky clenched-fist covering for the right hand, made of layered, bark-like angular plates with streaky vein-like markings, and long separated finger plates curling into the palm. Suggests a nature-guardian look.
Male/M_Handr_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the fist and finger plates; colour 3 on the streaky vein markings running along the plates.
Male/M_Handr_Dryad_01.differs: The male fingers are longer and more separated, sticking out from the fist, while the female version has shorter fingers tucked into a compact fist.

Male/M_Handr_Dryad_02.description: A clenched right-hand glove in a chunky, organic style: a smooth wrist cuff, mossy textured patches across the back and side of the fist, and segmented armored finger plates curling into the palm.
Male/M_Handr_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and main glove body; colour 1 on the mossy textured patches and finger edges; colour 2 on the segmented finger and knuckle plates.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Gamer_01.description: A wrist cuff with a curved back plate and a bulky padded front, joined by a looping cable to a slim rectangular game-controller slab that dangles along the forearm. It suggests a playful, casual gamer look.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the controller body and the outer wrist plate; colour 2 on the cuff; colour 3 on the controller buttons, cross pad and cuff stripe; colour 1 on the cable.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Lockbox_67_01.description: A wrist cuff with a buckled band paired with a cluster of sharp, blade-like claw spikes and thin linked frame loops across the knuckles and fingers of the fist. Aggressive, gauntlet-style street or sci-fi weapon look.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wrist band and the claw blades; colour 1 on the band edging and the thin linking frames.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Long_Mechaclaw_01.description: A pair of long, flat curved blade claws that hang down from the right fist, alongside a separate angular guard plate at the hand. Sleek, sharp mechanical weapon-gauntlet look.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Long_Mechaclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two long claw blades; colour 1 on the angular hand guard plate.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Reactor_04.description: A short armoured hand guard for the right fist: a rounded plate wraps the wrist and back of the hand, with a separate side panel, thin edge trim and small rivets. Its jagged lower edge sits over the knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate over the hand and the lower knuckle edge; colour 1 on the side panel; colour 2 on the thin edge trim; colour 3 on the rivets.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Short_Retroscifi_Bubb.description: A small translucent curved shell shaped like a half bubble, attached to the outer edge of the right hand and wrist. It is thin and glassy, in a retro sci-fi style.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Short_Retroscifi_Bubb.colourAreas: The default material appears glassy and translucent and ignores the colour scheme; no colour slot is clearly visible.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Drill_01.description: A tapering conical drill held in the right fist, with a flat multi-sided cap at the top, a sharp point downward and vertical fluted stripes running the length of the cone. Simple, chunky tool-hand style.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top cap and alternating flutes; colour 3 on the other alternating flutes; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Punk_01.description: A short wrist cuff with a ribbed knit band rising above a rounded, beveled armored bracer. A raised hexagonal panel sits on the outer side of the wrist. Punk-styled and worn on the right wrist.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer shell; colour 1 on the ribbed knit cuff; colour 3 on the raised outer panel; colour 2 on the edge trim and lower rim.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A floating, oversized sci-fi right-hand device: an angular armoured casing with clawed prongs, small barrel-like cylinders and a contrasting sensor dot, ringed by detached curved blade-like fins hovering around the hand.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing plates and inner fin panels; colour 1 on the outer fin edges, lower casing band and small square emblem; colour 2 on the prongs and upper housing; colour 3 on the sensor dot.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The male version adds a small square emblem plate below the cylinders and has a slimmer casing.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.description: A bulky sci-fi gauntlet for the right hand: angular layered armor plates around the forearm and fist, with jagged fins on top, a curved blade-like spike beside the hand and two small cylindrical emitter barrels at the knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates; colour 2 on the upper fins, blade spike and plate edges; colour 1 on the cuff band and the small block under the barrels; colour 3 on the small round studs.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A set of three curved, tapering claw blades that extend from the right hand's knuckles and hang downward, with blocky bases and sharp points. Suggests a monstrous symbiote or organic weapon look.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claw bases and upper blades; colour 1 on the tapering claw tips, blending down from the bases.

Male/M_Handr_Extra_Wrapped_Hook_002.description: A faceted, angular metal hook that replaces the right hand: a flat shaft extends from the fist and bends into a deep J-curve ending in a sharp upturned point. Suggests a pirate or brutal prosthetic look.
Male/M_Handr_Extra_Wrapped_Hook_002.colourAreas: The default metal material ignores the colour scheme and shows a glossy metallic finish across the whole hook; no separate colour areas are visible.

Male/M_Handr_Fem_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A set of small rings worn on the fingers of the right hand: a thin band with a butterfly-like winged ornament on one finger, and a chunky band with a frilly edge on another. Delicate, decorative jewellery.
Male/M_Handr_Fem_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin ring bands and the winged ornament's edges; colour 1 on the chunky ring band; colour 2 on the inner wings of the ornament.

Male/M_Handr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A clenched right-hand covering shaped like a chunky fist, with a smooth rounded back and knuckles and pointed, slightly clawed fingertips curled into the palm. It ends at the wrist with a plain straight cuff edge.
Male/M_Handr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hand covering, including the fingers; no other slots visible.
Male/M_Handr_Foxbatcon_2025_01.differs: The male fingers are longer and more pointed, reading as small claws, while the female version has short blocky fingertips.

Male/M_Handr_Gatling_01.description: A large arm-mounted gatling cannon replacing the right hand: a cluster of long barrels with segmented rings, a boxy housing with drum magazines and vented side canisters, plus a small tank and exposed wiring behind.
Male/M_Handr_Gatling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, drums, rings and barrel bands; colour 1 on the barrels and housing panels; colour 3 on the vent slots, panel marks and barrel tips; colour 2 on the small lens and gaps.

Male/M_Handr_Gatling_Alt_01.description: A bulky sci-fi gatling gun replacing the right hand: a cylindrical armored housing at the forearm with slotted vents, a side canister, and a barrel cluster of long rods ending in a ringed muzzle.
Male/M_Handr_Gatling_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, canister and muzzle rings; colour 1 on the barrel rods and housing bands; colour 3 on the vent slots, small cables and barrel tips; colour 2 on the side panel and sensor.

Male/M_Handr_Glove_Odragon_01.description: A fitted right-hand glove in a closed fist pose with a short forearm cuff. A jagged, swooping separate panel runs up the outer wrist, edged with thin contrasting piping and a trimmed top edge.
Male/M_Handr_Glove_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove and fingers; colour 1 on the swooping wrist panel; colour 2 on the piping and cuff edge.

Male/M_Handr_Glove_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A fingerless fist glove with a tall, flared forearm cuff, a wide strapped wrist band and a padded knuckle section. Fingertips and thumb are left bare. Suggests a sci-fi adventurer or space scoundrel look.
Male/M_Handr_Glove_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff and knuckle pads; colour 1 on the mid forearm panel and the hand sections; colour 2 on the wrist strap and the stripe down the cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Heraldry_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet with a rigid angular plate over the back of the hand and knuckles, a textured mesh palm, and long contrasting talon-like claws curving from the fingers. Gives an armored, predatory look.
Male/M_Handr_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the armored plates, finger segments and long claws; colour 1 on the textured palm and side mesh; colour 3 on the claw bases and knuckle tips.
Male/M_Handr_Heraldry_01.differs: The male gauntlet has long, swept-back talons rising from the fingers, while the female version has only short fingertip claws.

Male/M_Handr_Insect_01.description: A clenched right-hand covering shaped like an insect claw: a smooth wide cuff over the back of the hand, with pointed talon tips on the knuckles and curled segmented fingers carrying clustered contrasting hooked spines.
Male/M_Handr_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand and cuff shell; colour 3 on the knuckle claws and finger tips; colour 1 on the curled finger segments; colour 2 on the cluster of hooked spines on the back of the fingers.
Male/M_Handr_Insect_01.differs: The male version has a cluster of several contrasting hooked spines along the fingers and shorter knuckle claws, without the single large hook.

Male/M_Handr_Insulating_Glove_01.description: A chunky right-hand glove with a wide flared cuff that runs up the forearm, a separate rectangular panel on the outer forearm, and a closed fist with segmented, plated fingers. It has a protective, utility-suit look.
Male/M_Handr_Insulating_Glove_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim and finger segments; colour 1 on the forearm sleeve and knuckle edging; colour 3 on the rectangular forearm panel; colour 2 on the palm and hand covering.

Male/M_Handr_Junkbot_01.description: A right-hand replacement built from scrap-metal parts: a wrist cuff, thin rod struts, angular plates, a thick cylindrical block along the outer side and a claw-like grip. It looks improvised and robotic.
Male/M_Handr_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rods, cylinder and main plates; colour 1 on the wrist cap and angular panels; colour 2 on the cuff band and flat grip plates; colour 3 on the small panels and bolts.
Male/M_Handr_Junkbot_01.differs: The male version adds a thick cylindrical block along the outer side of the hand and has a more open, splayed claw arrangement.

Male/M_Handr_Kaiju_01.description: A right-hand covering with a short, fitted cuff over the hand and three long, curved talon-like claws extending from the knuckles, plus a raised segmented plate across the back of the hand. Monstrous, creature-like style.
Male/M_Handr_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main hand covering; colour 1 on the segmented plate on the back of the hand; colour 0 on the long claws; colour 2 on the small claw tips near the knuckles.

Male/M_Handr_Kaiju_02.description: An oversized monstrous right hand: a bulbous cluster of overlapping jagged scales around the fist that tapers into one long curved, ridged talon hanging downward. A tall horn-like spike rises from the top of the scales.
Male/M_Handr_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the overlapping scale cluster and horn spike; colour 1 on the long curved talon.
Male/M_Handr_Kaiju_02.differs: The male version has a tall horn-like spike rising from the top of the scale cluster.

Male/M_Handr_Largehook_01.description: A large pirate-style hook replacing the right hand: a short cylindrical cuff at the wrist with a thin, angular metal shaft that kinks and curls into a long pointed barb hanging down past the hip.
Male/M_Handr_Largehook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff; colour 1 on the hook shaft and barb.

Male/M_Handr_Lockbox_67_01.description: A clenched-fist glove with a soft, slightly baggy hand and a buckled cuff band at the wrist. Tribal-style line patterns decorate the back of the hand, and sharp contrasting claw spikes jut from the knuckles and fingertips.
Male/M_Handr_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the cuff band and the knuckle claws; colour 1 on the pattern lines, piping and cuff edge trim.

Male/M_Handr_Long_Gamer_01.description: A chunky retro game-controller gauntlet: a wide cylindrical forearm cuff with an octagonal rim, a raised button panel with a cross and dots on the outer side, and coiled cable wraps at the wrist ending in a small wrist pad.
Male/M_Handr_Long_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body and glove; colour 1 on the coiled cable wraps; colour 2 on the rim and wrist pad; colour 3 on the cross, dots and stripe markings.

Male/M_Handr_Long_Mecha_01.description: A blocky mechanical gauntlet-clamp worn over the right hand: a wide angular housing with a triangular marking tapers into a slotted twin-pronged pincer with notched teeth and banded tips, flanked by two side fins.
Male/M_Handr_Long_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and prongs; colour 1 on the side fins; colour 3 on the triangle marking and the pincer tips; colour 2 on the thin bands near the tips.

Male/M_Handr_Long_Mechaclaw_01.description: A boxy mechanical gauntlet housing over the right hand with an open-topped cuff, twin cylindrical pistons along the side, small clamp fittings, and two long curved blade claws sweeping down past the fingers.
Male/M_Handr_Long_Mechaclaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and the long claw blades; colour 1 on the top cuff and the small hooked claw; colour 2 on the piston cylinders; colour 3 on the clamps and fasteners.

Male/M_Handr_Long_Variable_Robot_002.description: A robotic right gauntlet-hand: a chunky angular cuff flows into a clenched fist with segmented blocky fingers, and a contrasting band at the wrist edge. Sits over the whole hand and wrist, suggesting a mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Handr_Long_Variable_Robot_002.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff, fist and fingers; colour 2 on the flat panel strip at the wrist edge.

Male/M_Handr_Mecha_02.description: A chunky mechanical right-hand gauntlet: a segmented, angular fist with plated fingers curled shut and a large slab-like shield plate mounted along the outer side of the hand. Sci-fi mecha styling.
Male/M_Handr_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large side plate; colour 2 on the back-of-hand block and knuckle base; colour 0 on the finger plates and top cap; colour 3 on the finger tips and inner joints.
Male/M_Handr_Mecha_02.differs: The side plate is a flatter, squarer slab on the male version, and the contrasting finger plates are more prominent and ribbed.

Male/M_Handr_Mitten_Santa_01.description: A chunky, rounded mitten covering the right fist, with a thumb tucked against the palm and a thick puffy cuff at the wrist. Festive, cartoonish holiday style, built from separate colour panels.
Male/M_Handr_Mitten_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mitten body and parts of the cuff; colour 3 on the panel across the back of the hand; colour 2 on the back of the hand and part of the cuff; colour 0 on the top of the cuff and the thumb and fingertips.
Male/M_Handr_Mitten_Santa_01.differs: The male mitten uses a patchwork colour pattern of blue, red, contrasting and light panels rather than a light mitten with a single contrasting cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Moth_01.description: A right-hand clenched gauntlet with a segmented, plated fist and a wide, flat flared cuff at the wrist. Long, curved claws sweep back from the knuckles, giving a creature-like superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the flared cuff and wrist panels; colour 1 on the segmented fist plates; colour 0 on the claws.
Male/M_Handr_Moth_01.differs: The male version has a row of long, curved claws along the knuckles, where the female version has shorter, smaller claws.

Male/M_Handr_Nightmare_Bladed_01.description: A bladed forearm guard: a long, tapering armored plate with a swept, pointed blade tip extending past the wrist, angular panels and an open back. It sits along the outer forearm with a dark, fantasy-armor look.
Male/M_Handr_Nightmare_Bladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame, edges and blade; colour 1 on the upper panel near the elbow; colour 3 on the large lower panel; colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Handr_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A right forearm bracer of overlapping angular plates with a flared cuff at the wrist and a long swept-back spike rising past the elbow. It sits over the forearm like fantasy armour.
Male/M_Handr_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the spike; colour 1 on the smaller inner plates and cuff edges. The glossy metallic finish largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Handr_Reactor_04.description: A chunky armoured gauntlet over a clenched fist, made of segmented plates with a raised cuff panel on the outer side, small rivet-like dots, and separate finger blocks. It reads as a sci-fi power fist.
Male/M_Handr_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main knuckle and back-of-hand plates; colour 1 on the cuff panel and the fingers; colour 3 on the small rivet dots; colour 2 on the seam lines between plates.

Male/M_Handr_Renegade_01.description: A right-hand glove in a sci-fi armoured style: a short cuff and smooth hand shell with a contrasting wrap-around band across the back of the hand, two screw-like fasteners, and separate segmented finger plates.
Male/M_Handr_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove shell and cuff; colour 1 on the raised band across the back of the hand; colour 2 on the segmented finger plates; colour 3 not visible.

Male/M_Handr_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A right-hand fist gauntlet with a bulky, angular plated block over the back of the hand and knuckles, rounded segmented finger pieces curled into a fist, and a bevelled rim of contrasting trim around the plate.
Male/M_Handr_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the large back-of-hand plate; colour 0 on the bevelled rim trim and edging; colour 1 on the segmented fingers and thumb.

Male/M_Handr_Retro_Warlord_02.description: A rotary minigun replacing the right hand: a chunky ribbed cylindrical housing with a separate collar ring, a cluster of long parallel barrels, and banded muzzle rings at the tip. Hangs at the side of the body.
Male/M_Handr_Retro_Warlord_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed housing; colour 2 on the collar ring; colour 0 on the barrels and muzzle rings.

Male/M_Handr_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.description: A mechanical right hand in a steampunk style: a boxy plated back of hand with a bolted side panel, chunky segmented fingers with round bolt-like joints, and a thick cylindrical thumb. Covers the whole hand.
Male/M_Handr_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back-of-hand plate; colour 1 on the side panel; colour 2 on the finger segments and inner palm; colour 3 on the bolts, joint caps and thumb cylinder.
Male/M_Handr_Robot_Steam_Punk_01.differs: The male hand has shorter, stubbier fingers packed closer into a compact fist-like shape.

Male/M_Handr_Robotexo_01_Basic.description: A robotic exoskeletal right hand: a flat plated back-of-hand shell with three round studs, a wrist cuff, thin rod-like struts and segmented mechanical fingers curled in a grip, with small cylindrical joint housings at the knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Robotexo_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and the back-of-hand plate; colour 1 on the fingers and struts; colour 2 on the joint housings and cuff underside; colour 3 on the joint lights.

Male/M_Handr_Scarab_01.description: A chunky right-hand gauntlet with a wide cuff and a glossy angular plate on the outer side. Segmented armoured finger plates curl into a fist, each ending in a long pointed claw. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Handr_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff and hand body; colour 2 on the glossy outer plate; colour 1 on the segmented finger plates; colour 3 on the claws.
Male/M_Handr_Scarab_01.differs: The male version has long, prominent claws extending from the knuckles, while the female version has only tiny tips.

Male/M_Handr_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_01.description: A short retro sci-fi glove for the right hand: a fingerless, padded fist wrap with segmented knuckle guards, enclosed by a clear glass bubble dome around the hand. Sits at the wrist and hand only.
Male/M_Handr_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knuckle guards and glove plates; colour 1 on the small inset panel on the back of the hand; colour 2 on the inner glove lining; the bubble dome is glassy and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Handr_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_02.description: A right-hand glove made of angular segmented plates over a clenched fist, enclosed by a clear glass bubble dome on the palm side. contrasting-lit seams and a round palm panel give it a retro sci-fi robotic look.
Male/M_Handr_Short_Retroscifi_Bubble_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented finger and knuckle plates; colour 1 on the glowing seam lines and round palm panel; colour 2 on the inner gaps; the bubble dome is clear and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Handr_Skeleton_02.description: A skeletal right hand made of separate finger and thumb bones with rounded joint knobs, curled into a loose fist and attached to a short flat cuff band at the wrist. Gothic, macabre look.
Male/M_Handr_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint ends; colour 2 on the wrist cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Skin_Fur_01.description: A bare clenched right hand with skin-textured fingers and a tuft of shaggy, spiky fur along the outer edge and wrist, with contrasting scratch-like markings. Monstrous werewolf style; each finger ends in a long contrasting claw.
Male/M_Handr_Skin_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts along the outer hand and wrist; colour 1 as shading in the fur; colour 2 on the claws and scratch markings; the skin ignores the colour scheme.
Male/M_Handr_Skin_Fur_01.differs: The male hand has long, prominent contrasting claws on every finger, where the female version shows only small claw tips.

Male/M_Handr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.description: A clenched right fist with skin-textured, wrinkled knuckles, a ragged tuft of fur spikes around the wrist, and long curved claws that sweep out from the fingertips. Monstrous werewolf hand.
Male/M_Handr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur tufts at the wrist; colour 2 on the claws; the skin-toned hand does not follow the colour scheme.
Male/M_Handr_Skin_Fur_Claws_01.differs: The male claws are noticeably longer and more prominent, sweeping out beyond the fingers.

Male/M_Handr_Steelcommando_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet with a smooth, glossy metal-like plate covering the back of the hand and knuckles, segmented articulated finger plates, and small pointed contrasting-tipped spikes along the fingertips. Retro armored superhero style.
Male/M_Handr_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back-of-hand plate; colour 1 on the segmented finger plates; colour 3 on the fingertip spikes; colour 2 on the darker inner shading of the plate.

Male/M_Handr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A clenched-fist gauntlet with a smooth, glossy shell over the hand, segmented finger plates, a short octagonal cuff at the wrist, and rounded knuckle studs. A retro superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove shell; colour 1 on the wrist cuff, finger plates and edge panels; colour 3 on the rounded knuckle studs.
Male/M_Handr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.differs: The male version has a smoother, more rounded shell and larger finger plates on the palm side, but the design is otherwise similar.

Male/M_Handr_Swing_01.description: A chunky, clenched-fist glove with a rounded cuff, angular panels over the knuckle and outer side of the hand, and segmented padded finger sections. It has a bulky, sporty-superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and cuff; colour 1 on the raised outer and knuckle panels; colour 2 on the fingers.

Male/M_Handr_Swing_02.description: A smooth, soft cloth glove for the right hand, shaped into a clenched fist with a short cuff at the wrist. Loose creases across the back and a plain, unadorned finish suggest a casual or superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_01_Glove.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with a plain cuff ending just above the wrist and individually modelled curled fingers. Simple casual or superhero styling.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_01_Hand.description: A bare right hand with five separate fingers curled into a relaxed fist, thumb wrapped across the front. It sits at the end of the wrist and shows a natural, unadorned human shape.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_01_Hand.colourAreas: Skin tone is fixed and ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 appears only on the flat wrist cut-off and the fingertip nails.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_01_Hand_Claw.description: A bare right hand clenched in a fist, with four long, slender, sharply pointed claws extending from the knuckles along the back of the fingers. Suggests a feral, monstrous or animalistic look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_01_Hand_Claw.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the hand itself is skin and does not take the colour scheme.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_2fingers_01.description: A bare right hand with a closed fist, showing the fingers curled in with two fingertips tipped by short nails. It sits at the end of the sleeve and suggests a plain, natural hand.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_2fingers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fingernails of the two visible fingers; the rest of the hand shows skin tone and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A right-hand gauntlet with a flared, angular forearm guard, a fitted fist section with knuckle plates, and three long curved blade claws along the outer edge. Superhero styling with a 90s comic feel.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cuff and the knuckle plates; colour 1 on the lower forearm and the claw undersides; colour 2 on the glove and some claw tips; colour 3 on the back panel of the forearm.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The male gauntlet's cuff is taller and rounder, with a small slit and spike on the back.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A right-hand piece made of a fitted glove and a segmented, ribbed armour sleeve running from a tech cuff band below the shoulder to the wrist. It suggests a sleek 90s sci-fi look, with a small antenna-like clip on the cuff.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed forearm sleeve segments; colour 1 on the glove and the cuff stripes; colour 2 on the cuff housing and segment edges; colour 3 on the small cuff light.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_90s_Tech_02.description: A tech gauntlet with a segmented, overlapping-plate forearm guard running from below the elbow to the wrist, ending in a fitted glove with a knuckle plate and a small panel on the outer hand.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_90s_Tech_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates; colour 1 on the glove fabric; colour 2 on the wrist panel and knuckle plate; colour 3 on a small accent on the wrist panel.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Alien_01.description: A chunky, angular glove covering the whole clenched fist, with faceted planes and a banded cuff at the wrist. Long, tapered claw fingers extend over the back of the hand and curve toward the palm. Suggests alien armor.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the cuff band; colour 2 on the claw fingers; colour 3 on the claw tips.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Alien_01.differs: The male claws are longer and more prominent, sweeping across the back of the hand, and the knuckle side has no contrasting marks.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A bulky armored gauntlet-blaster covering the right forearm and wrist, with raised banded ridges on the outer face, a swept side panel, and a ribbed finned barrel beside the knuckles. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell, ridged barrel and edge frames; colour 3 on the raised ridge bands, side panels and inner recess; colour 0 on the hand glove; colour 3 on the pointed fingertip claws.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Armadillo_01.differs: The male version has sharper claw-like fingertips and a shorter, thinner plate hanging beside the hand.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Armored_01.description: A close-fitting glove for the right hand with a smooth fist and a wide, flared armoured cuff on the forearm. A plated guard covers the back of the hand, with small round studs and contrasting knuckle tips.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove fabric and fingers; colour 1 on the forearm cuff and the back-of-hand plate; colour 3 on the round studs; colour 2 on the knuckle tips and cuff edging.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Armorninja.description: A fingerless armoured glove for the right hand: a rounded, plated cuff and back-of-hand guard with a row of round studs across the knuckles, and exposed segmented finger sections beneath.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plated hand guard and cuff; colour 2 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the round knuckle studs; colour 3 on the finger sections.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Ball_01.description: A smooth, faceted spherical ball that replaces the right hand, joined to the wrist by a short thick cylindrical cuff band. Simple, rounded and cartoonish, it suits robotic or cute costumes.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Ball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ball; colour 1 on the wrist cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Banded_01.description: A smooth, tight right-hand glove covering the fist and reaching up the forearm, finished with a wider, flared cuff band at the top edge with a thin separating line. Simple, clean superhero styling.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Banded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and the cuff band; the thin separating line at the cuff edge is a darker inset.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Bear_01.description: A right-hand and forearm covering styled as a bear paw: shaggy, jagged fur tufts run up the forearm and fade toward a smooth, rounded paw, which ends in short curved claws at the knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts up the forearm; colour 0 on the paw base and fur tips; colour 2 on the claws.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Boxing_01.description: A padded, rounded boxing glove for the right hand, with a thumb tucked against the fist, a short cuff around the wrist, a criss-cross lace at the back and a printed band with lettering on the cuff.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Boxing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded glove body and cuff; colour 1 on the laces; colour 3 and colour 2 on the lettered cuff band.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Bracer_Archer_01.description: A right-hand archer's gauntlet: a short, rounded bracer cuff on the forearm with an open skin-toned panel on the inner side, joined to a padded glove with a contrasting knuckle guard and segmented finger plates.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Bracer_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, back of the bracer and glove base; colour 1 on the side panels of the bracer and the finger trim; colour 2 on the knuckle guard and finger pads; the skin-toned inner panel does not take a colour slot.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Bracer_Cosmic_01.description: A tapered forearm bracer with a thick cuff at the elbow end, two raised straps around the middle and a banded cuff at the wrist. A small angular fin and a hexagonal plate sit on the outer back of the arm. Sci-fi superhero style.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Bracer_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell, straps and hexagonal back plate; colour 1 on the wrist band and shell panels; colour 2 on the elbow cuff; colour 3 on part of the wrist band.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cannon_01.description: A large smooth cannon barrel enclosing the right hand: a tapered, faceted cylinder with a flat sloped shoulder near the muzzle, a ringed opening at the top with small slot marks, and a narrow base cap.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cannon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main barrel body; colour 3 on the small slot marks around the muzzle rim; colour 1 on the muzzle interior and the base cap.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cannon_01.differs: The male cannon is a single smooth faceted barrel that is mostly one colour, without the stacked segments, fins and side vents of the female version.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cannon_02.description: A chunky armoured hand cannon built from stacked, faceted segments, with raised fin ridges on the casing, scooped vent cut-outs, a bulky ribbed base and a round muzzle opening on top. Heavy sci-fi gauntlet weapon.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cannon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper casing panels and the ridges; colour 1 on the side blocks, the lower band and the base; colour 2 on the small gaps and the base notches.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cannon_02.differs: The male version is a chunkier, multi-part cannon with raised fins, scooped vents and a two-tone panel split, while the female version is a plain smooth barrel.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cartoon_01.description: A cartoon-style clenched glove for the right hand: a puffy rounded cuff at the wrist, a smooth chunky fist with simple curled fingers, and three short stitched lines on the back of the hand.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cartoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the puffy cuff; colour 1 on the fingertips; colour 3 on the three lines on the back of the hand.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A bulky, clenched right-hand covering shaped like a beast's paw, with wrinkled fur-like texture, an open cuff at the wrist and sharp pointed claws jutting from the knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the paw covering; colour 3 on the claws and the jagged patches at the finger ends.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A bulky, wrinkled monstrous gauntlet covering the right hand and wrist, with a thick rounded cuff, chunky knuckled fingers and sharp curved claws at the fingertips; a beastly, creature-like look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrinkled hide of the hand and cuff; colour 1 on the patches between the knuckles and along the back of the hand; colour 3 on the claws.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Claw_02.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with long curved claws extending from the fingertips. It ends at the wrist, giving a feral superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the claws and the shaded underside of the fingers.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Claw_02.differs: The male version has longer, more curved fingertip claws and no extra spikes along the knuckles.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Colossus_01.description: An oversized, clenched right fist covered in rounded, cobblestone-like rock plates separated by narrow seams, with a few jagged crystal shards jutting from the knuckle side. Sits over the hand as a chunky stone gauntlet.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock plates; colour 3 on the seams between the plates; colour 1 on the jagged shards at the knuckles.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A chunky angular metal gauntlet-fist covering the right hand, with faceted plated knuckles and two long blade-like spikes sweeping back and up from the back of the hand. Suggests a cybernetic claw weapon.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faceted hand casing, though the metal reads dull; colour 2 on the long spikes.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A clenched-fist glove with a chunky, faceted cuff and back-of-hand guard edged in contrasting trim, rounded knuckle studs along the front, and segmented fingers. Suggests a sci-fi western gauntlet.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and hand guard; colour 2 on the edge trim; colour 1 on the knuckle studs; colour 3 on the fingers.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: A tight fingerless-style glove for the right hand with a short cuff, a panel over the back of the hand with slotted vents and pointed knuckle fins, and segmented finger sections. It suggests a techy, cyber look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the finger sections and palm; colour 1 on the main back-of-hand panel; colour 2 on the cuff; colour 3 on the vent slots, knuckle points and cuff fin.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A right-hand cybernetic fist with faceted, segmented knuckles and rounded fingertip caps, topped by a chunky octagonal wrist cuff with vertical slots and contrasting trim. Sits on the hand and wrist in a sci-fi style.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and fingers; colour 2 on the wrist cuff body; colour 1 on the cuff trim and slotted ribs; colour 3 on the fingertip caps.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Defender_01.description: A right-hand gauntlet with a smooth fitted glove and a tall angular flared cuff that rises over the forearm, with swooping slash grooves and pointed knuckle plates over the fist. Superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and inner hand; colour 1 on the forearm cuff and knuckle plates; colour 3 on the slash grooves and seam lines; colour 2 on the palm interior.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Deity_01.description: A close-fitting right-hand glove with a clenched-fist shape, rigid angular plates over the knuckles and fingers, small pointed tips at the fingertips, and a flared cuff with a contrasting inner lining at the wrist.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the glove body and fingers; colour 0 on the knuckle plates, fingertip tips and outer cuff shell; colour 3 on the inner cuff lining.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A right-hand gauntlet with a segmented plated fist and a long angular forearm guard that flares open at the elbow end. Ridged panels are crossed by thin raised bands, giving a rugged armoured look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fist plates and the inner lining of the flared cuff; colour 1 on the forearm panels; colour 2 on the crossing bands and edge trim.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A right gauntlet of segmented plate: a tall angular cuff at the forearm, a banded wrap at the wrist, a fitted fist with articulated fingers, and a long side plate with rivet detailing running along the outer forearm.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm sleeve and the fist; colour 1 on the long outer side plate; colour 2 on the cuff rim; colour 3 on the wrist bands.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A cartoonish dinosaur-suit glove for the right hand: a chunky closed-fist mitt with pointed claw tips on the fingers, three slash marks on the outer side, and a puffy rounded fluffy cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the claw tips; colour 2 on the puffy cuff; colour 3 on the slash marks.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Drill_01.description: A right-hand drill attachment: a long, tapering striped cone that points downward from the wrist, topped by a studded cylindrical cuff with a row of round holes. Suggests a comic-book superhero gadget.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Drill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff and the stripes of the cone; colour 3 on the alternating stripes of the cone; colour 1 on the inner core visible between the cuff and cone.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Foamfinger_01.description: A flat foam-finger novelty prop shaped like a giant hand with the index finger pointing downward, printed with an emblem and finger outlines. It hangs at the right hand and reads as a casual, cute sports-fan accessory.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Foamfinger_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the foam body and thick edge; colour 1 on the printed outline, finger lines and central emblem.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gauntlet_Short_01.description: A short armored fist gauntlet with overlapping segmented plates across the knuckles and back of the hand, exposed fingertip plates, and a rim at the wrist. It suits sci-fi or military armor looks.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gauntlet_Short_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor plates and finger plates; colour 3 on the inner lining and palm panel; colour 2 and colour 1 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gautlet_01.description: A right-hand plate gauntlet with a flared, rivet-studded cuff that reaches partway up the forearm, a clenched fist of overlapping segmented finger plates, and a raised knuckle guard over an exposed inner lining.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gautlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, finger plates and knuckle guard; colour 3 on the inner hand lining and palm; colour 1 and colour 2 are not visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gladiator_Mace_02.description: A hand-held gladiator mace with a large round scarred head covered in conical spikes, attached to a short banded metal collar at the grip. It hangs low at the right hand, suggesting an arena or medieval brawler style.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gladiator_Mace_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spherical head and the collar band; colour 1 on the top cap of the collar; colour 3 on the spikes and scratch marks; colour 2 on the handle core.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gladiator_Sword_02.description: A broad single-edged gladiator sword held in the right hand, with a wide tapering blade, scratched surface and contrasting edge trim, a round pommel-like grip with clawed spiked guard, and a banded cap at the top.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gladiator_Sword_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade face and the grip band; colour 1 on the blade edge trim and the top cap; colour 3 on the spiked claw guard and blade scratches; colour 2 on the round grip ball.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Glove_Clockwork_Armor.description: A tight right-hand glove with an extended forearm gauntlet made of angular panels, a wide banded cuff below the elbow end, a wrist band, and segmented knuckle plates over the fist. Suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Glove_Clockwork_Armor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff bands, knuckle plates and upper rim; colour 1 on the main forearm and hand panels; colour 2 on the inset panels and palm; colour 3 on the small accents at the wrist and rim.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Aquatic_01.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, ending at the wrist. It has a printed scale-like or spotted pattern and separately shaped fingers, with a smooth stretchy fit.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric; colour 1 on the repeating oval scale pattern. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendant_.description: A short, form-fitting superhero glove covering a clenched fist, with a chevron-shaped panel on the back of the hand, piped edges, a contrasting cuff band, and separate segmented finger sections.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back-of-hand chevron panel and upper wrist; colour 1 on the main glove body; colour 3 on the piping and trim lines; colour 2 on the finger segments.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendant_.description: A short, form-fitting superhero glove for the right hand: a snug cuff at the wrist with curved contrasting stripes and a contrasting inset panel, flowing into a smooth close-fitting fist covering the whole hand.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Ascendant_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and fingers; colour 1 on the cuff; colour 3 on the curved stripes and edge piping; colour 2 on the inset panel of the cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.description: A short, close-fitting glove for the right hand, shown as a clenched fist with sculpted finger segments. A separate contrasting cuff sits at the wrist, and the glove ends just past the wrist bone. It suggests a classic superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 2 on the wrist cuff band.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.description: A short, snug tight-fitting glove on a clenched fist, ending just past the wrist, with swooping abstract stripe panels across the back of the hand and knuckles and contrasting openings at the palm and finger gaps.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the swooping stripe panels across the back, side and cuff; colour 2 on the inner palm and finger openings.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.description: A short, snug glove on the right hand that covers the fist and ends at the wrist. Raised web-like line work in a contrasting colour forms a triangular, spiderweb pattern across the back of the hand. Suits a classic superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the raised webbing lines across the back of the hand.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.description: A short, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, ending at the wrist. Thin contrasting linework runs along the outer edge in an angular chevron, giving a clean classic superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Classic_Ti.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 2 on the thin line trim along the outer edge.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjester_.description: A short, fingerless-style fist glove with a patchwork jester look: stitched panels in separate colour blocks across the back of the hand and wrist, with heavy contrasting criss-cross stitching and the finger area left exposed.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjester_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main back-of-hand and cuff panel; colour 1 on the knuckle and finger-side panels; colour 3 on the small patch under the stitching; colour 2 on the stitching.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Madjester_.differs: The male glove is mostly the light slot on the cuff and back of the hand, with heavier, more prominent stitching and the contrasting slot limited to the front and knuckles.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_01.description: A short, close-fitting glove for the right hand that covers the fist and wrist, with a cuff band at the wrist, a large smooth panel over the back of the hand, and segmented finger caps.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the back-of-hand panel and the main glove body; colour 1 on the wrist cuff and the edge trim; colour 0 on the finger caps and palm side.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gloveshort_Reactor_01.differs: The male glove has a contrasting main body over the back of the hand with light finger caps and contrasting edge trim, and no contrasting parts, unlike the female version.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Glow_01.description: A snug, textured fabric glove covering the right hand in a closed fist, with a raised rounded panel on the back of the hand, thin lines running to knuckle pads on each finger, and a small pad on the thumb side.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and knuckle pads; colour 3 on the thin lines; colour 2 on the outlines around the panel and pads.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gunhand_Mechassn_02.description: A bulky mechanical gun-arm that replaces the right hand and forearm: boxy armoured housings, a ribbed segmented barrel section with cable-like braces, and twin barrels ending in ringed muzzles at the wrist.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gunhand_Mechassn_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy armour housings and braces; colour 1 on the ribbed segments, rear block and barrel tips; colour 3 on the small inset panels and stripes; colour 2 on the barrels and joints.
