Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gunhand_Warlord_01.description: A bulky sci-fi gun-arm replacing the right hand: a boxy armored housing at the wrist with a vented side, hazard-striped edge and round emblem, feeding a long barrel with a ribbed rail and a trigger loop.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Gunhand_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armored housing and barrel casing; colour 1 on the top block, ribbed rail, vents and barrel tip; colour 2 on the hazard stripes and small fittings; colour 3 on small details.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A right-hand armored gauntlet with a chunky fist and a long scalloped forearm shell that tapers to a point past the wrist, with a round glowing socket on the outer plate and small contrasting vents. Sci-fi armor look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gauntlet shell and fist; colour 1 on the round socket and the scalloped ridge lines; colour 2 on the small vent openings.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The male version has a smoother, more rounded shell that hugs the forearm more closely.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A sleek armored glove for the right hand: segmented plates cover the back of the hand and articulated fingers, with a large angular shield plate on the outer edge that carries a small octagonal emblem and rivets.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and back-of-hand plates; colour 1 on the outer shield plate; colour 2 on the finger segments and inner trim; colour 3 on the octagonal emblem.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A right-hand gauntlet with a chunky octagonal cuff at the forearm, banded glove and knuckle plate, and two ribbed hoses running along the outer forearm to the wrist, clamped by small straps. Sci-fi power-armor look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and forearm bands; colour 1 on the cuff, strap clamps and knuckle plates; colour 2 on the fingers and inner mechanism; colour 3 on the ribbed hoses.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A right-hand fist glove covered in shaggy, jagged fur tufts over the back of the hand, with a contrasting cuff at the wrist and long pointed claw-like fingertips curling into the palm. A monstrous holiday-creature look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shaggy fur; colour 1 on the wrist cuff and finger edging; colour 0 on the claw fingers and palm plates.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The male glove has longer, sharper claw tips that splay outward, while the female has shorter, blunter finger segments.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Leech_01.description: A right hand replaced by a clenched, fist-shaped organic mass with skin-like faceted surfaces and chunky, blunt tentacle-like fingers bunched along the front and back edges, giving a monstrous, alien look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fist and knuckle mass (skin-toned surface); colour 1 on the tips of the tentacle fingers, fading into the base.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Leech_01.differs: The male tentacles are larger and more numerous, forming a bigger cluster of protruding finger tips around the front and back of the fist.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Light_01.description: A right-hand glove and forearm sleeve in one piece: a fitted fist-shaped glove with a banded cuff, leading into a smooth sleeve that runs up past the elbow with a thin trimmed top edge. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove back, fingers and the sleeve's top opening; colour 1 on the palm and knuckle panels; colour 3 on the sleeve; colour 2 on the cuff and top edge stripes.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Light_02.description: A short, snug superhero glove covering a clenched fist and wrist, with a flat octagonal cuff opening, thin double banded stripes at the cuff edge, a raised back-of-hand panel and separate segmented finger ridges.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Light_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and finger ridges; colour 1 on the back-of-hand and palm panel; colour 2 on the thin stripes at the cuff; colour 3 on the cuff top.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.description: A snug long glove covering the right hand and forearm, ending in a plain straight cuff below the elbow, with the fingers curled into a fist and no visible panels or trim.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.colourAreas: The default material shows a speckled texture that ignores the colour scheme, so no slot is clearly visible on this sheet.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_01_Anniversary.differs: The male glove shows a uniform speckled texture with no separate cuff, forearm panel or contrasting hand section.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_01_Longglove.description: A plain, smooth, tight-fitting long glove covering the right hand in a closed fist and running up the forearm to just below the elbow. It has no visible seams or decoration, giving a simple superhero look.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Alien_Gladiator_.description: A long right-hand gauntlet covering fist and forearm: ridged, rib-textured organic sleeve with a row of stacked segmented plates along the outer edge, each carrying a stud and a pointed spike, plus a knuckle guard with spikes.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Alien_Gladiator_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed sleeve and the fist; colour 1 on the stacked outer plates and knuckle guard; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the round studs and knuckle grille.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Birdpeople_01.description: A long, smooth glove for the right hand with a fisted shape, a thick contrasting cuff at the forearm, and a row of small angular feather-like blades fanning out from the outer edge of the forearm.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the cuff band; the feather blades appear to take a metallic default finish.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_01.description: A long armored gauntlet for the right hand and forearm, with a flared octagonal cuff, a raised panel down the outer forearm, a row of small spikes along the edge, and a chunky fist section with studded knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Blackpaladin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff rim, upper forearm and finger plates; colour 1 on the lower forearm shell and knuckle edging; colour 3 on the inset forearm panel; colour 2 on the fist and back of the hand.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.description: A smooth, long form-fitting glove reaching the forearm, with a ring of upright cylindrical canisters strapped around the upper forearm cuff, held by thin bands. Suggests a sci-fi superhero gadget look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Cannisters_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove; colour 2 on the canister bodies; colour 1 on the canister end caps; colour 3 on the bands between the canisters.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.description: A tight right-hand glove with a long flared gauntlet cuff reaching partway up the forearm, with a V-shaped chevron notch cut into the outer edge of the rim. The hand is a closed fist with defined fingers.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Chevron_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and cuff; the sheet shows no other colour slots on this piece.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_01.description: A smooth, tight-fitting long glove for the right hand, reaching partway up the forearm, with a closed fist and long curved claws extending from the fingertips. Sleek, form-fitting superhero or feral style.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the claws; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_01.differs: The male claws are longer, curved and more prominent than the female version's short thin claw tips.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_02.description: A tight long glove covering the hand and forearm, with a contrasting band near the elbow and a tall pointed blade-like fin flaring up the back of the forearm; small claw tips at the fingers.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and fin edge; colour 2 on the band; colour 3 on the inner face of the back fin; colour 1 on the small fingertip claws.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_03.description: A tight, long right-hand glove with a flared open cuff up the forearm, a row of long curved spines along the outer forearm edge, and pointed claw tips extending from the fingers.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove, the spines and the claws.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_03.differs: The male glove has no separate band at the cuff, which flares open, and its claws take the same colour as the glove.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_04.description: A tight, smooth glove covering the hand and forearm in a clenched fist, with pointed claws tucked in along the fingers and a wide contrasting cuff near the top secured by hex bolts.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove; colour 1 on the claws; colour 2 on the cuff band; colour 3 on the bolts.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_04.differs: The male claws are shorter and curl in against the palm, while the female claws are longer and jut outward past the knuckles.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_01.description: A fingerless wrap glove covering the hand and forearm almost to the elbow, with angled contrasting trim bands and a V-shaped panel; long curved claws extend from the knuckles. Suggests a martial, fantasy look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap body; colour 2 on the trim bands and edging; colour 1 on the claws.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_01.differs: The claws are long and prominent, extending well beyond the fist.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_02.description: A right-hand gauntlet that runs from the fist up the forearm: a snug glove with a row of curved, blade-like fins along the outer edge, a flared cuff, and pointed claw tips over the knuckles. Suggests an ancient mystical look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and forearm sleeve; colour 1 on the curved fins, cuff edging and knuckle guard; colour 3 on the claw tips and knuckles.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_03.description: A right gauntlet of stacked, scalloped armor plates fanning out along the forearm, with a flared cuff and a fitted hand section over the knuckles. Long, sharp claws extend from the fingertips. Fantasy armor styling.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scalloped plates, cuff and hand covering; colour 2 on the inner gaps between plates; colour 0 on the claws.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Claw_Lemurian_03.differs: The male version has long, prominent claws extending from the fingers, while the female version shows only tiny claw tips.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Flare_02.description: A tight, smooth glove covering the right fist and forearm, ending in a flared, angled cuff that opens wider on the outer side. Plain, sleek superhero styling with no visible fasteners.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Flare_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and cuff; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Flared_01.description: A tight, long right-hand glove covering the hand and most of the forearm, with a seam down the centre and a thin band at the wrist. The top edge flares into pointed, V-shaped cuff wings with contrasting trim.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 1 on the flared cuff edge and points; colour 2 on the seam and wrist band.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Flared_01.differs: The male cuff flare is a little taller and wider, with a broader trimmed band around the top edge.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Flared_02.description: A smooth, tight-fitting long glove covering the right hand in a closed fist, with a cuff that flares outward at the forearm and ends in an angular open edge below the elbow.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Flared_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.description: A tight, long superhero glove that runs from the fist up over the forearm to just below the elbow, with stacked banded sections, a flared angular cuff at the top and a row of small metal spikes along the outer edge.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and lower forearm; colour 1 on the knuckle cap, the middle band and the upper cuff; colour 2 on the band around the upper forearm; colour 3 on the cuff inset panel and fingertip accents.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.description: A long, tight superhero glove that runs from the fist up over the forearm to just below the elbow, with a flared cuff at the top, banded colour panels and a separate trim accent at the knuckles and fingertips.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Foxbat_Classic_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm, hand and upper forearm panel; colour 1 on the cuff, mid-forearm band and fingertips; colour 2 on the elbow-side band; colour 3 on the small cuff notch and knuckle trim.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Glove_Folded_01.description: A tight glove covering the right hand and forearm, ending in a thick, rolled-over cuff below the elbow. The fist is closed and the fit is smooth, giving a simple elegant look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Glove_Folded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the folded cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.description: A snug fingerless wrap covering the right forearm and back of the hand, with angular diagonal bands and a V-shaped panel on the front edged in contrasting trim. Leaves the fingers bare; a martial, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wrap fabric; colour 2 on the edging trim and diagonal bands; colour 1 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting right-hand glove with a flared cuff reaching the forearm, topped by a bold jagged lightning-bolt fin rising from the outer edge of the cuff. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and lightning bolt; colour 2 on the thin edge lines along the bolt.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Lightning_01.differs: The male bolt is a larger, bolder lightning shape with a clear zigzag, while the female bolt is a thinner spike with tiny notches.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Punk_01.description: A snug fist-shaped glove with segmented knuckles and a wide, flared, faceted cuff that extends over the wrist, divided from the hand by a thin contrasting band. Superhero-punk look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove hand; colour 1 on the thin band at the wrist; colour 3 on the flared cuff; colour 2 on the thin edge line beside the band.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.description: A long, close-fitting glove covering the fist and forearm, banded in alternating panels, with a row of sharp conical spikes along the outer edge of the forearm and small spikes across the knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cuff band, middle band and fingers; colour 0 on the palm and the lighter forearm bands; colour 3 on the spikes.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Spikes_01.differs: The male version has shorter, smaller spikes along the forearm edge.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Spines_01.description: A tight, smooth long glove covering the right hand and forearm up to below the elbow, with a row of long curved spines sweeping outward along the outer edge of the forearm. Superhero or punk styling.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Spines_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and the spines; the other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Steampunk_04.description: A long, flared gauntlet covering the forearm and fist, with a round dial on the outer side, three short cylindrical coil rods projecting outward, looping flexible pipes, hex bolts and a knuckle-plated fist. Steampunk electrical gadget styling.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Steampunk_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main gauntlet shell and knuckle plates; colour 0 on the looping pipes and the palm and finger section; colour 3 on the coil rods and thin line accents; colour 2 on the dial ring and rod end caps.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.description: A tight, form-fitting long glove covering the right hand and forearm, with a flared cuff below the elbow and a single bat-like membrane wing with pointed spines projecting from the outer edge of the forearm.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove and the wing membrane; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.description: A long, tight-fitting glove that runs from the fist to mid-forearm, with a separate contrasting cuff band at the top. It is stained and torn, with a ragged wound at the knuckles that exposes contrasting finger tips. Suits zombie or horror looks.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Long_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body; colour 1 on the cuff band; colour 3 on the blood stains and wound; colour 2 on the exposed fingertips and grime spots.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Longarmor_02.description: A right-hand armoured gauntlet covering the fist and forearm, built from stacked segmented plates with a wide contrasting cuff at the top and a side band running to a knuckle guard with small studs.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Longarmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented forearm plates and hand; colour 1 on the top cuff, side band and knuckle guard; colour 3 on the knuckle studs.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A snug fingerless glove for the right hand, covering the wrist, palm and back of the hand and stopping at the knuckles so the fingers are bare. Soft cloth with a plain, martial-arts look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the wrist cuff and upper back of the glove; colour 0 on the palm and lower knuckle area, blending into colour 1 as a gradient.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Mechanon.description: A robotic right-hand gauntlet of angular segmented plates over the fist, with a thick wrist cuff, exposed struts at the back and large swept fin-like panels across the back of the hand.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knuckle and finger plates; colour 1 on the large back panels and struts; colour 2 on the wrist cuff and some side plates; colour 3 on small tips near the panels.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Mechanon.differs: The male version has large swept fin-like panels across the back of the hand, where the female has a more closed, tightly packed set of plates.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.description: An alien right-hand gauntlet: a clenched two-fingered fist with long curved claws, a wrapped band at the wrist, and a tall segmented flared cuff with fin-like ridges rising over the forearm.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the flared cuff and forearm plates; colour 3 on the wrist band; colour 0 on the fist; colour 1 on the mottled shading of the fist and the claws.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Med_Qularr_01.differs: The male version has longer, more prominent claws sweeping across the fingers, while the female claws are shorter, smaller points.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Medium_Flared_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with a short flared cuff that ends just above the wrist. Plain, simple construction suited to superhero or casual outfits.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Medium_Flared_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Minigun_01.description: A rotary minigun replacing the right hand: a cluster of long parallel barrels held by stacked ring plates, with bands around the middle and near the muzzle, and short rounded barrel tips at the far end.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Minigun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long barrels; colour 1 on the banded panels of the rings; colour 3 on the ring plates and barrel tips; colour 2 on the barrel ends.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Monster_01.description: A clenched right hand with a faceted, skin-like monstrous surface and long curved claws that sweep out from the knuckles across the back of the fingers. Sits on the hand only, giving a beastly look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; the skin-toned hand surface does not follow the colour scheme.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Monster_01.differs: The male claws are longer and more curved, projecting from the knuckles over the back of the hand, rather than short claws at the fingertips.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_None_01.description: An effectively empty right-hand piece: only a tiny flat disc-like cuff edge appears at the wrist, with no glove, gauntlet or visible hand covering. The bare hand is left uncovered.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tiny wrist edge; no other visible features take a colour.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Paw_01.description: A tight, fur-textured animal paw glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with a short cuff at the wrist, padded pads on the palm side and sharp curved claws protruding from the fingertips.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Paw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the claws; colour 1 on the paw pads and knuckle patches; colour 2 on the cuff and fur streaks; colour 3 on the mottled fur patches.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A short fingerless cloth glove for the right hand, with a soft wrinkled wrist and palm wrap that leaves the fingers bare, topped by a wide turned-back cuff with a contrasting band and triangular notch motifs. Pirate style.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and cuff fabric; colour 2 on the cuff band and its triangular motifs.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.description: A fitted pirate-style glove with a long flared cuff that reaches past the wrist onto the forearm, rimmed with a zigzag-edged band and marked by chevron stripes down the outer forearm.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and cuff; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the zigzag cuff band; colour 1 on the inner lining of the cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Power_Gauntlet_01.description: A chunky armoured right gauntlet covering the forearm and fist, with layered angular plates, a flared open cuff, a large oval gem on the outer side, and small round studs over the knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Power_Gauntlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the recessed inset channels along the forearm; colour 2 on the fingers and palm; colour 3 on the oval gem and knuckle studs.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Prisonguantlet_01.description: A bulky right-hand gauntlet with a large curved back plate, segmented ridged plates over the knuckles and forearm, a banded cuff, and a loop of heavy chain draped down the outer side on round fasteners.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Prisonguantlet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the back plate and cuff band; colour 0 on the segmented ridge plates; colour 2 on the fist cap and plate bases; colour 3 on the chain.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Punk_01.description: A right-hand punk gauntlet: a fitted glove with a ribbed knit cuff, a wide bevelled forearm guard with a raised outer plate, and a row of short curved claw spikes over the knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove and guard base; colour 1 on the ribbed cuff and the knuckle band; colour 3 on the outer plate and the claw tips; colour 2 on the bevelled edging and knuckle pads.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Raptor.description: A clawed, monstrous right-hand covering shaped like a raptor's talon, with a closed fist covered in scaly plates marked with spots, sharp claws on the fingertips and small spikes near the wrist.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Raptor.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand covering and scaly plates; colour 3 on the spots along the knuckles and fingers; colour 1 on the claws and spikes.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Raptor.differs: The male version has claws that point outward at the wrist and back of the hand, plus larger claws at the knuckles, rather than only downward-curving fingertip claws.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A snug right-hand glove reaching mid-forearm, with a tribal patterned band down the forearm and a cuff of hanging pointed tabs edged with a ruffled trim, giving a tribal, handcrafted look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body; colour 3 on the forearm pattern lines and the cuff rim; colour 1 on the hanging cuff tabs and their patterns; colour 2 on the ruffled edge at the top.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Reactor_01.description: An oversized sci-fi gauntlet-cannon for the right hand: a bulky armored housing with jagged blade-like prongs on top, small twin barrels at the side, a central glowing-style strip and curved crescent fins flaring below the fist.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor housing and fin undersides; colour 2 on the upper prongs and rear casing; colour 1 on the crescent fins and the band and clip at the wrist; colour 3 on the central strip and small indicator dots.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A right-hand cybernetic implant covering the forearm and fist with an angular armored shell. Hex-nut bolts with small gem centres and looped ribbed cables sit on the outer side and wrist flare. Sci-fi, industrial look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forearm shell and armor plates; colour 0 on the fist, knuckles and bolt housings; colour 2 on the ribbed cables; colour 3 on the small gem centres.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A heavy cybernetic right-hand implant: a clenched mechanical fist with an angular plated forearm shell, bolted hex nuts and coiled ribbed cables wrapped around the wrist and arm. Suggests a bulky sci-fi prosthetic.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mechanical fist; colour 1 on the forearm plating; colour 2 on the coiled cables; colour 3 on small accents and indicator slits.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Robot_Claw_01.description: A robotic right-hand replacement: a boxy cuffed wrist block leads to two jointed, segmented pincer arms with rounded joints and curved claw tips, giving a mechanical grabber in place of the hand.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Robot_Claw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist block and pincer segments; colour 1 on the wrist cuff plates and claw tip panels; colour 3 on the joint lights and studs; colour 2 on the inner joint mechanisms.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A close-fitting right hand covering in a clenched-fist pose, with a marbled, streaked surface and small jagged, crystalline ridges around the curled fingertips. It ends at the wrist and suggests an alien or elemental look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove surface; colour 1 on the streaks along the wrist and on the fingertip ridges; colour 2 in the mottled streaks.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.description: An alien organic hand-weapon: the fist is wrapped in fleshy, tentacle-like tendrils that curl over the knuckles, with a broad crescent axe blade fused beneath it that carries a single eye-like circular mark.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Axehand_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flesh-like tendrils and hand; colour 1 on the small inset plates and the axe blade; colour 2 on the blade edge and underside; colour 3 on the eye-like mark.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Gun_01.description: An organic, fleshy alien gun-gauntlet covering the right hand and forearm, tapering to a ragged point at the fingertips, with curling tendrils, ridges and folds across its surface. Looks grown rather than built.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Gun_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 3 appear blended across the fleshy body; colour 1 on the veined streaks and ridges. The default skin-like material largely mutes the scheme.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Sword_01.description: A long, narrow, pointed blade held point-down in the right hand, with a fleshy tentacle-like grip that wraps the hand and fingers in curling tendrils. Notched edges and small round holes run along the blade; alien, organic styling.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Roinesh_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the round hole details and blade edges; the tentacle grip keeps its own fleshy tone and does not take a colour slot.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A sci-fi armoured glove and forearm guard: a chunky segmented vambrace with a notched rim and a flared cuff ring, a contrasting back-of-hand plate, and a padded fist with plated knuckles. Suits soldier or tactical looks.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vambrace shell, cuff ring and knuckle plates; colour 1 on the top rim, lower forearm and finger base; colour 2 on the back-of-hand plate and side panel; colour 3 on the small wrist insert.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Shortfolded_01.description: A snug, plain glove covering the right hand in a closed fist, with sculpted individual fingers and a thick folded-over cuff band at the wrist. Casual, everyday look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Shortfolded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glove body and fingers; colour 1 on the folded cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Simian_01.description: A clenched simian-style fist with a skin-toned hand, short pointed claw-like nails, and a ragged tuft of spiky fur that flares up from the wrist and over the back of the hand.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Simian_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiky fur at the wrist and back of the hand; colour 0 on the nails; the hand itself is a skin tone that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_01.description: A skeletal right hand: a smooth covered palm with a flared wrist cuff, and long exposed finger and thumb bones extending straight and splayed, giving a bony, undead look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm and finger bones; colour 3 and colour 1 on the wrist cuff edge and its inner shading.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_01.differs: The male hand has long straight, splayed finger bones, while the female version has curled, clawed fingers.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.description: A skeletal right hand with a bony wrist cuff, knuckle plates, long segmented finger bones and jagged clawed spikes along the fingers. It is curled into a loose grip, giving a monstrous, undead look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff and knuckle bones; colour 1 on the long finger bones; colour 2 on the finger joints and tips; colour 3 on the jagged claw spikes.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Skeleton_Monster_01.differs: The male hand has smaller, sparser claw spikes and more open, clearly separated finger bones.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Sleeve_01.description: A cloth sleeve covering the right hand and wrist, with a contrasting band at the wrist end. It bunches and crumples around the fist, with a ragged edge trim at the knuckles. Casual superhero style.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Sleeve_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sleeve; colour 1 on the band at the wrist end; colour 2 on the ragged trim at the fist end.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Sleeve_01.differs: The male sleeve hugs and bunches around the fist with a crumpled, ragged edge, instead of flaring into a wide open bell cuff.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A right-hand covering of thin, twig-like fingers with long pointed tips, a short cuff at the wrist and one extended finger that hooks outward like a branch. Reads as a frosty, skeletal, monstrous hand.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hand and fingers; colour 1 on streaky patches over the knuckles, cuff and finger sides.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The male version has one long finger hooking outward like a branch, while the other fingers hang looser and straighter.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Space_01.description: A fingerless fist-style glove with a padded cuff, angular segmented knuckle guard and trim edging, and exposed fingertips. Sits on the right hand and wrist, giving a sleek sci-fi combat look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove body and finger bases; colour 1 on the cuff and wrist panel; colour 2 on the trim, knuckle guard and edging; colour 3 on the fingertips.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A right-hand armoured gauntlet with segmented, overlapping plates running up the forearm, cut-out gaps showing the arm, and a fist guard with small round vent holes over the knuckles. A sci-fi take on ancient pharaonic armour.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forearm plates and knuckle guard; colour 2 on the wrist and palm sections; colour 0 on the inner edge highlights; colour 3 on small accent markings.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Steelcommando_01.description: A sleek armoured gauntlet for the right hand: a tapered forearm guard of layered plates with a glossy back panel, a ribbed contrasting band near the elbow end, and a fitted fist with segmented knuckle caps.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates of the forearm and hand; colour 1 on the ribbed band and the fingertip studs; colour 2 on the glossy back panel and inset slots; colour 3 on the knuckle and finger caps.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Superlong_01.description: A tight, smooth extra-long glove covering the right hand and whole forearm, reaching up over the upper arm just below the shoulder. It has a thin contrasting band at the top edge and a glossy finish, suggesting a superhero or sleek formal look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Superlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hand and lower forearm; colour 2 on the upper forearm and upper arm; colour 1 on the top cuff band.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A close-fitting symbiote-style glove covering the right hand in a clenched fist, with a smooth panelled shell and a contrasting back panel; long curved claws extend from the knuckles.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main glove shell and claw casings; colour 1 on the back-of-hand panel and the palm opening inside; colour 2 on the claw tips.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_01.differs: The male claws are longer, sharper and more pronounced, curving outward from the knuckles.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A close-fitting symbiote-style right glove over the fist, with a contrasting cuff and back-of-hand panel, and long tapering claws sweeping from the finger tops past the knuckles. Menacing, monstrous look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the palm, fingers and claw bases; colour 1 on the cuff and back-of-hand panel; colour 2 on the claw tips.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_02.differs: The male version has long, curved claws along the back of the fingers, rather than short knuckle claws.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A bulky angular armored gauntlet with layered plates over the back of the hand, a handle-like frame on top, cylindrical canisters with ribbed caps at the sides, and long curved translucent claws extending past the fingers.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates and frame; colour 1 on the inner panels and claw tips; colour 3 on the canisters and their caps; colour 2 on the recesses and canister bases.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Talon_01.description: A fitted right-hand covering of scaly, segmented plating across the back of the hand and wrist, with banded finger segments ending in long curved contrasting claws. Its monstrous, reptilian look leaves the palm bare.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Talon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scaled plates over the back of the hand and wrist; colour 0 on the finger bands and knuckle segments; colour 2 on the claws; the palm and skin show the mannequin's own skin.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Talon_01.differs: The male claws are longer and fan out prominently from every fingertip, whereas the female claws are shorter and curl inward.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Teddy_01.description: A bulky, shaggy fur-like mitt that swallows the right fist, with a rough, rumpled surface and an open cuff at the wrist; a ridge of fur curls over the front and jagged crystal-like shards jut out at the back.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy mitt body; colour 1 on the jagged shards and the lower shading of the mitt.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Teddy_01.differs: The male version has larger shards jutting out visibly at the back and a raised fur ridge across the front of the fist.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Terror_01.description: A clenched right hand covering with a textured surface crossed by contrasting jagged vein-like markings, and long curved metallic claws sweeping back from the knuckles and wrist. It suggests a monstrous, predatory gauntlet.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Terror_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main hand surface; colour 2 on the jagged vein-like markings; colour 0 on the claws and knuckle plates.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Terror_01.differs: The male version shows the hand surface in a bright colour pattern instead of a skin-like tone, and its claws sweep back toward the wrist.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Thick_01.description: A thick, smooth long glove for the right hand, covering the fist and forearm up to just below the elbow, with a slightly flared open cuff and softly molded fingers; a plain, casual superhero look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Thick_02.description: A thick, smooth glove for the right hand: a clenched fist with sculpted fingers and a wide, slightly flared octagonal cuff that runs up over the forearm to just below the elbow. Plain, sleek superhero styling.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Thick_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glove, including the cuff and fist; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Toy_01.description: A chunky forearm bracer with a textured, cylindrical middle section, a thick angular cap at the elbow end with a small round gem, and two stacked bands around the wrist. Retro robot-toy look.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the elbow cap, wrist bands and lower rim; colour 0 on the textured forearm sleeve; colour 3 on the small round gem; colour 1 on the gem's surround.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Trey_King_01.description: A right-hand saw blade replacing the hand: a wrapped, banded cuff at the wrist leads into a long, curved, thin blade with jagged, spiky teeth along the rear edge, hanging down along the leg.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Trey_King_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrist cuff wraps and the blade's base guard; colour 1 on the blade body and teeth.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Urban_Rings_01.description: A set of chunky metal band rings worn on the fingers of the right fist, with a thick ring on the first finger and smaller bands on the neighbouring fingers. Urban, street-style hand jewellery.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Urban_Rings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring bands; the glossy metal largely ignores the rest of the scheme.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A right forearm gauntlet with a pointed, angular armored cuff that sweeps up past the elbow, a coil of tightly stacked rings around the wrist, and a sleek hand cover over the back of the fist.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm plate and hand cover; colour 1 on the upper cuff shell, the rings and the hand trim; colour 2 on the small vent slits and edge notches.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Vikorin_01.differs: The male version has no claw-like spikes at the knuckles and the wrist rings sit tighter together.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Viperia_01.description: A form-fitting superhero sleeve-and-glove for the right arm, covering the forearm and hand as a fist. It has a contrasting upper cuff, a contrasting band near the wrist and thin trim lines between the panels.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Viperia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forearm sleeve; colour 1 on the glove and the wrist band; colour 2 on the upper cuff and trim edges.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Webbed_01.description: A bare, clenched right hand rendered in skin, with webbing between the fingers and short pointed nails on each fingertip, plus a small fin-like flap at the outer edge of the fist.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Webbed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fingernails; the rest of the hand keeps its skin tone and does not take a colour slot.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Webbed_01.differs: The male hand has contrasting-tipped claw-like nails on the fingers and a small fin flap at the outer edge, instead of thin spikes along the edge.

Male/M_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.description: A wedding ring on a finger of the closed right fist. It is almost entirely hidden by the curled fingers, with only a faint sliver visible under the hand.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.colourAreas: No clearly visible features; the ring is hidden, so no colour slot can be identified.
Male/M_Handr_Tight_Wedding_Ring_01.differs: The male version has no clearly visible ring or pointed stone, while the female version shows a stone hanging below the fist.

Male/M_Handr_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A set of spiky, dragon-like rings worn on the fingers of the clenched right hand, with a plain band ring alongside. The bare hand stays uncovered, giving a festive ornate fantasy look.
Male/M_Handr_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiky dragon-head rings; colour 0 on the plain band rings.
Male/M_Handr_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The male version is only a set of spiky rings on bare fingers, with no glove covering the hand.

Male/M_Handr_Wrapped_Hook_002.description: A heavy prosthetic hook: a faceted metal J-shaped blade with a pointed tip, mounted on a forearm sleeve of crumpled cloth bound with several coiled cords and a curved armour plate on the outer side.
Male/M_Handr_Wrapped_Hook_002.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hook and the curved plate; colour 2 on the crumpled cloth sleeve; colour 3 on the outer and end cord coils; colour 1 on the middle cord coils.
Male/M_Handr_Wrapped_Hook_002.differs: The male version adds a wrapped cloth sleeve with cord bindings and a curved armour plate above the hook, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Head_Anniversary_Defender_01.description: A full-coverage retro superhero helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a raised rim framing two large side panels, a broad angular visor plate over the face, and a pointed collar piece resting on the shoulders.
Male/M_Head_Anniversary_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and the pointed collar; colour 2 on the visor plate, the back shell and the central crest strip; colour 3 on the two large side panels of the crown.

Male/M_Head_Anubis_01.description: A full jackal head covering the whole head, with a long tapered snout, narrowed glowing eyes, tall upright pointed ears and a smooth neck-hugging base. Egyptian-style animal-headed look.
Male/M_Head_Anubis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 covers nearly the whole head, snout and ears; the eyes show a small tint of other colours. The default material appears to mostly ignore the other colour slots.
Male/M_Head_Anubis_01.differs: The male version is a single-tone head with no brow diamond or side panels, and it has open, narrowed eyes.

Male/M_Head_Anubis_02.description: A full jackal-headed mask in the Anubis style: a long tapering snout, two tall pointed upright ears, sculpted brow ridges and narrow glowing eyes, with a smooth rounded skull cap and a thin band at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Anubis_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, snout and ears; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the thin neck band.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Bat_01.description: A furry animal head with a tapered muzzle, small contrasting nose and tall pointed ears with lined inner surfaces. A ragged ruff of fur tufts hangs around the neck and jaw. Beastly and cute in style.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head fur and outer ears; colour 0 on the muzzle and inner ear lining; colour 1 on the neck fur tufts and the inner ear base; colour 2 on the nose and eyes.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Bat_01.differs: The male ears are the same colour as the head fur on their outer backs, rather than a separate fleshy tone.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Bear_02.description: A full bear head with a short blunt muzzle, a contrasting nose, small rounded ears and a swept mane of spiky fur that covers the crown, sides and back of the head. Suits a beast or animal-themed hero.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Bear_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiky fur mane and ear rims; colour 3 on the fur around the eyes and cheeks; colour 1 on the muzzle and chin; colour 2 on the nose and eyes.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Bull_01.description: A full bull head replacing the human head: elongated snout with a large nose ring, small side ears with studs, a shaggy mop of hair over the brow and crown, and two long upswept curved horns.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy hair and the nose ring; colour 1 on the horns; colour 3 on the face, ears and neck band; colour 2 on the muzzle tip.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Cat_01.description: A full anthropomorphic cat head with large pointed ears, a furry face with a contrasting muzzle and expressive eyes, and a shaggy ruff of spiky fur that fans out around the neck and shoulders.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head, ears and neck ruff; colour 2 on the muzzle and face mask; colour 3 on the nose; colour 1 on the eyes.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Cat_01.differs: The male version has a shorter fur ruff that ends at the neck, without the long mane down the back.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Cat_03.description: A full lion head replacing the wearer's own: a sculpted feline face with a short muzzle, small rounded ears and a heavy flowing mane that frames the face and falls down the back of the neck to the shoulders.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Cat_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the face skin and inner ears; colour 0 on the mane and chin fur; colour 1 as streaks and tint through the mane and around the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.description: A full dragon head replacing the wearer's own: scaled snout with open toothed jaws and a long tongue, branching antler-like horns, a fan of feathery frills around the head, whisker-like tendrils, and a scaled back panel over the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Celestial_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled head, frills and jaw; colour 1 on the horns, tongue, inner mouth and frill tips; colour 3 on the whisker tendrils and the scale outlines at the back.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bat_Mouth_01.description: Two small clusters of sharp, pointed fang-like spikes that sit at either side of the jaw and lower cheeks, angled downward. Suggests bat-like monstrous tusks or teeth as an add-on to the head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bat_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fang spikes; the shading varies across the facets but no other colour slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bat_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed bat-like ears rising from the top of the head and flaring outward. Each has a smooth outer shell and a hollow inner cup with a gradient shading, giving a creature or beast look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bat_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and rim of the ears; colour 0 fading into colour 1 on the inner ear cups.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Mouth_03.description: A beast-mouth head piece: a chunky, angular U-shaped muzzle that wraps around the lips and chin, with thick upper and lower lip rims and prominent curved fangs showing inside. Suggests a bear or monster face.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Mouth_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main lip and chin surfaces; colour 0 on the upper rim edges and fangs.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Mouth_03.differs: The male mouth shows larger, more prominent curved fangs, with the lips open wider around them.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Top_02.description: A pair of small rounded animal ears set high on either side of the head, each a cupped shell with a tufted inner lining. The outer backs are smooth, giving a cute bear-like look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Top_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rim of each ear; colour 1 on the tufted inner fur lining.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Top_03.description: A pair of small rounded bear ears with textured, furry surfaces, perched on the upper sides of the head. Each ear has a hollow inner cup, giving a cute animal look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Bear_Top_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear cups.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_03.description: A shaggy, shoulder-length lion-style mane of layered hair strands that frames the face and merges into a full beard hanging down over the chest, with a swept-back crown and a thick, bushy back.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the mane and beard; colour 1 on the streaks and strands running through the hair; colour 3 on a faint patch at the crown.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Ear_01.description: A pair of large pointed cat ears set high on the sides of the head, with smooth outer backs and spiky tufted fur lining the hollow inner faces; a playful animal look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces and the inner fur tufts; colour 2 in the shadowed inner hollows.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Mouth_01.description: A pair of small pointed fangs that stick up from the lower chin on either side of centre, giving a feline or beastly look. The tiny cones sit below the lip and nothing else on the face changes.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both fangs; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cat_Mouth_01.differs: The fangs sit lower on the chin, clearly below the lip, whereas the female fangs rest on the lower lip.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Chimera_01.description: A tall, swept-back mohawk of long layered strands rising in a crest from forehead to nape, with spiky pointed tips along the ridge and a bare shaved scalp at the sides. It trails down the back of the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 on the spiked tips along the crest; colour 2 on the shaded underside near the front edge.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cobra_Mouth_01.description: A pair of curved cobra fangs at the mouth: two long, flat curved tusk-like blades hang down past the lips on either side, each with a small sharp tooth beside it. A monstrous snake-like look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cobra_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fangs and small teeth; colour 1 shows as a slight tint on the inner faces of the large fangs.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cobra_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, swept-up spiky horn-like fins rising from each side of the head, with smaller secondary spikes beside them and curved clawlike blades hooking down over the brow and temples. Monstrous cobra-inspired look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Cobra_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tips of the tall spikes and on the curved brow blades; the lower spike bodies show the skin tone rather than a scheme colour.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Corgi_Ear_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears sitting on top of the head, each with a hollow inner face and tufts of spiky fur fanning out at the base. Cute, beast-like headpiece with a furry look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Corgi_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces and fur tufts; colour 1 on the inner ear faces.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Corgi_Mouth_01.description: A set of small pointed animal teeth arranged in a U around the mouth and chin, with a row of tiny lower teeth and two larger tusk-like fangs jutting down at the sides of the jaw.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Corgi_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small teeth; colour 1 on the two large tusk fangs.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Hair_01.description: Swept-back, spiky hair with a tall crest on top and jagged locks that fall long down one side to about chin length, with two small horn-like tufts at the front. The sides and back of the head stay bare.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and upper hair; colour 1 on the lower tips and the longer side locks; colour 2 on a few shadowed strands at the ends.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Mouth_01.description: A U-shaped row of small pointed conical teeth that wraps around the mouth and lower jaw, with longer fangs curving up at the corners. It gives a feral, predatory beast look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the shaded undersides pick up a hint of colour 1 in places.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears set high on either side of the head, with an outer shell, a tufted inner lining and slightly jagged edges. They give a coyote or fox-like beastly look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Coyote_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rim fur; colour 1 on the inner ear lining.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Ear_01.description: A pair of fin-like ear frills sweeping out and back from the sides of the head, each a webbed membrane with cut-out slots and a rim of clawlike pointed spines along the lower edge. Suggests a dinosaur or beast head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and spines; colour 1 on the membrane; colour 2 on the slot cut-outs and inner shading; colour 3 on small speckles in the membrane.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Mouth_0.description: A set of two curved rows of conical teeth on square bases, forming an upper and lower jaw that sweeps out from the mouth and around the chin. Suggests a monstrous dinosaur or beast maw.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Mouth_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth; the square bases show a light metallic finish that appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Side_01.description: A pair of side-of-head cheek frills: clusters of pointed, fin-like spikes fanning backward from each side of the jaw and cheek, like a dinosaur's head crests. Faceted and angular, they leave the face and skull otherwise bare.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the spikes and frills; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Top_01.description: A narrow fin-like crest running front to back along the centre of the head, like a mohawk. It has swept-back jagged spikes, a raised rim and cut-out teardrop openings over an inset panel. Suits a beast or dinosaur look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Dinosaur_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and spikes; colour 1 on the inset panel between the openings; colour 3 on small flecks within the panel.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Ear_Bull_01.description: A set of small metal hoop rings floating beside the head at ear level: a pair of thin bands clustered on one side and a single ring on the other. They read as bull-style ear piercings.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Ear_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring bands; the glossy metal finish largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Fennec_Mouth_01.description: A curved row of sharp conical fang-like teeth arranged in an arc along the jaw and chin, with larger fangs at the corners. It gives a beastly, monstrous grin to the lower face.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Fennec_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Fishmonster_Mout.description: A ring of sharp triangular fangs that wraps across the mouth and cheeks, with upper and lower rows of pointed teeth in a monstrous fish-like grin. Sits over the lips and reads as a beastly face piece.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Fishmonster_Mout.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Goat_Top_01.description: A pair of long, pointed goat ears that stick out sideways from the top of the head and taper to tips, each with a recessed inner ear. It suits beast, monster or fantasy characters.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Goat_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear surfaces; colour 2 on the inner ear lining.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Hair_Bull_01.description: A short, chin-length hairstyle of tousled, sculpted locks swept across the forehead to one side, with pointed tips flicking out near the cheeks and a rounded, full crown that covers the back of the head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Hair_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head of hair; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Horns_Bull_01.description: A pair of large curved bull horns that sweep outward from the temples and turn upward to sharp tips, with ridged bands along the base. They float on the sides of the head like a headband-free horn set.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Horns_Bull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged base and lower horn surfaces; colour 1 on the upper horn tips as a gradient.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Kangaroo_Top_01.description: A pair of long, floppy kangaroo ears sprouting from the top of the head and drooping sideways and slightly back, each a tapered rounded lobe with a hollow inner face. Cute, animal-style head piece.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Kangaroo_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer surfaces of both ears; colour 1 and colour 0 on the small inner ear linings.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Kangaroo_Top_02.description: A pair of tall, upright pointed animal ears rising from the top of the head, with a smooth outer shell and a shallow inner hollow. They suggest a kangaroo or rabbit beast-head costume.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Kangaroo_Top_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and rim of the ears; colour 0 on the inner face of the ears; colour 1 on the tips of the inner face.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Kitty_01.description: A short, swept hairstyle of layered, pointed locks that sit on top of the head and sweep across the forehead to one side, with small cat-ear-like tufts at the crown and spiky tips at the back.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hair mass; colour 1 in the shaded underside and tips.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Kitty_02.description: A short, spiky swept hairstyle sitting on top of the head: layered sharp tufts sweep forward and to the side over the brow, with pointed tips flicking outward and the sides and back of the head left bare.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Kitty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair tufts; colour 2 on the underside of the fringe and the inner layers.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Lizard_Hair_01.description: A swept asymmetric hair piece: a thick side-swept fringe sits over one side of the crown and falls into long tapering locks that hang past the neck, with a small tied knot at the top. Suggests a stylised punk or fantasy look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Lizard_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main swept fringe and upper hair; colour 3 on the inner strands; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 2 on the knot at the top.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Ear_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears rising upright from the top of the head, with a textured fur-like outer surface, a raised rim and a smooth hollow inner face. Cute, playful beast style.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur and rim of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear hollows.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Hair_01.description: A short, choppy spiky hair piece of layered jagged locks with a fringe over the forehead and tapered pointed tips around the ears and nape; a few tufts stick up on top. Beast-child styling.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top layer of tufts and fringe; colour 2 on the middle layer at the sides and back; colour 0 on the lower tips and fringe ends.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Mouth_01.description: A small curved lower-jaw piece with a row of rounded, scalloped teeth-like bumps and pointed tips at each end, sitting under the lips along the chin as part of an animal mouth.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gum band and tooth edges; colour 1 on the rounded tooth shapes and end tips; colour 2 in the shadowed hollows between teeth.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Side_01.description: A single curved, tapering tongue-like protrusion hanging from the mouth down over the chin and throat, with a rounded tip and smooth low-poly surface; a playful llama-style beast feature.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Llama_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and front surface of the tongue; colour 1 on the lower tip and underside; colour 2 on the inner edge seen from the side.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mecha_Horse_Hair.description: A mecha-style mane made of five separate blocky rectangular segments spaced in a line along the centre of the head, from forehead over the crown to the nape, like a mohawk of mechanical tiles.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mecha_Horse_Hair.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all of the block segments; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mecha_Horse_Mout.description: A curved, U-shaped mechanical jaw guard that wraps under the chin and along the jawline, ending in round bolt-like discs at each side of the face. Suggests a robotic horse mouth piece.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mecha_Horse_Mout.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer jaw band; colour 0 on the inner lining; colour 1 on the round discs at each end.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mecha_Horse_Side.description: A pair of flat hexagonal plates mounted on either side of the head over the ears, like mechanical cheek or ear guards, each with a round central bolt, a lower band and small rivets.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mecha_Horse_Side.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plate rims and upper edges; colour 1 on the outer face panels and lower band; colour 0 on the inner faces and bolt; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mecha_Horse_Top_.description: A pair of tall, pointed ear-like blades rising from the top of the head, flat-sided and tapering to sharp tips, angled slightly outward. They suggest a robotic horse or beast look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mecha_Horse_Top_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer faces of the blades; colour 2 on the inner faces and edges; colour 0 on the inner panels seen from behind.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_01.description: A pair of long, slender moth-like antennae rising from the top of the head, curving outward and upward in a sweeping horn shape with a feathery, striated texture and a contrasting edge line.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper lengths of the antennae; colour 1 on the base and lower gradient of each antenna; colour 2 on the thin edge outline.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_02.description: A pair of smooth, faceted oval shells fixed over the brow and upper eye area, tilted outward like moth-like compound eyes or eye-masks. They sit on the face and leave the rest of the head bare.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the eye shells, fading toward colour 0 along their inner edges.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_03.description: A moth-like fluffy mane of layered, feathery tufts that frames the face and drapes over the head, neck and shoulders, ending in a jagged point at the upper back. Suggests a monstrous, insect-like creature.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_01_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and top tufts, fading into colour 1 on the lower tufts around the neck and shoulders.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_01.description: A pair of long, slender moth-like antennae sweeping up and outward in a V from the brow, tapering to fine points with feathery vanes and a contrasting central spine; they rise well above the head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathery outer vanes; colour 1 on the inner vane edges; colour 2 on the central spine; colour 3 on the small tips at the base.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_01.differs: The male antennae sweep back in a smoother, more pronounced curve from the brow when seen from the side.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_02.description: A pair of smooth, angular faceted plates set on either side of the face beside the eyes and cheeks, like moth-like wing or ear panels. They stand slightly off the head and leave the face uncovered.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on both side plates; the plates shade darker toward their lower edges.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_03.description: Swept-back, feathery moth-like hair with a smooth crest over the scalp and a contrasting plate at the forehead. Long layered feathery tufts fall past the shoulders to upper-back length, ending in jagged points, with small claw-like tips at the sides.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Moth_02_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, forehead plate and small side tips; colour 1 on the lower feathery tufts, blending in from the top; colour 2 on the shaded underside layers at the shoulders.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Mouth_01.description: A pair of large rodent-like buck teeth: two flat, tapered, chisel-shaped incisors side by side, hanging at the chin below the mouth. Suggests a cartoonish mouse or beast character head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tooth faces; colour 1 on the shaded outer edges and backs of the teeth.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Side_01.description: A set of thin, straight mouse whiskers that fan out sideways from either side of the upper lip, three or four strands per side, angled slightly downward. A small animal-face accessory that leaves the head bare.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the whisker strands; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, upright rounded-oval mouse ears rising from the top sides of the head, with smooth outer shells and deeply cupped inner faces edged by a thin rim.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shells and rims; colour 1 fading to colour 0 on the inner cup of each ear.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Mouse_Top_01.differs: The male ears show the outer shell and rim in a strong solid colour 3 finish rather than the female's skin-like tone.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Pitbull_Mouth_01.description: A set of separate conical fangs arranged in an open ring around the mouth and chin, upper and lower rows pointing inward like a beast's jaw; no base or gum, just floating spikes.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Pitbull_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the fangs; the other colour slots are not visibly used.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Pitbull_Side_01.description: A lolling beast tongue: a broad, flat, tapered tongue that juts out from the mouth and curls down past the chin toward the chest, with a rounded tip and subtle surface creases. Suits a monstrous dog-like head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Pitbull_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base of the tongue; colour 1 toward the tip and lower end; colour 2 on the shaded underside edge.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Pitbull_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that stand upright on top of the head, each a curved cupped shape with a hollow inner face and a smooth rounded outer shell, suggesting a pitbull or beast look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Pitbull_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells of both ears; colour 3 on the inner hollow of each ear, fading toward darker shading at the base.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Plantmonster_Mou.description: A ring of sharp conical teeth wrapping around the head: an upper row of downward-pointing fangs across the brow and a lower row of upward-pointing teeth across the jaw, forming a monstrous open maw around the face.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Plantmonster_Mou.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth; the teeth show no other colour slots on this sheet.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Raccoon_Top_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that sit high on the sides of the head and tilt outward. Each has a smooth rounded back, a hollow inner cup and a thin rim, for a cute beast look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Raccoon_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells of the ears; colour 1 on the back tint and the small base near the head; colour 3 on the inner cups; colour 2 on the inner shading and rim edge.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Reptillian_Mouth.description: Two small clusters of curved tusk-like fangs jutting upward from either side of the lower lip and chin, each with a tall pointed tusk beside a shorter blunt tooth. Monstrous reptilian mouth accessory.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Reptillian_Mouth.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tusks and teeth; the default material appears to ignore the other colour slots.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Ring_Bull_01.description: A thick open metal hoop, like a bull nose ring, hanging in front of the face and resting near the throat, with a gap at the top and a faceted, slightly chunky band.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Mouth.description: A wide, exaggerated row of small pyramid-shaped teeth that curves in a U-shape around the mouth and jaw and sweeps back along the cheeks toward the ears, giving a monstrous, salamander-like grin.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Mouth.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Mouth.differs: The male version ends each side in a small flat plate at the ear, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Side_.description: A pair of swept-back head fins or frills, one on each side of the head above the ears. Each is a cluster of long, thin, curved spines that taper to points, giving a beastly, salamander-like look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Side_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spines, with the tips fading toward colour 0.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Top_0.description: A pair of feathery, fin-like antennae that sweep up and outward from the top of the head, each with a ridged, layered vane, a bordering edge and a small lower flap. Suggests a sea creature or monstrous look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Salamander_Top_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged feather vanes; colour 3 on the outer edge ribs; colour 1 on the small lower flaps.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Helmet_.description: A narrow crest of jagged spikes running front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk, with tall spikes at the crown and smaller ones trailing down the nape. The rest of the head stays bare.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Helmet_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the spikes and the ridge; colour 1 on the spike tips as a gradient.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Side_01.description: A pair of fin-like side-head ornaments: each is a fan of layered, pointed, leaf-shaped fronds that sweep outward from the temple above the ears, suggesting seahorse or aquatic frills.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on some fronds in each fan; colour 1 on other fronds; colour 2 on the darker fronds.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Top_01.description: A pair of leaf-like feathered fronds that rise from two points on top of the head and fan outward in a V. Each has slender branching blades with spotted markings, giving a fantasy sea-creature look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Seahorse_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frond blades; colour 2 on the spots; colour 1 on the base stems where the fronds meet the head; colour 3 on a small accent near each base.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned_M.description: A wide, grinning row of thin, sharp fang-like teeth that curves around the mouth and stretches back along the cheeks toward the ears, like an oversized monstrous maw drawn over the lower face.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned_S.description: A set of three curved, tapering horn spikes in graduated sizes that jut downward from the lower lip and chin on each side, like small tusks or fangs. Suggests a serpent-like beast or monster face.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn spikes, with slight shading towards the tips; no other slots are visible.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned_S.differs: The male version has longer, narrower spikes, with the small ones sitting closer to the large central spike.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned_T.description: A set of small curved horn spikes on the head: two short pairs angled back above the temples and one single horn at the nose bridge. Bare skin shows between them, so this is a minimal monstrous accent.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned_T.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the horns; the other slots are not visible.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Serpent_Horned_T.differs: The male nose horn is longer and more prominent, and the horns default to a contrasting colour instead of a light one.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Mouth_01.description: A set of pointed monster teeth forming a U-shaped row of small pyramid fangs that wraps around the mouth and jawline, like an open toothy maw. Reads as a monstrous or beastly face piece.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the teeth; colour 1 on the shaded faces of some teeth.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Top_01.description: A pair of long, tapering monster horns rising from the top of the head and sweeping backward in a smooth curve, with hollow, lightly ribbed undersides and blunt cut bases sitting on the crown.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer surfaces of both horns; colour 0 on the hollow inner undersides; colour 1 on a small strip along the inner edge.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Set_Top_01.differs: The male horns are thicker and blunter at the front, and sit lower and more angled outward on the head.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Shisa_Mouth_01.description: Two pairs of small fang-like tusks flanking the mouth: a broad tapered tusk on each side of the lower lip, each with a smaller pointed cone tooth beside it. Suggests a beastly, guardian-lion look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Shisa_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large tusks; colour 0 on the small cone teeth.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Shisa_Mouth_01.differs: The male tusks take the mid contrasting colour (colour 1) by default, whereas the female tusks are near black (colour 2).

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Snake_Hair_01.description: A short mohawk split into two parallel ridges of sharp, jagged spikes running front to back along the crown, sweeping backward, with the sides of the head left bare. Beastly, punk-like styling.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Snake_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front spikes; colour 0 on the spike roots at the hairline; colour 2 on the middle of the ridges; colour 3 on the rear spikes.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Hair_02.description: A short, tall-crested mohawk-style hairpiece of sleek, layered strands sweeping up from the forehead into three sharp points, with one longer central tip and smaller flanking spikes, leaving the sides of the head bare.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Hair_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 on the longest central tip; colour 2 on the tip of the outer spike; colour 3 on the small inner spike tip.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Helmet_02.description: A tuft of furry, wolf-like mane hanging from the chin and jaw down over the upper chest, with a wedge shape and jagged, streaky-textured tips. A small contrasting patch sits under the chin. Suits beastly, feral looks.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Helmet_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur of the mane; colour 3 on the patch under the chin and at the nape.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Mouth_02.description: A set of small pointed beast teeth arranged in a U-shaped row along the jawline and chin, with larger fangs at the sides and smaller ones toward the front. Reads as a feral wolf-like mouth accessory.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Mouth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Top_02.description: A pair of pointed animal ears that sit high on the sides of the head, tapering upward and slightly outward, with hollow inner cups facing forward. Suggests a wolf or beast look, worn as a small head accessory.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Child_Suave_Top_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear cups.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Cobra_01.description: A full cobra head replacing the wearer's own: a scaled snake face with brow ridges and small fangs, framed by a broad flared hood that curls outward around it, with tall spines at the top corners.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Cobra_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the scaled face, crown and spines; colour 3 on the hood rim and outer edges; colour 0 on the smooth inner hood panel with faint line details.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Cobra_01.differs: The male hood is wider and rounder with fuller lobes, and the spines are longer and stand more upright.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Corgi_01.description: A full anthropomorphic corgi-like animal head with a glossy snout, open toothy mouth, upright pointed ears and shaggy fur tufts around the cheeks, neck and back, covering the whole head and upper neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Corgi_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ears, the fur at the back of the head and the cheek tufts; colour 1 on the shaggy fur along the sides and neck; colour 2 on the glossy face and snout; colour 3 on the tongue and inner mouth patch.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Coyote_01.description: A full coyote head with a long muzzle, large pointed ears and a swept-back mane of layered fur locks, plus a ragged spiky ruff of fur around the jaw and neck. Covers the whole head in an animal-beast style.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Coyote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face, mane locks and ear outsides; colour 1 on the inner ears, ruff and mane ends; colour 2 on the nose.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Coyote_01.differs: The male head is mostly colour 0 all over, with only the nose in colour 2, rather than a contrasting face and split back of the head.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Croc_01.description: A full crocodile head replacing the human head: a long tapering snout with an open, toothy jaw, a contrasting mouth interior, small side-set eyes and a plated, scaly skull and neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Croc_01.colourAreas: The skin-toned scaly hide does not appear to follow the colour scheme; the mouth interior and teeth keep their own tones. No clear slot assignments are visible.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Dinosaur_01.description: A full reptilian dinosaur head with a long toothy snout, scaly skin and a tall central crest. Frilled, feather-like fins sweep out from each side and back of the skull, giving a monstrous, raptor-like look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Dinosaur_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly head and snout; colour 0 on the crest spine and fin edges and tips; colour 1 on the inner fin panels; colour 2 on the fin markings.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Doberman_01.description: A full-head doberman mask with a long tapered muzzle, a rounded nose, sculpted eyes and tall pointed upright ears. It covers the whole head and continues down over the neck, giving a sleek, animal look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Doberman_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head and neck skin; colour 1 on the inner ears and the underside of the muzzle and jaw; colour 2 on the nose.
