Male/M_Head_Beast_Dog_01.description: A full husky-style dog head covering the whole head, with tall pointed ears, a tapered muzzle with a glossy nose, and shaggy layered fur that falls in tufts over the neck and nape.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner ears; colour 3 on the fur of the head, ears and neck ruff; colour 1 on the muzzle and around the eyes; colour 2 on the nose.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Dragon_01.description: A full dragon head replacing the wearer's own: a long toothy snout, swept-back brow plates over the eyes, a smooth domed skull with a tall central horn and small side spikes, and a finned crest trailing down the back of the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout and jaw; colour 3 on the skull, horn and spikes; colour 2 on the brow plates; colour 1 on the crest fin and the neck patch.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Fennec_01.description: A full fennec fox head covering with a short muzzle, large upright pointed ears with inner fluffy fur, tufted cheek fur and a swept crest of spiky fur along the top; fully replaces the head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer fur, ear rims and back of the head; colour 0 on the face, inner ear fur and crest; colour 1 on the muzzle tip, inner ear shading and crest tips; colour 2 on the nose and eyes.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Feral_01.description: A full replacement head shaped like a feral wolf or fox: long tapering snout, tall pointed ears, an open toothy mouth with fangs, and a shaggy mane of jagged fur tufts flowing down the back of the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Feral_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout top, ears and fur mane; colour 1 on the face sides, cheeks and lower jaw; colour 3 on the mouth interior and gums.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Ferret_01.description: A full ferret head replacing the human head: a tapered snout with a rounded nose, fine whiskers, small round ears, and shaggy layered fur tufts over the skull and neck, ending in a ruffled ruff at the throat.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Ferret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur and head; colour 1 on the inner ears and the ruffled neck fringe; colour 3 on the nose; colour 2 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Fishmonster_01.description: A full monster head with scaly, textured skin, heavy angled brows, wide-set eyes, a broad toothy grin and a jutting lower jaw. It covers the whole head down to the neck, with a fish-like, reptilian look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Fishmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaly head and neck skin; colour 1 on the lower jaw, chin and the patches around the eyes; colour 2 on the brow ridges; colour 0 on the teeth and eyes.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Gator_01.description: A full alligator head replacing the wearer's own: a long toothy snout with an open jaw, ridged scaly skin across the skull, small side-set eyes and a thick neck. Monstrous, reptilian look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Gator_01.colourAreas: The default skin-like material largely ignores the colour scheme; the scaly skin, teeth and mouth interior keep their own fixed shading, so no clear colour slot is visible.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Gator_01.differs: The male head has a thicker neck and a broader, heavier skull, with the jaw opened a little less.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Goat_01.description: A full animal head covering with a shorter muzzle, wide-set eyes and broad ears that sweep out sideways and taper to points. It covers the whole head and neck, with a smooth, skin-like finish and a beastly look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head, ears and neck; colour 1 on the patches around the eyes; colour 0 on the muzzle and inner ear edges; colour 2 on the nose.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Goat_01.differs: The male head has a shorter, blunter muzzle and a thicker neck.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Horse_Child_02.description: A wild horse-style mane: spiky, swept-back tufts crown the top of the head, with a long tapering mane strip running down the centre of the back of the neck and the sides left bare.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Horse_Child_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the spiky tufts on top and at the front; colour 0 on the long central mane strip, fading towards colour 1 at its tip; colour 2 shades the roots of the tufts.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Hyena_01.description: A full hyena head with a furry canine muzzle, large rounded ears, a contrasting nose and whiskers, and a swept-back shaggy mane of spiky tufts that trails down the nape in a long tapering strip.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Hyena_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the face fur and inner ears; colour 1 on the chin and lower muzzle shading and the tip of the mane; colour 0 on the mane strip and inner ear fur; colour 2 on the nose and the fringe tufts.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Hyena_Child_01.description: A hyena-style mane: a central mohawk-like strip of long, pointed spiky locks swept back from the forehead, with a longer tapering tail of hair running down the nape and back, and shaved sides.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Hyena_Child_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central strip and the upper part of the trailing mane; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the trailing mane; colour 3 on the spiky side locks; colour 2 on the darker roots at the crown.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Hyena_Child_Whiskers_0.description: A set of thin, fine whiskers fanning out from both sides of the muzzle area beside the nose and upper lip, like a cat or hyena's; delicate strands with no other head covering.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Hyena_Child_Whiskers_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whisker strands; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Kaiju_01.description: A full-head dragon-like monster helm with a ridged, scaled snout plate, two long swept-back horns, jagged swept mane spikes, curved side tusks and a pointed armoured collar that covers the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the snout plates, back stripe and neck collar; colour 2 on the horns and spiky crest; colour 0 on the tusks; colour 1 on the recessed face and eye area.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Kaiju_02.description: A full monstrous kaiju head covering: a broad crested skull-like helm with swept side flares, a pair of short upward horns, small fangs at the brow, and a segmented collar with a pointed front panel. A long curved horn juts from the jaw.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Kaiju_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the crested helm and front collar panel; colour 0 on the jaw, neck collar and lower face plates; colour 2 on the horns and jaw horn; colour 1 on the small fangs.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Kangaroo_01.description: A full animal head with a long tapered muzzle, contrasting nose, and large pointed ears that sweep outward and back. Fluffy tufts frame the cheeks, and the head covers the whole head down to the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head shell, muzzle top and outer ears; colour 0 on the cheek tufts, underjaw and inner ears; colour 1 on the eye markings and inner ear shading; colour 2 on the nose.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Kitty_01.description: A full anthropomorphic cat head with furry skin, tall pointed ears with pink inner lining, a swept tuft of hair on top, long whiskers, and tufted cheek fur with striped facial markings.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head fur and outer ears; colour 1 on the muzzle, nose area and stripe markings; colour 0 on the hair tuft and whiskers; colour 2 on the nose and eye details.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Kitty_02.description: A full cat-head replacement with a furry feline face, pointed ears, whiskers, striped facial markings and short tufted neck fur; a soft floppy beret-style cap with a band and a hair fringe sits on top.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Kitty_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fur of the face, ears and neck; colour 1 on the stripes and muzzle markings; colour 0 on the cap, hair tufts and whiskers; colour 2 on the cap band.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Lizard_01.description: A full lizard head with a long tapered snout, scaly texture, visible pointed teeth, side-set eyes and angular patches across the crown and cheeks; a swept mane of hair falls down one side.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled top of the head and the mane; colour 1 on the angular scale patches and mane tips; colour 3 on the strands within the mane; the snout and underjaw show a skin tone not set by the scheme.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Lizard_01.differs: The male head has a longer, heavier snout with more prominent teeth and a mane that sweeps further back.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Lizard_02.description: A full lizard head with a long tapered snout, scaled skin, small pointed teeth and side-set eyes. A swept hair-like crest is gathered toward the back and hangs down behind the head, with angular patches across the crown and cheeks.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Lizard_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled top of the head and the crest strands; colour 1 on the angular patches over the crown, cheeks and neck; colour 3 on the darker crest strands; the snout and lower face keep a skin tone that ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Lizard_02.differs: The crest on the male head is gathered toward the back and hangs behind the head, rather than falling across the front and side of the face as on the female.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Llama_01.description: A full llama head with an elongated furry muzzle, tall upright ears, shaggy layered fringe and tufted crest, a small nose and a tongue hanging from the mouth; it covers the whole head and neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the cheeks, fringe and ears; colour 1 on the face, forehead tuft, neck and tongue; colour 2 on the tufts behind the fringe; colour 3 on the nose.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Mantis_01.description: A full head covering shaped like a mantis skull: a smooth bony front plate with large domed bulging eyes, a row of sharp fang-like teeth along the jaw, and a soft cloth hood-like back that drapes down the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Mantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony front plate and eye rims; colour 1 on the cloth back panel; colour 3 on the domed eyes; colour 2 on the inner neck opening.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Mantis_01.differs: The cloth back panel hangs lower and wider over the neck and upper shoulders, covering more of the back of the neck.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Mecha_Horse_01.description: A full robotic horse head replacing the wearer's head: long angular muzzle, glowing eye slits, side cheek plates with hex bolts, two pointed ears and a mane of blocky slats running down the back of the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Mecha_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek plates and back panels; colour 1 on the muzzle tip and nose caps; colour 2 on the main head shell and mane slats; colour 3 on the eye lights.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Mecha_Horse_01.differs: The mane slats are larger and stand out more prominently along the back of the head, and the ears splay slightly wider.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Mechanical_Dragon_01.description: A full mechanical dragon head covering the whole head: a long, angular armoured snout tapering to a point, a tall blade-like crest, rounded horn-like nubs on top, and segmented plates across the back of the skull, exposing an inner layer at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Mechanical_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout plates and back-of-head segment rims; colour 2 on the horn nubs, crest edges and panels; colour 3 on the inner neck and gap layer; colour 1 on small accents.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Monkey_01.description: A monkey-faced head with a scowling muzzle, pointed ears and a tall swept-back crest of long spiky fur tufts, plus shaggy fur sideburns and a pointed beard. Covers the whole head in a wild beastly style.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur crest, sideburns and beard; colour 1 on the eye areas and faint tints in the fur; the face skin ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Moth_01.description: A moth-like beast head covered in a thick, shaggy fur mane that drapes over the head and down to the chest, with a small contrasting insectoid face, side eyes, and two long curved swept-back horn-like antennae.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face, the top of the fur and the antennae; colour 1 on the lower, shaggy fur mane, blending up from colour 0; colour 2 on the antenna edges; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Moth_02.description: A moth-like beast head: a smooth pointed face with slender curved eye slits, two long tapering feathered antennae sweeping up and outward, and a thick shaggy fur ruff that spills over the shoulders and chest.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Moth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur and antenna tips; colour 1 on the face and the lower fur ruff; colour 3 on the eye markings; colour 2 on the underside of the face.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Moth_02.differs: The male ruff is fuller and broader, spreading wider across the shoulders and chest.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Mouse_01.description: A full mouse-head replacement with a tapered snout, fine whiskers, large upright rounded ears with gradient inner faces, and a furry contrasting head. Marked eye patches and a contrasting muzzle give a cute animal look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Mouse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head fur and the lower inner ears; colour 1 on the eye patches and the upper inner ears; colour 2 on the muzzle; colour 3 on the nose, lips, ear rims and outer ears.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Mouse_01.differs: The male mouse has its outer ears, ear rims, nose and lips in colour 3, where the female has skin-toned ears and nose.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Owl_01.description: A full owl head replacing the wearer's own: a heart-shaped facial disc with round glossy eyes and a small hooked beak, a ruffled feathered crown and back that flare into a pointed cape-like nape, and a shaggy feathered ruff at the throat.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Owl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the facial disc and throat ruff; colour 1 on the crown and back feathers; colour 2 on the darker feather tips at the nape; colour 3 on the beak.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Pig_01.description: A full pig head replacing the wearer's own: a wrinkled, heavy-jowled face with a broad flat snout, small deep-set eyes and two rounded upright ears, blending into the neck with a short collar-like base.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Pig_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head, ears and neck; colour 1 on the snout tip.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Pitbull_01.description: A full-head dog mask in a pitbull style: a smooth close-fitting cranium, tall pointed upright ears with inner lining, a short broad muzzle with a contrasting nose, sculpted jowls and a lolling tongue hanging below the chin.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Pitbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the head, the centre stripe and the outer ears; colour 1 on the face and cheek patches and the tongue; colour 3 on the muzzle and inner ears; colour 2 on the nose.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Plantmonster_01.description: A full monstrous head covering shaped like a rounded bulb with a huge gaping toothed maw at the front. Lumpy rimmed lips frame rows of sharp fangs and an inner mouth lining, and raised round blotches are scattered over the skin.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Plantmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bulbous head skin and the fangs; colour 3 on the raised blotches; colour 2 on the lumpy lips around the mouth; colour 1 on the inner mouth lining.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Pumpkin_02.description: A large round ribbed pumpkin covering the whole head, with a carved jack-o'-lantern face of angular eyes, a triangular nose and jagged teeth, a curled stem on top and a small neck collar below.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Pumpkin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pumpkin shell; colour 1 on the stem and curled vine; colour 3 on the neck collar.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Pumpkin_02.differs: The neck collar is a short, tight ring under the head, rather than the longer pointed flare of the female version.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Pumpkin_03.description: A small, rounded jack-o'-lantern pumpkin head with vertical ribbing, angular carved eyes, nose and a jagged toothy grin, topped with a curling stem and a tendril. It replaces the head and sits over the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Pumpkin_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pumpkin body; colour 1 on the stem and curling tendril; colour 3 on the small cloth-like scrap at the neck beneath the head.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Rabbit_01.description: A full rabbit head replacing the human head: a furred, tapering muzzle with thin whiskers, angled eyes, and two tall pointed ears with lighter inner linings, ending in a neck base that sits at the collar.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Rabbit_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fur of the head and outer ears; colour 0 on the inner ears and whiskers; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Raccoon_01.description: A full anthropomorphic raccoon head with a short muzzle, large pointed upright ears, spiky swept-back fur tufts, bold mask-like eye patches and a rounded snout with a small nose. It covers the whole head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Raccoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur and outer ears; colour 2 on the eye mask patches; colour 1 on the muzzle and around the eyes; colour 3 on the nose and inner ears.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Raptor_01.description: A full replacement raptor-lizard head with a long toothy snout, small horns at the nose and a large fanned frill of ridged panels tipped with long spikes; finned ear flaps and a throat patch complete the reptilian look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Raptor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaly skin of the snout, face and frill spikes; colour 1 on the throat, ear fins and patterned frill panels; colour 3 on the frill stripes, mouth interior and back of the head.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Raptor_02.description: A full raptor-like reptile head replacing the wearer's own: a long toothy snout with an open jaw, and a wide fan-shaped frill of spiked ribs behind the skull. Small fins flare at the cheeks and neck. Monstrous, beastly look.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Raptor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout, jaw and frill ribs; colour 3 on the frill markings, back of the head and inner mouth; colour 1 on the frill patches, cheek fins and throat; colour 2 on the frill edges and spike tips.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Raptor_03.description: A full replacement raptor head with a long tapered snout, open toothy jaw and side-set eyes, topped by a fan-shaped frill edged with a row of curved horn spikes and small fins at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Raptor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout, jaw and frill underside; colour 1 on the throat, frill patches and neck fins; colour 3 on the mouth, head markings and frill stripes; colour 2 on the spike tips and frill edging.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Reptillian_01.description: A full reptilian beast head with a long snout, heavy brow ridges, pointed ears at the back corners and a raised central crest ridge. Scaly, textured skin covers the whole head and wraps down onto the throat.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Reptillian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose tip; colour 1 on the throat and jaw underside; colour 2 on the central crest plates; colour 3 on the head skin.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Seahorse_01.description: A full seahorse head replacing the wearer's own: a knobbly, studded head with a long tubular snout, round glossy eyes, feathery fin tufts at the sides, and leafy frond-like antlers branching from the crown.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Seahorse_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head and snout; colour 0 on the leafy fronds and spots' surrounding area; colour 1 on the eyes and spiky fin accents; colour 2 on the fin feathers and frond spots.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Serpent_Horned_01.description: A full reptilian head replacing the human head: a long tapering snout, wide toothy mouth with contrasting lips, side-set eyes, and a scaly crest of segmented plates running from brow to the back of the skull.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Serpent_Horned_01.colourAreas: The head is textured skin that mostly ignores the scheme; no clear colour slot is visible on the skin, crest or mouth.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Set_01.description: A full reptilian monster head with a long dragon-like snout, toothy jaw, sculpted brow ridges and two swept-back horns curving back; a smooth neck collar covers the neck. Suggests a dragon or lizard creature.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Set_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head, horns and neck; colour 1 around the eyes; colour 0 on the teeth, jaw underside and inner horn surfaces.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Set_01.differs: The male head has shorter, more swept-back horns and a blunter snout, with a smoother neck collar.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Shisa_01.description: A full head covering styled as a Shisa guardian lion: snarling muzzle with fangs, brow ridges, pointed ears, and a mane of carved spiral curls ending in jagged locks that hang past the neck.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Shisa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face, muzzle and curled mane; colour 1 on the crest panel on the forehead and the markings around the eyes and mouth; colour 2 on the mouth interior and eye recesses.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Skeletal_01.description: A full skeletal skull head with hollow glowing eye sockets, a fanged open jaw and a small collar-like neck base, topped by two long curving ridged horns that sweep up and outward, suggesting a demonic undead monster.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Skeletal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and jaw; colour 1 on the horns; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the teeth and fangs.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Spider_01.description: A full monstrous spider head covering the whole head and neck: a rounded carapace with clusters of bulbous eyes, small round gems below them, and two curved downward fangs with pointed tips. Mottled speckled surface, with small mandibles between the fangs.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the carapace and fang bases; colour 0 on the speckled patches and the large eyes; colour 1 on the small round gems and the fang tips; colour 2 on the small side eyes and mandibles.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Spider_01.differs: The male version has a pair of small contrasting mandibles between the fangs, where the female has a small toothed mouth.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Starowl_01.description: A full owl-griffon head with a hooked beak, tufted pointed ears, a masked eye area and shaggy layered feathers that flare into a ruff around the neck and cover the whole head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers and beak; colour 1 on the face mask patches and inner ears; colour 2 on the ear tips and beak tip; colour 3 on the eyes.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Starowl_01.differs: The male ruff is fuller and longer, and the beak and ears are slightly larger and bolder.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Suave_01.description: A full wolf head with a sleek, tapered muzzle, tall pointed ears and a shaggy ruff of fur around the cheeks and neck. A tuft of fur crests the forehead, and the fur ends in spiky, tipped points.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Suave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur, ears and ruff; colour 3 on the muzzle and eye-mask area; colour 1 on the fur tips and inner ears; colour 2 on the nose and some tuft tips.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Swan_01.description: A full swan head on a long, curved S-shaped neck, with a smooth rounded skull, a pointed downward-angled beak, small eyes and a patch on each cheek. A ruff of jagged feather tufts sits at the base of the neck on the shoulders.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, neck and feather ruff; colour 1 on the cheek patches; colour 2 on the beak and the underside of the ruff; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Beast_Swan_02.description: A full swan head with a curved, tapering neck bending forward, a long pointed bill, small round eyes and a ruff of jagged feathers around the base of the neck, sitting over the whole head.
Male/M_Head_Beast_Swan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, neck and feather ruff; colour 1 on the cheek patches around the eyes; colour 2 on the bill and the base of the ruff; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Bonemantis_01.description: A ring of six curved, tapering bone-like fangs arranged around the base of the neck, pointing downward and inward like mandibles. Suggests a monstrous, mantis-inspired collar that leaves the head and neck otherwise bare.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the fangs, with a faint tint from colour 1 on the shaded undersides.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Croc_Head_01.description: A crocodile-style set of teeth: two curved rows of long, sharp conical fangs, upper and lower, arranged around the mouth and jaw line with no other head parts. Suggests a monstrous, reptilian look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Croc_Head_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth, with shading toward darker tips; other colour slots not clearly visible.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Fennec_Ears_01.description: A pair of large, pointed fennec-fox ears rising from the sides of the head, with a rim around each ear, a hollow inner face lined with tufted fur, and a fringe of small feathery tufts along the lower edge.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Fennec_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner ear hollows; colour 0 on the fur tufts inside the ears.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Fennec_Hair_01.description: A short mohawk-style hairpiece of swept, layered locks that rise into tall pointed tips along the centre of the head, with the sides left bare. It suggests a fox-like, spiky punk-fantasy look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Fennec_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and body of the locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the locks.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Ears_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that sit high on the sides of the head and sweep up and outward, with a hollow inner cup lined with a tufted, feathery edge. Feral, beastlike fantasy look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 on the inner ear lining.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Teeth_01.description: A set of feral fangs arranged in a U-shaped row along the jawline and chin, with two large curved tusks flaring up at the mouth corners and smaller pointed teeth trailing down and around toward the neck.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Teeth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and tusks; colour 1 on the bases of some of the smaller teeth.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Tongue_01.description: A long, tapering tongue-like flap that hangs from the mouth down past the chin to the neck, with a ridged, wrinkled surface and a pointed tip. Suggests a feral beast or monster head.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Feral_Tongue_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tongue surface; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Ears_01.description: A pair of small pointed animal ears perched high on the sides of the head, each a cupped, slightly crumpled shell with an inner hollow facing forward. A cute ferret-like beast look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of each ear; colour 1 on the inner hollow of each ear.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Mouth_01.description: A set of sharp animal fangs sitting at the mouth: a row of small pointed teeth with two longer canines curving up from the upper row and two longer tusks pointing down at the corners. Feral and monstrous.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and fangs; the lower tips show darker shading. No other colour slots are clearly visible.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Mouth_01.differs: The male fangs are a wider row with longer lower tusks that hang further below the lip.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Side_01.description: A pair of thin, angular whisker clusters that sprout from either side of the nose and splay outward and slightly back. Each is a few fine bristles, giving a ferret-like animal look; no other head change is visible.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Ferret_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Horse_01.description: A neck-length mane of long, shaggy, feathered strands swept forward over the brow and falling down the back of the neck, with ragged pointed tips and a raised crest along the centre of the scalp.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the strands; colour 1 on the crest and central streaks along the scalp and back; colour 2 on the tapered tips of the strands.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Kaiju_Mouth_01.description: A monstrous mouth attachment: two long curved tusks that sweep down past the jaw on either side of the face, plus a few small pointed teeth or fangs set in a row around the mouth.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Kaiju_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large tusks and the small fangs; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Kaiju_Top_01.description: A set of small rounded bony nodules or scale-like studs scattered across the scalp, brow and cheekbones, in two arcs from the crown down to the face, giving a monstrous kaiju-like head.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Kaiju_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the nodules; the rest of the piece takes no other colour slots.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Kaiju_Top_02.description: A pair of small, faceted horn-like bumps set on the upper forehead, one on each side. Each is a chunky, angular pointed lump that angles outward, giving a monstrous kaiju brow.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Kaiju_Top_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of each horn surface; colour 1 on the inner side facets of each horn.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Kitty_Ears_01.description: A pair of pointed cat ears set high on either side of the head, each with a smooth outer shell and a soft, fluffy inner lining that faces forward. Cute, animal-like headgear.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Kitty_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shells of the ears; the inner ear lining shows a fluffy texture that does not take a clear colour slot.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Hair_01.description: A short, tall swept-up hairstyle of sharp, flame-like locks that rise into a spiky crest above the forehead. It sits close to the head and ends above the jaw, giving a wild, animalistic look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair locks; colour 1 on the shaded strands between the locks and along the edges.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_01.description: A stylised beard and sideburn set of layered, pointed blade-like tufts: swept-out flared wings of spikes at each cheek join a tapering, pointed goatee hanging from the chin. Suggests a wild beast or monkey-king look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tufts; colour 1 on the thin edge highlights and inner streaks of the strands.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_02.description: A furry beard-like chin piece: a collar wraps under the jaw and the shaggy fur fans out wide, ending in a short jagged fringe over the throat and upper chest. It suggests a beastly monkey or primate look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur and collar; colour 1 on the thin streaks running through the fur.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_02.differs: The male version is shorter and wider, with a broad fan of fur, while the female one hangs longer and narrower to a deeper point.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_03.description: Two pairs of small conical fangs set along the corners of the mouth, one pointing up and one pointing down on each side. A subtle bestial mouth accent with no other head coverage.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Monkey_Mouth_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upward fangs; colour 2 on the downward fangs. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_01.description: A row of chunky orc-style teeth set along the mouth line, with a long curved tusk sweeping up on one side and a large blunt stubby tooth on the other, giving a brutish underbite look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long tusk; colour 1 on the teeth flanking the centre; colour 2 on the two centre teeth; colour 3 on the large blunt tooth.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_02.description: A row of orc-like lower tusks and teeth along the mouth: two large curved outer tusks sweep up and outward, with smaller pointed teeth between them. Suggests a brutish, monstrous underbite.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the left large tusk; colour 3 on the right large tusk; colour 1 on the small teeth beside the tusks; colour 2 on the two centre teeth.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Mouth_02.differs: The male version has slightly larger, more widely spaced centre teeth and sits a little lower on the chin than the female version.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_01.description: A small chunky hoop ring with a dimpled, hammered surface, worn through the ear as a piercing. It is a thick rounded band with a hollow centre, giving a crude tribal, monstrous look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_02.description: A small chunky ring set through the ear, like a gauge or plug earring, with a hammered, faceted outer surface and a hollow centre. Sits on the side of the head, suggesting a brutish orc look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the ring; the inner lining shows a slightly different shade, likely from shading rather than a separate slot.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_03.description: A pair of chunky rough-textured ear gauges, one ring on each side of the head at ear level, with a thick chiselled band and open centre. A tribal, monstrous brute-style piercing.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Orc_Side_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings; the other slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Raccoon_Mouth_01.description: Two separate clusters of sharp fangs set along the lower jaw below the lips, with a clear gap at the centre. Tips point downward and outward for a feral raccoon-like snarl.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Raccoon_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth, with colour 1 shading toward the tips.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Raccoon_Mouth_01.differs: The male teeth are split into two distinct side clusters with a wider gap in the middle, and they are more tightly bunched.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Starowl_Ears_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that sweep up and outward from the top of the forehead, with hollow inner cups, tipped points and thin swooping line markings. Suggests a beastly owl, griffon or fox-like look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Starowl_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear cups; colour 2 on the ear tips, edge trim and line markings.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Starowl_Mouth_01.description: A hooked raptor beak worn over the nose and mouth: a smooth, pointed shell that curves down to a sharp tip past the chin, with small nostril dimples near the top. Suggests a griffon or owl head.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Starowl_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 2 on the hooked tip and lower edge, blending from colour 0 towards the tip.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Whiterhino_Ears_.description: A pair of small pointed animal ears with skin-like surfaces, angled outward and upward from the upper sides of the head. Each tapers from a wider base to a folded tip, giving a beastly rhino-like look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Whiterhino_Ears_.colourAreas: Colour slots don't visibly apply; the ears show a skin-toned surface that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Whiterhino_Mouth.description: A set of blocky, chunky teeth in upper and lower rows that curve around the mouth like a beast's jaw, worn over the mouth area. Suggests a rhino or monstrous creature look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Whiterhino_Mouth.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; the teeth show no other colour slots.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Ears_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears with faceted, angular shells and a hollow inner cup, set high on the sides of the head and angled outward like a wolf's. Suggests a beastly or cute animal-person look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of each ear; the inner ear cup shows a skin-like tone that does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Mouth_01.description: A set of jagged, spiky wolf teeth forming a U-shaped ring that wraps along the jawline and chin, with two longer fangs at the front. It sits around the mouth like a monstrous toothy jaw.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth; colour 1 on the shadowed bases and gum edges of the teeth.
Male/M_Head_Child_Beast_Wolf_Mouth_01.differs: The male teeth are packed more densely and form a fuller, wider jaw ring with shorter fangs at the front.

Male/M_Head_Child_Disco_01.description: A spherical, translucent bubble helmet that encloses the whole head, covered in a glittering, iridescent faceted sparkle pattern. It sits around the head down to the neck, giving a retro-futuristic disco or space look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Disco_01.colourAreas: The default material is an iridescent, sparkling glass-like finish that ignores the colour scheme; no colour slot is clearly visible.

Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A pair of large, pointed, swept-back fantasy ears that replace the normal ears. Each has a smooth outer shell and a textured inner ear, flaring from the sides of the head into sharp tips angled up and back.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shells of the ears; the inner ear lining keeps a fixed textured skin look that ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A pair of swept-back finned brow ridges, one over each eye, curving from the brow toward the temples with layered feather-like ridges. They read as dragon-like head ornaments that leave the rest of the face bare.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower and outer parts of each brow fin; colour 1 on the upper tips and the ridge edges, blending from colour 0.

Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A short, swept-back mane of layered, flame-like locks that fan out behind the head in pointed tips, with an open hairline at the front. Suggests a wild, dragon-like fantasy hairstyle.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair locks; colour 1 on the pointed tips of the locks; colour 2 on the inner lining under the front edge.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.differs: The male version has an open hairline with a hollow front edge instead of a separate forehead band.

Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A V-shaped ruff of layered, feather-like or fur-like tufts that wraps around the jaw and neck, with a fuller mass at the chin and swept-up pointed plumes rising beside each ear. Suggests a beastly, dragon-like look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tufts of the ruff and the chin mass; colour 1 on the tips of the tufts; colour 2 and colour 3 on the upright plumes by the ears, fading from one to the other.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.differs: The male version has a fuller, beard-like mass of tufts at the chin instead of a small separate panel.

Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: Swept-back, spiky dragon-like hair with feathery tapered tips, small curved horn-like ornaments at each temple, and twin braided locks with a band hanging in front of the shoulders, forming a beard-like fringe.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and braids; colour 1 on the hair tips and the braid bands; colour 3 on the horn-like temple ornaments; colour 2 on the inner horn parts.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.differs: The male version has no eye band, leaving the face open, and the braids read as a beard-like fringe.

Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A U-shaped row of small pointed fang-like teeth that traces the jawline from ear to ear around the lower face, giving a monstrous, beast-like grin. No other head covering is included.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth; no other colour slots are visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A pair of slender, curved, tapering tendrils or whiskers that start at the sides of the mouth and sweep down and outward past the jaw, ending in fine points. A small dragon-like accent.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both tendrils; no other colours visible.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.differs: The male tendrils sit higher, starting at the sides of the mouth like a moustache and hanging past the jaw.

Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.description: A pair of antler-like horns rising from the top of the head, each sweeping up and outward from a thick rounded base into a long curved main tine with a smaller side prong and a pointed tip.
Male/M_Head_Child_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thick bases of the horns; colour 1 across the mid-shafts, blending into colour 2 at the tips. Colour 3 is not visible.

Male/M_Head_Child_Drone_Top_01.description: A small headpiece sitting on the forehead and crown: an oval contrasting gem-like plate with a rim, flanked by two tall swept-up pointed fins that form a horned, V-shaped crest. Suggests a sleek robotic or alien drone helm.
Male/M_Head_Child_Drone_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two upswept fins; colour 1 on the thin edge trim of the fins and band; colour 3 on the rim around the oval plate; colour 2 on the oval plate.

Male/M_Head_Child_Fox_02.description: Two small clusters of thin, curved whiskers that fan out sideways from either cheek beside the mouth, like a fox's. A tiny animal accessory that leaves the rest of the face bare.
Male/M_Head_Child_Fox_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whisker shafts; colour 2 on the whisker tips and roots.

Male/M_Head_Child_Full_Falcon_Side_01.description: A pair of mechanical falcon-wing head fins mounted at the temples: each has a pointed plate at the front, layered swept-back feather blades and a small angled tip below, flaring backward from the sides of the head.
Male/M_Head_Child_Full_Falcon_Side_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front temple plates; colour 1 on the long upper wing blades; colour 2 on the middle layered blades; colour 3 on the small lower spikes.

Male/M_Head_Child_Full_Falcon_Top_01.description: A slim circlet-style falcon headpiece: an angular band rings the head, with a tall crest of layered pointed plates running front to back, a gem at the brow point, and small spikes flanking the crest.
Male/M_Head_Child_Full_Falcon_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the circlet band and crest plates; colour 1 on the tallest crest fin; colour 2 on the small side spikes; colour 3 on the brow gem.

Male/M_Head_Child_Kitsune_01.description: Two clusters of long, thin curved whiskers, one on each side of the face, fanning outward from beside the mouth. Slim and delicate, they suggest a fox or cat animal-character look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Kitsune_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whiskers; colour 2 on the darker whisker tips and roots.
Male/M_Head_Child_Kitsune_01.differs: The whiskers sit level with the mouth and spread wider across the cheeks than the female set.

Male/M_Head_Child_None_01.description: A small rounded, scoop-shaped neck patch that fills the base of the neck and upper chest, like a tiny bib or collar insert. Its edge is thin and flat, and it is open at the back.
Male/M_Head_Child_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole patch; the inner underside shows as a shadowed surface with no separate colour slot.

Male/M_Head_Child_None_02.description: A small shallow, rounded-triangular tray sitting at the base of the neck and upper chest, with a thick raised rim, a recessed inner panel and a small round ball set in the centre.
Male/M_Head_Child_None_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, inner panel and central ball; the underside is shaded but takes the same colour.
Male/M_Head_Child_None_02.differs: The male version has a raised rim around a recessed panel and a small round ball in the centre, which the female plate lacks.

Male/M_Head_Child_None_03.description: A small rounded-triangular gorget plate resting at the base of the throat, with a raised rim around a shallow recess and a domed stud at its centre; it flares slightly at the back like a collar.
Male/M_Head_Child_None_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and its central dome; the underside of the plate shows a shaded tone from the same slot.

Male/M_Head_Child_None_05.description: A small rounded, shield-like plate that sits under the chin and over the upper chest and throat, with a thin raised rim and a hollow, contrasting-lined interior at the back. It reads as a chin guard or bib piece rather than a full cap.
Male/M_Head_Child_None_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the plate and its rim; colour 2 on the inner lining visible at the back.

Male/M_Head_Child_Robot_Steampunk_01.description: A pair of small octagonal disc ear-plates mounted on short contrasting stems at each side of the head, each ending in a rounded knob that sticks outward. The discs have layered rims and a recessed centre, giving a mechanical steampunk robot look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Robot_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer disc rims and backs; colour 1 on the recessed ring of each disc; colour 3 on the central and end knobs; colour 2 on the stems.

Male/M_Head_Child_Robot_Steampunk_02.description: A pair of small octagonal barrel-shaped filter canisters worn at either side of the mouth and jaw, with banded, segmented metal casings and recessed round openings facing forward. Suggests a steampunk respirator.
Male/M_Head_Child_Robot_Steampunk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister casings; colour 3 on the recessed openings.

Male/M_Head_Child_Scarab_02.description: A pair of tall curved horns rising from the sides of the head, built from chunky segmented blocks that taper into sharp upturned tips. They sit at the temples and suit a demonic or insectoid fantasy look.
Male/M_Head_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base segments of each horn; colour 1 on the middle segments; colour 2 on the narrow band below the tip; colour 3 on the pointed tips and the base ends.

Male/M_Head_Child_Sockpuppet_Eye_01.description: A pair of flat, octagonal button-style eyes stuck onto the upper forehead, each with a short curved stitched thread loop across the middle; a cute novelty sock-puppet look, sitting high on the head.
Male/M_Head_Child_Sockpuppet_Eye_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the right-hand button; colour 1 on the left-hand button; colour 2 on the thread loops in the centres of both buttons.

Male/M_Head_Child_Sockpuppet_Hair_01.description: A small cap of short, straight strands of hair sitting on top of the head like a tuft, with a central parting and thicker rope-like strands running along the crown and sides; leaves the sides and back of the head bare.
Male/M_Head_Child_Sockpuppet_Hair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main strands of hair; colour 1 on the thicker rope-like strands along the crown and edges.

Male/M_Head_Child_Steelcommando_01.description: A retro metal face guard: a curved visor band across the eyes with two flat cheek plates that run down along the sides of the face toward the jaw, leaving the nose and mouth open.
Male/M_Head_Child_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the visor band and its polished edge; colour 1 on the inner edges of the cheek plates; the rest shows the glossy metal default.
Male/M_Head_Child_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male visor band is deeper and flatter across the front, with a separate lower lip under the band and straighter cheek plates.

Male/M_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_01.description: A flat, thin rounded-square screen panel that floats in front of the face like a TV head, with softly curved corners. It shows a cartoon picture of a contrasting cat with a rainbow and hearts on a meadow.
Male/M_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_01.colourAreas: The panel shows a fixed printed image that ignores the colour scheme; no slot visibly changes it.
Male/M_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_01.differs: The male screen shows a clear cartoon picture of a cat with a rainbow and hearts, rather than a scrambled pixel pattern.

Male/M_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_02.description: A pair of thick, rounded-rectangular slab panels floating on either side of the head like screens or earpieces, with bevelled edges and no connection to the skull. Reads as a minimal sci-fi head accessory.
Male/M_Head_Child_Tight_Tv_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both panels; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Crow_01.description: A full monstrous crow head with a large hooked beak, multiple small eyes clustered on each side of the face, two long ridged curving horns, and shaggy feathered tufts around the neck and back of the head.
Male/M_Head_Crow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathered face and the horn bands; colour 1 on the beak; colour 3 on the horn tips and the ragged neck and back-of-head tufts; colour 2 on the small eyes and thin neck band.

Male/M_Head_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.description: A full replacement head shaped like an elongated, skull-like monster with a long toothed snout, angular plated crown, curled brow ridges and a neck collar that covers the throat. Reads as a mechanical beast for cyberpunk or monstrous looks.
Male/M_Head_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell and snout; colour 1 on the neck collar and the curled trim around the eyes and cheeks; colour 2 on the side plates above the ears; colour 3 on the nostril lights.

Male/M_Head_Demon_01.description: A monstrous bald head with a long, crocodile-like snout, heavy brow ridges, pointed ears and rows of sharp fangs, with larger tusks jutting from the jaw. Replaces the whole head with a demonic, beastly look.
Male/M_Head_Demon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fangs and tusks; the skin-like head surface does not visibly use the colour scheme.
Male/M_Head_Demon_01.differs: The male jaw is longer and heavier, with more prominent pointed ears and wider-set tusks.

Male/M_Head_Demon_02.description: A bald, skull-like demonic head with a ridged brow, deep sunken eye sockets, small pointed ears and a long narrow jaw lined with sharp fangs down each side. The sculpted skin looks organic and gaunt.
Male/M_Head_Demon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fangs; the skin of the head takes a skin tone that does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Demon_03.description: A bald, skull-like demon head with a ridged brow, deep hollow eye sockets, a sunken nose and a jawless lower face, with rows of long pointed fangs along the cheeks and a smooth tapering neck.
Male/M_Head_Demon_03.colourAreas: The head and neck take the skin tone, which is not one of the four test colours; the fangs show a ivory tint that does not follow the scheme.

Male/M_Head_Disco_01.description: A full spherical disco-ball helmet covering the whole head, made of a grid of small mirrored square tiles with a glittering finish. A flared neck collar sits beneath the ball.
Male/M_Head_Disco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 tint the mirrored tiles, with the sparkle finish partly overriding the scheme; colour 3 on the neck collar beneath the ball.
Male/M_Head_Disco_01.differs: The male ball shows a clear grid of individual square tiles, and it has a larger, flared neck collar.

Male/M_Head_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A full dragon head covering the whole head: a smooth scaled snout with a contrasting nose, whisker tendrils, a beard tuft, two tall curved antler horns, and a swept-back mane of layered feathery spikes down the back.
Male/M_Head_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the face, snout and neck collar; colour 0 on the mane tufts, whiskers and beard; colour 1 on the mane tips and horn bases; colour 2 on the nose, brow markings and horn tips.

Male/M_Head_Drone_01.description: A full mechanical drone helmet with a smooth segmented shell, two tall pointed fins rising above the brow, a contrasting oval visor, and a rounded ribbed face section with small side lens pods. Side plates flare down along the jaw.
Male/M_Head_Drone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell plates, fins and jaw flares; colour 1 on the panel seams and edge trim; colour 3 on the ribbed face section and visor rim; colour 2 on the visor and inner fin surfaces.

Male/M_Head_Dryad_01.description: A full head replacement shaped like a hollow tree stump: a wood-grain, plank-like shell with jagged splintered spikes rising at the crown, a skull-like face with glowing eyes and a narrow nose slit, and a ridged collar at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bark shell and splintered crown; colour 3 on the thin cracks in the wood grain; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Dryad_02.description: A full monstrous head replacement resembling a bark-like tree spirit: a ridged, elongated neck and skull crowned with jagged thorn-like spikes, patches of rough textured growth on top, narrow glowing eyes and a fanged, snarling mouth.
Male/M_Head_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged bark-like head and neck; colour 2 on the rough patches across the crown and brow; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 3 on the thin vein lines and inner mouth.

Male/M_Head_Face_Chicken_01.description: A full cartoon chicken head covering the whole head and neck, with a scalloped feather texture, a serrated spiky comb on top, a hooked beak, wattle, round contrasting-ringed eyes and a jagged feathered collar edge.
Male/M_Head_Face_Chicken_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathered head and neck; colour 1 on the comb, face and wattle; colour 2 on the beak; colour 3 on the rings around the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Face_Rock_01.description: A full head replacement with a cracked, rocky skin texture: a dense network of fissures divides the face, scalp and neck into stone-like plates. The features are heavy-browed, blocky and rugged.
Male/M_Head_Face_Rock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates of the head; colour 2 on the crack lines; colour 3 on the neck edge.
Male/M_Head_Face_Rock_01.differs: The male head has a heavy brow and blocky jaw with thin contrasting crack lines and no coloured lips, while the female has a slimmer face with distinct lips and wider crack lines.

Male/M_Head_Facemask_01_Basic.description: A smooth, close-fitting cowl covering the whole head and neck, with open cutouts around the eyes and a straight cut across the nose that leaves the mouth and chin bare. Classic superhero style.
Male/M_Head_Facemask_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire cowl; the exposed mouth and chin are the mannequin's skin, not part of the piece.

Male/M_Head_Facemask_Valdia_01.description: A close-fitting superhero cowl covering the whole head with a smooth shell, a chevron-shaped stripe running over the crown, raised seam lines, small ear bulges and a pointed masked eye area with a separate lining, leaving the face open.
Male/M_Head_Facemask_Valdia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cowl shell; colour 1 on the mask lining around the eyes; colour 2 on the chevron stripe over the crown.

Male/M_Head_Facemask_Valhex_01.description: A close-fitting cloth superhero hood that covers the whole head and stops at the neck, with an open eye-and-nose mask cutout, a segmented ridge running over the crown, and outlined angular panel seams down the back.
Male/M_Head_Facemask_Valhex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood; colour 1 on the mask surround around the eyes; colour 2 on the outlining piping and the crown ridge segments.
Male/M_Head_Facemask_Valhex_01.differs: The male hood ends in a shorter, straight-cut neck edge at the base of the neck.

Male/M_Head_Facemask_Valstar_01.description: A close-fitting superhero hood covering the whole head and neck, with a quilted panel seam pattern, a raised diamond-shaped panel running up the forehead and crown, and a bordered mask surround at the eyes. Nose, mouth and chin are left open.
Male/M_Head_Facemask_Valstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood and neck; colour 1 on the forehead panel and the eye-surround inlay; colour 2 on the borders around the panel and eye openings.

Male/M_Head_Fishangler_01.description: A full monstrous fish-head covering the whole head: smooth rounded skull with a vein-patterned crest, large glossy side-set eyes, and a wide gaping mouth lined with rows of needle-like teeth and a ridged lower jaw.
Male/M_Head_Fishangler_01.colourAreas: The piece shows mostly its own skin-toned texture, with little response to the scheme; the eyes and jaw rim show separate texture details, and the crest has a paler veined pattern.

Male/M_Head_Fox_02.description: A full fox head replacing the human head: furry, tapering muzzle with whiskers and a rounded nose, upright pointed ears, tufted cheek fur and a fur-covered neck. Reads as an animal-headed beast or mascot look.
Male/M_Head_Fox_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur of the head, ears and neck; colour 2 on the darker fur markings around the muzzle and ear insides; colour 3 on the nose; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: A full replacement head shaped like an axolotl: a smooth rounded head with a wide grinning mouth, glossy eyes and faint speckles, crowned by three feathery external gills that fan out on each side.
Male/M_Head_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head skin; colour 1 on the gill fronds; colour 3 on the gill tips and edges and on the eyes; colour 2 on the small neck slot under the chin.

Male/M_Head_Full_Falcon_01.description: A full-head falcon helmet in segmented plate: a hooked beak over the face, angry angled eye slits, swept crest spikes and side fins on top, and a layered gorget collar flaring over the neck and shoulders.
Male/M_Head_Full_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet plates and neck collar; colour 1 on the beak and the crest and side feather blades; colour 2 on the inner helmet shell and edge lining; colour 3 on the eye markings and small side spikes.

Male/M_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Full_01.description: A full werewolf head covering with a long snarling muzzle, bared teeth, pointed ears and a bushy, spiky fur mane that flares around the head and ends at the base of the neck.
Male/M_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Full_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur of the head and mane; colour 1 on the muzzle, cheek fur and streaks in the mane; colour 2 on the nose and mouth interior.
Male/M_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Full_01.differs: The male mane is shorter, bushier and more flared, ending at the base of the neck rather than hanging long down the back.

Male/M_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_01.description: A full werewolf head with a long snout, bared fangs, pointed ears and a shaggy mane of layered fur tufts sweeping back over the skull and down the neck, leaving the bare-skinned face exposed for a feral monstrous look.
Male/M_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur mane and chin beard; colour 1 on shading streaks within the fur tufts; the skin of the face, nose and ears uses a fixed skin tone rather than the scheme.
Male/M_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_01.differs: The male version has a bare-skinned face with fur only around the mane and chin, and a heavier, more brutish muzzle.

Male/M_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_02.description: A werewolf head with a thick, spiky fur mane swept back and down the neck, small horn-like tufts above the brow, pointed ears, a bearded furred jaw, and a heavy snarling brutish face with visible tusks.
Male/M_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur; colour 1 on the streaky fur tips and shading in the mane; the face skin keeps its own tone and is not affected by the scheme.
Male/M_Head_Fur_Werewolf_Partial_02.differs: The male head has a heavier brutish face with a wider jaw and tusks, plus a fuller, longer mane and a furry beard.

Male/M_Head_Gadgetbot_01.description: A robotic full helmet with a rounded domed shell, contrasting side panels and contrasting stripes, a single protruding cyclops lens barrel over the face, an angular jaw guard, and a segmented neck collar piece.
Male/M_Head_Gadgetbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome shell, lens housing and jaw; colour 1 on the side panels, back module and neck collar; colour 2 on the stripes; colour 3 on the lens.
Male/M_Head_Gadgetbot_01.differs: The male helmet has a chunkier segmented neck piece with a wider contrasting collar, while the female has a slim neck stem with a thin ring.

Male/M_Head_Huge_Floatingbrain_01.description: A detached, floating brain with deeply folded, wrinkled surface hovering above the shoulders in place of a head, with a small contrasting neck collar plate and knob sitting at the neck base.
Male/M_Head_Huge_Floatingbrain_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brain; colour 2 on the neck plate and knob.

Male/M_Head_Huge_Floatingbrain_03.description: A head replacement in the form of a detailed, wrinkled human brain floating above the neck, with no face. It hovers over a small shallow collar cup that holds a ball at the neck base. Monstrous, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Head_Huge_Floatingbrain_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brain; colour 0 on the neck collar cup and ball.

Male/M_Head_Junkbot_01.description: A full-head replacement shaped like a boxy toaster: a rounded cuboid with two vertical slots in the face, a flat top with a small lever and a bolt, and a flat back panel. It sits on a thin collar ring over the neck.
Male/M_Head_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back panel, side panel and collar ring; colour 1 on the rounded front shell and neck tubes; colour 2 on the top plate and slot interiors; colour 3 on the lever and bolt head.

Male/M_Head_Junkbot_02.description: A retro CRT television worn as a full head replacement: a boxy rounded-edge casing with a bright cartoon-style screen, side control knobs and a tapered back, mounted on a contrasting neck bracket with a small mechanical clamp.
Male/M_Head_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front bezel, control panel and lower casing; colour 1 on the casing sides, knobs and neck bracket; colour 2 on the top and bottom edges and clamp; colour 3 on the corner edge strips. The screen shows its own picture.
Male/M_Head_Junkbot_02.differs: The male version sits on a broader neck bracket with a clamp, and its screen shows a rainbow cartoon picture.

Male/M_Head_Junkbot_03.description: A full-head retro television helmet: a boxy rounded-corner cabinet with a bright screen on the front showing a cartoon cat with a rainbow, two control dials and a speaker grille at the side, and a tapered back casing covering the whole head.
Male/M_Head_Junkbot_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing, bezel and side panel; colour 1 on the large curved panels of the cabinet and the dials; colour 2 on the base and the vent slot at the back; colour 3 on the top corner panel. The screen image ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Head_Junkbot_03.differs: The screen shows a clear cartoon cat with a rainbow and hearts instead of a scrambled static pattern.

Male/M_Head_Junkbot_Antenna_01.description: A small rounded cap-like plate sitting on top of the head, with two thin telescoping antennae angled outward in a V like rabbit-ear TV aerials. A quirky robot or retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Head_Junkbot_Antenna_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap rim and antenna rods; colour 1 on the main cap panels and antenna segments; colour 2 on the front panel and antenna tips; colour 3 on the rear side panel.

Male/M_Head_Junkbot_Screen_01.description: A flat, slightly curved rectangular screen panel that sits across the eyes and upper face like a visor, floating in front of the head. It shows a cute cartoon picture with a rainbow, hearts and a cat, leaving the rest of the head bare.
Male/M_Head_Junkbot_Screen_01.colourAreas: The screen shows a fixed multicoloured cartoon image that ignores the colour scheme; no colour slots are visible on it.
Male/M_Head_Junkbot_Screen_01.differs: The male screen displays a cartoon picture of a rainbow, hearts and a cat instead of the female's glitchy, pixelated static pattern.

Male/M_Head_Kitsune_01.description: A full fox-head replacement with tall pointed ears, a long tapering muzzle, a contrasting nose, fine whiskers, and swept cheek ruffs. contrasting swirl markings run over the brow and cheeks, and the neck is enclosed down to the shoulders.
Male/M_Head_Kitsune_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fur of the head, ears and neck; colour 1 on the muzzle and lower face as a fade; colour 0 on the brow and cheek markings and whiskers; colour 2 on the nose.

Male/M_Head_Lizard_05.description: A full lizard head replacing the wearer's own: a broad, smooth snout with a toothy, wide-set jaw, a central horn between the eyes, small spikes along the brow, and a patterned crest of scaly plates over the crown and back of the head.
Male/M_Head_Lizard_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest plates over the crown and back of the head; the skin, eyes, teeth and jaw trim appear to keep their own textured look and show little response to the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Mech_Mechrobot_01.description: A full mechanical robot helmet: a rounded domed shell with contrasting slit grooves and side panels, eyes set in a skeletal face with a teeth grille jaw, a cylindrical post on top, and a curved collar piece under the chin.
Male/M_Head_Mech_Mechrobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome shell and jaw; colour 1 on the side panels, top post, rear frame and chin collar; colour 2 on the grooves and joint gaps; colour 3 on the eyes.
Male/M_Head_Mech_Mechrobot_01.differs: The male helmet shows eyes glowing in the face sockets, while the female version has no visible eyes.

Male/M_Head_Monster_Child_Vampire_Large_.description: A monstrous set of oversized fangs: a row of long pointed teeth sits at the mouth, and a second U-shaped row of spiky teeth hangs down over the chest. Suggests a vampire or beast maw.
Male/M_Head_Monster_Child_Vampire_Large_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the teeth and fangs; the other colour slots are not visibly used.

Male/M_Head_Monster_Pumpkin_01.description: A full pumpkin-shaped head covering with ribbed, rounded lobes, a curved stalk on top, and a carved jack-o'-lantern face with angry eyes and a jagged toothy grin. A neck piece below the chin links it to the body.
Male/M_Head_Monster_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pumpkin shell; colour 2 on the stalk; colour 3 on the eye and mouth interiors; colour 1 on the neck piece under the chin.

Male/M_Head_Monster_Snowman_01.description: A full snowman head: a rounded, lumpy snow-textured sphere with a long pointed carrot-like nose, small round studs for eyes and mouth, a wide-brimmed top hat with a band, and a short flared neck piece sitting around the neck.
Male/M_Head_Monster_Snowman_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snowy head, hat and brim; colour 1 on the hat band and the eye and mouth studs; colour 2 on the nose; colour 3 on the neck piece.
Male/M_Head_Monster_Snowman_01.differs: The neck piece is a short, wide collar around the neck rather than a long flap hanging down the chest.

Male/M_Head_Monster_Vampire_01.description: A bat-like vampire monster head with a bald sloped skull, large pointed ears, a flat snout with slit nostrils, glaring eyes and a wide snarling mouth packed with jagged teeth over a contrasting lower lip.
Male/M_Head_Monster_Vampire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower lip and teeth; colour 2 on the inner ears and nostrils; the skin and eyes ignore the colour scheme and keep their default look.
Male/M_Head_Monster_Vampire_01.differs: The male version has a bat-like face with large pointed ears, a flat snout and a short snarling mouth, whereas the female has a human-shaped head with a long stretched jaw.

Male/M_Head_Monster_Vampire_Large_01.description: A monstrous bat head with large pointed ears, a sunken flat nose and a long tapering snout. The wide-open jaw is lined with rows of sharp fangs. It replaces the whole head and ends in a short neck.
Male/M_Head_Monster_Vampire_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears on the fangs and teeth; the skin ignores the scheme and shows a fixed flesh tone; the ear interiors and nose are dark; the eyes are fixed.

Male/M_Head_Monster_Vampire_Longjaw_01.description: A monstrous vampire head with a gaunt, scarred face, an elongated gaping jaw full of sharp fangs, and long straight hair with streaked bands falling past the shoulders at the back and sides.
Male/M_Head_Monster_Vampire_Longjaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light streaks of the hair and the fangs; colour 2 on the hair streaks; colour 1 on the hair ends and the streaks; the skin of the face is not affected by the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Beak_02.description: A rounded eagle-beak mask covering the nose and mouth: a smooth upper beak curves down to a sharp hooked tip, with small nostril holes and a separate lower mandible tucked beneath. Suits bird-themed or monstrous looks.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Beak_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 1 on the lower mandible and the inner edges.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Beak_03.description: A long, pointed stork-like beak worn over the nose and mouth, with a smooth tapering upper bill, small nostril holes and a thin lower shell tucked beneath. Suits animal, bird-mask and plague-doctor looks.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Beak_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper bill; colour 1 on the lower shell and the inner edges of the beak.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Beak_04.description: A hooked owl-style beak worn over the nose and mouth: a rounded upper mandible curving to a downward point, small nostril holes on the sides, and a separate smaller lower mandible beneath.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Beak_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper mandible; colour 1 on the lower mandible and the underside edges.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Beak_05.description: A duck-bill mouth piece: a broad, flat, rounded beak that extends forward from the nose and mouth, with small nostril slits on top and thin flared edges at the cheeks. Suggests an animal or monstrous costume.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Beak_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper beak and sides, blending into colour 0 toward the tip and lower bill; colour 2 on the underside and inner edges.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_01.description: A pelican-style beak worn over the mouth and chin: a long pointed upper bill with nostril slits above a deep, pouch-like lower bill that hangs below the jaw. A fantasy animal mask piece.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pouch and sides of the bill; colour 0 on the ridge and tip of the upper bill and the lip edge.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_02.description: A bird-of-prey beak worn over the nose and mouth: a hooked upper beak ridged down the centre and tapering to a sharp downward point, with a separate lower mandible beneath. Small nostril holes mark the sides.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 1 on the lower mandible and the edges of the beak.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_03.description: A long, pointed stork-like beak worn over the nose and mouth, with a smooth curved upper bill, small nostril holes and a separate thin lower mandible panel tucked beneath. It gives a bird-headed, creature look.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper bill; colour 1 on the lower mandible and the thin edge flaps.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_03.differs: The lower mandible on the male version sits shallower and flatter against the jaw, with a shorter, thinner underside than the female one.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_04.description: A hooked owl-style beak that covers the nose and mouth: a rounded upper mandible curving to a point, a smaller separate lower mandible beneath, and small nostril holes. Suggests a bird or beast-person face.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 1 on the lower mandible and underside edges of the beak.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_05.description: A flat, broad duck-bill beak that covers the nose and mouth and projects forward. It has small nostril slits near the top, a rounded tip and a smooth, slightly wrinkled surface, with flared edges at the cheeks. Suggests a cute animal or creature look.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Beak_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper bill and nostril area; colour 0 on the lower bill and tip, with a smooth gradient between them. Colour 2 on the underside.

Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Krampus_01.description: A long monstrous tongue that hangs out of the mouth and down over the chin and neck, curling out at the lips and tapering to a curved tip. A partial head piece with a beastly, festive-demon feel.
Male/M_Head_Mouth_Child_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lip rim and the tip; colour 1 on the main body of the tongue; colour 2 on the upper top surface; colour 3 on the small marking patch.

Male/M_Head_Nightmareinvasion_01.description: A bare, hairless male head with a stern brow and painted face markings: curved crescent slashes and a central pair of swept strokes across the forehead, plus thin streaks running down beneath each eye.
Male/M_Head_Nightmareinvasion_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the curved crescent marks above the brows; colour 1 on the central forehead strokes; colour 0 on the eye-liner streaks and the teardrop streaks under the eyes; skin uses the default skin tone.

Male/M_Head_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.description: A bare, hairless head with smooth, sculpted features, a strong brow and angular jaw, and no markings, hair or accessories. It replaces the default head and sits on the neck.
Male/M_Head_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head surface; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Head_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.differs: The male head has no face paint markings, and its skin takes the light colour slot rather than a fixed skin tone.

Male/M_Head_None.description: A small rounded cap-shaped plug that fills the neck opening at the base of the neck, with a thin raised rim. It is a head-type placeholder that leaves the head bare.

Male/M_Head_None_01.description: A shallow neck-plug: a rounded, angular cup with a raised rim that fills the neck opening at the top of the torso, with a small ball sitting in the middle. Gives a headless look.
Male/M_Head_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole neck cup, including the rim and the central ball.
Male/M_Head_None_01.differs: The male version has a raised rim around the cap and a small ball in the centre, while the female version is a plain flat cap.

Male/M_Head_Qularr_01.description: A full insect head replacement with a broad, angular carapace that sweeps out into pointed wings over the crown, large round eyes, small ridged mandible parts, thin antennae and two long curved fangs hanging beside the jaw.
Male/M_Head_Qularr_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the carapace and face plates; colour 1 on the spots across the shell and on the fang tips; colour 2 on the eyes and antennae; colour 3 on the fang bases.

Male/M_Head_Qularrhead_01_Fixed.description: A full alien insectoid head replacing the wearer's own: a wide, swept-back pointed crest over a rounded face with bulging eyes, spotted plating, curved mandible fangs, small bristly antennae and side nodules; back is ridged and segmented.
Male/M_Head_Qularrhead_01_Fixed.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest, head shell and back ridges; colour 1 on the spots, eyes, mouth and mandible tips; colour 3 on the side nodules and inner mouth; colour 2 on the shading and crevices.

Male/M_Head_Robot_Steampunk_01.description: A full robotic head covering with a smooth domed cranium, large round bulbous eye lenses, a snout-like breathing mask with side canisters, small side antenna studs, and a flared high neck collar that sits over the shoulders.
Male/M_Head_Robot_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, plating and canisters; colour 1 on the stripes, eye housings, mask and neck collar; colour 3 on the eye lenses and antenna tips.
Male/M_Head_Robot_Steampunk_01.differs: The male stripes on the cranium are broader and the collar is wider and flares out further over the shoulders.

Male/M_Head_Scarab_01.description: A full insect-like helmet with a flared bell-shaped rear rim, angular eye lenses and a contrasting toothy mouth grille. A tall curved central spine rises from the crown and forks into two backward-curving horns.
Male/M_Head_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and spine; colour 3 on the eye lenses; colour 2 on the horn tips and mouth grille; colour 1 on the neck collar beneath the helmet.

Male/M_Head_Scarab_02.description: A full-coverage insect-like helmet with angular layered plates, narrow slanted eye openings and a pointed lower face guard. Two tall segmented horns curve upward from the temples, and a neck collar sits below.
Male/M_Head_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and horn bases; colour 1 on the lower horn segments and neck collar; colour 2 on the middle horn segments and mouth area; colour 3 on the eye lenses and horn tips.

Male/M_Head_Serpent_01.description: A full reptilian head with a long tapered snout, wide toothy jaw, side-set eyes and a scaled plated crown with a segmented pattern that runs down the back of the head to the neck.
Male/M_Head_Serpent_01.colourAreas: The textured skin ignores the colour scheme and keeps its own fixed tones; the eyes, teeth, scale plates and jaw markings are all baked into the texture.

Male/M_Head_Serpent_02.description: A full reptilian serpent head with a long tapered snout, wide toothy mouth, small side-set eyes and short spikes above the brows and along the jaw. Scaly plating runs over the crown and down the back of the head.
Male/M_Head_Serpent_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled crown and back-of-head plates; colour 3 on the skin of the face and snout; colour 2 on the jaw and mouth scales and the spikes; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Bear_02.description: A full-head bear skull replacing the head: long tapered snout, flared cheek arches, open jaw with pointed fangs, and an exposed vertebral spine running down the back to a flat collar plate at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Bear_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, jaw and collar plate; colour 1 on the spine vertebrae; colour 3 on the fangs; colour 2 on the back teeth.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Crocodile_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a crocodile skull: a long toothed snout, hollow eye sockets and flared bony ridges at the back, perched on an exposed vertebrae neck with a small collar plate.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Crocodile_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, jaw and teeth; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae; the small neck plate takes colour 0.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Deer_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a deer skull with a long snout, eye sockets and a pair of large branching antlers, resting on an exposed segmented spine that forms the neck. Bestial, macabre fantasy look.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Deer_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 3 on the antlers; colour 1 on the exposed neck vertebrae.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Horse_02.description: A full-head horse skull replacing the head: long tapered muzzle with nostril holes, visible teeth line and eye sockets, and a row of vertebra-like spikes running down the back of the skull to a thin collar plate at the neck.
