Male/M_Head_Skull_Horse_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and neck collar plate; colour 1 on the row of spinal spikes down the back.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Hyena_02.description: A full hyena skull head replacing the head: long muzzle, open jaw with rows of small teeth and large fangs, flared cheekbone arches, and a segmented vertebra column at the back resting on a broad flat collar plate.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Hyena_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, jaw and collar plate; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae and a patch inside the mouth; colour 3 on the small teeth; colour 2 on the large fangs.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Hyena_02.differs: The male version has a wider, flatter collar plate under the neck, and its colour 1 shows as a small patch inside the mouth instead of down the throat.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Lizard_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a lizard skull, with hollow eye sockets, a toothy jaw and bony spikes radiating around the crown and cheeks. A short ringed vertebrae-like neck column supports it.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Lizard_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, spikes and jaw; colour 1 on the ringed neck vertebrae.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Lizard_02.differs: The male version adds a flat curved plate under the neck column, like a collar base, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Raptor_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a raptor dinosaur skull: long open-boned snout, large eye and skull-side openings, rows of sharp teeth, and an exposed vertebral spine at the neck above a wide flat collar plate.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Raptor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, jaw and collar plate; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae; teeth appear and follow no visible slot.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Raptor_02.differs: The male collar plate is wider and more prominent, and the jaw hangs a little more open, than on the female version.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Rat_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a rodent skull, with long buck teeth, hollow eye sockets, flared cheek arches and a separate lower jaw, sitting on an exposed vertebrae neck with a wide flat collar plate at the base.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Rat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, jaw and collar plate; colour 1 on the spine vertebrae of the neck; colour 2 on the tips of the teeth and the hollows inside the skull.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Rat_02.differs: The male version has a wide, prominent flat collar plate spread beneath the jaw and a shorter exposed neck.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Skeleton_02.description: A full skeleton-skull head replacing the face: rounded cranium, hollow eye sockets, exposed teeth with a jagged grin, a separate jaw and a short visible spine column at the neck, with a flat collar ring at the base.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull bone; colour 1 on the eye sockets and shading in the bone hollows; colour 3 on the teeth; colour 2 on the neck collar ring.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Tiger_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a tiger skull, with a long muzzle, open eye sockets, flared cheek arches and bared fangs. An exposed spine of vertebrae runs down the back into the neck.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Tiger_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and jaw bone; colour 1 on the vertebrae of the neck; colour 3 on the fangs and inside the mouth.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Tiger_02.differs: The male version adds a broad flat collar-like bone plate under the neck, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Head_Skull_Wolf_02.description: A full replacement head shaped like a wolf skull with an elongated snout, open jaw with sharp fangs, small ridges and flared bone plates at the back, and an exposed vertebrae neck resting on a broad flat collar plate.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull bone and collar plate; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae; colour 3 on the eye sockets and nose area; colour 2 on the teeth.
Male/M_Head_Skull_Wolf_02.differs: The male version has a wider, flat collar plate under the neck, sitting over the shoulders.

Male/M_Head_Sockpuppet_01.description: A whimsical sock-puppet head: a knit tube that covers the whole head and neck, with a long beaked snout and open mouth, button eyes, yarn-like tufts on top, and a rolled contrasting trim at the neck opening.
Male/M_Head_Sockpuppet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the knit body, snout and yarn tufts; colour 1 on the neck-edge trim, the eye patch and the ribbon-like bands on top of the head.

Male/M_Head_Steelcommando_01.description: A full-coverage retro helmet with a smooth rounded shell and raised seam lines, a wide T-shaped visor opening with a recessed face plate, and a broad layered metal neck guard that flares over the shoulders.
Male/M_Head_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the helmet shell and face plate; colour 0 on the neck guard; colour 2 on the recessed side panels and visor surround.
Male/M_Head_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male neck guard is wider and flares out at the back into a broad, segmented plate.

Male/M_Head_Teddy_02.description: A full-head plush teddy bear mask: a rounded, quilted-texture head with two round ears edged in zigzag stitching, a raised snout with a small triangular nose and two bead eyes. It encloses the whole head.
Male/M_Head_Teddy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head and outer ears; colour 1 on the snout and inner ears; colour 3 on the eyes and nose; colour 2 on the stitching.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Angel_Face_Full_02.description: A hollow, sculpted full-face mask with a smooth humanlike face, deep eye sockets, a sharp nose and closed lips. It wraps the face from forehead to chin, with an open back and a rim that sits along the sides of the head.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Angel_Face_Full_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face surface; colour 1 on the shading around the eyes and lips and on the inner rim edge at the back.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.description: A full bear-head covering with a snarling muzzle, bared teeth, small rounded ears and a shaggy fur mane that drapes down the back of the head and neck to the shoulders, giving a feral monstrous look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head and mane; colour 3 on the patches around the eyes and brow and the inner ears; colour 2 on the nose; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Bear_03.description: A full bear head covering with a rounded muzzle, contrasting nose, small round ears and layered shaggy fur tufts that fall in jagged points around the neck and down the back of the head.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Bear_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shaggy fur and ears; colour 1 on the fur across the forehead, brow and muzzle; colour 2 on the nose.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Boar_01.description: A full boar head that covers the whole head and neck, with a blunt snout, upright pointed ears, small eyes and long curved tusks at the mouth. Spotted skin texture and neck ridges give it a monstrous, beastly look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tusks; colour 1 on the nostrils and eyes; colour 2 on the spots across the skin; colour 3 appears to have little or no visible use; the skin base tone comes from the default material.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_01.description: A full feline head covering with a sculpted cat face, pointed ears, snarling muzzle with long sabre fangs, and swept-back spiky whisker fins on each cheek. It fits tightly over the whole head, suiting beast or monstrous characters.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head and fur surfaces and cheek spikes; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 3 on the nose; the inner ears, fangs and mouth appear to keep fixed shading.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_02.description: A full tiger head covering that replaces the human head: a snarling feline face with rounded ears, fur tufts at the cheeks, contrasting whiskers, bared teeth and a striped pattern running over the crown and down the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Cat_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the nose bridge, crown, back of the head and neck; colour 1 on the cheeks, muzzle, ears and inner face; colour 2 on the stripes and eyes; colour 0 on the whiskers and teeth.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Tiger_01.description: A set of bestial tiger-like teeth: rows of sharp conical fangs and teeth across the mouth, with two tall thick tusks at the corners. It sits over the lips and gives a monstrous, feral look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Tiger_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and fangs; the other colour slots are not clearly visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Werewolf_0.description: A pair of tall, pointed ear-like horns that rise from the sides of the head and curve slightly inward, with a flared, angular base and a separate inner panel. Beastly werewolf styling.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Werewolf_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of each horn; colour 3 on the inner panel of each horn.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Wolf_02.description: A monstrous wolf-like jaw overlay: thin angular upper and lower jaw plates framing the mouth, lined with rows of long jagged fangs that flare outward and back along the cheeks, giving a snarling, ferocious look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Child_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jaw plates; colour 1 on the fangs; colour 2 on the inner mouth panel.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Chimera_02.description: A bird-headed full head covering resembling a raptor or vulture: smooth, wrinkled skin-like surface with brow ridges, small eyes and a long hooked beak. It fits tight over the whole head and neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head skin; colour 0 on the beak; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_01.description: A monstrous full-head replacement: a skull-like face with cracked, vein-networked skin, a jagged tusked jaw with long fangs, and a crest of rough spiky plates sweeping back over the crown and skull.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cracked face and head skin; colour 3 on the vein-like crack lines; colour 1 on the spiky crest plates and small tooth-like accents around the mouth.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_01.differs: The male version has a broader head with longer, more prominent jaw tusks and a lower crest.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_02.description: A tight, full-head monstrous helm-like head type with a smooth swept-back crest, a pointed beak-like snout with small eye holes, and a cracked, cobbled plated skin covering the sides, back and neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Colossus_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the smooth crest and upper head shell; colour 0 on the cobbled plates of the face sides, beak and neck; colour 3 on the crack lines between plates.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Horse_01.description: A full horse-head covering with a long muzzle, flared nostrils, upright pointed ears and a shaggy mane that runs from the forehead down the back of the neck in ragged tufted strands. Sits over the whole head.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the head skin and ears; colour 0 on the muzzle, forelock and the light streaks of the mane; colour 1 on the blaze stripe and the mane's lower sections; colour 2 on the mane tips and eyes.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Lycan_01.description: A full werewolf head replacing the human head: a long canine snout with a snarling open mouth and bared fangs, tall pointed upright ears, sculpted brow ridges, and a smooth skin-like surface that extends down the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth; colour 1 on the eyes; the fur-like skin surface and inner ears do not take the scheme colours and show a fixed skin tone.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Otter_01.description: A full otter head that covers the whole head and neck: a rounded furry skull, small rounded ears, a broad muzzle with a bulbous nose, long thin whiskers and expressive eyes. Its textured fur gives it a realistic, animal look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Otter_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fur of the head and neck; colour 1 on the nose and the eyelid areas; colour 0 on the whiskers; colour 2 on the darker fur patches around the cheeks and muzzle.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Rat_01.description: A full rat head replacing the wearer's own: a tapering snout with a rounded nose, whiskers, bared teeth, a furrowed brow, and two rounded upright ears. Skin-like texture with a fur-like finish; it covers the whole head down to the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Rat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head and ear surfaces; colour 3 on the nose and brow areas; colour 1 on the eyes; the teeth and inner mouth keep fixed default shading.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Salamander_01.description: A full salamander-like head covering with a smooth, rounded snout, side-set eyes, and mottled patterning. Swept-back finned frills sit above the head, with thin whisker-like spines along the cheeks and a short neck collar.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Salamander_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main skin of the head and neck; colour 2 on the mottled stripe markings along the face and back; colour 0 on the upper fin membranes; colour 1 on the lower fin frills.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Greatwhite.description: A full replacement head shaped like a great contrasting shark: a tapering snout, small side-set eyes, gill-like creases along the cheeks and a toothy underslung mouth, with a smooth skin-like surface that sits directly on the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Greatwhite.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and snout; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the mouth interior and gill-crease shading; the teeth show a fixed shade.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Hammerhead.description: A full hammerhead shark head: a tall swept-back dorsal fin rises over the crown, a wide T-shaped crossbar extends sideways with an eye at each tip, and a toothy mouth sits below on the face.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Hammerhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin-like head and crossbar; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 0 and colour 2 on the teeth and mouth area.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Reef_01.description: A full shark-head replacement with a tapering hammer-like snout, a swept-back dorsal fin crest, small round eyes, gill-like creases and a wide toothy jaw with a separate lower panel. Monstrous aquatic look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Shark_Reef_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and fin; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the jaw and mouth interior; teeth show detail that does not follow the scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Skull_Bird_01.description: A full head replacement shaped like a bird skull with a long, pointed, slightly downcurved beak, hollow eye sockets, and a rounded cranium. A short vertebrae neck stub rests on a flat collar-like plate at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Skull_Bird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, beak and neck plate; colour 3 on the inside of the eye sockets; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Skull_Cat_01.description: A full head replacement shaped like a feline skull, with wide cheek arches, hollow eye sockets, a short muzzle and prominent fangs. A short exposed spine stub and a flat collar plate sit at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Skull_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull bone and neck plate; colour 1 on the neck vertebrae; colour 3 on the fangs and gum area.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Squid_01.description: A tight, full-head cephalopod mask: a smooth domed cranium with ridged brow and a face of long tentacles hanging over the chin, with shorter tentacles flaring at the sides and back of the neck. Suggests an eldritch horror.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Squid_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main head shell and tentacles; colour 0 on the ridged facial markings and tentacle undersides; colour 1 on the neck collar ring beneath the head.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Stag_01.description: A full animal head with a long tapering muzzle, furrowed brow, bared teeth and two upright pointed ears with inner ear detail. It replaces the head and continues down the neck, for a monstrous beast look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Stag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head skin and outer ears; colour 3 on the brow, cheeks, muzzle and neck; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the nose.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Vulture_01.description: A full vulture head replacing the wearer's own: a wrinkled, rounded skull with heavy brows, round side-set eyes and a large hooked, open beak, ending in a short neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Vulture_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrinkled head and neck skin; colour 2 on the hooked beak; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Werewolf_01.description: A full werewolf head with a long tapered snout, tall pointed ears and a thick shaggy fur ruff spilling over the neck and shoulders. Jagged teeth line the muzzle, and contrasting fur markings surround the eyes.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head and outer ears; colour 2 on the muzzle, eye markings and fur tips; colour 1 on the nose and lower jaw fur; colour 3 on the inner ears and jaw edging.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Werewolf_01.differs: The male head has contrasting fur markings around the eyes, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Whiterhino_02.description: A full rhino head replacing the wearer's own: a wrinkled, heavy-jawed snout with a bared-teeth snarl, small side ears, and two horns, a large one rising from the nose and a smaller one behind it. Ridged folds wrap the back of the skull.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Whiterhino_02.colourAreas: The skin-toned head, ears and neck folds ignore the scheme and show a fixed flesh tone; colour 1 on the horns, fading toward the base.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.description: A full wolf head with a long tapered snout, pointed upright ears with inner ear lining, and a shaggy mane of jagged fur locks falling to the neck and shoulders. The mouth is snarling, with bared teeth.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head, ears and mane; colour 2 on the darkened mane tips and nose; the muzzle skin, inner ears and teeth take their own fixed tones.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_01.differs: The male wolf has a fiercer snarling mouth with bared teeth and a wilder, more jagged mane.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.description: A full wolf head replacing the human head, with a long snout, open snarling mouth full of teeth, angry brow and tall pointed ears. Long shaggy fur locks fall past the jaw and over the back of the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head fur and mane; colour 2 on the darker tips of the mane locks; colour 3 on the inner ears and muzzle skin; colour 1 on the nose and eyes.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_02.differs: The male has a wide open, toothy mouth and a longer, fuller mane that hangs further down the back, plus small contrasting ornaments beside the jaw.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Alt_01.description: A full wolf head replacing the face: tall pointed ears, a long tapered snout with a nose tip, a snarling toothed mouth, and a long shaggy mane of jagged tufts falling past the jaw and down the back.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head and ears; colour 1 on the nose and teeth accents; colour 2 on the darker tips of the mane; colour 3 on the inner ears and snout skin.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Alt_01.differs: The male mane is longer and more ragged, with jagged tufts hanging lower over the shoulders and a more prominent snarl showing teeth.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_01.description: A wolf head replacing the wearer's own: short snarling snout with bared teeth, tall upright ears, and a shaggy mane of jagged tapering fur locks that hangs past the neck to the shoulders.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the head, ears and mane; colour 2 on the darker tips of the mane and the nose; the inner ears and muzzle skin are unaffected by the scheme.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_01.differs: The male wolf has a shorter, snarling muzzle with bared teeth, a heavier brow and a fuller, shaggier mane.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_02.description: A full wolf head with a snarling open mouth, bared teeth, pointed upright ears with inner lining, and a shaggy mane of jagged fur tufts falling past the neck to the shoulders. Fits tightly over the whole head.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Beast_Wolf_Bubble_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur and outer ears; colour 2 on the darker tips of the fur tufts and the nose; colour 3 on the inner ears, muzzle skin and mouth; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Bucket_01.description: A full robotic head shell shaped like a rounded bucket, with two protruding lens sockets for eyes, a thin seam for a mouth, valve-wheel knobs on each side and a ring of piston-like rods at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Bucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and top panel; colour 1 on the side valve wheels and small eye details; colour 3 on the mouth seam and one eye lens; colour 2 on the neck rods and base.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Bucket_01.differs: The neck has an open hoop with spaced rods hanging from the shell, rather than the solid flanged collar ring on the female.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Camera_01_1.description: A full-head novelty helmet shaped like a vintage film camera: a boxy body with a front lens barrel and square lens hood, twin film reels on top, a side hand crank, and a small collar mount at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Camera_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the camera body, lens hood and reel hubs; colour 1 on the lens ring, crank and side panel details; colour 2 on the film reels; colour 3 on the lens glass and top dome.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Camera_03.description: A novelty head replacement shaped like a shoulder-mounted broadcast video camera: boxy body with a protruding lens barrel at the front, top handle and viewfinder, riveted panels, sitting on a small collar mount at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Camera_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar mount, lens rim and edge framing; colour 1 on the main camera body and handle; colour 2 on the side panels and rear block; colour 3 on the lens barrel bands and small top accents.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Boar_01.description: A pair of curved boar-like tusks that meet under the chin and sweep up along both sides of the face, ending in sharp points beside the cheeks. Suits beastly or monstrous characters.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Boar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tusk pair; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Cat_02.description: A set of thin, curved cat whiskers fanning out in two clusters from either side of the muzzle area, each with several slender tapered strands. A cute animal-style face accessory that leaves the rest of the head bare.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Cat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the whisker strands; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Kitty_02.description: A set of thin, curved cat whiskers fanning out in two clusters from either side of the upper lip and muzzle area. Slender and delicate, they add a playful feline touch to the face.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Kitty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Kitty_03.description: A pair of thin, curved cat whiskers fanning out from either side of the upper lip, three or four fine strands per side sweeping outward and slightly downward. A cute animal face accessory.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Kitty_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the whisker strands; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Kitty_04.description: A small set of thin, curved cat whiskers: three slender strands fan out from each side of the upper lip and muzzle. They are a tiny cute animal accent with no other headwear or face covering.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Kitty_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whisker strands, with slight darker tips that look like colour 2; no other visible features use the colour slots.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Otter_01.description: A pair of thin, curved whisker clusters that fan out from either side of the nose and upper lip, each with several fine crossing strands. Only the whiskers are added; the head and face are unchanged.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Otter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Rabbit_01.description: Two sets of thin, curved whisker strands that fan outward from either side of the muzzle area of the face, like a rabbit's or cat's whiskers. It is a small animal-style face accessory with no other head covering.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Beast_Rabbit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whisker strands; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Camera_02.description: A small cylindrical spotlight lamp perched on top of the head, its round lens facing forward, held by a thin strap under the chin area and trailing a few cables from the rear.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Camera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lamp housing and rim; colour 3 on the front lens; colour 2 on the strap; colour 1 on the cables at the back.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Side_Camera_02.description: A novelty head attachment of two film reels mounted side by side on a bracket at one side of the head, with a strip of film looped between them and a hand crank sticking out on the opposite side.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Child_Side_Camera_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the reel discs; colour 0 on the film strip between the reels; colour 1 on the hand crank and the axle pins.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: A full-head robotic face shell with smooth sculpted features, blank eye openings, hexagonal plates on the brow and both temples, and a hollow back. A neck collar ring sits below the chin.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the face shell and hexagonal plates; colour 0 on the collar ring and the trim around the plates; colour 2 on the chin vent and the inner neck lining.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Cosmic_02.description: A close-fitting face mask that follows the features of the face from brow to chin, with hexagonal plates on the forehead and both temples and angular jaw segments. Suggests a sci-fi or robotic helmet.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main face shell; colour 0 on the borders around the hexagonal plates; colour 2 on the jaw and chin segments.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A full bald head type styled as a cybernetic face: a smooth skull with a sharply divided lower-face plate over the nose, cheeks and mouth, a band across the eyes with contrasting eye slits, and thin seam lines at the cheeks.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head and scalp; colour 1 on the lower-face plate; colour 2 on the eye band; colour 3 on the thin cheek seam accents.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Djmadbot_01.description: A cartoonish retro-robot head: a rounded cube covering the whole head, with spiral-pattern round eyes, a small triangular nose, a grille-like toothed mouth, and a stacked round button or beacon on top.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Djmadbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cube head; colour 0 on the eye rims, nose and mouth grille; colour 2 on the eye spirals; colour 3 on the top beacon and the neck piece.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Domeemperyan_01.description: A smooth, egg-shaped full helmet that covers the whole head with no openings, decorated with etched circuit-like panel lines, raised plates across the face and a domed crown. It reads as a sleek sci-fi tech helmet.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Domeemperyan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 3 on the domed crown, face panels and thin outline stripes; colour 1 on the small bracket marks and ring.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Domeemperyan_01_1.description: A smooth, egg-shaped full-head mask with a painted toy-soldier face: arched brows, round eyes, a curled moustache and a segmented grille mouth. A separate cap panel covers the crown and back of the head.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Domeemperyan_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face and lower back of the head; colour 1 on the top cap, brows and moustache; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth grille lines; colour 2 on the pupils and mouth interior.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Exartdecofull_01.description: A smooth, full-coverage helmet with a rounded egg-shaped shell, a central panel running front to back, and two thin eye slits with a vertical seam down the face. Side and rear panels wrap the head, with a flared band at the base of the skull.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Exartdecofull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central face and crown panel; colour 1 on the side and rear panels and neck band; colour 2 on the seam lines and eye slits. The neck area is the mannequin's own neck, not part of the piece.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face4partialmask_01.description: A close-fitting luchador-style cloth hood covering the whole head and ending at the neck, with stitched seams over the crown and back. Raised contrasting borders outline the eye holes, nose and mouth opening.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face4partialmask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the mask; colour 1 on the raised borders around the eyes, nose and mouth openings.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face4partialmask_02.description: A close-fitting cloth luchador-style hood that covers the whole head and stops at the neck. It has open eye and mouth holes with raised contrasting borders, a stitched seam along the crown, and a gathered hem at the back.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face4partialmask_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the hood; colour 1 on the raised borders around the eyes, nose and mouth openings.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_01_Basicface.description: A bare humanoid head with a smooth bald scalp, angular jaw, heavy brow, defined nose and lips, and detailed eyes and ears. A realistic, plain base face that sits on the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_01_Basicface.colourAreas: Skin tone is not driven by the colour slots; the whole head, eyes and ears keep their default skin appearance.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_01_Basicface_1.description: A bald, bare head type with a full face and ears, covered in bold flowing line tattoos: swirling spirals over the temples and crown, lines running down the cheeks, and marks on the chin and down the back of the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_01_Basicface_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and face; colour 3 on the tattoo lines and swirls.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Anniversary_Ironc.description: A bald, smooth head type with a stern, angular face, pointed ears and three raised curved ridges across the brow. It covers the whole head and neck as skin, with no hair.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Anniversary_Ironc.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skin of the whole head and neck; colour 1 on the brow ridges.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Anniversary_Ironc.differs: The male head has a matte, brighter skin finish with plain lips and eyes, and the brow ridges stand out more clearly.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Big_Mouth_01.description: A monstrous head covering with skin-like texture, veined markings across the scalp and a huge vertical maw stretched down the face, filled with rows of sharp fangs; the jaw is banded with contrasting stripes.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Big_Mouth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin-like head surface; colour 1 on the stripes along the jaw; colour 2 on the vein markings and mouth interior; the teeth ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Birdpeople_01.description: A full bird-head covering with layered feather plumage over the face, neck and back of the head, a spiky feather crest, a curved beak, and a smooth helmet-like faceplate with a rimmed edge over the brow.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the feathers; colour 0 on the smooth faceplate and beak; colour 2 on the rim around the faceplate.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Classic_Tights_01.description: A skin-tight head covering that wraps the whole scalp and forehead like a smooth hood, with cut-outs around the eyes, nose and mouth. Swirling scroll-like decorative markings curl across the brow, giving a masked superhero look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Classic_Tights_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head covering; colour 1 on the swirling scroll markings across the forehead and brow.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Classic_Tights_02.description: A skin-tight head covering that fits like a painted-on mask, leaving the eyes, nose and mouth open. Bold curved stripes run over the crown and down the face and back of the head, in a wrestler-style superhero look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Classic_Tights_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap and face covering; colour 1 on the curved stripe along the side of the head, the nose bridge and the small forehead patches; colour 2 on the stripes over the head, cheeks and back.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Classic_Tights_03.description: A smooth, skin-tight head covering that hugs the whole head and neck, with raised web-like lines branching over the forehead and cheeks and down the nose, plus a small patterned band at the neck. Eyes are left open with a coloured surround.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Classic_Tights_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head covering; colour 1 on the raised web lines; colour 3 on the patches around the eyes; colour 2 on the neck pattern.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Classic_Tights_04.description: A skin-tight head covering that hugs the skull and neck, leaving the eyes, nose and mouth open. Bold painted stripes run across the brow and cheeks, with three thin lines rising over the forehead, for a simple superhero look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Classic_Tights_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head covering; colour 1 on the three forehead lines; colour 2 on the brow chevron and the cheek-and-nose band.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Clockwork_Armor_0.description: A tight, full-coverage robotic helmet with a contrasting smooth face panel, angular blocky cheek plates, and swept fin-like crests along the top and rear. Segmented neck section extends down to the collar.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Clockwork_Armor_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top shell, crests and back of the head; colour 1 on the cheek plates, side blocks and neck; colour 2 on the face panel and lower neck; colour 3 on the small top-side accent panels.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Clockwork_Armor_0.differs: The male helmet has a contrasting front panel covering the face, with a solid light back shell, while the female version has a light faceplate with a stripe and a contrasting open panel at the back.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Cosmic_01.description: A close-fitting superhero head covering that wraps the whole skull and neck, with a glossy face panel around the eyes and nose, angular outlined trim, a hexagonal emblem on the forehead and a band across the back of the head. The mouth and chin stay open.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, back of the head and outline trim; colour 1 on the forehead, cheek and neck panels; colour 2 on the face panel and the band around the head; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Cyborg_01.description: A full-head cyborg face and skull piece: a smooth, mask-like faceplate with faint eye and mouth lines, a segmented cranial shell with panel seams, and a contrasting band wrapping the back of the head above a tight neck sleeve.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Cyborg_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceplate; colour 0 on the side and back head panels and neck; colour 2 on the crown plate and the band at the back of the head.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Cyborg_02.description: A bald head type with half the face replaced by a mechanical cyborg plate: exposed eye socket, segmented jaw and cheek panels, with thin seam lines running across the scalp and down the back of the head.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Cyborg_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mechanical face plates; colour 1 on the glowing strip at the mouth; colour 2 on the eye socket and gaps; the skin half ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Deity_01.description: A skin-tight head covering that wraps the whole skull and neck like a hood, leaving the eyes, nose and mouth bare, with a thin outlined edge cut across the cheeks. Smooth, seamless superhero look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole head covering; the thin outline along the cheek edge takes colour 2.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Edgy_01.description: A skin-tight face covering fitted to the head, leaving the scalp bare. A diagonal edge crosses one eye down to the jaw, with bordering stripes and a separate contrasting band under the chin, giving an edgy masked look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Edgy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main face panel; colour 1 on the inner border stripes; colour 0 on the outer outline and chin band.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Edgy_01.differs: The main face panel is the near-contrasting colour (colour 2) with a light outline, whereas the female has a light main panel with contrasting edging.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Holoforce_01.description: A tight, full-head hood that covers the scalp, neck and lower face, with a wide contrasting visor-like band across the eyes and small contrasting eye slits. Ears stay exposed, and a small patch sits at the chin, giving a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, back of the head and neck edges; colour 1 on the forehead, cheek and neck panels; colour 2 on the wide eye band; colour 3 on the chin patch and the neck stripe.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Irradiate_Zombie_.description: A bald head-type skin with a zombie face: sunken blackened eye sockets, a decayed streaky jaw and mouth area, and rough scarring along the cheeks and jaw. Smooth bare scalp, ears and neck; a gruesome undead look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Irradiate_Zombie_.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to tint the skin of the head and neck; the decay markings around the eyes, jaw and cheeks are fixed texture detail and do not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Irradiate_Zombie_.description: A bald zombie head with decayed, sunken features: hollow blackened eye sockets, a rotting jaw with exposed teeth, and contrasting necrotic streaks running across the cheeks. The back and top of the head are smooth skin.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Irradiate_Zombie_.colourAreas: Colour slots don't visibly affect this piece; the skin and the decay markings keep their own fixed shading.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Kigatilik_01.description: A bald, bare-skinned head with tribal-style painted markings: a pointed diamond-shaped mark on the forehead, curved brow lines around the eyes, slashes down the cheeks and a set of parallel bars at each temple.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Kigatilik_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brow swirls and cheek slashes; colour 2 on the forehead diamond and temple bars; the skin itself is not part of the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Krampus_01.description: A full-head monstrous Krampus face covering: a smooth skull cap with a brow ridge, glowing narrow eyes, a wide toothy grin over the lower face, pointed ears and short curved horns tipped with contrasting points.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the head and horn tips; colour 1 on the brow, forehead and pointed ears; colour 2 on the lower face, mouth and horn bases; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Krampus_02.description: A monstrous Krampus head covering the whole head and upper neck: smooth domed skull, curved horns swept out at the sides, glaring eyes and a snouted open mouth with fangs and a lolling tongue, ending in a ragged collar-like fringe.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Krampus_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, back of the head and horns; colour 1 on the face sides, cheeks and neck fringe; colour 2 on the snout, mouth interior and inner neck; colour 3 on the eyes and a patch of the neck fringe.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Lycan_03.description: A bare, hairless head sculpt with a heavy brow, deep creased cheeks, a broad flat nose and slightly pointed ears, giving a gruff, feral werewolf-like look without fur. Covers the whole head and neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Lycan_03.colourAreas: The whole head is skin and ignores the colour scheme; no colour slots are visibly used.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Noear_01.description: A bare humanoid head with a smooth, hairless scalp, a strong brow, angular jaw and a defined nose, with no ears at all. It covers the whole head and neck as a plain base face.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Noear_01.colourAreas: Colour slots don't visibly change anything; the head and face use a fixed skin shade, and the eyes have their own separate look.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Noseless_01_New.description: A bald humanoid head with a flat, noseless face showing only two slit nostrils, angular brow ridges, contrasting sunken eyes, small ears and a thin-lipped mouth. Suggests an alien or reptilian look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Noseless_01_New.colourAreas: The head is skin-toned and does not take the colour scheme; the eyes have small contrasting highlights that do not appear to follow any colour slot.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Punk_01.description: A bare, bald male head with a stern angular face, defined brow and small ears, ending in a short neck with a thin glossy collar band and contrasting inner lining. Suits a plain, unmasked superhero look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy neck collar band; colour 0 on the inner neck lining; the skin of the face and head does not take a scheme colour.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Reactor_01.description: A bare bald head with skin-textured face and ears, joined to a snug high standing collar that wraps the neck, with a thin contrasting band and a small inner neckline layer. Sleek superhero tights style.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer collar; colour 1 on the inner neck lining at the front; colour 2 on the thin band along the collar. The head skin ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Redbanner_01.description: A bald head type with painted face makeup: a contrasting skull-like mask covering the face and front of the head, contrasting painted eye sockets, small decorative flourishes on the brow and contrasting patches along the jaw.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Redbanner_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the painted face mask; colour 1 on the brow flourishes and jaw patches; colour 2 on the eye sockets; the rest of the head shows bare skin, not part of the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Simian_01.description: A bald ape-like head with a smooth domed skull, heavy brow ridge, flat broad nose, protruding muzzle and thin lips. The face is a separate contrasting tone from the skull, with small ears and a tapered neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Simian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull, brow and neck; the face, ears and lips keep their own skin-like tone, and the eyes show a fixed blue.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Skull_01.description: A full skull head replacing the face: smooth domed cranium, deep eye sockets with glowing rims, exposed teeth and jaw, and a visible spine of stacked vertebrae for the neck, ending at a small skin-toned collar.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and vertebrae; colour 1 on the glowing rims inside the eye sockets; the small orange neckline is skin, not part of the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Skull_02.description: A skull-face head type with a smooth close-cropped cranium, hollow angular eye sockets, a ridged nose cavity and a bared toothed jaw, continuing into a bare neck. Gives the wearer a skeletal, macabre look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone of the face and jaw; colour 2 on the crown of the skull; colour 1 on the eyes and teeth; the neck shows skin.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Valvee_01.description: A close-fitting superhero head covering: a smooth skullcap with a masked eye area, a pointed nose bridge and swept brow flashes, edged by a contrasting band that runs around the head to the nape. Leaves the face, mouth and ears bare.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Valvee_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skullcap; colour 1 on the eye mask, nose bridge and side stripe; colour 2 on the edging band around the head.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_01.description: A monstrous vampire head: bald, smooth skull with large pointed bat-like ears, deep-set eyes with heavy brow ridges, a flattened skull-like nose, and prominent long fangs protruding from the mouth.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_01.colourAreas: The skin ignores the colour scheme and shows its own tone across the head; colour 1 on the inner ears.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_01.differs: The male head has a heavier, more cracked and gaunt face with long protruding fangs and bright inner ears.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_02.description: A monstrous bat-like vampire head with a bald skull, tall pointed ears with ridged inner surfaces, deep-set eyes, a flattened nose and a wide snarling mouth with prominent long fangs.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and ears; colour 1 on the nose; colour 2 around the eyes; the fangs and ridged inner ears use a separate texture that ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_02.differs: The male head has a coloured nose patch, long prominent fangs, and larger, more open ears with paler ridged interiors.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_03.description: A bare-skinned bald head with a gaunt, deeply wrinkled vampire face, heavy brow, sunken cheeks, snarling mouth, and large pointed ears with ridged inner hollows. Monstrous and gothic in feel.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skin of the head and ears; colour 1 on the ridged inner ear hollows; eye whites and eye colour follow the skin and eye texture.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_03.differs: This version has a gaunt, deeply wrinkled face and ridged inner ears in a contrasting colour, while the female has smoother features and plain inner ears.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_01.description: A tight, bald monstrous head covering with a gaunt, wrinkled face: heavy brow, contrasting-rimmed eyes, a flattened pointed nose and long protruding fangs, plus large ribbed bat-like ears. It blends into the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed inner ears; the skin-toned head and face do not follow the colour scheme.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_01.differs: The male version has protruding fangs, heavier wrinkled brows and a rougher face, with contrasting ears.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_02.description: A tight, skin-like monstrous head covering: a smooth bald skull with pointed ear ridges, sunken shadowed eyes, a bat-like nose, creased cheeks and a snarling mouth with long protruding fangs. Fits close to the head and neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the nose and irises; colour 0 on the fangs; the skin-toned surface ignores the colour scheme.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_02.differs: The male version has long visible fangs, a distinctly coloured bat-like nose and pointed ear ridges, while the female has a plainer mouth.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_03.description: A bald, skin-tight monstrous head with a smooth rounded skull, deeply wrinkled and sunken cheeks, a gnarled flattened nose and a grimacing mouth. Suggests a withered vampire or ghoul.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_03.colourAreas: Skin tone follows the default head material and does not take the colour scheme; colour 1 on the eyes.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Vampire_Hood_03.differs: The male head has deeper wrinkles, a more gnarled, flattened nose and heavier, more ravaged cheeks than the smoother female version.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_01.description: A bald, bare-skin head sculpt with a zombie face: deep wrinkles across the brow, sunken glowing eye sockets, and a decayed, blotchy jaw and cheek area around exposed bared teeth. Covers the head and neck only.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_01.colourAreas: The skin ignores the colour scheme and keeps its own skin tone; the decay patches, eyes and teeth also keep fixed default looks.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Halfskull_.description: A bald, skin-toned head with a decayed zombie face: one side is rotted with wrinkled, stained flesh, while the other half of the face and skull is exposed bone with a visible eye socket, cheekbone and bare teeth.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Halfskull_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the exposed skull bone; colour 1 on the ragged edge where flesh meets bone; colour 2 on the stained, decayed patches of flesh. The skin itself ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nohead_02.description: A headless zombie neck stump: a ragged, jagged-edged ring of flesh at the neck with a torn, gory top, and a bare exposed spine with curved rib-like vertebrae rising from the centre.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nohead_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the exposed spine and vertebrae; the flesh ring and the torn top keep their own fixed tones and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nojaw_01.description: A bald zombie head with deeply wrinkled brow, sunken glowing eyes and a ragged, decayed lower face where the jaw is missing, leaving tattered contrasting strands hanging below the mouth.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nojaw_01.colourAreas: Skin tone is fixed and ignores the scheme; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the ragged decayed mouth and jaw strands.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Nojaw_01.differs: The male version has a broader, fuller jaw area with a longer ragged fringe of strands hanging below the mouth.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Partialmas.description: A skin-tight zombie head covering with wrinkled brow ridges, sunken eye sockets and a decayed lower face showing exposed flesh and teeth, with torn patches of rotting skin scattered over the scalp and cheeks.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Face_Zombie_Partialmas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth head covering; the flesh patches, eyes and teeth show fixed texture colours that ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fox_01.description: A full cartoon fox head replacing the wearer's own: a rounded skull with large hollow eye sockets, pointed ears, a short snout with a small nose, a toothy grin, and rows of small leaf-like spikes across the crown and back.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fox_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, face and snout; colour 1 on the lower jaw, chin and the tips of the spikes; colour 2 on the nose and inner ears.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting full helmet that covers the whole head down to the neck, with a separate central crown stripe and a broad face panel over the lower face. Clean, sleek lines suggest a superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 2 on the central crown and back stripe; colour 1 on the lower face panel.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Alien_01.description: A close-fitting full-coverage sci-fi helmet with a smooth domed crown, angular faceted cheek plates, a raised contrasting brow ridge with diamond and round inset lights, a lower face guard, and chevron-banded panels at the back and neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, cheek plates and back chevron bands; colour 1 on the side and neck panels; colour 2 on the brow ridge, centre strip and lower face guard; colour 3 on the diamond and round inset lights.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Dino_01.description: A full-coverage armoured helmet shaped like a dinosaur head, with a long snout, toothed maw, round side eyes, two tall horn spikes on the crown and a segmented neck guard at the back.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Dino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, neck guard and horns; colour 1 on the snout and cheek panels; colour 3 on the teeth and mouth interior; colour 2 on the eye rings.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Holohex_01.description: A close-fitting full helmet with a smooth rounded shell divided into vertical panels, a wide glossy wraparound visor band with side pods over the ears, and a angular faceplate ending in a chin guard. Sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the centre stripe and faceplate; colour 1 on the side shell panels; colour 2 on the visor band and side pods; colour 3 on the small cheek accents.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Symbiote_01.description: A full helmet with a pointed faceplate tapering to a chin point, a segmented crest ridge over the brow, and short winged panels flaring to each side. Angular alien-armor styling with a plated back.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceplate and rear panel; colour 1 on the crest, face frame, side wing tips and ear pods; colour 2 on the top plates and neck section; colour 3 on the eye slits.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelm_Symbiote_01.differs: The male helmet has a contrasting frame around the face and shorter, tighter wings sitting closer to the head.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelmdestroyer_01_1.description: A full-coverage helmet with a smooth rounded dome, a central ridge and raised horizontal ribs across the back and sides. A pointed faceplate with vertical grooves covers the nose and mouth, leaving narrow eye slits.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelmdestroyer_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main helmet shell and faceplate; colour 2 on the raised ridge and rib bands.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelmet_Cyberlord_0.description: A full robotic helmet with a smooth faceplate that has a single glowing eye lens and a vertical centre strip, plus a segmented cracked-panel skull with side discs. Exposed cables and a ringed collar cage run down the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelmet_Cyberlord_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceplate and front crest; colour 0 on the skull panels, neck rings and centre strip; colour 3 on the eye lens and cables; colour 2 in the seams.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelmviper_01.description: A smooth, rounded full-coverage helmet with a large solid face plate that ends in a V-shaped point at the brow. A contrasting stripe runs over the crown, there are small vented panels at the sides, and a trim band circles the base of the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelmviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the central crown stripe; colour 3 on the face plate and the neck band; colour 1 shows only on the mannequin neck, not on the helmet.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelmviper_02.description: A sleek full-face helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a wide central stripe running front to back that ends in two small horn-like points at the rear, a large smooth visor panel and side vents with small light strips.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Fullhelmviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 2 on the central stripe and side panels; colour 3 on the visor panel and the rim around the neck opening; colour 1 on the small side light strips.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A full toad-like head replacing the normal head: a broad, rounded, warty skull with heavy brow ridges, a wide flat mouth line, a baggy throat pouch under the jaw, and small speckled bumps across the top and back.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the skin of the head; colour 0 on the speckled warts; colour 1 on the throat pouch and lower jaw.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Grondling_01.description: A monstrous bald head type with a smooth broad skull, heavy brow ridges, glossy round contrasting eyes and a wide fanged mouth. Small curved hooks project from the jaw at each side. Suits alien or brutish creature characters.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Grondling_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyes; colour 1 on the jaw hooks and inner mouth; the skin-tone head surface does not follow the colour scheme.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Grondling_01.differs: The male head has a heavier, wider jaw and a fuller, more rounded skull.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Horsehead_01.description: A full cartoon horse head that replaces the whole head: a long tapered muzzle with flared nostrils and visible teeth, large round side-set eyes, a stripe down the face, and pointed upright ears. Smooth and rounded, it suggests a novelty mask.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Horsehead_01.colourAreas: The piece is textured, so it mostly ignores the colour scheme; the skin-tone coat, muzzle and ears, face stripe and eyes keep their default appearance.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Horsehead_Eyes_01.description: A pair of small rounded eye-like domes floating at the sides of the head, like a horse's side-set eyes, each with a horizontal band across the middle and a narrow vertical stripe below.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Horsehead_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main dome of each eye; colour 2 on the horizontal band; colour 0 on the rim edge; colour 3 on the small vertical stripe.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Horsehead_Eyes_01.differs: The male eyes sit higher, at the temples above eye level, rather than level with his own eyes.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Human_Robot_Wings_02.description: A small angular forehead plate with two long, flat blade-like wings sweeping up and outward in a V shape from its sides. It sits at the top of the forehead, giving a mechanical helmet-crest look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Human_Robot_Wings_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forehead plate; colour 2 on the two wing blades; colour 3 on the small marks on the plate.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Madjester_01.description: A tight, featureless full-head hood made of patchwork fabric panels joined by heavy contrasting stitching, with star-like stitched burst patches where the eyes would be; it extends down over the neck. Ragdoll or jester-style.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light patches including the face and back panels; colour 1 on the main crown, lower head, neck and one eye burst; colour 3 on the patches on the side and back; colour 2 on the stitching.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Madjester_01.differs: The male hood has a larger contrasting patch on the side and back of the head, a plain neck section without stitching, and bolder, thicker stitches; the patch layout differs from the female.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_01_Basic.description: A smooth, skin-tight full-head mask that covers the whole head and neck, with the nose, brow and cheek shapes sculpted through the fabric and open eye holes; the neck ends in a short collar at the base.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mask and neck; colour 1 on the eye openings.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_04.description: A full-head burlap-style sack mask with a gathered, wrinkled surface, hollow eye sockets, a stitched-open skull-like mouth with jagged teeth, and seam lines with stitch marks across the head. A lumpy cinched band closes it at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sack fabric; colour 3 on the stitches; colour 1 on the neck band; colour 2 on the mouth and nose cavity.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tight.description: A skin-tight full-head mask that covers the whole head and neck, with cut-outs around the eyes and a bare-looking nose and mouth area. Swooping curled brow markings sit across the forehead, giving a classic wrestler or superhero look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tight.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask over the forehead, cheeks and crown; colour 1 on the curled brow markings; colour 3 on the neck, eye surrounds, nose and mouth area.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tight.description: A skin-tight full-head mask covering the whole head and neck, with an abstract painted pattern: curved stripes running over the crown and down the face, a nose-bridge marking, and separate panels around the eyes and mouth.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tight.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the curved side-crown panels and nose-bridge marking; colour 2 on the stripes over the crown and face; colour 3 on the skin-like neck, eye surrounds and mouth area.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tight.description: A smooth, skin-tight full-head mask covering the whole head and neck, with raised web-like line patterns across the forehead and down the nose, outlined eye openings, and a jagged contrasting pattern at the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tight.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask surface; colour 1 on the raised webbing lines; colour 3 on the rims around the eye openings; colour 2 on the jagged neck pattern.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tight.description: A tight full-head mask that follows the skull and neck, with three thin painted strokes over the forehead, a contrasting band across the brow, a second band across the cheeks, and a separate panel over the nose and mouth. Superhero style.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tight.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask and neck; colour 1 on the forehead strokes; colour 2 on the brow and cheek bands; colour 3 on the eye edges and the lower face panel.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Classic_Tight.differs: The male mask has thinner, straight forehead strokes, and the eye surrounds are narrower with a wider lower face panel.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Glow_01.description: A skin-tight full-head hood that leaves the face open, with raised armoured panels on the brow, jaw, cheeks and back of the skull, joined by thin glowing seam lines. Suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fabric hood; colour 1 on the raised brow, cheek, chin and back-of-head panels; colour 3 on the thin seam lines.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Holoforce_01.description: A skin-tight full-head mask that covers the whole head and neck like a smooth hood. A wide band wraps across the eyes with small oval eye openings, and separate panels cover the crown and neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and back of the head; colour 1 on the forehead and neck panels; colour 2 on the eye band; colour 3 on the chin patch and the neck marking.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Holoforce_01.differs: The male mask has a broader contrasting patch at the chin, while the female has a narrow contrasting strip down the front of the neck.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Patternseta_F.description: A skin-tight full-head mask that covers the whole head and dips into a short neck, with flame-shaped eye patches that sweep up and outward toward the temples, edged by a thin contrasting outline.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Maskfull_Patternseta_F.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main hood and neck; colour 0 on the flame-shaped eye patches; colour 1 on the thin outline around the eye patches.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Mechanon_01.description: A full mechanical helmet with a smooth domed crown, a circular emblem ring at the brow, contrasting visor-like openings, and a pointed chin guard. A collar skirt wraps the neck, giving a robotic sci-fi look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, collar skirt and chin guard; colour 1 on the side and crown panels and edge trim; colour 3 on the ring under the brow emblem and the rear and side accent stripes; colour 2 on the visor openings and mouth area.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A full-coverage robotic helmet that encloses the whole head, with a smooth faceplate, a large round central lens, small round sensor discs, a chin guard, a mic boom at the jaw and segmented back plating. Mechanical, sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back and side plates and the neck collar; colour 1 on the main faceplate, crown and chin; colour 2 on the crown stripe and lens rims; colour 3 on the brow chevron and the rear neck panels.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Microphone_01.description: A full-head helmet shaped like a vintage broadcast microphone: a rounded, slotted metal grille encloses the head, held in a rectangular yoke under an arched "WFOX" sign, and it sits on a slim neck stem with cables.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Microphone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the grille and mesh body; colour 1 on the yoke frame and sign rim; colour 2 on the sign panel, inner backing and neck base; colour 3 on the sign lettering.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Monster_01.description: A monstrous bald head with a smooth, heavy brow, small contrasting eye pits and a wide mouth lined with long jagged fangs. Ridged bands run from the crown down the back of the skull, giving a creature look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fangs; colour 1 on the ridged stripes over the crown and back of the head; the skin surface ignores the scheme and shows its own fleshy tone; colour 2 on the eye pits.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Mummy_01.description: A full head wrapping of layered bandage strips coiled around the skull and face, with crossing diagonal straps over the eyes and face, a contrasting band across the brow, and loose strip ends sticking out at the crown and ear.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Mummy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bandage layers and loose ends; colour 3 on the band across the brow; colour 1 on the crossing face straps, lower wraps and crown tail; colour 2 on the shadowed edge at the jaw and ear.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Mummy_01.differs: The male version is made of visibly layered, crossing bandage strips with loose ends, rather than the female version's smooth panelled hood.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting full-head cowl with a beaked, hawk-like brow ridge, recessed eye areas and a ribbed lower face guard that continues into a textured neck sleeve. Small round discs sit at the sides of the head.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth head shell; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth guard and neck sleeve; colour 3 on the eye areas; colour 2 on the side discs and edge trim.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Phantom_01.description: A skin-tight full-head hood that covers the whole head and neck with smooth, seamless fabric. It has a central stripe over the crown, forehead, nose and down the back of the neck, with side panels over the cheeks and ears, and no openings beyond faint eye recesses.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central stripe over the crown, nose and back of the neck; colour 0 on the two swept panels on the top of the head; colour 3 on the side panels covering the face and ears.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.description: A small head accessory: an angular block sits on the forehead at the hairline, with two long flat blade-like wings sweeping up and outward in a V. Small slashes mark the block. Suggests a mecha or robotic helmet crest.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the forehead block; colour 2 on the wing blades; colour 3 on the small slashes on the block and wing roots.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Robotexo_01.description: A robotic head replacing the natural head: an angular, faceted face plate with a hard brow and jaw, cracked segmented side and back panels, a round eye socket, and exposed cables and struts down the neck to a wide open collar ring.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the face plate, top shell and neck core; colour 0 on the side and back panels, collar ring and neck struts; colour 3 on the cables; colour 2 on the panel cracks and seams.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Robotexo_01.differs: The male head has a sharper, faceted angular face and a wider, more open collar with longer neck struts.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.description: A close-fitting full head covering with a smooth rounded shell, a wide angular visor band across the eyes, a central stripe over the crown, a chunky jaw guard and round ear discs. It continues into a short neck sleeve.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and neck sleeve; colour 0 on the crown stripe, jaw guard and ear discs; colour 2 on the visor band; colour 3 on the cheek marks and the neck band.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: An alien full-head covering: a swept-back crested helmet with layered spiky plates over the crown, a contrasting-trimmed brow band, and a mottled skin-like face and neck with side vent discs and ridged jaw plates.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet plates and jaw ridges; colour 3 on the brow band trim; colour 1 on the mottled skin of the face and neck; colour 2 on the side discs.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Samurai_Top_01.description: A tall, thin blade-like crest rising from the top of the head along the centreline, with a notched, swirl-patterned panel and a raised rim. A small octagonal gem with two round studs sits on the forehead.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Samurai_Top_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest rim edge; colour 1 on the inner border of the crest and the gem setting; colour 2 on the swirl panel background and the round studs; colour 3 on the swirl pattern and the gem.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Snake_01.description: A full replacement snake-like head with a smooth, tapered reptilian snout, side-set glossy eyes, a wide grooved lower jaw with a visible mouth line, and a scale-plated crown that runs down the back of the skull to the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scale plates across the crown and back of the head; the skin-toned face and neck do not take a slot from the scheme; colour 2 on the lower jaw and snout underside; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Spotlight_02.description: A full-head stage spotlight helmet: a rounded housing with a wide ringed lens opening at the front, four flat barn-door flaps around it, and three small flared lamp nozzles at the back and sides.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Spotlight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing, lens rim and nozzles; colour 1 on the barn-door flaps and side clamps; colour 3 on the nozzle interiors; colour 2 on the lens.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.description: A smooth, full-coverage helmet that encloses the whole head in a seamless rounded shell, with three pairs of slanted chevron vents across the face and a hexagonal pod on each side over the ears. A slim collar band circles the neck.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and neck collar; colour 1 on the slanted face vents; colour 2 on the hexagonal side pods.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Tv_01.description: A full-head retro television helmet: a rounded boxy casing with a glowing picture-screen face, contrasting side panels bulging out at each ear, and a small collar ring at the neck. Playful, cute, mechanical look.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Tv_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main casing; colour 0 on the side panels; colour 1 on the neck ring; the screen shows its own picture and ignores the colour scheme.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Tv_01.differs: The screen shows a cartoon creature with hearts under a rainbow, clearly visible, unlike the female version's pixelated rainbow picture.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Variablerobot_01.description: A full robotic helmet with a faceted, angular shell, slit eye openings, a pointed faceted faceplate with a contrasting jaw strip, round disc pods over the ears, and small vent dots on the sides. It covers the whole head.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main helmet shell and faceplate; colour 3 on the ear discs and jaw strip; colour 2 on the eye slits, top slot and neck section.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Wingedcrest_Bluejay_01.description: A close-fitting helmet covering the crown and back of the head, with a serrated fin-like crest running front to back and angular cut-outs at the temples. The shell is split into broad contrasting panels and bands.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Wingedcrest_Bluejay_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest and the centre stripe of the shell; colour 1 on the large side panels of the shell; colour 2 on the bands across the sides and back and on the crest tail; colour 3 on the small edge accents near the temples.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Wingedcrest_Bluejay_01.differs: The male helmet is split into bold contrasting panels and bands using all four colour slots, instead of a plain shell with thin line details.

Male/M_Head_Tight_Worm_03.description: A monstrous worm-like head: a long, tall tubular neck that curves forward into a small hooked, mandibled face, with a ridged crest, two thin antennae with tips, and small claw-like pincers around the mouth.
Male/M_Head_Tight_Worm_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crest, back and upper body of the head; colour 0 on the underside of the throat; colour 3 on the antenna tips and crest bulb; the pincer tips take a fixed gold-like tone.

Male/M_Head_Toxicsteel_01.description: A full-coverage mechanical helmet with a smooth rounded shell divided by thin panel lines, a round speaker-like disc over the face, cylindrical side pods on short arms, and a V-shaped chin and neck panel.
Male/M_Head_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chin and neck panels; colour 3 on the main shell; colour 0 on the face disc, side pods, their arms and the small studs.

Male/M_Headaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: Two symmetrical clusters of three long, frond-like gills that fan out and upward from either side of the head, each with a feathery, serrated edge. Suggests an axolotl or aquatic creature costume.
Male/M_Headaccessories_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of each gill frond; colour 3 on the frilled edges and tips; colour 0 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Headsmallaccessories_Dragonbody_L.description: A pair of long, thin tapering whiskers that sprout from either side of the upper lip and sweep down and outward past the chin in curved points, like a dragon's barbels or a drooping moustache.
Male/M_Headsmallaccessories_Dragonbody_L.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Headwear_Variablerobot_Helmet_01.description: A blocky, low-poly robotic helmet with a domed faceted shell, a raised central stripe running front to back, a small square window at the brow, and chunky ear-side modules with boxy protrusions. The face stays open.
Male/M_Headwear_Variablerobot_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the central stripe; colour 2 on the lower ear modules and jaw plates; colour 3 on the small boxy side blocks.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessoery_Child_Wooden_01.description: A tribal-style headdress of long, pointed leaf-like feathers or plates radiating in a ring around the head from a thin band across the forehead, leaving the face open and the crown bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessoery_Child_Wooden_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the spikes; colour 1 on the alternating spikes and inner panels; colour 3 on the thin veins and edge lines; colour 2 on the forehead band and streaks.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Anniversary_Mind.description: A cluster of long, ribbed tentacle-like strands that hang from the top of the head, covering the face and draping over the shoulders and upper back, with curled tips. Suggests a monstrous, alien mind-flayer look.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Anniversary_Mind.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strands' ribbed surfaces; colour 1 on the thin edge lining; colour 2 on the darker inner strand faces.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Anniversary_Mind.differs: The male version is a set of long tentacle-like strands hanging over the face and shoulders, while the female version is only a small oval forehead plate with a diamond gem.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Armyhelmet_03.description: A pair of round goggles with chunky octagonal rims and domed lenses joined by a short bridge, worn pushed up on the forehead and held by a flat strap that circles the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Armyhelmet_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the goggle rims and bridge; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 0 on the head strap; colour 2 on the small strap connectors at the sides.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Astronaut_01.description: A partial helmet faceplate shaped like a deep curved bowl that covers the lower face from nose to chin and wraps toward the ears, with a raised nose notch and small pointed tips at the sides.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the thin edge rim along the top and side tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Aztecheaddress_0.description: A large fan-shaped feathered headdress: layered rows of long feathers radiate in a wide half-circle from a small cap on the head, with shorter contrasting feathers forming an inner ring. Tribal ceremonial style.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Aztecheaddress_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the long outer feathers; colour 2 on the shorter inner feathers; colour 0 on the small cap at the head.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bonemantis_01.description: A set of six curved, tapering fang-like mandibles arranged in a shallow V under the chin and jaw, pointing downward. Suggests a mantis or beast mouth-guard worn as a monstrous face accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the fangs; the other colour slots are not visible.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bonemantis_01.differs: The male version is a set of curved fangs hanging below the chin, whereas the female version is a pair of domed insect eyes worn over the eyes.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A retro sci-fi antenna: a rounded dome base topped by a thin upright mast with three stacked rings that widen toward the bottom, ending in a small ball tip. It floats above the head as a quirky accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome base; colour 1 on the mast and the thin spokes inside the rings; colour 2 on the rings and the ball tip.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A pair of retro sci-fi antennae floating out at either side of the head: each is a thin rod with a rounded bulb at the inner end, a small ball at the tip and several thin rings spaced along the shaft.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded bulbs; colour 1 on the central rods; colour 2 on the rings and tip balls.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A single thin antenna with a small round base and a slender curved stalk that bends and droops sideways, ending in a larger round bulb. It floats above the top of the head in a retro sci-fi style.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base ball; colour 1 on the curved stalk; colour 2 on the tip bulb.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A pair of thin, curved antennae rising from the top of the head, each a slender stalk with a small ball at the base and a larger bulb at the tip that droops outward. A retro sci-fi, alien look.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base balls; colour 1 on the thin stalks; colour 2 on the tip bulbs.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A small retro sci-fi antenna: a rounded base pad on top of the head holds a thin central rod with three stacked rings of increasing width and a round ball tip. Sits above the crown as a whimsical accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded base; colour 1 on the central rod and thin spokes; colour 2 on the rings and the ball tip.
