Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: Pair of floating retro sci-fi antennae, one at each side of the head: a rounded bulb on a thin rod with a small tip ball, wrapped by several thin open rings. They hover clear of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded bulbs; colour 1 on the central rods; colour 2 on the rings and tip balls.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A single thin antenna: a small round base ball on top of the head with a slim stalk that bends and droops slightly to the side, ending in a round bulb tip. Retro sci-fi accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base ball; colour 1 on the stalk; colour 2 on the tip bulb.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A pair of thin, curved antennae that rise from small spherical bases on top of the head and droop slightly, each tipped with a round bulb. A playful retro sci-fi or insect-like head accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spherical bases; colour 1 on the thin stalks; colour 2 on the tip bulbs.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A retro sci-fi antenna: a slim central mast rising from a small rounded dome base, topped with a ball tip and three widening rings threaded down the shaft with thin spokes. It floats above the head as a whimsical accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome base; colour 1 on the central mast and thin spokes; colour 2 on the rings and the ball tip.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A pair of floating retro sci-fi antennae, one at each side of the head: a thin rod with a rounded bulb at the inner end, a pointed tip outside, and several thin rings spaced along the shaft.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded bulbs; colour 1 on the central rods; colour 2 on the rings and pointed tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A thin, gently bent antenna stalk topped with a small faceted ball at the tip and a larger rounded ball at its base. It floats above the head, a retro sci-fi accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large base ball; colour 1 on the thin stalk; colour 2 on the small tip ball.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A pair of thin, curved antennae that rise from the top of the head and splay outward, each with a round bulb at the base and a small ball at the tip. Retro sci-fi, alien or insect-like look.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base bulbs; colour 1 on the thin stalks; colour 2 on the tip balls.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A retro sci-fi antenna: a small rounded dome base with a thin slanted mast rising from it, three stacked open rings of increasing size and a ball tip. It floats above the top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome base; colour 1 on the mast and thin spokes; colour 2 on the rings and the ball tip.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A single thin, bendy antenna with a small round ball at the base and a larger round bulb at the tip, arching and drooping to one side. It sits above the top of the head, with a retro sci-fi feel.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base ball; colour 1 on the stalk; colour 2 on the tip bulb.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.description: A pair of thin, bendy antennae rising from the top of the head, each with a round bead at its base and a small ball at the tip, curving gently outward in a retro sci-fi, bug-like style.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bubble_Retroscif.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the round base beads; colour 1 on the thin stalks; colour 2 on the tip balls.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bucket_01.description: A thin curved wire loop resting around the neck and collarbone, with a small rounded cylindrical bead at the front. The ends taper up toward the jaw like a minimal headset or choker accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Bucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin wire; colour 1 on the cylindrical bead at the front.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Corrupted_01.description: A spiky monstrous head accessory of sharp, thorn-like blades fanning up and out from the brow and temples, with a tall central spike and curved side horns. Sits on the forehead and crown, leaving the face open.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall upper thorns; colour 1 on the inner side blades; colour 2 on the outermost curved blades; colour 3 on the central spike.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Crimson_01.description: A fantasy circlet-mask worn across the brow: an ornate metal band with flame-like curling prongs, swept-out winglike side points, a pointed nose bridge, and two tall curved horns rising from the forehead.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band, side points and prongs; colour 1 on the two tall horns.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Dragon_Silly_01.description: A pair of octagonal disc pods worn over the ears like headphones, each with a fan of pointed, swept-back fin or wing blades sprouting from behind. A playful, dragon-like head accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Dragon_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the disc rims and outer casings; colour 3 on the outer disc faces; colour 0 on the fin blades; colour 2 on the blade outlines.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Enclosure_Cryoge.description: Two thin, tube-like hoses arch over the shoulders, each curving up from the upper chest and back over the shoulder line with a kinked, angular bend. They are loose, open ends with no helmet attached.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Enclosure_Cryoge.colourAreas: Colour 3 on both tubes; other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Cowboyhat_S.description: Steampunk goggles worn pushed up on the forehead: two round lens cylinders with panelled housings joined by a short bridge, held by a thin studded headband that circles the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Cowboyhat_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband; colour 1 on the goggle housings, bridge and studs; colour 3 on the inset panels of the housings; colour 2 on the lenses.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Patriot_Mas.description: Round-lens goggles with octagonal rimmed lenses and small side blocks, worn over the eyes on a wide padded band that wraps around the head. The band is layered and slightly ribbed.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Patriot_Mas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded band; colour 1 on the lens rims; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the side blocks and band edging.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Face_Patriot_Mas.differs: The male band sits as a plain, uniform strip at the back, largely hiding the lens rims, with no lower dip behind.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Techno_01.description: A mechanical jaw guard that wraps the lower face: a V-shaped chin plate with angular blade-like flares rising along each cheek toward the ears, and vented side panels with small round perforations. Sci-fi, armored look.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin plate and the outer cheek flares; colour 1 on the perforated side panels; colour 2 on the inner recesses and edge gaps.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_01.description: A wide angular visor band that wraps across the eyes and temples: a flat faceted strip with a notch at the nose and upswept ends at the sides. Suggests a sentai-style trooper mask.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor band; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_02.description: A angular V-shaped visor band that sits across the eyes, dipping to a point over the nose bridge and wrapping back toward the temples. A slim bright edge outlines the top. Suggests a sentai-style hero mask.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the visor face; colour 0 on the thin upper rim and inner surface.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_03.description: A pair of flat, leaf-shaped eye plates that angle outward and upward from beside the nose across each eye, like a sentai-style mask. They are thin, unattached shells with no strap, sitting on the face.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both eye plates; the plates appear to be a single colour with no other visible features.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_04.description: A wraparound visor band in one smooth curved shell that covers the eyes and upper face, dipping to a point over the nose and wrapping to the temples. It suggests a sleek, plain sentai-style helmet.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Full_Trooper_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor shell; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Guardian_01.description: A pair of stylized dragon-flame ear ornaments floating at the sides of the head: upper swept, pointed fin-like blades with swirl engravings above lower curling wave-shaped scrolls. Fantasy, east-asian look.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper swept blades; colour 2 on the swirl engravings; colour 1 on the lower curling scroll shapes; colour 3 on the thin swirl lines in the lower scrolls.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Lockbox_66_01.description: A close-fitting cap of layered, overlapping feather-like plates fanning back from the brow, with a small horn at the crown and sharp tapered tips flicking out around the nape and sides. Suggests a fantasy serpent-bird headdress.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper feather plates, blending toward colour 0 near the front edges; colour 2 on the underside and back plates; colour 3 on the crown horn and the feather tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Lockbox_66_02.description: A floating crest of long pointed feathers arranged in a fan arc that runs from ear to ear over the top of the head, with the tallest feather at the centre. Suggests a tribal headdress.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lower feather bases; colour 3 on the feather tips; colour 2 on the shading between them.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Modern_Ironclad_.description: A tall, swept-back crest of layered, blade-like plates running from the forehead over the crown and down past the nape, tapering to pointed tips. Reads as a stylised mohawk or mechanical helmet fin.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Modern_Ironclad_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crest plates; colour 1 on the inner edges and accent plates between the layers; colour 2 on the tapering tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Modern_Kinetik_0.description: A pair of ear-mounted discs with clusters of long, swept-back blade-like spikes rising from each. The spikes sweep up and back past the head, giving a winged, speedster-style look.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Modern_Kinetik_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ear discs and their rims; colour 3 on the spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A fan-shaped plume of long, overlapping feathers rising from a small tuft at the crown of the head and sweeping back and outward, like a flamboyant pirate hat feather worn as a crest.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather vanes; colour 0 on the feather centres and inner fade; colour 2 on the feather tips; colour 3 on the central quills and the base tuft.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Pirate_Hat_Feath.description: A small cluster of long, curved plume feathers fanning out from a single point at the side of the head, each with a central quill and frayed edges, in the style of a pirate hat plume.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Pirate_Hat_Feath.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feather vanes; colour 1 on the outer edges of some feathers; colour 3 on the central quills; colour 2 on the feather tips and shading.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Super_Retro_Dest.description: A minimal retro-villain head frame: two angular metal tubes rise from beneath the chin and run up either side of the face, each with a short hooked prong pointing toward the jaw. It leaves the head bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Super_Retro_Dest.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tubes; colour 2 on the darker upper tube ends; colour 1 on the hooked prongs by the chin.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Tight_Emissive_0.description: A translucent glass-like face shield that curves over the eyes, cheeks and nose and tapers to a point below the chin. It has a notched, angular upper edge at the forehead and no rear part. Sci-fi visor style.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Tight_Emissive_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shield, shown as a glossy glassy surface that mostly ignores the other colour slots; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Tight_Flighthelm.description: A small headset microphone boom: a cylindrical earpiece capsule on a slim open-frame arm at the cheek, with a jointed thin stalk curving down and forward to a flattened mic tip near the mouth.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Tight_Flighthelm.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm, frame and mic tip; colour 0 on the capsule body; colour 1 on the capsule's outer end cap.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Victory_01.description: A pair of swept-back head fins or wings, one on each side of the head, each made of a long curved blade with smaller layered feather-like blades beneath it, pointing upward and outward like horns.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer blades; colour 1 on the middle layered blades; colour 2 on the lower under-blades.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Winterevent_2025.description: A tall conical hennin hat with a long pointed peak and a draped veil that hangs from the tip down the back and sides, finished with a scalloped lace edge. Medieval, fairy-tale court style.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Winterevent_2025.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone and upper veil; colour 1 on the lower veil, fading in from the cone; colour 2 on the lace trim.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Wizard_01.description: A small, realistic human skull with a separate jaw and cracked bone texture, perched on one side of the head like a floating ornament. It suggests a macabre wizard or necromancer accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Wizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skull; the other colour slots are not visible. The bone texture appears to ignore most of the scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Wolf_Pelt_03.description: A pair of small, pointed ear-like tufts perched on the upper forehead, angled outward like a wolf's ears, each with a hollow inner panel and a thin rim. Only the two ears show; nothing covers the rest of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Accessory_Wolf_Pelt_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim of each ear; colour 1 on the inner panel of each ear.

Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A bald monstrous brute head with a heavy brow, pointed ears with a hoop earring, and a wide jutting underbite jaw showing curved tusks, small teeth and a protruding tongue. Thick, blocky neck and skull.
Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tusks and earring; colour 1 on the eyes and teeth gums; colour 2 on the teeth; colour 3 on the tongue; the skin ignores the scheme and keeps its own tone.
Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The male head has a broader, heavier jaw and larger tusks on both sides of the mouth.

Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_02.description: A full-head wrestler-style mask with a smooth cloth-like shell, raised rim stripe over the crown, angular eye surrounds, a nose point and a fanged tiki mouth. A ragged pointed beard-like flap hangs below the chin.
Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary16_2025_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mask shell; colour 0 on the eye surrounds, crown stripe and teeth band; colour 3 on the eye fills; colour 2 on the nose, mouth interior and chin flap.

Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.description: A full-face metal helmet with a domed crown, a brow band forming a V over glowing eyes, tall curved spikes rising from the top and sides, and a pointed mask-like faceplate that tapers to a chin point.
Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band and rim trim; the main helmet shell is glossy metal that largely ignores the scheme; colour 3 on the eye glow; colour 1 in the eye surrounds.

Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A full robotic helmet with a smooth glossy dome, panel seams, a round central eye lens on the brow, angry glowing eye openings, and a pointed chin guard. Round ear pods and tall angular fins rise at each side.
Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Glossy metal ignores the scheme for most of the shell; colour 1 on the ear pods, chin tip and rear ridge; colour 3 on the brow lens and eye glow; colour 0 on the side fins.
Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.differs: The male helmet has contrasting glowing eyes set in a heavier scowling brow, while the female has narrow, contrasting eye slits.

Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary_Mindslayer_01.description: A retro supervillain headpiece with two large curling ram-like horns with a mesh texture, a central brow ridge holding a diamond-shaped gem, a band across the eyes, and long tentacle-like strands hanging down behind the head to the shoulders.
Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary_Mindslayer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns, brow plate and hanging strands; colour 1 on the eye band and strand edging; colour 3 on the diamond gem.

Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary_Nighthawk_01.description: A soft draped hood with a bird-of-prey theme: a large curved beak projects over the face, with angry eye plates set into the front. The hood falls in a loose cowl around the neck and shoulders and ends in a slight point at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Anniversary_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood and cowl; colour 1 on the beak; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the eye plate surrounds.

Male/M_Helmet_Anubis_01.description: An Egyptian-style jackal headdress: a fitted cap across the top of the head with two tall pointed ears and a decorated front plate, plus a long striped cloth veil hanging behind and to the sides down to the shoulders.
Male/M_Helmet_Anubis_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cap and front plate; colour 2 on the ears and edge trim; colours 0 and 3 on the patterned hanging cloth.

Male/M_Helmet_Arcane_01.description: A jackal-headed full helmet in an Egyptian style: a long tapering snout, two tall pointed ears, a round jewelled medallion on the brow and a striped cloth headdress that drapes to the shoulders and back.
Male/M_Helmet_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face plating and the stripes on the headdress; colour 2 on the snout, ears and headdress cloth; colour 1 on the headband and medallion ring; colour 3 on the centre gem and side ornaments.

Male/M_Helmet_Armyhelmet_01.description: A rounded military combat helmet with a camouflage-style blotchy pattern, small leaf-like scraps sticking out of the shell, a contrasting band around the base with a small buckle, and two long dangling chin straps.
Male/M_Helmet_Armyhelmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell base; colour 3 on the camouflage blotches and the band around the base; colour 1 on the hanging chin straps; colour 2 on the small buckle and some scraps.

Male/M_Helmet_Armyhelmet_02.description: A rounded military-style combat helmet with a mottled camouflage-patterned shell, a band around the rim with a small buckle, a small box-shaped attachment on the left side, and two dangling chin straps.
Male/M_Helmet_Armyhelmet_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 3 in a mottled camouflage pattern on the shell; colour 3 on the rim band; colour 2 on the side attachment and buckle; colour 1 on the hanging straps.

Male/M_Helmet_Armyhelmet_03.description: A rounded military-style helmet with a contrasting rim band, rivet dots and a strap band circling the shell that holds a pair of round goggles on the brow; two dangling chin straps with contrasting tips hang at the sides.
Male/M_Helmet_Armyhelmet_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the goggle band; colour 1 on the rim band and goggle housings; colour 3 on the goggle lenses and the hanging straps; colour 2 on the strap tips and small fittings.

Male/M_Helmet_Astronaut_01.description: A full-enclosure astronaut helmet with a rounded shell, a large domed visor and a contrasting brow band with small vent slots. Side ear pods and a chin-mounted mic piece sit on a trim ring; a raised triangular emblem marks the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and trim ring; colour 1 on the visor dome, ear pods and chin piece; colour 2 on the brow band; colour 3 on the vent slots.

Male/M_Helmet_Aztecheaddress_01.description: A tribal feathered headdress: a large fan of long layered feathers radiates behind and above the head, with a small skull ornament at the brow and short strands hanging beside the face. Ancient ceremonial style.
Male/M_Helmet_Aztecheaddress_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer feathers; colour 2 on the inner feathers near the skull; colour 0 on the skull and head band; colour 1 on the hanging strands and face trim.

Male/M_Helmet_Beast_Stag_Antlers_03_Brok.description: A pair of wide stag antlers rising from small bases on top of the head, sweeping outward and up with several pointed tines per side. One antler is shorter and broken, giving an asymmetric, wild look.
Male/M_Helmet_Beast_Stag_Antlers_03_Brok.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bases and the lighter lower parts of the antlers; colour 1 on the upper beams and tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Beast_Stag_Antlers_03_New.description: A pair of wide-spreading stag antlers rising from small bases at the top of the head, sweeping outward and up in long curved beams with several sharp tines. Suits beast, fantasy and woodland looks.
Male/M_Helmet_Beast_Stag_Antlers_03_New.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bases at the head; colour 1 on the antler beams and tines; colour 2 on the tine tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Bike_01.description: A sleek aerodynamic cycling-style helmet with a long pointed peak over the brow, angular fins on the sides, vent cut-outs and rear openings. It sits over the top of the head, leaving the face open, with a sporty superhero look.
Male/M_Helmet_Bike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and crown; colour 3 on the central chevron stripe and vent panels; colour 1 on the side fins and lower rear shell; colour 2 on the small side pivot buttons.

Male/M_Helmet_Blockbuster_01.description: A smooth, rounded skullcap helmet that sits close to the head, with a brow line over the forehead and a tall fin-like crest running front to back, with a hollow opening at its front end.
Male/M_Helmet_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the central crest and its front opening rim; colour 2 on the thin edge trim around the base.

Male/M_Helmet_Bloodmoon_2025_01.description: A large, monstrous full-head covering shaped like a downward-pointing triangle, with a wide flared top and a pointed chin. Its surface is carved with organic, ribbed swirls, and it completely hides the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Bloodmoon_2025_01.colourAreas: The whole helmet takes a dark, glossy stone-like finish that largely ignores the colour scheme; the scheme is barely visible on the surface.

Male/M_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere_L.description: A large spherical bubble helmet, transparent like glass, that encloses the whole head and sits on the shoulders at the neck with a thin rim. Smooth and rounded, in a retro sci-fi astronaut style.
Male/M_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere_L.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faint rim at the neck; the glassy sphere is transparent and ignores the colour scheme.
Male/M_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere_L.differs: The male helmet is a clear, smooth glass bubble that shows the head inside, while the female one renders as an opaque, faceted, rock-textured sphere.

Male/M_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere_L.description: A large opaque sphere helmet built from faceted triangular panels with a mottled, cratered surface, covering the entire head and resting on the neck and shoulders. Retro sci-fi style with no visible face opening.
Male/M_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere_L.colourAreas: The whole sphere uses its default mottled stone-like texture; no colour slots are clearly applied.
Male/M_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere_L.differs: The male version is an opaque, faceted, rock-textured sphere that hides the head, unlike the clear glass bubble on the female.

Male/M_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere_M.description: A large faceted bubble helmet, a solid sphere of triangular facets that fully encloses the head and rests on the neck with a slim open rim at the base. It suggests a retro sci-fi space helmet.
Male/M_Helmet_Bubble_Retroscifi_Sphere_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 across the whole sphere surface; the default material shows a mottled stone-like texture, so the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Bucket_01.description: A humorous upturned metal bucket worn over the whole head, tapering slightly toward the top, with ridged bands near the rim and a thin wire handle hanging under the chin with a grip.
Male/M_Helmet_Bucket_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bucket body; colour 1 on the handle grip; the wire handle takes the light colour.

Male/M_Helmet_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy paper-bag hood that covers the whole head, with two small ragged eye holes on the front and a jagged, torn lower edge that hangs over the neck. Crude and comical, in a makeshift style.
Male/M_Helmet_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bag body and the round patch at upper left; colour 1 on the large curved panels on the front, sides and back; colour 2 on the torn lower band; colour 3 on the inset panel on the side.

Male/M_Helmet_Cat_01.description: An oversized cartoon cat head that covers the whole head: a rounded shell with two small rounded ears, stripe markings on the forehead, a flat painted face with big eyes, nose and cheeks, and a short neck collar.
Male/M_Helmet_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell, ears and neck collar; colour 1 on the inner ears and the eyes; colour 2 on the face and forehead stripes; colour 3 on the nose and cheeks.

Male/M_Helmet_Chicken_01.description: A full-head cartoon chicken mask with a glossy hooked beak, bulging googly eyes, a serrated comb running from forehead to back, and scale-textured feathered cover that flares into a ruffled collar at the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Chicken_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaly feathered head, neck ruff and eyeballs; colour 1 on the face, comb and wattle; colour 2 on the beak and pupils; colour 3 on the eye rims.
Male/M_Helmet_Chicken_01.differs: The male version has protruding contrasting googly eyeballs with contrasting pupils, rather than flat contrasting-rimmed eyes.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Bear_03.description: A small, faceted bear muzzle and snout piece that sits over the mouth and upper chin, jutting forward as a blunt wedge with a soft, sculpted nose ridge. Suits animal or beast character heads.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Bear_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and sides of the snout; colour 0 on the front and underside of the muzzle; colour 2 in the shadowed tip and lower edge.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Bear_03.differs: The male snout is wider and blockier, with a deeper, flatter underside sitting lower on the chin.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Beast_Croc_Tophat_01.description: A tall, slightly crumpled cloth top hat with a wide flat brim, a band of segmented panels studded with small spikes around the base of the crown, and a single long feather tucked in at the side.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Beast_Croc_Tophat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the small spikes and underside of the brim; colour 3 on the feather.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Celestial_Dragon_01.description: A pair of slender branching antler horns rising from the top of the head, each forking into a few sharp tines that sweep upward and backward; a fantasy dragon-like head accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Celestial_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of each horn; colour 1 on the upper shafts and tines, fading gradually between the two.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Dog_Ear_01.description: A pair of cartoon dog ears: tall, pointed, cupped ears with tapered lower tips, floating above the head on either side. Smooth and soft-looking, with a hollow inner face and a gradient at the tips.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Dog_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces; colour 1 on the ear tips as a gradient; colour 2 on the inner hollow of each ear.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Dog_Eyes_01.description: A pair of large cartoon eyeballs perched on the top of the head, one on each side, like stalk-less bug eyes. Each low-poly sphere has a round iris and pupil facing forward, giving a silly, cute look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Dog_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball spheres; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Bowlerhat_01.description: A classic bowler hat with a rounded domed crown, a short brim that curls slightly upward at the edges, and a contrasting band around the base of the crown. It sits level on top of the head, in a formal, vintage style.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Bowlerhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cadethat_01.description: A small folded garrison-style cadet cap that sits snug on top of the head, with a soft creased crown that peaks along the centre line and a contrasting piped seam running front to back.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cadethat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap body; colour 1 on the piping along the centre seam.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitary_.description: A close-fitting military tech helmet with a wide visor panel pulled down over the eyes, segmented shell plates on the sides and back, round ear discs, and circuit-like inlaid lines across the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitary_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell plates, ear discs and inlaid line details; colour 1 on the visor panel and top crown; colour 2 on the seams and gaps between plates.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitary_.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet shell with the visor raised out of view, leaving the face bare. It has a smooth domed crown, panelled sides with etched detail, and round earpiece discs, in a modern military style.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitary_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown and top panels; colour 0 on the side and rear shell plating, earpiece discs and rear band; colour 3 on small accents by the earpieces.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitary_.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet with a padded cloth crown, riveted side plates, a ridged band across the back, ear cups and a boom microphone curving toward the mouth, plus a thin antenna rising at the side.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Covertmilitary_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cloth crown and ear cup accents; colour 0 on the side plates, back band and microphone; colour 2 on the ear cups and antenna.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_01.description: A classic cowboy hat with a soft, creased crown pinched slightly at the front and a wide brim that curls up at the sides. Sits on top of the head, tilted low over the brow, in a western style.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and the top of the brim; the underside of the brim takes a darker shade from the scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_02.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a boxy, slightly creased crown and a broad flat brim that sits low over the eyes. The brim has a pointed front and back and a thin edge; western style.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim, with only a slight shading difference on the underside of the brim.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_02.differs: The male crown is shorter and the brim slightly narrower, and the underside of the brim is the same colour as the top rather than a separate contrasting colour.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Crump.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, crumpled and creased crown and a slightly wavy, drooping brim. It sits on top of the head, shading the face, with a casual western look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Crump.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim alike; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Crump.description: A crumpled wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a dented, creased crown and a floppy brim ragged along the edge and pierced by small holes. It sits on top of the head, giving a worn, weathered look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Crump.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Gunsl.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, creased crown pinched at the front and back, and a broad flat brim that dips slightly. It sits low on the head, shading the eyes, in a western gunslinger style.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Gunsl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; no separate trim or band is visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Tall_.description: A tall ten-gallon cowboy hat with a high, slightly pinched crown and a wide, gently curved brim that sits low over the brow. Soft felt-like shaping suggests a classic western look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Tall_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; the underside of the brim takes a darker shade.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneve.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, softly creased crown and an uneven, wavy brim that dips at the front and flares up at the sides. Sits on top of the head in a western style.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneve.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneve.description: A cowboy hat with a tall, creased, slightly crumpled crown and a wide brim that curls up at the sides and dips low over the eyes. Small worn holes and nicks show on the crown and brim edge.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneve.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedora_01.description: A classic fedora with a softly creased, tapered crown and a short brim that sits low over the brow. A wide hatband with thin edge piping wraps the crown, with a contrasting block at the front-side. Suggests a noir or pulp look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedora_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hatband; colour 1 on the thin piping along the band edges; colour 3 on the block section of the band at the front.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedorabig_02.description: A wide-brimmed fedora with a tall, softly creased crown and a flat, broad brim that shades the eyes. A band circles the base of the crown with a small contrasting patch at the front-right. Classic noir style.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Fedorabig_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 3 on the small patch on the band.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Hardhat_02_Basi.description: A rounded construction-style hardhat with moulded ridges over the dome, a short brim and a band around the base. A bulky headlamp with a hexagonal housing and round lens is mounted on the front.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Hardhat_02_Basi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and brim; colour 2 on the band and the lamp mounting frame; colour 1 on the lamp body; colour 3 on the lamp lens.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Huntershat_01.description: A furry trapper-style cap with a rounded, panelled crown, a short front brim, a band of contrasting trim around the base, and fold-down ear flaps with dangling ties. Sits snugly on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Huntershat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front, side and rear crown panels and the ear flaps; colour 1 on the alternating crown panels; colour 2 on the trim band and ties; colour 3 on the small tuft at the crown top and the flap studs.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Knitcap_01.description: A close-fitting ribbed knit skullcap that covers the crown and sits just above the brows and ears, with two thin contrasting stripes around the band. A casual, sporty beanie look with no brim or cuff.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Knitcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed knit body of the cap; colour 1 on the two stripes around the band.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Knitcap_01_2.description: A snug, smooth swim cap that hugs the skull from forehead to nape, with soft wrinkles across the crown and two thin contrasting stripes circling the base. It leaves the face and ears uncovered, giving a sporty, casual look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Knitcap_01_2.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap; colour 1 on the two stripes around the rim.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Mountie_01.description: A wide-brimmed hat with a tall, softly pinched crown and a broad, gently drooping brim all round, circled by a band with a small square patch at the front. Sits on top of the head, shading the eyes.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Mountie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 3 on the small patch at the front of the band.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Piratehatwide_0.description: A wide bicorne pirate hat with a shallow crown and brim folded up into two peaks at the front and back, edged with a contrasting piped trim. It sits on top of the head like a naval tricorn.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Piratehatwide_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hat; colour 1 on the edge trim and piping around the folded brim.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Piratehatwide_0.description: A tricorn pirate hat with a rounded crown and three upturned brim corners, one at the front and two at the sides. The brim has contrasting edge trim and a small stitched cross on each side panel.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Piratehatwide_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the edge trim around the brim; colour 2 on the cross stitches; colour 3 on the thin line under the brim edge.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Tophat_01.description: A tall, slightly tapered top hat with a flat crown, a broad band around the base of the crown and a narrow flat brim. It sits on top of the head and gives a formal, gentlemanly look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Tophat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Tophat_02.description: A tall, slightly tapered top hat with a flat crown, a wide flat brim and a contrasting band around the base of the crown. It perches upright on top of the head, giving a formal, whimsical look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Face_Tophat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Falcon_01.description: A pair of swept-back feathered wings mounted at the sides of the head, layered feather rows fanning upward and outward, with long hanging feather tails falling beside the face and neck. Winged-hero look, leaving the head bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wing feathers; colour 1 on the band of feathers at the wing base; colour 2 on the small feathers beneath the base; colour 3 on the long hanging feathers.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Hat_Baseballcap_02.description: A casual baseball cap worn forward: a rounded multi-panel crown with a short curved brim at the front and stitched seam lines, sitting snugly on top of the head with the back panel left plain.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Hat_Baseballcap_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front panels, brim and side panel; colour 0 on the rear panels of the crown; colour 2 on the stitched seam lines.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Hat_Baseballcap_03.description: A casual baseball cap worn backwards: a rounded, panelled crown sits snug on the head with the stiff curved brim at the back of the skull, and stitched seams separate the panels.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Hat_Baseballcap_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panels of the crown; colour 1 on the back panels of the crown and the brim; colour 2 on the stitched seams and edge piping.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Hat_Fez_01.description: A fez hat: a short, flat-topped truncated cone that tapers slightly toward the crown and sits on top of the head. A thin cord runs across the top and drops into a tassel hanging at the side.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Hat_Fez_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat body; colour 2 on the cord across the top; colour 3 on the small cap where the tassel attaches; colour 1 on the tassel.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_01.description: A pair of large ram-style horns with ridged, ribbed surfaces that sweep back from the top of the head, curl down past the ears and flick outward at the tips. A fantasy or monstrous head accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper ridged part of the horns; colour 1 on the curled lower tips, blending in from the base.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_02.description: A pair of large ram-style horns with ridged, ribbed surfaces, rising from the top of the head, curling outward and down past the ears, and ending in smooth tapered tips that sweep outward.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged base and main curve of each horn; colour 1 on the smooth tapering tips, blending in from the base.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_03.description: A pair of large ridged ram-style horns that sprout from the sides of the upper head, sweep back and curl down and forward into pointed tips. The surface is heavily ribbed, giving a bone-like, beastly look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base and top of each horn; colour 1 on the lower curl and tips of each horn.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_04.description: A pair of long ridged ram-like horns that sweep up and outward from the top of the head, then curve back and down to tapered points. Each rises from a small flared base on the scalp; a beastly, monstrous look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horns_Skeletal_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged bases and shafts of both horns; colour 1 on the tapering tips, blending in gradually.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horsehead_Horn_01.description: A single spiralling unicorn horn that rises from the centre of the forehead and tilts slightly forward, tapering to a point, with twisting ridged bands and a small rounded base on the brow.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Horsehead_Horn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised spiral ridges and the base; colour 1 on the recessed spiral band; colour 2 on the darker twisting groove.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Qularr_Villain_01.description: A segmented insect-carapace head cover: a smooth pointed plate over the crown with a decorated front panel, and stacked overlapping blade-like plates fanning out behind the head. Leaves the face open and looks alien and monstrous.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Qularr_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and stacked back plates; colour 1 on the front panel and under-brow band; colour 3 on the emblem marking; colour 2 in the gaps between plates.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_01.description: A close-fitting segmented skullcap of banded plates with a row of round studs around the lower back edge, topped by a textured brow visor that sweeps to a point and two short curved horn spikes at the front.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded side and back plates and the horn spikes; colour 1 on the crown panel; colour 2 on the textured brow visor and rim; the stud dots also take colour 2.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_02.description: A close-fitting segmented cap with a swept brow ridge, a round mechanical disc on the forehead, and a row of rivets at the rear. A wide fan of long, curved feather-like blades splays up and back from the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded cap and the stripes on the crown; colour 1 on the crown panel; colour 2 on the brim edge and crest blades; colour 3 on the glowing slits in the blades and the disc detail.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_02.differs: The male crest splays into a wide fan of blades on both sides with no single tall front spike, unlike the narrow single-row female crest.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_03.description: A angular helmet-visor with a pointed brow that covers the forehead and eyes, ribbed segmented plates at the back, and a fan of tall slotted fins sweeping back from the crown like a crest, with a thin central blade.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest fins, centre stripe and rear band; colour 1 on the side and brow plates; colour 2 on the segmented top and back plates; colour 3 on the slots in the fins and small accents.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_04.description: A sleek serpent-inspired headdress: a pointed beak-like snout with a gem at the brow, swept-back horn fins on the crown, and a banded segmented rim around the back of the head. Leaves the face open below the snout.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Headdress_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim plates; colour 1 on the fin edges, side bands and lower back band; colour 2 on the snout tip and inner panels; colour 3 on the brow gem.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Spikes_01.description: A row of five curved, tapering horn-like spikes running front to back along the centre of the scalp like a mohawk, each sweeping backward and upward and shrinking in size toward the nape.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Serpent_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shafts of the spikes; colour 1 on the pointed tips; colour 2 on the base ends where the spikes meet the head.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Teddy_Ear_01.description: A pair of small rounded teddy-bear ears floating at the upper sides of the head, each a domed wedge with a textured fuzzy outer shell and a contrasting inner face. Cute, playful animal headwear.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Teddy_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 1 on the inner face of each ear.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Teddy_Eyes_01.description: A pair of large round eyeball-shaped orbs floating at either side of the head, each with an iris ring, contrasting pupil area and small contrasting spots facing forward. Cartoonish, cute and monstrous in style.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Teddy_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball whites; colour 1 on the iris ring; colour 3 on the inner pupil area; colour 2 on the small spots.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Circlet_Basic_.description: A slim circlet band worn around the forehead, dipping to a V-shaped point at the brow with a round gem, and decorated with a lattice weave and swirling scroll motifs along a thin contrasting edge.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Circlet_Basic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front V panel and scroll base; colour 1 on the outer edge trim; colour 2 on the lattice weave and scrollwork; colour 3 on the gem.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Croc_Tophat_01.description: A tall, slightly crumpled top hat with a wide flat brim, a banded strap around the base studded with small contrasting spikes, and a long curved feather tucked in at the side. Sits upright on the head; whimsical gothic-dandy style.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Croc_Tophat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the banded hatband; colour 2 on the small spikes; colour 3 on the feather.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked_0.description: A metal circlet crown with a ring of tall, curved spikes around the head, a taller central spike and a pointed gem-set brow plate at the front. A trim band runs underneath, sitting low on the forehead.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown body and spikes; colour 1 on the underside band; colour 3 on the gems.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Crown_Spiked_0.differs: The male crown has a lighter, flat-topped rim between the spikes, with no contrasting inner band showing.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Dorag_01.description: A close-fitting cloth bandana skullcap with a smooth gathered crown and a small knot at the back of the head, from which a short pointed tail hangs. It has a polka-dot pattern and casual, pirate-like or street styling.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Dorag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap fabric; colour 1 on the polka dots; colour 2 on a small tab at the front hairline.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A small, thin curved plate that sits on top of the head like a single crest fin, running from a pointed tip at the forehead over the crown toward the back. Faceted and smooth, it leaves the rest of the head bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole plate; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_01.description: A small partial head piece: a smooth plate over the forehead and crown that runs back as a ridge with two thin fins rising from the front and hollow, fin-like ridges behind. It suggests an alien or insectoid crest.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and the fin edges; colour 1 on the inner surfaces of the crest between the fins.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_01.differs: The male crest sits lower and rounder over the head, with a shallower back opening.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_02.description: A close-fitting helmet that covers the back and sides of the head and the brow, with a swept face opening and a tall thin blade-like fin running front to back along the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the crown fin; colour 1 gives a slight tint on the lower back of the shell.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_03.description: A thin, blade-like fin crest running front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk, with a swept, scalloped edge that rises toward the back and a pointed base plate on the forehead.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pointed base plate at the forehead; colour 1 on the tall fin panel.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_04.description: A close-fitting smooth helmet that covers the crown, brow and back of the head, with a slim curved central crest and swept-back fins at the sides. It leaves the lower face open, with small tabs at the nape, for a sleek creature-like sci-fi look.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow plate and fins; colour 1 on the rear and side shell of the helmet.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Gadroonfins_04.differs: The male version has a taller curved crest on top and small pointed tabs at the nape.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Pompom_01.description: A pair of fuzzy pompoms dangling on short braided cords from either side of the head, hanging down beside the jaw to neck level like oversized tassel earrings. Cute and playful.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Pompom_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaggy pompom balls; colour 0 on the twisted braided cords.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Ravenspeaker_0.description: A close-fitting pilot-style helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, with raised ridges running front to back, angular swept panels, and round ear-mounted speaker pods with small knobs; the face stays open.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Ravenspeaker_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ridges, side shells and ear-pod rings; colour 0 on the swept chevron panels and rear lower edge; colour 2 on the ear pods, inset panels and knobs; colour 3 on the thin stripes and outlines.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Redstone_01.description: A close-fitting, streamlined helmet shell that covers the crown, sides and back of the head, with a pointed brow over the eyes and segmented ridge panels running front to back. The face stays open.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and top ridge panels; colour 1 on the lower side and back sections; colour 2 on the thin seam lines between panels.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A full alien-style helmet with a swept-back crest of pointed blades, a angular brow guard forming a nose-bridge point, ribbed segmented plates over the cheeks and back of the head, and round contrasting ear discs. The mouth and chin are left open.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, crest blades and ribbed plates; colour 3 on the strip beneath the brow; colour 2 on the ear discs.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: An alien mechanical head piece: a smooth curved shell hugs the face and sweeps back into a long spine down the back of the neck, crowned with a fan of angular crest fins and dangling spindly side prongs.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth shell and back spine; colour 1 on the crest fins, side prongs and spine inlay; colour 3 on thin line accents along the shell.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_01.description: Werewolf-style fur ruff: a ragged band of jagged fur tufts wraps around the jaw like a beard, with swept-back tufts at the temples and ears. It leaves the top of the head bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tufts at the temples; colour 1 on the main body of the jaw and neck fur; colour 3 on the tips of the fur; colour 2 on the darker tuft tips.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_01.differs: The male version has a slimmer, shorter band of fur at the back of the neck, hugging the nape with less contrasting fur hanging down.

Male/M_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_02.description: Werewolf-style fur: jagged spiky tufts at the temples and sideburns, and a thick layered ruff wrapping under the jaw and neck, with ragged tufts hanging below the chin and at the nape.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the temple tufts and the hanging tufts below the ruff; colour 1 on the upper part of the neck ruff; colour 3 on the tips of the ruff.
Male/M_Helmet_Child_Werewolf_02.differs: The male version adds ragged fur tufts hanging below the chin and across the nape, making the ruff fuller and longer.

Male/M_Helmet_Corrupted_01.description: A monstrous full helmet with a domed crown, swept-back horn-like spikes and tall blades rising from the top, a jagged face guard with a central ridge, and a flared, angular neck guard covering the lower head.
Male/M_Helmet_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the tall crown horns; colour 1 on the neck guard, lower face plates and side blades; colour 2 on the outlines, side horns and swirling trim; colour 3 on the central crest and the accent spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Cosmos_01.description: A faceted, angular helmet that covers the crown and the back and sides of the head, with an open face and flared panels that taper down past the cheeks and nape. Stacked plates give it a sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Helmet_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed top; colour 0 on the side and back plates; colour 1 on the lower tips of the cheek and nape panels.

Male/M_Helmet_Cowboy_Studded_01.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a pinched, dented crown, a row of small studs or eyelets around the crown, and a contrasting band at its base. The very broad brim sweeps out and shades the face.
Male/M_Helmet_Cowboy_Studded_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the underside of the brim and the band's buckle.

Male/M_Helmet_Crimson_01.description: A full armored helmet with a sculpted, mask-like faceplate, swept-back spiked fins at the cheeks and crown, and a segmented neck guard. Two long curved plumes arc upward and outward like antennae, giving a fantasy insectoid look.
Male/M_Helmet_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceplate, spikes and helmet shell; colour 1 on the crest, cheek trim and neck guard bands; colour 2 on the recesses and edge lines; colour 3 on the long plumes.

Male/M_Helmet_Cyborg_Plated_01.description: A close-fitting cyborg skullcap covering the crown and back of the head, with a raised plate running front to back over the top, a small vented block on the forehead panel, and a band around the lower back.
Male/M_Helmet_Cyborg_Plated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap sides and back; colour 1 on the raised top plate; colour 2 on the vented block; colour 3 on the band around the lower back and sides.

Male/M_Helmet_Cyborg_Ridge_02.description: A partial cyborg skullcap made of curved plates that hug the sides and back of the head, split by a raised central ridge band running front to back over the crown, leaving the top sections open.
Male/M_Helmet_Cyborg_Ridge_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side and back plates; colour 1 on the central ridge band and the plate edges near the temples.

Male/M_Helmet_Datareaper_01.description: A chunky sci-fi headset helmet sitting low over the brow: a raised central ridge runs front to back, flanked by rounded side pods with small round lens ports and rectangular plates. A contrasting band covers the eyes.
Male/M_Helmet_Datareaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central shell and ridge; colour 1 on the side pods and front inlay; colour 2 on the eye band, lens ports and rear section; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Defender_Update_01.description: A sleek superhero helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, with a smooth domed top, layered angular side plates, and a contrasting visor band across the eyes. Narrow cheek guards run down each side of the face, leaving the mouth and chin bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and outer plating; colour 1 on the forehead insignia, side plates and rear band; colour 2 on the eye band, top stripe and cheek guard edges; colour 3 on the small accents beside the temples.

Male/M_Helmet_Detective_01.description: A soft fedora-style detective hat with a slightly dented crown, a contrasting band at its base and a wide, gently drooping brim that shades the eyes. Sits on top of the head; pulp noir style.
Male/M_Helmet_Detective_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim; colour 1 on the crown; colour 2 on the hat band.

Male/M_Helmet_Dinosuit_01.description: A soft, rounded dinosaur-head hood that pulls over the head, with an open toothy mouth framing the face, large round eyes, and a row of pointed spikes running down the crest and back to the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood body; colour 1 on the teeth and the eye rims; colour 3 on the pupils; colour 2 on the back spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Dog_01.description: A full cartoon dog head mask with shaggy tufted fur, a spiky crest, pointed upright ears with inner ear openings, a contrasting nose, wide eyes and a friendly grin; it covers the whole head and sits down to the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur and muzzle; colour 1 on the ear tips, eye surrounds and eyes; colour 3 on the cheek patches; colour 2 on the nose and inner ears.

Male/M_Helmet_Draco_01.description: A metal dragon-style full helmet with a smooth domed crown, a pointed beak-like nose guard, and curved horn-like spikes and broad side fins around the head. Angular eye slits sit under trim-edged brow plates.
Male/M_Helmet_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, spikes and side fins; colour 1 on the nose guard and its edging; colour 3 on the brow and eye-slit trim; colour 2 on the central crest spike and inner spikes.
Male/M_Helmet_Draco_01.differs: The male helmet has broader, shorter side fins and more curved horn-like crown spikes, a heavier and less flared crown than the female version.

Male/M_Helmet_Dragon_Silly_01.description: A cartoonish dragon-head helmet with a blunt snout, googly eyes, small antlers and brow ridges, sitting over the head. A band circles the head with side ear discs, fin-like frills and curling whisker wires.
Male/M_Helmet_Dragon_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell, antlers and frills; colour 1 on the band around the head; colour 3 on the side discs and the fangs beneath the snout; colour 2 on the whisker wires, frill outlines and eye pupils.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Bat_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed bat-like ears that rise from the sides of the head and sweep up and slightly outward. Each has a smooth outer shell and a hollow, softly gradient-shaded inner cup.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Bat_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 0 and colour 1 blend as a gradient across the inner surface, with colour 0 toward the tip and colour 1 toward the base.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Bat_01.differs: The male ears take colour 3 on the whole outer shell, where the female ears show a skin-toned outer shell.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Bear_02.description: A pair of rounded animal ears set on the upper sides of the head, each a smooth shell with a raised rim and an inner lining of tufted fur. Suggests a bear or beastly look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Bear_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner fur tufts; colour 2 on the shadowed inner cup.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Cat_Spooky_01.description: A pair of pointed cat ears set on top of the head, with a smooth back and a hollow inner face of jagged, fur-like tufts. Suggests a feline, beastly look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Cat_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and fur tufts; colour 1 tints the outer shell towards the base; colour 2 in the shaded inner ear hollows.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Corgi_01.description: A pair of large pointed animal ears sitting on top of the head, with a smooth outer shell, a hollow inner cup, and tufts of spiky fur clustered at the base of each ear. Cute, playful beast style.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Corgi_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and fur tufts; colour 1 on the inner ear cups.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Coyote_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears set on top of the head, angled outward. Each has a smooth outer shell and an inner face with jagged, fur-like tufts around the edge. Suggests a coyote or fox.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Coyote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and the fur tufts around the rims; colour 1 on the inner ear faces.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Dinosaur_01.description: A pair of fin-like frills that sweep out and back from the sides of the head at ear level, each with a webbed inner panel edged by long pointed spines. A fantasy, beast-like look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Dinosaur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer spines and rim; colour 1 on the inner webbed panel; colour 2 on the openings between the ribs; colour 3 as small accents on the panel.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Dragon_01.description: A pair of membranous, bat-like dragon wings that fan out from the sides of the head where ears would be, each with slender curved ribs and swept-back spikes. Fantasy creature look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribs and spines; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 2 in the shaded patches near the base of the membranes.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Fennec_01.description: A pair of large, pointed fox ears that sit high on the sides of the head, each with a raised outer rim, a lined inner face with contrasting fur tufts, and a small fringe of swept feather-like tufts at the base.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Fennec_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner ear faces; colour 0 on the fur tufts inside the ears.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Feral_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that sit on top of the head and sweep up and outward, with jagged fur-tuft edges and a hollow inner face. Suggests a feral fox or wolf look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Feral_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces and edge tufts; colour 1 on the inner ear fur.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Ferret_01.description: A pair of small, rounded triangular animal ears perched on top of the head, slightly forward and angled outward, with soft crinkled outer surfaces and a hollow inner cup facing forward. Cute, beast-like styling.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Ferret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the ears; colour 1 on the inner ear hollows.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Fishmonster_01.description: A pair of fin-like ear frills: stacked, ribbed fan blades that flare outward and sweep down beside each side of the head, ending in points near the jaw. Suggests a fish-monster or aquatic creature look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Fishmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ridges of the fins; colour 1 on the inner ribs between the ridges; colour 2 on the shaded edges and tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Flame_01.description: A pair of large pointed animal-like ears rising from the top of the head, each with a flame-shaped tip, an inner hollow, and a fringe of small feather-like tufts along the front lower edge.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Flame_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer ear shells and edges; colour 2 on the inner ear hollows; colour 0 on the feather tufts and rear panels; colour 3 on the patches near the ear tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Goat_01.description: A pair of goat-like ears that sweep out horizontally from the sides of the head, tapering to long pointed tips, with a thin inner rim visible from the front. A monstrous, animal-style head accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear surfaces; colour 2 on the thin inner rim of each ear.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Guardian_01.description: A pair of tall, swept-back pointed ear fins with scalloped, bat-like trailing edges and hollow inner faces, worn high on the sides of the head like dragon or beast ears. Fantasy creature styling.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the ear fins; colour 1 on the inner hollows of the fins.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Guardian_01.differs: The male ears sit slightly lower and flare more outward, showing more of the inner hollows from the front.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_01.description: A pair of long, narrow animal ears that stick out sideways from the top of the head and droop slightly downward, each a tapered pointed shape with a hollow inner face. Suggests a kangaroo or rabbit costume.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 0 and colour 1 on the inner face of each ear.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_01.differs: The male ears angle down and outward, drooping sideways, while the female ears stand upright.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_02.description: A pair of tall, narrow pointed kangaroo ears standing upright from the top of the head, with a hollow inner face and a contrasting lining showing on the inside.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 on the upper inner lining; colour 0 on the inner ear surface.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kangaroo_02.differs: The male ears stand tall and upright, while the female ears flop out sideways.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kitten_01.description: A pair of cartoon cat ears: soft, rounded triangular ears with a thick furry-looking outer rim and a recessed inner face, set upright on the top front of the head, angled slightly outward.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kitten_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner ear faces.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kitty_01.description: A pair of pointed cat ears set on top of the head, angled slightly outward, with a shaded inner lining and a smooth outer shell. Cute, animal-style headwear that sits on the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Kitty_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and rim of the ears; the inner ear lining shows a fur-like texture that does not follow the scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Llama_01.description: A pair of tall, upright animal ears with a furry, textured outer surface and a smooth inner hollow, rising from the top of the head. Cute, beastly costume accent.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Llama_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the outer ears and rims; colour 1 on the inner ear hollows.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Mask_Lion_01.description: A pair of pointed, triangular feline ears set high on the top of the head, each with a smooth outer shell and an inner face striped with alternating bands. Suggests a lion or cat beast look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Mask_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of the ears; colour 1 on the striped bands inside the ears; colour 2 on the stripes between them.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Mask_Lion_01.differs: The male ears have their outer shell in the light colour slot 0, whereas the female outer shell is dark.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Mecha_Horse_01.description: A pair of tall, narrow pointed blades that rise from the upper sides of the head like horse ears, angled slightly outward. Faceted, angular metal construction gives a mechanical beast-helmet look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Mecha_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer faces of the ears; colour 2 on the inner faces and edges; colour 0 on the light worn facets inside the ears.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Mechanical_Monster_01.description: A pair of curved, segmented horns rising from the sides of the head and sweeping upward and slightly back, built from stacked mechanical plates that taper to pointed tips. Suits a robotic demon or monster look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Mechanical_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide base plates of each horn; colour 1 on the middle segments; colour 2 on the narrow joint segments; colour 3 on the tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Mouse_01.description: A pair of tall, rounded-oval mouse ears rising from the upper sides of the head, with a rim of skin-toned outer shell and a hollow inner face that fades in tone. Cute animal-costume style.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Mouse_01.colourAreas: The outer shell and rim use the skin tone and ignore the colour scheme; colour 1 on the upper inner surface of each ear, fading toward colour 0 at the base.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Pitbull_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that rise from the top of the head and sweep outward, each with a hollow inner cup and a smooth rounded outer shell. Suggests a beastly, pitbull-like look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Pitbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells of the ears; colour 3 on the inner cups, shading toward colour 2 deeper inside.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Pitbull_01.differs: The male ears are longer and sweep further outward, sitting wider apart on the head.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Pony_01.description: A pair of pointed, upright animal ears set on top of the head, with soft rounded outer shells, a raised rim and a hollow inner cup. Suggests a pony or unicorn costume.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Pony_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rims; colour 1 on the inner hollow of each ear.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Rabbit_02.description: A pair of tall, furry rabbit ears rising from the top of the head in a V shape, with tapered pointed tips, tufted fur edges and a hollow inner face. Suggests a cute animal costume.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Rabbit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fur of the ears; colour 1 on the fur gradient toward the base; colour 2 on the inner ear hollows.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Raccoon_01.description: A pair of large pointed animal ears that sit on top of the head and angle outward. Each is a smooth, leaf-shaped shell with a hollow inner face and a slim rim, for a cute beast-like look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Raccoon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the base tips and the back tint; colour 3 on the inner ear hollows; colour 2 on the deepest inner shading.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Set_01.description: A pair of long, tapering monstrous horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping back in a curve with pointed tips and a hollow, lighter inner face along the underside.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Set_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer horn surfaces; colour 0 on the hollow inner face; colour 1 on a small edge of the inner lining.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Set_01.differs: The male horns sit lower and sweep back flatter and more horizontally, with the tips less upright.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Starowl_01.description: A pair of tall, swept-back pointed animal ears with a hollow cupped interior, set high on the forehead and temples. Each has contrasting tips, a curved swoosh marking on the outer face and a separate inner lining.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 2 on the tips and swoosh markings; colour 1 on the inner lining of the ears.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Starowl_01.differs: The male version adds contrasting tips, a curved swoosh marking on each ear and a separately coloured inner lining, where the female version is a single plain colour.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Suave_02.description: A pair of tall, pointed animal ears that sit on top of the head and angle slightly outward. Each ear is a smooth, slim, faceted shell with a hollow inner cup and a thin rim, suggesting a wolf or beast look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Suave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 1 on the inner hollow of each ear.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Techcat_01.description: A pair of pointed cat-ear shells sitting on top of the head, each with a rimmed hard casing, a smooth outer back, and an inner face of striped vent-like slats above a flat panel. Suggests a mechanical feline headpiece.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Techcat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shells and rims; colour 1 on the flat inner panels; colour 3 on the inner stripes; colour 2 on the gaps between the stripes.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Teddybear_01.description: A pair of small, rounded teddy-bear ears perched on the top corners of the head, each with a cupped inner face, a thick fluffy rim and a zigzag stitched edge. Cute and playful.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Teddybear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fluffy rim and the back of the ears; colour 1 on the inner front face of each ear; colour 2 on the zigzag stitching along the edge.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Werewolf_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed beast ears that rise from the upper sides of the head, with a curved outer edge, a broad flared base and a separate inner lining. Suggests a werewolf or bat-like creature.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and back of each ear; colour 3 on the inner ear lining.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Whiterhino_01.description: A pair of short, pointed animal ears that rise from the top of the head and angle outward and slightly back, each a tapered, faceted cone with a narrow base. They suggest a rhino or beast look.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Whiterhino_01.colourAreas: The ears show a skin-like tone that does not follow the test scheme; no colour slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Wolf_Pelt_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed wolf ears that sit on top of the head, angled up and outward. Each has a smooth outer shell, a hollow inner face and small tufts of fur at the base.
Male/M_Helmet_Ear_Wolf_Pelt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 2 on the inner ear hollows; colour 1 on the fur tufts at the base of each ear.

Male/M_Helmet_Emblem_Facemask_01.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem with three interlocking elliptical orbits around a small central ring, sitting on the forehead and upper brow like a painted or raised badge. It suggests a sci-fi or superhero look.
Male/M_Helmet_Emblem_Facemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and central nucleus ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Cryogenic_01.description: A sealed cryogenic dome helmet: a tall rounded see-through bubble sits on a wide layered collar ring with tubing along the edges, a boxy vented block at the front and a plain plate at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Cryogenic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar rim; colour 1 on the collar band; colour 3 on the tubing and the front vent slots; colour 2 on the front block and back plate; the dome is translucent and ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Cryogenic_01.differs: The male dome is a transparent glass-like bubble that shows the face, while the female dome is opaque.

Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Hoses_01.description: A sci-fi enclosed helmet with a clear domed visor, a wide collar ring at the neck, two tall curved back-mounted panels with boxy tips, side canister fittings and looping hoses running around the neck and face.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar ring and side canisters; colour 1 on the curved back panels and helmet shell; colour 2 on the mouth vent, box tips and rear plate; colour 3 on the hoses and small lights. The visor is clear glass and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Lemurian_Bubble_.description: A translucent glass-like bubble helmet that encloses the whole head and neck in a tall rounded dome, with a smooth seamless surface and a slightly flared open lower edge resting on the shoulders.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Lemurian_Bubble_.colourAreas: The transparent dome ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint shows at the rim, so no slot is clearly used.

Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bubbl.description: A retro sci-fi bubble helmet: a clear egg-shaped dome with a pointed top, set in a chunky angular collar ring with a round vent or port at the chin and a tall panelled plate behind the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bubbl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin collar and the clear dome frame; colour 1 on the inner lining behind the face opening; colour 3 on the thin piping lines and the port centre; colour 2 on the rear plate seams. The dome is transparent and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bubbl.description: A retro sci-fi space helmet with a clear rounded glass bubble over the head, set into a chunky angular collar ring with a large back panel and a round vent port at the chin. Sits over the head and neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bubbl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar ring front and chin section; colour 1 on the inner visor lining behind the face; colour 2 on the back panel and side plates; colour 3 on the thin trim lines and the chin port centre. The bubble is clear and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bubbl.description: A full-enclosure retro sci-fi helmet: an opaque, tall smooth egg-shaped dome with a rounded pointed crown, a small round lens port at the front chin, and a separate angular plated collar band around the lower back and sides.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bubbl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the collar band; colour 1 on the shaded upper sides of the dome; colour 3 on the thin trim lines and the lens port; colour 2 on the lens port ring.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bubbl.differs: The male dome is smoother and more rounded, while the female dome has a faceted, more sharply pointed crown.

Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bubbl.description: A full-enclosure retro sci-fi bubble helmet with a smooth opaque rounded dome, a collar ring around the neck with a single round eye-like port at the front, and a rear panel with thin trim lines.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Retroscifi_Bubbl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and neck collar; colour 1 on the rear and side panels; colour 3 on the thin trim lines and the front port centre; colour 2 on the port rim.

Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Warlord_01.description: A full enclosure sci-fi helmet with a solid smooth domed front, angular side panels, a wide flared collar ring around the neck, hexagonal side lights and a thin antenna rising from the top.
