Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome front and collar ring; colour 1 on the side and back panels; colour 2 on the top crest and back centre strip; colour 3 on the collar lights and small side sensors.
Male/M_Helmet_Enclosure_Warlord_01.differs: The male helmet has a solid opaque dome front with no visible face opening, unlike the female's transparent visor.

Male/M_Helmet_Exartdecohalf_01.description: A smooth retro-futuristic helmet covering the skull and face down to the nose, with narrow eye slits, side panels, and a long swept-back fin that extends past the back of the head ending in a ribbed tail flare.
Male/M_Helmet_Exartdecohalf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central crest, forehead and nose guard; colour 1 on the side panels and rear band; colour 2 on the outline seams; colour 3 not visible; the ribbed fin tip shows a metallic tone.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_90s_Mask_01.description: A thin, shell-like face mask covering the brow, nose, cheeks and jaw, with angular eye slits, a notched top edge and separate cheek panels at the sides. It ends in a contrasting chin guard and has a hollow back.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_90s_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face shell and brow edges; colour 1 on the side cheek panels; colour 2 on the chin piece.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_90s_Tech_01.description: A mechanical head band with a central shield-shaped plate on the brow and chunky panelled cheek and ear guards on each side that drop toward the jaw. The face stays open, giving a retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow band; colour 1 on the forehead shield, side plates and cheek trim; colour 2 on the recessed mechanical panels and jaw pieces; colour 3 on the thin stripes and small lights.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_90s_Tech_01.differs: The male version has bulkier side guards that sit closer to the face, with a heavier cheek section.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Aci_01.description: A smooth, rounded open-face pilot helmet that covers the crown, sides and back of the head, with a raised band across the back, small rivets, recessed ear panels and a trimmed lower edge that dips over the ears.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Aci_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the lower edge trim and inner ear lining; colour 3 on the recessed ear panels; colour 2 on the inner shadowed edges.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Ancientarmor_02.description: A close-fitting ancient-style helmet with a ridged central crest, a pointed brow guard with a small nose guard, side plates over the ears and a decorative scrolled band around the lower rim. Leaves the face open.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Ancientarmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the scrollwork band and side ornament; colour 2 on the weathered shading and edges.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Anubis_Ears_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed jackal-style ears that rise from the top of the head, each with a hollow cupped front and a smooth rounded back, curving slightly outward to sharp tips.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Anubis_Ears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the ears; colour 1 shows as a faint tint on the back of the ears and inner hollows.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Blackpaladin_01.description: A full-face helmet with a smooth rounded shell, angular eye openings, a sculpted nose and mouth, and cheek guards. Curved horns sweep out from each side and contrasting spikes crown the top and back.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Blackpaladin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and cheek guards; colour 1 on the eye lenses; colour 3 on the curved side horns and the side hex boss; colour 2 on the spikes and back studs.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Blackpaladin_01.differs: The male version has two contrasting studs on the back of the shell, where the female has only one hex stud.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bonemantis_01.description: A monstrous insect-like head covering with an elongated, tapering skull shape, large bulbous compound eyes on the sides, and a row of small fang-like spines along the jaw. The back is open with a smooth interior.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, eye rims and smooth inner lining; colour 3 on the large eyes.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bonemantis_01.differs: The male version has a smooth plain interior in the same colour as the shell, without the ribbed contrasting lining seen on the female.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bowlerhat_01.description: A classic bowler hat with a rounded dome crown, a narrow brim that turns up slightly at the edges, and a wide contrasting band around the base of the crown. It sits level on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bowlerhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hatband.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bowlerhattall_01.description: A tall, flat-topped hat with a slightly rounded crown and a narrow rounded brim, wrapped by a contrasting band around the base of the crown. Sits upright on top of the head; a classic formal look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bowlerhattall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the band around the base of the crown.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bunnyears_01.description: A pair of tall, tapered rabbit ears rising from the top of the head. Both ears splay outward and one folds sharply at the tip. Each has a hollow inner face, giving a cute, playful costume look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bunnyears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear surfaces and rims; colour 1 on the inner ear lining, fading toward a pinkish skin-like inner tone.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Bunnyears_01.differs: The male ears splay wider apart and are shorter, with one ear folding down sharply at the tip.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cabbyhat_Victorian_01.description: A soft flat cap in the Victorian newsboy style: a rounded, panelled crown with stitched seams and a short stiff front peak, sitting snug on top of the head with a thin contrasting underside edge.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cabbyhat_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap crown and panels; colour 1 on the underside of the peak and the thin edge trim; colour 2 on the seam lines.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cadethat_01.description: A small soft garrison-style cadet cap that sits on top of the head: a folded cloth crown that peaks along the centre, with a contrasting piped seam running front to back over the top.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cadethat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap fabric; colour 1 on the piping along the centre seam.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Catears_01.description: A pair of pointed, triangular cat ears standing upright on the top front of the head, with hollow inner faces and a smooth outer surface. They read as playful, animal-themed costume ears.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Catears_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the ears; colour 1 and colour 3 as a gradient on the inner faces of the ears; colour 2 in the shadowed inner base.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Catears_02.description: A pair of small pointed cat ears set on the upper front of the head, each a simple angular triangular shell with a hollow inner face. Cute, animal-like accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Catears_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells; colour 1 and colour 3 blend across the inner ear faces.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Clown_01.description: A flat-topped boater-style straw hat with a short cylindrical crown and a narrow flat brim, circled by a patterned band. It sits level on top of the head and suggests a vaudeville or clownish look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Clown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the dots of the band pattern.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Clowncap_01.description: A jester's cap: a snug headband with a thin contrasting stripe and four long, curved, drooping points radiating from the crown, each tipped with a round pom-pom. The points have contrasting inner panels and stitched edging.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Clowncap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap and points; colour 1 on the headband and the inner panels of the points; colour 3 on the thin band stripe and edge stitching; colour 2 on the pom-poms.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cosmic_01.description: A sci-fi helmet of faceted armour plates that covers the crown, back and sides of the head. It has a horizontal visor band across the brow, hexagonal side details, a segmented rim and a pointed chin guard, leaving the lower face open.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back, side and chin panels; colour 1 on the crown and trim edges; colour 3 on the brow and side accents; colour 2 on the lower neck flare.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cosmic_01.differs: The male helmet's default colour pattern puts light panels over the back and sides, where the female version is mostly near-black.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_01.description: A rounded military tech helmet with a solid visor panel pulled down over the eyes, riveted side plates with round ear discs, and a segmented back shell with a ridge line. Sits snug over the whole skull, leaving the lower face bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side plates, back shell and ear discs; colour 1 on the visor panel and crown; colour 0 on the thin etched trim lines across the visor.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_02.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet with a smooth domed crown, segmented side plates with bolt holes and a round earpiece disc on each side. The visor is raised, leaving the face open, and a ridged band wraps the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown panel and small trim stripes; colour 0 on the side and rear plates and the earpieces; colour 2 on the rear band and gaps.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_03.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet with a smooth cloth-like crown, riveted plated sides, a banded rear neck guard, a tall thin antenna, and ear cups with a boom microphone curving toward the mouth.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Covertmilitary_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown and the trim stripes; colour 0 on the side plates, ear cups, rear band and microphone; colour 2 on the antenna and the ear cup housings.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_01.description: A classic cowboy hat with a creased, softly dented crown and a wide brim that curves up slightly at the sides. It sits low over the brow, giving a western look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and upper brim; the underside of the brim shows darker shading.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_02.description: A wide-brimmed western cowboy hat with a tall, flat-topped, boxy crown with soft creases and a broad, nearly flat brim that angles slightly down at the edges. Sits high on the head, shading the eyes.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; the underside of the brim takes a darker shade of the same colour.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Crumpled_01.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a soft, crumpled crown that is dented and creased, and a flat, slightly wavy brim all round. It sits on top of the head, with a casual, worn western look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Crumpled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, brim and crown alike; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Crumpled_02.description: A battered wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a crumpled, dented crown and a ragged, uneven brim pocked with small holes and worn edges; sits on top of the head with a weathered, tattered look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Crumpled_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, including crown and brim; the holes show gaps rather than a separate colour.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Gunslinger_.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, creased crown pinched into a notch at the front and back. The brim is broad and slightly drooping, and the hat sits low over the brow. A western gunslinger style.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Gunslinger_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, both crown and brim; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Small_02.description: A cowboy hat with a low, softly creased rounded crown and a broad, slightly drooping brim that flares out on all sides. It sits on top of the head, giving a simple western look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Small_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, both crown and brim; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Steampunk_0.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy-style hat with a tall flat-topped crown, a broad sloping brim that droops low over the face, and a studded band with a pair of small goggle lenses on the front. Steampunk western look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Steampunk_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim and the band's upper strip; colour 2 on the crown sides and goggle lenses; colour 3 on the crown top and goggle detailing; colour 1 on the lower hat band and goggle straps.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Tall_01.description: A ten-gallon cowboy hat with a tall, softly creased crown that pinches at the top and a wide, slightly drooping brim. It sits low over the brow, in a classic western style.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Tall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; the underside of the brim takes colour 2.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_01.description: A cowboy hat with a tall, softly creased crown and a wide, irregular brim that dips and curls unevenly at the sides. It sits on top of the head, giving a rough western look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_02.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a tall, creased crown and a brim curled up at the sides. Worn tilted low over the brow, with small worn holes and ragged edges giving a battered frontier look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hat, crown and brim; the small holes and worn spots show other colours only faintly.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_03_G.description: A translucent, ghostly cowboy hat with a tall, slightly dented crown, a thin band around its base and a wide, uneven brim that curls up at the sides. It sits on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cowboyhat_Uneven_03_G.colourAreas: The default material is translucent and glassy, so it mostly ignores the colour scheme; the band shows a faint metallic tint.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Creepy_01.description: A hollow face mask with a long, beak-like pointed chin, a raised central ridge stripe, and swirling raised brow motifs around the eye openings. It covers the face only and looks like a monstrous ritual mask.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Creepy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the central ridge stripe; colour 3 on the raised swirls around the eyes; colour 2 on the thin angular lines near the chin.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Crownsasquatch_01.description: A tribal crown: a flat-topped stitched headband sits on the crown of the head, ringed with tall curved blade-like plumes carved with spiral patterns, a thin central spike, and two narrow cloth flaps hanging by the cheeks.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Crownsasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband and hanging flaps; colour 3 on the tall plumes and central spike; colour 2 on the banding across the plume bases; colour 1 on the stitching.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A wide-brimmed cowboy hat with a low, pinched crown, a broad gently drooping brim with a contrasting edge, and a band of segmented blocks around the base of the crown with thin vertical accents. Sits on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper brim; colour 1 on the segmented hatband; colour 3 on the thin crown accents; colour 2 on the brim edge and underside of the brim.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cyberpunk_01.description: A two-part cyberpunk head piece: a wide curved visor shield covering the eyes and upper face with a nose notch, plus a separate segmented plate across the crown. The bare head shows between them.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Glossy metallic default material largely ignores the scheme; faint colour 1 sheen along the visor and crown plate edges.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Feather_01.description: A full-head bird mask with a long pointed beak, hexagonal eye plates and a jagged-edged brow border, crowned by a ring of spiky feathers that fan around the back of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and feathers; colour 1 on the beak and eye plate insets; colour 3 on the jagged trim around the face edge.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Fedora_01.description: A classic fedora with a short, softly creased crown and a narrow brim that slopes slightly down around the head. A wide band circles the base of the crown, with a thin edge line and a small contrasting patch at the front-right.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Fedora_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 1 on the thin edging lines along the band; colour 3 on the small patch on the band.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Fedorabig_02.description: A wide-brimmed fedora with a tall, softly creased crown and a broad flat brim that sits low over the eyes. A band wraps the base of the crown, with a contrasting patch at the front-right.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Fedorabig_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hatband; colour 3 on the patch on the band; colour 1 on a thin edge line along the band.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Fedoraflat_03.description: A wide-brimmed flat-topped fedora with a softly pinched, dented crown and a broad drooping brim that shades the eyes. A band circles the base of the crown with a contrasting patch at the front. Zoot-suit or noir style.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Fedoraflat_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 3 on the patch at the front of the band.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Fishinghat_01.description: A soft cloth bucket-style fishing hat with a rounded crown and a short downward-sloping brim edged in contrasting trim. A strap band with rows of eyelets circles the crown. It sits on top of the head, casual and outdoorsy.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Fishinghat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the brim edge trim; colour 2 on the band around the crown; colour 3 on the eyelets.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Foxbat_Classic_01.description: A full-head helmet with two large pointed bat-like ears, a central crest running down over the brow and nose, and ribbed inner ear linings. Eye openings and an open jaw guard leave the mouth exposed.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Foxbat_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, ear rims and jaw guard; colour 1 on the top crest, nose stripe and inner ears; colour 3 on the ribs inside the ears.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Foxbat_Classic_01.differs: The male helmet has narrower, taller ears and a slimmer jaw guard that hugs the face more closely.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_01.description: A full-coverage gladiator helmet with a smooth domed shell that flares out at the back and sides like a hood, a slatted face grille, a riveted chin guard, and a row of tall spines running along the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and chin guard; colour 1 on the crest spines; colour 2 on the face grille interior; colour 3 on the slats of the face grille.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_02.description: A full alien gladiator helmet with a smooth, elongated reptilian crown, swept-back ridges with slotted vents, and a rear neck guard with engraved scrollwork. An open face panel ends in a pointed chin, with two small fang-like tusks.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell, crown and neck guard; colour 1 on the face panel and pointed chin; colour 2 on the inner slots and side ridges; colour 3 on the fang-like tusks.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_02_No.description: A full alien gladiator helmet with an elongated, sculpted creature-head crown, swept-back ridged fins along the top and back, and a smooth neck guard with engraved edge detailing. Open face, with fang-like tusks at the brow and hanging cheek plates.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_02_No.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and crown; colour 2 on the swept fins and cheek plates; colour 3 on the fang-like tusks at the brow.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_03.description: A domed gladiator-style helmet with a ring of contrasting spikes around the crown and brow, a tribal face-like emblem on the forehead, ribbed cheek guards, a slotted face bar and a ridged flared rim at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Gladiator_Alien_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet dome and face bars; colour 1 on the ribbed cheek guards and rear rim; colour 2 on the spikes; colour 3 on the forehead emblem and markings.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hardhat_01_Basic.description: A rounded construction-style hardhat with a short front brim, raised ridges over the crown, small clips along the sides, a band around the base and a square badge panel with an emblem on the front.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hardhat_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and brim; colour 2 on the band around the base; colour 1 on the front badge panel.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hardhat_02_Basic.description: A rounded construction-style hardhat with moulded ridges on the dome, a short front brim and a band around the base. A bulky headlamp with a hexagonal housing and round lens is mounted at the front centre.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hardhat_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and brim; colour 2 on the band and the lamp's outer housing; colour 1 on the lamp body; colour 3 on the lamp lens.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hat_Chef_01.description: A tall, puffy chef's hat of soft gathered cloth with vertical folds, billowing above a plain snug headband that sits around the forehead. A playful, casual novelty head piece.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hat_Chef_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 blend across the puffed cloth crown, with colour 1 toward the top; colour 2 on the band around the head.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hat_Crown_01.description: A regal royal crown with a band around the head, arched metal bands rising to a central finial, and a padded cap between the arches with diamond-shaped cutouts. Sits on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hat_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, arches and finial; colour 1 on the padded cap; colour 2 on the diamond patterns; colour 3 on the studs along the band.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hat_Crown_02.description: A tall royal crown with a band of small heart-shaped studs, tall pointed metal arches at front and back, and puffy padded cushion panels filling the gaps. A cross-shaped finial and small spikes rise from the top.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hat_Crown_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, arches and finials; colour 1 on the padded cushions; colour 3 on the heart studs and trim details; colour 2 on the front gem.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hat_Fur_01.description: A tall, cylindrical fur hat with a flat top and thick shaggy sides, sitting on the crown of the head. Its soft, fluffy texture suggests a Russian ushanka-style winter hat.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hat_Fur_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the flat top; colour 2 on the band just below the top; colour 1 on the middle of the sides; colour 0 on the lower rim.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hockey_Mask_01.description: A hockey-style face mask with a smooth rounded shell, angled eye slits, drilled ventilation holes across the cheeks and chin, and a pointed chin. Straps with small studs wrap around a rear cap covering the back of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Hockey_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and the rim around the back; colour 1 on the rear head cap; colour 2 on the strap bars; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Holiday_Hat_01.description: A soft slouchy Santa-style holiday hat with a thick, textured fur-like cuff around the head and a crumpled cone of cloth that droops to one side, ending in a round pompom.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Holiday_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth cone of the hat; colour 1 on the fur cuff band; colour 2 on the pompom.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Horsemask_01.description: A full-head cartoon horse mask with a long muzzle, bulging round eyes, upright pointed ears and a contrasting blaze down the forehead. It has a small flap opening at the back of the neck and gives a comical beast look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Horsemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main head shell; colour 2 on the muzzle, ears and around the eyes; colour 0 on the forehead blaze and eyes.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Horsemask_01.differs: The male mask has no forehead horn and its eyes are plain white, unlike the female version.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Horsemask_Horn_01.description: A single tall spiralling horn that rises from the forehead at a slight forward-leaning angle, tapering to a point, with twisting ridged grooves along its length. Suggests a unicorn or fantasy beast look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Horsemask_Horn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the horn; colour 3 on one twisting spiral band and the base; colour 2 on the recessed spiral grooves; colour 1 on a small patch at the base.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Huntershat_01.description: A fur-look trapper cap with a rounded, paneled crown, a short front brim, a banded edge with contrasting trim and fold-down ear flaps tied with thin dangling cords. Sits snugly on the head in a rugged hunter style.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Huntershat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown panels, brim and ear flaps; colour 1 on the alternating crown panels; colour 2 on the trim band and ties; colour 3 on the small tip at the crown top and flap details.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_01.description: A close-fitting ribbed knit skullcap that sits snugly over the top of the head, ending just above the brow and ears, with two thin contrasting stripes running around the rolled edge. Casual, plain cold-weather style.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed knit body of the cap; colour 1 on the two stripes around the brim.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_01_2.description: A close-fitting skull cap that covers the crown and hugs the head down to the forehead and behind the ears, with a smooth, slightly wrinkled surface and two thin contrasting stripes around the rim.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_01_2.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cap; colour 1 on the two stripes around the rim.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_Reindeer_01.description: A close-fitting knit cap with a rolled brim, small ear tabs, two round eyes and a round nose on the front, and a pair of branching antlers rising from the top. A playful holiday reindeer hat.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Knitcap_Reindeer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap and ear tabs; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the nose; colour 2 on the antlers and the brim band.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_01.description: A close-fitting cloth wrestler's mask covering the whole head, with a seam down the back and centre top, stitched edges, and raised bordered cut-outs for the eyes, nose and mouth. It ends at the base of the skull.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask fabric; colour 1 on the raised borders around the eye, nose and mouth openings; the seam stitching is a slightly darker shade of the fabric.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_02.description: A luchador-style wrestling mask: a snug cloth hood covering the whole head with raised trim outlining butterfly-shaped eye openings and a mouth opening, and a thin edge at the neck. It has a speckled fabric pattern.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised trim around the eyes and mouth; the speckled cloth pattern of the mask does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_03.description: A snug cloth luchador wrestling mask covering the whole head, with open eye holes and mouth opening, contrasting raised trim outlining the eyes and running down the nose, and visible seams over the crown and back.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the mask; colour 1 on the raised trim around the eyes, nose and mouth.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_04.description: A close-fitting luchador wrestling mask of soft fabric that covers the whole head, with large angular eye holes and a mouth opening, each edged in raised contrasting trim. Seams run over the crown and down the back; the mask ends at the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fabric of the mask; colour 1 on the raised trim around the eye holes, nose bridge and mouth opening.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_05.description: A close-fitting luchador-style full-head mask covering the whole head and face, with a smooth face panel, eye openings, a jagged crest-shaped panel over the crown and a separate patch over the chin and mouth.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Maskluchador_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and back of the head; colour 1 on the forehead and side panels and the jaw band; colour 2 on the face panel and the side and back patches; colour 3 on the chin patch.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Militarytall_01.description: A tall, straight-sided cylindrical military shako-style hat with a flat top, a wide contrasting band around the lower half, and a short stiff peak jutting forward over the brow.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Militarytall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crown and the peak; colour 1 on the wide lower band.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Mountie_01.description: A wide-brimmed campaign-style hat with a tall, tapered crown pinched at the top and a broad, gently drooping flat brim. A band with a small contrasting patch at the front circles the base of the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Mountie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band; colour 3 on the small patch at the front of the band; colour 1 on thin edge piping.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Ninja_Mask_01.description: A cloth ninja-style balaclava covering the whole head and lower face, with a horizontal eye slit and rumpled fabric folds around the mouth and cheeks. It gathers snugly at the neck with a loose, wrinkled drape.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Ninja_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cloth hood and face wrap; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Officerhat_01.description: A peaked officer's cap with a wide flat crown that flares over a short band, a small stiff visor at the front, and thin piping around the crown edge. Sits on top of the head in a naval or military style.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Officerhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and band; colour 1 on the visor; colour 3 on the stitched trim strip around the band; colour 2 on the piping edges.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Officerhat_01.differs: The male cap has a plain back band with no contrasting strip across it.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Patriot_Mask_01.description: A close-fitting skullcap helmet with a central raised stripe, a banded rim, and an atom-style emblem on each side. Twin round goggle lenses sit over the eyes, with a pointed beak-like nose guard below. Sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Patriot_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap shell and rim band; colour 2 on the central stripe; colour 1 on the goggle housings, beak guard, lower edge trim and atom emblems; colour 3 on the goggle lenses.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A short, tricorn-style pirate cap sitting high on the head, with a rounded crown, upturned pointed corners edged in contrasting trim, a small contrasting emblem at the front and a large swept plume of feathers rising from the top and back.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap body and feather quills; colour 1 on the edge trim and the feather vanes; colour 2 on the front emblem and feather tips; colour 3 on the thin piping and feather midribs.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Pirate_Hat_Feather_01.description: A tricorne pirate hat with a rounded crown and a wide, wavy brim turned up into three points, edged in contrasting piping and studded underneath, with a band around the base and a cluster of long feathers swept out from one side.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Pirate_Hat_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and upper brim; colour 3 on the brim edge piping; colour 1 on the hat band and some feather tips; colour 2 on the underside of the brim and the front emblem.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Piratehatwide_01.description: A wide bicorne pirate hat with a low rounded crown and brim folded up at the front, back and sides into a broad triangular shape. A narrow edging runs along the folded rims. Sits on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Piratehatwide_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat body; colour 1 on the edging along the brim folds.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Piratehatwide_04.description: A tricorn pirate hat with a rounded crown and a broad brim folded up into three points, edged with contrasting binding. Small stitched cross marks decorate the brim sides. It sits on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Piratehatwide_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and inner brim; colour 1 on the brim edge binding; colour 2 on the cross stitch marks; colour 3 on a thin line under the brim.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Police_01.description: A police-style peaked cap with a soft, full rounded crown, a narrow contrasting band around the base, a short curved visor at the front, and a small shield-shaped badge above the visor. Sits level on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Police_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown; colour 3 on the band around the base; colour 1 on the visor; colour 2 on the badge patch.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Power_01.description: A close-fitting helmet with a rounded crown, a slim central slot on top, and small pointed fins at the brow. A wide band wraps across the eyes, and angular side plates flank the cheeks; sits over the whole head, with the face and jaw left open.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and the side plates; colour 1 on the crown panel; colour 3 on the band across the eyes; colour 2 on the edge outlines and the slot.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Qlyphotic_01.description: A monstrous full-head helm with a rounded domed crown, a thin central crest, swept-out curved horns at each side and a masked face with small studs, plus a long veil-like drape falling to the knees with a tattered, hole-ridden hem and two trailing streamers.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Qlyphotic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, mask and upper drape; colour 1 on the horns, crest and the lower drape and streamers, fading in as a gradient; colour 3 on the small eye and stud details.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Reactor_01.description: An angular faceted helmet with a contrasting pointed visor opening over the eyes, two tall swept-up horn-like fins on top, and slim side cheek pieces with small hinged jaw guards; leaves the mouth and chin bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the horn fins and cheek and jaw pieces; colour 2 on the visor opening; colour 3 on the small side lights.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Reactor_02.description: A full-head sci-fi helmet with a smooth domed crown, two tall pointed ear fins, a swept visor-like band across the face, a fanged lower jaw guard and a bulky segmented padded collar at the back of the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell, ear fins and jaw guard; colour 1 on the side bands, the crown tint and the padded neck collar; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Reactor_04.description: A sleek, angular sci-fi helmet covering the whole head, with a smooth domed crown, raised ridged crest panels, a pointed V-shaped face guard and a wide flared collar band at the base with vented side inserts.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and outer edge trim; colour 1 on the face guard and lower collar band; colour 2 on the crest ridges; colour 3 on the side vent inserts and small rivets.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Sacred_01.description: A full winged helmet with a smooth domed crown, a slotted faceguard with a pointed chin, a leaf-patterned crest plate across the brow, and two tall feathered wings sweeping up from the sides. Heroic, mythic look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the wing edges; colour 1 on the trim lines, faceguard borders and wing feathers; colour 3 on the brow crest plate.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Santabeer_01.description: A novelty Santa-style drinking hat: a slouchy cloth cap with a thick fluffy cuff and a pom-pom tail, carrying a beverage can on each side joined by thin tubes that run down to the mouth.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Santabeer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hat cap; colour 2 on the fluffy cuff and pom-pom; colour 0 on the cans; colour 3 on the tubes.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Sharkfin_01.description: A close-fitting, smooth head covering with a tall curved fin sweeping up and back from the crown, a diagonal band across the brow, and a pointed lower edge over the nose. It leaves the mouth and chin bare, in a shark-like superhero style.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin tip and the pointed lower edge; colour 1 on the main hood surface; colour 2 on the diagonal band across the brow; colour 3 on the small side panels.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Sharkfin_02.description: A close-fitting full-head hood with a tall, backswept shark-fin crest running along the crown, angular contrasting panels across the brow and sides, and a pointed chin section. The face is covered.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Sharkfin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin tip and the chin and lower-back panels; colour 1 on the main hood sides and the central crest strip; colour 2 on the top brow panel and the back neck patch; colour 3 on the small side inset panels.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Socrates_01.description: A smooth, elongated full-head helmet that tapers to a point above the crown, with a blank faceplate and thin contrasting trim lines running down the front and sides. The back has a small panel with three dots and a rear vent.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 3 on the trim lines, the dots and the small nub at the top; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Socrates_02.description: An alien full-head helmet with a smooth, elongated dome ending in a crown of jagged spikes at the top, with a pointed chin, teardrop eye openings at the sides and thin vein-like ridges across the surface.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Socrates_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spikes; colour 3 on the branching vein lines and the slashes near the face.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Space_01.description: A sleek sci-fi helmet with a smooth domed shell that has a large V-shaped opening at the front, so the face shows. A pointed mask covers the lower face and jaw. Thin contrasting trim outlines the opening.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed shell; colour 3 on the trim around the front opening; colour 1 on the lower face mask and the rim edge; colour 2 on the darker mask insert.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Steam_Plague_Mask_01.description: A full-head plague doctor mask shaped like a bird skull, with a long pointed beak, round goggle-style eye lenses, stitched-look markings, a padded cap with cut-out openings and a crown of tall spikes around the top.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Steam_Plague_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull-like shell and crown spikes; colour 3 on the padded cap panels; colour 1 on the stitch markings; colour 2 on the beak tip and the eye lens rims.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Swat_01.description: A rounded tactical combat helmet with a smooth shell and slim brim, padded ear and neck flaps wrapping the sides and back of the head, and a thin chin strap. Sits snugly on the crown, leaving the face open.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Swat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the padded ear and neck flaps and the inner front band; colour 2 on the chin strap.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A partial, open-faced helmet shell covering the crown and forehead, with a smooth curved plate that extends into a beak-like nose guard and a bordered rim with thin side flaps beside the cheeks. Suggests a bird-people costume.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main forehead and crown plate; colour 2 on the raised rim, nose guard and side flaps.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tight_Gogglessport_01.description: Sport-style wraparound goggles with a single wide visor lens across both eyes, a raised rim on top, small angular side blocks, and a broad flat elastic strap running around the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tight_Gogglessport_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and side blocks; colour 1 on the lens; colour 3 on the small accent strips near the temples; colour 2 on the head strap.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tight_Paintball_01.description: An open-topped visor band that circles the head like a sun visor, with a wide angular brim projecting over the eyes. The brim has a raised central panel and textured, carbon-like inserts. Sporty sci-fi look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tight_Paintball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and rim; colour 1 on the raised central brim panel; colour 2 on the underside of the brim; colour 3 on the textured rear band and inner strip.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tight_Russianhat_01.description: A fur ushanka cold-weather hat with a rounded crown, a front brim panel and side ear flaps, with a textured shaggy surface and contrasting edging between the panels. It sits snugly on the head, leaving the face open.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tight_Russianhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back panel and the upper crown fur; colour 1 on the front brim panel and the ear flaps; colour 2 on the edging between panels.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01.description: A tall, slightly tapered top hat with a flat crown, a broad flat brim and a wide contrasting band around the base of the crown. It sits high on the head, giving a formal, gentlemanly look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01_Glitter.description: A tall top hat with straight cylindrical crown, flat top and a modest wavy brim, wrapped by a wide contrasting band. Large freestanding metal "10" numerals stand against the front of the band, giving an anniversary look.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim, with a speckled glitter texture; colour 1 on the hat band; the "10" numerals appear as unpainted metal that ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tophat_01_Glitter.differs: The male hat adds large metal "10" numerals attached to the front of the band.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tophat_Wizards_01.description: A tall cloth top hat with a slightly slanted crown, creased fabric and a narrow flat brim, wrapped in a knotted band whose ragged ribbon tails hang down the back of the neck. Sits on the head; whimsical wizard or formal style.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tophat_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 2 on the hat band and hanging ribbon tails.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Tophat_Wizards_01.differs: The ribbon tails are longer and hang loosely down the back, with a knot at the rear of the band.

Male/M_Helmet_Face_Witch_01.description: A classic witch hat: a tall, crumpled cone that curls to a bent tip, with a wide wavy brim and a contrasting band around the base of the cone. It sits on top of the head, and the brim shades the eyes.
Male/M_Helmet_Face_Witch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone and the brim; colour 1 on the band around the base of the cone.

Male/M_Helmet_Facemask_Defender_01.description: A close-fitting cloth cowl-style head mask covering the skull and upper face with eye and nose openings, a diamond-shaped forehead plate, and angular swept-back side plates with slashed vents over the ears.
Male/M_Helmet_Facemask_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl and face cover; colour 1 on the forehead diamond and side plates; colour 3 on the chevron mark and the slashes in the side plates.

Male/M_Helmet_Facemask_Lockbox_65_01.description: A fox-like face mask covering the brow, eyes and nose, with two tall pointed ears tipped by small beads, a raised central crest plate with a club-shaped emblem, and flared scalloped cheek edges.
Male/M_Helmet_Facemask_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mask shell and ear tips; colour 0 on the crest plate, ear edging and trim lines; colour 2 on the club emblem and ear interiors.

Male/M_Helmet_Falcon_01.description: A falcon-themed full head mask helmet with a hooked beak over the nose and mouth, angry eye openings, swept-back wing-like feather blades rising from the sides, and dangling feather tufts at the cheeks.
Male/M_Helmet_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and wing feathers; colour 1 on the beak, brow crest and headband; colour 2 on the crest feathers and eye surround; colour 3 on the cheek tufts and eye glints.

Male/M_Helmet_Flower_01.description: A full head covering shaped like a flower: a rounded cowl around the face opening, ringed by a single row of large rounded petals with teardrop inlays, held by a contrasting band at the back. Whimsical fantasy style.
Male/M_Helmet_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the petals and the back of the cowl; colour 1 on the teardrop petal inlays and the cowl sides; colour 2 on the band behind the petals and the crown of the cowl; colour 3 on small accents at the cowl edge by the cheeks.

Male/M_Helmet_Fox_01.description: A full cartoon fox head mask with a pointed snout, upright rounded ears, and rows of small leaf-like spikes over the crown and back. It has a contrasting lower jaw with a toothy grin and big round googly eyes.
Male/M_Helmet_Fox_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head, ears and eyeballs; colour 1 on the lower jaw and the tips of the scale-like spikes; colour 3 on the teeth and mouth lining; colour 2 on the nose and pupils.
Male/M_Helmet_Fox_01.differs: The male version has big round cartoon eyeballs with pupils instead of hollow contrasting eye sockets.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Anniversary_Defender_.description: A full-coverage retro superhero helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a raised U-shaped band over the crown, a broad panel on each side of the crown and a solid faceplate with a thin horizontal trim line. Open at the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Anniversary_Defender_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell, faceplate and centre crown panel; colour 0 on the U-shaped band and the trim lines around the faceplate and lower edge; colour 3 on the side crown panels.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Anniversary_Defender_.differs: The male helmet has a solid opaque faceplate with no see-through visor.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Bounty_01.description: A full-coverage sci-fi bounty hunter helmet with a smooth domed shell, a raised central crest ridge running front to back, a T-shaped visor opening and two horizontal bands around the head. Trimmed edges give a rugged military look.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome and face plate; colour 3 on the crest ridge and edge trim; colour 1 on the rear panel and inset cheek panels; colour 2 on the horizontal bands and the visor and rim edging.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Bounty_02.description: A full-coverage helmet in a Spartan-like style: rounded shell with a raised central crest ridge, a T-shaped open face slot, flared rear neck guard, and boxy ear-mounted modules on each side.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek and side plates; colour 1 on the top panels and brow band; colour 2 on the crest, outer shell edging and rear shell; colour 3 on the side ear modules.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Cosmos_02.description: A full-head angular helmet with a pointed V-shaped front tapering to a chin point, a faceted crown, a raised diamond panel at the brow, and winged points flaring at the rear corners.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and front shell plates; colour 2 on the diamond brow panel; colour 3 on the V-shaped stripe along the front edge; colour 1 on the rear shell, side panels and flared points.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Cosmos_02.differs: The brow diamond is a separate contrasting panel in colour 2, and the shell has a matte finish rather than a metallic one.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Sandstorm_02.description: A full-coverage helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a raised angular crest band running front to back, and a contrasting faceplate with a tinted visor and side cheek vents. A small rear latch sits at the base. Sci-fi tactical look.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell sides; colour 1 on the crest band and the rear and brow plates; colour 3 on the panel between the crest bands; colour 2 on the faceplate frame and rear latch.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Super_Retro_Destroyer.description: A full retro-villain helmet with a rounded dome, a central spike, and two tall curved horn-like fins sweeping up from the brow. It has angular eye openings, a respirator-style mouth filter, and a metal frame around the jaw.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Super_Retro_Destroyer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and the frame around the jaw; colour 2 on the horn fins and brow plates; colour 1 on the respirator straps and mouth piece; colour 3 on the filter centre.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Techno_01.description: A full-coverage techno helmet made of faceted, hexagonal armour plates, with a raised centre ridge, vented ear pods, a swept V-shaped visor panel and an open chin guard. It sits over the whole head and suggests a sci-fi or cyber look.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, ridge and ear pod housings; colour 3 on the visor panel and ear vents; colour 1 on the cheek panels, the forehead badge and the rear neck light.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Trooper_01.description: A full-coverage sentai-style helmet with a smooth rounded dome, a contrasting band across the brow, angular visor recess, octagonal ear discs and a pointed lower jaw guard with a ribbed vent panel at the mouth.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and face shell; colour 2 on the brow band and ear discs; colour 1 on the jaw guard and neck section; colour 3 on the mouth vent.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Trooper_02.description: A full-coverage sentai-style helmet with a smooth rounded shell, a raised central fin from brow to nape, chevron stripes at the back, angular side vents and an open angular mouth cutout. Sits over the whole head.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Trooper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the stripes and trim lines; colour 2 on the crest fin and side pods; colour 3 on the mouth opening.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Trooper_03.description: A full-face sentai-style helmet with a smooth rounded shell, large angular eye lenses framed by chevron stripes, a toothy grille mouth and a band around the jaw with square ear modules on each side.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Trooper_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the crown panel, chevron stripes and eye rims; colour 1 on the jaw band and ear modules; colour 3 on the mouth grille.

Male/M_Helmet_Full_Trooper_04.description: A full-face sentai-style helmet with a smooth rounded dome, a large pointed visor plate edged in a contrasting rim, a chin guard band, side pods with small square inserts, and two tall slanted antenna fins rising from the sides.
Male/M_Helmet_Full_Trooper_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, visor plate and side pods; colour 1 on the chin guard band; colour 2 on the visor rim; colour 3 on the antenna fins and side pod inserts.

Male/M_Helmet_Fullbandana_01.description: A close-fitting cloth head wrap that covers the whole scalp and brow, with a knotted tie and short loose ends at the back. A small atom-style emblem sits on the forehead. A superhero look.
Male/M_Helmet_Fullbandana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap fabric; colour 1 on the atom emblem; the knot uses colour 0.

Male/M_Helmet_Fullhelmet_Crown_Spiked_01.description: A spiked metal crown band circling the head, with tall curved blade-like spikes rising around it, a taller central spike over a pointed brow guard, and a small teardrop gem at the front.
Male/M_Helmet_Fullhelmet_Crown_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, brow guard and spikes; colour 1 on the inner band strip; colour 3 on the teardrop gems.

Male/M_Helmet_Gem_Crown_01.description: A crown of tall, jagged crystal shards rising from a ring of smaller chunky crystals that circles the top of the head. The shards fan upward and outward in a spiky, fantasy style.
Male/M_Helmet_Gem_Crown_01.colourAreas: The crystal material is glossy and largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint from colour 1 shows in the crystal ring and some facets.

Male/M_Helmet_Gladiator_02_1.description: A smooth, rounded full-head helmet in a tall egg shape with a cluster of round breathing holes on the front face and no eye slits. A thick padded roll sits around the neck opening, and scratches mark the surface.
Male/M_Helmet_Gladiator_02_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the padded neck roll; colour 3 on the scratches and blood-like marks.

Male/M_Helmet_Gladiator_04.description: A fantasy gladiator helmet with a domed crown, a nose-guard face opening with cheek plates, tall swept-back horn-like spikes at the temples, and layered wing-like fins fanning out from each side. A broad neck plate hangs at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Gladiator_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, nose guard, cheek plates and horn spikes; colour 1 on the dome, back neck plate and outer side fins; colour 3 on the zigzag crown lines and the lower side fins; colour 2 on the middle side fin layers.

Male/M_Helmet_Gladiator_05.description: A sleek, angular helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, with a raised central crest, long swept-up blade fins at the temples, round ear discs, and a soft neck guard at the back. The face is left open.
Male/M_Helmet_Gladiator_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown and central crest panels and the edge trim; colour 0 on the side plates and swept fins; colour 2 on the ear discs and neck guard.

Male/M_Helmet_Graduationcap_01.description: A classic graduation mortarboard: a snug, low cap crown topped by a large flat square board, with a cord running from a centre button to a hanging tassel at the side of the head. Sits on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Graduationcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap crown and the centre button; colour 1 on the flat square board; colour 3 on the cord and tassel; colour 2 on the tassel knot.

Male/M_Helmet_Guardian_01.description: A full dragon-head helmet with a snouted muzzle, bulging eyes, swept-back flame-like fins at the temples, a furry mane around the jaw, and two branching antler horns on top; worn over the whole head, leaving the mouth visible.
Male/M_Helmet_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the snout, fins and antlers; colour 1 on the fur mane, antler rings and line patterns; colour 2 on the crown plate and swirl details; colour 3 on the nose studs, eyes and flame edges.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_01.description: A close-fitting half helmet that covers the crown, sides and back of the head, leaving the face open. A layered upper shell with a swept-back brow ridge sits over a smooth lower cap, with thin piping and a rim band at the base.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower cap and inner lining; colour 1 on the upper shell; colour 3 on the rectangular side patches; colour 2 on the piping and bottom rim.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_02.description: A close-fitting half helmet like a swim cap, with a smooth rounded crown, a ridge of separate side and rear panels, and a thin rimmed edge framing the face and ears; a separate band crosses the forehead.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown; colour 1 on the side and upper rear panels; colour 3 on the lower rear panels and forehead band; colour 2 on the rim edging.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Aquatic_02.differs: The male version adds a separate brow band across the forehead under the front edge, and its front rim is more open and rounded.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Deity_01.description: A close-fitting skullcap helmet with a seamed crown that dips to a point at the brow, plus rounded side panels covering the ears and temples. Thin edging outlines the lower rim. Sleek, superhero-style headwear.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and back of the cap; colour 1 on the side ear panels; colour 2 on the thin edging along the rim.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Deity_02.description: A close-fitting half helmet made of concentric angular bands that arc from the crown down to the temples and back of the head, leaving the face open. It has a chevron-like layered profile and a sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Deity_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outermost crown band; colour 1 on the second band; colour 2 on the third band; colour 3 on the innermost front band and edge lining.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Deity_03.description: A half helmet that caps the top of the head like a smooth shell, with a raised trimmed rim, a pointed shield-shaped panel on the forehead and an open back and face. Suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Deity_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the raised rim trim; colour 2 on the border around the forehead panel; colour 3 on the forehead panel inset.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.description: An Egyptian-style headdress helmet with a striped cloth-like nemes drape falling past the ears and down the back, topped by a bird-like beaked crest with curled horn shapes and a segmented side plate.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Eagle_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the striped drape; colour 3 on the stripes and edge piping; colour 1 on the segmented plates and crown panel; colour 2 on the beak crest and curled horns.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_01.description: A rounded plate helmet with an open face and a V-shaped brow, a raised central crest strip carrying three tall pointed spikes, and scalloped contrasting panels on the sides and back. Sits snugly over the crown and down to the nape.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 1 on the scalloped side and back panels and the edge trim; colour 3 on the crest strip; colour 2 on the spikes and the groove lines.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_02.description: A knightly full-face helmet with a horizontal visor slit, a stitched-mouth grille, small studs and spikes at the brow, and trimmed edges. A long swept-back mane of hair flows from the crown well past the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the hair mane; colour 1 on the edge trim, brow line and studs; colour 3 on the visor slit; colour 2 on the mouth grille.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_02.differs: The male mane sweeps back in a longer, larger crest that trails behind the head, rather than the female's tall bunched topknot.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_03.description: A rounded open-faced helmet with a nose guard and curved cheek edges, topped by a large swept-back mane of shaggy hair or fur that streams down the back in loose locks. Suggests a heraldic fantasy warrior.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Heraldry_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the mane; colour 1 on the front brow plate; colour 3 on the central stripe on the brow.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Nightvisor_02.description: A half-helmet visor band wrapping around the head, with a single large round lens over one eye, a broad strap with a buckle at the side, and a padded crown strip running from front to back over the scalp.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Nightvisor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main visor band and strap; colour 1 on the crown strip and lens ring accents; colour 3 on the small ribbed studs and the centre stripe of the crown; colour 2 on the lens and buckle.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Norse_01.description: A Norse-style half helmet with a domed cap, a central ridge band, knotwork patterns, a nose guard, spectacle-like eye rims with brow bands, cheek guards, and a flared neck guard at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Norse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and neck guard; colour 1 on the ridge band, knotwork, nose guard, eye rims and cheek guards; colour 2 on the brow bands and the band around the helmet base.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Norse_02.description: A close-fitting Norse-style half helmet with a rounded dome, a central ridge stripe and knotwork chain patterns. Thick raised brow pieces sit over a contrasting brow panel, with open cheek guards and a flared neck guard. No nose guard.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Norse_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, brow panel and lower neck guard; colour 1 on the ridge stripe, knotwork patterns and cheek and neck panels; colour 2 on the brow ridges and rim band.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Norse_02.differs: The male helmet adds thick raised brow ridges with a light panel across the eyes, where the female version has only a slim brow band.

Male/M_Helmet_Half_Victory_01.description: A smooth rounded helmet shell with a central stripe and a pointed brow opening that leaves the face exposed. Tall swept-back horn-like fins rise from each side, with smaller curved blades below them. Superhero style.
Male/M_Helmet_Half_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the large upper side horns; colour 1 on the central stripe and the curved side blades; colour 2 on the lower rear blades; colour 3 on the inner face opening and the edge piping.

Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Baseballcap_02.description: A casual baseball cap worn forward: a rounded multi-panel crown with a curved, slightly flared front brim, stitched seams and a separate rear panel. It sits snugly on top of the head, leaving the face uncovered.
Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Baseballcap_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front panels, brim and side seam panels; colour 0 on the rear crown panels; colour 2 on the stitched piping and seam lines.

Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Baseballcap_03.description: A casual baseball cap worn backwards: a rounded, paneled crown fits snugly on the head with the stiff brim pointing down the back of the neck, and contrasting stitched seams run along the panels and brim edge.
Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Baseballcap_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panels of the crown; colour 1 on the rear panels and the brim; colour 2 on the stitching and seams.

Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Baseballcap_04.description: A casual baseball cap with a curved brim and a six-panel crown with contrasting seam piping, worn with the brim to the front. A knotted headband wraps around the base of the crown, with loose tails hanging at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Baseballcap_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown panels at the back and sides; colour 2 on the brim and the front panel; colour 3 on the seam piping; colour 1 on the knotted band and its tails.

Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Fez_01.description: A classic fez: a short, flat-topped, slightly tapered cylindrical cap that sits upright on the crown of the head, with a thin cord running across the top to a hanging tassel at the side.
Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Fez_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap body; colour 2 on the cord across the top; colour 3 on the small tassel cap; colour 1 on the tassel.

Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Madjester_01.description: A four-pronged jester cap made of patchwork cloth with visible stitching. Each rounded, floppy horn arches out and down from the crown and ends in a small bell-like tassel. It sits on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main patchwork sections; colour 1 on larger patches and the tassel tips; colour 3 on the smaller patches at the horn bends; colour 2 on the stitching.
Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Madjester_01.differs: The male hat has thicker, rounder horns with longer hanging tassels and a different patch layout, with more of the bright patches on the horn tops.

Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Martialartsheadband_02.description: A martial-arts cloth headband wrapped around the forehead, tied in a knot at the back of the head with two long straight tails hanging down the nape. Simple, casual fighter style.
Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Martialartsheadband_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole headband, knot and tails.
Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Martialartsheadband_02.differs: The male tails are longer, flatter and hang straight down the back, and they spread slightly apart.

Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Persian_Turban_01.description: A rounded turban of wrapped, swirling cloth folds that covers the whole head above the brow, with a contrasting inner band at the forehead and a jewelled brooch at the front holding a tall upright feather.
Male/M_Helmet_Hat_Persian_Turban_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped cloth; colour 2 on the inner band and the feather; colour 3 on the brooch gem; colour 1 on the brooch setting.

Male/M_Helmet_Hats_Spy_01.description: A small rounded bowler-style hat with a domed crown and a short, slightly angular brim, wrapped by a band with a layered rosette flower on one side. Sits snugly on top of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Hats_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band and the centre of the flower; colour 0 on the outer flower petals.

Male/M_Helmet_Headcage_01.description: A open-frame cage worn over the whole head: vertical metal bars meet at a small round cap on top and are joined by horizontal bands, with small rivet-like studs at the crossings and a ring of spokes at the base.
Male/M_Helmet_Headcage_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bars, bands and top cap; colour 1 on the studs at the bar crossings.

Male/M_Helmet_Headset_01.description: A slim communications headset: a thin band arcs over the top of the head to a rounded ear cup on one side, with a tall antenna, a small block on the other temple and a thin boom microphone curving toward the mouth.
Male/M_Helmet_Headset_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the headband, ear cup, antenna and microphone boom; colour 0 on the small temple block.

Male/M_Helmet_Helmetextra_Lockbox_66_02.description: A smooth, angular full helmet that covers the skull and back of the head, with a blocky face mask showing a nose ridge, angled eye slits and a grille-like glyph on the chin. Contrasting trim bands run over the crown and back.
Male/M_Helmet_Helmetextra_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the face mask, chin plate and trim bands across the crown and back; colour 3 on the outline around the eyes and mouth.

Male/M_Helmet_Hood_Dark_01.description: A soft cloth hood with a pointed peak that sweeps back from the crown, draped folds over the face opening, and a V-shaped front edge that rests on the upper chest. Contrasting stitched trim runs along the opening. Assassin-style.
Male/M_Helmet_Hood_Dark_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood cloth; colour 2 on the stitched trim along the face opening.

Male/M_Helmet_Hood_Vigilante_01.description: A soft cloth hood with a pointed peak that drapes over the head and gathers loosely at the nape. Contrasting trim outlines the wide face opening, which leaves the lower face mostly uncovered.
Male/M_Helmet_Hood_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood cloth; colour 2 on the trim around the face opening.
Male/M_Helmet_Hood_Vigilante_01.differs: The male hood has a more open face area, without the fabric panel across the lower face seen on the female version.

Male/M_Helmet_Horns_Ragingbull_01.description: A pair of bull horns joined by a continuous curved band across the forehead, with segmented plated sections that sweep outward and end in sharp upturned tips. Sits high on the head like a horned crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Horns_Ragingbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the centre forehead plate and the horn tips; colour 1 on the outer band segments; colour 2 on the band sections near the ends of the curve.

Male/M_Helmet_Jester_01.description: A jester's cap with two soft, floppy lobes split down the middle, each trailing back into a long curling tail tipped with a small metal star. A contrasting band with diamond-shaped jewels circles the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Jester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one lobe and its tail; colour 1 on the other lobe and its tail; colour 2 on the headband; colour 3 on the diamond gems in the band; the star tips take the metal look.

Male/M_Helmet_Junkbot_01.description: A bowl-shaped colander helmet worn low over the brow, with a caged light bulb on top and two bulbous knob lights angled out from either side. Small hooks hang at the rim. Junkyard robot style.
Male/M_Helmet_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bowl body, bulb cage and knob tips; colour 1 on the bowl's broad band and the bulb top; colour 2 on the rim underside and the base around the bulb; colour 3 on the knob lights.

Male/M_Helmet_Junkbot_02.description: An upturned kitchen colander worn as a helmet: a faceted bowl dome with a short raised rim on top, small round holes, and little wire loop handles at the sides. Sits low over the brow, junkyard-robot comic style.
Male/M_Helmet_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, handles and the bowl's base panels; colour 1 on the large bowl panels; colour 2 on the diagonal stripe panels; colour 3 on the small rectangular patch near the front.

Male/M_Helmet_Kabuto_01.description: A Japanese kabuto-style helmet with a rounded dome front carved as a snarling fanged beast face, wide flared neck guards and side flaps studded with dots, a decorative knot finial on top, and a tied chin cord.
Male/M_Helmet_Kabuto_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and beast face; colour 1 on the knot finial, chin cord and the outer face of the neck guards; colour 2 on the guard edging; colour 3 on the dots, fangs and small accents.

Male/M_Helmet_Knight_01.description: A full-face knight's helmet with a rounded domed crown, a raised central crest ridge, curved ribbed grooves across the top, and a pointed visor-like faceplate that ends in a wedge over the chin. Hinge plates and small rivets sit at the sides.
Male/M_Helmet_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and faceplate; colour 1 on the central crest ridge and the rim trim; colour 2 on the grooves; colour 3 on the rivets at the sides.

Male/M_Helmet_Lemurian_Fin_01.description: A crest of three finned ridges running front to back over the top of the head, each a webbed membrane with long curved spines and a tall central spike, giving a mohawk-like aquatic monster look.
Male/M_Helmet_Lemurian_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spines and fin ribs; colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 3 on the spots across the membrane.

Male/M_Helmet_Lemurian_Fin_02.description: A single tall fin crest running front to back along the centre of the head like a mohawk: a thin webbed membrane held up by curved, tapering spines that flare outward and sweep backward.
Male/M_Helmet_Lemurian_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved spines and the edge of the fin; colour 0 on the webbed membrane, with colour 3 on the spots and colour 2 shading near the spine bases.

Male/M_Helmet_Lemurian_Fin_03.description: A pair of large fin-like crests rising from either side of the top of the head, each a webbed membrane with spread, curved spines that flare outward and sweep back toward the nape. Aquatic, monstrous look.
Male/M_Helmet_Lemurian_Fin_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 1 on the spines and edge ribs; colour 3 on the spots across the membrane; colour 2 on the shaded bases of the membrane near the spines.

Male/M_Helmet_Lion_Helmet_01.description: A lion-head headpiece worn over the head with the face showing beneath the brow. It has rounded ears, a broad snout and a shaggy, jagged mane of long tapering locks that falls behind and around the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Lion_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the head and parts of the mane; colour 1 on the snout and many mane locks; colour 2 on the spiky mane tufts and fangs; colour 3 on the ear insides and small accents.
Male/M_Helmet_Lion_Helmet_01.differs: The male version has a longer, more strand-like mane with large colour 1 areas over the snout and locks, and colour 2 and 3 accents, whereas the female one is mostly colour 0.

Male/M_Helmet_Lockbox_65_01.description: An oversized, wide conical parasol-style hat with a ribbed brim that slopes down over the shoulders. It has hanging tassels and beads around the rim, a small ornate horned crest on top, and an inner headband loop.
Male/M_Helmet_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the broad hat canopy and inner band; colour 0 on the crest ornament and small beads; colour 2 on the tassels and hair-like tuft; colour 3 on the small crest gem.
Male/M_Helmet_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The male hat has a steeper, more pronounced cone that slopes down toward the rim, rather than sitting nearly flat.

Male/M_Helmet_Lockbox_66_01.description: A beast-like head piece with a hard bird-of-prey mask covering the forehead and upper face, and a layered crest of overlapping feather plates sweeping back over the crown, ending in pointed tips and small horn spikes.
Male/M_Helmet_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the beak mask and the fade at the crest front; colour 1 on the feather plates; colour 2 on the darker rear feathers and mask trim; colour 3 on the eyes and the spike tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Lockbox_66_02.description: A full helmet styled as a tribal mask: a face plate with a carved grinning mouth and a central oval gem, a broad fan-shaped crest of tapering feather spikes around the brow, and a smooth rounded back shell.
Male/M_Helmet_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest frame, helmet back shell and chin edges; colour 1 on the face plate, feather bodies and back stripe; colour 2 on the recessed forehead panel and feather bases; colour 3 on the oval gem, mouth line, crest insets and feather tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A full-coverage metal helmet with a domed crown ringed by tall curved spikes, a broad contrasting band around the brow, a pointed nose guard and narrow eye slits, covering the head to the neck like a villain's war helm.
Male/M_Helmet_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and helmet shell; colour 1 on the spikes, brow band and nose guard; colour 3 on the glowing eye slits.

Male/M_Helmet_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A full-face fantasy helmet in the style of a Greco-Roman warrior: a rounded cap with a T-shaped opening, a small gem on the brow, a spiked crest and a tall swept-back plume of layered locks flowing down the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and the plume; colour 1 on the face panels, the brow band and the streaks in the plume; colour 2 on the edge trim around the opening; colour 3 on the brow gem.

Male/M_Helmet_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A full sci-fi superhero helmet with a rounded shell, angular tinted visor openings, a separate lower face guard, and a short collar at the neck. Long swept-back spikes flare from each side like fins.
Male/M_Helmet_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and collar; colour 1 on the trim lines, visor rim and lower face guard; colour 2 on the visor and the back vent panel; colour 3 on the side spikes and the small brow mark.

Male/M_Helmet_Mouthless_Mask_01.description: A face-covering monstrous mask with smooth, angular features, hollow contrasting eye sockets and a blank skin-like area where the mouth would be, with two small fang-like tusks at the chin. A thin band wraps around the back of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Mouthless_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face and fangs; colour 1 on the shadowed edges around the eyes; colour 2 on the eye sockets; the rear band shows a metallic light tone from colour 0.

Male/M_Helmet_Mutated_01.description: A full-head mutated hood of lumpy, fleshy folds and ridged tendrils, with a large open face gap and a short rim ending near the jaw. Studded with bulbous growths; monstrous, organic look.
Male/M_Helmet_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy surface; colour 1 on the larger bulbous growths and small patches; colour 2 on the small glossy nodules.
Male/M_Helmet_Mutated_01.differs: The male version ends near the jaw with a wider face opening, without the longer draping neck section of the female version.

Male/M_Helmet_Odragon_01.description: A full dragon-head helmet with a snouted face, fanged open jaw, glowing eyes, a pair of long swept-back horns, and frilled spiky fins around the cheeks and back of the skull. A central stripe runs over the crown, with small studs along the brow.
Male/M_Helmet_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell, horns and fins; colour 1 on the crown stripe, nose, fin edging and horn tips; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the studs and inner jaw.
Male/M_Helmet_Odragon_01.differs: The male helmet is opaque and painted, with a crown stripe, studded brow, contrasting eyes and edged fins, rather than a translucent glassy shell.

Male/M_Helmet_Partialmask_Space_01.description: A rounded, helmet-like head piece with a smooth domed shell and a thin open frame that wraps around the cheeks and under the chin, leaving the face exposed. Sleek, futuristic, sporty-looking.
Male/M_Helmet_Partialmask_Space_01.colourAreas: The whole piece appears near-and glossy, so the colour scheme seems largely ignored; no separate colour slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Pilgrim_Hat_01.description: A pilgrim-style hat with a tall, slightly tapered flat-topped crown and a wide, gently drooping brim with a thin contrasting edge. A broad band with a square buckle wraps the base of the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Pilgrim_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 2 on the buckle; colour 3 on the brim edge trim.
Male/M_Helmet_Pilgrim_Hat_01.differs: The male hat has the default pattern of a solid crown and brim with a contrasting band and a thin contrasting brim edge, whereas the female version is split into large colour-blocked panels.

Male/M_Helmet_Pot_01.description: A novelty cooking pot worn upside down as a helmet: a short cylindrical metal body with a rolled rim sitting low over the brow and a flat base on top, plus a thin curved handle sticking out sideways.
Male/M_Helmet_Pot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pot walls and rim; colour 1 on the flat base on top and the small handle mount; colour 2 on the handle.

Male/M_Helmet_Puppy_Ear_01.description: A pair of small, pointed puppy ears that sit on top of the head, one on each side. Each is a short, flat, angular flap that flops outward and slightly down. A cute, animal-themed accessory.
Male/M_Helmet_Puppy_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer surfaces of both ears; colour 0 on the highlighted inner edges and tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Qularr_Villain_01.description: An insect-like carapace helmet: a smooth pointed dome over the crown with a patterned front panel, and stacked, overlapping blade-like plates wrapping the back of the head. The face stays open.
Male/M_Helmet_Qularr_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and the swept back plates; colour 1 on the front panel and the inner lining; colour 3 on the emblem marking on the front panel.
Male/M_Helmet_Qularr_Villain_01.differs: The male version sits lower and wraps more fully around the head, with the stacked back plates forming a rounder band that covers the nape.
