Male/M_Helmet_Raptorcrestplate_01.description: A fan-shaped crest headpiece sitting on top of the head like a raptor's frill, with ribbed radiating panels, a row of curved horn spikes around the edge, and small fin-like tabs at the nape.
Male/M_Helmet_Raptorcrestplate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged rim and spike tips; colour 3 on the radiating rib markings; colour 1 on the blotchy panel patches; colour 2 on the central studs and back of the crest.

Male/M_Helmet_Raptorfan_01.description: A dinosaur-style neck frill that fans out around the face and head in a ring of ribbed, webbed segments with pointed spikes at the tips, plus a small curved crest of bony ridges above the forehead.
Male/M_Helmet_Raptorfan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frill membranes and the crest; colour 1 on the inner blend of each segment; colour 3 on the outer edge, rib lines and spike tips; colour 2 on the zigzag markings.

Male/M_Helmet_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A full-head retro helmet of smooth, rounded armored plates with a central stripe over the crown, an open visor window at the face, a chin guard with a notched edge, and a raised angular panel at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 1 on the crown stripe; colour 3 on the chin guard and rear panel; colour 2 on the inner visor opening.

Male/M_Helmet_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A retro sci-fi hat with a wide, flat flaring brim like a flying saucer and a domed canopy crown. A raised ridge arches over the dome, with a small oval ornament at the front and vented side panels on the brim.
Male/M_Helmet_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim; colour 1 on the domed canopy; colour 2 on the arched ridge and vent grilles; colour 3 on the front oval ornament and small brim accents.

Male/M_Helmet_Robotsamurai_Hat_01.description: A wide, shallow conical straw-style hat with a broad flat brim and a low peak, sitting high above the head like a samurai kasa. Ridged contrasting panels and small rectangular markings run across the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Robotsamurai_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim rim and underside; colour 1 on the main crown surface; colour 2 on the raised ridge panels along the peak; colour 3 on the rectangular markings on the crown.

Male/M_Helmet_Skeletal_01.description: A ram-skull mask helmet covering the face and head, with hollow eye sockets, a contrasting nose cavity, small fangs at the jaw and large ridged spiralling horns that curl down and outward beside the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Skeletal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull and the upper horn ridges; colour 1 on the horn tips and the fangs; colour 3 on the eye sockets; colour 2 on the nose cavity.

Male/M_Helmet_Sombrero_01.description: A wide-brimmed sombrero with a short tapered crown and a broad, slightly upturned brim. A star-shaped ornamental band with cut-out filigree and fine radiating lines sits around the crown, with small motifs on the brim. Worn level on the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Sombrero_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and brim surface; colour 1 on the brim edge, star-shaped band and motifs; colour 2 on the filigree cut-outs and underside; colour 3 on the fine radiating lines.
Male/M_Helmet_Sombrero_01.differs: The male brim is somewhat narrower and more curved, with a smaller band ornament and a slightly taller crown.

Male/M_Helmet_Spartan_Helmet_01.description: A Corinthian-style Spartan helmet: smooth domed crown with a subtle brow ridge, long cheek guards sweeping down either side of a narrow T-shaped face opening, and a flared rear rim with split neck flaps.
Male/M_Helmet_Spartan_Helmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and cheek guards; colour 1 on the thin edge trim around the rim and face opening.
Male/M_Helmet_Spartan_Helmet_01.differs: The male helmet has split neck flaps at the back, while the female version has a solid back with a single small central notch.

Male/M_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_01.description: A tall, straight-sided stovepipe top hat with a flat crown and a narrow, slightly angular flat brim. Three equal horizontal bands wrap the body above the brim. It sits upright on top of the head, with a formal, whimsical look.
Male/M_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown top and the middle band; colour 1 on the upper band; colour 2 on the lower band; colour 3 on the brim.
Male/M_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_01.differs: The male hat shows three equal bands of similar height, with the upper band being narrower than the female hat's large contrasting section.

Male/M_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Fancy_01.description: A tall stovepipe top hat with a curved brim that sweeps up at the sides, a contrasting rim band with a notch at the front, and a criss-cross lace-up panel with eyelets running up the front.
Male/M_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crown of the hat; colour 3 on the brim and the rim band around the top; colour 1 on the front laces; colour 2 on the eyelets.

Male/M_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Madjester_01.description: A tall flared stovepipe top hat with a wide angular brim, a contrasting band around the base, a ring of dots along the rim, and a cluster of long striped and soft feathers swept back on one side.
Male/M_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat body, brim and feather; colour 1 on the hatband and the feather tips; colour 3 on the rim dots and the striped feathers; colour 2 on the stripes of the feathers.

Male/M_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Party_01.description: A tall, slightly tapered stovepipe hat with a soft floppy brim and a padded crown, wrapped in broad horizontal bands with a narrow trim band at the base. Sits on top of the head in a festive party style.
Male/M_Helmet_Stovepipe_Hat_Party_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown top, brim and base band; colour 3 on the upper band; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 1 on the lower band.

Male/M_Helmet_Swing_01.description: A flat-topped, wide-brimmed boater-style hat with radiating stripes on the crown and brim, a thick contrasting band around the base, and a pair of small goggles with round lenses perched on the front of the band.
Male/M_Helmet_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the alternating stripes of the crown and brim; colour 1 on the hat band; colour 0 on the goggle housings; colour 3 on the goggle lenses.

Male/M_Helmet_Teddy_01.description: A full-head furry teddy-bear mask: a rounded shaggy head with small round ears, big glassy eyes, a snout with a nose, and a spiky tuft of fur swept up over the forehead. Playful, costume-mascot style.
Male/M_Helmet_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the muzzle fur, ears and lower cheeks; colour 1 on the inner ears, nose and eye rims; colour 2 on the face centre and forehead tuft; colour 3 on the outer head fur and the eye centres.

Male/M_Helmet_Teddy_Ear_01.description: A pair of small rounded teddy-bear ears with a textured, fuzzy-looking outer shell and a concave inner face, perched on the upper sides of the head. Cute, playful animal styling.
Male/M_Helmet_Teddy_Ear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 1 on the inner face of each ear.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A close-fitting superhero cowl helmet with tall swept-back bat-like ear fins and flared side wings, angular eye openings, a nose ridge and a chin strap band. It leaves the crown as a smooth cap.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth crown cap and nose stripe; colour 1 on the face mask, ear fins, side wings and chin strap.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The male version has a plain smooth crown cap and a contrasting nose stripe, with the mask and fins in a single colour, and no cheek insets or contrasting crown.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A close-fitting Greco-Roman style helmet with a segmented domed crown, a broad decorated brow band with a pointed nose guard, hinged cheek guards and a flared neck guard at the back. The face stays open.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed crown plates, cheek guards and neck guard; colour 1 on the brow band; colour 3 on the swirl decoration and the small studs at the temples; colour 2 on the outlines between plates.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ancient_01.description: An ancient-style full helmet with a rounded domed crown, swept ridged bands over the top, and a long pointed nose guard with a T-shaped face opening. A flared neck rim sits at the back; weathered, worn metal look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ancient_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell and nose guard; colour 1 on the swept bands across the crown and the back emblem markings; colour 2 in the shadowed face opening.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Angel_Face_Full_02.description: A rigid full-face mask sculpted like a stern humanoid face, with hollow eye sockets, a sharp nose and lips. It covers the face from brow to chin, open at the back, with a thin rim wrapping around the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Angel_Face_Full_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face shell; colour 1 on the lips and the shading around the eyes; colour 2 on the eye sockets.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A small circlet-style forehead ornament: a large oval domed gem in a contrasting bezel with a tiny top loop, flanked by curved, branching antler-like horns that sweep out across the brow, with scrollwork at the base.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns; colour 1 on the central gem; colour 2 on the gem bezel and top loop; colour 3 on the scrollwork.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A close-fitting skullcap with a patterned, cobblestone-like top panel and a smooth band around the sides and back; a narrow strip drops down the forehead to the nose bridge. Sits snug on the head, animal-hide in style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the patterned top panel and its edge piping; colour 2 on the plates within the pattern; colour 1 on the side and back band.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Armorninja.description: A small armoured headpiece that sits over the crown and brow: a central segmented plate with a ridged front crest, two swept-back winged blades curving out to each side, and small angular gem-like nodes at the temples.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved side blades and the central ridged plate; colour 1 on the main crown plates; colour 2 on the inner wing panels; colour 3 on the temple nodes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Artdeco_01.description: A close-fitting art deco helmet with a low swept-back ridge over the crown, a nose-guard face plate with cheek and eye openings, and angular side plates. Thin stripes run along the shell.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Artdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and face plate; colour 1 on the thin stripes running along the shell and down the face; colour 2 on the inner edges and rear opening.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Artdeco_01.differs: The male helmet has a lower, flatter swept ridge with striped lines along the shell, rather than a tall pointed crest with flared fins.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Asiandragon_01.description: A circlet made of a coiled serpentine dragon that wraps around the head, with a horned dragon head rising at the front and small dragon heads along the sides. A central ridged strip runs over the forehead and a small tab sticks up on top.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Asiandragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the coiled dragon body and heads; colour 1 on the ridged strip, the underside scales and the horns; colour 3 on the stitch-like markings along the body.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Asiandragon_01_Tako.description: A circlet made of a coiled serpentine dragon that wraps around the head, with a horned dragon head rising at the front, a central ridged strip over the forehead and small dragon heads on the sides. East-asian fantasy style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Asiandragon_01_Tako.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dragon's body and head; colour 1 on the ridged strip, underbelly scales and horns; colour 3 on the stitch-like markings along the body.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Beanie_01.description: A small, close-fitting cap made of alternating wedge panels that meet at the crown, with a contrasting band around the rim. It sits snugly on top of the head, giving a playful, cute look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Beanie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on alternating cap panels; colour 1 on the other alternating panels; colour 2 on the rim band.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Beanie_01.differs: The male version is a plain paneled cap with no propeller or stem on top.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Beret_01.description: A soft, rounded cloth beret with a flat crown that slopes down to one side, sitting snug on the head above a thin contrasting band, with a small shield-shaped badge on the front. Military in style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Beret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the beret body; colour 1 on the edge band; colour 3 on the badge.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Biker_01.description: A rounded, close-fitting open-face helmet shell with a low brim that wraps the head, a faint centre seam and small rivets on each side; sits over the crown and leaves the face and ears bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Biker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the rim band; the side rivets take the rim colour.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Biker_02.description: A rounded, close-fitting open-face helmet shell like a German-style biker or army helmet, with a flared rim of contrasting trim, small rivets at the sides, and a short pointed spike rising from the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Biker_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the rim band and rivets; colour 1 on the top spike.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Brainjar_01.description: A small clear dome sitting on the crown of the head, holding an exposed wrinkled brain. A riveted band rings its base, and coiled rod electrodes stick out sideways from both temples. Comic mad-scientist style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Brainjar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome rim, band and rod shafts; colour 1 on the brain; colour 3 on the coil rings; colour 2 on the rod tips and small spikes at the brain base.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Brainjar_02.description: A small transparent dome sits on top of the head over an exposed, wrinkled brain. A riveted band circles the base of the dome, and two small connectors sit at the sides. A monstrous, mad-scientist look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Brainjar_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the riveted base band and the dome rim; colour 1 on the brain; colour 2 on the small side connectors. The dome is clear and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Bronzeking_01.description: A crown-like headband circling the head with upright curved metal blades at the front and two tall decorated fin panels on each side, studded with round rivets; the back band has a wavy swooping upper edge.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Bronzeking_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upright blades, the band edging and the inner stripe; colour 1 on the band and the fin panels; colour 3 on the etched swirl markings of the fin panels; colour 2 on the rivets.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Bronzeking_01.differs: The male band has a wavy swooping back edge with a light inner stripe, while the female back is a raised curved plate.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Celestial_Halo_01.description: A floating halo accessory: a thin faceted ring standing upright behind the head, with a pair of feathered wings spreading from its sides and a long vertical bar with hooked ends crossing through the centre.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Celestial_Halo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the halo ring; colour 1 on the wings; colour 2 on the vertical bar.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Circlet_Basic_01.description: A slim circlet worn around the forehead, dipping to a V-shaped point at the brow with a round gem. The band has a woven lattice pattern and scrolled swirls on the front, with a thin edge trim along the top.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Circlet_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate and swirl panel; colour 2 on the lattice weave and swirls; colour 1 on the top edge trim; colour 3 on the gem.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Circlet_Basic_01.differs: The male circlet stays a level, even-width band around the back of the head, without the female version's V-shaped dip behind.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A close-fitting mechanical helmet with a rounded cap, flared side fins, and ear-level housings. A framing plate runs down each cheek and under the chin, leaving the face open. Futuristic superhero style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cap and ear housings; colour 3 on the top and back centre stripe and the forehead band; colour 2 on the front brow panel and the vents behind the ears; colour 0 on the cheek frame, side fins and chin plate.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_01.differs: The male version has a contrasting band across the forehead beneath the contrasting brow panel, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_02.description: A close-fitting mechanical helmet with a smooth rounded cap, an open face framed by angular plates, wide flared side wings swept back from the cheeks, and a segmented neck guard at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Clockwork_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap, face frame and side wings; colour 1 on the crown patch, side panels and neck guard; colour 2 on the recessed gaps and vents; colour 3 on a small accent at the rear.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Cooliehat_01.description: A very wide, shallow conical coolie hat with fine radiating ribs, a ragged frayed rim edged with contrasting trim, and a small notched crown collar on top. It sits over the head and shades the face.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Cooliehat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat cone and crown; colour 3 on the rim edge trim; colour 1 on the band around the base of the crown.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Croc_Tophat_01.description: A tall, slightly crumpled cloth top hat with a wide brim, a broad banded hatband studded with small contrasting spikes, and a long curved feather tucked into the side and sweeping backward. Sits upright on the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Croc_Tophat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hat crown and brim; colour 1 on the banded hatband; colour 2 on the small spikes; colour 3 on the feather.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Basic_01.description: A slim open-backed crown band with five tall pointed peaks tipped with round knobs, decorated with embossed scrollwork, small round gems and stitched edging. It sits low on the crown of the head, with a regal fantasy look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Basic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and peaks; colour 1 on the outer edge trim and the knobs on the peak tips; colour 3 on the round gems.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Eclipse_01.description: A spiked metal crown-band sitting around the forehead, with tall blade-like points, a tall central raised spike, a skull-like front plate with a gem and curved claw-like tendrils hanging over the brow. A separate contrasting panel runs along the front band.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Eclipse_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, spikes and front plate; colour 1 on the inset panel along the front band; colour 3 on the gems; colour 2 on the curved claw tendrils.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Eclipse_01.differs: The male crown has a taller central spike and a deeper back band rising into larger points.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Laurel_01.description: A laurel wreath crown of overlapping pointed leaves circling the head just above the brow, thickest at the back and thinning toward the front, where the two branches meet. Classical, ceremonial styling.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Laurel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leaf surfaces; colour 1 on the leaf edges and the stems between the leaves.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Laurel_02.description: A laurel wreath crown of overlapping pointed leaves that circles the head at the brow and ties off at the back, with a glossy metallic look. Classical, ceremonial styling.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Laurel_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper faces of the leaves; colour 1 on the underlying leaf layer and edges, most visible at the back and sides.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.description: A spiked metal crown band worn around the forehead, with tall curved spikes around the rim, a taller central spike, a pointed brow plate with a small gem, and a contrasting inner band.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown band and spikes; colour 1 on the inner band beneath the rim; colour 3 on the gem at the brow.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_01.differs: The male crown has a lighter top rim and a wider, flatter plate at the back, without the small pointed tab.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_02.description: A spiked crown band circling the head, with tall curved spikes around the rim, a separate thin floating hoop above, and a pointed brow panel that sweeps up into a tall curved horn-like blade.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown band and spikes; colour 1 on the front brow panel and its upswept blade; colour 2 on the stripe markings on the spikes and panel; colour 3 on the floating hoop.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_02.differs: The male version has a taller, more sweeping front blade and larger, more flared spikes than the female version.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_03.description: A spiked crown band circling the head, with a mottled ring, tall thin spikes with banded tips around it, two longer pointed prongs at front and back, and a separate thin floating hoop above.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled band and short spikes; colour 1 on the two long front and back prongs; colour 2 on the banded spike tips; colour 3 on the floating upper hoop.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_04.description: A thin circlet crown ringed with tall, tapered spikes that each carry notched chevron grooves, with a larger swept-back horn-like plate rising from the brow at the front. Sits low on the head; monstrous fantasy style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the circlet band and the spikes; colour 1 on the front brow plate and its horn; colour 2 on the grooves and stripes; colour 3 on the small eye markings on the brow plate.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Crown_Spiked_04.differs: The male version adds a small raised fin at the back of the circlet, and its front horn plate is taller and sweeps further back.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Cybermind_02.description: A smooth, close-fitting helmet cap with an oval gem-like panel on the forehead and an open face with a trimmed edge. Two ribbed flexible cables loop out from the sides and hang down behind the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Cybermind_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the forehead oval; colour 2 on the ribbed cables and face-opening trim; colour 0 on the small cable end caps.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Cybermind_03.description: A pair of ribbed, flexible cables that plug into the sides of the head through small collars, arc up and over the crown, then hang down behind the head to the upper back. A cyber-implant look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Cybermind_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collars where the cables join the head; the ribbed cable lengths take colour 2.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Deity_01.description: A faceted, angular full helmet with two tall swept-back horn-like ears, a crest-shaped plate on the brow, an open face with a mask-like lower panel, and a flared collar that flares out around the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and ears; colour 1 on the inner face panel around the eyes and mouth; colour 3 on the brow crest; colour 2 on the flared collar rim and brow edges.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A smooth, rounded medieval-style helmet covering the crown and back of the head, with a V-shaped brow and open face cut-out framed by a thick border, plus small spikes studding the sides and back.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the edge border around the face opening and lower rim; colour 1 on the small spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Dinoskullbone_01.description: A bone dinosaur skull worn like a cap on top of the head, with hollow eye sockets, small spikes on the brow and crown, and a long snout that juts forward over the face, ending in a wide row of pointed teeth.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Dinoskullbone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone of the skull and snout; colour 1 inside the eye sockets; colour 3 on the nostril tip of the snout; colour 2 on the teeth.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Dinoskullbone_01.differs: The teeth form a wider, fuller row that frames the mouth area, and the skull sits lower over the brow.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Dragon_01.description: A full-head dragon helmet shaped like a skull with a long tapering snout, glowing eyes, small spikes along the sides and two tall branching antlers on top. It covers the whole head and ends at the jaw.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and snout; colour 1 on the antlers and side spikes; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Egyptian_Pharaoh_01.description: A pharaonic nemes-style headdress: a striped cloth cap that sits over the crown with a band across the brow, and two broad striped lappets hanging down either side of the face to the collarbones, open at the back of the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Egyptian_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the striped crown and the outer stripes of the cloth; colour 2 on the alternate stripes; colour 1 on the brow band and the inner lappet panels and stripes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Emissive_01.description: A full-coverage sci-fi motorcycle-style helmet with a clear glass visor across the face, segmented shell plates, angular contrasting trim lines and a round side emblem plate with a small glowing mark; sits snug over the whole head.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Emissive_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the trim lines and side plate ring; colour 3 on the small side emblem; the visor is clear glass and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Face_Bullskull_01.description: A bull skull worn as a headpiece: the long muzzle hangs over the face, with wide curving horns sweeping out and upward from the brow and a wrapped cloth band binding it around the back of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Face_Bullskull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull; colour 1 on the horns and eye sockets; colour 3 on the forehead marking and the wrapped band.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Face_Dorag_01.description: A close-fitting cloth bandana with a snug crown and a band across the forehead, knotted at the back of the head with two short tails hanging down. Casual street or pirate look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Face_Dorag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the star-patterned cloth; colour 2 on the shadowed folds and edges.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Face_Dorag_01.differs: The male version has a small knot-like detail at the centre front of the band, and the back tails hang slightly longer.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Firebird_01.description: A close-fitting fantasy helmet with a smooth dome, a tall central spike at the crown, and swept-back cheek guards. A V-shaped brow plate holds a diamond gem, and a pair of tall fins flares from each side of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome, central spike and cheek guards; colour 1 on the brow plate and the side fins; colour 3 on the diamond gem; colour 2 on the bottom rim edge.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Firebird_02.description: A partial fantasy helmet: an open-faced crown band with a raised pointed front peak, a faceted gem at the brow, cheek guards curving down the sides and tall swept-back horn-like fins rising at each temple.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Firebird_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cheek guards and rim; colour 1 on the peak and the tall side fins; colour 3 on the brow gem.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Firefighter_01.description: A classic firefighter helmet: a rounded domed crown with raised ridge ribs, a crest strip down the centre, a front shield badge with an emblem, and a wide brim that sweeps out in front and stretches back into a long tail.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Firefighter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and brim; colour 1 on the ridge ribs and the front badge; colour 3 on the centre crest strip and the rear panel; colour 2 on the badge backing.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Firefighter_01.differs: The male brim is a plain light underside with no contrasting lining or inner band visible from behind.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Flighthelmet_01.description: A close-fitting pilot's flight helmet with a rounded shell, a translucent tinted visor over the eyes, side ear cups, and a boom microphone curving toward the mouth. Panelled shell with thin raised ridges.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Flighthelmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front shell and visor frame; colour 1 on the crown and back of the shell; colour 2 on the ear cups and top panel; colour 3 on the forehead patch and back stripe. The visor ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_01.description: A full-face gas mask: a smooth moulded face shell with round rimmed eye lenses and a ribbed cylindrical filter snout, held by thin straps over the crown and around the back of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face shell and head straps; colour 1 on the lens rims; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter canister.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.description: A close-fitting full-face gas mask with a smooth, rounded shell over the face, oval goggle lenses with raised rims, and twin side-mounted filter canisters at the mouth. Thin straps loop over the head and around the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face shell and head straps; colour 1 on the lens rims and side valve fittings; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the filter canisters.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Gasmaskfull_02.differs: The male mask's front filter canister is larger, with a bolder perforated grille, and the strap at the back forms a round ring at the rear of the mouth.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Golden_Age_01.description: A loose cloth sack hood that covers the whole head, rising to a pointed crown and gathering in soft folds at the neck. Two round eyeholes with contrasting rims sit at the front, giving a pulp-era look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Golden_Age_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood fabric; colour 1 on the rims around the eyeholes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Halo_01_New.description: A thin floating halo: a faceted torus ring hovering level above the top of the head without touching it. A simple angelic or heavenly accent with a slightly polygonal, rounded tube.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Halo_01_New.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Halo_03.description: A thin floating halo ring hovering above the head, with six pointed spikes radiating outward around its rim. Worn detached from the head, it suggests a fantasy or monstrous angelic look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Halo_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring; colour 3 on the spikes at the front-left, right and back-left; colour 2 on the remaining spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Harlequin_01.description: A snug jester-style cap that covers the crown and back of the head, with a hairline-cut front edge and several long curled horn-like points, each tipped with a small faceted ball.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Harlequin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap and its curled points; colour 1 on the ball tips; colour 2 on the thin edge outline.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Heroic_01.description: A close-fitting superhero cowl covering the crown and back of the head, with two short pointed ears, angular cheek guards flanking the eye openings, and an atom emblem on the forehead.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Heroic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cowl shell and ears; colour 1 on the atom emblem and the eye-lens trim; colour 2 on the inner edges of the cheek guards.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A fantasy helmet with layered, scale-like plates sweeping back over the skull, a central ridge crest, a nose-guard faceplate leaving the face open, and large segmented curling horns sweeping out from each side.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and crest; colour 2 on the faceplate and inner edges; colour 1 on the horns; colour 2 on the small side stud.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A solid superhero helmet with a rounded crown, a central crest and nose guard, angled side panels, and a flared lower rim that wraps the jaw and back of the head, leaving the face open.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell of the crown and back; colour 0 on the top patch, nose guard and lower flared rim; colour 2 on the side panels; colour 3 on the brow and rear stripe accents.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The male version is a solid segmented helmet with separate panels and a flared lower rim, while the female version is a translucent glowing web-like shell.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Archer_01.description: A close-fitting cloth hood with a pointed peak, draped over the head and down to the neck and shoulders, with an integrated face wrap covering the nose and mouth. Angular panels give it a stealthy archer or assassin look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hood body and face wrap; colour 2 on the inner hood lining and a side panel; colour 3 on the diamond-shaped panels on the back and sides; colour 0 on the lower collar edge and the chin and neck drape.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Fullopen_01.description: A soft cloth hood with a pointed crown and wrinkled folds, framing the face and hanging down the sides and back of the neck. A smooth band crosses the brow, and the mouth and chin are left bare. Suggests an assassin or rogue look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Fullopen_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood; colour 2 on the thin stripes across the brow band.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Fullopen_01.differs: The male hood has a smooth brow band with thin stripes and shows more of the face, and its back edge flares into small tails at the neck.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Heroic_04.description: A close-fitting cloth hood with a pointed crown and an oval face opening, its lower part gathering into a draped, wrinkled cowl that rests over the neck and upper shoulders. Suggests a stealthy, assassin-like look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Heroic_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the crown of the hood, fading into colour 0 on the draped cowl around the neck; the face opening shows the mannequin's interior.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Light_01.description: A soft, loose cloth hood that drapes over the head and pulls forward into a deep opening around the face, with a rumpled, slightly ragged edge and a fold of fabric hanging behind the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood fabric; colour 1 on the contrasting trim along the face opening edge.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Nighthawk_01.description: A close-fitting cloth hood that drapes over the head and down the back of the neck, with wrinkled folds and a pointed front peak carrying a triangular inset panel. Open at the face, with a contrasting-edged rim.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood cloth; colour 1 on the triangular brow panel; colour 2 on the edge piping around the face opening.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Santa_01.description: A close-fitting Santa-style hood with a thick rolled fur-like rim around the face and a pointed tail ending in a round pom-pom that hangs at the back. Panelled in patches, it covers the head and neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face rim and patches at the back and side; colour 1 on the main hood, interior lining and pom-pom; colour 2 on the panels and neck band; colour 3 on the patch on top.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Santa_01.differs: The male hood has a contrasting inner lining and a contrasting band around the neck opening, with more patchwork panels; the female has a plain contrasting interior.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Secret_01.description: A soft cloth hoodie hood pulled up over the head, with gathered folds, contrasting edge binding around the face opening and two long hanging drawstrings with tipped ends. Drapes slightly at the back of the neck; casual street style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood fabric; colour 1 on the binding around the face opening; colour 2 on the drawstring cords; colour 3 on the drawstring tips.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hood_Secret_01.differs: The male hood has a lower back that flares out over the neck, with the drawstrings hanging longer and further down the chest.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hoodbaggy_01.description: A soft cloth hood that fits closely around the head, with a rounded crown, gently creased folds and a wide face opening. The edges drape to the neck and the hood sits over the head like a casual cowl.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hoodbaggy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood; the inner lining also takes colour 0.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hoodbaggy_02.description: A soft, fitted cloth hood that wraps over the head and falls in loose folds to the neck, with an open face and a small pointed drape at each side of the jaw. Plain, casual and hooded.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hoodbaggy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood, including the inner lining.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.description: A set of swept-back horns on the crown of the head: curved, ridged horns on each side plus a central row of small jagged spikes running front to back along a thin band. Monstrous, beastlike headgear.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and central spikes; colour 3 on the horn tips and the thin band along the head.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.description: A monstrous crown of curved, ridged horns rising from the top of the head, with swept spiky fin-like blades flaring out at each side and a narrow spiked ridge running down the back of the skull.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and side blades; colour 3 on the horn bases and the thin edging along the scalp line; colour 2 on small parts of the back ridge.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_03.description: A pair of small swept-back horns rising from the forehead, plus a row of jagged fin-like spikes running in a crest down the centre of the scalp to the nape. Monstrous, demonic look that leaves the face bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horns and crest spikes; colour 3 on the horn tips and the thin edging along the crest base.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_04.description: A set of curled, tapering horns arranged in pairs along the top and sides of the head, with a thin ridge of small fin-like spikes running front to back down the centre of the skull. A narrow band frames the crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts and central ridge spikes; colour 3 on the horn tips and the thin band at the base.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_05.description: A narrow mohawk-style ridge of jagged, blade-like fins running front to back along the centre of the head, tallest and most splayed toward the back, with a thin contrasting base strip along the scalp.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Hornsmonster_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jagged fins; colour 3 on the thin base strip along the scalp.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ice_Crown_01.description: A delicate, jagged crown of thin interlaced shards forming a lattice band around the head, with long tapering icicle-like spikes rising and flaring outward. Sits on top of the head, suggesting a frozen, fantasy ice queen look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ice_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin crown framework and spikes; the glossy crystalline inner surfaces ignore the colour scheme. Other slots not clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A close-fitting full helmet with a smooth domed shell, flame-like swirl patterning across the crown and sides, a raised rim framing a T-shaped face opening, and a small hexagonal nozzle at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the flame patterning and crown panel; colour 1 on the raised rim around the face opening; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Kabuki_Mask_01.description: A thin, face-hugging kabuki-style mask covering the face from brow to chin, with eye openings, a sculpted nose and lips, and bold painted stripes above the eyes, around them and across the chin.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Kabuki_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask surface; colour 1 on the brow stripes, eye rims and chin stripe; colour 2 on the swooping lines beside the eyes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A pair of large curled ram-style horns rising from the forehead and sweeping back and around in a spiral on each side of the head, ending in thin curved tips. Beast or demon look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and curled tips; colour 1 on the mid sections of the horns; colour 2 on the outer bands; colour 3 on the small inner underside patches.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.description: A transparent glass bubble helmet set on a bulky mechanical collar ring that sweeps down into a chin plate. Ribbed hoses arc over the dome and loop around the face, with a round vent at the front and side canisters.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Lemurian_Bubble_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the collar ring and mechanical plates; colour 1 on the hoses, front vent disc and side canisters; colour 3 on the coiled spring sections; colour 2 on the underside. The dome is glass and ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Liberty_Crown_01.description: A crown-like headband sitting on the forehead and crown of the head, with a shallow curved band and a ring of long radiating spikes, like a statue's crown. Suggests a patriotic superhero look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Liberty_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the band; colour 1 on the front band and the spike bases; colour 2 on the spike tips and one front panel; colour 3 on the stripes along some spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Liberty_Crown_02.description: A crown-like band worn around the top of the head, with a ring of long radiating spikes fanning outward like a statue's diadem. Its shallow curved band has a split two-tone front panel, giving a patriotic superhero look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Liberty_Crown_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the band and the spike bases; colour 1 on one half of the front band and the spike shafts; colour 2 on the other half of the front band and the spike tips; colour 3 on the stripes along the spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Martial_Power_01.description: A full-face oni demon mask with two long curved horns on the brow, a scowling sculpted face, hollow glowing-looking eyes, open mouth cavity and curved contrasting fangs. A thin rim wraps around the head to hold it in place.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face and horns; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 1 on the mouth interior; colour 2 on the fangs.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Maskfoxbat_01.description: A thin shell mask covering the face and forehead, with two tall curved horn-like fins sweeping up from the temples, a raised brow ridge over the eyes, and a cut-out mouth and chin. Suggests a bat-like superhero look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Maskfoxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell and fins; colour 1 on the narrow stripe down the nose bridge.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Medieval_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting full helmet that covers the skull and sides of the head, with a V-shaped brow and a T-shaped open face slit edged in contrasting trim, plus a row of small rivets along each side. It ends at the jaw.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Medieval_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper dome, fading into colour 0 on the lower face and cheek plates; colour 2 on the trim around the face opening; colour 3 on the small rivets.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Medieval_01.differs: The male helmet stops higher at the nape with a short rear edge, while the female one has a longer rear skirt with a visible vertical split.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ninjaheadband_01.description: A cloth ninja headband wrapped around the forehead and temples, with a separate rectangular front plate bearing a small emblem, and a knot at the back with two long tails hanging down the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ninjaheadband_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band, knot and tails; colour 2 on the front plate; colour 3 on the emblem.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ninjahood_01.description: A loose cloth hood with a pointed peak that covers the whole head and drapes to the neck. Soft wrinkled folds run down the fabric, and the front opening is a shadowed slit across the eyes, leaving the mouth bare. Suggests a ninja or assassin look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ninjahood_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole hood fabric; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Parasite_02.description: An alien parasite-like head covering: a smooth domed cap over the crown, gripped by thick segmented, leg-like limbs that curve down around the face and temples and end in small sharp claws, with ridged bands along the sides.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Parasite_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed cap; colour 0 on the limbs and body shell; colour 1 on the ridged bands and spots; colour 3 on the claw tips.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_01.description: A small metal crown with a narrow band and tall, flared, pointed spikes of varied height, with a row of round and teardrop gems around the band. It perches on top of the head like a royal circlet.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown band and spikes; colour 3 on some of the round gems; colour 2 on the other round gems; colour 1 on the teardrop gem.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_02.description: A small spiked crown with a narrow band set with diamond-shaped studs and tall zigzag points, each tipped with a round ball. It sits on top of the head like a party crown, with a lining showing inside the front.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and the crown points; colour 1 on the ball tips; colour 2 on the diamond studs; colour 3 on the inner lining at the front.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_03.description: A small open-frame crown sitting on top of the head: a lattice of thin angular bands rises into tall points tipped with diamond-shaped finials, with diamond cutouts around the base band. Regal, fantasy-flavoured party headwear.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Party_Crown_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base band and inner lattice; colour 1 on the tall outer points and finials; colour 2 on the inner back spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Party_Hat_Tiny_01.description: A miniature top hat perched on the upper side of the head: a wide flat brim, a short cylindrical crown with a zigzag-edged cap and two thin bands, and a tied bow with dangling ribbon tails. Playful party style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Party_Hat_Tiny_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim and the crown sides; colour 1 on the zigzag-edged top of the crown; colour 2 on the bands around the crown; colour 3 on the bow and ribbon tails.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Partyhat_01.description: A small cone-shaped party hat with spiral stripes, perched on top of the head and held by a thin chin strap running down the side of the face. Playful, festive novelty headwear.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Partyhat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone body; colour 2 on the spiral stripes and underside; colour 1 on the thin chin strap.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Persianhood_01.description: A flat-topped cloth cap with a thick, wrinkled band around the brim, and a draped head-wrap hanging from it that covers the hair, ears and neck in loose folds, leaving the eyes and face open.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Persianhood_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cap crown; colour 2 on the wrinkled band; colour 0 on the draped head-wrap.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Persianhood_01.differs: The male wrap hangs more loosely at the sides and drops a little lower over the brow, leaving the lower face more open.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Pointedcap_01.description: A small, thin faceted cap that covers a narrow strip along the top of the head, running from a pointed V at the forehead back over the crown to a rounded edge. It sits flush on the scalp like a mohawk-shaped skullcap.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Pointedcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Pompom_01.description: A knitted beanie with a ribbed folded cuff and horizontal stripe bands, topped with a large shaggy pompom. Two braided cords hang from the ear areas, each ending in a small spiky pompom. Casual winter style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Pompom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff, top pompom and braided cords; colour 1 on the wide stripe bands and the dangling pompoms; colour 2 on the stripe; colour 3 on the thin stripe near the crown.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Prisonguard_01.description: A close-fitting tactical helmet with a rounded shell, a raised central stripe running front to back, segmented panels with ribbed insets, and a thick padded band wrapping low around the back and sides of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Prisonguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the central stripe and front tab; colour 2 on the padded rear band and top edge panels; colour 3 on the ribbed side insets.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Pulp_Aviatorcap_01.description: A close-fitting leather aviator cap with a paneled, seamed crown and ear flaps that hang down each side of the face. Fleece-like trim edges the brow and flaps, and a small buckled strap dangles at each ear.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Pulp_Aviatorcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leather crown and flaps; colour 1 on the fleece trim around the edge; colour 2 on the small buckles.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Pulp_Aviatorcap_02.description: A close-fitting leather aviator cap with panelled seams, a band around the crown, and ear flaps with contrasting piping and small buckle straps. Goggles with rounded lenses sit on the forehead. Classic pulp flyer style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Pulp_Aviatorcap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap shell, band and goggle frames; colour 1 on the piping and lining edges of the ear flaps; colour 3 on the goggle lenses; colour 2 on the goggle rims and buckles.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Railroadspikes_01.description: A cluster of long railroad-spike nails radiating outward from a single point on the crown of the head, each with a tapered shaft and a flat rounded head. Punk, monstrous look, sitting on top of the scalp.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Railroadspikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike shafts; colour 1 on the flat heads of the spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.description: A close-fitting pilot-style helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, open at the face, with raised ridges running front to back, chevron-shaped panels, and round speaker-like pods with small knobs over each ear.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ravenspeaker_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised ridges, ear-side shell and pod rings; colour 0 on the chevron panels and lower rear panels; colour 2 on the recessed crown panels and ear pods; colour 3 on the thin accent lines along the chevrons and back stripes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Redstone_01.description: A smooth, streamlined helmet that hugs the skull, built from faceted angular panels with grooved seams running front to back. It has a pointed nose-guard brow and leaves the face open.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell panels; colour 1 on the rear and lower side panels; colour 2 on the seam grooves.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Redstone_01.differs: The male helmet has a pointed V-shaped brow dipping over the nose, while the female one has a straight, bang-like brow edge.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Resistance_02_1.description: A smooth, rounded full-head helmet with a wide angular cutout across the eyes and a slim central nose guard running down over the mouth, leaving the lower face and chin open. Sleek, superhero-style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Resistance_02_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole helmet shell; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Retroscifi_Skullcap_.description: A close-fitting skullcap that covers the crown and back of the head, with a contrasting band trimming the front hairline and running down past the temples. Its smooth, plain shape suggests a retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Retroscifi_Skullcap_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on one half of the cap; colour 2 on the other half; colour 1 on the trim band along the hairline and sides.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ripper_01.description: An open-topped mechanical headband-helmet: a thick band wraps the head with spiky skeletal ribs arching over the crown, a knuckle-like ridged brow, claw-like prongs framing the eyes and cheeks, and short cylindrical pods jutting from each temple.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main band and brow; colour 0 on the crown ribs and the claw-like prongs around the eyes; colour 2 on the temple pods; colour 3 on the rings of the pods.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.description: A tight-fitting hairstyle made of overlapping stone plates, with tall jagged shards rising at the front and crown and a few larger crystal spikes fanning out at the temples. It covers the scalp down to about chin level.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates; colour 1 on the large crystal spikes; colour 3 on the cracks and seams between the plates.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A close-fitting full helmet with a tall swept-back central fin, layered angular plates stacked over the crown and back, a large visor panel over the face, and ribbed vented cheek guards. Sci-fi armoured look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell plates and cheek guards; colour 2 on the central fin; colour 1 on the visor panel; colour 3 on the thin accent stripe above the visor.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_02.description: A close-fitting alien helmet with a swept-back crest of pointed fins on top, a pointed brow guard over the eyes, ribbed cheek and ear vents, and a segmented ribbed band around the back of the skull. The face stays open below the brow.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crest, brow and main shell; colour 3 on the accent strip beneath the crest; colour 2 on the ear vents and back ribbing; colour 1 on the ribbed cheek plates.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.description: A close-fitting armoured helmet with a pointed brow visor over the eyes, tall swept-back spiky crest plates, ribbed cheek guards with round side vents, and stacked segmented bands wrapping the back of the head. Leaves the mouth and chin bare.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell, crest plates and brow; colour 3 on the strip under the crest; colour 2 on the round side vents and the recessed back bands; colour 1 on subtle band edges.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.differs: The male helmet has a taller, more sharply spiked crest and lighter banding at the back.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Roundedcap_01.description: A small, smooth rounded cap that covers only a narrow strip along the top-centre of the head, from the forehead hairline back toward the crown, with a thin edge. Suggests a sleek helmet plate.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Roundedcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap surface.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A samurai kabuto helmet: a ribbed, studded dome with a small peak finial, a narrow brim, upturned side wings, and a flared neck guard of stacked lamellar plates covering the sides and back of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and neck-guard plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and trim lines, and on the lining panel under the front and sides; colour 2 on the finial and the underside of the brim.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Samurai_01.differs: The male version shows a flared cloth lining panel beneath the front and sides of the helmet, and its side wings are larger.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: An open-faced sci-fi helmet frame: a segmented band wraps the head at the brow and sides, with angular cheek plates and a chin guard under the jaw, leaving the crown and most of the face uncovered.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and some plates; colour 1 on the large curved cheek and brow panels; colour 2 on the rectangular side blocks and brow band; colour 3 on the chin edge trim.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.differs: The male version has a solid brow strip running straight across the eyes, while the female version's brow band sits higher and is open in front.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Skullcap_01.description: A smooth, close-fitting skullcap helmet that covers the crown and back of the head down to the nape, with a pointed dip at the brow and narrow tabs framing the temples. Sleek, plain and sporty-superhero in style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Skullcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole cap shell; the small temple tabs also take colour 0.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Sorceror_01.description: A tall, tube-like sorcerer's hat with a jagged, crown-like upper rim of pointed spikes, a contrasting trim band at the brow, a square glyph badge at front and back, and thin spikes projecting from each side.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Sorceror_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hat; colour 2 on the jagged upper rim and side spikes; colour 1 on the brow band and badge plate; colour 3 on the glyph symbol.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A pharaoh-style nemes headdress: a cloth hood with two broad lappets falling past the jaw to the shoulders, a rigid browband with a central emblem, and a narrow tail hanging down the back. Diagonal panels give it a sci-fi ancient look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the browband, inner face frame, back tail and some diagonal panels; colour 1 on the main cloth of the hood and lappets; colour 2 on the diagonal panels and lappet hems; colour 3 on small accents under the lappets and side.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_02.description: A pharaoh-style nemes headcloth: a soft, flowing cloth hood that drapes over the crown and hangs in two lappets past the ears to the shoulders, with a banded diagonal pattern and a narrow tail down the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cloth and lappet fronts; colour 0 on the brow band, inner folds and rear tail; colour 2 on the diagonal back stripe and lappet edges; colour 3 on small accents at the neck edges.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: A chunky sci-fi visor headset: a boxy front shield covers the eyes and upper face, joined by a band around the head to round earcup discs at the sides, with a rear panel.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front visor block, earcup hubs and trim stripes; colour 1 on the headband and earcup shells; colour 2 on the strip above the visor; colour 3 on the rear panel.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.differs: The male version has a taller contrasting top strip with a notched edge and no contrasting panel visible from the front.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_01.description: A close-fitting skullcap helmet with a smooth seamed shell and small vent holes at the sides, studded with rows of short cone spikes over the crown, sides and back. Sits snug on the head with the face and ears left open.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the cone spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_01_New.description: A floating open-ring halo hovering above the head, a thick curved band with three long tapering spikes: one on each side and one pointing forward at the front. Gothic, monstrous accent with a gap at the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_01_New.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring band; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_01.description: A thin spiked halo crown standing upright above the head like a floating arc: a smooth curved band with a tall central spike, angled side spikes, two small horn-like spikes above and two swept, hooked barbs at the outer ends.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved band and its central and side spikes; colour 3 on the two small upper spikes; colour 2 on the two outer hooked barbs.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_01.differs: The male band is one smooth continuous arc, without the break near the centre seen on the female version.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_03.description: A floating spiked halo arc hovering above the head, made of a curved band with a tall central spike and shorter side spikes, plus small detached cone spikes and two curved hook-like blades flaring outward at the sides.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved band and its spikes; colour 3 on the small cone spikes; colour 2 on the outer hook blades.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_05.description: A broken spiked halo floating above the head: a thin curved band with a cracked gap, tall central spike and angled side spikes, plus small floating thorns and hooked claw-like blades to either side. Gothic, monstrous crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_05.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved band and its spikes; colour 3 on the two small floating thorns; colour 2 on the outer hooked blades.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_06.description: A broken spiked halo floating above the head: a thin curved band with a split in the middle, tall central spike, swept side spikes, and detached small thorn shapes and curved hooks hovering around it.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Epic_06.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the halo band and its central and side spikes; colour 3 on the small floating thorns; colour 2 on the outer curved hooked horns.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Large_02.description: A floating halo ornament hovering above the head: concentric spiral bands wrap around a central round gem, with three long tapering spikes radiating outward, one pointing forward-down. Suggests a sci-fi or fantasy crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spiked_Halo_Large_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiral bands; colour 3 on the central orb; colour 2 on the three spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spikeymask_01.description: A sleek, angular mask-helmet covering the crown, forehead and upper face, with a pointed brow ridge, narrow slanted eye openings and a crest of sharp spikes fanning out around the top and sides. Superhero or monstrous style.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Spikeymask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the mask; colour 1 on the tips of the spikes as a fade; colour 3 on the trim lining the eye openings; colour 2 on the inner back of the shell.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_.description: A hawk-styled head covering: overlapping feathers cover the crown, back of the head and neck, ending in a feathered ruff at the collarbone. A beaked half mask with swept-up pointed ear tufts covers the eyes and nose and leaves the mouth open.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers and ruff; colour 1 on the beaked mask and the outer edges of the ear tufts; colour 2 on the inner sides of the ear tufts.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Steelhawk_Mask_01.description: A close-fitting metal helmet with segmented horizontal ridges over the crown, a swept nose-guard and brow piece over the face, and tall feathered wing blades sweeping up from each side. Superhero hawk styling.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Steelhawk_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell and chin edge; colour 1 on the wing blades; colour 2 on the brow and nose-guard plate and thin ridge lines.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A close-fitting helmet with a swept-back crest of segmented plates, pointed fin-like wings at the temples, a nose guard and open eye slits. It covers the crown, sides and back of the head, with a sharp point at the nape.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell, side wings and nose guard; colour 1 on the band flanking the crest and the large back panel; colour 3 on the segmented crest plates.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Techcat_01.description: A full-head mechanical cat helmet with pointed ears holding ribbed inner panels, a smooth domed crown, angular cheek plates, slanted eye slits and a separate faceplate that covers the nose and mouth down to the chin.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Techcat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed crown, ear rims and cheek plates; colour 1 on the faceplate and jaw panels; colour 3 on the eye slits and the ribbed ear inserts; colour 2 on the seams and the ribbing between the ear inserts.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Tiara_Warrior_01.description: A slim superhero tiara sitting low across the forehead, with a central pointed shield-shaped plate holding a star emblem, winged chevron layers either side, and thin banded strips wrapping around the head to the back.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Tiara_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band, shield frame and outer strips; colour 1 on the winged chevron layers and part of the star; colour 3 on the outline edging and the rear star; colour 2 in the shield centre.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Tiara_Warrior_01.differs: The front plate is larger and more upright, with the winged chevrons packed closer to the shield and the side strips sitting lower on the head.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Titan_01.description: A close-fitting angular helmet with a faceted domed crown, broad side panels and cheek guards that frame an open face. The brow is a pointed visor-like ridge, and the back is smooth. Suits a sci-fi or superhero look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Titan_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the crown and brow; colour 0 on the side and back panels; colour 1 on the front cheek guards and the panel edges.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Urban_Anime_Hood_01.description: A close-fitting hood that covers the top, back and sides of the head, with an open face and a deep shadowed opening. Angular panelled sections and a broad band across the back give it a sleek, urban anime look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Urban_Anime_Hood_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown and back panels and the inner face lining; colour 1 on the top and side panels and the lower edges; colour 2 on the band across the back and the inside of the hood; colour 3 on small accents at the lower edge.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Urban_Anime_Hood_Ear.description: A close-fitting hood with two pointed cat-like ears on top, an open face and a jagged lower edge that drapes to the neck and shoulders. Panelled construction gives it a casual anime-inspired street look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Urban_Anime_Hood_Ear.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hood body and inner lining; colour 1 on the ears and edge panels; colour 2 on the broad band across the back and sides; colour 3 on small accents at the lower edge.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Urban_Beanie_01.description: A knitted, ribbed beanie that sits low on the head and covers the forehead down to the brows, with a slightly slouched crown and a wide contrasting cuff band edged with thin piping.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Urban_Beanie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed knit crown; colour 2 on the wide cuff band; colour 1 on the piping edging the cuff.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Vikorin_02.description: A crested alien headpiece: a smooth capped shell over the crown and brow with a fan of angular, hooked fins along the top, side prongs by the temples, and a long rigid tail curving down the back of the neck.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Vikorin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth shell and the tail; colour 1 on the crest fins, side prongs and edge panels; colour 3 on the thin inset lines.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Vine_01.description: A partial head piece of two mirrored, curling vine-like tendrils that frame the eyes and cheeks, with sharp thorn tips sprouting upward and curling round the temples and back of the head. Organic and monstrous, worn as a mask-like crown.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine tendrils; colour 0 on the swirled inner panels and highlights; colour 3 on the thorn tips and spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Viperpsionic_01.description: A smooth close-fitting helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, with raised curving trim lines, small round studs at the brow and temples, and three thin swept-back antenna spikes along the top. It leaves the face open.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Viperpsionic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the helmet shell; colour 1 on the raised curving trim bands; colour 3 on the small studs and a thin ridge line; colour 2 on the antenna spikes.

Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Welder_01.description: A boxy welder-style helmet that covers the whole head and face down to the nose. It has a wide angular shell, a low slot opening at the front, two padded blocks on top and small bolts at the sides.
Male/M_Helmet_Tight_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the helmet shell; colour 2 on the padded blocks on top and the straps inside the back; colour 3 on the front slot panel and the inner back panel.

Male/M_Helmet_Tinfoil_Hat_01.description: A snug, lumpy skullcap-style hat with a rolled band around the rim, a vertical stripe panel down the front, and two thin crinkled foil strips sticking up from the top like antennae. Comic, homemade look.
Male/M_Helmet_Tinfoil_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cap; colour 3 on the front stripe panel; colour 2 on the rim band and top patch; colour 0 on the antenna strips.

Male/M_Helmet_Toy_01.description: A tall, rounded cylindrical toy-soldier shako hat sitting high on the head, with a zigzag-edged band around the base and a raised fleur-de-lis style emblem on the front. Playful, cute military look.
Male/M_Helmet_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hat body; colour 1 on the zigzag band around the base; colour 2 on the front emblem.

Male/M_Helmet_Toy_Crown_01.description: A simple toy-style crown: a narrow open band worn on top of the head, rising into several tall, thin pointed spikes in a regular zigzag. Flat, plain construction with a fantasy royal feel.
Male/M_Helmet_Toy_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crown band and spikes; no other separate colour areas are visible.
Male/M_Helmet_Toy_Crown_01.differs: The male crown has a matte finish and evenly spaced, more regular spikes that stay mostly upright.

Male/M_Helmet_Traveler_01.description: A soft, rounded cap made of eight glossy leather-like wedge panels meeting at a small button on top, with a lighter inner band and thin contrasting piping around the rim. It sits snugly on the crown of the head.
Male/M_Helmet_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on alternating wedge panels; colour 3 on the other alternating wedge panels; colour 0 on the inner band at the rim; colour 2 on the piping and top button.

Male/M_Helmet_Traveler_02.description: A soft, slouchy beret-style cap with a puffed, wrinkled crown over a narrow contrasting band at the brow, topped by a tall curved feather plume that sweeps up from the side.
Male/M_Helmet_Traveler_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap crown; colour 2 on the band and the feather quill; colour 1 on the feather barbs.

Male/M_Helmet_Trumpknight_02.description: A smooth, rounded full-head helmet with a wide horizontal eye slit and a deep chin guard that covers the lower face and neck, finished with a thin contrasting rim at the bottom edge.
Male/M_Helmet_Trumpknight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper dome of the helmet; colour 1 on the lower face and neck guard; colour 2 on the bottom rim edging.

Male/M_Helmet_Umbrella_01.description: A novelty umbrella hat: a wide, shallow canopy of pointed fabric panels radiating from a central tip, with slim ribs ending in small ball tips, worn on top of the head on a narrow headband.
Male/M_Helmet_Umbrella_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on alternating canopy panels; colour 3 on alternating canopy panels; colour 2 on the remaining canopy panels; colour 0 on the ribs, ball tips and headband.

Male/M_Helmet_Unicorn_Horn_01.description: A single spiralling unicorn horn that tapers to a point, mounted on the centre of the forehead at the hairline and angled forward and upward. Twisting bands run along its length, giving a fantasy creature look.
Male/M_Helmet_Unicorn_Horn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded base and one spiral band; colour 1 on another spiral band; colour 2 on the twisting bands between them.

Male/M_Helmet_Unicorn_Horn_02.description: A single spiralling unicorn horn that rises from the top of the forehead and tilts slightly forward, tapering to a point. Twisting ridges wind around it, and a rounded knobbly base sits against the scalp.
Male/M_Helmet_Unicorn_Horn_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base knob and one spiral ridge; colour 1 on another spiral band; colour 2 on the remaining spiral band.

Male/M_Helmet_Viper_Supremeserpent_01.description: A snug serpent-styled helmet covering the crown and sides of the head, with a segmented central ridge running front to back, angular cheek plates with small eye slits, and short fang-like points at the brow. The face stays open.
Male/M_Helmet_Viper_Supremeserpent_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the segmented central ridge, back shell and lower band; colour 0 on the cheek plates; colour 2 on the brow and side frame; colour 3 on the eye slits.

Male/M_Helmet_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A tall conical hennin hat with a textured scale-like cone and a decorative band at the brim, trailing a long triangular veil down the back with a scalloped lace edge, plus loose hair strands at the sides.
Male/M_Helmet_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cone and the upper veil; colour 1 on the lower veil and hair tips; colour 2 on the scalloped veil edge; colour 3 on the decorative band.
Male/M_Helmet_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The veil is a little shorter and hangs closer to the back, with a broader, blunter drape.

Male/M_Helmet_Wizard_Hat_01.description: A classic wizard hat with a wide, wavy, drooping brim and a tall crumpled cone that bends into a curled tip. A belt band with a square buckle wraps the base, with a small skull ornament on the side.
Male/M_Helmet_Wizard_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brim, cone and skull; colour 1 on the curled tip of the cone, fading in from the cone; colour 2 on the band; colour 3 on the buckle.
Male/M_Helmet_Wizard_Hat_01.differs: The male hat adds a small skull ornament attached to the side of the band, next to the buckle.

Male/M_Helmet_Wolf_01.description: A full wolf-head helmet with a long tapered muzzle, tall pointed ears with swirling filigree at their bases, a central raised crest running down the snout, and swept-back pointed flares at the rear. It covers the whole head.
Male/M_Helmet_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main helmet shell; colour 3 on the central snout stripe and thin edge lines; colour 2 on the ears and swirl ornaments; colour 1 on the eyes.

Male/M_Helmet_Wolf_Pelt_01.description: A wolf-pelt headdress worn over the head like a hood: the wolf face with pointed ears sits over the brow, and shaggy fur drapes over the shoulders and back. Two paws cross at the chest, tied with a knot.
Male/M_Helmet_Wolf_Pelt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the cape, ears, muzzle and paws; colour 1 on the fur over the head and face and the fur tips; colour 3 on the knot at the chest; colour 2 on the nose and inner ears.

Male/M_Helmet_Wooden_01.description: A tribal face mask helm with a carved skull-like face, curved horns at the temples, a ring of long pointed feather-like spikes fanning around the head, and small hoop earrings hanging beside the jaw.
Male/M_Helmet_Wooden_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask face, horns and spikes; colour 1 on the central face marking, spike tips and horn tips; colour 3 on the eyes, mouth line and horn bands; colour 2 on the horn stripes and spike edges.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_01.description: A pair of tall, slender segmented antennae rising from the top of the head and curving outward then inward, each with jointed sections and a tapered tip. Suggests an alien or insectoid look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower antenna stalks; colour 1 on the upper jointed segments; colour 2 on the joint bands; colour 3 on the tips.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_01.differs: The male antennae are set closer together and sweep backward more, with the tips pointing in a similar direction and overlapping in side view.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_02.description: A pair of long, thin curving antennae rising from the top of the head, each with a thick base stalk, a slender ringed upper section and a rounded knob at the tip. Suggests an insectoid or alien look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Alien_Antennae_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the thick lower stalks; colour 0 on the slender upper stalks; colour 2 on the small rings; colour 3 on the tip knobs.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Amazon_01.description: A helmet crest worn along the centre of the head: a curved metal base band supports a tall, swept-back fin-like plume that trails to a long point behind the head, with small spiked studs along the ridge.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plume; colour 2 on the base band; colour 0 on the thin edge trim along the band; colour 3 on the small spikes and struts.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Animatroinc_01.description: A pair of tall, tapering faceted spikes like mechanical horns or antennae, each mounted on a small rectangular bracket on top of the head and angled slightly outward and upward.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Animatroinc_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tapered spikes; colour 0 on the small mounting brackets.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Anniversary16_2025_0.description: A pair of side-of-head feather fans that sweep out from the temples and ears, with pointed feather tufts under the jaw and a small bone-shaped ornament across the top of the head. Tribal, fantasy styling.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Anniversary16_2025_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the broad inner feathers and the bone ends; colour 1 on the outer feathers, jaw tufts and the bone band; colour 2 on the back feather tips and one bone end.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Anniversary16_2025_0.differs: The male version has light feathers with contrasting accents and contrasting and contrasting bone details, unlike the female's contrasting colouring.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Anniversary_Destroye.description: A thin metal circlet band sitting around the crown of the head, dipping to a pointed V over the brow, with several tall curved spikes rising from it like a spiked crown. Villainous retro sci-fi style.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Anniversary_Destroye.colourAreas: Glossy metal ignores most of the colour scheme; the band and spikes show a metallic finish, with colour 0 faintly on the band edges.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Anniversary_Destroye.differs: The male version has taller, more upright spikes on a thinner, open band that sits higher around the head.
