Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Destroyerbot_0.description: A slim angular circlet worn across the forehead, with a central faceted gem-like crest and two long tapering blade horns sweeping up and outward from the temples. Suggests a fantasy or mechanical demon look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Destroyerbot_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the circlet band and horns; colour 1 on the central crest and the small crest fins.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Egyptian_Phara.description: A small rearing cobra ornament sitting on top of the head like a crest, with a flared hood, studded rim, ribbed underbelly and a coiled tail curling down the back of the head. Egyptian pharaoh style.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Egyptian_Phara.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood shell and tail; colour 1 on the snake head, the inside of the hood and the centre seam; colour 2 on the ribbed belly; colour 3 on the back markings and eyes.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Firebird_03.description: A pair of long, swept-back horn-like flames rising from the top of the head, each ringed at the base by clusters of shorter curved spikes. The horns taper to sharp points and give a demonic, fiery look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Firebird_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the base of the horns and spikes; colour 2 on the mid-section of the horns; colour 1 on the horn tips and spike tips; colour 0 on the small spike points.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Fullhelm_Fin_0.description: A thick, smooth mohawk-style crest that runs front to back along the centre of the head, tapering to a point at the forehead and widening toward the nape. It has a flat top and a thin hollow underside.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Fullhelm_Fin_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole crest; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Fullhelm_Scoop.description: A mohawk-style crest that arches from the forehead over the top of the head to the nape, flaring wider at the back. A recessed slatted vent grille sits at the front, giving a mechanical helmet-fin look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Fullhelm_Scoop.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crest shell; colour 1 on the vent grille frame and slats; colour 2 on the grille interior.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_01.description: A single oval faceted gemstone set on the middle of the forehead, with a flat table facet in the centre and angular cut facets around the edge; it sits flush and slightly domed against the skin.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_01.colourAreas: The gem appears glossy and mostly ignores the scheme; a faint tint from colour 1 shows on some edge facets.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_02.description: A single faceted diamond-shaped gem mounted flat on the middle of the forehead, with a raised beveled centre and pointed top and bottom. A small jewel-like brow ornament with a fantasy or sci-fi feel.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_02.colourAreas: The gem appears glossy and dark; it seems to ignore the colour scheme, with no visible use of colour slots 0, 1 or 3.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_03.description: A small square faceted gemstone with bevelled edges and a flat back, mounted on the middle of the forehead like a brow jewel. Glossy and angular, it suggests fantasy or sci-fi headgear.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_03.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; faint hints of colour 1 show in the facets, with no other slots visible.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_04.description: A small faceted pentagonal gemstone with bevelled edges, set flat on the centre of the forehead like a third-eye jewel. It has a glossy, polished surface with a slightly recessed centre facet.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_04.colourAreas: The glossy gem largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 2 shows on the bevelled facets, with a faint hint of colour 1 along one upper edge.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_05.description: A faceted heart-shaped gemstone worn flat on the centre of the forehead, with a cut-crystal front face and a shallow, slightly domed back. A small decorative brow jewel with a fantasy or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_05.colourAreas: The gem is glossy and mostly ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 shows on the central front facet, and a faint tint from colour 1 on the upper facets.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_05.differs: The central front facet takes colour 0 as a distinct light panel, contrasting with the glossy outer facets.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_06.description: A single teardrop-shaped faceted gemstone set flat on the centre of the forehead, pointing upward, with a smaller inner facet and a flat back. Suggests a third-eye or mystic brow jewel.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_06.colourAreas: The glossy gem outline mostly ignores the colour scheme, with a hint of colour 1 on the upper facets; colour 0 shows on the brushed inner facet.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Gemstone_06.differs: The male gem has a lighter, brushed inner facet in the centre, whereas the female version's inner facet is contrasting and glassy.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Blackfan.description: A pair of tall curved horns rising from short banded bases at the temples, sweeping outward then upward to sharp tips, with segmented bands along their length. Sits on the forehead as a monstrous headpiece.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Blackfan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts and tips; colour 1 on the cylindrical bands at the horn bases; colour 2 on the darker segments and joints along the horns.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Bonemant.description: A pair of tall, sweeping bone-like horns rising from small angular base plates on the forehead, curving up and inward to fine tips, with ridged surfaces and a small spur on each horn.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Bonemant.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies and ridges; colour 1 fading in toward the horn tips; the small base plates take a neutral grey.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Creepy_0.description: A pair of tall curved horns rising from the top of the head, tapering to sharp glossy tips, with segmented ridged shafts wrapped in thin contrasting bands. Monstrous, demonic look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Creepy_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower horn shafts; colour 1 on the upper shaft blending toward the tips; colour 3 on the thin bands around the shafts; colour 2 on the horn tips.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Crow_01.description: A pair of long ridged horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping outward and up in a curve that tapers to sharp tips. Segmented ribbing runs along each horn, giving a monstrous, demonic look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Crow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of each horn; colour 3 on the tapering tips, blending smoothly from the base.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Cybercat.description: A pair of mechanical cat-ear horns: short cylindrical metal tubes with segmented barrels that rise from the top of the head in a V, each with a ringed base collar and a small capped tip.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Cybercat.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the base collars and the tip caps; colour 1 on the upper barrel sections; colour 0 on the lower barrel sections; colour 2 on the band details.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Demon_02.description: A pair of curved demon horns that sprout from the forehead near the hairline, each a segmented, ridged horn that sweeps outward then up to a sharp point, seated in a small angular base collar.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Demon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn segments; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 3 on the base collars at the forehead.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Faceless.description: A pair of long, smooth curved horns rising from the top of the forehead and sweeping up and slightly inward to sharp points, with thin ringed bands of contrasting lines spiralling along each horn.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Faceless.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main horn surfaces; colour 1, colour 2 and colour 3 on the thin banded lines wrapping each horn.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Gazelle_.description: A pair of long, smooth gazelle-like horns that rise from small collars on top of the head, curve backward and taper to sharp points. They sit on the crown and suggest a beast or monstrous look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Gazelle_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the tapering horn tips; colour 3 on the base collars.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_01.description: A pair of curved goat horns rising from the top of the head and sweeping backward in segmented ridged arcs to pointed tips, each seated in a short contrasting base collar. Suggests a beastly or demonic look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips, fading in from the shaft; colour 3 on the base collars.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_02.description: A pair of large ridged goat horns rising from the top of the forehead, sweeping up and back in a long curve to pointed tips. Each sits in a small angular base collar. Suggests a beastly or demonic look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips, shading toward the ends; colour 3 on the base collars.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_03.description: A pair of long, slender goat horns rising from the top of the head, sweeping up and back in a wavy curve with ridged texture and tips that flick outward. Animalistic, monstrous fantasy look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the base of each horn; colour 0 on the ridged horn shafts; colour 1 on the outer tips, fading in gradually from the shaft.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_04.description: A pair of tall spiralling goat horns rising from the top of the head, twisting in a corkscrew and curving outward, then flicking back to sharp tips. Ridged, segmented surface suggests a beastly, monstrous look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Goat_04.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the horn bases; colour 0 on the middle of each horn; colour 1 on the upper spiral and tips. Colour 3 is not visible.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Hook_01.description: A pair of tall curling horns rising from the sides of the head, each a segmented hooked stalk with banded joints and several sharp tines branching outward and upward, giving a monstrous antler-like crown.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Hook_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and long stalk segments; colour 1 on the banded joints and collars; colour 3 on the upper forward-pointing tines; colour 2 on the lower tines and hook tips.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Quad_01.description: Four curved, tapering horns sprouting from the top and front of the head: a large pair sweeping up and back, and a smaller pair curling forward near the brow, each rooted in a chunky segmented collar.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Quad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts, fading toward colour 1 at the tips; colour 3 on the base collars.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Reindeer.description: A pair of large branching reindeer antlers that curve outward and upward from the sides of the head, with many tines and forward-curling brow prongs near the temples. Worn as a head accessory with a fantasy, beastly feel.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Reindeer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main antler surface; colour 1 gives a faint tint toward the shaded tines. Colours 2 and 3 are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Reindeer.description: A pair of large branching reindeer antlers that curl out from the sides of the head, sweep back and up, and split into many tines. They rise well above the head, suggesting a fantasy creature or woodland spirit.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Reindeer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main antler branches and tines; colour 1 as a faint tint in the shaded curves; the tips are darkened by shading.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Six_01.description: A set of six curved, tapering horns, three on each side of the crown, sweeping up and back to sharp points. Each horn rises from a small collar-like base sitting on the top of the head, giving a demonic, monstrous look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Six_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips as a fade; colour 3 on the base sockets at the roots.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Spikedan.description: A pair of curling monstrous horns that sweep down from the top of the head and back up past the ears. Each has a spotted, spiky furred base, a segmented banded middle and a sharp hooked tip.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Spikedan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spotted furred base of the horns; colour 2 on the spots and small spikes; colour 1 on the banded segments; colour 3 on the hooked tips.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Unicorn_.description: A single tapering unicorn horn rising from the centre of the forehead and sweeping forward and upward in a gentle curve to a sharp point, with a faceted base sitting on the brow.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Unicorn_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and lower shaft of the horn; colour 1 blends through the middle of the shaft; colour 2 on the tip.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Zorran_0.description: A pair of ridged ram-style horns that sprout from the sides of the head just above the ears and curl backward and down in a tight spiral. Beastly, monstrous look, worn as a partial head accessory.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Zorran_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer ridged surface of the horns; colour 1 on the inner curl and tips of the horns; colour 0 on the flat cut faces at the front.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Horns_Zorran_0.differs: The male horns have a mostly contrasting outer surface with contrasting flat cut faces at the front, while the female horns have a contrasting outer surface.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Insect_Hoses_0.description: A crown of thick, flexible hoses arching over the top of the head from front to back, each ending in a ridged connector nozzle pointing down at the scalp. Suggests an insectoid or cybernetic head rig.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Insect_Hoses_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hose tubing; colour 3 on the thin stripes running along the hoses; colour 1 on the rings at the connector bases; colour 0 on the connector nozzle tips.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Lightning_01.description: A thin, flat lightning-bolt crest that stands upright on the top of the head, running front to back. It has a zigzag profile and a slim edge when seen head-on, a simple sci-fi or superhero head accent.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Lightning_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bolt; the edges catch light but no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Patriot_Wings_.description: A pair of feathered head wings mounted at the temples on short cylindrical stubs, sweeping up and back in tall curved arcs with a smooth rounded spine and layered pointed feathers ending in a sharp tip.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Patriot_Wings_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved spine of each wing; colour 3 on the mounting stubs; colour 0 and colour 2 on the layered feathers.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Rhino_Large_01.description: A single large curved rhino-style horn rising from the centre of the forehead at the hairline, with a segmented ridged surface, a tapering point that sweeps forward and up, and a chunky faceted base collar.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Rhino_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower horn shaft; colour 1 on the upper horn and tip; colour 3 on the base collar.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Rhino_Small_01.description: A single small rhino-style horn mounted at the centre of the forehead near the hairline, with a ridged, segmented surface that curves back and up to a point, set on an angular faceted base plate.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Rhino_Small_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the faceted base plate; colour 0 on the lower horn ridges; colour 1 on the upper tip of the horn, blending from colour 0.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Ribbons_01.description: A single long, narrow ribbon that starts at the top of the head, arches over the crown and hangs straight down the back to a tapered point around thigh level, with a subtly frayed, streaked look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Ribbons_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the band where the ribbon starts over the crown; colour 0 on the main length of the ribbon; colour 1 on the thin edge along the tail.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_0.description: A crown of thick segmented hoses arching over the top of the scalp from forehead to back of head, each ending in a ribbed connector plug that presses into the skull. Suggests cybernetic implants or a monstrous neural interface.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_0.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hose bodies; colour 3 on the thin edge lines running along the hoses; colour 1 on the ring bands at the joints; colour 0 on the plug-shaped connector tips.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_01_Ne.description: A thin, swept-back fin that runs along the centre of the head from forehead to nape, like a mohawk. It curves up and back to a sharp tip, with a notched, jagged trailing edge.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_01_Ne.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the piece uses a skin-like default material, so the other slots are not visible.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_01_Ne.differs: The male fin is taller and sweeps back further past the head.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_02_Ne.description: A large swept-back shark fin worn as a crest along the top of the head: a thin, curved skin-like membrane rising to a sharp point, with ragged pointed edges along its rear base.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Sharkfin_02_Ne.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole fin; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece, and the default skin material shows a skin tone.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Spike_Crown_01.description: A thin curved crown band arching across the top of the forehead, with rows of long cone spikes radiating outward and inward and small studs along the front face. Reads as a punk or monstrous spiked circlet.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Spike_Crown_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown band; colour 1 on the spikes and studs.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Titan_01.description: A pair of tall, sharply curved horns rising from the top of the head and sweeping outward then upward to points. Each is a hollow blade-like shell with a flat inner face, giving a monstrous, demonic look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Tight_Titan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the horns; colour 2 on the hollow inner faces; colour 1 gives a slight tint on the back-facing edges.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Trumpknigh_01.description: A tall, spiky plume of jagged feather-like hair tufts gathered by a short cylindrical tie on top of the head, then swept back and down to chin length, layered in ragged points.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Trumpknigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front crest tufts and the tie; colour 1 on the outer top and lower tufts; colour 2 on the inner back layers; colour 3 on a small accent tuft at the lower back.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Valorous_04.description: A pair of tall, pointed angular ear-like fins joined by a small rounded connector across the top of the head. Each has a recessed inner panel with cross struts, suggesting a beastly mechanical helmet.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Valorous_04.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shells and connector; colour 1 on the strut highlights and edges; colour 3 on the recessed inner panels.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Valorous_04.differs: The male version has a glossy rounded connector and a smoother ear shell without the thick raised frame, and its default colouring is mostly contrasting rather than light.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Winged_01.description: A slim circlet band worn around the head with a pointed V-shaped dip at the brow. Two tall, swept-back feather-like wings rise from the sides like long ears, with striped bands of layered feathers.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Winged_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the circlet band; colour 0 on the outer edges and tips of the wings; colour 1 and colour 2 on alternating stripes along the wing feathers.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A tall cone-shaped cloth hood or veil that rises to a sharp point high above the head, then drapes down the back in a diamond-shaped fall with a scalloped lace edge.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cone; colour 1 on the lower drape, fading in from the cone; colour 2 on the scalloped lace edging.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The male drape is wider and falls a bit lower across the back, with the cone leaning back slightly.

Male/M_Helmetattach_Wooden_01.description: A crest of long, pointed leaf-like blades radiating from a thin band around the crown and back of the head, flaring outward in a spiky, feathered headdress with a tribal, wild look.
Male/M_Helmetattach_Wooden_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade surfaces; colour 1 on alternating blades and the blade faces; colour 3 on the thin veins along the blades; colour 2 on the edge lines and the headband.

Male/M_Helmetattatch_Fullhelm_Crest_01.description: A tall, swept-back fin-shaped crest that runs front to back over the crown of the head, rising to a sharp point behind the head, with a hollow open back and a stripe down its centre line. Suggests a streamlined Art Deco helmet ornament.
Male/M_Helmetattatch_Fullhelm_Crest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main crest shell; colour 1 on the central stripe along the ridge; colour 2 on the hollow inner back of the crest.

Male/M_Helmetattatch_Tight_Crest_01.description: A sleek, swept-back helmet crest: a narrow fin-like ridge running front to back along the centre of the head, rising to a point behind the crown, with a contrasting stripe along its length. Suits sci-fi or art deco looks.
Male/M_Helmetattatch_Tight_Crest_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the crest; colour 1 on the stripe running along its centre; colour 2 on the small underside gap at the back.

Male/M_Helmetattatch_Tight_Sidespikes_01.description: A set of six conical spikes studding the sides and top of the head in two clusters, pointing up and outward like a ridge of horns. Suggests a monstrous or punk look.
Male/M_Helmetattatch_Tight_Sidespikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the spikes.

Male/M_Helmetattetch_Tight_Middlespikes_.description: Three separate conical spikes set in a line along the centre of the scalp, the tallest at the crown angled upward and the other two tilting forward and backward. A punk, mohawk-like head accessory.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Anniversary_Destroyer.description: A thin metal circlet band that dips into a V-shaped point at the brow, with tall curved spikes rising from its upper edge. It sits around the crown of the head like a spiked tiara.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Anniversary_Destroyer.colourAreas: The material looks glossy metal and mostly ignores the scheme; colour 0 may tint the band edges and spikes slightly.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Anniversary_Mindslaye.description: A small rounded forehead cap that sits on the front of the scalp, with a raised, puffy diamond-shaped gem-like centre set into a shallow domed plate; the back is open and hollow. A retro superhero head ornament.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Anniversary_Mindslaye.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed plate around the diamond; colour 3 on the raised diamond centre.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Anubis_01.description: A pair of tall, pointed ear guards made of ridged, fin-like plates that sweep up and outward from the sides of the top of the head, giving a jackal-like, animal-eared silhouette.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Anubis_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ridged plates; the piece appears to use only this one slot, with no visible contrasting parts.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Arcane_01.description: A bell-shaped cloth headdress that drapes over the head and falls to the shoulders with a flared, ruffled hem and two stripe bands. A trim band frames the crown, with a round medallion at the front and small rosette ornaments at the sides.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main draped cloth and hem; colour 0 on the stripe bands; colour 1 on the trim band and the front medallion; colour 3 on the medallion centre and the side rosettes.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Arcane_01.differs: The front sits higher on the forehead, leaving the eyes and face more open, while the female version's front drape hangs lower over the brow.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Aztecheaddress_01.description: A small sculpted human skull perched on top of the head like a headdress, with hollow eye sockets, a nasal cavity and a jaw, sitting above the forehead rather than covering the face.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Aztecheaddress_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skull; the eye sockets show shading only and no other slot is visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Beanie_01.description: A novelty propeller topper: a slim stacked stem of ringed segments with a pointed tip rises from a small hub, carrying a thin twisted two-blade propeller. It floats just above the crown of the head, with no cap shown.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Beanie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the propeller blades and central hub; colour 1 on the stem segments and pointed tip; colour 3 on one ring of the stem; colour 2 on the short stem section below the tip.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Beanie_02.description: A tiny propeller-beanie spindle: a slim vertical stack of segmented rings and a cylindrical hub topped with a pointed cone, standing upright on the crown of the head. No cap or blades are visible.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Beanie_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cylindrical hub; colour 1 on the pointed tip, upper ring and lower ridged segments; colour 2 on the band under the tip; colour 3 on the ring above the lower segments.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Bike_01.description: A brow-mounted visor shield: a swept, angular peak with a central V-shaped ridge and pointed upward wings, sitting across the forehead. Two short side arms with round bolts wrap toward the temples, leaving the face and back of the head open.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Bike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower edges and the underside of the peak; colour 1 on the outer wing tips and side arms; colour 3 on the central V panel and ridge; colour 2 on the side bolts.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Bonemantis_01.description: A pair of large, rounded insect-style compound eyes that sit over the eyes on the front of the face, each with a raised rim and a smooth domed centre. Hollow and open at the back.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Bonemantis_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rims around each eye; colour 3 on the domed eye centres.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Bonemantis_01.differs: This version is a pair of large insect eyes over the face, whereas the female version is a ring of bone claws at the throat.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Brainjar_Dome_01.description: A translucent glass dome that sits on top of the head like a raised, faceted crown. It has a rounded top and a straight cut edge around the forehead and sides, leaving the face bare. Suggests a sci-fi brain case.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Brainjar_Dome_01.colourAreas: The dome is translucent glass and largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint at the rim edge is the only visible variation.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Cape_Qlyphotic_01.description: A long hooded cloth cape that drapes from the head over the shoulders and down the back to below the knees, with a ragged, hole-riddled hem and long trailing tattered streamers at the sides.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Cape_Qlyphotic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hood and upper cape; colour 1 on the lower cape and tattered hem, blending down from colour 0.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Chicken_Eyes_01.description: A pair of small domed half-sphere eyeballs that float on either side of the head at temple height, each with a small round pupil facing outward. Cartoonish add-on for a chicken or beast mask.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Chicken_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball domes; colour 3 on the pupils.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Car_Cat_01.description: A pair of rounded, triangular cartoon cat ears with a soft, puffy outer shell and a recessed inner panel. They float slightly above the head, angled outward, with no band or connecting piece.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Car_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim of each ear; colour 1 on the recessed inner panel of each ear.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Cat_Eyes_01.description: A pair of oversized cartoon eyeballs that stick out from the sides of the head at temple height, each a smooth rounded sphere with a large iris and pupil facing forward. Comical and cute.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Cat_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball whites; colour 1 on the irises; colour 2 on the pupils.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Emblem_02.description: A small flat atom-symbol emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central nucleus, sitting on the centre of the forehead like a decal. It has a superhero or sci-fi feel.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Emblem_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the outlines and edging of the rings.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Face_Feather_01.description: A pair of small, flat, hexagonal feather-like plates worn on the temples beside the eyes, each with a swooping curved notch cut into it. They sit against the sides of the face as tiny decorative accents.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Face_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main faces of each plate; colour 0 on the swooping notch and the plate edges.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Teddy_Eyes_02.description: A pair of oversized four-hole sewing buttons floating at each side of the head, like teddy-bear button eyes or ear ornaments. Each is a flat disc with a raised rim and a recessed centre, with a plain back.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Child_Teddy_Eyes_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rims and the plain backs; colour 1 on the recessed button centres; colour 2 on the four holes.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Crimson_01.description: A small head-top crest: a tiny angular base plate on the crown holds two short segmented stalks that sweep up into long feathered plumes, which arc outward and droop to each side like antennae.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the small base plate; colour 0 on the short stalks; colour 3 on the long feathered plumes.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Crimson_02.description: A pair of curved, blade-like cheek guards that sweep from beside the eyes down along the jaw to sharp points, each with a raised fin-like ridge on top. The face stays open; the look is monstrous and fantasy.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Crimson_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer curved blades; colour 1 on the raised fin ridges. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Cryo_Bubble_Pointy_01.description: A tall, smooth bubble helmet with a domed top and straight sides that enclose the head and reach down to the neck base. The shell is translucent, so the head shows through, giving a sealed, cryogenic look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Cryo_Bubble_Pointy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole translucent shell; the other colour slots are not visible.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Cryo_Bubble_Pointy_01.differs: The male helmet is translucent glass that shows the head inside, while the female version looks opaque and solid.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Draco_01.description: A slim, open circlet-style head piece that sweeps into a V-shaped point over the brow, with two large swept-back horn blades rising from each temple. It sits on top of the head and leaves the face and crown uncovered.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn blades and outer circlet; colour 3 on the inner V-shaped brow band.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Draco_02.description: A partial head piece of angular, dragon-like blades: swept horn-shaped plates rise from each brow and temple, with small faceted fins behind them and a pair of curved claw-like fangs pointing down the cheeks.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brow blades and temple fins; colour 3 on the tips of the cheek fangs; colour 2 on the darker faceted plates.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Draco_Earrings_01.description: A pair of angular metal ear guards that sit over each ear and sweep outward and upward into long pointed fins, giving a horned, dragon-like helmet silhouette without covering the head.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Draco_Earrings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the guards; colour 1 on the inner edges and bevelled trim.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Draco_Earrings_02.description: A pair of curved, horn-like fin blades that sweep along both sides of the head, layered as overlapping serrated plates and ending in long points above the crown and below the jaw. Suggests a dragon or monstrous helmet accessory.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Draco_Earrings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on alternating plates of each fin; colour 2 on the other alternating plates; colour 1 and colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Dragon_Silly_02.description: A pair of small, smooth, forked horns that rise from the top of the head and angle outward, each with a short side prong. They suggest a playful, cartoonish dragon or deer look.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Dragon_Silly_03.description: Two small floating rectangular blocks that hover above the top of the head, angled outward like stubby antennae or horns. There is no cap or helmet, only the two separate pieces.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Dragon_Silly_04.description: A pair of cartoonish googly eyes perched on top of the head like stalks, each a rounded faceted eyeball with a large glossy pupil and highlight. A cute, silly monster look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Dragon_Silly_04.colourAreas: The eyes use their own painted texture and appear to ignore the colour scheme; no visible feature takes colour slots 0-3.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Hoses_01.description: A thin, translucent glass-like curved shell that arcs over the top and one side of the head like a swept-back crest, standing clear of the skull without covering the face. Sci-fi energy-containment look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole glassy shell; the glass-like default material largely ignores the other colour slots.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Hoses_01.differs: The male shell is a narrower sweep that sits more over the top and side, with a thin edge visible behind the head.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Warlord_01.description: A smooth, thick dome-shaped helmet shell that covers the top and front of the head down to the brow line, leaving the lower face open. A thin fin-like edge trails behind the head.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 across the whole dome; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Enclosure_Warlord_01.differs: The male version is a thick, rounded dome that covers the whole forehead and top of the head. The female version is a thin, swept-back shell that leaves the face and crown exposed.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Feather_01.description: A crest of overlapping leaf-like feathers arranged in a fan-shaped arc from the forehead over the crown to the nape, like a mohawk or headdress, with tips flaring outward and upward.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers; the shading varies across the crest. No other colour slots clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Gladiator_Alien_.description: A flat-planed face mask covering the forehead, eyes and nose and extending into a long elongated muzzle that ends in a pointed chin spike. It has narrow eye slits, engraved brow lines and chevron nostril grooves, giving an alien gladiator look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Gladiator_Alien_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole mask; colour 0 on the lit edge of the chin point and lower muzzle.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Horsemask_01.description: A pair of small rounded eyeball domes floating at the sides of the head, like a horse's eyes, each with a small round pupil facing outward. Monstrous, cartoonish beast styling.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Horsemask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball domes; colour 2 on the pupil rings; colour 3 on the centre of each pupil; colour 1 shades the back of the dome.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Horsemask_01.differs: The male version is a plain contrasting eyeball with a round pupil, without the wide band across the middle that the female version has.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Patriot_Mask_01.description: A small atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring, sitting flat on the side of the head above the temple. It reads as a decal-like badge with a science theme.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Patriot_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings; colour 1 on the outline edges and the central nucleus ring.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_01.description: A pair of tall, angular horn-like blades that sweep up from a V-shaped chin and mouth guard, curving up past the cheeks and temples on both sides of the face. Suggests a monstrous, sci-fi helm.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower guard and the lower part of the horns; colour 1 on the upper tips of the horns; the two blend in a gradient.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_02.description: A smooth, close-fitting skull cap with a low-poly faceted surface. It covers the crown and back of the head, and a slanted front section sweeps down into a point over the eyes and upper face like a visor.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the back and upper shell of the cap; colour 0 on the front and top panel; colour 2 on the lower front visor section.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_04.description: A partial angular face piece: a pointed, V-shaped mask panel covers the mouth and chin, with swept-back horn-like fins running along each side of the head to sharp tips behind the ears. Thin glassy lines cross the scalp.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed mask panel; colour 0 on the swept side fins; thin glass-like lines over the scalp ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Sacred_01.description: A pair of large upswept feathered wings mounted at the temples, flaring outward and tapering to tall points above the head. Each has a rimmed frame with layered feather ridges, suggesting a mythic winged helm.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Face_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and edge framing of each wing; colour 1 on the feather panels inside the wings.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Falcon_01.description: A partial crest of layered, blade-like feather shapes that sweeps back from a pointed gem at the brow over the top of the head, with a separate cluster of longer feathers at the back. The bare face and hair area stay open.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer brow-sweep feathers and the rear feathers; colour 1 on the central front feather and the side and back feathers; colour 2 on the inner feathers; colour 3 on the gem at the brow.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Fox_Eyes_01.description: A pair of rounded, eyeball-like shells floating at the temples on either side of the head, each with a small contrasting pupil facing outward and forward; a whimsical animal-mask accent that leaves the face bare.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Fox_Eyes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eyeball shells; colour 3 on the pupils; colour 2 on the rims around the pupils.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Full_Anniversary_Defe.description: A simple curved half-mask plate that wraps across the lower face from below the eyes to the chin, with a notched top edge and slightly flared sides. It is a plain, sleek retro-superhero face guard.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Full_Anniversary_Defe.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer face of the plate, with a faint colour 1 sheen on the inner surface. Other colour slots are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Full_Bounty_01.description: A minimal flat band-shaped visor that wraps across the eyes and around the sides of the head, with a long downward flap on each side of the face. Simple, angular construction with a sleek, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Full_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole band; the thin top edge shows a lighter tint of the same slot.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Full_Bounty_02.description: A wide, flat visor band that wraps across the eyes and temples, with a slightly angular, notched top edge and a thin contrasting rim. It is a simple opaque strip in a retro sci-fi bounty-hunter style.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Full_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the visor band; colour 1 (lighter) on the thin edge rim.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Full_Techno_01.description: A faceted angular half-mask that wraps across the cheeks, nose and mouth, with a pointed chin guard and small wedge-shaped studs at the temples. Open at the top and rear, it sits over the lower face like a sleek tech visor.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Full_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell of the mask; colour 2 on the small wedge-shaped studs at the temples.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Full_Trooper_04.description: A pair of slim, flat-sided angular blades that stand up and flare slightly outward from either side of the head, like antennae or short horns. Only the two spikes are present, with no helmet shell.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Gladiator_01.description: A pair of open, blade-like cheek and temple guards that sweep up into tall pointed fins beside the head and taper down to points along the jaw, with round ear discs. The face and crown stay uncovered.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer edges of the blades; colour 1 on the inner panels of the blades; colour 2 on the ear discs.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Gladiator_02.description: A pair of separate winged side pieces that sit over the ears and sweep up and back in tall curved blades, each with layered feather-like fins behind and a pointed cheek guard curving down beside the face.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade edges and cheek guards; colour 1 on the upper feather layer; colour 2 on the middle feather layer; colour 3 on the lower feather layer.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_01.description: A decorative dragon-style face piece: swept, feathery crests curl up and outward around each eye, joined by a thick shaggy whisker band that runs under the nose and around the cheeks and jaw. Suggests a fantasy beast mask.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the eye crests and feathery tufts; colour 1 on the shaggy whisker band that loops around the face.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_02.description: A pair of forked antler-like horns rising from the top of the head in a V, each a smooth tapered shaft with a short side branch, a ring band and a few thin stripes near the base.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn shafts and branches; colour 1 on the ring bands; colour 2 on the thin stripe bands.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_02.differs: The horns splay slightly wider apart and lean outward more.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_03.description: A pair of tall, pointed ear-like fins rising from the top of the head, each a curved shell with a notched, scalloped rear edge and a hollow inner face. Suggests a beastly or dragon-like fantasy look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of the ear shells; colour 1 on the hollow inner faces.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_03.differs: The male ears sit closer together and sweep back and outward at a more pronounced angle.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_04.description: A pair of bulging cartoon-like eyeball ornaments mounted on either side of the head at the temples, each a rounded shell with concentric iris rings and a pupil facing outward. Playful, monstrous, creature-inspired headgear.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded eyeball shells; colour 1 on the irises; colour 3 on the pupils; colour 2 on the outlines around the irises.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_05.description: A pair of small rounded, faceted knobs on short stalks, placed at either side of the head near the temples like ornamental horn-buds or sensors. Each has swirling contrasting bands across its surface.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_05.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main bulb of each knob; colour 1 on the swirling bands; colour 0 on the short stalks.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Guardian_05.differs: The knobs sit higher, beside the eyes and temples rather than down by the cheeks.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Half_Deity_03.description: A small curved plate covering the forehead and front of the crown, with a stepped, angular upper edge and a raised pointed shield-shaped inset down the centre. Sits like a partial helmet or brow guard over the bare head.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Half_Deity_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the stepped upper rim; colour 3 on the central shield inset; colour 2 on the outline around the inset.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Half_Nightvisor_01.description: A single round cyclops-style lens housing worn on the middle of the forehead: a chunky faceted ring with a glossy contrasting lens, a contrasting band around the rim and a smooth domed back.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Half_Nightvisor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ring and housing; colour 1 on the band around the rim; colour 2 on the lens.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Hat_Madjester_01.description: Four small floating bells hover around the head, two on each side, with no band or hat connecting them. Each bell is a flared cone with a small round clapper ball on top, suggesting a whimsical jester look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Hat_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bell bodies; colour 0 on the round balls on top of each bell.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Hats_Spy_01.description: A small rosebud-style flower worn on the side of the forehead near the temple: an outer ring of broad petals around a tightly coiled centre. A cute, decorative accent rather than a full hat.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Hats_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer petals; colour 1 on the coiled centre of the rose.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Heraldry_01.description: Three pointed cone spikes in a row along the centre of the head from front to back, each on a short cuffed base, forming a mohawk-like crest that curves back and down.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the spike cones; colour 3 on the short base collars.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Heraldry_02.description: A swept-back mohawk-style hair piece: a tall tuft of jagged, feathered locks rises from the crown and sweeps back into a long tapering tail past the nape, tied with a small band and topped with tiny spikes.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Heraldry_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hair locks; colour 1 on the small band at the base of the tuft.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Heraldry_02.differs: The male version's tuft lies lower and sweeps further back in a longer, arching tail.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Jester_01.description: A pair of small five-pointed metal stars floating on either side of the head at about ear height, standing free of the head with no band or cap. A whimsical jester-style accent.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Jester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stars; the default metal-like finish shows little of the other colour slots.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Kabuto_01.description: A small ornamental kabuto crest that floats above the crown of the head: a squared base with a carved key-pattern band, a slim neck, and a tall openwork knotwork plaque with curled, horn-like tips on each side.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Kabuto_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and the narrow neck; colour 3 on the recessed band of the base; colour 2 on the key-pattern carvings; colour 1 on the knotwork crest.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Kabuto_02.description: A helmet chin-strap accessory: two thick braided cords rise from a small plate under the chin up past the cheeks, joined below by a big looped bow knot with dangling tails. No helmet shell is shown.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Kabuto_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the braided cords and bow knot; colour 0 on the small chin plate; colour 2 on the plate's edge outline.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Lemurian_Bubble_01.description: A translucent glass-like bubble helmet that encloses the whole head, with a tall rounded dome and a flared lower rim that hangs to the shoulders and neck. Suggests an aquatic or alien life-support dome.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Lemurian_Bubble_01.colourAreas: The default glassy material ignores the colour scheme; no slot is clearly visible on the bubble.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A thin crown-like band that sits around the top of the head, with a jagged notched rim and a ring of tall curved horn spikes rising from it, evoking a villainous, monstrous coronet.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the curved horn spikes.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A superhero domino-style eye mask with angular, pentagonal eye openings and a pointed V-shaped brow that sweeps up to the sides. It wraps the eyes and nose bridge and ends in a flared, angled edge at the temples.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask body; colour 1 on the raised upper brow rim; colour 2 on the thin outline around the eye openings.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Modern_Kinetik_02.description: A pair of angular, slanted eye-shield lenses that sit over each eye like a stylised mask, with upswept outer corners and a thin raised rim; no strap is visible and the pieces do not join across the nose.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Modern_Kinetik_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised rim edges; colour 2 on the main lens surfaces.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Odragon_01.description: A pair of tall, curved dragon horns rising from the sides of the head and sweeping up and outward to sharp points, each with a small secondary spike near the tip. Fantasy monster headgear.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Odragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower and middle of each horn; colour 1 on the upper tips, fading in as a gradient.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Odragon_02.description: A set of floating fang-shaped tusks around the mouth: four downward-pointing cones hang from the upper lip and four smaller upward-pointing cones rise from the chin, forming a monstrous, dragon-like bite.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Odragon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the fangs, upper and lower; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Pirate_Hat_01.description: A small forehead ornament: two curved, horn-like arms sweep out from a central pointed plate, with a thin curved crest above. It sits flat on the brow like a stylised emblem, with a gothic, monstrous feel.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Pirate_Hat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two curved side arms; colour 0 on the central plate; colour 2 on the lower pointed centre; colour 3 on the upper crest.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Retro_Warlord_01.description: An angular lower-face mask made of layered, stacked plates with ridged edges, covering the face from below the eyes to the chin. It has a notched top and a stepped, pointed chin, giving a retro warlord look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer face of the plates; colour 1 on the inner surface, which shows from behind.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The male mask is built from several layered, offset plates with ridged edges, whereas the female one is a single flat sheet.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_Poi.description: A translucent retro sci-fi bubble helmet: a tall, egg-shaped glass dome that tapers to a point above the head and sits open at the neck, enclosing the whole head with generous space around it.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_Poi.colourAreas: The whole dome is a see-through glass-like material that largely ignores the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_Poi.description: A smooth, opaque, egg-shaped full-head bubble helmet with a tall pointed crown. It encloses the head, and the lower edge sweeps down into a point at the back of the neck.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_Poi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shell; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_Poi.differs: The male helmet has a smooth, glossy shell, while the female version has a rough, faceted surface.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_Rou.description: A large, translucent round bubble helmet that encloses the whole head in a smooth glassy dome, with an open flared lower rim resting around the neck and shoulders. Retro sci-fi spacesuit or diver style.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_Rou.colourAreas: The default material is glassy and translucent and does not visibly take the colour scheme; there are no separate coloured features.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_Rou.description: A smooth, opaque rounded dome helmet that fully encloses the head, with a plain front and a lower rim that stops at the neck. Its retro sci-fi bubble shape hides the face completely.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Retroscifi_Bubble_Rou.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole dome; the surface shows a mottled, faceted texture and no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Sandstorm_02.description: A partial angular face guard covering the eyes, nose and mouth, with a faceted brow plate flaring over the eyes and a narrow panel dropping down the face to the chin. It suggests a rugged sci-fi or monstrous mask.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the faceted brow plate and the cheek panel; colour 2 on the central nose and mouth panel; colour 0 on a small textured patch at the back edge.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Space_Glass_01.description: A sleek, translucent glass-like helmet shell covering the crown, brow and back of the head, with angular faceted edges, a V-shaped cut over the eyes and a notched lower rim at the nape. Futuristic space style.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Space_Glass_01.colourAreas: Glossy glass-like material that largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint from colour 0 on the shell and edge trim.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Stovepipe_Hat_Madjest.description: A small cluster of long curved feathers rising from a single point on top of the head and sweeping backward: two banded plumes with pointed tips and a wider soft feather beneath. A flamboyant jester-style head accent.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Stovepipe_Hat_Madjest.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the banded stripes of the two long plumes; colour 2 on the alternating bands and edges of those plumes; colour 0 and colour 1 on the wider soft feather, fading from one to the other.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Super_Retro_Destroyer.description: A pair of flat, angular teardrop-shaped eye lenses that sit over the eyes, each angled downward toward the nose with a thin flat profile. Evokes retro comic-villain goggles without a frame or strap.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Super_Retro_Destroyer.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both lens shapes, with a slight colour 1 sheen on the back faces; no other visible features.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Super_Retro_Destroyer.description: An open-topped, retro superhero headpiece: two tall swept-up pointed fins rise at the sides of the head, joined by a V-shaped brow that dips to a point over the forehead, with small spikes at the back.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Super_Retro_Destroyer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell of the fins and brow; the thin edge trim may take colour 1. The glossy metal finish largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Swing_01.description: A padded fabric headband worn around the forehead, with a pair of twin-lens goggles mounted on the front, resting on the brow. Rounded housings hold circular lenses with contrasting rims, joined by a ribbed bridge.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the headband; colour 0 on the goggle housings and bridge; colour 3 on the lenses; colour 2 on the lens rims.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Swing_01.differs: The male version has a wider curved plate at the back of the band, which is larger than the female one.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Swing_02.description: A partial hair-like head piece: a band of layered, swept feather-shaped locks wrapping the back and sides of the head, with a contrasting angular swoop across the forehead and scattered thin spikes.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Swing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the streaks and edges of the locks; colour 2 on the angular front panel.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Swing_03.description: A band of swept, wavy hair-like locks wrapping around the head at brow and nape level, with curling tufts at the temples and a jagged angular panel with raised points across the forehead. Leaves the crown bare.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Swing_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swirling locks; colour 0 on the highlight streaks in the locks; colour 2 on the jagged forehead panel.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Swing_03.differs: The forehead panel is jagged with raised points, and the locks sit higher on the head.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Crown_Eclipse_0.description: A spidery crown-like headpiece: a wide angular band across the forehead with a central spider-shaped ornament over the brow, curved claw-like spikes hanging down and rising at the temples, and a recessed panel between rims.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Crown_Eclipse_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band rims and central ornament; colour 1 on the recessed inner panels; colour 2 on the curved claws; colour 3 on the jewel in the centre ornament.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Dome_01.description: A rounded, translucent dome helmet that encloses the whole head like a fishbowl, with a smooth glassy shell and a slightly flared lower rim resting around the neck, leaving the face visible through it.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Dome_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome shell; the other colour slots are not clearly visible. The translucent material largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Flighthelmet_01.description: A wraparound flight helmet visor: a single curved, translucent shield covering the eyes and brow, with a notched cut-out over the nose and edges reaching back toward the temples. It sits on the face like sleek pilot goggles.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Flighthelmet_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor shield; the tinted, glossy surface shows little of the other colour slots.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Flighthelmet_02.description: A curved, translucent visor panel that wraps across the eyes and cheeks from temple to temple, with a straight top edge and a shallow angled lower edge. It suggests a flight helmet or sci-fi visor.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Flighthelmet_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole visor; the translucent glassy material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A small hexagonal metal tube fitted to the back of the head like a short socket or port, open at both ends with a notched, cut-away front edge. It looks like a mechanical head attachment.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tube; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Mask_Archer_01.description: A tight cloth lower-face mask covering the nose-bridge-down to the chin, with a separate upper edge panel and a thicker fabric neck piece that wraps around the throat. Ninja or archer-like, sleek and form-fitting.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Mask_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the neck wrap and side sections; colour 1 on the front chin panel; colour 2 on the upper nose-and-mouth panel.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Mask_Archer_01.differs: The male mask has a fuller, bulkier neck wrap that extends lower onto the throat.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Pompom_01.description: A small rounded pom-pom ball of crumpled, layered tufts that sits on top of the head like a topknot. It looks like fluffy fur or wadded cloth, with a playful, cute feel.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Pompom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole pom-pom; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_0.description: A pharaoh-style nemes headcloth: a soft cloth head covering with two broad lappets hanging down either side of the face, a striped, angular fold across the crown, and a thin tail trailing down the back.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_0.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main cloth of the lappets and crown; colour 0 on the front fold, inner lining and back tail; colour 2 on the striped panels and lappet hems; colour 3 on small accents at the edges.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Techcat_01.description: A pair of pointed cat-ear head pieces joined at the centre of the crown, with smooth angular outer shells and inner faces of ribbed, layered panels. Sits on top of the head in a tech-feline style.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Techcat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ear shells and rims; colour 1 on the lower inner panel of each ear; colour 3 on the ribbed stripes; colour 2 on the recessed gaps between the stripes.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Tiara_Warrior_0.description: A small flat five-pointed star ornament worn on the centre of the forehead, faceted like a pyramid with each point split into separate faceted panels. It sits flush against the skin like a tiara gem.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tight_Tiara_Warrior_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper-left facets of the star; colour 1 on the right facets; colour 2 on the lower-left facets; colour 3 on the back face of the star.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Tophat_Wizards_01.description: Two long, narrow cloth tails with ragged, pointed ends that hang straight down from the top of the head, one in front of the face and one behind. They read as loose hat streamers with a tattered, wizardly look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Tophat_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both tails; the back of the rear tail shows a slightly textured finish. Colours 0, 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Traveler_01.description: A single large curved feather mounted at the side of the head, its contrasting central quill sweeping up and back with layered, ragged barbs along both edges; a decorative, tribal-fantasy hair accessory.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather vanes; colour 2 on the central quill and shading at the base; faint colour 1 tint at the barb edges.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Umbrella_01.description: A novelty umbrella hat: a wide, shallow canopy of pointed fabric panels on thin ribs with small ball tips at the edges, floating above the head like a small parasol. Playful and comic in style.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Umbrella_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribs and ball tips; colours 1, 2 and 3 on the alternating canopy panels.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A pair of long, narrow cloth streamers hanging from either side of the head down past the chest, ending in jagged, pointed layered tips. Suggests a fantasy hennin veil with a flowing drape.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper lengths of the streamers; colour 1 on the lower tips and jagged ends, blending in a gradient.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_01.description: A small fur cap that sits on top of the head, with two tall pointed wolf ears and a shaggy, jagged-tufted fur fringe that hangs down the back of the head. A row of jagged tufts runs along the front brow edge.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ears, the back tufts and the outer fur; colour 1 on the top fur of the cap; colour 2 on the inner ear lining and the jagged front brow tufts.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_01.differs: The male cap adds a jagged fur edge along the front of the brow and sits further forward on the head.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_02.description: A row of six pointed conical fangs set side by side across the mouth area, with larger tusk-like fangs at each end, pointing downward like a snarling beast's teeth.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Wolf_Pelt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat tops of the fangs; the cone bodies take a shading from the default material.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Wooden_02.description: A pair of curved bull-style horns that sprout from the sides of the head, sweeping outward and up to sharp tips, with thin contrasting bands around each horn. Suggests a beastly or demonic look.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Wooden_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bases and shafts; colour 1 on the horn tips; colour 2 on the upper band; colour 3 on the lower band.

Male/M_Helmetextra_Wooden_03.description: A pair of dangling earrings: each has a small faceted stud at the ear, a long thin twisted cord with a small clasp, and a hoop ring hanging near the jaw and neck. Tribal, minimalist and partial.
Male/M_Helmetextra_Wooden_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the studs and hoop rings; colour 0 on the cords and clasps.

Male/M_Hipattach_L_Tight_Robot_Leg_Attat.description: A boxy angular armored thigh plate strapped to the outer left leg, with pointed upper corners, rows of recessed vent slots and thin seam lines, plus a small tapered pendant panel hanging from the front. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hipattach_L_Tight_Robot_Leg_Attat.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 3 on the vent recesses and seam lines; colour 1 on the hanging pendant panel; colour 2 on the small connector prongs.

Male/M_Hips_Animal_01.description: Form-fitting scaled leggings that reach the lower calf, fading out toward the ankle. A layered belly-scale panel runs down the front of the hips and crotch, and short rows of curved spikes run along the outer thighs.
Male/M_Hips_Animal_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the leggings and outer spikes; colour 0 on the front belly-scale panel; the lower legs fade to the bare skin tone.
Male/M_Hips_Animal_01.differs: The male version has smaller, tighter spikes on the outer thighs that stay closer to the leg.

Male/M_Hips_Animal_02.description: Fur-covered animal leg piece: close-fitting trousers with shaggy fur tufts along the outer thighs and a contrasting inner-thigh and groin panel, ending in ragged fur cuffs above smooth lower-leg sleeves.
Male/M_Hips_Animal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the thighs and hips; colour 1 on the front inner-thigh and groin panel; colour 2 on the fur tips at the cuffs; colour 3 on the lower-leg sleeves.

Male/M_Hips_Astronaut_01.description: Loose, full-length astronaut pants with a high padded waistband, harness-style straps crossing the hips, round hip connectors, contrasting thigh and shin panels, and contrasting bands strapped around the knees and calves; cuffs gather at the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pant legs and waistband; colour 1 on the thigh, knee and shin panels and the rear seat panel; colour 2 on the knee and calf bands and harness straps; colour 3 on the hip connectors and harness fittings.

Male/M_Hips_Astronaut_02.description: Full-length astronaut-style trousers with a high waist, contrasting front and rear leg panels, and contrasting straps with knee and shin bands. Round connector discs and a harness-like strap sit at the hips, and the cuffs are snug.
Male/M_Hips_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trousers and waist; colour 1 on the front thigh, shin and rear panels; colour 2 on the straps and leg bands; colour 3 on the round hip discs and harness accents.

Male/M_Hips_Beast_Mechanical_01.description: Robotic leg armour: a wide hip plate with layered thigh shells, exposed cabling and tubes along the legs, and bulky jointed mechanical knees with disc pivots leading to slim metallic shins.
Male/M_Hips_Beast_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hip plate, thigh shells and knee housings; colour 0 on the shin plates and lower thigh and rear panels; colour 2 on the thigh boxes and joints; colour 3 on the exposed cables.
Male/M_Hips_Beast_Mechanical_01.differs: The male version has bulkier, wider thigh shells with larger rear panels and a taller hip plate.

Male/M_Hips_Child_Moth_01.description: A pair of wide, curved wing-like panels flaring from the hips over the outer thighs to the knees, with a thin raised edge along the top and a pointed tip at the hip. Gives a moth-wing, monstrous look.
Male/M_Hips_Child_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper panels and the raised edge; colour 3 on the lower panels, blending down from colour 0; colours 1 and 2 are not visible.
Male/M_Hips_Child_Moth_01.differs: The male panels are broader and shorter, wrapping more around the side of the thigh with blunter lower edges.

Male/M_Hips_Child_Pants_Denim_01.description: Two small separate cloth patches on the thighs, one on the front of the right thigh above the knee and a smaller one on the outer left thigh, like torn or patched denim; the rest of the legs stay bare.
Male/M_Hips_Child_Pants_Denim_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on both thigh patches, the only parts of the piece that show.

Male/M_Hips_Child_Tight_None_01.description: A tiny flat oval patch sitting low across the front of the hips, like a small cap or waistband fragment. It is thin, plain and covers very little, with only a sliver showing at the back.
Male/M_Hips_Child_Tight_None_01.differs: The male version is a flatter oval at the front and shows only a thin sliver at the back, without the curved flap.

Male/M_Hips_Dinosuit_01.description: Baggy, loose-fitting pants with a banded elastic waist, a large quilted padded panel over the front of the hips and groin, and gathered cuffs at the ankles. Suggests a martial-arts or sporty superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pant legs and waistband; colour 1 on the quilted front panel; colour 2 on the ankle cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Dryad_01.description: A partial legs piece: a crumpled, ruffled short-like hip wrap over an exposed mechanical skeleton of legs, with slim rod-like struts, segmented cylinder columns and bulky knee rings. Organic-meets-robotic look.
Male/M_Hips_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the ruffled hip wrap; colour 0 on the struts, plates and knee rings; colour 1 on the cylinder columns; colour 3 on small bands and details on the columns.

Male/M_Hips_Dryad_02.description: Organic-mechanical leg piece: a wrapped twist of leafy, vine-like bands around the hips, with slender segmented leg frames of metal-like struts, knee guards and vertical tubes running down to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip swirls, leg struts and knee guards; colour 1 on the hip cloth panel and the tube inserts along the legs; colour 3 on small accents between the tubes.
Male/M_Hips_Dryad_02.differs: The male version has a larger, bolder contrasting-panel hip wrap with a distinct pointed front and back panel.

Male/M_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_01.description: Robotic leg piece: short, crumpled shorts of layered ribbed material at the hips, with exposed mechanical legs below made of slim armoured struts, cylindrical piston-like calves and bulky knee joints, ending above the feet.
Male/M_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shorts; colour 0 on the armoured struts, knee joints and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the cylindrical leg tubes; colour 3 on small bands within the tubes.

Male/M_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_02.description: Robotic exoskeleton leg frame: exposed mechanical limbs with segmented struts and ribbed inner cabling, jointed knee guards, and a swept, leaf-like hip mantle of curled plates with a separate inner panel at the waist.
Male/M_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip mantle plates, struts and knee guards; colour 1 on the inner hip panel and the leg cable sections; colour 3 on small accents between the leg segments; colour 2 on the joints.
Male/M_Hips_Dryad_Robotic_02.differs: The inner hip panel is a distinct angular, shield-like shape visible at front and back, and the hip mantle sits more open.

Male/M_Hips_Endo_01.description: A robotic exoskeleton-style leg frame: layered curved armor plates around the hips, then slender segmented legs of exposed mechanical struts, cylindrical actuators and rounded knee joints, ending in ankle cuffs above the boots.
Male/M_Hips_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plates, outer struts and knee and ankle joints; colour 1 on the actuator cylinders and front hip panel; colour 3 on the small connector accents; colour 2 on the inner hip lining and joint gaps.

Male/M_Hips_Endo_02.description: A robotic exoskeleton leg frame: layered curved plates wrap the hips, with slim mechanical struts down each leg, bulky knee joints and cylindrical piston segments along the thighs and shins. Skeletal, open construction.
Male/M_Hips_Endo_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plates, struts and knee joints; colour 1 on the piston cylinders and front crotch panel; colour 3 on the small accents between the pistons; colour 2 on the inner hip and joint recesses.

Male/M_Hips_Holohexarmor_01.description: Form-fitting sci-fi leggings with a ribbed segmented underlayer and raised hex-style armor plates over the hips, thighs, knees and shins, a central front stripe, and contrasting vent recesses. Runs from waist to ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Holohexarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed leggings underlayer and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the raised armor plates and front stripe; colour 2 on the recessed vents and gaps in the plates; colour 3 not visible.
Male/M_Hips_Holohexarmor_01.differs: The male version has larger thigh plates and a vertical stripe panel down the front of the waist, with more ribbing showing on the thighs.

Male/M_Hips_Holohexarmor_01_Tallboot.description: A tall sci-fi armored boot with a segmented shin guard that flares into pointed fins at the top, small round sensor lights, a banded ankle section and a chunky toe cap; it covers the foot and lower leg.
Male/M_Hips_Holohexarmor_01_Tallboot.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shin plates, toe and sole trim; colour 0 on the banded ankle section; colour 2 on the horn tips, toe cap and back panel; colour 3 on the small round lights.

Male/M_Hips_Moth_01.description: Form-fitting insect-inspired leg piece with a jagged-edged hip panel, rounded rear, layered plates down the thighs and shins, and tall wing-like fins flaring off the outer hips. Reaches the ankles with segmented boot-like cuffs.
Male/M_Hips_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hip panel, rear and ankle cuffs; colour 0 on the thigh and shin plates and the outer fins; colour 1 on the lower-leg guards; colour 2 on the small inner gap accents.

Male/M_Hips_Pants4medskirt_01.description: Plain full-length trousers with a low waistband, a straight fit through the thigh and a slight flare at the hem. Soft creases gather at the knees and above the ankles. They are meant to be worn under skirts.
Male/M_Hips_Pants4medskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole garment; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Basic_01_Pants_1.description: Plain full-length trousers sitting at the natural waist, with a fitted hip and thigh and a slight flare at the ankle. Soft wrinkles gather at the knees and hems, giving a casual everyday look.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Basic_01_Pants_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole pair of trousers; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Basic_01_Pants_1_Glitt.description: Loose, straight-leg casual pants with a plain waistband, slightly cuffed hems and a thin contrasting stripe down each outer leg; the mottled, worn-looking fabric falls to the ankles from the waist.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Basic_01_Pants_1_Glitt.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fabric of the pants; colour 1 on the thin side stripes down each outer leg.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_01.description: Fitted bell-bottom trousers that sit at the waist and follow the leg down to the knee, then flare into moderate cuffs with bunched creases above the ankle. Plain cloth with a retro casual feel.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole trouser surface; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_01.differs: The male pair sits higher at the waist and has a milder flare, with bunched creases just above the cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_Glitter.description: Low-rise bell-bottom pants that fit closely through the hips and thighs and flare widely from the knee to the ankle. A thin contrasting stripe runs down each outer seam, and the fabric has a speckled, glittery texture.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Bell_Bottoms_Glitter.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pants fabric with speckled texture; colour 1 on the thin side-seam stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Bounty_01.description: Low-rise pants with a glossy leather look: a contrasting front panel down each leg, a separate back and outer-side panel, a thin waistband, and slouchy wrinkles gathering at the ankles. A casual western-flavoured style.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front leg panels; colour 0 on the back and outer-side panels; colour 2 on the waistband.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Bounty_01.differs: The male version is looser and baggier, with wider contrasting side stripes and bunched cuffs above the boots.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_01.description: Pair of leg accessories made of rows of short, flat metal bands stacked down the outer sides of each thigh and calf, with small tabs and rivets. Worn over bare tights, giving a sci-fi renegade look.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bands; colour 1 on the small side tabs and fasteners; metallic material mostly ignores the other slots.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_02.description: Two columns of short curved metal slats stacked down the outer thighs like exposed ribs, each slat with a small rivet. They float off the leg without covering it, giving a sci-fi mechanical look.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the slat surfaces; colour 1 on the inner edges of the slats; colour 2 on the rivets.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_03.description: Two columns of small separate straps wrapped around the outer sides of each lower leg, stacked closely from knee to ankle with small fasteners; they are decorative bands over the bare legs, not full pants.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the fastener tabs and strap edges.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Child_Renegade_03.differs: The male straps are more numerous, evenly sized and tightly stacked, forming a denser row down each lower leg.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Cowboychaps_01.description: Western-style leather chaps: open-backed leg coverings with flared, boot-cut lower legs, fringe down the outer seams, and a belted waistband with a small buckle. Worn over a separate pair of trousers that show at the seat and back of the legs.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Cowboychaps_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer leg panels; colour 0 on the underlying trousers showing at the front, seat and inner back of the legs; colour 2 on the waistband and back hip panels; colour 3 on the small buckle detail.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Denim_01.description: Loose-fitting casual jeans with a gradient fade toward the hems, ripped and frayed tears across both knees and thighs, back pockets, a belt-line waistband and cuffed ankles; sits at the waist and reaches the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Denim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper legs and pocket area; colour 1 on the faded lower legs and cuffs; colour 3 on the torn, frayed patches at the knees and thighs; colour 2 on the waistband.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Ghosthunter_01.description: Fitted casual-tactical pants with slim legs that gather into cuffs above the ankles, large contrasting panels on the outer thighs, rounded knee pads, and a lower leg section in a separate colour. Sits at the hips.
