Male/M_Hips_Pants_Ghosthunter_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pants and waistband; colour 3 on the thigh panels; colour 2 on the knee pads; colour 1 on the lower legs, fading up from the cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Gi_01.description: Loose martial-arts gi pants with a low waistband, soft wrinkled cloth through the hips and legs, a faint seam down each outer leg, and gathered cuffs at the ankles. Suits martial-arts or casual looks.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Gi_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole pants; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Goth_01.description: Loose-fitting cargo-style trousers with a contrasting waistband, a side thigh pocket with a small stud, and gathered cuffs at the ankles finished with narrow trim bands; sits at the hips and reaches the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Goth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser fabric; colour 2 on the waistband and ankle cuff bands; colour 3 on the small stud on the thigh pocket.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Goth_02.description: Close-fitting gothic pants from waist to ankle, with quilted thigh panels, a separate panel over each shin, and criss-cross lacing at the thighs and lower legs. They end at the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Goth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pants and thigh panels; colour 1 on the panel behind the lacing at each shin; colour 2 on the lacing cords.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Inmate_01.description: Loose, ankle-length prison-style trousers with a grid of crossing bands down each leg, a buckled strap around each upper thigh, a vertical tab at the fly, and ragged, torn hems at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser fabric; colour 1 on the grid bands and thigh straps; colour 3 on the fly tab; colour 2 on the strap buckles.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Lockbox_65_01.description: Flared kung fu pants sitting at the waist with a contrasting waistband, vertical stripes down each leg, swirling flame-like patterns on the thighs and shins, and tattered, ragged bell-bottom hems reaching the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main pants; colour 0 on the waistband, vertical stripes and flame-like swirl patterns.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Madjester_01.description: Harlequin pants with an all-over diamond check pattern and a wide, thick contrasting waistband at the hips. The legs are fitted and end in gathered ankle cuffs, giving a theatrical jester look.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light diamonds; colour 1 on the mid diamonds; colour 2 on the outlines between the diamonds; colour 3 on the waistband.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Madjester_01.differs: The male version has a wide, thick contrasting waistband, where the female version has only a thin contrasting edge at the waist.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Martial_Power_01.description: Baggy martial-arts style knee-length pants with a high waist, full billowing legs gathered into cuffs just below the knee, and broad vertical stripes running down the front and back.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the pants; colour 0 on the vertical stripes down each leg. The lower legs below the cuffs are the mannequin's tights, not part of the piece.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Martial_Power_02.description: Knee-length martial-arts pants with a fitted waistband, baggy legs that puff out above gathered cuffs at the knee, and curling swirl motifs on the lower legs. Suggests an East Asian fighter look.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waistband and upper hips, fading into colour 0 on the main legs; colour 2 on the swirl motifs and knee cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Persian_01.description: Loose, baggy harem-style trousers gathered into puffy cuffs at the ankles, with a thin waistband and a patterned stripe running down each outer side. Sits at the waist with full leg coverage.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Persian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser fabric; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 3 and colour 2 on the patterned side stripes.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Persian_01.differs: The male version has closed sides with a narrow patterned stripe and a visible waistband, without the open hip cut-outs of the female version.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Pulp_Aviator_01.description: Pulp aviator riding breeches: full, baggy thighs that taper and gather at the knee, a slim waistband with a small button, curved piping on the front pockets, and short fitted boot cuffs below.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Pulp_Aviator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the breeches; colour 1 on the curved pocket piping; colour 2 on the lower boot cuffs; colour 3 on the waistband button and cuff buttons.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Rave_01.description: Low-rise, wide-leg flared pants with a contrasting waistband, a fly seam, and a strap with a stud around each shin above a zipper that runs down the front of the lower leg. Casual street rave style.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper legs and hips, fading toward colour 0 on the lower legs and flared hems; colour 3 on the waistband; colour 2 on the zippers and pull tabs.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Rave_02.description: Low-rise wide-leg rave pants with a contrasting waistband, studded patch pockets on the front and back hips, a strap around each knee and a zipper line down the lower leg, ending in a flared hem.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper legs and body of the pants; colour 0 on the lower legs and knee straps; colour 3 on the waistband and pocket patches; colour 2 on the zippers and studs.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Renegade_01.description: Full-length, close-fitting pants with a gradient from hip to ankle. Each outer leg has a cut-out slit laced with short crossing straps that stick out sideways, giving a sci-fi renegade look. Sits at the hips.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper pants and the side straps; colour 1 on the lower legs, where the colour blends in; colour 2 on the gaps inside the side slits; colour 3 on the thin stitched edging along the slits.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Renegade_02.description: Form-fitting sci-fi pants with a low-rise waistband and a separate centre panel over the hips and crotch. Each outer thigh has a column of contrasting slots joined by thin cords, and the legs taper to the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Renegade_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and centre hip panel; colour 1 on the legs; colour 2 on the slot inserts down the outer thighs; colour 3 on the thin cords linking the slots.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Santa_01.description: Full-length pants with a wide waistband, colour-blocked panels over the thighs and shins, and baggy gathered cuffs at the ankles. Loose through the lower leg, with a small round patch on the seat.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, seat, back of the legs and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the upper thighs and lower legs; colour 2 on the mid-thigh panels; colour 3 on the shin panels.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Santa_01.differs: The male pants are looser and baggier, with puffy cuffs that bunch over the boots.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Secret_01.description: Baggy casual sweatpants with an elastic waistband, loose billowing legs gathered into snug cuffs at the ankles, and twin stripes running down each outer side. Sits at the hips and reaches the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Secret_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pant legs; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 3 on the side stripes; colour 2 on the ankle cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Secret_02.description: Loose, straight-cut casual slacks with a plain waistband, relaxed full-length legs that bunch at the ankles into narrow cuffs, and two patch pockets on the back. Sits at the hips, with an everyday street feel.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Secret_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the trousers; colour 2 on the ankle cuffs; colour 3 on the back patch pockets.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Secret_03.description: Casual fitted trousers with a snug hip and thigh and a gentle straight leg that reaches the ankle. A contrasting waistband sits low on the hips, and the hems have a thin contrasting edge.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the legs; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 2 on the thin hem edging.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Secret_04.description: Loose casual cargo pants with a contrasting elastic waistband, large flapped cargo pockets on the outer thighs, two square back pockets, and gathered, cuffed hems that bunch above the ankles. Sits at the hips.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Secret_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser legs, with a gradient toward colour 3 at the lower legs and cuffs; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 2 on the cargo and back pockets.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Secret_04.differs: The male version shades the lower legs and cuffs with a colour 3 gradient and has plain back pockets without the small button details.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Ski_01.description: Close-fitting ski pants that run from the waist to the ankles, with a gradient that fades toward the lower legs, a contrasting stripe down each outer leg, and angled zip pockets at the hips and back waist.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Ski_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper pants; colour 1 in the gradient on the lower legs; colour 2 on the side stripes; colour 3 on the zip pocket tabs at the front and back waist.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Spy_01.description: Loose, straight-cut full-length trousers with a grid of bold lines forming a large check pattern over the whole leg. They have a plain waistband with a small front fastener and a soft fade toward the hems.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fabric of the trousers; colour 1 on the waistband lining and the lower legs; colour 2 on the grid lines; colour 3 on the small front fastener.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Spy_01.differs: The male version is loose plaid trousers with a grid pattern, while the female version is sleek fitted pants with colour-blocked panels, knee patches and shin stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Spy_02.description: Slim, casual jeans-style trousers sitting low on the hips, with a small button at the waistband, front pockets and two patch pockets on the back. They taper to the ankle and fade to a different shade toward the hem.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trousers and waistband, fading into colour 1 on the lower legs; colour 2 on the back pockets; colour 3 on the waist button.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Tight_01.description: Plain casual pants that fit closely through the hips and thighs, with a low waistband and a slight flare at the ankle hem. Bunched cloth creases gather at the knees and above the hem, and the legs reach to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Tight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole pants; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Tight_01.differs: The male pants have more pronounced wrinkles and bunching at the knees and lower legs, and a slightly higher waist.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Torn_01.description: Casual jeans-style pants with a fly, front and back pockets and a small button at the waist. The legs stop at mid-calf with ragged, torn hems, giving a worn, scavenged street look.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Torn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pant legs and pockets; colour 1 on the waist button and small rivets; edging along the torn hems comes from colour 2.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Urban_Baggy_01.description: Low-slung baggy urban cargo pants with loose, bunched fabric that pools at the ankles, a visible waistband band, a webbing belt with a hanging tail and buckle, cargo pocket on the thigh, and a draped chain at the hip.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Urban_Baggy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pant legs and pockets; colour 3 on the waistband/underwear band at the top; colour 1 on the belt and its hanging strap; colour 2 on the buckle and chain.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Urban_Rolled_01.description: Baggy urban cargo pants with a wide waistband, a thin belt with a square buckle and a dangling strap, a side cargo pocket, a hanging chain, and loose bunched legs rolled up below the knee.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Urban_Rolled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pant legs and belt trim; colour 1 on the waistband and the dangling belt strap; colour 2 on the buckle and chain.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Urban_Torn_01.description: Knee-length urban cargo shorts with a wide folded waistband, drawstring tabs, a contrasting upper panel and bulky side cargo pockets on the lower legs; torn, ragged hems give a worn street look.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Urban_Torn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, drawstring tabs and the back and inner panels; colour 1 on the upper hip and thigh panels; colour 2 on the lower shorts and cargo pockets.

Male/M_Hips_Pants_Urban_Torn_02.description: Torn, knee-length urban cargo shorts with a broad waistband panel, small tabs at the hips, side cargo pockets and ragged uneven hems; loose, worn street styling sitting at the hips.
Male/M_Hips_Pants_Urban_Torn_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waistband and upper hip panels; colour 2 on the shorts legs and cargo pockets; colour 0 on the back yoke panel and small waist tabs.

Male/M_Hips_Patriot_01.description: Full-length superhero pants with a fitted hip and thigh, large contrasting inner-thigh panels, loose gathered shin sections, and a contrasting ankle band. contrasting outlines edge the panels and a short seam runs down the front of the waist.
Male/M_Hips_Patriot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hips, outer thighs and ankle bands; colour 3 on the inner-thigh panels; colour 1 on the gathered lower legs; colour 2 on the seam outlines.

Male/M_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_02.description: A robotic exoskeleton for the legs: exposed mechanical struts run down each leg with bundled actuator tubes, round knee joints and ankle cuffs, and a cage of curved plates framing the hips and pelvis.
Male/M_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the struts, hip plates and joint casings; colour 1 on the actuator tubes along the legs; colour 3 on small accents on the actuators; colour 2 on the waist band.
Male/M_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_02.differs: The male version has an open cage of curved struts around the pelvis, showing the inner mechanism, instead of stacked hip plates.

Male/M_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_03.description: A robotic exoskeleton leg frame: a slim hip cage with angular plates and a waist band, and thin mechanical legs with exposed muscle-like cylinders, ringed knee and ankle joints, and segmented struts, leaving the body between them visible.
Male/M_Hips_Pelvis_Skeleton_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plates, struts and joint casings; colour 1 on the cylindrical actuator columns along the legs; colour 3 on small accents in the hips and actuators; colour 2 on the waist band.

Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_01.description: Robotic exoskeleton legs: a smooth brief-like hip section with skeletal mechanical legs below, made of slim metal struts, ringed knee joints and exposed piston-like cylinders down the thighs and shins, ending above the boots.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip section, struts and knee joints; colour 1 on the cylinder casings; colour 3 on the accents between the cylinders; colour 2 on the inner joint gaps.

Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_Jum.description: Robotic exoskeleton legs beneath a short loose cloth shorts-style hip piece with a bold centre seam. Segmented mechanical thighs and shins hold cylindrical piston-like tubes, with rounded knee joints, extra side struts and armoured ankle cuffs.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_Jum.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts and the armoured leg plates and knee joints; colour 1 on the cylindrical tubes along the legs; colour 3 on the centre seam and small accents in the tubes; colour 2 on inner joint gaps.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_Jum.differs: The male shorts sit longer with a bolder contrasting centre stripe, and the legs show extra diagonal side struts.

Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_Jum.description: A retro sci-fi exoskeleton leg piece: short loose cloth shorts with a bold front seam, over exposed robotic legs made of jointed metal plates, bulky knee and ankle cuffs and banded cylinder segments.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_Jum.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts, plating and knee and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the cylinder segments along the legs; colour 3 on the front seam and small accents; colour 2 on the inner joints.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_Both_Retroscifi_Jum.differs: The male shorts hang longer and looser with a prominent contrasting-accent seam down the front.

Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_None_01.description: Robotic exoskeleton leg set: slim mechanical legs with exposed inner tubing and joints, armored plates at the hips, thighs, knees and shins, and ring-like joint collars. It hangs from the hips down to the ankles, leaving the feet bare.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexo_None_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plates, joint rings and hip plates; colour 1 on the inner tubing and segments between the plates; colour 3 on small accents at the hips; colour 2 on the deep gaps and joints.

Male/M_Hips_Robotexol_01.description: Asymmetric full-length tights: one plain, smooth, form-fitting leg with a hip-high waist, while the other leg is replaced by an exposed robotic prosthetic with jointed metal segments, cable-like tubes, and a ringed knee and ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexol_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth tight leg, the hip cuff and the metal joint casings; colour 1 on the mechanical leg's inner tube sections; colour 3 on small accents between the tubes; colour 2 on the inner mechanism.

Male/M_Hips_Robotexol_Retroscifi_Jumpsui.description: Asymmetric retro sci-fi jumpsuit legs: one full trouser leg with a diagonal stripe, a band at the knee and a trim at the ankle, while the other leg is an exposed mechanical prosthetic with tubes and joints.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexol_Retroscifi_Jumpsui.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trouser fabric and mechanical casings; colour 1 on the knee band and the cylinders in the robotic leg; colour 3 on the diagonal stripe, ankle trim and waist seam.

Male/M_Hips_Robotexor_01.description: Asymmetric legwear: a smooth form-fitting tight covers the left leg and hip, while the right leg is an exposed robotic limb of segmented metal plates, cabling and glowing tubes, with a rigid hip cuff and jointed knee and ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tight leg and the hip cuff and armour plates of the mechanical leg; colour 1 on the tubes and cable sections; colour 3 on the small bands and accents within the tubes; colour 2 on the inner joints.

Male/M_Hips_Robotexor_Retroscifi_Jumpsui.description: A retro sci-fi jumpsuit bottom with loose cloth trousers on one leg and an exposed mechanical robotic leg on the other, with piston-like tubes, a jointed knee and ankle, and a diagonal stripe with banded cuffs on the cloth leg.
Male/M_Hips_Robotexor_Retroscifi_Jumpsui.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth trousers and metal leg casing; colour 1 on the cloth leg's calf bands and the robotic leg's tube segments; colour 3 on the diagonal stripe, the centre seam and the ankle band; colour 2 on the joints and inner mechanics.

Male/M_Hips_Rocker_01.description: Full-length wrestler-style pants with a fitted hip and thigh, wide bands with thin contrasting stripes around each thigh, and flared bell-bottom hems with tribal flame-like tendril patterns and a slit at the front.
Male/M_Hips_Rocker_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pants and flared lower legs; colour 1 on the wide thigh bands; colour 2 on the thin stripes between the bands, the hem edging and the tendril patterns.

Male/M_Hips_Skin_Furlong_01.description: Werewolf leg covering with a fur-textured surface from the hips to the ankles, with ragged shaggy tufts sticking out along the outer thighs and calves, and a skin-toned waistband and inner thigh patches. Sits close to the leg.
Male/M_Hips_Skin_Furlong_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur texture of the legs; colour 1 on the shadowed fur tufts; colour 2 on the streaks at the crotch and calves; the skin-toned waistband and inner thigh patches ignore the colour scheme.
Male/M_Hips_Skin_Furlong_01.differs: The male legs have ragged fur tufts that stick out at the outer thighs and calves, giving a shaggier outline than the smooth female version.

Male/M_Hips_Skirt_Wizards_01.description: A short cloth hip skirt with a gathered elastic waistband, a curved front hem and a split at the back that forms two short legs. A band of geometric key-pattern trim runs along the hem. It sits at the hips and ends at the upper thigh.
Male/M_Hips_Skirt_Wizards_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the skirt; colour 2 on the patterned hem band.

Male/M_Hips_Swing_01.description: Straight-leg pinstriped trousers with a slim waistband, a contrasting fly panel at the front, and turned-up cuffs at the ankles. They sit at the hips and have a relaxed vintage swing-era look.
Male/M_Hips_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vertical pinstripes and waistband; colour 1 on the stripes and the front fly panel; colour 2 on the ankle cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Teddy_01.description: Shaggy fur trousers with a loose, baggy cut, layered tufted fur covering the legs from waist to ankle, with a darker fade at the waist and ragged fringed hems at the cuffs.
Male/M_Hips_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur of the legs; colour 2 on the darkened fur around the waist; colour 3 on the fringed fur at the cuffs; colour 1 on the thin waist edge.
Male/M_Hips_Teddy_01.differs: The male version has a closer, more conventional trouser crotch without the open front gap, and hangs straighter down the legs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Hipstight.description: Plain skin-tight leggings that follow the leg muscles from the waist down to the ankles, with a smooth seamless surface and no added trim. A simple base layer that suits any superhero look.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Hipstight_1.description: Bare skin legs with a brief, smooth brief-style hip covering; the muscular legs run down to the ankles with no seams or added details, giving a plain base layer under other costume pieces.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Hipstight_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brief-style hip covering; the bare skin legs use the skin tone and ignore the colour scheme.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Hipstight_2.description: Tight, form-fitting leggings with a high waistband, panelled thighs and calves, and cut-out openings at the knees that expose skin. Colour-blocked swooping panels run down the legs to the ankles, giving a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Hipstight_2.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, the back of the hips and the lower calves; colour 1 on the front hip and swooping calf panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; skin shows through the knee cut-outs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Hipstight_3.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, banded with closely spaced horizontal segment lines that give a ribbed, jointed robotic look. Plain waistband, no pockets or fastenings visible.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Hipstight_3.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main legging surface; colour 2 on the thin horizontal grooves between the bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Hipstight_Ravenswoo.description: Form-fitting superhero tights from waist to ankle, bunched slightly at the knees, with thin angular piping lines running down the thighs and hips and separate close-fitting boot-like lower legs with a thin vertical seam.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Hipstight_Ravenswoo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs and hips; colour 3 on the thin angular piping lines and the calf seam accents; colour 2 on the lower-leg sections.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryb.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a high-cut brief, contrasting panels down the outer thighs and knees, small marks on the front thighs, and contrasting straps with bands around the shins and ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner thighs, lower legs and centre of the hips; colour 1 on the brief edge and the outer thigh and knee panels; colour 3 on the small thigh marks; colour 2 on the shin straps and ankle bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryp.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with a slim contrasting waistband, chevron-shaped panels on the thighs and knees, and diamond-shaped panels over the calves with contrasting cuffs at the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryp.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hips, upper legs and calf backgrounds; colour 2 on the waistband, outer thigh chevrons and ankle cuffs; colour 0 on the knee and lower thigh panels; colour 3 on the calf diamonds.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryr.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a high-cut hip and a thin waistband trim. Swooping curved side panels run down the thighs, a central panel covers the crotch and seat, and shaped panels wrap the calves.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh and leg fabric; colour 2 on the swooping side panels along the hips and thighs; colour 3 on the centre crotch and seat panel and the calf inserts; colour 1 on the waistband trim and lower calves.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryy.description: Form-fitting superhero tights with a low-rise waistband, chevron-shaped contrasting panels over the hips and thighs, and separate calf-length lower legs with trimmed tops and small diamond emblems at the knees.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_01_Legendaryy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs and upper legs; colour 1 on the waistband, hip chevron panels and the trim bands below the knees; colour 2 on the lower leg sections; colour 3 on the knee emblems.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_4longskirt_01.description: A bare skin-layer base for long skirts: briefs at the hips with sculpted bare legs down to the ankles, meant to sit under a separate long skirt or robe piece. It has no added garment detail of its own.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_4longskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brief-shaped hip section; the legs show a skin tone that does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_4longskirt_02.description: Plain skin-tight leggings that hug the hips and legs from the waist down to the ankles, with no seams or trim. They serve as an underlayer beneath long skirts or robes.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_4longskirt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole legging; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_4medskirt_01.description: A bare-skin leg base for use under medium skirts and shorts: bare legs down to the ankles with a plain brief-style hip band at the top. Smooth and unadorned, it shows no texture or details.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_4medskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brief-style hip band; the bare legs show skin and do not take a colour slot.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_4medskirt_02.description: Plain skin-tight leggings running from the waist to the ankles, hugging the hips and legs with no seams or trim; a base layer designed to sit under medium skirts or shorts.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_4medskirt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole leggings; no other colour slots visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_4medskirt_Ascendant_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights running from the waist to the ankles, with large contrasting panels down the outer thighs, a small panel at the groin, and shin-guard style panels around the calves, all edged with thin piping.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_4medskirt_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the outer thigh panels and the lower calf bands; colour 1 on the upper calf panels and groin panel; colour 3 on the piping trim.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_4medskirt_Ascendant_02.description: Form-fitting superhero tights covering the hips and legs to the ankles, with a high-cut brief front outlined by a thin edge line, padded thigh panels, inset knee guards, and separate shin sections with contrasting piping.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_4medskirt_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tights fabric; colour 1 on the thigh panels and lower shin sections; colour 2 on the inset knee panels and the brief front trim; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_90s_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from the waist to the ankles, with quilted padded panels down the outer thighs and over the shins and knees, ribbed side panels, and a separate waistband panel with small emblem marks at the hip.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_90s_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main leggings and ribbed side panels; colour 0 on the quilted thigh and shin panels; colour 2 on the waistband panel; colour 3 on the hip emblem marks and thin seam piping.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Alien_01.description: Skin-tight, glossy leggings running from the low waist to the ankles, with layered panels down the thighs, rounded kneecap patches, and a segmented, chevron-shaped waistband with contrasting trim. Sleek, alien-flavoured superhero styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main leg fabric; colour 3 on the thigh side panels, knee patches and waistband chevrons; colour 2 on the inner thigh panels, lower calf panels and waistband centre; colour 0 on the top waistband edge.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Alien_Hybrid.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with segmented colour-blocked panels: a hip band, thick thigh sections, curved calf panels with narrow inset strips, and a swooping shape across the buttocks. They end at the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Alien_Hybrid.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, rear and lower legs; colour 1 on the upper hip and calf panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow inset strips at the knees and calves.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings covered in a fish-scale mesh pattern, with slim swooping accent stripes down each front thigh and contrasting fin-like flares at the lower shins. Ends at the ankles; an aquatic superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the scale pattern of the leggings; colour 3 on the swooping thigh stripes; colour 2 on the flares at the lower shins.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a fish-scale mesh panel down the front and inner legs, edged by jagged zigzag borders, and smooth panels over the hips, back and outer legs. Sits at the hips and runs to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the smooth outer and rear panels; colour 0 and colour 1 on the scale-patterned front panel; colour 2 on the jagged edge outlines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Archer_01.description: Tight, form-fitting pants made of separate panels: a hip band, front thighs, a contrasting mid-thigh band, a knee section with a raised side strip, and swooping curved seams down the back of the legs. Ends at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Archer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, rear seat and lower calves; colour 1 on the upper thigh and shin panels; colour 2 on the mid-thigh bands; colour 3 on the raised knee strips.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings that run from the hips to the ankles, with large contrasting panels on the outer thighs, a small V-shaped panel at the front of the hips, and banded calf guards, all outlined in thin piping.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the outer thigh panels and lower calf bands; colour 1 on the upper calf panels and the hip V; colour 3 on the piping and outlines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with large padded oval panels on the outer thighs and back of the thighs, fitted calf sleeves, a V-shaped front waist inset and thin piping outlines.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the thigh panel borders and calf sleeves; colour 2 on the thigh panel centres and the front waist inset; colour 3 on the thin piping lines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: Close-fitting bird-person leggings with fine feathery texture on the thighs, a separate smooth brief-like panel at the hips, ragged feathery fringes at the calves, and banded wraps on the lower legs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hip panel; colour 1 on the leggings and feathery cuffs; colour 3 on the banded lower-leg wraps.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The male version adds a separate smooth brief-like hip panel and has finer feather texture on the thighs instead of large scale-like feathers.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Child_Partial_01.description: A minimal partial leg piece: two small faceted panels with thin rimmed edges resting on the upper thighs at the hip line, plus thin rings at each ankle. Most of the leg stays uncovered.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Child_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and ankle bands; colour 2 on the faceted thigh panels.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Chimera_01.description: Tight, full-length furry leggings covered in layered shaggy tufts from hips to ankles, with ragged fur fringes at the calves and a separate banded cuff around one ankle. A beastly, monstrous look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur across both legs; colour 3 on the ankle cuff band on one leg.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Chimera_02.description: Tight, full-length monster leggings covered in layered, shaggy fur tufts with jagged pointed strands, shaggier around the knees and ankles. They sit from the hips to just above the feet, giving a feral beast look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur across the whole piece; the lower ankle tufts show slightly different fur tones, but no other slots are clearly visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Chimera_03.description: Tight, full-length shaggy fur trousers covered in layered tufted strands from hips to ankles, with ragged fur fringes at the shins and separate smooth cuffs around the ankles. A beastly, monstrous look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Chimera_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur of the legs; colour 3 on the ankle cuffs. Colours 1 and 2 are not visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.description: Skin-tight full-length tights that sit at the hips. The upper legs are one solid panel, and the lower legs are a contrasting panel with swirling tribal flame-like scrollwork climbing the shins and calves.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the thighs and upper legs; colour 0 on the lower-leg panel; colour 1 on the tribal scrollwork; colour 2 on the small curled marks near the ankles.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, with smooth stretchy thighs and streaky, brush-stroke panels flaring up the calves in a jagged edge. Suggests a sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main leggings; colour 0 and colour 2 on the streaky calf panels; colour 1 on small accents at the lower calves.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from waist to ankle. The upper legs are one smooth panel with jagged, flame-like edges at mid-shin, and the lower legs have a separate panel with branching web-like vein patterns.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper thigh panel; colour 0 on the lower leg panel; colour 2 on the branching webbing pattern on the shins and calves.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the hips to the ankles, with a plain waistband, a central crotch and rear panel, and thin angular circuit-like lines down each leg. Triple bands wrap each thigh. Suits a sleek superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Classic_Tights_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings and waistband; colour 2 on the linework stripes; colour 1 on the triple thigh bands; colour 3 on the central front and rear panel.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Clockwork_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a high hip band and colour-blocked panels: a swooping front hip panel, separate thigh panels, calf inserts and lower shins. Sleek, sporty superhero styling with a small round patch on the rear.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Clockwork_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, rear patch, seat and lower shins; colour 1 on the hip and calf panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the calf inserts.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Color_Patch_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from waist to ankle, built from swooping colour-blocked panels that cut diagonally across the thighs, knees and calves. Smooth, glossy, athletic superhero styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Color_Patch_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hip and thigh panels; colour 0 on the lower-leg and inner-thigh panels; colour 3 on the waist-side, knee and calf accent patches; colour 2 on the hip-top and ankle patches.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a triple band of contrasting stripes above each knee and another triple band at each ankle. Smooth, plain, athletic look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Color_Stripe_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 3 on the upper stripe of each band; colour 2 on the middle stripe; colour 1 on the lower stripe.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Corrupted_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-cut brief-style hip section: a contrasting front gusset panel, a separate waistband strip, and side and rear panels that sweep around the hips. They end at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the legs; colour 1 on the front gusset and rear centre panel; colour 2 on the waistband strip; colour 3 on the rear side panels.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cosmic_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a low-slung hip band, diagonal strap lines across the hips, and multi-panelled legs: thigh blocks, knee-to-calf swooping panels with a narrow accent stripe, and short lower cuffs above the feet.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, seat, straps and lower shin panels; colour 1 on the front hips and the calf and back-leg panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow calf accent stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from hip to ankle with a glossy contrasting crotch and hip panel, contoured concentric-line patterns over the front thighs, and swirling contour lines down the outer legs and calves. A sleek cosmic superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy highlights of the hip and seat panels; colour 1 on the outer leg and calf swirl lines; colour 3 on the concentric front thigh patterns; colour 2 on the central hip panel and inner legs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_02.description: Fitted leggings with raised, layered armour-like plates over the outer thighs, knees and shins, a segmented hip yoke and a contrasting inner leg panel, ending in flared ankle cuffs. A sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised thigh and shin plates and hip yoke; colour 1 on the inner leg and hip panels; colour 2 on the plate edging and trim; colour 3 on the ankle cuffs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cosmos_02.differs: The male version adds raised armour plates over the thighs, knees and shins and contrasting-slot ankle cuffs, instead of smooth colour-blocked tights.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cryo_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from a low-slung brief-style waistband to the ankles, with long contrasting side panels down the outer legs outlined in contrasting piping, small knee patches and a separate brief-like panel at the hips and seat.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legs and inner thighs; colour 1 on the long outer leg panels; colour 2 on the piping, waistband edge and knee patches; colour 3 on the hip and seat brief panel.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cut_01.description: A pair of short, plain tubular cuffs that wrap the lower shins just above the boots, with slightly angled top edges. They read as minimal leg bands or the visible remnants of pant legs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both shin bands; no other colours visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: Tight, ankle-length trousers with a loose upper hip section and fitted lower legs. Swooping contrasting panels wrap the knees and shins, and two flat patch pockets sit on the back. A western-meets-street look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip and upper thigh panels; colour 3 on the lower leg and knee panels; colour 2 on the back pockets.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cybergrid_01.description: Tight full-length sci-fi leggings built from distinct armour-like panels: a padded hip and seat section, large rounded thigh and knee plates, and shin guards with contrasting trim, running from waist to ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cybergrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh and knee panels; colour 1 on the shin guards and inset thigh plates; colour 2 on the seat, lower calf and inner panels; colour 3 on the hip and knee accent details.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cybergrid_01.differs: The male version has bolder, more clearly separated armour plates on the thighs and shins and a distinct padded seat panel at the back.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: Asymmetric form-fitting cyberpunk leggings: one leg is a plain mesh-textured tight, the other is covered in segmented armored panels with ribbed knee and shin guards. Sits from the hips to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh-textured leg and the waistband; colour 1 on the armored leg panels, knee and shin plates and the front hip panel; colour 2 on the joint inserts and seam lines; colour 3 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The male version has a raised armored front hip panel with a small pouch-like plate, while the female version has a plain mesh hip.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.description: Cyberpunk leg armor over tights: both legs are covered in segmented plates with raised thigh panels, knee guards and shin cuffs, with a paneled brief-style waistband at the hips.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and brief panels; colour 1 on the leg armor plates and knee guards; colour 2 on the joint gaps and inset panels; colour 3 on the thin trim lines.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_02.differs: The male version has armored plates on both legs, whereas the female version has only one armored leg and one bare mesh leg.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_03.description: Asymmetric cyberpunk tights: one leg is covered in segmented armor plates with a knee guard and ankle cuff, the other is a plain textured fitted leg with a small knee pad and a panelled hip.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured hip and the bare-style leg; colour 1 on the armored leg plates, knee guards and hip panel; colour 2 on the joint gaps and back-of-knee panel; colour 3 not visible.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberpunk_03.differs: The armor is on one leg only, with the other leg a plain textured fitted leg, whereas the female version armors both legs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: Skin-tight sci-fi leggings from hip to ankle, built from a smooth hip section and long swooping side panels, with segmented knee caps and small dot details. The lower legs have contrasting calf panels.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip section, inner thigh and knee bands; colour 1 on the outer thigh and shin panels; colour 2 on the knee caps and calf panels; colour 3 on the small dot details.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Defender_Update_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, built from colour-blocked panels: a high hip band, a front thigh block, calf panels with a narrow inset stripe, and a round patch on the seat.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, seat, back of the legs and ankles; colour 1 on the hips and lower legs; colour 2 on the thigh blocks; colour 3 on the inset calf stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Deity_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with a stitched fly-panel outline at the front and contrasting side and back panels running down the outer legs and seat.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front, inner leg and waistband areas; colour 1 on the side and rear leg panels; colour 2 on the seam outlines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Draco_01.description: Form-fitting scale-textured tights covering the full leg, with short shorts-like hip panels edged in trim and pointed cuffs at the shins that flare into separate boot-style greave bands above the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled leg material; colour 1 on the hip and shorts panels; colour 2 on the trim lines and edging; colour 3 on the lower shin bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Firebird_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a V-shaped waistband, a small contrasting front panel, and contrasting jagged flame-like panels down the thighs edged with curved contrasting stripes.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main leggings and lower legs; colour 0 on the jagged thigh panels; colour 3 on the waistband and curved thigh stripes; colour 2 on the front crotch panel.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Fish_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-cut waistband and a chevron at the front hip. Curved swooping stripe bands wrap the lower legs, with smooth panels over the thighs and seat, edged in thin contrasting piping.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Fish_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the smooth thigh, seat and knee panels; colour 0 on the waist chevron and the light stripe bands; colour 1 on the swooping stripe bands; colour 3 on the thin piping outlines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Foxtech_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights with a low-cut brief top, segmented armored thigh plates down the outer legs, contrasting side panels, and shin guards with pointed trim. They run from the hips to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Foxtech_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the brief, the knee and shin accents and the lower-leg trim; colour 1 on the inner leg panels and waistband trim; colour 0 on the outer thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the armored thigh and shin plates.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Gamer_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-cut hip line, circuit-like patterned panels across the hips and groin, thin traced lines running down each leg, and thin contrasting bands at the waist and ankles. Sporty sci-fi gamer look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the circuit panels at the hips and groin; colour 2 on the lines down the legs; colour 3 on the waist and ankle bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: Form-fitting textured tights from waist to mid-calf, with angular outlined panels running down the outer thighs to the knees and segmented, ribbed shin guards below. A superhero-gladiator look with a contrasting waistband edge.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main textured tights; colour 0 on the angular thigh and knee panels; colour 3 on the lower shin guards; colour 2 on the waist edge and panel outlines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Glow_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from waist to ankle with bordered, angular panel lines down the thigh, knee and calf, a triangular crotch panel, and round spots at the hips and knees. Sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the bordered stripe panels and crotch panel; colour 2 on the slim stripes and round spots; colour 3 on the thin outlines around the panels.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Glow_01.differs: The male version adds a round spot at each hip beside the crotch panel.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, built from colour-blocked panels: a wide hip band, thigh and knee sections, contrasting inset stripes at the calves, and a round spot on each buttock.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, back seat with its round spot, and lower legs; colour 1 on the upper front thighs, calf sides and back swoops; colour 2 on the thigh blocks; colour 3 on the calf stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Hoses_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a textured hexagon scale pattern from hips to ankles, a contrasting waistband with a front panel, long piped seam lines down the outer legs and inner knees, and a column of small oval studs on each thigh.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the legs; colour 1 on the waistband and back panel; colour 2 on the front crotch panel; colour 3 on the seam piping and thigh studs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Hoses_01.differs: The male version has long piped seam lines running down the sides of the legs and across the knees, and a straighter, boxier hip band.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Jeweled_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a textured, studded-looking surface and large swooping panels down the thighs and shins, each edged with a beaded jewelled outline. Sits at the hips and runs to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Jeweled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main textured leg surface; colour 3 on the large swooping thigh and shin panels; colour 1 on the jewelled edging around those panels.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Jumpsuit_01.description: Loose, baggy trousers with a low waist and soft wrinkled folds through the thighs and knees. The legs are straight and the hems bunch up in slouchy folds over the feet. A casual, utilitarian look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Jumpsuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole leg garment; colour 1 gives a slight tint in the folds; the hem cuffs are lighter, also colour 0.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Junkbot_01.description: Mechanical junkyard-robot leg piece: an exposed cluster of hoses and joints at the hips, with skeletal piston legs, panelled thigh and shin casings, and rounded knee joints. Sits from the hips down to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plates, knee joints and outer leg casings; colour 1 on the thigh and shin panels; colour 3 on the accent bands and the hip core; colour 2 on the hoses and inner joints.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Junkbot_02.description: Robotic exoskeleton legs and hips built from exposed mechanical struts, pistons and cables, with rounded knee joints and ankle cuffs. Segmented limbs and a looping hip frame give a scrap-built cyborg look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer frame, knee joints and hip struts; colour 1 on the leg panels and hip plates; colour 3 on the small accents between the leg pistons and hip core; colour 2 on the inner cables and gaps.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Kaiju_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a brief-style hip panel, smooth contrasting thigh panels with jagged edges, small knee pads behind the knees, and pointed flame-like panels on the calves and ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip brief panel; colour 1 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the thigh panels and knee pads; colour 3 on the waist notch, calf panels and ankle points.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Kaiju_01.differs: The male thigh panels are smooth and flat with jagged edges, without the raised segmented plates on the female version.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_Retroscifi_J.description: Close-fitting retro sci-fi trousers running from the hips to the ankles, with diagonal stripe panels down each thigh, a short seam line at the front waist, and banded wraps below each knee and at the ankle cuffs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Kneeskirt_Retroscifi_J.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trouser fabric; colour 3 on the diagonal thigh stripes, front seam and ankle bands; colour 1 on the knee bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Krampus_01.description: Tight monster-style leggings with a high waist, colour-blocked thigh panels and shins. Ragged torn edges and cut-out gaps expose the knees, and the legs end in fitted cuffs above the feet.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, rear panel, and lower shins; colour 1 on the upper thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the mid-thigh panels.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Krampus_02.description: Tight, full-length leggings with a wide waistband, segmented panels over the thighs and calves, a slim contrasting stripe along the shin, and a small round patch on each buttock. Ends at the ankles, with a monstrous-costume feel.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Krampus_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, buttocks, back of the legs and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the hips, upper thighs and calves; colour 2 on the mid-thigh panels; colour 3 on the shin stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Leatherpads_1.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a wide waistband, panelled thighs, contrasting knee pads and swooping curved panels down the calves and back of the legs; ends at the ankle. Suits a sleek superhero or tactical look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Leatherpads_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, back of the hips and lower legs; colour 1 on the front hip and calf panels; colour 2 on the thigh pads; colour 3 on the knee pad strips.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.description: Form-fitting textured tights with a high-cut brief at the hips, diagonal segmented straps across each thigh, and angular shin guards with a pointed cuff at the back of each calf. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brief; colour 0 on the textured leg fabric; colour 2 on the thigh straps; colour 3 on the shin guards and calf cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with swooping curved side panels on the thighs, chevron-shaped trim bands above the knees and separate contrasting lower-leg sections with angular inset panels.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh and hip fabric; colour 2 on the swooping thigh panels, waist edge and shin inset panels; colour 1 on the lower legs; colour 3 on the chevron bands and thin outlines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.description: Loose straight-cut trousers with a flared leg that reaches the ankle, a banded waist with a hanging drawcord tie at the front, and swirling decorative panels running down the outer sides of each leg.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trouser fabric; colour 1 on the swirling side panels and the drawcord; colour 2 on the waistband and inner edging.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Madjester_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from waist to ankle, made of irregular harlequin patchwork panels joined by visible contrasting stitching. A jester-like, playful look that hugs the hips and legs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main patchwork panels; colour 1 on the patches; colour 3 on the patches; colour 2 on the stitching.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings covering the hips and legs down to the feet, with a contrasting hip section, a thigh section with swooping curved stripes and flared stripe marks at the outer thigh, and contrasting piping lines down the legs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hip and waist section; colour 3 on the thigh panels; colour 0 on the lower legs and the curved stripes on the thighs; colour 2 on the piping lines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: Skin-tight full-length superhero leggings from the hips to the ankles, with angular contrasting panels down the centre of the thighs, jagged arrow-shaped flashes on the outer thighs, zigzag seams at the knees and pointed shin panels.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the crotch and inner thigh panels and the shin flashes; colour 2 on the outline piping and seam lines; colour 3 on the arrow flashes on the outer thighs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01.description: Tight full-length leggings with sculpted, muscular thigh and calf shaping, pronounced bulges at the knees, and a contrasting section on the lower legs; worn from the waist down to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs, hips and upper legs; colour 1 subtly on the lower back of the legs and calf sides; the lower shins are a separate lighter panel using colour 0.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01.differs: The male version is full-length tights covering the legs, while the female version shows bare skin-textured legs with only a small brief.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_1.description: A bare-skin leg piece with muscular, sinewy thighs and calves ending above the ankles, topped by a plain brief-style hip band. Sits directly on the legs as a monstrous, beast-like skin covering with defined muscle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the brief-style hip band; the leg skin shows its own skin tone and does not follow the colour scheme.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_Legendaryb.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a high-cut hip band, wide contrasting panels covering most of the thighs and calves, and segmented knee and ankle guards with contrasting trim. They run from the hips to the feet in a sleek, sporty cut.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_Legendaryb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner thighs, knees and lower legs; colour 1 on the hip band and the large thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the knee and ankle trim; colour 3 on the small marks on the thighs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_Legendaryb.differs: The male version has wider contrasting thigh panels that cover most of the front of the leg, with clearly visible contrasting marks on the thighs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_Legendaryp.description: Form-fitting superhero tights with a banded waistband and multi-panel legs: chevron-shaped side panels on the thighs, a separate panel over each knee, and angular shin guards with diamond insets ending at the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_Legendaryp.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main thighs, hips and lower legs; colour 2 on the waistband and thigh side panels; colour 0 on the knee and lower-thigh panels; colour 3 on the diamond insets on the shins.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_Legendaryr.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a low-cut hip band, a contrasting centre panel at the crotch, swooping side stripes down the thighs, and separate shin-guard panels with pointed accents that end at the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_Legendaryr.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh and leg fabric; colour 2 on the swooping side stripes; colour 3 on the centre panel and the shin panel inserts; colour 1 on the waist trim and lower shin sections.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_Legendaryy.description: Form-fitting superhero tights that sit at the hips and run to the knees, with large contrasting side panels and chevron stripes on the thighs. Separate glossy shin guards with knee accents continue below.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_01_Legendaryy.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the hip side panels, chevron stripes and knee bands; colour 2 on the lower leg guards; colour 3 on the knee accents.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Alien_01.description: Tight, glossy full-length leggings with a low waistband and layered angular panels swooping down the thighs, plus knee guards and calf panels. A sleek, sci-fi monster-suit look ending at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband edge; colour 1 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the inner thigh panels and lower calf panels; colour 3 on the outer thigh panels, waist chevrons and knee guards.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Aquatic_01.description: Form-fitting full-length leggings covered in a fish-scale mesh pattern, with a jagged fin-like stripe running down each front thigh and contrasting gill-like slits at the lower calves. Sits from the waist to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the scale-patterned leg surface; colour 3 on the thigh stripes; colour 2 on the calf slits.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Aquatic_02.description: Tight full-length leggings with a scaled mesh pattern on the front of the legs, framed by large smooth back and outer-leg panels edged with jagged, fin-like teeth. Ends at the ankles; aquatic monster styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the smooth back and outer-leg panels; colours 0 and 1 on the scaled mesh inserts at the front and inner legs; colour 2 on the jagged edging between the panels.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Aquatic_02.differs: The male version has large smooth panels over the hips, back and outer legs with jagged edges, with the scales only on the front and inner legs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Ascendant_01.description: Skin-tight leggings from hip to ankle with large glossy panels down the outer thighs, a V-shaped centre panel at the front waist, and separate shin guards with contrasting piping and a knee-cap band. Suggests a beastly superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the outer thigh panels and lower shin panels; colour 1 on the front waist panel, knee bands and shin inserts; colour 3 on the piping and edge trim.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Ascendant_02.description: Snug full-length tights with rounded, framed armour-like plates on the outer thighs and back of the thighs, a strap-shaped panel at the front of the hips, and separate calf wraps with thin contrasting trim.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tights; colour 1 on the thigh plate frames and calf guards; colour 2 on the inset thigh plates and front hip strap; colour 3 on the thin trim lines.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Ascendant_02.differs: The male version has contrasting-framed thigh plates and calf guards with a contrasting strap-like front hip panel, while the female version has contrasting panels running from the hip down the outer thigh and angular calf guards.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Classic_01.description: Form-fitting leggings with short knee-length upper legs and a separate lower-leg section covered in swirling tribal flame-like patterns; sits from the waist down to the ankles, suggesting a beastly, tribal fantasy look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Classic_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper leg sections; colour 0 on the lower leg sections; colour 1 on the swirling tribal patterns; colour 2 on the small curled markings near the ankles.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Classic_02.description: Tight, form-fitting trousers running from the waist to the lower calves, where the smooth legs give way to streaky, striped organic patterning wrapped around the shins. Suggests a beastly or monstrous superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Classic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main trouser legs; colour 0 and colour 2 in the streaked stripes on the lower calves; colour 1 in small accent patches on the shins.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Classic_03.description: Tight, form-fitting leggings with jagged, flame-like edges across the knees. Below them the lower legs carry a sleek lower layer with raised, branching vein-like webbing that runs from knee to ankle, giving a monstrous, organic look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Classic_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper leggings and hips; colour 0 on the lower-leg layer and the jagged edges; colour 2 on the raised webbing lines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Classic_04.description: Tight full-length leg piece with a wide waistband, a contrasting front and back crotch panel, contrasting linework tracing muscle lines down each leg, and triple bands around the thighs; ends at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Classic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric and waistband; colour 3 on the front and back crotch panel; colour 1 on the thigh bands; colour 2 on the linework lines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Color_Patch_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with an asymmetric patchwork of separate panels: a large main panel over the hips and one leg, contrasting patches on the other thigh, knee and calf, and small patches at the waist. Ends at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Color_Patch_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main hip and leg panels; colour 0 on the thigh, lower-leg and shin patches; colour 3 on the knee, waist-edge and back calf patches; colour 2 on the hip-edge patch and lower calf patches.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Color_Stripe_0.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, with three-band stripes circling each leg above the knee and again just above the ankle. Sporty, sleek and simple.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Color_Stripe_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on one stripe band above the knee and at the ankle; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 3 on the remaining band.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Corrupted_01.description: Close-fitting full-length leggings with a low-cut brief-style waist, contrasting front gusset and rear panels, and a contrasting waistband. Muscular knee contours and lower-leg seams give a beastly, sculpted look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the legs; colour 1 on the front gusset and rear centre panel; colour 3 on the rear side panels; colour 2 on the waistband.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Cosmos_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with concentric ridged contour lines that mimic sculpted muscle, with oval striated panels on the inner thighs and a high-cut waistband. They end at the lower calf, above the feet.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hips, waist and knee areas; colour 1 on the ridged outer thigh and calf bands; colour 3 on the inner thigh muscle panels; colour 0 as highlights on the ridges.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Cosmos_02.description: Fitted trousers with layered, glossy armor-like plates wrapping the outer thighs, knees and calves, a central fabric panel down the front, and contrasting cuffs at the ankles. Sits at the hips and reaches the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy outer plates and hip guards; colour 1 on the fabric panel down the front and back of the legs; colour 3 on the ankle cuffs; colour 0 on the highlights of the knee and calf plates.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Cosmos_02.differs: The male version has armored plates over the thighs, knees and calves and separate ankle cuffs, instead of the female's skin-tight swirl-patterned leggings.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Cryo_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-rise brief-style waist band, jagged-edged panels running down the outer and rear legs, and rounded knee patches; fits closely from hips to ankles in a sleek monster-hero style.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the jagged side and back leg panels; colour 2 on the outlines, waistband edge and knee patches; colour 3 on the brief front and rear panel.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Deity_01.description: Tight full-length leggings with a high hip line, a seamed front panel at the crotch, and a long contrasting panel running down the outer side and back of each leg to the ankle. Sleek, superhero-like fit.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legs, front and inner sides; colour 1 on the outer side and back leg panels; colour 2 on the seam lines and piping.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Deity_01.differs: The contrasting side panel sits further back and is barely visible from the front, and the front seam panel has a pouch-like shape.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Draco_01.description: Tight full-length leggings with a scaled, fish-scale texture on the legs, short shorts-like panels with contrasting seams over the hips and seat, and rigid ribbed greave-like bands around the lower shins.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled leg surfaces; colour 1 on the hip and seat panels; colour 2 on the seams and edge lines; colour 3 on the shin bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Firebird_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a V-shaped waistband, jagged flame-like panels running down the outer thighs, curved contrasting stripes across each thigh, and a larger armoured-looking front centre panel; they end at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main legs, rear and lower legs; colour 0 on the flame-shaped thigh panels; colour 3 on the waistband trim and the curved thigh stripes; colour 2 on the front centre panel.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Firebird_01.differs: The male version has a larger, higher V-shaped front centre panel and a broader waistband than the female version.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Fish_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with swooping fin-like stripe bands running diagonally down the shins and outer thighs, a glossy panel over the thighs and rear, and thin contrasting outlines. A contrasting waistband dips low at the hips. Monstrous lionfish styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Fish_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main thigh and rear panels; colour 1 on the diagonal fin stripes; colour 0 on the waistband and the stripes between the fins; colour 3 on the thin outline piping.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Foxtech_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a brief-style hip section, layered armored plates down the outer thighs and shins, a contrasting inner-leg panel, and segmented knee and calf guards. Sleek, beast-tech superhero styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Foxtech_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hip brief, knee caps and shin stripes; colour 0 on the outer thigh and calf panels; colour 1 on the inner-leg panels and knee trim; colour 2 on the armor plates.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Gamer_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the hips to the ankles, with a thin waistband trim and ankle trim. Bold, angular circuit-like lines curve down the legs, and a tribal-looking pattern spreads across the groin and hip area. Gamer sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the angular patterns at the hips and groin; colour 2 on the lines running down the legs; colour 3 on the waistband and ankle trim.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Gamer_01.differs: The male version has bolder, doubled circuit lines curving down the legs and a denser angular hip pattern.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Gladiator_01.description: Tight full-length leggings with a textured, scale-like pattern, outlined armor-style panels running down the outer thighs to the knees, and separate segmented greave-like shin guards that end above the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the textured legging body; colour 0 on the thigh and knee panels; colour 2 on the outlines and trim around the panels and waistband; colour 3 on the lower shin guards.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Glow_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from hip to ankle, with bordered stripe panels down each leg, round knee patches and angled shin bands. A small shield-shaped panel with two round dots sits at the front of the hips. Creature-themed and glowing in style.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Glow_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings fabric; colour 1 on the wide bordered stripe panels, shin bands and groin panel; colour 2 on the narrow stripes, dots and knee patches; colour 3 on the thin outline edging.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Glow_01.differs: The male version adds a shield-shaped panel with two round dots at the front of the hips, and its back stripes form a blocky bracket shape.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Jeweled_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a rough, pebbled, fur-like texture and swooping contrasting panels down the thighs and shins, edged with a row of small studs or gems. They sit at the hips and end at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Jeweled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured main leg surface; colour 3 on the large swooping thigh and shin panels; colour 1 on the beaded edging and outlines along those panels.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Kaiju_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a hip band and front brief panel, jagged-edged contrasting panels along the inner thighs, contrasting knee patches, and pointed flared shin patches ending at the ankles. Monster-themed superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band and seat; colour 3 on the front brief panel, knee flares and lower shin points; colour 1 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the jagged thigh panels and knee caps.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Kaiju_01.differs: The male version has jagged-edged contrasting panels on the thighs rather than the female's overlapping segmented scale plates.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Lockbox_66_01.description: Form-fitting textured tights with a brief-style hip band, angular segmented straps across each thigh, and contrasting-trimmed shin plates with a pointed guard behind each knee. Ends above the feet, in a monstrous armored superhero style.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured leg fabric; colour 1 on the hip band; colour 2 on the thigh straps and plates; colour 3 on the shin plates and knee guards.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Lockbox_66_02.description: Tight, form-fitting superhero pants reaching the ankles, with large curved contrasting panels on the thighs, zigzag trim bands below the knee, and knee-patch panels on the lower legs. Sits high at the waist.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper leg fabric; colour 2 on the curved thigh panels and knee patches; colour 3 on the zigzag bands and thin piping; colour 1 on the lower legs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Lockbox_66_02.differs: The male version is full-length pants with a high waist, curved thigh panels and contrasting lower legs, rather than a low brief-style hip with separate shin guards.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Madjester_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings built from irregular patchwork panels joined with visible stitched seams, giving a ragged jester or rag-doll look. They run from the waist to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base patches; colour 1 on the patches and waistband; colour 3 on the round patches; colour 2 on the stitching.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Modern_Destroy.description: Tight, form-fitting superhero shorts-length tights covering hips and thighs to just above the knee, with a separate hip panel, curving contrasting piping lines down the thighs and contrasting swooping stripe accents on the outer thighs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Modern_Destroy.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hip and upper panel; colour 3 on the thigh sections; colour 2 on the curving piping lines; colour 0 on the swooping stripes on the outer thighs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Modern_Kinetik.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a central crotch and thigh panel, jagged lightning-like flashes on the outer thighs, angular outlined panels, and pointed calf inserts above the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Modern_Kinetik.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legs; colour 1 on the hip and inner thigh panels and the calf inserts; colour 2 on the outline and trim lines; colour 3 on the jagged thigh flashes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Patternseta_Bo.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low, V-cut waistband. The thighs have a zigzag trim line above the knee, and the lower legs have a separate panel with jagged lightning-bolt markings down the shins. They end at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Patternseta_Bo.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs; colour 1 on the waistband and lower legs; colour 3 on the zigzag trim line at the knee; colour 2 on the bolt markings.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Patternseta_Fi.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a waistband edged by a jagged, wing-like trim, and flame-shaped tongues licking up from fitted calf sections that run to the ankle. A beast-themed elemental fire look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Patternseta_Fi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 2 on the jagged waistband trim; colour 3 on the lower calf sections; colour 1 on the flame tips at the calves.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Phantom_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leg piece: a high-cut brief with a separate rear panel, fitted thighs, and calf sleeves that end above the ankle, leaving the feet bare. Sleek and form-fitting, worn from hips to lower shins.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs and knees; colour 1 on the brief, hip bands and back of the upper thighs; colour 2 on the rear and side hip panels; colour 3 on the front waist patch and calf sleeves.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Phantom_02.description: Tight-fitting full-length trousers that follow the leg muscles, with bold angular chevron-like stripes running down the outer thighs and calves, and separate banded cuffs at the ankles. Sits at the waist with a plain top edge.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Phantom_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trouser legs; colour 3 on the angular side stripes; colour 1 on the thin bands at the top of the ankle cuffs; colour 2 on the ankle cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Phantom_03.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a brief-style hip section and jagged lightning-like panels running down the outer thighs. The legs end in ragged, flame-like cuffs above the ankles, leaving the feet bare.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Phantom_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the hip brief and the jagged thigh panels; colour 3 on the lower calf cuffs with their ragged edges.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Pumpkin_01.description: Skin-tight monstrous leggings with sculpted, exaggerated muscle contours over the thighs and calves, veiny surface texture, and a thin waistband. They end above the ankles, giving a beastly, creature-like look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main leg surface; colour 1 on the vein-like markings; colour 2 on the waistband edge.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Pumpkin_01.differs: The male version has more pronounced, bulging muscle sculpting and more visible vein markings, especially on the inner thighs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Punk_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, with a central panel down the front and back of each leg and contrasting side panels that flare into pointed shapes at the knee and shin.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central front and back leg panels and the knee points; colour 1 on the outer side panels and the lower shins.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Radical_01.description: Smooth, form-fitting full-length tights that run from the hips down to the ankles, with a wide contrasting stripe down the outer side of each leg. Simple, sporty superhero styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Radical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the stripe down one outer leg; colour 2 on the stripe down the other outer leg.
