Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Reactor_01.description: Skin-tight sci-fi leggings with a brief-style hip piece, contrasting thigh and calf panels, contrasting banding lines, contrasting knee accents and ankle-length lower legs; covers the legs from hips to ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner thighs, knees and lower legs; colour 1 on the outer thigh and calf panels; colour 3 on the hip insert and knee accents; colour 2 on the brief-style hip section and banding lines.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Reactor_01.differs: The male version has a fuller brief-style hip section with a broad contrasting panel, giving more coverage at the hips and rear.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Retro_Warlord_.description: Loose, slightly gathered tights reaching to below the knee, with a rounded oval patch on each outer thigh and banded cuffs at the knees, above metallic-looking shin guards. A retro superhero-warlord look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Retro_Warlord_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main legs; colour 3 on the thigh patches and knee bands; colour 0 on the lower shin guards.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Retro_Warlord_.differs: The male version is fuller and baggier, bunching slightly above the knee, whereas the female version is cut tighter along the leg.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Retrodestroyer.description: Tight full-length leggings with a contrasting waistband, thin seam lines outlining boxy rectangular panels on the thighs and hips, and contrasting-lined seams down the calves. They end at the ankles in a retro superhero style.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Retrodestroyer.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leggings; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 3 on the thigh and hip panel seam lines; colour 2 on the calf seams and ankle edges.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Retrodestroyer.differs: The male version has boxier rectangular thigh panel outlines, while the female version has more curved, angled panels.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Retrosteelhead.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a hip band and colour-blocked panels: thighs, knees and calves are split into separate sections, with narrow contrasting stripes at the knees and a fitted lower leg. Retro superhero styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Retrosteelhead.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, rear panel and lower calves; colour 1 on the upper thighs, knee and calf panels; colour 2 on the mid-thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow knee stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Sandstorm_01.description: Tight, full-length leg suit with segmented panels: ribbed textured thigh sections, smooth lower legs, separate kneepads, and thin swooping contrasting piping. It has a broad shield-shaped front panel and cuffs at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth thigh and shin panels and the hip band; colour 2 on the ribbed thigh panels, kneepads and ankle cuffs; colour 3 on the swooping piping and knee edges; colour 1 on the front crotch panel.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Sandstorm_01.differs: The male version has a larger, broader front panel that sits lower on the crotch, and the ribbed panels cover more of the inner thigh.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Sandstorm_02.description: Form-fitting full-length tights with a brief-style waist panel, smooth legs, ribbed padded knee guards edged with contrasting trim, and thin trim rings at the ankles. Simple superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the brief-style waist panel; colour 2 on the ribbed knee pads; colour 3 on the trim edging the knee pads and ankle rings.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Sandstorm_02.differs: The male version has smooth plain thighs with a contrasting brief panel and only knee pads, lacking the ribbed hip and thigh panels and curved thigh stripes of the female version.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Scaled_01.description: Close-fitting full-length tights with a brief-like waist panel, slanted banded stripes over the hips and thighs, thin outlined seams, contrasting knee pads, and thick ringed cuffs at the ankles. A creature-inspired look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Scaled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the waist panel, thigh stripes and ankle cuffs; colour 2 on the knee pads; colour 3 on the thin seam lines and waist notch.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Scaled_01.differs: The male version has thicker, multi-ringed ankle cuffs, while the female version has thin single ankle bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Scarab_01.description: Form-fitting full-length leg tights with padded thigh panels, contrasting rear and side panels, small knee guards and banded ankle cuffs; a waist accent sits at the front. Sleek monster-hunter or superhero styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front thighs and lower calves; colour 1 on the waist accent, shins and side calf sections; colour 2 on the rear and side panels, knee guards and ankle bands; colour 3 on the small back plates.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Scarab_01.differs: The male version has contrasting panels covering the whole seat and back of the thighs, while the female shows light panels across the back.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Scarab_02.description: Full-length paneled tights with bulky, armored-looking thighs, large glyph-like marking plates down the outer and rear thighs, rounded knee guards and banded ankle cuffs. A monstrous superhero style with a layered, segmented build.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip, knee guards and some thigh panels; colour 1 on the lower legs, ankle cuffs and inner thigh panels; colour 2 on the side thigh panels; colour 3 on the large glyph-like markings on the thighs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Scarab_02.differs: The male version has bulkier, layered thighs with large glyph-like marking plates on the thighs, where the female version is smoother with only small marking plates.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Spinal_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, covered in monstrous spinal patterns: rib-like chevron bars down the thighs, chevron rows on the calves, and a bone-like glowing motif across the rear.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Spinal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the rear panel, side panels and calf chevrons; colour 3 on the trim lines and the back motif; colour 2 on the thigh rib bars.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Spooky_01.description: Skin-tight monstrous leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with feathery ridged texture down the thighs, jagged contrasting panels on the front of the hips and thighs, and a scattered spotted pattern over the back and sides.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg surface and ridges; colour 1 on the jagged front hip and thigh panels; colour 2 on the spots.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Starhawk_01.description: Form-fitting leg tights with a textured mesh or scaled front and inner leg, framed by solid jagged outer panels with contrasting edging that wrap the hips, knees and outer thighs. Ends at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the solid outer hip, thigh and knee panels; colour 2 on the edging trim between panels; the textured mesh sections show a skin-like tone that ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Starhawk_01.differs: The male version has the textured mesh covering more of the front thigh, with the solid panels pushed to the outer sides, rather than solid panels covering most of the front leg.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Starowl_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings running from the waist to the ankles, printed with star-and-line constellation patterns down the legs and hips, and finished with a narrow contrasting band at each ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings fabric; colour 3 on the star markings; colour 2 on the constellation lines and the ankle bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings covered in a scattered star pattern, running from the waist down to the ankles and hugging the muscular legs; a casual, playful superhero look with a plain waistband.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric of the leggings; colour 1 on the stars on the front and sides of the legs; colour 2 on the stars on the back of the legs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_02.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings that sit at the waist and end above the ankles, with star emblems on the hips, seat and knees. A simple, sleek superhero look with a sporty feel.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legs; colour 1 on the star emblems at the hips, seat and knees; colour 2 on the outlines of the stars.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_03.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a star-patterned upper section like short trunks over the hips and upper thighs, and plain smooth lower legs that run down to the ankles. A thin contrasting seam separates the two sections.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper trunk section behind the stars; colour 3 on the star pattern; colour 1 on the lower legs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_04.description: Close-fitting full-length tights ending just above the ankles, with a narrow waistband and a contrasting stripe down each outer leg that ends in a small star shape near the calf. Sporty superhero styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the waistband edge and the outer-leg stripes; colour 2 on the darker stripe edging and the star accents.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_05.description: Close-fitting full-length tights that follow the leg muscles down to the calves, with a jagged triangular contrasting panel at the waist that wraps from the front hip round to the back. Suits a beast or monster superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tights; colour 1 on the triangular waist panel. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_06.description: Tight, form-fitting full-length leggings that sit at the waist and run to the ankles, with a wide contrasting stripe of small stars down the outer side of each leg. Suits a patriotic superhero or stunt-performer look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 3 on the side stripes; colour 1 on the stars within the stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_07.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings that run from the hips to just above the ankles. The upper hips and thighs carry a star-patterned section that ends in a jagged zigzag edge, and the lower legs are a plain, glossy, muscular-looking contrasting section.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the star-patterned hip and upper thigh section; colour 3 on the stars; colour 1 on the glossy lower legs; colour 2 is not clearly visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_08.description: Form-fitting tights reaching the ankles, with a solid hip and upper-thigh section that has contrasting seam lines, and lower legs patterned with scattered stars and dots, giving a wrestler or monster-hero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_08.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hip and upper-thigh section; colour 2 on the seam lines dividing it; colour 0 on the lower-leg base; colour 3 on the stars and splotches.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_09.description: Form-fitting full-length tights running from the waist to the ankles, with a star-patterned panel down the front and back of each leg, bordered by thin piping and solid side panels. A casual-superhero, wrestler-like look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_09.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the side panels and lower legs; colour 0 on the star-patterned central panel; colour 3 on the star motifs; colour 2 on the thin piping along the panel edges.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_10.description: Form-fitting full-length tights that run from the waist to the ankles, split down the middle into two halves, with a jagged dividing edge. One leg is plain and the other carries a scattered pattern of stars and sparkles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Stars_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plain half of the tights; colour 0 as the base of the patterned half; colour 3 on the stars and sparkles on that half.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Swan_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the hips to the ankles, with large outer-thigh panels bordered by trim and ending in chevron stripes. A sleek superhero look with a monstrous-beast flavour.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the upper outer-thigh panels; colour 2 on the panel edging; colour 3 on the chevron stripes.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Swan_01.differs: The male panels are broader and reach further down the thigh, with larger chevrons.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Tactical_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from waist to ankle, with large contrasting panels over the outer thighs and knees, small arrow-like markings at the front hips, and thin bands at the ankles. Sleek tactical superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings and hips; colour 1 on the thigh and knee panels; colour 3 on the arrow markings at the hips and thighs; colour 2 on the ankle bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Traveler_01.description: Close-fitting full-length tights with a narrow contrasting waistband, smooth cloth-like legs and a gradient that fades into a separate lower-shin section ending in a thin cuff at the ankle. Sits at the hips; casual, creature-traveller look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs and upper legs; colour 1 on the lower shins and calves, blending upward as a gradient; colour 2 on the waistband and ankle trim.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valdia_01.description: Tight full-length leggings with a low waistband, sculpted knee guards and shin plates over the lower legs, and curving raised seam lines running down the thighs. Sleek, armoured-suit look suited to beast or sci-fi heroes.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valdia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs and main leg fabric; colour 1 on the shin and calf plates; colour 2 on the seam lines and ankle cuffs; colour 3 on the waistband trim and knee guards.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valelectric_01.description: Form-fitting superhero leggings with a low-cut waistband, a contrasting outer-leg panel, thin curved seam lines across the thighs, and bulky angular shin guards over the lower legs. Sits at the hips and runs to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valelectric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer thigh panels; colour 1 on the waistband, inner thighs and knee and calf sections; colour 3 on the thigh seam lines and lower shin panels; colour 2 on the edge trim and waist edging.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valerian_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from waist to ankle, decorated with a web of thin vein-like cracks and several slashed claw-mark gashes across the thighs, giving a wounded, monstrous look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legging fabric; colour 1 on the thin vein-like crack lines; colour 3 on the claw-slash gashes across the thighs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valflare_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights from waist to ankle, with a V-shaped front panel at the hips, flame-like swooping panels down the thighs and shins, and contrasting cuffs at the ankles. Ends above the feet.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valflare_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer thigh and back panels; colour 1 on the main leg panels and waistband; colour 3 on the front hip V and ankle cuffs; colour 2 on the swooping flame edging.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valhex_01.description: Form-fitting superhero leggings from the waist to the ankles, with a V-shaped waistband, broad swooping inset panels on the front of each thigh, and segmented knee guards above separate lower-shin panels.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valhex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer leg sides and ankle edges; colour 1 on the inset thigh and shin panels; colour 2 on the piping and knee guards; colour 3 on the small waistband accent.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valhex_01.differs: The inset front thigh panels are broader and cover most of the front of each thigh, giving a bolder colour block than the narrower female panels.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valstar_01.description: Form-fitting full-length leggings with segmented, chevron-ridged armor panels down the outer thighs and calves, rounded knee caps, and a contrasting front hip panel. Suggests a rugged beast-style superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip panel, knee guards and shin stripes; colour 1 on the inner, front and back leg fabric; colour 3 on the outer thigh and calf armor plates; colour 2 on the thin edging around the plates.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valstar_01.differs: The male version has broader thigh plates that wrap toward the front of the leg, covering more of each thigh side, and a shorter hip panel.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valvee_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with raised outlined panels down the thighs and shins, angular chevron overlays above the knees, knee patches and a small waistband panel; a sleek armored-suit look that runs from hips to ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Valvee_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the hip panels and chevron overlays; colour 3 on the knee patches and the waistband centre; colour 2 on the outline piping and shin plates.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Vigilante_01.description: Tight superhero leggings that end just below the knee, with a central crotch panel, large quilted side panels on the thighs and a thick, layered zigzag chevron band across each knee. The lower legs are left as bare mannequin.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main thigh panels; colour 0 on the inner thigh strips and the outer edge of the knee bands; colour 2 on the central crotch and rear panel; colour 3 on the knee band stripes.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Vigilante_01.differs: The male version has a wider, layered knee band with a light edge, and the thigh panels are shorter and blockier.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Warrior_01.description: Tight, form-fitting leggings with a quilted, scale-like texture from a slim waistband down to mid-calf, ending in separate contrasting armoured shin guards with glowing-style vein lines and a narrow contrasting cuff at the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Monster_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted scaled leggings; colour 1 on the waistband and ankle cuffs; colour 2 on the shin guard plates; colour 3 on the vein lines along the shin guards.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Nighthawk_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with segmented armored plates over the hips, thighs, and shins, plus a plated front panel at the crotch. Ribbed stretch fabric shows between the plates, giving a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large thigh, hip and shin plates; colour 1 on the stretch leggings fabric and the waistband; colour 2 on the inset panels and shin chevrons; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_None_01.description: A minimal placeholder hip piece: a small flat oval patch sitting at the pelvis just below the waist, with no skirt or shorts shape. It adds almost nothing to the silhouette.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Partial_01.description: Robotic leg piece with short, loose brief-like shorts over the hips and exposed mechanical legs below, with segmented armored plates, ringed knee joints, and cylindrical inner actuators running down to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Partial_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts, knee rings and outer leg plates; colour 1 on the cylindrical leg actuators; colour 3 on small accents on the actuators; colour 2 on the inner joints and cabling.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Partial_02.description: Cybernetic leg piece: a high, boxy brief-style waistband at the hips over exposed robotic legs of segmented metal plates, ribbed tube-like actuators and chunky ring-like knee joints, ending above the feet.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Partial_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip brief, metal leg plates and knee joints; colour 1 on the leg actuator tubes; colour 3 on the thin trim line and small accents.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Partial_02.differs: The male version has a taller, boxier brief that covers more of the hips, with no separate outer layer.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Patternseta_Bolt_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low-cut brief-style waistband, a jagged zigzag border across the thighs and a crackling bolt pattern down the shins. They end at the ankles, in a superhero style.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Patternseta_Bolt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper thighs and hips; colour 1 on the waistband and lower legs; colour 3 on the thin zigzag border lines; colour 2 on the bolt markings.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Patternseta_Fire_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a low waistband bearing a flame-shaped contrasting emblem at the front, and jagged flame tongues rising from a solid contrasting band around each lower calf, ending above the feet.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Patternseta_Fire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legs; colour 2 on the flame emblem at the waistband; colour 3 on the lower calf bands; colour 1 on the flame edge accents at the calves.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Phantom_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings reaching the lower calf, with a high-cut hip brief, glossy panels over the hips and buttocks, contrasting trim curving around them, a small front triangle, and a separate lower-leg section.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Phantom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front thighs and knee panels; colour 1 on the back thighs and the trim around the hip panels; colour 2 on the glossy hip and buttock panels; colour 3 on the front triangle and lower calves.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Phantom_02.description: Form-fitting superhero tights from the waist to the ankles, with outlined chevron-shaped panels down the outer thighs and calves, and contrasting angled cuffs with a thin contrasting band at the lower legs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Phantom_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 3 on the outlined thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the lower leg cuffs; colour 1 on the thin bands at the cuff tops.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Phantom_03.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a high-cut brief at the hips, lightning-like jagged panels running down the outer thighs, and jagged zigzag-topped boot-like calf sections. Sits from waist to ankle in a sleek, form-fitting way.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Phantom_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the brief and the jagged thigh panels; colour 3 on the calf sections.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Power_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with fine horizontal banded ribbing across the hips and thighs, a slim waistband and a plain cuff at each ankle. Sits at the natural waist with a sleek, sporty look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed banding over the leggings; colour 2 on the base fabric and lower thigh sections; colour 1 on the waistband and ankle cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Pumpkin_01.description: Skin-tight full-length tights that hug the hips and legs down to the ankles, with a shallow V-shaped waistband at the front and faint vein-like or muscle-like markings running down the legs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the tights; colour 1 on the faint vein-like markings down the legs; colour 2 on the waistband edge.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Punk_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, with contrasting side panels that flare into pointed shapes at the hip, knee and calf. A sleek, sporty superhero look with no other detailing.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and back centre of the legs and the seat; colour 1 on the side panels and lower calves.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Radical_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, with a contrasting stripe running down the outside of each leg from hip to ankle. Smooth, plain, sporty superhero styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Radical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the stripe down one outer leg; colour 2 on the stripe down the other outer leg.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Reactor_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from a brief-style waistband to the ankles, with glossy thigh panels, ribbed lower-thigh sections, knee patches, thin banding straps and a V-shaped emblem at the front of the waist.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip, upper thigh and lower shin panels; colour 1 on the ribbed thigh and calf sections; colour 2 on the waistband and banding lines; colour 3 on the front waist emblem and knee patches.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The male version has a fuller brief-style waist panel at the back, and its lower legs end in plain panels without the contrasting ankle cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.description: Retro superhero tights with a snug waist, running down the legs to just below the knee, with round contrasting patches on the hips and banded knee wraps. The lower shin looks like a separate boot or legging.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main tights; colour 3 on the hip patches and knee bands; colour 0 on the lower leg sections below the knees.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The male version is baggier and gathers loosely around the thighs and knees, while the female tights are closer-fitting.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.description: Skin-tight retro superhero leggings with a wide contrasting waistband, thin piping outlining rectangular panels on the thighs and back, and contrasting seam lines and bands at the knees and ankles. They end at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Retrodestroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the legs; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 3 on the thigh and hip piping; colour 2 on the knee and ankle bands and the calf seams.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit_01.description: Retro sci-fi jumpsuit legs: snug full-length trousers with a crinkled, worn-looking fabric, diagonal stripes down each thigh, banded straps just below the knees and thin cuffs at the ankles. Sits from the waist to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Retroscifi_Jumpsuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main trouser fabric; colour 3 on the diagonal thigh stripes, centre front seam line and ankle cuffs; colour 1 on the knee bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.description: Skin-tight retro superhero leggings reaching the ankles, built from colour-blocked panels: a band at the hips, a front-centre panel, thighs, swooping calf sections and a small round patch on each buttock, with narrow inset stripes at the knees.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waist band, seat, lower legs and back-of-leg panels; colour 1 on the front hip panel and calf and outer-leg swoops; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow knee and calf inset stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a wide waistband, angular colour-blocked panels sweeping diagonally down each thigh, diamond-shaped patches behind the knees, and a contrasting band above each ankle; ends at mid-calf.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and the bands above the ankles; colour 1 on the main leg panels; colour 2 on the large diagonal thigh and seat panels; colour 3 on the knee diamonds.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_01.description: Form-fitting paneled tights from the hips to the ankles, with ribbed segments over the upper thighs and knees, a V-shaped front crotch panel, swooping diagonal piping across the thighs, and banded cuffs at the calves and ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the ribbed thigh, knee and ankle segments; colour 1 on the front crotch panel; colour 3 on the diagonal piping and the bands below the knees.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_02.description: Form-fitting full-length tights with a brief-style hip section that has a Y-shaped front panel, banded knee panels with thin contrasting piping, and narrow trim rings at the ankles. A sleek superhero legwear piece.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg tights and the sides of the hip section; colour 1 on the Y-shaped hip panel; colour 2 on the banded knee panels; colour 3 on the piping at the knees and ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Sandstorm_02.differs: The male hip section has a Y-shaped front panel with contrasting side sections, unlike the plainer, shorter female brief.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scaled_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from the hips to the ankles, with a V-shaped front panel at the waist, diagonal bands down the thighs, contrasting knee patches, thin outlined panel lines and bands at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scaled_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the waist panel, thigh bands and ankle bands; colour 2 on the knee patches; colour 3 on the thin outline seams and the waist edge.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scarab_01.description: Form-fitting superhero leggings with padded, quilted panels over the hips and thighs, contrasting side and knee panels, small accent tabs at the back hips, and contrasting cuffs at the ankles. Sits from the waist to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front thigh panels and the back calves; colour 1 on the lower front legs and the waist tab; colour 2 on the seat, back thighs, side panels, knee pads and ankle cuffs; colour 3 on the small back hip tabs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scarab_01.differs: The seat and back thighs are contrasting panelling, while the female version has a mostly light rear with contrasting side panels.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scarab_02.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings from the hips to the ankles, with a glossy panelled hip section, angled contrasting front thigh panels, contrasting knee caps, ankle cuffs and contrasting geometric glyph markings on the outer thighs, calves and rear legs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip panels and lower front shins; colour 1 on the rear legs, side strips and ankle cuffs; colour 2 on the front thigh panels; colour 3 on the glyph markings and the hip trim.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scarab_02.differs: The male version adds contrasting glyph markings on the outer thighs and the backs of the calves, and has a codpiece-like front hip panel.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: Skin-tight sci-fi soldier leggings running from the hips to the ankles, built from colour-blocked panels: a hip band, a front thigh panel, knee panels with narrow inset strips, and swooping calf panels. Sleek, athletic and form-fitting.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip band, rear seat and lower calves; colour 1 on the upper front thighs and the swooping calf panels; colour 2 on the knee-to-thigh panels; colour 3 on the narrow inset strips at the shins.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A bulky, rounded snow-mound skirt shaped like a stacked snowman base. It starts at the waist, swells into a wide lumpy cone with soft tiers, and reaches the ankles, hiding both legs entirely. Whimsical holiday costume.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main snowy body of the skirt; colour 1 on the mottled speckled patches scattered across the surface.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The male mound is wider and lumpier, with more distinct stacked tiers and a visible cleft down the back.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Space_01.description: Form-fitting sci-fi leggings with a low V-shaped waistband, hexagonal panels on the thighs and calves, glowing-style line trim tracing curves down the legs, and segmented shin plating; they run the full leg to the ankle.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer thigh and shin panels; colour 2 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the curved line trim and shin outlines; colour 3 on the waistband, hexagon panels and knee bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Space_Monster_01.description: Tight, form-fitting futuristic leggings with a V-shaped waistband, swooping curved panels down the thighs, hexagonal knee-back panels, and segmented shin plates with piping that reach the ankles. Sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Space_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the waist V, the hexagonal thigh panels and the knee trim; colour 2 on the main thigh and calf fabric; colour 0 on the front thigh sections and shin plates; colour 1 on the curved piping lines and shin outlines.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: Form-fitting sci-fi trousers with a paneled, colour-blocked design: a contrasting waistband and rear patch, thigh panels, and looser shin panels with a narrow vertical stripe at each knee. The legs end just above the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, rear patch and lower legs; colour 1 on the hip and calf panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; colour 3 on the vertical knee stripes.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.differs: The male version has looser, slightly baggy calf panels and a bolder knee stripe.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Spinal_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from waist to ankle with printed circuit-like line patterns, chevron ribs down the thighs, a spine-like chevron trail down the back of the legs and a decorative emblem on the rear.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Spinal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the back panel, side panels and chevron dashes; colour 3 on the outer piping lines and the rear emblem; colour 2 on the rib chevrons at the front and back of the thighs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Spooky_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a spotted animal-like pattern, feathery ribbed texture along the thighs and jagged contrasting panels at the hips and inner thighs. They run from the waist down to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric and ribbed texture; colour 1 on the jagged panels at the hips and inner thighs; colour 2 on the spots.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Starhawk_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights with solid outer-leg panels edged in contrasting trim, jagged zigzag borders, and a mesh-textured inner leg and rear panel. A high-cut brief at the hips, the legs run to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the solid outer panels and brief; colour 2 on the trim outlines; colour 0 on the fishnet mesh inserts.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Starhawk_01.differs: The male version has more mesh exposed: solid panels stop at the knees as separate kneepad shapes, and the lower legs are all mesh.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Starowl_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the waist to the ankles, printed with constellation patterns of star shapes joined by thin lines, and finished with narrow contrasting bands at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 3 on the star shapes; colour 2 on the constellation lines and the ankle bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings covering the hips down to the ankles, patterned all over with scattered star shapes. A plain smooth waistband sits at the hips. A classic superhero or sporty look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric of the leggings; colour 1 on the stars on the front; colour 2 on the stars on the back and sides.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_02.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with stars on each hip and buttock and smaller stars over each knee. A smooth, sleek, form-fitting cut.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the star appliqués at the hips, seat and knees.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_02.differs: The male version adds stars on both hips and a second star on the seat, so it has more stars than the female version.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_03.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings reaching the ankles, with a star-patterned trunks-style section covering the hips and upper thighs. The legs below are plain and smooth, with a thin seam where the patterns meet.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the star-patterned trunks background; colour 3 on the stars; colour 1 on the leggings legs.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_03.differs: The male version has a longer, shorts-like star section reaching the upper thigh, while the female version has a high-cut brief shape that stops at the hips.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_04.description: Skin-tight leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with a contrasting waistband and a side stripe down each outer leg that ends in a small star point at the ankle. A sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the stripe edging and waistband; colour 2 on the centre of the side stripe and the top waist edge.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_05.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings that run from the hips to the ankles, with a small angular contrasting panel with a jagged edge on one side of the hip that wraps toward the lower back. A plain, sleek superhero base layer.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legging body; colour 1 on the asymmetric hip panel; colours 2 and 3 not visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_06.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with a wide starred stripe down each outer side seam. A superhero look with a sporty, retro feel.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_06.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 3 on the side stripes; colour 1 on the stars; colour 2 on the thin edge piping beside the stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_07.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a star-patterned upper section at the hips and thighs, ending in a jagged zigzag edge above plain lower legs that run down to the ankles. A patriotic superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_07.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper hip and thigh section; colour 3 on the star patterns; colour 1 on the lower legs; colour 2 on the thin outline along the zigzag edge.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_08.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings with a plain upper thigh section and a star-patterned lower section running to the ankles, divided by an angular stepped contrasting seam across each thigh. Sits at the hips.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_08.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shorts section; colour 2 on the seam lines across the thighs; colour 0 on the lower leg base; colour 3 on the star pattern.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_08.differs: The seam across each thigh is a more angular, stepped panel line, and the stars are larger than on the female version.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_09.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with a wide star-patterned panel down the centre of the front and back of each leg, bordered by thin edging, and plain side panels. Sits at the hips and reaches the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_09.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer side panels of the legs; the centre panels carry a star pattern with colour 0 as the base and colour 3 for the stars; colour 2 on the thin edging.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_09.differs: The star panel is wider and ends just below the knee at the front, with the lower leg fully in the plain side colour.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_10.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings split down the centre into two halves: one plain leg and one leg covered in a star pattern. A jagged, torn-looking edge divides the halves, and they end at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_10.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plain leg half; colour 0 as the base of the star-patterned leg; colour 3 on the stars.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Stars_10.differs: The dividing line between the plain and star halves is jagged, and the stars are larger, with a big star at the hip.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Swan_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings that run from the waist to the ankles, with large side panels over the hips and outer thighs edged in contrasting trim and marked with stacked chevron stripes. A sleek superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main legs; colour 1 on the hip and thigh side panels; colour 2 on the panel edging; colour 3 on the chevron stripes.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Tactical_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings from the hips to the ankles, with contrasting panels along the outer thighs and calves, small angular marks at the front of the hips, and thin bands at the ankles. A sleek tactical superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the thigh and calf panels; colour 3 on the small hip markings; colour 2 on the ankle bands.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Toy_01.description: Close-fitting full-length pants with a low waistband, smooth sleek legs and narrow ankle hems. A thin contrasting stripe runs down each outer leg and zigzags into a diamond with small triangular accents, giving a retro look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pants and waistband; colour 1 on the zigzag side stripes; colour 2 on the triangle accents; colour 3 on the triangle accents.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Toy_Leg_R_01_1.description: A single right-leg piece of segmented robotic armor: a smooth rounded thigh shell under an angular hip flange, a ringed knee joint, and a tapered shin plate ending above the ankle. Toy-like, mechanical styling.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Toy_Leg_R_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh and shin shells; colour 2 on the knee joint ring and the hip flange edge; colour 1 has no clear use on this sheet.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Traveler_01.description: Close-fitting full-length tights that run from the waist to the ankles, with a narrow contrasting waistband and thin ankle cuffs. The fabric is smooth with soft wrinkles, and the lower legs fade into a second shade.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper legs and hips; colour 1 fading in over the lower legs and ankles; colour 2 on the waistband and ankle cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Tucked_01.description: Skin-tight plain trousers that run from the hips to the ankles, with a smooth fit and slight knee bulges where the legs would be tucked into boots. A casual, sleek, superhero-friendly base layer.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Tucked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole trouser surface; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valdia_01.description: Form-fitting superhero leggings with sleek outlined panel lines running down the thighs and hips, angular knee guards, a lower-shin section in a separate colour, and a cuffed ankle band. A slim waistband with a V-shaped notch sits at the hips.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valdia_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thighs and upper legs; colour 1 on the lower legs; colour 2 on the panel outlines, waistband and ankle cuffs; colour 3 on the knee patches and waistband accent.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valelectric_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights from waist to ankle, with a notched contrasting waistband, contrasting outer-thigh panels, curved striped lines across the front thighs, and contrasting angular shin guards with pointed knee accents.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valelectric_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main legs, hips and lower calves; colour 0 on the outer thigh and side panels; colour 3 on the thigh stripes and shin panels; colour 2 on the waistband and panel edging.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valerian_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with thin branching vein-like lines across the legs and slashed claw-mark gashes on the outer thighs. Suggests a monstrous, wounded superhero look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valerian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leggings; colour 1 on the thin vein-like lines; colour 3 on the claw-slash marks on the thighs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valflare_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from a low hip line to the ankles, with swooping flame-like panels down each leg, a triangular front crotch panel, a scalloped back waistband, and contrasting cuffs at the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valflare_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer thigh panels and back of the hips; colour 1 on the main leg fabric and waistband scallops; colour 2 on the swooping outline trim; colour 3 on the front crotch panel and ankle cuffs.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valhex_01.description: Form-fitting superhero tights from waist to ankle, with large oval panels down the front and back of each thigh outlined in contrasting piping, a chevron at the waist, hexagonal knee pieces and separate calf panels.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valhex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer legs and waist; colour 1 on the thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the piping, knee hexagons and panel edges; colour 3 on the small waist accent.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valstar_01.description: Form-fitting superhero leggings with a V-shaped front panel at the hips, segmented scaled armor-plate panels along the outer thighs, shaped kneecap plates and shin guards over the lower legs; reaches the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valstar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main leg fabric and buttock area; colour 0 on the front hip panel, lower calves and waist trim; colour 3 on the outer thigh plates, knee plates and shin guards; colour 2 on the edging around the plates.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valvee_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with angular outlined panels on the hips and thighs, chevron stripes above the knees, rounded knee patches and contrasting shin guards down the calves.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Valvee_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg fabric; colour 1 on the waistband, hip panels and chevron stripes; colour 2 on the outlines and shin panels; colour 3 on the knee patches and the front waist accent.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Victorian_01.description: Snug, plain Victorian-style trousers with a straight waistband sitting at the hips and a front fall panel fastened by two rows of small buttons. The legs run to the ankle and fit closely.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trousers and waistband; colour 2 on the buttons.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Vigilante_01.description: Skin-tight superhero leggings running from the waist to the ankles, with large side panels down the thighs, a central strip at the crotch and bold chevron-shaped bands across the knees. The lower legs form a separate section.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer thigh and rear panels; colour 0 on the inner thigh and lower leg sections; colour 2 on the central crotch strip; colour 3 on the knee chevrons.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Vigilante_01.differs: The male tights have broader, more prominent knee chevrons with a contrasting edge line, and the crotch strip is wider.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Warrior_01.description: Form-fitting quilted tights with a diamond-stitched texture running from a contrasting waistband to the ankles, ending in angular segmented shin guards with glowing-line trim and a contrasting cuff at the base.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted leg fabric; colour 1 on the waistband and ankle cuffs; colour 2 on the shin guard plates; colour 3 on the trim lines of the shin guards.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01.description: Bare-skin leg piece with brief-style shorts and ragged, torn-flesh wounds on the thighs and knees, with sharp contrasting-edged tears and a small bone-like sliver; a decayed undead look.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the briefs; skin tone on the legs is fixed; colour 1 on the wound patches and torn edges; colour 2 on the deep hollows inside the wounds; colour 3 on the sliver in the front wound.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01.differs: The male version has sharper, darker-edged tears with deep hollows inside the wounds, while the female wounds are softer and more blended.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01_Tights.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings with an attached brief waistband, printed with ragged torn patches, stains and exposed-wound blotches on the thighs and shins. A tattered zombie look, fitted close to the legs down to the ankles.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01_Tights.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the brief waistband and its separate back panel; colour 0 on the leg fabric; colour 2 on the wound and grime patches; colour 3 on the blotchy stain spots.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Zombie_01_Tights.differs: The male version has a separate darker panel on the back of the waistband and a small yellow patch inside the wound on the front thigh.

Male/M_Hips_Tight_Zombie_Cannibal_01.description: Bare skin-look legs with brief underwear-style briefs at the hips, marked by ragged stitched scars that wrap around the thighs and calves. A gruesome zombie or cannibal look for horror characters.
Male/M_Hips_Tight_Zombie_Cannibal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the briefs; colour 1 on the stitched scar wounds and thread; the skin-toned legs do not take the colour scheme.

Male/M_Hips_Toxicsteel_01.description: Robotic leg piece: a rounded, armoured hip shell with a ruffled upper rim, plus exposed mechanical legs made of external struts, piston columns and bulky knee and ankle joints. Reads as sci-fi cyborg.
Male/M_Hips_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hip shell and its ruffled rim; colour 0 on the outer struts, knee and ankle joints and hip braces; colour 1 on the piston columns down the legs; colour 2 on the inner mechanical gaps.
Male/M_Hips_Toxicsteel_01.differs: The hip shell is a deeper, fuller pouch-like shape that covers more of the hips, and the leg struts are chunkier.

Male/M_Hips_Toxicsteel_02.description: A robotic exoskeleton leg piece: short rounded hip shorts with a ruffled, ridged waistband, and exposed mechanical legs made of jointed struts, tubes and bulky knee and ankle joints, built as a partial cyborg look.
Male/M_Hips_Toxicsteel_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hip shorts and waistband; colour 0 on the outer struts, knee joints and ankle joints; colour 1 on the tubes and inner leg panels; colour 2 on small joint gaps.

Male/M_Hips_Urban_Anime_01.description: Form-fitting ankle-length street pants with a high waistband, colour-blocked panels across the thighs and calves, and torn openings at the knees that show skin beneath. Sits at the waist with a sporty anime-inspired look.
Male/M_Hips_Urban_Anime_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, lower legs and back seat patch; colour 1 on the hip and shin panels; colour 2 on the thigh panels; skin shows through the knee rips.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Arcane_01.description: A short, hexagonal band wrapped around the upper left thigh, with raised swirling scroll patterns across its surface and a large round dome-shaped gem at the front of the outer side. The open top edge is flat.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band base; colour 3 on the raised swirl patterns; colour 1 on the round gem; colour 2 on the top opening.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Armored_01.description: A curved armored thigh guard worn on the outer left thigh, open at the top like a cup, with a raised angular panel and stepped layered edges. Suggests a sci-fi or superhero armor look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and outer rim; colour 1 on the raised panel frame; colour 2 on the inset centre of the panel; colour 3 on the thin inner border layer.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Astronaut_01.description: A curved flexible hose hanging at the left hip: ribbed segmented tubing leads to a smooth fabric-wrapped section, with a capped connector fitting on each end. Reads as an astronaut life-support line, sci-fi and mechanical.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the connector tips; colour 2 on the ribbed tubing and connector collars; colour 0 and colour 1 blend along the fabric-wrapped hose section.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Astronaut_02.description: A flexible hose attached at the left hip, hanging down the outer thigh in a U-shaped curve. It has ribbed tubing, a wrapped cloth-like middle section and a capped nozzle at each end. Suggests a sci-fi astronaut life-support line.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the nozzle tips; colour 2 on the ribbed tubing and end collars; colour 0 and colour 1 blend along the wrapped middle section.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Beast_Rhino_01.description: A thick, rounded tube-like thigh guard on the left leg, running from upper thigh to just above the knee. It has a contrasting band near the top and a faceted, angular cuff at the bottom, giving a bulky beast-like look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Beast_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh sleeve; colour 1 on the band near the top; colours 1 and 3 on the faceted cuff at the bottom.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Birdpeople_01.description: A rigid, open-sided thigh guard wrapping the back and outer left thigh, with a faceted hollow shell, a cut-out window on the front and a small strap tab with contrasting fasteners near the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole guard shell; colour 2 on the small fasteners at the lower strap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_01.description: A curved, tapering hip guard worn on the left outer thigh: a shell-like frame with a translucent inner panel, angular flared top edge and a round mechanical pod with a lens on the hip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell frame; colour 0 on the inner panel; colour 2 on the pod housing; colour 3 on the pod lens.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_02.description: A long angular blade-like armor shard hanging from the left hip along the outer thigh, tapering to a sharp point near the knee, with faceted planes and small rivet studs near the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted upper plates and lower edge; colour 1 on the top outer facet; colour 2 on the darker side panels; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_03.description: A curved armored thigh guard for the left leg: a wraparound plate shell with stepped, angular edges, a recessed front panel, and grooved slashes down the back. It sits on the outer upper thigh and suits sci-fi or superhero armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Blockbuster_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell and rim; colour 1 on the recessed front panel; colour 2 on the grooved slashes at the back; colour 3 on the small markings at the bottom edge and front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Bounty_01.description: A curved armoured thigh guard wrapping the outer left upper leg, with a thick bevelled frame, a triangular inset panel on the front, two horizontal ribs across the back and a strap around the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer frame and ribs; colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the triangular inset; colour 3 on the strap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Bounty_02.description: A curved thigh guard on the left upper leg: a wrapped shell with a thick angular frame around a window-like panel and a narrow inset strip, held by an elastic strap around the thigh. Suggests a sci-fi bounty hunter look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the frame and back shell; colour 0 on the large curved panel; colour 1 on the narrow inset strip; colour 3 on the thigh strap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Brutal_01.description: A hip-mounted armor shell for the left side: a curved, crumpled plate with jagged pointed edges and a ragged hollow opening in the middle, like a monstrous jawbone. Sits on the outer hip and upper thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shell; the hollow inside is shadow and takes no colour.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy, open-topped cardboard-style carton worn on the outer left thigh, hanging like a hip-mounted box with flat angular panels and a rim at the top. It has a playful, improvised, mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the side and back panels; colour 1 on the top interior and the curved patches and corner sections; colour 2 on the large front panel; colour 3 on the small angled patch near the front edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Chains_01.description: A length of heavy chain wrapped in several tight spiral coils around the left upper thigh, with chunky rectangular links. The stacked loops sit close together, giving a rugged, restrained look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 on the recessed gaps inside the links.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Chains_01.differs: The male chain coils are tighter and more closely stacked, forming a compact band on the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_01.description: A small cluster of three narrow cloth streamers curling out from the outer lower leg near the calf, with small studs along the strips and pointed tips; a loose, flared, punky accent.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the streamer strips; colour 3 on the pointed tips and the small stud dots.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_01.differs: The male streamers splay outward more, with slimmer tips on the upper two and a larger diamond tip only on the lowest.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_02.description: A cluster of three long, curved blade-like flares hanging down the outside of the left lower leg near the ankle, each tapering to a sharp tip with small studs along its length and diamond-shaped pointed ends.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Coat_Flair_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved flare bodies; colour 3 on the diamond-shaped tips and the small studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Mutated_01.description: Three separate curved horn-like spikes attached along the outer left thigh and knee, graduated in size with a large curved claw nearest the knee. Bony monstrous accents that sit off the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Mutated_01.differs: The male spikes are broader and more curved, with the largest one a thicker, hooked horn than on the female.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Mutated_02.description: A cluster of three curved, pointed horn-like spikes on the outer left leg: one larger, thick-based spike near the thigh-knee and two small thorns trailing down the shin. Monstrous, partial leg accent.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Scarab_01.description: A slender curved horn or spike hanging from the left hip along the upper thigh, tapering to a sharp point, with a band at the tip and a pointed end. Suggests a mechanical insectoid or monstrous accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long curved shaft; colour 2 on the band near the tip; colour 3 on the pointed tip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Scarab_02.description: A curved scarab-style pincer or tail worn at the left hip, arcing down along the outer thigh. A segmented, spined armored hook ends in a contrasting tip, and a ringed stinger points up from the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved hook body and spines; colour 0 on the hook tip; colour 2 on the ring joint at the base of the stinger; colour 3 on the stinger.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Tight_Ascendan.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical rings around a central hub, hovering against the outer side of the left thigh like a badge. Thin, wire-like construction with a sci-fi feel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Tight_Ascendan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rings and central hub; colour 1 on the thin edge outline of the rings.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Tight_Strapped.description: A small boxy rectangular pouch with rounded padded faces and a flap over the top, edged in contrasting trim. A vertical strap runs down its side, with a round button-like stud on the flap. It sits at the left hip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Tight_Strapped.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and vertical strap; colour 3 on the round stud.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Vigilante_01.description: A small rectangular pouch with rounded top corners, worn on the outer left thigh beside the hip. It has a flap fastened by a round snap and a contrasting tab hanging down the back; a practical vigilante utility style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the hanging tab; colour 3 on the round snap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Vigilante_02.description: A pair of small rectangular flap-topped pouches sitting side by side on the outer left hip and upper thigh, boxy and softly padded, in a tactical utility style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Child_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both pouches and their flaps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A angular armored thigh guard for the left leg: a shell of faceted plates wraps the outer thigh, with a raised panel on the front, a separate side plate and jagged pointed edges at the lower hem.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main front and lower shell plates; colour 0 on the raised edge panels and trim; colour 3 on the side plate insert; colour 2 on the jagged lower tips and small notches.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Corrupted_01.description: A single hip-mounted armour panel hanging down the outer left thigh, made of stacked jagged plates with curved contrasting spikes along the rear edge and a ragged, bat-wing-like outline. Suggests a monstrous, mechanical fantasy look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate edges and upper plate; colour 3 on the inset stripe panels; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 2 on the inner lining and outline.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cosmic_01.description: A chunky octagonal cuff worn around the left upper thigh, with narrow raised rims at top and bottom and smooth, slightly glossy angled panels. Reads as a sleek sci-fi leg band.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main body of the band; colour 0 on the upper rim edge; colour 1 on a glossy side panel and the lower rim.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cosmic_01.differs: The male band has smoother, larger plain panels, without the triangular facets seen across the female band's front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_01.description: A glossy, sculpted leg shell wrapping the outer left thigh down to just below the knee, with curved raised ridges along the front edge and a pointed flared top at the hip. Sleek and armour-like.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the raised curved ridge and edge trim. The glossy material largely ignores the other slots.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_02.description: A tapered, open-topped thigh guard worn on the left outer hip, made of curved segmented plates with swooping raised ribs on the upper front and a glossy hollow interior. Its angular, armored look suggests sci-fi.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell of the guard; colour 1 on the raised swooping ribs and edge trim; colour 3 on the inset slits at the front; colour 0 on the glossy inner lining, which is reflective.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Cosmos_02.differs: The male version has several stacked contrasting inset slits down the front, where the female version shows mostly a single slit.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dharmor_01.description: A segmented armored thigh guard on the left leg: a short open-topped sleeve with a large front plate, a thin contrasting band across the middle, and stacked angled plates wrapping the back of the thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front and side plates; colour 3 on the middle band and the upper back plate; colour 2 on the middle back plate; colour 0 on the lower back plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dharmor_Hoses_01.description: A mechanical thigh guard for the left leg: a boxy armored shell with bolted plates, a small knee-side cap below, and a thick ribbed hose that loops up past the hip to a capped end, held by a strap.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dharmor_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell rims and edging; colour 2 on the front plates, strap and hose end cap; colour 1 on the inner side panel; colour 3 on the ribbed hose.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Draco_01.description: A short armored thigh band wrapping the left upper leg: a rounded plate cuff with a tall pointed fin rising at the back, a raised central spine panel at the front, and edging bands at top and bottom.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cap, pointed fin and edging bands; colour 3 on the front spine panel; colour 0 on the side plates; colour 2 on the lower band and panel outlines.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Draco_01.differs: The top cap and rear fin use colour 1 on the male version, while the female version uses colour 3 there.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_01.description: A thigh-side hip attachment of overlapping jagged bark-like plates with ragged upper edges, wrapping the outer left thigh. A rough mossy patch covers the front and back, giving a wild dryad or forest guardian look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bark plates; colour 1 on the mossy patches; colour 3 on the thin cracks and veins between the plates.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_02.description: A small organic hip ornament of two curved, horn-like thorny growths joined at a lumpy base, hanging at the left hip beside the thigh. It has a gnarled, bark-like texture and suggests a woodland creature style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the lumpy surface; colour 0 on the tips and the patches along the ridges.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A single-sided thigh guard of overlapping bark-like plates with jagged upper edges and thin vein lines, patched with a rough mossy growth. It hangs over the outer left thigh to about mid-thigh, in a wild forest-guardian style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bark plates; colour 1 on the rough mossy patches; colour 3 on the thin vein lines.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_01.description: A cluster of glossy, flame-shaped tendrils attached at the left hip and hanging down the outer thigh, with jagged licking tips and a rippled, twisted surface. Suggests an elemental fire or monstrous accent.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Default glossy material largely ignores the colour scheme; most of the flames show a reflective sheen, with only faint hints of colour 1 and colour 3 in the ripples.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_01.differs: The male flames are longer and more streamlined, with taller tips reaching up the hip and a narrower body.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_02.description: A glossy, flame-shaped hip accessory on the left thigh: a curved shell of jagged, licking tongues that sweeps from the hip down the outer thigh, ending in ragged points. Fantasy elemental style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: The default material is glossy and largely ignores the scheme; it shows mostly one tone with faint reflections, so no clear colour slot is visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Element_Water_01.description: A glossy, wave-like hip and thigh accessory of layered swooping fins and curling tendrils that hang down the outer left thigh to just above the knee, giving a liquid, monstrous elemental look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows one uniform sheen, with slight tint variation only from reflections.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Element_Water_02.description: A glossy, wing-like sheet of swept, rippling fins attached at the left hip and hanging down the outer thigh, ending in ragged points with small curled tendrils at the top. A fantasy, elemental look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Element_Water_02.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; faint hints of colour 3 show in the fold recesses.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Falcon_01.description: A left thigh guard: a tall tapered armour shell wrapping the thigh, with a pointed lower edge, a lower cuff band and a jagged winged fin rising along the outer side to a crest gem. Fantasy-mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the edge trim and bands; colour 2 on the spiked outer fin and top surface; colour 3 on the crest gem and small band gem.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: Two slender, curved fin-like blades stacked down the outer left leg, one at the thigh and one at the calf, each with frilled, feathery jagged edges sweeping upward. Suggests an aquatic, amphibian creature look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer edges and frilled rims of the fins; colour 1 on the inner centre of each fin. Colours 0 and 2 are not visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Frigid_01.description: A curved hip and thigh guard for the left side: a rigid shell with a bordered edge, a banded top rim and a pleated, ribbed centre panel, hanging from the hip to the upper thigh. It looks like sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed pleated centre panel; colour 1 on the banded top rim and the border around the panel; colour 2 on the outer shell and the outer edge trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Gamer_01.description: A hip-mounted arcade-style control panel: a slanted rectangular box with rows of round buttons, short bars of markings and a ball-topped joystick, hanging at the left hip beside the hand like a portable game console.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box casing; colour 1 on the joystick stem and ball; colour 2 on the round buttons; colour 3 on the short bar markings.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Gladiator_01.description: A single angular hip guard plate hanging from the left hip: a tapering shield-like slab with a bordered edge, a recessed centre panel with a slashed inset, and a flared cap over the top. Suggests sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top cap and outer shell; colour 0 on the inner centre panel; colour 2 on the raised border; colour 3 on the slashed inset.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Heraldry_01.description: A curved armored thigh guard worn on the left leg: a broad shield-like plate with a contrasting rim, a heraldic blade emblem on the front, and a layered cuff with a small hanging tag just above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and the cuff band; colour 2 on the rim, top edge and knee cap piece; colour 3 on the front emblem and small details; colour 1 on the panel at the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Heraldry_01.differs: The male guard has a flatter, wider knee cap piece with a smaller contrasting panel that sits higher on the leg.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Holohex_01.description: A cluster of flat, angular hexagonal shards floating around the left lower leg, stacked from below the knee to the ankle with small spiky fragments jutting outward. Suggests a holographic or energy field accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shard cluster; the piece appears as a single flat tone, so other slots are not visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Holster_Bounty_01.description: A slim, open-framed holster on the left hip and thigh: a tapered pouch with a looped guard, a narrow flared handle tab pointing upward, and a contrasting strap band around the middle. Suggests a sci-fi gunslinger look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Holster_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body, loop and tab; colour 1 on the strap band across the middle; colour 3 on a tiny tip accent at the top.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Hoses_01.description: A cluster of segmented, ribbed flexible hoses hanging from the left hip along the outer thigh, curving downward in open-ended loops. Reads as mechanical or tentacle-like, a partial accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all of the hose segments.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Inmate_01.description: A small knee-level guard: a flat, angular shield plate with a bordered edge, held against the front of the left leg by a wide strap that wraps around the limb. Suggests a utilitarian prison-issue or sporty look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the encircling strap; colour 2 on the plate's border edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Ironclad_01.description: A angular armored hip plate mounted on the left outer thigh: stacked segmented bands with jutting ridged edges and a flared rim, forming a chunky mechanical guard hanging down the upper leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the raised ridges and rim edges; colour 0 on the top panel; colour 1 on the middle panel; colour 2 on the lower panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Kaiju_01.description: A side hip and thigh guard of layered, overlapping armour plates that curve around the outer left thigh, with a longer segmented panel hanging below and curved contrasting horns sweeping up from the hip. Monstrous, mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the lower hanging panel; colour 2 on the horns and spikes.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Knight_01.description: A curved thigh plate worn on the outer left thigh, with a scratched, weathered surface tapering toward the knee, held on by two thin round straps that wrap around the leg. Suggests medieval knightly armour.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate; colour 2 on the two leg straps. The plate also shows a pinkish gradient shading, and no separate border trim is visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Knight_02.description: A curved plate guard worn on the outer left thigh, tapering toward the knee, with a row of conical spikes along its outer edge and two thin octagonal straps that wrap around the leg. Suggests a brutal knight or monster look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and spikes; colour 2 on the two thigh straps. Colour 1 and colour 3 are not clearly visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_01.description: A single hip and thigh guard hanging from the left hip: a curved armor panel with a gridded lattice pattern, scrolled trim along the lower edge and a pointed lower tip. Suggests martial-arts fantasy armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and scrollwork trim; colour 2 on the lattice-filled panel fields; colour 1 on the inner lining.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The male version has a shorter, blunter panel with the ornate lattice and scrollwork clearly visible from the front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_02.description: A beast-head hip ornament on the left hip: a snarling wolf or dragon face with swept-back spiky mane and a fan of curved tusk-like spines, mounted on a ring-shaped base. Fierce martial-arts fantasy look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the head, mane and base; colour 0 on the curved spines and brow markings; colour 2 on the darker spine tips; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_01.description: Three separate octagonal bands stacked down the left leg: a wide thick band on the upper thigh, a thin band above the knee and a chunky band just below the knee. Simple, segmented cuffs with a jester-like feel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outside of the upper thigh band; colour 1 on its inner lining and on the middle band; colour 2 on the lower knee band, with colour 1 on its inner lining.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_02.description: A set of three separate bands stacked down the left thigh: a wrapped, creased cuff high up, a thin flat strap below it and a chunky octagonal band above the knee, with small studs.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped upper cuff; colour 1 on the middle strap; colour 2 on the lower octagonal band; colour 3 on the studs.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Madjester_02.differs: The male cuff is shorter with no visible lining beneath it, and the middle strap is wider and spaced further from the cuff.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_01.description: A boxy mechanical hip pod worn on the outer left thigh: a chamfered block with a contrasting vertical slot, a raised back plate, and a round domed disc with a segmented ring mounted at the rear.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box body and back plate; colour 1 on the round domed disc; colour 3 on the ring around the disc; colour 2 on the vertical slot.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_01.differs: The round disc is larger and sits higher on the back plate, so it is visible from the front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_02.description: A boxy, faceted mechanical hip pod mounted on the outer left thigh: an open-topped angular casing with a tall, raised back plate and a slot beneath. It gives a sci-fi armoured, mecha look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and lower plating; colour 1 on the tall back plate and upper rim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A curved armored hip-and-thigh plate on the left leg, wrapping the outer side and reaching mid-thigh, with a raised padded panel, thin contrasting piping, a small round fastener at the top and a thick trimmed lower edge. Modern sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 1 on the raised padded panel; colour 3 on the thin piping line; colour 2 on the lower edge band and top flared rim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Moth_01.description: A single curved wing-like panel hanging from the left hip down the outer thigh, tapering to a ragged point near the knee. It has a thin raised edge along the top and a soft, membranous look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the panel and its raised edge; colour 3 on the lower part of the panel, blending from colour 0 toward the hem.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_01.description: A lumpy, muscular-looking fleshy growth clinging to the outer thigh, tapering to a pointed tip near the knee, with bony spikes along the front and small contrasting and small round spots on the surface.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fleshy growth; colour 0 on the bony spikes; colour 1 on the small round spots on the back; colour 2 on the small opening at the front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_02.description: A mutated organic growth on the outer left thigh: a bulky, lumpy fleshy shell rising to a horn-like point at the hip and tapering to a claw-like tip below, with a large bony spike and small spurs.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy shell; colour 0 on the large spike and small spurs; colour 2 on the nodules at the front; colour 1 on the small nodules at the back.
