Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Mutated_02.differs: The male growth is shorter and bulkier, with a prominent large spike on the front and a wider body sitting mid-thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Newholster_01.description: A small western-style holster pouch on the outer thigh: a tall, open-topped flat case with a wedge-shaped mouth, a cross strap with a large buckle, and swirling scroll ornamentation on the face.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Newholster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body; colour 1 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle and scroll ornament.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Persian_Sword_01.description: A curved Persian-style sword hanging at the left hip in a rectangular clip mount, with a wrapped grip, a heavy round pommel with a central jewel, and a blade that sweeps down and hooks at the tip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Persian_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 1 on the hip clip mount; colour 2 on the grip wrap and pommel; colour 3 on the pommel jewel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Persian_Sword_01.differs: The sword angles more diagonally away from the hip, with a longer-looking blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Pirate_Fancy_Gun.description: A flintlock-style pistol worn at the left hip, hanging muzzle-down: a curved, bulbous grip with an inset side plate, a banded collar, a slim barrel with ring details and a flared muzzle tip, plus a thin rod along the side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Pirate_Fancy_Gun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved grip and barrel sections; colour 2 on the grip cap, side plate, lower barrel and muzzle; colour 1 on the collar band; colour 3 on the thin rod along the side.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Pirate_Fancy_Sword.description: A rapier hanging at the left hip: a long thin blade points down toward the ankle, with a swept cage guard of looping bars, crossed quillon arms and a small pommel at the top. Pirate swashbuckler style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Pirate_Fancy_Sword.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the looping hand guard; colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the crossed quillons and grip; colour 1 on the pommel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A hip-mounted armor cluster on the left thigh: overlapping angular plates and tall pointed shards fanning upward, with a shield-like plate at the lower front. Its crystalline, dragon-like form suggests a sci-fi or fantasy look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the plates and shards; the material appears to ignore the other colour slots, so nothing else shows clearly.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Pumpkin_01.description: A cage of curved bone-like ribs wrapped around the left thigh, joined by a vertical spine-like ridge at the back and front. Open gaps between the ribs show the leg beneath; a skeletal, macabre look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spine ridge and alternating rib segments; colour 1 on the front spine and many rib segments; colour 2 on some rib tips and segments; colour 3 on a few ribs at the outer thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Punk_01.description: A punk thigh harness of two buckled straps that wrap around the upper and lower left thigh, joined by a thin vertical strap running up toward the hip. Both straps are studded with round dots.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 3 on the round studs; colour 2 on the buckles.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Qularr_Armor_03.description: A thigh guard worn on the left outer thigh: overlapping angular armor plates on the front with stacked horizontal segments around the back, forming an open-backed cuff. Suggests alien or monstrous plated armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Qularr_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the plate edges and rim; colour 2 on the darker gaps between the stacked segments.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Renegade_Straps_01.description: A column of six evenly sized flat straps stacked down the outer left thigh, each a curved band with a small rivet and an overlapping tab. They sit open on the leg, suggesting a sci-fi renegade look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Renegade_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the small rivets and the tab ends.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Renegade_Straps_01.differs: The male straps are evenly sized and closely spaced down the thigh, while the female set is spaced further apart and tapers toward the knee.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky armored thigh guard worn on the left upper leg: a hollow, tapered shell of angular faceted plates with a contrasting band around the top and a hexagonal gem-like stud near the back.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the interior lining at the top rim; colour 1 on the upper band and side panel; colour 2 on the main faceted plates; colour 3 on the hexagonal stud.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A curved metal thigh guard worn on the left upper leg: a broad shell wrapping the outer thigh, with a rolled rim at the top and a tapered lower edge. A recessed vertical panel with a pointed bracket motif runs down the outer side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the top rim; colour 1 on the outlined inset panel border; colour 3 on the small ribbed detail inside the panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Retrosteelhead_01.differs: The male guard is shorter and sits lower on the thigh, with a flatter, less flared top edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Ripper_01.description: A cybernetic hip implant: an angular plate mounted at the left hip with two segmented, ribbed cable-like tendrils that curl down the outer thigh in loops. It gives a mechanical, monstrous look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular hip plate; colour 2 on the segmented tendrils; colour 3 on the thin stripes running along the tendrils and the small mechanism on the plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Robotsamurai_01.description: A hanging hip guard of overlapping segmented armor plates, like samurai kusazuri, tapering to a point down the outer left thigh. Broad upper plate with smaller stacked lames below suggests a robotic samurai look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate faces and lame edges; colour 1 on the upper plate panels and lame borders; colour 2 on the long upper plate strip and lower lames; colour 3 on small accent pieces between the plates.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Sacred_01.description: A curved, shield-like hip plate that wraps over the outer left thigh, with a raised edge border, a contrasting scaled or feathered emblem panel on each face, and small round studs at the corners. It suggests fantasy armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the raised border trim; colour 2 on the scaled emblem panel; colour 3 on the small gem-like accents and studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Sandstorm_01.description: A curved thigh guard wrapping the left upper leg, a smooth open-topped sleeve with contrasting edging, a notched lower hem, and raised swooping raised strips and hooked panels on the front and back. Sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the raised hooked panels; colour 3 on the slanted raised strips; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Sandstorm_02.description: A single tapered thigh guard worn on the outer left thigh, a curved plate with a bevelled lower edge and a pointed lower panel, held by two thin straps that wrap around the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the pointed lower panel; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_01.description: A narrow armoured thigh guard hanging from the left hip, made of a curved outer plate with a contrasting inner lining, a pointed spur at the front and a blunt cap at the lower end. It has a sleek, insect-like superhero look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge outlines; colour 3 on the pointed front spur; colour 1 on the lower cap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_02.description: A left-thigh armour guard: a rounded, cuff-like upper band with a raised contrasting spike at the hip, over a tapered plate that ends in a pointed hem, with curved fin-like accents down the side and a padded panel at the back.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper band and the hem edge; colour 0 on the main thigh plate; colour 1 on the curved side fins; colour 3 on the hip spike and the back panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_Alt_01.description: A single curved, tapering scarab-style claw hanging from the left hip along the upper thigh, with a smooth hooked upper end and a pointed tip set off by a contrasting collar band. Mechanical, insectoid look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long curved shaft; colour 2 on the collar band at the base of the tip; colour 3 on the pointed claw tip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_Alt_02.description: A curved, hook-like scarab claw worn on the left hip and thigh: a pointed segmented tip at the hip, a small collar joint, then a long tapering arm with barbed spines that curls around the thigh to a contrasting claw tip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Scarab_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the pointed upper tip; colour 2 on the joint ring; colour 1 on the curved arm and barbed spines; colour 0 on the claw tip at the lower end.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Spikysuit_01.description: A lumpy, bone-like armor growth on the outer left thigh: a rounded mass with several short spikes along its top edge and ribbed, fin-like ridges hanging down its lower half. Suggests a monstrous, organic look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spikes; colour 1 on the ridged streaks along the lower ribbing.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Spooky_01.description: A narrow, jagged ridge of overlapping shard-like spines running down the outer left hip and thigh, tapering to a point near the knee, with small eye-like studs near the top; monstrous, beastly styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper spines and ridge; colour 1 on the lower spines toward the tip; colour 3 on the small eye-like spots.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Spy_01.description: A futuristic spy pistol worn on a thigh strap: an octagonal padded band circles the upper leg, with a boxy pistol with ribbed grip and a long ribbed suppressor barrel hanging down the outer thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and casing; colour 1 on the top of the strap plate, grip ribs and barrel sections; colour 2 on the strap band and underside; colour 3 on the thin stripes and small sights.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Starhawk_01.description: A left thigh accessory of two octagonal plates stacked around the upper leg and joined by thin looping bands, with a pointed blade-like fin and a faceted gem-like spike at the outer side. A superhero armour look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two octagonal plates and the lower fin edge; colour 0 on the central blade-shaped fin; colour 3 on the faceted spike; colour 2 on the connecting bands.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Starhawk_02.description: A left thigh armor accessory: a large angular plated cap on the outer upper thigh with layered edging, joined by a slim curved strip to a small chevron-shaped plate above the knee. Sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cap and the lower chevron plate; colour 0 on the connecting strip; colour 3 on the stripe between the layers; colour 2 on the darker top edge and underside trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Steelarachnid_01.description: A rigid armoured thigh guard on the left leg: a curved shell wrapping the upper thigh with a pointed peak at the hip, slotted vents with inset panels, and a jagged lower edge above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the inset panels in the vent slots; colour 2 on the rim, peak and outer side; colour 3 on the small marks near the lower edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Steelcommando_01.description: A single armored thigh guard for the left leg: a raised front plate over a broad, curved shell that wraps the outer thigh, with a lower band and short pointed tips above the knee. Mechanical, retro-military look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised front plate; colour 2 on the main shell and lower band; colour 0 on the thin edge highlights along the rim.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male guard is wider and more rounded, with shorter tips at the bottom edge and a bulkier shell that sits higher on the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Super_Retro_Destroye.description: A single curved, shield-like metal plate that hangs off the left hip and upper thigh, tapering to a point at the bottom. It is hollow and open on the inner side, with a thin lighter rim, in a retro superhero style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Super_Retro_Destroye.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate surface; colour 1 on the lower tip shading; colour 2 on the hollow interior; colour 0 on the rim edge. The glossy metal finish mostly ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Symbiote_01.description: A curved, shield-like plate on the outer left hip and thigh, with a recessed oval centre holding a pair of pointed pyramid studs. Its organic-mechanical look suits a monstrous, symbiote style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer curved plate; colour 1 on the recessed oval centre; colour 3 on the pyramid studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Draycul_0.description: A small plate-armor guard for the outer left thigh: a pointed shield-shaped upper plate over a wider curved lower plate with a bordered rim and small rivets, held by two thick octagonal straps that ring the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Draycul_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 1 on the plate borders and rims; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Rockcryst.description: A cluster of chunky, faceted rock slabs with thin glowing cracks, attached at the left hip and hanging down the outer thigh as long tapering shards. It has a jagged, monstrous stone look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Rockcryst.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock surfaces; colour 3 on the cracks between the stone facets.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Thigharmor_Rockcryst.differs: The male rocks hang as longer, more pointed shards that reach further down the thigh, with the lower chunk set farther from the upper mass.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.description: A thigh-mounted utility band on the left upper leg: a segmented octagonal strap carrying a large flap pouch, a row of ammo cartridges, a small vented box and upright buckle tabs. Tactical, retro-military style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and strap; colour 1 on the pouch, flap and tabs; colour 2 on the vented box and fittings; colour 3 on the cartridges and small round studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A chunky faceted band worn around the left upper thigh, with an octagonal cross-section, rounded disc bumps on the outer side and a contrasting top edge. Suggests a retro superhero or mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band body and the round discs; colour 1 on the upper rim and the inner top edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Alien_01.description: A hip-mounted armor plate on the left thigh: a curved, shield-like shell with a pointed chevron lower edge, layered in three bands, studded with sharp crystalline spikes across the top. Suggests alien or monstrous armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shell; colour 3 on the spikes and small stud; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 1 on the lower chevron band.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Alien_02.description: A small rounded kneepad shell with two inset oval panels and a raised rim, topped by a thick curved band that arcs over the top of the knee. Sits on the left knee with a sleek, alien-armor look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the two inset oval panels; colour 2 on the curved band across the top.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ammo_Cartridge.description: A thigh band of upright ammunition cartridges with pointed tips hanging below a flat strap, plus a cluster of boxy magazine pouches with contrasting panels on the outer side of the left upper leg. Tactical, military look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ammo_Cartridge.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap and cartridge bands; colour 1 on the cartridge casings; colour 2 on the bullet tips and pouch panels; colour 3 on the pouch frames and thin lines around the band.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ammo_Cartridge.differs: The male version shows three magazine pouches in a row from the front, whereas the female version has two.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A small hip guard on the left thigh made of two stacked, overlapping curved plates with thick bevelled rims, forming a shield-like armoured flap that hangs from the hip over the upper thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 2 on the thick rims and edges of the plates.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: A set of three curved, blade-like fins that sweep down and back from the left hip and upper thigh, each with a contrasting edge. They stack like claw slashes and suggest an aquatic or monstrous look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top fin; colour 1 on the middle fin; colour 0 on the lowest fin; colour 2 on the edging.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armor_Ancienta.description: A tapered thigh plate worn on the outer left thigh, split by narrow vertical slits and carved with swirling angular spiral patterns, held on by two rigid octagonal bands that wrap fully around the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armor_Ancienta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the carved spiral line patterns; colour 2 on the weathered speckled patches; colour 3 on the two encircling bands.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armored_01.description: A mechanical hip-mounted frame: a tall, teardrop-shaped armor plate with an open oval cutout, standing off the outer thigh and ending at the knee in a small housing with two contrasting wheels.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame plate; colour 2 on the wheels; colour 1 on the small hubs at the wheel centres.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorninja.description: A small angular armour guard wrapped around the left upper thigh just above the knee, made of faceted plates with a curved central panel and a sharp pointed upper edge. Suggests ninja or sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper edge plates and inner rim; colour 1 on the large central curved panel; colour 2 on the rear and outer side plates; colour 3 on the lower accent flap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_02.description: A small angular kneepad plate worn on the outer side of the left knee: a faceted, shield-like shell with pointed top and bottom tips and a raised central ridge, hollow behind. Suggests armored sci-fi or monstrous gear.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the pointed upper and lower tip panels.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_Thi.description: A segmented armored thigh guard for the left leg: a faceted, curved shell over the outer thigh with an open, hollow back, small vent slits and angled trim at the top and knee ends. Suggests sci-fi or monstrous armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Armorviper_Thi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell; colour 1 on the corner tabs and the inner side panel; colour 3 on the small vent slits.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A curved, shield-shaped thigh plate worn on the outer left upper leg, with a bevelled rim, a notched lower edge and an atom emblem on its face. Suggests a superhero or sci-fi armour accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the main panel face.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A single draped cloth swag hanging from two round medallion anchors on the left hip, one at the front and one at the back, with a loose trailing tail of fabric ending near mid-thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped cloth; colour 1 on the medallion rims; colour 3 on the star-shaped centres of the medallions.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bandtied_01.description: A narrow cloth band wrapped around the upper thigh and knotted at the side, with two short pointed tails hanging down from the knot. Reads as a simple garter or bandage-style leg accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bandtied_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band, knot and tails; the tails fade toward a darker tip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer_0.description: A short, plain tapered greave that wraps the lower left leg above the ankle, with an octagonal rim at the top and bottom edge. The smooth, simple shell suggests a light monster-hunter or fantasy armour piece.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main greave shell; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim bands.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer_S.description: A monstrous armored calf bracer: a tapered octagonal cuff with contrasting trim, a raised cross-shaped plate on the outer front and a large curved scythe-like blade sweeping back from the side of the lower leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Beast_Bracer_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 1 on the rim and edge trim; colour 3 on the cross plate; colour 2 on the curved blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_L.description: A tapered, open-topped armoured bracer worn around the lower leg just above the ankle, with a rim of contrasting trim and a large angular cross-shaped plate mounted on the outer front.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_L.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bracer shell; colour 1 on the rim edging and the framing around the front; colour 3 on the large cross plate.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bracer_Angel_L.differs: The male bracer has a pitted, worn surface texture on its shell, while the female one is smooth and plain.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bucklestraps_0.description: Three separate studded straps stacked around the left upper thigh, each closing with a small buckle block on the outer side. A casual, street or punk-style leg accessory that sits loosely on the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Bucklestraps_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the buckle blocks.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cartridges_01.description: Two thin bands wrap the left upper thigh, holding a wide block of three upright cartridge cases with bevelled edges and recessed contrasting panels on the outer side of the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cartridges_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two thigh straps; colour 1 on the cartridge casings; colour 2 on the recessed panels of the cartridges.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cartridges_01.differs: The male version has a wider block that looks like three cartridges, whereas the female has only two.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cowboy_Lasso_0.description: A coiled twisted-rope lasso hanging at the left hip, with several loops of thick braided rope and a small knotted loop at one end. A western accessory that hangs beside the thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cowboy_Lasso_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole rope coil and knot; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: Two angular armoured plates strapped to the left leg: a larger curved guard on the outer upper thigh and a smaller shield-like plate just below the knee, with small rivets and a glossy, sleek finish.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 1 on a recessed inner panel along the edge of each plate; colour 2 on the underside and edges. The glossy finish partly ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.description: A bolted armour shell worn on the outer left thigh: a curved, open-backed plate with angular edges, hex bolt heads at the corners, a ridged inner lining and a heavy lower band. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 0 on the ridged inner lining and upper edge; colour 2 on the lower band; colour 3 on the bolts.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Defender_01.description: A small diamond-shaped kneepad worn on the front of the left knee: a faceted, pyramid-like shell with a raised ridge and a curved crescent marking, with a hollowed underside against the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 3 on the crescent marking; colour 1 on the inner back surface.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Defender_01.differs: The male pad is a deeper, more bulging diamond that stands further off the knee, with a dished back.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Deity_01.description: A curved, shield-like thigh guard worn on the outer left thigh: a smooth rounded shell with a contrasting front panel, a flared rear edge that extends past the leg, and a hollow open top. Suggests sleek sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and rear flared edge; colour 1 on the main front panel; colour 2 on the recessed side gap at the back.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Electric.description: A hexagonal armored thigh plate worn on the outer left thigh, with a segmented lower band, bolted panel and three coil-like electrode posts on the outside, plus a thick flexible cable arching over the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Electric.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and the rim; colour 1 on the ribbed lower band; colour 3 on the coil windings of the electrodes; colour 2 on the cable, bolts and electrode caps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Fincalf_01.description: A small fin-shaped calf accessory: a flat spotted panel on the outer left calf with three swept-back pointed fin blades and a long trailing tip at the lower back. Suggests aquatic or monstrous styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Fincalf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spotted panel surface; colour 3 on the spots; colour 1 on the fin blades and edge trim; colour 2 in the shaded stripes between the fins.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Fincalf_02.description: A small fin-like calf accessory on the outer left lower leg: a flat speckled membrane panel ribbed by three swept-back curved fins with pointed tips, giving a monstrous aquatic look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Fincalf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the speckled membrane panel; colour 1 on the fin ribs and edge trim; colour 3 on the spots; colour 2 on the shading between the fins.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_01.description: A small monstrous fin attached to the outer left thigh: a tapered membrane panel with several swept-back spiny ribs, mottled with spots, sitting flat against the side of the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fin ribs and edges; colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 2 shading at the panel bases; colour 3 on the spots.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_01.differs: The male fin is shorter and wider, with the ribs fanning out more sharply and angled backward.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_02.description: A fin-like thigh accessory on the outer left thigh: a stack of swept, membrane-like panels with sharp pointed spines along the edges, angled diagonally down the leg. Suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Finthigh_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiny edge ribs and outer rims; colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 3 on the speckled markings; colour 2 on the shaded diagonal bands.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Flower_01.description: A leg band of intertwined vine-like tendrils wrapped around the left thigh, with a large layered flower of pointed petals at the outer side and small leaf-like blades along the loops. Fantasy nature-inspired accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vines and many petals; colour 0 on the vine ends and some petal tips; colour 2 on the flower centre petals and leaf accents; colour 3 on the thin accent vines.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Furpads_01.description: A fur hip pad on the left outer hip: a flat, slightly curved backing plate covered in long, shaggy, pointed fur strands that hang down over the upper thigh. It suggests a beastly or savage look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Furpads_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur strands; colour 0 on the flat backing plate and its edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A curved armour plate strapped to the outer left thigh, with a bordered rim, rivets and cracked surface lines, a riveted rear panel, and several cone spikes projecting outward. Gladiator-style and aggressive.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the rim and outer shell; colour 2 on the rear riveted panel; colour 3 on the spikes and crack lines.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The male version has a larger, broader plate with more spikes, and the contrasting riveted panel sits mostly behind the plate rather than at the front edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Golden_Age_Sta.description: Two raised, flat-faced five-pointed stars of different sizes clustered down the outer side of the left thigh, standing slightly proud of the leg. A small superhero emblem accent in a golden-age style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Golden_Age_Sta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both stars; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Golden_Age_Sta.differs: The two stars sit closer together, nearly touching, and higher on the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A left-leg accessory of angular, segmented armour plates wrapping the outer thigh, with a curved lower band above the knee and stacked shell panels at the hip. It has a sleek mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer and rear plates; colour 0 on the plate edges, upper hip pieces and lower band; colour 2 on the inner panels; colour 3 on small accent patches near the lower edge.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: This version shows solid coloured armour plates with contrasting accents, whereas the female version has a glowing energy-web surface.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowboy_.description: An empty western-style thigh holster on the left leg: a tall open-topped pouch sits at the outer thigh, attached to a thin octagonal leg loop, with a row of rivets at the mouth and a rounded central panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowboy_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster top band, lower cap and central panel; colour 0 on the middle section and the leg loop edge; colour 2 on the rivets and inner holster side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowboy_.differs: The male holster has only a thin flat strap-like blade extending forward from the loop, and the pouch sits higher on the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowboy_.description: An empty open-topped western holster shell worn on the left outer thigh: a tapered, angular boxy pouch with a band of rivets near the rim, a rounded central plate and contrasting banding.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holstercowboy_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper band, rounded plate, lower band and outer side; colour 0 on the middle sections and rim; colour 2 on the rivets.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holsterpistol_.description: A thigh holster on the left leg holding a pistol, with a long rigid case hanging along the outer thigh and two thin straps wrapping around the leg. The pistol grip and hammer stick out at the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Holsterpistol_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster case and the leg straps; colour 0 on the pistol's slide section showing above the case; colour 3 on the pistol grip and upper body; colour 2 on the small trigger and hammer details.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Knife_01.description: A thigh-mounted combat knife hanging from a flat, angular octagonal band worn high on the left thigh. The blade is broad and pointed with a small hole near the tip and a blocky handle with a crossguard.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band; colour 2 on the handle and crossguard; colour 3 on the blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Light_01.description: A side hip-and-thigh panel made of overlapping tiers of leaf-shaped plates with raised rims and jagged lower points. It hangs from the outer left hip down the thigh, in a fantasy armor style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate surfaces; colour 0 on the raised rims and edging between the leaf sections.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Light_01.differs: The male version hangs longer and narrower down the outer thigh, with pointed tips trailing lower.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.description: Two separate angular band cuffs stacked on the left thigh: an upper stepped, zigzag-edged band and a lower thinner band with a small tab flap at the front. Mechanical armour-like styling, sitting mid-thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band body; colour 1 on the upper band's edge trim; colour 2 on the lower band body; colour 3 on the lower band's edge trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A curved plate guard worn on the outer left thigh, dented and scratched, with a few slotted screw-like fasteners. It is held by two thin straps with square buckles wrapping the thigh. Rugged, monstrous-mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate; colour 2 on the two thigh straps; colour 3 on the buckles and slotted fasteners.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A cluster of narrow, angular plates fanned around the outer left thigh, like overlapping mechanical blades or armor slats, hanging from the hip to above the knee. Suggests a robotic, sci-fi leg accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light outer plates; colour 1 on the large curved plates; colour 2 on the darker edge plates; colour 3 on the small band near the lower plate ends.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Mechassn_021.description: A mechanical armored thigh module strapped to the left upper leg: a boxy panelled casing with small block attachments on the outer side, a flared plate cap at the top and a segmented lower guard above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Mechassn_021.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower guard and the edge trim; colour 1 on the main casing and the side blocks; colour 3 on the top cap plate, with a small marking of colour 1 on its surface; colour 2 in the opening.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Monster_01.description: A small bone-like spike attached to the side of the left thigh: a tapering, faceted blade with ridged layers, rising from a shield-shaped base plate with a raised rim. Suggests a monstrous, beastly look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike blade and ridges; colour 3 on the raised rim of the base plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Padding.description: A pair of rounded padded thigh plates on the left upper leg, one on the front and one on the back, with a gap between them at the side. Bulky, sporty tactical armor with a small inset panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate shells; colour 1 on the large curved panels; colour 2 on the top and bottom edge panels; colour 3 on the small inset panel on the front plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Pockets_01.description: A band of padded pouches wrapped around the upper left thigh, with pouches spaced apart by contrasting strap segments and a wide flat strap section. Each flap-topped pocket has a round central fastener. Suggests a tactical or utility look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Pockets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the strap segments between pouches; colour 3 on the round fasteners on the pouch flaps.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Pockets_01.differs: The male version has fewer, larger pouches spaced apart with visible strap between them, and a wider strap section at the side.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Power_01.description: A rigid armored thigh guard on the left leg: an open-backed tapered shell with a tall angular plate rising along the outer edge, a stepped notch cut into the front, and an inset side panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tall angular plate and rim; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 1 on the inset panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Power_01.differs: The male version's inset panel sits more toward the front of the thigh and is clearly visible from the front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Powerarmor_01.description: A mechanical armor plate strapped to the outer left thigh: a large rounded shell with contrasting inset panels and a small round port, plus a smaller separate plate sitting behind it. Sci-fi power-armor styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Powerarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and the smaller rear plate; colour 2 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the small round lights in the ports; colour 0 on the inner mechanical detail.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Quiver_01.description: A slim thigh quiver on the left leg: a flat strap loops around the upper thigh and holds a narrow frame of fletched arrows angled down the outer thigh, with clamp bands and a pointed tip cap at the bottom.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh strap, frame rails and arrow fletching; colour 1 on the arrow shafts and clamp bands; colour 2 on the small fasteners; colour 3 on the base tip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_01.description: A pair of looping straps hanging from two small rings on the left outer thigh, each ring fixed to a short tab; the strips droop in swooping U-shapes down the leg. A casual rave or street accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hanging loops; colour 1 on the tabs; colour 0 on the tab edging; colour 2 on the rings.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_02.description: A pair of looping straps hanging from two small rings on flat tabs at the left hip, draping in deep U-shaped swags down the outer thigh. A casual rave or street accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tabs; colour 0 on the tab edges; colour 2 on the rings; colour 3 on the hanging straps.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Rave_02.differs: The male straps hang closer together and drape in deeper swags, with the tabs nearer each other.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A hollow, tapered armoured sleeve encasing the left thigh, with an open top rim, faint embossed vent slots and small studs on the side, and a banded lower edge ending in a notched, pointed hem above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main thigh shell; colour 2 on the band below it; colour 0 on the lower notched hem; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_Thi.description: A sleek angular thigh plate for the left leg: a tapered shell of flat faceted panels that wraps the outer thigh from hip to above the knee, with a rounded open top. Suggests retro sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_Thi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bright front edge panel and the outer face; colour 1 on the back and inner side panels.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Retroscifi_Thi.differs: The male plate has a fuller, rounded top rim that closes around the thigh, without the thin pointed flap at the hip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ringsthigh_01.description: A thigh wrap of criss-crossing overlapping straps between two contrasting bands at top and bottom, with octagonal metal rings and small tabs attached along the outer and rear sides. Sits on the left upper thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Ringsthigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossing straps; colour 2 on the gaps and underlayer between straps; colour 1 on the top and bottom bands; colour 3 on the rings and tabs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.description: A mechanical leg attachment worn on the left upper thigh: an open oval band with a ring-shaped socket at the top, ribbed vent panels on the back and a soft cloth-like lining inside. Sci-fi holster-like styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth lining and the outer band edges; colour 2 on the ribbed back panel and lower armoured block; colour 1 on the trim lines along the band.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.description: A two-part armored leg accessory for the left leg: an open thigh band with a flared front panel and a separate angular shin guard with a spiked fin on top, ridged vents and contrasting trim. Alien, mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band and shin guard shell; colour 1 on the ridged vent panels of the shin guard; colour 3 on the accents under the shin guard; colour 2 on the edge bands and trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.description: A left-leg accessory of two separate armored pieces: a curved thigh band with a raised ring at the back, and a pointed shin guard with a spiked crest, ridged vents and layered plates below the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band and main shin plates; colour 2 on the band's underside and the plate edges; colour 1 on the vented panel of the shin guard; colour 3 on the accents under the shin guard's crest.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.differs: The thigh band sits lower and wraps more fully around the thigh than on the female.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samurai_Large_.description: A single samurai-style hip and thigh guard hanging from the left hip: a rigid, angular plate with a raised zigzag border, jagged stepped edge at the front and a patterned swirl panel inset. Ends at upper thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samurai_Large_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate, rim and jagged edge; colour 1 on the thin inner border line; colour 2 on the swirl panel background; colour 3 on the swirl pattern.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.description: A segmented thigh guard on the left upper leg: three stacked curved plates across the front with contrasting edging, and a ribbed, banded octagonal block wrapping the back of the thigh. Suggests samurai-style armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and the panel behind them; colour 2 on the ribbed rear block.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.description: A samurai-style hip guard of four stacked, overlapping curved plates (kasazuri) hanging from the left hip to the upper thigh, with raised bordered edges. It wraps the outer hip like a short tassset.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the plates; colour 1 on the raised borders and the inner faces of the plates.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.description: A samurai-style layered thigh guard of overlapping lamellar plates that wraps around the outside of the upper left thigh, with a stack of ring bands at the top holding it in place. Reads as fantasy or east-asian armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and the inner plate faces; colour 2 on the stacked ring bands at the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.differs: The male version has a more closed, compact wrap around the thigh, with the plates sitting tighter together and the band nearer the outer side.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Scarletshield.description: A pair of stacked buckled straps wrapped around the left leg just below the knee, each with a square frame buckle and a short tail end. Casual, edgy accessory with a slightly faceted band shape.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Scarletshield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 2 on the buckle frames; colour 1 on the strap tail loops beside the buckles.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_.description: A sci-fi armored thigh guard worn on the left outer thigh: a segmented shell with a notched upper edge, a raised angular front plate and a hollow open top, giving a tactical soldier look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and edge plates; colour 1 on the curved front and back panels; colour 2 on the angled band and inner recess; colour 3 on the rear edge strip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A cluster of curved, blade-like fins or spines swept downward from the left hip, with chevron-patterned panels and thin contrasting edging. It suggests a mechanical sea-creature look worn as a hip accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fin surfaces; colour 1 on the edging and outer fin panels; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the undersides and inner sections.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Shackleankle_0.description: A chunky mechanical ankle shackle: a tapered, faceted cylindrical cuff with a vertical seam, paired contrasting clamp blocks on the front and back, and two rounded loop handles on the sides. Worn on the left ankle.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Shackleankle_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 1 on the two side loop handles; colour 2 on the clamp blocks.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Shacklethigh_0.description: A wide, angular thigh shackle: an octagonal metal band around the upper left thigh with a raised seam, a square locking plate on each side and a rounded C-shaped handle loop at the back.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Shacklethigh_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 2 on the square lock plates; colour 1 on the handle loops.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A small angular fin-like guard strapped to the outer left thigh above the knee: layered pointed plates and spikes jut upward and downward like shark fins, held by a thin strap around the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fin plates and spikes; colour 1 on the inner and back panels; colour 2 on the large front panel and strap; colour 3 on small accents at the lower edge.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sharkfin_01.differs: The male fin has a larger contrasting front panel and more separate spikes along the lower edge, whereas the female has a taller contrasting outer plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Space_Scoundre.description: A sci-fi thigh holster on the left leg: a tall angled pouch shell hangs at the outer thigh from a flat strap around the leg, with a diagonal strap and a flat octagonal plate below.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Space_Scoundre.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster shell, thigh band and plate edges; colour 1 on the plate top and the strap's inner section; colour 2 on the diagonal strap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Space_Scoundre.description: A sci-fi thigh holster on the left leg: a flat band wraps the upper thigh, with a boxy, angular holster shell on the outer side and a long strap sweeping up toward the hip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Space_Scoundre.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band and holster shell; colour 1 on the band's top surface and a strap section; colour 2 on the long diagonal strap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_01_Basi.description: A set of conical metal spikes studded in rows down the outer left thigh, pointing outward and slightly back, with small hexagonal bases. A punk or monstrous accent, sitting on the upper leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_01_Basi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes and their bases; the metallic default material largely ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_Calf_Me.description: Three curved, tapering horn-like spikes stacked in a vertical row on the outer left calf, each with a flared base collar and a long sweeping point. A monstrous, beast-like leg accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_Calf_Me.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base collars.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_Thigh_M.description: Three curved, tapering horn-like spikes stacked in a vertical line down the outer left thigh, each sweeping outward and backward from a short collar-like base. A monstrous, creature-inspired accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Spikes_Thigh_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each spike; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base rim of each spike.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Steampunk_Cowb.description: A short, open-topped tubular cuff or sleeve hanging at the outer hip, made of stiff panelled material with stitched edging. Three buckled straps wrap around it, with a studded strap band across the top. Suggests a steampunk western holster.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Steampunk_Cowb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the cuff; colour 1 on the straps and studded top band; colour 3 on the stitched edge lines; colour 2 on the buckles.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A hip accessory on the left side: a small boxy pack with a vertical seam and a small round indicator light, and a fan of several long striped straps that sweep back over the hip, held by contrasting clamp bands.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pack body and the strap edges; colour 1 on the stripes of the straps; colour 2 on the clamp bands and the pack's vertical seam; colour 3 on the small indicator light.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapped_02.description: A small rectangular box-style pouch worn on the outer left thigh at the hip, with a padded body, a flap on the back edge closed by a round stud, and a contrasting vertical strap running down its side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapped_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and vertical strap; colour 3 on the round stud; colour 1 on the side panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapsthigh_01.description: A wrap of overlapping criss-crossing strips bound around the left mid-thigh, finished with a solid band at the top and bottom edges. A short, snug cuff-like piece with a casual, street or punk feel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Strapsthigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and bottom edge bands; colour 0 on the light wrapping strips; colour 2 on the darker strips and gaps between wraps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sword_01.description: A sheathed sword hanging at the left hip: a long segmented scabbard with a flared, angular guard-shaped mouth, a small crossguard piece and a wrapped hilt pointing up along the side of the waist.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard mouth and scabbard body; colour 1 on the crossguard and hilt end cap; colour 2 on the grip and scabbard tip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Thighpad_01.description: A padded thigh guard on the outer left thigh: a rounded, ribbed front plate with a contrasting rolled band at its lower edge, held by two contrasting straps that wrap around the leg. Sporty, tactical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Thighpad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed plate; colour 1 on the lower rolled band; colour 2 on the two wrap-around straps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Tyrant_01.description: Two separate faceted armour plates strapped to the outer left thigh: a long upper plate at hip level and a shorter one above the knee, with chunky angular edges. A rugged, monstrous mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Tyrant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both plates; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Victory_01.description: A small curved hip panel hanging at the left hip: a rounded, pointed-tip shield shape with a raised border and layered, stitched inner panels stepping down to a point. Suggests a superhero hip guard.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer rim and back shell; colour 0 on the inner lower panel; colour 3 on the middle curved band; colour 1 on the upper panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Vine_01.description: A small wrap-like leaf or fin shape on the left outer thigh, draped over the leg with swirled underside patterning, a curling tendril tip rising toward the hip and small thorn-like spikes along the edge.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer surface; colour 0 on the swirled underside and lower band; colour 3 on the thorn spikes and the curled tip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Vine_01.differs: The male version is narrower and more elongated, tapering to a longer point down the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Amazon_.description: A straight, broad-bladed sword hanging point-down at the left hip, with a wrapped grip, round pommel, ornate winged guard and short loose cords. The blade has a darkened, slightly serrated edge. Suggests a fantasy warrior look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Amazon_.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blade; colour 1 on the guard; colour 3 on the grip wrap and cords; colour 0 on the pommel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Escrima.description: A single escrima stick carried in a small holder at the left hip, hanging straight down the outer thigh. It has a banded striped shaft, a capped top end and a curved flap that sits against the hip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Escrima.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stick shaft; colour 3 on the stripes along the shaft; colour 2 on the holder, flap and top bands; colour 1 on the small stud on the holder.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Gamer_0.description: A chunky retro sci-fi toy-style blaster hanging upright at the left hip: a boxy body with a contrasting angled panel and small studs, a long slim barrel pointing down, and a ribbed cap at the muzzle.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Gamer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gun body and barrel; colour 1 on the muzzle cap and the accent blocks on the body; colour 2 on the side panel; colour 3 on the small round lights.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Sideswo.description: A long rapier-style side sword hanging at the left hip, with a straight narrow blade, a swept metal hand guard with curling loops, a wrapped grip and a round pommel. Thin cords trail from the guard.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Sideswo.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the blade and the trailing cords; colour 1 on the grip; colour 2 on the hand guard and pommel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Tonfa_0.description: A tonfa holstered at the left hip: a long straight baton hangs down the outer thigh in a small contrasting bracket, with a short side handle sticking out sideways. Marked with thin stripe details near the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Tonfa_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baton body; colour 1 on the side handle; colour 2 on the mounting bracket and handle end cap; colour 3 on the stripe markings along the baton.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Wood_01.description: A small toy sword worn at the left hip: a straight, flat wooden blade, a chunky crossguard, a wrapped grip and a round pommel. It hangs point-down beside the thigh as a playful, simple accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Tight_Weapon_Wood_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade; colour 2 on the crossguard; colour 3 on the grip wrapping; colour 0 on the pommel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Traveler_01.description: A short tubular thigh sleeve worn on the left upper leg, with a rimmed top edge, a curved hem, and two contrasting straps fastened with ring buckles across the front. It suggests a utilitarian space-traveller look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sleeve body; colour 1 on the two straps; colour 3 on the ring buckles; colour 2 on the top rim and hem edging.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Vigilante_01.description: A left thigh rig of two padded straps with clasp buckles, joined to a flap pouch that hangs at the outer hip with a snap button and a contrasting tab. Practical vigilante or tactical styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and pouch body; colour 3 on the buckle clasps and the pouch snap button; colour 1 on the pouch tab.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Vigilante_02.description: Two octagonal straps wrap the upper left thigh, each with a large square buckle at the front and a contrasting edge trim. Two boxy flap pouches hang from the outer and rear side of the straps.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap centre bands and the pouches; colour 1 on the strap edges and trim; colour 3 on the buckles and small strap tabs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Waistbag_01.description: A hip-slung thigh bag on the left side: a patterned webbing belt runs around the hips with looping leg straps and ring fasteners, holding a flap pouch with studded closures and a small side holder.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Waistbag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbing straps and pouch body; colour 1 on the rings and studs; colour 2 on the pouch flaps and side holder; colour 3 on the stitched edging.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Brainscramble.description: A chunky sci-fi blaster pistol worn at the outer left hip and thigh, with an angular body, ridged contrasting grip and barrel, an open frame, a short antenna spike, and a row of three capsule-like canisters along one side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Brainscramble.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and frame; colour 1 on the grip panels; colour 2 on the ridged barrel and grip; colour 3 on the canisters.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Chakram_01.description: A circular chakram weapon worn flat against the outer left hip: a ring with a blade edge, curved horn-like points at the gap, an ornately etched inner band and a wrapped grip section along the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Chakram_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade edges; colour 1 on the inner band; colour 3 on the etched swirl patterns; colour 2 on the wrapped grip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Cleaver_01.description: A large rectangular butcher's cleaver with a wide flat blade and a handle with rivets, hanging blade-down at the side of the left hip like a carried weapon. Rough, gritty street or monstrous flavour.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Cleaver_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle scales; colour 0 on the handle edge trim; colour 0 on the blade with a darker steel look.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Cold_01.description: A sci-fi pistol in a bulky angular holster-shell worn against the outer left thigh, with a round dial, ribbed vents, layered armor plates and a protruding grip angled up toward the hip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Cold_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster shell and plates; colour 1 on the pistol grip and the rings inside the housing; colour 3 on the vent slats and ring accents; colour 2 on the darker casing and barrel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Combat_Knife_.description: A hanging combat knife with a curved, forward-swelling kukri-style blade and a short banded handle with small pin holes, hung at the left hip so it dangles down the outer thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Combat_Knife_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle and its band; colour 1 on the blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Destabilizati.description: A compact sci-fi blaster hanging at the outer thigh: a tapered, angular housing with a bulky segmented base, a thin side rod, and several claw-like prongs pointing down from the muzzle. Reads as a mechanical hip-mounted gadget.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Destabilizati.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper housing, side rod and outer frame; colour 0 on the central barrel section and prong tips; colour 2 on the lower base; colour 3 on the small inset panels and stripes.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Gunsword_01.description: A hip-mounted pistol-sword: a long straight blade with a serrated edge extends downward from a revolver-style cylinder and grip, hanging vertically at the left hip. Rugged mechanical hybrid weapon look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Gunsword_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the grip; colour 3 on the frame and hammer; colour 2 on the cylinder and blade base; colour 0 on the blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Hammer_01.description: A claw hammer worn hanging at the left hip, with a long slightly flared handle and a rounded head with a curved split claw. It hangs handle-up along the outer thigh like a holstered tool.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Hammer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle; colour 1 on the hammer head and claw.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Hatchet_01.description: A small hatchet worn hanging at the left thigh: a long straight handle with a collar at the base and a compact single-bladed axe head pointing sideways at the bottom. Reads as a practical hip-carried tool.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Hatchet_01.colourAreas: The default material renders as a translucent glowing outline and ignores the colour scheme, so no slot is clearly visible.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Hatchet_01.differs: This version is shown with a translucent glowing contrasting default appearance instead of the solid handle and axe head.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Icepick_01.description: A mountaineering ice axe hanging at the left hip, point-down along the thigh. It has a long straight shaft with a padded grip at the top, a curved serrated pick and a flat adze blade at the bottom.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Icepick_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the lower shaft; colour 2 on the padded grip; colour 0 on the pick, adze and end spike; colour 3 on a small stud on the grip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Katana_01.description: A sheathed katana worn at the left hip, hanging diagonally down the outer thigh. It has a wrapped hilt, a round guard, a slightly curved scabbard with a capped tip and short tie cords at the hip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Katana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard; colour 2 on the hilt wrap, guard and scabbard tip; colour 1 on the tie cords; colour 3 on small accents in the hilt wrap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Kunai_01.description: A single ninja kunai hanging point-down at the left hip: a leaf-shaped double-edged blade, a wrapped handle and a round ring at the top. Reads as a throwing-knife accessory in an east-asian ninja style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Kunai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the wrapped handle; colour 1 on the ring.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Mad_Scientist.description: A small retro ray gun worn at the left hip: a boxy, angular body with a perforated barrel tipped by a contrasting cap, contrasting-ringed coils, and a flared dish base with claw-like prongs gripping the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Mad_Scientist.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gun body, barrel and base prongs; colour 1 on the barrel tip, dish base and small side fittings; colour 3 on the coil rings and dots.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Mad_Scientist.description: A chunky sci-fi ray blaster hanging at the left hip: a boxy casing with a round lens housing, a curved grip and hooked top handle, and a small canister slung beneath, ending in a ribbed nozzle.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Mad_Scientist.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and lens housing; colour 1 on the grip, top handle and nozzle tip; colour 2 on the barrel sleeve and canister base; colour 3 on the lens and small dots.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Maraca_01.description: A single maraca hanging at the left hip: a rounded, egg-shaped rattle with zigzag and banded patterned stripes, a small collar ring, and a long tapering handle angled upward and forward.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Maraca_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle and the band near the top of the rattle; colour 0 on the collar ring and the zigzag bands; colour 3 on the zigzag bands; colour 2 on the thin stripes.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Newspaper_01.description: A rolled-up newspaper worn as a hip accessory on the left side, hanging vertically along the outer thigh. It is a loose spiral roll, slightly pinched in the middle, printed with columns of text.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Newspaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the newsprint roll; the printed text and creases are part of the texture and take no separate colour slot.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pipe_Wrench_0.description: A large pipe wrench hanging at the left hip: a fat rounded grip with a capped end, a thin shank, and a chunky adjustable jaw housing with a curved hooked jaw at the bottom. Casual mechanic's prop look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pipe_Wrench_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the grip; colour 2 on the grip end cap; colour 1 on the jaw housing; colour 0 on the shank and hooked jaw.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_02.description: A compact submachine gun held on the outer left thigh in an open angular frame-style holster that wraps around the leg, with a short barrel pointing forward and a boxy body with a vertical magazine.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster frame; colour 0 on the gun body; colour 2 on the barrel and grip housing; colour 3 on the small dots on the gun.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_05.description: A tall, narrow revolver holster hanging at the outer left thigh, held by a thin octagonal thigh strap. The holster has a rounded side plate and studs, with the pistol grip and cartridges showing at the top. Western style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body and thigh strap; colour 1 on the side plate, grip and holster bands; colour 3 on the cartridges; colour 2 on the hammer and rivets.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_Scifi_.description: A retro sci-fi pistol worn on the outer left thigh, hanging with the barrel pointing down. It has an angular grip, a wrapped holster-like casing around the barrel and a boxy magazine with slotted vents.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Pistol_Scifi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the grip, barrel and body of the pistol; colour 1 on the wrap around the barrel; colour 2 on the magazine block and upper fittings; colour 3 on the slots in the magazine.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Renegade_01.description: A hip-mounted sickle weapon hanging at the left thigh: a ring pommel on a wrapped handle with a collar, leading to a curved, hooked blade with a jagged, serrated edge and mottled metal finish.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle wrap; colour 0 on the pommel ring and collar; the blade is a glossy metal with a mottled finish that largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Roller_01.description: A cartoonish wooden rolling pin hanging vertically at the side of the left hip: a thick, slightly faceted, textured barrel with a narrow turned handle projecting from each end. Playful kitchen-weapon prop.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Roller_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central barrel; colour 1 on both handles.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Sai_01.description: A sai strapped to the outer left thigh: a flat octagonal band circles the upper leg, holding a long tapering spike with a cord-wrapped handle and two curved side prongs hanging point-down.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Sai_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the thigh band; colour 1 on the wrapped handle; colour 3 on the blade; colour 0 on the curved prongs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Sickle_03.description: A hip-mounted sickle with a short ribbed handle and a broad, deeply curved crescent blade that hangs down the outer thigh, with a small guard where the blade meets the grip. Suggests a fantasy or monstrous weapon.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Sickle_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the handle end cap; colour 0 on the blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spatula_01.description: A kitchen spatula hanging at the left hip: a slotted flipper blade on a long thin metal shaft, with a thick studded grip and a loop end at the top. Hangs down the outer thigh like a holstered weapon.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spatula_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the loop at the top of the handle; colour 2 on the handle grip and studs; the metal shaft and blade ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spy_01.description: A sci-fi spy pistol hanging vertically at the left thigh, with a boxy grip pointing upward, a chunky slide with ribbed panels, and a long suppressor of two studded cylinders extending down the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and slide; colour 1 on the ribbed panels, grip insert and suppressor cylinders; colour 3 on the small sights and stud dots; colour 2 on the grip panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spy_02.description: A closed umbrella hanging at the left hip, pointing down along the thigh. It has a hooked curved handle, a thin shaft, a furled canopy with a band and a small pointed metal tip; a few loose ribs stick out near the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furled canopy; colour 1 on the canopy band and stripes near the top; colour 3 on the hooked handle; colour 2 on the shaft and tip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Stick_02.description: A slender, gently curving branch-like stick with one short side twig near the thick top end, hanging along the outside of the left hip and thigh. A rustic, natural-looking carried weapon or staff.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Stick_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire stick; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Straplesspist.description: A tall, tapered western-style revolver holster hanging on the outer left thigh, with banded panels, a round side plate and a row of studs at the mouth. A revolver with a curved grip and contrasting cartridges sits in it, strapless.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Straplesspist.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower holster body bands and the revolver frame; colour 1 on the upper holster, round plate, stripes, cuff at the base and revolver grip; colour 2 on the studs and hammer; colour 3 on the cartridges and grip trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Swing_Cane_01.description: A slim swing cane hanging diagonally at the left hip: a curved crook handle, a segmented collar joint, a long straight shaft and a small forked metal claw tip at the bottom. Suggests a gadget or gentleman's weapon.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Swing_Cane_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved handle; colour 3 on the long shaft; colour 2 on the collar joint; colour 0 on the metal claw tip and fittings.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Swing_Pistol_.description: A flintlock-style swing pistol carried muzzle-down at the left hip: a curved grip with a round pommel, a cylindrical chamber with a hammer and trigger guard, and a long barrel with a glowing slot and a capped tip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Swing_Pistol_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel and frame; colour 1 on the grip and inner stripe; colour 2 on the chamber, pommel and muzzle cap; colour 3 on the glowing barrel slot.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Trooper_01.description: A slim sci-fi blaster or sidearm hung vertically at the outer left hip, with a long angular body, a tall side plate, a looping open handle frame and a segmented, glowing-looking core strip down its side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and side plates; colour 1 on the looping handle frame and outer bracket; colour 2 on the muzzle end and inner channel; colour 3 on the core strip and circuit-like markings.

Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Wheellockpist.description: A holstered flintlock-style pistol hanging at the left hip: a tapered, open-topped holster shell with a curved grip poking out above and a long slim barrel extending down the outer thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_L_Weapon_Wheellockpist.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper holster shell; colour 0 on the lower holster body and barrel; colour 2 on the grip and barrel tip; colour 3 on the small lock details.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Arcane_01.description: A wide band worn around the right upper thigh, with raised swirling scroll patterns across its surface and a round domed gem set on the outer side. Suggests an arcane, tribal-fantasy leg accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band base; colour 3 on the raised scroll patterns; colour 1 on the round gem; colour 2 on the open top interior.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Armored_01.description: A curved thigh guard of armor plating wrapping the outer right thigh, open toward the inside, with a raised angular rim at the top and a large hexagonal recessed panel with layered borders on the outer face.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shell and outer rim; colour 1 on the raised border around the recess; colour 3 on the thin inner trim line; colour 2 on the recessed centre panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_01.description: A curved flexible hose hanging at the right hip: a ribbed segmented tube joined to a soft fabric-wrapped section, with chunky collared connector caps and rounded nozzle tips at both ends. Suggests astronaut life-support gear.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wrapped hose section; colour 1 on the lower wrapped section; colour 2 on the ribbed tube and connector collars; colour 3 on the nozzle tips.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_01.differs: This version hangs closer to the hip in a tighter hook curve, with a shorter ribbed section than on the female.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_02.description: A flexible hose-like accessory hanging at the right hip: a ribbed segmented tube leads to a wrapped fabric-like section that curls back up into a second nozzle. Both ends have a capped connector and a rounded tip. Mechanical, space-suit feel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Astronaut_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the nozzle tips; colour 2 on the ribbed tube and end connectors; colour 0 on the upper wrapped section; colour 1 on the lower wrapped section.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Beast_Rhino_01.description: A bulky, tube-like thigh sleeve for the right leg, wrinkled and rough-textured like thick hide, with a thin contrasting band near the top and a small ragged edge at the knee. Sits around the upper leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Beast_Rhino_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh sleeve; colour 1 on the thin band near the top; colours 2 and 3 on the ragged lower edge at the knee.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Birdpeople_01.description: A segmented, angular thigh guard wrapping the right upper leg, with a faceted rim at top and bottom and a narrow open gap at the front. Small contrasting clasps sit at the lower edge. Suggests sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 2 on the small clasps at the lower edge; colours 1 and 3 not visible.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Birdpeople_01.differs: The male guard has a narrower front gap, a wider, more closed shell, and sits lower on the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_01.description: A tapered armored thigh guard on the right hip: an open-backed shell with a rimmed edge, a lighter inner panel, and round mechanical discs at the front and back. It narrows to a pointed tip near the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the inner panel; colour 2 on the disc housings; colour 3 on the disc centres.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_02.description: A long, tapering angular blade-like plate hanging from the right hip along the outer thigh, made of faceted planes that narrow to a sharp point above the knee, with small rivet studs near the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper faceted panel; colour 0 on the middle facets; colour 2 on the lower outer facets; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_03.description: A curved armored thigh guard on the right outer thigh: a rounded plate shell with a raised rim, diagonal grooved slashes across the back and a recessed inner panel, with small blocky tabs at the lower edge. Suggests a heavy sci-fi or superhero look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Blockbuster_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate shell, rim and tabs; colour 1 on the recessed inner panel; colour 2 on the diagonal grooves; colour 3 on the small lower accents.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_01.description: A curved thigh guard on the right outer thigh: a hexagonal plate in a thick angular frame with a triangular inset, split by two cross bars, with a fabric strap and a tall rounded contrasting shell wrapping the front.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the triangular inset; colour 2 on the frame, cross bars and rounded backing shell; colour 3 on the strap.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_01.differs: The male guard has a taller, rounded contrasting shell that wraps over the front of the thigh, whereas the female version's backing is a flatter plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_02.description: A curved thigh guard worn on the right outer thigh: a translucent shield-like plate in a thick angular frame with an inset vertical panel, plus a domed rear shell and a fabric strap wrapped around the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the frame and rear shell; colour 1 on the inset vertical panels; colour 3 on the wrapping strap; colour 0 shows faintly on the translucent plate.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Bounty_02.differs: The male guard has a curved, domed rear shell that wraps round the thigh, whereas the female version has a flatter, narrower back plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Brutal_01.description: A hip-mounted armour shell for the right side: a rounded, crumpled plate with a hollow interior, jagged fang-like points along its lower edge and a raised spike at the top. Suggests a monstrous or brutal look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole outer shell; the hollow interior shows as shadow with no visible slot.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Cardboard_01.description: A boxy cardboard-carton shaped block worn around the right upper thigh, with flat angular sides, an open top with a shallow recessed rim, and a wraparound shape. Comical, improvised novelty style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Cardboard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and back panels and the top rim; colour 1 on the curved side panels and the inner top recess; colour 2 on the angled lower panel; colour 3 on the small side patch.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Chains_01.description: A length of heavy chain wound in several tight, stacked loops around the right thigh, forming a compact band on the upper thigh. Gives a rugged, punk or industrial accent.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Chains_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the chain links; colour 2 in the gaps between links.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Chains_01.differs: The male chains form a tighter, flatter stack of loops sitting on the upper thigh rather than a tall spiral.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_01.description: Three curved, blade-like flares with studs and diamond-shaped tips, attached to the right calf. Two sit close together on the back of the calf and one hangs lower on the front, sweeping outward.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved flare strips; colour 3 on the diamond tips and the small studs; colour 2 on the inner edges of the strips.
