Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_01.differs: The male flares are split into a close pair at the back of the calf and a separate single flare lower at the front, rather than one evenly stacked row of three.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_02.description: A cluster of three curved, blade-like spurs stacked up the outside of the ankle and lower calf, each a tapering strip with small studs and a diamond-shaped tip hanging down. Suggests a monstrous or beastly look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Coat_Flair_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved spur blades; colour 3 on the diamond-shaped tips and the small studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_01.description: Three curved, horn-like spikes set in a line down the outer side of the right thigh to the knee, growing larger toward the bottom. They look like bony mutated growths with a monstrous, beastly look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three spikes; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_01.differs: The male spikes are smoother and more sharply curved like horns, with a larger, longer lowest spike.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_02.description: A small cluster of bony, curved horns on the outer right leg: one large swept-back horn near the upper knee and two smaller stubby spikes below it. Monstrous accent.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the horns; the piece shows no other colour slots.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Mutated_02.differs: The male version has a broader, more curved horn and shorter, stubbier lower spikes than the female's thin thorns.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Scarab_01.description: A slender curved scorpion-like tail hanging from the right hip along the outer thigh, with a smooth bone-like shaft that ends in a segmented joint and a sharp hooked stinger. Suggests a monstrous, insectoid look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long tail shaft; colour 2 on the joint band above the stinger; colour 3 on the stinger tip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Scarab_02.description: A curved, hook-like scarab claw hanging at the right hip: a pointed spike rises from a banded base, and a sweeping armoured horn curls down the outer thigh with a small spiny fin and a tip at the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved horn body and fins; colour 3 on the upper spike; colour 2 on the band joining spike and horn; colour 0 on the lower tip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Tight_Ascendan.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring, worn on the outer side of the right thigh. It is thin and outlined, like a decal or badge.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Tight_Ascendan.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and centre ring; colour 1 on the thin outline edging.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Tight_Strapped.description: A small rectangular box pouch hanging at the right outer hip and thigh, with a padded flap, a round stud clasp, a narrow strap running down its side and contrasting edge trim. Compact, utilitarian look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Tight_Strapped.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and strap; colour 3 on the round clasp stud.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Vigilante_01.description: A small boxy pouch worn on the right hip, with a padded rounded body and a folding flap closed by a round snap button, plus a contrasting tab strip down the flap. Casual tactical utility style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 1 on the tab strip down the flap; colour 3 on the snap button.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Vigilante_02.description: A pair of boxy utility pouches with folded-over flap lids, set side by side on the outer right hip and upper thigh. Tactical, practical vigilante look with soft cloth-like construction.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Child_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both pouch bodies and flaps; no other slots clearly visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A segmented armored thigh guard for the right leg: angular layered plates wrap the outer thigh, with a raised upper flange, a flared lower cuff and jagged points just above the knee. Sci-fi mechanical styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main upper and lower plates; colour 0 on the mid-panel bands and rim edges; colour 3 on the side panel inserts; colour 2 on the small vents and the lower cuff points.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Corrupted_01.description: A single tapering hip-to-thigh plate on the right side, edged with jagged, bat-wing-like scalloped points and studded with curved horn-like spikes down its outer face; a monstrous, armoured side guard.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate body and edging; colour 1 on the curved spikes; colour 3 on the chevron-shaped inlays; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Cosmic_01.description: A short, wide octagonal band worn around the right upper thigh, with thin raised rims at top and bottom and a smooth, matte outer surface. Suggests a plain sci-fi leg cuff.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main band body; colour 0 on the top and bottom rims; colour 1 on a small panel visible inside the back.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Cosmic_01.differs: The male version is a smooth, matte band with bright rims, while the female version has a glossy, faceted crystalline surface.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Cosmos_01.description: A curved, shell-like guard for the right thigh: a smooth glossy plate with a raised swooping rim and a hollowed front face, tapering to a angled point just below the knee. Sits on the outer thigh with a sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the raised rim and lower section. The glossy default material shows little of the scheme.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Cosmos_02.description: A hollow, scoop-shaped armor guard worn on the outer right thigh, open and tapering toward the knee, with layered swept plates at the top and slim contrasting trim bands running down its length.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the swept upper plates and trim bands; colour 2 on the lower body of the guard; colour 3 on the recessed inserts; colour 0 on the glossy inner surface.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_01.description: A short segmented armour cuff wrapping the right upper thigh: a large front plate with a contrasting horizontal band, and stacked angular panels at the back and side. Open at the top, ending above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front and outer plates; colour 3 on the horizontal band and upper back panel; colour 2 on the middle back panel; colour 0 on the lower back panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_Hoses_01.description: A bulky armoured thigh guard on the right leg: an open-topped shell with rounded padded plates, a wrapped flexible hose looping up to a capped end at the hip, and a small separate pad above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell frame and rims; colour 1 on the side inset panel; colour 2 on the padded plates, caps and knee pad; colour 3 on the hose.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dharmor_Hoses_01.differs: The male version has a wider, boxier shell, with the hose hugging closer to the front of the guard.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Draco_01.description: A rigid thigh guard wrapping the right upper leg, with a pointed fin-like plate up the front, a curved panel on the side, a raised flat cap with a pointed back tip and banded rims at top and bottom.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main side panel; colour 1 on the top cap and the top and bottom rim bands; colour 3 on the front fin and the strip down the back; colour 2 on the edging and lower band.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Draco_01.differs: The male version has a contrasting-slot top cap and a shorter front fin, while the female version has a contrasting-slot cap and a taller front fin.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_01.description: A hip-mounted thigh guard of overlapping bark-like plates with jagged, pointed upper edges, covered on the outer face by a rough mossy growth. It hangs from the hip to above the knee on the right leg, suggesting a woodland guardian style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the layered plates; colour 1 on the rough mossy patch over the outer face; colour 3 on thin vein-like lines along the plate edges.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_02.description: A small organic hip accessory of two curling, horn-like leaf or thorn shapes with pointed tips, joined at the base and hanging at the right hip beside the hand. Mottled surface suggests a fantasy nature or beast style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the curled shapes; colour 0 on the inner ridges, tips and mottled patches.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_02.differs: The male version's horns sit closer together and are bunched more compactly, with more of the main colour showing.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A right-thigh guard made of overlapping bark-like plates with jagged, leaf-shaped upper edges and a rough mossy patch on the outer side. It wraps the outer and front thigh with a broad smooth front plate, ending above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the rough mossy patch on the outer side; colour 3 on the thin vein lines between the plates.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Dryad_Alt_01.differs: The male version adds a broad smooth plate covering the front of the thigh, with the moss patch spread across the outer and back plates. The female version is made of narrower, separated plates.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Fire_01.description: A cluster of glossy, flame-shaped tongues that hangs from the right hip down the outer thigh, with jagged pointed tips and a swept, curling silhouette. It suggests a fiery, elemental hip accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: Glossy default material largely ignores the scheme; the flame body shows a reflective finish with faint sheen highlights, so colour slots have little visible effect.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Fire_02.description: A flame-shaped hip accessory on the right thigh: layered glossy swept tongues with jagged tattered tips flare from the hip and curl upward at the top, hanging to mid-thigh like a ragged mantle.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: Mostly glossy material that largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows as a faint sheen on some flame edges and undersides; the rest reads as the glossy body of the flames.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_01.description: A glossy, sculpted cluster of jagged wave-like shards and pointed fins that clings to the outside of the right thigh, hanging from hip to just above the knee, with a flat angular plate at the hip top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_01.colourAreas: The default glossy material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly in sheen on the shard undersides, and the rest reads as reflective surface.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_01.differs: The male version has a larger, bulkier mass with a pronounced flat angular plate at the hip and more flared shards at the top.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_02.description: A glossy, fin-like hip and thigh attachment on the right side: layered swooping ribbed panels with curled tendril tips at the top and bottom, hanging to mid-thigh like a stylised wave or monstrous wing.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_02.colourAreas: The glossy material largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 2 appears on most of the panels, with faint colour 1 sheen along the ribs.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Element_Water_02.differs: The male version is shorter and broader, with extra curled tendrils at the bottom edge and a flatter inner panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Falcon_01.description: A right thigh guard shaped like a tapering cuff, with a pointed lower edge, a raised front plate with swept spiky fins and a tall crystal-like point on top; a banded strap with a small diamond gem wraps the back.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the rim and edge trim; colour 2 on the spiked front plate and fins; colour 3 on the top point and the diamond gem.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Falcon_01.differs: The male guard is longer and sits lower on the leg, with a taller cuff and a less flared bottom point.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: Two swept-back, frilled fin blades on the outer right leg, one on the thigh and a longer one on the calf. Each has a ragged, feather-like edge and tapers to a point, giving an axolotl or monster look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the inner body of each fin; colour 3 on the frilled edges and ridges of the fins.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Frigid_01.description: A curved armour-like hip plate on the right thigh, with a bordered outer face holding a textured ribbed panel and an angled upper band. Its inside is a smooth open shell, giving a partial, sci-fi guard.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured central panel; colour 1 on the upper band and border of the outer face; colour 2 on the outer rim and the smooth inner shell.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Gamer_01.description: A slab-shaped arcade control panel worn at the side of the right hip, with a flat smooth front, a sloped back face carrying rows of buttons and indicator bars, and a small ball-topped joystick near the hand.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing; colour 2 on the buttons; colour 3 on the indicator bars; colour 1 on the joystick.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Gladiator_01.description: A single angular hip guard on the right side: a curved shield-shaped plate with a thick raised rim and a contrasting inset panel with a small accent stripe, hanging along the outer thigh. Sci-fi armoured look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and top rim; colour 2 on the inner frame edging; colour 0 on the inset panel; colour 3 on the small accent stripes.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Heraldry_01.description: A right thigh guard of curved armor plating that wraps the outer and front thigh, with a raised angular upper edge, a sculpted heraldic crest on the front, and a cuffed, flared band with a small emblem buckle above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and the cuff band; colour 2 on the upper rim and lower knee trim; colour 3 on the crest and emblem; colour 1 on the knee-side panels.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Heraldry_01.differs: The male guard is shorter and wider, sitting higher on the thigh with a broader, more rounded plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Holohex_01.description: A cluster of angular, faceted floating plates clustered around the right lower leg, with a larger central block, small jutting fins above and a tapered shard below the calf. Suggests a holographic or mechanical sci-fi field.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Holohex_01.colourAreas: All of the piece renders as a single flat tone on this sheet, so the colour slots cannot be told apart; it appears to take colour 0.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Holster_Bounty_01.description: A slim leg holster worn on the right outer thigh: a padded pouch-like sleeve with an open loop at the front and a flat tapering strap extending up toward the hip, crossed by a single contrasting band.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Holster_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body and upper strap; colour 1 on the band across the holster.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Hoses_01.description: A pair of segmented, ribbed flexible hoses draped down the right hip and outer thigh, curving and looping with open cut ends. They hang loosely from the hip like dangling cables, suiting a mechanical or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on both hoses; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Inmate_01.description: A small curved shield-like plate strapped to the right lower leg just below the knee, with a mesh-textured face, a rimmed edge and a wide band wrapping around the calf. Utilitarian, prison-issue look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh plate face; colour 1 on the wide strap band; colour 2 on the plate rim and edging.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Ironclad_01.description: A curved armored thigh guard on the outer right hip, built from stacked horizontal bands with raised flared ridges between them and a thick rim along the front edge. Mechanical, angular styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the rim and ridges between bands; colour 0 on the top band; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 2 on the lower band.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Kaiju_01.description: A monstrous armoured hip and thigh guard on the right leg: layered, jagged plates with a broad lower panel hanging beneath, and several curved horn-like spikes rising from the hip side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper armour plates; colour 1 on the lower hanging panel; colour 2 on the horn spikes; colour 0 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Kaiju_01.differs: The male version has a broader, shorter lower panel that wraps the outer thigh, with the plates sitting more to the side of the hip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Knight_01.description: A single curved thigh plate on the outer right leg, a tapering shell with a squared top edge, held by two thin octagonal straps that wrap around the thigh. Suggests knightly armour.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Knight_01.differs: The male plate has no contrasting rim edging and a squared-off top edge, giving a more angular, tapering shape.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Knight_02.description: A curved plate guard worn on the outer right thigh, held by two loop straps around the leg, with a row of conical spikes along its outer edge and studs on the face. Medieval armor with a brutal edge.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and the spikes; colour 3 tints the lower plate surface; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Knight_02.differs: The male plate is longer and narrower, with spikes that also project toward the back edge and larger studs down the side.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_01.description: A curved hip guard worn on the right hip that wraps partway round the thigh, with a flared, pointed lower hem, a lattice of raised ribs and scroll-like swirls near the hem. The rim has a contrasting edge trim.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plate body; colour 0 on the raised lattice ribs, scroll details and rim trim; colour 1 faintly on the inner lining.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The male version has a clearly visible contrasting rim trim and scroll details near the hem, and it hangs a little lower on the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_02.description: A beast-head hip guard styled like a snarling wolf or lion face with angular plates, a fanged muzzle and swept-back spiky mane blades, worn on the right hip like a fantasy martial-arts ornament.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the head and main plates; colour 0 on the curved mane spikes and tusks; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on some shadowed spikes and inner plates.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_01.description: Three separate octagonal bands stacked down the right leg: a wide thick band on the upper thigh, a thinner one above the knee, and a narrow one below the knee. Simple angular cuffs with a faceted look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the upper thigh band; colour 1 on the inside of the upper band and on the middle band; colour 2 on the lower band's outer surface, with colour 1 inside it.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_02.description: A set of three octagonal bands stacked down the right leg: a wide, creased wrap high on the thigh, a slightly thicker band below it, and an open-backed band at the knee, each with a small stud.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide upper thigh wrap; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 2 on the lower knee band; colour 3 on the small studs.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Madjester_02.differs: The male upper wrap is shorter and flatter with less criss-cross creasing, and the middle band is wider, with more space between the bands.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_01.description: A boxy mechanical thigh pack on the right leg: an angular panelled block with a contrasting vertical slot on its face and a raised back plate, plus a round dial-like disc mounted on the outer side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the boxy housing; colour 2 on the vertical slot; colour 1 on the round side disc; colour 3 on the dashed ring detail of the disc.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_01.differs: The male disc is larger and sits toward the back of the box, with a curved top edge peeking above the back plate when seen from the front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_02.description: A boxy, angular mechanical thigh guard worn on the right outer hip and upper thigh. Faceted plates form an open-topped shell with a tall raised fin on the outer side and a stepped lower edge.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the tall outer fin and upper side panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mecha_02.differs: The male version's shell is a wider, more upright box with a larger outer fin panel and a contrasting vent slot along the back of the lower edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A curved armoured hip and thigh guard for the right leg: a rounded shell with a raised upper rim, a large padded side panel, thin piping along its edge, a small round fastener and a thick bevelled hem.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the large padded panel; colour 3 on the thin piping; colour 2 on the bottom hem.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Modern_Ironclad_01.differs: The male guard is a shorter, boxier cuff that wraps further around the outer thigh, with a flatter rim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Monster_Shacklethigh.description: A chunky octagonal metal cuff worn around the upper right thigh, with flat faceted plates, a square lock housing on the outer face and a rounded loop handle on the inner side, like a prison shackle.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Monster_Shacklethigh.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff band; colour 1 on the loop handle; colour 2 on the square lock plates.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Moth_01.description: A single wing-like fabric panel hanging from the right hip along the outer thigh, pointed at the top with a raised edge and tapering to a ragged, slightly flared hem near the knee. Suggests a moth-wing side flap.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised upper edge and top of the panel; colour 3 on the lower body of the panel, fading in from the top.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mutated_01.description: A fleshy, mutated growth on the right outer hip and thigh: a tapering, folded mass of lumpy tissue hanging to the knee, studded with several small contrasting spikes along the front edge.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy mass; colour 0 on the spikes; colour 1 on small patches at the back; colour 2 on small spots near the lower front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mutated_02.description: A mutated, fleshy growth wrapped along the outer right thigh, with layered ridged lobes that sweep up into a curved horn-like tip and taper into a pointed tail below the knee, dotted with small spikes.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Mutated_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main fleshy body of the growth; colour 0 on the small spikes and claws; colour 1 on a small nodule; colour 2 on a bulbous node.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Newholster_01.description: A small holster sleeve worn on the outer right thigh: a tall tapered cloth-like pouch with a slanted open top, a strap with a square buckle around it, and ornate scrolled flourishes above. Western style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Newholster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body; colour 1 on the strap; colour 3 on the buckle and scrolled ornaments.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Newholster_01.differs: The male holster tapers to a longer point at the bottom and sits along the side of the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Persian_Sword_01.description: A hip-mounted curved sword hanging at the right thigh: a long blade sweeping down into a hooked, backward-curving tip, with a ribbed grip, a round gem-set pommel, and an angular bracket clip holding it at the hip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Persian_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the bracket clip; colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the grip and pommel; colour 3 on the pommel gem.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Pirate_Fancy_Gun.description: A holstered flintlock-style pistol hanging at the right hip, pointing downward: a curved rounded grip with octagonal end plate, a wide strapped band, and a slim barrel with a flared muzzle tip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Pirate_Fancy_Gun.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved grip body; colour 1 on the wide band around the grip; colour 2 on the barrel, muzzle and grip end plate; colour 3 on the thin rod along the barrel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Pirate_Fancy_Sword.description: A long slender rapier hanging at the right hip, with a looping swept hilt guard, crossed quillon bars and a small pommel. The thin blade hangs down along the leg. Pirate swashbuckler style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Pirate_Fancy_Sword.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 3 on the looped hand guard; colour 2 on the crossed quillons and grip; colour 1 on the pommel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A single angular hip guard of layered, faceted plates that sweeps up into several pointed fins along the right outer hip and thigh, with a broad rounded plate at the lower edge. Suggests a psionic dragon-scale look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and upper spikes; colour 1 on the lower edge trim. The material looks glossy and pale, so the scheme shows only weakly.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The male version is chunkier and rounder, with a wider lower plate and shorter, more closely grouped spikes.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Pumpkin_01.description: A rib-cage-like bone cage wrapped around the right thigh: a vertical spine at the back and a narrower ridge at the front, with curved rib bars arching between them. Skeletal, macabre monster style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spine and many of the ribs; colour 1 on the front ridge, spine tips and alternating ribs; colour 2 on some ribs; colour 3 on a few ribs near the top.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Punk_01.description: A punk leg accessory of two buckled straps around the upper and lower thigh, joined by a long diagonal strap that rises toward the hip. The straps are studded with rounded dots.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 3 on the dot studs; colour 2 on the buckles.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Qularr_Armor_03.description: A short segmented armour guard wrapped around the right upper thigh: overlapping curved plates at the front and stacked horizontal bands at the back, with a flared open top rim. Suits fantasy or sci-fi armour looks.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Qularr_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and bands; colour 1 on the edges and recessed folds of the plates; colour 2 on the plate undersides.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Renegade_Straps_01.description: A column of six short, flat straps stacked down the outside of the right thigh, each wrapping partway round the leg and fastened with a small stud. Loose tab ends stick out at the side, giving a sci-fi renegade look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Renegade_Straps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky angular armoured thigh guard worn on the right upper leg, a hollow tube of faceted plates with a raised hexagonal gem on the outer side and a wide contrasting band visible at the open top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer armour plates; colour 1 on the inner band and lining at the top; colour 3 on the hexagonal gem; colour 0 on the inner rim and edge highlights.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The male guard is wider and shorter in front, showing more of the contrasting inner band around the open top.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A rigid, tapered thigh guard on the right leg: a smooth curved shell with a broad rounded upper rim that is fairly level, a pointed lower edge, and a vertical inlaid strip with a pointed-arch motif.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the upper rim; colour 1 on the inlaid strip outline; colour 3 on the small mechanism detail within the strip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Retrosteelhead_01.differs: The male guard has a more level, rounded rim with a small peak at the front, instead of the female's slanted sweeping rim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Ripper_01.description: A cybernetic hip implant: an angular plated mounting block at the side of the hip with thick segmented cables looping down the outer thigh in hanging loops, with thin contrasting piping along each cable.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular hip block; colour 2 on the thick cables; colour 3 on the thin piping lines along the cables; colour 1 on the small round sockets on the block.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Robotsamurai_01.description: A hip-mounted armour guard on the right side: a tall tapering plate at the top over a stack of overlapping, curved segments that step down the outer thigh. It suggests samurai-style mechanical armour.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main segment plates; colour 1 on the upper plate face and the edge panels; colour 2 on the top plate section and the lowest segments; colour 3 on small accent bands between segments.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Sacred_01.description: A curved, shield-like hip plate on the right side, wrapping over the hip and upper thigh, with a raised rim, contrasting feather-like or claw-shaped emblems, and small round studs at the corners. Suggests armored fantasy or sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the raised rim edging; colour 2 on the feather-like emblems; colour 3 on the small studs and the inner accents of the emblems.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Sandstorm_01.description: A tapered thigh guard wrapping the right upper leg, with a slanted open top edge and notched lower edge. Raised curved and slashed panels run down the outer face, giving a sleek sci-fi armour look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main guard shell; colour 1 on the raised curved bracket-shaped panels; colour 3 on the slanted slash panels; colour 2 on the thin edge trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Sandstorm_02.description: A curved thigh guard worn on the outer right thigh: a rounded, bevelled armor plate with a pointed lower panel, held by two thick straps that wrap around the leg. Suggests a mechanical or armored look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the lower pointed panel; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_01.description: A curved armour-like plate worn along the outer right thigh, with a slender raised ridge along its edge ending in a pointed claw-like tip, a jagged notched rear edge and an angular cap near the knee. Suggests a mechanical scarab shell.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plate; colour 2 on the edge outline and inner lining; colour 3 on the pointed tip; colour 1 on the knee cap.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_01.differs: The male plate has a jagged, notched rear edge, while the female version is smoother and more rounded.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_02.description: A rounded, shell-like thigh guard on the right leg, with a broad domed top rim, a tapering lower panel edged in trim, curling fin-like fronds along the sides and a tall curved spike at the hip; a segmented panel shows at the back.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main lower shell; colour 2 on the top rim and bottom edge trim; colour 1 on the curling side fronds; colour 3 on the hip spike and the segmented back panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_02.differs: The male version has a larger, bulkier domed top rim that covers more of the upper thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_01.description: A single curved, bone-like claw that hangs from the right hip down the outer thigh, a smooth tapering arm ending in a contrasting collar and a sharp hooked talon. Suggests a monstrous, insectoid or mechanical hip accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long curved shaft; colour 2 on the collar band at the base of the talon; colour 3 on the pointed talon tip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_01.differs: The male claw hangs more vertically and close to the hip, while the female one is more slanted across the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_02.description: A curved, hook-like insectoid claw hanging at the right hip and running down the outer thigh: a tapering pointed tip on a banded base, a long arched shell blade, and a small spined fin curling off it.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Scarab_Alt_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the pointed tip; colour 2 on the band at the base of the tip; colour 1 on the curved shell blade and spined fin; colour 0 on the lower end cap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Spikysuit_01.description: A lumpy, bone-like armor growth attached to the outer right hip and thigh, with jagged spikes along its upper edge and rows of ribbed grooves down the side. Suggests a monstrous, organic look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bony mass and spikes; colour 1 on the ribbed grooves and inset streaks.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Spooky_01.description: A monstrous hip-mounted cluster of overlapping jagged spiked plates or feathers that tapers into a long point down the outer right thigh, with small contrasting-looking gem studs near the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plates and spikes; colour 1 on the lower tapering tips, blending in as a gradient; colour 3 on the small eye-like gems near the top.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Spy_01.description: A sci-fi spy pistol holstered on the right thigh: a strap band with a flat octagonal plate holds a boxy pistol with ribbed grips and a long ridged suppressor barrel pointing down the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body; colour 1 on the thigh plate top, ribbed grip sections and suppressor barrel; colour 2 on the thigh strap and plate edge; colour 3 on the small accent stripes and sensor.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_01.description: A right thigh guard made of two stacked octagonal armor plates joined by a thin angular wire loop, with a faceted gem-like spike and a pointed side blade panel. Sits on the outer upper thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the two octagonal plates and the edging of the side blade; colour 0 on the inner side blade panel; colour 2 on the wire loop; colour 3 on the faceted gem.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_02.description: A right-thigh armour guard: a smooth curved sleeve panel along the outer thigh, capped by a large faceted angular plate at the top and a pointed chevron cuff lower down, with thin trim bands between.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long sleeve panel along the thigh; colour 1 on the faceted upper plate and lower chevron cuff; colour 3 on the thin trim band under the upper plate; colour 2 on the top edge lining.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Starhawk_02.differs: The male upper plate is larger and wraps further across the front of the thigh, and the lower cuff is broader and shorter.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Steelarachnid_01.description: A mechanical thigh guard for the right leg: a curved, tapering armour shell with a pointed upper edge, thick contrasting rim, and two slotted vents with inset panels on the outer side. Ends above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the inset vent panels; colour 2 on the rim and lower edge trim; colour 3 on the thin seam line.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Steelcommando_01.description: A curved armor plate that wraps the outer right thigh, with a raised faceted panel on the front and a contrasting flared back shell that ends in pointed tails above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised front panel; colour 2 on the main shell and lower edge; colour 0 on the thin edge highlights along the rim.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male plate is wider and more boxy, wrapping further around the thigh, with a shorter lower edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Super_Retro_Destroye.description: A single curved, shield-shaped hip plate that cups the outer right hip and upper thigh, tapering to a point downward with a raised rim and hollow interior. Suggests retro superhero armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Super_Retro_Destroye.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face and the raised rim edge; colour 2 on the darker lower portion and inner hollow. The metallic finish partly ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Super_Retro_Destroye.differs: The male plate hangs a little lower on the thigh with a more pronounced, thicker raised rim along the inner edge.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Symbiote_01.description: A curved, leaf-shaped shell plate worn on the outer right hip and thigh, with an oval inset panel and two pointed faceted crystal spikes jutting out. Suggests an alien symbiote armour growth.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell plate; colour 1 on the inset oval panel; colour 3 on the two faceted spikes.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Thigharmor_Draycul_0.description: A right thigh guard of two stacked, angular armor plates with pointed notched edges and small rivets, held by two thick rounded straps that loop around the thigh. Sits on the outer thigh; sci-fi or monstrous armor style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Thigharmor_Draycul_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surfaces; colour 1 on the plate edge trim; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Thigharmor_Rockcryst.description: A cluster of chunky, faceted rock slabs hanging from the right hip and outer thigh, with cracked seams between plates and pointed shards dangling lower. Monstrous, stony armor accent.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Thigharmor_Rockcryst.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock plates; colour 3 on the glowing crack lines between the plates.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.description: A thigh band worn high on the right leg: a segmented panel strap carrying a large buttoned pouch, a row of bullet-like ammo cartridges, a boxy vented module and small tab clips. Tactical, 90s action-hero look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Ammo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band; colour 1 on the pouch, side plates and tab clips; colour 2 on the boxy module and small blocks; colour 3 on the cartridges.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.description: A chunky faceted band worn around the upper right thigh, with a many-sided angular profile, two raised rounded bosses on the front face and a contrasting upper rim. Suggests a retro superhero or mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band body and the round bosses; colour 1 on the upper rim section.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_90s_Foxbat_01.differs: The male band shows two round bosses across the front, and it sits lower and wider on the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Alien_01.description: A chunky alien armor plate worn on the outer right thigh: a rounded, carved upper shell with jagged crystalline spikes, stacked over a contrasting band and a zigzag-edged lower panel. Bulky, monstrous sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper carved shell; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 1 on the lower zigzag panel; colour 3 on the spikes and small studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Alien_02.description: A small rounded kneepad worn on the right knee: a smooth oval shell with two inset side panels and a raised rim, topped by a curved, overhanging band that shields the top of the knee. Suggests alien sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Alien_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the two inset side panels; colour 2 on the curved top band.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Cartridge.description: A thigh band studded with a row of upright bullet-like cartridges with pointed tips, plus a cluster of boxy magazine pouches with flat panels at the outer side. Worn on the upper right thigh in a tactical style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Cartridge.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the band and cartridge collars; colour 1 on the cartridge bodies; colour 2 on the pouch panels and cartridge tips; colour 3 on the pouch frames and thin bands between the cartridges.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ammo_Cartridge.differs: The male version has a wider cluster of three magazine pouches at the outer side of the thigh, rather than two.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Aquatic_01.description: A pair of stacked, overlapping curved plates forming a small hip guard on the right side, each with a raised pointed lower edge and a contrasting rim. It wraps the outer upper thigh like fin-shaped armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate faces; colour 2 on the raised rims and edges of each plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Aquatic_02.description: Three curved, blade-like fins stacked down the right hip and outer thigh, each a swept, tapering spike with a contrasting edge. They flare backwards around the hip, giving a monstrous aquatic look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the top fin face; colour 1 on the middle fin face; colour 0 on the lowest fin face; colour 2 on the edges of all three fins.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armor_Ancienta.description: A single curved thigh plate on the right leg, split by narrow vertical slits, with spiral, maze-like engraved patterns and a weathered stone-like surface. Two loose strap loops encircle the thigh to hold it in place.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armor_Ancienta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 1 on the engraved spiral lines; colour 3 on the two thigh straps; colour 2 on the worn, scuffed patches.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armored_01.description: A mechanical leg frame worn on the outer right thigh: a tall tapering shell with a large oval cutout and thin raised rim, ending in two small wheel-like rollers at the knee. Sci-fi, partial coverage.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the frame shell; colour 1 on the inner hubs of the wheels; colour 2 on the wheel tyres; colour 3 not visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorninja.description: A angular armored thigh guard for the right leg: a faceted, open-backed shell with a raised pointed front ridge and layered panels, sitting on the upper thigh above the knee. Ninja-like, sleek and segmented.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer front ridge and rear edge plates; colour 1 on the main curved panels; colour 2 on the side and inner shell; colour 3 on the small lower accents.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_02.description: A small angular kneepad: a faceted, slightly curved plate with a raised central ridge and pointed tips above and below, worn on the outer side of the right knee. It gives a mechanical, armoured look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main curved plate and its edge; colour 1 on the central ridge and the pointed top and bottom tips.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_Thi.description: A segmented, angular armor plate wrapped around the right thigh, made of faceted layered plates with a raised rim at the top, small vent slits and edge accents. Sits over the outer thigh like a sci-fi cuisse.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Armorviper_Thi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and top rim; colour 1 on the inset stripe panels and corner accents; colour 3 on the small vent slits.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A curved shield-shaped thigh plate worn on the outer right thigh, with a bevelled raised rim, a notched lower edge and an atom emblem on the face. Superhero-style armour panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim; colour 1 on the main plate face; colour 0 on the atom emblem.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A draped cloth swag hung from two round medallion clasps at the right hip, one on the front and one on the back, sagging in a deep U between them with folds falling to the outer thigh. Fantasy sash style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped cloth; colour 1 on the rims of the medallion clasps; colour 3 on the star-shaped centres of the medallions.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ascendant_02.differs: The male drape sags in a deeper, wider U-shaped swag between the front and back clasps, with more cloth visible across the hip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bandtied_01.description: A narrow cloth band wrapped around the right upper thigh, tied in a small knot at the outer side with two short pointed tails hanging down. Casual, understated accessory with a faceted, gathered look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bandtied_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band, knot and tails; no other colour slots visible.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bandtied_01.differs: The knot and tails sit toward the back of the thigh rather than toward the front as on the female version.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer_0.description: A plain, short tapered greave shaped as an octagonal tube, worn around the right lower leg above the ankle, with contrasting rims at top and bottom. Simple, smooth and partial in coverage.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the greave; colour 1 on the top and bottom rim bands.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer_S.description: A short ankle bracer cuff with a contrasting rim and edging, a chunky cross-shaped ornament on the front of the shin, and a large curved, scythe-like blade sweeping out and back from the outer side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer_S.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bracer cuff; colour 1 on the rim and edge trim; colour 3 on the cross ornament; colour 2 on the curved blade.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Beast_Bracer_S.differs: The male version's blade projects more to the side of the ankle, and the cross is larger and sits lower on the cuff.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_L.description: A short tapered armoured bracer wrapped around the lower right leg near the ankle, with octagonal rims at each end and a large angular cross-shaped spike mounted on the outer front. Its surface looks carved and pitted. Fantasy angelic-warrior styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_L.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cuff body; colour 1 on the rims and edge framing; colour 3 on the cross ornament.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bracer_Angel_L.differs: The male cuff has a rough, carved and pitted surface texture instead of a smooth one.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bucklestraps_0.description: Three stacked octagonal straps wrapped around the right upper thigh, each punched with small rivet holes and closed at the outer side by a boxy buckle. A partial leg accessory with a mechanical, street or punk look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Bucklestraps_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the buckle blocks.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cartridges_01.description: A pair of upright hexagonal cartridge pouches with recessed contrasting panels, mounted on the outer right thigh and held by two thin bands that wrap around the leg. Tactical, sci-fi utility gear.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cartridges_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the two thigh straps; colour 1 on the cartridge casings; colour 2 on the recessed cartridge panels.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cowboy_Lasso_0.description: A coiled twisted-rope lasso hanging at the right hip, with several loops bundled together and a small knot near the top. A western cowboy accessory that sits against the outer thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cowboy_Lasso_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rope strands; the knot and loops appear to use only colour 0.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: Two separate angular armor plates on the right leg: a larger curved shield on the outer thigh and a smaller guard at the knee, each with layered ridges and thin edge trim. A sci-fi tactical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plate shells; colour 1 on the outer ridged panels of each plate; colour 0 on the thin edge trim.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The male plates are wider and flatter with more of the contrasting-slot panel showing, plus thin light edge trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.description: A short, open-topped armored cuff wrapping the right upper thigh: angular faceted plates with a stepped lower edge, ridged side sections and large hex bolts at the corners. Suggests cyborg or mechanical armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main plate faces; colour 0 on the ridged side sections and rim; colour 2 on the lower edge band; colour 3 on the hex bolts.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.differs: The male plate covers more of the outer thigh with the contrasting face, and the ridged section is mostly at the back.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Defender_01.description: A small diamond-shaped kneepad on the right knee: a faceted, peaked plate with a crescent slash marking on the front and a slightly ridged, faceted back. Suits armoured superhero or sci-fi looks.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Defender_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 3 on the crescent marking on the front; colour 1 on the edge highlights.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Defender_01.differs: The male back is faceted with a slight ridge, while the female back is a flat, smooth panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Deity_01.description: A curved shell-like thigh guard worn on the right upper leg: a rounded, open-backed plate with a contrasting front panel and a flared, pointed lower edge. Smooth, sleek and sci-fi in style.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, rim and pointed lower edge; colour 1 on the main front panel; colour 2 on the recessed inner back opening.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Electric.description: A rigid thigh-mounted generator plate on the outer right leg: an angular armored shell with a ribbed side panel, three coiled electrode bolts on the outer face, and a looping cable arching over the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Electric.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate shell and bolt caps; colour 1 on the ribbed side panel; colour 3 on the coils and thin edge lines; colour 2 on the cable.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Fincalf_01.description: A small fin-like calf accessory: a flat membrane panel with three swept-back pointed spines along its edge, spotted with a mottled pattern. It sits on the outer side of the right lower leg, suggesting an aquatic or monstrous look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Fincalf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 1 on the spines and edge trim; colour 3 on the spots; colour 2 in the shaded gradients between the ribs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Fincalf_02.description: A fin-like calf accessory on the outer side of the right lower leg: a layered membrane with three swept-back contrasting-edged spines, spotted skin panels and a pointed tail at the bottom. Suggests an aquatic or monstrous look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Fincalf_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spines and the edge trim; colour 0 on the spotted membrane panels; colour 3 on the spots; colour 2 on the shaded creases between the panels.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_01.description: A small fin-like accessory on the outer right thigh: three stacked, membrane-like segments separated by curved, pointed ridges that sweep back into spiky tips. Suggests a monstrous or aquatic creature look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the edge ridges and pointed spines; colour 0 on the membrane panels; colour 3 on the spotted markings; colour 2 on the shaded areas of the membranes.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_02.description: A cluster of stacked, blade-like fins attached to the outer right thigh, with sharp curved tips sweeping backward and down. Each fin has a mottled membrane and a contrasting edge, giving a monstrous, creature-like look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fin edges and spines; colour 0 and colour 2 on the mottled fin membranes; colour 3 on the spotted markings.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Finthigh_02.differs: The male fins sit closer to the thigh and are narrower, with shorter trailing points.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Flower_01.description: A thin vine-like garland that wraps around the right thigh, made of twisting stems with small pointed leaves and a large layered flower rosette on the outer side. Suggests a fey, nature-themed look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine stems and many petals; colour 3 on the thin secondary vines; colour 0 on some leaves and the flower centre; colour 2 on the darker petals and leaf tips.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Furpads_01.description: A single hip pad on the right side: a curved flat backing plate covered with a shaggy curtain of jagged fur strands that hang down over the outer thigh. Suggests a beastly or savage look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Furpads_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur strands; colour 0 on the flat backing plate at the hip edge; colour 2 on the darker strand tips and roots.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A curved armor plate strapped to the outer right thigh, with a bordered rim, rivets, fine cracks and many conical spikes jutting outward. A studded contrasting panel sits behind it. Gladiator-style and monstrous.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 1 on the rim and top edge; colour 3 on the spikes, crystals and crack lines; colour 2 on the rear studded panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Gladiator_01.differs: The male version has more, larger spikes and a broader contrasting rear panel with studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Golden_Age_Sta.description: Two flat, thick five-pointed stars stacked vertically on the outer side of the right thigh, sitting close to the leg's edge and turned edge-on from the front. Simple superhero-style decorative emblems.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Golden_Age_Sta.differs: The male stars sit at the outer edge of the thigh, are closer together and are more similar in size, so they read edge-on from the front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A right thigh guard of layered, angular armour plates with a smooth curved front shield and separate side and back panels. It sits on the outer thigh from hip to just above the knee, with a sci-fi armoured look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front shield and rim edges; colour 1 on the outer and back plates and edge panels; colour 2 on the recessed inner gaps; colour 3 on the small accent patches near the top and lower front.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The male version is solid painted armour plates with a smooth front shield and colour patterns, whereas the female version is a glowing crackling energy surface.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holstercowboy_.description: An empty western-style thigh holster: a tall open-topped pouch with a rounded knee panel and studded upper band, hanging at the right outer thigh from an octagonal leg loop with light edging.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holstercowboy_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster body, studded band and knee panel; colour 0 on the mid-panels, top lip and loop edging; colour 2 on the studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holstercowboy_.description: An empty western-style thigh holster: a tall, tapered open-topped sheath hanging at the outer right thigh, with banded sections, a rounded central plate, and rows of round studs near the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holstercowboy_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top band, side plate and bottom band, and on the outer back panel; colour 0 on the middle sections and the rim; colour 2 on the studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holsterpistol_.description: A drop-leg pistol holster on the outer right thigh: a long open-topped sleeve holding a chunky sci-fi pistol, secured by two thin angular straps that loop around the thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Holsterpistol_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster sleeve and both thigh straps; colour 3 on the pistol body and grip; colour 2 on the pistol's joint details; colour 0 on the pistol's inner barrel section.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Knife_01.description: A thigh-mounted combat knife: a flat octagonal band circles the upper right thigh, with a broad-bladed knife hanging point-down from it beside the leg, complete with cross-guard and short handle.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band; colour 2 on the handle and cross-guard; colour 3 on the blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Light_01.description: A hip-mounted side plate for the right leg: two overlapping tiers of jagged, leaf-shaped panels with raised vein-like ridges and a bordered edge, hanging over the outer thigh. Fantasy armour with a spiky lower edge.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the panel surfaces; colour 0 on the raised veined ridges and edge trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.description: Two separate angular armoured bands worn stacked on the right upper thigh: a wider upper cuff with a stepped, notched front edge and a narrower lower band with a raised back tab. Both have contrasting rims.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper band; colour 1 on the rim of the upper band; colour 2 on the lower band; colour 3 on the rim of the lower band.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A curved thigh plate worn on the outer right thigh, with patched seams, scratch marks and screw-like fasteners, held by two buckled straps that wrap around the leg. Rugged, mechanical armor look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate; colour 2 on the two straps; colour 3 on the buckles and screw fasteners.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A cluster of angular, jagged mechanical plates fanned around the right outer thigh, with thin blades and shards of varied length standing off the leg. Suggests robotic armor fins on the hip and upper leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate faces and edge blades; colour 1 on the inner panels and plate sections; colour 2 on the inserts and edges; colour 3 on a small band near the lower front plate.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechassn_02.description: A mechanical armoured thigh guard wrapped around the upper right leg: a segmented shell with raised panels and small side modules, an angular lower cuff, and a solid sloped cap across the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechassn_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower cuff and edge frame; colour 1 on the main armour shell and side modules; colour 3 on the top cap; colour 2 on the small recessed vent.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Mechassn_02.differs: The male version has a solid, sloped top cap covering the upper opening instead of a thin open rim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Monster_01.description: A single small bone-like spike with ridged, notched edges, mounted on a thin angular base plate on the outer right thigh and pointing up and back. It suggests a monstrous, beastly growth.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike itself; colour 3 on the base plate and its edge trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Padding.description: A pair of curved, padded armor shells strapped to the right thigh, one on the front and one on the back, sitting close together. Chunky, rounded tactical leg protection.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell edges and outer rims; colour 1 on the large curved panels; colour 2 on the top edge and lower bands; colour 3 on a vertical inset panel on the front shell.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Padding.differs: The front and back shells sit closer together, and the colour 3 inset panel is larger and centred on the front shell.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Pockets_01.description: A band of padded pouches wrapped around the right upper thigh, each a squared, puffy pocket with a flap and a small gem-like clasp, joined by a flat backing strip on one side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Pockets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch bodies; colour 2 on the flat backing strip; colour 3 on the gem clasps.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Pockets_01.differs: The male band has its flat backing strip at the front of the thigh, with pouches around the outer side and back.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Power_01.description: A rigid armoured thigh guard worn on the right leg: an open-backed tapered shell with a tall angled outer plate, a recessed side panel and a stepped notch edge. Reads as a sci-fi mechanical leg accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and rim; colour 1 on the recessed side panel; colour 2 on the rear and inner shell.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Powerarmor_01.description: A sci-fi armored thigh guard on the right leg: a large curved shell with vent holes and small contrasting lights, plus a smaller separate plate at the back, with inset panels and notched tabs at the lower edge.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Powerarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and back plate; colour 2 on the inset panels; colour 0 on small edge details; colour 3 on the small round lights.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Quiver_01.description: A slim tubular quiver strapped to the outer right thigh by an octagonal band, holding several fletched arrows upright with their feathers at the top; small clamps and an end cap hold it along the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Quiver_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh band, quiver frame and arrow fletching; colour 1 on the arrow shafts and clamp sections; colour 2 on the small fasteners; colour 3 on the bottom tip accents.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_01.description: A pair of short tabs with metal rings on the outer right thigh, each holding a long looped strap that hangs in two drooping U-shaped swags down the leg. Suggests a rave or street accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the tabs; colour 0 on the tab edges; colour 2 on the rings; colour 3 on the hanging straps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_02.description: A pair of looped fabric straps hanging from two ringed tabs at the outer right thigh. The straps droop in rounded U-shapes down the leg and stay close to it. A rave or club accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hanging straps; colour 1 on the tabs; colour 0 on the tab edges; colour 2 on the metal rings.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Rave_02.differs: The male straps form deeper, more rounded loops that stay closed near the thigh, rather than trailing loosely to a point.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A rigid thigh guard for the right leg: a tapered open-topped shell with small recessed vents and rivets, ending in a contrasting band and a pointed, notched lower cap just above the knee.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main thigh shell; colour 2 on the band above the lower cap; colour 0 on the lower cap; colour 3 on the small rivets.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The male version is a shorter, broader shell with a wider, flatter lower cap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_Thi.description: A curved, faceted thigh guard wrapping the outer right thigh from hip to above the knee, with angular plating and a rounded lower edge. Sleek, segmented sci-fi armour with a wide open top rim.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_Thi.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the front and outer surface of the guard; colour 0 on the back panel and the angled inner facets; colour 2 on the edge trim.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Retroscifi_Thi.differs: The male guard has a wider, more open rim at the top and sits slightly lower on the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ringsthigh_01.description: A wide thigh wrap made of overlapping criss-crossing strap bands between two contrasting trim bands, with metal rings and buckle plates attached down the outer side. Sits on the right upper thigh, with a punk or mechanical feel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Ringsthigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crossing strap bands; colour 2 on the darker bands beneath them; colour 1 on the top and bottom trim bands; colour 3 on the rings and buckle plates.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Robot_Leg_Atta.description: A boxy mechanical thigh guard on the outer right thigh, with angular plates, pointed upper spikes, three recessed vent slots and thin circuit-like seams. A small tapered pendant piece with two prongs hangs below.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Robot_Leg_Atta.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plate; colour 3 on the recessed vent slots and seam lines; colour 1 on the tapered lower pendant; colour 2 on the small prongs.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Robot_Leg_Atta.differs: The male version sits more to the side of the thigh with its vent slots facing outward, and it has an extra thin spike rising near the hand.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.description: A mechanical thigh-mounted frame on the right leg: an open angular loop of segmented armored plating with a ring-shaped top mount, ribbed vent slots on the back, and a soft panel of cloth inside the frame.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner cloth panel and rim edge; colour 2 on the ribbed armored frame and ring mount; colour 1 and 3 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.differs: The male version's frame hangs a little higher on the outer thigh, with the cloth panel more visible inside the loop.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.description: Right-leg armour set: an open angular thigh band with a ring-shaped clasp on the outer side, plus a separate knee-to-shin guard with a swept horn-like spike and vented panel. Alien-mechanical, sits on the leg as partial armour.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating of the thigh band and shin guard; colour 1 on the vented panel at the knee; colour 3 on the accents under the shin guard; colour 2 on the darker edges and underside.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.description: Two separate armored leg pieces on the right leg: a curved open thigh guard with a ring-like top and a wraparound band, and a lower shin guard with a tall pointed spike and layered edges. Monstrous, partial armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Roinesh_Leg_At.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates of the thigh and shin guards; colour 2 on the edge bands and undersides; colour 1 on the vented inset at the top of the shin guard; colour 3 on the small accents at the front of the shin guard.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Large_.description: A samurai-style hip and thigh guard on the right leg: a curved, angular plate with jagged stepped spikes along the front edge and a swirl-patterned central panel, framed by a raised rim with contrasting trim.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Large_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate, spikes and rim; colour 1 on the thin inner trim line; colour 2 on the swirl panel background; colour 3 on the swirl pattern.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samurai_Large_.differs: The male version has a larger solid plate flaring over the hip and a broader swirl panel that sits higher on the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.description: A thigh band of stacked, ribbed segments wrapping the upper right thigh, with three overlapping curved plates on the outer front and a flat backing panel behind. Suggests samurai-style armor.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the three front plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and the rear backing panel; colour 2 on the ribbed band around the thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.description: A curved hip-and-thigh plate made of four stacked, overlapping lamellar bands, like a samurai tasset, wrapping around the outer side and front of the right upper leg. It looks like segmented armor with framed panels.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate faces; colour 1 on the plate border lines and the inner lining; colour 2 not visible.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.differs: The male plate sits higher at the hip and wraps further round the front of the thigh, so more of the inner lining is visible from the front.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.description: A samurai-style thigh guard: four stacked, curved lamellar plates wrapping the outer right hip and thigh, with a small plate cluster below and a ringed band around the upper thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer faces of the plates; colour 1 on the plate edging and the inner-side panels; colour 2 on the ringed thigh band.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Samuraiplate_0.differs: The male plates hang closer to the thigh and wrap more around the side, with the lower plate cluster sitting directly under them.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scarletshield.description: Two stacked, faceted band straps wrapped around the lower leg just below the knee, each closed with a square buckle on the front and a short tab of contrasting strap. Reads as a utilitarian leg brace.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scarletshield.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands; colour 1 on the strap tabs at the buckle; colour 2 on the buckle frames.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_.description: A sci-fi thigh guard of angular plated panels worn on the outer right thigh: a broad curved shell wraps the side, with a notched upper edge, round stud details, a smaller inner plate and a hanging flap behind.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and edges; colour 1 on the curved inlay panels; colour 2 on the wedge insets; colour 3 on the hanging rear flap.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_.differs: The male version has a larger shell with round studs on the front and a longer, more visible rear flap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A cluster of curved, blade-like fins or claws fanning out from the right hip and hanging down the outer thigh. Each pointed segment has a smooth inner face and a chevron-patterned edge, giving a monstrous aquatic look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth inner faces of the blades; colour 1 on the outlines and edges; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the panels between the stripes.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Shackleankle_0.description: A chunky faceted ankle shackle: a slightly tapered octagonal metal cuff with a seam down the middle, two square lock blocks on each side, and a rounded loop handle projecting from each side. Worn on the right ankle.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Shackleankle_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cuff body; colour 2 on the square lock blocks; colour 1 on the side loop handles.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A sharkfin-style leg accessory on the right outer thigh: layered, jagged angular plates sweep up into a broad pointed fin above a segmented cuff around the knee. It has a sci-fi, monstrous look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fin plates and lower edge blades; colour 1 on the outer side panels and cuff segments; colour 2 on the inset panels and rim; colour 3 on small accent patches near the cuff.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sharkfin_01.differs: The male fin is a broader, fuller sheet at the front that flares wide above the cuff, with a heavier rim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Space_Scoundre.description: A thigh-mounted holster on the right leg: a boxy open-topped case on the outer thigh, held by a flat leg band, with a long angled strap running up toward the hip and a flat octagonal platform below. Sci-fi scoundrel look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Space_Scoundre.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster case, leg band and platform rim; colour 1 on the platform top and the strap's inner section; colour 2 on the long strap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Space_Scoundre.description: A sci-fi thigh holster: a boxy angular pouch hangs on the outer right thigh, held by a flat leg band with a flat top plate, and a long thin strap curves up toward the hip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Space_Scoundre.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body and thigh band; colour 1 on the top plate of the band and the inner strap panel; colour 2 on the upper strap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_01_Basi.description: A cluster of conical metal spikes running down the outer side of the right thigh in several staggered columns, larger ones pointing outward and smaller ones angled forward. A partial, aggressive accessory suggesting punk or monstrous styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_01_Basi.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes, with a glossy metallic finish that shows little of the colour scheme; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Calf_Me.description: A set of three long curved horn-like spikes stacked down the outside of the right calf, each sweeping backward to a sharp point from a short banded base ring. Monstrous, clawlike accent.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Calf_Me.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips as a fade; colour 3 on the base rings.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Thigh_M.description: A set of three curved horn-like spikes stacked closely down the outside of the right thigh, each with a flared base cap and a long tapering tip. Suggests a monstrous or mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Thigh_M.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the horn bodies; colour 1 on the tapering tips; colour 3 on the base caps.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Spikes_Thigh_M.differs: The male spikes sit closer together and point more upward and outward, rather than sweeping back.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Steampunk_Cowb.description: A tall, tapered holster-like sleeve hanging from the hip along the outer thigh, with a flared open top, contrasting stitched edging, a studded strap at the top and three buckled straps below. Steampunk western styling.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Steampunk_Cowb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the holster; colour 1 on the straps and top studded band; colour 3 on the stitched edging; colour 2 on the buckles and studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_01.description: A hip-mounted gadget pack: a boxy rectangular pouch with a central strap and small round indicator, from which several curved, padded striped fins or strips spread out over the hip and buttock, held by contrasting straps.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch and the padded strips; colour 1 on the stripes along the strips; colour 2 on the straps and the pouch's central band; colour 3 on the small round indicator.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_01.differs: The strips spread wider apart like separate claws, rather than a tight bunch.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_02.description: A small rectangular box-shaped pouch worn on the outer right thigh, with a padded body, a flap on the outer face fastened by a round stud, and a vertical strap running down its side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapped_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pouch body and flap; colour 2 on the edge trim and vertical strap; colour 3 on the round fastener.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapsthigh_01.description: A short wrapped thigh band on the right leg: overlapping diagonal strips wind around the upper thigh between two thicker contrasting rims, giving a bandage-like or strapped look with a slightly open top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Strapsthigh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapping strips; colour 2 on the gaps and undersides between strips; colour 1 on the top and bottom rims.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sword_01.description: A sheathed sword worn on the right hip, hanging down the outer thigh at a slight angle. It has a segmented scabbard with banded ridges, a curved forked mouth guard, a crossguard and a wrapped hilt.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard and the curved mouth guard; colour 1 on the crossguard and the pommel cap; colour 2 on the hilt grip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Thighpad_01.description: A padded thigh guard on the right leg: a rounded, ribbed cushion shell over the outer and front thigh with a contrasting cuff at the lower edge, held by two thin straps wrapping around the back of the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Thighpad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded shell; colour 1 on the lower cuff; colour 2 on the two thigh straps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Tyrant_01.description: Two separate angular armor plates on the outside of the right leg: a taller slab at the hip and upper thigh, and a second plate lower down the thigh. Chunky, faceted add-on protection.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Tyrant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both plates; the plates show no other colour slots.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Tyrant_01.differs: The male pads sit closer together on the thigh, with the lower plate directly below the upper one rather than near the knee.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Victory_01.description: A curved, shield-like hip plate hanging at the right hip, tapering to a pointed tip at the front. Layered stripe panels with a raised rim give it a sleek superhero look; the back is a smooth plain shell.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide inner stripe; colour 1 on the upper panel; colour 3 on the middle stripe; colour 2 on the outer rim and the back shell.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Vine_01.description: A curled, organic leaf-like flap that hangs over the outer right thigh, with a smooth outer surface, swirled ridged underside, small hooked spikes and a tall curling tendril tip at the hip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer surface and tendril; colour 0 on the swirled inner ridges and lower edge; colour 3 on the spikes, tendril tips and dots.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Amazon_.description: A straight double-edged sword worn at the right hip, hanging angled down the outer thigh with its tip pointing toward the knee. It has a wrapped grip, a winged guard, a round pommel and loose cord ends.
