Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Amazon_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pommel and grip cap; colour 3 on the grip wrap and dangling cords; colour 1 on the guard; colour 2 on the blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Escrima.description: A slim baton (escrima stick) carried at the right hip in a small holder with a strap and a small stud, hanging straight down the outer thigh. Banded grip end with thin stripe markings along the shaft.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Escrima.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baton shaft; colour 3 on the stripe markings; colour 2 on the holder and strap; colour 1 on the small stud on the holder.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Gamer_0.description: A chunky retro sci-fi ray pistol worn hanging vertically at the outer hip and thigh: a boxy angular body with a wide grip-like fin, small studs and a long cylindrical barrel ending in a banded cap.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Gamer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and barrel; colour 1 on the end cap, side block and rear tip; colour 2 on the recessed panels; colour 3 on the small round studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Sideswo.description: A rapier-style side sword hanging at the right hip, with a long straight narrow blade, an ornate swept hilt with curling guard loops, a wrapped grip and a round pommel. Thin cords trail from the guard. Suggests a swashbuckling look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Sideswo.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the blade and trailing cords; colour 1 on the grip; colour 2 on the guard, crossguard loops and pommel (metal fittings).
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Sideswo.differs: The male sword hangs straighter down the front of the thigh, while the female sword sits angled slightly back and out from the hip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Tonfa_0.description: A tonfa holstered at the right hip: a long straight baton with banded stripes hangs point-down in a contrasting clip-on holder, its short side handle jutting out sideways. A practical, tactical martial-arts weapon.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Tonfa_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the baton shaft; colour 3 on the stripes and bands; colour 1 on the side handle; colour 2 on the holder and handle end caps.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Wood_01.description: A small wooden-style toy sword hanging at the right hip, with a straight flat blade, a chunky bar crossguard, and a wrapped grip ending in a rounded pommel. It hangs point-down along the thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Tight_Weapon_Wood_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the blade; colour 2 on the crossguard; colour 3 on the grip wrapping; colour 0 on the pommel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Traveler_01.description: A tube-like thigh wrap for the right leg, sitting mid-thigh with a slanted top edge and a curved lower hem. Two horizontal bands with ring fasteners across the front give it a sci-fi, practical look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh cover; colour 1 on the two horizontal bands; colour 3 on the ring fasteners; colour 2 on the top edge trim and cap.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_01.description: A pair of padded thigh straps worn high on the right leg, each closed with a buckle clasp, with a small flap pouch attached at the outer side. Practical vigilante or tactical utility gear.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and pouch body; colour 1 on the pouch's central tab; colour 3 on the strap clasps and the pouch stud.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_02.description: A pair of octagonal thigh straps worn one above the other on the right upper leg, each closed with a buckle at the front and edged with contrasting trim. Two flap pouches hang off the outer side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands and the pouches; colour 1 on the strap edging and trim; colour 3 on the buckles.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Vigilante_02.differs: The male version has a small vertical tab on the front of each strap, and its two pouches sit side by side toward the back of the outer thigh.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Waistbag_01.description: A thigh-mounted utility pouch hung from a patterned strap that slants across the hip, with a flap pocket on the outer side, a small side tab, and looping straps with ring fasteners cradling the front of the thigh.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Waistbag_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps and pouch backing; colour 1 on the ring fasteners and the buttons on the flap; colour 2 on the pouch flap and side tab; colour 3 on the stitching and strap pattern.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Brainscramble.description: A chunky sci-fi pistol worn against the outer right thigh, with an angular open-frame body, ribbed grip and barrel, a slanted ridged fin at the rear, and three small cylindrical canisters along one side.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Brainscramble.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and frame; colour 2 on the ribbed grip, barrel and underside; colour 1 on the ridged rear fin panels; colour 3 on the three canisters.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Chakram_01.description: A ring-shaped chakram weapon hanging at the right hip, set edge-on against the thigh. It has a braided grip section, a broad inner band with swirling engraved patterns, and sharp outward-curving blade edges with pointed tips.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Chakram_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade edges; colour 1 on the inner band; colour 3 on the swirling engraved patterns; colour 2 on the braided grip.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Cleaver_01.description: A butcher's cleaver hanging point-down at the right hip: a rectangular broad blade with a small hole in the lower corner, and a rounded handle with rivets. Suggests a gritty, brutal weapon accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Cleaver_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle; colour 0 on the handle edge trim; the blade shows metal and ignores the colour scheme.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Cold_01.description: A sci-fi blaster pistol worn in a bulky mechanical holster on the outer right thigh, with a segmented casing, a round emitter port, vent slits, a curved grip rising at the top and a thin antenna rod.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Cold_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the casing plates and metal housing; colour 1 on the grip, antenna and inner casing panel; colour 2 on the body of the holster; colour 3 on the vent slits and ring markings.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Combat_Knife_.description: A curved, leaf-shaped combat knife (kukri-style) hanging point-down at the right hip, with a short cylindrical handle and a ring collar above a broad blade that swells then tapers to a point.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Combat_Knife_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle and ring collar; colour 1 on the blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Destabilizati.description: A compact sci-fi hand blaster hanging at the outer thigh: a contrasting barrel base with vent slits and downward prongs, a contrasting central chamber, and an angular armored shell with a small side spur on top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Destabilizati.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and top spur; colour 2 on the lower barrel base and prongs' housing; colour 0 on the central chamber; colour 3 on the small inset accents and vent slits.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Destabilizati.differs: The male blaster has a shorter, stubbier side spur and longer, more splayed prongs hanging below the barrel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Gunsword_01.description: A hip-worn gun-sword hybrid: a revolver-style pistol with a curved grip and cylinder, its barrel extended into a long straight blade that hangs down the outer thigh. Mechanical, weapon-like and partial.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Gunsword_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the grip; colour 3 on the pistol frame and hammer; colour 2 on the cylinder; colour 0 on the blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hammer_01.description: A claw hammer worn at the right hip, hanging head-down: a long straight handle with a flat end cap, a metal head with a rounded striking face and a curved claw. Reads as a practical tool-weapon.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hammer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the handle; colour 1 on the hammer head; colour 3 not visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hatchet_01.description: A small hatchet hanging at the right hip beside the thigh: a long straight handle with a short single-bladed axe head at the lower end, hanging point-down. A practical, rugged weapon accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hatchet_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle; colour 0 on the axe head and its edge; colour 2 on the metal socket where the head meets the handle.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Hatchet_01.differs: The male hatchet has a solid handle and metal head, while the female version renders as a glowing translucent outline.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Icepick_01.description: A mountaineering ice axe hanging at the right thigh: a long straight shaft with a padded grip at the top, a metal collar, a curved perforated pick and a small flat adze blade at the bottom.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Icepick_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper grip; colour 1 on the lower shaft; colour 0 on the collar, pick and adze; colour 3 on a tiny mark near the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Icepick_01.differs: The male axe hangs closer to the leg, with the pick curving sideways near the knee, and sits slightly lower.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Katana_01.description: A sheathed katana worn at the right hip: a long, gently curved scabbard with a round guard, a wrapped handle and a short cord tied near the guard. It is slung at a diagonal, hilt forward and tip angled back behind the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Katana_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scabbard; colour 2 on the handle wrap, guard and cord; colour 1 on small fittings at the scabbard mouth and handle.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Katana_01.differs: The male katana is slung at a steeper diagonal, with the hilt angled forward and the tip swept back behind the leg.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Kunai_01.description: A single kunai throwing knife hanging point-down at the right hip: a leaf-shaped pointed blade, a long wrapped handle and a round ring pommel at the top. Ninja-style weapon accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Kunai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade; colour 2 on the wrapped handle; colour 1 on the ring pommel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Mad_Scientist.description: A retro sci-fi ray gun holstered at the right hip: a boxy, chunky body with a vented barrel, small antenna spikes and a flared muzzle, resting in a round dish-shaped cradle with clawed legs.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Mad_Scientist.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gun body and the cradle's claw legs; colour 1 on the muzzle tip, the side panel and the round cradle dish; colour 3 on the stripes and dots; colour 2 on small vents and details.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Mad_Scientist.description: A chunky sci-fi blaster holstered at the right hip and thigh: a boxy body with a round lens-like emitter, a swept-back curved grip or stock, a small canister underneath, and a short muzzle tip pointing down.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Mad_Scientist.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing and emitter housing; colour 1 on the grip, stock and muzzle tip; colour 2 on the swept upper stock and lower vents; colour 3 on the emitter lens and small dots.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Maraca_01.description: A single maraca hanging at the right hip: a rounded gourd head with zigzag and striped bands, a short contrasting collar and a tapering handle pointing upward. Festive, tribal-style percussion prop.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Maraca_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle and one band of the gourd; colour 3 on the zigzag bands; colour 0 on the collar and light bands; colour 2 on the stripes and zigzag edges.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Newspaper_01.description: A tightly rolled newspaper hanging at the right hip, slightly waisted in the middle with printed columns of text and a visible spiral end. It sits beside the thigh as a casual prop.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Newspaper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the newsprint; the printed text and spiral shading come from the texture and are not affected by the other colour slots.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pipe_Wrench_0.description: A large pipe wrench hanging at the right hip, handle up: a thick tapered grip with a capped end, a slim shaft, and an adjustable jaw with a knurled thumb wheel and hooked lower jaw.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pipe_Wrench_0.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the handle end cap; colour 0 on the shaft and hooked jaw; colour 1 on the wrench head housing.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_02.description: A compact submachine gun worn on the right outer thigh, held vertically in an angular open-frame holster band that wraps around the leg; the boxy body has a rear grip and small detail markings.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the gun body; colour 1 on the holster frame; colour 2 on the grip and barrel tip; colour 3 on the small dot markings.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_05.description: A tall, boxy revolver holster hanging at the outer right thigh on a thin loop strap around the leg, with a revolver grip and hammer poking out of the open top, a row of round studs, and a rounded side panel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the holster body and thigh strap; colour 1 on the revolver grip, side panel and lower band; colour 3 on the cartridges inside the top; colour 2 on the hammer and studs.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_Scifi_.description: A retro sci-fi pistol worn on the outer right thigh, hanging with the barrel pointing down. It has an angular swept-back grip, a chunky boxy magazine block and a wrapped holster-like casing around the barrel.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Pistol_Scifi_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and grip; colour 1 on the barrel casing wrap; colour 2 on the magazine block and rear housing; colour 3 on the stripes on the magazine.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Renegade_01.description: A small curved sickle weapon hanging at the right hip: a ring pommel, a cord-wrapped handle with a collar, and a hooked, angular blade with a sharp point. It looks like a sci-fi fantasy weapon.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Renegade_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the handle wrap; colour 0 on the pommel ring and collar; the blade is a glossy mottled metal that largely ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Roller_01.description: A large cartoonish rolling pin hanging at the right hip, hovering beside the thigh: a thick cylindrical barrel with a slightly textured surface and a turned handle protruding from each end.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Roller_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the barrel; colour 1 on both handles.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sai_01.description: A thigh-worn sai: a slim strap band around the upper right thigh holds a pointed sai with a wrapped handle and two curved side prongs, hanging blade-down along the outer leg. Suits ninja or martial styles.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sai_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the thigh strap; colour 0 on the curved prongs and guard; colour 1 on the handle wrap; colour 3 on the long blade.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sickle_03.description: A single-bladed sickle worn at the right hip, with a short grip and a broad crescent blade that sweeps down and back into a sharp hook along the outer thigh. Practical, martial look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sickle_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal blade; colour 1 on the handle grip; colour 2 on the handle end caps.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Sickle_03.differs: The male sickle has a wider, rounder crescent blade, while the female blade is narrower and more elongated with a tighter hook.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spatula_01.description: A oversized kitchen spatula hanging point-down at the right hip: a slotted metal turner blade on a long thin shaft, with a chunky grip handle ending in a hanging loop. A quirky, casual novelty weapon.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spatula_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the grip handle; colour 1 on the loop at the top of the handle; colour 0 on the shaft and slotted blade, which look like glossy metal.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spy_01.description: A sci-fi spy pistol hanging at the right thigh, with a boxy angular body, angled grip and a long barrel ending in two ribbed cylindrical suppressor sections. It hangs vertically at the side of the leg.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pistol body and grip; colour 1 on the ribbed suppressor sections and side grip panels; colour 3 on the small sight and indicator marks; colour 2 on the grip inset panel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spy_02.description: A furled spy umbrella hanging at the right hip: a curved crook handle, a slim shaft, a pleated canopy tied with a small band, and a pointed metal tip. It reads as a gentleman-spy accessory.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Spy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furled canopy; colour 1 on the canopy stripes and the tie band; colour 2 on the shaft and tip; colour 3 on the crook handle.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Stick_02.description: A slender, gently curved wooden stick with a short side branch near its thicker top end, hanging at the right hip along the outer thigh like a carried staff or branch. Rustic, primitive look.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Stick_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole stick; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Straplesspist.description: A strapless right-thigh pistol holster: a tall tapered case with studded upper band, banded lower sections and a knee-like side panel, holding a revolver whose grip, hammer and contrasting cartridges poke out the top.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Straplesspist.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main holster body and revolver frame; colour 1 on the bands, side panel and revolver grip; colour 2 on the studs and hammer; colour 3 on the cartridges and grip trim.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Swing_Cane_01.description: A slim walking cane worn hanging at the right hip, angled down along the thigh. It has a curved handle, a segmented mechanical collar, a long straight shaft and a small metal hooked tip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Swing_Cane_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved handle; colour 3 on the long shaft; colour 0 on the metal collar joints and the hooked tip; colour 2 on the connector segments.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Swing_Pistol_.description: A flintlock-style pistol worn hanging at the right thigh, muzzle pointing down. It has a curved grip with a rounded pommel, a cylindrical chamber, a trigger guard, a hammer, and a long barrel with a glowing slot and capped tip.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Swing_Pistol_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the grip and the lower barrel panel; colour 0 on the upper grip collar and barrel body; colour 2 on the pommel, chamber, hammer and muzzle cap; colour 3 on the slot along the barrel.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Trooper_01.description: A sci-fi blaster pistol holstered against the outer right thigh: a slim angular body with a glowing circuit-line channel, ribbed lower housing and an open looped handle guard. Reads as a sentai-style sidearm.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Trooper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body and ribbed housing; colour 1 on the looped guard and back edge; colour 2 on the recessed centre channel and muzzle; colour 3 on the circuit lines and central node.

Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Wheellockpist.description: A wheellock pistol in a tapered holster hanging at the right hip and thigh, with a curved grip poking out of a wrapped top flap and a long barrel tip extending below the holster.
Male/M_Hipsattach_R_Weapon_Wheellockpist.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the holster top flap and strap; colour 0 on the lower holster body; colour 2 on the grip and barrel; colour 3 on the small lock detail.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Ammo_Harness_01.description: A low-slung harness belt with a buckled strap at the waist, a row of bullet-like cartridges along its edge, and wide straps forming a brief that wraps the hips and groin, leaving the legs bare.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Ammo_Harness_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt and harness straps; colour 3 on the edge piping and inner lining; colour 1 on the cartridge bodies; colour 2 on the buckle and bullet tips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Ammo_Harness_01.differs: The male harness forms a fuller brief-like shape with straps meeting at the groin, rather than diagonal leg straps.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A long flared robe skirt with a studded waistband, an open front split showing two long contrasting panels edged with contrasting trim, and soft draped folds that fall to a slightly uneven calf-to-ankle hem.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the skirt body and waistband; colour 2 on the two front panels; colour 0 on the panel edging and waistband trim; colour 3 on the waistband studs.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A retro robot-style hip brief made of armour-like plates: a raised waistband with a central angular buckle plate at the front, a contrasting inner lining, and a rounded back panel with a pointed chevron seam.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and upper back plates; colour 1 on the lower back panel and side edges; colour 2 on the inner lining and front pouch; colour 3 on the central front plate.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.differs: The male version has a shorter front panel, with the central plate sitting higher and the waistband separated into two side plates.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Blockbuster_01.description: A small hip-layer armour piece on the buttocks: a chunky angular plate with a notched, heart-like top sits between two curved shell plates that flare out over each side of the rear. Bulky, mechanical, monstrous look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central notched plate; colour 0 on the two curved side shell plates.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Blockbuster_02.description: A pair of small angular armor plates at the hips and buttocks, each a separate faceted shell with an inset slanted panel on the back and a thin contrasting edge trim. Reads as a mechanical, superhero-style armored hip accent.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate shells; colour 1 on the thin edge trim; colour 3 on the slanted inset panels at the back.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Bounty_01.description: A pair of separate, stiff hip plates, one on each side of the hips, each a short curved panel with a thin contrasting edge. Worn over the hips as partial armor-like flaps in a space western style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main surface of both plates; colour 2 on the thin edge trim around each plate.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Bounty_01.differs: The male plates are broader and more squared-off, sitting flatter against the sides of the hips.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Clothing_Lockbox_.description: A knee-length wrap skirt with a plain smooth inner front panel, an open front slit, and a back and side cloth patterned with a geometric diamond weave. It has a banded waist and a hem with contrasting trim and pointed, uneven corners.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Clothing_Lockbox_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and the plain front panel; colour 1 on the diamond motifs; colour 3 on the zigzag lines between the diamonds; colour 2 on the hem trim.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Mutated_01.description: A set of small curved horn-like spikes studded around the hips: two large tusks curve out at each side of the hips, with a row of tiny thorns along the front and back of the waistline.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the horns and spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Mutated_01.differs: The male version has slightly larger, more closely spaced front thorns, and the side tusks sit a little higher on the hips.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Skirt_Birdpeople_.description: A pair of separate rigid thigh shells, each an octagonal tube wrapping the upper leg from hip to just above the knee, with an open cut-out on the front and small strap fasteners at the lower edge.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Skirt_Birdpeople_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main thigh shells; colour 1 on the outer side and back faces; colour 2 on the small fasteners at the lower edges.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Swan_01.description: A pair of separate feathered hip wings, one on each side of the hips, made of layered swept feathers that taper to pointed tips and hang down over the outer thighs. Suggests a fantasy bird-like look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper feathers; colour 1 on the lower feather tips, fading from the upper part; a thin edge binding along the top of each wing takes colour 0.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Swan_01.differs: The male wings have a thinner edge binding along the top and sit slightly higher on the hips.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Angel_Epic_.description: A small curved armour plate worn over the rear hips and lower back, with a jagged bat-wing upper edge, a pointed lower tip and a round emblem at the centre. The front is an open shell, giving a monstrous, mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Angel_Epic_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer back plate surface; colour 1 on the rim, edging and inner shell; colour 3 on the central emblem.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Victory_02.description: A small shield-shaped hip panel that tapers to a point over the upper thigh, with a thick raised border and swooping chevron ribs down the face. Superhero-style, it sits on the side of the hip as a partial accessory.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Child_Tight_Victory_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer border; colour 0 on the flat panel between the ribs; colour 3 on the raised swooping ribs and chevrons; colour 1 on the small diamond at the tip.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Corrupted_01.description: A partial hip skirt made of two pointed tabards, front and back, with layered bordered edges. A ragged, jagged-edged side panel hangs at each hip. Sits low on the hips, ending at mid-thigh, with a fantasy-warrior look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central face of the front and back tabards; colour 1 on the inner border band; colour 2 on the outer edge trim; colour 3 on the ragged side panels.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Crimson_01.description: A knee-length split skirt of quilted, scale-like textured panels that opens at the centre front and back, edged with curled trim and a riveted hem band, sitting on the hips under a thin waistband.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured skirt panels; colour 1 on the curled edge trim and hem piping; colour 2 on the riveted hem band; colour 3 on the waistband.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Crimson_01.differs: The male skirt hangs a little straighter with a narrower slit, covering more of the thighs.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Lockbox_66_02.description: A calf-length wrap skirt with a gathered, draped hip overlayer fading into a lower panel of diamond-patterned cloth, with a contrasting hem band and pointed, uneven edges. Wrapped around the hips and open at the front.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the draped hip overlayer and the pattern background; colour 1 on the diamond motifs and the lower fade of the drape; colour 3 on the zigzag pattern lines; colour 2 on the hem band.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Lockbox_66_02.differs: The male skirt wraps more closed at the front, with a single overlapping flap rather than layered open flaps, and a slightly shorter hem.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Retro_Talisman.description: Loose, plain athletic shorts with an elasticated waist, a centre seam and separate legs ending just above the knee, with a smooth gradient toward the hem. Sits at the hips with a sporty, casual look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Retro_Talisman.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waist and upper shorts; colour 1 on the lower legs and hem fade.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Retro_Talisman.differs: The male version is a pair of knee-length shorts with separate legs, while the female version is a short mini skirt.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_01.description: Casual knee-length board shorts with an elastic waistband and a tied drawstring at the front, loose cloth legs, and a large printed tropical flower pattern across the front and back.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric and waistband; colour 1 on the large flower shapes; colour 3 on the smaller leaf and petal shapes and hem edge; colour 2 on the drawstring.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_02.description: Loose knee-length board shorts with an elastic waistband, a drawstring tied in a bow at the front and an all-over pattern of shark silhouettes. They sit at the hips and hang straight to just above the knee.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts fabric and waistband; colour 1 on some of the shark shapes; colour 3 on the other shark shapes; colour 2 on the drawstring.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_03.description: Short, high-waisted brief-style swimsuit bottom with a printed branching, coral-like vein pattern across the body and a smooth contrasting waistband and leg-opening edging. Sits at the hips and covers only the pelvis.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base fabric; colour 1 and colour 3 on the branching pattern; colour 2 on the waistband and leg trim.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_04.description: A cloth sarong-style hip wrap tied in a knot at the front hip, with loose hanging ends, an asymmetric diagonal hem and a patterned floral body with contrasting border trim. Sits at the hips, above the knee.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Swimsuit_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap fabric; colour 1 on the large round flower motifs; colour 3 on the small flowers and border pattern; colour 2 on the hem border and underside edge.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Back_.description: A short split skirt panel worn at the hips that wraps around the sides and back. Two separate flared flaps with contrasting edge trim leave a gap down the centre back, and the piece ends at upper thigh length.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Back_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surface of the flaps; colour 1 on the inner surface; colour 2 on the edge trim along the flap borders.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Back_.description: A rear-hanging cloth skirt panel split down the centre into two pointed tails with a contrasting edge trim. It hangs from the waist to about knee level and leaves the front of the legs open, in a traveler style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Back_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 2 on the edge trim along the hem and centre split.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Front.description: A short, hip-length cloth skirt split into separate front and back panels, with a slit down the centre front and back. A contrasting stripe with small buttons runs down each front edge, and contrasting trim outlines every hem.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Front.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt panels; colour 1 on the vertical front stripes; colour 2 on the edge trim and waistband; colour 3 on the buttons.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Front.description: A knee-length wrap skirt of cloth split into front and back panels with pointed, uneven hems, hanging from the hips. Contrasting bands with small studs run down the front slits, and contrasting trim edges every panel.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Front.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt panels; colour 1 on the vertical front bands; colour 3 on the small studs along the bands; colour 2 on the edge trim.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Clothing_Traveler_Front.differs: The front panels overlap with the banded edges close together at the centre, rather than a wide gap between them as on the female version.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Cosmic_01.description: A sci-fi hip armour set of angular plates: a pointed front panel hanging over the groin and hips, a matching rear plate, and separate tapered plates flaring at each hip. Segmented, sleek and partial in coverage.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front panel, rear plate and hip plate edges; colour 1 on the oval inset panels and hip accents; colour 2 on the horizontal band across the front and the hip plate edges; colour 3 on small rear markings.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Cosmic_01.differs: The male front panel is mostly light with an oval contrasting inset and a contrasting horizontal band, and the rear plate is plain and light; the female version has a mostly contrasting front panel.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Cosmic_02.description: A short segmented hip skirt of three separate rigid panels, one at the front and one at each hip, with a broad horizontal band across the middle and angular cut-in details. Sits low on the hips in a sci-fi armoured style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Cosmic_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large curved patches of the front and side panels; colour 0 on the panel bases, edges and back panels; colour 2 on the horizontal band across the middle; colour 3 on small edge accents at the sides.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Cosmic_02.differs: The male version has a broad horizontal band across the middle of the front and side panels, and a plain back with round discs on the side panels.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Cosmos_01.description: A pair of angular hip guards shaped like layered blades, one on each hip. Each has a broad shield-like upper plate with inset trim lines and pointed segmented tips that taper down the thigh. Suggests a mechanical or monstrous sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper plates; colour 3 on the inset trim lines; colour 0 on the metallic lower blade edges; colour 2 on the inner blade panels.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Crimson_01.description: A short armoured hip skirt of jagged, pointed plates with a curved waist band and swirling scroll ornaments at the hips. It hangs to the upper thighs in split front and back panels with a gap at the centre, in a fantasy style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt plates; colour 1 on the waist band panel; colour 2 on the raised edging, scroll ornaments and the centre-front panel.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Crimson_01.differs: The male version has a narrow contrasting centre strip between two matching front plates, so the front looks more symmetrical.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Cryo_01.description: A set of four separate curved hip plates that sit around the hips: two small ones at the front sides and two wider ones at the sides and back. Smooth and sleek, with slightly flared edges and no fastenings.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the plates; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Defender_Update_01.description: A pair of hip-mounted armour fins: overlapping pointed blade-like plates that taper down the outer hips and upper thighs, each with contrasting banded clasps and glowing-strip inlays. A sci-fi partial piece over the tights.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the pointed blade plates; colour 2 on the banded clasps and top caps; colour 3 on the inlaid strips.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Defender_Update_02.description: A pair of hip-mounted armored panels on the outer thighs: overlapping angular fin-like plates stacked down each side, banded by contrasting segmented straps with glowing slot details. A sci-fi, superhero look that leaves the centre open.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Defender_Update_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large overlapping plates; colour 2 on the segmented bands and top caps; colour 3 on the slot inlays within the bands.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Draco_01.description: A pair of curved hip guards worn on the outer hips, each built from stacked overlapping plates with pointed fin-like edges and small triangular spikes, tapering downward. Suggests dragon-scale armor with a mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main curved plates; colour 1 on the layered trim bands and lower edges; colour 3 on the triangular spikes.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Element_Fire_01.description: A ragged ring of translucent flame tongues wrapped around the hips, with pointed licks hanging down over the upper thighs and a gap at the front centre. Reads as a blazing partial skirt.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The default material is a glowing, semi-transparent energy effect that ignores the colour scheme; the whole piece shows its own fire glow.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Element_Fire_01.differs: The male version is made of translucent glowing flames rather than solid glossy flame-shaped pieces.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Extra_Clothing_Traveler.description: A short skirt-like hip cover made of two flat, slightly flared panels split down the centre, with contrasting edge trim. It sits at the hips and hangs to the upper thigh, covering mostly the back and sides.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Extra_Clothing_Traveler.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panel surfaces; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Extra_Clothing_Traveler.description: A rear-only cloth skirt panel hanging from the hips, split down the centre into two long pointed tails with hemmed edges. It reaches roughly knee to calf length behind the legs, in a traveler style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Extra_Clothing_Traveler.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 2 on the edge trim along the hems and centre split.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Gamer_01.description: A hip harness of thin flat straps forming loops around the hips and upper thighs, joined at rounded hubs front and back, with small square buckles and forked clip-like prongs rising near the waist.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Gamer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the straps; colour 1 on the forked prongs; colour 2 on the buckles; colour 3 on the rounded hubs and joints.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Gladiator_01.description: A short gladiator-style loincloth of gathered cloth at the hips, with a long pointed apron panel hanging at the front and back, edged in thick contrasting trim with stepped chevron bands. It ends at the upper thigh.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth; colour 2 on the outer edge trim; colour 3 on the inner chevron band; colour 1 on the lower chevron band.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Gladiator_02.description: A short gladiator-style hip skirt with a broad rounded side panel, a pointed central front plate with small inset windows, and slim contrasting tabs beside it. The back has contrasting jagged tabs, and a rim edges the piece.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the side panels and central front plate; colour 0 on the slim side tabs; colour 2 on the edge trim, the belt-like top and the back tabs; colour 3 on the insets of the front plate.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Gladiator_02.differs: The male version has a solid front plate with insets, trim edging and contrasting jagged back tabs, whereas the female version is a simpler translucent set of tabs.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Heraldry_01.description: A short armored hip skirt of stacked, overlapping segmented plates over a fitted waist band, open at the front centre and split at the back. Small rivets edge the plates, with short tie straps at the waist. It suggests medieval or fantasy armor.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waist band and upper hip panel; colour 0 on the segmented plates; colour 2 on the plate edging and outlines; colour 3 on the tie straps and rivets.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Kaiju_01.description: A short, brief-like armoured hip guard of layered ridged plates, with pointed fin-like flares jutting out at each hip and a smooth rounded back panel; sits low on the pelvis with a monstrous, sci-fi feel.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ridged front plates; colour 3 on the smooth back panel and inner lining; colour 0 on the fin-like hip flares.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Lockbox_66_01.description: A knee-length cloth wrap skirt that hangs from the hips, open at the front with a wide V and pointed, uneven hems. The back is draped and gathered, with a geometric diamond-patterned lower panel and contrasting edge trim.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper draped cloth and inner lining; colour 1 on the gradient fade and the diamond motifs; colour 3 on the zigzag lines of the pattern; colour 2 on the hem trim.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Lockbox_66_02.description: A pair of separate curved hip guards, one over each hip, each a pointed shield-like plate with a raised rim, a ring ornament near the top and a tapering point that hangs down the upper thigh. Sci-fi armour styling.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rims and outer frames; colour 1 on the inset panels; colour 3 on the small chevron and stripe accents along the lower edge; colour 2 on the ring detail and inner grooves.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_01.description: A long, flowing skirt with a gathered waistband, a tiered ruffle across the hips, and uneven handkerchief-style hems edged with ruffles. It falls to about the ankles and is mostly closed at the front and back.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt panels and hip ruffle; colour 1 on the waistband and the ruffled hem edging.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The male skirt hangs as a fuller, mostly closed skirt with a drop-front hem, rather than the deep front split showing the legs.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_02.description: A short hip-layer skirt of overlapping pointed tapered tabs hanging from a banded waist, with a knotted, wrapped front and a scalloped rear plate; the fangs or claw-like tips give it a tribal, beastly look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Lockbox_67_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the waistband, front centre panel and some of the tabs; colour 0 on the front wraps, rear plate and long back tabs; colour 2 on the rear panel and alternating tabs; colour 3 on a thin edge at the top of the waist.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Long_Swing_01.description: A long, full flared skirt with a short overlaid tier at the hip. Chevron stripes sit on the upper tier, geometric patterned bands trim both hems, and a ruffled contrasting flounce finishes the hem at calf length.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Long_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt body and waistband; colour 1 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the patterned trim bands; colour 3 on the ruffled bottom flounce.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Martial_Power_01.description: A short martial hip skirt of quilted, padded side panels that flare outward, with pointed contrasting front and back panels and crossed wrap bands at the waist. contrasting edging outlines every panel; sits low on the hips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Martial_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the quilted side panels; colour 0 on the front and back triangular panels; colour 1 on the crossed waist wraps; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Mecha_01.description: A mechanical hip-layer armour piece: a rounded pelvic shell with a tapering front plate, angular hip guards on both sides, and two segmented plates hanging at the back. Sits low on the hips with a sci-fi mecha look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shell and back plates; colour 0 on the front plate and hip guard plates; colour 2 on the lower shell and plate edges; colour 3 on the back panel inserts and small accents.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A short, brief-style hip piece of stiff armored panels: a thick rounded rim at the waist, large angular side plates, a central vertical stripe and curved lower panels that cut high at the legs. Sits low on the hips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the large side plates; colour 0 on the central front and back stripe; colour 3 on the lower curved panels; colour 2 on the waist rim and edge outlines.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.description: Short, snug hip-hugging shorts with a large rectangular front panel, angular side panels edged in contrasting piping, and small round studs down each side. Sits at the hips and ends at the upper thigh, with a sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shorts body; colour 1 on the front panel and side panels; colour 2 on the piping edges; colour 3 on the round studs.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Sapphire_01.differs: The male version has shorter side panels that stay higher on the hips, with slim panels visible at the back edges.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.description: A knee-length split skirt with a fitted hip yoke, a narrow centre panel with vertical line details and an angular knotted emblem near the hem, and broad side panels with a pointed, uneven lower edge.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide side panels; colour 1 on the hip yoke and the centre panel; colour 2 on the seam lines and the top edge; colour 3 on the emblem at the hem.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_01.differs: The male version is shorter and fuller, with broad side panels joined directly to the yoke and no separate thigh band.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_02.description: A knee-to-shin length open-sided skirt with a fitted hip yoke, a central panel with vertical line detailing ending in a lattice motif, and flowing side panels with pointed, uneven hems.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flowing side panels; colour 1 on the hip yoke and central panel; colour 2 on the outlines and vertical lines; colour 3 on the lattice motif at the hem of the centre panel.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Modern_Witchcraft_02.differs: The male skirt is shorter, with a broader central panel and the lattice motif sitting higher, compared with the longer, narrower female panel.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Mutated_01.description: A fleshy, muscle-like monstrous hip wrap of ribbed lumpy tissue covering the hips and upper thighs, with tapering tendril tails hanging down, bony horn spikes jutting from the sides, and small eye-like contrasting nodules.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Mutated_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the fleshy body and tendrils; colour 0 on the horn spikes; colour 1 on the small nodules; colour 2 on the eye spots.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Mutated_01.differs: The male version is a shorter, bulkier mass sitting over the hips with tendrils ending around mid-thigh, rather than the longer split hang of the female one.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Nighthawk_01.description: A sleek armoured hip piece: a segmented belt band with a V-shaped front, a pointed codpiece-like plate, and a rounded, ribbed panel covering the seat at the back. Suggests a sci-fi or tactical look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Nighthawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates and rear panel; colour 2 on the belt band, grooves and inset slots; colour 1 is not clearly visible.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Pants_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: Baggy knee-length pirate breeches with a wide fitted waistband, full billowing legs and gathered cuffs that pouch below the knee. A swashbuckling look worn low on the hips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Pants_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the waistband; colour 1 on the main body of the legs; colour 0 on the gathered lower legs and cuffs, blending smoothly into colour 1.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Power_01.description: A brief hip garment like a brief-style loincloth: a wide stiff waistband with a square buckle plate at the front, a small tapered panel hanging in front and a curved panel across the rear. Sits low on the hips with a superhero look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Power_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband; colour 1 on the square buckle plate and its ring; colour 3 on the front and rear cloth panels.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A low-slung hip guard of faceted, angular plates: a thin band around the hips with sharp thorn-like spikes at each side, a pointed front pouch-like panel, and a tapering plate at the back.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: The piece shows a glossy metallic finish that largely ignores the colour scheme; colour 0 appears faintly on the plates.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Psionic_Dragon_01.differs: The male version has a narrower, more pouch-like front panel and a longer, broader back plate.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Pumpkin_01.description: A pair of separate hip guards, one on each side: bony, openwork shell plates with jagged edges and curved contrasting horns on top, over segmented lamellar plates that hang down the outer thigh. Monstrous fantasy style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Pumpkin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony outer shells; colour 1 on the segmented hanging plates and the inner panels; colour 2 on the horns.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A chunky armored hip belt of angular plates: raised side pods with contrasting panels, a V-shaped front plate dipping over the groin, and a faceted tapering plate hanging down the back. Sits low on the hips; sci-fi warlord style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor plates and back plate; colour 3 on the side hip panels and small accents; colour 1 on the V-shaped front plate and inner edge trim. The glossy inner surface ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A brief, rigid brief-style hip piece with a glossy metallic outer shell, a raised rim at the waist, two small vertical plates at the front centre, and a contrasting inner lining. It sits low on the hips, with a retro mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rim; colour 1 on the inner lining and edge band; colour 2 on the small front plates and the underside.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Sacred_01.description: A short hip-layer wrap resembling a brief loincloth or skirt: a thick rolled waistband with a contrasting piped panel at the back, and soft cloth that hangs to the upper thighs, pointed at the back and with side flaps at the front.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rolled waistband and main cloth; colour 2 on the back waist panel and front-side underlayer; colour 1 on the piping along the panel edges.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_01.description: A brief, jockstrap-like hip piece: a wide belt band angles down to a pentagonal front pouch, with a rounded, trimmed rear panel held by side straps. Sleek, revealing and superhero in style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front pouch plate and rear panel; colour 1 on the edge trim, side straps and fabric behind the pouch; colour 2 on the belt band; colour 3 on the corner tabs beside the front plate.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_01.differs: The male belt slants diagonally down to the front pouch and thin straps hold the rear panel, rather than a level band with fuller fabric folds.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_02.description: A brief, brief-style hip layer: a padded waistband with a V-shaped front panel over a layered underbrief, with a small angular armoured plate at the front that tapers into a narrow strip between the legs. Sits low on the hips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the underbrief and lower layer; colour 1 on the padded waistband and front panel; colour 3 on the front plate and the strip between the legs.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Santa_Coat_01.description: A short, flared coat skirt sitting at the hips, with a fluffy rolled hem, a wide contrasting front panel edged with a thick fur-like band, and a round button or buckle at the centre. Festive holiday styling.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Santa_Coat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the skirt; colour 0 on the front panel and the rolled hem; colour 2 on the edging band beside the front panel and the top edge; colour 3 on the side and back accent panels and the top front patch.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Scarab_02.description: A short, rigid armoured hip guard shaped like a beetle shell: sculpted plates wrap the hips and rear with a V-shaped front, raised side fins, curved groove accents and a small pointed centre piece at the crotch.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 1 on the front centre piece and underside edge; colour 3 on the curved accent grooves; colour 2 on the inner side fins.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Shorts_Breeches_01.description: Knee-length fitted breeches with a wide contrasting waistband, small buttons at the waist, and cuffed hems. A row of buttons runs up a contrasting side panel on each outer leg. Suggests a period or pirate look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Shorts_Breeches_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main breeches fabric; colour 1 on the waistband, hem cuffs and side button panels; colour 2 on the buttons.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Arcane_01.description: A short hip-slung wrap skirt of smooth cloth with a crossing front overlap, twisted rope-like trim at the waist and hem, and a winged eye emblem at the centre front. Mystic, fantasy look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt cloth; colour 2 on the twisted rope trim at waist and hem; colour 3 on the winged emblem; colour 1 on the eye centre of the emblem.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Birdpeople_01.description: A hip-slung skirt with a smooth gathered upper cloth section, a contrasting band along its hem, and rigid armored thigh plates below with strap brackets. A long knotted cloth flap hangs down the front centre.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the gathered upper cloth, fading toward colour 0 lower down; colour 0 on the thigh plates and front flap; colour 2 on the band along the hem of the cloth.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Birdpeople_01.differs: The front flap is knotted high at the waist and hangs longer, reaching lower than the thigh plates, and the cloth skirt falls longer and straighter.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Drka_01.description: A knee-skimming wrapped cloth kilt sitting at the hips, with a soft draped surface and a slanted front opening. A tapering tie-like panel with a contrasting border hangs down the centre front.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main kilt cloth; colour 1 on the border of the centre front panel; colour 2 on the inner tapering panel.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Drka_01.differs: The male kilt hangs a bit longer and straighter, reaching the upper thigh with a slanted front hem.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Egyptian_01.description: A knee-above Egyptian-style kilt of horizontally banded cloth with fine pinstripes, wrapped around the hips with a slanted front hem, and a long tapering panel hanging down the front centre.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Egyptian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded wrap of the kilt; colour 3 on the thin stripes between the bands; colour 1 on the long front panel, fading darker toward its tip.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Egyptian_01.differs: The male kilt is a flatter, straighter wrap covering the hips evenly, with the front panel hanging over a smooth front, not gathered and folded open like the female one.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Firebird_01.description: A hip-slung, mid-thigh skirt with a slim waistband and a draped panel that dips to a point at the front and back. Long pointed feather-like tabs with inset gem shapes hang from the hem around the thighs.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt panel and tab bodies; colour 1 on the edge piping along the hem and tabs; colour 2 on the waistband; colour 3 on the gem-like inserts in the tabs.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Firebird_01.differs: The male skirt hangs evenly around the hips with tabs spread wider, including a full row of longer tabs across the back.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Hakama_01.description: A long, wide-legged hakama with a wrapped sash waistband, vertical pleats down the front and a smooth flared back. It falls to the ankles and is worn over the hips. East-asian martial style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Hakama_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pleated body and waist sash; colour 2 on the thin pleat lines and small back hip details; colour 1 on the inner panel and back lining.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Hakama_01.differs: The male version has closed sides at the hips with no cut-out openings, and the pleats hang more evenly to the ankles.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Long_Cairngorn_01.description: A long, flared layered skirt-robe hanging from the waist to about the calves, with a tiered pointed hem, a contrasting triangular front panel and trim along each layer's edge. Loose cloth with a simple fantasy look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Long_Cairngorn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt cloth; colour 1 on the front triangular panel and the hem trim bands.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Long_Cairngorn_01.differs: The male version hangs straighter and a bit fuller, with the front panel starting slightly lower at the waist.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Military_01.description: A short, plain cloth skirt sitting at the hips, hanging to the upper thigh with slits at both sides and a thin contrasting edge trim along the hem and slits. Suggests a simple military or tunic-style kilt.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Military_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt cloth; colour 1 on the trim along the hem and side slits.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Trumpknight_01.description: A short wrap-style cloth skirt sitting at the hips, with a side slit and large angular colour-blocked panels. The hem is uneven and dips lower at the back. Suggests a casual, fantasy-tinged look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Trumpknight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper front wedge and the lower back hem; colour 1 on the large diagonal panel over the front and back; colour 2 on the front lower band; colour 3 on the side and rear-side panel.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_01.description: A knee-length wrap skirt sitting low on the hips, with a V-shaped front waist flap, a slanted asymmetric hem, repeating chevron stripes and a bold hem band with contrasting piped edging. Tribal, warrior-like look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt body; colour 1 on the chevron stripes, waist flap and wide hem band; colour 2 on the small dashed and chevron marks at the waistband; colour 3 on the piped hem edge.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_01.differs: The male skirt has a shallower front hem notch and a longer side drape that sweeps lower on one hip.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_02.description: A knee-length wrap skirt with banded waistbands, a wide back panel and open side flaps. A narrow patterned apron with diamond motifs hangs down the front centre. Tribal, warrior-like look, worn low on the hips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt body and the pattern's light areas; colour 1 on the back panel, front side patches and apron stripes; colour 2 on the waistbands, trim bands and the apron's pattern; colour 3 on the top waist panel, the edge piping and the apron diamonds.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Skirt_Warrior_02.differs: The male skirt has a centred front apron with symmetrical side flaps, and the flaps hang shorter than on the female version.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Steelarachnid_01.description: Brief armoured hip piece shaped like a segmented arachnid shell: a plated front with small vent-like slits, ridged overlapping plates across the rear split by a central strip, cut like briefs at the hips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim and front plating; colour 1 on the ridged rear plates and side segments; colour 3 on the central rear strip and the small slits.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Steelcommando_01.description: A low-slung armored hip piece: a thick angular plated waistband dipping to a pointed V at the front, with a pointed codpiece-like panel and separate rounded shorts panels covering the buttocks and upper hips at the back.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plated waistband and central front and back panel; colour 1 on the rounded hip and buttock panels; colour 0 on the inner lining of the band.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Subligar_Long_Viper_01.description: A partial hip belt with a snake-head buckle at the front, spiked plated guards over each hip and a long narrow segmented scaled panel hanging down the front to mid-thigh; a thin cord loops around the waist.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Subligar_Long_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip guard spikes and belt plates; colour 1 on the hip guard pods and thin cord; colour 2 on the guard undersides and inner details; colour 3 on the long scaled front panel.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Subligar_Long_Viper_01.differs: The male version has a wider band with a shorter, broader scaled panel and the back is a plain waist band.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Subligar_Rockcrystal_01.description: A brief-shaped hip piece of cracked, stacked stone plates with a row of crystal shards rising along the waist edge, held by a very thin strap around the hips. Monstrous, fantasy look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Subligar_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stone plates and thin strap; colour 3 on the crack lines between the plates; colour 1 on the crystal shards.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Subligar_Rockcrystal_01.differs: The male version has a more compact, higher-sitting pouch with crystals clustered at the sides and a barely visible strap.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Super_Retro_Destroyer_0.description: A brief, smooth superhero brief-style hip piece with a high-cut leg opening and a flat, capped top edge, sitting at the hips with a sleek, glossy finish and no added details.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Super_Retro_Destroyer_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rim and top edge; colour 1 on the main body of the briefs; colour 2 on the inner lining.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Super_Retro_Destroyer_0.differs: The male version has a flat, capped top, while the female version has a dished, bowl-like top opening.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Swan_01.description: A hip-slung armored belt with angular plates and faceted gems at each hip, a brief panelled front and back, and long pointed feathered side flaps hanging down the outer thighs. Fantasy-mechanical winged look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Swan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armor plate rims and feather fringe; colour 1 on the front and back panels and the feathered flaps; colour 2 on the belt band underside; colour 3 on the hip gems.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Swing_01.description: A short hip-slung skirt-like wrap with a layered flounce, open at the front in two angular tail-like flaps with rows of small buttons, revealing a striped lining inside. Sits around the hips with a jacket-tail look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Swing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer skirt flaps and flounce; colour 1 on the striped inner lining; colour 3 on the buttons and button tabs.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Swing_01.differs: The male version is a taller, band-like waist wrap that sits higher on the torso, with more evenly cut flaps.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Alien_01.description: A low-slung hip band forming a wide V-shaped brief: crossing angular panels sweep up at the front and wrap around the hips, ending in a small pointed plate at the groin and back. Sleek, alien-looking armor.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band and crossing panels; colour 1 on the pointed plates at the front and back and the inner lining.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Alien_01.differs: The male band is taller with a more steeply peaked V at the front and back, while the female sits lower and flatter.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_01.description: A small hip-layer loincloth of armored plates: a shield-shaped front and back panel, each with a V-shaped emblem, a contrasting hanging tab below and swept spikes at the top corners. Hangs at the groin and rear over tights.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the plate frames and side plates; colour 0 on the V-shaped inner bands; colour 3 on the central emblem and the top spikes; colour 2 on the hanging lower tabs.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_02.description: A small armoured hip piece: a shield-shaped plate with a circular emblem, angular spiked fins at the sides, and a long narrow pointed tail panel hanging down the front, plus a matching side plate on the hip.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer plate shell and side plate; colour 0 on the inner panel; colour 3 on the emblem and spikes; colour 2 on the long hanging tail panel.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_Epic_04.description: A small rigid rear hip plate shaped like a curved shield with jagged, horn-like upper points and a pointed lower tip. It sits over the buttocks and lower back, with a raised rim and a central emblem. Fantasy-armor styling.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Angel_Epic_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the raised rim and the inner shell; colour 3 on the central emblem.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Anniversary_Witch.description: A knee-length wrap skirt sitting at the waist, with an overlapping diagonal front panel, asymmetric pointed hem and thin contrasting edge piping. Its smooth cloth fades in shade from top to bottom, giving a retro witchy look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Anniversary_Witch.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper skirt body; colour 1 on the lower hem area as a gradient; colour 3 on the edge piping and a small tab at the waist.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Armorninja.description: Short, form-fitting briefs-style shorts sitting low on the hips, with a pointed upper edge and small peaked tabs at the sides. Curved panels sweep across the front and back, and a lower band covers the hips and seat.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper waist band and front panel; colour 1 on the large curved side and back panels; colour 2 on the lower seat and crotch section.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombie_0.description: A wide wrap of layered bandage strips wound around the hips and lower waist, with overlapping rough-edged bands and contrasting gaps between them. It sits low like a short wrapped skirt or belt, suggesting a mummy or zombie look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombie_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main bandage strips; colour 1 on the underlying layer visible along the lower edge; colour 2 on the thin gaps and creases between strips.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombie_0.description: A skirt-like wrap of overlapping bandage strips coiled around the hips and upper thighs, with gaps between the loops and a slanted, uneven lower edge. Suggests a ragged mummy or zombie look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Bandages_Zombie_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bandage strips; colour 2 on the thin edge lines and shadowed undersides between strips.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Barbarian_Norse_0.description: A tribal fur loincloth-style brief with shaggy, jagged-edged fur around the hips and upper thighs, worn under a wide studded belt with a large sculpted buckle at the front. Barbarian, Norse-inspired look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Barbarian_Norse_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur body; colour 1 on the fur tips; colour 2 on the belt strap; colour 3 on the studs and buckle.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A hip-slung tattered skirt with a jagged spiky waistband, a pointed V-shaped front panel with ragged hem, angled side strips, and long tapering tail-like strips hanging down the centre. Beastly, savage style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt panels; colour 1 on the waistband spikes and the tips of the hanging strips; colour 2 on the edge piping and the inner strips; colour 3 on the angled side strips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The male skirt has fuller, longer side and back panels that reach lower, with the central strips shorter and less prominent at the front.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Deity_01.description: A brief, high-cut brief-style hip piece with a stiff angular band around the waist that rises into notched points at front and back, and a smooth cloth-like seat and pouch below. Sits low on the hips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front pouch and the upper waistband; colour 1 on the back, side panels and inner lining.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Electric_01.description: A brief, armored hip layer shaped like high-cut briefs, with a segmented front plate, ribbed rear panels, and two curved cable-like conduits arching up from the hips over contrasting coil springs. Sci-fi tesla-coil styling.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main brief shell and rim; colour 1 on the ribbed front and rear panels; colour 2 on the conduits and hip mounts; colour 3 on the coil springs and thin piping lines.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Electric_01.differs: The male version has coiled springs at the base of each hip conduit and lacks the thin wire linking the two conduits across the front.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Fairyskirt_01.description: A short hip-slung skirt with a ragged, leaf-like hem of pointed tapering tips, made of layered panels with a contrasting band across the middle. It sits low at the waist and ends at the upper thigh.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Fairyskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front and back centre panels and the tip points; colour 1 on the side and lower petal-shaped panels; colour 2 on the wide middle band; colour 3 on small inner panels at the sides.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Fantasy_01.description: A fantasy hip piece: a short contrasting loincloth-style wrap with a pointed, trimmed hem, worn under a studded belt with round shield-like plates, a large ornate oval buckle at the front and smaller discs at the sides.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrap; colour 1 on the hem trim; colour 3 on the belt band and shield plates; colour 2 on the studs, buckle relief and belt edging.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A low-slung hip belt with a thin band around the hips, angular blocky pouches at the sides and back, and a faceted pouch at the front groin. It has a sleek, futuristic look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the belt band and the front pouch underside; colour 1 on the pouch tops and front pouch; colour 2 on the side and back pouch panels; colour 3 on small patches on the pouches and back.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Holoforce_01.differs: The male version is solid with distinct coloured panels, while the female version is a translucent holographic effect.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Knight_02.description: A short armoured hip skirt of three stacked, overlapping plates ringing the hips, studded with cone spikes at the sides and back, with a long narrow tapered front tabard hanging to mid-thigh and bearing a tribal lightning-like pattern.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plates and the front tabard; colour 1 on the pattern on the tabard; colour 2 on the inner lining at the waist edge and the plate edge lines.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Knightsubligar_01.description: A short banded armor skirt of stacked horizontal plates, worn at the hips. Buckled straps hang from the waistband, and the front is cut away in a high arch for a knight-like tasset look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Knightsubligar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband and upper plates; colour 3 on the lower plates; colour 2 on the buckle straps and rivets.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Knightsubligar_01.differs: The male version lacks the contrasting stitched edging on the plates and has a wider, shallower front arch.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Light_01.description: A short hip-slung armoured loincloth skirt with pointed front and back panels, a cut-away opening at one side, and stacked chevron bands on the back. Contrasting piping outlines the plates. Sits low on the hips in a fantasy-knight style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panels; colour 1 on the outline piping and edge trim; colour 2 on the chevron bands on the back and inner side.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Light_01.differs: The male version has a larger scooped leg opening at one side, showing a wider view of the chevron bands on the inner panel.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_02.description: A short tribal loincloth hanging from the hips, with a front and back panel that have ragged hems, open sides with stitched edging, and a painted thorny glyph design. It sits low on the hips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panels; colour 1 on the waist edge and one half of the side stitching; colour 3 on the other half of the stitching; colour 2 on the painted glyph markings.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_Lemurai.description: A hip-slung armoured loincloth with separate front and back plates joined by ribbed side wings; stacked chevron bands form a long spearhead point at the front, and a matching pointed rear plate hangs behind. Sits low on the hips with a sci-fi, alien feel.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_Lemurai.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed side wings; colour 1 on the chevron bands and front centre panel; colour 2 on the main plate bodies; colour 3 on the thin etched line markings.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Loincloth_Lemurai.differs: The front is a narrower, longer spearhead-shaped panel with chevrons stretching further down the groin, and the side wings sit flatter.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Loinclothmedicine.description: A short tribal loincloth with separate front and back panels hanging from a slim waistband, decorated with a thorny branch-like motif. Trimmed edges and a small flapped medicine pouch sit on the right hip.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Loinclothmedicine.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth panels and pouch; colour 1 on the waistband line and part of the edge trim; colour 3 on the other part of the edge trim; colour 2 on the branch-like print.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Loinclothmedicine.differs: The male pouch is smaller and sits higher on the hip, more flush against the waistband.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A ring of separate angular armor shards hanging around the hips like a jagged skirt, with longer pointed blades at the front and shorter overlapping plates at the sides and back. Mechanical, monstrous look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shard plates and the back centre panel; colour 1 on the large angled panels; colour 2 on the smaller inset patches and tips; colour 3 on the long front blades.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Medium_01.description: A plain knee-length skirt with a smooth, slightly tapered A-line shape and soft cloth folds. It sits at the natural waist and hangs down past the thighs, with no visible trim or fastenings.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Medium_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Monster_01.description: A hip-slung skirt of overlapping, downward-pointing bone-like plates in tiers, with a small V-shaped upper panel at the waist. Front and back sections hang to mid-thigh and taper to sharp points, giving a monstrous look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main plates; colour 0 on the plate edges and ridges; colour 1 on the V-shaped waist panel.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Monster_02.description: A short hip skirt of overlapping pointed plates in stacked, chevron-shaped tiers, with a V-shaped panel at the waistband and jagged tips at the hem. It hangs from the hips to the upper thigh, with a bestial, bone-armour look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Monster_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main overlapping plates; colour 1 on the V-shaped waist panel and upper edge; colour 0 on the highlights along the plate ridges.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.description: A short wrapped hip skirt with a thick gathered sash at the waist, a layered flared skirt beneath with contrasting edging, and a katana with scabbard tucked through the sash at a diagonal, hilt up by the ribs.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the gathered sash; colour 0 on the skirt layer; colour 1 on the skirt edging, sword handle wrap and scabbard; colour 3 on the sword guard and scabbard tip.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Ninja_Sword_01.differs: The male wrap is a shorter, straighter band sitting at the waist, with the sword hilt angled slightly lower across the front.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Padding.description: A ring of separate rounded armor pads around the hips: two large padded plates over the buttocks, a wide curved plate across the front of the pelvis, and smaller pads at each hip. It reads as tactical hip protection.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper surfaces of the pads and the front plate; colour 1 on the curved side sections of each pad; colour 2 on the lower panels of the rear pads and inner hollows; colour 3 on a small accent under the front plate.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Padding.differs: The male version has a wider front plate that spans more of the pelvis, with the hip pads set closer to it.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Puffy_01.description: Short puffy bloomer-style breeches with a fitted waistband studded with small round buttons. Vertical panels balloon out over the hips and thighs and gather in at the mid-thigh hem, giving a historical, swashbuckling look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Puffy_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the waistband and the seams between panels; colour 3 on the studs along the waistband; colour 1 on the wide striped panels; colour 0 on the alternating panels and the front crotch panel.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Punk_01.description: Low-slung, short button-fly denim-style shorts with a row of buttons down the front, pockets front and back, and frayed, uneven leg hems. They sit at the hips with a worn, distressed punk look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fabric of the shorts; colour 1 as a soft tint toward the hems; colour 3 on the front buttons; colour 2 on the inner hem underside.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Punk_01.differs: The male shorts are a single uniform fabric tone with a small worn patch, rather than a two-tone split, and have neater hems.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_01.description: Knee-length loose cloth shorts with a low waistband, baggy legs and turned-up cuffs at the knee. Contrasting panels with contrasting stitching run down the outer thigh and over the lower front of each leg. Casual street look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the shorts; colour 2 on the side and lower-leg panels; colour 1 on the cuffs; colour 3 on the stitching.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_02.description: Tight ankle-length pants with a low contrasting waistband and legs slashed into horizontal strips that grow wider and more open toward the ankles, leaving a ladder-like strap effect. Punk rave styling.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hips and upper legs; colour 1 on the mid legs; colour 2 on the lower legs and strap bands; colour 3 on the waistband and ankle trim.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_03.description: Knee-length, low-slung shorts with a contrasting V-notched waistband and dense ladder-like slashes across the thighs and lower legs, leaving strap-like strips. The fabric fades toward the hems, for a torn rave or street look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shorts body; colour 1 on the lower legs and hem strips, blending up from the light upper fabric; colour 3 on the waistband.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Rave_03.differs: The male version has more extensive slashes wrapping around the thighs and lower legs, leaving prominent strap-like strips.
