Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A pair of rigid, sci-fi thigh guards worn on the outer hips and upper thighs: curved armored shells with vented slits and small stud lights, plus a softer separate flap panel at the inner edge of each guard.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armor shells; colour 1 on the inner flap panels, trim edges and lower caps; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_02.description: A pair of separate angular armored hip plates, one on each side, that hang down the outer thighs as pointed blade-like shields, with segmented plating, contrasting inner panels and small stud rivets. Mechanical, salvaged sci-fi look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and pointed tips; colour 1 on the inset panels and edge stripes; colour 2 on the inner segmented sections; colour 3 on the small rivets.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_04.description: A pair of long, tapering side panels hanging from the hips to below the knees, one with segmented plated ribs and contrasting edge trim, the other a smooth plain sweep; a mechanical, monstrous wing-like skirt.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented plate panels; colour 1 on the edge trim and on the smooth panel; colour 2 on the darker recessed sections between plates; colour 3 on the small round markings.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Reactor_04.differs: The smooth plain panel hangs on the wearer's right hip, mirrored from the female version, and sits closer to the side.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Retroscifi_Sublig.description: A faceted brief-style hip piece with a pointed front and a wide, deep back panel. Low-poly triangular facets give it an angular, armoured sci-fi look, and it sits around the hips like swim briefs.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Retroscifi_Sublig.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main faceted surface; colour 2 on the darker facets and thin rim edge; colour 1 tints some facets on the back and sides.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Retroscifi_Sublig.differs: The male version is a fuller brief with a wider waistband and more coverage at the sides and back, without the flared hip edges.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Rippedpants_014ar.description: Loose, knee-length shorts sitting at the waist, with torn, jagged hems and ragged holes cut through the legs. A plain cloth construction gives a battered, beast-like or street-survivor look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Rippedpants_014ar.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole pair of shorts; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A cybernetic hip layer: a brief-shaped armored panel with a large ribbed centre plate, cylindrical pod nodes around the waist, and thick looping cables wrapping the hips. Sits low at the pelvis with a sci-fi, mechanical look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armored panel and framing; colour 1 on the ribbed front plate and the cylindrical pods; colour 2 on the looping cables; colour 3 on the small centre lights of the pods.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Ripper_01.differs: The male version has a larger, longer ribbed plate hanging at the front and a rounder, more compact cable arrangement.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.description: A mechanical hip armour skirt of angular plated panels, with front and back flaps, a round bolt-like hub on each hip, small clawed prongs at the waist and swept-back fins jutting from the sides. Sci-fi mecha style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer front and rim panels; colour 2 on the back panels, hip hubs and prongs; colour 1 on the side fins and vent stripes; colour 3 on the panel seams, hub centres and accent marks.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Robot_Wings_01.differs: The male version has a shorter front with a narrower centre gap and a triangular centre mark between the two front plates.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.description: A small rectangular armoured hip panel, a single flat plate hanging at the front of the groin and upper thigh like a short tabard, with a curved inset panel, a horizontal band and a small rectangular marking. Suggests a mechanical samurai style.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate border; colour 1 on the curved inset panels; colour 2 on the horizontal central band; colour 3 on the small rectangular marking near the top.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A low-slung hip brace with a raised, pointed rim around a wide open frame, a fitted panel over the rear, and a single long narrow cloth flap hanging down the front of one thigh to the knee.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging flap and rear panel; colour 1 on the outer rim; colour 2 on the inner edge of the frame.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, wider front brief-style panel and the flap hangs centrally down the front of the thigh.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01.description: A ragged fur loincloth-style skirt hanging from the hips, with layered shaggy strands and jagged hems at the front and back, joined at the sides by thin panels. Suggests a beastly, primal look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur at the waistline, fading softly into a faint tint of colour 1 toward the tips.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01.differs: The male version has front and back panels that wrap closer around the sides with shaggier layered strands, and the colour fade to colour 1 is much fainter.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01_Beas.description: A short furry loincloth of shaggy, ragged strands hanging from the hips in separate front and back flaps, open at the sides, ending around the upper thigh. Suggests a primitive beast or sasquatch look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Sasquatch_01_Beas.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur near the waist; colour 1 on the lower tips of the fur strands.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: Brief, form-fitting sci-fi briefs with a layered armored waistband, a raised angular plate at the front centre, and curved side panels; the leg openings are cut high, and the piece covers only the hips and crotch.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the waistband, front plate and central panels; colour 1 on the curved side panels and the band's upper layer; colour 2 on the lower brief section.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Shorts_01.description: Loose-fitting knee-length shorts sitting at the waist, with a straight hem and light creasing at the crotch and thighs. Plain, casual cloth construction.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Shorts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole garment; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Shorts_01.differs: The male version is looser and hangs straight to the knee with a plain hem, without the female version's snug fit and gathered cuffs.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Sideparted_01.description: A short wrap skirt with an angled, asymmetric hem that dips lower on one side. It has a wide waistband, a row of jagged tooth-like points below the band, and a patterned border along the hem.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Sideparted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt cloth; colour 1 on the waistband; colour 2 on the tooth-like points and the patterned hem border.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongcap_01.description: A plain, tube-like long skirt that sits at the waist and hangs straight to the ankles. It has a smooth, slightly draped cloth surface, a narrow hem and no visible openings or trim.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongcap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongfull_01.description: A plain long skirt that starts at the waist and flares gently into a wide, soft-hemmed A-line, falling to the ankles. Smooth cloth with subtle folds and no visible trim, suggesting robes or a simple casual look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Skirtlongfull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole skirt; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A short hip-slung brief-style piece with a banded waist, a contrasting front panel hanging down the centre, angular pointed panels at the sides and a rounded fitted seat at the back. Suggests a sci-fi Egyptian loincloth.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the brief and side panels; colour 0 on the hem edges, rear panel and upper edge trim; colour 2 on the front centre panel and waistband sections; colour 3 on the waistband segments at the sides.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The male version sits closer to the body with shorter, less flared side panels, without the long pointed flaps of the female version.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Spartanskirt_01.description: A short Spartan-style skirt of overlapping rigid vertical strips hanging from a studded waistband, over a plain under-skirt that shows between the strips. Sits on the hips and ends above mid-thigh; suits a greco-roman or gladiator look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Spartanskirt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging strips; colour 1 on the outlines, waist rim and hem edging; colour 3 on the round studs along the waistband; colour 2 on the under-skirt.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A short bone-like hip skirt of radiating pointed ribs or spines with ridged grooves, forming a spiky ring around the hips and groin. It looks like a monstrous, tribal trophy loincloth.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main rib spines and rim; colour 1 on the ridged grooves between the spines; colour 2 on the underside of the crotch panel.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Steelhawk_01.description: Brief-style hip layer with a raised waistband, a winged chevron front decorated with outlined feather-like bands, and jagged, notched side edges. The back is smooth and rounded. Sits on the hips with a superhero look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Steelhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main brief body; colour 2 on the wing-shaped piping lines on the front and along the back waistband; colour 0 on the thin top edge of the waistband.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Steelhawk_01.differs: The male version is a fuller brief with jagged notched sides and outlined wing piping on the front and waistband, rather than the female's open-sided winged plates.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Subligarluchador_.description: High-waisted wrestler briefs with a wide gathered waistband and leg openings cut high over the hips. Soft cloth with fine wrinkles, worn over the hips and crotch as a classic luchador or retro brief.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Subligarluchador_.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole brief, including the waistband and leg edging; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: Two separate layered fin-like blades flaring out from each hip, made of stacked curved plates with pointed tips and a jagged notch. They sit on the outer hips as a monstrous, biomechanical accent.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer and lower plates; colour 1 on the middle plate of each cluster; colour 2 on the tall inner spike plates; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A pair of curved, blade-like fins that jut from the hips, each a sweeping crescent with a rim edge and a separate inner face. Worn over the hips and upper thighs, with a sleek symbiote look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim edges; colour 1 on the outer faces of the fins; colour 2 on the inner faces.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Teleosskirt_02.description: A medium-length wrapped skirt sitting at the hips, with soft draped cloth folds and a hem cut into pointed arches at front and back that dip to points at the sides of the thighs. Edged with contrasting trim.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Teleosskirt_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main skirt cloth; colour 1 on the hem edge trim.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Teleosskirt_02.differs: The male wrap has a more open front arch that exposes more of the thigh, with shorter side points than the female version.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Trenchcoat_01.description: A knee-length trench coat skirt with an elastic waistband, a double-breasted front with a square cluster of four large buttons, and a flared hem that hangs loosely from the hips like a kilt.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Trenchcoat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skirt body and waistband; colour 1 on the thin front seam line; colour 2 on the buttons.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Trenchcoat_01.differs: The male skirt flares outward into a looser, kilt-like shape with a level hem and a fainter seam line, and its buttons form a neat square.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Cargo_01.description: Loose-fitting cargo capri pants ending below the knee with flared, cuffed hems. A slanted decorative belt with a square buckle sits low on the hips, and flap pockets hang on the outer thighs.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Cargo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the trousers and pockets; colour 1 on the slanted belt band; colour 3 on the belt buckle and small studs or dots; colour 2 on the thin waist belt.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Cargo_01.differs: The male belt buckle sits nearer the front centre of the hips, and the hems are plain cuffs without the female's split notches.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Shorts_01.description: Loose, baggy calf-length urban shorts with a low-slung waistband, a wide studded belt with a square buckle, and ripped, frayed patches and raw hems. They sit on the hips with a casual street look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Urban_Shorts_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shorts fabric; colour 2 on the upper waistband; colour 1 on the belt base; colour 3 on the belt studs and buckle.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Victory_01.description: Two curved, shield-shaped pointed panels hang from the hips, one at the front and one at the back, each with a thick contrasting border and a diamond tip. The back panel has chevron ridges; a superhero tabard-like look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel surfaces; colour 2 on the thick outer borders and edging; colour 3 on the raised chevron stripes of the back panel; colour 1 on the diamond tips.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Victory_02.description: A small shield-shaped hip panel hanging from the back of the hips, tapering to a point at mid-thigh, with a raised border and swooping chevron-like stripes. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Victory_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer border; colour 0 on the main panel surface; colour 3 on the raised curved stripes; colour 1 on the diamond at the tip.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A short armoured hip skirt made of stacked, chevron-shaped overlapping plates that flare outward and end in points, with a narrow vertical plate down the front centre. Sits low on the hips, mid-thigh at most.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces and centre front plate; colour 1 on the plate edging and borders; colour 3 on the thin stripe lines across the plates; colour 2 on the slot in the front plate.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Urban_Anime_Shirt_Wrapp.description: A jacket or shirt tied around the hips by its sleeves, forming a short skirt-like wrap with a contrasting panel, a square patch at the front hip, and two sleeves hanging down the front thigh. Casual street look.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Urban_Anime_Shirt_Wrapp.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the shirt and the lower sleeve cuff; colour 1 on the large contrasting panels at the back and sides; colour 2 on the waist band and one hanging sleeve; colour 3 on the square patch.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A large decorative bow worn at the small of the back, with two long pointed tails hanging down the backs of the legs to the calves, each tipped with a small round bobble. Jester-like, festive styling.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the tails and the front loops; colour 1 on parts of the tails and the bobbles; colour 3 on the top loop sections; colour 0 on the inner tail linings and knot. The glossy finish mutes the scheme.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The male bow is mostly one contrasting glossy tone with light patterning only on the inner linings, rather than the bright multi-panel pattern of the female version.

Male/M_Hipslayer_Wolf_01.description: A hip-length armored skirt of separate plates with a wide belted centre, flared side panels with swirl engravings, and jagged, pointed lower edges with a long central spike. Trim borders every plate; fantasy beast styling.
Male/M_Hipslayer_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the swirl engravings and central belt emblem; colour 2 on the belt band and rear inner panel; colour 3 on the trim edging.

Male/M_Hisplayer_Tight_Angel_Epic_03.description: A pair of armored hip guards: a rounded front plate with jagged, bat-wing-like upper edges, a central round emblem and a short hanging panel below, plus a matching plate on the back of the hips. Sits low on the waist.
Male/M_Hisplayer_Tight_Angel_Epic_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main front and back plates; colour 1 on the outer rims, jagged upper crests and side wings; colour 3 on the central emblem; colour 2 on the hanging lower panel.

Male/M_Jaw_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.description: A monstrous jaw-shaped lower face guard: a pointed chin plate lined with a row of jagged teeth, with curved blade-like fins sweeping up past the cheeks and round pivot discs by the ears.
Male/M_Jaw_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth rim and the swept-back blades; colour 1 on the chin plate; colour 2 on the round ear pivots; colour 3 on the small slit marks on the pivots.

Male/M_Legl_Attach_Variablerobot_01.description: A chunky angular thigh plate for the left leg: a faceted coffin-like shell with a raised rim and recessed front panel bearing a small triangular mark, wrapping the outer thigh with a tall pointed back edge.
Male/M_Legl_Attach_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole shell and recessed panel; colour 2 on the raised rim edges and small front mark.

Male/M_Legr_Attach_Variablerobot_01.description: A chunky angular thigh guard for the right leg: a faceted, tapering block of armor plating with a raised rear notch and recessed panel lines, worn on the outer thigh to just above the knee. Sci-fi robotic look.
Male/M_Legr_Attach_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole guard body; colour 2 on the recessed panel borders and small marked details.

Male/M_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.description: Scaled, form-fitting monster leggings reaching the ankles, with overlapping plates across the hips and groin, large segmented plates covering the back of each thigh, and banded plates around the shins and calves.
Male/M_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaled leg surfaces; colour 0 on the overlapping hip and groin plates; colour 2 on the segmented back-thigh panels; colour 1 on the shin and calf plates.
Male/M_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The male version has larger, bulkier back-thigh panels that extend further up and around the thigh, and the shin plates stay mostly on the front.

Male/M_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.description: Form-fitting scaled leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a layered segmented plated groin panel at the front, padded panels on the back of the thighs, and ridged segmented shin guards.
Male/M_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaled legs; colour 0 on the segmented groin panel; colour 1 on the ridged lower-leg sections; colour 2 on the padded back-thigh panels.
Male/M_Legs_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The colour 1 ridged section covers a shorter stretch of the lower leg, ending nearer the calf, rather than running down the shin as on the female version.

Male/M_Legs_Foxbatcon_2025_01.description: Skin-tight full-length leggings running from the hips to the ankles, with a contrasting panel on each inner thigh and crotch and scattered small round spots down the outer legs and back. Sleek, amphibian-like look.
Male/M_Legs_Foxbatcon_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg surface; colour 2 on the inner thigh and crotch panels; colour 3 on the small spots.

Male/M_Legsaccessoriesl_Dragonbody_Lockb.description: A single flame-like or fin-like organic fringe attached to the outside of the left lower leg: a tapering, swept-back blade with rippled, jagged edges that trails toward the ankle. Suggests a monstrous dragon look.
Male/M_Legsaccessoriesl_Dragonbody_Lockb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the fin and its lower edge; colour 1 on the jagged flame tips toward the back, blending in as a gradient from colour 0.

Male/M_Legsaccessoriesl_Dragonbody_Lockb.description: A flame-like fin or plume attached to the outer side of the left lower leg, built from layered swept ridges that fade to jagged pointed tips toward the back. A smooth flat inner face sits against the calf.
Male/M_Legsaccessoriesl_Dragonbody_Lockb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the plume and its smooth inner face; colour 1 on the pointed flame tips toward the rear, blending gradually from colour 0.

Male/M_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Lockb.description: A flame-like fin or frill attached to the outer right calf, made of swept, wavy ridges that flare into pointed tips at the top and taper to a long point near the ankle. Suggests a dragon or beast look.
Male/M_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Lockb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower and front parts of the frill; colour 1 on the upper flared tips, blending in as a gradient.

Male/M_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Lockb.description: A sculpted, flame-like fin or plume attached to the outer right calf, with swept ridged layers that taper to a wispy point near the ankle. It reads as a monstrous or dragon-inspired leg accessory.
Male/M_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Lockb.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the plume and its lower tip; colour 1 on the upper rear crest, blending into colour 0 lower down.
Male/M_Legsaccessoriesr_Dragonbody_Lockb.differs: The male version is a wider, fuller plume that sits higher and flares out further from the calf.

Male/M_M_Belt_Ravenswood_01.description: A pair of separate angular hip plates hanging at each side of the hips, like short rigid armoured hip guards with faceted edges and a pointed upper tip. They leave the front and back open and suggest a tactical or mechanical style.
Male/M_M_Belt_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on both plates; colour 1 on the thin trim lines and small details along the plate edges.

Male/M_M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ravenswood_01.description: A mechanical armored harness vest of angular segmented plates: broad shoulder guards, strap-like bands crossing the chest, and a plated lower ribcage band with a hanging tab at the back. Thin glowing-style piping outlines the edges.
Male/M_M_Chestlayer_Tight_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plates and straps; colour 1 on the thin edge piping and trim lines; colours 0 and 3 are not clearly visible.

Male/M_M_Helmet_Ravenswood_01.description: A bird-like hooded head covering with a long curved beak over the face, small pointed ear tufts and glossy eyes, and a fringe of long feather-like strands hanging down around the neck and back.
Male/M_M_Helmet_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the hood and head covering; colour 0 on the beak; colour 1 on the eyes; colour 2 on the hanging feather strands.

Male/M_M_Spadl_Ravenswood_01.description: A single curved shoulder cap that arches over the left shoulder and sweeps out to a pointed wing at the back. A contrasting band runs along the inner edge, giving a sleek, layered superhero look.
Male/M_M_Spadl_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shoulder shell; colour 1 on the band along the inner edge.

Male/M_M_Spadr_Ravenswood_01.description: A single right shoulder piece shaped like a swept, wedge-like pauldron that flares outward over the shoulder. A raised, folded-over collar panel stands up at the neck side, with a hollow interior. Suits a sleek modern superhero look.
Male/M_M_Spadr_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main pauldron shell and inner hollow; colour 1 on the raised collar panel and edge band.

Male/M_M_Ulegr_Ravenswood_01.description: A curved, shield-like thigh plate worn on the outer right leg, from hip to above the knee, with a smooth back and an outer face carved with swirling, rune-like relief patterns and a thin raised edge.
Male/M_M_Ulegr_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plate body and its back; colour 1 on the raised swirling carved patterns; colour 3 on the thin edge trim.

Male/M_Mask_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.description: A demonic horned half-helm mask covering the brow, eyes and nose with a spiked crest. Two tall curved horns sweep up from the temples, and a separate lower face guard covers the mouth and jaw. Monstrous fantasy look.
Male/M_Mask_Nightmareinvasion_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and horns; colour 3 on the flame-like markings around the eyes; colour 1 on the lower face guard.

Male/M_Mouth_Armor_Viper_Supremeserpent_.description: An angular armored jaw guard that wraps along the jawline from ear to ear. Chunky plates sit over the cheeks, banded metal segments run along the jaw, and a pointed fanged chin cup sits at the front. Suits a monstrous or sci-fi helmet look.
Male/M_Mouth_Armor_Viper_Supremeserpent_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the cheek plates; colour 1 on the chin cup and its fang points; colour 2 on the jaw band; colour 0 on the lighter underside segments.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Abe_Lincoln_01.description: A chin-strap style beard in the Abe Lincoln manner: a thick, textured band of hair-like fur running from the sideburns along the jaw and under the chin, leaving the mouth and upper lip bare.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Abe_Lincoln_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the beard; colour 1 as streaky mottled patches through the beard; colour 2 as darker streaks near the chin edge.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_01.description: A wild, full beard made of layered pointed tufts that run from the sideburns around the jaw and chin, ending in long jagged tips at the chin. Suggests a feral, beastly look.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base and upper part of the tufts; colour 1 on the tips of the tufts.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_02.description: A full braided beard with a moustache and cheek whiskers that sweep up into horn-like points beside the ears, ending in a thick plaited tail cinched by a band and tipped with a clawed tuft. Suggests a brutal, barbaric look.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main hair mass and tips; colour 1 on the shaded locks and streaks through the beard; colour 3 on the band around the braid.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_03.description: A thick, bushy moustache of streaky strands that sits over the upper lip and curves down past the corners of the mouth into pointed, drooping tips. Suggests a rugged, brutish or old-fashioned look.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the hair; colour 1 on the tips and lower ends of the strands.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Cobra_01.description: A large handlebar-style moustache with a thick, gathered centre above the lip and two long, tapering, pointed tips sweeping down and outward past the mouth corners. Pleated, fur-like ridges suggest a stylised, flared cobra hood.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Cobra_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the gathered centre and inner sections; colour 0 on the tapering outer tips, blending from one to the other.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A beard-like mouth accessory of layered, swept feather-like tufts that wrap from the chin along the jaw and sweep up and back beside each ear, ending in tall curved horn-like plumes; a monstrous, beastly look.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tufts along the chin and jaw; colour 1 on the tips of the tufts; colour 2 on the base of the ear plumes; colour 3 on the tips of the ear plumes.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Dwarven_01.description: A full dwarven beard with a broad swooping moustache, scruffy jagged sideburns along the jaw, and two thick braided plaits hanging from the chin, each tied off with a band near the tip.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Dwarven_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the beard, moustache and braids; colour 1 on the bands tying the braid ends.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Gladiator_01.description: A full, thick beard with a swept-up moustache, spiky layered sideburn locks and a braided tail that ends in a contrasting tie and a frayed tip. It hangs from the chin to the upper chest and suggests a rugged warrior.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the moustache and the upper beard and sideburns; colour 1 on the lower beard, braid and tip; colour 2 on the braid tie.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Krampus_01.description: A full beard that wraps the lower face and jaw, with a ragged, uneven lower edge that hangs down over the neck. It is built from patchwork panels and has a shaggy, monstrous look suited to beasts.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main beard body and outer edges; colour 0 on the inner cheek and chin panel and the back of the neck panel; colour 2 on the side patches and upper cheek strips; colour 3 on the patch at the lower front.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Krampus_02.description: A short, ragged beard-like mask piece that wraps the lower face and chin, hanging to the upper chest in a jagged, ruffled point with patchwork panels; suggests a monstrous, folkloric beast look.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Krampus_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer beard body and edges; colour 2 on the side and lower-cheek panels; colour 0 on the inner mouth and back panel; colour 3 on the chin patch.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Lambchops_02.description: A full facial-hair piece: thick, jagged muttonchop sideburns run from the ears down the jaw and join a chin beard, with a curled moustache above the lip. The hair is shaggy and rough-edged, with a rugged look.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Lambchops_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the hair; colour 1 on subtle streaks and shading within the sideburns and beard.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Lambchops_03.description: A pair of jagged, shard-like mutton-chop sideburns that run from the ear down along each jawline, ending in ragged spiky points at the chin corners. Reads as rough, feral or monstrous facial growth.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Lambchops_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jagged sideburn surfaces; colour 1 on small inner patches and the underside near the chin tips.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Lincoln_01.description: A chin-strap beard made of jagged, shard-like spikes that run from the sideburns along the jawline and under the chin, leaving the mouth clear. Suggests a monstrous, crystalline or icy look.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Lincoln_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike tips and upper faces; colour 1 on the inner and lower faces of the spikes. The other slots are not visible.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_01.description: A full beard made of layered, pointed strands that taper to a point below the chin, flanked by swept-back feathery whisker fins at each cheek. It wraps the jaw and has a smooth backing panel behind the neck.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the beard strands and cheek fins; colour 1 on thin accent streaks between the strands and along the fin edges; the back panel takes colour 0.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_01.differs: The male beard hangs fuller and longer below the chin, with a broader, wider bottom edge.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_02.description: A shaggy, fur-like beard hanging from the chin in a broad, full shape, with jagged strands spreading across the jaw and falling to a point on the upper chest, over a smooth cupped backing.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur tufts and backing; colour 1 on the thin streaks running through the strands.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Monkey_02.differs: The male beard is wider and fuller, spreading across the jaw and neck rather than hanging in a narrow wedge.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_01.description: A bushy handlebar mustache with strands of textured hair sweeping outward from the upper lip into long, pointed curls at each side, plus a small soul-patch tuft beneath the lower lip.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the mustache and the tuft; colour 1 on the outer curled tips and the tuft's underside, blending from colour 3.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_02.description: A spider-shaped beard covering the chin: a rounded, veined body with eight curved, pointed legs that curl up along the jaw and cheeks, plus a small separate pointed fang piece above the lip.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the veined spider body and the leg bases; colour 1 on the leg tips and the small upper fang piece.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_02.differs: The male spider body is larger and rounder, covering more of the chin, with legs that spread up the cheeks more symmetrically.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_03.description: A monstrous beard and moustache made of layered, feathery petal-like strands that fan over the chin, with long curling tentacle tendrils sweeping up around each cheek and a pointed tip hanging below the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the moustache and the main beard strands; colour 1 on the curling tentacle tips, blending in from the beard base.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_04.description: A stylised villain facial-hair set: a wide moustache with long curling upturned tips, and a broad pointed goatee gathered into a tie below the chin, ending in a tapered tuft. Sits on the upper lip and chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_04.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the moustache and goatee hair; colour 1 on the curled moustache tips and the tuft ends; colour 2 on the tie band.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_05.description: A villainous handlebar moustache and beard in one piece: a curled moustache above a broad, fibrous beard that fans out to each side into long, curling tendril tips, sitting over the mouth and chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_05.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main moustache and beard mass; colour 1 on the curling tendril tips, blending into colour 3 at the base.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_06.description: A stylised winged facial-hair accessory: a thin angular moustache band across the upper lip sweeps out into pointed wing tips at the cheeks, with two curved whiskers below and a small spike at the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_06.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the central moustache band and lower whiskers; colour 1 on the outer wing tips and chin spike, blending into colour 3.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_07.description: A full hair beard with sideburns: shaggy, textured strands run from the ears along the jaw and cover the chin, with a moustache joined to the beard in a closed loop around the mouth.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_07.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the beard, moustache and sideburns; colour 1 on the inner side of the sideburns and lower jaw edge.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_07.differs: The male version has a moustache joined to the beard in one loop around the mouth, all in a single colour, rather than a separate contrasting moustache.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_08.description: A full grizzled beard of streaky hair that runs from jagged sideburns along the jaw and around the chin, with a separate contrasting moustache above the mouth. It reads as rugged and weathered.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_08.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main beard and sideburns; colour 0 on the moustache; colour 1 on the inner edges and underside near the jaw.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_08.differs: The male beard adds a separate moustache across the upper lip and has jagged, stepped sideburns, with a fuller chin.

Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_09.description: A thick handlebar mustache with a textured, strand-like surface, sitting across the upper lip and sweeping outward into long, pointed tips that curl upward past the cheeks. A playful, villainous facial-hair accessory.
Male/M_Mouth_Beard_Villain_09.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the mustache; colour 1 on the curled outer tips, blending from colour 3 towards the ends.

Male/M_Mouth_Beast_Spider_01.description: A pair of spider-style mandibles: bulbous rounded pods flanking the mouth and cheeks, each with a mottled patch of small plates and tapering into a curved, pointed fang that hangs down beside the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Beast_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the mandible pods; colour 0 on the mottled patches; colour 2 and colour 1 on the fang tips, fading from one to the other.

Male/M_Mouth_Bike_01.description: A mechanical jaw guard that wraps from both sides of the head down under the chin to a pointed front, with slatted vents along the cheeks, angular cheek plates and a small contrasting front vent. Sci-fi biker style.
Male/M_Mouth_Bike_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin piece, jaw bar and rear panels; colour 1 on the outer cheek plate frames; colour 3 on the recessed inner cheek panels; colour 2 on the front vent.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Bear_02.description: A small set of curved, pointed fangs in two clusters, one on each side of the lower jaw near the chin, like bear tusks jutting upward. Tiny bestial accessory with no other head covering.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Bear_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the fangs; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Beard_Monkey_02.description: A full, shaggy beard hanging from the chin, with a smooth cupped upper edge and streaky, wispy strands that fan out wide and end in ragged points on the upper chest. Suggests a beastly or monkey-like look.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Beard_Monkey_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the beard; colour 1 on the thin streaks running through the strands.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Beard_Monkey_02.differs: The male beard is wider and shorter, spreading out across the jaw and upper chest rather than hanging in a slim point.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Beast_Spider_01.description: A pair of spider-like mandibles: two swollen, rounded pods with a bumpy speckled patch on the outer face, each tapering to a curved fang tip, flanking the mouth, with a small pointed central piece between them.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Beast_Spider_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the mandible pods; colour 0 on the speckled patches; colour 2 on the fang tips and the central piece, fading to colour 1 at the points.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Beast_Spider_01.differs: The male version adds a small pointed central piece between the mandibles, over the mouth and upper lip.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Celestial_Dragon_01.description: A monstrous mouth overlay: rows of sharp, jagged fangs ring the mouth, with a long, tapering tongue that curls out and down past the chin to a point. Suggests a beastly, venom-like creature look.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Celestial_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the teeth; colour 0 on the base of the tongue fading into colour 1 toward the tip.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Celestial_Dragon_02.description: A set of separate monstrous fangs: a row of long pointed upper teeth across the mouth with curved tusks at the corners, and a shorter lower row of small spikes set along the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Celestial_Dragon_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on all the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Celestial_Dragon_02.differs: The lower teeth sit in a tighter, flatter row under the chin and do not curve as far up the jaw.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.description: A wide, monstrous set of jagged teeth: two rows of small pointed cones run in a U-shaped band from the corners of the mouth, down around the jaw and chin, giving a grotesque, extended grin.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Cyberpunk_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth cones; colour 1 on the inner faces of some teeth.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Dragon_01.description: A set of separate curved fang-like teeth arranged in two rows along each side of the jaw, pointing downward and forward from the jawline. A monstrous, dragon-like mouth accessory that leaves the face itself bare.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Dragon_Silly_01.description: A jagged row of flat, angular triangular plates that forms a spiky collar-like fringe around the jaw and neck, with the points rising along both sides of the face. Suggests a silly dragon-like, monstrous accessory.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Dragon_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the triangular plates; colour 2 on the thick edging around each plate.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Gasmask_Insect_01.description: An insect-style gas mask covering the mouth and chin, with a ribbed filter grille at the front, curved contrasting mandible-like spikes at each side, and thick hose loops running up and over the back of the head to a cylindrical clasp.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Gasmask_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed grille; colour 1 on the mask shell and the cylindrical clasp at the back of the head; colour 2 on the mandible spikes; colour 3 on the hoses and small details.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Guardian_01.description: A spiked collar of overlapping angular shards that ring the base of the neck, with a larger pointed fang hanging at the front centre and shards fanning out at the sides and back. Suggests a dragon-scale or monstrous necklace.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spiked shards; colour 1 on small hidden underside segments visible at the back of the neck.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Guardian_02.description: A long, flowing beard-like piece that hangs from the chin down over the upper chest, with a cupped upper edge, swept vertical strands and a tapering, jagged point at the bottom. It suggests a wise dragon or fantasy sage.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Guardian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the beard; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the strands.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Guardian_03.description: A smooth, elongated beak-like snout cover that starts wide at the mouth and tapers to a blunt point below the chin, projecting forward and downward. It is hollow behind and suggests a stylised dragon or bird muzzle.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Guardian_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole snout; the hollow inner side takes a darker shading of the same slot.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Lizard_01.description: Two clusters of small pointed fangs or spines that flank the mouth and jaw line, curving back along each cheek toward the neck. A monstrous, reptilian facial add-on with no other head covering.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all of the teeth; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_01.description: Two pairs of small mandible-like appendages at the sides of the neck: long tapering tusks with a bulbous tip and a skull motif near the base, plus a pair of short curved contrasting hooks between them. Monstrous alien styling.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bulbous tips; colour 0 on the upper tusk shafts and skull motifs; colour 1 on the tapering tusk points; colour 2 on the short inner hooks.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_02.description: A pair of long curved mandibles hanging from the jaw line down over the collarbones, each with a bulbous tip, a tapering tusk-like blade with small claw spikes on the inner edge, plus two small contrasting fangs at the throat.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bulbous tips; colour 0 on the upper shafts and the small spikes; colour 1 on the tapering lower blades and skull-like markings; colour 2 on the small throat fangs.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_03.description: A pair of giant curved mandibles jutting from the sides of the jaw: each has a rounded cap and a segmented collar, then a long tapering horn-like tusk with small spikes along the inner edge, sweeping down over the collarbones.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Qularr_Mandibles_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rounded caps and the tusk bodies; colour 0 on the collar segments; colour 3 as speckled markings on the tusks; colour 2 on the tusk tips.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth.description: A monstrous mouth piece: a faceted, angular jaw and lower-face plate that juts forward past the chin, lined along both edges with rows of curved, pointed fangs. Suggests a raptor or beast muzzle.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper jaw plate; colour 1 on the lower chin and jaw tip, blending from colour 0; colour 2 on the rows of teeth.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_02.description: A beast-like muzzle piece: an angular, wedge-shaped snout covering the nose and mouth area, tapering toward the chin, with rows of curved fangs projecting along both sides of the jaw. Suggests a raptor or monster.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper snout, fading into colour 1 toward the chin end; colour 2 on the curved teeth.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_03.description: A beast-like mouth piece: a faceted, hollow beak-shaped cover over the mouth and chin that tapers into a long, thin pointed tongue-like tip extending forward and down past the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cover and mouth housing; colour 1 on the tapering tip, blending in as a gradient; colour 2 on the inner hollow.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Raptor_Teeth_03.differs: The male version has a shorter, stubbier front with a wider mouth opening, and the inside shows a colour 1 lining.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Tight_Leech_01.description: A monstrous leech-like mouth piece: a ribbed, fluted cup sits over the nose and mouth, with a dense fringe of thick tentacle-like tendrils hanging down past the chin to the neck.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Tight_Leech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed cup, which shows a skin-like tone from the default material; colour 1 on the hanging tendrils, fading towards the cup.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_01.description: A ring of jagged, sharp teeth around the mouth, with two long curved tusks hanging down past the chin from the corners and small upward fangs beside the cheeks. A beastly overlay for the lower face.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and tusks; the other colour slots are not visibly used on this sheet.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_01.differs: The male version adds two long curved tusks hanging well below the chin, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_02.description: A set of bestial teeth around the mouth: dense rows of jagged, pointed fangs along the upper and lower jaw, with short curved tusks curling up at each corner. Reads as a monstrous werewolf look.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the teeth and tusks; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Mouth_Child_Werewolf_02.differs: The male version has a fuller, denser set of large teeth with short tusks curling upward at the corners, instead of long tusks hanging down.

Male/M_Mouth_Cigar_01.description: A short, rounded cigar-shaped stick held at the corner of the mouth, with a contrasting band near the lit end, a fluffy fibrous tip at the other end and a thin twisted fuse trailing off it.
Male/M_Mouth_Cigar_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cigar body; colour 3 on the band near the mouth end; colour 0 on the fluffy tip and the fuse.

Male/M_Mouth_Cigar_02.description: A chunky cigar held in the mouth, pointing forward and slightly outward: a smooth rolled cylinder with rounded ends, a single narrow band near the lit end, and a rough textured ash tip.
Male/M_Mouth_Cigar_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cigar body; colour 3 on the band; colour 0 on the ash tip.

Male/M_Mouth_Cyberwire_01.description: A cybernetic jaw guard: a curved, segmented plate cups the chin and jawline and rises to a round disc pod over each ear, with a contrasting rim and small circular vents. Sci-fi partial face piece.
Male/M_Mouth_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jaw plate; colour 2 on the ear discs and chin band; colour 1 on the rim of each ear disc; colour 3 on the circular inserts in the discs and jaw sides.

Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_01.description: A mechanical cyborg jaw plate that wraps under the chin and along both jawlines, rising to angular hinge plates by the ears with hex-bolt pivots. Leaves the lips and mouth open.
Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jaw plate and hinge plates; colour 1 on the underside of the jaw; hex bolts take colour 0.

Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_02.description: A mechanical jaw guard that wraps under the chin and along the jawline, with a raised central chin plate, contrasting vertical dividers and angular flared edges that sweep up toward the cheeks. Suggests a cyborg or armored look.
Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the central chin plate; colour 0 on the upper edge trim along the jaw; colour 2 on the side dividers and outer jaw plates; colour 3 on the thin edge lines.

Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_03.description: A cybernetic jaw brace that follows the jawline from ear to ear, with a raised vented grille over the mouth and chin, small rounded nubs near the ears, and a thin plate at one cheek.
Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_03.colourAreas: The default material appears to ignore the colour scheme, so no colour slot visibly shows; the whole piece is a uniform metallic finish.
Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_03.differs: The male version has a slotted ventilator grille over the mouth and ear-side nubs, and lacks the separate coloured chin panel and trim of the female version.

Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_04.description: A cyborg mouthguard: a tall, faceted solid plate covers the mouth and chin, with thin flared metal wings curving under the jaw at each side. Blocky, armored, mechanical look.
Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front plate and jaw wings; colour 1 on the inner underside of the wings and plate edges.
Male/M_Mouth_Cyborg_Jaw_04.differs: The male version is a solid smooth faceted plate over the mouth with small jaw wings, lacking the vented grille and ear-side knobs of the female version.

Male/M_Mouth_Dragon_Silly_01.description: A U-shaped jaw-like guard wrapping around the chin and along both jawlines, with a segmented ridged upper band, two curved fangs at the front corners, and a row of triangular spikes hanging below like a dragon's lower jaw.
Male/M_Mouth_Dragon_Silly_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main jaw band; colour 3 on the segmented upper ridge and the fangs; colour 0 on the hanging triangular spikes; colour 2 on the back and underside of the band.

Male/M_Mouth_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.description: A pair of slender curved horn-like whiskers that start at the corners of the mouth and sweep outward and down in tapering points, like a dragon's barbels. They frame the mouth and reach past the chin toward the collarbones.
Male/M_Mouth_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both whiskers; the other colour slots are not visible.
Male/M_Mouth_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The whiskers sit right at the mouth and frame the lips, and look slightly thicker than on the female.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Alien_Hybrid_01.description: A face mask covering the nose and mouth down to the chin, made of angular overlapping plates with a diagonal band across the upper face and small studded details; pointed side flaps reach toward the ears. Suits alien or sci-fi looks.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Alien_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main lower plates; colour 2 on the diagonal upper band; colour 0 on the side flaps and edges; colour 3 on the angled patch near the mouth.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Animatronic_01.description: A robotic jaw brace that wraps under the chin: a boxy central block with two small round lights, a band of blocky teeth along the lower lip, and angular slab plates rising at each side of the jaw.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Animatronic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the chin block, jaw band and side slabs; colour 0 on the teeth and inner edge trim; colour 3 on the round lights.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Aquatic_01.description: A small faceted bird-beak accessory that covers the nose, with a raised ridge along the top and a pointed tip. Two contrasting nostril-like wedges sit at the base. Suggests an avian or animal-themed costume.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper ridge of the beak; colour 0 on the main lower beak body; colour 2 on the nostril wedges.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Beard_01_Basic.description: A medium-length faceted beard with a swept moustache and sideburns rising toward the ears, ending in a jagged, pointed chin tuft. Low-poly, spiky strands give it a rugged, fantasy look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Beard_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the moustache, sideburns and outer beard; colour 1 on the chin tuft and lower beard.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Beard_Fantasy_01.description: A full, long beard with a jagged, tapering lower edge that hangs below the chin in streaky pointed locks, with a curved moustache above. It is attached to the jaw by a flat collar-like band, giving a wizardly fantasy look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Beard_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beard and the flat jaw band; colour 1 on the jagged tips of the lower beard; colour 2 on the moustache and the strands between the locks.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Beard_Santa_01.description: A full, bushy fake beard with a moustache, a contrasting horizontal band across the cheeks and a jagged, tufted lower edge hanging to the chest. Pointed whisker tufts stick up at the sides by the ears.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Beard_Santa_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the back of the beard and the side whisker tufts; colour 1 on the moustache and main beard body; colour 2 on the horizontal band across the upper beard; colour 3 on the central vertical stripe.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Beard_Santa_01.differs: The male version has pointed whisker tufts at the sides and no strap over the head.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Beard_Tendrils_01.description: Two clusters of long, tapering spike-like tendrils hanging from either side of the jaw and chin, splayed downward past the neck like a split beard or mandibles. Monstrous, creature-like styling.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Beard_Tendrils_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper lengths of the tendrils; colour 1 on the tips and lower halves of the tendrils.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Braid_Goatee_Long_01.description: A long braided goatee hanging from the chin: a spiky flared tuft at the top, two tight bands cinching the braid, and a tapering pointed tail that reaches down over the upper chest.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Braid_Goatee_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the braid strands and pointed tail; colour 1 on the tuft at the chin end; colour 3 on the two binding bands; colour 2 on the band edges.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Carrot_01.description: A long tapering conical carrot nose that projects forward from the centre of the face, with subtle ridged texture along its length. Comical snowman-style novelty accessory that replaces the nose and points slightly downward.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Carrot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wide base end of the cone; colour 1 on the tapering tip, blending smoothly between the two.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Destroid_01.description: A pair of angular plate guards flanking the lower face, one on each cheek and jaw. Each is a flared, pointed panel with a bordered edge, leaving the mouth open, in a mechanical armored style.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Destroid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces; colour 1 on the raised edge trim around each plate.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Fangs_01.description: A pair of curved, tapering fangs that hang down from the upper lip on either side of the mouth, each ending in a sharp point. They suggest a vampiric or beastly look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Fangs_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fang bodies; the pointed tips show a darker shade that does not follow the scheme.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Goatee_01_Basic.description: A low-poly goatee and moustache set: thin curling moustache strands run from the upper lip down around the mouth, joining a chunky faceted chin beard with a pointed central patch. Sits on the lower face and chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Goatee_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the moustache strands and the central chin patch; colour 1 on the side sections of the chin beard.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Goatee_Sharplip_01.description: A stylised sculpted goatee: a curved moustache band arcs around the mouth and joins a broad, squared chin beard with a jagged upper edge, hanging below the chin like a false pharaoh-style beard.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Goatee_Sharplip_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the moustache band; colour 1 on the chin beard.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Holoforce_01.description: A solid, faceted mouth and nose guard with a pointed top ridge and stacked angular panels down to the chin. It has thin glowing edge lines and a hollow, bevelled back, giving a sci-fi helmet-mask look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer facet panels; colour 1 on the glowing edge trim and the rim around the back opening.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Holoforce_01.differs: The male version is a solid opaque faceted guard with contrasting edge trim, while the female version is a glowing translucent energy shell.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Joke_01.description: An oversized joke nose that fits over the real nose: a rounded, bulbous, hollow-backed shape with a jagged, spiky fringe flaring out beneath it above the upper lip. Comic, clown-like.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Joke_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the nose; colour 1 on the jagged fringe underneath.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Moustache_02_Basic.description: A long handlebar-style moustache of streaky hair strands: it sits across the upper lip, then droops in two long tapering points on either side of the mouth, reaching well below the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Moustache_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the moustache hair; colour 1 shows only as faint streaks on the inner strands.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Moustachegoatee_Tendri.description: A facial-hair accessory made of sharp, tapering tendrils: two long curved moustache strands sweeping down from beside the nose past the mouth, plus a small clustered goatee tuft of spiky blades under the lip.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Moustachegoatee_Tendri.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blades of the moustache and goatee; colour 1 on the inner tendrils of the moustache and goatee.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Mustache_01_Basic.description: A small, low-poly mustache that sits on the upper lip beneath the nose, tapering outward and downward at the sides with slightly curled tips. It suggests a classic, casual facial-hair look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Mustache_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the right side of the mustache (viewer's right); colour 1 on the left side of the mustache (viewer's left) as a separate patch.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Mustachedandy_01.description: A pair of slim, tapering moustache halves that sit on the upper lip beneath the nose, each sweeping outward to a fine pointed tip. It suggests a dapper, old-fashioned look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Mustachedandy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper surface of each moustache half; colour 1 on the underside and inner portion of each half.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Nightvisor_01.description: A V-shaped mechanical mouth and jaw guard that wraps under the chin and sweeps up both cheeks to round ear-side pods with contrasting lens-like centres, topped by tall angular fins. Sci-fi tactical helmet style.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Nightvisor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jaw plates and pod rims; colour 1 on the upward fins; colour 3 on the accent panels along the lower edge and chin; colour 2 on the pod centres.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Ringmaster_01.description: A ringmaster-style facial hair set: a wide handlebar moustache in two halves that sweep outward and curl up into sharp points, plus a small chiselled soul-patch goatee below the lower lip.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Ringmaster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the moustache; colour 1 on the goatee.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beard_01.description: A beastly beard and mutton-chop ruff of jagged, angular tufts that wrap along the jaw, chin and sides of the neck, with sharp spiky tips hanging down; feral, monstrous look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper bases of the tufts; colour 1 on the pointed tips, which fade in from the base.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beardfangs_0.description: A beastly beard of jagged, spiky tufts that frames the jaw and chin, with sharp points hanging below and small tusk-like fangs curving up beside the mouth. Suggests a sasquatch or monster look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beardfangs_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main beard tufts; colour 1 on the tips of the beard spikes; colour 3 on the small fangs by the mouth.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beardfangs_0.description: A shaggy beast-like beard of jagged, spiky tufts that wraps the jaw and chin and trails into a long pointed tuft below, with two small curved tusks rising beside the mouth and spiky sideburn tufts by the ears.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beardfangs_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beard tufts and sideburns; colour 1 on the lower tips of the beard and the long chin tuft; colour 3 on the curved tusks.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beardfangs_0.description: A shaggy, jagged beard of layered pointed locks that runs along the jaw and hangs in long tapering tufts below the chin, with spiky sideburn shards and two small curved tusks by the mouth. A beastly, monstrous look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beardfangs_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beard and sideburn locks; colour 1 on the tapering tips of the hanging locks; colour 3 on the two curved fangs by the mouth.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beardfangs_0.description: A shaggy, jagged beard of layered spiky tufts wrapping the jaw and chin, with sideburn-like shards near the ears and two small curved fangs rising beside the mouth. Suggests a beastly, monstrous look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Sasquatch_Beardfangs_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main beard tufts; colour 1 on the tips of the spikes and lower tufts; colour 3 on the two curved fangs.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Steam_Plague_Mask_01.description: A skeletal jawbone frame that wraps around the face from ear to ear, meeting in a pointed chin, with rows of sharp teeth along the inner edges. It leaves the face open, suggesting a monstrous steampunk look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Steam_Plague_Mask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone-like jaw frame; colour 1 on the spiked teeth.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Tentacle_01.description: A cluster of thick, tapering tentacles hanging from the mouth and chin area, with a long central tentacle flanked by shorter curling ones that end in sharp points. A monstrous, cephalopod-like face accessory.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Tentacle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to have no clear separate area; the whole piece shows a single fleshy skin tone with darkened tips, so it looks unaffected by the colour scheme.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Urban_Lipring_01.description: A small octagonal hoop lip ring worn through the lower lip, just left of centre, hanging in front of the mouth. A simple, edgy piercing suited to street and punk looks.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Urban_Lipring_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole ring; the metal finish appears to take little from the other colour slots.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Urban_Lipring_02.description: A pair of small metal lip rings, each a thick open hoop with a tiny bead end, set on either side of the lower lip near the mouth corners. A subtle street or punk piercing.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Urban_Lipring_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on both rings; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Vandyke_01_Basic.description: A facial hair set: a wide, drooping moustache with jagged, tapered tips curving down past the mouth corners, plus a separate pointed soul-patch goatee on the chin. Suggests a classic rugged, roguish look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Vandyke_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the moustache; colour 1 on the chin goatee.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Vandyke_02.description: A small soul patch of facial hair: a compact triangular tuft of jagged, layered strands sitting on the chin just below the lower lip, tapering toward the jaw. Suggests a casual, groomed look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Vandyke_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tuft, fading toward colour 2 at the lower tips.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Vine_Fullmask_01.description: A cluster of thick, tentacle-like tendrils covering the mouth and jaw, each tapering to a pointed tip and hanging below the chin. Swirling striped patterns run along the tendrils, giving a squid-like monstrous look.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Vine_Fullmask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tendril bodies; colour 1 on the swirling stripes and bands along the tendrils; colour 3 on the pointed tips.

Male/M_Mouth_Face_Witch_Nose_01.description: A large prosthetic witch nose with a broad bridge and bulbous sides, extending down and curving into a long hooked point that ends in a tapered tip past the mouth. Sits over the natural nose.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Witch_Nose_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main body of the nose; colour 0 on the tapering hooked tip.
Male/M_Mouth_Face_Witch_Nose_01.differs: The male nose is coloured contrasting by default rather than the skin tone shown on the female version.

Male/M_Mouth_Falconer_01.description: A faceted, angular bird-beak mask covering the nose, mouth and chin, tapering to a sharp downward point with small nostril holes on top and a wrapped shell that curves around the jaw toward the neck.
Male/M_Mouth_Falconer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole beak mask, with a glossy translucent sheen; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Blackpaladin_01.description: A heavy armored mouth-and-jaw guard with a ridged, grille-like front, angular layered plates and a pointed chin. It covers the lower face from nose to chin, with small rivet-like studs at the cheeks.
Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Blackpaladin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main front plates and cheek shells; colour 0 on the chin and lower jaw plate and the small studs; colour 2 on the upper nose-bridge panel; colour 3 on the inset side stripes.

Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Medium_0.description: A half-face respirator mask covering nose and mouth, with a small breather nozzle on top, angular armored plates, ribbed vent slots on the front, and round filter canisters on both cheeks. Suits military, sci-fi and cyberpunk looks.
Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Medium_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper brow-like plates and edging; colour 1 on the front chin panel and the round cheek filters; colour 2 on the side and back plates; colour 3 on the vent slits.

Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Prisongu.description: A compact respirator mask covering the mouth and chin, with a vented front grille and side filter canisters. Two thick hoses loop around the head to a padded cylindrical block at the back of the skull.
Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Prisongu.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front grille and vent plates; colour 1 on the mask shell, filter canisters and the rear cylinder block; colour 3 on the hoses and small studs.
Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Gasmask_Prisongu.differs: The hoses loop lower and the rear cylinder sits closer to the nape of the neck, so the loop is shorter.

Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Mask_Paintball_0.description: A sleek half-face mask covering the nose bridge, cheeks and chin, with a central ribbed breather grille and angled side vents crossed by thin bars. It wraps around the jaw toward the ears in a sci-fi, tactical style.
Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Mask_Paintball_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell and grille rim; colour 1 on the central breather grille; colour 3 on the side vent panels; colour 2 on the bars across the side vents.

Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Ripper_01.description: A cybernetic jaw guard covering the chin and lower face, with a toothed grille over the mouth, jagged spiked ridges rising along the cheeks, and four short cylindrical vent nozzles jutting out from the sides and underside.
Male/M_Mouth_Fullhelmet_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main jaw shell; colour 0 on the jagged cheek ridges, rim and mouth grille; colour 2 on the nozzle cylinders; colour 3 on the rings around the nozzles.

Male/M_Mouth_Gasmask_Insect_01.description: A small insectoid respirator over the mouth, with a ribbed grille and twin filter pods, flanked by two curved contrasting mandible-like claws. Tubes loop up around the face to a padded cylindrical block on top of the head.
Male/M_Mouth_Gasmask_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed grille; colour 1 on the mask body, filter pods and head block; colour 3 on the tubes and small accents; colour 2 on the mandible claws.

Male/M_Mouth_Guardian_01.description: A dragon-inspired mouth and jaw guard: a rounded, padded cover across the lower face with a bordered rim, spiky fin-like flares at the sides and a tapering, feathery beard-like tuft hanging below the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Guardian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded front cover, spikes and beard tuft; colour 1 on the inner lining and the tip of the tuft; colour 2 on the border band; colour 3 on the piping along the rim.
Male/M_Mouth_Guardian_01.differs: The male guard has larger side spikes and the contrasting piping joins into a continuous line across the bottom of the cover.

Male/M_Mouth_Guardian_02.description: A rounded, padded mouth and jaw guard covering the lower face, with a raised bordered rim, side spikes flaring outward and a long pointed beard-like tuft hanging below the chin. Suggests a beastly or armoured dragon look.
Male/M_Mouth_Guardian_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded front, spikes and beard tuft; colour 2 on the rim band; colour 3 on the raised trim strips along the rim; colour 1 on the inner lining and the tip of the beard.

Male/M_Mouth_Helmetgrill_01.description: A rigid mouth and jaw guard that wraps under the chin and up the cheeks to round rivet-like pivots near the ears, with a contrasting rim along the top edge and rows of short slashed grooves across the front.
Male/M_Mouth_Helmetgrill_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate and inner lining; colour 1 on the upper rim edge; colour 3 on the slashed marks; colour 2 on the pivot bolts.

Male/M_Mouth_Jaw_Rockcrystal_01.description: A U-shaped jaw of chunky stacked rock slabs that wraps around the chin and up along both jawlines to the cheeks, with rows of sharp crystal spikes jutting forward and outward like teeth. Monstrous, fantasy style.
Male/M_Mouth_Jaw_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between the stones; colour 1 on the crystal spikes.

Male/M_Mouth_Kabuto_01.description: A small kabuto-style chin guard: a curved plate sits under the lower lip, with two cord ties rising along the cheeks toward the ears and a decorative bow knot with dangling tails hanging beneath the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Kabuto_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin plate; colour 2 on the plate edge outline; colour 1 on the cords and the bow knot.

Male/M_Mouth_Kazoo_01.description: A small kazoo: a tapered rectangular tube with three finger holes along the top and a round capped membrane cup near the wider end. It is held in the mouth and points forward, sitting level.
Male/M_Mouth_Kazoo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the kazoo body; colour 1 on the round cap; colour 3 on the marking on top of the cap.

Male/M_Mouth_Kazoo_02.description: A small kazoo held in the mouth: a tapered, boxy tube that points forward from the lips, with slots along the top and a round wheel-like cap near the far end. Playful novelty accessory.
Male/M_Mouth_Kazoo_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top and sides of the body; colour 0 on the underside and the slot panels; colour 3 on the round cap; colour 2 on the small centre hub of the cap.

Male/M_Mouth_Llama_Tongue_01.description: A single curved, tapering tongue that extends forward from the mouth then bends sharply downward, hanging over the chin. It has a smooth, faceted, rounded form and reads as a playful beast or creature mouth accessory.
Male/M_Mouth_Llama_Tongue_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the tongue near the mouth; colour 1 on the lower hanging tip; colour 2 on the underside edge near the mouth.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Blackpaladin_01.description: A rigid, angular mouth mask covering the nose tip down to the chin, with stacked horizontal louvre ridges across the front and small round studs at each side where the mask meets the cheeks. Suggests a mechanical respirator or grill.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Blackpaladin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and louvre ridges; colour 1 on the inner recessed curves of the interior; small round side studs take colour 0.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_01.description: A mechanical lower-face mask covering nose bridge to chin, with a jagged-toothed grin plate, a heavy banded frame, two tall slab fins rising at the cheeks and round discs at the sides. Sci-fi, monstrous and prison-brute in style.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer frame bands and cheek edges; colour 0 on the grin plate and fin edges; colour 1 on the mouth interior behind the teeth; colour 2 on the tall fin panels and side discs.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_02.description: An asymmetric half mask covering only one side of the lower face and chin, with a thick padded band looping around the head at nose level and a stitched, grinning mouth design on the fabric panel.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the loop band around the head; colour 0 on the fabric mouth panel; colour 3 on the stitched grin markings.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_03.description: A fabric surgical-style mouth mask covering the nose-to-chin area with a vertical seam down the centre, held by a thin rigid loop band that wraps around the head above the eyes and down the cheeks.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin band framing the mask and looping around the head; colour 2 on the cloth of the mask; colour 3 on the centre seam stripe.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_04.description: A paneled cloth mouth and jaw mask covering nose-bridge to chin, with contrasting edge binding, dashed stitch lines across each panel, and three round vent-filter rings at the chin and both cheeks.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panels; colour 3 on the edge binding and stitching; colour 1 on the round vent rings; colour 2 on the top nose strip and bottom rim.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_05.description: A cloth respirator-style mouth mask covering the lower face, with a printed toothy grin band across the front, a thin border strap looping over the head, and round ribbed filter canisters on each cheek.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Inmate_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth mask body and border strap; colour 1 on the grin teeth band; colour 3 on the cheek filter canisters.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Muzzle_01.description: A restraint-style muzzle mask covering the lower face, with a rigid curved plate over the nose and mouth, slotted mouth vents, and a thin frame band arching over the head. A wide strap of bundled cables wraps around the back of the head.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Muzzle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face plate and frame band; colour 1 on the mouth slots and small studs; colour 3 on the rivets and strap clasps; colour 2 on the rear strap.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Ragingbull_01.description: A bull-faced mask covering the face from brow to muzzle, with a broad elongated snout, a hooded eye band with a central seam, angled cheek panels and a hanging nose ring. The back is a smooth hollow shell.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Ragingbull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the forehead, snout and nose ring; colour 1 on the cheek and muzzle panels; colour 2 on the eye band; colour 3 on the small jaw-side accents.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Steampunk_01.description: A steampunk mouth-and-nose mask covering the lower face, with a central panel of eyelet holes, angular side plates, and a plain lining inside. Thin straps with small rings loop over the head and cheeks to hold it.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central mask panel and inner lining; colour 1 on the angular side plates and top brow piece; colour 3 on the head straps; colour 2 on the eyelets and rings.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Teddybear_01.description: A cute teddy bear muzzle mask: a rounded, softly textured snout that covers the nose, upper lip and chin, with a small diamond-shaped nose on the tip and a thin curved mouth line underneath.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Teddybear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the muzzle; colour 1 on the nose; colour 2 on the mouth line.

Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Toothy_01.description: A half-face mask covering the nose, cheeks and jaw, with a raised nose bridge, curled spiral flourishes at the cheeks and a lower jaw lined with rows of sharp fangs. Suggests a monstrous, samurai-like look.
Male/M_Mouth_Mask_Toothy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask plate and spiral curls; colour 1 on the inner lining and jaw edge; colour 3 on the gums between the teeth; colour 2 on the darker recesses.

Male/M_Mouth_Party_Blower_01.description: A small party blower held in the mouth: a straight tube mouthpiece with a banded tip end, and a paper coil that curls into a flat spiral and extends out in front of the lips. Playful, festive novelty accessory.
Male/M_Mouth_Party_Blower_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tube; colour 2 on the tube end and the band at the coil joint; the coil has a spotted pattern with colour 1 spots and dots that ignore the scheme, on a light base.

Male/M_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_01.description: Two pairs of insectoid mandibles flanking the jaw and neck: long tapering spikes with a bulbous tip and a skull-like marking, plus a small pair of short curved fangs between them. Monstrous, alien styling.
Male/M_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bulbous tips; colour 0 on the upper spike segments and skull markings; colour 1 on the tapering spike ends; colour 2 on the small inner fangs.

Male/M_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_02.description: A pair of long, curved insectoid mandibles hanging from the jaw line down toward the collarbones, each tapering to a point with small side barbs and a bulbous tip, plus two small inner curved blades near the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bulbous tips; colour 0 on the upper shafts and small side barbs; colour 1 on the lower tapering shafts and skull-like marking; colour 2 on the small inner blades.

Male/M_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_03.description: A pair of giant curved mandibles that sit at the sides of the mouth and sweep down past the chest. Each has a rounded capped base, a segmented collar and a tapering horn-like tusk edged with small spikes.
Male/M_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_03.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rounded caps and the tusk bodies; colour 0 on the collar segments at the base; colour 3 as small speckled markings on the tusks; colour 2 on the tusk tips and shadowed undersides.
