Male/M_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_Humanface_.description: A pair of long curved insect mandibles that jut from either side of the mouth and sweep down past the chin, each ending in a sharp tip with a row of small spikes along the inner edge.
Male/M_Mouth_Qularr_Mandibles_Humanface_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rounded base caps and the mandible shafts; colour 0 on the collar rings at the base; colour 3 on speckled markings along the shafts; colour 2 on the tips and spikes.

Male/M_Mouth_Sandstorm_01.description: A mouth-and-nose respirator mask with a rounded front filter plate showing vented slots, framed by a thick padded rim and a wide ridged strap that wraps around the head, fastened by an octagonal clasp at the back.
Male/M_Mouth_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the strap; colour 1 on the front filter plate; colour 3 on the vent slots inside the plate; colour 2 on the rear octagonal clasp.

Male/M_Mouth_Scuba_01.description: A snorkel-style mouth piece: a mouthpiece sits at the lips, a rigid segmented tube rises up past one side of the face with a capped top, and a ribbed flexible hose curves back along the other cheek.
Male/M_Mouth_Scuba_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rigid tube; colour 3 on the tube's top cap; colour 2 on the ribbed flexible hose; colour 1 on the thin trim ring at the mouthpiece.

Male/M_Mouth_Spiked_01.description: A jaw-wrapping band that runs under the chin and angles up along both sides of the face toward the ears, with a small block at the chin, rivet holes on the side plates and cone spikes along the lower edge.
Male/M_Mouth_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main band; colour 1 on the chin block; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 2 on the rivet holes.
Male/M_Mouth_Spiked_01.differs: The male band shows a light metallic finish with visible rivet holes along the side plates, where the female band is darker and smoother.

Male/M_Mouth_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of curved, blade-like cheek guards, each a pointed leaf-shaped plate with a raised rim, standing off the cheeks from beside the eyes down to the jaw. Suggests a sleek sci-fi or beastly helmet accent.
Male/M_Mouth_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim edges; colour 1 on the outer plate surfaces.

Male/M_Mouth_Starhawk_02.description: A pair of curved, blade-like cheek guards that sweep from beside the eyes down along the jaw to points near the chin, leaving the mouth open. Faceted, shell-like plates suggest a beastly or mechanical helm.
Male/M_Mouth_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer surfaces of both plates; colour 1 on the inner surfaces and edges. Colours 2 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Mouth_Starowl_01.description: A hooked bird-beak mask covering the nose and mouth: a hollow, pointed shell that curves downward to a sharp tip past the chin, with small nostril marks on top. Suggests a raptor or owl costume.
Male/M_Mouth_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper beak; colour 2 on the lower tip and underside of the beak.

Male/M_Mouth_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A retro villain-style mouth frame: two separate angular metal tubes, each running up the cheek, turning along the jaw and ending near the chin, with a small hooked prong curving in toward the mouth.
Male/M_Mouth_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 2 on the metal tube frames, giving a glossy metallic finish; colour 1 on the hooked prongs by the mouth.

Male/M_Mouth_Techno_01.description: An angular sci-fi mouth and jaw guard: a V-shaped metal plate cups the chin, with tall pointed cheek fins sweeping up each side and vented side panels with round perforations. Sits over the lower face.
Male/M_Mouth_Techno_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chin plate, cheek fins and outer shell; colour 1 on the perforated side panels; colour 2 on the inner recesses beneath the fins; colour 3 on the small holes in the side panels.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Armor_Jaw_01.description: A slim, open metal jaw guard: a thin angular band that runs from in front of each ear down along the jawline and meets in a shallow point under the chin, leaving the mouth and cheeks bare.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Armor_Jaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the band; colour 2 on the underside of the chin and the inner edges. Colours 1 and 3 are not visible.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Bear_Boss_02.description: A metal jaw guard of flat, angular plates wrapping around the lower face from ear to ear, with jagged bear-trap teeth along the upper edge, a pointed chin and a round bolt at each hinge.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Bear_Boss_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jaw plates and teeth; colour 1 on the round hinge bolts at the sides; colour 2 on the thin edge lining underneath.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Beardtuft_Long_01.description: A long, tapered soul patch of facial hair that hangs from just below the lower lip and extends down past the chin to a rounded point, with a flared upper edge and a separate panel on one side.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Beardtuft_Long_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tuft and upper part; colour 1 on the lower side panel toward the tip.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Bikerbeard_01.description: A biker-style facial hair set: a thick, drooping handlebar moustache curling down at the ends, plus a separate chin tuft hanging in a narrow braid bound with several bands and ending in a small frayed tip.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Bikerbeard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the moustache and braided beard hair; colour 2 on the bands wrapped around the braid.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Bikerbeard_02.description: A full biker-style beard with a moustache and thick jagged sideburns that run from the ears along the jaw, ending in a short braided chin tuft bound with separate bands. Sits on the lower face and chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Bikerbeard_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main beard, sideburns and moustache hair; colour 2 on the bands around the braided chin tuft.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A angular chin guard: a faceted cup under the chin with thin flat bands that sweep up along the jawline toward the cheeks. It reads as a mechanical, armoured mouth piece.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole guard, including the chin cup and the jaw bands.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Chintuft_01.description: A small rounded tuft of facial hair, a soul patch, sitting on the chin just below the lower lip and curving around the front of the chin, with a pointed upper tip and a contrasting lower edge.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Chintuft_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tuft; colour 1 on the lower tip and underside.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Chops_Victorian_01.description: Sculpted mutton-chop sideburns that curve along each cheek and jaw and join in a thick moustache band above the lip, with upswept pointed tips near the cheekbones. Bold, beastly facial hair styling with a Victorian feel.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Chops_Victorian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upswept tips and the fringe edges of the cheek pieces; colour 1 on the main cheek sections; colour 2 on the moustache band and jawline underside; colour 3 on small patches at the lower cheek ends.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Clownnose_01.description: A small round clown nose: a smooth, hollow rubber-like ball that sits over the tip of the nose. The back is open to fit over the face. Suggests a playful, cute costume.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Clownnose_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole nose ball; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Cowboyrobotjaw_01.description: A slim, angular chin guard that covers the lower lip and chin: a central plate runs down the front, framed by thin edge strips and wrapped by side cheek pieces, giving a mechanical jaw look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Cowboyrobotjaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the side and top plates of the guard; colour 1 on the central front panel; colour 3 on the thin edge strips along the panel sides and top; colour 2 in the shadowed underside.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Cowboyrobotjaw_02.description: A small angular armored chin guard covering the mouth and jaw, with a flat top lip, a thin horizontal slot across the front, and short flared side wings at the cheeks. Suggests a robotic or mechanical half-mask.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Cowboyrobotjaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole chin guard and side wings; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Cowboyrobotjaw_02.differs: The male version adds a separate angular nose guard sitting on the bridge of the nose above the chin piece.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.description: A sci-fi open-face helmet shell: a thick angular ring framing the face and wrapping around the head, with layered side panels, ribbed vent inserts on top and a small boxy sensor block at the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and the inner face lining; colour 1 on the recessed panels and inserts; colour 3 on the thin stripe accents; colour 2 on the chin block and edge framing.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Cyberpunk_01.differs: The male chin block is a little larger and sits higher, with a bulkier ring at the sides.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Deity_01.description: A faceted, angular mouth guard that wraps across the lower face from cheek to cheek, with a V-shaped upper edge and a pointed chin. Folded planes give it a sleek, alien, armored look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Deity_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the right half of the front and its raised upper edge; colour 1 on the left half of the front and the inner back surface.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Dinojawbone_01.description: A skeletal dinosaur jawbone worn like a chin frame: two bony arms rise along the sides of the face to pointed tips above the ears and join under the chin, where a row of curved claw-like teeth points forward.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Dinojawbone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony jaw arms; colour 2 on the teeth.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Dragon_Tendril_01.description: A pair of long, thin whisker tendrils that sprout from small collar-like bases on each cheek beside the mouth, then curve outward and sweep back past the face with tapered, whip-like tips. Suggests a dragon or monstrous look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Dragon_Tendril_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the small bases where the whiskers attach; colour 2 on the long tendrils.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Dual_Tusk_01.description: A pair of short curved tusks jutting forward and down from either side of the chin, each with a banded, segmented base and a pointed tip. Suggests a beastly or orcish monster look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Dual_Tusk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper tops of the tusk bases and the tips; colour 1 on the middle bands; colour 2 on the segments near the tips.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Egyptian_Pharaoh_01.description: A pharaoh-style ceremonial false beard: a tapered rectangular column with a woven herringbone pattern, banded at the top, and a flared, ribbed curled tip at the bottom. It hangs from the chin.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Egyptian_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the woven beard body; colour 2 on the bands at the top and bottom of the beard; colour 1 on the ribbed tip and the top cap.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Gasmask_Medium_01.description: A half-face respirator mask covering nose bridge, mouth and chin, with angular armored plates, a ribbed front filter panel and rounded filter canisters on each cheek. Suggests a tactical or sci-fi combat look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Gasmask_Medium_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper nose and outer armor plates; colour 1 on the front filter panel and cheek canisters; colour 2 on the side housings and back shell; colour 3 on the vent slats.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Gasmask_Prisonguard_0.description: A high-tech respirator covering the mouth and chin, with side filter canisters and ribbed front vents. Thick hoses loop from the mask around the head to a canister at the back, held by thin head straps.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Gasmask_Prisonguard_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed front vent plate; colour 1 on the filter canisters and mask housing; colour 3 on the hoses and small studs; colour 2 on the head straps and the mask's underside.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Grassblade_01.description: A single thin grass stem held in the corner of the mouth, bending in two gentle angles and trailing down past the chin to a small serrated, feathery tip. A casual, rustic accessory.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Grassblade_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the stem; colour 0 on the serrated tip and the lower end of the stem.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Armorninja.description: An armoured ninja-style mouth mask made of stacked, segmented plates over the mouth and chin, with a pointed chin guard and long swept-back blades along each cheek toward the ears. Sits over the lower face.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper nose plate, chin plates and outer cheek blades; colour 1 on the framing cheek panels and plate edges; colour 2 on the central bands; colour 3 on the small cheek accents.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Light_01.description: A rigid, shield-shaped lower-face mask covering the nose bridge to the chin, with a raised central ridge, curved inset panels on each side and a pointed chin tip. Suggests a ninja or armored warrior look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and central ridge; colour 1 on the inset side panels; colour 2 on the small chin tip.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Paintball_01.description: A rigid lower-face mask covering nose bridge to chin, with a raised central nose ridge, a ribbed vent grille over the mouth and angled cheek panels with cross-strapped inserts. Sporty, protective, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mask_Paintball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the ribbed mouth grille; colour 3 on the cheek panel inserts; colour 2 on the straps across the cheek panels and grille slits.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegrou.description: A respirator-style face mask covering nose, mouth and chin, with a moulded rigid filter housing and round vent at the front, segmented cloth panels with contrasting seams, and two elastic straps around the head.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegrou.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main mask panels and head straps; colour 0 on the filter housing; colour 2 on the seams, strap fasteners and vent centre.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegrou.description: A respirator-style mask covering the nose, mouth and chin, with a round vented filter canister on each cheek and two thin straps that wrap around the head above and below the ears. Panel seams give it a moulded, tactical look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegrou.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mask shell, canisters and straps; colour 2 on the seam lines and edge trim.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegrou.description: A fitted half-mask covering the nose, mouth and chin, with a scooped upper edge under the eyes and vertical seam lines. Two thin straps run around the head, one above the brow and one across the cheeks.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskcombatsciencegrou.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mask panel; colour 2 on the seam lines, edging and straps.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskdragon_01.description: A small respirator-style mask covering the nose and mouth, with two rounded vent cups on the front and thin whip-like tendrils curving out sideways from each cheek. Suggests a dragon-themed, monstrous sci-fi look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskdragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell; colour 1 on the rings around the vent cups; colour 3 on the vent centres; colour 2 on the tendrils.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskdragon_02.description: A smooth, close-fitting mouth and nose mask covering the lower face, with a raised nose ridge and a pair of round, octagonal filter vents on the cheeks. Thin edge strips loop around the jaw to the back of the head.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Maskdragon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mask shell and thin edge strips; colour 1 on the vent rims; colour 3 on the vent centres.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mustache_Steampunk_01.description: A stylised handlebar mustache sitting on the upper lip: a chunky, faceted central section sweeps outward and up into two long, sharply pointed tips that extend past the cheeks. Suits a steampunk or dapper villain look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mustache_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the mustache; colour 1 on the upper portions of the pointed tips; colours 2 and 3 not visible.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mustache_Steampunk_02.description: A thick, bushy handlebar-style mustache that spreads across the upper lip and sweeps down and outward past the mouth corners, ending in curled, upturned tips. Sculpted with a shaggy, tufted texture; a comic, vintage look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mustache_Steampunk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central body of the mustache near the middle; colour 1 on the outer sweeps and curled tips, blending toward the centre.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mustachehandlebar_01.description: A thin, long handlebar moustache that sits across the upper lip and sweeps outward past the cheeks in smooth curves, each end finishing in a small curled hook. A classic dapper facial accessory.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Mustachehandlebar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole moustache; no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Qularrtuskbig_01.description: A pair of large curved tusks rising from beside the face over the head and sweeping down to sharp tips at the shoulders, built from segmented plates with jointed bands. Beastly, monstrous look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Qularrtuskbig_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper tusk segments; colour 1 on the lower tusk segments and tips; colour 3 on the base caps near the face; colour 2 on the joint bands.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Redstone_01.description: A soft cloth face wrap forming a loose, crinkled tube that covers the nose, mouth and chin and wraps fully around the head below the eyes, with a pair of contrasting stripes on each side.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the wrap; colour 1 on the paired stripes at the sides; the inner lining follows colour 0.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Ripper_01.description: A mechanical lower-jaw guard that wraps the chin and cheeks, with a toothed grille over the mouth, jagged serrated plates rising along the jaw toward the ears, and short cylindrical pipes jutting out from the chin and sides.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Ripper_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main jaw shell; colour 0 on the serrated edge plates and the central brow above the grille and teeth; colour 2 on the pipes; colour 3 on the rings around the pipes.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Rudolph_01.description: A smooth, rounded ball-shaped nose that sits over the tip of the nose at the centre of the face. It is hollow at the back, like a clown or reindeer nose, and suits cute, holiday and costume looks.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Rudolph_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole nose; the sheet shows no other colour slots on this piece.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A samurai-style half mask covering the nose, cheeks, mouth and jaw, sculpted with a raised nose bridge, a grimacing toothy mouth slot and a thin trim line along the edges, with a contrasting rim under the eyes.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask plate; colour 1 on the thin trim line across the cheeks and jaw; colour 2 on the rim along the upper edge and the mouth interior.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_02.description: A samurai-style half mask covering the lower face: a sculpted armored jaw with a snarling toothy mouth, a contrasting rim under the eyes, cord ties looping up to the ears, a layered plated neck guard below tied with a bow, and a bristly moustache.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jaw plate and neck guard plates; colour 1 on thin line details along the plates; colour 2 on the upper rim and toggles; colour 3 on the cords, bow and moustache.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_02.differs: The male version adds a bristly moustache above the mouth.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_Large_02.description: A samurai-style armored jaw guard covering the nose bridge to chin: a pointed chin plate, vertical slat markings across the mouth, and swirl-patterned cheek plates that wrap toward the ears, with a thin band beneath the jaw.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Samurai_Large_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main face and chin plate; colour 1 on the vertical slats and the thin line across the upper edge; colour 2 on the cheek plates, lower jaw band and swirl backgrounds; colour 3 on the swirl patterns.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Scuba_01.description: A scuba-style breathing apparatus: a ribbed mouthpiece with two rounded side cartridges sits over the mouth, joined by looping hoses that run around the head to a cylindrical canister at the back of the head.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Scuba_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed mouthpiece; colour 1 on the side cartridges and the rear canister; colour 3 on the hoses.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Scuba_01.differs: The rear canister sits lower at the back of the head, close above the neck, and the hoses loop more tightly.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Secret_03.description: A novelty disguise: an oversized rounded false nose with a broad base sits over the nose, with a ragged, jagged-edged moustache hanging beneath it above the lips. Comic, casual gag-costume style.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Secret_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 appears to tint the false nose (shown in a skin tone); colour 1 on the moustache.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.description: An angular half-face mask covering nose bridge to chin, with a contrasting central panel, bulky side filter pods with small round studs, and short fang-like tusks jutting down at the mouth. Sci-fi rebel look.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Space_Scoundrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose guard, side pods and tusks; colour 1 on the edge trim and inner accents; colour 2 on the main front panel.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Steampunk_01.description: A cloth mask-scarf wrapping the lower face from nose to chin and around the neck, with vertical seam lines, a studded rim along the top and a round filter canister on one cheek. Steampunk respirator style.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth body; colour 3 on the top rim band and the seam lines; colour 1 on the canister and the small studs; colour 2 on the inner lining.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Steampunk_01.differs: The male version has a smaller starburst-like patch on the top rim, whereas the female version shows a broad fluffy patch across the top.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_01.description: A tactical jaw-guard band that curves under the chin and up both cheeks to a boxy pod at each ear, with a small contrasting lens panel on the side of each pod and a vent at the chin. Sits over the lower face.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ear pods and the outer cheek bands; colour 0 on the inner chin band and chin plate; colour 2 on the lens panels and chin vent; colour 3 on the thin rims around the lens panels.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_02.description: A angular chin guard that wraps under the jaw in a V shape, with flat plates rising along each cheek to a point and a small hexagonal module at the chin. Suggests a tactical sci-fi mask.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jaw plates and cheek wings; colour 2 on the underside and chin housing; colour 3 on the small chin module.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_03.description: A angular chin guard of faceted plates that wraps under the jaw and sweeps up along both sides toward the cheeks, with a gem-like block at the chin. Suggests tactical or sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Tactical_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main jaw plates; colour 1 on the chin block; colour 2 on the outer edge and underside trim.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Techmask_01.description: A compact respirator-style mouth mask covering the nose to chin, with a central studded vertical strip, large round filter canisters on each cheek, and small marking stripes at the nose bridge. Suits sci-fi or tactical looks.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Techmask_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main mask shell; colour 1 on the central strip; colour 2 on the cheek canisters; colour 3 on the studs, canister rings and nose marks.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Titan_01.description: An angular faceted mouth guard covering the lower face from below the eyes, with a V-notched upper edge and a long pointed chin spike that hangs down over the throat. Suggests a sci-fi or monstrous helmet mask.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Titan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised upper rim edge; colour 2 on the main faceted plates of the guard; colour 1 has little visible effect.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Welder_01.description: A rigid angular half-mask covering the mouth and jaw, with a faceted front plate, round vent ports on the sides and two short upright filter posts near the cheeks. It has a lighter lining inside and suits industrial or sci-fi looks.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Welder_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the mask shell; colour 2 on the upright posts and vent ports; colour 0 on the inner lining under the chin.

Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Whiskers_01.description: A set of thin, curved whiskers fanning out from each side of the upper lip, three or four fine strands per side, giving a cat-like animal look. Sits at the muzzle without covering the face.
Male/M_Mouth_Tight_Whiskers_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the whisker strands; the fine tips show a faint metallic sheen and no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Mouth_Toy_01.description: A novelty false nose and moustache: a chunky faceted rounded knob sits over the nose, with two long, thin, upswept curled moustache tips extending out to each side above the lip. Comic, toy-like styling.
Male/M_Mouth_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the nose knob, which shows a stone-like finish; colour 2 on the moustache tips, with colour 1 showing on their undersides.

Male/M_Necklace_Tight_Fishinghat_01.description: A bucket-style fishing hat worn slung on the upper back like a hanging hat, held by a thin cord that loops around the neck. It has a rounded crown, a brim, small eyelet vents and a stitched band.
Male/M_Necklace_Tight_Fishinghat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the crown, the inner lining and the neck cord; colour 1 on the brim edge; colour 2 on the stitched band and cord fittings; colour 3 on the small eyelets.

Male/M_Patriotcelebrationl_2025_01.description: A curved shoulder guard that arches over the left shoulder, with a rimmed outer plate and stacked horizontal bands that overlap like lames. Small round studs sit at the lower edge. A sci-fi, superhero armor style.
Male/M_Patriotcelebrationl_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and edge plate; colour 1 on alternating horizontal bands; colour 2 on the other bands and inner lining; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Patriotcelebrationr_2025_01.description: A large eagle-themed shoulder guard: an overlapping scaled plate shell with a raised rim, a hooked beak-and-talon crest on top, and a fringe of long feather-like tabs hanging down the outer side.
Male/M_Patriotcelebrationr_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, frame and talons; colour 2 on the overlapping plates; colour 1 on the crest and the hanging feather tabs; colour 3 on the studs.
Male/M_Patriotcelebrationr_2025_01.differs: The male version adds an eagle-head crest on top and a fringe of feather-like tabs hanging down, with overlapping plates instead of simple ribs.

Male/M_Shoulder_Pad_L_Variablerobot_01.description: A boxy mechanical shoulder pad: a large blocky housing with two dial-like screw fittings sits on the outer shoulder, joined to an upright slotted vent plate at the front and a flat back plate, in a bulky robotic style.
Male/M_Shoulder_Pad_L_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main housing; colour 2 on the frame and back plate; colour 3 on the vent slats; colour 0 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Spad_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.description: A steampunk shoulder piece: a boxy vented metal housing on the left shoulder blade, with a curved shoulder cap, a tall thin exhaust pipe rising above, a small gear-like wheel at the side and coiled hoses below.
Male/M_Spad_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the housing frame and hose coils; colour 1 on the shoulder cap, top cylinder, back panel and pipe accents; colour 2 on the exhaust pipe and wheel; colour 3 on the vent slats.

Male/M_Spadl_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A single left shoulder guard with a tall, thin curved blade sweeping up above the shoulder, attached to an open cup-shaped pauldron with layered plates; a mechanical, sci-fi armour look.
Male/M_Spadl_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade and outer pauldron surface; colour 1 on the stripe along the blade and the inner plates; colour 2 on the inside of the cup and lower edge; colour 3 on the small inner accent panel.
Male/M_Spadl_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The male version has an open, curved cup with a lighter blade and a contrasting stripe, while the female has a chunkier enclosed pod and a mostly contrasting blade.

Male/M_Spadl_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a snarling bulldog head, with wrinkled brow, bared fangs and glowing eyes, set in a hollow rounded shell with a raised rim that caps the shoulder. Retro mechanical villain styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sculpted head; colour 1 on the rim and inner shell; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Anniversary_Destroyer_02.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a scowling, sculpted face with heavy brow ridges and a wrinkled snout, set in a hollow rim-edged shell. It caps the outer shoulder, with small spikes at the bottom edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Anniversary_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised rim and the hollow inner shell; the sculpted face is glossy metal that ignores the scheme; colour 3 shows on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a smooth, glossy shell that domes over the top of the arm, with a notched open underside and a thin contrasting rim. Retro robotic look.
Male/M_Spadl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, which has a glossy metallic finish; colour 1 on the rim and inner lining.

Male/M_Spadl_Aquatic_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder, with a raised metal rim and three swept-back fin-like spikes along the top. Three stripe panels run across the shell, giving an aquatic superhero look.
Male/M_Spadl_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes and the outer stripe panel; colour 1 on the middle stripe panel; colour 3 on the stripe panel nearest the spikes; colour 2 on the rim.

Male/M_Spadl_Aquatic_02.description: A curved, fin-like shoulder plate that caps the left shoulder, with a thick rim, layered swept panels, a stripe down the middle and a small square gem at each end; sleek, aquatic sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept outer panels; colour 1 on the central stripe panel; colour 2 on the rim border; colour 3 on the square gems.

Male/M_Spadl_Balloon_Toy_01.description: A small twisted balloon-animal dog perched on top of the left shoulder: glossy sausage-shaped balloon segments form the body, four legs, a head with long upright ears and a small tail. Playful and novelty in style.
Male/M_Spadl_Balloon_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, snout and neck segment; colour 1 on the legs and body balloons; colour 2 on one ear; colour 3 on the tail and the other ear.

Male/M_Spadl_Bounty_01.description: A curved, shell-like left shoulder cap that arches over the shoulder, with a thick rounded rim and two angled inset panels on the outer face plus a narrow raised strip along the top. Sci-fi bounty-hunter look.
Male/M_Spadl_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shell and rim; colour 1 on the upper inset panel; colour 0 on the lower inset panel; colour 3 on the top strip.

Male/M_Spadl_Buzzsaw_01.description: Three notched circular saw blades hovering at the left shoulder, each with a raised central hub, ring detail and studded rim holes, tilted at different angles and fanned over the shoulder and upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Buzzsaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face of the light blade and the hub rings; colour 2 on the blades; colour 3 on the small dots around the blade faces; colour 1 on the thin blade edges.
Male/M_Spadl_Buzzsaw_01.differs: The male blades show distinct colour detail, with contrasting-dotted faces, coloured edge trim and a raised hub, rather than a uniform shiny metal finish.

Male/M_Spadl_Buzzsaw_02.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades floating around the left shoulder, one large and two smaller, each with a raised centre disc and a star-shaped hub. Mechanical, industrial shoulder decoration.
Male/M_Spadl_Buzzsaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toothed blade rims; colour 1 on the inner blade discs; colour 3 on the star-shaped hubs.
Male/M_Spadl_Buzzsaw_02.differs: The blades sit in a more compact cluster on top of the shoulder, with one blade lying nearly flat instead of stacked down the arm.

Male/M_Spadl_Buzzsaw_03.description: Three floating circular saw blades with toothed edges and ring-shaped hubs, clustered at the left shoulder in different sizes and tilts. A mechanical, industrial shoulder accessory that is not attached to the body.
Male/M_Spadl_Buzzsaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade discs and hub rings; colour 1 on the inner band of each blade; colour 3 on the small rivets around the hubs; colour 2 on the teeth of the lower blade.

Male/M_Spadl_Cannonarm_01.description: A shoulder-mounted laser cannon: a streamlined armoured housing with contrasting vents sits on the back of the shoulder, and a long multi-barrel muzzle with open framework points up and forward past the head.
Male/M_Spadl_Cannonarm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and barrel shrouds; colour 1 on the edge trim and outer barrel rails; colour 2 on the vents and inner mechanism; colour 3 on small accents near the muzzle.

Male/M_Spadl_Cat_01.description: A small sculpted cat sitting upright on the top of the left shoulder, facing forward with pointed ears, front paws together and a long tail curling down the back of the shoulder. A cute, whimsical companion accessory.
Male/M_Spadl_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cat's body, ears, paws and tail; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Chicken_01.description: A novelty rubber chicken draped over the left shoulder like a scarf, its plump body resting on the back with legs dangling behind and a long limp neck hanging down the front of the chest.
Male/M_Spadl_Chicken_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chicken body and neck; colour 3 on the feet, comb and wattle; colour 2 on the small tuft of feathers at the head; colour 1 on the eye.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Aquatic_01.description: A row of three curved, fin-like spikes in graduated sizes, running along the top of the left shoulder toward the neck. Each is a swept, angular blade on a small faceted base, suggesting shark fins or aquatic ridges.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three fins; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Draco_01.description: A left shoulder piece of sharp, layered plates that sweep up and outward into long curved horn-like blades, with a jagged serrated panel on the front. Sits on top of the shoulder in a dragon-inspired, aggressive style.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the jagged serrated plates; colour 2 on the long curved horn blades and underlying edge plate.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Future_01.description: A single left shoulder gadget: a thick rounded ring with a recessed inner core, a spiked fin at its top edge, mounted on a slim angled strut with a cut-out slot that rises from the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ring rim; colour 1 on the strut and the spiked fin; colour 3 on the inner ring core; colour 2 on the ring's inner shadow and the strut tip.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Future_02.description: A single curved blade-like loop worn on the left shoulder: a slim, smooth hooked arc that rises over the shoulder and ends in a barbed, fishhook-like point at the front. Sleek, futuristic accent.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Future_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole curved blade; the other colour slots are not visible.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Punk_01.description: A cluster of four separate tapering spikes sprouting from the top of the left shoulder, fanning upward and outward at different angles. They are small, sharp and punky, with no base plate or strap.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A scatter of small conical spikes on the left shoulder: larger ones jut outward and back from the top of the shoulder, with a smaller cluster of tiny spikes lower on the upper arm. Punkish and mechanical.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the larger shoulder spikes; colour 2 on the small lower spikes on the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.differs: The male version has fewer, more widely spaced spikes across the top of the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.description: A slim adjustable strap band worn around the upper left arm, with loose strap ends passing through hexagonal metal buckle loops. A utilitarian sci-fi look with a long, flat band and trailing tabs.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap bands and tabs; colour 1 on the hexagonal buckle loops.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.differs: The male strap hangs looser and more open, with its two strap ends spread apart rather than overlapping.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tactical_01.description: A flat atom-shaped emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a small central nucleus, thin and decal-like, sitting on the outer left shoulder. Suggests a science or energy-themed superhero badge.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit rings and nucleus; colour 1 on the thin outline edging the rings.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A small flat atom-style emblem of looping elliptical orbits around a central ring, on top of the left shoulder, with two small separate curved fragments lower down the shoulder. Suggests a sci-fi superhero insignia.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the orbit loops and fragments; colour 1 on the thin outline edging them.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.differs: The male version adds two small separate curved fragments below the main emblem on the shoulder, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A left shoulder attachment of three long curved bone-like spines that sweep outward and forward from a segmented central spine, with contrasting hooked spikes on top and small curved thorns trailing down the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented central spine and the small thorns; colour 1 on the long curved spines; colour 2 on the hooked spikes.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The long spines are grouped more tightly and angle down the front of the shoulder, hanging more vertically than the female version.

Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A ring-shaped shoulder collar of layered, jagged fur-like spikes that encircles the left shoulder, open in the centre so the arm passes through. Feral, savage look, sitting around the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Child_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur spikes; the inner shadowed spikes appear darker from shading only.

Male/M_Spadl_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A boxy, angular mechanical shoulder pad for the left shoulder: a hollow shell with a raised rear fin, a textured front panel and a lower plated band, suggesting sci-fi robotic armor.
Male/M_Spadl_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and rear fin; colour 2 on the textured front panel and inner lining; colour 0 on the lower band; colour 3 on the angled accent patches.

Male/M_Spadl_Corrupted_01.description: A left shoulder piece shaped like a bat wing: a domed cap with scalloped, pointed flaps that sweep down over the upper arm and back, plus two curved horn-like spikes rising from the top.
Male/M_Spadl_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed cap and central ridges; colour 1 on the outer wing flaps and underside; colour 3 on the curved spikes.

Male/M_Spadl_Cosmic_01.description: A thin, curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder, wedge-shaped and tapering to a point over the upper arm. Its top carries stepped, angular raised panels with a slim contrasting edge along the underside.
Male/M_Spadl_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plate surface and raised panels; colour 1 on the angular trim and lower edge lining; colour 0 on the underside lining.

Male/M_Spadl_Cosmos_01.description: A single angular metal shoulder guard for the left shoulder: layered curved plates with a raised ridge band, sweeping out to a sharp point at the front and back, with a lining panel visible inside the rim.
Male/M_Spadl_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plates; colour 2 on the recessed ridge band and edge lines; colour 1 on the inner lining panel. The glossy metal finish mutes the scheme on the outer plates.

Male/M_Spadl_Cosmos_02.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a curved horn: a smooth faceted metal shell that sweeps outward and up into a sharp point, with a thin contrasting strip along the top edge. Sits on the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell and inner surface; colour 1 on the thin strip along the top edge; colour 0 on the outer rim edges.
Male/M_Spadl_Cosmos_02.differs: The male version's outer surface is mostly contrasting with only a thin contrasting strip, while the female version has a lighter shell with a wider inset panel.

Male/M_Spadl_Crimson_01.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a snarling dragon head, with swept-back spiky horns and flame-like crests, a rounded plated dome and a patterned underside lining. Sits over the shoulder cap in an ornate fantasy style.
Male/M_Spadl_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome plates; colour 2 on the dragon head, horns and rim edging; colour 1 on the patterned inner lining; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Cryo_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a layered plate with a stepped upper panel, edged by a thick arched band over the top, with small angular nubs at both ends. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadl_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower plate edge; colour 1 on the stepped upper panel; colour 2 on the arched band; colour 3 on the end nubs.

Male/M_Spadl_Cyberwire_01.description: A small sci-fi shoulder pad: a smooth domed cap with a tapered, pointed outer edge, a thick contrasting rim along the inner side, small vent slots on the flank and a round glowing-style indicator on top.
Male/M_Spadl_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top dome; colour 1 on the lower side shell; colour 2 on the rim; colour 3 on the round top marking and the small vent slots.

Male/M_Spadl_Defender_Update_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron of angular, segmented armor plates: a smooth domed outer shell with stacked panels and a small round port on the outer face, sitting over the top of the shoulder in a sci-fi superhero style.
Male/M_Spadl_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome shell; colour 1 on the upper and lower panel plates; colour 2 on the darker inset panels; colour 3 on the thin accent strip between plates.

Male/M_Spadl_Dog_01.description: A small figurine-like puppy lying on the left shoulder, with upright pointed ears, a bow tie at the neck, forepaws draped over the front and a thin tail hanging down the back. Cute, playful novelty shoulder piece.
Male/M_Spadl_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the puppy's body and legs; colour 0 on the inner ears, paws and muzzle; colour 2 on the bow tie; colour 3 on the eyes and bow tie centre.
Male/M_Spadl_Dog_01.differs: The puppy lies with its body along the shoulder, its head turned forward and its tail hanging down the back.

Male/M_Spadl_Draco_01.description: A single-shoulder pauldron: a curved plate with a rimmed edge caps the left shoulder, and tall curved, barbed spikes sweep up and back from it like dragon horns. Angular, sci-fi fantasy styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the rim trim; colour 3 on the inner barbed spikes; colour 2 on the outer long curved spike.

Male/M_Spadl_Dragon_01.description: A small winged dragon figure perched on the left shoulder, with a segmented belly, spread bat-like wings, swept-back horns and a long curling spiked tail hanging down the back. Suggests a fantasy pet companion.
Male/M_Spadl_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, wing arms and tail; colour 1 on the horns and wing claws; colour 2 on the chest panel and wing membranes; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Dryad_01.description: A left shoulder piece made of a curved, shell-like cap with a tangle of twisting woody branches or roots that sweep outward and one tall tendril rising up. Sits over the shoulder in a fantasy, nature-guardian style.
Male/M_Spadl_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the twisting branches; colour 0 on the shell-like cap; colour 1 on the spots or patches on the cap.

Male/M_Spadl_Dryad_02.description: A curved, shell-like shoulder plate that sweeps over the left shoulder, with a smooth main panel, a bordering frame of twisting vine-like ribs, and a lacy, organic cut-out growth across the outer half.
Male/M_Spadl_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 2 on the vine-like frame edging; colour 1 on the lacy outer growth.

Male/M_Spadl_Element_Fire_01.description: A left shoulder piece of swept, flame-like tongues that curl upward and outward, with a glossy rippled surface. It sits on top of the shoulder, stretching from the neck base toward the arm, with a fantasy-superhero elemental look.
Male/M_Spadl_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material ignores most of the colour scheme; the whole piece shows a reflective metallic finish, with no clear separate slot areas.

Male/M_Spadl_Element_Fire_02.description: A small left shoulder piece of glossy, rippled flame-like shapes: jagged swept tongues rise toward the neck and trail down over the upper arm, giving a spiky, flowing silhouette that perches on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: The default glossy material largely ignores the colour scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows in the reflections, with the rest reading as a reflective metallic finish.

Male/M_Spadl_Falcon_01.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a stylised falcon head, with swept feather crests and a hooked beak, rising from a flared, stud-decorated base band. A curved shell sits over the shoulder cap. Heroic, mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadl_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather crest and the base band; colour 1 on the outer rim, beak and studs; colour 2 on the feather slits; colour 3 on the eye.

Male/M_Spadl_Firebird_01.description: A small angular shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a shallow faceted cup with a sharply pointed flared outer edge, and a raised swept fin-like plate rising from the centre. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and pointed rim; colour 1 on the raised central fin plate; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Spadl_Frigid_01.description: A single left shoulder guard made of layered, stepped armor plates with a beveled edge, capping the shoulder and sweeping down the upper arm. A cluster of long, swept-back crystalline spikes rises from the top.
Male/M_Spadl_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate layers; colour 2 on the inner lining and plate edging; colour 1 on the tall spike cluster.

Male/M_Spadl_Future_01.description: A futuristic left shoulder piece: a small flared cap over the shoulder with a raised rim, topped by a tall ring with a spiked fin, and curved claw-like prongs sweeping forward over the chest.
Male/M_Spadl_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap, the spiked fin and the stem; colour 0 on the cap edge, ring frame and curved prongs; colour 3 on the inside of the ring.
Male/M_Spadl_Future_01.differs: This version has a larger, wider shoulder cap and a bigger ring that stands higher above the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadl_Gearbreak_01.description: A single curved shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a tall tapered plate with a thick contrasting rim, a small octagonal stud on the front and a boxy latch-like pod on the rear edge. Mechanical, utilitarian look.
Male/M_Spadl_Gearbreak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 2 on the rim edging and the boxy pod; colour 1 on the octagonal stud and the strap on the pod.

Male/M_Spadl_Gladiator_02.description: A single left shoulder guard: a curved, shell-like pauldron with a raised rim and swept, pointed fins at the front and back edges, sitting over the top of the shoulder. Sleek armoured look with a separate inner panel.
Male/M_Spadl_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer rim and pointed fins; colour 0 on the inner panel lining.

Male/M_Spadl_Heraldry_01.description: A rounded, domed left shoulder pauldron with a raised inner lining panel along the front rim, a small rivet at the side, and two stacked overlapping lames flaring below. Sits over the shoulder cap in a superhero-armour style.
Male/M_Spadl_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome of the pauldron; colour 3 on the inner lining panel; colour 1 on the stacked lames below; colour 2 on the rim edging and underside.
Male/M_Spadl_Heraldry_01.differs: The male pauldron has a lower, broader dome with the lining showing mainly as a narrow strip along the front edge.

Male/M_Spadl_Hybrid_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a bordered shell, a glowing eye-like gem in the middle, a ridged underside and several curved horn-like spikes pointing up and out. Monstrous, mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadl_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell surface and underside ridges; colour 2 on the outer rim and border plates; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 3 on the eye gem.

Male/M_Spadl_Ice_01.description: A single left shoulder piece made of a jagged cluster of faceted crystal shards, with a long pointed spike sweeping outward and smaller splinters hanging below. It sits on top of the shoulder as an icy, fantasy-style pauldron.
Male/M_Spadl_Ice_01.colourAreas: The glossy crystal ignores most of the scheme; colour 1 shows as a tint on some upper facets, and the rest of the shards are a glossy reflective finish that takes little of the other colours.

Male/M_Spadl_Ice_02.description: A cluster of jagged, faceted crystal shards piled over the left shoulder and trailing down the upper arm in a tapering, irregular column. Glossy angular fragments give it a frozen, fantasy look.
Male/M_Spadl_Ice_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the glossy shard surfaces; colour 1 on many of the shard facets as highlights. The glossy material largely ignores the other colour slots.
Male/M_Spadl_Ice_02.differs: The male shards form a bulkier, wider mass across the top of the shoulder with a shorter trail down the arm.

Male/M_Spadl_Insect_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron shaped like an insect shell: a domed top plate studded with rows of sharp spikes, pointed fins sweeping forward and back, and a tongue-like flap hanging over the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed top plate; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 0 on the pointed front and rear fins; colour 1 on the hanging flap and underside panels.

Male/M_Spadl_Jaggedhorns_01.description: A large curled ramlike horn that sprouts from the left shoulder: a thick segmented base sweeps up and around in a spiral, with ridged bands and tapering spiked tips at both ends. Monstrous, demonic style.
Male/M_Spadl_Jaggedhorns_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main segmented horn body; colour 2 on the thin ridge lines between segments; colour 1 on the upper horn band; colour 3 on the tips of both horn ends.

Male/M_Spadl_Kaiju_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a slightly bumpy, leathery surface and many curved horn-like spikes of varied size, one large spike sweeping up and back. Monstrous, aggressive styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shoulder cap; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Spadl_Kitten_01.description: A small kitten figure perched on the left shoulder, crouched with its front paws draped over the front of the shoulder and a long tail hanging down the back. Cute, soft and rounded, with pointed ears and small eyes.
Male/M_Spadl_Kitten_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the whole kitten body, ears, paws and tail; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Kitten_Toy_01.description: A small low-poly toy cat lying sprawled on top of the left shoulder, with a rounded head, pointed ears, stitched whisker lines and dot eyes, dangling front paws with paw-pad marks, and a long tail trailing behind.
Male/M_Spadl_Kitten_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, head, ears and limbs; colour 1 on the paw pads; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the whisker marks.

Male/M_Spadl_Lockbox_65_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron topped with a snarling dragon or beast head with spiky mane and horns, on a curved cap-shaped plate with trim edging and small hanging tassels. Ornate east-asian fantasy style.
Male/M_Spadl_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the beast head and mane; colour 0 on the horns, teeth and plate trim; colour 2 on the shoulder plate and tassels; colour 3 on the eyes and tassel beads.
Male/M_Spadl_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The male version has two tassels at the front and a larger, clearly defined dragon head.

Male/M_Spadl_Lockbox_65_02.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a horned beast or dragon head, with curved horns sweeping up and back, a snouted face on the outer shoulder, and a ragged fur-like fringe hanging around the lower edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main head plating and horns; colour 1 on the inset swirl panels; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the fur fringe.
Male/M_Spadl_Lockbox_65_02.differs: The default finish is matte and bright, so the coloured swirl panels and eyes stand out clearly against the plating.

Male/M_Spadl_Lockbox_66_01.description: A curved, angular shoulder plate for the left shoulder: a bordered shell with a raised hex-nut boss at the centre, a segmented band of small blocks along one edge, and notched tabs at the corners. Mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadl_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate face; colour 2 on the outer frame and tabs; colour 1 on the segmented band; colour 3 on the centre boss light.

Male/M_Spadl_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron of smooth, swept metal plating curling in a crescent around a faceted, angular beast-head ornament at its centre. It caps the shoulder with a pointed rear flare, in a heroic sci-fi style.
Male/M_Spadl_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swept shoulder plate; colour 1 on the faceted beast head; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A domed metal left shoulder guard with a raised outer rim, a stylised bird-head shape with a small eye on the front, flame-like cut-out panels and a round ring fitting at the point. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the inner and flame-shaped panels; colour 3 on the eye; colour 2 on the underside segments.

Male/M_Spadl_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a smooth shell that arches over the top of the arm and flares outward, with a contrasting band across it and a thick rim around the edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the band across the shell; colour 2 on the rim and underside.

Male/M_Spadl_Moth_01.description: A smooth, domed shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a hollow rounded shell with a thin rim of contrasting edging, covering the top of the shoulder and upper arm. It has a sleek, organic-looking superhero style.
Male/M_Spadl_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 1 blending into the upper edge of the shell; colour 0 on the thin rim edging.

Male/M_Spadl_Patriotcelebration_2025_02.description: A single curved shoulder cap with a stylised eagle-head crest on top, a rim of angular plates with small studs, rows of contrasting overlapping scale panels, and a fringe of long feather-like tabs hanging over the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Patriotcelebration_2025_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim plates and claw-like tips; colour 1 on the eagle crest and the hanging feather fringe; colour 2 on the scale panels; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Spadl_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A small left shoulder ornament of clustered, sharp horn-like spikes and blade shards fanning outward and back from the top of the shoulder, with a larger swept fin at the rear. Suggests a dragon-claw look.
Male/M_Spadl_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: All of the piece is one glossy material that appears to ignore the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Spadl_Qularr_Spines_01.description: A cluster of thin, jointed insect-like spines sprouting from the left shoulder and upper back, each segmented leg arching outward and tapering to a fine tip, with rounded socket bases. Suits monstrous or alien looks.
Male/M_Spadl_Qularr_Spines_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rounded joint bases; colour 1 on the main spine segments; colour 2 on the tapering outer sections; colour 3 on the tiny tips.
Male/M_Spadl_Qularr_Spines_01.differs: The male spines fan out wider across the top of the shoulder, with longer legs reaching further forward and outward.

Male/M_Spadl_Raven_01.description: A small perched raven figure sitting on the left shoulder, with textured feathered plumage, a tapering tail sweeping back, a sharp beak and thin clawed feet gripping the shoulder. A companion-style pet accessory.
Male/M_Spadl_Raven_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feathered body; colour 3 on the beak; colour 2 on the feet and claws.

Male/M_Spadl_Reindeer_Toy_01.description: A small plush toy reindeer perched on the left shoulder in a lying pose, with a rounded body, stubby legs, a round nose, branching antlers and a fuzzy collar ruff. Cute holiday novelty accessory.
Male/M_Spadl_Reindeer_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, head and ears; colour 1 on the collar ruff and rump patch; colour 2 on the antlers and hooves; colour 3 on the nose and eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Renegade_Punk_01.description: A single left shoulder pad of angular, faceted armor plating with a raised rim and a cluster of four sharp spikes along the top; a separate under-plate extends outward over the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Renegade_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the rim and edge trim; colour 2 on the under-plate; colour 3 on the spikes.

Male/M_Spadl_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A mechanical left shoulder guard: a curved metal cup with a thick domed cap on top, studded with large cone spikes, a face-like plate with small contrasting spikes below, and a buckled strap around the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal cup, face plate and strap; colour 1 on the domed cap and strap buckle accents; colour 3 on the large cone spikes and the line markings on the plate; colour 2 on the small lower spikes.
Male/M_Spadl_Renegade_Spikes_01.differs: The male cap is broader and flatter with spikes spread in a row along the rim, and the strap sits lower on the arm.

Male/M_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A small angular shoulder pad forming a curved hollow shell over the top of the left shoulder, with a raised contrasting cap plate stepped on top and chunky faceted edges. Suggests retro sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised top cap plate; colour 0 on the lower shell and side edges; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Male/M_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_02.description: A boxy mechanical missile launcher floating above the left shoulder, with six round ported openings on its front face and a ribbed flexible hose curving down from a collar fitting at the rear to the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box housing; colour 1 on the front face plate with the ports; colour 2 on the port rings and the hose end; colour 3 on the ribbed hose.

Male/M_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_04.description: A boxy shoulder-mounted missile launcher pod with a front face of six round tubes, a panelled top and a collar joint at the back. A flexible ribbed hose trails down from it toward the upper back.
Male/M_Spadl_Retro_Warlord_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box casing and rear collar; colour 1 on the frame around the front tube face; colour 2 on the tube openings; colour 3 on the wrapped hose.

Male/M_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A curved plate pauldron for the left shoulder: a tall, flared shell with a notched lower edge, a bright metal rim along the top, and a separate angled panel beneath. Suggests retro mechanical armour.
Male/M_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the raised rim edging; colour 1 on the lower angled panel.

Male/M_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_02.description: A single left shoulder guard: a curved, shell-like metal plate with a raised ridge and notched, angular lower edges, plus a rolled contrasting rim at the base. It sits over the top of the shoulder in a retro mechanical superhero style.
Male/M_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main plate; colour 0 on the thin raised edge trim; colour 1 on the rolled lower rim.

Male/M_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.description: A tapered, shell-like left shoulder cap with a raised rim, curving down over the shoulder to a pointed tip at the front. Angled slatted vents sit on the front and back faces; a retro mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadl_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim edging; colour 1 on the vent slats and the lower front tip; colour 3 on the recessed vent backing.

Male/M_Spadl_Rockcrystal_01.description: A shoulder cluster of chunky, faceted rock slabs with cracked seams between them, sitting over the left shoulder and sweeping outward into jagged crystal spikes with a smaller cluster hanging below.
Male/M_Spadl_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the cracks between the slabs.

Male/M_Spadl_Rubber_Duck_01.description: A small rounded toy duck perched on the left shoulder beside the neck, with a smooth low-poly body, upturned tail, round head, small eyes and a flat open beak. Playful novelty shoulder accessory.
Male/M_Spadl_Rubber_Duck_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the duck's body and head; colour 1 on the beak; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Sandstorm_01.description: A soft cloth shoulder cap shaped like a draped, open-ended cowl that wraps over the top of the left shoulder and upper arm, with gathered folds and a rounded, hollow opening on the underside.
Male/M_Spadl_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and inner folds of the wrap; colour 1 on the outer rim and lower edge, blending into the upper part.
Male/M_Spadl_Sandstorm_01.differs: The male version is a taller, rounder cap that covers the top of the shoulder, with a large opening underneath, instead of a low ring around the arm.

Male/M_Spadl_Sandstorm_02.description: A chunky angular left shoulder guard: a faceted, cup-shaped plate capping the shoulder with an inner curved lining, a trim band below and a tab hanging down the upper arm, held by a loop strap.
Male/M_Spadl_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate; colour 1 on the inner lining and lower band; colour 3 on the hanging tab; colour 2 on the strap loop.
Male/M_Spadl_Sandstorm_02.differs: The male guard is larger and wraps further over the shoulder and down the upper arm, with a wider strap loop.

Male/M_Spadl_Sandstorm_Alt_01.description: A rounded, soft cloth shoulder cap draped over the top of the left shoulder, with creased folds and an open hollow underneath, resembling a cut-off sleeve.
Male/M_Spadl_Sandstorm_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top and front of the cap; colour 1 gradient toward the lower and inner edges.
Male/M_Spadl_Sandstorm_Alt_01.differs: The male version is a larger rounded cap that covers the top of the shoulder, while the female version is a tighter cylindrical cuff on the upper arm.

Male/M_Spadl_Scarab_01.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a domed beetle shell, open on the underside, with a pointed horn on top, a rolled edge along the neck side, and hooked claw-like tips at front and back.
Male/M_Spadl_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and top horn; colour 1 on the rolled edge along the inner rim; colour 2 on the lower edge band; colour 3 on the hooked tips.

Male/M_Spadl_Scarab_02.description: A left shoulder guard of angular, swept plates with pointed edges, cut-out openings showing a glossy inset, and a separate curved fin-like panel rising over the top of the shoulder. Sci-fi superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 1 on the curved panel over the shoulder top; colour 2 on the glossy inset in the openings.

Male/M_Spadl_Shiba_Toy_01.description: A small plush toy dog with pointed ears, a curled tail and stubby paws, lying sprawled on top of the left shoulder like a perched pet. Soft stitched fabric look with a cute stuffed-animal style.
Male/M_Spadl_Shiba_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, head and ears; colour 1 on the belly, paws, tail tip, ear insides and eye patches; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the nose.

Male/M_Spadl_Shouldercape_01.description: A single-shoulder cape: a rounded cloth epaulette with contrasting edge trim sits over the left shoulder, held by a thin strap across the chest and back, with a loose cloth panel hanging to about hip level.
Male/M_Spadl_Shouldercape_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cloth epaulette and hanging panel; colour 1 on the edge trim of the epaulette; colour 2 on the strap; colour 3 on the small accent on the strap.

Male/M_Spadl_Shouldercape_02.description: A single left-shoulder cape: a rounded, padded shoulder cap with contrasting trim edging, from which a narrow length of soft draped cloth hangs down the outer arm and back to about hip level.
Male/M_Spadl_Shouldercape_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap top and the hanging cloth; colour 1 on the trim edging around the cap; colour 2 on the underside of the cap.

Male/M_Spadl_Shouldercape_03.description: A single-shoulder cape: a rounded mantle cap over the left shoulder with contrasting edging and a contrasting underside, a long soft cloth panel hanging down the back-left, and a thin strap looping around the neck.
Male/M_Spadl_Shouldercape_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mantle top and the hanging cloth; colour 1 on the edging around the mantle; colour 2 on the mantle underside; colour 3 on the neck strap.

Male/M_Spadl_Shouldercape_04.description: A single-shoulder cape: a rounded, layered shoulder cap with contrasting edge trim sits over the left shoulder, with a long narrow drape of soft cloth hanging down the arm side to about hip level.
Male/M_Spadl_Shouldercape_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the shoulder cap and the hanging cloth drape; colour 2 on the underlayer of the cap; colour 1 on the edge trim around the cap.

Male/M_Spadl_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A small mechanical shoulder piece: an angular, faceted cup with a round socket opening on the outer side, a contrasting curved cap over the top and a small contrasting inset panel. It sits on the left shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower cup and rear plate; colour 1 on the main shell and inner socket lining; colour 2 on the curved top cap and front wedges; colour 3 on the small inset panel.
Male/M_Spadl_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The male version has a longer, narrower sweep from above, with a more slanted contrasting front plate.

Male/M_Spadl_Splendor_01.description: A single left shoulder pauldron of layered, swept-back armoured fins that curve over the shoulder, with a smooth inset panel in the centre and a pair of pointed tips at the rear. Superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Splendor_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer shell and edge plates; colour 0 on the large upper inset panel; colour 1 on the curved inner panel; colour 2 on the narrow strip beside it.

Male/M_Spadl_Spooky_01.description: A single angular shoulder guard shaped like a skull-like mask, with a contrasting eye slot, a recessed glowing inset, and a few blocky stacked plates stepping down the outer upper arm. Sits over the left shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and stacked plates; colour 3 on the recessed inset panel; colour 2 on the eye slot.
Male/M_Spadl_Spooky_01.differs: The male version is wider and more compact, with fewer, blockier plates stepping down the arm, whereas the female version has a longer, narrower tail of plates.

Male/M_Spadl_Starhawk_01.description: A thin, open metal band arching over the left shoulder like a curved bracket, with jagged angular points at the front and back ends. It sits on top of the shoulder without covering it, suggesting a sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadl_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Spadl_Starhawk_02.description: A small curved shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a thin arched band wrapping partway around the upper arm, ending in angular blade-like fins, one sweeping forward and one small one upward. Mechanical, sleek superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular fins at each end; colour 1 on the main curved band; colour 2 on the inset panel at the front; colour 3 on a thin accent line along the band.
Male/M_Spadl_Starhawk_02.differs: The male version's fins sweep lower and flatter, with a thinner band, while the female version's fins stand taller and more upright on a chunkier band.

Male/M_Spadl_Steampunk_01.description: A chunky mechanical left shoulder pad shaped like a cogwheel: a round bolted plate ringed with blocky recessed segments, with curved contrasting brackets and an inner lining that cup the shoulder. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cog plate and blocky segments; colour 1 on the curved brackets and rim; colour 3 on the inner lining panel; colour 2 on the bolts and recessed insets.

Male/M_Spadl_Steelcommando_01.description: A rounded, dome-shaped metal pauldron with a hollow underside that caps the left shoulder. Raised seam lines divide the shell into curved plates, giving a retro mechanical armour look.
Male/M_Spadl_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper rim and top edge of the shell; the glossy metal body of the shell largely ignores the scheme; raised seams take no separate colour.
Male/M_Spadl_Steelcommando_01.differs: The male pauldron is a larger, deeper shell that covers more of the upper arm and shoulder than the female one.

Male/M_Spadl_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A single left shoulder guard: a smooth, curved metal cap with faceted edges that arches over the top of the shoulder and is hollow underneath. It has a retro mechanical, superhero look.
Male/M_Spadl_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper surface of the plate; colour 1 on the lower edge of the plate. The glossy metal shading partly ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Spadl_Tactical_01.description: A small curved shoulder patch that wraps the outside of the left upper arm, with a raised bevelled rim around a recessed panel showing an atom emblem. Suggests a tactical or science-themed superhero uniform.
Male/M_Spadl_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and the atom symbol; colour 1 on the recessed panel behind the atom; colour 2 on the inner edge and back of the shell.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_90s_Bullets_01.description: A padded, quilted shoulder cap that arches over the left shoulder, with layered rectangular bands of trim, a contrasting central plate and a row of bullet-like cartridges held by wire loops, plus a strap tab at the front and back.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_90s_Bullets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted padding and cartridge casings; colour 1 on the trim bands and the strap tab; colour 2 on the central plate; colour 3 on the cartridge bands.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_90s_Knife_01.description: A puffy, quilted shoulder pad arching over the left shoulder, with layered contrasting trim frames, a strap with a buckle, a row of small tube-like cartridges and a flat combat knife lying across the top.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_90s_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted padding and cartridge casings; colour 1 on the trim frames and strap; colour 2 on the inner panel and knife blade; colour 3 on the cartridge bands.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron with a smooth, tapering armored shell of segmented plates, held by a mechanical housing at the outer edge with vents and small indicator lights, plus a broad band and chevron stripe accents. Sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented shell plates; colour 1 on the broad band and lower edge trim; colour 2 on the mechanical housing and inner lining; colour 3 on the chevron stripes and small indicator lights.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Alien_01.description: A small angular shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a layered, hollow shell with a raised flat top plate, a beveled edge band and a curved spike jutting out to the side and back. Sci-fi alien styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower rim of the shell; colour 1 on the main shell body; colour 2 on the raised top plate and inner hollow; colour 3 on the spike.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.description: A curved, shell-like left shoulder pauldron of angular plate with a raised flared rear crest, hexagonal bolt heads across the outer face and contrasting edge trim. It caps the shoulder like an alien gladiator guard.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the edge trim and side panels; colour 3 on the crest and small edge accents; colour 2 on the inner lining; colour 1 on the hex bolts.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A small left shoulder cap shaped like a curved plate that drapes over the shoulder, with a pointed outer edge, swirling cloud-like scroll ornament, and layered striped bands hanging slightly front and back. East-Asian-inspired.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the draped bands; colour 3 on the plate edging and stripe between the bands; colour 2 on the curled scroll and scroll linework.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ancient_01.description: A left shoulder guard with a broad cap plate, a tall pointed engraved fin rising at the top, and a curved plate down the upper arm with a ringed cuff band. Ancient-fantasy armor.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ancient_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and fin; colour 3 on the arm plate, cuff ring and edge trim; colour 1 on the engraved swirl patterns.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ancient_01.differs: The male version has a tall narrow pointed fin and a longer curved plate running down the upper arm, rather than a wide wing shape.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Face_01.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a sculpted face plate with a raised outer rim, a lower flared cuff, small spikes on top and a long curved blade-like talon sweeping down behind the arm. Fantasy-gothic armor look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Face_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sculpted face plate; colour 1 on the rim and the upper outer shell; colour 2 on the lower cuff, talon and top horns; colour 3 on the small spike tips.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.description: A curved, squared-off shoulder plate for the left shoulder: a single rounded shell with a jagged notched lower edge and a second overlapping layer beneath, framed by a contrasting border. Sits on the shoulder cap like a sci-fi pauldron.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate faces; colour 1 on the raised border trim and the inner lining.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.differs: The male version adds a small contrasting spike-like wedge that projects from the underside of the plate against the body.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Round_01.description: A rounded, shield-like left shoulder cap with a raised rim that curls into hooked points at the top and bottom. A star-and-diamond emblem sits on the face, with small spikes at the edge. Superhero style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Round_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and hooked ends; colour 1 on the face panel and the underside; colour 3 on the star-shaped emblem; colour 2 on the small spikes.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.description: A curved, layered shoulder plate with jagged edges sits on the left shoulder. A contrasting cross-shaped block on top holds a large sweeping scythe-like blade that arcs outward and back, giving a fantasy-mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate face; colour 1 on the plate edging and outer shell; colour 3 on the cross-shaped block; colour 2 on the blade.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.differs: The male version adds a small contrasting spike pointing down and back beneath the plate, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Anniversary_Defender_.description: A small left shoulder cap of stacked, ridged armor plates that step down into a wide, flared outer visor-like flap. Sits on top of the shoulder and reads as retro superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Anniversary_Defender_.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ridged upper plates; colour 0 on the ridge edges and inner plate; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 3 on the flared outer flap.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A left shoulder cap shaped like a swept, pointed pauldron: a layered upper shell with a round inset gem, over a glossy lower plate that juts outward in a point, with a cutout and thin edge trim.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper shell; colour 0 on the lower pointed plate; colour 1 on the round gem-like inset; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A rounded, dome-shaped shoulder cap for the left shoulder, covered in a pebbled pattern of irregular plates like an armadillo shell, with a thin banded rim around the edge and a hollow underside.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell surface between the plates; colour 2 on the irregular plate patches; colour 1 on the segmented edge trim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.description: A domed, hollow shoulder cap that curves over the left shoulder like a shell, with a contrasting raised panel along the upper edge and a round mechanical port with a small lens on the front.
