Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the raised upper panel, edge piping and inner lining; colour 2 on the rim edges; colour 3 on the lens in the round port.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armor_Viperlogo_01.description: A single left shoulder pauldron of angular armor plating with a spiked crest on top, a raised rim, and segmented ribbed fins showing between the front and back plates; it sits over the shoulder cap.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armor_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer armor plates and spikes; colour 1 on the ribbed inner segments; colour 2 on the inner shadowed segments and underside; colour 3 on the small paired marks on the plate.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armorninja.description: A curved rectangular shoulder plate with a raised rim, mounted on the left upper arm, with a segmented banded lower section and a sharp curved horn-like blade sweeping out from the outer side. Suggests a ninja or mechanical armor style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, back of the plate and the curved blade; colour 1 on the main plate face and lower edge; colour 3 on the rectangular inset panel; colour 2 on the lower band.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A small angular shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a hollow faceted cap with a low ridge along the top and a tapering pointed extension that reaches down along the front and back of the arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the cap; colour 1 on the tapered lower extension and the inner underside.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Armorviper_01.differs: The male version has a lower, broader and more rounded shell with a flatter ridge than the female one.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A curved, shallow shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a raised rounded-angular plate with a bevelled rim, an atom emblem on its face, and a hollow underside. Suggests a clean superhero science look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the atom emblem; colour 1 on the main plate face and inner lining.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A small left shoulder plate: a curved, angular cap with a pointed lower tip and a thin raised rim around a recessed panel. It sits on top of the shoulder and reads as sleek sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin outer rim and edges; colour 1 on the recessed face panel, fading toward colour 2 at the lower point.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ascendant_02.differs: The male plate has a thinner, flatter rim, so the recessed panel is more exposed and the piece looks lower profile.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.description: A furry animal head shoulder piece with pointed ears, a snarling open mouth with small teeth and a rounded nose, resting on the left shoulder with ragged fur tufts around the neck edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur; colour 1 on the fur tufts and shading around the edges; colour 3 on the nose and inner ears.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A broad left shoulder pauldron made of a domed top plate with three raised round studs and stacked, overlapping banded plates that fan out below and outward. Its layered look suggests a mechanical bird-wing.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed top plate and inner plate surfaces; colour 2 on the outer edging and the stacked banding plates; colour 3 on the round studs.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The male version is a layered pauldron with stacked overlapping plates and three round studs, without the female version's feather-wing panel and tall rim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a smooth domed shell with a wide flared outer rim and a single angular, wing-like raised plate on the face, outlined by a contrasting border. Sits over the shoulder cap.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell face; colour 1 on the wide outer rim and inner lining; colour 2 on the border around the raised plate; colour 3 on the winged plate.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Birdpeople_02.differs: The male version has a smooth shell with a broad contrasting rim and one angular winged plate, instead of the female's layered serrated edge and three round bulbs.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A faceted, angular shoulder cap that arches over the left shoulder like a hollow shell, with a chevron-shaped pair of grooves along its length and a round octagonal lens-like port at both the front and back ends.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted shell; colour 2 on the chevron grooves; colour 1 on the octagonal port rims; colour 3 on the port centres.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_01.differs: The male version has a round port at both the front and back ends of the shell, whereas the female version has one only at the front.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A mechanical shoulder piece: a thick curved arch that bridges over the top of the shoulder, with contrasting angular tips at front and back and two blocky side panels with slashed markings hanging down the outer arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top of the arch; colour 2 on the arch tips and panel edges; colour 1 on the side panels; colour 3 on the slash marks.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A left shoulder guard of layered armor plates with a raised rim along the top, ribbed strips and rows of curved claw-like spikes along the top and outer edge. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the spikes; colour 1 on the upper rim, the edge trim and the ribbed strips; colour 2 on the claw spikes.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The upper rim is a shorter, flatter plate rather than a swooping flare, and the pauldron looks bulkier and covers more of the upper arm.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a hollow, skull-like shell with a contrasting cavity, a raised angular rim and small tusk-like points, ringed by a spiky fringe of fur tufts around the edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and rim; colour 1 on the spiky fur fringe; colour 2 on the inner cavity.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_03.description: A curved shoulder pauldron with a flat angular plate edged in a jagged spiky fringe, a snarling beast-face mask on the outer side, and lacing cords across the plate. Sits over the left shoulder with barbaric styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface and lacing cords; colour 1 on the spiky fringe edging; colour 2 on the plate rim and studs; colour 3 on the beast-face panel.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Child_Space_01.description: A smooth, rounded dome-shaped shoulder pod floating over the left shoulder, slightly faceted with a hollow open underside and a subtle horizontal seam. Suggests a sleek futuristic shoulder guard.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Child_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole dome shell; the material appears to ignore the other colour slots, and no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Child_Steelarachnid_0.description: A single mechanical spider-leg spike mounted on the left shoulder: a flat angular metal segment extends outward, bends, and sweeps up into a tapering curved point above the head, fixed by a small round cap.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Child_Steelarachnid_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular limb segments; colour 2 on the round mounting cap; colour 1 on a small slot detail on the cap.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.description: A single flat, padded strap that arches over the left shoulder from the base of the neck down the upper arm, tapering to a small rivet-like snap at the end. It has a rimmed edge and a hollow underside.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole strap; the recessed underside and snap look and take no distinct slot.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Covertmilitary_01.description: A small domed shoulder pad with faceted, angular edges, a raised octagonal disc on the outer face, and inset channelled panels with small vent-like slots along the lower edge. Sits on the left shoulder cap in a tech-military style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Covertmilitary_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and octagonal disc; colour 1 on the inset edge panels and trim channels; colour 2 on the underside.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Cross_And_Cirlce_01.description: A small mechanical shoulder emblem for the left shoulder: a flat octagonal ring with a central hub and cross spokes, four curved anchor-like prongs radiating outward. It sits flat on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Cross_And_Cirlce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring and central hub; colour 2 on the cross spokes and prongs.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A left shoulder cap made of three stacked, arched band panels with thick contrasting edging, overlapping like segmented plates over the top of the shoulder, fastened at the front by a round button-like stud. Casual western-cyber look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded panel faces; colour 2 on the edging around each band; colour 1 on the round stud at the front.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A left shoulder pad: a curved, dented metal plate with a rolled rim caps the shoulder. An octagonal vent stack rises from a collar on top and a short cylindrical nozzle sticks out at the side. Rugged cyber-western look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate surface; colour 1 on the collar ring at the base of the stack; colour 3 on the vent stack and side nozzle; colour 2 on the plate rim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap that sits over the left shoulder. A rounded upper shell tapers to a banded lower rim and carries small hex bolts. It reads as a light, mechanical cyborg-style pauldron.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shell; colour 0 on the lower band; colour 2 on the inner edge of the rim; colour 3 on the hex bolts.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Defender_02.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder, built from three stacked scalloped plates with a thick band between them and a hollow, lined interior. Sits over the top of the shoulder in a sleek superhero style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Defender_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and lower plates; colour 2 on the middle band; colour 1 on the inner lining and thin edge trim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A single left shoulder fin: a swept, winged panel that rises to a sharp point beside the neck and flares outward over the shoulder, crossed by three raised ribs and edged with a thin rim.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main fin panel; colour 2 on the edge rim and the three ribs; colour 0 on the inner side of the rising point.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Destroyer_01.differs: The male fin sits farther out on the shoulder and sweeps wider over the arm, with a more leaning tip.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A curved, open-backed shoulder guard that wraps the outer left shoulder like a short half-cylinder, with a raised rim, horizontal ridged bands on the outer panel and short pointed studs scattered across it.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and inner edge; colour 1 on the outer banded panel; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Destroyerbot_02.description: A single curved shoulder guard forming a shallow half-cylinder cap over the left upper arm, with a thick rim, a padded panel with faint horizontal segment lines, and a flat squared edge. Suggests gladiator or sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Destroyerbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and inner lining; colour 1 on the padded outer panel.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A small rounded shoulder plate that caps the left shoulder as a hollow, faceted shell, with a separate lower band of segmented panels along the rim. Suggests a sleek sci-fi or superhero armour pad.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed outer shell; colour 2 on the side and inner panels; colour 0 on the lower rim segments; colour 3 on the small accent panel at the front of the rim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_02.description: A segmented shoulder plate for the left shoulder: a rounded cap with stacked, overlapping curved bands that stand slightly proud over recessed inner panels. It gives a bulkier mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top cap and the inner panels; colour 1 on the raised outer bands; colour 3 on the recessed strips between the panels; colour 2 on the shadowed underside.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Dharmor_02.differs: The male plate is larger and bulkier, with the bands standing out from the shoulder like separate raised straps.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Disk_01.description: A small faceted disc-shaped shoulder piece with a shallow dished face and thick rim, mounted on the outer left shoulder and angled outward like a mechanical socket cap.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Disk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole disc, including the rim and dished face; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Double_01_Basic.description: A compact left shoulder pad made of stacked, overlapping curved plates that wrap over the top of the shoulder and taper to a stepped, pointed edge down the upper arm. It has a superhero-armour look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Double_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top rim plate; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 3 on the outer lower shell and edge trim; colour 0 on the inset panels.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Double_02_Basic.description: A small left shoulder pad made of two stacked, angular layered plates with a rim of conical spikes along the top and outer edge, a thin stripe between the layers, and an open hollow underside. Suits a mechanical or punk look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Double_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rims and spikes; colour 2 on the domed top panel; colour 0 on the inner face panel; colour 3 on the thin stripe.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Double_03_Basic.description: A left shoulder guard of stacked, layered curved bands over a rounded cap, with a tall swept fin rising at the back and small blade-like points at the front. It sits over the shoulder in a mechanical superhero style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Double_03_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer bands, fin and blade points; colour 0 on the inner rounded cap visible between the bands.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Draycul_01.description: A left shoulder plate shaped like a sculpted monstrous skull face, with a glowing-eye bulge, a large rounded cheek dome and curved contrasting claw-like fangs at the front. Riveted panel lines and a trim edge wrap over the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull plate; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the eye and the large dome; colour 2 on the fangs, the inner shoulder panel and the panel lines.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Electric_01.description: A domed left shoulder cap ringed by a curved metal rim, with hex-nut bolts and coiled contrasting-wound electrode coils sprouting from the top and sides like a Tesla coil. Sits over the shoulder as a mechanical superhero pad.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed cap; colour 3 on the seam lines and the coiled windings; colour 0 on the curved rim and side bolt; colour 2 on the hex-nut caps and coil ends.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Epaulette_01.description: A stiff, flat shoulder epaulette shaped like a scrubbing brush: a rounded plate with a narrow tab toward the neck, edged in a thin border, with a fringe of dense bristles hanging down over the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Epaulette_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top plate; colour 2 on the thin edge border; colour 1 on the hanging bristles.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Epaulette_02.description: A small military-style epaulette resting on top of the left shoulder: a flat, rounded plate with a short tab extending inward, edged with a thin contrasting rim and hung with a dense fringe of short strands along the outer edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Epaulette_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat top plate; colour 2 on the thin rim and underside band; colour 1 on the hanging fringe strands.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Epaulette_02.differs: The male plate has a shorter tab and a broader, more compact shape sitting across the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A single left shoulder guard in an art deco style: a smooth, beak-like pointed cap that extends outward over the arm, backed by a tall swept-up fin that curls into a scroll at the base, with a contrasting band near the tip.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder cap; colour 1 on the upright fin, its curled base and the band near the tip; colour 2 on the thin seam lines.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_02.description: A left shoulder pad shaped like a deep, curved shell with a thick rolled rim and an inner panel etched with thin grooves. A tall raised fin-like plate rises at the neck side. Retro art-deco sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim and shell; colour 0 on the inner panel and the raised fin plate; colour 2 on the thin groove lines.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Exartdeco_02.differs: The male pad has a deeper, more upright shell, and its raised fin plate is taller and more prominent.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fantasy_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a smooth rounded panel over the top with a separate flared panel sweeping outward and backward, edged with thin piping. Suggests a sleek superhero or sci-fi style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rounded cap; colour 1 on the flared outer panel and inner lining; colour 2 on the thin piping between panels.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A single feathered wing-like shoulder piece: a band wraps the top of the left shoulder and a fan of layered feathers sweeps outward and back, fading toward the tips. Angelic, fantasy look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shoulder band; colour 0 on the feather bases; colour 1 on the feather tips.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Feathers_02.description: A small domed shoulder cap sitting on the left shoulder, with a fringe of pointed feather-like spikes flaring out around its lower edge. Segmented panels give it a mechanical, armored look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Feathers_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main dome of the cap; colour 2 on the band across the top; colour 3 on the rectangular stripe; colour 0 on the feather spikes and rim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fin_01.description: A small membranous fin-like shoulder piece: a webbed, spotted skin panel stretched between several curved spiny ribs that sweep backward and outward from the left shoulder, giving a sharp, creature-like silhouette.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spotted membrane; colour 1 on the curved ribs and spines; colour 3 on the spots or speckles across the membrane; colour 2 on the shaded folds.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fin_01.differs: The male fin is a broader, shorter fan sitting more on top of the shoulder, with wider membrane between the ribs.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fin_02.description: A large fin-like shoulder piece: a webbed membrane ribbed with several curved spines, rising from the top of the left shoulder and sweeping up and back in a crest of pointed tips.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane surface; colour 1 on the curved spines and edge ribs; colour 2 on the shaded underside and inner panels; colour 3 on the spotted markings.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fin_02.differs: The male fin is a shorter, denser crest that rises upward from the shoulder, with spines clustered closer together.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Flower_01.description: A small rose-like flower worn on the left shoulder: a tight cluster of layered curled petals at the centre, ringed by longer pointed leaf-like petals that fan outward over the shoulder. Suggests a fantasy nature theme.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer pointed petals; colour 1 on the petal bands and inner petals; colour 2 on the petal centre and tips; colour 3 on small accents deep in the bloom.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Furrypad_01.description: A large fur shoulder pad for the left shoulder: a curved shell densely covered in layered, pointed fur tufts that sweep down and outward over the upper arm. Suggests a wild, animalistic look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Furrypad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts; colour 2 on the darker tips and roots of the fur; colour 0 on the inner shell rim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fursmall_01.description: A small fur shoulder tuft for the left shoulder: a cap of shaggy layered fur with jagged, pointed strands that drape over the top of the shoulder and hang partway down the upper arm. Suggests a wild or barbarian look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Fursmall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur at the top of the shoulder; colour 1 on the tips of the hanging strands; colour 2 on the shadowed underside.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Furspiked_0.description: A small shaggy fur tuft that caps the left shoulder, made of jagged, pointed locks that hang down over the upper arm and stick out in spikes. Gives a feral, savage look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Furspiked_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur near the shoulder top; colour 1 on the lower tips of the locks, blending in a gradient; colour 2 on the underside.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A single sleek shoulder guard: a smooth, swooping shell that curves over the top of the left shoulder and sweeps up into a pointed tip near the neck, with a thin contrasting edge trim.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Gadroonfancy_01.description: A single left shoulder guard shaped like a swept manta wing, with a raised central dome and tall angular spikes at the front and back. Thin pointed wings extend outward over the shoulder, giving a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Gadroonfancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer wing surfaces and spikes; colour 0 on the central dome; colour 3 on the inner spike underside and edge; colour 2 on small inset panels.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A domed left shoulder pauldron with a contrasting rim, a raised fin-like edge at the back, segmented stacked bands along the lower edge, a round port at the front and several cone spikes and small studs across the surface.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome and inner surface; colour 1 on the outer rim and lower rim bands; colour 2 on the round front port and segment bands; colour 3 on the spikes and raised studs.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Golden_Age_Bolt_01.description: A thin raised lightning-bolt emblem lying against the outer left shoulder, with a jagged stepped edge and a pointed tip running down the upper arm. Classic comic-book superhero styling.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.description: A small five-pointed star emblem that sits flat and slightly curved on the outside of the left upper arm, thin and faceted with a raised look. Suggests a classic retro superhero costume.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the front face of the star; colour 2 on the shaded underside and edges.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a smooth shell marked by chevron-shaped vent bands on top and a rolled lip that ends in a contrasting round port at the rear.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and rolled lip; colour 1 on the vent stripes; colour 2 on the round port.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Herculan_01.differs: The vent stripes are chevron-shaped bands on this version, not the straighter diagonal bands of the female version.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A curved, shield-shaped armored shoulder pad for the left shoulder, with a rim around the edge, ridged wavy channels across the face and a row of small spikes along the top edge. Fantasy dragon styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim, ridges and spikes; colour 1 on the wavy inset channels; colour 2 on the underside lining.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A small mechanical shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a angular pointed plate on the upper arm, held by a flat strap with notched, forked ends that wraps over the shoulder. Sci-fi and sleek.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate and the strap; the other colour slots are not clearly visible on this piece.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A floating field of faceted hexagonal shards hovering off the left shoulder, angular plates clustered into a tapered, upright shape with small spiky fins around it. It suggests a holographic energy shield.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the entire shard field; the piece appears a single flat tone and the other slots are not visible.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.description: A small cluster of jagged, bone-like spikes on the left shoulder, each mounted on a flat angular base plate. The spikes form a short arc over the top of the shoulder and give a monstrous, spiny look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the flat base plates under each spike.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.differs: The spikes are arranged in an arc across the top of the shoulder, rather than stacked vertically down the outer shoulder.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.description: Three short, jagged bone-like spike clusters mounted on angled base plates in a row along the top of the left shoulder, pointing upward and outward. Monstrous, spiky, partial shoulder ornament.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the base plates that anchor the spikes to the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.differs: The male version has three shorter, chunkier spike clusters, while the female version has longer, sweeping blade-like spikes and an extra small one.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A small mechanical shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a curved, angular rim frames a domed plate, with several segmented ribbed hoses arching over the top and clamped by small straps. It sits on the shoulder cap.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the curved rim and the clamp straps; colour 3 on the segmented hoses; colour 0 on the domed plate and hose end fittings; colour 2 on the inset panels and underside fittings.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Insignia_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a raised rim and a domed face bearing an atom-style emblem. It sits on top of the shoulder like a shield, in a superhero style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed face; colour 0 on the atom emblem; colour 3 on the raised rim and inner lining.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Insignia_02.description: A large rounded pauldron capping the left shoulder, a domed shell with a raised contrasting rim and an atom-style emblem of looping orbits on the outer face. Superhero style, sitting high on the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Insignia_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed shell; colour 3 on the raised rim and the inner lining; colour 0 on the atom emblem.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A single angular armored shoulder cap with a raised, flared outer rim and a light inset panel bearing a swirling tribal-like emblem; a small round stud sits at the front corner, with a deep inner lining hanging below the shell. Sits on the left shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the inset panel; colour 2 on the emblem design; colour 3 on the inner lining and the small stud.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ironclad_01.differs: The male lining hangs lower as a visible contrasting skirt under the shell, while the female version's lining is shallower and mostly hidden.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Justiciar_01.description: A small angular shoulder plate for the left shoulder: two flat, folded panels form a shallow ridge over the top of the arm, with a stepped, contrasting trim edge along the lower rim. Suits a sleek sci-fi or superhero look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Justiciar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate panels; colour 1 on the stepped lower edge trim; colour 2 on the small inner panel at the top.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Knight_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron of layered, segmented plates: a ridged upper cap with rivets curves over the shoulder, and stacked overlapping lames fan down over the upper arm. Medieval knightly styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cap plates; colour 3 on the lower lames, fading in with a gradient; colour 2 on the rivets and inner shading.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Knight_02.description: A left shoulder pauldron of layered, overlapping plates with raised ridges and rivets, studded with conical spikes along the top and outer edge. It caps the shoulder and upper arm in a medieval knight style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper plate and the spikes; colour 3 on the lower overlapping plates, fading in from the upper plate; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_01.description: A left shoulder accessory of two tall, swept-up blade fins with ribbed inner faces and glossy outer shells, fanning from a flat angular base plate on top of the shoulder. Sci-fi mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base plate top and the inner ridges; colour 1 on the ribbed inner faces of the blades; colour 2 on the glossy outer shells; colour 3 on the edge of the base plate.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_01.differs: The blades are taller and more pointed, standing further up from the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_01.description: A sci-fi shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a domed armored cap with chevron-like etched lines, edged with contrasting underplating, and topped by three long swept-back curved blades that flare outward and upward, with segmented plates over the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cap surface and the lower segmented arm plates; colour 1 on the swept blades and outer rim; colour 2 on the underplating and inner housing; colour 3 on the etched line details and small vents.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lemuriansorcerer_01.description: A left shoulder pauldron: a hollow, angular scalloped shell of stacked armor plates with chevron-shaped inset grooves, perched on top of the shoulder and open underneath. Sleek, futuristic superhero-tech styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lemuriansorcerer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plates; colour 1 on the top cap and the end panel at the outer edge; colour 3 on the chevron grooves; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Light_01.description: A winged shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a domed, ribbed cap with a contrasting outlined rim, sweeping outward into layered, sharp feather-like blades that trail down and back, in a heroic style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ribbed dome; colour 1 on the outer rim and border panel; colour 0 on the feather tips and highlights; colour 2 on the lower feather blades.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lionshield_01.description: A curved shoulder guard sculpted as a lion's head with swept mane ridges, sitting over the left shoulder like a cowl-shaped cap, edged with a thin contrasting rim. Heroic, fantasy-armor look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lionshield_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head and mane; colour 1 on the rim edging around the shield; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a dished shell with a small pointed fin at the back, a bordered rim of segmented plates, contrasting-tipped rivets and painted claw-like streaks across the surface.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented rim; colour 2 on the main shell and back fin; colour 1 on the claw-like streaks; colour 3 on the rivets.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_01.differs: The male version has a smaller, lower pointed fin at the back of the shell.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_02.description: A small curved shoulder cap that arches over the top of the left shoulder like a half-tube, with a thick rolled contrasting edge, scuffed patchy surface, rows of small drilled holes and a single round screw head.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Lycan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell panel; colour 1 on the rolled outer edge; colour 3 on the screw head; colour 2 on the small holes.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Martial_Power_02.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a flared, wing-like pauldron: a smooth curved plate with a wavy scalloped edge, a contrasting blade-like rim underneath, a ridged vented fin along the top and a faceted gem at the front.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main curved plate; colour 0 on the underside rim; colour 2 on the frame, fin housing and edging; colour 3 on the fin slots and the gem.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Mechanon.description: A mechanical left shoulder piece made of angular, layered armor plates that sit on top of the shoulder, with a swept-back winged fin and a pointed spike rising up beside the neck. Suggests a robotic sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plates and fin tips; colour 1 on the curved outer panels and edge plates; colour 2 on the inner and upper plates and the spike; colour 3 on small accent inserts between the plates.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A left shoulder piece of layered angular armor plates stacked over the shoulder, with a swept fin-like blade flaring out and upward at the rear. Mechanical, segmented sci-fi look sitting on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the pointed fin tips; colour 1 on the curved outer panels and fin face; colour 2 on the inner plate panels; colour 3 on small accents between plates.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Mechassn_01.description: A left shoulder pad in a sci-fi mechanical style: a rounded cup over the shoulder topped by an angular armored casing that tapers into a cylindrical barrel at the back, with fin-like side plates and a slim chevron accent.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top casing and side plates; colour 1 on the shoulder cup and inner rim; colour 2 on the rear barrel and lower panels; colour 3 on the chevron stripes.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Monster_01.description: A left shoulder cap made of overlapping curved plates that stack down over the upper arm, with jagged bone-like spikes and thin blades rising along the top and jutting out at the rear. Monstrous, organic look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main overlapping plates; colour 1 on the seams between plates; colour 0 on the spikes and blades along the top and rear.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Padding.description: A small rounded shoulder pad that caps the left shoulder, a smooth curved shell with a flared lower edge and a diagonal band of contrasting panels across it. Suits tactical or superhero suits.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 on the diagonal band across the pad; colour 0 on the rim and inner edge; colour 3 on the top patch.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Patterned_01.description: A small angular shoulder pad for the left shoulder: a domed upper plate with a contrasting lower panel, stacked layered lips below and a thick outlined edge. Sits over the top of the shoulder in a superhero style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper domed panel; colour 0 on the lower stacked panels; colour 2 on the outline edging.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A left shoulder guard shaped like a spiky shell: a large cone spike rises from the top, with smaller spikes projecting back and a cluster of round dimples down the front. It ends in a toothed edge at the bottom.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spikes; colour 1 on the round dimples; colour 3 on the toothed underside trim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Power_02.description: A compact left shoulder pad: a raised, slightly angular cap plate over the top of the shoulder with a separate rounded lower panel curving down over the upper arm. It suggests a sleek, mechanical superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper cap plate; colour 1 on the lower arm panel; colour 2 on the underside and edge trim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Psiagent_01.description: A thin, flat shoulder mantle of two overlapping angular plates with a narrow slot between them, arching over the top of the left shoulder from chest to upper back. It has a veined, web-like surface texture and a sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Psiagent_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole mantle plates; the web-like veining shows as lighter texture. No other colour slots are clearly visible.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Psiagent_01.differs: The male version is a larger, longer mantle that arcs further around the front and back of the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Psineophyte_01.description: A curved, cap-like left shoulder guard made of stepped angular panels with a notched split line and a veined, circuit-like surface texture. It sits over the top of the shoulder, suggesting a psionic sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Psineophyte_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoulder guard; the default material appears to ignore the other colour slots, and no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Psineophyte_01_1.description: A single psionic shoulder blade: a small rounded, faceted disc sits on top of the left shoulder and sweeps up into a tall thin curved spike with a web-like cracked texture, giving an energy-shard look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Psineophyte_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoulder disc and spike; the veined, cracked texture ignores the other colour slots and shows as a glowing white.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Punk_01.description: A single shoulder pad shaped like a shallow round dish, worn upright on the left shoulder. It has a raised rim, a ribbed turbine-style ring, a domed centre and a small central spike. Mechanical punk look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim; colour 1 on the ribbed ring; colour 2 on the domed centre and the back of the dish; colour 3 on the central spike and its base.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A small left shoulder cap of layered, crumpled cloth-like folds forming a rounded, bulging pad over the top of the shoulder, with contrasting edging and a thin trailing rim underneath. Suggests a light chiton-style shoulder piece.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main folded surface; colour 1 on the edging and rim along the folds.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.differs: The male version is a rounder, boxier cap with thin trailing edges, rather than a pointed wedge with a hanging flap.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.description: A single left shoulder guard of angular, segmented armour plates rising to a pointed fin at the back, with an inset triangular panel and a crumpled layered lining beneath. Sits on top of the shoulder; sci-fi alien styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main armour plates; colour 3 on the inset triangular panel; colour 1 on the crumpled lining, with colour 0 highlights on its folds.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.differs: The male version is wider and lower, with a broader shell and more of the lining visible, plus thin trailing edges under the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.description: A single left shoulder guard: a rounded, segmented armor cap with a tall backswept horn-like spike rising from the top, contrasting inset panels on the sides, and a broad wrapping rim of contrasting trim around the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main armor shell and spike; colour 3 on the inset side panels; colour 1 on the wrapping rim trim; colour 0 as highlights on the rim.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.differs: The male version has a larger, thicker rim that wraps further around the shoulder, and the spike leans further back.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Longshoulder_0.description: An alien, organic left shoulder growth: a tall curved horn-like tentacle with ribbed, banded segments and a ruffled flared base, topped by a sharp tip with a small secondary spike, rising from a rounded dome on the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Longshoulder_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main ribbed body; colour 3 on the ruffled edges and the tip; colour 1 on the fine ridge bands, the small spike and the base dome.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Shoulderbig_01.description: A single left shoulder pauldron of smooth segmented plates that sweeps out and down past the shoulder in a pointed, elongated shell, with an inner lining and thin seam lines. Sci-fi armor with a sleek, mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Shoulderbig_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 2 on the raised top panel; colour 1 on the inner lining under the shell; colour 3 on the thin seam lines and small central stud.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Spikeball_01.description: An alien left shoulder piece: a low, plated shoulder cap carrying a large smooth orb, with a long curved segmented horn sweeping up and outward, and small contrasting-tipped spikes studding the cap's edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Qularr_Spikeball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and horn segments; colour 3 on the horn bands and markings; colour 2 on the orb; colour 1 on the small spikes.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder, with a smooth layered shell, a separate raised panel on top and two thick rounded bars arching over it. Suggests a sleek, mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the rim and inner lining; colour 2 on the raised top panel; colour 3 on the two arching bars.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Redstone_01.description: A single angular shoulder guard made of flat slabs: a tall fin-like plate rising up beside the neck, with two shorter blocky plates angled forward and down over the shoulder, edged in contrasting trim. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the edge trim and end bands; colour 2 on the small inset slot detail.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Retroscifi_Coils_01.description: A left shoulder piece made of a fan of stacked, ribbed overlapping plates under a thick curved ring that arcs up and over the shoulder like a horn. Sits on top of the shoulder, retro sci-fi in style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Retroscifi_Coils_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the stacked ribbed plates; colour 0 on the outer arching ring; colour 3 on the thin trim line along the ring; colour 2 on the ring's back edge.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: Three long flowing ribbons anchored at a small flower-like rosette on the left shoulder, arching up and back over the shoulder then sweeping out and down behind the body in tapered, pointed ends. Elegant, decorative superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper ribbon lengths; colour 1 on the ribbon tips and the rosette petals; colour 2 and colour 3 on the small centre details of the rosette.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ribbon_01.differs: The ribbons fan out wider and farther from the body, trailing lower and to the side rather than hanging close to the back.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Rings_01.description: A fan of three thin, open C-shaped flat rings splayed apart at different angles from a hinge point on the shoulder, like mechanical blades or fins rising and flaring out from the arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Rings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the rings; the small hinge ends show a darker shade from the default material.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Rings_01.differs: The male version's rings are spread wider and tilted apart at distinct angles, rather than stacked tightly in a narrow fan.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A mechanical left shoulder cap: a segmented, domed armour plate ringed with short hex-capped connectors and looping thick cables, giving a cybernetic implant look that sits over the top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate panels; colour 2 on the cable loops and inner plate; colour 1 on the connector nozzles and hex caps; colour 3 on the small lights in the connector tips.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.description: Two segmented flexible hoses arc in wide loops over the left shoulder, each ending in a chunky cylindrical connector cap. A small mechanical cybernetic accent that sits on top of the shoulder and reaches toward the back.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the segmented hoses; colour 1 on the cylindrical connector caps.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.differs: The male hoses form wider, more separated loops with the connector caps spread apart, whereas the female loops are tighter and more bunched.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Robot_Shoulder_01.description: A boxy angular mechanical shoulder pad sitting on the left shoulder, with a large swept-back fin blade rising behind it, thin spiky fins trailing rearward and downward, a round bolted socket at the front, and a contrasting strap over the top.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Robot_Shoulder_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pad body and swept fin blade; colour 1 on the thin trailing fins; colour 2 on the strap and socket housing; colour 3 on the studs and the socket centre.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.description: A samurai-style shoulder guard of stacked angular plates that curve over the shoulder, topped by a tall curved horn-like blade at the neck side and layered lamellar plates hanging over the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and lower lamellae; colour 1 on the curved edge plates and horn tips; colour 2 on the horn base and inset square panels; colour 3 on the small accent panels at the plate ends.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A domed, shell-like left shoulder guard with a swirling gear-toothed spiral pattern, a raised rim edging, a round gem at the front and tall curved blade spikes fanning upward and outward.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed shell; colour 0 on the spiral pattern and the spike blades; colour 1 on the rim edging and spike edges; colour 3 on the front gem.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The male spikes fan more upward and stand taller above the shoulder, forming a crest.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_02.description: A sleek mechanical left shoulder piece shaped like a small winged craft, with ridged vents, contrasting curved horn spikes on top and a small round light at the front, plus a long narrow cloth tail trailing down the side of the body.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder shell and the long trailing tail; colour 1 on the underside panel; colour 2 on the horn spikes; colour 3 on the small round lights.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.description: A domed left shoulder cap with a raised rim, a swirling gear-like pattern on its surface, and a tall fan of long curved blade-like spikes rising from the front. A gem sits at the front edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim and the underside of the cap; colour 2 and colour 0 on the swirl and gear pattern of the dome; colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the gem.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.differs: The male spikes rise upward in a taller fan above the shoulder, rather than sweeping forward and outward as on the female.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.description: A sleek, angular alien-tech shoulder piece for the left shoulder: a plated shell with ribbed vents, a round end cap and two curved contrasting spikes, with a long narrow cloth strip hanging down the side of the body to the knee.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plated shell and the hanging strip; colour 1 on the underside plate and the ribbed vent inserts; colour 2 on the curved spikes; colour 3 on the round end cap.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.differs: The male version adds a long narrow cloth strip hanging from the shoulder down to about knee level.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A left shoulder piece shaped like a stylised bird or fish head, with swirling striped markings, a large eye, a beak-like point and feathered fins below, backed by a curved shield-like arc and a diamond stud.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved backing arc and the beak and jaw spikes; colour 1 on the head markings, stripes and feather fins; colour 2 on the diamond stud; colour 3 on the eye and stud gem.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A curved, segmented shoulder plate that arches over the top of the left shoulder like a short shell, with several raised ribs across its length and a contrasting edge trim. Samurai-inspired armour.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 3 on the thin ribbed lines between the segments; colour 1 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.description: A left shoulder guard of layered, segmented plates with a spiky, winged upper crest and a round cut-out notch, edged with raised rims and covered in swirling engraved patterns. Overlapping plates step down the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised outer rims and edges; colour 1 on the thin inner border lines; colour 2 on the plate faces; colour 3 on the swirl patterns.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Scales_01.description: A left shoulder guard made of overlapping pointed scale plates with raised ribs and bordered edges, studded with small pegs. It covers the top of the shoulder over a contrasting lining, with plates fanning out behind like feathers.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Scales_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scale plate faces; colour 1 on the raised borders and rims; colour 3 on the small peg studs; colour 2 on the inner lining.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Scales_01.differs: The male version is larger, covering more of the shoulder, with a longer fan of plates trailing behind and more of the contrasting lining visible.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A thin, flat, curved sci-fi shoulder plate for the left shoulder, with a stepped notched edge, a wide contrasting band across its middle and a small accent tab at the top. It sits close on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stepped outer edge of the plate; colour 1 on the main curved plate surface; colour 2 on the band across the middle; colour 3 on the small tab at the top.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A shoulder piece of four or five curved, fin-like blades fanning out from the left shoulder, each with a chevron pattern and a bordered edge. Sweeps back and outward like a sea creature's fins.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main blade surfaces; colour 1 on the blade edging and outlines; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the chevron backing and underside.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.description: A one-shouldered mechanical wing-cape: a finned shoulder plate anchors a curved, thorny spar that arcs up and back, with many long thin slatted blades fanning down to the calves like a ribbed vane.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long slatted blades; colour 1 on the finned shoulder plate; colour 2 on the curved spar; colour 3 on the blade edges.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.differs: The male version has many separate thin slatted blades with contrasting edges instead of one solid draped cloth sheet.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A small left shoulder piece made of stacked, angular fin-like plates that overlap and sweep back across the top of the shoulder, with a curved inner panel. It suggests sleek superhero or sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer plates and main shell; colour 0 on the middle layered plate edges; colour 2 on the lower layered plates and the fin tips; colour 3 on the inner recessed panel.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Skull_01.description: A left shoulder piece shaped like a skull-plate cap with a tall ridged horn rising from the top, glowing eye sockets, and a jagged lower rim of curved spikes around a rounded inner dome. Gothic, occult style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull plate and horn; colour 2 on the ridge lines and stripes; colour 1 on the spiked lower rim; colour 3 on the inner dome and eye spots.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Skull_02.description: A faceted, low-poly skull worn as a left shoulder pad, with hollow eye sockets facing forward and a jagged, angular flared rim of contrasting trim around the base. Suits gothic, monstrous or punk looks.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell; colour 1 on the jagged rim and edge trim; colour 3 on the small markings on the crown and around the eyes; colour 2 in the eye sockets.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Snake_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder, with a scaly snake-like textured surface, embossed bulbous scale ridges and a rimmed edge, plus two sharp blade-like fangs pointing downward from the lower edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled inner panel beneath the raised centre; colour 1 on the rim and the fang spikes; colour 2 on the raised scaled centre; colour 3 on the eye-like markings.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder, with a rounded cap, a raised band looping around one side and a pointed fin-like blade extending outward. Sleek superhero styling with a hollow underside.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate and blade; colour 1 on the looping outer band; colour 3 on the stripes running across the plate.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Space_01.description: A futuristic left shoulder piece: a glossy domed glass-like bubble in an angular angled housing, with a thin band and small round knob across it and a curved fin-like panel behind, sitting on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome; colour 2 on the angular housing and band; colour 1 on the curved panel behind the shoulder; colour 3 on the small knob.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.description: A rounded, segmented left shoulder cap with stitched panel seams and inset streaks, topped by a curved crossbar holding four long pointed spikes that stand upward in a neat row above the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap; colour 0 on the inset streaks and seam highlights; colour 3 on the curved crossbar; colour 2 on the spikes.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.differs: The spikes point mostly upward from a crossbar lying along the top of the shoulder, rather than fanning diagonally backward.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.description: A left shoulder piece: a small rounded cap with slashed markings, topped by a tall curved blade fin that sweeps upward, with a row of four contrasting arrow-shaped spikes between them. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap; colour 0 on the slash markings of the cap; colour 3 on the curved blade fin; colour 2 on the arrow spikes.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A small cluster of three sharp conical spikes on the left shoulder, pointing outward and slightly forward and back at different angles. Small, partial accent that gives a punk or armoured edge.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_01.description: A cluster of three curved, tapering horn-like spikes rising from the left shoulder, one large central spike with a banded base and two smaller spikes curving outward beside it. Sits on top of the shoulder as a fantasy or sci-fi accent.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower part of the main spike; colour 1 on the spike tips and the smaller spikes; colour 3 on the band at the base.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.description: A small left shoulder ornament: one stout ribbed cone-shaped spike with segmented plating, pointing outward, surrounded by a few tiny loose spikes scattered around the shoulder. Suggests a mechanical or armored superhero look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main spike body and small spikes; colour 1 on the spike tips.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.description: A cluster of four curved, tapering horn-like spikes of differing sizes, with plated, segmented surfaces and rimmed bases, sprouting upward and outward from the left shoulder. Suggests a monstrous or armoured look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of each spike; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 3 on the rimmed bases.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.differs: The male version has a more compact cluster with broader, plated segments and the smaller spikes sitting closer to the main spike.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A left shoulder piece of bony, ribbed segments that fan out over the shoulder cap, each tapering to a pointed claw-like tip. It sits on top of the shoulder and suggests an organic, monstrous armor.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised ribs and pointed tips; colour 1 on the recessed bands between the ribs.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.description: A mechanical shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a broad, angular plated pauldron that flares outward with a pointed lower edge and a tall curved horn rising near the neck, with slotted vents and small round studs.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pauldron plate and horn; colour 1 on the slanted vent slots; colour 2 on the rim edging and underside; colour 3 on the small round lights.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_0.description: A rounded metal shoulder cap for the left shoulder with a contrasting edge and thin inset stripe, a round gem-like emblem at the front, and a fan of long swept-back contrasting feathers at the outer side like a wing.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the rim edge and inset stripe; colour 3 on the round central gem; colour 2 on the feathers.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A curved, partial left shoulder cap made of layered bands that arc over the top of the shoulder. An outer band sweeps into a pointed hook at the front, with a flared lip at the back. Sleek, symbiote-like superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flared outer band along the arm side; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 2 on the raised inner band that ends in the hooked point.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Techsphere_01.description: A large rounded spherical shoulder pod floating over the left shoulder, with a recessed circular socket on each side, small raised round nodes and thin jagged panel-line trim across the shell. A mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Techsphere_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main sphere shell; colour 1 on the circular sockets; colour 2 on the jagged outline trim; colour 3 on the small round nodes.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Teeth_01.description: A cluster of long, curved tapering spines fanning out from a thin curved band on the left shoulder. The spines point mostly upward, giving a tribal, spiky shoulder crest.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Teeth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin shoulder band; colour 2 on the spine bases and most of each spine; colour 1 on the spine tips.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Teeth_01.differs: The spines stand more upright, pointing up from the shoulder, and the band wraps further down the front and back of the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Tigon_01.description: A small fitted shoulder cap for the left shoulder, a curved shell built from several banded panels that wraps over the top of the shoulder and stops short of the upper arm. Sleek, mechanical superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Tigon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top edge panel; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 3 on the outer side panel; colour 0 on the lower panel.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Tire_01.description: A chunky segmented shoulder cap shaped like a curved tire tread arch, with blocky ridged tread pieces over the left shoulder and a small perforated pointed plate hanging off the outer edge.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Tire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tread blocks; colour 3 as splatter markings across the tread; colour 1 on the hanging perforated plate.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Tire_02.description: A chunky left shoulder pad shaped like a curved segment of tyre tread: a hollow arch of blocky ridged tread that caps the shoulder. Rugged, mechanical, post-apocalyptic look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Tire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tread blocks and surface; colour 3 on the splattered markings across the top and sides; colour 1 on the shaded side and underside faces.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Toy_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder: a shield-like padded panel folding over the shoulder to a pointed lower edge, with a raised rim and a round dome button in a contrasting socket. Retro toy-robot styling.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main padded panel; colour 0 on the raised rim edging; colour 2 on the socket ring and underside; colour 3 on the dome button.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Toy_01.differs: The male pad is a more angular, V-shaped panel that drapes over the shoulder with a pointed front and back, rather than a rounded dome.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Victory_01.description: A curved, fin-like shoulder guard for the left shoulder: a swept, pointed shell with a raised rim, an inner panel, layered contrasting trim stripes and a round pivot joint at the front. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the large inner panel; colour 3 on the upper trim stripe; colour 1 on the lower trim stripe.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A mechanical single shoulder piece: a flat angular frame with forked, hooked prongs rising and dropping around the shoulder, holding a swept fin-like plate at the front. Sits on the left shoulder in a sci-fi style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the frame and prongs; colour 0 on the swept plate; colour 3 on the thin lines along the plate; colour 2 on the small slots and panel marks.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Vine_01.description: A left shoulder piece of curling, tentacle-like vine tendrils that fan out from a swirl-etched base, ending in sharp curved tips. It sits on top of the shoulder and sweeps outward and down, with an organic, fantastical look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine body; colour 0 on the swirl patterns and raised centre highlights; colour 3 on the pointed tips and the streaks along the tendrils.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Viper_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the left shoulder: a segmented shell of layered bands with thin contrasting piping, sweeping over the top of the arm like a compact pauldron cap.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light bands of the plate; colour 1 on the raised upper panel; colour 3 on the thin piping between bands; colour 2 on the rounded outer end and underside.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Viper_01.differs: The male plate is wider and sits flatter across the top of the shoulder, with bands sweeping diagonally rather than running straight down.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A chunky mechanical shoulder pad: a rounded, vented shell with a gaping intake mouth and layered angular outer bands, two round knobs on the front and thin stripes along the top. Sits on the left shoulder in a sci-fi style.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and lower jaw plate; colour 1 on the outer angular bands and edge trim; colour 2 on the knobs, intake interior and top stripes; colour 3 on the thin stripes on the front and top.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Wildfur_01.description: A left shoulder piece of layered, feathery fur tufts that form a wedge shape over the shoulder and upper arm. Each tuft ends in a swept, pointed tip, and the piece has a rough, wild look.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Wildfur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur tufts; colour 1 on the accent streaks within the layers; colour 2 on the darkened pointed tips.

Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Wolf_01.description: A left shoulder cap made of two stacked, overlapping curved plates with raised rims and etched swirl patterns. It sits over the top of the shoulder, with a hollow underside and a slight flare at the edges.
Male/M_Spadl_Tight_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper plate; colour 3 on the rims and edge trim; colour 0 on the lower plate; colour 2 on the etched swirl details.

Male/M_Spadl_Toxicsteel_01.description: A small rounded, domed shoulder cap for the left shoulder, made of padded plates with a pentagonal inset panel on top, thin contrasting piping lines and two small rectangular studs on the sides. It suggests a mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Spadl_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 0 on the pentagon panel, piping and small side studs; colour 2 on the outline and seam lines around the panel.

Male/M_Spadl_Traveler_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the left shoulder, made of soft padded cloth with a layered flap over a lower panel, contrasting piped edging and a small snap button at each end. Suggests a casual traveller's jacket.
Male/M_Spadl_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper flap; colour 1 on the lower panel; colour 2 on the piped edging; colour 3 on the snap buttons.

Male/M_Spadl_Warrior_01.description: A partial left shoulder guard made of two overlapping angular plates with ribbed, segmented faces and rounded inset panels, edged in raised trim. Two thin straps with small rings wrap the upper arm to hold it.
Male/M_Spadl_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed plate faces; colour 1 on the rounded inset panels; colour 3 on the raised edge trim, rings and the back of the plates; colour 2 on the straps.

Male/M_Spadl_Wires_01.description: A left shoulder guard with a large curved padded slab on top of the shoulder, over a jagged plate that wraps the upper arm, with a contrasting lower edge and two small round studs.
Male/M_Spadl_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top padded slab; colour 0 on the jagged plates; colour 2 on the lower edge; colour 3 on the round studs.
Male/M_Spadl_Wires_01.differs: The male version has a larger, bulkier top slab that covers more of the shoulder, with less open plating below it.

Male/M_Spadr_Anniversary16_2025_01.description: A right shoulder pad with a tall swept-back fin rising above the shoulder, fixed to a rounded mechanical cap with an open front scoop and small side detail. Sleek sci-fi armour look.
Male/M_Spadr_Anniversary16_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer fin surface and cap edges; colour 1 on the fin stripe and cap sections; colour 2 on the inner fin and scoop interior; colour 3 on the inner accent panels.
Male/M_Spadr_Anniversary16_2025_01.differs: The male fin is lighter with a curved contrasting stripe and leans outward, with an open scoop at the front of the cap.

Male/M_Spadr_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.description: A right shoulder guard sculpted as a snarling beast head with wrinkled muzzle, small fangs and glowing eyes, hollow behind and edged with a raised contrasting rim; sits over the shoulder cap.
Male/M_Spadr_Anniversary_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sculpted head, which shows as glossy metal; colour 1 on the rim and inner shell; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Anniversary_Destroyer_02.description: A right shoulder guard sculpted as a snarling beast face with a wrinkled brow, deep-set eyes and small spikes at the muzzle. A hollow, flared rim edges the back, and it caps the shoulder like a pauldron.
Male/M_Spadr_Anniversary_Destroyer_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised rim and the inner shell; colour 2 on the sculpted face; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 0 on the small spikes.

Male/M_Spadr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single right shoulder pauldron: a smooth, rounded, hollow metal dome that caps the shoulder, with a thin contrasting rim along its open edge and a slightly angular, faceted outline. Retro robot styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the pauldron; colour 1 on the thin rim around the edge and the inner lining. The glossy metal shading mutes the scheme.

Male/M_Spadr_Aquatic_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron shaped like a curved shield, made of three segmented armor panels inside a raised rim, with three swept-back curved spikes along the top ridge. Sits on top of the shoulder; suits a sci-fi or aquatic-themed look.
Male/M_Spadr_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer panel and the spikes; colour 1 on the middle panel; colour 3 on the inner panel; colour 2 on the rim.

Male/M_Spadr_Aquatic_02.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved, shell-like cap with a thick rim, layered fin-like plates on top and small square gem inserts at the front and back edges. It sits over the shoulder in a sleek sci-fi style.
Male/M_Spadr_Aquatic_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the layered upper plates; colour 1 on the curved centre fin panel; colour 2 on the outer rim and underside; colour 3 on the square inserts.

Male/M_Spadr_Balloon_Toy_01.description: A small twisted balloon-animal dog perched on the right shoulder, built from glossy sausage-shaped segments: a head with two upright ears, a rounded body, a tiny tail and four stubby legs spread across the shoulder top.
Male/M_Spadr_Balloon_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head, neck and body segments; colour 1 on the legs; colour 2 on one ear; colour 3 on the tail and the other ear. The glossy balloon finish gives a shiny look.
Male/M_Spadr_Balloon_Toy_01.differs: The male balloon dog lies more horizontally along the shoulder, with its legs spread outward and the body running along the shoulder line.

Male/M_Spadr_Bounty_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved, hollow cap with a thick rounded rim that wraps over the top of the shoulder, with inset angled panels on the outer face and a tall central panel on top.
Male/M_Spadr_Bounty_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell and rim; colour 1 on the upper inset panels; colour 0 on the lower inset panels; colour 3 on the central top panel.
Male/M_Spadr_Bounty_01.differs: The male pad is larger and deeper, with the open hollow end more visible at the front, and the contrasting panel is a long strip along the back of the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadr_Buzzsaw_01.description: Three toothed circular saw blades floating in a stacked cluster around the right shoulder, each with a raised central hub, a ring of small studs and notched edges. A mechanical, sci-fi shoulder ornament.
Male/M_Spadr_Buzzsaw_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade faces and hub rings; colour 1 on the blade rims and edge trim; colour 2 on the blade faces and central rings; colour 3 on the small dots around each blade.

Male/M_Spadr_Buzzsaw_02.description: A right shoulder ornament of three toothed circular saw blades floating in a loose cluster over the shoulder and upper arm, each with a central disc and a star-shaped hub. Industrial, mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Spadr_Buzzsaw_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the toothed blade rims; colour 1 on the blade discs; colour 3 on the star-shaped hubs; colour 2 on the shaded underside of the lowest blade.
Male/M_Spadr_Buzzsaw_02.differs: The blades are spread wider across the shoulder, with one blade tilted almost edge-on and sitting flatter above the arm.

Male/M_Spadr_Buzzsaw_03.description: A cluster of three toothed circular saw blades floating around the right shoulder, each with a hollow centre, an inner ring of contrasting panel and small studs. They are set at different angles for a mechanical, industrial look.
Male/M_Spadr_Buzzsaw_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade teeth and outer discs; colour 1 on the inner ring panels; colour 3 on the small studs around the rings; colour 2 on the darker shaded blade faces and centres.

Male/M_Spadr_Cannonarm_01.description: A large shoulder-mounted laser cannon slung diagonally over the right shoulder: a sleek, angular casing with a tapered rear housing, a multi-barrel muzzle pointing up and trim rails along the sides. Sci-fi heavy weapon style.
Male/M_Spadr_Cannonarm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing; colour 1 on the side rails and barrel housings; colour 2 on the rear vents and inner mechanism; colour 3 on small accents at the muzzle tips.
Male/M_Spadr_Cannonarm_01.differs: The male cannon is larger and angles diagonally up and back across the shoulder, extending well above the head.

Male/M_Spadr_Cat_01.description: A small sculpted cat sitting upright on the right shoulder, facing forward with pointed ears and a long tail curling down behind. A whimsical pet-style shoulder accessory.
Male/M_Spadr_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the cat's body and tail; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Chicken_01.description: A novelty rubber chicken draped over the right shoulder like a limp scarf, with its plump body on the back, legs dangling down the shoulder blade and a head with a beak, comb and eye hanging over the front.
Male/M_Spadr_Chicken_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the chicken body; colour 3 on the feet, legs, beak and wattle; colour 2 on the comb; colour 1 on the eye.
Male/M_Spadr_Chicken_01.differs: The male chicken is slightly larger and its head hangs higher on the front of the shoulder, closer to the collarbone.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Aquatic_01.description: A row of three curved, fin-like spikes in graduated sizes, swept backward and set in a line along the top of the right shoulder. Suggests aquatic or shark-fin styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Aquatic_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three fins; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Aquatic_01.differs: The male fins sit closer together and further forward, running in a tighter row along the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Draco_01.description: A spiky right shoulder guard of layered angular blades, with a long curved horn sweeping up and back from the shoulder and jagged serrated fins along the top. Suggests a dragon-like armoured fantasy look.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main serrated blade plates and fins; colour 2 on the long curved horn and underside blades.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Future_01.description: A mechanical shoulder accessory: a thick octagonal ring with a recessed inner core, flanked by a long tapered spike behind and a swept fin with a cut-out hole in front. It floats at the right shoulder, standing edge-on.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer ring; colour 1 on the spike and the swept fin; colour 3 on the inner core of the ring.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Future_02.description: A small curved blade-like shoulder accessory: a narrow hooked arc of smooth metal that arches over the top of the right shoulder and ends in two pointed barbs at the front and back. Futuristic and sleek.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Future_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole arc; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Punk_01.description: A small cluster of tapered conical spikes of varied length, fanned out from the top of the right shoulder near the neck. Sharp, aggressive accent in a punk sci-fi style.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on all of the spikes; the spikes are the only visible part of the piece.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Punk_01.differs: The male spikes are grouped as a tight pair of long leaning spikes plus two upright ones, so the cluster is spread more widely than the female version.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A scattering of separate cone-shaped spikes floating around the right shoulder and upper arm: a larger cluster of long spikes pointing outward and back over the shoulder, and a few smaller spikes lower down the arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the large shoulder spikes; colour 2 on the smaller spikes lower on the upper arm.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.description: A narrow strap band wrapped around the upper right arm, with overlapping strap ends fastened through hexagonal buckle loops and a raised rim along the edge. A simple, sleek sci-fi armband accessory.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Renegade_Spikes_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strap band and its rim; colour 1 on the hexagonal buckle loops.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Tactical_01.description: A small flat atom-style emblem on the outer right shoulder: three interlocking elliptical orbit rings around a central ring, with a thin raised outline. It lies flush against the sleeve as a decorative badge.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the emblem rings and their outline; the rest of the emblem shows little separate colour.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A flat atom-style emblem of three interlocking elliptical orbits around a central ring, lying flush on the right shoulder like a decal, with a few small detached curved fragments scattered beside it.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main orbit bands; colour 1 on the thin outline edging of the bands and the small fragments.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Tight_Ascendant_01.differs: The male version adds a few small detached curved fragments on the shoulder beside the atom symbol.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A bone-like shoulder spine for the right shoulder: a segmented central ridge with long curved blade-like spikes sweeping outward, shorter contrasting hooked claws on top, and small tooth-like spikes trailing down the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented ridge and the small tooth spikes; colour 1 on the long curved spikes; colour 2 on the short hooked claws on top.

Male/M_Spadr_Child_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A ring-shaped shoulder fringe of many jagged, spiky fur-like tufts that encircles the right shoulder, leaving the centre open. It has a rough, feral look and suits brutal or monstrous designs.
Male/M_Spadr_Child_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on all the spiky tufts; no other slots are visible.
