Male/M_Spadr_Clockwork_Armor_01.description: A chunky angular mechanical pauldron for the right shoulder: a domed, faceted shell with a raised curved fin at the front, a hollow inner cavity, and a layered lower rim band. Suggests sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Spadr_Clockwork_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell and raised fin; colour 3 on the angular inset panels and lower rim accents; colour 2 on the front block and rear inner cap; colour 0 on the lower rim band and inner cavity.

Male/M_Spadr_Corrupted_01.description: A right shoulder piece shaped like a bat wing: a domed cap with ribbed, scalloped edges, a long pointed membrane sweeping down over the upper arm, and curved horn spikes rising from the top.
Male/M_Spadr_Corrupted_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed cap plates; colour 1 on the underlying wing membrane and edge; colour 3 on the curved horn spikes.

Male/M_Spadr_Cosmic_01.description: A single right shoulder pad shaped like a curved, tapering shield that caps the shoulder. Angular raised panels and a square cut-out pattern sit on top, with segmented edge trim and a hollow underside. Sci-fi, superhero style.
Male/M_Spadr_Cosmic_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised top panels and outer edge; colour 2 on the recessed segments and inner panels; colour 0 on the underside lining.

Male/M_Spadr_Cosmos_01.description: A single angular metal shoulder guard with a swept, pointed back and layered ridged plates over the top of the shoulder. It has a hollow inner lining and sits on the right shoulder, with a sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Cosmos_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plates and raised edge trim; colour 1 on the inner lining and lower tab; colour 2 on the recessed grooves between plates.

Male/M_Spadr_Cosmos_02.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a curved horn: a shallow shell over the shoulder that sweeps up into a sharp crescent point beside the neck, with a thick rim and a contrasting strip along the inner side.
Male/M_Spadr_Cosmos_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell surface; colour 1 on the strip along the inner edge; colour 2 on the outer rim and underside.
Male/M_Spadr_Cosmos_02.differs: The male version has a matte, darker-rimmed finish, where the female version's rim and shell look glossy metallic.

Male/M_Spadr_Crimson_01.description: A right shoulder guard styled as a horned dragon head, with jagged flame-like spikes and a snarling snout at the front, set on a broad curved plate with a patterned lower panel and a rimmed edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Crimson_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the dragon head, spikes and outer rim; colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the patterned lower panel; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Cryo_01.description: A curved shoulder cap for the right shoulder, with a layered plate and a contrasting angular panel on top. A thick arched band with short tubular nozzles at both ends spans over it, showing a glowing-looking inner cavity underneath.
Male/M_Spadr_Cryo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder plate; colour 1 on the angular top panel; colour 2 on the arched band; colour 3 on the nozzles and the inner cavity under the band.
Male/M_Spadr_Cryo_01.differs: The arched band is larger and wider, arching well clear of the plate to reveal an inner cavity beneath it.

Male/M_Spadr_Cyberwire_01.description: A right shoulder pad shaped like a smooth, domed shell that sits on top of the shoulder, with a raised oval panel, small vent slits along the lower edge and a curved rim band arching up the inner side.
Male/M_Spadr_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper dome panel; colour 1 on the lower shell and edge; colour 2 on the curved rim band; colour 3 on the oval marking and the small vent slits.

Male/M_Spadr_Defender_Update_01.description: A rounded, shell-like mechanical shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a hollow cup open on the inner side, with stacked angular plates and segments on the outer face, plus a small round port. Suggests a sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Spadr_Defender_Update_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer shell; colour 1 on the upper and lower angled plates; colour 2 on the inset panels between plates; colour 3 on the thin accent stripe.

Male/M_Spadr_Dog_01.description: A small figurine-like puppy lying on the shoulder, with upright pointed ears, a long tail hanging down the back, paws draped over the front, and a bow tie at its neck. Cute, playful companion piece.
Male/M_Spadr_Dog_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the dog's body; colour 0 on the inner ears, muzzle patch and paws; colour 2 on the bow tie; colour 3 on the eyes and bow tie centre.

Male/M_Spadr_Draco_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved plate capping the shoulder with a contrasting edge, topped by a sweeping crest of sharp, swept-back spikes and a long curved horn-like blade that rises above and behind the shoulder. Dragon-themed armour.
Male/M_Spadr_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate surface; colour 1 on the plate edge trim; colour 3 on the inner crest spikes; colour 2 on the long curved blade and outer spikes.

Male/M_Spadr_Dragon_01.description: A small winged dragon figurine perched on the right shoulder, with a long tail hanging down the upper arm, spread bat-like wings, horns and spines along the back. Fantasy pet-companion style.
Male/M_Spadr_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dragon's body, wings and tail; colour 1 on the horns and wing tips; colour 2 on the wing membranes and chest underbelly panels; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Dryad_01.description: A right shoulder piece of twisting, root-like branches woven over a shallow curved shell. Tangled tendrils sweep outward and one horn-like twig rises above the shoulder. Organic fantasy look.
Male/M_Spadr_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the branches and tendrils; colour 0 on the inner shell and its rim; colour 1 on the spots showing through the shell.

Male/M_Spadr_Dryad_02.description: A single right shoulder piece: a smooth curved cap sweeping over the shoulder, with a lattice of organic, vine-like openwork on the outer side and a thick framing rim with a small upward prong. Suggests a nature-guardian look.
Male/M_Spadr_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth shoulder cap; colour 1 on the openwork lattice; colour 2 on the framing rim and prong.

Male/M_Spadr_Element_Fire_01.description: A right shoulder accessory shaped like swept, rippling flames: glossy, curling tongues stretch from the front of the shoulder over the top to the back, ending in sharp pointed tips. It sits on top of the shoulder rather than wrapping the arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Element_Fire_01.colourAreas: The glossy default material largely ignores the colour scheme; a little colour 1 shows in the recesses of the flame folds and a hint of colour 3 near the front tip.

Male/M_Spadr_Element_Fire_02.description: A right shoulder piece of glossy, swirling flame-like shapes: jagged ragged tongues spread over the top of the shoulder, with one long curled tip sweeping back and a shorter tongue pointing forward.
Male/M_Spadr_Element_Fire_02.colourAreas: Glossy reflective default material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly in some swirls and colour 3 faintly on the underside of the front tongue; the rest is glossy.
Male/M_Spadr_Element_Fire_02.differs: The male piece sits more compactly on top of the shoulder, with its long curled tip sweeping backward rather than up toward the neck.

Male/M_Spadr_Falcon_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a falcon head with swept feather crests, a hooked beak and a glaring eye, set on a curved plate rim studded with small diamond-shaped spikes. Sits on top of the shoulder in a fantasy-superhero style.
Male/M_Spadr_Falcon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathered head and the main plate; colour 1 on the beak and the raised rim edging and studs; colour 2 on the feather slots; colour 3 on the eye.

Male/M_Spadr_Firebird_01.description: A single angular shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a flared, faceted outer shell with pointed edges surrounds a raised inner cap with a tall swept crest, and jagged spikes rise at the front edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Firebird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer angular shell and front spikes; colour 1 on the raised inner cap; colour 2 on the inner lining beneath the cap.
Male/M_Spadr_Firebird_01.differs: The male version has taller, more jagged front spikes joined to the shell, and a larger shell with a taller crest.

Male/M_Spadr_Frigid_01.description: A single right shoulder pauldron of layered curved plates with slim contrasting edging, topped by a cluster of long swept-back blade-like spikes rising from the outer shoulder. Sleek, angular sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Frigid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate surfaces; colour 2 on the inner plate and the edge trim; colour 1 on the blade-like spikes.
Male/M_Spadr_Frigid_01.differs: The male version has a larger inner plate that wraps higher over the top of the shoulder, with slightly longer spikes.

Male/M_Spadr_Future_01.description: A single right shoulder piece: a broad rounded shoulder cap with trim edge, a long finned spar rising from it, a ringed turbine-like disc with a spike at the tip, and curved pincer hooks at the front.
Male/M_Spadr_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ring housing, cap edge trim and curved hooks; colour 1 on the shoulder cap, spike and fins; colour 3 on the inner ring; colour 2 on the underside.
Male/M_Spadr_Future_01.differs: The male shoulder cap is larger and wider, covering more of the shoulder, with a contrasting underside visible at the front.

Male/M_Spadr_Gearbreak_01.description: A curved, shield-like mechanical shoulder plate that wraps the outside of the right shoulder and upper arm, edged with a thick contrasting rim. A boxy module with a clasp is mounted on the outer face, with small octagonal fittings at the sides.
Male/M_Spadr_Gearbreak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main curved plate; colour 2 on the rim and the boxy module; colour 1 on the clasp and the octagonal side fittings.

Male/M_Spadr_Gladiator_02.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved, flared plate with a raised rim and sharp pointed fins trailing down the front and back, with a separate smooth inner lining panel. Sleek, armoured superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Gladiator_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shell and rim; colour 0 on the inner lining panel; the back spikes show slight sheen variation from the shell material.
Male/M_Spadr_Gladiator_02.differs: The male version is an opaque shell with a separate inner lining panel and defined spiked fins, rather than a translucent glassy plate.

Male/M_Spadr_Heraldry_01.description: A domed right shoulder pauldron with a rolled contrasting edge, a rivet at the front, a hollow inner lining that flares upward, and two stacked overlapping lames wrapping the upper arm below the dome.
Male/M_Spadr_Heraldry_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main dome; colour 3 on the inner lining; colour 1 on the stacked lower lames; colour 2 on the rim edging and underside.
Male/M_Spadr_Heraldry_01.differs: The male pauldron's lower lames sit shorter and wrap more evenly around the arm, without the pointed front tip.

Male/M_Spadr_Hybrid_01.description: A right shoulder pad shaped like a domed shell with a contrasting rounded outer rim, a paneled inner surface, a contrasting eye-like gem in the side and several curved spikes sticking out; sits over the shoulder cap with a lower skirt edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Hybrid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell panels and lower skirt edge; colour 1 on the spikes; colour 2 on the outer rim and edge plating; colour 3 on the eye-like gem.

Male/M_Spadr_Ice_01.description: A shoulder piece made of a jagged cluster of glossy, faceted shards that pile over the right shoulder, with a long pointed shard sweeping forward and smaller spikes hanging down the upper arm. Suggests a crystalline, fantasy look.
Male/M_Spadr_Ice_01.colourAreas: The glossy faceted material largely ignores the scheme; hints of colour 1 show on a few shard facets, while the rest reflects and light.

Male/M_Spadr_Ice_02.description: A right shoulder piece made of clustered, jagged faceted shards that pile over the top of the shoulder and trail down the upper arm in a tapering cascade. Glossy and angular, it suits an icy or crystalline fantasy look.
Male/M_Spadr_Ice_02.colourAreas: The glossy shard material largely ignores the scheme; colour 1 shows faintly as a tint on some facets, with the rest reflecting as a near-sheen.

Male/M_Spadr_Insect_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered, insect-like shell plates: a glossy domed cap studded with sharp spikes, over a swept pointed outer plate and curved lower lobes that wrap the top of the arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed top cap; colour 3 on the spikes; colour 0 on the swept outer plate and rim; colour 1 on the lower lobes and inner accents.

Male/M_Spadr_Jaggedhorns_01.description: A large segmented curling horn rising from the right shoulder, sweeping up and around behind the head. Ridged plated bands with contrasting seams taper to a hooked tip, with a small second spike at the base.
Male/M_Spadr_Jaggedhorns_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main segmented horn body; colour 2 on the seam lines between segments; colour 1 on the band near the base and the tip's upper section; colour 3 on the tapering tips.

Male/M_Spadr_Kaiju_01.description: A small right shoulder cap: a curved, open-bottomed shell with a slightly pitted surface, studded with contrasting conical spikes and a cluster of longer swept-back horns along its edges. Gives an aggressive, monstrous look.
Male/M_Spadr_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the shell; colour 2 on the spikes and horns.

Male/M_Spadr_Kitten_002.description: A small kitten figure crouched on the right shoulder, with pointed ears, forepaws draped over the front of the shoulder and a long tail hanging down the back. Cute, playful companion pet accessory.
Male/M_Spadr_Kitten_002.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the kitten's body, ears, paws and tail; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Kitten_Toy_01.description: A small toy cat figure lying sprawled across the top of the right shoulder, with a rounded head, pointed ears, a simple stitched face, stubby dangling legs with paw pads and a thin tail trailing down the back. Cute and playful.
Male/M_Spadr_Kitten_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body, head, ears, legs and tail; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the whisker marks; colour 1 on the paw pads.

Male/M_Spadr_Lockbox_65_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a smooth domed pauldron with a rim, topped by a detailed snarling dragon-head crest with spiky mane and horns, and two tasselled cords hanging from the front. East-asian martial-arts styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Lockbox_65_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the domed shoulder plate and tassels; colour 1 on the dragon head; colour 0 on the plate rim, horns and mane spikes; colour 3 on the eyes and cord beads.
Male/M_Spadr_Lockbox_65_01.differs: The male dragon head is larger and clearly readable as a snarling face with horns, sitting on the outer edge of the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadr_Lockbox_65_02.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a horned dragon or beast head, with curved horns, a swept back plate, an inset diamond gem eye and a ragged fur-like fringe hanging around the lower edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Lockbox_65_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the head shell, horns and back plate; colour 1 on the swirling markings; colour 3 on the diamond gem eye; colour 2 on the fringe.

Male/M_Spadr_Lockbox_66_01.description: A curved, sci-fi shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a glossy rimmed shell with a broad central plate, a hexagonal light-like stud, a segmented strip along one edge and angular flanges at the front and back.
Male/M_Spadr_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shell rim and flanges; colour 0 on the central plate; colour 1 on the segmented edge strip; colour 3 on the hexagonal stud.

Male/M_Spadr_Modern_Destroyer_01.description: A right shoulder guard of swooping, curled plates that sweep over the shoulder and around a recessed hollow, with a sculpted snarling beast head set in the centre. Suggests a mechanical, armoured villain look.
Male/M_Spadr_Modern_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the swirled shoulder plates; colour 1 on the beast head; colour 3 on its eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Modern_Ironclad_01.description: A single right pauldron shaped like a domed, hooded shell with a raised rim at the back and a stylised bird-head face on the outer side. Flame-like swooping panels and a round ring fitting sit on the lower edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Modern_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, rim and bird face; colour 1 on the inner lining and the panels beneath the face; colour 2 on the lower edge trim; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Modern_Kinetik_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a smooth, shallow hooded shell with a raised band across its top and a thick contrasting edge rim. Sleek and modern, in a superhero style.
Male/M_Spadr_Modern_Kinetik_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the band across the top; colour 2 on the edge rim and underside.

Male/M_Spadr_Moth_01.description: A single right shoulder cap: a smooth, rounded shell that curves over the top of the shoulder and upper arm, with a thin contrasting rim along the open inner edge. Suggests a soft organic or mechanical shoulder guard.
Male/M_Spadr_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 1 as a gradient toward the top of the shell; colour 0 on the thin rim edge.

Male/M_Spadr_Patriotcelebration_2025_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron shaped as a hollow curved dome, with a smooth rim and alternating raised vertical bands that step down over the upper arm. Small round studs sit on the front and back corners of the rim.
Male/M_Spadr_Patriotcelebration_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and edge frame; colour 1 on alternating vertical bands; colour 2 on the other bands and inner shell; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Spadr_Psionic_Dragon_01.description: A right shoulder ornament of jagged, faceted spikes and claw-like talons fanned out over the top of the shoulder, with a taller blade-like fin at the back. Suggests a stylised dragon crest.
Male/M_Spadr_Psionic_Dragon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole spiky shoulder piece; the glossy material shows little of the other slots.

Male/M_Spadr_Qularr_Spines_01.description: A cluster of thin, jointed insect-like spines sprouting from the right shoulder, each with a thick base segment tapering to a fine hooked tip. They arch outward and back over the shoulder, giving an alien, arachnid look.
Male/M_Spadr_Qularr_Spines_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main spine segments; colour 0 on the rounded base joints; colour 2 on the spine tips; colour 3 on the very ends of the tips.
Male/M_Spadr_Qularr_Spines_01.differs: The male spines are spread more widely, with several rising up beside the neck and a longer, more scattered arrangement over the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadr_Raven_01.description: A realistic raven perched on the right shoulder, with textured feathers, a long tapering tail, a stout curved beak and thin clawed legs gripping the shoulder. Sits beside the neck and faces forward.
Male/M_Spadr_Raven_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feathered body and head; colour 3 on the beak; colour 2 on the legs and claws.

Male/M_Spadr_Reindeer_Toy_01.description: A small plush toy reindeer perched on the right shoulder, lying with its legs tucked under it. It has a rounded body and head, branching antlers, a round nose, a wrapped neck scarf and small ears. Festive and cute.
Male/M_Spadr_Reindeer_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the body and head; colour 1 on the neck scarf and inner ear and tail tufts; colour 2 on the antlers and hooves; colour 3 on the nose and eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Renegade_Punk_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron of angular, segmented plates with cracked panel texture and contrasting edge trim, topped by a few tall cone spikes, with a contrasting underplate and open inner side. Punk sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Spadr_Renegade_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the edge trim and inner lining; colour 2 on the underplate; colour 3 on the spikes.
Male/M_Spadr_Renegade_Punk_01.differs: The male version has three spikes along the top, spaced more widely, and a larger, broader plate.

Male/M_Spadr_Renegade_Spikes_01.description: A right shoulder guard: a rounded, cap-like upper plate with a raised open front edge and large conical spikes, over a segmented mechanical upper-arm cuff with small spikes and a buckled strap. Sci-fi punk look.
Male/M_Spadr_Renegade_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shoulder cap; colour 3 on the large spikes and inner trim lines; colour 0 on the arm cuff plates and strap; colour 2 on the small cuff spikes.

Male/M_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_01.description: A broad angular shoulder pauldron: a hollow, arched metal shell with a faceted lower edge and a raised stepped cap panel on top, sitting over the right shoulder. Suggests retro sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the raised top cap panel; colour 0 on the faceted lower shell; colour 2 on the inner lining and underside edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_01.differs: The male pauldron is larger and wider, with a longer sweeping arch that extends further over the shoulder and upper arm.

Male/M_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_02.description: A boxy mechanical missile launcher block mounted above the right shoulder, with six round barrel openings on its front face and a ribbed flexible hose curving down toward the chest. Retro sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing; colour 1 on the front face plate holding the barrel openings; colour 2 on the barrel openings; colour 3 on the ribbed hose.

Male/M_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_04.description: A boxy shoulder-mounted missile launcher block with a front face of six round tube openings, angular panelled casing and a nut-fitted ribbed hose curving down toward the upper back. Retro sci-fi weapon pod resting on the right shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Retro_Warlord_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main casing; colour 1 on the front face plate and border around the tube openings; colour 2 on the launch tube openings and side panels; colour 3 on the ribbed hose.

Male/M_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved, plate-like cap with a raised, flared front edge, an angular pointed rear, and a rolled contrasting lower rim. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm in a retro mechanical style.
Male/M_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main outer plate; colour 0 on the front edge trim and the rear angular panel; colour 1 on the lower rim.

Male/M_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_02.description: A single right-shoulder plate: a curved, hooded shell with a flared, pointed front lip and a rim of contrasting trim, set over a separate lower band at the upper arm. Retro mechanical armour look.
Male/M_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell; colour 0 on the raised front rim and the back-facing outer panel; colour 1 on the lower band around the arm.

Male/M_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.description: A broad, tapered wedge-shaped shoulder vent for the right shoulder: a smooth hard shell with a framed front opening of angled louvre slats and a slotted vent at the back. Retro mechanical, sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and frame; colour 1 on the louvre slats and the back vent bars; colour 3 on the recessed interior behind the slats; colour 2 on the inner shadowed panels.
Male/M_Spadr_Retrosteelhead_Vent_01.differs: The male version is a wider, more squared shell with a smooth arched underside, and its front vent is shorter than the female one.

Male/M_Spadr_Rockcrystal_01.description: A right shoulder pad made of a cluster of chunky, faceted rock slabs veined with cracks, with a pointed crystal spike on top and a jagged shard trailing outward; it sits on top of the shoulder as a rugged fantasy pauldron.
Male/M_Spadr_Rockcrystal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rock slabs; colour 3 on the crack veins between the slabs; colour 1 and colour 2 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Spadr_Rubber_Duck_01.description: A small novelty rubber duck figure perched on the right shoulder, with a rounded body, small tail bump, round head and a flared open beak with small eyes. Playful, cute and toy-like.
Male/M_Spadr_Rubber_Duck_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the duck's body and head; colour 1 on the beak; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Sandstorm_01.description: A loose, open-ended cloth sleeve tube worn over the right shoulder like a draped cowl, with soft creased folds and a wide rounded opening. It covers only the shoulder and upper arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Sandstorm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and inner fabric; colour 1 on the outer lower part of the sleeve; colour 2 on the shadowed hem edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Sandstorm_01.differs: The male shoulder wrap is taller and rounder, sitting higher over the shoulder with a wider, more open ring.

Male/M_Spadr_Sandstorm_02.description: A chunky, angular armoured shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a faceted cup-shaped plate with an inset lining, a lower collar band, a loop strap around the arm and a small tab at the bottom. Sci-fi, mechanical styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Sandstorm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plates; colour 1 on the inner lining and the band under the plate; colour 3 on the small tab at the bottom; colour 2 on the strap loop around the arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Sandstorm_02.differs: The male version is larger and bulkier, with a wider open strap loop clearly visible below the plate at the front.

Male/M_Spadr_Sandstorm_Alt_01.description: A short, soft cloth shoulder wrap forming an open cowl-like tube that sits over the right shoulder, with rumpled folds and a rolled upper edge; casual superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Sandstorm_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper rolled edge and inner lining; colour 1 on the lower band of the wrap.

Male/M_Spadr_Scarab_01.description: A domed, smooth shoulder cap that sits over the right shoulder, with a single swept-back spike on top, a contrasting rolled rim along the inner edge, and curved talon-like tips at the front and back.
Male/M_Spadr_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome and spike; colour 1 on the rolled inner rim; colour 2 on the lower edge band; colour 3 on the talon tips.

Male/M_Spadr_Scarab_02.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered curved plates with pointed edges and glossy inset hollows, topped by a separate swept fin-like plate that curves over the shoulder. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm, with a mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Spadr_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main pauldron plates; colour 1 on the swept upper fin plate; colour 2 on the glossy inset hollows.
Male/M_Spadr_Scarab_02.differs: The male pauldron is larger and wraps the shoulder more broadly, with the upper plate curving closely over the shoulder instead of flaring out.

Male/M_Spadr_Shiba_Toy_01.description: A small plush toy dog lying on its belly across the right shoulder, with a rounded stuffed body, pointed ears, stubby paws, a curled tail and simple stitched face details. Cute and playful.
Male/M_Spadr_Shiba_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body, ears and tail; colour 1 on the muzzle and chest, ear insides, paws, back patch and tail tip; colour 2 on the nose; colour 3 on the eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Shouldercape_01.description: A single-shoulder cape: a rounded shoulder cap with contrasting trim on the right shoulder, and a long narrow drape of loose cloth hanging down the back to about thigh level. A thin strap crosses the chest to hold it.
Male/M_Spadr_Shouldercape_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap top and the hanging cloth drape; colour 1 on the trim edging the shoulder cap; colour 2 on the chest strap; colour 3 on the small strap detail.

Male/M_Spadr_Shouldercape_02.description: A single-shoulder cape: a rounded cloth mantle with contrasting trim caps the right shoulder, and a long draped panel of soft cloth hangs from it down the back to about hip level.
Male/M_Spadr_Shouldercape_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mantle top and the hanging cloth panel; colour 1 on the trim edging the mantle; colour 2 on the underside lining of the mantle.

Male/M_Spadr_Shouldercape_03.description: A single-shoulder cape: a rounded, layered cloth mantle with bordered edges sits over the right shoulder, held by a thin strap across the neck, with a long narrow cloth panel hanging down the back to about hip level.
Male/M_Spadr_Shouldercape_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer mantle top and the hanging cloth panel; colour 2 on the underside of the mantle; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the strap.

Male/M_Spadr_Shouldercape_04.description: A single-shoulder cape: a rounded, flared shoulder cowl with a contrasting inner lining and edge trim, from which a long, narrow cloth drape hangs down the back of the arm to about hip level.
Male/M_Spadr_Shouldercape_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shoulder cowl and the hanging drape; colour 2 on the inner lining underneath the cowl; colour 1 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Spadr_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A mechanical right shoulder pauldron of layered angular plates that cups the shoulder, with a hollow ring opening on the outer side, a stepped upper crest and a small accent panel. Sci-fi pharaoh-inspired armour.
Male/M_Spadr_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower rim and outer edge plates; colour 1 on the main shell and inner ring; colour 2 on the upper crest and under-plates; colour 3 on the small accent panels.

Male/M_Spadr_Splendor_01.description: A right shoulder piece of layered, swooping pointed plates that curve over the shoulder like a stylised wing, with a smooth inner panel and a teardrop inlay. Sleek superhero styling with sharp upswept tips.
Male/M_Spadr_Splendor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large inner panel; colour 1 on the teardrop inlay; colour 2 on the inner stripe; colour 3 on the outer layered plates and edging.

Male/M_Spadr_Spooky_01.description: A small angular shoulder guard on the right shoulder: a rounded, faceted cap with a slit-shaped cutout on the outer side, and stacked pointed plates tapering down the upper arm like a spike. Sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and the lower pointed plates; colour 3 on the inner slit accent; colour 2 on the cutout opening.

Male/M_Spadr_Starhawk_01.description: A thin, open metal shoulder band for the right shoulder: an angular, zigzag ring that circles the top of the arm and rises into sharp, pointed prongs at the front and back. It leaves the shoulder mostly bare.
Male/M_Spadr_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole band; no other colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Spadr_Starhawk_01.differs: The male band is a lower, more sharply zigzagged ring with thinner prongs. The female band has broader, more upright prongs.

Male/M_Spadr_Starhawk_02.description: A slim curved shoulder band that arcs around the upper right arm, with angular fin-like blades rising at both ends and a contrasting central strip. Sleek, sci-fi styling that sits on the outer shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Starhawk_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upturned end blades and outer edges; colour 1 on the main curved band; colour 2 on the inset section; colour 3 on a small accent under the band.

Male/M_Spadr_Steampunk_01.description: A chunky mechanical shoulder pad: a round rivetted disc ring carrying several boxy, faceted armour blocks with small inset windows, seated over a curved inner cuff piece at the shoulder. Steampunk sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the faceted blocks and outer disc ring; colour 1 on the inner cuff housing and side clamps; colour 3 on the inner lining panel; colour 2 on the rivets and window insets.

Male/M_Spadr_Steelcommando_01.description: A domed, hollow shoulder cap that covers the top of the right shoulder and upper arm, made of segmented curved plates with raised seam lines and a slightly flared open rim. It suggests retro mechanical armor.
Male/M_Spadr_Steelcommando_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer plates and raised seams; colour 2 on the hollow inner lining.

Male/M_Spadr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.description: A single right shoulder pad: a smooth, curved, hollow shell that caps the shoulder with faceted, slightly angular edges and an open inner side. It has a retro superhero look and no visible straps or extra parts.
Male/M_Spadr_Super_Retro_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell; colour 0 on the rim edge. The glossy metal finish mutes the scheme.

Male/M_Spadr_Tactical_01.description: A small curved shoulder plate for the right upper arm, with a raised rim around a recessed panel bearing an atom emblem. The plate is open and unlined behind, a superhero or tactical patch-style pad.
Male/M_Spadr_Tactical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and outer plate; colour 1 on the recessed panel; the atom emblem takes a light colour matching the rim.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_90s_Bullets_01.description: A right shoulder pad shaped as a rounded, padded cushion arching over the shoulder, with layered bordered panels on top carrying a row of small bullet-like cartridges and a vertical strap with a buckle plate at the front and back.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_90s_Bullets_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quilted padding and cartridge casings; colour 1 on the border bands and strap; colour 2 on the inner panel; colour 3 on the cartridge tips.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_90s_Knife_01.description: A right shoulder pad made of a puffy padded cushion that arches over the shoulder, with layered rectangular trim bands, a row of small cartridge-like tubes on top, a central strap, and a flat blade or bar sticking out sideways.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_90s_Knife_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded cushion and tube casings; colour 1 on the layered trim bands and strap; colour 2 on the inner panel and the flat blade; colour 3 on the tube bands.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a swept, tapering armour shell that points outward past the arm, with a raised vented tech band at the inner edge, ribbed panel lines and chevron stripes; a mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_90s_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the wide band along the inner edge; colour 3 on the chevron stripes and small indicator lights; colour 2 on the vented housing and edge trim.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Alien_01.description: A small angular alien shoulder pad for the right shoulder: a layered plate with a bevelled rim, a raised glossy panel on top, and a single sharp curved spike jutting outward from the front.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bottom rim plate; colour 1 on the main plate body; colour 2 on the raised top panel; colour 3 on the spike.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.description: A single right-shoulder pauldron: a curved, shell-like plate that arches over the shoulder, with a tall flared collar edge beside the neck, hex-bolt studs across the face and a contrasting rim, in an alien gladiator style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Alien_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the rim and edge panels; colour 3 on small accents near the top edge; colour 2 on the hex bolts and inner lining.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Amazon_01.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a curved cap, with a swirling cloud-like scroll pattern on the outer panel, a wide banded strip running over the top and hanging down front and back, and a thin edge trim.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main outer panel; colour 1 on the wide strip over the shoulder; colour 2 on the scroll pattern and curled top edge; colour 3 on the thin edge trim and stripes along the strip.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ancient_01.description: A right shoulder guard of layered angular plates with a tall pointed fin rising above the shoulder, carved swirl patterns, and a curved band and cuff ring around the upper arm. Ancient, mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ancient_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mottled shoulder plates and fin; colour 3 on the upper arm guard and cuff ring; colour 1 on the swirl engravings and band pattern.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ancient_01.differs: The male version has a tall upright pointed fin and a broader rounded arm guard, with plates sitting flat across the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Face_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a sculpted, wrinkled face plate with a raised rim, sitting on top of the shoulder. A curved talon-like blade sweeps back and down, with small spikes at the top and a contrasting underside.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Face_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sculpted face plate; colour 1 on the raised rim; colour 2 on the underside, talon blade and spikes; colour 3 on the small spike tips.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.description: A curved rectangular shoulder plate with a jagged notched lower edge and a thin raised rim, sitting over the right shoulder and upper arm as two overlapping layers. A small pointed spike juts out underneath it.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plate surface; colour 1 on the rim and inner lining; colour 2 on the small spike underneath.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Flat_01.differs: The male version adds a small contrasting spike protruding under the plate, which the female version lacks.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Round_01.description: A shield-shaped right shoulder plate with a raised rim, a cross-like star emblem set in a diamond-shaped recessed panel, small spikes at the ends, and curled tips. It sits on top of the shoulder in a heroic style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Round_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and curled tips; colour 1 on the recessed panel and underside; colour 3 on the cross emblem; colour 2 on the small spikes.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.description: A right shoulder guard made of a curved layered plate with a jagged lower edge, topped by a cross-shaped block from which a large curved scythe-like blade sweeps up and outward behind the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner plate surface; colour 1 on the outer shell and edge trim; colour 3 on the cross-shaped block; colour 2 on the curved blade.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Angel_Spiked_01.differs: The male blade is larger and sweeps out wider from the shoulder, with a bigger, bulkier guard.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Anniversary_Defender_.description: A right shoulder cap of stacked curved plates: a wide flared lower lip, a thin band above it, and a ridged fan of fluted ridges on top. It sits over the shoulder in a retro superhero style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Anniversary_Defender_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the flared lower lip; colour 2 on the thin band between the lip and the ridges; colour 1 on the fluted ridges; colour 0 on the outer ridge edges.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Arcane_01.description: A single right shoulder piece: a curved, hooded cap with a raised upper panel and a separate lower shell that sweeps out to a pointed tip, edged in thin contrasting trim with a small round gem-like stud.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Arcane_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower shell; colour 3 on the raised upper panel; colour 1 on the round stud; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armadillo_01.description: A rounded, dome-shaped right shoulder cap that covers the top of the shoulder and upper arm. Its surface has a cracked, cell-like pattern of raised plates, with a contrasting edge band. The inside is open and hollow.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armadillo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base shell between the plates; colour 2 on the cell-like plate pattern; colour 1 on the edge trim along the rim.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armadillo_01.differs: The male cap is a larger dome with a wider open front, so more of the hollow interior is visible from the front.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a curved, hollow shell that caps the shoulder, with a contrasting upper panel, a thin trim line along the lower edge, and a small round mechanical socket on the front.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armor_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and socket housing; colour 1 on the upper panel and inner lining; colour 2 on the lower edge trim; colour 3 on the socket centre.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.description: A mechanical shoulder-mounted engine box with a tall contrasting smokestack pipe topped by a small cap, a side gear wheel, a vented front grille, a coiled hose at the base, and a curved plate that arches over the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the box housing and hose rings; colour 1 on the shoulder plate, top canister and back panel; colour 2 on the smokestack, wheel and hose; colour 3 on the glowing vent slots.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Steampunk_001.differs: The shoulder plate is a broader, shorter arch that hugs the shoulder rather than flaring out, and the stack leans slightly back.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Viperlogo_01.description: A right shoulder armor cap with a angular, faceted outer shell and jagged spikes along the edges, open at the side to show stacked segmented plates beneath; small paired slits accent the front and back.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armor_Viperlogo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and edge spikes; colour 1 on the stacked inner segments; colour 2 on the recessed inner gaps and underside; colour 3 on the paired slit marks.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armorninja.description: A curved, cup-like right shoulder guard of layered armor plating, with a raised outer rim, a banded lower section, a rectangular inset panel and a single curved horn-like blade jutting out from the front edge. Mechanical ninja look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armorninja.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell, rim and curved blade; colour 1 on the main plate face; colour 2 on the lower band; colour 3 on the rectangular inset panel.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armorviper_01.description: A small faceted shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a broad, angular shell with a raised ridge along the top and a contrasting wedge that extends outward and down the side. It suggests sleek sci-fi armour.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armorviper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and ridge; colour 1 on the outer wedge panel.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Armorviper_01.differs: The male version is a flatter, wider shell with a longer, sharper wedge extending out at the side.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_01.description: A single curved shoulder cap that sits over the top of the right shoulder like a shallow shell, with a bevelled metal-look rim and a raised panel bearing an atom emblem. Suggests a clean superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main panel; colour 0 on the rim and the atom emblem.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_02.description: A small angular shoulder plate for the right shoulder: a shallow, wing-like shell with a pointed lower tip, a raised rim edge and swept notches. Sits on the outside of the shoulder, suggesting a sleek sci-fi suit.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised rim and outer edge; colour 1 on the main face of the plate; colour 2 on the shaded lower point and inner lining.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ascendant_02.differs: The male plate is wider and flatter, sitting more open across the top of the shoulder with a shallower rim.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.description: A furry animal-head shoulder piece: a bear head with small rounded ears, a shaggy jagged fur ruff and an open toothy mouth, perched on top of the right shoulder and facing forward.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Beast_Bear_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur; colour 1 on the fur tufts and streaks along the ruff; colour 3 on the nose and inner ears; colour 2 on the mouth interior and eyes.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A right shoulder pad made of layered, overlapping curved plates that sweep over the shoulder, with jagged feather-like edges at the back and three round domed studs across the top.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main upper plate; colour 2 on the layered under-plates, edging and feather tips; colour 3 on the three domed studs.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_01.differs: The male version is a low, layered pad with spiky feather edges and three round studs, rather than a tall cupped shell with a bird emblem.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.description: A cup-shaped right shoulder guard with a wide, thick rim around a contrasting shell; a winged, feather-like panel with angular segments covers the outer face, and the interior is open and hollow.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim and border; colour 0 on the shell surface; colour 2 on the angular wing frame; colour 3 on the feather-like inset panels.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Birdpeople_02.differs: The male version is an open-rimmed shell with a winged, feather-like panel on the outer face, rather than the female's layered dome with three round studs.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.description: A faceted, angular single shoulder guard that caps the right shoulder, open on the neck side, with chevron-shaped grooved bands across the top and round bolted lens-like ports on both ends. Mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 2 on the chevron grooves; colour 1 on the port rings; colour 3 on the port centres.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_01.differs: The male version has a larger shell with a round port on both the front and back ends, while the female has one only on the outer end.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_02.description: A mechanical right shoulder piece: a curved, arching plate over the top of the shoulder with angular edges, ending in two chunky armoured pods at the front and back, each with small slash marks.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arching top plate; colour 2 on the plate edges and pod frames; colour 1 on the pod panels; colour 3 on the slash marks.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered, segmented armor plates with a wide flared upturned rim and rib-like ridges. A row of curved claw spikes runs along the outer edge. Sits over the shoulder cap with a brutal, mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 1 on the outer flared rim, edge trim and raised ridges; colour 2 on the large claw spikes; colour 0 on the smaller side spikes.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_01.differs: The male pauldron has a larger, more open flared rim with a jagged edge and longer, more separated ridges.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_02.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a hollow, skull-like shell with a swept-up rim and pointed side fins, ringed by a dense fringe of long spiky tufts. It sits over the top of the shoulder, giving a brutal, monstrous look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shell and its pointed fins; colour 1 on the spiky fur-like fringe around the rim; colour 2 on the hollow interior.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_03.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered angular plates with a ragged jagged-edged fur or feather fringe around the rim, a textured snarling face panel on the outer side, small spikes on the edge and lace-like cord ties.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Brutal_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner plate surfaces and the cord ties; colour 1 on the jagged fringe around the rim; colour 2 on the plate edges and spikes; colour 3 on the face panel on the outer side.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Child_Space_01.description: A single rounded, bowl-like shoulder pad: a smooth faceted dome with a horizontal seam near the base and a shallow open cup underneath. It floats over the right shoulder, suggesting a sleek futuristic look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Child_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole dome and lower shell; the material looks glossy and pale, so the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Child_Steelarachnid_0.description: A single mechanical spider-leg spike mounted on the right shoulder: a short angular metal segment with a round socket cap, bending upward into a long pointed blade that rises past the head.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Child_Steelarachnid_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the metal leg segments; colour 2 on the round socket cap; colour 1 on the small stripe on the cap.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.description: A single right-shoulder plate: a broad, gently curved panel with a raised rim and a small rivet near the outer edge. It caps the top of the shoulder like a small pauldron, suggesting a sleek sci-fi combat suit.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole plate and its rim; the hollow underside shows a darker inner surface that does not follow the scheme.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Combatsciencegroup_01.differs: The male plate is wider and flatter, extending further across the shoulder, with a larger visible hollow on its underside.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Covertmilitary_01.description: A compact angular shoulder pad for the right shoulder: a faceted, domed shell with a recessed octagonal ring on the outer face, an angular trim channel along the edges and a flat underside with small rivets.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Covertmilitary_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and octagonal ring; colour 1 on the inset edge trim lines; colour 2 on the flat underside.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Cross_And_Cirlce_01.description: A mechanical shoulder emblem: a flat octagonal ring with a central hub and four cross spokes ending in flared, claw-like tips. It floats upright on the outer right shoulder like a small sci-fi badge.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Cross_And_Cirlce_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ring and central hub; colour 2 on the four cross spokes and their flared tips.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A right shoulder guard made of three curved, padded bands arched over the shoulder, each with a thick contrasting edge, and a round button-like stud on the outer side. Suggests a sleek cyber-western look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded band centres; colour 2 on the band edges and borders; colour 1 on the round stud.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.description: A single right shoulder cap of rounded, dented metal plating with a raised rim, topped by a tall octagonal exhaust stack on a narrow collar, plus a short round vent nozzle on the outer side. Cyber-western look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Cyber_Cowboy_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate; colour 1 on the collar ring at the base of the stack; colour 3 on the stack and the side nozzle; colour 2 on the plate rim edging.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.description: A small angular shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a faceted domed top panel over a deeper banded lower edge that flares slightly outward, with small hex bolts on the top panel. A mechanical, cyborg-style look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Cyborgarmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed top panel; colour 0 on the lower band; colour 2 on the underside edge; colour 3 on the hex bolts.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Defender_02.description: A rounded shoulder cap that sits over the right shoulder, open on the inner side like a scooped shell, with a wide contrasting band angled across its middle. Sleek, superhero-style tights armour.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Defender_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell of the cap; colour 2 on the wide band across the middle; colour 1 on the thin edge trim and the inner lining.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Defender_02.differs: The male cap is larger with a more steeply angled band and a deeper open scoop showing more of the inner lining.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Destroyer_01.description: A single right shoulder fin: a swept, wing-like blade with a tall sharp point rising beside the neck and a flared ribbed panel over the shoulder, edged with a raised rim. Sci-fi, superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fin panel; colour 2 on the rim and the raised ribs; colour 0 on the inner face of the upright point.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Destroyer_01.differs: The male fin has a broader, taller upright spike that curls toward the neck and a more compact outward flare.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.description: A curved, cup-shaped shoulder guard with a raised rim and a padded outer plate ribbed by horizontal seams, studded with short cone spikes. It sits over the right shoulder and upper arm, suiting a gladiator or mechanical look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Destroyerbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and inner shell; colour 1 on the ribbed outer plate; colour 2 on the spikes.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Destroyerbot_02.description: A single curved shoulder guard for the right shoulder: a flat, open-backed shell that wraps partway around the upper arm, with a contrasting rim and a segmented outer panel with faint horizontal ridges. Gladiator-style armor.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Destroyerbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim and the inner shell; colour 1 on the outer segmented panel.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_01.description: A rounded right shoulder plate: a broad domed cap with a hollow underside, trimmed edges and a segmented lower rim with inset panels. It sits over the shoulder and suits mechanical superhero armour.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed outer shell; colour 2 on the inner lining and side walls; colour 3 on the inset panels under the rim; colour 0 on the lower edge segments.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_01.differs: The male plate is a broader, smoother dome without the raised pointed fin at the front that the female version has.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_02.description: A right shoulder pad of layered, scalloped armor plates: a smooth domed cap over the shoulder with stacked curved bands below, separated by recessed inserts. Mechanical superhero styling, sitting over the shoulder and upper arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Dharmor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed cap and the inset panels between bands; colour 1 on the stacked scallop bands and edges; colour 3 on the recessed strips; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Disk_01.description: A small rounded shoulder disc worn on the right shoulder: a shallow dome with a faceted rim and a hollow recessed centre, standing slightly proud of the arm. Mechanical, minimal, sci-fi pauldron style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Disk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole disc; no other slots visible.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Double_01_Basic.description: A right shoulder pauldron of stacked, overlapping angular plates that curve over the top of the shoulder and taper to a pointed lower edge on the upper arm, with a rounded cap and layered lower ridges. Suits superhero or sci-fi outfits.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Double_01_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the top cap plate; colour 1 on the middle band of plates; colour 3 on the outer lower plates and edge trim; colour 0 on the inner panel faces.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Double_02_Basic.description: A right shoulder pad made of two stacked, angular layered plates with raised rims and a crest of cone spikes along the top; sits on the shoulder as a punk, mechanical accent.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Double_02_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the inner plate surfaces; colour 1 on the outer rims and spikes; colour 2 on the top panel; colour 3 on the thin stripe along the panel edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Double_02_Basic.differs: The male pad is wider and lower, with the spikes spread in a crest across the top rather than clustered along the outer edge.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Double_03_Basic.description: A right shoulder piece of stacked, overlapping curved bands forming a rounded cap over the shoulder, with a broad curled-up blade-like fin at the back and small pointed blades trailing behind. Sleek mechanical superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Double_03_Basic.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer blade fin, band edges and trailing blades; colour 0 on the inner layered plates between the bands.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Double_03_Basic.differs: The blade fin is shorter, wider and more curled over, with blunter trailing blades.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Draycul_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a snarling monster face with a gaping open mouth, fangs and tusk-like spikes, backed by a flat angular plate with rivets and slashed grooves. Sits over the shoulder cap.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Draycul_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the face sculpt and plate; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the fangs, spikes and rear plate; colour 3 on the eyes and mouth.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Electric_01.description: A domed shoulder cap with a bracketed rim and bolted side plate, topped by several coiled electrode posts with hex-nut caps. A Tesla-coil style mechanical pauldron sitting over the right shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Electric_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the rim, bracket and hex-nut cap edges; colour 1 on the dome shell; colour 3 on the coil windings and the thin seam lines; colour 2 on the hex caps and coil end pieces.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Epaulette_01.description: A right-shoulder epaulette: a flat, rounded octagonal plate with a thin edge rim and a short tab toward the neck, and a dense hanging fringe of twisted strands around the outer edge, sitting on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Epaulette_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the flat plate and tab; colour 2 on the edge rim; colour 1 on the hanging fringe strands.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Epaulette_02.description: A military-style shoulder epaulette: a flat, rounded octagonal plate with a narrow tab extending toward the neck, a thin rim, and a hanging fringe of short bullion strands along the outer edge. Sits on the right shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Epaulette_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top plate and neck tab; colour 2 on the thin rim underneath; colour 1 on the hanging fringe.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron in an art deco style: a smooth, streamlined dome that tapers to a point over the upper arm. A tall, curved fin rises at the back edge and ends in a scroll curl, with contrasting bands across the cap.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shoulder shell; colour 1 on the rising fin, the scroll curl and the bands across the cap; colour 2 on the thin seam lines.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_02.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a tall, swept scoop, with a broad panel, thick contrasting rim and a raised ridge that rises into a pointed fin above the shoulder. Retro art deco, sci-fi style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel and raised ridge; colour 1 on the thick outer rim and inner lining; colour 2 on the thin groove lines.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Exartdeco_02.differs: The male version has a taller, more upright fin rising above the shoulder and a deeper, more vertical scoop.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Fantasy_01.description: A single curved shoulder cap that sweeps over the right shoulder like a short hooded flap, with a raised rolled outer edge, a hollow open front and a separate lower panel flaring outward. Sleek, superhero-style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Fantasy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell and rolled rim; colour 1 on the lower flared panel and inner lining; colour 2 on the thin edge piping and the interior at the front.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A small feathered wing-shaped shoulder piece for the right shoulder: layered feathers sweep outward and back from a thick band that wraps the upper arm, giving a light angelic silhouette.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the band around the arm; colour 0 on the feather bases; colour 1 on the feather tips.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Feathers_02.description: A small domed shoulder cap for the right shoulder, ringed by a skirt of pointed, overlapping feather-like spikes that fan outward; banded panels cross the dome. Sits on top of the shoulder as a partial pauldron.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Feathers_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the dome of the cap; colour 2 on the band across the dome; colour 3 on the small rectangular inset panel; colour 0 on the feather spikes around the rim.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Fin_01.description: A small membranous fin worn on the right shoulder, swept backward, with thin spined ribs of contrasting trim fanning across a mottled webbed panel. Its edges taper into sharp points, giving an alien, creature-like look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the webbed membrane; colour 3 on the spots mottling the membrane; colour 1 on the spined ribs and edge trim; colour 2 on the underside.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Fin_02.description: A large fin-like shoulder ornament for the right shoulder: a webbed membrane between several curved spines, fanning upward and backward from the top of the shoulder like an aquatic or alien fin.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the membrane surface; colour 1 on the curved spines and edge trim; colour 3 on the mottled spots across the membrane; colour 2 on the underside and shading.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Fin_02.differs: The male fin stands more upright, fanning up from the shoulder top with a shorter, denser spread of spines.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Flower_01.description: A small rose-like flower perched on top of the right shoulder, with a tight spiral of petals at the centre and pointed outer petals splayed outward. Suggests a nature or fantasy shoulder ornament.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Flower_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the petal tips and edges; colour 1 on the main petal surfaces; colour 2 on the inner spiral and petal undersides; colour 3 on tiny accents at the flower centre.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Furrypad_01.description: A large shoulder pad for the right shoulder, made of layered, jagged fur tufts that sweep downward over the upper arm from a thin shell cap. Wild, feral look suited to beastly or barbarian styles.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Furrypad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur tufts; colour 2 in the shadowed depths of the tufts; colour 0 on the inner shell cap under the fur.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Fursmall_01.description: A small fur mantle for the right shoulder: a rounded cap of layered, shaggy tufts that fade to ragged pointed tips and hang over the upper arm. Suggests a primal or barbaric look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Fursmall_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur near the top of the shoulder; colour 1 on the fur toward the ragged tips; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Furspiked_0.description: A shaggy fur shoulder mantle for the right shoulder: layered, jagged tufts sweep outward and down over the upper arm, ending in ragged, spiky points. Wild, savage look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Furspiked_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper fur tufts at the top of the shoulder; colour 1 on the lower tips of the fur, blending in as a gradient; colour 2 on a small patch at the neck-side edge.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Gadroon_01.description: A sleek single-piece shoulder guard shaped like a smooth curved shell that sweeps up to a point beside the neck and flares over the outer shoulder, with a thin contrasting edge trim and a hollow underside.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Gadroon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Gadroonfancy_01.description: A sharp, angular shoulder guard on the right shoulder: a low fin-shaped shell with a raised inner panel and several swept-back spikes, one tall spike rising by the neck and a long point flaring outward over the arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Gadroonfancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell and spikes; colour 0 on the raised inner panel; colour 3 on the thin edge trim and inner spike faces.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Gladiator_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a rounded, open-fronted plate with a raised rim, several cone spikes jutting outward and back, a contrasting cylindrical port at the front, and stacked banded ridges beneath the plate.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Gladiator_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate; colour 1 on the rim and lower edge bands; colour 2 on the front port and the banding between ridges; colour 3 on the spikes and scratch-like markings.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Golden_Age_Bolt_01.description: A flat, thin lightning-bolt emblem worn on the right shoulder, standing slightly proud of the sleeve with a zigzag edge and a tapering point down the upper arm. Classic comic-book superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Golden_Age_Bolt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole bolt; no other colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.description: A small five-pointed star emblem with faceted raised points, mounted flat on the outer right shoulder. A simple angular badge in a classic retro superhero style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Golden_Age_Star_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole star; the raised faces show only lighter and darker shading of it.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Herculan_01.description: A small rounded shoulder pad cap for the right shoulder, with a striped vented top panel and a lower lip on the outer side holding two round contrasting intake holes. Mechanical, sleek sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Herculan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and lip; colour 1 on the vent stripes across the top; colour 2 on the round intake holes.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hipan_01.description: A right shoulder pad of curved, overlapping ridged plates with chevron-shaped ribbing, framed by a raised rim and a row of small spikes along the top edge. It is a fantasy-style armour cap with a contrasting inner lining.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hipan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and ridge plates; colour 1 on the chevron ribbing panels; colour 2 on the inner lining and spike tips.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Holoforce_01.description: A single right shoulder guard: a curved, shell-like plate tapering to a point over the upper arm, with a raised rim and forked clip-like tabs extending front and back across the shoulder. Sleek, mechanical sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Holoforce_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoulder plate and tabs; the piece shows almost entirely in colour 0, with no other slots clearly visible.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Holohex_01.description: A floating cluster of flat, faceted hexagonal shards hovering off the right shoulder, forming a tall angular plate that rises beside the neck and flares into small points near the arm. Suggests a holographic energy field.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Holohex_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shard cluster; the default material ignores the other colour slots, so no other slots are visible.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.description: A small group of short, jagged bone-like spikes, each on a flat base plate, mounted along the top and back of the right shoulder. Angular and monstrous, it is a sparse accent that leaves the body uncovered.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 3 on the flat base plates under each spike.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_01.differs: The male version bunches three or four spikes more tightly along the top of the shoulder, whereas the female one spreads them lower onto the upper arm.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.description: A pair of long, jagged bone-like spike clusters on the right shoulder: each sprouts angular blades from a flat base plate, one sweeping upward and one outward, for a monstrous, spiky look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spike blades; colour 3 on the base plates.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hornsmonster_02.differs: The male version has just two spike clusters on two base plates, while the female version has four separate spikes.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hoses_01.description: A mechanical right shoulder piece: a rounded dome shell held in an open angular frame, with four ribbed hoses arching over the top and clamped by small straps. Sits on the outer shoulder, suggesting a sci-fi power unit.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome shell and hose end caps; colour 1 on the outer frame and clamp straps; colour 2 on the inset panels and base; colour 3 on the ribbed hoses.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Insignia_01.description: A rounded, hollow shoulder cap for the right shoulder with a raised rim and a flat atom emblem on the outer face. It sits over the top and outside of the shoulder in a superhero style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Insignia_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main outer face of the cap; colour 0 on the atom emblem; colour 3 on the rim and inner lining.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Insignia_02.description: A large rounded right shoulder pauldron shaped like a domed shell with a raised contrasting rim and a hollow inner lining, printed with an atom emblem on the outer face. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm in a superhero style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Insignia_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the domed outer shell; colour 3 on the rim and inner lining; colour 0 on the atom emblem.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ironclad_01.description: A domed, angular shoulder pauldron with a raised curved fin rising over the top of the shoulder, a flat plate on the outer face carrying a spiky emblem, and round studs at the edges; a deep inner lining hangs below the shell.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ironclad_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer shell, fin and rim; colour 0 on the face plate; colour 2 on the emblem; colour 3 on the round studs and the inner lining below.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ironclad_01.differs: The male version has a larger inner lining that hangs visibly below the shell, and studs on both sides.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Justiciar_01.description: A small angular right shoulder guard made of two flat, folded plates that meet at a ridge over the upper arm, with a contrasting lower edge band and a contrasting notch at the top. Suggests sleek mechanical superhero armor.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Justiciar_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main flat plates; colour 1 on the lower edge band; colour 2 on the notch at the top.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Knight_01.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered, overlapping curved plates with raised ridges and small rivets. A wide domed cap sits over the shoulder, with stepped lames fanning down over the upper arm. Medieval knightly styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Knight_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shoulder cap plates; colour 3 on the lower stepped arm lames, blending in as a gradient; colour 2 on the rivets.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Knight_02.description: A right shoulder pauldron of layered, overlapping metal plates that curve over the shoulder and upper arm, studded with rows of conical spikes and small rivet holes. A medieval, aggressive knight look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Knight_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shoulder plates and spikes; colour 3 on the lower arm-side plates, which fade from the upper plates.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_01.description: A right shoulder piece of two broad, curved fin-like blades with ribbed inner faces, sweeping back from a flat angular base plate on top of the shoulder. Sleek sci-fi superhero look, worn as a small partial accessory.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the outer shells of the blades; colour 1 on the ribbed inner faces; colour 0 on the layered plates above the base; colour 3 on the base plate rim.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_01.differs: The male version has broader, more overlapping blades that sweep back and lie lower over the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_01.description: A right shoulder cap with a domed panel etched with chevron grooves, framed by sweeping blade-like fins that curve outward and back over the shoulder. A segmented plated band hangs below the cap onto the upper arm; sci-fi styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the domed top panel and the lower segmented band; colour 1 on the sweeping fins; colour 2 on the inner lining and edge; colour 3 on the grooves and accent lines.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lemurian_Sharp_01.differs: The male version has longer fins and a visible segmented plated band extending down the upper arm below the cap.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lemuriansorcerer_01.description: A single right shoulder pauldron of segmented angular plates that form a rounded scalloped cap over the shoulder and upper arm, with a raised top pad, stepped bands and a hollow inner side. Mechanical, sci-fi superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lemuriansorcerer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the top cap and the lower end panel; colour 3 on the thin chevron and stripe inserts; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Light_01.description: A winged shoulder piece for the right shoulder: a rounded cap with a contrasting rim, ribbed panels and swept-back blade-like feathers that fan out past the arm. Superhero styling with a mechanical, armored feel.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Light_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim and edge frame; colour 3 on the ribbed cap panels; colour 0 on the feather blades; colour 2 on the underlying lower feather blades.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lionshield_01.description: A domed shoulder guard on the right shoulder, sculpted as a lion's head with a swept mane flowing back over the shoulder, hollow underneath and edged with a thin contrasting rim. Suits a heroic or fantasy look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lionshield_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lion head and mane; colour 1 on the rim trim around the edge; colour 3 on the eyes; colour 2 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lycan_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a rounded, domed cap with a raised pointed fin at the back. It has a wide contrasting rim, panel seams and screw-like fasteners, and a scratched, clawed-looking surface.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lycan_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer rim and edge plating; colour 2 on the domed centre; colour 1 on the claw-scratch markings; colour 3 on the screw heads.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lycan_02.description: A curved, open-ended shoulder cap that arches over the right shoulder like a half-tube, with a thick rolled contrasting rim, a cracked and scuffed surface, small rivet holes and a screw-like fastener. Suggests a patched, mechanical or armour-like look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Lycan_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surface; colour 1 on the rolled rim edging; colour 3 on the round screw fastener; colour 2 on the small rivet holes and scuff patches.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Martial_Power_02.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a swept, wedge-shaped cowl with a wavy contrasting edge, a contrasting curved blade-like lower lip, a broad vented fin rising along the back, and diamond-shaped gem studs at each end.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Martial_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the curved lower lip; colour 2 on the trim, rim and fin frame; colour 3 on the gem studs and fin vents.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Martial_Power_02.differs: The male version's rear fin is larger and wraps higher around the neck side, making the guard look taller and bulkier.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Mechanon.description: A right shoulder piece of angular, layered plates: a swept-back curved fin with a pointed tip, a contrasting upright blade, and a stacked cluster of faceted panels over the shoulder cap. Mechanical, robotic superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Mechanon.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and the pointed fin tip; colour 1 on the large curved fin and outer panel faces; colour 2 on the upright blade and inner panel segments; colour 3 on small accent strips between the plates.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A mechanical right shoulder piece made of layered angular plates that form a jagged cluster over the shoulder cap, with a swept-back blade fin pointing outward and upward. It suggests a robotic, sci-fi armour look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer plates and the fin tip; colour 1 on the curved large plate and the plate edges; colour 2 on the inner slats and the upper blade; colour 3 on the small connecting bars.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Mechassn_01.description: A sci-fi right shoulder guard: an angular layered plate canopy with raised ridges over a curved inner cup, and a contrasting ribbed housing with small round nozzles at the front. It sits on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Mechassn_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 3 on the raised stripes and top panel; colour 1 on the inner cup and thin rings; colour 2 on the ribbed housing.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Monster_01.description: A right shoulder cap of stacked, overlapping curved plates with a tall bony spike rising from the top and smaller spines flaring off the front and rear edges. Monstrous, creature-like pauldron sitting over the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the stacked shoulder plates with a blended shading between the plate seams; colour 0 on the spikes and spines.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Padding.description: A small right shoulder pad: a rounded, faceted shell that caps the top of the shoulder and curves down over the upper arm, with a raised rim and angular panel divisions. Suits tactical or sci-fi armor.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Padding.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 0 on the rim edges; colour 2 on the diagonal band across the pad; colour 3 on the small stripe at the top.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Patterned_01.description: A right shoulder pad made of a domed upper cap over two stacked, overlapping lower plates, all edged with thick contrasting trim. It sits on top of the shoulder as a compact, hollow-backed cap. Suits a superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Patterned_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper cap and the inner lining; colour 0 on the lower stacked plates; colour 2 on the edge trim.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.description: A right shoulder guard shaped like a rounded, bulging shell with a tall spike on top and two smaller spikes stepping down the back, pitted with a cluster of round recesses; a toothed edge trims the lower rim.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Pirate_Fancy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and spikes; colour 1 on the round recessed dimples; colour 3 on the toothed trim along the lower rim.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Power_02.description: A rounded, domed shoulder pauldron for the right shoulder: a large peaked cap panel with a rolled edge sits over a lower cup that wraps the upper arm, with a hollow open underside toward the neck.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Power_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper domed cap panel; colour 1 on the lower cup section beneath the cap.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Prisonguard_01.description: A sleek angular shoulder pad for the right shoulder: a wedge-shaped contrasting shell with a bevelled light rim, tall raised fin-like panels on top, and a small slot detail on the outer face. Sci-fi armoured look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Prisonguard_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bevelled rim edging; colour 1 on the inset top panels; colour 2 on the main shell; colour 3 on the small slot accents.
