Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Prisonguard_01.differs: The male pad rises higher into a tall raised fin with tall panels, rather than lying flat and wide across the shoulder like the female pad.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Psiagent_01.description: A thin, flat shoulder cover for the right shoulder made of two or three overlapping rectangular panels with small gaps between them, curving over the shoulder like a stiff mantle. It has a veined, cracked surface texture and suggests a light sci-fi agent look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Psiagent_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the panels; the veined pattern appears to take the same light colour across the whole piece, with a faint hint of colour 3 near the neck edge.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Psineophyte_01.description: A right shoulder cap made of two stepped, angular plates with a narrow gap between them, covering the top of the shoulder and upper arm. Its surface is patterned with fine vein-like or circuit-like lines, giving a sci-fi psionic look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Psineophyte_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole shoulder plate surface and its vein pattern; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Psislicer_01.description: A single right-shoulder accessory: a small faceted disc sits on top of the shoulder and sweeps up into a tall, curved, blade-like spike of thin webbed, crystalline-looking material. Suggests a psychic energy shard.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Psislicer_01.colourAreas: The default material appears to ignore the colour scheme, showing a glowing translucent finish across the disc and spike; no visible use of colour slots 0-3.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Psislicer_01.differs: The male spike is taller and narrower, with a smoother edge, and stands more upright above the disc.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Punk_01.description: A round, shallow dish-shaped mechanical shoulder pad on the right shoulder, tilted outward, with a patchwork of panels, angular plates and a small spike on the face, and a rim around the edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Punk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the rim and the panel surface; colour 1 on the inner panel sections and rim accents; colour 2 on the panel patches; colour 3 on the small markings.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Punk_01.differs: The male version has a patchwork of angular panels and a small spike instead of the female's clean radial-finned turbine face.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.description: A small right shoulder piece shaped like a rounded, pebbled shell cap with a flared, folded edge and a hollow underside. It sits on top of the shoulder as a partial cover, with an alien, armor-like look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the textured main shell; colour 1 on the folded rim and edge panels.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_01.differs: The male version is a larger, bulkier shell that wraps further over the shoulder, with a broader flared rim.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.description: A single right pauldron: a rounded, segmented armor shell with a raised point at the back, a triangular chevron-patterned inset on the outer face and a soft, crumpled lining that frames the inner edge and hangs below.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main armor shell; colour 3 on the chevron inset on the outer face; colour 1 and colour 0 on the crumpled inner lining and edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_02.differs: The male pauldron sits lower and wider over the shoulder, with a shorter point and a lining that hangs below the shell.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.description: A single right shoulder guard: a rounded, segmented armor cap with a tall swept-back spike rising from the outer edge, grooved ridges along its length and a small angular inset panel on the side. Sci-fi alien styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main shell and spike; colour 3 on the inset side panel; colour 1 on the wide rim edging around the inner shoulder; colour 0 on highlights of the rim.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Armor_03.differs: The male version has a larger, more prominent trim rim that flares out around the top of the shoulder, with a shorter-looking spike.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Longshoulder_0.description: A tall, curved organic shoulder growth rising from the right shoulder like a tapering horn or tentacle, with banded ripples, a ruffled flared base and two sharp spikes at the tip, resting on a small rounded knob.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Longshoulder_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the banded body of the horn; colour 3 on the stripes and ruffled base edges; colour 1 on the thin ripple lines, the tip spike and the rounded knob at the base.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Shoulderbig_01.description: An elongated, streamlined shoulder guard of smooth plates that sweeps from the top of the right shoulder down over the upper arm, tapering to a pointed tip. It has a raised contrasting central ridge, thin seam lines and a small round port, with a fin-like underlayer.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Shoulderbig_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates; colour 2 on the raised ridge panel; colour 1 on the underlayer fins beneath the plates; colour 3 on the thin seam lines.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Spikeball_01.description: A right shoulder piece: a shallow rounded plate cap with small spines around its edge, topped by a glossy sphere and a long curved segmented horn sweeping up and outward. Organic alien look, worn on the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Qularr_Spikeball_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate and horn base; colour 3 on the horn bands and speckles on the plate; colour 1 on the small spines; colour 2 on the sphere.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A right shoulder cap: a rounded, shell-like pad with a contrasting inset panel on top and three slim raised bars arching across it, with a hollow, contrasting lining underneath. Suggests a sleek sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell; colour 1 on the inner lining and edge rim; colour 2 on the inset top panel; colour 3 on the raised bars.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The male version has three thinner bars across the top, while the female version has two thicker bars.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Redstone_01.description: A blocky angular right shoulder guard made of a tall slanted plate that rises above the shoulder, with a low box-like section along the outer arm and an open slot near the top. It has a mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Redstone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plates and raised fins; colour 1 on the edge trim and rim borders; colour 2 on the recessed slot.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Retroscifi_Coils_01.description: A right shoulder piece: a domed cap of stacked, ribbed segments sits on the shoulder, with a large curved ring-shaped fin rising behind and above it. Retro sci-fi look with a thin contrasting inner edge.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Retroscifi_Coils_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed dome segments; colour 0 on the inner face of the arc and the underside; colour 2 on the outer arc; colour 3 on the thin piping along the arc.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ribbon_01.description: A shoulder ornament of three long tapering ribbons that rise from a small flower-shaped rosette on the right shoulder, arch up and back over it, then trail down behind the body to below the waist.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ribbon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper part of the ribbons; colour 1 on the lower ribbon tips and the rosette petals; colour 3 on the rosette centre; colour 2 on the rosette base.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Rings_01.description: A shoulder ornament of three thin, open-centred curved rings fanned out from a single point on the shoulder, like stacked flared blades. It sits on the outer shoulder and gives a sleek, mechanical superhero look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Rings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all three rings; the small mounting points at the shoulder take colour 2.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Rings_01.differs: The rings are larger and spread wider, with one ring standing more upright and a flat thin edge projecting outward, and they are fitted to the right shoulder.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_02.description: A mechanical right-shoulder cap of segmented armor plating, with looping thick cables arching over the top and clusters of short bolt-like connector nubs sprouting from it. Cyberpunk implant look, sitting on the shoulder only.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap plating; colour 2 on the armor segments and the looping cables; colour 1 on the connector nubs and cylinders; colour 3 on the small centre lights in the connectors.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_02.differs: The male version has a larger contrasting armored block on the front of the shoulder and more nubs spread around the rim, without the forward cylinder.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.description: Cybernetic implant on the right shoulder: segmented flexible hoses arch in wide, layered loops over the shoulder, ending in small hexagonal connector caps, some with pointed tips. A partial mechanical accent in a sci-fi or cyberpunk style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the segmented hoses; colour 1 on the hexagonal connector caps and pointed tips.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Ripper_Hoses_01.differs: The male hoses arch in wider, taller loops with smaller connector caps, and one cap has a pointed tip.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Robot_Shoulder_01.description: A right-shoulder mecha pauldron: an angular wedge-shaped armour block with a tall pointed fin at the back, a round mechanical socket at the outer side, a contrasting handle-like bracket on top, and swept blade-like spikes trailing behind.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Robot_Shoulder_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main armour plates; colour 1 on the trailing spikes and fins; colour 2 on the top bracket and socket housing; colour 3 on the small studs and the socket centre.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.description: A single shoulder guard of stacked, angular segmented plates that curve upward into a tall horn-like crest at the front and back, with lamellar layers stepping down over the upper arm. Samurai-inspired and mechanical.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Robotsamurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper crest and edge plates; colour 1 on the main lamellar plates; colour 2 on the curved band between the plates; colour 3 on small accent panels at the lower edge.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.description: A right shoulder cap with a domed, swirl-patterned gear-like surface edged by a thick rim, with long swept spikes fanning from the top and back and a round gem-like stud at the front edge. Mechanical, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the rim and the underside of the cap; colour 2 on the swirl panel; colour 0 on the spikes and gear-tooth details; colour 3 on the round stud.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_01.differs: The spikes fan upward and backward across the top of the shoulder, giving a more crown-like spread than the forward-pointing cluster on the female version.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_02.description: A sleek mechanical shoulder piece shaped like a small starship, with a vented housing, contrasting lens details and contrasting curved horn-like fins on top. Two long wide cloth panels hang from it, one over the chest and one down the back, to the calf.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and the hanging cloth panels; colour 1 on the underside panels and trim; colour 3 on the small round lights; colour 2 on the horn fins.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_02.differs: The male version has two wide cloth panels, one hanging at the front and one at the back, instead of a single narrow streamer.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.description: A right shoulder cap with a broad domed shell edged by a thick raised rim, decorated with a gear-and-spiral pattern. Blade-like spikes sweep up and outward along the top and back, with a round gem-like stud at the front.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer rim and the underside of the shell; colour 2 on the spiral-patterned shell surface; colour 0 on the spikes and gear teeth; colour 3 on the round stud.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_01.differs: The spikes rise along the top and back of the shoulder, while the female version's spikes fan forward and outward from the front.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.description: A mechanical right shoulder guard: a rounded, ridged armor shell with a finned vented underside, a round lens at the front and two curved horns sweeping up and back. Two long cloth streamers hang from it down the front and back of the body.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell plating and the hanging cloth streamers; colour 1 on the vented underside and lower shoulder plate; colour 2 on the horns; colour 3 on the round lens.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Roinesh_Reward_02.differs: The male version adds two long cloth streamers that hang from the shoulder down the front and back of the body, reaching about the knees.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Sacred_01.description: A single right shoulder piece shaped like a stylised fish or beast head with a large eye, striped crest and feathery fins, backed by a tall curved shield-like plate and studded with a diamond-shaped spiked ornament.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Sacred_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved back plate, the jaw and the eye surround; colour 1 on the head crest, stripes and fins; colour 2 on the diamond ornaments; colour 3 on the eye and the ornament centres.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_01.description: A curved, samurai-style shoulder plate for the right shoulder: a stiff arched shell with three raised ridges and thin piping, forming a hollow cap that sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate shell; colour 3 on the ridge lines across the plate; colour 1 on the edge trim; colour 2 on the hollow underside.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.description: A large samurai-style right shoulder guard: a swirl-patterned curved plate with jagged, horn-like upper points and a round cutout, edged in raised trim, with stacked lamellar plates stepping down the upper arm and a serrated flap at the front.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the raised edge trim and the serrated front flap; colour 1 on the thin inner border lines; colour 2 and colour 3 on the swirl-patterned main plate surfaces.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Samurai_Large_01.differs: The male version has a larger, taller front flap that rises up beside the neck.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Scales_01.description: A right shoulder guard of layered, overlapping segmented plates ending in pointed tips, framed by contrasting trim and small studs, over a contrasting underlayer cup. It caps the shoulder and sweeps down the upper arm like an insect shell.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Scales_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented scale plates; colour 1 on the framing trim and pointed edge strips; colour 3 on the small studs; colour 2 on the underlayer cup beneath the plates.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Scales_01.differs: The male version is larger and more cup-shaped, with a prominent contrasting underlayer and plates sweeping down over the upper arm.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.description: A thin, flat sci-fi shoulder plate for the right shoulder: a curved layered shell with a stepped, notched outer edge and a wide contrasting stripe across it. Sits on top of the shoulder like a light pauldron.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Scifi_Soldier_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the stepped outer rim and underside edge; colour 1 on the main shell; colour 2 on the wide stripe and inner underside; colour 3 on the small tab at the top and the underside ribs.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A right shoulder fin cluster of several curved, pointed blade-like spines fanning backward from the shoulder, each with a glossy inner panel and chevron-patterned outer edge; an aquatic, sci-fi ornamental shoulder accessory.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the smooth inner fin panels; colour 1 on the fin edges and outlines; colour 3 on the chevron stripes; colour 2 on the darker tips and recesses.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.description: A single-shoulder piece: a small angular armored shoulder cap with a long thorny spar arching up and back to a flared horn tip. Many thin, long tapering blades or strips fan down behind the body like a shredded cape.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hanging strips; colour 2 on the thorny spar and horn tip; colour 1 on the shoulder cap plates; colour 3 on small accents at the cap.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Shadow_Destroyer_01.differs: The male version is split into many thin separate hanging strips fanned out from the spar, rather than a solid draped cloth sheet.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Sharkfin_01.description: A right shoulder piece made of stacked, angular layered plates that sweep to a point like a shark fin, sitting over the top of the shoulder with an inner lining. Suggests a sleek mechanical superhero style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Sharkfin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the top plate and outer shell; colour 0 on the middle layered plate edges; colour 2 on the lower plates and upper fin panel; colour 3 on the inner lining.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Skull_01.description: A single right shoulder piece shaped like a jagged, cracked skull-cap with a tall ribbed fin rising from the top. A spiky, clawed rim of contrasting panels curls around the base, and a rounded dome sits beneath.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Skull_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull shell and fin; colour 1 on the spiky rim and claw-like blades; colour 3 on the rounded dome and the eye spots; colour 2 on the ribbed lines and edging.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Skull_02.description: A low-poly skull-shaped shoulder cap for the right shoulder, with hollow eye sockets facing outward, a faceted cranium, and a jagged contrasting rim with pointed jaw and teeth spikes hanging over the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Skull_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the skull surface; colour 1 on the rim and jagged edge trim; colour 3 on the small markings on the brow, forehead and nose.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Snake_01.description: A small right shoulder cap shaped like a serpent's head: a scaled rim surrounds a raised, textured centre with two slit eyes, and a bordering edge ends in two sharp fang-like spikes pointing down the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled rim; colour 1 on the outer border edge and fang spikes; colour 2 on the raised textured centre; colour 3 on the eyes and small markings.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Socrates_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the right shoulder with a hollow underside, a looping raised rim, a cross-shaped raised stripe on top and a pointed fin-like blade extending outward. Sleek superhero styling.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Socrates_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell and the pointed blade; colour 1 on the looping rim; colour 3 on the raised cross stripes; colour 2 on the inner underside.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Space_01.description: A futuristic right shoulder piece: a large glossy domed sphere like a space helmet, held in an angular faceted mount with a thin band and a small round stud, and a curved fin-like panel rising behind it.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the glossy dome (glassy default material); colour 2 on the angular mount and band; colour 1 on the curved rear panel; colour 3 on the small round stud.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.description: A small rounded shoulder cap with scuffed, streaked panels, topped by a curved thin bar carrying four arrow-like spikes that fan upward and outward from the shoulder. Mechanical superhero style.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap; colour 0 on the streaks and scuffs of the cap; colour 3 on the curved bar; colour 2 on the spikes.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_01.differs: The spikes are shorter and more compact, and the curved bar lies closer to the shoulder cap.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.description: A right shoulder piece with a small rounded, faceted cap and a tall curved blade-like fin rising above it. A row of four arrow-shaped spikes projects from the fin's outer face. Aggressive, armoured sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spike_Bars_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the curved fin; colour 1 on the faceted shoulder cap; colour 0 on small highlight facets of the cap; colour 2 on the arrow spikes.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_01.description: A small cluster of three short conical spikes studding the right shoulder, pointing outward and slightly forward and back from the top of the shoulder. A minimal, aggressive accent for punk or armored looks.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on all the spikes; the other colour slots are not visible on this piece.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_01.description: A cluster of curved horn-like spikes sprouting from the right shoulder: one tall main spike sweeps upward from a short banded base, with smaller spikes angling outward and down around it. Suggests a monstrous, armored look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Meandering_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the main spike; colour 1 on the spike tips and the smaller spikes; colour 3 on the band at the base.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.description: A small right-shoulder ornament: a stout, ridged cone-shaped spike jutting outward from the shoulder, ringed by several smaller separate spikes scattered around it. Suits a spiky superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cone and the small spikes; colour 1 on the base tips and edges of the spikes.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Stout_01.differs: Its large cone sweeps back along the shoulder, and the small spikes cluster closer to the top of the shoulder.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.description: A cluster of four curved, segmented horn-like spikes sprouting from the right shoulder, one large central spike sweeping upward with smaller ones fanning out around it, each ringed by a contrasting base band.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented spike bodies; colour 1 on the spike tips as a gradient; colour 3 on the base bands at the root of each spike.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikes_Thick_01.differs: The male version has its spikes grouped more tightly and upright, with the largest spike closer to the centre and the smaller spikes packed around its base.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikysuit_01.description: A right shoulder piece made of a fan of ribbed, bone-like plates that taper into pointed tips and drape over the top and front of the shoulder. Suggests an organic, monstrous armor.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Spikysuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plate surfaces and pointed tips; colour 1 on the ridged bands running across each plate.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.description: A mechanical single shoulder guard: a wide, angular plated cap with pointed front and rear edges, slanted grooves across the top, small round studs, and a tall curved horn-like spike rising from the inner edge near the neck.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Steelarachnid_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main plating; colour 1 on the slanted groove inserts; colour 2 on the edge trim, spike and base; colour 3 on the small round dots.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_0.description: A domed, cap-like shoulder guard with a raised rim and a thin inset line, fitted over the right shoulder. A round gem-like boss on the front holds a swept row of long contrasting feather blades pointing outward.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Steelhawk_Feathered_0.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the dome of the guard and the mount around the boss; colour 1 on the rim edging and inset line; colour 3 on the round boss; colour 2 on the feather blades.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A single right shoulder piece: a smooth, layered cap that curves over the shoulder, with a glossy horn-like blade sweeping up and back from its upper edge. Stacked bands give it a sleek, symbiote-like look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shoulder cap; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 2 on the glossy swept-back blade along the top.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Techsphere_01.description: A large rounded spherical shoulder pod that sits over the right shoulder like an oversized orb, with jagged outlined seams, a recessed round lens-like disc on the outer face and small raised dots across the shell.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Techsphere_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main shell; colour 1 on the recessed circular disc; colour 3 on the small raised dots; colour 2 on the seam outlines and edging.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Teeth_01.description: A right-shoulder cluster of long, tapering curved spines rising from a thin curved base strip on top of the shoulder. It reads as a tribal, claw-like spiked shoulder accent.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Teeth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thin base strip along the shoulder; colour 2 on the main body of the spines; colour 1 on the spine tips.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Teeth_01.differs: The spines are shorter and stand more upright, pointing up and outward from the shoulder top rather than sweeping flat to the side.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Tigon_01.description: A small fitted shoulder cap for the right shoulder, a rounded hollow shell with a raised rim at the neck side, built from stacked bands of contrasting panels. Sits snug over the shoulder like a sleek jacket shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Tigon_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the raised upper rim; colour 1 on the middle band; colour 3 on the outer side panel; colour 0 on the lower panel.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Tire_01.description: A single right shoulder guard made of a chunky, segmented half-ring of blocky panels that arches over the shoulder, with a small perforated, fin-like piece hanging from the underside. Mechanical, industrial look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Tire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented shoulder blocks; colour 3 on the worn, splattered marks across them; colour 1 on the perforated fin piece underneath.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Tire_02.description: A chunky segmented shoulder guard shaped like a section of tyre tread, forming a curved open-bottomed cap over the right shoulder with blocky faceted tread pieces and rough worn edges. Suits a scrappy post-apocalyptic look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Tire_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tread blocks; colour 3 on the splattered markings across the surface; the inner underside follows colour 0.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Toy_01.description: A small right shoulder plate shaped like a shield, folded into a peaked ridge over the shoulder, with a raised rim of contrasting trim around a padded panel and a glossy dome button on top. Retro toy-like.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Toy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main padded panel; colour 0 on the rim trim; colour 2 on the button base ring; colour 3 on the dome button.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Toy_01.differs: The male plate is a flatter, folded wedge with a ridge that hangs over the upper arm, rather than a rounded domed cap.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Victory_01.description: A single right shoulder guard shaped like a curved, sweeping fin or wing: a smooth dished plate with a raised outer edge, layered stripes along the rim and a small round pivot at the tip. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Victory_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main inner plate; colour 2 on the outer rim and edge shell; colour 3 on the stripe below the plate; colour 1 on the thin lower stripe.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Vikorin_01.description: A mechanical shoulder piece: a wedge-shaped plate with a contrasting inner panel and thin piping, wrapped by flat angular struts that arch over the shoulder and branch out like spider legs, with small slotted marks.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Vikorin_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the struts and outer frame; colour 0 on the wedge's inner panel; colour 3 on the thin piping lines; colour 2 on the small slots and marks.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Vikorin_01.differs: The male version's struts arch over and hug the top of the shoulder, forming a more closed canopy.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Vine_01.description: A right-shoulder ornament of organic, tentacle-like vine shapes: a broad swirl-patterned base sprouting several curling, pointed tendrils that sweep outward and curl up above and around the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Vine_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main vine body; colour 0 on the swirl markings; colour 3 on the pointed tendril tips and thin streaks along the tendrils.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Viper_01.description: A small rounded shoulder plate for the right shoulder: a shallow hollow cap with a wide raised central stripe bordered by thin contrasting piping, sitting over the top of the shoulder as a partial superhero pad.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Viper_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer side bands of the cap; colour 1 on the central stripe; colour 3 on the thin piping beside the stripe; colour 2 on the inner and rear shell of the plate.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Viperps_01.description: A bulky mechanical shoulder guard shaped like an angular vented housing, with a contrasting-trim frame, recessed contrasting vent panels, slim striped slots and two round nozzle caps on the front. A stepped lower flange extends over the upper arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Viperps_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main housing and lower flange plates; colour 1 on the outer frame and edging; colour 2 on the vent recesses and nozzle caps; colour 3 on the thin accent stripes.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Wildfur_01.description: A shoulder piece of layered, overlapping fur tufts with swept, pointed tips, forming a wedge that caps the right shoulder and upper arm. It has a smooth backing on the inner side and a wild, feral look.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Wildfur_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fur layers and inner backing; colour 1 on the streaks within the tufts; colour 2 on the darkened pointed tips.

Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Wolf_01.description: A right shoulder cap shaped like a curved shell, with a hollow underside and a layered flared lower edge. Swirling engraved scrollwork runs along the lower tier, and contrasting trim outlines each edge. Suggests fantasy armour.
Male/M_Spadr_Tight_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main shell; colour 3 on the edge trim; colour 0 on the lower tier and the inner lining; colour 2 on the scroll engraving.

Male/M_Spadr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A domed, rounded shoulder cap for the right shoulder, made of a dented, worn shell with a hexagonal panel and a bordered stripe on top, and small rectangular studs along the sides. It has a mechanical, industrial look.
Male/M_Spadr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main shell; colour 0 on the hexagonal panel, the outline stripe and the small side studs; colour 2 on the thin line details inside the panel.

Male/M_Spadr_Traveler_01.description: A small curved shoulder cap for the right shoulder: a rounded, cloth-like shell with a raised upper flap over a lower panel, edged in contrasting trim and fastened with small snap buttons. Sits on top of the shoulder.
Male/M_Spadr_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper flap; colour 1 on the lower panel; colour 2 on the edge trim; colour 3 on the button studs.

Male/M_Spadr_Variablerobot_01.description: A boxy mechanical shoulder pod that sits on the right shoulder, with a chunky angular housing, two round dial-like fittings on the outer face, and a slatted vent panel set into a flat backing plate.
Male/M_Spadr_Variablerobot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main housing; colour 2 on the flat backing plate and frame; colour 3 on the vent slats inside the panel; colour 0 on the round dial fittings.

Male/M_Spadr_Warrior_01.description: A right shoulder guard made of two overlapping angular plates with ridged, grooved surfaces and a raised contrasting rim, sitting on top of the shoulder and held by loose straps with small ring fittings.
Male/M_Spadr_Warrior_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged plate surfaces; colour 1 on the inset rounded patches; colour 3 on the plate rims and ring fittings; colour 2 on the straps.

Male/M_Spadr_Wires_01.description: A single right shoulder guard made of a curved outer plate with a jagged, notched crescent wrapping the front and back of the upper arm, ending in angular lower tips with small studs. Sits over the shoulder and upper arm.
Male/M_Spadr_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the outer curved plate; colour 0 on the crescent wings; colour 2 on the lower edge tips; colour 3 on the small studs.

Male/M_Tail_Child_Tight_Phoenix_02.description: Three long, slender tail feathers that fan out from the base of the spine and trail down past the knees, each tapering from a thin shaft to a barbed, leaf-shaped tip with a glossy inset centre.
Male/M_Tail_Child_Tight_Phoenix_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper shafts near the base; colour 1 on the lower shafts; colour 2 on the barbed feather tips; colour 3 on the inset centre of each tip.

Male/M_Tail_Child_Tight_Phoenix_03.description: Four long, thin feather-like tail streamers fanning out from the base of the spine, two to each side, each ending in a jagged, barbed plume tip with a glossy teardrop centre. Hangs to roughly the knees or below.
Male/M_Tail_Child_Tight_Phoenix_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the streamer roots near the waist; colour 1 on the long streamer shafts; colour 2 on the barbed plume edges; colour 3 on the teardrop centres of the plumes.

Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Amazon_01.description: Three narrow hanging cloth tabs with pointed, leaf-shaped tips, worn at the hips and hanging to mid-thigh. Each tab has embroidered scroll motifs and vertical lines, suggesting an ancient warrior loincloth.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Amazon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth of the tabs; colour 1 on the edge outline and the leaf-shaped tips; colour 3 on the vertical lines and scroll embroidery.

Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Amazon_02.description: A short rectangular cloth drape hanging from the lower back down the upper thighs, with swirling scrollwork at the top, a bold chevron band in the middle and curling flame-like scrolls along the hem. Reads as an amazon-style tabard.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Amazon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth; colour 1 on the scrollwork at the top; colour 2 on the chevron band; colour 3 on the curling hem scrolls.

Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Cores_02.description: A trailing string of small glowing ring-shaped cores that starts at the lower back and curves down and outward to one side, growing larger toward the end; a tiny energy tail with no solid body.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Cores_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the glowing rings; the glowing energy ignores the other colour slots.

Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Cyberwire_01.description: A rear tail-skirt of long, narrow tapering strips that hang from the lower back to about mid-thigh or knee, with jagged pointed ends and thin contrasting edging. It gives a slashed, cybernetic-cloth look.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Cyberwire_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper strips and main body of the panels; colour 1 on the lower strip faces; colour 3 on the edging along the strip borders.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Cyberwire_01.differs: The male version is wider and hangs lower, wrapping farther around the hips, and has a small angular plate at the top centre of the back.

Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A single fin-like tail piece worn along the side of the lower back and hip: a ribbed fan with jagged, spiky edges and a tall pointed tip at the top, tapering to the hip. Suggests a sea-creature or monstrous look.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed fan surface; colour 1 on the outer edging and border lines; colour 2 on the inner panel; colour 3 on the zigzag markings along the centre.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_01.differs: The male fin hugs the body closer and is narrower, lying along the back of the hip rather than flaring out to the side.

Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_02.description: A sea-creature tail accessory of thin, swept-back fin blades: a broad finned wedge with sharp pointed tips hangs at one hip, with a long narrow spike extending outward. Looks like a stylised aquatic fin or tail.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fin membranes; colour 1 on the outlines and ribbing; colour 2 on the darker fin panels; colour 3 on the small markings along the ribs.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_02.differs: The male version sits higher at the hip, with the fin held closer to the body.

Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_03.description: A pair of thin, blade-like fin panels hanging at the hips and rear, ribbed with vertical stripes and edged with a contrasting border. They taper to sharp points and sweep outward like sea-creature fins.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed stripes of the fins; colour 1 on the edge borders; colour 2 on the inner panels; colour 3 on the zigzag markings.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_03.differs: The male fins are two similar, mirrored panels sweeping out from each hip, rather than one large and one small.

Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_04.description: A set of separate, detached fin-like blades floating around the hips and rear: a large spiny dorsal fin with ribbed membrane, plus smaller pointed fins angled outward. Suggests an aquatic monster or creature look.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed fin membranes; colour 1 on the fin edges and spines; colour 3 on the accents between the ribs; colour 2 on the darkest fin tips.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_04.differs: The male version has its fins grouped closer to the back, with the large fin rising higher up the spine.

Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_05.description: A set of sharp, fin-like rear accessories: a tall dorsal fin rising along the lower back with smaller pointed fins flaring out from each hip, ribbed with spiny edges. Suggests a sea-creature or monstrous look.
Male/M_Tail_Extra_Tight_Seacreature_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed fin membranes; colour 1 on the fin edges and spines; colour 2 on the darker fin bases; colour 3 on the accent markings between the ribs.

Male/M_Tail_Foxbatcon_2025_02.description: A long, thick amphibian-style tail with a rounded blunt base at the hips, tapering to a curved tip. A frilly, feathery fin fringe runs along its upper edge and it has a speckled surface.
Male/M_Tail_Foxbatcon_2025_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main tail body with speckles; colour 2 on the rounded base cap; colour 1 on the inner fin ridge; colour 3 on the frilly fin edges.

Male/M_Tail_Kaiju_01.description: A thick, tapering monster tail that attaches at the lower back with a rounded base plate. Rows of curved horn-like spines and small spikes run along its length, and it sweeps out to a pointed tip.
Male/M_Tail_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the base plate and the small spikes along the top; colour 1 on the underside of the tail; colour 2 on the large curved horns; colour 0 on the plates between the horns.
Male/M_Tail_Kaiju_01.differs: The male tail sticks out more horizontally with a longer, gentler sweep, and it has a smaller base plate.

Male/M_Tail_Peacock_Base_01.description: A fan of long peacock tail feathers attached at a small patch on the lower back, with thin contrasting quills sweeping down and out into large eyed feather tips that spread wide and reach below the knees.
Male/M_Tail_Peacock_Base_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the quills and upper feather shafts; colour 1 on the feather vanes; colour 3 on the eye spots; colour 2 on the feather edges and the base patch.
Male/M_Tail_Peacock_Base_01.differs: The male tail splits into two main feather bundles that sweep out to either side of the legs, with no central cluster.

Male/M_Tail_Starowl_01.description: A skirt-like rear piece made of layered, feather-shaped panels with pointed tips, hanging from the waist to about the knees. It wraps around the hips, open at the front, giving a owl-wing fantasy look.
Male/M_Tail_Starowl_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main panel surfaces; colour 2 on the chevron bands and outer edges of each feather; colour 3 on the thin edge piping.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Alien_01.description: A segmented, jointed tail that projects from the lower back and sweeps downward and out, splitting near the end into two clawed prongs with pointed tips. Mechanical, insectoid look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Alien_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the jointed upper segments; colour 1 on the forked lower prongs; colour 2 on the joint bands; colour 3 on the pointed claw tips.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Bird_01.description: A short skirt-like tail of overlapping layered feathers hanging from the waist at the rear and wrapping round the hips, with ragged pointed feather tips along the hem. Suggests a bird-like costume.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Bird_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer feathers at the back and their spots; colour 1 on the top band and the spots and tips of the feathers; colour 3 on the inner feather layer seen at the front.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Bird_01.differs: The male version sits mostly behind the hips and is shorter, with less wrap toward the front than the female version.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A feathered skirt-like tail piece of overlapping layered feathers sitting at the hips, short in front and fuller at the back, ending in pointed tips around mid-thigh. Suggests a bird-person costume.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scale-like feathers at the back; colour 1 on the long outer feathers and front feathers; colour 2 on the shadowed underlayer; colour 3 on the waistband edge.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Bunny_01.description: A small rounded bunny tail: a puffy, faceted low-poly ball with creased tuft-like folds that gathers to a point, sitting on the lower back at the tailbone.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Bunny_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper and outer puff; colour 1 on the lower and back part of the puff, fading in as a gradient.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Cat_01.description: A slender, tube-like cat tail that rises from the base of the spine, arcs out behind the hips and trails down and outward with a gentle S-curve, tapering slightly. Animal-inspired and minimal.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Cat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on most of the tail; colour 1 fades in along the lower length toward the tip.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Cat_01.differs: This tail sweeps further out and to the side, ending around thigh height, while the female tail curls down closer to the legs.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A long, sinuous tail that starts as a thick ridged, muscular stalk at the lower back and curves outward and down into a large, swept-back tuft of layered feather-like strands with pointed tips.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the ridged tail stalk; colour 0 on the strands of the tuft; colour 1 on the spiky feather tips.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A long beast-like tail that grows from the base of the spine: a thick tapering fleshy stalk curving out and down, ending in a dense swept tuft of layered feather-like spiky fronds.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail stalk; colour 0 on the base of the tuft fronds; colour 1 on the pointed frond tips; the cut end at the base takes colour 0.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Chimera_02.differs: The tail projects more horizontally backward from the hips, with the tuft trailing out behind rather than hanging against the legs.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Devil_01.description: A slim, curving devil tail that springs from the base of the spine, extends outward in a long shallow S-curve, and ends in a flat arrowhead point. Playful demonic accessory.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Devil_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail's main surface and arrowhead; colour 2 on the underside shading of the tail.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Devil_01.differs: The male tail extends out farther to the side in a longer, shallower sweep rather than curling in a tight hook.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dino_01.description: A long, tapering reptilian tail that grows from the lower back and sweeps out and down to a curved point, with rows of sharp curved spines along its underside. Suggests a dinosaur or monster look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dino_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail body; colour 0 on the spines; colour 1 on the shaded underside. Small ring markers are scattered along the tail.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dino_02.description: A long, tapering reptilian tail that grows from the base of the spine and trails out behind in a gentle curve, lined with rows of sharp curved spikes and ending in a narrow pointed tip.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dino_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail body; colour 0 on the large spikes; colour 1 on the small studs along the tail and the shaded underside.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dino_02.differs: The male tail stretches out in a longer, flatter sweep that trails further to one side, while the female tail curls in a tighter, lower arc.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dino_03.description: A long tapering reptilian tail that emerges from the lower back and sweeps out and down to a curled point, with a row of sharp spikes along its top ridge. It suggests a dinosaur or lizard creature look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dino_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spikes; colour 1 on the underside of the tail; the upper tail body shows skin tone, so the default material seems to ignore the scheme.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dinosuit_01.description: A long tapering dinosaur-style tail that grows from the lower back and sweeps out behind in a gentle curve to a thin pointed tip. Pointed spikes run along the top ridge, giving a monstrous, beast-like look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dinosuit_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tail body; colour 2 on the row of spikes along the ridge.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Dinosuit_01.differs: The male tail extends further out behind the body in a flatter sweep, while the female tail curves more steeply downward.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Draco_01.description: A long segmented dragon tail that emerges from the lower back and sweeps out and down in a curve, tapering to a pointed blade-like tip. Rows of sharp spines run along the top, with contrasting underside ribbing.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main tail plates; colour 3 on the spines and the tip blade; colour 2 on the underside ribbing; colour 0 on the flat base where it joins the body.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Draco_02.description: A short, tapering dragon tail that sits at the base of the spine and curves down behind the hips to a point. It has a plated upper shell, a segmented underside and a row of spikes along the ridge, giving a mechanical, monstrous look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Draco_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper shell plates; colour 3 on the ridge spikes; colour 0 on the flat cap where the tail joins the body; colour 2 on the segmented underside bands.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Feathers_01.description: A pair of long, whip-like feathered tails springing from the lower back and sweeping outward and down past the hips, each with a slender spine, serrated feather edges and a curled eye-marked feather tip.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Feathers_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather blades near the base; colour 2 on the thin spines; colour 0 on the fringe along the edges; colour 3 on the curled eye-patterned tips.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fin_01.description: A single curved tail that sweeps out from the lower back and tapers to a thin hooked tip, with a ridge of spiky, webbed fin spines along its upper edge. Suggests a monstrous or aquatic creature look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fin_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the smooth tail body; colour 2 on the underside shading and fin ridge edges; colour 0 and colour 1 on the webbed fin membrane between the spines.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fin_01.differs: The male tail is longer and thinner, trailing low and far behind the body in a long swept curve. The female tail is shorter and thicker, with a tighter downward curl.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fin_02.description: A thick, tapering tail that sweeps out from the lower back and trails to a long point, with a row of spiny, membranous fins along its upper ridge. Suggests a monstrous, aquatic or demonic creature look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fin_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fin ribs and membranes; colour 1 on the underside of the tail; colour 2 on the fin webbing; colour 3 on the main tail body.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fin_02.differs: The male tail is longer and more slender, trailing out in a gentler curve, while the female tail is thicker and hooks tighter at the tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Finduolarge_01_1.description: A large fish-like tail attached at the lower back: a thick tapering tail curving down and outward, flanked by two sets of spined, webbed fins that fan out sideways. Suggests an aquatic or monstrous creature look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Finduolarge_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail body and fin spines; colour 0 on the webbed fin membranes; colour 2 on the inner fin panels; colour 1 as a tint on the underside of the tail.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Finlarge_01.description: A large fin-shaped tail worn at the lower back: a thick curved tapering tail sweeps back and down, topped by a webbed fin membrane held up by several curved spines. Aquatic, monstrous look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Finlarge_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail body and the spines; colour 0 and colour 2 on the webbed fin membrane; colour 1 on small speckles and the underside shading.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Finlarge_01.differs: The male tail sweeps out more horizontally and straight behind the body, with a longer, flatter trailing tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fluffy_01.description: A large, plump fluffy tail shaped like a rounded teardrop, attached at the lower back and projecting outward and backward with a tapering tip. Its furry surface suggests a playful animal or beast style.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fluffy_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the fur over most of the tail; colour 0 on the fur toward the base; colour 2 on the tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fox_01.description: A short, plump fox tail growing from the lower back and angling down and to one side, tapering to a blunt point at the base with a ragged, jagged-edged tip. Soft fluffy, animal styling.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fox_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the tail; colour 0 fading in toward the base end; colour 3 on the jagged tip fur.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fox_02.description: A large, bushy fox-style tail with a tapered tip, shaggy tufted fur and a soft gradient along its length. It sprouts from the lower back, sweeps out behind and hangs down beside the hip.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Fox_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the tail fur; colour 0 on the tapered tip; colour 2 on the base near the body, blended in a gradient.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_01.description: A single large, bushy fox-style tail with a teardrop shape and textured fur strands, attached at the hip and sweeping down and back, ending in a curled upturned tip. Suggests a kitsune or beast look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base of the tail fur; colour 1 on the lower fur and curled tip, blending as a gradient from base to tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_02.description: A set of three large, fluffy fox tails fanning out from the lower back and sweeping down and outward past the hips, each with a curled, pointed tip. Fur is layered and feathery, giving a kitsune-inspired fantasy look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur near the base of the tails; colour 1 on the fur toward the tips, blending from base to tip; colour 2 on the small central hub where the tails join.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_03.description: A set of three large, fluffy fox tails fanning out from the lower back, one hanging down the centre and two sweeping outward and down to each side. Each tail is thick and furry with a tapered, contrasting tip.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Kitsune_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur near the base of the tails; colour 1 on the mid-length fur; colour 2 on the tail tips.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Krampus_01.description: A slim, tapering monster tail that projects from the lower back and hangs down and to the side, ending in a shaggy tuft with a small contrasting claw-like tip. It suggests a beastly, demonic look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Krampus_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shaggy tuft and the base band; colour 2 on the middle of the tail; colour 3 on the upper stem; colour 0 on the claw tip.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Krampus_01.differs: The male tail is shorter and hangs closer to the body, with a straighter stem.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Leopard_01.description: A thick, tubular leopard tail with a spotted pattern, emerging from the lower back, curving down and sweeping out behind before hooking upward into a rounded tip. Suggests a feline, beastlike look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Leopard_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main tail body; colour 1 on the spots and the rounded tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Lion_01.description: A slim, smooth lion tail that springs from the lower back, arcs out and down in a gentle curve, and ends in a tufted fur brush. A playful animal-costume accessory.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Lion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the tail shaft; colour 1 on the tuft; colour 3 on the tuft tips and underside.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Lizard_01.description: A smooth lizard-style tail that starts at the base of the spine and sweeps out behind the hips, tapering along a gentle curve to a fine pointed tip. Small ring-shaped pieces float near the tail.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Lizard_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail and on the small floating rings; colour 1 shading along the underside of the tail.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Lizard_01.differs: The male tail extends further out horizontally and comes with small floating rings around it, while the female tail curls down toward the legs and has no rings.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Megaterak_01.description: A mechanical segmented tail that starts at the base of the spine and tapers down the back of the legs to a pointed barbed tip, built from armoured plates with ribbed spines along each side.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Megaterak_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the plate frames and rib spines; colour 1 on the inset panels of each segment; colour 2 on the base housing and joints; colour 3 on small accents at the base.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Otter_01.description: A thick, tapering animal tail with an open rounded base at the tailbone that curves down and outward to a pointed tip. Banded stripes wrap around it. Suits beast, animal or creature costumes.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Otter_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the main tail body; colour 1 on the stripe bands wrapping around it.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Peacock_01.description: A fan of long peacock tail feathers that sprouts from the lower back and sweeps down and outward behind the legs, fading from thin contrasting quills to broad eyed feather tips. It forms two large sweeping plume clusters, suiting a fantasy or beast look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Peacock_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper quills and the fade at the feather bases; colour 1 on the broad feather vanes; colour 3 on the eye markings near the tips; colour 2 on the feather edges.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Peacock_01.differs: The male tail splits into two large plume clusters, one on each side, rather than a single even fan.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Phoenix_01.description: A fan of long feathered tail plumes attached at the lower back and sweeping down to about knee level. Each plume has a fluffy fringed base, a thin tapering shaft and a spiky, pointed gem-like tip. Suggests a phoenix or firebird look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Phoenix_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fluffy feather bases; colour 1 on the long shafts and the feather fringes; colour 2 on the spiky tip casings; colour 3 on the inset tip gems.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Phoenix_02.description: A fan of seven long, slender feather-like tail plumes radiating from the lower back and sweeping down past the knees, each ending in a spiky, barbed leaf-shaped tip with a glossy central gem-like panel.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Phoenix_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the root where the plumes gather and the top of each shaft; colour 1 on the long shafts; colour 2 on the spiky barbed tips; colour 3 on the central panel of each tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Pig_01.description: A short curly pig tail: a thin, tapering furry tail that loops once in a tight curl and ends in a cut stub at the base. It sits low on the back at the hip, a playful beast-like accessory.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Pig_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the furry tip and upper part of the tail; colour 3 on the looped base section and stub.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Pony_01.description: A full, bushy pony-style tail that starts at the small of the back and sweeps down and back in fluted, streaky strands, ending in several jagged, pointed tufts. Fantasy creature look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Pony_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the tail; colour 1 on the root where it attaches; colour 2 on the shaded streaks through the middle; colour 3 on the pointed tips.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Pony_02.description: A large, bushy pony-style tail of layered, swooping locks that sweeps out and back from the lower back and tapers to a point, with jagged tufts along the top and pointed tips at the bottom.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Pony_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the locks; colour 1 on the lower tips and edges of the locks; colour 2 on the jagged upper tufts; colour 3 on the pointed tip where the tail meets the body.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Rat_01.description: A long, bare rat-style tail that starts at the base of the spine, extends out behind the body in a shallow curve, and tapers to a thin point. Fine ridged texture suggests skin segments.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Rat_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail, with faint colour 1 shading in the ridges.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Rat_01.differs: The male tail trails out straighter and flatter behind the body, without the female version's tight curl at the tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Rattlesnake_01.description: A long, tapering snake-like tail that extends out and back from the lower back, with a hollow open base and a segmented rattle tip at the far end. Suggests a beastly or monstrous creature costume.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Rattlesnake_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper base of the tail; colour 1 on the tapering lower length; colour 2 on the rattle segments.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Rattlesnake_01.differs: The male tail sweeps out more horizontally, with the rattle held farther from the body and lower on the hip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Retro_01.description: A slender, flexible tail that springs from the base of the spine and curves down and back, ending in a stack of three tapering segmented cones that form a pointed, stinger-like tip. Suggests a retro mechanical or monstrous look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Retro_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail cord; colour 0 on the cone segments of the tip; colour 2 on the joint rings between segments; colour 1 on a thin inner stripe along the cord.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Retro_01.differs: The tail cord reads mostly as colour 3 with a colour 1 stripe along its underside, more strongly two-toned than on the female version.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Scorpion_01.description: A segmented scorpion tail rising from a flared cup at the lower back, arching up over the shoulder with rounded plated segments and ending in a pair of pincer-like bulbs with a curved contrasting stinger.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Scorpion_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the lower rounded tail segments; colour 1 on the upper segments and terminal bulbs; colour 2 on the stinger; colour 3 on the base cup.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Seacreature_01.description: A thick scaly fish-like tail that leaves the lower back and sweeps out and down, ending in several spread, pointed fins with a tall ridged dorsal fin above. Fantasy sea-creature look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Seacreature_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the scaled tail body and fin ribs; colour 1 on the fin edges and membrane; colour 2 and colour 3 on the inner fin markings.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Seacreature_01.differs: The male tail ends in several widely spread pointed fins with long trailing tips, instead of the female's single swept tail fin.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Shark_01.description: A shark tail worn at the lower back: a thin, sweeping fin-like shape that trails backward and down from the hips, with a pointed upper tip, a broad curved lower lobe and a small secondary fin near the base.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Shark_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole tail, with no visible contrast on other slots.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Skeleton_01.description: A skeletal spine-like tail of stacked vertebrae with short rib-like spurs, thick at the base over the lower back and tapering to a thin whip-like tip that trails out behind the body.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vertebrae and spurs; colour 1 on the inner joints and connecting sections; colour 2 and colour 3 not clearly visible.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Skeleton_01.differs: The male tail sweeps out more horizontally and to the side, rather than hanging down behind the legs.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Snake_01.description: A long, tapering serpent tail that sprouts from the lower back and trails down and outward, with a ridge of overlapping spiky plates along the top, a segmented underside and a thin pointed tip.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Snake_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the spiny dorsal plates; colour 0 on the scaly side bands and edge; colour 2 on the underside and the open base.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Snake_01.differs: The tail trails out in a longer, flatter sweep with a gentler curve and a more pointed tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Squirrel_01.description: A large bushy squirrel tail with streaked, fur-like strands. It rises from the lower back, curls up and over in an S-curve, and tapers to a point that hangs down the back. Suggests an animal costume.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Squirrel_01.colourAreas: Colour 0, 1, 2 and 3 appear mixed together in streaks across the fur texture; no separate parts are visible.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Squirrel_02.description: A large bushy squirrel tail with streaky fur-like strands, rising from the lower back in a big S-curve up and over, with a ragged tufted tip. It sits behind the body and reaches above the shoulders.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Squirrel_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on most of the tail with streaks of colour 0 and colour 3 through the fur strands; colour 2 in the shadowed strands near the base.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_01.description: A long monstrous tail that extends from the lower back, curving down and outward. It has a ribbed, muscular body with a row of small spikes along the spine and ends in a large curved blade with small side claws.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ribbed upper ridge along the tail; colour 3 on the outer tail body and the segments near the tip; colour 1 on the spines; colour 2 on the curved blade and claws.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_02.description: A long, curving symbiote-style tail that starts at the lower back, sweeps out behind the body and tapers to a single hooked contrasting barb. A ridged, ribbed strip runs along its top over a smooth contrasting underside.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the ridged strip along the top; colour 3 on the tail body and underside; colour 2 on the hooked barb tip.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_02.differs: The male tail sits lower and stretches out in a flatter, wider sweep, with the barb curling up at the end.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_03.description: A long, thick, snaking monster tail that emerges from the lower back and sweeps outward, with a row of small jagged spikes along its upper ridge and a large curved blade-like barbed tip.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the tail body; colour 0 on the row of spikes along the ridge; colour 1 on the blade-like tip; colour 2 on the open cut end at the base.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Symbiote_03.differs: The male tail extends straighter and further out to the side, with a longer, flatter blade tip and less curl toward the hips.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Teddy_01.description: A small round fluffy pom-pom tail, like a cotton ball with a crinkled, tufted surface, sitting at the base of the spine on the lower back. Cute bunny-style rear accessory.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Teddy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fluffy surface, fading to colour 1 toward the top and back of the puff.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Werewolf_01.description: A large bushy werewolf tail of layered, shaggy fur tufts with sharp claw-like spikes along the edges. It sprouts from the lower back, sweeps down and out behind the legs, and tapers toward the base.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Werewolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper fur near the base; colour 0 on the lower shaggy tufts; colour 2 on the claw-like spikes; colour 3 on the tip at the root end.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Werewolf_01.differs: The male tail sits slightly higher and hangs a little more compactly than the female version.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_01.description: A short, bushy wolf tail attached at the lower back, built from low-poly, tapering tufts of fur that end in jagged, pointed tips and sweep back and down. Suggests a beastly, feral look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the main body of the tail fur; colour 3 on the base where it joins the body; colour 2 on the pointed tips of the tufts.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_02.description: A short furry canine tail that curves outward and downward from the base of the spine, with a hollow open stump at the root and a shaggy, pointed tip. Suits animal, beastly costumes.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fur near the base of the tail; colour 1 on the fur toward the tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_04.description: A bushy wolf tail with layered, shaggy fur tufts, tapering to a pointed tip at the front. It hangs from the lower back and curves around the hip, giving a beastly, animalistic look.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the fur along the lower edge; colour 1 on the upper fur tufts; colour 2 on the shaggy fur at the base end; colour 3 on the tip.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_05.description: A short, bushy wolf tail with a rounded furry base at the lower back that sweeps back and downward into jagged, tapered tufts ending in points. Reads as an animal costume accessory.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_05.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the fluffy fur at the base of the tail; colour 1 on the long tufts along the body of the tail; colour 3 on the underside at the root; colour 2 on the tips of the tufts.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_Armor_01.description: A tail shaped like a flat, curved steel blade with a hooked crescent notch and swept barbs, carrying swirling engraved scrollwork and a small clasp at the base. It hangs from the lower back, sweeping down and out behind the legs.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_Armor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade body; colour 3 on the engraved scrollwork; colour 1 on the small clasp at the base.

Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_Short_04.description: A short, bushy wolf tail made of layered fur tufts, tapering to a pointed tip, with small spikes along the top. It attaches at the base of the spine and angles backward and down, in a beastly style.
Male/M_Tail_Tight_Wolf_Short_04.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the base of the tail near the body; colour 1 on the main fur body and tufts; colour 2 on the tapered tip.

Male/M_Tail_Traveler_01.description: A rear-only cloth skirt panel hanging from the waist to about the calves, flat across the back with a pointed, curved hem. It has a contrasting central seam and edging, and leaves the front and sides open, like a long tail or half-robe.
Male/M_Tail_Traveler_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main cloth panel; colour 2 on the central strip and the edge trim.

Male/M_Tails_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A long, tapering dragon-like tail with a scaly textured upper surface and a smooth underside, edged with a row of feather-like fins along the spine. It juts out from the lower back and sweeps out and back in a gentle curve.
Male/M_Tails_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the scaled upper surface and end cap; colour 1 on the underside; colour 0 on the feathery spine fins.
Male/M_Tails_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.differs: The tail sweeps out more level and straight to the side, whereas the female tail curls in a tighter downward hook.

Male/M_Uarml_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single ribbed, segmented mechanical sleeve covering one arm from shoulder to wrist, with a large rigid hollow shoulder cup and tightly stacked rings along the tube-like arm. Retro robotic style.
Male/M_Uarml_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper sleeve rings, fading toward colour 0 near the wrist; colour 2 on the shoulder cup, with a thin rim of colour 0.
Male/M_Uarml_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.differs: The shoulder piece is a larger, bulkier cup with a rim, wrapping around the shoulder.

Male/M_Uarml_Arm_Insect_01.description: A single-arm mechanical armour sleeve covering the shoulder to the wrist: a domed shoulder cap, segmented upper arm with ribbed inset panels, a flared elbow guard, and a sleek plated forearm with small spike accents.
Male/M_Uarml_Arm_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap, elbow guard and outer plating; colour 1 on the ribbed inset panels; colour 2 on the side panels and joints; colour 3 on the small spikes and elbow gems.

Male/M_Uarml_Dryad_03.description: An asymmetric single-arm piece: a cluster of long, curved, claw-like glossy blades sweeping up and back over the shoulder, above a ribbed, petal-like fibrous sleeve that wraps the forearm. Organic, fantasy look.
Male/M_Uarml_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy shoulder blades; colour 0 on the ribbed forearm sleeve; colour 3 on the reddish veining marks in the sleeve.

Male/M_Uarml_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A single organic, vine-wrapped arm covering from shoulder to wrist: a veined, bark-like sleeve with a rounded shoulder cap, a broad flowing panel down the outer arm, and twisting tendrils coiling around the forearm.
Male/M_Uarml_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the veined arm sleeve and shoulder cap; colour 1 on the broad panel and some tendrils; colour 2 on the coiling tendrils; colour 3 on the thin vein markings.

Male/M_Uarml_Endo_01.description: A mechanical single-arm prosthetic covering the upper arm: a rounded shoulder cap with a swirl-disc housing, a striped cylindrical piston section, exposed rods with small bolts, and a contrasting forearm guard ending near the wrist.
Male/M_Uarml_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder cap, rings and rods; colour 0 on the housing plate and forearm guard; colour 3 on the stripes and disc swirl; colour 2 on the bolts and small joints.

Male/M_Uarml_Junkbot_Arm_01.description: A single mechanical right arm: a rounded armored shoulder cap, an upper arm with a caged work-light bulb on the front, a chunky joint, and an exposed piston-and-strut forearm. Junkyard robot style, worn over the arm only.
Male/M_Uarml_Junkbot_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and forearm plating; colour 1 on the upper arm shell and forearm pistons; colour 3 on the light bulb; colour 2 on the elbow joint and cage wires.

Male/M_Uarml_Junkbot_Arm_02.description: A mechanical single-arm piece: a cylindrical extinguisher-like canister upper arm with a jagged spiked shoulder plate, thin strap bands, a hex-nut joint at the elbow and a segmented plated forearm with a cable loop. Scrappy junkbot look.
Male/M_Uarml_Junkbot_Arm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the canister and forearm plates; colour 1 on the shoulder plate, bands and arm panels; colour 2 on the joints and forearm blocks; colour 3 on small accents and edge tabs.

Male/M_Uarml_Mecha_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style arm covering the left arm: a domed shoulder cap with a circular vent, segmented ribbed upper arm, ball-jointed elbow with a ribbed band, and a plated forearm ending at the wrist.
Male/M_Uarml_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the shoulder cap and segmented upper arm; colour 0 on the shoulder rim, forearm plates and lower arm; colour 1 on the elbow joint knobs; colour 3 on the shoulder ring and the ribbed band at the elbow.

Male/M_Uarml_Mecha_02.description: A mechanical single-arm armour sleeve on one arm only: a large flared shoulder guard with a rim, ribbed upper section, angular segmented plates, a bulbous elbow joint and ringed cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Uarml_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the angular arm plates and the large shoulder rim; colour 1 on the shoulder cap, ribbed joints, elbow and cuff rings; colour 3 on the small indicator light; colour 2 in the shoulder recess and gaps between segments.
Male/M_Uarml_Mecha_02.differs: The male version has a larger, flared shoulder guard with a wide contrasting rim and contrasting recess, bulkier than the female's smaller cap.

Male/M_Uarml_Mechanon_02.description: A single mechanical arm replacement with a large curved shoulder shield plate, exposed piston-like tubing and a jointed elbow, running down to a segmented armoured forearm with a contrasting cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Uarml_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder plate, tubing and elbow joint; colour 1 on the forearm and upper arm panels; colour 2 on the inner joints and wrist cuff; colour 3 on small accents near the shoulder and forearm.

Male/M_Uarml_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.description: A mechanical steampunk arm brace for one arm: a large boxy shoulder housing with a curved plate, flexible tubes and rods down the upper arm to a chunky bolted elbow ring, ending in a contrasting wrist cuff.
Male/M_Uarml_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder housing, rods and forearm casing; colour 1 on the tubes and rod segments; colour 3 on the elbow ring joint and bolts; colour 2 on the wrist cuff, cable and shoulder plate.
Male/M_Uarml_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.differs: The male version has a much larger, boxier shoulder housing with a contrasting curved plate and a chunkier elbow joint, and a looping cable.

Male/M_Uarml_Skeleton_02.description: A single mechanical skeletal arm overlay: slim bone-like rods run from a large rounded shoulder plate down past jointed elbow knobs to a narrow wrist band, worn over one arm of a bodysuit.
Male/M_Uarml_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone rods; colour 1 on the joint knobs at the shoulder and elbow; colour 2 on the shoulder plate and wrist band.
Male/M_Uarml_Skeleton_02.differs: The male version has a large rounded shoulder plate and a slimmer wrist band.

Male/M_Uarml_Skeleton_03.description: A single skeletal arm overlay: a long upper-arm bone and split forearm bones with knobbed joint ends at the shoulder and elbow, ending in a short wrist cuff. It lies over one sleeve and suggests a macabre, mechanical look.
Male/M_Uarml_Skeleton_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shafts; colour 1 on the joint ends at the shoulder and elbow; colour 2 on the wrist cuff.

Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A single-arm covering shaped like a gnarled twig: a large faceted, angular shoulder plate, a thin rim arching behind it, and a knotted, bark-like limb down to the wrist with small thorn-like spikes.
Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the branch-like arm and shoulder plate; colour 1 on the streaky patches along the arm; colour 2 on the inner faces of the shoulder plate.
Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The male version has a large faceted, angular shoulder plate, rather than the small rounded shoulder knob.

Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_03.description: A single-arm covering shaped like a rough wooden branch: a bark-textured sleeve from the shoulder to the wrist with a rounded stump cap at the shoulder, a joint break at the elbow and small twig spikes.
Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Snowman_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bark surface of the sleeve and shoulder cap; colour 1 on the streaky mottled markings along the arm; small twig spikes follow colour 0.

Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A mechanical single-arm cybernetic sleeve: a mesh-textured shoulder cap under a large curved armor loop, segmented plates down the upper arm and forearm, and exposed cable-like rods ending in a narrow cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mesh shoulder cap and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the armor plates and shoulder loop; colour 2 on the rods and inner mechanism; colour 3 on small accent marks.
Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The shoulder loop is larger and stands out farther from the shoulder, and small knobs stick out from the sides of the forearm plates.

Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.description: A single mechanical toy-like arm covering one arm only: a rounded shoulder cap with a thin rim, segmented upper arm and forearm, and a ball joint at the elbow, like a jointed doll or action figure limb.
Male/M_Uarml_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper arm, forearm and shoulder cap; colour 2 on the shoulder rim and joint gaps; colour 1 shows faintly in the shading of the underside.

Male/M_Uarml_Toxicsteel_01.description: A single fitted armoured sleeve covering one arm from shoulder cap to wrist, with a bulky angular shoulder piece and segmented ridged plates along the forearm. Reads as a mechanical, sci-fi asymmetric arm guard.
Male/M_Uarml_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole sleeve, including the shoulder cap and segmented plates.
Male/M_Uarml_Toxicsteel_01.differs: The male shoulder cap is larger and more pronounced, rising higher over the shoulder.

Male/M_Uarml_Trooperbot_Arm_01.description: A mechanical prosthetic-style arm on one side: a rounded armoured shoulder cap, exposed hydraulic pistons and cables down a segmented upper arm, a banded elbow joint and a slim forearm cage with tubes ending at the wrist.
Male/M_Uarml_Trooperbot_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap rim, piston housings and wrist bands; colour 1 on the inner shoulder panel and the tubes in the forearm; colour 2 on the elbow band and joints.

Male/M_Uarml_Wires_01.description: A mechanical single-arm upper piece: a domed shoulder cap with a round lens-like socket, and bundled cables and rods running down the arm past a joint pod to a banded cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Uarml_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder dome top, the arm plates and the wrist cuff; colour 1 on the shoulder shell, brackets and rods; colour 2 on the cables; colour 3 on the shoulder lens and joint lights.

Male/M_Uarmr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single ribbed, segmented mechanical sleeve covering one arm from shoulder to wrist, topped by a large angular dish-like cap plate on the shoulder. Retro robotic style, worn over the bare torso.
Male/M_Uarmr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper part of the ribbed sleeve, fading toward colour 0 near the wrist; colour 2 on the shoulder cap.
Male/M_Uarmr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.differs: The male shoulder cap is larger, bulkier and more prominent, standing out from the shoulder.

Male/M_Uarmr_Arm_Insect_01.description: A single-arm armoured sleeve with a large rounded pauldron-like shoulder cap that opens to a hollow with inner detail, ribbed segmented plates down the arm and a flared forearm bracer with small barbs. Insectoid and mechanical.
