Male/M_Uarmr_Arm_Insect_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and outer armour shells; colour 1 on the ribbed plates; colour 2 on the inner recesses and side panels; colour 3 on the small barbs and inner shoulder accents.
Male/M_Uarmr_Arm_Insect_01.differs: The shoulder cap is larger and bulkier, with an open hollow showing contrasting-accented inner detail on top.

Male/M_Uarmr_Cyber_Cowboy_01.description: A single armored sleeve covering one whole arm from shoulder to wrist: a domed shoulder cap, stacked segmented plates down the upper arm, a smooth tapered forearm with grooved lines, and banded trim at the cuff.
Male/M_Uarmr_Cyber_Cowboy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and plates; colour 2 on the forearm sleeve and cuff bands; colours 1 and 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Uarmr_Dryad_03.description: A single-arm organic guard: a cluster of curved, glossy thorn-like blades sweeps up and back from the shoulder, above a ribbed, fibrous forearm sleeve with fine vein-like lines. Bare elsewhere; suggests a monstrous woodland look.
Male/M_Uarmr_Dryad_03.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the glossy shoulder thorns; colour 0 on the ribbed forearm sleeve; colour 3 on the fine vein lines in the sleeve.

Male/M_Uarmr_Dryad_Alt_01.description: A single-arm sleeve covering the upper arm to the wrist, with a bunched, gathered shoulder and twisting vine-like tendrils wrapping around the arm, plus a broad flared panel along the outer shoulder. Organic fantasy look.
Male/M_Uarmr_Dryad_Alt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the sleeve body with fine veining; colour 1 on the outer shoulder panel and some of the vines; colour 2 on the twisting vines around the forearm.

Male/M_Uarmr_Endo_01.description: A mechanical prosthetic-style arm piece on the left arm only: a large rounded shoulder cap over a boxy housing with a spiral disc, a ribbed striped cylinder on the upper arm, exposed jointed rods at the elbow and a plated forearm sleeve.
Male/M_Uarmr_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder housing and forearm plating; colour 1 on the shoulder cap, rings, elbow struts and joints; colour 3 on the stripes of the upper-arm cylinder and the spiral; colour 2 on the elbow bolts and joint nubs.
Male/M_Uarmr_Endo_01.differs: The male version has a large rounded cap over the shoulder, whereas the female has a flatter angular plate with a small hooked cap.

Male/M_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_01.description: A single mechanical arm covering for one arm: a chunky extinguisher-like upper cylinder with ragged, layered shoulder plating, a contrasting segmented joint, and a bulky hex-nut forearm with spiky fins and a cuffed wrist.
Male/M_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the cylinder body, hex nut and fins; colour 1 on the shoulder plates and upper and forearm casing; colour 2 on the joint rings and lower forearm; colour 3 on small accent tabs at the shoulder and elbow.
Male/M_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_01.differs: The male version has a heavier, more enclosed shoulder cluster and a larger contrasting casing wrapping the upper arm.

Male/M_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_02.description: A single mechanical right arm piece: a bulky rounded metal shoulder cap, a wire-caged bulb set in the upper arm, and a jointed forearm of exposed pistons and rods. Its scrap-built look suggests a junkyard robot.
Male/M_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder cap and forearm frame; colour 1 on the upper-arm panel and forearm sections; colour 3 on the bulb; colour 2 on the elbow joint block.
Male/M_Uarmr_Junkbot_Arm_02.differs: The bulb cage is larger and stands out farther from the arm, and the shoulder cap is bigger and more rounded.

Male/M_Uarmr_Mecha_01.description: A single mechanical arm covering: a segmented shoulder cap with a rim, ribbed upper arm plates, a jointed elbow with round connectors, and a banded, plated forearm guard ending at the wrist. Robotic sci-fi look.
Male/M_Uarmr_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder rim, forearm plates and upper armour edges; colour 2 on the segmented upper arm and shoulder cap; colour 1 on the elbow joint knobs and band; colour 3 on the shoulder and elbow vent details.

Male/M_Uarmr_Mecha_02.description: A single mechanical arm armour on one arm: a rounded shoulder cap, segmented upper-arm plates, a bulky jointed elbow and an angular forearm guard ending in ringed cuff bands. Sci-fi robotic style.
Male/M_Uarmr_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper-arm and forearm plates and shoulder rim; colour 1 on the shoulder cap, elbow joint and cuff rings; colour 2 on the gaps between segments; colour 3 on the small indicator lights.

Male/M_Uarmr_Mechanon_02.description: A mechanical prosthetic-style arm covering one arm: a large dish-shaped shoulder plate, a thin exposed strut and joint at the elbow, and a segmented armoured forearm with vents and a banded cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Uarmr_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder dish, struts and joint plates; colour 1 on the forearm and upper arm panels; colour 3 on small accents at the shoulder joint and forearm; colour 2 on the cuff band and inner recesses.

Male/M_Uarmr_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.description: A mechanical steampunk arm rig on one arm: a large ribbed shoulder housing with a looping cable, pipe-like struts down the upper arm, a chunky geared elbow joint, and a banded cuff at the wrist.
Male/M_Uarmr_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder housing, struts and elbow casing; colour 1 on the tubes and hoses between the joints; colour 3 on the elbow gear ring and shoulder fittings; colour 2 on the cable and wrist band.
Male/M_Uarmr_Robot_Steam_Punk_Arm_01.differs: The male version has a larger, bulkier ribbed shoulder housing and a chunkier elbow joint.

Male/M_Uarmr_Skeleton_02.description: A single-arm skeletal overlay: a bone-like upper arm and forearm with jointed elbow, running from a rounded shoulder cap down to a slim cuff at the wrist. Worn over the arm of a bodysuit, with a mechanical, anatomical look.
Male/M_Uarmr_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint ends and elbow; colour 2 on the shoulder cap and wrist cuff.
Male/M_Uarmr_Skeleton_02.differs: The male shoulder cap is a solid rounded pad and the wrist cuff is a thinner band.

Male/M_Uarmr_Skeleton_03.description: A skeletal arm overlay: a slender upper-arm bone and a split forearm of two bones, with rounded joint knobs at shoulder and elbow, ending in a short band at the wrist. Sits over each arm like exposed bones.
Male/M_Uarmr_Skeleton_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint ends at shoulder and elbow; colour 2 on the wrist band.

Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_02.description: A single-arm covering shaped like a rough twig or branch, running from a large flared shoulder cap down to the wrist, with small thorn-like spikes on the forearm and elbow. Organic, whimsical snowman-stick look.
Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the branch surface and the outer rim of the shoulder cap; colour 1 on the mottled streaks along the arm; colour 2 on the underside of the shoulder cap.
Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_02.differs: The male shoulder cap is a wide flared disc with a curling rim and a separate darker underside, larger than the female one.

Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_03.description: A single sleeve shaped like a gnarled twig or branch, covering one arm from shoulder to wrist with a bark-like textured surface and small thorn-like spurs poking out near the elbow and forearm.
Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Snowman_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main branch surface; colour 1 on the streaks and veins running along the length; the small spurs follow colour 0.

Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.description: A single mechanical sleeve covering one arm: a broad armored shoulder plate with a wide open loop rising toward the neck, mesh-textured joints, segmented plated arm sections, and a wrist of vertical rods with a narrow cuff.
Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder plate, arm plates and forearm shell; colour 0 on the mesh joints and wrist cuff; colour 2 on the wrist rods; colour 3 on small accents.
Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Space_Pharaoh_01.differs: The male shoulder plate forms a wide open loop arching up toward the neck, while the female version is a smaller, tighter cap.

Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.description: A single mechanical doll-like arm: a large rounded ball shoulder with a raised curved shoulder-cap rim, segmented upper arm, ball elbow joint and smooth tapered forearm ending at the wrist. Toy or robot style, worn on one arm only.
Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder ball, upper arm and forearm segments; colour 1 on the shoulder rim and joint edges.
Male/M_Uarmr_Tight_Toy_Arm_01_1.differs: The male shoulder ball is larger and bulkier, with a more pronounced raised rim around it.

Male/M_Uarmr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A single fitted sleeve covering one arm from shoulder to wrist, with a rounded shoulder cap and segmented, ridged plating along the forearm and upper arm. Reads as a mechanical, partial jacket arm.
Male/M_Uarmr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the whole sleeve, including the shoulder cap and ridged segments.

Male/M_Uarmr_Trooperbot_Arm_01.description: A single mechanical arm replacing one sleeve: a large rounded shoulder dome with a rim, a jointed upper arm of stacked segments, and a piston-like forearm with exposed rods and a banded cuff above the wrist.
Male/M_Uarmr_Trooperbot_Arm_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder rim, joint housings and stacked segments; colour 1 on the shoulder inner panel and the forearm piston rods; colour 2 on the cuff bands and cables; the shoulder dome shows a metallic, weathered finish that ignores the scheme.

Male/M_Uarmr_Wires_01.description: A mechanical single-arm rig: a domed shoulder cap with a round glowing socket, then exposed cables and rods running down the arm past a spherical elbow joint to a cuff at the wrist. Sci-fi cybernetic look.
Male/M_Uarmr_Wires_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder dome, elbow joint and wrist cuff; colour 1 on the shoulder trim, brackets and rod segments; colour 2 on the cables; colour 3 on the socket at the shoulder.

Male/M_Ulegl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style leg cover on one leg only, from upper thigh to ankle: segmented armored plates, exposed ribbed tubing panels at the calf, and a looping cable clasp around the shin. Robotic, sci-fi look.
Male/M_Ulegl_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim of the thigh cap; colour 1 on the ribbed calf panels; colour 2 on the armor plates, cables and lower shin; colour 3 on the small round indicator on the thigh.

Male/M_Ulegl_Dryad_01.description: A single-leg covering that wraps one leg from hip to ankle in smooth, fitted panels crossed by thick tangled vine-like bands, with contrasting vein lines and clawed, ragged toes. Organic, monstrous forest-guardian style.
Male/M_Ulegl_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leg panels; colour 2 on the twisting vine bands; colour 3 on the thin vein lines.

Male/M_Ulegl_Dryad_02.description: A single-leg covering of twisting woody vines and branches wrapped around the right leg from hip to ankle, over a mottled patterned underlayer, with a small separate plate at the knee and ragged root-like tips at the ankle.
Male/M_Ulegl_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the vine branches and wrapping; colour 1 on the mottled underlayer; colour 0 on the mottled patches and the knee plate.

Male/M_Ulegl_Endo_01.description: A mechanical single-leg brace worn on one leg only: an angular armored thigh shell, a jointed knee with a coiled band, and segmented shin plates ending in an ankle joint. Sci-fi cyborg look.
Male/M_Ulegl_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh shell, shin plates and ankle cap; colour 1 on the knee joint housing, rods and the hip rod; colour 3 on the knee coil bands and small connectors; colour 2 on the hydraulic pistons and inner knee.
Male/M_Ulegl_Endo_01.differs: The male version has a protruding rod and connector at the top of the thigh and a narrower shell, instead of the wide dished top with a square stud.

Male/M_Ulegl_Mecha_01.description: A single mechanical leg brace on one leg: a rounded hip cap, segmented angular thigh and shin plates with recessed slots, and a cylindrical knee joint with ribbed cable detail, ending in an ankle ring.
Male/M_Ulegl_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip cap and the thigh and shin plates; colour 1 on the joint cylinders at the hip, knee and ankle; colour 3 on the recessed slot strips; colour 2 on the knee ribbing.

Male/M_Ulegl_Mecha_02.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style leg on one side: a domed hip cap, segmented angular armour plates down the thigh, a round knee joint and a tapered plated shin ending in an ankle ring. Reads as robotic and sci-fi.
Male/M_Ulegl_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip cap and the thigh and shin plates; colour 1 on the hip, knee and ankle joint balls; colour 2 on the knee-front panel and calf insert; colour 3 on the round emblem on top of the hip cap and on stripes at the ankle joint.
Male/M_Ulegl_Mecha_02.differs: The hip cap carries a round contrasting emblem on top, and the ankle ring has a more visible stripe.

Male/M_Ulegl_Ravenswood_01.description: A rigid, tapered thigh plate worn on the outer left leg, with raised swirling vine-like relief and a thin contrasting edge trim; a plain smooth back surface gives it an arcane, monstrous armor look.
Male/M_Ulegl_Ravenswood_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the plate base and back; colour 1 on the raised swirling relief; colour 3 on the thin edge trim.

Male/M_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_01.description: A single exposed skeletal leg attachment on one leg: a long bone-like shaft with a knuckled joint, a narrower lower segment with a thin cable, and a chunky clawed foot block at the ankle. Monstrous, mechanical look.
Male/M_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper bone; colour 1 on the lower shin segment; colour 2 on the thin cable; colour 3 on the chunky foot block.

Male/M_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_02.description: A single exposed skeletal leg: a long thigh bone runs down the front of the leg from a ragged band at the upper thigh, with a jointed knee, a thinner shin bone and a clawed, bony foot cuff at the ankle.
Male/M_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh bone and knee joint; colour 1 on the shin bone; colour 3 on the thigh band and the ankle and foot piece; colour 2 on the thin cable along the shin.
Male/M_Ulegl_Skeletal_Monster_02.differs: The thigh band sits higher, close to the hip, and the bone runs more along the front of the leg.

Male/M_Ulegl_Skeleton_01.description: A single skeletal leg made of bone: a rounded hip joint, long thigh bone, knee joint and paired shin bones running down to the ankle. It sits on one leg only, over the mannequin's tights, in a monstrous undead style.
Male/M_Ulegl_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint ends and shading around the knee and ankle.

Male/M_Ulegl_Skeleton_02.description: A skeletal leg overlay on one leg only: a bone-like femur, knee joint and a double-boned shin run down the outer thigh to an ankle cuff, held at the hip by a flat strap loop. Suggests a monstrous or mechanical look.
Male/M_Ulegl_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the knee joint accents; colour 2 on the hip strap and ankle cuff.
Male/M_Ulegl_Skeleton_02.differs: The male version shows a double shin bone (two parallel bones) below the knee, with a larger hip strap.

Male/M_Ulegl_Steampunk_01.description: A mechanical prosthetic-style leg on one side only: a segmented piston-like thigh with a boxy hip housing, a jointed knee cap, and a chunky lower leg with valve-like fittings and a cuffed ankle. Steampunk, robotic and partial.
Male/M_Ulegl_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip rim, knee cap and ankle rings; colour 1 on the thigh cylinder segments; colour 3 on the valve fittings, joints and lower leg; colour 2 on the hip housing and bands.
Male/M_Ulegl_Steampunk_01.differs: The lower leg is bulkier with stubby valve-like fittings, and the hip housing has a wider frame that stands out from the body.

Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_01.description: A mechanical leg attachment: a boxy angular hip housing on the outer thigh, twin rods down to a knee cluster of valve wheels and pipes, then a slim shin tube with an ankle ring.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the hip housing top, shin tube and knee parts; colour 0 on the housing side, rods and ankle ring; colour 2 on the inner housing; colour 3 on the bands and knee accents.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_01.differs: The male hip housing is a blockier, angular shell with a contrasting-topped cover and no strap, unlike the rounder female pod.

Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_02.description: A mechanical single-leg attachment on the outer thigh: a compact cuff at the hip, a long slatted blade-like strut with a loop handle down the thigh, and a jagged, scrappy cluster of pipes and spikes around the shin.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strut and pipes; colour 1 on the shin housings and parts of the hip cuff; colour 2 on the top of the hip cuff; colour 3 on the shin panel, foot tip and cuff markings.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Junkbot_02.differs: The male version has a smaller, flatter hip cuff and the strut hugs the leg more closely.

Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A single mechanical prosthetic leg worn on one side: a rounded hip cuff, a segmented thigh strut with a joint ball at the top, a ball-jointed knee, exposed wiring, and a ribbed coil above the ankle.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hip cuff and thigh panels; colour 0 on the struts, joint balls and shin frame; colour 1 on the inner panels and ankle cuff; colour 3 on the wires and cables.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Mechanon_02.differs: The male version has a softer, rounded hip cuff with a visible ball joint at the top of the thigh, instead of a flat angular hip plate.

Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Robotexol_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic leg replacing one thigh and shin: a hexagonal hip plate, exposed piston-like cylinders and cabling along the thigh and calf, and plated knee and ankle joints. Sits on one leg only.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Robotexol_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plate, knee and ankle armour and frame plates; colour 1 on the cylinders; colour 3 on the small bands and accents on the cylinders and hip; colour 2 on the cables and inner workings.

Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Toy_Leg_01_1.description: A single-leg mechanical prosthetic-style piece: a segmented doll-like leg with a bulky thigh shell, ball-jointed knee and tapered shin, held at the upper thigh by an angular hoop band. Covers only one leg.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Toy_Leg_01_1.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh, shin and knee segments and the hoop band; colour 2 on the joint gaps at the knee and upper thigh.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Toy_Leg_01_1.differs: The male version has a blockier thigh shell and a larger, more prominent hoop band at the hip.

Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Trooperbot_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic leg worn on one side only: a jointed hip cap, slim piston-like thigh, rounded knee joint and ribbed shin with exposed hoses, ending above the foot. Sci-fi robotic look.
Male/M_Ulegl_Tight_Trooperbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main leg plating and joint casings; colour 1 on the hoses and joint rings; colour 2 on the ribbed segments and hip cap details; colour 3 on worn patches at the knee.

Male/M_Ulegl_Toxicsteel_01.description: A single-leg mechanical armour piece: a bulky thigh casing with a flat plated top, rounded knee pods, and a tapered segmented shin guard ending in a ring cuff at the ankle. Covers one leg only.
Male/M_Ulegl_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the thigh casing, knee pods and ankle ring; colour 0 on the top plate and shin guard; colour 1 on a small connector at the front of the thigh; colour 2 on edge lining.

Male/M_Ulegr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style leg cover on one leg only: segmented armored plating from hip to ankle, exposed ribbed cabling and panels along the thigh and calf, and a looped ring clasp at the knee.
Male/M_Ulegr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the top rim cap; colour 1 on the ribbed thigh and calf panels; colour 2 on the main armor plates and cabling; colour 3 on the small side light.
Male/M_Ulegr_Anniversary_Mechanon_01.differs: The male version shows ribbed colour 1 panels higher up the thigh as well as on the calf, so it looks more heavily paneled.

Male/M_Ulegr_Dryad_01.description: A single-leg covering that runs from the hip to the ankle, wrapped in twisting vine-like bands over a smooth, veined leg sheath, with a clawed, ragged edge at the ankle. Organic, monstrous nature look.
Male/M_Ulegr_Dryad_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leg sheath; colour 2 on the vine bands; colour 3 on the thin veins.

Male/M_Ulegr_Dryad_02.description: A single-leg covering of twisting woody vines and thorny root shapes wrapped around a mottled panel, running from the hip to the ankle with a knotted band at the knee. Organic, monstrous nature-guardian look.
Male/M_Ulegr_Dryad_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the vine and root wrapping; colour 1 on the mottled leg panel; colour 0 on the mottled patches and the knee plate.

Male/M_Ulegr_Endo_01.description: A single mechanical leg brace on one leg only: a tall angular armoured thigh shell with a front rod, a coiled knee joint with a ring, a segmented shin guard and a small ankle bolt.
Male/M_Ulegr_Endo_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh shell and shin plates; colour 1 on the knee joint and top nubs; colour 3 on the knee coils and ankle tips; colour 2 on the inner rod and recessed gaps.
Male/M_Ulegr_Endo_01.differs: The male thigh shell is taller and fuller with a closed front, while the knee joint sits slightly higher.

Male/M_Ulegr_Mecha_01.description: A single mechanical leg brace on one leg: a curved hip plate over a round joint, an angular armored thigh segment, a chunky knee joint, and a segmented shin guard ending in a ring at the ankle.
Male/M_Ulegr_Mecha_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip plate and the thigh and shin armor; colour 1 on the hip, knee and ankle joints; colour 3 on the recessed slots in the armor; colour 2 on small joint details.

Male/M_Ulegr_Mecha_02.description: A single mechanical leg armour on one leg only: a broad hip cap over a ball joint, faceted segmented thigh and shin plates, a knee ball joint and an ankle ring, giving a robotic prosthetic look.
Male/M_Ulegr_Mecha_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip cap and the thigh and shin plates; colour 1 on the ball joints and ankle ring; colour 2 on the knee and shin panel; colour 3 on the markings on the hip cap and ankle bands.
Male/M_Ulegr_Mecha_02.differs: The male version has a larger hip cap with a contrasting-marked inset and no separate hip band.

Male/M_Ulegr_Skeletal_Monster_01.description: A single skeletal leg attachment: a long bone runs down the outside of one leg from thigh to knee, then a shorter jointed bone with a thin cord leads to a chunky, jagged bone cluster at the ankle. Monstrous and asymmetric.
Male/M_Ulegr_Skeletal_Monster_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper bone; colour 1 on the lower jointed bone; colour 2 on the thin cord; colour 3 on the ankle bone cluster.

Male/M_Ulegr_Skeletal_Monster_02.description: A partial skeletal-monster leg piece on one leg: a thin band at the hip, a long exposed thigh bone, a knee joint, a slim lower bone with a thin cable, and a chunky segmented plate cluster at the ankle.
Male/M_Ulegr_Skeletal_Monster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the thigh bone and knee joint; colour 1 on the lower leg bone; colour 3 on the hip band and ankle plates; colour 2 on the thin cable.

Male/M_Ulegr_Skeleton_01.description: A single exposed skeletal leg on one side: a femur with a ball joint at the hip, a kneecap and knee joint, and a slender shin bone down to the ankle, sitting over the leg.
Male/M_Ulegr_Skeleton_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bone shafts and joint balls; colour 1 on the joint shading around the knee, hip socket and ankle ends.

Male/M_Ulegr_Skeleton_02.description: A single exposed skeletal leg: thigh bone with ball joint, prominent kneecap and shin bones, held by a thin loop around the upper thigh and a cuff at the ankle. It lies over the body's leg like a bone overlay.
Male/M_Ulegr_Skeleton_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bones; colour 1 on the joint shading around the knee; colour 2 on the thigh band and ankle cuff.
Male/M_Ulegr_Skeleton_02.differs: The male version has a thinner thigh loop and a more prominent kneecap, with the bones running straighter down the front of the leg.

Male/M_Ulegr_Steampunk_01.description: A single mechanical prosthetic-style leg piece on one leg: a hip cap with a curved rim, a segmented piston thigh with valves, a knee joint ring, and a chunky lower leg with ring bands and an ankle cuff.
Male/M_Ulegr_Steampunk_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hip cap and joint bands; colour 0 on the hip rim, knee and calf rings, and ankle cuff; colour 1 on the thigh casing; colour 3 on the valves and lower leg.
Male/M_Ulegr_Steampunk_01.differs: The male lower leg is a bulkier calf casing with an extra ring band, rather than the slim tapered shin of the female.

Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_01.description: A partial mechanical leg attachment on one leg: a hip cap with a long rectangular strut and handle-like loop down the thigh, ending in a cluster of pipes, joints and plates around the shin and ankle.
Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the struts, loop and pipework; colour 1 on the hip cap, joints and lower plates; colour 2 on the hip cap edge; colour 3 on the shin panel and cap accents.
Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, more swept contrasting hip cap with contrasting accents and a tidier, more compact lower-leg assembly.

Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_02.description: A single-leg mechanical attachment: a rounded thigh pod with an angular shell cap, thin rods running down to a shin of jointed pipe sections, valve wheels and small canisters, ending in a cuff above the ankle.
Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the pod's lower shell, rods and cuff; colour 1 on the angular shell cap and shin tube; colour 2 on the pod's inner core; colour 3 on the joint bands and valve fittings.
Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Junkbot_02.differs: The male thigh pod has an angular fin-like shell cap over a contrasting core and no strap, unlike the female's flat capped pod with a strap.

Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Mechanon_02.description: A mechanical single-leg brace on the character's left leg: a flared hip plate at the thigh, segmented rods and cable-like piping down the thigh and shin, a ball joint at the knee, and ringed ankle segments.
Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Mechanon_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the hip plate and thigh panel; colour 0 on the rods, ball joint and casing; colour 1 on the ankle rings, piping and inner segments; colour 3 on thin cable accents near the knee and calf.
Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Mechanon_02.differs: The male version has a smaller hip plate with a rounded contrasting-and-contrasting joint sitting on top of the thigh, rather than a ball joint on the hip.

Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Robotexor_01.description: A single mechanical leg replacement on one side: an angular armoured hip cuff, exposed cylindrical piston tubes down the thigh and calf, and segmented plates with ring joints at the knee and ankle.
Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Robotexor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hip cuff, armour plates and joint rings; colour 1 on the piston cylinders; colour 3 on the bands around the pistons and the hip cuff edge; colour 2 on the inner mechanics.

Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.description: A single mechanical leg brace worn on one leg: a flat-topped hip cap, a jointed thigh strut with ribbed hydraulic pistons, a rounded knee joint and a segmented shin plate. Exposed cables run down the leg, giving a robotic sci-fi look.
Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the strut and shin plates; colour 1 on the cables and knee joint rings; colour 2 on the piston ribs and hip cap; colour 3 on small accents.
Male/M_Ulegr_Tight_Trooperbot_01.differs: The male version has a flatter, squarer hip cap and a bulkier knee joint.

Male/M_Ulegr_Toxicsteel_01.description: A single-leg mechanical armour piece: a tapered thigh shell with a flat angular plate at the hip, rounded knee guards, and a segmented shin greave ending in a ringed ankle cuff. Sits on one leg only, with a sci-fi, monstrous look.
Male/M_Ulegr_Toxicsteel_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the thigh shell, knee guards and ankle cuff; colour 0 on the hip plate and shin greave; colour 2 on the edge trim and small joint details; colour 1 on a small accent at the knee.

Male/M_Vehicle_Broom_01.description: A witch-style broom worn as a vehicle attachment beside the hip: a long straight slender handle with a wrapped binding near one end and a bushy, wrinkled bristle head that flares out behind the body.
Male/M_Vehicle_Broom_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bristle head; colour 1 on the long handle; colour 2 and colour 3 on the binding bands where the bristles meet the handle.

Male/M_Vehicle_Glider_Mayhem_01.description: A winged hover glider the wearer stands on: a rounded central hull with organic swirl markings, long swept wings ending in hooked claw-like tips, and curved fin blades angled below and above the wings.
Male/M_Vehicle_Glider_Mayhem_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hull plating and wing surfaces; colour 3 on the swirl markings, wing joints and rear housing; colour 1 on the curved fin blades, wing tips and central stripe.

Male/M_Waistaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_2025_.description: A cluster of stacked, folded fin panels on the left hip, sweeping back into pointed tips. It has an angular, pleated look, with layered blades that overlap and flare outward from the hip.
Male/M_Waistaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_2025_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer fin surfaces and edges; colour 1 on the inner and lower fin surfaces, blending into colour 3 across the panels.
Male/M_Waistaccessoriesl_Foxbatcon_2025_.differs: The male fins are more angular, with folded, pleated panels and sharper tips, rather than the smooth, rounded, ribbed fan of the female version.

Male/M_Waistaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_2025_.description: A single swept-back fin ornament on the right hip: three stacked, ribbed fin layers curve to a point, with a frilled ragged lower edge. Suggests an amphibian or monster look.
Male/M_Waistaccessoriesr_Foxbatcon_2025_.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer rims and ribbed fin edges; colour 1 on the inner fin surfaces and frilled underside.

Male/M_Waistl_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A small hip accessory of overlapping curved, claw-like spikes or fins on the left hip, fanning outward in two clusters: long tapered blades above and a darker segmented cluster of hooked talons below. Monstrous, dragon-like styling.
Male/M_Waistl_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 and colour 1 on the upper blades, fading from one to the other toward the tips; colour 2 and colour 3 on the lower segmented talons, fading toward the tips.

Male/M_Waistr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.description: A small cluster of curved, clawlike spikes worn at the right hip: long tapering blades fan out from a knotted base, with shorter talon-like points curling below. Suggests a monstrous dragon-scale accent.
Male/M_Waistr_Dragonbody_Lockbox_65.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the middle of the long spikes; colour 1 on the spike tips; colour 2 on the base knot; colour 3 on the lower curling talons.

Male/M_Wings_Blockbuster_02.description: A pair of mechanical blade-wings mounted on the upper back: each has a blocky pivot housing with a round joint, a long swept-up blade above and sharp tapering spikes hanging below. The style is sci-fi mecha.
Male/M_Wings_Blockbuster_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade edges and spike tips; colour 1 on the pivot housings; colour 3 on the main blade surfaces and lower spikes; colour 2 on the round joints.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Future_01.description: A pair of large curved blade-like mechanical wings that arc up and out from the back, each with a ringed circular hub, a hooked tip, a contrasting inner blade panel and a slim trim line along the edge.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade surfaces and hub housing; colour 1 on the edge trim and inner stripes; colour 2 on the inner blade panels; colour 3 on the ring in each hub.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Future_01.differs: The male wings spread wider and lower, with the blades set farther apart and the far wing longer and more slanted, rather than held upright as on the female.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Future_02.description: A pair of small mechanical blade wings floating at the sides of the back: each has a round ringed hub with a glowing core and a long swept, tapering blade with a small spike on top, hanging down past the hips.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Future_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer hub rings; colour 1 on the long blades and top spikes; colour 2 on the underside blade panels; colour 3 on the inner hub cores.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Jetpack_Mechanical_01.description: A pair of detached mechanical jet-fighter wings floating out to each side of the back, each with a central fuselage, swept wing blades with serrated edges, tall tail fins and a small canopy. Sci-fi jetpack style.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Jetpack_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main fuselage and wing plates; colour 1 on the wing blades and tail fins; colour 2 on the fin insides and underside details; colour 3 on the canopies and small markings.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_01.description: A pair of mechanical wing arms mounted on the upper back: jointed clamp mounts feed curved arms that arc up and out, ending in swept feather-like blades with spiky crests. Sits behind the shoulders in a static pose.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the mounting clamps and lower blade edges; colour 1 on the curved arms and upper feather crests; colour 2 on the inner blade surfaces and joints.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_02.description: A pair of static feathered wings held out and slightly back from the shoulders, with layered feathers that lengthen into long pointed tips. Fantasy angelic style, hanging behind the body at about knee depth.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper leading edge and feather tops; colour 1 on the mid feather layers; colour 3 on the long lower feather tips; colour 2 on the darkened transition between the mid and tip feathers.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_Fl.description: A pair of mechanical wing-arms mounted on a small back clasp, each curving up and out over the shoulders like an arched boom before ending in swept, blade-like feathered tips with a jagged crest.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_Fl.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper feather crests and outer arch surfaces; colour 0 on the lower blade-like feather edges and clasp segments; colour 2 on the inner joints and underside shading.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_Fl.description: A pair of feathered wings that sweep out and down from the upper back, with layered feathers ending in long pointed tips that hang to about knee level. The look is fantasy or superhero, with a gradient from top to bottom.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Feather_Fl.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper leading edge and feather tips near the top; colour 1 on the main body of the feathers; colour 3 on the long lower feather tips; colour 2 in the darker feather roots between the and bands.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_01.description: A pair of static stone-look back wings: two long, narrow angular arms rise from carved shield-shaped plates at the shoulder blades and spread in a V, each tipped with a small rounded ornament with a circular emblem.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long arms and the carved plates; colour 1 on the rounded tip ornaments; colour 3 on the circular emblems; colour 2 on the cap atop each tip.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_01.differs: The two wings sit slightly more upright and are less symmetrical, with the left arm angled more steeply than the right.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_02.description: A pair of rigid, static angular wings made of stacked plank-like feather segments, with blocky crenellated tips and stepped, tooth-like lower edges. They stand out from the upper back, splayed slightly outward and angled back.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the blocky upper tips; colour 0 on the main feather panels; colour 3 on the stepped lower feather ends.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_02.differs: The male wings sit closer to the body and are more upright, so they hang as a narrower pair.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_Flap.description: A pair of long angular stone-like struts that mount on flat carved shield-shaped plates on the upper back and angle upward and outward like wings, each ending in a rounded cap with a circular emblem.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_Flap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the struts and mounting plates; colour 1 on the rounded end caps; colour 3 on the circular emblems on the caps; colour 2 on the tips atop the caps.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_Flap.description: A pair of large stone-slab wings on the back, each made of long parallel plank-like feathers with a blocky capped top and a stepped, crenellated lower edge; held out and angled slightly outward from the shoulders.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Lockbox_66_Stone_Flap.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main feather slabs; colour 2 on the capped tops of the wings; colour 3 on the stepped lower tips.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Scibladed_01.description: A compact mechanical backpack module: a round, rimmed disc housing with a recessed concentric-ringed face and a glowing core, above a tapering plate-like pod on a short connector. Sits centred on the upper back; sci-fi.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Scibladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the disc rim and the outer pod shell; colour 1 on the central core, connector and pod accents; colour 2 on the recessed disc face and pod panel; colour 3 on the small vent marks on the connector.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Scibladed_02.description: Six detached blade-like panels floating in a fan behind the shoulders, three per side, each a tapered angular shard with a pointed tip and layered segments. Suggests mechanical or energy wings for a sci-fi hero.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Scibladed_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the light inner strips of each blade; colour 1 on the blade tips and outer edges; colour 2 on the darker central segments; a small floating accent shard near the spine takes colour 1.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Scibladed_03.description: Six thin, flat, tapering blade shaped panels fan out from the upper back, three per side, spread like a skeletal wing. They float free of the body and suggest a sci-fi energy wing rig.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Scibladed_03.colourAreas: All blades appear to take a single colour; the default material seems to ignore the scheme, so no distinct colour slots are visible.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Tight_Armored_01.description: A pair of large feathered wings swept back from the shoulder blades, with layered rows of long, pointed armoured feathers that graduate in length and taper to sharp tips. Suggests a fantasy or superhero winged look.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Tight_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the upper covert feathers; colour 2 on the middle row of long feathers; colour 0 on the lower flight feathers.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Tight_Armored_01.differs: The male version has two wings, one on each side of the back, which are wider and fan out more.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Tight_Chimera_Bat_Rig.description: A single bat-like wing attached at the right shoulder blade, with a thick jointed bony arm, spiked finger struts and a thin stretched membrane fading toward the edge, ending in pointed claw tips. Fantasy or monstrous styling.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Tight_Chimera_Bat_Rig.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bony arm and finger struts; colour 0 on the membrane; colour 1 on the membrane's lower edge shading; colour 2 on the claw tips.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Tight_Chimera_Bird_Le.description: A single large feathered wing that springs from the upper back and extends out to one side, with a smooth padded leading edge, overlapping rows of feathers, and long flight feathers at the tip. Suggests a fantasy or angelic bird look.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Tight_Chimera_Bird_Le.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leading edge and the upper feather rows; colour 1 on the long flight feathers and outer feather rows; colour 3 on the feathers near the shoulder joint.

Male/M_Wings_Child_Tight_Scarab_01.description: A pair of insect-like wings sprouting from the upper back, each a broad, tapered membrane with a network of raised veins. They sweep outward and slightly down, giving a scarab or beetle look.
Male/M_Wings_Child_Tight_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing membranes; colour 3 on the veins and edge lines.

Male/M_Wings_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A single mechanical wing of layered, blade-like angular feather panels that sweep outward and back in tiers, floating off to one side of the body with small rivet-like nodes. Suggests a sci-fi reactor-powered flight pack.
Male/M_Wings_Extra_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the long upper blade feathers; colour 1 on the inner base panels of the lower feathers; colour 2 on the tips of the lower feathers; colour 3 on the small nodes.

Male/M_Wings_Future_01.description: Four curved, scythe-like mechanical blade wings floating behind the shoulders: two long arcs and two shorter blades, each with a round ringed hub, a pointed tip and a contrasting inner blade panel. Sci-fi, hovering design.
Male/M_Wings_Future_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer blade edges and hub housings; colour 1 on the inner blade edges and spines; colour 2 on the blade panels; colour 3 on the hub centres.

Male/M_Wings_Holoforce_Insect_02.description: A pair of translucent insect-style wings with a fine network of veins, hanging down and angled outward behind the shoulders from a small angular chevron-shaped mount between the shoulder blades. Sci-fi, psionic look.
Male/M_Wings_Holoforce_Insect_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the central mount and the wing membranes seen from the front; colour 0 on the wing veins; colour 1 on the wing surfaces seen from behind.

Male/M_Wings_Holoforce_Insect_03.description: Two pairs of translucent insect wings with fine branching veins: a large upper pair sweeping outward and a longer lower pair angled down, all joined at a small angular gem-like emblem mount between the shoulder blades.
Male/M_Wings_Holoforce_Insect_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the vein lines and wing edges; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 2 on the central mount; colour 3 on the small centre accent. The wings look glassy and only partly follow the scheme.

Male/M_Wings_Jetpack_Mechanical_01.description: A large mechanical jetpack of stacked jet-fighter modules fanning out across the back, with swept, serrated wings, finned engine pods and tall tail fins spanning well beyond the shoulders. Sci-fi superhero flight gear.
Male/M_Wings_Jetpack_Mechanical_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing plates and pod casings; colour 1 on the wing surfaces and fins; colour 3 on the engine intakes and cockpit-like caps; colour 2 on the small vents and joints.

Male/M_Wings_Jetwings_01.description: A single large mechanical jet wing swept back from a small shoulder harness on the chest and back. Long angular overlapping feather-like blades and spiked tips form a segmented swept silhouette, with a sci-fi aircraft look.
Male/M_Wings_Jetwings_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the harness and most of the wing blades; colour 1 on the upper wing ridge panels; colour 2 on a few panels along the wing top; colour 3 on the chest harness centre.
Male/M_Wings_Jetwings_01.differs: The male wings show the main wing blades mostly in the light colour, with contrasting panels limited to the top ridge, while the female wings show them mostly dark.

Male/M_Wings_Jetwings_02.description: A single large swept-back mechanical wing mounted at the upper back, built from overlapping angular blade-like panels and pointed feather spikes that fan out and taper to sharp tips, giving a jet-like aggressive look.
Male/M_Wings_Jetwings_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the large outer blade panels and edge spikes; colour 1 on the upper wing panels and some layered plates; colour 2 on the inner panels and struts near the mount.
Male/M_Wings_Jetwings_02.differs: The male version shows a paler, whitish default finish on the large blade panels, with less contrasting surface than the female one.

Male/M_Wings_Jetwings_Wing_01.description: A single wing made of many jagged, angular blade-like shards fanned out from the shoulder blade and sweeping back and outward. Overlapping metallic plates give a sharp, mechanical jet-wing look.
Male/M_Wings_Jetwings_Wing_01.colourAreas: The default material appears to ignore the colour scheme, so no slots are clearly visible; the whole wing shows a uniform glossy metallic finish.
Male/M_Wings_Jetwings_Wing_01.differs: The male version appears in a single uniform glossy metallic finish without separate contrasting panels.

Male/M_Wings_Kaiju_01.description: A pair of large, swept-back mechanical wings with ridged, cracked-looking upper panels and a lower perforated feather section, joined by a jagged, spiny central spine clamped across the upper back and shoulders.
Male/M_Wings_Kaiju_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wing panels; colour 1 on the lower perforated wing sections; colour 3 on the central spine and shoulder mount.
Male/M_Wings_Kaiju_01.differs: The male spine mount is larger, with more prominent protruding spikes running down the back.

Male/M_Wings_Kaiju_Static_02.description: A pair of static, swept-back mechanical wings mounted on a spiny central spine between the shoulder blades. Each wing has a sleek, layered upper blade with a lower panel of perforated feather-like plates, giving an armoured, angular look.
Male/M_Wings_Kaiju_Static_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the upper wing blades; colour 1 on the lower perforated feather panels; colour 3 on the central spiny spine mount; colour 2 on small recesses within the wings.

Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_66_01.description: A pair of large mechanical wings on shoulder-blade mounts with round plates and rigid arm struts curving up past the head. Each wing has long straight feather panels, a contrasting blocky upper section and a crenellated lower edge.
Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_66_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the struts, shoulder plates and feather panels; colour 2 on the upper wing blocks; colour 3 on the crenellated feather tips; colour 1 on the round joint caps and small mount lights.
Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_66_01.differs: The wings are posed asymmetrically in the sheet, with one strut held upright at the side of the head, but the piece itself looks the same.

Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_66_02.description: A pair of large static feathered wings that arc up and out from a small mechanical clasp plate across the upper back, with curved metal spars, layered swept-back feathers and pointed tips that reach below the hips.
Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_66_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the clasp plate and the upper feather edges; colour 1 on the main feather blades; colour 2 on the curved spars and feather tops; colour 3 on the feather tips.

Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_66_Flap_01.description: A pair of large mechanical wings mounted on shoulder plates on the back, with long angled struts rising over the shoulders and tall segmented feather panels with notched, battlement-like edges. Suits a superhero or sci-fi look.
Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_66_Flap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the struts, shoulder plates and lower feather panels; colour 2 on the notched upper feather sections; colour 3 on the feather tips; colour 1 on the shoulder joint caps and small connectors.

Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_66_Flap_02.description: A pair of large feathered wings on curved mechanical arm struts joined by a small clasp plate across the upper back. Layered feathers sweep up into hooked tips at the top and taper into long pointed tips below.
Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_66_Flap_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the clasp plate and the upper feather areas; colour 1 on the main feather blades; colour 3 on the lower feather tips; colour 2 on the struts and the darker feather edges.

Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_67_01.description: Long, narrow moth-like wings hanging from the upper back, each side with a broad upper lobe and tapering pointed lower tips that sweep down to the calves, with spotted eye-like patterns and a bordered edge.
Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_67_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the wing membranes and spots; colour 0 on the patterned inner panels; colour 1 on the edge borders and veins.
Male/M_Wings_Lockbox_67_01.differs: The male wings are long, narrow and drooping with spotted moth-like patterning, whereas the female version has broad, pale, translucent fairy wings.

Male/M_Wings_Moth_01.description: A pair of large butterfly-style wings with broad upper lobes and rounded lower lobes, patterned with fine veins, eyespots and concentric rings, joined at a small central clasp on the upper back. Fantasy insect look.
Male/M_Wings_Moth_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing membranes; colour 1 on the wing tips, veins and ring markings; colour 2 on the eyespots and tip stripes; colour 3 on the central clasp at the back.

Male/M_Wings_Scibladed_01.description: A mechanical back-mounted wing rig: a round ringed hub between the shoulder blades with eight long segmented arms fanning out, each tipped with a flat angular blade. Sci-fi, energy-weapon look.
Male/M_Wings_Scibladed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hub ring and arm casings; colour 1 on the bands along the arms and the hub centre; colour 2 on the blades and hub core; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Wings_Starhawk_01.description: A pair of mechanical wings mounted at the shoulder blades: each has a curved upper panel fanning into rows of long, layered blade-like feathers with contrasting edging, spreading outward and slightly downward to about hip height.
Male/M_Wings_Starhawk_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved upper panels; colour 3 on the feather blades; colour 1 on the thin line between panel and feathers; colour 2 on the edging around the feathers.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Armored_01.description: A large mechanical wing mounted at the upper back: jointed armored arms with rounded shoulder housings carry long layered feather blades that sweep back and out to sharp tips. Suggests a sci-fi angelic look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Armored_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the arm segments and the lower feather rows; colour 1 on the shoulder housings and the main feathers; colour 2 on the longest upper feather tips; colour 3 on the small joint lights.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Armored_01.differs: The male wing has a wider, more open span and a triple-lobed shoulder housing with two parallel arm struts, unlike the narrower female version.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Bat_02.description: A pair of small bat-style wings sprouting from the upper back, each a membrane stretched over thick curved finger-bones with a scalloped lower edge. They are swept outward and slightly asymmetric, giving a compact gothic superhero look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Bat_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the bone struts and outer edging; colour 3 on the outer membrane sections; colour 1 on the middle membrane sections; colour 0 on the inner membrane sections nearest the body.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Beetle_01.description: A compact beetle-shell backpiece: two rounded, glossy wing-case halves meet in a centre seam over the upper back, with veined insect wings folded beneath and visible along the seam and inner edge.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Beetle_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell halves and rim; colour 1 on the upper part of the folded veined wings; colour 3 on the lower part of the wings; colour 2 on the wing veins.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Beetle_02.description: A pair of beetle-style wings worn on the upper back: rounded, glossy wing-case shells sit over the shoulder blades, with long translucent veined wings hanging down and angling outward past the hips.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Beetle_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer shell wing-cases and edge trim; colour 1 on the upper veined wing membranes; colour 3 on the lower wing membranes; colour 2 on the vein lines.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Beetle_03.description: Pair of beetle-style insect wings mounted at the upper back: rounded hard wing-case shells sit on top, with long veined translucent membrane wings sweeping down and outward, edged by a thick rim.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Beetle_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing-case shells and the wing rims; colour 1 and colour 3 on the veined wing membranes, blending from one to the other toward the tips.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Bird_01.description: A single large feathered bird wing worn on the back, swept out and back in a long, arched shape with a smooth leading edge and layered rows of feathers that fan into ragged tips.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Bird_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the upper leading edge; colour 1 on the mid band of small covert feathers; colour 3 on the main long flight feathers; colour 0 on the outer feather tips and underside.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Bird_01.differs: The wing spreads wider and more outward to the side, with a fuller span, than the female version.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Birdpeople_01.description: A single large feathered bird wing worn on one side of the back, with a rounded padded leading edge, layered rows of long flight feathers sweeping outward and back, and a small patch of scaly feathering near the shoulder.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Birdpeople_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the padded leading edge and shoulder covert; colour 1 on the long flight feathers; colour 3 on the feather bases along the wing's inner band; colour 2 on the feather tips.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Butterfly_01.description: A pair of large butterfly wings on the upper back: broad upper wings sweep up and outward, with smaller lower wings ending in trailing tails. Veined, gradient-textured membranes give a delicate, fantasy insect look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Butterfly_01.colourAreas: The wings carry a painted texture rather than flat slots: the wing edges and veins take tones, the central gradient areas take a to-blend, so the scheme is largely baked into the texture.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Butterfly_02.description: A pair of large butterfly wings on the back: broad upper wings and smaller lower wings with a trailing tail tip, patterned with eyespots, veins and scalloped edges. They spread wide behind the shoulders.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Butterfly_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wing borders and outer membrane; colour 1 on the inner vein streaks of the upper wings; colour 2 on the lower wing patches and spots; colour 3 on the eyespot and vein markings.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Cherub_02.description: A pair of small feathered wings mounted high on the upper back at the shoulder blades, swept outward and slightly back, with a rounded upper edge and rows of layered feathers ending in long tips. Cherub or angelic in style.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Cherub_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the upper covert feathers near the wing base; colour 1 on the long lower flight feathers; colour 2 in the shadowed feather undersides.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Child_Scarab_02.description: A pair of large butterfly-like wings rising from the upper back: each side has a tall pointed upper wing and a longer, swept-down lower wing. Both have segmented veins and rigid, glossy, mechanical-looking edges.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Child_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Mostly a glossy default material that largely ignores the scheme; a faint tint of colour 1 shows on the vein panels of the wings, with colour 2 on the darker edges and frames.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Chimera_01.description: A single large feathered wing on the back, with a bony, clawed spar along the leading edge, a smooth membrane near the shoulder and layers of long feathers trailing toward the tip; a fantasy-monstrous hybrid look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Chimera_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bony spar and joints; colour 0 on the membrane and shoulder area; colour 1 on the long flight feathers; colour 2 on the claw tips.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Chimera_02.description: A single large bat-style wing extending from the upper back: a thick jointed bony arm with branching struts supports a thin membrane that scallops between pointed fingers tipped with small claws. Suggests a monstrous, gothic fantasy look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Chimera_02.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bony arm and finger struts; colour 0 on the wing membrane, fading toward colour 1 near the edges; colour 2 on the claw tips.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bat_Left_01.description: A single bat-style wing (left side) mounted at the upper back: a jointed, bony arm frame with claw-tipped fingers stretches a thin membrane between the spars, giving a scalloped trailing edge. Suits gothic, monstrous or fantasy looks.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bat_Left_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bony arm and finger frame; colour 0 on the membrane; colour 1 as a soft tint toward the outer edge of the membrane; colour 2 on the claw tips.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bird_Right_01.description: A single large feathered bird wing attached at the upper back, sweeping out and back from the shoulder with a smooth leading edge, rows of small overlapping covert feathers and long layered flight feathers at the tip.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Chimera_Bird_Right_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the leading edge and the small covert feathers on one side; colour 1 on the long flight feathers; colour 3 on a band of feathers along the wing's upper spine.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Colossus_01.description: A single large wing mounted on the upper back: a jointed, segmented armature with cracked, vein-like surface detail carries rows of long pointed crystalline feather blades that sweep outward and downward.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Colossus_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the segmented wing armature; colour 1 on the crystal feather blades; colour 3 on the cracks and veining in the armature.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Colossus_01.differs: The wing extends further out and is angled more sideways, giving a longer span than the female version.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Demon_01.description: A large bat-like dragon wing sweeping out from the upper back, with thick jointed bony arms, long clawed finger spars and a stretched membrane between them. Reads as a demonic, fantasy back accessory.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Demon_01.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the bony arm and finger spars; colour 1 on the membrane between the spars.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Demon_01.differs: The male version has wings that spread wider and hang lower behind the back, showing a fuller membrane from the rear.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Demon_Large_01.description: A pair of large bat-like demon wings sprouting from the upper back: bony, tapering arm spars with clawed tips support scalloped membranes. The wings sweep outward and upward, with a fantasy, monstrous look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Demon_Large_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the bony spars and joints; colour 1 on the wing membranes.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Demon_Large_01.differs: The wings are posed asymmetrically, with one wing spread out to the side and the other held narrow and upright along the back.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Draco_01.description: A pair of large bat-like mechanical dragon wings rising from the upper back, with a tall curved spiked leading edge, angular armoured plates and long blade-like feathers that fan down to below the knees.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Draco_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the blade-like feather panels and inner struts; colour 1 on the leading-edge armour plates; colour 2 on the gaps and joints; colour 3 on the small gem-like patches on the upper wings.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Draco_01.differs: The wings spread wider from the body than the female version, with the lower blades hanging farther out.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Dragonfly_01.description: Two pairs of translucent dragonfly wings with contrasting vein networks, mounted on a small angular metal hub between the shoulder blades. They sweep outward and slightly back, with the upper pair larger than the lower.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Dragonfly_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central hub and the wing edge frames; colour 1 on the wing membranes near the base; colour 3 on the outer wing membranes; colour 2 on the veins.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Drka_01.description: A pair of large mechanical wings mounted on the upper back: layered angular armored plates at the roots sweep out into long, spiky blade-like feathers that fan upward and outward, giving a sci-fi superhero look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Drka_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armored root plates and their edges; colour 1 on the long blade-like feathers.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Engine_01.description: A pair of mechanical wings mounted on the back: angular armored engine housings with circular turbine details at the base, sweeping into long rows of layered metallic feather blades that angle up and outward.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Engine_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feather blades; colour 1 on the engine housing panels and circular details; colour 2 on the housing frame and undersides.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Fairy_01.description: A pair of slender, fairy-like wings on the upper back, each made of long pointed petal-shaped feathers that fan out and taper into curled tips. Thin trailing tendrils hang down past the hips. Delicate fantasy look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Fairy_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main wing spars and tips; colour 1 on the large fanned petal blades; colour 2 on the curled edge lines and some upper blades; colour 3 on the small accent blades.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_02.description: A single feathered wing attached at the upper back, sweeping outward and up in layered rows of feathers that fan into pointed tips. Folded and compact, it suggests an angelic or superhero look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the feathers nearest the shoulder; colour 1 on the middle band of feathers; colour 2 on the next band; colour 3 on the outer feather tips.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_02.differs: The male wing is held more upright and spread wider across the back, with a broader base.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_03.description: A single feathered wing attached at the shoulder, swept back and out in a long tapering shape. Rows of layered feathers fan from a small wrapped base, with banded bands of feather colour giving a bird-like superhero look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Feather_Multicolor_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the wrapped base at the shoulder; colour 1 on the inner feathers; colour 2 on the middle feather band; colour 3 on the outer feather tips.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Feathered_01.description: A pair of mechanical bladed wings mounted on round socket joints at the shoulder blades. Each wing sweeps up and out in layered, pointed metallic feathers with contrasting tips, suggesting a sci-fi armoured look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Feathered_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the round shoulder sockets; colour 0 on the wing spars and inner feather plates; colour 2 on the outer feather blades; colour 3 on small accents at the joints.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Feathered_01.differs: The male wings are mirrored and spread evenly, so they look symmetrical from the back.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Firewing_01.description: A pair of large feathered butterfly-style wings sprouting from the upper back, with long layered swept-back feathers that taper to pointed tips and a gradient of shades across each feather, flaring wide to both sides.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Firewing_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the feathers, especially the outer front face; colour 1 on the upper feather tips; colour 3 on the inner back feather band; colour 2 on the feathers nearest the spine.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Firewing_02.description: A pair of large static feathered wings sweeping up and outward from the upper back, built from layered spiky feather blades that fan into pointed tips, with shorter feathers hanging low behind the hips.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Firewing_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the outer face of the feathers and the lower feather fringe; colour 1 on the upper wing tips; colour 3 on the inner feather bands on the back; colour 2 on the inner feathers near the spine.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Firewing_03.description: A pair of static, feathered wings sprouting from the upper back, swept up and outward in jagged flame-like feather tips that taper to points, with longer lower feathers hanging past the hips. Suits fantasy, demonic or gothic looks.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Firewing_03.colourAreas: Colour 3 on the outer feather tips and upper wing; colour 2 on the inner wing base and lower feathers; colours 0 and 1 are not visible.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Blade_01.description: A single wing of energy blades attached at the upper back: several long, curved, tapering talon-like blades fan out and sweep upward and back, with a mottled, translucent holographic surface. Suggests a sci-fi or fantasy superhero look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Blade_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing blade; the default energy material ignores the other colour slots and glows uniformly.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Fixed_01.description: A pair of rigid, swept-back mechanical wings on a hexagonal hub at the upper back and shoulders. Each wing is a flat angular blade with layered panels, edge trim and a slot detail. Suits a sci-fi hero.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Fixed_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hub frame and wing edges and undersides; colour 1 on the curved wing panels; colour 2 on the wing sections and hub details; colour 3 on the central hub core.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Holoforce_Fixed_01.differs: The male version has solid panels that take the colour scheme, rather than the female's translucent holographic surface.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Ice_01.description: A pair of wings made of jagged, shard-like ice blades in staggered rows, fanning up and outward from the shoulder blades. The crystalline feathers taper to sharp points and give a fantasy or elemental look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Ice_01.colourAreas: The wings show a glossy crystalline finish that appears to ignore the colour scheme; no separate colour slots are visible.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Ice_01.differs: The male wings rise higher above the shoulders and fan wider, rather than hanging low along the back as the female wings do.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Insecttriple_01.description: Three pairs of translucent insect-style wings fanning out from a small metal hub between the shoulder blades: a long upper pair swept outward, a shorter middle pair, and a lower pair angled down, all with veined membranes.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Insecttriple_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the central hub and wing root fittings; colour 1 on the wing membranes; colour 3 on the veining and lower wing edges.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.description: Two pairs of long, narrow dragonfly wings sprouting from the upper back, each a translucent angular panel with a thin rim and a hexagonal outline, swept outward and slightly back like a mechanical insect.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Mecha_Dragonfly_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the translucent wing panels; colour 0 on the thin edge rims; colour 1 shows as a tint on some wing surfaces.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Megaterak_01.description: A pair of mechanical bat-style wings: jointed metal arm frames with rounded shoulder pods, clawed tips and pleated membrane panels fanning between the struts. They spread outward from the upper back in a sci-fi, cyborg look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Megaterak_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the shoulder pods and joint segments; colour 0 on the strut plating and claw tips; colour 2 on the pleated membrane and the spurs; colour 3 not clearly visible.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_01.description: A single large wing of separate curved, blade-like feather shards that fans out from the upper back, sweeping outward and downward with detached tips floating above. Angular, claw-like and fantasy-styled.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing; no other colour slots are visible on the blades.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_02.description: A pair of flat, tribal-style blade wings with a ring-like hub near the shoulders and long, curved, claw-like feathers sweeping outward and down, plus two tall spikes on top. Sits on the upper back.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_02.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the whole wing surface; the glossy metal edges show highlights and ignore the other colour slots.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Nephilim_02.differs: The male wings sit slightly further out from the back and spread wider, with the two halves overlapping less.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Phoenixflight_01.description: A single large translucent energy wing sweeping out from the upper back, made of layered feather-like streaks that taper into long ragged tips; suggests a flaming phoenix wing in a superhero style.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Phoenixflight_01.colourAreas: Colour scheme appears largely ignored by the glowing energy material; the whole wing shows one glowing tone rather than distinct slots.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Reactor_01.description: A pair of mechanical wings on long jointed metal support arms that reach out from the upper back. Each wing has a sleek housing with a round joint, angular blades and layered feather-like panels that sweep back.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Reactor_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the support arms, housings and upper blades; colour 1 on the lower feather panels and joint rings; colour 3 on small accent marks on the housings; colour 2 on the darkest lower feathers.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Reactor_01.differs: The male wings are spread as two clearly separate side-by-side wings on parallel arms, held lower and wider apart.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Scarab_01.description: A pair of insect-style wings mounted on the upper back: each has a curved, hard shell-like plate at the shoulder and a long, tapering membrane with fine radiating veins, spread wide and angled outward.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Scarab_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the curved shoulder shell plates; colour 2 on the wing membranes; colour 3 on the vein lines and wing edges.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Scarab_01.differs: The male wings spread wider and higher, with larger shell plates that arch further out over the shoulders.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Scarab_02.description: Butterfly-style wings: two large upper wings sweeping up and out and two long, narrow lower wings sweeping down, with jagged edges. Glossy cell-like veined panels give the wings a mechanical insectoid look, attached at the upper back.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Scarab_02.colourAreas: Colour 2 on most of the wing surfaces; colour 1 on the veined panels of the wing faces; colour 0 on the edge trim. The glossy material largely ignores the scheme.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Scarab_02.differs: The male wings show a visible honeycomb of veined cell panels across each wing, and the wings are broader.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Shadow_01.description: A single wing of ragged, smoky shadow rising from the upper back and sweeping outward and back, splitting into long tapering feather-like tendrils with wispy frayed edges. Suggests a dark, spectral fantasy look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Shadow_01.colourAreas: The wing is a energy effect that seems to ignore the colour scheme; no visible use of colour slots 0-3.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Space_01.description: A pair of mechanical wing blades mounted on the upper back: angular armoured shoulder joints with circular details sweep out into long, narrow blade-like feathers, with slim struts angling down along the back.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Space_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the armoured joints and struts; colour 1 on the long blade panels and inner sections; colour 3 on the small circular lights and accents; colour 2 on the recessed joint details.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Spooky_01.description: A single large bat-like demon wing rising from the upper back, with a thick jagged spiked bone frame and thin membrane stretched between long fingers that taper to points. Gothic, monstrous look.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Spooky_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the spiked bone frame and edges; colour 0 on the upper membrane; colour 1 on the membrane tips and lower edges.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Spooky_01.differs: The male wing spreads wider and angles further back, with fingers fanning behind the body rather than out to the side.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Statue_01.description: A pair of large feathered angel-style wings rising from the upper back, with rows of long layered flight feathers, a thick rounded leading edge and a bulky shoulder joint. The wings sweep up and out, then taper downward.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Statue_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the feather surfaces; colour 0 on the feather highlights and tips; colour 2 on the leading edge and shoulder joint; colour 3 on small markings on the wings.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Statue_01.differs: The male wings sit wider apart, with a broader gap between them and a chunkier shoulder joint.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Tech_01.description: A pair of static mechanical wings: each has a long blade-like upper spar and a fan of narrow blade feathers, mounted on segmented shoulder brackets. They sweep outward and back from the upper back, in a sci-fi style.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Tech_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spars, feather blades and shoulder brackets; colour 1 on the support struts and the spar tips; colour 2 on small joint details.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Tech_01.differs: The wings spread wider apart, with a more open, splayed set of spars, whereas the female pair sits closer together and tighter to the back.

Male/M_Wings_Tight_Tech_Flap_01.description: A pair of small mechanical wings mounted high on the upper back: each has a long bladed top spar with a pointed tip and a fan of narrow segmented blade feathers below, joined at a segmented hinge column near the spine.
Male/M_Wings_Tight_Tech_Flap_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the spars and blade feathers; colour 1 on the tips and hinge brackets; colour 2 on the joint inserts.

Male/M_Wings_Winterevent_2025_01.description: A pair of large snowflake-shaped wings on the back, each a radiating starburst of spiky branches with smaller side barbs and diamond-shaped blade tips, hanging low and splayed out beside the hips and legs.
Male/M_Wings_Winterevent_2025_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the branch arms and barbs; colour 1 on the central inner blades near the spine; colour 2 on the diamond tips.
Male/M_Wings_Winterevent_2025_01.differs: The male wings sit much lower, centred around the hips and legs, and the two halves are separated by a clear gap at the centre instead of overlapping the shoulders.

Male/Meo_Chestlayer_Tight_Pelt_01.description: A shaggy fur mantle draped over the shoulders, upper chest and upper back, with a wide open neck. Long ragged tufts hang in a V at the front and a broad fan at the back, giving a rugged, feral look.
Male/Meo_Chestlayer_Tight_Pelt_01.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the main body of the fur; colour 1 on the tips and lower tufts; colour 2 on the darker underlying patches near the neck and in the fur roots.

Male/Uarml_Robotexo_Arm_01_Cyborg.description: A single mechanical replacement arm: a bulky segmented shoulder cap in a ringed socket, exposed piston-like upper arm with joint nodes, and a banded forearm with ribbed cylinders, worn on one arm only.
Male/Uarml_Robotexo_Arm_01_Cyborg.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the shoulder rim, forearm bands and cuff; colour 1 on the segmented shoulder and arm casings; colour 2 on the joint nodes and inner mechanics; colour 3 on the shoulder socket lining.

Male/Uarmr_Robotexo_Arm_01_Cyborg.description: A single mechanical arm replacing one sleeve: a bulky ribbed shoulder joint in a rimmed socket, thin exposed cable-like forearm struts, and a ringed elbow and wrist collar. It looks like a cyborg prosthetic.
Male/Uarmr_Robotexo_Arm_01_Cyborg.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the ribbed shoulder and forearm segments; colour 0 on the shoulder rim, elbow rings and wrist cuff; colour 3 on the shoulder socket lining; colour 2 on the joints and cabling.

Male/Vehicle_Glider_Rocker_M_01.description: A flat hover-glider platform the wearer stands on, with swept bat-like wings, speaker cones on the front and sides, twin exhaust pipes on boxy housings at the rear, and a central fin at the back. Rock-concert styling.
Male/Vehicle_Glider_Rocker_M_01.colourAreas: Colour 2 on the main deck, wings and housings; colour 3 on the central fin, underside panel and small accents; colour 1 on star patterns and deck markings; colour 0 on the speaker cones and exhaust tips.

Male/Vehicle_Horse_01.description: A mechanical horse mount lying horizontally beneath the rider: armoured horse head and body with a saddle, rear rocket thruster cluster, side exhaust pipes and a long lance-like rod trailing below. Sci-fi hover-steed styling.
Male/Vehicle_Horse_01.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the head, neck and body plating; colour 0 on the saddle, muzzle and side pipes; colour 2 on the hooves, leg joints and mane sections; colour 3 on the saddle blanket and rod tip.

Male/Vehicle_Horse_02.description: A mechanical horse vehicle body with an armored horse head and neck, a contrasting saddle-like torso panel, studded mane ridge, long exhaust pipes flaring out sideways, and a lance-like rod along the underside; the rider sits above it.
Male/Vehicle_Horse_02.colourAreas: Colour 1 on the head and neck armor; colour 0 on the muzzle, exhaust pipes and rod fittings; colour 2 on the torso panel and ear interiors; colour 3 on the rod tip and small accents.

Male/Vehicle_Horse_03.description: A vehicle attachment shaped like a compact cluster of five flared thruster nozzles on a boxy hull with a swept, curved panel. It floats at the hips and behind the legs, suggesting a rocket-powered mechanical steed.
Male/Vehicle_Horse_03.colourAreas: Colour 0 on the hull ridges and the collars between the nozzles; colour 1 on the swept front panel and the nozzle rims; colour 2 on the nozzle interiors and the hull underside; colour 3 is not clearly visible.
